original:
Skyrim Expedition - Day 19

We have spent two whole days stumbling almost blindly in the dark, and then suddenly there it was! Nchuanthumz! It is here that Klorgic and Duramac built their home! It was once a grand palace, but time and negligence have humbled its mechanical splendor. Nevertheless, by making this discovery, we have etched our places in history.

Skyrim Expedition - Day 20

What a fool I am! To think I could control these mechanical puppets as Duramac did. Based on my notes, it seems I must summon a dwarven sphere overseer and provide it with the following parts: 3 large cogs 3 actuators 1 units of oil But alas, I am a historian, and the language of machines is foreign to me. I've managed to figure out how to summon the overseer by pressing the side buttons on the panel, but I wouldn't know what an actuator was even if it smacked me in the face. For now, I must rest and regain my strength. I am so tired...
traduit:
天际远征-第十九天

在黑暗中跌跌撞撞整整两天，突然，它就出现了！尼楚瑟姆兹！克罗吉克和杜拉马克建造的家园就在此地！曾经的恢弘宫殿与机械，因年久失修而黯然失色。然而，凭这一番发现，就足以让我们留名史册了。

天际远征-第二十天

我真是个蠢货！想着我也能像杜拉马克那样操纵这些机械。按我的笔记，似乎必须召唤一个矮人机械球工头，然后提供以下东西： 3个大型齿轮 3个制动器 1单位的油 但是，哎，我是个历史学家，这些机械的语言对我来说太陌生了。我已经设法弄清楚如何通过控制面板上的按钮来召唤工头，但就算你把制动器怼到我脸上，我也认不出来。 现在，我必须休息一下，恢复体力。我太累了……

original:
Skyrim Expedition - Day 1

I have arrived in Skyrim to solve a single mystery, to find the lost sanctuary of Nchuanthumz. According to legend, it was built by the famed Dwemer architects, Klorgic and Duramac, the latter of whom is said to be a distant relative of the great Dumac Dwarfking. While the two began as rivals, through mutual respect and admiration they eventually became friends, and over time, much more. Whereas Klorgic was an architect of great renown, his palatial estates suffered from their excess - the size of his rooms matched only by their emptinesss. Duramac, on the other hand, was a genius engineer, but lacked the artistic vision to allow his inventions to reach their full potential. It's only when they joined forces to create Nchuanthumz that they built something truly profound. If I am to find their creation, I must grasp history itself by the tail.

Skyrim Expedition - Day 17

Our travels have brought us to this bleak, underground tunnel, which the natives call Frostroot Cave. Its winding cords of ice and rock make it truly a miserable place. My scales feel chilly, but more so my nerves. Luckily we've hired a few soldiers of fortune into our employ. Some would call them bandits, but I like to refer to them as mercenaries at a discount! Hopefully I can convince them not to touch the artifacts and keep the scrap instead.
traduit:
天际远征-第一天

我来到天际是为了解开一个谜题，寻找尼楚瑟姆兹的失落避难所。据说它是由著名的锻莫建筑师克罗吉克和杜拉马克建造的，后者还是矮人王杜马克的远房亲戚。 两人虽然一开始是对头，但因为彼此敬重，最终成了朋友，随着时间的推移，他们的关系越来越好。 虽然克罗吉克是个有名的建筑师，但他宏伟的庄园却存在问题：房间宽敞无比却十分空旷。另一方面，虽然杜拉马克是个天才工程师，却缺乏艺术眼光，无法让发明充分发挥潜力。 只等他们联手创造尼楚瑟姆兹时，才真正创造了一些深刻的东西。如果想要找到他们的造物，就必须抓住历史的尾巴。

天际远征-第十七天

我们一路旅行来到这个荒凉的地下隧道，当地人管这里叫做霜根洞穴。蜿蜒的冰和岩石把这里变得凄惨无比。我的鳞片冻得发冷，神经更甚。 所幸我们雇佣了几个寻求财富的打手。有些人把他们叫做强盗，但我更喜欢叫他们打折雇佣兵！只希望我能说服他们不要碰拿些完好的器物，只留些碎片。

original: Assembly Line Constructs
traduit: 装配线机械

original:
<font face='$HandwrittenFont'>According to my research, Duramac's constructs were meant to clean and organize the living space. Klorgic was creative but messy, his thoughts a scramble that only Duramac understood.

While the centurion and sphere assembly lines are damaged beyond repair, the spider construct can thankfully do the same work, albeit at a bit slower pace. The assembly line can be powered by placing a dynamo in the actuator, which should provide the energy required to build the construct.

Once the construct is built, I'll need to activate the levers in the house to have it renovate various sections of the home. By my calculations, each section should take no longer than a day to finish.</font>
traduit:
<font face='$HandwrittenFont'>根据我的研究，杜拉马克的机械是用来清洁和组织生活空间的。克罗吉克很有创造力，也很混乱，他乱七八糟的思想只有杜拉马克能理解得了。

百夫长和机械球的装配线都已经损坏得没法修复了，但谢天谢地，机械蜘蛛也能做同样的工作，只是速度会慢点。需要在执行器里放一个动力核心来供能，这样装配线就能工作了。

等机械造好了，我就拉动房间里的拉杆，让它翻新房子的各个部分。根据我的计算，每部分的翻新时间不超过一天。</font>

original:
<font face='$HandwrittenFont'>Five Hands served Her once. Yet those numbers have dwindled, and as I deign to stand here alongside hedge wizards, sellswords, and other vermin on two legs, I cannot help but weep for the Lady and her station.

Still, I will not allow them access to the armory. They do not deserve the honor of wearing the sacred garb. To do so means you are an extension of the Goddess. Our bodies and soul belong to Her, and are fortified by her divine magic. So it was for my ancestors, and so it is for me. 

As such, I will not see my Lady's hands covered in filth. The Matriarch may have granted them a place on the dais, but while they stand eye to eye, they are still beneath us. And so, they are beneath Her.

I would slay every last one of them, but I stay my hand for Her sake. As long as they are loyal and do the Lady's bidding, I will allow their hearts to remain beating against their soiled flesh.</font>
traduit:
<font face='$HandwrittenFont'>想当年五位手掌使效忠于她。可如今数量却越来越少，我现在只能屈尊和什么树篱法师、佣兵和其他两条腿的害虫站在一起，我不仅为女神如今的地位而垂泪。

但我不会让他们接近军械库。他们不配享有穿上神圣装束的荣誉。穿上就意味着你是女神的眼神。我们的身体灵魂都将属于她，并被她的神圣魔力所强化。我的祖先如是，我亦如是。

因此，我绝不允许女神之手沾染污秽。女教长可以给他们安排一席之地，但他们要在我们之下。只有这样，他们才能在她之下。

谁来我就杀谁，但我的手只为她而动。只要他们忠心耿耿听从女神的旨意，我就允许他们的心继续在肮脏的肉体中跳动。</font>

original:
<font face='$HandwrittenFont'><font size='20'>
Priestess Velothi,

You or whoever's reading this, I need your help. Well, that's a stupid thing to write, of course you're reading this, you wouldn't be staring at a piece of paper and not read it, would you?

Not unless you're illiterate or mad. Not "angry" mad but "I clip my toenails with a fork" mad. You get what I mean.

Point is, I think I've found it. The Mask of Sotha Sil, in Kagrenzel, a Dwarven labyrinth with a surprsingly high vowel count. It's high up on the Velothi Mountains, and you're a Velothi too! Funny how that works out. 

There's just one problem. I caught myself in some contraption, and now I'm not sure where I am. We've decided to make camp here, and have one of the mercs I hired find help. He can't write or read or put together a coherent thought, but that's why I'm giving him this letter. 

Really, I should have just taken the mask and left the orb. You'd think I'd know better than to fall for a trap that obvious. But the orb was glowing and cute and looked kind of lonely. 

Side note, if you come rescue me, DO NOT touch the orb.</font>
traduit:
<font face='$HandwrittenFont'><font size='20'>
维洛锡祭司：

不管是谁在看这封信，我需要帮助。好吧，这么写是有点傻，当然如果你正在读这封信，你总不会只是盯着纸看而不读吧？

除非你是文盲或是疯子。不是“生气的”疯子，我说的是“我拿叉子剪脚趾甲”的疯子。你明白吧。

重点是，我应该是找到了。索萨·希尔的面具，就在卡格雷泽尔，名字又臭又长的矮人迷宫。就在维洛锡山脉的高处，巧了，你也是维洛锡！多有意思。

只是有一个问题。我被某个装置困住了，现在也不知道在什么位置。我们决定先扎营，让我雇的佣兵去找人帮忙。他不识字也不读书，脑子也乱得很，所以我才写了这封信。

我真该只把面具拿走，不管那颗球的。你也觉得我不该掉进这么明显的陷阱吧。但那个球发着光，很可爱，看起来还有点孤独。

注，如果来救我，别碰那个球。</font>

original:
<font face='$HandwrittenFont'>
You have lost the temple, but you are not lost. The right place exists in the wrong time. 

Know that when the great egg Baar Dau cracked open, from its rotten yolk spilled the Dissident Priests and heretics, full of lies and falsehoods that give shape to Othreloth and his Reclamation. But in reality the bile spewed by the Lie Rock cannot fool a Minister of Truth for long.

The Tribunal will rise once more, and the Grand Inquisitors will judge all from the beginning. For entry to our temple is the ending of words, ALMSIVI.</font>
traduit:
<font face='$HandwrittenFont'>
你以为失去了神殿，但事实并非如此。正确的地方出现在了错误的时间。

要知道，当巨蛋巴尔·达乌被打碎，腐坏的蛋黄中流出了异见的祭司和教徒，他们满口谎言与谬误，正是这些谎言塑造了欧斯瑞罗斯和他的收复者。但事实上，谎石喷吐的愤怒无法永远愚弄真理部长。

审判席将会重新复兴，大审判官们会重新审判一切。因为进入我们神殿的是最后之语——阿玛希维。</font>

original:
The Goddess commands you to recover the artifacts of her fellow God-Kings. We have received word that the Mask of Vivec is being transported from Raven Rock to an unknown ship at the dock. We don't know the destination, only that to ensure secrecy, multiple couriers are being used to hide the identity of the mask bearer. However, our contact at the docks says the courier is a member of the guard who patrols the Bulwark, and he has plans of his own for the mask. He's arranged a meeting with a buyer after midnight, at an unknown location. His greed angers the Goddess. Track the guard's movements, dispose of them both and return the artifact to her rightful hands. In addition, the Goddess' temple is in need of new servants, both to restore this temple and to provide valuable services. Speak to Priest Drureth. He will hand you a letter to be delivered to the banished priestess, Aphia Velothi in Raven Rock. She is a friend to the Tribunal, and will translate it so that it can be passed to the common folk. When you meet her, be sure to also inquire about the whereabouts of our apothecary, Curate Melita. She had been in search of the Mask of Sotha Sil. Succeed and you will gain access to the Goddess' armory. Fail and you will incur her wrath. The law is as the Goddess commands.

ASV

女神命令你找回她们三位神王的面具。我们收到消息，维威克的面具正从鸦石镇被运送到码头某个未知的船上。我们不知道目的地，只知道为了保密，他们派了多名信使来隐藏真正的面具持有者。 然而，我们在码头的线人说真正的信使是负责在防护堤巡逻的一个卫兵，他自己也想处置面具。他安排了在午夜后与买家见面，地点不详。 他的贪婪激怒了女神。跟踪那个卫兵的行踪，把他们两个都杀掉，然后把神器物归原主。 此外，女神的神殿需要新的追随者来修复，并提供有价值的服务。和德鲁雷斯祭司谈谈。他会给你一封信，转交给鸦石镇被放逐的女祭司阿菲娅·维洛锡。她是审判席的朋友，她会负责翻译，以便传播给普通民众。 你见到她的时候，一定打听一下我们的药剂师兼副祭司梅丽塔的下落。她一直在寻找索萨·希尔的面具。 任务成功，你就可以进入女神的军械库。失败，就会招致她的怒火。女神的旨意就是法律。

original:
I live to serve only Her. Always Her. I have found the forge, and when its spark is lit, her fire will burn. The Spectre once worked the gears of this swollen machine, but I no longer require his service. The mechanism is simple. With this vial of Pyroil Tar, I have all that is required to ignite it. Tar lit the flame once before, and tar will do so again. And when I return triumphant, fire in hand, she will embrace me once more. But I have a problem. The machine requires four gems to power it, and I have procured only one. The others, it seems, are still out there. Yet I have no doubt that as Her chosen, she will guide me to them. For now, I will return to the temple. The entrance sits above the mine in Raven Rock, perched atop cliffs of basalt. But even if one finds the cave, only the devout know the way inside the temple. I spin the words and the way opens.

ASV
traduit:
我活着只为效忠她。只有她。 我已经找到了锻炉，等它的火花点燃，她的火焰也会重新燃烧。幽灵曾经操纵过这个庞大机器的齿轮，但我不再需要他帮忙了。机制很简单。有了这瓶皮罗依焦油，我就能够点燃它了。 焦油过去曾经点燃过火焰，现在还能再度点燃。等我凯旋，手握火焰，她就会再次拥抱我了。 但还有个问题。机器需要四颗宝石来驱动，我只找到一颗。其他的，似乎还在那里。但没关系，身为她选中之人，我会得到她的指引。 现在该回神殿了。入口在鸦石镇矿场上方，坐落在山崖上。但即使有人找到了洞穴，也只有虔信之人才知道进去的路。我会转动文字把路打开。

ASV

original: Priest Arthamis' Note
traduit: 阿萨米斯祭司的纸条

original:
<font face='$HandwrittenFont'>
The Matriarch does not speak of what remains locked behind the gate. She says our way is to serve the Goddess and the Tribunal. 

But Erden was right. The artifact speaks to us. I feel its heartbeat rattling in my head like a loose rock. Rattle, rattle, rattle. A curious song. Not a heart of blood, but stone.  

Yet the gate remains for all intents and purposes, impenetrable. I see no levers or chains. No secret buttons under the display cases. 

There is nothing here save a few broken pillars and the mannequins. In fact, I grew so weary of their stares I covered their faces with masks. It was not until that moment that the solution came to me.

What if the mannequins themselves are the key? Three faces, and three masks. A Tribunal. But which mask goes on which face?

When memory fails, I go to the sculptor's room, and pray at the shrines so that I can match blessing to symbol. I feel now I can solve the puzzle, but without the masks, it is useless.

Erden hates it when I worry. He tells me to be patient, that masks or not, our master will show us the way. I have no choice but to believe.</font>
traduit:
<font face='$HandwrittenFont'>
女教长没有提及门后还锁着什么。只说我们在侍奉女神和审判席。

但厄尔登是对的。那件神器会对我们说话。我能感受到它的心跳在我的脑海里像松动的岩石一样嘎达作响。嘎达，嘎达，嘎达。一首古怪的乐曲。而且不是血肉之心，而是石头的。

但不管怎样，那扇门仍然不可逾越。我没看到拉杆或链条。陈列柜下也没有隐藏的按钮。

这里除了几根破碎的柱子和几个人体模型外什么都没有。而且我也烦透了它们的凝视，就用面具遮住了他们的脸。直到此时，我才想到解决办法。

如果人体模型本身就是钥匙呢？三张脸，三个面具。审判席。但究竟该怎么对应呢？

记忆不清的时候，我就去雕刻家的房间，在祭坛前祈祷，这样我就能把祝福与象征匹配起来。我觉得现在能解开这个谜题了，但没有面具，也是无用。

厄尔登讨厌我忧心忡忡的样子。告诉我要有耐心，不管有没有面具，主人都会给我们指明道路。别无选择，唯有相信。</font>

original: Priest Drureth's Journal
traduit: 德鲁雷斯祭司的日记

original:
<font face='$HandwrittenFont'>
The temple is almost complete, but there is work to be done. So much work, and not enough hands. 

Where once stood an army, now only a dozen of us remain.

This would not be the case if the Matriarch had delivered justice to the Diviner, Erden Relvel, for his blasphemous comments about the Corpus. 

Instead she offered him exile, which to me was more reward than punishment. Worse yet, he was allowed to sway Arthamis and a few others to join him.

We cannot afford to let sentimentality affect our decisions. I need to remind her, we are at war, and every Dunmer lost is a soldier for the enemy.</font>
traduit:
<font face='$HandwrittenFont'>
神殿虽然已经基本竣工，但还有很多工作要做。然而人手却不够了。

曾经足以驻扎一支军队的地方，如今只剩我们十几个人。

如果女教长能够对占卜师厄尔登·雷尔维尔关于枯萎病的亵渎言论主持正义，情况不会是这样。

相反，她将之流放，依我看这与其说是惩罚，不如说是奖赏。更糟糕的是，他还被允许左右阿萨米斯等其他几个人加入他。

我们不能再感情用事了。我必须提醒她，我们是在打仗，每失去一个丹莫就是多了一个敌人。</font>

original: Matriarch Drevlan's Journal
traduit: 女教长德蕾维安的日记

original:
<font face='$HandwrittenFont'>When I first entered the great chamber, I was there again, in the High Chapel, nestled in her glow. 

Great pillars surrounded the stone where the Goddess Almalexia once stood. As if it were washed in the fire, Mournhold had shed its skin to reveal a temple of rock and bone.

I knew then that this stone was the heart of our Goddess. And through faith, love, and sweat, we have slowly restored Her flesh. 

Now that she is almost complete, my thoughts turn to my old friend, Erden Relvel. He was the Diviner whose scrying brought us to this holy place. Without him, none of this would be possible. Yet time and toil changed him, to the point I questioned his devotion. Wherever he is, I hope he has regained his love for Her.

Regardless, our work does not end there. With Her Hands to guide me, we will rid this world of her dissidents. We will reunite the fires of hope and truth under Her banner and theirs, and let the light of ALMSIVI shine on servants and apostates alike.</font>
traduit:
<font face='$HandwrittenFont'>当我第一次走进大殿，我又回到了那里，在至高礼堂，依偎在她的光芒中。

巨大的柱子环绕着阿玛莱西亚女神曾经站立的地方。仿佛在火中被洗刷过一样，哀伤之城褪去了皮肤，露出了用岩石和骨头筑成的神殿。

我知道这块石头就是我们女神的心脏。通过信仰、爱与汗水，我们就能慢慢恢复她的肉身。

现在她基本完成了，我的思绪转向了我的老朋友，厄尔登·雷尔维尔。他是把我们带到这个圣地的占卜者。没有他，这一切都不可能实现。然而时间和辛劳之下，他变了，以至于我开始怀疑他是否忠诚。无论他到那里，我都希望他能重新爱上她。

无论如何，我们的工作并没有就此结束。在阿玛莱西亚之手的指引下，我们会把异见者从世界上清除掉。我们会在她与他们的旗帜下重新点燃希望与真理的火焰，让阿玛希维的光芒照耀一切追随者与叛徒。</font>

original: Erden Relvel's Note
traduit: 厄尔登·雷尔维尔的纸条

original:
<font face='$HandwrittenFont'>
I was told that without the masks, the gate would not open, but the priests underestimate my master's will.

It was Dagoth Ur who opened the gate, and beckoned me forward. And when I wear his face, I speak his truth, and from his words I spawn the cure that will spread across the world.

My temple brother, Arthamis, was the first to receive its blessing. His once melancholy face has been carved into the most delightful shape, and his mouth stitched into a comely smile. He must be quite pleased with the changes, as I have heard no complaints. I feel now that he is truly happy. 

You may have already met him - slain him with Her Hand. Perhaps you have met all my master's little pets as they descended on Her temple. I knew this would happen. For there must come a time when the Tribunal's champion will challenge my master, as the Nerevarine once did.

The Tribunal has three heads, and you wear them all. And so, by opening the way, you are worthy of dying by my master's hand.

Come to the graveyard by Tel Mithryn. My master's creatures will dine on you there.</font>
traduit:
<font face='$HandwrittenFont'>
有人告诉我，没有面具，就打不开大门。但祭司们低估了我主人的意志。

达格斯·乌尔亲自打开了大门，招呼我上前。让我戴上的他面容，道出他的真言，从他的神谕中演化出治愈的办法，传播到全世界。

我的同道阿萨米斯是第一个接受祝福之人。他曾经忧郁的脸被雕刻成了最可爱的形状，嘴被缝成了美丽的微笑。他一定会对这些变化十分满意，因为我没有听到任何抱怨。现在我觉得他真的很快乐。

你可能已经见过他，和阿玛莱西亚之手一起杀了他。也许你也在她的神殿见过我主人的其他小宠物。我知道发生了什么。因为总有一天，审判席的勇士会向我主发起挑战，就像当年的尼瑞瓦因一样。

审判席有三个头，你都带着吧。既然你能打开门，就应该死在我主手里。

到泰尔·米斯瑞恩的墓地来吧。我主的造物会在那里把你啃食殆尽。</font>

original: Matriarch Drevlan's Note
traduit: 女教长德蕾维安的纸条

original:
Rumors have long stalked the temple halls of the return of The Sharmat, spreader of Corpus, the corrupter of hearts, the architect of the Akulakhan. I speak, of course, of the blighted one, Dagoth Ur. We now know this word has been spread by a traitorous priest who once served Her faithfully. The Diviner, necromancer, and my former friend, Erden Relvel. It is his creations that accosts Her temple, but I know not the source of his power. My fear is the truth may be found in the armory. Before we began building this temple, my predecessor gave me a gift. Or rather, a responsibility. A box. The box was to be placed in the armory, but never opened. In fact, his voice stumbled at the mere mention of it, and his hands gripped the edges as if to drop it would shatter the world. As such, I heeded his warning when he begged me never to look inside. To this day, I do not know how to open the rear gate. Yet the restoration of this temple has required many hands, and not all of them Hers. It's possible someone has found a way inside. Take the armory key I have given you and investigate the area. Only with the full power of the Tribunal, and our Goddess' will, can evil be vanquished.

ASV
traduit:
长久以来，神殿中一直传播着萨玛特回归的谣言。他是枯萎病的传播者，心脏的腐化者，阿库拉可汗的建造者。当然，我说的这些都是已经被摧毁的达格斯·乌尔。 这个消息是由一个曾经服侍过女神的叛徒祭司传播的。占卜师、死灵法师，也是我曾经的朋友，厄尔登·雷尔维尔。 就是他派遣生物来进攻神殿，但我不知道他力量的来源。我担心真相可能在军械库中。 在我们开始建造这所神殿之前，我的前任就给了我一份礼物。更确切的说，是一份责任。那是一个盒子。 盒子本来是要放在军械库里的，但从来没有打开过。当时，只要一提起它，他的声音就会断断续续，他的手紧紧抓住它，仿佛只要它一掉下来，世界就会破碎。因此，当他恳求我不要往里面看的时候，我听从了他的警告。直到今天，我还不知道怎么打开后门。 然而修复神殿需要很多人手，而且也不全是女神的信徒。可能有人找到了进去的方法。

ASV

original: Reclamation Priest's Journal
traduit: 收复者祭司的日记

original:
<font face='$HandwrittenFont'>
The audacity of these Tribunal heretics knows no limit. The downright temerity of their priests, to think they can spread their heresy in plain view of the Reclamation, is an affront to the senses.

Yet this arrogance shall be their downfall. I will gather the guard and cleanse this temple in the name of the true gods.
</font>
traduit:
<font face='$HandwrittenFont'>
这些审判席的异端胆大妄为毫无底线。那些祭司居然认为可以在收复者的注视下明目张胆传播自己的异端邪说，简直是一种侮辱。

original:
<font face="$HandwrittenFont" size="18">
For twenty years all I've been is a loyal guard. I do what I'm supposed to, pay my taxes, and pray to the Gods. But they return me no favors.

I pray for riches, and I get guard duty. I pray for a good woman, and I get more guard duty.

Now I'm supposed to deliver this expensive-looking mask to the Temple. Well, it's time I made my own luck. I'm selling the thing to this Imperial I met at the Netch.

I'll just tell the priests the bloody mask got swallowed by a guar, so good luck finding it now. 

Twenty years and I've never spoken a lie. They'll have no choice but to believe me.
</font>
traduit:
<font face="$HandwrittenFont" size="18">
二十年来，我一直是忠诚的卫兵。尽忠职守，按时纳税，向神祈祷。但他们没有回报我。

我祈求财富，却得到了卫兵的任务。我祈祷娶个好姑娘，却得到更多的卫兵任务。

现在派我去把这个看着就很贵的面具送到神殿去。好啊，是时候自己创造运气了。我要把这东西卖给我在气母遇到的帝国人。

我会告诉那群祭司，那倒霉的面具被瓜尔吞了，要找就自谋多福吧。

二十年了，我从没说过谎。但他们别无选择，只能相信我。
</font>

original:
<font face='$HandwrittenFont'>
Kenro was a strange one. Always skulking about, perusing my wares, but never buying. 

I'd ask him if he wanted a sword, and he'd say, "Not today." 

So I'd ask him if he'd fancy a set of armor. And again he says, "Not today."

Every day for a month, the same song and dance. Not today, not tomorrow, not ever. Or so I thought.

One day I open the shop, check my wares, and find a mistake in the shipment. Inside the crate is an odd blue gem, lumped in with the usual iron and steel. Figuring it for a mistake, I was about to send it back, when Kenro walks in the store.

I give him the usual greeting, and ask him if he wants to buy some wares, fully expecting him to say the words, "Not today." 

But to my surprise, he doesn't. Today, he wants to buy. 

He doesn't want a sword or a shield. He wants the gem. As he hands me the coin, I get a strange feeling in the pit of my stomach, like this is the last time I'll see him. So I ask him where he's headed. He tells me he's going to see a blacksmith. I'm not sure if that's a joke, seeing as I run the forge. 

When I ask him which smith, he tells me, a Dwarven one. In Fahlbtharz.

My face goes white. Kenro says, "You look like you've seen a ghost." 

I say to him, "No, have you?" And he just smiles.</font>
traduit:
<font face='$HandwrittenFont'>
肯罗是个怪人。常偷偷摸摸端详我的商品，却从来不买。

我问他要不要买把剑，他却说，“今天不行”。

我又问他要不来套盔甲，他又说，“今天不行”。

一个月了天天如此。今天不行，明天不行，永远不行。至少我是这么想的。

有一天，我开店检查货物，发现里面有些问题。箱子里有一块奇怪的蓝色宝石，和普通的钢铁混在一起。我觉得是送错了，正要把它送回去，这时候肯罗走进店里。

我同往常一样跟他打招呼，问他想不想买点啥，满心期待他会接着说：“今天不行”。

但出乎我意料，他没说。今天，他打算买了。

他既不买剑也不买盾牌，而是想要那块宝石。当他把金币递给我的时候，我有一种奇怪的感觉，好像这会是我最后一次见他一样。我问他要去哪里，他跟我说去见个铁匠。我不确定这是不是个玩笑，毕竟我正经营铁匠铺。

我问他是哪个铁匠，他跟我说，是个矮人，在法尔巴塔兹。

我的脸瞬间变白。肯罗说：“你看着像是见了鬼一样。”

我跟他说：“没有，你呢？”他只是笑。</font>

original:
The Goddess commands you to recover the artifacts of her fellow God-Kings. We have received word that the Mask of Vivec is being transported from Raven Rock to an unknown ship at the dock. We don't know the destination, only that to ensure secrecy, multiple couriers are being used to hide the identity of the mask bearer. However, our contact at the docks says the courier is a member of the guard who patrols the Bulwark, and he has plans of his own for the mask. He's arranged a meeting with a buyer after midnight, at an unknown location. His greed angers the Goddess. Dispose of them both and return the artifact to her rightful hands. In addition, the Goddess' temple is in need of new servants, both to restore this temple and to provide valuable services. Speak to Priest Drureth. He will hand you a letter to be delivered to the banished priestess, Aphia Velothi in Raven Rock. She is a friend to the Tribunal, and will translate it so that it can be passed to the common folk. When you meet her, be sure to also inquire about the whereabouts of our apothecary, Curate Melita. She had been in search of the Mask of Sotha Sil. Succeed and you will gain access to the Goddess' armory. Fail and you will incur her wrath. The law is as the Goddess commands.

ASV
traduit:
女神命令你找回她们三位神王的面具。我们收到消息，维威克的面具正从鸦石镇被运送到码头某个未知的船上。我们不知道目的地，只知道为了保密，他们派了多名信使来隐藏真正的面具持有者。 然而，我们在码头的线人说真正的信使是负责在防护堤巡逻的一个卫兵，他自己也想处置面具。他安排了在午夜后与买家见面，地点不详。 他的贪婪激怒了女神。把他们两个都杀掉，然后把神器物归原主。 此外，女神的神殿需要新的追随者来修复，并提供有价值的服务。和德鲁雷斯祭司谈谈。他会给你一封信，转交给鸦石镇被放逐的女祭司阿菲娅·维洛锡。她是审判席的朋友，她会负责翻译，以便传播给普通民众。 你见到她的时候，一定打听一下我们的药剂师兼副祭司梅丽塔的下落。她一直在寻找索萨·希尔的面具。 任务成功，你就可以进入女神的军械库。失败，就会招致她的怒火。女神的旨意就是法律。

<font face='$HandwrittenFont'>Indobar's a riot. Every day he reminds us how we're not worthy to wear his precious Ordinator armor, even though I'm pretty sure if push came to shove, I could take him.

But since I'm not good enough to be Her Hand, just for fun I started calling myself Almalexia's Toe. Dirty little toe at that, with a lot of ash under the nail.

Anyways, I tossed the idea to Indobar, and knocked back another pint as the veins on his forehead started popping. I also offered to anoint Sindras as Almalexia's navel, because why not? There's enough body parts on her ladyship for all of us. 

Indobar didn't think it was very funny. Must be in the blood. Same goes for me, after all. My ancestors were Armigers. Loyal to Vivec, and more importantly, knew how to take a joke.

Can't tell whose side Sindras is on, but you can't really get a read on what the mage thinks, given he's got a mushroom on his head.</font>
traduit:
<font face='$HandwrittenFont'>因多巴尔就是个灾难。他每天都在提醒我们，说我们不配穿上他珍贵的协调使盔甲，尽管我很确信，如果逼急了我，他不是我的对手。

但由于我还不足以成为阿玛莱西亚之手，出于好玩儿，我给自己取了个外号叫阿玛莱西亚的脚趾头。小脚趾很脏，指甲下面还有很多泥。

不管怎样，我把这个想法抛给了因多巴尔，又喝了一大杯，他额头上的血管都要爆裂了。我还提议管辛德拉斯叫阿玛列西亚的肚脐眼儿，有啥不好的？女神身上的零部件够我们分了。

因多巴尔觉得这并不可笑。这肯定是刻在血脉里的。毕竟我也一样。我家祖先都是灵动扈从。忠于维威克，只不过，更懂得开玩笑。

不知道辛德拉斯支持谁，但也不知道这法师咋想的，脑袋上顶了个蘑菇。</font>

original: Sculptor Visthar's Journal
traduit: 雕刻家维斯塔尔的日记

original:
The statue was my masterpiece, my one true love. Some say she is too large, too grand, but I would have made Her a thousand feet tall if I could. For my love is a titan, and we are but useless worms, groveling at Her feet. However, to sculpt a goddess came with no shortage of anxiety. The pressure I felt to chisel every line, hone every curve, and do so with exacting precision was almost too much to bear. But the end result was one I take immense pride in. These days, the anxious voices in my head are no more. Instead, they speak in a patois of ease and routine. I've fallen into a simple routine, making shrines with basic carvings in tribute to the three. A

, for Almalexia. S

, for Sotha Sil. V

, for Vivec. [pagebreak] Yet it is risk that makes a sculptor an artist. It is daring that turns the ordinary into the sublime. I dared to sculpt a Goddess once. As I chisel away at these blocks of stone, doing the same tired work, I wonder, is it too late to be that bold again?
traduit:
这座雕像是我的杰作，我唯一的真爱。有人说她太高大了，但如果可以，我想把她造到千尺高。因为我所爱的女神就是如此伟岸，而我们不过是无用的蠕虫，匍匐在她的脚下。 然而，雕刻女神的历程总与焦虑相伴。我准确无误地刻画打磨好每一根线条。这样的压力让我难以承受，不过最后的结果还是令我感到自豪。 这几天，我脑子里总算不再有焦虑的声音了。相反，他们开始用一种轻松而例行的话语交谈了。我陷入了一种简单的日常生活，用基本的雕刻来制作祭坛，向三神致敬。 A

, 代表阿玛莱西亚。 S

, 代表索萨·希尔。 V

, 代表维威克。 [pagebreak] 然而，正是冒险使雕刻匠人变成了艺术家。是勇气使得平凡变得崇高。 我曾经敢于雕刻一位女神。当我再凿着石头，做同样的工作时才回想，自己胆子挺大，是不是晚了点？

original:
, Gisli has told me all about the feast of fresh catches you prepared. Your fishing exploits are quickly becoming a thing of legend, and every legend deserves a song. --Viarmo

Down, down in the briny blue Lie slaughterfish and clams for stew Drawn by gold, pearl, and glass Dullards 'neath the sea trespass But what of angels, carp, and cats Grayling, spider, perch and bass? [pagebreak] Lyretail, pygmy, tuna, pog, What one remains that sings their song? All hail the king of the rod! Rattled by bolts that storms invite They plead with fish that will not bite With hollow growling in their gut, They return with empty baskets! But, When dinner's bell rings, we shout and sing, "We bend the knee to the fisher king!" All hail the king of the rod!
traduit:
, 吉斯莉和我说起你所准备的海鲜大餐。你捕鱼的事迹很快就会成为传奇。每个传奇都应该有传唱的诗歌。 ——维阿墨

沉沦，沉沦在深蓝色中， 宰鱼烹蛤炖煮佳肴。 黄金、珍珠和玻璃， 驱使钝汉擅闯海洋。 但天使鱼、鲤鱼、鲶鱼 茴鱼、蛛鱼、鲈鱼呢? [pagebreak] 燕尾、小日鲈、金枪鱼、珀格鱼， 还有什么能让它们歌唱呢？ 为钓竿之王欢呼吧！ 弱者被电闪雷鸣吓倒， 恳求着鱼儿快快上钩。 腹内空空， 空篮而归。 但当晚餐的铃声响起，我们再次高唱， “向渔人之王致敬吧！” 为钓竿之王欢呼吧！

original:
<font face='$HandwrittenFont'><font size='18'>
Good news! The other day I stepped on a rock and nearly lost a scale. I was about to curse the rock, put it an envelope, and mail it to a Daedric Prince - one of the nasty ones of course - when I realized the rock was shaped like a fish! 

Truly this was a sign from the Divines that you had succeeded in your tasks. I am glad to see the rock was correct and I do not have to burn this letter in shame.

As such, you will next travel to where rocks and fish live in harmony - the dank, sun-starved caves of Skyrim. From their waters I seek the following:
[pagebreak]

Direfish
Glass Catfish
Tripod Spiderfish
Vampire Fish

I wish you luck, which you will almost certainly need, unless you have a lucky hat like I do. I will not loan you my hat, but you are welcome to read the fourth volume of Fishing Mastery to give yourself an edge.</font>
traduit:
<font face='$HandwrittenFont'><font size='18'>
好消息！我那天踩到石头了，差点蹭掉一片鳞。我正要诅咒那块石头，然后把它装进信封里，寄给那群可恶的迪德拉君王，这时候才看到，这石头居然长得像条鱼！

这可能真的是圣灵的预兆，说明你已经成功完成了任务。看来这石头不赖，我也不用把这封信烧了。

所以，接下来你就去岩石和鱼类和谐共生的地方吧。从天际那些阴暗潮湿的洞穴里，获得这次任务的目标：
[pagebreak]

恐鱼
玻璃鲶
三脚蛛鱼
吸血鬼鱼

祝你好运，不过估计你需要像我一样有一顶幸运帽。但我可不能借给你，不过欢迎你再读读《钓鱼大师》的第四卷，创造点前期优势。</font>

original:
<font face='$HandwrittenFont'><font size='18'>
You came to us a novice, and now look at you! A fishing master! None of us, least of all the fish, expected you to come this far. Most of us placed wagers that you'd be dead already. 

Long story short, you only have one more step before becoming a true fishing legend, and helping me get out of debt. You will need the Argonian rod I gave you earlier, as well as the Alik'r rod from Viriya.

Here is a list of the rarest catches in all of Skyrim:

[pagebreak]

Angelfish
Angler
Lyretail Anthias
Scorpion Fish

Be sure to read the fifth, and final, volume of Fishing Mastery to learn the secrets of their whereabouts, and the rods one must use to catch them. Should you succeed, I have the perfect gift for someone sharp like you to represent your mastery of fishing. It will help you skin your catches as well as the occasional bandit. Best of luck.</font>
traduit:
<font face='$HandwrittenFont'><font size='18'>
你当初来的时候还是个菜鸟，再看看现在！妥妥的钓鱼大师！谁能想到你能走到这一步，尤其是那些鱼。我们里大多数人都觉得你死定了。

长话短说吧，你只差一步就成为真正的钓界传奇了，还能帮我还清债务。你需要我之前送你的阿尔贡钓竿，还有薇丽雅的阿里克'尔钓竿。

下面提到的都是天际最罕见的鱼类：

[pagebreak]

天使鱼
鮟鱇鱼

original: Fishing Mastery, v1
traduit: 钓鱼大师·卷1

original:
[pagebreak]

Fishing Mastery Volume 1 by Swims-In-Deep-Water

[pagebreak]

o you have decided to learn how to fish! Good for you! It's a noble endeavor, and with plenty of practice, it can be profitable one. Keep in mind that every journey begins with a single step, one that is usually clumsy and will end with you falling on your face. That is why, for your first lesson, it's recommended that you stick to calmer skies and fairer climates, where the fish will happily bite on even the most unattractive of hooks. This guidebook details four types of fish that are ideal for beginners. They are most common on a clear day near streams and lakes in the fairer parts of Skyrim away from snow and ice. The places one can catch these fish are too numerous to mention here, but an excellent way to begin one's fishing journey is to start by casting your line right off the docks near the Riften Fishery into Lake Honrich. Once you've had your fill of lake fish, head west to try your hand at fishing from the river that runs alongside Ivarstead. End your journey at Vilemyr Inn with aching arms and a full belly. [pagebreak] [pagebreak]

arp

Caught in Temperate Lakes and Streams Large in Size Uncommonly Caught Seen in Fair Weather They say the carp is the Jarl of the Karth River. Royal, stately, and austere. This sounds like it would taste very tough and chewy, but that is not the case! Eat until your scales swell! Carp are very popular for many reasons. Some even keep them as pets. But they are too big for most fish tanks. Better to eat them. [pagebreak]

lassfish

Caught in Temperate Lakes Small in Size Commonly Caught Seen in Fair Weather Glassfish are a common fish one can see through like a window! They are not so different than us on the inside. The best time to catch them is on a clear day, but if you are lucky, you can catch them on a rainy day as well. While their natural habitats are deep subterranian waterways, glassfish can be caught in the open waters of warm, clear lakes when they swim above ground for spawning. They say that if you eat a glassfish, you'll become clear as glass yourself. [pagebreak]

oldfish

Caught in Temperate Lakes Small in Size Uncommonly Caught Seen in Fair Weather Goldfish are known for being kind. They would much rather talk things out than get into a fight. This doesn't mean they will be friends with your hook. You will need to woo them, like any fish. Like glassfish, you won't find them in a river. The next time you think you've spotted a septim glistening at the bottom of a small pond, there's a chance it might be a friendly goldfish staring back instead. [pagebreak]

ogfish

Caught in Temperate Streams Large in Size Commonly Caught Seen in Fair and Rainy Weather A long, bright fish with silver scales and a claw-shaped mouth. I should ask Viriya what she thinks of pogfish. Perhaps she might like them just as much as mudcrab. You can also find a pogfish on a rainy day. Sometimes they are just in a gloomy mood. Pogfish use their powerful fins to swim up and down the rivers of Skyrim, most commonly in the Reach. Spend some time fishing along a stream and your lure will catch the clawed face of a pogfish before you know it. [pagebreak] If you manage to obtain all these fish, congratulations! You have graduated from novice to apprentice. If you are so inclined, feel free to bring proof of your catches to the Fishery in Riften. We are always looking for new friends to add to our collection!
traduit:
[pagebreak]

钓鱼大师 第一卷 游于深水 著

[pagebreak]

看来你已经决定好学习钓鱼了！好极了！钓鱼不但是需要大量练习的崇高努力，学好了更能从中获利。 请记住，千里之行始于足下，而这第一步往往都是笨拙的，最终会以你摔倒在地告终。这也是为什么，我会在你的第一课中，建议你选择更加晴朗的天气和更加温和的气候。因为在那里，即使再不受鱼待见的鱼钩，也会有鱼乐意去咬。 这本指南会详细介绍四种适合初学者去钓的鱼。在远离冰雪的晴好天气，那些溪流湖泊中，十分常见。 可以钓到这些鱼的地方太多了，这里就不一一列举了。不过有个开始你钓鱼之旅的绝佳地点，那就是在裂谷渔场的码头上，把你的鱼线抛入霍利奇湖。 等你钓完湖里的鱼，就向西沿着前往伊瓦尔镇的河流继续钓。最后带着酸痛的手臂和填饱的肚子在烂醉如泥旅店结束你的行程。 [pagebreak] [pagebreak]

鲤鱼

在温带河、湖中捕获 大型鱼类 罕见 晴天出没 人都说鲤鱼是卡斯河的领主。高贵、庄严，而且朴素。听起来好像很硬很有嚼劲似的，但事实并非如此！能吃到你鳞片膨胀！ 鲤鱼很受欢迎的原因很多。有人甚至拿它们当宠物养。但对于大多数鱼缸来说，它们还是太大了。最好还是把它们吃了吧。 [pagebreak]

玻璃鱼

在温带湖泊中捕获 小型鱼类 常见 晴天出没 玻璃鱼是一种能像窗户一样被看透的常见鱼类！它们的内部与我们并没有什么不同。捕获它们的最佳时间就是晴天，但如果运气好，雨天也能抓到。 虽然它们的自然栖息地是地下深处的水道，但它们会游到地上温暖清澈的开阔湖泊产卵。这也是捕获它们的好机会。 他们说，如果吃了玻璃鱼，就会变得像玻璃一样清澈。 [pagebreak]

金鱼

在温带湖泊中捕获 小型鱼类 罕见 晴天出没 金鱼一向动口不动手，因为它善。但这不意味着它们会和你的鱼钩成为朋友。你需要像鱼一样和它们示爱。 和玻璃鱼一样，你在河里是找不到它们的。下次当你觉得自己看到小池塘底部有一枚塞普汀在闪闪发光的时候。那很可能是一条友好的金鱼正在回望你。 [pagebreak]

珀格鱼

在温带溪流中捕获 大型鱼类 常见 晴天与雨天出没 珀格鱼纤长明亮，有着银色的鳞片和爪形的嘴。我应该去问问薇丽雅，看她对珀格鱼是什么想法。也许她会像喜欢泥沼蟹一样喜欢上它们。 雨天的时候也能钓到珀格鱼。可能他们有时也会心情郁闷吧。 珀格鱼利用它们强大的鱼鳍在天际的河流中游来游去，尤其多见于瑞驰地区。多花些时间沿着小溪钓鱼，你的鱼饵很可能会在你意识到之前，就钩到了珀格鱼的爪子脸。 [pagebreak] 如果你成功钓到这几种鱼，那恭喜你！你已经从一个新手升级成学徒了。如果你愿意，可以带着自己的渔获证明到裂谷渔场来。我们一直在寻找新朋友加入！

s a master fisherman, you have accomplished almost everything. You have fished in pools where the weather is fair, and hooked curious fish that come out for the rain. You have dipped your rods in half-frozen lakes, and in waters tucked away in bottomless caves. You have fished the breadth of Skyrim, from Winterhold to Falkreath, and become an expert of the craft. However, you still have more to learn. The rarest fish cannot be lured with technique alone. One must center themselves, and be in tune with the water mentally and spiritually. You also need more specialized rods, not the cheap ones you find at the general goods store. The Nords are excellent craftsmen, but for the rarest, most exquisite, most delectable, most vaingloriously spectacular fish, you must use rods of Alik'ri and Argonian make. If you have managed to obtain such rods, then you are ready to embark on your final test. Good luck. [pagebreak] [pagebreak]

ngelfish

Caught in Temperate Lakes Small in Size Rarely Caught Seen in Any Weather Caught with Alik'ri Fishing Rod The angelfish is a rare jewel of a fish. They prefer freshwater lakes in mild climates, but they are far from delicate. While they are small, angelfish can be quite aggressive towards other fish. Their natural habitat is a mystery, but stories of angelfish swimming in glades untouched by man or mer have sparked many fisherman's imaginations. [pagebreak]

ngler

Caught in Freezing Waters Large in Size Rarely Caught Seen in Any Weather Caught with Argonian Fishing Rod The angler is an ugly brute of a fish that swims in the deepest trenches of the Sea of Ghosts. It fancies itself a fisherman by wearing a lure on its head to attract other fish. However, in this world there is always a bigger fish, and a bigger lure. You are the angler that will catch the angler, if your rod is up to it. [pagebreak]

yretail Anthias

Caught in Temperate Streams Small in Size Rarely Caught Seen in Any Weather Caught with Alik'ri Fishing Rod It is said that the lyretail anthias is a social butterfly. One look at its color and you can see why. Its vibrant scales make even an Argonian jealous. A local legend is one of a fisherman who became lost in the woods and was lured into a beautiful grove by the sound of the wind through the evergreen trees. There, he saw lyretail swimming in a pool that was clear as glass. Of course, the spriggan that dwelled there made his legend a short one. [pagebreak]

corpion Fish

Caught Underground Large in Size Rarely Caught Caught with Argonian Fishing Rod They say there exists a cavern so dark that it drives any who delve it to madness. It is in these untouched depths that the scorpion fish finds its home. They also say that fishermen have plenty of time to concoct the most outlandish of tales. When I think about the scorpion fish, I am reminded of the old tale about the frog and the scorpion. The scorpion wanted to cross the water, and the frog said "Why don't we fish in the water instead?" So that's what they did, and they became the best of friends. [pagebreak] You have made the fishing hero's journey, legendary fisherman. In conclusion, I will leave you with the words my master told me. Think back to the tripod spiderfish. In many ways, it is a lot like you. A fisherman can feel the movements of a fish underwater as they swim curiously around their hook. They make their lure an invitation rather than a threat. And when they sense the subtle tug on their line, they know the moment they must strike. It is an unexplainable oneness with nature, the lure, and their prey. No matter your techniques or peculiar habits, the truth is on the hook. For when you catch the rarest of fish, you will have proven once and for all that you are a fishing legend, one who bows to no one.

身为钓鱼大师，你几乎完成了所有挑战。 你在晴朗的池塘中垂钓，也曾在风雨中钓出怪鱼。你把钓竿浸在半冻的湖泊，抛进深不见底的洞窟。从冬堡到佛克瑞斯，你已经钓遍了整个天际，终成一代钓鱼专家。然而，你还有很多东西要学。 最稀有的鱼不是单凭技巧就能钓到的。除了要以自己为中心，精神与灵魂与水调和，还需要专业的钓竿。不是那种你在普通商店里买来的便宜竿子。 诺德人确实是优秀的工匠，但想要钓到最稀有、最精致、最美味、最壮观的鱼，你必须用阿里克'尔和阿尔贡制作的钓竿。 等你设法拿到了这两样钓竿，那就可以开始你的最终测试了。祝你好运。 [pagebreak] [pagebreak]

在温带湖泊中捕获 小型鱼类 极难捕获 任意天气出没 使用阿里克'尔钓竿 天使鱼是鱼中珍宝。它们喜欢气候温和的淡水湖，但它们一点也不脆弱。天使鱼虽然很小，但对其他鱼类很有攻击性。 它们的自然栖息地仍是个谜，但天使鱼在人迹罕至的沼泽里游泳的故事，激发了许多渔民的想象力。 [pagebreak]

在冰冻水域捕获 大型鱼类 极难捕获 任意天气出没 使用阿尔贡钓竿 鮟鱇鱼丑陋凶猛，游弋在幽灵海的海沟深处。它把自己想象成渔夫，在头上带了个诱饵来吸引其他鱼。然而，世上总有更大的鱼，更大的饵。只要你的钓竿够得到，那你就是狩猎的一方。 [pagebreak]

燕尾花鮨

在温带溪流中捕获 小型鱼类 极难捕获 任意天气出没 使用阿里克'尔钓竿 据说，燕尾花鮨是朵交际花。光是看它的颜色就知道了。它那充满活力的鳞片，连阿尔贡都会为之嫉妒。 当地有个传说，一个渔夫在树林中迷路，被穿过常青树木的风声吸引到一个美丽的小树林。他在那里看到燕尾花鮨在清澈如玻璃一样的池塘里游泳。当然，住在那里的木灵让他的传说戛然而止。 [pagebreak]

蝎子鱼

在地下捕获 大型鱼类 极难捕获 使用阿尔贡钓竿 他们说有个黑暗的洞窟，任何进去的人都会被逼疯。蝎子鱼就是在这些无人涉足的深渊安家。他们还说，渔民们闲着没事儿就喜欢编造这种离奇的故事。 当我想到蝎子鱼时，我就想起一个有关青蛙和蝎子的古老故事。蝎子想要过河，青蛙就说：“我们为什么不在水里钓鱼呢？”后来他们就这么做了，然后成了最好的朋友。 [pagebreak] 你已经完成了钓鱼英雄的旅程，称为一代传奇钓客。最后，我将把我主人的告诉我的话留给你。 回想一下三脚蛛鱼。它在很多方面和你很像。当鱼好奇地绕着鱼钩游来游去时，渔夫能感觉到鱼在水下的运动。他们的鱼饵不是威胁而是邀请。当他们感觉到鱼线被轻轻拉扯时，就知道是时候出手了。这是一种无法解释的，自然、诱饵、猎物的合一。 不管你的技巧还是特殊的习惯，真相永远由鱼钩决定。当你钓到最稀有的鱼，你将永远证明自己是个钓界传奇，一个不需向任何人低头的传奇。

f you ever find yourself staring into the abyss and wondering what you've done with your life, do not fret. It is likely not the void of death that is standing before you, but rather, one of Skyrim's many caverns, mines, and other dark places. It is a darkness that, if you're lucky, will be full of water and teeming with fish. But be forewarned, while you may be a seasoned adventurer, only an expert fisherman should attempt to fish these uncharted waters. While they won't kill you, if you fail to catch one you may just die of embarrasment, and that is a fate far worse. Fortunately, this guidebook will help you avoid having to hear the mocking laughter of fish echoing in your skull. Before we get to the fish, we should first discuss the places one can go that are suitable for fishing in the dark. Brood Cavern, in the mountains south of Morthal, is well known by hunters as a place of shelter and hungry fish eager to bite your hook. You may have to contend with wild animals that sometimes reside in its cool depths, so pack something sharp to go along with your fishing rod. Embershard Mine near the sleepy town of Riverwood is said to be flooded deep within, and may be a hidden gem for subterranean fish seekers. It is too bad that bandits and thugs have been seen by many coming and going from its entrance. It may be best to fish elsewhere for now. For the truly brave, Chillwind Depths south of the Dragon Bridge is rumored to have dark waters that ripple with life. Take care not to venture far from the entrance, as this cave is known to be infested with frostbite spiders. These are only a few of the many deep places one may find a good fishing spot. Those that fancy themselves as explorers will no doubt turn up numerous places to cast their lines underground. [pagebreak] [pagebreak]

irefish

Caught Underground Large in Size Commonly Caught Legend has it that the direfish has a bit of dragon blood coursing through its fish veins. It would be a dire situation indeed if you pulled your rod up and a dragon was on the other side. Direfish have been known to enjoy giving underground explorers a fright by splashing the waters of the underground lakes they inhabit when anyone passes by. [pagebreak]

lass Catfish

Caught Underground Large in Size Commonly Caught The glass catfish is also known as the ghost catfish, or the phantom catfish. Those names might be too frightening for timid fisherman, so we call it the glass catfish to help soothe your nerves. To me, cutting my scales on glass is a scarier thought than a ghostly catfish. Perhaps I am alone in thinking this way. Like the glassfish, the glass catfish is native to deep subterranean waters where the sun is a distant memory. [pagebreak]

ripod Spiderfish

Caught Underground Large in Size Uncommonly Caught I will let you in on a secret. I have a fear, one that is quite common in Skyrim. I am terrified of... things with three legs. Why use three, instead of four? It seems like an accident waiting to happen. What, you thought I was terrified of spiders? They are good for pest control. I know I said good things come in threes, but the tripod spiderfish is an exception. It is a long, terrifying creature, found stalking the bottom of underground lakes. It does not use its eyes to find food, but rather it perches on its fins and senses the movement of its prey. [pagebreak]

ampire Fish

Caught Underground Large in Size Uncommonly Caught Caves are dark, and creatures of the night are drawn to their shadowy splendor. The vampire fish is much like its namesake, swimming in dark pools, baring sharp fangs. Ours is to wonder if they also have tiny coffins to sleep in. If you manage to catch such a fish, let me know.

[pagebreak] We have completed our dark and treacherous journey into the world of underground fish. If you have the determination to catch all of the fish within these pages, you are a true fishing master. Fine work!

[pagebreak]

Line and Lure by Aland Sea-Bird

[pagebreak]

y name is Aland Sea-Bird. My fame, or lack thereof, is irrelevant. I am not writer. As it so happens, my wife gave me this quill when I retired. She called it a gift. To me it is a burden, but I suppose many teachers feel this same weight. If I were to walk the bridge to Sovngarde, I would take all my knowledge with me. Hard lessons learned from decades fishing the waters of Skyrim. In my life, I've fished in waters open and deep, amidst storms no mortal dare brook. I've ventured down bottomless caves, and challenged the monsters of the deep with my hook. I have seen them all, and caught them all, be it fish, monster, or boot. With this guide, I will teach you how to do the same. [pagebreak]

Chapter I: The Rod

Just as a warrior needs a sword and a blacksmith a hammer, the first thing any aspiring fisherman needs is a rod. You can find one at a general goods store, or left behind on boats and docks by other fisherman that have come before you. When you obtain one, wield it like you would a weapon, swinging it this way and that. Get a feel for its balance and weight. It must become an extension of your body and mind. [pagebreak]

Chapter II: Supplies

Once you have a rod, you will next need supplies. This includes bait and other essentials to capture the fish once it's been reeled close to the shore. However, you need not bring your own. It is customary in Skyrim to leave fishing supplies by waters where the fish are plentiful. To find a set of fishing supplies is to be met with a greeting, a hearty hello from one fisherman to another. When you are done, you will leave these supplies for the next fisher. Such is the way. [pagebreak]

Chapter III: Casting the Line

When you are ready to fish, bait your hook using the fishing supplies. Then, cast your line with vigor and allow the hook to sink below the surface. The art of fishing is one of patience and focus. In particular, it requires the concentration of two senses, sight and touch. You might ask, how can one know if there are nearby fish for the taking? It is no different than the way moths are drawn to a flame. When your bait lands on the surface of the water, nearby fish will excitedly converge. The ripples on the surface will quickly announce their presence. Watch for these ripples carefully! The more the water stirs, the more plentiful the number of fish. In contrast, a quiet surface when your line hits the water will tell you there are no more fish to catch, and you must return in a day's time. In time, you will learn to tell fish apart based on the tug on your line. You will know the difference between a river betty's curious nibble, and a carp's eager pull. [pagebreak]

Chapter IV: Reeling It In

When you have hooked your fish, the time for patience and serenity is over. Now come the throes of war. Your fish will thrash as it fights for its life, but you must keep your grip firm and your mind focused, as you reel your line and pull in your catch. Once you have reeled it in, the fish is yours. Scale it, cook it, and consume it how you please. Depending on your custom, there are different rituals to follow. But for all fisherman, a catch is always cause for celebration. [pagebreak]

Chapter V: The Rare and Unusual Catch

Different fish are native to different climates. If you seek a variety of fish, do not stay in one place. Temperate lakes and streams to the south will hook you a different catch than snow fringed ponds and pitch black caverns. When you seek a fish that is seldom caught, the uncommon and rare fish that fisherman brag about until long in their years, your best bet is to fish when the sun is low on the horizon. Dawn and dusk offer the best chance to catch these elusive creatures. If you seek the very rarest of fish, special rods are required. Seek the advice of those in the Riften Fishery. Follow their guidance and wisdom, just as you have done with me. Of course, not every catch will feed your belly. Some may fill your coin purse, while others have interesting uses to those who brew potions. In my travels, I have even heard tall tales of Dwarven rods used to lure lost trinkets settled at the bottom of ponds and lakes. For what purpose, a Nord like myself cannot know. As the world moves on, such things are lost to time. [pagebreak]

Chapter VI: In Conclusion

There you have it. As I stated at the beginning of this journey, I am no writer. What is written here are not words, but a piece of me. It is the callow boy who in his arrogance was nearly dragged into the water by a goldfish. It is the shivering fishmonger, sitting on a frozen bucket in the dead of night praying to Kyne that he will live to see the sunrise. It is the old man at the lake drinking a potion of strength, turning back time so he can hook an old foe. It is part of me, and if you heed its message, it will become part of you.

鱼线和鱼饵 “海鸟”阿兰德 著

[pagebreak]

我叫“海鸟”阿兰德。你听过也好，没听过也好，都无所谓。 我不是个作家，只是碰巧，我妻子在我退休的时候，给了我这支笔。她管这叫礼物，但我觉得就是负担，可能很多老师都有这样的感受。等我走上去松加德的桥，所有知识都会一并带走。那是我在天际的水域辛苦钓鱼几十年的宝贵经验。 我这辈子，钓过开阔深邃的大海，也闯过狂风骤雨的河湖。也曾冒险进入无底深洞，用鱼钩挑战那些深水怪物。无论是鱼、怪物，还是别人扔的臭靴子，我都钓到过。 我会用这本指南，对你倾囊相授。 [pagebreak]

第一章： 钓竿

战士需要剑，铁匠需要锤子，有抱负的渔夫自然首先要备好钓竿。你可以在杂货店买，也可以到渔民前人的船或码头上去找。等你拿到钓竿，就像武器一样挥舞一下，感受它的平衡与重量。它必须成为你身体和思想的延伸。 [pagebreak]

第二章： 用品

等你有了钓竿，就需要准备补给了。这里包括鱼饵还有用来捕获拖上来的鱼所需的物品。 然而，你也不需要自己携带。在天际，人们习惯把钓鱼用品留在鱼类丰富的水域。一套钓鱼用品，就是渔民之间最诚挚的问候。 等你钓完鱼，就把这些东西留给下一个渔民。这就是规矩。 [pagebreak]

第三章： 抛鱼线

等你准备好钓鱼，用钓鱼用品给鱼钩上好饵料。然后，用力抛出鱼线，让鱼钩沉到水下。 钓鱼的艺术就在于耐心和专注。特别需要两种感官的集中——视觉和触觉。 你可能会问：“我怎么知道附近有没有鱼？”这其实和飞蛾扑火的道理没什么两样。当你的鱼饵落到水面，附近的鱼会兴奋地聚过来。很快，水面上的涟漪就会宣布它们的存在。 仔细观察这些涟漪！水搅动地越厉害，鱼的数量也就越多。相反，当你的鱼线接触水面但很平静的时候，就说明无鱼可钓了，等上一天再来。 随着时间的推移，你将学会根据鱼线的拉力来区分鱼。到时候，你就能明白河贝蒂鱼好奇的啃食和鲤鱼急切的撕咬拉扯之间的区别了。 [pagebreak]

第四章： 收鱼线

当你钓到鱼的时候，耐心与平静的时间就结束了。现在只有战争的疼痛挣扎。你的鱼会为了生存而战，不停挣扎，而你则要在收线抓鱼的时候牢牢攥紧手，集中注意力。 等你把鱼线收起来，这条鱼就归你了。按你喜欢的方式，刮鳞、烹饪、享用。可能根据你自己的习惯，还有不同的仪式需要遵循。但对所有渔民来说，有渔获总是值得庆祝的。 [pagebreak]

第五章： 稀有罕见的渔获

不同的鱼栖息在不同气候的区域。想要钓到更多种类的鱼，就不要总是停留在一个地方。南方温暖的河湖、白雪覆盖的池塘和漆黑深邃的洞穴，都能吸引你抓到新的鱼类。 你想钓一条能吹好几年的稀有鱼类，那就最好选择在太阳落山时钓鱼。晨昏时分是捉那些怪东西的最佳时机。 如果你想钓那些最稀有的鱼类，那就需要特殊的钓竿。去向裂谷渔场的人寻求建议吧。遵循他们的指导和智慧，就像你阅读我的书一样。 当然，不是每次钓鱼都能填饱你的肚子。有的可以填满你的钱包，还有一些对制药有所帮助。 在我的旅行中，我甚至还听说过用矮人钓竿来钓起水底丢掉的小饰品这种荒诞的故事。不管怎样，我这样的诺德人是不会相信的。随着世事变迁，这些怪谈也会消失在时间中。 [pagebreak]

第六章： 结语

书到此为止了。正如我在这段旅程开始时说的，我不是个作家。这里写的不是文字，而是我的人生。 是那个因为傲慢差点被金鱼拖进水里的幼稚孩子。 是那个在夜深人静时，浑身发抖坐在结冰的鱼桶上，向凯娜祈祷能活到日出的鱼贩。 是那个喝下一瓶力量药水，想要让时光倒流，拿鱼钩和老对手再斗一场的老人。 它们都是我的一部分，如果你能够用上这些信息，那也会成为你的一部分。

original: 8th of Last Seed, 4E 201 Can you believe our luck? We've stumbled onto a gold mine. Or, more accurately, a Dwarven metal mine. A staggering amount of scrap lies along the bottom of this frozen lake. Had we known how lucrative this trip would be, we would have brought wagons, not buckets. Strange machines still stand just above the water. If we could only find what powers them! Riches surely lie in wait, and we can hang our fishing rods up for good. I'll bet we'll find it here, amongst the rest of the scrap. We just need to keep doing what we know how to do best. Fishing. Sometimes I see a glint, a faint glow at the bottom. But when I cast my line in or try to swim to the bottom to retrieve it, it eludes me. [pagebreak] 11th of Last Seed, 4E 201 No luck. We still haven't managed to fish up whatever it is that might power these machines. Jorid jokes we'll need a Dwarven fishing rod to solve this decidedly Dwarven mystery. Schematics are said to lie in a ruined tower at Alftand, in the mountains up north. When people speak of me tomorrow, they won't say, "here comes Faldrin, the fisherman." They'll say, "here comes Faldrin, the treasure hunter!" We leave for Alftand at first light.
traduit: 4E 201年，末种月8日 你能相信我们撞大运了吗？ 我们摔进了一座金矿里。或者更准确点说，一座锻莫金属矿里。无数废料散落在这结冰的湖底。早知道这趟旅程能有这么大赚头的话，我们就会带一辆马车来，而不是提几个桶。 奇怪的机器仍然矗立在水上。要是我们能找到给它们供能的东西就好了！财富肯定在静静等待，到时候我们就能把鱼竿永远封存起来了。我打赌我们会在此地，在其余碎片中找到它。我们只需要继续做我们最擅长的事情——钓鱼。 有时候我看到在湖底微弱的亮光。不过当我把鱼线投进去或者试图游到水底把它捞上来的时候，它又从我面前消失了。 [pagebreak] 4E 201年，末种月11日 运气不好。我们还是没有钓到任何可能给这些机器供能的东西。乔里德开玩笑说我们需要一根矮人钓竿来解决矮人的谜团。图纸据说是在艾尔夫坦德的一座废弃塔楼里，就在北边的山里。 将来人们谈论我的时候，他们不会说：“那个渔夫福尔德林来了。”他们会说：“那个宝藏猎人福尔德林来了！”天一亮我们就动身去艾尔夫坦德。

original: 22nd of Sun's Height, 4E 201 Sold to Windpeak Inn: Salmon, 16 Arctic Char, 8 Crab Legs, 12 [pagebreak] 30th of Sun's Height, 4E 201 A traveler came passing through, Seviur. Some kind of wizard. I've got no love for wizards, but he offered me up potions and fire salts, all just for a place to lay up for a while. Of course, I agreed. Only a noble could dream of treasures like these! [pagebreak] 2nd of Last Seed, 4E 201 Sold to Windpeak Inn: Salmon, 13 Arctic Grayling: 6 Last night, I seen Seviur castin' his spells on mudcrabs, of all things. Now I don't have any crab to sell to the inn. He said that I could have them when he's done, but something's not right with those crabs when he's through with them. They smell old, foul. [pagebreak] 5th of Last Seed, 4E 201 A mudcrab tried to get at me while I was sleeping last night. Good thing I keep a sharp blade under the bed. Tomorrow I'm going to tell my visitor that it's time for him to go. I've had enough of the chanting at all hours of the night. [pagebreak] 7th of Last Seed, 4E 201 I can't believe it. It's true what they say: no good deed goes unpunished. I told Seviur that he needed to leave, and he just started ranting about how this was his place now. Said not to forget our deal, that he was not to be disturbed. Now I'm scared he'll cast his magic on me if I have another cross word with him. [pagebreak] 9th of Last Seed, 4E 201 Now I know what he's been up to. He's been doing awful, evil magic on those crabs. Don't get me wrong, mudcrabs'll snap your ankles with their claws just as soon as look at you. But they don't deserve... this. I can't stay here. I'll head to Windpeak Inn next morning. Not coming back, not ever. This place is cursed now.
traduit: 4E201年，末种月7日 销往风岳旅店： 鲑鱼16条 北极鲑8条 蟹腿12条 [pagebreak] 4E201年，日高月30日 有个叫瑟维尔的旅行者经过此地。看样子是个巫师。我虽然不喜欢巫师，但他给了我几瓶药水和火盐，想要借个歇脚的地方。我也就同意了。毕竟这些东西也只有贵族才用得起！ [pagebreak] 4E201年，末种月2日 销往风岳旅店： 鲑鱼13条 北极茴鱼6条 昨天晚上，我看见瑟维尔在泥沼蟹身上施法。现在我没螃蟹能卖给旅店了。他说等完事儿就还给我，可他用过的螃蟹都有点不对劲。闻起来又老又臭。 [pagebreak] 4E201年，末种月5日 昨晚睡觉的时候，有只泥沼蟹想要过来夹我。还好我床下有把锋利的小刀。明天我得给那位客人下逐客令了。我已经受够了他整晚整晚的吟唱了。 [pagebreak] 4E201年，末种月7日 真不敢相信。老话说得好，好人未必有好报啊。 我让瑟维尔离开，他却吼着说这里现在是他的地盘了。他说不要忘了我们之间的约定，别再打扰他什么的。现在我害怕如果再和他生气，他就该拿魔法对付我了。 [pagebreak] 4E201年，末种月9日 现在我知道他在做什么了。他对那些螃蟹施放了可怕的邪恶魔法。别不信，那些泥沼蟹只要一看到你就会用钳子夹断你的脚踝。但他们不应该……这样啊。 我可不能再待下去了。明天一早就去风岳旅店，再也不回来了，永远不回来。这地方被诅咒了。

original: [pagebreak] 30th of Sun's Height, 4E 201 To master the art of necromancy, one requires a constant supply of corpses upon which to practice. Here on the coast I can practice my arts undisturbed, save for a lone fisherman I convinced to let me rest in his shack. Amazing how far a few potions and fire salts can take you. Soon, I will begin the pacification ritual that will bring me wave after wave of docile creatures to slay and practice my abilities. [pagebreak] 2nd of Last Seed, 4E 201 The ritual is complete. Mudcrabs arrive from the sea in droves, each ready to surrender their life. Already I feel myself growing stronger in the dark arts. I bring down the knife, and see life's flame extinguished from their eyes. Then I raise my hand, and see it spark once more. I bring the knife back down again. The others watch on, their feeble minds unable to resist. [pagebreak] 7th of Last Seed, 4E 201 A curious thing happened today. As a fresh wave of the clawed creatures rose out of the water, one of them ran ahead of the pack and lunged right at me, snapping and chittering. Perhaps my illusion has had some kind of adverse effect on them, driving them to frenzy instead of calm submission. I will dispel the illusion for now and make do with the creatures I find close to the shore. [pagebreak] 10th of Last Seed, 4E 201 More have come from the sea with deadly intent, this time almost too many to manage. I need to be careful. Is this my doing? No... the illusion ritual ended long ago. I fear I have ignited something within them. No matter. I've come too far to stop now.
traduit: [pagebreak] 4E201年，日高月30日 想要精通死灵法术，就需要不断有尸体练习。 这里的海岸，可以让我不受干扰练习魔法，除了有个独行的渔夫。我花了几瓶药水和火盐说服他让我借住在他屋里。 很快，我就开始安抚仪式，引来一波又一波温顺的生物，供我杀戮和练习。 [pagebreak] 4E201年，末种月2日 仪式完成了。泥沼蟹成群结队地从海里爬上岸，每一只都准备好了放弃自己的生命。 我已经能感受到自己在黑魔法中越发强大了。我放下刀，看着生命的火焰从它们的眼中熄灭。我抬起手，再度将之点燃。然后又拿起刀。其他也只是看着，它们虚弱的头脑压根无法抵抗。 [pagebreak] 4E201年，末种月7日 今天发生了一件怪事。当一波又一波螃蟹浮出水面，其中一只居然跑在最前面，径直向我扑来，又咬又叫。也许是我的幻术对它们产生了某种不利影响，变得不再平静服从，而是歇斯底里。 我现在得取消幻术，用在海岸附近找到的生物暂时将就一下。 [pagebreak] 4E201年，末种月10日 越来越多泥沼蟹带着致命的意图爬上岸了，这次太多了，根本管不过来。我得小心了。 这是我的问题？不对啊……幻术仪式早就停下了。难道是我激起了它们的某些东西？ 不管了。都已经走到这一步了，不能停下。

original: Bounty: Juvenile Mudcrab

original:
<font face="$HandwrittenFont">
<font size="24">Bounty: Juvenile Mudcrab</font>

<font size="18">After hanging up my sword and bow to live a quieter life, I decided to study the lives and habitats of mudcrabs here at the Riften Fishery. It is my hope that one day we might breed mudcrabs much like we do fish. If only everyone else at the Fishery shared my interest...

I am in search of a juvenile mudcrab so that I may study its growth. These young mudcrabs rarely leave the water, so I now need an intrepid fisherman to catch one. They can be caught in almost all lakes and streams throughout Skyrim, though a breeding ground is said to be in Whiterun west of Broken Fang Cave.

Please make haste. I must show progress in my research as soon as possible.

-- Viriya, Riften Fishery

<font size="16">Note to self: It's been twelve days since an adventurer took up this bounty. And so far, nothing! How much longer must I wait?</font>

original: Letter on Mudcrab Attacks
traduit: 有关泥沼蟹袭击的信

original:
<font face="$HandwrittenFont">
<font size="18">Viriya,

I have received multiple accounts of fishermen being attacked near a small shack on the shore west of Dawnstar by a swarm of mudcrabs. Yes, mudcrabs. No, I didn't believe it either, until I saw their wounds for myself.

One traveler said that they "jumped out of the sea right at her." I would like you, the foremost expert on mudcrab, to investigate. I cannot afford to spare any of my guards, so I ask you, please find a way to rid these beasts from our shores!

-- Jarl <Alias=Jarl>

<font size="16">Viriya's notes: Fascinating. I wonder what could be causing them to gather together and become aggressive? Mudcrab are timid creatures unless threatened, so something must have stirred them up. Either way, they will have to be put to rest so the shore is safe again. A shame I won't get a chance to study them.</font>
traduit:
<font face="$HandwrittenFont">
<font size="18">薇丽雅：

近日很多渔民报告在晨星西部海岸的棚屋遭到了泥沼蟹袭击。没错，是泥沼蟹。我本来也是不信，直到看到他们身上的伤口。

有游人说，它们“从海里跳出来，正对着她。”我需要你这个顶尖泥沼蟹专家，去调查一下。我目前抽不出卫兵人手，所以还请你帮忙想办法把这些野兽赶出我们的海岸！

——<Alias=Jarl>领主

<font size="16">薇丽雅的笔记：太好了。我很想知道它们为什么聚集在一起，还变得很有攻击性。毕竟泥沼蟹是非常胆小的生物，除非受到了威胁，所以一定是有什么东西把它们激怒了。不管怎样，都必须处理它们，保证海岸再次安全。可惜没机会研究它们了。</font>

MILA'S VERY SECRET TREASURE

STOP READING NOW! Or I'll tell mom and the guards! It's illegal to read things that don't belong to you! If you're still reading, it must be because we're friends and I want you to have the treasure at my secret hiding spot! I have a place where I like to play behind Dragonsreach. I pretend I have my very own vegetable stall, just like mom! That's where I keep my best treasure. I keep it all locked up so Braith can't take it. My favorite flower is also in there, and a really big bug I found last week. I didn't kill it, it was dead when I found it. Honest!
traduit:
米拉的大秘宝

别—再—读—了！不然我就跟妈妈和卫兵说了！看不属于你的东西是犯法的！ 如果你还在往下读，说明咱俩一定是朋友，是我告诉你我的秘密藏宝点！ 我在龙临宫后面玩，有个特别喜欢的地方。我假装像妈妈一样有自己的蔬菜摊！那是我最宝贵的东西。我把它锁起来，不能让布赖斯拿走。 我最喜欢的花也在里面，上周还抓到一只很大的虫子。我没杀它，它被发现的时候就已经死了。真的！

original: Bounty: Lost Wares
traduit: 悬赏：货物丢失

original:
<font face="$HandwrittenFont">
<font size="24">Bounty: Lost Wares</font>

    <font size="18">A tragedy has befallen this one's business. We were set upon by wolves along the road west of Old Hroldan Inn in the Reach. While dealing with the beasts our cart overturned, sending everything tumbling down the hill and into the nearby river below. In the cart were three exquisite bottles of flin, some of the finest spirits in Tamriel. These were of a very desirable vintage and quite rare.

    Regretably, the bottles have already been sold and were on their way to be delivered. Ri'saad has known the buyer for many years, and she is not known for her patience. If they aren't found soon, this one's reputation will be ruined!

    As the bottles have all sunk down into the muck at the bottom, this one believes a skilled fisherman may be needed to pluck them from the river. A handsome reward awaits any who can return these prized bottles to me with haste.

-- Ri'saad</font>
traduit:
<font face="$HandwrittenFont">
<font size="24">悬赏：货物丢失</font>

 <font size="18">在下的生意出了个大悲剧。我们在瑞驰领的古霍尔丹旅店西边的路上遭到了狼群袭击。在对付野兽的时候，我们的车翻了，所有货物都滚下了山，掉进了附近的河里。车上还存放着三瓶精美的飞令，那可是全大陆都相当罕见的陈年佳酿。

遗憾的是，这些酒已经售出，是正在运送的途中。里'撒德认识买家好多年了，她的耐心是出了名的差。如果不尽快找回来，在下的名声就全毁了！

既然酒都沉到了河床的淤泥中，在下觉得可能需要技术熟练的渔民去捞。只要能尽快把这些珍贵的酒还回来，必有重谢。

——里'撒德</font>

original: Wanted: A Seafood Feast
traduit: 需求：海鲜大餐

original:
<font face="$HandwrittenFont">
<font size="24">Wanted: A Seafood Feast</font>

    <font size="18">Our tenants have all paid their rent on time for once, so I find myself suddenly flush with coin. I've decided to celebrate with a feast!

    Of course, the innkeeper at the Winking Skeever possesses neither the ingredients nor the skill to prepare what I desire. I seek a cooked arctic char, steamed crab legs, and a helping of crab stew for good measure. Please set a table on the second floor of the inn so that I might avoid being disturbed.

    I will leave behind generous repayment once my dining has concluded, but only if the meal meets my expectations. Unfortunately for me, few things do.

-- Gisli</font>
traduit:
<font face="$HandwrittenFont">
<font size="24">需求：海鲜大餐</font>

<font size="18">这次我们的房客按时交了租，突然就有钱了。我决定办场宴会庆祝一下。

不过，眨眼恶鼠的老板既没有食材也没有技术来准备我要的菜品。我点了一份烤北极鲑、清蒸蟹腿，再来一碗炖蟹。就放在旅店二楼的桌子上，不要来打扰我。

等用餐结束，我自会留下丰厚报酬，前提是这顿饭符合我的预期。只不过，很少有人能做到。

——吉斯莉</font>

original:
<font face="$HandwrittenFont">
<font size="36">Bounty</font>

    A single glassfish is needed for a potion that a client has requested. I cannot leave my shop unattended during the daylight hours, so I have no choice but to request that someone else acquire this fish for me.

    Please see me at my establishment, Grave Concoctions, in Falkreath once you have the glassfish. A reward of 100 gold will be granted, plus an additional reward for any who might be willing to assume more work regarding a private matter.

-- Zaria

traduit: 我想提高钓鱼技术。你能教我些东西吗？

original: An entire list of fish to catch? But I only just learned how to fish!
traduit: 一整张钓鱼清单？但我才刚学会钓鱼！

original: Should I cook them for you while I'm at it?
traduit: 要我帮你把它们炖了么？

original: I'll bring them back soon.
traduit: 我很快就带回来。

original: Relax, I was just joking.
traduit: 别紧张，我就开个玩笑。

original: Here are the fish you asked for.
traduit: 这是你要的鱼。

original: I'll do my best. No promises.
traduit: 我尽力。但不打包票。

original: The fish you tend to at the Fishery must be very important to you.
traduit: 你在渔场养的鱼对你来说肯定很重要吧。

original: I see. You hired someone to catch a juvenile mudcrab, but they never returned.
traduit: 我明白了。你雇人去抓泥沼蟹幼体，但他们都没回来。

original: I wouldn't mind taking over the bounty.
traduit: 我不介意接手悬赏。

original: I don't have time to help right now. Maybe some other time.
traduit: 我现在没空帮你。等改天吧。

original: I haven't found a juvenile mudcrab just yet.
traduit: 我还没有找到泥沼蟹幼体。

original: I got your letter. And I have a new companion for your golden friend right here.
traduit: 我收到你的信了。你的金鱼朋友有伴儿咯。

original: Here's the glassfish you requested in your bounty.
traduit: 这是你悬赏的玻璃鱼。

original: Thanks for the coin. And... a note from the Jarl?
traduit: 多谢你的金币。还有……领主的纸条？

original: I'm ready for the next fishing challenge.
traduit: 我准备好迎接下一个钓鱼挑战了。

original: I see, these fish come out in the rain. And... you lost your lucky fishing hat?
traduit: 我明白了，这些鱼都得在雨天钓。还有……你的幸运渔帽丢了？

original: Here are the fish you were after. I also found your lucky fishing hat.
traduit: 这是你要的鱼。你的幸运渔帽我也找到了。

original: Alright. I'll be back soon with the fish. And the hat.
traduit: 好。我很快就带鱼回来。还有你的帽子。

original: I'd like to take over the bounty for the juvenile mudcrab.
traduit: 我想拿泥沼蟹幼体的报酬。

original: The mudcrabs have been slain. They were driven into a fury by a necromancer.
traduit: 泥沼蟹都杀光了。它们好像是被一个死灵法师激怒了。

original: I managed to find a juvenile mudcrab for you to study. Here you go.
traduit: 我帮你找到研究用的泥沼蟹幼体了。给你。

original: Just point me toward something with claws, and I'll make it dead.
traduit: 只要报酬到位，它们小命不保。

original: I'm always up for one of your crab dilemmas.
traduit: 我来解决你的泥沼蟹难题了。

original: Fishermen saw glowing objects that may activate it, but couldn't retrieve them.
traduit: 渔民看到了可能激活它的物体，但没法取到。

original: I've returned. Is the Dwarven fishing rod complete?
traduit: 我回来了。矮人钓竿完成了？

original: Consider the bounty paid in full. I'll try using this near Bronze Water Cave.
traduit: 准备好奖金吧。我会去青铜水洞穴附近使用这个的。

original: In exchange for the schematic, could you build a Dwarven fishing rod for me?
traduit: 作为图纸的交换，你能给我做一根矮人钓竿吗？

original: They believed using a Dwarven fishing rod might help. Here are the schematics.
traduit: 他们觉得矮人钓竿可能会有帮助。这是图纸。

original: I investigated Bronze Water Cave and discovered a dormant Dwarven mechanism.
traduit: 我调查了青铜水洞穴，发现一个休眠的矮人机械。

original: I'm here for the fishing contest. Are you ready to begin?
traduit: 我来参加钓鱼比赛了。你准备好了吗？

original: You're Brutius? I expected someone younger. You're just a feeble old man.
traduit: 你就是布鲁提乌斯？我还以为你很年轻，没想到是个脆皮老头子。

traduit: 这是你在市场摆摊需要的东西。

original: Looks like you're all set up.
traduit: 看来你都准备完了。

original: Good luck, Viriya. I hope everything works out with your new venture.
traduit: 祝你好运，薇丽雅。愿你新事业一切顺利。

original: Alright. I'll be back with the fish.
traduit: 好。我会带鱼回来。

original: This may take longer. I'll need to prepare for the cold.
traduit: 这次可能得花更久。我得先做好御寒准备。

original: I'll explore underground and bring you the fish you need.
traduit: 我去地底探索一下，把你要的鱼带回来。

original: Caves are dangerous. You're lucky I'm the one doing this for you.
traduit: 洞穴都很危险。你该庆幸是我去做。

original: I'll return with these rare catches soon.

original: This looks like it'll be a real challenge. I'll do my best.
traduit: 这次挑战像个样子了。我会尽力的。

original: Thanks for the Argonian fishing rod, and the coin. I'll put them to good use.
traduit: 多谢你的阿尔贡钓竿和奖金。我会好好利用的。

original: This Alik'ri rod is fit for a master fisherman. Thank you, Viriya.
traduit: 这根阿里克'尔钓竿很适合钓鱼大师。谢了，薇丽雅。

original: That certainly wasn't something you see every day.
traduit: 这可不是平时随便能看得到的。

original: I'm glad that's over.
traduit: 能解决就好。

original: I'll tell the Jarl that we prevailed. Good luck on your journey back to Riften.
traduit: 我会去向领主报告胜利喜讯的。也祝你回裂谷时一路顺风。

original: Looks like your juvenile mudcrab is growing up fast.
traduit: 你的泥沼蟹长得很快啊。

original: I'll check with Swims-In-Deep-Water then.
traduit: 那我去问问游于深水。

original: An Argonian fishing rod? Thank you. I will be sure to put it to good use.
traduit: 阿尔贡钓竿？谢了。我会好好利用的。

original: I hope everything is to your liking. Please enjoy your meal.
traduit: 希望一切合你心意。请慢用。

original: Seviur drew them to the coast using magic, but he lost his control over them.
traduit: 瑟维尔用魔法把它们吸引到海岸边，但最后没控制住它们。

original: They'll write songs in our honor after a battle like that!

original: I brought Mila a goldfish. I should follow her to make sure she's going to take care of it.
traduit: 我送给米拉一条金鱼。我应该跟着她，看她把金鱼照顾好。

original: I gave Mila a goldfish. She seemed very happy with her new pet. In exchange, she handed me a single septim. It's not much, but at least I helped brighten a child's day.
traduit: 我送给米拉一条金鱼。她对新宠物很满意。作为交换，她给我一枚塞普汀。虽然不多，但我让这孩子高兴了一整天。

I should give the bottle to the guard suspected of using skooma in the Falkreath Barracks. Now that I understand Zaria and the Jarl's plan, I should obtain the disguised potion from Zaria.
traduit: 城镇卫兵中有人吸食斯库玛，领主请萨莉亚帮忙阻止。萨莉亚计划制造一种伪装成斯库玛样子的隐形药水。我应该去把瓶子交给佛克瑞斯兵营中涉嫌使用斯库玛的卫兵。现在我明白了萨莉亚和领主的计划，应该从萨莉亚那里拿走伪装好的药剂。

original: Zaria gave me her invisibility potion disguised as a bottle of skooma. I should hand it over to the guard inside the barracks.
traduit: 萨莉亚把她配制的隐形药水伪装成一瓶斯库玛交给了我。我应该拿给兵营里的卫兵。

original: I killed the guard suspected of using skooma in the Falkreath Barracks. I should let Zaria know.
traduit: 我杀死了佛克瑞斯兵营里涉嫌使用斯库玛的卫兵。应该去告诉萨莉亚了。

original: I handed the invisibility potion disguised as skooma over to the guard inside the barracks. I should follow him to see if he tries to use the "skooma".
traduit: 我把隐形药水伪装成的斯库玛交给了兵营里的卫兵。我应该跟着他，看他会不会说“斯库玛”这个词。

original: I watched as the guard drank the potion disguised as skooma. He seemed truly distraught after he saw himself turn invisible. Hopefully this is the last of his skooma using days. I should let Zaria know that the plan worked.
traduit: 我看着卫兵喝下伪装成斯库玛的药水。他在看到自己隐形之后，似乎心烦意乱。希望这是他最后一次服用斯库玛。我应该去告诉萨莉亚计划成功了。

original: I let Zaria know that the plan to scare the guard away from using skooma was a success. She rewarded me with an enchanted ring from the Jarl himself.
traduit: 我告诉萨莉亚吓退卫兵不再服用斯库玛的计划成功了。她奖励给我一枚领主本人使用的附魔戒指。

original: I let Zaria know that I killed the guard suspected of using skooma. She clearly disapproved of my methods, but still rewarded me with an enchanted ring from the Jarl nonetheless.
traduit: 我告诉萨莉亚我杀了那个疑似使用斯库玛的卫兵。她显然不赞同我的做法，但还是奖励给我一枚领主使用的附魔戒指。

original: Ri'saad, the Khajiit caravan merchant, has accidentally lost several bottles of expensive flin. traduit: 卡吉特商人里'撒德不小心丢失了几瓶昂贵的飞令。他的买家不是个有耐心的人，所以他必须尽快找回这些酒。里'撒德发出悬赏，从古霍尔丹旅店西边的河里找回酒。

original: I discovered what appears to be the Khajiit caravan's overturned cart along the river west of Old Hroldan Inn. If I fish here, I may be able to recover the lost bottles of aged flin.
traduit: 我在古霍尔丹旅店西边的河里发现了卡吉特商队翻倒的马车。如果在这里钓鱼，也许能找回丢失的那几瓶陈年飞令。

original: I've managed to fish up all of the rare bottles of aged flin that were lost in the river. I should return them to Ri'saad to fulfill the bounty.

original: I gave Ri'saad the lost bottles of aged flin. In return, he paid me with an enchanted ring that aids the wearer in moving quickly and silently. The aged flin must have been very special indeed.
traduit: 我把丢失的几瓶陈年飞令都还给了里'撒德。作为回报，他送给我一枚附魔戒指，可以帮助佩戴者快速无声地行动。看来这批酒真的很值钱。

original: Caught in the Rain
traduit: 雨天垂钓

original: The fish that Swims-In-Deep-Water would like me to catch are a bit more elusive than last time. However, they come to the surface more frequently while it is raining. I should refer to the second volume of Fishing Mastery to learn more. He also asked me to help fish up his lucky fishing hat, lost at a fishing spot west of Sarethi Farm. He claims that it rains wherever he wears the hat when fishing. That sounds far-fetched, but I suppose I could use all the luck I can get.
traduit: 游于深水这次让我抓的鱼比上次更难了。然而，它们会在雨天频繁浮出水面。我可以参考《钓鱼大师》的第二卷了解更多。他还让我帮忙找回他的幸运渔帽。那顶帽子在萨雷锡农场西边的一个渔场丢失了。他说他钓鱼时，戴着帽子到哪里，哪里就下雨。虽然听着很牵强，但我应该运用能得到的所有运气。

original: I have read the second volume of Fishing Mastery. All of the fish I need to catch are most easily caught when it's raining in the warmer parts of Skyrim. Catfish, spadefish, and pygmy sunfish can only be caught in lakes. Pearlfish can be caught in both lakes and streams. He also asked me to help fish up his lucky fishing hat, lost at a fishing spot west of Sarethi Farm. He claims that it rains wherever he wears the hat when fishing. That sounds far-fetched, but I suppose I could use all the luck I can get.
traduit: 我读完了《钓鱼大师》的第二卷。我需要捕获的所有鱼都可以在雨天的天际温暖地区得到。鲶鱼、锹鱼和小日鲈只能在湖里捕到。珍珠鱼在河湖中都能捕到。他还让我帮忙找回他的幸运渔帽。那顶帽子在萨雷锡农场西边的一个渔场丢失了。他说他钓鱼时，戴着帽子到哪里，哪里就下雨。虽然听着很牵强，但我应该运用能得到的所有运气。

original: I've given Swims-In-Deep-Water all of the fish he requested as proof of completing his fishing challenge, as well as his lucky fishing hat. He rewarded me with an Argonian fishing rod, which will be useful when trying to catch large fish. He also handed me a sum of gold.
traduit: 我把游于深水所需的鱼交给他，作为完成钓鱼挑战的证明。还有他的幸运渔帽。他奖励给我一根阿尔贡钓竿，对钓大鱼很有帮助。除此之外还有一笔金币。

original: I've given Swims-In-Deep-Water all of the fish he requested as proof of completing his fishing challenge. I kept his lucky fishing hat to myself after telling him I couldn't find it. He rewarded me with an Argonian fishing rod, which will be useful when trying to catch large fish.
traduit: 我把游于深水所需的鱼交给他，作为完成钓鱼挑战的证明。但我告诉他我没找到他的幸运渔帽后，把帽子据为己有了。他奖励给我一根阿尔贡钓竿，对钓大鱼很有帮助。

original: Swims-In-Deep-Water would like me to catch fish that can commonly be caught in streams and lakes in the warmer parts of Skyrim. Once I've caught one of each, I should return them to him. His field guide, Fishing Mastery, should provide details on each fish and how they can be caught. He mentioned that a copy is sitting on a shelf in the back room of the Riften Fishery.
traduit: 游于深水希望我能钓一些天际温暖地区溪流湖泊中的常见鱼类。等我钓到，就可以交给他。他的实地指南《钓鱼大师》应该能提供每种鱼的详细信息和捕获方法。他把一卷副本放在裂谷渔场后屋的架子上供我使用。

original: I read the first volume of Fishing Mastery, Swims-In-Deep-Water's field guide. All of the fish I need to catch can be caught in the warmer parts of Skyrim on a clear day. Goldfish and glassfish can only be caught in lakes, while pogfish are found in streams. Carp can be caught in both lakes and streams. I should be able to catch what I need by fishing of off the docks near the Riften Fishery, and along the river that leads to Ivarstead.
traduit: 我读了游于深水写的《钓鱼大师》的第一卷。我需要捕获的所有鱼都可以在晴天的天际温暖地区得到。金鱼和玻璃鱼只能在湖里捕获，而珀格鱼生活在溪流中。鲤鱼在河湖中都能捕到。我可以在裂谷渔场附近的码头上，沿着通往伊瓦尔镇的河流，钓到我需要的东西。

original: I've given Swims-In-Deep-Water all of the fish he requested as proof of completing his fishing challenge. In return, he gave me a sum of gold, as well as a key to the Riften Fishery.
traduit: 我把所有鱼交给了游于深水，作为完成钓鱼挑战的证明。作为回报，他给了我一笔金币和裂谷渔场的钥匙。

original: I received a hastily written letter from Viriya. I should read what it has to say.
traduit: 我收到薇丽雅急匆匆写的信件。我应该读一下内容。

original: Viriya received a letter from Jarl <Alias=Jarl> in Dawnstar. The frenzied mudcrabs have emerged once again. When the Dawnstar guard arrived, they were attacked by a spirit that caused them to flee in terror. Viriya is already on her way to Dawnstar and asked for my assistance. I should answer the call and return to the shore west of Dawnstar.
traduit: 薇丽雅收到晨星城领主<Alias=Jarl>的来信。疯狂的泥沼蟹再次出现。等晨星卫兵抵达时，他们遭遇了精魂袭击，惊恐逃跑。薇丽雅已经在赶往晨星的路上，她请求我的支援。我应该赴约赶往晨星城西边的海岸。

original: I have arrived once again at the shore west of Dawnstar. The signs of a recent battle scar the surrounding area where Viriya and a handful of guards have stood their ground against a mudcrab horde. As I approached, the frenzied mudcrabs began to emerge from the sea again. I should help Viriya and the guards defeat them.
traduit: 我再次来到晨星城以西的海岸。薇丽雅和几个卫兵坚守的地方留下了最近一场与泥沼蟹战斗的痕迹。当我靠近时，疯狂的泥沼蟹再次从海里出现。我应该帮助薇丽雅和卫兵击败它们。

original: I've helped Viriya and the guards defeat a wave of frenzied mudcrabs, but more are coming. I should take a moment to prepare for the next assault.
traduit: 我帮助薇丽雅和卫兵们击退了一波疯狂的泥沼蟹，但还有更多正在赶来。我得花些时间应对下一次袭击。

original: Another wave of frenzied mudcrabs have emerged from the sea west of Dawnstar, this time more numerous than ever. We will need to fend them off once more.
traduit: 另一波疯狂的泥沼蟹在晨星以西的海域出现了，这次规模远胜以前。我们需要再次击溃它们。

original: After several hard-fought battles, the frenzied mudcrab attacks have stopped for now. We should regroup inside the shack nearby.
traduit: 经过几轮苦战，疯狂的泥沼蟹停止进攻了。我们应该回附近的小屋里重新集结。

original: Now that we've regrouped after the battle, I should speak to Viriya inside the shack.
traduit: 我们结束战斗后重新集合，我应该到小屋里和薇丽雅谈谈。

original: The guardian spirit of a massive emperor crab has materialized off the coast, along with a new wave of mudcrabs. The guardian spirit is too large to be harmed by normal means. However, I should be able to use the catapults the guards have put in position nearby. The mudcrabs seem to have collected the flaming pots from the wrecked wagon near the shack. I will have to recover them from the mudcrabs and use them to fire the catapults at the guardian spirit.
traduit: 一只巨型帝王蟹守护之灵出现在海岸附近，还有一群新的泥沼蟹伴随。守护之灵过于巨大，普通攻击不能奏效。不过我可以使用卫兵在附近设置的投石机。泥沼蟹似乎从小屋附近失事的马车上收集了一些燃烧罐。我可以把它们从泥沼蟹那里拿回来，然后向守护之灵发射。

original: Using the catapults, I managed to vanquish the emperor crab guardian spirit. The swarms of frenzied mudcrabs have come to an end. I should speak to Viriya now that the battle is over.
traduit: 托投石机的福，我成功击败了帝王蟹守护之灵。疯狂的泥沼蟹群已经退去。战斗结束了，我应该找薇丽雅谈谈。

original: In the aftermath of the battle, Viriya thanked me for helping defeat the guardian spirit of the emperor crab. The guards must tend to their wounds, and Viriya will make the long journey back to Riften. The emperor crab guardian spirit and its horde of frenzied mudcrabs should no longer threaten the people of Dawnstar. I should travel to Dawnstar and inform the Jarl that the battle was a success.
traduit: 战斗结束了，薇丽雅感谢我帮忙击败了帝王蟹守护之灵。卫兵们还需要照顾伤员，薇丽雅也踏上返回裂谷城的漫长旅途。帝王蟹守护灵和那群疯狂的泥沼蟹应该不会再威胁晨星人民了。我可以去向晨星领主报告了。

original: In the aftermath of the battle, Viriya thanked me for helping defeat the guardian spirit of the emperor crab. The guards must tend to their wounds, and Viriya will make the long journey back to Riften. The emperor crab guardian spirit and its horde of frenzied mudcrabs should no longer threaten the people of Dawnstar. I traveled to Dawnstar and informed the Jarl, who rewarded me for my efforts.
traduit: 战斗结束了，薇丽雅感谢我帮忙击败了帝王蟹守护之灵。卫兵们还需要照顾伤员，薇丽雅也踏上返回裂谷城的漫长旅途。帝王蟹守护灵和那群疯狂的泥沼蟹应该不会再威胁晨星人民了。我到晨星向领主报告，得到了领主的奖赏。

original: I met Viriya, one of the employees at the Riften Fishery. She handed me a bounty letter and seemed rather frustrated. I should see what it has to say.
traduit: 裂谷城渔场的雇员薇丽雅递给我一封悬赏信，而且似乎很沮丧。我应该看看上面写了什么。

original: Viriya at the Riften Fishery has been conducting research on breeding mudcrabs to harvest their meat, much like fish. She has issued a bounty for someone to obtain a juvenile mudcrab for her studies, but the last person to accept the bounty never returned. I should speak to her when I am ready to take over the bounty.
traduit: 裂谷渔场的薇丽雅一直在研究，如何像养鱼一样培育肉用泥沼蟹。她曾悬赏获取一只泥沼蟹幼体以供研究，但最后接受悬赏的人再也没回来。等我准备好接受悬赏任务的时候，可以去她谈谈。

original: Viriya at the Riften Fishery has been conducting research on mudcrabs in the hopes that they could be more easily bred and harvested, much like fish. She has issued a bounty for someone to obtain a juvenile mudcrab for her studies, but the last person to accept the bounty never returned. I should try fishing one up myself in the streams and lakes in the temperate parts of Skyrim. One lake in particular is known to be teeming with mudcrab, which Viriya mentioned was west of Broken Fang Cave.
traduit: 裂谷渔场的薇丽雅一直在研究，如何像养鱼一样培育肉用泥沼蟹。她曾悬赏获取一只泥沼蟹幼体以供研究，但最后接受悬赏的人再也没回来。我可以试着在天际气候温和地区的河湖中钓一只。薇丽雅推测断牙洞穴西边的湖是泥沼蟹的聚集地之一。

original: I turned a juvenile mudcrab over to Viriya for her research. In return, she gave me a key to the Riften Fishery so that I may enter whenever I need to.
traduit: 我把一只泥沼蟹幼体交给薇丽雅做研究使用。作为回报，她给了我一把裂谷渔场的钥匙供我随时进出。

original: Beneath Bronze Waters
traduit: 青铜水之下

original: Calcelmo has heard fishermen's tales of a strange apparatus outside of Bronze Water Cave. He believes it is an ancient Dwemer mechanism of unknown purpose, waiting to be brought to life. I should investigate the area and see if there might be any way to trigger it.
traduit: 卡塞莫听了渔夫们的故事，说青铜水洞穴附近有个奇怪的装置。他认为那是一种未知的古老锻莫机械，正等待着被赋予生命。我应该去调查一下那个区域，看看有没有办法激活它。

original: I've arrived at the entrance of Bronze Water Cave. The fishermen that once fished here seem to have left behind a journal. It may contain a clue for activating the mechanisms nearby.
traduit: 我来到了青铜水洞穴入口。曾在这里捕鱼的渔民似乎留下了一本日记。里面可能有激活机械的线索。

original: The fishermen at Bronze Water Cave saw faint glowing objects at the bottom of the lake near Bronze Water Cave, but they were unable to fish them up. They believed that a fishing rod of Dwarven make might be needed to retrieve them. They recently left for Alftand Ruined Tower, where the schematics for such a rod might be located.
traduit: 青铜水洞穴的渔民在附近的湖底看到了微微发光的物体，但没法捕捞上来。他们认为可能需要一根矮人制造的钓竿来捞取。他们最近去了艾尔夫坦德遗迹塔，想要寻找钓竿的图纸。

original: I've found the schematics for the Dwarven fishing rod that might be used to catch the glowing objects that lie below the water's surface outside of Bronze Water Cave. I should return it to Calcelmo so that he can construct it.
traduit: 我找到了矮人钓竿的图纸，可以用来捕捞青铜水洞穴水下的发光体。我应该把它交给卡塞莫，让他来制作钓竿。

original: I've given Calcelmo the schematics for the Dwarven fishing rod. I now need to wait for him to construct it. I should ask him about it at this time tomorrow.
traduit: 我把矮人钓竿的图纸交给了卡塞莫。我现在要等待制作完成。明天这时候再来看看。

original: Calcelmo should be finished constructing the Dwarven fishing rod from the schematic I discovered.
traduit: 卡塞莫应该已经根据我发现的图纸完成了矮人钓竿的制作。

original: Calcelmo has given me the Dwarven fishing rod. I should cast it at the fishing spots near Bronze Water Cave so that I might be able to catch the objects that might activate the mechanisms near the cave.
traduit: 卡塞莫把钓竿给了我。我应该用它去青铜水洞穴附近的钓鱼点下钩，这样就可能激活洞穴附近的机械了。

original: I cast the Dwarven fishing rod into the water near Bronze Water Cave, and caught an aetherium dynamo core. An empty socket on the pedestal nearby appears to be shaped to hold such a core. I'll have to insert the dynamo core to bring the rest of the mechanism to life.
traduit: 我用矮人钓竿在青铜水洞穴附近的水里下钩，钓到了一个神光动力核心。附近的基座上似乎有个用来容纳核心用的空插座。我得把动力核心插进去才能让机械的其余部分运转起来。

original: After using the Dwarven fishing rod near Bronze Water Cave and powering up an ancient mechanism using aetherium dynamo cores, a pedestal rose from beneath the surface revealing a submerged chest.
traduit: 在青铜水洞穴附近使用矮人钓竿，并把神光动力核心插在古老机械上提供动力后，一个基座从水下升起，露出一个淹没在水下的箱子。
