original: Mila Valentia in Whiterun wrote me a letter saying that the goldfish I brought her needs a companion. I should bring her another goldfish whenever the opportunity arises.
traduit: 白漫城的米拉·巴伦西亚给我写了封信，说她的金鱼需要一个伴儿。等有机会，我可以再给她一条。

original: I brought Mila another goldfish. I should follow her to the trough where she will keep them.
traduit: 我又给米拉找来一条金鱼。我应该再跟她去看看，她会把它们放在哪里。

original: Mila's goldfish now has a new companion. In exchange, she gave me a note and a key. I should see what the note has to say.
traduit: 米拉的金鱼现在有新伙伴了。作为交换，她给了我一张纸条和一把钥匙。我应该看看纸条上写了什么。

original: Mila's note mentions that she keeps "treasure" in a secret hiding place where she likes to play behind Dragonsreach. It's likely just things she's found around Whiterun, but I should check just to be certain.
traduit: 米拉在纸条上说，她把“宝藏”藏在了龙临宫后面她经常玩耍的一个秘密地点。可能是她在白漫城附近发现的东西，但我应该去检查一下。

original: I brought Mila Valentia another goldfish. In exchange, she gave me the key to her treasure box at her hiding spot behind Dragonsreach. I was surprised to discover that she has collected a set of rare alchemy ingredients.
traduit: 我又给米拉找来一条金鱼。作为交换，她把藏在龙临宫后面宝箱的钥匙给了我。我惊讶地发现她居然收集了一套稀有的炼金原料。

traduit: 私人课程

original: Lynea in Markarth is in search of a fishing tutor. I should let her know when I feel up to the task. Her bounty letter said that she can be found waiting in the Silver-Blood Inn.
traduit: 马卡斯的莱妮雅正在寻找钓鱼教练。我应该向她展示自己的资质。她在悬赏中说在银血旅店等着。

original: I spoke to Lynea about fishing lessons, and she agreed to meet me on the docks near the Warrens in Markarth when she is ready to begin.
traduit: 我和莱妮雅谈了钓鱼课程的事，她同意等准备好之后，到马卡斯城窝棚区外的码头跟我见面。

original: I met Lynea on the docks near the Warrens. I should catch several fish in order to demonstrate proper fishing technique.
traduit: 我在窝棚区外的码头和莱妮雅见面。为了示范正确的钓鱼技术，我应该先钓上几条。

original: I caught several fish while Lynea watched on. I should speak with her now that the lesson is complete.
traduit: 我抓到了几条鱼，莱妮雅则在一旁观摩。课程结束了，我应该和她谈谈。

original: Lynea seemed to appreciate her fishing lesson, and gave me her amulet of Dibella as payment.
traduit: 莱妮雅似乎很满意这节钓鱼课，把她的迪贝拉护符送给我作为报酬。

original: Tusked Terror
traduit: 牙之恐怖

original: The Jarl of Windhelm has put out a bounty on a monsterous horker known as Fangtusk, which has been terrorizing fishermen north of Hollyfrost Farm. Fishermen have learned that it seems to enjoy arctic grayling above all other fish. I should obtain an arctic grayling and leave it near its feeding grounds in order to lure it out.
traduit: 风舵城领主悬赏猎杀一只叫“牙牙”的怪物。它一直在冬青霜农场以北恐吓渔民。据渔民们说，它十分喜爱北极茴鱼。我应该去抓一条放在觅食地附近，把它引出来。

original: I've placed an arctic grayling at Fangtusk's feeding grounds, which seems to have lured it out. I can now slay it in order to rid the area of its hostility.
traduit: 我在牙牙的觅食地放了一条北极茴鱼，把它引了出来。现在我可以杀掉它，消除这片区域的威胁。

original: I have slain Fangtusk. During the battle, I discovered that the rumors about its ability to drain the life of those around it are true. I should inspect it to learn what, if anything, has granted it this unnatural ability.
traduit: 我已经杀死了牙牙。我在战斗中发现，它能吸干周围人生命的传言不虚。我应该检查一下，看究竟是什么原因让它拥有了这种非自然的能力。

original: After slaying Fangtusk, I discovered the remains of a vampire inside its gut, along with an enchanted vampiric ring. I should show the Jarl's steward the ring as proof that the deed is done.
traduit: 杀死牙牙后，我在它的肚子里发现了一具吸血鬼遗骸和一枚附魔的吸血鬼戒指。我应该把戒指拿回去交给领主总管，作为悬赏完成的证明。

original: I showed the vampiric ring taken from Fangtusk to Jarl of Windhelm's steward, who rewarded me for fulfilling the bounty.
traduit: 我把从牙牙肚子里找到的吸血鬼戒指交给了风舵城领主的总管，拿到了赏金。

original: Crustacean Extermination
traduit: 灭绝甲壳类

original: Viriya has entrusted me with another task directly from her. I should read what her note has to say.
traduit: 薇丽雅直接委托给我另一个任务。我可以看看她的纸条上写了什么。

original: An unexplained swarm of aggressive mudcrabs have recently begun attacking fishermen at a fishing shack on the coast west of Dawnstar. Viriya has tasked me with eliminating them in order to make the coasts safe once more.
traduit: 最近有一群怪异好斗的泥沼蟹开始袭击晨星西部海岸鱼棚的渔民。薇丽雅委托我去消灭它们，好让海岸再度安全。

original: I've arrived at the fishing shack west of Dawnstar. As I approached, frenzied mudcrabs attacked from the sea. I'll have to defeat them in order to make this area safe again.
traduit: 我到达了晨星城以西的渔民小屋。一靠近，疯狂的泥沼蟹就从海里出来围攻我。我必须击败它们才能确保这片区域恢复安定。

original: I've defeated the swarm of frenzied mudcrabs. I should investigate the area to see if I can discover why the mudcrabs in this area have become so aggressive.
traduit: 我击败了一群疯狂的泥沼蟹。我应该调查一下这个区域，看看能否查明这群泥沼蟹变得具有攻击性的原因。

original: I discovered that Seviur, a novice necromancer, was practicing his arts on the coastline. He cast a powerful illusion spell to bring mudcrabs to the shore where he repeatedly killed and resurrected them in order to hone his abilities. Aggressive mudcrabs not under Seviur's control soon began rising from the sea to attack. Eventually, Seviur was slain, but it seems that the frenzied mudcrab attacks have not stopped. I must now quell this latest mudcrab attack on the coastline.
traduit: 我发现一个叫瑟维尔的死灵法师学徒，正在海岸线上练习魔法。他释放了一个强大的幻术魔法，把泥沼蟹引到岸边，在那里反复杀死与复活它们，以此锻炼自己的能力。不受瑟尔维控制的好斗泥沼蟹很快从海里冒出来攻击。最后，瑟尔维被杀了，但陷入疯狂的泥沼蟹并没有停下。我现在必须平息这场泥沼蟹对海岸的袭击。

original: I discovered that Seviur, a novice necromancer, was practicing his arts on the coastline. He cast a powerful illusion spell to bring mudcrabs to the shore where he repeatedly killed and resurrected them in order to hone his abilities. Aggressive mudcrabs not under Seviur's control soon began rising from the sea to attack. Eventually, Seviur was slain, but it seems that the frenzied mudcrab attacks have not stopped. Now that the mudcrabs have been defeated, I should return to Viriya.
traduit: 我发现一个叫瑟维尔的死灵法师学徒，正在海岸线上练习魔法。他释放了一个强大的幻术魔法，把泥沼蟹引到岸边，在那里反复杀死与复活它们，以此锻炼自己的能力。不受瑟尔维控制的好斗泥沼蟹很快从海里冒出来攻击。最后，瑟尔维被杀了，但陷入疯狂的泥沼蟹并没有停下。现在泥沼蟹已经被击败了，我可以回去找薇丽雅了。

original: I returned to Viriya and told her about the mudcrab swarm and the necromancer who stirred them into a frenzy. As payment, she gave me an Alik'ri fishing rod, which should be very helpful when trying to catch smaller fish.
traduit: 我回到薇丽雅处，告诉她泥沼蟹群与操纵它们陷入疯狂的死灵法师的事。作为回报，她送给我一根阿里克'尔钓竿，对我钓小鱼很有帮助。

original: Investigate the area near the fishing shack west of Dawnstar
traduit: 调查晨星城西边渔民小屋附近的区域

traduit: 杀死疯狂的泥沼蟹（<Global=ccBGSSSE001_MQ2CrabsKilled>/<Global=ccBGSSSE001_MQ2CrabsTotal>）

original: First Catch
traduit: 首次垂钓

original: Skyrim's waters are teeming with life just below the surface. With enough skill and a bit of luck, I could catch a few fish that would make for a hearty meal. While there are many places to fish throughout Skyrim, I've heard rumors of an excellent fishing spot at a camp near the Guardian Stones just south of Riverwood.
traduit: 天际的水下生机盎然。只要有足够的技巧和一点运气，我就能钓上几条鱼，然后做成一顿丰盛的大餐。虽然天际的钓鱼点很多，但我听说河木镇南边的守护之石附近有个营地是绝佳的钓鱼点。

original: I've found the fishing spot near the Guardian Stones. I should try my hand at fishing here to see what I can catch. The fisherman who camps here seems to have a copy of Line and Lure nearby. I might learn a few things by flipping through it.
traduit: 我找到了守护之石附近的钓鱼点。我应该试试，看能钓上来什么。在这里扎营的渔民手边似乎有本《鱼线和鱼饵》。我可以读一下，学点基础知识。

original: Using my fishing rod and supplies, I managed to make my first of many successful catches.
traduit: 我用钓竿和其他用品，成功钓到了第一条鱼。

traduit: 前往河木镇南边的钓鱼营地

traduit: 装备一根钓竿

traduit: （可选）阅读鱼线和鱼饵

original: The Ultimate Feast
traduit: 终极盛宴

original: Gisli in Solitude has requested a huge seafood meal. The innkeeper does not stock everything she would like, so I'll need to collect all of the food in Gisli's bounty letter in order to set a table for her on the second floor of the Winking Skeever.
traduit: 独孤城的吉斯莉想要准备一顿丰盛的海鲜大餐。旅店老板没有备齐所需的所有食物。我得把吉斯莉悬赏信上的所有食物都准备好，才能在眨眼恶鼠二楼为她安排席面。

original: I have set a table for Gisli at the Winking Skeever in Solitude. I should wait for her to take her seat and check in once she's finished dining.
traduit: 我在眨眼恶鼠为吉斯莉准备了酒席。等她坐下吃完，我再去找她。

original: Gisli should be finished dining by now. I should check the table for her payment.
traduit: 吉斯莉现在应该已经吃完了。我应该去查看一下账单。

original: I prepared a huge seafood feast for Gisli in Solitude. Judging by the letter of thanks and the coin purse left on her empty plate, she seemed satisfied with her meal.
traduit: 我帮独孤城的吉斯莉准备了一顿丰盛的海鲜大餐。从她的感谢信和空盘子里剩下的一大袋金币来看，她似乎对这顿饭很满意。

traduit: 获取一盘清蒸蟹腿

original: End of the Line
traduit: 生涯终点

original: I've received a letter from Viriya. I should read what it has to say.
traduit: 我收到薇丽雅的信。我应该读读里面写了什么。

original: Viriya is planning to leave the Riften Fishery and start her own market stall in the Grand Plaza specializing in her passion, mudcrab. I should see if I can help her by obtaining all of the supplies she will need to build her stall so she can move on to her next venture.
traduit: 薇丽雅计划离开裂谷渔场，到大广场去开一个属于自己的摊位，专门经营自己喜欢的泥沼蟹。我应该看看能不能帮她弄到搭建摊位所需的物资，这样她就能进行下一步了。

original: I have given Viriya everything she needs in order to build her own market stall in the Grand Plaza. I should wait for her to set it up.
traduit: 我把薇丽雅所需的东西交给她去搭建市场摊位。我应该等待她安排妥当。

original: Viriya should have her market stall in the Grand Plaza set up by now. I should pay her a visit when I have the chance.
traduit: 薇丽雅在大广场的摊位摆好了。等有机会可以去拜访一下。

original: I spoke to Viriya at her new market stall, where she has started a new chapter in her life beyond the Riften Fishery. I'm glad she was able to realize her dream of farming and selling mudcrab meat.
traduit: 我和薇丽雅在她新开张的摊位上聊了聊，她离开了裂谷渔场，开启了人生的新篇章。很高兴她能够实现自己养殖贩卖泥沼蟹肉的梦想。

While fishing, press [Activate] to reel in your line. Reeling when there is a strong pull on your line will reel in your catch.

Ripples on the surface when casting your line are from nearby fish. If the water is calm when you cast your line, there are no more fish to catch. Fish will return to the fishing spot in a day's time.

original:
<font face="$HandwrittenFont">
This Spell Tome will teach its reader the unique art of the Telekinesis Arrow, giving both a Lesser Power, and the knowledge to craft these special arrows.

Upon firing the arrow, one will find it to be suspended - frozen in the air until the Telekinesis Arrow Lesser Power is cast, upon which the volley will be released.  

It appears that only a certain number of arrows can be suspended in the air at a time.  Attempting to fire any more than ten, they are simply returned to the archer's quiver.  While suspended, one can pluck them from the air, however.

Upon making contact, these arrows lose their magical power, and cannot be retrieved.  As they contain magical properties of their own, they appear to me impervious to enchantments from the bow they are fired from.
</font>
traduit:
<font face="$HandwrittenFont">
这本法术书能教会读者念动箭的独特技法，赋予他们制作这种特殊箭矢的技能和知识。

射箭时，会发现箭矢冻结在空中，直到用轻微力量的念动术释放。

似乎一次性只能让一定数量的箭悬浮在空中。如果发射超过十次，就会被送回射手的箭袋里。然而，当它们悬浮在空中，人们也可以把它们从空中摘下。

一旦接触到目标，箭就会失去力量，无法回收。因为它们自己具备附魔属性，所以我认为它们似乎不受射出它们的弓的附魔效果影响。
</font>

original:
<font face="$HandwrittenFont" size="17">

Someone, please help!  A group of Necromancers are experimenting with conjuring Zombies using ancient, dangerous magic, which I fear will have unintended and irreversible consequences.  I was expelled from their studies as their ambitions grew into folly, against my warnings.

They're performing a ritual to summon a large group of these foul, uncontrollable creatures as we speak in the southern-most area of Skyrim, and must be stopped before it's too late!
traduit:
<font face="$HandwrittenFont" size="17">

来人帮帮忙！一群亡灵术士正在试验用古老的危险魔法召唤僵尸，我担心这会带来意想不到而且不可逆转的后果。他们不顾我的警告，狂妄自大地把我开除了。

他们正在进行仪式，打算召唤大批常识中肮脏、不可控的生物，他们就在天际最南部的地区，必须尽快阻止他们，否则悔之晚矣！

original: 3rd of Sun's Height, 4E 201 An apprentice of mine recently discovered an ancient tome in a forgotten cavern during a gathering expedition. This tome is like nothing I've seen in a very long time. I believe it's a conjuration spell of some sort, but I can't be certain. I'll need to spend some time deciphering this. It could be quite valuable to us. [pagebreak] 18th of Sun's Height, 4E 201 I've spent the last several weeks working tirelessly to decipher this ancient tome. It's just as I suspected; It is indeed a conjuration spell. However, the creature summoned is especially vicious. An undead zombie of wonderfully putrid potency that appears to be much more active in the late night hours. I'm not stopping now. I plan to create an even more powerful version of this spell. As Molag Bal as my witness I shall have a zombie horde at my command before long. [pagebreak] 15th of Last Seed, 4E 201 Nothing could have prepared me for the power I am about to wield. The whole of my training has been for this moment. Soon, my apprentices and I shall perform a ritual the likes of which has not been seen in centuries, and bring forth an undead army, powerful and willing to do my bidding. Its power will radiate across Skyrim, bringing forth waves of undead from the darkness. The time is at hand!
traduit: 4E 201， 日高月3日 我的一个学徒在一次集体探险时发现了一部古籍。这本书与我多年所见大有不同。我感觉这是一本召唤法术的书籍，却也不敢判定。 我需要花些时间破译一番。也许对我们很有价值。 [pagebreak] 4E201年，日高月18日 过去几周我锲而不舍地破译那本古书。如我所料，这确实是法术书。然而所召唤之物甚是邪恶。是一种不死僵尸，具有神奇的腐烂能力，在深夜尤为活跃。 我不能停下来了。我要创造一个更强大的法术版本。莫拉格·巴尔为证，我不久之后就能指挥一大群僵尸了。 [pagebreak] 4E201年，末种月15日 没有什么能够阻止我去获得即将掌控的力量了。我所有的修行都是为了这一刻。我很快就会和徒弟们一起举行一场数百年来未有的仪式，率领一支强大服从的亡灵大军。它的力量必将辐射天际，从黑暗中引来一波又一波亡灵。 时机已到！

original:
<font face='$HandwrittenFont'><div align="left">
10 Sun's Height

I have arrived at the College of Winterhold, who have generously allowed a fellow academic to make use of their vast library. A good thing, as even in the short ride from Sivdur's Respite north of Windhelm, I feel chilled down to my very bones. I now search for the means to gain entrance to Sivdur's tomb using the faint inscriptions found near the entrance.

My objectives are to discover where Sivdur's amulet might be found, as well as the burial site of Sivdur's nemesis, Magrathi. I shall start with texts on ancient Nord heroes and work backwards from there.

13 Sun's Height

No luck thus far. Discouraging, but I will not despair. The answers lie in these walls somewhere.

14 Sun's Height

A breakthrough! It has been recorded that Sivdur's amulet has traditionally been passed down from father to son for generations. If my tracing of the lineages is correct, the current living descendants of Sivdur are the Battle-Borns, a clan that resides in the city of Whiterun. If this is true, then Sivdur's amulet is likely possessed by the youngest Battle-Born son, one Lars Battle-Born. I must inquire with them.

19 Sun's Height

Details are sparse, but Magrathi appears to have once been an influential priest of the dragon cult. He seems to have slain Sivdur's brother over rightful ownership of a silver mine. He is said to have been laid to rest in Shroud Hearth Barrow near Ivarstead.

I will now return to Sivdur's Respite, take some additional notes, and then travel east to Windhelm where a few good sellswords might be found that can help me with this treacherous undertaking.
traduit:
<font face='$HandwrittenFont'><div align="left">
日高月10日

我已经抵达冬堡学院，他们十分慷慨地允许学者同行使用他们的大图书馆。这是好事，因为即使从西弗杜尔之栖到风舵城路程不远，但我还是感觉浑身发冷。我现在正用在坟墓入口发现的模糊铭文寻找进入西弗杜尔坟墓的方法。

我的目标是找到西弗杜尔的护符，还有西弗杜尔的宿敌马格拉斯的墓地。我要从古诺德英雄文本着手，往后追溯。

日高月13日

目前为止还没什么发现。虽然令人懊丧，但我不会绝望。答案就在这些墙上的某个地方。

日高月14日

重大突破！据记载，西弗杜尔的护符是父子相传的。如果我对血统的追踪无误，住在白漫城的战狂氏族就是西弗杜尔的后裔。如果真是如此，那么西弗杜尔的护符很可能在战狂家最小的儿子拉斯·战狂手里。我必须去问问他们。

日高月19日

虽然细节很少，但马格拉斯似乎是拜龙教一位很有影响力的祭司。他似乎为了争夺一个银矿的合法所有权而杀害了西弗杜尔的兄弟。据说他被安葬在伊瓦尔镇附近的覆炉古坟。

我现在得回西弗杜尔之栖做些额外笔记，然后向东去风舵城，那里应该能找到优秀的佣兵协助我完成这项危险的任务。

I have seen it in my dreams, standing over the champion's lifeless body, clutching a gleaming golden katana turned red with the blood of my foes.

We must puzzle out that Imperial scholar's notes and breach the tomb. Then I will have my victory.

我们必须破解那个帝国学者的笔记，然后打开坟墓。然后我们就赢定了。

original: Eranya's Notes on Sivdur's Tomb
traduit: 艾然雅的西弗杜尔之栖笔记

original: 7 Sun's Height I have arrived. The entrance of Sivdur's tomb remains impressively intact. I hope that the interior remains equally well-preserved. That is, assuming Titus Mede II elected not to pillage the entire ruin over two decades ago when Goldbrand was allegedly returned to Sivdur's side. One can only hope he exercised restraint. It appears that the burial chamber is locked using an ancient mechanical system, and only by placing the correct objects on the pedestals flanking the chamber's entrance will the path open. Fascinating! I must research where to find the relics required to open the chamber. I shall return when I have more answers. 23 Sun's Height The inscriptions relate to two ancient relics. The first is Sivdur's amulet, inscribed with the symbols of his rank and other honorifics. The second is the skull of Sivdur's betrayer and lifelong enemy, Magrathi. Sivdur, never having exacted revenge in his time, now calls out to us from the beyond to defile his enemy's resting place, and place the skull near his sacred burial chamber as a sort of trophy. Morbid, but not uncommon for the period. I now go out in search of the relics that will lead to the opening of the tomb. I have left my notes where I conducted my research, in the Arcanaeum in the College of Winterhold. If some ill fate were to befall me, perhaps another may continue the search.
traduit: 日高月7日 我终于找到了。西弗杜尔之墓的入口完好无损，令人赞叹。希望内部也同样保存妥当。也就是说，得假设提图斯·迈德二世在二十年前并未掠夺整个遗迹，据说黄金烙印当时被归还给了西弗杜尔。我们只能希望他当时保持克制了。 墓室似乎用一种古老的机械锁系统锁上了，只有把正确的东西放在墓室入口两侧的基座上，通道才会打开。太厉害了！ 我必须研究一下在哪里能找到打开墓室所需的文物。等我找到更多答案时我会回来的。 日高月23日 这些铭文与两件古代文物有关。其一是西弗杜尔的护符，上面刻有象征其身份地位的徽记以及其他荣誉名号。其二是西弗杜尔的背叛者和宿敌马格拉斯的头骨。西弗杜尔生前未竟复仇之愿，如今在冥冥之中向我们发出召唤，要我们亵渎其仇敌的安息之所，并将头骨置于他神圣的墓室附近作为战利品。虽说有些病态，但在那个时代倒也并不罕见。 我现在要出发去寻找打开坟墓所需的遗物。我把笔记留在冬堡学院秘藏馆做研究的地方。假如我遭遇不幸，也好有其他人继续寻找。

original: Eranya's Journal
traduit: 艾然雅的日记

original:
<font face='$HandwrittenFont'>
2 Sun's Height

My name is Eranya, Imperial historian. My research on ancient artifacts has led me across the sands of Elsweyr and the forests of Valenwood, and now, it has led me to the inhospitable north of Skyrim.

My quarry is that of Goldbrand, a golden katana said to have been forged by dragons and embodies the power of the Daedric Prince Boethiah. The blade has passed through many hands, most recently those of Emperor Titus Mede II. He was rumored to have possessed it during the Battle of the Red Ring.

After the battle, Mede II (or one of his agents) had it returned to the tomb of the one said to have originally possessed the blade: Sivdur, an ancient Nord warrior who fought in defense of the dragons. And there, in Sivdur's Respite, is where Goldbrand is said to reside. Mede II was said to have felt that he lacked the right to claim the blade, and that it should return to the one who it was first entrusted.

No direct record of the location of Sivdur's Respite exists in the Imperial archives. However, I discovered a strange missive on a mission involving precious cargo, and along with it, a map. As it turns out, this was the only record of the mission to return Goldbrand to Skyrim, and the map led to Sivdur's Respite. It lies in a cave in the mountains just north of Windhelm!

Based on my findings there, I have other business to attend to now. It would seem I have some traveling yet to do. I have documented my findings in a separate journal on the topic.

15 Last Seed

I am starting to believe I may have attracted unwanted attention. A group of dangerous cultists who worship the daedric prince Boethiah are said to gather near Windhelm, and Goldbrand's whereabouts would no doubt be of interest to them. Already I feel like I see the same faces as I pass strangers along the road.

I should be careful.
traduit:

日高月2日

我叫艾然雅，帝国的历史学家。我对古代神器的研究带领我穿越艾斯维尔的沙漠、威伦森林的森林，现在，它带我来到了荒凉的天际之北。

我的猎物是黄金烙印，据说是一把由龙族铸造的黄金太刀，象征着迪德拉君王波耶西亚的力量。这把剑已经几经辗转，最近一次是在皇帝提图斯·迈德二世的手中。有传言说他曾在红环之战中使用它。

战争结束后，迈德二世（或是他的代理人）将它送回了最初拥有此剑者——西弗杜尔的坟墓中。西弗杜尔是个保卫龙族的古代诺德战士。据说黄金烙印就放在西弗杜尔之栖。相传是迈德二世觉得无权拥有此剑，应该物归原主。

帝国的档案中没有西弗杜尔之栖的准确记录。然而，我在一次任务中发现了一封奇怪的信件，里面提及了珍贵的货物和一张地图。事实证明，这就是将黄金烙印送回天际的唯一记录，而地图则指向了西弗杜尔之栖。它就在风舵城北边山里的一个山洞里！

据我在那里的发现，现在还有事情要做。看来我又要去旅行了。我已经在另一本关于这个主题的日记里记录了发现。

末种月15日

我开始觉得我可能引起了一些不必要的注意。据说有群信仰迪德拉君王波耶西亚的危险教徒聚集在风舵城附近，而黄金烙印的下落无疑会引起他们的兴趣。我已经觉得，路上遇到的陌生人里有相同的面孔了。

我得小心点。

original: Caravan Captain's Note
traduit: 车队队长的纸条

original: We met with Sadras and picked up the cargo. At least their captain seemed in better spirits, but the others looked exhausted. To make matters worse, the air was flush with news about the caravans who didn't make it, sieged by Dwarven automatons on the road to Whiterun. My worry is such fears will find their way into the minds of my men. Especially when the details of their stories seem to corroborate, it only serves to throw more kindling on the flame. Hopefully the other captains have a plan. We've had a few deserters already, and we'll need every available body if these attacks continue. It'll be difficult to convince the men to leave the safety of the tavern for the terrors of the unknown. Even without this Dwarven nonsense, the road ahead will only get more perilous given the copious bandits, wolves, and other dangers on the road. Captain Inodes has asked us to take a detour with the Dres caravan to Falkreath. Staying off the main road might provide us some cover.
traduit: 我们和萨德拉斯碰头，取走了货物。至少他们的队长看起来精神多了，但其他人都很疲惫。更糟糕的是，接到的全是那些没能成功的商队消息，他们在前往白漫城的路上被矮人机械包围了。 我担心这种恐惧会影响到我底下人的思想。尤其是当他们的故事细节似乎得到了证实，更是火上浇油了。 希望其他队长有好的计划。我们手下已经出现逃兵了，如果袭击持续，我们需要所有可用的人手。但很难说服他们离开安全的旅店去面对未知的恐怖。 即便没有关于矮人的胡言乱语，前面的道路也会更加危险，因为路上有大量的强盗、狼群和其他危险。伊内多斯队长让我们和德莱斯的商队绕道去佛克瑞斯。远离主干道也许能为我们提供一些掩护。

original: Lost Caravan Guard's Note
traduit: 遗失的车队护卫纸条

original: We crossed into Skyrim under the cover of ashfall. As far as anyone knows, we're shipping refugees, just one in a long line of vagrant caravans escaping the wrath of the Red Mountain. Normally, a story like that would be enough to get us through, but not this time. Now I've been a caravan guard for some time, and I've seen some pretty extensive security measures. Locks, chains, the works. One client even had a conjurer summon a daedra to guard his wagon, but even compared to that this seems excessive. For one, everything has a code name. The cargo, the guards, even the horse. As for the caravans, to keep it familiar we've each been given a name from one of the Great Houses. Of course, some of the guards didn't like that part. One of the new bloods said he'd rather bend the knee to a guar than wear the name of House Dres. But Captain Inedos brought him in line with the point of his blade, and the rest followed. You'd think the Red Year would unite us, but it seems like there's old scars that haven't healed and old scores that haven't been settled. But at the end of the day, none of that matters. The job's the job. Like the Captain said, at least they didn't name us after the boots. We've also got several decoy caravans heading out through Skyrim, all the way to some undisclosed location in Hammerfell. But since that's not enough, each caravan will meet up at preset checkpoints and swap their items out. That means different decoys traveling different paths every step of the way. With the refugee garb they say we should blend right in, and on the off chance we don't, we've got runners set to flee to the next village, hidden compartments, anything you can think of. Still, if you ask me, all of it sounds like a waste of time. I'm no scholar, but those two bits of cargo don't look like anything special, just a fancy way to bash some poor f'lah's skull in. With all the chaos bleeding out of Vvardenfell, we've made it to Windhelm without so much as a papercut. Come morning we're heading out west along the river toward Nightgate Inn. If all goes well we'll reach the mountain pass by midday. Still, we'd get there sooner if not for all the stops.
traduit: 我们在灰烬的掩护下进入天际。其他人都以为，我们是在运输难民，只是逃离红山怒火的流浪商队大军的一员。一般来说，这样的故事足以让我们撑过去，但这次不行了。 我做了一段时间的车队护卫，见过不少安全措施。锁头、铁链、机关。有批客人中甚至有个召唤师叫出一个迪德拉来保护自己的马车，但即使与此相比，这次的也似乎过分了。 首先，所有的东西都有代号。货物、护卫乃至马匹。至于商队，为了朗朗上口，每个都用一个大家族的名字做代号。 当然，有的护卫不喜欢这样。有个新人说，他宁可向瓜尔下跪，也不愿用德莱斯家族的名号。但伊内多斯队长一刀把他带走了，其他人也就没意见了。你以为红色之年会让我们团结起来？但似乎还有好些旧伤未愈，旧怨未解。但这不重要了。工作就是工作，至少和队长说的，没用臭靴子烂鞋取名就不错了。 我们有几支诱饵商队正在穿行天际，一路前往落锤的某个秘密地点。但由于这还不够，每个商队都会在预设的检查点相遇并交换物品。 这就意味着不同诱饵每走一步都走不同的路线。他们说我们应该融入当地，所以穿着难民的衣服，万一没能融入，就要跑到下一个村庄，找到隐秘的隔间，找到想到的任何东西。 不过，如果要我说，我只觉得是浪费时间。我不是个学者，但这两件货看起来没什么特别的，顶多是用来敲开某个可怜的费’拉什的头骨的花哨办法。 瓦登费尔一片混乱，我们却毫发无损地到达风舵城。第二天早上，我们沿河向西，前往夜扉旅店。如果一切顺利，我们将在中午抵达山口。不过，如果不是停了那么多站，我们早就到了。

original: Seedy Guard's Note
traduit: 破烂的护卫纸条

original: Telvanni handed the cargo off to us at the checkpoint. They seemed a bit on edge but they aren't sharing details exactly, just that they were attacked by Dwarven machines. Bunch of useless fetchers, all of them. We also had a surprise visit from the Hlaalu caravan. The whole crew was an odd bunch. More scholars and farmers than warriors I'd say, but a few were just my type. I tried to chat it up with a fetching raven-haired girl, but she kept those sultry red eyes fixed on the cargo as it changed hands. In any case, the main package is secured, but there's fear it was damaged during transport. Oddly the Hlaalu captain didn't seem too concerned about it. He and the boss talked for a bit by themselves. I tried my luck with the raven-haired tart once more, and she told me her name was Velyne. She asked whether Captain Inodes would be at the next checkpoint. I told her no, but the truth is I didn't even know. I don't know why she cared anyway, their cargo is a decoy. The real package is going to Indoril at the next stop. Once that's delivered, I'm hearing we might stop for a day or two in Whiterun to get our bearings. The captain of the Indoril caravan is a Nord, and he mentioned heading over to the Hall of the Dead to pay his respects. That's fine, I'll be paying mine at the tavern. Hopefully I'll get a chance to buy sweet little Velyne a drink.
traduit: 泰瓦尼在检查点把货物交给了我们。他们看起来有点紧张，但没有透露具体细节，只是说自己受到了矮人机械的攻击。一群没用的费彻。 哈拉鲁车队突然造访我们。全员都是些奇怪的人。学者和农民比战士多，但有几个是我喜欢的类型。我试着和一个迷人的黑发女孩搭讪，但她在货物易手时，那双性感的红眼睛一直盯着货物看。 无论如何，主要包裹是安全的，但也怕在运输途中有什么损坏。奇怪的是，哈拉鲁的队长并不太在意这件事。他和老板单独谈了谈。我又试着撩了那个乌发小骚货，她告诉我她叫威莱尼。她问我伊内多斯队长会不会在下个检查点。我没告诉他，但其实是我也不知道。我不知道她为什么会这么在意，反正他们的货就是个诱饵。 真正的包裹会在下一站送到因多瑞尔手里。一旦交付，我们可能能在白漫城停留一两天，以便了解情况。因多瑞尔的队长是个诺德人，他提出要去亡者之厅致敬。没关系，我会在酒馆待着，希望我有机会请可爱的小威莱尼喝一杯。

original: Velyne's Letter
traduit: 威莱尼的信

original: Inedos, The reports are right. Wraithguard and Sunder are singing, sending a signal out to anyone that might be listening. I don't know how, but I think I know why. The Tools were only meant to be used on Numidium, it makes sense that they would never be allowed to leave Morrowind. To ensure this, Kagrenac must have put in a failsafe system. If the Tools were ever stolen, drones would be activated across Tamriel to recover them. The drones would then store the items in a vault until a Tonal Architect could fetch them. Unfortunately, as I suspected, that information was enough for some of the captains to betray us and change course. They no longer care about the artifacts or the job. They consider the cargo to be a death trap, and are taking measures to unload it. Your caravan might think they were carrying the Tools, but Sadras and Hlaalu swapped them before we ever got to Whiterun, and intentionally gave them up to the retrieval drones. Fortunately, I managed to track the drones back to a vault near Winterhold; what the locals call the Sightless Pit. I've also discovered the vault can be opened with an attunement crystal, which I've sent along with this letter. As I am no warrior, I dare not venture inside without you. Hopefully this message reaches your party in time, for I know we are of like mind. As a scholar, I want to see the artifacts delivered to my master, and you have always been someone who does not shirk his duty. I have faith that you and your crew can return north and repair this mistake. Velyne
traduit: 伊内多斯： 报告无误。幽魂之护与裂解正在鸣叫，向任何可能听到的人发出信号。我不知道原因，但我或许能猜到。这些工具只能在努米迪安上使用，所以永远不得离开晨风是有道理的。 为了确保这一点，卡格瑞纳克一定安装了保障系统。一旦工具被盗，机械将在泰姆瑞尔全境激活前来找回它们。然后机械会将这些物品存储在密室中，直到音调工程师来取走它们。 不幸的是，如我所料，这个消息足以让一些队长背叛我们改变路线。他们不再关心货物或者工作。他们认为这批货太过危险，正打算卸货。 你的商队可能以为他们携带的是工具，但萨德拉斯和哈拉鲁在我们抵达白漫城前交换了工具，并把它们故意交给回收机械。所幸我成功追踪到机械回到了冬堡附近的一个密室，当地人称之为“盲坑”。我还发现了密室可以用调音水晶打开，我把它和这封信一同寄给你了。我不是战士，没你陪同我不敢贸然进去。 希望这条消息能及时送达你处。你我志趣相投。身为学者，我希望看到这些文物能送到我导师那里，而你一直都是个有担当的人。我相信你和你的车队成员能够北归，弥补这个错误。 威莱尼

original: Carriage Driver's Note
traduit: 车队车夫的纸条

original: It happened sometime after we crossed deeper into the mountains, but I swear I could hear singing. Tuneless, very quiet, but singing nonetheless. No one else believes me, but I'd bet my bottom drake that it had something to do with the Dwarven machines attacking us last night. I've never heard of these things leaving their ruins, let alone roaming the countryside going after travelers. It's almost as if they were drawn to the music. Tonight we're handing the cargo off to the Sadras caravan, and I say good riddance. But the captain says we're going to eventually circle back to Whiterun, which means we could see the cargo again. If that happens, I'm getting off this caravan. I don't care about the gold. I haven't slept for days and I feel like I'm losing my mind. Even now, I can hear that awful singing in my head. I just want it to stop.
traduit: 事情发生在我们穿过深山之后，但我发誓我绝对听到了歌声。没有音调，也很安静，但就是在唱。没人相信我，但我敢赌，这和昨晚矮人机械攻击有关。我从来没听说过这些东西会离开遗迹，更不用说在乡间游荡跟踪旅行者了。就好像他们是被音乐吸引了一样。 今晚我们要把货物交给萨德拉斯商队，总算是解脱了。但队长说我们最终要绕回白漫城，也就是说我们又能看到货物了。 真是那样的话，我就离开这个商队吧。我不在乎钱了。我已经好几天没睡，快要疯了。 直到现在，我还能听到那可怕的歌声在脑海里回响。赶快停下吧。

original:
<font face="$HandwrittenFont" size="17">
During my excavations, I came across a quite peculiar little fellow - a Mudcrab, clad in plated Dwarven armor.  He's quite friendly, but with all of my studies I have no time to take care of such a thing.

From what I have seen, you seem to be quite trustworthy.  Would you be interested in purchasing him?  If so, please meet with me in my laboratory in Understone Keep.

-Calcelmo
</font>
traduit:
<font face="$HandwrittenFont" size="17">
在我的发掘过程中，我遇到了个非常奇怪的小家伙，是个泥沼蟹，却穿着矮人装甲。他倒是很友好，不过我还要研究，没时间照顾这家伙。

我看你还算值得信赖。有兴趣买下吗？想买的话，就到石下要塞的实验室来找我吧。

——卡塞莫
</font>

original:
<font face='$HandwrittenFont'>This deed signifies ownership of the Dwarven Mudcrab to the undersigned.  Ownership may only be transferred with an accompanying Bill of Sale.

P.S. He will follow you anywhere you go, but he's cautious of aggressive strangers.  He's smart and fast, so you can dismiss him to stay at any of your owned homes, just inside a city, or right where he stands, if you think it makes him a good home.

From time to time he may also dig up something useful or valuable!  Lastly, I've included a Spell Tome so you can summon him to your location at any time.

I hope you enjoy him.  Back to work for me.

</font>

<font face='$HandwrittenFont'>此契约由矮人泥沼蟹所有者持有。所有权仅在附有销售单据的情况下才可转让。

希望你会喜欢他。我得赶紧回去工作了。

original: 1st of Evenings Star, 4E 130 We have secured a location that will serve us well; an old partially abandoned smugglers' hideout in Riften. One of the council members, Sychelle Gatharian, had done prior business with the inhabitants, and pointed us in their direction. It was a prudent choice, as these small band of unsavory entrepreneurs seem more than happy to assist us with our venture, for they have a love of gold above all else. With this much aid, building our trap should be accomplished reasonably quickly. Once this is done we will bring her remains to us and draw our spider out! [pagebreak] 18th of Morning Star, 4E 131 It is done. Now all we can do is wait. When he arrives we will incapacitate him with our magic and separate him from his blade. We will then channel his life force and mana into our constructed device, which will use his own energy to shield the weapon from him. In essence he will become bound to it, for whilst he lives, the shield will hold. [pagebreak] Hopefully this plan will work and we can avoid bloodshed, for given what we now know of him, we do not wish his death. Perhaps, there is even hope that, without his blade, we can rehabilitate him, for despite his crimes, I do pity the poor soul.
traduit: 4E130年，夜星月1日 我们已经找到了对我们有利的阵地：裂谷城一个部分废弃的走私者藏身处。议会的成员瑟切尔·加塔里安，以前曾和里面的住民做过生意，还给我们指明了方向。 这是个谨慎的选择，因为这群讨厌的走私犯似乎很乐意帮忙，他们对黄金的热爱胜过一切。有了这么多助力，我们的陷阱应该可以很快就能完成。等这边一完工，我们就用她的遗体引蛇出洞！ [pagebreak] 4E131年，晨星月18日 完成了。现在等待就好。 等他来了，我们就用魔法让他失去行动能力，再夺走他的剑。然后把他的生命力量和魔能导入我们建造的装置里，这样就能用他自己的能量把他和武器隔绝开。从本质上说，他是被束缚住了，只要他活着，护盾就会奏效。 [pagebreak] 希望计划能够成功，能避免流血杀戮，因为根据我们对他的了解，也不希望他会死。 也许，当他没有了剑，我们能使他改过自新，即便他犯了罪，我还是同情这个可怜人。

original: 14th of Last Seed, 4E 130 Our guild has been commissioned to capture and restrain a renegade Blades captain. Many tall tales have been spoken of his cruelty and malice, some even claiming he is part serpent. In addition to bearing the arms of his former employers, it is said that he wields an Akaviri weapon of dark magic. The combination makes him quite formidable. Thankfully, the guild has great experience in dealing with such things and we will win the day! [pagebreak] 6th of Hearthfire, 4E 130 We encountered our foe but all did not go as planned and he escaped us. He was more powerful than we had imagined and many lives were lost as a result of our misjudgment. However, I am now convinced that his dreaded blade is the source of his power, as I have witnessed first hand the dark magic it yields, for the blade drinks both lifeforce and mana from any that befall it. We must think of a way to separate our foe from the source of his power. [pagebreak] 2nd of Suns Dusk, 4E 130 We have devised a means to separate our foe from his blade and we must now set a trap and lure him to us. I am certain that it will work, but to be sure I must think of an incentive to draw him to us. I think it would be prudent to research this former Captain in more depth. [pagebreak] 13th of Suns Dusk, 4E 130 Upon reading what I have regarding our Captain, my heart almost feels pity for him. It would seem that his madness and malice stem from the loss of his wife. The records reveal that it was after this tragic event that the darkness of the soul overcame him. However, pity will not save lives. He must be stopped in all event! Therefore, I have decided to acquire the remains of his loved one, in the hope that this will draw him to us.
traduit: 4E130年，末种月14日 我们公会被委托去抓捕一名变节的刀锋会队长。他的残忍恶毒传说甚多，甚至有人说他有蛇的血统。除了前组织的装备外，他还挥舞着可怕的阿卡维尔黑魔法武器。这种组合使得他相当可怕。 所幸公会在处理这类事情上经验丰富，我们会赢的！ [pagebreak] 4E130年，炉火月6日 我们和敌人遭遇了，但一切都超出了计划之外，他逃走了。他比我们想象的还要强大，许多人因我们的误判而丧命。 然而，我现在确信，他那把可怕的剑就是力量的源泉，我亲眼看见它产生的黑暗魔法，任何被剑碰到的人都会被吸走生命和魔力。 我们必须想办法把敌人和他的力量之源分开。 [pagebreak] 4E130年，日暮月2日 我们已经想出办法把敌人和剑分开了。现在我们需要布下陷阱，把他引过来。这个办法肯定会奏效，不过为保险起见，必须想办法保证能引他上钩。 必须再好好调查一下这位前队长。 [pagebreak] 4E130年，日暮月13日 我读关于这位队长的情报时，心中不免怜悯。看来他疯狂与恶意的根源是丧妻之痛。记录显示，正是在这次悲剧之后，他的灵魂就被黑暗征服了。 然而，怜悯并不能拯救生命。无论如何都要阻止他！因此，我决定去取他爱人的遗体，希望能够把他引过来。

original:
<font face='$HandwrittenFont'>
I met Sychelle Gatharian on a Morndas, outside the docks in the rain. Should've taken it as a sign.

We'd done business before, she and I. Smuggling black soul gems, corpses, the kind of dark and dishonest things that would make grown men sleep in pairs. But this was different. This was big.

The sword she gave me was like nothing I'd ever seen. Teeth like a slaughterfish and a blood red gem in the center. I said it must've been one of a kind. That's when she smiled and told me there was another. 

My job was to swap them.

We sealed the venture with a coin, of which more was promised later. The mage told me I'd be contacted in a week. A group of her associates would pay us to use the hideout to kill some captain, after which, I'd make the switch. 

She told me to keep this a secret from the mages, which made me pause, but the details didn't matter much to me. All I wanted to know was the number on the ledger. It was enough.

Months later and the deal has turned rotten. The mages underestimated their own magic, and we our greed. Now we're all paying the price for our stupidity. 

Some tried to fight their way out, but the bastard won't die. I'm beginning to think he can't. On top of that, every man that he's felled has risen to fight beside him, making him that much harder to kill.

I guess I have no one to blame but myself. I should've trusted my gut from the start. Mage jobs always have a bad stink on them, but this one smelled especially foul. But I wanted that gold so bad I convinced myself and the men it was moon sugar. 

The funny thing is, I don't even have Bloodthirst anymore. I lost it at the pits at Faldar's Tooth, thinking I could just kill the mages and Gatharian once I got my hands on the other one. But when the spell went bad, the guild sealed the captain in these chambers, and us along with him.

Now all I have left is a festering wound, an empty stomach, and the mage's coin to show for it.

Chances are, this coin is probably the only thing that will ever make it out of here. But oh, could it tell you a story. 

Because this coin has bought a lot of lives.

It's sold a lot of dreams, and spilled a lot of blood.

I know now the coin is cursed. Yet for some reason, I can't let it go.</font>
traduit:
<font face='$HandwrittenFont'>
周一，我在码头外面的雨中遇到了瑟切尔·加塔里安。这应该就是征兆吧。

我们以前有过生意往来，走私黑色灵魂石、尸体之类黑暗不洁的可怕东西。但这次不一样。是个大活儿。

我从未见过这样的剑。像是食人鱼的牙齿，中间有颗血红色的宝石。我说这东西简直独一无二。但她却笑着告诉我，还有另外一把。

我的工作就是交换它们。

我们以一枚金币的定价结束了冒险，后来又答应给我更多的钱。法师告诉我，一周之后再联系我。她的同伴们会付钱给我们利用藏身处去杀某个队长，然后由我去交换。

她让我对法师们保守秘密，这让我迟疑了一下，但细节对我来说无关紧要。我能记住账本上的数字就够了。

几个月后，这笔交易就变质了。法师们低估了自己的魔法，我们也小看了自己的贪婪。现在我们都为自己的愚蠢付出了代价。

有些人想杀出去，可那混蛋压根死不了。我开始还觉得他没什么。但更重要的是，每一个被他打倒的人，都会站起来替他作战，使得他变得更难杀了。

只能怪自己了。一开始就该坚信我自己的直觉。法师的工作总有一股子臭味，这次尤其难闻，但我太想要钱了，只能说服自己和我的人那是月亮糖。

有意思的是，我把嗜血弄丢了。我把它放在法尔达之牙的坑里，想着等我拿到另一把剑，就杀死法师和加塔里安。但当法术失效的时候，公会把我们连同那个队长一起封印在这个房间里。

现在只剩下一个溃烂的伤口，饥肠辘辘的肚子，和那枚法师的金币。

很有可能，这枚金币是唯一能从这里逃出去的东西。但，它能把曾经发生的故事告诉你吗？

就是这金币，害了多少人的命。

多少人卖了自己的梦想，抛头洒血。

这金币是被诅咒了。但不知怎的，我不想撒手。</font>

original: 7th of Morning Star, 4E 171 My son, I do not have long for this world, but before the winter night embraces me, I would confess a great regret that has burdened my heart for many years. Long ago, my brethren and I were commissioned to hunt down and ensnare a dark and powerful renegade captain. A man who, once a proud soldier, had become corrupted by a powerful artifact, and turned to great darkness of deed. We fulfilled our commission, but not without great cost, for I alone managed to survive the encounter. But, in the many years that have followed this venture, I have often wondered if our deed in ensnaring him was equally evil. For with our combined enchantments, we have bound him to an eternity of misery, for we bound him to the guardianship of the very thing that drove him insane, the artifact. A powerful weapon that now, despite his yearning for it, he cannot yield while he lives. It is a cruel fate for a once great man, for he was just that until grief and anger laid him bare to such utter corruption and malice. That story is a sad tale indeed. But now, these many years on, my heart sees the truth, and I would undo that which was done and free him from his misery. But alas, it is too late for me to take on such a quest. Therefore I pray that you, my son, will do this task in my stead. [pagebreak] I beg you as a father's last wish, seek him out and set him free. Your father, Sellonus
traduit: 4E171年，晨星月7日 儿子，我时日无多了，但在冬夜拥抱我前，我需要向你坦白多年来压在我心头的巨大遗憾。 很久以前，我和弟兄们奉命追捕一个黑暗而强大的叛变队长。他曾是个骄傲的士兵，却被一件强大的神器腐蚀，变得行迹黑暗。我们完成了任务，却付出了很大代价，因为只有我一个人在战斗中活了下来。 但在那次冒险之后的多年里，我时常在想，我们诱捕他的行为是否同样邪恶。我们联合使用附魔把他束缚在了让他发疯的神器之下，使他承受永恒的痛苦。那武器确实很强大，也难怪他会渴望，到死都不愿撒手。 对于曾经的强者来说，这样的命运太过残酷。在悲伤与愤怒使他暴露在如此彻底的堕落与恶意前，他就是个强者。真是个悲剧。 但这么多年过去，我看透了，我要撤回所做的一切，把他从痛苦中解放出来。但是，哎，我已经无力完成了。所以，我祈求你，儿子，替为父做完这件事。 [pagebreak] 作为父亲，我最后的愿望，就是把他找到，放出来。 你的父亲 瑟洛努斯

original: 22nd of Morning Star, 4E 131 What was done cannot be undone! We did what we set out to do and our commission was fulfilled, but at such a horrid cost for all of us. Together we endeavored to lay a trap here, with the aid of the inhabitant smugglers, and ensnare him. Knowing something of his past, we brought with us the remains of his dear departed wife, hoping that this alone would lure him into our grasp. Our plan worked, but something went horribly wrong! [pagebreak] Perhaps it was a mishap of our magic or the deeper magic of the weapon he wielded, I know not which with any certainty. All I know is that for some reason, our enchantment caused his being to divide, and we suddenly found ourselves caught in a battle with three where there had once been one! But with great effort we managed to separate and contain these divisions within the chambers of this vault. But this was a small victory, if any at all, for I have yet to determine the true cost of it. [pagebreak] I know not how many of my guild survived the deed, for I cannot break the seals to these doors without undoing all that we have achieved. All I can do is await their return and pray. There is at least some comfort in knowing that our foe can no longer wield his blade, for he and the magical shield are one. He is bound to it. He is now both its prisoner and its guardian! [pagebreak] 23rd of Morning Star, 4E 131 Alas, our casualties were too high. For although we have trapped him here in this vault, it is now clear to me that only I and one other may live to tell this tale. However, there is no time to grieve the loss of our guild, for we must seal this place shut and report to the council at once. They must be informed of what has happened here. My colleague is severely wounded, but hopefully he has strength yet to assist me, for we must not fail!
traduit: 4E131年，晨星月22日 覆水难收了！我们做了该做的事，使命完成了，但所有人都付出了可怕的代价。 我们在当地走私者的帮助下，一起在这里布下陷阱。我们对他的过去有所了解，于是带来了他爱妻的遗体，希望仅凭这一点就能把他引过来。我们的计划成功了，但是出了严重的问题! [pagebreak] 不知是我们的魔法出了问题，还是他使用的武器有更深层的魔力。我只知道，我们的附魔使他的生命分裂了。他突然一分为三，让我们陷入了苦战！ 我们花了很大力气才把他们分开，封印在宝库的各个房间里。但这充其量只是小胜，因为还不能确定付出了多少代价。 [pagebreak] 不知道公会成员活下来多少，也不能打开封印去确认，否则一切努力都付之东流了。我所能做的只能等待并祈祷他们回来。 知道我们的敌人不能再挥舞那把剑，也算是个安慰了，因为他已经和魔法护盾融为一体了。他被剑束缚住了。现在他既是囚徒也是守护者！ [pagebreak] 4E131年，晨星月23日 哎，伤亡太大了。虽然我们把他困在了宝库里。但我很清楚，只有我和另一个人能活着讲述这个故事。但没有时间为公会的损失感到悲伤，因为我们必须封印这里，并立刻向议会报告。他们必须知道这里发生的事情。 我的同事受了重伤，但希望他还有力气帮我，我们决不能失败！

original:
<font face='$SkyrimBooks'>I, Cassipia Sagnus, Vigilant of Stendarr, do hereby issue this report on my investigation into the reports of a "dark presence" within Champion's Rest.

Champion's Rest is the site of an ancient battle arena where Nords would test their mettle in gladiatorial combat. Long believed to be lost to time, it was recently uncovered by mining prospectors near Shor's Stone after discovering a new deposit of silver.

Upon discovery, the miners say they witnessed a "ghost, clad head to toe in armor". While this alone was cause for concern, what they said next was even more foreboding: the spirit wielded a massive blade which seemed to "whisper" to them in their minds. This hints at the workings of a powerful Daedric artifact.

The only relic that matches this description is Umbra, once believed to be lost or, by some accounts, destroyed. Umbra is a sentient weapon who corrupts its bearer and compels them to kill so that the blade may feast on the souls of those it slays. It appears to have resurfaced here, though why I cannot say.

If the apparition that haunts this site truly is the resurgence of Umbra, then it has grown very powerful, and Shor's Stone is in grave danger.</font>
traduit:
<font face='$SkyrimBooks'>我，斯丹达尔的警戒者，卡西皮亚·萨格努斯，特此发布关于我对冠军之息的调查报告。

冠军之息是一处古老的竞技场遗迹，诺德人曾在此进行角斗，考验勇气。长期以来，人们都认为它已消失在时间长河之中，但最近，舒尔之石附近的新银矿的勘探者又发现了它。

被发现后，矿工们都说看到了“一个全副武装的鬼魂”。虽然这一点本身就足以令人担忧，但他们接下来的话更加不祥：鬼魂挥舞着一把大剑，似乎在他们的脑海里低语。似乎暗示了一个强大迪德拉神器的原理。

唯一符合这一描述的神器就是“蚀影”。它一度被认为已经遗失，也有说法是已经被摧毁。蚀影是有意识的武器，会腐蚀它的持有者，强迫他们杀戮，借此享受灵魂盛宴。它似乎重现江湖了，但我不知道原因。

如果这里出没的鬼影真的是蚀影，那它已经变得非常强大了。舒尔之石现在非常危险。
</font>

Journal of Cresitus Treasure Hunter 4E 179

[pagebreak] 12th of Sun's Dusk I've never been much for writing in journals, but it couldn't hurt to start. How else will my exploits be remembered? I've yet to reach "personal bard" levels of fortune. By way of introduction, my name is Cresitus. I've traveled north from Cyrodiil to seek my fortune in Skyrim by delving forgotten depths and wooing women. While I haven't had much luck with the latter, I've heard tales of an ancient arena whose whereabouts have, up until now, remained a mystery. While the original name is lost to time, Champion's Rest is what it's known as today. I can see it now: halls upon halls, glittering with gold and jewels! Maps in the Imperial Library place Champion's Rest east of the village of Shor's Stone. I will set out for the eastern mountains at dawn. [pagebreak] 13th of Sun's Dusk Short entry today. Day's hike, little to show for it. Why does Skyrim have so much snow? Maybe the treasure hunter's life isn't all it's cut out to be. But if it were easy, everyone would do it, right? I'll press further into the mountain pass tomorrow. [pagebreak] 16th of Sun's Dusk By some small miracle, I'm alive. Deep in the mountains, snow gave way underfoot. Next thing I knew, I'm plummeting into a cavern at a devilish height. What a foolish place Skyrim is. Both legs are surely broken, and my agony is only second to my despair. I'm going to die in here. It's been three days since the fall. Food ran out yesterday. Water will be the next to go, unless some rain happens to fall through the cursed hole above. [pagebreak] --- I've been slipping in and out of dreams. I dreamt that I was floating in a sea of black. Before me floated a sword unlike anything I had ever seen. A real treasure, just like in the stories. It... called to me. Knew my name. I reached out my hand, then... I'm awake now. It turns out, the sword was real; I have it right here next to where I write this entry. My legs are beginning to feel better. That can't be right. [pagebreak] --- When I sleep, I hear the sword. It whispers to me. Not with words, but with intent. It has a hunger, I can feel it. Of course, it seems silly that a weapon wouldn't hunger for lives, when you think about it. Is that not their purpose, to free the soul from the living? Maybe none of this is real. [pagebreak] --- I can walk again. I've set up a small camp here. I think it's the sword, it's helping me. It thirsts for souls, and it needs ME to find them. All I could think about was getting out of this place, but now, amongst the restless souls of so many fallen warriors... Yes. Yes, I think I'll stay. [pagebreak] --- It whispered to me its name. It is... we are... Umbra.

[pagebreak]

宝藏猎人 克雷希图斯的日记 4E179年

[pagebreak] 日暮月12日 我一向不喜欢写日记，但现在开始也无妨。不然我的功绩如何让人铭记？我还没有实现财富自由呢。 自我介绍一下，我叫克雷希图斯。从希罗帝尔北上来到天际，依靠探索被遗忘的深处和渴望爱的女人来寻找我的财富。虽然我对后者没什么把握，不过我听说过一个古老竞技场的故事，直到现在，依然下落成谜。虽然最早的名字已经随时间流逝消失，但还有个“冠军之息”的名字流传至今。 我现在能看到：一座座大厅，堆满了金银珠宝！ 按照在帝国图书馆找到的地图，冠军之息位于舒尔之石村子以东。明天就出发前往东部山区。 [pagebreak] 日暮月13日 无事发生。徒步一整天，什么收获都没有。为什么天际的雪这么多？也许宝藏猎人的生活也不是那么理想化，但如果真那么容易，岂不是人人都去干了？明天我会继续向山口前进。 [pagebreak] 日暮月16日 由于某种小小奇迹，我还活着。 深山中，积雪在脚下消融。接下来，我只记得，我掉进了一个非常深的洞穴里。天际真是个蠢地方。 两条腿肯定都断了，但痛苦赶不上绝望。我要死在这里了。 摔下来已经三天了。食物昨天就吃光了。下一个没的就是水，除非有雨水碰巧从上面那个该死的洞落下来。 [pagebreak] --- 我已经在梦里进进出出。我梦见自己飘浮在一片漆黑的海洋里。面前悬浮着一把从未见过的剑。一个真正的宝藏，就像故事里那样。它……呼唤了我。它知道我的名字。我伸出手，然后…… 我现在醒了。事实证明，剑是真的，它就在我的旁边。 腿感觉好些了。难以置信。 [pagebreak] --- 当我睡觉时，我又听到剑的声音。它又再我耳边低语，不是用语言，而是行动。它有一种渴望，我能感觉到。当然，仔细想想，武器怎么会渴望生命，太蠢了。它们的目的不是把灵魂从活人身上解放出来吗？ 也许这一切都不是真的。 [pagebreak] --- 我又能走路了。我在这里搭了个小营地。我觉得是剑帮了我。它渴望灵魂，需要我去找。 我满脑子都只想离开这个地方，但现在，这里有那么多阵亡战士的不安灵魂……没错。没错。我应该留下来。 [pagebreak] --- 它低语着告诉我它的名字。它是……我们是……蚀影。

original: I've heard rumors that a Nordic ruin, Champion's Rest, was recently uncovered in a silver mine near Shor's Stone. The miners reportedly fled, leaving their belongings behind. I should investigate the miner's campsite to see if I can learn anything about what caused them to flee.

original: The miners witnessed an armor-clad ghost wielding a menacing blade that struck fear into them, causing them to flee. A Vigilant of Stendarr investigated, and suspects that this blade may be Umbra, a Daedric artifact with the power to steal souls and bend its bearer to its will. original:
<font face="$HandwrittenFont" size="19">
Dear person who happened upon this letter, it is your lucky day!  Nearby you will find the Fork of Horripilation.  Oh, how I do love cutlery!  "But what is it?" you must be asking.  Well, horripilation is the standing of hairs on end due to cold, fear, or excitement -- and excitement is indeed upon us, my friend!

Take this fork, and use it to kill two special Bull Netches in single combat.  Each will yield an artifact: The Eye of Ciirta, and the Branch of the Tree of Shades.  Warriors of another age might find these familiar.  Combine these together with some Heart Stones at a Staff Enchanter for a special surprise!

If you're successful, you'll be rewarded quite handsomely, with the Staff of Sheogorath (handsome, indeed!)  If not, well... I do love to watch a good fight!

Yours Truly,
Lord Sheogorath
</font>
traduit:
<font face="$HandwrittenFont" size="19">
看到这封信的亲，今儿你走大运了！附近有毛骨悚然餐叉。哦，我太喜欢餐具了！“但那是什么?”你肯定要这么问吧。好好，毛骨悚然是指由于寒冷、恐惧或兴奋而汗毛竖起啊，我们谁都会兴奋的，朋友！

拿上叉子，去一次性杀两只特殊的雄性气母。他们会掉落希尔塔之眼和阴影之树的枝杈。另外一代的勇士们可能对它们很熟悉。把它们和一些心石结合起来，在法杖附魔台收获一份意外之喜吧！

如果你成功了，那奖励很丰厚，谢尔格拉之杖（漂亮得很呐！）。如果没，嗯……我喜欢看精彩的比赛！

敬启，
谢尔格拉老爷
</font>

original:
<font face="$HandwrittenFont">
I've always despised my husband's charity, but at least it was just coin. Then he let that stranger into our home for dinner.

He was an odd sort, prone to forgetfulness and a wandering eye. I wasn't sure if he was staring at my bosom or the amulet around my neck, but stare he did. It wasn't entirely unwelcome, but I wasn't about to flirt in front of my husband.

Besides, it turns out he wasn't staring at me at all. He actually wanted to know about the creepy doll behind me, and asked if I was expecting. 

I told him I wasn't, and the doll was for one of Bolli's charity cases. Erikur in Solitude asked us to take in a child for reasons that are beyond me. I told Bolli I wanted nothing to do with the urchin, but my husband is stubborn when it comes to his bleeding heart. 

Luckily, a few days after the dinner, the boy just disappeared, and I know better than to care.</font>
traduit:
<font face="$HandwrittenFont">
我一向鄙视丈夫的布施行为，但好歹也只是花点钱。直到他带着那个陌生人进家吃饭。

那人太古怪，容易健忘，目光游离。不确定他是不是在盯着我的胸还是脖子上的护身符，但他确实盯着我看了。倒不是反感，只是我不想在丈夫面前调情。

再说，他根本不是盯着我看。他看的是我身后那个吓人的娃娃，还问我是否怀孕了。

我告诉他没有，那娃娃不过是为波利的一个慈善项目准备的。独孤城的艾瑞库尔想让我们收养一个孩子，但我不知道原因。我跟波利说过，我不想和那个臭小子有任何关系，但我丈夫慈悲心上来了就固执得很。

所幸，晚饭后没几天，那孩子就失踪了，可我无所谓。</font>

Now you'll need to put those skills to the test and more. In Silverdrift Lair is a tomb that houses an ancient Nord clan. Near a large chest is a corpse with a lantern, its candle still burning. It holds a key. 

When you have the key, open the chest and you'll find a sword that can raise the dead. 

When you find it, bring it to the grave of the Gray Fox in Riften. It's a small, unmarked headstone on the east side of the cemetery. Complete the task, and maybe you'll even get to meet him.

-- A Stranger
traduit:
<font face="$HandwrittenFont">
干得漂亮。出于某种原因，你发现偷取是不可能的，所以另辟蹊径了。

现在你还需要把这些技能付诸实践。在银流巢穴有座诺德氏族的古墓。在一个大箱子旁边有一具尸体，旁边有一盏蜡烛还在燃烧的灯笼。尸体身上有钥匙。

等你拿到钥匙，打开箱子，你会发现一把能让尸体复生的剑。

拿到剑以后，带到裂谷城的灰狐墓前。就是墓园东侧一块没有标记的小墓碑。任务完成，也许你就能见到他了。

——陌生人

original: Letter to Gisli
traduit: 给吉斯莉的信

original:
<font face="$HandwrittenFont">
Construction on the port east of Jehanna has been approved and will begin once the transfer of land is official. The boy's consent should suffice, as the head of the Ice-Blade clan has long been absent and the mother has taken ill, per your brother's instruction.

The deed is enclosed with this letter. Sending the boy to Riften before he's old enough to grasp what happened is a good idea. Not the orphanage though. It's best he live in comfort lest he suspect our motives.

Still, it's a dangerous gambit, made more complicated should the rightful heir return. Your brother would kill me for saying this, but if you have the chance, it may be worth selling the venture for the right price. This has been more trouble than it's worth.

-- M
traduit:
<font face="$HandwrittenFont">
杰汉纳东部港口的建设已经获批了，等土地转让正式完成，就能动工了。只要那个男孩同意就行，据你兄长的情报，冰刃氏族族长长期空缺，他母亲又得了病。

契约已随信附寄。在那孩子还没明白发生了什么之前就把他送去裂谷城吧。不过不是去孤儿院。让他吃好的住好的，免得怀疑咱们的动机。

不过，还是有风险，一旦合法的继承人回归，情况就会变得更加复杂。说句剜口割舌的，其实，找个机会卖个好价钱也不错。不然就太麻烦了，不值当。

——M

original: Stranger's Instructions
traduit: 陌生人的指示

original:
<font face="$HandwrittenFont">
You've made it this far, which proves you're ready for the real work.

But first, let's go over why you're here. You may have heard the Gray Fox is dead. It's true. But the Fox lives on in the one who wears the cowl. This job will tell me if that person is you.

Who am I? That's not important. Just a stranger who wants to see the cowl passed on to someone who deserves it.

As you might expect, the job won't be easy. It requires fast thinking and fast fingers. But get it done, and you'll be worthy of being the next Gray Fox.

Take the forged deed in the strongbox, then find a woman named Gisli in Solitude. On her should be the real document. You'll relieve her of this burden, then place the fake in Erikur's House. She'll think she misplaced it.

When the job is done, find the barrel behind the Winking Skeever for further instructions.

-- A Stranger
traduit:
<font face="$HandwrittenFont">
既然你走到这一步了，就说明你准备好开始真正的工作了。

但首先，我们先来看看你为什么来这里。你可能已经听说灰狐死了。这是真的。但灰狐还会在戴面具的人身上复活。这份工作将测试你是否有这个资格。

我是谁？不重要。我只是个无名之辈，想把面具传给配得上它的人。

正如你所料，这项任务不容易。需要敏捷的思维和手指。但只要完成它，你就是当之无愧的下任灰狐。

拿上保险箱里的伪造契约，然后去独孤城找个叫吉斯莉的女人。她身上有正牌的文件。你可以帮她解除这个负担，然后再把假文件放到艾瑞库尔的家里。到时候她只会以为自己放错地方了。

任务完成之后，去找眨眼恶鼠后面的木桶，里面有下一步指示。

——陌生人

original: Thief's Note
traduit: 盗贼的纸条

original:
<font face="$HandwrittenFont" size="17">
The Fox told me he wore the cowl to forget himself, and start a new life.

Yet I'm the one who can't remember. Every time we meet, he's a stranger to me. Or was it a she? 

It doesn't matter. I spoke his words to a beggar, told her "Shadow hide you." She slipped me a note that confirms my suspicions. The Gray Fox is dead. And now that I've seen his headstone, I know for a fact his time is over, and the cowl will be passed on.

I'm gonna be the next one to wear it. And when I do, I'll become so rich I won't need any memories. I'll just buy new ones.
traduit:
<font face="$HandwrittenFont" size="17">
灰狐告诉我，戴上面具是为了忘记自己，开始新的生活。

但我却成了忘记他的那个。每次见面，他都是个陌生人。或者是她？

无所谓。我把他的话告诉了乞丐，跟她说“愿暗影把你隐藏起来” 。她塞给我一张纸条，证实了我的怀疑。灰狐的确死了。我看到了他的墓碑，他的时代结束了，而面具会一直传承下去。

我将是下一个。到时候，我会变得富可敌国，不需要任何回忆。到时候钱可以买来新的。

original: The Sword of Clan Ice-Blade
traduit: 冰刃氏族之剑

original:
<font face="$HandwrittenFont">
To my descendants,

The ancestral sword of Clan Ice-Blade has an enchantment that dulls the blade for anyone save those descended from our bloodline. 

It serves as definitive proof of one's ancestry above all other claims.

Sygrold Ice-Blade
traduit:
<font face="$HandwrittenFont">
致我子孙后人：

冰刃氏族祖传之剑，上有附魔一道，非我血脉用之，其剑骤钝。

此即祖先血脉之明证。

西格罗尔德·冰刃

original: Stranger's Journal
traduit: 陌生人的日记

original:
<font face="$HandwrittenFont">
The curse of the Gray Cowl is said to strip you of your identity, wiping you from all of recorded history. 

But the curse was broken long ago. The truth is, it wasn't Nocturnal that robbed me of my life. It was my selfishness.

I wore the cowl out of pure greed. I left my family because I loved only myself.

Then my sister passed, leaving her son an orphan. The last of the Ice-Blades, heir to a fortune, and easy prey for the wolves.

With the boy in danger, it's time I took responsibility as the head of this clan. But if I'm to be his father, I have to stop being a stranger. I must pass the cowl onto another, and in doing so, the Gray Fox must die. 

Until then, I come to this grave every night bringing flowers, to ask my sister for forgiveness.</font>
traduit:
<font face="$HandwrittenFont">
灰面具的诅咒会夺去你的身份，抹去你在历史上的所有记录。

但诅咒早就被打破了。事实上，夺走我人生的不是诺克图娜尔，而是我的自私。

我戴上面具纯粹是因为贪婪。我离开了家庭，只因我只爱自己。

后来我姐姐去世了，留下一个儿子。那孤儿成了冰刃氏族的最后一人，所有遗产的继承者，和群狼的猎物。

孩子有危险，我应该承担起族长的责任。但如果我想成为他的父亲，就不能再扮演一个陌生人了。我必须把面具传给另一个人，这样一来，灰狐就必须死。

在那之前，我每晚都会带着花来到这座墓前，乞求我姐姐的原谅。</font>

original: Letter to General Tullius
traduit: 给图留斯将军的信

original:
<font face="$HandwrittenFont" size="16">
15th of Last Seed, 4E 201

General Tullius,

During these times of war, I strongly believe it is important to inspire our population through a show of military strength and pageantry.  To the younger among us, nothing is as inspiring as the sight of an Imperial Soldier wearing the finest armors our Empire has ever set its hands to.

It is for this reason I am formally requesting that several Imperial relics be placed back into the service of the Empire, and distributed among high ranking officials. We must do all we can to inspire awe, and help galvanize the image of our cause among the populace.

It has come to my attention that a paticular artifact, the Armor of Morihaus, Gift of Kynareth, also known as The Lord's Mail, has recently gone missing.  It is believed a group of Redguard mercenaries have stolen it with the aim to sell to the highest bidder.  They were last seen traveling south of Fort Greymoor.

Find these mercenaries, and reclaim The Lord's Mail.  Wear it proudly.  Show the people that Kynareth favors the realm of the Empire.

Emperor Titus Mede II
</font>
traduit:
<font face="$HandwrittenFont" size="16">
4E201年，末种月，15日

图留斯将军：

我坚信，在战争之中，展示军事实力与壮观场面对于鼓舞人民来说十分重要。没有什么比让我们的年轻人看到帝国军人身着帝国有史以来最好的盔甲更能鼓舞他们了。

由此，我正式要求将几件帝国文物遗产归还帝国，并分发高级官员。我们必须尽我们所能激发人民的敬畏之心，并在民众心目中树立起我们事业的形象。

我注意到一件特殊的神器最近刚刚失踪，就是莫里豪斯的盔甲，凯娜瑞丝的赠礼，也被称作“君王铠甲”。据说是被一群红卫雇佣兵偷走，并打算卖给出价最高者。他们最后出没于灰色荒原堡南部。

找到这群雇佣兵，夺回君王铠甲。自豪地穿上吧。让人民知道凯娜瑞丝是护佑帝国的。

皇帝提图斯·迈德二世
</font>

original: Majid - Please Read
traduit: 马吉德阅

original:
<font face="$HandwrittenFont" size="16">
Majid,

As we discussed, this armor is extremely valuable.  Please protect it at all costs.  You and your men should sleep in shifts in order to prevent any surprises, and dispose of anyone you do not recognize.  We cannot be found out.

The buyer will be traveling to meet you in the coming days.  We stand to make a small fortune, and you and your men will get the proper cut of the profits, as agreed.  The loss of such an artifact will bring disgrace to the Empire, and we should all be proud.

Please be aware, it is extremely important that you do not put this armor on.  I did not believe the stories, but when I put it on I was overcome with an uneasy fatigue.  Do not tell the prospective buyer about this lest they change their minds.  Let them seek out Kynareth's blessing themselves.
</font>
traduit:
<font face="$HandwrittenFont" size="16">
马吉德：

正如我们所谈，此护甲十分昂贵。请不惜一切代价予以保护。你们要轮班看守以防意外，处理掉一切生人。我们决不能被发现。

买主过几天就会来与你见面。我们能小赚一笔，到时候你和你部下能得到相应的分润。失去这样一件神器，帝国将蒙受羞辱，我们都该为此自豪。

有一件事务必注意，千万不要穿戴此甲。虽然我不信那些故事，但每当我穿上，就会有一股不安的疲劳向我袭来。不要把这事儿告诉买家，以免他们改主意。让他们自己去寻求凯娜瑞丝的祝福吧。
</font>

original: Kinthal's Journal
traduit: 金塔尔的日记

original:
<font face='$HandwrittenFont'><font size='20'>
Even though we no longer raid with the backstabbing Seducers, we still work for that wizard Thoron. He's been paying us handsomely to turn over Ri'saad's caravan, looking for any trinkets that seem strange.

A week ago we found a sword unlike anything we've ever seen. Thoron's face lit up when he saw it. "This could be it," he said. Something about a "bridge." He's probably lost it. No sword is worth how much he paid us for it. Won't hear us complaining, though.

We see Thoron once a month so he can have a look at our spoils. Everything he doesn't want, we split and sell. Nice and clean. When we're done, he skulks off back to that lair of his in Solitude. What he does there is anyone's guess.
</font>
traduit:
<font face='$HandwrittenFont'><font size='20'>
即使我们不再和背后捅刀子的诱惑者一起抢劫，可还是要给那个巫师托隆打工。他给了我们一大笔钱去抢劫里'撒德的商队，要找那些奇怪的小玩意儿。

一周前我们发现了一把从没见过的剑。托隆的脸顿时亮了。他说着“可能就是这个了”。然后念叨着关于什么“桥”的东西。他八成是失了智了。一把剑也值得他花这么大价钱。不过我们是不会说什么的。

我们每个月去见托隆一次，让他看看我们的战利品。他不想要的，我们就分赃卖掉。干净漂亮。等我们完事儿，他就偷偷溜回他在独孤城的老窝。谁也不知道他在哪儿捣鼓什么。
</font>

original: Svarig's Journal
traduit: 斯瓦里格的日记

original:
<font face='$HandwrittenFont'><font size='20'>
We continue to do the bidding of Thoron, our wealthy benefactor. Though our relationship has taken a turn for the worse, he still pays exceedingly well and continues to ask us to pillage the trade caravans as they pass, searching for anything we can find that seems "off" or has even a hint of magic.

Thoron is a powerful conjurer, but also completely insane. He has become increasingly unhappy with our spoils as of late. I suspect that the vainglorious Saints have done something to gain his favor. We've all become fearful of what might happen if we meet him next month and he disapproves of our spoils. If you ask me, all that time he spends holed up in those sewers has finally turned his brains upside down.

He seemed to really like those tongs and rusty calipers we brought him a few months back. All we need is to find the right piece of junk that he thinks will help him "bridge the gap" he keeps going on about, and we'll have full coin purses once again.</font>
traduit:
<font face='$HandwrittenFont'><font size='20'>
我们还在听托隆的命令，他可是让我们富起来的大恩人。虽然我们的关系变得更糟了，但他仍然给我们丰厚的报酬，并继续要求我们打劫过往商队，寻找到一切看起来“不对劲”的东西，最好是带点魔法。

托隆确实是个强大的召唤师，但完全疯了。他最近对我们拿来的战利品越来越不满意。我怀疑是那群虚荣的圣徒做了什么让他特别中意的事。我们都有点担心下个月见到他时，他还不满意的话，会发生什么事。要我说，他躲在下水道里太久，脑子已经坏掉了。

他似乎真的很喜欢我们几个月前给他的夹子和生锈的卡钳。我们只需要找到他认为能帮他“弥补差距”的合适垃圾，就能赚的盆满钵满了。</font>

original: Evethra's Journal
traduit: 伊芙瑟拉的日记

original:
<font face='$HandwrittenFont'><font size='18'>I know of you both, Amber and Madness. I am well acquainted with your secrets. 

Amber, the glowing works of an alien root, I find your resin pristine and holy. Light and powerful, you require a delicate hand, one that recognizes the fragile nature of beauty. 

Madness, I know you to be a flexible breed, one congealed from the tattered minds of dead heroes. Unlike Amber, I would bend and bow you like a sinew. I would beat and hammer you, stretch and fold you, knowing that each blow would callous your skin and sharpen your teeth.

It was dark armored men that brought me these treats, these puzzles to solve. "Courtesy of Thoron," they said. Liars. There is no Thoron, not anymore. He is a memory of long past, and memories are as real as dreams and other fanciful thoughts. Still, I had to have them.

Amber, so exquisite, so pretty, like drops of fallen star dew. From your honeyed globes I would craft myself an armor that trapped me inside your beauty and warmth. I would suffocate myself in your light, and in death live for eternity.

But madness, oh madness, you charm me with your edge. From you I would forge a knife to cut out Sheogorath's tongue, and use it to lick the dust off my anvil. Oh how happy that would make all three of us.

In my desperation I've turned to magic, to try and turn these earthly materials into your equals. I have forged armor and blade in hopes of finding a worthy pair. But they are failures. Not fit to be your shadows. 

So instead, I will mine the forests and the dead. I will have caravans search the far corners of Tamriel. I will reach into the eye of Oblivion itself, until I find you both again.
</font>
traduit:
<font face='$HandwrittenFont'><font size='18'>我很熟悉你们两个，琥珀与疯狂矿。我深知你们的秘密。

琥珀，异域根茎的闪光之物，你的树脂纯净而神圣。轻巧而有力，你需要的是一只纤巧的手，一只懂得美的脆弱本质的手。

疯狂矿，我知道你是个灵活的品种，诞生自死去英雄的破碎思想中的凝结。不像对琥珀那样，我会把你像肌肉一样弯折锻炼。我会用锤子锻打你，拉伸你，折叠你，每一击都会使你的皮肤变得更坚硬，牙齿变得更锋利。

穿着黑色盔甲的人给我带来这些方法，让我解开了谜题。他们说，这是托隆的好意。骗子。托隆不在了，再也不在了。他只是很久以前的记忆，就像梦好其他幻想那样不真实。不过，我还是留着它们。

琥珀，那么精致，那么美丽，就像一滴滴陨落的星露。我要用你甜蜜的眼珠制作一套盔甲，把我困在你那美丽与温暖中。我愿在你的光芒中窒息，在死亡中获得永生。

但是，疯狂矿，哦疯狂矿，你的锋芒也吸引着我。我要用你的身体打造成一把刀，割下谢尔格拉的舌头，再用舌头舔掉我铁砧上的灰尘。哦，那我们三个该有多开心啊！

我在绝望中寻求魔法，想把那些俗世之物变成与你们相同的东西。我锻造了很多刀剑盔甲，希望能找到合适的。但它们都是失败品，连成为你们的影子都不配。

所以，我要去森林与亡者之地挖掘。派商队到泰姆瑞尔的偏远角落去搜寻。我会深入湮灭之眼，直到再次找到你们。
</font>

original: Seducers Bandit Leader's Journal

original:
<font face='$HandwrittenFont'><font size='20'>
Dark work, this, but does it ever pay well. Once every few days, a merchant comes galloping through, defenseless as a babe. We Seducers always do our good deed, and lighten their load before we let them pass. It's the least we can do.

Moving north was the best thing we ever did. Leave Ri'saad to the milk drinkers of Whiterun, or as they call themselves, the Saints. They're probably still hounding him on the road to Markarth.

Svarig is behind on his visit. I wonder if his path from the west was more treacherous than usual. 

We need a change in our fortunes. If we don't get paid soon, I fear the others might not stay much longer. Hopefully this new lead pans out.</font>
traduit:
<font face='$HandwrittenFont'><font size='20'>
真是黑暗的工作，但收益好啊。每隔几天，就有商人像个婴儿一样毫无防备地疾驰而过。我们诱惑者总是那么乐于助人，在他们路过我们之前帮他们减轻点负担。这也是举手之劳么。

搬到北方则是我们做过的好事之最。把里'撒德留给白漫的那群懦夫，或者是他们自称的，“圣徒”。他们可能还在通往马卡斯的道路上继续追杀呢。

我们需要改变命运。如果不尽快拿到报酬，恐怕其他人也待不了多久了。希望这边的新线路能成功。</font>

original: Ri'saad's Note on Bandit Attacks
traduit: 里'撒德被强盗袭击的说明

original:
<font face='$HandwrittenFont'><font size='18'>
The roads have been unkind to this one, plagued by outlaws along the route from Whiterun to Markarth. Guards travel with Ri'saad, yes, but they are ill-equipped to deal with ones such as this. They wield strange golden weapons and wear gleaming armor. Ri'saad has read of such things only in stories. Their encampment is found just west of North Brittleshin Pass.

Each time they set upon us, they shout, "The Saints would like to browse your wares today." The brutes steal mostly trinkets and oddities, no matter how cheap this one knows them to be. Then, they allow Ri'saad to go on his way. Ri'saad has not yet fought back. While it has harmed this one's coin purse, it is not worth a life.

Ri'saad has heard of another gang patrolling the roads further north, calling themselves the "Seducers." They are known for their menacing, dark armor. Skyrim grows more perilous by the day. They are known to camp along the road west of Fort Kastav.

This one would pay handsomely to any who would help. Ri'saad fears for any who might come to harm at the hands of these worrisome pests.</font>
traduit:
<font face='$HandwrittenFont'><font size='18'>
从白漫到马卡斯的道路上到处都是强盗。确实，护卫们一直跟着里'撒德，但他们没有足够好的装备对付这些人。他们挥舞着奇怪的金色武器，穿着闪闪发光的盔甲。里'撒德只在故事里读到过。他们的营地就在北脆胫隘口的西边。

每次他们找上来，都会喊着：“圣徒来看看你们今天的货。”这些野兽抢的大多都是些小饰品或者稀奇古怪的玩意儿，而且不管价格。然后，他们就会允许里’撒德继续走他的路。里’撒德还没反击。虽然钱包受损了，但还不值得玩命。

里’撒德还听说有另一个团伙在更北边的路上徘徊，自称叫“诱惑者”。他们穿着很有威胁感的黑色盔甲。天际真是一天比一天危险。据说他们在卡斯塔夫堡以西的路上扎营。

无论是谁，只要愿意帮忙，在下都会给出丰厚的报酬。里'撒德担心有人可能被这些害虫加害。</font>

original: Joften's Notes
traduit: 约弗腾的笔记

original:
<font face='$HandwrittenFont'><font size='20'>
An ancient battle site was discovered near Thoron's lair. On the ground, an assortment of weapons and armor of the Daedra known as Golden Saints and Dark Seducers laid strewn about.  It is from this site that we took up their arms, and joined together as bandit companies under their names. Since then, as the only blacksmith, I have taken it upon myself to study these otherworldly artifacts.

And now, at last, my efforts to reproduce the exquisite craftsmanship of these great Daedra has finally born fruit.

My mind is not what it once was. If my memory fails me, at least these notes can help the others keep the craft alive.

One would be foolish to forge weapons from gold, as it is far too soft. And yet the golden blades of the Saints are nimble and harder than steel. How could this be? The trick appears to be three fold: First, the structure of the piece must be reinforced with refined moonstone. Second, the gold must be hammered into place while the gold is heated just below its melting point. Third, the introduction of the heart of a Daedra to the forge when heating the piece so it can be hammered into shape completely transforms the attributes of the metal, giving it its uncanny hardness.

The process for forging the dark armor of the Seducers is similar, but requires more finesse, as you must balance shaping the unyielding ebony with malleable quicksilver. The heat applied must be very precise or the shape and integrity of the equipment will be ruined. As before, introduce the Daedric heart to the forge as you heat the material.</font>
traduit:
<font face='$HandwrittenFont'><font size='20'>
在托隆的巢穴附近发现了一处古老的战斗遗迹。地上都是黄金圣徒和黑暗诱惑者这些迪德拉的武器装备。我们正是从这个遗迹中拿取了他们的装备，以它们的名义组织起来，成立强盗帮派。从那时起，作为唯一的铁匠，我就开始研究这些超凡的神器。

现在，我为重现这些伟大精湛的迪德拉工艺所付出的努力终于结出了果实。

我的思想已经今非昔比。如果我的记忆背叛了我，至少也要让这些笔记帮助其他人保住这些手艺。

黄金质地太软了，用来锻造武器是个很蠢的选择。然而圣徒的黄金剑却比钢铁还要灵活坚硬。原因何在？似乎有三方面原因：首先，必须用精炼月石进行加固。其次，黄金必须即将达到熔点时捶打到位。第三，要把迪德拉心脏引入锻炉加热，使其可以捶打成形，进而改变金属的属性，赋予不可思议的硬度。

锻造诱惑者的黑暗盔甲的过程也很相似，但需要更多技巧，因为你必须在塑造坚硬的黑檀与柔软的水银之间取得平衡。施加的火力必须非常精确，否则装备的形状和完整性将会遭到破坏。和之前一样，也需要在加热材料时加入迪德拉心脏。</font>

original: Saints Bandit Leader's Journal
traduit: 圣徒强盗头目的日记

original:
<font face='$HandwrittenFont'><font size='20'>
Now this is what I call easy coin! I'm proud to be one of the Saints. Every few days, Ri'saad comes down the road, and his wares are ours for the taking. We don't take everything, mind you. If he don't got nothing to sell, he can't stay in business, and then where would we be? We just skim a bit off the top each time.

Kinthal should be happy with our latest take. He'll be leaving his camp up near Karthwasten to pay us a visit soon.

Those damn Seducers were eating into our profits, until we drove them off up north. Other merchants pass through those parts, so maybe they'll stay gone.</font>
traduit:
<font face='$HandwrittenFont'><font size='20'>
这就是我说的赚快钱！能成为圣徒的一员太好了。每隔几天，里'撒德就会路过这条路，他的货都是我们的。注意，我们不是拿走所有东西。如果他没货可卖，不就经营不下去了么。那我们怎么办？我们每次只能从上面掠一点点。

金塔尔肯定会对我们的最新成果感到满意。他很快就要离开在卡斯威斯腾附近的营地来看我们了。

那些该死的诱惑者还在蚕食我们的利润，直到我们把他们赶到北方为止。其他商队还会经过这些地方，所以他们可能会离开。</font>

[pagebreak]
<font face='$HandwrittenFont'><font size='20'>5th of Sun's Height, 4E 201

The sword's bloodlust can be used. Its desire to cleave, a bridge. Cut open the path. But never let the wound fester. A broken bone grows stronger when healed. 
[pagebreak]
18th of Sun's Height, 4E 201

Another vision. A long march through the gray. Crackle of boots, pressed on misshapen throats. In the fog, a whistle, marking time.

The sword is planted in the earth. Chaos screams, bleeds. Through its heart, roots are nourished. From the wound, a tree blooms. A path opens.
[pagebreak]
1st of Last Seed, 4E 201

Scar tissue hardens, roots thicken. The wound bleeds, but the path is blocked. A fish swimming upstream. 

Perhaps the path is not for me. The path is for it. The river must flow from source to mouth, to fill the mind's cup. 
[pagebreak]
16th of Last Seed, 4E 201

Temporary hearing loss. Bread, baking in a hearth. We reach out and grasp the abyss, only to let go. Face first into the mud with gritted teeth. Light bending through a glass eye. How easily we are lost! Revelations soaring on red wings above the dark. Rain running down the side of every window pane.

[pagebreak]
<font face='$HandwrittenFont'><font size='20'>

I will not go manic.



I will bring Mania to me.</font>

[pagebreak]
<font face='$HandwrittenFont'><font size='20'>4E201年，日高月5日

剑的杀戮欲望可以被利用起来。它撕裂的欲望就是一座桥梁。可以开辟道路。但永远不能让伤口溃烂。骨头在折断痊愈之后会变得更强。
[pagebreak]
4E201年，日高月18日

又一个景象出现了。穿越灰色的漫漫长路。战靴声噼啪铿锵，压在畸形的喉咙上。雾里，一声哨响，标志着时间。

剑插在地上。混乱的尖叫、流血。通过它的心脏，根系得到了滋养。伤口处长出一株树木。道路打开了。
[pagebreak]
4E201年，末种月1日

伤疤组织变硬，根在变粗。伤口在流血，但路被堵住了。一只逆流而上的鱼。

或许这条路压根不是为我开辟的。而是为它自己。河流必须从源头进嘴，才能灌满心灵的杯。
[pagebreak]
4E201年，末种月16日

暂时性失聪了。面包，烤在炉子里。我们伸手去抓深渊，却只是为了放走它。先把脸埋在泥里，咬紧牙关。透过玻璃眼的光线弯曲了。我们多容易迷路啊！启示带着红色翅膀在黑暗中展翅翱翔。雨水顺着每一扇窗的玻璃流下来。
</font>
[pagebreak]
<font face='$HandwrittenFont'><font size='20'>

我去不了狂热了。



我要把狂热带到身边来。</font>

traduit: 有关铁匠的纸条

original:
<font face='$HandwrittenFont'><font size='20'>
Our blacksmith, Joften, has gone mad. Most of the time he spouts nonsense. This all started three days ago. Now he won't even pick up his hammer. We've tried to talk sense into the lout, but it's like he doesn't even see us. 

He wrote down the means to forge our Golden arms and armor, and that of the Seducers, but he never told a soul where he left the blasted notes! If we weren't holding out hope that he might snap out of it, we would have already parted his head from the rest of him.

Lately he's been going on about "playing under the bridge," like he were still a child. "That's where I always hid my toys," he said. I know his kin used to live around Half Moon Mill. We should round up some folks to have a look.
</font>
traduit:
<font face='$HandwrittenFont'><font size='20'>
我们的铁匠约弗腾疯了，从三天前开始就胡说八道。现在连锤子都不拿了。我们试着和那个疯子讲道理，但他好像看不见我们一样。

他写下了锻造黄金和诱惑者装备的方法，但他从没告诉任何人笔记到底放哪儿了！如果不是想着他还有可能好起来，我们早就把他大卸八块了。

最近他老说什么“去桥下玩”，好像自己还是个孩子似的。还说“我总是把玩具藏在那里”。我记得他的亲戚以前住在半月木材厂附近。我们应该召集人手去看看。
</font>

original: Gadnor's Last Wishes
traduit: 加德诺的遗愿

original:
<font face='$HandwrittenFont'><font size='20'>
Gadnor, my trusted friend and companion, has been laid to rest. I have built a shrine to watch over him and bring peace to weary travelers.

Of the few riches Gadnor possessed in life, his most prized was a warhammer made of jagged crystal he famously won in a coin toss. After months of research, he came to believe this hammer was some sort of otherworldly treasure. Shortly before his passing, it was his wish that it be hidden away until "one who has walked the Shivering Isles" emerges to retrieve it. I have followed his instructions to the letter, and a powerful illusion spell now obscures it.

To break the spell, one must first acquire pieces of what supposedly make up the weapon itself, "amber" and "madness ore." Such things, if they actually exist, would be great treasures in their own right. If the enchantment is correct, only by placing the ores into the embers near Gadnor's body will the spell be broken.

If Gadnor is not mad, perhaps one day this peerless weapon will find its way into worthy hands once again.</font>
traduit:
<font face='$HandwrittenFont'><font size='20'>
我的挚友伙伴加德诺，已经安息了。我建造了一座祭坛守护他，也给疲惫的旅行者带去安宁。

加德诺一生财富不多，最宝贝的就是一把锯齿状的水晶战锤，是在一次扔硬币时赢回来的。经过几个月的研究，他确信这把锤子是某种超凡的珍宝。他去世前，希望把它藏起来，直到“一个走过战栗群岛的人”出现来取回它。我遵照他的遗愿去做了，用一个强大的幻术把它封印了。

想打破这个幻术，需要获得武器本身的材料，“琥珀”和“疯狂矿石”。这种东西若真的存在，本身就是巨大的财富。如果附魔没出问题，只要把矿石放进加德诺尸体附近的余烬里，法术就会解除。

如果加德诺说的不是疯话，也许有一天，这把无与伦比的武器会再次落入值得使用之人手中吧。</font>

original: Thoron's Journal - Volume 2
traduit: 托隆的日记·卷2

original:
[pagebreak]
16th of Sun's Dusk, 4E 200

I have taken up residence deep in the Solitude sewers, away from prying eyes. I am sure to be undisturbed here while I continue my work.

It pains me to work with these bandit imbeciles, with their heads made of cheese. Or was it brains made of yogurt? I suppose the distinction is irrelevant. They are clumps of aged dairy, left out in the sun. Each one far too stupid to know the worth of their plunder, and for that reason they themselves are given worth.

Much as our Lord would do, I have split them into two groups to cover the caravan trade routes therein. The armors I've collected from these tunnels will serve some use here. Perhaps I will make it a competition. The group that retrieves the most artifacts will be rewarded with a bar of soap.
[pagebreak]
28th of Rain's Hand, 4E 201

The more artifacts I gather, the more in tune with our Lord I become. I can feel his wisdom coursing through me, informing my every move. Yet there is something lacking, as nothing I have retrieved thus far has allowed me to return to my blessed Mania. I have even turned to using tokens from Dementia out of desperation.

With every failed attempt, my patience continues to thin. I may need to strangle a bandit or two or twenty to calm my frazzled nerves.
[pagebreak]
15th of Midyear, 4E 201

Our Lord Sheogorath must be pleased. Very, very pleased. This new artifact is a truly remarkable find. Yes, truly, truly remarkable. To think that it was nearly dismissed as an ordinary claymore, when it was in fact the Sword of Jyggalag, the weapon wielded by the Prince of Order. 

It's the craftsmanship that betrays its truth. Perfect symmetry on both sides, its angles matching ten numerals beyond the decimal. Perhaps twenty, or even forty numerals. I will make an effort to count them tonight.

Yet its true power is held in its enchantment. For when I look upon its crystal edge, I see more than my reflection. I begin to see time the way a cloud sees the river. It has a beginning and an end, but they exist in concert. The past, present, and future flow as one.

I spoke to a cloud the next day, and it confirmed this to be true. Through the sword's visions, I know what is to come. The sewers beneath the city is where the path will open. The sword will serve as the bridge.
[pagebreak]
22nd of Midyear, 4E 201

The Sword of Jyggalag reveals much beyond my intent. It has a logic that seems familiar, but at the same time repels me. It desires Mania as I do, but its goal is that of destruction. 

Worse yet, our Lord's voice feels distant, muted even. I find my thoughts being short, and my words moreso. 
[pagebreak]
30th of Midyear, 4E 201

I need to keep my writings separated. I am beginning to suspect my journals are speaking to each other. No, not suspect. I have proof. 

But I can't write it here, lest my future self speak more lies. Each thought, past and present, must remain pure.
</font>
traduit:
[pagebreak]
4E200年，日暮月16日

我住在独孤城下水道的深处，躲避那些窥探的目光。再继续工作的时候，就肯定没人能打扰我了。

和那些白痴强盗共事太痛苦了，他们的脑袋都是奶酪做的。或者大脑里全是酸奶？不过都一样。他们就是在太阳底下晒冒了泡的过期牛奶。每个人都蠢得不行，不知道他们掠夺的东西的价值，所以就自以为是地定价。

正如我主所愿，我把他们分成了两组来袭扰那些商队的贸易路线。我从隧道里收集的盔甲派上用场了。也许我可以把这变成一场竞赛。取回神器最多的小组，奖励肥皂一块。
[pagebreak]
4E201年，雨手月28日

收集的器物越多，我和主就越合拍。我感受到主的智慧灌注我的全身，指引着我的一举一动。然而还缺少一些东西，我找回的东西还不足以让我回到那幸福的狂热区。出于绝望，我甚至开始拿痴呆区当替代品了。

尝试失败一次又一次，耐心越来越少。我可能需要掐死一两个或二十个强盗来安抚我疲惫的神经。
[pagebreak]
4E201年，年中月15日

我主谢尔格拉肯定很高兴。非常非常高兴。这件新神器太了不起了。没错，真的，真的很了不起。想想看，它看起来只是一把普普通通的大剑，可实际上却是秩序君王的杰盖拉格之剑。

巧夺天工。两边完美对称，精度足达小数点后十位。也许是二十，甚至是四十。今晚我要努力数一数。

然而它真正的力量在于它的附魔。因为我望向它晶莹的锋刃时，我看到的不仅仅是自己的倒影。我开始像云朵俯瞰河流一样观察时间。它有开始有结束，但却一致存在。过去、现在和未来浑然一体。

第二天，我对着一朵云说话，它证实了这是真的。通过剑上的景象，我知道将会发生什么。道路将在这座城市的下水道中打开。剑会充当桥梁。
[pagebreak]
4E201年，年中月22日

杰盖拉格之剑揭示了我的意图。它看起来有很令人熟悉的逻辑性，但同时又让我感觉厌恶。它和我一样渴望狂热，但它的目标是毁灭。

更糟糕的是，我主的声音越来越远。我发现自己的思维越来越短促，话短的更厉害。
[pagebreak]
4E201年，年中月30日

我得把我写的东西分开。我怀疑日记在互相交流。不，不是怀疑。我有证据。但我不能写下来，以免我未来的自己说更多谎言。每个思想，无论是过去的还是现在的，都必须保持纯洁。
</font>

Heretical Thoughts

[pagebreak]

ealotry is an abomination that must be wiped from the Shivering Isles. We cannot suffer their beliefs to spread to even one more soul. They name us Heretics for our lack of belief. We gladly accept the name, and will make a honorable one. It is not heresy to speak truth. It is not heresy to speak out against an unjust lord. It is not heresy to take arms and action in defense of true belief. We are the so-called Heretics of the Shivering Isles, but we do not speak heresy. We speak the truth. Our Lord, Sheogorath, is but a man. He is only flesh and blood, not a god, and certainly not a Daedric Prince. There are no princes in the realms of the Daedra, only vile servitors such as the Hungers that we summon to do our bidding. Sheogorath the False is a mad despot. Years of dabbling in foul magic and consorting with Daedra have driven him mad. He is not a fit ruler, let alone divine. He perverts the teachings of Arden-Sul, He Who Gave His Heart's Blood. When the truth of our cause is common knowledge among the people, we will drive him from New Sheoth and put that cesspool to the sword. His four limbs will be scattered to the four winds. His head will rest upon the Hill of Suicides and his heart shall be burnt in the flames of freedom. His entrails shall be fed to the dogs. We will make all the people of the Shivering Isles wear the robes of the Heretics. By these robes we know each other to be true non-believers. The people shall return to the wilderness and live among the wild things, as we do. They will see the wisdom and purity of the life we lead and they will hail us as saviors.
