original:
<font face="$HandwrittenFont">
Deep in the swamps of Hjaalmarch, where the branches are gnarled and the mist is thick, lies a tower of unknown provenance.

Few in the province dare speak the name Myrwatch, and those that do couch their words with apprehension and fear. Yet the mystery of the tower only piques my interest further, and so I have made it my life's work to discover its secrets.

What I can deduce of its past comes from its present. From the cut of the stone to the wards that surround it, every piece is a clue, a signature that can be traced back to a pen and hand.

The stone seal that guards the entrance is none other than the Eye of Magnus, a symbol born from the legacy of Shalidor. Its burning gaze can be found not just in Myrwatch, but outside the College of Winterhold.

Could it be the mages here were cast out from the college, and set out to carve their own path? This is but a theory, and yet, one I feel has merit.

Nevertheless, without access to the mind of its occupants, true insight will remain frustratingly out of grasp.
</font>
traduit:
<font face="$HandwrittenFont">
在希雅陲沼泽地树木盘根错节、雾气浓重的深处，坐落着一座来历不明的塔楼。

省内很少有人敢提起“无量塔楼”这个名字，就算提起也都带着恐惧。然而，这塔楼的神秘却激起了我进一步探索的兴趣，所以我把解开它的秘密当成了毕生的工作。

我要从它现有的一切推断其过去。从切割方式到周围的纹路，每块石头都是线索，都是可以追溯到笔和手的签名。

守卫入口的石印非是他物，正是玛格努斯之眼，沙利多遗产的象征。它燃烧的目光不仅出现在无量塔楼，也出现在冬堡学院外。

会不会是这里的法师被逐出了学院，另立门户？这算是一种猜想，但也有可取之处。

然而，可惜的是，如果没法进入居住者的思想中，那么仍然无法真正将其洞察。
</font>

original: Anora's Journal
traduit: 阿诺拉的日记

original: 1st of Morning Star, 3E 423 A wise mage once told me the power of a spell lies in one's conviction. It's evident to me now that the college has lost all desire and purpose, and has become feckless under its current stewardship. The Arch-Mage Shalidor believed the halls to be a proving ground where a mage could test the limits of their abilities. Now the college is a tomb of knowledge, where grand spells and lofty ideals are left to wither and rot. We should not let the outside world dictate how we conduct ourselves. Placating their ignorance is not a virtue. The augurs speak of a great war on the horizon, and we should be doing everything in our power to prepare for it. That is why Teel-Ja and I have chosen to leave. We know the road ahead will be hard, but one thing we do not lack is the conviction to see it through. [pagebreak] 23rd of Rain's Hand, 3E 428 Construction of the tower is almost complete. Teel-Ja accused me of being impatient, a crime which I've been guilty of more often than not. Between us he has always been the tortoise, and I the hare. Still, our needs are pressing. The coming war will not wait for the mortar to dry. The location has much to do with the delays, but that can't be helped. The Nords are distrustful of magic by nature, and some would frown upon our efforts. Others might take a more violent approach. For that reason, we've put a ward on the door that requires magic to dispel. We've chosen to honor Shalidor in much of what we do, including the seal outside the door. Teel-Ja seemed pleased with the idea of setting it on fire, while others seemed uncomfortable with the idea. I warned them that pride is the enemy of progress. If we are to survive in the coming storm, we must not be bound by tradition. We must be willing to set it aflame. [pagebreak] 11th of First Seed, 3E 429 It's been a year since construction has finished, yet there is still much that needs to be done. The tower is only the foundation for our defense. Our minds and our magic must serve as its ramparts, and for them to hold we must amplify our strength. As such, I have sent scouts throughout Tamriel to find powerful artifacts that may help us in our efforts; artifacts the college wizards refused to obtain out of cowardice or comfort. Many of these relics played a role in preventing calamities of the past. Perhaps it is their destiny as much as ours to stand between the world and its ruin. [pagebreak] 17th of Frost Fall, 3E 429 We've had little luck finding artifacts of note. Based on the information I've culled from the Arcanaeum records, I know there are several here in Skyrim, including the Staff of Gauldur. We must endeavor to find them all. More concerning, however, is the disposition and morale of the mages. Even Teel-Ja seems to have fallen into the trappings of routine and idleness. It is hard to convince weary souls to explore yet another ruin when the task has been stripped of all urgency. [pagebreak] 29th of Sun's Height, 3E 433 It's now halfway through the year 433, more than ten years since we left the college. Yet all remains blissfully calm. One of the new acolytes even suggested abandoning her training to become a cook, happily showing me her spell for preserving apple pies. I reminded her that she is here to study battle magic, not pastries. She will have more than enough time to indulge her sweet tooth when her youth is behind her. It is why we've devoted half the library to the placement of powerful artifacts, to serve as a reminder of our pursuit. Yet seeing the racks as they are now, collecting only dust, makes me wonder if I've led us all astray. [pagebreak] As leader of this guild, I have the training to fight and the knowledge of what's to come. What I don't have, sadly, is the conviction that it will. [pagebreak] 28th of Last Seed, 3E 433 A courier came by with news from Cyrodiil. Emperor Septim is dead. The Gates of Oblivion have opened. Divines help us all.
traduit: 3E423年，晨星月1日 一位睿智的法师曾告诉我，法术的力量源于一个人的信念。 这句话现在太适合我了，学院已经失去了所有愿望与目标，眼下的管理更是显得无能。 大法师沙利多希望学院成为法师们测试能力极限的试炼场。可现在，这里只是知识的坟墓，伟大的法术与崇高的理想都在里面腐朽枯萎了。 我们岂能让外人左右。安抚他们的无知不是什么美德。有预兆说一场大战即将来临，我们应该尽全力做好准备才是。 这就是我和泰尔-加选择离开的原因。我们知道前路艰难，但我们就是不缺坚持到底的信念。 [pagebreak] 3E428年，雨手月23日 塔已经基本建成了。泰尔-加总是说我经常犯没耐心的毛病。他一直像个乌龟，而我像只野兔子。尽管如此，我们的需求还是很紧迫。即将到来的战争不会等待灰浆干涸。 延误的很大原因是选址，但这样没办法。诺德人天生不信任魔法，有些人对我们的努力嗤之以鼻。其他人的方式可能会更加暴力。 我们做了很多设计来致敬沙利多，比如门口的封印。泰尔-加似乎对烧掉它的想法很满意，可其他人似乎觉得不大舒服。我告诫他们，骄傲是进步的敌人。如果我们想在即将到来的风暴中生存下来，就别被传统束缚。我们必须愿意将其点燃。 [pagebreak] 3E429年，初种月11日 塔楼已经建成一年了，但还有很多工作。塔楼只是我们防御的基础。我们的思想和魔法必须成为它的壁垒。想要守住它，就必须增强我们的力量。 为此，我派出探索小队去泰姆瑞尔各地寻找强大的神器，来帮助我们。学院里的巫师们由于怯懦或安逸，拒绝去寻找这些文物。那些遗存有许多在过去为防范灾难发挥了巨大作用。或许它们和我们的命运相同，都站在了世界的存亡之间。 [pagebreak] 3E429年，霜落月17日 没能找到什么重要的神器。根据我从秘藏馆收集的信息，我知道在天际就有好几个，比如高尔多的法杖。我们必须努力把它们都找出来。 然而，法师们的性情和士气更令我担忧。就连泰尔-加都陷入了例行公事和无所事事的陷阱。当任务没了紧迫感，很难说服疲惫的灵魂去探索新的遗迹。 [pagebreak] 3E433年，日高月29日 现在433年已经过去一半，我们离开学院也有十多年了。然而，一切都保持着幸福的平静。有个新学徒甚至想放弃训练，改行当厨师，还很高兴地跟我展示她用法术保存苹果派的本事。我提醒她，她是来学习战斗魔法的，不是来当糕点师。等她青春过去，有的是时间放纵自己的甜品欲望。 这就是为什么我们要花半个馆的地方来放置强大的神器。就是为了不忘当年的追求。可看现在架子上除了灰尘就是灰尘。我怀疑自己是不是把大家带错了方向。 [pagebreak] 作为公会的领袖，我接受过战斗训练，也知道接下来会发生什么。遗憾的是，我没有信念了。 [pagebreak] 3E433年，末种月28日 有信使带着希罗帝尔的消息来了。塞普汀皇帝死了。湮灭之门打开了。圣灵保佑。

original:
<font face="$HandwrittenFont">Long ago, my ancestors built a great hall on the mountainside, north of Bilegulch Mine. They called it Hendraheim, a warrior's home that rivaled Sovngarde itself.

As the last of my clan, I wish to bequeath this home to a true warrior. You are not a Nord, yet I've heard your prowess in battle rivals that of our most legendary fighters. I ask you to prove it with your blade.

Eydvina Shield-Hearth
traduit:
<font face="$HandwrittenFont">很多年前，我的祖先在胆汁峡谷矿场北边的山腰上建了一座大厅，起名叫做亨德拉海姆，是个媲美松加德战士之家的地方。

作为我氏族的最后一员，我希望把这个家园留给真正的战士。虽然你不是诺德人，但听说你在和我们最传奇的战士战斗时的勇猛，希望你能用你的剑来证明。

艾德维娜·盾炉

traduit: 艾德维娜的纸条

original:
<font face="$HandwrittenFont">When the world was young, things were simpler.

It was us or them. We fought to survive, and in death we found glory. 

Now we fight our own Shield-Sisters and Brothers, for banners that change with the wind.

When I killed Hjarek on the battlefield, I vowed not to take up arms again. I found honor in this choice, but shame in its consequence.

The bards do not sing tales of those who die in their homes, slain by time. If I am to see him again, I must stand eye to eye with Tsun on the Whalebone Bridge, and earn my place in the Hall of Valor.

I miss you, brother. Wait for me in Sovngarde.
traduit:
<font face="$HandwrittenFont">当世界还年轻的时候，一切都很简单。

非我者即他。我们为生存而战，在死亡中找寻荣耀。

现在我们却和自己的盾牌姐妹与兄弟战斗，为了那些迎风飘扬的旗帜而战。

当我在战场上杀死哈莱克的时候，我发誓不再拿起武器。我为这一选择感到光荣，也为其后果感到羞耻。

吟游诗人不会传唱那些死在家里，被时间杀害的人。如果我想再见到他，我一定要在鲸骨桥上直面苏恩的试炼，争取在勇士大厅占下一席之地。

我想你了，兄弟。在松加德等等我。

original:
<font face='$HandwrittenFont' size='20'>
If you are reading this, I am dead, and so, you will have to hear my toast in spirit. 

Of course, a little business first. As I have no living heirs, I have decided the manor will be bequeathed to you. Provided, you finish this last meal.

As you know, I have always loved dinner parties. And so, for my final dinner, I've decided to have a few friends over. 

Verin, you and I shared a long and fruitful business partnership, but you altered the books to give yourself a larger cut. Don't think I didn't notice.

Marina, you were my first love, but also, my first mistake. For your love was not mine alone, and for that, I never forgot.

Igrit, you were my ward, and in some ways, I considered you a daughter. But a daughter does not plot to steal an inheritance. So I will teach you this lesson as a father would.

Leyathil, we fought in the war together, and our bond is in many ways sacred. Yet I know the horrors you committed to survive, and while I dismissed it then, I cannot now.

Galtius, my old Imperial friend, who used to drink wine with me at the Surilie Brothers vineyard in Skingrad. One night, you drank too much, and saw fit to insult my family. I told you I forgave you, as you were drunk. I did not. 

Lastly, <Alias=Player>. We have never met. I've brought you here on a whim. You are here as a wild card. A chance to change the fates of my friends. Or, to revel in it. Much like my fate in the next world, it's far more exciting, you see, if the future is unknown.

And with that said, drinks are served.</font>
traduit:
<font face='$HandwrittenFont' size='20'>
如果你读到这篇文，我已经死了，所以你只能接受我的灵魂来祝酒了。

当然，先谈点生意吧。我没有活着的继承人了，所以决定把庄园遗赠给你。只要你在这里用完这最后一餐。

如你所见，我很喜欢举办宴会。所以，我的最后一宴，请了几个朋友过来。

维林，你跟我保持了长期的商业伙伴关系，却偷改账目，做大自己的分成。别以为我没注意到。

玛丽娜，你是我的初恋，也是我犯下的第一个错误。因为你的爱不属于我一个人，所以，我永远不会忘记。

伊格里特，你是我的养女，我对你视如己出。但女儿不该谋夺遗产。所以，我要像个父亲一样给你上一课。

蕾雅希尔，你我平肩作战，我们之间的关系很神圣。但我知道你为了生存所经历的恐怖，虽然我当时没有理会，但现在不行。

伽耳提乌斯，我的帝国老朋友，你我曾经在斯金格勒的苏瑞利兄弟葡萄园喝酒。那次你喝多了，羞辱了我的家族。我是说过要原谅你的酒后失言。但并没有。

最后，<Alias=Player>。我们素未谋面，邀请你只是一时兴起。你就是这里的未知数。应该改变我朋友们命运的机会。或者，好好享受。就像我在另一个世界里的命运一样，如果未来是未知的，那就更让人兴奋了。

话止于此，酒水已经端上来了。</font>

original:
<font face='$HandwrittenFont' size='22'>
The information we got from the mole was spot on. At first glance, it looked like any ordinary cave. 

I was ready to turn around and give up for the night, when up walk these nobles with furs fine enough to sleep on. I watched them enter the cave one by one, until there was one guy left. Then I tapped him on the shoulder, and rammed my fist so hard into his forehead that I heard his skull crunch.

He'll be all right though. But he's gonna need a new tunic, I heard a thread rip.</font>
traduit:
<font face='$HandwrittenFont' size='22'>
线报准确无误。乍一看确实和普通的洞穴没什么两样。

天色已晚，我刚打算暂停探索，这时走来一群贵族，身上的皮草足以打地铺了。我看他们一个接一个走进洞穴，直到只剩下一个人。我拍了拍他肩膀，一拳砸在他脑门上，骨头都响了。

不过他没什么大碍。只不过他可能需要一件新外衣了，我好像把线撑崩开了。</font>

original:
<font face="$HandwrittenFont">
<Alias=Player>,

We have challenged the Imperial dogs to a duel of champions. They are said to be led by a great warrior, but anyone who licks the boots of the Empire can hardly lay claim to such a title.

That is why we ask you to put these fools in their place. Find me in the Palace of the Kings, and I will provide you with the armor of a true champion. Once equipped, you will meet with a garrison of our finest soldiers and put an end to this milk-drinker and his band of imposters.

When the time comes, do not waste your breath with words. Let the fields of Whiterun drink down their blood. 

- Yrsarald Thrice-Pierced
traduit:
<font face="$HandwrittenFont">
<Alias=Player>：

我们向帝国狗们提出来一场冠军对决。据说他们是由伟大的战士领导，但向帝国溜须拍马的人配不上这样的头衔。

这就是为什么我们想请你让那群傻瓜闭嘴。来众王之殿找我，我会给你一身真正的冠军盔甲。等装备齐整，你就和我们最精锐的部队一起去干翻那个懦夫和他手下那帮骗子。

该出手时就出手。让白漫的田野饱饮他们的鲜血。

——“三度刺穿者”伊尔萨拉德

original: Letter of Commendation

original:
<font face="$HandwrittenFont">We've received word of your victory over the rebels, and so has most of Skyrim. We expect recruitment to increase tenfold as a result. No one wants to side with a losing cause.

As a reward, you're welcome to keep the champion's armor and weapons. Judging by what you did to those turncloaks, I know you'll make good use of it.

- Legate Adventus Caesennius
traduit:
<font face="$HandwrittenFont">我们收到你了战胜叛军的捷报，天际大部分地区都在传。预计参军人数将会因你增加十倍。没人会站在注定失败的一方。

作为奖励，你可以留下冠军的盔甲武器。从你对那些叛军的所作所为来看，你肯定会好好利用它们的。

——艾文图斯·凯西尼奥斯副官

original:
<font face="$HandwrittenFont">
Word of your battle with the Imperials is traveling across Eastmarch. I wish I could've been there to see their pathetic excuse for a champion beg for his life. You have more than earned the right to wear the armor of the Stormbear, so it is yours to keep. 

Fight well and may Talos guide you.

- Yrsarald Thrice-Pierced
traduit:
<font face="$HandwrittenFont">
你与帝国战斗的消息传遍了东陲。真希望在现场亲眼见证他们可怜的借口和一个冠军跪地求饶的景象。你完全有资格穿上风暴熊甲，你可以留下它们了。

好好战斗，愿塔洛斯指引你。

——“三度刺穿者”伊尔萨拉德

original:
<font face="$HandwrittenFont">
<Alias=Player>,

A troop of Stormcloak rebels have challenged us to a battle on the fields of Whiterun. They want us to send a garrision of our greatest champions to fight theirs. I've talked to General Tullius and we can't rule out the possibility this is some kind of trap. 

After all, the traitors have shown they have little concern for loyalty, it's doubtful they would give honor the same courtesy.

original:
<font face="$HandwrittenFont">
There is talk in the taverns about a battle in Whiterun between two champions, one Stormcloak, one Imperial. Yet while the stage has been set, the actors have not.

Yrsarald Thrice-Pierced has made it clear that the Stormcloak champion must prove their mettle by bringing him the pelts of five snow bears. While the task seems daunting, rumor has it that a warrior named Klija Wolf-Claw of Bruma has already slain the beasts, and has made her way to Kynesgrove.

For their side, Legate Adventus Caesennius has made no mention of any ritual in selecting their champion. It makes you wonder if any willing soldier would do.
traduit:
<font face="$HandwrittenFont">
酒馆旅店都在传，说有风暴斗篷和帝国会派出冠军在白漫城决斗。然而，舞台虽然搭好了，演员却没就位。

“三度刺穿者”伊尔萨拉德明确表示，想当风暴斗篷冠军，就必须拿出五只雪熊的皮，来证明自己的勇气。虽然这项任务看起来很艰巨，但据说布鲁玛有位叫“狼爪”克里亚的勇士已经杀死了足够的野兽，并前往凯娜之林。

而帝国那边，艾文图斯·凯西尼奥斯副官没提出任何遴选冠军所需的仪式。这就很让人怀疑是否有士兵愿意出头了。

original: Legate Adventus Caesennius's Note
traduit: 艾文图斯·凯西尼奥斯副官的纸条

original:
<font face="$HandwrittenFont">
A troop of Stormcloak rebels have challenged us to a battle on the fields of Whiterun. They want us to send a garrision of our greatest champions to fight theirs. I've talked to General Tullius and we can't rule out the possibility this is some kind of trap. 

After all, the traitors have shown they have little concern for loyalty, it's doubtful they would give honor the same courtesy.

Still, winning this would dispel a lot of the mystique around their warriors. If we win, it's a huge blow to their morale. If we lose, we'll let it be known that our champion was just another soldier. 

Regardless, it's best we find someone who's willing to give their life for the cause. If they somehow survive, they'll have earned the armor we forged them.
traduit:
<font face="$HandwrittenFont">
风暴斗篷叛军向我们发起挑战，要与我们在白漫决一死战。他们想让我们派出一支由最精锐勇士组成的军队去和他们作战。我和图留斯将军都觉得不能排除这是陷阱的可能性。

毕竟，叛军已经表现出自己对忠诚的毫不在意，他们是否还会重视荣誉，很令人怀疑。

尽管如此，赢下这场比赛可以驱散围绕在他们战士身上的许多神秘感。也能重创他们的士气。如果我们输了，那就对外说我们的冠军只不过是个士兵。

不管怎样，我们最好能找一个愿意为此拼命的人。如果他能活下来，就能获得我们为他准备的盔甲。

original: Letter from Cuinanthil's Steward
traduit: 奎南希尔管家的来信

original:
<font face="$HandwrittenFont">
Dear master,

I have a bit of unfortunate news. While searching for the whereabouts of your brother Ernanthil, I discovered that your bodyguard, Inimoro, has been stealing from your coffers. 

I know you trust him with your life, so it must wound you dearly to hear this news. Still, as heir to your father's business and fortune, you must learn that even the staunchest of allies can be bewitched by the allure of coin. 

That unpleasant news aside, I hope you are well. Please remember to write your mother, she misses you dearly.

Your faithful charge,
Alrano</font>
traduit:
<font face="$HandwrittenFont">
亲爱的主人：

有个不幸的消息。在搜寻您弟弟厄南希尔下落时，我发现您的保镖印摩罗一直在偷窃您的财物。

您把性命都托付给了他，这个消息肯定对您打击很大。但作为您父亲事业与财富的继承人，您必须清楚，再坚定的盟友也会被金钱所迷惑。

先不提这令人不悦的消息，希望您一切安好。请记得给您母亲写信，她非常想念您。

您忠实的管家
奥拉诺</font>

original: Rogue's Instructions
traduit: 暴徒的指示

original:
<font face="$HandwrittenFont">
All right, here's the plan. Take the letter and seal it with the ring. Then put on this courier's clothes and deliver it. I haven't seen too many female couriers around so it might be dicey, but it's all we got.

Still, it should work so long as you talk like a bloody courier. I'm sure you've gotten enough letters to know how they speak. And if it don't work the first time, wait an hour, think about what you're gonna say, and try again. When it comes to poor folk, the Elf's got the memory of a goldfish.

Anyways, once Cuinanthil reads the letter, he'll have his bodyguard arrested. He might even have him killed on the spot. Doesn't matter either way.

Knowing him, the next thing he'll do is go straight for his treasure, to count every last coin and make sure it's all there. 

Then we just follow that snotty little spear polisher as he leads us straight to the gold.

--E
</font>
traduit:
<font face="$HandwrittenFont">
好了，计划是这样。把信拿去，用戒指封好。然后就穿上那个信使的衣服送出去。虽说没见过几个女的送信，确实有点风险，但我们也只能将就了。

不过，只要你说话像个送信人就行了。相信你也收到过信件，知道他们是怎么说话的。如果一次不成功，就等上一小时，琢磨琢磨该怎么说，然后再试一次。那个高精灵遇到穷人，记忆力就和金鱼一样。

不管怎样，只要奎南希尔读了这封信，他就会叫人逮捕他的保镖。甚至可能当场杀了他。但都无所谓了。

以我对他的了解，接下来肯定会直接去核对他的财宝，数清每一枚金币。

然后就跟着那个鼻涕虫过去，让他直接带咱们找到黄金。

——E
</font>

original: Cuinanthil's Journal
traduit: 奎南希尔的日记

original:
<font face="$HandwrittenFont">
The deal with the Silver-Bloods has been fully consummated. The location of the vault is rather ingenious, hiding in plain sight amongst degenerates and thieves.

It tickles me to know they dream of wealth and fortune, never realizing only a single wall separates it from their soiled bedrolls. 

As for security, there are two measures. The door is locked securely by key, but that would only embolden their curiosity. That is why as far as the locals know, it belongs to a beggar named Eslaf.

Now if any of these gutter rats had even a modicum of intelligence, they would realize that Eslaf Erol is the name of a fictional prince who made his fortune from nothing.

I too have worked from the ground up to achieve my current status. I have taken that which was to be divided, and multiplied it tenfold. 

After all, my brother Ernanthil is fortunate to have his life, he should not protest if I take everything else.</font>
traduit:
<font face="$HandwrittenFont">
和银血家族的生意已经谈妥了。保险库的位置很巧妙，就隐藏在那些贱民和小偷的眼皮子底下。

他们都梦想着发大财，却不知道与他们肮脏的铺盖只一墙之隔的地方就有我的财宝。乐死我了。

至于安全，已经做了两重保障。门如果只是被牢牢锁着，就只会助长他们的好奇心。所以对外都说，这里属于一个叫伊斯拉夫的乞丐。

但凡这些臭水沟里的老鼠有点脑子，就会知道伊斯拉夫·埃罗尔是个虚构的、白手起家的王子。

毕竟，留我弟弟一命就是他走大运了，就算我夺走他的一切，他也不该抗议。</font>

original: Ernanthil's Journal
traduit: 厄南希尔的日记

original:
<font face="$HandwrittenFont">
My brother's always been the greedy sort. Offer him a slice and he'll take the whole pie, and worse yet, he'll act like he's doing you a favor.

But I always figured father would see through his lies. Never thought I'd be cut out of the will like some half-blood Orc's son. 

But it's all right. It's a bit poetic in a sense. Father's favorite book was about the beggar named Eslaf. His old man left him nothing too, except what he was willing to take. Me, I'm gonna take it all.</font>
traduit:
<font face="$HandwrittenFont">
我的兄弟太过贪婪。分蛋糕的时候，总会把整个都拿走，更扯的是，他还会表现得是在帮你似的。

我总盼着父亲识破他的谎言。却从没想过，我会像个兽人混血儿一样从遗嘱中除名。

不过无所谓。从某种意义上说，这还有点诗意。父亲最喜欢的书就是乞丐伊斯拉夫。除了他愿意拿走的东西，他父亲也没给他留下什么。但我，我全都要。</font>

original: Mysterious Altar
traduit: 神秘的祭坛

original:
<font face="$HandwrittenFont">
I was two days into my journey from Markarth when the ataxia struck. I thought if I bit down on a piece of cloth it would distract me from the pain, but eventually my joints could bear the weight no longer. 

I stopped at the Roadside Ruins looking for a place to rest. It was there, in the briars of an autumn fog, that I came across a strange altar rooted in the ground. Beside it stood an old woman, who I took for its keeper. 

Taking note of my apprehension, the old woman beckoned me forward. Wordlessly she raised her hand, and directed it toward the altar. She was asking me to choose.

In my travels I have passed through hagraven camps and seen many a twisted thing, but none like this. Placed in its gnarled hands were three empty bowls, and a cup to fill them. 

At last the old woman spoke, with an accent I couldn't place. The first bowl, she said, would grant you power. The second would bring you fortune. The third, however, would offer you nothing at all. 

Looking back now, I can't tell you if any of this was real, or some hallucination I dreamt up to cope with the fever. Or it could be the altar was no different than a standing stone, a tribute to a god long forgotten. Still, I felt compelled to ask the woman how and where I would find my boon. She said it would come to me. 

Unfortunately, the ataxia has cursed me with sleeplessness. Worse yet, the disease has progressed to a point that I fear I will not live to see the outcome of my choice. A shame, as I wonder even now if I have made the right one.

--Rulnik Wind-Strider
</font>
traduit:
<font face="$HandwrittenFont">
刚从马卡斯城出发两天，运动失调症就发作了。我本以为咬一块布就能分散注意力，但最后关节还是承受不住了。

我停在路边遗址，想找地方休息休息。就在那片秋雾的荆棘丛中，我看到了一个奇怪的祭坛，扎根在地上。旁边站着个老太太，大概是看守祭坛的人。

老太太注意到我的顾虑，便招呼我近前。一言不发地举起手，指了指祭坛，让我做出选择。

我在旅行中也路过过乌鸦鬼婆的营地，看见过很多扭曲的东西，但没有一个像这样。那粗糙的手中托着三个空碗和一个用来灌满它们的杯子。

最后，老太太说话了，口音含糊不清。她说，第一个碗会给我力量，第二个会给我财富。但第三个什么都不会给我。

现在回想起来，我也说不清这一切是真的，还是我发烧产生的幻觉。祭坛可能和立石没什么不同，就是对某个被遗忘已久的神灵的崇拜。不过我还是有必要和那女人问清楚该怎么找到我应得的恩惠。她却说我会想起来的。

可惜，运动失调让我失眠了。更糟的是，我的病越来越重，感觉我已经看不到自己选择的结果了。太遗憾了，我到现在还在想自己的决定是否正确。

——鲁尔尼克·风行者
</font>

original: Prisoner's Note
traduit: 囚犯的纸条

original:
<font face="$HandwrittenFont">
I don't know how I became a prisoner here, but the bandits say I have one of two options. Fight for my freedom, or get sold to slavers.

I'm not sure who or what it is I have to fight, but I doubt it's gonna be fair. The Pit Champion's got this big, powerful meat cutter on her back. Meanwhile they left me an iron sword so old it had mushrooms growing on it.

Maybe one of the other poor sods who've fought before me has something that isn't completely useless. If these pit fighters killed a soldier or two, I'm guessing they didn't bother cleaning up the mess. 

But seeing as this whole thing is rigged, I'm not sure winning will do me much good anyway.</font>
traduit:
<font face="$HandwrittenFont">
我不知道自己怎么被关到这里来的。但强盗们说我有两个选择。要么为自由而战，要么被卖给奴隶贩子。

我不知道要和什么东西斗争，但这东西公平么？那个深坑冠军扛着把巨大有力的切肉刀。然后他们丢给我一把发霉的破铁剑。

也许在我之前战斗过的倒霉蛋有什么还能用的东西。如果这些深坑角斗士杀过一两个看守，我猜他们也根本懒得收拾。

但这一切都是有人操纵，恐怕就算获胜我也没什么好处。</font>

original: Note from the Temple of Kynareth
traduit: 凯娜瑞丝神殿的纸条

original:
<font face="$HandwrittenFont">
To all adventurers,

I offer you Kynareth's favor, in exchange for your help. There is a gravely ill man in my care at the Temple of Kynareth. Storms of ataxia have weakened his bones, and I fear their heavy rains will wash his life away.

He requires a special soup made of the fruit of an Ironwood tree, charred skeever hide, and salt.

Unfortunately, the Ironwood trees, once a staple of Skyrim's forests, are all but extinct. Moreover, importing the fruit from orchards to the south has been difficult due to bandit raids and embargos from the war. Our first attempt at securing the ingredient was lost. As the man's fever progresses, I fear a second request will come far too late. 

I've heard from the ferrymen, however, that an Ironwood grows on an island to the north called Giant's Tooth, but duty bounds me to the temple. But if by chance the winds of Kynareth see fit to bring one to your shop, please deliver it to Whiterun as soon as you can. A man's life hangs in the balance.

Danica Pure-Spring
</font>
traduit:
<font face="$HandwrittenFont">
冒险者们：

The nights are long here. The frost nips at your scales. But I've always been stubborn. Thick-shelled, as they say. So I've stuck to it.

The first days were the hardest. I dared not try and fish, with the giants lurking. But hunger makes brave hatchlings of us all, so I dove in, and found the waters calm.

这里的夜很漫长。鳞片都能结上霜。但我就是这么固执。他们也说了，壳子厚。所以也就坚持下来了。

摆渡人说过铁木的树皮就像猛犸牙一样坚硬，此言不虚啊。我们只能等待收获那些小小果实了。</font>

<font face="$HandwrittenFont">
All right, here's the plan. Take the letter and seal it with the ring. Then put on this courier's clothes and deliver it.

Make sure you look and talk like a bloody courier. I'm sure you've gotten enough letters to know how they speak. And if it don't work the first time, wait an hour, think about what you're gonna say, and try again. When it comes to poor folk, the Elf's got the memory of a goldfish.

Anyways, the letter will say Inimoro's been stealing from his boss, and the seal will prove it's real. Once Cuinanthil reads the letter, he'll have the Dunmer arrested. He might even have him killed. Doesn't matter either way.

Knowing him, the next thing he'll do is go straight for his treasure, to count every last coin and make sure it's all there. 

Then we just follow that snotty little spear polisher as he leads us straight to the gold.

--E</font>
traduit:
<font face="$HandwrittenFont">
好了，计划是这样。把信拿去，用戒指封好。然后就穿上那个信使的衣服送出去。

你言行举止一定要像个信使。相信你也收到过信件，知道他们是怎么说话的。如果一次不成功，就等上一小时，琢磨琢磨该怎么说，然后再试一次。那个高精灵遇到穷人，记忆力就和金鱼一样。

不管怎样，信上会说印摩罗一直在偷他老板的东西，有印章为证。只要奎南希尔读了这封信，他就会叫人逮捕他的保镖。甚至可能当场杀了他。但都无所谓了。

以我对他的了解，接下来肯定会直接去核对他的财宝，数清每一枚金币。

然后就跟着那个鼻涕虫过去，让他直接带咱们找到黄金。

——E</font>

original:
<font face="$HandwrittenFont">
Don't be alarmed, but I've been following you. You might say I'm a fan of your work. But I also don't like doing business in person, so I slipped you this letter while you slept. Consider this job my apology for messing with your beauty rest.  

Don't worry, this ain't some small time caper. There's enough clink in it to fill both our cups, if you're game.

The mark's a fat, milk-drinking noble who just arrived in Markarth. He's got one of those fancy High Elf names, Cuinanthil. Don't try to pronounce it, you'll just give yourself a headache. 

Point is, he's so rich if you poke him he'll spit gems out his mouth. And I know for a fact he's stashed a large portion of his wealth in a vault somewhere in the Reach.

Problem is, you can't get anywhere near him with his Dark Elf bodyguard by his side at all times. But the sellsword's got one weakness - sujamma from his homeland. So here's what I need you to do:

First, take this vial and spike some sujamma at a cookpot, so the heat activates the poison. As for the sujamma itself, you can probably get a bottle on Solstheim, if none of the traders around here have it. A bit out of the way, but worth it. 

Once the sujamma's spiked, convince the innkeeper at the Silver-Blood Inn to sell it. When the two stop by the inn, the drink will turn the Dunmer's insides out, and keep him at the bar for a good long while.

Once the bodyguard's out of the way, you'll be free to pick the other one's pockets. Take whatever you like, but what I need is his personal ring seal, the one he uses for letters.

When you have the seal, go to the Warrens. I'll leave a note with further instructions outside the third door on your left.

-- E</font>
traduit:
<font face="$HandwrittenFont">
别惊讶，我一直在关注你。你的活计不错，我很中意。但我不喜欢当面谈生意，所以就趁你睡觉的时候把信塞给你了。这一票就算我打扰你美容觉的谢礼吧。

别担心，我没闹着玩。如果你愿意，这一票够咱俩分。

目标是个刚到马卡斯城的软蛋胖子贵族。高精灵，名字叫奎南希尔。不用读，自找烦恼。

关键是，他太有钱了，戳一下就能吐出宝石。而且我知道他把大部分财产都藏在瑞驰某地的保险库里。

问题是，他身边一直有个暗精灵保镖，根本无法靠近。但保镖有个弱点——来自他故乡的苏贾玛。所以，我需要你：

首先，拿着小瓶子，在锅里给苏贾玛加点料，让热量激活毒药。至于苏贾玛，如果附近的商人不卖的话，你可以去索瑟海姆买一瓶。虽然偏僻，但值得跑一趟。

等苏贾玛加了料，就说服银血旅店的老板把它卖掉。当他俩路过旅店时，那酒就会把丹莫弄得五迷三道，足可以让他在店里留很长时间了。

保镖走后，你就可以扒那家伙的口袋了。其他东西随你拿，我只要他私人写信用的戒指印章。

拿到印章，就去窝棚区。我会在你左边第三扇门外留了纸条，上面有进一步指示。

——E</font>

original:
<font face="$HandwrittenFont" size="20">
A hag handed me this cup, saying it would bring out the best and the worst in me. I wasn't sure about that part, but I do like shiny clink, so I took it off her hands.

Besides, I think this hag was half blind and fully empty in the head. This wasn't no cup. It looks more like a trophy to me.

So I got to thinking, being the idea guy that I am, if some pit dog goes through all the trouble of becoming champion, we should give them this cup, with a ceremony and a feast and such. Maybe even carve their name into it. Then I pitched my idea to the boss, thinking she'd love it. 

But instead she got real mad, stomped on my bunions, and made me scrub the privy for even entertaining the idea before taking the cup for herself.

Next thing I know, I'm down in the dungeon, washing a particularly foul smelling bucket, that it hits me again. In order to be the champion, you'd have to kill the boss first. It's no wonder she was so mad. 

I guess the old hag was right after all. Turned out it was the best and worst idea all at once.</font>
traduit:
<font face="$HandwrittenFont" size="20">
有个巫婆把杯子给了我，说它能激发我最好的一面和最坏的一面。这我不太确定，但我确实喜欢闪亮的东西，所以我拿走了。

再说，这老巫婆八成是半瞎半傻了。这哪是什么杯子，看着更像个奖杯。

作为一个有创意的人，我开始琢磨了，如果哪个深坑狗不费吹灰之力得了冠军，我们就把奖杯颁给他们，再办个仪式和宴会什么的。甚至可以把他们的名字刻上。然后我把想法告诉了老板，以为她会喜欢。

结果她生气了，踩了我的脚趾，让我去刷厕所，甚至在她自己把杯子拿走前都没考虑我的提议。

接下来，我就在地牢里，刷着一个特别难闻的桶，结果突然想起来。想成为冠军，就得杀了老大。难怪她那么生气。

看来老巫婆说得对。事实证明，这既是最好的主意，也是最坏的主意。</font>

original:
<font face="$HandwrittenFont">
So the other day me and the boys robbed this caravan full of monks. Real easy, except there wasn't any loot. But one monk, he was a squealing type. Put a knife to his throat and he sang like nirnroot.

The monk tells us there's a secret compartment in the carriage. We pop it open, and find the shiniest set of weapons and armor I ever laid my eyes upon. The kind you have to squint to look at it. 

When we got back to camp, first thing I did was try on a boot. Funny thing is, it didn't fit. I swear it was the right size, but Remy laughs and snatches it from me, saying some rubbish about how only real warriors can wear real armor.

Except jokes on him, they wouldn't fit him neither. Soon the whole crew is trying on the set, but no matter the piece, no matter the size, they can't keep it on. Some manage to get it on for a second, right up until the color goes out of their face.

And it ain't just the armor. You try and swing one of the weapons, and you feel sick to your stomach. Like the thing don't want you wielding it.

So we're all sitting by the campfire, out of ideas, when Orenn, the new blood, gets the idea to have their kin Eigorn try the armor on. Everyone laughs.

The kid ain't even one of the crew, just some green little bastard who decided to tag along for the raid. Like Orenn, they ain't even killed their first man yet. But lo and behold, the kid tries on a boot, and the damn thing fits.

"I guess Eigorn's part of the crew now," Orenn says, but the pup ain't having it. Turns out, they ain't wanna do the work! They don't even LIKE being a bandit. 

So I tell Orenn, either the kid fights with us, or I cut their throat. I'm about to do it, when Orenn, that bloody traitor, picks up the big shiny mace and nearly clobbers my head off. 

Luckily the rest of the crew was there to keep that mace from turning my skull to porridge. But that's when I get the idea to try the armor on Orenn. And by the Nine, it fits that bastard too.

Which brings us to where we are now. The two of them are following orders, sure, but I don't trust them one bit. It's not just about the armor. Orenn's been talking nonsense for a while now, saying we should let people go like they ain't bloody witnesses.

Remy pointed out that we just need them to wear the armor, and look all intimidating like. The crew will do the rest. But that ain't gonna cut it. I want to test them. If we get into a fight, I need to know the person standing next to me is willing to kill a man if they have to.

And if either of them refuse, we kill them both.</font>
traduit:
<font face="$HandwrittenFont">
有一天我和小的们抢了个满是僧侣的车队。容易倒是容易，就是没货。但有个僧侣挺会嚎。把刀顶在他喉咙上，他就唱得跟个奈恩根似的。

僧侣告诉我们车厢里有个秘密隔间。我们把它打开，就看见了这辈子见过最闪亮的武器盔甲。得眯着眼睛才能看得清。

我们回到营地，我第一件事就是试穿了一下那双靴子。有意思，不合适。大小肯定是合脚的，但雷米笑着从我手里抢走了它，说了通什么好马配好鞍的废话。

结果除了笑话同样适合他以外，也没什么适合他的部件。很快全帮人都在试穿，但不管是什么部件，不管什么尺寸，大家都不能一直穿戴。有人成功戴上一秒钟，然后脸上的喜色还没来得及出现就消失了。

不仅仅是盔甲。想要挥动武器，只能感到恶心，好像那东西不打算让你用一样。

所以我们都坐在营火旁，一点主意没有。最后新来的奥伦说出让他亲戚艾格伦试试的想法。所有人都乐了。

这小子根本不是帮里的一员，只是打算入伙跟我们一起去抢劫的混蛋菜鸟。和奥伦一样，他们还连个投名状都没拿到呢。但瞧瞧，这小子怎么他妈的和这鞋子这么合适。

“我想艾格伦现在是咱们的一员了。”奥伦这么说，但那狗崽子不接受。结果，他们连活儿都不想干！他们甚至不喜欢当强盗。

所以我就告诉奥伦，你们俩小子要么跟我们混，要么我就把你们喉咙割断。就在我准备动手的时候，那个该死的小叛徒奥伦，拿起那根又大又亮的锤子，差点把我头给敲掉了。

好在其他弟兄都在，没让钉锤把我脑袋敲成稀粥。但就在那时，我有了给奥伦穿上盔甲的想法。九圣灵在上，这混蛋居然也合适。

这就把我们带到现在这个境地了。他俩是服从命令，但我一点不信任他们。这不光是盔甲的问题。这段时间奥伦一直在胡言乱语，说我们应该放了这些人，就像他们不是目击者一样。

雷米说我们只要让他们穿着盔甲，看着够唬人就行。剩下的让帮里兄弟去办就行。但这还不够。我得测试清楚。万一我们要去打架，我必须知道站在我身边的人能不能在必要的时候愿意杀人。

如果他们拒绝，我们就得宰了他俩。</font>

utnumbered and isolated, I yielded to my foe. The creature dressed like a gentleman, and I hoped for honorable treatment. Instead, I found myself a feast for a blood-drinking monster. Shamed by my corruption, and despairing of my own welfare, I passively acquiesced in my gradual integration into the affairs of Clan Aundae. I made no human my prey, only beasts, and kept myself apart from the other clankin; nonetheless, I abandoned hope and lived like a beast. Drawn by intimations of my former life, I visited my former post at Bal Ur, hoping perhaps to atone in some for my crimes by preying upon its monsters, or perishing under their attacks. It is there that, by chance, I made petition to the Lord of Troubles, Molag Bal, at an altar deep in the caverns beneath the pilgrim's shrine. I was surprised, and thrilled, and terrified, when Molag Bal, or some aspect or agent of that Daedra Lord, offered me a chance to cure myself of vampirism, in return for a favor. 寡不敌众、孤立无援，我向敌人屈服了。那家伙打扮得像个绅士，本以为能得到体面的招待。没想到，却是把自己带入了一个吸血怪物的盛宴。 我对自己的堕落感到羞愧，对自己的幸福感到绝望。我被动地默许了自己逐渐融入奥恩戴氏族的事务。我不去捉人，只抓野兽，把自己与其他氏族成员隔离开。尽管如此，我还是放弃了希望，像野兽一般生活。 受过往生活的启发，我回到了在巴尔·乌尔的旧居，希望通过捕食那里的怪物来弥补我的罪行，或者在它们的攻击下死去。就在那里，偶然的机会，在朝圣者神殿下方洞穴深处的一个祭坛上，我向动乱之主莫拉格·巴尔祈祷了。莫拉格·巴尔或者那位迪德拉君主的某个化身或代理者，给了我一个治愈吸血鬼病的机会作为回报，我感到惊讶、兴奋且害怕。然而，若我的魂灵得不到痊愈，就没有任何希望，我接受了他的任务。 从达 斯·乌尔 坡颗 神 的 咒 石 并 送 巴尔·乌尔的莫 ·巴尔 祭坛。 我把宝石放在祭坛前的盆子里，立刻感受到一种无法用语言表达的痛苦和恐惧，事后我仿佛睡着了，梦见自己被成千上万把小刀从肠子中切出来。我在祭坛前醒来，凝视着剑刃上自己的倒影，看着自己的脸——不再是那个长满尖牙、眼睛空洞的嗜血怪物。

original:
<font face="$HandwrittenFont">Azarain once told me I was the strongest warrior in all of Tamriel. But that is a lie.

A strong man would have ended his life long ago. He would have delivered Stendarr's justice upon his soul. I am weak man, and so, I live.

The Vigil teaches us that vampires are an abomination, to be destroyed without mercy. But in my cowardice I began to entertain the blasphemous, that vampirism had a cure. 

Never has the subject been broached by the Keepers. After all, the very idea that these creatures were capable of salvation would threaten the principles of the order. So to learn more, I sought the aid of the very monster I have sworn to oppose. 

Molag Bal's price was steep. I was to gather thralls and build an altar deep in the mines of Dawnstar, for purposes that would only become clearer as the nights went on. To that shrine I was to sacrifice the lives of nine of my brothers and sisters, one for each divine. 

At times my resolve has wavered, but the Prince has offered proof in the form of Galur Rithari. His excerpts prove that a cure exists, through a dream of being "sliced by thousands of tiny knives from my bowels inside out." As the town speaks of nightmares and the presence of Vaermina, I now see why Dawnstar was chosen for this unholy vigil.

With only three sacrifices left, the ritual is almost complete. No doubt Azarain will see this as treachery, which is why I cannot bring myself to sacrifice him. But with every Vigil that dies at our hand, it only calcifies my resolve. The weakness of my mind does not betray the strength of my will.

For all my cowardice, I am worth the souls of a dozen men. If I rejoin the Vigil, more lives will be saved in the end. 

Perhaps when the accounting is done, Stendarr will show me mercy. </font>
traduit:
<font face="$HandwrittenFont">阿扎兰以前夸我是泰姆瑞尔最强大的战士。但这是谎言。

强者会毫不犹豫终结自己的生命，把灵魂献给斯丹达尔的正义。但我是个懦夫，所以我还活着。

警戒者教导我们，吸血鬼是可憎之物，要毫不留情地消灭。但我怯懦地接受了亵渎神明的说法，觉得吸血鬼是可以治愈的。

守护者们从未提及这个话题。毕竟，能够拯救这些生物的想法会威胁到教团的原则。为了了解更多，我只能向曾经发誓对抗的怪物寻求帮助。

莫拉格·巴尔开出的价码太高昂了。我需要召集奴仆，在晨星矿场深处建造祭坛，随着夜晚流逝，我的目的越发清晰。我需要把九个兄弟姐妹的生命献给祭坛，每个圣灵对应一个。

有时我的决心也会动摇，但君王又举出加卢尔·里萨里的例子来佐证。加卢尔的文章记录了治疗方法的存在，通过一个“被成千上万把小刀从肠子中切出来”的梦。当镇上都在谈论噩梦和瓦尔迷纳的时候，我明白为什么晨星会被选为不洁警戒者的根据地了。

只剩三个祭品，仪式就完成了。阿扎兰无疑会把这视为背叛，所以我不能牺牲他。但每有一个警戒者死在我们手上，都会动摇我的决心。我意志的强大和思想的怯懦不能相抵。

可尽管我很懦弱，但我存在的意义远超那十几个灵魂。等我重新加入警戒者，会有更多生命因我得救。

也许等这契约结束后，斯丹达尔垂慈于我的。</font>

original:
<font face="$HandwrittenFont">The investigation has moved slowly, but that was to be expected. The townsfolk have their own problems, and few pay any mind to the fate of Stendarr's chosen. I will write what I've pieced together so far, in hopes it provides some clarity.

From what I've gathered, Fenrik came to Dawnstar to investigate rumors of Daedra worship. There was some thought that this cult was the source of the town's recurring nightmares, although it's unclear how much of that is true. Then one night, Fenrik disappeared, without a word to the innkeeper or anyone in town. It was then that other patrols started to go missing, also without a trace.

Of leads I have one. The other day the innkeeper found something curious behind the inn, in the midst of emptying the trash. It was an Elven dagger, its blade warm with blood and upon further examination, tipped with poison.

The craft of the blade can mean many things. Perhaps this Daedric cult is Elven in origin. Moreover, Elven weapons are fashioned from Quicksilver, and there is a mine in close proximity. The poison too could have originated from a nearby source. It's also likely that our murderer moves at night, when the eyes of the town are blind to their heathen worship.

As such, I suspect three individuals as possible owners of the blade. Vereth the Elf, who complains of the cold and yet seems resolute in staying. Harald the miner, who works the ore from which the murder weapon was fashioned. Lastly, Irine the traveler, who seems to know more about alchemy than the proprietors of the Pestle.

All three seem to be active in the small hours, but I can only follow one at a time. Still, doing so will prove useful, as they will either lead me to their place of worship or eliminate themselves as suspects.

But first, I must meet the writer of this note. Perhaps they know more about the dagger, or have information that can narrow down my search.</font>
traduit:
<font face="$HandwrittenFont">调查的进度十分缓慢，但也在意料中。镇民都有自己的事要忙，很少有人关心斯丹达尔所选之人的命运。先把目前找到的线索拼凑起来记下，希望能找到清晰的信息。

据我所知，芬里克来晨星城是为了调查迪德拉邪教的传闻。有人认为那个邪教就是镇上反复出现噩梦的来源，只是目前还不清楚真伪。有天晚上，芬里克没有和旅店老板或镇上人打招呼，就失踪不见了。就是在那之后，其他巡逻队也开始失踪，没有留下任何痕迹。

有一条线索。旅店老板有天在倒垃圾的时候，发现旅店后面有些奇怪的东西。一把精灵匕首，上面沾着温热的血，仔细一看，上面还有毒药。

刀的工艺意味着很多信息。或许这个迪德拉邪教起源于精灵。此外，精灵武器是水银打造，附近就有一个矿场。毒药也可能来自附近。凶手很可能在晚上行动，以此躲过镇民对他们邪教崇拜的关注。

因此我怀疑有三个人可能是这把刀的主人。精灵维瑞斯，他一直抱怨寒冷，却坚持留下。矿工哈拉尔德，他开采的矿石就是制造凶器的原料。最后就是旅行者艾利涅，她似乎比钵与杵的店主还懂炼金术。

这三个人似乎在凌晨都很活跃，但我一次只能跟踪一个。尽管如此，这样做还是有用的，要么他们会把我带到礼拜场所，要么就可以打消嫌疑。

但首先，我得去见见写信的人。也许他们知道更多关于匕首的事，或许能缩小我的搜索范围。</font>

original:
<font face="$HandwrittenFont">
Orthrus,

The new route you suggested may help us avoid the pirates, but not the storms. The Sea Stallion now lies at the bottom of Pilgrim's Trench, and its cargo along with it.  If I ever find that charlatan of a priest we paid to bless the ships, I'm going to rip the amulet of Kynareth off his neck and strangle him with it.

Anyways, if you know any divers looking for a challenge, I've enclosed a potion of waterbreathing and some scrolls with this letter. It won't do anything about the slaughterfish, but at least it'll help you hold your breath.</font>
traduit:
<font face="$HandwrittenFont">
欧特鲁斯：

你建议的路线虽然能帮我们避开海盗，却避不开风暴。海种马号连同货物一起现在沉到了朝圣者海沟底部了。如果我能找到那个雇来给船祈福的二五眼祭司，我就把凯娜瑞丝的护符从他脖子上扯下来然后勒死他。

无论如何，如果你认识愿意挑战一番的潜水员，我随信附上一瓶水下呼吸药水喝一些卷轴。虽然对付不了食人鱼，好歹能帮他憋住气。</font>

original: 1st of Sun's Dawn, 4E 201 Master Ellane said the Staff of Chaos was crafted by Loreth, and passed on through the generations until it was stolen by Jagar Tharn, before being shattered into pieces by the Eternal Champion. While the pieces may be lost forever, they say centuries later, a descendant of Loreth sought to recreate their magic. The results were the Arms of Chaos, magical staves that harnessed the power of the Sun and the Moon. Yet one day, the mage dismantled the staves and left them lifeless, convinced they were possessed by some unknown madness. It was my master's obsession to restore these artifacts, and in her honor, it has become mine. If only I could speak to her, I would know what to do next. 17th of Rain's Hand, 4E 201 Leave it to my late master to provide guidance on how to proceed. Going through her effects, I found a sketch of the necklace she often wore. It's identical in all ways but one - there's an orb set in the center of the amulet, teeming with fire. If it's true that Loreth's magic allowed one to travel to distant worlds, then it's possible this orb is a Sigil Stone! If my hunch is right, the staves are missing the same. 22nd of Rain's Hand, 4E 201 My spirit renewed, I scoured the archives in Winterhold and found my path forward. I must find a way to summon three Daedra, Guardians of the Sigil Stones. There's an altar on the eastern shore of Skytemple Ruins, bearing a Daedric mark. It may be what I need. 28th of Rain's Hand, 4E 201 I've hit a snag. The ring used to activate the summoning circle was buried with my late master, which I foolishly had shipped to her ancestral home. To think she even gifted me the ring, and I mistook it for sentiment! I feel thicker than Netch Jelly. Still, complaining won't undo my mistake. The name of the ship was the Sea Stallion, I wonder if I can catch it before it departs. 2nd of Last Seed, 4E 201 The courier has yet to return. I'm beginning to fear the worst; that the ship had already left the dock long before my letter arrived. I'm not sure what to do at this point. I haven't had much sleep, and my mind is starting to hear creaking noises where nothing exists. I wish my master were here still, so I could seek her wisdom. They say there is a Shrine of Akray at the pass to the south. Come morning, I will visit it and pray for an answer.
traduit: 4E201年，日晓月1日 埃兰大师说混沌之杖由洛瑞斯创造，代代相传，直至被贾伽·萨恩偷走，最后又被永恒勇士粉碎。 虽然那些碎片永远遗失了，但据说几百年后，有洛瑞斯的后裔试图重现它们的魔力。结果造就了混沌武器，一种能够利用太阳与月亮力量的法杖。然而有一天，法师拆毁了这些法杖，将之毁灭，因为他确信这些武器沾染了某种未知的疯狂。 修复这些神器是我老师的夙愿，为了她的荣耀，我接过了这个使命。但要是我能和她谈谈就好了，我不知道下一步该怎么办。 4E201年，雨手月17日 还是让我已故的老师来指导我吧。在翻找她的遗物时，我发现了她时常佩戴的项链的草图。其他方面且不去说，但护符的中间有个充满火焰的球体。如果洛瑞斯的魔法真的能让人穿越诸界，那这个球很可能是个印记石！如果我猜的没错，那些法杖也同样缺少印记石。 4E201年，雨手月22日 我现在精神焕发，查找了冬堡的所有档案，找到了前进的方向。我必须想办法召唤三个守护印记石的迪德拉。天庙遗迹东侧有一个祭坛，上面有迪德拉标志。也许正是我想要的。 4E201年，雨手月28日 遇到障碍了。用来激活召唤圆阵的戒指和先师一起下葬了，还是我傻乎乎地把它送回了她的祖屋。想想看，她都已经把戒指送给我了，我却以为是单纯的师生情谊！我可真是比气母胶还迟钝。 不过抱怨弥补不了错误。船的名字叫“海种马”，不知道能否在它出发前赶上。 4E201年，末种月2日 信使还没有回来，应该是最坏情况了，在我的信到达前，船就离开码头了。不知道现在该怎么办了。有些失眠，脑子也有点幻听。 真希望老师还活着，这样就能向她请教智慧了。他们说南边的隘口有个阿尔凯祭坛。明天早上我要去拜访一下，祈祷得到答案。

original:
<font face='$HandwrittenFont'>
If you're reading this, it means I'm dead, a fate I'm sure brings a smile to your face, if you're standing on your head anyway. Otherwise it would just be a frown, and we can't have that. That would be far too predictable.

For who doesn't appreciate a little chaos? Maybe I'll finish this sentence by saying flying horker loaf. Hopefully now your frowns are facing the right direction.

After all, neither rhyme nor reason has a home here. Fire is water, up is down, right is wrong. Death is life. 

And so like Dalak to Loreth before me, I speak to you now, dear apprentice, from inside this box. A wise sage might caution you to be careful when you follow my path, lest you end up in the same place. 

But I have never claimed to be wise. To me, death is yet another adventure, another possibility to explore. The same should be true of your life.</font>
traduit:
<font face='$HandwrittenFont'>
如果你读到这封信，说明我已经死了，相信同样的命运降临时，你的脸上会露出笑容，前提是你在倒立。否则只会是愁眉苦脸，但我们就不提了，因为太好猜了。

试问谁不喜欢一点小小的混沌呢？也许我应该用飞起的海象肉排来结束这段话。希望你的眉头能朝向正确的方向。

毕竟无论韵脚还是理性，在此都没有立足之地。火就是水，上就是下，对就是错，死就是生。

亲爱的学徒，就像当年达拉克告诫洛瑞斯那样，我现在也躺在盒子里和你对话。贤者可能会告诫你，走上他的老路一定要当心，不要重蹈他的覆辙。

但我从来不说自己是什么贤者智者。对我来说，死亡不过是另一种冒险，另一种探索的可能性。你的人生也该如此。</font>

original:
Survival Mode adds new gameplay features and challenges to transform Skyrim into a land of unrelenting cold and harsh wilderness.

To enable Survival, open the Pause Menu, select "Settings", "Gameplay", and check "Survival Mode". Survival can be enabled using any difficulty setting. For maximum challenge, use Survival with "Master" or "Legendary" difficulty.

Survival: Basics

Staying Healthy
You'll need to pay attention to your overall wellness by staying properly fed, rested and warm. See "Survival: Hunger, Food & Fatigue" and "Survival: Cold, Warmth & Freezing Water" for more details.

Fast Travel
Fast Travel is disabled. If you wish to go somewhere, you must do so on foot. You can also take a carriage or boat to your destination, but note that you may arrive hungry, cold, and in need of rest after a long journey.

Health Regeneration
You no longer regenerate health. You must use restorative spells, food, and potions to replenish your health.

Leveling Up
To level up, you must now sleep in a bed. You may still spend your perk points later once they have been granted after sleeping.

Inventory Management
You're able to carry far fewer items. See the "Survival: Items" entry for more details.

Survival: Hunger, Food & Fatigue

Hunger
Over time, you will become hungry, which will impact your total stamina, as well as your ability to wield most weapons. As you become hungrier, your total available stamina will decrease, represented by a dark region inside the stamina bar. Eat food to restore your hunger. If you eat enough, you will receive the Well Fed bonus. In Survival, if you eat raw meat, you may contract Food Poisoning, which can prevent you from receiving health benefits from food until the effect wears off.

Food
In general, cooked food restores far more hunger than uncooked food. Make sure to prepare a few meals before heading out on your next adventure. Hot soups can now be cooked by using fire salts, which restore your cold and also grant a bonus to your warmth rating.

Fatigue
Even the most stalwart adventurers will need to rest from time to time. Fatigue decreases your total available magicka, represented by a dark region inside the magicka bar. As you become more fatigued, the effectiveness of potions will begin to decline, and your ability to recover magicka and stamina will begin to suffer. You will need to periodically sleep in a bed in order to restore your fatigue. In Survival, the Well Rested bonus is no longer granted automatically after sleeping. If you sleep outside, you will not be able to get a restful night's sleep, waking up Drained at best. If you sleep in a bed indoors, you will receive the Well Rested bonus.

Survival: Cold, Warmth & Freezing Water

Cold
The frigid chill of Skyrim is now a formidable foe unto itself. Traveling in snowy or rainy areas will increase your Cold. Cold decreases your total available health, represented as a dark region inside the health bar. As you become colder, your movement speed and ability to pick locks and pick pockets will begin to suffer. If you reach the highest level of Cold, your health will be reduced to 0 and you will die from exposure to the elements. You can warm up by standing near a fire, eating hot soup, or moving to a warmer location. A sun or snowflake icon will appear near the compass to note whether you are currently getting warmer or colder.

Warmth
The higher your warmth rating, the more slowly you will feel the effects of cold environments. Most clothing and armor provide warmth, displayed on the item's description. Some armor is exceptionally warm, while others are ill-suited to protect their wearer from harsh climates. You can also temporarily increase your warmth rating by eating hot soup or holding a torch.

Freezing Water
Taking a swim in an ice cold river can make for a quick death. If you swim in a freezing area, you will immediately become colder and begin taking health damage. Exit the water as soon as possible in order to begin warming up and stop the loss of health. Using a Flame Cloak spell or the Dunmer Ancestor's Wrath ability can make you temporarily immune to the effects of freezing water.

Survival: Disease & Affliction

Disease
Creatures across the land now carry threatening new diseases, and previous diseases are now even more debilitating. Eating uncooked meat can now cause Food Poisoning. If you fail to cure a disease, it may progress into a more serious version over time.

Affliction
Time spent while unwell puts you at risk of contracting an affliction, which cause effects that can linger long after you have improved your condition. Afflictions cannot be cured directly, but will wear off over time.

Afflictions
Weakened: You are less effective at using melee weapons and blocking damage with your shield.
Addled: Magicka and stamina regenerate more slowly.
Frostbitten: You are less effective at picking locks, picking pockets, and doing damage with a bow.

Shrines
Shrines no longer cure diseases for free; you must now make a gold offering in order to receive the shrine's benefits. Shrines you craft in a house you have built can be used for free.

Survival: Items

Carry Weight
In Survival, your carry weight has been significantly reduced. Becoming overencumbered also quickly drains your stamina and causes you to become fatigued much faster. Arrows and lockpicks now have weight.

Perks & Standing Stones
The Extra Pockets perk and The Steed Stone now grant 50 extra carry weight, instead of 100.

Survival: Vampires & Werewolves

Both vampires and werewolves can restore their hunger by feeding on their victims. While transformed into a Werewolf or Vampire Lord, you are immune to reduced health from cold, and you will become colder much slower than normal.

生存模式添加了新的游戏功能与挑战，将天际变成了无情的寒冬与严酷的荒野。

要启用生存模式，请打开暂停菜单，选择“设置”-“游戏玩法”，并勾选“生存模式”。生存模式可以在任意难度下进行。为了获得最大挑战，可以使用“大师”或“传奇”难度进行生存模式游戏。

生存：基础

保持健康
你需要注意身体的整体健康，保持适当的饮食、休息与保暖。详见“生存：饥饿、食物与疲劳”和“生存：寒冷、保暖与冰水”

快速旅行
快速旅行已被禁用。如果你想去某个地方，就必须步行前去。你也可以乘坐马车或者船只抵达目的地，但要注意，你可能会因长途旅行而饥寒交迫，需要休息。

生命恢复
你不再恢复生命值。必须使用恢复系法术、食物和药水来补充生命值。

升级
为了升级，你必须上床睡觉。睡眠后获得额外能力点数时，仍然可以过后再使用。

库存管理
你可以携带的物品变少。详见“生存：物品”条目。

生存：饥饿、食物与疲劳

饥饿
随着时间推移，你会感到饥饿，这会导致你耐力上限降低，在耐力条上会出现一块黑暗区域。饥饿还会影响你使用武器攻击的速度。吃东西可以缓解饥饿感。如果你吃的东西够多，会得到“酒足饭饱”奖励。在生存模式中，生吃肉类可能导致食物中毒，导致无法从食物中获得生命增益，直至效果结束。

食物
一般来说，吃熟食比吃生食更能缓解饥饿感。在你下次出门冒险前，一定要准备几顿饭。热汤现在可以用火盐加热，可以恢复你的寒冷，也能提升你的温暖等级。

疲劳
即使是最坚定的冒险家也需要不时休息一下。疲劳会导致你魔力上限降低，在魔力条上会出现一块黑暗区域。疲劳还会影响你恢复魔力和耐力的速度，以及使用药剂的效果。你需要定期睡在床上来缓解疲劳。“充分休息”的奖励不再在睡觉后自动获得。如果你睡在室外，将无法得到宁静的睡眠，即使醒来也会“筋疲力尽”。如果你睡在室内的床上，你会得到“充分休息”的奖励。

生存：寒冷、温暖与冰水

寒冷
天际的寒冷是个可怕的敌人。在多雨雪的地区旅行会加重寒冷。寒冷会导致你的生命上限降低，在生命条中会显示一块黑暗区域。当你变得寒冷，移动速度与开锁、扒窃能力都会受到影响。等你的寒冷等级达到最高，生命值将归零，死于严寒。你可以通过站在火堆附近、喝热汤或者转移到温暖地区来取暖。指南针附近会有一个太阳与雪花的图标，提示你现在是暖是冷。

温暖
你的温暖等级越高，受寒冷环境影响的速度就越慢。大多数衣服与护甲都有保暖功能，在物品描述中会显示。有些护甲保暖效果更好，而有一些则难以保护穿戴者免受恶劣环境影响。你还可以通过喝热汤或者拿火把来暂时提高你的温暖等级。

冰水
在冰水里游泳可能会让你死得更快。如果你在寒冷地区游泳，会立即变冷，并开始受到健康损害。为了保暖和阻止健康损害，要尽快离水。使用火焰斗篷或者丹莫的先祖之怒能使你暂时免疫冰水的效果。

生存：疾病与疼痛

疾病
这片土地上的生物现在携带着威胁人类的新疾病，而以前的疾病现在会使人更加衰弱。吃生肉会导致食物中毒。如果你不治愈疾病，它可能会随时间推移发展为更严重的疾病。

疼痛
身体不适的时间会让你有感染疾病的风险，这种影响会在你病情好转后很长一段时间内持续存在。疼痛不能直接治愈，但会随着时间推移而消退。

疼痛种类
虚弱：近战武器和盾牌的效果降低。
头昏脑涨：魔力与耐力恢复减慢。
冻伤：开锁、扒窃与弓箭效果降低。

祭坛
祭坛不再免费治疗疾病，你必须献上金币才能得到祭坛的增益。在你建造的房子里制作的祭坛可以免费使用。

生存：物品

负重
在生存模式中，你的负重大大减少。过度负担还会迅速消耗你的耐力，使你更快感到疲劳。箭与开锁器现在也有重量。

额外能力与立石
额外口袋与骏马立石现在给予50点负重加成，而非100点。

生存：吸血鬼与狼人

吸血鬼与狼人都能以猎物为食来缓解饥饿。当你变身狼人或吸血鬼领主时，你的生命值不会因寒冷而降低，变冷的速度也会比平时慢得多。

traduit: 娜拉的日记

original:
<font face="$HandwrittenFont">My old master was a collector of things. Skeletons, staves, and priceless artifacts. The most prized of which were the helm and staff of Mannimarco himself, the King of Worms.

The old master was also a collector of apprentices, which in our trade are even more dangerous than the artifacts. He was aware of my ambition, and where it would end. He knew I would steal his artifacts and kill anyone who stood in my way, himself included.  

So like any good necromancer would do, he made sure his trap would ensnare me even beyond the grave.

The doors are blocked by some kind of invisible ward, but there must be a way to remove it. The master was nothing if not circumspect, and he would've left himself an out were he to fall victim to his own trap.

In fact, I think he aimed to make a game of it. His final words to me were, "start with the map."

I've tried to make sense of the clue, and have made some progress. The flags seem to represent the torches. I just have to remove the right ones.</font>
traduit:
<font face="$HandwrittenFont">我的老师是个收藏家。骷髅、法杖和无价神器应有尽有。其中最珍贵的就是蠕虫之王曼尼马克的头盔和法杖。

老师还会收集学徒，这在我们这行比收集神器还要危险。他知道我的野心，以及野心的终点。他知道我会偷走他的藏品，杀掉所有挡路的人，包括他在内。

就像所有优秀的死灵法师所做的那样，他确保了自己的陷阱即便在他死后依然能诱捕我。

门被某种无形结界挡住了，但一定有解除的办法。老师一向谨慎，如果他自己落入自己的圈套，一定有办法出来。

事实上，我觉得他的目标是把这当成一种游戏。他跟我说的最后一句话是：“先从地图开始。”

我试着解读线索，取得了一些进展。这些旗子似乎代表着火把，只要取出正确的就行。</font>

original: Arch Necromancer's First Clue
traduit: 大死灵法师的第一线索

original:
<font face="$HandwrittenFont">
A mage travels Skyrim, snuffing out the souls of its people along the way. In each place they collect a torch, to represent the light of the dead.

Their journey starts by traveling west, to Morthal. From there, they cross the plains south, to Falkreath, and make use of the alchemist's table.

Next they travel northeast, past the river, and stopped at the Nightgate Inn, where they cooked themselves a meal before snuffing the light there.

Finally, they head north to Fort Dunstad, where their journey ends.

Only when they had gathered the light of four souls did they receive the blessing from the King of Worms. 

Trace their path and let the way forward fall.</font>
traduit:
<font face="$HandwrittenFont">
一个法师游历天际，扼杀途中遇到的灵魂。每到一个地方，他们就收集一个象征死者之光的火把。

他们从西出发前往莫萨尔。又穿过平原向南，来到佛克瑞斯，借用炼金术士的桌子。

紧跟着又出发往东北而去，过了河在夜扉旅店停下，打尖住店。

最后，他们向北来到丹斯塔德堡，结束了旅行。

只有他们聚齐四团灵魂之光，才能获得蠕虫之王的祝福。

追寻他们的路，才能让前路打开。</font>

<font face="$HandwrittenFont">
While most necromancers, myself included, prefer to use whole corpses and skeletons, sometimes such supplies are not readily available. The Bone Forge offers an alternative - an altar upon which you may place raw supplies and forge them whole again.
 
The basic recipe to create a skeleton suitable for most menial tasks is as follows:

One bowl of bone meal
One greater soul gem, filled

Once you place the materials on the Bone Forge, simply lay your hands on it and your skeleton will appear before you. The Bone Forge can only sustain a single creation at a time, but it will remain with you until destroyed.

I have found that adding frost salts will create a Boneman - a type of undead not normally found outside of the Soul Cairn. They are sturdier than the average skeleton and make for a good companion to assist in the gathering of, well, supplies.</font>

original: Helm of Oreyn Bearclaw
traduit: “熊爪”奥瑞恩之盔

original:
<font face="$HandwrittenFont">I should have known better than to trust an apprentice to locate the Bloodworm Helm. I described its features, thinking that would be enough. A trollbone skull with an open maw. A necromancer's crown.

This skull clearly belongs to a bear. Never mind the enchantments placed upon it are for a warrior. Still, it seems my apprentices have stumbled upon a find nonetheless. The helm is that of Oreyn Bearclaw, the fabled warrior of the Wood Elves.

Perhaps I will raise a Bosmer, give him the helm, and have him perform the slaying of the witch-serpent Glenhwyfaunva for my amusement.

As for the artifacts of Mannimarco, I will have to redouble my search efforts. Perhaps this new girl, Naara, will have better luck finding them. She is green, but ambitious.</font>
traduit:
<font face="$HandwrittenFont">我早该知道不该让学徒去找血蠕虫之盔。我以为把特征描述了就足够了。一个长着嘴巴的巨魔头骨。死灵法师的王冠。

这明显是个熊头骨么。别管上面有什么附魔，那也是给战士用的。尽管如此，我的学徒们似乎还是有些意外收获。这顶头盔属于“熊爪”奥瑞恩，木精灵的传说战士。

也许我可以复活一个波斯莫，让他戴上头盔，让他给我表演杀死巫毒蛇格伦威法恩瓦的戏码，让我高兴一下。

至于曼尼马克的神器，我得继续加倍努力搜索。也许新来的那个叫娜拉的姑娘运气会更好呢。虽然她没什么经验，但很有野心。</font>

original:
<font face="$HandwrittenFont">
In my dream, I am surrounded by my four apprentices, but they are no longer mortal, but spirits, their souls taking the form of greater gems.

To bring them to darkness, one must place them on the Altar of the Revenant, and turn greater to black. Only then will you be free.</font>
traduit:
<font face="$HandwrittenFont">
在我的梦里，我被四个爱徒围着，但他们不再是凡人，而是精魂，他们的灵魂会以大型宝石的形式存在。

想要带他们进入黑暗，就必须把他们放在亡魂祭坛上，变大，变黑。只有那时，你才能获得自由。</font>

<font face='$HandwrittenFont'><font size='18'>With spring comes pollen, mold, and the specter of disease. The Dwemer knew this as well, and took steps to counter it.

只要把一只蜂蝇扔向空中，这些微型金属昆虫就会向你四周吹气，让你抵抗毒素、提高耐力。另外，它们还会让你少一点打退堂鼓的理由。

original: Spring greeted me with a splash of color, as beautiful flowers grew everywhere. And I do mean everywhere dear reader, as they were wild and hostile, covering the floors and even a few unfortunate corpses. This horrific sight of beauty was soon ruined by the choking air. Thick, toxic pollen floated everywhere, spewed out by the various flowers. Perhaps the dwemer had allergies to surface flora, and saw Spring as nothing more than a season of suffering. While the mercenaries coughed and vomited from the effects, my strong constitution allowed me to notice strange spriggans shambling through the artificial forests. Where they passed, the buds receded, and the air was clean and breathable. Were these the tenders of the gardens, or just a consequence of its existence? Regardless, I endeavored to follow the path of the spriggans, leading me deeper into the ruins.
traduit: 春季以一片色彩迎接了我，到处都是美丽的花朵。我说的是到处，亲爱的读者，这些花狂野且充满敌意，覆盖了地板，甚至还能看到几具倒霉蛋的尸体。这可怕的美景很快就被令人窒息的空气毁掉了。各种花朵喷出浓厚的毒花粉，飘得到处都是。也许矮人对地表的植物过敏，把春天看做了痛苦的季节。雇佣兵们都因为花粉而咳嗽呕吐，我体格还算强壮，注意到有奇怪的木灵在人造森林中蹒跚而过。它们所经之处，花蕾凋谢，空气清新，变得可以呼吸了。这是花园的温柔，还是刻意设计的结果？不管怎样，我还是努力沿着木灵经过的道路走了下去，进入了遗迹深处。

original: Log of Elberon the Great, Vol 4
traduit: 伟大艾尔贝隆的日志·卷4

original: As I trundled into the halls of Autumn, a marvelous sight unfolded. Before me lay an enormous stretch of farmland, decrepit and overgrown, but a farm nevertheless. Strange fruits and grains grew in plots, while emaciated chickens ran about all the while tended by massive double-bladed centurions. Did the dwemer find it amusing that the surface-peoples had a whole season dedicated just to harvest, or did they do this as a mockery to some forgotten god of the feast? Whatever the case, I aimed to sample a piece of dwarven produce myself. Though the fruit smelled delicious, it was as hard as a rock, and the insides glowed with a foul light. Yet as dense as the harvest was, I observed the bladed centurions cutting through it with little effort and carrying them off to a hopper at the far end of the fields. While no doubt the blades of these machines would make short work of flesh and armor, my men nevertheless valiantly served as a distraction as I carried the heavy wheat over to the depository, hoping that these offerings would satiate whatever freakish endeavors the dwarves had begun, and gain me access to the rest of the farms.
traduit: 当我走进秋季大厅时，一番奇妙的景象展现在眼前。在我面前的是一大片农田，尽管破败不堪又杂草丛生，但仍然是片农田。地上长着陌生的水果与谷物，瘦弱的鸡跑来跑去，所有这一切都由巨大的双刃百夫长照料。锻莫是觉得地表人用整整一个季度专门用来收获很有意思，或是他们这么做是为了嘲笑某个被遗忘的盛宴之神呢？不管怎样，我要亲自检查一下这里的矮人小麦。 庄稼发着刺眼的光芒，谷物硬得跟石头一样。尽管小麦长势很密，我发现那带着刀刃的百夫长仍然能毫不费力地穿行而过，把小麦带到入口附近的一个存放处。这些机械的刀刃无疑能轻易切开血肉和盔甲。当我逃跑时，我的手下仍然勇敢地去分散它们的注意力了。也许如果我有更多时间或人手，就能把这些沉重的小麦搬到仓库去，满足矮人们的怪异努力。

original: Log of Elberon the Great, Vol 3
traduit: 伟大艾尔贝隆的日志·卷3

original: Summer was a maze of tunnels and pipes, and no doubt centuries of neglect had left the place in a state of pure haywire. Lava spewed from every stone orifice I could see, and unbearable heat made for a precarious journey, and many of the lesser mercenaries turned back to cooler times. But the dwemer had predicted such superheat, indeed no doubt this unbearable weather was what summer meant to them. Even as I pulled myself through the swelter, I noticed repair spiders darting to and fro, ignoring me and heading into side sections, which revealed great levers. Flipping them released some sort of magical coolant, reducing the heat from impossible to merely annoying. Perhaps if enough of these spiders were directed to overheated sections and enough coolant levers flipped, I thought, I could find out what secrets this section of summer beheld.
traduit: 夏季大厅是一座隧道和管道构成的迷宫，毫无疑问，千百年来的无人问津让此地陷入了彻底的混乱。岩浆从我所能见到的每一个石头孔洞上喷涌而出，难以忍受的高温使得旅程变得危险，很多低阶的佣兵回到了凉快些的季节大厅。不过锻莫已经预料到了这种酷热，因为这种难以忍受的天气无疑就是夏季之于他们的意义所在了。在闷热的空气中挣扎时，我注意到了有修理蜘蛛无视我的存在窜来窜去，钻进侧面，里面露出巨大的杠杆。似乎每个部分都有一个维修节点，能释放某种神奇的冷却剂，把无法忍受的高温降低到只是烦人的地步。如果有足够多的蜘蛛被引导到过热的地方，有足够多的冷却装置运转起来，我就能发现这片夏天的秘密了。

traduit: 伟大艾尔贝隆的日志·卷5

original: Winter was, not to my surprise, home to a great indoor blizzard and what the mercenaries thought of as artificial stone mountains. Yet they were not mountains, but great towering silos of frozen water. And the cold! Not even the high mountains compared to such chills, and we were soon trading furs amongst ourselves to keep warm! Yet just as soon as the wind had picked up, it died down, the temperature dropping and the icy waters unfreezing, yet still cold. It became clear that if I was to progress through these silos, I would have to take advantage of the variable chill, quickly crossing through paths formed by the ice floes as impromptu bridges. As clever a solution as any solution thought up by me.
traduit: 不出我所料，冬季就是那场巨大的室内暴风雪的故乡。佣兵们说那里有许多人造石头山，然而那些不是山，而是巨大高耸的冰冻储水塔。还有酷寒！就算是最高的山峰都没有这么冷，我们很快就要相互交换毛皮取暖了！然而风刚起就停下了，冷水开始解冻，但仍然很冷。很显然，要通过这个区域，就必须利用多变的寒意，迅速穿过浮冰形成的小路，就像跑过临时搭建的桥梁一样。我想出来的办法总是这么妙。

original:
[pagebreak]

Forgotten Seasons My Journey Through the Ancient World of The Dwarves Vol. 1 by Elberon Blackthorn

[pagebreak]

[pagebreak]

fter having saved the town of Tanglehaven with my patented snake oil serum, word of my deeds soon spread, and one of my helpful admirers pointed me in the direction of an old system of caverns. But lo, it was not a simple naturally formed cave, but Vardnknd, a long forgotten Dwarven ruin. A storm of great intensity had ravaged the region recently, and the locals all thought that some curse lay upon the caves, and they spewed out bad weather because of this. But Elberon Blackthorn is nothing if not well read, and I was well-versed with the legends surrounding those caves. You see, I had been looking for Vardnknd for a long time, because deep within it contained a Karstanghz-Beharn, better known as a Weather Witch. These legendary devices were said to be able to control the weather, and Vardnknd's was the strongest of them all. But why did they make it? To terrorize innocents? To help in times of underground drought? Either way, a storm now raged across the region, and it was obvious who was at fault. To save the locals, and to claim the power of the weather for my own, me and my trusted band of mercenaries dove towards the problem with the same bravery and skill I approach everything in life with. Inside, evidence of the storm's rampage could still be seen and felt. Pipes spewed a poisonous ooze into the streams, rubble lay about, and most tellingly, a massive indoor storm raged. The Weather Witch had gone mad! Alas, the door to the main gallery was sealed shut. But with my impressive knowledge of the Dwarves and their infernal sciences, I was able to quickly deduce the issue. You see, dear readers, while the storm raged, it drew its power from magic derived from each of the four seasons. Yes, the Dwarves had in this very ruin undertaken a massive analysis of spring, summer, autumn, and winter, and tied to each of them a conduit that would focus their natural energies into the gallery, allowing the weather to be controlled! All one had to do was enter each part of the facility and disconnect those conduits. Only then could I enter the main gallery and shut down the Weather Witch! This first volume details my intrepid adventure into each of these seasonal sub-facilities, as well as my harrowing escape. It also serves as a manual on how to shut down the conduits which I aim to document in my next volume. Thus armed with this information and my benefactor's funding, my apprentice and I have once more endeavored into the heart of this ruin, this time with more men and hopefully, with more satisfactory results.

[pagebreak]

utumn

As I trundled into the halls of Autumn, a marvelous sight unfolded. Before me lay an enormous stretch of farmland, decrepit and overgrown, but a farm nevertheless. Strange fruits and grains grew in plots, while emaciated chickens ran about, all the while tended by enormous double-bladed centurions. Did the Dwemer find it amusing that the surface-people had a whole season dedicated just to harvest, or did they do this as a mockery to some forgotten god of the feast? Whatever the case, I aimed to examine a piece of this Dwarven wheat myself. The harvest glowed with a foul light, the grains as stiff as a rock. Yet as dense as the wheat was, I observed the bladed centurions cutting through it with little effort and carrying them off to a set of depositories near the entrance. While no doubt the blades of these machines would make short work of flesh and armor, my men nevertheless valiantly served as a distraction as I made my escape. Perhaps if I had more time, or more men, I could carry the heavy wheat over to the depository, and sate whatever freakish endeavors the Dwarves had begun. [pagebreak]

pring

Spring greeted me with a splash of color as beautiful flowers were scattered across the halls of metal and stone. There were even animals sauntering about, feeding off the vegetation warmed by the artificial light. Unfortunately, our journey through this horrific sight of beauty was soon delayed by a most peculiar obstruction. Thick, gnarled roots blocked the passageways, halting our progress. Perhaps the Dwemer had found nature to be cumbersome, and saw spring as nothing more than a season of suffering. While the mercenaries labored to cut through the bark, my strong perception allowed me to notice strange spriggans shambling through the artificial forests. As I brushed aside it, the roots quivered, as if their tendrils were an extension of the forest creature. Were these spriggans the tenders of the gardens, or just a consequence of its existence? Regardless, if we could somehow sever the connection between the spriggans and the roots, we might find a way deeper into the ruins. [pagebreak]

ummer

Summer was a maze of tunnels and pipes, and no doubt centuries of neglect had left the place in a state of pure chaos. Lava spewed from every stone orifice I could see, and unbearable heat made for a precarious journey, causing many of the lesser mercenaries to turn back to cooler times. But the Dwemer had predicted such superheat, for this unbearable weather was undoubtedly what summer meant to them. As I pulled myself through the swelter, I noticed repair spiders darting to and fro, lowering bridges that granted access to side sections of the chamber. It seems that within each section is a service waypoint that releases some sort of magical coolant, reducing the heat from impossible to merely annoying. Perhaps if I could find a way to direct the spiders to the various waypoints in the area, I could drop the temperature to a more manageable level. [pagebreak]

inter

Winter was, not to my surprise, home to a great indoor blizzard and what the mercenaries thought of as artificial stone mountains. Yet they were not mountains, but great towering silos of frozen water. And the cold! Not even the highest mountains compared to such chills, and we were soon trading furs amongst ourselves to keep warm! It became clear that to progress through this area, I would need to dive through the unfrozen waters that surrounded the towers, snaking up and around the structure like the ice wraiths that call this place home. As clever a solution as any solution thought up by me, but not one I could risk at the moment. Perhaps when we return to this ruin, I can find someone less important to brave it.
traduit:
[pagebreak]

遗忘之季 我穿越古老的矮人世界之旅第一卷 艾尔贝隆·黑刺 著

[pagebreak]

[pagebreak]

在用我的专利蛇油精华拯救了盘曲港镇后，我很快就名声远扬了，一位欣赏我的热心人士告诉了我一座古老的洞穴群。但是瞧啊，这不是普通的天然洞穴，而是一座被遗忘已久的矮人遗迹——瓦德肯特。 最近一场猛烈的风暴席卷了这片地区，当地居民们都觉得洞穴里有什么诅咒，因此恶劣天气从洞穴里倾泻而出。不过艾尔贝隆·黑刺可不是文盲，对周围那些洞穴的传说更是了如指掌。你瞧，这么久以来我一直都在寻找瓦德肯特，因为它的深处有一个卡斯坦格兹-贝哈恩——更广为人知的名字是天气女巫。 据传这些传说中的装置能够操控天气，而瓦德肯特里的是其中最为强大的。他们为什么要制造它呢？为了吓唬无辜的人？为了在地下干旱时提供帮助？不管怎样，如今一场风暴席卷了整片地区，是谁的毛病显而易见了。为了拯救当地居民，为了让天气之力为我所用，我和我信赖的佣兵们要鼓起所有的勇气，用尽毕生所学来解决这个问题。 在洞穴里面，仍然能看到、感受到风暴肆虐的证据。管道向溪流中涌出有毒的泥浆，碎石到处都是，而最为明显的证据是一场强大的室内风暴在肆虐。天气女巫已经疯了！唉，通往主厅的大门被封死了。不过凭借我对矮人和他们那万恶科学的深刻了解，我很快就能推断出这个问题。 我亲爱的读者，你瞧，当风暴肆虐的时候，它从四季的魔力中吸取能量。没错，在这座遗迹中，矮人对春、夏、秋、冬进行了大量的分析，并且在每一个季节大厅都建了一条管道，将它们的自然能量集中到大厅中，从而得以操控天气！我们要做的就是进入这个设施的各个部分，切断这些管道。只有这样我才能进入主厅，然后关闭天气女巫！ 第一卷详细记述了我进入四季附属设施的英勇冒险以及恐怖逃离的过程。同时它也是一本讲述关闭管道方法的手册，这些内容我本打算写在下一卷上。 这次有了这些信息以及我赞助人的资金，我的徒弟和我再次努力进入这座遗迹的中心，这次我们带了更多的人，同时也有望取得更令人满意的成果。

[pagebreak]

秋季

当我走进秋季大厅时，一番奇妙的景象展现在眼前。在我面前的是一大片农田，尽管破败不堪又杂草丛生，但仍然是片农田。地上长着陌生的水果与谷物，瘦弱的鸡跑来跑去，所有这一切都由巨大的双刃百夫长照料。锻莫是觉得地表人用整整一个季度专门用来收获很有意思，或是他们这么做是为了嘲笑某个被遗忘的盛宴之神呢？不管怎样，我要亲自检查一下这里的矮人小麦。 庄稼发着刺眼的光芒，谷物硬得跟石头一样。尽管小麦长势很密，我发现那带着刀刃的百夫长仍然能毫不费力地穿行而过，把小麦带到入口附近的一个存放处。这些机械的刀刃无疑能轻易切开血肉和盔甲。当我逃跑时，我的手下仍然勇敢地去分散它们的注意力了。也许如果我有更多时间或人手，就能把这些沉重的小麦搬到仓库去，满足矮人们的怪异努力。 [pagebreak]

春季

春季以一片色彩迎接了我，美丽的花朵散落在金属与岩石的大厅里。甚至有动物在四周闲逛，以人造光照亮的植被为食。可惜，我们穿越这一可怕美景的旅程很快被一个最为奇特的障碍阻挠了。 粗大、扭曲的树根堵住了通道，阻碍了我们的前进。也许锻莫发现自然就是累赘，认为春季不过就是一个受苦的季节。当雇佣兵费力地劈开树皮时，我敏锐的感知力让我得以发现有奇怪的木灵在人造森林中蹒跚而过。当我推开树根时，树根颤动着，好似它们的卷须就是这座森林的一部分。是这些木灵造就了这些植物，还是这些植物形成了木灵？不管怎样，如果我们能找到切断树根与木灵之间联系的方法，我们就会找到更加深入遗迹的路。 [pagebreak]

夏季

夏季大厅是一座隧道和管道构成的迷宫，毫无疑问，千百年来的无人问津让此地陷入了彻底的混乱。岩浆从我所能见到的每一个石头孔洞上喷涌而出，难以忍受的高温使得旅程变得危险，很多低阶的佣兵回到了凉快些的季节大厅。不过锻莫已经预料到了这种酷热，因为这种难以忍受的天气无疑就是夏季之于他们的意义所在了。 在闷热的空气中挣扎时，我注意到了有修理蜘蛛窜来窜去，放下了通往各个大厅侧面的桥梁。似乎每个部分都有一个维修节点，能释放某种神奇的冷却剂，把无法忍受的高温降低到只是烦人的地步。也许我能找到一种把蜘蛛引导到地区各个节点方法，这样我就能把温度降低到更能忍受的程度了。 [pagebreak]

冬季

不出我所料，冬季就是那场巨大的室内暴风雪的故乡。佣兵们说那里有许多人造石头山，然而那些不是山，而是巨大高耸的冰冻储水塔。还有酷寒！就算是最高的山峰都没有这么冷，我们很快就要相互交换毛皮取暖了！ 显然，要通过这个区域，就需要潜入储水塔周边没有结冰的水域，像以此地为家的冰怒灵一样在建筑周围蜿蜒前行。我想出来的办法总是这么妙，不过我现在还不能冒险。没准当我们返回这座遗迹时，我能找到个不那么重要的人冒这个险。

original: Mercenary's Note

original:
<font face='$HandwrittenFont'><font size='18'>It's been two days since we've heard from the mage.

He told us to wait here at camp, but everyone's tired of stripping spiders for loot. The mage promised us fortune and glory, but if the fool got himself killed, none of us get paid. That's a problem.

Still, I'm not sure we should leave just yet. Something about this place feels off.
Maybe it's the air. One minute it's dry enough to crack your throat. Other times, it's wet enough to drown you. In most ruins, it's easy to lose track of time. But here, I feel like I'm losing my mind.

Last night I decided to step outside and take a breath. Maybe just seeing the sun again would help me keep my wits. When I got back to camp, sweating from the heat, I told one of the other mercs she should do the same. She told me she already did, but it was too damn cold. I wasn't sure what she meant until I saw the snow on her boot.
traduit:
<font face='$HandwrittenFont'><font size='18'>我们已经有两天没收到法师的消息了。

他让我们在营地等着，不过所有人都厌倦了拆卸蜘蛛的烂活。法师许诺给我们财富和荣耀，但如果那个蠢货把自己作死了，我们谁都拿不到报酬了。这是个问题。

不过，我还是不确定是不是应该走人。这地方有点不对劲。

没准是空气的问题。一会儿干得呛嗓子。一会儿又潮得能把你给淹死。人在遗迹里很容易失去时间观念。然而在这里，我觉得是要失去理智了。

昨天晚上我决定去外面透透风。没准重新看见太阳能让我保持理智。当我汗流浃背回营地的时候，我跟另一个雇佣兵说她也应该这么做。她告诉我她已经去了，但太冷了。我看见她靴子上的雪才明白她在说什么。

original: Note on Summer
traduit: 夏季笔记

original:
<font face='$HandwrittenFont'><font size='18'>The boss says we can use one of those control rods to make the metal crawlies open the way. 

Supposedly you just point the thing at one of those round waypoints and the spider does the rest, but I don't know how to fire the rod. I just hope I figure it out before I collapse from all this heat. I can almost smell my blood cooking.
traduit:
<font face='$HandwrittenFont'><font size='18'>老板说要用其中一根控制杆让金属爬虫把路打开。

按理说，只要把它对准其中一个圆形的维修节点，蜘蛛就会自己处理剩下事情了。但我不懂得怎么发射。希望能在我被热晕前搞清楚。我觉得自己的血都要被煮开了。

original: Note on Autumn
traduit: 秋季笔记

original:
<font face='$HandwrittenFont'><font size='18'>Mage says we have to harvest wheat and stuff it in the depositories. 

Only I don't know which wheat goes in which container. Seems like the symbols on the signs and the depositories might be a clue, but they all look the same and it's making my head hurt.

Shor's Bones, this isn't what I signed up for. If I wanted to work on a farm I'd go back to Rorikstead. The treasure better be worth it.
traduit:
<font face='$HandwrittenFont'><font size='18'>法师说让我们收割小麦，塞到仓库里。

不过我不知道小麦和容器的对应关系。看起来路标和寄存点上的符号是个线索，但看起来也没啥区别，头大。

舒尔的骨头啊，这可不是我想要的。我真这么喜欢收庄稼，干嘛不回洛利克镇呢。那份宝藏最好值得我这么干。

original: Note on Winter
traduit: 冬季笔记

original:
<font face='$HandwrittenFont'><font size='18'>Two steps into winter and I can't feel my toes.

Now the mage says we're gonna have to jump fifty feet into water so cold it'll crack your bones. This is all Bjorn's fault, I wanted to try the Summer room but I drew the sodding short straw.
traduit:
<font face='$HandwrittenFont'><font size='18'>刚走进冬季大厅没两步，脚趾头就没知觉了。

现在法师还说我们得跳进五十尺深的水里，水冷得能把骨头冻折了。都怪比约恩，我还想试试夏季大厅，结果抽了个下签。

original: Elberon's Journal
traduit: 艾尔贝隆的日记

original:
<font face='$HandwrittenFont'><font size='17'>
I've split the mercs into groups and explained how to disable the conduits in each season, using simple words for their infinitesimally small minds. To their credit, some of them decided to take notes.

It would be easier if they simply read the account of my previous expedition. Of course, doing so would make them aware of the horrible fate that befell their predecessors.

I've also told the men to be on the lookout for other curiosities, such as Dwarven insects, Dwarven mounts, and three Dwarven Crown masks we uncovered in our last foray.

However, the main prize in this tomb of inclement weather is the Turn of the Seasons, a magical spell that legends say is cast not by the spellcaster, but by the the weather itself! 

Once you read this tome and are imbued with its power, they say the rain will grant you a silver tongue, as charming as a spring romance. Summer's sweltering heat fills you with stamina when dressed in light armor, whereas winter's snow offers a boon to heavy armor wearers. Meanwhile, the clouds are a gift to hunters, their bows cutting through the autumn wind. 

Such a prize must be deep within the ruins, perhaps in the chamber of the one who orchestrated this unholy sky.
</font>
traduit:
<font face='$HandwrittenFont'><font size='17'>
我把雇佣兵分成了几个组，用最简单易懂的话给他们那近乎于无的脑子解释了每一个季节大厅关闭管道的方法。值得称赞的是，他们中的一些人决定做点笔记。

如果让他们读一下我先前的探险记录可能会更容易些。当然了，这么做的话会让他们意识到降临在以前那些佣兵身上的可怕命运。

我还告诉这些人要注意其他的宝物，比如矮人昆虫、矮人坐骑以及我们上次短暂的探寻过程中发现的三枚矮人王冠面具。

不过，这座恶劣天气的坟墓中最重要的宝物是“四季轮转”，据传是一个由天气本身而非施法者施展的神奇法术！

一旦你阅读了那本法术书，被其力量所感染，据说雨水就会赐予你三寸不烂之舌，好像春季的爱情般迷人。当你身着轻甲时，夏季的酷热会让你精力充沛，而冬季的雪则会给身穿重甲之人赐福。相比而言，云朵则是猎手的礼物，让他们的弓穿过秋季的风。

这等宝物一定在遗迹深处，也许就位于谱写这片危险天空之物的大厅内。
</font>

original: Dwarven Crown Journal
traduit: 矮人王冠日记

original:
<font face='$HandwrittenFont'><font size='18'>
One of the curiosities the mercs uncovered during their excavation was an ornate Dwarven headpiece, which I quickly deduced to be a crown.

As leader of this expedition, the responsibility of wearing said crown naturally fell to me. However, upon adorning it, I noticed the piece was incomplete. 

According to legend, the crown's boon was said to turn with the seasons, as if it were guided by the moon and stars. However, it seems the enchantments are actually tied not to the crown itself, but the masks that slot into its facing.
 
If memory serves me correctly, there are three masks in total. Spring, Autumn, and Winter. What became of the Summer mask, I do not know, but perhaps the Mid Year heat made it too unbearable to wear.
traduit:
<font face='$HandwrittenFont'><font size='18'>
佣兵们在挖掘过程中发现了一顶华丽的矮人头饰，我很快推测出这是顶王冠。

作为本次探险的领队，戴上这顶王冠的重任自然就落在了我的肩上。不过，在喜爱之余，我注意到其零部件并不完整。

根据传说，王冠的恩惠会随着季节变化，就好像受到月亮与星辰的引导一样。不过，这些附魔似乎与王冠本身并无关系，而是与镶嵌在其正面的面具有关。

如果我没记错的话，面具一共有三个。春季、秋季和冬季。不知道夏季面具为什么没有了，也许年中的高温还戴着它就太难受了。

original: I've heard tales of a lost Dwarven ruin southwest of Markarth. While such ruins are not uncommon in Skyrim, this one was rumored to let one control the sky itself. If my travels take me south of Rorikstead, I should keep an eye out for anything that might resemble an entrance.
traduit: 我听说马卡斯西南有一个矮人遗迹。尽管遗迹本身在天际并不少见，但据说这个遗迹能让人控制天空。如果我旅行到洛利克镇以南，可以留意一下类似入口的东西。

original: I've discovered a strange Dwemer ruin, where a mercenary party has been attacked by hostile machines. I should investigate.
traduit: 我发现了一个奇怪的锻莫遗迹，有一支雇佣兵队伍遭到了敌对机械的攻击。我应该调查一下。

original: It seems a mage had set up camp in the heart of the ruins. Unfortunately, he was struck by lightning before I could reach him. Maybe I can find out more about these ruins by inspecting his remains.
traduit: 似乎有个法师在遗迹核心位置安营。但很不幸，在我找到他前，他就被闪电击中了。也许我可以通过检查他的遗体来发现更多有关遗迹的信息。

original: According to the mage's journal, Vardnknd contains a device capable of controlling the weather. However, without a steward to manage it, the storm has increased in size and threatens to affect weather outside of the ruins. Left unchecked, it could spread to the rest of Skyrim. It seems the only way to shut down the system is to disable four separate conduits in sub-facilities throughout the ruins.
traduit: 根据法师的日记，瓦德肯特有一个能控制天气的装置。然而，由于无人管理，风暴的规模越来越大，并有可能影响到遗迹以外的天气。如果不加以控制，可能蔓延到天际其他地方。看来唯一能关闭系统的方法就是关闭遗迹分设在四处的管道。

original: With all the conduits deactivated, I should be able to proceed and shut down the source of this inclement weather.
traduit: 所有管道都已经关闭，我应该可以继续关闭这种恶劣天气的源头。

original: I defeated the Sky Orchestrator. The violent weather seems to have ceased as a result.
traduit: 我击败了天空协调者。猛烈的天气似乎停止了。

original: At the center of the ruin I have encountered an enormous Dwarven machine. As the weather seems to obey it, perhaps destroying it will stop the storm.
traduit: 我在遗迹中心遇到了一个巨大的矮人机械。天气似乎受它操控，也许摧毁它将停止风暴。

original: To reach the Conduit of Autumn, I need to open a massive door. The door seems connected somehow to the pipes and depositories nearby.
traduit: 要抵达秋之管道，需要打开一扇巨大的门。这扇门似乎与附近的管道和仓库相连。

original: The path to the Conduit of Spring is blocked by thick roots. I'll need to find a way to move them aside.
traduit: 通往春之管道的路被厚厚的树根挡住了。我得想办法把它们移开。

original: The Conduit of Summer appears to be powered by heat. In order to disable it, I'll need to activate service waypoints that supply coolant to the facility. However, with the pathways blocked, I'll first need to use a control rod to direct a repair spider to the waypoints.
traduit: 夏之管道似乎是靠热量驱动的。为了关闭，需要激活为设施提供冷却剂的维修节点。然而由于路径被阻塞，我需要先使用控制杆来引导修理蜘蛛到路径点。

original: The facility that studied winter has been ravaged by a permanent blizzard. I should be able to navigate through each icy water reservoir to reach the Conduit of Winter.
traduit: 研究冬季的设施被一场永久性暴风雪摧毁。我应该能穿过冷水库抵达冬之管道。

original: I discovered a journal on the mage's body. I should inspect it to learn more about what lies ahead in these strange ruins.
traduit: 我在法师身上找到一本日记。我应该读一下，进一步了解这个古怪遗迹背后的东西。
