original: Halvar's Journal
traduit: 哈尔瓦的日记

original:
<font face='$HandwrittenFont'>
Came into town a few days ago looking for work. The folks here are nice enough, and there's plenty of wheat and potatoes needing to be harvested, so I've got a steady supply of coin coming in. 

I don't think I'm going to need my old pack goat Hilda for much longer...all my bones are starting to creak, and my adventuring days are long over. Now I just need to find someone willing to take care of her. Maybe get a few coins for her too - there's strength in those old bones of hers yet.

Ah, how I'm going to miss wandering the wilds of Skyrim! I saw so many strange and wonderful things out there - pine trees as tall as mountains, old nord tombs, I once even stumbled across a wandering spirit made of pure ice!

Even ran across a few folks trying their hand at taming different types of creatures. Don't know why they'd want anything but a loyal dog or trusty goat like my Hilda though - some of them beasts out in the wild just aren't meant to be tamed.

Ran across an alchemist with a pet rabbit, and almost got robbed by a thief with a tame fox, but I suppose a rabbit or a fox could be docile enough. But that pickpocket trying to train a skeever must have been as mad as old Sheo'. And I don't want to think too hard about the vampire that almost made a meal out of me...could have sworn it had a trained frostbite spider! Gives me the shivers just thinking about it.
traduit:
<font face='$HandwrittenFont'>
我几天前来这镇上找工作了。本地人都很好，很多人需要人手帮忙收小麦和土豆，所以我收入还算稳定。

我觉得我再也不需要那驮货的老山羊希尔达了……我所有的骨头都开始嘎嘎作响，冒险的日子已经结束了。我现在只需要找个愿意照料她的人家。没准还能拿她卖点钱——她那把老骨头还有些力气的。

哎，我会多么怀念在天际荒野里漫游的日子啊！看见了那么多奇怪又壮观的景象——像山丘那般高的松树，古老的诺德坟墓，甚至无意间碰见了纯粹由冰组成的游魂！

我甚至遇见了一些尝试驯养不同生物的人。不过搞不懂他们为什么不想要忠诚的狗或者像我那希尔达一样可靠的山羊——那些野兽就是没法驯服的。

我碰见了一个有宠物兔的炼金师，我还差点被一个有条温顺狐狸的贼给抢了，不过我想兔子或者狐狸还是挺温顺。不过那个设法训练恶鼠的扒手肯定跟老谢一样有疯病。我也不想太纠结于那个差点把我当晚餐的吸血鬼……那家伙绝对有一只受过训练的霜噬蜘蛛！光想想就让我打哆嗦。

original: Thief's Journal
traduit: 盗贼的日记

original: 4th of First Seed I guess being Bosmer really does give me a way with animals! This little fox wandered up to me today, bold as brass, and started begging for treats. I didn't have anything on me at the time but a sweet roll, but it seemed to like that well enough. I wonder if this gift with animals works on horses - it would make stealing them dead easy. 15th of First Seed The furry nuisance won't leave me alone! It's been following me everywhere, even down into the sewers. At least it's quiet enough that it won't alert the guards... 1st of Rain's Hand The fox has a real nose for sniffing out valuables. Just this morning she dug a silver locket out of the mud - I never would have seen it if she hadn't started pawing at the ground. She must be attracted to shiny things. Can't say I blame her, really. 9th of Rain's Hand Finding Sweet Roll has turned out to be the best stroke of luck I've had in a while. She's got better eyes and instincts than any thief I've ever met, including Vex. I can't remember the last time my coin purse was this heavy - I'm starting to jingle like a battalion of Imperials when I walk. 25th of Rain's Hand I think I'll try out this animal-taming thing on the wolves outside of town. Some of the other thieves have been eyeing me recently; they would think twice about jumping me if I had a wolf at my heels.
traduit: 初种月4日 我觉得身为波斯莫真是给了我对付动物的方法！今天这只小狐狸朝我走过来，很大胆，还朝我要吃的。当时我除了一个甜卷外什么都没有带，不过狐狸似乎也挺喜欢的。我想知道这种对付动物的天赋对马有没有用，让偷马变得简单些。 初种月15日 这条毛茸茸的讨厌鬼一直缠着我！不管我走到哪里，甚至是进下水道，它都跟着。还好它足够安静，不会惊扰到守卫…… 雨手月1日 狐狸对贵重物品的嗅觉可真灵。就在今天早上，她从泥里挖出了一个银吊坠，要不是她把地刨开的话，我根本看不见。她一定是被闪闪发光的东西吸引住了。真的，不能怪她。 雨手月9日 能找到“甜卷”是我近些日子最幸运的事情。她的眼力与直觉比我见过的的任何盗贼都要好，哪怕是威克斯也比不上。我记不起上次我的钱袋这么重是什么时候了，我走路的时候，已经开始像一支帝国军队一样叮当作响了。 雨手月25日 我觉得得在城外的狼身上试试这种驯兽法了。最近其他小偷开始盯上我了；如果我有一匹狼跟着的话，他们在袭击我之前会掂量一下的。

original: Pickpocket's Journal
traduit: 扒手的日记

original:
<font face='$HandwrittenFont'>
I ain't been having no luck at lifting gold off them rich merchants in the market, and those thieves guild s'wits don't want me. Said I'm too clumsy. I'm running out of food and skooma, may need to start killing some of the skeevers down here for meat...

One of the skooma dealers at the docks told me he knew a guy from Morrowind who trained a nix hound to distract his marks - helped him steal a heaping pile of gold, he said. Don't know if I believe a word of it, but what else am I going to do? Might as well give it a try.

Too bad there ain't any nix hounds around here. Plenty of skeevers, though...I'm gonna need to catch some anyway for food, might as well have a go at training one first.
traduit:
<font face='$HandwrittenFont'>
我没有手气从市场的富商手里搞到钱，盗贼公会的那些斯’威特也不想收我。说我太笨了。我吃光了食物，喝光了斯库玛，也许得杀点这里的恶鼠整点肉了……

码头的一个斯库玛贩子跟我说，他知道一个来自晨风的家伙，他训练了一只尼克斯犬让目标分心，还因此大偷一笔。我不知道自己该不该信，但我还能做些什么呢？不妨去试试吧。

真糟糕，这里根本没有尼克斯犬。不过，恶鼠倒有的是……反正要抓一些来吃，不如先去训练一只。

original: Vampire Naturalist's Journal
traduit: 吸血鬼自然学者的日记

original:
<font face='$HandwrittenFont'><div align="left">
While my siblings may be obsessed with the taste that fear imbues in the blood of mortals, I find that pain lends a much more potent sweetness. And nothing is quite so capable of causing pain as the venom of a frostbite spider.

But alas, the usual method of harvesting frostbite venom involves killing the spider - a costly and dangerous venture. Far too little venom can be obtained through violent methods for the experiments I wish to conduct. 

To that end, I have captured a frostbite spider from deeper in the cave so that I may regularly collect its venom, which seems to be unusually potent. I discovered that it appears to have some measure of intelligence, and I have been attempting to teach it to obey certain orders. Oh how delicious it would be to have a tamed spider entangle my prey on command!

I think I will name it Arachnia.
traduit:
<font face='$HandwrittenFont'><div align="left">
虽然我的兄弟姐妹们可能沉迷于凡人血液因恐惧散发的味道，但是我发现痛苦带来的味道更加甜美。没有什么比霜噬蜘蛛的毒液更能引起痛苦的了。

但是，唉，一般要获得霜噬毒液就得杀死蜘蛛，成本高昂且危险。对于我想要实施的实验而言，通过暴力手段取得的毒液实在太少了。

为此，我从洞穴深处捉了一只霜噬蜘蛛，这样我也许就能定期收集它的毒液了。这种毒液似乎效力很强。我还发现它似乎有一定程度的智力，我一直试着教它服从一些命令。啊，如果有一只蜘蛛能按照命令缠住我的猎物，那该多棒啊！

以后就叫它八脚怪吧。

original: Notes on Tamed Rabbit
traduit: 驯兔笔记

original: 14th of Second Seed The rabbits here seem particularly adept at sniffing out potion ingredients. I recently found one nibbling on my thistle plants and managed to capture it. It is my hope that I will be able to train it to lead me to the most bountiful flora. 22nd of Second Seed The rabbit (which I have decided to name Thistle, in honor of the carefully cultivated plants it managed to destroy) is showing great promise. It has proven to be quite tame and even rather intelligent. Getting it to respond to commands, however, can be a bit of a trial. I've resorted to plying it with carrots.
traduit: 次种月14日 这里的兔子似乎特别擅长嗅出药水的成分。我最近就发现了一只正在啃我的蓟类植物，我想办法把它给捉住了。但愿我能训练它，让它带我找最丰富的植物种群。 次种月22日 那只兔子（我叫它蓟花，用以纪念它打算摧毁的那些精心培育的植株）很有前途。事实证明，它非常温顺还特别聪明。不过，让它对命令做出回应却有点挑战。我要给它喂胡萝卜试试。

original: 23th of First Seed wanted so badly to make a go at being farmers, so here we are now with our own rocky plot of land and a ruined old farmhouse with a leaky roof. It's not what I dreamed of, but we'll make the best of it. At least the soil's good, even if it's full of boulders. I'll be able to get a nice garden going, with all the ingredients I need for my potions. The income from that should get us through the first winter, if nothing else. [pagebreak] 10th of Second Seed I found a secret room walled off in the basement. It will do nicely for my alchemy lab; I love my husband dearly, but he can be a pig-headed dolt when it comes to the gentle magics of the earth. If it weren't for my potions, little would have perished last winter from a fever. [pagebreak] 1st of Frostfall Our plantation is doing well enough, but 's eyes are getting bigger than his purse. He was talking of purchasing a wagon recently, like we don't sometimes struggle to put food on the table. A wagon, honestly! I've seen the ugly looks he gives my potions and herbs, but where else are we going to get the money for all the things he buys? Next thing you know, he'll be trying to buy another farm! [pagebreak] 13th of Mid Year 's gone missing. We've looked everywhere, but we can't find find him. His little wooden sword is missing too - gods perserve me, I hope he hasn't run off! He doesn't realize how dangerous it is out there on the tundra. [pagebreak] 16th of Mid Year It's been three days now. My little boy is still gone. I don't like how is looking at me - his eyes are too dark, too still, like a frozen lake. I think I even heard him mutter something about "getting what I deserve." Could he have...? No, I dare not even put the thought to paper. [pagebreak] He did it. He must have. That monster killed my son, and now he looks at me with those hate-filled eyes and a mocking smirk. He despises my alchemical arts so much that he took my son from me to punish me. I've never brewed poison before, but I know how it's done. I know how to bottle death. A few drops in his mead and my child will be avenged. [pagebreak] It is done. The gods will damn me, but they will damn him more for the murder of a child. , I'm so sorry. traduit: 初种月23日 非要去当农民，所以我们有了自己的石头地和屋顶漏水的破农舍。这不是我梦寐以求的生活，但我们会尽力而为。 至少土壤很好，即使到处都是巨石。我就要有个漂亮的花园了，里面可以种我做药剂的原料。这笔收入至少能让我们度过第一个冬天。 [pagebreak] 次种月10日 我在地下室发现了一间被墙隔开的密室。可以用来做我的炼金实验室。我很爱我丈夫，但他面对这世界的温柔魔力时，却显得像个顽固的呆瓜。要不是我的药，小去年冬天就发烧烧死了。 [pagebreak] 霜落月1日 我们的农园打理的不错，但眼大肚子小。最近非要买辆马车，说得好像我们已经不用为养家糊口发愁了似的。马车，真够了！ 我看到了他看向我药剂和草药时难看的眼神，但不然我们从哪儿弄来钱买他想要的东西呢？下次你就知道了，他会盘算再买个农场！ [pagebreak] 年中月13日 失踪了。我们到处都找过了，但就是找不到他。他的小木剑也不见了——诸神保佑，但愿他没有跑掉!他根本不知道苔原上有多危险。 [pagebreak] 年中月16日 已经三天了。我儿还是没有找到。我不喜欢看着我的样子。他的眼睛太黑，太平静了，像被冰封的湖水一样。我甚至能听到他咕哝什么“罪有应得”之类的话。 他该不会……？我都不敢把这想法写下来。 [pagebreak] 是他。肯定是他。那个怪物杀了我儿子，现在用充满仇恨的眼神看着我，带着嘲弄的傻笑。他鄙视我的炼金术，把我儿从我身边夺走来惩罚我。 我从来没做过毒药，但我知道怎么做。我知道怎么下毒。只要在他的蜜酒里滴上几滴，我儿就大仇得报了。 [pagebreak] 成功了。诸神会诅咒我，但更会为他杀了一个孩子而诅咒他。，我很抱歉。我希望我能- 等等，我听到亻

original: 14th of First Seed Today's the first day of our new lives. I bought a sizable piece of land with a run-down farmhouse for dirt cheap just outside of Rorikstead. No one else wanted it, on account of how rocky it is. Too many boulders, the other men said. But and I have strong backs and willing hearts; we'll get those boulders out, and turn this fertile land into a plantation they could only dream of. This will be the perfect place to raise our little . [pagebreak] 21st of Second Seed Long day. Hand hurts almost too much to write. Farmhouse is repaired, and the first plants are in the ground. Feels good. We did it. kissed me tonight like she did when we were first married. Her eyes are calling me. [pagebreak] 1st of Sun's Height We harvested our first crops today. It wasn't much, but it's a start. When I watched the sun's rays first break over the horizon on our fields today, I knew what to name this place - , after Akatosh's glorious light. Soon, it will be an inheritence worthy of our son. Just a bit longer, I know it. [pagebreak] 23rd of Frostfall My heart is troubled. is fast growing into a strapping young boy, though he spends too much time playing with that wooden sword of his and dreaming of running off to join the Legion. But my dear wife, ... her strangeness worries me. Sometimes she'll disappear for hours at a time, and then turn up in the house as though she'd been there all along. I often see her carrying a basket full of strange dark flowers, and she won't tell me what they are or where she got them. And last winter, when fell ill with fever, produced a small black bottle from who knows where and poured who knows what down his throat... only a few minutes later, the fever was gone. refused to tell me what was in the bottle, or where she got it. I was so happy that she saved our little boy, of course, but... Mara preserve me, but I'm afraid that my wife is a daedra worshipper, or a witch. [pagebreak] 16th of Mid Year has been missing for three days. My little boy. I've searched everywhere, but there's no trace of him. Even his favorite toy sword is missing. What if wolves got him? Or brigands snatched him away? has been watching me. I don't like the look in her eyes. And she hasn't cried at all. What kind of mother doesn't cry when her child is missing? What if- I dare not even put the thought to paper. It's unthinkable. [pagebreak] I found it. I found 's secret. This is the place she's been disappearing to. The potions, the plants, the books... such evil and unnatural things I found down there. Divines help me, my wife is a witch. I didn't want to open her foul books, but I had to know, I had to- Deadly Nightshade. That's what the plant is called, the one I saw her sneaking around with. She grows it everywhere in this hidden place. She must have poisoned my son. I've seen the sneer on her face, the laughter in her eyes as she watched me tearing apart the farm looking for him. She was mocking me. I've never felt rage like this. I'm shaking with it, sweating with it. I know exactly what I've got to do. My son's spirit whispers to me, demanding vengeance. I keep an axe by the door for dealing with wild animals. It will do for dealing with a witch as well.
traduit: 初种月14日 今天是我们新生活的第一天。我用很低的价格在洛利克镇外买了一处相当大的地，上面有座没人要的农舍，因为这地方岩石太多。虽说其他人都说石头太多。但和我有坚强的背脊和踏实肯干的心，我们要把这些大石头搬走，把这片肥沃的土地变成他们只能做梦想想的农园。 这里将会是小成长的完美地方。 [pagebreak] 次种月21日 漫长的一天。手疼的都快没法写字了。农舍修好了，第一批作物也种下去了。感觉很好。我们成功了。今晚亲吻了我，就像我们新婚时那样。她的眼睛在呼唤我。 [pagebreak] 日高月1日 今天我们收获了第一批庄稼。虽说不多，但是个好开始。今天，当我第一次看到阳光刺破地平线，洒在我们的田地上，我就知道该给这个地方取个什么名字了——，用阿卡托什的光辉为名。很快它就会成为我们儿子应得的遗产。我知道，这可能还需要些时间。 [pagebreak] 霜落月23日 我现在心烦意乱。正在快速茁壮成长，尽管他成天玩那把木剑，并梦想着跑去军团参军。 但我亲爱的妻子，……她的古怪让我担心。有时她会消失几个小时，然后又出现在房子里，就好像从未消失过。我经常看她提着一篮子奇怪的黑花，既不告诉我是什么，也不说是从哪儿采的。去年冬天，发烧时，不知道从哪儿拿来一个小黑瓶子，把不明液体倒进他喉咙里……几分钟后，高烧就退了。可拒绝告诉我瓶子里的是什么东西，又是从哪里得到的。我当然很高兴她救了我们的孩子，但是…… 玛拉保佑，我妻子千万别是个迪德拉信徒或者女巫。 [pagebreak] 年中月16日 已经失踪三天了。我的儿啊。 我四处找，也没发现他的踪迹。就连他最喜欢的玩具剑也不见了。他要是被狼抓走了呢？还是强盗把他绑了？ 一直在监视我。我不喜欢她的眼神。她连眼泪都不掉一滴。什么妈才能在儿子失踪的时候一声不哭？ 但如果—— 我都不敢把这想法写下来。太不可思议。 [pagebreak] 我发现了。我发现了的秘密。她失踪的地方。那些魔药、植物还有书……我在那里发现了好多邪恶古怪的东西。神啊，救救我吧，我妻子居然是女巫。 我不想翻开她肮脏的书，但我必须知道，必须- 夜影花。这就是那株植物的名字，我看到她偷偷摸摸拿着的那个。她把花种在这种隐蔽的地方。 一定是她毒死了我儿子。我在农场到处找儿子的时候，我看见了她脸上的嘲笑，还有她眼底的笑意。她嘲笑我。 我从来没有这么愤怒过。我颤抖，流汗。 我很清楚该怎么做。我儿子的灵魂在向我低语，要我为他报仇。 我在门边放了一把用来对付野兽的斧子。现在也可以用来对付女巫。

original:
<font face="$HandwrittenFont">

Ma and Pa are fighting again. They're always fighting these days. Ma hates how obsessed Pa is with cows and the price of wheat, and all that boring stuff. Pa doesn't like Ma's flowers or her bottles of goopy stuff. I don't like the goopy stuff either, but it does make me feel better when I'm sick, so I guess it's okay. 

I can't wait till I'm old enough to join the Legion and get away from the farm. I've been practicing every day with my sword - I think I'm good enough to be a captain, or even a general! But Pa doesn't want me to join the Legion cause he says I have to take over the farm when I'm old enough. Ma doesn't want me to go cause it's dangerous. That's about the only thing they agree on.

I bet if I defeated a bandit or killed a wolf or something that would show them! Then they would have to let me join up with the Legion. 

Pa always tells me to stay away from the old well, the one toward the tall monument, out by the tree sitting on a rock. Wolves like to hunt out there, he says. So that's where I'll go. I'll kill a wolf and bring home its head, and that'll prove I'm a man and not a baby.

I'm tired of listening to Ma and Pa yell at each other anyway.

</font>
traduit:
<font face="$HandwrittenFont">

爸妈又吵架了。这些天他们老是吵架。妈讨厌爸他对奶牛、小麦价格以及所有那些无聊的事情如此着迷。爸也不喜欢妈的花和她那瓶黏糊糊的东西。我也不喜欢黏糊糊的东西，但它确实能让我生病的时候感觉好一点，所以我想也没什么。

我等不及长大后离开农场加入军团了。我每天都在练剑，我想我可以当队长，甚至是将军!但是爸爸不想让我加入军团，因为他说等我长大了就得接管农场。妈妈不想让我去，因为太危险了。这是他们唯一能达成一致的事。

我敢打赌，如果我打败了一个强盗或杀死了一只狼或其他什么东西，那就能证明他们错了！那他们就得让我加入军团。

爸爸总是叫我远离那口老井，就是那口通向高大纪念碑的井，就在那棵树旁边的岩石上。他说狼喜欢在那里捕猎。这就是我想要的。我会杀死一只狼，把它的头带回家，这将证明我是一个男人，而不是一个婴儿。

反正我也听腻了爸妈互相嚷嚷。

</font>

traduit: 我发现了金丘农园的可怕真相。儿子失踪后，<Alias=Husband>和<Alias=Wife>自相残杀，而孩子似乎是为了逃避父母的争吵才逃跑的。 唯一能让精魂平静下来的办法就是找出<Alias=GhostChild>发生了什么，我需要找到他日记里提到的那口古井。

original: I have found <Alias=GhostChild>'s remains near the old well, along with his beloved toy sword. According to his journal, he ran away from home to escape his parents' constant fighting; apparently, it looks like the wolves got the better of him. I should return the toy sword to <Alias=FarmLocation>, so that the spirits of <Alias=Husband> and <Alias=Wife> can finally know the truth of what happened to their son.

The Rise and Fall of Saint Jiub the Eradicator Hero of Morrowind and Savior of the Dunmer by Jiub

[pagebreak]

am a hunter. I am a redeemer. I am Jiub. The tale of my rise to glory begins in the ash wastes of Morrowind. I rode alone, weapon at my side and the burning wind stinging my face. My quest was arduous, but necessary to ensure the survival of the Dunmer people. A pestilence was creeping across the ashlands, a menace with an insatiable hunger that plagued innocent travelers simply trying to get home. It was my self-sworn task to hunt them down one-by-one and drive them from the skies. Their fury knew no bounds and their war cry resonated across the land. They were the notorious cliff racers, and they had to be destroyed. On a particularly hot day during Sun's Height, I was tracking what I called a Lingerer... a cliff racer without a nest. He was a particularly feisty one too, leading me on a merry chase across almost three miles of ash dunes. I had managed to take a piece out of one of his wings in an earlier scuffle so he couldn't maintain much of a climb, but he still had quite a bit of stamina left and he was trying to make me tire of the chase. Almost two solid hours passed and my silt strider was tiring, but I couldn't give up... I had sworn to eliminate the foul beasts to the last and I wasn't about to let it go. If I was going to stop the thing, I'd have to do it fast. I pulled my longbow from my back and nocked my last arrow. I took a deep breath and pulled, trying to keep the cliff racer in my sights. It was literally a longshot with the beast gaining distance and the silt strider bouncing me around at full gallop. Finally, with a silent prayer, I released the string. The arrow sang through the air like a howling demon as it sliced its way towards its target. Finally, just as it crested the lip of a foyada, the arrow struck it in the midsection. It let out a horrible cry and fell out of sight. My cries of triumph were quickly stifled by the sound of over a hundred wings. Rising from the foyada was an entire colony of cliff racers and they were out for blood. The blasted thing had led me right to their nest and sacrificed itself with the intent of feeding me to its brood. It was a trap. The damned things had become much too clever. Knowing this was likely the end, I jumped down from the silt strider and hit the back of its leg with the flat of my glass blade. There was no need for the innocent thing to die here today because of my stupidity. As the ash cloud cleared from being stirred up by its massive legs, the cliff racer brood approached. I held my sword high and prepared for the worst. The battle lasted two full days. I was beaten, clawed, bitten and knocked down more times than I care to remember. In the end, seventy-six cliff racers were slaughtered. I was knee-deep in their corpses and my body on the verge of collapse. But I had survived. I smiled to the heavens and all went black. When I awoke, all I felt was my back on a cold stone floor. Every muscle in my body was on fire, and my vision was blurred. Slowly, I tried to climb to my feet. It took several agonizing minutes, but I finally managed to do it. As my eyes adjusted to the dim light of my new surroundings, I realized that I was standing before Lord Vivec himself. He was simply staring at me... floating above his throne and staring at me with his piercing eyes. When I began to prostrate myself as a sign of respect, he held up one of his hands as if to say it wasn't necessary. Was I dead? Was Lord Vivec pleased with me? Was he about to strike me down in anger for my somewhat sordid past? Suddenly I understood everything. Suddenly I realized that I was brought here for a reason. I should have died in those ash wastes, but Lord Vivec must have seen something inside me that he hadn't seen in millennia and decided to spare me from my fate. Thus began my ascent to Sainthood. Thus began the rise of Jiub!

晨风的除害英雄 丹莫的救世主 圣鸠步的崛起与陨落 鸠步 著

[pagebreak]

我乃猎手。我乃救世主。我即是鸠步。 我走向荣耀的传说始于晨风的灰烬荒地。我独乘一骑，身负武器，燃烧的风刺痛了脸颊。我的任务艰巨，然而必须要保障丹莫人民的生存安全。一场瘟疫正在灰地蔓延，一场无尽贪食的威胁困扰着想要归家的旅人。我暗暗发誓，要把它们一个个从天上击落。它们的怒火永无止境，它们的叫声响彻大陆。它们就是臭名昭著的峭壁行者，它们必须被摧毁殆尽。 在日高月一个特别炎热的日子里，我跟踪着一只没有巢穴的峭壁行者……它名叫逗留者。它也相当活跃，让我高兴地追着他跑过了将近三里的灰丘。在早些的追逐中，我设法把它的翅膀削掉了一块，所以它爬不了多久，不过它仍然有不少耐力，试图让我厌倦追逐。近过去了足足两个小时，我的泥沙漫步者开始累了，但是我不能放弃……我曾发誓要彻底消灭这些肮脏的畜生，我不想就此罢休。如果我想阻止它，就得快点动手。 我从背上取下弓，搭上最后一支箭矢。我深吸一口气，拉弓，努力让峭壁行者保持在视野之内。这可真是一次高难度远射，那畜生不断向远方跑去，泥沙漫步者全速飞奔把我颠来颠去。最终，随着无声的祷告，我放开弓弦。箭矢从空中呼啸而过，如同一只嚎叫的恶魔，飞向它的目标。最后，当逗留者抵达佛亚达的边缘时，箭射中了它的腹部。它发出骇人的叫声，消失在了视线之外。 我那胜利的叫喊声很快被无数翅膀拍打的声响压了过去。佛亚达中飞出了一大群峭壁行者，它们一心渴求杀戮。那个混球把我引向它们的巢穴，然后自我牺牲，把我去喂它的崽子。这是个陷阱。这些天杀的东西太狡猾了。知道自己可能大限将至，我从泥沙漫步者上跳下来，用玻璃剑的剑面打了它的腿背。没必要因为我的愚蠢而让无辜的生命在今天死在这里。当泥沙漫步者结实的腿扬起的灰云散去时，峭壁行者的崽子们接近了。我把剑高高举起，做好了最坏的打算。 战斗持续了足足两天。我已经记不清我被打、被抓、被咬、被击倒多少次了。最终，我杀死了七十六只峭壁行者。我站在齐膝深的尸骸中，身体濒临崩溃。不过我活了下来。我向天空微笑，一切就陷入了黑暗。 当我醒过来时，我感觉我躺在冰冷的石头地板上。我身上每一寸肌肉都在燃烧，我的视力也模糊了。我试着慢慢爬起来。这几分钟痛苦难熬，不过最终我做到了。当我的眼睛适应新环境的昏暗光线时，我发现我就站在维威克大君本尊面前。他只是盯着我……悬浮在他的王座上，用他那锐利的目光盯着我。当我下拜以示尊重时，他抬了抬手，似乎在说不必多礼。我死了吗？维威克大君对我满意吗？他会不会因为我略显卑鄙的过去而愤然将我毁灭呢？ 突然之间，我明白了一切。突然之间，我明白我并非无缘无故被带到此处。我本该死在那灰烬中，不过维威克大君一定看到了我内心中某些他千年未曾得见的东西，并且决定让我摆脱命运。 就这样，我的升圣之路开始了。就这样，鸠步的崛起开始了！

Touching the Sky by Parmion Saldor

Translated from Falmer Text by Calcelmo of Markarth [pagebreak]

any of the most dedicated snow elves once committed themselves to a tireless journey through the Chantry to the Inner Sanctum. They carried with them the paramount desire to become one with their god, Auri-El. Though all set out with the determination to prove their worth, few were prepared for the trials that lay ahead. For the path to Auri-El was not without its tribulations. The pilgrims struggled not only against the natural elements of the treacherous vale, but with a myriad of tests upon their faith and loyalty. It is told that many simply could not continue on the path for long before turning back. Some argue that the rebuke they endured upon their return was crueler than any punishment that may have lay ahead of them along the path. In their failed attempt, they were forced to live in the shadow of those who did continue on to achieve the great glory and honor of ascension into the light. Forever after, their faith and loyalty in Auri-El would be scrutinized and their remaining days filled with shame and regret. Tales of those who reached the Inner Sanctum are not without their share of woes. It is said upon their arrival that many were mere shells of the person they had once been. Some were quite mad from sleeplessness and starved to the point of frailty. By the end of their journey, the marvel that they had strength yet to carry their vessel and ascend the stairs of the temple was the last true testament of their loyalty. Regardless of each individual's tale, the final words remain eerily similar. It is said that every pilgrim ascended, bathed in light, a look of relief and contentment on their face.

许多虔诚至极的雪精灵曾将自己献身于从神殿到内殿那不知疲倦的旅程。他们怀着与他们的神——奥瑞-艾尔——融为一体的崇高愿望。尽管所有人都下决心要证明自己的价值，但很少有人为前方的考验做好准备。因为通向奥瑞-艾尔的道路并非一帆风顺。朝圣者们不仅要与险恶山谷的自然环境做斗争，还要经历无数对他们的信仰与虔诚的考验。 据传，很多人在这条路上根本走不了多远就折返了。一些人认为他们返回后所遭受的谴责要比前方道路上可能面临的任何惩罚都要残酷。由于他们的尝试失败了，他们要被迫生活在继续前进，取得了升入光芒的伟大荣光的那些人的阴影中。从此之后，他们对于奥瑞-艾尔的信仰与虔诚会受到审查，而他们的余生会充满愧疚与悔恨。 那些抵达内殿者的故事也不是一点苦难都没有。据说当他们抵达时，许多人已经是一具行尸走肉了。有些人因失眠而发狂，而有些人饿到了虚脱。在他们旅途的最后，仍有力气举着水壶爬上圣殿的台阶，就是对其虔诚的最终考验。不管每个人的故事有什么不同，结尾都非常相似。据说，每一位朝圣者都拾级而上，沐浴在阳光中，面露欣慰与满足之情。

Diary of Faire Agarwen Translated from Falmer Text by Calcelmo of Markarth [pagebreak]

Forward The dates noted in this diary are translated literally. This verbiage matches no known modern measure of time, and is assumed to be a custom form of counting the days and months. Excavations of ancient Falmer slave quarters have turned up brass vessels, very similar to a deep bowl, with twenty markings crudely etched onto the inside. Falmer scholars theorize that this bowl would be placed under a drip of water coming from an overhanging rock and as the bowl filled, the water's level would reach these markings, thus indicating a crude passage of time. Because of this diary, the vessel has been called a "kulniir," a primitive Falmer timekeeping device. [pagebreak]

Third Marking, Tenth Kulniir It feels like years since we were forced into hiding. I dare not write where we stay for fear of endangering the good people of this house should this diary be discovered. We have been shown a kindness by this family once known to the Snow Prince. Even in death his great influence has ensured our safety. We were separated from many of our kin along the road when it became increasingly difficult to travel discreetly in our numbers. We were forced to go our separate ways and travel only at night. I have heard no news of where the others may have gone and fear I never shall. Our lives are forever changed. [pagebreak] Seventh Marking, Tenth Kulniir In the night I find it difficult not to focus on times past. There are moments in my rest when I still hear the laughter of Young Ones at play in the valley. Other times I see the pale flicker of happy moments which were once so common in the land of the Snow Elves. I try not to dwell on these memories too long. Often our surroundings make it impossible to dwell on any happiness. We have been locked together in such close quarters for so long we grow tired of each other's company. Even the strongest of us have faltered with nothing to do but think on what is lost. I wake each day to forlorn faces and am reminded of where we are and all we have left behind. We are all yearning for a day when we can emerge from hiding and walk freely in the light once more. But I fear we are losing all hope that such a day will ever come. [pagebreak] Tenth Marking, Tenth Kulniir I tire of the tears of women and children. My own have run dry. The men have begun to look upon us as if we are all weak yet we have survived the same trials as they. I cannot bring myself to think on the numbers we lost in battle. Yet I cannot force the images of my own losses from my mind. And now in a time when our people should be banding together it feels we are drifting apart. The Nords have truly won. Our once great pride and unity are shattered. If we lose hope now we will never survive. Today many, myself included, have tried to speak out in voices of reason. There can be no hope without talk of our future. We can make no difference if our spirits remain broken. [pagebreak] Eighteenth Marking, Tenth Kulniir We know that we can never again be the Snow Elves and live freely in this world. We will forever be in hiding in one form or another. But there is no reason we cannot live life with the sun and the wind against our skin. There are those here who are friends to us and plan to help us once the threat has ended. We know now to survive we must be born anew. Outside, we will appear as though we belong here. Inside, we will carry our truth and our scars.

前言 这本日记中的日期是逐字翻译而成的。这种措辞与现代的时间度量不匹配，我们认为这是一种专门用于计算日期和月份的形式。在对古代伐莫奴隶居住区的发掘工作中，发现了类似深碗的黄铜器皿，其内部粗糙地刻着二十道标记。伐莫学者认为这个碗会被置于来自悬岩的滴水下，依据水面达到这些标记的时间，来表示时间大致的流逝。根据这本日记，该容器被称为“库尼尔”，是一种原始的伐莫计时装置。 [pagebreak]

第十库尼尔，第三标记 自从我们被迫东躲西藏以来，我觉得好像过了好几年。我不敢写我们呆在哪里，因为如果这本日记被发现的话，会波及到这座房子的好心人。雪王子旧识的这家人对我们很好。即便牺牲了，他那巨大的影响力还是在保佑着我们安全。由于我们的人数让我们越来越难以谨慎行进，因此我们一路上与许多同胞走散了。我们被迫分道扬镳，只敢走夜路。我没听到其他人去向的消息，而且恐怕永远也打听不到了。我们的生活永远改变了。 [pagebreak] 第十库尼尔，第七标记 我发现在夜里很难不去回忆过去的时光。当我休息的时候，我仍然能听见年轻人们在山谷里玩耍时的笑声。其他时候，我看见曾经在雪精灵的土地上如此常见的幸福时刻一闪而过。我努力不去沉湎于这些回忆太长时间。我们在这么个小地方一起呆太久了，对彼此都觉得烦了。即便是我们之中最坚强的人，也因为无事可做而踌躇，只想着失落的事物。我每天早上醒过来，都会看见那些绝望的面孔，然后想起来我们身处何处以及我们所留在身后的一切。我们都渴望有朝一日能从藏身之处走出来，再次自由自在地行走在阳光下。不过我担心我们已经完全失去了期盼这一天将会来临的希望了。 [pagebreak] 第十库尼尔，第十标记 我厌倦了女人和孩子的眼泪了。我自己的眼泪已经流尽了。男人们开始觉得我们都是弱者，然而我们同他们一样经过了重重考验。我没法想象我们在战斗中失去了多少人。我也没法忘记我自己失去的东西。而现在正是我们族人应该团结一致的时候，但是我却觉得我们渐渐疏远了起来。诺德人确实赢了。我们曾经伟大的骄傲与团结被击碎了。如果我们现在失去了希望，我们就没法活下去。如今，包括我在内的许多人，都试着发出理性之声。如果我们不谈及未来，就不会有希望。如果我们的精神依然崩溃的话，就会一事无成。 [pagebreak] 第十库尼尔，第十八标记 我们知道我们没法再作为雪精灵，在这个世界自由生活了。我们永远以这样那样的方式躲藏起来。不过我们没有理由不能在阳光和微风下生活。这里有些人是我们的朋友，他们计划在威胁结束后帮助我们。我们现在知道，为了生存我们必须重生。从外表看，我们会表现得仿佛属于这里。在心底里，我们将带着我们的真相与伤疤。

Journal of Mirtil Angoth Translated from Falmer Text by Calcelmo of Markarth

4th of Evening Star I used to dream of fighting in battles like my Father. He had begun teaching me to fight the moment I was able to pick up a blade. Mother had argued that I was too young, but he paid her no mind. I can still remember the elation I felt the first time I bested Father in a match and the look of pride on his face. If it were up to him I know he would have allowed me to join him in battle. With me at his side he may have fared better. Now with Father and so many others slain, the Old Ones claim we are left with too few warriors to continue the fight. I was not the only Young One to speak out in protest, but our small voices went unheard. It has been decided that we must flee to seek help and protection. [pagebreak] 8th of Evening Star News has reached us that the great Snow Prince has fallen in battle. The urgency to go into hiding has left many of us scattered and those of us still together unsure of which direction to turn. In the long hours of night we keep huddled together always fearing the worst until the first light of the blessed sun. May Auri-El guide our footsteps. [pagebreak] 13th of Evening Star In the night I overheard the Old Ones whispering secrets of the underground and the Dwemer who dwell there. I thought back on stories Father once told me of these dwarves, heroic tales of honor and glory. The Old Ones must know of these stories for it has been decided that we will change course upon first light. I feel hopeful that the Dwemer will help us to avenge our fallen and reclaim our land.

夜星月4日 我曾梦想像我父亲一样战斗。当我能举得起剑的时候，他就开始教我战斗了。母亲吵着说我太小了，不过他没有理会。我还记得第一次在比试中胜过我父亲的喜悦以及他脸上的骄傲。如果由他决定的话，我知道他会让我加入战斗的。有我在他身旁，他可能会表现得更好。现在我父亲还有其他许多人都被杀了，长老们说我们剩下的战士太少，没法继续战斗了。我不是唯一一个大声抗议的青年，然而我们微弱的声音却没人理会。已经决定了，我们必须逃走，去寻求帮助和庇护。 [pagebreak] 夜星月8日 伟大的雪王子在战斗中牺牲的消息传到了我们这里。紧迫的躲避行动使我们许多人走散了，而我们这些仍然在一起的人不知道该往哪个方向走。在漫漫长夜，我们总是挤成一团，担心最坏的事情发生，直到天亮。愿奥瑞-艾尔指引我们前进。 [pagebreak] 夜星月13日 夜里，我无意间听见长老们小声说着关于地下以及居住在那里的锻莫的秘密。我想起父亲曾经给我讲过关于锻莫的故事，关于荣耀与荣誉的英雄传说。长老们一定知道这些故事，因为他们决定我们天一亮就改变方向。希望锻莫能帮我们复仇，收复我们的土地。

Glory be to Minorne! Glory be to the mistress of all! My life for you, oh beautiful savior! Where once my feeble ramblings seemed so grand, I now realize they are but scratches on parchment, unworthy of you. Oh, that I could properly describe you, I would write a thousand testaments to you! Damn my tiny thoughts, if only I were wiser! Minorne asks that we bring more here for her, more to worship her and do her bidding! I have sent word to the Hall of the Vigilants to come. A simple lie was told, for they would not understand. Not until they saw her, o glorious Minorne! But she is fearful! There are fools in this world that do not heed to her beautiful voice. The guard, Florentius, sent from the Beacon, he still prays to Arkay, an absentee god who pales in comparison to Minorne! I will pray to the goddess I can see! May he rot in his cage! Oh, sweet, sweet, Minorne...

荣耀属于蜜诺妮！荣耀属于万物的女主人！美丽的救世主啊，我将生命献给您！曾经我那无力的胡言乱语是如此苍白，如今我明白它们不过是羊皮纸上的划痕，配不上您！啊，若我能正确地将您描绘出来，我将为您写下千言万语。我的思想太渺小了，我若能再智慧些就好了！ 蜜诺妮让我给她带更多的人，让更多人崇拜她，服从她！我已经给警戒者之厅捎了信让他们过来。一句简简单单的谎言，因为他们在见到她之前是不会理解的，美丽的蜜诺妮啊！ 然而她很害怕！这世上有很多傻瓜不听从她那优美的声音。从烽火台派来的守卫——佛伦提乌斯——仍在向阿尔凯祈祷，与蜜诺妮相比这位看不见的神苍白无比。我要向我所见的女神祈祷。愿佛伦提乌斯烂在笼子里！ 啊，最亲爱的蜜诺妮……

original: Discovering Ruunvald, Vol. IV
traduit: 探索鲁恩瓦德·卷4

original:
[pagebreak]

Discovering Ruunvald Vol. IV by Moric Sidrey

[pagebreak]

I have found my muse and her name is Minorne. Reading back over old journals, I realize she has called to me from deep inside Ruunvald. She is the voice I've been hearing, the one who has called me ever downwards into the mountain. The Vigilants, the workers, they hear her too! What joy to learn that I am not alone in her love! Oh, Minorne, how would we have ever found this place without you! As I write this we are digging out the last bit of rock to get to you. Those without tools have started using their hands! I cannot write anymore, I must get back to work. Ruunvald awaits!

M. Sidrey

[pagebreak]

探索鲁恩瓦德 第四卷 墨里克·西德利 著

[pagebreak]

我发现了我冲动的来源，她的名字是蜜诺妮。回顾以前的日记，我发现是她在鲁恩瓦德深处召唤我。她就是我一直听到的那个声音，那个一直呼唤我进入这座山的声音。警戒者还有工人们，他们也听到她的声音了！得知她并非独宠我一人是何等乐事啊！啊，蜜诺妮，如果没有您，我们怎会发现此地！当我写这篇日记的时候，我们正在挖掘最后一块岩石，以便找到您。那些没有工具的人已经开始上手了！我不能再写了，我必须回去工作。鲁恩瓦德正等着呢！

original: Discovering Ruunvald, Vol. III
traduit: 探索鲁恩瓦德·卷3

original:
[pagebreak]

Discovering Ruunvald Vol. III by Moric Sidrey

[pagebreak]

The damnable headaches! Minorne be merciful, I just can't seem to shake them. The workers have started to report them as well, but while their focus on conversation and civility may wane because of it, they have not swayed from their task. If anything, they seem to have doubled their efforts. I myself cannot seem to focus on anything other than the dig. I sit here now, studying some unearthed Nordic artifacts, yet I feel a nagging call to see how the dig is progressing. The other day without thinking, I picked up a shovel and started digging myself. Fortunately, no one seemed to find this unusual, which is a blessing. I'd hate for the Vigilants of Minorne to think that I'd lost my senses! As we dig, we uncover more Nordic ruins and architecture, but have yet to hit the main chamber. Everyday I dream we'll finally reach Ruunvald, and I can't help but reflect on what this will mean to my reputation! My family will be so proud, especially my father, Minorne. He and mother have always been interested in my studies, even if my sister Minorne was not. But I'm most excited to reveal my findings to my colleagues, Minorne and Minorne, and perhaps my mentor Minorne. Oh, won't they all be pleased?

M. Sidrey
traduit:
[pagebreak]

探索鲁恩瓦德 第三卷 墨里克·西德利 著

[pagebreak]

该死的头疼！蜜诺妮行行好，我止不住头疼。就连工人们也开始报告头疼了，尽管他们因此不那么注意交谈与礼节，但却没有偏离任务。要说有什么不同的话，他们似乎加倍努力了起来。我自己似乎没法对挖掘之外的事情集中注意力。我现在坐在这里，研究着一件出土的诺德文物，但我感到一股烦人的冲动，要去看看挖掘进展得如何。前几天，我不假思索地拿起铲子，自己开始挖掘了起来。万幸的是，没有人发现这种异常，这是好事。我不喜欢让警戒者的蜜诺妮觉得我失去了理智！ 在挖掘的过程中，我们发现了更多诺德遗迹与器物，不过还没有挖到主厅。每天我都梦见我们终于抵达了鲁恩瓦德，我忍不住想这对我的名声意味着什么！我的家族会特别骄傲，尤其是我的父亲蜜诺妮。他跟母亲总是对我的研究很感兴趣，尽管我的姐姐蜜诺妮并不是这样。不过最令人兴奋的还是向我的同事——蜜诺妮跟蜜诺妮，也许还有我的导师蜜诺妮透露我的发现。哦，他们难道不会高兴吗？

M.西德利

original: Discovering Ruunvald, Vol. II
traduit: 探索鲁恩瓦德·卷2

original:
[pagebreak]

Discovering Ruunvald Vol. II by Moric Sidrey

[pagebreak]

Our luck continues! Not only do we continue to tunnel into caves and shafts that speed our descent, but struck multiple veins of precious ore. Now that the excavation has proven to be a financial success, the Vigilants have sent more supplies, materials, and workers to further the cause. I find myself unable to contain my glee at times, and have become prone to cheerful outbursts in front of the men. One might find this very out of character for me, but the men seem to share my enthusiasm. Never before have I worked with a group so single-minded in their pursuit. To have so many people working towards the same goal with little to no deviation from the task at hand is an uncanny blessing! Stendarr be praised! With so much going well, I hesitate to document what seem like minor troubles in comparison. It must have something to do with the cramped spaces, but I have found myself prone to aches in my head. While these hardly deter me from my leadership role, I have found myself distracted at times. I have had many a conversation with the workers where I drift off, only to have them call me back to reality. Sometimes I lose small amounts of time and can't remember what I've done. I am hoping this is nothing more than excitement of reaching our goal, but I will try to keep note as we dig deeper. Perhaps a half tankard of ale before sleep will help me with these headaches.

M. Sidrey
traduit:
[pagebreak]

探索鲁恩瓦德 第二卷 墨里克·西德利 著

[pagebreak]

我们的好运仍在继续！我们不但继续挖掘了洞穴和竖井以加快向下的速度，而且还挖到了多条珍贵矿石的矿脉。现在，挖掘工作已经证明是有钱可赚的了，为了推进这一工作，警戒者送来了更多的补给、材料以及工人。我发现有时我无法控制自己的喜悦之情，在人们面前也更容易爆发出高昂的情绪。有人可能觉得这不符合我的个性，不过大家似乎都跟我一样热情。我从来没有和这么一心一意追求目标的团队合作过。有这么多人朝着同一个目标努力，几乎没有偏离手头的任务，这等好事真是难以置信!赞美斯丹达尔! 在这么多事情进展顺利的情况下，我很犹豫是否要记下那些相比起来微不足道的麻烦事。我发现自己很容易头疼，也许与这里空间狭小有关吧。我发现自己有时候会分心，虽然这并没妨碍我担任领导的职责。我曾多次在迷迷糊糊中与工人们交谈，结果是他们把我叫回现实。有时我会有点断片儿，记不清自己做了什么。我希望这只是即将达成目标的兴奋造成的，而我会在深入发掘的过程中试着继续记录。也许睡前喝半杯麦酒能帮我缓解头痛。

M.西德利

original: Discovering Ruunvald, Vol. I
traduit: 探索鲁恩瓦德·卷1

original:
[pagebreak]

Discovering Ruunvald Vol. I by Moric Sidrey

[pagebreak]

I have decided to document our expedition to find Ruunvald in my journals, with hopes that, should we fail, it will bring illumination to those who follow us. I myself have stood on the shoulders of academic giants to get where we are today, spending endless hours in libraries and private collections. I am certain that there is some artifact of great power to be found in those ruins, one that the Vigilants could find useful in their mission. I do not mean to sound pompous, but I feel as if I am on the precipice of my destiny with this quest. I am certain we are digging in the right place. I can feel it in my bones, and I dream of finding Ruunvald at night. Even in my waking hours, I can almost hear a reassuring voice telling me we are going the right way. The expedition has had a great deal of luck so far. After only a few weeks, the first tunnel broke through into a large shaft, leading downward towards where I suspect to find Ruunvald. With just a few bits of carpentry, we've established our first base camp within the mountains. If we continue to be this fortuitous, we shall reach our goal in record time!

M. Sidrey
traduit:
[pagebreak]

探索鲁恩瓦德 第一卷 墨里克·西德利 著

[pagebreak]

我决定在日记上记录我们寻找鲁恩瓦德的探险，如果我们失败了，希望它能给后继者带来点启发。我自己也是站在学术巨擘们的肩膀上，在图书馆和私人收藏馆中花费了数不尽的时光，才有如今的成就的。我相信，在这遗迹中能找到某种拥有巨大力量的东西，在警戒者的任务中派上用场。 我不想说的太自负，不过我觉得这次任务中我的命运似乎处在转折点上。我确信我们挖对了地方。我在心底里能感受到，我夜里做梦都梦见找到鲁恩瓦德。即使在我醒着的时候，我也几乎能听到一个令人安心的声音，跟我说我们走对路了。 到目前为止，探险队运气不错。仅仅几周之后，第一条隧道就打通了，形成了一座巨大的竖井，向下通往我觉得能找到鲁恩瓦德的地方。我们做了一点点木匠活，就在山里搭建起了第一座营地。如果我们还能这么幸运的话，我们达成目标的时间会创纪录的！

M.西德利

original: Confessions Of A Khajiit Fur Trader
traduit: 一位卡吉特毛皮商的自白

original:
[pagebreak]

Confessions Of A Khajiit Fur Trader

[pagebreak]

My execution is tomorrow. The turnkey asks what I'd like for my last meal. Bring me paper, I say. A quill and a candle. Perhaps the Jarl would like a confession. I would rather pass the time. When my father's harem burned down and our family fortune was lost to the ashes, my brother and I set to begging in the gutters of Elsweyr. I will never forget the first time we stole a traveler's purse. It was almost by accident. Just a slip of the claw and the pouch fell into our hands. We ate like kings that night. We slept in a warm bed for the first time in months. Soon after, my brother and I took up the knife. The gang we joined treated us as the dirty orphans we were. We robbed, we scammed, we cut and ran and years of debauchery and hard living took their toll. I lost half my left ear in a knife fight with a blind drunk Argonian. I wanted to give up, but my brother, he dreamed bigger, better. My brother wanted to make it to Cyrodiil and become legit merchants. We had a plan. One final heist of a northbound caravan said to be filled with jewels. Something went wrong. My brother could not stop the horses on time, and I stood helplessly by and watched the wagon plummet over a cliff. But as I picked through the wreckage, my devastation turned to excitement. There were no jewels, but there were plenty of luxurious wolf pelts, horker tusks and mammoth hides, more than enough to buy my way to Cyrodiil. I'd follow in the footsteps of so many of my kind. A traveling merchant, someone with a respectable profession. I had all the furs bundled in my pack when I saw my brother's broken body. His ears were still warm, and I shut his eyes for the last time. This was his dream. And he would want me to go. But what I wanted, well, the caravan guards were coming. I had to go, but I couldn't just leave his body to rot. My brother gave me my first skin. It was to be a memento. But in the darkness of the fence's cabin, the coin hit my hand heavy. Then she looked at my brother's pelt and offered three times the amount of any other fur. Disgust caught in my throat, but did not live very long. I realized the cost of such a forbidden luxury. The value, the demand, the respect. This is what I wanted. It became easier. A dark alley, a gag in one hand and a quick slice across the throat. Gently hold the body as it bleeds. I became faster, my cuts precise and fluid. I peel the skin with one motion and kept the merchandise pristine, in one piece. I became rich. Far richer than anyone in my family had ever been. Yet I was careful. My stronghold was well-hidden, and practically impenetrable. I hired the men that used to employ me. We moved frequently on less traveled roads when we hunted in the wild. We stalked the back alleys we used to sleep in when we hunted in the city. I grew so rich that I no longer needed to dirty my own hands. Patchwork colored furs fetched the best price among the Bosmer. Argonians preferred the pelts completely skinned and tanned. Orcs prized the thick, waterproof leather of the Argonians. Humans most often bought tails and ears. I had to employ an alchemist and a master craftsman for a couple odd requests, but I didn't ask questions when the gold piled up. And now I'm a prisoner. Maybe I became careless. Maybe I let too many secrets slip between the sheets. The raid of my fortress was a massacre. They took me alive, barely. That was their mistake. My enemies should have killed me when they had the chance. I have one lockpick. And the northern wall of my cell is weak from disrepair. My head shall not roll tomorrow. I am not finished with the trade. There will always be buyers. Someday, I will sell my own skin for a king's ransom, as my name is legend. And yours shall rot in the gutters with your bones. -The Fur Trader
traduit:
[pagebreak]

一位卡吉特毛皮商的自白

[pagebreak]

明天我就要掉脑袋了。狱卒问我上路饭要吃啥。 我说：给我纸笔还有蜡烛。 也许领主希望我忏悔。我倒宁愿用来打发时间。 在我父亲的府宅被付之一炬，财产化作灰烬之后，我跟我哥开始在艾斯维尔的贫民窟乞讨。我永远忘不了我们第一次偷走旅人的钱包。那件事就是凑了巧了，爪子那么一滑，钱包就进了我们手里。那晚我们吃得像国王一样丰盛。那晚我们是几个月以来头一次在床上睡觉。 没过多久，我哥和我拿起了刀。我们加的团伙把我们当肮脏的孤儿。我们抢劫、恐吓、砍人、跑路，多年放荡和艰苦的生活也让我们付出了代价。我的左耳在跟一个喝醉的阿尔贡瞎子互砍的时候给削没了一半。 我不想干了，但我那哥哥，他有更大、更好的梦想。 我哥想去希罗帝尔，当个合法商人。我们有一个计划。最后抢一辆北上的大篷车，据说里面装满了珠宝。 不过出了点岔子。我哥没能及时勒住马，我无助地站在一边，眼瞅着马车从悬崖上掉了下去。但当我检查马车残骸时，我的悲伤变成了兴奋。车里没有珠宝，但有许多华丽的狼皮、海象牙和猛犸皮，价值远远超出了我去希罗帝尔的路费。我追随着很多同胞的脚步。变成了行商，这是个受人尊敬的职业。 在我打包好所有毛皮时，我看到了我哥的残躯。我为他合上了眼睛，他的尸体尚有余温。这是他曾经的梦想。他会希望我去的。不过我想要的是什么呢？成吧，大篷车守卫来了。我得溜了，但我不能就这么让他的尸体烂掉。 我从我哥身上得到了第一张毛皮。这是件遗物。我从销赃贩子昏暗的小屋那大赚了一笔。然后她看着我哥的毛皮，出了三倍于其他毛皮的价格。我感到恶心，但这没持续多久。我意识到了这种禁忌奢侈品的价值、需求跟好处。 这就是我想要的。 我越干越上道儿。一条昏暗的小巷，一只堵住嘴的手，一次快速的割喉。轻轻地抱住流血的尸体。我变得更迅速，我的剪裁变得精准流畅。我只要一下子就能剥下整张皮，这样货就能完好无损了。 我有钱了。比我祖上的人还有钱。不过我很谨慎。我的据点很隐蔽，很难察觉。我雇了那些曾经雇佣我的人。我们在野外狩猎时，经常走那些人迹罕至的路。在城里狩猎时，我们在自己过去曾经打盹的后巷里偷偷靠近猎物。我变得特别有钱，我不用再弄脏自己的手。 木精灵喜欢出高价买颜色交织的毛皮。阿尔贡喜欢鞣制的整皮，兽人喜欢买厚实防水的阿尔贡皮。人类最常买耳朵和尾巴。我不得不雇一位炼金师和一位工匠大师来处理那些奇怪的请求，不过只要有赚头，我就从不多问。 而现在呢，我是个囚犯。可能是我变得粗心了。可能我在床上说漏了太多秘密。他们对我堡垒的突袭是场屠杀，他们好不容易才活捉了我。这是他们的失误。我的敌人一有机会就该杀了我。 我有一根开锁器。我牢房北面的墙因为年久失修而摇摇欲坠。明天我才不会掉脑袋呢。 我的买卖还没结束，也从来不缺买主。总有一天，我要把自己的皮也高价卖掉，因为我的名字就是个传奇。而你们的骨头只会在臭水沟里烂掉。 ——毛皮商

They went on a rampage through the Spring and killed the other priests as they cowered in the pool, praying for Arkay's protection. "...and as we tore the spine... ...last priestess... ...took the viscera into the Bloodstone Chalice... ...waters ran red forever more..." Perhaps this "Bloodstone Chalice" is the answer. [pagebreak] ~ 18th of Sun's Height, 4E 201 Weeks of research and still nothing to show for it. It would seem that the Bloodstone Chalice is most likely the key to harnessing the power of the Spring, but it is also clear that at some point it was removed from the ruins. I've found an illustration of it which I have endeavored to sketch here, but nothing else regarding where it may have ended up. [pagebreak]
traduit: ~4E201年，次种月19日 多亏几位下属不甚光彩的过往，我们找到了方法，在将月亮糖变为斯库玛的步骤中添加进了血泉水。它药效更强，成瘾性更大。我们把地下室变成了个窝点，然后派出一些本地人，带着“样品”去哄人们过来。本来令人失望的血泉反而创造了稳定的血液来源。 我们管它叫“红水斯库玛“，以防客人们碰巧注意到角落里有“水”。 我在与泉水相连的房间找到了很多破损书籍，我会继续研究它们，找到饮用血泉又不产生副作用的方法。凡人喝了泉水似乎会感染各种各样的疾病，而吸血鬼则会获得力量，不过只能持续很短的时间。 [pagebreak] ~4E201年，年中月9日 我找到的很多书籍都被时间跟湿气给毁了，变成了破破烂烂的碎片，不过我已经拼凑出了血泉的起源了，聊胜于无吧。 在第一纪元时，它曾经是阿尔凯的圣泉，由祭司伦盖尔所主持。我略过了许多与研究无关的内容，不过似乎他所深爱的女人被咬了，转化成了吸血鬼，之后也转化了他。他们在圣泉里大开杀戒，杀死了其他瑟缩在池水中祈求阿尔凯保佑的祭司们。 “... ...当我们撕裂……最后一位女祭司……脊柱……把内脏放进血石圣杯……泉水永远变成了红色……” 也许这个“血石圣杯”就是答案了。 [pagebreak] ~4E201年，日高月18日 研究了几周依旧一无所获。血石圣杯似乎最可能是利用血泉力量的关键，不过很明显，在某个时间点它被从废墟中移走了。 我找到了关于它的插图，我已经尽力在这里画出来了，但关于它的去向，就没有别的线索了。 [pagebreak]

traduit: 维纳鲁斯·沃尔平的日记

original: ~ 28th of Sun's Dusk, 4E 200 I've found an interesting book of short stories on the pawnshop's shelves today. I don't think the owner will mind if I take it. I really should spend more time around the docks, these Altmer are too thin blooded for my taste. Anyway, one of the tales in the book is an account of the "Bloodspring of Lengeir's Feast," a fabled source of power for vampires. It is a story I've read several renditions of before but this version suggests that it may be located in Skyrim, in a ruin buried by quaking of the earth during the 2nd Era. Considering that my business here with Inquisitor Amolmaire is, shall we say, at an end, it might be a good time to leave Summerset for a worthwhile diversion for the next twenty to thirty years. Perhaps I shall investigate this fabled Bloodspring. [pagebreak] ~ 2nd of Morning Star, 4E 201 I was able to obtain passage from Alinor to Solitude by way of ship. No mean feat with this Nord insurrection going on, I assure you. I ran across one of my own in the local tavern and feared at first that it might cause problems for me, but it turns out that she is well-positioned here in the city and has been happy to help if I keep a civil manner. We spoke much on my research into the Bloodspring and while she made sure to point out she thinks it a "soft headed pursuit" she did say that what she's heard would point to The Rift. [pagebreak] ~ 5th of First Seed, 4E 201 After months of searching I finally may have found a lead. While looking for a bit of dinner in the Vilemyr Inn, I overheard an old hermit by the name of Jokull, talking about strange red water he found bubbling out of the ground. Once I dispose of this soldier, I'll follow to see if I can find the location. [pagebreak] ~ 13th of First Seed, 4E 201 I can't believe I didn't realize sooner. Jokull has been taking buckets of rock and dirt out of his house all week. When I realized that he's digging a basement I snuck in to check if he had uncovered the Bloodspring. He's hit a cave system that must be where Bloodspring has sunken into over the years. It was hard to see in the dim light, even with my eyes, but I would swear the water I saw pooled on the ground was red. [pagebreak] Unfortunately he woke up while I was exploring the basement and he dropped his torch on a pelt as I killed him. More setbacks. [pagebreak] ~ 4th of Rain's Hand, 4E 201 The runnels I initially found had passed through too much rock and dirt but I've "befriended" some of the locals and we've managed to find the source of the Bloodspring. We've kept a low profile so as not to draw too much attention and thus far I've managed to keep them to only attacking hunters and other dregs, but we'll need to set up a ready food source that won't draw too much attention if we are to remain here. The Bloodspring is not everything that I'd hoped it would be. Though it is blood and gives great strength it provides no sustenance. And the power it grants lasts only for a short while and carries a weakening of the body and mind with it. I've had to lock the door to the chamber to keep the others from becoming completely dependent upon it. When I've tested it on mortals, it is worse for them, for it carries only disease and addiction with no benefits at all. Addiction. I may have just found a solution for our food problem.
traduit: ~4E200年，日暮月28日 我在当铺的书架上找到了本挺有意思的短篇故事集。我觉得老板应该不会介意我把它拿走。我真应该多花点时间在码头转转，这些傲特莫的血液对我来说味道太淡了。 不管怎样，书中的一篇故事描述了“伦盖尔盛宴的血泉”——传说中吸血鬼力量的源泉。这个故事我之前看过几个版本，不过这个版本表明它可能位于天际，在一座第二纪元因地震而被掩埋的废墟里。 鉴于我在这里跟阿墨梅尔仲裁官的事务可以说是完事了，是时候离开夏暮岛，给之后的二三十年找点有意义的消遣了。也许我该去调查调查这座传说中的血泉。 [pagebreak] ~4E201年，晨星月2日 我能走水路从艾琳诺去独孤城。我敢说，在诺德的叛乱仍在持续的当口，这么干可不容易。我在当地酒馆碰见了一位同胞，一开始我还担心这会给我惹上麻烦，不过事实证明她在这城里地位挺高，如果我讲礼貌的话，她也乐意帮忙。我们就对血泉的调查聊了很多，尽管她明确表明她觉得这是个“蠢爱好”，但她还是说了她听说的消息都指向了裂痕领。 [pagebreak] ~4E201年，初种月5日 经过几个月的寻找，我终于发现了一条可能的线索。我当时正要在烂醉如泥旅店找点晚餐，无意中听见一位叫约库的老隐士在谈论地上冒出的怪异红水。 等我解决掉这个士兵，我就跟上去看看能不能找到那地方。 [pagebreak] ~4E201年，初种月13日 难以置信，我竟然没早点意识到。 整个星期，约库都在把一桶桶的石头跟泥土从屋里搬出来。当我意识到他在挖地下室时，我偷偷溜了进去，看看他是不是发现了血泉。他碰上了一个洞穴系统，那一定是多年来埋藏血泉的地方。即便以我的眼力，在昏暗的光线下也很难看清东西，不过我保证我看见地上的积水是红色的。 [pagebreak] 倒霉的是，他在我探索地下室的时候醒了，就在我杀了他时，他把火把掉在了毛皮上。麻烦事更多了。 [pagebreak] ~4E201年，雨手月4日 我最开始发现的隧道被太多的岩石泥沙堵住了，不过我跟一些本地人“交了朋友”，我们设法找到了血泉的源头。我们一直低调行事，以免引起太多注意。到目前为止，我只让他们攻击猎人跟其他混混，但要想留在这里，必须建立一个稳定的食物来源，才能不引起过多注意。 血泉并不完全符合我的预期。虽然它流出来的是血，而且能赋予人强大的力量，不过却不能满足饥渴。它所赋予的力量只能维持一小段时间，伴随而来的是身体和精神的虚弱。我只得锁上房门，以免其他人完全依赖血泉。当我用血泉在凡人身上做测试时，效果更糟，除了生病和成瘾之外，没有一丁点好处。 成瘾。 我刚刚可能找到解决食物问题的办法了。

original: 17th of Sun's Height Damn that scheming elf! Damn him! He steals my notes, my discovery, and publishes it under his name! Twenty years of my life spent digging through those ruins, and what do I get? A dedication? 'Friend and Colleague' my arse. He's just mocking me! Well, I'll have the last laugh. Taron may have my theory, but he doesn't have any proof, not yet. If I can find the Forge first, I can show the world this is my discovery. Mine, not his! [pagebreak] 4th of Last Seed I've got a lead. One of the moldy old books in Mzund mentioned the Forge. Ruined through and through, but I was able to copy down a few scraps, including a map of the first-era Dwemer kingdoms. Need to cross-reference it with modern borders when I get back. [pagebreak] Here's the result: 1 - Arkngthamz This one, 'Arkngthamz', was on the inscription, too. Apparently the main Aetherium research center. Seems like the place to start. [pagebreak] 2 - Mentioned as a 'Bthar-zel' ('allied city'?). Not Bthardamz, though. Looks like a smaller site, north or northwest of there, on the river. 3 - The primary source of Aetherium. Extracted from some deeper mine? 4 - A storage site for raw Aetherium, just outside a major city. Apparently, it had to be kept outside because the Aetherium was 'harmonically volatile'. [pagebreak] 5 - No name, no identifying information, but page after page of ruined diagrams. Couldn't make out much, but it looks like - an astrolabe, a gear, some sort of crest in four pieces? Could this be the location of the Forge? Something important, at least. [pagebreak] 22nd of Last Seed Arkngthamz. My map may be rough, but it was enough to get me here. There may be something to this after all. [pagebreak] 23rd of Last Seed Reached the Treasury. There's a Tonal Lock here, still active. Judging from the corpses, it's safe to say the traps are still active, too. Couldn't find any clues, so I'll make a sketch and work through this carefully. Five Resonators. Five tones. Just have to hit them in the right order. Let's see... [pagebreak]
traduit: 日高月17日 那个奸诈的精灵真该死！真该死！他偷了我的笔记、我的发现，还以他的名义发表了！二十年来我在这些遗迹里挖啊挖啊，我得到了什么？一段致谢？“朋友和同事”个屁！他就是在耍我！ 好吧，我会笑到最后的。泰荣也许拥有我的理论，可他没有任何证据，现在还没有。我可以先找到锻炉。我可以告诉全世界这是我的发现。是我的，不是他的！ [pagebreak] 末种月4日 我有线索了。姆祖恩德的一本发霉的旧书里提到了锻炉。虽然这书彻底损毁了，不过我能复制一些残页，包括第一纪元锻莫王国的一份地图。等我回去后得拿它跟现代的地区边界做个比对。 [pagebreak] 对比结果如下： 1-阿肯撒兹 碑文上也有这个“阿肯撒兹”。这显然是进行神光水晶研究的主要中心。看来可以从这里着手。 [pagebreak] 2 - 里面提到被称为一座“巴撒-泽尔”（“同盟城市“？）。不过，不是巴塔丹兹。似乎是一较小的地点，在北边或者西北边的河上。 3 - 神光水晶的主要来源？从更深的矿井里开采的？ 4 - 有一个储藏神光水晶原矿的地方，就在主城外面。很显然，神光水晶具有“调和不定性”，因此必须得储存在外面。 [pagebreak] 5 - 没有名字，没有识别信息，只有一页又一页损毁的图表。看不出来什么了，不过它似乎是--一个被分成四块的星盘、齿轮或者徽章？这也许是锻炉的位置？就算不是，也一定很重要。 [pagebreak] 末种月22日 阿肯撒兹。我的地图也许很潦草，不过也足以让我抵达那里了。说不定这里终究有些玄机。 [pagebreak] 末种月23日 抵达宝库了。这里有个仍在奏效的音调锁。从这些尸体判断，陷阱应该也启动着。 找不到任何线索，因此我要画张草图，然后仔细琢磨琢磨这东西。五个调谐器。五个音调盘。必须依照正确的顺序敲击它们。我看看…… [pagebreak]

Day 14
I knew I should have volunteered for the excavation earlier. For months, Moric had been going on to the Vigilants about detecting mystical energies deep in the east mountains. Said he'd found some old tomes about the ruins of "Ruunvald," or something the like, a Nordic chamber thousands of years old. I remember thinking "Yeah, if it's so old, how come no one's found it yet? There's plenty of adventurers wandering around these parts."
Seemed like most of the other Vigilants agreed, we had more important things to do. But Moric took a team and went digging, and when he started turning up a long buried temple, well, didn't I feel like a troll in a dung heap.
Soon enough, he was sending back letters to the Hall, begging for as many men as we could send. I didn't volunteer at first, still seemed like a myth to me. But when word came back that they'd hit the main chamber, I packed up and headed this way to help. Always did want to be a part of history, and better late than never, they say.
Well, "they" didn't mention that the late comers would be stuck with guard duty. I just sit up here all day, watching for bandits and wolves, neither of which I've seen. Mostly I just see diggers coming up for supplies. Gotta say, I been seeing them a lot less regular, now that I think about it... Day 19
All right, it's been 3 days since anyone's come up. The last one to emerge was Apa, and he just walked around a bit with a weird vacant look in his eyes. Told Florentius and me to come down as soon as we had the chance, then trudged back in.
Something ain't right, and I aims to find out what...
- Volk
traduit:
14日
早知道我就早点主动申请参加挖掘了。墨里克跟警戒者们念叨了几个月，说他检测到东边山脉深处有神秘能量，还说他找到了一些古籍，记载着一处叫什么“鲁恩瓦德”的遗迹，是一座拥有数千年历史的诺德墓穴。我记得我当时想：“是啊，如果有这么古老的话，怎么会没人发现它呢？这一带可到处都是冒险者呀。”
其他大部分警戒者似乎也觉得我们有更重要的事情要做。不过墨里克还是带了一支队伍去挖掘了，等他真的挖掘出一座掩埋已久的神殿时，哎，我觉得自己简直像个掉进粪堆的巨魔。
没过多久，他就往大厅寄信，恳求我们尽可能多派人手支援。我一开始没有报名，总觉得这事儿虚无缥缈。不过当听说他们挖到主厅时，我收拾好了行李就去帮忙了。我总是想留名青史，而且人们常说嘛，迟到总比不到强。
呃，“人们”可没说迟到的话会被困在守卫的岗位上啊。我整天整天坐在这儿，要防备强盗或者狼，不过我啥也没看见。大部分时候我只能看见挖掘的人来取补给。不过，这么一说我才发现，他们上来的次数好像越来越少了…… 19日
好吧，已经三天没人上来了。最后出现的人是阿帕，他只是四处晃了晃，眼睛里带着一种怪异的茫然。他让佛伦提乌斯和我有空就下去看看，然后就拖着步子回去了。
有点不对劲，我得去搞清楚……
——沃克

original:
[pagebreak]

Notes on Dimhollow Crypt x Vol. 3 As written by Adalvald

[pagebreak]

Divines be praised! Here at last is the breakthrough I have been seeking. All the dangers I have escaped, the traps I have eluded and the foul draugr I have avoided have brought me at last to this. In my previous volume of notes and observations regarding Dimhollow Crypt's possible connections to the ancient vampire clans of Skyrim's history, I wrote of a great chamber, far larger than anything else I've yet seen here in the crypt. Alas, a few wandering draugr forced me to retreat to the earlier passages of the crypt, thus depriving me of an opportunity to study this huge cavern. Well, praise be to Stendarr, for as I write this, I have just spent nearly a full day exploring that very cavern. It was a risk that proved more than worth it, because what I found in that chamber nearly defies description. Central to this huge cavern is an island of stone in a subterranean lake. Upon this island is something I can only describe as an elaborate ceremonial construction surrounded by stone columns linked by arches. There is no mistaking the stark contrast in architecture here; no ancient Nords made this stonework. Here, too, were more of the gargoyle statues that I first glimpsed in earlier passageways. There is no draugr burial site in Skyrim that contains these statues, save Dimhollow Crypt. Indeed, I am now certain that the strange construct in this main chamber was built long after the crypt, and by wholly different masters. These must be the same builders who placed the gargoyles through the crypt, perhaps to frighten away the curious. All signs seem to indicate that the masons who crafted these strange arches were servants of some ancient master who favored necromancy or vampirism. The style and craftsmanship in the stonework are not only distinct in terms of design, seeming to speak of an entirely different culture than that of the old Nord peoples, but also in skill with which they were fashioned. The cutting and shaping of the stone, for example, suggests more sophisticated tools than the crypt's original architects would have possessed. Although I feel a sense of exhilaration that my theories have at last been confirmed beyond any shadow of a doubt, I am also disappointed at the lack of answers. How long ago were these new features added to the crypt? And by whom? And for what purpose? On one point, I have no doubts. I must return to the Hall of the Vigilant and share these findings with my brothers and sisters. When they see what I've discovered with their own eyes, they will no longer scoff at my theories or mock my endeavors. And when that is done, I will return to my work. For now, Dimhollow Crypt might be a mystery, but by Stendarr I will see that mystery solved.

[pagebreak]

幽空地穴的笔记 第三卷 阿达瓦尔德 著

[pagebreak]

多谢圣灵保佑！这就是我一直在找的重大突破。我所躲过的危险，绕开的陷阱，避开的肮脏尸鬼，终于让我走到了这一步。 上一卷中，我说幽空地穴可能与天际历史上的古老吸血鬼氏族存在联系，还提及了一座大厅，比我在地穴中看到的任何东西都要大得多。 哎，几个游荡的尸鬼逼得我退回到地穴前面的通道里去了，这样我就没机会研究这座巨大的墓穴了。 嗯，赞美斯丹达尔，当我写下这些的时候，我已经探索这座地穴足足快一天了。 事实证明，这次冒险是值得的，因为我在这大厅里发现的东西几乎无法用言语描述。 这座巨大地穴的中央是地下湖中的一座石头岛。这岛上的东西，我只能将其描述为一座精心设计的仪式用建筑，周遭是由拱门连接的石柱。 毫无疑问，此地的建筑与古诺德人的石雕形成了鲜明的对比，绝非出自诺德人之手。这里也有更多的石像鬼雕像，我之前也在通道里瞥见过。 除了幽空地穴，天际没有哪一处埋葬尸鬼的地方有这些雕像。 实际上，我现在肯定这主室里的奇怪建筑是墓穴修建后很久才由完全不同的主人所建造的。这些人肯定就是把石像鬼放置在墓穴里的建造者，也许是为了吓跑好奇的人。 所有迹象都表明，那些雕刻这些怪异拱门的石匠似乎侍奉某个喜欢死灵法术或者吸血鬼的古老主人。 石雕的风格和工艺不仅在设计上与众不同，似乎也来自与古诺德人完全不同的文化，这些差异也体现在了它们的制作工艺上。 例如，从石头的切割和形状来看，它所使用的工具比地下室最初的建造者们所使用的工具更加复杂。 尽管我为终于能确凿证明自己的理论而感到兴奋，但我也对答案的缺失而感到失望。这些新特征是多久以前加进地穴的呢？是谁加的？又是为了何种目的？ 但有一点，我毫不怀疑。我必须回警戒者之厅，与兄弟姐妹们分享这些发现。当他们亲眼见到我的发现时，他们就不会再嘲笑我的理论或者努力了。 这事办完之后，我就得回去工作了。就目前来看，幽空地穴可能还是一团谜，不过斯丹达尔在上，我会解开谜题的。

The Aetherium Wars by Taron Dreth Dedicated to Katria, my Friend and Colleague

[pagebreak]

he end, when it came, was swift. In the span of three short years, the great dwarven cities of Skyrim, from Markarth to the Velothi Mountains, fell before the armies of the High King. Cities that had held fast against the Nords for over a hundred years crumbled abruptly and without warning. For centuries, scholars have marveled at the sudden collapse of the Dwemer city-states. Even the Nords seem to have been taken by surprise, though their chroniclers were quick to ascribe their success to King Gellir's inspired tactics and the blessings of Shor. My research suggests a much different cause, however. In the decades preceding their fall, the dwarven cities of Skyrim had been decimated by internal disputes and infighting over a most surprising cause: Aetherium. Modern scholars know Aetherium as a rare, luminescent blue crystal found in some Dwemer ruins. Most consider it little more than a curiosity, as it has proven all but impossible to work with: while it has a strong magical aura, it is alchemically inert, and no known process can enchant, smelt, mold, bind, or break it. [pagebreak] To the dwarves, of course, such problems were merely a challenge. In the years following King Harald's reign, the Dwemer discovered a considerable source of Aetherium in their deepest delvings. An alliance of four cities, led by Arkngthamz, the great research center in the southern Reach, was formed to oversee its extraction, processing, and study, and a new 'Aetherium Forge' constructed to smelt it under precisely controlled conditions. If the inscriptions I discovered are to be believed, the results were nothing short of spectacular: the items produced by the Forge were artifacts of immense power, imbued from the moment of their creation with powerful enchantments. The dwarven alliance shattered almost immediately, as the four city-states and their rivals attempted to claim the Forge. [pagebreak] We can only speculate that none were successful. Decades of conflict merely weakened them all, allowing for King Gellir's subsequent conquests. And though the Dwemer reclaimed most of their lands a century later, there is no evidence that they ever resumed their research on Aetherium. Perhaps the costs had just been too great. [pagebreak] But nothing like the Aetherium Forge described in the inscriptions has ever been found within the borders of Skyrim. It may have been destroyed long ago, by the Nord invaders or the Dwemer themselves. Or perhaps it, like the secrets of Aetherium itself, still remains to be discovered.

[pagebreak]

神光水晶之战 泰荣·德莱瑟 著 感谢我的朋友和同事， 卡提雅

[pagebreak]

结局说来就来。在短短三年时间里，从马卡斯到维洛锡山脉，天际广大的矮人城市在至高王的军队面前沦陷了。抵抗诺德一百多年的一众城邦，在毫无征兆的情况下迅速消亡。 几百年来，学者们一直对锻莫城邦的突然陷落感到惊讶。即便是诺德人似乎也很是吃惊，不过他们的记录者们很快就将他们的成功归功于格利尔王突发奇想的战术以及舒尔的祝福。 我的研究则表明了一个截然不同的原因。在陷落前的几十年里，天际的矮人城市因一个令人惊讶的原因——神光水晶——而发生了内部纠纷和内讧。 现代学者们知道神光水晶是一种发现于锻莫遗迹中稀有的发光蓝色晶体。大部分人觉得它就是个奇珍异玩而已，因为事实证明，尽管它拥有强大的魔法气息，却几乎不能加以利用。加之在炼金上的惰性，任何已知的工艺都无法令其附魔、冶炼、浇铸、凝结或破碎。 [pagebreak] 不过对于矮人而言，这些问题仅仅只是个挑战罢了。在哈拉尔德王统治下的几年里，锻莫在他们最深入的挖掘工程中发现了数量可观的神光水晶。由阿肯撒兹领导四座城市组成的联盟，负责监督其开采、加工、研究并建造了一座能够在精确可控的条件下将其冶炼的“神光水晶锻炉”。 如果我发现的铭文是可信的，那结果无疑非常惊人：锻炉生产的物品从诞生的那一刻起就充满魔力，是充满巨大力量的神器。由于四座城邦和它们的对手都想抢走熔炉，矮人联盟几乎立刻就瓦解了。 [pagebreak] 我们只能推测没有人成功。几十年来的冲突只是削弱了他们所有人，从而导致格利尔随后占领了这些地区。尽管一百年后锻莫重新夺回了大部分的土地，但没有证据表明他们重启了对神光水晶的研究。也许是因为代价实在太大了。 [pagebreak] 不过天际境内从没发现过类似铭文中描述的神光水晶锻炉的东西。它一定很久之前就被诺德入侵者或者锻莫自己给毁了。或者锻炉就像神光水晶本身的秘密一样，仍有待发掘。

I will make my way into the Soul Cairn tomorrow after I gather my things and prepare for a potentially lengthy exile. More importantly, I must enact my plans with Serana, and get her to Dimhollow Crypt as soon as possible.
traduit: 末种月27日 哈孔的短视正在变成一个严重的问题。我一次又一次警告他，他那愚蠢的预言会给我们的族人引起太多注意，但我说的话他一句都不听。在他眼里，我不再是妻子，而是一个麻烦鬼。埋头于工作是我在忍受他那愚蠢的行动时唯一的慰藉了。 末种月28日 我今天有了个突破。我能使用少量材料，把传送通道正确地与灵魂石冢相协调。尽管传送门只打开了几秒钟，但我相信只要配方正确，它就可以无限期维持下去。我想我少了一种关键成分，一种有足够效力的物质来抵制那股试图阻止我侵入的力量。事实证明，与理想之主交流毫无价值。无论是否保证供应充足的灵魂，他们都在当谜语人，也不提供帮助。如果我想逃离哈孔的魔掌，我得让传送门开得足够久，好带我离开这里... ...如果有必要的话，是永远离开这里。 炉火月3日 成功了！在浪费成千上万金币买的原料后，我找到了维持传送门的方法。为了自保，以下列出的成分没有标明正确的数量。作为第二道保险，我要把自己的血液加入配方，这样就没有人能复制它，跟着我进灵魂石冢了。 配方包括： 精研骨粉 纯净虚无盐 灵魂石碎片 称取适量，将上述物质置于镶银边的传送门管道，加入血液作为活性剂。 明天我就准备，收拾出漫长流放之旅所需的东西后，进入灵魂石冢。更重要的是，我必须执行我跟瑟拉娜的计划，尽快带她去幽空地穴。

original: Dawnguard Orders - Lynoit
traduit: 黎明守卫命令——利诺特

original:
<font face='$HandwrittenFont' size='16'>
Lynoit,

We've received word of an increase in Vampire activity in western Skyrim. In the coming weeks, we plan to dispatch several more agents to the region, and need to establish a network of wilderness supply drops to support them.

You are to plant caches in the following locations: 
 - On the small island south of Solitude Sawmill.
 - Due east of the entrance to the ruin Volskygge.
 - On the east side of Karthwasten Bridge.
 
If these reports are to be believed, the situation may be far more dangerous than you realize. Be cautious.
</font>
traduit:
<font face='$HandwrittenFont' size='16'>
利诺特：

我们接到消息，西天际的吸血鬼活动有所增加。接下来几周，我们计划加派特工到该地区，并建立一个野外补给网络来支持他们。

你要在以下地点设立隐秘点：
-独孤城伐木场南边的小岛上。
-沃尔斯盖吉遗迹入口正东。
-卡斯威斯腾桥东侧。

如果报告属实，那么情况可能比你想象的还要危险。多加小心。
</font>

original: Dawnguard Orders - Hakar
traduit: 黎明守卫命令——哈卡尔

original:
<font face='$HandwrittenFont' size='16'>
Novice Hakar,

Your repeated failures are an embarrassment to our entire order. Are you truly so inept you cannot even complete a simple courier mission?

You have one last chance to redeem yourself. We recently established a number of wilderness caches to supply our agents in the field. You are to restock the chests listed below, then report back for further orders.

Our caches in Whiterun Hold are located:
 - In Rorikstead, in the pasture behind Frostfruit Inn.
 - Near Stendarr's Shrine in the center of the tundra.
 - South of Whiterun's Western Watchtower.

You have one week. Return successful, or not at all.
</font>
traduit:
<font face='$HandwrittenFont' size='16'>
新手哈卡尔：
你一再的失败让全教团都为之尴尬。你真的笨到连个简单的送信任务都完成不了了吗？

最后给你一次挽回失败的机会。我们最近新建立了一批野外隐秘点，为我们的外出人员提供物资补给。你需要去补充下列箱子，再回来报告领取进一步的任务。

我们在白漫领的隐秘点位于：

-洛利克镇霜果旅店后面的田场。
-苔原中心地区斯丹达尔祭坛附近。
-白漫城西部哨塔南部。

你有一周时间。要是不成功，就别回来了。
</font>

original: Dawnguard Orders - Saliah
traduit: 黎明守卫命令——莎莉亚

original:
<font face='$HandwrittenFont' size='17'>
Saliah,

In the past several weeks, all of the couriers sent to replenish our supply caches in the northern reaches have gone missing. These drops must be made within the week to ensure our operatives have the provisions they need.

You are to restock the following caches:
 - In Morthal, on the islet due east of the mill.
 - Outside Nightgate Inn, at the foot of the pier.
 - Near Winterhold, under the great arch.
 
Take care. Too many of our agents have been lost on this task already.
</font>
traduit:
<font face='$HandwrittenFont' size='17'>
莎莉亚：

过去几周，派往北部地区送货的人都失踪了。这批货物是我们的人需要的补给，必须在一周内送到他们手里。

你需要去补充以下隐秘点：
-莫萨尔城，在伐木场正东的小岛上。
-夜扉旅店外的码头下。
-冬堡附近的大拱门下。

务必当心，我们已经因此牺牲太多人了。
</font>

original: I'll bring you everything we have on them, but it's not much.
traduit: 我会把所有有关它们的资料都给你，不过不太多。

original: So don't get your hopes up. It's mostly lies, leavened with rumor and conjecture.
traduit: 所以不要抱太大希望。大部分都是些夹杂着谣传和猜测的谎言。

original: What brings you to this remote place?
traduit: 你在这种遥远的地方干什么？

original: The ice entombs the heart. The bane of Kagrenac and Dagoth Ur.
traduit: 冰雪埋藏了心脏。这是卡格瑞纳克与达格斯·乌尔的祸根。

original: To harness it is to know. The fundaments. The Dwemer lockbox hides it from me.
traduit: 想要驾驭它就要了解它。很简单的道理。但锻莫的密锁箱把它和我隔绝了。

original: The Elder Scroll gives insight deeper than the deep ones, though. To bring about the opening.
traduit: 上古卷轴提供了比深地之民更深刻的洞察力。能够带来打开它的方法。

original: Where can I learn more about magic?
traduit: 从哪里能学到更多魔法？

original: Where did he go?
traduit: 他去哪里了？

original: Somewhere up north, in the ice fields.
traduit: 在北边冰原的某处。

original: Said he found some old Dwemer artifact, but... well, that was years ago.
traduit: 他说自己找到了一些锻莫古器……不过那是很多年前的事了。

original: Haven't heard from him since.
traduit: 从那以后就没他的音信了。

original: He's dead?
traduit: 他死了？

original: Oh no. I hope not. But even I haven't seen him in years, and we were close.
traduit: 啊，没有。我希望他还活着。不过我已经很多年没见过他了。我们关系很不错的。

original: Became obsessed with the Dwemer. Took off north saying he had found some old artifact. Haven't seen him since.
traduit: 他被锻莫迷住了。一路向北，说他发现了一件锻莫古器物。从那以后就没再见过他。

original: Somewhere in the ice fields, if you want to try to find him.
traduit: 如果想找他，他应该就在冰原的某处。

traduit: 你有什么卖的吗？

original: Got a pretty full stock of potions and alchemy reagents.
traduit: 这里有很多药水和炼金原料。

original: I've helped your people.
traduit: 我帮助过您的人民了。

original: DialogueRiftenGoodbyes
traduit: DialogueRiftenGoodbyes

original: What does it mean to be a werewolf?
traduit: 成为狼人意味着什么？

original: Nothing, until you choose to use it.
traduit: 没什么。直到你选择使用它。

original: Then, well... you got a taste. Stronger, faster.
traduit: 然后，嗯……你已经尝试过了。更强了，也更敏捷了。

original: It doesn't last long, though. The blood of your foes can sustain you. If you're willing to feed.
traduit: 不过不会持续太久。如果你愿意啃食的话，敌人的血可以维持你的形态。

original: I seek the knowledge of the Elder Scrolls.
traduit: 我来寻找关于上古卷轴的知识。

original: Do you?
traduit: 是吗？

original: It is true there are some here who have spent years studying the accumulated knowledge of the scrolls.
traduit: 确实，这里的人花了很多年研究卷轴积累的知识。

original: But what you seek does not come easily, and can destroy those without a strong will.
traduit: 但你所求并非寻常之物，意志不坚是会被摧毁的。

original: I will see you dead, monster.
traduit: 去死吧，怪物。

original: Living with you would be perfect.
traduit: 和你住在一起真是太完美了。

original: We could live in my house in Whiterun.
traduit: 我们可以住在我在白漫城的房子里。

original: I have a house in Riften.
traduit: 我在裂谷城有所房子。

original: My house in Markarth would be perfect.
traduit: 我在马卡斯的房子会很完美。

original: How about my house in Windhelm?
traduit: 我在风舵的房子怎么样？

original: Let's live in my house in Solitude.
traduit: 那咱们就住我在独孤城的房子吧。

original: Your old place would suit us just fine.
traduit: 你的旧宅很适合咱们的。

original: Breezehome, my house in Whiterun.
traduit: 微风阁，我在白漫城的房子。

original: Honeyside, my house in Riften.
traduit: 甜蜜湾，我在裂谷的房子。

original: Vlindrel Hall, my house in Markarth.
traduit: 林德尔会堂，我在马卡斯的房子。

original: Hjerim, my house in Windhelm.
traduit: 霜斋，我在风舵城的房子。

original: Proudspire Manor, my house in Solitude.
traduit: 豪塔别墅，我在独孤城的房子。

original: I'd like us to move somewhere else.
traduit: 我们搬到别处住吧。

original: I'd like to decorate my home.
traduit: 我想装修一下我家。

original: Bedroom furnishings. (<Global=HDWhiterunBedroom> gold)
traduit: 卧室家具。（<Global=HDWhiterunBedroom>金币）

original: Bedroom furnishings. (<Global=HDRiftenBedroom> gold)
traduit: 卧室家具。（<Global=HDRiftenBedroom>金币）

original: Enchanting laboratory. (<Global=HDRiftenEnchanting> gold)
traduit: 附魔实验室。（<Global=HDRiftenEnchanting>金币）

original: Garden. (<Global=HDRiftenGarden> gold)
traduit: 花园。（<Global=HDRiftenGarden>金币）

original: Living room. (<Global=HDSolitudeLiving> gold)
traduit: 客厅。（<Global=HDSolitudeLiving>金币）

original: Bedroom. (<Global=HDSolitudeBedroom> gold)
traduit: 卧室。（<Global=HDSolitudeBedroom>金币）

original: What about the Dragonborn?
traduit: 那龙裔呢？

original: What about... wait. Are you? Were you the one the Greybeards were calling?
traduit: 那龙……等等。是你？你就是被灰胡子召唤的龙裔？

original: I'm looking for an Elder Scroll.
traduit: 我在找上古卷轴。

original: And what do you plan to do with it? Do you even know what you're asking about, or are you just someone's errand girl?
traduit: 你打算用它干什么？你知道自己在问什么吗，还是小姑娘你单纯在帮人跑腿？

original: And what do you plan to do with it? Do you even know what you're asking about?
traduit: 你计划对它做什么呢？你知道你在问什么吗？

original: Alchemy laboratory. (<Global=HDMarkarthAlchemy> gold)
traduit: 炼金实验室（<Global=HDMarkarthAlchemy>金币）

original: Armory. (<Global=HDWindhelmArmory> gold)
traduit: 武器室。（<Global=HDWindhelmArmory>金币）

original: Bedroom furnishings. (<Global=HDWindhelmBedroom> gold)
traduit: 卧室家具。（<Global=HDWindhelmBedroom>金币）

original: Werewolf!
traduit: 狼人！

original: It's a werewolf! To arms! To arms!
traduit: 是狼人！抄家伙！抄家伙！

original: We're done with this when none of them are left standing. Let's go.
traduit: 杀得他们一个不剩就结束了。走吧。

original: And now... I think I can rest. Farewell, my friend, wherever your travels take you.
traduit: 而现在……我可以安息了。无论你路向何方，都请保重，永别了，我的朋友。

original: So, the beast is destroyed.
traduit: 这样一来，怪物被消灭了。

original: Not only that, but Auriel's Bow is in safe hands.
traduit: 不止如此，奥瑞艾尔之弓也得到了妥善保管。

original: The Dawnguard will now be dedicated to safeguarding it, making sure that prophecy will never come to pass.
traduit: 黎明守卫现在将全力守卫这把弓，确保预言永无实现之日。

original: You've served Skyrim well.
traduit: 你为天际立下了大功。

original: Even with these vampires gone, the fight isn't completely over. Once we're settled back in at the fort, there will be more work to do.
traduit: 即使没了这些吸血鬼，战斗也还没完全结束。我们回到堡垒后就有更多工作要做了。

original: We'd be honored to have you join us.
traduit: 如果有你加入，我们会十分荣幸。

original: Where did the Dawnguard come from?
traduit: 黎明守卫是怎么来的？

original: Vampires need to be dealt with. Hunted, rooted out, destroyed.
traduit: 总得有人去猎杀，根除，摧毁吸血鬼。

original: Once there was a group dedicated to a similar cause. They called themselves the Dawnguard.
traduit: 曾有一个组织致力于类似的事业，他们自称黎明守卫。

original: That was a long time ago, but the idea was, and is, a good one. That's why I'm bringing it back.
traduit: 那是很久以前了，但这个主意过去是，现在也是好主意。这就是为什么我要使其复生。

original: This latest attack proves it's the right time.
traduit: 最近的这次袭击证明时机合适了。

original: Well, maybe it really is time to resurrect the Dawnguard.
traduit: 嗯，也许是时候重建黎明守卫了。

original: Well it was... Thank the Vigilants for ruining that.
traduit: 嗯那就要……感谢警戒者们把它毁了。

original: Ugh. I thought this place was supposed to be secret?
traduit: 啊。我还以为这地方够隐秘。

original: Hold it! He's the one Tolan mentioned.
traduit: 等等！他就是托兰提过的那个人。

original: Hold it! She's the one Tolan mentioned.
traduit: 等等！她就是托兰提过的那个人。

original: Here comes another one!
traduit: 又来一个！

original: How can I help him?
traduit: 我该怎么帮他？

original: Arvak! Arvak, where are you? Arvak, please come back! Come back!
traduit: 阿瓦克！阿瓦克你去哪儿了？阿瓦克，快回来！回来！

original: Please, he's such a loyal creature, and he's been running for so long. You have to save him! A place like this will change you...
traduit: 求求你了，他这么忠诚，也载我跑了这么久了。你得救救他！这种地方会改变你们……

original: Calm down. Who's Arvak?
traduit: 冷静点。谁是阿瓦克？

original: Arvak. My horse. We came to this horrible place together. We were attacked by monsters, so I told him to run.
traduit: 阿瓦克，我的马。我们一起来到这恐怖的地方，被怪物袭击了，所以我叫他快跑。

original: You must help me find my Arvak. He doesn't deserve to be in a place like this!
traduit: 你得帮我找到阿瓦克，他不该来这种地方！

original: Where do I begin?
traduit: 我从哪里开始？

original: The only way to get to my brother is by following in the Initiates' footsteps and traveling from wayshrine to wayshrine just as they did.
traduit: 找到我兄弟的唯一办法就是跟随新人的足迹，从一个路龛到另一个路龛，就像他们一样。

original: The first lay at the end of Darkfall Passage, a cavern that represents the absence of enlightenment.
traduit: 第一个在暗瀑通道的尽头，一个代表未经启蒙的洞穴。

original: Good, they should be able to help us.
traduit: 很好，他们应该能帮我们。

original: I'm afraid in their current form, they still believe the Chantry to be an active center of worship.
traduit: 恐怕以目前的情况，他们还以为神殿依然是活跃的信仰中心。

original: They won't respond to you in any way other than believing that you're an Initiate and you're undertaking the journey to the Inner Sanctum.
traduit: 他们不会以任何方式回应你，除了认为你是一个新人，正在进行通往内殿的旅程。

original: Who are the spectral Prelates you mentioned?
traduit: 你提到的“幽灵教士”是谁？

original: They're ghosts of the snow elf priests that tended the wayshrines before being slaughtered by the Betrayed.
traduit: 他们是雪精灵祭司的鬼魂，在被背叛者屠杀前，他们照看着路龛。

original: Through the grace of Auri-El, they were restored to their spectral form to enable them to continue their duties.
traduit: 多亏奥瑞艾尔的恩典，他们恢复成了幽灵形态，得以继续履行职责。

original: So, let's get this straight.
traduit: 那么，我们来捋一捋。

original: We need to do all that nonsense to get into the temple, so we can kill your brother and claim Auriel's Bow?
traduit: 我们得做那么多毫无意义的事情才能进神殿，然后杀了你兄弟拿到奥瑞艾尔之弓？

original: Wayshrine?
traduit: 路龛？

original: Yes, let me show you.
traduit: 对，我来给你展示一下。

original: What exactly did the Betrayed do?
traduit: 这些背叛者到底做了什么？

original: They swept into the Chantry without warning and began killing everyone without pause.
traduit: 他们毫无征兆地冲进神殿，开始不停地屠杀每一个人。

original: I imagine you know why we're here.
traduit: 你应该知道我们为什么要来这里。

original: Of course. You're here for Auriel's Bow. Why else would you be here?
traduit: 当然，你们是在找奥瑞艾尔之弓，不然还能是为什么呢？

original: I can help you get it, but first I must have your assistance.
traduit: 我能帮你找到它，但首先你们得帮我。

original: Why?
traduit: 为什么？

original: Because that means there's still hope that they might one day shed their hatred and learn to believe in Auri-El once again.
traduit: 因为这意味着他们还有希望，某一天能放下仇恨，重新信奉奥瑞艾尔。

original: It's been a long time since I felt that way and it's been long overdue. My thanks, to both of you.
traduit: 我很久没有过这样的感觉了，早该如此。多谢你们二位。

original: He was a vampire. He controlled them.
traduit: 他是个吸血鬼，是他操纵了它们。

original: A vampire?
traduit: 吸血鬼？

original: I see. That would explain much.
traduit: 懂了，那就说得通了。

original: Deep inside, it brings me joy that the Betrayed weren't to blame for what happened here.
traduit: 我内心深处其实很庆幸，原来这里发生的一切不是背叛者们造成的。

original: You took a big risk coming here.
traduit: 你来这里冒了很大的险。

original: I did. But something about you makes me think I can trust you. I hope I'm not wrong.
traduit: 确实。但你身上的某种特质让我觉得可以相信你。但愿我没看走眼。

original: Anyway, my mother and I didn't feel like inviting a war with all of Tamriel, so we tried to stop him. That's why I was sealed away with the Scroll.
traduit: 不论如何，我们母女不想和整个泰姆瑞尔为敌，所以试着阻止他。这就是我跟卷轴一起被封印的原因了。

original: What do you mean... "lost himself"?
traduit: “他陷进去了”……是什么意思？

original: He just became absorbed... obsessed. It was kind of sick, actually.
traduit: 他变得专注……痴迷。实际上，已经有些病态了。

original: The prophecy said that vampires would no longer need to fear the sun. For someone who fancied himself as vampire royalty, that's pretty seductive.
traduit: 预言说吸血鬼不用再害怕太阳了。对于一个自诩为吸血鬼王室成员的人来说，这相当诱人。

original: I wonder what these souls do all day. They look... bored.
traduit: 我想知道这些灵魂成天都干些什么。他们似乎很……无聊。

original: Be careful with those crystals. They feel... hungry.
traduit: 当心这些水晶。它们感觉……很饥渴。

original: Another one of those things. Let's keep our distance.
traduit: 又是那些东西。我们离它远点吧。

original: Ugh. The smell here... let's try to handle this quickly.
traduit: 呃。这儿的味道……我们赶紧把事情办了吧。

original: This better not be all the things you just can't be bothered with.
traduit: 最好别把你不要的都丢给我。

original: Anything good?
traduit: 有好东西吗？

original: If you think it'll help.
traduit: 如果你觉得有用的话。

original: All right, let's see what you have.
traduit: 好吧，看看你有什么。

original: Why don't you keep your things, and I'll keep mine.
traduit: 还是你背你的，我背我的吧。

original: I think I'll hang on to my things, thank you.
traduit: 我觉得还是自己背自己的吧，谢了。

original: Hands to yourself.
traduit: 拿你自己的。

original: Not going to happen.
traduit: 没门儿。

original: My congratulations on defeating Harkon. Clearly, you are the superior vampire.
traduit: 恭喜您击败了哈孔。显然，您是更为高贵的吸血鬼。

original: You are the new Master; we bow to your power. A power which, I note, includes Auriel's Bow.
traduit: 您是新主人了，我们都臣服于您的力量。我注意到这力量中还包括了奥瑞艾尔之弓。

original: The castle, of course, is yours. We shall follow you, and help spread your influence across Skyrim.
traduit: 城堡当然属于您了。我们将追随、帮助您在天际传播影响力。

original: Run, coward! Run back to the filthy Dawnguard!
traduit: 滚吧，懦夫！滚回那肮脏的黎明守卫！

original: Run, coward! You're a traitor to your race!
traduit: 滚吧，懦夫！你就是你们族类的叛徒！

original: When I find you, I'm going to gut you like a deer and feast upon you blood!
traduit: 等找到你，我要把你像宰鹿一样开膛破肚，喝干血液！

original: Enough games, let's finish this!
traduit: 游戏玩够了！结束吧！

original: It ends here!
traduit: 到此为止！

original: I'll rend the flesh from your bones!
traduit: 我要把你剔骨抽筋！

original: I will darken the skies!
traduit: 我会遮蔽天幕！

original: Auriel's Bow will be mine!
traduit: 奥瑞艾尔之弓是我的！

original: What trickery is this?
traduit: 这是什么诡计？

original: Hiding won't help you!
traduit: 躲藏救不了你！

original: No... Serana... your own father....
traduit: 不……瑟拉娜……你的亲生父亲……

original: Die, mortal!
traduit: 死吧，凡人！

original: Die, traitor!
traduit: 死吧，叛徒！

original: Your blood will be mine!
traduit: 你的血归我了！

original: I'll drain the life from you!
traduit: 我要吸干你的血！

original: I should have killed you and your mother long ago!
traduit: 早该把你跟你妈都杀了！

original: I'll make you pay for this, daughter!
traduit: 你要付出代价，女儿！

original: You dare defy your father?!
traduit: 竟敢违抗你的父亲？！

original: First you die, then Serana suffers!
traduit: 首先宰了你，然后是瑟拉娜！

original: Serana isn't yours, she's mine!
traduit: 瑟拉娜可不归你，她是我的！

original: You've turned her against me!
traduit: 就是你让她和我反目！

original: Die, you traitorous dog!
traduit: 死吧，你个叛徒！

original: How dare you disobey me!
traduit: 你敢违抗我！

original: You'll pay for your insolence!
traduit: 为自己的傲慢付出代价吧！

original: You can't stop the prophecy!
traduit: 你阻止不了预言！

original: I'll rip the Dawnguard apart!
traduit: 我要把黎明守卫连根拔起！

original: I despise your presence, mortal!
traduit: 下贱的凡人！

original: May Auri-El keep you free from harm.
traduit: 愿奥瑞-艾尔保你免受伤害。

original: May Auri-El watch over you.
traduit: 愿奥瑞-艾尔护佑你。

original: May Auri-El light your path.
traduit: 愿奥瑞-艾尔照亮你的道路。

original: Look, take whatever you want. I'm getting out of here!
traduit: 听着，拿上你想拿的。我可要走了！

original: Help me!
traduit: 救我！

original: I'm getting out of here!
traduit: 我要离开这里！

original: Gods, Vampires! I... I can't take this anymore! I'm not cut out for this!
traduit: 神啊，吸血鬼！我……我受不了了！我可搞不定这个！

original: Stand aside!
traduit: 靠边！

original: Forgive me, but I am on urgent business for the Dawnguard. I have no time to speak with you.
traduit: 抱歉，我找黎明守卫有急事。我没空跟你说话。

original: Forgive me, but I am on urgent business for the Dawnguard. Stand aside!
traduit: 抱歉，不过我找黎明守卫有急事。靠边去！

original: Halt, vampire!
traduit: 站住，吸血鬼！

original: Your end has come!
traduit: 你的末日到了。

original: Light take you!
traduit: 圣光将制裁你！

original: Death to the Dawnguard!
traduit: 黎明守卫，去死吧！

original: Perish, worm!
traduit: 死吧，臭虫子！

original: Shadows take you!
traduit: 让阴影带走你！

original: That's close enough, fool. Now you die!
traduit: 够近了，蠢蛋。现在去死吧！

original: You there! Traveler! Over here!
