traduit: 我干掉了在<Alias=Dungeon>的<Alias=Vampire>。

original: Excellent. That's one less beast and nest of broodlings we needn't worry about any longer.
traduit: 很好，又少了一头野兽以及一窝幼崽要担心了。

original: We need to destroy him before he turns his comrades into a brood of vampires.
traduit: 我们得在他把这些战友们变成一群吸血鬼之前干掉他。

original: He's holed up with a group of a bandits.
traduit: 他跟一群强盗躲在一块儿。

original: He's holed up with a group of a necromancers.
traduit: 他跟一群死灵法师躲在一块儿。

original: I've found another beast hiding from the light of day.
traduit: 我发现了另一头躲避阳光的野兽。

original: The <Alias=Boss> at <Alias=Dungeon> has been destroyed.
traduit: 我干掉了在<Alias=Dungeon>的<Alias=Boss>。

original: Very good, though I suspect there's more wherever he came from.
traduit: 干得好，不过我怀疑还会有更多。

original: We cannot afford to relax.
traduit: 我们可不能掉以轻心。

original: I've discovered the whereabouts of a vampire lair.
traduit: 我发现了一个吸血鬼巢穴。

original: Destroying the head vampire is usually sufficient to scatter its minions, though it's best to destroy every last one of them.
traduit: 干掉吸血鬼首领足以驱散他的仆从，当然最好是全部干掉。

original: I've killed the vampire masquerading as a <Alias=Target>.
traduit: 我杀了伪装为<Alias=Target>的吸血鬼。

original: Very good. That's one less monster we need to worry about.
traduit: 干得好，又少了一头需要担心的怪物。

original: Though there's plenty more where he came from. Be ever watchful.
traduit: 不过老巢里还多的是，保持警惕。

original: I've located the whereabouts of a vampire masquerading as a common citizen.
traduit: 我发现了一个伪装成普通市民的吸血鬼。

original: Track him down and dispose of him.
traduit: 找到他，然后干掉他。

original: Tread lightly. The law is unaware of the danger and will treat you as a criminal if you are caught.
traduit: 小心行事。当权者还不知道危险的存在，一旦被抓，会被当成罪犯的。

original: This is the power that I offer!
traduit: 这就是我赐予你的力量！

original: Now, make your choice!
traduit: 现在，选吧！

original: Have you decided? I am not a patient man.
traduit: 你决定好了吗？我可没什么耐心。

original: We usually feed on our visitors, but perhaps we'll make an exception in your case.
traduit: 我们经常以我们的访客为食，不过也许我们对你会破个例。

original: After so many centuries, I feared the Elder Scroll and my daughter were lost to me.
traduit: 这么多世纪了，我都担心上古卷轴和我女儿已经离我而去了。

original: You have brought my daughter back safely, and for that I am grateful.
traduit: 你把我女儿安全地带回来了，对此我很感激。

original: Unnnhhhh...
You wanted to speak to me?
traduit: 你想跟我谈谈吗？

original: Yes, I did. When I told you that I was grateful for my daughter's safe return, I told the truth. But I did not tell you everything.
traduit: 没错。之前我说过，感谢你带我的女儿平安归来，那是真心话。只是我并未对你道明一切。

original: Are you going to help?
traduit: 你会帮忙吗？

original: Well, I certainly can't help any less than the Vigilants of Stendarr, now can I?
traduit: 好吧，我当然不能比斯丹达尔的警戒者帮的少了，现在可以了吗？

original: Yes, I've been aiding Tolan.
traduit: 是的，我一直在帮托兰的忙。

original: It certainly seems the Vigilants of Stendarr can't help themselves. No surprise there.
traduit: 看来斯丹达尔的警戒者们也自顾不暇了，这并不奇怪。

original: So, it is real...
traduit: 看来，这是真的……

original: Well, don't just stand there!
traduit: 喂，别光站在那儿！

original: Goodbye
traduit: 再见

original: I think I could use your help.
traduit: 我觉得需要你的帮助。

original: What is it now?
traduit: 怎么了？

original: Was there something else?
traduit: 还有别的事吗？

original: Well, go on! What are you waiting for?
traduit: 喂，接着走啊？你还在等什么？

original: This one's mine!
traduit: 这个归我了！

original: Come on!
traduit: 快点！

original: Here we go...
traduit: 可以啊……

original: For those who cherish memories of loved ones, their compassion often conceals the beast.
traduit: 对于那些珍惜亲人记忆的人来说，他们往往会因为怜悯之心把野兽藏起来。

original: Our compassion compels us to destroy it.
traduit: 而我们的怜悯之心迫使我们去将其摧毁。

original: Perhaps you care to explain this letter then?
traduit: 那你能解释下这封信吗？

original: I see you've already taken it upon yourself to gather the information you seek.
traduit: 你要自己去收集你要的情报了。

original: Where'd you say this vampire was hiding?
traduit: 你说的这个吸血鬼藏在哪儿？

original: That letter's the last I've heard of him and mentions where he is. Now please, leave me alone.
traduit: 那封信是我最后听到有关他的消息，还提到了他的下落。现在别来烦我，求你了。

original: That letter's the last I've heard of her and mentions where she is. Now please, leave me alone.
traduit: 那封信是我最后听到有关她的消息，还提到了她的下落。现在别来烦我，求你了。

original: I'll get rough with you if I have to.
traduit: 必要的话，我可不介意对你动粗。

original: All right, calm down... Here, take this.
traduit: 好吧，冷静点……给，拿去吧。

original: I'll get rough with you if I have to. (Intimidate)
traduit: 必要的话，我可不介意对你动粗。（恐吓）

original: You don't scare me. Let's go.
traduit: 你还吓不到我，走着瞧。

original: I'll get rough with you if I have to. (Brawl)
traduit: 必要的话，我可不介意对你动粗。（打架）

original: You don't scare me.
traduit: 你吓不倒我。

original: Perhaps some coin will jog your memory? (<BribeCost> gold)
traduit: 或许这些金币能唤起你的记忆？（<BribeCost>金币）

original: Well... we weren't the closest of friends... Here, take this.
traduit: 嗯……现在咱俩算得上好朋友了……给，拿去吧。

original: Afraid my memory can't be bought with what you've got there.
traduit: 恐怕你的钱还不够买我的记忆。

original: Make this easier for you, tell me what I want to know. (Persuade)
traduit: 放轻松，告诉我想知道的吧。（说服）

original: All right... Here, take this.
traduit: 好吧……给，拿去吧。

original: Like I said. I don't know what you're talking about.
traduit: 我说过了，听不懂你在说什么。

original: I'm looking for a vampire.
traduit: 我在找一头吸血鬼。

original: I don't know what you're talking about.
traduit: 我不知道你在说什么。

original: I've learned of a possible monster.
traduit: 我听说有个潜在的怪物。

original: And while I do not know its exact whereabouts, I do have information suggesting someone who does.
traduit: 虽然不清楚准确下落，但情报表明确实有人知道。

original: Pay a visit to the beast's last known contact. Do what you must to find where it's hiding now.
traduit: 去拜访一下这头野兽最后的已知联系人，尽你所能找到它的藏身处。

original: Then root out the monster, and destroy it.
traduit: 然后斩草除根，彻底摧毁。

original: Indeed. It is no small thing to submit yourself to the flesh sculptor's knife.
traduit: 确实，把自己交给血肉雕刻师的刀可不是件小事。

original: Are you sure you know what you're doing?
traduit: 你知道自己在干什么吗？

original: I have not always been a ragged beggar. I learned my art from the masters of the art of flesh sculpture.
traduit: 别拿我当成臭乞丐，这技术可是从一个血肉雕刻师那里学到的。

original: I studied with the Faculty of Chirurgeons in Cloudrest. I walked with the Hollow-Faced Men of Nohotogrha for three years.
traduit: 我以前在云栖城的外科塑型师学院，跟随无面人诺霍塔格拉学了三年。

original: I count the nobility of both the Empire and the Dominion among my clients.
traduit: 帝国和先祖神洲的很多贵族们都是我的客户。

original: And yet, I have fallen so low that I must justify myself to a wanderer in the sewers of this backwater of the world.
traduit: 然而，我却沦落到如此地步，必须在这穷乡僻壤的阴沟里向一个流浪者证明自己。

original: Yes, I'd like you to change my appearance. (<Global=DLC1SurgeryCost> gold)
traduit: 对，我希望你给我整整容。（<Global=DLC1SurgeryCost>金币）

original: Hmm. Very well. Just tell me what you desire - beauty or hideous deformity, nothing is beyond my skill.
traduit: 嗯，好吧，告诉我你想变成啥样——变得好看或者丑成畸形，没什么是我做不到的。

original: Despite my present low estate, I am no beggar. Begone until you have the coin to warrant my skills.
traduit: 尽管我现在混的很惨，但也不是什么乞丐。起开，等你有钱了再来找我证明我的能力。

original: Why, are you interested in my services? I warn you, my skills do not come cheaply.
traduit: 为什么，你对我的服务感兴趣吗？先说清楚，我的技术可不便宜。

original: I do not practice my art for free, however. I doubt you can afford my services. You have the smell of the vagabond about you.
traduit: 要我表演技艺可不免费，我怀疑你付不了账。你身上带着一股流浪汉的味道。

original: I understand you know how to change someone's appearance.
traduit: 我听说你知道如何改变别人的外表。

original: Change it? I can remake your face, if that's what you desire.
traduit: 改变？如果你想的话，我能重塑你的脸。

original: This is true, but my techniques only work on the living. You've chosen a different path to remake yourself.
traduit: 没错，但我的技术只对活人有效。你已经选择了一条不同的路来重塑你自己。

original: Heard anything about a moth priest passing through?
traduit: 听说过有蛾祭司路过的消息吗？

original: My business is my own. Just tell me what I need to know.
traduit: 这事跟别人无关。就告诉我我需要知道什么就成了。

original: The College of Winterhold seems like a good place to start.
traduit: 冬堡学院似乎是个不错的起点。

original: I'm not afraid of you!
traduit: 我不害怕你！

original: If you think I'll help you, you're mistaken.
traduit: 如果你觉得我能帮你，那你就大错特错了。

original: Your kind are a blight upon Tamriel, monster!
traduit: 你们就是泰姆瑞尔的祸害，怪物！

original: What is your command?
traduit: 你的命令是什么？

original: Greetings, master. What do you need?
traduit: 主人，你好。你需要什么？

original: Ah, you are here. Good.
traduit: 啊，你在这里。很好。

original: Excuse me, but I must address the court.
traduit: 抱歉，不过我必须得跟宫廷说一声。

original: Well done! Somehow I knew it would be you and Serana who found our moth priest.
traduit: 干得漂亮！我就知道你和瑟拉娜会找到我们的蛾祭司。

original: That was... not as useful as I would have liked. Even so, you did well.
traduit: 这……没我想得那么有用。即便如此，你干得不错。

original: What are you waiting for? Get out there and find a moth priest!
traduit: 你还磨蹭什么呢？出去找蛾祭司去！

original: I think my father wanted to see you. Have you talked to him yet?
traduit: 我想我父亲想见你。你跟他谈了吗？

original: I have ordered the court to assemble. I have a new task for us all to carry out, and that includes you.
traduit: 我已下令召集宫廷上下，有一项新任务需要大家共同完成，你也不例外。

original: Come now, and hear my proclamation.
traduit: 来吧，聆听我的旨意。

original: How will vampires gain power over the sun?
traduit: 吸血鬼如何获得改变太阳的力量？

original: I don't know yet. The Moth Priest died before finishing the transcription, but he did name the Elder Scrolls that contained the prophecy.
traduit: 还不知道。那个蛾祭司还没来得及完成转录就死了，不过他的确指明了藏有预言的是哪几卷上古卷轴。

original: The scroll you found with Serana is one of those scrolls of prophecy. Now that it is back within my grasp, we can read the scroll and learn more.
traduit: 你在瑟拉娜那里找到的就是记载了预言的卷轴之一。如今它重归我手，我们也就可以阅读上古卷轴，了解更多信息了。

original: As you know, vampires are powerful, but we have limits. Our great enemy is the sun, and until recently it's an enemy we've had no way to fight.
traduit: 如你所知，吸血鬼是很强大，但是我们也有极限。我们最大的敌人就是太阳，它一直是我们无法解决的敌人。

original: For centuries I searched for an answer to this problem. I found an old prophecy written by a Moth Priest, those scholars who read the Elder Scrolls.
traduit: 千百年以来我一直在寻找办法解决这个问题。我发现了一则由蛾祭司书写的古老预言，这些祭司就是阅读上古卷轴的学者。

original: The prophecy tells of a time in which vampires will gain power over the sun, and will no longer fear its tyranny.
traduit: 这预言说，吸血鬼将会得到控制太阳的力量，不再惧怕它的暴政。

original: I believe the secret to unraveling that prophecy is written in Serana's Elder Scroll.
traduit: 我看这预言尚未揭秘的部分，就写在瑟拉娜的上古卷轴里。

original: Scions of the night! Hear my words!
traduit: 暗夜贵族们！听我一言！

original: The prophesied time is at last upon us. Soon we will claim dominion over the sun itself, and forge a new realm of eternal darkness.
traduit: 预言的时代终于到来了，我们很快就会支配太阳，建立一个新的永夜王国。

original: Now that I have reclaimed one of my Elder Scrolls, we must find a Moth Priest to read it.
traduit: 我已找回一卷上古卷轴，但必须有蛾祭司来阅读。

original: I have spread false rumors about the discovery of an Elder Scroll in Skyrim to lure a Moth Priest here.
traduit: 我故意散布谣言，说在天际发现了一卷上古卷轴，为的就是把蛾祭司引过来。

original: Now it is time to see if those efforts have borne fruit. Go forth, and search the land for rumors of a Moth Priest within our borders.
traduit: 现在是时候看看这些努力是否取得成果了。去吧，在这片土地上搜查关于境内蛾祭司的消息。

original: Look to the cities. Speak to innkeepers, carriage drivers, anyone who would meet a traveler.
traduit: 去城市里看看，跟旅店老板、马车夫这些有可能见过旅客的人谈谈。

original: Go now, and carry out this task. This is my command!
traduit: 现在就去完成这个任务，这是我的命令！

original: I need to find a Moth Priest.
traduit: 我得找蛾祭司。

original: Does he have the Scroll? Is everything ready?
traduit: 上古卷轴给他了吗？一切都准备好了？

original: For the reading? Yeah. Just let the old man know when you're ready.
traduit: 读卷轴吗？嗯。你准备好了就跟老爷子说一声。

original: It's important that I find him right away. (Persuade)
traduit: 我必须马上找到他。（说服）

original: Heard anything about a Moth Priest passing through?
traduit: 你听过什么蛾祭司路过的消息吗？

original: Where is he now?
traduit: 他现在在哪里？

original: Know anything about a Moth Priest visiting Dragon Bridge?
traduit: 你知道有个蛾祭司来龙桥吗？

original: You can find us at Fort Dawnguard, near Stendarr's Beacon.
traduit: 我们的黎明守卫堡垒就在斯丹达尔的烽火台附近。

original: Very well. I'll hurry on my way there before more of those vampires turn up.
traduit: 很好。我得在更多吸血鬼出现前赶紧动身。

original: We're called the Dawnguard. We're fighting a vampire conspiracy.
traduit: 我们是黎明守卫，正在跟一场吸血鬼阴谋作斗争。

original: We're called the Dawnguard, and we need you to read an Elder Scroll.
traduit: 我们是黎明守卫，需要你阅读上古卷轴。

original: You have an Elder Scroll? Remarkable!
traduit: 你们有上古卷轴？了不起！

original: If my knowledge of history serves me, I recall that the Dawnguard was an ancient order of vampire hunters.
traduit: 如果我没记错历史的话，黎明守卫是个古老的吸血鬼猎人组织。

original: I will be happy to assist you with your Elder Scroll. Just tell me where I need to go.
traduit: 我很乐意帮你们阅读上古卷轴。告诉我我该去哪里就成了。

original: Now tell me, whom do you represent, and what do you want with me?
traduit: 现在告诉我，你代表谁，找我有什么事？

original: Are you alright?
traduit: 你还好吗？

original: I'm quite alright, thanks to you. Dexion Evicus is my name. I'm a Moth Priest of the White Gold Tower.
traduit: 多亏了你，我很好。我叫戴希翁·艾维库斯，是白金塔的一名蛾祭司。

original: These vampires claimed they had some purpose in store for me, but they wouldn't say what. Probably hoping to ransom me, the fools.
traduit: 这些吸血鬼说我有些价值，但又不愿细说。可能是想勒索我，一群傻瓜。

original: Are you prepared to read the Elder Scroll?
traduit: 你准备好阅读上古卷轴了吗？

original: Oh, most certainly! Let's find out what secrets the scroll can tell.
traduit: 哦，当然啦！让我们找找看卷轴里有些什么秘密。

original: Have my companions made you feel welcome?
traduit: 我的同伴有没有好好招待你？

original: It's not exactly the hospitality I'm used to, but your man Isran has seen to my needs well enough.
traduit: 虽然不是我习惯的待客方式，不过伊士冉已经很周全了。

original: And might I add, this is a remarkable fortress. I have colleagues back home that would love to study this place in detail.
traduit: 我想补充一句，这座堡垒可真的非同寻常。我家乡的同事们应该很乐意详细研究研究它。

original: Glad you made it here safely, Dexion.
traduit: 很高兴看到你平安无事，戴希翁。

original: Ah, my rescuer! It's good to see you again.
traduit: 啊，我的救命恩人！再见到你真好！

original: I must rest now. The reading has made me weary.
traduit: 我是得歇歇。阅读卷轴太累了。

original: Come on, old man. You should get some rest.
traduit: 来吧，老爷子。你得歇一歇了。

original: I'm back from <Alias=Dungeon> with the <Alias=Item>.
traduit: 我从<Alias=Dungeon>带回了<Alias=Item>。

original: You're back and alive to boot! Fantastic.
traduit: 你回来了，而且还活着！太好了。

original: Ooh, good. I was just starting to get bored.
traduit: 哦，非常好。我刚才还有些无聊呢。

original: Let's see what you've got there.
traduit: 我们来看看你带了些什么。

original: Back already? Can't wait.
traduit: 回来了？我等不及了。

original: You never disappoint. What've you got there?
traduit: 你从我不让我失望，带什么回来了？

original: We've been so terribly fortunate. I can't wait to see what's in these drawings.
traduit: 我们真是太幸运了，等不及要看看这些图纸里有什么了。

original: I think even Gunmar's been impressed with what we've managed to do with the Dwemer drawings. Let's see what we can do with these ones!
traduit: 我猜就连甘马尔也会对我们在锻莫图纸上取得的成就感到佩服。来看看这些能让我们做什么！

original: I want to add some punch to our crossbow capabilities, I've done all I can on my own. I need a little inspiration.
traduit: 我让咱们的弩威力再大点，光靠我一个人还是不太够，得找点灵感才行。

original: I've always been fascinated with Dwemer artifacts. I take them apart, poke around in their guts, and try to figure things out - with mixed results.
traduit: 我一直对锻莫文物很感兴趣。把它们拆开，研究里面的构造，试着搞清楚原理。但结果嘛，时灵时不灵。

original: But as luck would have it, I've tracked down the location of some actual Dwemer diagram drawings!
traduit: 但幸运的是，我找到了一些锻莫正牌设计图的位置！

original: So, if you'd be a dear and collect those plans for me?
traduit: 所以，能麻烦你帮我收集这些图纸吗？

original: I've got more leads on additional Dwemer plans.
traduit: 我还有更多有关锻莫图纸的线索。

original: Those last ones helped me immensely. If you could collect this one for me, it's sure to result in extraordinary success!
traduit: 之前那套可帮了我大忙，要是你能替我把这套也弄来，肯定能取得大成功！

original: Ready for more? I certainly am.
traduit: 准备继续找了吗？我也等不及了。

original: Be a dear and fetch me another set of Dwemer diagrams?
traduit: 能再帮个忙给我带一套锻莫设计图吗？

original: It's amazing what I'm able to learn from studying these Dwemer plans.
traduit: 我从这些锻莫设计中学到的东西可太神奇了。

original: Want to head out there and collect some more?
traduit: 还想再去收集一些吗？

original: I'm starting to think you like this as much as I do!
traduit: 我开始觉得你和我一样喜欢这个了！

original: Here's the location of the next set of Dwemer diagrams. Thanks!
traduit: 下一组锻莫设计图的位置在这里，多谢了！

original: Alright! One more set of dwemer plans to go.
traduit: 好了！又有一套锻莫图纸要找了。

original: Think I'll be sad when we're done collecting these. Who knows though, maybe more plans will turn up in the future.
traduit: 等咱们把这些都收集光了，我可能会难过吧。但这事儿也没准，说不定以后还有更多图纸出现呢。

original: But I can't wait to see these drawings. Go on, get out of here!
traduit: 但我现在等不及要看看这些图纸了，赶紧的，出去找吧！

original: I've located more dwemer plans.
traduit: 我发现新的锻莫图纸了。

original: Be a dear and collect these diagrams for me?
traduit: 能劳烦你帮我去收集这些设计图吗？

original: Finish them!
traduit: 杀了他们！

original: An impressive display, but a wasted effort. You delay nothing but your own deaths!
traduit: 你们的表演很精彩，但还是白费力气，不过是拖延自己的死期罢了！

original: Did you really come here expecting to claim Auriel's Bow?
traduit: 你们还真的来这儿拿奥瑞艾尔之弓了啊？

original: You've done exactly as I predicted and brought your fetching companion to me.
traduit: 你完全照我预言，把你迷人的同伴带到我这儿来了。

original: Which, I'm sorry to say, means your usefulness is at an end!
traduit: 很遗憾，这意味着你已经完全没用了！

original: You're welcome.
traduit: 客气了。

original: You risked everything to get Auri-El's Bow, and in turn, you've restored the Chantry.
traduit: 你们不顾一切，只为取得奥瑞-艾尔之弓，但也顺带收复了神殿。

original: I can't think of a more deserving champion to carry it than you.
traduit: 我想不到比你更有资格保管它的勇士了。

original: If you wish to learn more about the bow, or obtain Sunhallowed Arrows for it, I'd be more than happy to help. You've but to ask.
traduit: 如果你想再多了解一下这把弓，或者取得圣阳箭，我都很乐意帮忙。尽管提就是了。

original: The Betrayed weren't to blame.
traduit: 背叛者们不该负这个责。

original: What? What are you talking about?
traduit: 什么？你什么意思？

original: So, the deed has been done.
traduit: 那么，这件事就结束了。

original: The restoration of this wayshrine means that Vyrthur must be dead and the Betrayed no longer have control over him.
traduit: 这座路龛的修复意味着维苏尔已经身死，背叛者们再也无法控制他了。

original: What will happen to you now?
traduit: 你现在有什么打算？

original: Even with Vyrthur gone and the Inner Sanctum destroyed, my duty as a Knight-Paladin of Auri-El remains.
traduit: 即使维苏尔已死、内殿被毁，我身为奥瑞-艾尔圣骑士的职责依然存在。

original: I've been sworn to protect this vale and everything it represents until I die.
traduit: 我发过誓要守护这个山谷，和它代表的一切，直至死亡。

original: What is the Chantry of Auri-El?
traduit: 奥瑞-艾尔的神殿？

original: This is, or was, the epicenter of our religion. Most of the snow elf people worshipped Auri-El.
traduit: 这里是，或者曾经是我们的宗教中心。大多数雪精灵都信奉奥瑞-艾尔。

original: The Chantry was constructed near the beginning of the First Era to provide a retreat for those that wished to become enlightened.
traduit: 这座神殿建于第一纪元初期，用来为那些寻求启蒙之人提供静修地。

original: Why weren't the snow elves here affected?
traduit: 为什么这里的雪精灵没有受影响？

original: The Chantry is quite isolated, so it took some time for word of the dwarves' offer to reach us here.
traduit: 神殿非常偏僻，所以矮人的提议过了一段时间才传到我们这里。

original: By the time the compact had been completed, it was too late for us to even attempt to intervene.
traduit: 当盟约订立的时候，我们已经来不及干预了。

original: That's why I'm here for the Elder Scroll.
traduit: 这就是我来这里找上古卷轴的原因。

original: You think I'd have the audacity to place my own daughter in that tomb for the protection of her Elder Scroll alone?
traduit: 你以为我是为了一卷上古卷轴，就狠心把女儿关进那所墓穴里？

original: The scrolls are merely a means to an end. The key to the Tyranny of the Sun is Serana herself.
traduit: 卷轴不过是达到目的的一种手段，太阳暴政的关键在于瑟拉娜本身。

original: Who were your people?
traduit: 你的族人？

original: We were once a wealthy and prosperous society that occupied a portion of Skyrim.
traduit: 我们的社会也曾富裕繁荣，占据了天际的一部分。

original: Unfortunately, we were constantly at war with the Nords who claimed the land as their ancestral home.
traduit: 不幸的是，我们一直在和声称这片土地是祖先家园的诺德人战斗。

original: What do you do?
traduit: 你是做什么的？

original: So are you here as a client? Shall I remake your face?
traduit: 你想当我的客户？让我重塑你的脸？

original: But, my techniques only work on the living, not those that have crossed over into undeath.
traduit: 但我的技术只对活人有效，变成亡灵的人就没戏了。

original: You must be the face sculptor I've heard about.
traduit: 你一定就是我听说过的那个脸部雕塑家了吧？

original: Yes. I once practiced my art in the salons and manors of Tamriel's great and good. Now, the scum of Skyrim are my only clients.
traduit: 是的，我曾经在全泰姆瑞尔最上流的沙龙和庄园里施展我的技术。现在，我的客户只剩天际的渣滓们了。

original: But no matter. The greatest artists are never recognized in their own time.
traduit: 但没关系，最伟大的艺术家们从未在当代获得认可。

original: I assumed you were here to see me about your face. To have it sculpted into something more... artful than Nature has bestowed upon you.
traduit: 我猜你是为了你的脸来找我的，来把它雕刻成……比自然赋予你的更巧妙的样子。

original: What do you want?
traduit: 你想怎样？

original: Hmm, I suppose I can work with your face. After all, the sculptor cannot always choose the finest clay.
traduit: 嗯，看来我能处理你的脸。毕竟雕刻师也不能总是挑最好的粘土。

original: What have you done to yourself? I can't work with you in this state, night-walker.
traduit: 你把自己怎么了，这种状态下我没法跟你合作，夜行者。

original: Take my advice, don't listen to that talk of the "face sculptor" down in the Ragged Flagon. "Face butcher" is more like it from what I've heard.
traduit: 听我的劝，别听漏壶那所谓的“脸部雕塑家”说的。据我所知更像是“脸部屠夫”。

original: People say there's someone in Riften that can... change your face. Make you look completely different. Do you believe that?
traduit: 人们说在裂谷城有个人能……改变你的面容。让你看起来完全变了个人。你信吗？

original: Are you saying Harkon means to kill her?
traduit: 你是说哈孔打算杀了她？

original: If Harkon obtained Auriel's Bow and Serana's blood was used to taint the weapon, the Tyranny of the Sun would be complete.
traduit: 如果哈孔获得了奥瑞艾尔之弓，再用瑟拉娜的血玷污这把武器，那么太阳暴政就终结了。

original: In his eyes, she'd be dying for the good of all vampires.
traduit: 在他看来，她应该为了全体吸血鬼的利益去死。

original: You'll also want to find Gunmar. Big brute of a Nord, hates vampires almost as much as I do.
traduit: 你还得去找甘马尔，诺德蛮夫，跟我一样仇恨吸血鬼。

original: Got it into his head years back that his experience with animals would help. Trolls in particular, from what I hear.
traduit: 几年前他就想过他和动物相处的经验能派上用场，他尤其擅长训练巨魔。

original: Last I knew he was out scouring Skyrim for more beasts to tame.
traduit: 上次听说他在天际寻找更多的野兽来驯服。

original: Bring the two of them back here, and we can get started on coming up with a plan.
traduit: 把他们俩带回来，我们就可以开始制定计划了。

original: She'll help us?
traduit: 她会帮我们吗？

original: Might need a little convincing, but she should.
traduit: 可能要说服一下，但她会的。

original: Where can I find the people we need?
traduit: 在哪儿能找到我们要的人？

original: Right to the point, aren't you. I like that. Not like those fools in the order.
traduit: 直入正题，是吧。我喜欢，不像教团里那些傻瓜。

original: We should keep it small. Too many people, and we'll draw unwanted attention to ourselves.
traduit: 我们应该控制规模，太多人会引起不必要的注意。

original: I think we'll want Sorine Jurard. Breton girl, whip-smart and good with tinkering. Fascination with the Dwemer. Weapons in particular.
traduit: 索琳·菊拉德是个好人选。伶牙俐齿的布莱顿姑娘，擅长修补。沉迷锻莫，尤其是武器。

original: Last I knew, she was out in the Reach, convinced she was about to find the biggest dwarven ruins yet.
traduit: 上次听说她去了瑞驰，坚信能找到迄今最大的矮人遗迹。

original: If they're bold enough to attack us here, then this may be bigger than I thought. I have good men here, but...
traduit: 如果他们敢来这里攻击我们，那么情况可能比我想的严重。我这里人手不错，但……

original: There are people I've met and worked with over the years. We need their skills, their talents, if we're going to survive this.
traduit: 这些年来我遇到过一些人，也和他们共事过。如果我们要渡过难关，需要他们的技术与才能。

original: If you can find them, we might have a chance.
traduit: 如果你能找到他们，我们也许就有机会。

original: We have to do something.
traduit: 我们得做些什么。

original: Well of course we do. I'm old, not stupid.
traduit: 当然了。我只是老了，但不笨。

original: We're just going to need some help.
traduit: 我们只是需要一些帮助。

original: So you're just going to give up?
traduit: 所以你要放弃了？

original: When did I say that?
traduit: 我什么时候这么说了？

original: We just need... we need help.
traduit: 我们只是需要……需要帮助。

original: I warned them. I knew something like this would happen eventually. But they didn't listen, and look where it's gotten them.
traduit: 我警告过他们，我知道迟早会出这种事。但他们不听，看看他们的下场吧。

original: This attack... it's unlike the vampires. Do we at least know what they were after, or is this completely a lost cause?
traduit: 这种袭击……不像是吸血鬼。我们至少知道他们在找什么吗，还是说我们注定要失败？

original: Oh, Serana. If you'd only open your eyes.
traduit: 哦，瑟拉娜，睁开你的眼看看吧。

original: The moment your father discovers your role in the prophecy, that he needs your blood, you'd be in terrible danger.
traduit: 一旦你父亲发现你在预言中的作用，需要你的血，那你就深陷危险之中了。

original: So to protect me you decided to shut me away from everything I cared about?
traduit: 所以为了保护我，你就决定让我远离我在乎的一切？

original: You never asked me if hiding me in that tomb was the best course of action, you just expected me to follow you blindly.
traduit: 你从没问过我，把我藏在坟墓里是不是最好的选择，只希望我盲目地跟着你。

original: Both of you were obsessed with your own paths. Your motivations might have been different, but in the end, I'm still just a pawn to you, too.
traduit: 你们俩都执迷于自己的路，你的动机或许不同，但最终，我对你来说也只是个棋子罢了。

original: How dare you! I gave up everything I cared about to protect you from that fanatic you call a father!
traduit: 你怎么能这么说！我放弃了一切在乎的东西，就是为了保护你，不被你那个发狂的父亲伤害！

original: This "stranger" has done more for me in the brief time I've known him than you've done in centuries!
traduit: 这个“陌生人”在我认识他的短短时间里为我做的比你几个世纪以来做的还要多！

original: This "stranger" has done more for me in the brief time I've known her than you've done in centuries!
traduit: 这个“陌生人”在我认识她的短短时间里为我做的比你几个世纪以来做的还要多！

original: This stranger aligns himself with those that would hunt you down and slay you like an animal, yet I should entrust you to him?
traduit: 这个陌生人和那些把你当成野兽一样追捕猎杀的人站在一边，我却还要把你托付给他？

original: This stranger aligns herself with those that would hunt you down and slay you like an animal, yet I should entrust you to her?
traduit: 这个陌生人和那些把你当成野兽一样追捕猎杀的人站在一边，我却还要把你托付给她？

original: This stranger may call himself vampire, but he knows nothing of our struggle. Why should I entrust you to him?
traduit: 这个陌生人是可以自称吸血鬼，但他对我们的努力一无所知。我为什么要把你托付给他？

original: This stranger may call herself vampire, but she knows nothing of our struggle. Why should I entrust you to her?
traduit: 这个陌生人是可以自称吸血鬼，但他对我们的努力一无所知。我为什么要把你托付给她？

original: We'll return soon.
traduit: 我们很快就会回来。

original: One more word of warning. There's a dragon that calls itself Durnehviir roaming the Cairn. Be wary of him.
traduit: 我还有一句警告。石冢中游荡着一条龙，自称杜耐维尔，小心。

original: The Ideal Masters have charged him with overseeing the Keepers, and will undoubtedly intervene if you're perceived as a threat.
traduit: 理想之主委任他来监管看守者们，如果你被视为威胁，他肯定会介入。

original: What do we need to do?
traduit: 我们该怎么做？

original: You need to locate the tallest of the rocky spires that surround these ruins.
traduit: 去找废墟周围最高的石塔。

original: At their bases, the barrier's energy is being drawn from unfortunate souls that have been exiled here.
traduit: 屏障的能量源自那些被放逐至此的不幸灵魂。

original: Destroy the Keepers that are tending them, and it should bring the barrier down.
traduit: 消灭守卫它们的看守者，应该就能破坏屏障。

original: What is your decision?
traduit: 你的决定如何？

original: Your intentions are still somewhat unclear to me.
traduit: 我还是不太清楚你的意图。

original: But for Serana's sake, I'll assist you in any way that I can.
traduit: 但为了瑟拉娜着想，我会尽我所能帮你。

original: I'll meet you back there.
traduit: 我在那儿等你。

original: Hey... we did pretty well for ourselves here. Good work.
traduit: 嘿……我们在这里做得很好，干得漂亮。

original: I'll take this one back to the castle.
traduit: 我会把他带回城堡。

original: This will put my father in a great mood. You should come enjoy it while it lasts.
traduit: 父亲会为此高兴的，趁他还在兴头上的时候来享受吧。

original: Off the northern coast of Skyrim, due west of Solitude.
traduit: 在天际北部海岸，独孤城的西边。

original: I'll set out at once, then.
traduit: 那么，我马上就出发。

original: I command you to travel to Castle Volkihar.
traduit: 我命令你去沃基哈尔城堡。

original: Certainly. Where can I find this castle?
traduit: 当然可以。我在哪里能找到这座城堡？

original: By the divines! It's as if my eyes have been opened! I am blinded by the light of your majesty. I... I must obey you.
traduit: 圣灵在上！我的眼睛就像是被解封了！我被大人您的光芒蒙蔽了双眼。我……我必须服从您。

original: What would you have of me, master?
traduit: 您要我做什么，主人？

original: Help!
traduit: 救命！

original: My love! I knew you'd come for me! I just knew it!
traduit: 亲爱的！我就知道你会来救我！我就知道！

original: You came for me? How did you know? I thought I was going to die in here. Thank you!
traduit: 你怎么收到消息来救我的？我还以为要死在这了。多谢！

original: Don't worry about me, I'll be fine!
traduit: 不用担心我，我没事！

original: I've rescued <Alias=Prisoner> from <Alias=Dungeon>.
traduit: 我把<Alias=Prisoner>从<Alias=Dungeon>救出来了。

original: I know! Arkay told me of your success!
traduit: 我知道！阿尔凯告诉我你成功了！

original: Arkay's never clear on life and death. Is she still alive? There's always hope...
traduit: 阿尔凯从不明说生死。她还活着吗？总有希望……

original: Arkay is so hard to understand when it comes to life and death. Is he still alive? There's always hope...
traduit: 阿尔凯在谈及生死时很难理解。他还活着吗？总有希望……

original: A vicious night stalker rules over a group of bandits - seeks to gain leverage over the righteous.
traduit: 一个恶毒的夜行者统治着一群强盗，试图挑战公平正义。

original: A vicious night stalker rules over a group of necromancers - seeks to gain leverage over the righteous.
traduit: 一个恶毒的夜行者统治着一群死灵术士，试图挑战公平正义。

original: Your wife, kidnapped!
traduit: 你的妻子，被绑架了！

original: Your husband, kidnapped!
traduit: 你的丈夫，被绑架了！

original: Your friend, kidnapped!
traduit: 你的朋友，被绑架了！

original: Arkay has some grave news, friend.
traduit: 朋友，阿尔凯有些坏消息。

original: I've destroyed the vampire in the Jarl of <Alias=Capital>'s court.
traduit: 我消灭了在<Alias=Capital>领主宫廷的吸血鬼。

original: Good. Maybe now they'll afford the vampire threat a tad bit more respect, eh?
traduit: 干得好。也许现在他们会多关注一下吸血鬼的威胁，是吧？

original: The Jarl's in danger. A vampire plays as a visiting "advisor" to the court. Destroy it before it's able to complete its foul business.
traduit: 领主有危险。一只吸血鬼伪装成来访的“顾问”，混进了宫廷，得在它恶行得逞前除掉它。

original: But be warned. The Jarl's guards are unaware of the threat, and will treat violence against this "advisor" as a crime.
traduit: 但请注意，领主的卫兵们没有意识到威胁，还会把针对“顾问”的暴力行为视为犯罪。

original: Convince the Jarl of the threat and he'll let you destroy the creature. If not, then do your best not to get caught.
traduit: 说服领主认清危险，他就会允许你消灭那怪物。如果说不通，那就暗中下手，尽量别被抓到。

original: Quickly now! The longer you delay, the more danger the Jarl is in.
traduit: 快！你拖得越久，领主就越危险。

original: You are in danger. A vampire has infiltrated your court.
traduit: 你有危险，有个吸血鬼潜入了你的宫廷。

original: That's quite a bold claim. I'd need proof before I could possibly accept it.
traduit: 这指控还真是大胆。我需要证据才能相信。

original: Well... I trust you'll take care of this unwanted visitor. My guards will not interfere with you carrying out my justice.
traduit: 嗯……希望你处理好这位不速之客。我的卫兵不会妨碍你执行我的判决。

original: You are in danger. A vampire has infiltrated your court. (Give letter)
traduit: 你有危险，有个吸血鬼潜入了你的宫廷。（给予信件）

original: Are you able to give us the scroll now?
traduit: 现在你能给我们卷轴了吗？

original: Yes. Please, follow me.
traduit: 没错。请跟我来。

original: Keep watch for Durnehviir. With the prison's barrier down, he's almost certain to investigate.
traduit: 当心杜耐维尔，监狱的屏障被破除，他肯定会来调查。

original: You managed to destroy all three Keepers? Very impressive.
traduit: 三个看守者都被你消灭了？很不错。

original: You hate him that much?
traduit: 你有那么恨他？

original: You must understand that he's no longer the man I married all that time ago.
traduit: 你得明白，他已经不是我很久之前嫁的那个人了。

original: He's obsessed... insane. Everyone around him fears him as they would a rabid dog.
traduit: 他早已……走火入魔。他就像疯狗一样，周围人都避之不及。

original: For all of this to end, he must die.
traduit: 要给这一切画上句号，他必须死。

original: And if Harkon failed?
traduit: 那如果哈孔失败了呢？

original: The only way I'd even consider returning to Tamriel was if Harkon were not only to fail, but to be destroyed.
traduit: 不能只是失败，只有哈孔身死，我才能考虑返回泰姆瑞尔。

original: You said "even if I could." Why?
traduit: 你说“即使你能”，为什么？

original: Like Serana, I am a Daughter of Coldharbour, an vampire offspring of Molag Bal.
traduit: 我跟瑟拉娜一样，是冷港之女，莫拉格·巴尔的吸血鬼后裔。

original: My presence in Tamriel would simply double the risk that Harkon could complete the prophecy.
traduit: 我在泰姆瑞尔只会倍增哈孔实现预言的风险。

original: Why don't you come back with us?
traduit: 你为何不跟我们一起回去？

original: Even if I could, it would only serve to hinder your efforts.
traduit: 即使我能，也只会妨碍你的努力。

original: Harkon would likely sense my return to Tamriel. The last thing you need right now is a trail for him to follow.
traduit: 哈孔可能会感知到我回了泰姆瑞尔，现在你最好小心点，不要给他留下线索。

original: We're not sure, but they have an Elder Scroll.
traduit: 我们不确定，但他们有一份上古卷轴。

original: By the Eight...
traduit: 八圣灵啊……

original: All right, look. I'll consider it, but I can't just leave this bear to prey on more innocent people.
traduit: 好吧，听着。我会考虑，但不能放这头熊去猎杀更多无辜之人。

original: Once it's dealt with, then perhaps I'll see what Isran expects of me.
traduit: 等这里的事解决，也许我会去看看伊士冉有什么打算。

original: All right. I'll hear out Isran, see if there's anything I can do to help.
traduit: 好吧。我去见伊士冉一趟，看看能帮上什么忙。

original: Where do you expect me to go?
traduit: 你想让我去哪儿？

original: We're up against vampires.
traduit: 我们的敌人是吸血鬼。

original: Vampires?
traduit: 吸血鬼？

original: That... well, that might change things.
traduit: 那……好吧，那可能就不一样了。

original: Tell me more about what's going on.
traduit: 告诉我出了什么事。

original: Isran needs your help.
traduit: 伊士冉需要你的帮助。

original: Isran? Needing someone else's help? Never thought I'd hear that.
traduit: 伊士冉？需要我的帮助？没想到我会听到这话。

original: I'm afraid he's a few years too late. I've moved on. I have more important business to attend to.
traduit: 恐怕他这话晚了几年。我已经向前看了，还有更重要的事情要做。

original: Besides, he can handle anything alone! He assured me so himself. What could he possibly need my help with?
traduit: 再说了，他一个人什么都能搞定！他亲口跟我保证过，还需要我来帮什么忙？

original: You there, hold fast!
traduit: 那边的，等等！

original: I've tracked this damned bear for two weeks; I'll not let it have any more victims.
traduit: 我已经跟踪这头该死的熊两周了，不能再让它伤人了。

original: We're meeting at Fort Dawnguard.
traduit: 我们黎明守卫堡垒见。

original: Ah. Been working more on his secret hideout, has he? It'll be interesting to see how much progress he's made.
traduit: 啊，他还在他的秘密藏身处忙活，对吧？倒是想看看他究竟折腾出多少名堂。

original: I'll finish up here and head in that direction soon as I can. See you there.
traduit: 我会把这里的事忙完然后尽快去那边。到时候见。

original: All right. If nothing else, I suppose it wouldn't hurt to learn more about what's going on so I can better defend myself.
traduit: 好吧，退一步讲，多了解一下发生了什么也无妨，这样我也能更好地保护自己。

original: But I'm not just going to abandon what I've been working on here. It's too useful. I need at least one intact dwarven gyro.
traduit: 但我不能就这么丢下手头的事不管，实用性太高了。我至少得拿到一个完整的矮人陀螺仪。

original: So either I need to find the satchel those mudcrabs stole, or I need another gyro from someplace. You wouldn't happen to have one, would you?
traduit: 所以，要么我得找到被那些泥沼蟹偷走的包，要么就从别的地方另找一个陀螺仪。你不会正好有一个吧？

original: We're not sure, but Isran is concerned.
traduit: 我们不确定，但伊士冉很担心。

original: In case you haven't noticed, Isran is always concerned about something. That's what got us working together in the first place.
traduit: 你没注意到的话，伊士冉一直都在担心某些事情。这就是为什么我们当初会合作。

original: Still, if he sent you to find me, it may actually be pretty bad.
traduit: 尽管如此，他都派你来找我了，说明可能非常严重了。

original: They have an Elder Scroll.
traduit: 他们有上古卷轴。

original: I... Well, that's actually something I never would've anticipated. Interesting.
traduit: 我……嗯，这倒是我从没想到的，有趣。

original: I'm not sure what they would do with one, but in this case Isran is probably correct in thinking it isn't good.
traduit: 我不确定他们会用它来干什么，但这种情况下，伊士冉认为局势不妙应该是对的。

original: Vampires threaten all of Skyrim. We need your help.
traduit: 吸血鬼威胁着全天际，我们需要你的帮助。

original: Vampires? Really?
traduit: 吸血鬼？真的？

original: Oh, and I suppose now he remembers that I proposed no less than three different scenarios that involved vampires overrunning the population.
traduit: 哦，我猜现在他想起来了我提出了至少三个与吸血鬼肆虐人间有关的设想。

original: Well, what are they up to?
traduit: 好吧，他们要干嘛？

original: You had a falling out?
traduit: 你们闹翻了？

original: Yes, that was my point. I felt it was rather clear.
traduit: 对，就是这个意思。我觉得说得很清楚了。

original: Look, what is it you want from me?
traduit: 说吧，要我干什么？

original: Isran asked me to find you.
traduit: 伊士冉让我来找你。

original: Isran? Wants me?
traduit: 伊士冉？找我？

original: No, you must be mistaken. He made it exceedingly clear the last time we spoke that he had no interest in my help.
traduit: 不，你肯定搞错了。上次我们谈话时他非常明确地表示，对我的帮助不感兴趣。

original: I find it hard to believe he's changed his mind. He said some very hurtful things to me before I left.
traduit: 很难相信他会改变主意。我离开前他说了些很伤人的话。

original: Anyway, I'm quite happy in my current pursuits. So if you'll excuse me...
traduit: 无论如何，我对现在的事业很满意。所以你不介意的话……

original: I understand that, but I really can't leave here without at least one usable piece of dwarven equipment.
traduit: 我知道，但在有一件能用的矮人装备前我真的离不开这儿。

original: A single gyro would be enough, I think. Believe me, this is useful stuff.
traduit: 我想一个矮人陀螺仪就够了。相信我，能派上用场。

original: Isran and I still need your help.
traduit: 伊士冉和我还是需要你的帮助。

original: If Isran is really asking for me, it must be serious. I'll help. Where do you need me to go?
traduit: 伊士冉要是真的找我了，说明情况很严重。我会帮忙，要我去哪里？

original: So you'll help us?
traduit: 这么说你会帮我们了？

original: You haven't seen a sack full of dwarven gyros lying around, have you? I'd swear I left it right here.
traduit: 你看到放在附近的满满一袋矮人陀螺仪了吗？我发誓我刚刚就放在这儿的。

original: Do you think mudcrabs might've taken it? I saw one the other day... Wouldn't be surprised if it followed me here.
traduit: 你觉得会不会是已经被泥沼蟹给拿了？前几天看到过一只……要是跟着我来了也不奇怪。

original: Just look around, will you?
traduit: 找找周围，好吗？

original: Do you know where these other scrolls are?
traduit: 你知道其他卷轴在哪吗？

original: My traitor wife stole one of them away and then disappeared.
traduit: 我那叛徒妻子偷了一幅然后失踪了。

original: As for the other, the last that I heard, it was lost in the bowels of a Dwemer ruin.
traduit: 至于另一幅，我最后听说是消失在了锻莫遗迹深处。

original: It seems our work is not yet done. But I have waited this long, and we are so very close now. I can wait a bit longer.
traduit: 看来我们的任务还没完成呢。但都等了这么久，我还能再等一会儿。

original: Then you may begin your reading.
traduit: 那你可以开始阅读了。

original: Of course, master.
traduit: 当然了，主人。

original: You must read an Elder Scroll.
traduit: 你必须阅读上古卷轴。

original: Ah, yes, the Elder Scroll! I admit, I'm looking forward to this.
traduit: 啊是的，上古卷轴！我承认我很期待。

original: I have a new task for you, thrall.
traduit: 奴仆，我有新的任务要给你。

original: Of course. What is it that you need me to do?
traduit: 当然，您需要我做什么？

original: Master, I have done as you asked and traveled here.
traduit: 主人，我已遵照您的吩咐前来。

original: Well, your thrall awaits and we have given him the Elder Scroll. Command him to read it, and let us hear the words of prophecy together.
traduit: 好了，你的奴隶在等我们，上古卷轴已经给他了。去命令他阅读卷轴，我们来一起听听预言说了什么。

original: I have made the Moth Priest my thrall.
traduit: 我把蛾祭司转化为了我的奴仆。

original: Yes, I see that. I trust his capture was not too difficult a task?
traduit: 嗯，我知道了。相信抓他不太难吧？

original: Isran's at Fort Dawnguard.
traduit: 伊士冉在黎明守卫堡垒。

original: He's been working on that place for years now. Never lets anyone in.
traduit: 他在那里忙了很多年了，从不放任何人进去。

original: His own little fortress. Well, I guess I'll get to see what he's been up to all this time.
traduit: 他自己的小堡垒。好吧，我看可以去看看他这些日子到底在忙些什么。

original: I'll meet you there.
traduit: 我在那儿等你。

original: How did you know?
traduit: 你怎么知道的？

original: If Isran is anything, he's stubborn.
traduit: 要说伊士冉有什么了不起的，那就是他很固执。

original: Yes, he said to meet him at Fort Dawnguard.
traduit: 对，他说了去黎明守卫堡垒见他。

original: Of course he did.
traduit: 当然了。

original: Don't know how well I'd have managed by myself. You have my thanks.
traduit: 我一个人不知道会干成啥样，多谢你了。

original: You've helped me, so I suppose the least I can do is find out what Isran wants. He's still at that fort near Stendarr's Beacon, I assume?
traduit: 你帮了我，我想至少要搞清楚伊士冉想做什么。他还在斯丹达尔的烽火台附近的那个堡垒，对吧？

original: For two weeks I've tracked that bear, and now find that you've killed it on your own.
traduit: 我追踪那头熊有两周了，结果现在是你一个人宰了它。

original: I'm not sure whether that makes you brave or foolish. What brings you here?
traduit: 都不知道你是勇敢还是愚蠢了，来这儿干嘛？

original: Watch yourself. This bear is vicious.
traduit: 自己小心。这头熊很凶暴。

original: We need to stop this creature before it kills again.
traduit: 我们得在这头畜生再造杀孽前阻止它。

original: Serana believes in me, why won't you?
traduit: 瑟拉娜相信我，你为什么不呢？

original: Serana?
traduit: 瑟拉娜？

original: This is all well and good, but do we actually know anything about what they're doing? What do we do now?
traduit: 说的是没毛病，但我们真的了解他们的企图吗？现在要怎么行动？

original: If anyone is going to stand in their way, it's going to be us.
traduit: 如果说还有人能阻止他们，那也只能是我们了。

original: And they have an Elder Scroll.
traduit: 而且他们还有一幅上古卷轴。

original: I'm sure you've heard a bit of what we're up against. Powerful vampires, unlike anything we've seen before.
traduit: 相信你们对我们面临的挑战有所耳闻了。强大的吸血鬼，与以往我们见过的完全不同。

original: All right Isran, you've got us all here. Now what do you want?
traduit: 好了，伊士冉，我们都来了。你打算做什么？

original: Please, we need your help.
traduit: 拜托了，我们需要你帮忙。

original: Look, I've just gotten myself out of quite a mess here, in case you haven't noticed, and while I appreciate your help, I...
traduit: 听着，你看我刚刚才摆脱了这堆烂摊子，虽然感谢你的帮助，但我……

original: What's that? No, that's not what I...  Yes, but... Are you sure? Really?
traduit: 什么？不，我不是那……对，但是……你确定？真的？

original: Fine. Arkay says it's a good idea for me to go. I don't agree, but he's not the sort of fellow you can just ignore.
traduit: 好吧。阿尔凯说我最好还是去。我再不同意，也不能无视他的旨意。

original: I'll see you at Fort Dawnguard, then. Don't worry, Arkay will show me the way.
traduit: 黎明守卫堡垒再会。别担心，阿尔凯会给我指路。

original: Isran? My help?
traduit: 伊士冉？我的帮助？

original: Is this... some kind of a joke? Did Arkay put you up to this?
traduit: 这是……在讲笑话吗？阿尔凯让你这么干的？

original: Isran's done nothing but mock me. He's never given me the respect I deserve.
traduit: 伊士冉就会嘲笑我。从来没给我应有的尊重。

original: You can meet me at Fort Dawnguard.
traduit: 你可以去黎明守卫堡垒见我。

original: I suppose I could... what, praytell, is there?
traduit: 我想可以……什么，再说一下，哪里？

original: I knew it! I knew Arkay would save me. I asked for help, and he sent you!
traduit: 我就知道！我知道阿尔凯会救我的。我请求帮助，他就派你来了！

original: You are a very welcome addition to this dreary place, my friend. I owe both you and Arkay a great deal.
traduit: 热烈欢迎你来到这个沉闷的地方，我的朋友。我欠你和阿尔凯太多了。

original: I'm sure I'll manage to repay him later, but you... What can I do to thank you?
traduit: 我相信以后会偿还他的，但你……我该怎么感谢你呢？

original: No, and I'm not going to waste men looking. We're fighting a war against your kind, and I intend to win it.
traduit: 不知道，而且我可不想浪费时间找人。我们正在和你的同类们作战，而且还要赢。

original: You want to find him, try talking to anyone who'd meet a traveler. Innkeepers and carriage drivers in the big cities maybe. But you're on your own.
traduit: 如果你想找他，试试去跟见过他的旅行者聊聊。也许旅店老板或者马车夫知道他在哪儿。不过你们得自己去问了。

original: Do you know where he's staying now?
traduit: 你知道他现在住在哪里吗？

original: Some Imperial scholar arrived in Skyrim a few days ago. I was staking out the road when I saw him pass by. Maybe that's your Moth Priest.
traduit: 几天前就有个帝国学者到天际来了。我当时在路边盯梢，正好看见他经过。说不定就是你们要找的蛾祭司。

original: Who can?
traduit: 那谁有办法呢？

original: Well, the Moth Priests are the only ones I've heard of who can do it. They spend years preparing before they start reading, though.
traduit: 嗯，我只听说过蛾祭司能办得到。不过在开始阅读之前，他们会花上几年的时间来准备。

original: Not that it helps us anyway, because they're all half a continent away in Cyrodiil.
traduit: 不过说这些也是白搭，因为他们都在希罗帝尔，隔着半个大陆呢。

original: So, in case you didn't notice the giant thing on my back, I have the Elder Scroll with me.
traduit: 另外，如果你还没注意到我背的东西，这就是上古卷轴。

original: Whatever it says, it will have something that can help us stop my father.
traduit: 不管那上面写了什么，它都能帮我们阻止我父亲。

original: But of course, neither of us can read it.
traduit: 不过当然了，我们谁都没法读。

original: Thank you for your kindness. I'll remember it the next time I'm feeling hungry.
traduit: 谢谢你的好意。下次我觉得饿的时候，我会想着的。

original: You hear me? Don't feel like a guest, because you're not. You're a resource. You're an asset.
traduit: 听清了吗？别拿自己当客人，你不是。你是资源。是财产。

original: In the meantime, don't make me regret my sudden outburst of tolerance and generosity, because if you do, your friend here is going to pay for it.
traduit: 还有，别让我后悔突然对你这么仁慈，不然的话，你的朋友就得跟着倒霉了。

original: It can stay for now, but if it so much as lays a finger on anyone here, I'll hold you responsible. Got it?
traduit: 它可以暂时待在这里，但只要它胆敢碰谁一根汗毛，就拿你是问。懂了？

original: Because we're going to need her help.
traduit: 因为我们需要她的帮助。

original: Why, because of that story about the prophecy? About some vampire trying to put the sun out?
traduit: 就因为这个故事跟预言有关？跟什么吸血鬼要灭了太阳有关？

original: Do you actually believe any of that?
traduit: 你真的相信那些鬼话吗？

original: No, you're right. We just have to convince the others you're on our side.
traduit: 不，你说得对。我们只需要让他们相信你是我们这边的就行了。

original: Well, let's move then. I'm nothing if not persuasive.
traduit: 嗯，那让我们继续吧。别的不敢说，说服人我还是在行的。

original: What sort of prophecy?
traduit: 什么样的预言？

original: It's pointless and vague, like all prophecies. The part he latched onto said that vampires would no longer need to fear the sun.
traduit: 跟所有预言一样，它毫无意义又含糊不清。他死抓不放的那部分说，吸血鬼再也不用害怕太阳了。

original: That's what he's after. He wants to control the sun, have vampires control the world.
traduit: 那就是他想要的。他想控制太阳，让吸血鬼控制世界。

original: What about it?
traduit: 那是怎么回事？

original: It all comes back to my father.
traduit: 都是因为我父亲。

original: I'm guessing you figured this part out already, but my father's not exactly a good person. Even by vampire standards.
traduit: 你一定已经猜到了，我父亲不是什么好人。就算以吸血鬼的角度来讲也一样。

original: He wasn't always like that, though. There was... a turn. He stumbled onto this obscure prophecy and just kind of lost himself in it.
traduit: 不过，他并非一直如此。他……变了。他无意中发现了一个模糊的预言，然后有点把自己陷进去了。

original: What are you doing here?
traduit: 你在这里做什么？

original: I'd rather not be here either, but I needed to talk to you.
traduit: 我也不想在这里呆着，不过我得跟你谈谈。

original: It's important, so please just listen before your friend, here, loses his patience.
traduit: 这很重要，所以在你那位朋友觉得不耐烦之前，好好听着。

original: It's... well, it's about me. And the Elder Scroll that was buried with me.
traduit: 是……嗯，是关于我，还有跟我一起埋起来的上古卷轴的事情。

original: I'm impressed you could find a Moth Priest so quickly.
traduit: 你能这么快找到蛾祭司，真不简单。

original: You probably weren't expecting to see me again.
traduit: 没想到能再见到我吧。

original: Thank the divines for you!
traduit: 感谢圣灵！

original: You arrived just in time. I think those vampires were getting hungry.
traduit: 来得正是时候。我觉得那些吸血鬼已经开始饿了。

original: I owe you a debt for the timely rescue.
traduit: 多谢你及时出手相救。

original: Ah, hello there!
traduit: 嘿，你好啊！

original: My trip to Skyrim has become quite the adventure!
traduit: 我的天际之旅已经变成了一场大冒险！

original: A Moth Priest? What in Oblivion do you need a Moth Priest for?
traduit: 蛾祭司？你找蛾祭司做什么？

original: Not as much as I would like. Even after spending decades of my life in study of the Elder Scrolls, they remain a great mystery to me.
traduit: 远没达到我预想的程度。即便花费了几十年的时间研究上古卷轴，它们对我来说仍然是个巨大的谜。

original: It's true for most of my brothers in the order as well. We don't really know where the scrolls came from or who wrote them.
traduit: 教团中大部分同修都是这样。我们真的不清楚卷轴是从哪里来的，或者是谁写的。

original: What we do know is that some are born with the special gift to read the Elder Scrolls.
traduit: 但我们已知，有些人生来具备阅读上古卷轴的特殊天赋。

original: These chosen few can divine events of the past and future within the scrolls, though in time, it drives us to blindness.
traduit: 这些被选中的少数人可以一窥卷轴中过去与未来的事件，不过随着时间的推移，我们的双目就会失明。

original: I'm afraid there's not much more to tell. Even today, the Elder Scrolls remain a great enigma.
traduit: 恐怕没什么好说的了。时至今日，上古卷轴仍然是个谜。

original: It is the great spire at the heart of the Imperial City, among the tallest towers in all of Tamriel.
traduit: 它位于帝都中心，是座巨型尖塔，也是全泰姆瑞尔最高的建筑之一。

original: The lower floors are home to the Imperial Council, and the Order of Moth Priests occupies the middle floors.
traduit: 下层是帝国议会的所在地，而中层则是蛾祭司的。

original: The tower suffered damage in the recent war with the Aldmeri Dominion, and is not what it once was.
traduit: 这座塔最近在跟先祖神洲的战争中遭到了破坏，不复往日了。

original: I hope one day to see it restored to its former glory.
traduit: 希望有一天它能恢复旧日辉煌。

original: It is our sacred duty to study the Elder Scrolls.
traduit: 研究上古卷轴是我们的神圣职责。

original: We read these ancient scrolls of prophecy in order to divine the future, and we use that knowledge to aid the Emperor.
traduit: 我们阅读这些卷轴来一窥未来，用这些知识辅佐皇帝。

original: Sometimes we venture out into the world in search of more scrolls for our library at the White-Gold Tower.
traduit: 有时候我们会外出探险，寻找更多的上古卷轴来填充白金塔的图书馆。

original: That is the very purpose that first brought me to Skyrim.
traduit: 我来天际的首要目的就是这个。

original: What else would you like to know?
traduit: 你还想知道些什么呢？

original: Fine, fine. No need to get your breeches in a twist.
traduit: 好吧好吧。没必要和你拧着干。

original: The obvious answer is to go to the Imperial City. The Moth Priests make their home in the White Gold Tower.
traduit: 当然是去帝都了。蛾祭司们就住在白金塔里。

original: Sometimes they go out looking for Elder Scrolls. Lucky for you, there's a Moth Priest in Skyrim right now, doing just that.
traduit: 有时候他们会到外面走走寻找上古卷轴。算你走运，天际现在就正好有一个在找卷轴的蛾祭司。

original: He stopped in to do some research in the library, then left for Dragon Bridge. If you hurry, you might catch him there.
traduit: 他停下来在图书馆里做了些调查，然后奔龙桥去了。如果你动作快点的话，没准能在那里追上他。

original: Have I heard anything? It was the talk of the city for three days straight.
traduit: 我有没有听说过？这三天来城里净传这事了。

original: Ain't too often we get a visitor like that.
traduit: 像这样的客人可不常有呀。

original: Oh, he just left a short while ago. He said he'd finished up his work and it was time to move on.
traduit: 啊，他刚走没多久。他说他已经办完了事，是时候得走了。

original: That's all I can tell you. He asked me not to let anyone know where he was going. I suppose he didn't want the attention.
traduit: 我能告诉你的就这些。他让我别跟别人说他去哪里了。我觉得他是不想引起注意。

original: Ah, well, in that case I'll tell you what I know.
traduit: 啊，好吧，那样的话我就把我知道的都告诉你。

original: He took the road southwest out of town, and said he was going to be crossing over the Dragon Bridge. That's all that he told me. I hope it helps.
traduit: 他走了镇外西南方向的那条路，说他是要过龙桥。他就跟我说了这些。希望对你有所帮助。

original: Any idea how you're going to find a Moth Priest? Skyrim's a pretty big place.
traduit: 你知道怎么去找蛾祭司吗？天际可挺大的呢。

original: Actually, now that I think of it... I'm going to come along with you.
traduit: 事实上，我在想……和你一起去。

original: I've been really wanting to get out and explore a bit.
traduit: 我一直都特想出去探索一下世界。

original: Now, if everyone will please be quiet, I must concentrate.
traduit: 现在，大家请安静，我必须集中注意力。

original: I see a vision before me, an image of a great bow. I know this weapon! It is Auriel's Bow!
traduit: 我眼前看到了预兆，一幅巨大弓箭的图像。我知道这个武器。这是奥瑞艾尔之弓！

original: Now a voice whispers, saying "Among the night's children, a dread lord will rise."
traduit: 现在有一个声音低语：“黑夜之子中，将会有可怖的君主崛起。”

original: In an age of strife, when dragons return to the realm of men, darkness will mingle with light and the night and day will be as one.
traduit: 纷乱之时，龙族重归尘世，光暗混同，昼夜归一。

original: The voice fades and the words begin to shimmer and distort. But wait, there is more here.
traduit: 声音消失了，文字开始闪烁扭曲。等等，还有别的。

original: The secret of the bow's power is written elsewhere. I think there is more to the prophecy, recorded in other scrolls.
traduit: 弓之力量的秘密写在别处。看来还有记载在别的卷轴上的预言。

original: Yes, I see them now... One contains the ancient secrets of the dragons, and the other speaks of the potency of ancient blood.
traduit: 没错，我现在看见了……一份写着巨龙古老的秘密，另一份诉说着古老血脉的预言。

original: My vision darkens, and I see no more.
traduit: 视野变黑了，什么都看不见了。

original: To know the complete prophecy, we must have the other two scrolls.
traduit: 要知道完整的预言，必须找到另外两个卷轴。

original: Well, back before I... you know. The College of Winterhold was the first place I'd think to go for any kind of magic or historical thing.
traduit: 嗯，之前在我……你懂的。如果我想找跟魔法或者历史相关的东西，我第一个想到的就是冬堡学院。

original: The wizards know about all kinds of things that people probably shouldn't know about.
traduit: 巫师知道很多不为人知的事情。

original: I serve my master's will.
traduit: 我遵从主人的意志。

original: But my master is dead, and his enemies will pay!
traduit: 主人已死，他的敌人必须付出代价！

original: Never much cared for folks who can't mind their own business.
traduit: 跟我生意无关的事情我从来不关心。

original: Sorry, but that Moth Priest's comings and goings are none of my business, and none of yours either.
traduit: 抱歉，不过那个蛾祭司咋样了不关我的事，而且也不关你的。

original: I can see that.
traduit: 我知道了。

original: He said he was heading for Dragon Bridge next. I hope that helps you.
traduit: 他说他下一站要去龙桥。希望能对你有所帮助。

original: It's like I said, I'm not going to talk about it.
traduit: 我说了，我不想谈这件事。

original: Suits me just fine.
traduit: 谢天谢地。

original: An' maybe it won't.
traduit: 也许不会。

original: Ah yes, I remember your Moth Priest now.
traduit: 啊没错，我现在想起来那个蛾祭司了。

original: He wanted me to take him out to Dragon Bridge, but I told him it ain't one of my stops.
traduit: 他想让我载他去龙桥，不过我跟他说我不去那边。

original: Can't help you, friend. I might remember better if my pockets weren't so light.
traduit: 朋友，我没法帮你。不过如果我的钱包没这么扁的话，没准我记性能好点。

original: Now that I think on it, I did see your priest.
traduit: 现在我想起来了，我确实见过你的祭司。

original: He tried to hire me for a trip to Dragon Bridge, but I told him that ain't one of my stops.
traduit: 他想雇我载他去龙桥，不过我跟他说我不去那边。

original: Might be that I have, but I can't say for sure.
traduit: 也许我有，不过我可不敢肯定。

original: I got enough troubles on my mind just tryin' to scrape by out here.
traduit: 我脑子里的破事已经够多了，只想挣钱糊口。

original: That's one of them Imperial scholars, right? Old man with a gray robe?
traduit: 是个帝国学者，对吗？穿灰袍子的老头？

original: I will share that knowledge with you gladly, master. What do you wish to know?
traduit: 主人，我很乐意跟你分享那些知识。你想知道些什么？

original: Very well.
traduit: 非常好。

original: Hold it. If you're going downstairs, you keep your weapons to yourself or we'll be getting better acquainted.
traduit: 等等。如果你要下楼，收好自己的武器，不然我们就得深入交流一下了。

original: Haran manages the inn in Winterhold. A forsaken place under the shadow of the mages guild. She will help us keep an eye on the mages.
traduit: 哈兰经营着冬堡的旅店，是个法师公会阴影中的破败地盘。她会帮我们盯着那些法师。

original: Valindor of Riften has his ears in places that we'd love to listening in. Joining our family should increase our possibilities in the south.
traduit: 裂谷的瓦林多能监听我们想听的地方。让他加入家庭里来应该会增加我们在南方的机会。

original: A pathetic creature in her present condition, but the gift will embolden her. And her lowly state suits her to being our eyes and ears in Markarth.
traduit: 有个人现在的处境是很可悲，但这份礼物会让她更加大胆。她的卑微姿态让她适合成为我们在马卡斯的耳目。

original: Understood.
traduit: 明白。

original: When you offer the embrace, do so away from prying eyes. Our new sibling will then likely require rest while his blood undergoes the change.
traduit: 当你给予拥抱时，要远离窥视的目光。我们新的兄弟在血液变化时可能需要休息。

original: Return to me when your part is done.
traduit: 完成你的任务后就回来找我。

original: When you offer the embrace, do so away from prying eyes. Our new sibling will then likely require rest while her blood undergoes the change.
traduit: 当你给予拥抱时，要远离窥视的目光。我们新的姐妹在血液变化时可能需要休息。

original: Why am I able to bestow the gift of Harkon's blood?
traduit: 为什么我能赐给别人哈孔的血？

original: I have found such a soul and the stars appear cooperative.
traduit: 我找到了一个这样的灵魂，星象也正合意。

original: While the blessed state of undeath can be "accidentally" conferred - consider the brutish creatures you find wailing in dank hovels in the wild...
traduit: 虽然神圣的不死之身可以被“意外”授予——想想那些在野外潮湿的茅屋里嚎叫的野蛮生物吧……

original: Only those who can trace their ancestry through Harkon's mortal blood line can faithfully accept the power conferred by his Vampiric blood.
traduit: 唯有能哈孔的凡人血脉追溯祖源者，才能完全接纳他吸血鬼之血赋予的力量。

original: And among those, it seems, only when the heavens show the correct aspects.
traduit: 而这些人，似乎是天堂向他们敞开了到来之路。

original: Can't anyone become a vampire if bitten by one?
traduit: 被吸血鬼咬过的人不是都能变成吸血鬼吗？

original: Because he himself bestowed upon you a portion of his vitality when he infused you with his own blood the night you returned with Serana.
traduit: 因为在你带瑟拉娜回来的那晚，他给你注入自身血液的同时，也赐予了你一部分活力。

original: A small measure of his blood now and forever flows through your veins.
traduit: 你的血管里永远流着他的部分血液。

original: Why am I able to bestow the gift of Harkon's blood?
traduit: 为什么我能赐给别人哈孔的血？

original: How do I turn him into a vampire?
traduit: 我要怎么把他转化为吸血鬼？

original: How do I turn her into a vampire?
traduit: 我要怎么把她转化为吸血鬼？

original: Our blood grants us power to calm and relax. If you currently lack the gift, forgo feeding for a day and that power will come naturally.
traduit: 我们的血赋予了我们冷静与放松的力量。如果你尚且缺乏这种天赋，就放弃一天的进食，这力量自然会到来。

original: Once your thrall is suitably sedated, you will be able to impart the gift without resistance.
traduit: 当你的奴隶自然地镇静下来，就可以无阻力地赐予礼物了。

original: I don't feel... right... I'm going to lay down... for awhile...
traduit: 我有点……不对劲……我得……躺一会儿……

original: Something's happened, I can't quite remember...
traduit: 发生了什么事，我不太记得了……

original: They're a splinter group of the "Vigilants of Stendarr." A bit more ambitious, it seems.
traduit: 他们是“斯丹达尔警戒者”的一个分支，看来更有野心。

original: The Dawnguard are apparently focused on exterminating vampires, noble and brute alike.
traduit: 黎明守卫明显更专注于消灭吸血鬼，无论贵贱。

original: Not a serious threat, but we can't leave them completely unchecked or they may become one.
traduit: 不算是个严重威胁，但我们不能放任不管，否则必成后患。

original: A more "serious" group of the Vigilants of Stendarr. Sometimes when you skin a skeever, you find he has a more aggressive mate.
traduit: 斯丹达尔的警戒者中一个更“严肃”的队伍。有时你刚剥了恶鼠的皮，会发现它还有个更发狂的伴儿。

original: The Dawnguard apparently like killing vampires.
traduit: 黎明守卫显然更喜欢杀吸血鬼。

original: Almost as much as we like killing them.
traduit: 就跟我们喜欢杀他们一样。

original: Can't anyone become a vampire if bitten by one?
traduit: 被吸血鬼咬过的人不是都能变成吸血鬼吗？

original: I've found a new candidate, ripe for Harkon's Gift. I'm sending you to welcome this soul into our family.
traduit: 我找到了一个适合接受哈孔礼物的新人选。就由你去欢迎这个灵魂加入我们。

original: He simply said "It is time."
traduit: 他就说了句“是时候了”。

original: Well, well. He wants the Chalice, then.
traduit: 好吧好吧。看来，他想要圣杯了。

original: You've heard of the Bloodstone Chalice?
traduit: 你听说过“血石圣杯”吗？

original: Please, take the bow... it's yours.
traduit: 请拿起弓吧……它属于你了。

original: So, the deed has been done. My brother is dead.
traduit: 看来，契约已经完成了，我兄弟已经死了。

original: Questions? I expected as much.
traduit: 有什么问题吗？我等着你开口呢。

original: You've nothing to fear from me. Please, we have much to discuss.
traduit: 你不用怕我。拜托了，我们有很多事要谈。

original: May Auri-El's brilliance illuminate your path.
traduit: 愿奥瑞-艾尔之光照亮你的道路。

original: May Auri-El's light guide you in your darkest hours.
traduit: 愿奥瑞-艾尔之光指引你走出最黑暗的时光。

original: May Auri-El's warmth imbue your body with strength.
traduit: 愿奥瑞-艾尔以力量温暖你的身体。

original: May Auri-El's glow shield you from your enemy.
traduit: 愿奥瑞-艾尔之光保护你不受敌人伤害。

original: May Auri-El's radiance fill your heart with joy.
traduit: 愿奥瑞-艾尔之光以欢愉充实你的内心。

original: I'll be off then.
traduit: 那我就走了。

original: This may be the last time we're able to converse. If you have any questions before you leave, I suggest you ask them.
traduit: 这可能是我们最后一次谈话了，离开前还有什么问题，还是尽快问吧。

original: Otherwise, all I can do now is grant you my hopes for a safe journey.
traduit: 除此之外，我也只能祝愿你旅途平安了。

original: So I need to fill this at each wayshrine?
traduit: 所以我得挨个去这些路龛把它倒满？

original: Once you've located a wayshrine, there will be a spectral Prelate tending to it.
traduit: 每次你找到了路龛，会发现有一位幽灵教士照看它。

original: They will allow you to draw the waters from the shrine's basin as if you've been enlightened.
traduit: 他们会让你从路龛的水池里取水，就像得到启蒙一样。

original: These caves must be massive.
traduit: 这些洞穴想必很大。

original: Caves? Oh, no. The Chantry encompasses far more than a few caves, as you'll soon discover.
traduit: 洞穴？哦不。神殿包括的远不止几个洞穴，你很快就知道了。

original: But before I send you on your way, you'll need the Initiate's Ewer.
traduit: 在我送你离开前，你需要新人之壶。

original: How many more wayshrines are there?
traduit: 这里一共有多少路龛？

original: There are five in total, spread far apart across the Chantry.
traduit: 总计五个，分散在神殿各处。

original: I know how it all sounds, but if there was another way I'd have done it long ago.
traduit: 我知道听来很奇怪，但要是有别的办法，我早就那么做了。

original: Well, once the Initiate's enlightenment was complete, he'd bring the ewer to the Chantry's Inner Sanctum.
traduit: 一旦启蒙完成，新人会把水壶带到神殿的内殿。

original: Pouring the contents of the ewer into the sacred basin of the Sanctum would allow him to enter for an audience with the Arch-Curate himself.
traduit: 把水壶里的水倒进圣堂的盆中，就可以进去见教士长了。

original: Once the Initiate completed his mantras, he'd dip a ceremonial ewer in the basin at the wayshrine's center and proceed to the next wayshrine.
traduit: 新人念诵教导之后，会把一只仪式用的水壶浸泡在路龛中心的盆里，然后前往下个路龛。

original: Prelates of these shrines were charged with teaching the mantras of Auri-El to our Initiates.
traduit: 这些路龛的高级教士负责向我们的新人传授奥瑞-艾尔的教导。

original: This structure is known as a wayshrine. They were used for meditation and for transport when the Chantry was a place of enlightenment.
traduit: 这种结构被称为路龛。当神殿还是启蒙之地时，它们被用于冥想和运输。

original: Have you tried getting into the Inner Sanctum?
traduit: 你试过进入内殿吗？

original: Leaving the wayshrines unguarded would be violating my sacred duty as a Knight-Paladin of Auriel.
traduit: 让路龛无人看守会违背我作为奥瑞-艾尔圣骑士的神圣职责。

original: And an assault on the Betrayed guarding the Inner Sanctum would only end with my death.
traduit: 而袭击把守内殿的背叛者只会以我的死亡而告终。

original: You don't even know if he's alive.
traduit: 你甚至都不知道他是否还活着。

original: He's alive. I've seen him.
traduit: 他活着，我见过他。

original: But something's wrong. He never looks as though he's in pain or under duress. He just... stands there and watches, as though waiting.
traduit: 但是有些不对劲，他看上去不像是痛苦或受到胁迫。他只是……站在那里看着，就像在等待。

original: Didn't you fight back?
traduit: 你没有还击吗？

original: The Chantry was a place of peaceful worship. I led a small group of paladins, but we were no match for the Betrayed's sheer numbers.
traduit: 神殿是崇尚和平之地，我手里只有一小队圣骑士，所以不是背叛者的对手。

original: They slaughtered everyone and stormed the Inner Sanctum where I believe they corrupted Vyrthur.
traduit: 他们屠杀了所有人，冲进内殿。维苏尔恐怕就是在那儿被他们腐化了。

original: Do I have a choice?
traduit: 我有得选吗？

original: Absolutely. You could turn around and travel back from wherever you started empty handed, or you could assist me.
traduit: 当然了，你也可以从哪儿来回哪儿去，空手而归。不然，就只能帮我。

original: What type of assistance do you need?
traduit: 你需要什么样的帮助？

original: I need you to kill Arch-Curate Vyrthur... my brother.
traduit: 我需要你去杀了教士长维苏尔……我的兄弟。

original: Kill your brother, why?
traduit: 杀了你的兄弟，为什么？

original: The kinship between us is gone. I don't understand what he's become, but he's no longer the brother I once knew.
traduit: 我们之间没有亲缘关系了。我不明白他变成了什么样，但他不再是我曾经认识的那个兄弟了。

original: It was the Betrayed... they did something to him, I just don't know why Auri-El would allow this to happen.
traduit: 是背叛者们造成的……他们对他做了些什么，我只是不明白为什么奥瑞-艾尔会允许这种事情发生。

original: For the thousands of years I've served as the Chantry's sentinel, there hasn't been a single visitor here for any other reason.
traduit: 我守卫了神殿几千年了，没有一个人是因为其他原因来这里的。

original: They request Auriel's Bow, and I request their assistance. It's been repeated so many times, I can't imagine it any other way.
traduit: 他们需要奥瑞艾尔之弓，我需要他们的帮助。这么多次的重复让我难以想象还有别的可能。

original: Snow elves? You're a Falmer?
traduit: 雪精灵？你是伐莫？

original: I prefer snow elf. The name "Falmer" usually holds a negative meaning to most travelers.
traduit: 我更喜欢雪精灵这个称呼，“伐莫”这个名字对大多数旅人通常都有负面含义。

original: Those twisted creatures you call Falmer, I call the Betrayed.
traduit: 那些你们叫伐莫的扭曲生物，我称之为背叛者。

original: This cave is a temple to Auriel?
traduit: 这个洞穴是奥瑞艾尔的神殿？

original: Auriel, Auri-El, Alkosh, Akatosh... so many different names for the sovereign of the snow elves.
traduit: 奥瑞艾尔，奥瑞-艾尔，阿尔科什，阿卡托什……雪精灵的至高神有这么多不同的名讳。

original: Who are you?
traduit: 你是谁？

original: I am Knight-Paladin Gelebor. Welcome to the Great Chantry of Auri-El.
traduit: 我是圣骑士盖勒布。欢迎来到奥瑞-艾尔的伟大神殿。

original: What is this bloodspring?
traduit: 血泉是什么？

original: An ancient font, full of power. As much as it looks like blood, sadly it is not. Can you imagine if it were? We'd never need to hunt again.
traduit: 一座充溢着力量的古老泉眼。虽然看上去像血水，但很遗憾并不是。能想象它真是血水吗？那我们就再也不用打猎了。

original: Still, its liquid is powerful, full of magic. Others have noticed, though they have never fully realized its potential.
traduit: 尽管如此，它的力量依然

original: All right, you've heard what it has to say. Now tell me, is there any reason I shouldn't kill this bloodsucking fiend right now?
traduit: 好了，你已经听完它说的了。该你说了，我凭什么不杀这个吸血怪物？

original: What do you mean by allaying fear through vampiric seduction?
traduit: 你说用吸血鬼的诱惑来减轻恐惧是什么意思？

original: You've given me a great gift friend. The night air hums and the shadows are full of color.
traduit: 你给了我一件大礼，朋友。夜晚的空气在低吟，阴影中充满了色彩。

original: Make use of my coffin whenever you like. My home is your home.
traduit: 随时可以用我的棺材，我家就是你家。

original: Great gift of blood you've given me. Blood that boils in my veins. Gives me strength.
traduit: 你给我的血是份厚礼。它在我的血管中沸腾着，赐给了我力量。

original: You can use my coffin whenever you like.
traduit: 你随时可以用我的棺材。

original: I never knew the darkness held such colors, or the night air smelled so sweet. You have given me a great gift.
traduit: 我都不知道黑夜中有如此的色彩，空气是这样甜美好闻。你给我的礼物很珍贵。

original: Please, make use of my coffin whenever the need arises.
traduit: 请吧，有需要就用我的棺材吧。

original: My best beloved! I never knew the night held such vibrant color, or that the air vibrated so. And at times, it's as if the very shadows whisper.
traduit: 亲爱的！我从不知道夜里的色彩这么鲜艳，空气是这么有活力，影子们就像是在低语一样。

original: It is a cherished gift you have given me. To see the world this way, through your eyes. It will only bring us closer.
traduit: 你给我的礼物太珍贵了，通过你的眼睛以这样的方式看待这个世界，我们一下就亲近了。

original: It's impressive.
traduit: 真令人印象深刻。

original: It's something all right.
traduit: 没关系的。

original: Why didn't you tell me it was so huge?
traduit: 你怎么没告诉我它有这么大？

original: I didn't want you to think I was one of those... you know, the women who just sit in their castle all day?
traduit: 我不想让你觉得我是那种……你懂的，成天只知道坐在城堡里的那种女人？

original: I don't know. Coming from a place like this, well... it's not really me. I hope you can believe that.
traduit: 我不确定。来到这么个地方，嗯……这不是真正的我。我希望你能相信我说的。

original: Someone you don't want to see?
traduit: 有你不想见的人？

original: My father and I don't really get along.
traduit: 我跟我父亲不太合得来。

original: Ugh, saying it out loud makes it sound so... common. "Little girl who doesn't get along with her father." Read that story a hundred times.
traduit: 啊，讲出来听上去就很……寻常。“跟父亲关系不好的小女孩”，这种故事都读过上百遍了。

original: Why wouldn't you be safe there?
traduit: 你在那里有什么不安全？

original: Let's just say that my mother and father had a bit of a falling out.
traduit: 就算是我父母闹翻了吧。

original: Don't worry, I'm not in any danger or anything like that. It'll just be more unpleasant to run into my father.
traduit: 别担心，我很安全。就是碰见我父亲不会太愉快罢了。

original: Tell me about your home.
traduit: 跟我说说你的家。

original: It's on an island near Solitude. Hopefully we can find a boat to take us there.
traduit: 它在独孤城附近的一座岛上。希望我们能找到一艘船划过去。

original: It's my family home. Not the most welcoming place, but depending on who's around, I'll be safe there.
traduit: 那就是我的家。不是最好的地方，不过这得取决于谁在那里，我在那里会安全的。

original: This is it. Home sweet... castle.
traduit: 就是这样了。甜蜜的家……一座城堡。

original: This is your home?
traduit: 这就是你的家吗？

original: Why were you locked away?
traduit: 你为什么被关起来？

original: I'd... rather not get into that with you. If that's all right.
traduit: 如果可以的话，我……不太想谈论这个。

original: I'm sorry, it's not that... it's just that I don't know who I can trust just yet.
traduit: 抱歉，我……我只是还不知道我能相信谁。

original: Let's get to my home, and I'll have a better sense of where we all stand.
traduit: 去我家吧，我需要再多了解一下当前的情况。

original: How long were you in there?
traduit: 你在那里面有多久了？

original: Good question. Hard to say.
traduit: 好问题。难说啊。

original: I... I can't really tell.
traduit: 我……我真的不知道。

original: I feel like it was a long time. Who is Skyrim's High King?
traduit: 我觉得已经过了好久了。现在谁是天际至高王？

original: Where do you want to go?
traduit: 你想去哪里？

original: I wasn't told where to take you.
traduit: 没有人告诉我该带你去哪里。

original: Your lack of planning fills me with confidence.
traduit: 你这缺少计划的样子可真让我信心满满啊。

original: I don't think he knew much of anything.
traduit: 我觉得他什么都不知道。

original: Figures I'd be woken by a couple of know-nothings. So where are we off to, now?
traduit: 我就知道我会被一些一问三不知的人弄醒。所以现在我们要去哪里？

original: No. We expected some kind of artifact.
traduit: 没。我们以为是某种神器。

original: And instead you found me. So what's your next step, now that I'm here?
traduit: 结果你却发现了我。现在既然我在这里了，你接下来打算怎么办？

original: Nobody. I just walked in here.
traduit: 没人。我就是走进来的。

original: You're lucky to be alive, then. I'm guessing you don't have a plan for where to go next, then?
traduit: 那你没有死可真是走运。那么我猜你没有计划好接下来要去哪里吧？

original: That's not really your business.
traduit: 这不管你的事。

original: I see. Where are you taking me, then? Is that much my business?
traduit: 我知道了。那么你要带我去哪里？这总该关我的事了吧？

original: A man named Isran.
traduit: 一个叫伊士冉的人。

original: I... don't know who that is. Did he... mention my father at all?
traduit: 我……不认识他。他……提过我父亲吗？

original: I was sent to retrieve something from this cave.
traduit: 他们派我来到这个洞穴里取些东西。

original: That something... was probably me.
traduit: 那东西……可能就是我。

original: My name is Serana. Who sent you here?
traduit: 我叫瑟拉娜。谁派你到这里来的？

original: Unh... where is... who sent you here?
traduit: 呃……在哪里……谁派你来的？

original: Unh... who are you?
traduit: 呃……你是谁？

original: It appears I have you to thank for turning my daughter against me.
traduit: 看来我还要感谢你让我女儿背叛我呢。

original: I knew it was only a matter of time before she'd return with hatred in her heart.
traduit: 我知道她带着仇恨回来只是时间问题。

original: I knew it was only a matter of time before your ambition outgrew your loyalty.
traduit: 我知道你的野心超过你的忠诚只是时间问题。

original: What's on your mind?
traduit: 你在想什么？

original: That Moth Priest, Dexion. He said we needed two other Elder Scrolls. I think I know where we can start looking.
traduit: 那个蛾祭司，戴希翁。他说我们还需要两份上古卷轴，我大概知道从哪里开始找了。

original: Can't it wait?
traduit: 不能等等吗？

original: Well, you could waste a lot of time trying to figure out our next move, or you could let me help.
traduit: 好吧，你可以花很久很久试图去想明白我们该怎么办，或者你可以让我搭把手。

original: Your choice.
traduit: 随你便。

original: Years of mocking, of dismissal... and now suddenly here you are, begging for help.
traduit: 多年来的嘲笑，无视……然后现在你突然就来求我帮忙了。

original: Yes, you've explained yourself. I'm supposed to just throw myself in front of you all and offer protection, am I?
traduit: 对，你说得很明白了。我就该挡在前面保护你们，是吧？

original: Isran, these vampires are different. I know you've disagreed with the Order in the past...
traduit: 伊士冉，这些吸血鬼不一样。我知道你反对教团以前的做法……

original: Why not just scream at the top of your lungs "Here we are, monsters! We're oh so tasty! Come and get us!"
traduit: 不如扯嗓子大喊“在这儿呢，怪物！我们味道好极啦！来抓我们啊！”

original: Look at these fools, so concerned with tending their precious "beacon."
traduit: 这群傻瓜，这么担心照看他们的宝贝“信标”。

original: Well what did you expect, Tolan? Didn't I tell you? Didn't I warn you this would happen?
traduit: 那你在期待什么呢，托兰？我没告诉你们吗？是我没警告过你们会出这种事吗？

original: So where is this Elder Scroll?
traduit: 那么上古卷轴在哪里？

original: We need to find my mother, Valerica.
traduit: 我们得找到我母亲，瓦蕾莉卡。

original: She'll definitely know where it is, and if we're lucky, she actually has it herself.
traduit: 她肯定知道它在哪里，如果我们运气好的话，没准她自己就拿着那东西呢。

original: Isn't that pretty risky, staying around the castle?
traduit: 待在城堡里会不会很危险？

original: Oh, absolutely. But my mother's not a coward.
traduit: 啊，当然啦。不过我母亲不是个胆小鬼。

original: That is... I don't think we'll actually trip over her there. But it's worth a look.
traduit: 只不过……咱们应该碰不上她。试试看吧。

original: There's an unused inlet on the northern side of the island that was used by the previous owners to bring supplies into the castle.
traduit: 小岛的北边有一个废弃的入口，城堡的前主人用它来运送补给。

original: An old escape tunnel from the castle exits there. I think that's our way in.
traduit: 那里有个老旧的逃生通道。我们可以从那里进去。

original: In Castle Volkihar?
traduit: 就在沃基哈尔城堡？

original: Wait... that almost makes sense!
traduit: 等等……这差不多就说得通了。

original: There's a courtyard in the castle. I used to help her tend a garden there.
traduit: 城堡里有一个庭院。我过去常常在那里帮她打理花园。

original: All of the ingredients for our potions came from there. She used to say that my father couldn't stand the place. Too... peaceful.
traduit: 我们所有药剂的材料都出自那里。她常说我父亲受不了那个地方，太……平静了。

original: I used to help my mother tend a garden in the courtyard here.
traduit: 我过去常常在那里帮我母亲打理花园。

original: How about right here, in the castle?
traduit: 会不会就在这栋城堡里呢？

original: Sealed away like you were?
traduit: 像你一样被关起来？

original: I don't think so. She said she wanted to stay awake in case the situation was resolved.
traduit: 我不这么认为，她说她想保持清醒，也许能解开这个局面。

original: It had to be one of us, and, well, she's so much more powerful than I am. It just made sense for her to be out here.
traduit: 肯定是我们中的一个人，嗯，她比我强得多，留在外面合情合理。

original: Anything else?
traduit: 还有别的事吗？

original: Feel the last word of Soul Tearing within yourself: "Zol" - the unlife that results when a soul is imprisoned in dead flesh.
traduit: 在内心感受灵魂撕裂的最后一个词：“佐尔”——灵魂被囚禁在死躯中的非生命状态。

original: Hear now the second word of Soul Tearing: "Vaaz"- meaning to tear your enemy's soul from its living vessel.
traduit: 现在听好灵魂撕裂的第二个词：“瓦兹”——意为从敌人的生命容器中撕裂灵魂。

original: As promised, I now teach you the first word of Soul Tearing: "Rii" - the essence of your enemy's life force.
traduit: 依照承诺的那样，我现在教你灵魂撕裂的第一个词：“瑞尔”——敌人生命能量的精华。

original: You have kept your side of the bargain, now let me fulfill mine.
traduit: 你已经履行了你的承诺，现在该我了。

original: I can feel my strength returning each time I am set free from that prison!
traduit: 每次从那监狱里被释放出来，都感觉到我的力量又回来了！

original: Ah! The free air of Vus at long last!
traduit: 啊！终于有威斯的自由空气了！

original: I rejoice in my freedom, if only for a moment.
traduit: 我为我的自由而高兴，哪怕只有片刻。

original: The skies of Keizaal are mine again!
traduit: 凯扎尔的天空又属于我了！

original: You give me freedom from the enslavement of the Ideal Masters. Thank you.
traduit: 你让我从理想之主的奴役中解脱出来，感谢你。

original: You share her blood.
traduit: 你也流着她的血。

original: Hmmm. Not bad. We'd better hope that's good enough. Mistakes with these kinds of portals can be... gruesome.
traduit: 嗯。不赖啊。希望这就够了。这种传送门如果出错的话……后果挺可怕的。

original: Anyway, enough of that. Let's get started.
traduit: 不管怎样，这就够了。我们开始吧。

original: We're also going to need a sample of her blood. Which... if we could get that, we wouldn't even be trying to do this in the first place.
traduit: 我们还需要她的血液样本。这东西……如果我们能拿得到的话，我们还来这里干嘛啊。

original: What do we need?
traduit: 我们需要些什么呢？

original: A handful of soul gem shards, some finely-ground bone meal, a good bit of purified void salts...
traduit: 灵魂石碎片，精研骨粉，再加上纯净虚无盐……

original: Oh... damn it...
traduit: 啊……活见鬼……

original: If she made it there, we'll find her.
traduit: 如果她成功进去了，那我们会把她找出来的。

original: That circle in the center of the room is definitely some type of portal.
traduit: 这房间中央的圆圈很明显就是某种传送门了。

original: If I'm reading this right, there's a formula here that should give us safe passage into the Soul Cairn.
traduit: 如果我没理解错的话，这里这个配方应该能给我们创造出安全进入灵魂石冢的通道。

original: Why did she care where used souls went?
traduit: 为什么她会在乎灵魂的去向呢？

original: The Soul Cairn is home to very powerful beings. Necromancers send them souls, and receive powers of their own in return.
traduit: 灵魂石冢里有很强大的东西。死灵法师送给他们灵魂，然后得到他们的力量作为交换。

original: My mother spent a lot of time trying to contact them directly, to travel to the Soul Cairn itself.
traduit: 我母亲花了很长时间，试着直接跟它们交流并进入灵魂石冢。

original: What's this "Soul Cairn" that she mentions?
traduit: 她提到的这个“灵魂石冢”是什么？

original: I only know what she told me.
traduit: 我只知道她跟我说过的内容。

original: She had a theory about soul gems. That the souls inside of them don't just vanish when they're used... they end up in the Soul Cairn.
traduit: 她有个关于灵魂石的理论。使用时，宝石里的灵魂没有消失……而是去了灵魂石冢。

original: I've found your mother's notes.
traduit: 我找到了你母亲的笔记。

original: You did? Let me see them.
traduit: 你找到了？让我看看。

original: And what's this thing?
traduit: 这是用来干什么的？

original: Look at all this. She must have spent years collecting these components.
traduit: 瞧瞧这些。她一定花了很多年来收集这些部件。

original: You are prey, like all mortals. I banish you!
traduit: 跟其他凡人一样的猎物。我这就将你驱逐！

original: I've collected all the Amulets of Night Power.
traduit: 我已经收集了所有的暗夜之力护符。

original: Excellent! I'm sure you'll put those to good use.
traduit: 非常好！好好利用吧。

original: Good luck.
traduit: 祝你好运。

original: Will I be able to keep these amulets?
traduit: 我能保管这些护符吗？

original: Of course. I wouldn't be telling you where to find them if I desired them for myself.
traduit: 当然可以，我想要的话就不会告诉你去哪找它们了。

original: Of course. I wouldn't be telling you where to find it if I desired it for myself.
traduit: 当然可以，我想要的话就不会告诉你去哪找它了。

original: Will I be able to keep this amulet?
traduit: 我能保管这个护符吗？

original: Where did these amulets come from?
traduit: 这些护符是哪来的？

original: Depends on who you ask. Some say Molag-Bal himself gave these amulets to ancient powerful vampire lords. Some say this is just a myth.
traduit: 看你问谁了。有人说莫拉格·巴尔亲手将这些护符送给了古代的强大吸血鬼领主，有人说这不过是传说罢了。

original: Harkon disbelieved in their existence, though perhaps he felt slighted they were not already in his possession and only feigns indifference.
traduit: 哈孔不相信它们存在，尽管他可能是觉得它们还没有为他所用，假装漠不关心。

original: What do these amulets do?
traduit: 这些古护符有什么用？

original: The amulets increase the effectiveness of your vampiric powers.
traduit: 这些护符能增长你吸血鬼力量的效果。

original: Is there anything I can do to help?
traduit: 有什么我能帮忙的吗？

original: I've located the last known resting place of a set of ancient Amulets of Night Power.
traduit: 我发现了一套有着暗夜之力的古护符的最后沉睡之地。

original: They should be among our kind, not laying about unguarded for mortals to find.
traduit: 它们应与我等同在，而不是无防备地任由凡人们去寻找。

original: I've located one of the lost ancient Amulets of Night Power.
traduit: 我已经确定了一个遗失的暗夜之力古护符的位置。

original: It should be among our kind, not laying about unguarded for mortals to find.
traduit: 它应与我等同在，而不是无防备地任由凡人们去寻找。

original: Where did these rings come from?
traduit: 这些戒指从哪来的？

original: Depends on who you ask. Some say Molag-Bal himself gave these rings to ancient powerful vampire lords. Some say that is just a myth.
traduit: 取决于你问谁了，有人说莫拉格·巴尔把这些戒指赐给了一些远古的强大吸血鬼君王。有人说那只是个传说。

original: Harkon himself disbelieved in their existence, though perhaps he felt slighted they were not already in his possession and only feigns indifference.
traduit: 哈孔自己也不相信它们的存在，虽然他可能是因为自己还没有掌控它们，所以假装无所谓而轻视它们。

original: Best of luck to you.
traduit: 祝你好运。

original: Will I be able to keep these rings?
traduit: 我能保留这些戒指吗？

original: Of course, I wouldn't be telling you where to find them if I desired them for myself.
traduit: 当然，我要是想要的话也不会告诉你它们在哪儿了。

original: Of course, I wouldn't be telling you where to find it if I desired it for myself.
traduit: 当然，我要是想要的话也不会告诉你它在哪儿了。

original: Will I be able to keep the ring?
traduit: 我能保留这个戒指吗？

original: What do these rings do?
traduit: 这些戒指有什么用？

original: They increase the abilities of your vampiric powers.
traduit: 它们能增长你的吸血鬼能力。

original: I've collected all the Rings of Blood Magic.
traduit: 我已经找回了所有的血魔法戒指。

original: Well done! I trust you'll put those to good use then.
traduit: 干得漂亮！希望你会好好利用它们。

original: I've discovered the whereabouts of a set of ancient Rings of Blood Magic.
traduit: 我发现了一套上古血魔法戒指的下落。

original: They belong among our kind, not gathering mold in some vagabond's treasure pile.
traduit: 它们属于我族，而非在某个流浪汉的财宝堆里面发霉。

original: I've discovered the whereabouts of one of the ancient Rings of Blood Magic.
traduit: 我发现了一枚上古血魔法戒指的下落。

original: It belongs among our kind, not gathering mold in some vagabond's treasure pile.
traduit: 它属于我族，而非在某个流浪汉的财宝堆里面发霉。

original: <Alias=Candidate> has been welcomed to the family.
