traduit: <Alias=Candidate>已经被接到我们大家庭来了。

original: Very good. Should you visit him again, I suspect you'll find our new sibling appreciates his transformation.
traduit: 非常好，如果你再去拜访他，我想你会发现我们这位新兄弟会很感激他的转化。

original: Very good. Should you visit her again, I suspect you'll find our new sibling appreciates her transformation.
traduit: 非常好，如果你再去拜访她，我想你会发现我们这位新姐妹会很感激她的转化。

original: Rrrraaaaahhhh!
traduit: 啊啊啊啊！

original: Yyyaaahh!
traduit: 咿呀啊啊！

original: Grrah!
traduit: 嘎啊！

original: Yah!
traduit: 呀！

original: Die!
traduit: 去死吧！

original: Yaahh!
traduit: 呀啊！

original: Gaaahh...
Not... yet...
Not... like... this...
traduit: 不该……如此……

original: Gah...
Unf!
traduit: 唔！

original: Hey, watch it!
traduit: 嘿，看着点！

original: Hmph.
traduit: 嗯。

original: Hey!
traduit: 嘿！

original: Watch it!
traduit: 小心点！

original: What are you doing?
traduit: 你在做什么？

original: Agh!
traduit: 啊哈！

original: Oof!
traduit: 哦！

original: Son of a...
traduit: 狗娘养的……

original: Over here!
traduit: 在这！

original: Hmm?
traduit: 嗯？

original: Yes?
traduit: 嗯？

original: You need something?
traduit: 有什么事吗？

original: Sorry, what?
traduit: 抱歉，什么？

original: What the... get back! Hurry!
traduit: 什么……回来！快！

original: Got him!
traduit: 抓住他！

original: To think... no one's been here in four thousand years...
traduit: 想想看……已经四千年没人来过这儿了……

original: It's... it's true. It's all true! Come on, let's check it out!
traduit: 这是……是真的。都是真的！来吧，我们来看看！

original: Woah...
traduit: 哇哦……

original: Beautiful. That crown... it's everything I could have hoped for.
traduit: 太美了，那王冠……这正是我梦寐以求的。

original: Beautiful. That staff... it's everything I could have hoped for.
traduit: 太美了，那法杖……这正是我梦寐以求的。

original: Beautiful. That shield... it's everything I could have hoped for.
traduit: 太美了，那盾牌……这正是我梦寐以求的。

original: By forging something, of course!
traduit: 当然是锻造一个东西了！

original: Go ahead. After everything you've done, you should do the honors.
traduit: 去吧，你做了这么多，这份荣耀应该属于你。

original: I... I almost can't believe it. We did it! We actually did it!
traduit: 我……我都不敢相信。我们做到了！真的做到了！

original: There's only one thing left to do. We have to prove this actually works. That this is the real Aetherium Forge.
traduit: 只剩一件事情了，我们要证明这里就是真正的神光水晶锻炉。

original: I can hardly believe it. This is it. We've actually found the Forge! At last!
traduit: 简直不敢相信，就是这里，我们真的找到了锻炉！找到了！

original: What do you make of all this?
traduit: 你怎么看这一切？

original: Go ahead, give it a try.
traduit: 来吧，试一试。

original: Look at the device here - the gear in the center is just about the right size. Try putting the shards in and... we'll see what happens.
traduit: 看这个装置，中心的齿轮正好合适。试下把碎片放进去然后……看看会怎么样。

original: Yes, I have them. What now?
traduit: 是的，我带了碎片。接下来呢？

original: You made it! And you've brought the shards!
traduit: 你来了，还带来了碎片！

original: We still have to find the Forge itself. I had a lead on that, too.
traduit: 我们还是要找到锻炉本身，那里我也有一个线索。

original: There's so much to do. I'm going to head out and start tracking things down. We'll meet again, I'm sure of it.
traduit: 有太多事情要做了，我要出去开始找些东西。我们还会再见面的，我相信。

original: For the first time in a long while, I think I - we - may actually be able to do this. And... and I owe it all to you. Thank you.
traduit: 很长一段时间以来，我头一次觉得我——我们——可能真的能办成这件事。而这……都是你的功劳。谢谢你。

original: Then what?
traduit: 接下来呢？

original: I had a map, in my journal. That's where we should start.
traduit: 我日记里有张地图，我们就从这儿入手。

original: We have to find the other pieces, of course. There should be, hmm... three more. One for each of the four cities that worked on the Forge.
traduit: 当然了，我们得找到其他的碎片。应该有，嗯……还有三个。四个参与锻造的城市各有一个。

original: So... what now?
traduit: 那么……现在要做什么？

original: My life's work. Unraveling one of the great mysteries of the dwarves.
traduit: 这是我毕生的事业，解开矮人最伟大的谜团之一。

original: What are you talking about?
traduit: 你在说什么？

original: Let me see it. ...Huh...
traduit: 我来看看……哈……

original: Look, on the edge here. This has been cut, precisely cut. If you had another piece, about the same size, it would... it would snap right in.
traduit: 看，在这边缘。是切割的痕迹，而且很精确。如果有另一件同样大小的碎片，应该……应该能正好拼在一起。

original: I saw a drawing of this once. This shard... it's... it's part of a key. A key made of pure Aetherium! The key to the Forge!
traduit: 我以前在图纸上见过，这碎片……是……是钥匙的一部分。用纯净的神光水晶打造！通往锻炉的钥匙！

original: What? What is this?
traduit: 什么？这是什么？

original: So this is it...
traduit: 那么这就是了……

original: Got it!
traduit: 成了！

original: If all else fails, just take a chance, see what happens. Wouldn't be surprised if half the traps had been sprung by now...
traduit: 实在没辙的话，就放手一搏，看看会发生什么。搞不好半数陷阱都已经失效了……

original: See if you can find a pattern in the sequence. Most of these locks have a pattern of some kind.
traduit: 看看能不能找到这组顺序里的规律。这类机关锁大多都有某种规律可循。

original: You might look around a bit. Maybe one of our predecessors still has a clue.
traduit: 可以四处看看，也许某位前辈还有线索。

original: You could always go back and get my journal, you know.
traduit: 随时可以回去拿我的日记，知道吗。

original: Would you want me to? After what happened the last time I tried it?
traduit: 你想让我帮忙吗？我上次可是失败了哦？

original: I'll fight anything that can be fought. Beyond that... I don't want your death on my conscience.
traduit: 只要是能打到的东西，我都不怕。但……我不想因为我的过失，让你也送命。

original: Are you going to help?
traduit: 你会帮忙吗？

original: Beyond that... well, maybe one of our predecessors still has a clue.
traduit: 除此以外……嗯，也许某位前辈还有线索。

original: Well, your loss...
traduit: 唉，这是你的损失……

original: Hey! Journal?
traduit: 嘿！日记？

original: Grab my journal, would you? We're going to need it.
traduit: 带上我的日记好吗？我们会需要的。

original: ...this is where I ended up. It was... quite the fall.
traduit: ……这就是我最后的归宿，还真是……摔得够惨。

original: Any advice?
traduit: 有什么建议吗？

original: Hmm... well, you can pick up where I left off. My notes should still be in my journal, if you can read it.
traduit: 嗯……好吧，你可以接着我停下的地方继续。我的笔记应该还在日记里，但愿你看得懂。

original: Well, my notes were in my journal, but you didn't grab that, did you? Hmph.
traduit: 嗯，我的笔记就在日记里，但你还没拿上吧？哼。

original: ...Yeah. I thought I was prepared for anything. How can you prepare for a damned earthquake?
traduit: ……是啊。我就算准备得再全，又怎么知道会有地震？

original: And that was just one trap! Look around! Who knows what else this thing is capable of?
traduit: 而且那只是陷阱之一！看看周围吧！谁知道这里还会有什么？

original: You mean... the earthquake?
traduit: 你是说……那次地震？

original: Well, there's the Falmer, to start with. Deadly rapids. Major earthquakes. Massive chasms. Unstable ground. Lethal falls.
traduit: 嗯，首先是伐莫。还有致命的湍流、大地震、巨型裂缝、不稳定的地面、危险的瀑布。

original: And then you get to the real danger. We can discuss that when the time comes. If it comes.
traduit: 然后才是真正的危险，如果遇到了的话，到时候我们再讨论。

original: Any dangers I should be aware of?
traduit: 有什么危险需要我注意吗？

original: It wasn't always like this. Best-preserved dwarven city I'd ever laid eyes on. And then... the earthquake hit.
traduit: 这里以前可不这样。本来是我见过的保存最完好的矮人城市。后来……发生地震了。

original: Now... you'd be lucky to find a single room intact.
traduit: 现在……你能找到一间完好的房间都算幸运了。

original: What happened to this place?
traduit: 这个地方发生了什么？

original: Now you decide to give up? Fine. I'll be here.
traduit: 现在决定放弃了？好吧，反正我就在这儿。

original: No thanks.
traduit: 不了，谢谢。

original: Sure.
traduit: 当然。

original: I'm not going to talk you out of it, am I? I know, I know. I was just like you, once.
traduit: 看来我是劝不住你了，是吧？我懂，我懂，以前的我就跟你一样。

original: Well, if you want to reach the summit, you're going to need some help. You... want a hand?
traduit: 好了，如果你想抵达最高处，就还需要一些帮助。需要……我帮忙吗？

original: I won't give up that easily.
traduit: 我不会轻易放弃。

original: I can handle myself. (Persuade)
traduit: 我自己应付得来。（说服）

original: Hmph... maybe so. Then again, I thought I could, too.
traduit: 嗯……可能吧。话说回来，我也以为我可以呢。

original: Sure, that's what they all say.
traduit: 是啊，好些人都这么说。

original: The name's Katria. I am - was - an adventurer. Raided ruins like this for nigh on twenty years.
traduit: 我叫卡提雅，是个——曾经是个冒险家。探索这样的遗迹已经二十年了。

original: I was on the trail of something big. It led me here, and... I didn't make it.
traduit: 我在追踪一桩大发现。为它跑到这儿来，然后……就折在这儿了。

original: Who are you?
traduit: 你是谁？

original: What are you still doing here?
traduit: 你怎么还在这儿？

original: Let me guess. You're here for the treasure, aren't you? Just like all the others.
traduit: 我猜下，你是来找宝藏的吧？就跟其他人一样。

original: Turn back...
traduit: 回去吧……

original: What can you tell me about Dimhollow Crypt?
traduit: 关于幽空地穴你能告诉我些什么？

original: Brother Adalvald had been there not long ago. Said he found something of great importance.
traduit: 阿达瓦尔德修士不久前还去过那里，说他发现了非常重要的东西。

original: It must have been important to the vampires as well, for them to risk an open attack on the Vigilants.
traduit: 对吸血鬼来说肯定也很重要，因为他们竟然冒险在毫无掩护的情况下攻击警戒者。

original: What was this place?
traduit: 这是什么地方？

original: Are there other Vigilants out there?
traduit: 外面还有其他警戒者吗？

original: How did you survive the vampires' attack?
traduit: 你是怎么从吸血鬼的进攻中活下来的呢？

original: I'll meet you in Dimhollow Crypt. I owe these vampires a debt of vengeance.
traduit: 我会跟你在幽空地穴碰面的。我要向这帮吸血鬼报仇雪恨。

original: I'm ready to be turned.
traduit: 我已经准备好被转化了。

original: I promise to try and make this as painless as possible. Hold still.
traduit: 我保证尽量不弄疼你。别动。

original: Let's just get it over with.
traduit: 那我们就赶紧把这事结了吧。

original: As you wish.
traduit: 如你所愿。

original: I understand.
traduit: 我知道了。

original: Good.
traduit: 很好。

original: In that case, I'm glad you're the one doing it.
traduit: 那样的话，我很高兴你是转化我的那个人。

original: Let's not waste too much time, then.
traduit: 那我们就别浪费时间了。

original: I'm ready.
traduit: 我准备好了。

original: Turning someone is a very... personal thing for vampires. It's intimate. For us.
traduit: 对于吸血鬼来说，把某人转化成吸血鬼是一件……很私人的事情。对我们而言，这事很私密。

original: I don't want you to feel like I'm forcing you into this.
traduit: 我不想让你觉得我是在逼你。

original: You're right. Let me think about it.
traduit: 你说得对。让我考虑考虑。

original: I understand. Take your time.
traduit: 我明白了。不着急。

original: She actually did it... created a portal to the Soul Cairn. Incredible.
traduit: 她真的做到了……创造一个通往灵魂石冢的传送门。真了不起。

original: By the blood of my ancestors...
traduit: 祖先的血脉啊……

original: Let's get that portal open.
traduit: 我们把传送门给打开吧。

original: All right. Here goes.
traduit: 好的。来吧。

original: We won't know until we find her.
traduit: 只有找到她，我们才能知道。

original: Yes... yes, you're right. I'm sorry. I just didn't expect anyone to care how I felt about her. Thank you.
traduit: 是啊……没错，你说得对。对不起。我只是没想到会有人在乎我对她的看法。谢谢。

original: Are we ready then?
traduit: 那准备好了吗？

original: It sounds like she was pretty selfish.
traduit: 听起来她挺自私的。

original: She wasn't, always. But I think you're right.
traduit: 她也不是一直这样。不过我想你说的没错。

original: She was practically smirking as we left home. Almost like she was proud of herself.
traduit: 当我们离家出走时，她几乎在傻笑，就像是为自己感到骄傲一样。

original: Like she didn't want to just stop my father... she wanted to stick it to him, too.
traduit: 就好像她不仅仅是想要阻止我父亲……她还想要他难受。

original: I don't know what she was thinking.
traduit: 我不知道她在想些什么。

original: Neither do I.
traduit: 我也不知道。

original: She always seemed happy, before we heard the prophecy. Then it all changed. She became a different person. They both did.
traduit: 在我们听说预言之前，她总是那么快乐。然后一切都不一样了。她完全变了一个人。他们俩都是。

original: It sounds like she did everything for your sake.
traduit: 听起来她所做的一切都是为了你好。

original: Possibly. I guess even a vampire mother is still a mother.
traduit: 可能吧。我猜即便是一位吸血鬼母亲也依旧是母亲。

original: She worried about me. About all of us. But she wanted to get me as far away from my father as possible before he really went over the edge.
traduit: 她很关心我，还有我们所有人。但她想在我父亲彻底崩溃前，带我离他越远越好。

original: What will you do if we find your mother?
traduit: 找到了你母亲后，你打算怎么做？

original: I've been asking myself the same thing since we came back to the castle.
traduit: 自从我回到城堡后，我就一直问自己同样的问题。

original: She was so sure of what we did to my father, I couldn't help but go along with her. I never thought of the cost.
traduit: 她很清楚我们对父亲做了些什么，我忍不住就同意了她的做法，而从来没考虑过代价。

original: Okay, here goes.
traduit: 好，开始了。

original: Can I ask you something first?
traduit: 我能先问你些问题吗？

original: Of course. What is it?
traduit: 当然。你想问什么？

original: The ingredients are in the vessel.
traduit: 配料放容器里了。

original: Then the rest is up to me.
traduit: 那剩下的就交给我了。

original: Are you ready to go? I'm not entirely sure what this thing is going to do when I add my blood.
traduit: 你准备好出发了吗？我不完全确定加入我的血液后，这东西会怎么样。

original: No... it's not working!
traduit: 不……不管用！

original: Fools.
traduit: 傻瓜。

original: The bow! Use the bow!
traduit: 弓！用那把弓！

original: Break his shield! Hurry!
traduit: 打破他的护盾！快！

original: Quick, the bow!
traduit: 快，用那把弓！

original: Yeargh!
traduit: 呀啊啊！

original: You were waiting... all this time for someone with my blood to come along.
traduit: 你等了……这么久就是为了我这种血统的人出现。

original: Well, too bad for you... I intend on keeping it. Let's see if your blood has any power to it!
traduit: 那么，很遗憾……我要自己留着。先来看看你的血有没有什么力量！

original: A prophecy that lacked a single, final ingredient... the blood of a pure vampire. The blood of a Daughter of Coldharbour.
traduit: 但还缺少最后一种成分……纯种吸血鬼的血，冷港之女的血。

original: The blood of a vampire... Auriel's Bow...
traduit: 吸血鬼的血……奥瑞艾尔之弓……

original: It... it was you? You created that prophecy?
traduit: 是……是你？你创造了那个预言？

original: Auri-El himself may have been beyond my reach, but his influence on our world wasn't.
traduit: 或许我无法触及奥瑞-艾尔本尊，但他对世界的影响，却另当别论了。

original: All I needed was the blood of a vampire and his own weapon, Auriel's Bow.
traduit: 我只需要吸血鬼的血和他的武器，奥瑞艾尔之弓。

original: You want to take revenge... on a god?
traduit: 你想要……向神复仇？

original: The moment I was infected by one of my own Initiates, Auri-El turned his back on me.
traduit: 自从我被麾下的新人感染，奥瑞-艾尔就抛弃了我。

original: I swore I'd have my revenge, no matter what the cost.
traduit: 我发誓要复仇，无论付出什么代价。

original: You're... you're a vampire?
traduit: 你是……你是个吸血鬼？

original: But Auriel should have protected you...
traduit: 但奥瑞艾尔应该会保护你……

original: Gelebor and his kind are easily manipulated fools.
traduit: 盖勒布和他的同类都是些易于操纵的傻子。

original: Look into my eyes, Serana. You tell me what I am.
traduit: 看着我的眼睛，瑟拉娜。告诉我，我到底是什么。

original: Until the "Betrayed" corrupted you. Yes, yes. We've heard this sad story.
traduit: 直到“背叛者”腐化了你。好了好了，我们听过这悲伤的故事了。

original: How dare you. I was the Arch-Curate of Auri-El, girl. I had the ears of a god!
traduit: 放肆！你这小丫头，我可是奥瑞-艾尔的教士长。神也要为我侧耳！

original: Enough, Vyrthur. Give us the bow!
traduit: 够了，维苏尔。把弓给我们！

original: Well, at least we're getting closer. Let's go.
traduit: 好吧，至少我们越来越近了。走吧。

original: I've never been in those tunnels before, but I'd bet they run right under the courtyard and into the tower ruins.
traduit: 我以前从没进过这些地道，不过我敢肯定它们通向庭院下方，一直通向塔楼的废墟里。

original: Very clever, mother. Very clever.
traduit: 老妈，聪明啊，太聪明了。

original: Then he just walled it off.
traduit: 然后他就把它给封起来了。

original: It appears that way. I suppose he wanted to put the past behind him.
traduit: 似乎是这样。我觉得他想把这些抛诸脑后。

original: Perhaps if he had spent more time with us, he would have recognized the beauty for himself.
traduit: 他要是肯多花点时间在我们身上，说不准还能意识到家里有多美。

original: What happened to the castle courtyard?
traduit: 城堡庭院发生了什么？

original: If I had to guess, I'd say the moment mother fled the castle, father went on a rampage.
traduit: 要我猜的话，大概我母亲一逃离城堡，我父亲就暴跳如雷了。

original: Knowing him, anything at all that reminded him of her was just destroyed.
traduit: 据我对他的了解，所有让他想起我母亲的东西都会被毁掉。

original: Everything's been torn down... the whole place looks... well, dead. It's like we're the first to set foot here in centuries.
traduit: 全都被拆了……整个地方好像……好吧，死了。就好像我们是几百年来第一个踏进这里的人。

original: We've made it to the courtyard.
traduit: 我们到庭院了。

original: Oh no...
traduit: 哦不……

original: I used to walk through here after evening meals. It was beautiful, once.
traduit: 我过去常常在晚餐后路过这里。这里曾经很漂亮。

original: Wait...
traduit: 等等……

original: Something's wrong with the moondial here. Some of the crests are missing and the dial is askew.
traduit: 这里的月晷出了些问题，有些纹样缺失，仪表盘也歪了。

original: I didn't even know the crests could be removed. Maybe my mother's trying to tell us something?
traduit: 我都不知道这些纹样是能取下来的，难道我妈是想告诉我们什么？

original: This was my mother's garden. It... do you know how beautiful something can be when it's tended by a master for hundreds of years?
traduit: 这里曾经是我母亲的花园。哎……你知道某样东西被主人精心保养上百年后能有多漂亮吗？

original: She would have hated to see it like this.
traduit: 她肯定不喜欢看到这花园变成这样。

original: This used to lead into the castle's great hall. It looks like my father had it sealed up.
traduit: 这条路曾经通向城堡大厅。看起来我父亲把它给封起来了。

original: That's why we're headed there?
traduit: 这就是我们去那里的原因吗？

original: She had to be up to something in that garden. I'm hoping it's a clue that will tell us where she went.
traduit: 她肯定在那个花园里藏了什么名堂。但愿是有关她下落的线索。

original: But then it all changed.
traduit: 不过后来一切都变了。

original: It was very sudden. It was almost like one day we were a normal family, and then the next I didn't know who they were.
traduit: 变得很突然。就好像昨天我们还是一个正常的家庭，然后第二天我就不认识他们了。

original: I'd try to visit my mother in the garden, and she'd quickly shoo me away saying she was much too busy.
traduit: 我试图去花园里去找我母亲，不过她说她太忙了，很快就把我轰走了。

original: So you always got along?
traduit: 所以你们总是在一起了？

original: Like the best of friends. I would never hesitate to share anything with her.
traduit: 就像最好的朋友一样。我想都不会想就会跟她分享一切。

original: Were you and Valerica close?
traduit: 你跟瓦蕾莉卡关系很好吗？

original: Before my father became obsessed with the prophecy, mother and I spent quite a bit of time together.
traduit: 在我父亲痴迷于那则预言之前，我母亲跟我总是呆在一起。

original: She was very fond of her alchemical garden in the castle courtyard. She taught me quite a bit about cultivating quality reagents.
traduit: 她很喜欢城堡院子里的炼金花园，教了我很多有关培养高质量试剂的知识。

original: But now... we have a clue. Something made by the Forge. Something that can lead us to it.
traduit: 但现在……我们有线索了。锻炉打造的一些东西，能带我们去找到它的东西。

original: To what end?
traduit: 目的是什么？

original: I don't know. Certainly not longevity. Kind of a waste of time for a vampire.
traduit: 不知道，肯定不是为了延年益寿，对吸血鬼来说完全是浪费时间。

original: What did she research?
traduit: 她都研究什么呢？

original: Looking at the equipment and materials, it looks like she was trying to advance her necromancy.
traduit: 从这些设备和材料来看，大概是想精进自己的死灵法术吧。

original: Your mother maintained quite a laboratory.
traduit: 你母亲的实验室真不错。

original: I had no idea that her laboratory even existed.
traduit: 我根本不知道这里有个实验室。

original: She had an alchemy setup in her drawing room, but nothing that even comes close to what's here.
traduit: 她的客厅里有一个炼金装置，但根本比不了这里的东西。

original: Fools? Why do you say that?
traduit: 蠢蛋？你为什么这么说呢？

original: Because most of the stories end with the Ideal Masters duping the necromancers, who end up dead or wishing they were dead.
traduit: 因为大部分故事都以理想之主欺骗死灵法师收场，这些家伙要不就是死了，要不就是生不如死。

original: Then how are you sure they even exist?
traduit: 那你是怎么确信它们存在呢？

original: I've read stories. Stories about fools that managed to... communicate with them.
traduit: 我读过一些故事。讲述蠢蛋们试图去……跟它们交流。

original: You give the Ideal Masters souls, they give you powers to summon the undead. It's all very business-like.
traduit: 你给理想之主灵魂，它们给你召唤亡灵的力量。就像是做生意一样。

original: What exactly are the Ideal Masters?
traduit: 理想之主究竟是什么？

original: Nobody really knows.
traduit: 没有人知道。

original: As far as I've heard, no one's seen them and returned to Tamriel to tell about it.
traduit: 据我所知，没有人见过它们后还能活着回泰姆瑞尔。

original: Why was your mother so fascinated by it?
traduit: 你母亲为什么对它如此痴迷？

original: Honestly, I don't know. Necromancers are always interested in souls, though, so that probably has some kind of interest.
traduit: 老实说，我不知道。死灵法师总会对灵魂感兴趣，所以可能是有某种吸引力。

original: Anything you can tell me about the Soul Cairn?
traduit: 能跟我说说灵魂石冢吗？

original: The Soul Cairn is a tiny sliver of Oblivion, the realm of the daedra.
traduit: 灵魂石冢位于湮灭，也就是迪德拉领域的一小块区域。

original: It's ruled by unseen beings known as the Ideal Masters.
traduit: 被一种称为“理想之主”的不可见存在统治着。

original: Feel free to poke around the fort and take what you need. There isn't much yet, but you're welcome to anything you can use.
traduit: 随便在堡垒里转转，拿上你需要的东西。这里东西并不多，不过只要你用得上的话，就尽管拿。

original: Yes, a crossbow. Best thing for killing vampires. Just take a few shots at those crates over there.
traduit: 没错，弩。猎杀吸血鬼最好的武器了。对着那边的箱子射几箭吧。

original: Uh, crossbow? I've never...
traduit: 呃，弩？我从来没……

original: Don't worry, I think we can make a Dawnguard out of you. Here, take this crossbow and let's see how you shoot.
traduit: 别担心，我想可以把你培养成黎明守卫。拿着，试试这把弩，我们来看看你是怎么射击的。

original: "My pa's axe", Stendarr preserve us.
traduit: “我爸的斧子”，斯丹达尔保佑我们。

original: Uh, my weapon? I mostly just use my pa's axe, when wolves are attacking the goats or something.
traduit: 呃，我的武器吗？我几乎只用我爸的斧子，当狼群攻击山羊或者什么的时候。

original: Didn't I tell you to step forward? Hmm... Farm boy, eh? What's your weapon?
traduit: 我不是跟你说往前走吗？嗯……农场小子，嗯？你的武器是什么？

original: Yes, si... Isran.
traduit: 遵命，长……伊士冉。

original: Do I look like a "sir" to you, boy? I'm not a soldier, and you're not joining the army.
traduit: 我看起来像你的“长官”吗，小子？我不是士兵，你也不是来参军的。

original: I'm, uh... my name is Agmaer, sir.
traduit: 我，呃……我叫阿格迈尔，长官。

original: You there, boy. Stop skulking in the shadows and step up here. What's your name?
traduit: 小子，就是你。别偷偷摸摸藏着了，往前走。你叫什么名字？

original: While you're thinking about it, the vampires will be gathering strength in the shadows, waiting to strike.
traduit: 当你考虑的时候，吸血鬼会在暗中积聚力量，等待发动袭击。

original: I'm going to Dimhollow Crypt. Perhaps I can be of some small assistance to you.
traduit: 我会去幽空地穴的。也许我对你能有点用。

original: I know what you think of us. You think we're soft, that we're cowards. You think our deaths proved our weakness.
traduit: 我知道你对我们的看法。你觉得我们软弱，你觉得我们是懦夫。你觉得我们的死证明了我们懦弱无能。

original: Stendarr grant that you do not have to face the same test and be found wanting.
traduit: 愿斯丹达尔保佑你不用面对同样的遭遇，也不用证明你自己也不够格。

original: You Vigilants were never trained for...
traduit: 你们警戒者从来没训练过……

original: Tolan, I don't think that's a good idea.
traduit: 托兰，我不认为这是个好主意。

original: I'll meet you at Dimhollow. It's the least I can do to avenge my fallen comrades.
traduit: 我会在幽空地穴跟你碰面。至少我能替我那些倒下的同伴报仇。

original: That's good enough for me. Go see what the vampires were looking for in this Dimhollow Crypt. With any luck, they'll still be there.
traduit: 这对我来说就够了。去这个幽空地穴，去看看吸血鬼都在找些什么东西。运气好的话，他们还会在那里的。

original: Yes, that's it. Dimhollow Crypt. Brother Adalvald was sure it held some long-lost vampire artifact of some kind.
traduit: 是的，幽空地穴。阿达瓦尔德修士确信里面藏着某种遗失已久的吸血鬼神器。

original: We didn't listen to him any more than we did Isran. He was at the Hall when it was attacked...
traduit: 我们没听他的，就像没听伊士冉的一样。大厅被袭击的时候他也在……

original: Tolan, tell him about, what was it, Dimhollow?
traduit: 托兰，告诉他吧，哪里来着？幽空地穴？

original: Tolan, tell her about, what was it, Dimhollow?
traduit: 托兰，告诉她吧，哪里来着？幽空地穴？

original: I need someone out in the field, taking the fight to the damn vampires, while we're getting the fort back into shape...
traduit: 我需要有人在外面跟那些可恶的吸血鬼战斗，而与此同时我们要把堡垒恢复原状。

original: I was just looking around. What is this place?
traduit: 我就是四处看看。这是什么地方？

original: Why do I even post guards? This is the headquarters of the Dawnguard. Well, it used to be, a long time ago.
traduit: 为什么我还要派守卫？这里是黎明守卫的总部。嗯，在很久以前，它曾经是。

original: As you can see, we have some work to do to restore it to its former glory. But maybe you want to help me with that?
traduit: 如你所见，为恢复它的旧日荣光，我们还有些工作要做。不过也许你会给我帮帮忙？

original: I heard you were looking for vampire hunters.
traduit: 我听说你们在找吸血鬼猎人。

original: You heard right. I'm glad word's finally starting to get around. But that means it won't be long before the vampires start to take notice as well.
traduit: 你听的没错。消息终于能传播开来了，我感到很高兴。不过这也意味着吸血鬼很快也会注意到它的。

original: I'm here to join the Dawnguard.
traduit: 我来这里加入黎明守卫。

original: Got a fire in your belly to kill vampires, eh? Good for you.
traduit: 你胸中涌动着猎杀吸血鬼的热情，嗯？不错。

original: But look around - there's really not much to join yet. I've only just started rebuilding the order.
traduit: 不过看看周围吧——确实还没几个人加入呢。我也是刚刚开始重建这个教团。

original: Yes, well... I never wanted any of this to happen. I tried to warn all of you... I am sorry, you know.
traduit: 好吧，嗯……我也不希望看到这一切。我警告过你们所有人……结果，你知道的。

original: Isran, Carcette is dead. The Hall of the Vigilants... everyone... they're all dead. You were right, we were wrong. Isn't that enough for you?
traduit: 伊士冉，凯西提死了。警戒者之厅……所有人……他们全死了。你是对的，我们错了。这还不够吗？

original: And now that you've stirred up the vampires against you, you come begging for my protection?
traduit: 然后你们惹毛了吸血鬼，现在又来乞求我的庇护了？

original: I remember Keeper Carcette telling me repeatedly that Fort Dawnguard is a crumbling ruin, not worth the expense and manpower to repair.
traduit: 我还记得守护者凯西提一再告诉我，黎明守卫堡垒是个摇摇欲坠的废墟，不值得花费钱和人力来修复。

original: And now you want to come running to safety with the Dawnguard, is that it?
traduit: 然后你就跑来寻求黎明守卫的庇护了，是这样吗？

original: You know why I'm here. The Vigilants are under attack everywhere. The vampires are much more dangerous than we believed.
traduit: 你心里清楚。警戒者到处遭受攻击。吸血鬼比我们想的还要危险。

original: Why are you here, Tolan? The Vigilants and I were finished with each other a long time ago.
traduit: 你来这儿做什么，托兰？我早就跟警戒者没关系了。

original: Isran will decide if you've got what it takes. Go on, he's right inside.
traduit: 伊士冉会评定你是否有能力。走吧，他就在里面。

original: So who are you? What do you want?
traduit: 所以你是谁？你想干嘛？

original: Well? Ready to join the fight against the damn vampires?
traduit: 嗯？准备好去跟该死的吸血鬼干架了吗？

original: New recruits? Hmm.
traduit: 新成员？嗯。

original: Here to join the Dawnguard? Good.
traduit: 来加入黎明守卫的吗？不错。

original: Where is everybody? This place looks almost deserted.
traduit: 其他人在哪里？这地方看起来差不多荒废了。

original: You've probably killed lots of vampires, huh? I'm sure Isran will sign you right up. Not sure he'll take me. I hope so.
traduit: 你可能已经杀死了很多吸血鬼了吧，嗯？伊士冉一定会同意你马上入伙的。不知道他会不会捎带上我。希望他能同意吧。

original: That must be it. Fort Dawnguard... Wow. Bigger than I expected.
traduit: 这肯定就是了。黎明守卫堡垒……哇哦。比我想象中的大哎。

original: Hey, uh, don't tell Isran I was afraid to meet him by myself. Not the best first impression for a new vampire hunter, I guess.
traduit: 嘿，呃，别跟伊士冉说我害怕独自一人去见他。我想，对于一个吸血鬼猎人新手来说，这个第一印象可不怎么样。

original: Truth is, I'm a little nervous. I've never done anything like this before. I hope you don't mind if I walk up with you.
traduit: 说实话，我有点紧张。我以前可从来没干过这种事。如果我跟你一起的话，我希望你不介意。

original: Oh, hey there! You here to join the Dawnguard, too?
traduit: 哦，嘿！你也是来这里参加黎明守卫的？

original: Sorry, I'm not interested.
traduit: 抱歉，我不感兴趣。

original: That's what everybody says, right up until they find their throat being ripped out by a pack of hungry vampires.
traduit: 大家都这么说，直到他们发现一群饥渴的吸血鬼撕破他们的喉咙。

original: Killing vampires? Where do I sign up?
traduit: 猎杀吸血鬼？我要去哪里报名？

original: Ha. Isran's going to like you. He's up the hill in the fort. He'll decide if you're Dawnguard material.
traduit: 哈。伊士冉会喜欢你的。他就在山上的堡垒里。让他看看你是不是当黎明守卫的料。

original: Ha. Isran's going to like you. Go talk to him at Fort Dawnguard, southeast of Riften. He'll decide if you're Dawnguard material.
traduit: 哈。伊士冉会喜欢你的。去黎明守卫堡垒跟他谈谈，就在裂谷城东南边。让他看看你是不是当黎明守卫的料。

original: Vigilants? Dawnguard? What are you talking about?
traduit: 警戒者？黎明守卫？你在说什么？

original: I haven't noticed any vampire menace.
traduit: 我没有注意到任何吸血鬼的威胁。

original: You're not paying attention then. Like most everyone else around here.
traduit: 那你就是没走心。就跟这里大部分人一样。

original: Haven't you heard that the Hall of the Vigilants was destroyed by vampires? They never took the threat seriously, and now they've paid the price.
traduit: 你有没有听说警戒者之厅被吸血鬼给毁了？他们从不把那威胁放在心上，现在付出代价了。

original: What's the Dawnguard?
traduit: 黎明守卫是什么人？

original: We're vampire hunters. We search out and destroy those bloodsucking scum wherever we find them.
traduit: 我们是吸血鬼猎人。无论我们在哪里找到这帮吸人血的渣滓，我们都会把他们揪出来消灭掉。

original: You there. The Dawnguard is looking for anyone willing to fight against the growing vampire menace. What do you say?
traduit: 那边的，黎明守卫正在找想参与对付日益增长的吸血鬼威胁的人，你觉得怎么样？

original: Changed your mind, huh? The Dawnguard could use somebody like you.
traduit: 改变主意了，呃？黎明守卫会用得上你这种人的。

original: Yeah? You change your mind? The Dawnguard could use somebody like you.
traduit: 嗯？改变主意了？黎明守卫会用得上你这种人的。

original: I'm ready to be soul trapped.
traduit: 我准备好你对我施展摄魂陷阱了。

original: I promise to make this as painless as possible. Hold still.
traduit: 我尽量不弄疼你。别动。

original: Let's just get this over with.
traduit: 赶紧把这件事办了吧。

original: Don't worry about it.
traduit: 别担心。

original: Oh. Good.
traduit: 哦。好的。

original: I trust you completely.
traduit: 我完全相信你。

original: Thank you.
traduit: 谢谢。

original: Let's not waste any more time then.
traduit: 那我们就别再浪费时间了。

original: I know this is difficult for you. I hope you trust me.
traduit: 我知道这对你来说很难抉择，希望你能相信我。

original: I'd never do anything that could hurt you.
traduit: 我是绝对不会伤害你的。

original: Soul trap me. I won't feel right as a vampire.
traduit: 对我施展摄魂陷阱吧。我觉得变成吸血鬼不太好。

original: Are you sure? I'm willing to do it, but you need to think it through.
traduit: 你确定？我是不介意，不过你得考虑考虑。

original: You'll remain mortal, but you'll find yourself weakened within the Soul Cairn.
traduit: 你还会是凡人的状态，不过一旦你进入灵魂石冢你会发现自己被削弱了。

original: Wouldn't that kill me?
traduit: 那不会弄死我吗？

original: My mother taught me a trick or two. I could partially soul trap you, and offer that gem to the Ideal Masters. It might be enough to satisfy them.
traduit: 我母亲教了我一两招。我能够对你施展不完全的摄魂陷阱，然后把那颗灵魂石献给理想之主。这应该足以满足它们了。

original: It would make you a bit weaker when we travel through the Soul Cairn, but we might be able to fix that once we're inside. Maybe.
traduit: 当我们穿越灵魂石冢的时候，你可能会觉得有一点点虚弱，不过一旦进去以后，我们没准就有可能恢复了。

original: What was the Hall of the Vigilants?
traduit: 警戒者之厅是什么？

original: Dimhollow Crypt. Brother Adalvald thought it contained some long-lost vampire artifact. It seems he was right.
traduit: 幽空地穴，阿达瓦尔德修士认为里面有失传已久的吸血鬼神器，看来他是对的。

original: The Hall of the Vigilants is in ruins, my brothers and sisters dead or scattered.
traduit: 警戒者之厅成了废墟，我的兄弟姐妹们被杀得七零八落。

original: The vampires are much more dangerous than we ever dreamed. The Dawnguard is the only hope now.
traduit: 我们做梦也没想到吸血鬼会这么危险。现在黎明守卫是唯一的希望了。

original: Isran was right all along. We should have listened to his warnings. It's too late for the Vigilants now.
traduit: 伊士冉一直都是对的。我们应该听他的警告的。对于警戒者而言，这一切都太晚了。

original: You wouldn't dare. Now shut up and keep on watch.
traduit: 你没那个胆子。现在乖乖闭嘴继续放哨。

original: And I have half a mind to tell Lokil of your disloyalty.
traduit: 我也特想跟洛基尔说你对他不忠诚。

original: I wish Lokil would hurry it up. I have half a mind to return to the castle and tell Harkon what a fool he's entrusted this mission to.
traduit: 希望洛基尔能快点。我现在特别想回城堡，跟哈孔说他把任务派给了这么个蠢蛋。

original: All this talk is making me thirsty. Perhaps another Vigilant will wander in soon.
traduit: 说了这些，我都觉得渴了。也许很快会有别的警戒者逛荡进来。

original: Ha. Those two deserved what they got. Their arrogance had become insufferable.
traduit: 哈。那俩罪有应得。我受够了他俩的傲慢无礼。

original: He fought well though. Jeron and Bresoth were no match for him.
traduit: 不过他身手不错。杰朗和布雷索不是他的对手。

original: To come in here alone... a fool like all the rest of them.
traduit: 一个人来这里……跟他们其他人一样蠢。

original: Well, well. You made it. Good. Isran's in the fort. He'll get you sorted out.
traduit: 很好，很好。你来了。不错。伊士冉在堡垒里。他会给你安排妥当的。

original: Report to Isran at Fort Dawnguard. And get moving if you're serious about it. The vampires aren't going to wait around to make their next move.
traduit: 跟黎明守卫堡垒的伊士冉打报告。如果你对这件事真上心的话，动作利落点。吸血鬼不会傻等着采取下一步行动。

original: Heard they're reforming the Dawnguard. Vampire hunters or something, in the old fort near Riften. Might consider joining up myself.
traduit: 听说他们在重建黎明守卫。在裂谷城附近的旧堡垒，是吸血鬼猎人或者什么的。我自己也会考虑考虑入伙的。

original: They say that vampires attacked the Hall of the Vigilant. Burned it to the ground! Never heard of vampires doing anything like that before.
traduit: 他们说吸血鬼攻击了警戒者之厅。一把火把它烧了个精光！以前从没听说过吸血鬼会做这种事。

original: Never seen a crossbow before, eh? Not surprised. Kind of a Dawnguard specialty. Nothing better for putting down vampires.
traduit: 以前从没见过弩，嗯？不奇怪。这算是黎明守卫专属。用它杀吸血鬼再好不过了。

original: Which is where you come in. If killing vampires sounds good to you, go talk to Isran up in the fort. He decides who's Dawnguard material.
traduit: 你要入伙是吧。如果你真觉得猎杀吸血鬼不错的话，去跟堡垒里的伊士冉谈谈。他决定谁是当黎明守卫的料。

original: Which is where you come in. If killing vampires sounds good to you, come talk to Isran at Fort Dawnguard, southeast of Riften.
traduit: 你们要入伙是吧。如果你真觉得猎杀吸血鬼不错的话，来跟黎明守卫堡垒的伊士冉谈谈吧，就在裂谷城的东南边。

original: Any idea where it could be?
traduit: 知道它可能在哪儿吗？

original: There's an offering altar not terribly far from here. I'm willing to bet that the gem you're looking for is there.
traduit: 离这里不远处有个祭坛，我敢肯定你要找的宝石就在那里。

original: Is there anything else? Could be your last chance.
traduit: 还有别的吗？这可能是你最后的机会了。

original: Good, I could use all the help I can get.
traduit: 太好了，什么样的帮助都好。

original: Your soul essence was trapped inside a gem. When you and Serana entered the Soul Cairn, it was "given" to the Ideal Masters as payment.
traduit: 你的灵魂精华被困在一块宝石里。当你和瑟拉娜进入灵魂石冢时，它被“献给”理想之主作为报酬。

original: You simply need to retrieve the gem. The moment you touch it, your soul essence will be restored.
traduit: 你只需要找回宝石。一碰到它，你的灵魂精华就恢复了。

original: Can you help get my soul back?
traduit: 你能帮我取回我的灵魂吗？

original: So my daughter applied some of the lessons I taught her about necromancy, did she?
traduit: 所以我女儿把我教她的死灵法术课程付诸实践了，对不对？

original: Don't worry, I think I can help you.
traduit: 别担心，我觉得我能帮你。

original: What do we do now?
traduit: 我们现在该做什么？

original: Well, before we spoke to my mother in the Soul Cairn, I would have said we bring the bow to my father.
traduit: 嗯，在我们和我妈谈话之前，我会说把弓带给我父亲。

original: But after everything with her... I don't think we can trust him.
traduit: 但经历了那些事情后……我觉得没法相信他。

original: I have the bow.
traduit: 我拿到弓了。

original: It's... not as shiny as I was expecting.
traduit: 它……没我想的那么闪耀。

original: Still, it's beautiful.
traduit: 不过，还是很漂亮。

original: A small price to pay for the betterment of our kind.
traduit: 这是为了族类进步而付出的小小代价。

original: Hatred born of your neglect.
traduit: 仇恨源于你的忽视。

original: Loyalty? You never intended to let me live.
traduit: 忠诚吗？你从没想过让我活下去。

original: Were you always a vampire?
traduit: 你一直都是吸血鬼吗？

original: That's... a long story.
traduit: 那是……一个很长的故事了。

original: Have you been to Winterhold before?
traduit: 你之前来过冬堡吗？

original: Yes, but when I was here it wasn't so... crumbly. This used to be a city.
traduit: 来过，不过我过去来的时候，这里没这么……摇摇欲坠。这里曾经是座城市。

original: I wonder what happened here.
traduit: 我想知道这里发生了些什么。

original: What do you know about Elder Scrolls?
traduit: 你对上古卷轴都知道些什么？

original: I mean... as much as anyone. Not a lot.
traduit: 我……跟其他人一样，也不多。

original: You'd figure a couple hundred years locked away with one would have given me some insight, but no.
traduit: 你可能觉得，跟一个东西一起关个几百年会让我有什么顿悟，然而并没有。

original: Is it fragile? Do we need to be careful with it?
traduit: 它很珍贵吗？我们是不是得小心点？

original: Ha. Nothing can destroy an Elder Scroll. Worry more about protecting your hide, and let me worry about my things.
traduit: 哈。没什么东西能动得了上古卷轴。你就担心担心你的人身安全吧，我来操心我自己的事。

original: Why do you have an Elder Scroll?
traduit: 你为什么会有上古卷轴？

original: It's... complicated. I can't really talk about it. I'm sorry.
traduit: 这……很复杂。我不能说。抱歉。

original: Is that an Elder Scroll?
traduit: 那是上古卷轴吗？

original: Yes, it is, and it's mine.
traduit: 是的，它是我的。

original: Who is your father?
traduit: 你父亲是谁？

original: He's a... powerful man. Or at least used to be.
traduit: 他很……有名望。或者至少曾经如此。

original: Are you taking me to him?
traduit: 你会带我去见他吗？

original: The more we feed, the greater our prowess will grow. We could perhaps discover even more gifts of Hircine.
traduit: 我们吃的越多，能力就越强，也许还能得到海尔辛更多恩赐。

original: What is it?
traduit: 什么意思？

original: I've sensed the blood pulsing a little stronger, of late. I had assumed you had as well.
traduit: 我最近感到血液跳动得更烈了。你没感受到么。

original: I think our potential is on the rise. Hircine smiles on us. Let's not question too much.
traduit: 我们的潜力可能还在提升，海尔辛在向我们微笑，还是别问太多了。

original: Something has shifted in the moons, brother.
traduit: 双月又有变幻了，兄弟。

original: Something has shifted in the moons, sister.
traduit: 双月又有变幻了，姐妹。

original: There's no time. You need to get moving now. (Persuade)
traduit: 没时间了，你现在得马上过去。（说服）

original: Fine, fine! I can't afford to forget about this work, though. Some very interesting applications.
traduit: 好吧好吧！但我忘不了这项工作。一些非常有趣的应用。

original: Now where is it I'm supposed to be going?
traduit: 那么我应该去哪里呢？

original: I'm sorry, I'm not about to do that without at least a single gyro to show for my efforts.
traduit: 抱歉，如果没有一个陀螺仪来证明我的心血，我是不会走的。

original: Here. Let me show you how it's made...
traduit: 来，我教你这东西怎么做……

original: Assuming you have the smithing skills, you should be able to make this yourself at Gunmar's forge. Either way, I'll have some for sale soon.
traduit: 你要是掌握了锻造技能，应该可以在甘马尔的锻炉自己做一个。但无所谓，我很快就会开卖了。

original: Here. Let me show you how this works...
traduit: 来，我教你这东西怎么用……

original: I'll have some for sale soon.
traduit: 过后我也会售卖一些。

original: Hmmm... I see. Clever dwarves. With a similar technique and a little tinkering I should be able to improve the capabilities of our crossbows.
traduit: 嗯……我明白了。聪明啊矮人。我只要借鉴这种技术，再稍作改良，就能提高我们弩箭的性能。

original: I often wonder where we'd be if the Dwemer were still around. Ah well. We'll have to manage with the scraps we find.
traduit: 我常常想锻莫要是还存在，我们将会如何。现在我们只能凑合用找到的残骸了。

original: Would you look at that. An exploding crossbow bolt. This should be fun!
traduit: 你看那个，会爆炸的弩箭。这应该很有趣！

original: I see... similar to the exploding bolt, only this one will cause damage with splintering shards of ice sharp as glass. Charming!
traduit: 我明白了……和爆炸弩箭很像，只是这个会造成玻璃一般锋利的冰屑伤害。太好了！

original: Let's see... Ooh! This diagram explains how to fashion a bolt that will send a jolt of shock through whatever it hits.
traduit: 我看看……哦！这张图解释了如何制造一种使打击目标受闪电震击的弩箭。

original: Testing this will require some extra precautions, I think.
traduit: 我想，测试这个估计需要一些额外防护措施。

original: Is it really... it is! I was hoping we'd find this. It's a diagram for a dwemer crossbow. Much more sophisticated, and powerful, than the ones we use.
traduit: 真的吗……就是它！我就希望能找到这个。这是锻莫弩的设计图。比我们用的更精密，更强大。

original: Now this is a find! Plans for improving the Dwemer crossbow. This should add some extra punch to an already devastating weapon.
traduit: 这可是个大发现！改进锻莫弩。这会给本就具有毁灭性的武器增加额外的冲击力。

original: Hmmm... interesting... those dwarves were clever creatures. I'll tinker around with these techniques and see what I can come up with around here.
traduit: 嗯……有意思……矮人们以前可真聪明。我会改进这些技术，看看会发现什么。

original: Stay sharp out there.
traduit: 在外面要千万小心。

original: You know where to find me if you need more.
traduit: 还需要的话，知道上哪儿找我吧。

original: If you need anything else, I'll be here.
traduit: 还需要什么东西的话，我就在这儿。

original: Isran had a surprising stockpile of weapons and armor. Take a look.
traduit: 伊士冉拥有惊人的武器盔甲储备，来看看。

original: It's no Warmaiden's, but I've got a decent supply.
traduit: 虽然不是战争少女打造的，但我这里供应充足。

original: What do you need? Blades, armor, smithing materials?
traduit: 你需要什么？刀剑，盔甲，锻造材料？

original: This is everything I've got right now.
traduit: 现有的全在这儿了。

original: Keep yourself armed and protected as best you can.
traduit: 尽你所能的武装好来保护自己。

original: I'll buy whatever you're looking to get rid of.
traduit: 有什么不要的都可以卖我。

original: It's sort of a random assortment of things. See anything useful?
traduit: 各种各样的东西都有。看见什么有用的了吗？

original: Here's everything I have. Sorry there isn't more.
traduit: 全都在这儿，抱歉没多的了。

original: It's not easy to get supplies way out here, but I'm managing. Take a look.
traduit: 往这里运补给不容易，但我能应付得来。看看吧。

original: Potions my friend, potions! Possibly some spells. Maybe some other things I've forgotten about. Actually I'm not sure. Let's see, shall we?
traduit: 药水啊朋友，药水！可能有些法术。也许还有其他我忘了的东西，来看看吧？

original: Oh, well... some... things, I suppose. Remedies, cures, a poison or two.
traduit: 哦，好吧……有些……东西，我想。药水，疗法，一两瓶毒药。

original: Look, I'll be honest with you. I have no idea. But I'm sure we can find something worth your time.
traduit: 听着，说实话，我也不知道。但我们肯定能找到值得你花费时间的东西。

original: Here, I've got a dwarven gyro. Take it.
traduit: 给，我有一个矮人陀螺仪，拿去吧。

original: Thank you! It's not much, but this will help a great deal with some things I've been researching.
traduit: 多谢！这东西看起来普通，但对我手头的几个研究项目帮助很大。

original: Now where is it Isran expects me to go?
traduit: 所以伊士冉想让我去哪儿？

original: Well then I'm very sorry, but I just can't walk away from this project yet.
traduit: 好吧，那我很抱歉，但我还不能放弃这个项目。

original: I don't have any gyros on me.
traduit: 我身上没有什么陀螺仪。

original: You've been imprisoned here for all this time?
traduit: 这么长时间以来你一直被困在这里吗？

original: Time has very little meaning to me. Consequently, it has little meaning to the Ideal Masters as well.
traduit: 时间对我而言没什么意义。不过，对理想之主也是如此。

original: I suppose you could call this the ultimate waiting game, each watching the other to see which will give in.
traduit: 你可以管这叫终极等待游戏，看着哪一方会先投降。

original: You became trapped.
traduit: 你被困住了。

original: Unfortunately, yes.
traduit: 很不幸，是这样的。

original: Since the Keepers weren't able to claim my soul, they had their minions construct a barrier that I'd never be able to breach.
traduit: 看守者们没办法索取我的灵魂，它们就让手下建造了这个我没法突破的结界。

original: They tricked you.
traduit: 它们把你给耍了。

original: The Ideal Masters unleashed their Keepers and sent them to destroy me.
traduit: 理想之主派出了手下的看守者，让它们来杀我。

original: Fortunately, I was able to hold them at bay and retreat into these ruins.
traduit: 所幸我击退了它们，逃到了这片废墟中。

original: What was the bargain?
traduit: 讨价还价？

original: I requested refuge in the Soul Cairn, and in exchange, I would provide the Ideal Masters the souls that they craved.
traduit: 我在灵魂石冢里寻求庇护，而我会提供理想之主它们所渴望的灵魂作为交换。

original: If I had foreseen the value they placed on my own soul, I would never have come here.
traduit: 早知道他们如此觊觎我的灵魂，我绝不会来这里。

original: How did you become imprisoned here?
traduit: 你是怎么困在这里的？

original: When I entered the Soul Cairn, I had intended to strike a bargain with the Ideal Masters, the custodians of this place.
traduit: 当我进入灵魂石冢时，我本来是打算跟管理此地的理想之主讨价还价的。

original: And Serana's opinion in this?
traduit: 那瑟拉娜对此的看法呢？

original: You care nothing for Serana or our plight.
traduit: 你根本不在乎瑟拉娜跟我们的处境。

original: You're here because we're abominations in your mind. Evil creatures that need to be destroyed.
traduit: 你来到这里是因为你对我们深恶痛绝。觉得我们只是应该被消灭的邪恶生物。

original: You see the Tyranny of the Sun as your chance at deification, and like Harkon you won't hesitate to destroy anything that stands in your path.
traduit: 你把太阳暴政视为神化自己的机会，就跟哈孔一样，你会毫不犹豫地摧毁任何挡路者。

original: Whether or not you've become one of us in order to survive the Soul Cairn, you're still a vampire hunter at heart.
traduit: 无论当初你是不是为了在灵魂石冢存活下来而成为我们中的一员，但内心深处还是个吸血鬼猎人。

original: Perhaps her death is destined.
traduit: 也许她的死亡早已注定。

original: No! I will not allow that happen. The Elder Scrolls only tell of events that might be, not events that will be.
traduit: 不！我绝不允许这种事发生。上古卷轴记载的事只是可能，而不是注定。

original: I'll need your help.
traduit: 我会需要你的帮助的。

original: Have you been listening to me? Like Serana, I'm a pure-blooded vampire. My presence on Tamriel is as much of a danger as hers.
traduit: 你没听我说话吗？跟瑟拉娜一样，我是纯血吸血鬼。我出现在泰姆瑞尔比呆在这里危险得多。

original: The Tyranny of the Sun requires Serana's blood?
traduit: 太阳暴政需要瑟拉娜的血？

original: Now you're beginning to see why I wanted to protect Serana, and why I've kept the other Elder Scroll as far from her as possible.
traduit: 现在你明白我为什么要保护瑟拉娜，以及为什么我要让另一部卷轴尽可能离她越远越好了吧。

original: How does Serana fit in?
traduit: 瑟拉娜又怎么牵扯进去的？

original: Like myself, Serana was a human once. We were devout followers of Lord Molag Bal.
traduit: 跟我一样，瑟拉娜曾是人类。我们是莫拉格·巴尔大人的忠实追随者。

original: Tradition dictates the females be offered to Molag Bal on his summoning day. Few survive the ordeal. Those that do emerge as a pure-blooded vampire.
traduit: 传统决定了在莫拉格·巴尔的召唤日要献上女性给他。很少有人能熬过这趟折磨，成功了的都转化为了纯血吸血鬼。

original: We call such confluences the "Daughters of Coldharbour."
traduit: 我们将这种转化者称为“冷港之女”。

original: What do you mean?
traduit: 你什么意思？

original: When I fled Castle Volkihar, I fled with two Elder Scrolls.
traduit: 当我逃离沃基哈尔城堡时，我带走了两份上古卷轴。

original: The scroll I presume you found with Serana speaks of Auriel and his arcane weapon, Auriel's Bow.
traduit: 我想你发现的那卷跟瑟拉娜在一起的上古卷轴记载了奥瑞艾尔和他的神器————奥瑞艾尔之弓。

original: The second scroll declares that "The Blood of Coldharbour's Daughter will blind the eye of the Dragon."
traduit: 第二卷卷轴则称：“冷港之女的鲜血会蒙蔽巨龙之眼。”

original: I'm just here for the Elder Scroll.
traduit: 我来这里是为了找上古卷轴。

original: Glorious. Serana claims you're her guardian, yet your first instinct appears to be greed. I see that my daughter is still as naive as ever.
traduit: 真不错啊。瑟拉娜说你是在保护她，但你的第一反应却是表现出贪心。看来我女儿还是跟从前一样天真。

original: Serana has sacrificed everything to prevent Harkon from completing the prophecy. I would have expected her to explain that to you.
traduit: 瑟拉娜牺牲了一切阻止哈孔完成预言。我还指望她已经跟你说过了。

original: I've saved her from your foolish plan.
traduit: 我把她从你的愚蠢计划里给救了出来。

original: I find your choice of words quite interesting considering that Serana is in far more danger now than she was following my "foolish plan."
traduit: 你这话可真有意思，比起遵照我的“愚蠢计划”，瑟拉娜现在的处境才更加危险。

original: I had no idea you felt that way about me, Serana. It was never my intention to push you aside.
traduit: 从没想过你会这样看我，瑟拉娜。我从来没想过对你置之不理。

original: All I wanted is for us to be a family again... for things to return to the way they were before.
traduit: 我想过的全是让我们重新组成一个家……让一切都变回老样子。

original: Yes, he's a fanatic... he's changed. But he's still my father. Why can't you understand how that makes me feel?
traduit: 没错，他是着魔了……是变了。但他还是我父亲啊。为什么你就不明白这对我而言是什么感受？

original: I need more time to prepare myself.
traduit: 我要花更多时间来准备。

original: Go. Reconsider your plight.
traduit: 去吧，想想你吃的苦头。

original: I am.
traduit: 准备好了。

original: Hold still, then.
traduit: 那就站稳别动了。

original: I wish to regain the gift of beast blood.
traduit: 我希望能重获野兽之血。

original: Do you, now? Hircine doesn't usually bestow his favor on the fickle.
traduit: 是吗？海尔辛通常可不会赐福善变之人。

original: But you've proven your worth. I'm willing to try.
traduit: 但你已经证明了自己的价值，我愿意试试。

original: Are you ready now?
traduit: 你现在准备好了吗？

original: Here, take this one and give it a try. You'll want to get to know how to use it if you really plan to join the Dawnguard.
traduit: 给，拿着这东西试试。如果你真的要加入黎明守卫的话，你会想知道怎么用这东西的。

original: What's that you're shooting with?
traduit: 你在用什么射击呢？

original: I guess this is it. Wish me luck.
traduit: 我想就是这个了。祝我好运。

original: I never forget who my friends are. Or my enemies.
traduit: 我绝不会忘记谁是朋友，谁是敌人。

original: Yes, of course Lokil. Do not forget who brought you news of the Vigilants' discovery.
traduit: 正是，洛基尔。别忘了是谁把警戒者的发现告诉你的。

original: And we will not return without it. Vingalmo and Orthjolf will make way for me after this.
traduit: 不带上它我们是不会走的。以后文嘉莫和欧兹约夫都得给我让路。

original: Peace at last...
traduit: 终于安息了……

original: He knew nothing. He served his purpose by leading us to this place. Now it is up to us to bring Harkon the prize.
traduit: 他什么都不知道。把我们带到这里算是物尽其用了。现在该我们把珍宝带给哈孔了。

original: We haven't gotten anywhere ourselves with...
traduit: 我们自己也没得到什么进展……

original: Are you sure that was wise, Lokil? He still might have told us something.
traduit: 洛基尔，你觉得这么做明智吗？他可能还会告诉我们些东西的。

original: So go and meet your beloved Stendarr.
traduit: 去见你亲爱的斯丹达尔吧。

original: I believe you, Vigilant. And I don't think you even know what you've found here.
traduit: 警戒者，我相信你。我觉得你根本不知道你在这里究竟发现了什么。

original: I'll never tell you anything, vampire. My oath to Stendarr is stronger than any suffering you can inflict on me.
traduit: 我不会告诉你任何东西的，吸血鬼。我对斯丹达尔的誓言比所有你能施加在我身上的痛苦都强大。

original: So you prefer living in the shadows.
traduit: 因此你更喜欢生活在阴影里。

original: I do. It's how the vampire has survived for millennia, and the only way we can continue to survive in the future.
traduit: 是啊。这是千年来吸血鬼的生存之道，也是未来我们活下去的唯一方法。

original: What sort of attention?
traduit: 什么样的注意？

original: If eternal night fell, there are many who wouldn't stand for it. They would raise armies in attempts to return things to normal.
traduit: 如果永夜降临，很多人对此会无法忍受。他们会组建军队试图让一切回到正轨。

original: The order of the day would be our destruction until every last vampire was hunted down and eliminated.
traduit: 那天将会是我们的灭绝之日，直到所有吸血鬼都被猎杀致死。

original: Why haven't you pursued the prophecy?
traduit: 你为什么不追寻预言了呢？

original: Harkon's vision is a world plunged in eternal darkness where the vampire can flourish and never again fear the "tyranny of the sun."
traduit: 哈孔所见的幻象是一个跌入永恒黑暗的世界，在那里吸血鬼繁荣昌盛，再也不用惧怕“太阳暴政”了。

original: What he fails to realize is how much attention would be called to our kind if the prophecy came to fruition.
traduit: 然而他不明白，如果预言成真，那么我们会引起多大的注意。

original: What do the Masters provide in return?
traduit: 那理想之主以什么作为回报呢？

original: The ability to summon powerful undead guardians as one would conjure an atronach or daedra.
traduit: 召唤强大的不死守卫，就跟召唤侍灵或者迪德拉一样。

original: However, the majority of necromancers that are foolish enough to enter into a bargain with the Ideal Masters wind up here... as harvested souls.
traduit: 然而，大多数蠢到去和理想之主讨价还价的死灵法师最终都会来到这里……成了被收割的灵魂。

original: Why would they require sustenance?
traduit: 它们为什么需要食物呢？

original: The Ideal Masters's weakness is their insatiable hunger for pure souls.
traduit: 理想之主的弱点就是对纯粹灵魂的贪婪。

original: It's the reason for the Soul Cairn's existence, and the only leverage a necromancer has when bargaining with them.
traduit: 这就是灵魂石冢存在的原因，也是死灵法师与它们交易的唯一筹码。

original: And the crystals?
traduit: 那水晶呢？

original: Conduits through which the Ideal Masters speak to their underlings and feed on their victims.
traduit: 理想之主能通过水晶与手下交谈，并以受害者为食。

original: How so?
traduit: 怎么讲？

original: I think they transcend what we perceive as a physical form.
traduit: 它们应该已经超越了我们所能感知的物质形态。

original: Perhaps they were once corporeal beings, but they've obviously reached a point where they no longer require a tangible presence.
traduit: 也许它们曾经有实体，不过显然它们已经达到了不需要实体的境界。

original: What do they resemble?
traduit: 它们长什么样呢？

original: Well, some necromancers believe they are the crystalline structures dotting the Soul Cairn.
traduit: 嗯，有些死灵法师相信它们就是点缀在灵魂石冢的水晶体。

original: I believe there's more to it than that.
traduit: 但我觉得远不只如此。

original: Who are the Ideal Masters?
traduit: 谁是理想之主？

original: I know very little about them.
traduit: 我对它们知之甚少。

original: They're mystic entities that lord over the Soul Cairn, controlling every aspect from its fabric to its appearance.
traduit: 他们是主宰灵魂石冢的神秘存在，控制着从结构到外观的方方面面。

original: Coldharbour?
traduit: 冷港？

original: It's what some call the domain of Molag Bal. His place in Oblivion.
traduit: 这就是有些人口中莫拉格·巴尔的领域。他在湮灭的势力范围。

original: Serana underwent this ritual willingly?
traduit: 瑟拉娜是自愿接受这仪式的吗？

original: It was expected of her, just as it was expected of me.
traduit: 这是她的本分，和当年的我一样。

original: Being selected as an offering to Molag Bal is an honor. She wouldn't have dared turn her back on that.
traduit: 成为莫拉格·巴尔的祭品是种荣幸。她不敢拒绝的。

original: You heard the Scroll reading. Now do you believe Serana?
traduit: 你也听到卷轴的解读了，现在愿意相信瑟拉娜了吗？

original: I heard a lot of vague nonsense. You could interpret that a hundred different ways.
traduit: 我听到的是许多模糊不清的废话，能用上百种不同的方式去解读。

original: Only thing that stood out for me was Auriel's Bow. That's a powerful weapon, and I sure as Oblivion don't want the vampires to get hold of it.
traduit: 唯一让我印象深刻的是奥瑞艾尔之弓。那是件强大的武器，坚决不能让吸血鬼得到它。

original: The Moth Priest can stay here for now. As for the vampire, I still don't trust it, so keep it on a leash.
traduit: 蛾祭司可以暂时留在这里。至于吸血鬼，我还不能相信，所以继续拴住它。

original: Do you have any insights about your Elder Scroll reading?
traduit: 你对这幅上古卷轴的解读有什么见解吗？

original: I wish I could say that I did, but without the other two Scrolls, the picture will remain incomplete.
traduit: 我倒是希望能给肯定的答复，但没有其他两幅卷轴，愿景就不完整了。

original: I admit, I feel a bit frustrated that I can't be more helpful. Still, our enemy is likely just as much in the dark as we are, and that's something.
traduit: 我得说，对帮不上忙感到有点沮丧。尽管如此，敌人很可能跟我们一样一无所知，这就够了。

original: Now it's a race to claim the remaining Scrolls and discover what part Auriel's Bow has to play in this prophecy.
traduit: 现在是一场争夺剩余卷轴的比赛，并找出奥瑞艾尔之弓在这个预言中扮演了什么角色。

original: Are you saying you want to learn more about me?
traduit: 你是想再多了解了解我吗？

original: I guess you'll never get to find out.
traduit: 我想你永远都别想找到答案。

original: Not at this rate, no.
traduit: 照这样下去，没戏。

original: I guess we'll have to keep looking for that Moth Priest, then.
traduit: 我猜那我们得继续找那个蛾祭司了。

original: I guess so.
traduit: 我看也是。

original: Where would a Moth Priest actually go?
traduit: 蛾祭司到底会去哪里？

original: Do you have any ideas?
traduit: 你有什么想法吗？

original: You want us to help you?
traduit: 你想让我们帮你？

original: That was the plan, yes. Assuming the rest of them can trust a vampire. Come on, I'll need you to help convince them.
traduit: 计划就是那样，没错。只要他们能相信一个吸血鬼的话。来吧，我需要你帮我劝劝他们。

original: What's all this have to do with the Dawnguard?
traduit: 这一切跟黎明守卫有什么关系？

original: I'm sorry, I had heard there were vampire hunters here. I thought they might want to know about a vampire plot to enslave the rest of the world.
traduit: 抱歉啊，可是我听说这里有吸血鬼猎人。我觉得他们也许想了解了解吸血鬼企图统治世界的阴谋。

original: Was I wrong?
traduit: 难道我搞错了吗？

original: You're back, good! So, what happened?
traduit: 你回来了，很好。所以，发生了什么？

original: I can handle myself, and there are still unanswered questions
traduit: 我能保护好自己，还有一些疑问没有答案呢。

original: I suppose you're right. I should have a little more faith.
traduit: 我想你说得没错。我应该更信任你的。

original: Just be sure to keep your eyes open and your guard up.
traduit: 你一定得睁大眼睛，提高警惕。

original: I don't think so. In fact, I'm going to help her get home.
traduit: 我不这么觉得。事实上，我要送她回家。

original: Home? Well, where is that? Some dusty crypt or frigid cave?
traduit: 家？嗯，在哪里？什么脏兮兮的地穴或是冷冰冰的洞穴吗？

original: No doubt she'd like you to lead her into such a place. Then, when you're alone and beyond help, the fangs will come out!
traduit: 毫无疑问她希望你带她去这种地方。然后，当你独自一人、孤立无援的时候，她就会亮出牙齿！

original: Because she's one of them.
traduit: 因为她是他们的一员。

original: She's... she's a vampire? Are you a complete fool? You can't trust them! She'll turn on you the first chance she gets!
traduit: 她是……她是吸血鬼？你傻了吗？你不能相信他们！一有机会她就会背叛你的！

original: Her name's Serana. It was her that the vampires were seeking.
traduit: 她叫瑟拉娜。那些吸血鬼要找的就是她。

original: What do you mean? Why were the vampires after this woman?
traduit: 你是什么意思？为什么吸血鬼要找这位女人？

original: It's good to see you all in one piece. Who is this?
traduit: 很高兴见到你没缺胳膊少腿。这是谁？

original: Another time, maybe.
traduit: 也许下次吧。

original: I'll be here if you change your mind.
traduit: 如果你改了主意，我就在这儿。

original: That's why I'm here. Let's go.
traduit: 这就是我来这里的原因了。我们走。

original: I'm right behind you.
traduit: 我紧随在后。

original: I wasn't sure you'd come back for me. I'm still looking for a guide to get me home. What do you say?
traduit: 我不确定你会不会回来找我，还在找一个向导带我回家呢，怎么样？

original: I'd be happy to, but you already have a creature under your command.
traduit: 我很乐意，但你已经带着一头动物了。

original: Alright. Now take note. He'll mind you and us Dawnguard, but there's no accounting for other folk.
traduit: 好啊，记住了，他会在意你还有我们黎明守卫，但其他人就不考虑了。

original: And heed also this. He's no pet. Mistreat the beast or leave him alone for too long, and he'll return to the wild forgetting you ever existed.
traduit: 还要注意这点，他不是宠物。虐待或者放他独自待上太久，他就会忘了你，回到野外。

original: Now, you be careful with the creature.
traduit: 现在，你要小心这东西了。

original: Aye. And you be careful with the creature.
traduit: 嗯，小心这家伙。

original: I'd be happy to, but your purse is lighter than you think.
traduit: 我很乐意，但你的钱包好像比你想的要轻。

original: I'd like to buy an armored troll. (<Global=DLC1TrollCost> gold)
traduit: 我想买一头武装巨魔。（<Global=DLC1TrollCost>金币）

original: Aye lad.
traduit: 好啊小兄弟。

original: Aye lass.
traduit: 好啊小姑娘。

original: Oh, I'm sure I have something you'll find useful.
traduit: 哦，我肯定有些对你有用的东西。

original: You'd be surprised what people leave behind when you burn their village to the ground.
traduit: 把村庄夷为平地后，你会惊讶于人们留下的东西。

original: Many in the court don't bother with potions, but I keep things stocked just in case.
traduit: 宫廷里的很多人都懒得买药水，但我还是准备好了以防万一。

original: I may not have potions to block the sun, but I do have nearly everything else.
traduit: 我可能没有防晒药水，但除了这个几乎都有。

original: Always a pleasure to serve a fellow alchemist.
traduit: 能为炼金术士效劳是我的荣幸。

original: If there's one thing I know, it's weapons and armor. Take a look.
traduit: 如果说我有什么真正了解的东西，那就是武器盔甲了。来看看吧。

original: Always good to have a backup plan, in case the claws and teeth aren't enough.
traduit: 有个备用计划总是好的，以防爪子和牙齿不够用。

original: I keep the forge running day and night in case Lord Harkon needs anything.
traduit: 我让锻炉日夜保持运转，没准哈孔大人有所需求呢。

original: I keep the forge running day and night in case you need anything.
traduit: 我让锻炉日夜保持运转，没准您有所需求呢。

original: I'm not the most powerful of vampires, but I'm good with a hammer. See for yourself.
traduit: 我不算很强大的吸血鬼，但我锤子使得很熟练。看看吧。

original: A little extra protection never hurts.
traduit: 多一点防御无伤大雅。

original: I am more than happy to buy or sell whatever you might need.
traduit: 我很乐意买卖你需要的任何东西。

original: I'm sorry I don't have more to offer.
traduit: 抱歉我没有更多卖的了。

original: I hope I have something that interests you. I always wish to be of service.
traduit: 希望我有些东西能让您感兴趣，一直都希望能为您效劳。

original: You need something? I am happy to help, if I can.
traduit: 需要什么吗？我很乐意帮忙，能帮的话。

original: I've scrounged up a few things. Here, please, take a look.
traduit: 我找到了一些东西。在这儿，请看。

original: Do you have the Elder Scroll with you?
traduit: 上古卷轴在你这儿吗？

original: Yes. I've kept it safely secured here ever since I was imprisoned.
traduit: 没错。自从被关在这里，我就一直妥善保管着。

original: Fortunately, you're in a position to breach the barrier that surrounds these ruins.
traduit: 所幸你可以突破包围这些废墟的屏障。

original: Fortunately, you seem to have already killed the Keepers maintaining the barrier around these ruins.
traduit: 万幸，你已经杀死维持遗迹周围结界的看守者了。

original: I'm sorry, Serana. I didn't know... I didn't see.
traduit: 抱歉，瑟拉娜。我不知道……我不知道这事。

original: I've allowed my hatred of your father to estrange us for too long. Forgive me.
traduit: 对你父亲的恨意让我疏远你太久了。原谅我。

original: If you want the Elder Scroll, it's yours.
traduit: 如果你想要上古卷轴的话，给你。

original: I want us to be a family again. But I don't know if we can ever have that.
traduit: 我想让我们重新成为一个家。不过我不知道我们还能不能这样。

original: Maybe we don't deserve that kind of happiness. Maybe it isn't for us.
traduit: 也许我们就不配拥有那种幸福。也许那就不是给我们准备的。

original: But we have to stop him. Before he goes too far. And to do that, we need the Elder Scroll.
traduit: 不过我们得阻止他，在一切不可挽回之前。我们需要上古卷轴才能做到这一点。

original: Farewell. Remember that Harkon's not to be trusted.
traduit: 别了。记住不能相信哈孔。

original: Take the scroll, then be on your way.
traduit: 拿着上古卷轴，然后你该上路了。

original: Now, let me get the scroll's case opened.
traduit: 现在，我们来打开卷轴匣。

original: Follow me and stay close. Keep your eyes open for Durnehviir.
traduit: 跟紧我。当心杜耐维尔。

original: Quickly, this way.
traduit: 快点，走这边。

original: The Elder Scroll is just ahead.
traduit: 上古卷轴就在前面了。

original: Follow me, this way.
traduit: 跟着我，走这边。

original: Be careful, and keep my daughter safe.
traduit: 当心，保护好我女儿。

original: How long will that take?
traduit: 这需要花费多长时间？

original: Minutes? Hours? Years? I can't even begin to guess. I suggest we don't wait around to find out.
traduit: 几分钟？几小时？几年？我不清楚。咱们不能干等着。

original: Now, let's get you the Elder Scroll and you can be on your way.
traduit: 现在，拿着上古卷轴然后你就可以上路了。

original: A savior?
traduit: 救了她？

original: The scroll!
traduit: 卷轴！

original: She has the scroll!
traduit: 她带着卷轴！

original: I can't believe it.
traduit: 简直不敢相信。

original: For my daughter's safe return, you have my gratitude.
traduit: 感谢你带我的女儿平安归来。

original: Tell me, what is your name?
traduit: 告诉我，你叫什么名字？

original: This is my savior, the one who freed me.
traduit: 他就是救了我的那个人。

original: Now tell me, who is this stranger you have brought into our hall?
traduit: 现在跟我说说，你带进我们大厅的这位陌生人是谁啊？

original: Of course I'm delighted to see you, my daughter. Must I really say the words aloud?
traduit: 见到你当然高兴了，我的女儿。这些话一定要大声说出来吗？

original: Ah, if only your traitor mother were here, I would let her watch this reunion before putting her head on a spike.
traduit: 啊，如果你那叛徒母亲在这里就好了，我要让她瞧瞧这场重逢，然后再把她脑袋钉起来。

original: After all these years, that's the first thing you ask me? Yes, I have the scroll.
traduit: 都多少年了，你张口问我的第一个问题竟然是这个？是啊，我带着卷轴呢。

original: My long-lost daughter returns at last. I trust you have my Elder Scroll?
traduit: 我失散多年的女儿终于回来了。你应该还带着我的上古卷轴吧？

original: I guess I'm expected.
traduit: 看来我还算受欢迎。

original: I need training in Heavy Armor.
traduit: 我需要重甲训练。

original: Well, at least you're smart enough to want to learn more. I'll show you what I can.
traduit: 嗯，至少你够聪明，想学习更多。我会教你我知道的东西。

original: You already know as much as I do. And that's a compliment.
traduit: 你知道的已经和我一样多了，这是我的致意。

original: I can certainly try.
traduit: 我当然可以试试。

original: Can you teach me to be a better Marksman?
traduit: 你能教我怎么成为更好的弓箭手吗？

original: You're already as good as I am. There's nothing you can learn from me.
traduit: 你已经和我一样优秀了，从我这里学不到什么。

original: Can you teach me more about archery?
traduit: 你能教我箭术吗？

original: Working metal isn't easy. Let me show you a few things.
traduit: 加工金属并不简单，让我给你看些东西。

original: Can you train me in Smithing?
traduit: 你能教我锻造吗？

original: You know as much as I do. I can't teach you anything new.
traduit: 你知道的和我一样多，教不了你新东西了。

original: A noble cause. Arkay likes the idea very much, so I'm happy to help.
traduit: 这是崇高的事业。阿尔凯欣赏这个想法，我也很高兴帮忙。

original: Can you train me in Restoration?
traduit: 你能教我恢复系技能吗？

original: You know more than I do now. Arkay has us both beaten, but he's not giving up all his secrets.
traduit: 你现在知道的比我都多了。阿尔凯又在我俩之上，但他不会说出他所有的秘密。

original: Will I be able to safely revisit the Soul Cairn?
traduit: 我还能安全地再次拜访灵魂石冢吗？

original: As you've been traveling in the Soul Cairn, your body has become attuned to it.
traduit: 当你穿越灵魂石冢时，你的身体已经适应了它。

original: Let's just say a tiny part of you rubbed off on it, and in its place, a bit of the Soul Cairn filled the void.
traduit: 简单说就是你的一小部分被搓掉了，而灵魂石冢的一小部分把空缺给填上了。

original: You should find no difficulty using the portal any longer.
traduit: 你应该不会再觉得使用传送门有什么难的了。

original: I'm gonna have to kill you... again!
traduit: 我要再次……杀了你！

original: Stay back!
traduit: 别过来！

original: Oh no you don't!
traduit: 哦，住手！

original: You're not getting the best of me!
traduit: 你赢不了我！

original: Here we go, let's get the blood flowing again.
traduit: 我们走吧，让我们的血液再次奔腾起来。

original: You're not going to keep me in here!
traduit: 你不能把我关在这里！

original: She says she lives in a castle near Solitude.
traduit: 她说她住在独孤城附近的一座城堡里。

original: I'm pretty sure she's a vampire, actually.
traduit: 事实上，我很确定她是个吸血鬼。

original: That would fit with the rest of it... I don't like it, but you did right to play along. We need to find out what this is all about.
traduit: 这就说得通了……我不喜欢你这么干，不过你是对的。我们得弄清楚这到底是怎么一回事。

original: She didn't want to follow me here. But she wants me to take her home.
traduit: 她不想跟我来这儿。不过她想让我带她回家。

original: Home? Where's that?
traduit: 家？在哪里？

original: I don't know who she is. She says she lives in a castle near Solitude.
traduit: 我不知道她是谁。她说她住在独孤城附近的一座城堡里。

original: Tolan was right. And he's dead. The vampires killed him.
traduit: 托兰说得没错。他已经死了。吸血鬼把他给杀了。

original: Damn fool. I told him not to go. The Vigilants always had more bravery than sense.
traduit: 那个蠢货。我跟他说了别去。警戒者老是勇猛有余但缜密不足。

original: Did you at least find out what the vampires were looking for in there?
traduit: 至少你找到吸血鬼要找的东西了吧？

original: Yes, the place was crawling with vampires.
traduit: 是啊，那地方到处都是吸血鬼。

original: Good. I assume you took care of that little infestation. Did you figure out what they were looking for in there?
traduit: 很好。看来你已经解决那个小麻烦了。你知道他们在那里要找什么了吗？

original: What is it?
traduit: 什么？

original: Go on inside. Isran'll want to talk to you.
traduit: 进里面去。伊士冉想跟你谈谈。

original: Tolan was telling me about some cave that the Vigilants were poking around in. Seemed to think it was related to these recent vampire attacks.
traduit: 托兰跟我说警戒者在打探某个洞穴，他好像认为这和最近的吸血鬼袭击有关联。

original: What exactly are you planning to do to these vampires?
traduit: 你究竟想拿这些吸血鬼怎么办？

original: First thing is to get this fort back into shape. Right now, a vampire could practically walk right in the front door.
traduit: 第一件事就是让堡垒恢复原状。现在，吸血鬼几乎能从前门直接进来。

original: But I have something for you to do, since you're asking.
traduit: 不过既然你问了，我确实有些事情让你去办。

original: Of course, my dear. All will be well now.
traduit: 当然了，亲爱的。一切都会好起来的。

original: He was out of control, Garan. It had to be done.
traduit: 他失控了，加兰。只能如此。

original: I'm not happy about this. He... he was still my father. But I suppose my father really died a long time ago.
traduit: 我不觉得高兴。他……他依然是我父亲，但我想父亲确实多年前就已经不在了。

original: This was just the end of something else.
traduit: 这不过是别的什么被消灭罢了。

original: My lady, you have my deepest sympathies. I am sure this was not easy for you.
traduit: 小姐，我对您深表同情。承受这些是很不容易的。

original: Lord Harkon, defeated. I never imagined I'd see the day.
traduit: 哈孔大人，战败了。从没想过我会见到这天。

original: I think perhaps... I think you did more than that. You have my thanks.
traduit: 可能……你做的不止这些。多谢了。

original: I think my father really died a long time ago. This was just... the end of something else.
traduit: 我觉得我父亲其实早就死了。这不过是……别的什么被消灭罢了。

original: I did what needed to be done. Nothing more.
traduit: 我做了必要之事，仅此而已。

original: I... I suppose this is difficult for you.
traduit: 我……我想你心里也不好受吧。

original: It's over. He's dead, and the prophecy dies with him.
traduit: 结束了。他死了，预言也随之消亡了。

original: Why wouldn't Isran like me asking about Florentius?
traduit: 为什么伊士冉会不喜欢我问佛伦提乌斯的事？

original: The two of them just never got along. That's why Isran didn't have you go looking for him when he sent you after us.
traduit: 他们俩一直处不来。这就是为什么伊士冉让你来找我们的时候，没有让你去找他。

original: She's the daughter of a powerful vampire lord.
traduit: 她是一个强大吸血鬼领主的女儿。

original: And so you delivered her to them.
traduit: 所以你把她交给了他们。

original: I never got the chance.
traduit: 我没有那个机会。

original: I suppose you're lucky you're not dead. Or worse, one of them.
traduit: 我猜没死算你走运了。或者更糟，成为他们的一员。

original: There were too many of them, and only one of me.
traduit: 他们人太多了，我就一个人。

original: So they have everything they wanted, and we're left with nothing.
traduit: 所以他们得到了想要的一切，而我们一无所获。

original: I'm lucky I made it out alive.
traduit: 活着出来已经很幸运了。

original: Right. So they have this woman, and an Elder Scroll.
traduit: 是的。那么他们得到了这个女人，还有一幅上古卷轴。

original: By the Divines, this couldn't get much worse. This is more than you and I can handle.
traduit: 圣灵在上，这事糟透了。这不是你跟我应付得来的。

original: She wanted to go home, so I took her to her castle.
traduit: 她想要回家，所以我就带她回了她的城堡。

original: I'm waiting to hear what any of this means.
traduit: 我在等着听这都意味着什么。

original: The vampires were looking for a woman trapped in Dimhollow.
traduit: 吸血鬼们在找一个被困在幽空地穴的女人。

original: A woman? Trapped in there? That doesn't make any sense. Who is she? More importantly, where is she?
traduit: 女人？困在那儿？这根本说不通。她是谁？更重要的是，她在哪儿？

original: I'm ready to carry out this task.
traduit: 我已经准备好执行这项任务了。

original: Good. Go and speak to Garan Marethi. Tell him it is time. He will understand.
traduit: 很好。去跟加兰·玛瑞锡聊聊。告诉他是时候了。他会明白的。

original: Tell me again about being a Vampire Lord.
traduit: 再跟我说下关于变成吸血鬼领主。

original: When you first transform into a Vampire Lord, you will hover in the air. While you do, you will command the powers of Blood and Night.
traduit: 当你刚变成吸血鬼领主时，你会盘旋于空中。在此期间，你将掌握血与夜之力。

original: What must I know about being a vampire?
traduit: 身为吸血鬼，我该知道些什么？

original: As a vampire, you will gain new powers, but also a weakness to sunlight.
traduit: 作为吸血鬼，你将获得新的力量，但也有畏惧阳光的弱点。

original: With each passing day that you do not feed, that weakness will become more deadly, but your powers will also become stronger.
traduit: 随着不进食的天数推移，你的弱点会越发致命，但力量也越发强大。

original: Feed upon those who are sleeping, and your vulnerability to sunlight will diminish along with your powers.
traduit: 找那些睡眠中的人的进食，你的光照脆弱性将随着力量一起减少。

original: I have a task that will test your new powers, but first, do you have any questions?
traduit: 我有个检验你的力量的任务，不过首先，你有什么问题吗？

original: There is much to learn, but if you master the powers of the Vampire Lord, few enemies will be able to stand against you.
traduit: 你还有的可学呢，只要你驾驭了吸血鬼领主的力量，就无人能与你抗衡。

original: I don't like the feel of this place. I'll wait for you back by the entrance.
traduit: 我不喜欢这地方的感觉。我会在入口等你回来。

original: I need training for Two-Handed weapons.
traduit: 我要训练双手武器。

original: I can crush skulls with the best of them. Let me show you a few things.
traduit: 砸脑壳我最在行了，让我给你露几手

original: You're pretty good. I don't think there's anything more you can learn from me.
traduit: 你很厉害了。我不认为你还能从我这里学到什么。

original: Of course! It is my duty to serve, and I am happy to do it!
traduit: 当然了，服务是我的职责，我很乐意这么做。

original: I need training in Speech.
traduit: 我要训练口才。

original: I am afraid you're beyond my meager abiliities. I am sorry I cannot serve you better.
traduit: 恐怕您已经超越了我这微薄的能力。很抱歉我无法更好地为您服务了。

original: Now that you've retrieved the Elder Scroll, you should be on your way.
traduit: 你现在已经找回上古卷轴了，你该上路了。

original: If there's anything I can do before you depart, you must let me know.
traduit: 在你离开前，如果我能为你做些什么的话，跟我说。

original: Remember that Harkon isn't to be trusted. No matter what he promises, he'll deceive you in order to get what he wants.
traduit: 记住不能相信哈孔。不管他跟你做过什么保证，他都会为了他想要的东西而欺骗你。

original: And promise me you'll keep my daughter safe. She's the only thing of value I have left.
traduit: 答应我，保护好我女儿。她是我唯一珍视的东西了。

original: We may never return.
traduit: 我们可能永远都不会回来了。

original: After what I've put Serana through, I would understand if she never wished to see me again. I leave that decision in your hands.
traduit: 是我让瑟拉娜经受了这一切，如果她不想再见我也在所难免。我把决定权交给你。

original: We could use your help in Tamriel.
traduit: 我们在泰姆瑞尔会需要你的帮助的。

original: As much as it pains me to send you and Serana back alone, I can't take the risk.
traduit: 让你跟瑟拉娜自行回去，我心里也不好受，但我不能冒险。

original: We'll return for you when we can.
traduit: 有可能的话，我们会回来接你。

original: I appreciate your concern for me, but Serana is all that I care about. You must keep her safe at all costs.
traduit: 谢谢你的好意，不过我唯一在乎的只有瑟拉娜。你必须不惜一切代价保护好她。

original: You're staying here?
traduit: 你要待在这里吗？

original: I have no choice. As I told you before, I'm a Daughter of Coldharbour.
traduit: 我没得选。之前跟你说过，我是冷港之女。

original: If I return to Tamriel, that increases Harkon's likelihood of bringing the Tyranny of the Sun to fruition.
traduit: 如果我回到了泰姆瑞尔，那就会增加哈孔实现太阳暴政的可能性。

original: Just call your name in Tamriel? That's it?
traduit: 在泰姆瑞尔呼唤你的名字？就这样？

original: Trivial in your mind, perhaps. For me, it would mean a great deal.
traduit: 或许对你而言微不足道，但对我来说，这意义重大。

original: I don't require an answer, Qahnaarin. Simply speak my name to the heavens when you feel the time is right.
traduit: 你无需答复，夸纳林。只要在你觉得时机成熟向天空呼唤我的名字即可。

original: How could I help?
traduit: 我怎么帮你？

original: I will place my name with you and grant you the right to call my name from Tamriel.
traduit: 我会把我的名字告诉你，并允许你在泰姆瑞尔召唤我。

original: Do me this simple honor and I will fight at your side as your Grah-Zeymahzin, your Ally, and teach you my Thu'um.
traduit: 还请给个面子，我将作为你的格拉-泽伊玛津，你的盟友，与你并肩作战，并把我的吐'目教给你。

original: What's stopping you?
traduit: 你为什么没成功？

original: I fear that my time here has taken its toll upon me. I share a bond with this dreaded place.
traduit: 恐怕是因为我长期驻留，与这恐怖之地建立了某种联系。

original: If I ventured far from the Soul Cairn, my strength would begin to wane until I was no more.
traduit: 如果我冒险远离灵魂石冢，力量就会开始减弱，直至消散。

original: What kind of a favor?
traduit: 什么样的帮助？

original: For countless years I've roamed the Soul Cairn, in unintended service to the Ideal Masters.
traduit: 我在灵魂石冢漫游了无数岁月，一直被迫为理想之主们服务。

original: Before this, I roamed the skies above Tamriel. I desire to return there.
traduit: 在这之前，我也曾在泰姆瑞尔上空翱翔，我渴望着回到那里。

original: I don't trust things that try to kill me.
traduit: 我不会相信要杀我的东西。

original: If my desire to end your life was still my purpose, we would not be speaking.
traduit: 如果我还想着取你性命，就不会来谈话了。

original: My desire to speak with you was born from the result of our battle, Qahnaarin.
traduit: 我想和你谈谈是因为我们的那场战斗，夸纳林。

original: I merely wish to respectfully ask a favor of you.
traduit: 只是想恭敬地请你帮个忙。

original: What do you want from me?
traduit: 你想要什么？

original: The tone of your voice is understandable. Perhaps I can alleviate your suspicions.
traduit: 你言语中的顾虑在所难免，也许我可以解释一二。

original: I found you equally worthy.
traduit: 你也很不错。

original: Your words do me great honor.
traduit: 得闻此言，幸甚。

original: I have more pressing matters at the moment.
traduit: 我现在有更要紧的事。

original: Forgive me, Qahnaarin. We will continue this when time releases you from its relentless grasp.
traduit: 原谅我，夸纳林。当你从时间的无情掌控中释放后，我们再继续吧。

original: Why did you call me "Qahnaarin?"
traduit: 你为什么称我为“夸纳林”？

original: My claws have rended the flesh of innumerable foes, but I have never once been felled on the field of battle.
traduit: 我的爪子撕碎了无数敌人的血肉，从没有在战场上倒下过。

original: I therefore honor-name you "Qahnaarin," or Vanquisher in your tongue.
traduit: 因此我尊称你为“夸纳林”，在你的语言中是“征服者”。

original: Didn't you try to kill me?
traduit: 你不是想杀我吗？

original: The hostility was necessary. I was bound to an oath.
traduit: 这种敌视非我本意，我被誓言所束缚了。

original: Why are we speaking?
traduit: 我们有什么可聊的？

original: I believe in civility among seasoned warriors, and I find your ear worthy of my words.
traduit: 我相信老练的战士应该懂得礼节，也认为我的话有必要说给你听听。

original: I thought you were dead.
traduit: 还以为你死了。

original: Cursed, not dead. Doomed to exist in this form for eternity. Trapped between laas and dinok, between life and death.
traduit: 被诅咒了，所以不会死。我注定要以这种形态存在下去，困在拉斯与迪诺克，生与死之间。

original: Stay your weapons. I would speak with you, Qahnaarin.
traduit: 且慢动手，听我一言，夸纳林。

original: Never mind. I don't need you to do anything.
traduit: 没事了，还不需要你干嘛。

original: Troll, follow me!
traduit: 巨魔，跟着我！

original: Troll, get lost!
traduit: 巨魔，滚吧！

original: Troll, wait!
traduit: 巨魔，停下！

original: As long as you don't get in my way.
traduit: 你别妨碍我就好。

original: I was going to say the same thing to you.
traduit: 彼此彼此吧。

original: Where do you need to go?
traduit: 你想去哪里？

original: My family used to live on an island to the west of Solitude. I would guess they still do.
traduit: 我的家人过去曾住在独孤城西边的一座岛上。我猜他们还住在那里。

original: By the way... my name is Serana. Good to meet you.
traduit: 顺便……我叫瑟拉娜。很高兴见到你。

original: Why were you locked away like this?
traduit: 为什么他们像那样把你关起来？

original: That's... complicated. And I'm not totally sure if I can trust you.
traduit: 这很……复杂。我也不是完全确定我是不是能信任你。

original: But if you want to know the whole story, help me get back to my family's home.
traduit: 不过如果你想知道全部的故事，就帮我回家。

original: The Dawnguard would want me to kill you.
traduit: 黎明守卫让我杀了你。

original: Don't think that'll keep them from turning on you eventually. They'll figure out what you are.
traduit: 别以为这样他们就不会背叛你，他们会发现你是什么。

original: Not fond of vampires, are they?
traduit: 他们不喜欢吸血鬼，是吧？

original: Well, look. Kill me, you've killed one vampire. But if people are after me, there's something bigger going on.
traduit: 好吧，听着。杀了我，你是杀死了一个吸血鬼。然而如果有人在找我，就说明有大事要发生了。

original: I can help you find out what that is.
traduit: 我能帮你查出来要发生的大事是什么。

original: You're a vampire?
traduit: 你是个吸血鬼？

original: Can't you tell your own kind? I smelled you almost before my eyes were open.
traduit: 你觉得我认不出自己的同类？我还没睁开眼睛就闻出你是谁了。

original: How did you know I was a vampire?
traduit: 你怎么知道我是个吸血鬼？

original: You think I can't tell my own kind? I smelled you almost before my eyes were open.
traduit: 你觉得我认不出自己的同类？我还没睁开眼睛就闻出你是谁了。

original: No, a group called the "Dawnguard" sent me here.
traduit: 不是，一个叫“黎明守卫”的组织派我来的。

original: That's not a name I know. And it doesn't sound like a name a group of vampires would choose.
traduit: 我不认识这个名字。听起来一群吸血鬼也不会选它作为名号。

original: Who's your father?
traduit: 你父亲是谁？

original: He's a very powerful man. Or he was at one point. I'm surprised another vampire hasn't heard of him.
traduit: 他很有名望。至少曾经如此。竟然有吸血鬼没有听说过他。

original: Are you a...
traduit: 你是个……

original: Vampire, yes.
traduit: 没错，吸血鬼。

original: What do you mean, "like you"?
traduit: 什么叫“像你一样”？

original: A... can't you tell just from looking at me? A vampire.
traduit: 呃……你就看不出来吗？我是个吸血鬼。

original: Why would someone who isn't... like me... come all the way down here?
traduit: 为什么一个不……像我一样的人……会一路下到这里？

original: Are you one of my father's little acolytes?
traduit: 你是我父亲的一个小跟班吗？

original: That's not your concern.
traduit: 这不关你的事。

original: I think it is, actually.
traduit: 事实上，我觉得关我的事。

original: Is he... like me?
traduit: 他……像我一样吗？

original: Is he working for my father?
traduit: 他替我父亲工作吗？

original: I... don't know who that is.
traduit: 我……不认识这个人。

original: Who were you expecting?
traduit: 你以为是谁？

original: I was expecting someone... like me, at least.
traduit: 我以为是一些……至少像我一样的人。

original: I was expecting someone from my family. I don't recognize you. Are you one of my father's little acolytes?
traduit: 我以为是我家里的人。我不认识你。你是我父亲的一个小跟班吗？

original: Fine, then.
traduit: 那算了。

original: I must head back to the Sanctuary before dawn. I will see you there, Listener.
traduit: 我必须得在黎明前回到圣所。聆听者，我会在那里见你的。

original: What are you doing?
traduit: 你在做什么？

original: I am sure Nazir's cooking is great and all, but my appetites are a little more... discerning.
traduit: 我知道纳兹尔厨艺很棒，但我的胃口有点……特别。

original: You were hunting?
traduit: 你在狩猎吗？

original: You could call it that. Didn't put up much of a fight but made for a tasty snack. A rich bouquet of flavors, I would definitely recommend it.
traduit: 你可以这么说。没怎么打架，但做了一顿美味的点心。香气浓郁，我绝对推荐。

original: Listener! Fancy seeing you out here.
traduit: 聆听者！想不到在这里能撞见你！

original: That is all I have to teach you. If you wish to be reminded of these lessons, you need only ask.
traduit: 这就是我要教给你的所有东西了。如果你还想回忆这些内容，开口问就行。

original: Do I get a reward for finding your daughter?
traduit: 我都把你女儿找回来了，有什么奖赏吗？

original: I was about to suggest that very thing. Yes, you most certainly deserve a reward.
traduit: 我正打算说这件事呢。没错，你当然应该得到奖赏了。

original: What happens now?
traduit: 现在呢？

original: You have done me a great service, and now you must be rewarded.
traduit: 你帮了我很大的忙，现在该奖赏你了。

original: For centuries we lived here, far from the cares of the world. All that ended when my wife betrayed me and stole away that which I valued most.
traduit: 几个世纪以来我们居住在这里，远离尘世。直到我妻子背叛了我，偷走了我最为珍视的东西。

original: I don't really care what you are.
traduit: 我不是很在乎你们的身份。

original: Perhaps you should. I count some of the oldest and most powerful vampires in Skyrim among the members of my court.
traduit: 也许你应该在乎。我的宫廷成员里可有一些天际最强大、最古老的吸血鬼。

original: You're a reclusive cannibal cult.
traduit: 你们是一个隐居的吃人异教团。

original: Not quite, though I can see how an outsider might arrive at that conclusion.
traduit: 并不尽然，不过我知道一个外人是怎么得出这么个结论的。

original: No, we are vampires, among the oldest and most powerful in Skyrim.
traduit: 不，我们是天际最为古老、最为强大的吸血鬼。

original: You first.
traduit: 你先说。

original: Very well. I am Harkon, lord of this court. By now, my daughter will have told you what we are.
traduit: 很好。我叫哈孔，这座宫廷的君主。现在，我女儿已经跟你说了我们的身份了。

original: So, welcome to Fort Dawnguard.
traduit: 那么，欢迎来到黎明守卫堡垒。

original: Making sure you're not vampires. Can't be too careful.
traduit: 确保你们不是吸血鬼，小心为上。

original: Hold it right there.
traduit: 站那儿别动。

original: Let's go have a little chat with it, shall we?
traduit: 我们来跟它谈谈，好吧？

original: In the meantime, we're going to get to the bottom of why a vampire showed up here looking for you.
traduit: 与此同时，我们要搞清楚为什么会有一个吸血鬼来找你。

original: We'll get to that. For now, get acquainted with the space.
traduit: 咱们回头再谈，现在，先熟悉一下这个地方吧。

original: Sorine, you'll find room to start your tinkering on that crossbow design you've been working on.
traduit: 索琳，有房间能动工打造你正在设计的弩。

original: Gunmar, there's an area large enough for you to pen up some trolls, get them armored up and ready for use.
traduit: 甘马尔，这里也有足够大的地方来让你养巨魔。给他们穿上盔甲，准备派上用场。

original: Forget I said anything.
traduit: 忘了我说的吧。

original: No, just...
