第一纪元685年，忒伊十八岁，他第一次来到哀伤城，这是一座遍布尖塔的城市，也是女神的家园。他的堂兄卡寇斯早已经是神殿的资深门徒，在购置的房子里分给了他一楼的几个房间。房间很小，没有家具，但窗外长着苦绿草，风一吹，就使他的卧室充满了可爱的辛辣气息。 那首歌的旋律已不再困扰他。有时他甚至都意识不到如今的它低沉而悠扬。偶尔，当他前去寺庙接受指导时经过街道，有人从他身边经过，歌声便会强上几分，然后再度平复。不管这些人有何不同之处，忒伊从未试图去查探。他记得上次任由歌声引导的时候，他杀了他的小堂弟瓦斯特。这段记忆并没有怎么让他困扰，但除非逼不得已，他不想再伤害任何人。 家族的信使定期给忒伊送来贝娜拉的信，她仍然呆在戈尼岛上的桑迪尔之屋。她本来会去神殿学习，她的聪明才智当然足以胜任，但她选择不去。最多一两年，她就得离开，在因多瑞尔家族中占有一席之地，但她并不着急。忒伊对来信中的琐碎传闻表示欢迎，并回以自己学习和恋爱的消息。 在他来到哀伤城的第三个月，他认识了一个女孩。她也是神殿的学生，她的名字叫阿克拉。忒伊在给贝娜拉的信中热情地介绍了她，说她有索萨·希尔的头脑，维威克的机敏和阿玛莱西亚的美丽。贝娜拉愉快地回信说，如果她知道神殿的学生被允许能这样亵渎神明的话，她自己可能早就来当门徒了。 “你这么钟情于你的堂姐，”当忒伊给她看信时，阿克拉笑了。“我这是看了一段受挫爱恋的未了余情吗？” “她很可爱，但我从来没有这样想过，”忒伊嘲笑道。“我对乱伦没什么兴趣。” “那她是和你血缘很近咯？” 忒伊想了一会儿。“我不知道。说实话，他们不怎么提到过她的父母或我的父母，所以我真的不知道我们的血缘关系到底是怎样的。我只知道他们在红山之战牺牲了，每当我们问起她的父母或我的父母时，似乎都会让大人们的心情蒙上厚厚的阴影。然后我们就不再问了。但你也是一个因多瑞尔。说不定你也是我的堂亲，和我的血缘关系比贝娜拉还要近。” “说不定呢。”阿克拉微笑着，从椅子上站起来。她解开作为出身良好的女祭司而盘起的庄重发式。在忒伊的注视下，她取下将长袍固定在披肩上的小胸针。柔软的丝质布料缓缓滑下，第一次向他展露了她黝黑、修长的身体。“如果我们真是的话，现在你对乱伦很有兴趣了吗？” 当他们交欢时，那首歌开始在忒伊的脑子里缓慢而有节奏地响起。他面前阿克拉的身形黯淡了，代之以他噩梦中的画面，之后又一切如常。当他终于瘫倒，房间里似乎飘满了他梦中的火红云彩，那个女人和她的孩子临死前的尖叫声在他的脑海中回荡。他睁开眼睛，看到的是阿克拉，正微笑着看着他。忒伊吻了她，感激地将她拥入怀中。 在接下来的两个星期里，忒伊和阿克拉形影不离。即使他们上课时分别位于神殿的两侧，忒伊也会想到她，而且不知为何知道她在想他。之后，他们会急着奔向彼此，每个晚上在他的房间里颠鸾倒凤，每个白昼在神殿花园的幽僻角落翻云覆雨。 一天下午，忒伊急着去见他的爱人，歌声在一个衣衫褴褛的老妇人走来时变得响亮刺耳。他闭上眼睛，试图叫它安静下来，但当他再度睁开双眼看着她从一个街头小贩那里买软木球茎草纸时，他认出了她是谁。那是他在戈尼岛的老保姆，艾德芭。甚至连告别都没有就离他而去，到大陆上与她的家人团聚。 她没看到他，当她从街边走过，忒伊转身跟着。他们走过阴暗的通道，进入城市最贫穷的地区，这里对他来说就像阿卡维尔最荒凉的公国一样陌生。她打开了一条没有名字的街道上的小木门，他终于喊出了她的名字。她没有转身，但当他跟上去时，他发现门是虚掩着的。 室内阴暗潮湿，像个洞穴。她面对他站着，脸上的皱纹比他记忆中的还要多，刻满了悲伤的线条。他关上了身后的门，她抓起他的手，亲了亲。 “你长得好高好壮，”艾德芭说着开始流泪。“在我让他们把我从你身边赶走之前，我应该自杀的。” “你的家人都还好吗？” 忒伊冷冷地问。 “你是我唯一的家人，”她低声说。“因多瑞尔的猪把刀戳在我脸上，强迫我离开，因为他们发现我只为你和你的家人服务，而不是为他们。我做仪式的时候被贝娜拉那个贱货看到了。” “你说话像个疯婆子，”忒伊冷笑道。“你怎么能只爱我和我的家人，却恨因多瑞尔家族？我就是因多瑞尔家族的人。” “你已经长大了，可以知道真相了，”艾德芭狂热地说道。忒伊尖刻地嘲弄了一番她的疯狂，却看到她那双老迈的双眼里有什么近似于此的东西在燃烧。“你不是因多瑞尔家族所生；他们在战后把你收入他们的家族，像这样他们和其他家族收养了所有孤儿。这是他们所想到的抹去历史、消除敌人所有痕迹的唯一方法，他们要把敌人养成他们中的一员。” 忒伊转身向门外走去。“我知道你为什么被从戈尼岛赶走了，老女人。你有妄想症。” The movement of everything seemed to take on the rhythm of the music as if strange choreography had been staged: the girl rising to the window, the clouds reflecting back red from the inferno below, her scream, all muted, consumed by the Song. Everything that came thereafter Tay had seen so many times, it had almost ceased to be a nightmare. He did not remember anything of his life before coming to the island of Gorne, but he understood that there was something different in his past that set him apart from his cousins. It wasn't simply that his parents were dead. His cousin Baynarah's parents had also died in the War. Nor were the other Housemen on Gorne or nearby Mournhold unusually cruel to him. They treated him with the same polite indifference that any Indoril has for every other eight-year-old boy that got underfoot. But somehow, with absolutely certainty, Tay knew he was alone. "If you tell anyone else that you keep hearing music where there's no music to be heard, they'll call you mad and bury you in the Shrine of Sheogorath," his uncle Triffith would snarl, before striding away to attend his business. There were no clouds, but it rained most every night, so the vegetation on the island of Gorne was bewildering lush. The stones themselves seemed to glow with sunlight, and the ditches burned with white meadowsweet and parsleydown; all around him were soft smells of flower and tree untroubled by wind; the foliage was purple green, blue green, ash green, white green. The wide cupolas, twisting cobbled streets, and thatched roofs of the little village of Gorne, and massive bleached rock of Sandil House all were magical to him. Against Aunt Ulliah's admonishments, Tay, Baynarah, and Vaster had breakfast outdoors every morning with the servants. It looked like the scene of a tremendous battle, a holocaust of fire. Charred boxes, weaponry, animal bones, and detritus too annihilated to be identifiable littered the ground. Speechless, Tay and Vaster stepped into the black field. Baynarah smiled, proud that she had finally found something of true wonder and mystery. "What is this place?" asked Vaster at last. "I don't know," Baynarah shrugged. "I thought at first that it was some kind of ruin, but now I think it's a junk pile, just not like any junk pile I've ever seen. Just look at this stuff." The three began an unorganized survey of the dusty mounds of refuse. Baynarah found a twisted sword only lightly blackened by flame and began polishing it to read the inscriptions on the blade. Vaster amused himself by breaking brittle boxes with his hands and feet, imagining himself a giant of unbelievable strength. A battered shield attracted Tay: there was something about it that reverberated with the sound of the Song. He pulled it out, and wiped its surface clean. "I've never seen that crest before," said Baynarah, looking over Tay's shoulder. "I think I have, but I don't remember," Tay whispered, trying to conjure the memory from his dreams. He was sure he had seen it there. "Look at this!" Vaster cried, interrupting Tay's thoughts. The boy was holding up a crystal orb. As his hand moved over the surface, brushing away grit and dust, a key in the Song rose which sent a shiver through Tay's entire body. Baynarah ran over to look at Vaster's treasure, but Tay felt paralyzed. "Where did you find that?" she gasped, gazing into the swirl beneath the crystal surface. "Over in that wagon," Vaster gestured toward a heap of blackened wood, barely discernible from the other piles but for its cart spokes. Baynarah began digging into the half-collapsed structure, so only her feet could be seen. The Song built in potency, sweeping over Tay. He began walking toward Vaster slowly. "Give me that," he whispered in a voice he could barely recognize as his own. "No," Vaster whispered back, his eyes locked on the colors reflected in the heart of the globe. "It's mine." Baynarah dug through the remains of the wagon for several more minutes, but she could find no treasures like Vaster's. Most everything within was destroyed, and what remained was common-place by any standards: broken arrows, armor shards, guar bones. Frustrated, she pulled herself out into the sunlight. Tay was alone, at the edge of the great gorge. "Where's Vaster?" Tay blinked and then turned back to his cousin with a shrug and a grin: "He went back to show everyone his new plunder. Did you find anything interesting?" "Not really," said Baynarah. "We probably ought to get back home before Vaster tells them anything that'll get us in trouble." Tay and Baynarah started the walk back at a quick pace. Tay knew that Vaster would not be there when they got back. He would never be returning home again. The crystal globe rested snugly in Tay's satchel, hidden under a pile of junk he had picked up. With all his heart, he prayed for the Song to return and drown out the memory of the gorge and the long, silent fall down. The boy had been so surprised, he hadn't even time to scream.

一切又开始了。尽管看似万籁俱寂（炉中沉火毕剥；年轻的女仆带着孩子在门边的椅子上沉睡；织了一半的毯子挂在墙上，等待着明日完成；窗外月亮中的一颗能够透过乳白色的云朵见着；孤零零的一只鸟藏在房椽后面安详地咕咕叫），忒伊听到那首歌的第一道和弦在遥远的某处突兀奏响。 房椽上的鸟儿呱呱地飞出窗外，女仆怀中的婴儿哭叫着惊醒。乐声渐强，曲调依然玄妙庄严。一切的运转似乎都依着音乐的旋律，仿佛一场怪诞的舞蹈正在上演：女仆在窗边站起，云朵被下方的炼狱染红，她的尖叫消解于歌声之中，因此寂然无声。之后发生的一切忒伊已经见过了太多次，真实地几乎不像是一场噩梦。 他完全不记得来到戈尼岛之前的事情，但他知道自己的过去必然有什么不同之处，将他和其他堂亲同辈区别开来。不只是因为他的父母双双亡故。他的堂姐贝娜拉的父母同样在那场战争中死去。也不是说戈尼岛上或者紧邻的哀伤之城里的家族成员排挤他。他们待他以礼貌的冷淡，就像所有因多瑞尔族人对待其他碍事的八岁男孩一样。 但是不知何故，忒伊无比肯定，自己孑然独立，与众不同。因为他总是听到一首歌，总是做那些噩梦。 “你单纯是想象力丰富。”乌莉雅姑姑会笑着耐心说道，然后摆摆手支开他，好重新忙自己的经文和家务。 “与众不同？世上所有人都觉得自己‘与众不同’，结果这个看法本身成为了一个普遍化观点。”他的堂兄卡寇斯如是说，他在为担任神殿祭司而学习，对悖论理解很深。 “如果在根本没有音乐的时候你还跟别人说你能听到音乐，他们会说你疯了，把你埋到谢尔格拉祭坛底下去。”他的叔叔特里菲斯会这样大吼，然后大步走开忙他自己的事。 只有他的保姆艾德芭会认真地听他讲述，并且带着淡淡的骄傲表情点头。但她除此以外不发一言。 他的堂姐兼首席玩伴贝娜拉对他说的歌声和噩梦最不感兴趣。 “忒伊，你老是讲这些真是烦。”贝娜拉说道，他、她和一个小堂弟瓦斯特走进花丛中的一块空地。草地很矮，刚及他们的脚踝，还有前年秋天留下的大堆黑色树叶。“现在，我们能不谈这个了吗？我们该玩什么呢？” 忒伊想了一会儿。“我们可以玩奥辛纽姆之围。” “那是什么？”瓦斯特问道，他是他们的常伴，比他们小三岁。 “奥辛纽姆是兽人的家园，就在沃斯嘉山脉。几百年来，它一直在扩大，越来越大，越来越大。兽人会从山上下来，劫掠整个高岩。然后，匕落的乔勒国王和蒂亚戈纳教团的盖登·辛吉以及其他来自哨卫城的人，我记不清了，都联合起来对抗奥辛纽姆。三十年，他们打了又打。奥辛纽姆的墙是用铁做的，尽管他们很努力，但还是无法攻入。” “后来呢？”贝娜拉问道。 “你这么会编故事，干嘛不编一下呢。” 于是他们就这样做了。忒伊是兽人的国王，坐在一棵他们称为奥辛纽姆的树上。贝娜拉和瓦斯特扮演乔勒国王和盖登·辛吉，他们向忒伊投掷石子和树枝，而忒伊则用他最阴沉的声音嘲弄他们。三人决定，让女神凯娜瑞丝（由贝娜拉分饰两角）回应了盖登·辛吉的祈祷，并将奥辛纽姆淹没在一场大雨中。城墙生锈溶解了。这时，忒伊顺从地从树上跳下来，让乔勒国王和盖登·辛吉用他们的附魔刀剑把他碎尸万段。 在第一纪元675年那个夏天的大部分时间里，忒伊几乎察觉不到太阳的威力。虽说万里无云，但每天晚上都会下雨，所以戈尼岛上的植被繁茂得眼花缭乱。石头本身似乎在阳光下发光，沟渠里燃烧着白色的绣线菊和欧芹；在他周围都是柔和的花香和树香，风儿吹拂也吹不消散；树叶是紫绿、蓝绿、灰绿和白绿。戈尼小村庄宽大的穹顶、曲折的鹅卵石街道和茅草屋顶，以及桑迪尔宅邸巨大的漂白岩石，通通令他感到惊奇。 然而那些梦仍然在夜里纠缠着他，此外无论是否清醒，那首歌始终缭绕不绝。 不顾乌莉雅姑姑的劝告，忒伊、贝娜拉和瓦斯特每天早上都在户外与仆人们一起吃早餐。乌莉雅会为自己和来访的贵宾准备室内早餐：客人不常来，所以她经常独自用餐。一开始仆人们会默默地吃饭，试图表现得彬彬有礼，但他们很快就会憋不住，向孩子们讲述八卦、消息、故事和传闻来逗他们开心。 “可怜的阿妮尔又发烧了。” “我告诉你，他们被诅咒了。他们所有人都是。在小仙子身上撒尿，他们就会在你身上撒尿。” “斯达莎小小姐看起来，哦，是不是肚子那里胀得有一点点紧啊？” “她才没有！” 仆人之中只有忒伊的保姆艾德芭一言不发，她不像其他女仆那样漂亮，但她脸上的疤痕并没有让脸走形。她那可怜的断鼻和短发给她带来了某种异样的神秘感。她只是静静地对那些闲言碎语微笑，并以近乎令人恐惧的爱和虔诚的目光看着忒伊。 有一天早餐后，贝娜拉悄悄对忒伊和瓦斯特说：“我们得去岛的另一边山上。” 她以前也这么发号施令过，而且总能让他们大开眼界：一个藏在蕨类植物和高耸岩石后面的瀑布；一片阳光明媚的无花果树林；一个农民们搭建的秘密蒸馏房；一棵病态的橡树，扭曲成一个跪着的人形；一堵坍塌的石墙，在他们想象中它的历史有数千年之久，是一个落难公主最后的避难所，他们叫她梅拉。 三个人穿过森林，直到他们来到一片林中空地。在几百尺之外，草地下沉到一条干涸小溪的河床，上面布满了光滑的小石头。他们沿着小溪进入黑暗的树林，那里的树木高高地笼罩在他们头上。零星的红色和黄色花朵在潮湿的灌木丛中绽放，但随着孩子们在巨大的橡树和榆树下行进，它们变得越来越稀少。空气中弥漫着鸟儿嘀嗒嘀嗒的合唱声，汇成那首歌的一个小和弦。 “我们要去哪里？”忒伊问。 “不是我们要去哪里，而是我们要去看什么。”贝娜拉回答。 森林完全包围了这三个孩子，让他们沐浴在它的阴暗色泽中，向他们呼出湿润的鸣叫与叹息。他们很容易就能想象自己是在一个怪物体内，沿着它扭曲的石头脊柱行走。 贝娜拉爬上陡峭的山坡，透过厚厚的灌木和树木窥看。忒伊将瓦斯特拉出小溪河床，抓着柔软的小草爬了出来。这里没有穿过森林的道路。荆棘和低垂的树枝像被锁住的野兽的爪子一样向他们袭来。鸟儿的叫声变得越来越激烈，似乎对入侵感到愤怒。一根树枝在瓦斯特的脸颊上划出了血痕，但他没有喊叫。即使是能够像飘渺幽灵一样穿过密不透风的森林的贝娜拉，也有一条辫子被荆棘扯住，弄乱了一个仆人几个小时前编织的繁复样式。她停下解开了另一条辫子，于是她明艳的一头乱发在她身后散开。现在她散发着野性，成了领着另外两人穿过她林地的宁芙。歌声开始像狂野的脉搏一样律动。 他们在一个悬崖下的突出石架上俯瞰着伟岸的峡谷，凝视着下面一大片灰烬。这看起来就像一场惨烈大战和烈焰留下的浩劫。烧焦的箱子、武器、兽骨，以及损毁得无法辨认的碎渣散落在地上。忒伊和瓦斯特哑口无言地踏上了黑色的地面。贝娜拉笑了，她为自己终于找到了真正奇异和神秘的事物而得意。 “这是什么地方？”最后瓦斯特问道。 “我不知道，”贝娜拉耸了耸肩。“我一开始以为这是什么废墟，但现在我认为这是一个垃圾堆，只是和我见过的其他垃圾堆都不太一样。看看这些东西就知道了。” 三人开始各自漫无目的地在这些尘土飞扬的垃圾堆中翻找。贝纳拉找到了一把被火焰微微烧黑的曲剑，开始擦拭它以阅读剑刃上的铭文。瓦斯特自娱自乐，手脚并用地打碎脆弱的箱子，想象自己是一个力大无比的巨人。一面破旧的盾牌吸引了泰勒：上面有什么东西激起了歌声回荡。他把它拉出来，把表面擦干净。 “我以前从未见过这个徽章。”贝娜拉从忒伊的肩膀上探过头来。 “我想我见过，但我不记得了。”泰勒低声说，试图唤起他梦中的记忆。他确信他在梦里看到过它。 “看看这个！”瓦斯特喊道，打断了忒伊的思绪。男孩举起了一个水晶球。当他的手在表面移动，拂去砂砾和灰尘时，歌声高了一阶，忒伊浑身颤抖。贝娜拉跑过去看瓦斯特的宝物，忒伊怔在原地。 “你在哪里找到的？”她喘着气，凝视着水晶表面下的漩涡。 “在那辆车上。”瓦斯特指向一堆发黑的木头，除了它的车辐外，几乎无法从其他一堆堆废物中将它辨认出来。贝娜拉开始在半塌的木架中翻找，只有她的脚露了出来。歌声的力量渐渐强大起来，席卷了忒伊全身。他开始慢慢走向瓦斯特。 “把它给我。”他用几乎认不出是自己的声音沉声说。 “不，”瓦斯特小声回道，他的目光定定望着在球体中心反射出来的色彩。“这是我的。” 贝娜拉在车骸中又挖了几分钟，但她没有找到像瓦斯特那样的宝物。里面的大部分东西都已经毁坏，剩下的东西怎么看都平平无奇：断箭、盔甲碎片、瓜尔骨头。她失望地抽出身子回到阳光底下。 忒伊独自一人站在大峡谷边上。 “瓦斯特去哪了？” 忒伊眨了眨眼，然后回过头来，耸了耸肩，笑着对他的堂姐说。“他回去向大家炫耀他的战利品了。你找到什么了吗？” “并没有，”贝娜拉说，“我们也许应该在瓦斯特说漏嘴给我们惹麻烦之前回家去。” 忒伊和贝娜拉开始快步往回走。忒伊知道他们回去时瓦斯特不会在那里。他永远回不了家了。水晶球紧紧地躺在忒伊的书包里，藏在他捡来的一堆杂物下面。他全心全意地祈求歌声复返，淹没峡谷中留下的记忆，淹没那漫长而沉默的坠落。那孩子太过震惊，他甚至来不及尖叫。

The Axe Man A surprising way to become proficient with an axe

[pagebreak]

f all the members of the Morag Tong I've spoken with, none disturbed me as much as Minas Torik. A quiet and reserved man who never drank, never visited a brothel or even uttered a curse, he was famous for his ability to make people disappear. Once a person was targeted by the Brotherhood and Torik was sent to them, they would simply cease to be. I asked him once what his weapon of choice was, and was equally startled by his answer. "I only likes to use axes," he said in his typical, quiet voice. The image of this silent, dour fellow attacking anyone with a weapon as inherently bloody and violent as an axe so frightened and intrigued me that I questioned him about it further. This is an inherently dangerous activity, for assassins are not typically keen to give out their stories. Torik did not mind the questions, though it took some time to get the full story out of him, as naturally shy and reserved as he was. It seemed that Torik had been orphaned at a very young age and sent to live with his uncle, a saltrice plantation owner in Sheogorad in northern Vvardenfell. The man promised to show his nephew the business and eventually make him a partner when he was old enough. In the meantime, the boy was put to work as his uncle's house servant. It was a grueling life as the old man was very particular about how things should be done. The boy was first required to give all the floors in the house a thorough scouring, from the attic to the cellar. Whenever the floor was not cleaned to the uncle's satisfaction, which was frequent, Torik was thrashed and forced to begin again. The boy's second duty was to ring the bell that would bring the laborers into the house. This was done at least four times a day, once for each meal, but if his uncle had any news or additional instructions for the laborers - which he frequently did - the bell might need to be sounded a dozen times or more. It was a huge iron bell in the tower and the boy quickly discovered that he had to throw his entire body into the motion of pulling the chain in order to have it sound loud enough to bring everyone in from the field. If he was tired and did not pull the backbreaking chain hard enough, his uncle was soon at his side to beat him until he rang the bell loud and clear. Torik's third task was dusting all the shelves in his uncle's vast library. As deep and old as the shelves were, he was required to work with a long, heavy duster on a rod. The only way that he could reach to the back of the shelves was to hold the duster at his shoulder and then swing it out in a sweeping motion. Again, if the uncle saw any dust left over or felt that the boy was not working as hard as he ought to, the punishment was swift and severe. After several years, Minas Torik grew into a young man, but his job responsibilities were not increased. His uncle promised to teach him the business, once Torik had demonstrated his mastery of his servile assignments. Divorced from any knowledge of any work other than his own, Torik never knew how badly in debt his uncle was and how poorly the farm's yield was. In his eighteenth year, Torik was called into the cellar by his uncle. He thought that he had not done a good enough job scouring the floor down there, and was frightened of the beating to come. What he found, however, was his uncle packing his goods into crates. "I'm leaving Morrowind," he explained. "The business has gone sour, so I thought I'd try my luck running a caravan in Skyrim. I understand there's good money to be made, trading fake Dwemer artifacts to the Nords and Cyrodiils. I wish I could take you with me, my lad, but there won't be much need for scouring, bell pulling, and dusting where I'm going." "But uncle," said Torik. "I can't read, I knows nothing of the business you promised to teach me. What wills I dos on my own?" "I'm certain you can find a job in some domestic capacity," shrugged the uncle. "I've done my best with you." Torik had never stood up to his uncle before, and felt no anger only a sort of coldness that gripped his heart. Among his uncle's possessions being packed away was an old heavy iron axe, allegedly of Dwemer manufacture. He picked it up in his hands and was surprised to find that it was not much heavier than his dusting rod. In fact, it felt very comfortable as he pulled it over his shoulder and swung it out as he had done so many times before. In this instance, however, he swung it into his uncle's right arm. The old man screamed with pain and rage, but for some reason, Torik didn't feel frightened anymore. He propped the axe against his other shoulder, and swung it out again. It cut a swath across the old man's chest and he fell to the floor. Torik hesitated before lifting the axe above his head. It was another natural position for him, like he was ringing a bell. Over and over again, he swung down as if he was calling the laborers in from the field. Except that this time, there was no sound except for a wet thump, and no laborers came in from the field. Of course, his uncle had sent them away hours before. After a time, there was nothing left of his uncle that couldn't be washed down the cellar drain. The process of cleaning up came easily to Torik as well. Blood scrubbed up much quicker than the usual grime and saltrice flour that littered the cellar floor. It was well known that Torik's uncle was planning to leave Morrowind, so his disappearance provoked no suspicion. The house and all the belongings were sold to the debt collectors, but Torik took the axe. It seemed that his uncle had given him some worthwhile business skills after all.

he Daedra are powerful ancestor spirits, similar in form and substance to the Tribunal (Blessed Be Their Holy Names), but weaker in power, and more arbitrary and removed from the affairs of mortals. In old times, the Chimer worshiped the Daedra as gods. But they did not deserve this veneration, for the Daedra harm their worshippers as often as help them. The Advent of the Tribunal (Blessed Be Their Holy Names) changed this unhappy state. By the Apotheosis, the Tribunal (Blessed Be Their Holy Names) became the Protectors and High Ancestor Spirits of the Dunmer, and bade the Daedra to give proper veneration and obedience. The Three Good Daedra, Boethiah, Azura, and Mephala, recognized the Divinity of the Triune Ancestors (Blessed Be Their Holy Names). The Rebel Daedra, Molag Bal, Malacath, Sheogorath, and Mehrunes Dagon, refused to swear fealty to the Tribunal (Blessed Be Their Holy Names), and their worshippers were cast out. These Rebel Daedra thus became the Four Corners of the House of Troubles, and they continue to plague our tranquility and tempt the unwary into Heresy and Dark Worship. The Priests of the Temple remain ever vigilant for signs of the Adversaries' return, sometimes aided by the loyal Three Good Daedra, who are familiar with the wiles of their rebellious kin. The Good Daedra are known to the Temple as the Anticipations, since they are the early ancestral anticipations of the loving patronage of the Tribunal. The Anticipations are the Daedra Lords Boethiah, Mephala, and Azura. Boethiah is the Anticipation of Almalexia but male to her female. Boethiah was the ancestor who illuminated the elves ages ago before the Mythic Era. He told them the truth of Lorkhan's test, and defeated Auriel's champion, Trinimac. Boethiah ate Trinimac and voided him. The followers of Boethiah and Trinimac rubbed the soil of Trinimac upon themselves and changed their skins. Mephala is the Anticipation of Vivec, but manifold and androgynous. Mephala taught the Chimer to evade their enemies or kill them with secret murder. Enemies were numerous in those days since the Chimer were a small with enemies on all sides. Mephala organized the clan systems that eventually became the Great Houses. Later, Mephala created the Morag Tong. Azura is the Anticipation of Sotha Sil, but female to his male. Azura was the ancestor who taught the Chimer how to be different from the Altmer. Her teachings are sometimes attributed to Boethiah. In the stories, Azura is often encountered more as a communal progenitor of the race as a whole rather than as an individual ancestor. She is associated with Dusk and Dawn, and is sometimes called the Mother Soul. Azura's Star, also called the Twilight Star, appears briefly at dawn and dusk low on the horizon below the constellation of the Steed. Azura is associated with mystery and magic, fate and prophecy.

he following is from the Apographa, the hidden writings of the Tribunal Temple. It is a scholarly retelling of a tradition transmitted through the Ashlanders concerning the battle at Red Mountain and subsequent events. The Ashlanders associate this tale with the telling of Alandro Sul, a shield-companion of Nerevar who came to live among the Ashlanders after the death of Nerevar and during the ascension of the Tribunal. There are many variant treatments of this story, but the primary elements are consistent throughout the tradition. The murder of Nerevar, the tragic fate of Dagoth Ur, and the profane source of the Tribunal's divine power are denied by Temple doctrine as ignorant Ashlander superstition, and not widely known among civilized Dunmer. Resdayn, present day Morrowind, was contested ground between two very different types of mer: the Chimer, who worshipped Daedra, and the Dwemer, who worshipped a profane and secret power. These two people warred with each other constantly until their lands were invaded by a young, vibrant, and violent alien culture, the Nords. Two heroes, one from the Chimer and one from the Dwemer, Indoril Nerevar and Dumac Dwarf-Orc, made peace between their people and together ousted the alien invaders. Then these two heroes worked long and hard to maintain that peace thereafter, though their counselors thought it could not last or, worse, that it shouldn't. Nerevar's queen and his generals-- Almalexia, Sotha Sil, Vivec-- told him to claim all Resdayn for his own. But Nerevar would not listen, for he remembered his friendship with Dumac. There would be only peace. Until Dagoth-Ur arrived. House Dagoth had discovered the source of the profane and secret power of the Dwemer: the legendary Heart of Lorkhan, which Dumac's people had used to make themselves immortal and beyond the measure of the gods. In fact, one of the their high priests, Kagrenac, was building a New God so that the Dwemer could claim Resdayn for their own. The Tribunal urged Nerevar again to make war on the Dwarves. Nerevar was troubled. He went to Dumac, his friend of old, and asked if what Dagoth-Ur said was true. But Kagrenac and the high priests of the Dwemer had kept their New God secret from their King, and Dumac said the Dwemer were innocent of any wrongdoing. Nerevar was troubled again and made pilgrimage to Holamayan, the sacred temple of Azura, who confirmed that all that Dagoth-Ur said was indeed true and that the New God of the Dwemer should be destroyed for the safety of not only Resdayn, but for the whole world. When Nerevar went back and told his Tribunal what the goddess had said, his queen and generals felt themselves proved aright and again counseled him to war. There were reasons that the Dwemer and Chimer had hated each other forever. Finally, Nerevar, angered that his friend Dumac would lie to him, went back to Vvardenfell. This time the Chimer King was arrayed in arms and armor and had his hosts around him, and he spoke harshly to Dumac Dwarf-Orc, King of Red Mountain. "You must give up your worship of the Heart of Lorkhan or I shall forget our friendship and the deeds that were accomplished in its name!" And Dumac, who still knew nothing of Kagrenac's New God, but proud and protective as ever of his people, said, "We shall not relinquish that which has been our way for years beyond reckoning, just as the Chimer will not relinquish their ties to the Lords and Ladies of Oblivion. And to come at my door in this way, arrayed in arms and armor and with your hosts around you, tells me you have already forgotten our friendship. Stand down, my sweet Nerevar, or I swear by the fifteen-and-one golden tones I shall kill you and all your people." And so the Chimer and Dwemer went to war. The Dwemer were well-defended by their fortress at Red Mountain, but the bravery and cleverness of Nerevar's queen and generals drew most of Dumac's armies out into the field and kept them there, so that Nerevar and Dagoth-Ur could make their way into the Heart Chamber by secret means. There, Nerevar met Dumac and the Dwarf King and they both fell from grievous wounds. Dagoth-Ur slew Kagrenac and took the tools the Dwemer used to tap the power of the Heart. He went to his dying lord Nerevar and asked him what to do with these tools. And Nerevar summoned Azura again, and she showed them how to use the tools to separate the power of the Heart from the Dwemer people. And on the fields, the Tribunal and their armies watched as the Dwemer turned into dust all around them as their stolen immortality was taken away. Back in Red Mountain, Nerevar told Dagoth-Ur to protect the tools and the Heart Chamber until he returned. Dagoth-Ur said, "But shouldn't we destroy these tools at once, so that they might never be used for evil again?" But Nerevar was confused by his wounds and his sorrow (for he still loved Dumac and the Dwemer people) and so went to the fields outside of Red Mountain to confer with his queen and his generals, who had foreseen that this war would come and whose counsel he would not ignore again. "I will ask the Tribunal what we shall do with them, for they have had wisdom in the past that I had not. Stay here, loyal Dagoth-Ur, until I return." Then Nerevar told his queen and generals all that had transpired under Red Mountain and how the Dwemer had used special tools to turn their people into immortals and of the wondrous power of the Heart of Lorkhan. The Tribunal decided that the Chimer should learn how to use this power so that Nerevar might claim Resdayn and the world for their people. Nerevar did not expect or want this, so he asked his queen and generals to help him summon Azura yet again for her guidance. But the Tribunal had become as greedy as Kagrenac upon hearing of the power of the Heart and they coveted it. They made ritual as if to summon Azura as Nerevar wanted but Almalexia used poisoned candles and Sotha Sil used poisoned robes and Vivec used poisoned invocations. Nerevar was murdered. Then Azura came forth anyway and cursed the Tribunal for their foul deeds. She told them that she would use her powers over dusk and dawn to make sure Nerevar would come back and make things right again. But the Tribunal laughed at her and said that soon they would be gods themselves and that the Chimer people would forget their old ways of worship. And Azura knew this would be true and that it would take a long time before her power might bring Nerevar back. "What you have done here today is foul beyond measure and you will grow to regret it, for the lives of gods are not what mortals think and matters that weigh only years to mortals weigh on gods forever." And so that they might know forever their wicked deeds Azura changed the Chimer into Dunmer, and their skin turned ashen and their eyes into fire. "Let this mark remind you of your true selves who, like ghouls, fed on the nobility, heroism, and trust of their king." And then the Tribunal went into Red Mountain and met with Dagoth-Ur. Dagoth-Ur saw what had been done, for his skin had changed as well, and he tried to avenge the death of Nerevar but to no avail. He was driven off and thought dead. The Tribunal found the tools he had been guarding and, through study of Kagrenac's methods, turned themselves into gods. Thousands of years after their apotheosis, the Tribunal are still the gods of Morrowind and the old ways of worship are remembered only by a few. And the murder of Nerevar is known to fewer. 下文是隐藏于异典的审判席神殿著作，它是对灰地民红山之战及其后事件流传下来的传说的学术性复述。灰地民将这个故事与尼瑞瓦的盾卫阿兰德罗·苏联系到一起，在尼瑞瓦死后审判席登天期间，他选择来到灰地民社会生活。这个传说有不同的解读方式，但其中的主要元素都一致。谋杀尼瑞瓦，达格斯·乌尔的悲惨命运，审判席神圣力量的亵渎来源，这些都被审判席神殿教义否定为无知灰地民的迷信言论，不为开化丹莫所普遍了解。 瑞斯戴恩，今名晨风，曾为两个有着巨大差异的莫类族群所争夺之地：信仰迪德拉的凯莫，和信仰渎神、隐秘力量的锻莫。两族战争不断，直到被诺德人这个新生、活力却又残暴的外来文化入侵。 分别来自凯莫和锻莫的两位英雄：因多瑞尔·尼瑞瓦、“矮兽人”杜马克为两族人民缔结了和平以共同驱逐异族入侵者。此后两位英雄为维持和平付出了长期努力，尽管他们的顾问认为和平无法长久，抑或不应长久。尼瑞瓦的王后阿玛莱西亚，和将军索萨·希尔、维威克告诫他应将瑞斯戴恩全土纳入版图。但尼瑞瓦没有采纳，他依然珍惜与杜马克的友谊，把和平放在第一位。 直到达格斯·乌尔前来。达格斯家族发现锻莫渎神且隐秘的力量之源——传说中的洛克汗之心，杜马克的族人利用它使自身踏足不朽，超越诸神度量。实际上，他们的一位叫卡格瑞纳克的高等祭司，正在建造一位新神，为锻莫占领瑞斯戴恩全土做铺垫。 尼瑞瓦再次被审判席敦促向矮人宣战，这使他陷入了两难境地。他与老友杜马克会晤并问及达格斯·乌尔所言是否属实，但卡格瑞纳克和锻莫高等祭司们对他们的王隐瞒了建造新神的计划，所以杜马克坚称锻莫一族没有任何非分之举。困惑之余，尼瑞瓦前往阿祖拉的霍拉马延神殿朝圣，阿祖拉证实了达格斯·乌尔所言属实，为瑞斯戴恩与整个世界的安全考虑，必须摧毁锻莫的新神。当尼瑞瓦回去将女神神谕转告审判席后，他的王后与将军们证实了猜想，再次建言开战。锻莫与凯莫之间长久的敌视自有其道理。 最终，为朋友杜马克的欺骗感到愤怒的尼瑞瓦回到了瓦登费尔。但这次，这位凯莫之王全副武装，统率大军，以尖锐的言辞向红山之王、“矮兽人”杜马克发难：“你必须舍弃对洛克汗之心的崇拜，否则我将把我们的友谊及在其名义下所做的一切尽数遗忘！”杜马克此时仍对卡格瑞纳克的新神一无所知，一如既往地骄傲于他的子民且为之辩护，他说：“我们不会未经估量就放弃多年来走过的道路，就像凯莫也不会放弃与湮灭君王的联系一样。而你现在披坚执锐，率兵前来，说明已经放弃了我们间的友谊。退后吧，亲爱的尼瑞瓦，否则我就以十五又一金色音调的名义发誓杀了光你们所有人。” 于是，凯莫与锻莫开战了。锻莫在红山要塞防御森严，但尼瑞瓦的王后与将军们以其勇毅与谋略牵制了杜马克大部分军队，使他们滞留在战场上，尼瑞瓦和达格斯·乌尔得以通过秘密途径进入“心室”。在那里尼瑞瓦和矮人王杜马克相遇，两人都倒在血泊之中。达格斯·乌尔杀死了卡格瑞纳克，夺走了锻莫用以获取心脏神力的工具。他走向垂死的主公尼瑞瓦面前询问如何处置，尼瑞瓦再次召唤阿祖拉，而她展示了如何使用工具从锻莫子民中分离出心脏的力量。 在战场上，审判席及其军队则目睹了四周的锻莫化为尘土——因其盗取的不朽之力被取走了。 转回红山，尼瑞瓦让达格斯·乌尔在他返回之前保护好工具和“心室”。达格斯·乌尔说：“我们是否应该立即毁掉这些工具，以防它们再被用以作恶？”但尼瑞瓦为他的伤痛与悲哀感到迷惘（他仍然爱着杜马克与锻莫人民），所以走出红山，来到战场上与曾向他预警这场战争的王后与将军们协商。“我要向审判席询问如何处理他们，过去他们曾展现了我所缺乏的智慧。忠实的达格斯·乌尔啊，在这儿等我回来吧。” 随后尼瑞瓦向他的王后与将军们讲述了红山之底发生的一切，锻莫是如何运用特殊工具让他们的子民踏足不朽，以及洛克汗之心的奇异力量。审判席决定，凯莫应当学习如何化用这种力量，以便尼瑞瓦可以为人民征服瑞斯戴恩甚至整个世界。尼瑞瓦没有这种打算，也不想看到这种结果，他请求王后与将军们协助他再次召唤阿祖拉寻求指点。但审判席在听说了心脏神力后变得和卡格瑞纳克一样贪婪，觊觎其力量。他们照尼瑞瓦所愿举行仪式召唤了阿祖拉，但阿玛莱西亚用的是剧毒蜡烛，索萨·希尔给的是带毒的长袍，维克则道出恶毒的咒语。尼瑞瓦被谋杀了。 但阿祖拉还是现身了，她为审判席的恶行诅咒他们。告诉他们她会以晨昏之力确保尼瑞瓦回归，让一切重回正轨。但是审判席嘲笑她，声称他们不久将登神位，凯莫会遗忘传统信仰。阿祖拉知道这将成为事实，因为她的力量要带回尼瑞瓦尚需等待。“你们今日所作所为极恶非道，日后必将后悔，神之生命非凡人可以揣度，凡人岁月之忧于神则是永久的负担。”为了让他们永远记住自己的恶行，阿祖拉将凯莫变为丹莫，使他们的皮肤变灰，眼睛化红。“让这印记时刻提醒你们，自己真实的自我，就如以王的高贵、英勇、信任为食的食尸鬼一般。” 之后审判席进入红山，见到了达格斯·乌尔。因为自己皮肤变灰而知晓了这一切的达格斯·乌尔试图为尼瑞瓦复仇，但他失败了。被逼退后他被认为身死，审判席又找到了他一直守护的工具，通过研究卡格瑞纳克的工具，把自己变为了神。 在审判席登天后数千年，他们依然是晨风诸神，传统信仰仅存于极少数丹莫。但阿祖拉的神谕徘徊耳边，且每日都能看到她对人民所施加的诅咒，所以即使尼瑞瓦之死鲜为人知，王后与将军们也恐惧于他的回归。

f you would be wise, model your lives on the lives of the saints. If you would learn valor, follow St. Nerevar the Captain, patron of Warriors and Statesmen. Lord Nerevar helped to unite the barbarian Dunmer tribes into a great nation, culminating in his martyrdom when leading the Dunmer to victory against the evil Dwemer and the traitorous House Dagoth in the Battle of Red Mountain. If you would learn daring, follow Saint Veloth the Pilgrim, Patron of Outcasts and Spiritual Seekers. Saint Veloth, prophet and mystic, led the Dunmer out of the decadent home country of the Summerset Isles and into the promised land of Morrowind. Saint Veloth also taught the difference between the Good and Bad Daedra, and won the aid of the Good Daedra for his people while teaching how to carefully negotiate with the Bad Daedra. If you would learn generosity, follow Saint Rilms the Barefooted, Patron of Pilgrims and Beggars. Saint Rilms gave away her shoes, then dressed and appeared as a beggar to better acquaint herself with the poor. If you would learn self-respect and respect for others, follow Saint Aralor the Penitent, Patron of Tanners and Miners. This foul criminal repented his sins and traveled a circuit of the great pilgrimages on his knees. If you would learn mercy and its fruits, follow Saint Seryn the Merciful, Patron of Brewers, Bakers, Distillers. This pure virgin of modest aspect could heal all diseases at the price of taking the disease upon herself. Tough-minded and fearless, she took on the burdens of others, and bore those burdens to an honored old age. If you would learn fierce justice, follow Saint Felms the Bold, Patron of Butchers and Fishmongers. This brave warlord slew the Nord invaders and drove them from our lands. He could neither read nor write, receiving inspiration directly from the lips of Almsivi. If you would learn pride of race and tribe, follow Saint Roris the Martyr, Patron of Furnishers and Caravaners. Captured by Argonians just before the Arnesian War, Roris proudly refused to renounce the Tribunal faith, and withstood the cruel tortures of Argonian sorcerers. Vengeance and justice for the martyred Saint Roris was the rallying cry of the Arnesian War. If you would learn the rule of law and justice, follow Saint Olms the Just, Patron of Chandlers and Clerks. Founder of the Ordinators, Saint Olms conceived and articulated the fundamental principles of testing, ordeal, and repentance. If you would learn benevolence, follow Saint Delyn the Wise, Patron of Potters and Glassmakers. Saint Delyn was head of House Indoril, a skilled lawyer, and author of many learned treatises on Tribunal law and custom. If you would learn the love of peace, follow Saint Meris the Peacemaker, Patron of Farmers and Laborers. As a little girl, Saint Meris showed healing gifts, and trained as a Healer. She ended a long and bloody House War, intervening on the battlefield in her white robe to heal warriors and spellcrafters without regard to faction. The troops of all House adopted white robes as her standard, and refused to shed the blood of their brethren. If you would learn reverence, follow Saint Llothis the Pious, Patron of Tailors and Dyers. Contemporary and companion of the Tribunals, and the best-loved Alma Rula of the Tribunal Temple, he formulated the central rituals and principles of the New Temple Faith. Saint Llothis is the symbolic mortal bridge between the gods and the faithful, and the archetypal priest.

圣人之道

如果你想拥有智慧，那便追寻圣者们的脚步生活吧。 若你想了解勇敢，追寻领袖圣尼瑞瓦的脚步吧。他是战士与政治家们的守护者。尼瑞瓦大人统一了尚未开化的诸丹莫部落，将其建设为一个伟大的国家。红山之战中，他率领丹莫击败了邪恶的锻莫，以及背叛了丹莫的达格斯家族，但圣尼瑞瓦本人也在此战中殒命。 若你想了解开拓，追寻朝圣者圣维洛斯的脚步吧。他是放逐者与寻求心灵者们的守护者。圣维洛斯，先知与秘智者，带领丹莫从颓废堕落之乡夏暮岛离开，来到这应允的晨风之地。圣维洛斯还教导了丹莫如何分辨迪德拉的好坏。在为他的人民争取到好迪德拉援助的同时，又教导他们如何小心地与坏迪德拉谈判。 若你想了解慷慨，追寻赤脚圣瑞姆斯的脚步吧。她是朝圣者与乞丐们的守护者。圣瑞姆斯将她的鞋子送给穷人，又以乞丐的身份生活，只为了更深切地体会劳苦大众们的痛楚。 若你想了解尊严与尊重，追寻悔罪者圣阿拉诺的脚步吧。他是皮革匠与矿工的守护者。阿拉诺曾是一名肮脏的罪犯，为表悔罪之心，他长途环绕，膝行朝圣。 若你想了解仁慈及其恩惠，追寻慈悲的圣瑟琳的脚步吧。她是酿酒师、面包师、酒厂工人们的守护者。这位纯洁而端庄的处女可以治愈一切疾病，但代价却是将疾病转移到她自己身上。她以坚定无畏的意志接过他人的负担，并将其背负终生。 若你想了解严厉的正义，追寻勇者圣费姆斯的脚步吧。他是屠夫与渔夫们的守护者。这位骁勇的军阀奋力杀敌，将诺德侵略者赶出了我们的土地。他目不识丁，却直接从阿玛希维处得到神启。 若你想了解民族与部落的骄傲，追寻殉道者圣洛瑞斯的脚步吧。他是供应商与旅行商人们的守护者。洛瑞斯在阿尼西亚战争前被阿尔贡俘虏，但是他以凛然之姿拒绝放弃自己对审判席的信仰，无论阿尔贡巫师如何以酷刑折磨他，他依旧虔诚不改。为殉道者圣洛瑞斯复仇和讨回公道成为了阿尼西亚战争中的战斗口号。 若你想了解公正与律法的规则，追寻公正者圣奥姆斯的脚步吧。他是货商与文员的守护者，也是协调使的创始人。圣奥姆斯构想并阐释了测试、磨炼与悔罪的基本原则。 若你想了解仁爱，追寻智者圣德林的脚步吧。他是陶工和玻璃工们的守护者。圣德林曾是因多瑞尔家族的首领，也是一位经验丰富的律师，著有许多审判席法律与习俗的论文。 若你想了解和平之爱，追寻止战者圣梅里斯的脚步吧。她是农民与劳动者们的守护者。圣梅里斯从小便展露出了治愈的天赋，并在日后成为了一名治疗师。她终结了一场漫长而血腥的家族斗争。在战场上，她着一袭白袍穿梭于阵间，不分派别地治疗战士与法师们。最后，所有家族的军队都以她白袍为旗帜，并立誓再不自相残杀。 若你想了解敬畏，追寻虔信者圣里洛菲斯的脚步吧。他是裁缝与染匠的守护者。他是审判席的同代人和伙伴，也是最受神殿所爱的阿玛·鲁拉。他制定了新神殿信仰的主要仪式和原则。圣里洛菲斯也是神明与信徒之间象征性的凡俗桥梁，更是所有神职人员的典范。

The House of Troubles

[pagebreak]

mong the ancient ancestral spirits who accompanied Saint Veloth and the Chimer into the promised land of Morrowind, the four Daedra Lords, Malacath, Mehrunes Dagon, Molag Bal, and Sheogorath, are known as the Four Corners of the House of Troubles. These Daedra Lords rebelled against the counsel and admonition of the Tribunal, causing great kinstrife and confusion among the clans and Great Houses. Malacath, Mehrunes Dagon, Molag Bal, and Sheogorath are holy in that they serve the role of obstacles during the Testing. Through time they have sometimes become associated with local enemies, like the Nords, Akaviri, or Mountain Orcs. Malacath is the reanimated dung that was Trinimac, Malacath is a weak but vengeful god. The Dark Elves say he is Malak, the god-king of the orcs. He tests the Dunmer for physical weakness. Molag Bal is, in Morrowind, the King of Rape. He tries to upset the bloodlines of Houses and otherwise ruin the Dunmer gene pool. A race of monsters, said to live in Molag Amur, are the result of his seduction of Vivec during the previous era. Sheogorath is the King of Madness. He always tests the Dunmer for mental weakness. In many legends he is called upon by one Dunmer faction against another; in half of these stories he does not betray those who called him, further confusing the issue of his place in the scheme of things (can he help us? is he not an obstacle?). He is often associated with the fear other races have of the Dunmer, especially those who, like the Empire, might prove as useful allies. Mehrunes Dagon is the god of destruction. He is associated with natural dangers like fire, earthquakes, and floods. To some he represents the inhospitable land of Morrowind. He tests the Dunmer will to survive and persevere. The worship of these four malevolent spirits is against the law and practice of the Temple. However, the Four Corners seldom fail to discover those greedy, reckless, or mad enough to serve them. By ancient Temple law and custom, and also by imperial law, the lives of witches and warlocks are forfeit, and Imperial garrisons join Ordinators and Buoyant Armigers of the Temple in tracking down and destroying these foul covens in the wilderness refuges and ancient ruins where they conceal their profane worships.

当圣维洛斯和凯莫抵达应许之地晨风，在一道而来的先灵之中，有四位迪德拉君主——玛拉凯斯、梅鲁涅斯·大衮、莫拉格·巴尔以及谢尔格拉，他们被称为动乱之屋的四角。这些迪德拉君主反对审判席的建言和戒律，在大家族和部落之中制造纷争和混乱。 玛拉凯斯、梅鲁涅斯·大衮、莫拉格·巴尔以及谢尔格拉，他们在扮演试炼中的阻碍之时是神圣的。自古以来，他们时不时会与当地的敌人联系在一起，比如诺德人、阿卡维尔人。还有山地兽人。 玛拉凯斯是前身为崔尼玛克的粪便复活而成，他是位弱小却一心复仇的神灵。暗精灵称他是马拉克，兽人的神王。他考验着丹莫躯体上的弱点。 在晨风，莫拉格·巴尔是强暴之王，他企图用诸如打乱各家族血脉的种种方法来毁坏丹莫的基因池。有一族怪物，据说栖息在莫拉格·阿穆尔，便是他在上一纪元诱惑维威克的产物。 谢尔格拉是疯狂之王，他始终考验着丹莫精神上的弱点，许多传说中他被一派丹莫召唤出来对付另一派，有一半故事里他并没有背叛召唤他的人，进而混淆了他在万物之中所处的位置（他会帮助我们？莫非他不是阻碍？）他常常与外族对丹莫的恐惧联系在一起，特别是像帝国那样也许可堪证明的得力盟友。 梅鲁涅斯·大衮是毁灭之神，他与自然灾害联系在一起，比如火灾，地震，还有洪水。对有些人来说他代表着晨风的荒凉恶土。他考验着丹莫生存与忍耐的意志。 神殿的法律与惯例禁止对这四位恶灵的信仰。不过，四角总能找到那些或贪婪或轻率或是足够疯狂的人来侍奉他们。不管是根据神殿的古老法律与习俗还是根据帝国的法律，邪巫信徒无论男女一概处死，帝国驻军与神殿的协调使和灵动扈从合作，追查并摧毁在野外藏身处和古老废墟中暗中信仰异端的邪恶集会。

Take for instance, the story I told you last night about my cousin. If he hadn't fallen off that horse, he never would have become one of the Empire's foremost alchemists." It was late one Middas night at the King's Ham, and the regulars were always especially inclined toward philosophy. "I disagree," replied Xiomara, firmly but politely. "Great ideas and inventions are most often formed slowly over time by diligence and hard work. If you'll recall my tale from last month, the young lady -- who I assure you is based on a real person -- only recognized her one true love after she had slept with practically everyone in Northpoint." "I put it to you that neither is the case," said Hallgerd, pouring a topper on his mug of greef. "The greatest inventions are created by extraordinary need. Must I remind you of the story I told some time ago about Arslic Oan and the invention of bonemold?" "The problem with your theory is that your example is entirely fictional," sniffed Xiomara. "I don't believe I remember the story of Arslic Oan and the invention of bonemold," frowned Garaz. "Are you sure you told us?" "Well, this happened many, many, many years ago, when Vvardenfell was a beauteous green land, when Dunmer were Chimer and Dwemer and Nord lived together in relative peace when they weren't trying to kill one another," Hallgerd relaxed in his chair, warming to his theme. "When the sun and moons all hung in the sky together--" "Lord, Mother, and Wizard!" grumbled Xiomara. "If I'm going to be forced to hear your ridiculous story again, pray don't embellish and make it any longer than it has to be." This all happened in Vvardenfell quite some time ago (said Hallgerd, ignoring Xiomara's interruption with admirable restraint) during an era of a king you would never have heard of. Arslic Oan was one of this king's nobles and very, very disagreeable fellow. Because of his allegiance to the crown, the king had felt the need to grant him a castle and land, but he didn't necessarily want him as a neighbor so the land he granted was far from civilization. Right in an area of Vvardenfell that is, even today, not quite civilized to this day. Arslic Oan built a walled stronghold and settled down with his unhappy slaves to enjoy a quiet if somewhat grim life. It was not long before his stronghold's integrity was tested. A tribe of cannibalistic Nords had been living in the valley for some time, mostly dining on one another, but occasionally foraging what they liked to call dark meat, the Dunmer. Xiomara laughed with appreciation. "Marvelous! I don't remember that from before. It's funny how you don't hear much about the Nords' rampant cannibalism nowadays." This was obviously, as I've said, quite some time ago (said Hallgerd, glaring at part of his audience with civil malevolence) and things were in many ways quite different. These cannibalistic Nords began attacking Arslic Oan's slaves in the fields, and then slowly grew bolder, until they held the very stronghold itself under siege. They were quite a fearsome sight you can imagine: a horde of wild-eyed men and women with dagger-like teeth filed to tear flesh, wielding massive clubs, cloaked only in the skins of their victims. Arslic Oan assumed that if he ignored them, they'd go away. Unfortunately, the first thing that the Nords did was to poison the stream that carried water into the walled stronghold. All the livestock and most of the slaves died very quickly before this was discovered. There was no hope of rescue, at least for several months when the king's emissaries would come reluctantly to visit the disagreeable vassal. The next closest source of water was on the other side of the hill, so Arslic Oan sent three of his slaves with empty jugs to bring some back. They were beaten with clubs and eaten before they were a few feet outside the stronghold gates. The next group he sent through he gave sticks to defend themselves. They made it a few feet farther, but were also overwhelmed, beaten, and devoured. It was obvious that better personal defensive was required. Arslic Oan went to talk to his armorer, one of his few slaves with specific talents and duties. "The slaves need armor if they're going to make it to the river and back," he said. "Collect every scrap of steel and iron you can find, every hinge, knife, ring, cup, everything that isn't needed to keep the walls sturdy, smelt it, and give me the most and the best armor you can, very, very quickly." The armorer, whose name was Gorkith, was used to Arslic Oan's demands, and knew that there could be no compromise on the quality and quantity of the armor, or the speed at which he worked. He labored for thirty hours without a break - and, recall, without any water to slake his thirst as he struggled with the kiln and anvil - until finally, he had six suits of mixed-metal armor. Six slaves were chosen, clad in the armor, and sent with jars to collect river water. At first, the mission progressed well. 我都说了，这是很久之前的事了（哈尔杰德继续讲，带着恶意瞪了一眼某位听众），世殊时异，很多事情都完全不同了。这些吃人的诺德人开始在野外攻击阿斯里克·奥安的奴隶，然后慢慢变得越发大胆，直到他们包围了要塞。你们可以想象那景象有多可怕：一群目露凶光，满口利齿的男男女女，挥舞着结实硕大的棍棒，披着受害者人皮的衣服蔽体。 阿斯里克·奥安觉得，如果他无视他们，他们早晚会散去的。 不幸的是，诺德人做的第一件事就是在流入要塞的河水里下毒。直到所有牲畜和大部分奴隶濒临死亡，才被发现。至少在几个月时间里，只有国王的使者不情不愿地来拜访这个不怎么令人愉快的附庸时，才有得到救援的希望。离这里最近的水源在山的另一边，所以阿斯里克·奥安派了三个奴隶拿着空水壶去取一些回来。 可他们没走出要塞大门几尺地，就被棍棒打翻带走吃掉了。他派出下一组人的时候，给他们配了棍子来保护自己。他们往前多走了几尺，但还是被打败吃掉了。显然，需要更好的防护。阿斯里克·奥安去和自己的护甲工匠谈话，那是他为数不多具有特殊才能和具体职责的奴隶之一。 他说：“奴隶们需要盔甲，这样才能走到河边并回来。把你能找到的所有碎钢都拢起来，铰链、刀子、戒指、杯子，只要不用来加固城墙，就都给我熔了，要快，尽快。” 护甲工匠高尔基斯已经习惯了阿斯里克·奥安的无礼要求，他知道不管是护甲的数量质量，还是工作效率，都是没法讨价还价的。他连续工作三十个小时没有休息，要知道他在窑炉和铁砧之间挣扎的时候是没有水可喝的，最后，他打造了六套混合金属制成的盔甲。 他们挑选了六个奴隶，身穿盔甲拿着罐子去河边打水。起初，任务进行得很顺利。诺德人用棍棒打这群奴隶，但奴隶们抵抗着殴打继续前进。然而，奴隶们逐渐走不动了，被无休止的殴击弄得头晕目眩。最后，他们一个个倒下，身上的盔甲被剥去，然后被吃掉了。 “你的盔甲太厚重了，奴隶们走不快。”阿斯里克·奥安对高尔基斯说。“你去收集所有中毒牲畜的尸体，剥去它们的皮，尽快地给我做出最多最好的皮甲。” 尽管考虑到牲畜腐烂的状况，这项任务十分恶心，但高尔基斯照他的吩咐去做了。通常情况下，处理和固化皮革需要相当长的时间，但高尔基斯不知疲倦地工作，在半天的时间里，他就做了十二套皮革盔甲。 十二名身着盔甲的奴隶被派去继续打水。起初，他们的进展比先前的探险队好得多。其中两个人几乎是立刻倒下，但其他几个人运气不错，躲开了大部分攻击。有几个人到了河边，三个人把罐子装满了，还有一个人差一点就回到了要塞的大门。唉，他摔倒了，被吃掉了。诺德人的胃口非常好。 “在我用光所有奴隶之前，我们需要什么？”阿斯里克·奥安若有所思地对高尔基斯说，“是比皮革坚硬，比金属轻盈的盔甲。” 护甲师已经考虑过这一点，并清点了可用的材料。他曾想过用石头或木头做点什么，拆除要塞部件会造成更大问题。其次最常见的是被剥皮的动物尸体、大块的肌肉、脂肪、血液和骨头。他不辞辛劳地工作了六个小时，终于制作出了十八套骨模护甲，这是有史以来第一批骨模护甲。阿斯里克·奥恩对这景象(和气味)有些怀疑，但他非常口渴，如果必要的话，他愿意再牺牲十八个奴隶。 高尔基斯颤抖地问道，“能让奴隶们穿着盔甲在院子里练习走动走动，然后再派他们去面对诺德人吗?” 阿斯里克·奥安冷静地答应了，奴隶们穿着骨模盔甲在要塞的院子里走了好几个小时。他们逐渐习惯了关节的弯曲、背后板的刚性以及肩膀和臀部承受的重量。他们发现了如何将脚稍微倾斜以保持平衡；如何快速转身但不会跌到；如何起跑并快速停止。当他们被送出要塞大门时，已经是使用中甲方面的业余选手了。 其中十七个被杀并被吃掉了，但有一个带着一罐水回来了。 “纯粹胡说八道。”肖玛拉说，“但就算如此，我的观点还是没错。你这故事里的护甲师也和我说的所有伟大发明家一样，勤勤恳恳地创造了骨模护甲。” “我觉得这里也有很多偶然因素，”加拉兹皱眉，“但这个故事太过骇人，真希望你没讲过。” “如果你觉得这就算可怕，”哈尔杰德咧嘴笑道，“那就该听听接下来发生了什么。”

original: Merilar's Journal
traduit: 梅莉拉的日记

original:
<font face='$HandwrittenFont'> <font size='17'>I know what he's planning.  Does he really think he can take all the credit for discovering these spiders?  Next time he goes into the safety cage to do whatever it is he does with those spiders, I'll lock the door. He'll have no choice but to listen to me then.

What does he mean about me not being right in the head?  There's nothing wrong with me.  He's the one trying to steal my discovery! Does he think I don't see what he's doing? There's nothing wrong with me. Nothing!
[pagebreak]
He keeps talking to me like I'm insane. I'm not insane! Who said I'm insane? Did I say I was insane? I'll show him insane!

It doesn't matter. He'll see what real power is. The chanting we heard just outside the main chamber must mean there's something extremely powerful there. If I can get my hands on that energy and bring it back, who knows what kind of discoveries we can make from it.
traduit:
<font face='$HandwrittenFont'> <font size='17'>我知道他在盘算什么。他真以为发现这些蜘蛛是自己的功劳了？下次他再进安全笼对付蜘蛛，我就把门锁上。那样他就别无选择，只能乖乖听我的了。

他说我脑子不正常？我能有什么事儿。明明是他想偷我的发现！他以为我不知道他在干什么？我什么事儿都没有。没有！
[pagebreak]
他一直跟我说话，好像我疯了一样。我没疯！谁说我疯了？我说过我疯了吗？我现在想让他疯！

没关系。他会明白什么叫真正的力量。我们在主厅外听到的吟唱一定意味着什么，那里有非常强大的东西。我要得到这种能量并带回来，谁知道我们能发现什么呢。

original: Servos' Journal
traduit: 瑟佛斯的日记

original:
<font face='$HandwrittenFont'> <font size='17'>She's finally done it. I knew she'd eventually crack. I probably should have left when I had the chance. The untapped power within these spiders has finally gone to Merilar's head. Who would have thought these tiny albino creatures had the ability to harness such magic?

Being locked in this cage is frustrating, of course, but it is keeping me even more focused on my work. What did she think I was going to do, anyway? As my sister, she must have known how devoted I am to this work. Although, I can't fault her for her actions right now. Who knows what kind of fumes these experiments have been giving off, or what effect they have on the human brain. At least I'm all right. Or maybe I'm not but I think I am? Could these experiments be having the same effect on me that they are on her?
[pagebreak]
Magnificent! It seems as though you can combine any one of the base spiders with a modifier to tweak its behavior. For instance, just imbuing an Albino Pod with a Ruby seems to create a spider that jumps at its victims and proceeds to explode. But, by simply adding a Salt Pile to the mix it creates the same manner of spider, but instead of jumping and exploding it emits flames from its body. I'd experiment with more of these behaviors, but it seems the bandits we tested the mind control spiders on are all still locked away, Merilar doesn't want me to let them out. Maybe there are too many in there for her to handle?

I heard her muttering to herself earlier today. She was saying things like, "The spiders are mine. They'll listen to me!" What exactly is she planning? I hope she's not attempting to enter the blocked off room in the main chamber. She knows we specifically sealed it after hearing odd chanting coming from that direction. Then again, what she used to "know" may not matter right now, considering the state she's been in. I hope she'll be all right.
traduit:
<font face='$HandwrittenFont'> <font size='17'>她还是走到这一步了。我知道她最后会崩溃的。也许我本该找机会离开。这些蜘蛛体内未开发的力量最终进入了梅莉拉的脑海。谁能想到区区白化蜘蛛竟有如此魔力？

被关在这笼子里确实令人懊丧，但也能更加专注于工作了。她会以为我要做什么呢？身为妹妹，她一定明白我对这份工作有多投入。不过我也不能责怪她现在的行为。谁知道这些实验释放了什么气体，又会对人脑有什么影响。至少我没事。也许已经有事了，但我自己还没觉得？这些实验对我的效果和对她一样吗？
[pagebreak]
太棒了！看来可以将任意的基底蜘蛛进行更改，以调整其行动模式。比如，在白化卵囊中植入红宝石似乎能创造一种跳向目标并爆炸的蜘蛛。通过简单地在混合中加入盐堆，则创建了相同形态却不会跳跃爆炸的蜘蛛，反而从身体中发射出火焰。我还想尝试更多办法，但我们用来测试精神控制蜘蛛的强盗都还被锁着，梅莉拉不想让我把他们放出来。也许是里面东西太多她处理不了？

今天早些时候，我听见她自言自语。她说：“蜘蛛是我的。它们会听我的！”她到底在计划什么？希望她没有打算进入主室的封闭房间。她明白，我们在听到那个方向传来奇怪吟唱后特意把它封了起来。话又说回来，考虑到她现在的状态，她过去“明白”的东西现在可能并不重要了。希望她没事。

original: Ildari's Journal, vol. III
traduit: 伊达利的日记·卷3

original:
<font face='$HandwrittenFont'><font size='18'>
These warrens are well suited to me. I can plot my vengeance undisturbed. I've created many ash spawn and summoned atronachs to do my bidding. Yet I know it isn't enough. Neloth is a wily old wizard. I need more power.

I'm out of test subjects, except for Niyya. I saved her for last. She pretended to be my friend when I first came here. But now I know the truth. The voices have told me all about her lies and betrayal. She works with Neloth to bring me down. I've saved a special experiment just for her. It will take quite a while to complete.

I can't attack Neloth directly, he's too powerful. But I can make his life uncomfortable. I've killed his steward. I've withered his home. Maybe I should poison his precious tea. I'll need a more capable servant for that. The ash spawn are too clumsy for such delicate work.
traduit:
<font face='$HandwrittenFont'><font size='18'>
这里很适合我。可以不受干扰地组织复仇计划了。我制造了许多灰烬怪，召唤了侍灵来执行命令。但这还远远不够。内洛斯是个老奸巨猾的巫师。我需要更多力量。

除了妮雅以外，已经没有研究对象了。我把她留到了最后。刚来的时候，她假装是我的朋友。但现在我知道真相了。那些声音告知我她的谎言与背叛。她打算和内洛斯一起搞垮我。我给她留了个特别的实验，要花一段时间才能完成。

我不能直接攻击内洛斯，他实在太强了。但我可以让他过得不舒服。我杀了他管家，毁了他的家。也许还可以在他的宝贝茶里下毒。我需要更得力的仆从。灰烬怪太笨拙了，做不来这么精细的活儿。

original: Ildari's Journal, vol. II
traduit: 伊达利的日记·卷2

original:
<font face='$HandwrittenFont'><font size='18'>
I am stronger now. The heart stone kept me alive after Neloth's butchery. I can feel the bones in the ash calling to me. I can call back to them too. With the heart stone I can bind the spirits to bone and ash and raise a servant to do my bidding.

Tonight I will seize control. These miners and fortune seekers are pawns of Neloth. I can feel them staring at me. I'm sure they are sending him messages, reporting on my every move. The only ones I can trust are the voices. They've never lied to me. They've shown me that these fools plan to betray me, just like Neloth.

When they are all asleep, I will raise my ash spawn. Their brute of a leader will die first. I can see the lust in his heart. He may act all kind and generous, but I know what he wants, what they all want. They want the heart stone.

I'll keep a few prisoners. I need test subjects for my experiments. There is more that the heart stone can do. I just need to try out a few ideas.
traduit:
<font face='$HandwrittenFont'><font size='18'>
我现在更强了。心石让我在内洛斯的杀戮下活了下来。我能感受到灰烬中的骸骨在呼唤我。我也要回应他们。有了这颗心石，我就能把精魂束缚在骨与灰烬中，还能让奴仆听我号令。

今晚我将掌握控制权。这些矿工和寻宝者都是内洛斯的爪牙。我能感觉到他们正在盯着我。他们肯定会给他报信，监视我的一举一动。我唯一能相信的就是那些声音。它们从不骗我。它们让我知道了这些傻子打算和内洛斯一样背叛我。

等他们都睡着，我唤醒了我的灰烬怪。他们的野蛮头子会第一个死。我能看得到他内心的欲望。他可能表现得很善良慷慨，但我知道他想要什么，他们都想要什么。他们都想要心石。

我要留几个俘虏做实验。心石还能做更多事。我需要尝试一些想法。

original: Ildari's Journal, vol. I
traduit: 伊达利的日记·卷1

original:
<font face='$HandwrittenFont'><font size='18'>
The fools have taken me in. Weak, pathetic men intent on looting this ancient fortress with their crude mining. Niyya is pleasant enough. I may choose to spare her when the time comes.

I'm still weak from Neloth's betrayal. He promised me power and glory. He failed to mention the constant pain. And the voices. By the three, I would do anything to not hear the voices.

When my strength returns, I will have my vengeance upon my former master. I can feel the power of the heart stone beating inside me. I need to find a way to tap into its power. Then he shall pay in blood and fire and ash.
traduit:
<font face='$HandwrittenFont'><font size='18'>
那些傻子骗了我。虚弱可怜的人们打算用他们的粗略的挖掘来掠夺这座古老城堡。妮雅很讨人喜欢。到时候我可能会留她一命。

内洛斯的背叛使我虚弱。他许给我力量与荣耀，却没有提到这持续的疼痛。还有那些声音。三神在上，我愿意做任何事来让自己听不见那些声音。

等我回复力量，我要向前导师报仇。我能够感受到心石在我体内跳动的力量。我得想办法利用起来。那样他就要付出血与火与灰烬的代价了。

original: Journal of a Madman
traduit: 疯子的日记

original:
<font face="$HandwrittenFont">
They said it was impossible. They, not me. I knew! The book knew. It knows all. And I know all. All I need to know. To fly! They laughed. The others were afraid. Don't even try, they said. They said it was impossible. They, not me. The book is filled with knowledge. The book fills me. With knowledge. Secret hidden knowledge. My knowledge. I must hide the knowledge. Hide it away deep inside. I will eat the book. A page at a time. Slowly. Slowly. I will become one with the knowledge contained on its pages. In its pages. In me! The knowledge of flight. They said it was impossible. Ha!
traduit:
<font face="$HandwrittenFont">
他们都说不可能。是他们，不是我。我明白！这书上也是这么写的！它写的，我都知道。我现在需要知道。飞！他们笑。还有人害怕。他们连试试都不敢。他们都说不可能。是他们，不是我。这书里都是知识。这本书已经把我装满了。我有知识了。秘密就藏在知识里。是我的知识。我必须把知识藏起来。藏得要多深有多深。我把书吃掉。一次吃一页。慢。慢慢的。我就和知识融为一体了。就在这页上。在我身体里！有飞翔的知识。他们都说不可能。哈！

original: Mireli's Letter to Mother
traduit: 米瑞莉致母亲的信

original:
<font face="$HandwrittenBold" size="19">
Mother,

I understand your worries, but there's really nothing that should frighten you that much. The first crew working here was a bunch of idiots and milk-drinkers who didn't know how to watch their own backs. We might run into some trouble, but I've handled trouble before. 

The one who hired us, Ralis, is a bit of an odd one. I'm keeping my eye on him, though, so don't add that to your fretting. We'll be fine. We'll all be fine. Just worry about you and father, and let me worry about myself. 

We'll talk when I'm home. There should be money enclosed with this, and if it's missing you should take it out of the courier's hide. 

Yours,
Mireli
</font>
traduit:
<font face="$HandwrittenFont" size="19">
妈：

我知道你很担心，但真没什么好怕的。第一批在这里干活儿的人就是群白痴和懦夫，完全不懂得怎么保护自己。我们可能会遇到点麻烦，但以前又不是没处理过。

雇我们的那个拉里斯是有点怪怪的。不过我会小心他的，所以别再发愁了。我们没事儿。我们肯定都没事儿。你还是操心操心你和我爸吧，我自己能照顾好自己。

等我回家咱们再聊吧。信里带着钱，要是钱不见了，别忘了让送信的拿出来。

你女儿，
米瑞莉
</font>

original: Letter to Imperial City
traduit: 致帝都的信

original:
<font face="$HandwrittenFont" size="18">
This is the third letter I am attempting to send to the Imperial Council in Cyrodiil for guidance in the matter surrounding the threat to Fort Frostmoth. 

A sizable dark elf force has established a stronghold on the southwestern portion of Solstheim. I've given them ample opportunity to surrender, but all attempts to communicate with them have met with conflict.

I will continue to do whatever's necessary to ensure the safety of Fort Frostmoth and rid Solstheim of these invaders until I receive orders stating otherwise.

General Falx Carius
Garrison Commander, Fort Frostmoth 
</font>
traduit:
<font face="$HandwrittenFont" size="18">
这是我试图寄给希罗帝尔帝国议会的第三封信，以征求对霜蛾堡周边威胁的指示。

一支庞大的暗精灵部队在索瑟海姆西南部建立了要塞。我给了他们足够的投降机会，但所有沟通尝试均以冲突告终。

在新的命令到来前，我将继续采取所有必要措施，确保霜蛾堡的安全，并铲除来到索瑟海姆的入侵者。

霜蛾堡指挥官
法克斯·卡里乌斯将军
</font>

original: Ildari's Journal
traduit: 伊达利的日记

original:
<font face="$HandwrittenFont">
Day 32
It's been almost a month since unearthing the crypt at Fort Frostmoth, and I haven't seen a single spark of life in the general's remains. Grafting the heartstone to the subject is proving much more difficult than I originally anticipated. I've used almost every method I can think of, and still there's no sign of reanimation. At this rate, it could be years before I make any progress... which is time that I just can't afford right now. If my vengeance is to come to fruition, I need results. If not, I may need to resort to more drastic measures.

Day 47
It finally appears that I'm making some progress. After my latest experiment, General Carius's eyes briefly opened and he moved his arms. It lasted for less than a few moments, but it's the first sign of progress I've seen since I arrived here. A few of my assistants were insisting that I was imagining things, but I dismissed them for their insolence. They won't be bothering anyone ever again.

Day 55
General Carius awoke fully today. He bolted upright after my incantations and began staggering around like a blind man. He seemed to ignore my commands... in fact, hearing my voice seemed to increase his hostility. I was able to remove the heartstone before he became violent, but this isn't a result that I expected. Even though he's able to be awakened, I feel as though the real work has just begun.

Day 59
The general is still unable or unwilling to listen to my commands. He's acting increasingly paranoid, and appears to have his own free will. He's convinced that I am a "spy" or the "enemy," and I've had to restrain him to prevent him from outright attacking me. This is becoming intolerable. I'm beginning to wonder if someone with a heartstone can be commanded at all. If my experiments with General Carius fail, I may have to resort to self-experimentation... something I've been avoiding for a long time.
</font>
traduit:
<font face="$HandwrittenFont">
第32天
从霜蛾堡的墓穴里把将军的尸体挖出来已经快一个月了，还是没有看到一丝生命的火花。事实证明，把心石移植到实验对象上比我预期的要困难得多。我几乎用上了能想到的一切办法，但还是看不到复活迹象。照这样下去，可能需要很多年才能有所进展……可我负担不起。如果想要复仇，就必须成功。如果还是没有结果，那就需要更激烈的措施了。

第47天
看来终于有进展了。在最新的实验里，卡里乌斯将军短暂地睁开了眼睛，手臂也动了动。虽然持续不到几分钟，但这是我到此之后看到的第一个进步迹象。我的几个助手坚持认为是我胡思乱想，我因他们傲慢无礼把他们都打发了。他们再也打扰不了我了。

第55天
卡里乌斯将军今天完全苏醒。我念完咒语，他猛地起身，像个盲人一样摇摇晃晃走来走去。他好像无视了我的命令。甚至听到我的声音还会增加他的敌意。我在他变得暴力前移除了他的心石，但这不是我想要的结果。尽管已经能够唤醒他了，但我觉得真正的工作才刚刚开始。

第59天
将军仍不能或不愿听我号令。他表现得越来越偏执，似乎有了自己的自由意志。他确信我是“间谍”或“敌人”，我不得不制止他，以防遭到攻击。事情开始变得无法容忍。我开始怀疑有心石的人还能不能被操纵。如果卡里乌斯将军的实验失败，我可能不得不采取那个我逃避许久的方案……拿自己实验。
</font>

original:
<font face="$HandwrittenFont">
Dear Wulf,

I'm writing to you now as I already feel my mind going. I fear that soon I will not be able to write at all. I came to the wilderness to better know the All-Maker. But in the wilds I found a force greater than any we've known. 

It is seductive, this power I've been granted. I know you would not approve, so I don't dare show my face to you. But know that I realized the greatest potential of my strength before the last. 

I hope to one day meet you before the All-Maker, brother. 

    - Torkild
</font>
traduit:
<font face="$HandwrittenFont">
亲爱的沃弗：

我现在给你写信，因为我已经能感到思维不济了。恐怕很快我就无法写字了。我到荒野里，希望能够更好地了解造物主。但我在野外发现了一种前所未有的力量。

太诱人了，我被赋予的力量太诱人了。我知道你不会同意，所以我不敢在你面前露面。但你要知道，我在最后一刻到来前发现了自己最大的潜能。

希望有一天，在造物主面前与你相见，兄弟。

--托基尔德
</font>

original: Saden's Journal
traduit: 赛丹的日记

original:
<font face='$HandwrittenFont'>
If you're reading this, run. Get back in your boat and row as far and as fast as you can. There is no safe harbor here, there is no treasure worth the horror that awaits you. It's a miracle you aren't dead already.

Haldyn sent us from Japhet's Folly out into the sea, looking for hidden islands and forgotten coves. He said we needed outposts all around Tamriel to hide all the treasure we're soon to pillage. I say he's mad. A fresh group like us has more immediate concerns than outposts. We don't even have a name yet.

But I kept my mouth shut, my head down, and did what I was told. I wish to the Nine that I'd have said something...

This island looked so peaceful, so remote. Seemed like a good place for an outpost.  Bjord and I stayed behind while the others scouted about. It wasn't long before we heard the screams. We peered over the rocks and I can't even describe what we saw, although I'll never forget it. The blood. Gods, the blood...

What those monsters did brought out the coward in Bjord.  All it did to me was raise a fire in my chest, a hate in my gut so strong I can almost feel it coursing into the mace in my hand. I told Bjord to run, to tell the others never to come here. I stayed to write out this warning to anyone unlucky enough to land on this rock.

Now that I've done that duty, there's only one thing left. I'm going to kill as many of those things as I can. I'm even going to try for the big one.

Maybe I'll do it. Maybe I'll kill every one of them. Maybe you've found this rock abandoned and safe. I doubt it...
</font>
traduit:
<font face='$HandwrittenFont'>
如果你读到这东西，快跑。回你自己的船上去能跑多快跑多快。这里不是避风港，也没有什么你值得忍受的恐惧。你到现在还没死真是个奇迹。

哈尔丁派我们从贾菲特之愚出海，寻找隐秘的海岛和洞窟。他说我们需要在泰姆瑞尔周围各处设立哨站来藏匿我们抢来的财宝。要我说他就是疯了。像我们这样的新组织有比哨站更紧迫的问题。我们到现在还没起名字呢。

但我还是闭了嘴低了头，按吩咐照办了。九圣灵在上，我真该说些什么的……

这个岛看起来够平静，也够偏僻。应该是设哨站的好地方。布约尔德和我殿后，其他人则出去侦察四周。我们在石头后面盯着，我真没法形容看到了什么，但我永远也忘不了。血。天呐，全是血……

那些怪物的所作所为让布约尔德的懦弱暴露了。但我只是感觉怒火中烧，内心的仇恨激荡，我甚至能感觉到它在我的钉锤上流动。我告诉布约尔德赶快跑，去告诉其他人不要到这里来。我要留下来写下这篇警告，提醒那些不幸来到这块石头的人。

现在既然我事情办完了，就剩下一件事了。我要尽我所能多杀点怪物。我甚至想试试那头大个儿的。

也许我能杀几个。也许我能把他们都宰了，然后你发现这块被遗弃的石头很安全。但我没什么把握……
</font>

original: Gratian's Journal
traduit: 格瑞希安的日记

original:
30 Rain's Hand 4E10 Received a letter from the East Empire Company today. They say that some of the miners broke through the wall in shaft three of Raven Rock Mine and found some ruins. I hope this isn't another waste of time like that fiasco they sent me to in Cyrodiil. I'll gather my assistant, Millius and sail back to Raven Rock at first light... it'll be nice to see the old house in Solstheim again. 7 Second Seed 4E10 Finally arrived in Raven Rock and was surprised at the number of dark elf refugees living in town. They aren't really from mining stock, but I think they'll make fine workers one day. Millius and I spent a good part of the day clearing the ash off of the roof of my house. The damn volcano is still erupting almost day and night. If it wasn't for the ash covering everything it would almost look beautiful. 8 Second Seed 4E10 Millius and I are headed into Raven Rock Mine to have look at whatever it is the miners uncovered. I think I'll stop by the old Swing and Scoop and pick up a few supplies before we head down. Couldn't hurt to be prepared. 9 Second Seed 4E10 Looks like the miners broke right through the wall of an old Nordic barrow. I've seen this sort of thing in Skyrim before... damn Nords have barrows dotting the landscape and almost none of them are ever marked on any maps. Looks like this barrow belong to something called the "Bloodskal Clan." I'm going to take some rubbings of the inscriptions on the tombs and see if I can't learn some more information from my history books. 10 Second Seed 4E10 It's been a few days and I can't find even a single mention of this clan anywhere. Millius and I decided to proceed ahead. We've come to a dropdown point, but I can see a massive chamber below. Took the better part of a day to lower everything down and climb down the almost sheer drop. 11 Second Seed 4E10 It's been an astonishing day of discovery! After exploring the large chamber beyond the dropoff, I was startled to find the strangest weapon I've ever laid eyes upon sitting on a pedestal of sorts. The blade appears to be flawless, and is emitting a faint chilling glow. Bits of parchment I found about the chamber seem to call this "The Bloodskal Blade." Not certain if I should remove it yet, I think I'll sleep on it.

12 Second Seed 4E10 I've decided against my own better judgment to remove the Bloodskal Blade from its pedestal. Millius seems completely against it, but we need to bring this wondrous artifact with us when we find a way out of the barrow. 13 Second Seed 4E10 I should have listened to Millius. The moment the blade was lifted, we were set upon by draugr. Millius fought bravely, but he fell. I was able to destroy the remaining ones, but I was badly wounded. I can barely stand. My only chance would be finding a way out of this place, but I fear that I'm trapped. 14? Second Seed 4E10 Exploring has been slow. I can only move for maybe a few minutes at a time before I have to rest. My supplies are running low, and I'm feeling weaker by the hour. The only progress I've made is finding a strange door with markings on it that I've never seen. There appears to be something to them I'm missing, as they've confounded my attempts at getting through. I'll have to study this further in order to make any progress... barely can keep awake. I'm fairly certain that the key to the door involves the use of the Bloodskal Blade. When swinging the weapon, I'm noticing a ribbon of mystical energy emanating from it. I think by swinging the sword in different directions, it's possible to manipulate this ribbon and solve whatever puzzle this door presents. I hope to get well enough to put this to the test soon... each swing is a huge effort. Last entry I've lost track of time and my strength is fading. I can't even stand anymore. My wounds refuse to heal. I'm afraid this tomb will become my resting place. If anyone finds this journal, please send these notes to my superiors at the East Empire Company and tell my wife that I love her. May Arkay guide me to my final rest.
traduit:
4E 10年，雨手月30日 今天收到了东帝国公司的来信。他们说有些矿工破开了鸦石镇矿场3号井的岩壁，发现了一些遗迹，希望这次别像他们送我去希罗帝尔那次一样成了浪费时间的闹剧。我召回了助手米利乌斯，天一亮就坐上了回鸦石镇的船……又能回索瑟海姆的老家了，真好。 4E 10年，次种月7日 终于到了鸦石镇，没想到镇上居然有这么多暗精灵难民。虽然他们不是矿工出身，但我认为他们总会成为好工人的。米利乌斯和我花了大半天时间清理房顶上的积灰，该死的火山几乎日夜不停地在喷，要不是搞得到处都是灰，那它还有点顺眼。 4E 10年，次种月8日 米利乌斯和我正前往鸦石镇矿场看看矿工们的发现。我认为在出发前应该先去一趟“挥铲挖土”买些补给。万无一失么。 4E 10年，次种月9日 看来矿工们正好挖穿了一座诺德古坟的墙壁，以前我在天际见过这种地方……该死的诺德人到处修坟，而且几乎从未有过任何地图记载。这座古坟似乎属于一个叫“血颅”的氏族。我要带些墓志铭的拓片，看看能不能从历史书上找到更多资料。 4E 10年，次种月10日 几天过去了，找不到任何有关这个氏族的资料，米利乌斯和我决定继续前进。我们来到了一处悬崖边，但下面有一个巨大的墓室。我们花了大半天放下所有东西，从几乎垂直的岩壁爬了下去。 4E 10年，次种月11日 今天有了大发现！在搜索过岩壁下的大型墓室后，我在一个台座上见到了一把前所未见的奇异武器。剑身无瑕，微泛寒光。墓室中的羊皮纸碎片似乎称它为“血颅刃”。我不确定该不该把它拿走，得好好考虑下。

4E 10年，次种月12日 明知不妥，我还是决定将血颅刃从台座上取下。米利乌斯对此强烈反对，但我们必须带上这件古怪的神器，等找到出去的路时一起带走。 4E 10年，次种月13日 我是该听米利乌斯的，刚拔起剑我们就被尸鬼袭击了。米利乌斯勇敢地战斗，但还是倒下了。我消灭了剩下的尸鬼，也受了重伤，几乎站不起来。唯一的办法就是找到出口，但恐怕我是被困住了。 4E 10年，次种月14日？ 探索进展缓慢，每次走动几分钟后我就必须休息。补给即将用完，我感到越发虚弱。唯一的进展是找到了一扇门，上面有些没见过的奇怪印记。 这些印记里似乎有什么玄机，试了各种法子就是打不开门。我得再仔细研究才能有进展……很难保持清醒。 我很确信这扇门的钥匙与运用血颅刃有关。挥舞这把武器时，我注意到了它发出的神秘能量波。朝不同方向挥剑，就有可能控制能量波解决这门留下的谜题。希望我的伤势好到能尝试一下……每次挥剑都很费力。 最后的记录 已经分不清时间了，体力逐渐地消退，我再也站不起来了。伤口无法愈合，怕是要葬身于此了。如果有人发现了这本日记，请把这些记录寄给我在东帝国公司的上司，并告诉我妻子我爱她。 愿阿尔凯指引我安息。

original:
[pagebreak]

Wind and Sand Afa-Saryat

[pagebreak] [pagebreak]

Let the wind blow. Let the sand scour. Let the magic of air and sand be free to roam the Alik'r. From the mystic membranes that stand between the two, absorb and convey unto me and all who may understand the deep essential powers of the desert. [pagebreak] eserts are often considered to be useless wastelands, avoided by the casual traveler and shunned by the softer species as unfit for civilization. But to those who bother to investigate, to dwell, to live, to linger in these spaces, a driving hardiness develops that serves them well in all environs should they ever choose to live. A thoughtfulness born of care -- for who knows best how to best invest their resources than one who has had to walk half a morning and labor for an hour to extract a few drops of water from an unyielding plant? This same sort of requisite thrift applies to all other creatures who wring their living in such a land. The insight that may at first be missed, though, is that the magic of this land is similarly affected. Forgoing the showy lights and sounds of the forest dwelling mages in Summerset, the flamboyant gesticulations of the Bretons, or even the bellowing of the Nords, there is a certain economy to the casting of a true Alik'r wizard. This is not meant as a slight against other magical styles, only noting that such energies might be better focused into reflection and purpose. [pagebreak] On Sand When both foreigners and natives imagine the desert, often their first image is one of orange-hued sand blowing beneath a dark blue sky. Indeed, this is not wholly incorrect, as the shifting sands are one of the key components not only of the desert, but of its natural magics. Consider: sand is nothing but the weathering of rocks, older by far than any of the living inhabitants who claim a land as "theirs." As each rock breaks further, more of its inner space is revealed, until it is practically naught but exposed surface in its aggregate self. This collective then scatters, intermingles, scatters, and repeats, in infinite combinations so long as Nirn continues to exist. If we believe, as I do, that the rocks themselves contain remnants of Magnus's gift, than this exposure and combinatorial explosion results in a breadth and diversity of magic energy as is unknown elsewhere in Tamriel. [pagebreak] On Air Much as the sand learns from every grain around it, so too does the air which conveys it from one combination to the other absorb the sense knowledge of its carried grains. In fact, it is plausible that the air itself is guiding the combinations to novelty and expression. Indeed, consider that in the Nordic tradition, Kyne is the widow of Shor (an aspect of Lorkhan), then her ministrations (via wind) to his physical legacy within Mundus could be seen as a form of celestial mourning, from which we mortals can benefit. It would seem, indeed, that the next level of magical awakening may well be driven by scrying appropriate wind channels to carve novel paths through the vast desert such as to further diversify the land's memory. Reading the knowledge of the sands, though, is an immense task in itself, though, more fit to an army of clerical workers than a wizard of any standing.
traduit:
[pagebreak]

风与沙 阿法-萨亚特

[pagebreak] [pagebreak]

让风吹拂吧。让沙冲刷吧。让空气与沙子的魔力自由地漫游在阿里克'尔吧。从介乎于二者的神秘薄膜中，吸收并传达给我和所有可能了解沙漠深层本质力量之人吧。 [pagebreak] 沙漠通常被视为无用的荒地，一般旅行者都会避之不及，就连那些温和的物种也会避开，认为它并不适合文明。但对那些不厌其烦地调查、居住、生活、逗留其间者来说，一旦他们选择了生存，那么就会展现出一种坚毅的动力，在任何环境中都能很好地服务于他们。那是一种自谨慎中诞生的思考力，试问，谁能比一个为了从一株顽强的植物中提取几滴水而不得不走半个上午、劳动一个小时的人更懂得如何最好地投资他们的资源呢? 同样的节俭也适用于其他所有在这样土地上生活的生物。然而，人们一开始可能会忽略的一点是，这片土地的魔力也受到了类似的影响。抛开夏暮岛法师们发出的炫光艳声，也不必理会布莱顿人浮夸的手势，更不用去听闻诺德人的咆哮，一个真正的阿里克'尔巫师是最懂得创造经济价值的。这并不意味着对其他魔法风格的轻视，只是我们更注重把能量更好地集中在反射与目标上。 [pagebreak] 论沙 无论本地人还是异邦人，他们想起沙漠的第一印象往往是湛蓝天空下橙色的沙子。当然，这样想不是没有道理，因为流沙不仅是沙漠的关键组成部分，更是它的自然魔法。 试想，沙子不过是岩石风化的产物，比任何一个活在这片土地且声称自己“拥有”土地者还要古老得多。随着每一块岩石的进一步断裂，其内部的空间会更多地显露出来，直到它消散到只剩一个裸露的表面。只要奈恩继续存在，这种过程就会以无限的组合分散、混合、分散，循环往复。如果我们都能如我一样相信，岩石本身蕴含玛格努斯馈赠的残余，那么这暴露与组合的爆炸会导致泰姆瑞尔其他地方所未知的魔力广度与多样性。 [pagebreak] 论空气 就像沙子会从周围每一粒沙中学习一样，将沙子从一种组合转换成另一种组合的空气也吸收了沙子的感知知识。事实上，空气本身似乎就在引导组合走向新颖与表达。考虑到诺德传统中，凯娜是舒尔的遗孀（洛克汗的另一个法相），那么她（通过风）维护着梦达思中的他的身体遗产也可以视为一种天国的哀悼，而我们凡人则从中受益。 所以看来，通过寻找适合的风道，在广阔的沙漠中开辟新的道路，从而进一步丰富这片土地记忆，很可能会是推动魔法觉醒的下个阶段。然而，阅读沙之知识本身就是一项浩大的任务，比起养尊处优的巫师，或许更适合那些文员小吏。

I knew if we dug deep enough we'd eventually hit some fresh ruins. Markarth, a city built upon a city. From early pieces recovered we've determined the name of the city is Nchuand-Zel, but past that we have very little info. We've been given an escort though and tomorrow we will delve into the city proper.

* * * * *


It's only been a day and I already miss my desk and chair. I thought it would be a little more fun to explore, but so far it's just been fighting spiders and getting to view an occasional rubble pile. Hopefully we get to the main ruin soon so we can set up a camp and I can start cataloguing some of the items I've been able to find.

* * * * *


We found the Armory earlier and Erj has stayed behind to find a way into the main vault. If anyone can open the locks it's him. We've kept going and settled up here for the night since the guards say it will be easy to defend. I've put up a few runes just in case.
traduit:
我知道，如果我们挖得够深，最后会挖到新的遗迹。马卡斯是城中之城。从早期发现的碎片里，我们确定了这座城市的名字叫尼楚安德-泽尔，但过去的信息太少了。我们已经被护送到了现场，明天我们将深入城区。

* * * * *


才过了一天，我就开始怀念我的桌椅了。我本以为探索会更有趣，但到现在，我只是在和蜘蛛战斗，偶尔看看碎石头。希望我们能赶紧到主遗迹区，这样我们就能搭个帐篷，我也能开始整理我找到的东西了。

* * * * *


我们之前找到了军械库，厄基留下来想办法进到主保险库去。如果有人能把锁打开，那就是他了。我们继续前进，选择在这儿过夜，因为护卫说这里容易防守。我写了一些符文以防万一。

This excavation is going to be one of the harder ones, I can tell. Hired some diggers out of Raven Rock. They all said they were experienced miners, but I guess they're not used to running into trouble as they dig. In a place like this, you never know what was buried long ago, and have to be ready for whatever you come across. 

In any case, there were some unfortunate losses when the sleeping dead weren't quite sleeping and weren't quite dead. Operation is stalled unless my friendly partner is able to find enough coin for us to hire some replacements. Maybe it's time to take up a collection from the constant spectators who gather to mock me.

我敢说，这次会是最难挖的一次。从鸦石镇招了些挖掘工人，他们都说自己是经验丰富的矿工，但我猜他们不习惯在挖土时遭遇麻烦。在这种地方，你永远都不知道很久以前埋了些什么，无论遇到什么都必须做好准备。

总之，沉睡的亡灵并没完全入睡也没死透，不幸造成了些损失。除非我那友善的合伙人能有足够的钱让我们另外雇些人，否则项目就会停摆。可能该向那些聚在一堆嘲笑我的看客们募捐了。

Moving on to Solstheim next, chasing after vague rumors of this Kolbjorn Barrow. My patron seems confident we can find the Relics of Ahzidal out here. I'm a bit skeptical, but so long as he pays well, I'll dig wherever the old coot likes. 

Initial prospects look poor, to say the least. I was sure I had my map wrong at first, until it became clear that the place had just been lost to the ash. I'll dig out as much as I can, maybe see if I can recruit some of the local residents to help me out. 拉里斯·瑟达瑞斯的日记·卷19

接下来是索瑟海姆，追查关于这个寇泊琼古坟的模糊传闻。我的金主好像很有把握能在这儿找到阿兹达尔的遗物。我有些怀疑，但只要这老傻瓜付得起钱，要我去哪儿挖都行。

至少可以确定，最初的前景并不乐观。一开始我以为地图是错的，直到后来发现这地方刚被火山灰埋了。我会尽可能发掘，或许可以看看能不能招些当地居民来帮忙。从鸦石镇出来后就没见过人影，但我一直能听到附近的交谈和低语，只要找到他们就行了。

original:
I've only tried a few combinations, but things look promising. Here's what I've discovered so far:

Ruby + Albino Pod =

Jumping Flame Spider

Ruby + Damaged Pod =

Exploding Flame Spider

Ruby + Salt Pile + Damaged Pod =

4 3

Flame Cloaked Spider

[pagebreak] Looking at the results, it seems as though the purity of the gem could enhance the imbuing process in some unforeseen way. Perhaps if I could get my hands on a Flawless Ruby... I have also theorized that if one were to mix most any of the ingredients in the previous experiments a new discovery is likely to be made. Upon further inspection of both a diamond and a garnet it seems they don't contain the necessary power required. I know for a fact that a ruby works, as seen in my previous experiments. Next I'll see how the reaction works with an amethyst, emerald, or even a sapphire. There must be other types of spiders out there. Who knows what other kinds of imbuing processes have taken place. We'd best keep our eyes open. The source of the interaction will most likely be nearby, whatever new species we find.

[pagebreak] 从结果看，宝石的纯度似乎能以某种不可预见的方式增强注入过程。也许我该去找颗无瑕红宝石来。 我觉得理论上，如果把先前实验中的大部分材料都混合起来，可能会有新发现。 进一步观察钻石和石榴石发现，它们并不蕴含所需的能量。从之前的实验，我已经确定了红宝石的作用。接下来，我需要看看紫水晶、绿宝石和蓝宝石是如何反应的。 肯定还有其他类型的蜘蛛。还不知道会发生什么其他类型的灌输过程。我们得睁大眼睛好好看着。无论发现了什么新类型，相互作用的源头很可能就要显现了。

original: I am not your champion, monster.
traduit: 我不是你的勇士，怪物。

original: Who do you think brought Septimus here? Who do you think protected you on your journey to open the box and loose my knowledge on this world?
traduit: 你以为是谁引导赛普蒂莫斯至此？你以为是谁在你打开盒子、把我之知识泄露于世的旅途中庇护了你？

original: Your free will is an illusion. Whether you acknowledge me or not is your own business. But I will be in your mind.
traduit: 你的自由意志不过是幻觉。认不认我是你的事，但我会深刻在你的脑海里。

original: An Amulet of Mara? I haven't seen such a thing in a very long time.
traduit: 玛拉护符？我已经很久没见过这东西了。

original: You go ahead and arrange the wedding ceremony when you're ready.
traduit: 准备好的话就去安排婚礼吧。

original: You've embarrassed the temple and spat in the face of love. What do you want?
traduit: 你让神殿蒙羞，还侮辱了爱情。你还想干什么？

original: Is that an Amulet of Mara? I'm surprised someone like you isn't spoken for.
traduit: 那是玛拉护符吗？你这样的人居然还没对象，太令人惊讶了。

original: An Amulet of Mara? You're not married? Surprising.
traduit: 玛拉护符？你还没结婚吗？令人惊讶啊。

original: That amulet. I've seen the Nords wear these when they're looking to marry. With your strength, you should have no trouble.
traduit: 那个护符。我看见诺德人求偶的时候会带着。凭你的力量应该不难吧。

original: Is that Lady Mara's amulet? I'm shocked a fine person like you isn't married already.
traduit: 那不是玛拉女神的护符吗？你这样的好人居然还没有结婚吗。

original: You're wearing Mara's amulet? You? I'd marry you. I'd marry you twice.
traduit: 你居然带着玛拉护符？你吗？我来和你结，两次都可以。

original: Look at you. Wearing an Amulet of Mara. Are you saying you're available?
traduit: 看看你。居然带着玛拉护符。你是说你还单身吗？

original: An Amulet of Mara, you're looking for marriage, then?
traduit: 玛拉护符，你是在求婚吗？

original: You should arrange the ceremony at the Temple of Mara right away. I can't wait.
traduit: 你应该赶快到玛拉神殿安排婚礼。我都等不及了。

original: Have you spoken to the Temple of Mara, yet? I'm so excited.
traduit: 你跟玛拉神殿谈过了？我真兴奋啊。

original: You should speak to the priest in the Temple of Mara to arrange the ceremony. No sense waiting.
traduit: 你应该赶快和玛拉神殿的祭司去商量安排婚礼。别傻等着了。

original: I'll see you at our wedding!
traduit: 咱们在婚礼上见！

original: Hey, shouldn't you tell the Temple of Mara that we're getting married? Be hard to have a wedding without a priest.
traduit: 嘿，你难道不该去和玛拉神殿知会一声咱们要结婚了吗？没有祭司可办不成婚礼啊。

original: Now shouldn't you be off arranging our wedding day? Don't keep me waiting.
traduit: 你不是该去安排我们的婚礼了吗？别让我等太久了。

original: You should tell the priest we're getting married. They'll take things from there.
traduit: 你应该去和祭司谈谈咱们结婚的事。他们会帮忙的。

original: Never thought I'd get married under a Nord god. But with you, it feels right.
traduit: 从没想过我会在一个诺德神灵的注视下结婚。但只要是你，就没关系。

original: Our wedding is soon. I'll see you then!
traduit: 我们的婚礼要开始了。一会儿见！

original: We have our wedding soon, don't we? That's right, we do!
traduit: 我们的婚礼就要开始了，对吧？没错，就要开始了！

original: Our wedding is soon, under Mara's loving eyes. It'll be perfect.
traduit: 我们的婚礼快开始了，在玛拉的深情注视下。太完美了。

original: I'm looking forward to our wedding. You and me....
traduit: 我期待着咱们的婚礼。你和我……

original: The wedding is soon. It'll be a good day.
traduit: 婚礼快开始了。真是美好的一天。

original: I'm the best warrior in Morthal, and that's no boast.
traduit: 我是莫萨尔最强的战士，这可不是自夸。

original: Your call.
traduit: 你决定吧。

original: Right, then.
traduit: 那好吧。

original: Bafagra badee.
traduit: 巴发个啦 巴迪。

original: I am watching, Skaal-friend.
traduit: 我看着你呢，斯卡尔之友。

original: Go on, then.
traduit: 那就继续吧。

original: Still have something you need?
traduit: 还有什么需要吗？

original: Is there still something you need of me?
traduit: 你还要我做什么？

original: What was it you needed, again?
traduit: 你刚才说要什么，再说下？

original: Yes, Thane. What is it?
traduit: 好的，武卫大人。什么事？

original: What would you ask of me?
traduit: 你要我做什么？

original: Just let me know what needs doing.
traduit: 需要什么跟我说就是了。

original: I'm sorry, but I'm not going to do something like that. Even for you.
traduit: 抱歉，但我不会做这种事。即使是你要求我。

original: Joooo fah!
traduit: 尤 法！

original: Anything else before you go?
traduit: 走之前还有别的事吗？

original: Kawafoo.
traduit: 卡瓦弗。

original: I'm sorry, that can't be done.
traduit: 抱歉。这实在办不到。

original: No problem, I'll handle it.
traduit: 没问题，我来处理。

original: Araa.
traduit: 阿拉。

original: Did you need something?
traduit: 你有什么事？

original: Baroo?
traduit: 巴鲁？

original: Come on. Let's see what you're made of.
traduit: 来吧。看看你有什么能耐。

original: I am Hermaeus Mora. I have been watching you since you defeated Miraak. Your progress is most impressive.
traduit: 我乃赫麦尤斯·莫拉。你击败米拉克后，我就在观察你。你的成果令人惊叹。

original: I am Hermaeus Mora. I have been watching you since we last spoke, and I am pleased with your progress.
traduit: 我乃赫麦尤斯·莫拉。上次交流后我就在观察你，我为你的成果感到欣慰。

original: I am Hermaeus Mora. I am the guardian of the unseen, and knower of the unknown. I have been watching you, mortal.
traduit: 我乃赫麦尤斯·莫拉。我乃未见之物的守护者，未知之物的了解者。我注视你很久了，凡人。

original: Most impressive.
traduit: 感佩之极。

original: Got this from a pretty excited looking dark elf around Raven Rock. He said it was important I got it to you as soon as I could.
traduit: 鸦石镇有个很兴奋的暗精灵给了我这封信，说很重要，让我赶紧拿给你。

original: Another note from your friend Ralis. I hope everything is all right.
traduit: 又是你的朋友拉里斯的信，希望没出什么事。

original: Another letter from Ralis. He's starting to scare me a little.
traduit: 又是拉里斯的信，他开始让我觉得害怕了。

original: I've got another letter from Ralis, but this is the last thing I'm delivering for him. That place is just too much for me.
traduit: 我这里又有拉里斯的信，这是我最后一次送他的信了，那地方太恐怖了。

original: Come on, you monster!
traduit: 来吧，怪物！

original: Skyrim belongs to the Nords!
traduit: 天际属于诺德人！

original: Fine! I'll take care of it, just please leave me alone!
traduit: 好！我会处理的，别再烦我了！

original: You know what you have to do.
traduit: 你知道该怎么做。

original: Ugh. You mangy piece of pit-bait.
traduit: 啊。你这个肮脏的鱼饵。

original: If that's what you want. Come find me at the College if you change your mind.
traduit: 随你的想法吧。如果你改主意了。就来学院找我。

original: I'm heading home if you need me.
traduit: 我先回家了，有需要请叫我。

original: I need to get back to the village. My father will have need of me.
traduit: 我得回村子了，父亲还需要我。

original: (hiss)
Well, then, I'm going to head back and get myself a drink. Maybe I'll see you soon.
traduit: 好吧，那我先回去喝一杯了。下次再见。

original: It has been an honor, Skaal-friend.
traduit: 这是我的荣幸，斯卡尔之友。

original: What do you need to take?
traduit: 你需要带什么？

original: Whatever you say, boss.
traduit: 你说了算，老板。

original: <Alias=Dungeon> is free of bandits.
traduit: <Alias=Dungeon>没有强盗了。

original: Now that's good work. Everyone will be a lot safer with them gone, Dark Elf and Nord alike.
traduit: 干得很好。没了他们，大家就安全多了，对暗精灵和诺德都一样。

original: Here, some gold as promised, and let me show you a bit about wearing heavy armor. Save you some aches on a long march.
traduit: 给。这是我承诺过的金币，让我来展示一下该怎么穿重甲吧。省得你在长途跋涉之后感觉浑身酸痛。

original: Your kindness warms my heart as sunlight warms the skin on a cold day. The Skaal are once again in your debt, outsider.
traduit: 你的好意让我暖心，就像冷天照在皮肤上的日光。斯卡尔又欠你一个人情了，外来者。

original: The bandits won't be a problem anymore.
traduit: 强盗再也不是问题了。

original: Forget it.
traduit: 算了吧。

original: Yes. It is.
traduit: 是啊。

original: That's too bad.
traduit: 那太糟糕了。

original: I was foolish to expect compassion from an outsider.
traduit: 我居然蠢到跟一个外来者诉苦。

original: It's not my problem.
traduit: 不关我的事。

original: I'll do it.
traduit: 交给我。

original: That's a brave offer. I'd be happy to throw in my coin behind that.
traduit: 真是个勇敢的提议。我很乐意出钱。
