original: I know you faced great danger to bring this map to me. There are no words to tell how glad my heart is. Thank you, brave one.
traduit: 把地图带回来一定冒了很大风险。感激之情无以言表。谢谢你，勇士。

original: I name you friend of the Skaal, and I will trust you with the knowledge of forging Stalhrim.
traduit: 我承认你是斯卡尔的朋友，铸造魔冰的知识也可以传给你了。

original: If you bring Stalhrim here to my forge, you can use my tools to make what you will from it.
traduit: 有魔冰就带到我这儿来吧，工具和炉子都随你使用。

original: It is good to see you again, my friend. Did you find the elves at their ship?
traduit: 很高兴又看见你了，我的朋友。你在船上找到了那些精灵吗？

original: I will return to the village. When you have the map, please bring it to me there. And thank you. May the All-Maker bless your days.
traduit: 我要回村子了。你拿到地图后，请把它带来给我。谢谢你，愿造物主保佑你。

original: Ah, sweet Oblivion. Soon I shall return.
traduit: 啊，甜美的湮灭。我很快就会回来的。

original: I do so love dealing with mortals.
traduit: 我真喜欢和凡人做交易。

original: Until you summon me again.
traduit: 下次召唤我时再见。

original: It's been so much fun.
traduit: 太好玩儿了。

original: I'll be going now.
traduit: 我先走了。

original: A butler's work is never done.
traduit: 仆人的活儿是干不完的。

original: Ah, a fresh mortal who seeks to bargain with me.
traduit: 啊，有个想和我谈生意的新鲜凡人。

original: So, we meet again.
traduit: 我们又见面了。

original: So soon? You must be hungry for a deal.
traduit: 这么快又见面了？你肯定急着做交易吧。

original: You have many things I wish to buy.
traduit: 你这儿有很多我想买的东西。

original: A new master. It's been centuries.
traduit: 有新的主人了啊。上一个还是几百年前呢。

original: Oh look. My new master.
traduit: 哦看啊。这不是我的新主人么。

original: More cups and plates for me to carry?
traduit: 还要我背更多的杯子和盘子吗？

original: I don't suppose you'll carry some of this for a while.
traduit: 看来你自己暂时不会背这些东西了。

original: I have some things to sell.
traduit: 我有些东西要卖。

original: I'm sure we can strike a bargain.
traduit: 我们肯定会成交的。

original: Haggling with you can be so...entertaining.
traduit: 跟你讨价还价还真是……有意思。

original: Let's make a deal.
traduit: 我们做个交易吧。

original: I can hardly wait.
traduit: 我等不及了。

original: What kind of a person should I look for?
traduit: 我该找个什么样的人？

original: Hmm. Excellent question.
traduit: 嗯，问得好。

original: Once word gets out, there will be a lot of people to choose from.
traduit: 消息一旦传开，肯定会有一大堆人来报名。

original: Someone with a brilliant mind and robust physique that is blindly obedient would be ideal.
traduit: 理想的人选要有聪明的大脑、结实的体魄，还要能无条件服从。

original: Oh, and they need to know how to brew tea. Ulves always waters it down.
traduit: 哦，还必须要知道如何泡茶。乌尔维斯总是加太多水。

original: You can't just order me around.
traduit: 你不能这么使唤我。

original: Well, somebody needs to get me a new steward. It might as well be you.
traduit: 嗯，可总要有人帮我找个新管家啊，你可能就合适。

original: But if you don't want to help a master wizard of House Telvanni, possibly earning his favor, you're a fool.
traduit: 但你要是不愿意帮泰瓦尼高等巫师的忙，让自己有机会赢得好感，那就是个傻子。

original: Of course, Master Neloth. As you command.
traduit: 当然了，内洛斯大师。就按您的吩咐。

original: Finally. Someone who recognizes my importance around here.
traduit: 这里总算是有人意识到我的重要性了。

original: Hey, I'm not your servant.
traduit: 嘿，我不是你的仆人。

original: Obviously not, or you would have a cup of tea in your hands.
traduit: 当然不是，不然你手上就该端一杯茶。

original: I supposed you want to be asked nicely. Very well.
traduit: 瞅你这意思，是想让我低三下四求你呗。好极了。

original: Please, oh hero of Skyrim. Please find Varona. I shall be ever so grateful.
traduit: 拜托了，天际来的英雄。请你去找瓦罗纳吧。我会很感激的。

original: Why don't you just make your own tea?
traduit: 为什么你不自己泡茶呢？

original: What? Make my own tea?
traduit: 什么？要我自己泡茶？

original: I am a master wizard of the House Telvanni. Other people make tea for me.
traduit: 我可是泰瓦尼的高等巫师，我的茶都是别人帮我泡的。

original: I found what you wanted.
traduit: 我找到你要的了。

original: It's a bit dried up, but it will do. Here.
traduit: 有点干燥了，但还能用。拿着。

original: I've got a daedra heart.
traduit: 拿到迪德拉之心了。

original: A bit ripe, isn't it? Here. Take this.
traduit: 有点刺鼻是吧？拿着吧。

original: I've got a giant's toe.
traduit: 我有巨人脚趾了。

original: Nasty bitches, aren't they? Here's your fee.
traduit: 难搞的狗东西，对吧？这是你的钱。

original: I've found a hagraven claw.
traduit: 我有块乌鸦鬼婆之爪。

original: Not bad for an amateur? Take this.
traduit: 对新手来说还行。拿去吧。

original: I've have some vampire dust.
traduit: 我有些吸血鬼灰烬。

original: You could have cleaned it. It's still bloody. Here's your money.
traduit: 你该洗一下的，上面还有血迹呢。这是你的钱。

original: I have a briarheart.
traduit: 我有颗荆棘之心。

original: Hmm. Better than average quality. I'll take it.
traduit: 嗯，品质还不错，我要了。

original: I have some void salts.
traduit: 我有些虚无盐。

original: Do you need any help?
traduit: 你需要帮忙吗？

original: Well, I could use a daedra heart. Can't grow that in my garden.
traduit: 嗯，我需要一颗迪德拉之心。我自己种不出来。

original: Hmm. I'm running out of giant toes. I'll pay extra for one.
traduit: 嗯，我的巨人脚趾快用完了。给我一根，我多付你些钱。

original: As a matter of fact, I need a hagraven claw. I'll pay extra if you find one.
traduit: 其实，我需要一块乌鸦鬼婆之爪。你找到了我会多付你些钱。

original: How about some vampire dust? Bring me some of that and I'll pay handsomely.
traduit: 有吸血鬼灰烬吗？带些给我，我会给个好价钱。

original: You got a briarheart? That's what I really need. Neloth keeps taking all of mine.
traduit: 有荆棘之心吗？我真的需要那玩意儿。内洛斯老是把我的拿走。

original: You find some void salts and you bring them to me. I'll beat anyone else's price.
traduit: 你找些虚无盐带来给我。我出的价比别人都高。

original: Bilgemuck is an animal of some kind? And you want it back?
traduit: “脏脏”是某种野兽吗？你要把他找回来？

original: Bilgemuck prize beast. You find, he follow.
traduit: “脏脏”珍贵的野兽。你找，它跟。

original: Bilgemuck love meat. Give meat, he follow. You go.
traduit: “脏脏”喜欢肉。给肉，它跟。你去。

original: I'm sorry, this is all just too strange for me.
traduit: 我很抱歉，但这听起来太奇怪了。

original: No strange. Strong. You strong, make us stronger. Help tribe-kin.
traduit: 不怪。壮实。你壮，让我们更壮。帮助部落血亲。

original: Are you saying you want my help?
traduit: 你说需要我帮忙？

original: Bilgemuck run. Prize beast, run.
traduit: “脏脏”跑了。珍贵的野兽，跑了。

original: Fool tribe-kin, chase away. Bilgemuck fear.
traduit: 愚蠢的部落血亲，赶跑了。“脏脏”害怕了。

original: You bring, he follow you. Yes?
traduit: 你带，它跟你。好？

original: How did you learn to talk?
traduit: 你是怎么学会说话的？

original: Chief smart. Most Riekling dumb but chief smart.
traduit: 酋长聪明。大多数瑞克灵笨，但酋长聪明。

original: What is going on here?
traduit: 这儿出了什么事？

original: We family. We strong, you stronger.
traduit: 我们家人。我们壮，你更壮。

original: Come on, now, no time for chatter.
traduit: 走吧，没工夫闲扯了。

original: I'd really just rather get to the barrow, if that's all right with you.
traduit: 不介意的话，我们还是赶紧去古坟吧。

original: We can talk after I've gotten the blessing.
traduit: 等我得到赐福后再聊吧。

original: Let's just keep moving.
traduit: 我们还是快走吧。

original: Come on, let's get up there.
traduit: 走啊，快点上去。

original: You ready to head inside?
traduit: 你准备好进去了吗？

original: Don't worry about me. You and Bujold should get up to the barrow.
traduit: 别担心我。你跟布约德应该去古坟那儿。

original: We'll clean up here. You go with Bujold.
traduit: 我们会收拾这里。你跟布约德走吧。

original: I'm going to stay here and check on the mead.
traduit: 我要留下来清点蜜酒。

original: A lot of work to do around this place...
traduit: 这地方有的忙了。

original: I did what had to be done.
traduit: 我做了该做的事。

original: Wonderful, simply wonderful! Councilor Morvayn will be quite pleased when he hears about this.
traduit: 太好了，真是太好了！莫尔凡议员听到这消息肯定很高兴。

original: He's no longer a threat.
traduit: 他再也构不成威胁了。

original: Then... it's finally over.
traduit: 那么……终于结束了。

original: What of the Redoran Guard I sent to assist you?
traduit: 我派去协助你的瑞多然卫兵呢？

original: What if they try to stop me?
traduit: 如果他们要阻止我呢？

original: If you have the evidence and it places your life in peril, I would expect you to do whatever you must to keep yourself alive.
traduit: 如果你拿到了证据，且因此受到生命威胁，希望你采取一切必要手段保证人身安全。

original: Here, this key should open the front door of the manor in case they've locked it. Good luck.
traduit: 拿着，为防他们上锁，这把钥匙应该能打开宅邸的正门。祝你好运。

original: Nothing unusual about them at all?
traduit: 他们就没有一点可疑之处吗？

original: People have mentioned it's a bit odd about how close in age Mirri appears to be to her father, but that's hardly a cause for alarm.
traduit: 有人说过，米莉看上去和她父亲的年纪太相近了，但这并不值得大惊小怪。

original: Just make sure that you find solid evidence. If I accuse them without it, I'll be the laughingstock of the colony.
traduit: 务必要找到确凿的证据。要是没有证据就指控他们，我会成为整个聚落的笑柄。

original: A benefit? How?
traduit: 贡献？怎么说？

original: They're quite wealthy and they've been quite generous by sharing their fortune with the community.
traduit: 他们很富有，也非常慷慨地与社区分享他们的财富。

original: They've contributed coin, food, supplies... even helped repair a few of the buildings in town with their own hands.
traduit: 他们捐了钱、食物和物资……甚至还亲手帮助修复了镇上的几座建筑。

original: Can you tell me more about the Severin family?
traduit: 能告诉我关于瑟佛林家的事情么？

original: Tilisu is wife to the family patriarch, Vendil. They have a single child, a daughter named Mirri.
traduit: 蒂莉苏是这户人家的家长文迪尔的妻子。他们育有一女叫米莉。

original: They arrived here ten years ago, and have been nothing but a benefit to Raven Rock ever since.
traduit: 他们大约在十年前来到这里，从那以后就一直在为鸦石镇做贡献。

original: So go search their house.
traduit: 那就去搜查他们家啊。

original: I'm not kicking down anyone's door until I have solid evidence in hand.
traduit: 除非已有确切的证据，不然我不会去踹任何人的家门。

original: If you're wrong about Tilisu, things would quickly go downhill around here and the real culprits might slip away. I can't afford for that to happen.
traduit: 要是你错怪了蒂莉苏，事态会迅速恶化，真凶也可能会溜走。我负不起这种责任。

original: I saw her in the Ulen tomb.
traduit: 我在乌伦祖坟里看到她了。

original: So Geldis's plan worked, eh? Everytime we tried it, no one would ever show up.
traduit: 所以吉迪斯的计划起作用了？我们每次尝试，从没人出现过。

original: If Tilisu's involved in any sort of plot to harm Councilor Morvayn, I'm going to need hard evidence to prove it.
traduit: 如果蒂莉苏参与了某种危害莫尔凡议员的阴谋，我就需要确凿的证据来揭露它。

original: I suspect Tilisu Severin is the culprit.
traduit: 我怀疑蒂莉苏·瑟佛林就是犯人。

original: Tilisu? Are you sure?
traduit: 蒂莉苏？你确定？

original: Now, if you'll excuse me, I'd like to meditate a bit.
traduit: 嗯，请让我静一静，我要冥想一下。

original: I'll let you get to it then.
traduit: 那我就不打扰了。

original: Oh, no bother. We all have a right to be here.
traduit: 哦，没关系。我们都有来这里的权利。

original: Tell me why you're really here.
traduit: 告诉我你来这里的真实原因。

original: What do you mean? I thought I was clear.
traduit: 你在说什么？我已经说得很清楚了。

original: I'm simply honoring a fellow departed Dunmer.
traduit: 我只是来祭奠一位逝去的丹莫同胞。

original: You're lying. You're from House Hlaalu!
traduit: 你在说谎，你是哈拉鲁家的人！

original: What kind of nonsense is that!?
traduit: 你在胡扯什么？！

original: I'm simply honoring a fellow departed Dunmer, and you hurl baseless accusations at me?
traduit: 我不过是在祭奠一位逝去的丹莫同胞，你就无缘无故地污蔑我？

original: You aren't an Ulen.
traduit: 你不是乌伦家的人。

original: Since there aren't any Ulens left on this island, I've taken it upon myself to leave the traditional offering in their stead.
traduit: 因为岛上已经没有乌伦家的人了，所以我自愿为他们送上传统供品。

original: I presume the same thing you're doing... leaving an offering for the departed.
traduit: 可能和你做的是同一件事……给死者送祭品。

original: Nice to see a fellow Dunmer following the traditional customs.
traduit: 很高兴看到一个遵循传统习俗的丹莫同胞。

original: Forgive my surprise, it's just that I wouldn't expect that sort of behavior from someone who isn't Dunmer.
traduit: 请原谅我的惊诧，我只是没想到这种行为会发生在外族人身上。

original: Oh, excuse me! I didn't realize there was anyone else here.
traduit: 哦，抱歉！我不知道这里有人。

original: How did Vilur get caught?
traduit: 维鲁尔是怎么被抓的？

original: He underestimated the Redoran Guard. They were organized and brought a swift end to the coup.
traduit: 他低估了瑞多然卫兵。他们训练有素，迅速平息了这场政变。

original: Vilur tried to run, but he was caught by Captain Veleth himself.
traduit: 维鲁尔试图逃跑，但被维黎斯队长亲自逮到。

original: Vilur Ulen was executed a short time later and his remains placed in the Ulen Ancestral Tomb.
traduit: 不久后维鲁尔·乌伦就被处决，骨灰安放在乌伦家祖坟里。

original: Vilur did this alone?
traduit: 维鲁尔一个人就这么干了？

original: He arrived alone, but spread enough coin around to start changing people's minds.
traduit: 他来时是一个人，但是在这儿花了很多钱来改变人们的想法。

original: Half the bloody town joined his side. Can you believe that?
traduit: 结果半数刁民都站到他那边儿去了，你敢信吗？

original: Why did Councilor Morvayn execute an Ulen?
traduit: 为什么莫尔凡议员要处决乌伦家的人？

original: Back in 95, Vilur Ulen came to Raven Rock with a plan to take over our town.
traduit: 在95年，维鲁尔·乌伦带着一个接管鸦石镇的计划来到了这里。

original: The fetcher thought he could stir up the locals and use them against the Redoran Guard and then murder Councilor Morvayn when we weren't looking.
traduit: 那个费彻以为他能煽动本地人，让他们对付瑞多然卫兵，然后在我们没注意到的时候刺杀莫尔凡议员。

original: Why do Dunmer leave ash yams in their tombs?
traduit: 为什么丹莫要在坟墓里放灰烬薯？

original: When a Dunmer is laid to rest, the body is burned and returned to the ashen soil.
traduit: 当丹莫去世后，遗体会被火化，然后回归灰质土壤。

original: Since the ash yam is born of the very same soil, it represents rebirth and renewal... the fact that life ends and begins anew.
traduit: 因为灰烬薯是相同土壤上长出来的，也就象征着重生和更新……即生命周而复始的真相。

original: Thanks for the tip.
traduit: 多谢指点。

original: You can thank me if it works. Until then, I'd head to the tomb and wait until your visitor shows up.
traduit: 有用的话再谢吧。在那之前，我要是你就会去坟里等着客人现身呢。

original: Why haven't you told Adril about this?
traduit: 你为什么不告诉阿德尔这些？

original: What makes you think I haven't?
traduit: 你怎么知道我没说过？

original: Any time Adril and the Redoran Guard made a move, the Ulens must have been one step ahead and didn't show up.
traduit: 每次阿德尔和瑞多然卫兵采取行动时，乌伦家的人都先他们一步，从来没出现过。

original: How do I get them to do that?
traduit: 怎样才能让他们自投罗网？

original: There's an Ulen Ancestral Tomb near the Temple. Someone's been leaving ash yam offerings on the altar inside.
traduit: 神殿附近有一座乌伦家的祖坟，有人在里面的祭坛上放了灰烬薯。

original: If you were to wait inside for whomever that is, I'm betting they'll have some of the answers you're looking for.
traduit: 你要是在里面等那个人，我赌他们会有你要找的答案。

original: You have a better idea?
traduit: 你有更好的点子？

original: Actually, I do.
traduit: 实际上，我有。

original: If you want to catch those slippery slaughterfish, you need to let them come to you.
traduit: 如果想抓到那些滑溜溜的食人鱼，就得让它们主动来找你。

original: You think he's mistaken?
traduit: 你觉得他误判了吗？

original: No, I just think he's going about this the wrong way.
traduit: 不，我只是认为他的方法错了。

original: Adril Arano said you might be able to help me.
traduit: 阿德尔·阿拉诺说你可能帮得上我的忙。

original: Well, well. Adril's got himself a spy, does he?
traduit: 嘿嘿。阿德尔都有密探了，是吧？

original: Azura knows he needs all the help he can get. He's been chasing the Ulens for years now.
traduit: 连阿祖拉都知道他需要任何能得到的帮助，他追逐乌伦家已经好些年了。

original: I need you to start out by being my eyes and ears... search Raven Rock and see if you can root out these traitors.
traduit: 我需要你来做我的耳目……搜查一下鸦石镇，看看能不能抓到这些叛徒。

original: The best place to start would be Geldis Sadri over at the Retching Netch Cornerclub.
traduit: 先去呕吐气母街角吧找吉迪斯·萨德利。

original: If he provides you any leads, check them out before bringing them to my attention. I can't afford to make any mistakes.
traduit: 要是他给了你什么线索，最好确认一下再来找我。我没有犯错的余地。

original: I've decided to help you protect Councilor Morvayn.
traduit: 我决定帮你保护莫尔凡议员。

original: I'm pleased you've reconsidered.
traduit: 很高兴你改变了心意。

original: I'd prefer not to get involved.
traduit: 我不想被牵扯进去。

original: Without Councilor Morvayn, Raven Rock has no future. Keep that in mind next time you decide to help or not.
traduit: 少了莫尔凡议员，鸦石镇就没有未来可言了。下次你决定是否要帮忙时，要记住这点。

original: What happened to House Hlaalu as a result?
traduit: 哈拉鲁家的下场是什么？

original: They had welcomed the Empire with open arms, and benefited from it.
traduit: 他们张开双手迎接了帝国，也从中获利。

original: When everything was said and done, they were no longer recognized as a Great House and were dismissed from the Council.
traduit: 当尘埃落定后，他们不再被视为大家族，并从议会中除名了。

original: I presume that was their downfall.
traduit: 我猜那就是他们衰落的原因。

original: Hlaalu deserved every bit of the hatred they received once the Empire released its grasp on Morrowind.
traduit: 后来帝国放松了对晨风的控制，哈拉鲁受到大家憎恨也是活该了。

original: Having past ties to the Empire immediately turned them into the scapegoat for the Dunmer people's suffering.
traduit: 由于过去和帝国的关系，他们立马被指为丹莫民众遭受苦难的替罪羊。

original: What can you tell me about House Hlaalu?
traduit: 能跟我说说哈拉鲁家族么？

original: Traitors. The lot of them.
traduit: 叛徒，全是叛徒。

original: Their collaboration with the Empire may have given them unrivaled political and economic strength, but their hearts weren't with the Dunmer people.
traduit: 他们靠着和帝国合作赚取权力和财富，却和丹莫民众渐行渐远。

original: Why don't you ask them to investigate?
traduit: 为什么不让他们来调查？

original: Most of my contacts live leagues away from Solstheim.
traduit: 我的联络人都离索瑟海姆很远。

original: Sending the occasional message back and forth is all we can manage, and sometimes takes months or more to arrive.
traduit: 顶多就是偶尔互通消息，有时候得等上数月或者更久。

original: However, any information we can glean in times like this I consider vital to House Redoran's survival.
traduit: 但是，我认为在这种时候收到的任何消息，对瑞多然家的存亡都是关键的。

original: You mentioned your "sources?"
traduit: 你刚才说你有“线人”？

original: I maintain a few contacts in other Dunmer settlements across Tamriel.
traduit: 我和全泰姆瑞尔的一些丹莫聚落都有联系。

original: Most hail from House Redoran, but there are a few from other houses.
traduit: 大多数是瑞多然家的，但也有少部分别家的。

original: Well, good luck with that.
traduit: 嗯，也只能祝你好运了。

original: Before you dismiss this entirely, I was hoping you might be able to lend a hand by investigating on the councilor's behalf.
traduit: 在你拒绝之前，我还是希望你能为了议员帮忙调查一下。

original: What will you do?
traduit: 你接下来会怎么做？

original: Summoning you here was part of my plan. I was hoping you'd be interested in investigating for me.
traduit: 把你找来是我的计划之一，我希望你有兴趣帮我调查一下。

original: How can I help?
traduit: 我能帮上什么？

original: I had a feeling you'd be willing to listen to me.
traduit: 我就知道你会伸出援手。

original: Why haven't you acted on the information?
traduit: 你为什么不根据情报采取行动？

original: Raven Rock is a small settlement, so it's hard to accomplish anything in secret.
traduit: 鸦石镇是个小聚落，在这里很难进行秘密行动。

original: If any of them is from House Hlaalu, I wouldn't be able to make a move without them knowing.
traduit: 要是我们当中有哈拉鲁家的人，行动就很难逃过他们的眼睛。

original: I'm afraid that one day I'll awaken and discover him dead, and I don't want it to come to that.
traduit: 我就怕某天醒来发现他死了，我不希望事态发展到那种地步。

original: He ordered the execution. It's on his head... not yours.
traduit: 是他下的处决令，要报也是报在他头上……不是你。

original: Now that's just ridiculous!
traduit: 这么说也太荒谬了！

original: As second councilor, it's my responsibility to protect Councilor Morvayn from harm.
traduit: 作为副议员，我有责任保护莫尔凡议员不受伤害。

original: You feel an attack on the councilor is imminent.
traduit: 你觉得议员随时会遭袭击。

original: I do. I've received some information from my sources that there could be elements of Ulen's house, House Hlaalu, already in Raven Rock.
traduit: 是的。我从线人那里得到了些消息，鸦石镇可能已经有一伙乌伦家或者哈拉鲁家的人了。

original: You sound paranoid.
traduit: 你听起来确实很多疑。

original: As second councilor, it's my responsibility to explore the possibility of any threat, no matter how paranoid it might seem.
traduit: 作为副议员，深入考虑各种威胁是我的责任，无论看上去有多偏执。

original: Your concern seems justified.
traduit: 你会担心是合理的。

original: It may be justified, but it certainly isn't appreciated. Councilor Morvayn simply feels that I'm being paranoid.
traduit: 可能合理，但肯定不被重视。莫尔凡议员就觉得我有些多疑。

original: Why would the Ulens want him dead?
traduit: 为什么乌伦家想杀了他？

original: It's a private matter. Let's just say they seek revenge for the execution of one of their own... ordered by Councilor Morvayn himself.
traduit: 私人恩怨。简单来说就是他们家有人被处决了……命令是莫尔凡议员亲自下的。现在想要报仇。

original: The problem is I don't have any solid proof that anyone from House Hlaalu is hidden among us... only my suspicions.
traduit: 问题是，我们安插在哈拉鲁家族里的暗线没有给我提供任何确凿的证据……所以这都是我的推测。

original: He's in danger of being killed? How?
traduit: 他有被杀的风险？什么情况？

original: The Ulen Family of House Hlaalu, a rival Great House, has placed a deathmark on the councilor's head.
traduit: 与我们敌对的大家族——哈拉鲁，其下所属的乌伦家给议员发了一个死亡标记。

original: I don't want to see any of you get hurt.
traduit: 我不想看到你们有人受伤。

original: Oh, could you get me an extra blanket. I think I might need it.
traduit: 哦，能帮我再拿条毯子吗，我可能用得着。

original: That man is going to kill himself one day, and take the rest of us with him.
traduit: 那家伙迟早会害死自己，然后拉大伙儿陪葬。

original: Thanks for the warning.
traduit: 多谢提醒。

original: Master Neloth is going to be casting some rather loud spells in the next day or two.
traduit: 内洛斯大师会在接下来一两天施放一些噪音很大的法术。

original: You should warn the others.
traduit: 你该警告下其他人。

original: Oh, and if the tower door suddenly gets icy cold, don't come in.
traduit: 哦，要是塔门突然开始结冰，就别进来了。

original: And suffered twice as much.
traduit: 受的苦也是两倍于以往。

original: Neloth is a master wizard of the House Telvanni.
traduit: 内洛斯是泰瓦尼家族的高等巫师。

original: I've already learned more than I would have in twice the time at the College of Winterhold.
traduit: 我在这边学到的东西是在冬堡学院的两倍多。

original: I hope it's worth it.
traduit: 希望这是值得的。

original: The pain has subsided. Thank you for asking.
traduit: 痛感减轻了，感谢您的关心。

original: Hopefully the frost lessons are over.
traduit: 希望寒霜课程上完了。

original: How are your lessons coming, Talvas?
traduit: 你的课程怎么样了，塔瓦斯？

original: I already did, but it won't do any good. They haven't had any for months.
traduit: 已经加了，但是没用。那边几个月来都缺货。

original: Taproot? That's all? Add it to the Raven Rock list.
traduit: 直立根？没了？那就加到去鸦石镇的清单上。

original: You have some tea, but I'll get you a fresh cup.
traduit: 您先喝点茶，我过会儿再帮您倒一杯。

original: Elynea is waiting for fresh taproot before she can regrow that chamber.
traduit: 艾琳娜需要新鲜的直立根才能重新培植房间。

original: Varona, get me some canis root tea.
traduit: 瓦罗纳，帮我倒杯犬根茶。

original: Oh, and remind Elynea that she needs to fix my tower.
traduit: 哦，提醒艾琳娜记得给我修塔。

original: That chamber has been withered for too long.
traduit: 那个房间已经枯萎很久了。

original: That's what you said yesterday!
traduit: 您昨天也这么说！

original: I really can't put this trip off for much longer.
traduit: 我真的不能再拖下去了。

original: Maybe some daedra heart. Elynea never seems to stock it.
traduit: 可能还要些迪德拉心脏，艾琳娜从来不多留些。

original: Let me get you the rest of the list tomorrow. I'm just too busy to think about this right now.
traduit: 我明天再跟你说其他的，现在太忙了，没空想这个。

original: I know that. What else?
traduit: 我知道，还有别的吗？

original: Hmm? Oh. Raven Rock. Right.
traduit: 嗯？哦，鸦石镇，对了。

original: I need soul gems...
traduit: 我需要些灵魂石……

original: Master Neloth, I'm preparing for a trip to Raven Rock to pick up supplies.
traduit: 内洛斯大师，我准备去鸦石镇买些物资。

original: I have your list of soul gems, but nothing else.
traduit: 我清单上只有您的灵魂石，别的没了。

original: What does it mean to be a member of your house?
traduit: 成为你家族的一员意味着什么？

original: For now, not much. But in a few decades when I return to Vvardenfell, you would be seen as Morrowind nobility.
traduit: 目前来说没什么。但到我几十年后回瓦登费尔去时，你会被人们视为晨风贵族。

original: In the mean time, we would keep a bed and chest here for you.
traduit: 现在的话，我们会在这儿给你留个床和箱子。

original: At least you don't have to taste every time to see if it's brewed right.
traduit: 至少你不像我一样，每次泡完还得试喝。

original: I don't know how he drinks that stuff.
traduit: 不懂为什么他要喝那玩意儿。

original: If you're here about the canis root tea, it's almost ready.
traduit: 你要是来拿犬根茶的话，马上就好了。

original: Well you'll just have to wait. Last time I brought his meal up late he asked if I wanted to be a part of one of his experiments.
traduit: 你还是等着吧，上次给他送饭送完了，他就问我要不要当他的试验品。

original: Well I can't wait forever. Master Neloth keeps asking if I have his soul gems yet.
traduit: 我不能一直等啊，内洛斯大师不停问我买到灵魂石了没。

original: I would have had it ready, but Master Neloth wanted his meal early.
traduit: 原本是该写完了的，但是内洛斯大师今天想提早进餐。

original: Where is your list of things you need from Raven Rock?
traduit: 你的鸦石镇采购清单呢？

original: Maybe two hundred years ago they were.
traduit: 那可能是两百年前吧。

original: Now they say those green lands are ash covered too.
traduit: 他们说绿地现在也被火山灰埋了。

original: So you've said a hundred times. But didn't you also tell me the Telvanni lands were green and lush?
traduit: 你都说过上百次了。但不也说过泰瓦尼的领地绿茵茵的吗？

original: It's a good thing you've always lived here on Solstheim.
traduit: 你能一辈子待在索瑟海姆是好事。

original: Vvardenfell is covered in ash. Red Mountain makes sure of that.
traduit: 瓦登费尔都被火山灰埋了，有红山当然就是这样。

original: I'm sick of all this ash. I know dunmer aren't supposed to mind the ash, but I hate it.
traduit: 真受够这些火山灰了。我知道丹莫应该习惯了，但就是非常讨厌。

original: Bah! Patience is for the young. An old dunmer like me can't afford it.
traduit: 呸！只有年轻人才有耐心，我这个老丹莫等不起。

original: Soon. Be patient. Ulves is still making his list. And of course Master Neloth keeps adding to his.
traduit: 快了，你要耐心点。乌尔维斯还在开他的单子，内洛斯大师当然还要加些东西。

original: What with all the ash spawn on the road these days, I'm not leaving until the trip is worth it.
traduit: 现在路上都是灰烬怪，要是没必要我也不想去。

original: Are you going to Raven Rock soon? I need some thing.
traduit: 你要去鸦石镇吗？我需要一些东西。

original: Who else lives here?
traduit: 还有其他人住在这儿吗？

original: Talvas is Master Neloth's apprentice. If you are interested in spells, he might be willing to sell you some.
traduit: 塔瓦斯是内洛斯大师的学徒。如果你对法术感兴趣，他可能会卖给你一些。

original: Elynea is our alchemist. She specializes in mushrooms and other types of fungus.
traduit: 艾琳娜是我们的炼金术师。她的专业领域是菌类研究。

original: Ulves runs the kitchens.
traduit: 乌尔维斯掌管厨房。

original: Are you one of Neloth's apprentices?
traduit: 你是内洛斯的学徒吗？

original: No. Talvas is his apprentice. I'm his steward. I manage the day to day affairs of Tel Mithryn.
traduit: 不。塔瓦斯才是他的学徒。我是他的管家，负责处理泰尔·米斯瑞恩的日常事务。

original: Tel Mithryn. It's the home of Master Neloth.
traduit: 泰尔·米斯瑞恩。内洛斯大师的居所。

original: You may have heard of him. He's a famous Telvanni wizard.
traduit: 你可能听说过他，一位很著名的泰瓦尼法师。

original: He's not here right now. I think he's in Raven Rock.
traduit: 他现在不在这儿。我想应该在鸦石镇。

original: What do you have to trade?
traduit: 你要和我交易什么？

original: Here, take a look.
traduit: 来吧，看一看。

original: Hail, thuri. Your thu'um has the mastery. Climb aboard and I will carry you to Miraak.
traduit: 向您致敬，图瑞。您的吐'目征服了我。骑上来吧，我会带您去找米拉克的。

original: Your thu'um is stronger than Miraak's. Vobalaan in. I serve you now.
traduit: 你的吐'目比米拉克更强大。沃巴兰 因。我愿侍奉于您。

original: Miraak has forced me to serve him for too long. Nahkriin saraan lingrah. Let us destroy him together.
traduit: 米拉克强迫我侍奉他太久了。纳克林 萨兰 灵嘎。让我们一起毁灭他。

original: Climb on and we will smite our enemies.
traduit: 爬上来，我们一起击溃敌人。

original: Bo nu. Quickly.
traduit: 波 努。快来吧。

original: How can I serve you, thuri?
traduit: 有何吩咐，图瑞？

original: Hail, thuri. Shall we fly together?
traduit: 向您致敬，图瑞。我们一起飞翔吧？

original: Zu'u fent aam. I am at your command.
traduit: 祖'乌 芬特 阿姆。我听命于您。

original: You're right. I want to be the new chief.
traduit: 你说得对。我想当新任酋长。

original: Strong always fight strong!
traduit: 壮的总打壮的！

original: Slow down here. I don't want to hurt you.
traduit: 慢点。我不想伤着你了。

original: Strong always fight strong. Old chief strong, me stronger.
traduit: 壮的总打壮的。老酋长很壮，我更壮。

original: You stronger?
traduit: 你更壮？

original: Fight me!
traduit: 和我打！

original: The Nords are dead.
traduit: 诺德人都死了。

original: You strong! All tribe-kin stronger with you.
traduit: 你壮！部落血亲都跟着你变壮。

original: But... maybe you too strong.
traduit: 但……也许你太壮了。

original: Too strong, want be chief.
traduit: 太壮了，想当酋长了。

original: Let's go!
traduit: 我们走！

original: We fight!
traduit: 我们打一架！

original: I don't know about this...
traduit: 我不太清楚……

original: You know. We know. Come fight. We wait, but you, come fight.
traduit: 你清楚。我们清楚。来打。我们等，但你，来打。

original: You want me to kill people?
traduit: 你想让我去杀人？

original: Bad people. They come, fight us. We fight back now.
traduit: 坏人。他们来，打我们。我们现在打回去。

original: What do we need to do now?
traduit: 我们现在要做什么？

original: Bad Nords. Say Thirsk theirs. Live by water, bother tribe-kin.
traduit: 坏诺德人。说瑟斯科他们的。住水边，骚扰部落血亲。

original: We fight. You strong. You help. No more bad Nords.
traduit: 我们打，你壮。你帮忙。没有坏诺德人了。

original: I brought your Scathecraw.
traduit: 我把苦痛草给你带来了。

original: Good redgrass. Later, we burn. Now, final task.
traduit: 上好的红草。过会儿，我们点燃。现在，最后的任务。

original: Then, you tribe-kin.
traduit: 之后，你部落血亲。

original: What is this "redgrass"?
traduit: “红草”是什么？

original: Here, like this. Go, bring two hands of redgrass. Be friend of tribe-kin.
traduit: 这儿，像这种。去，拿两手红草。当部落血亲朋友。

original: You want me to do something else?
traduit: 你还要我做别的事吗？

original: Tribe-kin missing redgrass. Need for godspeak dance.
traduit: 部落血亲们想要红草。用在敬神舞。

original: You bring redgrass, we dance.
traduit: 你带红草，我们跳舞。

original: I brought back your animal.
traduit: 我把你的野兽带回来了。

original: Bilgemuck follow you. Bilgemuck know strength.
traduit: “脏脏”跟你。“脏脏”知道力量。

original: Tribe-kin stronger. You stay, help more.
traduit: 部落血亲变壮。你留，再帮忙。

original: At your service.
traduit: 愿为您效劳。

original: Ah, my favorite customer.
traduit: 啊，是我最喜欢的顾客。

original: I'd like you to carry some things.
traduit: 我希望你能帮我扛些东西。

original: Certainly, sir.
traduit: 当然可以，先生。

original: Certainly, ma'am.
traduit: 当然可以，女士。

original: I live to serve.
traduit: 乐意效劳。

original: I always dreamt of being a pack mule.
traduit: 我一直想当头驴。

original: I was hoping you'd say that.
traduit: 我正盼你这么说呢。

original: What does that mean?
traduit: 这是什么意思？

original: I'm not sure, but it is fascinating, isn't it?
traduit: 我不确定，但是很值得探究，不是吗？

original: Perhaps it has some relation to what's going on here. Quite unexpected.
traduit: 可能和这儿发生的事情有所联系呢，真是意想不到。

original: I'm afraid I can't give you any answers. But there are ruins of an ancient temple of Miraak's toward the center of the island.
traduit: 恐怕我给不了你什么答案，不过岛的中央有一座米拉克的古代神殿遗址。

original: If I were you, I'd look there.
traduit: 我要是你就会去那边看看。

original: What does it mean if we're both Dragonborn?
traduit: 如果我们都是龙裔，意味着什么呢？

original: I am unsure. It may mean that you could save us, or it may mean that you could bring about our destruction.
traduit: 我不确定。可能意味着你能救我们，也可能是指你会带来我们的灭亡。

original: But our time here is running out. The few of us left free of control cannot protect ourselves for much longer.
traduit: 但时间不多了，我们剩下的这些人没法保护自己太久。

original: You must go to Saering's Watch. Learn there the word that Miraak learned long ago, and use that knowledge on the Wind Stone.
traduit: 你得前往瑟琳看台，学会很久以前米拉克在那儿学的龙语，运用那些知识来解放风石。

original: You may be able to break the hold on our people there, and free them from control.
traduit: 也许就能把我的族人从控制中解救出来。

original: Miraak did claim to be Dragonborn.
traduit: 米拉克确实自称是龙裔。

original: That is what the stories say. You are Dragonborn as well, then. Perhaps you are connected.
traduit: 这也是传说中记载的。你也是龙裔，也许你们有所联系。

original: I am indeed Dragonborn.
traduit: 我确实是龙裔。

original: Then perhaps you are connected with him. The old tales say that he, too, was Dragonborn.
traduit: 也许你和他有某种关联。古老的传说中记载他也是龙裔。

original: What does this all mean?
traduit: 这一切代表着什么？

original: It means what I feared has come to pass. Miraak was never truly gone, and now has returned.
traduit: 这代表我所畏惧的事情已经发生了。米拉克从未真正灭亡，现在他回归了。

original: If you could go to this place and see him... Are you like Miraak? Are you Dragonborn?
traduit: 如果你能前往那里见他……你跟米拉克一样？你是龙裔吗？

original: I read a book in Miraak's temple, and went somewhere. Miraak was there.
traduit: 我在米拉克的神殿里读了一本书，然后就去了某个地方。米拉克就在那里。

original: The legends speak of that place. Terrible battles fought at the temple. The dragons burning it to the ground in rage.
traduit: 传说中曾提到过那个地方。那座神殿曾有过一场大战。龙族盛怒之下将其夷为平地。

original: They speak also of something worse than dragons buried within. Difficult to imagine, but if true...
traduit: 他们说里面还埋藏着比龙族更可怕的东西。难以想象，但如果是真的……

original: So, you have seen things, yes? My magic grows weak, and so does the barrier around our village. Time is short. Tell me what you know.
traduit: 那么，你看到了什么，对吧？我的魔法在逐渐变弱，围绕村子的屏障也是如此。时间不多了，把你知道的都告诉我吧。

original: I feared that it would be so.
traduit: 我就怕是这么回事。

original: He has confirmed that Miraak is indeed behind the suffering of our people.
traduit: 他确认了米拉克确实是我们族人受难的幕后指使者。

original: She has confirmed that Miraak is the one behind the suffering of our people.
traduit: 她确认了米拉克确实是我们族人受难的幕后指使者。

original: No, but I have brought someone who has seen things...
traduit: 不，但是我带来一个人，他看到了某些东西……

original: Frea! What news do you bring? Is there a way to free our people?
traduit: 芙瑞雅！情况怎么样？有办法解放我们的族人吗？

original: Frea! I had worried I would not see you again.
traduit: 芙瑞雅！我都怕再也见不到你了。

original: Father! I have returned! There is yet hope!
traduit: 父亲！我回来了！还有希望！

original: Ugh! The heart stone protects me!
traduit: 啊！心石保护我！

original: So Neloth is afraid to face me himself!
traduit: 看来内洛斯害怕直面我！

original: Pawn of Neloth!
traduit: 内洛斯的走狗！

original: What can you tell me about Ildari Sarothril?
traduit: 能跟我说说伊达利·萨罗希里么？

original: Master Neloth's old apprentice? The one before me?
traduit: 内洛斯大师以前的学徒？在我之前的那个？

original: I never met her. Master Neloth took me on because she died.
traduit: 我从没见过她，内洛斯大师收我也是因为她死了。

original: I heard it was messy.
traduit: 听说她死的很惨。

original: She was a headstrong one. Always pushing Master Neloth to teach her more.
traduit: 她是个固执的人，总是催着内洛斯大师多教教她。

original: Her lust for power was her undoing.
traduit: 对力量的贪欲让她走向了灭亡。

original: She let Master Neloth do some ritual thing to her. We buried her out back.
traduit: 她让内洛斯大师对她进行某种仪式，我们把她埋在后面了。

original: That was some twenty years ago now.
traduit: 那是二十年前的事情了。

original: Ildari? She was a beauty, she was.
traduit: 伊达利？她以前很漂亮，真的。

original: I tried to court her, but she had no interest in me.
traduit: 我追求过她，但她对我不感兴趣。

original: She was only interested in magic and power.
traduit: 她只在乎魔法和力量。

original: She died in some experiment Master Neloth did on her. He claimed she wanted him to.
traduit: 她死于内洛斯大师某次在她身上做的实验，内洛斯大师坚称她是自愿的。

original: Try walking around the grounds with the ring on.
traduit: 戴上这个指环到处走走。

original: Be sure to bring back an amusing story of how Ildari died.
traduit: 回来时记得跟我讲讲伊达利是怎么死的。希望是个有趣的故事。

original: Mogrul isn't someone you can ignore.
traduit: 莫古尔不是你能放着不管的人。

original: Sooner or later they all pay.
traduit: 迟早要把钱还回来。

original: It looks like an ash spawn attack.
traduit: 看起来像一场灰烬怪袭击。

original: There are more and more of those things showing up around here lately.
traduit: 最近这一带老是冒出那些东西，越来越频繁。

original: I suppose you'll have to find me a new steward.
traduit: 看起来你要帮我找个新管家了。

original: Try Raven Rock. They are in awe of me there. I'm sure almost anyone would be willing to serve me.
traduit: 去鸦石镇看看，那边的人都敬畏我。肯定是人人都乐意来服侍我。

original: Varona is dead. I found her body on the road.
traduit: 瓦罗纳死了。我在路上看到她的尸体。

original: Dead? Oh, merciful ancestors!
traduit: 死了？哦，仁慈的先祖啊！

original: That blasted wizard couldn't be bothered to give her some protection for those trips. This is all his fault.
traduit: 那个混蛋法师根本就没想过为她的路途提供保护，全是他的错。

original: Best tell Neloth. I'm sure he'll mourn for all of two seconds.
traduit: 最好跟内洛斯说一声。他最多就会哀悼两秒钟。

original: Dead? Truly?
traduit: 死了？真的？

original: Oh, Varona. She didn't deserve this. This is a dark day for Tel Mithryn.
traduit: 哦，瓦罗纳。她死的真不值。这是泰尔·米斯瑞恩的黑暗时光。

original: Go tell Master Neloth. When I'm done here, I'll prepare her grave.
traduit: 去告诉内洛斯大师吧。等我忙完了就去打理她的坟墓。

original: She's dead? Oh my. Master Neloth is not going to be happy to hear that.
traduit: 她死了？哦天哪，内洛斯大师听到后肯定不高兴。

original: Maybe you should be the one to tell him.
traduit: 不如你来跟他说吧。

original: It takes a strong will to command a dragon's soul. Perhaps you aren't as powerful as you think.
traduit: 掌控龙魂需要强大的意志。也许你没有想象中那么强大。

original: Not this time, Dragonborn. This one's mine.
traduit: 这次不行，龙裔。这条是我的。

original: This dragon's soul belongs to me.
traduit: 这条龙的灵魂属于我。

original: Do you ever wonder if it hurts? To have one's soul ripped out like that?
traduit: 你有想过那会痛吗？像那样把灵魂硬生生扯出来？

original: Thank you for your help. We will meet again soon.
traduit: 感谢你的协助。我们后会有期。

original: One step closer to my return.
traduit: 我的回归又近了一步。

original: I grow ever stronger, Dragonborn.
traduit: 我更强大了，龙裔。

original: Your people are free.
traduit: 你的族人自由了。

original: So it is. You have proven yourself an ally to the Skaal, and so the Skaal shall be allies to you.
traduit: 确实如此。你证明了自己是斯卡尔人的盟友，斯卡尔人也会如此待你。

original: It would seem so. And you are to thank for it.
traduit: 看来确实如此。这都是你的功劳啊。

original: Can you train me in Conjuration?
traduit: 你能训练我的召唤术吗？

original: Yes, but don't tell Master Neloth. I'd have to give him your payment.
traduit: 是的，但别告诉内洛斯大师。不然我得把你付的钱给他了。

original: Do you work with Neloth?
traduit: 你和内洛斯一起工作吗？

original: Not so much with, as for.
traduit: 不是一起，是为他工作。

original: I am Master Neloth's apprentice. He's teaching me the art of sorcery.
traduit: 我是内洛斯大师的学徒。他教我法术之道。

original: How long have you been studying the Skaal?
traduit: 你研究斯卡尔多久了？

original: Well, let me think...
traduit: 嗯，让我想想……

original: I suppose it's been nearly a year now. My goodness, how the time has flown!
traduit: 我想快一年了，天啊，时间过得好快！

original: You're not one of the Skaal?
traduit: 你不是斯卡尔人吗？

original: Oh no, most certainly not. I'm a historian. I'm here to learn about the history of Solstheim.
traduit: 哦，不是，当然不是。我是个历史学家。来这儿研究索瑟海姆的历史。

original: Solstheim is a fascinating place, but we know so little about its past. There are many mysteries that remain unsolved.
traduit: 索瑟海姆是个迷人的地方，但我们对这儿的历史几乎一无所知。还有很多谜团尚未解开。

original: What did you do in Skyrim, before you came back here?
traduit: 你回来以前，在天际是做什么的？

original: Well, my mother used to say that I was born an angry child.
traduit: 嗯，我妈常说我生来爱发火。

original: It's true that my heart has always been restless, and fighting was the only way I could find peace.
traduit: 而我也确实静不下来，打架成了唯一能让我静下来的事儿。

original: I was a soldier for a time, and then a mercenary, but I was never truly happy until I came here.
traduit: 我以前参过军，也当过佣兵，但来这儿后才找到了幸福。

original: What is "oneness with the land?"
traduit: “与这片土地合一”是什么意思？

original: The Skaal hunt not for sport, but to survive.
traduit: 斯卡尔人狩猎不为娱乐，只为谋生。

original: We believe that all creatures have a right to live as they will, and when we take what we need from them, we thank the beast for its gifts.
traduit: 我们认为所有生物都有以自己想要的方式生活的权利。当我们从野兽身上获得所需之物后，会感谢它们的赠予。

original: The less we disturb the land and the beasts within it, the more we respect the wishes of the All-Maker.
traduit: 我们越少干扰这片土地和其中的野兽，就越尊重造物主的意愿。

original: What wisdom can you share about hunting?
traduit: 关于狩猎，你可以分享什么经验吗？

original: The first piece of wisdom I teach to any hunter of the Skaal is to ask the simple question, should I truly kill this beast?
traduit: 我教给所有斯卡尔猎人的第一课，就是问自己一个简单的问题：我真的应该杀死这头野兽吗？

original: We take only what we need, and so we preserve the oneness with the land.
traduit: 我们只会狩猎供自己所需的部分，这样才能与这片土地合一。

original: What kinds of game do you hunt?
traduit: 你们的猎物有哪些？

original: Deer, bear and horker provide most of what we need for skins and meat.
traduit: 鹿、熊还有海象提供了我们需要的大部分皮和肉。

original: Sometimes, when the wolves grow too bold and threaten the village, we must hunt them to cull their numbers.
traduit: 有时，狼群会变得过于大胆，一旦对村子有威胁，我们也必须狩猎，减少它们的数量。

original: What else does a First Hunter do?
traduit: 首席猎人还有什么职责？

original: When we stalk large game, I lead our hunters in tracking the beast. It is also a way of saying that I am the most skilled hunter in the village.
traduit: 追踪大型猎物时，我负责带领其他猎人追踪。这也代表我是村里最有经验的猎人。

original: I doubt that an outsider could truly understand, but I hope my words have helped to answer your question.
traduit: 我想作为外来者你可能无法完全理解，但希望我的回答能为你解惑。

original: Who do you trade with?
traduit: 你们和哪些人做交易？

original: Many hunters pass through our village, and sometimes the Dark Elves of Raven Rock visit us.
traduit: 很多猎人会路过我们的村子，有时鸦石镇的暗精灵也会来拜访。

original: They bring us things from their homeland that we can't find on the island, such as spices, fine cloth and ores that we cannot mine here.
traduit: 他们从自己家乡带来了很多这个岛上找不到的东西，比如香料、上等布料和我们这儿挖不到的矿石。

original: It's true we Skaal prefer a simpler life than some, but we do still enjoy a luxury from time to time.
traduit: 我们斯卡尔人确实更喜欢简单的生活，但偶尔也会享受一些奢侈玩意儿。

original: Who or what is the All-Maker?
traduit: 造物主是什么？

original: You are an outsider, and I don't know if I can make you understand. I will try.
traduit: 我也不确定能否给你这样的外来者解释清楚，试试看吧。

original: The All-Maker is the maker of all things, and it is from the All-Maker that life flows like a great river.
traduit: 造物主创造了一切，生命如江河滔滔流淌，皆出自造物主之手。

original: As all rivers must return to the sea, so all life returns in time to the All-Maker.
traduit: 就像所有河流终汇成海，所有生命最终也会回归造物主。

original: I know our ways must seem strange to you, but the nine gods of the Empire are equally strange to us.
traduit: 我知道我们的传统对你来说很奇怪，但是帝国那九个神在我们眼中也很奇怪。

original: How did you become the leader of the village?
traduit: 你是如何成为村子领袖的？

original: I was chosen by the people of the village when our last leader, Skaf the Giant, departed the cold world to join the All-Maker.
traduit: 当上一位首领，“巨人”斯卡夫离开这寒冷世界去陪伴造物主后，村里的族人就推举我为领袖。

original: I suppose I've always spoken my mind and tried to do what's best for the Skaal. That's why the others call me Fanari Strong-Voice.
traduit: 我想是因为我总是心直口快，做对斯卡尔最有利的决定，所以他们才会叫我“强音”法娜丽。

original: Tell me more about your people, the Skaal.
traduit: 告诉我关于你们斯卡尔人的事。

original: We are Nords, much like those you'll find in Skyrim. Long ago our path diverged from that of our cousins on the mainland.
traduit: 我们是诺德人，跟你在天际看到的那些一样。很久以前，我们和内陆的远亲们渐行渐远。

original: We live as one with the land, for the land provides all that we need.
traduit: 我们与这片提供了一切生活所需的土地合为一体。

original: Also, like the Nords of old, we embrace the All-Maker. We do not worship the nine gods of the Empire.
traduit: 我们与古早诺德人一样，信奉造物主，从不拜帝国的那九个神。

original: These must be the "Great Workshops of Nchardak". Impressive even in ruins.
traduit: 这里一定是“尼查达克大工坊”了。即使成了废墟也很壮观。

original: In the city's days of glory, it was reputed to be able to assemble a complete automaton in a single day.
traduit: 在这座城市的光辉岁月里，号称是一天就能组装一台完整的百夫长。

original: Much of the Dwemer army at the Battle of Red Mountain must have come from here.
traduit: 红山之战的锻莫军队应该大多都来自于此。

original: Here are the cubes you left behind.
traduit: 这是你丢下的方典。

original: Here, I picked up this cube for you.
traduit: 来，我帮你拿回了这块方典。

original: Wouldn't it be easier just to turn off the trap? Like so?
traduit: 把陷阱关了不就简单了？像这样。

original: I hope the rest of the cubes are this easy to find. Although knowing the Dwemer, I rather doubt it.
traduit: 希望剩下的方典也这么好找。但就我对锻莫的了解，应该没这种好事。

original: You'll need a cube to unlock this door. I hope you remembered to pick up the cube I placed in the pedestal.
traduit: 这道门需要方典才能解开。希望你把我放在基座上的那块带上了。

original: You should be able to unseal this door with the control cube I gave you.
traduit: 用我给你的方典来开门啊。

original: Three of the cubes are through here. This seems like a sensible place to start.
traduit: 穿过这里可以拿到三块方典。从这里开始似乎很明智。

original: Aren't you going to read the book? I didn't go to all this trouble just to stand around admiring it.
traduit: 你不打算读这本书吗？我这么大费周章不只是为了站在它面前欣赏封面。

original: Only Storn can reveal the secrets you asked about.
traduit: 只有斯托恩才能解开你所求的秘密。

original: The land is out of balance. Miraak's power still corrupts the sacred Stones.
traduit: 这片土地失去了平衡。米拉克的力量依旧腐化着圣石。

original: Tell me more about this book, then.
traduit: 那么，告诉我关于这本书的事情。

original: Miraak had this? This does not look like something of the Dragon cult.
traduit: 米拉克的东西？这看来不像是拜龙教的。

original: It is a dark thing, unnatural. I would have nothing to do with it. But the Dark Elf Wizard, Neloth...
traduit: 这是非自然的黑暗造物，我不想和它有任何接触。但那个暗精灵法师，内洛斯……

original: He came to us some time ago, asking about Black Books. I believe he knows a great deal about them. Perhaps too much.
traduit: 不久前他来找我们问黑暗经书的事。他应该研究得很透彻。可能已经透彻过头了。

original: Seek him out to the south. Be cautious, Dragonborn. There is something else at work here.
traduit: 去南边找他吧。但是要小心，龙裔。这里头另有蹊跷。

original: That's not enough. I need to stop Miraak now.
traduit: 这还不够，我要立即阻止米拉克。

original: I cannot help with that. None here can. You will need the knowledge Miraak himself learned. You will need to learn more about this Black Book.
traduit: 这我帮不了你，这里没人能帮你。你需要米拉克学过的那些知识。还得更透彻地了解这本黑暗经书。

original: Look out for that Steam Centurion! Get to higher ground!
traduit: 小心那台蒸汽百夫长！到高处去！

original: Look out! Another Steam Centurion!
traduit: 注意！又一台蒸汽百夫长！

original: With the water level this high, we can swim across the collapsed part of the passage and reach the other side.
traduit: 水位这么高，我们可以直接游过崩塌的路段，到另一边去。

original: There's a passage up there. We could reach it if the water level was higher.
traduit: 这上面有通路。要是水位够高，我们就能过去。

original: You must have left a cube in one of the pump control pedestals. If you remove it, the pumps will stop and we'll be able to swim up there.
traduit: 你肯定忘了一个水泵控制基座上的方典。要是拿下来，水泵就会停止工作，我们就能浮上去了。

original: Unfortunately, each cube we retrieve shuts down the corresponding pumps, raising the water level. We'll have to be careful.
traduit: 不幸的是，每拿回来一块方典就会关闭对应的水泵，水位就会升高，我们得小心行事。

original: Very good. By my count, we've found a total of four cubes. I have one that you forgot to pick up. I hope you didn't leave any others lying around.
traduit: 很好。算了下我们一共找到了四个方典。我这里有一个你忘了拿的。希望你没有遗漏其他的了。

original: Very good. By my count, we've found a total of four cubes. Assuming you haven't dropped any anywhere.
traduit: 很好。算了下我们一共找到了四个方典。前提是你没在哪儿搞丢了。

original: Let's see where this leads.
traduit: 看看这儿通往哪里吧。

original: Ah, good! Another cube. We're finally making some progress.
traduit: 啊，很好！又一个方典。终于有些进展了。

original: Maybe through here.
traduit: 也许要穿过这儿。

original: Hmm, nothing down here.
traduit: 嗯，下面没东西。

original: Ah, good. Now we can see if we can find a way to get that next cube.
traduit: 啊，很好。我们现在来看看怎么拿到下一个方典。

original: It looks like we'll need to lower the water level to make any more progress.
traduit: 看来我们得降低水位才能继续了。

original: I believe these pillars will activate the pumps for this room, assuming they still work.
traduit: 我相信这些石柱能启动房间里的水泵，希望它们还能运转。

original: Good luck with that.
traduit: 祝你好运吧。

original: Now, I believe I owe you a little more than a debt of gratitude for all that work you did.
traduit: 啊，但你帮了我这么多，可不是说句谢谢就能报答的。

original: Here... it's not much, but it's the best an old, retired miner can do.
traduit: 拿着……虽然不多，但我这个退了休的矿工老头就只有这些了。

original: You were right all along. (Give journal)
traduit: 你一直以来都是对的。（给予日志）

original: Let me see that!
traduit: 我看看！

original: Ha, I knew it! Gratian's death wasn't because of a rockfall, it was just a story to keep people away from the tombs.
traduit: 哈，我就知道！格瑞希安绝不是死于塌方，那只是让人远离墓穴的托词。

original: Now that I have his journal in hand, I can get some closure from the East Empire Company. Make them pay for lying to everyone.
traduit: 既然我拿到了他的日记，也就可以和东帝国公司做个了断了。他们欺骗了所有人，应该付出代价。

original: I've returned.
traduit: 我回来了。

original: You're back!
traduit: 你回来了！

original: Please, tell me what you found.
traduit: 拜托了，告诉我你找到了什么。

original: Any idea of where to start?
traduit: 从哪儿开始找有想法吗？

original: Gratian kept a journal of notes about his discoveries. If you can find his... remains, I'm hoping it will help.
traduit: 格瑞希安把他的记载写在一本日记里。你要是能找到他的……遗体，我猜就用得上了。

original: Here's everything I have. The letter, the key. Please, do this for me so I can finally regain the respect that I've lost.
traduit: 我把所有东西都交给你，信，钥匙。拜托了，帮我这一回吧，这样我才能把丢掉的尊严挣回来。

original: So you do need my help.
traduit: 所以你需要我的帮助。

original: I do. I want to know what happened to Gratian, and what the East Empire Company is keeping from all of us.
traduit: 需要。我想知道格瑞希安出了什么事儿，还有东帝国公司在隐瞒什么。

original: Why are you telling me all of this?
traduit: 你为什么要跟我说这些？

original: Look, my wife nags that I'm too old to go traipsing around these mines chasing my story.
traduit: 听着，我老婆总念叨，说我一把年纪了，不该再为倒旧账而在矿场里瞎折腾了。

original: Time's my enemy... it's caught up with me before I could find the answers that I'm looking for.
traduit: 时间在和我作对……我还没能找到答案，就要被它追上了。

original: I still think you're crazy.
traduit: 我还是觉得你疯了。

original: Sigh. I don't care what you, or anyone else thinks about me.
traduit: 唉。我不在乎你，还是其他人怎么看我。

original: I admit, this does sound suspicious.
traduit: 我承认，这听上去很可疑。

original: Finally! Someone who believes me.
traduit: 总算有人相信我了。

original: I'm telling you... there's something big down there, something that the East Empire Company wanted to hide from everyone.
traduit: 我跟你说……下面的东西很重要，重要到东帝国公司不想任何人知道。

original: This is hardly proof of anything.
traduit: 这很难说是证据。

original: Now you're starting to sound like everyone else.
traduit: 那你和其他人没什么两样。

original: The key is to the locked section?
traduit: 这把钥匙可以通往封锁的矿区？

original: It is. Well, I assume it is. I haven't been able to find the entrance.
traduit: 是啊。嗯，我猜的。我到现在还没找到入口。

original: What did the letter say?
traduit: 信里写了什么？

original: It describes a discovery that was made in the mine by some of the diggers. They wanted Gratian to take a closer look.
traduit: 信上说，几个挖掘工人在矿里有些发现。他们想让格瑞希安去调查清楚。

original: The East Empire Company must have felt it was of great value, as they locked that section of the mine off from everyone else.
traduit: 东帝国公司一定是觉得那玩意儿很珍贵，所以把那片矿区封锁起来不让别人进去了。

original: What's your proof?
traduit: 你的证据呢？

original: My wife and I were cleaning out our home, and we came across some of my great-grandfather's things locked in an old chest.
traduit: 我们两口子在打扫屋子的时候，偶然发现了我曾祖父的遗物，被锁在一个旧箱子里。

original: I found an unsent letter he'd written to the East Empire Company, and a key.
traduit: 我发现了一封打算寄给东帝国公司的信，还有一把钥匙。

original: How did he die?
traduit: 他怎么死的？

original: East Empire Company called it "a terrible accident," claiming that he was lost in a rockfall, but I know better.
traduit: 东帝国公司声称那是“糟糕的意外”，说他死于塌方，但我知道那是假的。

original: East Empire Company?
traduit: 东帝国公司？

original: You never heard of them?
traduit: 你没听说过他们？

original: They're the largest trading company in Tamriel, originally chartered by the Emperor of Cyrodiil himself.
traduit: 那可是全泰姆瑞尔最大的贸易公司，最初由希罗帝尔皇帝特许成立。

original: Who was your great-grandfather?
traduit: 你的曾祖父是谁？

original: Gratian Caerellius. He spent his entire life exploring ancient ruins across Tamriel and he died in these very mines almost 200 years ago.
traduit: 格瑞希安·凯利乌斯。他一生都在勘探全泰姆瑞尔的古代遗迹，大约200年前死在了这矿里。

original: But mark my words, these mines hold a secret that could put Raven Rock back on the map.
traduit: 记住我说的，这矿里藏着一个足以让鸦石镇重新闻名的秘密。

original: What sort of a secret would be hidden here?
traduit: 这里藏着什么秘密？

original: A secret the East Empire Company swept under the rug two centuries ago.
traduit: 一个被东帝国公司藏了两百年的秘密。

original: It killed my great-grandfather, and left Raven Rock with a worthless and tainted mine.
traduit: 它害死了我的曾祖父，让鸦石镇只剩下一个没价值还被污染了的矿。

original: It's dangerous here for an old man.
traduit: 对一个老人来说这儿很危险。

original: Ask most of the folks around here and they'd agree with you.
traduit: 这附近的大伙儿谁不是这么说呢。

original: I'm just exploring.
traduit: 我只是在探查这地方。

original: Exploring, huh? Most folks think this place isn't worth the effort.
traduit: 探查，哈？大多数人都觉得没必要费这个力。

original: Perhaps I could help.
traduit: 也许我帮得上忙。

original: Hmph, maybe. Been difficult trusting people lately, they think I'm crazy.
traduit: 哼，也许吧。但我很难再信任何人了，大家都觉得我疯了。

original: Busy doing what?
traduit: 忙着做什么呢？

original: Why should I tell you? I don't even know who you are.
traduit: 为什么要跟你说？我甚至都不认识你。

original: Who in the blazes are you?! Can't you see I'm busy?
traduit: 你他妈又是谁？！没看到我很忙吗？

original: Crescius, you're an obstinate old fool and you're going to get yourself killed.
traduit: 克雷修斯，你个顽固傻老头子，迟早把自己害死。

original: Just let me go, woman!
traduit: 让我去就是了，你这娘们儿！

original: That was almost two centuries ago. There may be nothing left to find.
traduit: 那差不多是两百年前的事了。下面八成找不到什么东西了。

original: And I'm telling you that I'll do whatever it takes to find my great-grandfather's remains. He's down here, I can feel it.
traduit: 我告诉你，我会不惜一切代价找到我太爷爷的遗体。他就在下面，我都感觉得到。

original: Crescius, last time you explored the mine you almost fell to your death. I'm not spending the rest of my days as a widow!
traduit: 克雷修斯，你上次探查矿坑的时候就差点摔死了。我可不打算下半辈子守寡！

original: Damn it, woman! I said to leave me be!
traduit: 混账娘们儿！我叫你别管我！

original: After all that, why?
traduit: 经历了这些，为什么给我？

original: I just wanted to remind that codger you can't just go around taking things from other people.
traduit: 我就只是想提醒那老头儿，不能就这样随便拿走别人的东西。

original: Now that you've delivered the message, I'm satisfied.
traduit: 既然你已经替我转达了，就够了。

original: Besides, that pickaxe hasn't done me any good in years. Maybe you can put it to good use.
traduit: 再说，这东西搁我手里已经好多年没派上用场了，说不定给你才能物尽其用。

original: I have your Ancient Nordic Pickaxe.
traduit: 我拿到你的古诺德鹤嘴锄了。

original: So you finally tracked down old Crescius, eh? Quite a character, isn't he.
traduit: 所以你真去找老克雷修斯了？他挺有个性吧。

original: Tell you what. Since you went through all the trouble of finding it for me and all, you keep it.
traduit: 这样吧。既然你费了这么大劲儿帮我和大家找到它，你就拿着吧。

original: Let me think about this.
traduit: 让我想想。

original: Good. Now let me get back to what I was doing.
traduit: 好，那我回去忙我的了。

original: Fine, you keep it.
traduit: 好吧，你留着。

original: Now you're finally talking some sense. A mining tool belongs in a mining family.
traduit: 这才叫讲道理嘛。采矿工具就该属于矿工家庭。

original: Just tell him I lost it or something.
traduit: 你告诉他我弄丢了就行。

original: It doesn't belong to you.
traduit: 它到底不属于你。

original: Oh, very well. Here. Tell him I hope he drops the thing on his foot.
traduit: 哦，好吧。拿去。跟他说希望这东西会砸到他的脚。

original: Glover wants his Ancient Nordic Pickaxe back.
traduit: 葛洛文想把他的古诺德鹤嘴锄要回去。

original: The damn fool doesn't even deserve to have it! The pickaxe was made for mining, not selling.
traduit: 那个混账傻子根本不配拥有它！这把鹤嘴锄是拿来采矿，不是拿来卖的。

original: I'll bet he stole it from the Skaal in the first place.
traduit: 我敢赌他一开始是从斯卡尔村偷出来的。

original: I assume it's rare.
traduit: 我猜很稀有吧。

original: I don't think I've come across more than a chunk or two in my lifetime, and smithing's my trade.
traduit: 我想我这辈子最多也就见过一两块吧，锻造可是我吃饭的本事。

original: If you're looking to learn more, you should head over to the Skaal Village. Someone there's bound to know more about it than I do.
traduit: 你要是想了解更多，就该去斯卡尔村。那儿肯定有人比我懂得多。

original: Is stalhrim a type of ore?
traduit: 魔冰是一种矿石吗？

original: Calling stalhrim an ore is like calling my forge a campfire.
traduit: 把魔冰叫作矿石的话，那我的锻炉就是营火了。

original: Some folks say it's "enchanted ice," but I think there's more to it than that.
traduit: 有些人说它是“附魔过的冰”，但我不认为就那么简单。

original: What's an Ancient Nordic Pickaxe?
traduit: 古诺德鹤嘴锄是什么？

original: It's the only tool tough enough to crack stalhrim, is what it is.
traduit: 那是唯一可以敲碎魔冰的强韧工具。

original: Not many of those beauties left in the world... forging them is a lost art.
traduit: 这种好东西在世上不剩几把了……它们的锻造方法已经是门失传的技术。

original: The one Crescius "borrowed" came from the Skaal Village up north. I, uh, traded them some goods for it.
traduit: 克雷修斯“借走”的那把是从北边儿斯卡尔村来的。我，呃，用些货物从他们那儿换来的。

original: Can't you just get the guard to find Crescius?
traduit: 你就不能让卫兵去找克雷修斯吗？

original: Um, I prefer to handle these things on my own.
traduit: 嗯，这些事情我宁愿自己来。

original: Look, if you see Crescius, tell him to give me that pickaxe back and I'll pay you for the trouble.
traduit: 听着，要是你看到克雷修斯，跟他说把鹤嘴锄还给我，我会付你跑路费的。

original: Why all the fuss over a simple pickaxe?
traduit: 不就是一把鹤嘴锄吗？

original: No, no, no. This isn't just your run-of-the-mill pickaxe... I'm talking about an Ancient Nordic Pickaxe.
traduit: 不不不。可别小瞧了……我说的是一把古诺德鹤嘴锄。

original: They don't exactly grow on trees, you know.
traduit: 这东西可不常见。

original: What's the matter?
traduit: 怎么了？

original: You haven't seen Crescius Caerellius have you? That foolish old man's taken my pickaxe again!
traduit: 你有看到克雷修斯·凯利乌斯了吗？那个傻老头又把我的鹤嘴锄拿走了！

original: Is Master Neloth a good teacher?
traduit: 内洛斯算是个好老师吗？

original: Um. Well, he is a very great wizard. It's a great honor for him to have taken me as his apprentice.
traduit: 嗯。其实，他是个很伟大的法师，收我当学徒是我的荣幸。

original: To be honest, it's horrible. He's very unpleasant and hardly teaches me anything. Sometimes he uses me in his experiments.
traduit: 但是老实说，糟透了。他很难相处，几乎没教我什么。有时还拿我做实验。

original: Even so, I pick up a lot from just watching him.
traduit: 尽管如此，我单看着他还是学到了很多。

original: Can't you make them stop?
traduit: 你不能阻止他们吗？

original: Make them stop? Oh no, certainly not. At least not yet.
traduit: 阻止他们？不，当然不能了。还不是时候。

original: Not until I've figured out what is going on.
traduit: 我得先知道发生了什么。

original: Imagine the power of being able to command entire villages to do your bidding.
traduit: 想象一下能够控制整个村庄为你所用的力量。

original: Imagine what I could do with that power.
traduit: 试想要是我有那种力量会做什么。

original: Where is everyone?
traduit: 其他人呢？

original: They are off working on their pillar. Happens every night.
traduit: 他们去建石柱了，每晚都这样。

original: Then where's his great-grandfather?
traduit: 那么他的曾祖父在哪儿？

original: I'm sure he's down there somewhere, buried under a mountain of rubble like the East Empire Company claims.
traduit: 我确定就在下面某处，埋在一座碎石山堆下面了，就跟东帝国公司说的那样。

original: My greatest fear is that my stubborn mule of a husband will end up suffering the same fate.
traduit: 我最怕的是我那犟得跟头驴一样的丈夫最后也落得这种下场。

original: I'm guessing you don't agree with Crescius's story.
traduit: 我猜你不会认同克雷修斯的说法。

original: Poor Crescius is aging and I believe it's addled his mind.
traduit: 可怜的克雷修斯老了，恐怕他的脑子也糊涂了。

original: As the years have passed, it's gotten worse. He's become obsessed with his theories of conspiracy.
traduit: 随着时间推移，情况更糟糕了。他深陷于自己那些阴谋论。

original: Be careful down there, the mine can be treacherous.
traduit: 在那下面小心点，矿里是有潜在危险的。

original: At least hear me out before you walk away.
traduit: 在走开前至少听我说完。

original: Sure, ignore the ravings of a "crazy old man." I get it.
traduit: 当然了，别理会一个“疯老头”的疯话。我懂。

original: Well? What happened!
traduit: 嗯？发生什么了！

original: Try the lower sections of the mine. I've never been able to get that far.
traduit: 去矿井的下部找找看吧，我一直没能下到那么深。

original: Decided to give me a listen, eh? Good.
traduit: 终于想听我说了吗？很好。

original: What do you want?
traduit: 你想怎样？

original: Why you're leading Crescius on, I'll never understand.
traduit: 我真是搞不懂，你为什么要教唆克雷修斯。

original: My apologies for Crescius's ravings.
traduit: 抱歉，克雷修斯总是胡言乱语。

original: What?! Ooooohhhhhh Nooooooooooo!!!!!
traduit: 什么？！哦哦哦哦哦哦不！！！！

original: It's working, I'm flying! I'm really flying! Hahahaha!
traduit: 成功了，我在飞了！我真的在飞！哈哈哈哈！

original: They said it couldn't be done. They said it. They said it. But they were wrong!
traduit: 他们说过是不可能的，说过的。但他们都错啦！

original: There's nothing to worry about, nothing to worry about at all...
traduit: 没什么好担心的，完全不用担心……

original: The book in my dream showed me...
traduit: 我梦里的书告诉过我……

original: To touch the sky like a dragon...
traduit: 像龙一样触及天空……

original: I have an idea. I'll wait here and retrieve this cube once you find the last one we need. Good luck!
traduit: 我有个点子。我就在这儿等着，等你找到最后一个方典我就取下这个。祝你好运！

original: What a mess. I'm getting tired of wading around in this muck.
traduit: 真是令人作呕。在这脏水池里跋涉真让我受不了。

original: I'd guess that must be the pump activator up there.
traduit: 我想上面那就是水泵启动器。

original: But how to reach it?
traduit: 但我们要怎么上去呢？

original: You'll need to lower the water level before we can proceed any further.
traduit: 你得先降低水位我们才能继续前进。

original: The last cube is somewhere through the northern door. We won't be able to open it until the water level is lower.
traduit: 最后一个方典就在北侧的门附近。但是要先降低水位才能开门。

original: If I'd known that I was married to a fox who digs under beds to look for treats, then perhaps I would have.
traduit: 我要是知道娶了条会到床底下挖洞找礼物的狐狸，就会藏的更好了。

original: That is sweet of you, Deor, but you should find a better hiding place next time.
traduit: 你太好了，迪乌尔，但下次该藏在更隐蔽的地方。

original: What?! That was supposed to be a gift! I was hoping to surprise you.
traduit: 什么？那是我要给你的礼物！本来想给你个惊喜的。

original: Husband, do you know why there's a pouch of spiced tea leaves under the bed?
traduit: 老公，为什么床下有包香料茶叶？

original: Very well, I'll take a look at it later.
traduit: 好吧，我等会儿看看。

original: One of our chairs is about to break. It will need to be mended with a new leg.
traduit: 我们有张椅子要断了。需要条新的椅脚。

original: What for?
traduit: 干什么用？

original: Make sure that you save some wood from the pile.
traduit: 记得在木材堆里留几根木头。

original: It makes my heart heavy, to think of killing a beast when we have no need of its hide or its meat. That is not our way.
traduit: 一想到我们本不需要它的皮肉，就感到心痛。太不像我们的作风了。

original: The bear might find food elsewhere. We will leave it alone.
traduit: 如果那头熊去别的地方找食物，就别碰了它。

original: We had better do something about it, then.
traduit: 那我们最好处理下吧。

original: Yes, I know the one you saw. It watches us each night, always moving closer.
traduit: 对，我知道你看到的那一头。它每天晚上都在观察我们，而且靠得越来越近。

original: As the ashfall worsens, the land and water are poisoned. The animals have less to eat and become desperate.
traduit: 火山灰越下越多，土壤和水质都被污染了。野兽的食物变少，就会铤而走险。

original: There was a great brown bear on the slopes the other day. I could swear by the All-Maker that it was watching the village.
traduit: 上次山坡上出现了一头大棕熊。我敢对造物主发誓，它肯定在观察我们的村子。

original: Then get back to it, you lazy horker! The day is wasting.
traduit: 那就快回去干啊，你个懒海象！已经浪费一整天了。

original: There's no time for that now, I have work to do.
traduit: 现在可没时间，我有活儿要干。

original: Complaining to me won't make your pain go away, Oslaf. Go and see Edla, perhaps she has a remedy.
traduit: 跟我抱怨也不会减轻你的背痛，奥斯拉夫。去找艾迪拉，她可能有药水。

original: There's a terrible ache in my back today.
traduit: 我的背今天好痛。

original: I'm sure the All-Maker has more important concerns than your potatoes, Oslaf.
traduit: 造物主肯定有比你的土豆更重要的事情要办，奥斯拉夫。

original: Hm, perhaps I'll make an offering to the All-Maker. He can make our potatoes ripen as surely as he makes the snow fall from the sky.
traduit: 嗯，也许我该去祭拜造物主。求他让我们的土豆成熟，就像能让天下雪一样。

original: Be patient, my husband. The crop doesn't grow faster because it hears your growling stomach.
traduit: 耐心点，老公。作物不会因为你肚子饿就长得更快。

original: Are the potatoes ready for eating? I want to roast them with some onions for the night's meal.
traduit: 土豆可以吃了吗？我想加些洋葱烤来当晚饭。

original: Well, Deor and Yrsa are still young. In time, I'm sure that they will have many children.
traduit: 嗯，迪乌尔和依尔莎还很年轻。我敢说他们迟早会有很多孩子。

original: Perhaps one of them will want to learn the ways of iron-shaping.
traduit: 或许其中某个愿意学习打铁呢。

original: Nikulas is restless. He's like an eagle, always seeking to fly somewhere new.
traduit: 尼库拉斯很好动。他就像只鹰，总是想飞到新的地方去。

original: I do not think he has the patience to work the forge.
traduit: 我不认为他有耐心干锻炉的活儿。

original: All-Maker willing, young Nikulas will take an interest. I would be happy to teach him.
traduit: 造物主同意的话，年轻的尼库拉斯会有兴趣的。我会很乐意教导他。

original: It's tradition that the son of the smith take his father's place, but you have no son. Who will become smith of the Skaal after you?
traduit: 让铁匠的儿子子承父业是传统了，但你没儿子。之后谁来当斯卡尔的铁匠呢？

original: You speak the truth, Baldor. It makes my heart glad to see her keeping busy after Heifnir's death.
traduit: 你说得对，鲍德尔。海福尼尔过世后，能看到她忙着干活儿让我很安心。

original: Very well, I'll ask Edla to trade for some coal.
traduit: 好吧，我会找艾迪拉买些煤炭。

original: True, but I think that Edla would be hurt if you didn't give her the chance to trade for it first.
traduit: 是啊，但我想艾迪拉要是知道你没先找她买，会很失望的。

original: You know how happy it makes her to play the village peddler
traduit: 你也知道她有多喜欢扮做村里的小贩。

original: I could travel to Raven Rock and purchase some more.
traduit: 我可以去趟鸦石镇买些回来。

original: We're nearly out of coal again.
traduit: 我们的煤炭又要用完了。

original: Her name is forge. Now be silent before she hears you and becomes angry.
traduit: 她叫锻炉。现在安静点儿，免得她听到后发火。

original: Oh? And what is her name, this secret wife of yours?
traduit: 哦？那她叫什么，你那个秘密老婆？

original: Because I already have a wife, and I wouldn't want to make her jealous.
traduit: 因为我已经有老婆了，我不想让她嫉妒。

original: Why have you never taken a wife, Baldor?
traduit: 你怎么不找个老婆呢，鲍德尔？

original: Watch out, the water's rising even higher with both pumps shut down.
traduit: 小心，两个水泵都关闭后，水位变得更高了。

original: Do you have the cube? Good, good! Then I'll take this cube and we can be on our way.
traduit: 你拿到方典了吗？好，很好！我再拿回这块就能继续上路了。

original: That's it! Don't touch anything else. Quickly now.
traduit: 就是这样！现在什么都别碰。快走吧。

original: Well, that's progress of a sort. But we'll need all three down at once to get to the pump control.
traduit: 嗯，这也算某种进展吧。但我们需要把三座桥同时降下来才能去水泵控制器那边。

original: We'll need to get all three of these bridges down in order to reach the pump control.
traduit: 我们得把这三座桥都降下来才到得了水泵控制器那儿。

original: I have some cubes I'm sure you're going to need.
traduit: 我这儿有些方典，你肯定用得上。

original: You'll need the cube I picked up to start all the boilers.
traduit: 你得拿回我拿来的这块方典，才能开启所有锅炉。

original: I'm quite sure the boilers will not work while they're under water.
traduit: 我很确定那些锅炉没法在水下运作。

original: I thought you understood how this worked by now. The water level needs to be lower for the boilers to work at all.
traduit: 我还以为你已经明白流程了。只有先降低水位，才能让锅炉运转。

original: It should now be as simple as using the cubes to turn on the four boilers.
traduit: 现在应该可以用方典轻松打开四个锅炉。

original: As much as I enjoy this place, I'm ready to see if we can actually open the book's protective case. You do still remember why we're here?
traduit: 虽然我很喜欢这个地方，但我也想知道到底能不能打开书的保护装置。你还没忘我们来的目的吧？

original: You need to start the four boilers. Then we should be able to open the book's protective case upstairs.
traduit: 你必须先启动四个锅炉。之后我们就应该能打开楼上书的保护装置了。

original: Is there some problem?
traduit: 有什么问题吗？

original: Now we can finally see about getting those boilers started.
traduit: 现在我们终于可以启动那些锅炉了。

original: With the cubes I retrieved, we should now have a total of five. I hope you haven't left more scattered about.
traduit: 算上我拿来的方典，我们现在应该总共有五块。希望你没有遗漏其他的。

original: With the cube I retrieved from the pumping pedestal, we should now have five cubes - exactly what we need.
traduit: 算上我从水泵控制台拿来的方典，我们现在应该有五块——刚好凑够了。

original: That was easier than I expected. I'm glad you were here to do all the hard work.
traduit: 比我想的要简单。很高兴麻烦的活儿你都包了。

original: No.
traduit: 不。

original: Then this will be over soon for you.
traduit: 那么很快就结束了。

original: Good. Then let us see who truly has the soul of the Dov.
traduit: 很好。那么我们来看看谁才有真的都瓦之魂。

original: The time for talking is long past.
traduit: 废话就不多说了。

original: What's the unusual armor you're wearing?
traduit: 这件奇怪盔甲是怎么回事？

original: Ah, this is bonemold armor... quite impressive, wouldn't you say?
traduit: 啊，这是骨模盔甲……看了就忘不掉，对吧？

original: It's fashioned from actual bone that's been reinforced with a resin-like material and then shaped to form the armored plating.
traduit: 这玩意儿是用真骨头当原料，以树脂状的材料加固后，塑形成了现在的装甲板。

original: It might appear brittle, but I'd wager it could stop the blow of a weapon better than iron or steel.
traduit: 可能看起来很脆，但我打包票，它可比普通钢铁耐造多了。

original: Why have such elite soldiers on this island?
traduit: 为什么岛上有这些精锐士兵？

original: To protect Councilor Morvayn, of course.
traduit: 当然是为了保护莫尔凡议员。

original: He has quite a few friends on the Council back in Morrowind and they wanted to ensure his safety while he was here.
traduit: 他在晨风的议会有不少朋友，他们希望确保他在这里安然无恙。

original: Other than that, I'm not at liberty to discuss it.
traduit: 除此之外，我不便透露。

original: Who are the Redoran Guard?
traduit: 瑞多然卫兵是什么人？

original: All of the soldiers in this town are Redoran Guard... some of the best warriors that House Redoran has to offer.
traduit: 瑞多然家的精英战士。

original: I've spent quite a few years honing their skills and I can assure you they're not just your average city guard.
traduit: 我花了好几年来磨练他们的技巧，可以向你保证他们不是什么普通的城市守卫。

original: Regardless, I hope to return there someday... which doesn't seem likely given my husband's commitment to Councilor Morvayn.
traduit: 无论如何，我希望某天能回到那里……虽然看起来违背了我丈夫向莫尔凡议员作出的承诺。

original: Doesn't sound that impressive.
traduit: 听起来没那么了不起。

original: Hmph. Well, beauty's in the eye of the beholder, I suppose.
traduit: 哼，好吧，我想每个人审美不同。

original: It sounds like quite a sight.
traduit: 听起来景致绝佳。

original: I haven't seen the city in over fifty years. Even for a Dunmer, that seems like an eternity.
traduit: 我已经五十多年没见过这座城了，即使是丹莫也感觉是一辈子那么久。

original: Where are you from originally?
traduit: 你的故乡在哪儿？

original: Adril and I lived in Blacklight, the capital city of Morrowind.
traduit: 阿德尔和我原本住在晨风的首都黑光城。

original: House Redoran has improved Blacklight substantially over the last thousand years... its grandeur rivals that of Mournhold itself.
traduit: 瑞多然家千年来大力建设着黑光城……它的雄伟不亚于哀伤之城。

original: The Rootspire where the Council of Great Houses meet is something to behold.
traduit: 大家族议会所在的“根塔”值得一观。

original: You haven't told him how you feel?
traduit: 你没跟他说你的感受吗？

original: I'm the wife of a Second Councilor and certain things are expected of me.
traduit: 作为副议员的妻子，我要负责一些特定事务。

original: The most important is that I stand by Adril, no matter how I feel. And I intend to do that until we get off this miserable rock.
traduit: 重要的是不管感受如何，都要支持阿德尔。在我们离开这座可悲的小岛前，我都会这么做。

original: Perhaps you should return to Morrowind.
traduit: 也许你该回晨风去。

original: I assure you, if I could convince Adril to do that, I'd be on the next ship back to Blacklight.
traduit: 我可以保证，要是真能说服阿德尔这么做，我立马就搭船回黑光城了。

original: Unfortunately, Adril and Councilor Morvayn are very close friends, and they will never abandon one another... despite my feelings.
traduit: 可惜阿德尔和莫尔凡议员是非常要好的朋友，他们永远不会抛弃彼此……不论我的感受如何。

original: You worry much on your husband's behalf.
traduit: 你很担心你的丈夫啊。

original: He's in grave danger, and yet he continues to place himself in harm's way.
traduit: 他的处境已经很危险了，但他还是继续将自己置于危险之中。

original: When I fall asleep at night, all I can do is hope he'll still be there when I awaken.
traduit: 我每晚入睡时，唯一能做的就是祈祷醒来后他还在身边。

original: This island was never meant for us. There's too much death here.
traduit: 我们不该来这座岛的，这里随时笼罩于死亡之下。

original: Who's your husband?
traduit: 你的丈夫是？

original: Adril Arano, Second Councilor of Raven Rock.
traduit: 阿德尔·阿拉诺，鸦石镇的副议员。

original: How I hate that title... damn fool's going to get himself killed over it someday.
traduit: 我恨这个头衔……那个傻子迟早会为它丧命。

original: You must owe him quite a bit.
traduit: 你一定亏欠他很多。

original: We've fought quite a few battles together, and saved each other's lives on more than one occasion.
traduit: 我们多次一同上战场，互相不止一次救过对方的命。

original: Our bond is our strength. We've always been at each other's side and nothing will ever change that.
traduit: 我们的纽带就是我们的力量，总是在彼此身边，没什么可以把我们拆开。

original: Are you friends with Councilor Morvayn?
traduit: 你和莫尔凡议员是朋友吗？

original: I've known the councilor since we were both quite young. We rose the ranks in House Redoran together.
traduit: 我跟莫尔凡自幼相识，一起在瑞多然家内向上攀升。

original: When word arrived in Blacklight that the Councilor's father had passed, I was asked to sail to Raven Rock with him as his second.
traduit: 当议员的父亲过世的消息传到黑光城后，我被邀请作为副手和他一起去鸦石镇。

original: It meant passing on better opportunities at home, but I didn't want to leave his side.
traduit: 那意味着放弃了家乡更好的机会，但我不想离开他的身边。

original: Has security been an issue?
traduit: 这里不够安全吗？

original: This isn't exactly the city of Blacklight. We're on the frontier out here, and we've had more than a fair share of troubles.
traduit: 这里与黑光城大不相同。身处边疆，自然会遇到了不少的麻烦。

original: After all we've been through together, I refuse to let Councilor Morvayn down.
traduit: 但与莫尔凡议员共患难这么多年，我不能让他失望。

original: Why are you so suspicious of visitors?
traduit: 为何对访客这么多疑？

original: I have to be. As Second Councilor, the security of Raven Rock is my primary concern.
traduit: 我没得选。作为副议员，鸦石镇的安危是我最关心的问题。

original: Raven Rock the only settlement on the island?
traduit: 鸦石镇是岛上唯一的居住地？

original: Well, there's a small enclave of Nords to the north at Skaal Village. They pretty much keep to themselves, and we both like it that way.
traduit: 呃，北面有块很小的诺德飞地叫做斯卡尔村。他们几乎与世隔绝，这也正合我们的意。

original: Then there's Tel Mithryn to the east. The Telvanni live over there... sort of a strange lot, but since we're both from Morrowind, we get along.
traduit: 然后东边儿是泰尔·米斯瑞恩。泰瓦尼家住那儿……他们有点奇怪，但既然我们都来自晨风，相处得也还行。

original: Other than that, Solstheim is crawling with bandits and Reiklings, but that's to be expected living on the frontier like this.
traduit: 除此之外，索瑟海姆到处都是强盗和瑞克灵，但毕竟是在边疆地区，也可以理解。

original: Do you rule all of Solstheim?
traduit: 你们统治整个索瑟海姆吗？

original: Solstheim is theoretically under my rule, but without revenue from the mine, I lack the resources to actually govern anything but Raven Rock itself.
traduit: 理论上整个索瑟海姆都归我管，但是少了矿场的盈余后，我就没有统治鸦石镇以外地方的资源了。

original: Not that there's much beyond the confines of our town anyway.
traduit: 但其实除了我们的镇子，这儿也没什么了。

original: If you're interested in pursuing the subject, help yourself to any of the historical volumes in my library.
traduit: 如果对这个议题有兴趣，欢迎你来我的图书馆随意阅读历史书卷。

original: Sounds rather complicated.
traduit: 听上去很复杂。

original: Hmm. Pity that one of our own people doesn't fully grasp our ways.
traduit: 嗯，就连我族同胞也没能完全理解我们的规矩，真是遗憾。

original: Yes, I imagine it would to someone not of our people.
traduit: 是啊，外人想必很难理解。

original: But you said Redoran leads the Council.
traduit: 可你刚刚才说议会是由瑞多然主导。

original: Well of course. With four other houses on the Council, someone has to keep the rabble organized.
traduit: 当然了，议会也包括其他四个大家族，总得有人把这群乌合之众组织起来。

original: Our house leads the Council by virtue of our preeminence in battle, wisdom, and ancestral glory.
traduit: 我们家族领导议会凭的是战场上的卓越表现、智慧以及自古以来的荣耀。

original: Council? You mean there's no Jarl?
traduit: 议会，你们没有领主吗？

original: This isn't Skyrim, outlander. A group of powerful and influential Dunmer families have been ruling Morrowind for millennia.
traduit: 这里不是天际，外地人。权势显赫的丹莫家族们已经统治晨风数千年之久。

original: They embody a council made up of five Great Houses: Telvanni, Dres, Indoril, Sadras and Redoran.
traduit: 五个大家族组成了议会：泰瓦尼、德莱斯、因多瑞尔、萨德拉斯和瑞多然。

original: What is House Redoran?
traduit: 瑞多然家是什么？

original: You've never heard of House Redoran?
traduit: 你没听说过瑞多然家？

original: We're the mightiest of the Great Houses and we lead the Council, the ruling body of Morrowind.
traduit: 我们是最强盛的丹莫大家族，我们主导着晨风的统治机构————议会。

original: Don't tell me you believe that rot! Well, as soon as Jorn gets back, you'll see. You'll see.
traduit: 别跟我说你相信那些鬼话！乔恩回来你就知道了，等着看吧。

original: We don't even know what's inside. And besides, there's... the curse.
traduit: 我们根本不知道里面有什么。况且，这儿……被诅咒了。

original: See? I told you. Just where the map said it would be.
traduit: 看吧？我都说了。就跟地图上画的一样。

original: I'm here about the Stalhrim map.
traduit: 我来这里找一张魔冰地图。

original: So you know my purpose here, then? I suppose you must have found that dullard of a blacksmith.
traduit: 看来你知道我的目的了，对吧？我猜你找到那个笨铁匠了。

original: Unfortunately for you, my mission here is also a secret. To protect it, I have no choice but to silence you.
traduit: 你运气不好，我这是趟秘密行动。为了保住秘密我别无选择，只能杀你灭口。

original: Now, give me one good reason that I should not kill you where you stand.
traduit: 现在，给我个理由，说服我不用当场杀了你。

original: I'm not sure. Perhaps I'm just remembering something wrong.
traduit: 我不确定，可能只是我记错了。

original: I don't know. I keep thinking of the Earth Stone... Something to do with that.
traduit: 我不知道，我在想土石……应该和那个有些关系。

original: Can you tell me anything about him?
traduit: 你能告诉我些关于他的事吗？

original: I hear that name, and I see a temple, here on Solstheim. What could that mean?
traduit: 我听说过这个名字，见过那个神殿，就在这索瑟海姆。这意味着什么呢？

original: I'm not sure. I think so, but the only thing that comes to mind is a shrine near the Earth Stone.
traduit: 我不确定，应该吧，但是我唯一想的起来的，是土石附近的一座祭坛。

original: Do you know him or not?
traduit: 你到底认不认识他？

original: Maybe... I can't help but think of some sort of temple here on the island. Why would that be?
traduit: 也许吧……我总会想到这座岛上的某个神殿。为什么会这样？

original: Is he somewhere else on Solstheim?
traduit: 他在索瑟海姆岛上其他的某个地方吗？

original: I just can't be sure. I... I don't think I like talking about this.
traduit: 我真的不确定。我……我不想讨论这个。

original: Where have you heard his name? Please try and think.
traduit: 你是在哪儿听过他的名字的？请试着回想一下？

original: No, I'm sure of that. And yet... I think I had a dream of a temple, and he was there.
traduit: 不，我很确定。但是……我好像梦到了一座神殿，他就在那儿。

original: Is he someone here in Raven Rock?
traduit: 他是鸦石镇的人吗？

original: It's difficult... Something about it doesn't feel right. A... A temple, here on the island. That's all I can recall.
traduit: 很难说……感觉太不真实了。一座……神殿，就在这岛上。我只能想起这些了。

original: Try to remember.
traduit: 仔细想想。

original: It's so strange. I feel like it's from a dream. Something about the Earth Stone, and a shrine... That's it. That's all I can think of.
traduit: 太奇怪了。我感觉是在梦里见过。好像和土石有关系，还有一个祭坛……没错，我就记得这些了。

original: Tell me anything you can.
traduit: 把你知道的都告诉我。

original: I... I'm not sure. I don't want to talk about this.
traduit: 我……我不太确定。我不想谈这些。

original: Which is it? Yes or no?
traduit: 到底是啥？有还是没有？

original: I don't know why, but I'm thinking about a temple, here on the island. Maybe it was just a bad dream.
traduit: 我不晓得原因，但是能想起来一座神殿，就在这岛上。可能就是场噩梦吧。

original: Is there anything you can tell me?
traduit: 你能告诉我些什么？

original: It was very strange. Was I... building something? A shrine, down on the beach near the Earth Stone? I'm not sure.
traduit: 很奇怪。我是在……建什么东西？一座祭坛，在土石旁边的沙滩上？我不确定。

original: Tell me about your dream.
traduit: 告诉我你梦到了什么。

original: Maybe I'm just confused. I can't be sure.
traduit: 也许我就是记错了。我不确定。

original: What did he want?
traduit: 他想要什么？

original: I don't know... I feel strange just thinking about it. A temple, maybe? Here on the island? Something about a temple...
traduit: 我不知道……一想起来就觉得很奇怪。可能是一座神殿？就在这岛上？反正是和一座神殿有关的……

original: Tell me whatever you can.
traduit: 把你知道的都告诉我。

original: I can't be sure. I know I've heard that name, but it... it doesn't feel real. Does that make any sense?
traduit: 我也说不好。我应该是听过这名字，但就是……感觉不太真实。说不通啊？

original: Is he someone you know, or not?
traduit: 你认识他吗？

original: I remember a temple on Solstheim, and working to build something. It... it was not a pleasant dream.
traduit: 我只记得索瑟海姆岛上有个神殿，还有建造什么东西。这……是场噩梦。

original: What sort of dream?
traduit: 什么样的梦？

original: I... I can't. I just can't be sure. I think maybe he had something to do with a temple. A temple here on the island. Does that help?
traduit: 我……说不上来。没法确定。我想可能他和一座神殿有关系。就在岛上。有帮上你吗？

original: Just tell me if you know him.
traduit: 把你知道的关于他的消息都告诉我。

original: I... I don't know. It almost feels like a dream. Something about a temple on the island...
traduit: 我……我不知道。就好像是一场梦。好像和岛上某座神殿有关系。

original: Where did you hear the name?
traduit: 你从哪儿听到这个名字的？

original: I don't think so. I'm not... The name has something to do with the Earth Stone, I think. But I'm not sure what.
traduit: 我不确定。呃……这个名字跟土石好像有什么联系。但我也说不清。

original: I'm not even sure... I can picture a temple, here on Solstheim. Must've been a bad dream.
traduit: 我真的不太清楚……我还记得有座神殿，就在这索瑟海姆。一定是做噩梦了。

original: Do you know someone called Miraak?
traduit: 你认识一个叫米拉克的人吗？

original: Miraak? The name sounds familiar... Or does it? I can't remember.
traduit: 米拉克？这名字听起来很耳熟……还是错觉？我记不得了。

original: Why do I recognize that name? It sounds so familiar... Did I have a dream about someone named Miraak?
traduit: 为什么我对这名字有印象？好耳熟啊……是不是梦到过一个叫米拉克的？

original: I don't think so, though it sounds like a name I've heard before...
traduit: 应该没有，但听起来像我以前听说过的名字。

original: I think so, but I can't remember how I know him. Or maybe I'm wrong. I'm not sure.
traduit: 应该有吧，但我想不起来怎么认识的了。可能我记错了，不太确定。

original: That's not someone who lives in Raven Rock, I don't think... but it sounds so familiar.
traduit: 他不是鸦石镇住户吧，我想……但是听起来很熟悉。

original: Miraak... I'm sure I've heard that name before. Haven't I? Was it in a dream?
traduit: 米拉克……我确定以前听过这名字。有吗？还是在梦里？

original: Do I? I was going to say no, but somehow I feel like I do. Does that make any sense?
traduit: 我认识吗？原本我要说不，但是不知怎的好像该说是。这合理吗？

original: I think so, but from where? I can't recall.
traduit: 应该认识吧，但是在哪儿认识的？想不起来了。

original: I recognize the name, but... I don't know how I know it. It sounds so familiar.
traduit: 我知道这名字，但是……不清楚怎么知道的了。听起来很耳熟。

original: No, I... Wait. Maybe. I don't know how I know that name...
traduit: 不，我……等下，可能。我不记得怎么听说的了。

original: I think so, but I'm not sure where I heard the name.
traduit: 应该认识，但我不确定在哪儿听到了的。

original: I think maybe I had a dream about someone with that name...
traduit: 我可能在梦见过这个名字……

original: Did I know someone by that name? Someone... Someone that wanted something...
traduit: 我认识这个人吗？这人……这人想要某种东西……

original: No. Wait... I recognize the name, but I'm not sure why.
traduit: 不。等下……我想起来了，但是不晓得怎么回事。

original: Miraak... It sounds very familiar. Not someone here, but... I'm not sure I can recall.
traduit: 米拉克……听起来很耳熟。不是这儿的人，但是……我不确定能不能想起来。

original: Hmm. Sounds like something from a dream, and yet it might be more. Strange.
traduit: 嗯。听起来像梦里的什么东西，但好像不止这样。奇怪。
