original: I might know someone. Or maybe not. I can't remember...
traduit: 我可能认识这人。但又可能不认识。想不起来了……

original: Why does that sound so familiar? There's no one here by that name, and yet I swear I've heard it.
traduit: 为什么这名字听起来这么熟悉？这儿没有叫这个名字的，但我发誓有听到过。

original: I... I'm unsure. I swear I know the name, but cannot place it.
traduit: 我……我不确定。我肯定听过这名字，但是对不上号。

original: You know who Miraak is?
traduit: 你知道谁是米拉克吗？

original: Do I? What a strange thing. It sounds so familiar, and yet I cannot place the name.
traduit: 我知道吗？真奇怪。听起来很耳熟，但是和人对不上了。

original: Glad to be back.
traduit: 真高兴可以回来。

original: The food is better up here, too.
traduit: 这里的食物也更好吃。

original: We have enough problems around here without having to build that blasted thing outside. Thanks for helping us wake up and move off it.
traduit: 我们这儿的问题已经够多了，还要去建造外面那破玩意儿。谢谢你让我们醒来离开那里。

original: You ever tried hunting with no sleep under you? It wasn't pretty. Now I can rest properly, it should all be going better.
traduit: 试过在失眠时打猎吗？那可不太好过。现在我可以睡个好觉了。一切也会好转。

original: You have no idea how good it is to be back here. Thanks for your help, friend.
traduit: 回到这儿的感觉太好了。感谢你的帮助，朋友。

original: The place still has some of the Riekling stink on it, but that'll wash out in time.
traduit: 这地方还有瑞克灵的臭味呢，但我会马上洗干净。

original: I definitely missed the forge. I wonder if it missed me.
traduit: 真想念我的锻炉啊，不知道它想不想我。

original: Finally, I can get some sleep at night.
traduit: 晚上终于睡得着了。

original: Don't want to talk to the likes of you.
traduit: 我不想和你这种人说话。

original: We have nothing to say to each other.
traduit: 我们之间没什么好的。

original: Keep away from me.
traduit: 离我远点儿。

original: I hate most of the travelers that come through here, but you've shown yourself as one of the better ones.
traduit: 来这儿的大多数旅行者我都讨厌，但你已经证明自己是个好人了。

original: You planning on sticking around for a while? Think about ways to make yourself useful.
traduit: 打算在这儿多呆一会儿吗？先证明自己的价值吧。

original: Glad to have a warm place to sleep, myself, but I would have left the rest of these idiots to toughen up a little longer.
traduit: 很高兴有个暖窝儿睡觉，但我宁可让那些蠢货变得坚强一点儿。

original: Getting a little antsy...
traduit: 有点烦躁……

original: Just warming up for a bit here, before I head out and take some revenge on those Rieklings.
traduit: 还在热身，等我好了就去找那些瑞克灵报仇。

original: Once Halbarn's done sharpening my blade, those Rieklings are going to pay...
traduit: 等哈尔巴恩把我的刀磨锋利，那些瑞克灵就得付出代价了……

original: Just one more mug of mead, and then I'm off!
traduit: 再来一杯蜜酒，然后就上！

original: Make it quick. I won't be here much longer.
traduit: 快说啊，我马上就离开这里了。

original: I was able to salvage most of the latest batch of mead. The rest was... fouled.
traduit: 我抢救出了大部分新酿的蜜酒，剩下的都……脏了。

original: There's a lot of work to do, still, getting this place back up and running.
traduit: 还有很多事情要做，要让这个地方重回正轨。

original: Can't talk too much, I'm afraid.
traduit: 恐怕说不了几句了。

original: Thanks for having my back, friend.
traduit: 谢谢你的支持，朋友。

original: It's good to have trustworthy souls in this place.
traduit: 很高兴这里有人值得信赖。

original: That's right, walk away while I'm still inclined to let you.
traduit: 这就对了，趁我还同意你离开前走吧。

original: Yes, otherwise he'll teach me nothing. You can trust me. (Persuade)
traduit: 对，不然他什么都不会教我。你可以信任我。（说服）

original: I might not trust you, but I will trust your greed. Very well, take the map.
traduit: 我可能不信任你，但我相信你的贪婪。好吧，把地图拿去吧。

original: Return here with Stalhrim weapons and armor, and I will pay you a fair price for them.
traduit: 带着魔冰武器和盔甲回来，事成必有重赏。

original: Tell the blacksmith whatever lie you will. We have no further need of him.
traduit: 随便跟那个铁匠撒个谎。我们再也用不着他了。

original: You expect me to just hand you the map, so you can deliver it to the blacksmith and laugh at the foolish Thalmor you so easily outwitted?
traduit: 你要我把地图给你，好让你给那个铁匠？然后你们俩就能嘲笑被你轻松骗到的梭默？

original: You have made a grave miscalculation, and now you will pay the price!
traduit: 你的算盘打错了，现在付出代价吧！

original: The smith said he'd teach me how to make Stalhrim weapons.
traduit: 那个铁匠说他会教我如何制造魔冰武器。

original: And you will sell them to me. I suppose I'll have to give you the map first?
traduit: 然后你会拿来卖给我。看来我该先把地图给你对吧？

original: You want Stalhrim weapons, and I think I can help you get them.
traduit: 你想要魔冰武器，而我觉得能帮到你。

original: Here to make me an offer, then? Very well, what do you have in mind?
traduit: 来和我做交易的？好啊，你怎么考虑的？

original: The blacksmith won't talk. You're wasting your time (Persuade)
traduit: 那个铁匠是不会开口的，你在浪费时间。（说服）

original: I admit, we are not making the progress I'd hoped. Perhaps you are right, this venture might be more trouble than it's worth.
traduit: 我承认，我们没能达到预期进展。也许你说得对，这趟冒险的麻烦可能比收益大得多。

original: Very well, you have convinced me. We will depart the island shortly and seek our weapons elsewhere.
traduit: 好吧，你说服我了。我们很快会离开这座岛，去别的地方找我们的武器。

original: You dare to question me? That insult will be your last!
traduit: 你竟敢质疑我？没有下次机会了！

original: Leave this island now, or your life is forfeit. (Intimidate)
traduit: 立刻离开这座岛，要不你的命就没了。（恐吓）

original: I can see that is no idle threat. Very well, we will depart the island once we have loaded the ship.
traduit: 看得出来你不是在虚张声势。好吧，我们会把货物装上就走。

original: No weapon is worth dying for, not even a weapon forged from Stalhrim.
traduit: 为武器而死可不值得，即使是魔冰铸造的也不划算。

original: Here, give this map to the blacksmith. I have no further need of it.
traduit: 拿着，把这张地图给那个铁匠。我不需要了。

original: You dare threaten me? For that insolence, I will flay the flesh from your bones!
traduit: 你敢威胁我？这么狂妄我要把你的皮给扒了！

original: How do the Dunmer bury their dead?
traduit: 丹莫如何埋葬死者？

original: The Dunmer race doesn't bury their dead, or leave them to rot inside a stone sarcophagus.
traduit: 丹莫并不埋葬死者，也不会让遗体在石棺中腐烂。

original: When a Dunmer passes, his body is given to fire, so he might return to the ash from whence he came.
traduit: 当一个丹莫过世后，尸体会被火化，以回归来处，即灰烬中。

original: The Dunmer don't believe that death is the end, we believe that it's the beginning.
traduit: 丹莫并不认为死亡即是终结，我们认为那是开始。

original: The false Tribunal?
traduit: 伪审判席？

original: Sotha Sil, Almalexia and Vivec represent what was... beings who won the Dunmer people's hearts with their actions, but blinded them just the same.
traduit: 是索萨·希尔、阿玛莱西亚和维威克过去所代表的……他们以行动赢得了丹莫的心，但又以同样的方式蒙蔽了我们。

original: They were aberrations, false prophets. They used their status as heroes to shield the True Tribunal from our minds.
traduit: 他们是异端、虚伪的先知，以自己英雄的身份阻止我们去了解真审判席。

original: But now that they've been destroyed, the light can finally shine upon the House of Reclamations.
traduit: 但是如今他们已经被摧毁了，光明终于在收复者之家重新亮起。

original: What exactly are the "Reclamations?"
traduit: “收复者”是什么？

original: The Reclamations are the True Tribunal... the daedra that consecrate the Dunmer people: Azura, Mephala and Boethia.
traduit: 收复者即为真审判席……丹莫百姓所崇拜的迪德拉：阿祖拉、梅法拉和波耶西亚。

original: We call them the True Tribunal because they have reclaimed their place in our hearts from the false Tribunal that came before.
traduit: 我们称真审判席为收复者，是因为他们从伪审判席手中夺回了以往在我们心中的地位。

original: Have you always served as a ferryman?
traduit: 你是一直靠摆渡为生吗？

original: Not at all. I used to fish the waters around Solstheim. Made a damn fine living at it, too.
traduit: 不是，我以前在索瑟海姆附近捕鱼，过得也还挺快活。

original: But over the years, the ash from Red Mountain poisoned the sea up there and the fishing became difficult.
traduit: 但是过了几年，红山的火山灰污染了那里的水域，很难捕到鱼了。

original: If it weren't for my supply runs to Raven Rock, I'd have likely sold my ship by now and moved back to Riften.
traduit: 要不是现在还能给鸦石镇运物资，我可能早就把船卖掉回裂谷城去了。

original: How long have you been a sea captain?
traduit: 你当了多久的船长了？

original: I've been sailing the Northern Maiden across the Sea of Ghosts for nearly twenty years now.
traduit: 我在幽灵海上开北方少女号快二十年了。

original: Might be time to find a new home port, though, the way things are going around here.
traduit: 但照这儿的情况来看，也许是时候找个新的母港了。

original: How has Raven Rock needed your help?
traduit: 为什么鸦石镇需要你的帮助？

original: As you can imagine, the eruption of the Red Mountain took an awful toll on Solstheim.
traduit: 你应该想得到，红山喷发对索瑟海姆造成了很严重的破坏。

original: Hunting for game has been scarce, and the waters are apparently too tainted for fishing.
traduit: 打猎获得的猎物变得稀少，水域污染严重，不再适合捕鱼了。

original: According to Councilor Morvayn, my husband's been Raven Rock's most important food source for decades.
traduit: 根据莫尔凡议员的说法，我的丈夫是鸦石镇几十年来最重要的粮食供给人。

original: Why did you leave Morthal?
traduit: 你们为什么离开莫萨尔？

original: It wasn't long before we became homesick... we were the only Dunmer in Morthal.
traduit: 我们不久后就开始想家了……毕竟整个莫萨尔就只有我们是丹莫。

original: When word reached us that a settlement of Dunmer was forming on Solstheim, we were thrilled.
traduit: 当我们听说有个丹莫聚落正在索瑟海姆形成时，感到非常兴奋。

original: It's been difficult, but I'm not regretting it one bit. In fact, I'm glad we've been able to stay and help.
traduit: 这是段苦日子，但是我一点都不后悔。实际上我很高兴能在这儿留下来帮忙。

original: Where did you learn your alchemy skills?
traduit: 你的炼金术在哪儿学的？

original: After we left Morrowind, we found ourselves in Skyrim.
traduit: 我们离开晨风后，来到了天际。

original: We wandered around a bit and ended up in Morthal where we took temporary residence with Lami, the town's alchemist.
traduit: 先是到处流浪一阵子，然后暂时住在莫萨尔的炼金术师拉米那儿。

original: I was fascinated by her work, and over a period of a few years she taught me quite a bit.
traduit: 她的工作把我们迷住了，往后的几年里她教了我很多。

original: Is magic involved?
traduit: 有使用到魔法吗？

original: No. Only the Telvanni have the ability to weave living growth from the ash.
traduit: 没有，只有泰瓦尼才有法子从灰烬中种出活的作物。

original: This simply takes the right ingredients, the right tools and a lot of patience.
traduit: 我只需要对的材料，合适的工具和大把耐心就够了。

original: What exactly is "ash-grown food?"
traduit: “灰烬食物”到底是什么？

original: The Dunmer have been growing food in the ashlands for thousands of years.
traduit: 丹莫已经在灰地耕耘了几千年。

original: It was born out of the necessity to survive in the harsh climate of our homeland.
traduit: 我们家园的恶劣气候促成了它的诞生。

original: And now, with the constant eruptions of the Red Mountain, it's more important than ever.
traduit: 而现在，随着红山的不断喷发，它比以往时期都重要。

original: In all honesty, it came down to a disagreement between what I believe and what Elder Othreloth believes.
traduit: 说实话，这归根结底是我和欧斯瑞罗斯长老之间的信仰对立。

original: I'd prefer not to get into the details, but let's just say our opinions about the current status of the Tribunal vary widely.
traduit: 我不想说的太复杂，简单讲就是对于审判席的看法大相径庭。

original: You're a priest at the Temple?
traduit: 你是个神殿祭司？

original: Far from it. In fact, I'm no longer welcome there.
traduit: 远非如此，事实上我已经不被那儿欢迎了。

original: This is where you met?
traduit: 这就是你俩的相遇？

original: It was. After refusing to allow anyone to bring him food, Councilor Morvayn ordered his door to be knocked down before Crescius starved to death.
traduit: 是啊，那会儿他拒绝任何人给他带食物。莫尔凡议员下令撞开他的家门，免得他把自己饿死。

original: I was a Temple priest at the time, and they had me use my healing arts to restore strength to his ailing body.
traduit: 我那时候是神殿祭司，他们让我用治疗法术给他那副弱身子骨恢复体力。

original: I stayed for a while and cared for him, then... I suppose we fell in love.
traduit: 我留下来照顾他，之后……我想我们就爱上彼此了。

original: Why didn't he move somewhere else to find work?
traduit: 他为什么没有搬到别的地儿去找工作？

original: Our home has been in his family for over two hundred years. Leaving would have been like abandoning precious memories.
traduit: 我们住的是他的祖宅，有两百多年了。离开这里等于是抛弃那些珍贵的回忆。

original: Instead, he stayed on Solstheim and spent most of his life prospecting for a new ebony source. Sadly, it never surfaced.
traduit: 所以正相反，他留在索瑟海姆，花了半辈子来勘测新的黑檀矿源。可惜他一直没找到。

original: A decade ago, this drove him into a deep depression. He shut himself inside his home and refused to come out.
traduit: 十年前，这件事儿让他陷入重度抑郁。他把自己锁在家里不愿出门。

original: How did you meet Crescius?
traduit: 你和克雷修斯怎么相遇的？

original: To understand how we met one another, you have to appreciate what he's going through.
traduit: 想知道我们怎么相遇的，就得先了解他的过往。

original: Crescius is a third-generation miner... all his life, he's lived and breathed nothing else.
traduit: 克雷修斯出身矿工家庭，他是第三代了……他这一生就知道采矿。

original: By the time Crescius came of age, the ebony mine in Raven Rock was shut down. He took that quite hard.
traduit: 当克雷修斯成年后，鸦石镇黑檀矿场关了。他受到了很大的打击。

original: Ridiculous? Why?
traduit: 可笑？怎么说？

original: Well you know it as well as I do. Raven Rock Mine wasn't empty at all... it's still rich in ebony ore.
traduit: 你我都知道，鸦石镇矿场还没挖完……里面还有大量的黑檀矿。

original: I came from three generations of miners, and I couldn't get anyone to believe me.
traduit: 我家三代都是矿工，可就是没人肯信我。

original: Well we showed them, didn't we!
traduit: 如今总算证明了，不是么！

original: Solsthiem is still rich in ebony ore. I know there's more down there... I can smell it.
traduit: 索瑟海姆的黑檀矿依然很丰富，我知道那下面还有更多……我闻得出来。

original: I come from three generations of miners, and I'm telling you that the East Empire Company was wrong.
traduit: 我家可是祖传三代的矿工，可以明确地说，这就是东帝国公司的错。

original: They just didn't want to spend the coin trying to find it.
traduit: 他们只是不想花钱去找而已。

original: Are there any other Imperials in Raven Rock?
traduit: 鸦石镇还有其他帝国人吗？

original: Those cowards left decades ago. Every single damned one of them.
traduit: 那些懦夫几十年前就走啦，没一个混蛋留下来。

original: The moment the ebony mine dried up, they pulled up stakes. Ridiculous!
traduit: 当黑檀矿枯竭后，他们跑得比谁都快，太可笑了！

original: Who taught you that?
traduit: 这是谁教你的？

original: I had a friend over there, a dark elf named Vanryth... a very talented armorsmith.
traduit: 我在那边有个朋友，是个叫凡瑞斯的暗精灵……很有才华的护甲匠人。

original: Spent a lot of time with the guy swapping smithing techniques. Learned a heck of a lot, including how to repair bonemold.
traduit: 我花了很长时间跟他交流锻造技术，学到了很多，包括修补骨模。

original: After he moved on to greener pastures, I decided to pack up, move out here and put those lessons to the test. Been here ever since.
traduit: 后来他另谋高就，我也就收拾收拾搬到了这儿，把学到的知识应用起来，一直到现在。

original: How did you end up in Raven Rock?
traduit: 你为什么来了鸦石镇？

original: A fine question, and the one that I hear most often from visitors to our town.
traduit: 好问题，也是镇上访客最常问我的。

original: I wish I had a more romantic tale to tell, but I was simply seeking my fortune and chose Raven Rock to ply my trade.
traduit: 真想有个浪漫故事讲讲，但我只是想找个出路，然后选中了鸦石镇来做生意而已。

original: Besides, knowing how to repair bonemold armor wasn't very useful in Riften.
traduit: 另外，修补骨模的知识在裂谷城没什么用。

original: How did your mother die?
traduit: 你母亲怎么死的？

original: We lived in a settlement perhaps a league from the border of Black Marsh, the homeland of the Argonians.
traduit: 我们住在距离黑沼泽边境几里外的地方，那边是阿尔贡的家园。

original: Even though the Argonian Invasion ended a long time ago, there are still a few scale-skin clans that live within our borders.
traduit: 尽管阿尔贡入侵很久以前就结束了，但还有一些鳞皮族住在边境附近。

original: To put it simply, they attacked our settlement and slaughtered almost everyone. It was horrible.
traduit: 简单地说，他们袭击了我们的聚落，几乎没留下任何活口，太恐怖了。

original: Where did you get all these items?
traduit: 你从哪儿得的这些东西？

original: Gjalund over at the docks brings me most of my supplies, and the rest comes from bartering with the people in town.
traduit: 我的补给大多是码头那儿的加朗德带来的，其他的是通过和镇民交易来的。

original: Oh, Glover Mallory gets me a few things once in a while. He usually has the most amazing deals that I can't pass up.
traduit: 哦，葛洛文·马洛里偶尔会给我一些东西。他的货一般都很棒，我每次都照单全收。

original: What exactly do you sell here?
traduit: 你这儿卖些什么东西？

original: The question you should be asking is "what don't I sell here" because I have pretty much any supplies you might need.
traduit: 你这问题该换成“有什么东西是你不卖的”，因为你需要的我这儿几乎都有。

original: If it's not a weapon, potion or armor, then it's likely that I have it.
traduit: 除了武器，药水还有护甲之外，我应该都有。

original: Okay.
traduit: 好吧。

original: Bah, you're just like the rest of the folks around here.
traduit: 啧，你就跟这儿其他人一个样儿。

original: Mark my words... the East Empire Company will return to Raven Rock, and when they do, I'll be at the top of their list.
traduit: 听着，东帝国公司迟早会回鸦石镇，到时候我就飞黄腾达了。

original: You have friends at the East Empire Company?
traduit: 你有朋友在东帝国公司工作？

original: Oh, absolutely. In fact, I've corresponded with Vittoria Vici herself more than once.
traduit: 当然有了。实际上我还和维托利亚·维齐通过信呢，不止一次。

original: You know, the lady who runs the East Empire Company Warehouse in Solitude... the biggest warehouse they have in Skyrim.
traduit: 你认识她吗，那个独孤城东帝国公司仓库的管理人，那是他们在天际最大的仓库。

original: Are sales that bad out here?
traduit: 这儿的生意不好么？

original: Bad? What if I told you that you're the first person that's even considered looking at my wares today.
traduit: 不好？跟你说，今天除了你来，就还没开张呢。

original: I've half a mind to contact my friends at the East Empire Company and see if they need an extra hand in Windhelm.
traduit: 我已经想联系我在东帝国公司的朋友，没准儿他们在风舵城需要帮手。

original: Now I get it.
traduit: 现在我知道了。

original: True story, friend. True story.
traduit: 真实的故事哦，朋友。全是真的。

original: What did the netch do?
traduit: 那气母有什么反应？

original: Well, the bottle broke on the netch, and it must have swallowed its contents because it started floating sort of tilted.
traduit: 嗯，那个酒瓶在气母身上裂开了，它肯定喝了里面的东西，因为它飘起来的时候歪歪扭扭的。

original: Finally, it stopped and began to quiver. A few moments later, the foulest liquid to ever assail your nostrils spewed from its maw.
traduit: 最后，气母停下来开始颤抖。过了会儿，它嘴里喷出来了最难闻刺鼻的液体。

original: I've seen plenty of drunks in my day, and I'll tell you right now that netch was sick.
traduit: 我这辈子见过很多醉鬼，但那气母实在是醉翻天了。

original: Doesn't sound unusual.
traduit: 听起来没什么不寻常啊。

original: Ah, but you see this particular Dunmer was as naked as the day he was born and singing badly at the top of his lungs.
traduit: 啊，但你要知道那丹莫跟刚出生一样啥都没穿，扯着嗓子唱得难听的要死。

original: As I'm watching this spectacle, a netch floats over the Bulwark towards him.
traduit: 我看这个奇景的时候，刚好一只气母飘过防护堤到他旁边儿。

original: The man looks straight up at the netch... yells "have a drink" and tosses the bottle... and it never hit the ground.
traduit: 他就直直地盯着气母看，吼了句“干一杯！”接着把瓶子甩出去了……瓶子甚至没掉在地上。

original: Your inn has an unusual name.
traduit: 你这酒吧名字很特别啊。

original: There's actually a funny story behind the name, friend.
traduit: 背后其实有个有趣的故事，朋友。

original: A few years ago, I was walking down by the docks and I noticed a Dunmer staggering along with a bottle of sujamma in hand.
traduit: 几年前，我沿着码头走路，看到个手拿一瓶苏贾玛的丹莫，走得跌跌撞撞。

original: He was one of my patrons, and liked to drink heavily, so I wasn't exactly surprised.
traduit: 他是我的常客，酒喝得很凶，所以我并不在意。

original: Have you tried to stop this?
traduit: 你试过阻止这发生吗？

original: Certainly not! Doing so would interfere with whatever is going on, and I would be unable to see how this all turns out.
traduit: 当然没有！这么做会干预一切后续发展，那我就看不到结果如何了。

original: What are these people doing?
traduit: 这些人在干什么？

original: Building something, clearly. And yet they don't seem to have much to say about it.
traduit: 显然是在建造什么东西，但是他们好像没法多说什么。

original: I'm very interested to find out what happens when they finish.
traduit: 我很想知道他们盖完以后会发生什么。

original: Hmm. Still no steam. You didn't remove any of the cubes downstairs, did you?
traduit: 嗯。还是没有蒸汽。你没移除下面的方典，对吧？

original: If you removed any cubes downstairs, you'd better go put them back.
traduit: 要是你移除了下面的方典，最好赶紧放回去。

original: The boilers won't work if they're flooded, you know.
traduit: 锅炉要是被水淹了就没法启动，你也懂的。

original: All four boilers need to be working to open the casing. Are you sure you didn't remove a cube from one of the boilers?
traduit: 四个锅炉都必须运转才能打开装置。你确定没有移开某个锅炉的方典吗？

original: The last time I was here, I only explored a small part of the ruins.
traduit: 我上次来的时候，只搜索了这废墟的一小部分。

original: You're going to pay, outlander.
traduit: 你会付出代价，外地人。

original: You'll regret crossing me, outlander.
traduit: 你会后悔与我为敌的，外地人。

original: Don't fight back, and I promise I'll kill you quickly.
traduit: 别挣扎了，我保证让你死个痛快。

original: Those boots'll look mighty fine on me.
traduit: 你那双鞋子留给我穿很合适。

original: Your armor will look good on me.
traduit: 我以后穿你这身护甲会很好看。

original: Time to die, outlander!
traduit: 受死吧，外地人！

original: I'm gonna bleed you!
traduit: 给你开几道口子！

original: I'll cut you open!
traduit: 我来给你大卸八块儿！

original: Die, outlander!
traduit: 去死吧，外地人！

original: I've given out the Sadri's Sujamma as requested.
traduit: 我照你说的把萨德利的苏贾玛都发完了。

original: Perfect! All that's left now is to go ahead and wait for the patrons to come in.
traduit: 完美！接下来就等客人们上门了。

original: As promised, here's a little something for yourself.
traduit: 我说好的，这小玩意儿是给你的。

original: I'm all out of Sadri's Sujamma.
traduit: 我把萨德利的苏贾玛都发完了。

original: Here's a bit more. Hope you're not drinking this stuff yourself.
traduit: 这里还有些。你可不要都自己喝了。

original: Geldis Sadri wants you to try his new drink.
traduit: 吉迪斯·萨德利希望你尝尝他新酿的酒。

original: Good old Geldis is always managing to keep our spirits up... and our eyesight hazy. Thank you.
traduit: 吉迪斯那个老好人总是想让我们精神振作……以及眼睛发花。谢了。

original: What? Oh. No thank you. I need to keep my head clear.
traduit: 什么？哦，算了，谢谢你。我要保持头脑清醒。

original: Oh, how kind. Thank Geldis for me, won't you?
traduit: 哦，太有心了。帮我跟吉迪斯说声谢谢，对吧？

original: Sorry, I'm always on duty and I don't wish to have my brain addled by Geldis's strange concoctions.
traduit: 抱歉，我一直都在值勤，也不希望被吉迪斯调的怪酒整晕了。

original: Oh, wonderful. Anything to keep the spirits up.
traduit: 哦，太好了。只要是能提神的都行。

original: Get that vile liquid away from me!
traduit: 把那毒液从我这儿拿开！

original: Sorry, Geldis won't allow me to drink while I'm working at the Netch.
traduit: 抱歉，吉迪斯不准我在呕吐气母上班时喝酒。

original: Geldis needs to bottle this up and send it to the mainland instead of wasting his time out here... his drinks are outstanding. Thanks.
traduit: 吉迪斯该把这个包装起来送到内陆去卖，而不是在这儿浪费他的时间……他调的酒好喝极了，多谢。

original: At least my father will let me drink whatever I want without complaining. Tell Geldis I appreciate it.
traduit: 至少父亲不会对我喝什么酒产生抱怨。跟吉迪斯说声谢了。

original: Perfect! I was just thinking about heading over for a drink. Thanks for saving me the trip.
traduit: 太棒了！我正想着过去喝一杯呢。谢谢你让我少跑一趟。

original: Hmph, he's begging for patrons again, eh? Well, I suppose I could have just a bit.
traduit: 嗯，他又在揽客了吗？好吧，我想能稍微喝点儿。

original: Well that sounds lovely. Thank you.
traduit: 听起来不错，谢谢你。

original: Not today, too many things on my mind.
traduit: 今天算了，我要考虑的事情很多。

original: Sure, got nothing better to do.
traduit: 好啊，反正也没别的事可做。

original: Well, tell Geldis that Mirri says she really appreciates it.
traduit: 好吧，告诉吉迪斯，米莉说她真的很爱喝。

original: Always a pleasure to taste anything Geldis comes up with.
traduit: 喝吉迪斯酿的酒总是一种享受。

original: I should mix some of this into my next potion... who knows what would happen!
traduit: 我应该加些这个到我的下批药剂里……天晓得会发生什么！

original: No! I can't! It may be poison!
traduit: 别！我不喝！这可能是毒药！

original: The day I refuse sujamma from Geldis is the day I sprout wings and fly off of this rock.
traduit: 要我拒绝吉迪斯的苏贾玛，除非是我长出翅膀从这石镇飞走了。

original: There's nothing finer than dark elf sujamma... like nectar it is.
traduit: 没什么比得上暗精灵的苏贾玛了……就跟蜜一样甘醇。

original: Take that swill and pour it down a well.
traduit: 把那泔水倒井里去吧。

original: Sorry, never touch the stuff.
traduit: 抱歉，我从不碰那种东西。

original: They'll show up eventually I suppose.
traduit: 我想他们最终一定会来的。

original: Yes, I suppose they might. Ah well.
traduit: 哎，但愿如此。好吧。

original: I could help spread the word.
traduit: 我可以帮你宣传。

original: I was kind of hoping you'd say that.
traduit: 就等你这句话呢。

original: Here, take these samples of the sujamma and spread the word. If you get rid of all of them, there's something extra in it for you.
traduit: 拿着，带上这些苏贾玛样品帮我宣传。要是全部发完了，我还会给你额外的奖励。

original: So what's the specialty of the house?
traduit: 这里的招牌是什么？

original: The finest sujamma to cross your lips, friend. My own personal formula that I call "Sadri's Sujamma."
traduit: 上好的苏贾玛任你品尝，朋友。都是我自己的独家秘方，我起了个名字叫“萨德利的苏贾玛”。

original: In fact, I've just added some new ingredients to the mixture that I think makes it taste better than ever.
traduit: 实际上，我刚加了些新的配料进去，觉得比以往的更很好喝了。

original: All I need to do is get the word out that it's ready and they'll flock here for it.
traduit: 只要我把大功告成的消息放出去，大家肯定会蜂拥而至。

original: The Temple's tomb has been cleansed.
traduit: 神殿的祖坟清理干净了。

original: Spirits be praised!
traduit: 感谢诸灵啊！

original: I'm hoping you didn't suffer much at the hands of those foul beings. Please, accept this as a token of my thanks.
traduit: 希望那些肮脏生物没给你带来大麻烦。请收下这个吧，聊表我的感激。

original: Yes, indeed.
traduit: 嗯，确实。

original: I'll cleanse the tomb for you.
traduit: 我会为你们扫清祖坟。

original: Thank you, wanderer. That would be most kind.
traduit: 感谢你，漂泊者。那就太好了。

original: Here, this key should open the door to the tomb.
traduit: 拿着，这是祖坟大门的钥匙。

original: Why can't you use the tomb?
traduit: 祖坟为什么不能用了？

original: Those foul vermin... the abominations we call ash spawn have risen from the ashes of our own ancestors.
traduit: 因为那些肮脏的寄生虫……被我们称为灰烬怪的可憎之物会从祖先的骨灰中重生。

original: They're befouling the memories of our forefathers by defiling their remains.
traduit: 它们亵渎了我们祖辈的遗骸，玷污了对他们的回忆。

original: What are the Ancestral Tombs?
traduit: 这些祖坟是什么地方？

original: They are where we inter our dead. They are sacred places, meant to honor their passing.
traduit: 那是我们安葬逝者的地方，是用来缅怀逝者的圣地。

original: Sadly, we've been unable to use the Ancestral Tomb beneath the Temple as of late, and have resorted to other locations to scatter the remains.
traduit: 可惜，神殿下的祖坟最近无法使用，我们只能在其他地方播撒他们的骨灰。

original: I have that netch jelly for you.
traduit: 我找到你要的气母胶质了。

original: Goodness, it must have been quite difficult tracking those creatures down out there.
traduit: 天啊，要在外头找到这些生物肯定很难吧？

original: Here, take these. They should help you during your journeys.
traduit: 拿着，这些拿去吧。它们能在你的旅途中派上用场。

original: I have some netch jelly right here. (Give 5 netch jelly)
traduit: 我这里有些气母胶质。（给出5块气母胶质）

original: My goodness, you're quite resourceful aren't you?
traduit: 天啊，你可真有办法啊，不是吗？

original: This is all I can offer in return for this. I hope it's enough.
traduit: 我只能给你这些来报答了。希望你满意。

original: Sounds risky.
traduit: 听上去很冒险。

original: Well, I have these other ingredients for sale for now. It'll have to do.
traduit: 嗯，现在我还有这些别的原料可以卖。就这样吧。

original: I could gather some for you.
traduit: 我可以帮你搜集一些。

original: That would be splendid! I'd be more than happy to give you something for the effort.
traduit: 那可太好了！我很乐意回报你的辛劳。

original: You're selling quite a few exotic ingredients.
traduit: 你卖的这些材料非常稀奇。

original: Yes, I'm proud to say that I grow or harvest most of it myself.
traduit: 对啊，这些可都是我亲手种的采的哦。

original: I only wish I had a better source for netch jelly. Those creatures are difficult to track down since it's so dangerous beyond the Bulwark.
traduit: 只希望我能有更好的气母胶质货源。那些生物很难去追踪，因为防护堤外太危险了。

original: I found the Emberbrand Wine stash.
traduit: 我找到了被藏起来的余烬牌葡萄酒。

original: Good, this will help me keep things running without having to worry about a bunch of soldiers falling asleep on duty.
traduit: 很好，这样我就不必担心卫兵们在值勤时打瞌睡了。

original: Here, take this for your trouble.
traduit: 拿着，这是你的跑路费。

original: Any idea where I can begin?
traduit: 我该从哪里找起？

original: They're too smart to have left it in the Bulwark. I'd search one of the abandoned houses on the outskirts of town.
traduit: 他们不会傻到把它藏在防护堤内。是我的话，会从镇外那几间被遗弃的屋子开始找。

original: It'll turn up sooner or later.
traduit: 它迟早会出现的。

original: I certainly hope so.
traduit: 我确实希望如此。

original: I could track the stash down for you.
traduit: 我能帮你找到那批酒。

original: You would?
traduit: 你愿意吗？

original: That would be helpful. I just don't have time to do it myself right now.
traduit: 帮上大忙了。这会儿我实在是没时间去找。

original: Petty distractions?
traduit: 次要的消遣？

original: Some of my own men have become quite accustomed to a spirit they called "Emberbrand Wine."
traduit: 我的一些手下很喜欢喝一种酒，叫“余烬牌葡萄酒”。

original: Despise the stuff myself. It's powerful and tremendously addicting... I've seen men fail to finish even a single flask.
traduit: 但我不喜欢。它劲儿大而且很容易上瘾……我见过有人甚至一瓶都喝不了。

original: If I knew where they were stashing the bottles, I'd put an end to it myself.
traduit: 要是知道他们把酒藏在哪儿，我就自己去解决了。

original: Is it difficult commanding the Redoran Guard?
traduit: 指挥瑞多然卫兵很难吗？

original: It can be. Even the most experienced warriors can fall prey to petty distractions.
traduit: 是的。即使是最老练的战士也会因为次要的消遣而分心。

original: They usually didn't amount to much, but they make my job that much harder.
traduit: 一般都没什么大不了，但还是会给我的工作带来麻烦。

original: You're welcome at the Retching Netch anytime.
traduit: 你随时可以光顾呕吐气母了。

original: Well then, I suppose I'm off to do what I do best.
traduit: 那么，我想去做最擅长的事情了。

original: Here. This was something I carried around in happier times. Maybe you can find a use for it.
traduit: 拿着。这是我以前那段快乐时光里带着的。也许你用得上。

original: Trust me, I've seen my share of hardcases, and she's doing this to herself for no reason.
traduit: 相信我，比她麻烦的人我见多了，她还不至于走到这个地步。

original: She could be someone again if she was given the chance.
traduit: 如果给她机会，还是能重新做人的。

original: Maybe this will change your mind. (<BribeCost> gold)
traduit: 没准这个能让你回心转意。（<BribeCost>金币）

original: Well, there's morals, and then there's money. In this case, money wins.
traduit: 嗯，一边是道德，一边是钱财。这次是钱财胜出了。

original: Tell Bralsa she's welcome here anytime.
traduit: 告诉布拉尔萨她随时可以回来。

original: It's going to take more than that to change my mind.
traduit: 就这点钱不够让我回心转意。

original: Let her back in, or you answer to me! (Intimidate)
traduit: 让她进门，不然我要你好看！（恐吓）

original: Okay, okay. There's no need to get violent.
traduit: 好吧好吧。没必要动粗。

original: If Bralsa wants to come back, she's welcome here... I swear.
traduit: 要是布拉尔萨想回来，这儿是欢迎的……我发誓。

original: I'm not afraid of you. She's not coming in here, and that's that.
traduit: 我可不怕你。这里就是不欢迎她，就这样。

original: She has a right to do what she pleases. (Persuade)
traduit: 她有权做想做的事。（说服）

original: I suppose you're right. If she wants to spend her life at the bottom of an ale mug, it's her right.
traduit: 你说得对。要是她乐意饮酒度日，那也是她的自由。

original: Tell her she'll welcome back anytime.
traduit: 告诉她随时可以回来。

original: No, sorry. It isn't right.
traduit: 不，对不起。那么做就是错的。

original: Why did you ban Bralsa Drel from your inn?
traduit: 你为什么禁止布拉尔萨·德雷尔进你的酒馆？

original: Have you seen the poor girl? She's a mess.
traduit: 你见过那个可怜的女孩吗？她简直是糟透了。

original: She used to be richer than Councilor Morvayn and she's spending it all drowning her sorrow.
traduit: 以前她比莫尔凡议员还有钱，但她却全花在借酒浇愁上了。

original: As much as I love making coin, I can't watch her do that anymore. I won't.
traduit: 就算我喜欢挣钱，也实在看不下去了。我办不到。

original: Sorry to hear that.
traduit: 真遗憾。

original: Sure, I bet you are. Everyone's always sorry.
traduit: 是啊，我猜也是。大家都说很遗憾。

original: I could talk to him for you.
traduit: 我会替你和他谈谈。

original: You can try...
traduit: 你试试看吧……

original: If you can get that stubborn mule to let me into the Netch, I'll make sure you get what's coming to you.
traduit: 要是能说服那犟驴让我进气母，我一定会报答你。

original: Used to? What happened?
traduit: 以前？然后出了什么事？

original: That fetcher Geldis won't even allow me inside. Said I was bad for business.
traduit: 那个费彻吉迪斯甚至不让我进门了。说我影响了他做生意。

original: If I want to spend my last bag of coins getting drunk, that's my business. What does he care?
traduit: 我要是想把钱花来买醉，那也是我的选择。关他什么事啊？

original: Why should I pity you?
traduit: 我为什么要同情你？

original: Doesn't everyone pity the hopeless? Look at me... I'm no better than a beggar.
traduit: 大家不都同情无望之人吗？你看我……跟乞丐没什么两样了。

original: I used to be a miner, a good one too. I made more gold digging up ore in a month than some people earn in a lifetime.
traduit: 我从前是个矿工，很能干的那种。我挖一个月矿挣的钱比有些人一辈子挣得还多。

original: When the mine dried up, I was lost. I have no other trade, so I spend my time drinking my fortune away at the Retching Netch... or I used to anyway.
traduit: 但是当矿脉枯竭后，我就迷失了。我没别的门路，就把时光消磨在呕吐气母，把财富喝得一干二净……反正以前就那样。

original: Still buying East Empire Pendants?
traduit: 还收东帝国公司吊坠吗？

original: Absolutely. Here's your payment.
traduit: 当然。这是你的酬劳。

original: I am. Here you go.
traduit: 收啊。拿去吧。

original: You're making my buyer happy. Keep them coming.
traduit: 你让我的买主很高兴。以后也卖我吧。

original: As long as you keep bringing them, I'll keep buying them.
traduit: 只要你还有货，都拿来卖我。

original: I'm beginning to like this partnership. Here you go.
traduit: 我开始喜欢这段合作了。拿去吧。

original: Where can you find them?
traduit: 在哪里能找到它们？

original: Well, well. Seems you're proving fairly useful for an outlander.
traduit: 嗯。看来你这个外地人还挺有本事的。

original: Here's your coin. Keep bringing me more, and I'll keep paying you for them.
traduit: 这是你的钱。再拿更多些来，我都会付钱的。

original: I'll sell you some of mine. (Give East Empire Pendants)
traduit: 我卖给你一些吧。（交出东帝国公司吊坠）

original: They could be anywhere on the island. The mines might be a good place to start.
traduit: 它们可能出现在岛上的任何地方。或许你该从各个矿场找起。

original: If you find any while you're exploring Solstheim, bring them here and I'll pay you for them.
traduit: 在你探索索瑟海姆期间，只要找到了都可以拿来卖给我。

original: What's an East Empire Pendant?
traduit: 东帝国公司吊坠？

original: It's an amulet that was made exclusively for the East Empire Company.
traduit: 那是专为东帝国公司制作的护符。

original: They gave them to their workers as an incentive at one point... a kind of reward for extra effort.
traduit: 以前是当做奖励机制发给工人的……用来鼓励额外工作。

original: They're no longer being made, so they've become collectible. I'd love to get my hands on a few of them.
traduit: 现在已经绝版了，所以就成了收藏品。我很想弄到一些。

original: Do you sell any special mining gear?
traduit: 你有卖特殊的采矿工具吗？

original: Mining gear? No. However, I used to sell East Empire Pendants until I ran out of them. Popular little item.
traduit: 采矿工具？没有。以前我倒是有卖东帝国公司的吊坠，直到卖光。那小玩意儿销路很好。

original: Who is Hermaeus Mora?
traduit: 赫麦尤斯·莫拉是谁？

original: It seems the ancient Dwemer discovered this book and took it to study.
traduit: 看来古代锻莫找到了这本书，然后仔细研读。

original: I found their "reading room" in the ruins of Nchardak. The book is there, but it's sealed in a protective case which I wasn't able to open.
traduit: 我在尼查达克遗迹找到了他们的“阅览室”。书就在那里，但是被锁在一个我打不开的保护装置里。

original: But perhaps the two of us together will be able to get at the book.
traduit: 要是我们合作，或许就能拿到那本书。

original: To Nchardak, then. Follow me.
traduit: 出发吧，去尼查达克。跟我来。

original: Just tell me where the book is and I'll go get it.
traduit: 告诉我书在哪儿，我自己去就行。

original: I'm afraid it isn't that simple. If it was, I would have the book already.
traduit: 恐怕没那么简单。不然，我早就拿到手了。

original: What are these Black Books? Where do they come from?
traduit: 这些黑暗经书是什么？它们从哪儿来的？

original: The Black Books have something to do with Hermaeus Mora?
traduit: 黑暗经书和赫麦尤斯·莫拉有关？

original: You didn't know? Hmm, I thought it was obvious.
traduit: 你不知道？嗯，我以为这显而易见。

original: What do the Black Books have to do with Hermaeus Mora?
traduit: 赫麦尤斯·莫拉和这些黑暗经书有什么关系？

original: Hmmm... No, that's probably not of any use.
traduit: 嗯……不，这应该没什么用。

original: Actually, I wonder if...
traduit: 实际上，我在想要不……

original: Maybe if we can find out...
traduit: 如果我们能找出……

original: Well, you'd better say something. And soon.
traduit: 你最好说点什么，快点啊。

original: Your stomach isn't my problem. We'll act when I say we do and not before.
traduit: 你忍不了不关我的事。等我下令才能行动。

original: Then train them. What are we doing here? We should either get used to staying here, or be preparing to retake the hall.
traduit: 那就训练他们啊。我们现在在这儿干嘛呢？要么就安顿下来，要么就做好准备，夺回大厅。

original: You're having us do neither, and I can't stomach it.
traduit: 但是你两个都不选，我受不了了。

original: I'm not going to lead them to their deaths if they aren't ready.
traduit: 他们还没准备好，我不打算带他们去送死。

original: I never said it would be. But either way, we have to try. Whether we succeed or not, it'll stir up some of the old blood in this crowd.
traduit: 我从没说过会成功。但是无论如何我们都得试试。不管成功与否，都能稍微唤醒这些家伙的热血。

original: It won't be that easy to get rid of the Rieklings, Kuvar.
traduit: 把瑞克灵赶走可不简单，库瓦尔。

original: Just trust me, you don't want to drink it.
traduit: 相信我，你不会想喝的。

original: What did they... do to it?
traduit: 他们对它……干了些什么？

original: Were you able to salvage any of the mead?
traduit: 你有抢救出任何蜜酒吗？

original: Most of the old brew is still good, but I had to get rid of some of the newer batches.
traduit: 之前酿的大多还能喝，但是新酿的几批我必须处理掉。

original: Not everything is as happy as you do.
traduit: 不是每个人都像你这么乐观。

original: Not everything is as dire as you make it out to be.
traduit: 不是每件事都像你说的那么糟糕。

original: Because he's not hard on himself.
traduit: 因为他对自己太宽松了。

original: Why are you so hard on Elmus?
traduit: 你为什么对艾穆斯那么严厉？

original: No. But you need to come on the hunt more than we need you on the hunt.
traduit: 不。比起我们的需要，是你自己更应该去打猎。

original: I... uh, I hadn't planned on it. Do you need my help?
traduit: 我……呃，我没打算过。需要我帮忙吗？

original: Are you going to join us on the next hunt?
traduit: 我们下次打猎时你会加入么？

original: This is home, now, boy. Start living it.
traduit: 现在这儿就是家了，小子。接受现实吧。

original: I... I hadn't really thought of it. I'm still hoping we can go home.
traduit: 我……没认真考虑过这事儿。我还以为能回家呢。

original: We're not going to be lounging around in a hall anymore, so you'll have to be a little more useful. Can't make mead down here.
traduit: 我们没法儿再在大厅里闲逛了，所以你得多帮些忙。这下面酿不了酒。

original: What do you mean?
traduit: 你什么意思？

original: So... what do you plan on doing?
traduit: 所以……你打算怎么做？

original: I can handle it. Just wish there was more mead, is all.
traduit: 我还能过得去。只是希望这儿有更多的蜜酒，别的没了。

original: Not everyone was built for this kind of life. There's no shame in that.
traduit: 不是人人都能适应这儿的生活。这没什么丢脸的。

original: It's rough out here. But I'm getting by.
traduit: 在这儿过日子很艰辛。但我还撑得住。

original: How are you holding up?
traduit: 你还好吧？

original: Why do we need these cubes?
traduit: 我们要这些方典干什么？

original: I thought I made myself clear the first time.
traduit: 我不是说得很明白了吗？

original: The boilers in the Great Hall provide steam to the reading room upstairs, which we need in order to open the book's protective case.
traduit: 大厅里的锅炉为楼上的阅读室提供蒸汽，这样我们才能打开书的保护装置。

original: We need a total of five cubes - one to operate the pumps in the Great Hall, the other four to activate the boilers.
traduit: 我们总共需要五块方典——一个用来操控大厅的水泵，其他四个用来启动锅炉。

original: If that fire has remained lit for all this time, there must be magic at work in it.
traduit: 要是火一直没熄灭，里面一定有魔法的作用。

original: Perhaps something is meant to go into the fire. But what could it be? Something that's already nearby, perhaps?
traduit: 也许该在火里加些什么。但加什么呢？或许是附近的什么东西？

original: This fire seems significant. I'm sure it's important for some reason.
traduit: 这火看起来有某种意义，我确信它必有原因。

original: These statues are clearly the focus of this area. There must be some way to interact with them.
traduit: 这些石柱显然是这个区域的重点，一定有办法和它们互动。

original: I'd wager that the statues are the key to opening the chamber beyond.
traduit: 我敢赌这些石柱是打开下个房间的关键。

original: Interesting that these statues are different. If they represent archery, magic and swordsmanship, then what does that tell us?
traduit: 这些石柱互不相同，有意思。要是它们各自代表箭术、魔法和剑术，那么其中的含义是什么？

original: No doubt there's some connection between these pressure plates and opening the next chamber.
traduit: 毫无疑问，这些压力板和打开下个房间有关。

original: Hm, I wonder if I should have brought more torches.
traduit: 嗯，我该带几只火把来的。

original: Bit of a chill in the air down here.
traduit: 这下面的风有点冷啊。

original: I wonder how long it took the ancient Nords to build this tomb.
traduit: 真不知道古诺德人花了多久建造这个墓穴。

original: Let's try not to disturb anything.
traduit: 我们最好不要打扰任何东西。

original: I'll have to come back to this place later and take detailed notes.
traduit: 我之后一定要回来，做些详细记录。

original: This is clearly in the same tradition as the draugr tombs of Skyrim.
traduit: 这里面的传统显然和天际的尸鬼墓一样。

original: We might well be the first to set foot in here since this tomb was sealed.
traduit: 我们可能是这座墓穴封闭后第一次进来的人。

original: How remarkable to think these passages have gone undisturbed for so long.
traduit: 这些通道这么长时间都没受干扰，真了不起。

original: This place was quite a find!
traduit: 这地方是个大发现！

original: This tomb is remarkably well-preserved. Fortune has truly smiled on us.
traduit: 这个墓穴保存的相当完好。我们真的很走运。

original: I can't wait to get back to the village and start writing about this place.
traduit: 等不及回到村里去记载这地方了。

original: I was afraid the earthquakes might have done serious damage here, but the tomb seems to be in fine condition.
traduit: 原本我还担心地震会对这里造成严重破坏，但这墓穴看来情况良好。

original: Simply fascinating.
traduit: 太神奇了。

original: I can't help but wonder if this place has some connection to the history of the Skaal.
traduit: 真想知道这地方和斯卡尔的历史有没有关系。

original: This tomb is a discovery of great significance. We'll be remembered for this.
traduit: 发现这个地方意义重大，我们会被史书记录的。

original: If only these walls could speak, I would love to hear the stories they could tell.
traduit: 要是这些墙壁能说话就好了。我真想听它们的故事。

original: Now where did I leave that book on dragon language translation?
traduit: 我那本龙语翻译书放哪儿啦？

original: It's got to be in here somewhere...
traduit: 应该就在这里某处……

original: Curse my lack of organization... I know that book is here.
traduit: 我怎么老是乱放东西……书肯定在这里。

original: Hm, I wonder if I should find something warmer to wear...
traduit: 嗯，我应该带些保暖的衣服来……

original: Let's see... I ought to bring a few torches, and certainly my journal so that I can write down my observations.
traduit: 我想想，我应该带些火把，还有日记来记录我的观察。

original: Perhaps I'll need some rope. Oh, who am I trying to fool? At my age, I'll be lucky if I can climb a steep set of stairs.
traduit: 也许我需要些绳索。啊，想什么呢。在我这年纪，还能上几个台阶就算走运的了。

original: And so I feel your shame all the more deeply.
traduit: 这下我更能感觉到你有多丢人了。

original: When it's time, we will seek you out. Until then, go and attempt to earn your honor in the old ways.
traduit: 等时机到了，我们会去找你的。到那时候，试着遵循古法去赢得你的荣耀吧。

original: Kuvar, I'm your wife. You can't...
traduit: 库瓦尔，我是你的妻子。你不能……

original: Just... I can't even look at you right now.
traduit: 算了吧……我现在根本无法面对你。

original: Get out of here. Run to the wilds.
traduit: 快出去吧，到野外去。

original: Kuvar, I...
traduit: 库瓦尔，我……

original: Your words carry some wisdom. But if you truly believed in the spirit of Thirsk, you would have spoken them honestly.
traduit: 你说的不无道理。但要是你真的相信瑟斯科的精神，就会实话实说。

original: Instead you hid your shame.
traduit: 但你却隐瞒了自己的耻辱。

original: Kuvar, listen to me. You said yourself that this place had lost sight of its past. We need a new tradition, to move us forward.
traduit: 库瓦尔，你听我说。你自己也说过这里不复从前了。我们需要一个新的传统来引领我们前进。

original: Instead of listening to a ghost in a tomb, we should steer our own destinies.
traduit: 与其听从坟墓里的鬼魂，我们应该掌控自己的命运。

original: So... you don't deny this?
traduit: 所以……你不否认？

original: My second would do well to keep his mouth shut.
traduit: 他可真是大嘴巴。

original: My second would do well to keep her mouth shut.
traduit: 她可真是大嘴巴。

original: Bujold. Your second claims that Hrothmund did not yield a blessing to you. Is that true?
traduit: 布约德。你的副手宣称哈洛斯蒙德并没有给你赐福。这是真的？

original: You need to know the truth. She was rejected by Hrothmund.
traduit: 你必须知道真相。她被哈洛斯蒙德给拒绝了。

original: I don't think you know how dangerous it is to say what you've just said.
traduit: 我想你不清楚刚才发言的严重性。

original: This is a serious accusation. I'm sure Bujold can straighten it out for us.
traduit: 这是一个严重的指控。我相信布约德会给我们厘清真相。

original: It was an honor to stand with her.
traduit: 担任她的副手是我的荣耀。

original: Yes, I remember how I felt being there with her the first time, before we were wed. I hope to see you more around the hall, friend.
traduit: 没错，我还记得第一次与她相伴的感受。我希望你以后常来大厅转转，朋友。

original: I'll keep out of your way.
traduit: 我是不会妨碍你的。

original: See that you do.
traduit: 务必如此啊。

original: Hrothmund said the next Thirsk chief is a long way off.
traduit: 哈洛斯蒙德说瑟斯科的下任首领还要等很久才会出现。

original: Well, then. I'll do my best to keep the hall together until that day comes.
traduit: 那么，我会尽力让大厅团结一致，直到那天到来。

original: Now, look... I understand you were just defending yourself. And because you helped us retake the hall, I'll look past it this once.
traduit: 现在，听着……我知道你是在自卫。再加上你帮我们夺回了大厅，这次就算了。

original: But I wouldn't show my face in here again, if I were you. Do we understand each other?
traduit: 但我要是你的话，就不会再出现在这儿了。明白我的意思了吗？

original: She attacked me and I had to defend myself.
traduit: 她袭击了我，我得自卫。

original: Ah. I see. I hope she... fought well.
traduit: 啊，我知道了。希望她……死得英勇。

original: Was it... did Hrothmund recognize anyone else? Was it you? Is that why...
traduit: 是因为……哈洛斯蒙德选择了其他人吗？是你吗？所以才会……

original: I don't know what happened to her. (Lie)
traduit: 我不知道她干啥去了。（撒谎）

original: Well, let's hope she makes it back soon. This lot doesn't have much patience with me.
traduit: 嗯，希望她早点回来。这群人可不怎么服我。

original: It's not that simple. Bujold was rejected by Hrothmund.
traduit: 这可没那么简单。布约德被哈洛斯蒙德给拒绝了。

original: Are you being serious? How... how did she take it?
traduit: 你是认真的？她……她有什么反应？

original: I'm back.
traduit: 我回来了。

original: How did things go out there? Where is Bujold?
traduit: 事情进展如何？布约德人呢？

original: Bujold says you served well. Before we were married, I was her second on the first trip to the barrow.
traduit: 布约德说你干得很好。在我们结婚前她第一次去古坟那儿，是我担任她的副手。

original: Hrothmund knows strength, in this world and the next.
traduit: 哈洛斯蒙德不管是生前还是死后，都对人的意志了若指掌。

original: Let's not waste any time, then.
traduit: 那我们就别浪费时间了。

original: We're going to fight his ghost?
traduit: 我们要和他的鬼魂战斗？

original: No, no, nothing like that. He doesn't need to battle us to know us. He's always watched over Thirsk, and sees us from beyond.
traduit: 不，完全不是那样。他用不着和我们交手就摸清我们了。他一直在远方注视着瑟斯科和我们。

original: And in my case, since he's already deemed me worthy, it will just be a matter of him remembering why he blessed me before.
traduit: 对我来说，既然之前他就认为我够格，那么只要让他想起来曾经为什么赐福于我就行了。

original: Really, all you need to do is watch.
traduit: 真的，你只需要看着就行了。

original: What's going to happen in there?
traduit: 在里面会发生些什么？

original: It's pretty simple. Hrothmund's axe is in there with him. Anyone who attempts to take hold of it has their spirit judged by Hrothmund himself.
traduit: 很简单。哈洛斯蒙德的斧头随他下葬了。任何人只要握紧斧头，他们的意志就会受到哈洛斯蒙德本人的评判。

original: The burial place of Hrothmund, who founded Thirsk.
traduit: 瑟斯科的建立者，哈洛斯蒙德的葬身之处。

original: He brought a group of true warriors away from the soft life of the Skaal, to know the wilderness, to feel the sting of cold and of steel.
traduit: 他带着一群真正的战士们离开了斯卡尔的舒适生活，去领悟荒野，去感受严寒与兵刃的威胁。

original: I know that... sounds a little silly. It's just the way it's written in the books, and that phrase has always stuck with me.
traduit: 我知道这……听起来有点傻。但书上就是这么写的，那些字句一直困扰着我。

original: Are you ready to go inside?
traduit: 准备好进去了吗？

original: We are if I have anything to say about it.
traduit: 要是我有发言权的话，快了。

original: Are we hunting soon?
traduit: 我们快要去打猎了吗？

original: There's more, yet. Don't get too comfortable.
traduit: 要学的还多的是呢。别太安逸了啊。

original: Thanks to you. You've taught me a lot.
traduit: 谢谢你。你教了我很多。

original: I'm proud of you, Hilund. You've held up well.
traduit: 我为你骄傲，希兰德。你表现得很好。

original: Don't push, son.
traduit: 别得寸进尺了，小子。

original: You like it?
traduit: 你喜欢吗？

original: I'm sorry. The mead... it is good.
traduit: 对不起。蜜酒……很好喝。

original: I know... I just... I wanted...
traduit: 我知道……我只是……想要……

original: There are more important things than mead, Elmus.
traduit: 比蜜酒重要的事情还多的是呢，艾穆斯。

original: Have you tried any of the mead I brought out of storage? It still tastes all right to me, but...
traduit: 尝过我从储藏库里拿出来的蜜酒吗？我觉得味道还可以，但是……

original: Forget it. I'll make things better in my own way.
traduit: 算了吧。我会自己来改善这个局面。

original: That's what I'm trying to do...
traduit: 那就是我在尽力做的……

original: I don't want your apologies. I want Thirsk to live up to its name.
traduit: 我要的不是你的道歉，而是让瑟斯科不负它的威名。

original: I'm trying to apologize. Do you want to listen?
traduit: 我在跟你道歉呢。想听听吗？

original: Do you know how tired I get of watching the softer ones here grow softer?
traduit: 你知道我有多看不惯这些软蛋们越来越软吗？

original: I'm sorry about before. You're not wrong, it's just...
traduit: 之前的事我很抱歉。你没有错，只是……

original: That's between me and the spirits, Kuvar. You know that.
traduit: 这是我和亡魂之间的秘密，库瓦尔。你也知道。

original: What exactly happened at the barrow?
traduit: 古坟里发生了什么？

original: I'm feeling motivated. That's enough for now.
traduit: 我感到被鼓舞了，现在这就够了。

original: Are you feeling any stronger?
traduit: 感觉到变强壮了吗？

original: Just... leave her be. She'll find her way.
traduit: 反正……别去烦她。她自己会想明白的。

original: Why so touchy on this?
traduit: 为什么在这事情上这么敏感？

original: And I don't think she needs any help from you to do that.
traduit: 我不认为她需要你来教她。

original: I'm not harassing her. She just needs to decide what kind of person she wants to be.
traduit: 我没骚扰她。她需要自己决定成为一个什么样的人。

original: I don't want you harassing Hilund anymore.
traduit: 我不会再放你去骚扰希兰德了。

original: Don't worry about Kuvar. Just be patient, and enjoy the between times, like this one.
traduit: 别管库瓦尔怎么说。有时候要有耐心，享受这种时光。

original: But Kuvar's been saying...
traduit: 但库瓦尔一直说……

original: Calm yourself, Hilund. There's plenty of time for that. Solstheim isn't going anywhere.
traduit: 冷静点，希兰德。打猎随时都能去。索瑟海姆又跑不掉。

original: Are we off on the hunt again, soon?
traduit: 我们很快又要去打猎了吗？

original: Hmph. Very well. I'll just have to find someone else to assist us then.
traduit: 哼。好吧，我只能找别人来帮我们了。

original: With all due respect, those "things" aren't the only problem we have right now.
traduit: 恕我直言，那些“东西”并不是我们现在唯一的麻烦。

original: Be patient, keep the door locked, and we'll get there when we can.
traduit: 请保持耐心，把门锁好，等我们空出手来就会去的。

original: I appreciate your problems, Adril, but I can't be expected to run a temple with those... things running around in there.
traduit: 我理解你的难处，阿德尔，但这里面有那些……东西存在，我就没法主持神殿了。

original: I'm sorry, Elder. I'm doing the best I can.
traduit: 对不起，长老。我已经尽力了。

original: I did indeed. When are you going to do something about our central Ancestral Tomb? I can't even go down there any longer. It's getting intolerable!
traduit: 没错。你打算什么时候处理咱们核心祖坟的事情？我现在根本下不去了。实在让人难以忍受！

original: You wanted to speak to me, Elder?
traduit: 您在找我吗，长老？

original: Faith's just going to have to wait, Elder. I'm sorry.
traduit: 信仰的事儿得以后再说，长老。我很抱歉。

original: Our faith is being judged every day, captain. We can't ignore it.
traduit: 我们的信仰每天都受到考验，队长。我们不能忽视这点。

original: Elder, we barely have enough men to keep the town safe as it is. I can't pull them off watch.
traduit: 长老，我们的人手快不够保护镇子的安全了。我不能把他们调离岗位。

original: Captain Veleth, I haven't seen you or your men visiting the Temple.
traduit: 维黎斯队长，我很久没见你和手下们来神殿参拜了。

original: Sorry, I... Never mind.
traduit: 对不起，我……算了。

original: Fethis, they doesn't care about us. If they did, we wouldn't be standing ankle-deep in ash trying to sell a few meager trinkets to survive.
traduit: 费希斯，他们根本不关心我们。不然的话，怎么会让我们深陷灰烬中，靠着卖些小首饰来谋生。

original: They just send you those promises to keep you off their backs... you must know this.
traduit: 他们只是在用这些许诺来应付你，让你别烦他们了……你肯定也知道啊。

original: What's that supposed to mean?
traduit: 你什么意思？

original: Gods. Not this again.
traduit: 天啊，又来了。

original: Milore, I've finally gotten that letter back from the East Empire Company.
traduit: 米洛尔，我终于收到东帝国公司的回信了。

original: Thanks, Milore. I appreciate that.
traduit: 谢了，米洛尔。借你吉言。

original: Have faith. Things will change for the better.
traduit: 要有信心。事情会好转的。

original: Haven't sold much.
traduit: 没卖出什么东西。

original: It's going to be a long time before things ever get back to the way they were... if ever.
traduit: 要恢复到以前的样子还有的等了……可能的话。

original: How's business today, Fethis?
traduit: 今天生意如何，费希斯？

original: Don't worry, my love. I'll find a way.
traduit: 不用担心，亲爱的。我会有法子的。

original: I don't want you hunting them again. You almost got killed last time.
traduit: 别再去猎杀它们了。上次你差点送了命。

original: Damn. I'm still low on netch jelly. He might have to wait until next month until I can gather some more.
traduit: 该死。我的气母胶质还是不够。他可能得等到下个月我再采一些的时候了。

original: Gjalund said our customer in Windhelm wants more of that balm.
traduit: 加朗德说我们在风舵城的客人还想要更多的香油。

original: Be careful out there.
traduit: 在外面要小心。

original: Pleasant journey, serjo.
traduit: 旅途愉快，塞乔。

original: May your path be free from danger.
traduit: 愿你的前路免于危险。

original: Don't stay away for too long.
traduit: 别离开太久。

original: Next time, then.
traduit: 下次吧。

original: Next time you're hungry, stop by... I always have plenty of food for sale.
traduit: 肚子饿了再来看看……吃的在我这儿随时能买到。

original: Remember, I have plenty of potions and ingredients if you're ever in the market.
traduit: 记着，想买许多药剂和材料的话，可以来我这儿。

original: Farewell, friend.
traduit: 再见了，朋友。

original: Another day of misery...
traduit: 又是悲惨的一天……

original: See you in the mines!
traduit: 矿场里见！

original: Don't waste your life like I did.
traduit: 别像我一样虚度光阴。

original: May the wind be at your back, friend.
traduit: 祝你一路顺风，朋友。

original: My doors are open if you wish to discuss matters involving Raven Rock.
traduit: 如果想讨论鸦石镇的相关事务，请随时过来坐坐。

original: I'm pleased I was mistaken about you, serjo.
traduit: 很高兴我把你看走眼了，塞乔。

original: I appreciate the help you've been giving us.
traduit: 感谢你为我们做的一切。

original: Remember, we're watching you.
traduit: 记住，我们盯着你呢。

original: Good journey, traveler.
traduit: 祝你旅途顺利，旅客。

original: Thank you for your assistance, it's raised my men's spirits quite a bit.
traduit: 感谢你的协助，让我的手下士气上升了。

original: Abide by our laws, and we'll get along well.
traduit: 遵守这里的法律，我们就相安无事。

original: May Azura, Mephala and Boethia guide you.
traduit: 愿阿祖拉、梅法拉和波耶西亚指引你。

original: Non-believers are never welcome here.
traduit: 这儿不欢迎非宗教信徒。

original: Come back anytime, my doors are always open.
traduit: 随时回来，我这门永远开着的。

original: Watch yourself out there... looks like an ash storm might be brewing.
traduit: 外出时小心点儿……看来有场风暴正在酝酿。

original: Come back if you're feeling thirsty. I'll set you up right.
traduit: 口渴了就回来吧，立马给你满上。

original: Safe travels, outlander.
traduit: 祝旅途平安，外地人。

original: If you need any supplies, you know where to find me.
traduit: 如果需要任何补给的话，你知道在哪儿找我。

original: Keep yourself safe... Solstheim's still a dangerous place.
traduit: 顾好自己的安全……索瑟海姆还是危险的地方。

original: Bring your weapons and armor to me. I'll fix it up right.
traduit: 带着你的武器和护甲来找我，能帮你修好。

original: Thank you, stranger. Thanks for everything.
traduit: 谢谢你，陌生人。谢谢你做的一切。

original: Mark my words. Raven Rock isn't finished yet.
traduit: 听好了，鸦石镇还有未来。

original: Send the Skaal shaman to me. He holds the secrets that will be mine.
traduit: 把斯卡尔萨满带来见我，我会得到他守护的秘密。

original: I know what you want: to use your power as Dragonborn to bend the world to your will.
traduit: 我知道你想要什么：运用你作为龙裔的力量，让世界臣服于你。

original: But this is not enough. Miraak knows the final Word of Power. Without that, you cannot hope to surpass him.
traduit: 但这还不够。米拉克还知道最后一句力量之语。少了它，你就别指望能胜过他。

original: The second Word of Power. Use it to bend the wills of mortals to your purpose.
traduit: 第二句力量之语。用它来使凡人的意志为你的目的所用。

original: Here then is the knowledge you need, although you did not know you needed it.
traduit: 这就是你需要的知识，尽管你不知道自己需要。

original: Ah, splendid! I had no doubt you'd make it across. Let's see what awaits us ahead.
traduit: 啊，太好了！我从不怀疑你能过去。让我们看看有什么在前头等着。

original: Keep moving, and don't look down! Well...other than to see where you're going, of course.
traduit: 继续走，别往下看！嗯……除非你是要看路，当然了。

original: If you can keep up with the platforms, you should be able to get across the chasm.
traduit: 要是你能跟上平台的速度，应该就能穿过这段深渊。

original: By the nine! I've never seen anything like this. They appear to be platforms made entirely of magical force. Absolutely remarkable!
traduit: 九圣灵啊！我没见过这种东西。它们像是魔法能量形成的平台。太神奇了！

original: I'm sure everything will be fine.
traduit: 我确定不会有事的。

original: I'll just stand over here while you flip that switch.
traduit: 你按开关的时候我就站这里好了。

original: There appears to be a switch of some kind here.
traduit: 这里有个类似开关的东西。

original: Here's another riddle. "Stay your course. To idle is to die." Well, at least it's straightforward.
traduit: 又一道谜语。“勇往直前，发呆者死。”好吧，至少说的很直白。

original: Alright, lets see what we have next.
traduit: 好吧，看看接下来有什么。

original: Now, lets see if we can find the other half of that claw.
traduit: 现在，看看能不能找到另一半龙爪。

original: Alright, now just unlock the other one.
traduit: 好了，现在去解开另一边。

original: Ah! So, that's where that goes!
traduit: 啊！原来是这么回事啊！

original: Splendid! The gates have opened!
traduit: 太好了！门打开了！

original: And...
traduit: 然后……

original: Only five more to go! Now let's just hope something good happens when you hit the last one.
traduit: 只剩下五个了！只希望当你踏上最后一块时发生的是好事。

original: Careful there!
traduit: 小心点！

original: And two, I'm not going anywhere near them.
traduit: 二，我可不打算靠近它们。

original: One, the riddle is most likely referring to these flat square stones.
traduit: 一，这道谜语看起来像在说这些扁方石头。

original: Well, I'm pretty sure about two things.
traduit: 嗯，我可以确定两件事。

original: "Continue along the path, don't tread where you've been.." Interesting...
traduit: “顺应道路，永不回头。”有趣……

original: I expect there's another riddle in here, along with a puzzle.
traduit: 我觉得这里该有另一道谜语，还有一道难题。

original: Well done! It looks like we can head in either direction. Since you seem to know what you're doing, why don't you lead the way?
traduit: 干得好！看来我们能选一个方向前进了。既然你看来很有把握，为什么不让你来带路呢。

original: You go ahead and see what you can figure out.  I'll look around and see if I can find anything of use.
traduit: 你先去看看能发现什么。我会到处看看，也许能找到有用的东西。

original: There you go! Now let's see what mysteries await us in the next room.
traduit: 成功了！现在来看看下个房间有什么谜题等着我们。

original: Ah, that's the trick!
traduit: 啊，是这样啊。

original: Perhaps a different form of attack will yield better results.
traduit: 也许换种攻击方式会有更好的结果。

original: Well, see what you can figure out. I'm going to inspect these pillars further to see if I've missed something.
traduit: 嗯，你看看能发现什么。我来仔细观察下这些石柱，也许我错过了什么。

original: They also have glowing stones of some kind at the top. They look vaguely similar to drawings I've seen of objects called Impact Stones.
traduit: 它们顶部也有那种发光的石头。看起来有点像我见过的，某种叫“冲击石”的东西。

original: Three pillars surrounding a central one. Perhaps they are connected somehow?
traduit: 三根石柱围绕着中心的一条。没准它们有某种联系？

original: The inscription must be a reference to these pillars.
traduit: 碑文一定是在说这些石柱了。

original: "All men must die, often by their own means." Sounds rather grim, if you ask me.
traduit: “人谁不死，自取其果。”听起来有点可怕啊。

original: Hm... three pillars. Other than that plaque, there doesn't seem to be anything else worthy of note. Let's see what the inscription says.
traduit: 嗯……三根石柱。好像除了那座石碑外，没什么值得注意的了。来看看碑文写了什么。

original: I wonder if this fire pit has anything to do with the riddle.
traduit: 你说这个火坑与谜语有关系吗？

original: Mind your step. There seem to be some corpses strewn about on the floor here.
traduit: 注意你的脚步。地板上好像有几具尸体。

original: "A sacrifice will bring you closer to that which you seek." I wonder what it means.
traduit: “牺牲会让你更接近所求。”我想知道这意味着什么。

original: Now, I'm not sure if you can read the dragon language, but this seems to be a riddle of some sort.
traduit: 嗯，我不清楚你能不能读懂龙语，但这看来是某种谜语。

original: I've had a look around and the only interesting thing I've found is this inscription here, and a switch below it.
traduit: 我四处看了看，只有这个碑文和它下面的开关有点意思。

original: Galdrus, it's time for your lesson.
traduit: 加德鲁斯，该来上课了。

original: Sotha Sil, Almalexia and Vivec. Saints who were never meant to be the cornerstones of our faith.
traduit: 索萨·希尔、阿玛莱西亚还有维威克。这些圣人们从来不该是我们信仰中的基石。

original: What consequences did we suffer from this fallacy?
traduit: 这种谬论让我们承受了什么后果？

original: The Reclaimations are Azura, Mephala and Boethia. They mean to reclaim what was lost from the Tribunal's falsehoods and lies.
traduit: 收复者们是阿祖拉、梅法拉和波耶西亚。它们收复了因审判席的虚伪和谎言而失去的东西。

original: Who are the Reclamations?
traduit: 收复者们是什么？

original: Why do we rejoice that The Tribunal has fallen and their false promises are but a memory?
traduit: 审判席倒台了，他们的虚伪预示也不过是回忆罢了。为什么我们要对此感到欣喜？

original: Aha! Here's another of those dragon language inscriptions! I wonder what it says.
traduit: 啊哈！这里有另一条龙语碑文！看看说了些什么？

original: Just let me study these runes for a moment...
traduit: 让我研究一会儿这些符文……

original: Hmm, here's another mention of the guardian. I can only assume that this is the guardian's tomb we are standing in now.
traduit: 嗯，这里又提到了那个守护者。我只能假设我们正在那位守护者的墓里。

original: It says that he was loyal, and his reward was an honorable death. Quite fascinating.
traduit: 这里提到他很忠诚，荣耀的死即是对他的奖励。很有趣。

original: The writing describes a guardian who defeated someone named Miraak.
traduit: 这段文字描述了一位守护者，他击败了一个叫“米拉克”的人。

original: In fact, if I'm reading this correctly, it says that Miraak was a traitor. Most interesting.
traduit: 这么说吧，要是我没搞错的话，写的是米拉克是个叛徒。太有趣了。

original: These runes have faded a bit, but I believe I can translate the inscription.
traduit: 这些符文已经有些褪色了，但我一定能翻译出碑文。

original: Let's find out what's written here.
traduit: 看看这里写了什么。

original: Let's have a closer look at these runes.
traduit: 仔细看看这些符文吧。

original: Look! Here's another wall with dragon language inscriptions on it!
traduit: 你看！这里有另一面龙语碑！

original: This writing refers to a guardian who inspired both men and dragons.
traduit: 这段文字说的是一位激励着人类与龙族的守护者。

original: I wonder if the guardian was himself a man or a dragon?
traduit: 也不知道这位守护者是人还是龙。

original: More of the dragon-tongue. The runes have faded a bit, but I believe I can translate the inscription.
traduit: 又有龙语了。这些符文有些褪色了，但我一定能翻译出碑文。

original: Finally. I can get back to work.
traduit: 我终于可以回去工作了。

original: Are we done? I thought so.
traduit: 说完了吗？我想也是。

original: That's that then.
traduit: 就这样吧。

original: What do you think you're doing?
traduit: 你以为自己在干什么？

original: That belongs to me.
traduit: 那是我的。

original: Do you have a death wish?
traduit: 找死是吧？

original: I wouldn't if I were you. A wizard's pockets can be more dangerous than a dragon's mouth.
traduit: 我要是你就不这么干。法师的口袋可比龙嘴还危险。

original: Keep your prying hands away from my secrets.
traduit: 别用你的脏手碰我的秘密。

original: Clumsy oaf!
traduit: 笨手笨脚的家伙！

original: Watch out! My equipment is fragile.
traduit: 小心！我的设备很脆！

original: Yes, yes. You're Dragonborn. We're all very impressed.
traduit: 对，对。你是龙裔。真了不得。

original: Was that really necessary?
traduit: 真的有必要吗？

original: Hmm. I'll have to get someone to bring this to my lab.
traduit: 嗯。我得找人把这个带回实验室。

original: What a waste of a good specimen.
traduit: 多好的样本就这样浪费了。

original: Fascinating.
traduit: 有意思。

original: They aren't very clever, are they?
traduit: 他们不太聪明，是吧？

original: Careful with that thing!
traduit: 小心那东西！

original: Am I supposed to be frightened?
traduit: 我该感到害怕吗？

original: Watch where you're going.
traduit: 小心看路。

original: Stop that!
traduit: 停下！

original: Get out of my tower.
traduit: 滚出我的塔。

original: Well, my pretties. What shall we do today? Maybe see if you can regenerate your fingers?
traduit: 我的漂亮宝贝儿们，今天我们做点啥？或许看看你们能不能长出新指头？

original: There must be a way. I'll find it if I have to vivisect every spriggan on this island.
traduit: 一定有法子的。即使要我解剖岛上的每只木灵也要找到。

original: Spriggans. Ugh.
traduit: 木灵。呜呕。

original: What...? Whoever did this is dead. You hear me? Dead!
traduit: 什么……？无论是谁干的都得死，听到了吗？你死定了！

original: Hey! We got a deader over here!
traduit: 嘿！这儿有具尸体！

original: Ash and ice! Who did this? Come out and face me like a man!
traduit: 灰和冰啊！谁干的？有种滚出来见我！

original: ...retire some day... get my self a place on the mainland...
traduit: ……等哪天退休了……给自己在大陆上找块地儿……

original: ...I've almost got enough... just need one good haul...
traduit: ……我快挣够了……只要再干一票大的……

original: ...might pay off my bounty this time... walk into Raven Rock a free man...
traduit: ……这次应该够付我的赏金了……作为自由人走进鸦石镇……

original: ...told him to just hand it over, but did he listen? Oh, no... he had to fight back...
traduit: ……都告诉他交出来了，他听了吗？没有……非要抵抗……

original: ...ain't goin' back to prison... rather die in the ash...
traduit: ……才不回监狱里去……宁可死在灰里……

original: ...he he he... callin' my bluff when he rolls dragon eyes... the fool...
traduit: ……嘿嘿嘿……敢在玩牌的时候说我诈和……傻子……

original: ...just one more bottle... maybe a second one to get to sleep...
traduit: ……再来一瓶儿……也许得两瓶儿才睡得着……

original: ...she was real surprised when I pulled that knife from my boot...
traduit: ……我从鞋子里抽出刀来给她吓傻了……

original: ...should have known she wouldn't wait for me... I'll gut that filthy farmer when I see him...
traduit: ……早就知道她不会等我了……等我看见那该死的农民就宰了他……

original: ..."he's got your eyes," she says... lyin' tramp...
traduit: ……她说“他眼睛很像你”……谎话连篇……

original: ...captain promised me a life o' adventure on the high seas...instead I'm stuck on this cesspit of an island...
traduit: ……船长答应我这辈子都在海上冒险……现在却困在这粪坑一样的岛上……

original: ...damn wizards... not good enough for yer precious college, eh?
traduit: ……该死的法师……我不配进你们高贵的学院，对吧？

original: ...I'd kill for a decent bottle of mead... not fair that they always take the good stuff...
traduit: ……一瓶上好的蜜酒能让我去杀人……好东西全给他们拿走了，不公平……

original: ...I should go back to pickin' pockets in Windhelm... easy money, less chance of an axe in your skull...
traduit: ……我该回风舵城去当小偷儿……来钱快，也没那么容易被砍头……

original: ...knew a girl with hair of gold, I called her fair, she called me bold...
traduit: ……认识个金发女孩儿，我叫她美女，她叫我莽夫……

original: ...ale and mead, ale and mead, 'tis the only advice a sailor heeds...
traduit: ……啤酒和蜜酒，啤酒和蜜酒，水手喝了就得救……

original: Why do I need this Word of Power to defeat Miraak?
traduit: 我为什么需要这句力量之语来打败米拉克？

original: Even dragons submit to Miraak's Voice. Without that power, you cannot face him. So say I, Hermaeus Mora, master of the tides of Fate.
traduit: 就连龙也会屈服于米拉克的吼声。没有那种力量，你就无法面对他。此，即命运潮汐之主，赫麦尤斯·莫拉的断言。

original: Thank you for setting my mind to rest. Now I can hope the All-Maker will show mercy to him in the beyond.
traduit: 感谢你让我的心灵回归平静。现在我希望造物主在他往生的日子里赐予他仁爱。

original: Let me impart some of the wisdom of the Skaal to you. You've done me a service; I will do you one in kind.
traduit: 让我传授些斯卡尔人的智慧给你。你帮了我的大忙，我必须报答你。

original: I just got out of there as fast as I could.
traduit: 我以最快的速度离开了那里。

original: I didn't take you for a coward. But until we know the limits of our courage, we don't really know ourselves.
traduit: 没想到你是个懦夫。但只有知晓了勇气的极限在哪儿，才算是真正的了解自己。

original: Hard to be sure. He put up a strong fight.
traduit: 我不确定，他跟我缠斗了一阵子。

original: Well, the truth is my brother really died long ago.
traduit: 嗯，其实我兄弟很久以前就死了。

original: What was left of him.
traduit: 一下子就完事了。

original: He had become a werebear.
traduit: 他变成熊人了。

original: He appeared mad. I had to kill him to defend myself.
traduit: 他看上去像是疯了，我不得不杀了他来自卫。

original: I... I understand. That's not an existence I would wish on anyone.
traduit: 我……我明白了。我不希望有人这样活着。

original: I hope you gave him a swift end.
traduit: 希望你让他走得痛快。

original: It looks like I was right. He was taken in by that...
traduit: 看来我猜对了，他被那东西给……

original: Where did you find this?
traduit: 你在哪里找到的？

original: I have a letter from your brother. (Give letter)
traduit: 我这里有一封你兄弟的信。（交出信件）

original: This is by his hand, for certain.
traduit: 这是他的笔迹，毫无疑问。

original: Do you have any idea where he might have gone?
traduit: 你知道他可能去哪里了吗？

original: He set off from here so long ago, it's hard to say. Could be in Hammerfell for all I know.
traduit: 他很早以前就离开了，很难说得清。在落锤都有可能。

original: If you happen to cross his path, be wary. He was a fierce warrior as a man. If he fell prey to his more bestial side, he could be deadly.
traduit: 你要是遇见他了，要小心。他还是人的时候就已经是个强悍的战士了，如果被自己的野性一面所控制，那就更加危险了。

original: What's a werebear?
traduit: 熊人是什么？

original: Twisted beasts, a curse of Hircine. True bears are noble and great creatures of the wild.
traduit: 一种被扭曲的野兽，是海尔辛的诅咒。真正的熊是大自然高贵而强大的生物。

original: But the daedra have no skill for creation, so they befile the All-Maker's workings.
traduit: 但是迪德拉可没有创造之力，他们只能改造造物主的作品。

original: I've heard tell of men who, by curse or by heart's desire, become transformed into one of those vile things.
traduit: 我听说有些被诅咒，或是自愿的人就会变成那种邪恶的东西。

original: It is a pitiable fate. And one that I fear has fallen to my brother.
traduit: 多可悲的命运，恐怕我兄弟也是其中一员了。

original: What happened to your brother?
traduit: 你兄弟出什么事了？

original: This... this is my brother's handwriting. This was his.
traduit: 这……这是我兄弟的笔迹。是他的。

original: I know that name... I found this near an old shrine. (Give journal.)
traduit: 我知道这个名字……这是在某个古老祭坛附近发现的。（交出日记）

original: I wish I could tell you.
traduit: 我自己也想知道。

original: He had a wild gleam in his eye, more than most.
traduit: 他眼睛里闪烁着狂野的光芒，比大多数人都强烈。

original: In my darkest times, I fear he fell in among the werebears of the glacier.
traduit: 我就怕，在我遭难的时候，他会跑去加入冰川熊人。

original: I hope you will give me word if you find anything about my brother.
traduit: 如果你找到了关于我兄弟的任何消息，请跟我说一声。

original: How long have you been First Hunter?
traduit: 你担任首席猎人有多久了？

original: In days past, my brother Torkild and I would share the hunt, but that was... long ago.
traduit: 从以前我兄弟托基尔德跟我一起打猎的时候开始，但那是……很久以前了。

original: Have you been exiled?
traduit: 你们被放逐了？

original: I wouldn't call it that. We've just got a bit of an infestation, is all.
traduit: 倒不是这个意思。我们只是遇到了一些麻烦，仅此而已。

original: Down here to catch our breath, and then we'll be back in the hall once I get the rest of these up to move.
traduit: 我们在这下面喘口气，等其他人爬得起来，我们就会打回大厅去。

original: What is the Skaal?
traduit: 斯卡尔是什么？

original: The Skaal is a group of Nords who live up to the north of here. They're always talking about their connection to the natural world.
traduit: 斯卡尔人是一群住在北边的诺德人。他们总是谈论着自己和自然世界的纽带。

original: It's a lot of nonsense to me, but they seem to get by.
traduit: 听起来都是胡说八道，但是他们似乎过得还不错。

original: A long time ago, a man named Hrothmund left the Skaal to form his own tradition.
traduit: 很久以前，一个叫哈洛斯蒙德的人离开了斯卡尔村，开创了自己的传统。

original: Warriors in the wild, living like the Nords of old.
traduit: 以古代诺德人的方式，成为在野外求生的战士。

original: They would hunt, they would fight, and the mightiest among them would rise up as leader.
traduit: 他们会打猎，战斗，其中最强之人会担任首领。

original: But those days are behind us, now.
traduit: 但是那些日子离我们很遥远了。

original: I make it. I drink it. I share it with friends. Ha!
traduit: 我酿。我喝。我分享。哈！

original: Thirsk didn't always make its own mead. No, we used to get by on shipments from Skyrim.
traduit: 瑟斯科本来没有酿蜜酒。以前我们都是靠着天际来的物资过活的。

original: But those gold-grubbers at the East Empire Company started charging more than their share for bringing it over.
traduit: 但是后来那些东帝国公司的强盗们开始漫天要价。

original: We still buy what we have to, but I make as much as I can.
traduit: 我们仍会买些必需品，但酒我尽量自己酿。

original: Of course, the village to the north.
traduit: 当然，就是北边儿那个村子。

original: What is Thirsk?
traduit: 瑟斯科是什么？

original: Do you know of the Skaal?
traduit: 你知道斯卡尔吗？

original: What happened?
traduit: 发生了什么？

original: Rieklings.
traduit: 瑞克灵。

original: Those filthy vermin... they came in numbers. Waves of the things.
traduit: 那些肮脏的害虫……他们数量太多了，成群结队的来。

original: One at a time, they're pests, but with this many...
traduit: 一次一只还好对付，但数量太多了就……

original: And so here we are, out of our home.
traduit: 然后我们就来这儿了，被赶出了家门。

original: Here is the foul book that killed Storn. Take it away from here. Throw it into the sea. It is evil.
traduit: 这是杀了斯托恩的那本臭书。把它带走，扔到海里去吧。太邪恶了。

original: I think he knew what would happen. He saw his death in that book.
traduit: 我想他预料到了会发生什么。他在那本书里看到了自己的死亡。

original: Do not let his death be for nothing. Go and stop Miraak.
traduit: 别让他的牺牲白费了。去阻止米拉克吧。

original: I do not blame you. I know he chose this. I just wish he had seen another way.
traduit: 我不怪你。这是他自己的抉择。多希望他能找到其他的办法。

original: Leave me to mourn my father. I have no more words for you now.
traduit: 留我在这儿为父亲哀悼吧。我的话都说完了。

original: I understand. I'll talk to Storn.
traduit: 知道了，我会和斯托恩谈。

original: Good. Although I do not think he will help you. These secrets are sacred to us.
traduit: 很好。虽然我觉得他不会帮你。那些知识对我们来说无比神圣。

original: Aren't you his apprentice? He must have taught you his secrets...
traduit: 你不是他的弟子吗？他肯定告诉过你他的秘密……

original: You will not convince me to betray Storn's trust. Talk to him. He will decide the matter.
traduit: 别想说服我背叛斯托恩的信任。自己跟他谈，由他来决定。

original: I need the "secrets of the Skaal" in order to defeat Miraak.
traduit: 我需要“斯卡尔的秘密”来打败米拉克。

original: You must talk to Storn, then. As shaman, he is the keeper of such lore.
traduit: 那么你必须和斯托恩谈。作为萨满，他负责守护这些知识。

original: I have learned some of what he knows, but it is not my place to divulge anything to an outsider.
traduit: 我大概了解了他所知道的，但是无权透露给外来者。

original: There you go. I didn't doubt you for a second. Let's see what's up ahead.
traduit: 成功了，我就知道你行。继续看看前面有什么吧。

original: That's all I can make out from this etching. I'll check the rest and see if there's anything else. You keep trying out the combinations.
traduit: 从蚀刻碑上就只能看出这些。我去看看其他还有什么。你试试各种组合吧。

original: And the third has something to do with fire. It also seems to mention scales.
traduit: 第三个是与火有关的什么东西。好像也提到了鳞片。

original: The second one mentions the the night sky, and the moon.
traduit: 第二个提到了夜空，还有月亮。

original: Ah, yes, here's something. The first one has to do with a breeze, or maybe it's wind.
traduit: 啊，是的，有了。第一个跟微风有关，可能就是风。

original: Perhaps there's enough undamaged text in these etchings to tell us the combination.
traduit: 可能这里还没损坏的文本雕刻能告诉我们怎么组合。

original: It seems these rings can be moved.
traduit: 这些圆环应该可以转动。

original: Hmm...looks like it needs some sort of key. Maybe those half claws you found would fit in here if you put them together?
traduit: 嗯……看来需要某种钥匙。也许你找来的半只爪子合起来能放进去？

original: There must be hundreds of years of history etched in these walls. Too bad they seem to be too damaged to read.
traduit: 这些墙上应该刻有数百年的历史，可惜破损太多难以阅读。

original: Ah, the Hall of Stories. These are found in many ancient Nord tombs.
traduit: 啊，故事大厅，很多诺德墓穴里都有。

original: I didn't think you were going to survive that fall, let alone those things that were down there.
traduit: 我以为你掉下去就回不来了，何况下面还有那些东西等着你。

original: I'm guessing this one will be even faster. Just remember to stay focused, and most importantly, run!
traduit: 我猜这次可能会更快，记得保持专注，跑就完了！

original: These platforms are definitely moving more quickly. Can you keep up with them?
traduit: 这些平台的移动速度真的变快了，你跟得上它们吗？

original: I'm glad these platforms appear once you finish them. I don't want to find out what's down in that water.
traduit: 幸好你过了平台后所有的平台重新出现了，我可不想知道下面水里有什么。

original: Is it just me, or are these platforms moving a little faster?
traduit: 是我的错觉，还是这些平台的移动速度变快了？

original: That looks like quite a drop! Is there something moving down there?
traduit: 看起来好深啊！下面有活物吗？

original: Aha!
traduit: 啊哈！

original: Thought you could hide, eh?
traduit: 觉得躲得了是吧？

original: So that's where you went!
traduit: 原来跑那儿去了！

original: Ha! I guess they fled.
traduit: 哈！看来他们跑了。

original: Well. Nobody is here now.
traduit: 嗯。现在这儿没人了。

original: Must have scared them away.
traduit: 他们应该被吓跑了。

original: You can only hide so long.
traduit: 你就能藏一会儿罢了。

original: Some sort of trickery is at work here.
traduit: 有人在这儿耍花招呢。

original: Try putting yourself back together now.
traduit: 现在打起精神来吧。

original: I could almost admire these Dwemer machines if they weren't so annoying.
traduit: 我确实欣赏这些锻莫机械，但它们太烦人了。

original: Another one for the scrap heap of history.
traduit: 又一个扫入历史的垃圾堆。

original: No match for my magic.
traduit: 我的法术无可匹敌。

original: That's that.
traduit: 结束了。

original: Hardly a challenge.
traduit: 轻松得很呐。

original: Should have known better than to challenge a master wizard of the House Telvanni.
traduit: 你早该知道泰瓦尼的高等巫师不容挑战。

original: Just the shadows playing tricks.
traduit: 只是看花眼罢了。

original: Hmm. Nothing, I guess.
traduit: 嗯。应该没什么。

original: I could have sworn...oh well.
traduit: 我肯定……好吧。

original: More of these things?
traduit: 这玩意儿还多的是？

original: There seems to be an inexhaustible supply of these Dwemer contraptions.
traduit: 这些锻莫机关好像无穷无尽。

original: I think they may be rebuilding themselves while we're not looking.
traduit: 我猜它们大概会趁我们不注意时自我修复。

original: For House Telvanni!
traduit: 为了泰瓦尼家族！

original: You are no match for my magic!
traduit: 你挡不住我的魔法！

original: What have we here?
traduit: 看看这是个什么？

original: Nothing I can't handle!
traduit: 没什么是我解决不了的！

original: So you chose to day to die...
traduit: 看来你死期到了……

original: Fire, storm and ice!
traduit: 烈焰，风暴还有寒冰！

original: By the fires of Red Mountain!
traduit: 以红山之焰的名义！

original: You can't hide from a Telvanni wizard!
traduit: 休想躲过泰瓦尼巫师！

original: There you are!
traduit: 你在这儿！

original: Is someone there?
traduit: 有人吗？

original: Come out this instant!
traduit: 马上滚出来！

original: I'll find you.
traduit: 我会找到你的。

original: So you want to play hide and seek, eh?
traduit: 想玩捉迷藏，是吧？

original: Yes? Who's there?
traduit: 哦？是谁？

original: Hmm? Show yourself!
traduit: 嗯？快现身！

original: You'll pay for that!
traduit: 你要付出代价！

original: Uhh!
traduit: 呃！

original: Uh...now it's my turn!
traduit: 啊……换我啦！

original: Ah...damn you!
traduit: 啊……该死的！

original: By Malacath's hairy knuckles, you'll pay for that!
traduit: 玛拉凯斯的毛指头啊，你要付出代价！

original: I've just the spell for you!
traduit: 这法术就是给你准备的！

original: Fear my power!
traduit: 畏惧我的力量吧！

original: Time to die!
traduit: 去死吧！

original: Die N'wah!
traduit: 死吧，恩'瓦！

original: Damn fetcher!
traduit: 该死的费彻！

original: Learn the power of the Telvanni!
traduit: 见识泰瓦尼的力量吧！

original: Nyyahh!
traduit: 嗯啊！

original: Ahh!
traduit: 啊！

original: Get out of here before I toss you out.
traduit: 在被我扔出去前自己滚出去。

original: Leave, or I'll be forced to show you the true power of a Telvanni wizard.
traduit: 滚吧，不然就让你见识下泰瓦尼法师真正的力量。

original: I'll take care of you!
traduit: 我来收拾你！

original: I'll make you pay for that!
traduit: 我会让你付出代价！

original: You dare attack me?
traduit: 你居然敢攻击我！

original: Get your hand out of my pocket!
traduit: 把手从我口袋里拿开！

original: Thief! I'll teach you.
traduit: 小偷！我要给你个教训。

original: So you think you can steal from me?
traduit: 你觉得能从我这儿偷东西？

original: Agh! It... hurts.
traduit: 啊！好……痛。

original: No... not like this.
traduit: 不对……不能这样。

original: Does it bother you to be trespassing right now?
traduit: 现在后悔擅闯进来了吧？

original: Does stealing make you feel less impotent?
traduit: 偷东西让你觉得自己能干是吧？

original: I see you have little in the way of morals.
traduit: 看来你没什么道德可言。

original: Hmm. I expected you to die. Oh, well.
traduit: 嗯。还以为死的是你呢。算了。

original: Fascinating. I hope one of you dies.
traduit: 太棒了。希望你们当中死一个吧。

original: Ugh!
traduit: 啊！

original: So, you are smart enough to surrender to a master wizard of the House Telvanni.
traduit: 看来，你也知道该向泰瓦尼高等巫师投降。

original: I should kill you anyway, but that would be boring.
traduit: 我是该杀了你，但那太无聊了。

original: Dagon's eyeballs, but you're an ugly one, aren't you?
traduit: 大衮的眼珠子啊，你真他妈丑啊，是吧？

original: I am a master wizard of House Telvanni!
traduit: 我是泰瓦尼家的高等巫师！

original: I command powers you can only dream of!
traduit: 我的力量超乎你的想象！

original: You cannot best my magic!
traduit: 你无法抵抗我的魔法！

original: The very elements are at my command!
traduit: 诸般元素听我号令！

original: You are no match for me, dragon!
traduit: 你不是我的对手，龙！

original: Dwemer mechanisms have no sense of self preservation.
traduit: 锻莫机械都没有自我保护意识。

original: I admire the Dwemer skill but it can get tiresome.
traduit: 我确实欣赏锻莫技艺，但也审美疲劳了。

original: A werewolf? Here?
traduit: 有狼人？在这儿？

original: He's no longer commanding the ash spawn.
traduit: 他再也不能指挥那些灰烬怪了。

original: Then Raven Rock will no longer be attacked by those creatures.
traduit: 那么鸦石镇就再也不会被那些生物袭击了。

original: Councilor Morvayn was offering quite a bounty for assistance with this matter.
traduit: 莫尔凡议员开过一大笔赏金给解决这个麻烦的人。

original: I'd say you've more than earned it.
traduit: 我认为那是你应得的。

original: I found this letter.
traduit: 我找到了这封信。

original: Let me see that.
traduit: 让我看看。

original: Judging from these writings, General Carius was under the impression that the fort was still active as it was 200 years ago.
traduit: 从这些文字来看，卡里乌斯将军还认为那座堡垒跟200年前一样活跃。

original: What turned him into one of the undead appears to remain a mystery for now.
traduit: 至于他被什么东西变成亡灵现在还不清楚。

original: I think I've solved your ash spawn problems.
traduit: 我想我解决了你的灰烬怪难题。

original: Excuse me? How can you be so certain?
traduit: 你说什么？你怎么能如此肯定？

original: He'll no longer send ash spawn to Raven Rock.
traduit: 他不会再派灰烬怪来鸦石镇了。

original: Councilor Morvayn told me to give this to you if you made it back in one piece... and you got rid of General Carius.
traduit: 莫尔凡议员说，只要你能活着回来，就把这个给你……何况你还把卡里乌斯将军解决了。

original: Better than a soldier's pay, so you should be thankful.
traduit: 这可比士兵的酬劳高多了，你该心存感激。

original: I killed General Carius.
traduit: 我杀了卡里乌斯将军。

original: I had my suspicions that he was undead. How else could he have survived for over 200 years?
traduit: 之前我就怀疑过他是亡灵，不然怎么会过了两百多年还活着。

original: It's a shame. There are quite a few tales of General Carius's exploits, including the founding of Raven Rock.
traduit: 太遗憾了。卡里乌斯将军的很多功绩至今还在这里被传颂，鸦石镇能建立也多亏了他。

original: I have some information about Fort Frostmoth.
traduit: 我有些关于霜蛾堡的情报。

original: You should bring this information to Captain Veleth as soon as possible.
traduit: 你该尽快把这个情报送给维黎斯队长。

original: Do you have any insights to share about this puzzle?
traduit: 你对这个谜题有什么看法？
