original: Drovas, I thought I told you I needed the jazbay crushed for my Emberbrand Wine. Where is it?
traduit: 多瓦斯，我告诉过你要把贾兹贝葡萄榨汁来做余烬牌葡萄酒。在哪儿呢？

original: Must've run off.
traduit: 应该跑了。

original: No one here now.
traduit: 这里没人。

original: Where'd you go?
traduit: 你去哪了？

original: Come back and fight me!
traduit: 回来干一架！

original: I return you to the ash.
traduit: 我要让你滚回灰烬。

original: Azura take you.
traduit: 阿祖拉会干掉你。

original: Another victory for the Redoran Guard.
traduit: 瑞多然卫兵的又一次胜利。

original: And so it ends.
traduit: 到此为止。

original: There was no other way it could end.
traduit: 这是必然的结果。

original: Victorious again.
traduit: 又赢了。

original: No need to be worried, I suppose.
traduit: 我想没必要担心。

original: Guess it was nothing.
traduit: 应该没什么。

original: I must have imagined it.
traduit: 肯定是我的幻想。

original: Something's wrong...
traduit: 不对劲…

original: Hm? What was that?
traduit: 嗯？那是啥？

original: That noise... I'm not alone here.
traduit: 那个声音…还有人。

original: I'll find you eventually.
traduit: 迟早找到你。

original: Going to hide, are you?
traduit: 还在躲，是吗？

original: You can't hide forever.
traduit: 你没法藏一辈子。

original: I may not be able to see you, but I can hear you.
traduit: 我可能没看见，但听到动静了。

original: Enough hiding. Come out and face me.
traduit: 别藏了，滚出来见我。

original: I know you're here.
traduit: 我知道你在这儿。

original: You can play this game as long as you like... I will find you.
traduit: 你想玩捉迷藏就继续…我会找到你的。

original: Come out!
traduit: 出来！

original: I'll cut you in two, fetcher!
traduit: 我会把你切成两半儿，费彻！

original: I'll scatter your ashes to the wind!
traduit: 我要把你骨灰扬了！

original: For House Redoran! For Honor!
traduit: 为了瑞多然家！为了荣耀！

original: How dare you invade our territory!
traduit: 你竟敢入侵我们的领地！

original: Your remains will be hung from the Bulwark!
traduit: 你的尸体会挂在防护堤上！

original: You've already lost!
traduit: 你已经输了！

original: I bring the might of House Redoran upon your head!
traduit: 以瑞多然家的力量给你压扁！

original: You'll regret raising a weapon against me!
traduit: 后悔对我出手吧！

original: Azura take you!
traduit: 阿祖拉会干掉你！

original: I die, serving my homeland...
traduit: 我为家园而死……

original: Azura, forgive me...
traduit: 阿祖拉，宽恕我……

original: I join you in death, father...
traduit: 我这就去找您，父亲……

original: Enough!
traduit: 够了！

original: Nuh!
traduit: 呜！

original: Arrgh!
traduit: 啊呃！

original: Maah!
traduit: 嘛啊！

original: Yeeeaarrggh!
traduit: 呀啊啊啊！

original: Rraaarrgghh!
traduit: 啊呃啊！

original: Nnnyyaarrgh!
traduit: 嗯啊啊啊！

original: Rraaah!
traduit: 啊！

original: Die!
traduit: 死吧！

original: I've found your missing Folio.
traduit: 我找到了你遗失的对开本。

original: You have?
traduit: 找到了？

original: You have no idea what this means to me... to my family. Reclamations bless you!
traduit: 你不知道这对我……我的家族来说意味着什么。愿收复者们保佑你！

original: Well, you've certainly proven your worth around here to me. Please, accept this gift as a token of my appreciation!
traduit: 好吧，你已经向我证明了自己的价值。请收下这份礼物，聊表我的感激吧。

original: Actually, I already have it. (Give Folio)
traduit: 事实上，我已经拿到了。（交出对开本）

original: Mephala bless you! You found it!
traduit: 梅法拉保佑你！你找到了！

original: Sorry, can't help you with that.
traduit: 抱歉，我无能为力。

original: Offer to help and then change your mind because I mentioned the reavers? Hmph, some sellsword you are.
traduit: 你说要帮我，结果听到我说有抢匪就改变主意了？呵，你这佣兵不过如此啊。

original: I'll see if I can find the book for you.
traduit: 我看看能不能帮你找到那本书。

original: Thank you, you have no idea how much it hurts losing such a precious heirloom!
traduit: 谢谢你，你是不知道丢了那么贵重的传家宝有多心痛！

original: How do you know?
traduit: 你怎么会知道？

original: One of the sailors survived. Poor thing crawled all the way to Raven Rock on his hands and knees.
traduit: 其中一个水手活下来了。那可怜虫一路爬到鸦石镇。

original: Before he died, he told the Redoran Guard about the wreck and warned us that it was going to be crawling with reavers.
traduit: 他死之前，把船难告诉了瑞多然卫兵，警告我们那边以后会爬满一堆抢匪。

original: Was it aboard a ship?
traduit: 是船运吗？

original: Yes, the "Strident Squall" or something like that.
traduit: 是的，叫做“尖啸号”或者类似的名字。

original: The damn thing sunk right off the coast of Solstheim. Can you imagine?
traduit: 那该死的船就在索瑟海姆海岸上搁浅了，你敢信？

original: You mentioned that you lost something?
traduit: 你说丢了什么东西？

original: A few months ago, I had sent an important folio to the First Edition Bookshop in the Imperial City to be rebound.
traduit: 几个月前，我寄了一本重要的对开本给帝都的“初版书店”，请他们帮我重新装订。

original: They sent it back to me recently, but it never arrived.
traduit: 他们最近给我寄回来了，但是一直没有送达。

original: Strong steel guard you, friend.
traduit: 强兵利器会护你周全，朋友。

original: Farewell, strong one.
traduit: 再见，大块头。

original: Be always warm, Skaal-friend.
traduit: 注意保暖，斯卡尔之友。

original: May the sun light your path.
traduit: 愿阳光照耀你的前路。

original: Be welcome in our village.
traduit: 欢迎来我们的村子。

original: Until our next meeting, outsider.
traduit: 后会有期，外来者。

original: Farewell, outsider.
traduit: 再见，外来者。

original: All-Maker guide you.
traduit: 造物主会指引你。

original: All-Maker shelter you.
traduit: 愿造物主庇佑你。

original: May darkness never touch you.
traduit: 愿黑暗远离你。

original: Strength and courage be always with you.
traduit: 愿力量与勇气永远伴随着你。

original: Yes, yes, of course. Goodbye.
traduit: 好，好的，没问题。再见。

original: Until next time, then.
traduit: 那回头见了。

original: You need to leave? Alright.
traduit: 你得走了？好吧。

original: I'm sure you have more important things to do. Farewell, then.
traduit: 我想你有更重要的事儿要做。那就再见了。

original: May your hunts always bring you game.
traduit: 愿你总能打到猎物。

original: Remember to hunt only when you have need.
traduit: 记住只在有需要的时候去狩猎。

original: What is your role among the Skaal?
traduit: 你在斯卡尔村的职责是？

original: As shaman of Skaal Village, I serve as both a guide and a healer, as well as a keeper of traditions.
traduit: 作为斯卡尔村的萨满，我既是向导又是医师，也是习俗的传承者。

original: I also remind the Skaal to live as one with nature and to honor the will of the All-Maker, so that we'll be worthy to join him in death.
traduit: 还要提醒斯卡尔人与自然和平共处，尊重造物主的意愿，这样死后才能与它合一。

original: We make a good team. Why not join me for a while?
traduit: 我们配合得还不错，要不暂时和我同行？

original: Join you? You mean leave the village to journey with you and fight at your side?
traduit: 和你同行？你是指让我离开村子和你并肩作战？

original: I'm flattered, but the village is my home. It's very rare for one of the Skaal to leave, and I have responsibilities here.
traduit: 我很荣幸，但斯卡尔村是我的家。很少有斯卡尔人会离开，何况我在这里有应尽的义务。

original: I'll make it worth your while. (<bribecost> gold)
traduit: 我不会让你白走一趟的。（<bribecost>金币）

original: The land provides all that I need. I have no use for your coins.
traduit: 这片土地提供了我需要的一切，你的钱对我没用处。

original: As I've already told you, I have no need of money.
traduit: 已经说过了，我不需要钱。

original: You can trust me. I saved your life, remember? (Persuade)
traduit: 你可以信任我。我救过你的命，还记得吗？（说服）

original: You're right. I suppose the others can get by without me for awhile.
traduit: 你说得对。离开大家一段时间大概也没什么问题。

original: Very well, if you need my help, seek me out here in the village.
traduit: 好吧，需要帮忙就来村子里找我吧。

original: I am sorry, but I must refuse. I am grateful for your help, but my place is here, with my people.
traduit: 抱歉，但是我得拒绝。我很感激你的帮助，但是我必须留在这儿，和族人在一起。

original: We Skaal are not like you. We do not seek adventure, we wish only to live in peace and to honor our traditions. I hope you understand.
traduit: 斯卡尔与你不同。我们并不追求冒险，只想尊重传统安宁地过日子。希望你能理解。

original: Our defenses have been breached! I need reinforcements!
traduit: 我们的防线被突破了！需要增援！

original: Fort Frostmoth will never fall! Long live the Empire!
traduit: 霜蛾堡永不沦陷！帝国万岁！

original: Men, an invader has entered the fort! Prepare yourselves for an ambush!
traduit: 手下们，一个入侵者闯入了堡垒！准备好伏击！

original: My thuri Miraak is the only true Dovahkiin.
traduit: 我的图瑞米拉克是唯一的真都瓦克因。

original: Krin mey. You are a fool to challenge Miraak. His thu'um is supreme.
traduit: 克因 梅。妄想挑战米拉克实在愚蠢，他的吐'目是最强的。

original: Your death has been foretold.
traduit: 我已预见了你的死亡。

original: Aam uv dir. Those that will not serve Miraak must die.
traduit: 阿姆 乌维 迪尔。不臣服于米拉克的都得死。

original: Now we will see whose thu'um is the stronger!
traduit: 现在来看看谁的吐'目更强！

original: You are strong, Dovahkiin. Rinik mul. But not strong enough.
traduit: 你很强，都瓦克因。瑞尼克 穆尔。但还不够。

original: I came a long way to kill you.
traduit: 我跋涉到此专为杀你。

original: I don't plan on being killed by the likes of you.
traduit: 你这等货色岂能杀我。

original: I don't have to know what you are to kill you.
traduit: 要宰了你没必要知道你是什么东西。

original: What next, carnivorous rabbits?
traduit: 下回是什么？食人兔吗？

original: I don't know whether to kill it or pet it.
traduit: 也不知道是该弄死它还是该摸摸它。

original: That's a nice trick, but it won't save your skin.
traduit: 有趣的把戏，但那可救不了你。

original: If you have to ask that, you'd probably be best leaving his books to wiser heads than yours.
traduit: 如果这都要问我，你最好还是把他的书留给其他更聪明的人。

original: Like all Daedric Princes, he's not to be trifled with. But he is subtler than most of his ilk, appropriate for the prince of knowledge and fate.
traduit: 所有迪德拉君王都不容小觑。但比起大多数同类们，他更狡猾诡秘，正合知识与命运之主这个头衔。

original: Many scholars and loremasters have been ensnared by the lure of learning the secrets that only Hermaeus Mora possesses.
traduit: 很多学者和博学家们都被赫麦尤斯·莫拉所引诱，去学习只有他才知晓的秘密。

original: But don't worry. I have no intention of joining them in their endless search through the infinite halls of Apocrypha.
traduit: 但别担心。我没想过要加入他们的行列，一直在异典无尽的大厅里获取知识。

original: Mu het. We are here.
traduit: 姆 赫特。我们到了。

original: Wundun oblaan. We have arrived.
traduit: 翁都 欧伯兰。我们到了。

original: We are here. Wundun oblaan. How else can I serve you?
traduit: 我们到了。翁都 欧伯兰。还有什么可以效劳的？

original: Drem. There is no prey here.
traduit: 旦姆。这里没有猎物。

original: I sense nothing nearby.
traduit: 我感觉不到这附近有东西。

original: Krosis, the land below us is empty of prey.
traduit: 科洛西斯，下面没有猎物。

original: Krosis, thuri. That is impossible.
traduit: 科洛西斯，图瑞。那不可能。

original: Zu'u nis. I cannot do that.
traduit: 祖'乌 尼斯。我做不到。

original: Zu'u nis krif tol. It cannot be done.
traduit: 祖'乌 尼斯 克里夫 吐尔。我办不到。

original: As you command.
traduit: 遵命。

original: Mu fen krif.
traduit: 姆 芬 克瑞夫。

original: At once. Zu'u fen al.
traduit: 马上。祖'乌 芬 阿尔。

original: I will look for a spot to land.
traduit: 我会找个地方降落。

original: As you command. Mu daal wah golt.
traduit: 谨遵号令。姆 达尔 瓦 戈特。

original: Yes, thuri. Wah golt. I will land at once.
traduit: 是，图瑞。瓦 戈特。我马上降落。

original: What'll you give me for these?
traduit: 你打算开多少价？

original: Well, take a look at what I have and maybe we can make a deal.
traduit: 嗯，看看我有什么吧，没准能做成一笔买卖呢。

original: If you've got something to sell, I'm willing to buy. Why don't we see what kind of a deal we can make.
traduit: 你有得卖我就有得买。买卖不成仁义在。

original: If the quality's right, I'll take those off your hands. Let me take a look.
traduit: 质量过关我就跟你买了。让我看看。

original: Got the best merchandise on the island. Have a look for yourself.
traduit: 岛上最好的货物。自己来看看吧。

original: What do you have for sale?
traduit: 你卖些什么？

original: Just got some of my merchandise off the latest supply ship. See if anything strikes your fancy.
traduit: 刚到了一批运来的新货。看看有没有你喜欢的。

original: All sorts of useful things. Feel free to browse.
traduit: 各种有用的东西，随便看吧。

original: Follow me, I need your help.
traduit: 跟我来，我需要你帮忙。

original: I am sorry, but my duty is to my people right now.
traduit: 抱歉，但我有对族人的义务。

original: I will follow you, Skaal-friend, but I must return to the village afterward.
traduit: 我愿意跟随你，斯卡尔之友。但我之后就得返回村子。

original: You have a companion already. You don't need my help.
traduit: 你已经有位同伴了，不需要我的帮助。

original: What's being built outside of town?
traduit: 城外那是在建什么东西？

original: That? It's... Well, it's a shrine for... something. I'm not sure what.
traduit: 那个？那是……一座祭坛……给谁的来着，记不清了。

original: Yes, I... I'm not sure what to say. Did we build that? I really don't remember.
traduit: 嗯，我……我不知道该怎么讲。那是我们建的吗？真记不起来了。

original: Tell me about the shrine outside of town.
traduit: 跟我说说镇子外祭坛的事吧。

original: The Earth Stone is there, and the rest... It's a shrine, but I... Did we build that? I'm not sure.
traduit: 土石在那边，剩下的……是个祭坛，但是……是我们建的吗？我不确定。

original: I'm... I'm not really sure. I think it's important, but I can't say why...
traduit: 我……真不太能肯定。我知道那个很重要，但说不出个所以然来。

original: Why is there a shrine being built by the water?
traduit: 为什么要在水边修个祭坛？

original: A shrine for... Well, it's... I think it's important.
traduit: 一个为谁建的祭坛……好吧，它……它可能很重要。

original: Did we build that, or did I imagine that?
traduit: 是我们修的吗？还是我的幻想？

original: Can you tell me about the shrine outside of town?
traduit: 关于镇子外的祭坛能告诉我什么？

original: It's a shrine, I think. But I don't remember where it came from.
traduit: 是个祭坛吧，这样。但我记不得是从哪儿来的了。

original: I'm not sure. Did we build it? I can't remember...
traduit: 我不确信，是我们建的？记不得了。

original: Who is building that shrine?
traduit: 谁在外面盖那个祭坛？

original: It's a shrine to... I don't remember. Isn't that strange?
traduit: 是个用来……记不起来了，奇怪了。

original: I think it's important, but... I couldn't really say.
traduit: 我觉得那玩意儿很有必要但是……说不上来。

original: Why is a shrine being built near town?
traduit: 为什么镇子旁边儿在盖一座祭坛？

original: The Earth Stone, and... It's a shrine that... Hmm. I can't recall.
traduit: 那是土石跟……一座祭坛……额，想不起来了。

original: I don't know, it's hard to remember...
traduit: 我不知道，很难记起来……

original: Why build a shrine outside of town?
traduit: 你们为何要在镇子外修祭坛？

original: There's a shrine at the Earth Stone, but... well, I can't seem to recall what it's for.
traduit: 土石旁边有座祭坛，不过……好吧，看来我想不起来那是用来干啥的。

original: I don't know. I feel like I knew something about it, but now I can't remember.
traduit: 不清楚，我感觉我应该知道些什么，但想不起来了。

original: There's a shrine at the Earth Stone, I think.
traduit: 那祭坛挨着土石，是吧。

original: I can't really remember... I think I knew at one time, but now I'm not sure.
traduit: 我想不起来……以前好像知道，但现在不确定了。

original: The Earth Stone is there. There's also a shrine...
traduit: 土石在那儿，还有座祭坛……

original: Are we building it? I had a dream about that...
traduit: 我们盖的？梦里好像梦到过……

original: Why are you building a shrine near town?
traduit: 你们为什么在镇子旁边儿修个祭坛？

original: Do you mean by the Earth Stone? There's a shrine there, but I don't remember what it's for...
traduit: 你说土石旁边的？是有个祭坛，但我想不起来那是干啥的……

original: Well, I... You know, I can't remember. It's important, I think, but it's hard for me to think about.
traduit: 嗯，我……我真记不起来了，那很重要，但回想起来很不容易。

original: Can you tell me more about the shrine outside of town?
traduit: 能告诉我更多关于镇子外祭坛的事儿吗？

original: There's a shrine at the Earth Stone. It's... I'm not really sure what it's for. I thought I knew at one point.
traduit: 土石那边有座祭坛。它是……我也想不起来是干啥用的了，以前应该知道吧。

original: I don't know... Did we build that?
traduit: 不太清楚……真是我们建的吗？

original: There's a shrine there, but I'm not sure what it means...
traduit: 这儿有座祭坛，但我不确定那意味着什么……

original: Why can't I remember? I was sure it was important.
traduit: 为什么我想不起来了？我很确定那很重要。

original: Can you tell me more about the shrine near town?
traduit: 能告诉我关于镇子旁边祭坛的事儿吗？

original: It's a shrine, for... Err, I don't remember.
traduit: 那个祭坛是……呃，忘了。

original: I thought I remembered, but now I'm not sure. Is it important, or did I imagine that?
traduit: 感觉明明记得，但现在又不确定了。也不知道它是真重要，还是我想多了？

original: You there. What brings you to this place? Why are you here?
traduit: 那边的。你在这儿做什么？为什么来这里？

original: I was here alone then, and I find an assistant is absolutely essential for this kind of dirty, dangerous work.
traduit: 原本我是一个人来的，但我发现还必须有一名助手来帮我干这些危险的脏活儿。

original: Other Stones?
traduit: 其他的圣石？

original: I can feel it. The balance of the living land has nearly been restored.
traduit: 我感觉得到。这片土地已经快要恢复平衡了。

original: But while the Tree Stone remains under Miraak's influence, the natural order remains out of balance.
traduit: 但树石还在米拉克的控制下，自然秩序还没取得平衡。

original: And all can be undone if Miraak exerts his will again. You must continue on your path, and gather the knowledge you need to defeat him.
traduit: 如果米拉克再次施加他的意志，一切都将毁灭。你必须继续前行，收集打败他所需要的知识。

original: I've cleansed the other four Stones.
traduit: 我已经净化了其他四座立石。

original: Yes. There are six sacred Stones - Wind, Water, Earth, Beast, Sun, and Tree. Through them the Oneness of the land is maintained.
traduit: 没错。共有六座圣石——风、水、土、兽、日和树。这片土地的一体性正是通过它们而维持的。

original: Frea saw that the Tree Stone now stands imprisoned in Miraak's new temple. I doubt you can free it until his power is broken.
traduit: 芙瑞雅看到树石被困于米拉克的新神殿中。也不知你能不能在他的力量枯竭前解放它。

original: But you may be able to cleanse the other Stones. Even if this does not stop Miraak, it surely will delay his return.
traduit: 但也许你可以去净化其他圣石。就算这样做没法阻止米拉克，也能延缓他的回归。

original: What happened when I Shouted at the Wind Stone?
traduit: 我对风石使用龙吼时发生了什么？

original: The power of the Stone had been corrupted. It was the source of the influence that had taken control of the Skaal.
traduit: 圣石的力量被腐化了。就是那股力量的影响控制了斯卡尔。

original: Your Shout broke whatever evil will controlled the Stone, and restored its true nature as a conduit of the All-Maker's gifts.
traduit: 你的龙吼摧毁了控制圣石的不明邪恶力量，恢复了它真正的本质，即传递造物主赠予的媒介。

original: Freeing the other Stones will diminish whatever dark influence is spreading across Solstheim.
traduit: 解放其他的圣石可以减弱遍布索瑟海姆的黑暗控制力量。

original: Why do you think this Neloth can help me find Black Books?
traduit: 为什么你认为内洛斯可以帮我找到黑暗经书？

original: He also is searching for them. In fact, he has already found one. He showed it to me when he came here.
traduit: 因为他也在找它们，实际上已经找到一本了。他来这儿的时候给我看过。

original: It was very like the one you found in Miraak's temple. A thing of dark magic, not of the All-Maker.
traduit: 那本和你在米拉克神殿里找到的很像。属于黑暗魔法之物，而非源自造物主。

original: What do you know about these Black Books?
traduit: 关于这些黑暗经书你知道些什么？

original: Our traditions do not speak of them. But they and Miraak are connected. You read a Black Book, and saw him.
traduit: 按我们的传统不会探讨它们。但它们与米拉克有联系。你读了一本黑暗经书后，就看到了他。

original: And the book's power comes from the same dark source as that which corrupted the Wind Stone.
traduit: 这书的力量与腐化风石的力量可以追溯到同一源头。

original: But beware. You are now walking the same road as Miraak.
traduit: 但要小心。你已经在步米拉克的后尘了。

original: Come, there looks to be a way out through here.
traduit: 来吧，这边似乎有出口。

original: Very good, Galdrus. Your lessons are going well. You may carry on.
traduit: 很好，加德鲁斯。你的课上的很顺利，继续吧。

original: The destruction of our homeland, the exile of our people and the rebuilding of our civilization.
traduit: 我们家园的毁灭，我们族人的流亡还有文明的重建。

original: Who were the perpetrators of those falsehoods?
traduit: 那些谎言的编织者是谁？

original: We rejoice as the New Temple rises. We rejoice because we embrace the Reclamations as our saviors.
traduit: 我们是为新神殿的崛起而欣喜。我们是为拥抱收复者们为我们的救世主而欣喜。

original: Very well. I'm ready, Elder.
traduit: 好啊。我准备好了，长老。

original: It's the capital of Morrowind... been that way ever since Mournhold was sacked by the Argonians.
traduit: 那是晨风的首都，自从哀伤之城被阿尔贡洗劫后就是了。

original: I don't visit there often anymore, but we still get the occasional supply ship and visitors from there.
traduit: 我不常回去了，但偶尔会有物资船和访客从那儿来。

original: What is the city of Blacklight?
traduit: 黑光城是什么地方？

original: How can you have Dunmer blood in your veins and have no knowledge of Blacklight?
traduit: 你怎么流着丹莫的血却对黑光城一无所知？

original: Your ignorance of our homeland doesn't surprise me.
traduit: 看来你对我们的故乡一无所知，但也难怪。

original: I have to get back home.
traduit: 我得回家了。

original: I can't talk now. I must get back to the village.
traduit: 先不聊了。我得赶紧回村子里去。

original: I... I don't know how I got here.
traduit: 我……不知道怎么来这儿的。

original: Is this a dream? No, it is a nightmare, surely.
traduit: 这是一场梦吗？不，这肯定是场噩梦。

original: I can't speak now, friend. I must return home.
traduit: 现在不是说话的时候，朋友。我得先回家。

original: Thank you, my friend. You have set us free.
traduit: 谢谢你，我的朋友。你救了我们。

original: A fever must have taken me. What else could explain this?
traduit: 我一定是发烧昏头了，不然怎么解释？

original: I don't mean to be rude outsider, but I must get back to the village.
traduit: 恕我失礼，外来者，但我必须回村子。

original: Who are you? What am I doing here?
traduit: 你是谁？我怎么在这儿？

original: This... this is some dark magic. It has to be.
traduit: 这……这是某种黑暗魔法，错不了。

original: I have no time to speak now, outsider. I'm on my way home.
traduit: 我现在没空聊天，外来者。我要赶回家。

original: All-Maker bless you! You have saved us!
traduit: 造物主祝福你！你救了我们！

original: The whole village is here! What sorcery is this?
traduit: 全村儿的人都在这儿！这是什么巫术？

original: I must get back to the village. As leader of the Skaal, I'm needed there.
traduit: 我必须回村子，身为斯卡尔的首领，人们需要我。

original: Why was I building a temple?
traduit: 我为什么在建一座祭坛？

original: I must be going mad. But then, so must everyone else.
traduit: 我肯定是疯了，其他人也是。

original: Sorry friend, but I'm on the road home. Find me there and perhaps we can talk.
traduit: 抱歉，朋友，但我在回家的路上。等我到那边儿再聊吧。

original: You are a true hero. I thank you, friend.
traduit: 你是个真正的英雄，感谢你，朋友。

original: We're the victims of some evil magic, but why?
traduit: 我们成了某种邪恶法术的受害者，但是为什么呢？

original: I'm on my way to Skaal Village. Perhaps I'll see you there.
traduit: 我正在回斯卡尔村。也许我们在那边儿见？

original: Finna? Aeta? Where are my wife and daughter?!
traduit: 芬娜？爱耶塔？我妻子和女儿呢？

original: By the All-Maker, please let my wife and daughter be safe.
traduit: 造物主在上，请保佑我的妻女平安无事。

original: I must get home, outsider.
traduit: 我必须回家了，外来者。

original: What in Mundus am I doing out here at this hour?
traduit: 我他妈这会儿究竟在这外面干啥呢？

original: This is both fascinating and terrifying.
traduit: 这真是既奇妙又恐怖。

original: I don't know what spell you freed us from, outsider, but I thank you.
traduit: 不晓得你替我们解除了什么法术，外来者，但我感谢你。

original: I pray to the All-Maker that whatever this was, it doesn't happen again.
traduit: 我只祈求造物主永远别再让这事儿重演，不管那究竟是什么。

original: My road takes me home, outsider. Hunt well.
traduit: 我要回家了，外来者。愿你打猎丰收。

original: Relief and gratitude
traduit: 总算解脱了。

original: You saved us! But from what? Is it truly over?
traduit: 你救了我们！但是谁干的？真的结束了吗？

original: Forgive my impatience, but I must get back to the village right away.
traduit: 原谅我的不耐烦，但我真得立马回村子里去。

original: I'm with the Guild. How about you look the other way? (<BribeCost> gold)
traduit: 我是公会的。你看能不能睁一只眼闭一只眼？（<BribeCost>金币）

original: Well, I suppose I could forget that I saw you this time.
traduit: 好吧，这次就当我没看到。

original: All right, just keep it quiet. I warn you though, there's still a price on your head. Next guard you run into might not be so... agreeable.
traduit: 好吧，那就别声张。但我警告你，你人头上还是有赏金。下次撞见卫兵可能就没那么……通融了。

original: How about I pay you some gold and you look the other way? (<BribeCost> gold)
traduit: 不如我给你点钱，你就权当没看见？（<BribeCost>金币）

original: I'd rather die than go to prison!
traduit: 我宁可死也不去监狱！

original: Good. I've been itching for a fight.
traduit: 好啊，我一直想打一架。

original: If death is what you seek... I'll be happy to oblige!
traduit: 如果你在求死……乐意效劳！

original: Then in House Redoran's name, you'll get your wish!
traduit: 那么，以瑞多然家的名义，满足你的愿望！

original: Solstheim has no use for your kind!
traduit: 索瑟海姆不需要你这种人！

original: I submit. Take me to jail.
traduit: 我投降。押我去监狱吧。

original: Right then! Off to the Bulwark with you.
traduit: 明智之选！跟我到防护堤监狱走一趟吧。

original: I don't have time for this. Do you?
traduit: 我没时间，你呢？

original: I suppose I can overlook it for now, but you better keep your hands clean or I'll come after you again... you got that?
traduit: 我想现在可以不计较这事儿，但你最好把手放干净点儿，不然还来找你……明白吗？

original: You're lucky the bounty on you is so low, otherwise I'd be hauling you to the Bulwark myself. Get out of my sight.
traduit: 庆幸你的赏金不高吧，不然我就亲自把你拖到防护堤去了。现在别让我看见你。

original: You caught me. I'll pay off my bounty. (<CrimeGold> gold)
traduit: 你抓到我了，我付清罚金。（<CrimeGold>金币）

original: Wise choice. Now come along with us. After we confiscate any stolen goods, you'll be free to go. After you pay the fine, of course.
traduit: 明智的选择，现在跟我们走，没收赃物后你就可以走了。当然，是在你交了罚款后。

original: Good enough. I'll just remove any stolen goods on you, and then you're free to go.
traduit: 好吧，我会带走你身上偷来的赃物，然后你可以走了。

original: Any chance I could talk you into overlooking this? (Persuade)
traduit: 我能不能劝你别管这事儿？（说服）

original: Very well, you're free to go. Next time you might not be so lucky.
traduit: 行吧，你可以走了，下次可就没这么幸运了。

original: What in the name of Azura...?
traduit: 以阿祖拉之名……？

original: In House Redoran's name, I order you to stop!
traduit: 以瑞多然家之名，我命令你停下！

original: You've committed crimes against the Dunmer people of Solstheim. What say you in your defense?
traduit: 你对索瑟海姆的丹莫民众犯下了罪行，还有什么要辩解的？

original: You're making a mistake...
traduit: 你弄错了……

original: The only mistake here belongs to you. You're a wanted man and there's no way I'm letting you walk away.
traduit: 唯一的错误在于你自己。你是个通缉犯，我不会放过你的。

original: The only mistake here belongs to you. You're a wanted woman and there's no way I'm letting you walk away.
traduit: 唯一的错误在于你自己。你是个通缉犯，我不会放过你的。

original: There's no mistake. You've committed crimes against the Dunmer people of Solstheim, and in the name of House Redoran it's time to face justice.
traduit: 我没弄错任何事情。你对索瑟海姆的丹莫民众犯下罪行，是时候以瑞多然家的名义审判你了。

original: One moment... you look familiar.
traduit: 等会儿……你看上去很眼熟……

original: Stop right there... where have I seen you before?
traduit: 站住……我在哪儿见过你来着？

original: Come on, boy, I've got something for you...
traduit: 过来，我有些东西给你……

original: How do you survive out here?
traduit: 你在这外面如何谋生？

original: We get by trading odds and ends with the locals. I've decided to stay here and make sure she passes in peace. It's the least I can do for her.
traduit: 我们跟当地居民们做些小生意。我已经决定了留在这里，确保她能安心离世。这是我唯一能为她做的了。

original: Every once in a while a local makes it out here. Although, they usually just want to catch a glimpse of Dusty. Silt Striders are pretty rare now.
traduit: 居民们偶尔会过来看看。但他们通常是为了看一眼小灰的。泥沙漫步者现在很稀有了。

original: No, what is it?
traduit: 没有，那是什么？

original: This is Dusty. I personally trained her from a larva. Feels like a lifetime ago now.
traduit: 这是小灰。在它还是幼虫时我就开始训练她，感觉有一辈子那么久了。

original: She hasn't been in traveling condition for quite a while now. I've tried to let her go off on her own but she insists on staying here.
traduit: 她的身体状况早就不适合旅行了。我试过把她放生，但她坚持待在这儿。

original: From that look on your face I'm guessing you've never seen a Silt Strider before?
traduit: 从你的表情看来，我猜你以前没见过泥沙漫步者吧？

original: Enough about this.
traduit: 换个话题吧。

original: What were they used for?
traduit: 它们的用途是什么？

original: Mostly for transporting goods and people. They were pretty commonplace in Morrowind, but that was ages ago.
traduit: 通常是运货和载人。以前在晨风很常见，但那是几百年前了。

original: A Silt Strider carapace is so strong it can withstand the harshest of weather.
traduit: 泥沙漫步者的外壳非常坚固，可以抵御最恶劣的天气。

original: Even the legendary sandstorms of Vvardenfell's Molag Amur Region were said to barely make a dent in them. Of course, that's all ash now.
traduit: 就连瓦登费尔的莫拉格·阿穆尔地区的著名沙尘暴，几乎都不能对它们造成伤害。当然，现在那里是一片灰烬了。

original: Why are they so rare?
traduit: 为什它们很稀有？

original: The blast from the volcano wiped most of them out.
traduit: 火山喷发几乎把它们灭种了。

original: Found Dusty here in a small cave on Vvardenfell. Silt Strider cocoons are pretty tough.
traduit: 我在瓦登费尔的一个小洞穴里找到了小灰。泥沙漫步者的茧硬的很。

original: About Silt Striders...
traduit: 关于泥沙漫步者……

original: What would you like to know?
traduit: 你想知道些什么？

original: Where are you taking me?
traduit: 你要带我去哪儿？

original: You. Fol. Low. Me!
traduit: 你。跟。我。走！

original: Who taught you to talk?
traduit: 是谁教你说话的？

original: You. Fol. Low. Me?
traduit: 你。跟。我。走？

original: You. Fol. Low. Me.
traduit: 你。跟。我。走。

original: How long has the farm been abandoned?
traduit: 这座农场被遗弃多久了？

original: Not sure. I was told it's an old Imperial farm that was wiped out by the eruption of the Red Mountain.
traduit: 不清楚。我听说这原来是个帝国农场，在红山喷发后就被毁了。

original: Not certain who lived there... it was already a pile of rubble when I arrived in Raven Rock.
traduit: 不确定原主人是谁……我来鸦石镇的时候这儿就已经是一堆瓦砾了。

original: At last. Sovngarde...
traduit: 结束了。松加德……

original: Kill me already!
traduit: 快杀了我啊！

original: Show me you are the hero they say you are!
traduit: 让我见识下他们口中的英雄！

original: I am the Ebony Warrior!
traduit: 我是黑檀战士！

original: It has? What do you mean?
traduit: 什么？你是什么意思？

original: I have done all that can be done. There is nothing left.
traduit: 能做的事情我都做了。我失去目标了。

original: No quests to be undertaken. No villains to be slain. No challenges to face.
traduit: 没有任务可接。没有恶棍可杀。没有挑战可以面对。

original: Except for you. You are my last challenge. Only you can send me to Sovngarde with honor.
traduit: 除了你，你就是我最后的挑战。只有你才能把我荣耀地送进松加德。

original: Make your preparations. When you are ready, come find me at my last vigil.
traduit: 做好准备吧。好了以后去我的终末守灵处找我。

original: What were you saying before?
traduit: 你之前在说什么？

original: The time has come.
traduit: 是时候了。

original: Can you train me in Enchanting?
traduit: 你能教我附魔吗？

original: Don't be ridiculous. Of course I can.
traduit: 别开玩笑了，小事一桩。

original: The question is, should I? I suppose if it's going to be done right, I'll have to do it.
traduit: 问题是，我该教你吗？我想要让事态变好的话，是得教你。

original: I could, but I won't.
traduit: 我能教，但我不教。

original: It wouldn't do to have you become better than me after all.
traduit: 让你超越我可没什么好处。

original: Runil agreed to your request.
traduit: 鲁尼尔同意了你的请求。

original: You've brought warmth to my heart, outsider, and I'm in your debt.
traduit: 你让我感到暖心，外来者。我欠你一份人情。

original: Please accept this as a token of gratitude. Once again, you've proven yourself an ally to the Skaal.
traduit: 请收下这个聊表我的感激吧。你再次证明了自己是斯卡尔人的盟友。

original: She's not exactly young anymore.
traduit: 她可老大不小了。

original: Ah, well, I suppose she'll always be that fiesty little girl I used to know.
traduit: 啊，好吧，我还总觉得她是我认识的那个暴躁小女孩呢。

original: Of course, when you reach my age, you'll find that the word "young" is a very relative term.
traduit: 当然，等你到了我这个年纪，就知道“小”这个词是相对的。

original: She wants this placed at her mother's grave.
traduit: 她想把这个放到她母亲的墓旁。

original: Ah yes, Bera's silver necklace. It was a wedding gift and she rarely took it off.
traduit: 啊是的，贝拉的银项链。这是她几乎从不取下的结婚礼物。

original: I'll be glad to oblige. What a touching gesture, to display the symbol of her devotion in such a way.
traduit: 我很乐意效劳。多么感人的做法啊，以这种方式展现她的奉献。

original: Tell Morwen I'll be happy to grant her request. I am sure it will bring joy to her mother and father as they walk in Aetherius.
traduit: 告诉莫尔雯，我很乐意代劳。相信她在光界的父母会很高兴的。

original: Morwen of Skaal Village sent me to ask a favor of you.
traduit: 斯卡尔村的莫尔雯让我来请你帮个忙。

original: Morwen, you say? Now there's a name I haven't heard in a long time. Left to join her mother's people on Solstheim, as I recall.
traduit: 你说莫尔雯？很久没听到过这个名字了。没记错的话，她离开这里去加入她母亲在索瑟海姆的族人了。

original: I knew her parents quite well, you know. Bera and Ulfarr were good people, very much in love.
traduit: 我跟她的父母很熟，知道吧。贝拉和乌尔法都是好人，恩爱得很。

original: Now, what can I do for young Morwen?
traduit: 那么，我能为小莫尔雯做什么？

original: I came across a few of my mother's old things not long ago. Among them was a necklace that my father gave to her when they were married.
traduit: 我不久前翻到了一些母亲的遗物。其中有一条父亲在结婚时送给她的项链。

original: I believe she would want it placed upon her tombstone in Falkreath, as a symbol of her undying love and the great sacrifice she made for it.
traduit: 她肯定也想把项链放在她佛克瑞斯的墓碑上，作为她永恒的爱和为此作出的巨大牺牲的象征。

original: If you find yourself in Falkreath, please give this amulet to the priest Runil and tell him that I sent you. He will understand.
traduit: 哪天你要是到了佛克瑞斯，请把这个护符交给鲁尼尔祭司，告诉他是我让你去的。他就懂了。

original: I don't have much to give in reward, but return to me when the task is done and I'll do what I can. Thank you, Skaal-friend.
traduit: 我没什么能报答你的，但是完成任务后请回来找我，我一定尽我所能。谢谢你，斯卡尔之友。

original: Why did your mother leave the village?
traduit: 为什么你母亲要离开村子？

original: A trade ship from Skyrim struck ice off the coast near the village, and the Skaal took in the surviving sailors.
traduit: 一艘天际来的商船在村子附近撞上了冰山，幸存的水手们被斯卡尔人收留了。

original: My mother fell in love with one of the sailors - my father - and eventually returned with him to Skyrim.
traduit: 我的母亲爱上了其中一个水手，也就是我父亲。最终和他一起回天际了。

original: That's the spirit!
traduit: 这才像话！

original: Hit me harder!
traduit: 没吃饭吗！

original: When next we meet, it will be at my last vigil.
traduit: 我们下次见面，会是在我的终末守灵处。

original: You are the one.
traduit: 就是你了。

original: All-Maker help us!
traduit: 造物主救救我们！

original: What in the...?
traduit: 这是怎么……？

original: Kill the dragon, quickly!
traduit: 宰了这条龙，快！

original: Back to where you came from!
traduit: 哪儿来滚回哪儿去！

original: You have left me no choice.
traduit: 你让我没得选了。

original: I was a fool to trust you!
traduit: 我信任你真是瞎了眼！

original: Your master cannot help you now!
traduit: 现在你的主人也帮不了你了！

original: You've no right to be here, monster!
traduit: 滚出去，怪物！

original: Bring the wyrm down!
traduit: 把那条龙弄下来！

original: Bring the man-beast down!
traduit: 把这半人半兽的东西弄下来！

original: Leave us alone, monster!
traduit: 离我们远点儿，怪物！

original: You're a fool to test me, outsider.
traduit: 挑战我是愚蠢的行为，外来者。

original: I have slain more dangerous creatures than you!
traduit: 我杀过比你还危险的东西！

original: You will not break me, outsider.
traduit: 你无法击败我，外来者

original: You'll regret starting this fight.
traduit: 打这一架你会后悔的。

original: Did you think I would run?
traduit: 觉得我会逃跑吗？

original: I don't want to kill you, but I will.
traduit: 我不想杀你，但是我会。

original: If I must die to protect my people, so be it!
traduit: 如果我必须以死保护族人，那就来吧！

original: You anger one, you anger us all!
traduit: 惹怒一个，你可就惹怒了我们所有人！

original: Are you truly ready to die?
traduit: 真的准备好受死了吗？

original: My steel will be your death!
traduit: 你会死在我的武器下！

original: All-Maker, give me strength!
traduit: 造物主，赐我力量！

original: Prepare to leave this world!
traduit: 准备好滚去阴间！

original: You leave me no choice!
traduit: 是你让我没得选！

original: I will not fall!
traduit: 我输不了！

original: Today, you return the All-Maker!
traduit: 今天，你就要回归造物主了！

original: I do not fear death!
traduit: 我可不怕死！

original: Remember that you chose this path.
traduit: 记住是你选的这条路。

original: If death is what you want, you'll have it!
traduit: 想死我就成全你！

original: I will not go quietly!
traduit: 我可不会轻易倒下！

original: This was a foolish mistake, outsider.
traduit: 这是个愚蠢的错误，外来者。

original: I am not so old that I cannot fight!
traduit: 我还没老到打不了！

original: I grieve that you must meet your end this way, but necessity demands it.
traduit: 很遗憾你命中的结局如此，但这是必要的。

original: This realm is beyond you. You have no power here.
traduit: 这个位面凌驾于你，你在这里孱弱不堪。

original: House Hlaalu will... have its revenge...
traduit: 哈拉鲁家会……复仇的……

original: No, it's not my time...
traduit: 不，我命不该绝……

original: I won't allow you to ruin years of planning!
traduit: 我不会让你毁了多年来的准备！

original: For House Hlaalu! For Vilur Ulen!
traduit: 为了哈拉鲁家！为了维鲁尔·乌伦！

original: Careful Mirri... someone's in here with us!
traduit: 小心了，米莉……这儿还有人呢！

original: Come on, I know you're in here.
traduit: 出来啊，我知道你在这里。

original: Watch it Tilisu, I think we might have a visitor!
traduit: 小心点蒂莉苏，看来我们有客人了！

original: Stop hiding, coward. I'll make it quick, I promise.
traduit: 别藏了，懦夫。会让你死个痛快的，我保证。

original: But you told me House Hlaalu was disliked.
traduit: 但你告诉我哈拉鲁家族不受欢迎。

original: The Ulen family being a part of House Hlaalu didn't matter.
traduit: 乌伦家是不是哈拉鲁家的并不重要。

original: It's Dunmer tradition for the ashes of the deceased to be placed in an ancestral tomb.
traduit: 丹莫的传统就是让逝者的骨灰安放于祖坟中。

original: Valin Ulen and his son's remains were both laid to rest there because that's what he'd requested.
traduit: 瓦林·乌伦请求把他和儿子的骨灰合葬在这儿。

original: Why do the Ulens have a tomb in Raven Rock?
traduit: 为什么乌伦家在鸦石镇有个祖坟？

original: Vilur Ulen wasn't the first Ulen to live in Raven Rock. His father, Valin Ulen, was one of the first Dunmer to settle here.
traduit: 维鲁尔·乌伦不是乌伦家在鸦石镇的第一代。他的父亲，瓦林·乌伦是第一批在这里安家的丹莫。

original: Unlike his son Vilur, Valin was a good man. He contributed to the community and was quite respected.
traduit: 但是瓦林和他儿子不一样，他是个好人，为社区做了贡献，很受人尊敬。

original: When Valin died, his family provided the funds to construct the tomb.
traduit: 瓦林死后，他家里出钱修了这个祖坟。

original: How did the Dunmer survive this at all?
traduit: 丹莫是如何存活下来的？

original: House Redoran took charge and was slowly able to build an army. It took years, but it became a force to be reckoned with.
traduit: 瑞多然家接管了局面，慢慢组建起一支军队。花费了数年时间，使之成为了一股不容忽视的力量。

original: When the Argonians invaded years later, House Redoran's army was able to prevent them from sweeping across all of Morrowind.
traduit: 当数年后阿尔贡入侵，正是瑞多然家的军队阻止了他们横扫整个晨风。

original: It would be fair to say that House Redoran literally saved the Dunmer people from destruction.
traduit: 可以说，瑞多然家确实拯救了丹莫，免于灭族。

original: Why do the Dunmer hate the Empire?
traduit: 丹莫为什么反感帝国？

original: During the Oblivion Crisis, gates to the plane of Oblivion opened all over Morrowind.
traduit: 在湮灭危机期间，晨风遍地都开启了湮灭之门。

original: The Empire pulled most of its forces out of Morrowind to deal with the gates in their own homeland, leaving us virtually defenseless.
traduit: 帝国撤回了绝大部分的晨风驻军，去应对自己国土上的湮灭之门，几乎让我们毫无防御能力。

original: We had no standing army at the time, just uncoordinated pockets of resistance.
traduit: 当时我们没有正规军，只有缺少协调的小股抵抗军。

original: Yes, thuri.
traduit: 是，图瑞。

original: Bo pruzaan. Better to fly.
traduit: 波 普鲁赞。马上起飞。

original: I don't need some bucket of scrap metal following me around...
traduit: 我不需要一团废铁跟着我……

original: (hiss...)
You should follow me.
traduit: 你应该跟我走。

original: (hiss!)
You seem friendly.
traduit: 你看起来很友善。

original: Crescius lost your Ancient Nordic Pickaxe.
traduit: 克雷修斯弄丢了你的古诺德鹤嘴锄。

original: Blast! That careless old fool.
traduit: 混蛋！那个老冒失鬼。

original: Well, thanks for trying anyway. Here you go... for your trouble.
traduit: 好吧，至少感谢你试过了。拿着吧……你的跑路费。

original: You tell Crescius he better give that pickaxe back to me, or else.
traduit: 你跟克雷修斯说，他最好把那鹤嘴锄还给我，否则要他好看。

original: Find my pickaxe yet?
traduit: 你找到我的鹤嘴锄了吗？

original: Gone now, I suppose.
traduit: 跑了吧，我猜。

original: Ah well.
traduit: 啊好吧。

original: It is a shame that was necessary.
traduit: 很遗憾，这是必要的。

original: I thank you for your protection, All-Maker.
traduit: 感谢你保护我，造物主。

original: I am sorry, but you left me with no choice.
traduit: 抱歉，但你让我没得选。

original: That's the end of that.
traduit: 到此为止了。

original: The wind plays a trick on my ears, surely.
traduit: 一定是风让我幻听了。

original: I thought I saw... no, surely not.
traduit: 我以为看到了……不，不可能。

original: You skulk and sneak like a riekling.
traduit: 你就像瑞克灵那样到处躲藏。

original: Come out and face justice, coward.
traduit: 出来接受制裁吧，懦夫。

original: The All-Maker sees you, even if I cannot.
traduit: 造物主看得见你，就算我不能。

original: A coward hides. A true warrior does not.
traduit: 懦夫才会躲起来，而真正的战士不会。

original: By the All-Maker, no! It cannot be!
traduit: 造物主啊，不要！不可能！

original: Why!? Why?!
traduit: 为什么？！为什么？！

original: You must go, outsider.
traduit: 你得走了，外来者。

original: I'm sorry, but you must leave now.
traduit: 很抱歉，但你现在就得离开。

original: It is time for you to go, outsider.
traduit: 你是时候离开了，外来者。

original: You cannot stay here any longer.
traduit: 你现在就得走了。

original: You... murderer!
traduit: 你这个……凶手！

original: By the All-Maker, why?
traduit: 造物主啊，为什么？

original: All-Maker preserve us!
traduit: 造物主救救我们！

original: What... what are you doing?!
traduit: 什么……你在干什么啊？！

original: Oh no! No!
traduit: 哦不！不要！

original: Why do you steal from us?
traduit: 你为什么要偷我们的东西？

original: Honorless thief!
traduit: 可耻的小偷！

original: What gives you the right to do that?
traduit: 你有什么权利这么做？

original: So that is how you treat others?
traduit: 你就是这样对待别人的？

original: All-Maker, I am prepared to return...
traduit: 造物主，我准备好回来了……

original: All-Maker... please...
traduit: 造物主……求求你……

original: I come home to you, All-Maker...
traduit: 我要回家了，造物主……

original: Soon I will be one... with nature...
traduit: 马上我就要……与自然合一了……

original: Unnnhhhh.... it hurts...
traduit: 呃啊……好痛……

original: Not... finished yet...
traduit: 还……没完……

original: Unnnhh...
You would steal from those who have so little?
traduit: 你连这么穷的也要偷？

original: You're no better than those thieving reavers.
traduit: 你比那些抢匪好不了哪去。

original: Another soul returns to the All-Maker.
traduit: 又一个回归造物主的灵魂。

original: Life should never be taken without reason.
traduit: 永远不能滥杀无辜。

original: Your heart is as cold as winter.
traduit: 你的心和冬天一样冷。

original: Violence is not our way, outsider.
traduit: 暴力不是我们的方式，外来者。

original: The All-Maker frowns upon such violence.
traduit: 造物主不赞成使用这种暴力。

original: Your actions show a lack of respect.
traduit: 你的行为不尊重我们。

original: The All-Maker frowns upon such needless violence.
traduit: 造物主反对这种无谓的暴力。

original: Why would you do such a thing?
traduit: 你为什么那么做？

original: I doubt that was truly necessary.
traduit: 我觉得没必要这么做。

original: Why not return to Morrowind?
traduit: 为什么不回晨风去呢？

original: Oh, believe me... I'd be on the first ship off of this miserable island if I could.
traduit: 哦，相信我，要是可以离开这可悲的岛那我立马就上船了。

original: But I'm not sure I could do that to my father. I think it would break his heart.
traduit: 但我不能那样对我父亲，他会伤心的。

original: We've already lost my mother, I don't want to leave him alone.
traduit: 我已经失去了母亲，不想让他一个人孤零零的。

original: You don't like it on Solstheim?
traduit: 你不喜欢索瑟海姆？

original: Don't like it? I hate it!
traduit: 不喜欢？我是恨透了！

original: Every day it's the same thing. We open the shop, we hardly sell a thing, we close the shop and go to sleep.
traduit: 这儿每天都一成不变，开店、一分不挣、关店、睡觉。

original: What kind of a life is that?
traduit: 这到底算哪门子生活？

original: You need something?
traduit: 有什么事吗？

original: I don't recognize you, so I'll assume this is your first visit to Raven Rock, outlander. State your intentions.
traduit: 未曾谋面，你是第一次来鸦石镇吧，外地人。说明你的来意。

original: All right, Adril. Don't worry about rushing it. Just pay me when you can.
traduit: 好吧，阿德尔。别担心慢慢来。钱够了再付不迟。

original: After all these years, they're gouging us for every last drake we have.
traduit: 这些年来，他们一直在骗我们的钱。

original: Let me talk to Lleril. I'll see what we can do.
traduit: 我去跟雷里尔说，看看怎么处理。

original: Look, the East Empire Company didn't give me a choice. They've raised their prices again, and there's nothing I can do about it.
traduit: 听着，是东帝国公司逼我的。他们又涨价了，我实在是没办法。

original: Damn it, Gjalund. You know we don't have that much coin.
traduit: 混账，加朗德。你知道我们没那么多钱。

original: This load cost me double what we had agreed on. Nothing I can do about it.
traduit: 这批货比我们讲好的价钱要贵一倍。我也没办法。

original: But what?
traduit: 但是怎么了？

original: Before you even ask... yes, I have the supplies you requested.
traduit: 不用问了……你要的物资我都带来了。

original: But...
traduit: 但是……

original: We, uh... we were delayed by bad weather.
traduit: 我们，呃……被坏天气给耽搁了。

original: Well met, Adril.
traduit: 你好啊，阿德尔。

original: Gjalund. I was starting to wonder what happened to you.
traduit: 加朗德。我都怀疑你是不是出事了呢。

original: Hail, Gjalund.
traduit: 你好啊，加朗德。

original: This is Apocrypha, where all knowledge is hoarded.
traduit: 这里是异典，一切知识的贮藏之地。

original: I am Hermaeus Mora, Prince of Fate and Lord of Secrets. This is Apocrypha, where all knowledge is hoarded.
traduit: 我乃赫麦尤斯·莫拉，命运与隐秘之主。这里是异典，一切知识的贮藏之地。

original: If you tire of the search, read your book again to return to your mortal life. For a time. The lure of Apocrypha will call you back. It is your fate.
traduit: 如果你疲于搜寻，就把书再读一遍，回到凡俗生活。过段时间后，异典的诱惑力会将你召回，这就是你的命运。

original: Perhaps you are a fool or a coward. If so, you are in peril. Read your book again and escape before Apocrypha claims you forever.
traduit: 也许你是个傻子或者懦夫，那你就有危险了。把书重新读一遍，在异典彻底控制你前逃出去吧。

original: Sate your thirst for knowledge in the endless stacks of my library.
traduit: 在我永无穷尽的书库里满足对知识的渴望吧。

original: Perhaps you will prove clever enough to uncover the secrets hidden here. If so, welcome.
traduit: 也许你够聪明，可以揭开这里隐藏的秘密。如果是这样，我欢迎你。

original: As I told you when I gave you the Oghma Infinium, your free will is an illusion. Why else would you be here?
traduit: 赐予你无限智典时我就说过，你的自由意志不过是虚妄，要不然为什么你会在这里？

original: I know you, champion. The Oghma Infinium was only the beginning.
traduit: 我认识你，勇士，无限智典不过是起点罢了。

original: So, another seeker after knowledge enters my realm.
traduit: 所以，又一个知识追求者来到我的领域。

original: There's probably an exit through one of these sarcophagi. Let's get moving.
traduit: 可能某个这些石棺能通往出口，继续走吧。

original: It looks like a secret entrance opened up along the wall. You lead the way.
traduit: 看来是条沿墙壁的秘密入口。你带路吧。

original: I can see that in my eagerness for adventure, I have forgotten my duties as a son and as a Skaal.
traduit: 我明白了，对冒险的渴望让我忘记了作为一个儿子和斯卡尔人的责任。

original: You have helped me to see wisdom, and I thank you for that, Skaal-friend.
traduit: 你让我有了新的领悟，谢谢你，斯卡尔之友。

original: Take this. Just give your mother some more time. (<bribecost> gold)
traduit: 拿去吧。就再多给你母亲一些时间。（<bribecost>金币）

original: Yes, you're right. She still mourns for my father, and having me near brings her comfort.
traduit: 嗯，你说得对。她还在哀悼我爸，我在身边能安慰她。

original: You have my oath that I will not leave the village until my mother is ready to let me go.
traduit: 我答应你，在我妈没准备好放我走前不会离开村子。

original: I am grateful for your offer, outsider, but I am Skaal. All that I need, I was born with.
traduit: 感谢你的给予，外来者。但我是个斯卡尔人，天生就有需要的一切。

original: I do understand. In fact, I'm willing to help you get started.
traduit: 我明白了。实际上，我正要帮你。

original: You are?
traduit: 你愿意？

original: I admit, I was not expecting to hear that.
traduit: 我得承认，没料到你会这么说。

original: The world is dangerous, and you're not ready for it. (Intimidate)
traduit: 世界很危险，而你还没准备好。（恐吓）

original: Well, I know there is some danger, of course, but I didn't think it would be that bad.
traduit: 嗯，我明白会有危险，这是当然的，但没想到会那么糟。

original: If the risk is truly so great, I will train with Wulf Wild-Blood and hone my skills. Perhaps in three or four winters, I will truly be ready.
traduit: 要是真的那么危险，我会跟着“野血”沃弗磨练我的技巧。也许再过三四个冬季我就真的准备好了。

original: There is no fear in my heart. My father's blood flows in my veins, and he was a mighty warrior. I will face any danger.
traduit: 我心里没有恐惧。父亲的血在我体内流淌，他可是个强大的战士。我会直面任何危险。

original: You'd abandon your mother when she needs you most? (Persuade)
traduit: 你要在你母亲最需要你的时候抛弃她吗？（说服）

original: There is truth in your words. She has not been herself since my father's death.
traduit: 你说的有道理。父亲过世后她就变了。

original: I know that it would be difficult for her, at least for a time, but I am a man now. I have the right to choose what life I will.
traduit: 我知道这对她而言会很困难，至少暂时如此，但我已经成年了。我有权决定自己的生活。

original: Your mother tells me that you want to leave the village.
traduit: 你母亲告诉我你想离开村子。

original: That's right. I want to go out into the world and earn great glory. I want to hunt the deadliest creatures and claim vast riches.
traduit: 没错。我想去外面的世界赢得荣耀，去猎杀最危险的猎物，夺取巨大的财富。

original: I am weary of living in this village. I want to do something with my life other than farm, fish and hunt deer.
traduit: 我厌倦了住在这个村子里。这辈子除了干农活，打鱼和捕鹿我还想干点别的。

original: I know it must be hard for an adventurer such as you to understand this, but we Skaal live very boring lives.
traduit: 我知道你这个冒险家很难理解这点，但我们斯卡尔人的生活很无趣。

original: I could talk to him.
traduit: 我会跟他谈谈。

original: You would do that? I know he would listen to you. You've been out there in the wide world. You know its perils.
traduit: 你会吗？我知道他会听你的话。你见过世面，知道有多凶险。

original: Yes, perhaps you can convince him. I would be grateful if you would do this thing, outsider.
traduit: 对，也许你能说服他。我会很感激的，外来者。

original: Who's your son?
traduit: 你儿子是谁？

original: His name is Nikulas. He's a good lad, strong and loyal. I only wish he wasn't so eager to leave the village.
traduit: 他叫尼库拉斯，是个好小伙子，强壮而实诚。我只希望他别那么急着离开村子。

original: I've tried to tell him that the world beyond our lands is dangerous and cruel, but he won't listen.
traduit: 我已经告诉他这方水土之外的世界是危险而残酷的，但他听不进去。

original: Hagajawala!
traduit: 哈加哇啦！

original: Booneetay! Koowah!
traduit: 布尼泰！库哇！

original: Hooojarakwafala!
traduit: 胡贾啦哇法啦！

original: Uuruuu...
traduit: 呜噜噜…

original: Wuuuu...
traduit: 呜…
嘛…

original: Huu... kuuu...
traduit: 呼…枯…

original: Nyuuu... waaa...
traduit: 尼…哇…

original: Fuuughuuuu...
traduit: 弗呜乎…

original: Waaaaaaaah!
traduit: 哇啊啊！

original: Huuuuwaaaa!
traduit: 呼呜哇啊！

original: Kuuuuuuuuuwaaaaa!
traduit: 枯呜哇啊！

original: Gaaah!
traduit: 嘎啊！

original: Kuuh!
traduit: 枯呜！

original: Daaah!
traduit: 哒啊！

original: Hoooh!
traduit: 呼！

original: Guh!
traduit: 咕！

original: Waaah!
traduit: 哇！

original: Pugh!
traduit: 噗！

original: Huf!
traduit: 呼！

original: Guuh!
traduit: 咕呜！

original: Buuh!
traduit: 布呜！

original: Huuuuwargh!
traduit: 呼呜哇！

original: Buruuuwah!
traduit: 布呜哇！

original: Fffffarrrrgah!
traduit: 弗法啊嘎！

original: Jyyyyyyyoooooor!
traduit: 唧咿哟！

original: Hufwah!
traduit: 呼哇！

original: Bagaru!
traduit: 叭嘎噜！

original: Wooocha!
traduit: 呜碴！

original: Falaraga!
traduit: 法啦嘎！

original: You will pay for your crimes against the Skaal. Prepare to die!
traduit: 你们要为对斯卡尔人犯下的罪行付出代价，准备受死吧！

original: Thalmor, to arms! Kill the intruder!
traduit: 梭默，准备战斗！杀死入侵者！

original: I have business to discuss with your leader.
traduit: 我有事要和你们的领导谈谈。

original: You will find him on the deck. Any hint of treachery, and your life is forfeit.
traduit: 他就在甲板上。要是让我发现你耍花招，你的命就没了。

original: Why would the Thalmor abduct you?
traduit: 为什么梭默要绑架你？

original: I do not know this word Thalmor, but if you mean the elves, they were trying to learn the secrets of forging Stalhrim.
traduit: 我没听说过梭默，但如果你说的是那些精灵，他们是为了得到铸造魔冰的秘密。

original: Their leader, an elf named Ancarion, has a map. He says that it shows the location of a hidden source of Stalhrim.
traduit: 他们的领导是一个叫安卡利昂的精灵。他手中有张地图，说上面记载着一处魔冰的隐藏矿源。

original: I hope that you can make my son see wisdom.
traduit: 希望你能让我儿子想清楚。

original: My son and I gather items to trade with travelers who visit the village.
traduit: 我跟我儿子采集东西来和村里的访客做交易。

original: If Nikulas leaves me now, I will be truly alone.
traduit: 如果尼库拉斯现在离开我，那我就真的独自一人了。

original: I hope that Nikulas will hear your words. He no longer seems to hear mine.
traduit: 希望尼库拉斯会听你的话，他好像已经不听我说的了。

original: If Nikulas leaves, I fear he will never return.
traduit: 要是尼库拉斯走了，恐怕他就回不来了。

original: You must leave this place!
traduit: 你们必须离开这里！

original: It is not safe here! We must go back to the village!
traduit: 这里不安全！我们得回村里！

original: Ysra, can you hear me?
traduit: 伊斯拉，能听到吗？

original: Ysra, I'm here to help you!
traduit: 伊斯拉，我来救你了！

original: You must listen to me!
traduit: 你们得听我说！

original: We must leave this place!
traduit: 我们要离开这里！

original: Oslaf, please!
traduit: 奥斯拉夫，听我说！

original: You must fight against what is controlling you!
traduit: 你们必须抵抗控制你们的东西！

original: Let me guess, you need me to do something dangerous.
traduit: 让我猜下，你要我去做些危险的事情。

original: Quite right! Quite right! This, however, is paying work. Allow me to explain.
traduit: 没错，没错！这个，无论如何，我都会付钱的。请听我解释。

original: I helped a man in need, that's all.
traduit: 举手之劳，没什么。

original: Modest as well as brave. Most admirable! I can see why the Skaal think highly of you.
traduit: 谦逊而勇敢。太令人敬佩了！我明白为什么斯卡尔人对你评价很高了。

original: Yes, I think you're just the adventurous sort I need. I have a job offer for you.
traduit: 嗯，我认为你就是我需要的冒险家，有份工作给你。

original: This place is all I'd hoped, and much more.
traduit: 这个地方和我想的一样，可能还更好。

original: History truly comes alive here, don't you think?
traduit: 历史在这里变得鲜活了起来，不觉得吗？

original: You can leave if you like. I think I'll be safe now.
traduit: 你想走可以走了。我觉得这里安全了。

original: Now that was a proper adventure!
traduit: 这真是一场真正意义上的冒险！

original: I admit, it was quite a thrill to watch you vanquish that Dragon Priest.
traduit: 我承认，看你击败那个龙祭司很刺激。

original: You've quite a keen mind to go with those steel nerves.
traduit: 你头脑敏锐，勇气十足。

original: I'll return to my studies.
traduit: 我要回去研究了。

original: Very well then, back to work.
traduit: 好吧，我要继续工作了。

original: Right then.
traduit: 那好吧。

original: Do you think this place has any connection with the Skaal?
traduit: 你觉得这地方和斯卡尔有关系吗？

original: I've been thinking about that, and I believe it does.
traduit: 我也思考过，感觉是有的。

original: I believe it was the ancient ancestors of the Skaal who built this tomb for their master, the Dragon Priest they called the guardian.
traduit: 我认为，这座陵墓就是出自斯卡尔先民之手，用来安葬他们的主人，也就是他们口中的“守护者”龙祭司。

original: In all likelihood, these people were ancient Nords who came with the Dragon Priest to live here on Solstheim.
traduit: 这些人很可能是跟随龙祭司来索瑟海姆定居的古诺德人。

original: Separated from their people on the mainland, they developed a distinct culture that became the Skaal we know today.
traduit: 他们与内陆的族人分离后，逐渐发展起了独特的文化，最终演变成我们今天所知的斯卡尔。

original: Of course this is all just theory and conjecture. It is likely we will never know the truth.
traduit: 当然，这些都只是理论和猜想。真相可能永不为我们所知了。

original: Why all the traps and puzzles?
traduit: 为什么这里全是陷阱和谜题？

original: A good question. Partly to keep unwanted intruders away, I suppose.
traduit: 问得好。部分原因是为了赶走不速之客吧，我猜。

original: They might also have been meant as tests, to ensure that only the truly worthy can reach the main burial chamber.
traduit: 或许也是某种试炼，为确保能进主墓室的人都不是等闲之辈。

original: Who can say, really? The motives of the Dragon Priests are as inscrutable as those of the Dragons they worshipped.
traduit: 但谁敢肯定呢？龙祭司们的意图和他们崇拜的龙一样难以理解。

original: What have you learned about this place?
traduit: 你对这个地方了解多少？

original: This is clearly a tomb, if a rather elaborate one. I would guess it was built for a Dragon Priest who achieved great fame in his time.
traduit: 这显然是座墓穴，而且还相当宏伟。我猜是为一位享誉盛名的龙祭司而建的。

original: It seems he was held in high regard by both men and dragons, because he defeated a traitor named Miraak.
traduit: 看来人和龙都很尊敬他，因为他击败了一个叫米拉克的叛徒。

original: Perhaps Miraak was also a Dragon Priest, probably a contemporary of this guardian. He must have turned against his own order.
traduit: 也许米拉克也曾是位龙祭司，和这个守护者是同一时代的人。他肯定是背叛了自己的教义。

original: After his defeat, Miraak was banished to Solstheim and the guardian was made his jailer.
traduit: 在被击败后，米拉克被放逐到索瑟海姆，而这位守护者成了他的狱卒。

original: There are so many delightful ways I've pictured you dead.
traduit: 我想象过你死后的场景有多美好。

original: We're one of the same kind, you and I. I'm glad to have met you.
traduit: 我们是同类人啊，咱们俩。很高兴能认识你。

original: Azura's wisdom to you, friend.
traduit: 阿祖拉的智慧与你同在，朋友。

original: Filth. Run to the horizon before I hunt you down.
traduit: 脏东西，在我发作之前给我消失。

original: I'm not going to warn you again.
traduit: 我不会再警告你了。

original: Stop that.
traduit: 停下吧。

original: Hey, be careful!
traduit: 嘿，小心！

original: I'm on your side!
traduit: 我是你一头的啊！

original: You...must...die.
traduit: 你……必须……死。

original: Must...kill.
traduit: 必须……死。

original: Kill.
traduit: 杀。

original: Free...again.
traduit: 又……自由了。

original: At last.
traduit: 终于。

original: Sheogorath take fools like you, put that down.
traduit: 谢尔格拉专门收你这种傻子，把那放下。

original: If you value your hands, keep them off that.
traduit: 还想要手的话，就把那玩意儿放下。

original: That's not for you.
traduit: 那不是给你的。

original: Yes, sera?
traduit: 怎么了，塞拉？

original: Sera?
traduit: 塞拉？

original: There's something you need?
traduit: 有什么需要么？

original: Azura light your steps.
traduit: 愿阿祖拉照亮你的前路。

original: Mephala cloak you.
traduit: 愿梅法拉遮蔽你。

original: Now if you'll excuse me...
traduit: 恕我失陪了……

original: Boethiah guide your blade.
traduit: 愿波耶西亚指引你的刀刃。

original: That's certainly one way to get attention.
traduit: 你确实会博人眼球。

original: Azura preserve us.
traduit: 阿祖拉保佑我们。

original: Mephala hide me.
traduit: 梅法拉遮蔽我。

original: Death does not diminish.
traduit: 死亡不可避免。

original: By Azura. A fight!
traduit: 阿祖拉在上，开打了！

original: By the blood of Boethiah.
traduit: 以波耶西亚之血之名。

original: This should be interesting.
traduit: 这会很有意思的。

original: Boethiah devour you. Get out of here!
traduit: 波耶西亚吞噬你，滚出去！

original: I knew I'd find you!
traduit: 我就知道能找到你！

original: Can't hide from me.
traduit: 你躲不开我。

original: Ran away, I guess.
traduit: 我猜跑了吧。

original: No sign of 'em.
traduit: 没有踪迹啊。

original: I'll find you...
traduit: 我会找到你的……

original: Done.
traduit: 搞定了。

original: Good enough.
traduit: 够了。

original: Must be hearing things.
traduit: 一定是幻听了。

original: Hmm. Nothing here after all.
traduit: 嗯。什么都没有。

original: Must be my imagination.
traduit: 肯定是我的幻觉。

original: Must have been nothing.
traduit: 什么都没有。

original: Hmph. Nothing there.
traduit: 哼，啥都没有。

original: Mind's playing tricks on me...
traduit: 可能是心理作用吧……

original: Get him!
traduit: 拿下他！

original: I know you can hear me!
traduit: 我知道你听得到！

original: Anybody there?
traduit: 有人吗？

original: I know I heard something.
traduit: 我肯定听见什么了。

original: Agh! Flithy n'wah!
traduit: 啊！肮脏的恩'瓦！

original: Not good enough.
traduit: 还不够看。

original: You'll have to do better than that!
traduit: 你还未够班。

original: By Dagon's eyes, you'll pay for that!
traduit: 大衮的眼珠子啊，你要付出代价！

original: Give it your best!
traduit: 使劲儿啊！

original: That's it? Ha!
traduit: 就这？哈？

original: Lucky... hit...
traduit: 打得……好……

original: Didn't even hurt!
traduit: 不痛不痒！

original: Sheogorath's madness take you!
traduit: 谢尔格拉的疯狂要弄死你！

original: Nyyarrggh!
traduit: 嗯呀啊啊！

original: Filthy fetcher!
traduit: 肮脏的费彻！

original: Die, N'wah!
traduit: 死吧，恩'瓦！

original: Molag Bal curse you!
traduit: 莫拉格·巴尔诅咒你！

original: I'll... gut you!
traduit: 我要…宰了你！

original: Just... die!
traduit: 去……死吧！

original: Time... to end this!
traduit: 是该……做个了断！

original: Weren't expecting this, were you?
traduit: 没猜到这招儿，对吧？

original: You're bleeding!
traduit: 放你的血！

original: Not impressed!
traduit: 没什么大不了的！

original: You're nothing!
traduit: 你算什么东西！

original: Give up! You've already lost.
traduit: 投降吧！你都输了。

original: Agghh!
traduit: 啊啊！

original: Aaaiiee!
traduit: 啊！

original: You should have listened. Guards! Help! Trespasser!
traduit: 你应该听我的才对。卫兵！帮忙！有非法入侵者！

original: Guards! Trespasser!
traduit: 卫兵！有人非法入侵！

original: I'm not going to warn you again. Get out, or I'll call the guards!
traduit: 我不会再警告你了。赶紧出去，不然我喊卫兵了！

original: Last warning. Leave, now.
traduit: 最后一次。离开，立刻。

original: This is the last time I'll say it. Get out.
traduit: 这是我最后一次提醒。出去。

original: It's time for you to leave, my friend.
traduit: 你该离开了，朋友。

original: You, of all people. Get out!
traduit: 你，就是你。出去！

original: That's close enough.
traduit: 太近了。

original: I'm warning you. Back off!
traduit: 我警告你。后退！

original: Mephala shield us.
traduit: 梅法拉快保护我们。

original: By Azura, no!
traduit: 阿祖拉在上，不要！

original: Murder!
traduit: 杀人啦！

original: To arms!
traduit: 抄家伙！

original: To our brethren's aid!
traduit: 快来救人！

original: You're dead.
traduit: 你死定了。

original: I'll have your hands for that!
traduit: 看我剁了你的手！

original: Not from me you don't!
traduit: 偷到我头上来了！

original: I should cut off your hands for that!
traduit: 看我剁了你的手！

original: Dirty filching N'wah...
traduit: 肮脏的小偷恩'瓦……

original: Malacath take you!
traduit: 玛拉凯斯要搞死你！

original: I... will... persevere...
traduit: 我…还…没死…

original: You better... kill me... while you have the chance.
traduit: 你最好…宰了我…在你还有机会的时候…

original: I'll let you stay. This time.
traduit: 你就留下吧。但就这一次。

original: You can stay, but you're not supposed to be here.
traduit: 你可以留下，但确实不该在这里。

original: You can't hide from me!
traduit: 你躲不掉的！

original: Be careful!
traduit: 小心！

original: What are you doing that for?
traduit: 你这是干什么？

original: You could have just asked.
traduit: 你可以直接说的。

original: I saw you do that, you know.
traduit: 我看见你干什么了。

original: Ha! Found you!
traduit: 好！抓到你了！

original: You're not supposed to be in here.
traduit: 你不该在这里的。

original: You'll give that back if you know what's good for you.
traduit: 识相点就把那东西还回来。

original: Thief!
traduit: 小偷儿！

original: What? Nooo!
traduit: 什么？不——！

original: Assassin!
traduit: 有刺客！

original: Gods help us!
traduit: 老天保佑！

original: Let the ghosts consider their new brethren.
traduit: 就让鬼魂们见见新朋友。

original: Well, worry not over what can't be undone.
traduit: 别再担心无可挽回的事了。

original: I can see Boethiah smiles in your heart.
traduit: 波耶西亚正朝你微笑。

original: Comfort is given, justice is taken
traduit: 安慰是给出去的，正义是抢来的。

original: Not my concern, no sera.
traduit: 不关我的事儿，塞拉。

original: Better to suffer a wrong than to do one.
traduit: 受冤屈总比作恶强。

original: Grrh!
traduit: 呃！

original: Nnh!
traduit: 嗯！

original: Mephala shields me.
traduit: 梅法拉快保护我。

original: Close...
traduit: 还差点……

original: You'll need to be luckier than that!
traduit: 你没那么走运！

original: N'wah!
traduit: 恩'瓦！

original: I'll kill you another day.
traduit: 改天再宰了你。

original: Nerevar guide me!
traduit: 尼瑞瓦指引我！

original: Boethiah inspire me!
traduit: 波耶西亚助我！

original: Azura curse you!
traduit: 阿祖拉诅咒你！

original: You're going to pay for this.
traduit: 你要付出代价！

original: Come on. Let's see what you've got.
traduit: 来啊，让我看看你有啥本事。

original: I'm going to put you down.
traduit: 马上干掉你。

original: I'll send your soul as a gift to Boethiah.
traduit: 我会把你的灵魂献给波耶西亚。

original: Sheogorath's beard, you're an ugly one.
traduit: 谢尔格拉的胡子啊，你真他妈丑。

original: Azura help us!
traduit: 阿祖拉救救我们！

original: I...I think I'm going to pretend that never happened.
traduit: 我……我就当没发生过吧。

original: Is it over yet? Does he have eyes again?
traduit: 结束了吗？他的眼睛回来了吗？

original: Is it over yet? Does she have eyes again?
traduit: 结束了吗？她的眼睛回来了吗？

original: It looks like it's beginning to wear off.
traduit: 看来效果在消退了。

original: I think I'm going to be sick.
traduit: 我觉得我要吐了。

original: Hmm. From the way they are waving about, I'm assuming they aren't under your control.
traduit: 嗯，看眨动的样子，我猜它们不受你控制了。

original: And I see now that your tongue is also...well, it's probably best if I don't say. Don't bother trying to scream though.
traduit: 而且你的舌头也……嗯，我还是不说好了。别试着喊了。

original: You have no idea of the true power a Dragonborn can wield!
traduit: 你对龙裔真正的力量一无所知！

original: He can await my arrival with the rest of Tamriel.
traduit: 他可以和全泰姆瑞尔一起等待我的回归。

original: She can await my arrival with the rest of Tamriel.
traduit: 她可以和全泰姆瑞尔一起等待我的回归。

original: So you have slain Alduin... Well done. I could have slain him myself, back when I walked the earth, but I chose a different path.
traduit: 看来你宰了奥杜因……干得好。我还在现世的时候，本来可以亲手宰了它的，但我选了另一条路。

original: You have done little beyond killing a few dragons.
traduit: 你也就是宰了几条龙罢了。

original: You have defeated dragons, yes, but still...
traduit: 你打败过一些龙，没错，但是……

original: You have slain a great many dragons, I see. And yet...
traduit: 你已经屠了相当数目的龙了，我看得出来。但是……

original: Ahh... You are Dragonborn. I can feel it. And yet...
traduit: 啊……你是龙裔。我感觉得到。但是……

original: My husband is second councilor, so I certainly have the means to reward you if you find my folio.
traduit: 我丈夫是副议员，所以如果你找到我的对开本，我一定不吝奖励你。

original: You look able enough to venture outside of town. Perhaps you could help me recover something precious that was lost?
traduit: 你看上去有实力去野外冒险。也许能帮我找回一样珍贵的东西？

original: It might take more than a simple request to change Geldis's mind. He can be quite stubborn.
traduit: 让吉迪斯改变主意可没那么简单。他这人很顽固。

original: Bralsa's may be welcome here again, but I still expect her to pay her way like everyone else.
traduit: 这里会重新对布拉尔萨开放，但我希望她像别人一样付钱。

original: The East Empire Pendants are scattered all over, so leave no stone unturned.
traduit: 东帝国公司吊坠到处都有，所以不遗余力的去找吧。

original: Careful with those netches... they may look tame, but they can seriously hurt you when threatened.
traduit: 小心那些气母……它们看起来很温顺，但在感到威胁时会让人受重伤。

original: Find me that stash of wine... I'm itching to be rid of it.
traduit: 去帮我找到那些酒……我等不及把它们处理掉了。

original: Just get them to taste my sujamma... once they take a sip, it'll sell itself.
traduit: 让他们尝尝我的苏贾玛……只要一小口就足以推销出去了。

original: Be cautious, friend. The ash spawn are soulless beings with no regard for compassion.
traduit: 小心点，朋友。灰烬怪是些没有灵魂的东西，它们不会留情。

original: Are you here to pray, or perhaps pay your respects at our Ancestral Tomb?
traduit: 你是来祈祷，还是想对我们的祖坟献上敬意呢？

original: The Argonians invaded Morrowind?
traduit: 阿尔贡入侵过晨风？

original: Quite a while ago, yes. They cut a bloody swath across most of the southern region of Morrowind.
traduit: 很久以前的事儿了，晨风南部遭到他们大肆屠杀。

original: Nobody seems certain why it happened... an attempt at expansion, revenge for the enslavement of their people or perhaps both.
traduit: 没人知道他们为啥那样做……扩张领土，或是为族人遭奴役而报复，也许两个都对。

original: Whatever the case may be, thousands of Dunmer needlessly lost their lives and many more were exiled from their homeland.
traduit: 无论原因是什么，成千上万的丹莫牺牲了生命，更多的人被迫逃离家园。

original: What do your titles mean?
traduit: 你们的头衔意味着什么？

original: Councilor Morvayn is House Redoran's representative on Solstheim.
traduit: 莫尔凡议员是瑞多然家在索瑟海姆的代表。

original: As second councilor, it's my job to support him and make certain his rule is enforced.
traduit: 作为副议员，我的职责是协助他，并确保他的命令执行下去。

original: Torkild? Your brother is looking for you.
traduit: 托基尔德？你兄弟在找你呢。

original: He hears the underslake of blood dust!
traduit: 他听到了血尘的扬弃！

original: They can't talk the wave signs!
traduit: 示好对他们无用！

original: Who... thirst for sky... All-Maker craves the night of sun.
traduit: 谁在……渴望天穹……造物主也在追求夜晚的日光。

original: When I first got to Kolbjorn, you couldn't even see it. Buried in the ash, like most other things on this blasted island.
traduit: 我刚来寇泊琼那会儿，什么都看不出来。全被灰给埋住了，跟这混账岛上其他地方一样。

original: Dug out a pile of the stuff taller than me just to find the barrow. Who knows how much to reach the door.
traduit: 我挖的土堆起来比我还高，但也才刚找到古坟。想挖到入口不知道要多久。

original: Excavating isn't exactly my specialty. Even if it was, the ash storms fill it in faster than you can dig.
traduit: 挖掘一向不是我的强项。就算是，火山灰风暴的掩埋速度远比你挖得快。

original: Yes, sir, Captain Veleth, sir.
traduit: 好的，维黎斯队长，好的。

original: See that they stay that way, or else I'll send you back to Skyrim in a crate. You understand me?
traduit: 给我接着放干净了，要不我就把你装在箱子里运回天际。听懂了吗？

original: Oh, come on. You know me, Captain Veleth. My hands are clean.
traduit: 哦，得了吧。你是了解我的，维黎斯队长。我手是干净的。

original: Hold a moment, Mogrul.
traduit: 等一下，莫古尔。

original: I've gotten a report that you've been harassing some of the townsfolk. Is this true?
traduit: 我听说你在骚扰镇民。有这回事吗？

original: I said to put it on my account and that's the end of it. Understand?
traduit: 叫你先记到账上就是了。懂了吗？

original: About your account... it's been a few months...
traduit: 说到你的账……已经有几个月了……

original: Why don't you say that louder so the entire town can hear you, idiot.
traduit: 你咋不说得再大声点给全镇人听到呢，蠢货。

original: Just give them to me and put it on my account.
traduit: 快点给我然后记在我账上。

original: Mogrul... I got those special poisons you asked for.
traduit: 莫古尔……我有你要的特制毒药了。

original: If you want that beautiful wife of yours to stay that way, you'd better.
traduit: 要是你还想让你老婆那张漂亮脸蛋保持下去，最好是这样。

original: Look, I know why you're here. I'll get the coin, I promise.
traduit: 听着，我知道你来干什么。会把钱凑够的，我保证。

original: Ash yams? Disgusting. I'd rather eat cheese that's been sitting in the sun for a week.
traduit: 灰烬薯？恶心。我宁愿吃在太阳下放了一周的奶酪。

original: Oh... Mogrul. Care for anything from my stand today?
traduit: 哦……莫古尔。今天来我的摊子买什么？

original: I'll see what I can do...
traduit: 我会努力的……

original: That isn't my problem. I was clear when I loaned Garyn the money that I wanted it back by the first harvest.
traduit: 这又不是我的问题。我当初借钱给盖仁的时候就说好了，要在下次收成的时候拿回来。

original: You can't get blood from a stone, Mogrul. As it is, we can barely make ends meet.
traduit: 石头是挤不出来血的，莫古尔。事实上，我们已经快入不敷出了。

original: Milore, you need to talk some sense into your husband.
traduit: 米洛尔，你得说服你的丈夫才行。

original: It's your mess. You clean it up.
traduit: 你惹出来的麻烦，自己解决。

original: You won't help me!?
traduit: 你不帮我？！

original: Master Neloth is going to kill me. Assuming he doesn't make me into a test subject again.
traduit: 内洛斯大师会杀了我的，前提是他不再拿我当实验品了。

original: Why don't you destroy it?
traduit: 你怎么没解决它？

original: I need to keep Master Neloth distracted so he doesn't find out what I did.
traduit: 我要转移内洛斯大师的注意力，这样他就不知道我干了什么。

original: There is no telling what he would do to me.
traduit: 谁知道他会怎么处置我。

original: While you are taking care of the creature, I'll try to figure out what went wrong.
traduit: 你去处理那东西，我去看看是哪里出了问题。

original: I, uh... I'm going to be reading the spell book. Maybe it can tell me how to banish the Ash Guardian.
traduit: 我，呃……我要去看看法术书，可能写了怎么驱逐那头灰烬守护者。

original: How did the Ash Guardian get loose?
traduit: 那头灰烬守护者是怎么失控的？

original: I am embarrassed to admit that it was my fault.
traduit: 不好意思，那是我的错。

original: Master Neloth refused to teach me the Ash Guardian spell. So I read his spell book on my own and learned it.
traduit: 内洛斯大师拒绝教我召唤灰烬守护者的法术，所以我偷看了他的法术书来学习。

original: Something went wrong when I cast it. The creature is attacking everything in sight.
traduit: 在召唤的时候出了某些问题，那玩意儿在攻击视野里的一切。

original: The unworthy flee before the Master's power.
traduit: 废物还是从主人的力量前滚开吧。

original: Another offering for the Master.
traduit: 又来一个主人的贡品。

original: You cannot escape Miraak's sight!
traduit: 你逃不出米拉克的视野！

original: You cannot escape the Dragonborn's justice!
traduit: 龙裔的审判无从逃避！

original: You won't win!
traduit: 你赢不了的！

original: Miraak help me!
traduit: 米拉克助我！

original: I shall not fall!
traduit: 我不会输的！

original: Gargh!
traduit: 嘎呃！

original: Yaggh!
traduit: 呀呃！

original: The true Dragonborn returns to this world soon, and all will be judged!
traduit: 真正的龙裔即将回到这个世界，众生都将迎来审判！

original: The rightful Dragonborn comes soon!
traduit: 真正的龙裔即将归来！

original: We shall clear the way for the coming of the true Dragonborn!
traduit: 我们来为真正龙裔的到来开路！

original: Your blood will flow in Miraak's name!
traduit: 你的血将为米拉克而流！

original: Your false reign ends now!
traduit: 终结你这虚伪之君！

original: You would dare call yourself the true Dragonborn?
traduit: 你敢称自己是真的龙裔？

original: I will purify the world for Miraak's return!
traduit: 我要为米拉克回归净化这个世界！

original: None shall stand against Miraak!
traduit: 所有人都将臣服于米拉克！

original: For Miraak!
traduit: 为了米拉克！

original: The truth will take you!
traduit: 真理会吞噬你！

original: Master, guide my hand!
traduit: 主人，引领我！

original: The true Dragonborn will judge you!
traduit: 真正的龙裔会审判你！

original: You will be an offering to the Master!
traduit: 你会成为主人的贡品！

original: Your soul belongs to Miraak!
traduit: 你的灵魂属于米拉克！

original: Where do you get your goods?
traduit: 你的货物都是从哪儿来的？

original: Sometimes things fall off the back of a cart.
traduit: 偶尔从运货马车上掉下来的。

original: I find them, clean them up and resell them.
traduit: 我捡到再清理干净，就拿来卖。

original: Who am I?
traduit: 我是谁？

original: Buy something or keep moving.
traduit: 不买东西就走开。

original: You appear to be in dire straits. What happened?
traduit: 你似乎陷入了困境，怎么了？

original: I was one of the wealthiest miners in town... I could haul up almost three or four times what the average digger could.
traduit: 我以前是镇子里最有钱的矿工……我挖的矿比别人多三到四倍。

original: I never saw the end coming like it did... the mine running out of ebony.
traduit: 从没想过事情会那样发展……黑檀矿脉居然枯竭了。

original: Unlike most of my fellow miners, I was too foolish to save enough coin for that day. The rest I spent on sujamma to drown my sorrows.
traduit: 和其他矿工不一样，我没有存够钱。只能把剩下的拿去买酒消愁。

original: Councilor Morvayn was kind enough to allow Rirns and I to live in one of the abandoned buildings. At least it keeps the ash out of our eyes.
traduit: 莫尔凡议员好心让我和瑞恩斯住在一间废弃房屋里，至少眼睛不会吃灰了。

original: I was one of the Redoran Guard under Captain Veleth's command.
traduit: 以前我是维黎斯队长手下的瑞多然卫兵。

original: A few years ago, I was out on patrol with two other men when we were attacked by some ash spawn.
traduit: 几年前我和几个同袍巡逻时，遭到灰烬怪袭击。

original: They sprung from the ground with no warning and killed one of my companions instantly. I was so frightened, I ran all the way back to Raven Rock.
traduit: 它们毫无预警地从地下跳出来，瞬间杀了我的一个同伴。我吓坏了，就一路跑回鸦石镇。

original: Unfortunately, I'd left the other guardsman behind and he never made it. Captain Veleth discharged me from service.
traduit: 不幸的是，另一个被我丢下的卫兵没能活下来。维黎斯队长就把我开除了。

original: There isn't a single night that passes where I don't regret what I did, but it's too late for that now.
traduit: 我每天都为所作所为后悔不已，但是已经太迟了。

original: Here. Have a gold piece. (1 gold)
traduit: 来。给你一枚金币。（1金币）

original: Thank you, outlander.
traduit: 谢谢你，外地人。

original: Bless you, sera.
traduit: 祝福你，塞拉。

original: Bless you, muthsera.
traduit: 祝福你，慕斯塞拉。

original: How are things now that the mines are open again?
traduit: 矿场重新开张后怎么样了？

original: Couldn't be better. The sections that are being opened up have revealed some huge deposits of ebony.
traduit: 再好不过了。已经开放的区域能看到一些巨型黑檀矿脉。

original: Old Crescius has a nose for exactly where to dig. If they'd only listened to him years ago, the town wouldn't have been in such dire straits.
traduit: 克雷修斯老头对于在哪儿开挖的嗅觉特别灵。要是大家几年前就听他的，镇上就不会陷入这种危急困境了。

original: At this rate, I'll be able to put a roof over my head in just a few months.
traduit: 照这个速度，我再过几个月就能把屋顶盖上了。

original: Bralsa's been nice enough to show me how to swing a pickaxe. She's an old hat when it comes to digging up ebony.
traduit: 布拉尔萨教过我很多用鹤嘴锄的技巧，她可是个挖黑檀矿的老手。

original: I may not be an expert at it yet, but it's good to be back to work and have some coin in my pockets.
traduit: 虽然我还不是个采矿行家，但能回到工作岗位，包里有钱总是件好事。

original: With the mines open, Raven Rock has become a significant colony of the Dunmer people again.
traduit: 矿场开张后，鸦石镇再次成为了丹莫的一个重要聚落。

original: I've been able to convince my superiors at House Redoran to send me the resources they've been denying now that we're deemed more important.
traduit: 我已经说服了瑞多然家的高层们把物资送来，之前他们一直拒绝，但现在我们受到重视了。

original: Soon, we'll have a steady supply of workers and materials to keep things going for years to come.
traduit: 很快，我们就有稳定的工人和材料供应，以维持未来几年的运转。

original: Things are picking up... for now.
traduit: 情况正在好转……至少现在如此。

original: All I'm wondering is how long it'll take for House Redoran to begin ignoring us again if the mine runs out of ore for a second time.
traduit: 我纳闷的是，要是矿场又枯竭了，瑞多然家是不是又会无视我们。

original: I've been made the foreman of the mine thanks to everything you did down there.
traduit: 多亏了你在矿井下做的一切，我当上工头了。

original: It's good to get the old nose working again. I missed sniffing out the ebony deposits and getting my hands dirty.
traduit: 我的嗅觉能再次派上用场还不赖，好怀念边闻着矿脉边抬矿的感觉。

original: Best of all, Aphia isn't so cross when I go down there any more!
traduit: 最安逸的是，现在我下矿阿菲娅再也不那么发火儿了！

original: You might think it's all perfume and roses now that the mine's open, but all I see is a new security problem on our hands.
traduit: 可能你觉得矿场开张后美好纷呈，但我却看到了一个新的安全隐患。

original: Making sure those shipments of ebony make it safely from the mine to the shipping docks is my new order of the day.
traduit: 确保那些黑檀矿从矿场安全运到码头是我新的日常任务。

original: And with Solstheim crawling with reavers and Azura-knows what else, I can't risk any attacks on Raven Rock.
traduit: 而且索瑟海姆到处爬满了抢匪，鬼晓得还有什么东西，我不能让鸦石镇冒着被袭击的风险。

original: How do you think? It's a blessing.
traduit: 你觉得呢？当然是好事儿啊。

original: I've got regular paying customers again, thirsty workers at the end of the day, and more coin than I can count.
traduit: 现在又有稳定的客源了，那些辛苦一天的工人们个个饥渴难耐，赚的钱数都数不过来。

original: I've always had a steady stream of work thanks to the Redoran Guard, so it hasn't affected me much.
traduit: 多亏了瑞多然卫兵，我一直都有源源不断的活儿干，所以对我来说变化不大。

original: However, I've seen the smile on people's faces and there's hope around here once again... something we've been lacking for a long time.
traduit: 但是，我看到了人们脸上的笑容，这里又有希望了……这是我们长久以来缺乏的东西……

original: I've had to muster some more men to protect the mine, but I don't really have a problem with that.
traduit: 我不得不召集更多人手来保护矿场，但我真的不介意。

original: Second Councilor Arano is concerned that once word reaches the reavers that the mine has reopened, they might think about paying us a visit.
traduit: 副议员阿拉诺担心一旦矿场重新开张的消息传到抢匪耳朵里，他们可能会上门拜访。

original: I say let them try. My men are ready for them.
traduit: 我说让他们放马过来。我的手下准备好迎接了。

original: Here in my temple.
traduit: 这是我的神殿。

original: Here in my shrine.
traduit: 这是我的祭坛。

original: That you have forgotten.
traduit: 你们已然忘记。

original: Here do you toil.
traduit: 你们在此辛劳。

original: That you might remember.
traduit: 如此才会想起。

original: Here you reclaim.
traduit: 你们在此收复。

original: Far from yourself.
traduit: 离你遥远之处。

original: I grow ever nearer to you.
traduit: 我越来越靠近。

original: Your eyes once were blinded.
traduit: 你们双眼曾盲。

original: Now through me do you see.
traduit: 现以我来视物。

original: Your hands once were idle.
traduit: 你们双手曾空。

original: Now through them do I speak.
traduit: 现以它们听教。

original: Wake up. Wake up!
traduit: 醒醒，醒醒！

original: Miraak has you, just like the others!
traduit: 你被米拉克控制了，就和其他人一样！

original: Why did you touch the Stone?
traduit: 你为什么要碰圣石？

original: Come back! Wake up!
traduit: 醒过来啊！起来！

original: You must fight him!
traduit: 你必须反抗他！

original: Ro...Da!
traduit: 洛……达！

original: Zii...Gron!
traduit: 兹……格隆！

original: Grah...Dun!
traduit: 格拉……顿！

original: Nah...Kest!
traduit: 纳……凯斯！

original: Toor...Shul!
traduit: 托……苏尔！

original: You are the true Dragonborn.
traduit: 你才是真正的龙裔。

original: You should not have come here!
traduit: 你不该来这儿！

original: For Whiterun!
traduit: 为了白漫！

original: Ah, now we can finish this.
traduit: 啊，现在来做个了断吧。

original: Did you think to escape me?
traduit: 你觉得逃得开吗？

original: It's too late for regrets, Dragonborn.
traduit: 现在后悔太迟了，龙裔。

original: There's no escape from this place.
traduit: 你逃不出这里的。

original: You are in my power here.
traduit: 你在我的力量掌控之中。

original: Hiding is beneath you, Dragonborn.
traduit: 躲藏可不符你的名头啊，龙裔。

original: As you'll see, that's easier said than done. This way to the boilers.
traduit: 马上你就知道了，这没那么简单。走这边去锅炉那儿。

original: No, we'll have to do this the hard way. If we can restore the steam supply to this room, I'm certain I can open it.
traduit: 没辙，咱们只能用笨法子了。如果能恢复这房间的蒸汽供应，就肯定能打开。

original: So tantalizingly close... But trust me, no magic will open that. I'd have had the book already if it could.
traduit: 近在咫尺了……但相信我，没有魔法打得开它。有用的话我早就拿到书了。

original: You can see the book right here.
traduit: 你从这里可以清楚地看到书。

original: (Walk away)
traduit: （离开）

original: Depends. Who's asking?
traduit: 不一定。看是谁问了。

original: The Greybeards seem to think so...
traduit: 灰胡子是那么想的……

original: Yes, I am Dragonborn.
traduit: 对，我确实是龙裔。

original: You there! You're the one they call Dragonborn?
traduit: 那边儿的！你就是人们口中的龙裔吗？

original: Your lies fall on deaf ears, Deceiver. The True Dragonborn comes... You are but his shadow.
traduit: 你那谎言对我们无效，欺诈者！真正的龙裔即将到来……你不过是他的影子罢了。

original: Then it is too late. The lie has already taken root in the hearts of men.
traduit: 那就太迟了，这谎言已经在人们心中扎根了。

original: So we shall expose to them the falseness in their hearts by tearing out yours, Deceiver!
traduit: 那就先把你的心脏挖出来，让他们看清真相！

original: Your lies fall on deaf ears, Deceiver! We know you are the False Dragonborn!
traduit: 你那谎言对我们无效，欺诈者！我们知道你是假龙裔！

original: You shall not stand in the way of the true Dragonborn's return. He comes soon, and we shall offer him your heart!
traduit: 你不该阻挡真正龙裔的回归。他即将到来，而我们会把你的心脏献给他！

original: You cannot escape the truth. You cannot escape the True Dragonborn!
traduit: 你无法逃避真相，你无法逃避真正的龙裔！

original: When Lord Miraak appears all shall bear witness. None will stand to oppose him!
traduit: 当米拉克大人现世，所有人皆须见证，无人能违抗他。

original: When Lord Miraak appears all shall bear witness. None shall stand to oppose him!
traduit: 当米拉克大人现世，所有人皆须见证，无人能违抗他。

original: I don't know what you're talking about.
traduit: 我不知道你在说什么。

original: Oh, how the Deceiver wags his clever tongue.
traduit: 嚯，欺诈者可真是口齿伶俐啊。

original: But you shall not evade us with guile and deceit. No. You shall pay for your blasphemy!
traduit: 但你的诡诈与欺骗无法蒙蔽我们！不，你将为你的亵渎之举付出代价！

original: When Lord Miraak appears all shall bear witness. None will there be who oppose him.
traduit: 当米拉克大人现世，所有人皆须见证，无人能违抗他。

original: So we shall rip the falsehood from their breasts by tearing the false heart from yours!
traduit: 那就先把你的心脏挖出来，让他们看清真相！

original: No! Do not touch the Stone while Miraak controls it!
traduit: 不！别在米拉克控制圣石的时候碰它！

original: It's on your head if something goes wrong.
traduit: 要是出了什么问题可都是你的责任。

original: Just let me get back inside first.
traduit: 我还是先进里面去吧。

original: The, uh... the lab is too small. Also, I need the ashy soil.
traduit: 呃……实验室太小了，而且，我需要灰质土。

original: Master Neloth knows what I'm doing.
traduit: 内洛斯大师知道我在干什么。

original: No need to bother him about it though. He's quite busy at the moment.
traduit: 没必要告诉他这个，他现在太忙了。

original: Master Neloth told me to practice this spell while he's away.
traduit: 内洛斯大师要我在他走了后练习这个法术。

original: No need to tell him about it when he gets back. He knows all about this.
traduit: 没必要在他回来后告诉他，他全都知道的。

original: Master Neloth has tasked Elynea with repairing the tower.
traduit: 内洛斯大师已经吩咐艾琳娜去修复塔楼了。

original: Why aren't you doing this in the lab, where it would be safer for all of us?
traduit: 你为什么不在实验室里练习呢，那里对我们来说更安全吧？

original: If you must know, I'm trying to get this Ash Guardian spell to work.
traduit: 你一定要知道的话，我正在尝试灰烬守护者法术。

original: Now let me concentrate.
traduit: 现在不要打扰我。
