original: Besides, shouldn't you be worrying about the damage to the tower?
traduit: 另外，难道你不关心下塔的损害情况吗？

original: Why are you out here? Aren't you supposed to be in the tower assisting Master Neloth?
traduit: 你怎么在外面？你应该在塔里帮内洛斯大师的忙啊？

original: Why are you out here? Master Neloth is away. Aren't you supposed to stay in the tower?
traduit: 你怎么在外面？内洛斯大师出门了，你不该待在塔里吗？

original: Goora!
traduit: 格拉！

original: Hawah!
traduit: 哈哇！

original: Felgir paw tuwani barj.
traduit: 费基尔 帕瓦 图瓦尼 巴尔吉。

original: Goora! Goora! Goora!
traduit: 格拉！格拉！格拉！

original: Karoo taray pelfrik?
traduit: 咔如 塔瑞 培福瑞克？

original: Froo ha cawasy jo la.
traduit: 弗鲁 哈 卡瓦西 哟 啦。

original: Roo cha!
traduit: 噜 查！

original: Why do you think your brother became a werebear?
traduit: 为什么你认为你兄弟变成了熊人？

original: He never felt the call of the All-Maker as I do. As we all should.
traduit: 他从没像我们大家那样，感受到造物主的召唤。

original: We seek to live in peace with the land, but he had an eye for dominance and strength.
traduit: 我们追求与这方水土和平共处，但是他的眼中只有征服和蛮力。

original: For unnatural strength, you need look no further than the beasts of this island, mangled by the daedra.
traduit: 想了解那些非自然的力量的话，你只消看看这岛上的被迪德拉腐化的野兽。

original: It's not a fate I would wish on anyone. And not what I wanted for my brother.
traduit: 我不希望任何人落得如此下场，更不希望我兄弟如此。

original: Another border...no, aetheric order. I think that's right.
traduit: 另一种界限……不，光界秩序。这样应该没错。

original: Two fingers pronated...what's pronated? Oh. Rotated. That might work.
traduit: 两根手指内旋……啥是内旋？哦，就是转一下。说不定能行。

original: Tart bones? That doesn't even make sense. I'll just ignore that part.
traduit: 酸骨头？完全看不懂啊。我直接忽略这段吧。

original: Are you practicing a spell?
traduit: 你在练习法术吗？

original: Yes. I'm trying to summon an Ash Guardian.
traduit: 对。我在尝试召唤灰烬守护者。

original: I'm just having trouble deciphering Master Neloth's handwriting.
traduit: 我没法辨认内洛斯大师的笔迹。

original: I don't mean to be rude, but I need to concentrate.
traduit: 无意冒犯，但我现在需要专心。

original: That was you? You're the Dragonborn?
traduit: 就是你？你就是龙裔？

original: Please, you have to believe me. I did everything against my will, I had no choice!
traduit: 拜托，你相信我，我是被逼的，我没得选！

original: Not... exactly. Look, it's difficult to explain.
traduit: 不对……听着，很难解释的清。

original: I heard... a voice in my head. It told me to bring the cultists to Windhelm. I didn't want to do it, but I did it anyway. I couldn't control myself.
traduit: 我听到……脑子里有个声音。要我把教徒带到风舵城去，我不想那么做，但我控制不了自己。

original: I don't know. I can't remember everything clearly.
traduit: 不知道。我记不清那些事了。

original: It's hard to explain... I remember those people with the masks coming on board, then...
traduit: 很难解释，我只记得带着这些戴面具的漂洋过海，然后……

original: Next thing I remember, I was here and they were gone. That's not right, losing whole days like that.
traduit: 我就发现船到了港，他们也不见了。不过太怪了，一整天就这么过去了。

original: There's been something strange going on there for a while, but after this... I'm done. I'm not going back to Solstheim.
traduit: 那边最近怪事频发，但这次……我受够了，我再也不回索瑟海姆了。

original: Do you have enough coin for the journey?
traduit: 你为这次旅行带够钱了吗？

original: The Maiden doesn't move until I've been paid.
traduit: 你得付钱，不然北方少女号开不了。

original: We sail as soon as I'm paid.
traduit: 我拿到钱后才开船。

original: If you've got the gold, I'm your captain.
traduit: 你要是有钱，我就开船。

original: My ship's ready to sail if you've brought enough gold.
traduit: 钱带够船随时起航。

original: I fear there is too much we do not yet know.
traduit: 恐怕我们不知道的还多着呢。

original: But how is that possible? After all this time...
traduit: 但怎么可能呢？过了这么久了……

original: Something feels wrong. Brace yourself!
traduit: 我感觉有些不对劲，打起精神来！

original: It is no wonder the dragons razed his temple to the ground. Seeing the remains hung up like trophies must have enraged them to no end.
traduit: 难怪龙族会把他的神殿夷为平地，看到这些尸骸像战利品一样吊起来肯定让它们怒不可遏。

original: I had heard Miraak had turned against the Dragon Cult, but to display the remains in such a manner as this...
traduit: 我曾听说过米拉克背叛了拜龙教，但像这样把尸骨展出在大厅里……

original: It is eerily quiet. I do not suspect that will be the case the further we go. Be on your guard.
traduit: 静得出奇。再往前走恐怕就不那么太平了，保持戒备。

original: It looks like there is only one way to proceed.
traduit: 看来只有一条路可选。

original: I leave the honor of pulling that handle to you. I do not want to put my hand anywhere near the mouth of that statue.
traduit: 拉那个把手的荣耀给你了，我一点儿都不想摸那雕像的嘴巴附近。

original: I do not recognize this statuary. We passed by a few of them earlier, but they are becoming more frequent as we get further in.
traduit: 这些雕像太陌生了。咱们之前也路过了几个，但是越往里走它们出现得越频繁。

original: I do not like this place. It almost looks as if these statues will come to life at any moment.
traduit: 不喜欢这个地方。这些雕像就像随时会活过来一样。

original: Nothing but ruined books.
traduit: 都是些毁了的书。

original: I wonder if there is something here that tells the story of Miraak...
traduit: 也不知道这里有没有什么东西记录了米拉克的故事……

original: Then perhaps you do have business here... Forgive me. I'm Rakel, of the Frostmoon Pack. Welcome, brother.
traduit: 那么你在这儿确实不是外人……原谅我。我是霜月狼群的拉克尔。欢迎你，兄弟。

original: Then perhaps you do have business here... Forgive me. I'm Rakel, of the Frostmoon Pack. Welcome, sister.
traduit: 那么你在这儿确实不是外人……原谅我。我是霜月狼群的拉克尔。欢迎你，姐妹。

original: Be on your way, outlander.
traduit: 快走吧，外人。

original: Grr...
Last warning.
traduit: 最后一次警告了。

original: Leave. Now.
traduit: 立刻离开。

original: Hold, traveler. You have no business here. Be on your way.
traduit: 站住，旅行者。这儿没你的事，快走。

original: ...Wait. You... you're one of us, aren't you? A werewolf?
traduit: ……等等，你……是我们的同类，对吧？你也是狼人？

original: Hold, traveler. You have no business here.
traduit: 站住，旅行者。这儿没你的事。

original: Meat. Furs. Bone. Trophies of the hunt. But those are of little use to you.
traduit: 肉、毛皮、骨头，都是我们狩猎的战利品。对你没什么用。

original: There is one more thing... Since the days of the Great Hunt, our pack has kept a set of rings, blessed by Lord Hircine himself.
traduit: 但是有一样东西……自从大狩猎以来，我们留下了一套戒指，是由海尔辛大人亲自赐福过的。

original: I sense his favor on you. For you... I will part with them, if you can pay my price.
traduit: 我感觉到他对你的眷顾。是你的话……只要价钱到位，我就愿意割爱。

original: Do you have anything to trade?
traduit: 有什么要交易的吗？

original: You might find a few others. Strays. Lone hunters. But ours is the last true pack that remains.
traduit: 你可能找得到其他流浪的孤独猎人。但我们是真正仅剩的狼群了。

original: Are there other werewolves on Solstheim?
traduit: 索瑟海姆岛上还有其他狼人吗？

original: Aye. The blood still runs true among some on Solstheim, as it has for centuries. We have chosen to embrace Lord Hircine's blessing.
traduit: 没错。几百年来这种血液依然在索瑟海姆岛上流传。我们选择拥抱海尔辛大人的赐福。

original: You know it well. The speed and strength of the beast. The thrill of the hunt. The triumph of the kill. This is our purpose, our way of life.
traduit: 你自己也清楚吧，野兽的速度与力量，狩猎的快感，杀戮的成就感。这就是我们的追求和生活方式。

original: So it was for my father, and his father before him. And I welcome any who walk that path.
traduit: 我们的父辈都选择了这样的生活，也欢迎任何选择这条路的人。

original: Are you all werewolves?
traduit: 你们都是狼人吗？

original: I am Majni, Alpha of the Frostmoon Pack. You are welcome here, so long as you respect our law.
traduit: 我是马吉尼，霜月狼群的首领。我们欢迎你留下来，只要遵守这儿的规矩。

original: Welcome, brother. It's been too long since we met another who shares our blood.
traduit: 欢迎你，兄弟。我们很久没见过流着相同血液的人了。

original: Welcome, sister. It's been too long since we met another who shares our blood.
traduit: 欢迎你，姐妹。我们很久没见过流着相同血液的人了。

original: For now. My pack lived in the mountains northeast of here, 'till they were wiped out. Damn werebears.
traduit: 现在是的。我原本属于东北边儿那个山上的狼群，后来他们被干掉了。该死的熊人。

original: Majni offered to help me reclaim my territory. I hunt with him until then. After that... we'll see.
traduit: 马吉尼答应帮我夺回领地，那之后我就先跟着他一起狩猎。至于以后……走着瞧吧。

original: Are you part of this pack, too?
traduit: 你也是这个狼群的一份子，对吧？

original: Why? Have you seen how they live? They cower behind their walls, afraid of every ash hopper, every netch!
traduit: 为什么？你见过他们怎么过日子的吗？躲在墙后，无论是灰烬跳虫还是气母都能吓着他们！

original: No, I'd rather be here. Free to hunt, free to live my life as I choose.
traduit: 不，我宁可留在这儿。自由地打猎，自由地生活。

original: Have you ever thought about moving to a city?
traduit: 你有想过到城市里住吗？

original: Since I was born. My parents were members of the pack, back when Majni's father was Alpha.
traduit: 自我出生以来，我父母就是这个狼群的一份子，那会儿头狼还是马吉尼的父亲。

original: After they died, Majni and Akar took care of me, taught me to hunt. I'm not as good as they are, but... I do my best.
traduit: 他们去世后，是马吉尼和阿喀尔照顾我，教我怎么狩猎。我不像他们那么厉害，但……已经尽力了。

original: Do you live out here?
traduit: 你要在这儿过一辈子吗？

original: Deer. Sabers. Rieks. Boar. Bear.
traduit: 鹿、剑齿虎、瑞克灵、野猪还有熊。

original: I hunt soon. Go bother Majni.
traduit: 我要去打猎了，找马吉尼去吧。

original: You hunt? What do you hunt?
traduit: 你会狩猎？都捕猎些什么？

original: Hunt well, brother.
traduit: 祝你狩猎丰收，兄弟。

original: Hunt well, sister.
traduit: 祝你狩猎丰收，姐妹。

original: Huntsman guide you.
traduit: “大狩猎者”会指引你。

original: Hircine go with you.
traduit: 海尔辛会与你同行。

original: Goodbye, whelp.
traduit: 再见，小狗。

original: How goes your hunt?
traduit: 狩猎顺利吗？

original: Greetings, blood-kin.
traduit: 你好啊，血亲。

original: Welcome, brother.
traduit: 欢迎你，兄弟。

original: Welcome, sister.
traduit: 欢迎你，姐妹。

original: Hello again.
traduit: 又见面了。

original: I don't trust you, whelp. Keep that in mind.
traduit: 给我记住，小狗，我信不过你。

original: What is it, pup?
traduit: 干什么，小狗？

original: Akar. Majni's brother.
traduit: 阿喀尔，马吉尼的兄弟。

original: I hunt. He talks. Go talk to him.
traduit: 我负责打猎，他负责沟通。你找他谈。

original: You mean you'll give him what he wants?
traduit: 你的意思是要让他得偿所愿？

original: Yes. The Skaal also tell of the day when we must finally give up our secrets. When Herma-Mora finally wins.
traduit: 对，斯卡尔人也曾提及我们终有放弃保守秘密的一天，也就是赫玛-莫拉获胜的那天。

original: As shaman, it is my duty to guard these secrets, but also to decide when it is necessary to give them up.
traduit: 作为萨满，我有职责守护这些秘密，但也要决定什么时候该放弃它们。

original: I believe that time is now. If I am wrong, may my ancestors forgive me.
traduit: 我认为时候到了。如果我错了，希望先祖们宽恕我吧。

original: I'll restore the remaining Stones if that will help.
traduit: 有用的话，我就去恢复其他的圣石。

original: It may. It should. And I will think on what you ask of me, to decide if it is necessary, or just another of Herma-Mora's tricks.
traduit: 应该有用。我也会认真考虑你要我做的到底是势在必行，还是赫玛-莫拉的另一个诡计。

original: He said it's the only way he'll teach me the final Word of Miraak's Shout.
traduit: 他说只有这么做，他才会教我米拉克的龙吼的最后一句力量之语。

original: So it falls to me to be the one to give up the secrets to our ancient enemy. I do not know if I have the strength to face him.
traduit: 看来，我就是那个向宿敌交出秘密的人。不知道我的力量是否足以面对他。

original: With Miraak's corruption of the Stones... the Oneness of the land is disrupted, and our connection to the All-Maker is broken.
traduit: 米拉克腐化了圣石……这片土地的完整性被破坏了，连带着我们和造物主之间的纽带。

original: The Tree Stone is still corrupted... the land is still out of balance. But with the other five restored... it may be enough. It will have to be.
traduit: 树石依然处于腐化中……这方水土的平衡还未恢复。但是其他五座圣石已经恢复了……或许已经足够。如今也只能如此了。

original: I spoke to Hermaeus Mora. He asked for the "secrets of the Skaal."
traduit: 我跟赫麦尤斯·莫拉谈过了。他想要“斯卡尔的秘密”。

original: Are you ready to trade your secrets to Hermaeus Mora?
traduit: 你准备好拿你们的秘密和赫麦尤斯·莫拉做交易了吗？

original: No... I am still too weak to face him. It will take all my strength if I am to force him to hold to his bargain.
traduit: 不……我还是太虚弱，不足以面对他。我得耗尽力气才能迫使他履行承诺。

original: You must cleanse the other Stones so that I can draw power from the All-Maker.
traduit: 你得先净化其他的圣石，这样我才能得到造物主的力量。

original: Hermaeus Mora... old Herma-Mora himself. So he is the source of Miraak's power. Of course.
traduit: 赫麦尤斯·莫拉……居然是老赫玛-莫拉。原来是他赐予米拉克力量。难怪。

original: We have many tales of Herma-Mora trying to trick us into giving up our secrets to him.
traduit: 我们中流传着很多传说，述说着赫玛-莫拉如何欺骗我们放弃秘密。

original: And now he comes again for what we have long kept from him.
traduit: 现在他又卷土重来了，想得到我们一直守护的东西。

original: Herma-Mora? Why do you call him that?
traduit: 赫玛-莫拉？为什么你们那样叫他？

original: That is our name for him - the Demon of Knowledge. He has always been our enemy.
traduit: 那就是我们给他的名字——知识的恶魔。他一直都是我们的敌人。

original: Why would Hermaeus Mora want your secrets?
traduit: 为什么赫麦尤斯·莫拉想要你们的秘密？

original: We know him as Herma-Mora, the Demon of Knowledge. It is in his nature to hoard secrets to himself. Their value to him is of no consequence.
traduit: 我们称他为赫玛-莫拉，知识的恶魔。他的天性就是聚藏秘密，秘密的价值对他来说无关紧要。

original: The very fact that the Skaal have kept knowledge from him has merely increased his desire to have it.
traduit: 斯卡尔人决不对他公开秘密，这只会加深他的掠夺欲望。

original: Have you? The actual Oghma Infinium? That's... I've searched for it myself for many years without success...
traduit: 是吗？真正的无限智典？哎……我找了很多年，却无功而返……

original: Well then, you should know better than anyone that Hermaeus Mora is not to be trifled with.
traduit: 好吧，那你应该比任何人都清楚，赫麦尤斯·莫拉不容小觑。

original: But he is subtler than most of the other Daedric Princes, as you would expect of the prince of knowledge and fate.
traduit: 他比其他的迪德拉君王更狡猾，完美诠释了什么叫做知识与命运之主。

original: You seem to have escaped the fate of many who find themselves ensnared forever by the lure of his secrets. Or... perhaps not.
traduit: 不少人被他的秘密所诱惑，深陷其中，永世无法脱身，而你似乎逃过了这般宿命。或许……也未必。

original: I've dealt with Hermaeus Mora before. I've read the Oghma Infinium.
traduit: 我跟赫麦尤斯·莫拉交易过，我读了无限智典。

original: I will strike like a hawk!
traduit: 看我像鹰一样攻击！

original: Where did you come from?
traduit: 你是从哪儿来的？

original: All-Maker protect me!
traduit: 造物主保护我！

original: A wise decision.
traduit: 明智的决定。

original: I accept your yield.
traduit: 我接受你的投降。

original: I'll stay my weapon... for now.
traduit: 我不会动手…暂时的。

original: Assassin! Assassin!
traduit: 有刺客！有刺客！

original: You'll pay dearly for what you've done.
traduit: 你会为此付出代价！

original: You'll regret what you've done, murderer!
traduit: 你会后悔的，凶手！

original: Have you taken leave of your senses?
traduit: 你疯了吗？

original: How dare you!
traduit: 你怎么敢！

original: Not very sporting of you to do that.
traduit: 你这样可不像话。

original: We mean you no harm, but... be on your way.
traduit: 我们无意伤害你，但是……快走吧。

original: Leave us in peace.
traduit: 别打扰我们。

original: You have no business with our pack. Begone.
traduit: 我们狼群不欢迎你。滚开。

original: Get out of here.
traduit: 离开这里。

original: As the Archmage of Winterhold, you and I should share our secrets.
traduit: 身为冬堡学院的大法师，我们应该交换秘密。

original: Winterhold? That small college that is falling into the Sea of Ghosts?
traduit: 冬堡？那快要掉进幽灵海的小学院？

original: You're the one that recovered the Staff of Magnus. Impressive.
traduit: 原来玛格努斯之杖是你找回来的，干得漂亮。

original: Talvas should finish his apprenticeship in a couple of decades. Come see me then. I think I could teach you a trick or two.
traduit: 塔瓦斯应该还有几十年就学完了。那时候再来找我，可能会教你几招。

original: You must be almost as powerful as Savros Aren of Winterhold.
traduit: 你一定和冬堡的萨沃斯·阿冉一样强大。

original: Savros? Ha! He wouldn't be fit to be my apprentice.
traduit: 萨沃斯？哈！他连给我当学徒都不配。

original: Of course he does have a knack for wards that would be handy to learn.
traduit: 当然，他确实摸到了个简单易学的结界术窍门。

original: If you see him, let him know that I might be willing to take him on as my apprentice. For a price of course.
traduit: 你要是看见他，告诉他我也许会同意收他为徒。当然是有代价的。

original: I've heard of the House Telvanni of Morrowind.
traduit: 我听说过晨风的泰瓦尼家。

original: Of course you have.
traduit: 这不很正常么。

original: Everyone has heard of the master wizards of Morrowind.
traduit: 晨风法师大族名加海内。

original: We are one of the great houses that rule Morrowind.
traduit: 我们是统治晨风的大家族之一。

original: You must be a very powerful wizard.
traduit: 你肯定是个实力强大的法师。

original: I am likely the greatest wizard you will ever meet.
traduit: 我应该是你见过的最强的法师。

original: Who else do you think could create a staff enchanter?
traduit: 除了我之外还有谁能发明法杖附魔台？

original: If you make yourself useful around here, I might just let you use it.
traduit: 你要是能在这儿帮忙，也许我会让你使用它。

original: You again. Didn't I see you in Raven Rock?
traduit: 又是你。我是不是在鸦石镇见过你？

original: I don't recall inviting you into my tower. I do hope you make this worth my while.
traduit: 我不记得邀请过你来我的塔。希望别浪费我的时间。

original: What do you do for Master Neloth?
traduit: 你都替内洛斯大师做些什么？

original: I am his mycologist. He may have grown Tel Mithryn by himself, but I nurture it.
traduit: 我是他的真菌学者。虽然是他种植了泰尔·米斯瑞恩，但养育陪护的人是我。

original: Mushrooms and fungi are my life's work. When I saw Tel Mithryn I knew I had to be here.
traduit: 研究菌类是我一生的志向。当看到泰尔·米斯瑞恩时，我就知道要留下来。

original: I've learned so much since then.
traduit: 从那以后我学到了很多。

original: Did you grow this tower?
traduit: 这座塔是你种出来的吗？

original: Me? No. That's Master Neloth's doing. I wasn't even born then.
traduit: 我？不是。这是内洛斯大师种的。我那会儿都还没出生呢。

original: It's Telvanni magic at its best. He brought the cuttings with him from Morrowind and used sorcery to grow them.
traduit: 这是泰瓦尼家最高阶的法术。他带着晨风的插枝来这儿，用法术把它们种上了。

original: This is Master Neloth's tower. He's a Telvanni Wizard.
traduit: 这里是内洛斯大师的塔楼。他是个泰瓦尼法师。

original: If you have released the Wind Stone and broken the hold on my people, perhaps you can do the same for the rest of Solstheim.
traduit: 如果你能解放风石，打破我族人所受的束缚，或许对索瑟海姆岛上其他圣石也有效。

original: I doubt it will fully stop whatever Miraak is doing, but it may slow his progress.
traduit: 也许我们不能完全阻止米拉克的行动，但至少能拖延他的进程。

original: How do I know I can trust you, demon?
traduit: 我怎么知道该不该相信你，恶魔。

original: My word is as true as fate, as inevitable as destiny. Bring me what I want, and I will give you what you seek.
traduit: 我所言就如命运一般真实，如天数一样必然。把我要的带来，我就给你在寻找的东西。

original: Beware! Another of those creatures!
traduit: 小心！那种生物又来了！

original: Now we will see if he knows what he is talking about.
traduit: 现在来看看他是不是真的知道自己在说什么。

original: Finally. We will not have to listen to his complaining.
traduit: 终于清净了，不用再听他叨叨了。

original: I think you did it.
traduit: 我想你成功了。

original: You should leave slogging around in the muck to us youngsters.
traduit: 在脏水里的活儿交给我们年轻人吧。

original: That's correct. I'm glad to see someone else has been paying attention.
traduit: 没错。很高兴终于有人专心听我讲了。

original: So, we only need one more of these... cubes?
traduit: 那么，我们现在只差……一个方典了？

original: Be careful.
traduit: 小心。

original: It is rather impressive.
traduit: 太壮观了。

original: It would be madness to go through there.
traduit: 要穿过去简直是疯了。

original: Amazing to think that they built this so long ago, and it still survives.
traduit: 一想到他们建了如此之久的地方竟然还能运作，就觉得太神奇了。

original: The dwarves must have feared this book to lock it away like this.
traduit: 矮人们一定很惧怕这本书，就把它这样封起来了。

original: The Skaal have always avoided ruins such as these. Nothing of the All-Maker is to be found within.
traduit: 斯卡尔人一直以来都会避开这种废墟。里面完全找不到造物主的创造。

original: Maybe... we should think about this some more.
traduit: 可能……我们得再考虑一下。

original: No, no, I couldn't. ...You open it.
traduit: 不，不行。我不去……你打开吧。

original: Well, what are you waiting for? Go ahead and open it.
traduit: 所以呢，你在等什么？去打开啊？

original: I can't believe it. We... we actually found it!
traduit: 不敢相信。我们……我们真的找到了！

original: Nikulas has agreed to stay.
traduit: 尼库拉斯同意留下来了。

original: May the All-Maker bless you with many sons and daughters, outsider. Once again you have shown that you are a true friend of the Skaal.
traduit: 愿造物主保佑你儿孙满堂，外来者。你再一次证明了自己是斯卡尔真正的朋友。

original: I wish that I could give you a reward that is equal to the joy in my heart, but I don't have much to offer one who has so much already.
traduit: 我希望能给你与我心中快乐同等的回报，但你已有太多，我没什么好东西给你了。

original: Perhaps these will prove useful to you. These herbs are unique to the island, and their like cannot be found elsewhere.
traduit: 也许这些会对你有用。这些草药是岛上的特产，其他任何地方都找不到类似的。

original: Maybe you should let him go.
traduit: 也许你该放手了。

original: Perhaps someday I will have to, but for now I need Nikulas here. You see, his father, my husband, was recently lost to us.
traduit: 可能将来某天我必须放手，但是现在我需要尼库拉斯留在这儿。你看，他父亲，也就是我丈夫最近才离我们而去了。

original: Nikulas is all that I have left in this world. I know it is selfish of me to say so, but I cannot lose him. Not while I still grieve.
traduit: 我在这世上只有尼库拉斯了。我知道这么说很自私，但是我不能没有他。至少在这悲痛时刻。

original: Also, I know his heart. Nikulas is reckless and foolish, like most young men. He cannot understand what awaits him in the wide world.
traduit: 而且，我懂他的心性。尼库拉斯跟所有年轻人一样莽撞而愚笨。他不知道外面的世界有什么在等着他。

original: And so it begins...
traduit: 要开始了…

original: You've made a fatal mistake!
traduit: 你犯了个致命的错误！

original: You'll pay for your treachery!
traduit: 为背叛付出代价吧！

original: For Councilor Morvayn!
traduit: 为了莫尔凡议员！

original: For House Redoran! For honor!
traduit: 为了瑞多然家！为了荣耀！

original: I'll stain the ash with your blood!
traduit: 把你的血都洒了！

original: I'll not fall to the likes of you!
traduit: 你这种人打不倒我！

original: To the death, then!
traduit: 奋战到死！

original: For House Redoran!
traduit: 为了瑞多然家！

original: Time to teach this whelp a lesson!
traduit: 该给这雏儿上上课了！

original: Victory or death!
traduit: 要么赢，要么死！

original: No Ash Guardian. Maybe the book has something.
traduit: 灰烬守护者没出来。可能这本书有问题。

original: Nothing.
traduit: 没什么。

original: Why won't this summoning work?
traduit: 为什么召唤不了？

original: Mogrul says pay up. We figure we can just take it off your corpse.
traduit: 莫古尔叫你还钱。我们寻思还是从你尸体上拿吧。

original: You are welcome among us, so long as you mean no harm.
traduit: 欢迎加入我们，只要别伤人就行。

original: Hail, brother! I am Rakel, of the Frostmoon Pack.
traduit: 你好啊，兄弟。我是霜月狼群的拉克尔。

original: Hail, sister! I am Rakel, of the Frostmoon Pack.
traduit: 你好啊，姐妹。我是霜月狼群的拉克尔。

original: Unless of course you'd like to contribute to my investigation. It could be very enlightening to observe you.
traduit: 除非你愿意协助我调查，观察你应该能得到很多灵感。

original: I would not advise touching the stone again. The effects of repeated contact could be...
traduit: 我建议你别再去碰那石头了，跟它连续接触会造成……

original: Ah, so you appear able to resist the effect by exerting your will. Fascinating!
traduit: 啊，看来你能够运用意志来抵抗这种影响。有意思！

original: Fascinating. By touching the stone, you appear to have fallen under whatever influence is affecting the others.
traduit: 太神奇了。摸了那石头后，你好像和其他人一样陷入了某种影响之下。

original: I wonder how long this effect will last. Perhaps it is permanent as with the others.
traduit: 我好奇这种影响会持续多久。可能和别人一样是永久的。

original: That would be a shame. You were an interesting exception to the otherwise universal phenomenon.
traduit: 那就太可惜了，你原本是这种普遍现象中的特例。

original: Can you hear me? Do you have any free will left, or are you completely under this outside influence like the others?
traduit: 听得到吗？你还有自我意识吗，还是和别人一样完全被这种外来影响控制了？

original: Hmm. It appears that you were not as unusual after all.
traduit: 嗯。看来你并没有那么特别。

original: That seems inadvisable... oh well.
traduit: 这好像不太明智……好吧。

original: Now I just have to figure how to get this thing started...
traduit: 我现在只需要想办法启动这东西……

original: If you say so. That old crackpot made the trials sound a lot harder than that.
traduit: 你说了算。照那个老疯子说的，这试炼应该没这么简单。

original: Nonsense. A few Dwemer Spiders will pop out, we kill them, and the Treasure of Kagrumez will be ours!
traduit: 胡说八道。最多跳出来几只锻莫蜘蛛，干掉它们后，卡格鲁梅兹的财宝就是我们的了！

original: Maybe we should come back with more men. We don't know how many of those things will come out.
traduit: 也许我们该多带些人回来。谁知道这些玩意儿会跑出来多少。

original: Do you need help with your research?
traduit: 你的研究需要我帮忙吗？

original: I suppose that depends. Are you willing to be an experimental subject?
traduit: 看情况吧。你准备好当我的实验品了吗？

original: You've never heard of the great houses of Morrowind?
traduit: 你没听说过晨风的大家族吗？

original: House Telvanni is the house of the master wizard, one of the ruling houses of Morrowind.
traduit: 泰瓦尼家是个法师大族，也是晨风的统治家族之一。

original: Master Neloth is one of the oldest and most respected members of House Telvanni.
traduit: 内洛斯大师是泰瓦尼家族最德高望重的长者之一。

original: Well, at least if the other Nord returns, they'll take care of him.
traduit: 好吧，至少另一个诺德人要是回来了，也会被灰烬怪解决的。

original: Ha! Wait...
traduit: 哈！等等……

original: Did you hear that? Sounds like those Ash Spawn are back.
traduit: 听到了吗？好像灰烬怪又回来了。

original: Who cares? Nords all look the same to me.
traduit: 谁管他啊？我看诺德人都一个样儿。

original: Do you think he's the one we left in the tunnel?
traduit: 你觉得他就是我们丢在地道里的人吗？

original: Ha ha ha! No more! What a fool.
traduit: 哈哈哈！我快不行了！真是个傻子！

original: Listen to this one! "My nights have been impossible to bear without you."
traduit: 听听这个！“没有你，我无法忍受夜晚。”

original: "I beg of you: Please depart that blasted isle and return to Solitude at once!"
traduit: “我求你了，赶快离开那该死的小岛，赶快回独孤城来！”

original: Well, this is your lucky day. (Give formula)
traduit: 嗯，看来今天是你的幸运日。（交出配方）

original: Well, I'll be. That's the one.
traduit: 哦，的确啊。就是这个。

original: What happened to Esmond?
traduit: 埃斯蒙出什么事了？

original: His story is as old as Solstheim itself.
traduit: 他的故事和索瑟海姆一样古老。

original: He served the dragons before their fall from power, as most did. A priest in their order.
traduit: 和大多数人一样，在龙族失势之前他也服务它们。他曾是拜龙教的祭司。

original: But unlike most, he turned against them. He made his own path, and his actions cost him dearly.
traduit: 但与众不同的是，他转而与龙族为敌，选了一条自己的路，这个选择让他付出了沉重的代价。

original: The stories say he sought to claim Solstheim for himself, and the dragons destroyed him for it.
traduit: 传说中他谋划过夺取索瑟海姆，而龙族为此摧毁了他。

original: Tell me of your people, the Skaal.
traduit: 跟我说说你们斯卡尔人吧。

original: We have lived on Solstheim for many generations. Our people are tied to the land itself.
traduit: 我们在索瑟海姆上生活了很多代了。族人们和这方水土紧密相连。

original: We try to serve the All-Maker, to live in balance with nature, instead of exploiting it as others would.
traduit: 我们努力侍奉着造物主，与自然和谐相处，而不是像其他人那样压榨自然。

original: DLC2ExpSpiderQuesDetectFriendDie
traduit: DLC2ExpSpiderQuesDetectFriendDie

original: Bring that cube. We'll need it.
traduit: 把方典带上。我们还用得着。

original: Yes. You may have noticed he's trying to return to Solstheim.
traduit: 对。你应该注意到了，他正试着回归索瑟海姆。

original: Well, I knew something connected with Hermaeus Mora was spreading its influence across the island.
traduit: 嗯，我能感觉到与赫麦尤斯·莫拉有关的东西正在这岛上扩张影响力。

original: I wasn't sure that it was in fact the same entity as this legendary namesake of the central temple. Although the villagers seem quite convinced.
traduit: 但我不确定那个实体是否就是与岛中心那座神殿同名的传说人物。虽然那些村民们对此深信不疑。

original: That's right.
traduit: 没错。

original: Is this somehow connected to your search for Miraak?
traduit: 这跟你找米拉克那件事有关系吗？

original: What could you know of them?
traduit: 你对它们的了解如何？

original: I'd rather be stuck out here than floating in there.
traduit: 我宁可困在这儿，也不想在里面当漂尸。

original: And now we're stuck out here listening to it all day and night.
traduit: 我们现在被困在这儿夜以继日地听着。

original: I saw the Fadrin brothers bobbing around in there this morning, so that makes three.
traduit: 我看到法德林兄弟早上在这儿，所以有三个了。

original: How many is that today?
traduit: 今儿有几个？

original: My mother was Skaal, but she left the village and I was born in Skyrim.
traduit: 我母亲曾是个斯卡尔人，但她离开了村子，在天际生下了我。

original: Miraak is behind what's happening to your people.
traduit: 你族人的遭遇要归咎于米拉克。

original: How do you know this?
traduit: 你是怎么知道的？

original: I've seen Miraak.
traduit: 我看到米拉克了。

original: Really? How?
traduit: 真的吗？怎么看到的？

original: I know.
traduit: 我明白。

original: Herma-Mora forced you to serve him in order to defeat Miraak. Do not let him lure you further down that path.
traduit: 赫玛-莫拉迫使你为他服务，来击败米拉克。不要被他诱惑到歧路了。

original: The All-Maker made you Dragonborn for a higher purpose. Do not forget that.
traduit: 造物主让你成为龙裔是为了更崇高的目标，不要忘记这点。

original: Walk with the All-Maker, Skaal-friend.
traduit: 追随造物主吧，斯卡尔之友。

original: Hermaeus Mora wouldn't have helped me without Storn's sacrifice.
traduit: 没有斯托恩的牺牲，赫麦尤斯·莫拉就不会帮我了。

original: Yes, his "help" which did not require him to kill my father. Such is the way of Herma-Mora, the eternal enemy of the Skaal.
traduit: 是啊，他的“帮助”并没有规定要杀了我的父亲。这就是赫玛-莫拉的本性，斯卡尔人的宿敌。

original: I killed Miraak. But Hermaeus Mora is still out there.
traduit: 我杀了米拉克，但赫麦尤斯·莫拉依然存在。

original: It was Miraak who threatened Solstheim. With him gone, Herma-Mora has been foiled once again.
traduit: 威胁索瑟海姆的人是米拉克。少了他，赫玛-莫拉的诡计就再一次被挫败了。

original: Tell me, though... my father's death... was it necessary? Was there no other way to destroy Miraak?
traduit: 告诉我……我父亲的死……是必要的吗？要击败米拉克就没有别的方法了吗？

original: Hermaeus Mora killed Storn, remember. Not Miraak.
traduit: 记住，是赫麦尤斯·莫拉杀了斯托恩。不是米拉克。

original: I know. The Skaal will not forget this. Storn's death will become another of the many tales of Herma-Mora's treachery.
traduit: 我知道。斯卡尔人不会忘记这点。斯托恩的死将成为众多与赫玛-莫拉诡计相关的传说之一。

original: I couldn't have defeated Miraak without Storn's help.
traduit: 没有斯托恩的协助，我是无法打败米拉克的。

original: Then... it was the All-Maker's will, as he said. I know I should not doubt it. But it is good to hear, all the same. Thank you.
traduit: 那么……那就是造物主的旨意，和他说过的一样。我明白不该对此产生怀疑。但还是很高兴听到你这么说。谢谢你。

original: Storn didn't die for nothing. Miraak will never threaten Solstheim again.
traduit: 斯托恩的死没有白费。米拉克再也不能威胁索瑟海姆了。

original: Thank you. Whatever your other reasons for acting, you have done the Skaal a great service. We will not forget what you've done.
traduit: 谢谢你。无论你还出于什么原因，都帮了斯卡尔人一个大忙。我们永远不会忘记你的功绩。

original: It's over. Miraak is dead.
traduit: 结束了，米拉克死了。

original: Then my father's sacrifice... it was not in vain. He died to free us.
traduit: 那么我父亲的牺牲……并没有白费。他是为了解放我们而死。

original: Tell me... was it the only way? Did he need to die?
traduit: 告诉我……那是唯一的方法吗？他必须去死吗？

original: I know it is not my place, but... may I offer a word of advice... of warning?
traduit: 我知道没有这个资格，但是……我能给个建议……或者劝告吗？

original: I can feel it. The Tree Stone is free again. The Oneness of the land is restored.
traduit: 我感觉得到，树石重获自由了。这片土地的整体性恢复了。

original: Does that mean... is it over? Is Miraak defeated?
traduit: 这意味着……结束了吗？米拉克被击败了？

original: So you know where to find this Black Book? The one connected with Miraak?
traduit: 那么你知道上哪儿去找这本与米拉克有关的黑暗经书吗？

original: Yes, I do. I haven't been able to get it, though. But maybe together we can unlock the secrets the Dwemer left behind.
traduit: 是的。我一个人拿不到它，但也许我们两个合作就能解开锻莫留下的秘密。

original: Why won't the book you have here help me?
traduit: 为什么你这本书帮不了我？

original: Oh, it clearly is not associated with the same power that has overtaken the island.
traduit: 哦，因为它和控制了这座岛的力量一点关系都没有。

original: And I'm not talking about Hermaeus Mora. These Black Books are all his, of course.
traduit: 我说的不是赫麦尤斯·莫拉啊。当然。黑暗经书全是他的。

original: No, what you're looking for is a specific book. Presumably because Miraak's power derives from it.
traduit: 不，你要找的是其中特定的一本，大概是因为米拉克的力量源于此书。

original: You have a Black Book?
traduit: 你有一本黑暗经书？

original: Yes. I haven't been idle while this fascinating madness engulfed Solstheim.
traduit: 对啊。当索瑟海姆陷入这神奇的狂热时，我可没闲着。

original: But my book isn't what you're looking for. I'm quite sure it is unconnected with this Miraak.
traduit: 但我这本不是你要找的。我很确信它和米拉克一点关系都没有。

original: But I do know where to find a Black Book that can help you.
traduit: 不过我知道你要找的黑暗经书在哪儿。

original: Isn't Miraak your ally? Why help me defeat him?
traduit: 米拉克不是你的盟友吗？为什么要帮我打败他？

original: He has served me long and well. But he grows restless under my guidance.
traduit: 他尽心侍奉我很久了。但在我的指导下他逐渐变得焦躁不安。

original: His desire to return to your world will spread my influence more widely. But it will also set him free from my direct control.
traduit: 让他返回你们的世界的确会让我的影响变得更广，但也会让我失去对他的直接控制。

original: It may be time to replace him with a more loyal servant. One who still appreciates the gifts that I have to offer.
traduit: 看来是时候找个更忠诚的，懂得感恩我之赐予的人，来取代他了

original: It's been a while, outlander. Looking to unleash some havoc across Tamriel again?
traduit: 好久不见了，外地人。想在泰姆瑞尔大闹一番了吗？

original: Teldryn Sero, blade for hire. If you have the coin, I'm at your service.
traduit: 我叫泰卓因·赛罗，是个佣兵。只要你有钱，我就为你效劳。

original: The best swordsman in all Morrowind is at your service... for the right price.
traduit: 晨风最强的剑客，愿为你效劳……只要钱到位了。

original: Don't pass up on this opportunity, outlander. I'm worth every coin.
traduit: 别错过这次机会啊，外地人。一分钱一分货。

original: I've got swords, spells and a few other tricks up my sleeve. You'll find I'm full of surprises.
traduit: 我会剑术，法术还有些其他的把戏。你会发现我是个充满惊喜的人。

original: You ready to get going?
traduit: 你准备出发了吗？

original: What's our next move?
traduit: 我们下一步怎么办？

original: Very well. (0 gold)
traduit: 好吧。（0金币）

original: Looks like you've already have someone with you. If you want me to come along, you'll have to ask them to leave.
traduit: 看来你已经有同伴了。如果要我同行的话，你得先请他们离开。

original: I was enjoying our travels together before we parted company. I'd be happy to rejoin you for no charge... if you're interested.
traduit: 我还挺享受我们分道扬镳前的旅途。我很乐意免费加入你的队伍……如果你有兴趣的话。

original: Consider yourself hired. (<global=hirelinggold> gold)
traduit: 你被录用了。（<global=hirelinggold>金币）

original: Unless you have enough coin on you, I'm not going anywhere.
traduit: 除非你钱带够了，不然我哪儿也不去。

original: It looks like you already have someone with you. If you want me to join, you'll have to part ways with them first.
traduit: 看来你已经有同伴了。要我加入的话，你得先和他们分开。

original: Then let's be off!
traduit: 那我们出发吧！

original: You see that green light? That comes from the Wind Stone, where my people work against their will.
traduit: 看见那道绿光了吗？是从风石来的，我的族人们被迫在那里做苦工。

original: They must be freed soon.
traduit: 我们得尽快解救他们。

original: The village is just ahead. Storn has used his magic to raise a barrier around it, protecting the few of us left.
traduit: 村子就在前面了。斯托恩用魔法构筑了一道屏障，护住了村里仅剩的几个人。

original: That the barrier is still there is a good sign.
traduit: 还好屏障还在。

original: Soon they will finish building my temple, and I can return home.
traduit: 他们很快会建完我的神殿，那时我就能回去了。

original: Find them!
traduit: 找到他们！

original: Nooo....
Aggghhh...
traduit: 啊啊……

original: Hhuurrrkh...
You should have known better.
traduit: 你没有自知之明吗。

original: That was foolish of you.
traduit: 你这样太蠢了。

original: No more!
traduit: 停下！

original: Please, stop!
traduit: 求求你，快停下！

original: Knew I'd find you!
traduit: 就知道会找到你！

original: Now we finish this!
traduit: 现在来做个了断！

original: Yes, run and hide!
traduit: 对啊，跑去躲着啊！

original: Spineless coward!
traduit: 没骨气的懦夫！

original: You are without courage!
traduit: 你就是个没种的！

original: Now we end this!
traduit: 现在就了结了吧！

original: Yes? Hello?
traduit: 喂？有人吗？

original: What was...?
traduit: 那是啥？

original: How long do you think you can hide?
traduit: 你觉得躲得了多久？

original: There is no honor in this.
traduit: 这可不是什么高尚的事儿。

original: All-Maker, guide my eyes and ears.
traduit: 造物主，请指引我的耳目。

original: Come now, there is no need to hide.
traduit: 出来啊，没必要躲着。

original: Is there anything else?
traduit: 还有什么吗？

original: Now all that's left are these Black Books, waiting for another ambitious fool to be lured into Hermaeus Mora's clutches.
traduit: 现在剩下的就是这些黑暗经书了，等着下一个有野心的笨蛋落入赫麦尤斯·莫拉的魔爪。

original: Speaking of which... I think I've located another book, if you're interested. Here, let me show you.
traduit: 说到这个……我想起来又找到了另一本书，你有兴趣吗？这里，我指给你看。

original: Now all that's left are these Black Books. It's a shame I haven't located any more. So much more to be learned.
traduit: 现在剩下的就是这些黑暗经书了。很遗憾我再也没找到其他的了。还有很多可以学的。

original: You don't seem very grateful.
traduit: 你看起来不太感激啊。

original: I don't recall asking you to kill Miraak. That was your own project.
traduit: 我可没叫你去杀了米拉克。那是你自己的任务。

original: And I'm not even mentioning the fact that now we'll never know what would have happened when Miraak returned.
traduit: 我甚至都没提到那个已经永远不得而知的情况，要是米拉克真的回归了会怎样。

original: Although... from all indications he could have proved a serious nuisance. So, yes, I am grateful that you dealt with him.
traduit: 但是……据种种线索来看，他可能会是个严重的麻烦。那么，好吧，我感激你除掉了他。

original: You don't need to worry about me.
traduit: 你不需要担心我。

original: I wasn't worried. Just interested. I don't get to observe first-hand many people who've spoken to Hermaeus Mora.
traduit: 我不担心，只是好奇。我很少有机会直接观察与赫麦尤斯·莫拉交流过的人。

original: No, nothing interesting. I just killed Miraak and saved Solstheim.
traduit: 没有，没什么特别的。我不过就是杀了米拉克，拯救了索瑟海姆罢了。

original: Well, that is what you hero types do, isn't it? I wasn't expecting anything less.
traduit: 嗯，那不正是你们这种英雄的活儿吗？都在我意料之中。

original: Don't you want to know what happened with Miraak?
traduit: 你不想知道米拉克的下场吗？

original: Who? Oh him. Well, I assume you killed him. Or Hermaeus Mora turned on him when you looked like the winning bet. Or a bit of both.
traduit: 谁？哦他啊。嗯，我猜被你杀了吧。或者当你胜券在握时，赫麦尤斯·莫拉背刺了他。不然就是两者皆有。

original: Miraak's influence has vanished from Solstheim. So I assumed you had handled things. Why, did something interesting happen?
traduit: 米拉克的影响已经从索瑟海姆消失了，想必是你处理的吧。发生了什么有趣的事情？

original: What are you looking for?
traduit: 你在看什么？

original: Incipient madness. Loss of self-awareness. Black spots in the whites of the eyes.
traduit: 精神初步失常，自我意识流失。眼白上出现黑斑。

original: Any of the documented indications of Hermaeus Mora's permanent influence.
traduit: 这些都是文献记载中，赫麦尤斯·莫拉带来的永久性影响。

original: Hmm, no, you look fine. Well, at least no different than when I first saw you.
traduit: 嗯，没有，你看上去没事。至少跟我初次看到的你没两样。

original: Hold still. Let me get a good look at you.
traduit: 别动，让我好好看看你。

original: I don't need your advice.
traduit: 我不需要你的建议。

original: I understand. Walk with the All-Maker, Dragonborn.
traduit: 我明白。愿你追随造物主之道，龙裔。

original: Sure, what is it?
traduit: 当然了，什么事？

original: As shaman of the Skaal, I am charged with the spiritual well-being of my people.
traduit: 作为斯卡尔萨满，我要守护族人们的心灵。

original: While you are not of the Skaal, you are Skaal-friend, and so I give you this warning.
traduit: 虽然你不是斯卡尔人，但也是斯卡尔之友，所以我还是要劝告你一二。

original: One more thing, Dragonborn, if you will.
traduit: 还有件事，龙裔，容我多说一句。

original: One more thing, Skaal-friend, if you will.
traduit: 还有件事，斯卡尔之友，容我多说一句。

original: What do you have in mind?
traduit: 你在想什么？

original: You're the boss.
traduit: 你说了算。

original: Did you still want me to help you or not?
traduit: 还要我的帮助吗？

original: If it'll help us get moving quicker, sure.
traduit: 要是可以让我们脚步快些，没问题啊。

original: About time. Let's go.
traduit: 该是时候了，出发吧。

original: You're going ahead without me? Suit yourself...
traduit: 你想一个人先走？随便你吧……

original: Oh fine, go on... leave me here. When you decide to return to your senses, you know where to find me.
traduit: 哦好吧，你走啊……把我丢在这儿。等你恢复理智了，再来找我吧。

original: You better not be gone long.
traduit: 最好别走的太远。

original: Make it quick, I don't like this waiting game.
traduit: 快点儿。我不喜欢这种耐性训练。

original: So this is the fabled College of Winterhold. Amazing.
traduit: 看来这就是传说中的冬堡学院了，太神奇了。

original: I hope we don't bump into any Forsworn around here. I heard they're as wild as a pack of beasts.
traduit: 希望我们不会在这儿遇到弃誓者。听说他们和野兽没什么两样。

original: The Pale reminds me of the northern part of Solstheim... rife with freezing cold weather and full of unfriendly creatures.
traduit: 苍原让我想到了索瑟海姆的北部……天气寒冷且到处都是有敌意的生物。

original: I can't believe how carelessly the dead are buried here. I can't imagine my body just rotting away like that.
traduit: 不敢相信死者就这样敷衍地埋在这儿了，我的尸体要是那样腐烂下去简直不敢想。

original: Whiterun... the pride of Skyrim. Doesn't look like much to me. Now Blacklight on the other hand, that's a proper city.
traduit: 白漫城……天际的骄傲。在我看来不太像啊。不过另一方面，说明黑光城才是大城市。

original: I lived in the Gray Quarter of Windhelm for years... it's a wretched place full of bitter Dunmer. Let's be done here quickly.
traduit: 我在风舵城的灰民区住过一段时间……那里有很多愤恨不平的丹莫，是个可悲之地。我们完事儿了就赶紧走吧。

original: Can you imagine what Markarth must have looked like when the dwarves were living here? I can't even begin to imagine.
traduit: 你能想象矮人们还在时的马卡斯是什么样吗？我是想不出来。

original: Solitude... home to the East Empire Company, the heartless bastards.
traduit: 独孤城……东帝国公司的老巢，那些心狠手辣的混蛋。

original: So this is Riften. Glover Mallory told me a good deal about the place. It looks exactly as I'd pictured.
traduit: 原来这就是裂谷城。葛洛文·马洛里跟我说过这儿的很多事情。和我想象的一模一样。

original: You may want to be careful down here... the Thieves Guild makes the Ratway it's home.
traduit: 你在这下面最好小心点儿……盗贼公会的大本营就在鼠道里。

original: Dawnstar is full of struggling miners. Sounds a lot like a certain town in Solstheim, eh?
traduit: 晨星城满是些在生死线上挣扎的矿工。听上去就像索瑟海姆的某个镇子，是吧？

original: Ugh, what a wretched place. Who would build a town in the middle of a swamp?
traduit: 啊，这地方太糟糕了。谁会把镇子建在沼泽中央啊？

original: Riverwood looks peaceful. If I had to settle in Skyrim, this might be the place I'd choose.
traduit: 河木镇看起来很安宁。如果我要在天际安家，可能会选在这儿。

original: Vampires are wretched beings. Feeding off of others the way they do... it's disgusting.
traduit: 吸血鬼都该死。他们以别人的血液为生……太恶心了。

original: Warlocks practice all sorts of foul sorcery. We should proceed with caution.
traduit: 这些术士啥邪术都会。我们推进时务必小心。

original: Careful, it looks like something's lived here recently.
traduit: 注意，这儿最近好像有什么生物住过。

original: Damn bandits are worse than the vermin that infest the ash wastes back home.
traduit: 该死的强盗简直比老家那些灰烬里肆虐的害虫还可恶。

original: Dragons, eh? Good, I was looking for a challenge.
traduit: 龙，是吧？很好，我正在找些挑战呢。

original: There are restless dead about... I suggest we proceed with caution.
traduit: 附近有未安息的亡灵……我建议谨慎行事。

original: Despite the foul beings that infest this place, I'm certain we'll find plenty of wealth to make it worth our time.
traduit: 尽管这地方被些恶心玩意儿污染了，我很确定能找到大笔财富，绝不会浪费我们的时间。

original: The dwarves were a clever race. I wonder what happened to them?
traduit: 矮人以前是个很聪明的种族。我好奇他们到底遇到了什么事？

original: To think the Falmer are loosely related to the Dunmer sends shivers down my spine.
traduit: 想到伐莫是丹莫的远亲真让我全身发毛。

original: Not much of a farm. How do they expect to grow anything in this ash-free soil?
traduit: 这农场真不像样。他们怎么在无灰土里种出作物来？

original: The Forsworn are little more than beasts. They won't listen to reason, so prepare for the worst.
traduit: 弃誓者不过是野兽罢了。他们蛮不讲理，所以做好最坏的打算吧。

original: Ugh, the stench. We must be nearing a giant's home.
traduit: 呃啊，这股臭味。我们肯定离巨人的窝不远了。

original: Becoming a hagraven requires a sacrifice to their foul deity. Show them no mercy before we become one of the victims.
traduit: 成为乌鸦鬼婆需要向他们的邪神献祭。面对他们不要手软，不然我们就成牺牲品了。

original: I never fancied becoming a miner... didn't want to spend the rest of my days cracking rocks.
traduit: 我从没想过当个矿工……我不想把一辈子花在敲打石头上。

original: I was briefly in the employ of an orc warrior once. I had to quit because he refused to bathe. Disgusting.
traduit: 我曾有小段时间给一个兽人战士干活。因为他不洗澡，我就辞职了。真恶心。

original: Nice place you have here. I never knew you were so wealthy.
traduit: 你这边还不赖嘛，我都没想到你这么有钱。

original: I wonder how many souls were lost when this ship met its fate.
traduit: 不知道这艘船沉的时候有多少冤魂丧生了。

original: Spriggan are loathsome creatures. They summon some of the most benign beings of the forest and bend them to their will.
traduit: 木灵真是令人生恶，它们会召唤森林中最温顺的动物，让它们屈服于自己的意志。

original: What would possess someone to give their allegiance to Hircine, only to see their free will taken from them like this?
traduit: 是什么让一个人效忠海尔辛，只为了看着自由意志像这样被剥夺？

original: Anytime you want to head for Skyrim, I'm right with you. I've spent enough time on Solstheim to last a lifetime.
traduit: 等你想回天际了，我也陪你。我在索瑟海姆都快过一辈子了。

original: Hope we don't run into too many ash spawn out here.
traduit: 但愿我们在这儿别碰上太多灰烬怪。

original: I'm not sure why House Redoran is so insistent on maintaining Solstheim. Seems like more trouble than it's worth.
traduit: 我不确定为什么瑞多然家这么坚持要控制索瑟海姆，这里的麻烦看来比利益要大。

original: With the ash from Red Mountain covering half the island, it's astonishing how much Solstheim reminds me of home.
traduit: 红山的火山灰都盖住半个岛了，真没想到索瑟海姆让我想起了故乡。

original: How can the Skaal stand it up here? It's freezing!
traduit: 斯卡尔人怎么能忍受这个地方？冷死了！

original: The Telvanni are amazing. Look what they've grown from the ash... have you ever seen anything like it?
traduit: 泰瓦尼很神奇，看看他们从灰烬里种出了什么……你见过这种东西吗？

original: I've called Raven Rock my home for a number of years. Azura knows why... it's a mess.
traduit: 我已经把鸦石镇当自己的家很多年了，天晓得为什么……太糟了。

original: Seems like things are looking up in Raven Rock now that the mine's open. It's a nice change.
traduit: 看来矿场开张后事态有所好转，是个不错的转变。

original: I'm glad that I'm finally traveling with someone who seems competent. My last patron was killed trying to tackle an entire fort of bandits alone.
traduit: 很高兴终于能和一个过得去的人旅行，上个雇主死于坚持要单挑一整座堡垒的强盗。

original: I grew up in the city of Blacklight in Morrowind. If you ever get the chance, you should visit there... it's spectacular.
traduit: 我在晨风的黑光城长大，你要是有机会该去看看……非常壮观。

original: I don't know why I decided to make my way to Solstheim to seek my fortune. I should have stayed home.
traduit: 不知道为什么我要来索瑟海姆讨生活，真该待在家里。

original: You like my chitin armor? It was specially crafted for me by Grendis Rolovo... one of the finest master armorsmiths in Morrowind.
traduit: 你喜欢我的甲壳护甲吗？是格兰蒂斯·若洛夫专门帮我打造的……他是晨风最好的护甲锻造师之一。

original: All this walking... I wish there was a silt strider around here.
traduit: 走了这么久……真希望这附近有泥沙漫步者。

original: I wonder what became of Saint Jiub? I met him once, you know.
traduit: 我想知道圣鸠步怎么样了？我见过他一面，知道吧。

original: Our journey's been quite rewarding so far. Hopefully you won't mind sharing the spoils.
traduit: 这趟旅途收获颇丰，希望你不介意分享一些战利品。

original: Waaaaaah!
traduit: 哇！

original: Buuuuraaaa!
traduit: 布拉！

original: Wuuuuuupaaaaa!
traduit: 呜啪！

original: Gaaaaah!
traduit: 嘎啊！

original: Waaaaaaah!
traduit: 哇啊！

original: Baaaa roooka!
traduit: 吧 茹卡！

original: Foo may wa!
traduit: 弗 梅 哇！

original: Araaaaaa!
traduit: 阿拉！

original: Peeeee fa!
traduit: 呸 法！

original: Araloo! Araloo!
traduit: 阿拉鲁！阿拉鲁！

original: Raaa fay.
traduit: 啦 非。

original: Mella kalee.
traduit: 梅拉卡里。

original: Kaaarooo.
traduit: 咔如。

original: Meeelaaak.
traduit: 梅拉克。

original: Faa thoo.
traduit: 法苏。

original: Bek.
traduit: 贝克。

original: Dool.
traduit: 都儿。

original: Keeel faa.
traduit: 科一 法。

original: Hoola wakasee.
traduit: 呼啦 哇卡塞。

original: Foora paka.
traduit: 弗拉 帕卡。

original: Kooova mook.
traduit: 库哇 目克。

original: Alakasee.
traduit: 阿拉卡瑟。

original: Eerelaya.
traduit: 伊尔啦呀。

original: Feeerako.
traduit: 菲啦口。

original: Ah baa faroo!
traduit: 啊 吧 法噜！

original: Koolawasa!
traduit: 库拉瓦萨！

original: Boo tha!
traduit: 布它！

original: Kalafoo!
traduit: 卡啦弗！

original: Moooong cha!
traduit: 梦查！

original: Boool eekasa!
traduit: 布尔 一卡萨！

original: Agaroo?
traduit: 啊嘎噜？

original: Boo cha.
traduit: 布查

original: Awafalagahuka.
traduit: 阿瓦法啦嘎护卡。

original: Waayaruu?
traduit: 哇呀路？

original: Poo ma. Pooooo ma.
traduit: 噗 嘛。噗呜 嘛。

original: Kalaree?
traduit: 卡拉嘞？

original: Huuuwa.
traduit: 呼哇。

original: Muuuu fa.
traduit: 目法。

original: Eeeeloo.
traduit: 伊噜。

original: I've got some juniper berries. (Give berries.)
traduit: 我这里有些刺柏浆果。（交出果子）

original: Oh, perfect. Just the right ripeness, too. Good work, friend.
traduit: 哦，太好了。熟度也恰到好处。干得好，朋友。

original: How is the mead?
traduit: 蜜酒怎么样？

original: We lost most of the batches we had brewing when... before those things were here.
traduit: 大部分快酿好的酒都被糟蹋了……都怪那些家伙。

original: One is just ready to take its turn, though, and it's about time to add some of the flavorings.
traduit: 但有一桶快好了，是时候加些调料了。

original: You can't find them on Solstheim, but if you find yourself back in Skyrim, I wouldn't mind you bringing some juniper berries.
traduit: 调料在索瑟海姆岛上找不到，但可以回天际去找找。希望你能帮我带些刺柏浆果回来。

original: They add a different kind of sweetness. Tart. Makes the flavor more round.
traduit: 它们能添加一种不一样的甜酸味，让口感变得更润。

original: I found some Ashfire Mead. (Give mead.)
traduit: 我拿到了些灰焰蜜酒。（交出蜜酒）

original: Oh, that's the stuff all right. You're a good friend to Thirsk, and to me. I thank you.
traduit: 哦，就是这个。你是瑟斯科还有我的好朋友。谢了。

original: Is there anything that would make being down here more bearable?
traduit: 有什么能让你在这下面的日子更好过吗？

original: Well, the easy answer, of course. Mead!
traduit: 嗯，很简单，当然是蜜酒了！

original: Actually, now that I think of it, I have been missing the Ashfire. It's a special brew that we make at Thirsk.
traduit: 其实，说到这个，我真的很怀念灰焰蜜酒。那是我们以前在瑟斯科酿的特殊口味。

original: If you could... somehow... get up there and grab a bottle, I'd be a long way towards forgetting how miserable it is down here.
traduit: 如果你能……不管怎样……上去拿一瓶下来，我很快就会忘记这下面有多惨。

original: I've got a lot of Riekling spears. I hope it's enough. (Give spears.)
traduit: 我这里有很多瑞克灵的长矛。希望够数了。（交出长矛）

original: Oh, I'm sure it will be. Give them here, and I'll get to work soon!
traduit: 哦，肯定够了。放这儿吧，我要开工了！

original: How is the hunting going?
traduit: 狩猎如何了？

original: To tell you the truth, I've been a little distracted. I've got this... idea.
traduit: 说实话，我有点烦了。我想到了一个……主意。

original: I want to make a reminder. So we never forget what happened the last time we got soft.
traduit: 我想做个提示物，这样我们就永远不会忘记上次变软弱后发生了什么。

original: I want to ring the whole hall with their little spears. Mocking us, from the past. Making us work harder. Fight better.
traduit: 我要用它们那些小长矛来警醒整个大厅。用过往来嘲讽我们。使我们干活更努力，战斗更拼命。

original: The only problem is, I'm going to need a lot of spears. A lot. So, if you could find a bunch of them for me, that would make it easier on me.
traduit: 唯一的问题是，我需要很多根长矛，非常多。所以，你要是能帮我找来一大堆，我就省了很多麻烦。

original: I've brought the materials you wanted. (Give stalhrim and ebony.)
traduit: 我把你要的原料带来了。（交出魔冰和黑檀）

original: Just in time, too. Kuvar was starting to give me some grief about his new armor. This will do the trick nicely.
traduit: 正是时候。库瓦尔才跟我抱怨他的新护甲呢。这样就没问题了。

original: You come back if you ever want some fancier armor yourself, now.
traduit: 如果你想要更漂亮的护甲，随时来找我。

original: Are you getting back to work?
traduit: 你要回去干活了吗？

original: Cleaning out the forge was the easy part. But those blasted rieklings made off with most of my materials.
traduit: 清理锻炉是最容易的部分，但是那些该死的瑞克灵把我大多数的材料都顺走了。

original: And I can't forge air.
traduit: 我也没法锻造空气。

original: You tend to wander around, don't you? If you come across any stalhrim or ebony in your travels, bring them back to old Halbarn. Help each other out.
traduit: 你正要去周围转转，是吧？要是你在旅途中遇到了魔冰或者黑檀，就把他们带给老哈尔巴恩。就当是助人为乐吧。

original: I don't care how much you're paying me, there's no way I'm doing that.
traduit: 不管你开价多少，我都不会这么干。

original: That's not going to happen.
traduit: 那是不可能的。

original: Right away.
traduit: 马上。

original: What did you need?
traduit: 你需要什么？

original: Raven Rock is purely a Dunmer settlement?
traduit: 鸦石镇是个纯丹莫聚落吗？

original: Raven Rock started out as an Imperial settlement, but the Empire decided to abandon it just as my people were first setting foot here.
traduit: 鸦石镇一开始是个帝国人聚落，但我的族人刚来到这里，就赶上帝国决定把这里遗弃。

original: They left the town a shambles... but when House Redoran took over, we turned it around and it became ours.
traduit: 他们遗留的镇子简直是废墟……瑞多然家接管后，几经修缮才把这里变成我们的。

original: And even if it's been a struggle to make this island livable, we're proud to call it home.
traduit: 尽管在岛上讨生活很难，我们仍然可以骄傲地把这里称为“家园”。

original: My thoughts are always with my people.
traduit: 我总是挂念着族人们。

original: Even now, the All-Maker watches over us.
traduit: 即使现在，造物主也看着我们。

original: Where shall we journey next?
traduit: 我们接下来去哪儿？

original: No matter where the road takes us, my thoughts are of home.
traduit: 不管路通往何方，我的心总是向着家。

original: Is it good to see more of the world, for wisdom is the child of experience.
traduit: 多看看这个世界也好，毕竟智慧来源于经验。

original: Your fearlessness never ceases to impress me.
traduit: 你的无畏令我惊叹。

original: You face danger without hesitation.
traduit: 面对危险，你毫不犹豫。

original: For a shaman, you fight pretty well. Who trained you?
traduit: 就萨满而言，你的战斗技巧不错。谁教你的？

original: It was Skaf the Giant, our former chieftan, who taught me the ways of battle.
traduit: 是“巨人”斯卡夫，我们的上任首领，他教导我战斗的方式。

original: He was a great bear of a man, and a fearsome warrior. I used to be terrified of him when I was a little girl.
traduit: 他是个巨熊般的男人，一个令人心生恐惧的战士。小时候我很怕他。

original: I was a restless and angry child, and Skaf taught me swordplay so that I could, as he used to say, "put that fire to good use."
traduit: 我小时候很好动，脾气也大，所以斯卡夫就教我剑术，他说这是“物尽其用”。

original: He was a great man and a good leader. I miss him dearly.
traduit: 他是个很好的人，也是个好首领。我很想他。

original: Sooner or later, death comes for us all.
traduit: 无论早晚，人固有一死。

original: We Skaal do not fear death. We know we will return to the All-Maker and be born anew.
traduit: 斯卡尔人不惧死亡。我们知道我们会回归造物主的怀抱然后重获新生。

original: Life never truly ends. Death is just a passage from one form to the next.
traduit: 生命永远不会真正的结束。死亡只是从一段到另一段的过程。

original: Then why stay here? Why not live somewhere safer?
traduit: 那为什么留在这儿？为什么不住在安全些的地方？

original: We are bound to this land, like a great pine with roots that run as deep as the tree is tall.
traduit: 我们和这片土地紧密相连，就像一颗巨松那样根深蒂固。

original: I know it must seem strange to you, but for us, the thought of leaving our village is equally strange.
traduit: 我知道你会觉得有些奇怪，但是对我们来说，离开村子的念头也很奇怪。

original: The land and the Skaal are one. There is no other way to say it.
traduit: 斯卡尔与这片土地一体同心。再没有更贴切的形容了。

original: Where is your mother?
traduit: 你母亲呢？

original: She died when I was very young.
traduit: 她在我很小时去世了。

original: She was caught in a terrible snowstorm while returning home from gathering firewood.
traduit: 在拾柴火回来的路上，她被一场可怕的暴风雪吞噬了。

original: You must understand that, for the Skaal, life is a constant hardship. We take nothing for granted. We cannot afford to.
traduit: 你得理解这点，对斯卡尔人来说，生命中充满挑战。我们从不、也没资格认为世上有什么是理所当然的。

original: Between the wolves, the weather and the threats in the south, even a simple task like gathering wood for the fire can turn deadly in an instant.
traduit: 除了狼群、天气还有南边儿来的威胁，就算拾柴这样的小事也可能致命。

original: That could still happen, couldn't it?
traduit: 还是有可能的，对吧？

original: Hah! Not if Fanari has anything to say about it.
traduit: 哈！法娜丽可不这么想。

original: When it comes to being chieftain, she is like a wolf with her jaws clamped tight upon a fresh kill.
traduit: 谈到首领的位子时，她就像匹紧咬着猎物不放的狼。

original: But that's alright. The Skaal need a shaman and I know that is my place.
traduit: 但是没关系。斯卡尔人需要一个萨满，我知道这是我的职责。

original: But what? What is it?
traduit: 但是？什么但是？

original: It is not right that I should say this, because I must honor my father's wishes, but this is a path I never chose.
traduit: 如果按我父亲的遗愿，我不该说这种话。但我真的不想选这条路。

original: I always thought that I would be a great hunter, or even the village chieftain.
traduit: 我一直认为我会是个好猎人，甚至成为村子首领。

original: Are you sure you're ready to be Shaman of the Skaal?
traduit: 你准备好担任斯卡尔村的萨满了吗？

original: I have been preparing for it all my life. There is no question that I'm ready, but...
traduit: 我已经为这天准备了一辈子。当然准备好了，但是……

original: Have you destroyed the Ash Guardian yet? Master Neloth will kill me... or worse... if he finds out!
traduit: 你摧毁灰烬守护者了吗？内洛斯大师会杀了我……或者更糟糕……要是让他知道了！

original: Is it done? Is the Ash Guardian gone?
traduit: 搞定了吗？干掉灰烬守护者了？

original: Have you dealt with the Ash Guardian?
traduit: 你处理完灰烬守护者了吗？

original: I've got it. Don't cast Ash Guardian without a heart stone.
traduit: 我知道了，没有心石就不要召唤灰烬守护者。

original: That's right. Don't be like me and have to learn the hard way. Here's the spell tome, and a heart stone so you can try it safely.
traduit: 没错。别像我这样学教训。这本法术书给你，还有一颗心石，这样你可以放心试一试。

original: What's a heart stone?
traduit: 心石是什么？

original: Heart stones are only found on Solstheim, as far as I know.
traduit: 据我所知，只有索瑟海姆岛上才有心石。

original: Master Neloth believes they may be fragments from inside Red Mountain that were flung here during the huge eruption two hundred years ago.
traduit: 内洛斯大师认为心石可能是两百年前，红山喷发时，从火山内部抛到这里的碎块。

original: I'll just take the staff.
traduit: 我拿法杖就行了。

original: That's definitely safer. I'm not sure I'll risk summoning an Ash Guardian again myself. Too easy to forget about the heart stone!
traduit: 那确实更安全。我不确定还会不会冒风险召唤灰烬守护者了。一不小心就会把心石忘了！

original: I'd like to learn the Ash Guardian spell.
traduit: 我想学习召唤灰烬守护者的法术。

original: All right. But remember, don't cast this without a heart stone! Otherwise the guardian will attack everyone, including you.
traduit: 好吧。但是记住，不要在没有心石的时候召唤！否则灰烬守护者会攻击任何人，包括你。

original: They attacked us. Those bastards at Frossel. Stole our treasure - wait! Forget I said that. That's my treasure. You can't have it!
traduit: 他们袭击了我们。佛塞尔的那群混蛋，偷走了我们的财宝。等等，当我没说，财宝属于我，不是你的！

original: I can't believe it...
traduit: 我不信……

original: Must go back and get it.
traduit: 必须回去拿回来。

original: Everyone dead! Everyone but me...
traduit: 都死完了！除我以外的所有人……

original: All that treasure!
traduit: 所有的宝物！

original: Lost...
traduit: 都没了……

original: Just remember, Raven Rock is sovereign territory of House Redoran. This is Morrowind, not Skyrim. While you're here you will be expected to abide by our laws.
traduit: 记住了，鸦石镇是瑞多然家的主权领土。这里是晨风，不是天际。在这里必须遵从我们的法律。

original: Any questions?
traduit: 还有问题吗？

original: None of your business.
traduit: 不关你的事。

original: That's the kind of attitude that's going to land you in prison, but I'll let it go for now.
traduit: 这种态度迟早会让你进监狱，这次我就放过你了。

original: Just looking for work.
traduit: 只是来找工作的。

original: You've picked one of the worst places in Morrowind to do that, but suit yourself.
traduit: 你选了全晨风最差的地方来找工作，只能说人各有志了。

original: I'm looking for Miraak. Do you know him?
traduit: 我在找米拉克。你认识他吗？

original: Miraak... I... I'm not sure that I do.
traduit: 米拉克……我……我不确定。

original: Until?
traduit: 直到？

original: Until we ended up tracking him to one of the largest bandit encampments I'd ever seen.
traduit: 直到我们追踪到了一个强盗营地，是我这辈子见过的最大之一。

original: My patron took one look at me, and made the most menacing grin I'd ever seen.
traduit: 我的雇主看了我一眼，脸上露出最凶狠的狞笑。

original: At that moment, I knew I'd never see him again. No amount of money would ever be worth that kind of death.
traduit: 那会儿我就知道再也见不到他了。给再多的钱也不值得那样送死。

original: Why did you work for him then?
traduit: 那你为什么要给他干活儿？

original: Simple... he paid well. Very well.
traduit: 很简单……他开价很高，非常之高。

original: Anyway, we'd just cleared a ruined fort somewhere outside of Whiterun and when we got outside, we saw one of them galloping away on horseback.
traduit: 总之，我们刚清理完白漫城外的一个废弃堡垒。出来时看见其中一个人骑马飞奔而去。

original: Well, my boss wasn't about to let him get away, so we pursued... on foot, for three days.
traduit: 我老板不打算放过他，所以我们就追上去了……徒步追了整整三天。

original: How did you end up on Solstheim?
traduit: 你怎么流落到索瑟海姆来了？

original: Long story, but I don't see the harm in sharing it with you.
traduit: 说来话长，不过分享给你也没什么坏处。

original: My last patron was a true Nord. He was dressed in animal skins, had tattoos on his face...  a real traditional type, if you know what I mean.
traduit: 我的上一个雇主是个真正的诺德人。身披兽皮，脸上刺青……非常的传统，这么说你应该懂吧。

original: He had an insatiable bloodlust and was extremely stubborn... one of the toughest employers I've ever had.
traduit: 他嗜血成性，而且顽固到了极点……是我遇到的最难相处的雇主之一。

original: Is that so? Well, you'll never get that treasure now!
traduit: 是吗？好啊，你们永远也别想得到财宝了！

original: Boss said to bring you back or bring back your corpse.
traduit: 老大说要么带活人，要么带尸体回去。

original: I'm not chasing that map. It's a fool's errand. I'm done.  Leave me alone.
traduit: 我不会去找那张地图。傻子才去找。我不干了，离我远点。

original: We've got work to do.
traduit: 我们还有活儿要干。

original: I told him "no" once already.
traduit: 我已经跟他说过“不”了。

original: Boss says you're to come back with me.
traduit: 老大要你跟我回去。

original: Come on. Let's go.
traduit: 来吧，走了。

original: Time to go.
traduit: 该走了。

original: The time comes soon when...
traduit: 时机将至……

original: What happened to the mine?
traduit: 那个矿怎么了？

original: It used to be one of the richest ebony mines in Morrowind, but it dried out years ago.
traduit: 那以前是晨风最富有的黑檀矿，但几年前被挖空了。

original: Now, we're barely holding on out here. Without the mine, Raven Rock doesn't feel like it can last much longer.
traduit: 现在我们只是在苦苦撑着，少了矿脉，鸦石镇应该撑不了多久了。

original: You cannot flee me, Dragonborn.
traduit: 你逃不掉的，龙裔。

original: I can call you back to my tower as often as I like.
traduit: 我随时可以把你传回我的塔。

original: Your death will not be that painless.
traduit: 你别想死的那么痛快。

original: Did you truly think to be rid of me so easily?
traduit: 你真以为打败我那么容易吗？

original: Your Thu'um is weak, Dragonborn.
traduit: 你的吐'目很弱，龙裔。

original: You cannot hope to defeat me here.
traduit: 在这里打败我想都别想。

original: Well, now... a fellow beast-blood. Well met, friend. Not many of our kind still hunt these lands.
traduit: 嗯……你也流着野兽之血。欢迎你，朋友。在这片土地上狩猎的同胞们不多了。

original: Remember Majni's pack, at Frostmoon Crag. Now, I must be off. The blood calls.
traduit: 记住马吉尼狼群，在霜月险崖。那么，我得走了。鲜血在召唤我。

original: I do not think that is wise.
traduit: 我不认为那是明智之举。

original: You should leave those books alone.
traduit: 你不该碰那些书。

original: Remember what happened to Storn.
traduit: 记住斯托恩的下场。

original: Do not let Herma-Mora tempt you further.
traduit: 别再受赫玛-莫拉的诱惑了。

original: Not again.
traduit: 没有下次了。

original: Are you sure this is a good idea?
traduit: 你真觉得这样做好吗？

original: I wish you would stop doing that.
traduit: 希望你别再那么做。

original: You won't catch me doing that.
traduit: 你不会发现我那么干的。

original: I'm never going to get used to that.
traduit: 我忍不了这种事情。

original: Ugh, not again.
traduit: 呃，别再这么做。

original: I can't believe you do that on purpose.
traduit: 我不相信你是故意的。

original: That isn't right.
traduit: 这是不被允许的。

original: That can't be good for you.
traduit: 这对你没好处。

original: That book! Look out!
traduit: 那本书！小心！

original: What in the...
traduit: 搞什么……

original: Hmm. Your eyes appear to be completely back to normal. Interesting.
traduit: 嗯，你的眼睛看上去完全恢复正常了，有意思。

original: Fight or die well.
traduit: 要么奋力一搏，要么壮烈赴死。

original: Beware the tentacles!
traduit: 小心那些触手！

original: No fear, hunters! Only strength!
traduit: 别怕，猎人们！干就完了！

original: Strike hard and fast!
traduit: 出手要快而狠！

original: Luck? Luck will play no part today. We will earn our victory or return to the All-Maker.
traduit: 好运？好运今天派不上用场。我们要么取胜，要么回归造物主。

original: Sounds fun. I'll join your hunt.
traduit: 听起来很有趣。我要加入狩猎。

original: Well met, friend. May we all fight or die well.
traduit: 欢迎，朋友。希望我们打得精彩，死得壮烈。

original: Think you'll win the fight?
traduit: 你觉得你们打得赢吗？

original: A warrior expects nothing, and therefore is ready for anything.
traduit: 身为战士，心无旁念，才能直面一切。

original: If our aim and our hearts are true, the All-Maker will grant us strength.
traduit: 只要我们心志纯粹、目标坚定，造物主就会赐我们力量。

original: If not, today is as good a day to die as any other.
traduit: 不然，今天死或者以后死也没什么区别。

original: Either way, they will sing songs of our bravery around the campfires for many years.
traduit: 无论如何，人们会在以后很多年里，围着营火歌颂我们的勇气。

original: A Netch?
traduit: 一头气母？

original: The giant air-floaters from the dark elf lands. Only the brave dare to hunt them, only the strong survive them.
traduit: 这是暗精灵土地上的巨型浮空生物。只有勇士才敢猎杀他们，只有强者才能活下来。

original: Come. Test yourself against the beast with us. We all will share in the glory of the hunt!
traduit: 来吧。和我们一起检验你的实力。我们将一同分享狩猎的荣耀！

original: We have come south to test our worth against the mighty Netch. Will you join us?
traduit: 我们来南边是为了打败强大的气母以证明自己的实力的。你要加入我们吗？

original: The mighty beast will fall and we will rise.
traduit: 那强大的野兽将陨落，而我们会崛起。

original: We will test ourselves. May the All-Maker not find us wanting.
traduit: 我们要试试自己的实力。愿造物主不要对我们不满。

original: They will sing stories of this day.
traduit: 他们会歌颂今天的故事。

original: We will honor and sing praises for the fallen.
traduit: 我们会尊敬死者，并为他们歌颂。

original: The beast was not the only one to fall this day. May the All-Maker welcome our brethren with open arms.
traduit: 今天死的不止这头野兽。愿造物主张开双手欢迎我们的弟兄们。

original: Our victory will bring meat and bones to our people and glory to our families.
traduit: 我们的胜利会给族人带来肉和骨头，给家族带来荣耀。

original: The beast was strong, but we were stronger.
traduit: 这野兽很强大，但我们更强。

original: It was a good hunt.
traduit: 狩猎很成功。

original: That doesn't bother you? Hmm.
traduit: 对你没作用？嗯……

original: Say hello to Hermaeus Mora for me.
traduit: 代我向赫麦尤斯·莫拉问好。

original: Ah, yes, the lure of the Black Book.
traduit: 啊，对的，黑暗经书的诱惑。

original: Can I dig for ebony in Raven Rock Mine?
traduit: 我能在鸦石镇矿场挖黑檀矿吗？

original: Of course!
traduit: 当然了！

original: In fact, Councilor Morvayn has given you the full run of the place. Help yourself to whatever you like.
traduit: 实际上，莫尔凡议员授权你随意出入这里。你想挖多少就挖多少。

original: We're all in agreement that you're entitled to as much as you can carry.
traduit: 挖到背不动才好，我们都不介意。

original: It's good to get back to mining after all these years.
traduit: 过了这么些年，能回来采矿真好啊。

original: This mine's amazing! Have you ever seen so much ebony in your life?
traduit: 这个矿太惊人了！你这辈子看到过那么多黑檀矿吗？

original: I've been out of the business so long, I almost forgot how to swing a pickaxe.
traduit: 我不干这行太久了，都快忘记怎么挥舞鹤嘴锄了。

original: Good to know that the mine's safe again. I heard a lot of strange things happened here.
traduit: 很高兴知道矿井里又安全了。听说这儿发生了很多怪事。

original: Getting your hands dirty, outlander?
traduit: 来挖矿的，外地人？

original: Help yourself to as much ore as you like... you've earned it.
traduit: 你想挖多少都随便……这是你应得的。

original: I haven't set foot in these mines for ages. It's strange being back after so long.
traduit: 我好久没踏进矿场了。过了这么久回来还真奇怪。

original: There's nothing quite like the sound of metal striking rock.
traduit: 没什么比金属敲打岩石的声音更悦耳的了。

original: Nice to be making some coin again.
traduit: 又能赚钱的感觉真不赖。

original: Thanks to House Redoran getting these mines reopened, I can provide for my family again.
traduit: 感谢瑞多然家让矿场重开了，我又能养家糊口了。

original: Welcome to Raven Rock Mine, outlander.
traduit: 欢迎来到鸦石镇矿场，外地人。

original: I'll be back.
traduit: 我会回来的。

original: Whatever you want. The answer isn't going to be any different later though.
traduit: 随你的便，我的答复是不会变的。

original: People are trying to kill me. I'm not taking no for an answer. (Intimidate)
traduit: 有人想杀了我，你拒绝可没用。（恐吓）

original: Hold on, now. I'm just a simple sailor. I never wanted to get mixed up in any of this. Alright, I'll take you. But we leave immediately.
traduit: 等等，好吧，我就是个船夫，不想卷入这一切。我答应带你去，我们得立刻出发。

original: Yeah, well, and I don't want them trying to kill me. So the answer is still no.
traduit: 嗯，是啊，我也不想被他们给宰了。所以我还是得拒绝你。

original: You owe me. Those cultists you brought here tried to kill me. (Persuade)
traduit: 这是你欠我的，你带来的那些教徒们想杀了我。（说服）

original: Alright, you have a point. Taking you back to find out who sent them is the least I can do.
traduit: 好吧，你说的有道理，我有义务带你去查清楚是谁派来的。

original: Besides, maybe you can put a stop to whatever's going on over there. I owe them a bit of payback myself.
traduit: 除此之外，你或许能解决那边发生的怪事儿。毕竟我还欠他们人情。

original: Look, I'm sorry about your troubles, but I've got to look out for myself. I'm not going to risk it.
traduit: 听着，对于你遇到的事儿我很抱歉，但我必须得考虑自己，我不想冒这个险。

original: I'll pay you double your usual rate. (Give <Global=DLC2CostToSailx2> gold)
traduit: 我给你开双倍的价钱。（付<Global=DLC2CostToSailx2>金币）

original: Well... a man's got to make a living, after all. Fine. We'll cast off immediately.
traduit: 嗯……人总要吃饭的嘛。好吧，我们立刻起航。

original: That's a tempting offer... when you actually have the gold, I might be willing to consider it.
traduit: 这个提议很不错……等你有这笔钱了，我也许会改变主意。

original: There's been something strange happening on Solstheim for a while, but this... this is something else. I hope you get to the bottom of it.
traduit: 索瑟海姆这阵儿本来就常发生一些怪事，但这次……这事儿可不一样，我希望你能查个水落石出。

original: Yes, you are. You're taking me to Solstheim.
traduit: 你得回去，你得带我回索瑟海姆去。

original: Have you been listening to me? I'm not going back there.
traduit: 你没听我说的吗？我没想过回去了。

original: How can you not know how you got here? You sailed here, right?
traduit: 你怎么不知道自己怎么来的？你把船开过来的，对吗？

original: I was attacked by some cultists who came here on your ship.
traduit: 我被你船上来的几个教徒袭击了。

original: Now hold on! That wasn't my fault... I didn't know they were going to attack anybody. I don't even know how I got here.
traduit: 听我说！那不是我的错……我完全不知道他们要袭击某人，我连自己怎么来的都不清楚。

original: What happened? Why won't you go back?
traduit: 发生什么事了？你为什么不回去了？

original: Solstheim? Where's that?
traduit: 索瑟海姆？在哪儿啊？

original: But I'm not going back there. There's something wrong about that place.
traduit: 但我不打算回去了，那地方有些古怪。

original: Are you the captain of the Northern Maiden?
traduit: 你是北方少女号的船长吗？

original: Sure. Yeah. That's me. Why? Who sent you?
traduit: 对啊，就是我。咋了，谁派你来的？

original: I think this belongs to you. (Give Glover's Letter)
traduit: 这应该是你的。（给葛洛文的信）

original: I... I can't believe it. All those years on the farm, and my mother never told me about any of this.
traduit: 我……不敢相信。在农场上的那些年里，我妈从来没告诉我这些。

original: Words can't even begin to describe how much I appreciate you bringing this to me.
traduit: 多亏你把它带来，我也不知道该怎么表达感谢。

original: Here, take this. I used to carry it for good luck, but I think you deserve it more than I do.
traduit: 给，拿着这个吧。以前我都随身带着以求好运，现在你比我更需要这个了。

original: You think someone is out to get you?
traduit: 你觉得有人暗算你吗？

original: I don't know. But I mean to find out.
traduit: 我不知道。但我会查出来的。

original: I still have some research to do before I'll know anything for certain.
traduit: 我还要调查一番才能确定。

original: What can you tell me about Morrowind?
traduit: 能跟我说说晨风么？

original: Red Mountain dominates the island. Every now and then ash and debris from an eruption land on our shores.
traduit: 红山俯瞰着这个岛。时不时会有火山灰和岩石被喷出来坠落到我们的海岸上。

original: You are too young to remember the Nerevarine. He defeated Dagoth Ur and saved us all from the blight.
traduit: 你太年轻，可能不知道尼瑞瓦因。他打败了达格斯·乌尔，把我们从枯萎病中拯救出来。

original: When the city of Vivec was destroyed, it took decades for us to rebuild.
traduit: 维威克城被摧毁后，我们花了几十年来重建。

original: We are still but a shadow of our glorious past, but some day we will rise again.
traduit: 比起过去的辉煌，我们现在不过是阴影，但终有复兴的一日。

original: The ignorant think it is only a place of ash and lava.
traduit: 无知者觉得那儿只有灰烬和岩浆。

original: It had rolling green plains and swamps and verdant hills too.
traduit: 过去那里有起伏的绿色平原、沼泽和青翠的山丘。

original: There is the big island of Vvardenfell, and the coastal mainland.
traduit: 晨风主要由瓦登费尔这座大岛，和沿岸的内陆组成。

original: House Telvanni has it's properties on Vvardenfell. I've never been to the mainland myself.
traduit: 泰瓦尼家族的势力范围在瓦登费尔。我自己则从未去过内陆。

original: It is the only place where silt striders can be found.
traduit: 泥沙漫步者是当地特有生物。

original: Although I managed to transplant a few here when I arrived.
traduit: 我来这儿后试着引进过几只。

original: It's the homeland of the dunmer. The lesser races call us dark elves.
traduit: 那里是丹莫家乡。那些低等种族称我们为暗精灵。

original: We built great works there, like Vivec and Ald'ruhn. Many of them are destroyed now, either by Red Mountain or the argonian invasion.
traduit: 我们在那里建造了几座大城市，比如维威克城和奥德'鲁恩。现在大多被摧毁了，要么是红山，要么是阿尔贡入侵。

original: Where is Master Neloth?
traduit: 内洛斯大师在哪儿？

original: He's off doing research in Raven Rock. I think.
traduit: 我猜，他是去鸦石镇做调查了。

original: He told me all about it, but I can't seem to recall the details right now.
traduit: 他跟我说过，但细节记不清了。

original: So this is Raven Rock, eh? Not all that much to look at.
traduit: 那么，这儿就是鸦石镇，对吧？看起来没什么大不了的。

original: I've heard tales of the mushroom towers of Morrowind. Never thought I'd see one.
traduit: 我以前听说过晨风的蘑菇塔，但从没想过能亲眼看见。

original: Someone's been busy.
traduit: 看来某人一直很忙啊。

original: Hmm. Reminds me of the standing stones back home.
traduit: 嗯。这让我想起了故乡的立石。

original: There's something... wrong here.
traduit: 这儿有些……不对劲。

original: I'd like passage back to Skyrim.
traduit: 我想买张去天际的票。

original: Can't say I'd mind heading out of here. I still need to get paid, of course.
traduit: 我也想离开这儿，但你当然也得付钱。

original: If you ever need aid, seek out Majni's pack, up at Frostmoon Crag. They've long welcomed outsiders.
traduit: 你要是需要帮助，就去马吉尼的狼群，就在霜月险崖上面。他们总是欢迎外来的。

original: Now... my prey awaits. Good hunting to you.
traduit: 现在……猎物还等着我呢，祝你捕猎愉快。

original: You can't be serious.
traduit: 你一定是开玩笑。

original: Did she ever return here?
traduit: 她回来过吗？

original: Sadly, no. She died in Falkreath, where I was born.
traduit: 很遗憾，没有。她死在佛克瑞斯了，我出生的地方。

original: Have the dragons made life more difficult for the Skaal?
traduit: 龙的出现有让斯卡尔人的生活恶化吗？

original: Well, the dragons are a constant danger, but so far they have taken little interest in our village. Thank the All-Maker for that!
traduit: 嗯，龙是个长久的危险因素。但是目前为止它们对我们村子还不感兴趣。感谢造物主！

original: But have they forced us to change the way we live our lives? No, not at all.
traduit: 不过要说我们有因为龙而被迫改变生活方式吗？不，完全没有。

original: They are but one more hardship added to the many we already endure.
traduit: 它们不过是我们经受了的苦难中新添的一个罢了。

original: She lives. Seek her in Highpoint Tower.
traduit: 她还活着，去制高塔楼找到她。

original: I suppose you're right. At least here I'm safe from Mogrul.
traduit: 你说得对，至少我在这里不用担心莫古尔。

original: You complain too much.
traduit: 你抱怨的太多了。

original: Tel Mithryn is the safest place in Solstheim. Only a fool would challenge Master Neloth.
traduit: 泰尔·米斯瑞恩是索瑟海姆岛上最安全的地方。

original: Do you ever get lonely out here in the middle of nowhere?
traduit: 你在这人烟稀少的地方不会寂寞吗？

original: Thank you. I didn't mean to be so defensive.
traduit: 谢谢你，我不该这么敏感。

original: I know Varona was your friend. It's okay to miss her.
traduit: 我知道瓦罗纳是你朋友，想她很正常。

original: It's not your fault, Drovas. You do other things well.
traduit: 这不是你的错，多瓦斯。你其他的事情做得很好。

original: Varona was never able to do the repair work that you do.
traduit: 瓦罗纳可没你那么会修东西。

original: I can't help it if I have a black thumb. It's like the mushrooms hate me.
traduit: 手指弄脏我也没办法，就像蘑菇恨我一样。

original: I miss Varona. She used to help me with the gardening.
traduit: 我想瓦罗纳了，她过去常帮我管理花园。

original: Master Neloth is the most powerful wizard of House Telvanni. Maybe the most powerful in all of Morrowind.
traduit: 内洛斯大师是泰瓦尼家最强大的法师，可能还是全晨风最强的。

original: Someday I will inherit all of this. It's worth a little pain.
traduit: 我总有一天会继承这一切，受点苦是值得的。

original: I don't understand why you let him do these things to you.
traduit: 我不明白为什么你让他这么对待你。

original: They're back to regular size. It didn't hurt nearly as much this time.
traduit: 已经恢复到正常大小了。这次没那么痛。

original: How are your ears, Talvas?
traduit: 你耳朵怎么样了，塔瓦斯？

original: I know, I know.
traduit: 我懂，我懂。

original: So, unearthly screams, don't come up. Got it.
traduit: 那么，听到诡异的尖叫，就别上去。懂了。

original: You better get used to this, Drovas. This isn't that unusual for Tel Mithryn.
traduit: 最好习惯这点，多瓦斯。这在泰尔·米斯瑞恩是很正常的。

original: Unearthly screams?
traduit: 不寻常的尖叫？

original: What have I gotten myself into.
traduit: 我真是给自己找麻烦。

original: Master Neloth is preparing to... well, it's better if you don't know.
traduit: 内洛斯大师正准备要……你还是别知道好了。

original: However, if you hear unearthly screams, I would advise you to not come up.
traduit: 总之，要是你听到什么不寻常的尖叫，我建议你别上来。

original: Ah! The wood is for the staffs. Put them away when you get a chance. But don't get in my way.
traduit: 啊！那些木材是用来做法杖的。你有空就收走，但别妨碍到我。

original: Mostly books. There were a couple of soul gems, some ingredients for Elynea, and some strange wood.
traduit: 大多是书。有一些灵魂石，艾琳娜要的材料，还有些奇怪的木材。

original: What did they bring? Books? Soul gems?
traduit: 他们带来些什么？书？灵魂石？

original: Master Neloth, the silt strider traders just dropped off some supplies.
traduit: 内洛斯大师，那些泥沙漫步者商队刚卸下一批物资。

original: Yes, yes. Canis root tea. And don't let Ulves water it down.
traduit: 对，对。犬根茶。还有别让乌尔维斯加太多水。

original: I'll go fetch some, Master Neloth. Canis root, right?
traduit: 我马上去泡，内洛斯大师。犬根茶，对吧？

original: Drovas, where's my tea?
traduit: 多瓦斯，我的茶呢？

original: Who are you? What are you doing here?
traduit: 你是谁，在这儿做什么？

original: It's true that I normally prefer to stay home and conduct my research in peace. Everything's so much more convenient there.
traduit: 我确实更喜欢待在家里安安静静地搞自己的研究。那里方便得很。

original: But, given that something seems to be taking control of the minds of all the inhabitants, I thought it worth investigating.
traduit: 但是这里似乎有什么东西在控制居民们的心智，值得调查一番。

original: What are you doing here?
traduit: 你在这里做什么？

original: Where did you live before you were here?
traduit: 你们来这儿之前住在哪里？

original: Tribe-kin live all places. All of world within great water.
traduit: 部落血亲到处住。全世界在大海里。

original: Why did you take over Thirsk?
traduit: 你们为什么要占领瑟斯科？

original: Hot fire. Cold dizzydrink. Happy tribe.
traduit: 热乎乎的火，凉冰冰的酒，高高兴兴的部落。

original: I suppose Master Neloth won't mind. He's always telling me to get out of his way.
traduit: 内洛斯大师应该不介意吧。他总是要我别碍着他。

original: Once I've got Stalhrim, how do I forge it into something useful?
traduit: 我取得魔冰后，怎么把它熔炼成有用的东西？

original: With skill and patience. It's very much like working ebony.
traduit: 要有技巧和耐心。就跟处理黑檀一样。

original: Yes... I'd say if you know how to forge ebony, then you know everything you need to know in order to forge Stalhrim.
traduit: 没错……如果你知道怎么熔炼黑檀，那你就知道怎么熔炼魔冰了。

original: Where can I obtain Stalhrim?
traduit: 我在哪儿可以挖到魔冰？

original: You can find some in Raven Rock Mine, as well as that new source of Stalhrim on the map you recovered from the elves.
traduit: 鸦石镇矿场能挖到一些，另外，从精灵手里拿回来的地图上也有新的魔冰矿源。

original: Just be sure to bring an ancient Nord pickaxe with you. It's the only pickaxe that can mine the Stalhrim properly without breaking it.
traduit: 记得带上一把古诺德鹤嘴锄就是了。只有它才能开采魔冰。

original: Tell me about forging Stalhlrim.
traduit: 告诉我怎么熔炼魔冰。

original: Well, first you'll need to obtain some Stalhrim, of course, and then you'll need to work it.
traduit: 好吧，首先你当然得弄来一些魔冰，然后接着就开始加工。

original: At Haknir's Shoal, a band of pirates uncovered an ancient treasure chest containing a single piece of Stalhrim armor. How did they know to dig in this remote spot?
traduit: 在海科尼尔的浅滩上，一群海盗挖出了一个装有一件魔冰护甲的远古宝箱。但他们怎么知道要跑到这么偏僻的地方来挖宝？

original: A band of pirates followed an ancient treasure map to Haknir's Shoal, where they discovered a chest at the location marked on the map. By following the map, perhaps I can find the rest of the treasure they sought.
traduit: 一群海盗参照一张古代藏宝图来到了海科尼尔的浅滩。他们在地图上标记之处发现了一个宝箱。照这张地图的指示，或许我能找齐他们在追寻的其他宝物。

original: A band of pirates followed an ancient treasure map to Haknir's Shoal, where they found a chest containing a piece of the armor of Haknir Death-Brand, the legendary pirate king. By following their map, perhaps I can find the rest of the treasure they sought.
traduit: 一群海盗参照一张古代藏宝图来到了海科尼尔的浅滩。他们在地图上标记之处发现了一个宝箱，其中装有一件传奇海盗之王，“死印”海科尼尔的护甲。照这张地图的指示，或许我能找齐他们在追寻的其他宝物。

original: By following an ancient treasure map, I found the armor of Haknir Death-Brand, the legendary pirate king. In addition to his armor, one chest also contained the key to Gyldenhul Barrow. Could it be connected to Haknir's treasure?
traduit: 照着一张古代藏宝图的指引，我找到了传奇海盗之王“死印”海科尼尔的护甲。除此之外，宝箱里还有一把打开吉尔登胡尔古坟的钥匙。这会与海科尼尔的宝藏有关吗？

original: By following an ancient treasure map, I found the armor of Haknir Death-Brand, the legendary pirate king. A key contained in one of the chests led me to Gyldenhul Barrow, where I found a room filled with Haknir's cursed gold. But touching it triggered the curse: the doors behind me have sealed.
traduit: 照着一张古代藏宝图的指引，我找到了传奇海盗之王“死印”海科尼尔的护甲。其中一个宝箱里有打开吉尔登胡尔古坟的钥匙，我在那里发现了一个房间，装满了海科尼尔那些受过诅咒的黄金，当我触碰时引发了诅咒：身后的门封死了。

original: By following an ancient treasure map, I found the armor of Haknir Death-Brand, the legendary pirate king. A key contained in one of the chests led me to Gyldenhul Barrow, where I found his tomb and one of his cursed swords. But when I touched the sword, his ghost appeared and attacked.
traduit: 照着一张古代藏宝图的指引，我找到了传奇海盗之王“死印”海科尼尔的护甲。其中一个宝箱里有打开吉尔登胡尔古坟的钥匙，我在那里发现了他的坟墓，还有一把受过诅咒的剑。当我触碰那把剑时，他的鬼魂现身并袭击了我。

original: By following an ancient treasure map, I found the armor of Haknir Death-Brand, the legendary pirate king. A key contained in one of the chests led me to Gyldenhul Barrow, where I defeated Haknir's ghost and claimed his swords and gold as well.
traduit: 照着一张古代藏宝图的指引，我找到了传奇海盗之王“死印”海科尼尔的护甲。其中一个宝箱里有打开吉尔登胡尔古坟的钥匙，我在那里击败了海科尼尔的鬼魂，并且夺走了他的剑和金币。
