original: I met Tharstan, a historian living in the Skaal village who discovered the recently-unearthed entrance to an old crypt. He offered to hire me as protection while we explored the crypt, and asked me to meet him there if I was interested.
traduit: 我邂逅了沙尔斯坦，他是一位住在斯卡尔村的历史学家。他发现了一个最近出土的古墓入口，提出雇用我保护他探索墓穴。并告诉我要是有兴趣，就去那里找他。

original: I arrived at the old tomb to find Tharstan waiting for me. He was eager to start exploring the place, and he asked me to lead the way. First, I need to figure out how to open the doors in the main chamber. Once that's done, we can explore the tunnels beyond.
traduit: 我到达古墓时发现沙尔斯坦正等着我，他很渴望探索这个地方，并叫我带路。首先，我得找出打开主厅大门的方法。等搞定后，我们就能探索外围隧道了。

original: I met Tharstan, a Nord from the Skaal village who discovered an old Draugr crypt. I agreed to accompany him in exploring the old crypt. After we discovered a pair of Word Walls, as well as two pieces of an ancient claw, we gained entry into a sealed chamber. Tharstan's translations suggest that we'll find a Dragon Priest's sarcophagus nearby.
traduit: 我邂逅了沙尔斯坦，一个来自斯卡尔村的诺德人，他发现了一座尸鬼古墓。我同意陪他探索古墓。在找到一对龙语墙后，我们得到了一个古老龙爪的两半碎片，进入了一个封闭的墓室。沙尔斯坦的译文表明我们会在附近找到一位龙祭司的石棺。

original: I met Tharstan, a Nord from the Skaal village who discovered an old Draugr crypt. I agreed to accompany him in exploring the old crypt. Inside, we found the tomb of a Dragon Priest left behind long ago to guard against a traitor from his own order.
traduit: 我邂逅了沙尔斯坦，一个来自斯卡尔村的诺德人，他发现了一座尸鬼古墓。我同意陪他探索古墓，并在其中发现了一座被长久遗弃的龙祭司墓穴，其目的是看守教团中的背叛者。

original: I met a historian named Tharstan in Skaal village and he hired me to help him explore an old tomb he'd discovered. It turned out to the tomb of a Dragon Priest named Vahlok, who I fought and defeated.
traduit: 我邂逅了沙尔斯坦，他是一位住在斯卡尔村的历史学家。他招募我去帮忙探索一座发现的古墓。结果这座古墓属于一位叫瓦洛克的龙祭司，我们发现并击败了他。

original: Neloth is being attacked by an unknown assailant. He gave me a ring that will identify the source of the attacks. If I walk around the grounds of Tel Mithryn, I might find a clue.

original: Neloth is being attacked by an unknown assailant. He gave me a ring that identified the source of the attacks as a heart stone hidden in the grave of Ildari Sarothril.
traduit: 内洛斯遭受了不明身份的袭击。他给了我一枚能识别袭击来源的戒指，我用它发现了藏在伊达利·萨罗希里墓中的一颗心石。

original: Neloth is being attacked by an unknown assailant. I discovered the source of the attacks was a heart stone hidden in Ildari Sarothril's grave. Neloth has divined that his former apprentice is still alive and seeking vengeance on him. Neloth asked me to track down and kill Ildari.
traduit: 内洛斯遭受了不明身份的袭击。他给了我一枚能识别袭击来源的戒指，我用它发现了藏在伊达利·萨罗希里墓中的一颗心石。内洛斯探测到他从前的徒弟还活着，并且在向他复仇，就让我去追踪并杀死伊达利。

original: Neloth's former apprentice, Ildari Sarothril, was covertly attacking him. Deep under Highpoint Tower I confronted Ildari and killed her.
traduit: 内洛斯从前的徒弟伊达利·萨罗希里在暗中袭击他。我与伊达利在制高塔楼的地底深处对峙并杀了她。

original: I've stumbled across Crescius Caerellius inside of Raven Rock Mine. He's convinced that the mines of Raven Rock contain a secret important enough for him to risk his own life to discover. He appears to have more to tell, so I should listen to what he has to say if I want to learn more.
traduit: 我在鸦石镇矿场里偶然遇见了克雷修斯·凯利乌斯。他确信矿井里有个值得他冒生命危险去揭开的秘密。看来他还有很多事情没说，如果我想了解更多最好听听。

original: I've stumbled across Crescius Caerellius inside of Raven Rock Mine. He's convinced that the remains of his great-grandfather, Gratian Caerellius, are at the bottom of the mine and that the East Empire Company has falsely designated his ancestor's death as an accident. He's tasked me with exploring the mine on his behalf to locate the remains, and perhaps discovering what killed Gratian Caerellius.
traduit: 我在鸦石镇矿场里偶然遇见了克雷修斯·凯利乌斯。他确信他曾祖父格瑞希安·凯利乌斯的遗体就在矿井底部，而东帝国公司将他祖先的死伪造成一场意外事故。他请我代他去探索矿井，找到祖先的遗骨，如果可能的话，找出格瑞希安·凯利乌斯的死因。

original: I've located the skeletal remains of Gratian Caerellius. In his satchel, I've discovered an old journal. In order to return it to Crescius, I'll have to discover a way to escape Bloodskal Barrow.
traduit: 我找到了格瑞希安的尸骨。他的背包里有一本古老的日记。为了把日记还给克雷修斯，我必须找到逃离血颅古坟的办法。

original: After locating the remains of Gratian Caerellius, recovering his journal and escaping Bloodskal Barrow, I should bring the evidence of my discovery to Crescius Caerellius.
traduit: 在找到格瑞希安·凯利乌斯的尸骨、拿到他的日记然后逃出血颅古坟后，我应该把发现的证物交给克雷修斯·凯利乌斯。

original: I've located Gratian Caerellius's remains and uncovered the truth regarding his untimely death deep inside Bloodskal Barrow.
traduit: 我在血颅古坟深处找到了格瑞希安·凯利乌斯的尸骨，揭开了他英年早逝的真相。

original: Captain Veleth told me that Adril Arano, Second Councilor of Raven Rock,  wanted to speak to me immediately. I should find him and discover the reason for his urgent message.
traduit: 维黎斯队长告诉我，鸦石镇副议员阿德尔·阿拉诺想尽快和我谈话。我该去找他问问急着找我的原因。

original: Adril Arano has requested my help with what he believes is an imminent threat on Councilor Morvayn's life. He believes members of the Ulen family are present on the island and seek revenge upon Morvayn for executing their ancestor. He's requested that I investigate the identity of any possible assassins, hoping to catch them unaware. For now, I've refused his request, but I should return to Adril when I'm ready to assist him.
traduit: 阿德尔·阿拉诺请我帮忙解决莫尔凡议员遭受的生命威胁。他认为乌伦家的某些成员就在岛上，是为报莫尔凡议员处决其先祖之仇而来。他请我调查刺客的身份，想要不走漏风声地抓捕他们。我暂时拒绝了他的请求，等我准备好帮他时会回来找他的。

original: Adril Arano has requested my help with what he believes is an imminent threat on Councilor Morvayn's life. He believes members of the Ulen family are present on the island and seek revenge upon Morvayn for executing their ancestor. He's requested that I investigate the identity of any possible assassins, hoping to catch them unaware. Adril suggests that I start by speaking to Geldis Sadri, the innkeeper at the Retching Netch Cornerclub. He's hoping that Geldis, who has quite the reputation as a gossip, might have some useful leads.
traduit: 阿德尔·阿拉诺请我帮忙解决莫尔凡议员遭受的生命威胁。他认为乌伦家的某些成员就在岛上，是为报莫尔凡议员处决其先祖之仇而来。他请我调查刺客的身份，想要不走漏风声地抓捕他们。他建议我先去和呕吐气母街角吧老板吉迪斯·萨德利交流一下。他希望以八卦闻名的吉迪斯能派上用场。

original: Geldis Sadri has pointed out that someone is leaving ash yam offerings in the Ulen Ancestral Tomb even though no Ulens live on Solstheim. He suggests that I stake the tomb out at night and discover the identity of the mystery visitor. Hopefully this person is either the assassin himself or can lead me to the assassin threatening Councilor Morvayn's life.
traduit: 吉迪斯·萨德利指出，尽管索瑟海姆岛上没有乌伦家的住户，还是有人给乌伦祖坟送灰烬薯。他建议我在夜间监视祖坟，找出这神秘访客的身份。希望此人要么能带我找到威胁莫尔凡议员生命的刺客，要么就是刺客本人。

original: I discovered Tilisu Severin visiting the Ulen Ancestral Tomb at night. This seems suspicious, as she doesn't belong to the Ulen family by name. I should bring this piece of evidence to Adril Arano immediately.
traduit: 我发现了蒂莉苏·瑟佛林在晚上拜访了乌伦祖坟。这看来很可疑，因为在姓氏上她不属于乌伦家。我该马上把这份证据告知阿德尔·阿拉诺。

original: I've informed Adril Arano that Tilisu Severin was the mystery vistor leaving offerings in the Ulen Ancestral Tomb. Since this is not enough evidence to accuse her of a crime, he's sending me to Severin Manor in order to uncover solid evidence that exposes Tilisu as an assassin.
traduit: 我已经告知阿德尔·阿拉诺，蒂莉苏·瑟佛林就是给乌伦祖坟上贡的神秘访客。虽然这不足以起诉她有罪，阿德尔还是派我去瑟佛林宅邸，去找蒂莉苏就是刺客的铁证。

original: I've recovered evidence from Severin Manor that exposes the true nature of the Severin family. The letters indicate that Vendil Severin is actually Vendil Ulen and that his supposed wife Tilisu and his daughter Mirri are members of House Hlaalu, one of the Great Houses that opposes Morvayn's House Redoran. All three of them are working in conjuction with unknown forces in a place called "Ashfallow Citadel," to assassinate Councilor Morvayn. I need to bring this urgent revelation to Adril Arano immediately.
traduit: 我在瑟佛林宅邸发现了他们的真面目。信上说文迪尔·瑟佛林实际上就是文迪尔·乌伦，他所谓的妻子蒂莉苏，女儿米莉也都是哈拉鲁家的成员，而哈拉鲁家与莫尔凡的瑞多然家敌对。他们三人都和在“烬休堡垒”的地方的一支神秘武装力量有联系，企图暗杀莫尔凡议员。我得马上把这个紧急消息告诉阿德尔·阿拉诺。

original: Adril Arano has sent me to Ashfallow Citadel to destroy Vendil Ulen and whatever forces he's amassed there. I'm supposed to meet two Redoran Guard outside the ruins who will assist me in this regard.
traduit: 阿德尔·阿拉诺派我去烬休堡垒消灭文迪尔·乌伦还有他在那里聚集的武装力量。我应该和两个瑞多然卫兵在废墟外碰头，他们会在这次行动中帮助我。

original: Adril Arano has sent me to Ashfallow Citadel to destroy Vendil Ulen and whatever forces he's amassed there. I've found the two Redoran Guard I was supposed to meet there dead. I'll have to carry the fight into the ruins alone.
traduit: 阿德尔·阿拉诺派我去烬休堡垒消灭文迪尔·乌伦还有他在那里聚集的武装力量。我发现原本该和我在那儿碰头的两个瑞多然卫兵死了。我只能自己一人迎接废墟里的战斗了。

original: I've killed Vendil Ulen and stopped the threat against Councilor Morvayn. Vendil had hired assassins from Morrowind known as the Morag Tong to help him with his coup, but fortunately I was able to defeat them in the depths of Ashfallow Citadel. I should return to Adril Arano with the good news.
traduit: 我杀了文迪尔·乌伦，解决了莫尔凡议员的生命威胁。文迪尔从晨风的莫拉格堂招募了一批刺客来帮他发动政变，但不幸的是被我在烬休堡垒深处全部击败。我该带着这个好消息回去找阿德尔·阿拉诺。

original: With the Vendil Ulen dead and the Morag Tong eliminated, I've ended the threat to Councilor Morvayn. In appreciation for my actions, I've been awared Severin Manor and all of the contents within and deemed an honorary citizen of Raven Rock.
traduit: 随着文迪尔·乌伦身死和莫拉格堂的覆灭，我终结了莫尔凡议员的威胁。为表彰我的行动，我被赐予瑟佛林宅邸还有其中的一切财物，并被视为鸦石镇荣誉公民。

traduit: 死者的进军

original: I've stumbled across a dark elf in combat for his life with strange, ashen beings at the Attius Farm outside of Raven Rock. He appears outnumbered, and he's requested I lend him a helping hand.
traduit: 我在鸦石镇外的阿提乌斯农场遇到了一个暗精灵，他正为人身安全和一群奇怪的灰烬生物作战。看来他寡不敌众，并请求我出手帮助他。

original: I've stumbled across Captain Modyn Veleth fighting strange beings called "ash spawn" at the Attius Farm outside of Raven Rock. Captain Veleth was outnumbered, so I engaged his attackers and lent him a helping hand.
traduit: 我鸦石镇外的阿提乌斯农场遇到了莫迪恩·维黎斯队长，他正和一群名为“灰烬怪”的奇怪生物战斗。维黎斯队长寡不敌众，所以我帮了他一把，与他的敌人们交战。

original: Captain Veleth explained that the ash spawn have been attacking Raven Rock for some time now, and he's been trying to locate their source. His lack of manpower and reluctance to leave the town without a commander are keeping him from finding out more. As a result of our conversation, I've agreed to help him deal with this situation. I need to begin by searching the Attius Farm for clues that might lead me to the ash spawn's source.
traduit: 维黎斯队长告诉我，灰烬怪袭击鸦石镇已经有一段时间了，而他在努力找到其来源。因为人手不足，还有不放心离开镇子后指挥空缺，他没法进一步调查。谈话之后，我同意帮他突破这个困境。我应该先从阿提乌斯农场开始，看看是否能找到指向灰烬怪来源的线索。

original: While assisting Captain Veleth at the Attius Farm, I've discovered a strange note. I should give this note to Captain Veleth in order to learn more about the origins of the ash spawn threat to Raven Rock.
traduit: 我在阿提乌斯农场帮助维黎斯队长时，找到了一个奇怪字条。我应该把它带给维黎斯队长，了解更多关于鸦石镇的灰烬怪威胁来源的信息。

original: Captain Veleth was alarmed by the strange note I recovered from the ash spawn at the Attius Farm. The note mentions Fort Frostmoth, the ruins of an Imperial fort located southeast of Raven Rock. According to him, the fort's been abandoned ever since the eruption of Red Mountain. He's sent me to Fort Frostmoth to kill the author of the note, General Falx Carius, before the town falls prey to his threats.
traduit: 维黎斯队长对我在灰烬怪身上找到的字条感到很惊恐。字条上提到了霜蛾堡，它位于鸦石镇东南方，是一座废弃的帝国堡垒。据他所说，这座堡垒自红山爆发以来就弃用了。他派我去霜蛾堡击杀字条的落款人，法克斯·卡里乌斯将军，以免鸦石镇为他所害。

original: I've slain General Falx Carius in the ruins of Fort Frostmoth and put an end to any further ash spawn attacking Raven Rock. I should return to Captain Modyn Veleth and inform him of my victory.
traduit: 我杀死了废弃的霜蛾堡的法克斯·卡里乌斯将军，终结了灰烬怪对鸦石镇的袭击。我该回报给莫迪恩·维黎斯队长，把我的这场胜利告诉他。

original: I've slain General Falx Carius in the ruins of Fort Frostmoth. I should examine his remains to determine what he was doing here.
traduit: 我杀死了废弃的霜蛾堡的法克斯·卡里乌斯将军。我该检查下他的尸体，看看他在这儿出了什么事。

original: According to the letter I found on General Carius's remains, he appeared to be responsible for sending what he calls his "men" to attack the town of Raven Rock. I should bring this information to the guards in Raven Rock and let them know the threat has been eliminated.
traduit: 根据我在卡里乌斯将军尸体上找到的信，看来他负责派他所谓的“手下”去袭击鸦石镇。我该把这个消息告知鸦石镇的卫兵，让他们知道这个威胁已被抹除。

original: I've slain General Falx Carius in the ruins of Fort Frostmoth and put an end to any further ash spawn attacking Raven Rock. Captain Veleth was very pleased with my results, and awarded me a bounty in gold.
traduit: 我杀死了废弃的霜蛾堡的法克斯·卡里乌斯将军，终结了灰烬怪对鸦石镇的袭击。维黎斯队长对我的战果很满意，授予了我一笔赏金。

original: Someone named Mogrul sent a messenger for me. This Mogrul wants to talk.
traduit: 有个叫莫古尔的传信给我，说要和我谈谈。

original: Helping Drovas has come back to bite me. He owed a money lender named Mogrul 1000 septims. Now Mogrul expects me to pay Drovas' debt. If I don't, he's going to keep sending thugs after me.
traduit: 帮助多瓦斯反而害了我。他欠一个叫莫古尔的放贷人1000塞普汀。现在莫古尔指望我来还多瓦斯的债，否则的话，他就要一直派些恶棍来骚扰我。

original: Helping Drovas has come back to bite me. He owed a money lender named Mogrul 1000 septims. Mogrul expected me to pay Drovas debt, which I've done.
traduit: 帮助多瓦斯反而害了我。他欠一个叫莫古尔的放贷人1000塞普汀。现在莫古尔指望我来还多瓦斯的债，我已经还了。

original: Helping Drovas has come back to bite me. He owed a money lender named Mogrul 1000 septims. Mogrul expected me to pay Drovas debt. However, I killed him instead.
traduit: 帮助多瓦斯反而害了我。他欠一个叫莫古尔的放贷人1000塞普汀。现在莫古尔指望我来还多瓦斯的债，但我杀了他。

original: Helping Drovas has come back to bite me. He owed a money lender named Mogrul 1000 septims. I persuaded him to take half that.
traduit: 帮助多瓦斯反而害了我。他欠一个叫莫古尔的放贷人1000塞普汀。现在莫古尔指望我来还多瓦斯的债，我说服他只还一半。

original: Unearthed
traduit: 出土

original: Outside Kolbjorn Barrow, I met Ralis Sedarys, an explorer who came to Solstheim in search of relics within the barrow. But when he arrived, he found it buried by the ash. He had all but given up on excavating it, but if I can supply the funds, he offered to make me a partner in his expedition.
traduit: 在寇泊琼古坟外，我遇到了拉里斯·瑟达瑞斯。他来索瑟海姆寻找古坟中的遗物。但等他到了这里后，才发现古坟被火山灰掩埋了。他在几乎要放弃挖掘时提出让我出资，做他这次探险的合伙人。

original: Ralis Sedarys came to Solstheim in search of the Relics of Ahzidal, powerful items said to have been sealed in Kolbjorn Barrow, but found it buried by ash. I agreed to fund his expedition to excavate the Barrow. He set to work, saying he'd send a courier when he had progress to report.
traduit: 拉里斯·瑟达瑞斯来索瑟海姆寻找阿兹达尔的遗物，据说这些蕴含强大力量的宝物被封存于寇泊琼古坟中，但这里现在已经被火山灰掩埋了。我同意资助他发掘古坟的探险。他开工了，说一有进展就派人告诉我。

original: I agreed to fund Ralis Sedarys' expedition to excavate Kolbjorn Barrow. I should visit the site and see how the work is going.
traduit: 我同意了资助拉里斯·瑟达瑞斯对寇泊琼古坟的发掘，该去现场看看工程进展如何了。

original: I agreed to fund Ralis Sedarys' expedition to excavate Kolbjorn Barrow, but work on the dig has come to a halt. The excavation had reached a dead end when Draugr within the tomb awoke, killing several miners and causing the rest to flee.
traduit: 我同意了资助拉里斯·瑟达瑞斯对寇泊琼古坟的发掘，但挖掘工程停滞了。当挖到了一处死胡同时，墓中的一头尸鬼苏醒了，杀死了几个矿工，其他人都跑了。

original: I agreed to fund Ralis Sedarys' expedition to excavate Kolbjorn Barrow, but work on the dig has come to a halt. The excavation had reached a dead end when Draugr within the tomb awoke, killing several miners and causing the rest to flee. I defeated the Draugr, but now need to find a way past the dead end.
traduit: 我同意了资助拉里斯·瑟达瑞斯对寇泊琼古坟的发掘，但挖掘工程停滞了。当挖到了一处死胡同时，墓中的一头尸鬼苏醒了，杀死了几个矿工，其他人都跑了。我击败了那头尸鬼，现在要找到一条绕开死胡同的路。

original: I agreed to fund Ralis Sedarys' expedition to excavate Kolbjorn Barrow, but work on the dig has come to a halt. The excavation had reached a dead end when Draugr within the tomb awoke, killing several miners and causing the rest to flee. I found a way past the dead end, but must deal with the Draugr before work can continue.
traduit: 我同意了资助拉里斯·瑟达瑞斯对寇泊琼古坟的发掘，但挖掘工程停滞了。当挖到了一处死胡同时，墓中的一头尸鬼苏醒了，杀死了几个矿工，其他人都跑了。我找到了一条绕开死胡同的路，但要复工还得先处理那头尸鬼。

original: I agreed to fund Ralis Sedarys' expedition to excavate Kolbjorn Barrow, but work on the dig has come to a halt. At his request, I defeated the Draugr and found a way past the dead end.
traduit: 我同意了资助拉里斯·瑟达瑞斯对寇泊琼古坟的发掘，但挖掘工程停滞了。照他说的，我击败了那头尸鬼，并找到了绕开死胡同的路。

original: I agreed to fund Ralis Sedarys' expedition to excavate Kolbjorn Barrow, but in order to continue, he needs more gold to hire replacements for the workers that have been killed.
traduit: 我同意了资助拉里斯·瑟达瑞斯对寇泊琼古坟的发掘，但为了复工，他需要更多金币来招募人手，换下那些被杀的工人。

original: I agreed to fund Ralis Sedarys' expedition to excavate Kolbjorn Barrow. He told me to return in a few days to see how work was progressing.
traduit: 我同意了资助拉里斯·瑟达瑞斯对寇泊琼古坟的发掘。他告诉我过几天来看看进展。

original: I agreed to fund Ralis Sedarys' expedition to excavate Kolbjorn Barrow. I should return and see how the work is going.
traduit: 我同意了资助拉里斯·瑟达瑞斯对寇泊琼古坟的发掘，该回去看看工程进展如何了。

original: I agreed to fund Ralis Sedarys' expedition to excavate Kolbjorn Barrow, but work on the site has stopped. Most of the miners were killed by another wave of Draugr attacks, and two more are unaccounted for.
traduit: 我同意了资助拉里斯·瑟达瑞斯对寇泊琼古坟的发掘，但现场施工已经中止。大多数矿工死于又一波尸鬼袭击，还有两名矿工下落不明。

original: I agreed to fund Ralis Sedarys' expedition to excavate Kolbjorn Barrow, but work on the site has stopped. Most of the miners were killed by another wave of Draugr attacks, and two more are unaccounted for. I dealt with the Draugr, but still need to locate the missing miners.
traduit: 我同意了资助拉里斯·瑟达瑞斯对寇泊琼古坟的发掘，但现场施工已经中止。大多数矿工死于又一波尸鬼袭击，还有两名矿工下落不明。我打败了尸鬼，但还得去找消失的矿工们。

original: I agreed to fund Ralis Sedarys' expedition to excavate Kolbjorn Barrow, but work on the site has stopped. Most of the miners were killed by another wave of Draugr attacks, and two more were unaccounted for. I found the bodies of the missing miners, but still need to deal with the Draugr threat.
traduit: 我同意了资助拉里斯·瑟达瑞斯对寇泊琼古坟的发掘，但现场施工已经中止。大多数矿工死于又一波尸鬼袭击，还有两名矿工下落不明。我找到了失踪矿工的遗体，但还得解决尸鬼的威胁。

original: I agreed to fund Ralis Sedarys' expedition to excavate Kolbjorn Barrow, but work on the site has stopped. At his request, I dealt with the Draugr and found the bodies of the missing miners.
traduit: 我同意了资助拉里斯·瑟达瑞斯对寇泊琼古坟的发掘，但现场施工已经中止。照他说的，我解决了尸鬼并找到了失踪的矿工。

original: I agreed to fund Ralis Sedarys' expedition to excavate Kolbjorn Barrow, but the ongoing Draugr attacks means he needs more gold in order to hire more miners and guards to protect them.
traduit: 我同意了资助拉里斯·瑟达瑞斯对寇泊琼古坟的发掘，但持续不断的尸鬼袭击意味着他需要更多金币来招募更多矿工，以及保护他们的守卫。

original: I agreed to continue funding Ralis Sedarys' excavation of Kolbjorn Barrow. He told me to return in a few days to see how work was progressing.
traduit: 我同意了资助拉里斯·瑟达瑞斯对寇泊琼古坟的发掘。他告诉我过几天回来看看工程进展。

original: I agreed to continue funding Ralis Sedarys' excavation of Kolbjorn Barrow. I should return and see how the work is going.
traduit: 我同意了资助拉里斯·瑟达瑞斯对寇泊琼古坟的发掘，该回去看看工程怎么样了。

original: I agreed to continue funding Ralis Sedarys' excavation of Kolbjorn Barrow, but Draugr have attacked the miners again, and only a few managed to escape. Ralis asked if I could wipe them out so the excavation could continue.
traduit: 我同意了资助拉里斯·瑟达瑞斯对寇泊琼古坟的发掘，但尸鬼再一次袭击了矿工，只有几个得以逃生。拉里斯问我能否干掉尸鬼让发掘复工。

original: I agreed to continue funding Ralis Sedarys' excavation of Kolbjorn Barrow, but Draugr again attacked the miners. Once again, I slew the Draugr so work could proceed.
traduit: 我同意了资助拉里斯·瑟达瑞斯对寇泊琼古坟的发掘，但尸鬼再一次袭击了矿工。我又杀死了尸鬼，这样工程又能推进了。

original: I agreed to fund Ralis Sedarys' expedition to excavate Kolbjorn Barrow, but once again, he needs more gold to hire increasingly reluctant miners and guards to work on the site.
traduit: 我同意了资助拉里斯·瑟达瑞斯对寇泊琼古坟的发掘，他又需要更多金币来招募抵触情绪日益增长的矿工和守卫了。

original: I agreed to continue funding Ralis Sedarys' ill-fated excavation of Kolbjorn Barrow, but when I returned to his mining camp, I found only blood and corpses. Ralis himself was nowhere to be seen.
traduit: 我同意了资助拉里斯·瑟达瑞斯对寇泊琼古坟那倒了大霉的发掘，但等我回到他的挖掘营地时，只看见了血迹和尸体。拉里斯他本人都不见了。

original: I agreed to fund Ralis Sedarys' ill-fated excavation of Kolbjorn Barrow, but when I returned to his mining camp, I found only blood and corpses. Deep within the barrow, I found Ralis performing a ritual to release Ahzidal, the Dragon Priest that had been sealed there.
traduit: 我同意了资助拉里斯·瑟达瑞斯对寇泊琼古坟那倒了大霉的发掘，但等我回到他的挖掘营地时，只看见了血迹和尸体。在古坟深处，我发现拉里斯在进行某个仪式，来释放被封印的龙祭司，阿兹达尔。

original: I agreed to fund Ralis Sedarys' ill-fated excavation of Kolbjorn Barrow, but when I returned to his mining camp, I found only blood and corpses. Deep within the barrow, I found Ralis performing a ritual that released Ahzidal, a powerful Dragon Priest I fought and defeated.
traduit: 我同意了资助拉里斯·瑟达瑞斯对寇泊琼古坟那倒了大霉的发掘，但等我回到他的挖掘营地时，只看见了血迹和尸体。在古坟深处，我发现拉里斯在进行某个仪式，来释放被封印的龙祭司阿兹达尔，我与它战斗并将它击败。

original: Ralis Sedarys came to Solstheim hoping to find the Relics of Ahzidal and release their maker from his imprisonment in Kolbjorn Barrow. When he found the barrow buried by the ash, he convinced me to fund its excavation, using the miners as blood sacrifices for his rituals. I saw through his lies and decided to kill him for his crimes.
traduit: 拉里斯·瑟达瑞斯来索瑟海姆想要找到阿兹达尔的遗物，并把他们的创造者从寇泊琼古坟里释放出来。当他发现古坟被火山灰掩埋后，就说服了我资助他的发掘，把矿工当作他仪式的血祭。我看穿了他的谎言，决定让他为自己的罪行偿命。

original: Ralis Sedarys came to Solstheim hoping to find the Relics of Ahzidal and release their maker from his imprisonment in Kolbjorn Barrow. When he found the barrow buried by the ash, he convinced me to fund its excavation, using the miners as blood sacrifices for his rituals. I saw through his lies and killed him for his crimes.
traduit: 拉里斯·瑟达瑞斯来索瑟海姆想要找到阿兹达尔的遗物，并把他们的创造者从寇泊琼古坟里释放出来。当他发现古坟被火山灰掩埋后，就说服了我资助他的发掘，把矿工当作他仪式的血祭。我看穿了他的谎言，让他为自己的罪行偿命了。

original: Ralis Sedarys came to Solstheim hoping to find the Relics of Ahzidal, but fell under the spell of their maker, a powerful Dragon Priest entombed in the barrow. He convinced me to fund its excavation, but was compelled by Ahzidal to use the miners as ritual sacrifices. Ralis had no control over his actions, so I allowed him to live and depart the barrow in peace.
traduit: 拉里斯·瑟达瑞斯来索瑟海姆想要找到阿兹达尔的遗物，但他被遗物的创造者，那位被埋葬在古坟中的强大龙祭司所蛊惑。他说服了我资助他的发掘，却被阿兹达尔强迫把矿工作为仪式的血祭。因为拉里斯无法控制自己的行为，所以我放了他一条离开古坟的生路。

original: The Fate of the Skaal
traduit: 斯卡尔的命运

original: After a strange experience with the Black Book in the Temple of Miraak, Frea says it is important to consult the Skaal Shaman. I should accompany her back to her village.
traduit: 在米拉克神殿体验了一番奇异经历后，芙瑞雅说很有必要去请教斯卡尔萨满。我应该陪她回村子里去。

original: Storn, the Skaal shaman, has suggested that my experiences on Solstheim mean I am connected to Miraak. To follow the path Miraak has taken and learn what he knows, I must travel to Saering's Watch and learn the Word of Power written there.
traduit: 斯卡尔萨满斯托恩，认为我在索瑟海姆的经历意味着我与米拉克有联系。为了重走米拉克之路来了解他所知的一切，我必须前往瑟琳看台，学会那里铭刻的力量之语。

original: In order to free the people of the Skaal, and to thwart Miraak's plans, I have learned a new Word of Power. I must use this new knowledge to disrupt the activity at the Wind Stone, where the Skaal are working against their will.
traduit: 为了解放斯卡尔人，挫败米拉克的计划，我学会了一种新的力量之语。我必须用这个新知识来打断风石处的活动，斯卡尔人正被迫在此劳作。

original: The people of the Skaal have been freed from the control they have been under, but in doing so a hideous creature has been released. It must be defeated before the Skaal are truly safe.
traduit: 斯卡尔人已经从精神控制中解放出来，但这过程也放出了一个可怕的怪物。必须打败它，确保斯卡尔人的安全。

original: The Skaal have been freed from Miraak's control, and his minion has been destroyed. Now that Storn no longer needs to focus on keeping his people safe, he may be able to tell me more about how to find and defeat Miraak.
traduit: 斯卡尔人不再受米拉克的控制了，他的爪牙也被毁灭了。既然斯托恩不再需要专注于保护他的族人，他也许能告诉我更多关于寻找和打败米拉克的办法。

traduit: 陪芙瑞雅回斯卡尔村

traduit: 与“跨崖者”斯托恩交谈

traduit: 与斯托恩交谈

traduit: 打败深潜者

original: The Temple of Miraak
traduit: 米拉克神殿

original: After freeing the Skaal from the magic controlling them, Storn, the shaman, has asked me to seek out a member of their tribe who is still missing. I need to look to the temple near the center of Solstheim to find Frea and make sure she is safe.
traduit: 在把斯卡尔人从控制他们的魔法中解放出来后，萨满斯托恩请我去找一名仍然下落不明的族人。我得去索瑟海姆中央的神殿去找芙瑞雅，确保她的安全。

original: I've found Miraak's temple on Solstheim. Now I need to find out why people are trying to kill me on his behalf.
traduit: 我发现了索瑟海姆岛上的米拉克神殿。现在要查清为什么有人打他的旗号袭击我。

original: I was successful in defeating Miraak after he attacked me, but he has disappeared. I should search his temple to learn more about what's going on here.
traduit: 在成功击退了现身攻击我的米拉克后，他却消失了。我得搜查他的神殿，深入了解这里发生了什么。

original: I've found Frea, a warrior from the Skaal Village on Solstheim. She is also searching the Temple of Miraak, looking for answers. We've agreed that we need to find where Miraak's power is coming from.
traduit: 我找到了索瑟海姆斯卡尔村的战士，芙瑞雅。她也在调查米拉克神殿寻找答案。我们同意必须找出米拉克力量的源头。

original: After delving through the Temple of Miraak, Frea and I have discovered a strange book deep within secret chambers. Frea believes it has a connection to what's happening on Solstheim. I should read it to learn what secrets it holds.
traduit: 在探索米拉克神殿后，芙瑞雅和我在密室深处发现了一本神秘书籍。我该读一读看看其中有什么奥秘。

original: After searching the Temple of Miraak, Frea and I found a strange book. When I read it, I was transported to some other realm, where I learned that Miraak is still alive and plans to return to Solstheim. I need to tell Frea what I've seen.
traduit: 在探索米拉克神殿后，芙瑞雅和我发现了一本神秘书籍。我读了后就被传送到了另一个位面，在那里了解到米拉克还活着，还计划着回归索瑟海姆。我得告诉芙瑞雅我的所见所闻。

original: After finding Frea, and searching the Temple of Miraak, we discovered a strange book. When I read it, I was transported to some other realm and learned that Miraak is still alive and claims he'll return soon. Frea has suggested we take this information back to her village, and see what can be done to stop Miraak.
traduit: 在探索米拉克神殿后，芙瑞雅和我发现了一本神秘书籍。我读了后就被传送到了另一个位面，在那里了解到米拉克还活着，他宣称很快就会回归。芙瑞雅建议我们把这个消息带回她村里去，看看能做什么来阻止米拉克。

original: Find Frea
traduit: 寻找芙瑞雅

original: Talk to Frea
traduit: 和芙瑞雅交谈

original: Defeat Miraak
traduit: 击败米拉克

original: Explore the Temple
traduit: 探索神殿

original: Find the source of Miraak's power
traduit: 找到米拉克的力量之源

original: Read the Black Book
traduit: 阅读黑暗经书

original: Approach Miraak
traduit: 靠近米拉克

original: Dragonborn
traduit: 龙裔

original: I've been attacked by a group of cultists. I need to see if they have any evidence of what prompted this assault.
traduit: 我被一群教徒攻击了，得看看他们身上有没有引发了这次袭击的证据。

original: I've found a note on one of the cultists who attacked me. Perhaps it has some clue as to what prompted them to come after me.
traduit: 我在其中一个攻击我的教徒身上找到了一张字条。也许这上面说了是什么让他们冲我来的。

original: I've been attacked by a group of people claiming to work for someone named Miraak. I need to find out why they're trying to kill me, and so I should look for the boat in Windhelm they used to travel from Solstheim.
traduit: 我被一群自称听命于米拉克的人袭击了。我需要查出他们为什么试图杀了我，这样就得去风舵城找那条把他们载到这里来的船。

original: I have arrived on Solstheim in search of the "Miraak" mentioned in a note as being behind the attempt on my life. Perhaps someone in the town of Raven Rock will know about him.
traduit: 我来到索瑟海姆找字条中提到的，想要取我性命的“米拉克”。也许鸦石镇里有人了解他的情报。

original: The people of Raven Rock know the name Miraak, saying that he has a temple near the center of the island. I should seek him out and find out why people have attacked me on his behalf.
traduit: 鸦石镇的人听过米拉克这个名字，说他在岛中央建了一座神殿。我得去找他，查清楚为什么会有人打他的旗号来袭击我。

original: After an attempt on my life, I've tracked the people responsible to the isle of Solstheim, where someone named Miraak has a temple near the center of the island. It's time to find out what's going on.
traduit: 在有人试图取我性命后，我追踪嫌疑人来到了索瑟海姆岛，一个叫米拉克的人在岛中央有座神殿。是时候查清出什么事了。

original: Find out who sent the Cultists
traduit: 查出是谁派的教徒

original: Read Cultists' Orders
traduit: 读教徒的命令

original: Search for information about Miraak
traduit: 寻找关于米拉克的信息

original: Investigate the shrine
traduit: 调查祭坛

original: Reach the Temple of Miraak
traduit: 到达米拉克神殿

original: Reluctant Steward
traduit: 不情愿的管家

original: Neloth has asked me to locate his steward, Varona Nelas. She is probably somewhere around Tel Mithryn.
traduit: 内洛斯请我帮忙找到他的管家，瓦罗纳·内拉斯。她现在可能在泰尔·米斯瑞恩附近。

original: Neloth has asked me to locate his steward, Varona Nelas. Last time anyone in Tel Mithryn saw her, she was on her way to Raven Rock.
traduit: 内洛斯请我帮忙找到他的管家，瓦罗纳·内拉斯。上次泰尔·米斯瑞恩有人见到她时，她正在前往鸦石镇的路上。

original: Neloth asked me to locate his steward, Varona Nelas. I found her body on the road to Raven Rock.
traduit: 内洛斯请我帮忙找到他的管家，瓦罗纳·内拉斯。我在去鸦石镇的路上发现了她的尸体。

original: I found Neloth's steward, Varona, dead on the road to Raven Rock.
traduit: 我发现内洛斯的管家瓦罗纳死在去鸦石镇的路上。

original: I found Varona's dead body on the road to Raven Rock, apparently killed by ash spawn. Now Neloth wants me to find someone in Raven Rock willing to be his new steward.
traduit: 我发现内洛斯的管家瓦罗纳死在去鸦石镇的路上，她显然是被灰烬怪所杀。现在内洛斯想让我在鸦石镇找个愿意当他新管家的人。

original: Neloth asked me to locate his steward, Varona Nelas. I found her dead body on the road to Raven Rock. Now Neloth wants me to find someone in Raven Rock willing to be his new steward. I've heard Drovas Relvi might be willing.
traduit: 内洛斯请我帮忙找到他的管家，瓦罗纳·内拉斯。我在去鸦石镇的路上发现了她的尸体。现在内洛斯想让我在鸦石镇找个愿意当他新管家的人，听说多瓦斯·雷维可能正有此意。

original: Neloth asked me to locate his steward, Varona Nelas. I found her dead body on the road to Raven Rock. Neloth sent me to Raven Rock to find a new steward. I found Drovas Relvi, who seemed very eager to take the position.
traduit: 内洛斯请我帮忙找到他的管家，瓦罗纳·内拉斯。我在去鸦石镇的路上发现了她的尸体。内洛斯派我去鸦石镇找个新管家，我找到了多瓦斯·雷维，他看起来很想要这份工作。

original: Find Varona
traduit: 找到瓦罗纳

original: Tell Neloth that Varona is dead
traduit: 把瓦罗纳的死讯告诉内洛斯

original: Find a new steward
traduit: 找个新管家

original: Report back to Neloth
traduit: 回去向内洛斯汇报

original: Tame Dragon controller
traduit: 驭龙之道

original: The Gardener of Men
traduit: 凡人的园丁

original: With Neloth's help, I gained access to the Black Book in Nchardak. Now to read it and learn more of Miraak's knowledge.
traduit: 在内洛斯的帮助下，我拿到了尼查达克的黑暗经书。现在要阅读它，了解更多米拉克的知识。

original: With Neloth's help, I gained access to the Black Book in Nchardak. I read it and was transported to Hermaeus Mora's realm of Apocrypha, where I found the book's counterpart. Hermaeus Mora himself appeared and taught me the second Word of "Bend Will". He has promised to teach me the third Word but only in return for "the secrets of the Skaal."
traduit: 在内洛斯的帮助下，我拿到了尼查达克的黑暗经书。我读了这本书，并被传送到了赫麦尤斯·莫拉的领域：异典，我在那里找到了这本书的翻版。赫麦尤斯·莫拉亲自现身，教会了我“意志屈服”的第二句龙语。他答应教我第三句，前提是我用“斯卡尔的秘密”作交易。

original: With Neloth's help, I gained access to the Black Book in Nchardak. I read it and was transported to Hermaeus Mora's realm of Apocrypha, where I found the book's counterpart. Hermaeus Mora himself appeared and taught me the second Word of Bend Will. He promised to teach me the third Word but only if in return for "the secrets of the Skaal." The Skaal shaman Storn agreed to give Hermaeus Mora what he wanted, but when Storn read the book, Hermaeus Mora killed him while teaching me the promised Word of Power.
traduit: 在内洛斯的帮助下，我拿到了尼查达克的黑暗经书。我读了这本书，并被传送到了赫麦尤斯·莫拉的领域：异典，我在那里找到了这本书的翻版。赫麦尤斯·莫拉亲自现身，教会了我“意志屈服”的第二句龙语。他答应教我第三句，前提是我用“斯卡尔的秘密”作交易。斯卡尔萨满斯托恩同意让赫麦尤斯·莫拉如愿，但是当斯托恩阅读这本书时，赫麦尤斯·莫拉在教我许诺的龙语时杀了他。

original: Learn the hidden knowledge of "Epistolary Acumen"
traduit: 学习《信札巧笔》的隐秘知识

original: Wait for Storn to read the book
traduit: 等待斯托恩读书

original: At the Summit of Apocrypha
traduit: 异典之巅

original: Hermaeus Mora taught me the final Word of Power of the "Bend Will" Shout, killing Storn in the process. I now have what I need to return to Apocrypha and face Miraak.
traduit: 赫麦尤斯·莫拉教会了我“意志屈服”龙吼的最后一句力量之语，同时杀死了斯托恩。回异典去挑战米拉克所需的一切都已完备。

original: Hermaeus Mora taught me the final Word of Power of the "Bend Will" Shout, killing Storn in the process. With this Shout, I can tame Miraak's dragon and force him to fly me to Miraak's temple in Apocrypha.
traduit: 赫麦尤斯·莫拉教会了我“意志屈服”龙吼的最后一句力量之语，同时杀死了斯托恩。有了这个龙吼，我就能驯服米拉克的龙，强迫他载我去异典的米拉克神殿。

original: Hermaeus Mora taught me the final Word of Power of the "Bend Will" Shout, killing Storn in the process. I used the Shout to tame Miraak's dragon and flew to his temple, where he was waiting for me.
traduit: 赫麦尤斯·莫拉教会了我“意志屈服”龙吼的最后一句力量之语，同时杀死了斯托恩。我使用了这个龙吼驯服了米拉克的龙，飞到了他的神殿，他正在此等我。

original: Hermaeus Mora taught me the final Word of Power of the "Bend Will" Shout, killing Storn in the process. I used the Shout to tame Miraak's dragon and flew to his temple, where I fought and killed him. Miraak will never threaten Solstheim again.
traduit: 赫麦尤斯·莫拉教会了我“意志屈服”龙吼的最后一句力量之语，同时杀死了斯托恩。我使用了这个龙吼驯服了米拉克的龙，飞到了他的神殿，在此与他战斗并将其斩杀。米拉克再也不能威胁索瑟海姆了。

original: Unlock your "Bend Will" Shout
traduit: 解锁你的“意志屈服”龙吼

original: Read "Waking Dreams"
traduit: 阅读《清醒之梦》

original: Reach Miraak's Temple
traduit: 到达米拉克的神殿

original: Use the "Bend Will" Shout to tame Sahrotaar
traduit: 使用“意志屈服”龙吼来驯服萨洛塔尔

original: The Path of Knowledge
traduit: 知识之道

original: In order to defeat Miraak, I need to find more of the Black Books, the source of his knowledge and power. Storn suggested that the wizard Neloth may know the location of the Black Books that I need.
traduit: 为了打败米拉克，我需要找到更多的黑暗经书，也就是他的知识与力量之源。斯托恩提到，那个叫内洛斯的法师可能知道我需要的黑暗经书的下落。

original: In order to defeat Miraak, I need to find more of Hermaeus Mora's Black Books, the source of his knowledge and power. The Telvanni wizard Neloth found one of these books in the Dwarven ruin of Nchardak, but it is locked inside some kind of protective mechanism. Maybe together we can find a way to get at this Black Book.
traduit: 为了打败米拉克，我需要找到更多的黑暗经书，也就是他的知识与力量之源。泰瓦尼法师内洛斯在尼查达克锻莫遗迹找到了其中一本，但它被锁在某种保护装置里了。也许我们一起努力能拿到这本黑暗经书。

original: With the help of the Telvanni wizard Neloth, I found another of Hermaeus Mora's Black Books in the Dwarven ruin of Nchardak.
traduit: 在泰瓦尼法师内洛斯的帮助下，我在锻莫遗迹尼查达克里找到了另一本赫麦尤斯·莫拉的黑暗经书。

original: Travel to Nchardak with Neloth
traduit: 与内洛斯一起前往尼查达克

original: Restore the steam supply to the Dwemer reading room
traduit: 恢复锻莫阅览室的蒸汽供应

original: Release the book from the Dwemer contraption
traduit: 把书从锻莫装置中取出来

original: Init quest
traduit: 初始化任务

original: "Untithed to any thane or hold, and self-governed, with free worship, with no compensation to Skyrim or the Empire except as writ in the Armistice of old wheresoever those might still apply, and henceforth let no Man or Mer say that the Sons and Daughters of Kyne are without mercy or honor." -Skyrim's Offer of Solstheim to Morrowind, 4E 16
traduit: “不向任何武卫或领地缴纳赋税，自信自治，不在旧有《停战协议》这一仍适用的条约以外对天际或帝国做出任何赔偿，从今往后，任何人与莫都不能说凯娜的子女是没有怜悯与荣誉的。”——天际向晨风提供索瑟海姆，4E16年

original: Raven Rock Mine, once one of the most abundant sources of ebony in Morrowind, was shut down in 4E 170. This lead to a mass exodus from the town, cutting the population in half.
traduit: 鸦石矿场曾经是晨风最富的黑檀产地之一，在4E170年关闭。这导致了大量劳力离开小镇，人口减少一半。

original: Most of Raven Rock's original structures were leveled when the Red Mountain erupted in 4E 5. The Dunmer have largely rebuilt the town over the past two hundred years.
traduit: 当红山在4E5年爆发时，鸦石镇的大部分原建筑都被夷为平地。过去200年中，丹莫大力重建了城镇。

original: Although the East Empire Company originally founded Raven Rock, they turned the failing mining colony over to the dark elves at the beginning of the Fourth Era.
traduit: 虽然鸦石镇最初是由东帝国公司建立，但他们在第四纪元初时把这衰落的采矿殖民地移交给了暗精灵。

original: Some tales tell of ancient Nord heroes whose Voices were powerful enough to tame and ride dragons.
traduit: 某些传说中叙述的古诺德英雄的声音强大到足以驯服并驾驭巨龙。

original: The Dunmer of Morrowind construct chitin armor out of the shells of native insects layered with resinous glues.
traduit: 晨风丹莫用当地昆虫的外壳和树脂胶打造甲壳护甲。

original: Netch are often domesticated on the Morrowind mainland. Wild netch were first sighted on Solstheim several decades ago, perhaps drawn by the familiar flora that has grown up in the southern ashlands.
traduit: 晨风大陆的气母常被驯化。几十年前，人们第一次在索瑟海姆岛上见到野生气母，或许是被南部灰地的熟悉植物群所吸引来的。

original: Rieklings have little culture of their own, but scavenge what relics they can from around Solstheim and form strange attachments to what they find.
traduit: 瑞克灵没有自己的文化，但他们会从索瑟海姆周围搜罗任何能找到的遗物，并对其产生一种奇怪的依恋。

original: Thirsk Mead Hall was founded by Hrothmund, who originally left the Skaal in order to live the lifestyle of ancient Nord warriors in the wilderness.
traduit: 瑟斯科蜜酒大厅最初有哈洛斯蒙德建立，他离开了斯卡尔希望在荒野中过上远古诺德战士们的生活方式。

original: Hawala faaaakara. Baaaa rakhee kaloo. Pooja kan faroo kee jaa. Goora! Goora! Goora! --Riekling Godspeak Song
traduit: 哈哇啦 法咔啦。吧 啦咔喝 咔啰。泼加 坎 法噜 咳 加。格拉！格拉！格拉！——瑞克灵神谕歌

original: The island of Solstheim is located to the north-east of Skyrim. The "Northern Maiden" out of Windhelm is known to occasionally take passengers back and forth.
traduit: 索瑟海姆岛位于天际的东北方。据说，风舵城的“北方少女”偶尔会载客往返其间。

original: The master wizards of House Telvanni traditionally grow their homes from fungal spores, using secret methods known only to themselves.
traduit: 泰瓦尼家的大法师们用自己的秘密方法，培育真菌孢子来种出自己的房子。

original: The ancient Nords of Solstheim sealed their tombs with Stalhrim, a form of enchanted ice as hard as stone. The Skaal are the only ones who know the secret of crafting armor and weapons out of Stalhrim.
traduit: 索瑟海姆的古诺德人用魔冰，一种附了魔、坚硬如石的冰来封印他们的坟墓。只有斯卡尔人了解用魔冰打造武器和护甲的秘密。

original: "...the people of Solstheim, the heirs of the Guardian, must remain wary, lest the dark influence of Herma-Mora, or even the Traitor himself, return someday." --excerpt from "The Guardian and the Traitor"
traduit: “……索瑟海姆之民以及守护者的继承者，要始终保持警惕，以免被赫玛-莫拉的黑暗影响侵蚀，甚至有一天，背叛者自己会卷土重来。”——摘自《守护者与背叛者》

original: Strange flora native to Morrowind have sprouted up in the ash that blankets the southern reaches of Solstheim.
traduit: 来自晨风的奇怪植物已经在索瑟海姆南部的灰烬中生根发芽了。

original: Raven Rock, Solstheim's main settlement, is firmly under the control of House Redoran, the most powerful of the Great Houses of Morrowind.
traduit: 鸦石镇，索瑟海姆的主要定居点，被晨风最强的大家族瑞多然牢牢掌控着。

original: The ashfall from Red Mountain has driven much of Solstheim's native wildlife into the northern half of the island.
traduit: 来自红山的火山灰把索瑟海姆的大部分本土野生生物驱赶到了岛的北部。

original: Skaal Village, near the eastern coast of Solstheim, is home to an ancient offshoot tribe of Nords known as the Skaal.
traduit: 斯卡尔村位于索瑟海姆的东海岸附近，是诺德的古老部落分支——斯卡尔人的家园。

original: Solstheim was part of Skyrim until the High King gave it to Morrowind in 4E 16 to serve as a refuge for the Dunmer after the events of the Red Year.
traduit: 索瑟海姆曾经是天际的一部分，直到至高王在4E16年把它作为红色之年事件之后丹莫的避难所划归晨风。

original: Each of Solstheim's sacred stones grants a power which can be used only once. Return to the stone to reacquire the power.
traduit: 索瑟海姆的每块圣石都能赋予一种一次性的力量，需要回到圣石处来重新获取。

original: One of the most dangerous Steam Animunculi is the Dwarven Ballista, which fires a bolt that can penetrate even the thickest armor.
traduit: 矮人弩炮是最危险的蒸汽机械之一，它发射的弩矢可以穿透最厚的护甲。

original: Reading one of Hermaeus Mora's Black Books may transport you into his realm. Read it again to escape.
traduit: 读一遍赫麦尤斯·莫拉的黑暗经书可能会将你传送到他的领域，重读一遍来逃离。

original: Apocrypha is the realm of Hermaeus Mora, the Daedric Prince of Fate and Knowledge. Many who come here seeking forbidden knowledge remain forever.
traduit: 异典是赫麦尤斯·莫拉，命运与知识之迪德拉君王的领域。许多来此寻求禁忌知识的人永远留在了这里。

original: Seekers are servants of Hermaeus Mora. They are rarely seen outside his Oblivion realm of Apocrypha.
traduit: 探求者是赫麦尤斯·莫拉的仆人。它们极少在异典湮灭领域之外被发现。

original: Rieklings may be small in stature, but they attack in swarms and can be fearsome in melee combat. They are even known to tame and ride boars into battle.
traduit: 虽然瑞克灵身材矮小，但他们成群结队地发起攻击，在近战中很可怕。他们甚至以驯服和骑乘野猪出战而闻名。

original: Lurkers are thought to be native to the murky waters of Hermaeus Mora's realm of Apocrypha.
traduit: 深潜者被认为是赫麦尤斯·莫拉的异典领域浊水中的原住民。

original: Ash Spawn began to appear on Solstheim after the massive eruptions of Red Mountain early in the Fourth Era covered the southern part of the island in ash. Their exact origins are unknown.

original:
You can ride a dragon by using the Bend Will Shout to tame it temporarily. When the dragon is landed, press [Activate] to mount. When you're riding the dragon, press [Activate] to dismount, or press it again to cancel a dismount command while the dragon is landing.

You can order the dragon to fly to anywhere you can fast travel - just bring up the map and fast travel to that marker.

You can lock onto a target while riding the dragon. Press [Jump] to toggle Target Lock mode on and off. While you're in Target Lock mode, your current target will appear on the interface below the compass.

While in Target Lock, you can cycle forward and backward through the list using [Left] and [Right]. If the current target dies or gets too far away, the Target Lock will automatically switch to the next target. If there are no more targets, you will automatically leave Target Lock.

You can also command the dragon to attack your current target by pressing [Sneak].
traduit:

你可以命令龙飞到任何你可以快速旅行到达的地方，只需打开世界地图，快速旅行到那个标记位置。

你可以在骑龙时锁定目标。按下[Jump]切换到目标锁定模式。当你处于该模式时，你当前的目标将显示在指南针下方的界面上。

在目标锁定模式中，你可以使用[Left]和[Right]来切换目标。如果当前目标已死亡或者距离目标太远，目标锁定会自动切换到下个目标。如果没有其他目标，将自动解除目标锁定模式。

你还可以按[Sneak]命令龙攻击你当前的目标。

original: The Beginner's Guide to Homesteading
traduit: 初学者建房指南

original:
[pagebreak]

The Beginner's Guide to Homesteading

[pagebreak]

If you're like most people, you've always dreamed of owning your own steading and building your own home. But where to start? Never fear, you hold in your hands the guide to everything you need to know. Before long, you'll be gazing complacently across your well-tended lands from the porch of your own manor house. [pagebreak] Getting Started There are two vital pieces of equipment that the prospective homeowner needs: the Drafting Table and the Carpenter's Workbench. Your Drafting Table is where you'll lay out the plans for each stage of your new house. Don't worry about making a mistake here - you can always change your mind, and making a new plan costs you nothing. Remember: measure twice and cut once. Your Carpenter's Workbench is where you'll do the actual construction. Once you've settled on a plan at the Drafting Table, you can start building your house at the Carpenter's Workbench. Avoid the common beginner's mistake - don't try to build the roof without building the proper supports first! Space for the Family If you have a spouse or children, you'll certainly want to get the house in a livable state as soon as possible. Your loving spouse will no doubt make do with nothing more than a roof over her head and a bed to sleep in, but what about the children? Don't worry - all they need is a bed and a chest or dresser to store their treasures, and they will be perfectly content. Building Materials You will need a lot of supplies to complete your house, but it isn't necessary to gather everything you need ahead of time. Unless you're in a hurry, you can just build in stages as materials become available. You'll enjoy watching your home progress from dream to reality. The most common materials you'll need are sawn logs, cut stone, and clay. Luckily, these are plentiful in Skyrim - in fact, most building sites will have one or more easily accessible sources of clay and stone. For sawn lumber, any lumber mill owner will be glad to sell and deliver as much as you need. You'll need a lot of nails - fortunately even a novice blacksmith will soon find themselves turning iron into nails with ease. When you turn to furnishing your completed house, you'll need a much wider variety of materials. Some of them, such as straw and glass, are commonly obtained from general goods stores. For the rest - the whole of Skyrim will become your general store! Hiring a Steward Once your estate is well-established, you may wish to consider hiring a steward to help manage your affairs. A good steward can be invaluable - from hiring a carriage driver to buying a cow to keeping you supplied with building materials - freeing you to enjoy the fruits of your labors. Before hiring a steward, it's advisable to bring a potential candidate to your manor and observe whether they are a good fit for your requirements. Remember, you are putting your entire estate into their hands - you need someone you can trust implicitly. Building Your House The rest of this guide will review plans for each room that you might want to build. [pagebreak] [pagebreak] Small House Before you get too ambitious, gain confidence by building this tidy cottage. It is the perfect starter home, and might turn out to be all you need. But don't worry - if you decide to keep building, you can remodel this into an entry way to the rest of your house. [pagebreak]

[pagebreak] Main Hall You may decide the Small House is not enough - perhaps you need room for a growing family? The next step is to add a Main Hall, which will turn your cottage into an imposing manor house: two floors, including space for two small bedrooms, a back room and a large dining area. [pagebreak]

[pagebreak] Additions Once you've built a Main Hall, your options become almost unlimited - you now have room to add three more additional wings, if you decide you still need more space. For each wing, you have three choices of what to build, giving a total of nine possible additions! (But remember - you can only build three of them, so choose wisely.) [pagebreak] West Wing - Bedrooms The Bedroom addition is perfect if you have a family who needs more comfortable living quarters than the Main Hall affords. The Bedroom has space for a master bedroom plus two children's beds, as well as all the dressers, wardrobes, etc. that anyone could desire. This addition also includes a spacious exterior porch. [pagebreak]

[pagebreak] West Wing - Greenhouse Perhaps you are a gardener at heart? If so, the Greenhouse provides room for planters where you can grow almost whatever you wish, sheltered from Skyrim's harsh climate. Tend and harvest your crops from the comfort of your own home! [pagebreak]

[pagebreak] West Wing - Enchanter's Tower If your interests lie in the magical realm, this tower addition is for you. Conduct your research in privacy and comfort. Plenty of space for keeping your collections and artifacts organized. And the view from the tower is guaranteed to take your breath away. [pagebreak]

[pagebreak] North Wing - Storage Room If you simply need more space to store your many possessions and collections, build yourself a Storage Room. The included porch can even be connected to the porch on the East or West wings, if you build the Bedroom or Armory additions. [pagebreak]

初学者建房指南

[pagebreak]

如果你和大多数人一样，一直梦想拥有自己的庄园，建造自己的家。可该从哪里开始呢?不要怕，你手里的这本指南有你想知道的一切。用不了多久，你就会从自己庄园的户外平台上，得意洋洋地望着你精心打造的土地。 [pagebreak] 开始准备 身为准房主，两个设备至关重要——设计桌和木工台。 设计桌可以让你为新房的各阶段制定计划。不用担心犯错，你可以随时改变计划，制定新的计划不需要付出任何代价。切记：反复丈量，一次成型。 木工台是你进行实际施工的地方。一旦你在设计桌确定了计划，就可以在木工台上施工建造你的房子了。为了避免初学者常犯的错误，不要在没建立支撑的时候就直接盖屋顶！ 家庭生活空间 如果你有配偶或孩子，你肯定会想尽快把房子调整到适宜居住的状态。毫无疑问，你的爱人无非是想要个栖身之所和一张床，但孩子们怎么办? 别担心，只需要一张床和一个箱子或梳妆台来存放他们的宝贝，他们会非常满意的。 建材 你需要很多材料来完成房子，但没必要提前收集所有东西。除非你很赶时间，大可以分时分段使用材料进行建造。看着你的家从梦想变成现实是很不错的感觉。 所需的常见建材就是切好的原木、石料和黏土。所幸是这些东西在天际十分丰富，大多数建筑工地都能轻易找到黏土和石头的矿床。至于木材，所有伐木场老板都会很乐意出售并交付你的所有所需。 你还需要大量的钉子，不过好在即使是新手铁匠也能轻松地把铁打成钉子。 当你开始布置已经建好的房子时，你所需的材料就更加广泛了。其中包括稻草和玻璃，通常可以在杂货店买到。至于其他的，整个天际都可以成为你的供货商！ 雇佣管家 一旦你的庄园落成，你可能会雇佣一位管家来帮你打理事务。好的管家是无价的，可以帮你雇车夫、买牲畜，乃至替你去采购建材，总之可以让你自由地享受自己的劳动成果。 雇佣管家前，建议你把潜在的候选人带到庄园来，看看他们是否符合你的要求。记住，你是要把全部财产交到他们手中，所以得是完全可信任的人才行。 开始建造你的房子 本指南的剩余部分将为你提供构建每个房间的可选计划。 [pagebreak] [pagebreak] 小房子 在你的野心膨胀之前，建议先建个整洁的小屋来获得信心。这是个完美的入门级房屋，可能会直接满足你所需的一切。但也不必担心，如果你决定继续建造，可以随时把它改造成通往房子其他部分的玄关。 [pagebreak]

[pagebreak] 主厅 你可能会嫌弃小房子远远不够，希望有个更大的房间容纳不断壮大的家庭？那么下一步就是增加一个主厅，将你的小屋变成壮观的庄园大宅，包括两个小卧室，一个里屋和一个大用餐区。 [pagebreak]

[pagebreak] 扩建 建造好主厅之后，你的选择几乎无限，如果你还需要更多空间，你可以再扩建三个额外侧翼房间。 每个侧翼，你都有三种选择，总共有九种可添加的房间！（但请记住，你只能选择其中三个，请考虑清楚。） [pagebreak] 西翼-卧室 如果你的家庭需要比主厅更舒适的居住空间，那卧室是个完美的选择。卧室提供一张主床和两个儿童床的空间，兼有衣柜、橱柜等等，所有人的东西都能放下。该扩建还提供一个宽敞的户外平台。 [pagebreak]

[pagebreak] 西翼-温室 也许你内心里还住着一个园丁？当真如此的话，温室为你提供种植空间，你可以种植几乎任何你想种的东西，并避开天际恶劣气候的影响。在你舒适的家中照料并收获你的作物吧！ [pagebreak]

[pagebreak] 西翼-附魔师塔 如果你有志于魔法领域，这个塔楼扩建就是为你而设的。在私密舒适的地方进行实验。还有足够的空间保存你的收藏和制品。塔上的景色也一定会让你惊叹不已。 [pagebreak]

[pagebreak] 北翼-储藏室 如果你只是需要更多的空间来存放你的许多财产和收藏品，那就给自己建一个储藏室吧。如果你建造了卧室或军械库的话，那么附带的户外平台甚至可以连接东翼或西翼的平台。 [pagebreak]

[pagebreak] 北翼-战利品室 你是个喜欢炫耀战利品的巨物猎手吗？战利品可以让你随意选择摆放七个宏伟标本，一定能让您的访客感到惊讶并记忆犹新。 [pagebreak]

[pagebreak] 北翼-炼金实验室 身为有抱负的炼金术师，这座塔楼将给你充足的舒适空间来磨炼技艺。当你在酿制药水是需要休息一下，也可以在塔顶欣赏美景。 [pagebreak]

[pagebreak] 东翼-军械库 如果你喜欢成天敲打金属，或者纯粹就是个军械收藏家，那么军械库就是为你而设。充足的空间用于锻造，大量的地方来展示你的军械藏品，军械库在什么宅子都是完美的扩建选项。 [pagebreak]

[pagebreak] 东翼-厨房 厨房提供一切你所需要追求的至高烹饪艺术。厌倦了在火上拿锅做菜？你还可以配一个新的烤箱！ [pagebreak]

[pagebreak] 东翼-藏书楼 藏书楼肯定会让那些重视文学的人感到高兴。有大量空间让你摆放书架，然后你就可以享受你的藏书了。或者可以带本书去塔顶，顺带俯瞰一下你的庄园？ [pagebreak]

欢迎来到您的新家！ 本家装指南将提供可在领地总管处购买的套装清单。每个套装都包含您屋内特定部分的家具与装饰，购买后即会交付。 您只需提供金币，而剩下的都交给总管。等您购买后再次回家时，新的家具装饰已摆放到位。 客厅 为位于住宅二楼中心的生活区添置一张大桌子以及椅子和各种装饰。 卧室 为二楼主卧添置装饰家居和一张更大更豪华的床。此外，在卧室门外添加一个小用餐区，包括一张桌子，几把椅子和其他装饰。 炼金实验室 将一楼的一间屋布置上炼金设备，包括炼金台和相关装饰。 附魔实验室 将一楼的一间屋布置上附魔设备，包括奥术附魔台，还有几个测试新魔法的练习假人。 露台 在房子后面的石制露台上添加一张小桌子、两把椅子和其他家具。

original: Consider Adoption
traduit: 请考虑领养

original:
WANTED ~ A Good Home ~

In these days of war and strife, the orphans of Skyrim are the true victims. Many have no one left to turn to, and face a life of hard labor, poverty, and misery. If you could provide a stable home for one of these innocent children, please, consider adoption. Whether you choose to adopt from us, or to take in someone closer to home, you can make a difference in a child's life. For more information, enquire with: Constance Michel Honorhall Orphanage, Riften
traduit:
想要 ~ 一个美好的家~

在这充满战争和冲突的日子里，天际的孤儿们才是真正的受害者。他们面临着艰苦繁重的劳动，和贫穷痛苦的生活。 如果您能给这些无辜的孩子提供一个稳定的家，还请考虑领养。无论您是选择从我们这里、还是离您家更近的地方领养，您都可以改变一个孩子的人生。 想了解更多信息，请咨询 裂谷城，荣耀堂孤儿院 康斯坦斯·米切尔

original: Hi there.
traduit: 你好啊。

original: Did you see that?
traduit: 你看到了吗？

original: Oh my goodness!
traduit: 哦天啊！

original: Whoa! They killed Grelod! Ha ha ha ha ha!
traduit: 哇！他们杀了桂罗！哈哈哈哈哈哈！

original: Yeah! Get her! Kill her!
traduit: 耶！她死了！她死了！

original: Magic? That's dangerous. You want to learn that, go to that College in Winterhold. They teach that stuff there.
traduit: 魔法？那可是很危险的。你要想学，就去冬堡学院吧。他们在那儿教这东西。

original: Hey! I know. The Jarl's wizard could teach ya. He's lots closer.
traduit: 嘿！我知道。领主的宫廷巫师也能教你。他就在附近。

original: Goodbye, assassin.
traduit: 再见，刺客。

original: Are you a soldier? One day, I'm going to be a soldier!
traduit: 你是士兵吗？总有一天我也会去当兵的！

original: Pa says I'm too young to fight in the war, but I can still help by patrolling the town.
traduit: 爸爸说我太小了，不能去打仗，但我可以在镇上巡逻。

original: I wish I was a soldier! They get to travel and stay up late and have fun!
traduit: 我希望我是个士兵！他们可以旅行，可以熬夜，而且很好玩！

original: Have you met Lucky? He's my pet goat, and he helps me patrol the town.
traduit: 你见过幸运吗？他是我的宠物山羊，他帮我在镇上巡逻。

original: It's a wonderful house, my love. If you don't mind, I'm going to start a small store. Something to do whenever you're on the road.
traduit: 这房子太棒了，亲爱的。如果你不介意，我打算在这儿开家小店。你冒险的时候我可以做点事。

original: You have quite a house. I'm thinking of setting up a small store here. Sell odds and ends.
traduit: 你的房子真好啊。我打算在这里开家商店。卖些零碎东西。

original: Strange house, but strong. Solid. I think I'll open a store. A task to tend to whenever you're away.
traduit: 奇怪的房子，但很坚固。够结实。我想开家小店。你出门的时候我也有事可做。

original: This house of yours is wondrous, at least to these eyes. I've thought about starting a store. Something to do here when you're out.
traduit: 你的房子真是太棒了，至少我看起来不错。我想开家店。你出门的时候我可以做点什么。

original: This house is huge. I'll be tripping my feet all over this place. Hey, I think I'll start a little business here. Something to do, you know?
traduit: 这房子真够大的。我可以在这里好好活动了。嘿，我想在这里做点生意。总得找些事情做，你说呢？

original: I've seen bigger houses, but it's yours, so I like it. Now, I think I need something to do if you're ever away, so I'll be opening a store.
traduit: 我看过更大的房子，但这是你的，所以我很喜欢。我想在你出门的时候找点事做，开一家店吧。

original: A good house. You chose well. I don't like sitting still, so I've decided to open a store. Buy and sell whatever is needed.
traduit: 好房子。你选的不错啊。我不喜欢天天坐着，所以我打算开家店买卖些东西吧。

original: Assur had to move away because of the Empire. But we get to stay.
traduit: 阿苏尔因为帝国的关系不得不离开。但我们可以留下来。

original: The mages don't let us go in the College. They said it's not safe in there.
traduit: 法师们不让我们进学院，他们说里面不安全。

original: Assur says his pa says the College made lots of bad things happen, but the mages I've seen look nice.
traduit: 阿苏尔他爸说学院干了不少坏事，但我见过的法师人看上去都不错。

original: Assur and I are playing a game. Don't tell him where I am!
traduit: 阿苏尔和我在玩游戏。别告诉他我在哪儿！

original: There's not many people left in Winterhold, so I only have Assur to play with, and sometimes he's mean.
traduit: 冬堡剩下的人不多了，所以只有阿苏尔陪我玩，有时他很凶。

original: Assur always wants to play "Hunt the Elf" and he makes me be the Elf.
traduit: 阿苏尔总是想玩“狩猎精灵”，然后让我去扮精灵。

original: What're you lookin' at? I'm not afraid of you, ya know. Even if you are my elder.
traduit: 你看什么？告诉你，我不怕你。就算你是我长辈也没用。

original: Boys, girls, dogs, elders - there's nobody I won't fight!
traduit: 男孩、女孩、狗狗、老头，没人我不敢打！

original: I don't fight Lars no more, if that's what you're worried about.
traduit: 我不会再打拉斯了，你就别担心了。

original: Stupid Lars Battle-Born. I fight him almost every day, but it's not much of a fight, 'cause he don't fight back.
traduit: 笨蛋拉斯·战狂。我天天都和他打，但那算不上战斗，因为他不还手。

original: We're united, but where should we live? My home is yours, of course.
traduit: 我们结为一对了，但我们该住哪儿呢？当然了，我家就是你家。

original: I'm a married man! Hey, where should we live? I guess you could always stay with me.
traduit: 我也是结了婚的男人了！嘿，咱们要住哪里？你可以和我住一起。

original: Married. It doesn't feel like I thought it would, but I'm happy. Where should we live? You could stay with me....
traduit: 结婚了。和我想的不一样，但我很开心。我们该住哪里呢？你可以和我住一起……

original: This is the happiest day of my life. Where should we live? My home is your home now, of course.
traduit: 这是我一生中最快乐的一天。我们该住在哪里呢？当然了，我家就是你家。

original: We're married. I guess we'll need to decide where we're living, won't we? You can always stay with me.
traduit: 我们结婚了。我想咱们应该决定一下住在哪里了对吧？你可以跟我一直住一起。

original: I guess we have our entire lives together, now. Where should we live? You could stay with me....
traduit: 看来我们这一辈子都要永远在一起了。我们到哪里去住？你可以和我在一起……

original: We face the world together now. Where should we live? My home is yours.
traduit: 我们现在要一起面对世界了。我们到哪里住呢？来我家住也行哦。

original: Hey! Wanna play tag?
traduit: 嘿！想玩捉人游戏吗？

original: Hiya! What's your name? Are you visiting? What do you do?
traduit: 你好！你叫什么？你在参观吗？你做什么呢？

original: Papa says I won't see Roggvir any more, but he wouldn't tell me why not.
traduit: 爸爸说我再也见不到罗吉维尔了，但他不肯告诉我为什么。

original: My papa says I'm greg-gare-ree-yus, just like him! He says it means "smart," but my brother says he's wrong.
traduit: 我爸爸说我就像他一样“格雷格-格里-瑞-尤斯”，但我哥哥说他错了。

original: Papa used to say I was greg-gare-ree-yus, just like him. I miss him...
traduit: 爸爸以前常说我像他一样“格雷格-格里-瑞-尤斯”。我很想他……

original: I... I don't want to talk.
traduit: 我……我不想说话。

original: I don't have anything to say.
traduit: 我没什么可说的。

original: Pardon me.
traduit: 抱歉了。

original: Mother says I shouldn't talk to people...
traduit: 妈妈说我不该和别人说话……

original: You're a guest. And father says we have to be polite to guests.
traduit: 你是客人吧。爸爸说要对客人有礼貌。

original: Mama said I could help with the goats!
traduit: 妈妈说我可以帮忙照看山羊！

original: Father says I don't have the knack for reading, but mama says I won't need it to work the farm.
traduit: 爸爸说我没掌握阅读的诀窍，但妈妈说在农场工作不需要读书。

original: This is the Old Hroldan Inn. Clean beds and strong drink.
traduit: 这里是古霍尔丹旅店。请享受干净的客房和烈酒。

original: My mother's dead, but I won't close the inn. I've hired Leontius to run things.
traduit: 我母亲死了，但我不会关店的。我雇了莱昂提尤斯来看管。

original: If you drink too much, you're out. No drunks.
traduit: 如果你喝多了，那就出去。这里没有醉鬼的地方。

original: Changed the linens myself. They're fresh.
traduit: 都是我换的床单。很干净。

original: Why is everyone so upset? If there's Forsworn, the Jarl will take care of them, right?
traduit: 为什么大家都这么难过？如果有弃誓者，那领主会去处理的吧？

original: Hope Pavo will be able to go back to his mine soon. Everyone needs a home.
traduit: 希望帕沃能尽快回到自己的矿场。每个人都该有个家。

original: What'cha doing in Left Hand? Do you dig up rocks too, like my mom?
traduit: 你在左手矿场干什么？你也是和我妈妈一样来挖矿的吗？

original: Why do they call it Left Hand Mine? Can the miners use their right hands too?
traduit: 他们为什么管这里叫左手矿场呢？矿工们不能用右手吗？

original: Have you met Torom? He's the best dog in the Reach.
traduit: 你见过托罗姆吗？它是瑞驰最好的狗。

original: Hi! I've never seen you around here before. Are you a miner too?
traduit: 嗨！我没在这儿见过你。你也是矿工吗？

original: Sondas takes care of me when mom's not around.
traduit: 妈妈不在的时候松达斯会照顾我。

original: Derkeethus used to take me diving way down deep in the river. I miss him.
traduit: 德吉图斯曾经带我去河里潜水。我好想他。

original: Mom says the Empire is mean, but I don't think they're that bad.
traduit: 妈妈说帝国人很刻薄，但我觉得他们没那么坏。

original: The Stormcloaks are named after Ulfric. He's a bad man, but don't tell the soldiers that.
traduit: 风暴斗篷们拿乌弗瑞克的名字来命名。他是个坏人，但别跟士兵们这么说。

original: I can't believe my mother's gone. Now what'll I do?
traduit: 真不敢相信我妈妈走了。我现在该怎么办？

original: I knew it! I knew my father was a hero and he didn't just run away.
traduit: 我就知道！我爸爸是个英雄，他是不会逃跑的。

original: It's just me and my mother at the mill here. My father is gone. We don't know what happened to him.
traduit: 这里只有我和我妈妈。我父亲离开了。我们不知道他发生了什么。

original: I hope you're not here to start some trouble. I'll fight you if I have to.
traduit: 我希望你不是来找麻烦的。如果有必要，我来和你打。

original: My mother taught me the millwork trade... you know, which trees to cut and which ones to pass up.
traduit: 我妈妈教我做木工……你知道，得分清楚哪些树该砍，哪些不该砍。

original: Someday I'll take over the mill... when I'm old enough.
traduit: 总有一天我会接管木材厂……等我长大以后。

original: I'm not afraid of anyone. Put a sword in my hand and I could defend this place if I had to!
traduit: 我谁也不怕。只要我手里有把剑，必要时我就能保护这里！

original: Millwork sure is boring, but at least I don't have to work in a nasty mine.
traduit: 木工确实很无聊，但至少我不用在肮脏的矿井里工作。

original: If you beat up my sister Sissel, I won't tell.
traduit: 如果你打了我妹妹希塞尔，我不会说的。

original: Are you new around here? You should go to the inn if you need a place to stay.
traduit: 你是新来的吗？如果需要住的地方，就去旅店吧。

original: Sissel thinks she's so special. No way she's more special than me.
traduit: 希塞尔觉得她很特别。她不可能比我更特别。

original: I'm the older sister, by nearly five minutes. Sissel's barely worthy to walk in my shadow.
traduit: 我是姐姐，早了五分钟。希塞尔根本不配跟着我。

original: I wish I could be an adventurer like you, and go wherever I want.
traduit: 我希望能成为你这样的冒险家，去任何想去的地方。

original: I had a dream that there was a good dragon. He was old and gray, but he wasn't scary.
traduit: 我做了一个梦，梦里有头善良的龙。他又老又灰，一点也不吓人。

original: Most days, I do all I can to stay away from my sister and my father. The beating's the same from either one.
traduit: 大多数时候，我都会尽量躲着我姐姐和爸爸。两个人打人的方式都一样。

original: Some day soon I'll stop being afraid. Jouane is teaching me magic. He says I'm real good.
traduit: 总有一天我不会再害怕。乔安内在教我魔法。他说我真的很棒。

original: There's a new museum opening up in Dawnstar. The owner is asking me to hand out invitations to travelers.
traduit: 晨星新开了一家博物馆。馆长让我给旅行者们发请帖。

original: Here's a letter from the Jarl's steward. Looks like official business.
traduit: 这是领主总管寄来的信，似乎是有公务。

original: There's a new lady in charge of the Orphanage in Riften. She asked me to hand out these notices to everyone I met.
traduit: 裂谷城新换了一位女士负责孤儿院。她让我把这些通知派发给遇到的每一个人。

original: Ah, a letter from the Jarl! Moving up in the world, eh?
traduit: 啊，是领主送来的信！你正在往上爬啊？

original: Please, mister. You got to get me out of here. Ever since Aventus left, Grelod's been even meaner than usual. I swear, she's going to kill one of us.
traduit: 拜托了，先生。你得把我带出去。自从阿文图斯走了，桂罗比以前更刻薄了。我发誓，我们会有人被她杀了的。

original: Please, lady. You got to get me out of here. Ever since Aventus left, Grelod's been even meaner than usual. I swear, she's going to kill one of us.
traduit: 拜托了，女士。你得把我带出去。自从阿文图斯走了，桂罗比以前更刻薄了。我发誓，我们会有人被她杀了的。

original: I used to hate it here, but it's not so bad anymore. Constance is real good to us.
traduit: 我以前讨厌这里，但现在没那么糟了。康斯坦斯对我们很好。

original: It's too bad the orphanage ain't letting us kids get adopted. I'd be the best son ever.
traduit: 孤儿院不让我们这些孩子被领养真是太糟了。我会成为最好的儿子的。

original: I was named after the sound a lion makes. You know: rrroooaaaarr! Really.
traduit: 我是用狮子的叫声命名的。你听：洛——阿！真的。

original: I can't believe it! Grelod is dead! She's really dead!
traduit: 真不敢相信！桂罗死了！她真的死了！

original: I do hope mummy and father come to get me soon. Ever since that Aventus boy left, Grelod has been so angry.
traduit: 我真希望妈妈和爸爸快点来接我。自从阿文图斯那小子离开以后，桂罗一直很生气。

original: I do hope mummy and father come to get me soon. Ever since that Aventus boy left, this place has gone mad.
traduit: 我真希望爸爸妈妈快点来接我。自从阿文图斯那小子离开以后，这地方就疯了。

original: My parents dropped me off here a year ago. But they're coming back to get me. They said so.
traduit: 我父母一年前把我送到这里。但他们会来接我的。他们说了。

original: You look kind of scary. But nobody is scarier than old Grelod.
traduit: 你看起来有点吓人。但没人比老桂罗更可怕。

original: Constance Michel says we have to be careful of people we don't know.
traduit: 康斯坦斯·米切尔说我们得小心陌生人。

original: I'm really afraid of Grelod. When Aventus escaped, she was so mad. I got double the beatings that day.
traduit: 我真的很怕桂罗。阿文图斯逃跑的时候，她很生气。我那天挨的打比平常多两倍。

original: Kill one person, and you can solve so many problems. I wonder at the possibilities.
traduit: 杀个人，就能解决很多问题。我在想这种可能。

original: When Aventus escaped, Grelod was so mad. I got double the beatings that day. But that won't happen ever again.
traduit: 阿文图斯逃跑的时候，桂罗气疯了。我那天挨了两倍的打，但这再也不会发生了。

original: I hate it here. Grelod the Kind is the meanest person in all of Skyrim.
traduit: 我讨厌这里。慈祥的桂罗是全天际最刻薄的人。

original: Things are much better now that Grelod is dead, but still. I'm sick of this place.
traduit: 桂罗死后这里好多了，但还是不行。我讨厌这个地方。

original: I'm strong, and quick, and can do any chore you want. Come on, adopt me. Please?
traduit: 我很强壮，也很敏捷，而且可以做你想做的任何家务。拜托，请收养我吧。好吗？

original: When Aventus took off, when he said those things, about killing Grelod... I never imagined he was serious...
traduit: 阿文图斯离开时说的那些要杀死桂罗的话……我没想过他是认真的。

original: Come to get yourself a kid? You're out of luck. No way Grelod will let any of us get adopted. Especially not since Aventus took off.
traduit: 来收养孩子吗？你运气不好。桂罗不会让我们被收养的。尤其是阿文图斯跑了以后。

original: Grelod ain't going to like some stranger just hangin' around. Not that I care.
traduit: 桂罗不喜欢陌生人到处闲逛。但我不在乎。

original: Constance don't care much for strangers in the orphanage. Afraid someone might hurt one of us kids. Which, I gotta admit, is kind of nice.
traduit: 康斯坦斯不太在意孤儿院里的陌生人。但害怕有人会伤害我们这些孩子。我得承认，这样挺好的。

original: Why's someone like you want to hang around a place like this?
traduit: 为什么你这样的人会来这里呢？

original: Grelod... murdered. Here. I... I need... air... You... you... Get out of here! Get out!
traduit: 桂罗……被杀了。就在这儿。我……我需要……呼吸些空气……你……你……出去！快出去！

original: I can't believe Grelod is dead. I had no love for the woman, but to be murdered, in cold blood...
traduit: 真不敢相信桂罗死了。我一点也不喜欢这个女人，但被谋杀，还是太残忍了……

original: You really shouldn't be in here.
traduit: 你真的不应该进来。

original: I'm sorry, but the children aren't up for adoption right now. You should go.
traduit: 抱歉，但孩子们现在还不能被收养。你得走了。

original: My only concern is for the children. The poor darlings have no one else.
traduit: 我只关心孩子们。这些可怜的宝贝儿们没有别人了。

original: By the gods, a dragon's been sighted just south of the city, flying around Lost Tongue Overlook.
traduit: 神啊，城南发现了一条龙，飞过失语眺岩了。

original: You came to visit! It's so much better here with Grelod gone. Thanks to you.
traduit: 你来了！自从桂罗死了这里好多了。谢谢你。

original: You're new around here, so I'll go easy on ya. But don't get on my bad side.
traduit: 你是新来的，所以我会对你宽容点。但别惹到我。

original: Get me mad, and I'll prank ya. And not a little. A lot.
traduit: 让我生气，我就捉弄你。不止捉弄一下。很多的。

original: Ah, everybody around here's so serious.
traduit: 啊，这里每个人都那么严肃。

original: So I like to have a little fun, so what?
traduit: 我喜欢开点小玩笑，那又怎样啊？

original: My friend Dorthe doesn't like my pranking. "You're being mean, Frodnar!" So what if I am?
traduit: 我朋友朵西不喜欢我搞恶作剧。“你太无聊了，弗洛德纳！”就算是又怎么样？

original: Mother wants me to work at the mill. But I ain't nobody's slave.
traduit: 妈妈想让我去木材厂工作。但我不是任何人的奴隶。

original: You gotta have better things to do than talk to me all day...
traduit: 你肯定有比整天和我聊天更重要的事做……

original: Papa says I'm too friendly with strangers, but you seem all right.
traduit: 爸爸说我对陌生人太友好了，但你看起来不错。

original: My father is Alvor, the blacksmith. I'm his assistant. I mean, apprentice.
traduit: 我父亲是铁匠阿尔沃。我是他的助手，我是说，徒弟。

original: Some day I'm going to forge my own sword!
traduit: 总有一天我要锻造属于自己的剑！

original: Papa says I'm not ready for weapons. So I make lots of horseshoes and hobnails.
traduit: 爸爸说我还没准备好打造武器，所以我做了很多马蹄铁和钉子。

original: Mama doesn't think I'm girlish enough. But that's just stupid girl talk.
traduit: 妈妈觉得我不够女孩子气。但那只是女生的傻话。

original: Papa may have wanted a son, but he got me. He's a lucky man.
traduit: 爸爸也许想要个儿子，但他有了我。他很幸运。

original: Ain't nothin' a boy can do that I can't do better.
traduit: 男孩子能做的事，我也能做。

original: Oh. For some reason I didn't realize you were the same person all the stories were about...
traduit: 哦。不好意思，一时没有认出你就是传闻中的那个……

original: Well, in any case, you still need to kill those bandits, remember? Then we can discuss you buying property in Falkreath.
traduit: 无所谓，你还是要去杀了那些强盗，记得吗？然后咱们再来讨论你在佛克瑞斯买地的事。

original: I got your letter. I'm <Alias=Player>.
traduit: 我收到了您的信。我就是<Alias=Player>。

original: Ah, it's you. Yes, well, now we'll see if the stories about you are true.
traduit: 啊，是你啊。好吧，来让我们看看你的那些传闻是不是真的。

original: There's a group of bandits in my Hold that I... may have had a few discreet dealings with.
traduit: 我的领内有群强盗，我……可能和他们有些小交易。

original: The cut they were giving me was good at first, but now it's time to clean things up. Go and take care of it.
traduit: 他们一开始分我的还不错，但现在到了该清理的时候了。去把他们料理了。

original: There's that group of bandits that need to be taught a lesson, remember?
traduit: 有一群强盗需要被教训一顿，忘了？

original: Do you have any work you need done?
traduit: 你有什么工作要做吗？

original: You've proven reliable. There's a group of bandits in my Hold that I... may have had a few discreet dealings with.
traduit: 你确实够可靠。我的领地上有群强盗，我……可能跟他们做了些小交易。

original: How about hide-and-seek?
traduit: 捉迷藏怎么样？

original: I know all the good spots! You don't stand a chance!
traduit: 所有藏人的好地方我都知道！你没机会的！

original: You stand right there and count to 10. No peaking. Ready? Okay go!
traduit: 你就在那里数到十。不许偷看。准备好了吗？开始了！

original: Figures. You elders are always so boring.
traduit: 好吧。你们大人都是这么无聊。

original: Hey. You wanna play a game?
traduit: 嘿。想玩游戏吗？

original: Hello.
traduit: 你好。

original: I will be back at your house if you need me, Thane.
traduit: 如果你需要我，我就在你家里等着，武卫大人。

original: I'll keep watch at Lakeview Manor until you return, Thane. Good hunting.
traduit: 我在湖景庄园等您回来，武卫大人。祝你狩猎愉快。

original: I'll return to Windstad Manor and remain on guard, my Thane.
traduit: 那我就回风城庄园继续站岗，武卫大人。

original: As you command, Thane. I'll guard Heljarchen House until you return.
traduit: 遵命，武卫大人。在你回来前，我都会看守赫雅根大宅的。

original: I'll wait for you at the Jarl's Longhouse in Falkreath until you need me again, Thane.
traduit: 我会在佛克瑞斯的领主长屋等您再次召我，武卫。

original: I'll return to Highmoon Hall in Morthal until you need me again, Thane.
traduit: 我会在莫萨尔的悬月大厅等您再次召我，武卫。

original: As you command, Thane. I'll wait at the White Hall in Dawnstar until you need me again.
traduit: 遵命，武卫。我会在晨星的白色会堂等您再次召我。

original: (bark)
traduit: （犬吠）

original: Give me everything you're carrying, dog.
traduit: 狗，把你带的所有东西给我。

original: Of course, Thane. How can I be of service?
traduit: 当然，武卫。有什么需要效劳的？

original: Do you need something from me, Thane? Or can I carry something for you?
traduit: 有什么事吗，武卫？需要我帮您拿些东西吗？

original: What's mine is yours, Thane.
traduit: 我的东西就是您的东西，武卫大人。

original: I am sworn to carry your burdens.
traduit: 我发誓要为你承担一切。

original: I am at your command.
traduit: 我听你的指挥。

original: How can I serve you, my Thane?
traduit: 有什么需要效劳，武卫大人？

original: You're out in the middle of nowhere, aren't you?
traduit: 你怎么会在这荒无人烟的地方？

original: Don't have to tell me twice. But then, I'm not the one that buried iron under these mountains.
traduit: 别再这么说了。再说，把铁埋在山下面的又不是我。

original: Teach them to stop paying me.
traduit: 告诉他们别再付我钱了。

original: Here. You deserve a reward for your service.
traduit: 给。你的服务值得这份奖赏。

original: Great! Let's go!
traduit: 好啊！我们走！

original: My blade is yours to command, Thane.
traduit: 我的剑听候你的命令，武卫。

original: Lead on, Thane.
traduit: 带路吧，武卫。

original: I'm with you, Thane.
traduit: 我会跟随您，武卫。

original: As you will, my Thane. I will protect you with my life.
traduit: 如你所愿，武卫大人。我会用生命保护你。

original: As you command, my Thane.
traduit: 遵命，武卫大人。

original: I'll be right here. Be careful now!
traduit: 我就在这里。你自己小心！

original: Yes, Thane. Be careful.
traduit: 是，武卫。请小心。

original: I'm yours to command, Thane. I'll wait here until you need me.
traduit: 遵命，武卫。我会在这里等待您的召唤。

original: Don't be long. My place is by your side.
traduit: 请不要太久。我还是应该在您身边。

original: As you wish, my Thane.
traduit: 如你所愿，武卫大人。

original: I will remain on guard here.
traduit: 我会在这里警戒。

original: Watch your tongue, stranger. We don't take backtalk in this inn.
traduit: 说话小心点，陌生人。我们旅店不欢迎顶嘴的。

original: When I grow up, I'm going to be an assassin. That way I can help lots of children, just like you.
traduit: 等我长大了，我也要当刺客。这样我就能像你一样去帮很多孩子了。

original: We done?
traduit: 完事了？

original: Finally. I got stuff to do, ya know.
traduit: 终于结束了。我还有事。

original: Ten septims tomorrow, baby Battle-Born. Or I'm gonna bloody your nose and your lip.
traduit: 明天拿十个塞普汀，战狂小娃。不然我就把你鼻子和嘴唇都弄出血来。

original: No! Please! I really don't have any money, Braith! I'll give you ten septims tomorrow. Just don't hit me.
traduit: 不！拜托！我真没钱了，布赖斯！明天我给你十个塞普汀。别打我。

original: You'd better give me five septims right now, or I'm going to bloody your nose...
traduit: 你最好现在就给我五个塞普汀，不然就让你鼻子流血哦……

original: I... I don't have any money.
traduit: 我……我没钱了。

original: Battle-Born! Give me your money!
traduit: 战狂！把钱给我！

original: Yes. Braith bullies me all the time. All the elders think I'm a milk drinker 'cause I can't fight. Nobody understands.
traduit: 是，布赖斯一直欺负我。所有长辈都觉得我是个不会打架的懦夫。没人理解我。

original: If you can get Braith to leave me alone, I'll be your best friend... forever! I'll pay you, too! My whole life's savings - two septims!
traduit: 如果你能让布赖斯离我远点，我就是你最好的朋友……永远永远！我会给你钱的！我一生攒下来的所有积蓄都给你，两个塞普汀！

original: Having trouble?
traduit: 有麻烦吗？

original: Yeah? Why?
traduit: 啊？为什么？

original: You need to stop bullying Lars Battle-Born.
traduit: 你不能再欺负拉斯·战狂了。

original: Then by my right as Jarl, I name you Thane of Falkreath. Congratulations.
traduit: 那么我以领主之名，任命你为佛克瑞斯武卫。恭喜。

original: I grant you a personal Housecarl, and this weapon from my armory to serve as your badge of office.
traduit: 我会授予你一名私人侍卫，并从我的军械库中取出这把武器作为你的贵族身份象征。

original: I'll also notify my guards of your new title. Wouldn't want them to think you're part of the common rabble, now.
traduit: 我还会通知我的卫兵你拥有了新头衔。我可不想让他们把你当成普通老百姓。

original: I grant you this weapon from my armory to serve as your badge of office.
traduit: 我要从我的军械库中把这把武器授予你作为你的身份象征。

original: Then by my right as Jarl, I name you Thane of the Pale. Congratulations.
traduit: 那么我以领主之名，任命你为苍原武卫。恭喜。

original: Then by my right as Jarl, I name you Thane of Hjaalmarch. Congratulations.
traduit: 那么我以领主之名，任命你为希雅陲武卫。恭喜。

original: If there's nothing else, I really must ask you to leave.
traduit: 如果没有别的事，那我真得请你离开了。

original: Lead on, Thane. My blade is always yours to command.
traduit: 带路吧，武卫。我的剑永远听候您的命令。

original: Excellent. Lead on, Thane.
traduit: 好极了。带路吧，武卫大人。

original: Good. My place is by your side, Thane.
traduit: 好。我和您同在，武卫大人。

original: Five, four, three, two, one... go!
traduit: 五，四，三，二，一……开始！

original: Sure, tag sounds fun.
traduit: 好啊，抓人听起来挺有意思的。

original: Come back if you want to play tag.
traduit: 想玩捉人游戏要再来啊。

original: Papa doesn't like when I talk to customers, anyway.
traduit: 反正爸爸不喜欢我和顾客说话。

original: Thanks for talking to me.
traduit: 谢谢你和我说话。

original: For a stranger, you're not so bad.
traduit: 作为一个陌生人，你还不错。

original: Where are you thinking?
traduit: 你想去哪儿住呢？

original: Where?
traduit: 哪里？

original: You want to move? Where?
traduit: 你想搬家？去哪儿呢？

original: I was just getting settled in. Where are we going?
traduit: 我才刚安顿下来啊。我们搬去哪儿？

original: I'll see you there, then.
traduit: 那咱们那边见。

original: Very well. I'll meet you there.
traduit: 太好了。我们那边见吧。

original: All right. I'll see you there.
traduit: 好吧。我们那里见。

original: If that's what you want. I'll see you there, soon.
traduit: 如果这是你的想法，那我们就那地方见吧。

original: I'll see you there.
traduit: 我们那里见。

original: Our new home. I'll see you there!
traduit: 我们的新家啊。我们那边见吧！

original: Then I'll see you at home!
traduit: 那我们家里见！

original: A home for the two of us. I'll meet you there.
traduit: 我们彼此共同的家。我们那里见。

original: It will be our little nest. I'll be waiting for you there.
traduit: 那里将会是我们的小窝。我会到那儿等你的。

original: The two of us, living together. I'll see you at home!
traduit: 我们俩一起住。那家里见！

original: I'll see you at home, then. Don't keep me waiting!
traduit: 那咱们家里见。别让我等太久哦！

original: I'll be waiting for you at home, then.
traduit: 那我去家里等你。

original: Oh? Where?
traduit: 哦？哪里？

original: Oh really? And where were you thinking?
traduit: 哦真的？你想搬去哪儿呢？

original: And where would that be?
traduit: 那我们去哪儿呢？

original: I'll get everything ready and meet you there.
traduit: 我会把一切东西收拾好，然后到那里找你。

original: Someday I'm going to kill a dragon all by myself.
traduit: 总有一天，我要自己杀头龙。

original: I'm eleven years old, and I could take you.
traduit: 我已经十一岁了，能够打败你了。

original: I'd like to decorate my home.
traduit: 我想装修一下我家。

original: Very well, I'll make the arrangements. The next time you visit your house, your new furnishings will be in place.
traduit: 很好，我这就安排。下次去房子时，您的新家具就到位了。
