traduit: 我想让你为房子买些家具。

original: Entry Room. (<Global=BYOHHPCostEntryRoom> gold)
traduit: 门厅。（<Global=BYOHHPCostEntryRoom>金币）

original: Small House (<Global=BYOHHPCostEntryRoom> gold)
traduit: 小房子。（<Global=BYOHHPCostEntryRoom>金币）

original: Let me know if you change your mind.
traduit: 如果你改主意了，随时告诉我。

original: Then stop wasting my time.
traduit: 那就别浪费我的时间了。

original: Well, that's your business. Was there anything else you needed?
traduit: 好吧，反正是你的事。你还有什么需要吗？

original: Excellent. Then I grant you a title to the land.
traduit: 太好了。那我就给你这块地的所有凭证吧。

original: Excellent. We're glad to have you as a landowner in Hjaalmarch. Here's the title to your steading.
traduit: 太好了。我们很高兴你能成为希雅陲的地主。这是你的产权凭证。

original: If you don't mind getting your feet wet, your best bet is to head north past the mill. The odd tomb or two along the way won't bother you.
traduit: 不怕弄湿脚的话，就往北走，过了木材厂就到了。路上零星有几座坟墓，也不会碍你事。

original: The land is on the coast, across the Karth delta from Solitude. An inspiring location, as you'll see.
traduit: 那片地在海岸边，和独孤城隔着卡斯三角洲。那地方真叫人心旷神怡，你去了就知道。

original: No, I'm afraid not. But there is land if you want to buy it.
traduit: 恐怕不太行。但如果你想买地皮的话，还是可以的。

original: Yes, it is. The Jarl thought of you when it came up for sale.
traduit: 没错。要卖的时候，领主想起了你。

original: It's on the north coast of Hjaalmarch, with a magnificent view of Solitude on its crag. Just the place for a new manor house.
traduit: 这块地位于希雅陲北面的海岸边，可以看到悬崖上面独孤城的壮丽景色。是个建庄园的好地方。

original: There aren't any houses for sale in Morthal. But if you're interested, I could sell you land in the hold where you could build your own house.
traduit: 莫萨尔没有现房出售了。但如果你感兴趣，我可以卖给你一块领内的土地，你可以自己在那里建房。

original: Yes. It's on the north coast of Hjaalmarch, with a magnificent view of Solitude on its crag. Just the place for a new manor house.
traduit: 没错。这块地位于希雅陲北面的海岸边，可以看到悬崖上面独孤城的壮丽景色。是个建庄园的好地方。

original: Do you know where I can buy materials like glass or straw?
traduit: 你知道我去哪里能买到玻璃或稻草之类的吗？

original: I think we may have a problem in the basement. Been hearing a lot of scurrying down there lately.
traduit: 我觉得地窖出了些问题。最近经常有东西跑来跑去。

original: Absolutely not. No pets. Ever.
traduit: 绝对不行。不许养宠物。永远不许。

original: No. Now get it out of here.
traduit: 不行。现在就把它弄出去。

original: All right. But you're responsible for him.
traduit: 好吧。但是你要对他负责哦。

original: A rabbit?
traduit: 兔子？

original: A fox?
traduit: 狐狸？

original: A... mudcrab?
traduit: 泥沼蟹？

original: A... skeever?
traduit: 恶鼠？

original: I'll never speak to you again!
traduit: 我再也不想和你说话了！

original: Why... why did you do that?
traduit: 为什么……为什么你要这么做？

original: Leave me alone!
traduit: 离我远点！

original: No. No pets. Ever.
traduit: 不。不许养宠物。永远不许。

original: Sure. When I don't need him, he can stay with you.
traduit: 当然。我不需要他的时候，可以让他陪着你。

original: Thanks. Thanks... for everything, Pa.
traduit: 谢谢。谢谢……您做的一切，爸。

original: Thanks. Thanks... for everything, Ma.
traduit: 谢谢。谢谢……您做的一切，妈。

original: I have a family again. I... I can't thank you enough.
traduit: 我又有了一个家。我……我真的很感激您。

original: This is more than I ever could have hoped for. Thanks. Thanks so much.
traduit: 这比我期望的还要多。谢谢。非常感谢。

original: Thank you. Thanks... for everything.
traduit: 谢谢您。谢谢……您做的一切。

original: I... I know it's not much, but... I've found a few little things. I've put them in the chest in my room.
traduit: 我……我知道这不算什么，但……我找到些小玩意儿。我把它们都放在我房间的箱子里了。

original: If you see anything you want, take it. You've done so much for me... it's the least I can do.
traduit: 如果您看到有需要的东西，就拿去。您为我做的太多了……这是我最起码应该做的。

original: I... I know it's not much, but... I've found a few pretty things. They're in the chest in my room.
traduit: 我……我知道这不算什么，但……我找到些漂亮的小玩意儿。都放在我房间的箱子里了。

original: If you see anything you like, please, take it! You've done so much for me. It's... it's the least I can do.
traduit: 如果您看到有需要的东西，就请拿去吧。您为我做的太多了……这是我最起码应该做的。

original: This is... this is great! It's everything I could have asked for!
traduit: 真是……太棒了！这里有我想要的一切！

original: It's... it's everything I could have hoped for.
traduit: 这就是……我想要的一切。

original: A real home. A real family. I almost can't believe it.
traduit: 一个真正的家。一个真正的家庭。我简直不敢相信。

original: I... I have a home again. A family. I almost can't believe it.
traduit: 我……我又有家了。真不敢相信。

original: Is... is that your pet, Mama? He looks really scary!
traduit: 那是……您的宠物吗，妈妈？他看起来好吓人！

original: A doggy! Mama, I didn't know you had a doggy! He's so cute...
traduit: 狗狗！妈妈，我都不知道您有狗狗！好可爱……

original: A dog! Wow, I didn't know you had a dog!
traduit: 是狗！喔，我都不知道您养了狗！

original: A pet! Wow, I didn't know you had a pet!
traduit: 是宠物！喔，我都不知道您养了宠物！

original: Is... is that your pet, Papa? He looks really scary!
traduit: 那是……您的宠物吗，爸爸？他看起来好吓人！

original: Is... is that your pet? Really? Wow, he looks tough!
traduit: 那是……您的宠物吗？真的吗？喔，他看着好强壮！

original: A doggy! Papa, I didn't know you had a doggy! He's so cute...
traduit: 狗狗！爸爸，我都不知道您有狗狗！好可爱……

original: Look, Papa! I made a new friend!
traduit: 看，爸爸！我找了个新朋友！

original: Look, Mama! I have a new friend!
traduit: 看，妈妈！我找了个新朋友！

original: Pa! Look what followed me home!
traduit: 爸！看有个什么东西和我回家了！

original: Ma! Look what followed me home!
traduit: 妈！看有个什么东西和我回家了！

original: Where would I get that?
traduit: 那我上哪儿买呢？

original: Well... I heard there's a really nice tailor's in Solitude. And... and maybe the Khajiit sell dolls? They always have the best toys.
traduit: 嗯……我听说独孤城有家很好的裁缝店。还有……也许卡吉特的商队会卖娃娃？他们总是有最好玩的玩具。

original: I'm sure the Khajiit would have one- their toys are the best!
traduit: 我觉得卡吉特那里应该有，他们的玩具可好了！

original: For clothes... there's a tailor's shop in Solitude. I'm sure they'd have lots to choose from.
traduit: 衣服的话……独孤城有家裁缝店。他们那里应该有好多好多。

original: What would you like?
traduit: 你想要什么？

original: I'd... I'd really like a dolly. Or maybe a pretty new dress?
traduit: 我……我很想要个娃娃。或者一件新裙子？

original: Well, sweets are always good. Or a new outfit. Or... or maybe a wooden sword? All my friends have swords.
traduit: 嗯，如果有甜点就不错。或者新衣服。或者……也许是木剑？我的朋友们都有剑了。

original: I await your orders, Thane.
traduit: 我在等待您的命令，武卫大人。

original: Is it time to move out?
traduit: 要开始行动了？

original: I await your command, Thane.
traduit: 我等候您的命令，武卫大人。

original: Yes, my Thane? Do you need something?
traduit: 武卫大人？您有什么事吗？

original: What do you need, Thane?
traduit: 您有什么事，武卫大人？

original: What is it, Thane?
traduit: 怎么了，武卫大人？

original: I'll stand guard here.
traduit: 我会在这里守着。

original: Be careful, Thane.
traduit: 请小心，武卫大人。

original: I'll wait for you here.
traduit: 我会在这里等你。

original: Lead on, my Thane.
traduit: 请带路吧，武卫大人。

original: I'll follow your lead, Thane.
traduit: 我听从您的命令，武卫大人。

original: Onward, then.
traduit: 那就前进吧。

original: You know what? I like you. You're not afraid to get your hands dirty.
traduit: 你知道吗？我很中意你。你不怕弄脏自己的手。

original: I hereby grant you permission to purchase property in Falkreath hold. Talk to my steward if you're interested.
traduit: 我在此批准你在佛克瑞斯购置地产。如果你有兴趣，可以和我的总管谈谈。

original: Waaaaaaah....
traduit: 呜哇……

original: Milk-drinker.
traduit: 胆小鬼。

original: You... you take that back!
traduit: 你……你给我把那话收回去！

original: You can't catch me!
traduit: 你抓不到我的！

original: Grr... I'm gonna get you for that!
traduit: 嘎……我要抓住你！

original: Skeever-brain!
traduit: 恶鼠脑子！

original: Wolf-breath!
traduit: 狼味道！

original: Horker-face!
traduit: 海象脸！

original: Oh yeah? Well, I've seen mudcrabs that're smarter than you!
traduit: 哦，是吗？我见过的泥沼蟹都比你聪明！

original: Elf-ears!
traduit: 精灵耳！

original: Draugr-breath!
traduit: 尸鬼口臭！

original: Mammoth-nose!
traduit: 猛犸鼻子！

original: Well, you smell like a Hagraven. And you look like one, too!
traduit: 哼，你闻起来像个乌鸦鬼婆。长得也很像！

original: Hm. Well, if you change your mind, come see me again.
traduit: 嗯，好吧，如果你改主意，再来找我吧。

original: Hmph. Suit yourself. I can't promise someone else won't buy it in the meantime, though.
traduit: 嗯。随你的便吧。但我不能保证在此期间不会有人买下。

original: That's unfortunate. Maybe I misjudged you.
traduit: 这可不巧了。也许是我高估你了。

original: Then by my right as Jarl, I grant you a title to the land.
traduit: 那以领主的名义，我授予你这片土地的所有凭证。

original: Wonderful. I'll sleep better knowing you're watching the southern marches. Here's the title to your steading.
traduit: 太好了。知道你在南边住，我也能睡得安稳了。这是你的庄园所有凭证。

original: Just follow the road south from Dawnstar, past Fort Dunstad, then head south.
traduit: 从晨星往南走，路过丹斯塔德堡，然后再往南。

original: The land is near Giants' Gap, right on the border with Whiterun Hold. You'll almost be in sight of the Loreius Farm, in fact.
traduit: 这块地在巨人峡谷附近，在和白漫领的交界上。事实上你都可以看到罗瑞尤斯农场了。

original: No, I'm sorry. But there is land, available to you for purchase.
traduit: 不，很抱歉。但还是有土地可供购买的。

original: Land? Ah, yes. The Heljarchen estate. I thought of you immediately when it became available.
traduit: 土地？啊，没错。赫雅根庄园。一有可售卖的地我就想到你了。

original: It's in the south of the Pale, near Giants' Gap. Just the spot for someone like you to establish a steading.
traduit: 这片地位于苍原领的南部，巨人峡谷附近。是你这样的人安家的好地方。

original: Sorry, no houses for sale in Dawnstar right now. But... I could sell you land in the hold where you could build your own house.
traduit: 抱歉，晨星没有现房了。但是……我可以卖给你一块领内的土地。

original: Yes, it is. It's in the southern part of the Pale, right on the border with Whiterun Hold. All the room in the world to build your own house.
traduit: 没错。这片地位于苍原领的南部，就在白漫领的边界上。有的是地方让你建房子。

original: Bard. (<Global=BYOHHPCostBard> gold)
traduit: 吟游诗人。（<Global=BYOHHPCostBard>金币）

original: Flute.
traduit: 长笛。

original: You're a connoisseur, indeed. Not many appreciate the subtle beauty of the flute.
traduit: 您可真是个行家。很少有人懂得长笛的微妙之美的。

original: Drum.
traduit: 鼓。

original: Sit back and enjoy some classical drumming.
traduit: 请坐，享受些经典的鼓乐吧。

original: Lute.
traduit: 鲁特琴。

original: The most elegant of instruments. The pinnacle of the bardic art.
traduit: 最优雅的乐器。吟游诗人艺术的巅峰。

original: I'd like you to play a different instrument.
traduit: 你能不能换个乐器演奏。

original: Certainly. I am trained in the three traditional bardic instruments: lute, drum, and flute. Which would you prefer?
traduit: 当然。我学过三种传统吟游乐器，鲁特琴、鼓、长笛。您喜欢哪种？

original: I don't need your services any more.
traduit: 我不再需要你效劳了。

original: I'm sorry to hear that. It was my honor to have you as a patron. Please let your steward know if you want to hire me again.
traduit: 真遗憾。能有您这样的雇主是我的荣幸。如果您还想雇佣我，请告知您的管家。

original: Can you take a break?
traduit: 你能休息一下吗？

original: Your wish is my command, as always.
traduit: 您之愿，我之命，一如既往。

original: How about some instrumental music?
traduit: 来点器乐怎么样？

original: I'd like to make a request.
traduit: 我有个要求。

original: Of course, anything you like!
traduit: 好啊，随您吩咐！

original: C'mon boy, come with me.
traduit: 来吧，孩子，跟我来。

original: Enough. <Alias.ShortName=Child1>, go to your room.
traduit: 够了。<Alias.ShortName=Child1>，回你的房间去。

original: Enough. <Alias.ShortName=Child2>, go to your room.
traduit: 够了。<Alias.ShortName=Child2>，回你的房间去。

original: Cut it out, both of you.
traduit: 你俩都给我打住！

original: Allow me to introduce myself. I am the bard Llewellyn, known as "The Nightingale". Your steward has arranged for me to take service with you.
traduit: 请允许我自我介绍一下。我是吟游诗人卢埃林，人们都管我叫“夜莺”。您的管家安排我来为您服务。

original: Good day to you. I am Sonir, the bard that your steward has hired. Please let me know if there's anything specific you want to hear.
traduit: 祝您安好。我是索妮尔，是您管家雇来的吟游诗人。如果您有什么特别想听的，请随时告诉我。

original: Hello, my name is Oriella, the bard that you asked your steward to hire. I hope my music will be pleasing to you.
traduit: 您好，我是奥莉拉，您管家雇来的吟游诗人。希望我的音乐能够让您开心。

original: No, never mind.
traduit: 没有，当我没说。

original: Oh. Well then, I'd best be on my way.
traduit: 哦。那我还是走吧。

original: I've changed my mind. I'd like you to stay.
traduit: 我改主意了。我希望你留下来。

original: Ah, excellent! We'll just call this a misunderstanding between friends. I've already forgotten it, myself.
traduit: 啊，太好了！我们就当是朋友之间的误会吧。我已经忘了。

original: As you wish. We can consider this incident nothing more than an unfortunate misunderstanding.
traduit: 如您所愿。就当是个不凑巧的误会吧。

original: Good! I knew you couldn't have been serious when you dismissed me. Life without music is hardly worth living, is it?
traduit: 太好了！我就知道您要解雇我时不是认真的。没有音乐的生活毫无意义，难道不是吗？

original:
[pagebreak]

The Nirnroot Missive Revised Edition By Sinderion

[pagebreak]

[pagebreak] The following is a transcript of the speech given by Master Alchemist Sinderion at the Alchemical Symposium on Rain's Hand of 4E 02. It is a revised version of an earlier missive Sinderion gave to the same group several years before. We've done the best we could to preserve the original tone of his speech, but some light embellishments have been made for editorial reasons and for clarity. Sharmirin Raythorne, Imperial Scribe [pagebreak] would like to address the Symposium today with some startling revelations regarding the nirnroot. Although this curiously tenacious flora grows almost anywhere a significant body of water is present, it's extremely rare, and soon to become extinct. After years of extensive research, and the tireless efforts of my field assistant, I came into the possession of a large sampling of nirnroot. According to the theories presented by the noted Imperial Herbalist Chivius Regelliam, the nirnroot once flourished until a cataclysmic event severely reduced their numbers. Although many scholars reject the proposal that the Sun's Death event of 1E 668 catastrophically affected plant life, Chivius felt that the nirnroot's normal growth cycle was interrupted by the lack of sun for a full year. Whereas other plant species tend to "find a way," the nirnroot's mysterious magical nature made it especially susceptible to this climate shift. While this may or may not be the case, it's certainly true that the recorded sightings of nirnroot are declining as the years pass. Chivius's notes oddly describe the nirnroot as emitting a "brilliant yellowish glow." Contrary to this fact, the nirnroot of today has a soft, haunting blue-white glow. Subsequent studies by other scholars have failed to adequately explain this shift in hue. I propose that the nirnroot sensed its own impending extinction and therefore altered its metabolism in order to survive. One of the most glaring pieces of evidence of my theory is the presence of nirnroot in subterranean environments... places completely devoid of sunlight. Strangely, Chivius's notes fail to mention even a single instance of a subterrestrial nirnroot. How could this be? How could a surface-dwelling plant suddenly begin appearing in new locations radically different from its normal habitat? The answer, my fellow alchemists, is ironically concealed within Chivius's own notes. Although he spends a great deal of time experimenting with the nirnroot in his laboratory, he overlooked an important part of a plant's growth cycle... its soil. Chivius was correct in assuming the volcanic eruption of Red Mountain contributed to the demise of the nirnroot, but I believe the ash from that mighty explosion did more than simply cloud the skies. When mixed with the fertile soil of Cyrodiil, this fine powder is the true cause of the nirnroot's astounding metamorphosis. Although little volcanic ash from that dark time remains, I have performed tests on samples sent to me from Vvardenfell. Careful scrutiny of the samples revealed that they were rife with "ash salt," a highly magical substance. Dunmer native to the Vvardenfell region were known to have used ash salt as an ingredient to cure the "Blight," an awful disease which decimated their realm hundreds of years ago. This unique property of the ash salt coupled with the nirnroot's inherent magic caused the radical change... in essence; the root "healed itself." In summation, it's clear that the nirnroot was dying and used a byproduct of its destructor to preserve itself. I feel the nirnroot has accomplished in a relatively short amount of time what it would take other species thousands of years to complete. Whether you subscribe to my theory or not, one thing is certain; the nirnroot is on a path to destruction. It contains untapped potential to create potions the likes of which have never been seen in our day. I propose to you today that we divert a small portion of our funds to an expedition to collect some of these roots to study. I have outlined this proposal for your perusal after this section of the Symposium. Please, seriously consider this proposal before it becomes too late, and the nirnroot becomes nothing but a memory. Thank you for your time.

奈恩根书信 修订版 辛德莱昂 著

[pagebreak]

[pagebreak] 下文是炼金大师辛德莱昂于4E02年雨手月的炼金术研讨大会上所做的演讲。是辛德莱昂数年前给同一团体的信件的再修订。我们已尽最大努力来保持其演讲的原本基调，但出于编辑和清晰文理的考虑而略加修饰。 帝国抄写员 沙米林·雷霍恩 [pagebreak] 我希望在今天的研讨会上发表关于奈恩根的惊人发现。 尽管这种奇特而顽强的植物几乎可能生长在任何重要水体附近，但却非常罕见，几近灭绝。经过多年广泛研究，以及我的田野助手不懈努力，我获得了大量奈恩根样本。根据著名帝国草药学者奇维乌斯·雷格里姆的假说，奈恩根曾一度繁荣，直到一场灾难性事件导致了数量严重减少。尽管许多学者反对1E668年的“日之死”事件灾难性地影响了植物生命的说法，但奇维乌斯认为，一整年没有阳光导致了奈恩根的正常生长周期被打断了。尽管其他植物倾向于“另寻他路”，但奈恩根的神秘魔法性质使其特别容易受到气候变化的影响。情况究竟如何不得而知，但随着时间推移，有记录的奈恩根目击事件正在减少却是毋庸置疑的。 奇维乌斯的笔记里奇怪地描述奈恩根散发的是“明亮的黄色光芒”。与此相反，今天的奈恩根散发的是一种柔和迷人的蓝白色光芒。其他学者后续的研究也未能充分解释这种色调变化的原因。我个人认为是奈恩根感受到了自己即将灭绝，因此改变了自己的代谢方式来求得生存。我这一猜想的最明显证据之一就是地下环境中存在的奈恩根，能够在完全没有阳光的地方生存。奇怪的是，奇维乌斯的笔记里从没提到过奈恩根在地下生长的案例。这又是怎么回事？一种地表植物怎么会突然出现在与其正常栖息环境截然不同的新地方呢？ 炼金同仁们，讽刺的是，答案就隐藏在奇维乌斯自己的笔记中。尽管他花了大量的时间在实验室里对奈恩根进行实验，但他忽略了植物生长周期里的一个重要部分--土壤。奇维乌斯认为红山的火山爆发导致了奈恩根的灭绝，这是正确的，但我相信那次巨大爆炸产生的火山灰不仅仅是使天空蒙上了云。当与希罗帝尔的肥沃土壤混合时，这种细粉末就成了奈恩根巨大变化的真正原因。尽管那段黑暗时期的火山灰所剩无几，但我已经对瓦登费尔寄给我的样本进行了测试。仔细检查这些样品，发现它们充满了“灰烬盐”，这是一种非常神奇的物质。丹莫出生在瓦登费尔地区，他们使用灰烬盐作为治疗“枯萎病”的原料，这种可怕的疾病在几百年前摧毁了他们的王国。灰烬盐的独特属性加上奈恩根的内在魔力导致了彻底的变化……从本质上说，就是奈恩根“自愈”了。 总之，很明显，奈恩根在灭绝过程中使用了毁灭自己之物的一个副产品来保存自己。我觉得奈恩根在相对较短的时间内完成了其他物种需要数千年才能完成的事情。 不管你是否赞同我的理论，有一件事是肯定的;奈恩根正在走向毁灭。它蕴含着未开发的潜力，可以创造出我们今天从未见过的药水。我今天向你们提议，从我们的基金中拨出一小部分来进行一次探险，收集这些根进行研究。在研讨会的这一部分之后，我会总结此提议供你们阅读。请认真考虑，否则就太迟了，到时候奈恩根将成为回忆。 感谢聆听。

original: Hamelyn's Journal
traduit: 哈姆林的日记

original:
<font face='$HandwrittenFont'>
Ten years of ridicule. Ten years of imprisonment. Ten years of exile.

The children threw rocks and the women spat upon me as the menfolk dragged me into Whiterun's prison. They branded me a danger to their pitiful existence... used words like "madman" and "insane." Could a madman escape the prisons undetected? Could a lunatic establish a laboratory right under their noses? Could a psychopath create a mighty army from the common skeever?

My days as an apprentice alchemist in Winterhold were no better. Those egotistical braggarts couldn't compete with my abilities. Where they fell short, I'd constantly excel. Did they appreciate my genius? Did they relish my contributions? No. My instructors beat me and said I was irresponsible, and the Arch Mage cast me into the streets like a common beggar.

As my enemy grows complacent and weak, as they forget Hamelyn and his utter brilliance, I build my army. I use every bit of knowledge at my disposal to forge their demise. Thanks to Sabjorn's unwitting assistance, my legion grows stronger every day. The irony that the same ingredients used to make his vile drink could be used to feed my offspring isn't lost upon me.

Oh, they will pay. Their ignorance of impending annihilation amuses me. I will bury Whiterun and watch Winterhold burn. And when they experience the fury I've unleashed upon them, when my progeny are gnawing the flesh from their bones, they will come begging and groveling at my feet. But there will be no mercy, no quarter and no leniency. And I will laugh and I will dance and I will rejoice over their mangled, broken corpses. The time for recompense has arrived.

Ten years of pain. Ten years of misery. Ten years of death.
traduit:
<font face='$HandwrittenFont'>
十年的嘲笑。十年的监禁。十年的流浪。

当他们把我拖向白漫城监狱的时候，小孩朝我扔石头，女人向我吐口水。他们觉得我对他们可怜的生存状态造成威胁了……骂我是个“疯子”“傻子”。疯子能逃狱吗？精神病能在他们眼皮子地下建立实验室吗？变态能用普通的恶鼠造出一支大军吗？

我在冬堡当炼金师学徒的日子也好不到哪儿去。那些骄傲自大的吹牛大王能力根本比不上我。他们做不到的，我能做到。他们有欣赏过我吗？有肯定过我的贡献吗？不。我的导师们都在打击我，说我不负责任，大法师把我像乞丐一样扔到了街上。

我的敌人变得自满软弱，他们忘记了哈姆林的辉煌，可我却建立了自己的军队。我要利用我掌握的一切知识来消灭他们。多亏了撒布乔恩在他不知情的情况下对我的帮助，我的军团一天比一天强大了。讽刺的是，做他那恶心饮料的原材料也可以用来喂我的崽子们。

他们会付出代价的。他们对即将到来的毁灭一无所这，真是好笑。我要葬送白漫城，亲眼看着冬堡化为灰烬。让他们体验到我的怒火，等我的孩儿们啃食他们的骨肉的时候，他们会来求饶，匍匐在我的脚下。但我们不会手下留情。我一定会大笑，我一定会跳舞，我会因他们残破的尸骸而欢喜。是时候还债了。

十年的痛苦。十年的惨境。十年的死亡。

Atlas of Dragons 2E 373 Compiled by Brother Mathnan

[pagebreak] Herein is recorded the list of known dragons, both living and dead, including those slain by the Dragonguard since the time of its founding, as well as those slain in earlier ages, where they can be identified. Unfortunately, only a few of the dragons slain by our Akaviri predecessors during the Crusade were recorded and thus this list is sadly incomplete. [pagebreak] Deceased by Report Nahagliiv - Local tales name him as the dragon buried in the mound west of Rorikstead. No date associated with his death, although almost surely dates to the Dragon War era. Odahviing - Records dating to the Crusade of interrogation of captured Dragon Cultists indicate that this dragon was buried in a mound in the southeast of Skyrim, near Riften. Sahloknir - Local legends claim this is the dragon buried in the mound near Kyne's Grove, slain by the Nord hero Jorg Helmbolg in the First Era. Viinturuth - Death dating back to Dragon War era, according to documents recovered from Dragon Cult temples which record his burial near Lake Yorgrim. Vuljotnaak - Death dating back to Dragon War or just after, according to recovered Dragon Cult documents, which record his burial in a mound near Granite Hill. [pagebreak] Slain by the Dragonguard Grahkrindrog - Slain in 2E 184 after perpetrating great slaughter in Winterhold and Eastmarch. Name confirmed with assistance from the College mages. Krahjotdaan - Slain in 1E 2871 in the southern Jerall Mountains, name confirmed by the dragon's own account. Unnamed Dragons - Numbering 12, as recorded in the Annals dating back to the founding of Sky Haven Temple. [pagebreak] Known to Live Ahbiilok - Sightings dating back to the early years of the Dragonguard throughout the northern Jerralls. Multiple attempts to kill him have failed. He is believed to be lairing somewhere in Morrowind. Mirmulnir - Last sighted in the Reach in 2E 212. Nahfahlaar - Repeated alliances with mortal protectors which have prevented his elimination. His last known protector was the King Casimir II of Wayrest, which the Dragonguard successfully ended in 2E 369. He escaped and current location is unknown. Paarthurnax - The legendary lieutenant of Alduin in the Dragon War. He is now known to lair on the Throat of the World under the protection of the Greybeards of High Hrothgar. Master Araidh continues the established policy of avoiding direct confrontation with the Greybeards while waiting for an opportunity to exact justice upon him.

[pagebreak] 这里记录已知的龙族名录，包括仍存活的和已死的，已死的记录可辨别是早期被杀还是龙卫成立以来被杀。不幸的是，神圣远征中被我们的祖先阿卡维尔人杀死的龙只有少数被记录下来，因此这个名单很遗憾是不完整的。 [pagebreak] 已死报告 纳哈格立夫-当地传说称他就是埋在洛利克镇西边龙冢里的龙。没有关于他死亡的确切日期，只能确定是巨龙战争时期。 傲达威英-讨伐被俘拜龙教教徒的记录显示，该龙被埋在天际东南接近裂谷城的一个龙冢里。 撒洛克尼尔-当地传说称他就是埋在凯娜之林附近龙冢里的龙。于第一纪元被诺德英雄约格·海姆伯格讨伐。 维图鲁斯-死亡时间可追溯到巨龙战争时代，根据从拜龙教神殿里找到的文书，他被埋在约格利姆湖附近。 福爵纳克-死亡时间可追溯到巨龙战争时期或战争刚刚结束，根据复原的拜龙教文书，他被埋在花岗岩山丘附近的龙冢里。 [pagebreak] 被龙卫所杀的 格拉克林德罗格-2E184年在冬堡及东陲两领内犯下大屠杀后被杀。学院法师协助下，名字得以确认。 克拉爵丹尼-1E2871年讨伐于杰拉尔山脉南部，该龙亲口描述了自己的名字。 无名龙-编号12，根据编年史记载，可以追溯到天佑神殿建立。 [pagebreak] 已知存活的 阿比洛克-龙卫早年在杰拉尔山脉北部发现其踪迹。多次尝试杀死未果。该龙可能藏匿在晨风某地。 米拉墨尼尔-最后一次发现记录为2E212年的瑞驰。 纳法拉尔-多次与凡人结盟，庇护者阻止他被消灭。最后一个已知的庇护者是途歇国王卡西米尔二世，龙卫在2E369年成功结束了他的统治。该龙现已逃脱，目前下落不明。 帕图纳克斯-巨龙战争中奥杜因的传奇副将。他现在由霍斯加修道院的灰胡子保护，藏身于世界之喉。宗师阿莱伊德继续执行既定政策，避免与灰胡子直接对抗，同时等待对他的正义审判。

original:
<font face='$HandwrittenFont'>
I don't know why I let Anders talk me into this plan. He said the place would be full of riches, but I have yet to see even a single gold coin. To make matters worse, I think the other priests are beginning to suspect we aren't who we say we are. If they discover we're posing as priests of Nocturnal, I'm sure they're not going to simply ask us to leave nicely. I'll have to watch my step.

As an "acolyte of Nocturnal," I've been assigned a mentor. Old dark elf fellow by the name of Lythelus. Maybe if I act the part, I can pry some information from him about the Pilgrim's Path. Anders swears to me that all of the temple's wealth is stashed within their inner sanctum, which supposedly sits at the end of the path, so my job is to get us through the obstacles alive.

Lythelus was easier to coax than I expected. Gave me a wealth of information on the Pilgrim's Path, but he was speaking in riddles. I'll try to record what I remember here and share it with Anders after he's done with his mentor. The only thing Lythelus seemed clear about was that there were five "tests" on the path. This what he said about each:

"Shadows of their former selves, sentinels of the dark. They wander ever more and deal swift death to defilers."

"Above all they stand, vigilance everlasting. Beholden to the murk yet contentious of the glow."

"Offer what She desires most, but reject the material. For her greatest want is that which cannot be seen, felt or carried."

"Direct and yet indirect. The path to salvation a route of cunning with fortune betraying the foolish."

"The journey is complete, the Empress's embrace awaits the fallen. Hesitate not if you wish to gift her your eternal devotion."

He also mumbled some nonsensical phrases like "night is the new day" and how he was the "ghost of the sun." I have no idea what these cryptic sentiments mean, but hopefully during tomorrow's ritual, Anders and I will put everything we've learned to the test.
traduit:
<font face='$HandwrittenFont'>
真不知道我是怎么同意和安德斯执行这个计划的。他说那地方一定满是宝藏，但我连个金币都没找到。更糟糕的是，其他祭司可能开始怀疑我们的身份了。要是他们发现我们冒充诺克图娜尔的祭司，那肯定是没法善了了。我得小心。

作为“诺克图娜尔的侍祭”，我被指派了一位导师。叫做“莱瑟鲁斯”的暗精灵老东西。如果我能扮演好角色，兴许能从他那里打听到关于朝圣之路的情报。安德斯发誓说神殿的所有财宝都藏在密室里，而密室就在路的尽头，所以我的工作就是确保我们活着通过这些阻碍。

莱瑟鲁斯比我想的还好哄。他跟我说了好多朝圣之路的信息，但说得都是谜语。我试着记录下在这里记下的东西，等安德斯跟导师谈完后，再和他分享。莱瑟鲁斯唯一清楚的似乎是，在这条路上有五个“试炼”。他如是评价：

“他们是黑暗的哨卫，留下了自己的影子，他们四处游荡，迅速杀死亵渎之人。”

“最重要的是，时刻保持警惕，光芒的争议会带来蒙恩的黑暗。”

“将她欲迎还拒的物质献上。她最大的需求是那看不见、摸不着、拿不动的东西。”

“直接却又间接。救赎之路亦是命运背叛愚者的狡诈之路。”

“旅程已然结束，女皇的怀抱正等待着堕落之人。想要把你永远的忠诚献上，就不要犹豫。”

他还咕哝了一些不知所云的话，比如“黑夜就是新的白昼”还有什么他如何是“太阳的幽灵”。我不知道这些神秘的感想意味着什么，但希望我和安德斯能在明天的仪式上把学到的一切付诸行动。

original:
<font face="$HandwrittenFont" size="20">
It seemed like an easy enough job. Groz and me done plenty like it before. Some chinless Breton wants bodyguards for a trip into the mountains. Fine. Easy clink for us.

He goes on about this twice-forsaken mask of his the whole way, of course. Got a pretty good laugh when Groz snatched it and put it on her face - he threatened to fire us for that one. Not smart out here on your own, he realized that right fast and shut up about not paying.

So we get here, he thumbs through some papers and mutters to himself - never you mind that me and Groz had to cut through ten stinking trolls just to get him here - and without so much as a warning, poof.  He's put on that mask and vanished. Could have put my hands on his throat one moment, the next he's not so much as thin air.

Well, after a while we didn't know what to do, and Groz picks her gear up to head home, when he poofs back, that mask in his hand. Begs us not to leave, says he needs us to wait, this is what he's paying us for. Then puts the mask back on his sorry face and he's gone again. I'd seen cloaks do invisibility before, but a few swings of my fist proved he wasn't pulling that one. Nothing there to hit.

He shows up again, tells us he just needs more time. Has to figure out something about other masks, and vanishes again. That was yesterday, and I'm done with twiddling my thumbs and writing letters to myself. We're leaving come sunrise, and if he shows up again I promise Azura I'm putting this dagger through his chest to keep him in one place. We'll pull more loot off him dead than he could have paid alive. But not the mask. That cursed thing can stay and rot with him and the trolls right here.
</font>
traduit:
<font face="$HandwrittenFont" size="20">
这工作看似很轻松。我和格罗兹以前干过很多类似。有个胆小的布莱顿人想带几个保镖进山。好吧，对我们来说不叫事。

当然，他一路上都在说他那被两次遗忘的面具。当格罗兹抢过来放在她脸上时，她笑得很开心——威胁说要为此解雇我们。但他很快就意识到一个人在这地方独行多么不明智，所以也就闭嘴不提不付钱的事了。

我们到了，我和格罗兹为了把他弄到这里，干掉了十个臭气熏天的巨魔。他翻着一些文件，自言自语，然后连个提示都没有，噗的一声，戴上面具就消失了。我本可以在上一秒把手放在他的喉咙上，下一秒他就不是空气了。

过了一段时间，我们不知道该怎么办了，格罗兹收拾好装备准备回家，他噗的一声又回来时手里还拿着面具。他求我们别走，说要我们等，这就是他付钱给我们的原因。然后把面具戴回他那可怜的脸上，他又走了。我以前见过斗篷能隐身，可我挥了几拳，就知道他没耍那一招，他是又消失了。

他又出现了，告诉我们他只是需要更多时间。必须找出其他面具的奥秘，然后再次消失了。那是昨天的事了，我已经厌倦了无聊和给自己写信解闷了。我们天亮就走，如果他再出现，我向阿祖拉保证，我会用这把匕首刺穿他的胸膛，让他再也不能来回乱跑。他死后，我们会从他身上抢到比他活着还多的钱。但我可不要那个面具。那个被诅咒的东西可以留在这里和他还有巨魔一起腐烂。
</font>

The Book of the Dragonborn by Prior Emelene Madrine Order of Talos Weynon Priory Year 360 of the Third Era, Twenty-First of the Reign of His Majesty Pelagius IV

[pagebreak] [pagebreak]

any people have heard the term "Dragonborn" - we are of course ruled by the "Dragonborn Emperors" - but the true meaning of the term is not commonly understood. For those of us in the Order of Talos, this is a subject near and dear to our hearts, and in this book I will attempt to illuminate the history and significance of those known as Dragonborn down through the ages.

Most scholars agree that the term was first used in connection with the Covenant of Akatosh, when the blessed St. Alessia was given the Amulet of Kings and the Dragonfires in the Temple of the One were first lit. "Akatosh, looking with pity upon the plight of men, drew precious blood from his own heart, and blessed St. Alessia with this blood of Dragons, and made a Covenant that so long as Alessia's generations were true to the dragon blood, Akatosh would endeavor to seal tight the Gates of Oblivion, and to deny the armies of daedra and undead to their enemies, the Daedra-loving Ayleids." Those blessed by Akatosh with "the dragon blood" became known more simply as Dragonborn.

The connection with the rulers of the Empire was thus there from the beginning - only those of the dragon blood were able to wear the Amulet of Kings and light the Dragonfires. All the legitimate rulers of the Empire have been Dragonborn - the Emperors and Empresses of the first Cyrodilic Empire founded by Alessia; Reman Cyrodiil and his heirs; and of course Tiber Septim and his heirs, down to our current Emperor, His Majesty Pelagius Septim IV.

Because of this connection with the Emperors, however, the other significance of the Dragonborn has been obscured and largely forgotten by all but scholars and those of us dedicated to the service of the blessed Talos, Who Was Tiber Septim. Very few realize that being Dragonborn is not a simple matter of heredity - being the blessing of Akatosh Himself, it is beyond our understanding exactly how and why it is bestowed. Those who become Emperor and light the Dragonfires are surely Dragonborn - the proof is in the wearing of the Amulet and the lighting of the Fires. But were they Dragonborn and thus able to do these things - or was the doing the sign of the blessing of Akatosh descending upon them? All that we can say is that it is both, and neither - a divine mystery.

The line of Septims have all been Dragonborn, of course, which is one reason the simplistic notion of it being hereditary has become so commonplace. But we know for certain that the early Cyrodilic rulers were not all related. There is also no evidence that Reman Cyrodiil was descended from Alessia, although there are many legends that would make it so, most of them dating from the time of Reman and likely attempts to legitimize his rule. We know that the Blades, usually thought of as the Emperor's bodyguards, originated in Akaviri crusaders who invaded Tamriel for obscure reasons in the late First Era. They appear to have been searching for a Dragonborn - the events at Pale Pass bear this out - and the Akaviri were the first to proclaim Reman Cyrodiil as Dragonborn. In fact it was the Akaviri who did the most to promote his standing as Emperor (although Reman himself never took that title in his lifetime). And of course there is no known hereditary connection between Tiber Septim and any of the previous Dragonborn rulers of Tamriel.

Whether there can be more than one Dragonborn at any time is another mystery. The Emperors have done their best to dismiss this notion, but of course the Imperial succession itself means that at the very least there are two or more potential Dragonborn at any time: the current ruler and his or her heirs. The history of the Blades also hints at this - although little is known of their activities during the Interregnum between Reman's Empire and the rise of Tiber Septim, many believe that the Blades continued to search out and guard those they believed were (or might be) Dragonborn during this time.

Lastly, we come to the question of the true meaning of being Dragonborn. The connection with dragons is so obvious that it has almost been forgotten - in these days when dragons are a distant memory, we forget that in the early days being Dragonborn meant having "the dragon blood". Some scholars believe that was meant quite literally, although the exact significance is not known. The Nords tell tales of Dragonborn heroes who were great dragonslayers, able to steal the power of the dragons they killed. Indeed, it is well known that the Akaviri sought out and killed many dragons during their invasion, and there is some evidence that this continued after they became Reman Cyrodiil's Dragonguard (again, the connection to dragons) - the direct predecessor to the Blades of today.

I leave you with what is known as "The Prophecy of the Dragonborn". It often said to originate in an Elder Scroll, although it is sometimes also attributed to the ancient Akaviri. Many have attempted to decipher it, and many have also believed that its omens had been fulfilled and that the advent of the "Last Dragonborn" was at hand. I make no claims as an interpreter of prophecy, but it does suggest that the true significance of Akatosh's gift to mortalkind has yet to be fully understood.

When misrule takes its place at the eight corners of the world

When the Brass Tower walks and Time is reshaped

When the thrice-blessed fail and the Red Tower trembles

When the Dragonborn Ruler loses his throne, and the White Tower falls

When the Snow Tower lies sundered, kingless, bleeding

The World-Eater wakes, and the Wheel turns upon the Last Dragonborn.

龙裔之书 塔洛斯教团 维农修道院 埃梅灵·玛德琳院长 著 第三纪元360年 佩拉吉奥斯四世陛下 治理第二十一年

[pagebreak] [pagebreak]

许多人都听说过“龙裔”这个词（我们自然是由“龙裔皇帝”统治的）但这词的真正含义并不广为人知。我们塔洛斯教团而言，十分珍视这一主题。本书中，我将尝试阐明世代相传的龙裔之历史与意义。

学界普遍认为这个词最早与阿卡托什圣约有关，当时圣阿莱西亚获赐诸王护符，至尊神殿的龙火得以首次点燃。“阿卡托什怜悯地看着身处困境的人类，从自己心脏中抽出宝贵的鲜血，以此龙血赐福于圣阿莱西亚，订立盟约：只要阿莱西亚的后代效忠于龙血，阿卡托什就会尽力封闭湮灭之门，阻挡他们的敌人——信奉迪德拉的亚历德族所召唤的迪德拉大军与不死族。”那些被阿卡托什用“龙血”赐福的人被简而称之为龙裔。

因此，龙裔与帝国统治者的联系从最初便存在了--只有身怀龙血之人能够佩戴诸王护符，点燃龙火。帝国的合法统治者皆为龙裔：阿莱西亚建立的第一帝国的诸位皇帝与女皇、雷曼·希罗帝尔及其继承人、还有泰伯·塞普汀及其继承人，一直到当今的佩拉吉奥斯·塞普汀四世陛下。

然而由于这种与皇帝们的联系，龙裔的其他意义早已被世人遗忘，除了我们这些献身服务于曾为泰伯·塞普汀的神圣塔洛斯的学者、信徒。很少有人意识到，龙裔并非简单的遗传之事，而是阿卡托什的赐福。至于赐福的方式与原因则超出了我们理解能力。有佩戴诸王护符点燃龙火为证，那些加冕为帝、点燃龙火之人毫无疑问是龙裔。但究竟是因为他们是龙裔才能办成这些事，还是说办成这些事就是阿卡托什降下赐福的标志？我们只能说那是神圣的奥秘：两者皆是或皆非。

塞普汀一脉都是龙裔，当然这也是龙裔为何被普遍认为是简单遗传的原因之一。但我们可以确定的是早期的希罗帝尔统治者并非全部具有血缘关系。也没有实证表明雷曼·希罗帝尔是阿莱西亚的后裔，虽然有很多类似的传说，但大多都只能追溯到雷曼的时代，很可能只是为雷曼的统治提供合法化依据。我们知道，通常被视为皇帝亲卫的刀锋会，起源于第一纪元末期因不明原因入侵泰姆瑞尔的阿卡维尔圣战者。他们似乎一直在寻找龙裔（有苍白隘口之事为证），阿卡维尔人最先声称雷曼·希罗帝尔为龙裔。事实上正是阿卡维尔人为提升雷曼的地位至皇帝做了最大努力（尽管雷曼一生中从未得到这个头衔）。当然，泰伯·塞普汀也并未与泰姆瑞尔以前的龙裔统治者们有任何已知的世系关联。

任意时代是否会同时出现多位龙裔则是另一个谜。皇帝们都会尽其所能来消除这种观念，但话说回来，皇位继承本身意味着任意时代至少有两个以上的潜在龙裔：现任统治者及其继承人。刀锋会的历史也暗示了这点，尽管他们在雷曼皇朝至泰伯·塞普汀崛起之间的“空位时期”活动隐秘，但许多人相信他们是在坚持搜寻并保卫自己认为是（或可能是）龙裔的人。

最后，我们来谈谈龙裔的真实意义。他们与龙之间的联系如此明显，以至于在龙族成为遥远记忆的今天被忘记了。我们忘了，在早期，成为龙裔意味着拥有“龙血”，一些学者认为虽然确切意义不明，但这就是字面意思。诺德人中流传着龙裔英雄的传说，作为强大的屠龙者，他们能够偷取所杀龙的力量。确实，阿卡维尔人在入侵期间追寻并屠戮了很多的龙，一些证据表明他们在成为雷曼·希罗帝尔的龙卫后（又是与龙有关）依然保持这一做法（龙卫是当今刀锋会的前身）。

我将“龙裔预言”奉送诸位。据说它源于一本上古卷轴，有时也被归于古阿卡维尔人之作。许多人试图将其破译，也相信它的预示已经实现，且“最后的龙裔”即将出现。我不是预言的解读者，但它确实表明，阿卡托什给凡人的馈赠的真实意义并未被完全理解。

当三神陨落，红塔震颤

当龙裔君主失势，白塔倒塌

original:
[pagebreak]

Shadowmarks by Delvin Mallory

[pagebreak]

eed to know your way around, eh? Don't want to stumble into a necromancer's house or fall into another trap set up by the city guard? Then you need to read this book from cover to cover. Learning to identify the shadowmark can mean the difference between making a fortune and ending up with a blade in your gut. The clever little marks are carved all over Skyrim... mostly on the doorframes or fronts of buildings, but you can find them pretty much anywhere a thief's been. It's the way we talk to each other without talking. Keeps the newer thieves from becoming dead thieves and all that nonsense. There aren't that many of the bloody things, so I don't want to hear any excuses about not having the time to learn them. Anyway, enough of my gabbing. Time to put your wizard's cap on and do a little research. [pagebreak]

Glossary of Shadowmarks

[pagebreak]

[pagebreak]

"The Guild"

This is the symbol for the Guild. This means the place is as safe as the Flagon's cistern. If you see this shadowmark, someone from the Guild is nearby for certain. [pagebreak]

[pagebreak]

"Safe"

We usually leave this shadowmark when we've scouted and found a safe way around something, a hallway without traps or maybe a house that's already cleared out. If you see one of these, head the way it's pointing and you'll be fine. [pagebreak]

[pagebreak]

"Danger"

If you see this shadowmark, head the other way or take your life in your own hands. It means there's something ahead or beyond that door that wants to turn you inside-out. [pagebreak]

[pagebreak]

"Escape Route"

Now, on the rare occasion (it better be a rare occasion if you want to work in the Guild) that you find yourself in jail, look for this little beauty. You see this shadowmark and escape is just a few steps away. [pagebreak]

[pagebreak]

"Protected"

We put these shadowmarks on places we don't want you to go. As in stay out of there or there's going to be a boot up the backside. These people are under the Guild's protection and should never be robbed or assaulted. [pagebreak]

[pagebreak]

"Fence"

This should quickly become your favorite shadowmark. The person near this mark will buy your... hard-earned stolen goods for a fair price. [pagebreak]

[pagebreak]

"Thieves' Cache"

Who says we only take and never give back? If you find this shadowmark near a chest or maybe a hollowed log, you're in for a surprise... a gift from the Guild for the thief in the field. Whoever said membership didn't have its privileges? [pagebreak]

[pagebreak]

"Loot"

There's something near this shadowmark worth stealing. Saves you from breaking into a place only to find the people don't even have two septim to rub together. [pagebreak]

[pagebreak]

"Empty"

The opposite of the Loot Shadowmark. Pass on this place, there's nothing inside.
traduit:
[pagebreak]

暗影标记 戴尔文·马洛里 著

[pagebreak]

想要搞清周围环境，对吧？不想误打误撞走到死灵法师的房子里头，或者踩到城镇卫兵下的陷阱吧？那你得好好把这本书从头读到尾了。能否学会辨识暗影标记，有可能意味着你到底是大发财源还是被捅死的区别。 这些精妙的小标记刻遍了全天际……绝大多数在门框或者建筑物的正面，但你基本上能在任何有贼光顾的地方找到它们。这就是我们无声的交流。也是为了防止新来的小贼变成死贼的黑话。没有那么多该死的事情，别让我听到什么没时间学习的理由。 好了，我说得够多了。该是时候戴上你的术士冠，做点小研究了。 [pagebreak]

暗影标记表

[pagebreak]

[pagebreak]

“公会”

这个是公会的象征标记。意味着标记的地点跟漏壶的蓄水池一样安全。你要是见着这个暗影标记，肯定有公会的伙伴在附近。 [pagebreak]

[pagebreak]

“安全”

我们通常会在侦查并找到安全通过的方法时留下这个暗影标记，有可能是没有陷阱的走廊，或者是已经清理干净的房子。如果你看到，那顺着它指明的方向前进，包你没事。 [pagebreak]

[pagebreak]

“危险”

你要是见着这个暗影标记，要么另寻他路，要么走过去找死。那扇门的前后肯定有什么东西可以把你从里到外翻出来。 [pagebreak]

[pagebreak]

“退路”

嗯，在极少情况下（如果你想在公会干，就最好不要发生），你会发现自己身处监狱，那就找找这个小美人。看到这个暗影标记，那逃生路线就在几步开外。 [pagebreak]

[pagebreak]

“庇护”

我们会在不想让你进的地方打上这个暗影标记。别进到这些地方，否则就等着滚蛋吧。这些地方有公会罩着，不能随便打劫或袭击。 [pagebreak]

[pagebreak]

“销赃”

这个应该会很快变成你最爱的暗影标记。标记附近的伙计会买下你……千辛万苦偷来的货，而且价格公道。 [pagebreak]

[pagebreak]

“盗贼贮藏”

谁说咱只管索取却从不回馈了？你要是在某个箱子或者一根掏空的原木旁边找着了这个暗影标记，那你就有个惊喜了……一份公会送给在外盗贼的大礼就在里面。谁说公会会员没有福利？ [pagebreak]

[pagebreak]

“劫掠”

在这暗影标记附近有东西值得一偷。省得你闯进某个地方，却只发现里头的人穷到都没有两个塞普汀能互相摩擦。 [pagebreak]

[pagebreak]

“空无一物”

与“劫掠”相反。换个地方吧，里头没油水能捞了。

The Nightingales Volume II: What We Were By Gallus Desidenius

[pagebreak] [pagebreak]

s a Nightingale, I feel compelled to place quill to parchment and record my thoughts regarding my knowledge of our order. If one day the Nightingales should vanish from Tamriel, then let this tome serve as a reminder of what we once were and to dispel any rumor or hearsay about our purposes and our motivations. I will attempt to relate the scant bit of knowledge I have of our history to the best of my ability. It is my hope that in the future, someone else may happen upon this writing and amend it in order to expand the record of our existence. Our history begins with a well-known tale. The tome "The Real Barenziah IX" mentions that a bard named "Nightingale" tricked Queen Barenziah into revealing the location of an artifact called the Staff of Chaos which he later claimed for his own. The story goes on to reveal that "Nightingale" was a powerful Imperial Battlemage named Jagar Tharn in disguise and that he used the Staff to imprison Emperor Uriel Septim VIII. His ultimate goal was to assume the form of the banished emperor and sit upon the throne in his stead. In actuality, the individual identified as "the bard Nightingale" was not Jagar Tharn at all. This master of disguise was a Nightingale thief named Drayven Indoril. Jagar Tharn hired Drayven, one of the greatest master thieves in Skyrim, to seduce Barenziah and coerce her into revealing the location of the Staff of Chaos. After the Staff was given to Jagar Tharn, he attempted to eradicate Drayven, but his Nightingale abilities aided his escape. Jagar Tharn searched for Drayven but eventually had to abandon the pursuit in order to enact his plans involving the emperor. It is interesting to note that history refers to Jagar Tharn as "Nightingale" well after the point Drayven would have vanished from the story. The distortion of actual events is very typical of Barenziah's manipulation. With the pressure of blame falling squarely on her shoulders for Uriel Septim VII's imprisonment, she twisted the truth and created the notion that the "bard" named Nightingale was Jagar Tharn himself. She felt the tale of being enthralled by the master sorcerer held more of a forgiving if not romantic notion than simply being seduced by a master rogue. Some also further speculate that eliminating Drayven from history was her attempt at protecting the reputation of Jagar Tharn, whom she was rumored to have been quite fond of. Drayven had escaped into Morrowind after Jagar Tharn's pursuit and rejoined the Indoril family who held an estate quite close to the border of Skyrim which allowed him to perform his Nightingale duties at the Sepulcher if the need arose. He remained there for many years until the Indoril family began to lose its power and a war between the houses erupted. Not wanting any part of it, and feeling that Jagar Tharn was no longer a threat, Drayven left his homeland behind and settled in The Rift under the guise of a miner. Co-currently with Drayven's history, born out of Dravyen's seduction of Barenziah, the Dunmer Queen eventually bore a child. This child, whom Barenziah abandoned with a midwife in an attempt to keep her Nightingale story valid, eventually grew into adulthood and struck out on her own to find her father. Calling herself Dralsi, she overturned every stone in Skyrim looking for any traces of Drayven. After an unknown number of years passed, she finally located him in a small mining community called Shor's Stone. He was quite elderly now... no longer the spry rogue that had seduced Barenziah, but nevertheless he was still Dralsi's father and he treated her as such. In the remaining years of Drayven's life, he imparted the ways of the Nightingale to Dralsi until he finally succumbed to his age. Dralsi willingly struck the Oath of the Nightingales and performed her duties well in the service of Nocturnal. She eventually took a husband and together they had a child whom they named Karliah. Like Dralsi's father did for her, Dralsi taught Karliah the art of thievery and how to survive in Skyrim living as a rogue. She intended to pass the Nightingale mantle on to Karliah, but had to wait until the time was right to reveal it. When she was old enough, Karliah struck out on her own wanting to ply her trade in a larger city. She eventually found her way to Riften and joined the Thieves Guild under my own leadership at the time. As Karliah slowly climbed the ranks in the Guild, I watched her progress and saw much of her mother in her methods. After several years passed, I received word that Dralsi had been killed defending the Twilight Sepulcher from a band of mercenaries and so it became time for the mantle to be passed. I traveled to Nightingale Hall with Mercer Frey and together, we inducted Karliah into the Nightingales. I will relate my own history in my next volume and perhaps, as I uncover more information, the history of Mercer Frey as well.

夜莺 卷二 我们何为 加卢斯·德西德尼乌斯 著

[pagebreak] [pagebreak]

作为一名夜莺，我觉得有必要根据我对我们的认识，执笔记录下我的所思所想。如果有朝一日夜莺从泰姆瑞尔上消失了，那么就让这部书提醒世人，曾经的我们是什么样的人，并消除任何有关于我们的目的、动机的谣言以及传闻。 我将尽我所能，将掌握的关于我们的历史的有限信息串联起来。我希望在将来，有人能够看到这份稿子，对其加以修正并扩充我们存在的记录。 我们的历史源于一则广为人知的传说。《真实的巴兰兹亚·卷九》提到了一位名为“夜莺”的游吟诗人诱骗巴兰兹亚女王，让她说出一件名为混沌之杖的器物所在的位置，其后就声称该物归自己所有。故事之后揭露了“夜莺”是强大的帝国战斗法师贾伽·萨恩所伪装的，他用这根法杖囚禁了皇帝尤瑞尔·塞普汀七世。他的终极目标是化身为被放逐的皇帝，登上皇位。 事实上，那个“夜莺游吟诗人”的身份根本就不是贾伽·萨恩。这位伪装大师是一位名为德莱文·因多瑞尔的夜莺盗贼。贾伽·萨恩雇佣了身为天际最伟大盗贼之一的德莱文，去诱骗巴兰兹亚，迫使她说出混沌之杖的位置。当他把法杖交给贾伽·萨恩后，此人试图杀德莱文灭口，不过他的夜莺能力帮助他逃脱了。贾伽·萨恩到处搜寻德莱文，不过最终为了实施他与皇帝有关的计划而放弃了。 有意思的是，当德莱文从故事中消失后，历史就将贾伽·萨恩称为“夜莺”了。对该事实的扭曲显然是巴兰兹亚操纵的。由于要对尤瑞尔七世被囚禁一事负直接责任，她歪曲了事实，并编造了名为夜莺的“游吟诗人”就是贾伽·萨恩本人这一说法。她认为被术士大师诱骗虽然没有被盗贼大师诱骗那么浪漫，但人们会对此更加宽容。有些人还进一步推测，将德莱文从历史中抹除是因为她试图去维护贾伽·萨恩的名誉，据传她对此人喜爱有加。 在被贾伽·萨恩追捕后，德莱文逃入了晨风，重新加入了因多瑞尔家族。该家族在非常靠近天际边界的地方拥有一块地产，这让他在需要的时候能履行在坟墓作为夜莺的职责。直到因多瑞尔家族开始失势，家族之间的战争打响之前，他在那里居住了很多年。因为他不想卷入纷争并认为贾伽·萨恩不再是个威胁后，德莱文离开了故乡，假借矿工的身份定居在裂痕领。 在德莱文的故事发展的同时，丹莫女王巴兰兹亚因受其诱惑而最终生下了一个孩子。巴兰兹亚为了让那编造的夜莺故事不被拆穿，她跟接生婆遗弃了这个孩子。这个孩子最终长大成人，独自寻找她的父亲。她自称为德莱茜，翻遍了天际每一处角落去寻找德莱文的踪迹。不知过了多少年，她终于在一处叫舒尔之石的矿区找到了他。他现在垂垂老矣……不再是那曾经诱骗巴兰兹亚的机敏盗贼，但不管怎样他仍然是德莱茜的父亲，也确实如父亲般待她。在德莱文余下的岁月里，他将夜莺之道传授给德莱茜，直到他大限将至。 德莱茜自愿立下夜莺的誓言，出色地履行了侍奉诺克图娜尔的义务。她最终结婚生女，夫妻俩给女儿起名为卡莱亚。正如德莱茜的父亲对她一样，德莱茜授予卡莱亚偷窃技艺以及在天际作为盗贼的生存之道。她想把夜莺的斗篷传给卡莱亚，不过需要等待一个合适的时机。当卡莱亚长大后，她开始在一座大城里自立门户。她最终去了裂谷城，加入了那时我在领导的盗贼公会。 当卡莱亚慢慢在公会中晋升时，我关注着她的进步，在她的行为方式中看到了她母亲的许多影子。几年过后，我收到消息说德莱茜在保卫黄昏坟墓时被一伙雇佣兵所杀，是时候将她的使命传承下去了。我跟墨瑟·弗雷一同去了夜莺大厅，把卡莱亚引荐成为夜莺。 我会在下一卷中讲讲我自己的事情，也许当我找到足够的信息时，也可以写一写墨瑟·弗雷的事情。

[pagebreak]

The Nightingales Volume I: Who We Are By Gallus Desidenius

[pagebreak] [pagebreak]

s a Nightingale, I feel compelled to place quill to parchment and record my thoughts regarding my knowledge of our order. If one day the Nightingales should vanish from Tamriel, then let this tome serve as a reminder of what we once were and to dispel any rumor or hearsay about our purposes and our motivations. Our trinity serves the Lady Nocturnal, the Empress of Murk and the Daughter of Twilight. We believe her to be our patron, if not the patron of all thieves worldwide. We serve her without prayer, without charity and without celebration. Our bond with Nocturnal is in the form of a business transaction we strike known as the Oath. Her terms are simple and binding. As Nightingales we are required to guard the Twilight Sepulcher, the Temple of Nocturnal, against those perceived as a threat. In return, we are allowed to use our abilities as Nightingales to further our own means and the means of the Thieves Guild. Upon our death, we are bound to the Twilight Sepulcher as guardian spirits until such time as Nocturnal feels our contract has been fulfilled. Our ultimate fate lies within the Evergloam, Nocturnal's realm. There, our spirits become one with shadow itself and we become the cloak which envelops all of our fellow thieves in their endeavors. This is the true origin of the phrase "walk with the shadows" uttered within the Thieves Guild. The Twilight Sepulcher is more than a temple, it contains a conduit from our world to the Evergloam, a swirling pool of liquid midnight we call the Ebonmere. This is the heart of the Sepulcher, and the source of Nocturnal's influence throughout the world. The Ebonmere can only be sealed by removing a unique key from its lock. This key, which occasionally finds its way beyond the walls of the Sepulcher, is widely known as the Skeleton Key of Nocturnal. The Skeleton Key is an often misunderstood artifact. Those that seek to possess it tend to use only a fraction of its potential. Most mistake it for a unique and unbreakable lockpick. While this is true, the wonder of this device can only be appreciated once the owner is willing to expand his mind and abstract what defines "unlocking." This action refers to more than simple doors and portals. In the proper hands, the Skeleton Key has the capability to unlock hidden potential and untapped abilities. The extent of this power has yet to be discovered, which is a frightening thought if it ever fell into the wrong hands. As a member of the trinity of Nightingales, it is incumbent upon us to recover the Skeleton Key if it strays from the Twilight Sepulcher. Why Nocturnal allows the Key to be stolen in the first place is a mystery. Some say she revels in the chaos this artifact causes, others feel she simply does not care, that the petty squabbles of men and mer are beyond her attention. Whatever the case may be, it is our duty to ensure it remains safely within the confines of the Sepulcher. To say that the Nightingales are a holy order would be doing us a disservice. In our hearts, we are thieves. We enjoy the hunt and delight in the spoils. We might swear our loyalty to Nocturnal and hold some influence within the Thieves Guild, but the greatest allegiance a Nightingale holds is to himself.

夜莺 卷一 我们是谁 加卢斯·德西德尼乌斯 著

[pagebreak] [pagebreak]

作为一名夜莺，我觉得有必要根据我对我们的认识，执笔记录下我的所思所想。如果有朝一日夜莺从泰姆瑞尔上消失了，那么就让这部书提醒世人，曾经的我们是什么样的人，并消除任何有关于我们的目的、动机的谣言以及传闻。 我们三人组侍奉黑暗女皇、暮光之女诺克图娜尔女士。即便她不是世界上所有盗贼的守护神，我们也相信她是我们的守护神。我们并非用祈祷、善行以及庆典来侍奉她。我们与诺克图娜尔的契约是一种我们称之为誓言的业务关系。她开的条件简单明了且极具约束力。作为夜莺我们要看守诺克图娜尔的神殿——黄昏坟墓，使其免受外界的威胁。作为交换，诺克图娜尔允许我们使用作为夜莺的能力来扩充我们自己以及盗贼公会的财富。 我们去世后，我们会作为守护灵与黄昏坟墓相连，直到诺克图娜尔认为我们完成了协议为止。我们最终的归宿就是诺克图娜尔的领域“永暮”。在那里，我们的灵魂将成为阴影本身的一部分，掩护所有同行盗贼的行径。这就是盗贼公会中所说的“与阴影同行”的真正起源。 黄昏坟墓不仅仅是一座神殿，它还有从我们的世界通往永暮的通道，一汪暮色如漩涡般在其中涌动的池沼，我们称其为黑檀池。这就是坟墓的中心，也是诺克图娜尔影响我们世界的源头。关闭黑檀池的方法只有一种，就是从它的锁上取走一把特殊的钥匙。这把钥匙会时不时出现在坟墓之外，许多人称其为诺克图娜尔的万能钥匙。 万能钥匙是一把经常遭人误解的器物。那些企图占有它的人往往只利用了其一小部分的潜力。许多人误将其当成一把特殊的、不会损坏的开锁器。虽然这是事实，但是只有当所有者愿意打开自己的思路并使“解锁”这一定义抽象化，这一工具的神奇之处才会显现。“解锁”这一动作不单单指打开门与入口。在恰当的人手中，万能钥匙能够解锁隐藏的潜力以及尚未开发的能力。这种力量的范围还有待发掘，如果它落入歹人之手那将会有可怕的后果。 作为夜莺三人组的一员，如果万能钥匙离开了黄昏坟墓，我们就有责任将其寻回。诺克图娜尔一开始就允许有人偷走钥匙的原因是个谜。有人说她陶醉于该器物引起的混乱，还有人觉得她就是不在乎，她根本就不在意人跟莫的小打小闹。不论原因是什么，我们的职责就是确保它安全地留在坟墓内。 认为夜莺是神圣的教团对我们而言是种伤害。在我们的心中，我们就是盗贼。我们享受狩猎，喜欢战利品。我们是发誓效忠诺克图娜尔，也在盗贼公会内有一定的影响力，然而夜莺还是最忠实于自己的。

original: Thalmor Dossier: Ulfric Stormcloak
traduit: 梭默档案：乌弗瑞克·风暴斗篷

original:
<font face='$HandwrittenFont'>
Status: Asset (uncooperative), Dormant, Emissary Level Approval

Description: Jarl of Windhelm, leader of Stormcloak rebellion, Imperial Legion veteran

Background:
Ulfric first came to our attention during the First War Against the Empire, when he was taken as a prisoner of war during the campaign for the White-Gold Tower. Under interrogation, we learned of his potential value (son of the Jarl of Windhelm) and he was assigned as an asset to the interrogator, who is now First Emissary Elenwen. He was made to believe information obtained during his interrogation was crucial in the capture of the Imperial City (the city had in fact fallen before he had broken), and then allowed to escape. After the war, contact was established and he has proven his worth as an asset.The so-called Markarth Incident was particularly valuable from the point of view of our strategic goals in Skyrim, although it resulted in Ulfric becoming generally uncooperative to direct contact. 

Operational Notes:
Direct contact remains a possibility (under extreme circumstances), but in general the asset should be considered dormant. As long as the civil war proceeds in its current indecisive fashion, we should remain hands-off. The incident at Helgen is an example where an exception had to be made - obviously Ulfric's death would have dramatically increased the chance of an Imperial victory and thus harmed our overall position in Skyrim. (NOTE: The coincidental intervention of the dragon at Helgen is still under scrutiny. The obvious conclusion is that whoever is behind the dragons also has an interest in the continuation of the war, but we should not assume therefore that their goals align with our own.) A Stormcloak victory is also to be avoided, however, so even indirect aid to the Stormcloaks must be carefully managed.
</font>
traduit:
<font face='$HandwrittenFont'>
状态：有利用价值（不合作），停止活动，特使级别许可

描述：风舵城领主，风暴斗篷叛军领袖，帝国军团退伍军人

背景：
    我们是在对抗帝国的“第一次战争”中首次注意到乌弗瑞克，当时他是白金塔战役中的俘虏。在审讯过程中，我们认识到他的潜在价值（风舵城领主之子），因此，他作为可利用的资产交给当时的审讯官、如今的首席特使，爱琳温。我们引导他相信，他在审讯期间吐露的情报，对攻克帝都起到了关键作用（事实上在他招供前我们就已经攻陷了这座城市），然后我们让他逃脱。战后，我们建立了接触途径，他证明了自己是一位很有利用价值的对象。从我们在天际的战略目标来看，所谓的“马卡斯事件”对我们达成在天际的战略目标尤其有利，不过这一事件也导致乌弗瑞克不再愿意与我们直接接触。

对策摘要：
    在极端情况下，我们仍然可能进行直接接触，但是总体上其价值应视为休眠状态。只要内战维持当前僵持不下的态势，我们就不应该插手。海尔根事故例外，乌弗瑞克之死显然会急剧增加帝国的胜算，进而损害我们在天际的整体地位。（注：海尔根有龙突然介入一事仍在调查中。初步能得出的推论是：操纵龙族的幕后势力同样希望内战延续，但我们不可就此断定对方目标与我方一致）。不过我们也应避免风暴斗篷获胜，因此即使是对风暴斗篷进行间接援助也应谨慎安排。
</font>

original: Thalmor Dossier: Delphine
traduit: 梭默档案：戴尔芬

original:
<font face='$HandwrittenFont'>
Status: Active (Capture or Kill), High Priority, Emissary Level Approval

Description: Female, Breton, mid 50s

Background:
Delphine was a high-priority target during the First War, for both operational and political reasons. She was directly involved in several of the most damaging operations carried out by the Blades within the Dominion. She had been identified and was slated for the initial purge, but by bad luck was recalled to Cyrodiil just before the outbreak of hostilities. During the war, she evaded three attempts on her life, in one case killing an entire assassination team. Since then, we have only indirect evidence of her movements, as she has proven extremely alert to our surveillance. She should be considered very dangerous and no move against her should be made without overwhelming force and the most careful preparation.

Operational Notes:
She is believed to still be working actively against us within Skyrim, although we have no location on her. Assumed to be working alone, as no other Blades are known to be active in Skyrim, and she has in the past avoided contact with other fugitive Blades for her own security (one of the reasons she has so far evaded elimination). Her continued existence is an affront to all of us. Any information on her whereabouts or activities should be immediately forwarded to the Third Emissary.
</font>

</font>

original: Japhet's Journal
traduit: 贾菲特的日记

original:
<font face="$HandwrittenFont">A smaller band than was expected joined with me departing Dawnstar. Apparently the local word is that this island is unfit for any sort of habitation, owing to spirits and ill-favored weather. No matter, more space for the loyal few, though the building of the citadel may prove to be time consuming. 
[pagebreak]
This first winter was difficult, with the abandonment of many men and women to return to their families on the mainland. A culling of the herd -- let us lose the faithless, the weak, and those who lack the fortitude to persevere. 
[pagebreak]
The stories of ghosts inhabiting this place are just stories. They frighten away more of those who would weep like children when their shadows flicker in the firelight. Me and my closest remain, ever vigilant. 
[pagebreak]
I find little need for additional company. The cold and winds seem to finally have driven off the last of those who would fancy themselves to be my compatriots. I have no need of their indolence. Let those who look upon Japhet's Fortress be afraid and know the great man who conquered the accursed island. 
[pagebreak]
Now even my more trusted go-betweens have stopped making their regular deliveries of food and supplies to the fortress. I must now become self-sufficient and farm the land, as my father did. 
[pagebreak]
The rocks are unyielding, and my grain grows short. But I will not abandon my greatest creation. I will weather the storm and fend off the ghosts and bite into the wind such that all might sing songs of my great settlement. 
[pagebreak]
I'm starting to think the stories of the ghosts may have a kernel of truth to them. Or else it's simply the hunger talking. 
[pagebreak]
The ghosts are speaking to me now, the more of this icemoss that I eat, the more clearly I can hear them. They are telling me it was a mistake to come here, as if I didn't already know that. 
[pagebreak]
OH GODS HELP ME
</font>
traduit:
<font face="$HandwrittenFont">和我一起离开晨星的队伍比预期还要小。很明显，当地的说法是，由于精魂作怪和恶劣的天气，这座岛已经不适合居住了。不论如何，尽管建造堡垒可能会被证明是浪费时间之举，也要给忠心跟随的人更多空间。
[pagebreak]
第一个冬天很艰难，很多人离去，回到了在大陆的家。得对群体进行淘汰，我们需要抛弃那些不忠的、软弱的、没有毅力坚持下去的。
[pagebreak]
鬼魂住在这里的故事也就是个故事罢了。当它们的影子在火光中闪烁时，吓跑了更多会像孩子一样哭泣的人。我和我最亲近的人时刻保持着警惕。
[pagebreak]
我觉得没有必要再找别的同伴了。冷风似乎终于把那些自以为是我同胞的人赶走了。我不需要他们的懒惰。让那些看到贾菲特要塞的人感到害怕吧，让他们知道征服了诅咒岛屿的人有多么伟大吧。 
[pagebreak]
现在就连我最信任的中间人也不再定期给堡垒输送食物补给了。我现在必须自给自足，像我父亲那样种地。
[pagebreak]
岩石坚硬，五谷干枯。但我不会放弃我最伟大的创造。我将扛过风暴，击退幽灵，迎着冷风，让所有人都歌唱我伟大的定居点之歌。
[pagebreak]
我开始觉得闹鬼的故事可能有一定道理了。或者这只是饥饿的幻觉。
[pagebreak]
鬼魂现在跟我说话了，我吃的冰苔越多，声音就越清晰。他们告诉我来到这里是个错误，好像我还不明白似的。
[pagebreak]
啊 神 保 佑 我
</font>

original:
To anyone reading this: BEWARE THIS BLADE

It is hoped that the only people having access to this room should be the Jarl of Whiterun and his trusted wizard. If anyone else is reading this, please understand the magnitude of your folly, turn around, and never even speak of this room or this blade to anyone. 

It has corrupted and perverted the desires of great men and women. Yet its power is without equal -- to kill while your victim smiles at you. Only a daedra most foul could have concocted such a malevolent and twisted weapon. But it appears that all who wield it end up with the crazed eyes of those wild men who roam the hills chattering with rabbits. 

It is not to be trifled with. Not even the hottest fires of the Skyforge could melt it; indeed the coals themselves seemed to cool when it was placed within. We cannot destroy it, and we would not have it fall into the hands of our enemies. So we keep it, hidden, dark and deep within Dragonsreach, never to be used. 

Woe be to any who choose to take it.
traduit:
敬告所有读到本文者：远！离！这！把！刀！

但愿能够进入此间的只是白漫领主与他信任的巫师。假使你并非他们，且正在阅读此文，请立刻意识到你自己的愚蠢，转过身去，永不要与任何人提及这个房间或这把刀。

再强大的人也会被它腐化扭曲。当你的受害者向你微笑时惨遭杀害，就会加强它的力量。只有最邪恶的迪德拉才会制造如此恶毒扭曲的武器。但似乎所有挥舞它的人到最后都会露出那种在山中游荡和兔子闲聊的野人才会有的疯狂眼神。

千万不可掉以轻心。就连天空锻炉里最炽热的火焰都无法把它熔化，实际上，煤填进去就会变凉。我们不能摧毁它，也不能让它落入敌手。所以我们把它藏在了龙临宫的深处，永远封存。

任何选择它的人都会祸不旋踵。

<font face='$HandwrittenFont'>In my dream, I see the line of Harbingers start with Ysgramor. Each of them ascends to Sovngarde, until we come to Terrfyg, who first turned us to the ways of the beast. He tries to enter Sovngarde, but before he can even approach Tsun, he is set upon by a great wolf, who pulls him into the Hunting Grounds, where Hircine laughs with welcoming arms. 

Terrfyg seems regretful, but also eager to join Hircine after a lifetime of service as a beast. 

Then I see every next Harbinger turn away from Sovngarde and enter the Hunting Grounds of their own accord. Until it comes to me, and I see great Tsun on the misty horizon, beckoning me. It appears I have a choice. And then, at my side, a stranger I had not seen before. As I look into <Alias.PronounPosObj=Player> eyes, we turn to see the same wolf who dragged away Terrfyg, and <Alias.Pronoun=Player> and I draw weapons together. 

I realize this is only a dream, but a strong enough dream to inspire a man like me to take to writing, so it must be of some import. 
[pagebreak]
I've spoken of my thoughts to the Circle, withholding the part about the stranger lest Skjor worry I will no longer seek his counsel, and I was not surprised to see them torn by it. Skjor and Aela are strong in the ways of the beast, and even seemed to suggest that the Hunting Grounds would be their choice of afterlife, if it were truly a choice. 

Vilkas seemed most troubled. The boy is as fierce as a sabre cat in battle, but his heart's fire burns too brightly at times. He felt deceived, and I don't blame him. Farkas didn't know what to think, but I believe he will come around with me and his brother eventually. He usually does. 

I don't know what to do about Skjor and Aela. I know they respect the Companions, and me, but they take to the blood more deeply than the rest of us.
[pagebreak]
Fortune smiles upon us. Yesterday, Vilkas was telling me how difficult it had been for him to give up his transformations. Until we can pursue a true cure, the twins and I have chosen not to give in to the beastblood. For me, it's provided a clearer head, but Vilkas seems to be suffering a bit for it. Farkas seems completely untroubled. That boy continues to amaze with his fortitude. 

While Vilkas was confiding, through the shadows of Jorrvaskr, I saw a newcomer approach, who wished to join our numbers. It was the stranger from my dream, the one who would stand with me against the beast. Vilkas began speaking obliquely, not wishing to air our problems in front of our guest, and I had to be doubly cautious to not reveal anything of our secrets to the newcomer while also not revealing the details of my dream to Vilkas. I don't know how the politicians deal with these sorts of machinations daily. 

In any case, I've sent Vilkas to test the newcomer. We'll see if <Alias.Pronoun=Player> is truly the great warrior I dreamt of. 
[pagebreak]
This newcomer, it seems, is made of decent stock. <Alias.PronounCap=Player> calls <Alias.PronounRef=Player> <Alias=Player>, and has already impressed some of the Circle with <Alias.PronounPosObj=Player> mettle. I still keep my own counsel on <Alias.PronounPosObj=Player> place in my dream, for now. Let us see what kind of destiny <Alias.Pronoun=Player> is carving before hitching to <Alias.PronounObj=Player>. 

In the meanwhile, I look for ways of cleansing my blood. The writings and legends on the subject are sparse and contradictory. I don't wish to engage any wizardry on this matter, but I fear they may be the only ones who best know how to navigate these worlds of knowledge. 

It's apparent to me now that Terrfyg's choice to turn us was indeed a mistake. Magics and their ilk are not in keeping with the spirit of the Companions. We face our problems directly, without the needs of such trickery. I can only hope to guide us back to the true path of Ysgramor before the rot takes me.
[pagebreak]
<Alias=Player> continues to impress. I don't know yet where <Alias.Pronoun=Player> will stand on the question of the blood, but the question has not been presented yet. <Alias.PronounCap=Player> does know that we carry the beastblood, and appears curious about it. Soon enough, I can explain our troubles, and hopefully see what role <Alias.Pronoun=Player> will play.
[pagebreak]
I'm amazed that Aela thinks she can keep a secret among this drunken rabble. Especially with the loss of Skjor (my heart aches), emotions are fraying, and the walls of discretion are the first to fall. 

Apparently she and <Alias=Player> are waging their own separate war against the Silver Hand, in retaliation for Skjor's death. Their hearts are noble, but the course of vengeance is running hot, and I fear the counterstroke that may come if they do not rein in their fury. 

<Alias=Player> shows valor, though, even in this more underhanded time. We have not had cause to speak much, and that is something I deeply regret. I have high hopes for <Alias.PronounPosObj=Player> destiny, as I realized that <Alias.PronounPosObj=Player> appearance in my dream may indeed mark <Alias.PronounObj=Player> as the Harbinger to succeed me. 

I have received few dreams over the course of my life, but when they come, I have learned to trust them. I have also learned to trust the instincts of my heart, which tells me that <Alias=Player> can carry the Companions legacy as truly as any residing in Jorrvaskr, especially with the loss of Skjor. Aela is too solitary, Vilkas too fiery, and Farkas too kind-hearted. Only <Alias=Player> stands as a true warrior who can keep a still mind amidst these burning hearts.

I will not speak to <Alias.PronounObj=Player> of any of this, though. It is too much to burden another with. My hope is that <Alias.Pronoun=Player> and I can keep counsel over the coming years, that I can impart the wisdom of the Harbingers. All things in time. Firstly, I will seek <Alias.PronounPosObj=Player> assistance in the matter of the witches of Glenmoril. It would appear that our path to the cure is not without some poetic justice for the tricksters who first cursed us. 
</font>

<font face='$HandwrittenFont'>在梦里，我看到了以伊斯格拉默为首的先驱们。他们人人都升入了松加德，直到第一个把我们引上野兽之路的特瑞格。他本想进入松加德，但在接近苏恩之前，就被一只巨狼袭击拖进了猎场，海尔辛在那里笑着欢迎他的到来。

我不知道该拿斯科约尔和艾拉怎么办了。他们是很尊重战友团与我，但他们比我们更加嗜血。
[pagebreak]
幸运在冲我们微笑。昨天，威尔卡斯告诉我做出放弃变化能力的决定对他来说很困难。我和那对双胞胎决定，在找到真正治愈的办法之前，绝不向兽血屈服。对我来说，这种痛苦会让我头脑更加清醒，但威尔卡斯似乎受到了一些折磨。法卡斯好像没受什么影响的样子，这小子的坚韧程度真是令我惊讶。

就在威尔卡斯向我倾诉的时候，有个新人穿过了月瓦斯卡的阴影，说想要加入我们的队伍。是我梦中那个陌生人，愿意与我并肩对抗野兽的那个人。威尔卡斯开始拐弯抹角，不想让客人知道我们的问题，我得加倍小心了，既不能向新人透露我们的秘密，也不能让威尔卡斯知道我梦境的细节。真不知道那些政客们一天到晚是怎么耍这些阴谋诡计的。

但不管怎么说，我已经让威尔卡斯去测试新人了。但愿<Alias.Pronoun=Player>真的是我梦寐以求的那个强大战士。

新人好像表现不错。<Alias.Pronoun=Player>叫做<Alias=Player>,而且已经用<Alias.Pronoun=Player>的勇气打动了圆环的部分成员。我仍然保留着<Alias.Pronoun=Player>在我梦中的事。就让我们看看在正式加入前，<Alias.Pronoun=Player>的命运如何吧。

original:
THE TOTEMS OF HIRCINE

[pagebreak] Among those of us to whom Lord Hircine bestowed his most precious gift of Lycanthropy, there are legends that he also set into the world specific artifacts of his power. They date to a period when men could neither write, nor speak, nor barely think, but the powers of blood of the beast were yet flowing strong among the selected. The first: a carved skull, of the wolf itself. Used by those ancient shamans in the blood ceremonies that created our lineage, it is said to grant a great presence to those who prostrate themselves before it, such that those who witness their forms cower in a terror unknown except to those who have glimpsed the face of Hircine himself. The second: a thigh bone, carved as the skull, but from some animal unknown. Used as some form of medicinal wand in the more ancient brotherhood, it was said to grant a kind of heightened awareness, both in sight and smell, such that the prey could never flee too far from our senses. Through these totems, we channel and focus our energies of the beast. While werewolves give up the powers of magic known to men, we can tap into a more direct natural energy at times, and through these totems, discover the abilities that first tamed the world before wrought civilization sullied it.
