original:
[pagebreak]

The Night Mother's Truth by Gaston Bellefort

[pagebreak]

lthough various works have been written on the subjects of both Morrowind's Morag Tong, and Tamriel's more widespread Dark Brotherhood, there remains confusion as to precisely when and how these two feared assassins guilds formed. Or, more specifically, when and how the Dark Brotherhood split from the Morag Tong, as the former is widely accepted to have sprung from the latter. The largest point of contention seems to be the figure of the Night Mother, a woman who figures prominently in both organizations. Through extensive research and interviews, and not inconsiderable risk to my own life (for the Dark Brotherhood holds this information sacred), I have finally solved this ages-old mystery. I have finally uncovered the Night Mother's Truth. Although her name has been lost to time, the Night Mother was once a mere mortal, a Dark Elf woman who lived in a small village once located where the city of Bravil stands now, in the Imperial Province of Cyrodiil. She was a respected member of the Morag Tong and, like her fellow members, this woman made her trade as an assassin in service to the Daedric Prince Mephala. In fact, the woman held the title of Night Mother, reserved for the highest ranking female member of the organization. To be Night Mother of a particular sect was to be that group's matron - the favored of Mephala, both respected and feared. However, it was not Mephala who facilitated the transformation from woman to spectre, but another, some would say far deeper form of evil - Sithis, the Dread Lord, embodiment of the unending Void. Following the Potentate's assassination in 2E 324, strife descended upon the Morag Tong, and the guild was all but eradicated in Cyrodiil and much of the Empire. It was shortly after these events that the Dunmer woman claimed to hear the voice of Sithis himself. The Dread Lord, she claimed, was displeased. He was unhappy with the Morag Tong's lack of success. The Void, he told her, was hungry for souls - and it was her destiny to set things right. And so, according to Dark Brotherhood legend, Sithis visited the Night Mother in her bed chamber, and begat her five children. Two years passed, before the unthinkable happened. The Dark Elf woman followed through with the Dread Lord's ultimate plan - one night, she murdered her children, and sent their souls straight to the Void. Straight to their father. When they learned of this affront to decency, the people of the village rallied against the woman. For such an act was considered incomprehensible, even for a Night Mother of the Morag Tong. In one night of vengeance, they descended upon the woman, killing her, and burning down the house in which the atrocity took place. And that was the end of the story. Or so everyone thought. A little more than thirty years later, an unnamed man heard a strange, comforting voice inside his very head, just as the Dunmer woman claimed to hear the voice of Sithis inside hers. The voice identified herself as the Night Mother, and named the man "Listener" - the first of many. And so the Unholy Matron set her servant on his path - he would found a new organization, a guild of assassins known as the Dark Brotherhood, in service not to Mephala, but to the Dread Lord Sithis. The Morag Tong, now surviving only in Morrowind, was an artifact of a forgotten age. The Dark Brotherhood would marry business with death. The organization would grow in wealth and power, and the Void would swell with fresh souls. It was, the Night Mother told her Listener, the perfect arrangement. In the early days of the Dark Brotherhood, the bodies of the Night Mother and her children were recovered from their original burial site, and interred in a crypt beneath the site of her house. And there they remain, even today. So if, in your travels, you find yourself in the city of Bravil, and make a wish at the statue of the Lucky Old Lady (as is the local custom), know that you stand on sacred, if evil, ground. For you stand above the Night Mother, the Unholy Matron herself, and your luck has just run out.

夜母的真面目 贾斯顿·贝利福特 著

[pagebreak]

叙述晨风省的莫拉格堂和广泛分布于泰姆瑞尔各处的黑暗兄弟会的文章已经不少，但关于这两大令人们谈之色变的刺客公会究竟是在何时如何形成，还存在着不少的争议谜团。或者说得更具体地：黑暗兄弟会是何时如何从莫拉格堂中分裂衍生出来，因为前者脱胎于后者这一说法是被广泛接受的。 　　最大的争论点似乎是夜母的形象问题，这是一位在两大组织中都占有重要地位的女人。通过广泛的调研探访，这过程中伴随着生命危险（毕竟于黑暗兄弟会而言，这些秘闻都是神圣的），我总算是解开了这古老的谜团。我总算能让夜母的真面目大白于天下了。 　　她的本名虽已被时间遗忘，但说到底，夜母也不过是区区凡人罢了：她是一名暗精灵，曾居于帝国的希罗帝尔省一座小村庄中，也就是今天的布拉维尔。她曾是莫拉格堂中备受尊崇的一员，如其他成员那般，这女人是侍奉迪德拉君主梅法拉的刺客。而实际上，这女人持有着“夜母”头衔，代表着身为组织内最高阶的女性成员。成为了这一特殊教派的夜母，成为了该教守护女神梅法拉的宠儿，备受尊敬与敬畏。 　　不过，并非是梅法拉促使她转变为幽魂，而是另外的存在，有人将之称为更为深远的恐怖和邪恶的存在——西帝斯，恐惧之主，无尽虚空的化身。 　　随着第二纪元324年辅政官被刺杀，冲突也降临在莫拉格堂中，而希罗帝尔乃至帝国境内大量地区的公会几乎被根除。此事发生后不久，那个丹莫女人宣称亲耳听闻了西帝斯的声音。她还宣告，恐惧之主深感忿怒，对莫拉格堂的失败感到不悦。他告诉她，虚空渴望着灵魂——而这便是她的使命：把一切拉回正轨。 　　于是乎，就如黑暗兄弟会那些传说所述，西帝斯驾临了夜母的床笫，还赐她生下五子。两年匆匆而过，不可思议的事发生了，这女暗精灵遵循了恐惧之主的终极计划：某夜，她亲手杀死了她的骨肉，将这些亡魂直接送至虚空见他们的父亲。 　　当得知这严重触犯公序良俗的行为后，村民们愤而集合起来排挤这女人。再怎么说，这等行径也实在太过于不可理喻了，即使她是莫拉格堂的夜母。在那复仇之夜，他们突然袭击了那个女人，将她杀死后还焚毁了她做出暴行的房屋。大概所有人在想，故事应该就此了结了。 　　三十余年后，某位无名男子听到了一道陌生而慈祥的声音在他脑海中响起，就如那丹莫女人宣称听闻了西帝斯的声音那般。那道声音自称是夜母，并赋那人新头衔“聆听者”——此后无数的夜母特使中的第一人。 　　此后，这不洁主母让她的仆役踏上了他自己的道路--成立一个全新组织，一个叫做“黑暗兄弟会”的刺客公会。且他们不再侍奉梅法拉，而是转投恐惧之主西帝斯。至于莫拉格堂，现在只在晨风省苟延残喘，不过是终将被岁月遗忘的产物。黑暗兄弟会将把死亡变成买卖。这新生的组织将在财与权的哺育下茁壮成长，而虚空被鲜活的灵魂填充。夜母告知她的聆听者，此乃完美的安排。 　　黑暗兄弟会早期时期，夜母母子们的尸首被从他们原先的安葬地找到，重新埋回了她房子旧址下面的地窖中。直到今天，他们仍在那里。 　　所以如果你在旅途中到达了布拉维尔，还朝幸运老妇人像许愿（这是当地风俗）时，要知道你所立足之处神圣而邪恶。毕竟，你正站在不洁主母“夜母”之上。而你的好运也即将到头。

original:
[pagebreak]

Nords of Skyrim

[pagebreak]

ords of Skyrim - My People, My Pride Respected reader. My name is Hrothmund Wolf-Heart, and I am a Nord. But, more importantly, I am a Nord born and raised in the land of Skyrim. I write this volume in the desperate hope that the rest of Tamriel can come to know my people as they deserve to be known, and understand this province for what it truly is - a place of uncontested beauty and culture. Some of what you know is undoubtedly true. Physically, we Nords are an impressive, often imposing sight - tall of stature, strong of bone, and thick of muscle. Our hair is often fair, and worn braided, as has been the custom for generations. Often we are swathed in the hides of beasts, for such creatures are abundant in Skyrim, and we would be foolish not to take advantage of such an available resource. Having read this far, you may be shocked at the strength of my words, and the literacy of a northern "savage." Aye, many Nords can both read and write. My father began my instruction in the way of letters when I was but a bairn, as did his father, and his father before him. But the accomplishments of the children of Skyrim are multitude, and go beyond mere wordcraft. For we are artisans as well, and through the ages have learned to manipulate steel the way a sculptor would clay. Indeed, I have seen with mine own eyes, visitors from High Rock and Cyrodiil weep in disbelief as they beheld the blades wrought in the fires of the Skyforge, and honed to beautiful deadliness by the gods-touched hands of Clan Gray-Mane. But how can this be true, you ask? How are such achievements possible from a people who have yet to emerge from the muck and snow? Again, provincial bias clouds the truth. The cities of Skyrim are a testament to Nord ingenuity and craftsmanship. Chief among them are Solitude, seat of the High King and capital of the province; Windhelm, ancient and honored, a jewel in the snow; Markarth, carved into the living rock itself, in ages long since past; Riften, nestled in the golden shadows of the Fall Forest, whence comes delicious fish and mead; and Whiterun, built around the hall of Jorrvaskr, home of the most noble Companions and revered Skyforge. And now, respected reader, you have the full measure of it. We Nords are everything you imagined - and so much more. But let not this work be your only gateway to the truth. Book passage on carriage or vessel, and make the journey north. See Skyrim with thine own eyes. See Skyrim as have the Nords, since the gods first shaped the world.
traduit:
[pagebreak]

天际的诺德人

[pagebreak]

天际的诺德人——我的同胞，我的骄傲 尊敬的读者，本人名为赫罗特蒙德·狼心，诺德人。但，更为重要的是，我是一名在天际大地土生土长的诺德人。 本人撰写本书所抱持之心态，实为希望泰姆瑞尔其他地方的人们，能前来以应得的方式了解我的族人；并了解这个省份的真实面貌——这是一片拥有无与伦比之美与文化的土地。 您所知晓的某些事物无疑是正确的。论体格，我等诺德人实在令人印象深刻，常造成视觉冲击——身材魁梧，骨骼强健，肌肉发达。我们习惯把淡金的头发按世代所传习俗那般编作发辫。我等多身裹野兽毛皮，也是因天际省此类生物极为丰富，如不加以利用，则甚为愚蠢。 阅览至此，您可能会为我措辞的素养，以及北境“蛮夷”的文化水平感到震惊。然也，不少诺德人都兼具备读写能力。家父在我童年时就开始教导我读书识字，正如他的父亲曾经做的那样。 但天际之子们的建树成就是多方面的，可不止区区舞文弄墨。因为我们也是能工巧匠，而经历历代传承，已然学会如何像雕刻大师驾驭粘土那般驾驭钢铁。 诚然，我曾亲眼目睹，从高岩和希罗帝尔远道而来的游客发出难以置信的哭泣，只因他们见证了在天空锻炉的烈炎中受千锤百炼而成的锋锐剑刃被灰鬃氏族那有如曾被众神抚摸过的双掌细细打磨抛光，变得美艳而致命。 但您定要发问：这怎么可能呢？一个从未走出泥泞与雪地的民族，怎么可能会取得这般成就？重复一遍——对外省的刻板偏见往往掩藏了事实。 天际的诸多城市，便是诺德人创造力及匠心工艺之力证。在其中首屈一指的便是独孤城，至高王御座及全省首府之所在；风舵城，古老而荣耀，如雪中明珠；马卡斯城，于松动岩床上凿险而成，已跨越无数岁月；裂谷城，坐落于秋日森林的金色荫蔽下，彼方传来鱼虾与蜜酒的浓郁喷香；还有白漫城，围绕月瓦斯卡大厅建成，那里是高贵的战友团和备受尊崇的天空锻炉家的所在。 那么现在，尊敬的读者，您对此间风土人情已有充分了解。我等诺德人正如您所想象的一切，乃至超出更多。 但，莫将本书作为您了解真相的唯一路径。预订马车或是乘船而来，开始一趟北上之旅。凭您的双眼，亲自看看这天际省。亲自看看，这自众神首度将世界揉捏成型以来，就是诺德人家乡的天际省。

We finally did it. We bought the lighthouse. I thought Habd was just making idle promises all these years, what husband doesn't want to promise their wife the two moons from the sky, but I didn't think we'd actually manage to get it! Now if I could only find where we put everything

----

I can't find my favorite cooking pot and it is slightly infuriating. Sudi and Mani seem unhappy, but they're still young and don't seem to understand that we just want to spend a few more years with them before they leave us to see the world. I know they think their father will live forever, but I see his age creeping into his eyes. He made me promise again that when he died I would put his bones in the lighthouse fire so he could look out over the ocean forever. 

----

Oooh those two get to me sometimes! I went to unpack some of our keepsakes from the trading ships we used to sail but I can't find them!

----

Sudi keeps saying she's hearing something in the basement at night and Mani suggested it was skeevers! They know I hate skeevers! Now I'm too scared to go down there at all. I'm glad I unpacked my favorite urn and put it safely on the mantle before those two started causing mischief. If they put a skeever in the basement I swear...

我们终于成功买下灯塔了。我以为哈伯德这些年就会说空话，什么丈夫不愿意承诺给老婆摘俩天上的月亮，但我没想到我们真的成功了！现在我得找地方存我们所有的东西。

----

我找不到我最喜欢的锅了，有点气人。苏第和马尼好像不太开心，但他们还年轻，可能不明白我们只是想在他们离开我们去看世界前和他们多待几年。我知道他们觉得自己的老爸长生不老，但我从他眼睛里看出他已经老了。他让我在他死后把遗骨放到灯塔的火里，这样他就能永远眺望大海了。

----

哦，他们俩有时真是让我受不了！我去收拾我们从以前航海的商船带来的纪念品，但我找不到了！

----

苏第说她晚上听到地窖里有动静，马尼说那是恶鼠！他们知道我讨厌恶鼠！现在我都不敢下去了。我很高兴我找到了我最喜欢的瓮，我得在那俩家伙捣乱前把它放到壁炉架上。如果他们真在地窖里放了只恶鼠，我发誓……
</font>

original: Midden Incident Report
traduit: 秽道事故报告

original: The missing students were found in the Midden this morning. Dead, as expected. None of us bothered keeping a detect life charm for the search at this point. The bodies were found together, each suffering the same deformities; peeled and bubbling skin on the arms and face. Conjurer's burn, as it's commonly referred to around the College. There's little doubt they were attempting a summoning ritual well beyond their capabilities. The relic nearby put any doubt in this theory to rest. I admit that I've never seen one like it - a large, segmented sculpture of a gauntlet, the Daedric sigil 'O' emblazoned upon the palm. Attempts to move it were in vain. I must show it to Archmage Sedoth during his upcoming visit. Perhaps he will know more. While we couldn't move the relic, I was able to pry four "rings" from it. I'm sure there's a connection between them and the ritual the students were attempting. I'll store these in the Arcanaeum until we can consult with a conjuration master to learn more.
traduit: 失踪的学生已在秽道发现。如预期一样，全部死亡。我们没有再费心去保持探测生命的魔法了。 这些尸体毫无疑问是一同被发现的，每个都有同样的畸形现象：手臂和脸部的皮肤被剥去或起泡。这是“召唤师灼烧”，学院里很常见，他们毫无疑问是尝试了一种超过自己能力范围的召唤仪式。 附近的遗物打消了所有疑虑。我从未见过如此巨大、分段的护手雕塑，手掌心上还雕刻着迪德拉文的“O” 字纹样。试图移动无果。我必须在大法师瑟多斯到来的时候展示给他。也许他会知道更多。 虽然我们无法移动该遗物，但我从里面撬出四个“指环”。相信它们与学徒们尝试的仪式有一定联系。 我要把这些东西放在秘藏馆，直到我们从召唤大师处了解更多。

original: Kyr's Log

original: Frostmere Crypt, Week 12 What a disaster. We haven't seen a caravan in a week. We actually lost ground in the tunnels- Thal and his team were crushed when their section collapsed. I've heard word of a mutiny. If next week isn't any better... [pagebreak] Frostmere Crypt, Week 13 Two new recruits- Eisa and Ra'jirr. Girl said she did time in Cidhna Mine, down in Markarth, and it shows- she's got more experience than all of us put together. I've put her in charge of the dig. Cat's good with a blade, so I've sent him topside with the raiders. [pagebreak] Frostmere Crypt, Week 14 Tunnel's going well. Eisa made our first big find just yesterday- buried chest with a couple hundred gold. Topside, Ra'jirr and his team have hit five merchants this week, in and out faster than the guard could respond. Looks like things are finally going my way. [pagebreak] Frostmere Crypt, Week 15 The tunnel broke out into some kind of giant cavern. There's whole forest down there- found a nice sword all laid out on some kind of monument and everything. But this is just strange. Eerie. What is this place? Not like any tomb I've ever seen. [pagebreak] Frostmere Crypt, Week 16 I think the cat's gone crazy. All of a sudden, he can't focus, keeps muttering to himself. He's gone from our best raider to our worst- botched two jobs just today. Eisa's trying to cover for him, but she's not fooling anyone. Lately, he keeps asking to see my sword, begging to borrow it. Like I'll let him get his paws on it- it's beautiful, perfectly balanced, better than any I've ever held. Sure, he can have it- right in the gut.
traduit: 霜池地穴第12周 真是一场灾难，我们已经一周没有看到车辆经过了。隧道里出了事故，塔尔那队人所在的区域塌了，所有人都被压碎了。我听说有暴动的消息。如果下周还不好转的话…… [pagebreak] 霜池地穴第13周 来了两个新人，一个叫埃莎一个叫拉’吉尔。那姑娘说自己在马卡斯的希讷矿场蹲过大狱，她肯定比我们所有人加起来都有经验。我让她负责挖掘工作。那个卡吉特的刀法不错，所以我让他到上层去突击队报道了。 [pagebreak] 霜池地穴第14周 隧道挖掘很顺利。就在昨天，埃莎带来了我们到这里来的第一个大发现——一口埋在地下装着几百枚金币的箱子。拉’吉尔和他的团队这周已经抢劫了五个商人，进进出出的速度比卫兵的反应快多了。看来事情终于朝着有利于我的方向发展了。 [pagebreak] 霜池地穴第15周 隧道的尽头有个巨大的洞穴。下面有一整片森林，我发现有把漂亮的剑放在一个类似纪念碑之类的东西上。很奇怪。太怪了。这是个什么地方？和我见过的坟墓都不一样。 [pagebreak] 霜池地穴第16周 我觉得那只猫疯了。他突然就没法集中注意力，还一直自言自语。就在今天，他这个最好的突击队员搞砸了两场买卖。埃莎还想替他掩饰，但她骗不了任何人。 最近他一直想看我的剑，求我借给他。说的好像我会让他把爪子碰一下似的。这把剑真漂亮，而且平衡性非常好，我就没用过这么好的剑。当然，他也可以拥有它，用自己的肚子。

original:
<font face="$HandwrittenFont" size="18">Left the White River gang this morning, with Hajvarr's thugs on our tail. Wasn't a bad gig, but it was time to move on. Ra'jirr and I weren't getting anywhere with him in charge.
[pagebreak]
I'll never understand how he does it. I couldn't find so much as a rumor in Windhelm, while Ra'jirr stayed outside the city, got wasted on Moonsugar, and still managed to find us a lead- some gang out Morthal way. They're holed up in an old ruin, digging it out in between raids on the caravans.
[pagebreak]
Joined up with Kyr's band. Their treasure-hunting dig is a disaster: three months of work have barely cleared a single hall, and six men have died from the cave-ins. I've taken charge of the dig, while Ra'jirr is leading the raids topside. Maybe that year in Cidhna Mine will pay off after all.
[pagebreak]
You'd think a man who could swing a sword could use a pickaxe, but these louts are exhausted after barely an hour. No wonder this tunnel's taking forever. I've set up round-the-clock shifts, and ordered double rations for the best diggers. That'll give them some incentive.
[pagebreak]
Night shift woke me to say they'd hit something big. Kyr, Ra'jirr, and I went down to take a look. It's huge, like a whole forest was just swallowed up by the earth, with a big old monument out in the center. Kyr took the sword from it as a trophy, proof his whole plan was finally paying off. For once, he might be right.
[pagebreak]
Ra'jirr's been having nightmares over the past few days. He keeps muttering about a "Pale Lady"- one of those swamp women who steal children away at night, I think. To think some fool story could turn the toughest bandit I know into a cowering kitten, frightened of his own shadow. I'm just glad none of the others see him like this.
[pagebreak]
It's getting worse. Ra'jirr can barely sleep at all now, and whenever he dozes off, he wakes up screaming- woke the whole place last night. He says the "Pale Lady" is coming for us- she's down in the forest, we have to return the sword or she'll kill us all. Not a chance- the boss clings to that thing like he was born with it. I've told everyone Ra'jirr just has a fever, but this can't go on. I've pulled a few things together. I'll slip out tonight and never look back.</font>
traduit:
<font face="$HandwrittenFont" size="18">今天早上逃离白河帮，哈瓦尔手下的暴徒就跟在我们后面。虽说这场大戏还不赖，但也该是时候跑路了。拉'吉尔和我可不想待在在他掌控之下的地界。
[pagebreak]
    我可永远搞不懂他是怎么做到的了。我在风舵城里头连一点谣言都听不着，而拉'吉尔待在城外头，把时间浪费在嗑月亮糖上，居然还有法子给我们找着个头儿，是个莫萨尔外头道上的帮派。他们躲在个古老的废墟里，在打劫商队的空当里挖宝。
[pagebreak]
    进了凯尔的队。他们那寻宝挖掘工作就是场灾难：足足干了三个月才勉强清理好一间大厅，就这还有六个人因为塌方事故送了命。我接手挖掘的活，而拉'吉尔去地上带队打劫。看来看来在希讷矿场待一年总算看见回报了。
[pagebreak]
    总觉得一个能挥剑的爷们用镐肯定不费劲，但这些傻子才干了不到一个小时就累得要死要活了。难怪这隧道一直挖不通。我安排了全天候轮班，又规定挖得最棒的那家伙能拿到双倍配给口粮。这总该能给他们点激励了。
[pagebreak]
    轮夜班的把我弄醒说他们挖到了大的。凯尔、拉'吉尔和我都下去瞧了。这还真是大家伙，像是一整片森林给吞进地里头了，中心还有块好大的古碑。凯尔把里头的剑拿下来当作战利品，证明他整个计划总算有回报了。这一回，他说不定是对的。
[pagebreak]
  过去几天，拉'吉尔一直在做噩梦。他一直咕哝着什么“苍白夫人”——我想是那些会在晚上偷小孩儿的沼泽女鬼吧。想想看这愚蠢的故事会把我所知道的最坚强的强盗变成个抖似筛糠的小猫咪，连自己的影子都能把他吓着。我真庆幸没别人能看见他这副样子。
[pagebreak]
  情况越来越糟糕了。拉'吉尔现在几乎没法睡着，每当他打盹，就会鬼叫着吓醒——昨晚把大家全惊醒了。他说“苍白夫人”要来找我们了——她就在森林里，我们得把剑还回去，不然她就把我们全杀光。想都别想——头儿死死抱着那东西，好像是从娘胎里带出来的一样。我跟大伙说拉'吉尔只是发烧了，但这不是长久之计。我已经拾掇了几件东西。今晚我就偷溜出去，再也不回来了。</font>

original:
<font face='$HandwrittenFont'><font size='18'>
I hate it here. Why did we have to move to Skyrim anyway? I miss the big port cities, there was always something to do and new people around. Or even being cabin girl on one ships we used to sail on would be better than this! Mani says we should run away, but I can't leave Mother and Father alone out here... Oh what to do?

----

We've been here for two months now and there is nothing to do! From the top of the lighthouse we can see all the way to the College at Winterhold, but Father says that magic is for Daedra worshippers. The only interesting thing to have happened lately is that Mother snapped at us at dinner and accused us of stealing things out of the cellar. I did hear scratching down there the other night, but I thought it was just Father cleaning fish.

----

I caught Mani in the cellar a couple days ago going through some the barrels and crates. At first I thought it was him all along making those scratches to play a trick on me, but I heard them again last night and Mani was in bed. Father finally said he would go get some traps and poison from town in case it's skeevers. I'm really scared, it doesn't sound like skeevers to me.

----

Mani won't listen, he thinks I'm just making up the noises and keeps sneaking into the cellar! Oooh why is he so stupid some times? I don't know why he keeps going down there but I've found the cellar key he copied and hid it in Mother's favorite keepsake so he won't find it. The scratching is getting louder.
</font>
traduit:
<font face='$HandwrittenFont'><font size='18'>
我讨厌这里。为什么我们非得住在天际？我想念大港口城市，那里总能找到事情做，周围也总有新朋友。就是在我们曾经航行过的船上继续当船员也比这强！马尼说我们应该逃跑，但我不能把爸妈单独留在这里啊……哎，怎么办？

----

我们已经在这里住了两个月了，什么事都做不了！从灯塔顶端能看到冬堡学院，但父亲说魔法是迪德拉信徒才会学的东西。最近唯一一件有意思的事儿，就是妈妈在吃饭时对着我们大吼大叫，骂我们偷了地窖里的东西。有天晚上我确实听到了刮擦的声音，但我以为是爸在清理鱼。

----

几天前我在地窖里发现马尼在翻木桶和板条箱。刚开始我还以为是他一直在闹腾，但昨晚我又听到了，马尼就躺在床上。父亲最后决定去镇上弄些陷阱和毒药，以防是恶鼠。我真的很害怕，听起来可不像是恶鼠。

----

马尼就是不听，他觉得是我在制造噪音，一直偷偷溜进地窖！哦，为什么他有时候这么笨？我不知道他为什么一直往地窖跑，但我找到了他配的地窖钥匙，然后藏在妈最喜欢的纪念品里，这样他就找不到了。抓挠声是越来越大了。
</font>

In order for the Penitus Oculatus to ensure the safety of our honored Emperor during his visit to Skyrim, we must personally verify the security of every city in the province. To this end, I appoint you my personal representative, granting all rights and privileges afforded a commanding officer of the Penitus Oculatus. Gaius, my beloved son - you may be new to the Penitus Oculatus, but I need someone I can trust. You must carry out your duty, for the safety of the Emperor, the glory of the Penitus Oculatus, and the honor of the Maro family name.

Your superior officer (and loving father),

Commander Maro

original: The Legend of Red Eagle
traduit: 红鹰传说

original:
[pagebreak]

The Legend of Red Eagle by Tredayn Dren Archivist of Winterhold

[pagebreak]

his tale was transcribed from the memory of Clarisse Vien, student of Winterhold. Elements of the legend suggest a date c.1E 1030, though as with any oral tradition, much of it is likely a later anachronism. Curiously, stories of a similar king and his legendary blade appear in other ancient myths of the Reach. [pagebreak] Long ago, a child was born in the Sundered Hills. They named him Faolan, which means 'Red Eagle' in the tongue of the Reach, for the screeching bird-call that greeted his birth, and the crimson blooms on the autumn hills. Thus began his legend: Reach-child, born under auspicious skies, his very name the color of blood. Ten kings ruled the Reach in those days, and though men were free, the people were scattered and warred amongst themselves. The augurs foresaw the boy's destiny: a warrior without peer, first and foremost Lord of the Reach, chosen to unite all under his name. Faolan grew in years and strength, and it seemed the prophecy would be fulfilled. The banner of the Red Eagle was raised along the cliffs of the Reach, and his people prospered. Then came Hestra, Empress of the South, riding to war. One by one, the kings stood before her. One by one, they fell aside, bending knee in Imperial bargains or slaughtered on the battlefield. Her legions came at last to the Sundered Hills, and envoys were sent to bargain for their surrender. Faolan refused to yield the freedom of his people, but the elders were afraid, cast him out, and accepted the Imperial yoke. Thus was stolen by the foreign invaders: his land, his people, his very name. In the years that followed, Red Eagle became known as the untamed spirit of the Reach, unbowed, unbroken, stained by the blood of his foes. [pagebreak] He gathered loyal Reachmen to himself, those who clung to the old ways, who yearned for freedom, and forged a new nation. Together, they fell upon the occupiers and the traitors by night, disappearing into the cliffs and caves each morn, evading capture. It was not enough. For every Imperial patrol and garrison they wiped out, yet more seemed to march from the green south to replace them. [pagebreak] One night, under a cloud-choked sky, the men of the Red Eagle warmed themselves over damp fires of smoldering moss. A huddled, shambling figure came to them, cloaked in rags, face cowled. Though his men mocked and cast stones at the stranger, Faolan sensed something, and beckoned. The cowl was thrown back in the dim light, and she revealed herself to be one the ancient and venerable Hagravens. She offered power, for a price, and a pact was made. Thus was brokered to the witch: his heart, his will, his humanity. From that day forth, his was a spirit of vengeance, pitiless and beyond remorse. The rebels grew in strength and numbers, and none could stand against them. Faolan's eyes burned coldly in those days, black opals reflecting a mind not entirely his own. Two years passed, and the foreigners were all but driven from the Reach. Such peace could not last, however, and a great host fell upon them, a swift army of invaders unlike any before. For a fortnight, Hestra's generals laid siege to Red Eagle's stronghold, till he himself came forth for battle, alone and robed in nothing but his righteous fury. A thousand foreigners fell before his flaming sword, and the enemy was routed. Yet, when night fell, so too did he. The warriors who came to him said Faolan's eyes were clear again on that final night. He was taken to the place prepared for him, a tomb hidden deep within the rock. With his remaining strength he presented his sword to his people, and swore an oath: Fight on, and when at last the Reach is free, his blade should be returned, that he might rise and lead them again. Thus was given for his people: his life, his dream, his sword. But when every debt is repaid in blood, these he shall reclaim once more.
traduit:
[pagebreak]

红鹰传说 冬堡档案管理员 崔戴恩·德伦 著

[pagebreak]

该故事抄录自冬堡学徒克拉里斯·威恩的回忆。传说中某些要素表明其年份应为第一纪元1030年左右，尽管和所有口头传统一样，大部分内容可能随着时代变迁而有所误差。奇怪的是，类似的君王和他的传奇之剑的故事还出现于瑞驰其他的古老神话中。 [pagebreak] 许久以前，一名婴儿降生于裂分群山。他们为他起名为弗兰，这在瑞驰方言中意为“红鹰”，因为他出生时，有刺耳鸟鸣和秋日群山开放的殷红花朵相迎。 应天示祥瑞而生、以血色冠名的瑞驰之子，开启了他的传说。 时有十王分治瑞驰，而人们虽然自由，但仍是四散各处，互相攻伐。预言预示了这孩子的命运——他将会是无敌的勇士、瑞驰第一也是最重要的君王，他被选中以他的名义来团结所有人。 随着岁月流逝，弗兰出落得愈发孔武有力，似乎预言即将应验。红鹰的旌旗沿着瑞驰处处崖壁飘扬，而他的子民繁荣强盛。 随后，南方的女帝海斯特拉踏上了扩张之路。诸王一一挺身阻挡其前，又一一倒伏一侧，或是在与帝国的讨价还价中卑躬屈膝，或是在沙场被斩杀殒落。 最终，她的军团进军裂分群山，并派遣使节劝降。弗兰拒绝放弃子民的自由，但长老们心怀畏惧，把他赶走，领受了帝国的枷锁。 他的土地、他的子民，乃至他的英名，就这样被异邦的侵略者们窃据了。随后数年，红鹰成为了瑞驰那著名的不驯精神的代表，不折不弯、不屈不挠、不被敌人的鲜血玷污。 [pagebreak] 他将坚守古老传统、渴望自由、赤胆忠心的瑞驰人召集麾下，建立了新的国家。他们一同乘夜突袭占领军和卖国贼，每日清早又消隐于峭壁和岩洞中逃脱追捕。这仍不够。帝国的巡逻队和驻军每被消灭一次，似乎就会有更多人从绿色的南方开拔而来取代他们的位置。 [pagebreak] 一晚，在乌云密布的天穹下，红鹰的部下正在潮湿的苔藓上烧火取暖。一抹蜷缩蹒跚、身穿破布、脸蒙头巾的身影走近他们。尽管手下人对陌生人大加嘲弄、投掷石块，但弗兰觉察到了什么，并招手示意。兜帽在微光下被掀开，她正是一位古老而可敬的乌鸦鬼婆。她提出以代价换取力量，与红鹰达成了协议。 他的心脏、意志、人性都卖给了女巫。自那日起，他变成了复仇的精神，无情、无悔。反抗军的力量和人数都在增长，无人可与之抗衡。在那段时日里，弗兰双目冷酷地燃烧，漆黑的眼瞳映射着不完全归属于他的思想。两年过去，异邦人几乎都被赶出了瑞驰。 然而，这样的和平不可能持久，一支庞大军队向他们袭来，那是一支前所未见的迅捷侵略部队。两周后，海斯特拉的将军们便包围了红鹰的要塞，直至他独自一人，只带着正义的愤怒亲自出战。一千名异邦人殒命于他熊熊燃烧的剑下，敌军大败溃逃。然而，待夜幕降临，他也倒下了。找到他的战士们说，在那终末的夜，弗兰的双眼再次清澈了起来。 他被葬于为他预备好的、藏匿岩石深处的坟墓中。他用最后的力气，将剑交给他的子民，并起誓：要继续战斗，当瑞驰最终重获自由的时候，再将他的剑归还，让他重新站起来领导他们。 他的生命、梦想、佩剑都交付了子民。但当诸般血债皆以血偿时，他将再度取回这一切。

Do not presume we have grown fat and complacent here in the north. Our Matriarch was wise to bring us here. Our camp is secure, and our numbers grow. 

We will not skulk in the shadows with you, making petty plots with rabble and sycophants. When we strike, we will do it with cunning and power, and the occupiers will fall before us. That is the way of true Reachmen.

<font face="$HandwrittenFont" size="18">
阿拉里克：

别以为我们在北方已经吃肥了自满了。我们的女族长带我们来这里是明智之举。我们营盘稳固，人数也在增加。

original:
<font face="$HandwrittenBold" size="19">
They fell upon us at dusk. Dozens of them. The caravan guards were dead in moments. They took everyone else back to the pens. Blinded those who tried to resist.

One by one, they've taken the others away- feeding us to those monstrosities, or worse. I don't have much time left. Eydis, my love, if you ever get this- forgive me. 

Firir
</font>

<font face="$HandwrittenFont" size="19">
它们几十个在黄昏时发起了进攻。商队的护卫瞬间就被杀光了。剩下的人都被带到了据点。凡是试图反抗的都被弄瞎了。

它们一个接一个地把其他人带走了，是要拿我们去喂那些怪物，或者是更糟的情况。我时日无多了。亲爱的爱迪斯，如果你能得到这个，请原谅我。

菲利尔
</font>

Twenty-five years I have grieved for my husband, and sought revenge against the Empire for his death. I have researched the magicks to return his spirit to a body and something about the story of Fjori and Holgeir has drawn me here...

----------

Holgeir would make the perfect vessel to bring my Saeel back to life.

----------

I have managed to raise the dead here and use them as laborers to clear the way to the main burial hall. Something about the methods used by the ancient Nords has kept them incredibly well preserved. Would that these Stormcloaks had half their sense. We could have used them to push the elves right off the continent and formed a new state to combat the empire.

----------

And now, when I am so close, a war breaks out. The sleeping bear of Skyrim, who would not come to aid us in Hammerfell, awakens now that the Empire has abandoned them as well. They think they know suffering at the hands of the Empire? They know nothing. I would see both the Empire and these sons of Skyrim  into Oblivion myself.
</font>

----------

霍吉尔会是我的赛尔起死回生的完美容器。

----------

我设法在这里复活了亡灵，让他们充当扫清通往主墓室道路的劳力。古诺德人用了某种方法把它们保存得相当完好。这群风暴斗篷大凡用上一半理智，我们就能用它们把精灵赶出大陆，再建立一个新的政权去对抗帝国了。

I was skeptical, but it's obvious now. The old hymns had truth to them! The relief wasn't far from the entrance, just as they said. I've no doubt now that it hides the entrance to Kvenel's tomb.
The two keys must be hidden somewhere nearby - ceremonial replicas of Okin and Eduj, favored weapons when Kvenel went into battle. I don't dare explore further without hiring bodyguards to accompany me, however. To think - The Tongue Chieftain Kvenel could be entombed behind just a few feet of stone! The ancestor we scarcely believed was real.
Twice damned for planning this foolish scouting trip. I should have hired those sellswords in the first place. Perhaps there's no need. This place is just a tomb, after all, and there are no obvious signs of habitation. It isn't as though the thousand-year dead will mind if I have a look around.
traduit:
当时还很怀疑，但现在结果很明显了。古老的圣歌是真的！如它们所说的一样，凹槽的地方离入口不远。我现在确信这里藏着通往基伏奈尔坟墓的入口。
奥金和埃杜伊这两把仪式钥匙的复制品肯定就在某个地方。这两把钥匙是基伏奈尔上战场时最喜欢的武器。不过，如果不雇保镖的话，我是不敢进一步探索的。想想看，发声者酋长基伏奈尔就埋在几尺厚的石头后面！这可是我们几乎不相信曾经存在的祖先。
两次因为策划这愚蠢的探查之旅而被骂了。我一开始就该雇佣这些佣兵。不过也许必要。这地方就是个坟，而且也没有明显的居住迹象。死了几千年的人估计也不会介意我四处看看。

original:
<font face="$HandwrittenFont" size="18">How to summarize a lifetime of research? So little of what I have learned matters now- the petty politics of ancient times, the age-long campaign to wipe out all mention of the Gauldur name.

I know not what awaits us within Folgunthur, so here, then, is the truth of the tale, as best I have been able to piece it together.
[pagebreak]
In the opening days of the First Era, the Archmage Gauldur was revered throughout the north. Wisdom, wealth, honor, and power were his, and even Ysgramor's heirs sought his counsel.

Smothered by his shadow, Gauldur's three sons grew cruel and resentful. They lusted after their father's power and prestige, and eventually Jyrik, the eldest, discovered its source: a mysterious amulet, from which he never parted. Together, they conspired to murder their father in his sleep and divide his amulet between them. And so it was done.

Consumed by their newfound power, the brothers laid waste to the surrounding villages. So great was the carnage that the High King himself intervened, sending a company of battlemages led by the Archmage Geirmund to subdue the brothers. And after a devastating battle, the three fled the field.
[pagebreak]
Mikrul, the youngest, was run to ground in Folgunthur, the ancient barows at the foot of Solitude. And though he fought for three days and nights, he was at last overcome and entombed there, his crypt sealed by an ivory claw.

Geirmund pursued Jyrik to the shattered crypts of Saarthal, half-buried even then. Ten veteran wizards fell before Jyrik's elemental magic, but he could not overcome them all together. He too fell, and was sealed within the ruined city.
[pagebreak]
And at last, Sigdis was cornered in the southernmost reaches of Skyrim. He challenged Lord Geirmund to a duel, knowing his foe was honor-bound to accept. And they clashed in battle, matched strength for strength, and fell together on the field before Ivarstead. The High King ordered a tomb built for Geirmund on the lake which still bears his name, and had Sigdis sealed within, forever guarded by the one who slew him.
[pagebreak]
Gauldur himself was interred in a cave not far from where his tower once stood, in the place called Reachwater Rock. And when it was done, King Harald issued an edict: the name and deeds of Gauldur and his sons were to be expunged from every record, every chronicle. Under pain of death, no word of them was to be spoken, lest any try to recover the amulet that had been sealed at so great a cost.

And so it was done. But a little survived the ages. Enough.
[pagebreak]
Four thousand years have passed, and the tombs remain sealed. The fragments of the Gauldur Amulet lie within. Since the day I first heard the rumor, I have felt its power, calling to me, pulling at me. I will be the one to reclaim it, restore it, bear it out into the world once more. I must have it. I must!
</font>
traduit:
<font face="$HandwrittenFont" size="18">如何总结一辈子的研究？古代政治的琐碎记载，一场旷日持久的运动，目的就是为了消除所有提到了高尔多这个名字的人。我现在所了解到的不过如此。
    
我不知道在佛古恩瑟里，究竟会发生什么。以防万一，我只能尽我所能把故事的真相拼凑出来了。
[pagebreak]
在第一纪元初期，大法师高尔多在全北境都备受尊敬。智慧、财富、荣誉、力量，都聚集在他一身。即使是伊斯格拉默的后裔们，也要寻求他的建议。

高尔多三个儿子被笼罩在他的阴影之下感到窒息，变得残忍而愤懑。 他们贪恋父亲的力量和威望，最终长子杰瑞克发现了他力量的来源:一个他从不摘下的神秘护符。他们合谋在父亲熟睡时将其杀害，并将他的护身符一分为三。一切就如计划中那样进行得很完美。

兄弟三人被他们新获得的这股力量灌注得脱胎换骨后，将周围的村庄尽数夷为平地。这场屠杀的规模过大，乃惊动了至高王亲自出面干预。他调遣了一队的战斗法师，命大法师格尔蒙德率队镇压三兄弟之乱。经过一场破坏性巨大的恶战后，三人逃离了战场。
[pagebreak]
老三米克拉尔，被赶到了独孤城脚下的古老坟冢“佛古恩瑟”处力尽倒下。尽管他奋力抗争了三日三夜，但最终还是被击杀了。他被就地埋葬，而他的墓室被一只象牙龙爪所封印。

格尔蒙德一路猎杀杰瑞克，一直追赶到萨瑟尔遗迹中残破不堪的地下城中——尽管在那时，这片废墟已经被半埋了。十位经验丰富的巫师在杰瑞克的元素魔法面前倒下了。但双拳难敌四手。没用多久，他也步了后尘，被封印在已成残垣断壁的废城之中。
[pagebreak]
而最终，在天际的极南之地，西格蒂斯被逼入绝境。走投无路的他仍作困兽之斗，向格尔蒙德大人提出了决斗——他知道自己的敌人出于荣誉，必然会接受这一提案。于是一场单挑激斗就此打响。双方势均力敌，最后双双倒在伊瓦尔镇郊外的田野。闻讯的至高王下令，就地在湖畔为格尔蒙德修造坟墓，坟墓仍旧以他的名字命名，并将西格蒂斯封印其中。如此，他将永远被终结他生命的人严加看守。
[pagebreak]
高尔多本人被深葬于一所洞穴之中，距他的魔法高塔所在的地方并不遥远，名为“触水岩”。这一切告终之后，哈拉尔德王便颁布一道新令：涉及高尔多父子的每一页档案文献，每一纸编年史记，都要尽数抹去。从名讳，到事迹，无一例外。在死亡的威胁下。再没有一字一句被谈及，以免有心之人试图寻找那花费如此庞大代价才勉力封印起来的护符。
   
一切就此结束了。但仍有关于此事的传言流传下来。这，便够了。
[pagebreak]
四千年过去，那些古墓仍被完好密封。高尔多护符的碎片就深藏其中。自我第一次听闻这谣言的那天起，我就能感受到它在冥冥之中的力量，呼唤着我，拉扯着我。我将是那个夺回它、修复它，让它重见天日、再次展现在世人面前的人。我必须得到它。必须！
</font>

original: Daynas Valen's Journal
traduit: 戴纳斯·维兰的日记

original: 18th of Morning Star, 4E 201 How long has it been since I first heard the Gauldur legend? Eighty years? A hundred? I can think of nothing else now. My goal is at hand. After years of searching, I finally traced the Ivory Claw to a collector in Bravil. His death was necessary. But I have it. At last, I have it. [pagebreak] 22nd of Morning Star, 4E 201 Three days of nonstop riding. I reached Anvil ahead of my pursuers, and took passage on the Icerunner, bound for Solitude once more. [pagebreak] 29th of Morning Star, 4E 201 The other passengers are becoming suspicious. Returning from dinner, I caught one brute rooting around in my quarters. He almost found the claw. Had the captain not intervened, I would have flayed him alive. I hoped to spend the voyage sequestered in my room, reviewing my notes and preparing spells, but I need to deflect some attention from myself. I'll have to mingle, pretend to be just another petty mage. For now. [pagebreak] 2nd of Sun's Dawn, 4E 201 The brute claims to be an adventurer, off to seek his fortune in the ruins of Skyrim with his companions. Perhaps I can turn this to my advantage, use them as fodder for the traps and Draugr within the tombs. I can see the greed in his eyes. Yes, that should work. Three weeks to Solitude, the captain says. If I have to suffer these fools longer than that, I'll swim. [pagebreak] 27th of Sun's Dawn, 4E 201 With the brute and his companions in tow, I led our band across the marsh to Folgunthur, where we made camp for the night. Little has changed since my first expedition ten years ago. But this time, I have the claw. And I will have the amulet. I spent all night preparing a synopsis of my notes, in case some fragment of the tale or piece of ancient lore may be needed to bypass the wards within the tomb. Then I cast all my books and scrolls into the fire, and reduced my life's work to ashes. At long last, today is the day of reckoning. If I cannot have the amulet, no one will.
traduit: 第四纪元201年，晨星月18日 距离我第一次听说高尔多传说那天，已经过去多久了？八十年？一百年？我心里已经装不下这些杂念了。我苦苦追寻的目标，终于近在眼前。 寻找多年，我终于追查到象牙龙爪的下落——它在布拉维尔的一位收藏家手中。他的死，是必然的。而我将是它的下一任主人。我终于得到它了。 [pagebreak] 第四纪元201年，晨星月22日 在马上赶了三天的路。我终于赶在追捕者之前抵达了安维尔。登上了“冰驰者号”接续前进。再一次抵达了独孤城。 [pagebreak] 第四纪元201年，晨星月29日 同乘的其他旅客开始怀疑了。用完晚餐后回房时，我发现有个放肆的畜生正在我的舱间里乱翻一气。他几乎就要找到那只龙爪了。要不是船长及时介入此事，我非活剥了他的皮不可。 我本想在我的舱间里安安静静地打发这段旅程的闲暇。重温我的笔记，预备一些法术。但现在，我得把汇聚在我身上的那些注意力转移开来。我得乔装打扮一番，伪装成另一位平凡的小法师。现在只能如此了。 [pagebreak] 第四纪元201年，日晓月2日 那畜生自称是个探险家，想和同伴一同到天际的废墟遗迹里寻宝。说不定，我能把这一点转化为我的优势，将他们作为饲料，喂给古墓里的机关陷阱以及尸鬼大军。我能从那双眼睛里看到贪婪的光芒。没错，这应该能行。 船长告知我，再过三周，就能抵达独孤城。要是我得忍耐这伙傻瓜更长时间，那我宁愿游过去。 [pagebreak] 第四纪元201年，日晓月27日 在和那畜生还有他的伙计们约好结伴同行后，我带着队伍跋涉渡过沼泽，抵达佛古恩瑟。我们在那里安营过夜。自我十年前的第一次探险到此，这地方几乎毫无变化。但这一次，我手握龙爪。我一定会得到护符的。 我花了整整一晚，把我的所有笔记整理出一份概要，以防可能需要哪些故事片段或者传说细节，来绕行古墓中的部分墓室。而后，我将我所有的研究书籍和卷轴付之一炬，把毕生的心血化为灰烬。花了这么久，今天就要见分晓了。就算我拿不到护符，别人也休想拿到。

original: 3rd of Hearthfire, 4E 200 You know, just when you think you've hit bottom, sometimes the Aedra throw you a rope. Since the rebels took over the mines in these parts, I haven't been able to find work anywhere. And along comes Bern, my old partner, with an deed to some old gold mine out in the hills. It's been too long since we did a job together- what, four years now? Nice to finally work with someone who knows the business. Sounds like the place was a steal, too. [pagebreak] 22nd of Hearthfire, 4E 200 No one sells a mine for a song. I figured the place would be in bad shape, but not this bad- barely a glorified cave. There may have been gold here once, but we don't even have a vein to start with. We struck out at random. Three weeks digging the lower tunnel, but nothing to show for it yet. [pagebreak] 15th of First Seed, 4E 201 Nothing. No gold, no gems, no ore, not even any useful stone- the rocks around here crumble the moment you stack one on another. I'm ready to toss it in, but Bern wants to keep on going. "Just a little farther, Hadrir." "We're so close, Hadrir." Bah. Bern wants me to head back to Riften for supplies next week. Might give me a chance to cool down. [pagebreak] 29th of First Seed, 4E 201 So I come back, and- nothing. No sign of Bern. It's like he just up and left. No blood, no struggle, he just ran out on me, I suppose. I've waited three days, and he's not coming back. I'm going to head back to Riften and see if I can find him, or find some other work there. No sense wasting any more time here. Bern, if you find this- I expected better from you.
traduit: 4E200年，炉火月3日 你知道吗，当你觉得自己已经跌到谷底了，有时伊德拉会把你甩出去。自从叛军占领了这一带的矿场，我就到处找不到工作了。我的老搭档伯尔尼来了，带着一份某个山间老金矿的地契。 我们已经很久没有一起共事了，到现在得有四年了吧？很高兴终于能和懂行的人合作了。而且那地方听起来也很便宜。 [pagebreak] 4E200年，炉火月22日 没人能以一首歌的价格把矿买下。我本以为这地方很糟，但也不算太烂，这就是个被吹出来的洞穴。也许这里曾经有金子，可我们连个矿脉的毛都没找着。 我们在下面的隧道胡乱挖了三周，还是什么都没发现。 [pagebreak] 4E201年，初种月15日 什么都没有。没有金子，没有宝石，也没有矿，连稍微能用的石头都没有，这里的岩石堆起来就会碎裂。我已经准备好放弃了，可伯尔尼还想继续。“往前再走走，哈德里。”“我们已经快挖到了，哈德里。”我呸。 伯尔尼让我下周回裂谷城拿补给。也许我能借机会冷静一下。 [pagebreak] 4E201年，初种月29日 所以我还是回来了，但什么都没有。没找到伯尔尼的踪迹。好像他就这么走了。没有血迹也没有挣扎的痕迹。他可能是就这么跑了。 我已经等了三天，他还是没回来。我得去裂谷城找找他，或者去那里找点别的工作。没必要在这里浪费时间了。 伯尔尼，如果你发现这本日记，希望你好自为之吧。

original: Yngol and the Sea-Ghosts
traduit: 英格尔与海鬼

original:
[pagebreak]

Yngol and the Sea-Ghosts

[pagebreak]

asser and Secunda passed over Ysgramor's people as their fellowship landed in long-boats upon the rocky shores of Hsaarik Head on their journey from Atmora to Mereth. Boats littered the coast, but Ysgramor did not count his kin, Yngol's among them. Ysgramor commanded the sea-ghosts to surrender his kin, and a great gale darkened the sky. The seas thrashed and churned, and a wrathful storm appeared. Ysgramor took up the oars and rowed into the storm alone. Upon the Sea, Ysgramor wrestled the sea-ghosts, and the storm carried him along the jagged coast. Two fortnights passed without relief, until finally the storm broke. Come the next dawn, Yngol's long-boat was found in the icy surf, but the vengeful sea-ghosts had already taken Yngol and his clansmen. In his terrible grief, Ysgramor slew a dozen dozen beasts and burned them in honor of his fallen kinsman. A barrow-hill was dug in the Atmoran tradition, and Yngol was laid to rest with rites and honors among his clansmen far below the rocky face of Hsaarik Head, the first Children of the Sky to perish in Tamriel.
traduit:
[pagebreak]

英格尔与海鬼

[pagebreak]

马瑟尔和瑟坤达指引着伊斯格拉默的人民及其同伴自长船舰列从萨黎柯海角那岩石海岸登陆。他们自阿特莫拉大陆启程，前往莫瑞斯。登岸舟凌乱散落在海岸线上，而伊斯格拉默在人群中却没发现他的部分族属，英格尔也在其内。 　　 伊斯格拉默喝令海鬼交还他的亲人，一股狂风遮蔽了整片苍穹。骇浪翻涌，惊涛撼岸，飓风暴怒呼啸。伊斯格拉默抄起双桨，独自进入了风暴之中。 伊斯格拉默在海面上与一众海鬼大战，而剧烈的狂风暴雨沿锯齿状海岸刮擦拖拽着他。如此的胶着对抗足足持续了近一个月，直到最后，风暴散去。次日黎明，英格尔的长船总算在冰冷的海浪中被寻得，然而复仇的海鬼们已将英格尔和他那些同族带走了。 　　 极度悲痛之中，伊斯格拉默宰杀了许多野兽，并点燃它们以纪念死去的亲人。依阿特莫拉传统，人们为他建了一座坟丘，英格尔和其他的同族共同长眠于萨黎柯海角的乱石之下。他是首位在泰姆瑞尔折翼的天空之子。

original: Note from Agna
traduit: 阿格娜的纸条

original:
<font face='$HandwrittenFont'><font size='18'>
Golldir, don't be such a milk drinker. I know you've been scared of Hillgrund's Tomb since your brother locked you in there when you were children, but we can't let Vals Veran get away with this!

Hillgrund and our other ancestors need us to protect their remains, and I'm going in, with or without you. I'm sure one dark elf is nothing to worry about, but if something should happen, don't forget to check the secret passage in case he barricaded himself in the deeper chambers.


-Aunt Agna
</font>
traduit:

original: 8th of Evening Star, 4E 200 Jaree-Ra is up to something big. He wouldn't tell me exactly, all he said was, "It'll be just like the good old days, before the cave-in sealed your boats in there." We can't send our ships out of here anymore. What is he hinting at? 14th of Evening Star, 4E 200 He wants to know what loot we have saved up. I don't care what he says, I'm not telling him anything about my stash! It stays down there where it's safe. I can't imagine he'd ever jump in this murky water, let alone swim down to the sunken boat. 21st of Evening Star, 4E 200 It's on! There's bound to be someone out there who will.

BIOGRAPHY OF QUEEN BARENZIAH VOLUME ONE by Stern Gamboge Imperial Scribe

[pagebreak]

ate in the Second Era, a girl-child, Barenziah, was born to the rulers of the kingdom of Mournhold in what is now the Imperial Province of Morrowind. She was reared in all the luxury and security befitting a royal Dark Elven child until she reached five years of age. At that time, His Excellency Tiber Septim I, the first Emperor of Tamriel, demanded that the decadent rulers of Morrowind yield to him and institute imperial reforms. Trusting to their vaunted magic, the Dark Elves impudently refused until Tiber Septim's army was on the borders. An Armistice was hastily signed by the now-eager Dunmer, but not before there were several battles, one of which laid waste to Mournhold, now called Almalexia. Little Princess Barenziah and her nurse were found among the wreckage. The Imperial General Symmachus, himself a Dark Elf, suggested to Tiber Septim that the child might someday be valuable, and she was therefore placed with a loyal supporter who had recently retired from the Imperial Army. Sven Advensen had been granted the title of Count upon his retirement; his fiefdom, Darkmoor, was a small town in central Skyrim. Count Sven and his wife reared the princess as their own daughter, seeing to it that she was educated appropriately-and more importantly, that the imperial virtues of obedience, discretion, loyalty, and piety were instilled in the child. In short, she was made fit to take her place as a member of the new ruling class of Morrowind. The girl Barenziah grew in beauty, grace, and intelligence. She was sweet-tempered, a joy to her adoptive parents and their five young sons, who loved her as their elder sister. Other than her appearance, she differed from young girls of her class only in that she had a strong empathy for the woods and fields, and was wont to escape her household duties to wander there at times. Barenziah was happy and content until her sixteenth year, when a wicked orphan stable-boy, whom she had befriended out of pity, told her he had overheard a conspiracy between her guardian, Count Sven, and a Redguard visitor to sell her as a concubine in Rihad, as no Nord or Breton would marry her on account of her black skin, and no Dark Elf would have her because of her foreign upbringing. "Whatever shall I do?" the poor girl said, weeping and trembling, for she had been brought up in innocence and trust, and it never occurred to her that her friend the stable-boy would lie to her. The wicked boy, who was called Straw, said that she must run away if she valued her virtue, but that he would come with her as her protector. Sorrowfully, Barenziah agreed to this plan; and that very night, she disguised herself as a boy and the pair escaped to the nearby city of Whiterun. After a few days there, they managed to get jobs as guards for a disreputable merchant caravan. The caravan was heading east by side roads in a mendacious attempt to elude the lawful tolls charged on the imperial highways. Thus the pair eluded pursuit until they reached the city of Rifton, where they ceased their travels for a time. They felt safe in Rifton, close as it was to the Morrowind border so that Dark Elves were enough of a common sight.

original:
The Journal of Medresi Dran
On Angarvunde:
Whispers of this ancient temple have been few and far between, and most real knowledge seems similar to Angarvunde itself; buried and forgotten. Yet, every story or legend I hear all seem to speak of immeasurable riches found deep within. "Great treasure waits for the worthy adventurer," said one old fool after many false flirtations and tankards of mead. Though he may have been a nuisance, his information matches most of my research, specifically the location of Angarvunde. Tomorrow I will hire a mining team to assist me in my excavation and head towards the ruin. By this time next month, I shall be rich!

-M.D.
traduit:
迈德雷斯·德兰的日记
关于安佳翁德：
关于这远古神殿的传闻很少，而大多数真知就如安佳翁德本身一样被埋藏遗忘。然而我听到的每一个传说故事似乎都在向我诉说：里面蕴藏着不可估量的财富。 “大宝藏只等待那些与之相配的冒险家。”和一个老傻瓜多次虚假的调情又大杯喝蜜酒之后，他才吐露出来。虽然他挺讨厌，但给的消息确实与我的研究大部分吻合，特别是安佳翁德的位置。 明天就雇个发掘团队协助我进行挖掘，然后前往遗迹。下个月我就发财了！

-M.D.

original: Of Fjori and Holgeir
traduit: 有关佛乔里和霍吉尔

original:
[pagebreak]

Of Fjori and Holgeir

[pagebreak]

n her 29th summer of life, Fjori the huntress met the warlord Holgeir on the field of battle. None remember what they fought over, for their love to come was so great it overshadowed all rivalries or disputes. They fought to a standstill, as their followers looked on - till her sword broke his axe and his shield dulled her blade and all could see that they were equals. As the Eagle finds its mates, so too did Fjori find hers in Holgeir, and a time of peace came to the clans of the forest. But as the summer's warmth gives way to winter's chill, so too would this peace pass. But the Snake came and bit Holgeir, its venom seeping deep into the wound. A Whale greeted Fjori's view as she came over the snow-covered mountains to the coast. She obtained an elixir from the Akavir and returned to the forest in haste. Though Holgeir could smell the winds of Sovngarde, she gave him the elixir and he was cured in an instant. But the Snake bit Fjori as she poured the last drop into Holgeir's mouth, and fatigued from her journey, she joined the ancestors immediately. Holgeir's grief was such that he built a tomb and upon completion, took his own life that he might rejoin her.
traduit:
[pagebreak]

有关佛乔里和霍吉尔

[pagebreak]

29岁当年的仲夏，女猎人佛乔里于沙场上初遇了军阀霍吉尔。已无人记得他们为何而战，只因他们之间的爱伟大到可令一切纷争黯然失色。他们在各自手下的追随者们的注视下，一直战斗，直至她的宝剑斩裂了他的战斧，而他的盾牌也挫钝了她的剑锋。所有目击者都明白他们势均力敌。 　　 正如鹰隼寻得一生之比翼般，佛乔里也寻得了她的连理，那便是霍吉尔。森林里的各氏族也得以走向一段平和时光。但当仲夏之温晴渐渐步向凛冬之严霜，这段宝贵的宁静也终究告终。 　　 一条毒蛇骤然来袭，狠狠咬噬霍吉尔，毒液渗透进了伤口的深处。 　　 在佛乔里翻过白雪皑皑的群山到达海岸时，一尾巨鲸出现在她的视野中。 　　 她自阿卡维尔找到了灵药，匆匆奔回了森林。 　　 尽管霍吉尔已能呼吸到松加德的微风了，但及时赶到的她喂他服下灵药，他随即便复愈如初。 但当佛乔里把最后一丁点灵药也喂进霍吉尔嘴里时，毒蛇果断暴起，咬住了她，再加上旅途劳顿，她当场便加入了先祖们的行列。 　　 康复的霍吉尔满心悲怆，为佛乔里建造一座坟墓。待这墓冢最后一砖一瓦落成，他当即了却孤生，希冀能与她再会。

original: Notes on Yngol Barrow
traduit: 英格尔古坟笔记

original:
What a peculiar place the barrow turned out to be. I hadn't explored for very long before reaching this elaborate room and gate locking me from going further into the crypt.

I confess it - I'm relieved! This place puts the fear of Oblivion into me.  There are some carvings in this room.  I'll attempt to transcribe them for the College so I have something to show for this effort.
<HR>
All was so in Atmora
land of truth and our home

Man in his throne, 
     so should he be
Whale in the sea, 
     so should he be
Eagle in Sun's Sky, 
     so should he be
Snake in the weed
     so should he be

Sorrow! For the Sea-Ghosts took Yngol
Prize Brother of Sail from Atmora's Fleet

And none on land
    nor sky, nor sea
would ever again 
    be as should be
<HR>
Fascinating, these ancient Nords. I wonder what other secrets are hidden here? Surely there can't be harm in trying to go a little further, and there is a lever here which must open the gate beyond.
traduit:
这座古墓真是个奇怪的地方。我探索了没多久就来到了这样一个精致的房间，大门挡住了我进一步深入墓穴的脚步。

但我得承认，我松了口气！这地方让湮灭的恐惧侵入了我的内心。这房间里有很多浮雕。我要试着把它们抄录下来送回学院，这样也算有东西能证明我的努力了。
<HR>
曾经的阿特莫拉
真理之土和我们的家

人端居于王座，
那是属于他的地方，
鲸遨游于海洋
那是属于他的地方，
鹰飞翔于炎日
那是属于他的地方，
蛇潜伏于草丛
那是属于他的地方，

哀哉！阿特莫拉舰队的英格尔，
扬帆起航的荣誉弟兄
竟被海鬼带走

不在陆地，
不在天空与海洋

只能永远，
待在属于他的地方
<HR>
这些古诺德人还真是迷人。真不知道这里究竟还藏着什么秘密？当然再往前走也不会有什么好处了，这里正好有根杠杆，一定能打开通往外面的门。

original: 4th of Evening Star, 4E 200 It never ceases to amaze me how many fall for my simple trap. I may have to consider tweaking it a bit though. Many of them, in recent months, have been dying the second they hit the cage floor. Putting a foot or two of water in didn't help either. In fact, it may actually be making things worse. The last one to fall in broke both his arms and legs! He proceeded to float there and eventually drown. If it weren't for the water I would have had a great time twisting his mind until I decided to end him. 8th of Evening Star, 4E 200 Captured another one...finally. It's definitely true that whatever these Orcs gain in size and strength they lose in mental capacity. I'm amazed they can even speak. He kept saying that when he gets out he'll break me in half like a twig...persuasive isn't he? Anyway, I told him that if he holds his head under the water for as long as this candle wick lasts I'd let him go free. Stupid thing drowned within minutes! I never tire of this. 13th of Evening Star, 4E 200 I haven't captured a soul for days, and the last victim died on impact. Of course I was still able to reclaim his soul, but without the thrill of killing, or any kind of torture, the process lacks that special something. The reclaimed souls I've summoned make decent targets, but taking a mortal's life is so much more...sweet.
traduit: 4E200年，夜星月4日 我总是惊讶于这简单的陷阱是怎么抓到这么多人。不过我可能要稍微调整一下。近来几个月许多人一碰到笼子底部就被摔死了，灌进去一两尺的水也无济于事。事实上水可能让事变得更糟了。上一个掉进去的摔断了胳膊腿！结果就那么漂在那里淹死了。要是没有水，我就能很开心地扭曲他的思维，直到我决定了结了他。 4E200年，夜星月8日 终于又抓到一个。毫无疑问，这些兽人的体型和力量与心智是成反比的。他们居然会说话。他一直在喊，说等他出来，就会把我像树枝一样劈成两半……挺有说服力啊？总之，我告诉他，如果他把头扎水里，坚持到蜡烛烧完，我就放他自由。几分钟就淹死了！我从来都是乐此不疲。 4E200年，夜星月13日 好几天没抓到灵魂了。最后一个受害者是摔死的。当然，我还是能收回他的灵魂，但没有了杀戮的刺激和任何形式的折磨，这个过程就缺乏了那种特殊的东西。召唤被再生灵魂倒是不错的目标，但剥夺凡人的生命会更……甜蜜。

original:

A Kiss, Sweet Mother

[pagebreak]

o you wish to summon the Dark Brotherhood? You wish to see someone dead? Pray, child. Pray, and let the Night Mother hear your plea. You must perform that most profane of rituals - the Black Sacrament. Create an effigy of the intended victim, assembled from actual body parts, including a heart, skull, bones and flesh. Encircle that effigy with candles. The ritual itself must then commence. Proceed to stab the effigy repeatedly with a dagger rubbed with the petals of a Nightshade plant, while whispering this plea: "Sweet Mother, sweet Mother, send your child unto me, for the sins of the unworthy must be baptized in blood and fear." Then wait, child, for the Dread Father Sithis rewards the patient. You will be visited by a representative of the Dark Brotherhood. So begins a contract bound in blood.

THE DREAMSTRIDE The Mysterious Alchemists of Vaermina [pagebreak] [pagebreak]

or over a thousand years, the Priests of Vaermina have been masters of the art of alchemy. The complexity and potency of their mixtures are nothing short of legendary. These alchemical treasures are so highly sought-after, that a single draught showing up on the black market can command sums in the tens of thousands of septims. Of the numerous potions that have surfaced to date, Vaermina's Torpor is perhaps the most impressive. A single sip of this viscous liquid places the imbiber in a state known as "The Dreamstride." This condition allows the subject to experience the dreams of another as if they were actually there. The subject becomes an integral part of the dream, behaving as if they belong. To any other entities in this dream state, the subject will be mistaken for the dreamer; the subject will even find his mannerisms, speech patterns and knowledge expanded appropriately. To an observer, after the subject has imbibed the potion, they will appear to vanish. As the subject traverses distances within the dream, they will also be traversing distances in the actual world. When the Torpor's effect has expired, the subject will fade back into reality in the exact location projected within the Dreamstride. Some Dreamstrides have transported their subjects a few feet, and some have appeared thousands of miles from their origin in a matter of minutes. It's to be noted that the Dreamstride is highly dangerous and presents the subject with numerous pitfalls. In certain dreams, subjects have been exposed to life-threatening scenarios such as sicknesses, violence and even death. In most cases, the subject simply fades back to our world without harm, but in some instances, the subject never reappeared and was assumed to have expired or the subject reappeared deceased. It's also quite possible that the subject could reappear in a precarious or hazardous location in reality, even though that location appeared safe within the Dreamstride. Vaermina's Torpor is as mysterious and elusive as the priests that created it. It's unknown whether this unique transport mechanism is a result of the Torpor itself or simply the odd machinations of Vaermina, but the potential for using the Dreamstride to penetrate seemingly impassible obstacles certainly outweighs its mysterious nature.

梦中漫步 瓦尔迷纳的秘仪炼金术师 [pagebreak] [pagebreak]

千余年来，瓦尔迷纳座下众多祭司都是炼金大师。由他们调和的高效而复杂的药剂无一不堪称传奇。该类炼金珍品极受追捧，区区一瓶出现在黑市就能被哄抬到数万塞普汀的天价。 在其许许多多记录在案的药饮中，最令人印象深刻者可能是“瓦尔迷纳之眠”。只需轻呷一口这黏稠的药液，饮用者就将入睡，并置身于被称作“梦中漫步”的状态。该状态赋予饮用者一种身临其境体验他人经历的清明梦。梦的主体成为梦不可分割的一部分，表现得好像他们属于梦一样。在梦境中出现的其他实体也会把做梦者误判为彼时的经历者；做梦者甚至会发现自己的行为举止、谈吐方式和知识面得到了适当的延展。 从观察者视角而言，做梦者在服下该药饮后似乎就会骤然消失。他们在梦中跨越了多远的距离，现实的身躯就梦游了多远。待梦游剂药力减退，他们的身体则逐渐浮现于在梦中漫步时最终所处位置的现实同一地点中。某些梦中漫步不过位移了数步之遥，而某些梦游却能出现在相隔起始点千里之外的位置。 需要指出，“梦中漫步”带有高度隐患，还会使做梦者蒙受众多的危险。在特定梦境中，做梦者还可能遭遇危及生命的情形，如染病、暴力乃至死亡。绝大多数案例内的做梦者能毫发无伤地直接浮现于现实世界，但在某些特例中，做梦者再也没有重新出现，可能已然死去；或是当他们再度出现时，已是一具死尸。这也很可能是因为做梦者重现于某些不稳定或是危险的位置——就算这些地点在梦游中是安全地带也一样。 瓦尔迷纳之眠神秘难解，就连调和它的祭司们都没法完全明了。这种独特的传送性质到底是，眠剂本身的药效还是瓦尔迷纳设下的古怪阴谋，至今仍是未知数。不过，比起那诡秘神异的性质，以“梦中漫步”渗透越过表面上不能穿行的障碍物，这种潜在的应用方式自然更有意义。

Our numbers are few, and with no Speaker, the contracts have dwindled almost to nothingness. Rasha's hold on the Sanctuary is slipping. 26th of Frostfall, 4E 189 Silence! Deafening silence! In my head in my head in my head. It is the silence of death, the silence of the Void. Seeping into me, through the Mother. The silence is hatred. The silence is rage. The silence is love. 4th of Evening Star, 4E 189 Today, Rasha declared himself Listener, claiming the Night Mother spoke to him at last. But when questioned, he could not name the Binding Words. Liar! Deceiver! His charade must not stand. 5th of Evening Star, 4E 189 Rasha is dead. As commanded by the silence, so did I obey. He did the deed, gladly. 10th of Sun's Dawn, 4E 190 Only three of us left. Cicero, Garnag, Pontius. 15th of Sun's Dawn, 4E 190 The Night Mother remains silent. I remain unworthy. The Sanctuary remains doomed. 3rd of First Seed, 4E 190 I can hear it. Deeper, and deeper. Louder and louder, punctuating the silence like thunder on a calm evening. Laughter. 4th of First Seed, 4E 190 Laughing, laughing, laughing, laughing! It is the jester! A voice from the Void, to cheer poor Cicero! I accept your gift, dearest Night Mother. Thank you for my laughter. Thank you for my friend. 16th of Rain's Hand, 4E 191 Pontius is dead. A Dark Brotherhood assassin was killed by a common bandit while walking the streets of Cheydinhal. How can something so sad be so funny? 17th of Rain's Hand, 4E 191 I love the laughter, dearest Night Mother, but still I long to hear your voice. It's not too late! Speak to me, my mother! Speak to me, that I may set things right! I can save the Sanctuary, I can save the Brotherhood! You can have the laughter! Take it back! An exchange, then? The laughter for your voice? 2nd of Second Seed, 4E 191 It's not safe to leave the Sanctuary. We'll stay here. All is well. 29th of Last Seed, 4E 191 Garnag is gone. Gone gone gone gone gone. Left to get food, but he'll be back. It's only been three months. Three months. Tree months? Twelve moths? Four sloths! 21st of Sun's Dusk, 4E 192 Cicero is dead! Cicero is born! The laughter has filled me, filled me so very completely. I am the laughter. I am the jester. The soul that has served as my constant companion for so long has breached the veil of the Void finally and forever. It is now in me. It is me. The world has seen the last of Cicero the man. Behold Cicero, Fool of Hearts - laughter incarnate! 28th of Sun's Dusk, 4E 200 Found the old journal, decided to write, a treatise on silence, sound, darkness and light! How long has it been since the Night Mother first came here? How long since I was made Keeper? How long since I became the fool? Since I've been alone? Since Cheydinhal fell? Since they started pounding on the door, like so many hammered heartbeats? It's dark in here, and quiet. Poor Cicero no longer hears the laughter, for he is the laughter. There is no Listener in Cheydinhal. No Listener in Cyrodiil. No Listener in me. We must leave here. Before the Sanctuary falls. Before the Night Mother burns. Before the Dark Brotherhood withers. Before the laughter dies. 29th of Sun's Dusk, 4E 200 I took a stroll, and spied a maid, but Matron's duty stayed my blade. So busy now, I miss the thrill, if only I had time to kill.
traduit: 第四纪元189年，炉火月1日 如先前许许多多其他城市一样，夏丁赫尔爆发了暴乱。圣所没有被破坏，但是能坚持多久呢？我们的人手寥寥，而没有发言者，契约也几乎要见底了。拉沙对圣所的控制力正在下降。 第四纪元189年，霜落月26日 寂静！绝对的寂静！在我脑子里在我脑子里在我脑子里。这是死亡的寂静，是虚空的寂静。通过母亲深入我的内心。寂静是恨意。寂静是愤怒。寂静是爱。 第四纪元189年，晚星月4日 今天，拉沙宣称他自己是聆听者，夜母终于跟他说话了。然而当我询问他时，他没法说出暗语。他撒谎！他欺诈！他的伪装站不住脚的。 第四纪元189年，晚星月5日 拉沙死了。 我遵从了寂静的命令。我才没有动刀子，哦不，我只是对加纳格那热切的耳朵说了点甜言蜜语。他是西塞罗和主母的好兄弟，忠诚的兄弟。他高高兴兴地行动了。 第四纪元190年，日暮月10日 只剩下我们三个了。西塞罗、加纳格、庞修斯。 第四纪元190年，日暮月15日 夜母仍然保持沉默。我仍然不够格。圣所依然难逃厄运。 第四纪元190年，初种月3日 我能听见。越来越深，越来越响，就像平静夜晚的雷声打破了寂静。是笑声。 第四纪元190年，初种月4日 笑声，笑声，笑声，笑声！是小丑！是来自虚空的声音，让可怜的西塞罗开心！最亲爱的夜母啊，我接受您的礼物。谢谢给我笑声。谢谢你我的朋友。 第四纪元191年，雨手月16日 庞修斯死了。黑暗兄弟会刺客走在夏丁赫尔大街上时候，被一个普普通通的暴徒杀死了。还有什么事情能如此悲伤，如此滑稽呢？ 第四纪元191年，雨手月17日 最最亲爱的夜母啊，我喜欢笑声，但我还是渴望听见您的声音。现在还不太晚！跟我说话吧，母亲！跟我说话，我能让事情回归正轨！我能拯救夏丁赫尔，我能拯救兄弟会！ 您能拥有笑声！收回它吧！然后呢，做个交换？用您的笑声？ 第四纪元191年，次种月2日 离开夏丁赫尔并不安全。我们会呆在这里。一切都很好。 第四纪元191年，末种月29日 加纳格走了。走了走了走了走了走了。他出去找吃的，但他会回来的。才刚刚过去了三个月。三个月。三个目？十二个日子？四个栗子！ 第四纪元192年，日暮月21日 西塞罗死了！西塞罗诞生了！ 笑声充斥了我，完完全全充斥了我。我就是笑声。我就是小丑。长久以来一直作为我永恒伴侣的灵魂，终于永远地打破了虚空的面纱。它现在在我心里。是我。 世界见证了西塞罗作为人的最后一面。看着西塞罗，红桃小丑——笑声的化身！ 第四纪元200年，日暮月28日 找到了旧日记，决定写东西，一篇关于寂静、声音、黑暗和光明的论文！ 自从夜母第一次到这里过去多久了？自从我当上守护者以来过去多久了？自从我成为小丑过去多久了？自从我独自一人，自从夏丁赫尔陷落，自从他们像许许多多人的心跳一样敲门，过去多久了？ 这里很黑、很安静诶。可怜的西塞罗再也听不见笑声了，因为他就是笑声。夏丁赫尔没有聆听者。希罗帝尔没有聆听者。我不是聆听者。 我们必须离开这里。在圣所陷落前。在夜母烧毁前。在黑暗兄弟会消失前。在笑声沉寂前。 第四纪元200年，日暮月29日 我出去溜达了一圈，碰见了个女仆，不过主母的职责不让我拔刀。我太忙了，我错过了刺激的时刻，要是我有空杀人该多好啊。

original: Cicero's Journal - Volume 3
traduit: 西塞罗的日记·卷3

original: 23rd of Sun's Dusk, 4E 188 Now that things have settled down, the reality of our situation has finally come to bear - we are a Dark Brotherhood without a Listener. With no Listener, the Black Sacrament will go unheard. Surely the Night Mother will speak to someone soon, thus choosing a new Listener to take Alisanne Dupre's place. Until that happens, though, we must take to the streets. We must hear the pleas of the desperate and vengeful. The people of Tamriel must not know, must never know, that their prayers to the Night Mother are going unheeded. 24th of Morning Star, 4E 189 It is a new year, and two months since the Night Mother first arrived here at the Cheydinhal Sanctuary, and still the Unholy Matron has not seen fit to speak to any one of us. And so, Rasha has decided to revive an ancient Dark Brotherhood tradition - the appointing of a Keeper, a guardian whose sole duty is the safeguarding of the Night Mother's remains. The remaining members of the Black Hand will make their decision tomorrow. 25th of Morning Star, 4E 189 I have been chosen. By some incomprehensible twist of fate, the Black Hand has named me the Night Mother's Keeper. In all honesty, I am both incredibly honored and deeply saddened. This means the end of my contracts. I'll be lucky to lift a blade again. Thankfully, Rasha has promised me one final contract before I accept my new duties. 30th of Morning Star, 4E 189. The jester lies dead. My final contract has been completed. Oh, how he laughed and laughed. Until he didn't. 3rd of First Seed, 4E 189 I have settled well into my new role as Keeper. It is my duty to not only keep the Night Mother's shrine clean, and the candles lit, but to tend to the body as well. The Night Mother's crypt was a consecrated place - shroud-kissed, absent of sunlight, and safe from the world above. Removed from there, the remains are subject to the filth and corruption of the living. The body is perfectly preserved, so the concern is not physical, but rather spiritual - the remains must be sanctified regularly, so that they may continue to serve as a conduit for the Night Mother's soul. Our Matron's eternal spirit may travel the Void freely, but it is through her own earthly remains that she communicates with the Listener. And so, I wash the corpse weekly with the requisite oils, recite the ancient incantations, and personally see to the extermination of any insects or rodents. If the Night Mother does not speak, it will be because she chooses not to - not because she is unable. This is my responsibility. This is my vow. 12th of Mid Year, 4E 189 Months and months and months and no Listener. Why won't the Night Mother speak to me? I am worthy as Keeper, but not as Listener? I protect our Lady, keep her sanctified, but still she will not grace me with her voice? 4th of Sun's Height, 4E 189 So long since I worked my blade. So long since I saved a soul. But I am now Keeper. No longer a taker. I think back fondly on my hours with the jester. His laughter, his screams, his pitiful cries. And then, as the end drew near, his laughter once more. Merry in death as well as life. I was honored to know him.
traduit: 第4纪元188年，日暮月23日 现在事情尘埃落定了，我们的处境开始显现——一个没有聆听者的黑暗兄弟会。没有聆听者，就不会有人聆听黑色圣礼。当然了，夜母很快会跟某人对话，新选中的聆听者会代替阿蕾萨妮·杜普雷的位置。不过在那之前，我们必须得走上街头。我们必须倾听绝望和复仇之人的恳求。永远不能让泰姆瑞尔的人们知道他们向夜母的祈求被忽视了。 第4纪元 189年，晨星月24日 新年到了，自从夜母首次到达这所夏丁赫尔圣所以来已经两个月了，然而不洁主母仍然没有在我们任何人中找到合适的人选。 因此，拉沙决定重启一项黑暗兄弟会的古老传统--指定一名守护者，一位全职保护夜母遗骨安全的卫士。剩下的黑手成员明天就会做出决定。 第4纪元189年，晨星月25日 我被选中了。造化弄人，黑手任命我为夜母的守护者。说实话，我既感到无比荣幸又特别伤心。这意味着我不能再去履行契约了。我还能再次拿起武器就很幸运了。谢天谢地，拉沙许诺在我接受新任务前给我最后一桩契约。 第4纪元189年，晨星月30日 小丑死了。我最后的契约完成了。啊，他就那么笑啊笑啊笑啊，直到最后咽了气。 第4纪元189年，初种月3日 我已经适应了作为守护者的新角色。我的职责不仅仅是保持夜母祭坛的干净整洁，点燃蜡烛，还要保养好遗骨。夜母的墓穴是一处神圣之所——被层层缠绕，隔绝阳光，远离尘世。离开那里，遗骨就会受到生者的污秽与腐败的影响。躯体被完美地保存起来，因此物质上的担忧不足为惧，但精神上的却要重视起来。遗骸需要定期进行尸祝，只有这样它才能继续充当夜母灵魂传导的媒介。我们主母永恒的灵魂也许能自由往来虚空，然而她要通过留在现世遗体，才能与聆听者交流。 因此，我每周得用必需的油脂清洁遗体，背诵古老的咒语，亲手消灭所有昆虫以及鼠类。如果夜母现在没有说话，那只是因为她选择不去说话，而非不能说话。这是我的职责。这是我的誓言。 第4纪元189年，年中月12日 月复一月，还是没有聆听者。为什么夜母不跟我说话？我是一个合格的守护者，但不配做聆听者吗？我保护我们的圣母，维持她的神性，但她仍然不愿赐予我聆听她声音的权利吗？ 第4纪元189年，日高月4日 自打我放下武器以来，自打我超度灵魂以来，已经过去太久太久了。不过现在我是一名守护者。不是一名杀手。 我深深地记起我与小丑共度的时光，他的笑声，他的尖叫，他可怜兮兮的哭泣。然后，随着大限将至，他又笑了出来。活着死去都是那么快活。我很荣幸能认识他。

traduit: 西塞罗的日记·卷2

original: 7th of Sun's Height, 4E 188 Wayrest is lost. The city fell to corsairs, and it's just a matter of time before the Sanctuary is breached. May the Night Mother watch over her children in their hour of need. 5th of Last Seed, 4E 188 We received word today - the Wayrest Sanctuary was raided and destroyed by the corsairs. There were no survivors. There are now only three active Dark Brotherhood strongholds remaining: The Cheydinhal Sanctuary, here in the Imperial Province; a remote Sanctuary located in a forest in Skyrim; and the Corinthe Sanctuary of Elsweyr. The Black Hand has ordered the Corinthe Sanctuary closed, and its members integrated into our own ranks here, in Cheydinhal. I will embrace those new family members as warmly as I was, when I first made my home here. 27th of Hearthfire, 4E 188 The situation in Bravil grows more dire. The city has erupted in violence, due to a war of control being waged by Cyrodiil's two largest skooma traffickers. The Listener, Alisanne Dupre, has been forced to employ sellswords to protect her own residence. 1st of Sun's Dusk, 4E 188 Things in Bravil have come to a head. The statue of the Lucky Old Lady has been destroyed, and Alisanne Dupre has left her residence to guard the crypt of the Night Mother, hidden below the remains of the statue. If the crypt is discovered, Alisanne Dupre will, of course, protect the remains of the Unholy Matron until her dying breath. Rasha is sending Garnag and Andronica to aid in the crypt's defense. I begged to accompany them, but Rasha wouldn't have it. He says my place is here, defending this Sanctuary, and I must of course respect that decision. 12th of Sun's Dusk, 4E 188 Botched my contract and forfeited the bonus. The silk merchant was already cold, and I was halfway through the window, when her daughter stepped into the room. I had little choice at that point. 21st of Sun's Dusk, 4E 188 So much has happened since my last entry. After Garnag and Andronica left for Bravil, we stopped receiving communications from the city. We feared the worst. This morning, those fears were confirmed, when Garnag returned alone, transporting a most precious cargo - the great stone coffin of the Night Mother herself. The story Garnag told could curl the blood of even the most hardened of Sithis' servants. The crypt of the Night Mother, raided. Dearest sister Andronica, cut to pieces. And the Listener herself, the most honored Alisanne Dupre, burned alive in a storm of mage fire. Garnag, though gravely injured (he will most certainly lose his right eye), managed to fend off the attackers, and transport the Night Mother's coffin safely out of the city. He has been on the road, making his way back here, since that tragic night.
traduit: 4E 188年，日高月7日 途歇城陷落了。城市落入了海盗之手，圣所被攻破只是时间问题了。希望夜母能够在她的孩子们需要她的时候保佑他们。 4E 188年，末种月5日 我们今天收到了消息，途歇城圣所被海盗袭击摧毁了。无人生还。 如今黑暗兄弟会只剩下了三所活跃的据点：在此地位于帝国省的夏丁赫尔圣所；位于天际森林的遥远圣所；以及位于艾斯维尔的科林斯圣所。 黑手下令关闭科林斯圣所，成员整合进了我们夏丁赫尔的队伍中。我会像我初到这里安家的时候一样，尽可能热情地接纳这些新成员。 4E 188年，炉火月27日 布拉维尔的形势变得更加严峻了。希罗帝尔两支最大的斯库玛毒贩团伙发生了所有权的争端，城市发生了暴乱。聆听者阿蕾萨妮·杜普雷被迫找雇佣兵保护她的住处。 4E 188年，日暮月1日 布拉维尔的事情越发紧急。幸运老妇人的雕塑被摧毁了，阿蕾萨妮·杜普雷离开了她的居所，来看守藏于雕塑残骸下的夜母墓穴。如果墓穴被摧毁，阿蕾萨妮·杜普雷无疑会保护不洁主母的遗骨至死方休。 拉沙派加纳格和安德洛妮卡去帮忙守卫墓穴。我求着跟他们一起去，但拉沙不让。他说我的任务是呆在这里保卫圣所，而我理所应当必须尊重这一决定。 4E 188年，日暮月12日 我把契约搞砸了，没拿到奖金。丝绸商人已经凉了，而就在我快要走到窗户的时候，她的女儿进了房间。那时我别无选择。 4E 188年，日暮月21日 自从我上次记日记后发生了很多事情。在加纳格和安德洛妮卡去往布拉维尔后，我们与那座城市失联了。我们害怕会发生最糟糕的情况。今早，当加纳格独自运送最珍贵的东西——夜母本尊的大石棺回来的时候，那些恐惧成真了。 加纳格所讲述的故事可以让最冷漠的西帝斯仆从心头一凌。夜母的墓穴被攻破了。亲爱的姐妹安德洛妮卡被人大卸八块。而最令人尊敬的聆听者本人，阿蕾萨妮·杜普雷，被魔法火焰风暴活活给烧死了。 尽管加纳格人受重伤（他的右眼肯定是瞎了），但仍然没能抵御袭击者，只能连夜将夜母的棺材安全运出城市。自从那惨绝人寰的一夜之后，他一直在往回赶。

original: 18th of Evening Star, 4E 186 As I begin this new phase of my life, I have decided to finally keep a journal. So much has happened to me thus far, both within the Brotherhood and without - when I think there is no record of what has transpired, it almost seems an affront to Sithis himself. So I am determined to make amends. Yes, the Dark Brotherhood has its own scribes and chroniclers, but it is their solemn task to record those events deemed important to the organization as a whole. Let this volume serve as the personal record of one man, a lowly assassin who has pledged his blade and his life for the Dark Brotherhood. 23rd of Evening Star, 4E 186 I have arrived safely in the Cheydinhal Sanctuary, and have been greeted warmly by Rasha and the others. Indeed, the level of support and acceptance shown by my new family is rather overwhelming. For this Sanctuary knows suffering, knows sorrow, for the ghosts of Purification still haunt its halls. So, who better to understand the plight of a brother who has lost home and heart? Who better to comfort one whose Sanctuary is no more? The Bruma Sanctuary may be gone, but my dearest brothers and sisters will live forever in my dreams, just as their souls live forever by the Dread Father's side. 1st of Rain's Hand, 4E 187 Completed the baroness contract. She died well. Her handmaiden, less so. 12th of Rain's Hand, 4E 187 Cheydinhal suits me. With the destruction or abandonment of the other Sanctuaries, our contracts are plentiful, as are our bonuses. Still, we seem to be losing our footholds throughout Tamriel at an alarming rate. There are rumors that the Black Hand is split on our continued direction. Some favor expansion, the others consolidation. My personal feeling is that the Dark Brotherhood needs to, at the very least, maintain the illusion of being everywhere at once. It has become exceedingly difficult to fulfill (or even establish) contracts in provinces where we no longer have a physical presence, like Hammerfell. The more we ignore Tamriel, the more people lose faith in the Dark Brotherhood - our power, our services, our dedication to the Void. 27th of Rain's Hand, 4E 187 The Listener, Alisanne Dupre, has been visiting with us for several days, down from her private residence in Bravil. She and Rasha had been discussing the possibility of re-opening the Shadowscale training facility of Archon, in Black Marsh, but ultimately decided we lacked the resources to follow through with the plan. 27th of Rain's Hand, 4E 187 Completed the Arena contract. I ultimately decided to pose as a starstruck fan, and immediately got into the Grand Champion's good graces. While escorting the arrogant fool through the Great Forest, I slashed his throat and left the corpse for the bears.
traduit: 4E 186年，夜星月18日 随着我的生活进入了新阶段，我终于下定决心写日记了。到目前为止，我经历过了很多兄弟会里里外外的事情--如果我觉得无事可记的话，那就几乎是对西帝斯本尊的冒犯了。因此我决心做出弥补。 黑暗兄弟会是有自己的抄写员和记录人，不过他们的庄严任务是记录那些对整个组织而言意义重大的事件。就让这卷日记成为一个卑微的刺客，一个为黑暗兄弟会献出他的刀剑以及生命的人的私人记录吧。 4E 186年，夜星月23日 我已经安全抵达了夏丁赫尔圣所，受到了拉沙以及其他人的热烈欢迎。确实，我的新家庭对我的支持和接受程度相当高。因为这座圣所仍然记得痛苦，记得哀伤，被净化的幽灵们仍旧徘徊在这间大厅。那怎能不理解一位失去家和心灵的兄弟的困境呢？又怎能不给自己圣所已然不复存在的人以安慰呢？ 布鲁玛圣所也许消失了，然而我最亲爱的兄弟姐妹们会永远活在我的梦中，就如同他们的灵魂永远与恐惧之父同在一样。 4E 187年，雨手月1日 刺杀男爵夫人的契约完成了。她死得很干脆。但她的女仆就没这么舒服了。 4E 187年 雨手月12日 夏丁赫尔很适合我。随着其他圣所被摧毁和被抛弃，我们的契约和酬金越来越多。 然而，我们似乎正在以惊人的速度失去在整个泰姆瑞尔的据点。有传言说黑手就未来发展方向上出现了分歧。有人支持扩张，而其余人支持巩固整合。 我个人的想法是黑暗兄弟会至少需要维持一种无所不在的错觉。在我们不具有实际组织存在的省份，比如落锤，履行（甚至是签订）契约都变得很困难。我们越是忽视泰姆瑞尔，就会有越多人对黑暗兄弟会，对我们的力量、我们的服务、我们对于虚空的决心，失去信任。 4E 187年，雨手月27日 聆听者阿蕾萨妮·杜普雷从她在布拉维尔的私人居所来拜访了我们几天。她跟拉沙讨论要重启位于黑沼泽亚坎城的影鳞训练课程，但最终认定我们缺乏足够的资源来执行这一计划。 4E 187年，雨手月27日 竞技场的契约完成了。我最终决定扮演一位追星迷，并立即得到了总冠军的青睐。在护送这个目中无人的蠢蛋经过大森林时，我割断了他的喉咙，然后把他的尸体留下喂熊了。

[pagebreak] Jorgen of Morthal, 8th generation of Clan Axe-Bearer to bear the Hilt of Mehrunes' Razor. Son of Halnir, son of Hroi, son of Koli, son of Malte, son of Lygrleid, son of Neddrir, son of Lenne. [pagebreak] Ghunzul, leader of the Cracked Tusk Bandits, and 8th to bear the blade shards of Mehrunes' Razor. Son of Shelakh, son of Mog, son of Grul, son of Durgob, son of Uzgakh, son of Ramolg, son of Othmash. [pagebreak] Drascua, leader of the Forsworn of Dead Crone Rock, and 8th to bear the pommel of Mehrunes' Razor. Daughter of Cairine, daughter of Edana, daughter of Malvina, daughter of Muriel, daughter of Riane, daughter of Cayleigh, daughter of Sorcha. [pagebreak]

HISTORICAL BACKGROND

Of all the groups that pledged to eradicate the Mythic Dawn from Tamriel, none were as inadvertently successful as the Keepers of the Razor. Originally a militia group founded to destroy the remnants of the Mythic Dawn, the group was renamed the after discovering the legendary artifact of Mehrunes Dagon that became their namesake. How they found the Razor is a secret that I have been unable to uncover, but it is clear that they were not part of Frathen Drothan's failed expedition to Varsa Baalim, and in fact the group does not first appear in Imperial records until fifty years later. The Razor was divided among the three highest ranking members of the order's inner circle, to be passed down from oldest child to oldest child "until the twin moons themselves disappeared from the skies." Although this pledge seems to have been loosely interpreted, as the moons did vanish from the heavens during The Void Nights of 4E98-4E100, yet the Razor's pieces were still being bequeathed through the generations during and after this time. Tracing the lineages of the inner circle proved especially difficult thanks to the group's unusual membership. While the leader of the Keepers of the Razor was a Nord and thankfully was easily researched through the clan's family histories, the other two members were an Orc and a native daughter of the Reach, whose culture's paucity of respect for literacy made tracking them down less straightforward. Fortunately, Othmash gro-Gularz and his sons are well-recorded for their service in the Imperial Legion. Yet the daughters of Sorcha proved nearly impossible to find until I uncovered Markarth's meticulously thorough tax records, which recorded each birth of Sorcha's kin in order to administer certain petty fees. Sorscha's current descendent, Drascua, fled to Dead Crone Rock after the Markarth Incident, and is considered by the Jarl to be a major threat to the safety of the hold.

[pagebreak]

剃刀的守护者们 核心圈的现后裔

[pagebreak] 莫萨尔的乔尔根，“持斧者”氏族第八代梅鲁涅斯剃刀柄传人。父亲哈尼尔，祖父赫莱，曾祖克里，高祖马尔特，五世祖莱格莱，六世祖内德瑞，七世祖莱内。 [pagebreak] 古祖尔，裂牙堡垒强盗的首领，第八代梅鲁涅斯剃刀刃传人。父亲舍拉克，祖父莫格，曾祖格鲁尔，高祖杜尔戈布，五世祖乌斯迦克，六世祖拉莫格，七世祖奥斯曼什。 [pagebreak] 德拉斯库拉，亡妪岩弃誓者的首领，第八代梅鲁涅斯剃刀柄头传人。母亲凯琳，祖母艾达娜，曾祖母马尔维娜，高祖母姆瑞尔，五世祖母瑞安妮，六世祖母凯烈，七世祖母索尔茶。 [pagebreak]

历史背景

在所有发誓要在泰姆瑞尔铲除神话黎明的组织中，只有剃刀守护者在不经意间取得了成功。起初他们只是个民兵组织，目的就是为了摧毁神话黎明的残余，该组织发现了传说中梅鲁涅斯·大衮的神器，并以此重新命名了自己的名字。至于他们是如何发现剃刀，一直是我难以解开的谜题，但很明显，他们并没有参与弗雷森·得罗桑那次失败的瓦萨·巴里姆探险，因为事实上，他们是直到那次探险的五十年后才首次出现在帝国的记录中。 剃刀被分配给了教团核心圈三位级别最高的成员，并不断传给他们的长子，“直到双月从天空中消失”。当然，这个誓言似乎也不是没有漏洞，因为在4E98-100年的“虚空之夜”期间，双月确实从天空消失了，但剃刀碎片还是在这段时间和其后被代代相传。 由于该组织成员来源不同寻常，追踪其核心圈子的血脉变得尤为困难。剃刀守护者的首领是个诺德人，得益于氏族历史记载，找到他们并不难，可另外两人一个是兽人，一个是瑞驰人女子，他们的文化缺乏对文字记载的尊重，所以追踪他们就不那么容易了。所幸，奥斯曼什·格洛-古拉兹及其子孙在帝国军团的服役记录保存良好。但索尔茶的女性后人们几乎不可能找到了，直到我发现了马卡斯一丝不苟的税务记录，其中有索尔茶后人的出生记录，以便管理征税。索尔茶的后代德拉斯库拉在马卡斯事件后逃到了亡妪岩。被领主视为领地安全的主要威胁之一。

original: Stromm's Diary
traduit: 斯特罗姆的日记

original:
I've decided to remain behind with one of our guards and further document the living area we've stumbled across. I write this to the best of my ability, but due to the sudden disappearance of the Dwemer it is almost impossible to say for certain what anything is. The Tree By the Nine I cannot determine the purpose of this tree. It appears to be from the area around Whiterun, but why and how it got here is beyond me. I think it may be a gift from the surface world, but based on the lavish surroundings it could also be a display of power. I'll check the living areas nearby for any additional clues. Living Areas Upon further investigation of the area, it looks like this structure houses two clans or families. I can think of no other reason for this particular layout. Perhaps this group oversaw this particular portion of the city? I'll have to compare notes from the other areas as we uncover more of the city - hopefully some of those will contain more in depth clues. It appears a smaller wing collapsed on itself and maybe when the expedition returns we can dig out an entrance. Falmer have begun to creep back into this area of the ruins. It's a good thing I am not alone here.
We've managed to block off some of the areas we suspect the Falmer were coming in through, but they're still getting to us somehow. Together we are able to hold them back, but how long until Staubin and the rest return?
traduit:
我决定和一名护卫留下来进一步记录我们偶然发现的这个生活区。我会尽我所能写完这篇文章，但由于锻莫的突然消失，几乎没法下定论了。 [pagebreak] 树 我无法确定该树的用途。似乎是来自白漫附近的地区，但我不明白它是怎么被移栽到这里的。我认为这可能是地表世界的礼物，但基于周围奢华的环境，也可能是一种权力的象征。我去附近的生活区找找有没有其他线索。 [pagebreak] 生活区 根据对该区域的进一步调查，这座建筑似乎住着两个氏族或家庭。我想不出这样特殊布局的其他原因了。也许是这个组织在监督城市的这个特殊区域？随着我们对这座城市探索的越发深入，我必须与其他区域的人交换意见，希望其中能包含更多深入的线索。好像有个小侧翼倒塌了，也许等探险队回来，我们可以挖出一个入口。 [pagebreak] 伐莫已经悄悄摸回这片区域了。还好我不是一个人在这里。
我们已经成功封锁了一些我们怀疑的伐莫可以通过的区域，但他们还是会以某种方式接近我们。我们齐心协力就能阻止他们，但斯陶宾他们什么时候能回来？

original:
A mighty lord deserves a mighty offering

无论一个人生前强大抑或卑微，
我们最终都将回归这蘑菇生长的地方。

original: Staubin's Diary
traduit: 斯陶宾的日记

original:
After making our way down the mine and through the spiders we've finally made it down to Nchaund-Zel proper. They've built this city into the very cave walls that house it. Amazing. Nchuand-Zel hums with life, but its guardians lay dormant, hopefully we can learn more as we go deeper.

* * * * *

This area seems to be where two of the city's families lived. We've spent some time studying this tree outside the dwellings but cannot figure out what its significance is. Stromm will be remaining behind with one of the students to further study this area in greater depth. I look forward to reading his notes on the subject.

* * * * *

Today we entered the city's armory. The Falmer have yet to break into the best of the dwarven goods thanks to the sturdy dwemer locks. Erj said he would be able to get into the vaults and would send word when he's in. The spiders gave us much trouble but who could have foreseen they've been the only thing keeping Markarth safe?

* * * * *

After exiting the Armory we made camp, but the Falmer have been watching us and finally tired of our intrusion. They came while we slept and slaughtered what guards were left. Meridia forgive me for using my students as a distraction to get away, but I have to bring this place back to life.

* * * * *

too many . . . couldn't hit switch . . .
traduit:
我们沿着矿场往下走，穿过蜘蛛群抵达了尼楚安德-泽尔。他们把城市建在了洞穴里。太神奇了。尼楚安德-泽尔充满了生命，但守护者却在休眠，希望随着我们深入研究，能了解到更多。

* * * * *

这片区域似乎是城市里两户人家居住的地方。我们在民居外研究过这棵树，但不知道它的意义。斯特罗姆和其中一名学生留在后面，进一步研究该区域。期待能阅读他关于该课题的笔记。

* * * * *

今天我们进入了城市的军械库。多亏矮人坚固的锁，伐莫还没能撬开他们最好的物品。厄基说他能进入保险库，进去后给我们发信号。蜘蛛给我们带来了很多麻烦，但谁能想到它们是唯一能保护马卡斯安全的东西？

* * * * *

离开军械库，我们扎营了，但伐莫一直在关注我们，终于厌倦了我们的入侵。他们趁我们睡觉的时候来屠杀了剩下的护卫。美瑞蒂亚，请原谅我用自己的学生来帮我分散注意力，但我必须让这个地方活起来。

* * * * *

太多了…… 没法按下开关了……

original:
<font face='$HandwrittenFont'><font size='18'>
We tried to get through glacier at the top, but we couldn't find any way into that tower parapet. Yag spotted in the glacial wall and construction of a catwalk was finished just in time for a storm to hit. At first we thought to wait it out, but it has only gotten worse. A shift in the glacier took out several of the new laborers.

I ordered everyone to quickly move as much of the supplies as we could into the fissure and we managed to get most of it. One of the hands decided he wasn't going to listen and tried to make it out through the storm, but got blown off the catwalk by the wind.

Looks like we are well and truly stuck in here. But for all that I feel even more driven that I should be the one to uncover the mysteries of this ruin. I'm tired of all the credit for my work going to the Mages or the Legion. It will be my name that goes down in the history books for this discovery.

traduit:
<font face='$HandwrittenFont'><font size='18'>
我们试图穿过顶部的冰川，可是找不到任何办法进入塔楼。雅格在冰川壁上发现了裂缝，正在盯着搭建栈桥，结果赶上了风暴。起初我们还想等它过去，可天气变得越发糟糕。冰川的变化带走了几个新来的工人。

我命令所有人尽快把更多补给运进裂缝里。大部分东西都成功拿到了。有个人不听指挥，打算穿过风暴，结果被风吹下了栈桥。

看来我们真的被困住了。但就算这样，我还是觉得更有动力去探索这片遗迹的奥秘了。我已经厌倦了把所有功劳都归给法师们或者军团了。我会凭借这次发现而名标史册的。
</font>

original:
<font face='$HandwrittenFont'><font size='18'>
The eyeless creatures took us in our sleep. I don't know what happened to the Khajiit brothers, we never saw them in the cell. I managed to pick the lock and we made a break for it, but got split up. Sulla yelled something about not leaving without finding what he came here for and Umana chased after him.

Yag and I tried for the top of the cave shaft, but one of the ramps was broken. Without a hesitation, she grabbed me by the scruff of my tunic, threw me atop the ledge and told me to run. 

And I did.
I didn't even look back.
I just ran like a coward.
I could hear her fighting them and I just had to get away. I didn't even notice the arrow in my shoulder till I hid here.

[pagebreak]

Eight Divines, please just take me now.

<font face='$HandwrittenFont'><font size='18'>
那些不长眼的生物在我们睡觉时把我们抓了。不知道卡吉特那哥俩怎么样了，没在牢房看见他们。我把锁撬开了。虽然我们逃出来，但却分开了。苏拉大喊着不找到目标就不离开，乌马娜去追他了。
