original: Arondil's Journal Day 28 The new experiment has proven a success! The milk maid (who's name still escapes me) was revived as the others, bowing to my commands, with only one interesting development. She has reformed incorporeally, more phantasm than reanimated dead. As her glowing visage stood before me, I found my hand reaching out to touch her. As my fingers passed through her, I felt a sensation unlike any other, as if her essence were invigorating my very soul, connecting with me on a level no woman of flesh and blood could do. This discovery is life changing! Day 35 I have ordered my older servants to go out and find any more subjects that may have become lost. With the discovery of the inner sanctum deeper still within Yngvild, I should have sufficient room to store many new materials until I can transform them into willing slaves. I look back on my daydreams whilst living in Dawnstar and wonder if they were in fact portents of times to come...
traduit: 阿荣迪尔的日记 第二十八天 新实验成功了！挤奶女工（我还是没记起她的名字）和其他人一样复活了，服从了我的命令，不过有个有趣的进展。她是以无实体状态复活的，与其说是死尸复活，不如说是幻影。当她容光焕发的面庞出现在我面前时，我忍不住伸手抚摸她。当我的手指穿过她的身体，感到了一种与众不同的感觉，仿佛是她的精华激励着我的灵魂，这种联系是任何有血肉的女人都无法做到的。这个发现改变了我的生活！ 第三十五天 我已经命令老仆人们出去寻找更多可能迷路的对象了。随着鹰维尔德更深处的密室被发现，我应该有足够的空间来存储更多新材料，直到我把她们都变成自愿的奴隶。回想起住在晨星的白日梦，真不知这是否预示着我的好时代到来了……

original: Arondil's Journal, Part 3
traduit: 阿荣迪尔的日记·卷3

original: Arondil's Journal Day 21 An intriguing development. Tonight, my guards have brought me a trespasser they found near the cave. At first I was understandably upset. Not only was I disturbed during one of my few moments alone with my favorite servant, but I recognized the trespasser as a milk maid from Dawnstar. She remembered me, as well, and made bold claims that I had been lurking near her at all hours. What lies! True, I had taken notice of her on occasion, but she was nowhere near the most noticeable of maidens in town. Her continued accusations, coupled with my fear of more uninvited guests, led me to conclude that she could never return to Dawnstar. My servants were quick to carry out my sentencing. Her body is here next to me, as I write this. Funny. Her eyes are still so full of life. Perhaps I will try a new experiment tonight, using fresher materials.
traduit: 阿荣迪尔的日记 第二十一天 有趣的进展。今晚我的守卫给我带来了一个在洞穴附近发现的入侵者。开始我理所当然的陷入沮丧。因为在我和我最喜欢的仆人独处的时间被打扰了，而且这个闯入者居然是晨星城的挤奶女工。她还记得我，居然大胆地声称我一直躲在她附近。什么鬼话！是，我是偶尔注意过她，但她可算不得城里最引人注目的姑娘。她不断地指责我，再加上我害怕引来更多不速之客，所以结论很明显了：她不能再回晨星城了。我的仆人很快就执行了我的判决。 当我写这篇日记的时候，她的尸体就在我身边。有意思。她的眼睛还充满活力。也许今晚我能用更新鲜的材料来做新实验了。

traduit: 阿荣迪尔的日记·卷2

original: Arondil's Journal Day 8 I have established a temporary work station in the cold caves, and have found multiple burial chambers within the snow and ice. While in the first chamber, I exhumed a few 'test subjects,' all female. I was stunned to find my mind wandering again to the women of Dawnstar as I examine my find. At first, I was slightly disturbed by my thoughts, but later I found myself reevaluating... Day 9 The first trials went splendidly. Each subject was reanimated in a state of total complacency, bending to my every task and whim. I have ordered a few of my new servants to guard the island, while the rest will act as my personal entourage, standing by me at all times. Standing watch over me while I sleep...
traduit: 阿荣迪尔的日记 第八天 我在寒冷的洞穴里建了个临时工作点，又在冰雪下面发现了好几个墓穴。在第一间墓室里，我挖出了几个“测试对象”，还都是女性。我惊讶的发现，当我检视发现成果的时候，思绪又飞到了晨星的女人身上。一开始我还对此很困扰，但后来发现我得重新评估评估了…… 第九天 首轮实验很成功。每个对象都在一种十分完美的状态下重新活了过来，并服从我的所有指示和兴致。我已经命令几个新仆人守卫小岛，其他的则作为我的私人随从，随时陪在我身边。在我熟睡时守护我……

original:
Arondil's Journal Day 1 It seems the cretins of Dawnstar are not quite a foolish as I had surmised. They found my experimentations, and needless to say, were not pleased with what they saw. No matter. My work can only flourish without the distractions of living amongst the unenlightened. I have found a cave off the north coast of Skyrim that will be more than sufficient for my continued studies. The ruins of Yngvild should hold the materials I need to learn more about reanimating and enslaving the dead.
On a personal note, I WILL miss the young maidens of Dawnstar. Such beauty was intoxication. I often found my thoughts wandering around them, imagining secret encounters between myself and one or two of the local girls...
traduit:
阿荣迪尔的日记 第一天 看来晨星的白痴们也不像我想的那么蠢。他们发现了我的实验，不消说，他们对此很不满。无所谓。我的工作只有在不被无知者干扰的情况下才能蓬勃发展。 我在天际北部海岸找了个洞穴，用来继续研究绰绰有余了。鹰维尔德遗迹里应该有我需要的材料，来丰富我复活和奴役死者的知识。
不过我还是会想念晨星的年轻少女们。美得令人陶醉。我的思绪经常随她们游荡，想象着能和一两个当地女孩儿来一场神秘邂逅……

original:
The Lunar Forge
The Forge I've managed to get the forge itself up and running, but again, I find nothing special about its workings. These weapons were clearly forged here, yet the secret of their enchantment remains elusive. All I've been able to discern so far is some connection between the weapon's power and the appearance of the moons.





The Lunar Weapons The weapons themselves are crafted of what seems to be normal metal, but while the moons are high above they gain an additional ability. It seems that once the sun has gone down, the Lunar weapons take on a vampire-like ability, transferring a small amount of health from the victim to the user.
traduit:
月之锻炉
锻炉 我已经设法修好了锻炉并让它运转起来，但我又发现它的运行方式没什么特别的。这堆武器很明显是在这地方打出来的，然而它们上面那种附魔的秘密还是那么难以捉摸。到现在我能搞清楚的，也就是这些兵器的力量肯定和双月月相有联系。 月之武器 那些武器本身似乎就是寻常金属锻出来的，但一等月亮出来，它们就获得了额外的能力。看起来太阳一落下去，那些月之武器就拥有了像吸血鬼一般的效果，能从受害者身上将少量的生命力给吸取到使用者身上。

13th of Sun's Dusk 1E139 

At the command of Lord Harald we have swept our company to the south edge of our territories in an attempt to drive the Snow Elves up north to the main host of his forces. The first few days met with heavy resistance, but as we approached the eastern edge of Lake Honnith we have seen little and less of them.

21st of Sun's Dusk 1E139

We've begun to receive reports of attacks back around Lake Honnith and word has come from the front that we should pull back to be sure we are not leaving our rear exposed. If there is a stronghold of Elves here, we will surely root them out.

27th of Sun's Dusk  1E139 

It sounds impossible, but we appeared to have stumbled upon a massive hold out of the Dragon Cultists, who were believed to be wiped out during the Dragon War. The Elves must wait, as this is a threat we cannot ignore. If we are quick, we may be able to catch them unaware and avoid a lengthy siege.

21st of Evening Star 1E139

Third week of the siege. The men grow restless with the cold and all miss their families. If that blasted storm hadn't caught us off guard and slowed our ascent we might have taken the Monastery, but as it stands we may be in for several more weeks of pounding on their walls. I've sent word to Harald to send one of the Voice masters to help bring down the wall.

4th of Morning Star 1E140

We've brought down their main gate thanks to the young Voice master, but the brash lad took an arrow in the neck in the process. It seems he will be joining the Eight in Sovngarde soon. The cultists have fallen back to the interior of the Monastery but soon enough we will breach those defenses. The sooner the better - it's too blasted cold on this mountain.

5th of Morning Star 1E140

We entered the Monastery today only to find all inside dead. It appears they purposely caved in the stairway to the refectory and then took their own lives. Some appear to have slit their own wrists, others we found with empty vials. Most appear to be poisoned, but oddly there are not as many empty bottles as one would expect by the number of dead. We shall hold up here over night rather than face the cold, and explore the catacombs in the morning to see if we can find another passage to the upper areas.

6th of Morning Star 1E140

May the Eight protect us from Dragons and madmen. We lost half our remaining men today. We discovered a well in the catacombs, locked but with several buckets already filled, and in their excitement for a drink that didn't risk frostbite on their tongue, two score drank before we could stop them. Gods only know how these cultists could use that horrible poison in their own water supply. We've lost more men to this catastrophe than we did taking the courtyard.

The well was locked from this side, and the key must be somewhere in the catacombs, but with the ghosts of these dead cultists and the men demoralized, it just isn't worth the search. Let those gods-forsaken cultists drink their way to Oblivion and be done with it. The upper door in the courtyard has some sort of barrier over it and our mages believe that the sacrifice made here will sustain it for decades at the least.

We leave this accursed place tomorrow to regroup and push up north, but I will leave this journal, so that in an age or so when the poison has faded, someone may find a way in to be sure the cultists met their due fate.
</font>

1E139年 日暮月13日

奉哈拉尔德大人之命，我部已扫荡到了领土的南端，以期将雪精灵向北驱赶至主力大军的包围圈中。最初几天遇到强烈抵抗，但我们接近霍利奇湖东岸的时候，所能看到的雪精灵已经越来越少了。

1E139年 日暮月21日

我们收到报告，霍利奇湖附近发生袭击，前线则传来消息说我们应该撤退，确保后方不会暴露。如果这里有精灵据点，我们一定要铲除。

1E139年 日暮月27日

虽然听起来匪夷所思，但我们好像偶然发现了一个大型拜龙教据点，他们明明已经在巨龙战争中灭亡了才对。精灵们先搁置一边，因为拜龙教是不可忽视的威胁。如果我们行动够快，也许能在出其不意的情况下干掉他们，以免长期围城战。

1E139年 夜星月21日

围困已持续三周。弟兄们因为寒冷而焦躁不安，大家都很想家。要不是那场猛烈的风暴打得我们措手不及，减慢了我们的速度，我们可能已经拿下那个修道院了，但照目前的情况看，大概还要再折腾几周了。我已经派人传信给哈拉尔德，让他派一位吼声大师来帮忙攻克城墙。

1E140年 晨星月4日

多亏了那位年轻的吼声大师，我们把大门冲开了，但那莽小伙子脖子上挨了一箭。看来他很快就要加入松加德的八神了。教徒们已经撤到修道院内部，但我们很快就能攻破那些防线。越快越好，这山上太冷了。

1E140年 晨星月5日

我们今天攻进修道院了，但里面的人都死了。看来他们是故意把通往餐厅的主楼梯弄塌然后自杀了。有的是割腕，有的身边有空药瓶。大部分似乎都是中毒死的，奇怪，死亡人数和瓶子对不上，瓶子数量没有那么多。我们应该在这里过夜，顺道避避风寒，明天一早再探索墓穴，看看能不能找到其他通往上层区的通道。

1E140年 晨星月6日

愿八神保佑我们不受龙族和疯子们的伤害。今天我们损失了一半人。我们在墓穴里发现了一眼井，井口门锁着，但有好几桶装好的水。弟兄们渴疯了，只想喝一口不至于冻伤舌头的水，我们没来得及阻止，就有四十多人把水喝了。天知道这些教徒居然会在自己的水源里下这种可怕的毒药。我们在这场意外灾难中牺牲的人比占领庭院死的还多。

这口井是从这边锁上的，钥匙肯定在墓穴的什么地方，但那群死去的教徒鬼魂四处游荡，弟兄们士气也低，根本不值得去找了。让那些被神遗弃的教徒到湮灭继续喝去吧。院子上面的门上有某种屏障，我们的法师认为这里的献祭至少能让它维持几十年。

明天我们就离开这倒霉地方，重新集结然后向北进发，但我把日记留在这里，等什么时候毒药消散，就能有人找到进去的办法，确认那些教徒得到了应有的下场了。

ON ARTAEUM By Taurce il-Anselma

[pagebreak] [pagebreak]

he Isle of Artaeum (ar-TAY-um) is the third largest island in the Summurset archipelago, located south of the Moridunon village of Potansa and west of the mainland village of Runcibae. It is best known for being home to the Psijic Order, perhaps the oldest monastic group in Tamriel. The earliest written record of Psijics is from the 20th year of the First Era and tells the tale of the renowned Breton sage and author Voernet, traveling to the Isle of Artaeum to meet with Iachesis, the Ritemaster of the Psijics. Even then, the Psijics were the counsellors of kings and proponents of the "Elder Way," taught to them by the original race that inhabited Tamriel. The Elder Way is a philosophy of meditation and study said to bind the forces of nature to the individual will. It differs from magicka in origin, but the effects are much the same. That said, it is perhaps more than coincidence that the Isle of Artaeum literally vanished from the shores of Summurset at the beginning of the Second Era at about the time of the founding of the Mages Guild in Tamriel. Various historians and scholars have published theories about this, but perhaps none but Iachesis and his own could shed light on the matter. Five hundred years passed and Artaeum returned. The Psijics on the Isle consisted of persons, mostly Elves, who had disappeared and were presumed dead in the Second Era. They could not or would not offer any explanation for Artaeum's whereabouts during that time, or the fate of Iachesis and the original council of Artaeum. Currently, the Psijics are led by the Loremaster Celarus, who has presided over the Council of Artaeum for the last two hundred and fifty years. The Council's influence in Tamrielan politics is tidal. The kings of Summurset, particularly those of Moridunon, have often sought the Psijics' opinion. Emperor Uriel V was much influenced by the Council in the early, most glorious parts of his reign, before his disastrous attack on Akavir. It has even been suggested that the fleet of King Orghum of Pyandonea was destroyed by a joint effort of Emperor Antiochus and the Psijic Order. The last four emperors, Uriel VI, Morihatha, Pelagius IV, and Uriel VII, have been suspicious of the Psijics enough to refuse ambassadors from the Isle of Artaeum within the Imperial City. The Isle of Artaeum is difficult to chart geographically. It is said that it shifts continuously either at random or by decree of the Council. Visitors to the island are so rare as to be almost unheard of. Anyone desirous of a meeting with a Psijic may find contacts in Potansa and Runcibae as well as many of the kingdoms of Summurset. Were it more accessible, Artaeum would be a favored destination for travelers. I have been to the Isle once and still dream of its idyllic orchards and clear pastures, its still and silent lagoons, its misty woodlands, and the unique Psijic architecture that seems to be as natural as its surroundings as well as wondrous in its own right. The Ceporah Tower in particular I would study, for it is a relic from a civilization that predates the High Elves by several hundred years and is still used in certain rites by the Psijics. Perhaps one day I might return. [Note: The author is currently on the Isle of Artaeum by gracious consent of Master Sargenius of the Council of Artaeum.]

论阿塔姆 陶尔斯·伊-安塞尔玛 著

[pagebreak] [pagebreak]

阿塔姆岛（发音为ar-TAY-um），是夏暮群岛的第三大岛，位于波坦萨的莫里度诺村南侧、大陆的朗希巴村西侧。以其为赛伊克教团所在地而闻名。赛伊克教团可能是全泰姆瑞尔最为古老的修士团体。 关于赛伊克的最早的书面记载是第一纪20年代间的一则故事，描述德高望重的布莱顿贤者兼作家沃尔奈特，他南旅阿塔姆岛拜访赛伊克教团的时任仪式大师——艾克西斯。 彼时的赛伊克已是诸王的顾问，还是一群 “古道”的支持者。那是泰姆瑞尔的原住种族教授给他们的冥想与研究的哲学，据说是将自然力量与个人意志相结合。它与魔力起源不同，但效果相近。 　　 在第二纪元开始时，阿塔姆岛如字面意思所述的那样从夏暮岛海岸线处消隐无踪了，而同期发生了法师公会在泰姆瑞尔大陆建立这件大事，这可能并非巧合。无数史家和学者就此事提出各种各样的理论假说，但可能除艾克西斯本人外无人能阐明此事的真相。 五百年过去，阿塔姆岛回来了。岛上那群多数由精灵组成的赛伊克法师均在第二纪元消隐无踪，并被那时的世人推定已然死亡。他们不能或是不想就这段空白期内阿塔姆岛的下落、或是艾克西斯和阿塔姆最初的议会的命运给出任何解释。 目前，赛伊克由博学大师凯勒瑞斯领导。他在过去250年里主持着阿塔姆议会。议会对泰姆瑞尔政局造成的影响时有起伏。夏暮岛诸王，特别是莫里度诺的几位，时常问政于赛伊克。皇帝尤瑞尔五世在位早期，也就是他开展对阿卡维尔的那次灾难性远征之前的黄金期，就受益于议会的巨大影响。甚至有流言称，派安多尼亚之王奥格哈姆的舰队其实是被安条克皇帝和赛伊克联合击破的。但最近四任皇帝——尤瑞尔六世、莫里哈萨、佩拉吉奥斯四世和尤瑞尔七世，却对赛伊克持怀疑态度，乃至拒绝阿塔姆岛使节进驻帝都。 很难在地理图册上标注阿塔姆岛的所在点。传闻其确切位置始终在变迁，或是出于随机性，或是出于议会的号令。罕有访客能真的登岛，甚至基本没多少确凿的登陆记载。任何人如想拜会赛伊克，都可以去波坦萨、朗希巴，以及夏暮群岛诸国寻得他们的对外联络人。 如果真的能轻易抵达，那阿塔姆必然成为游客们的首选。我曾一度登岛，现今仍能在梦中走过那有如田园诗中描绘的百果园、旷人心胸的牧野、依然静谧的泻湖、山雾缭绕的林场，还有那独树一帜的赛伊克风格建筑，它看起来拥有和周围环境融为一体般的自然，却又有自身的奇妙之处。岛上的塞波拉塔是我探求的重点对象，因为它是某个文明的遗迹，其起源比高精灵还要早几百年，至今仍用于赛伊克的某些仪式。或许未来某一天我会回到那里加以探索。 [注：作者目前在阿塔姆岛上——由阿塔姆议会的萨尔格纽斯大师热情地迎允他登岛。]

traduit: 最后的亚历德王

[pagebreak]

The Last King of the Ayleids by Herminia Cinna

[pagebreak]

he Ayleids, or Heartland High Elves, ruled Cyrodiil in the long ages of Myth before the beginning of recorded history. One of the earliest recorded dates, in fact, is the Fall of White Gold Tower in 1E 243, which is commonly assumed to mark the end of the Ayleids. Although Ayleid rule over all of Cyrodiil was indeed broken in 1E 243, this was only one of the most obvious stages near the end of a long decline. The first two centuries of the First Era saw increasing strife between the great Ayleid lords of Cyrodiil. Alessia appears to have taken advantage of a period of civil war to launch her uprising. Imperial historians have traditionally attributed her victory to intervention from Skyrim, but it appears that she had at least as much help from rebel Ayleid lords during the siege of White Gold Tower. The popular image of the Ayleids as brutal slavemasters is based in fact, of course, but it is less well-known that a number of Ayleid princes continued to rule parts of Cyrodiil after 263, as vassals of the new Empress of Cyrodiil. This suggests either that Ayleid rule was not universally detested, or that Alessia and her successors were more pragmatic than is traditionally believed, or perhaps some of both. In any event, excavations at a number of Ayleid sites show continued occupation and even expansion during the so-called Late Ayleid Period (1E 243 - c. 498). At first, many Ayleid lords continued to rule as vassals of the new human regime. In some cases, Ayleid supporters of Alessia were even rewarded with new lands taken from slain enemies. It is not clear to what extent human slavery continued under the Cyrodilic Empire. Humans continued to dwell in the Ayleid-ruled areas of Cyrodiil, but there is nothing definitive to show under what terms. This was an uneasy relationship from the beginning, and was not destined to last long. Resentment at the continued presence of Ayleid nobles within the Empire was a contributing factor to the rise of the so-called Alessian Order founded by Maruhk. The first victims of the Alessians were the Ayleids of Cyrodiil. In the early 300s, the surviving Ayleid communities in human-ruled areas were obliterated one by one, the refugees temporarily swelling the power of the remaining Ayleid lordships. Then in 361, the Alessians gained control of the Empire and enforced the Alessian Doctrines throughout its domain. The Ayleid lordships were abolished. Enforcement of this decree does not appear to have required much direct violence -- it seems that by this point the balance of power was so overwhelmingly against them, and their fate so long foreshadowed, that most of the remaining Ayleids simply left Cyrodiil, eventually being absorbed into the Elven populations of Valenwood and High Rock. Indeed, the rise of the Direnni Hegemony may be linked to this exodus of Ayleids from Cyrodiil (a connection so far little studied by historians). Still, a remnant Ayleid population seems to have survived the rule of the Alessians, because we hear of "the last king of the Ayleids" joining the battle of Glenumbria Moors where the Dirennis decisively defeated the Alessians in 482. How this king's people survived the preceding century is unknown. We do not even know who they were, although recent research points to Nenalata as the possible resting place of this "last king." Unfortunately, in the current state of the Empire, funds are no longer available for proper scientific investigation of such extensive ruins, so the answer to these questions will have to be left to future generations.

最后的亚历德王 赫米尼亚·辛纳 著

[pagebreak]

亚历德，或称腹地高精灵，早在有记录的历史开始前的长远神话中就统治着希罗帝尔。事实上，最早记载的日期之一是第一纪元243年的白金塔陷落，一般认为此事件标志着亚历德时代的落幕。 虽说亚历德对整个希罗帝尔的统治确实在第一纪元243年破灭，但这不过是一段漫长衰退将告终结时表露得最为显著的一个阶段罢了。在第一纪元的前两世纪，希罗帝尔的各大亚历德领主间的冲突就不断升级。阿莱西亚乘内战之机发动了起义。传统上，帝国史家总将她的成功归因于天际的介入，然而在围攻白金塔期间，她似乎还从亚历德叛乱领主处得到了不少帮助。 公众对于亚历德的主流印象，就是一伙蛮横残暴的奴隶主。当然了，这的确是基于事实的，但鲜为人知的是，243年后尚有一定数量的亚历德君王作为希罗帝尔新女皇的封臣统治着希罗帝尔的部分地区。该状况表明，要么亚历德的统治并未面临着普遍的怨恨，要么阿莱西亚及其继任者比传统观点所认为的更趋务实，或两者兼而有之。 不论如何，关于一系列亚历德遗迹的发掘工作展示着，在所谓的亚历德统治晚期（第一纪元243年—498年），仍有一些亚历德接续占据、乃至扩张了自己的地盘。首先，许多亚历德领主甘当新人类政权的附庸，从而得以继续统治。在某些情况下，阿莱西亚的亚历德支持者们甚至能从被诛灭的敌方手中夺得的新领土作为奖励。尚不清楚在希罗帝尔帝国治下，人类奴隶制在如何程度上接续存在。人类仍继续居住在亚历德所统治的希罗帝尔地区，但其具体处境，则缺乏确凿史料佐证。 这份合作关系自一开始便暗流涌动，注定难以长久。很多人对帝国内部仍有亚历德贵族存续心怀怨恨，这也促成了马鲁克创立、崛起了所谓的“阿莱西亚教团”。阿莱西亚教团手下的首批受害者便是希罗帝尔的亚历德。第一纪元三世纪早期，残居于人类势力领域内的亚历德族居住地被一个接一个地毁灭。迅速逃亡的亚历德难民们暂时壮大了残余亚历德贵族的势力。 361年，阿莱西亚教团取得了控制全帝国的权柄，且在帝国全境推行阿莱西亚教义。亚历德领主制度被废除。这条政令落实过程中，似乎并未直接动用武力镇压手段，大概是因为到了这个地步，力量的天平显然已彻底倾斜，他们的命运也早有预兆，因此绝大多数亚历德遗民都干脆地背井离乡，把希罗帝尔抛在身后，最终被威伦森林和高岩省的精灵住民吸纳同化。事实上，迪伦尼霸权的雄起可能与这次希罗帝尔的亚历德大逃亡有所关联（迄今为止，史家们仍很少研究其联系）。 虽说如此，仍有些残存的亚历德族人得以在阿莱西亚教团的统治下幸存下来。毕竟，我们曾听闻在482年，“最后的亚历德王”参与了格林纳巴荒野会战，帮助迪伦尼方决定性地击溃了阿莱西亚教团。这位国王的子民究竟如何在过往的百年间生还下来仍不得而知。我们甚至不知晓他们是谁，尽管新近研究指出，尼纳拉塔可能是这位“末王”的长眠之所。很不幸，在帝国目前的状态下，已无足够的经费可支持针对如此广阔的遗迹开展科学调研活动了。因此，我们只能将这些问题留给后人解答。

original: Atronach Forge Manual
traduit: 侍灵熔炉手册

original: Nephew - I apologize that I cannot see you personally before you leave. The trip from Sadrith Mora is treacherous this season, or I would have visited upon hearing the news. The Nords have a fine college at Winterhold, and I am sure you will excel. You may know that I, too, attended there. I was quite the conjuration adept in my own day. I am sending you my notes on something called the 'Atronach Forge', a bit of a project of mine while at Winterhold. Mention nothing to the faculty, but ask your fellow pupils about a place called the Midden. You will find the Forge there. I fear a number of my notes are missing, scattered and lost in my travels around Skyrim. Perhaps you may stumble across these in your own adventures. [pagebreak] The Atronach Forge offers few clues as to who built it, and even fewer as to how to unlock its full potential. Only through blind experimentation, and a few singed eyebrows, have I been able to understand its function. The Forge is mostly a large dais, almost crude of make, but emblazoned with the traditional Daedric O rune. An offering box is attached, as well as a prominent lever. The Dais also features a large setting which seems set to receive some large, spherical object. I have had no luck determining what this missing object may be, however, or what effect it may have on the efficacy of the Forge. The Forge is activated by placing certain items into the offering box, and then pulling the lever. The Forge consumes the items and conjures something upon the dais. The conjuration can be predicted reliably if the appropriate items are left in the box - but many combinations either have no effect or catastrophic reactions. Once I conjured a wild goat! Well, most of the goat, at least. Experimenting wildly with the Forge is dangerous. I've recorded such recipes as I have discovered on the following pages. The simplest, yet perhaps most hazardous stable recipe is that for a summoned atronach. The conjured brutes will attack the first thing they see, however! Be ready for battle if you have reason to use these recipes. [pagebreak] Flame Atronach: Fire Salts + Ruby Frost Atronach: Frost Salts + Sapphire Storm Atronach: Void Salts + Amethyst
traduit: 侄儿： 我很抱歉不能在你离开前亲自见你。这种季节从萨德瑞斯·莫拉启程实在危险，若非如此，我一听闻这些消息便会来访。诺德人在冬堡有个相当不错的学院，而且我确信你将在此脱颖而出。你应该知道我以前也在那里上过学。想当年我可是一位技艺娴熟的召唤系专家。我把关于“侍灵熔炉”的笔记寄给你，这是我尚在冬堡时的一个项目。 莫要跟师长提及，去问同学，找他们了解“秽道”的所在。熔炉就在那里。恐怕我在天际旅行时遗失了不少笔记。兴许你会在你自己的冒险生涯中与它们不期而遇。 几乎没有线索表明侍灵熔炉是何人建造，更没有开发它全部潜力的蛛丝马迹。最后通过反复盲目实验，还烧掉了不少眉毛，我才了解了它的具体功能。 [pagebreak] 熔炉的主体是个巨大的台子，打造工艺几近粗制滥造，但装饰有传统的迪德拉O 符文。附属有个贡品箱，以及一柄突出的杠杆。台子上还有另外的巨大装置，似乎是为放置某些大型球状物件而设。然而，我尚不能确定遗失的物件为何，还有它对熔炉的功效有何影响。 熔炉是通过将某些物品置入贡品箱内，然后拉动杠杆来激活。熔炉会消耗这些物品，并在台子上召唤某些事物。只要物品组合合适，召唤就是可以预测的，但更多的组合要么是徒劳无功，要么就是灾难性的反应。我曾有一次召唤出一头野山羊！好吧，至少是山羊的绝大部分躯体。 疯狂地对熔炉进行实验很危险。下面几页是我发现的配方。 最为轻而易举的，但也许是最为危险的稳定配方是召唤侍灵。然而，受召唤的野蛮生物看见什么就会攻击什么！如果你有理由使用这些配方，那就要做好战斗准备了。 [pagebreak] 火焰侍灵： 火盐 + 红宝石 冰霜侍灵： 霜盐 + 蓝宝石 风暴侍灵： 虚无盐 + 紫水晶

<font face='$HandwrittenFont'><font size='18'>
If only Umani would have left one of these Dwarven machine creatures intact for me to study. The fact that they almost killed those Khajiit brothers in the middle of the night doesn't mean we couldn't have found a way to disable one. We dragged some stuff in front of the pipes they came out of to stop them from coming back.

They are simply fascinating! It is just as Calcelmo described in Dwarves, v2. Their appearance does, in fact, resemble that of an arachnid. I had thought that to be an embellishment given by his source. The inclusion of the soul gem into the design of the apparatus is quite remarkable. It could explain the focus for the lightning that he describes.

Oddly enough it doesn't appear to be the main power source for the apparatus. Perhaps some sort of harmonic resonance with the energies contained in the soul gem to bring heat to a small boiler? Too early to say conclusively. That does raise the question of where they get the liquid for the boiler however.

Huh, that was strange. I thought I just saw something moving beyond the barred door. It looked vaguely humanoid. I wonder if it could be an undiscovered automaton? I'm going to move my bedroll down here to see if I can catch another glimpse of it. This is all so exciting!
</font>
traduit:
<font face='$HandwrittenFont'><font size='18'>
如果乌马娜能留下个完整的矮人机械生物给我研究就好了。它们差点在大半夜杀了卡吉特那哥俩，但这不代表我们就摧毁不了它们。我们拖来一些东西堵在他们出来的管道前，以防它们再来。

它们简直太迷人了！就像卡塞莫在《矮人·卷二》里描述的那样。它们的外表确实很像蜘蛛。我原以为那只是他把消息来源添油加醋的说法。把灵魂石纳入仪器的设计也很了不起。这样就能解释他所描述的闪电焦点了。

不过灵魂石似乎不是机械的主要供能单位。也许是某种与灵魂石中包含的能量产生的谐波共振，给小动力炉提供热量？现在下结论为时尚早。可现在又有问题了，他们是从哪里获得动力炉里的液体的？

嘶，真奇怪。我好像看见有什么东西在闩着的门外面移动。看起来有点像人。会不会是没被发现过的自动机械？我要把铺盖移到下面看看能不能再看到一次。太兴奋了！
</font>

original:
To my old and dear friend Anton, I will never forget the kindness you and the entire Virane family paid to me, when I visited High Rock those many years ago. We were both young, impetuous, and foolish, and those were dangerous times for us all. But we knew even then, as we surely know now, that our battlefield is the kitchen. Our sword, the spoon. Our enemy, hunger. And now, thanks to your guidance and friendship, I can share our love of Breton cuisine with all of Tamriel. For this cookbook is not just a collection of recipes, but the sum total of my life's work, and a testament to the power of passion. Your friend in food, The Gourmet [pagebreak]

Uncommon Taste By the Gourmet

[pagebreak] [pagebreak]

Congratulations! By opening this volume you have taken the first step on a truly epic journey, a voyage through the vast landscape of Breton food and its myriad joys and wonders. You will explore scents, flavors and textures so exquisite, they will seem impossible. But they are more than possible! Indeed, by following the carefully selected recipes presented in this cookbook, you will prepare extraordinary dishes with such ordinary ease, those around you will suspect sorcery. But the only magic is that which exists in your own heart, the passion you possess for creating delicious, amazing food that can be prepared easily, and enjoyed endlessly. Start here, and some day, you too can be a Gourmet! [pagebreak] Sunlight Souffle' Ingredients - 2 1/2 Ounces Cow's Cheese - 1 Ounce Butter - 1 Ounce Flour - 9 Ounces Milk - A Dash of Salt - A Dash of Pepper - A Cupful of Ground Nutmeg Recipe - Stoke the flames of your oven, and achieve a moderate heat. - Grate the cheese into thin shavings by running a finely honed elven dagger over the block. - Separate the egg whites from the yolks, and beat the whites vigorously until they thicken. - Begin preparation of the signature Sunshine Sauce - melt the butter, and add in the flour while stirring continuously until well blended. Move the mixture to a smaller flame and begin gently stirring in the milk. It is crucial that you do not stop stirring! Continue to do so for ten minutes, until the mixture thickens. Then, and only then, will the Sunshine Sauce be considered ready. - Add the salt, pepper and nutmeg, and remove from the flame. - Add in the grated cheese, and then the egg yolks. Stir well until fully blended. Then, gently add in the egg whites with a spoon made of carved hickory wood. - Gently pour the mix into four stonework souffle' dishes, filling each nearly (but not quite!) to the top. - Put the dishes in your moderately hot oven and shut that door! Keep sealed for 25 minutes, or your scrumptious suns will rise, only to fall down flat into the oven's abyss. - Remove after 25 minutes, and serve immediately. Behold, the brilliance of the sun, and the exquisite flavor of the Sunshine Souffle'! [pagebreak] Potage le Magnifique Ingredients - 4 Cups Chicken Broth - 4 Cups Beef Broth - 2 1/2 Ounces Butter - 1 Wooden Flagon of Flour - 1 Cup Diced Carrots - 1/2 Cup Diced Onions Recipe - Stoke the flames of your open-pit fire, and achieve a low heat. - Combine all ingredients into a large soup pot. - Stir vigorously! - Once hot, pour into earthen soup bowls immediately! Behold, the Gourmet's signature dish - the Potage le Magnifique! But wait. I know what you're wondering. "That's it? Is that all there is to it? What's the secret of the Gourmet?" Do you really expect me to give away the secret to my most popular dish? Well guess what? I will! For that secret, my friends, is YOU! That's right, the Potage le Magnifique is delicious, and extraordinary. Using just the simple ingredients listed, you will create a potage that is both hearty and delicious. But in order to make the Potage le Magnifique truly magnificent, it takes the imagination of a truly inspired chef. Do you have that gift? I have served bowls of the Potage le Magnifique that have caused grown men to weep with with joy. Can you guess what I added? Can you create... magic?

致我亲爱的老友安东， 我永远不会忘记，在我许多年前造访高岩时，您和全维拉尼家对我的善意。彼时我们都年少冲动，还有些愚蠢，对我们所有人来说，那都是一段危险的时光。但就算如此，彼时我们也深知，正如我们现在知道的那样，我们的战场便是厨房。我们的利剑，即是汤勺。我们的宿敌，即是饥饿。 而如今，感谢您的谆谆教诲和深厚友谊，我能和全泰姆瑞尔分享我们对布莱顿美食的热爱了。因为这本烹饪指南绝不仅仅是一份食谱集，还是我毕生心血的精髓大成，更是激情力量的最佳证明。 您的烹饪好友， “美食家” 敬上 [pagebreak]

奇珍异味 美食家 著

[pagebreak] [pagebreak]

恭喜您！ 翻开本书之时，您已迈出了这一趟真正意义上的史诗征途的第一步。而这，是一趟充满数之不尽欢乐和广阔风景的布莱顿美食之旅。你将探索的香气、风味、口感是如此精致优雅，以至于它们看似是绝无可能、令人难以置信的。但，它们啊，其实拥有无限的可能性！ 　　 确实，只要好好遵循本烹饪指南中精心严选的食谱，您将能轻松愉快地以寻常无奇的手法烹饪出无与伦比的菜肴，以至于让您身边的亲友们怀疑您调入了魔法。但唯一存在的魔力就盘桓在您的心中，那就是您创造美味非凡、令人称奇的菜品的热情，而这些菜品的烹饪无比轻松，入口却是乐享无穷。 　　 就此开始吧，总有一天，你也能成为美食家！ [pagebreak] 阳光蛋奶酥 食材配料表 　　 ·半盎司装牛乳酪——2份　　 ·黄油——1盎司　　 ·面粉——1盎司　　 ·鲜奶——9盎司 ·食盐——少许 ·胡椒粉——少许 ·肉豆蔻粉——1杯 烹饪流程 ·点燃烤箱的炉火，调至热量适中的文火。 　　 ·用精心打磨的精灵匕首将乳酪块削成薄透的屑片。 　　 ·打一个蛋，将蛋清蛋黄分离，猛力搅拌蛋清直至稠糊。 　　 ·开始准备招牌的阳光酱——融化黄油，并在连续搅拌中添入面粉，直到充分混合。然后将混合物移至较小的炉火处，并开始缓缓注入鲜奶轻柔搅拌。您绝对不能停止搅拌，这是至关重要的步骤！继续执行该步骤大约10分钟，直至混合物变稠，也只有到那时侯，阳光酱才算制作完成。 　　 ·向阳光酱内加盐，胡椒粉及肉豆蔻粉，并将之从火上移开。 　　 ·向阳光酱内加入削碎的乳酪，再打入蛋黄。充分搅拌直至完全混合。然后，以精制雕刻的山胡桃木勺将蛋清缓缓注入。 　　 ·轻柔地将混合物倾入4枚石制蛋奶酥模具组中，每一枚都要几乎填满至顶（但不要太满）。 　　 ·将模具组置入您热度中等的烤箱中，再关上门！保持密闭25分钟，否则您香浓美味的太阳们刚刚升起，就只能在烤箱的深渊里陨落了。 　　 ·25分钟后开箱取出，立即食用。 　　 看吧，这小太阳夺目的流光溢彩！这阳光蛋奶酥的绝品风味！ [pagebreak] 美味浓汤 食材配料表 　　 ·鸡汤——4杯　 ·牛汤——4杯 ·半盎司装奶油——2份 ·面粉——1木酒壶 ·胡萝卜丁——1杯　 ·洋葱丁——半杯 烹饪流程 ·点燃您露天灶的炉火，达到较低温度。 　　 ·将所有食材添入大汤锅中。 　　 ·猛力搅拌！ 　　 ·一旦热度足够，马上倾入陶汤碗中！ 　　 看吧，这就是美食家的招牌菜品——美味浓汤！ 　　 不过少安毋躁，我知道您心中所想。“就这？这便是全部的工序啦？美食家的秘料究竟是什么？” 　　 您当真期望，我会将我最受欢迎的菜品的个中奥秘和盘托出吗？好好猜猜看？我当然会了！因为这秘料的真面目啊，我的朋友，那就是您！确实，美味浓汤的美味可口，非同凡响。仅运用清单内所列出的简单食材，您就能创造出既丰盛又美味的羹汤。但，为了让美味浓汤具备真正意义上的美味，它需要一位真正有灵感的厨师的想象天分。您，拥有这样的天赋吗？ 　　 我曾烹饪出能让大人也激动得泪流满面的美味浓汤。您可否猜得到，我究竟添加了什么呢？您能创造出这样的……魔法吗？

original:
<font face="$HandwrittenFont">
My dearest Ranmir,

By the time you receive this, I will be gone. I know that it's wrong to mislead you, but I didn't want you to prevent me from going.

I know it's been hard on you, on both of us, struggling to survive. I hate to see the look in your eyes every time you think about how little the two of us have, and I know you're too proud to ever say anything. So I'm going to make it all better.

I've talked to my friend Vex, and she's given me some advice. I know how to get something that will allow us to live happily, without ever worrying about money ever again.

I love you so much, Ranmir. You mean the world to me, and I only want to see you happy.

Worry not. I'll be home soon.


Isabelle
traduit:
<font face="$HandwrittenFont">
我亲爱的兰米尔：

你收到这封信的时候，我已经离开了。我知道误导你不对，但我不想让你阻止我去。

我知道挣扎着活下去对你我来说都很艰难。我不喜欢你每次想到我们俩一无所有时你的眼神，我知道你很骄傲，不愿意多说。所以我会让一切都好起来的。

我和我朋友小烦谈过，她给了我一些建议。我知道怎么得到能让我们快乐的生活，不必担心钱的东西。

我很爱你，兰米尔。你就是我的一切，我只想看到你幸福。

别担心，我很快就会回家。


——伊莎贝拉

<font face="$HandwrittenFont">

Most esteemed overseer,

As was already communicated to your subordinate, I wish to hire your organization for some delicate ambassadorial work. All of this, of course, would culminate in a historic meeting with the Leader himself.

In order to secure an audience with the Leader, some secondary meetings must first take place. They have been outlined below.

1.) You must attend the upcoming wedding at the Temple of the Divines in Solitude. The bride must be given a gift she will never forget, one that will get all of Solitude to talking and which will, undoubtedly, reach the ears of the Leader himself.

2.) A certain high-ranking military officer, permanently stationed in Skyrim, is responsible for securing the Leader's safety should he choose to schedule a visit. When this officer learns of the Leader's journey, he will begin the necessary security arrangements. You must learn this officer's plans, and meet with his people, to ensure appropriate security for your eventual audience with the Leader.

3.) Several months ago, the Leader planned a visit to Skyrim that was canceled unexpectedly. In that time, a world renowned chef was contacted, and brought to Skyrim in order to prepare a lavish meal. That chef remains in Skyrim on retainer. You must meet with him, and convince him that it would be your honor to cook for the Leader in his place.

I realize these instructions are a bit non-specific, and do apologize, but I feel the vagueness is necessary to ensure security. Surely an organization as esteemed as your own has the means and resources to obtain all the essential information before each meeting can take place.

When the final part of our arrangement has been carried out - that is, when you have secured an audience with the Leader himself, and brought such business to a close - I will contact you about final payment.

Most sincerely,  

A friend

traduit: 波耶西亚的试炼

original:
Boethiah's Proving ~The following account is true. May it serve as a warning to those with ears to hear and hearts to know.~

~~~

On a certain day, at a certain time, the faithful gathered to perform certain rituals, hoping to gain a glimpse of their master. The day was correct, the summoning true. Slashing a smoking tear through the Veil, She, her-very-self, appeared before them, terrible and resplendent. She came arrayed in ebony darker than a moonless night, wielding a blade burning hotter than the surface of the sun. And though she wore the guise of a Dunmer warrior-queen, she towered above them like a statue carved from the Red Mountain itself.

"Why have you disturbed me?"

Surprised, the first among them prayed:

"O Boethiah, Prince of Plots, Deceiver of Nations, Queen of Shadows, Goddess of Destruction, we come to worship thee!"

She looked down upon her followers, gathered to bear witness. Frowning she asked the first:

"Tell me, you who profess to know me, how shall I know you?"

Afeared he exclaimed:

"Each night I pray to thee, each night I call out thy wondrous names. Surely thou must recognize the sound of my voice? Thy most devoted of believers?"

She frowned and let out a long sigh, and then of a sudden he was gone, the air from her lungs dispersing him. Turning to the second she asked:

"And you? How shall I measure the worth of your existence?"

Stunned by the power of her voice, he bowed before her darkening visage. She clapped her hands, and he too was gone. To the third:

"And you, tell me, how shall I know you apart from such as were they, of whom there is no trace?"

Shaken and speechless from the nullifications of his brethren, he whispered:

"Have mercy upon us!"

She blinked twice. Once, he was in agony. Twice, he was destroyed. She cast a withering glance across those remaining and said:

"I do not grant mercy."

And so it was with the others. She putting them to proof, they offering none. Finally she came to me, eyes aglow with anger, tongue wet with hate, and said:

"Of all my believers, but two remain. Tell me, second-to-last, with what shall you prove your existence?"

Without hesitation I drew forth my blade and buried it in the chest of the other who stood beside me, and without fear replied:

"Ask him whose blood now sprouts from my blade if I exist."

She smiled. And the gates of Oblivion opened between her teeth. Then she said:

"Tell me, now-last of my followers, wherefore do you remain where the others do not?"

I retrieved my blade, and offered it up saying:

"I am alive because that one is dead. I exist because I have the will to do so. And I shall remain as long as there are signs of my handwork, such as the blood dripping from this blade."

Accepting my gift, she nodded and said:

"Indeed."

~~~

~If in the reading, your blood boils in your veins, and your mind blazons with fire, then Boethiah calls you. It is then most wise to heed her call. Find her on the mount which overlooks Windhelm. Meet us there and be tested.~
traduit:
波耶西亚的试炼 ~下文所述皆为事实。望有警于有耳聆听、有心了解者。~

~~~

某天，某时，一群虔诚的信徒进行了一个完善的仪式，希望能一睹其主人的风采。日子正当时，召唤毫无疑问奏效了。 一阵浓烟撕裂了现世与湮灭的屏障，既华丽又可怖，她——毫无疑问是她本尊，出现在了信徒面前。她身披比无月之夜还要黑暗的黑檀，手持比日冕还要火热的利剑。尽管她伪装成一名丹莫战争女王的形象示人，但却早已超越了这形象的本质，如同用红山本身去雕刻的塑像一般。

"你们为何要打搅我？"

最前面的一名信徒赶忙惊骇地祈祷道：

"啊，波耶西亚，阴谋之主、欺骗天下者、暗影女王、毁灭女神！我们都在此歌颂您，向您祈祷！"

她轻蔑地俯视着见证这一切的追随者们，眉头微皱，问那第一个信徒。

"告诉我，你这自称追随我的凡人，我该如何知晓你的价值？"

惊恐的他大声喊叫：

"每晚我都向您祈祷，每一个夜晚我都不停赞颂您的名字！您一定能认出我的声音，不是吗？我是您最忠诚的信徒啊？"

她眉头紧皱，并长叹了一口气，结果那信徒突兀地消失了，就好像被那口气吹灭了一样。 而后她转向第二个信徒，并问道：

"那你呢？我又该如何衡量你存在的价值？"

第二个信徒被女神声音中的力量所震慑，直匍匐在她那黑暗的面容之下。 于是她拍拍手，第二个信徒也消失了。 接着她问第三个信徒：

"还有你，告诉我，我该怎么知道你和那些消失的人不一样？"

第三个信徒由于他的同伴被女神拒绝而战战兢兢，他乞求道：

"饶了我们吧！"

她眨了两次眼睛。第一次，信徒变得痛苦不堪。第二次，信徒被直接毁灭了。 她冷冷地瞥了一眼剩下的人，并说道：

"我从不饶恕。"

其他人也是如此。女神让他们证明自己，但没人能献上合适的“供物”。 最后，她走到我的面前，眼里燃着怒火，舌尖缠着湿与恨。她问道：

"我所有的信徒当中，现在只剩下两个人。倒数第二位，你该如何证明你存在的价值？"

我毫不犹豫地拔出剑，将其刺入站在我身旁的另一个信徒的胸口里，并毫无畏惧地回应道：

"那就问问他，如果我在这里，谁的血正从我的剑里流出？"

她向我微笑了。而后，湮灭之门在她的齿间开启。她说：

"现在，你成为了我最后一个信徒。告诉我，为什么你仍站在其他人都消失了的地方？"

我从尸体上拔出剑，并将其奉献给女神，说：

"我之所以还活着，只因那个人已经被我杀了。我以我自己的意志证明了我的存在和价值。我还会继续留下，因为这里有我亲手创造的痕迹，就比如那剑刃上滴下的血。"

女神接受了我的礼物，并点了点头。而后说道：

"的确如此。"

~~~

~如果在阅读过程中，你的血液在血管中沸腾，你的心灵如烈火般燃烧，那么这是波耶西亚在呼唤你。而听从她的召唤才是明智的行为。在俯视着风舵城的山上寻找她吧。在那里找到我们然后接受试炼。~

original:
Night of Tears
Dranor Seleth

Saarthal holds a prominent place in Skyrim history, even if most do not remember it by name. It is of course the site of one of the first major Nord settlements, one of the first cities of men in Skyrim, and the earliest known capital of their civilization. It was also the site of terrible bloodshed, when the elves attempted to drive the Nords out of Skyrim, to succeed only in incurring their wrath in the form of Ysgramor and his fabled Five Hundred Companions, who swept the elves from Skyrim and firmly established it as the home of the Nords.

All this is known, but little else. What happened on that Night of Tears, when Saarthal was razed to the ground? What provoked the elves to such a deliberate, vicious attack, and what prompted such a severe response from the Nords?

Vingalmo's Treatise on the Altmer Antecedent suggests that the elves of the Merethic Era, along with their counterparts the early Dwemer, possessed a degree of sophistication unparalleled in Tamriel. They displayed power beyond what could be expected of the time. While a distinct explanation is not given for this, I believe that this work, compared with the early writings of Heseph Chirirnis, suggest that something greater was at work on that night in Saarthal.

The true motives behind the Night of Tears have been obscured to us by the passage of time, but I believe this was not a simple war of territory, or of control of Skyrim. I believe that what happened was a significant event based around something very particular. 

The Nords found something when they built their city, buried deep in the ground. They attempted to keep it buried, but the elves learned of it and coveted it for themselves. Thus they assaulted Saarthal, their goal not to drive the Nords out but to secure this power for themselves. I believe Ysgramor knew something of what the elves would find under Saarthal, and rallied together his people to keep the elves from gaining it. When Nords once again controlled Skyrim, this power was buried deep below the earth and sealed away. 

Time has kept this knowledge from us, but it is my hope that Time will also reveal the truth of these words. Every effort will be made to relocate Saarthal, and find that which has been lost to us.
traduit:
泪之夜
德拉诺·塞勒斯

    即使大多人早已记不得这个名字，但萨瑟尔在天际历史中却仍占有重要地位。这里无疑是诺德最早的定居地之一，也是天际中最早的人类城市之一，和他们文明已知最早的首都。这里还是可怕流血事件的发生地，精灵试图将诺德人赶出天际，换来的是传说中伊斯格拉默五百战友的怒火。他们将精灵扫出天际，并把这里确立为诺德的家园。

    这些是众所周知的，但除此外甚少。在萨瑟尔被夷为平地的泪之夜到底发生了什么？是什么刺激了精灵发起如此恶毒的蓄意袭击，又使得诺德人给出如此强烈的反击？

    文嘉莫的《论傲特莫先祖》表明，精灵纪元的精灵与其锻莫同胞，拥有着泰姆瑞尔无法比拟的渊博学识，表现出超出时代预期的力量。虽然对此没有明确解释，我相信与希瑟弗·奇里尼斯的早期著作相比，这个作品表明，萨瑟尔的那个夜晚有更强大之物发挥了作用。

    随着时间流逝，泪之夜背后真正的动机已经不为人知，但我相信这不只是一场简单的领地战争，或对天际控制权的争夺。我认为发生了一起极其特殊的重大事件。

    诺德人在建造他们的城市时发现了一些深埋于地下的东西。他们试图将其继续掩埋，但精灵得到了消息，渴望得到它。因此他们袭击了萨瑟尔，目的不是为了赶走诺德人而是确保自己获得这种力量。我相信伊斯格拉默知晓精灵会在萨瑟尔城下找到什么，并集结了他的人民来阻止它落于精灵之手。当诺德人再次掌控了天际后，这种力量被深埋于地下且就此封存。 

    时间让我们对此无知，但我希望时间也能揭开这些言语背后的真相。我等将竭尽所能去重新定位萨瑟尔，找到失落之物。

After years of sailing from Hammerfell to Solstheim and back, Ramati and I have finally saved enough money to buy that old light house we spotted on the coast and we are moving in next month.

----

These Nords really know how to live. It may be cold, but you can't beat the tranquility of the watching icebergs to live out your silver years. Ramati loves the place too, despite the occasional leaky ceiling. Mani and Sudi, unfortunately, seem miserable here; I know the kids are old enough to strike out on their own, but I hope they'll grow to love the peace and quiet here as I have.

----

Mani and Sudi continue to bicker and harass each other and they seem to have started in on their mother as well. Ramati keeps finding things missing from the cellar. Sudi said she heard a noise down there but Mani just thinks their mother is going mad from isolation. The very thought of it is ridiculous, she's always wanted to retire here!

----

Sudi keeps saying that she hears scratching coming from the cellar at night. I think she's just trying to get her mother's goat, but I'd better head into town to get a few traps just in case it's skeevers. Should only take a couple days. I just hope those two go easy on Ramati while I'm gone.

----

Oh gods. Oh gods why?

I returned home to find my beautiful Ramati killed and this thing, this horrible bug-like creature ransacking our home. I managed to kill the damned thing, I think it might be a daedra! I've never seen anything like it! Oh gods poor Ramati.

It must have come out of the cellar. I'm going down there and locking the door behind me to make sure they don't escape. I don't know if I'll make it out, but I have to save my family!

--Habd

<font face='$HandwrittenFont'><font size='18'>
多年来我和拉马提在落锤和索瑟海姆之间往返航行，终于攒够了钱去买下我们在海边看到的那座旧灯塔，下个月就能搬进去了。

----

这些诺德真的很懂生活。天气虽然很冷，但看着冰山的宁静安度晚年是无与伦比的享受。拉马提也很喜欢这地方，就是天花板偶尔会漏水。不幸的是，马尼和苏第看起来很不自在。孩子们大了，也该自立门户了，但我希望他们能和我一样喜欢这里和平宁静的氛围。

----

马尼和苏第继续互相争吵骚扰，似乎也开始攻击他们的母亲。拉马提总是发现地窖里丢东西。苏第说她在下面听见什么声音，但马尼认为是他们的母亲因为与世隔绝疯掉了。开玩笑，她可是一直想在这里过退休生活！

----

苏第一直在说她晚上听到地窖里传来抓挠的声音。我看她就是想惹她母亲生气，但我最好去镇上买几个陷阱回来，以防是闹恶鼠了。应该用不了几天就能回来。我只希望我不在的时候他俩能让拉马提省点心。

----

哦，神啊，神啊，为什么？

我一回家就看见我美丽的拉马提被杀了。这可怕的虫子一样的生物洗劫了我家。我杀了那东西，它可能是迪德拉！我从没见过这种东西！哦，天，可怜的拉马提。

一定是从地窖钻出来的。我得下去把门锁上，确保它们不会逃走。我不知道自己能不能逃出去，但我必须救我的家人！

--哈伯德
</font>

original: Cicero's Journal - Final Volume
traduit: 西塞罗的日记·终卷

original: 30th of Sun's Dusk, 4E 200 I have written the letters. So polite. So official! To Astrid, in Skyrim. Her Sanctuary still stands. Still operates. But how? No Listener means no Black Sacrament, no Black Sacrament means no contracts. Her family can abandon the Old Ways, and still survive, still kill, but is that family still Brotherhood? Or something else? Something new. Something different. Something wrong? Something wrong. Still, we must go! Tomorrow, we set sail. Float on a boat through the moat called the sea her and me! 22nd of Evening Star, 4E 200 Sick sick sick of the rocking tossing rolling throwing upon the gray gray waves! I've been reading of Skyrim, of the good days, the old days, of the Old Ways. There was another Sanctuary once. A Dawnstar Sanctuary. Good, ancient and strong. Blessed by Sithis. Cicero will go there! No need of Astrid! The Mother and I will settle, and she will speak to me, finally, and we will build the Old Ways anew, together. 23rd of Evening Star, 4E 200 The passphrase is mine! I have found it, in a letter ancient as the Sanctuary itself. The Black Door will ask - "What is life's greatest illusion?" I am to answer - "Innocence, my brother." Finally, a space, a place, to call my own! A joker's retreat for the Fool of Hearts!!!! 4th of First Seed, 4E 201 The Sanctuary is home! As I had dared hope! Cool and dark and lovely. My Sanctuary, Sanctuary from all. I know its every corner, every hall, every shadowed nook and alcove. My Sanctuary. The guardians know me, recognize me as Keeper. They leave poor Cicero alone. The big ugly beast - a different story. He'd eat me if he could, but to bind me, grind me, he'd need to find me. And Cicero will make sure that does not happen. For I have Sanctuary! Sanctuary from all. 13th of First Seed, 4E 201 The Sanctuary is safety, and salvation. But silent, so silent. I give my love to the Unholy Matron. I give my laughter freely. But I do not hear her. The silence has returned. Now that I am laughter, and no longer hear laughter, I once again hear the silence. The silence of the Void. It reaches across time and space. Its silence is deafening, once more. 1st of Rain's Hand, 4E 201 Mother and Keeper must go. I am not the Listener, and never will be. But I am the Keeper. I must serve my Mother's will above my own. I must find her Listener. I must teach Astrid the error of her ways, the beauty and necessity of the Old Ways. I have sent the letter to Astrid. We leave soon. But Cicero will keep this Sanctuary as his Sanctuary! A place to rest and ply my trade, for I once more take up the blade, and send some lucky souls to Him, when laughter strikes, as fits my whim!
traduit: 第四纪元200年，日暮月30日 我已经写了信。如此礼貌。如此正式！写给天际的阿斯垂德。她的圣所依然屹立不倒。依然运转。但怎么办到的？没有聆听者意味着没有黑色圣礼，没有黑色圣礼意味着没有契约。她的家族能抛弃老规矩，仍然存在，仍然杀戮，但这个家还算是兄弟会吗？还是别的什么？新的某种东西。不一样的某种东西。错误的某种东西？ 错误的东西。 不过，我们得走了！明天，我们出航。在小船上飘过名叫大海的护城河，她跟我！ 第四纪元200年，夜星月22日 摇摇摇！我已经厌倦了在灰色的海浪上摇摇摇！ 我一直在看有关天际的东西，关于过去的好日子和老规矩的东西。曾经还有一座圣所。晨星圣所。不错、古老又坚固。由西帝斯赐福。西塞罗会去那里！不需要阿斯垂德！ 夜母跟我会住在那里，然后她最终会对我说话，我们会重建老规矩，一起。 第四纪元200年，夜星月23日 暗语是我的啦！我在一张与圣所一样古老的字条上找到了！ 黑门会发问：“人生最大的幻觉是什么？” 我会回答：“是无辜，我的兄弟。” 终于，一个地方，一个处所，是属于我自己的！一个为红桃小丑所造的退路！！！！ 第四纪元201年，初种月4日 圣所是家！如我所愿！凉爽、黑暗又可爱。我的圣所，所有人的圣所！ 我了解它每一个拐角，每一座大厅，每一个阴暗的角落和壁龛。我的圣所。守卫者们认识我，知道我是守护者。他们让可怜的西塞罗一人呆着。大个的丑怪兽——就不一样了。如果他能的话，他会吃了我，不过想要抓住我，撕碎我，他得找得着我。西塞罗不会让他找到的。因为我有圣所！ 所有人的圣所！ 第四纪元201年，初种月13日 圣所是安全港，是救赎。不过很寂静，太寂静了。我将爱奉献给了不洁主母。我纵声大笑。然而我没有听见她说话。寂静已经回归了。如今我就是笑声，再也听不见笑声了，我有一次听见了寂静。虚空的寂静。它跨越了时空。它的寂静再次震耳欲聋。 第四纪元201年，雨手月13日 夜母跟守护者必须得走。我不是，也不会是聆听者。不过我是守护者。我必须服从主母而非自己的意愿。我必须找到她的聆听者。我必须让阿斯垂德认识到她那方式的错误，以及传统方式的美与必要性。我已经给阿斯垂德写了封信。我们很快会离开。不过西塞罗会把这座圣所继续当他自己的圣所！ 一个可以休息和继续我的活计的地方，只为我能再次手握利刃，当我突发奇想而大笑时，我将会为他献上些幸运的灵魂。

original: Annals of the Dragonguard
traduit: 龙卫编年史

original:
Annals of the Dragonguard 2800-2819

Scribe's Note: I have faithfully copied the following from the Annals of the Dragonguard of Sky Haven Temple for the years 2800-2819 (4329-4338 in the Old Calendar), Brother Annulus, 2E 568. 2801: Emperor Kastav again ordered the Dragonguard to sieze hostages from Markarth and Hroldan to ensure that the jarls meet their conscription quotas. Our Master's official protest was denied, as usual. This will make relations with the local populace more difficult, although the "hostages" are in fact housed and trained with the other acolytes. 2804: Upon the outbreak of the Winterhold Rebellion, our Master refused orders to send the Dragonguard out to help supress the rebellion. The Emperor ordered our supplies cut off, but we have made arrangements with the local Reachmen and are effectively self-sufficient. The Grandmaster supports our Master's action on the grounds that it violates the Oath of Allegiance. 2805: The Temple is besieged. The fool Kalien was sent to Winterhold and sacked the city. There was a reason he was denied entry into the Dragonguard. But the local people do not count the difference between Akaviri. All our years of building up trust with people of Skyrim are now for naught. 2806: We learned of the accession of Reman II (of blessed name) when the siege of the Temple was lifted. We provided the honor guard for the Emperor's first visit to Skyrim, a great boost to the Temple's prestige. 2809: We received reports of a dragon in the east. Scouts were sent immediately, and signs of it were discovered, but it fled at our approach. The survivors have grown wary indeed. 2812: We finally received permission from the Emperor to begin construction of Alduin's Wall. Craftsmen from Temples across the Empire have arrived and begun the great work, overseen by our own Master, as is only fitting, as she is unmatched in her dragonlore. 2813: Work on Alduin's Wall progresses. The Master dismissed several craftsmen (from a western Temple that I do not need to name, they are so well-known for stiff-necked pride), which has delayed the work, but there must be no compromise. Alduin's Wall is our gift to those that come after us. 2815: The Grandmaster visited the Temple in the summer to view the progress of the Wall. He has received complaints about the expense (there is no doubt where these originate), but he was so impressed by the Wall even in its half-finished state that he gave our Master a Writ of Requisition under the Emperor's seal. There will be no more delays! Further reports of dragons in the east which could not be verified. 2818: An auspicious year. Alduin's Wall was finished, a dragon was located and slain, and Emperor Reman II visited to officially dedicate the Wall. The Blood Seal was consecrated in the presence of all the Dragonguard of Skyrim, a great honor of which few Temples can boast.
traduit:
龙卫编年史 2800-2819

抄录记：我忠实地从安努鲁斯修士2E568年写于天佑神殿的《龙卫编年史》中抄录了2800—2819年（旧历法4329-4338年）部分。 2801：卡斯塔夫皇帝再次命令龙卫从马卡斯与霍尔丹扣押人质，以确保领主们足额征兵。我们的宗师提出的正式抗议一如既往遭到了拒绝。这使得与当地民众的关系越发紧张。尽管“人质”实际上是和其他侍僧一样被安置与训练的。 2804：冬堡起义爆发时，宗师拒绝了派龙卫镇压叛乱的命令。皇帝下令切断了我们的补给，但我们已经与当地瑞驰人达成协议，现在可以自给自足了。大宗师支持了我们宗师的行为，因为这些命令违背了我们的效忠誓言。 2805：神殿被围困了。愚不可及的卡里恩被派往了冬堡，洗劫了那座城市。拒绝他加入龙卫不为无因。但当地人并没有考虑阿卡维尔人之间的区别。我们多年以来与天际居民建立信任的努力全部付之东流了。 2806：当神殿之围解除时，我们得知了雷曼二世（愿这个名字得到祝福）加冕了。我们为皇帝首次出访天际提供仪仗队，这大大提升了神殿的声望。 2809：我们收到报告，东边有龙出没。我们立即派出侦察兵，发现了它的踪迹，但它在我们接近时逃走了。幸存的龙确实是变警惕了。 2812：我们终于获得了皇帝的许可，开始建造奥杜因之墙。来自帝国各地神殿的工匠齐聚这里，在我们宗师的监督下开始这项伟大的工程，也只有她能担得起这项任务，因为她关于龙的知识无人出其右。 2813:奥杜因之墙的工作正在开展。宗师解雇了几个工匠(来自一个我不知道名字的西部神殿，他们素来强项傲慢)，虽然这会耽搁工程，但绝不能妥协。奥杜因之墙是我们送给后人的礼物。 2815：大宗师在夏天参观了神殿，视察墙的建造进展。他曾收到过关于花费过高的抱怨（这倒是事实），但他对这未完工的墙印象很深，所以给了我们宗师一份加盖皇帝印玺的征用令状。这下不会再延误了！ 关于东边巨龙出没的进一步报告无法得到证实。 2818：吉祥之年。奥杜因之墙竣工了，找到了一头龙并杀掉，雷曼二世陛下也前来为墙揭幕。血印在全天际龙卫见证下神圣地刻下，这是很少有神殿能得到的荣耀。

original: Thalmor Dossier: Esbern
traduit: 梭默档案：伊思本

original:
<font face='$HandwrittenFont'>
Status: Fugitive (Capture Only), Highest Priority, Emissary Level Approval

Description: Male, Nord, late 70s

Background:
Esbern was one of the Blades loremasters prior to the First War Against the Empire. He was not a field agent, but is now believed to have been behind some of the most damaging operations carried out by the Blades during the pre-war years, including the Falinesti Incident and the breach of the Blue River Prison. His file had remained dormant for many years, an inexcusable error on the part of my predecessor (who has been recalled to Alinor for punishment and reeducation), in the erroneous belief that he was unlikely to pose a threat due to his advanced age and lack of field experience. A salutary reminder to all operational levels that no Blades agent should be considered low priority for any reason. All are to be found and justice exacted upon them.

Operational Notes:
As we are still in the dark as to the cause and meaning of the return of the dragons, I have made capturing Esbern our top priority, as he is known to be one of the experts in the dragonlore of the Blades. Regrettably, we have yet to match their expertise on the subject of dragons, which was derived from their Akaviri origins and is still far superior to our own (which remains largely theoretical). The archives of Cloud Ruler Temple, which is believed to have been the primary repository of the oldest Blades lore, were largely destroyed during the siege, and although great effort has been made to reconstruct what was lost, it now appears that most of the records related to dragons were either removed or destroyed prior to our attack. Thus Esbern remains our best opportunity to learn how and why the dragons have returned. It cannot be ruled out that the Blades themselves are somehow connected to the dragons' return.

We have recently obtained solid information that Esbern is still alive and hiding somewhere in Riften. Interrogation of a possible eyewitness is on-going. We must proceed carefully to avoid Esbern becoming alerted to his danger. If he is indeed in Riften, he must not be given an opportunity to flee.
                                                 
</font>
traduit:
<font face='$HandwrittenFont'>
状态：在逃（仅可活捉），最高优先级，特使级别许可

描述：男性，诺德人，70多岁

背景：
    在对抗帝国的“首次”大战前，伊思本曾为刀锋会博学者之一。他并非一线密探，然而现在我们相信在战前几年，他在幕后参与了由刀锋会进行的大部分破坏活动，其中包括法林纳斯提事故以及蓝河监狱的破坏行动。部分出于我前任的判断失误，认为此人年事已高且缺乏实战经验故而威胁不大，导致此人的档案被封存多年。这是一个不可原谅的错误（该成员已被召回艾琳诺接受处罚和再教育）。该事件是对所有成员的教训，不可出于任何理由而低估刀锋会探员。要把他们每个人都揪出来，施以正义的制裁。

对策摘要：
    在巨龙回归的原因和意义尚不明朗时，我将抓捕伊思本列为最首要的任务，因为众所周知他是刀锋会中龙类学识的专家。遗憾的是，我们关于龙的知识还赶不上他们。他们的这些知识是来自他们的阿卡维尔出身，且目前很大程度仍然远远超过我们那些大多仅存在于理论上对于龙的认识。据说凌云者神殿的档案馆保存了多数最古老的刀锋会学识，但大多在围攻期间被毁。尽管我们已经尽很大努力重整遗失的资料，目前看来，似乎大多数与龙相关的记录在我们进攻之前就已经被摧毁或者转移了。因此伊思本的存在是我们学习巨龙回归方式和原因的绝佳机会。不排除刀锋会本身与巨龙的回归在某种程度上存在联系的可能性。

    近期我们获得可靠消息称伊思本还活着，藏身在裂谷某地。针对疑似目击者的审问工作正在进行。我们的行动务必要谨慎，谨防打草惊蛇。如果他确实在裂谷，那绝不能让他逃脱。
                                                 
</font>

original:
RUMINATIONS ON THE ELDER SCROLLS

by Septimus Signus, College of Winterhold

[pagebreak] Imagine living beneath the waves with a strong-sighted blessing of most excellent fabric. Holding the fabric over your gills, you would begin to breathe-drink its warp and weft. Though the plantmatter fibers imbue your soul, the wretched plankton would pollute the cloth until it stank to heavens of prophecy. This is one manner in which the Scrolls first came to pass, but are we the sea, or the breather, or the fabric? Or are we the breath itself? Can we flow through the Scrolls as knowledge flows through, being the water, or are we the stuck morass of sea-filth that gathers on the edge? Imagine, again, this time but different. A bird cresting the wind is lifted by a gust and downed by a stone. But the stone can come from above, if the bird is upside down. Where, then, did the gust come from? And which direction? Did the gods send either, or has the bird decreed their presence by her own mindmaking? The all-sight of the Scrolls makes a turning of the mind such that relative positions are absolute in their primacy. I ask you again to imagine for me. This time you are beneath the ground, a tiny acorn planted by some well-meaning elf-maiden of the woodlands for her pleasure. You wish to grow but fear what you may become, so you push off the water, the dirt, the sun, to stay in your hole. But it is in the very pushing that you become a tree, in spite of yourself. How did that happen? The acorn is a kind of tree-egg in this instance, and the knowledge is water and sun. We are the chicken inside the egg, but also the dirt. The knowledge from the Scrolls is what we push against to become full-sighted ourselves. One final imagining before your mind closes from the shock of ever-knowing. You are now a flame burning bright blue within a vast emptiness. In time you see your brothers and sisters, burnings of their own in the distance and along your side. A sea of pinpoints, a constellation of memories. Each burns bright, then flickers. Then two more take its place but not forever lest the void fills with rancid light that sucks the thought. Each of our minds is actually the emptiness, and the learnings of the Scrolls are the pinpoints. Without their stabbing light, my consciousness would be as a vast nothingness, unknowing its emptiness as a void is unknowing of itself. But the burnings are dangerous, and must be carefully tended and minded and brought to themselves and spread to their siblings.
traduit:
上古卷轴之思

冬堡学院 赛普蒂莫斯·希格纳斯 著

[pagebreak] 想象一下，以一块优质织物的拓宽视野之祝福，生活于海浪之下。将织物放在鳃上透过它的经纬纱来呼吸，饮啜。尽管植物纤维浸透了你的灵魂，令人不适的浮游生物终会污染这块布料，直至它发出预言之天堂的臭味。这就是上古卷轴化为现实的一种方法，但我等究竟是海洋，呼吸者还是那块织物呢？ 我们是如知识一般流动于卷轴之上的潮水，还是被困于海边的沉积沼泽？ 再想象一下，这次不同。一只鸟被风吹起，又被石头击坠。但如果这鸟上下颠倒，则石头有可能是从上往下落的。那么这阵风是从何处，哪个方向来的呢？这风、这石头是诸神的旨意还是鸟的自由意志决定了它们的出现？ 卷轴的全视角使思维转变，以至于将一个相对视角视为无争议的首要条件。 再请你为我想象一下。这次你是被某个善心的精灵少女玩乐时埋在地下的橡子。你渴望成长，又害怕自己会变成什么。所以你将水，泥土，光照推到一边，继续留在自己的洞里。尽管不是出于本意，但正是在这情况下你变成了一棵树。这究竟是如何发生的？ 这个例子中，橡子是一种树卵，知识是水和太阳。我们既是蛋里的雏，也是泥土。卷轴上被我们拒绝的知识会带给我们新的视角。 在你的头脑为全知而震撼前，再最后想象一下。你是浩瀚虚空中燃烧着的一束明亮蓝焰，随着时间推移，你看到了在远处和身边燃烧着的同胞们，它们是一片光点之海，是记忆的星座。每个都闪烁光芒燃烧着自己。然后再来两个替代了它们的位置，但不是永远如此，以免虚空充满会吞噬思想的变质光芒。 我们每个人的头脑实际上都是空白的，而卷轴的知识就是那些光点。如果没有那刺眼光芒，我们的意识就是一个无知的虚空，正如虚空对自身一无所知一样。但那光焰的灼伤同样是危险的，在携上它们以及传给同胞时要小心处理。

original:
[pagebreak]

Effects of the Elder Scrolls

[pagebreak]

t is widely known among scholars that the Elder Scrolls entail a certain hazard in their very reading. The mechanism of the effects has, at present, been largely unknown -- theories of hidden knowledge and divine retribution were the subject of idle speculation with little investigation. I, Justinius Poluhnius, have undertaken to thoroughly document the ailments afflicted by the Elder Scrolls on their readers, though a unified theory of how they manifest continues to elude me and remains a subject for future study. I have grouped the effects into four, finding that the avenue of experience depends largely upon the mind of the reader. If this is unclear, I hope that a proper dichotomy will lay it plain. [pagebreak] Group the First: The Naifs For one who has received no training in the history or nature of the Elder Scrolls, the scroll itself is, effectively, inert. No prophecy can be scried nor knowledge obtained. While the scroll will not impart learning to the uninformed, nor will it afflict them in any adverse fashion. Visually, the scroll will appear to be awash in odd lettering and symbols. Those who know their astronomy often claim to recognize constellations in the patterns and connections, but such conjecture is impossible to further investigate since the very nature of this study necessitates unlearned subjects. [pagebreak] Group the Second: The Unguarded Intellects It is this second group that realizes the greatest danger from attempting to read the scrolls. These are subjects who have an understanding of the nature of the Elder Scrolls and possess sufficient knowledge to actually read what is inscribed there. They have not, however, developed adequate discipline to stave off the mind-shattering effect of having a glimpse of infinity. These unfortunate souls are struck immediately, irrevocably, and completely blind. Such is the price for overreaching one's faculties. It bears mentioning, though, that with the blindness also comes a fragment of that hidden knowledge -- whether the future, the past, or the deep natures of being is dependent on the individual and their place in the greater spheres. But the knowledge does come. [pagebreak] Group the Third: Mediated Understanding Alone in Tamriel, it would appear that only the Cult of the Ancestor Moth has discovered the discipline to properly guard one's mind when reading the scrolls. Their novitiates must undergo the most rigorous mental cultivation, and they often spend a decade or more at the monastery before being allowed to read their first Elder Scroll. The monks say this is for the initiates' own protection, as they must have witnessed many Unguarded Intellects among their more eager ranks. With appropriate fortitude, these readers also receive blindness, though at a far lesser magnitude than the Unguarded. Their vision fogs slightly, but they retain shape, color, and enough acuity to continue to read mundane texts. The knowledge they gain from the scroll is also tempered somewhat -- it requires stages of meditation and reflection to fully appreciate and express what one saw. [pagebreak] Group the Fourth: Illuminated Understanding Between the previous group and this one exists a continuum that has, at present, only been traversed by the monks of the Ancestor Moth. With continued readings the monks become gradually more and more blind, but receive greater and more detailed knowledge. As they spend their waking hours pondering the revelations, they also receive a further degree of mental fortitude. There is, for every monk, a day of Penultimate Reading, when the only knowledge the Elder Scroll imparts is that the monk's next reading shall be his last. For each monk the Penultimate Reading comes at a different and unknowable time -- preliminary work has been done to predict the occurrence by charting the severity of an individual monk's blindness, but all who reach these later stages report that the increasing blindness seems to taper with increased readings. Some pose the notion that some other, unseen, sense is, in fact, continuing to diminish at this upper range, but I shall leave such postulations to philosophers. To prepare for his Ultimate Reading, a monk typically withdraws to seclusion in order to reflect upon a lifetime of revelations and appoint his mind for reception of his last. Upon this final reading, he is forever blinded as sure as those Unguarded ones who raced to knowledge. The Illuminated one, though, has retained his understanding over a lifetime and typically possesses a more integral notion of what has been revealed to him. It is hoped that this catalog will prove useful to those who wish to further our mortal understanding of the Elder Scrolls. The Moth priests remain aloof about these matters, taking the gradual debilitation that comes with reading as a point of pride. May this serve as a useful starting point for those hoping to take up such study. ---- Dictated to Anstius Metchim, 4th of Last Seed in the 126th year of the Second Era
traduit:
[pagebreak]

上古卷轴的影响

[pagebreak]

学者们都清楚，阅读上古卷轴，会带来一定的危害。目前，该机制的原理尚未为人知悉——而基于秘密知识或圣灵降罪的推论，多数为未经推敲调研的妄断猜测。 　　 鄙人，贾斯汀尼乌斯·珀鲁纽斯，已经着手把上古卷轴带给阅读者的种种病痛完整记录，尽管关于它们各自症状如何表现的共性统一理论仍深深困扰着我，这也是我未来研索的主题。 我将其诸种状况归为四类，由此发现，体验到的感觉很大程度取决于读者的思维。若如此说明过于模糊，我希望能以一种适当的二分法将之陈明。 [pagebreak] 状况群体一：无知者 于未曾接受上古卷轴历史或性质之教育的人而言，卷轴本身处于惰性状态。并无预言可供占卜，亦无知识可供获取。卷轴虽不向无知者传授智慧，却亦不以任何不利形式折磨他们。于他们所见，卷轴所载尽是莫名其妙的刻纹和符号。其中了解天文学的人，常称于其内纹样及连结当中辨得某某星座，然而诸如此类的无端猜想均不可能进行深入调研，毕竟这一类研读，实质上未从卷轴中学得任何知识。 [pagebreak] 状况群体二：无防备者 正是这第二类群体，在尝试阅读卷轴时，能意识到至大的风险。他们对上古卷轴的性质有所了解，且具备足够的知识去阅读记载其中的内容。然而，他们尚未达成足够的自制力，无力回避在瞥见无穷之识的一刻带来的震撼效果。他们不幸的灵魂，将立刻遭受无可挽回的冲击，导致完全失明。此即自不量力的下场。然而值得一提的是，伴随失明一同到来的，还有那些隐秘知识的一隅——关于将来、往昔、又或是万物的深层性质，这些东西的获得取决于个体、及其于更广阔范畴中所处的立场。但这些知识确实是授入了他们脑海。 [pagebreak] 状况群体三：间接明悟者 在全泰姆瑞尔，仅有先祖蛾教派探得一种可在阅读卷轴时适当保护他们心智的方法。在见习者们获准研读第一卷上古卷轴前，须经受最严格的精神修行，在修道院待上十年甚至更久。僧侣们称，此举只为同修得到更好的保护，因为他们一定是目睹了自己团队中很多“无防备者”的下场了。虽具备与之适配的刚毅意志，这些研读者亦将失明，但其程度远轻于无防备者。他们视野略为模糊，但仍可辨识颜色、形状，且残余视力足以阅读普通文本。他们自卷轴所得之知识也相对更加缓和，需要经由一段冥想与回想，才能充分理解并表达自己看到的知识。 [pagebreak] 状况群体四：启蒙明悟者 本群体与前一群体间存在一种递进延续关系，目前仅先祖蛾教派的修士方得达此境界。随着研读时日渐久，僧侣们将步步迈向失明，但却获得了更庞大更详尽的知识。当他们花费自己清醒的时间去思考这些启示时，其心智精神也会越发坚韧。每一位僧侣，均有迎来倒数第二次研读的一日。彼时，上古卷轴告知他们——下一次将是最后的研读。 于每位僧侣而言，倒数第二次研读来临的时间各不相同，而且难以预测。已完成的初步研究表明，可凭一位僧侣自身失明的加剧程度推演其出现时间点。但据所有进入这种后期阶段的人报告所述，随着阅读次数增多，失明的加剧程度亦在减缓。有些人提出了另一种概念：事实上，还有其他一些难被察觉的感官机能，亦随此上限接续削弱。但我将把此类猜想留予哲学家们去研究。 在筹备其终末研读时，修士往往会隐居起来，以求反思一生获得的启示，并为迎接这最终一次启示而调整自己的心灵。经此最终研读后，他将如那些求得知识的无防备者一样永久失明。然而，启蒙者可终生地保有自己的理解，且通常能对揭示给他之物有更加完整的概念。 希望本篇论述，能对希望进一步了解上古卷轴的人有所帮助。先祖蛾修士们仍对此类课题保持冷漠，还把随研读而来的逐渐衰弱视为一种骄傲。愿本文能为那些希望从事此方向研究的人提供一个有用的起点。 --口述自安斯提奥斯·米奇姆，作于第二纪元126年末种月4日

original:
[pagebreak]

Pension of the Ancestor Moth

[pagebreak]

To be read by all novitiates of the Temple: he Order of the Ancestor Moth is as ancient as it is noble. We nurture and celebrate our beloved ancestors, whose spirits are manifest in the Ancestor Moths. Each moth carries the fjyron of an ancestor's spirit. Loosely translated as the "will to peace," the fjyron can be sung into the silk produced by the Ancestor Moths. When the silk is in turn spun into cloth and embroidered with the genealogy of the correct Ancestor, clothing of wondrous power can be made. Adepts of our order are gifted with prescient powers. The wisdom of the ancestors can sing the future into the present. For this reason, our order and our order alone has been given the privilege to interpret the Elder Scrolls. These writings exceed even the gods, both aedra and daedra. Such insight into the inner fabric of reality comes at a price. Each reading of the Elder Scrolls is more profound than the last. Each leaves the priest blind for longer, and longer periods of time. Finally, the last reading achieves a nearly sublime understanding of that scroll's contents, but the priest is left permanently blinded to the light of this world. No longer can he read the scrolls. This Monastery is dedicated to the service of these noble members of our order. They now live out their lives with the Ancestor Moths that they so love. Their underground demesnes are well suited to the moths. They raise and nurture the fragile creatures, singing to them constantly. They harvest the silk and spin it into bolts of cloth. They weave the cloth, embroidering it with the genealogies and histories of the ancestors that spun the silk. This is their new life. As they tend the Ancestor Moths, so we tend the blind monks. While they toil in dark, we serve in the light. They need food and water. We provide. They need tools and furniture. We provide. They need secrecy and anonymity. We provide. They need purveyors to sell the fruit of their labors. We provide. At one time, we also provided protection. Many generations ago, Gudrun came to our temple. Newly blinded by visions of what was to be, she brought with her new teachings. The visions of the ancestors foresaw the need of the monks to defend themselves. They train and practice the teachings of Gudrun constantly. They are masters of the sword of no sword, the axes of no axe. As a novitiate, you will learn the teachings of Gudrun. You will learn the way of the peaceful fist. You will learn to serve the blind monks. You will learn to provide. In time, you may attain the peace and insight of the Ancestor Moths.

从先祖蛾教派引退

[pagebreak]

本书供神殿的初心者修士参阅： 先祖蛾教派，源远流长而高贵圣洁。我们精心照料，并赞颂光耀我们深深钟爱的先祖，而他们的精神就彰显于先祖蛾身上。每翼飞蛾均携有承载祖先精魂的“吉绒”。吉绒，可粗略释义为“和平意志”，能被化入先祖蛾所产吐的丝中。待丝织成绸布，再在其上纺绣对应的先祖世系，就能制作出具有神奇力量的衣服。 　　 我们教派中的熟手身怀先见之明的能力。先祖的智慧，能于当下颂唱未来的景象。正因此，我们，也只有我们，被赋予了解读阐释上古卷轴的特权。此类文献甚至超越了包括伊德拉和迪德拉在内的诸神。这种对现实内部结构的洞察是有代价的。对上古卷轴的每一次研读所得，均比前一次更为深入。而每一次研读，亦将导致祭司失明的时间越来越长。最终，终末的研读将对卷轴的内容具有近乎崇高的理解，但祭司本人也自此永远失去了这世界的光明。自此，他再不能研读卷轴。 　　 本修道院致力于为我派中这类高洁的成员服务。他们现今与挚爱的先祖蛾共度余生。他们的地下领地非常适宜蛾族繁衍生息。他们细心照料培养这些脆弱的生灵，为它们反复颂唱。他们收割绸丝将之纺作绸筒，编织作布匹，在上面绣上纺丝祖先的家谱与历史。此便是他们的全新生活。 　　 正如他们精心看顾先祖蛾那般，我们亦精心看顾这一众盲僧。当他们躬耕于黑暗，我们以光明事之。当他们需求食物和清水，我们予之。当他们需求工器和家私，我们予之。当他们需求隐遁和匿名，我们予之。当他们需出售劳动果实，也由我们办理。 　　 曾一度，我们亦为他们供予庇护。许多许多代之前，古德伦进访我们神殿。她虽已因预见将要发生之景象而新近失明，却携来她的全新教诲。先祖之幻象预示：诸僧皆需自我保护。因而，他们紧加训练，不断亲身践行古德伦的教诲。成为了无剑而有剑、无斧而有斧的高手大师。 　　 身为初心者修士，你将学习古德伦的教诲。练习平和拳道。了解如何侍奉众盲僧。习得如何供予。随着时光荏苒，你将获得先祖蛾的平静与洞察力。

The Battle of Red Mountain and the Rise and Fall of the Tribunal

[pagebreak] [pagebreak]

[The following is a transcript of the words of Lord Vivec, addressed to a Dissident Priest, Malur Omayn, who confronted Vivec with the Ashlander traditions surrounding the Battle of Red Mountain and with prophecies of the Nerevarine, and to unnamed magistrates of the Inquisition who joined Vivec in interrogating the Dissident Priest.] [pagebreak] Who can clearly recall the events of the distant past. But you have asked me to tell you, in my own words, the events surrounding the Battle of Red Mountain, the birth of the Tribunal, and the prophecies of a Nerevar reborn. Here is what I can tell you. When the Chimer first abandoned the herds and tents of their nomadic ancestors, and built the first Great Houses, we loved the Daedra, and worshipped them as gods. But our brethren, the Dwemer, scorned the Daedra, and mocked our foolish rituals, and preferred instead their gods of Reason and Logic. So the Chimer and Dwemer were always at bitter war, until the Nords came and invaded Resdayn. Only then did the Chimer and Dwemer put away their strife and join together to cast out the invaders. Once the Nords were driven out, General Nerevar of the Chimer and General Dumac of the Dwemer, who had come to love and respect one another, resolved to make peace between their peoples. In that time I was but a junior counselor to Nerevar, and Nerevar's queen, Almalexia, and his other favorite counselor, Sotha Sil, always doubted that such a peace might long survive, given the bitter disputes between Chimer and Dwemer, but by negotiation and compromise, Nerevar and Dumac somehow managed to preserve a fragile peace. But when Dagoth Ur, Lord of House Dagoth, and trusted as a friend by both Nerevar and the Dwemer, brought us proof that High Engineer Kagrenac of the Dwemer had discovered the Heart of Lorkhan, and that he had learned how to tap its powers, and was building a new god, a mockery of Chimer faith and a fearsome weapon, we all urged Nerevar to make war on the Dwarves and to destroy this threat to Chimer beliefs and security. Nerevar was troubled. He went to Dumac and asked if what Dagoth Ur said was true. But Kagrenac took great offense, and asked whom Nerevar thought he was, that he might presume to judge the affairs of the Dwemer. Nerevar was further troubled, and made pilgrimage to Holamayan, the sacred temple of Azura, and Azura confirmed that all that Dagoth Ur said was indeed true and that the creation of a New God of the Dwemer should be prevented at all costs. When Nerevar came back and told us what the goddess had said, we felt our judgements confirmed, and again counseled him to war, chiding Nerevar for his naive trust in friendship, and reminding Nerevar of his duty to protect the faith and security of the Chimer against the impiety and dangerous ambitious of the Dwemer. Then Nerevar went back to Vvardenfell one last time, hoping that negotiations and compromise might once again preserve the peace. But this time the friends Nerevar and Dumac quarreled bitterly, and as a result, the Chimer and Dwemer went to war. The Dwemer were well-defended by their fortress at Red Mountain, but Nerevar's cunning drew most of Dumac's armies out into the field and pinned them there, while Nerevar, Dagoth Ur, and a small group of companions could make their way into the Heart Chamber by secret means. There, Nerevar the Chimer King met Dumac the Dwarf King and they both collapsed from grievous wounds and draining magics. With Dumac fallen, and threatened by Dagoth Ur and others, Kagrenac turned his tools upon the Heart, and Nerevar said he saw Kagrenac and all his Dwemer companions at once disappear from the world. In that instant, Dwemer everywhere disappeared without a trace. But Kagrenac's tools remained, and Dagoth Ur seized them, and he carried them to Nerever, saying, "That fool Kagrenac has destroyed his own people with these things. We should destroy them, right away, lest they fall into the wrong hands." But Nerevar was resolved to confer with his queen and his generals, who had foreseen that this war would come and whose counsel he would not ignore again. "I will ask the Tribunal what we shall do with them, for they have had wisdom in the past that I had not. Stay here, loyal Dagoth Ur, until I return." So Nerevar told Dagoth Ur to protect the tools and the Heart Chamber until he returned. Then Nerevar was carried to us where we waited on the slopes of Red Mountain, and he told us all that had transpired under Red Mountain. What Nerevar had said was that the Dwemer had used special tools to turn their people into immortals and that the Heart of Lorkhan held wondrous powers. [Only later did we hear from others present that Dagoth Ur had thought the Dwemer destroyed, not made immortal. And no one knows for sure what really happened there.] After hearing Nerevar, we gave our counsel as he requested, proposing, "We should preserve these tools in trust for the welfare of the Chimer people. And who knows, perhaps the Dwemer are not gone forever, but merely transported to some distant realm, from which they may some day return to threaten our security once again. Therefore, we need to keep these tools, to study them and their principles, so that we may be safe in future generations." And though Nerevar voiced his grave misgivings, he was willing to be ruled by our counsel, under one condition: that we all together should swear a solemn oath upon Azura that the tools would never be used in the profane manner that the Dwemer had intended. We all readily agreed, and swore solemn oaths at Nerevar's dictation. So then we went with Nerevar back into Red Mountain and met with Dagoth Ur. Dagoth Ur refused to deliver the tools to us, saying they were dangerous, and we could not touch them. Dagoth Ur seemed to be irrational, insisting that only he could be trusted with the tools, and then we guessed that he had somehow been affected by his handling of the tools, but now I feel sure that he had privately learned the powers of the tools, and had in some confused way decided he must have them for himself. Then Nerevar and our guard resorted to force to secure the tools. Somehow Dagoth Ur and his retainers escaped, but we gained the tools, and delivered them to Sotha Sil for study and safe-keeping. For some years we kept the oaths we swore to Azura with Nerevar, but during that time, in secret, Sotha Sil must have studied the tools and divined their mysteries. And at last he came to us with a vision of a new world of peace, with justice and honor for nobles, and health and prosperity for the commoners, with the Tribunal as immortal patrons and guides. And dedicating ourselves to this vision of a better world, we made a pilgrimage to Red Mountain and transformed ourselves with the power of Kagrenac's tools. And no sooner than we had completed our rituals and begun to discover our new-found powers, the Daedra Lord Azura appeared and cursed us for our foresworn oaths. By her powers of prophecy, she assured us that her champion, Nerevar, true to his oath, would return to punish us for our perfidy, and to make sure such profane knowledge might never again be used to mock and defy the will of the gods. But Sotha Sil said to her, "The old gods are cruel and arbitrary, and distant from the hopes and fears of mer. Your age is past. We are the new gods, born of the flesh, and wise and caring of the needs of our people. Spare us your threats and chiding, inconstant spirit. We are bold and fresh, and will not fear you." And then, in that moment, all Chimer were changed into Dunmer, and our skins turned ashen and our eyes into fire. Of course, we only knew at that time that this had happened to us, but Azura said, "This is not my act, but your act. You have chosen your fate, and the fate of your people, and all the Dunmer shall share your fate, from now to the end of time. You think yourselves gods, but you are blind, and all is darkness." And Azura left us alone, in darkness, and we were all afraid, but we put on brave faces, and went forth from Red Mountain to build the new world of our dreams. And the new world we shaped was glorious and generous, and the worship of the Dunmer fervent and grateful. The Dunmer were at first afraid of their new faces, but Sotha Sil spoke to them, saying that it was not a curse but a blessing, a sign of their changed natures, and sign of the special favor they might enjoy as New Mer, no longer barbarians trembling before ghosts and spirits, but civilized mer, speaking directly to their immortal friends and patrons, the three faces of the Tribunal. And we were all inspired by Sotha Sil's speech and vision, and took heart. And over time, we crafted the customs and institutions of a just and honorable society, and the land of Resdayn knew millennia of peace, equity, and prosperity unknown to other savage races. But beneath Red Mountain, Dagoth Ur had survived. And even as the light of our bold new world shined ever more brightly, beneath Red Mountain, the darkness gathered, a darkness that was close kin to the bright light that Sotha Sil coaxed from the Heart of Lorkhan with the Tools of Kagrenac. As the darkness grew, we fought it, and crafted walls to confine it, but we never could destroy it, for the source of the darkness was the same source as the source of our own divine inspiration. And in these latter days of Morrowind, reduced to a subjugated province of the Western Empire, as the glory of the Temple fades, and the dark tide rises from Red Mountain, we are reminded of Azura and her promised champion's return. We have waited, blind, and in darkness, mere shadows, drained of our ardent vision, in shame of our folly, in fear of our judgement, and in hope of our deliverance. We do not know if the outlander claiming to fulfill the prophecies of the Nerevarine is our old companion Nerevar reborn, or a pawn of the Emperor, or a catspaw of Azura, or some simple twist of fate. But we insist you adhere to Temple doctrine, and conform to the strictures dividing the Hierographa from the Apographa, and that you not speak that which must not be spoken openly. Act as a dutiful priest should, in accordance with your vows of obedience to the canons and archcanons, and all will be forgiven. Defy me, and you will know what it is to stand against a god. -- Vivec

红山之战 和 审判席的崛起与陨落

[pagebreak] [pagebreak]

[以下抄本记录了维威克大君向与他就红山之战相关灰民传统，尼瑞瓦因预言对质的异见祭司玛鲁尔·奥马恩，和同审异见教徒的无名执法官之间的语录。] [pagebreak] 谁能清楚记得过去的事呢。但如果要我告诉你自己对有关红山之战、审判席的诞生以及尼瑞瓦重生预言的事件的观点，那就是接下来的这些。 当凯莫最初放弃游牧先祖的牧群与帐篷，建立第一个大家族时，我们仍热爱迪德拉，尊奉他们为神。但我们的同胞锻莫蔑视迪德拉，嘲笑我们愚蠢的仪式，更为推崇他们的诸位理性与逻辑之神。因此凯莫与锻莫常年征战，直至诺德入侵瑞斯戴恩。到那时凯莫与锻莫才放下了冲突，联手抵御外敌。 当诺德人被驱逐后，惺惺相惜的凯莫尼瑞瓦将军和锻莫杜马克将军决定为两族带来和平。那时还只是尼瑞瓦低级顾问的我，和尼瑞瓦的王后阿玛莱西亚及另一位被看重的顾问索萨·希尔经常质疑这种和平如何能在两族间存在激烈冲突的情况下长久。但尼瑞瓦和杜马克以某方式谈判作出妥协，设法维护着脆弱的和平。 但尼瑞瓦和锻莫共同的朋友达格斯家主，达格斯·乌尔向我们证实锻莫高级工程师卡格瑞纳克已经发掘出了洛克汗之心，并通晓如何运用其力量。他们同时还在建造一个亵渎凯莫信仰的新神，一种可怕的武器。我们力劝尼瑞瓦向矮人开战以摧毁这对凯莫信念及安全的威胁。他很困惑，只好去向杜马克求证达格斯·乌尔所言是否属实。但卡格瑞纳克非常生气，质问尼瑞瓦为什么认为自己有资格评判锻莫的事务。 尼瑞瓦愈加不安，他前往霍拉马延阿祖拉神殿朝圣，阿祖拉证实达格斯·乌尔所言不虚，应不计一切代价阻止锻莫创造新神。当尼瑞瓦归来转达神谕后我们感到判断成真了，再次劝他开战，责备他天真地信任友谊，提醒他有义务保护凯莫信仰与安危，防范充满危险而不敬的野心锻莫。 尼瑞瓦最后一次回瓦登费尔，寄希望于用谈判和妥协再次维护和平。但这次他和杜马克发生激烈争吵，结果自然是凯莫和锻莫开战。 锻莫在红山的要塞防御很严密，但尼瑞瓦用诡计将杜马克的军队诱至战场并牵制于此，同时他、达格斯·乌尔及小股部队秘密进入心室。杜马克战死后，在达格斯·乌尔和其他威胁下，卡格瑞纳克向神之心挥舞他的工具。据尼瑞瓦所言他看到卡格瑞纳克及其同伴突然消失了，就那一瞬间，各地的锻莫都无影无踪。达格斯·乌尔拾起卡格瑞纳克遗落的工具带给尼瑞瓦：“卡格瑞纳克那个傻瓜居然用这些东西毁灭了族人，为防它们落入奸人之手，应马上销毁。” 但尼瑞瓦打算与预见此战的王后及将军们商议，他再也不会忽视他们的建言了。“我要问问审判席该如何处置它们，他们有我所欠缺的智慧。忠诚的达格斯·乌尔啊，你留在这里等我回来吧。”因此尼瑞瓦告诫达格斯·乌尔在他返回之前保护好工具与心室。 尼瑞瓦被抬到我们所在的红山坡道，告诉了我们山下发生的一切。但他所说的是锻莫以特殊工具使全族不朽，洛克汗之心拥有神奇力量。（后来我们从其他在场者得知达格斯·乌尔认为锻莫是被毁灭而非成就不朽，当然无人能确定那里究竟发生了什么。） 在听尼瑞瓦说完后，我们按他要求给出建议：“我们应该为了凯莫人民的福祉保留这些工具。谁知道锻莫是不是永远消失了，或许仅仅是传送到了某个遥远领域。万一某天他们回归会再次威胁到我们。因此需要留下这些工具以研究它们的原理，以保证未来子孙的安全。” 尽管尼瑞瓦表示他颇为疑虑，但只要满足一个条件他还是愿意接受我们的建议：我们所有人都要向阿祖拉宣誓永不以锻莫预期的渎神方式使用这些工具。我们欣然同意，照尼瑞瓦的口述庄严宣誓。 之后我们随尼瑞瓦返回红山与达格斯·乌尔会面，但他拒绝将工具交给我们，声称它们危险到我们不能触碰。达格斯·乌尔似乎失去了理智，坚持认为只有自己才能掌管这些工具。我们猜测他已经受到了手中工具某程度的影响，但现在我确信他私下里已经了解了工具的效用，然后在某种被迷惑的情况下认为必须自己持有他们。后来尼瑞瓦和守卫们以武力强行取得了工具，达格斯乌尔及其随从不知怎的逃了出去。我们得到工具后把它们交付索萨·希尔进行研究保管。 几年来我们遵守了在尼瑞瓦见证下向阿祖拉发的誓言，索萨·希尔在这段时间秘密研究这些工具，领悟他们的奥秘。最后，他带来一个和平新世界的愿景，为了贵族的公正与荣耀，平民的健康与繁荣，由审判席作为不朽代言人、指导者。为将自己奉献于更美好世界的愿景，我等前往红山朝圣，借助卡格瑞纳克工具之力改变了自己。 就在不久后我们完成了仪式开始探索新取得的力量时，迪德拉君王阿祖拉现身，因我等违背誓言而诅咒我们。她以预言权能向我等保证：她的勇士尼瑞瓦将会信守誓言回归，以惩罚我等的违誓，确保亵渎神明的知识不会再被用来嘲弄与违抗诸神意志。但索萨·希尔对她说：“古神残酷专横，不问精灵苦乐。你的时代已经过去。我等智慧的血肉之躯新神才会真正关心人民需要。收起你的威胁与责难吧，无常之灵。我等勇毅而新立，无惧于你。” 在那一刻，所有凯莫都变成了丹莫，我等皮肤灰暗，瞳色火红。当然我们那时只知道自身的变化，但阿祖拉说：“这并非我所为，而是你们所致。你们选择了自身与子民的命运，此刻起至末日，所有丹莫也将分担你们所受。你们认为自己是神，却双目失明，满眼黑暗。”然后阿祖拉置我们于黑暗中而去，尽管害怕，我等仍摆出坚毅之面踏出红山，建立梦想的新世界。 我们塑造的新世界辉煌而慷慨，丹莫信众充满热诚与感激。最初他们惧怕这幅新面孔，但索萨·希尔告诉他们此乃祝福而非诅咒，是他们天性发生改变的标志，是作为新精灵享有的恩惠：不再是畏惧精魂的蛮族，而是文明的精灵。丹莫能够直接与不朽代言人及指导者，审判席的三面对话。我们都为索萨·希尔的宣讲与远见感到振奋并振作起来。随时间推移，我们创造了正义而荣耀的社会，瑞斯戴恩之地历经了其他蛮族所没有的千年和平、公正和光辉岁月。 但在红山底部的达格斯·乌尔存活了下来。就在我们勇敢新世界之光愈发明亮夺目时，聚集的黑暗几近索萨·希尔用卡格瑞纳克工具从洛克汗之心取得的光芒。随着黑暗延伸，我等与之抗争，建造围墙来限制它。但我们永远无法摧毁它，因为黑暗与我等神圣之启同源。 后来晨风随着神殿荣耀日趋消减，黑暗之潮从红山涌起，逐渐沦为屈服于西方帝国的一个省份。我们终于想起阿祖拉所预言的勇士归来。我等在黑暗中已等待许久，盲眼望去尽是黑暗之影，热切憧憬早已耗尽；羞耻于愚行，畏惧于判断，殷切盼望着解脱。我等不知声称要实现尼瑞瓦因预言的外地人到底是老朋友尼瑞瓦的重生，还是皇帝的一枚棋子；是阿祖拉的爪牙，还是命运一次平淡无奇的转折。但我等坚持要求你们遵守神殿教义，遵守圣经对异典的约束，不得道出不能公开之事。作为尽职的祭司就要按誓约服从于正典，一切都将得到宽恕。若敢违抗我，你就会知道与神对立是何等滋味。 ——维威克
