海尔辛的传说

[pagebreak]

年中月5日，湮灭的疯狂君王带着一贯的骄傲与自负，站在天际寒冷的群山之间，他召唤海尔辛前来赌上一场。猎神现身，因为今天正是他的召唤日，而谢尔格拉的大胆之举激起了他的兴致。 谢尔格拉的领域极尽歪曲，里面尽是些傻笑的呆子、浮夸的作家和怯懦的残废。疯狂君王只会为了别人自身的困惑、悲剧或愤怒而进行无利可图的交易，推动那无谓的流血牺牲。所以，谢尔格拉为自己搭建了一个舞台，自己来扮演海尔辛的对手。 扭捏作态的君王不慌不忙地提出了赌约的内容：每个君王都训练一头野兽，三年为期再来这里，来一场殊死斗兽。海尔辛可怕的面孔上毫无表情，他同意了。两位君王各自返回了自己的领域，徒留一片风雪。 海尔辛虽然自信，却也知道谢尔格拉狡诈，于是在自己的隐秘领域秘密培育了一头令人厌恶的怪物。他召唤了一头古老的迪德拉斯，并注入了化狼症的邪恶诅咒。它拥有了强健跳动的心脏和满口锯齿交错的尖牙，即便是在海尔辛麾下的一众强大的狩猎者中，也难寻拥有如此无与伦比、难以言喻之恐怖的存在。 三年之期已满，还是同一天，海尔辛如约而至，却看到谢尔格拉盘腿倚在一块大石上，正不耐烦地吹着口哨。狩猎君王把他的矛戳在地上，唤来他那咆哮着的巨兽造物。谢尔格拉像往常一样狡猾地脱下帽子，站在一旁，露出栖息在身后石头上的那只色彩斑斓的小鸟。鸟儿在山巅的狂风中娴静地鸣叫，声音微弱到几乎不能听见。 迪德拉斯以扭曲古怪的动作一跃而起，原本伫立着巨石的地方只剩一片狼藉。怪兽以为自己胜利了，沾满血迹的嗉囊蜷缩成了一个笑脸，却又听到清爽的空气中飘来一阵柔和的歌声。小鸟轻轻沿着愤怒的迪德拉斯的鼻子蹦蹦跳跳。谢尔格拉旁观一切，静静地开怀一笑，看着这小东西在大怪兽赤红的眼睛中间啄了啄一块小碎鳞片。在狂怒的嚎叫中，狼化的迪德拉斯弄瞎了自己的眼，企图把那讨厌的小东西赶走。就这样持续了好几个小时，海尔辛惭愧地看着他最棒的怪兽在追逐一只看似很没脑子的小鸟的过程中逐渐自毁，听着那小鸟用清幽的音色鸣叫着悲伤的曲调。 赌输的海尔辛面色难堪，烧毁了已经残破的怪兽尸体，用早已被遗忘的语言咒骂着撤回了自己的领域。他的诅咒仍然在那些山峰上缠绕，途径之人无不因他的愤怒而恐惧得不敢停留。 谢尔格拉转过身，示意让小小的鸣鸟落在他的肩上，然后大摇大摆地走下山，迎着阿贝希恩海岸和暖的微风和充满活力的晚霞，与泰姆瑞尔最小的冠军一起吹起了口哨。

alacath's Tale

[pagebreak]

n the days before the Orsinium's founding, the spurned Orc-folk were subjected to ostracism and persecutions even more numerous and harsh than their progeny are accustomed to in our own age. So it was that many champions of the Orsimer traveled, enforcing what borders they could for the proliferation of their own people. Many of these champions are spoken of yet today, among them the Cursed Legion, Gromma the Hairless, and the noble Emmeg Gro-Kayra. This latter crusader would have certainly risen to legendary status throughout Tamriel, had he not been subject to the attention of certain Daedric Princes. Emmeg Gro-Kayra was the bastard son of a young maiden who was killed in childbirth. He was raised by the shaman of his tribe, the Grilikamaug in the peaks of what we now call Normar Heights. Late in his fifteenth year, Emmeg forged by hand an ornate suit of scaled armor, a rite of ascension among his tribe. On a blustery day, he pounded the final rivet, and draping a heavy cloak over the bulky mantle, Emmeg set out from his village for the last time. Word of his exploits always returned home, whether defending merchant caravans from brigands or liberating enslaved beast folk. News of the noble Orc crusader began to grace even the lips of Bretons, often with a tinge of fear. Less than two years after ascending to maturity, Gro-Kayra was making camp when a thin voice called out from the thickening night. He was surprised to hear the language of his people spoken by a tongue that obviously did not belong to an Orc. 'Lord Kayra', said the voice, 'tales of your deeds have crossed the lips of many, and have reached my ears.' Peering into the murk, Emmeg made out the silhouette of a cloaked figure, made wavy and ephemeral by the hazy campfire. From the voice alone he had thought the interloper an old hag, but he now decided that he was in the presence of a man of slight and lanky build, though he could discern no further detail. 'Perhaps,' the wary Orc began, 'but I seek no glory. Who are you?' Ignoring the question, the stranger continued, 'Despite that, Orsimer, glory finds you, and I bear a gift worthy of it.' The visitor's cloak parted slightly, revealing nothing but faintly glinting buttons in the pale moonlight, and a bundle was withdrawn and tossed to the side of the fire between the two. Emmeg cautiously removed the rags in which the object was swathed, and was dazzled to discover the item to be a wide, curved blade with ornately decorated handle. The weapon had heft, and Emmeg realized on brandishing it that the elaborate pommel disguised the more practical purpose of balancing the considerable weight of the blade itself. It was nothing much to look at in its present condition, thought the Orc, but once the tarnish was cleaned away and a few missing jewels restored, it would indeed be a blade worthy of a champion ten times his own worth. 'Her name is Neb-Crescen' spoke the thin stranger, seeing the appreciation lighting Gro-Kayra's face. 'I got her for a horse and a secret in warmer climes, but in my old age I'd be lucky to even lift such a weapon. It's only proper that I pass her on to one such as yourself. To possess her is to change your life, forever.' Overcoming his initial infatuation with the arc of honed steel, Emmeg turned his attention back to the visitor. 'Your words are fine, old man,' Emmeg said, not masking his suspicion, 'but I'm no fool. You traded for this blade once, and you'll trade for it again tonight. What is it that you want?' The stranger's shoulders slumped, and Emmeg was glad to have unveiled the true purpose of this twilight visit. He sat with him a while, eventually offering a stack of furs, warm food, and a handful of coins in exchange for the exotic weapon. By morning, the stranger was gone. In the week following Emmeg's encounter with the stranger, Neb-Crescen had not left its scabbard. He had encountered no enemy in the woods, and his meals consisted of fowl and small game caught with bow and arrow. The peace suited him fine, but on the seventh morning, while fog still crept between the low-hanging boughs, Emmeg's ears pricked up at the telltale crunch of a nearby footfall in the dense snow and forest debris. Emmeg's nostrils flared, but he was upwind. Being unable to see or smell his guest, and knowing that the breeze carried his scent in that direction, Emmeg's guard was up, and he cautiously drew Neb-Crescen from its sheath. Emmeg himself was not entirely sure of all that happened next. The first moment of conscious memory in Emmeg Gro-Kayra's mind after drawing Neb-Crescen was the image of the curved blade sweeping through the air in front of him, spattering blood over the virginal powder coating the forest floor. The second memory was a feeling of frenzied bloodlust creeping over him, but it was then that he saw for the first time his victim, an Orc woman perhaps a few years younger than himself, her body a canvas of grisly wounds, enough to kill a strong man ten times over. Emmeg's disgust overwhelmed the madness that had overtaken him, and with all his will enlisted, he released Neb-Crescen from his grip and let the blade sail. With a discordant ringing it spun through the air and was buried in a snowdrift. Emmeg fled the scene in shame and horror, drawing the hood of his cloak up to hide himself from the judging eyes of the rising sun. The scene where Emmeg Gro-Kayra had murdered one of his own kind was a macabre one. Below the neck, the body was flayed and mutilated almost beyond recognition, but the untouched face was frozen in a permanent expression of abject terror. It was here that Sheogorath performed certain rites that summoned Malacath, and the two Daedric Lords held court in the presence of the disfigured corpse. 'Why show me this, Mad One?' began Malacath, once he recovered from his initial, wordless outrage. 'Do you take such pleasure in watching me grieve the murder of my children?' His guttural voice rumbled, and the patron of the Orismer looked upon his counterpart with accusing eyes. 'By birth, she was yours, brother outcast,' began Sheogorath, solemn in aspect and demeanor. 'But she was a daughter of mine by her own habits. My mourning here is no less than your own, my outrage no less great.' 'I am not so sure,' grumbled Malacath, 'but rest assured that vengeance for this crime is mine to reap. I expect no contest from you. Stand aside.' As the fearsome Prince began to push past him, Lord Sheogorath spoke again. 'I have no intention of standing between you and vengeance. In fact, I mean to help you. I have servants in this wilderness, and can tell you just where to find our mutual foe. I ask only that you use a weapon of my choosing. Wound the criminal with my blade, and banish him to my plane, where I can exact my own punishment. The rights of honor-killing here belong to you.' With that, Malacath agreed, took the wide blade from Sheogorath, and was gone. Malacath materialized in the path of the murderer, the cloaked figure obscured through a blizzard haze. Bellowing a curse so foul as to wilt the surrounding trees, the blade was drawn and Malacath crossed the distance more quickly than a wild fox. Frothing with rage, he swung the blade in a smooth arc which lopped the head of his foe cleanly off, then plunged the blade up to its hilt in his chest, choking off the spurts of blood into a steady, growing stain of red bubbling from beneath the scaled armor and heavy cloak. Panting from the unexpected immediacy and fury of his own kill, Malacath rested on a knee as the body before him collapsed heavily backwards and the head landed roughly upon a broad, flat stone. The next sound broke the silence like a bolt. 'I - I'm sorry...' sputtered the voice of Emmeg Gro-Kayra. Malacath's eyes went wide as he looked upon the severed head, seeping blood from its wound, but somehow kept alive. Its eyes wavered about wildly, trying to focus on the aspect of Malacath before it. The once-proud eyes of the champion were choked with tears of grief, pain, and confused recognition. To his horror, Malacath recognized only now that the man he had killed was not only one of his Orismer children, but very literally a son he had blessed an Orc maiden with years hence. For achingly long moments the two looked upon each other, despondent and shocked. Then, silent as oiled steel, Sheogorath strode into the clearing. He hefted Emmeg Gro-Kayra's disembodied head and bundled it into a small, grey sack. Sheogorath reclaimed Neb-Crescen from the corpse and turned to walk away. Malacath began to stand, but kneeled again, knowing he had irreversibly damned his own offspring to the realm of Sheogorath, and mourned his failure as the sound of his son's hoarse pleas faded into the frozen horizon.

玛拉凯斯的传说

[pagebreak]

在奥辛纽姆建立前的岁月，被唾弃的兽人一族受尽了排挤和迫害，远比他们后人在我们这个时代所习惯的那些更多更残酷。因此，许多奥辛莫勇士四处奔走，为族人繁衍争取更大的空间。时至今日，此类勇士仍被津津乐道，其中包括“诅咒军团”、“无毛”葛罗姆玛还有高尚的艾姆戈·格洛-凯拉。如果不是被某位迪德拉君王盯上，这位圣战士肯定能在全泰姆瑞尔打出一片传奇。 艾姆戈·格洛-凯拉是个私生子，还是少女的母亲死于难产。他的部落格里卡马格在我们现在称为“诺马尔高峰”的山上，一位萨满巫师把他抚养长大。十五岁时，艾姆戈为完成部落的成年仪式，亲手打造了一套华丽的鳞片盔甲。在一个狂风大作的日子里，他敲打上最后一颗铆钉，配上了厚重的斗篷，随后就离开了村庄。无论是保护商队免受强盗的袭击，还是解救被奴役的野兽，他的丰功伟绩总能传到人们的耳中。 这名高贵的兽人圣战士的事迹甚至开始在布莱顿人中带着一丝恐惧口口相传着。 两年后的一天，格洛-凯拉正在扎营，听到一个微弱的声音从渐浓的夜色中传来。他惊讶于听到同族用一种显然不属于兽人的语言同他交谈。 那个声音说道：“凯拉大人，我和很多人一样听说过您的事迹。”通过朦胧的夜色，艾姆戈看到了一个披着斗篷的身影，在摇曳的营火映衬下，身影显得抖动而短暂。单听声音，他还以为是个老太婆，但现在他能断定这是个身材瘦削之人，可其他细节就不明了。 “也许吧，”警惕的兽人答道，“但我不是追求荣耀之人。你是什么人？” 陌生人没有理会他的问题，继续说道：“尽管如此，奥辛莫啊，您已经被荣耀找上了，而我有一份配得上这份荣耀的礼物。”来客把斗篷微微拉开，只露出在苍白月光下闪闪发光的纽扣，顺手抽出包裹，扔在了两人之间的营火边。艾姆戈小心翼翼取下包裹的破布，惊奇地发现里面是一把刀柄装饰华丽的宽刃弯刀。武器很沉重。艾姆戈在挥舞时意识到，精心装饰的刀柄掩盖了平衡重量的实际目的。兽人心想，这把剑现在的样子没什么值得一看，可一旦它的瑕疵被修复，重新镶嵌丢失的宝石，那确实可以当高十倍于己的勇士的佩刀。 瘦小的陌生人看到了格洛-凯拉脸上露出的赞赏之情，介绍道：“她叫内布-克森，我用一匹马和一个温暖地方的秘密买下她，我这把年纪还能拿起这样的武器也算幸运了。我应该把她交给像您这样的勇士。拥有她会永远改变您的生活。” 艾姆戈克服了最初对宝刀的迷恋，把注意力转回到来客身上。艾姆戈并没有掩饰自己的疑虑：“你说得对，老头儿。但我不傻，你靠交换把刀买到手，现在却要再换一次。你有什么打算？”陌生人肩膀耷拉下来，艾姆戈很高兴揭开了这次深夜造访的真正目的。两个人坐了一会儿，艾姆戈给了他一些皮草和一堆金币，又请他吃了顿热乎饭，换取了这奇异的武器。到早上，陌生人已离开了。 艾姆戈遇到陌生人后的一周，都没有把“内布-克森”出鞘。他在森林没碰上什么敌人，打猎也是靠弓箭。他很享受这片宁静。但第七天早上，林间雾气还在低垂的树枝间蔓延，走在浓厚积雪和森林遗迹中的艾姆戈竖起耳朵，听着附近传来窸窸窣窣的脚步声。 艾姆戈长大鼻孔嗅了嗅，可由于在上风口，什么都闻不到。目不能视，鼻不能闻，但他明白风已经把他的气味吹向了那个方向，于是他赶紧防备，小心翼翼拔出了内布-克森。接下来的事艾姆戈自己也不记得了。 艾姆戈·格洛-凯拉抽出内布-克森之后，脑海里只剩下两个记忆。第一个是弯刃在他面前的空气扫过，森林的雪地上遍洒鲜血。第二个记忆是一股疯狂的嗜血欲望在他身上蔓延，但就在那时，他第一次看清了受害者，一个比他年轻几岁的女兽人，身上布满可怕的伤口，就算是再强壮十倍的男人也难免一死。 艾姆戈内心的恶心感压制了疯狂，他用尽全身力气把内布-克森放开。宝刀被抛到空中，随着一声不和谐的鸣响，旋转着埋进了雪堆里。又羞又怕的艾姆戈逃离现场，拉起斗篷的兜帽隐藏自己，不愿面对初升的太阳。 艾姆戈·格洛-凯拉谋杀同族的一幕令人毛骨悚然。脖子以下的尸身皮肤残破，烂到几乎无法辨认，但脸部却没有一丝伤痕，永远凝固着极度恐惧的表情。 就在此地，谢尔格拉举行了召唤玛拉凯斯的仪式，两位迪德拉君王在被虐杀至死的尸体前会面了。 “你给我看这作甚，疯子？”玛拉凯斯从无言的愤怒中醒过神来。“看我为孩儿被杀感到悲伤就让你这么高兴吗？”他声音沉闷，奥辛莫的守护神用指责的眼神怒视自己的对头。 谢尔格拉神情举止也很严肃：“被遗弃的兄弟啊，按血统，她确实是你的孩子。但从行为习惯看，她也算我的女儿。我的悲愤不会比你少上分毫。” 玛拉凯斯嘟囔道：“那可不一定，但我肯定要自己去为这罪行复仇。你不要掺和进来。靠边。”可怕的君王从他身边挤过去时，谢尔格拉又发话了。“我无意妨碍你报仇。我其实是想帮你。我在这片荒野有仆人，可以告诉你在哪里找到我们共同的仇人。我只要求你用我的武器去杀掉犯人，好把他流放到我的领域，到那里我自有手段惩罚他。而在这里进行荣誉谋杀的权利归你了。” 玛拉凯斯同意了，从谢尔格拉手中拿过弯刀，走了。 玛拉凯斯出现在凶手的行进路线上，那披着斗篷的身影在暴雪吹起的雾气中模糊不清。玛拉凯斯一声伴随着肮脏诅咒的怒吼，令四周树木尽皆枯萎。他拔出刀来，迅如野狐般冲了过去。怒火中烧之下，他一刀挥出了一道流畅的弧线，干脆利落地砍下仇人的头颅，然后一刀插进胸膛，鲜血喷涌，鳞甲和厚重的披风被不断染红。 玛拉凯斯因自己的杀戮出乎意料的直接愤怒而喘着气，跪在地上，他面前的尸体沉重地向后倒去，头颅闷声落在一块又宽又平的石头上。 下一个声音像晴天霹雳一样打破了寂静。 “我--我很抱歉……” 艾姆戈·格洛-凯拉结结巴巴地说道。玛拉凯斯瞪大眼，看着被自己砍下的头颅。头颅不断有鲜血从伤口渗出，却奇迹地活了下来。他的眼睛疯狂地转来转去，试图把注意力集中在眼前的玛拉凯斯身上。这位勇士曾经傲然的眼睛中噙满了悲苦迷茫的泪水。 玛拉凯斯这才惊恐地意识到，他所杀的人不但是他的奥辛莫子民，更是他多年前赐予兽人少女的儿子。两人面面相觑，在沮丧震惊中久久未能缓神。 随后，谢尔格拉像涂了油的钢铁般沉默地大步走来。他抓起艾姆戈·格洛-凯拉的首级，塞进了灰色的小袋子里，又从尸体上拔出内布-克森，转身离开。玛拉凯斯刚刚站起来，就又跪倒，他明白了，自己已经不可逆转地把自己的骨血诅咒到了谢尔格拉领域，当儿子嘶哑的哀求声渐渐消散在冰冷的地平线上时，他不禁哀悼自己的失败。

he position Shezarr enjoys in Cyrodilic worship if often misconstrued. He, and a thousand other deities, have sizeable cults in the Imperial City. Shezarr is especially venerated in the Colovian West, though he is called Shor there, as the West Kings are resolutely, and religiously, Nordic. The haziness of Shezarr's relationship to the Divines (he is often called their 'Missing Sibling') begins with St. Alessia, the so-called 'Slave Queen of Cyrodiil, the founder figure of the original Cyrodilic Empire. In the earliest Cyro-Nordic stories of the Heartland, Shezarr fought against the Ayleids (the 'Heartland Highelves') on mankind's behalf. Then, for some unknown reason, he vanishes from the stage (presumably to help other humans elsewhere), and, without his leadership, the Ayleids conquer the humans and enslave them. This slavery lasts for generations. The isolated humans eventually begin to venerate the pantheon of their masters, or at least assimilate so much of High Elven religious practices into their native traditions that the two become indistinguishable. In 1E242, under the leadership of Alessia, her demigod lover, Morihaus-Breath-of-Kyne, and the infamous Pelinal Whitestrake, the Cyrodilic humans revolt. When Skyrim lends its armies to the Slave-Queen of the South, the revolution succeeds. The Ayleid Hegemonies are quickly overthrown. Shortly thereafter, White Gold Tower is captured by Alessia's forces, and she promptly declares herself the first Empress of Cyrodiil. Part of the package meant that she had to become the High Priestess of Akatosh, as well. Akatosh was an Aldmeri god, and Alessia's subjects were as-yet unwilling to renounce their worship of the Elven pantheon. She found herself in a very sensitive political situation. She needed to keep the Nords as her allies, but they were (at that time) fiercely opposed to any adoration of Elven deities. On the other hand, she could not force her subjects to revert back to the Nordic pantheon, for fear of another revolution. Therefore, concessions were made and Empress Alessia instituted a new religion: the Eight Divines, an elegant, well-researched synthesis of both pantheons, Nordic and Aldmeri. Shezarr, as a result, had to change. He could no longer be the bloodthirsty anti-Aldmer warlord of old. He could not disappear altogether either, or the Nords would have withdrawn their support of her rule. In the end, he had become "the spirit behind all human undertaking." Even though this was merely a thinly-disguised, watered-down version of Shor, it was good enough for the Nords. As for why Tiber Septim has not attempted to 'revitalize' Shezarr during his wars against the Aldmeri Dominion, we can only speculate that, at this time, memories of the Alessian Order's follies (the Dragon Break, the War of Righteousness, the defeat at Gelnumbria Moors) would only damage his campaign for the Imperial Crown.

舍扎尔在希罗帝尔信仰中享有的地位常被误解。他与其他众多的神祇在帝都内有相当大的教派。舍扎尔在西部的科洛文地区特别受尊崇，尽管他在那儿被叫作舒尔，因为西部诸王都是坚定的“宗教诺德人”。 舍扎尔与诸圣灵间朦胧的关系（他常被称为“缺位的同胞”）始于 “希罗帝尔的奴隶女王”、原希罗帝尔帝国奠基人--圣阿莱西亚。在最古老的关于腹地的希罗-诺德传说中，舍扎尔领导人类与亚历德（腹地高精灵）作战。后出于某种未知原因，他从台面上消失了。（大概是在别处帮助人类）没有了他的领导，亚历德征服并奴役了人类。 奴役延续了几代之久，分崩离析的人类开始对他们主人的信仰加以崇敬，或至少吸收了甚多宗教习俗于本地传统中，以致二者难以区分。 1E 242，在阿莱西亚与她的半神恋人，“凯娜之息”莫里豪斯和声名狼藉的佩林纳尔的领导下，希罗帝尔人类发动了起义。当天际向南方的奴隶女王派出援军后，革命很快取得了成功，亚历德统治迅速倾覆。不久后阿莱西亚的军队占领了白金塔，她随即宣布自身为希罗帝尔首任女皇。其诸多责任中包含了她必须同时成为阿卡托什的至高祭司。 阿莱西亚发现自己处在非常敏感的时局中，阿卡托什曾是一位奥德莫神，而现在阿莱西亚的臣民仍不愿放弃对精灵神系的敬拜；但她也需要维持与坚决反对任何精灵神祇崇拜的诺德人的盟友关系。另一方面，因为担心爆发新的革命，她也不能强迫臣民们回归诺德神系。因此，阿莱西亚女皇做出让步，创立了一种新宗教：八圣灵教，一种简洁的、充分研究了诺德与奥德莫后得出的综合体。 因此，舍扎尔必须有所改变。他不能再是当初嗜血的反奥德莫领袖了，但也不能完全消失，否则诺德人就会撤回对她统治的支持。最终，他成为了“一切人类事业背后的支柱”。尽管这仅仅是一个掩饰的很肤浅的、温和版舒尔，但对诺德人来说已经足够了。 至于为何泰伯·塞普汀与先祖神洲的战争中没有尝试让舍扎尔“复活”，我们只能推测，此时任何唤醒对阿莱西亚教团的记忆（龙破、正义之战、格林纳巴荒原之战）的愚蠢行为只会损害他追求皇帝宝座的行动。

The Ritual of the Innocent Quarry, also called the Wild Hunt, is an ancient rite drawing magical energy from the powerful magicka stream that engulfs this realm. The creators and times of the rituals are long forgotten. But followed properly, the rite brings great power and prestige to the Huntsman. The ritual pits the all-powerful Huntsmen and their Greater and Lesser Dogs against the pitiful and doomed Innocent Quarry, called by tradition the Hare, after the mortal creature of human hunts. At once, the Huntsman is transported by the exquisite thrill and glory of his might and dominion over his helpless prey, and at the same time touched by the tragic, noble, and ultimately futile plight of the Innocent Quarry. In the highest aesthetic realization of the ritual, the ecstatic rapture of the kill is balanced by the Huntsman's identification with the sadness and despair of the Innocent Quarry. As in pieces the body of the innocent Hare is torn, the Huntsman reflects on the tragic imbalances of power and the cruel injustices of the world. As the Hunt begins, the Lesser Dogs assemble before the green crystal reflections of the Chapel of the Innocent Quarry. Inside the Chapel, the Huntsmen, the Greater Dogs, and the Master of the Hunt perform the rites that initiate and sanctify the Huntsmen, the Hunt, and the Innocent Quarry. Then the Huntsman emerges from the Chapel, displays the Spear of Bitter Mercy, and recites the Offices of the Hunt. The Offices describe explains the laws and conditions of the four stages of the Hunt: the Drag, the Chase, the Call, and the View to the Kill. Stage One -- The Drag, in which the Lesser Dogs drag the ground to flush out the Hare. Stage Two -- The Chase, in which the Greater Hounds drive the Hare before them. Stage Three -- The Call, in which the Greater Hounds trap the Hare and summon the Huntsmen for the kill. Stage Four -- The View, in which the Huntsman makes the kill with the ritual Spear of Bitter Mercy, and calls upon the Master of the Hunt to view the kill by ringing the town bell. The Master of the Hunt then bestows the Bounty upon the Huntsman Bold who has wielded the Spear of Bitter Mercy in the kill. The Master of the Hunt also calls upon the Huntsman Bold to name the next Hare for the next Hunt (though the Huntsman Bold himself may not participate in the next Hunt). The Offices of the Hunt, which the Huntsmen, Master, and Hounds are solemnly sworn to honor, detail the practices and conditions of the Hunt. These practices and conditions, also known as the Law, strictly define all details of the Hunt, such as how many Hounds of each sort may participate, how the Spear of Bitter Mercy may be wielded, and so forth. In addition, the Law states that the Hare must have a genuine chance to escape the Hunt, no matter how slim. In practice, this condition has been defined as the availability of six keys, which, if gathered together in the Temple of Daedric Rites, permit the Hare to teleport away from the Hunt, and so elude the Huntsman and his Spear. It is inconceivable, of course, that the Hare might actually discover the keys and escape, but the forms must be observed, and tampering with the keys or cheating the Hare of a genuine chance of finding or using the keys is a shameful and unforgivable betrayal of the Law of the Hunt. [pagebreak] 莫让任何人，在有旁观目击者在场时，道出狩猎尚未被他们召降一事的相关细节——无论是仪式的宣告所述，还是被遵守的亘古法则，均属此列。 对无辜猎物狩猎仪式又被称为“荒野狩猎”，乃是一场自席卷这个位面的强横魔力洪流中汲取奥术能量的远古仪式。其为何人何时所创，早已被漫长的历史所遗忘。但只需正确地循其道而行，仪式就将为猎手带来巨大的力量和声望。 这仪式，全能的猎人带着他们的大小走狗，追捕猎杀那可怜而命运注定的无辜猎物——按传统，称之为“脱兔”，是为人类所狩猎的致命生灵。彼时，猎手将被自身强大力量及对其无助猎物的生杀予夺所带来的激昂与荣耀所打动，但同时也会为无辜猎物的悲惨、高洁和终究徒劳的绝境深受感动。在仪式中，因终结生命而生的狂喜和对无辜猎物悲伤绝望的感同身受所达到的平衡，就是最极致的美。待无辜脱兔被撕碎，猎手也将深刻反思力量的悲剧性失衡，以及这世界的残酷不公。 于狩猎之始，小型猎犬集结，在无辜猎物圣堂的翠绿水晶倒影之前。于圣堂之中，众猎手及大型猎犬，还有那位狩猎之主将共举仪式，并祝福猎手、狩猎以及那无辜的猎物。随后，猎手从圣堂内步出亮相，展示 “苦仁之矛”，并吟唱《狩猎圣则》。圣则描述阐释了狩猎四大步骤的铁律及条件：逼近、追猎、呼唤以及见证下的杀戮。 　　 首先——逼近，以小型猎犬逼近驱赶，叫脱兔惊逃。 　　 其次——追猎，以大型猎犬群起追猎围赶，将脱兔驱至人前。 　　 再次——呼唤，以大型猎犬困住脱兔，唤猎手前来猎杀。 最末——见证，猎手以仪式上的“苦仁之矛”处决猎物，再击鸣城中巨钟，召唤狩猎之主见证其猎杀。狩猎之主随即便为仗“苦仁之矛”进行猎杀的“勇敢猎手”赐赠赏物，也会让勇敢猎手指明下一场狩猎的脱兔——尽管这位猎手本人未必会参与下一场狩猎。 狩猎圣约则是猎手、狩猎之主及猎犬们为其荣耀庄严宣誓要尊重的，详尽阐述了狩猎的践行及条件。诸如此类的践行及条件（也称“铁律”）严格界定了狩猎的一切细节，例如各种猎犬可参战多少只，“苦仁之矛”如何使用等等。此外铁律还规定，脱兔将拥有自狩猎脱逃的真正生机——不论多么渺茫。在实施时，该条件被明示确定为六把共藏于迪德拉仪式神殿中的可用之钥，它们允许脱兔自狩猎中传送离开，如此便可规避猎手及其长矛。而当然了，要脱兔当真寻得六钥并自此逃脱是不可想象的，该法则必须被遵守。而暗中篡改诸钥，或是欺瞒误导脱兔寻找或使用钥匙的真正机会，是对狩猎铁律极为可耻而不可饶恕的背叛。 狩猎仪式为猎手施加庇佑，令其可免受各种种类攻击，包括凡人或超凡的武器，以及各种魔法。然而猎手们也被警告，仪式不能自长矛的强横力量中保护他们，还被告诫称，切勿在近战搏斗、黑暗难视或其他危险情势中鲁莽地挥舞长矛，只因被“苦仁之矛”单单一触，无论无辜脱兔或是猎手同伴，皆注定瞬间身亡。 为一场荒野狩猎命名，无疑是一项庄严而崇高的权利。因为除至高迪德拉君王以外的众生，面对“苦仁之矛”的强横魔法时皆脆如薄纸。长矛本身是一柄恐怖的武器，绝不可自狩猎仪式的猎场中带出。

e who know the Old Ways are well aware of the existence of a spiritual world invisible to the unenlightened. Just as one living in a kingdom but unaware of the political machinations underneath may see a new tax or battle preparation as the caprices of fortune, many observe floods, famines, and madness with helpless incomprehension. This is deplorable. As the great Cuilean Darnizhaan moaned, "The power of ignorance can shatter ebony like glass." What, after all, is the origin of these spiritual forces that move the invisible strings of Mundus? Any neophyte of Artaeum knows that these spirits are our ancestors -- and that, while living, they too were bewildered by the spirits of their ancestors, and so on back to the original Acharyai. The Daedra and gods to whom the common people turn are no more than the spirits of superior men and women whose power and passion granted them great influence in the afterworld. Certainly this is our truth and our religion. But how does it help us in our sacred duty of seliffrnsae, or providing "grave and faithful counsel" to lesser men? Primarily, it is easy to grasp the necessity both of endowing good men with great power and making powerful men good. We recognize the multiple threats that a strong tyrant represents -- breeds cruelty which feeds the Daedra Boethiah and hatred which feeds the Daedra Vaernima; if he should die having performed a particularly malevolent act, he may go to rule in Oblivion; and worst of all, he inspires other villains to thirst after power and other rulers to embrace villainy. Knowing this, we have developed patience in our dealings with such despots. They should be crippled, humiliated, impoverished, imprisoned. Other counsellors may advocate assassination or warfare -- which, aside from its spiritual insignificance, is expensive and likely to inflict at least as much pain on the innocents as the brutish dictator. No, we are intelligence gatherers, dignified diplomats -- not revolutionaries. How, then, are our counsellors "faithful"? We are faithful only to the Old Ways -- it is essential always to remember the spiritual world while keeping our eyes open in the physical one. Performing the Rites of Moawita on the 2nd of Hearth Fire and the Vigyld on the 1st of Second Seed are essential means of empowering salutary spirits and debilitating unclean ones. How, then, are we at once faithful to those we counsel and to the Isle of Artaeum? Perhaps the sage Taheritae said it best: "In Mundus, conflict and disparity are what bring change, and change is the most sacred of the Eleven Forces. Change is the force without focus or origin. It is the duty of the disciplined Psijic ["Enlightened One"] to dilute change where it brings greed, gluttony, sloth, ignorance, prejudice, cruelty... [here Taheritae lists the rest of the 111 Prodigalities], and to encourage change where it brings excellence, beauty, happiness, and enlightenment. As such, the faithful counsel has but one master: His mind. If the man the Psijic counsels acts wickedly and brings oegnithr ["bad change"] and will otherwise not be counselled, it is the Psijic's duty to counterbalance the oegnithr by any means necessary [emphasis mine]." A student of the Old Ways may indeed ally himself to a lord -- but it is a risky relationship. It cannot be stressed enough that the choice be wisely made. Should the lord refuse wise counsel and order the Psijic (to use Taheritae's outmoded word) to perform an act contrary to the teachings of the Old Ways, there are few available options. The Psijic may obey, albeit unwillingly, and fall prey to the dark forces against which he has devoted his life. The Psijic may abandon his lord, which will bring shame on him and the Isle of Artaeum, and so may never be allowed home again. Or the Psijic may simply kill himself.

我等通晓古道之人，皆深知未蒙启迪者目不得见的精神世界确实存在。正如身居王国却不觉其背后政治阴谋之人，可能将征税或备战视作命运变幻无常，而泛泛之众面临洪涝、饥荒和疯狂之时，亦觉茫然无助。此诚可悲可叹。正似伟大的奎连·达尔尼扎安所怨诉那般，“无知之力，足可如粉碎玻璃般粉碎黑檀。” 归根结底，拨动梦达思无形之弦的精魂力量，其起源究竟为何？任何阿塔姆的新人皆知，这些精魂为我等先祖——且先祖在日，彼等亦为其先祖灵魂所惑，而如此一直上溯至源初的阿查赖。普罗大众所求助的迪德拉与诸神，不外乎是拜力量与激情所赐而在来世取得巨大影响力的卓越者的精魂罢了。 毋庸置疑，此即我等所奉真理，我等所抱信仰。但其又如何相助于我等塞黎夫尔尼的神圣职责，为平凡者提供“严肃而忠实的劝告”呢？ 首先，赋予称义者以权势和令拥权者称义的必要性不必多言。我们深知强大的暴君意味着什么威胁--彼所滋生残暴邪行，温养迪德拉波耶西亚；彼所激发憎恶仇恨，助长迪德拉瓦尔迷纳；若他于崩殂前曾作惨绝人寰之举，则他或将握权于湮灭。最为可怖的，乃是他将鼓动其他恶徒渴求权柄，并令其他治人者欣然拥抱罪恶。正因如此，我等便在与暴君打交道之时自有耐心之法。彼等应受致残瘸瘫、辱骂唾弃、一贫如洗、陷身牢狱之苦。其他顾问乐得倡导暗杀或战争——然此不仅于精神上无足轻重，且代价高昂，对无辜大众造成痛苦并未少于暴虐独夫。非也，我等为集智之人、高贵的外交官——而非革命者。 如此，我等顾问又如何能“忠诚”呢？我等仅忠于古道--身在物质界，心念精神界，这至关重要。于炉火月2日所行莫瓦塔仪式，和于次种月首日所行的维吉尔德仪式，是裨益灵魂、涤除邪祟的重要手段。如此，我等又如何既忠于我们谏言之人，又忠于阿塔姆呢？贤者塔赫黎特所言最是贴切：“于梦达思，冲突与差异带来变化，而变化正是十一力中至圣者。变化乃无焦无源之力。戒律严明的赛伊克 （“通晓者”） 之职责，即稀释诸般招致贪婪、暴食、懒惰、无知、偏见、残忍……（于此，塔赫黎特列举111种罪业）的变化，而鼓励倡导引致卓越、美丽、幸福及启迪的变化。因而，忠实的顾问只有一主：自己的思想。如若赛伊克所建言者品行不端、招致奥格尼瑟（“坏变化”），则不可继续进言，赛伊克有责以任何必要之手段来制衡奥格尼瑟（此为我等关键职责）。” 古道门生自可与君王缔盟——但这是危险之举。身为赛伊克应当明智抉择，这一信条再怎么强调也不为过。但如若君王拒绝明谏，又命赛伊克（以塔赫黎特所用陈词旧句而言之）行背逆古道教义之举，则只能让赛伊克陷入两难之境。赛伊克虽觉违心，或将从之，从此堕入黑暗并放弃坚持一生的信仰。或背主而去，使其与阿塔姆岛蒙羞，因而被永远驱逐。或干脆自刎了却。

One of the earliest recorded dates, in fact, is the Fall of White Gold Tower in 1E 243, which is commonly assumed to mark the end of the Ayleids. Although Ayleid rule over all of Cyrodiil was indeed broken in 1E 243, this was only one of the most obvious stages near the end of a long decline. The first two centuries of the First Era saw increasing strife between the great Ayleid lords of Cyrodiil. Alessia appears to have taken advantage of a period of civil war to launch her uprising. Imperial historians have traditionally attributed her victory to intervention from Skyrim, but it appears that she had at least as much help from rebel Ayleid lords during the siege of White Gold Tower. The popular image of the Ayleids as brutal slavemasters is based in fact, of course, but it is less well-known that a number of Ayleid princes continued to rule parts of Cyrodiil after 263, as vassals of the new Empress of Cyrodiil. This suggests either that Ayleid rule was not universally detested, or that Alessia and her successors were more pragmatic than is traditionally believed, or perhaps some of both. In any event, excavations at a number of Ayleid sites show continued occupation and even expansion during the so-called Late Ayleid Period (1E 243 - c. 498). At first, many Ayleid lords continued to rule as vassals of the new human regime. In some cases, Ayleid supporters of Alessia were even rewarded with new lands taken from slain enemies. It is not clear to what extent human slavery continued under the Cyrodilic Empire. Humans continued to dwell in the Ayleid-ruled areas of Cyrodiil, but there is nothing definitive to show under what terms. This was an uneasy relationship from the beginning, and was not destined to last long. Resentment at the continued presence of Ayleid nobles within the Empire was a contributing factor to the rise of the so-called Alessian Order founded by Maruhk. The first victims of the Alessians were the Ayleids of Cyrodiil. In the early 300s, the surviving Ayleid communities in human-ruled areas were obliterated one by one, the refugees temporarily swelling the power of the remaining Ayleid lordships. Then in 361, the Alessians gained control of the Empire and enforced the Alessian Doctrines throughout its domain. The Ayleid lordships were abolished. Enforcement of this decree does not appear to have required much direct violence -- it seems that by this point the balance of power was so overwhelmingly against them, and their fate so long foreshadowed, that most of the remaining Ayleids simply left Cyrodiil, eventually being absorbed into the Elven populations of Valenwood and High Rock. How this king's people survived the preceding century is unknown. We do not even know who they were, although recent research points to Nenalata as the possible resting place of this "last king." aving arrived at Gottlesfont Priory, halfway on the Gold Road between Skingrad and the Imperial City, I resolved to make a side trip to view the magnificent ruins of Ceyatatar, or "Shadow of the Fatherwoods' in the ancient Ayleid tongue. After many hours of difficult travel through tangled hawthorn hells and limberlosts, I was suddenly struck dumb by the aspect of five pure white columns rising from a jade-green mound of vines to perfect V-shaped arches and graceful capitals towering above the verdant forest growth. This spectacle caused me to meditate on the lost glories of the past, and the melancholy fate of high civilizations now poking like splinter shards of bone from the green-grown tumulus of time-swept obscurity. Within the forest tangle I discovered an entrance leading down into the central dome of a great underground edifice once dedicated to Magnus, the God of Sight, Light, and Insight. Dimly lit by the faded power of its magical pools, the shattered white walls of the enclosure shimmered with a cold blue light. The marble benches of the central plaza faced out across the surrounding waters to tall columns and sharp arches supporting the high dome. From the central island, stately bridges spanned the still pools to narrow walkways behind the columns, with broad vaulted avenues and limpid canals leading away through ever-deeping gloom into darkness. Reflected in the pools were the tumbled columns, collapsed walls, and riotous root and vine growth thriving the dark half-light of the magical fountains. The ancient Ayleids recognized not the four elements of modern natural philosophy -- earth, water, air, and fire -- but the four elements of High Elf religion -- earth, water, air, and light. The Ayleids considered fire to be but a weak and corrupt form of light, which Ayleid philosophers identified with primary magical principles. Thus their ancient subterranean temples and sanctuaries were lit by lamps, globes, pools, and fountains of purest magic. It was by these ancient, faded, but still active magics that I knelt and contemplated the departed glories of the long-dead Ayelid architects. Gazing through the glass-smooth reflections of the surrounding pools, I could see, deep below, the slow pulse, the waxing and waning of the Welkynd stones. The chiefest perils of these ruins to the explorer are the cunning and deadly mechanisms devised by the Ayleids to torment and confound those would invade their underground sanctuaries. What irony that after these many years, these devices should still stand vigilant against those who would admire the works of the Ayleids. For it is clear... these devices were crafted in vain. They did not secure the Ayleids against their true enemies, which were not the slaves who revolted and overthrew their cruel masters, nor the were they the savage beast peoples who learned the crafts of war and magic from their Ayleid masters. No, it was the arrogant pride of their achievements, their smug self-assurance that their empire would last forever, that doomed them to fail and fade into obscurity.

he Isle of Artaeum (ar-TAY-um) is the third largest island in the Summurset archipelago, located south of the Moridunon village of Potansa and west of the mainland village of Runcibae. It is best known for being home to the Psijic Order, perhaps the oldest monastic group in Tamriel. The earliest written record of Psijics is from the 20th year of the First Era and tells the tale of the renowned Breton sage and author Voernet, traveling to the Isle of Artaeum to meet with Iachesis, the Ritemaster of the Psijics. Even then, the Psijics were the counsellors of kings and proponents of the "Elder Way," taught to them by the original race that inhabited Tamriel. The Elder Way is a philosophy of meditation and study said to bind the forces of nature to the individual will. It differs from magicka in origin, but the effects are much the same. That said, it is perhaps more than coincidence that the Isle of Artaeum literally vanished from the shores of Summurset at the beginning of the Second Era at about the time of the founding of the Mages Guild in Tamriel. Various historians and scholars have published theories about this, but perhaps none but Iachesis and his own could shed light on the matter. Five hundred years passed and Artaeum returned. The Psijics on the Isle consisted of persons, mostly Elves, who had disappeared and were presumed dead in the Second Era. They could not or would not offer any explanation for Artaeum's whereabouts during that time, or the fate of Iachesis and the original council of Artaeum. Currently, the Psijics are led by the Loremaster Celarus, who has presided over the Council of Artaeum for the last two hundred and fifty years. The Council's influence in Tamrielan politics is tidal. The kings of Sumurset, particularly those of Moridunon, have often sought the Psijics' opinion. Emperor Uriel V was much influenced by the Council in the early, most glorious parts of his reign, before his disastrous attack on Akavir. It has even been suggested that the fleet of King Orghum of Pyandonea was destroyed by a joint effort of Emperor Antiochus and the Psijic Order. The last four emperors, Uriel VI, Morihatha, Pelagius IV, and Uriel VII, have been suspicious of the Psijics enough to refuse ambassadors from the Isle of Artaeum within the Imperial City. I have been to the Isle once and still dream of its idyllic orchards and clear pastures, its still and silent lagoons, its misty woodlands, and the unique Psijic architecture that seems to be as natural as its surroundings as well as wondrous in its own right. Perhaps one day I might return. Note: The author is currently on the Isle of Artaeum by gracious consent of Master Sargenius of the Council of Artaeum.

[pagebreak]

阿塔姆岛（发音为ar-TAY-um），是夏暮群岛的第三大岛，位于波坦萨的莫里度诺村南侧、大陆的朗希巴村西侧。以其为赛伊克教团所在地而闻名。赛伊克教团可能是全泰姆瑞尔最为古老的修士团体。 关于赛伊克的最早的书面记载是第一纪20年代间的一则故事，描述德高望重的布莱顿贤者兼作家沃尔奈特，他南旅阿塔姆岛拜访赛伊克教团的时任仪式大师——艾克西斯。 彼时的赛伊克已是诸王的顾问，还是一群 “古道”的支持者。那是泰姆瑞尔的原住种族教授给他们的冥想与研究的哲学，据说是将自然力量与个人意志相结合。它与魔力起源不同，但效果相近。 　　 在第二纪元开始时，阿塔姆岛如字面意思所述的那样从夏暮岛海岸线处消隐无踪了，而同期发生了法师公会在泰姆瑞尔大陆建立这件大事，这可能并非巧合。无数史家和学者就此事提出各种各样的理论假说，但可能除艾克西斯本人外无人能阐明此事的真相。 五百年过去，阿塔姆岛回来了。岛上那群多数由精灵组成的赛伊克法师均在第二纪元消隐无踪，并被那时的世人推定已然死亡。他们不能或是不想就这段空白期内阿塔姆岛的下落、或是艾克西斯和阿塔姆最初的议会的命运给出任何解释。 目前，赛伊克由博学大师凯勒瑞斯领导。他在过去250年里主持着阿塔姆议会。议会对泰姆瑞尔政局造成的影响时有起伏。夏暮岛诸王，特别是莫里度诺的几位，时常问政于赛伊克。皇帝尤瑞尔五世在位早期，也就是他开展对阿卡维尔的那次灾难性远征之前的黄金期，就受益于议会的巨大影响。甚至有流言称，派安多尼亚之王奥格哈姆的舰队其实是被安条克皇帝和赛伊克联合击破的。但最近四任皇帝——尤瑞尔六世、莫里哈萨、佩拉吉奥斯四世和尤瑞尔七世，却对赛伊克持怀疑态度，乃至拒绝阿塔姆岛使节进驻帝都。 很难在地理图册上标注阿塔姆岛的所在点。传闻其确切位置始终在变迁，或是出于随机性，或是出于议会的号令。罕有访客能真的登岛，甚至基本没多少确凿的登陆记载。任何人如想拜会赛伊克，都可以去波坦萨、朗希巴，以及夏暮群岛诸国寻得他们的对外联络人。 如果真的能轻易抵达，那阿塔姆必然成为游客们的首选。我曾一度登岛，现今仍能在梦中走过那有如田园诗中描绘的百果园、旷人心胸的牧野、依然静谧的泻湖、山雾缭绕的林场，还有那独树一帜的赛伊克风格建筑，它看起来拥有和周围环境融为一体般的自然，却又有自身的奇妙之处。岛上的塞波拉塔是我探求的重点对象，因为它是某个文明的遗迹，其起源比高精灵还要早几百年，至今仍用于赛伊克的某些仪式。或许未来某一天我会回到那里加以探索。 注：作者目前在阿塔姆岛上——由阿塔姆议会的萨尔格纽斯大师热情地迎允他登岛。

The Five Songs of King Wulfharth

[pagebreak]

Shor's Tongue he first song of King Wulfharth is ancient, circa 1E500. After the defeat of the Alessian army at Glenumbria Moors, where King Hoag Merkiller was slain, Wulfharth of Atmora was elected by the Pact of Chieftains. His thu'um was so powerful that he could not verbally swear into the office, and scribes were used to draw up his oaths. Immediately thereafter the scribes wrote down the first new law of his reign: a fiery reinstatement of the traditional Nordic pantheon. The Edicts were outlawed, their priests put to the stake, and their halls set ablaze. The shadow of King Borgas had ended for a span. For his zealotry, King Wulfharth was called Shor's Tongue, and Ysmir, Dragon of the North. [pagebreak] Kyne's Son The second song of King Wulfharth glorifies his deeds in the eyes of the Old Gods. He fights the eastern Orcs and shouts their chief into Hell. He rebuilds the 418th step of High Hrothgar, which had been damaged by a dragon. When he swallowed a thundercloud to keep his army from catching cold, the Nords called him the Breath of Kyne. [pagebreak] Old Knocker he third song of King Wulfharth tells of his death. Orkey, an enemy god, had always tried to ruin the Nords, even in Atmora where he stole their years away. Seeing the strength of King Wulfharth, Orkey summoned the ghost of Alduin Time-Eater again. Nearly every Nord was eaten down to six years old. Boy Wulfharth pleaded to Shor, the dead Chieftain of the Gods, to help his people. Shor's own ghost then fought the Time-Eater on the spirit plane, as he did at the beginning of time, and he won, and Orkey's folk, the Orcs, were ruined. As Boy Wulfharth watched the battle in the sky he learned a new thu'um, What Happens When You Shake the Dragon Just So. He used this new magic to change his people back to normal. In his haste to save so many, though, he shook too many years out on himself. He grew older than the Greybeards, and died. The flames of his pyre were said to have reached the hearth of Kyne itself. [pagebreak] The Ash King he fourth song of King Wulfharth tells of his rebirth. The Dwarves and Devils of the eastern kingdoms had started to fight again, and the Nords hoped they might reclaim their ancient holdings there because of it. They planned an attack, but then gave up, knowing that they had no strong King to lead them. Then in walked the Devil of Dagoth, who swore he came in peace. Moreover, he told the Nords a wondrous thing: he knew where the Heart of Shor was! Long ago the Chief of the Gods had been killed by Elven giants, and they ripped out Shor's Heart and used it as a standard to strike fear into the Nords. This worked until Ysgramor Shouted Some Sense and the Nords fought back again. Knowing that they were going to lose eventually, the Elven giants hid the Heart of Shor so that the Nords might never have their God back. But here was the Devil of Dagoth with good news! The Dwarves and Devils of the eastern kingdom had his Heart, and this was the reason for their recent unrest. The Nords asked the Devil of Dagoth why he might betray his countrymer so, and he said that the Devils have betrayed each other since the beginning of time, and this was so, and so the Nords believed him. The Tongues sung Shor's ghost into the world again. Shor gathered an army as he did of old, and then he sucked in the long-strewn ashes of King Wulfharth and remade him, for he needed a good general. But the Devil of Dagoth petitioned to be that general, too, and he pointed out his role as the blessed harbinger of this holy war. So Shor had two generals, the Ash King and the Devil of Dagoth, and he marched on the eastern kingdoms with all the sons of Skyrim. [pagebreak] Red Mountain he fifth song of King Wulfharth is sad. The survivors of the disaster came back under a red sky. That year is called Sun's Death. The Devil of Dagoth had tricked the Nords, for the Heart of Shor was not in the eastern kingdoms, and had never been there at all. As soon as Shor's army had got to Red Mountain, all the Devils and Dwarves fell upon them. Their sorcerers lifted the mountain and threw it onto Shor, trapping him underneath Red Mountain until the end of time. They slaughtered the sons of Skyrim, but not before King Wulfharth killed King Dumalacath the Dwarf-Orc, and doomed his people. Then Vehk the Devil blasted the Ash King into Hell and it was over. Later, Kyne lifted the ashes of the ashes of Ysmir into the sky, saving him from Hell and showing her sons the color of blood when it is brought by betrayal. And the Nords will never trust another Devil again. [pagebreak]

The Secret Song of Wulfharth Ash-King

[pagebreak]

The Truth at Red Mountain he Heart of Shor was in Resdayn, as Dagoth-Ur had promised. As Shor's army approached the westernmost bank of the Inner Sea, they stared across at Red Mountain, where the Dwemeri armies had gathered. News from the scouts reported that the Chimeri forces had just left Narsis, and that they were taking their time joining their cousins against the Nords. Dagoth-Ur said that the Tribunal had betrayed their King's trust, that they sent Dagoth-Ur to Lorkhan (for that is what they called Shor in Resdayn) so that the god might wreak vengeance on the Dwarves for their hubris; that Nerevar's peace with the Dwemer would be the ruin of the Velothi way. This was the reason for the slow muster, Dagoth-Ur said. [pagebreak] The Armies Grow And Lorkhan (for that is what they called Shor in Resdayn) said: "I do not wreak vengeance on the Dwarves for the reasons that the Tribunal might believe I do. Nevertheless, it is true that they will die by my hand, and any whoever should side with them. This Nerevar is the son of Boethiah, one of the strongest Padomaics. He is a hero to his people despite his Tribunal, and he shall muster enough that this battle will be harder going still. We will need more than what we have." And so Dagoth-Ur, who wanted the Dwarves as dead as the Tribunal did, went to Kogoran and summoned his House chap'thil, his nix-hounds, his wizards, archers, his stolen men of brass. And the Ash King, Wulfharth, hoary Ysmir, went and made peace with the Orcs in spite of his Nordic blood, and they brought many warriors but no wizards at all. Many Nords could not bring themselves to ally with their traditional enemies, even in the face of Red Mountain. They were close to desertion. Then Wulfharth said: "Don't you see where you really are? Don't you know who Shor really is? Don't you know what this war is?" And they looked from the King to the God to the Devils and Orcs, and some knew, really knew, and they are the ones that stayed. [pagebreak] The Doom Drum Nerevar carried Keening, a dagger made of the sound of the shadow of the moons. His champions were Dumac Dwarfking, who carried a hammer of divine mass, and Alandro Sul, who was the immortal son of Azura and wore the Wraith Mail. They met Lorkhan at the last battle of Red Mountain. Lorkhan had his Heart again, but he had long been from it, and he needed time. Wulfharth met Sul but could not strike him, and he fell from grievous wounds, but not before shouting Sul blind. Dagoth-Ur met Dumac and slew him, but not before Sunder struck his lord's Heart. Nerevar turned away from Lorkhan and struck down Dagoth-Ur in rage, but he took a mortal wound from Lorkhan in turn. But Nerevar feigned the death that was coming early and so struck Lorkhan with surprise on his side. The Heart had been made solid by Sunder's tuning blow and Keening could now cut it out. And it was cut out and Lorkhan was defeated and the whole ordeal was thought over.

武夫哈斯王的五首歌

[pagebreak]

舒尔的喉舌 武夫哈斯王的第一歌年代久远，大约在1E500年。阿莱西亚军在格林纳巴荒野被击败时，“精灵杀手”霍格王战死沙场，阿特莫拉的武夫哈斯被酋长联盟选为新王。他的吐'目强悍如斯，以至于无法开口宣誓就任，而由文员为他起草了书面的誓约。此后，文员们立刻写下了他继任后的第一项法令：恢复诺德的传统信仰。法令极其严酷，祭司们被处以火刑，神殿被付之一炬。博加斯王的阴影一时之内消失无踪。因其狂热信仰，武夫哈斯王被呼为“舒尔喉舌”、“伊斯米尔”、“北方巨龙”。 [pagebreak] 凯娜之子 武夫哈斯王的第二歌颂扬了他在古神注视下的功绩。他与东方的兽人交战，把他们的首领吼入地狱。他重建了被龙损毁的霍斯加第418级台阶。当他口吞雷云让军队免于寒凉之时，诺德人将其尊为“凯娜之息”。 [pagebreak] 古老敲击者 武夫哈斯王的第三歌讲述了他的死亡。敌神奥凯，始终想要毁灭诺德人，甚至在阿特莫拉偷走了他们的寿命。看到武夫哈斯王的强大力量，奥凯再度召唤了“时间吞噬者”奥杜因的幽灵。所有诺德人都被吃到了六岁大小。变成孩童的武夫哈斯恳求已死的众神之首舒尔帮助他的子民。舒尔自己的灵魂随后在精魂位面与“时间吞噬者”大战，一如时间初始时的一般，舒尔获得了胜利，奥凯的兽人子民则被毁灭。小武夫哈斯注视着天上的战斗，学会了新的吐'目，如此这般去震撼龙神。他用这新的魔法把族人变回了正常。然而他急于拯救更多人，以致浪费了自己太多的寿命，直至苍老甚于灰胡子，最后死去。据说他葬礼的柴堆燃起的大火足以媲美凯娜的炉火。 [pagebreak] 灰烬之王 武夫哈斯王的第四歌叙述了他的重生。东方诸国的矮人与恶魔爆发了战争，诺德人希望他们能借机夺回他们那里的古老领地。他们本打算发动进攻，却因没有强大的王者统领而放弃。此时，恶魔达格斯走来，发誓自己并无恶意。此外，他告诉诺德人一件有趣的事，他知道舒尔的心脏藏在何处！很久以前，众神之首被精灵巨人所杀，心脏亦被取走，以此向诺德人制造恐惧。这招奏效了，直到伊斯格拉默呼吼真理，诺德人才卷土重来。精灵巨人们知道他们最终会输，于是把舒尔的心藏了起来，这样诺德人就永远无法夺回自己的神。可恶魔达格斯带来了好消息！东方诸国的矮人和恶魔拥有他的心，而这也是他们最近动荡纷争的原因。诺德人问恶魔达格斯，为何背叛同胞，他说，恶魔自来互相背叛，事实就是如此，诺德人相信了。发声者们又将舒尔的幽灵唤至人间。舒尔像以前一样召集了军队，又吸来武夫哈斯王长年飘散的骨灰，重新塑造，担当军队的大将。此时舒尔有了两位将军，灰烬之王和恶魔达格斯，他带着所有天际之子进军东方诸国。 [pagebreak] 红山 武夫哈斯王的第五歌是悲哀的。灾难的幸存者们在一片红天下回来。是年被称为“日之死”。恶魔达格斯欺骗了诺德人，因为舒尔的心脏根本不在东方诸国。舒尔的军队刚刚抵达红山，所有恶魔和矮人就向他们扑来。他们的巫师举起山峰将舒尔困在红山之下，直到时间的尽头。他们屠杀了天际之子，但在此之前，武夫哈斯王杀死了“矮兽人”杜马克王，以及他的族人。恶魔维克将灰烬之王扔进地狱，一切都结束了。回来后凯娜将伊斯米尔的灰烬带向天空，把他从地狱拯救出来，让她的孩子们看到了背叛带来的血色。诺德人自此再也不会相信恶魔了。 [pagebreak]

灰烬之王武夫哈斯的秘之歌

[pagebreak]

红山的真相 正如达格斯·乌尔所言，舒尔的心脏就在瑞斯戴恩。当舒尔的军队逼近内海最西端时，他们凝视着矮人大军集结的红山。斥候来报，说凯莫军队刚刚离开纳西斯，正在慢慢加入他们的族人，打算对抗诺德人。达格斯·乌尔说，审判席辜负了王的信任，他们把达格斯·乌尔送去见洛克汗（瑞斯戴恩如此称呼舒尔），这样，神就可以让矮人的傲慢付出代价。尼瑞瓦与锻莫的和平将会毁灭维洛锡之道。达格斯·乌尔说，这就是集结缓慢的原因。 [pagebreak] 军队壮大 洛克汗（瑞斯戴恩如此称呼舒尔）说：“我不会向矮人复仇，虽然审判席觉得我会如此。然而他们确实会命丧我手，任何支持他们的人都要死。尼瑞瓦是波耶西亚之子，波耶西亚又是最强的帕多梅之一。他是那审判席人民的英雄，他会聚集足够的战力，战争也会因此而变得艰难。我们需要更多人。”于是，和审判席一样希望矮人灭亡的达格斯·乌尔前往寇戈兰，召集他家族的战士、尼克斯犬、巫师、弓箭手，还有他偷来的黄铜人。灰烬之王武夫哈斯，古老的伊斯米尔，不顾自己的诺德血统，前去与兽人讲和，带来许多战士，却没有巫师。即便面对红山，许多诺德人也无法与他们长年的敌人结盟。他们几近出逃。而武夫哈斯说道：“难道你们不知身处何地吗？难道你们不知舒尔是谁吗？难道你们不知这场战争意味着什么吗？”他们看着王、神以及恶魔和兽人，有些人明白了，选择留了下来。 [pagebreak] 末日之鼓 尼瑞瓦手持哀鸣，那是用月影之声制成的匕首。他的勇士是手持圣锤的矮人王杜马克，还有阿祖拉的不朽之子，身穿幽魂链甲的阿兰德罗·苏。他们在红山决战中遇到了洛克汗。洛克汗重新拥有了心脏，但由于分离过久，需要时间适应。武夫哈斯与苏大战，却奈何不得，最终重伤倒地，但他也弄瞎了苏的眼睛。达格斯·乌尔遇到杜马克并将其击杀，但裂解却击中了他主人的心脏。尼瑞瓦丢开洛克汗，愤怒地杀死了达格斯·乌尔，但反过来也被洛克汗重伤濒死。但尼瑞瓦却诈死，趁洛克汗不备侧击得手。心脏被裂解的调音一击固化，然后被哀鸣切下。由于心脏被切除，洛克汗被打败，整个考验功亏一篑。

s their name suggests, the Dark Brotherhood has a history shrouded in obfuscation. Their ways are secret to those who are not themselves Brothers of the Order ("Brother" is a generic term; some of their deadliest assassins are female, but they are often called Brothers as well). How they continue to exist in shadow, but be easily found by those desperate enough to pay for their services, is not the least of the mysteries surrounding them. The Dark Brotherhood sprang from a religious order, the Morag Tong, during the Second Era. The Morag Tong were worshippers of the Daedra spirit Mephala, who encouraged them to commit ritual murders. In their early years, they were as disorganized as only obscure cultists could be-there was no one to lead the band, and as a group they dared not murder anybody of any importance. This changed with the rise of the Night Mother. All leaders of the Morag Tong, and then afterward the Dark Brotherhood, have been called the Night Mother. Whether the same woman (if it is even a woman) has commanded the Dark Brotherhood since the Second Era is unknown. What is believed is that the original Night Mother developed an important doctrine of the Morag Tong-the belief that, while Mephala does grow stronger with every murder committed in her name, certain murders were better than others. Murders that came from hate pleased Mephala more than murders committed because of greed. Murders of great men and women pleased Mephala more than murders of relative unknowns. We can approximate the time this belief was adopted with the first known murder committed by the Morag Tong. In the year 324 of the Second Era, the Potentate Versidue-Shaie was murdered in his palace in what is today the Elsweyr kingdom of Senchal. In a brash move, the Night Mother announced the identity of the murderers by painting "MORAG TONG" on the walls in the Potentate's own blood. Previous to that, the Morag Tong existed in relative peace, more or less like a witches' coven-occasionally persecuted but usually ignored. In remarkable synchronicity at a time when Tamriel the Arena was a fractured land, the Morag Tong was outlawed throughout the continent. Every sovereign gave the cult's elimination his highest priority. Nothing more was officially heard of them for a hundred years. It is more difficult to date the Era when the Morag Tong re-emerged as the Dark Brotherhood, especially as other guilds of assassins have sporadically appeared throughout the history of Tamriel. The first mention of the Dark Brotherhood that I have found is from the journals of the Blood Queen Arlimahera of Hegathe. She spoke of slaying her enemies by her own hand, or if necessary "with the help of the Night Mother and her Dark Brotherhood, the secret arsenal my family has employed since my grandfather's time." Arlimahera wrote this in 2E412, so one can surmise that the Dark Brotherhood had been in existence since at least 360 if her grandfather had truly made use of them. The important distinction between the Dark Brotherhood and the Morag Tong was that the Brotherhood was a business as much as it was a cult. Rulers and wealthy merchants used the order as an assassin's guild. The Brotherhood gained the obvious rewards of a profitable enterprise, as well as the secondary benefit that rulers could no longer actively persecute them: They were needed. They were purveyors of an essential commodity. Even an extremely virtuous leader would be unwise to mistreat the Brotherhood. Not long after Alimahera's journal entry came perhaps the most famous series of executions in the history of the Dark Brotherhood. The Colovian Emperor-Potentate Savirien-Chorak and every one of his heirs were murdered on one bloody night in Sun's Dawn in 430. Within a fortnight, the Colovian Dynasty crumbled, to the delight of its enemies. For over four hundred years, until the advent of the Warrior Emperor Tiber Septim, chaos reigned over Tamriel. 第三纪元第一世纪的智者蒙托凯写道： 3E127年 伊奇达格战役结束，尤瑞尔·塞普汀三世皇帝被俘，在送往其舅父在落锤基拉尼王国的城堡途中，死于愤怒的暴民之手。其舅父塞弗鲁斯宣布成为皇帝，并策马赶往帝都。忠于皇帝尤瑞尔与狼后波特玛母子的军队，现在也宣誓效忠新皇。作为回报，天际、高岩、落锤、夏暮岛、威伦森林、黑沼泽和晨风的贵族们从帝国那里得到了新的独立与自治权。红钻战争结束。 波特玛仍在负隅顽抗，但影响力越来越小，直到只剩下独孤王国仍在掌控中。她召唤迪德拉为她作战，并让麾下的死灵法师把战死的军队复活成亡灵战士，并且不断攻击她的两个弟弟，皇帝塞弗鲁斯·塞普汀一世和利尔莫斯王玛格努斯的军队。因为她日渐疯狂，盟友们也开始远离，她战友只剩下长年累月攒下的僵尸和骷髅。独孤王国变成了一片死亡之地。古老的狼后被腐烂的骷髅女佣侍候，并与吸血鬼将军们制定战争计划的故事，吓坏了她的臣民。 3E137年 玛格努斯打开了房间的小窗户。几周以来，他第一次听到属于城市的声音：大车吱呀作响，马蹄踢踢踏踏，还有孩子的笑声传来。他微笑着回到床边，洗漱更衣。有人敲响了房门。 “进来吧，佩儿。”他说道。 佩拉吉奥斯走进房间。显然他已经起床很久了。玛格努斯对他的精力感到惊奇，也很好奇，如果让一个十二岁的孩子来领导战争，那还能持续多久。 “您看外面了吗？”佩拉吉奥斯问，“所有镇民都回来了！商店都开门了，还有法师公会，港口有好多从各地来的船，有一百艘！” “他们都不再害怕了。我们已经解决了所有和他们为邻的僵尸和鬼魂，他们知道安全了，自然就回来了。” “塞弗鲁斯伯父死后会变成僵尸吗？”佩拉吉奥斯问。 “我可不会对他下手，”玛格努斯哈哈大笑，“你怎么会问这种问题？” “我听人说，他太老了，而且经常生病。”佩拉吉奥斯回答。 “他可不算老，”玛格努斯说，“他才六十岁。只比你爹我大两岁而已。” “那波特玛姑姑多大了？”佩拉吉奥斯问。 “七十了，”玛格努斯说，“没错，她是老了。还有问题吗。我得去见指挥官了，但咱们可以晚餐时候再谈。你自己玩吧，记得别闯祸啊？” “是，长官。”佩拉吉奥斯知道，他父亲必须继续围攻波特玛的城堡。等他们接管城堡并把她抓起来之后，就会搬出旅店住进城堡。佩拉吉奥斯对此并不期待。整个城镇弥漫着奇怪、甜蜜的死气，但他一靠近城堡的，就会被这种气息熏得喘不过气。就算他们把一百万朵鲜花倒在地上也驱散不了。 他花了几小时在城里游荡，给他在利尔莫斯的妹妹和母亲买了些吃的带回去。他盘算着还需要给谁买些礼物，却又被难住了。他的堂兄弟们，也就是塞弗鲁斯、安条克两位伯父，还有波特玛姑姑的孩子们全部死于战争期间，有些是战死的，有些则是因为庄稼烧毁引发的饥荒中饿死。比安吉伯母去年也已经去世。剩下的只有他、母亲、妹妹、父亲，还有身为皇帝的伯父了。虽然还有姑姑波特玛，但她肯定不作数。 他早上去法师公会的时候，本打算不进去了。那些地方总有一些奇怪的烟、水晶和旧书本，让他感到害怕。但这次，佩拉吉奥斯打算给塞弗鲁斯伯伯买个独孤城法师公会的纪念品。 一个老妇人正艰难地开门，所以佩拉吉奥斯上前帮她把门打开了。 “谢谢。”她说。 她几乎是他见过的最老的存在。脸如同一个腐烂的苹果，配上了一团乱蓬蓬的白发。他下意识地躲开了想要轻拍他脑袋的粗糙爪子。但她脖子上的一颗宝石突然引起了他的兴趣。那是一颗闪亮的黄色宝石，但里面似乎还困着什么东西。当烛光照在它上面，里面是一只四脚野兽正在踱步。 “这是灵魂石，”她说道，“里面是一只强大恶魔狼人的精魂。很久很久以前，它就被附魔了，具有魅惑他人的力量，但我一直在考虑给它施加另一个法术。也许可以让变化系施加一个锁或者护盾。”她停下，用那双阴冷发黄的研究仔细打量男孩：“孩子，你和我挺像啊。你叫什么名字啊？” 他说：“佩拉吉奥斯。”虽然他一般会说“佩拉吉奥斯王子”，但他被告诫不要在城里引人注目。 “我也认识个叫佩拉吉奥斯的人，”老妇人缓缓地微笑，“你是一个人在这儿吗，佩拉吉奥斯？” “我父亲……正带着军队进攻城堡。但等攻入城墙，他就会回来了。” “我敢说不会太久了，”老妇人叹了口气，“万事万物无论建造得多完美，也不能长久。你是来法师公会买东西的吗？” “我想给我伯父买个礼物，”佩拉吉奥斯说，“但钱可能不够。” 老妇人让男孩帮忙照看东西，自己进去找公会的附魔师。那是个年轻的诺德人，带着满怀雄心来到独孤王国。虽然价格昂贵，但老妇人没花什么口舌就劝说附魔师移除了灵魂石上面的法术，又重新注入了一个强大的诅咒。这是一种慢性毒药，会年复一年侵蚀佩戴者的心智。她还买了一个便宜的抗火戒指。 “为了感谢你对我这个老人的好意，我给你买了几样东西。”她说着将项链和戒指给了男孩，“你可以把戒指送给伯父，告诉他戒指上有悬浮法术，所以如果他需要从高处跳下去，能够得到戒指的保护。灵魂石就是送给你的了。” “谢谢您，”男孩说，“但您对我太好了。” “这和好意无关，”她很诚实地回答，“你知道吗，我去过帝国皇宫的记录大厅好几次，我在上古卷轴的预言里读到过你。总有一天，你会成为皇帝，孩子，你会成为皇帝佩拉吉奥斯·塞普汀三世，这块灵魂石会指引你，子孙后代也会永远铭记你和你的事迹。” 说完，老妇人消失在法师公会背后的小巷。佩拉吉奥斯找了一圈，却没想到要去石头后面看看。如果他找到了，就会发现一条从城里通往独孤城堡的地道。如果他走过去，就会穿过步履蹒跚的亡灵和一座昔日辉煌宫殿的断壁残垣，找到王后的卧室。 卧室里，他会发现独孤狼后正在休息，聆听着城堡陷落的声音。然后他会看到，在她咽下最后一口气前，脸上那无牙的笑容。 第三纪元第二世纪的智者因佐里克斯写道： 3E137年 波特玛·塞普汀死于城堡被围的一个月之后。生前，她是独孤狼后、皇帝佩拉吉奥斯二世之女、国王曼提亚柯之妻、皇帝金泰拉二世之姑、皇帝尤瑞尔三世之母、皇帝安条克与塞弗鲁斯之姊妹。在她死后，玛格努斯指派其子佩拉吉奥斯承袭了独孤城，并接受贵族议会的指导。 3E140年 皇帝塞弗鲁斯·塞普汀坠马而死。他的弟弟继位，是为皇帝玛格努斯·塞普汀。 3E141年 史载，独孤之王佩拉吉奥斯“偶有古怪”。他迎娶了瓦登费尔女公爵卡塔瑞亚。 3E145年 皇帝玛格努斯·塞普汀逝世。其子“疯子”佩拉吉奥斯加冕。

Varieties Of Daedra by Aranea Drethan Healer and Dissident Priest

[pagebreak]

here is little chance of our ever understanding the various orders of Daedra and their relationships to the Daedra Lords and their dominions. Of the varieties of Daedra that appear in our world, and the varieties of their relationships to their fellows and their Daedra patrons, there is no end. In one place and time they are seen to be this, and in another place and time they are seen to be the opposite, and in another place and time they are seen to be both this and that, in completely contradictory terms. What Daedra serves this Prince? What Daedra gives orders, and what Daedra serves, and in what hierarchy, and under what circumstances? What Daedra exist in fellowship with one another, and what Daedra have eternal enmity to one another, and what Daedra are solitary, or social, and by turns solitary or social? There are no limits to the varieties of behaviors that may be observed, and in one place they may be this, and in another place they may that, and all rules describing them are always found to be contradictory and in exception to others. Further, from whom may we seek answers to our questions about these orders? From mortals, who know little but what they may observe of another world? From the gods, who speak in riddles, of enigmas wrapped in mysteries, and who keep things from us, the better to preserve their dominion over us? From the Daedra themselves, who are never the models of straightforwardness or truthtelling, but rather are famous for misstatements and obfuscations? And even were the Daedra to speak the truth, how can we know if they know themselves, or that there is any truth about them that is to be known, or are all arrangements among the Daedra protean and ever subject to change? In short, what is to be known is little, and and what is to be trusted is nothing. These things being said, I shall venture to relate what I have observed and heard of the relationships of the servants of Lord Dagon in my brief service to the Telvanni Wizard Divayth Fyr, when I sought him out and offered to bring peace to the victims of corprus in his sanitarium, once the Prophecies of the Incarnate had been fulfilled, and Dagoth Ur had been destroyed, and the Blight had been banished from the island of Vvardenfell forever. Divayth Fyr told me that he, by choice, trafficked only with two Daedra Powers -- Mehrunes Dagon and Azura. Azura, he said, knew and understood all things, and declined to speak of these things, or only spoke in riddles. Mehrunes Dagon, on the other hand, out of pride, fixity of purpose, and a predictable lack of subtlety in thought, knew nothing and understood nothing, and was inclined to speak freely and without falsehood. Divayth Fyr said that Dagon's chief servants, the Dremora, were like him in pride, fixed purpose, and lack of subtlety, with the addition of the peculiar traits of honor and loyalty, both within their class and within their relationship to Lord Dagon. And Divayth Fyr said that the Dremora were ordered into clans and castes, and these clans and castes were well-defined. Individual Dremora might rise or fall in ranks, or move back and forth among clans, but only when regulated by complex oaths, and only at the will and pleasure of their Lord Dagon. The Dremora refer to themselves as 'The Kyn' ('the People'), contrasting themselves to other Daedra, whom they consider unthinking animals. The term 'kynaz' refers to a member of the Dremora race ('he of the Kyn'). The least of kyn castes are the Churls, the undistinguished rabble of the lowest rank of Dremora. Churls are obsequeous to superiors but ferociously cruel to humans and other Daedra. Next in rank are the Caitiffs, creatures of uncalculating zeal, energy without discrimination. Caitiffs are used as irregulars in the faction wars of the Daedra, as berserkers and shock troops, undisciplined and unreliable, but eager and willing. The highest of the regular rank-and file of Dremora troops are the Kynvals, warrior-knights who have distinguished themselves in battle, and shown the deliberate steadiness of potential war leaders. Above the rank and file warriors of the Churl, Caitiff, and Kynval castes are the officer castes. A Kynreeve is a clan sheriff or clan officer. Kynreeves are typically associated either with a clan fighting unit or an administrative office in the order of battle. The Kynmarcher is the lord and high officer of a Daedric citadel, outpost, or gate. A Kymarcher's command is usually associated both with a unit and with a 'fief' -- a location or territory for which he is responsible. Above the Kymarcher is the Markynaz, or 'grand duke'. A Markynaz is a lord of lords, and member of the Markyn, Mehrunes Dagon's Council of Lords. The highest rank of Dremora is the Valkynaz, or 'prince'. This warrior duke is a member of the Valkyn, Mehrunes Dagon's personal guard. The Valkynaz are rarely encountered on Tamriel; normally they remain by Mehrunes Dagon's side, or serve as commanders of operations of particular importance or interest to Dagon. Of the varieties of other Daedra I encountered while I served in Divayth Fyr's Corprusarium -- Ogrims and Golden Saints, Daedroths and Winged Twilights, Scamps and Clannfear -- there is much that might be said, but little that is helpful or reliable. I did note, however, that when Divayth Fyr sought a Daedra of a character like unto the Dremora, but of greater power, and greater inclination for independence and initiative, or solely as a master, he summoned Xivilai, who are like the Dremora in personality and temperment, except that they hate subordination, and are liable to disloyalty and betrayal when they feel they have not been treated with the proper deference and respect. The feral, beastlike Daedra like the Clannfear and the Daedroth appear in the service of many different Daedric Powers, and may represent common creatures existing like wild animals in the wildernesses of Oblivion. Other savage, semi-intelligent creatures like Scamps and Spider Daedra may also be found in the realms of various Daedra Lords. The case of the Elemental Atronachs, on the other hand, is less certain. Flame and Frost Atronachs, for example, appear to be highly intelligent, but not all varieties of Elemental Atronachs seem to be social or to have the power of speech. Divayth Fyr preferred not to summon or deal with these creatures, had little experience with them, and showed no inclination to speculate upon their nature, so I learned little about them during my time at Tel Fyr.

我们很少有机会了解迪德拉的各种社会秩序，和它们与迪德拉君主及其领地的关系。至于在我们世界中出现的各种迪德拉，以及他们与其同伴、庇护者之间关系之多样，则是无穷无尽的。在某一时间地点里，他们被认为是这样的，而在另一个时间地点里，他们却被认为与刚刚是相反的，但在别的时间地点里，他们甚至同时拥有两种自相矛盾的特点。 哪些迪德拉会服务于哪些君王？哪些迪德拉会发号施令、哪些迪德拉会服务他人，其所处的阶层、状况如何？哪些迪德拉彼此间相视莫逆，哪些迪德拉又不共戴天？哪些迪德拉是独居的、哪些是群居的、又有哪些是时而独居时而群居的？可观察到的行为之多样几乎没有穷尽，在此处可能如此，而在那里可能不同，所有描述他们的规律都显得自相矛盾、充满例外。 进一步说，对于这些秩序问题，我们又该向谁寻求答案呢？那些可能观察到另一个世界但知之甚少的凡人？那些用谜语包裹奥秘，以欺瞒维系统治的神灵？还是那些从不坦诚了当，热衷误导迷惑的迪德拉？ 即便迪德拉会说出真相，我们又怎么能知道他们是否了解自己？或者他们是否有真相可被了解？或者那些不过是迪德拉变化无常中的一部分并永无规律可言？ 简而言之，能被了解的东西很少，值得相信的东西为零。 既然说了这些话，我就大胆地讲一讲我从泰瓦尼巫师迪维斯·菲尔那里了解到的知识。当时降世者预言已应验，达格斯·乌尔被消灭，枯萎病也已被永远地逐出瓦登费尔岛。而我则找到了他并为在他疗养院内的克普瑞斯患者带来平静。在为他短暂服务的这期间，我对君主大衮仆人之间的关系有所见闻。 迪维斯·菲尔告诉我，他自己只会选择与梅鲁涅斯·大衮和阿祖拉两方迪德拉势力进行交易。 他说阿祖拉知晓所有事物，但却拒绝讨论这些，或者就只以谜语交流。 另一方面，梅鲁涅斯·大衮由于傲慢、固执且明显缺乏睿智，对一切都不知不解，却倾向于不弄虚作假，畅所欲言。 迪维斯·菲尔说，大衮的主要仆人——魔人像他一样的傲慢、固执与迟钝，并对自身等级关系和对君主大衮有着特殊的忠诚感、荣誉感。 迪维斯·菲尔说，魔人都被划分进各个定义明确的氏族和种姓中。个别魔人的升迁降黜、部族归属调动，只在复杂的誓言约束、并得到君主大衮的首肯下方可进行。 魔人用“基恩”（“民众”）来指代他们自己，同时也是将自己与其他迪德拉（他们觉得都是不会思考的动物）区分开。而术语“基纳兹”则指的是一名魔人族人（“基恩的一员”）。 基恩中最低等的种姓是下民——魔人中最低级的平庸下等民。下民们往往对上级卑躬屈膝，但却对人类和其他迪德拉残酷无情。 下民的上一级是劣民——一种无谋狂热、活力充沛的生物。在迪德拉的派系战争中，劣民们被用作狂战士与突击队一类的非正规部队，无纪律不可靠，但却又狂热好战。 魔人军队中常规级别里最高的是基恩瓦尔。他们是在战斗表现出色的战骑士，具有成为战争领袖所需的深思熟虑潜质。 在下民、劣民与基恩瓦尔这些普通战士种姓之上的，便是军官种姓了。 基恩里夫是氏族内的治安官或长官。基恩里夫一般会与一个氏族的战斗部队或战斗序列的指挥机构有关。 而基恩玛策尔是迪德拉城寨、哨站或大门的领主与高级长官。一名基恩玛策尔通常指挥位于他负责地区或领土上的部队。 在基恩玛策尔之上的便是玛基纳兹，或称“大公爵”。玛基纳兹是众主之主，也是玛基恩（梅鲁涅斯·大衮的众主议会）的一员。 魔人中最高级的便是瓦尔基纳兹，或者说是“亲王”。这些战士公爵是瓦尔基恩（梅鲁涅斯·大衮亲卫）的一员。瓦尔基纳兹很少出现在泰姆瑞尔，他们一般会守在梅鲁涅斯·大衮的身边，或是担任大衮十分看重或感兴趣的行动的指挥官。 我在迪维斯·菲尔的克普瑞斯疗养院里服务时遇过其他种类的迪德拉，如奥格瑞姆和黄金圣徒、迪德拉斯和暮光之翼、邋遢鬼和惊惧兽，可说的很多，但有益可靠的很少。 而且我注意到，当迪维斯·菲尔寻求一个与魔人性格仿佛，但更强更自主的战斗力，或者仅仅为了支配一个迪德拉时，他会召唤在性格和气质上都像魔人的希维莱，只是他们讨厌服从，且当他们觉得自己没有得到应有的尊敬时，他们便容易不忠与背叛。 而像惊惧兽、迪德拉斯这种野兽般的迪德拉，会出现在许多不同的迪德拉势力中为其服务，同时也可能代表着像野生动物一样存在于湮灭的荒地之上的普通生物。至于其他像邋遢鬼、蛛形迪德拉这样的野蛮、半智生物有可能在各迪德拉君主的领域内发现。 另外，元素侍灵的情况则不那么确定。举个例子，火焰与冰霜侍灵看起来很聪明，但并不是所有种类的元素侍灵都具有社交性或语言能力。迪维斯·菲尔不喜欢召唤或谈及这些生物，对他们了解不多，同时也没有表现出想要推测他们性质的倾向，所以我在泰尔·菲尔期间很少了解关于他们的知识。

She felt at once that he was the only man for she. When she professed her love, Nienolas just laughed. He said he loved more his ax handle and shaft. Fury gripped the Queen of the Axe, the maid Ellabeth, And her thoughts turned to pondering musings of death. In the still of the night, she kidnapped her rival And then told her choices between doom and survival. III. Lorinthyrae awoke in a house in the moors In a room lightly furnished except for three doors. he hamlet village of Lorikh was a quiet, peaceful Dwemer community nestled in the monochrome grey and tan dunes and boulders of the Dejasyte. No vegetation of any kind grew in Lorikh, though there were blackened vestiges of long dead trees scattered throughout the town. Kamdida arriving by caravan looked at her new home with despair. She was used to the forestland of the north where her father's family had haled. Here there was no shade, little water, and a great open sky. It looked like a dead land. Her mother's family took Kamdida and her younger brother Nevith in, and was very kind to the orphans, but she felt lonely in the alien village. It was not until she met an old Argonian woman who worked at the water factory that Kamdida found a friend. Her name was Sigerthe, and she said that her family had lived in Lorikh centuries before the Dwemer arrived, when it was a great and beauteous forest. "Why did the trees die?" asked Kamdida. "When there were Argonians only in this land, we never cut trees for we had no need for fuel or wooden structures such as you use. When the Dwemer came, we allowed them to use the plants as they needed them, provided they never touched the Hist, which are sacred to us and to the land. For many years, we lived peaceably. No one wanted for anything." "What happened?" "Some of your scientists discovered that distilling a certain tree sap, molding it and drying it, they could create a resilient kind of armor called resin," said Sigerthe. "Most of the trees that grew here had very thin ichor in their branches, but not the Hist. Many of them fairly glistened with sap, which made the Dwemer merchants greedy. They hired a woodsman named Juhnin to start clearing the sacred arbors for profit." The old Argonian woman looked to the dusty ground and sighed, "Of course, we Argonians cried out against it. It was our home, and the Hist, once gone, would never return. The merchants reconsidered, but Juhnin took it on his own to break our spirit. He proved one terrible, bloody day that his prodigious skill with the axe could be used against people as well as trees. Any Argonian who stood in his way was hewn asunder, children as well. The Dwemer people of Lorikh closed their doors and their ears to the cries of murder." "Horrible," gasped Kamdida. "It is difficult to explain," said Sigerthe. "But the deaths of our living ones was not nearly as horrible to us as the death of our trees. You must understand that to my people, the Hist are where we come from and where we are going. To destroy our bodies is nothing; to destroy our trees is to annihilate us utterly. When Juhnin then turned his axe on the Hist, he killed the land. The water disappeared, the animals died, and all the other life that the trees nourished crumbled and dried to dust." "But you are still here?" asked Kamdida. "Why didn't you leave?" "For us, we are trapped. I am one of the last of a dying people. Few of us are strong enough to live away from our ancestral groves, and sometimes, even now, there is a perfume in the air of Lorikh that gives us life. It will not be long until we are all gone." Kamdida felt tears welling up in her eyes. "Then I will be alone in this horrible place with no trees and no friends." 'We Argonians have an expression," said Sigerthe with a sad smile, taking Kamdida's hand. "That the best soil for a seed is found in your heart." Kamdida looked into the palm of her hand and saw that Sigerthe had given her a small black pellet. It was a seed. "It looks dead." "It can only grow in one place in all Lorikh," said the old Argonian. "Outside an old cottage in the hills outside town. I cannot go there, for the owner would kill me on sight and like all my people, I am too frail to defend myself now. But you can go there and plant the seed." "What will happen?" asked Kamdida. "Will the Hist return?" "No. But some part of their power will." That night, Kamdida stole from her house and into the hills. She knew the cottage Sigerthe had spoken of. Her aunt and uncle had told her never to go there. As she approached it, the door opened and an old but powerfully built man appeared, a mighty axe slung over his shoulder. "What are you doing here, child?" he demanded. "In the dark, I almost took you to be a lizard man." "I've lost my way in the dark," she said quickly. "I'm trying to get back to my home in Lorikh." "Be on your way then." "Do you have a candle I might have?" she asked piteously. "I've been walking in circles and I'm afraid I'll only return back here without any light." The old man grumbled and walked into his house. Quickly, Kamdida dug a hole in the dry dirt and buried the seed as deeply as she could. He returned with a lit candle. "See to it you don't come back here," he growled. "Or I'll chop you in half." He returned to his house and fire. The next morning when he awoke and opened the door, he found that his cottage was entirely sealed within an enormous tree. He picked up his axe and delivered blow and after blow to the wood, but he could never break through. He tried side chops, but the wood healed itself. He tried an upper chop followed by an under chop to form a wedge, but the wood sealed. Much time went by before someone discovered old Juhnin's emaciated body lying in front of his open door, still holding his blunted, broken axe. It was a mystery to all what he had been chopping with it, but the legend began circulating through Lorikh that Hist sap was found on the blade. Shortly thereafter, small desert flowers began pushing through the dry dirt in the town. Trees and plants newly sown began to live tolerably well, if not luxuriantly. The Hist did not return, but Kamdida and the people of Lorikh noticed that at a certain time around twilight, long, wide shadows of great, bygone trees would fill the streets and hills. 洛瑞克是一座安宁平和的锻莫社区，它建立于德亚希特单调的灰褐棕黄交错的沙丘和巨岩中。任何种类的植被在洛瑞克都难以成长，枯死的树木零落在镇上。卡米迪达乘着大篷车抵达此地，看着她的新家只觉得绝望。她习惯了和堂亲一起住在他们土生土长的北境林地里。但此处毫无树荫，水源短缺，徒有开阔的天空，却看起来一片死气沉沉。 她的表亲为她和她弟弟涅威斯接风洗尘，对这两名孤儿关怀备至，可她在这生分的村落里只感觉到孤单。直到她遇上在纯水加工厂工作的阿尔贡婆婆谢歌特，她们成了新朋友。她说在锻莫到来前，她的家族在洛瑞克居住了很久，那时此处是一座美丽的大森林。 “这些树为什么会枯死呢？”卡米迪达问。 “当年只有我们阿尔贡一族定居的时候，我们从不伐木——毕竟我们不像你们，不需要用木头烧火或是盖房。锻莫迁居于此后，我们也准许他们按需采伐植物，但不能冒犯希斯特，那对我们一族还有这片土地来说都是神圣的。在漫长的年月间，我们也都相安无事。” “然后呢？” “你们中一些学者研究发现：蒸馏特定的树液，浇铸塑形再烘干，能创造某种很有弹性的盔甲，叫做树脂，”谢歌特说，“绝大多数在此地生长的树，枝杈里都含有很稀薄的分泌液——除了希斯特。圣树的枝叶因流淌的树液而闪闪发光，这让锻莫商人变得贪婪。他们雇了个叫朱宁的伐木工，开始清伐那神圣的树木以牟取暴利。” 阿尔贡婆婆长叹着望向如今尘土飞扬的土地：“我们阿尔贡自然激烈反对。那是我们一族的家呀，希斯特一旦被毁，就永不会恢复了。商人们不得不重新考虑此事，但朱宁自行其是，继续破坏我们的信仰。在那恐怖血腥的一天，他证明了他骇人的斧技不仅能砍伐树木，还能砍伐人民。那些阻碍他的阿尔贡均被劈碎，孩童也不例外。而洛瑞克的锻莫紧闭大门，对杀戮惨叫充耳不闻。” “好恐怖，”卡米迪达倒吸一口冷气。 “虽然很难描述，”谢歌特说，“但我们死些人的威胁远不如我们的圣树之死可怕。你要明白，我族从希斯特圣树来，也终将归希斯特圣树去。于我们而言，肉体的毁灭不算什么；而毁却我们的圣树便是把我们夷族灭种。在朱宁抡起他的伐木斧劈砍希斯特圣树时，他也杀死了这方土地。水消失了，动物死绝了，受圣树所恩养的生灵都干燥破碎，化成尘土了。” “可你们怎么还在这？”卡米迪达问，“为什么不离开呢？” “我们？我们被困住了。我是最后一批垂死挣扎的人了。我们当中基本不会有谁健壮到足以脱离我等先祖流传的森林生存。就算现在，偶尔还能嗅到洛瑞克空气中残余的香味，它赋予了我等生机。但用不了多久我们就要全部消失了。” 卡米迪达感觉到眼泪涌出了自己的眼睛，“那我就将在这个可怕的地方一个人生活，没有树也没有朋友。” “我们阿尔贡有一句俗语，”谢歌特凄然而笑，牵起卡米迪达的手，“汝心所在彼方，便是育种良壤。” 卡米迪达望向掌心，看到谢歌特给了她一颗漆黑的小球。那是一枚种子。“它好像已经死了。” “全洛瑞克只有一处能让它长大，”年迈的阿尔贡说，“村子外小丘上，一所老农舍外边。我已经没法亲自去了，那里的主人发现我后就会像猎杀我们所有的族人般杀了我，而我虚弱到无力自卫了。但你能去把种子种下。” “那会怎么样？”卡米迪达问，“希斯特会回来吗？” “不。但其部分神力会。” 深夜，卡米迪达偷偷离开了家，登上小丘。她知道谢歌特所说的老农舍，她的姨母和舅舅都曾叮嘱她千万别去那儿。当她走近，屋门大开，一名强健有力的老人肩扛一柄巨斧冒出来。 “孩子，你在这儿干什么？”他盘问着，“天太黑，多亏我没把你看成那些蜥蜴人。” “太黑了，我迷路了，”她连忙说，“我想回我在洛瑞克的家。” “那就赶紧走。” “您能借我一根蜡烛嘛？”她可怜巴巴地问，“我刚刚就绕了几圈啦，要是没有点光我没法回去了。” 老人抱怨着回到房舍内。卡米迪达在干裂的地面上挖出个小坑，尽她所能把种子深埋起来。 “别再过来了，”他带着一支点燃的蜡烛回来，吼道，“不然我一斧头给你剁成两块。” 他回屋去燃起壁炉并休息。待到次日清晨他醒来后推开大门，惊讶地发现他的房屋整个被一株巨木封住了。他赶忙抡起他的巨斧一下又一下地劈斩，但不管怎么砍都没法突破它。他试着从左右两侧砍，但巨木随即自愈如初。他接着上劈下挑想要打出一处缺口，但巨树还是纹丝不动。 过了一段时间，有人发现朱宁的瘦弱的尸体平躺在他洞开的门前，他还紧紧攥着那把钝斧。他到底曾经砍过什么坚硬之物才会变成这样？人们好奇地谈论着这个谜，不过传说已在洛瑞克再度流传，说，那把斧刃上流淌着希斯特的树液。 不久后，大漠新蕾开始在村子的干裂沙土上推进蔓延。新播种的树苗和植物虽并不繁茂，但长势喜人。希斯特圣树并未再临，但卡米迪达和洛瑞克村民留意到，当暮色降临的某时，逝去的大树长长的、宽阔的影子会布满街道和山丘。 [pagebreak] 出版商说明： 《种子》是马洛巴尔·苏的系列著作中起源较广为人知的一本，故事原型发源自晨风南部的阿尔贡奴隶们。“马洛巴尔·苏”仅仅用锻莫替换了丹莫的角色，然后宣称这故事是他千自锻莫遗迹里掘出的素材——除此外，他后来还公然宣称阿尔贡们口口相传的古老原纪只是在复述他撰写的“原创”罢了！ Fall of the Snow Prince

[pagebreak]

An account of the Battle of the Moesring as transcribed by Lokheim, chronicler to the chieftain Ingjaldr White-Eye rom whence he came we did not know, but into the battle he rode, on a brilliant steed of pallid white. Elf we called him, for Elf he was, yet unlike any other of his kind we had ever seen before that day. His spear and armor bore the radiant and terrible glow of unknown magicka, and so adorned this unknown rider seemed more wight than warrior. What troubled, nay, frightened us most at that moment was the call that rose from the Elven ranks. It was not fear, not wonder, but an unabashed and unbridled joy, the kind of felicity felt by a damned man who has been granted a second chance at life. For at that time the Elves were as damned and near death as ever they had been during the great skirmishes of Solstheim. The Battle of the Moesring was to be the final stand between Nord and Elf on our fair island. Led by Ysgramor, we had driven the Elven scourge from Skyrim, and were intent on cleansing Solstheim of their kind as well. Our warriors, armed with the finest axes and swords Nord craftsmen could forge, cut great swaths through the enemy ranks. The slopes of the Moesring ran red with Elf blood. Why, then, would our foe rejoice? Could one rider bring such hope to an army so hopeless? To most of our kind, the meaning of the call was clear, but the words were but a litany of Elven chants and cries. There were some among us, however, the scholars and chroniclers, who knew well the words and shuddered at their significance. "The Snow Prince is come! Doom is at hand!" There was then a great calm that overcame the Elves that still stood. Through their mass the Snow Prince did ride, and as a longboat slices the icy waters of the Fjalding he parted the ranks of his kin. The magnificent white horse slowed to a gallop, then a trot, and the unknown Elf rider moved to the front of the line at a slow, almost ghostlike pace. A Nord warrior sees much in a life of bloodshed and battle, and is rarely surprised by anything armed combat may bring. But few among us that day could have imagined the awe and uncertainty of a raging battlefield that all at once went motionless and silent. Such is the effect the Snow Prince had on us all. For when the joyous cries of the Elves had ended, there remained a quiet known only in the solitude of slumber. It was then our combined host, Elf and Nord alike, were joined in a terrible understanding -- victory or defeat mattered little that day on the slopes of the Moesring Mountains. The one truth we all shared was that death would come to many that day, victor and vanquished alike. The glorious Snow Prince, an Elf unlike any other, did come that day to bring death to our kind. And death he so brought. Like a sudden, violent snow squall that rends travelers blind and threatens to tear loose the very foundations of the sturdiest hall, the Snow Prince did sweep into our numbers. Indeed the ice and snow did begin to swirl and churn about the Elf, as if called upon to serve his bidding. The spinning of that gleaming spear whistled a dirge to all those who would stand in the way of the Snow Prince, and our mightiest fell before him that day. Ulfgi Anvil-Hand, Strom the White, Freida Oaken-Wand, Heimdall the Frenzied. All lay dead at the foot of the Moesring Mountains. For the first time that day it seemed the tide of battle had actually turned. The Elves, spurred on by the deeds of the Snow Prince, rallied together for one last charge against our ranks. It was then, in a single instant, that the Battle of the Moesring came to a sudden and unexpected end. Finna, daughter of Jofrior, a lass of only twelve years and squire to her mother, watched as the Snow Prince cut down her only parent. In her rage and sorrow, Finna picked up Jofrior's sword and threw it savagely at her mother's killer. When the Elf's gleaming spear stopped its deadly dance, the battlefield fell silent, and all eyes turned to the Snow Prince. No one that day was more surprised than the Elf himself at the sight that greeted them all. For upon his great steed the Snow Prince still sat, the sword of Jofrior buried deeply in his breast. And then, he fell, from his horse, from the battle, from life. The Snow Prince lay dead, slain by a child. With their savior defeated, the spirit of the remaining Elven warriors soon shattered. Many fled, and those that remained on the battlefield were soon cut down by our broad Nord axes. When the day was done, all that remained was the carnage of the battlefield. And from that battlefield came a dim reminder of valor and skill, for the brilliant armor and spear of the Snow Prince still shined. Even in death, this mighty and unknown Elf filled us with awe. It is common practice to burn the corpses of our fallen foes. This is as much a necessity as it is custom, for death brings with it disease and dread. Our chieftains wished to cleanse Solstheim of the Elven horde, in death as well as life. It was decided, however, that such was not to be the fate of the Snow Prince. One so mighty in war yet so loved by his kin deserved better. Even in death, even if an enemy of our people. And so we brought the body of the Snow Prince, wrapped in fine silks, to a freshly dug barrow. The gleaming armor and spear were presented on a pedestal of honor, and the tomb was arrayed with treasures worthy of royalty. All of the mighty chieftains agreed with this course, that the Elf should be so honored. His body would be preserved in the barrow for as long as the earth chose, but would not be offered the protection of our Stalhrim, which was reserved for Nord dead alone. So ends this account of the Battle of the Moesring, and the fall of the magnificent Elven Snow Prince. May our gods honor him in death, and may we never meet his kind again in life.

由酋长“白眼”英格加尔德书记官洛克海姆抄录的默斯灵峰战役记录 他究竟从何而来，我们一无所知。但，他驾着一匹素净纯白的骏马踏入战斗。我们只能把他称作精灵，因为他确是精灵，但却与我们在那日前所见其他同类截然不同。他的长矛及盔甲闪耀着未知魔力的光芒和慑人的亮光。而正因如此，才叫这位未知的骑士看起来比其他战士更加威武。 在那一刻，最叫我们不安、乃至战栗的，是自精灵残军中响起的呼唤。那非惧，亦非惊，而是一种毫不掩饰、肆无忌惮的欢愉。一种将死之人重获第二次生命机会时所深深感受到的幸福。彼时精灵败局已定、已近灭亡，正如在索瑟海姆打响的大大小小的冲突那般。默斯灵峰一役将决出诺德与精灵，谁可在这美丽的岛上笑到最后。在伊斯格拉默的引领之下，我们将精灵之祸驱离天际大地，还计划一并清洗他们残留于索瑟海姆上的一切同族。我们的战士，装备有诺德工匠所能锻造的最精良的战斧刀剑，把敌军砍得粉碎，默斯灵峰的山坡已经被精灵的鲜血染红。那么，我们的敌人凭什么这么高兴？一位驰援的骑士能为这么绝望的军队携来这么大的希望吗？ 对我们大多数人而言，这些呼唤不过是精灵一连串祈求和悲号交织的胡言乱语罢了。然而，我们当中见多识广的学者和史官们，深知这“胡言乱语”的含义，并为其所传达的信号深深震栗。 “雪王子来了！大祸临头了！” 随后，一股巨大的静默降临至仍血战不倒的精灵军之上。雪王子策马穿过军阵，如一艘小艇破开法尔丁湖冰冷的湖水那般推分他们族人。华丽的白马速度渐缓，从狂奔渐至漫步，带着那不知名的精灵骑士踏着从容缓慢、几近幽灵的步伐，行至战线前端。 诺德战士一生对流血与战斗司空见惯，再难被战斗所致的结果惊动。但那天，我们之中极少有人可能想象到，杀声震天的战场突然陷入静止和沉默，会激起何等敬畏与紧张。这便是雪王子给予我们所有人的震撼。待精灵们的欢声终了，所剩下的唯有在沉睡的孤寂中才能感受的静谧。就在那时，我们双方，无论精灵还是诺德人，都达成了可怕的共识，在默斯灵峰，胜负已无关紧要。唯有死亡会无差别地降临在许多人身上。荣耀加身的雪王子，一位与众不同的精灵，确实在那天，为我族带来无数死亡。 如同骤起的猛烈风雪，能叫行人失明，甚至撼动最坚固殿堂的地基，雪王子确实席卷了我们的队伍。事实上，冰霜确实在那精灵周遭旋转翻滚，有如受呼唤而来，听从其令而行。他闪耀的长枪挥舞，向阻挡在其面前的所有人奏鸣挽歌。那天，我们最勇猛的英豪陨落在他面前。“铁砧掌”乌尔基、“白发”斯特罗姆、“橡木杖”芙蕾达、“狂人”海姆达尔。他们都长眠于默斯灵峰山脚下了。 这一天，战争的态势似乎第一次确实地逆转了。备受雪王子壮举鼓舞的精灵们全数集结，向我们的军队发起最后的冲锋。可就在那一瞬间，默斯灵峰之战便戛然而止，画上了出人意料的句号。 乔菲尔之女芬娜，年仅12岁便做了她母亲的扈从，眼睁睁目睹雪王子斩杀了她仅剩的亲人。于悲怒交加之间，芬娜捡起乔菲尔的剑，狂暴地掷向杀母仇人。待精灵那闪耀的长矛终止了死亡之舞，战场沉入一片死寂，所有人注目于雪王子。这一天，没有谁能比精灵们自己更为那迎接他们的景象惊诧了。雪王子仍端坐于他那高大的坐骑上，却不动分毫，乔菲尔之剑深埋在他胸口。随后，他自战马陨落，自血战陨落，自人世陨落。雪王子就此战死，被一个孩童杀死了。 随着他们的救星身亡，残余的精灵战士的精神很快就崩溃了。败逃脱伍者不计其数，那些仍留在战场上的则被我们宽大的诺德战斧砍杀。待这一天告终时，剩下的只有战场上一面倒的屠杀。但在那场战役中，我们仍能隐约看到那兼具英勇与技巧的身影，因为雪王子的盔甲和长矛仍闪闪发光。即使他已战死，但这强悍而未知的精灵，仍令我们充满敬畏。 火化亡敌的尸身是我们一贯的做法。这既是习俗，也是需要，毕竟死尸会诱发疾病和恐惧。我们的首领们希望能将索瑟海姆一切精灵部落的痕迹尽数驱除，无论生死。然而我们决定，不可如此对待雪王子。一位于战争中勇猛无敌、在亲族中万众爱戴的壮士，值得更有敬意的待遇。即便他已战死，而且是我们的仇敌。 于是，我们以精制丝绸裹起雪王子的遗骸，将他抬入新掘的坟冢。他闪耀的盔甲和长矛安置在彰显荣誉的基座上，整座坟冢满满地陈列着王族规制的奇珍异宝。各酋长均认同此举，这位精灵应被冠以如此荣耀。只要大地仍旧允许，则他的遗体将永眠于此冢之下。然他将不受我们魔冰的守护，这仅为诺德亡者所独享。 这便是关于默斯灵峰战役、以及强大高贵的精灵雪王子陨落的记录之终。愿我们诸神荣耀他的英灵，也愿我们永远不再与他的族人相逢。
