original: Stay back, lord!
traduit: 大人，退后！

original: No, Igmund. It's too dangerous.
traduit: 不行，依格蒙德。太危险了。

original: Stop right there! Were I can see you.
traduit: 别站那里！保持在我视线之内。

original: It's a little late for that, don't you think?
traduit: 你不觉得现在有点晚吗？

original: He wants the city this badly, he can fight me for it.
traduit: 他这么想要这座城，就来和我一战吧。

original: She wants the city this badly, she can fight me for it.
traduit: 她这么想要这座城，就来和我一战吧。

original: She's watching over the others. Look alive now.
traduit: 她在关注别的。看来能活命了。

original: Somehow I doubt that will persuade them.
traduit: 不知怎的，我怀疑这能否说服他们。

original: Halt in the name of the Jarl Balgruuf the Greater!
traduit: 以领主“伟岸者”巴尔古夫之名，站住！

original: Halt in the name of the Jarl Hrongar.
traduit: 以霍隆格纳领主之名，站住。

original: Where's Anuriel?
traduit: 安努瑞尔呢？

original: Halt in the name of the Jarl!
traduit: 以领主之名义，站住！

original: I've brought all the blood you require.
traduit: 你需要的血我都带来了。

original: I can almost... hear them. I feel their life energy. Come, I will make the mixture.
traduit: 我几乎能……听到它们的搏动。我感受到了它们的生命能量。来，交给我混合。

original: I heard you know about Elder Scrolls.
traduit: 我听说你知道上古卷轴。

original: Elder Scrolls. Indeed.
traduit: 上古卷轴。我知道。

original: The Empire. They absconded with them. Or so they think. The ones they saw. The ones they thought they saw.
traduit: 帝国。他们带着它们潜逃了。至少他们是这么认为的。他们看到了那些，就以为自己看到了那些。

original: I know of one. Forgotten. Sequestered.
traduit: 我知道一个。被遗忘、隔绝。

original: But I cannot go to it, not poor Septimus, for I... I have arisen beyond its grasp.
traduit: 但我不能去，不该由可怜的赛普蒂莫斯去，因为我……我已经超越了它的掌控。

original: Consider it done.
traduit: 包在我身上。

original: Well, soldier? Can you do this?
traduit: 怎么样，士兵？做得到吗？

original: May your will carve itself upon the world.
traduit: 愿你的意志铭刻于世。

original: I'm having some difficulties with the guards. Can you take care of that?
traduit: 我和卫兵有些矛盾。你能处理一下吗？

original: Hmm... Yes, I've heard about all that fuss. I myself know it's all a terrible, terrible misunderstanding. I'm quite sure you're innocent in all this.
traduit: 嗯……我是听说了那些大惊小怪的事。我也知道这是个可怕的误会。你肯定是无辜的。

original: This one time only, I'll grant you special immunity for any past transgressions, real or perceived.
traduit: 只此一次。我特别豁免你过去的违法行为，不管是真的还是被察觉的。

original: But going forward, I'm sure you realize that your fate is in your own hands. And the law can not be bent for personal friendships.
traduit: 但还得向前看。我相信你知道命运在自己手里，法律可不能为私人友谊让路。

original: Are you doing well, serving as Jarl?
traduit: 当领主怎么样？

original: Ahhh. Quite fine my friend. Quite fine.
traduit: 啊。很好，朋友。非常好。

original: So sad what happened to young Elisif. Tragic really. Such a young and pretty girl.
traduit: 艾利西弗年轻早逝实属不幸。真是悲哀，这么漂亮的年轻姑娘。

original: Was in over her head, I'm afraid.
traduit: 恐怕她无法理解。

original: But we should be done with murders in the Blue Palace. I've stepped up security around here.
traduit: 但我们是时候结束蓝宫谋杀案了。我已经加强了这里的安保。

original: I desired stealth and secrecy, but you executed the task with as much subtlety as a enrage mammoth.
traduit: 我本期望隐秘行事，但你像头愤怒的猛犸一样巧妙地完成了任务。

original: But my purpose was ultimately gained. My previous champion was erased, and a new one born.
traduit: 不过我的目的还是实现了。前任勇士被抹杀，新的勇士诞生。

original: If you can learn to be subtle in rendering death, perhaps I will share more of my power with you.
traduit: 你如果能学会更巧妙地处理杀人手法，或许我可以多分给你一些力量。

original: You have done well, my Champion. You have earned my respect, a feat few manage and live to tell about.
traduit: 做得好，我的勇士。你赢得了我的尊重，很少人能做到并活着讲述这一壮举。

original: I shall write your name upon the Tablet of Absolute Darkness.
traduit: 我会把你的名字铭刻在“绝暗石板”上。

original: You will die now.
traduit: 你现在得死。

original: That remains to be seen.
traduit: 这可说不好啊。

original: Never mind. Forget I mentioned it.
traduit: 别在意。就当我没说。

original: You aren't afraid to die?
traduit: 你不怕死？

original: A man who feels no fear has no heart. I know fear. But it does not control me.
traduit: 无畏者无心。我能感知恐惧，但不会被恐惧支配。

original: If you desire to fight me, then let's get this over with.
traduit: 如果你想和我一战，那就来吧。

original: This is what you want? To slave for others? What about your own destiny?
traduit: 这就是你想要的？给别人为奴为婢？你自己的命运呢？

original: Mind my words or I'll mind them for you: I'm slave to no man, no god, and no Daedra.
traduit: 记住我的话，或者我会替你记着：我不是任何人、神或者迪德拉的奴隶。

original: Boethiah talks about leaving your mark, a sign of your passing.... Well, you can make a mark on the world without treachery and murder.
traduit: 波耶西亚说：人要留下来过的痕迹……但不用背叛与谋杀也能在世上留下印记。

original: Whenever a man's life is saved by armor made with these hands, these hands have changed that man's destiny and his family's.
traduit: 每当这双手制作的盔甲救了一个人的性命。就是改变了他们一家的命运。

original: So you can tell that heartless Daedra bitch I'm done doing her dirty work.
traduit: 所以，去告诉那个无情的迪德拉贱人，我不会再给她干那些龌龊的营生了。

original: Boethiah is displeased. She wants you dead.
traduit: 波耶西亚不高兴。她要你死。

original: The Prince of Plots usually gets what she wants. I'm surprised I'm not dead already. She must have had some reason to keep me alive so long.
traduit: 阴谋君王总能得到自己想要的。我也惊讶自己为什么还没死。她肯定是有什么理由才让我活了这么久。

original: Tell me, what's it like being Boethiah's champion?
traduit: 告诉我，给波耶西亚当勇士感觉如何？

original: I told you. I'm done with all that. There's enough blood on these hands. I'm interested in creating things now.
traduit: 我告诉你。我受够了。这双手沾满鲜血。现在我更希望去创造些什么。

original: So you're Boethiah's champion, eh?
traduit: 所以你就是波耶西亚的勇士？

original: That was a long time ago.
traduit: 很久以前的事。

original: Now, if you're going to get those thieves, you should head to Bleak Falls Barrow, northeast of town.
traduit: 如果你想抓住那些小偷，就去镇子东北方向的荒瀑古坟吧。

original: Your father said to speak to you.
traduit: 你父亲让我和你谈谈。

original: So the disgusting pig sent you to bother me? One day, I'll tear his face apart so he can leave me alone.
traduit: 那个臭猪让你来烦我？总有一天，我会把他的脸扯碎，看他还能不能烦我。

original: My father doesn't know anything about me.
traduit: 我父亲对我一无所知。

original: But I know about him. And about the war. More than he might think.
traduit: 但我了解他。也了解这场战争。懂得比他想象的还要多。

original: I've heard there's trouble with your children.
traduit: 我听说你正为孩子烦恼。

original: Yes, my youngest son. He's a dark child. I don't know what to do with him.
traduit: 对，我的小儿子。这孩子有些阴暗。我不知道该拿他怎么办。

original: He was always a quiet lad, but lately... something has changed. He's become brooding. Violent.
traduit: 他以前很安静。但最近……变了。变得阴森、暴力。

original: He won't say a word to me, but I don't know how I upset him.
traduit: 他什么都不肯和我说，我也不知道他为什么生气。

original: If you could speak to him. Draw out the truth. I would be immensely grateful.
traduit: 如果你能和他谈谈，让他说出真相。那就不胜感激了。

original: Wait here. I'll be right back with your reward.
traduit: 在这儿等着。我去给你拿报酬来。

original: You couldn't afford my time.
traduit: 我的时间你耽搁不起。

original: Fine, leave me to die.
traduit: 好吧，那就留下我等死吧。

original: What can I do?
traduit: 我能做些什么？

original: My camp is nearby in the ruins of Nilheim. Get me there safely and you'll be rewarded.
traduit: 我的营地就在附近的尼尔海姆废墟。把我护送回去，你就能拿到报酬。

original: Are you ok?
traduit: 你怎么样？

original: Bandits attacked and ransacked my cart. Can you help me?
traduit: 强盗洗劫了我的马车。你能帮帮忙吗？

original: Oh, come now. Don't go away mad.
traduit: 哦，得了吧。别气鼓鼓的了。

original: Harpies, every one of them.
traduit: 一群鹰身女妖。

original: <Laughter>
traduit: （笑声）

original: I don't know. If you see any big strong men around, let us know, will you?
traduit: 我不知道啊。如果你看到什么高大强壮的男人，那就告诉我们。好吗？

original: Hello, ladies! Is there anything a big strong man can do for you this fine day?
traduit: 你们好啊，女士们！天气这么好，高大强壮的男人能为你们做些什么吗？

original: Oh, hi, I'm glad I ran into you. I was wondering if...
traduit: 哦，你好。很高兴碰到你。我想知道……

original: Sadly, yes. Even the townsfolk have taken to calling her "Grelod the Kind." Her very existence has become something of a running joke.
traduit: 不幸的是，没错。连城里的人都叫她“慈祥的桂罗”，她的存在已经成了一个笑话了。

original: Grelod runs this orphanage because she's old, and set in her ways, and doesn't know any other life. These children need love, and comfort. I try...
traduit: 桂罗经营孤儿院是因为她老了，而且习惯了自己的方式，不懂其他生活。这些孩子需要爱和安慰。我在尝试……

original: But... I'm sorry, you should go. The children aren't up for adoption, and it's cruel to get their hopes up. Besides, Grelod hates... visitors.
traduit: 但是……对不起，你该走了。孩子们不适合被收养，让他们抱太大希望太残忍了。而且，桂罗讨厌……游客。

original: Is Grelod always like that?
traduit: 桂罗一直这样吗？

original: Well? Grelod the Kind. Is she... you know?
traduit: 嗯？慈祥的桂罗。你是不是已经把她……那啥了？

original: This better be important.
traduit: 最好是有要紧事。

original: There's little time for talk, what do you want?
traduit: 没时间废话了，你想干什么？

original: Yes, yes, what is it now?
traduit: 好，好，又有什么事？

original: You're quite noisy for someone who claims to be a thief.
traduit: 身为一个盗贼，你太吵闹了。

original: Must you keep stopping?
traduit: 你必须经常停下来吗？

original: What? What is it?
traduit: 什么？怎么了？

original: Glad the antidote is taking effect.
traduit: 解药起作用了就好。

original: Quickly, what did you want?
traduit: 快说，你想干什么？

original: Hold on... you shot me!
traduit: 等等……你刚才拿箭射我！

original: No, I saved your life. My arrow was tipped with a unique paralytic poison. It slowed your heart and kept you from bleeding out.
traduit: 不，我是救你的命。我的箭上涂着一种独特的麻痹毒药。能够减缓心脏跳动，防止你失血过多。

original: Had I intended to kill you, we wouldn't be having this conversation.
traduit: 如果我想杀你，那我们就不会在这里交谈了。

original: Easy, easy. Don't get up so quickly.
traduit: 放松，放松，不要起来太快。

original: How are you feeling?
traduit: 你感觉如何？

original: You and I have business to discuss. Ah, but you have not yet reported back to Astrid, have you? Do that, and then we shall talk.
traduit: 咱们有事要谈。啊，但你还没和阿斯垂德汇报吧？去吧，回来再谈。

original: Dear brother. I've been waiting for you. Your next contract awaits, as I'm sure Astrid indicated.
traduit: 亲爱的兄弟。我一直在等你。你的下份契约正等着呢，阿斯垂德应该说过了吧。

original: Dear sister. I've been waiting for you. Your next contract awaits, as I'm sure Astrid indicated.
traduit: 亲爱的姐妹。我一直在等你。你的下份契约正等着呢，阿斯垂德应该说过了吧。

original: As I said, go speak with Gabriella. She's been assisting me with your next contract. This Emperor business, well... it does involve everyone.
traduit: 我说了，去找加布里艾拉谈谈。她一直在帮我处理你下一份契约。关于皇帝的事……确实需要群策群力。

original: My point exactly.
traduit: 那我说的就没毛病。

original: Why that's not the same thing at all. The Dominion were invaders. Conquerors. We had to fight them, to preserve our own way of life.
traduit: 这根本不是一回事。先祖神洲是侵略者、征服者。我们必须与之战斗，才能保全我们的生活之道。

original: And when the elves marched into your beloved Cyrodiil, and everyone took up arms against them, wasn't that treason? Against the Dominion? Huh?
traduit: 那当精灵冲进你可爱的希罗帝尔的时候，你们怎么也拿起武器了？这就不是背叛了？你们这是在背叛先祖神洲啊？

original: Oh, I know enough. I know those trouble-making Stormcloaks refuse to submit to Imperial authority. Such seditious behavior. Why it's treason!
traduit: 哦，我知道的够多了。我知道那些捣麻烦的风暴斗篷拒绝接受帝国权威，这就是一场煽乱。一场背叛！

original: Typical Imperial rot. You speak of Skyrim like you know the land, know its people. You're from Cyrodiil! You know nothing about us! Nothing!
traduit: 典型的帝国腐败言论。你谈起天际时就好像多了解这片土地还有这里的人民一样。别忘了你来自希罗帝尔！你对我们一无所知！一无所知！

original: Who were you talking to?
traduit: 你在和谁说话？

original: Emperor Pelagius III.
traduit: 皇帝佩拉吉奥斯三世。

original: Now surely even you know about Pelagius' decree? On his deathbed - oh, and this was inspired - he forbade... death! That's right! Death! Outlawed!
traduit: 你也应该知道佩拉吉奥斯的法令吧？在他弥留之际，哦吼，灵光一现，他就禁止……死亡！没错！死亡！不合法！

original: Charmed.
traduit: 美味啊。

original: The Gourmet. Leave it to Titus to spare no expense.
traduit: 美食家。提图斯真是不吝成本啊。

original: I prefer a good roast duck. But your soup will do.
traduit: 我更喜欢烤鸭。不过你的汤也很好。

original: I've been waiting for this opportunity for a long time.
traduit: 我等这次机会很久了。

original: So glad we kept you in Skyrim. Serving your Emperor was worth the wait, of course.
traduit: 我们很高兴能把你留在天际。当然，侍奉皇帝也是值得等待的。

original: You're not at all what I expected. I imagined you'd be fatter, honestly.
traduit: 你和我想的完全不一样。说实话，我还以为你会更胖呢。

original: You've done your duty and we're all very grateful. Now... I'd like to eat.
traduit: 你尽责了，我们很感谢。现在……我想赶紧品尝。

original: I think something's... wrong... I...
traduit: 我感觉有些……不对……我……

original: Oh... Oh how marvelous. Just delicious. It is everything I had hoped it would be. It.... I....
traduit: 哦……何等美味。好吃。和我期望的一样。它。我……

original: Oh... Oh how marvelous. Just delicious. It is everything I had hoped it would be. Please, everyone. Enjoy.
traduit: 哦……何等美味。好吃。和我期望的一样。来，大家都尝尝。

original: Hold on, I need a minute.
traduit: 等下。我需要些时间。

original: This isn't a damn summer picnic! Hurry up. We need to hit them before they know we're here.
traduit: 我们可不是去夏日野餐！快点。我们得在他们发现之前干掉他们。

original: I'm ready, ma'am.
traduit: 我准备好了，长官。

original: What's the situation?
traduit: 什么情况？

original: The Stormcloaks are here in force. Stick close and follow orders so we don't stir up the whole place against us.
traduit: 风暴斗篷已经强势抵达了。跟紧我们，服从命令，别一次性引来所有敌人。

original: Looks like the damned rebels got here first. No matter, we have the element of surprise. Prepare to move out.
traduit: 看来该死的叛军先到了。没关系，敌明我暗。准备进去。

original: You ready, auxiliary?
traduit: 辅助兵，准备好了吗？

original: Ulfric's right-hand man, Galmar Stonefist, has located what he believes is the final resting place of the Jagged Crown.
traduit: 乌弗瑞克的得力助手，加尔玛·石拳觉得自己已经找到了锯齿王冠最终安放之地。

original: We're going to make sure he doesn't get his hands on it.
traduit: 我们得确保王冠不被他染指。

original: The rest of my men are already assembling outside Korvanjund. I'll meet you there as soon as I finish up here.
traduit: 我的其他部下已经在科万琼德外面集结了。我这边完事儿就去找你们。

original: I think I'd rather be a regular soldier.
traduit: 我宁愿当个普通士兵。

original: Send another one in here! Send two! I don't care!
traduit: 再派一个过来！派两个！我不在乎！

original: One of you get in here! I could put all of you down!
traduit: 你们谁赶紧进来！我能把你们都撂倒！

original: What are you waiting for? I know you want to kill me. Now's your chance!
traduit: 你还在等什么？我知道你想杀我。现在你机会来了！

original: Damn. Another fight.
traduit: 该死的。又打架了。

original: Someone's going to get hurt.
traduit: 会有人受伤的。

original: They're fighting over that thing, I think.
traduit: 他们应该是在争那东西吧。

original: What's all the commotion?
traduit: 这骚乱是怎么回事？

original: That can be arranged.
traduit: 那就好办了。

original: You can take it over my dead body!
traduit: 除非是我死了，否则你别想拿走它！

original: If it's a fight you want, it's a fight you'll get.
traduit: 如果你想打架，那就来吧。

original: Back off!
traduit: 退后！

original: You'll have to take it from me.
traduit: 想要就从我这里抢吧。

original: Your blood won't bother me!
traduit: 反正你的血不会困扰到我！

original: You'll have to fight me for it.
traduit: 你得跟我争一争。

original: I'll hurt you if I have to.
traduit: 如果有必要我也可以伤你。

original: You're too slow and stupid to take it from me.
traduit: 你又慢又蠢，拿不走的。

original: I don't think so!
traduit: 我不这么想！

original: I saw it first! I'm taking it.
traduit: 我先看见的！应该归我。

original: Not if I get it first.
traduit: 除非我先拿到。

original: No. It's mine!
traduit: 不。这是我的！

original: We'll see about that.
traduit: 我们走着瞧吧。

original: I'm taking it anyway.
traduit: 反正我要拿走。

original: I think not.
traduit: 我不同意。

original: Hey! That's my sword.
traduit: 嘿！这是我的剑。

original: Don't touch that dagger! It's mine.
traduit: 别碰那把匕首！那是我的。

original: I don't think so. That axe is mine.
traduit: 我可不觉得。那把斧子是我的。

original: Keep away from that bow. It's mine.
traduit: 离那把弓远点。那是我的。

original: Hands off. That's my armor now!
traduit: 手撒开。那是我的盔甲！

original: You're too slow. I saw it first.
traduit: 你太慢了。我先看到的。

original: Hey! What's this?
traduit: 嘿！这是什么？

original: Who left that here?
traduit: 谁丢在这儿的？

original: Well! Finders, keepers as they say.
traduit: 好吧！俗话说，谁捡到算谁的。

original: If nobody wants that, I'll take it.
traduit: 没人要我拿走了啊。

original: Damn shame to leave that lying around.
traduit: 把它丢在这里太浪费了。

original: It's a bit worn, but I'll take it.
traduit: 虽然有点旧，不过不要紧。

original: Looks like it's my lucky day.
traduit: 看来今天是我走运了。

original: Hmm. What's this?
traduit: 嗯。这是什么？

original: I've got things to do.
traduit: 我还有事要做。

original: I know, I know... Wars to fight, dragons to confront, guild business to conduct.
traduit: 我知道，我知道……仗要打，龙要防，公会忙。

original: So, what could a dog need help with?
traduit: 所以，一条狗又需要什么帮助呢？

original: My master and I had a bit of a falling out. We got into an argument and it got rather... heated.
traduit: 我和主人吵了一架。吵得很凶。

original: He's kicked me out until I find someone who can settle our disagreement. That's where you come in.
traduit: 他把我踢出来了，我得找到能解决我们矛盾的人，你能办得到。

original: That's done it! Let's get in there.
traduit: 成功了！我们进去吧。

original: Well? There must be a way through. Look around.
traduit: 嗯？这里肯定有路可以通过。四处看看吧。

original: This is it. We've found Gathrik's tomb.
traduit: 是这里。我们找到加斯瑞克的坟墓了。

original: You can't shake us off that easily. Let's see what's here!
traduit: 你没那么容易甩掉我们。来看看这里有什么！

original: This way.
traduit: 这边走。

original: Come on, hurry up.
traduit: 快点，跟上。

original: Better to stick together down here.
traduit: 最好别分开。

original: This looks like the way out! I was starting to wonder if we'd ever make it.
traduit: 好像是出路！我还以为永远找不到呢。

original: I'm the one the Blades have been searching for. I'm Dragonborn.
traduit: 我就是刀锋会一直在找的人。我是龙裔。

original: What's that you said? Dragonborn? Then... there really is hope after all?
traduit: 你说什么？龙裔？这么说……真的还有希望？

original: You'd better come inside. Quickly now. Thalmor agents have been seen in the Ratway.
traduit: 你最好进来。快点。梭默探子已经到鼠道里了。

original: There are Thalmor agents in the Ratway. Looking for you.
traduit: 鼠道里有梭默特使正在搜捕你。

original: And no doubt you're one of them. Leave me alone!
traduit: 你肯定也是其中之一。离我远点！

original: What happened on the 30th of Frostfall?
traduit: 霜落月30日发生了什么？

original: It was a cold day. The end of Frostfall is nearly winter in the Jerall Mountains.
traduit: 那天很冷。在杰拉尔山脉，霜落月的结束就代表冬天即将来临。

original: We heard the news at Cloud Ruler by courier, riding hard from the Imperial City.
traduit: 我们在凌云者神殿收到了信使从帝都千辛万苦送来的情报。

original: 30th of Frostfall, 171. Thirty years ago. The Great War started that day.
traduit: 三十年前，171年霜落月30日。浩大战争爆发了。

original: The Thalmor ambassador delivered his ultimatum to the Emperor Titus Mede: the heads of every Blades agent within the Aldmeri Dominion.
traduit: 梭默大使向提图斯·迈德皇帝发出了最后通牒——先祖神洲境内所有刀锋会密探的人头。

original: I knew, that day, that it was truly the beginning of the end.
traduit: 我当然记得那一天，因为那是终焉的开始。

original: Come in, come in! Make yourself at home!
traduit: 请进，请进！别拘束。

original: Please. Come in. Musn't talk in the Ratway.
traduit: 请进请进。不能站在鼠道里说话。

original: Come in, come in. Too many ears out there.
traduit: 请进，请进。外面耳目太多。

original: Come in. Quickly now.
traduit: 请进。快请进。

original: There we are!
traduit: 好了！

original: Only a couple more.
traduit: 还有两个了。

original: This one always sticks... there we go.
traduit: 这个总是卡住……好了。

original: This'll just take a moment...
traduit: 得花一会儿工夫了……

original: Delphine said to "remember the 30th of Frostfall."
traduit: 戴尔芬说了“铭记霜落月30日”

original: Ah. Indeed, indeed. I do remember.
traduit: 啊。没错，没错。我当然记得。

original: Delphine really is alive, then? You'd better come in then and tell me how you found me and what you want.
traduit: 戴尔芬真的还活着？你还是进来吧，告诉我你是如何找到我的，还有你想要干什么。

original: Oh, and when you find Esbern... if you think I'm paranoid... you may have some trouble getting him to trust you.
traduit: 如果你觉得我有些多疑的话，那你找到伊思本的时候……可能会觉得他也不大相信人。

original: Just ask him where he was on the 30th of Frostfall. He'll know what it means.
traduit: 只要问他“霜落月30日你在何方”就行。他知道那意味着什么。

original: There you are.
traduit: 你来了。

original: Nobody here anymore.
traduit: 这里没人。

original: Must've scared 'em off.
traduit: 肯定是吓跑了。

original: Cleared out, I guess.
traduit: 应该是没人了。

original: Guess it's all clear now.
traduit: 现在应该没人了。

original: Oh well. Must have run off.
traduit: 好了。应该是跑了。

original: Nobody here now.
traduit: 这里没人了。

original: Is it safe?
traduit: 安全了？

original: Damn, where'd you go?
traduit: 该死，你去哪里？

original: Where are you hiding?
traduit: 你藏哪里了？

original: Come back here!
traduit: 回来！

original: I hope there aren't any more.
traduit: 希望不会再来了。

original: That takes care of that.
traduit: 这就搞定了。

original: Teach you to mess with me.
traduit: 这就是惹我的下场。

original: All over now.
traduit: 都结束了。

original: Phew!
traduit: 呸！

original: That's the last of them.
traduit: 这是最后一个了。

original: I guess I was just hearing things.
traduit: 我是不是听见什么了。

original: Just getting jumpy I guess.
traduit: 可能是紧张过头了。

original: Here we go.
traduit: 我们走。

original: Ahhh!
traduit: 啊！

original: By Ysmir, you won't leave here alive!
traduit: 伊斯米尔在上，你休想活着离开！

original: Oh, no you don't!
traduit: 哦，你休想！

original: You're as good as dead!
traduit: 你死定了！

original: Don't just stand there! Kill him!
traduit: 别傻站着了！快杀了他！

original: Don't just stand there! Kill her!
traduit: 别傻站着了！快杀了她！

original: Well well. Another maggot to squash beneath my boot.
traduit: 好啊好啊。我的鞋子底下又多了条蛆。

original: Attack!
traduit: 进攻！

original: To arms, boys! To arms!
traduit: 兄弟们，抄家伙！抄家伙！

original: What in the bloody blazes?
traduit: 这是搞什么鬼？

original: Never should have come here...
traduit: 你就不该来这儿……

original: Now you're mine!
traduit: 你的命归我了！

original: Thought I heard something.
traduit: 我就说听见点儿什么。

original: Time to end this little game!
traduit: 是时候结束这些小游戏了！

original: Hello? Who's there?
traduit: 嘿？谁在那边？

original: Is... is someone there?
traduit: 那边……有人吗？

original: You can't hide from me forever.
traduit: 你不可能永远躲着我的。

original: When I find you, you're dead.
traduit: 我找到你你就死定了。

original: You afraid to fight me?
traduit: 你是害怕和我一战吗？

original: Come on, show yourself!
traduit: 来吧，现身吧！

original: Stay away from me!
traduit: 离我远点！

original: I'm going to find you.
traduit: 我会找到你的！

original: You won't get away.
traduit: 你逃不掉的。

original: He's dead. You're next.
traduit: 他死了。你是下一个。

original: Hey! Somebody get down here! Help!
traduit: 嘿！都快下来！救命！

original: Yeah.
traduit: 是我。

original: Boss was looking for you - said he'd be up at the summit. Better not keep him waiting.
traduit: 老大在找你，说他在山顶等你。别让他等太久了。

original: I've got the sap.
traduit: 我拿到汁液了。

original: Wonderful. I'll use it to repair the tree. Thank you so much for all your help.
traduit: 太好了。我要用它来修复树木。非常感谢你的帮助。

original: But... I can't run the Temple without the support of people who are inspired by the Gildergreen. How can this little tree bring new worshippers?
traduit: 但是……如果没有那些受镀绿树鼓舞的人，我又如何打理神殿呢？这株小树能带来新的信徒吗？

original: I've got a sapling.
traduit: 我拿到了一棵树苗。

original: I've found Nettlebane for you.
traduit: 我找到刺草之祸了。

original: Oh. I... well, I honestly didn't expect you to come back. Of course, I'm glad you did!
traduit: 哦。我……哎，我真没想到你能回来。当然，我很高兴你能成功。

original: Now... I don't really want to touch that thing, though. Do you think you could handle the next steps?
traduit: 但我真不愿碰那东西。你能处理好下面的步骤吗？

original: It's a shame, isn't it?
traduit: 很遗憾，是吧？

original: So, have you gotten Nettlebane back from those filthy Hagravens yet?
traduit: 你把刺草之祸从肮脏的乌鸦鬼婆那里抢回来了吗？

original: Do you have the Eldergleam sap?
traduit: 你找到古光树的汁液了吗？

original: Welcome, child.
traduit: 欢迎你，孩子。

original: Was I correct in hearing that you were traveling to the grove of the Eldergleam?
traduit: 我听说你要去古光树之林？

original: What's happened to the Gildergreen is a travesty.
traduit: 镀绿树的事简直就是胡闹。

original: Please move quickly. Eldergleam awaits us.
traduit: 请快点。古光树在等着我们。

original: Is it much further to the sanctuary?
traduit: 这里离圣所还远吗？

original: I can't believe I've finally made it here.
traduit: 真不敢相信我终于来了。

original: It's like it was in my dreams.
traduit: 简直就像做梦。

original: I can almost hear its heart.
traduit: 我几乎能听到它的心跳。

original: No deal. Take the axe and take back Barbas!
traduit: 没得商量。拿上斧子带巴巴斯回去！

original: Hrmph. You're no fun at all. Guess I'll have to make my own fun elsewhere.
traduit: 哎。你可真没劲。看来我得去别处找乐子了。

original: And with the pup back, I'll be restored to my full power. There's a whole world just waiting for me!
traduit: 等狗子回来，我就恢复了全部力量。整个世界都等着我呢！

original: I'd really like to keep this axe...
traduit: 我真的很想留下斧头……

original: And I could absorb the spirit of poor, dead Barbas. He'd still be reunited with me.
traduit: 这样我就能吸收死掉的巴巴斯的可怜精魂。他一样可以和我团聚。

original: And I'm sure Barbas doesn't want me to have that axe. He'd want it this way.
traduit: 而且我敢肯定巴巴斯不想让我拿回斧子。他肯定这么想。

original: The choice is yours, friend. We're all counting on you to make the right decision. Put him out of our misery!
traduit: 选择权在你，朋友。我们都在等着你作出正确的决定。把他从我们的痛苦中解救出来！

original: I sure would like to keep this axe...
traduit: 我确实想留下斧头……

original: Excellent work. A hero and his faithful companion, retrieving the ancient artifact for the prince. It's almost... storybook.
traduit: 干得漂亮。英雄与忠诚的伙伴为君王找回了古老的神器。和故事书一模一样。

original: Ah, but it almost seems a shame to give a weapon like that away, doesn't it? I suppose I could be persuaded to let you keep it...
traduit: 啊，不过把这样的武器拱手让人很可惜吧？我想你应该留着它……

original: But only if you use the axe to kill Barbas. Simple as that.
traduit: 但前提是你用斧杀掉巴巴斯。就这么简单。

original: We're back. Now fulfill your end of the bargain.
traduit: 我们回来了。现在，履行你的约定。

original: And?
traduit: 所以？

original: I've been thinking it over...
traduit: 我一直在考虑……

original: Absolutely! Now I can reabsorb his body, and return to full power. All without having to listen to his whining.
traduit: 当然！现在我可以重新把他吸收，恢复全部力量。完全不用听他发牢骚。

original: Oh, sure, he'll be back in a century or two, but think of the fun I can have 'til then.
traduit: 哦，当然，他一两百年也就回来了，但在此之前我得好好享受。

original: Enjoy that axe! And don't worry about poor old Barbas. After all, he really should have picked a better friend...
traduit: 好好用那把斧头吧！可怜的老巴巴斯。毕竟，他真该选个更好的朋友……

original: He's dead. Are we done here?
traduit: 他死了。完事了吗？

original: Sounds easy enough. Let's go find him.
traduit: 听起来很容易。我们去找他吧。

original: Thank you. Now, since he banished me, Vile's been rather weak. He can't manifest very far from one of his shrines.
traduit: 谢谢。自从维尔把我赶出来，他的力量也变弱了。他不能离开自己的祭坛太远。

original: I know there's a cult that worships him at Haemar's Shame. We should be able to talk to him there.
traduit: 我知道有人在海玛之羞拜他。我们可以去那儿找他谈谈。

original: If this works out, I'll make sure you're rewarded. Just don't trust any offer he makes you... okay?
traduit: 如果成功了，我会奖励你的。不过不要相信他的任何提议……好吧？

original: I'm just here to reunite you with Barbas.
traduit: 我来此只是想让你和巴巴斯重聚。

original: Ugh. That insufferable pup? Forget it. Request denied. No deal.
traduit: 啊。那个讨厌的狗子？算了吧。请求否决。没商量。

original: I'm glad to be rid of him. Even if it does mean I'm stuck in this pitiful shrine, in the back end of... nowhere.
traduit: 我很高兴能摆脱他。虽然我被困在这个……无聊的神殿里。

original: Well... perhaps there is a way he could earn his place back at my side. Maybe. But no promises.
traduit: 嗯……也许有办法让他重回我身边。只是也许，我可不打包票。

original: Okay, follow me.
traduit: 好，跟我来。

original: All right, then. We'll get together later.
traduit: 好吧。我们以后再聚。

original: Stop following me.
traduit: 别跟着我了。

original: Did you just talk?
traduit: 你刚才说话了？

original: Skyrim is now host to giant, flying lizards and two-legged cat-men... and you're surprised by me? Yes. I just talked. And am continuing to do so.
traduit: 天际现在有大个的蜥蜴满天飞，两脚的猫人遍地跑……你却对我这么惊讶？没错，我会说话，而且会一直说下去。

original: So you're a little lost puppy?
traduit: 所以你是只迷路的小狗？

original: Very funny. My master is Clavicus Vile, Daedric prince of wishes. As you can imagine, he's quite the important person.
traduit: 有意思吧。我主人是迪德拉中的愿望君王，卡拉威库斯·维尔。你肯定知道他是个大人物。

original: You were looking for me?
traduit: 你找我？

original: Yes, I think you'll be just what I need.
traduit: 没错，我想我需要的就是你。

original: DA03Hello
traduit: DA03Hello

original: Woof.
traduit: 汪。

original: Well, well. Hello there, big man.
traduit: 哎，哎。你好啊，大个子。

original: Hello there, miss.
traduit: 你好啊，小姐。

original: Barbas, at your service.
traduit: 巴巴斯，愿意效劳。

original: Ah, there you are. I've been waiting for you to arrive.
traduit: 啊，你来了。我一直在等你。

original: Collect the Rueful Axe from Rimerock Burrow, and I believe we'll have a deal.
traduit: 去雾凇岩地洞拿回悔恨之斧，我们就能达成协议。

original: Ah, you've got the axe! And my dog. Splendid.
traduit: 啊，你拿回了斧头！还有我的狗。很好。

original: You have business with Clavicus Vile?
traduit: 你找卡拉威库斯·维尔何事？

original: It's nice to be rid of that detestable dog. Things are so much more fun without his incessant preaching.
traduit: 摆脱那条讨厌的狗真是太好了。没有他在耳边没完没了地唠叨，一切都变得有趣了。

original: DA03VileGreetingBranchTopic
traduit: DA03VileGreetingBranchTopic

original: By all means, let's hear it. It's the least I could do, since you already helped me grant one final wish for my last worshippers...
traduit: 无论如何，说来听听吧。毕竟你也替我的信徒完成了最后的愿望……

original: They were suffering so from vampirism, and begged me for a cure. Then you came and ended their misery! I couldn't have planned it better myself.
traduit: 他们被吸血鬼病折磨得厉害，想找我要解药。然后你就来结束了他们的痛苦！我都想不出这么好的点子。

original: So, what's your heart's desire? What kind of deal can we strike?
traduit: 所以，你的愿望是什么？我们能达成什么交易？

original: Lord Vile, I have a request of you.
traduit: 维尔大人，我有个请求。

original: The Stormcloaks were there ahead of us.
traduit: 风暴斗篷当时就在我们前面。

original: Yes. Well, I didn't respond as quickly to the Legate's suggestion as perhaps I should have.
traduit: 是的。好吧，我或许应该及时回应副官的建议。

original: But at least we ended up with the damn crown. Now then...
traduit: 但至少我们拿到了那个破王冠。现在……

original: We lost a lot of good men. I hope it was worth it.
traduit: 我们为此损失了很多好兵。希望这是值得的。

original: That's not for you to decide. Soldier.
traduit: 这不是你能决定的。士兵。

original: I wouldn't have sent you in the first place if it wasn't going to be worth it. Now then...
traduit: 如果不值得，那一开始我就不会派你去。现在……

original: Nothing I couldn't handle.
traduit: 没什么我处理不了的事。

original: That's what I like to hear. I'll get the full report from Legate Rikke. Now then...
traduit: 我就喜欢听这个。我会从瑞姬副官那拿取完整报告。现在……

original: Here's the Jagged Crown. Legate Rikke sent me to deliver it to you.
traduit: 这是锯齿王冠。瑞姬副官派我把它交给你。

original: Excellent work, soldier. I have to admit, I had my doubts it even existed. Did you run into any trouble?
traduit: 做得好，士兵。我确实怀疑过它的真实性。有遇到麻烦吗？

original: Mind your own business.
traduit: 自己管好自己吧。

original: We've got nothing to talk about.
traduit: 我们没什么好说的。

original: I've been looking for a way to appease Hircine.
traduit: 我一直想办法安抚海尔辛的怒火。

original: There is a certain beast in these lands. Large, majestic.
traduit: 传说有一种巨大、雄伟的野兽。

original: It's said that Hircine will commune with whoever slays it. I tracked it into these woods, but then had my... accident with the child.
traduit: 无论谁猎杀它，海尔辛都会与之交谈。我追踪到了这片树林，结果……就那孩子出了意外。

original: I want to beg his forgiveness. Give him back the ring. But while I'm stuck in here, the beast wanders free.
traduit: 我想恳求他的原谅，将戒指还给他。但我被困在这里，那头野兽还在外面游荡。

original: Never thought I'd see you again.
traduit: 没想到还能再见到你。

original: We were told you may be coming.
traduit: 我们听说你可能会来。

original: Return when you have completed the Great Hunt.
traduit: 等你完成了大狩猎再回来。

original: Greetings, fellow hunter.
traduit: 你好啊，猎人。

original: May Hircine guide our blades.
traduit: 愿海尔辛指引剑刃的方向。

original: We follow you, hunt-master.
traduit: 我们会追随你，狩猎大师。

original: The Bloodmoon lights the way.
traduit: 血月照亮了道路。

original: Show us the path to the prey.
traduit: 带我们找到猎物。

original: Hircine chose you to lead the Great Hunt. So lead.
traduit: 海尔辛选你领导这场大狩猎。所以开始吧。

original: A sad time.
traduit: 悲伤的时刻。

original: Why are you so eager to open the box?
traduit: 你为什么急着打开这个盒子？

original: The box contains the heart. The essence of a god.
traduit: 这个盒子里装着心脏。一位神的精华。

original: I have devoted my life to the Elder Scrolls, but their knowledge is a passing awareness when compared to the encompassing mind of divinity.
traduit: 我毕生都在研究上古卷轴。但是它们的知识比起神明包罗万象的思想就像转瞬即逝的灵感。

original: The Dwemer were the last to touch it. It was thought to have been destroyed by the Nerevarine, but my lord told me otherwise.
traduit: 锻莫是最后接触它的。大家以为它已经被尼瑞瓦因摧毁了。但我的主人说不是那样。

original: Dig, Dwemer, in the beyond. I'll know your lost unknown and rise to your depths.
traduit: 挖啊，挖到深处啊。锻莫，我将知道你失落的未知，达到你们的深度。

original: When the top level was built, no more could be placed. It was and is the maximal apex.
traduit: 当顶层建好，就无法再被超越了。它就是过去与现在的最高点。

original: How long will it be sung? My feet were set upon the rock but it turned to mud and drew me down.
traduit: 这首歌还要唱多久？我的脚已经把磐石踏成了泥，我都快陷进去了。

original: It lick the panes and smokes the glass...
traduit: 舔着窗户，玻璃都快冒烟了……

original: I have inscribed the lexicon.
traduit: 我已经把方典刻好了。

original: Oh, but the Dwemer had more than even Septimus expected.
traduit: 哦，但锻莫比赛普蒂莫斯想的还聪明。

original: This will take time to decryptify. Be on your way, and Septimus will find  you if he has further need.
traduit: 我需要时间来解密。走吧，如果赛普蒂莫斯需要，会找你的。

original: Where is this "Blackreach"?
traduit: 这个“黑境”在哪？

original: Under deep. Below the dark. The hidden keep. Tower Mzark.
traduit: 在地下深处。黑暗之中，隐藏的堡垒。姆扎克塔。

original: Alftand. The point of puncture, of first entry, of the tapping.
traduit: 艾尔夫坦德。刺入之地、首入之地、叩击之地。

original: Delve to its limits, and Blackreach lies just beyond.
traduit: 进入它的深处，黑境就在下面。

original: But not all can enter there. Only Septimus knows the hidden key to loose the lock to jump beneath the deathly rock.
traduit: 但不是所有人都能进去。只有赛普蒂莫斯知道打开那致命岩石的隐藏钥匙。

original: So, where is the Scroll?
traduit: 那，卷轴在哪里？

original: Here.
traduit: 在这儿。

original: Well, here as in this plane. Mundus. Tamriel. Nearby, relatively speaking.
traduit: 在这个位面，在梦达思。在泰姆瑞尔。相对而言，很近。

original: On the cosmological scale, it's all nearby.
traduit: 从宇宙来衡量，都在附近。

original: Please, don't just let it stay like this. It's disgraceful.
traduit: 拜托，不要放弃了。太不像话了。

original: It was taken by a lightning strike. Wish I had time to deal with it, but it's hard enough with all these wounded from the war.
traduit: 它被雷击了。我也很想有时间来处理，但是战争中的伤员就够我受的了。

original: What is it... what has happened to the Gildergreen? I have traveled long here to worship beneath its branches.
traduit: 这是怎么回事……镀绿树怎么了？我长途跋涉到这里，就是为了在它的枝杈之下膜拜。

original: (forcegreet)
traduit: (forcegreet)

original: You're here! I was beginning to think you might not make it.
traduit: 嘿！我还以为你撑不住了。

original: I think I'll pass on it.
traduit: 我看还是算了。

original: I'll get right on it.
traduit: 我马上就去。

original: Do you have any sweep jobs?
traduit: 你这里有打扫工作吗？

original: One of the quickest ways to make some coin in Skyrim is to clear out some of the wealthier homes of their valuables.
traduit: 在天际赚钱最快的方法之一，便是清扫有钱人家里的贵重物品。

original: If you're interested, I could point out a good place that could use a little housecleaning.
traduit: 如果你有兴趣，我可以给你指一个需要打扫的好地方。

original: Tell me about the sweep jobs.
traduit: 跟我说说打扫任务。

original: I think we have a nice wealthy home for you to break into. Think you can clear the place of valuables and keep it quiet?
traduit: 我们有个挺富裕的人家可以让你闯一闯。能保证安安静静地把贵重物品打扫干净吗？

original: These people just inherited some heirlooms from a relative. Good timing for us, bad timing for them, eh?
traduit: 这些人从亲戚那里继承了些传家宝。我们走运，他们倒霉，是吧？

original: Just got a tip on this house... should be stuffed with loot. Care to head over there and find out?
traduit: 刚刚收到这家的风儿……应该是满满当当。想过去看看吗？

original: Got a message from one of my people that this place just came into some coin. Should be a good target. Want to take it?
traduit: 我的人捎了个口信，说这地方挺有钱。应该是个好目标。想接手吗？

original: Someone with connections to our Guild wants us to hit this place and send a message by clearing it of valuables. You want to handle it?
traduit: 有个公会的关系户想让我们突袭这里，清除里面的贵重品来传递信号。你来？

original: Good timing. The people in this home recently got one of your fellow Guild mates sent to jail. How about you make them pay for it.
traduit: 好机会。这家人刚把咱们公会的人送进监狱。去让他们付点代价。

original: You can give this house a once over. I hear they're fairly well-off and probably have lots of good stuff ripe for the picking. Sound good?
traduit: 看看这所房子。听说相当有钱，应该有些好东西可挑。如何？

original: The owner of this place just got an inheritance from a relative lost in the war. Sound like something you can sink your teeth into?
traduit: 这地方的主人刚刚从一个在战斗中失踪的亲戚手里拿了一笔遗产。吃得下吗？

original: Maurice said that renewal is more important than maintenance.
traduit: 毛利斯说，创新比维持更重要。

original: I... you're right of course. It can be hard to hear the winds of Kynareth when all you hear are the rabble in the temple.
traduit: 我……你说得对。当你满耳都是神殿里这群俗子嘈杂，也就很难听到凯娜瑞丝之风了。

original: Death feeds new life.
traduit: 死亡孕育新生。

original: I'm sure that, in time, this little sapling will grow into a new Gildergreen that will tower over Whiterun. Thank you.
traduit: 我相信，假以时日，这株树苗一定会长成新的镀绿树屹立在白漫城之上。谢谢你！

original: DA03VileOffer0
traduit: DA03VileOffer0

original: There's an axe. An incredibly powerful axe. An axe powerful enough for me to have quite a bit of fun, indeed.
traduit: 一把斧头，一把威力无比的斧头，一把能让我找到无数乐子的斧头。

original: If you bring it to me, I'll grant you my boon. No strings attached. No messy surprises. At least, not for you.
traduit: 如果你把它带回来。我就赠予你恩惠。没有附加条件。没有恶意惊喜。至少对你来说没有。

original: As I recall, it's resting in Rimerock Burrow. Barbas can lead you right to it. The little mutt might even earn his place back at my side.
traduit: 我记得它在雾凇岩地洞。巴巴斯会带你去。这条小串儿狗说不定还能回到我身边呢。

original: What's your offer?
traduit: 你有什么提议？

original: In Rimerock Burrow, there's an artifact called the Rueful Axe. Bring it to me, and I'll take Barbas back. Simple as that.
traduit: 在雾凇岩地洞，藏着一把叫悔恨之斧的神器。拿来给我，我带巴巴斯走。就这么简单。

original: What did you want, again?
traduit: 你想要什么来着？

original: As much as I hate to say it, you're almost as powerful as I am right now. But that's just because half of my power resides in that mutt, Barbas.
traduit: 虽然我不想这么说，但你和现在的我几乎一样强了。不过那是因为我一半的力量都在那个串儿狗巴巴斯身上。

original: Come to think of it, I know of a win-win situation for both of us.
traduit: 我想起来，有一个共赢的方案。

original: The power to crush all before me!
traduit: 让我拥有粉碎面前一切的力量！

original: Really? Power? You're a dragonborn; you already have more power than most people who aren't immense, fire-breathing monsters.
traduit: 真的？力量？你是龙裔啊。你已经比大多数人都强了，又不是人人是会喷火的怪物。

original: Really? Power? Haven't you already killed enough of your foes using the more mundane means at your disposal? Swords, magic, etc.? How... uninspired.
traduit: 真的？力量？难道世俗中的手段都满足不了你的杀戮了吗？刀剑、魔法。真是……没创意。

original: An end to the civil war that plagues my land.
traduit: 我希望困扰这片土地的内战终结。

original: Oh, if I had my full power, granting that would be trivial.
traduit: 哦，要是我在全力状态，那也就罢了。

original: I'd simply snap my fingers, and everyone in Skyrim would die. War resolved.
traduit: 只要我打个响指，天际的人都死光光。战争也就结束了。

original: Why did Vile kick you out?
traduit: 为啥维尔把你踢出来了？

original: Well... I guess you could say I got on his nerves. I tend to be the voice of reason and he finds that... irksome.
traduit: 嗯……我觉得算是把他惹火了吧。我喜欢讲道理，但他觉得那……很讨厌。

original: He couldn't just kill me, you see. We're technically part of each other. But he was able to banish me from his domain.
traduit: 他不能杀了我。严格意义上我们都是彼此的一部分。但他还是把我赶出了他的领地。

original: Of course, because of our separation, Vile is now much weaker. I guess he figured it was a small price to pay for not having to listen to me anymore.
traduit: 当然，因为我们分离开，维尔的力量也弱多了。我猜他会觉得为了耳根子清净这点代价不算啥。

original: Don't worry. I'll make sure he sees the light. I trusted you, now you trust me.
traduit: 别担心。我会说服他的。我相信你，现在你得相信我。

original: Yeah, yeah, dog gets master, master gets cosmic axe, everyone's happy. Just get over here, mutt.
traduit: 对，对，狗子找到主子，主子拿回大斧子，皆大欢喜，皆大欢喜。快过来吧，你个串儿。

original: I knew I could trust you!
traduit: 我就知道你靠得住！

original: I see he's having a good influence on you.
traduit: 看起来他对你是有正面影响的。

original: Yeah, rub it in. Just imagine what I could get done with my full power and none of these pesky "morals."
traduit: 是啊，别哪壶不开提哪壶。如果没了这些讨厌的“道德”，我用自己的全部力量想做什么不行？

original: Still, I've got this axe, and even if I can't use it, I'm sure someone would make a deal for it. Maybe I'll have a word with Molag Bal...
traduit: 不过，我拿回了这把斧头，我倒是用不上，不过肯定能拿它去做交易。也许该和莫拉格·巴尔谈谈……

original: I see he's having a good influence on you.
traduit: 看起来他对你是有正面影响的。

original: Maybe. For now just lay low and do your job. I have a feeling we'll be rid of the Captain soon...
traduit: 也许吧。但现在你要低调，做好你的工作。我有一种感觉，咱们快要摆脱船长了。

original: If only we could get our hands on that treasure. We could get out of here and never look back.
traduit: 如果我们能拿到那些宝藏就好了。那样就能远走高飞了。

original: The Captain has it locked away in that drowned ship by his quarters. He says it's "to keep it safe" but I know he's just keeping it for himself.
traduit: 船长把它锁在房间旁边那艘沉船上了。说是为了“保护它”，我看就是为了他自己。

original: Where did you keep all that loot?  I've been here almost a year and haven't seen any of it.
traduit: 你把赃物都藏哪儿了？我来这儿快一年了，却什么都没见过。

original: Well, before that cave-in sealed our ships in here we could loot any size ship we wanted.
traduit: 嗯，在塌方把咱们的船彻底封在这里前，我们可以随意抢劫大小船只。

original: You've been here for a while, right? What was it like back when we could still make runs out to the coast?
traduit: 你来这儿有一阵子了吧？我们还能去海边的时候是什么感觉来着？

original: I'd rather not have company right now.
traduit: 我现在不想有人跟着。

original: I understand. Some journeys must be taken alone. I'll be here if you change your mind.
traduit: 我明白了。有些旅途必须一个人前往。但如果你改主意了，我会陪你一起去。

original: You're welcome to join me.
traduit: 欢迎你加入。

original: I thank you for your kindness.
traduit: 感谢你的好意。

original: Can I help you?
traduit: 需要帮忙吗？

original: I am a traveler. A pilgrim. I follow the voice of Kynareth wherever it can be heard.
traduit: 我是旅行过来的朝圣者。我追随凯娜瑞丝的声音，无论它在哪里。

original: I've dreamed of seeing Eldergleam for years. Might I travel alongside you? I promise not to get in the way.
traduit: 我多年来都梦想目睹古光树。能让我跟你一起旅行吗？保证不会碍事的。

original: What did you have in mind?
traduit: 你想干什么？

original: Follow me. I think I can convince the tree to help us.
traduit: 跟我来。我应该能说服这棵树来帮我们。

original: I'll just take the sap. Danica was very insistent on having it.
traduit: 我还是带树汁回去吧。丹尼卡对此很坚持。

original: Very well. I can't stop you. But I can't bear to watch it, either.
traduit: 很好。我制止不了你。但我也不忍心看。

original: Do you have a better idea?
traduit: 你有更好的主意吗？

original: Well... yes. There is something.
traduit: 嗯……是的。确实有。

original: It won't repair the tree back at the temple, but we could bring them a new one.
traduit: 虽然不能修复神殿外的树，但可以给他们带一株新的回去。

original: Then stand aside. I have work to do.
traduit: 那就站一边去。我还要办事。

original: With pleasure. Nature has a way of finding vengeance, though. You walk a bleak path, friend. One that will lead to suffering.
traduit: 好吧。但大自然自有报复的办法。你走的是一条荒芜之路，朋友。只能带来痛苦。

original: I need sap to fix the Gildergreen.
traduit: 我需要汁液来修复镀绿树。

original: You would violate this marvel of Kynareth's glory to fix that half-breed stump in Whiterun?
traduit: 你打算毁坏凯娜瑞丝荣耀的神迹去修复白漫城的烂木桩子？

original: That's abominable. Barbaric. I'll have no part of this. Why didn't you tell me what you intended?
traduit: 可恶。野蛮。我不会参与这种事的。你为什么不把你的企图告诉我？

original: I had no idea you were a man of violence. What exactly are your intentions in this blessed place?
traduit: 我不知道你是个这么暴力的人。你来这里到底是为了什么？

original: I had no idea you were a woman of violence. What exactly are you intending to do here?
traduit: 我不知道你是个这么暴力的人。你来这里到底是为了什么？

original: Are you aware there's a plot to steal Frost?
traduit: 你知道有人要偷寒霜吗？

original: Don't tell me - Sibbi and Louis Letrush? Well, Sibbi is in jail and Letrush is certainly welcome to try. My hired help is more than a match for him.
traduit: 别告诉我是西比和路易士·莱特鲁什吧？嗯，西比在监狱里，莱特鲁什想要试试也欢迎。我雇的帮手可比他强多了。

original: I'm aware of who stole Frost. And why.
traduit: 我知道是谁偷了寒霜。也知道原因。

original: Are you aware that Letrush stole Frost?
traduit: 你知道莱特鲁什偷了寒霜吗？

original: I'm not interested right now, thanks.
traduit: 我现在没兴趣，谢谢。

original: That's a real shame. You would've fit the bill nicely.
traduit: 真遗憾。你很符合我的要求的。

original: Sounds easy enough.
traduit: 听起来很容易。

original: Good man. You won't regret it.
traduit: 好汉子。你不会后悔的。

original: Ah, you're a smart woman. That's exactly what I wanted to hear.
traduit: 啊，你是个聪明女人。我就想听这话。

original: What sort of message?
traduit: 什么信息？

original: Ah, well, I recently approached Sibbi Black-Briar about buying Frost, one of the finest breeding horses in Skyrim. He agreed to sell.
traduit: 哎，我最近找到西比·黑棘，想要购买寒霜。那是天际最好的马匹之一了。他也答应出售。

original: I paid Sibbi half the cost of Frost up front, but before he could deliver, Maven had him locked up. Sibbi believes this exempts him from our deal.
traduit: 我已经预付给西比一半的款项，但没等交货，他就被玛雯关起来了。西比认为这样一来我们的交易就不作数了。

original: It does not.
traduit: 他想得美。

original: I want you to talk to Sibbi for me. Then, I want you to bring me Frost and the Lineage Papers that prove the horse's worth.
traduit: 我想让你帮我和西比谈谈。然后，我要你找到寒霜，还有能够证明它价值的血统证明给我。

original: Go on, then. Deliver my message to Sibbi.
traduit: 去吧。把我的消息告诉西比。

original: I may not be fond of Letrush, but even I've got to admit he's got the upper hand.
traduit: 我可能不喜欢莱特鲁什，但不得不承认他占了优势。

original: (Sigh) Let's just kill them both, eh?
traduit: 哎，我们把他俩都杀了吧？

original: (Whimpering)
traduit: （呜咽）

original: (Sobbing)
traduit: （哭泣）

original: I… I don't know, it wasn't me. I swear!
traduit: 我……我不知道，不是我。我发誓！

original: Honest, I didn't take it!
traduit: 说真的，不是我！

original: Look at me when I'm talking to you, eh?
traduit: 我跟你说话的时候看着点我，行吗？

original: You start flapping that jaw of yours or I'll start flapping it for you. You understand me?
traduit: 你要是再不开口我可以帮你开。明白吗？

original: Where'd you stash it?
traduit: 你藏哪里了？

original: Am I going have to beat it out of you? Is that what you want?
traduit: 要我把你逼出来？这就是你想要的？

original: What do you need, guardian?
traduit: 守护者，你需要什么吗？

original: Yes, champion of Azura?
traduit: 阿祖拉的勇士？

original: The Twilight watches us all, guardian.
traduit: 暮光注视着你我，守护者。

original: Just glad all that business with Malyn is over with. What did you need?
traduit: 马林的事总算结束了。你需要什么吗？

original: I don't like doing business with Azura's faithful. Make it quick.
traduit: 我不喜欢和阿祖拉的信徒交易，走开吧。

original: No. Not like this.
traduit: 不。不该是这样。

original: Why is it so run down?
traduit: 这里怎么这么破旧？

original: Sad, isn't it? We can't afford to keep the place running since these attacks started.
traduit: 很悲哀，对吧？自从袭击开始，我们就没钱维持这个地方了。

original: Pirates, you see.
traduit: 是海盗。

original: Raiding all along the coast, from Hammerfell to Vvardenfell. Only the Shatter-Shields appear safe.
traduit: 从落锤到瓦登费尔，沿着海岸线发动袭击。只有碎盾家的船安然无恙。

original: The pirate haven has been destroyed.
traduit: 海盗的避风港已经被摧毁了。

original: I can't express how much easier you've made my job.
traduit: 我无法形容你让我的工作变得有多轻松。

original: Maybe Adelaisa will finally ease up, but I expect she won't.
traduit: 也许阿德莱萨也会放松下来，但我想她不会。

original: Ah, yes, your pay. The Company thanks you for your services. Should we ever be able to help you, stop by.
traduit: 啊，对了，你的报酬。公司感谢你的帮助。如果有什么需要，可以来找我们。

original: I know where the Blood Horkers are.
traduit: 我知道血腥海象在哪里。

original: Just in time. This is Adelaisa, one of my superiors from the Company.
traduit: 太及时了。这位是阿德莱萨，是我在公司的一位上司。

original: She's been dispatched to... eh... see to it that we get back on schedule.
traduit: 她被派来……呃……视察咱们是否按计划进行了。

original: You should probably speak to her.
traduit: 你应该和她谈谈。

original: Have you heard of a pirate crew called the Blood Horkers?
traduit: 你有没有听说过一个叫血腥海象的海盗团？

original: Heard of them? I've been captaining a crew for 'em well on nine years now. What's it to you?
traduit: 听说过没有？我已经给他们当了九年船长了？跟你有什么关系？

original: Know about them? Lad, you're looking at them.
traduit: 看见他们了吗？小伙子，远在天边近在眼前。

original: I hear you're a man who might know something about pirates.
traduit: 我听说你对海盗团有所了解。

original: Know about them? Lass, you're looking at them.
traduit: 看见他们了吗？姑娘，远在天边近在眼前。

original: I've got the logbook.
traduit: 我拿到了日记。

original: How did you get it? No, never mind, I probably shouldn't know.
traduit: 你是怎么拿到的？哦，算了，也许我不该问。

original: I see... it looks like Suvaris has been traveling to Dawnstar to meet with a pirate crew there.
traduit: 我明白了……看来苏瓦利斯去晨星见过那里的海盗。

original: Get to Dawnstar and see what you can find out about these rogues. I'd wager they won't be too far from the tavern.
traduit: 去晨星看看，能不能查到这些混蛋的下落。我敢打赌他们一定是在酒馆附近游荡。

original: Try to find out where their fortress is. The captain, Stig Salt-Plank, has to know something.
traduit: 试试能不能找到他们的堡垒在哪里。船长“咸木板”斯蒂，肯定知道些什么。

original: I'm glad I'll have you beside me in there. This place chills my blood, and I don't care who knows it.
traduit: 很高兴你在我身边。我不在乎谁这么想，但这地方有些瘆人。

original: I've returned with the courier's package.
traduit: 我带着通讯员的包裹回来了。

original: I'm looking for a courier.
traduit: 我在找信使。

original: Seen any Stormcloak couriers lately?
traduit: 最近见过风暴斗篷通讯员吗？

original: Seen any Imperial couriers lately?
traduit: 最近见过帝国通讯员吗？

original: What would it take to identify the buyer? (Bribe)
traduit: 怎样才能让我知道买主的身份？（贿赂）

original: Well, now that you mention it, there is something I've been trying to get my hands on.
traduit: 既然你都这么说了，我有件一直想弄到手的东西。

original: Great Malacath, we beseech you, aid us in our time of need...
traduit: 伟大的玛拉凯斯，我们恳求您，在我们需要的时候给予帮助……

original: What efforts would they be undermining?
traduit: 他们会破坏什么努力？

original: This! This... Orb. The Eye of Magnus, whatever you want to call it. It's clearly powerful, and no doubt they want it for themselves!
traduit: 这个！这个……球体。玛格努斯之眼，随便你怎么叫。它很明显十分强大，这一点毫无疑问，他们自己肯定也想要！

original: I expect to be informed if they make any future attempts to contact you.
traduit: 如果他们将来试图联系你，希望你能通知我。

original: Get to the bottom of what?
traduit: 弄清什么真相？

original: Whatever it is those Psijics are up to. They cannot be trusted.
traduit: 不管那些赛伊克想干什么。他们都不值得信任。

original: For all we know, he's here to scout out the College. I'm sure they want to undermine our efforts.
traduit: 据我们所知，他是来侦察学院情况的。我敢肯定，他们想要破坏我们的努力。

original: I'm not sure what just happened but I assure you I will get to the bottom of it.
traduit: 我不知道刚才发生了什么，但我向你保证，我会查个水落石出的。

original: I am not "up to" anything. I apologize if I have offended in any way.
traduit: 我没有什么“企图”。如有冒犯，万望见谅。

original: What? What trickery is this? You're not going anywhere until I find out what you're up to!
traduit: 什么？这是耍什么把戏？在我查清你的企图前你哪儿也别想去！

original: There's been a misunderstanding. Clearly I should not be here. I shall simply take my leave.
traduit: 这里肯定有什么误会。看来我不应该继续待在这里了。告辞。

original: Don't play coy. You asked to see a specific member of the College. Here he is. Now what is it that you want?
traduit: 别跟我打马虎眼。这是你点名要见的学院成员，现在他来了。你到底想干什么？

original: Don't play coy. You asked to see a specific member of the College. Here she is. Now what is it that you want?
traduit: 别跟我打马虎眼。这是你点名要见的学院成员，现在她来了。你到底想干什么？

original: I'm sorry, I'm afraid I don't understand.
traduit: 抱歉，恐怕我不明白您的意思。

original: Well? What is the meaning of this?
traduit: 嗯？这是什么意思？

original: None can stand against the Wolf Queen!
traduit: 没人能敌得过狼后！

original: I can see to that. We'll need plenty of fresh corpses to rebuild her army, you see.
traduit: 交给我吧。我们需要大量的新鲜尸体来重建她的军队。

original: You've come far, mortal. No doubt you seek to enter Potema's Sanctum.
traduit: 你走得很远啊，凡人。不用问，你是想进入波特玛的密室吧。

original: Did she, now? Well, as it turns out, there are a few lingering contracts we haven't had the chance to complete just yet.
traduit: 是吗？嗯，没错，还有一些契约悬而未决。

original: And more, dribbling in from time to time. I'll assign them to you as they become available. To be completed at your leisure.
traduit: 而且，时不时地有新的加进来。一有空我就把它们分配给你。抽空完成吧。

original: Astrid said you'd have some work for me.
traduit: 阿斯垂德说你有工作要给我。

original: So what's the plan?
traduit: 所以计划是什么？

original: Head to the Riften jail and talk to Sibbi. Get him to tell you where Frost and his Lineage Papers are and bring them to me outside Riften.
traduit: 去裂谷城监狱和西比谈谈。让他告诉你寒霜和他的血统证明在哪里，找到之后到裂谷城外给我。

original: You'll be well paid for your time.
traduit: 我会付很丰厚的报酬。

original: But this is supposed to be your work.
traduit: 但这本就是你的工作。

original: I really don't have time to deal with you right now. Please just let me get back to my work.
traduit: 我现在真的没时间和你磨烦。请让我继续工作吧。

original: Here's the ring.
traduit: 戒指在这儿。

original: Excellent! Sorry it didn't work out with you and your lady. I know how excited you were for the wedding.
traduit: 太好了！你们俩没能结合真是太遗憾了。你明明那么期待婚礼。

original: You kept saying it would be a huge ceremony at Morvunskar. You said you even had some magic staff there that would handle all the guests.
traduit: 你一直说会在莫万斯卡举办隆重的婚礼。你还说你还有法杖能招待所有宾客。

original: What was that story about my fiancee?
traduit: 我未婚妻是怎么回事儿？

original: How could you forget? It was the sweetest story I'd ever heard.
traduit: 你怎么会忘了呢？这可是我听过最甜蜜的故事。

original: You met at the full moon, under the biggest tree in Witchmist Grove, surrounded by fireflies. It was straight out of a storybook.
traduit: 满月时，你们相识在女巫迷雾树林最大的树下，身旁还有萤火虫围绕。就像故事书里的描写一样。

original: Yeah, I've been getting that a lot.
traduit: 是啊，我听了好些次了。

original: Aw, what's wrong? Did the engagement fall through? Look, how about we call it even, as long as you bring back the wedding ring?
traduit: 啊，怎么了？订婚泡汤了？这样，不如你把结婚戒指拿回来？这样我们扯平了。

original: That's really a shame - I was so looking forward to the wedding. You said you'd have all the most interesting guests.
traduit: 真遗憾，我本来很期待婚礼举行的。你说过会邀请一大群客人。

original: Okay, how much do I owe you?
traduit: 好吧，我该付你多少？

original: It's not about the money, really. I wouldn't have given you the wedding ring on credit if you weren't so obviously in love.
traduit: 真的跟钱没关系。如果你们不是那么相爱，我才不会赊账卖你婚戒呢。

original: But if there isn't going to be a wedding, the least you can do is give the ring back. That was one of my best pieces.
traduit: 但如果你不打算举行婚礼，至少把戒指还给我。那可是我最好的作品之一。

original: So, you're finally back. Look, I've been patient, but you still owe me.
traduit: 你终于回来了。看，我倒是很有耐心，但你还是欠我的。

original: Here's your goat. Now can you help me retrace my steps?
traduit: 这是你的羊。现在你应该能帮我回忆一下行程了？

original: Gleda! And not a scratch on her! Happy day!
traduit: 格丽达！毫发无损！太好了！

original: I still can't figure out why you stole her. You left a note explaining it, but half of it was gibberish and the rest had mead spilled on it.
traduit: 我还是不太明白你为什么偷她。你留了张字条，但是上面一半是胡言乱语，另一半撒的全是蜜酒。

original: Only bit I could make out was "repaying Ysolda in Whiterun," and even that's mostly scribbles. Guess you could try there.
traduit: 我只能读懂一丁点，写着“把钱还给白漫城的伊索尔达”，不过写的也很潦草。我觉得你应该到那里问问。

original: What happened with Gleda again? I'm a little fuzzy on that.
traduit: 格丽达怎么了？我记不清了。

original: You really don't remember stealing a goat and selling her to a Giant? Are you thick?
traduit: 你真的不记得自己偷了只山羊卖给巨人了？你糊涂了？

original: Go get her! At least she's bound to follow you back - you smell just like the fermented feed she likes.
traduit: 去找她！她应该会跟着你回来，你身上闻着就像她最喜欢的发酵饲料。

original: That sounds pretty bad...
traduit: 听着不太妙啊……

original: You're damned right it does. I'll never breed another prize-winning goat like Gleda!
traduit: 你说的太对了。我再也养不出像格丽达这样出色的山羊了！

original: And don't you think of coming back to Rorikstead until you get her back from that Giant.
traduit: 在你把她从巨人手里救回来前，别想回洛利克镇。

original: I have no idea what you're talking about.
traduit: 我不知道你在说什么。

original: Is that so? Does the name Gleda ring a bell? The star beauty of my farm? Kidnapped by a drunk lout and sold to a Giant?
traduit: 是吗？格丽达，听着耳熟吗？我农场里的明星小美女？被一个酒鬼绑架卖给了巨人？

original: You'd better remember her right fast, before I call the guards and have you hauled away.
traduit: 在我喊卫兵把你拖走之前，最好把她想起来。

original: I'm sorry?
traduit: 抱歉？

original: Sorry's not good enough! Not while my Gleda is still out there, alone and afraid. You kidnapped her and sold her to that Giant.
traduit: 光说对不起有什么用？我的格丽达还孤孤零零地在外面担惊受怕。你把她绑架了，还卖给了巨人。

original: You! You've got a lot of nerve showing yourself in this town again. What do you have to say for yourself?
traduit: 你！你还敢在镇子上露面。你还有什么要说的吗？

original: If you had to kill your own brother to be allowed back home, you'd think twice as well.
traduit: 如果你要杀了你的亲兄弟才能回家，那你也该好好想想。

original: Don't tell me you, of all people, are afraid of a battle.
traduit: 别告诉你居然还会害怕战斗。

original: I would need to challenge the chief, and take his head, to return home. I'd rather stay here.
traduit: 我需要向酋长提出挑战，砍了他的脑袋，然后才能回家。我宁愿待在这儿。

original: I really do apologize. I think I've picked up everything.
traduit: 实在抱歉。我已经把所有东西收拾好了。

original: I suppose that'll do. Dibella teaches us forgiveness, after all. Even for a drunk like you.
traduit: 我想这样就行了。毕竟迪贝拉教导我们要学会宽容。即使是你这种烂酒鬼。

original: DialogueGenericSharedInfo
traduit: DialogueGenericSharedInfo

original: Don't do that.
traduit: 别这样。

original: Oh no! By the gods! This can't be happening!
traduit: 哦不！神啊！不应该是这样的！

original: You dirty thief!
traduit: 你这个小贼！

original: Stop, thief!
traduit: 停下，小偷！

original: Of course.
traduit: 当然。

original: It can't be helped.
traduit: 没办法。

original: Not my problem.
traduit: 这不是我的问题。

original: It would seem so.
traduit: 看起来是这样。

original: It's all in this note.
traduit: 都在这张字条里。

original: You've done well.
traduit: 你干得好。

original: Maybe you can help me.
traduit: 也许你能帮我。

original: Thank you. Here, this is for you.
traduit: 谢谢。给，这是给你的。

original: Just bring it back to me.
traduit: 把它带回来给我。

original: I can pay you.
traduit: 我会给你报酬的。

original: Okay. Just this once.
traduit: 好吧。就这一次。

original: How can I argue with that?
traduit: 我有什么可反驳的呢？

original: Okay, okay. You've talked me into it.
traduit: 好吧，好吧。你说服我了。

original: No need to get rough!
traduit: 没必要这么粗鲁！

original: Whatever you say!
traduit: 你说了算！

original: Don't hurt me! You win.
traduit: 别伤害我！你赢了。

original: A little coin always greases the wheels.
traduit: 小小的金币总是能疏通关节。

original: Gold solves most problems, doesn't it?
traduit: 金子能解决的问题多得很，是吧？

original: For that price? Sure.
traduit: 这个价格？好啊。

original: You expect me to believe that?
traduit: 你以为我会信吗？

original: That doesn't change anything.
traduit: 这改变不了任何事。

original: I'll teach you to talk to me that way!
traduit: 敢和我这么说话，看我教训你！

original: Hope you're willing to back those words up with your fists!
traduit: 希望你的拳头硬到能支持这些话！

original: I don't have to take that from you!
traduit: 我没必要听你的！

original: We've got an assassin! Check the shadows!
traduit: 我们抓到刺客了！查查影子！

original: What are you staring at, you worthless piece of gutter trash? I simply must start locking the doors again...
traduit: 你在看什么，你这没用的废物？我又得重新锁门了……

original: Aretino? Why that little bastard! You tell him I'm coming for him! And when I find him, it will be the beating of his miserable life!
traduit: 艾瑞提诺？怎么是那个小混蛋！去告诉他，我要去找他了！等我抓住他，他那悲惨的一生免不了再受打击！

original: Aventus Aretino says hello.
traduit: 阿文图斯·艾瑞提诺向你问好。

original: The what? Why how dare you! I will not be intimidated in my own orphanage! Get out! Get out this instant!
traduit: 什么？你敢威胁我！我还不会在自己的孤儿院被吓到！滚出去！立马滚出去！

original: The Dark Brotherhood has come, Grelod.
traduit: 桂罗，黑暗兄弟会来了。

original: I have a family heirloom you can have. Supposed to be sort of valuable. I hope that's all right.
traduit: 我有一件传家宝可以给你。应该很值钱。希望你收下。

original: Assassinations don't come cheap, boy.
traduit: 小子，请人刺杀价钱不便宜啊。

original: Finally! My prayers have been answered!
traduit: 太好了！我的祈祷终于应验了！

original: You've come at last! I knew you would!
traduit: 你终于来了！我就知道你会来的！

original: Grelod is the headmistress of Honorhall Orphanage. But not for long.
traduit: 桂罗是荣耀堂孤儿院的院长。但她当不了多久了。

original: It's Honorhall Orphanage, in Riften.
traduit: 在裂谷城的荣耀堂孤儿院。

original: Please don't kill Constance Michel. She really is kind.
traduit: 千万不要杀了康斯坦斯·米切尔，她是个好人。

original: Well? Is it done?
traduit: 嗯？成功了吗？

original: Grelod the Kind. Is she... you know?
traduit: 慈祥的桂罗。你是不是把她……那啥了？

original: What do you want? You have no business being in here!
traduit: 你想干什么？你不该在这儿！

original: Riff-raff! That's all you Riften people are!
traduit: 闲杂垃圾！你们裂谷城人都这个德行！

original: This is an orphanage, not an inn. Begone from here.
traduit: 这是孤儿院，不是旅馆。赶紧出去。

original: You're trying to frighten me, hmm? Do your worst!
traduit: 想吓唬我？别做梦了！

original: Contract?
traduit: 契约？

original: My mother, she... she died. I... I'm all alone now. So they sent me to that terrible orphanage in Riften. Honorhall.
traduit: 我母亲，她……她去世了。我……成了孤儿。所以他们就把我送到了裂谷城那个可怕的荣耀堂孤儿院里。

original: The headmistress is an evil, cruel woman. They call her Grelod the Kind. But she's not kind. She's terrible. To all of us.
traduit: 那个院长是个邪恶残忍的老女人。人家都叫她“慈祥的桂罗”。但她一点也不慈祥，她对我们所有人来说都很可怕。

original: So I ran away, and came home. And performed the Black Sacrament. Now you're here! And you can kill Grelod the Kind!
traduit: 所以我逃回家了。然后执行了黑色圣礼。现在你来了！你应该去杀了慈祥的桂罗！

original: (Remain silent)
traduit: （保持沉默）

original: You don't have to say anything. There's no need. You're here, so I know you'll accept my contract.
traduit: 你什么都不用说了。我知道，你既然来了，就一定会接受我的契约。

original: Yes, of course... The Black Sacrament...
traduit: 对，没错……黑色圣礼……

original: It took so long. So very long. But now that you're here, you can accept my contract.
traduit: 我等了太久太久了。但既然你来了，就接受我的契约吧。

original: I'm sorry boy, but I'm not who you think I am.
traduit: 抱歉，孩子。我不是你想得那种人。

original: Of course you are! I prayed, and you came, and now you'll accept my contract!
traduit: 你当然是！我祈祷了，你就来了，现在你得接受我的契约！

original: It worked! I knew you'd come, I just knew it!
traduit: 成功了！我就知道你会来，我就知道！

original: I did the Black Sacrament, over and over. With the body, and the... the things. And then you came! An assassin from the Dark Brotherhood!
traduit: 我一遍又一遍执行黑色圣礼。守着这具尸体，还有……这堆东西。你终于来了！黑暗兄弟会的刺客！

original: Was a man named Sam with me?
traduit: 有个叫山姆的和我一起吗？

original: Dibella teaches love and compassion, but that doesn't mean we're just going to tell you what you want to know and let you walk away from this.
traduit: 迪贝拉教导我们充满爱心和同情。但不代表我们要告诉你想知道的事，然后放你走。

original: Pick up your mess, then apologize, and if we think you're sincere we'll consider lending you aid.
traduit: 把你自己弄得烂摊子收拾好，然后道歉，如果够真诚，我们会考虑帮你。

original: Wake up!
traduit: 起来！

original: That's right, it's time to wake up, you drunken blasphemer!
traduit: 没错，该醒醒了，你这醉鬼亵渎者！

original: Thanks, I guess.
traduit: 那，谢谢了。

original: My pleasure. But I think it's time for you to go. No fun keeping you locked up in here with the staff.
traduit: 我的荣幸。不过，我觉得你该走了。把你和法杖关在这里也怪没意思的。

original: Why did you choose me?
traduit: 你为什么选择我？

original: Let's be honest, here. I don't always think my decisions through.  But you... you're going places.
traduit: 老实说吧。我做决定的时候时常不细考虑。但是你……去过不少地方。

original: Maybe a little influence from your old uncle Sanguine could help adjust your course a bit...
traduit: 也许啊，你桑吉恩老叔的一点影响可以帮你调整一下路线……

original: So all of this was just a prank?
traduit: 所以这一切都是恶作剧？

original: Just a prank? Just a prank? The Daedric Lord of Debauchery does not deal in mere "pranks."
traduit: 恶作剧？恶作剧？迪德拉的放荡君王可不止在“恶作剧”哦。

original: This may have begun as a minor amusement, but it wasn't long before I realized you'd make a more interesting bearer of my not-quite-holy staff.
traduit: 刚开始可能是个玩笑，但没过多久，我就意识到，你或许适合拿着我这把不咋神圣的法杖。

original: I really just needed something to encourage you to go out into the world and spread merriment.
traduit: 我只是想鼓励你去全世界传播欢乐而已。

original: And you did just that! I haven't been so entertained in at least a hundred years.
traduit: 然后你做到了！我少说也有一百年没这么开心了。

original: I could sure use a staff like that...
traduit: 我确实需要一把法杖……

original: So... you were telling me a tale?
traduit: 所以……你在跟我讲故事？

original: What did I do? Please, whatever it is, I'm sorry.
traduit: 我做了什么？求你了，不管做了什么，都是我不好。

original: I don't have time for this nonsense. I've got a home to keep and children to feed. Now let me out of here!
traduit: 我没时间和你废话。我还要养家弄孩子。现在放我走！

original: Tell you what. You release me, and I promise my associates won't hunt you down like an animal and butcher you in the street. It's a win-win.
traduit: 告诉你。你放了我，我保证我的同伙不会像抓畜生一样把你在街上宰了。双赢嘛。

original: My name is Fultheim. I'm a soldier. Well, mercenary, really. You know, a... a sellsword. I've lived in Skyrim all my life.
traduit: 我叫弗瑟姆，是个士兵。嗯，给钱就行那种。你明白……雇佣兵。我一辈子都住在天际。

original: That's all! I'm a nobody, really. So can't you just let me go?
traduit: 就这些！我就是个无名小卒，真的。你就不能放了我吗？

original: None of your damned business who I am! If you're going to kill me, just do it already!
traduit: 我是谁和你有什么关系！要想杀我赶紧动手！

original: As Mara is my witness, if I didn't have this hood on right now I would spit right in your face...
traduit: 玛拉给我作证，要是没戴着这个破麻袋，我早啐你了……

original: Ahhh... Vasha, at your service. Obtainer of goods, taker of lives, and defiler of daughters.
traduit: 啊……鄙人瓦沙，乐意效劳。敛财、杀人、糟蹋姑娘，我都干。

original: Have you not heard of me? Perhaps I will have my people carve my name in your corpse, as a reminder.
traduit: 没听说过我吗？也许我该叫我手下人把我的名字刻在你尸体上作为纪念。

original: Would someone pay to have you killed?
traduit: 有人会花钱杀你吗？

original: What? Oh gods, I don't want to die...
traduit: 什么？哦天啊，我不想死……

original: Excuse me? What kind of question is that?
traduit: 我没听清，你问的什么？

original: Me? Ha! Are you serious?
traduit: 我？哈！你开玩笑呢？

original: Did you ever want to return to your stronghold? Go back to your family?
traduit: 你有没有想回过你的要塞吗？想回去找家人吗？

original: You didn't die. A battle you live through is a great honor.
traduit: 你没死。你所经历的每一次战争都是莫大的荣耀。

original: There you are. Look, I... I just wanted to say thanks for coming to find me. Back in Dawnstar. Crazy jester finally met his match, am I right?
traduit: 你来了。那个，我……只是想感谢你去晨星城找我。那个疯子小丑终于碰上对手了吧？

original: The anticipation is killing me. Can you figure out who has the contract? Which one will you choose?
traduit: 等待真是煎熬啊。你能找出谁才是契约的目标吗？你想选哪个？

original: That twisted jester will pay for what's he's done...
traduit: 那个扭曲的小丑要为他的所作所为付出代价……

original: I'm afraid I don't have a primary contract for you yet.
traduit: 恐怕我现在没小契约给你。

original: Why am I not surprised to learn Cicero is alive? I still can't stomach the little clown, but if you've welcomed him here, I won't question it.
traduit: 为什么听说西塞罗活着我一点都不惊讶呢？我还是受不了这个小丑，但如果你欢迎他来，那我不会反对的。

original: Maybe I'll make the Potage le Magnifique, hmm? You may have killed the Gourmet, but true artistry never dies.
traduit: 也许我该做点美味浓汤？你是杀了美食家，但真正的厨艺是永远不死的。

original: Maybe I'll make the Potage le Magnifique, hmm? But not the way you make it! Ha ha ha. No, certainly not...
traduit: 也许我该做点美味浓汤？但不能用你的配方！哈哈哈哈！当然不能用……

original: I've been expecting you.
traduit: 我一直在等你。

original: Should have figured the little lunatic would completely snap.
traduit: 我早该想到这个小疯子会彻底爆发的。

original: So, what of the old beggar, Narfi? Is it done? Has he groveled for his last septim?
traduit: 怎么样，那个老乞丐纳菲怎么样了？他有没有为自己最后一枚塞普汀趴在地上？

original: How went your meeting with Ennodius Papius? Did you prove his paranoia legitimate?
traduit: 你和恩诺迪尤斯·帕尤斯的会面怎么样？有没有向他证明他自己的偏执是正确的？

original: I see you're back from Dawnstar. Beitild lies dead, I hope?
traduit: 从晨星回来了啊。但愿贝提尤德已经死了？

original: You're alive. Then I guess you haven't paid a visit to the vampire yet, hmm?
traduit: 你还活着。你还没去找那个吸血鬼吗？

original: Please tell me you flayed that horrible bard alive and made a drum from his skin...
traduit: 请一定告诉我，你活剥了那个恶心诗人的皮做了个鼓……

original: Taken care of that layabout Deekus, yet? Or does the idea of killing a fellow Argonian make your scales crawl?
traduit: 搞定那个懒汉蒂库斯了吗？还是说杀个阿尔贡会让你的鳞片感觉有点冷？

original: No new boots? Does this mean the Argonian is still alive?
traduit: 没穿新靴子？这么说那个阿尔贡还活着？

original: You smell like dead cat. Can I assume Ma'randru-jo has been taken care of?
traduit: 你闻着像只死猫一样。玛'兰德鲁-约已经被料理了？

original: How went your encounter with  Ma'randru-jo? Back in Hammerfell, I always loved watching two cats rip each other to shreds...
traduit: 你和玛'兰德鲁-约的会面如何？在落锤时，我特别喜欢看两只猫互撕……

original: Hmph. No arrows protruding from your skull... Can I assume Anoriath is dead, then?
traduit: 嗯。你脑袋上没带着箭回来……看来阿诺利亚斯已经死了？

original: Ah, back from Fort Graymoor. The old servant has been put out of her misery, I hope?
traduit: 啊，从灰色荒原堡回来了。看来那个老仆人已经解脱了吧？

original: So, you've returned from Mzinchaleft! A Dwarven ruin... what an exotic place for a kill. Assuming Maluril is actually... dead?
traduit: 从姆津查莱夫特回来了啊！在矮人遗迹这种充满异族情调的地方杀人。玛鲁利尔死了吗？

original: Back from your little vacation in Falkreath. So, did you enjoy the sights, sample the food... kill the housecarl?
traduit: 从佛克瑞斯度假回来了啊。喜欢那里的风景和食物吗？侍卫死了吗？

original: You haven't faced that pirate captain yet, have you? Safia? I only ask because you're still alive...
traduit: 你还没面对那个海盗船长吧？叫萨非亚来着？我这么问只是因为你还活着……

original: So many contracts, so little time...
traduit: 契约多得很，时间不宽裕啊。

original: Will there ever come a time when the people of Skyrim no longer need our services? I think not.
traduit: 说不定有一天，天际的人们不再需要我们的服务？我看不会。

original: Still here? What's the matter, can't handle what I'm throwing your way?
traduit: 还在呢？怎么了，我给你的任务处理不了吗？

original: I wish I had more contracts to dole out. You handled those jobs like a born killer.
traduit: 我希望能发给你更多契约。你处理起来就像个天生的杀手。

original: You reek of death, my friend. I salute you.
traduit: 你浑身散发着死亡的气息，朋友。向你致敬。

original: Remember the passphrase: "Silence, my brother."
traduit: 记住密语——“是沉寂，我的兄弟。”

original: The Sanctuary is in the southern Pine Forest. Close to the road, but away from prying eyes.
traduit: 圣所就在南部的松林里。离大路不远，但不太容易被窥探到。

original: Have you talked to Nazir? He's sure to have some additional contracts for you.
traduit: 和纳兹尔谈过了？他肯定有额外的契约要给你。

original: I don't have anything for you just yet. Please, talk to Nazir, and see what he has available.
traduit: 我还没东西要给你。去吧，找纳兹尔谈谈，看看他有什么契约。

original: I'm still trying to find a suitable contract for you. Continue to work with Nazir on the, um, supplemental assignments.
traduit: 我还在为你寻找一份合适的契约。继续和纳兹尔做那个，呃，附加任务吧。

original: The Keeper will be arriving soon, with the body of the Night Mother. So many preparations to be made...
traduit: 守护者很快就要带着夜母的尸体到这里来了，还有很多准备要做……

original: Go, take care of the Muiri contract. There will be plenty more, I promise you.
traduit: 去吧，处理好暮蕊的契约。还会有更多的，我保证。

original: Why are you still standing there? Hurry, before the meeting begins.
traduit: 怎么还站在这儿？快点，会议要开始了。

original: Speak with Nazir and see if he has any contracts available. I need time to read Motierre's letter.
traduit: 跟纳兹尔谈谈吧，看看他有什么契约可做。我需要些时间来读一下莫提雷的信。

original: What are you waiting for? My husband is out there somewhere with that lunatic. Find them! Do what you've been tasked to do!
traduit: 你还在等什么？我丈夫和那个疯子还在外面。找到他们！做你该做的事！

original: Shouldn't you be out ruining someone's special day?
traduit: 你不是该去毁了某人的好日子吗？

original: Ah, good to see you, brother. Gearing up to kill the Emperor? Exciting times. Exciting times, indeed.
traduit: 哦，很高兴见到你，兄弟。准备好刺杀皇帝了吗？真是激动人心的时刻啊。

original: Ah, good to see you, sister. Gearing up to kill the Emperor? Exciting times. Exciting times, indeed.
traduit: 哦，很高兴见到你，姐妹。准备好刺杀皇帝了吗？真是激动人心的时刻啊。

original: Cicero is at your service, oh great and powerful Listener!
traduit: 西塞罗随时听候差遣，伟大、强大的聆听者！

original: Let's kill someone.
traduit: 一起去杀人吧。

original: Citizen?
traduit: 公民？

original: You must be lost. The tavern is down the road a piece.
traduit: 你一定是迷路了。酒馆在路那边。

original: I'm fairly certain you wandered into the wrong building, friend...
traduit: 我确信你一定是走错地方了，朋友……

original: Yes, Listener?
traduit: 嗯，聆听者？

original: I am yours to command.
traduit: 听候差遣。

original: How may I serve you, my Listener?
traduit: 有什么可以效劳的吗，聆听者？

original: Yes, Listener? How may I serve you?
traduit: 嗯，聆听者？有什么可以效劳吗？

original: Listener. It is an honor to stand before you.
traduit: 聆听者。很荣幸与您见面。

original: Please...
What is it you want?
traduit: 你想要什么？

original: Just... just stop. And I'll tell you where I've hidden my treasure.
traduit: 请……停下来。我会告诉你宝藏藏在哪。

original: It's... in a hollowed-out rock. In the tundra. A bit west of Whiterun. Now please... please stop.
traduit: 在……一个挖空的石头了。就在白漫西面一点的苔原上。请……停下吧。

original: Oh gods, you've taken everything I have. Just kill me and be done with it...
traduit: 天啊，你夺走了我的一切。杀了我算了……

original: Why are you people doing this?
traduit: 你们为什么要这么做？

original: Is it information you want?
traduit: 你要什么消息？

original: This... this is about the inheritance, isn't it? All right! I'll tell you where I've hidden it.
traduit: 是……关于遗产的事吧？好吧！我告诉你藏在哪。

original: It's in a hollowed-out tree stump. In the marsh, south of Solitude. Now please, you'll let me go now. Right?
traduit: 在独孤城南面沼泽，一个挖空的树桩里，求你了，放我走吧。好吗？

original: Why don't you be a dear and let me go now. All right? I won't say a word to anyone. Our little secret. I promise.
traduit: 你为什么就不能放我走呢。怎么样？我不会跟任何人说的。我们之间的小秘密。我保证。

original: You... you can't do this to me...
traduit: 你……你不能这么对我……

original: Do you have any idea who I am? When my father hears about this, he will gut you.
traduit: 你知道我是谁吗？要是我爸知道了，他会杀了你的。

original: Ah, now I understand. This is about that my father's hidden cache, isn't it? The dowry for my wedding.
traduit: 哦，我明白了。是我父亲藏起来的东西吧？我的嫁妆。

original: Ha! Well it's safely hidden away, in a hollowed-out tree stump. Just outside Riften, tucked away nice and secure. You'll never find it.
traduit: 哈！好吧，它就藏在裂谷城外一个被挖空的树桩里，很安全。你永远也找不到。

original: Damn it. I gave it away, didn't I?
traduit: 该死的。我这是说漏嘴了？

original: I'll tell you anything. Anything! Just please stop... hurting me...
traduit: 我什么都告诉你。什么都告诉你！请不要……再伤害我了……

original: I just...  can't take the pain. Not a second longer.
traduit: 我……吃不了这样的苦。一秒也受不了了。

original: I'll give you money. Treasure. I have some things hidden away. Take them all. They're yours. Just please... stop.
traduit: 我给你钱，宝藏。我把东西藏起来了。都给你，都给你。请……停下。

original: Just north of Windhelm. There's a hollowed-out rock. I have some things hidden in there. Take them! They're yours.
traduit: 在风舵城北，一个挖空的石头里。我藏了些东西。拿走吧！都是你的了。

original: I've told you everything I can. I don't know what else you could want...
traduit: 我能告诉你的全说了。我不知道你还想要什么……

original: So... wait. Cicero is alive? And we're all friends again? I swear, I can hardly keep up...
traduit: 所以……等等。西塞罗还活着？我们又是朋友了？我真是有点跟不上了……

original: You know, I can still sell you some potions and such, or train you in alchemy.
traduit: 我还可以卖你些药水什么的，或者训练你的炼金术。

original: I like it here. We should have moved to Dawnstar ages ago.
traduit: 我喜欢这里。我们早就该搬到晨星来了。

original: I can't wait to see what the future brings.
traduit: 我等不及要看未来会发生什么了。

original: Do you need alchemy components? Or training?
traduit: 你需要炼金材料嘛？或者训练？

original: Hello, Listener.
traduit: 你好啊，聆听者。

original: What do you think? Some more Nirnroot, maybe?
traduit: 你想要些什么？来点奈恩根吗？

original: I learned to cook from my father. Ah, but that was a long time ago. Before, you know... I killed him. But let's not talk about that now.
traduit: 我以前和父亲学过做饭。啊，但那是很久之前了。就在，那个……我杀了他以前。但我们现在不谈这个了。

original: I'll follow you till I'm dust in the breeze. You do realize that?
traduit: 我会追随你直至化为风中尘埃。你知道吗？

original: This place is already starting to feel like home. Must be all the bloodstains.
traduit: 这地方开始有家的感觉了。肯定到处都是血迹。

original: What do you need, Listener?
traduit: 你需要什么吗，聆听者？

original: Listener, please... if Cicero is going to be a part of this Sanctuary I'll accept that. But can't you do something about the... dancing?
traduit: 聆听者，拜托……如果西塞罗要成为圣所的一份子，我愿意接受。但你就不能想办法让他别……跳舞吗？

original: Got to admit, I find the Night Mother's presence... comforting.
traduit: 不得不说，夜母的存在让人……心安。

original: The new initiates are working out well. Eager, dedicated, and not afraid to get their hands wet.
traduit: 新人工作很好。热情敬业，不怕弄脏手。

original: Things proceeding well, Listener?
traduit: 进展顺利吗，聆听者？

original: The Dark Brotherhood is on the rise again, Listener. I can feel it.
traduit: 聆听者，黑暗兄弟会再次崛起了。我能感觉得到。

original: Cicero can talk for a moment. Just a moment. Then Mother must be... tended to.
traduit: 西塞罗可以聊一会儿。就一会儿哦。还要……照料母亲嘛。

original: Oh, I do wish to get to know you better. But I must tend to mother. Maybe we can talk for just a moment...
traduit: 我真想再多和你聊聊。但我必须照顾母亲。也许我们可以谈一小会儿。

original: Yes, Listener? How can Cicero be of service?
traduit: 嗯，聆听者？有西塞罗可以效劳的吗？

original: Aha! I knew you could do it! I just knew it! I knew the Dark Brotherhood would save me!
traduit: 啊哈！我就知道你能行！我就知道！我就知道黑暗兄弟会能救我！

original: Here, just like I promised. This should fetch you a nice price. And thank you. Thank you again.
traduit: 给，这是我承诺的报酬。应该能卖个好价钱。谢谢你，真的很谢谢你。

original: Grelod the Kind is dead.
traduit: 慈祥的桂罗死了。

original: Where would I go to join up?
traduit: 我该到哪里入伙呢？

original: Well I can't just tell that to any skeever that washes up.
traduit: 我可不能把这些事随便告诉给什么水耗子。

original: From the look of you, I'm guessing you're more looking to cause some trouble for the Horkers.
traduit: 看你的表情更像是想给海象团找麻烦。

original: Haldyn will take my hide for this, but Skyrim's been feeling a bit confining lately.
traduit: 哈尔丁让我藏在这儿，但最近在天际感觉有点受限。

original: We draw council at Japhet's Folly. The fools in Windhelm won't go near it, which is fine by us.
traduit: 我们都是在贾菲特之愚开会。风舵城的傻子们不会靠近，对我们来说是好事。

original: If you'll pardon me now, my crew needs gathering. Should be in Hammerfell before the other Horkers know who let slip their secret.
traduit: 失陪了，我得去集合船员。我得赶在其他海象团的知道是谁泄密之前赶回落锤。

original: So where are the Blood Horkers?
traduit: 所以血腥海象在哪？

original: You miss them? I don't know how many times I feared for my life.
traduit: 你想念它们？我不知道有多少次担心自己丢了命。

original: There were many good battles, friend. I miss those days.
traduit: 那时经历了很多大战啊，朋友。我想念那段日子。

original: Why not fight back?
traduit: 为什么不反击呢？

original: Our own security forces are limited, and all the mercenaries are tied up in this ridiculous war.
traduit: 我们自己的护卫力量有限，所有的雇佣兵又都被拘束在这场荒诞的战争里。

original: We don't even know their base of operations, and attacking single ships won't really solve the problem.
traduit: 我们甚至不知道他们的老巢在哪儿，攻击单艘船只解决不了问题。

original: Do you remember the Legion? Fighting the Thalmor in the Great War?
traduit: 你还记得军团吗？和梭默在浩大战争时作战？

original: I doubt the Forsworn would risk holding this mine a second time. They lost many of their warriors.
traduit: 我怀疑弃誓者不会再冒险来抢这个矿了。他们损失了不少战士呢。

original: Are you worried the Forsworn might return?
traduit: 你担心弃誓者还会回来吗？

original: It's the rush of good fortune, my friend. It makes you work harder.
traduit: 这是好运来了，朋友。要更努力工作了。

original: I feel like we're mining even more ore than before.
traduit: 我感觉咱们比以前挖得更多了。

original: Good to see you again, friend! We've opened the mine back up. If you're here for work, I'll buy any ore you have.
traduit: 再见到你真高兴，朋友！我们重新开放矿场了。如果你是来干活儿的，我会买下你所有的矿石的。

original: I never thought I'd see Kolskeggr again.
traduit: 真没想到我还能再见到科斯凯格。

original: The mine is just how I remember it.
traduit: 矿场还和我记忆里一样。

original: It's good to be mining again.
traduit: 能重新挖矿感觉真好。

original: I've never seen Pavo so happy. It's good to be back in Kolskeggr.
traduit: 我从没见过帕沃这么开心。能回到科斯凯格真好。

original: There, I cast the spell.
traduit: 好，我来施法。

original: Well done, indeed.
traduit: 确实干得不错。

original: Well, you clearly possess the minimum aptitude required. Congratulations. I'll escort you up to the gate.
traduit: 嗯，显然你达到了天赋的最低要求。恭喜。我来送你到大门口。

original: You'll want to speak with Mirabelle Ervine right away. And welcome to the College of Winterhold.
traduit: 你得马上和米拉贝勒·厄文谈谈。欢迎来到冬堡学院。

original: Okay, this is for the spell. (Give 30 gold)
traduit: 好吧，这是买法术的钱。（30金币）

original: Never mind. I'm not interested.
traduit: 算了。我不感兴趣。

original: No? Very well, it's your choice.
traduit: 是吗？很好，随你意愿吧。

original: I don't know the spell.
traduit: 我不懂那个法术。

original: I don't know that spell.
traduit: 我不懂那个法术。

original: Nords don't care much for magic. The College in Winterhold is about the only place it's not looked down on.
traduit: 诺德人不太关心魔法。冬堡学院是唯一不会轻视它的地方。

original: Otherwise you could talk to the Jarl's pet wizard in Solitude.
traduit: 或者你可以跟独孤城领主的宠物巫师聊聊。

original: The College of Winterhold is the only place in Skyrim open-minded enough to teach magic.
traduit: 冬堡学院是天际唯一开放到可以传授魔法的地方。

original: Although Ulfric's court wizard has been known to take on apprentices once in a while.
traduit: 尽管乌弗瑞克的宫廷巫师偶尔也会收徒的。

original: Magic? Goodness, not here! Nothing dangerous like that! That's all kept to that College up in Winterhold.
traduit: 魔法？天啊，这里没有！没有那种危险的东西！那都是冬堡学院才会碰的玩意。

original: Better that than dealing with Ulfric's wizard like some do.
traduit: 去那儿总比找乌弗瑞克的宫廷巫师好。

original: Magic is for the weak. Elves, I mean. They keep to that College in Winterhold. They know their place.
traduit: 魔法是为弱者准备的。我是说精灵。他们一直待在冬堡那所学院里。他们很明白自己的位置。

original: Of course there is Farengar. He might be the Jarl's wizard, but at least he's a Nord.
traduit: 当然还有法仁加。他虽然是领主的宫廷巫师，但好歹是诺德人。

original: Pfft, I should've guessed as much. Your kind sticks to that College in Winterhold, as well they should.
traduit: 切，我早该猜到的。你们这种人最好一直待在冬堡学院里。

original: You'd never think to learn from a Nord like the Jarl's wizard.
traduit: 你从没想过向领主的诺德巫师去学习。
