original: There's a College in Winterhold that teaches magic. It's very secretive, though, and you know how people hate secrets.
traduit: 冬堡有所学院在教授魔法。但是他们很神秘，你也知道，大家都很讨厌秘密。

original: The Jarl's court wizard was taught there. That one's full of secrets.
traduit: 领主的宫廷巫师就是在那里学习的，那里充满秘密。

original: I've got no interest in magic users. No use for their kind at all. They're way up north in Winterhold, and that's fine with me.
traduit: 我对魔法使用者没兴趣。他们一无是处。他们住在北边的冬堡，跟我也没什么关系。

original: I don't even like our Jarl havin' a  court wizard.
traduit: 我甚至不喜欢我们领主还雇了个宫廷巫师。

original: Bit of advice, folks here don't care for magic or those that use it. If you're intent on it, check at the College up in Winterhold.
traduit: 给你点建议。这里的人不喜欢魔法还有使用魔法的人。如果你下定决心了，可以去冬堡学院看看。

original: Either that or go see the Jarl's court wizard.
traduit: 要么去那儿，要么去找领主的宫廷巫师。

original: Looking to blow yourself up? I hear that's what magic does to you. There's a College in Winterhold that teaches magic, unless that blew up too.
traduit: 想把自己炸飞吗？我听说魔法就是那样。冬堡学院有个学院会教魔法，除非它也爆炸了。

original: Be a lot safer just to have the Jarl's wizard teach you a thing or two.
traduit: 让领主的宫廷巫师教你两手还安全点。

original: Magic is nothing but trouble. If you're set on it, there's that College in Winterhold or Ulfric's court wizard. But don't say I didn't warn you.
traduit: 魔法只会带来麻烦。如果你下定决心的话，冬堡学院或者乌弗瑞克的宫廷巫师都可以教你。但别说我没警告你啊。

original: The people of Skyrim don't like magic much, so about the only place you're likely to find a teacher is the College of Winterhold.
traduit: 天际的人不太喜欢魔法，所以你也只能去冬堡学院找老师了。

original: That'd be the College in Winterhold. I suppose you'll be headed there, then. Well, don't let me get in your way.
traduit: 那就是冬堡学院吧。我猜你会去的。好了，不挡你路了。

original: Seen enough magic in my day to know to stay away from it. I'd stay away from the Jarl's wizard in Dawnstar too.
traduit: 我这辈子见过很多魔法，所以知道应该远离它。所以我也会远离晨星领主的巫师。

original: If you wanna be a damn fool, go to the College in Winterhold instead.
traduit: 如果你想当个大傻子，那就去冬堡学院吧。

original: You lookin' for Falion? Why don't you go bother those mages at their College in Winterhold and leave my brother alone?
traduit: 你在找法利昂吗？还是去烦冬堡学院的法师们吧，让我兄弟一个人待着。

original: Any aspiring mage would do well to look for the College in Winterhold. Head there, and you'll get what you're after.
traduit: 任何有抱负的法师都应该去冬堡学院。那里能得到你想要的东西。

original: Although our Jarl's humble wizard might be willing to help you too.
traduit: 尽管我们领主那位谦卑的巫师可能也会愿意帮助你。

original: Magic? Got no good use for that here. Mages keep to their College in Winterhold. Go bother them.
traduit: 魔法？这东西在这儿没什么好用处。法师们都在冬堡学院里，去那儿烦他们去吧。

original: Wish the Jarl's wizard would up and leave with ya.
traduit: 真希望领主的巫师跟你一块离开。

original: Head north to Winterhold. There's a College there, they teach magic. Most Nords don't care for them.
traduit: 向北去冬堡吧。那里有个学院教导魔法。大多数诺德人不喜欢他们。

original: Else you could go see the Jarl's wizard. Might be able to help you.
traduit: 或者你也可以去找领主的巫师。也许能帮到你。

original: Magic? You're on the wrong side of Skyrim. You want Winterhold... that College there. They teach it.
traduit: 魔法？你站在天际的错误一方了。想学的话就去冬堡……那里的学院。他们会教的。

original: Otherwise you can try the Jarl's wizard. I wouldn't, though.
traduit: 或者你也可以试着去找领主的巫师。反正我是不会去。

original: Winterhold. You want the College there. They teach quite a bit.
traduit: 冬堡。你应该是想去那里加入学院。他们确实会教很多。

original: Oh, I think you'll find that magic is rare in Skyrim. Winterhold, though... The College there has it in abundance. Look there if you wish to learn.
traduit: 哦，我觉得你会发现，天际中魔法是很少见的。不过，冬堡学院里还是有很多。如果想学，就去那里看看吧。

original: Not here. Definitely not here. You want to learn, join the College in Winterhold. They'll deal with it.
traduit: 不在这里。绝对不是。如果想学，那就去冬堡学院吧。他们会教你的。

original: Magic is... frowned upon in Skyrim. Only the mages at the College of Winterhold teach it freely. If you wish to learn, join them.
traduit: 魔法……在天际不太受认同。只有冬堡学院的法师会自由传授。如果想学就去那里加入他们吧。

original: A prospective student, are you? Well, I'm afraid I'm not much good at teaching. You should try your luck at the College of Winterhold.
traduit: 未来的学徒啊？但我恐怕不太善于教学。你应该去冬堡学院碰碰运气。

original: I have no time or patience for a student. Perhaps the College of Winterhold will grant you admission.
traduit: 我没时间也没耐心教学生。也许冬堡学院会收你。

original: That's right. College of Winterhold, just north of town. Hard to miss.
traduit: 没错。冬堡学院，就在镇北。不要错过了。

original: I overheard something about a College.
traduit: 我偶然听说过学院的事。

original: Yes, you were going to demonstrate your ability, were you not?
traduit: 对，你是要展示自己的能力对吗？

original: A standard spell for one skilled in Destruction magic is the Firebolt. Casting one at the seal on the ground here would be sufficient.
traduit: 毁灭系魔法标志性法术之一就是火矢术。朝地上的标记扔一个即可。

original: Those invested in Restoration magic find Healing Hands to be essential. Can you cast it on me? That would prove your skill.
traduit: 致力于恢复系魔法的人会发现治愈之触很重要。你能在我身上释放一个吗？这样就足以证明你的技术了。

original: The Fear spell has saved the life of many an Illusion mage. If you could cast it on the seal here on the ground, that would prove your skill.
traduit: 恐惧术救过很多幻术法师的命。如果你能对着地上的标记释放一个，就证明你的技术了。

original: The Flame Atronach is a vital companion for anyone relying on Conjuration. Summoning one here would certainly show your skill.
traduit: 对于依赖召唤系的人来说，火焰侍灵是至关重要的伙伴。在这里召唤一个肯定能证明你的技术。

original: The Mage Light spell is useful to any mage, not just those specializing in Alteration. Can you cast one on the seal on the ground?
traduit: 魔光术不仅是对专攻变化系的法师，其实对任何法师都很实用。你能在地上的标记释放一个吗？

original: It would seem that you have yet to reach a level of skill that the College would find valuable, so I'm afraid I can't allow you to join at this time.
traduit: 看来你的技艺还没达到学院认可的水平，所以恐怕我不能让你进入。

original: Unfortunately, one needs to be able to cast at least Apprentice level spells in any school of magic before being allowed to join the College.
traduit: 不幸的是，只有能够施放任意魔法学派的学徒级法术的人，才能被允许加入学院。

original: And thus, you're not skilled enough to be a candidate. I'm afraid we're not interested.
traduit: 而你的技艺不足以胜任。恐怕我们对你没什么兴趣。

original: You don't know what you're dealing with. There will be consequences if you harm that tree. Leave this place - you're not welcome here anymore.
traduit: 你不知道你面对的是什么。如果你伤害了那棵树，后果自负。离开这里——你在这里不再受到欢迎了。

original: (Growling)
traduit: （咆哮声）

original: Not now. The Underforge, tonight.
traduit: 不是现在。晚上在地下锻炉。

original: Not here. The Underforge. Come on.
traduit: 不是这里。到地下锻炉去，来吧。

original: Thank you for coming, brother.
traduit: 感谢你能来，兄弟。

original: Thank you for coming, sister.
traduit: 感谢你能来，姐妹。

original: Ah, there you are.
traduit: 啊，你来了。

original: The blood calls, brother.
traduit: 鲜血在召唤，兄弟。

original: The blood calls, sister.
traduit: 鲜血在召唤，姐妹。

original: Speak to me, Shield-Brother.
traduit: 盾牌兄弟，我有话说。

original: Speak to me, Shield-Sister.
traduit: 盾牌姐妹，我有话说。

original: Let's make the bastards pay.
traduit: 让那些混蛋付出代价。

original: Skjor's somewhere ahead. We need to find him.
traduit: 斯科约尔在前面。我们得去找他。

original: Less talk, more hunt.
traduit: 少说话，多狩猎。

original: Let's keep moving.
traduit: 继续走。

original: You've returned.
traduit: 你回来了。

original: The rumors were true... I beg of you, don't harm the tree! Nothing good can come of it.
traduit: 传言是真的……求求你，不要伤害这棵树！这么做不会有好结果的。

original: You mean this weapon? (Show Nettlebane)
traduit: 你是说这个武器？（展示刺草之祸）

original: The rumors were true! You carry the one weapon Eldergleam fears - Nettlebane. I beg of you, don't harm the tree! Nothing good can come of it.
traduit: 传言是真的！你带着让古光树畏惧的武器，刺草之祸。求求你，不要伤害这棵树！这件事不会有什么好结果的。

original: Oh, I don't believe those rumors, my friend. Besides, who would ever want to harm such... Wait, it can't be.
traduit: 哦，我不相信那些传言，朋友。再说，有谁会想伤害这样……等等，这不可能。

original: Where can I find such a weapon?
traduit: 到哪里才能找到那个武器？

original: Welcome to Eldergleam Sanctuary, my friend. If you have any questions, speak to Asta.
traduit: 欢迎来到古光圣所，朋友。如果你有什么问题，去和阿斯塔聊聊吧。

original: You are in Eldergleam Sanctuary - just a small glimpse of what beauty Kynareth has to offer. Wonderful place, isn't it?
traduit: 你现在所在的地方是古光圣所，美丽的凯娜瑞丝赐予给我们的惊鸿一瞥。真是个好地方啊，对吧？

original: Oh, I don't believe those rumors, my friend.  Besides, who would ever want to harm such beauty?
traduit: 哦，我不相信那些谣言，朋友。再说，谁会想伤害这样的美景呢？

original: He had your soft face, and that silly grin you get when you've done something wrong. That's his, too.
traduit: 他的脸和你一样温柔，还有你做错事时傻笑的样子和他一模一样。这就是他。

original: I don't know. What'd he look like?
traduit: 我不知道。他长什么样子啊？

original: Of course, sweetie. What'd you like to know?
traduit: 当然了，甜心。你想知道什么？

original: Mama, can we talk. You know, about papa?
traduit: 妈妈，我们能聊聊吗。关于爸爸的事？

original: What is this place again?
traduit: 这是什么地方来着？

original: Oh, I don't believe those rumors, my friend. Besides, who would ever want to harm such beauty?
traduit: 哦，我不相信那些传言，朋友。再说，谁会想要伤害这样的美景呢？

original: Now, if you'll excuse me, I have nothing more to discuss. I encourage you to take your time and enjoy yourself. You look like you could use the rest.
traduit: 好了，没什么好聊的了，恕我失陪。我劝你也慢下来，好好享受一下。你看起来需要休息。

original: As you can see, Eldergleam's roots are large and stretch far, blocking any path to her trunk.
traduit: 你也看到了，古光树的根部十分巨大，延展深远，堵住了通往枝干的一切道路。

original: Though, believe it or not, there are rumors of a weapon that even Eldergleam herself would lift her roots for, more out of fear than respect.
traduit: 不过，不管是不是真的，有传言说有种武器连古光树自身都会出自恐惧而非尊敬而抬起她的根。

original: Why not?
traduit: 为什么？

original: Yes, my friend. Though no one has been able to get close to her for as long as I can remember.
traduit: 没错，朋友。尽管从我记事起就没人能接近她。

original: And that tree? Is that Eldergleam?
traduit: 那那个树呢？就是古光树吗？

original: (Invisible Continue) Location of Attack
traduit: (Invisible Continue) Location of Attack

original: Join the forces mustering at the [CAPITAL] (infos conditions on location go here)
traduit: Join the forces mustering at the [CAPITAL] (infos conditions on location go here)

original: (Invisible Continue) Difficulty based on Attack Dela
traduit: (Invisible Continue) Difficulty based on Attack Dela

original: Infos conditioned on Attack Delta go here.
traduit: Infos conditioned on Attack Delta go here.

original: The enemy is mustering for a final attack.
traduit: 敌军正在集结兵力准备总攻。

original: So you'll come to the peace council?
traduit: 所以你会来参加和平会议吗？

original: Yes. I'll give Tullius one more chance to quit Skyrim with his tail between his legs.
traduit: 当然。我再给图留斯一次机会让他赶紧夹着尾巴退出天际。

original: Tullius will look weak if he refuses, not you.
traduit: 拒绝只会显得图留斯软弱。而不是你。

original: He is weak. And no doubt knows it. He's no fool, he'll come, if only to give his troops a chance to refit.
traduit: 他是很弱。这不必说。但他不傻，他会去的，哪怕只是为了给自己的部队一个重新整备的机会。

original: But you're right. Victory is within our grasp. We can afford to give the Empire one more chance to withdraw.
traduit: 但你说得对。胜利在望。给他们一次撤退的机会也无妨。

original: You're right. Let Tullius be the one to insult the Greybeards by refusing their summons.
traduit: 你说得对。就让图留斯去羞辱灰胡子，拒绝他们的召唤。

original: Show up these Imperials for the foreigners they really are.
traduit: 把这些帝国人的真面目展现给外邦人。

original: Hmm. We could use the time to bring in new recruits. Our losses have been heavy recently...
traduit: 嗯。我们也可以用这段时间招些新兵。最近我们损失很大……

original: General Tullius hasn't agreed to attend yet.
traduit: 图留斯将军还没同意参加。

original: I can't agree to any peace council until I know Tullius will be there. The other Jarls could take that as a sign of weakness.
traduit: 只有图留斯到场我才会参加和平会议。不能让其他领主认为我在示弱。

original: General Tullius has already agreed to attend.
traduit: 图留斯将军已经同意参加。

original: Good. Maybe he's realized he's beaten. The way things are going, we'll be knocking at the gates of Solitude itself before too long.
traduit: 很好。也许他意识到了败局已定。照这样下去，要不了多久，我们就能叩开独孤城大门了。

original: Good. We still hold half of Skyrim despite everything the Empire could throw at us.
traduit: 很好。不管帝国使出什么招数，我们仍旧保有半个天际。

original: I doubt the Empire has the stomach for much more bloodletting.
traduit: 我怀疑帝国还有胃口继续承受流血。

original: Good. They've had their victories, but Tullius is no fool. The Empire can't afford to keep this up much longer.
traduit: 很好。他们虽然打了胜仗，但图留斯不傻。帝国维持不了多久了。

original: They want to negotiate a truce until the dragon menace is dealt with.
traduit: 他们希望通过谈判达成休战直到龙的威胁被解决。

original: I have the greatest respect for the Greybeards, of course. And the dragon attacks are a growing plague.
traduit: 诚然，我十分敬重灰胡子。巨龙的袭扰也日益严重。

original: But the political situation is still delicate. Not all the Jarls are fully committed to supporting me as High King.
traduit: 但时局仍旧微妙。并不是所有领主都全力支持我成为至高王。

original: I can't afford to appear weak. I can't agree to this unless Tullius himself will be there.
traduit: 我不能示人以弱。除非图留斯亲自到场，否则我不会同意。

original: I have a message from the Greybeards.
traduit: 灰胡子让我捎个信。

original: It's about time they turned their gaze from the heavens, back to our bleeding homeland. What do they want?
traduit: 他们总算把眼光从天堂转回我们流血的家园了。他们想要什么？

original: Hmph. Suit yourself.
traduit: 哼。随便你。

original: Let's just see about that.
traduit: 那我们来看看啊。

original: *Sigh* I was part of the gang in the ruins here. Friend of mine went crazy and stole the boss' sword. They blamed me for it.
traduit: （叹气）我曾经是遗迹里的帮派成员。我的一个朋友发疯了，偷走了老大的剑。他们为此责怪我。

original: Look, I'm done here. Mop the floor with these idiots for all I care. Just get out of my way.
traduit: 所以，我和这里闹掰了。拿这些白痴洗了遍地，我才不管呢。别挡我的路。

original: Wait, what's going on here?
traduit: 等等，这是怎么回事？

original: What a waste. Fools.
traduit: 真浪费。傻子。

original: You go speak with Muiri. I've got to deal with the Night Mother and her little... clown.
traduit: 你去和暮蕊谈谈吧。我得去应付夜母和她的……小丑了。

original: It's all up to you now... Listener.
traduit: 现在全看你了……聆听者。

original: Go. Quickly. Hide in the coffin before Cicero and the traitor meet.
traduit: 赶快去吧。在西塞罗和叛徒会面前躲进棺材里。

original: It's time we put a little kink in the Emperor's security.
traduit: 是时候帮皇帝的安全措施做点小调整了。

original: Off to Solitude with you. Time to give the Emperor some real motivation to visit Skyrim.
traduit: 去独孤城吧。是时候帮皇帝整些来天际的好理由了。

original: You've got people to kill, my friend. Best get to it.
traduit: 你还有人要去杀呢，朋友。最好赶快去。

original: Go on, now.
traduit: 去吧。

original: Good luck. And try not to get yourself killed.
traduit: 祝好运。别把命送了。

original: Happy hunting.
traduit: 狩猎愉快。

original: Be sure and introduce yourself to your new Family members. They're all very eager to meet you.
traduit: 一定要向新家的成员介绍自己。他们都很想见你。

original: Humble Cicero lives to serve.
traduit: 谦卑的西塞罗随时恭候差遣。

original: Damnable jester...
traduit: 该死的小丑……

original: I took that prancing fool into my home, and this is how he repays me?
traduit: 我允许那傻子进入我家，他就是这么报答我的？

original: You may go now...
traduit: 你现在该走了……

original: I am yours, master.
traduit: 我听您吩咐，大人。

original: I am yours, mistress.
traduit: 我听您吩咐，大人。

original: Walk always in shadow, my Listener.
traduit: 愿你永远行于阴影，聆听者。

original: Just say the word, master.
traduit: 请吩咐吧，大人。

original: Just say the word, mistress.
traduit: 请吩咐吧，大人。

original: Ready when you need me, Listener.
traduit: 随时听候差遣，聆听者。

original: Just do whatever the contact wishes. Be professional, represent us well, and get the job done.
traduit: 听契约人的愿望。显得专业点，好好代表我们把工作做好。

original: Since it's your first contract, I'll let you keep whatever Muiri pays. She'll be generous, I'm sure. They always are.
traduit: 既然是你第一份契约，那暮蕊的报酬就自己留着吧。我相信她会慷慨解囊的。他们这些人总是这样。

original: DBAstridO3GiveQuestTopic1
traduit: DBAstridO3GiveQuestTopic1

original: I do indeed.
traduit: 确实。

original: You must go to the city of Markarth, and speak with the apothecary's assistant. You'll probably find her in The Hag's Cure, when the shop is open.
traduit: 你必须去马卡斯城，找药剂师的助手谈谈。她大概在鬼婆妙方，店开门的时候应该能找到。

original: The girl's been running her mouth, wants an ex-lover killed. She's apparently performed the Black Sacrament.
traduit: 那姑娘胡言乱语的，要杀了她的前男友。显然她已经完成了黑色圣礼。

original: Her name is Muiri. I need you to talk to her, set up the contract, and carry it out.
traduit: 她叫暮蕊。和她谈谈，定下契约然后执行吧。

original: Do you have a contract for me?
traduit: 你有契约要给我？

original: Ah, there you are. Good, I was done speaking with that muttering fool anyway. We've got some business to discuss.
traduit: 啊，你回来了。很好，我已经和那个自言自语的傻子说完了。我们有事要谈。

original: You. Over here!
traduit: 喂。在这儿！

original: Come on, this way.
traduit: 跟上，这边走。

original: Let's keep moving. That thing is still out there.
traduit: 我们得继续前进。那东西还在外面。

original: Let me see if I can get that door open.
traduit: 我试试能不能把门打开。

original: There you go. Take a look around, there should be plenty of gear to choose from. I'm going to see if I can find something for these burns.
traduit: 好了。四处找找看，这应该有很多装备可以拿。我看看能不能找到治疗烧伤的东西。

original: Well now. Funny you should ask.
traduit: 哎呀，你问的真有趣。

original: If you turn around, you'll notice my guests. I've "collected" them from... well, that's not really important. The here and now. That's what matters.
traduit: 如果你转过头去，就会看到我的客人了。我把他们从……不重要了。此时此地才最要紧。

original: You see, there's a contract out on one of them, and that person can't leave this room alive. But... which one? Go on, see if you can figure it out.
traduit: 你看，他们中的一个就是契约的目标，那个人不能活着离开。但……到底是谁呢？去吧，看看你能不能弄明白。

original: Make your choice. Make your kill. I just want to observe... and admire.
traduit: 你来选，你来杀。我只想观察……然后赞叹你。

original: You want me to murder someone else? Who?
traduit: 你想让我再杀人？是谁？

original: I don't think I like where this is going...
traduit: 我不喜欢这样……

original: A problem?
traduit: 问题？

original: You see, that little Aretino boy was looking for the Dark Brotherhood. For me, and my associates.
traduit: 你看，艾瑞提诺那小子是在找黑暗兄弟会吧。在找我，还有我的同事们。

original: Grelod the Kind was, by all rights, a Dark Brotherhood contract. A kill... that you stole.
traduit: 慈祥的桂罗，不管怎么说，都是黑暗兄弟会的契约。但是被你偷过来……杀了。

original: A kill you must repay.
traduit: 你得杀个人来偿还。

original: We need to talk.
traduit: 我们得谈谈。

original: Look. Something is happening here. I'm not sure entirely what that something is, but... Well, we need to find out.
traduit: 那个。这里发生了些事情。我还拿不准。但是……好吧，我们得弄清楚。

original: If the Night Mother really did give you an order to talk to a contact, we'd be mad to ignore it.
traduit: 如果夜母真的命你去和联络人谈话，我们要是无视的话，就是疯了。

original: And I think we'd both agree, Cicero's brought quite enough madness to this Sanctuary.
traduit: 西塞罗已经给这个圣所带来够多疯狂了。我觉得，这点咱们都同意吧。

original: So go. Go to Volunruud. It's a crypt, pretty far to the northeast. Talk to this Amaund Motierre. And let's see where all this leads. Hmm?
traduit: 所以，去吧。去沃伦鲁德吧。那是个地下墓穴，在东北方向，还挺远的。和阿蒙德·莫提雷谈谈。看看事态会如何发展。嗯？

original: Best put your other tasks aside. The real challenge is about to begin.
traduit: 你最好先把其他任务放一放。真正的挑战要开始了。

original: With Vici's murder, you've started us down a path the Dark Brotherhood hasn't traveled in centuries. The assassination of an Emperor.
traduit: 随着维齐被杀，你带着我们走上了黑暗兄弟会几世纪都没做过的道路。刺杀皇帝。

original: And now, your reward. A unique spell to summon a legend of the Dark Brotherhood. His soul serves us now in death, as his body once did in life.
traduit: 来，这是你的奖励。一个召唤黑暗兄弟会传奇刺客的独特法咒。他的灵魂在死后仍旧像生前一样为大家服务。

original: Ah, and of course, a bonus, for killing Vici while she addressed her guests, as instructed. Gold... simple and pure. Spend it as you will.
traduit: 当然，还有额外的奖励，你如指示所说，在维齐对宾客讲话时把她杀了。金币……简单而纯粹。想怎么花就怎么花吧。

original: Now then. Time to proceed to the next stage of the plan. Go and speak with Gabriella. She's been helping me arrange your next contract.
traduit: 现在。该进行计划的下个阶段了。去找加布里艾拉谈谈。她一直在帮我筹备下份契约的事。

original: Unfortunately, in your zeal, you failed to eliminate Vici while she addressed her guests, as directed. I'm sorry, but your bonus is forfeit.
traduit: 可惜啊，你太热心了，没按照指示在维齐对宾客讲话时除掉她。抱歉，奖金作废咯。

original: Excellent. Once again, you've proven yourself a born assassin.
traduit: 太好了，你再次证明了自己就是个天生的刺客。

original: Tell you what. Why don't you hold onto Shadowmere a while longer? He's a fine steed, and hasn't been ridden nearly as much as he should lately.
traduit: 对了。你为何不把微影多留些日子？那是匹好马，最近很少有人骑了。

original: And now that this Cicero mess has been mopped up, we can get back to the matter at hand, hmm?
traduit: 现在，西塞罗的麻烦也解决了。我们也该回到正题了吧？

original: You are not worthy.
traduit: 你没有资格。

original: Go now to Castle Dour in Solitude. Present the Gourmet's Write of Passage to the officer in charge, Commander Maro. I'm sure you remember him.
traduit: 现在去独孤城的阴郁堡吧。把美食家的通行证交给马洛指挥官。相信你还记得他。

original: Oh yes, it is Cicero! You were a fool to spare me. What, did you think I would be grateful? Cicero should be Listener! Not you! Now you will die!
traduit: 哦，没错，是西塞罗！你可真是个小丑，居然放过了我。怎么，你以为我会感激你吗？西塞罗才是聆听者！不是你！现在去死吧！

original: Ahhh.... gotcha! Oh, Listener, you should see the look on your face! Ha ha ha ha ha ha ha!
traduit: 哦哈哈哈……骗到你了！哦，聆听者，你表情好好笑啊！哈哈哈哈哈哈哈！

original: Oh, Cicero has returned! Not to kill the kind Listener, but to serve, until one of us dies horribly, in service to our Mother! Best friends forever!
traduit: 哦，西塞罗回来了！不是来杀善良的聆听者的，而是要为我们的母亲服务，直到我们中的一个可怕地死去！我们永远都是好朋友！

original: In the meantime, I'll make myself at home in the Sanctuary. I'm sure Mother needs... tending.
traduit: 还有，我在圣所就像在自己家一样。母亲需要我……照顾。

original: You! You're responsible for the siege of Solitude! By Sithis, this undermines all our plans! Fool! Finish that mess, and only then will we speak!
traduit: 你！你要为独孤城被围负责！这破坏了我们全部计划！把这烂摊子收拾好，然后再来找我说话！

original: You! You're responsible for the siege of that... city! By Sithis, this undermines all our plans! Fool! Finish that mess, and only then will we speak!
traduit: 你！你要为城市被包围负责！这破坏了我们全部计划！把这烂摊子收拾好，然后再来找我说话！

original: Half of Skyrim knows. Old hag gets butchered in her own orphanage? Things like that tend to get around.
traduit: 半个天际都传遍了。老妖婆在自己的孤儿院被杀了？这事儿想传开太容易了。

original: Oh, but don't misunderstand. I'm not criticizing. It was a good kill. Old crone had it coming. And you saved a group of urchins, to boot.
traduit: 哦，但别误会。我这不是批评你。杀得漂亮。那老东西自找的。而且你还救了一群孩子。

original: Ah, but there is a slight... problem.
traduit: 啊，但是有一个小小的……问题。

original: You know about that?
traduit: 你都知道了？

original: Who I am really isn't as important as what I am. And what I am is an admirer. Of sorts.
traduit: 我是谁不重要，重要的是我是干什么的。从各种意义上，我都很佩服你哦。

original: DBNazirContractSet1ReadyBranchTopic
traduit: DBNazirContractSet1ReadyBranchTopic

original: Well then, let's get started. I've got three available right now.
traduit: 那我们开始吧。我这里有三份没做的契约。

original: Your targets are the beggar Narfi, an ex-miller named Ennodius Papius, and Beitild, a mine boss.
traduit: 你的目标是乞丐纳菲、前木材厂主恩诺迪尤斯·帕尤斯，还有矿场老板贝提尤德。

original: When you've completed all those, we'll see if I might have some more.
traduit: 等做完这些，再看看还有没有其他的。

original: I'm ready for the first set of contracts.
traduit: 我准备好接第一份契约了。

original: It is. These aren't particularly glamorous assassinations, I'll be honest. Don't pay much, either.
traduit: 没错。说实话，这些暗杀不出彩。也付不了你多少钱。

original: But they'll keep you busy. Just do them as you're able. There's no real time limit - the targets aren't going anywhere.
traduit: 但他们也够你忙的了。尽你所能去做就是。没有时间限制，反正目标也不会乱跑。

original: You can turn each one in as it's completed, or wait and turn in the whole group when all the targets have been eliminated. Whichever works for you.
traduit: 你可以每完成一个过来上交一次，也可以等目标全消灭之后一起上交。这都无所谓。

original: Sounds simple enough.
traduit: 听起来很简单。

original: The prominent feature here is the Hall of the Elements. It's our primary location for lectures, practice sessions, and general meetings.
traduit: 这里最突出的特色就是元素大厅了。这里是我们演讲、练习、集会的地方。

original: The College of Winterhold has been a fixture in Skyrim for thousands of years.
traduit: 冬堡学院已经在天际屹立数千年了。

original: Sorry, I'm not ready for that just yet.
traduit: 抱歉，我还没准备好。

original: I see.
traduit: 我知道了。

original: Well, please let me know when you are.
traduit: 好吧，等你准备好请告诉我一声。

original: I'd love to have a look around.
traduit: 我想四处看看。

original: Wonderful. Please follow me, and don't wander off.
traduit: 很好。请跟我来，不要乱走。

original: I was told to come see you.
traduit: 有人叫我来见你。

original: Another new student... I'm surprised at how many of you there are lately.
traduit: 又是新生吗……最近居然有这么多人。

original: Well, first you'll need these. While you're not required to wear them, you may find them more to your liking than your current clothes.
traduit: 好吧，先给你这些。虽然不强制着装，但你可能会发现它们比你现在的衣服更合适。

original: I'll give you a brief tour, and then we'll get you to your first class. Are you ready to begin?
traduit: 我会带你简单参观一下，然后带你去上第一堂课。准备好开始了吗？

original: Yes, just a brief overview of our facilities. Are you ready?
traduit: 对，只是简单介绍一下我们的配置。准备好了吗？

original: You said something about a tour?
traduit: 你要带我参观吗？

original: Do you know about Delphine's... activities?
traduit: 你对戴尔芬的……行为有了解吗？

original: That's her business. Not mine. Probably not yours either.
traduit: 我从来不过问她的事。好像你也管不着。

original: The dragonstone was some kind of map?
traduit: 龙石是某种地图？

original: Yes. A map of ancient dragon burial sites. I've looked at which ones are now empty. The pattern is pretty clear.
traduit: 没错。一张古代龙冢的地图。我查看过里面有些地点现在已经空了。路径很清楚。

original: It seems to be spreading from the southeast, starting in the Jeralls near Riften. The one near Kynesgrove is next if the pattern holds.
traduit: 似乎是从东南方向开始的。从裂谷城旁边的杰拉尔山脉开始，如果路径保持一致，那接下来应该是凯娜之林附近这座。

original: That's none of your business.
traduit: 不关你事。

original: You're wrong. It is my business. You may be the only one that can stop these dragons.
traduit: 你错了。这就是我的事。你可能是唯一能阻止这群龙的人。

original: But you'll understand that soon enough.
traduit: 很快你就会明白。

original: I absorb some kind of power from dragons. That's all I can say.
traduit: 我能说的是，我能从龙族那吸取某种能量。

original: This is no time to play the reluctant hero. You either are or aren't Dragonborn.
traduit: 没工夫让你充什么扭扭捏捏的英雄了。要么是，要么不是。

original: But I'll see for myself soon enough.
traduit: 但我应该很快就能亲眼看到了。

original: Yes, that's how I first learned I was Dragonborn.
traduit: 是的，这就是我得知自己是龙裔的方法。

original: Good. And you'll have a chance to prove it to me soon enough.
traduit: 好。你很快就能向我证明了。

original: What of it?
traduit: 有什么关系呢？

original: Can you do it? Can you devour a dragon's soul?
traduit: 你能做到吗？你真的能吞噬龙魂吗？

original: Here I am. What do you want?
traduit: 我来了。你想干什么？

original: Now we can talk.
traduit: 现在我们可以聊聊了。

original: Close the door.
traduit: 把门关上。

original: Come on, close the door.
traduit: 快点，把门关上。

original: You're not afraid of me, are you?
traduit: 你不会是怕我吧？

original: Just close the door, will you?
traduit: 把门关上，好吗？

original: We should keep moving. Come here. Let me see if I can get those bindings off.
traduit: 我们得继续前进。过来点，我试下能不能把这些绳索弄断。

original: Looks like we're the only ones who made it. Was that really a dragon? The bringers of the End Times?
traduit: 看来只有我们成功了。那真的是头龙？末日的使者？

original: Did you see that?
traduit: 你看到了吗？

original: Well would you look at that!
traduit: 快看！

original: This appears to lead somewhere. Let's see where it goes.
traduit: 这似乎是通往某个地方。我们去看看它通往哪里。

original: I'm not sure. I certainly wasn't expecting this.
traduit: 我不太确定。我确实没有料到。

original: Someone get that thing out of here and burn it.
traduit: 谁去把那东西弄出来烧了。

original: Raagh!
traduit: 呀啊！

original: Enjoy this while you can. Soon you will all be slaves.
traduit: 趁现在好好享受吧。你们早晚都是奴隶。

original: I said, on your knees, Elf!
traduit: 我说了，跪下，精灵！

original: Tolfdir is likely already addressing the new Apprentices. Go on in, and if you have any problems, let one of our senior members know.
traduit: 托夫迪尔可能已经在给新生上课了。去吧，如果你有什么问题，随时和老成员交流。

original: Initially you'll be learning from Tolfdir, one of our most esteemed Wizards.
traduit: 一开始教导你们的是我们这里最受人尊敬的巫师，托夫迪尔。

original: This is where you'll be staying. This bed and desk are yours. Please try and be considerate of others.
traduit: 这就是你的住处了。这床和桌子归你了。请尽可能替别人着想。

original: Now, let's go back to the Hall of the Elements, where most of the members gather for lectures and study sessions.
traduit: 好了，我们回元素大厅吧，大部分成员都会聚集在那儿参加讲座或者进行学习。

original: Now I'll show you to your quarters. You're going to be sharing space with your fellow Apprentices, who you'll meet shortly.
traduit: 现在我带你去看看住处。你们这些学徒会住一起，你很快就会见到他们了。

original: Our newest members are housed here in the Hall of Attainment.
traduit: 我们的新学员都住在成就大厅。

original: I'll ask that you please keep your voice down while inside, as others may be working on research or... delicate experiments.
traduit: 希望你在里面能安静点，因为其他人可能正在进行研究或者……微妙的实验。

original: Unfortunately, we've had to implement more stringent entry procedures, due to some problems with the local Nords.
traduit: 不幸的是，我们不得不实施更严格的入学程序，因为我们和当地诺德人出了些问题。

original: We don't anticipate any real violence, but it never hurts to be prepared.
traduit: 我们应该不会真的演化出暴力事件，但还是要有备无患。

original: On your knees!
traduit: 跪下吧！

original: I presume you're talking to me?
traduit: 你这是跟我说话？

original: Not so fast Elf!
traduit: 别那么急，精灵！

original: Well, yes. Two of them. But you're reaching the end of what I have available.
traduit: 嗯，好吧。还有两个。但你快把我手头的都做完了。

original: Your targets are a dark elf wizard named Maluril, in the dwarven ruin of Mzinchaleft. And Helvard, the housecarl of Falkreath.
traduit: 你的目标，一个是矮人遗迹姆津查莱夫特里的暗精灵巫师玛鲁利尔。还有佛克瑞斯的侍卫黑尔沃德。

original: Kill these two, and I'll have one last contract to give you. I'm just finalizing some details now.
traduit: 杀完之后，我还有最后一份契约给你。我还在敲定一些细节。

original: Are there any more contracts available?
traduit: 还有其他契约吗？

original: Just one right now, actually.
traduit: 事实上，现在就一个。

original: I need you to eliminate an old woman named Agnis, a servant in Fort Greymoor.
traduit: 我要你除掉一个叫阿格尼斯的老女人，她是灰色荒原堡里的仆人。

original: Are there any more contracts, Nazir?
traduit: 纳兹尔，还有别的合同吗？

original: Well aren't we the eager one? Sorry to disappoint, but there's nothing. Try me again later.
traduit: 嗯，这么积极啊？但抱歉了，现在没有。过会儿再来找我吧。

original: There are indeed. Three, to be exact.
traduit: 确实有。而且有三个。

original: There's Deekus, a shipwreck scavenger. Ma'randru-jo, a traveling caravaner. And Anoriath, a hunter.
traduit: 沉船拾荒者蒂库斯、旅行商人玛'兰德鲁-约、还有个猎人阿诺利亚斯。

original: Hmph. How about, instead of giving you another contract, I simply deride you for not finishing the one you still have?
traduit: 嗯。与其给你新契约，我是不是应该先嘲笑你没把手头的契约完成？

original: Astrid sent me for another contract.
traduit: 阿斯垂德派我来接新的契约。

original: So it would appear. Though I'd suspect she'd want you to complete your other contracts first. Do those, then we'll talk about something new.
traduit: 是吗。不过我猜她应该是希望你先完成手头上的。等做完再来谈新的吧。

original: As a matter of fact, I do. Two of them. One rather easy assignment, and another that should prove quite a challenge.
traduit: 我确实有两个。一个比较简单，但另外一个应该相对富有挑战性。

original: Your first target is an Orc bard named Lurbuk. The other is a vampire by the name of Hern.
traduit: 第一个目标是兽人吟游诗人卢布克，另一个是吸血鬼赫恩。

original: Do you have any more contracts?
traduit: 还有别的契约吗？

original: I'm sorry, I don't. Come see me again later.
traduit: 抱歉，没了。以后再来找我吧。

original: Well then, your timing couldn't be better.
traduit: 那你来的正是时候。

original: As it turns out, I've got two new contracts. One rather easy assignment, and another that should prove quite a challenge.
traduit: 我这里刚好有两份新契约。一份简单点，一份就相当有挑战性了。

original: Astrid wanted me to see you about some more work.
traduit: 阿斯垂德派我来看有没有更多工作。

original: More work? My friend, you still haven't finished the last set of contracts I gave you. Why don't you concentrate on eliminating that final target.
traduit: 还要更多？朋友，你还没完成我给你的上份契约呢。为什么不集中精力先把这份干完呢。

original: More work? My friend, you still haven't finished the last two contracts I gave you. Let's get those done, hmm?
traduit: 更多工作？朋友，你还没完成我给你的上两份契约呢。把这些先搞定吧，好吗？

original: By Sithis, now I am truly impressed!
traduit: 西帝斯在上，我太感动了！

original: To kill a pirate captain, on her own ship no less? Simply masterful!
traduit: 杀死一个海盗船长，还是在她自己船上？真是熟练啊！

original: You've not only earned your payment, but my respect as well. And believe me, friend - that does not come easily.
traduit: 你不仅得到了报酬，还有我的尊重。相信我，朋友，这可不是容易事。

original: I'm afraid that concludes our business. You have exhausted all available additional contracts.
traduit: 我们的交易恐怕到此也就结束了。你已经做完了所有额外契约。

original: But I'm sure you've got plenty to keep you busy right about now, hmm?
traduit: 但我相信你现在还有很多事要忙对吧？

original: Safia is dead.
traduit: 萨非亚死了。

original: Hmph. Well, that's sure to throw a branch into Falkreath's well-oiled political machine.
traduit: 嗯。这肯定会给佛克瑞斯运转良好的政治机器带来麻烦的。

original: Here's your payment. Well earned, as always.
traduit: 这是你一如既往应得的报酬。

original: Helvard is dead.
traduit: 黑尔沃德死了。

original: I hope the elf didn't give you too much trouble. I once got set on fire by a sorcerer. Nasty business, that.
traduit: 希望那个精灵没给你添太多麻烦。我以前就被一个巫师给点着过。这不是个讨喜的差事。

original: But I digress. Here's your payment.
traduit: 说跑题了。这是你的报酬。

original: Maluril is dead.
traduit: 玛鲁利尔死了。

original: Don't worry, my friend, I'll spare you the facetious quip about killing a defenseless old woman.
traduit: 别担心，朋友。我不会笑话你杀了个手无寸铁的老女人的。

original: Infiltrating an occupied fort and making it out in one piece is nothing to joke about. Well done.
traduit: 潜入一个被盘踞的堡垒又毫发无损的逃出来可不是开玩笑的。干得好。

original: Your payment for services rendered.
traduit: 这是你的辛苦费。

original: Agnis is dead.
traduit: 阿格尼斯死了。

original: Ah, so the hunter came to know the fear of the hunted, hmm?
traduit: 啊，这么说猎人已经了解猎物的恐惧了？

original: Your payment, my friend. Well done.
traduit: 朋友，拿着报酬吧。干得好。

original: Anoriath is dead.
traduit: 阿诺利亚斯死了。

original: Ah! Well done! Well done!
traduit: 啊！干得好！干得好啊！

original: Those caravaners can be an elusive bunch. Takes a fair bit of stalking to take one down. But then, that's half the fun, isn't it?
traduit: 那些车队商人可是不好捉摸。想要干掉一个也得花不少工夫呢。但这也是乐趣的一部分，对吧？

original: Here's your payment. Well earned, indeed.
traduit: 这是你的报酬。干得好。

original: Ma'randru-jo is dead.
traduit: 玛'兰德鲁-约死了。

original: Personally, I've always found Argonians to be incredibly unpredictable opponents. Especially near water.
traduit: 我一直觉得阿尔贡很不好对付。尤其是在水边。

original: In any event, nice work. Here's your payment.
traduit: 不管怎么说，干得漂亮。这是你的报酬。

original: Deekus is dead.
traduit: 蒂库斯死了。

original: Wonderful. The only good bard is a dead one, as far as I'm concerned. All that singing and... mirth.
traduit: 太好了。我看啊，只有死了的吟游诗人才是好诗人。那些歌唱还有笑声太烦人了。

original: Your payment, as per the usual.
traduit: 一如既往，拿好报酬。

original: Lurbuk is dead.
traduit: 卢布克死了。

original: No sarcasm this time. You faced a vampire, and lived to tell the tale. Well done.
traduit: 这次就不讽刺你了。你单独面对吸血鬼，还活了下来。干得好。

original: And if you contracted Sanguinare Vampiris, be sure to get that taken care of. Else you'll end up like our own Babette.
traduit: 如果你感染了血腥吸血热的话，别忘了治一下。不然就和我们的巴贝特一样咯。

original: Unless, of course, that was your goal all along. Here's your payment.
traduit: 啊，当然了，除非你一直都想变。这是报酬。

original: Hern is dead.
traduit: 赫恩死了。

original: Of course she is. I hear the mining business is extremely cutthroat. And those hours... they're murder.
traduit: 当然。我听说采矿业是十分残酷的。而且那个工作时长……他们才是凶手。

original: I could do this all day. Here's your payment.
traduit: 杀多少我都不嫌累。报酬拿好。

original: Beitild is dead.
traduit: 贝提尤德死了。

original: Good. And I hope you were careful in that lumber mill. Those splinters and rusty nails can be quite nasty.
traduit: 很好。希望你路过锯木厂的时候小心点。那里碎屑和锈铁钉太多了。

original: Your payment, for a job well done.
traduit: 干得漂亮，拿好报酬。

original: Ennodius Papius is dead.
traduit: 恩诺迪尤斯·帕尤斯死了。

original: Congratulations. You slaughtered an emaciated beggar in cold blood. You are truly an opponent to be feared.
traduit: 祝贺你。冷血地残杀了一个瘦弱的乞丐。真是个令人畏惧的人啊。

original: Here's your payment.
traduit: 给你报酬。

original: Narfi is dead.
traduit: 纳菲死了。

original: DBAstridSanctuaryGreetTopic
traduit: DBAstridSanctuaryGreetTopic

original: Well, what happens now is you start your new life in the Dark Brotherhood. You're part of the Family, after all.
traduit: 现在你要在黑暗兄弟会开始新生活了。毕竟你已经是这个家的一员了。

original: This, as you can see, is our Sanctuary. You won't find a safer place in all of Skyrim. So get comfortable.
traduit: 如你所见，这里是我们的圣所。在天际没有比这里更安全的地方。所以放松点。

original: So what happens now?
traduit: 那现在怎么办？

original: And you. A Stormcloak? I'd thought better of you. You'll all come to regret this day.
traduit: 还有你。风暴斗篷？我对你评价这么高。你们都会后悔的。

original: Any tips about Keerava?
traduit: 有关于基拉瓦的情报吗？

original: She was the toughest of the bunch. Honestly, I'm amazed she didn't kick you out of the Bee and Barb herself.
traduit: 她是这些人中最顽固的。说实话，我很惊讶她没把你踢出蜂与钩。

original: Here's Keerava's payment, courtesy of her family.
traduit: 这是基拉瓦的欠款，可得谢谢她的家人了。

original: Keerava's stubborn, but she's got a soft spot for family.
traduit: 基拉瓦很固执，但对家庭很看重。

original: Talk to Talen-Jei at the Bee and Barb and see if you can get something out of him. They're... well acquainted if you catch my meaning.
traduit: 和蜂与钩的塔伦-杰聊聊，看看能不能从他那套出些什么。他们……很熟悉彼此，懂吧。

original: TG01Goodbyes
traduit: TG01Goodbyes

original: I'll be here when you're done.
traduit: 搞定了就来这里找我。

original: Come back when you grow a backbone.
traduit: 等你有骨气了再来吧。

original: Just leave me in peace.
traduit: 别打扰我。

original: I hope Brynjolf chokes on his gold.
traduit: 希望布林乔夫被他的金币给噎死。

original: I can't stand this city. It's impossible to make a decent living here.
traduit: 真受不了这个城市。在这里根本过不上体面的生活。

original: TG01Hellos
traduit: TG01Hellos

original: I trust everything went well?
traduit: 我想一切还顺利吧？

original: Have anything for us yet?
traduit: 有什么要交给我们的吗？

original: What is it with you and all these questions? Very well, ask away.
traduit: 你怎么要问这些问题？好吧，尽管问。

original: All right, I'll entertain you a bit more. Go on.
traduit: 好吧，我可以再招待招待你。来啊。

original: Now what did you want? I already paid you.
traduit: 你现在还想要什么？我已经给你钱了。

original: I know you... everyone's been talking about it. What are you here for?
traduit: 我知道你……每个人都在谈论这件事。你来这儿干什么？

original: I'm not paying you or Brynjolf a single coin! Now get out of my tavern!
traduit: 我不会给你和布林乔夫一个子儿！滚出我的酒馆！

original: I said get out! I'm not paying a single coin!
traduit: 我说了出去！一个子儿也不付！

original: Here for a room or something to drink? Show me some coin first.
traduit: 想要开房间还是喝点什么？前提是付得起钱。

original: You want something or not?
traduit: 到底想要些什么？

original: We got the message... now just take your business elsewhere.
traduit: 我们收到信了……现在去别处做你的生意吧。

original: I hope you're here for friendlier reasons now... after all, I'm all paid up.
traduit: 希望你这次没有恶意……毕竟，我的钱已经付清了。

original: Oh no! You're the one from Brynjolf's outfit, aren't you?
traduit: 哦不！你是布林乔夫的人吧？

original: No! That urn was priceless!
traduit: 不！那个瓮很值钱的！

original: Please, reconsider what you're doing. Maybe I can pay later...
traduit: 请三思。我晚些会付钱的……

original: I... I don't care! I'm not paying!
traduit: 我……我不在乎！我不会付钱的！

original: I'm sorry, you're going to have to leave. Tell Brynjolf he'll just have to make due without my coin.
traduit: 抱歉，你还是走吧。告诉布林乔夫，想要我的钱就等着吧。

original: So, can I interest you in anything today?
traduit: 你今天有什么需要吗？

original: Look, I got the message. What else did you want?
traduit: 那个，我已经知道了。你还想要什么？

original: It's you! Please, don't hurt me!
traduit: 是你！请不要伤害我！

original: Please! Don't take the statue! It's the only thing of value I have left!
traduit: 求你不要拿走雕像！那是我唯一值钱的东西了！

original: Ask all you want, you can't squeeze blood from a stone. Not in this part of the world anyway.
traduit: 随你怎么问，石头也榨不出血来。反正世上还没这种事。

original: If you're looking for a room, try the Bee and Barb. This place is for the working man.
traduit: 如果找房间，去蜂与钩试试。这地方是给工人的。

original: Getting here was easy.
traduit: 来这里很容易。

original: Reliable and headstrong? You're turning out to be quite the prize!
traduit: 可靠又任性？你还挺值这个价钱的！

original: So... now that I've whetted your appetite with our little scheme at the market, how about handling a few deadbeats for me?
traduit: 所以……既然我在市场上的小计划勾起了你的胃口，帮我处理几个老赖怎么样？

original: So this is the Ragged Flagon?
traduit: 这就是漏壶？

original: Well, well... color me impressed, lad. I wasn't certain I'd ever see you again!
traduit: 嗯嗯……真不错啊，小子。我都不知道还能不能再见到你！

original: Well, well... color me impressed, lass. I wasn't certain I'd ever see you again!
traduit: 嗯嗯……真不错啊，姑娘。我都不知道还能不能再见到你！

original: Get over to Windhelm. Tell Ulfric of our victory here.
traduit: 去风舵城吧，向乌弗瑞克报告我们胜利的喜讯。

original: DBNazirContractSet6ReadyBranchTopic
traduit: DBNazirContractSet6ReadyBranchTopic

original: Hmph. Yes. Yes, I believe you are. Very well, then.
traduit: 嗯。对，对。我相信你准备好。很好。

original: You need to find and kill Safia, the captain of the pirate ship Red Wave.
traduit: 你需要找到并杀死赤红波浪号海盗船的船长萨非亚。

original: The ship travels the northern coast, and sometimes isn't even in Skyrim at all. So you'll have to be patient. Good luck.
traduit: 那艘船会在北部海岸航行，有时甚至不在天际。所以你要有耐心。祝你好运。

original: I'm ready for the last contract.
traduit: 我已经准备好接最后一份契约了。

original: What's Haelga's story?
traduit: 哈尔嘉有什么故事？

original: She's as stubborn as she is beautiful, isn't she? Glad you found a way to get her to pay.
traduit: 她既漂亮又固执是吧？很高兴你找到办法让她付钱了。

original: Got Haelga's payment here.
traduit: 这是哈尔嘉付的钱。

original: Haelga is a devout follower of Dibella and dotes over the statue to the Divine that she keeps at the Bunkhouse. Use it as leverage and she'll cave.
traduit: 哈尔嘉是个迪贝拉的虔诚信徒，非常喜欢她放在工棚里的那个神像。把这个当成筹码，她会屈服的。

original: Any help with Bersi?
traduit: 波西有什么情报吗？

original: I wasn't sure that he'd see the light, but I'm sure you "explained" it to him. Well done!
traduit: 我不确定他会不会明白，但我相信你跟他解释过了。干得好！

original: I have Bersi's Payment.
traduit: 这是波西付的钱。

original: He's as pig-headed a man as you'll ever find.
traduit: 他是你能找到最顽固的人了。

original: The key is that ugly dwarven urn in his shop. Smash that thing to bits and he'll change his attitude.
traduit: 关键在于他店里那个丑陋的矮人瓮。把那东西打碎，他会改变态度的。

original: But we've only just arrived here -- you've no idea what any of us are capable of. Why not give us a chance to show you what we can do?
traduit: 但我们才刚来，你根本不知道我们会些什么。为什么不给我们一个机会展示一下能力呢？

original: Please, please! This is exactly what I'm talking about. Eagerness must be tempered with caution, or else disaster is inevitable.
traduit: 等等，等等！这就是我想说的。急切的心情必须辅以谨慎的态度，否则必然招致灾祸。

original: Then what are we waiting for? Let's get started!
traduit: 那我们还等什么？快开始吧！

original: Of course, my dear. Of course. You all certainly possess some inherent natural ability. That much is not being questioned.
traduit: 当然，亲爱的。当然。你们都有天赋。这一点是毋庸置疑的。

original: What I'm talking about is true control, mastery of magic. It takes years, if not decades, of practice and study.
traduit: 我所说的是真正的掌控，对魔法的精通。这需要几年乃至几十年的实践和研究。

original: Sir, I think we all understand that fairly well. We wouldn't be here if we couldn't control magic!
traduit: 老师，我想我们都很清楚这一点。如果我们不能控制魔法也就不会在这里了！

original: So, as I was saying, the first thing to understand is that magic is, by its very nature, volatile and dangerous.
traduit: 所以，正如我所说，首先需要理解的就是，魔法的本质，是不稳定与危险的。

original: Unless you can control it, it can and will destroy you.
traduit: 除非你能掌控它，不然必会被它掌控甚至毁灭。

original: Welcome, welcome! We were just beginning. Please, stay and listen.
traduit: 欢迎，欢迎！我们才刚刚开始。请吧，留下听讲吧。

original: Oh, fine. Have my boon and be done with it. I've got more interesting deals to make, anyway.
traduit: 啊，好吧。享用我的恩惠吧。反正我还有更多有趣的交易要做。

original: Vile! None of that - you made a deal, and the mortal stood by it honestly. Now it's your turn to come through.
traduit: 维尔！别废话了，你提出了交易，而这个凡人一直坚守着。现在该你履行诺言了。

original: A lack of ambition like that really ought to be punished. Perhaps by turning you into a worm, or maybe a few decades of...
traduit: 像你这么没志气就该被罚，也许应该把你变成蛆，或者几十年的……

original: I'll make sure this war ends, all right. Just as soon as the dragons swarm across Skyrim and wipe out all of you puny...
traduit: 我保证，战争会结束的。就在龙族横行天际，杀光你们所有人的时候……

original: You can be a part of a tremendous power - all you have to do is let your soul be absorbed by this axe. I never said it would be your power...
traduit: 你可以成为一股强大力量的一部分，只需要让斧头把你的灵魂吸收了。我可从没保证过一定是“你自己”的力量……

original: It's a shame you wished for something so dull as me taking back the mutt. Quite the lack of imagination on your part.
traduit: 只是希望我把那条串儿狗带回去，真可惜。太没创意了。

original: Now, as for your wish... An end to the war, was it?
traduit: 现在，至于你的愿望……终结战争是吧？

original: Now, as for your wish... Power, was it?
traduit: 现在，至于你的愿望……力量是吧？

original: Ah, that feels so much better! You forget how nice supreme power feels until you've been stuck in a cave for a few years.
traduit: 啊，感觉好多了！在洞里困了好几年，都快忘了拥有无上力量的感觉了。

original: We're all pretty new at this, right? Let's just give it a chance. What's the worst that could happen?
traduit: 这方面我们都是新手是吧？给个机会试试看吧。还能出什么事吗？

original: Oh, don't listen to him. We can do it, just give us a chance!
traduit: 哦，别理他。我们可以的，给我们个机会！

original: Oh, don't listen to her. We can do it, just give us a chance!
traduit: 哦，别理她。我们可以的，给我们个机会！

original: See? He agrees with us too! Why don't you actually show us something?
traduit: 看到了吗？他也同意我们的意见！为什么不来点实打实的呢？

original: See? She agrees with us too! Why don't you actually show us something?
traduit: 看到了吗？她也同意我们的意见！为什么不来点实打实的呢？

original: I'm not really sure what to think.
traduit: 我不知道该怎么想。

original: Not going to weigh in either way?
traduit: 不想加入争辩吗？

original: I admire your restraint, but there are times when you must make decisions, even without all the facts. Rely on instinct.
traduit: 我很欣赏你的克制，但有时候即使你没有了解全部事实，也需要依靠本能做出决断。

original: I think we should learn something practical.
traduit: 我觉得我们应该学点实用的东西。

original: Is that so?
traduit: 这样吗？

original: Safety should be more important than anything.
traduit: 安全第一。

original: Well, your classmates certainly seem to disagree with you.
traduit: 嗯，看来你的同学们和你意见相反啊。

original: You want my opinion?
traduit: 你想听我的意见？

original: You've been quiet so far. What do you think we should do?
traduit: 你一直都很安静啊。你觉得我们该怎么办？

original: Where did I need to go again?
traduit: 我还需要去哪里？

original: You'll need to speak with Mirabelle Ervine. Her quarters are in the Hall of Countenance, but she could be anywhere on the grounds.
traduit: 你得跟米拉贝勒·厄文谈谈。她住在面容大厅。

original: How am I supposed to do all of this?
traduit: 我要怎么做？

original: Do you want me to hold your hand as well?
traduit: 需要我手把手教你吗？

original: You have the ring. All you have to do is pick Brand-Shei's pocket and plant it there.
traduit: 拿着戒指。只需要把它放到布兰德-谢的口袋里。

original: You're going to have to sneak over to Madesi's stall and use your lockpick on the strongbox.
traduit: 偷偷溜到玛德希的柜台，用你的开锁器打开保险箱。

original: Then when you have the ring, you pickpocket Brand-Shei and leave it behind.
traduit: 拿到戒指之后，放到布兰德-谢的口袋里。

original: Why are we doing this to Brand-Shei?
traduit: 我们为什么要这样对待布兰德-谢？

original: We've been contracted to make sure Brand-Shei remembers not to meddle in affairs that aren't his own.
traduit: 我们接到契约要让布兰德-谢明白，不该管的事不要管。

original: Now, since we're not the Dark Brotherhood, we're not going to kill him, we're just going to make sure he sits in the prisons for a few days.
traduit: 但我们不是黑暗兄弟会，不能杀了他，我们只是要让他进监狱待几天。

original: I'm ready. Let's get this started.
traduit: 我准备好了。我们开始吧。

original: Good. Wait until I start the distraction and then show me what you're made of.
traduit: 好。等我开始分散大家的注意力，就看你的了。

original: Damn. I knew I shouldn't have waited.
traduit: 该死。我就知道不该犹豫。

original: What a waste of time.
traduit: 真是浪费时间。

original: Well, I see that my time is up. Come back tomorrow if you wish to buy.
traduit: 好了，看来我该收摊了。想买明天请早。

original: I dunno, sounds like I should try it.
traduit: 我不知道，听起来我可以试试。

original: What if he's right? Maybe I'll buy one.
traduit: 万一是真的呢？也许可以买一瓶试试。

original: I could get rich and stop selling these trinkets.
traduit: 要是真能发财，我就不用卖这些破烂了。

original: This is just what I need right now.
traduit: 我现在正需要这东西。

original: I can't afford to get one, but can I afford not to?
traduit: 我是买不起，但我不想错过啊。

original: That Wisp Essence didn't help, but maybe this will.
traduit: 精华液没用，但也许这个真能管用呢。

original: He has to be lying!
traduit: 他肯定在骗人！

original: Twenty coins? No one has that much.
traduit: 二十金币？谁有那么多钱。

original: Don't listen to him, he's making this up.
traduit: 别听他胡编乱造。

original: Why would you even listen to him?
traduit: 你们听他的干嘛？

original: He gives other merchants a bad name.
traduit: 他简直是给商人团体抹黑。

original: This is ridiculous.
traduit: 太荒唐了。

original: Grow back that missing limb!
traduit: 能让断肢重生！

original: See into other people's thoughts!
traduit: 看穿别人想法！

original: Learn a library's worth of knowledge in moments!
traduit: 一瞬间掌握海量知识！

original: Wield powerful magic incantations!
traduit: 使用强大的魔法！

original: Live for thousands of years!
traduit: 长生不老！

original: Who knows what powers the elixir will unlock!
traduit: 谁晓得这种灵药还能释放什么力量！

original: Please hurry, I have only a few bottles left!
traduit: 欲购从速，我就剩这几瓶了！

original: Only twenty septims a bottle!
traduit: 二十塞普汀一瓶！

original: Only twenty gold septims! Hurry before my supply is gone.
traduit: 只要二十塞普汀！快点吧，货可不多了。

original: How much does it cost?
traduit: 得花多少钱？

original: My sources must remain a secret for their own protection but I can promise that the contents are genuine.
traduit: 我必须对消息来源保密以保护他们。但我可以保证，内容绝对真实可靠。

original: One sip of the elixir and your wishes will be granted. Great wealth, everlasting life or perhaps limitless power could be yours!
traduit: 只要喝下一口灵药，愿望就会成真。巨大财富、长生不老、力拔山河，一切都能属于你！

original: How did you get that, then? No one's seen them in years!
traduit: 那你是怎么弄到的？都多少年没人见过他们了！

original: The one and only.
traduit: 独一无二。

original: Mystical beings who live in legends and were masters of great magic. Imagine the power that coursed through their veins!
traduit: 传说中精通强大魔法的存在。想象一下他们血管中涌动的力量吧！

original: Oh come on, are you talking about the Snow Elves?
traduit: 哦得了吧，你是说雪精灵？

original: That was a simple misunderstanding, but this item is the real thing.
traduit: 那是个小误会，但这回的是真东西。

original: Lads and lasses I give you, Falmerblood Elixir!
traduit: 大家伙看好，我给你们带来了“伐莫血灵药”！

original: That's what you said about the Wisp Essence and it turned out to be crushed nirnroot mixed with water!
traduit: 上次你说的什么“精华液”，就是奈恩根碾碎了兑水！

original: Patience, Brand-Shei. This is a rare opportunity, and I wouldn't want you to get left out.
traduit: 耐心点，布兰德-谢。这可是个难得的机会，我不希望你被漏掉了。

original: Come on, Brynjolf... what is it this time?
traduit: 快说吧，布林乔夫……这次又是什么？

original: Gather 'round all!
traduit: 请看过来！

original: No pushing, no shoving. Plenty of room!
traduit: 不要挤，不要抢。空间足富裕！

original: This way everyone! Over here!
traduit: 大伙都看过来！都看过来！

original: You need to hear this!
traduit: 你们得听听！

original: Everyone! Everyone! Gather 'round!
traduit: 大家伙！大家伙！看过来！

original: I have something amazing to show you that demands your attention!
traduit: 我有很棒的东西要给你们展示，瞧一瞧看一看咯！

original: You want to talk to me? After everything you've done?
traduit: 你还想和我说话？在你做了那么多事之后？

original: Divines smile on you, friend.
traduit: 圣灵向你微笑，朋友。

original: I hope the wilds claim you, one of these days.
traduit: 希望有一天荒野会将你吞噬。

original: What do you need, my friend?
traduit: 有什么需要吗，朋友？

original: I've had just about all I'm willing to take from you. What is it?
traduit: 我已经和你没什么好谈的了。还有什么事？

original: You and me, we're the only people around who aren't complete fools.
traduit: 你和我，咱俩是这附近唯二不是傻瓜的人了。

original: Now why would I want to talk to you?
traduit: 你和我有什么可谈的？

original: Friends like you are hard to find and very valuable to me.
traduit: 像你这样的朋友很难遇到，对我来说很珍贵。

original: Something you need, you miserable wretch?
traduit: 想干什么，你这个可怜虫？

original: Good to see you. Finally someone useful is around.
traduit: 遇到你真好。这周围总算有人还算有点用了。

original: I don't like talking to someone who holds their honor so cheaply.
traduit: 我不和寡廉鲜耻的人说话。

original: Good to have you by my side, friend. I need reliable people around.
traduit: 很高兴有你在我身边，朋友。我需要身边有些可靠的人。

original: You have something to say, dog? Something on your mind?
traduit: 你还有什么要说么，狗？盘算什么呢？

original: You're someone who can get things done. I like that.
traduit: 你是个会办事的。我喜欢。

original: I should bash your face in after all you've done.
traduit: 你搞了这么多事，我真该揍你一顿。

original: You've been a good friend to me. That means something.
traduit: 你是我的好朋友。明白我的意思吧。

original: What do you want? You've caused enough trouble.
traduit: 你还想要什么？你惹的麻烦还不够多吗。

original: Good to see you again, friend.
traduit: 很高兴又见到你了，朋友。

original: You. What do you want?
traduit: 是你啊。想干什么？

original: Now here's a man I'm glad to see.
traduit: 很高兴见到你啊。

original: Now here's a woman I'm glad to see.
traduit: 很高兴见到你啊。

original: You! You're going to hurt me again aren't you? Just stay away.
traduit: 是你！你又打算来伤害我了吗？离我远点。

original: It's so good to see you again.
traduit: 很高兴又见面了。

original: I don't mean you any trouble. Just leave me alone.
traduit: 我不想惹麻烦。离我远点。

original: Divines bless you. May the ground you walk quake as you pass.
traduit: 圣灵祝福你。愿你的步伐震天动地。

original: Gods strike you down.
traduit: 愿诸神把你打倒。

original: My favorite drinking buddy. Let's get some mead.
traduit: 我最爱的酒友啊。一起去喝一杯吧。

original: Just looking at you makes me upset.
traduit: 光是看见你我就心烦。

original: Good to see Skyrim still has such fine people. You give an old man hope.
traduit: 很高兴在天际还能看到你这样的好人。你让我这个老人家看到了希望。

original: You're just rotten. No good.
traduit: 你真是烂的一无是处。

original: I hope your parents are proud of you. They have a lot of reason to be.
traduit: 希望你的父母能以你为豪。他们一定会的。

original: Leave me alone. Can't an old man have some peace?
traduit: 别打扰我。老人家就不能享受安静吗？

original: You're not as dumb as you look.
traduit: 你不像看上去那么蠢嘛。

original: Here to shame an old woman? Leave me be.
traduit: 来羞辱老妇人吗？别打扰我。

original: Well, look at you. If only everyone acted like you did.
traduit: 啊，看看你。要是每个人都像你一样该多好。

original: You. Every time I look at you my blood boils.
traduit: 是你。一看到你我气就不打一处来。

original: It's a fine day with you around.
traduit: 有你在就是个好天气啊。

original: You're nothing but trouble.
traduit: 你就是个麻烦。

original: Good day, friend! Keeping well?
traduit: 你好啊，朋友！最近怎么样？

original: Worthless. Everyone like you is completely worthless.
traduit: 垃圾。像你这样的人都是垃圾。

original: Good to see you. At least you know how to treat someone properly.
traduit: 很高兴见到你。至少你知道该如何善待别人。

original: Every time I think of you, I imagine a Saber Cat closing its claws around your face.
traduit: 每次想到你。我都想有只剑齿虎能把你的脸抓烂。

original: You're mean. I hate you. I hate you forever and ever and ever.
traduit: 你坏透了。我恨你。我会永远永远恨你。

original: You're the best! Can you be my father?
traduit: 你太棒了！你愿意做我爸爸吗？

original: You're the best! Can you be my mother?
traduit: 你太棒了！你愿意做我妈妈吗？

original: I hope monsters come and eat you.
traduit: 我希望有怪物把你吃了。

original: I bet you could slay one of those mean old dragons. I bet you could do anything.
traduit: 我打赌你能干掉一头老恶龙。我打赌你什么都能做得到。

original: The gods know what you've done.
traduit: 你做的事众神都看着呢。

original: A fine day to you, friend. May you die with a sword in your hands.
traduit: 祝你好运，朋友。愿你战死时紧握自己的剑。

original: What do you want, milk drinker?
traduit: 想干什么，懦夫？

original: May the gods watch over your battles, friend.
traduit: 愿诸神在战斗时保佑你，朋友。

original: Absolutely no time to deal with lowlifes these days. Go away.
traduit: 这年头没工夫和小人打交道。躲远些。

original: Oh, it's you. I was wondering why I was smelling something unpleasant.
traduit: 哦，是你啊。我还说哪里来的恶心味道。

original: So nice to have pleasant company for a change.
traduit: 能有个令人愉快的伙伴真好啊。

original: There are so few pleasures in life as fine as your company.
traduit: 生活中很少有比和你相伴更美好的快乐了。

original: What do you want? Aren't your hands coated with enough blood?
traduit: 你想干什么？你手上的血还不够多么？

original: May your next fight bring you victory, friend.
traduit: 愿你的战斗将你引向胜利，朋友。

original: For your crimes, may Malacath boil your blood and grind your bones.
traduit: 愿玛拉凯斯因你的罪行将你血液焚干，挫骨扬灰。

original: May your weapons be sharp and your prey fresh.
traduit: 愿你的武器永远锋利，你的猎物无处可逃。

original: Khajiit wishes for you to go away. You have done us too much harm.
traduit: 卡吉特希望你离开点。你伤害我们太多了。

original: These sands are cold, but Khajiit feels warmness from your presence.
traduit: 这些沙子很冷，但卡吉特因你的存在感到温暖。

original: Its scent is foul, unclean. Hurtful.
traduit: 肮脏不洁的气味。太有害了。

original: Speak. Khajiit will listen until all the sugars in the world turn sour.
traduit: 说吧。卡吉特会倾听直到世界上所有的糖都变酸。

original: It fills us with rage. What harm does it bring to us now?
traduit: 让我们充满愤怒的人。现在又带来什么灾难？

original: Ours is to smile at your passing, friend.
traduit: 我们会微笑着目送你走过，朋友。

original: It annoys us. What does it want to take from us now?
traduit: 惹怒我们的家伙，这次又想夺走什么？

original: It is our most favored company.
traduit: 是我们最爱的伙伴啊。

original: Hmm... Yes, the silence suits you. Gives you an air of mystery.
traduit: 嗯……沉默和你很搭。给你增添了一股神秘感。

original: Now, down to business. I'm arranging a job for you. But in the meantime, go talk to Nazir. He may have some smaller contracts to tide you over.
traduit: 现在，说正题。我要给你准备一份工作。这段时间，就去找纳兹尔谈谈吧。他或许会有一些小契约可以让你适应适应。

original: Soon, the Night Mother will arrive. And things around here are sure to get even more interesting.
traduit: 夜母快要到了。这里的事情一定会变得更加有趣的。

original: Ah, but one last thing. A welcome home present. The armor of the Dark Brotherhood. May it serve you well in all your... endeavors.
traduit: 啊，最后一件事。回家礼物。黑暗兄弟会的护甲。愿它陪伴你的……努力。

original: Soon, my dearest. Soon.
traduit: 很快了，亲爱的。很快。

original: I'm arranging a job for you, but I need some more time. For now, go talk to Nazir. He may have some smaller contracts to tide you over.
traduit: 我正在为你准备工作，但还需要些时间。现在先去找纳兹尔谈谈吧。他那里有些小契约可以帮你适应适应。

original: When do I get to kill someone?
traduit: 我什么时候能去杀人？

original: Our Family, my dearest. Our Family. Together, united as one, the Dark Brotherhood can accomplish anything.
traduit: 是我们的家庭了，亲爱的。我们的家。团结一致，黑暗兄弟会就能所向披靡。

original: But you must be anxious to get to work. I'm arranging a job, but need a bit more time. For now, go see Nazir. He's got several smaller contracts.
traduit: 但你一定急于投入工作吧。我正在安排，需要些时间。现在去找纳兹尔吧。他手里有几个小契约。

original: I am honored to be a part of your Family, Astrid.
traduit: 我很荣幸能加入你的家庭，阿斯垂德。

original: DBAstridSleepReacttion3Topic
traduit: DBAstridSleepReacttion3Topic

original: Am I to take your silence as acceptance?
traduit: 我可以把你的沉默当做同意吗？

original: Then you know where we stand. Make your kill, and we're square. Repayment of your debt is but a discreet knife thrust away.
traduit: 那你应该知道我们的立场。把人杀了，我们就扯平了。只需要小心翼翼地把刀捅进去，你的债就还清了。

original: DBAstridSleepReacttion2Topic
traduit: DBAstridSleepReacttion2Topic

original: See, I knew we could resolve this civilly. A debt owed must be repaid. You understand that.
traduit: 我就知道我们能用文明的方式解决问题。欠债还债，理解理解。

original: Well, get to it then. Pick your guest, and send the poor fool to the Void.  I'll give you the key to this shack, and you'll be on your way.
traduit: 好了，那就开始吧。选一个客人，把那个可怜的傻瓜送到虚空去。我就把小屋的钥匙给你，然后你就能离开了。

original: All right, I'll do it. I'll kill one of them.
traduit: 好吧，我去做。我会杀了他们之一的。

original: DBAstridSleepReacttion1Topic
traduit: DBAstridSleepReacttion1Topic

original: Now that is a shame.
traduit: 那可真是丢人啊。

original: But what you fail to realize is that you involved yourself in this "insanity" when you took Grelod's life. You made your choice.
traduit: 但你没意识到吗，你杀了桂罗的时候就已经卷进“疯狂”中了。你已经选了这条路。

original: Now it's time to face the consequences of your actions. You don't leave this shack until someone dies.
traduit: 现在是时候为自己的行为买单了。除非有人死，否则你是离不开这个小屋的。

original: I'll have no part of this insanity.
traduit: 我不会参与这种疯狂之举的。

original: This isn't over.
traduit: 这还没完。

original: You hear me you old fool! This isn't over!
traduit: 听见了吗，老匹夫！还没结束！

original: The Empire will return. Count on it.
traduit: 帝国会回来的。等着吧。

original: Yes, but not likely the one you intend.
traduit: 没错，但可能不是你要的那种。

original: He's right. Galmar, come, let us restore order.
traduit: 他说得对。加尔玛，来吧，让我们重建秩序。

original: Come Galmar, we have much to do.
traduit: 来吧，加尔玛，我们还有很多事要做。

original: Jarl Black-Briar. I must admit, I do like the sound of that.
traduit: 黑棘领主，我承认，我很喜欢这个说法。

original: And don't worry about any rioting, Legate. I have it under control.
traduit: 别担心会发生暴乱，副官。一切都在我掌控之中。

original: We will soon begin publicly executing captured men. That should send a clear message to the people.
traduit: 我们会很快公开处决俘虏。这应该能向民众发出明确的信号。

original: Indeed. Come, there is much to be done.
traduit: 确实。走吧，还有很多事要做。

original: Enough! Both of you!
traduit: 够了！你们俩！

original: There is a burning city out there that needs a government.
traduit: 有个还在燃烧的城市需要新政府。

original: Are you two quite done?
traduit: 你俩说完了吗？

original: You, go pack your things.
traduit: 你，回去收拾东西。

original: And you, go sit on that damn chair and start acting like a Jarl.
traduit: 你，去那个破椅子上坐好，表现得像个领主样子。

original: If you ladies are finished bickering, there's much to be done.
traduit: 两位女士要是吵够了，还有很多事情要做。

original: Jarl Black-Briar put your government together. Do it now, or there will be rioting in the streets.
traduit: 黑棘领主快点组建自己的政权。现在就做，不然街上会发生骚乱。

original: We must move quickly to prevent further violence.
traduit: 我们必须迅速采取行动，防止进一步的暴力事件。

original: If you two are finished with the touching homecoming, there's a city in chaos out there.
traduit: 快点结束你们感人的返乡庆祝，外面的城市还一团乱呢。

original: Vignar Gray-Mane! Your family was noticeably absent from the walls. Now I know why. Wouldn't a dagger in the back have sufficed?
traduit: 维吉纳·灰鬃！你们家根本没在城墙上。现在我算知道了。背后捅刀子还不够么？

original: Thongvor. I should have executed your whole treacherous clan when I had the chance.
traduit: 松瓦。我当初有机会就该把你们这群叛徒都处决了。

original: So enters Maven Black-Briar, the glint of Imperial coin in her eyes. So tell me, what's the price for a woman's integrity these days?
traduit: 所以玛雯·黑棘就这么走进来了。眼睛里闪烁着对帝国钱币的渴望。告诉我，这个时代一个女人的正直是什么价？

original: Welcome back. I've left a few surprises for you to discover.
traduit: 欢迎回来。我给你准备了些惊喜。

original: Balgruuf!
traduit: 巴尔古夫！

original: Ready to listen to the Silver-Blood family now, Igmund?
traduit: 准备好听命于银血家族了吗，依格蒙德？

original: I think I'll like living here.
traduit: 我想我会喜欢上这里。

original: Ahhh... It's good to be home.
traduit: 啊……回家的感觉真好。

original: Gods. A woman attacked right on the streets.
traduit: 神啊。一个女人在街上被袭击了。

original: Are you all right? Did you see what happened?
traduit: 你还好吧？你看到发生什么了吗？

original: (Invisible Continue)(Forced Goodbye) Time Limit to Attack
traduit: (Invisible Continue)(Forced Goodbye) Time Limit to Attack

original: The attack will be launched imminently. Gather your weaponry and get to the front lines... Now, soldier!
traduit: 攻击马上就要开始了。带着你的武器去前线……现在就去，士兵！

original: Now that our "ghost" has been unmasked, I hope we see more visitors in town than just the occasional pilgrim.
traduit: 既然我们的“鬼魂”已经被揭开了面具，但愿能多些游客，而不只是偶尔路过的朝圣者。

original: If I were you, I'd keep away from the barrow on the east side of town... it's haunted.
traduit: 如果我是你，我会离镇子东边的古坟远点……那里闹鬼了。

original: We don't get many visitors through here, unless their headed up to High Hrothgar of course.
traduit: 除了去霍斯加修道院的，我们这里没多少游客。

original: Need a room? Maybe a drink? You name it.
traduit: 要租间房？还是喝杯酒？随你吩咐。

original: Let me know if I can get you anything.
traduit: 有什么需要帮忙的尽管说。

original: Anything I can help you with? A drink or a room perhaps?
traduit: 有什么能帮忙的吗？想来杯酒还是要间房？

original: Pardon me, milord. Would you care to hear me play my lute?
traduit: 打扰了，老爷。想听我演奏一曲鲁特琴吗？

original: Pardon me, milady. Would you care to hear me play my lute?
traduit: 打扰了，夫人。想听我演奏一曲鲁特琴吗？

original: If you fancy a bit of music, let me know.
traduit: 如果喜欢音乐的话，请告诉我。

original: I can't believe Fastred's gone. I... I should have been nicer to her.
traduit: 真不敢相信法斯莱德离开了。我……我应该对她好一点的。

original: I can't believe Fastred ran off to Riften with that... that bastard.
traduit: 真不敢相信法斯莱德和那个……混蛋跑到裂谷城去了。

original: My daughter's driving me crazy, so forgive me if I'm a bit on edge.
traduit: 我女儿快把我逼疯了，请原谅我有点急躁。

original: If you ever settle down to have children, think twice before you do it.
traduit: 如果你想安定下来生娃，最好三思后行。

original: Any idea how I can get my daughter's head out of the clouds?
traduit: 要怎么样才能让我闺女不那么糊涂？

original: You a pilgrim or just passing through?
traduit: 你是来朝圣的还是路过？

original: Watch yourself on High Hrothgar, I hear wolves prowl the steps.
traduit: 去霍斯加修道院的路上要小心，我听见阶梯上有狼叫唤。

original: I hope Fastred's doing well in Riften. I miss her.
traduit: 希望法斯莱德在裂谷城过得好。我很想她。

original: You must be another pilgrim on the way up to High Hrothgar. No other reason to pass through here.
traduit: 你一定也是去霍斯加修道院的朝圣者吧。没有别的理由会经过这里了。

original: Pilgrim or not, if I were you, I'd move right through our backwards little town.
traduit: 不管是不是来朝圣，如果我是你的话，我会直接绕过我们这个落后的小镇。

original: You better not be here to stir up any trouble.
traduit: 在这里最好别挑事儿。

original: And to think that we've been supplying the Greybeards with our own food supplies. What have they ever done for us?
traduit: 想想看吧，我们一直给灰胡子提供食物。他们为我们做过什么？

original: Oh! You're a traveler! You must have so much to tell about the world outside this boring town!
traduit: 哦！你是旅行者吧！你肯定有这个小镇外世界的很多故事可讲！

original: Have anything interesting to tell me?
traduit: 有什么有趣的事吗？

original: I can't imagine how exciting it must be like to journey from place to place. You're so lucky!
traduit: 我无法想象从一个地方到另一个地方旅行会有多么兴奋。你真幸运！

original: Narfi's happy now. Maybe Narfi can sleep. Sleep all night. Sleep, sleep, sleep.
traduit: 纳菲现在很开心。也许纳菲可以睡觉。睡一整晚。睡觉，睡觉，睡觉。

original: Narfi's sad now. Still wait for Reyda. No more sleep. No, no... no.
traduit: 纳菲现在很伤心。还在等着瑞达。睡不着。睡不着……睡不着。

original: I can't see you, Reyda! I can't find you! Why are you hiding? Hiding, hide, hide, hide! Don't make me sad!
traduit: 我看不到你啊，瑞达！我找不到你！你为什么要躲起来？躲起来，躲，躲，躲！别让我伤心了！

original: Oh Reyda! Redya! You live among the clouds now, dear Reyda!
traduit: 哦瑞达！瑞达！你现在去云上生活了，亲爱的瑞达！

original: I miss Reyda. She was so nice to Narfi. Narfi's sad he can't be with Reyda.
traduit: 我想瑞达了。她对纳菲很好。不能和瑞达在一起，纳菲很难过。

original: You don't look like a pilgrim. Why bother visiting Ivarstead?
traduit: 你看着不像个朝圣者。来伊瓦尔镇做什么啊？

original: Hmm? What do you want?
traduit: 嗯？你想要什么？

original: Is it absolutely necessary for you to bother me right now?
traduit: 你一定要现在打扰我吗？

original: Thanks again for delivering those supplies to the Greybeards.
traduit: 再次感谢你帮灰胡子送补给。

original: Ah, good to see you again! How did that delivery go?
traduit: 啊，又见到你了！补给送到了吗？

original: Passing through on your way to High Hrothgar? About to make a delivery up there myself.
traduit: 要去霍斯加修道院吗？我得送些补给过去。

original: I wish I could make my deliveries more often, but the road's getting dangerous.
traduit: 我也希望能经常送东西上去，但路上是越来越危险了。

original: 7,000 Steps indeed... next time they need to build it closer to the ground...
traduit: 7000级台阶啊……下次他们应该把它修得离地面近些……

original: I'm going to put those pelts you gave me to good use.
traduit: 我会好好利用你给我的兽皮。

original: So, have you shown those furry menaces that I mean business?
traduit: 你有让那些毛怪知道我是认真的了吗？

original: This has to be the worst place in Skyrim to run a mill. How am I supposed to do anything with all those bears running around?
traduit: 这儿肯定是天际里最不适合经营木材厂的地方。那么多熊跑来跑去，我该怎么办？

original: These damn bears are driving me crazy!
traduit: 这些该死的熊快把我逼疯了！

original: Can you believe it? Another pile of logs ruined.
traduit: 你能相信吗？又一堆木料被毁了。

original: I swear, if one more thing goes wrong, I'm going to burn my mill to the ground!
traduit: 我发誓，如果再出什么岔子，我就把我的木材厂烧了！

original: Hello, my friend? What can I do for you on such a fine day?
traduit: 你好啊，朋友？天气真好啊，我能为你做点什么吗？

original: Miss Temba is much happier now that you took care of those bears. She may not look like she is, but I can tell.
traduit: 多亏你对付了那些熊，谭巴小姐现在高兴多了。她可能看起来不太像，但我看得出来。

original: Those bears are making Miss Temba so angry. I hope you can do something about them.
traduit: 那些熊让谭巴小姐很生气。希望你能做些什么。

original: Such a fine day, smell the air! Isn't it wonderful?
traduit: 真是个好天气，呼吸呼吸新鲜空气吧！很棒不是吗？

original: I hope life's treating you well, friend.
traduit: 希望生活对你很好，朋友。

original: Oh my, a guest!
traduit: 啊，有客人来了！

original: Please, make yourself at home!
traduit: 请吧，不必拘束！

original: Lone travelers can find these woods a little treacherous.
traduit: 独行的旅人会觉得这片森林有些危险哦。

original: We've been looking for someone to join us in a hunt.
traduit: 我们一直在找人加入我们的狩猎。

original: Hern and I do so adore guests! These guards are such a bore.
traduit: 我和赫恩很喜欢客人！那些卫兵很讨厌。

original: A guest, oh my!
traduit: 哦，天啊，有客人来了！

original: Why don't you stay a while?
traduit: 为什么不多待会儿呢？

original: The patrols never seem to give us time to be alone, the nosy pests.
traduit: 巡逻队似乎不想让我们独处，这些爱管闲事的臭虫。

original: Is Hert his sister or his wife? Or both?
traduit: 赫特是他妹子还是妻子？还是两个都是？

original: Hert keeps giving me this look. I don't know if she wants me or if she wants to eat me.
traduit: 赫特一直这样看着我。我不知道她是想要我还是想吃我。

original: Just my luck, stuck in the sticks with this crazy old woman.
traduit: 我运气不好，跟个疯老太婆困在一起。

original: I grew up hearing songs about Eyldi the Bear! She wrestled a storm out of the sky!
traduit: 我听着“熊罴”艾尔迪的歌长大！她曾经对抗过天上的风暴！

original: If you're looking for a room, you want the Four Shields.
traduit: 如果想找房间，可以去四盾酒馆。

original: You look like you've seen your share of adventure.
traduit: 看来你是个经历过冒险的人。

original: It's no easy thing to make a living in the wilds of Skyrim.
traduit: 在天际的荒野谋生可不容易。

original: Don't see many travelers out this way.
traduit: 这里没多少游客经过。

original: This land's tough and unforgiving, but beautiful, too.
traduit: 这片土地严酷无情，却又美丽。

original: You hear all this talk about a war? I hope it never comes here.
traduit: 你听说关于战争的传言了吗？希望战火永远别烧到这里来。

original: Seen some mean-spirited folk pass through lately. Thought I was rid of those sorts when I left Markarth.
traduit: 最近看到一些卑鄙的人路过。我还以为离开马卡斯就摆脱他们了呢。

original: Welcome, traveler. Mind yourself in our town.
traduit: 欢迎啊，旅行者。在我们镇上要小心。

original: We aren't a big city like Solitude or Markarth, but we like it this way.
traduit: 我们这里不是像独孤或者马卡斯那样的大城市，但我们喜欢这样。

original: If it weren't for Michel, I'd probably be dead in a Markarth gutter by now.
traduit: 如果不是米切尔，我现在可能已经死在马卡斯的水沟里了。

original: Got a loving wife, a healthy son and a patch of land to call my own. What more could a man ask for?
traduit: 有个挚爱的妻子，健康的儿子，再加上一块属于自己的土地。一个男人夫复何求？

original: I'm hoping to run my own inn someday.
traduit: 我希望有一天能开一家属于自己的旅馆。

original: Faida's teaching me the innkeeper's trade. She runs the Four Shields.
traduit: 菲达在教我开酒馆的本事。她正在经营四盾酒馆。

original: Please stop looking at me like that.
traduit: 请不要这样看着我。

original: First the war and now there's talk of dragons. What's next?
traduit: 先前是打仗，现在又说有龙。那接下来是什么？

original: Working hard gives a man reason for drinking hard! Well, that and putting up with a wife like mine.
traduit: 努力工作赋予男人拼命喝酒的理由！哦对，还得忍受我老婆这样的妻子。

original: You're a well-traveled sort, I can tell just looking at you.
traduit: 你一看就是个经常旅行的人。

original: You been to Markarth? They've got a tavern called the Silver-Blood Inn. Best ale this side of Skyrim.
traduit: 你去过马卡斯吗？那里有个银血旅店。他们那儿有天际最好的麦芽酒。

original: Money's been tight since the mill burned down. My wife won't let me forget it.
traduit: 自从木材厂被烧毁之后，资金就很紧张。我妻子总是提醒我。

original: They say a strong drink, a sharp axe and a good woman are all a Nord needs to be happy. Two out of three's not bad.
traduit: 他们说一杯烈酒，一把快斧和一个好娘们就是诺德人快乐的全部。嗯，三个占俩也不错。

original: Rest a spell! Can't work every minute of your life.
traduit: 休息休息吧！不能让生活被工作挤满。

original: Where is that lazy man?
traduit: 那个懒汉跑哪儿去了？

original: You going to try and sell me something? Well, I ain't interested.
traduit: 你想卖什么给我吗？我没什么兴趣。

original: Did my worthless husband send you?
traduit: 是我那个没用的爷们儿派你来的？

original: Got nothing to say to strange folk.
traduit: 我和陌生人没话说。

original: Keep walking, stranger.
traduit: 走开吧，陌生人。

original: Got nothing to spare for travelers nor refugees, here.
traduit: 这里没有多余的东西分给旅者和难民。

original: If you're looking for handouts, look somewhere else.
traduit: 如果你在找施舍，那还是别处看看吧。

original: You want anything in this life, you gotta take it. Just not from me.
traduit: 这辈子如果有什么想要的，一定要得到手。但别从我这儿拿。

original: Faida's the name. I keep the inn.
traduit: 我叫菲达。是酒馆的老板。

original: Something different about you, I can tell. Hope you ain't here to cause trouble.
traduit: 看得出来你有些不一样。希望你不是来找麻烦的。

original: The meals I serve ain't what I'd call a Jarl's feast, but they'll fill your belly.
traduit: 我提供的食物比不上领主的盛宴，但能填饱你的肚子。

original: Seen a lot of travelers lately. Mostly soldier, nowadays.
traduit: 我最近见过很多旅人。大部分都是士兵。

original: You met the Lylvieves? Quiet family, but they're the heart of Dragon Bridge.
traduit: 见过李维一家吗？虽然是个安静的家庭，但他们是龙桥的心脏。

original: Poor Horgeir. Everyone in town knows about his wife's affair but him. Probably better if he doesn't know.
traduit: 可怜的霍格尔。除了他，镇上人人知道他妻子有外遇。他还是不知道的好。

original: I think the dragons are here to test us, and make sure we're still true Nords.
traduit: 我觉得龙族是来考验我们的，以此确保我们仍是真正的诺德人。

original: I was a barmaid at the Winking Skeever when I met my husband, rest his soul. Wasn't for him, I'd still be working there!
traduit: 我认识我丈夫的时候正在眨眼恶鼠当服务员，愿他安息。如果没有他，我现在还在那里工作！

original: Respect the law, and you'll have no trouble in Dragon Bridge.
traduit: 遵纪守法，在龙桥就没有麻烦。

original: Mind you don't cross Tassius. He's in charge around here.
traduit: 注意别惹到塔西留斯。他在这里说了算。

original: Don't start any trouble and I think we'll get along just fine.
traduit: 别惹麻烦，咱们就能相处得很好。

original: At least, if you're gonna cause trouble, go somewhere else, okay? Please?
traduit: 如果你要惹麻烦，至少去别的地方好吗？

original: Are you a mercenary? You won't find much work here.
traduit: 你是佣兵？你在这儿可找不到活。

original: Another quiet day.
traduit: 又是宁静的一天。

original: Another quiet day... I hope.
traduit: 希望又是……宁静的一天。

original: Heard there were wolves on the road up north.
traduit: 听说北边的路上有狼。

original: Those rebels better not try coming to Haafingar.
traduit: 希望那些叛军别到海芬加来。

original: I'll bet a drunk like you sees a lot of strange things.
traduit: 我打赌你这种酒鬼一定会看到很多奇怪的东西。

original: I give up. What did you see?
traduit: 我放弃了。你看到了什么？

original: Very well. I respect your discretion.
traduit: 很好。我尊重你的判断。

original: Now, I need your assistance with a matter of a more... personal nature.
traduit: 我现在需要你帮我，处理一件更加……私密的事。

original: Oh, very good. Very good indeed. You, my dear, are going to fit in here quite nicely...
traduit: 哦，很好。非常好。亲爱的，你很适合这里……

original: I live only to serve. Hail Sithis!
traduit: 我就是为此而生。西帝斯万岁！

original: Of course, dear. Of course. And, from what my little ravens tell me, you handled yourself quite well.
traduit: 当然，亲爱的。当然。我的小乌鸦告诉我你处理得很好。

original: I did what had to be done. Nothing more.
traduit: 我只是做了该做的事。

original: Ah, you're back. So, how went your first real contract? A bit more exciting than what Nazir's been offering, I'd wager.
traduit: 啊，你回来了。第一份正式契约感觉如何？肯定比纳兹尔提供的更刺激吧。

original: That bastard got exactly what he deserved.
traduit: 那混蛋罪有应得。

original: But last I heard, Nilsine is still alive. So I guess you decided not to kill her as well. I have to admit... I'm disappointed.
traduit: 但我听说，尼尔欣还活着。看起来你是不想杀她了。我只能说……我很失望。

original: Here's the payment for killing Alain. And nothing for letting Nilsine live. Just remember, that was your decision.
traduit: 这是你杀死阿兰的报酬。但是尼尔欣还活着，也就没有额外的钱了。这是你自己决定的。

original: Alain Dufont now lies dead.
traduit: 阿兰·杜峰特已经死了。

original: Thank you. That bastard got exactly what he deserved.
traduit: 多谢。那混蛋罪有应得。

original: And... I heard about Nilsine. You have more than fulfilled your part of the bargain. Please, take this - as payment, and a symbol of my affection.
traduit: 而且……我听说尼尔欣死了。你完成了额外的约定。请收下这个作为报酬吧，作为我的谢礼。

original: I'll never forget you.
traduit: 我不会忘记你的。

original: Well, what news? Is Alain...
traduit: 嗯，有消息吗？阿兰……

original: DB03MuiriAlainWhyBranchTopic
traduit: DB03MuiriAlainWhyBranchTopic

original: I went to Windhelm to see the Shatter-Shields. They were old and dear friends, and... in mourning. Friga was killed recently. Murdered...
traduit: 我去风舵城看望碎盾一家。他们和我是亲密无间的老朋友，而且……正沉浸在悲哀中。弗丽嘉最近遇害了。谋杀……

original: I met Alain in the tavern, while I was... drinking my sadness away. He was handsome, and charming. He said I was the "beautiful lily" of his dreams.
traduit: 我在酒馆里遇到了阿兰，当时我在……借酒浇愁。他长得很英俊，也很有魅力。他说我就是他的梦中情人。

original: Alain made all the pain just... go away. But it was all lies! Alain used me. He ruined my name, destroyed my friendship with the Shatter-Shields...
traduit: 阿兰让我所有的痛苦都……消失了。但这都是谎言！他利用了我，毁了我的名声，也毁了我和碎盾家的友谊……

original: Do you know why Alain was in Windhelm? He heard about Friga's murder. He wanted to befriend the family, in their grief... and rob them blind.
traduit: 知道阿兰为什么出现在风舵吗？他听说弗丽嘉遇害了，想趁着他们一家悲伤不已的时候，把他们洗劫一空。

original: Alain used me to get close to my friends. And now they all think I'm some kind of... monster. Alain Dufont took my life. And now I'm taking his.
traduit: 阿兰利用我去接近我的朋友。现在他们都觉得我是……怪物。阿兰·杜峰特毁了我的人生。现在我也要毁了他。

original: Tell me the full story. Why do you want Alain dead?
traduit: 告诉我来龙去脉。你为什么要杀阿兰？

original: Excellent. Once Alain is dead, I'll pay you. In gold. I've saved up a bit. I hope that'll do.
traduit: 太好了。等阿兰一死，就给你报酬。用金币。我存了些钱，但愿足够。

original: But, well... There is one more thing. If you're interested?
traduit: 不过，嗯……还有一件事。不知道你感不感兴趣？

original: It will be done.
traduit: 交给我。

original: DB03MuiriContractDetails2a
traduit: DB03MuiriContractDetails2a

original: I'll need more to go on than that...
traduit: 我需要更多信息……

original: Alain is... is dead?
traduit: 阿兰……死了？

original: I... I'm grateful. It's just this... this isn't at all how I imagined things would play out. There was Alain, but I was considering more, and...
traduit: 我……很感激。只是……事情的发展完全出乎了我的想象。阿兰的事，还有很多别的事……

original: Ah, well. Dead is dead. Right? My thanks to you, assassin. Here's the gold I was going to pay for the job. You earned it, after all.
traduit: 啊，好吧。死了就死了，对吧？谢谢你，刺客。这是酬金。你应得的。

original: Actually, Alain Dufont is already dead. I killed him.
traduit: 实际上，阿兰·杜峰特已经死了。我杀的。

original: DB03MuiriContractDetails1
traduit: DB03MuiriContractDetails1

original: What I need? What I need is for Alain Dufont to die! I want him hunted down and murdered like the dog he is!
traduit: 我要什么？我要阿兰·杜峰特死！我要他像条狗一样被宰掉！

original: Obviously. Now tell me what you need.
traduit: 没错。现在，告诉我你要什么。

original: DB03MuiriKillNilsineTopic
traduit: DB03MuiriKillNilsineTopic

original: If you can... I want you to kill someone else, as well. You don't have to - not as part of our deal. But if you do... I'll pay you even more.
traduit: 如果可以的话……我希望你去再杀一个人。当然你不杀也没事，毕竟这是在我们协议之外。但如果你干了……我会多付你些报酬。

original: It's Nilsine Shatter-Shield, in Windhelm. If Nilsine dies, too... I'll make it worth your while.
traduit: 目标是风舵城的尼尔欣·碎盾。如果尼尔欣也死了……我会给你个满意的价格。

original: I'm listening.
traduit: 我听着呢。

original: Isn't there some business you should be tending to?
traduit: 你不是有事要办吗？

original: The Dark Brotherh... Oh. Oh! I... my goodness, you're really here! The Black Sacrament. It actually worked?
traduit: 黑暗兄……哦，哦！我……天啊，你真的来了！黑色圣礼，成功了吗？

original: The Dark Brotherhood has come, Muiri.
traduit: 黑暗兄弟会已经来了，暮蕊。

original: Why are you looking at me like that?
traduit: 你为什么这样看着我？

original: We all are, my dear, but sometimes the Divines reward those who don't seem to deserve it. Call it dumb luck.
traduit: 我们都这么想，宝贝儿，但有时候圣灵会奖赏那些根本不值得被赏的人。这就叫狗屎运吧。

original: Sometimes I'm surprised he's still the chief.
traduit: 有时候我也惊讶他是怎么当酋长到现在的。

original: Oh, you've seen your father just trying to chase a skeever from his house. He's a bit soft.
traduit: 啊，你也看到过，你父亲尝试把恶鼠从房间里赶出去的样子。他有点软弱。

original: Hello, my love. Back from some adventure I bet.
traduit: 你好啊，亲爱的。冒险回来了吗。

original: It's good to see you again, dear.
traduit: 见到你真好，亲爱的。

original: It's pleasing to see you again.
traduit: 很高兴又见到你。

original: Ah, it's my love, come to visit.
traduit: 啊，是亲爱的啊，回来看看吗。

original: Hello, dear. I haven't been drinking too much, if that's what you're thinking.
traduit: 你好啊，亲爱的。我没喝多少酒，你别多想啊。

original: You and I, we're the only people in Skyrim worth loving. That's what I think.
traduit: 你和我，我们彼此是天际中唯一值得相爱的。我是这么想的。

original: Good to see you, dear.
traduit: 你好啊，亲爱的。

original: Yes, my love? What do you need?
traduit: 怎么了，亲爱的？有什么事吗？

original: Do you need anything, my love?
traduit: 有什么需要吗，亲爱的？

original: Speak. You can ask anything of me, love.
traduit: 说吧。你可以跟我说任何事，亲爱的。

original: Is there anything you need, dearest?
traduit: 有什么需要吗，挚爱？

original: I love you. You know that, right?
traduit: 我很爱你。你应该知道吧？

original: What do you need, love? Ask anything.
traduit: 有什么事吗，亲爱的？随便提。

original: Yes, love?
traduit: 怎么了，亲爱的？

original: What about my father? Was he a good hunter?
traduit: 我父亲怎么样？他是个好猎手吗？

original: Oh of course. My mistake.
traduit: 啊，是。我的错。

original: That's what everyone keeps saying. But you didn't kill her. That's what I was asking.
traduit: 大家都这么说。但又不是你杀的她。你没听懂我问什么吧。
