original: What's happening? Damn it, what are you doing?
traduit: 发生什么了？该死的，你在干什么？

original: Get these things off of me!
traduit: 把这些东西拿开！

original: Cowards! Stealing a woman from her home! For shame!
traduit: 懦夫！把个女人从家里绑出来！也不嫌害臊！

original: By the gods, when I get out of here you're dead! You hear me? Dead!
traduit: 诸神在上，等我出去你死定了！听见了吗？死定了！

original: Aggghh! Re...lease me!
traduit: 啊啊啊！放……了我！

original: Thank you! Thank you! I won't tell anyone what happened here, I swear it!
traduit: 谢谢！谢谢！我不会对任何人提起这里的事，我发誓！

original: Oh, gods, please! Let me live! I'll do anything you want!
traduit: 哦，神啊，求你了！让我活下去！我愿意为你做任何事！

original: I... I can hear you talking out there. Please, let me go. I've done nothing to you.
traduit: 我……能听到你在外面说话。求你了，让我走吧。我没对你做过什么啊。

original: Is this about that raid last week? I told Holgrim there was no honor in killing sleeping men, but he wouldn't listen! It wasn't my fault, I swear!
traduit: 是因为上周的突袭吗？我告诉过霍尔格姆杀熟睡的人很不光彩，但他不听啊！不是我的错，我发誓！

original: I'm just a soldier. Killing is my job! Surely you can't fault a man for doing his job?
traduit: 我就是个士兵，杀人就是我的工作！你总不能说一个人尽职尽责有什么不对吧？

original: Please, oh please, I don't want to die...
traduit: 求你了，求你了，我不想死啊……

original: Ah, sweet freedom. Now that's more like it. You have my thanks, stranger.
traduit: 啊，甜美的自由。这才像话嘛。谢谢你了，陌生人。

original: Whoever this is, clearly we got off on the wrong foot. Ah, but no worries. This is not the first time I have been bagged and dragged.
traduit: 不管你是谁，但我们很明显一开始就搞错了。啊，别担心，这不是我第一次被人拖来拖去了。

original: Come now. Whatever the problem, we can talk about it like civilized folk. Hmm?
traduit: 现在，不管有什么问题。我们也应该像个文明人一样讨论。嗯？

original: Hello? Hello? Ah, I know you're listening.
traduit: 喂？喂？我知道你在听。

original: A man in my position makes lots of enemies. But what is a life-threatening situation if not an opportunity for mutual benefit? Hmmm?
traduit: 像我这样的人树敌很多。但如果能够互利互惠，生命危险又算得了什么呢？嗯？

original: You'll let me go. I know you will. This is all just part of the game we play...
traduit: 你会放我走的。我知道你会的。这只是我们游戏的一部分……

original: They used to come from the Night Mother. Potential clients would perform the Black Sacrament, and she would hear their prayers.
traduit: 通常都是来自夜母。潜在的客户会执行黑色圣礼，夜母能够听到他们的祈祷。

original: The Night Mother would communicate this to the Listener, who would then dispatch a Speaker to arrange the contract with the client.
traduit: 夜母会联络聆听者。聆听者会派遣发言者去安排与客户接洽契约。

original: But that was a long time ago. There hasn't been a Listener in years, not since Cyrodiil was overrun in the war with the Thalmor.
traduit: 但那都是很久前的事了。自从希罗帝尔在对抗梭默的战争中被占领之后，已经很多年没有聆听者了。

original: But people don't know that. So they still perform the ritual... and we eventually hear about it. When someone wants us, we find out.
traduit: 但人们并不知道。所以他们依旧会举行仪式……最后早晚会传到我们的耳朵里。只要有人需要，我们就会去联络。

original: Where do the contracts come from?
traduit: 这些契约都是从何而来？

original: Are there any rules I should be aware of?
traduit: 我应该注意什么规矩吗？

original: Used to be the Dark Brotherhood was bound by Five Tenets, but we stopped following those years ago.
traduit: 过去黑暗兄弟会有五大信条，但我们已经摒弃多年了。

original: All those rules, all that discipline, and look where the Dark Brotherhood ended up. We're the last of our kind, and we live the way we see fit.
traduit: 看看吧，遵循这些规矩、律条，黑暗兄弟会是什么下场。我们已经是仅存的了，所以只按自己觉得合适的方式生活。

original: Bottom line - respect your Family. Do that, and everything else will fall into place.
traduit: 底线就是，尊重你的家人。做到这一点，其他自然水到渠成。

original: Who is the Night Mother?
traduit: 夜母是谁？

original: The Unholy Matron, the Shrouded Lady, the Mistress of the Void. She goes by many names.
traduit: 不洁主母、隐蔽女士、虚空夫人。名号很多。

original: Ages past, Sithis gave a woman five children. She killed them to win his favor, thus becoming the Night Mother. If you believe that sort of thing.
traduit: 很久以前，西帝斯给了一个女人五个孩子。为了博得他的青睐，女人杀死了孩子们，从而成为夜母。前提是你相信这种故事。

original: Today, she's... well, she's a skeleton. An ancient corpse. But, more importantly, a corpse that's being brought to this Sanctuary by her Keeper.
traduit: 现如今，她是……呃，一具骷髅。一个老尸。但更重要的是，这具尸体被她的守护者带到了这个圣所。

original: Who is the Night Mother?
traduit: 夜母是谁？

original: DBAstridThirdGreetBranchTopic
traduit: DBAstridThirdGreetBranchTopic

original: Of course. And you've repaid your debt, in full.  Here's the key to the shack. But why stop here? I say we take our relationship to the next level.
traduit: 当然。你已经还清了债。这是钥匙。但是就止步于此吗？我觉得咱们的关系应该更进一步。

original: I would like to officially extend to you an invitation to join my Family. The Dark Brotherhood.
traduit: 我想正式邀请你加入我的家庭。黑暗兄弟会。

original: In the southwest reaches of Skyrim, in the Pine Forest, you'll find the entrance to our Sanctuary. It's just beneath the road, hidden from view.
traduit: 在天际西南部有个松林，我们圣所的入口就在路下面隐藏着。

original: When questioned by the Black Door, answer with the correct passphrase: "Silence, my brother." Then you're in. And your new life begins.
traduit: 当被黑门询问时，要用正确的密语回答：“是沉寂，我的兄弟。”然后，你就能进去了。就此开始新生。

original: I'll see you at home.
traduit: 我们家里再见。

original: So... I'm free to go?
traduit: 那……我能走了吗？

original: I'm ready. Let's go.
traduit: 准备好了。我们走。

original: All right, please stay close to me while we're inside. It should be safe, but it's always better to be cautious.
traduit: 好，进去时请跟紧我。虽然应该没有危险，但还是小心点为好。

original: We'd better go see. These can tend to themselves for a few minutes.
traduit: 我们最好去看看。这些家伙几分钟内可以自己工作的。

original: You hear that? The others must have found something!
traduit: 你听到了吗？其他人肯定发现了什么！

original: As long as they can swing a pickaxe where I tell them, they're as smart as we need them to be.
traduit: 只要他们能在我说的地方挥镐头，那就足够了。

original: They seem less intelligent each time you raise them, if that's even possible.
traduit: 每次你把他们复活，似乎都不那么聪明了。

original: Bah. Weak-willed rabble. Even dead they're almost useless.
traduit: 呸。意志薄弱的贱货。死了都没什么用处。

original: There goes another one.
traduit: 又来一个。

original: Feel free to grab a pick and help them out. I prefer not to sully myself with manual labor.
traduit: 你随便挑一个来帮他们吧。我可不愿意让体力劳动玷污了自己。

original: These thralls of yours are slower than Argonians in a blizzard.
traduit: 你这些奴隶比暴风雪里的阿尔贡还慢。

original: I've made my peace. I'm ready.
traduit: 我冷静下来了。我准备好了。

original: Farewell, Brother Casimir.
traduit: 别了，凯西米尔老兄。

original: Go now! The orcs could breach the inner sanctum at any moment!
traduit: 快走！兽人随时可能闯进密室！

original: Brother Thorek, we must remain here and guard this Skull with our lives if necessary.
traduit: 图雷克兄弟，我们必须做好用生命保护头骨的准备。

original: And what about you, Brother Casimir? Are you prepared to serve the will of Vaermina?
traduit: 那你呢，凯西米尔兄弟？准备好为瓦尔迷纳献身了吗？

original: Then it's decided.
traduit: 那就决定了。

original: Brother Casimir, you must activate the barrier and release the Miasma. Let nothing stop you.
traduit: 凯西米尔老兄，你去激活屏障、释放毒气。中途不要停下。

original: Then let it be done. Farewell, my brothers!
traduit: 然后一切就了结了。别了，兄弟们！

original: Agreed. To the death.
traduit: 同意。至死方休。

original: We have no alternative. It's the will of Vaermina.
traduit: 我们别无选择。唯有执行瓦尔迷纳的意志。

original: The Miasma? But, brother...
traduit: 毒气？但是，兄弟……

original: Then we have no choice. The Miasma must be released.
traduit: 我们别无选择，必须释放毒气。

original: But... no more than a handful of us remain, brother.
traduit: 不过……我们剩的人不多了，兄弟。

original: We must hold. We can't allow the Skull to fall into their hands.
traduit: 我们必须坚持住。不能让头骨落入他们手里。

original: The orcs have breached the inner sanctum, Brother Veren.
traduit: 维仁兄，兽人已经要闯入密室了。

original: All right. I'm ready.
traduit: 好吧。我准备好了。

original: I still have my key to the library. Whenever you're ready, let's move on.
traduit: 我还带着图书馆的钥匙。准备好就走吧。

original: Looks difficult to breach.
traduit: 看起来很难攻破啊。

original: Impossible actually. Hmm, I wonder...
traduit: 实际上毫无可能。嗯，我想……

original: There may be a way to bypass the barrier, but I must check their library and confirm it can be done.
traduit: 也许有办法绕过屏障，但我必须去查查他们的图书馆，看看是否可行。

original: Damn it. The priests must have activated this barrier when the Miasma was released.
traduit: 该死。肯定是祭司们在释放毒气时激活了这个屏障。

original: Do you know where we can find the Torpor?
traduit: 你知道去哪儿找“瓦尔迷纳之眠”吗？

original: I believe there is a laboratory in the east wing. If we proceed there, we should be able to locate a sample.
traduit: 我想东侧应该有个实验室。如果我们继续往下走，应该能找到样本。

original: Found it.
traduit: 找到了。

original: Let me take a look...
traduit: 让我看看……

original: Mara be praised! There is a way past the barrier to the inner sanctum.
traduit: 赞美玛拉！有能穿过屏障进入内部密室的方法了。

original: It involves a recipe for a liquid known as Vaermina's Torpor.
traduit: 它说到了一种叫“瓦尔迷纳之眠”的药水配方。

original: I'd be happy to help.
traduit: 我很乐意帮忙。

original: Thank Mara. I was afraid I'd never be able to convince you.
traduit: 感谢玛拉。我还担心永远说服不了你呢。

original: Allow me to gather the materials I need for my ritual, and then I will meet you outside the ruins.
traduit: 请允许我继续收集仪式所需的材料，我们遗迹外见。

original: I was just seeing if you came to your senses.
traduit: 我只是想看看你清不清醒。

original: Amusing. Now if you'll excuse me, I need to continue my research. I have no time for idle chatter with any simpleton who strikes up a conversation.
traduit: 有趣。失陪了。我得继续研究，没时间和随便攀谈的傻子闲聊。

original: My apologies, Erandur. I spoke out of turn.
traduit: 依兰杜尔，抱歉。我说错话了。

original: Apologies accepted. I understand how this entire story can be mistaken for fiction since the circumstances are so abstract.
traduit: 我接受道歉。我明白为什么整个故事都被误解为虚构，毕竟情节太简略了。

original: However, I can assure you that I will do everything in my power to keep you safe if you're willing to help me.
traduit: 但我可以向你保证，只要你愿意帮我，我会尽力保你安全。

original: Wish to converse with the crazy old elf, eh? Very well. Go on.
traduit: 想和疯狂的老精灵聊天吗？很好。请吧。

original: Unless you're here to solve this nightmare problem, I don't need you.
traduit: 除非你是来解决噩梦问题，否则我用不上你。

original: Need a room? Don't worry. Nightmares don't seem to happen for travelers.
traduit: 需要房间吗？别担心，旅行者好像不会做噩梦。

original: You come to Dawnstar at a bad time. Tempers are... fiery.
traduit: 你来晨星的时机不好。大家脾气都很……暴躁。

original: The Jarl is... tired. Be mindful of that.
traduit: 领主很……疲惫。注意着点。

original: These dreams are real I tell you. Real!
traduit: 我告诉你，这些梦都是真的。真的！

original: Can't sleep well no matter how much drink I put in me.
traduit: 不管喝多少酒就都睡不踏实。

original: I envy you travelers. Dreams aren't affecting anyone not from here.
traduit: 真羡慕你们这些旅行者。噩梦影响不到你们这些外来者。

original: What is it? I haven't had much sleep.
traduit: 怎么了？我睡不了多久。

original: If I get any rest soon, I'll count myself richer than a king.
traduit: 现在连好好休息都是一种奢求。

original: If you're here about the nightmares, I'm afraid my pleas to the College of Winterhold go unheard.
traduit: 如果你是为噩梦的事情而来，恐怕我向冬堡学院的请求至今无人理睬。

original: Seems like no one is getting a decent night's rest in Dawnstar, stranger. Best buy your steel and move on.
traduit: 晨星城没人睡过安生觉，陌生人。你买完装备最好赶紧走吧。

original: Gods I'm so tired.
traduit: 神啊，我太累了。

original: Please. I must remain uninterrupted if I am to complete the ritual. Have no fear, your time will come.
traduit: 想要完成仪式，我必须有安静的环境。别害怕，会好起来的。

original: What troubles you, my son?
traduit: 你有什么烦恼，孩子？

original: What troubles you, my daughter?
traduit: 你有什么烦恼，孩子？

original: Yes, my son, what is it I can help with?
traduit: 孩子，我能帮上什么吗？

original: Yes, my daughter, what is it I can help with?
traduit: 孩子，我能帮上什么吗？

original: You're wrong to come here, stranger. No rest in Dawnstar.
traduit: 陌生人，你不该来这儿。晨星不得休息啊。

original: By the Divines, I'm tired.
traduit: 圣灵在上，我太累了。

original: No. I don't have anything for bad dreams, so don't ask.
traduit: 不。我不想再谈噩梦的事了，别再问了。

original: Lady Mara will save us from these nightmares. You'll see.
traduit: 玛拉女士会把我们从噩梦中拯救出来。

original: How will I know when to awaken?
traduit: 我怎么知道什么时候该醒过来？

original: I will watch over you as you slumber to ensure your safety. If I deduce anything is amiss, I will use my arts to bring you back.
traduit: 我会在你入睡之后确保你的安全。一旦我察觉不对劲，就会用我的手段把你唤醒。

original: Otherwise, I am uncertain what will end your Dreamstride. Perhaps when Vaermina's curious appetite has been filled.
traduit: 否则，我也不确定如何会结束你的梦中漫步。也许是瓦尔迷纳的好奇心被满足时。

original: What will The Dreamstride feel like?
traduit: 梦中漫步是什么感觉？

original: You'll be viewing the memory of another through your own eyes and with your own body.
traduit: 你将通过自己的眼睛、身体来观察别人的记忆。

original: Those around you will perceive you as normal and you will find the words you utter may not be your own.
traduit: 周围人会认为你很正常，而你会发现自己说的话不是自己的。

original: Thanks to all of these odd principles, there is quite a lot of debate as to whether this is really a dream or just the machinations of Vaermina.
traduit: 正是这些奇怪的原则，产生了不少争论，谁也不知道这究竟是梦，还是瓦尔迷纳的阴谋。

original: How can the Skull be affecting Dawnstar?
traduit: 头骨对晨星有什么影响？

original: Lore holds that the Skull of Corruption holds a constant hunger for the memories of others.
traduit: 传说堕落头骨对他人的记忆有着永恒的渴望。

original: The Skull has been out of touch for so long, I fear it's gained the ability to reach out on its own and try to feed.
traduit: 头骨已经脱离控制太久了，我觉得它已经获得了自己伸手觅食的能力。

original: What it does with these memories is just conjecture and an argument for scholars and historians to this very day.
traduit: 至于它拿这些记忆做什么，目前学界还在争论猜测。

original: Who is the Daedric Lord Vaermina?
traduit: 迪德拉君王瓦尔迷纳是谁？

original: Vaermina resides in a strange realm known as Quagmire... a nightmarish land where reality shifts upon itself in seemingly impossible ways.
traduit: 瓦尔迷纳住在一个叫“噩梦沼泽”的古怪领域……一个噩梦般的地方，其中的存在会以不可能的方式转变。

original: From her citadel at the center, she reaches forth to collect our memories, leaving nothing in return apart from visions of horror and despair.
traduit: 她从领域中心的堡垒伸出摄取我们记忆的手，留给我们的只有恐怖与绝望的景象。

original: I can't trust you. You're hiding something.
traduit: 我不信你。你肯定在隐瞒什么。

original: Your concerns are understandable; trust is a very difficult commodity to come by these days.
traduit: 可以理解你的担忧。如今信任是件不容易的事。

original: I can only give you my word as a priest of Mara that my intentions are honorable.
traduit: 作为玛拉的祭司，我只能向你保证，我的意图是高尚的。

original: I trust you. How can I help?
traduit: 我相信你。我该怎么帮你？

original: Wonderful! My lady Mara will be quite pleased!
traduit: 太好了！玛拉女士会很高兴的！

original: Nightcaller Temple is only a short walk from Dawnstar. Come, we must hurry.
traduit: 唤夜神殿离晨星不远。来吧，我们得快点。

original: What could you do, anyway? Dreams aren't real.
traduit: 你又能怎么办？梦不是真的。

original: These dreams are manifestations created by the Daedric Lord Vaermina.
traduit: 这些梦是迪德拉君主瓦尔迷纳创造的。

original: She has an awful hunger for our memories. In return, she leaves behind nightmares not unlike a cough marks a serious illness.
traduit: 她极度渴望我们的记忆。然后会留下噩梦，就像重病中伴随的咳嗽一样。

original: I must end her terrible influence over these people before the damage becomes permanent.
traduit: 我必须结束她对这些人的可怕影响，以免造成永久性伤害。

original: What's your plan?
traduit: 你的计划是什么？

original: I need to return to the source of the problem, to Nightcaller Temple.
traduit: 我要回去找问题的起源——唤夜神殿。

original: Perhaps you'd be willing to assist me in that regard?
traduit: 也许你能来帮我？

original: What's wrong with everyone around here?
traduit: 这里的人都怎么了？

original: The entire town is being plagued by horrible nightmares. They're in serious danger but I'm afraid there's little I can do about it.
traduit: 整个镇子都被恐怖的噩梦困扰。形势很严峻，但我对此无能无力。

original: DB06GabriellaWhatToDoBranchTopic1
traduit: DB06GabriellaWhatToDoBranchTopic1

original: I understand. Gaius Maro will die.
traduit: 我明白了。加留斯·马洛死定了。

original: To earn your bonus, do not kill Gaius Maro in Dragon Bridge, or on the road. Kill him in one of the other major cities he'll be visiting.
traduit: 想要获得奖励的话，就不要在龙桥或者路上杀死加留斯·马洛。在他途经的大城市里动手。

original: There, the body will be discovered quickly, as will the letter implicating Gaius Maro in the plot to assassinate the Emperor.
traduit: 那样，他的尸体就能被更快发现，当然还有那封暗示加留斯·马洛参与刺杀皇帝的信件。

original: Do that, and Astrid has authorized me to grant you a rather unique bonus. It is a special token, to be given to Olava the Feeble, in Whiterun.
traduit: 阿斯垂德说了，如果照做，就给你一份特殊的奖励。是一个特殊的标记，可以拿去给白漫城的“软脚虾”奥拉瓦。

original: Olava is an old and dear friend, and a powerful seer. The token entitles you to a reading of your future. It's an opportunity one should not pass up.
traduit: 奥拉瓦是老朋友了，也是一个强大的预见者。这个标记可以让你预知自己的未来。不容错过哦。

original: With the Emperor's arrival in Skyrim now a certainty, his security service, the Penitus Oculatus, will need to begin its preparations immediately.
traduit: 随着皇帝确定要抵达天际，他的护卫，洞察眼，也会立刻开始准备工作。

original: Security is being handled by a Commander Maro. Astrid and I have devised a plan to break the man, and in doing so, cripple the Emperor's protection.
traduit: 安保工作由马洛指挥官负责。阿斯垂德和我想出了一个计划来击垮此人，借此削弱皇帝的保护。

original: You are to slay the commander's son, Gaius Maro, and once he is dead, plant false evidence on his body implicating him in a plot to kill the Emperor.
traduit: 你需要杀了指挥官的儿子加留斯·马洛。他死了之后，在他尸体上放上栽赃假证，诬陷他参与刺杀皇帝的阴谋。

original: She did. What are the details?
traduit: 是的。能说说细节吗？

original: Sorry.
traduit: 抱歉。

original: I'm disappointed in your failure. But the Empire still needs you. I'll have to over look it for now.
traduit: 你的失败让我失望。但帝国还需要你。且观后效吧。

original: Turns out you're a screw up like the rest. But I still need you. So I'll overlook it for now.
traduit: 原来你和别人一样搞砸了。但我还需要你。所以暂时忽略你的失败吧。

original: Reporting for duty.
traduit: 报告。

original: I've got my hands full with something. Don't go far. I'll need you soon.
traduit: 我手头还有别的事要忙。别走太远，我很快就要用上你了。

original: I'm in the middle of something. But don't go far. I'll need you soon.
traduit: 我正忙着呢。但别走太远，我很快就要用上你了。

original: Good. I can use someone I can trust.
traduit: 很好。总算有个靠得住的了。

original: Excellent. I have a couple tasks for you.
traduit: 很好。我有几个任务给你。

original: Good. I have some things that need doing.
traduit: 好。有些事要办。

original: Good. I'm spread thin. I could use the help.
traduit: 很好。我快忙不过来了。需要你帮忙。

original: Got my hands full as usual.
traduit: 我一直忙的不可开交。

original: There's plenty that needs doing.
traduit: 很多事要做。

original: I'm not here to talk. I'm here for those documents.
traduit: 我不是来谈话的。我来拿那些文件。

original: Can't stop to chat, citizen.
traduit: 没时间聊天，公民。

original: No time to talk. Out of my way.
traduit: 没时间聊天了。不要挡路。

original: I believe the killer is Wuunferth the Unliving.
traduit: 我确定“活死人”巫恩菲斯就是凶手。

original: That's quite an accusation. I assume you have proof?
traduit: 这可是相当严重的指控。想必你有证据吧？

original: Anyone seen entering or leaving? Any strange lights or unusual noises?
traduit: 有人进出过吗？有什么奇怪的光或者声音吗？

original: No.
traduit: 不知道。

original: So you don't know anything about this house?
traduit: 所以你对这房子一无所知？

original: Once more and I'm going to have to kill you.
traduit: 再来一次，我就杀了你。

original: Don't do that again. Last warning.
traduit: 别再这么干了。最后一次警告了。

original: You're pushing your luck.
traduit: 你有些得寸进尺了。

original: Make them all pay for what they've done to me...
traduit: 让他们为对我所做的一切付出代价……

original: Ainethach's in charge of Karthwasten. You should bother him.
traduit: 艾尼塔克负责卡斯威斯腾。你应该去找他。

original: What do you want? Can't people leave us alone?
traduit: 你要干什么？就不能让我们静静吗？

original: Strangers are nothing but trouble.
traduit: 陌生人就是麻烦。

original: Karthwasten has enough problems. Leave us alone.
traduit: 卡斯威斯腾的问题够多了。别来烦我们。

original: Ainethach's dead, but that doesn't mean we can stop working.
traduit: 艾尼塔克死了，但这不代表我们要停止工作。

original: I work in the mines. I hunt. Everything else I do is my business.
traduit: 我在矿场工作、打猎。其他再做什么事是我的自由。

original: These Reach folk are so... nosy.
traduit: 这些瑞驰人太……多管闲事了。

original: Ragnar has a strong arm. Pity he isn't an Orc.
traduit: 拉格纳的力气很大。可惜他不是个兽人。

original: Finally, both of my mines are open again. Time for everyone to get back to work.
traduit: 我的两个矿场终于都重新开放了。大家都该回去工作了。

original: If the Forsworn aren't attacking my town, the Nords are trying to force me off it.
traduit: 不是弃誓者想袭击我的城镇，就是诺德人想把我逼走。

original: I'm one of the few native sons of the Reach that owns land. It doesn't make me very popular.
traduit: 我是瑞驰为数不多拥有土地的原住民。但这没让我多受欢迎。

original: Ainethach is dead. What will happen to Karthwasten now?
traduit: 艾尼塔克死了。现在卡斯威斯腾会怎么样？

original: I'm Ainethach's right-hand man. I help supervise the mines.
traduit: 我是艾尼塔克的得力助手。帮他监督矿场。

original: Not many Nords would work for a Reachman, but Ainethach is a good man.
traduit: 没有多少诺德人愿意替瑞驰人工作，但艾尼塔克是个好人。

original: The good mine is closed and the other mine has no ore. Gods have cursed me.
traduit: 好的矿场被关闭了，剩下那座没矿了，诸神在诅咒我。

original: Sauranach mine is open again. How am I supposed to handle all this work?
traduit: 索兰那驰矿场重新开放了。我该怎么处理这些工作？

original: You're not from here, and we don't need to be talking.
traduit: 你不是本地人，我们没话可说了。

original: You should talk to Ainethach. He's in charge.
traduit: 去找艾尼塔克聊吧，他在这儿说了算。

original: Don't have nothing to say to you, stranger.
traduit: 跟你没话可说，陌生人。

original: Karthwasten doesn't need outsiders prying in our business.
traduit: 卡斯威斯腾不需要外人来窥探。

original: The mine is closed. Get lost.
traduit: 矿场关闭了。到别处去吧。

original: I've been sent by Silver-Bloods to keep this mine "safe."
traduit: 我是银血家派来保护矿场“安全”的。

original: Our business is done here.
traduit: 我们在这儿没事了。

original: We're in control of this mine. No sudden moves.
traduit: 我们已经把矿场控制了。别轻举妄动。

original: Time to find another job.
traduit: 是时候找新工作了。

original: What do I need?
traduit: 我需要做什么？

original: You, and those aiding you, wish to know more about the Eye of Magnus. You wish to avoid the disaster of which you are not yet aware.
traduit: 你，还有那些帮助你的人，都想更加深入地了解玛格努斯之眼。你希望避免你还未知的灾难。

original: To see through Magnus' Eye without being blinded, you require his staff.
traduit: 想要看穿玛格努斯之眼而不被蒙蔽，你需要他的法杖。

original: Events now spiral quickly towards the inevitable center, so you must act with haste. Take this knowledge to your Arch-Mage.
traduit: 现在，事态正急转直下，几乎无法挽回，所以你必须尽快行动。把这些消息告诉你们的大法师。

original: I'm not the first to come see you?
traduit: 我不是第一个来见你的人吗？

original: No, though you may be the last. The one who calls himself Ancano has sought my knowledge as well, through very different questions.
traduit: 不是第一个，但有可能是最后一个。那个自称安卡诺的人也想通过不同的问题来寻求我的知识。

original: Your path differs from most. You are being guided, pushed towards something.
traduit: 你的道路异于大多数人。你在被引导着推向某些事物。

original: It is a good path, one untraveled by many. It is a path that can save your College. I will tell you what you need to know to follow it further.
traduit: 这是一条无人走过的好路，也是一条能够拯救你们学院的道路。我会告诉你需要知道的东西，以便继续前进。

original: Thalmor? What Thalmor?
traduit: 梭默？哪个梭默？

original: The one who calls himself Ancano.
traduit: 那个自称安卡诺的人。

original: He seeks information about the Eye, but what he will find shall be quite different.
traduit: 他在寻找关于“眼”的情报，但他将会发现完全不同的东西。

original: His path will cross yours in time, but first you must find that which you need.
traduit: 他的道路会与你相交，但你必须先找到你需要的东西。

original: Is that my job?
traduit: 这就是我的工作？

original: You've shown yourself useful so far. All these lunks are too afraid of Haldyn to head in before the fog's cleared.
traduit: 到目前为止，你已经充分证明了自己的价值。这些笨蛋太害怕哈尔丁了，在雾散开之前都不敢进去。

original: So if you're willing to perform one more service for the Company, we could put this matter behind us for good.
traduit: 所以如果你愿意再替公司办件事，我们就可以一举解决这个事件了。

original: Take out Haldyn, and we'll handle the rest.
traduit: 除掉哈尔丁，剩下的我们来处理。

original: You think you know how to repair the Phial?
traduit: 你觉得能修复白瓶吗？

original: I have some thoughts. There are three crucial elements. Some may be easier to find than others.
traduit: 我有一些想法。需要三个关键材料。有些可能相对容易找到。

original: On the top of the Throat of the World is a patch of Unmelting Snow. No heat can touch it.
traduit: 世界之喉的山顶有一团不融之雪。任何热量都无法将它融化。

original: Then we need the tusk of a mammoth, ground to a fine powder as only the giants know how.
traduit: 然后我们需要猛犸牙粉，制作方法只有巨人知道。

original: The final step is tricky. It requires the briar heart from a Forsworn of the Reach.
traduit: 最后一步比较棘手。需要一颗瑞驰弃誓者的荆棘之心。

original: If you can bring me these materials, the Phial can again be made whole.
traduit: 如果你能把这些材料带给我，我就能修复白瓶了。

original: Ah, I see. The old Dark Brotherhood "silent intimidation" treatment.
traduit: 啊，我知道了。老黑暗兄弟会刺客的“沉默恐吓”。

original: Oh, I know who you are. Don't be so surprised. You ain't the first assassin sent to kill me. Won't be the last. Now let's get this over with.
traduit: 哦，我知道你是谁。别那么惊讶。你不是第一个来刺杀我的。也不会是最后一个。现在赶紧了结吧。

original: Sithis? Let me guess: "In the Void!" By the gods, you Dark Brotherhood are a predictable lot, aren't you?
traduit: 西帝斯？我猜猜看啊，“在虚空里！”。天啊，你们这些黑暗兄弟会真是好猜，不是吗？

original: Okay, here's how this works. You try to assassinate me, and I kill you. Horribly. I have done this dance before, you know.
traduit: 好吧，就这样吧。你想暗杀我，我想杀了你。真可怕。我以前跳过这种舞。

original: You face the Dread Lord...
traduit: 你在面对恐惧之主……

original: The Dark Brotherhood? Yeah, yeah, yeah. You think this is the first contract I've had on my life?
traduit: 黑暗兄弟会？知道，知道。你以为我这辈子头一回被下单吗？

original: I'm a pirate, sweetie. Assassination attempts are an occupational hazard. Now, shall we?
traduit: 我是海盗，宝贝儿。暗杀可是高危行业哦。现在，要开始吗？

original: I represent the Dark...
traduit: 我是代表黑暗……

original: Right. Well. If you have some kind of official business with the jarl, I'm afraid now's not the time. Go on then. Off with you.
traduit: 好吧。听着。如果你有要事要找领主的话，很抱歉现在不是时候。请自行离开吧。

original: Fiend! You will not leave here alive! Guards! Guards!
traduit: 恶魔！你休想活着离开！卫兵！卫兵！

original: The Dark Brotherhood has come!
traduit: 黑暗兄弟会来了！

original: And why would I... Oh. Oh! Guards! Guards, I need assistance!
traduit: 我为什么要……哦。哦！卫兵！卫兵，我需要支援！

original: You protect the Jarl. But who protects you?
traduit: 你来保护领主，那谁来保护你呢？

original: Who are you? Why are you here? Leave this place. I have much work to conduct....
traduit: 你是谁？你来干什么？离开这里。我有很多活儿要干呢……

original: Yes... quite. But if that power could be harnessed. Controlled. The possibilities would be...
traduit: 对……很迷人。但如果这种力量能够被利用，控制。那可能……

original: But... who exactly are you? And why are you in here? I think it best you leave Mzinchaleft. These ruins can be quite... dangerous.
traduit: 不过……你到底是谁？为什么在这里？你最好还是离我远点。这些遗迹可能很……危险的。

original: Fascinating race, the Dwemer. Powerful... and extinct.
traduit: 迷人的种族啊，锻莫。强大……却也灭绝了。

original: Death? Oh, there's death to be found here, to be sure.
traduit: 死亡？哦，这里肯定会死人。

original: But not my own!
traduit: 但不是我！

original: The only thing you will discover in Mzinchaleft is death.
traduit: 你在姆津查莱夫特只能找到死亡。

original: I swear, you people are an odd bunch. Please, just step aside, that I may return to my duties!
traduit: 你可真是个怪人。请让开，我要回去工作了。

original: Sleep? I can't sleep now! There's too much to be done. And what's this Void you're rambling on about?
traduit: 睡觉吗？我现在可睡不着！要做的事太多了。你说的虚空是什么意思？

original: Sleep now, old woman. Embrace the Void.
traduit: 沉睡吧，老太太。拥抱虚空。

original: But I have many more rooms to clean. Fort Greymoor is quite large, and rather filthy if I do say.
traduit: 但是我还有很多房间要打扫。灰色荒原堡很大，而且很脏。

original: You've cleaned your last room, servant.
traduit: 仆人，这是你打扫的最后房间了。

original: Well now, you are a strange one. You remind me a bit of myself, when I'm stalking a deer. I'm not quite sure how I feel about that...
traduit: 哎呀，你可真是个怪人。你让我想起了我追踪一头鹿的时候。我还真说不准自己对此该作何感想……

original: Is that so? We shall see, villain. We shall see!
traduit: 是吗？那咱们走着瞧吧，恶棍。走着瞧！

original: I am the predator. You are my prey.
traduit: 我是捕食者。而你，是我的猎物。

original: Are you... threatening me? Walk away fool. It's not worth it.
traduit: 你在……威胁我？走开，蠢蛋。别来烦我。

original: Only cowards hunt animals. True game walks on two legs.
traduit: 只有懦夫才会去捕食动物。真正的猎物都是两条腿的。

original: Now aren't you a strange one. Well, if you're here to shop, shop. If not, find some other caravan to stalk.
traduit: 你可真够怪的。如果想买东西，那就去买。如果不是，去跟踪别的商队吧。

original: I'm going to beat you like a house cat!
traduit: 我要像揍家猫一样揍扁你！

original: And why would you be looking for me, hmm? I'm not sure I appreciate your presence here. Friend.
traduit: 你找我干什么？我不太欢迎你的光临。朋友。

original: You're one hard mage to track down, Ma'randru-jo.
traduit: 你可真是个难追的法师啊，玛'兰德鲁-约。

original: Go away! I don't know who you are, but this is my spot! Whatever's on that ship is mine!
traduit: 走开！我不知道你是谁，但这是我的地盘！那艘船的东西也是我的！

original: You'll have to catch me first!
traduit: 你先抓住我再说！

original: I'm going to kill you. Slowly. Painfully.
traduit: 我要慢慢地，痛苦地，杀了你。

original: I'm sorry, Argonian, but I've been sent to kill you.
traduit: 抱歉了阿尔贡。我是来杀你的。

original: What's the matter, friend? Khajiit got your tongue? Maybe you need a little ditty to loosen your gob, hmm?
traduit: 怎么了朋友？卡吉特把你舌头偷走了吗？要不要来首小曲润滑一下嘴巴啊？

original: There once was a stranger, with eyes full of danger, he spoke not a word, but his meaning was heard... Sing on, sweet Lurbuk, sing on!
traduit: 从前有个陌生人，眼里充满了危险，他一句话也不说，但一切不言而喻……唱吧，可爱的卢布克，唱吧！

original: Hmm... All right... How about this?
traduit: 嗯……好吧……这个怎么样？

original: Shadows creep, and... and phantoms leap! A man got... he got scared. And the demons dared! To um... visit upon him all which they feared!
traduit: 阴影在蠕动，然后……然后幻影飞跃！一个人开始……他开始害怕。恶魔们竟然！呃……将他们所害怕的一切都降临了！

original: Brilliant, I know. It's a gift.
traduit: 我知道，很完美。算是礼物吧。

original: Sing me a song, bard. A song of fear, and death!
traduit: 诗人，给我唱首歌吧。一首恐惧与死亡之歌！

original: Ha! Oh, that's a good one, friend. Killing Lurbuk... I mean, can you even imagine something so ludicrous? Depriving the world of my unique talents?
traduit: 哈！哦，这话很不错，朋友。杀死卢布克……你能想象出这有多好笑吗？难不成有人嫉妒我独一无二的才华吗？

original: Someone hired the Dark Brotherhood to kill you, Lurbuk.
traduit: 某人雇了黑暗兄弟会来杀你，卢布克。

original: Hmph. Don't say much, but there's a strange aura about you. You walk in the shadow of death...
traduit: 嗯。不用多说，但你的身上有一股奇怪的气场。你正行于死亡的阴影中。

original: Leave here. Leave here and never return.
traduit: 离开这里。离开就再也不要回来。

original: Ah, so the Brotherhood has come for old Hern, has it? Well then, let us meet as equals.
traduit: 这么说兄弟会来找老赫恩了？那我们就开诚布公吧。

original: Assassin versus vampire. A fight for the ages.
traduit: 刺客对吸血鬼。一场好斗。

original: Well then, you won't be leaving here alive!
traduit: 那你就别想活着离开了！

original: I know what you are, nightspawn.
traduit: 我知道你是什么，暗夜之子。

original: I've a mine to run, so if you'll excuse me...
traduit: 我还要去采矿，所以先失陪了……

original: What? Well, we'll see about that now, won't we?
traduit: 什么？好吧，那咱们走着瞧啊？

original: I represent the Dark Brotherhood. Your death is at hand!
traduit: 我代表黑暗兄弟会。你的死期到了！

original: And let me guess, that someone is my so-called husband Leigelf? Well the feeling's mutual.
traduit: 让我猜猜，是我那个所谓的丈夫雷盖尔夫吧？心照不宣啊。

original: Someone wants you dead, Beitild.
traduit: 某人想要你的命，贝提尤德。

original: Who are you? You... you're with the Dark Brotherhood, ain'tcha? I knew it. I knew you'd come for me!
traduit: 你是谁？你……你是黑暗兄弟会的，对吧？我就知道。我就知道你会来找我！

original: Aiiiiiiiieeeeee!
traduit: 啊啊啊啊啊啊啊啊！

original: Die, worm!
traduit: 死吧，蛆！

original: What? What do you mean?
traduit: 什么？你什么意思？

original: Oh! Oh... no... No!
traduit: 哦！哦……不……不！

original: You were right to be paranoid, Ennodius.
traduit: 恩诺迪尤斯，你的怀疑是正确的。

original: Do... do you want something? Look, if you ain't gonna talk, or spare no coin, just go away...
traduit: 你……你有什么需要吗？听着，如果你不说话，也不愿意施舍给我点钱，那就走开吧……

original: Oh... Oh no... Please, please... I ain't never harmed no one... Old Narfi just wants to be left alone...
traduit: 哦……哦不……求，求你了……我没伤害过谁啊……老纳菲只想一个人待着啊……

original: Your pathetic existence has come to an end, Narfi.
traduit: 纳菲，你可悲的一生就要结束了。

original: No! Oh, by the gods, please no!
traduit: 不！哦，神啊，请不要这样！

original: Beg! Beg for your miserable life!
traduit: 乞求吧！乞求你那悲惨的人生吧！

original: Tell me about Safia.
traduit: 跟我说说萨非亚。

original: Ah, yes. The pirate captain. A ruthless she-devil, by all accounts. Deadly with a blade.
traduit: 啊，没错。海盗船长。人人都说她是个杀人不眨眼的女魔头，刀刀致命啊。

original: And let's not forget her crew - loyal and bloodthirsty, the lot of them.
traduit: 别忘了她还有船员，个个忠诚又嗜杀。

original: This is my final contract, and certainly the most challenging. Be careful with this one, my friend.
traduit: 这是我这里最后一份契约，当然，挑战性也最大。小心点，朋友。

original: Tell me about Helvard.
traduit: 跟我说说黑尔沃德。

original: He's the housecarl of Falkreath. You know what that means? He's the bodyguard to the Jarl himself. So be careful.
traduit: 佛克瑞斯的侍卫。知道意味着什么吗？他会贴身保护领主。所以小心点。

original: Tell me about Maluril.
traduit: 和我说说玛鲁利尔。

original: He's dangerous. Very dangerous. A rogue Dark Elf mage doing research into Dwarven artifacts should be both respected... and feared.
traduit: 他是个危险人物。非常危险。一个研究矮人器物的暗精灵流浪法师，值得尊敬……乃至敬畏。

original: Just not by you.
traduit: 但对你来说不算事。

original: Tell me about Agnis.
traduit: 和我说说阿格尼斯。

original: She's a maid. Old, and feeble. But with this contract it's much more a matter of "where" than "who."
traduit: 一个老而虚弱的女佣。但这份契约的关键不在“杀谁”而是“去哪儿杀”。

original: Your political affairs are your own, but any allegiance you may have in the ongoing war could very well affect your access to Fort Greymoor.
traduit: 你的政治立场没人干涉，但你在战争中效忠任何一方都有可能影响你进入灰色荒原堡。

original: Tell me about Anoriath.
traduit: 和我说说阿诺利亚斯。

original: The wood elf may run a stall in the city, but he retreats to the plains outside Whiterun to hunt. Kill him there, and no one will bear witness...
traduit: 那个木精灵在城里摆摊，但也会去白漫城郊的平原上狩猎。在那里杀他，没人能看得见……

original: Tell me about Ma'randru-jo.
traduit: 跟我说说玛'兰德鲁-约。

original: He's an accomplished wizard. And, locating him may be challenging, as he travels with the caravans.
traduit: 他是个有点本事的巫师。而且，想要追踪他有点难度，毕竟他是跟着商队四处旅行。

original: Tell me about Deekus.
traduit: 和我说说蒂库斯。

original: He's an Argonian layabout, likes to scavenge shipwrecks. My guess is he'll run if threatened. Or swim, if given the chance.
traduit: 一个阿尔贡流浪者，喜欢搜寻沉船残骸。我猜，他要是受到威胁可能会水遁而走。

original: Tell me about Lurbuk.
traduit: 跟我说说卢布克。

original: He is, by all accounts, the worst bard in all of Skyrim.
traduit: 众所周知，他是天际最烂的吟游诗人。

original: Apparently so many people sought his death, Astrid had to hold a lottery to determine the client.
traduit: 显然想要他命的人太多了。以致阿斯垂德不得不抽签选取客户。

original: Tell me about Hern.
traduit: 跟我说说赫恩。

original: He's a vampire, and has blended into human society for years. He's never far from his female companion, Hert. Also a vampire.
traduit: 他是个融入人类社会多年的吸血鬼。他有个女伴赫特。也是个吸血鬼。

original: The contract is for the male, Hern. But you'll probably have to contend with the female, too. So for Sithis' sake, watch yourself.
traduit: 契约是要杀那个男的，赫恩。但有可能还得和那个女的搏斗。看在西帝斯的份上，一定小心。

original: Tell me about Beitild.
traduit: 和我说说贝提尤德。

original: She separated from her husband several months ago. Now the two run competing mining operations. Beitild's angry and desperate. A fighter.
traduit: 几个月前她和丈夫分居了。现在两家矿场正在竞争。贝提尤德又气又绝望。真是个斗士啊。

original: Tell me about Ennodius.
traduit: 跟我说说恩诺迪尤斯。

original: He lives just outside Anga's Mill, in the woods. He was once the miller. Now Papius is just a paranoid recluse who thinks someone is out to get him.
traduit: 他住在安佳木材厂外的树林里。曾经是木材厂主。现在就是个多疑的隐居者，总觉得有人要害他。

original: And he's right.
traduit: 他猜对了。

original: Tell me about Narfi.
traduit: 跟我说说纳菲。

original: He's a hapless beggar living in some ruins just outside the village of Ivarstead. Easy even for you.
traduit: 他是个住在伊瓦尔镇外废墟里的倒霉乞丐。就算是你也能对付。

original: Who was this scholar?
traduit: 那个学者是谁？

original: A smart man came and told us about a blade piece.
traduit: 有个智者来告诉我们碎片之一的下落。

original: Skjor thinks you should find it, and I'm supposed to watch you.
traduit: 斯科约尔认为应该由你去找，而我则负责观察你。

original: One of those icebrains who wanders the land getting people's hopes up.
traduit: 又是一个四处流浪想给人们带来希望的冻脑壳。

original: From my view, I don't think we'll find anything here.
traduit: 依我看，我们在这儿什么都找不着。

original: You'd better hope there's still a chance for you to prove yourself, though, or this Trial might last longer than you'd like.
traduit: 但你最好希望能够得到机会证明自己，否则这场考验可是要持续很久的。

original: We should keep moving.
traduit: 我们得继续走。

original: We need to get back to Jorrvaskr.
traduit: 我们得回月瓦斯卡了。

original: There you are.
traduit: 你在那儿啊。

original: Calixto Corrium was the real killer.
traduit: 卡利斯托·克利姆是真正的凶手。

original: I'm glad you were able to correct your mistake. I'll release Wuunferth immediately.
traduit: 很高兴你能更正了错误。我这就释放巫恩菲斯。

original: Ysmir's beard! The man was always a bit odd, but I wouldn't have expected...
traduit: 伊斯米尔的胡子！这人总是有点古怪，只是我没想到……

original: Calixto Corrium was the Butcher.
traduit: 卡利斯托·克利姆就是“屠夫”。

original: The killer has struck again.
traduit: 凶手又作案了。

original: Oh, isn't that a shame. And here I am in the Bloodworks.
traduit: 哦，真可惜。我当时在血厂。

original: Looks like you aren't such a sharp investigator after all.
traduit: 看来你也不是个精明的侦探啊。

original: The killer must still be out there.
traduit: 凶手肯定还在逍遥法外。

original: Obviously. You should visit the Bloodworks to talk to Wuunferth -- we need to figure out where the evidence went wrong.
traduit: 当然了。你得去血厂找巫恩菲斯谈谈，我们得找出证据到底哪里出了问题。

original: What happened here? Another killing?
traduit: 发生什么了？又有人被杀了？

original: Indeed. I... I thought you captured the Butcher.
traduit: 确实。我……我以为你抓住了屠夫。

original: You said the city was safe, now. How could this have happened?
traduit: 你说过城市已经安全了。现在这是怎么回事？

original: All the wood furniture in this inn is rotting to the core. Do you know why that is, Kleppr?
traduit: 知道为什么这个旅店里所有木制家具都在腐烂吗，克莱珀？

original: I don't know, my darling wife. I assume you're going to tell me?
traduit: 我不知道，我亲爱的老婆。我猜你会告诉我的吧？

original: It's rotten because the wood is cheap and its soaked with ale! Now we'll have to replace all the furniture before bugs set in.
traduit: 因为这些木头太便宜了，而且里面被麦芽酒泡烂了！我们得在生虫子之前把家具都换了。

original: Pa says the Empire made us leave, but the Empire just does whatever the elves tell them to.
traduit: 爸爸说帝国让我们离开，但帝国只听精灵们的。

original: How come you're in Winterhold? My pa says people like you are the reason no one lives here anymore.
traduit: 你来冬堡干什么？我爸说你这样的人就是这里没人住的原因。

original: We don't get many people like you visiting Winterhold. Usually it's elves.
traduit: 像你这样的人不常来冬堡。这里来的大多是精灵。

original: My pa says elves are bad and not to trust 'em.
traduit: 我爸说精灵很坏，不要相信他们。

original: Did you know that most of Winterhold fell into the sea? I heard it's because of that College.
traduit: 你知不知道冬堡大部分土地都掉进大海里了？我听说是因为那家学院。

original: Someday I'm gonna grow up and be the Jarl.
traduit: 总有一天，我会长大当领主。

original: I heard the College teaches you how to kill people with magic. Is that true?
traduit: 我听说学院会教你用魔法杀人。这是真的吗？

original: I'm just the Housecarl. If you need something, you should speak to Kraldar.
traduit: 我只是侍卫。如果有什么需要，请找卡拉达。

original: I'm very busy, you know. I'm the only one Kraldar can rely on to assist him.
traduit: 你知道，我很忙。我是卡拉达唯一能依靠的人了。

original: Kraldar's family was once very powerful in Winterhold. It's my honor to assist him even now.
traduit: 卡拉达的家族在冬堡一度十分强大。即使现在，帮助他也是我的荣幸。

original: Kraldar has big plans for Winterhold. We'd be better off if he was in charge.
traduit: 卡拉达对冬堡有宏伟的规划。如果由他来负责，情况会好很多。

original: Some people can't be trusted to accomplish anything that's asked of them. They don't take pride in their work.
traduit: 有些人不值得托付。他们根本不知道尽职尽责。

original: I'm not one to complain, but I'm not sure why Kraldar insists on keeping Malur Seloth around.
traduit: 我不是爱抱怨，但我不明白为什么卡拉达要坚持留下马鲁尔·塞洛斯。

original: My job is to serve the Jarl, not waste time talking with travelers.
traduit: 我的工作是为领主服务，不是浪费时间和旅行者聊天。

original: Thonjolf is convinced I've got some connections at the College, so he goes easy on me.
traduit: 托恩乔夫觉得我在学院里有熟人，所以对我很宽容。

original: I don't really know anyone at the College. I guess everyone just assumes I do because I'm a Dunmer.
traduit: 我真的不认识学院里的人。我猜是因为我是丹莫，所以大家都以为我认识。

original: People won't say it, but they're afraid of me, so they leave me alone.
traduit: 人们不说，但他们害怕我，所以离我都远远的。

original: It turns out that if people think you're some sort of secret wizard, they'll let you get away with a lot.
traduit: 事实证明，如果大家认为你是某种神秘的巫师，他们会容忍你很多。

original: I'm trying to do as little as possible. You're getting in the way of that.
traduit: 我尽量少做了。别妨碍我。

original: With the Empire's help, Winterhold will be back on its feet in no time.
traduit: 有了帝国的帮助，冬堡很快就会恢复生机了。

original: There's yet hope that our relationship with the College can be repaired.
traduit: 我们与学院的关系还有修复的希望。

original: Winterhold may not look impressive, but it has a very rich history.
traduit: 冬堡乍一看可能没那么惊艳，但它的历史十分悠久。

original: Winterhold was once the capital of Skyrim, you know. Quite an honor.
traduit: 你要知道，冬堡曾经是天际的首都。实在是荣幸啊。

original: I'd like nothing more than to see Winterhold regain its former glory.
traduit: 我只想看到冬堡重拾昔日的荣光。

original: It's hard to recover from something like the Great Collapse, but I believe Winterhold can do it.
traduit: 想从大坍陷恢复过来很难，但我相信冬堡能够做到。

original: The College of Winterhold is truly an asset to our city... err, town.
traduit: 冬堡学院是我们城……呃，镇的宝贵财富。

original: I have a very close relationship with Savos Aren, the current Arch-Mage.
traduit: 我和现在的大法师萨沃斯·阿冉关系很好。

original: Just say the word if you need a drink or something to eat.
traduit: 如果需要吃的喝的，招呼一声。

original: We may not have as much to offer as Whiterun or Solitude, but we'll do what we can to make your stay a pleasant one.
traduit: 我们也许不能像白漫独孤那样提供丰富的东西，但也会尽所能让你在这里过得愉快。

original: Winterhold doesn't offer much, but we like living here. Been here all our lives.
traduit: 冬堡什么都没有，但我们喜欢住在这里。一辈子都在。

original: If you're here for the College, don't let the folks in town bother you. Just try and keep to yourself.
traduit: 如果你是来拜访学院的，别让镇上的人打扰到你。尽量别跟其他人说话。

original: The Mages at the College keep to themselves for the most part, so we don't see much of them.
traduit: 学院的法师们大多不与人往来，所以我们很少能见到他们。

original: Most of our business comes from folks traveling to and from the College.
traduit: 我们大部分生意都来自往来于学院的人。

original: If you need a drink, just say the word.
traduit: 如果想喝一杯，尽管说。

original: Something I can get for you?
traduit: 能为你做点什么吗？

original: Turns out who runs Winterhold doesn't change much. Can't say I'm surprised.
traduit: 结果谁管着冬堡都没太大变化。我也不太惊讶。

original: I won't complain about Korir being gone, but I don't expect things to really be any different.
traduit: 我不会因为科利尔离开而抱怨，但我不希望事情真的有什么不同。

original: If there's anything you need, just let me know.
traduit: 如果需要什么，尽管告诉我。

original: If you've business with the College, you're welcome to stay here. It's where most of our business comes from, in fact.
traduit: 如果你和学院有往来，欢迎你留在这里。事实上，这也是我们大部分业务的来源。

original: Unlike some folks here in town, we have nothing against the College or the people that come and go.
traduit: 我们不像镇上的某些人，不反对学院或来去学院的人。

original: Don't worry about Nelacar. He has a permanent room here at the Inn, but he keeps to himself and doesn't cause any trouble.
traduit: 不用在意内拉卡。他在旅店有固定的房间，但不跟人来往，也不会惹麻烦。

original: Let me know if you need anything. We're here to provide.
traduit: 有什么需要就告诉我们，我们会提供的。

original: Without us looking out for Winterhold, it's doomed. Simply doomed.
traduit: 没有我们的守护，冬堡就完了。很容易就完了。

original: I'd rather see the Sea of Ghosts swallow Winterhold entirely than have it run by the Empire.
traduit: 我宁愿让幽灵海把冬堡整个吞了，也不愿意看帝国来统治它。

original: Ours is the only family left that truly cares what happens to Winterhold.
traduit: 我们家是唯一真正关心冬堡命运的家族。

original: Korir will be the first to tell you that if it weren't for that College, we'd all be better off. I agree with him.
traduit: 科利尔总会先告诉你，如果没有那所学院，我们的生活会更好。我同意他的观点。

original: Winterhold might yet thrive if that College had never been built.
traduit: 如果没有那所学院，冬堡也许还会兴旺发达下去。

original: We do the best we can, even though we have next to nothing. But we Nords don't give up, not ever.
traduit: 即使一无所有，我们也会尽力做到最好。诺德人不言放弃，永远不会。

original: Assur is going to grow up to be a great man, because he'll have lived through such hardship.
traduit: 阿苏尔会成为一个伟大的人，因为他经历了这样的磨难。

original: Driven out of my own home. After all this, I can't believe it.
traduit: 被逐出家园。经历这一切，真不敢相信。

original: It wasn't enough that the College still stands, now the damnable Empire has Winterhold. I hope they all freeze to death.
traduit: 学院还在还不算。现在该死的帝国占领了冬堡。但愿他们都被冻死。

original: I don't care how many Colleges they build, or how much the sea swallows up. I'll outlast them all.
traduit: 我不在乎他们建立了多少学院，也不在乎被大海吞噬了多少。我会比他们都长寿。

original: You know Winterhold used to be the seat of power in Skyrim? Now it's a shell.
traduit: 你知道吗，冬堡曾经是天际的权力中心。现在只剩个空壳了。

original: Few will admit it, but we know the truth about the Great Collapse.
traduit: 很少有人会承认，但我们知道大坍陷的真相。

original: Those cursed mages... It's their fault Winterhold is gone.
traduit: 那些该死的法师……冬堡的沦陷就是因为他们。

original: The College is the worst thing that's ever happened to Winterhold, maybe to Skyrim.
traduit: 学院是冬堡乃至全天际最糟糕的东西。

original: You want something?
traduit: 有什么事吗？

original: Empire's in charge now, huh? Only a matter of time before we start getting bothered by them Thalmoricars... err, Justimors... Y'know, them elves.
traduit: 现在帝国说了算，哈？过不了多久我们就会被他们的梭默狗给烦……呃，审判者……你明白的，那些精灵嘛。

original: Unless you're bringin' me another round, you can just keep walking.
traduit: 除非你想请我喝一轮，否则你可以走了。

original: I'm just trying to have a quiet drink here, all right?
traduit: 我只想安静地喝一杯，不行吗？

original: It's not like there's anything to do here but drink anyway.
traduit: 反正在这儿除了喝酒也没什么可做的了。

original: You ask me, not enough of Winterhold fell off into the sea.
traduit: 要我说，冬堡沉到海里的还不够多。

original: Nothing to do here but drink till you forget you got nothing to do.
traduit: 这里没什么事可做，只能喝酒喝到忘了你自己没事可做。

original: I'll sell just about anything, if it's worth my time. Keep that in mind, will you?
traduit: 只要是值得我花费时间的东西，我什么都卖。记住了吗？

original: I do what's necessary so we can get by. Have to, since I can't count on my brother for anything.
traduit: 我只做必须要做的事，这样我们才能活下去。没办法，指望不上我兄弟做事了。

original: Things are easier now that I don't have to worry about Ranmir anymore.
traduit: 现在不用担心兰米尔，事情就简单多了。

original: I still can't believe you were able to help Ranmir pull himself together.
traduit: 我还是不敢相信你能帮兰米尔重新振作起来。

original: Without all our money going to drink, I can afford to expand my selection a bit.
traduit: 现在不用花钱买酒，我就能负担更多了。

original: If you're looking for Ranmir, he's either passed out in bed, or working on winding up that way.
traduit: 如果你要找兰米尔，那他不是在床上昏着，就是努力让自己在床上昏着。

original: My brother's a good-for-nothing drunk. We'd have lost the house by now if it were up to him.
traduit: 我兄弟是个一无是处的酒鬼。如果让他来管家，我们连房子都没了。

original: Just because we live in the middle of nowhere doesn't give Ranmir the right to drink himself into oblivion.
traduit: 就算我们住在偏僻的地方，也不能让兰米尔喝酒喝到湮灭去。

original: Ranmir has no problem drinking himself under the table, so I have to be the one to make ends meet.
traduit: 兰米尔天天把自己灌的烂醉如泥，所以就得我来养家。

original: I don't deal with any College applicants these days, so don't bother asking.
traduit: 我现在不和任何申请加入学院的打交道，别费心问了。

original: My days at the College are long behind me, but I prefer to stay close by.
traduit: 我已经不在学院很久了，但我更喜欢待在这附近。

original: Dagur and I have an understanding. He gives me privacy, and I make sure my experiments don't blow up his inn.
traduit: 达古尔和我达成共识。他给我私人空间，我则确保实验不会炸了他的旅馆。

original: If you're here for sight-seeing, well then you've seen the sights. Might as well head somewhere warmer.
traduit: 如果你是来参观的，那你已经看完了。还是去个暖和点的地方吧。

original: Don't worry about those Stormcloaks. You're safe from them here. As if they'd want the place anyway.
traduit: 不用担心那些风暴斗篷。你在这里很安全。好像他们无论如何都想要这个地方似的。

original: Keep clear of the College, and keep yourself out of trouble.
traduit: 远离学院，别惹麻烦。

original: Hard to believe I ever complained about Riften being cold...
traduit: 很难相信我还抱怨过裂谷城很冷……

original: Take care if you're venturing too far from town. That's a bitter wind coming off the Sea of Ghosts.
traduit: 如果你冒险的时候离开城区太远，要小心了。幽灵海吹来的狂风可不是玩的。

original: Winterhold belongs to Skyrim, not the Imperials, or the Mages.
traduit: 冬堡属于天际，不是帝国人的也不是法师的。

original: Don't worry, my love. Just show the bugs your adoring face, and they'll scurry away in complete fear in no time.
traduit: 别担心，亲爱的。只要把你那张动人的脸蛋给虫子们看看，它们很快就会在完全的恐惧中跑开了。

original: You're an idiot, Kleppr. Why did I ever marry you?
traduit: 克莱珀你个白痴。老娘怎么就嫁给你了？

original: Not a day goes by I don't ask that question myself, my dear.
traduit: 我没有一天不问自己这个问题，亲爱的。

original: Frabbi, my dear loving wife, could you please clean out our guest rooms?
traduit: 弗拉碧，亲爱的老婆，能打扫一下我们的客房吗？

original: Clean the rooms yourself Kleppr. It's not like you do anything important around here.
traduit: 自己去打扫，克莱珀。你又没什么活儿可干。

original: No, just check in the guests and manage the coin and keep a roof over your head. No, nothing important.
traduit: 是啊，也就是登记入住、管账算账，然后让你有地方住。也没啥要紧事。

original: Kleppr, you idiot! Can't you do anything right?
traduit: 克莱珀你个傻子！你就不能干点好事吗？

original: What? What did I do this time? I was just standing here!
traduit: 什么？我又做错什么了？我只是站在这儿啊！

original: You were just standing there when you were supposed to be serving drinks to our customers!
traduit: 你在应该给客人斟酒的时候戳在那里！

original: Shouldn't you be helping me then, wife of mine? Sharing my problems? Being my better half?
traduit: 你不是应该帮我吗，老婆？分享我的麻烦？成为我最好的另一半？

original: I am your better half. And your better half is telling you to stop being an idiot and serve the customers their drinks!
traduit: 我是你最好的另一半。你的另一半现在告诉你别再发呆赶紧给客人去倒酒！

original: How are your chores coming, my son?
traduit: 卫生打扫得怎么样了，儿子？

original: Today I've cleaned the linens, washed the floors, and checked in on all our guests.
traduit: 今天我洗了床单，擦了地板，然后给所有客人做了登记。

original: Ah, my son, you'll be a fine innkeeper someday, like your father.
traduit: 啊，儿子，早晚你会和你爹我一样成为优秀的旅馆老板的。

original: But mother says you're a terrible innkeeper!
traduit: 可妈说你差劲透了！

original: That's right! Worst innkeeper in all of Skyrim!
traduit: 没错！全天际最差旅馆老板！

original: Never mind your mother, Hreinn. You listen to me, and you'll be a great man one day.
traduit: 别管你妈，贺莱尼。听我说，你会成为好男人的。

original: Father, why do you and mother fight so much?
traduit: 爸，为什么你和我妈总吵架？

original: We don't fight, son. We, um, talk. Loudly.
traduit: 我们不是吵架，儿子。我们，呃，只是说话声音大。

original: Will I need to talk so loudly with my wife when I get married?
traduit: 那我结婚以后需要跟我老婆大声说话吗？

original: Dibella's Heart, son, I hope not.
traduit: 迪贝拉的心啊，儿子，我希望用不着。

original: How are your chores coming, son?
traduit: 打扫做得怎么样了，儿子？

original: I've been cleaning up spills and there is fresh linen for the rooms.
traduit: 我一直在清理洒出来的东西，房间里已经铺上新床单了。

original: Aren't you wonderful! Why can't your father be more like you and your sister?
traduit: 你可太棒了！你爹怎么就不能像你和你妹妹一样呢？

original: Are you going to walk over to father and start hitting him again?
traduit: 你要走到爸的面前打他了？

original: No, not right now. Maybe later, if I'm still upset.
traduit: 不，现在不行。等等吧，看我什么时候心情不好。

original: "White-Gold Concordat"? What's that?
traduit: “白金协定”？那是什么？

original: The Great War... only thirty years past and already ancient history to most people.
traduit: 浩大战争……只是过去三十年，大多数人却觉得已是古老的历史了。

original: Seems to me like it just ended... it's never really ended for me.
traduit: 似乎这一切刚刚结束……但对我而言，从未结束。

original: But to answer your question, the White-Gold Concordat was the fancy name they put on the peace treaty between the Empire and the Thalmor.
traduit: 但还是回答一下你的问题，白金协定是帝国和梭默签订和平条约取的花哨名字。

original: It ended the war and saved the Empire to fight another day.
traduit: 它结束了战争并挽救了帝国，让帝国有机会重新战斗。

original: Also trampled on the sacred name of Talos, and gave the Thalmor free reign to stamp out Talos worship throughout the Empire.
traduit: 但也践踏了塔洛斯的圣名，赋予梭默在帝国境内扑灭塔洛斯信仰的自由权力。

original: Get to the point.
traduit: 说重点吧。

original: What did Malyn do?
traduit: 马林做了什么？

original: Don't change the subject.
traduit: 别转移话题。

original: Soul gems are the subject, friend. They're used in enchanting, then they break. Except one.
traduit: 没有跑题，朋友。大部分灵魂石在进行附魔之后，就会破碎。但有一个例外。

original: Azura's Star. A Daedric artifact that allows any number of souls to pass through it.
traduit: 阿祖拉之星。一个可以承载无限灵魂的迪德拉神器。

original: Some of us wanted to find out how. I was working under Malyn Varen, then. If only we knew what he was really planning.
traduit: 我们中的一些人希望弄清原理。当时我正在马林·瓦伦手下工作。如果我们知道他真正的计划就好了。

original: Soul gems? Why are you asking?
traduit: 灵魂石？你问这干什么？

original: That's what caused all the trouble. Soul gems are used in enchanting, but they break afterwards. Except one.
traduit: 这就是麻烦的根源。灵魂石被用于附魔后就会破碎。但有一个例外。

original: They're for enchanting, correct?
traduit: 用来附魔的，对吧？

original: They are. Except the gem is always consumed. They're frail. Except for one.
traduit: 没错。这些脆弱的灵魂石都会被消耗掉。但有一个另外。

original: What do you know about soul gems?
traduit: 你对灵魂石了解多少？

original: I misspoke. Forget I asked.
traduit: 是我口误，当我没问。

original: That's for the best.
traduit: 那再好不过。

original: I didn't agree to anything. Talk. (Intimidate)
traduit: 我可没答应过。快说。（恐吓）

original: Just calm down. I'll tell you everything.
traduit: 冷静，冷静。我会告诉你一切。

original: Do you think muscling me is going to work? I'm a wizard. An old. Elven. Wizard. Think about it.
traduit: 你觉得能吓得住我？我是巫师，年长的，精灵，巫师。好好琢磨琢磨。

original: Look, I'm willing to pay. (<BribeCost> gold)
traduit: 我会付钱的。（<BribeCost>金币）

original: A few coins for my soul? If only you understood the irony.
traduit: 几个破钱就想让我出卖灵魂？不觉得可笑么。

original: I don't think you understand. I'm not answering questions.
traduit: 我看你还是不懂。我不会回答的。

original: A priestess of Azura sent me. (Persuade)
traduit: 是阿祖拉的女祭司派我来的。（说服）

original: Azura? Gods, it's all finally coming back to haunt me.
traduit: 阿祖拉？老天，还是找上我了。

original: You're working with the Daedra? Right. Now tell me the one about the Argonian Maid and the lusty baron.
traduit: 你在跟迪德拉合作？好吧。要不再跟我聊聊阿尔贡女仆和风流男爵的小故事？

original: Would you believe I was given a vision?
traduit: 你相信我收到了启示吗？

original: Well, I've certainly heard worse things.
traduit: 这样啊，我当然听说过更糟糕的事。

original: I think the man you want to talk to is Nelacar. He was exiled a few years ago, bad research. Still hangs around the Frozen Hearth.
traduit: 我觉得你是在找内拉卡。他几年前因为研究不当而被赶走了。现在还在冻炉旅店晃悠。

original: You were given a vision? Are you serious?
traduit: 你看到了启示？没开玩笑吧？

original: Whatever. The person you probably want is Nelacar. He's in the Frozen Hearth. Be careful, he was exiled from the College for a reason.
traduit: 不管怎样。你找的应该是内拉卡，就住在冻炉旅店里。小心，他被学院开除不是毫无根据的。

original: No. I wouldn't.
traduit: 不，我不信。

original: Why don't you head into town and get a drink at the Frozen Hearth? I hear old Nelacar still has a room there. He knows a lot of stories, that one.
traduit: 要不去冻炉旅店喝一杯吧。我听说老内拉卡在那里租了个房间。他倒是知道很多类似的事。

original: Vision? What vision are you talking about? Oh, no matter.
traduit: 启示？你说的启示是什么？哦，没关系。

original: You should head to the Frozen Hearth and speak with Nelacar. It's his story to tell, and I wouldn't want to discredit him by talking behind his back.
traduit: 你该去冻炉旅店找内拉卡谈谈。我不想在背后对他的故事说三道四，会丢他脸的。

original: The vision is true, isn't it?
traduit: 那启示是真的吗？

original: You should go into town and talk to an elf named Nelacar. He was involved in the whole mess.
traduit: 你应该去镇上找那个叫内拉卡的精灵谈谈。他曾经卷入了整场混乱。

original: Something tells me that it is.
traduit: 我觉得是的。

original: Yes, I did. I shouldn't be the one to tell you about this. There's an Altmer named Nelacar in the Frozen Hearth. Believe me, he'll know.
traduit: 没错。这件事不该由我说。去冻炉旅店找个叫内拉卡的傲特莫。他肯定知道。

original: Did you say "exile"?
traduit: 你刚才说“开除”？

original: Oh no, I'm not talking about that. I'm not being blamed for saying something out of place. Again.
traduit: 哦，不，我没说那个。我不想再因为说些不合时宜的话而被责备。

original: If you want to know, ask Nelacar. He's staying at the Frozen Hearth. Knows the whole sad story.
traduit: 如果想知道的话就去问内拉卡吧。他现在住在冻炉旅店。他知道那个悲伤故事的全部。

original: Wait. What artifact?
traduit: 等等。什么神器？

original: Almost the opposite. The College got rid of something... someone, that was too much trouble.
traduit: 恰恰相反。学院还除去了些麻烦的东西……还有人。

original: There's an Altmer named Nelacar staying at the inn outside the College. You should ask him about it.
traduit: 有个叫内拉卡的傲特莫住在学院外面的旅店里。你应该去问他。

original: Is the College hiding something?
traduit: 学院在藏什么？

original: I don't believe in fate.
traduit: 我不信命运。

original: Perhaps that is what you are meant to believe. To better serve your role as Azura's champion.
traduit: 为了更好地发挥身为阿祖拉勇士的作用。也许还是应该相信的。

original: Do not fight it. Azura's prophecies always come to pass. To deny them is to go headlong into the darkness with no light to guide you.
traduit: 不要与之抗争。阿祖拉的预言百发百中。否定预言就是在没有光的指引下一头扎进黑暗一样。

original: Are you all alone here?
traduit: 你一个人在这儿？

original: Yes. There were others at first, but Azura's visions tested everyone's faith. One by one, they left. Afraid to know their own future.
traduit: 没错。起初还有其他人。但是阿祖拉的启示考验着每个人的信念。他们因害怕知道未来，一个接一个地离开了。

original: But I refuse to abandon the shrine. The visions are a gift. Azura warns me of tragedy, war, death before it happens. I won't leave her guidance.
traduit: 但我不会丢下祭坛不管。启示是馈赠。阿祖拉会在悲剧、战争、死亡到来前警告我。我不会离开她的引导。

original: Where did this shrine come from?
traduit: 这个祭坛是怎么来的？

original: My people, the Dunmer, built it. We fled from Morrowind after Vvardenfell erupted almost 200 years ago.
traduit: 大概两百年前，瓦登费尔火山喷发时，我们逃离了晨风，我的丹莫同族在那之后建造了它。

original: Those of us who were faithful to Azura were given a vision that led us away from the island before the worst came.
traduit: 我们这些忠于阿祖拉的信徒在厄运到来前接到了阿祖拉的启示，指引我们离开了瓦登费尔岛。

original: This shrine is our thanks to her. That none will forget that she watches over us all.
traduit: 为了感激她并铭记她对我们的庇护，所以才建造了这座祭坛。

original: We are children of the Twilight. Beings who are to be guided from the darkness into the light. And from the light into darkness.
traduit: 我们是暮光之子。被指引从黑暗走向光明，亦从光明走入黑暗。

original: Azura. Who led her children away from the disaster of Vvardenfell. You are the prophet that reveals our true future.
traduit: 阿祖拉。是您带着孩子们逃离了瓦登费尔的灾难。您就是揭示我等真正未来的预言者。

original: No harm shall come to me, for I live under Azura's wisdom. Her foresight protects me. Her insight sustains me.
traduit: 我活在阿祖拉的智慧之下，永不受到伤害。她的远见保护着我，她的洞察支持着我。

original: Have you seen that Shrine of Azura? They say the dark elves built it after they fled from Morrowind. Sight to see.
traduit: 有没有见过阿祖拉的祭坛？听说是暗精灵逃离晨风后建造的。十分壮观。

original: Playing tonight, Ogmund? Everyone here is anxious to hear the old ballads performed by the True Skald of the Reach.
traduit: 今晚演奏吗，欧格蒙？这里每个人都急切想听瑞驰真正的老吟唱者演唱的老歌。

original: Son, I know thousands of the old ballads. If I played all of them, everyone in this inn would be as grey as I am before I finished.
traduit: 孩子，我知道成千上万的古老歌谣。如果我演完了，这旅馆里所有人都该跟我一样白胡子白头发了。

original: Uh, right. Maybe just one of the popular songs, like "The Slaying of the Falmer Princes"?
traduit: 啊。对。那也许来个流行歌？比如《伐莫王子之死》？

original: That's a sensible lad. Now fetch me drink.
traduit: 这主意不错。给我拿点酒。

original: Ah, Yngvar, here to sing? You know an employee of the Silver-Blood family is always a guest of honor here.
traduit: 啊，英瓦尔，来唱歌吗？你知道银血家族的雇员永远是这里的贵宾。

original: Shut it, Kleppr. Thongvor isn't here, so save your kissing up for a Nord who cares.
traduit: 闭嘴吧，克莱珀。松瓦不在，所以别拍马屁了，去讨好你在乎的诺德吧。

original: Always such a model for decency in these troubled times, Yngvar.
traduit: 在这个动荡年代，你可真是个正直的典范，英瓦尔。

original: Another drink, Cosnach? A porter with Arnleif and Sons deserves nothing but the finest here.
traduit: 再来一杯吗，科斯纳奇？阿雷夫父子贸易商行的搬运工应该喝到这里最好的。

original: All your drinks are watered down, Kleppr. You aren't fooling me, and you know Lisbet can't afford to pay me enough for the finest drinks anyhow.
traduit: 你所有酒都掺水了，克莱珀。你骗不了我，而且你也知道利斯拜特无论如何也不会付我买最好的酒的工钱。

original: I wasn't aware that Lisbet was having trouble, Cosnach. Is Arnleif and Sons not doing a good turn of business these days?
traduit: 我不知道利斯拜特遇到麻烦了，科斯纳奇。阿雷夫父子商行最近的生意不好吗？

original: What are you, blind? That store is empty. Forsworn get almost every shipment that comes in.
traduit: 你瞎了？那家商店都空了。几乎每批货物都被弃誓者劫走了。

original: That's just terrible. I'm so sorry to hear that.
traduit: 太可怕了。听到这个消息我很难过。

original: No you aren't.
traduit: 不，你没有。

original: Good to hear. You can be a difficult man to find. Thankfully those couriers are tenacious.
traduit: 太好了。你可真难找。谢天谢地，这些信差真够顽强的。

original: Good to hear. You can be a difficult woman to find. Thankfully those couriers are tenacious.
traduit: 太好了。你可真难找。谢天谢地，这些信差真够顽强的。

original: Mama, when is Cade coming home?
traduit: 妈妈，卡德什么时候回来？

original: He's off fighting, Adara, with the Stormcloaks. He'll return when the war is over.
traduit: 他去和风暴斗篷一起打仗了，艾达拉。仗打完了他就会回来的。

original: Our son joining the Stormcloaks. If this war had never happened, Cade would have joined the Imperial Legion, like grandfather.
traduit: 我们的儿子加入了风暴斗篷。如果这场战争没有爆发，卡德就会像他爷爷那样去加入帝国军团。

original: Endon, we talked about this... Are you still disappointed in Cade's choice?
traduit: 恩东，我们已经谈过了……你还对卡德的选择失望吗？

original: No. I think if I was a young man, I would have done the same.
traduit: 不。如果我还年轻的话，我也会这么做的。

original: Can I join the Legion when I grow up?
traduit: 那我长大以后能加入军团吗？

original: If there's still a Legion left, Adara. I'm sure you'd make a great soldier. Just like your brother.
traduit: 如果到时候还有军团在这儿的话，艾达拉。我相信你会和你哥哥一样成为好士兵的。

original: We sold all those lovely little necklaces you brought me today. Did you make them yourself?
traduit: 你今天给我的那些可爱小项链都卖了。是你自己做的吗？

original: That's right! Papa helped me with the clasps, but I did all the links on my own.
traduit: 没错！爸爸帮我做了扣子，但是我自己串起来的。

original: Adara bends the silver so naturally. Grandmother would have cried if she saw how deft our daughter has become.
traduit: 艾达拉把银弯曲得很自然。如果奶奶看到我们的女儿这么灵巧，她一定会哭出来的。

original: Well, I'm proud of both of you. I haven't been so busy since those nobles from Solitude come into the city three years ago.
traduit: 我真为你俩感到骄傲。自从三年前独孤城的贵族们来过这里我就没这么忙过。

original: I miss those days, before the Forsworn took up arms again, when you could walk the roads in peace.
traduit: 我也怀念那些在弃誓者重新拿起武器之前，能够在和平的道路上行走的日子。

original: Endon, dear, please don't.... Save your frustrations for work.
traduit: 恩东，亲爱的，请不要……把你的沮丧留到工作上。

original: You're right, dear. I'm sorry to worry you.
traduit: 你说得对，亲爱的。抱歉让你担心了。

original: No, no girl. It's the pickled spider tongue and then the decayed taproot. Do it the other way, and your cure turns into a poison.
traduit: 不，不对，孩子。先是腌制的蜘蛛舌，然后是腐烂的直立根。方式一变，解药就变成毒药了。

original: There's just so much to memorize. How am I supposed to remember what goes where for every single herb?
traduit: 要记住的东西太多了。我怎么能记住每一种草药的顺序？

original: You will. Until then, you'll taste every potion you make before you sell it.
traduit: 你会的。在那之前，你得先尝过自己的每一种药剂再往外卖。

original: Bothela, I have a question....
traduit: 波塞拉，我有个问题……

original: You want to know a secret of mine, young girl? The most effective poison to kill a man? A potion to make others fall in love, perhaps?
traduit: 你想知道我所有的秘密吗，小姑娘？杀人最见效的毒药？还是能让别人坠入爱河的魔药？

original: I was actually just wondering if you had any family....
traduit: 我只是想知道你还有没有家人……

original: Oh. Oh, I see....
traduit: 哦，哦，我知道了……

original: I'm sorry. You don't have to tell me if you don't....
traduit: 抱歉。如果你不想说就算了……

original: I have one. A nephew. He's in prison for being a member of the Forsworn.
traduit: 我有个侄子。因为是弃誓者的一员被下大牢了。

original: I'm sorry, I didn't realize.
traduit: 抱歉，我不是有意的。

original: Don't be. We all make mistakes.
traduit: 没关系。谁都会犯错的。

original: Another foul day at the smelter.
traduit: 冶炼厂又是糟糕的一天。

original: Mmmhmm.
traduit: 嗯嗯嗯。

original: "Mmmhmm"? I've been working with you for over 10 years, and all you have to say is "mmmhmm"?
traduit: “嗯嗯嗯”？我和你共事十多年了，你就一句“嗯嗯嗯”？

original: Sometimes I think we deserve these miserable lives of ours.
traduit: 有时候我觉得我们活该过这种惨日子。

original: Give us a coin, Cosnach. You'll just spend it on cheap ale, anyway.
traduit: 给我们个金币吧，科斯纳奇。反正你也只会把钱拿去买廉价麦芽酒。

original: Like you won't do different?
traduit: 说得好像你会干点别的一样。

original: I'm a cripple. I have a reason to be drinking.
traduit: 我是个跛子，喝酒是有原因的。

original: And I'm a porter with no shipments coming in. You're not getting any coin from me, Degaine.
traduit: 我就是个没货可运的搬运工。我是不会给你钱的，德加因。

original: How did you manage to cripple yourself, Degaine?
traduit: 你是怎么把自己弄残的，德加因？

original: Mining accident, back when I was in prison for being a pickpocket.
traduit: 矿难，当时我因为偷东西正好在监狱里。

original: You're lying. You're not quick enough to be a pickpocket. What's the real reason?
traduit: 你撒谎。你没那么快的手当小偷。到底为啥？

original: Fell off the top of the cliff after a drunken party with the priestesses of Dibella.
traduit: 和迪贝拉的女祭司们喝大了从悬崖上摔下来了。

original: I don't buy that story, either.
traduit: 这我也不信。

original: Too bad. That one's my favorite.
traduit: 太糟了，那个可是我最喜欢的一个。

original: My Jarl, we need to discuss the state of Markarth's collapsing trade with the other holds.
traduit: 领主，我们得讨论一下马卡斯和其他领地的贸易情况。

original: Of course there's a collapse in trade, Raerek. The Stormcloaks stalk every road and harass every one of our patrols.
traduit: 贸易当然会崩溃的，拉瑞克。风暴斗篷在每条路上骚扰我们的每个巡逻队。

original: Not to mention the rebels completely control Windhelm and all of Eastmarch hold.
traduit: 更不用说叛军已经完全控制了风舵城和整个东陲领。

original: Why do you pester me with battles we can't win? I need my steward to plan for our victory, not nag me with every ill account.
traduit: 你为什么要拿我们赢不了的仗来烦我？我需要的是总管为我们的胜利制定计划，而不是拿各种不正当理由来烦我。

original: Forgive me for worrying about the future of Markarth. The lifeblood of a city is gold, Igmund, and it doesn't stop bleeding because there's a war on.
traduit: 请原谅，我是在担心马卡斯的未来。一座城市的命脉就是金钱，依格蒙德。它不会因为战争就停止流动。

original: Very well. I'll send a request for additional Legionnaires to protect trade to the other Imperial holds. Hopefully Solitude can spare more men.
traduit: 很好。我会请求军团来保护其他帝国方领地的贸易。希望独孤城能多腾出点人手。

original: Raerek, how is The Reach faring against this Forsworn menace?
traduit: 拉瑞克，瑞驰应该如何对抗弃誓者的威胁？

original: Things are bad, Igmund. Our forces are barely able to keep the Forsworn in check. Merchants are reporting the loss of more of their shipments.
traduit: 情况很糟，依格蒙德。我们的军队几乎无法控制弃誓者。商人们报告说货物损失更多了。

original: This is why I say we take the fight to them. Gather the Legion and drive those blasted beasts out of the Reach for good.
traduit: 这就是为什么我说我们得向他们开战。召集军团，把那些可恶的野兽永远赶出瑞驰领。

original: And what do Legion soldiers know about the hills the Reach? And the caves that make up those hills? The Forsworn can hide and ambush every assault.
traduit: 军团的士兵对瑞驰的山脉又有多了解？还有山里的洞穴呢？弃誓者们可以隐藏并随时发动袭击。

original: The safety of the city and our settlements must be our only concern, Igmund. The rest of the Reach is on its own.
traduit: 这座城市和定居点的安全必须是我们唯一关心的问题，依格蒙德。瑞驰的其他地方只能靠自己了。

original: Cowards, the both of you. My father would not sit idly back and wait while evil men take over his lands. We're done discussing this for now.
traduit: 你俩全是懦夫。我父亲不会坐视不管，等着那些恶民接管他的土地。不要再说了。

original: Igmund, we need to talk about the Silver-Blood family.
traduit: 依格蒙德，我们得谈谈银血家族的事。

original: What about them? They seem loyal enough.
traduit: 他们怎么了？看起来够忠诚啊。

original: Loyal? Thongvor supports Ulfric and his Stormcloaks! We should imprison the entire family as a precaution.
traduit: 忠诚？松瓦支持乌弗瑞克和他的风暴斗篷！我们应该把他们全家关起来以防万一。

original: I second that, Igmund. Who knows what that family will do for power? They could be working with the Forsworn, for all we know.
traduit: 我也同意，依格蒙德。谁知道那个家族会为了权力做出什么事？据我们了解，他们可能在和弃誓者合作。

original: Enough! We can't imprison the very people that own the jail we would be throwing them into. The Silver-Blood family are to be left alone, am I clear?
traduit: 够了！我们不能把监狱的主人扔进他们自己的监狱。不许碰银血家，明白了？

original: Yes, my Jarl.
traduit: 遵命，领主。

original: I want word on our campaign against the Imperials.
traduit: 我想听听我们对抗帝国人的情况。

original: I have a few very detailed missives from border patrols, beginning with Fifth Irregulars' reports on the movements of....
traduit: 我有几封来自边境巡逻队的详细报告，第一封是第五非正规军关于……

original: Oh, Talos's breath, Reberrus. Skip ahead to the good part.
traduit: 哦，塔洛斯在上，雷贝鲁斯。捡关键部分说。

original: Oh, right. Oh, well, things are going well enough. At least, as well as we can hope.
traduit: 哦，好的。呃，一切都很顺利。至少和我们希望的一样好。

original: What does that mean Reberrus? Are we winning or aren't we?
traduit: 这算什么意思，雷贝鲁斯？我们到底赢没赢？

original: I, uh, I can't tell Thongvor. It's anyone's guess.
traduit: 我，我不好说，松瓦。不好说。

original: I see. Well, let's continue this discussion later then.
traduit: 我知道了。好吧，以后再讨论吧。

original: How goes the trade in and out of the city?
traduit: 城里的贸易进出情况如何？

original: Very well, Thongvor. With the Stormcloaks here to help, the Silver-Blood family control nearly every route in and out of the city.
traduit: 非常好，松瓦。有了风暴斗篷的帮助，银血家族几乎控制了进出城市的每一条路线。

original: Except the ones attacked by Forsworn.
traduit: 除了被弃誓者攻击的那些。

original: Well yes, of course you had to go and mention that.
traduit: 是啊，你提的也没错。

original: The Forsworn aren't our real concern, defeating the Imperials and making sure we keep control of this city is.
traduit: 我们真正该关心的不是弃誓者，而是击败帝国并确保我们控制这座城市。

original: Yes, Thongvor.
traduit: 是，松瓦。

original: Reburrus, I need you to draft a letter to Ulfric requesting more men.
traduit: 雷贝鲁斯，我要你起草一封给乌弗瑞克的信，要求增加些人手。

original: Ha! About time we got some more muscle in this city.
traduit: 哈！是时候给这个城市增加人手了。

original: Thongvor, do you really think that's wise? I mean, King Ulfric is such a busy man, and there are so many areas of Skyrim to protect.
traduit: 松瓦，你觉得这样真的明智吗？我是说，乌弗瑞克陛下很忙，而天际还有很多区域需要保护。

original: Whose side are you on, Reburrus? I'm not worried about Skyrim, I'm worried about the Reach. Specifically, the part of the Reach we're standing on.
traduit: 你这是什么立场，雷贝鲁斯？我不担心天际，我担心的是瑞驰。准确的说，就是我们站的这块地方。

original: Yes, Thongvor. I'll draft the letter immediately.
traduit: 是，松瓦。我马上去起草。

original: Tacitus? What is this?
traduit: 塔西佗？这是什么？

original: Uh, a nail?
traduit: 呃，一个钉子？

original: Is that what you call it? In the Legion we would have called it "useless." Look how brittle the metal is!
traduit: 你管它叫钉子？在军团里我们管这叫“废物”。看看这金属脆成什么样了！

original: I... I'm sorry. I just, well, the forge gets so hot and I thought....
traduit: 我……对不起。我只是，只是，锻炉太热了，我想……

original: You thought what? You would skip a step? Not heat the metal all the way through? Useless! Now do it again.
traduit: 你想啥？跳过这一步？不把金属完全加热？废物！现在重来。

original: When will I learn how to forge weapons and armor? Isn't that my job?
traduit: 我什么时候才能学会锻造武器和护甲？那不是我的工作吗？

original: Your job is to do what I say. And I say you have many nails and fittings to make before you even touch a blade. Now get to work.
traduit: 你的工作就是按我说的做。在你上手做武器之前，你还得继续打钉子和配件。现在开始工作吧。

original: Uncle Calcelmo....
traduit: 卡塞莫叔叔……

original: What is it nephew? Can't you see I'm trying to think here?
traduit: 怎么了侄子？你没看见我在思考吗？

original: I just wanted to know if you needed anything.
traduit: 我只是想问问你需不需要什么。

original: Um, no. Nothing. Nothing at all.
traduit: 嗯，没有。不需要，啥也不需要。

original: MS12SharedInfo
traduit: MS12SharedInfo

original: Just a man's life work, is all. I've finally derived the location of the White Phial, but this doting busybody won't let me get it.
traduit: 找了一辈子。我终于知道白瓶的位置了，但这个爱管闲事的家伙不让我去拿。

original: Now, how would you like me to align the Phial's properties?
traduit: 现在你想让我如何调整白瓶的药性？

original: I'm not as skilled as Curalmil, so I'm afraid it will only ever refill with one type of liquid.
traduit: 我没有库拉米尔那么熟练，所以恐怕只能装一种药液。

original: It's just one of those things that happens. The lungs just... give up. Even elves get old.
traduit: 这是常有的事。这肺……算是完了。就算是精灵也会变老啊。

original: What's it matter to you? Not like you could do anything about it.
traduit: 这跟你有什么关系？好像你也无能为力似的。

original: Stop bothering me Aicanter!
traduit: 别烦我了，爱坎塔！

original: Next season, nephew. Next season for sure....
traduit: 下一季度，侄子，下一季度肯定会……

original: "Next season for sure..." What? Uncle Calcelmo, I don't understand what you mean.
traduit: “下一季度肯定会……”什么？卡塞莫叔叔，我不明白你什么意思。

original: The excavation, Aicantar! Right after I finish my book. We'll start excavating Nchuand-Zel again.
traduit: 开挖，爱坎塔！等我写完书，咱们就再次开始挖掘尼楚安德-泽尔。

original: Could I maybe, skip the excavation, Uncle Calcelmo? I, uh, I just think you won't need me.
traduit: 卡塞莫叔叔，我能不参加挖掘吗？我觉得你不太需要我了。

original: Nonsense, you're a vital part of my research team. You'll be there, have no fear! Now, I don't want to hear another word of protest.
traduit: 胡说，你是我研究团队中重要一员。你一定得去，别害怕！好了，我不想再听任何抗议了。

original: Filthy natives. Get to work. We have meals to prepare and no time to prepare them!
traduit: 肮脏的原住民。赶快工作。我们还要准备饭，没时间了！

original: Right away, sir!
traduit: 马上就办，先生！

original: Always another big meal to cook. Figures.
traduit: 又得做一大顿饭了。

original: Move it. Get to work. Get to work!
traduit: 动起来。快去工作。工作！

original: Voada, you spilled laundry water in the soup pot again! Do I need to cut off your fingers to teach you a lesson?
traduit: 沃达，你又把洗衣服的水洒进汤锅里了！要我剁了你的手指头你才能长记性吗？

original: You touch her, and I swear it'll be your fingers that go missing, you stupid Breton!
traduit: 你敢碰她，我保证丢了手指的就是你，你这个傻逼布莱顿！

original: Now now, brother. Arnoit is just being his usual gloomy self, he didn't mean it, did you Arnoit? You're just being silly again.
traduit: 好了好了，哥哥。安东只是一如既往得阴沉罢了，不是故意的。你说呢，安东？你又犯傻了。

original: Whatever. Just get back to work. Now.
traduit: 算了。赶紧回去工作吧。

original: Here's what I can spare.
traduit: 这是我能给你的。

original: What do you want with the Elder Scroll?
traduit: 你想要上古卷轴做什么？

original: Ooooh, an observant one. How clever to ask of Septimus.
traduit: 哦~善于观察的人。来问赛普蒂莫斯，真聪明。

original: This Dwemer lockbox. Look upon it and wonder.
traduit: 这个锻莫密锁箱。看看吧，惊叹吧。

original: Inside is the heart. The heart of a god! The heart of you. And me.
traduit: 里面就是心脏！神之心！你的心。也是我的心。

original: But it was hidden away. Not by the Dwarves, you see. They were already gone.
traduit: 但是它被藏起来了。看看，不是矮人锁的，他们早就消失了。

original: Someone else. Unseen. Unknown. Found the heart, and with a flair for the ironical, used Dwarven trickery to lock it away.
traduit: 是别人，看不见的人，未知的人。找到了心，用某种天赋和矮人的诡计把它锁起来了。

original: The scroll will give the deep vision needed to open it.
traduit: 卷轴会提供深邃的理解来打开它。

original: For not even the strongest machinations of the Dwemer can hold off the all-sight given by an Elder Scroll.
traduit: 即使是锻莫最强大的阴谋也没法阻挡上古卷轴赋予的全视之力。

original: Why are you still standing around here? Go get me the Phial, you fool.
traduit: 为什么还站在那儿？去把白瓶给我找来，你个傻瓜。

original: So I'm free to leave?
traduit: 那我可以走了？

original: Yes, you're innocent. As innocent as anyone can be in this city.
traduit: 没错，你是无辜的。全城里最无辜的。

original: I guess we also owe you something for locking you up. Here, my family's ring. And everything the guards confiscated from you.
traduit: 因为你被关起来，我想我们还欠你些什么。这是我家族的戒指。还有卫兵从你那儿没收的东西。

original: Now if you'll excuse me, I have a mine that needs new workers to fill it.
traduit: 恕我失陪了，矿场还需要新工人来填满呢。

original: My eyes inside Cidhna Mine tell me that Madanach is dead.
traduit: 我的耳目告诉我迈德纳奇死了。

original: You've done a great service to the Silver-Blood family. I've had the Jarl officially pardon you, and taken care of a few other loose ends.
traduit: 你替银血家族做了很大贡献。我已经让领主正式赦免你了，还处理了其他一些问题。

original: DBMrandrujoKillChoice2aBranchTopic
traduit: DBMrandrujoKillChoice2aBranchTopic

original: You are a disgrace to our race! I spit on your fur!
traduit: 你真是我们一族的耻辱！我要在你的毛皮上吐口水！

original: What? Why? I don't understand... I have done nothing to wrong you. Please, mercy!
traduit: 什么？为什么？我不明白……我没有得罪过你啊。请发发慈悲！

original: What? You dare challenge Ma'randru-jo? You will suffer for your insolence!
traduit: 什么？你想挑战玛'兰德鲁-约？你会为傲慢付出代价的！

original: I'm sorry, egg brother, but I've been sent to kill you.
traduit: 抱歉了，卵生兄弟，我是被派来杀你的。

original: All right, everyone. Let's be careful, but have fun!
traduit: 好了，大家。小心一点，但是要开心！

original: J'zargo... what shall we have you do... Ah! Why don't you verify that we're the first ones here? Look for any amount of tampering with the tombs.
traduit: 杰'扎格……看看你要做些什么……啊！你去确认一下我们是否是第一批到达的。看看坟墓有没有被动过的痕迹。

original: Onmund, please search that area over there. See if you notice any... residual energies. Alive or undead.
traduit: 昂蒙德，请搜索一下那边的区域。看看能不能注意到任何生者或死者……残留的能量。

original: Brelyna, my dear, why don't you search for warding magics. Anything designed to keep people out. Don't interact with them, just identify them.
traduit: 小布莱丽娜，你去找找结界魔法。任何能够拒人在外的东西都可以。在不触发的情况下，识别即可。

original: Now, let's see. What shall we have the rest of you do?
traduit: 好了，我们来看看。剩下的人该干些什么？

original: I don't have any more questions. What would you like me to do?
traduit: 我没有问题了。需要我做些什么？

original: Ah, yes. Hmm. Well, why don't you see if you can assist Arniel Gane? He's one of our scholars, here working on cataloging our finds.
traduit: 啊，对。要不你去看看能不能帮上阿内尔·甘？他是咱们学院的学者，正在整理我们在这里的发现。

original: I expect he'd appreciate some help in locating any additional magical artifacts here in the ruins.
traduit: 如果你能在遗迹里找到其他魔法物品，他会很感激你的。

original: Any enchanted items will do; the usefulness of the enchantment is irrelevant. If you find anything, the class can look it over.
traduit: 任何附魔物品都可以，附魔的功用无关。如果发现了什么，可以让全班看看。

original: Find Arniel Gane. He's somewhere in the northern section of the ruins. He'll show you what to do.
traduit: 去找阿内尔·甘。他在遗迹北部的某个地方。他会告诉你怎么做。

original: What did you want me to do?
traduit: 我需要做些什么？

original: Well, are there any questions before we begin?
traduit: 好了，在我们开始前还有什么问题吗？

original: I'm not sure what to expect here. Please be on your guard.
traduit: 我不确定这里会有什么。请提高警惕。

original: What... What was that? Everything seemed to shimmer for a moment.
traduit: 什么……怎么回事？一瞬间好像所有的东西都在闪烁。

original: And here we all are. Shall we step inside?
traduit: 人到齐了。我们进去吧？

original: What could this place be?
traduit: 这是什么地方？

original: Be prepared to defend yourself.
traduit: 自己保护好自己。

original: This is simply fascinating.
traduit: 真是令人着迷啊。

original: Please be careful here. The site isn't entirely secured.
traduit: 请小心。这里还不是完全安全。

original: J'zargo finds nothing but dust in these ruins.
traduit: 杰'扎格在遗迹里只找到了灰尘。

original: Do you think there's treasure here? Something to make J'zargo a powerful wizard?
traduit: 你觉得这里会有宝藏吗？能让杰'扎格成为强大巫师的东西？

original: Who knows what we might find in here.
traduit: 谁知道我们会在这里发现什么。

original: You know, there might be gold somewhere in here.
traduit: 这里可能会有金子。

original: To think, my ancestors destroyed the homes of Onmund's ancestors. So much bloodshed.
traduit: 想想看，我的祖先摧毁了昂蒙德祖先的家园。太血腥了。

original: I'm not seeing signs of any warding magics at all. Either they're not here, or they were removed long ago.
traduit: 我在这里看不到任何结界魔法的迹象。要么是根本没有，要么就是早就失效了。

original: This is better than sitting around talking about magic, don't you think?
traduit: 你不觉得这比坐而论道好多了吗？

original: This is exciting, isn't it?
traduit: 很兴奋吧？

original: I wonder if everyone else would be so happy to rifle through the bones of their ancestors.
traduit: 我不知道其他人会不会有兴趣去翻自己祖先的骨头。

original: Can you imagine what it was like, living here so long ago? The first men in Tamriel, here...
traduit: 你能想象很久以前这里的样子吗？泰姆瑞尔的第一批人类，就在这儿……

original: I'm not so sure we should be here.
traduit: 我不确定咱们该不该来这儿。

original: I find it hard to believe this excavation was approved.
traduit: 真是难以置信，这次发掘居然被批准了。

original: Don't touch anything!
traduit: 不要乱动东西！

original: It's going to take forever to sift through all this.
traduit: 把这些东西筛选一遍要花很长时间。

original: I'll be amazed if we find anything useful here.
traduit: 如果能在这里发现有用的东西，我会很惊讶的。

original: Well, certainly none of this will benefit my research...
traduit: 哎，这些东西对我的研究没帮助……

original: I'm not quite ready to go inside yet.
traduit: 我还没准备好进去。

original: No? I daresay we don't have all day.
traduit: 还没有吗？咱们可不能等一整天啊。

original: Still? If I have to wait much longer, you may need to just bury me here.
traduit: 还没好吗？如果再等很久，你就把我埋在这里好了。

original: Sorry, I'm still not ready to go in there.
traduit: 抱歉，我还没准备好进去。

original: Help! Get that beast out of my house!
traduit: 救命！快把那畜生赶出我的房子！

original: It's still here! Get it out!
traduit: 还在这里！快把它弄出去！

original: Get that thing out of here!
traduit: 把那东西弄出去！

original: Thank you! I thought that beast would be the end of me!
traduit: 谢谢！我还以为那畜生会把我吃了呢！

original: Me? I like to talk to my targets before the kill. Taunt them, scare them... even challenge them.
traduit: 我吗？我喜欢在杀人前先和目标谈谈。奚落他们，吓唬他们……乃至挑衅他们。

original: That can have interesting results. Some victims may flee, others may cower in fear.
traduit: 这样可能会产生很多有趣的结果。有些受害者可能会逃跑，也有些会哆嗦着缩成一团。

original: If you can goad a target into attacking you first, you may even find any local guards coming to your aid.
traduit: 如果你能先刺激目标来攻击你，甚至连当地的卫兵都会跑来帮你。

original: What's your preferred method of assassination, Astrid?
traduit: 阿斯垂德，你喜欢什么样的刺杀方式？

original: Just be yourself. Eliminate the targets any way you see fit. Quiet, loud, quick, slow - whatever you feel is best.
traduit: 做好你自己就行。用你自认为最合适的方式消灭目标。或静或闹，或快或慢，怎么样都好。
