original: I know the phrase. I'll get Cicero - you go home.
traduit: 我知道密语。我来解决西塞罗，你先回吧。

original: In there! Through the door. Some old Sanctuary, by the looks of it. I would have followed him, but I don't know the phrase.
traduit: 在那里！门后头。看起来应该是个以前的圣所。我本想追进去，但是我不知道密语。

original: Where's Cicero now?
traduit: 西塞罗现在在哪？

original: What gave it away?
traduit: 你怎么找来的？

original: Ha ha ha ha ha.
traduit: 哈哈哈哈。

original: Yeah, got to admit that little jester is good with that butter knife. But don't worry, I gave as good as I got.
traduit: 是啊，不得不说那小丑玩黄油刀玩得很溜。但别担心，我已经尽力伤他了。

original: You're hurt.
traduit: 你受伤了。

original: Should have figured Astrid would send you.
traduit: 我就知道阿斯垂德会派你过来。

original: Do me a favor and kill that little jester twice. Just to make sure.
traduit: 帮我个忙，多杀那小丑一次。好好确认一下他死没死。

original: Oh, it's ancient. Apparently one of the first Sanctuaries in Skyrim. It hasn't been used by the Brotherhood in close to a hundred years.
traduit: 哦，那个圣所有年头了。是天际的第一座圣所。兄弟会已经有将近一百年没有用过那里了。

original: If you say Cicero has gone there, it stands to reason that he's familiar with the place. That means you'll be fighting him on his own ground.
traduit: 你既然说西塞罗去过那里，他肯定对那里很熟悉。所以你是要在他的地盘上和他斗了。

original: Tread carefully.
traduit: 谨慎行事。

original: What do we know about the Dawnstar Sanctuary?
traduit: 你对晨星圣所有什么了解？

original: Look, the Dark Brotherhood is a family. This Sanctuary is a family. And, we've always welcomed those... shunned by society.
traduit: 黑暗兄弟会是一个家庭。这个圣所就是家。而且，我们也一直欢迎……被社会抛弃的人士。

original: Werewolves, wizards, eternal ten year-old vampires... what does it matter? In truth, I've rarely met a lunatic I haven't liked.
traduit: 狼人、巫师、永远十岁的吸血鬼……但有什么关系？事实上，我没遇上过几个让我讨厌的疯子。

original: Cicero's problem isn't his madness. It's an adherence to an ancient, outmoded way of life. The Night Mother's ways... simply are not our ways.
traduit: 西塞罗的问题不在于疯狂。而是对古老过时道路的坚持。也就是夜母的道路……但这不是我们的活法。

original: He just couldn't accept that. And now he'll have to pay the price.
traduit: 既然他无法接受，那就必须付出代价。

original: Isn't there any way to work this out?
traduit: 就没有其他解决办法了吗？

original: Reporting in.
traduit: 报告。

original: Speak with Ulfric, he's expecting word from Whiterun.
traduit: 去跟乌弗瑞克谈谈。他在等白漫城的消息。

original: The Stormcloaks are here. In force. Get down to the front line. This is it. We must hold the city. Move it!
traduit: 风暴斗篷大军压境。快下前线去。就现在。我们必须守住城市。快去！

original: We're taking the city. Meet the soldiers gathering for the attack. Move it!
traduit: 我们要攻占这座城市。去找准备进攻的士兵们会合。快去！

original: We're attacking Riften. Meet the soldiers gathering for the attack. Move it!
traduit: 我们要攻占裂谷城。去找准备进攻的士兵们会合。快去！

original: We're mounting our final attack on Windhelm. You're needed on the front line. Get a move on soldier!
traduit: 我们要对风舵城发动总攻了。前线需要你。快点吧，士兵！

original: We're taking the capital. Meet the soldiers gathering for the attack. Move it!
traduit: 我们要攻占首府了。去找准备进攻的士兵会合。快去！

original: We're taking Dawnstar. Get down there and join the rest of the men gathering for the attack. Now soldier!
traduit: 我们要占领晨星城了。去找其他准备进攻的将士会合。现在就去，士兵！

original: We're taking Winterhold. Get over there and join the rest of the men gathering for the attack. Now soldier!
traduit: 我们要占领冬堡了。去找其他准备进攻的将士会合。现在就去，士兵！

original: We're ready to launch our attack on Solitude. But the Emperor's cousin is getting married! We can't risk attacking now. So we'll bide our time.
traduit: 我们已经准备好向独孤城进军了。可皇帝的表妹就要结婚了！我们不能贸然进攻。等待时机吧。

original: We're ready to launch our attack on Solitude. But the Emperor's visiting! We can't risk attacking now. So we'll bide our time.
traduit: 我们已经准备好向独孤城进军了。可皇帝来了！我们不能贸然进攻。等待时机吧。

original: We're taking the city. Meet the brothers gathering for the attack. Fight well or die well. Talos be with you.
traduit: 我们要攻城了。去找其他准备进攻的兄弟们会合。不成功就成仁。愿塔洛斯与你同在。

original: We're taking Whiterun. Meet the brothers gathering for the attack. Fight well or die well. Talos be with you.
traduit: 我们要占领白漫城。去找其他准备进攻的兄弟们会合。不成功就成仁。愿塔洛斯与你同在。

original: We're mounting our attack on Markarth. Get over there and join the brothers gathering for the attack. This is it now! Talos be with you.
traduit: 我们正要进攻马卡斯城。去找其他准备进攻的兄弟们会合。是时候了！愿塔洛斯与你同在。

original: We're mounting our final attack on Solitude. Get over there and join the rest of the army. They'll be launching the attack soon. Talos be with you!
traduit: 我们正要对独孤城发起总攻。去那边加入攻击部队。他们很快就要进军了。塔洛斯与你同在！

original: We're taking the capital. Meet the brothers gathering for the attack. Fight well or die well. Talos be with you.
traduit: 我们要占领首府了。去找其他准备进攻的兄弟们会合。不成功就成仁。愿塔洛斯与你同在。

original: We're taking Falkreath. Get over there with the others. Fight well or die well.
traduit: 我们要占领佛克瑞斯了。和其他人一起过去吧。不成功就成仁。愿塔洛斯与你同在。

original: We're liberating Morthal. Join the brothers gathering for the attack. Talos be with you.
traduit: 我们要解放莫萨尔城了。加入进攻的兄弟们。塔洛斯与你同在。

original: The Imperials are here. All lined up pretty-like in their shiny armor. We'll put a few dents in those bastards before we give up the city. Move it!
traduit: 帝国军来了。穿得闪闪发亮排排站好了。在放弃这座城之前得先把他们的盔甲打出几个瘪子。快去！

original: Did you notice anything strange before she left?
traduit: 她走之前有什么异样吗？

original: She began to spend a lot of time with Alva. Yet just a week before, she despised her.
traduit: 她开始经常和阿尔瓦在一起。然而就在一周前，她还很鄙视她。

original: In fact, the night she disappeared, she was supposed to meet Alva.
traduit: 其实，她失踪那晚，本来是要去见阿尔瓦的。

original: Alva told me later that she never showed up. I never got to tell her good bye.
traduit: 阿尔瓦后来告诉我，她没有去。我都没来得及跟她告别。

original: What can you tell me about your wife?
traduit: 你能跟我说说你妻子的情况吗？

original: Laelette? I thought she left to join the Stormcloaks. Ah! My poor Laelette!
traduit: 拉莱特？我以为她是去加入风暴斗篷了。啊！我可怜的拉莱特！

original: I thought Laelette left to join the war. I hadn't heard from her since she left.
traduit: 我以为拉莱特是去参战了。自从她离开，我就没收到她的来信。

original: Tell me again about your wife?
traduit: 再跟我说说你妻子好吗？

original: What can you tell me about Laelette?
traduit: 关于拉莱特你能告诉我些什么？

original: Now there's a mystery.
traduit: 现在是个谜。

original: She ran away when the war started. Her husband, Thonnir, was devastated. No note or nothin'.
traduit: 战争一开始她就跑了。她丈夫索尼尔十分悲痛。音信全无啊。

original: I'm pretty sure she up and joined the Stormcloaks.
traduit: 我很肯定她是加入风暴斗篷了。

original: You found me! Laelette was trying to find me too, but I'm glad you found me first.
traduit: 你找到我了！拉莱特也想找到我，但很高兴你领先了。

original: Laelette was told to burn mommy and me, but she didn't want to.
traduit: 有人让拉莱特来烧死我和妈妈，但她不想。

original: She wanted to play with me forever and ever.
traduit: 她想永远和我一起玩。

original: She kissed me on the neck, and I got so cold that the fire didn't even hurt.
traduit: 她亲了我的脖子，我冷得连被火烧都不疼了。

original: Laelette thought she could take me and keep me, but she can't. I'm all burned up.
traduit: 拉莱特以为能带我走，但她做不到。我全身都烧焦了。

original: I'm tired. I'm going to sleep for a while now.
traduit: 我太累了。我要先睡一会儿。

original: Then pay up and I'll forget about it.
traduit: 那就交钱，我权当什么都没发生。

original: Very well. Here. Take this back to Brynjolf and tell him he'll have no more trouble from me.
traduit: 很好。给。把这个交给布林乔夫，告诉他我不会再给他找麻烦了。

original: My wife died. Things won't be the same without her.
traduit: 我妻子去世了。失去她，一切都不一样了。

original: My husband died. Things won't be the same without him.
traduit: 我丈夫去世了。失去他，一切都不一样了。

original: My father died. Things won't be the same without him.
traduit: 我父亲去世了。失去他，一切都不一样了。

original: My mother died. Things won't be the same without her.
traduit: 我母亲去世了。失去她，一切都不一样了。

original: My daughter died. Things won't be the same without her.
traduit: 我女儿去世了。失去她，一切都不一样了。

original: My son died. Things won't be the same without him.
traduit: 我儿子去世了。失去他，一切都不一样了。

original: My sister died. Things won't be the same without her.
traduit: 我姐妹去世了。失去她，一切都不一样了。

original: My brother died. Things won't be the same without him.
traduit: 我兄弟去世了。失去他，一切都不一样了。

original: My aunt died. Things won't be the same without her.
traduit: 我阿姨去世了。失去她，一切都不一样了。

original: My uncle died. Things won't be the same without him.
traduit: 我叔叔去世了。失去他，一切都不一样了。

original: My niece died. Things won't be the same without her.
traduit: 我侄女去世了。失去她，一切都不一样了。

original: My nephew died. Things won't be the same without him.
traduit: 我侄子去世了。失去他，一切都不一样了。

original: My cousin died. Things won't be the same without her.
traduit: 我表亲去世了。失去她，一切都不一样了。

original: My cousin died. Things won't be the same without him.
traduit: 我表亲去世了。失去他，一切都不一样了。

original: My kinsman died. Things won't be the same without him.
traduit: 我的族人去世了。失去他，一切都不一样了。

original: My kinswoman died. Things won't be the same without her.
traduit: 我的族人去世了。失去她，一切都不一样了。

original: My friend died. Things won't be the same without her.
traduit: 我朋友去世了。失去她，一切都不一样了。

original: My friend died. Things won't be the same without him.
traduit: 我朋友去世了。失去他，一切都不一样了。

original: My girlfriend died. Things won't be the same without her.
traduit: 我女友去世了。失去她，一切都不一样了。

original: My boyfriend died. Things won't be the same without him.
traduit: 我男友去世了。失去他，一切都不一样了。

original: Are you mad? I could have died!
traduit: 你疯了吗？我差点就死了！

original: I thought I was clear regarding the dangers that awaited you within the Dreamstride.
traduit: 我以为我已经充分提醒过你梦中漫步的危险了。

original: However, this hardly matters any longer as you appear to have exited unscathed.
traduit: 不过你毫发无损地出来了，也就不重要了。

original: It served a purpose.
traduit: 目的达到了。

original: After what you just experienced, you are not amazed? I am at a loss for words.
traduit: 经历这些你不惊讶吗？我是不知道说什么好了。

original: It was remarkable... As if I were really there.
traduit: 太神奇了……仿佛身临其境。

original: How I envy you. I can only imagine the excitement of seeing history through the eyes of another!
traduit: 真羡慕你。我只能想象用别人视角看历史的兴奋感。

original: Sadly, I am resigned to just reading of its wonders through my research of the Skull.
traduit: 可惜的是，我只能通过对头骨的研究来发现它的奥妙。

original: It... it worked. Mara be praised!
traduit: 成……成功了。感谢玛拉！

original: You vanished after drinking the Torpor and materialized on the other side. I have never seen anything quite like it.
traduit: 你喝了之后就消失到另一边去了。我从没见过这种现象。

original: So, should I drop this statue down a well?
traduit: 这么说，我应该把这个雕像扔井里吗？

original: Not Lady Dibella? No, please! I can't lose her!
traduit: 不会是迪贝拉夫人吧？不，不要！我不能失去她！

original: I get the message. Here, take your gold. I hope you choke on it!
traduit: 我明白了。来，拿上钱。别噎死了！

original: You want me to break anything else?
traduit: 你还想让我打碎别的东西吗？

original: All right! I get it. I'll pay on time from now on. Just don't smash anything else.
traduit: 好吧！我明白了。从现在起我会按时付钱的。别再打碎任何东西了。

original: Here, take your gold and leave me in peace.
traduit: 来，拿着你的钱，别再打扰我了。

original: What do you know about Shouts?
traduit: 你知道龙吼吗？

original: In the old tales, Nord heroes would use the power of their Voice to Shout down the gates of cities and strike down their enemies.
traduit: 在古老传说中，诺德英雄们会用吼声之力打破城门、击败敌军。

original: But only the Greybeards study the Way of the Voice any more. If you can Shout... you need to talk to them.
traduit: 但如今只有灰胡子还在研习吼声之道。如果你能使用龙吼……那就该去和他们谈谈。

original: Old Nord folk tales always talk about Shouting their enemies to pieces. I always thought it was just a myth.
traduit: 在古诺德故事里人们总说要把敌人喊成碎片。我一直以为这只是神话。

original: If you think you might be able to do that kind of thing, the Legion could certainly use your help.
traduit: 如果你自认为可以做到，那军团当然需要你的帮助。

original: Go talk to the Greybeards, see what they can tell you.
traduit: 去和灰胡子谈谈，看看他们怎么说。

original: Well, I only know what I've heard in the old tales. Shouting is an ancient form of magic - the use of one's voice to project their power.
traduit: 好吧，我只知道在那些老故事里听过的。龙吼是一种古老的魔法形式，用声音去传出他们的力量。

original: If you can Shout, you need to go see the Greybeards. They'll know what to do.
traduit: 如果你会的话，你应该见见灰胡子。他们知道该如何做。

original: I know more than most. I trained with the Greybeards at High Hrothgar when I was a boy.
traduit: 我知道的比大多数人都要多。我年轻时曾经在霍斯加修道院和灰胡子们一起训练。

original: The Way of the Voice is an ancient, spiritual form of magic in which you project your vital essence into a "thu'um" or Shout.
traduit: 吼声之道是一种古老、精神性的魔法形式，将你的精华以“吐'目”或龙吼的形式投射出去。

original: Most people would need to train for years before they could even attempt a single Shout.
traduit: 大多数人都需要训练多年才能尝试一种简单的龙吼。

original: The Dragonborn is different - you have an inborn ability to Shout, the same way dragons are said to.
traduit: 但龙裔则不同，你天生具备像龙族一样的龙吼才能。

original: Who are the Greybeards?
traduit: 灰胡子是谁？

original: They live in seclusion on the slopes of the Throat of the World, the great mountain of Skyrim.
traduit: 他们居住在天际最高山世界之喉的山坡上。

original: They're masters of the Way of the Voice. If you really are Dragonborn, they're the ones who can teach you how to use your power.
traduit: 他们是吼声之道的大师。如果你真是龙裔，他们能教导你如何使用自己的力量。

original: Near as I can tell, a bunch of ancient Nord hermits who live on top of a mountain.
traduit: 据我所知，他们是一群住在高山之上的诺德隐士。

original: Never heard of them talking to anybody before. If they really do want to talk to you, you'd better go find out what they want. You never know.
traduit: 从没听说他们和谁讲过话。如果他们真的和你说话，那你最好弄清他们的意图，毕竟，世事难料啊。

original: They're the Masters of the Way of the Voice - of Shouting. They live up on top of the Throat of the World.
traduit: 他们是精通龙吼的吼声之道大师。住在世界之喉的山顶。

original: If you're really Dragonborn, they'll want to talk to you. In the old stories, they always summon the Dragonborn for training.
traduit: 如果你真是龙裔，他们会和你谈谈的。在古老传说中，他们经常召龙裔过去训练。

original: Ulfric can tell you more than most anyone. He was studying to be a Greybeard himself, back before the Great War.
traduit: 乌弗瑞克可以告诉你更多，浩大战争前，他就在学习如何成为灰胡子。

original: What's it mean to be Dragonborn?
traduit: 成为龙裔的意义是什么？

original: Well, in the old tales, the Dragonborn heroes would use the power of their Voice to defeat the enemies of Skyrim.
traduit: 嗯，在古老传说中，龙裔英雄们会利用他们的吼声之力去打败天际的敌人。

original: Wulfharth was Dragonborn. Talos, too - the founder of the Empire, back in the good old days.
traduit: 武夫哈斯是龙裔。还有建立帝国，带领人民重回美好时代的塔洛斯。

original: In the very oldest tales, back from when there still were dragons in Skyrim, the Dragonborn would slay dragons and steal their power.
traduit: 在最古老的传说里，从天际还有龙存在的时候起，龙裔就可以杀死巨龙并夺取它们的力量。

original: It means you have the Dragon Blood - you have an inborn ability to use your Voice the way dragons do.
traduit: 这意味着你拥有龙之血脉，你天生就能使用像龙一样的吼声。

original: The old tales tell of Dragonborn heroes who slew dragons and took their power.
traduit: 古老传说讲述了龙裔英雄们杀死巨龙掠夺力量的事。

original: It seems those tales are true.
traduit: 看来故事是真的。

original: With the dragons returning, and now a Dragonborn appearing... maybe the Greybeards know what it all means.
traduit: 龙族回归，现在又出了一位龙裔……或许灰胡子知道这意味着什么。

original: It means you can kill dragons and steal their power - even speak with a dragon's voice, they say.
traduit: 这意味着你可以杀死巨龙并夺取他们的力量，甚至用龙的吼声来呼喊。

original: There hasn't been a Dragonborn seen in the land for centuries. Not since Talos himself walked the 7,000 Steps to High Hrothgar.
traduit: 自塔洛斯攀登霍斯加修道院前的七千级台阶以来，这片土地已经好几个世纪没有出现过龙裔了。

original: I don't know much. Only the old tales about the ancient heroes who would use the Voice to defeat the enemies of Skyrim.
traduit: 我知道的不太多。只知道古老的传说中古代英雄会用吼声打败天际的敌人。

original: They say the Emperors used to be Dragonborn, but that all ended when Martin died during the Oblivion Crisis.
traduit: 他们说皇帝曾经都是龙裔，直到马丁在湮灭危机中死去。

original: The Greybeards can tell you much more than I can. They're the masters of the Way of the Voice and taught Tiber Septim himself.
traduit: 灰胡子能说的远比我多。他们是吼声之道的大师，还曾经教导过泰伯·塞普汀。

original: The only thing I remember is the old story of Tiber Septim being called Dragonborn by the Nords, before they switched sides and joined the Empire.
traduit: 我只记得一个老故事，泰伯·塞普汀被诺德人叫做龙裔，直到后来他们加入了帝国一方。

original: No doubt those Greybeards up at High Hrothgar will talk your ear off about it.
traduit: 不用说，霍斯加修道院的灰胡子肯定会把这事儿和你唠叨个没完。

original: What do you know about Haldyn?
traduit: 你对哈尔丁有什么了解？

original: We used to think the pirates had an army of battlemages at their side.
traduit: 我们曾以为海盗里有一支战斗法师队伍。

original: As it turns out, it was just one. Haldyn. I've since learned more about him.
traduit: 事实证明，只有一个人。哈尔丁。后来我详细调查过他。

original: The most dangerous sort of man -- quick to anger, but patient in exacting vengeance.
traduit: 他是最危险的那种人，暴躁易怒，但又耐得下心伺机报复。

original: He also has a fearsome control of Destruction magic.
traduit: 他还精于可怕的毁灭魔法。

original: I wish you the best of luck.
traduit: 希望你好运吧。

original: Do you have any proof of that?
traduit: 你有证据吗？

original: Not yet, no. But perhaps an intrepid person such as yourself could help with that.
traduit: 还没有。但也许你这样的勇士能帮上忙。

original: They have a dark elf who oversees their operations. Suvaris Atheron.
traduit: 他们有个监工的暗精灵。苏瓦利斯·奥瑟伦。

original: She's meticulous to a fault, and keeps a logbook with every transaction she makes.
traduit: 她生性严谨。每笔交易都有日记记录。

original: If it were to somehow end up in my hands, I wouldn't argue.
traduit: 如果能落在我的手里，也就确凿了。

original: Who are the Shatter-Shields?
traduit: 碎盾是什么人？

original: A very powerful family in Windhelm.
traduit: 风舵城的一个强大家族。

original: They run a private shipping operation, and would love to have the docks to themselves.
traduit: 他们经营着一家私人航运，希望能拥有自己的码头。

original: Wouldn't surprise me if they were in league with the pirates, somehow.
traduit: 如果是他们和海盗勾结，我是不会惊讶的。

original: I know this place looks horrible -- please don't hold it against the Company.
traduit: 我知道这地方看起来很糟，但请不要因此厌恶公司。

original: MS10Hellos
traduit: MS10Hellos

original: Please excuse the mess.
traduit: 这里很乱，请见谅。

original: If you get me the logbook, I'll have proof of Shatter-Shield's treachery.
traduit: 如果你能把日记找来，我就能掌握碎盾氏族背叛的证据了。

original: Let me know when you've learned more about the pirates.
traduit: 等你找到海盗的情报就来告诉我。

original: She's probably the one you ought to talk to.
traduit: 你应该和她谈谈。

original: Give those pirates what for!
traduit: 给那些海盗点颜色瞧瞧！

original: We're so grateful for your help.
traduit: 非常感谢你的帮助。

original: What're you looking at?
traduit: 你在看什么？

original: I think they may have met after all.
traduit: 我想她们还是见面了。

original: You think Alva...but that means...
traduit: 你是说阿尔瓦……但这就是说……

original: Ye gods! You think Alva is a vampire?
traduit: 神啊！你说阿尔瓦是吸血鬼？

original: Azura has seen your coming, traveler. It was not curiosity, but fate, that has led you here.
traduit: 阿祖拉已经看到了你的到来，旅行者。引领你来此的不是好奇心，而是命运。

original: You're the one who conspired with the Forsworn against Markarth! You're coming with me, murderer!
traduit: 是你和弃誓者密谋反抗马卡斯！你跟我们走吧，杀人犯！

original: There's no mistake. You're a wanted man... and it's time to pay for your crimes.
traduit: 没什么错。你是个通缉犯……是时候为你的罪行付出代价了。

original: There's no mistake. You're a wanted woman... and it's time to pay for your crimes.
traduit: 没什么错。你是个通缉犯……是时候为你的罪行付出代价了。

original: The only mistake was you showing your face. You've committed crimes against Skyrim and her people, and it's time to face the Jarl's justice.
traduit: 唯一的错就是你露脸了。你对天际和她的人民犯下了罪行，是时候接受领主的审判了。

original: The Arch-Mage asked me to see you about class.
traduit: 大法师让我来和你谈谈课的事。

original: Yes, from what I've heard I expect Tolfdir will be occupied for some time. Hmm, that is a problem, isn't it?
traduit: 啊，我听说托夫迪尔最近没有时间。嗯，这是个问题，对吧？

original: I suppose someone else will need to look after the Apprentices for now.
traduit: 看来现在需要找别人照顾学徒们了。

original: CWSharedInfoStack
traduit: CWSharedInfoStack

original: Good. You've got real fire in you. I like that... Talos guide you.
traduit: 很好。我就喜欢你这样充满激情的……塔洛斯指引你。

original: I knew I could count on you.
traduit: 我就知道你靠得住。

original: Good. Don't die out there.
traduit: 好。别死在那儿啊。

original: We all have faith in you.
traduit: 我们对你有信心。

original: Go with the Nine.
traduit: 九圣灵与你同行。

original: Talos keep you.
traduit: 塔洛斯保佑你。

original: Don't screw this up.
traduit: 别搞砸了。

original: Good. And remember - keep the gods, and they'll keep you.
traduit: 好。记住，心念众神，众神也会保护你。

original: Excellent. Put the fear of the Nine into those motherless dogs.
traduit: 非常好。把九圣灵的恐惧降临给那些死妈狗。

original: That's what I wanted to hear. Good luck out there.
traduit: 我就想听这个。祝你好运。

original: I knew I could count on you, soldier.
traduit: 我就知道你靠得住，士兵。

original: We do this for the good of Skyrim and her people. Never forget that.
traduit: 永远不要忘记，我们是为了天际和天际人民的利益。

original: Make me proud.
traduit: 让我为你骄傲吧。

original: May the gods keep you.
traduit: 愿众神保佑你。

original: Good. Make it it happen, soldier.
traduit: 好。把事情办好吧，士兵。

original: Show the rebels the futility of their cause.
traduit: 让叛军明白明白他们的事业是徒劳的。

original: As long as the rebels are willing to die fighting the Empire, we must be willing to oblige them.
traduit: 既然叛军想和帝国作战至死，那咱们得满足他们。

original: Peace may yet return to Skyrim. But until then, we fight.
traduit: 天际也许会重归和平，但在这之前，我们还要奋战。

original: Don't take too long figuring it out. I've got a war to run here.
traduit: 别想太多了。还有仗要打呢。

original: I see. Well, make it quick, or do you have better things to do than fight for the people of Skyrim?
traduit: 明白了。但还是快一点。你难道还有比为天际人民而战更好的事要做？

original: Well, soldier? Are you up to the task?
traduit: 怎么样，士兵？能胜任吗？

original: What do you say? Can you do this?
traduit: 怎么样？能做到吗？

original: This won't be easy, but that's why I'm sending you. Think you can handle it?
traduit: 这事儿不容易，所以我要派你过去。你能解决吗？

original: This won't be easy. But that's why I'm sending you. You got the grit to get this done?
traduit: 这事儿不容易，所以我要派你过去。怎么样，有勇气吗？

original: You gave those mongrels a real whipping, eh? Good work. We'll be sure to send a garrison to reinforce the area and keep the peace.
traduit: 你狠狠教训了那群杂种？干得好。我们得派驻军增援那个区域，维持和平。

original: Excellent! We've hit 'em where it hurts. Repairs will be needed when we take over, but at least the Stormcloaks won't benefit in the meantime.
traduit: 太好了！我们击中了他们的要害。我们接管后还需要维护，但至少这段时间里风暴斗篷拿不到好处了。

original: We hit 'em where it hurts. As soon as we can, we'll take over - make the needed repairs. In the meantime, the people no longer slave for the Empire.
traduit: 我们击中了他们的要害。我们得尽快接管，进行必要的维修。人民不会再受帝国的奴役了。

original: Well done, indeed. This will be of great service. Understanding the enemy's position makes us all the more equipped to usurp it.
traduit: 干得好。这对我们很有帮助。了解敌人的位置有助于在夺取它时准备更充分。

original: And with the rebels thinking us occupied elsewhere for the time being, we'll be able to take them by surprise.
traduit: 既然叛军觉得我们正在忙活其他地方。我们就能出其不意打击他们。

original: Good work. Knowing more about the enemy's position makes it that much easier to take it from him.
traduit: 干得好。加深对敌军部署的了解，把它夺回来也就更容易了。

original: And of course, they'll be caught off guard thinking we're off doing something altogether different.
traduit: 当然，他们还以为我们在忙别的事，到时候肯定会猝不及防。

original: Your objective is Fort Sungard.
traduit: 你的目标是森加德堡。

original: You're going to Fort Sungard.
traduit: 你得去森加德堡。

original: Your objective is Fort Snowhawk.
traduit: 你的目标是雪鹰堡。

original: You're going to Fort Snowhawk.
traduit: 你得去雪鹰堡。

original: Your objective is Fort Greymoor.
traduit: 你的目标是灰色荒原堡。

original: You're going to Fort Greymoor.
traduit: 你得去灰色荒原堡。

original: Your objective is Fort Neugrad.
traduit: 你的目标是纽格拉德堡。

original: You're going to Fort Neugrad.
traduit: 你得去纽格拉德堡。

original: Your objective is Fort Dunstad.
traduit: 你的目标是丹斯塔德堡。

original: You're going to Fort Dunstad.
traduit: 你得去丹斯塔德堡。

original: Your objective is Fort Kastav.
traduit: 你的目标是卡斯塔夫堡。

original: You're going to Fort Kastav.
traduit: 你得去卡斯塔夫堡。

original: Your objective is Fort Greenwall.
traduit: 你的目标是青垣堡。

original: You're going to Fort Greenwall.
traduit: 你得去青垣堡。

original: Your objective is the enemy held fort.
traduit: 你的目标是敌军控制的城堡。

original: You're going to the fort.
traduit: 你得到要塞去。

original: The rebels are keeping some of our men prisoner there. I aim to turn that into an advantage.
traduit: 叛军把我们的人囚在那里，我要想办法把这变成优势。

original: I've sent men to scout out the area. You are to meet them, find a way to slip in, free our men, and take over the fort.
traduit: 我已经派人侦察过那片区域了。你过去找他们，想办法溜进去把我们的人放了，占领整个要塞。

original: They won't be expecting an attack from the inside.
traduit: 他们不会料到攻击从内部而来。

original: They have some of our boys locked up there. But with a little luck, we can turn that to our advantage.
traduit: 他们把我们的人关在那里。只要一点运气加成，我们就能把劣势变为优势。

original: I've sent some men to scout out the area. Meet them, see if you can't find a way to slip in, free our men, and take over the fort.
traduit: 我已经派人去侦察那个地区了。去和他们会合，看看能不能溜进去把人救出来，占领整个要塞。

original: They'll never suspect an attack from the inside.
traduit: 他们不会想到攻击从内部而来的。

original: Go in quiet, break our man out, then get out of there. Don't risk combat if you can avoid it. If you can't, then give 'em hell.
traduit: 悄悄进去，把人救出来，然后离开那儿。尽量避免冒险战斗。实在不行，就把他们干掉。

original: Go quiet, break him out, then run. This isn't a suicide mission. Don't risk combat if you can avoid it. If you can't, then give 'em hell.
traduit: 保持安静，把人救出来，然后赶紧跑。这不是自杀行动。尽量避免冒险战斗。实在不行，再把他们干掉。

original: You made it! I'm impressed. It was a gamble, but turned out well.
traduit: 你成功了！很厉害么。虽然是在赌博，但结果很好。

original: You're alive! It was a gamble - but as Talos keeps us, we keep each other - I wasn't going to just let them rot in there.
traduit: 你还活着！这是一场赌博，不过塔洛斯保佑我们，我们也守护彼此。我不会让他们在那里腐烂的。

original: You're headed to Markarth.
traduit: 你得去马卡斯。

original: Get over to Markarth.
traduit: 到马卡斯去。

original: You're headed to Morthal.
traduit: 你得去莫萨尔。

original: Get over to Morthal.
traduit: 到莫萨尔去。

original: You're headed to Whiterun.
traduit: 你得去白漫。

original: Get over to Whiterun.
traduit: 到白漫去。

original: You're headed to Falkreath.
traduit: 你得去佛克瑞斯。

original: Get over to Falkreath.
traduit: 到佛克瑞斯去。

original: You're headed to Dawnstar.
traduit: 你得去晨星。

original: Get over to Dawnstar.
traduit: 到晨星去。

original: You're headed to Winterhold.
traduit: 你得去冬堡。

original: Get over to Winterhold.
traduit: 到冬堡去。

original: You're going to Riften.
traduit: 你得去裂谷。

original: Get over to Riften.
traduit: 到裂谷去。

original: You're headed to the capital.
traduit: 你得到首府去。

original: Get over to the capital.
traduit: 到首府去。

original: Damn Stormcloak rebels.
traduit: 该死的风暴斗篷叛军。

original: What the rebels like to forget, is that the Empire's what's keeping the Dominion out of Skyrim.
traduit: 叛军忘了，是帝国在阻止先祖神洲侵入天际。

original: Can't wait to kill another of Ulfric's boys.
traduit: 等不及再杀一个乌弗瑞克的小崽子了。

original: Damn faithless Imperials.
traduit: 背信弃义的帝国军。

original: Next Imperial I see is dead.
traduit: 下次再碰上帝国兵，我一定让他死。

original: We'll show those faithless dogs who this land belongs to.
traduit: 我们要教训这群没信仰的狗东西，告诉他们这片土地属于谁。

original: Stay sharp.
traduit: 注意四周。

original: Keep an eye out for trouble. It's only a matter of time.
traduit: 注意四周。情况发生只是时间问题。

original: Talos guide you.
traduit: 塔洛斯保佑你。

original: The waiting... the insufferable waiting.
traduit: 等啊等……太难受了。

original: Can't wait to gut one of those rebels.
traduit: 等不及去杀叛军了。

original: Soon. I can almost taste it.
traduit: 快了。我已经要闻到了。

original: Well? Where the hell are those damned Stormcloaks? Let's get this over with already.
traduit: 那群该死的风暴斗篷跑哪去了？我们得赶快把事情解决掉。

original: If those rebels think they can best us, they have another think coming.
traduit: 如果那些叛军觉得能打败我们，那就大错特错了。

original: By the Nine, I hate the waiting. The goddamned waiting.
traduit: 九圣灵啊，我讨厌这么等下去了。

original: Can't wait to kill another Imperial.
traduit: 忍不住想再杀个帝国兵。

original: Gah. Let's do this already. I'm itching to kill something.
traduit: 哈。赶紧把这事儿了结吧。我真想杀点什么了。

original: What's taking them so long? Did they get lost? Let's get this over with already.
traduit: 他们怎么这么慢？迷路了？我都等不及干一架了。

original: Can't wait to see the look on their faces when they find us here waiting to spill their blood.
traduit: 真想看看他们发现我们在这里等着杀他们时的表情。

original: Auxiliary.
traduit: 辅助兵。

original: Quaestor.
traduit: 财务官。

original: Praefect.
traduit: 监察官。

original: Tribune.
traduit: 保民官。

original: Legate!
traduit: 副官！

original: Not sure you belong here, citizen.
traduit: 你不该在这儿，公民。

original: Hey, Unblooded.
traduit: 嘿，新人。

original: If it isn't Ice-Veins. Hi there.
traduit: 是冰之血脉啊。你好啊。

original: Bone-Breaker.
traduit: 碎骨者。

original: Snow-Hammer.
traduit: 雪锤。

original: Stormblade. It's an honor.
traduit: 风暴之刃。很荣幸见到你。

original: Think you might be in the wrong place, friend.
traduit: 朋友，你走错地方了吧。

original: The Stormcloaks will be here any minute! Hurry! Get inside and lock your doors!
traduit: 风暴斗篷随时会来！快！进去把门锁上！

original: Citizens! Go home and lock your doors!
traduit: 公民！快回家去把门锁上！

original: It's not safe out here! Return to your homes immediately!
traduit: 这里不安全！快回家！

original: The imperial butchers are on their way. Get home and lock your doors!
traduit: 帝国屠夫要来了。快回家，把门锁上！

original: What are you people doing outside? Go home. Now!
traduit: 你们在外面干什么？快回家！

original: Go home and lock your doors.
traduit: 回家，把门锁上。

original: My spies report the Jarl's Steward, Anuriel, has arrangements with the Thieves Guild that would be rather embarrassing if made public.
traduit: 我得到密探回报，说领主的总管安努瑞尔与盗贼公会有私下协议，如果公之于众会很尴尬。

original: I need you to find evidence of her corrupt activities, and use it to gain a measure of her "cooperation."
traduit: 我需要你去搜集她腐败行为的证据，以此来与她商讨“合作”。

original: Rumor has it the Jarl's Steward, Raerek, is a faithful Talos worshipper, if not a true son of Skyrim - he still supports the Empire, after all.
traduit: 传言说领主总管拉瑞克是个虔诚的塔洛斯信徒。但他毕竟还在支持帝国，算不得真正的天际之子。

original: But, if confronted with proof of his belief, you might be able to "persuade" him to aid our cause, indirectly of course.
traduit: 但如果搜集到他信仰的证据，也许就能“说服”他支持我们的事业，当然是间接地。

original: Wouldn't want to sully his reputation, would we?
traduit: 我们也不想玷污他的名声，对吧？

original: Meet the soldiers preparing for the attack. Then join them in wiping out the rebels. Once you prevail we will garrison the fort.
traduit: 去找准备好进攻的部队会合。然后和他们一起进攻叛军。一旦你们拿下要塞，我们会派军驻守。

original: Meet the brothers preparing for the attack. Then join them in wiping out the Imperials. Once you prevail we will garrison the fort.
traduit: 去找准备好进攻的弟兄们会合。然后和他们一起进攻叛军。一旦你们拿下要塞，我们会派军驻守。

original: We sure showed them, eh? Thanks for your part in all that.
traduit: 我们教训了他们一顿哈？感谢你作出的贡献。

original: Good job out there. Glad you were with us.
traduit: 干得漂亮。有你跟着我们真是太好了。

original: Thanks. Couldn't have done that without you.
traduit: 谢了。没你是办不到的。

original: If you're planning violence against me or mine, you'll regret it.
traduit: 如果你打算对我们动武，你会后悔的。

original: What do you want with us?
traduit: 你想对我们做什么？

original: Please! Have mercy... I beg you...
traduit: 拜托！可怜可怜我们……求你了……

original: Yyyyyyyaaaaaahhhhhhh!
traduit: 呀啊啊啊！

original: Wwwwwwrrrraaaaaahhhhh!
traduit: 唔啊啊啊啊！

original: Hhhhhhhaaaaaa!
traduit: 哈啊啊啊啊！

original: Hhhhhhuuuuuuaaaaaa!
traduit: 呼啊啊啊啊！

original: Yyyyrrrraaaaahhhhh!
traduit: 咦呀啊啊啊！

original: Rrrraaaaaaggghhhh!
traduit: 呃啊啊啊啊！

original: Aaaaaahhhhaaaaa!
traduit: 啊哈！

original: Hhhhhuuuuuzzzzzaaaaahhhhh!
traduit: 呼啊啊啊！

original: Rrrrraaaaa!
traduit: 呀啊啊啊啊！

original: Yyyyyeeeaaaaahhhhhh!
traduit: 耶啊啊啊啊！

original: We sure showed them!
traduit: 我们算是教训了他们一顿！

original: They'll think twice before coming back here, that's for sure!
traduit: 他们再回来前肯定会掂量掂量！

original: We did it!
traduit: 我们成功了！

original: I feel so alive!
traduit: 总算能松口气了！

original: We destroyed those Stormcloak traitors!
traduit: 我们打败了那些风暴斗篷叛徒！

original: We showed those Imperials what real Nords are made of!
traduit: 我们让那群帝国兵见识了真诺德人的本色！

original: Imperial business. Be on your way.
traduit: 正在执行帝国公务。远离。

original: This is none of your concern, citizen.
traduit: 此事与你无关，公民。

original: Move along.
traduit: 走开。

original: Citizen. I'm warning you. Your presence is interfering with Imperial business. Be gone!
traduit: 公民，我警告你。你在妨碍帝国公务。离开这里！

original: Step aside, citizen.
traduit: 站到一边去，公民。

original: Be gone!
traduit: 走开！

original: Citizen. You have been warned. You leave me no choice but to resort to violence.
traduit: 公民。我已经做出警告。你现在迫使我们诉诸暴力。

original: You leave me no choice, citizen.
traduit: 你让我别无选择，公民。

original: You have been warned.
traduit: 我已经警告过你。

original: This doesn't concern you, friend.
traduit: 此事与你无关，朋友。

original: Keep walking.
traduit: 走开吧。

original: Are you looking for a fight?
traduit: 你是找打架么？

original: Don't make me tell you again. Get out of here.
traduit: 别逼我再重复了。离开这里。

original: I warned you. You leave me no choice but violence.
traduit: 我已经警告过你。你这是逼我使用暴力。

original: Fine. Have it you way. A fight it is.
traduit: 好啊。如你所愿，跟你打一架。

original: Alright, if it's a fight you want. You've got it.
traduit: 好吧，你既然想打架就来吧。

original: Need you to deliver some false orders to the Stormcloak commander in Dawnstar.
traduit: 我需要你给晨星的风暴斗篷指挥官送些假命令。

original: Once you find the courier's route, kill him and take his place.
traduit: 一旦你找到通讯员的路线，杀了并取代他。

original: Need you to deliver some false orders to the Imperial Legate in Morthal.
traduit: 我需要你去给莫萨尔的帝国军指挥官送些假命令。

original: We understand the Nightgate and Roughwater inns are frequent stops for Stormcloak runners.
traduit: 我们了解到，风暴斗篷的人经常去夜扉旅店和激流旅店光顾。

original: Set an ambush along the road between, or camp by one of the inns.
traduit: 在路上设下埋伏，或者在旅馆边上等着。

original: Bring whatever he's carrying to me, and I'll send you with convincing misinformation back to Dawnstar.
traduit: 把他带的东西送回来，我给你一份以假乱真的错误情报送回晨星。

original: My scouts tell me the inns at Dragonbridge and Rorikstead are frequent stops for Imperial runners.
traduit: 侦察兵报告说，帝国通讯员时常经过龙桥镇和洛利克镇。

original: Set an ambush on the road between, or camp one of the inns.
traduit: 在两个镇子之间设伏或者蹲守在旅馆附近。

original: Bring me whatever he's carrying, and I'll send you to Morthal with something convincing but full of lies.
traduit: 把他带的东西送回来，我给你一份以假乱真的错误情报送回莫萨尔。

original: The Nightgate and Candlehearth inns are frequent stops for Stormcloak runners.
traduit: 风暴斗篷的通讯员常去夜扉和烛炉堂两家旅店。

original: See if you can't "convince" one of those innkeepers to help you.
traduit: 看看能不能“说服”旅店老板帮你。

original: One way or another, get me those documents.
traduit: 无论怎样，把文件拿到手。

original: But don't do anything rash if you go to Windhelm.
traduit: 但如果要是去风舵城，千万不要鲁莽。

original: The inns at Dragonbridge and Rorikstead are frequent stops for Imperial runners.
traduit: 帝国通讯员经常光顾龙桥和洛利克镇的旅店。

original: The inns at Dragonbridge and Solitude are frequent stops for Imperial runners.
traduit: 帝国的通讯员经常光顾龙桥和独孤城的旅店。

original: It just so happens, I've got some scouts along the road. Meet up with them, and together see if you can't overpower the caravan.
traduit: 我刚好派了几个侦察兵去路上。和他们会合，看看能不能截获那辆马车。

original: Well, well. Look who it is! How have you been?
traduit: 哎呀。看看这是谁来了！最近怎么样？

original: I need this to go well. This is my first real command since they promoted me after Whiterun.
traduit: 希望一切顺利。这是我在白漫城一战升职以后第一次指挥。

original: You know, some nights when I close my eyes, I see the battle stretched out before me, like I'm still there...
traduit: 知道么，有时候晚上一闭上眼睛，战斗的场面还是历历在目，仿佛置身其中。

original: Do the men you've killed haunt you? Mine do...
traduit: 你杀过的人会缠着你吗？我杀的会……

original: I'm all right, I guess. How are you?
traduit: 我想我还行。你怎么样？

original: These are dark days. But at least we know we're doing our part to make things better, eh?
traduit: 这是黑暗的时代，但我们至少在尽自己的力量让事情变得更好，对吧？

original: I guess I'm doing all right. I need this to go well. This is my first real command since they promoted me after Whiterun.
traduit: 我还不错哦。希望一切顺利。这是我在白漫城一战升职以后第一次指挥。

original: Do the men you killed haunt you? Mine do...
traduit: 你杀过的人会缠着你吗？我杀过的会……

original: I've been better. And you?
traduit: 我好多了。你呢？

original: Straight to business with you, huh?
traduit: 直接谈任务是吧？

original: Well, it just so happens I have the perfect mission for you.
traduit: 好吧。正好我有个完美的任务给你。

original: I suppose you're right... they say it gets easier...
traduit: 我想你说得对……他们说那样会更容易……

original: I'm not sure if that's a good thing...
traduit: 我不确定是不是好事……

original: But never mind all that. We've got a job to do.
traduit: 但没时间想这些了。我们还有事要办。

original: Only a beast kills without feeling.
traduit: 只有野兽才会毫无感情地杀戮。

original: That's what I keep telling myself.
traduit: 我一直这样劝自己。

original: But, never mind all that. We've got a job to do. Don't we?
traduit: 但是，不管了。我们还有工作不是吗？

original: If you hadn't killed them, they would have killed you.
traduit: 你不杀他们，他们就会杀你。

original: I remember you... you were with us at Helgen, and Whiterun. Glad to have you with us. How are you?
traduit: 我记得你……当时你和我们一起在海尔根和白漫城。很高兴你和我们在一起。你怎么样？

original: But never mind all that. What brings you out this way?
traduit: 不管了。你来这儿做什么？

original: But, never mind all that. What brings you out this way?
traduit: 但是，不管了。你来这儿干什么？

original: Hello friend.
traduit: 你好啊，朋友。

original: Glad you're here.
traduit: 你在这儿真是太好了。

original: You're still alive?
traduit: 你还活着啊？

original: Huh. I had heard you died.
traduit: 哈。我还听说你死了呢。

original: I have to admit. This is more fun that I thought it'd be.
traduit: 我得承认。这可比我想的有意思。

original: I can't remember the last time I visited home. Think I've forgotten what a proper bed looks like, let alone feels like.
traduit: 我都不记得上次回家是什么时候了。像样的床铺别说感觉，连是什么样子都忘了。

original: Who do you think's killed more Imperials? You? Or me?
traduit: 你觉得咱们谁杀的帝国兵多？你还是我？

original: Have you always been that ugly?
traduit: 你一直这么丑吗？

original: I've heard some things about Ulfric I don't like, but he's right about this war and about Skyrim's future.
traduit: 我不喜欢一些关于乌弗瑞克的言论，他对战争和天际未来的看法是正确的。

original: I don't think Galmar even knows my name. Probably because I'm not "The Dragonborn."
traduit: 我觉得加尔玛可能都不记得我叫啥。可能因为我不是“龙裔”吧。

original: Ever wonder if maybe we should a call a truce with the Imperials and join forces for just a little while take care of some of these dragons?
traduit: 你有没有想过。我们也许该和帝国休战一段时间，联合对付这些龙？

original: Who do you think killed more rebels? You? Or me?
traduit: 你觉得咱俩谁杀的叛军更多？你还是我？

original: "Dragonborn" huh? Was it your ma or your pa that was the dragon?
traduit: “龙裔”啊？你妈是龙还是你爸是龙？

original: Ever get the impression Rikke's not always sure what side she's on? I'm not doubting her loyalty. Just, she seems rather sympathetic to the rebels.
traduit: 你有没有觉得瑞姬的立场有点动摇啊？我知道她很忠诚。但她似乎很同情叛乱者。

original: I don't think Rikke even knows my name. Probably because I'm not "The Dragonborn."
traduit: 我觉得瑞姬可能都不记得我叫啥。可能因为我不是“龙裔”吧。

original: Ever wonder if maybe we should a call a truce with the Stormcloaks, join forces for just a little while, and take care of some of these dragons?
traduit: 你有没有想过。我们也许该和风暴斗篷休战一段时间，联合对付这些龙？

original: Focus on the mission.
traduit: 专注任务。

original: What? Now's not the time to chat.
traduit: 什么？现在可不是聊天的时候。

original: This should be fun.
traduit: 应该很有意思。

original: I wonder how many of us think we'll be the lucky ones and survive this?
traduit: 我想知道我们中有多少人觉得是因为运气才活下来的。

original: So, do you get that weird taste in your mouth before battle, too? What is that?
traduit: 你上战场前嘴里也会有奇怪的味道么？那是啥？

original: Pleasant weather for a war, no?
traduit: 今天天气很适合打仗吧？

original: Gah! Let's get on with it already!
traduit: 哈！我们开始吧！

original: You made it? I was sure I'd find you face down in the dirt.
traduit: 你还活着啊？我还以为你会脸朝下趴在那儿呢。

original: I'm pretty sure I killed more than you. I was counting.
traduit: 我确信自己杀的比你多。我有在数哦。

original: That was fun.
traduit: 有意思。

original: That went pretty well, all things considered.
traduit: 总的说来，结果还不错。

original: Do colors seem brighter to you? Everything seems bigger, too. Strange...
traduit: 有没有觉得周围很亮啊？所有东西都变大了。奇怪……

original: Are your ears still ringing? I hope that goes away.
traduit: 你也耳鸣吗？希望能赶紧缓过来。

original: Get over to the capital! We're mounting our final attack!
traduit: 到首府去！我们正准备发动最后的进攻！

original: Get over to Markarth. We're mounting our final attack!
traduit: 到马卡斯去！我们正准备发动最后的进攻！

original: Get over to Morthal. We're mounting our final attack!
traduit: 到莫萨尔去！我们正准备发动最后的进攻！

original: Get over to Falkreath. We're mounting our final attack!
traduit: 到佛克瑞斯去！我们正准备发动最后的进攻！

original: Get over to Whiterun. We're mounting our final attack!
traduit: 到白漫去！我们正准备发动最后的进攻！

original: Get over to Dawnstar. We're mounting our final attack!
traduit: 到晨星去！我们正准备发动最后的进攻！

original: Get over to Winterhold. We're mounting our final attack!
traduit: 到冬堡去！我们正准备发动最后的进攻！

original: Get over to Riften. We're mounting our final attack!
traduit: 到裂谷去！我们正准备发动最后的进攻！

original: Get over to Windhelm. We're mounting our final attack!
traduit: 到风舵去！我们正准备发动最后的进攻！

original: Get down to the front line.
traduit: 到前线去。

original: Get down there and join Rikke on the front line.
traduit: 和瑞姬一起去前线。

original: Get down there and join Galmar on the front line.
traduit: 和加尔玛一起去前线。

original: We're not quite ready to muster the final attack.
traduit: 我们还没做好发动总攻的准备。

original: I need you to create some chaos in the hold so I can maneuver men into position without drawing too much attention.
traduit: 我需要你在领地内制造一些混乱，这样就能在不引起注意的情况下指挥人员就位了。

original: I need you to create some chaos in the hold.
traduit: 我需要你在领内制造一些混乱。

original: Search out enemy soldiers in the wilderness, or guarding towns and settlements, and kill them.
traduit: 在野外找找敌军，或者城镇、村落的守军，杀了他们。

original: Find enemy controlled resources like sawmills, flour-mills, and smelters, and sabotage them.
traduit: 找找敌人控制的资源点，木材厂、磨坊、冶炼厂都行，破坏掉。

original: And take out resources like sawmills, flour-mills, and smelters, with a little sabotage.
traduit: 破坏木材厂、磨坊、冶炼厂一类的资源。

original: And sabotage enemy controlled resources.
traduit: 破坏敌人控制的资源点。

original: If you run across any enemy couriers, take them down, and bring me whatever they're carrying.
traduit: 如果遇到敌人的通讯员，干掉他们，然后把东西带回来。

original: Good work!
traduit: 干得好！

original: Good job!
traduit: 干得好！

original: Excellent. These should come in handy.
traduit: 很好。这些早晚会派上用场。

original: I would hate to think what would happen if this fell into enemy hands.
traduit: 真不敢想象这些东西落入敌手会怎样。

original: Here. Take this for your trouble.
traduit: 来，收下这个算是酬劳了。

original: So why'd you join up with the Legion?
traduit: 你为什么加入军团？

original: How'd you end up here?
traduit: 你怎么到这里的？

original: What are your thoughts on all this?
traduit: 你对这些有什么看法？

original: My father was a Legionnaire, and his before him. I guess I never considered doing anything else.
traduit: 我父亲和祖父都是军团兵。我从没想过做别的营生。

original: So how'd you end up here?
traduit: 那你怎么到这里来的？

original: I signed on 'cause I couldn't watch the Stormcloaks tearing everything apart and not do something. But, most of my family disagrees with my choice.
traduit: 因为我不能坐视风暴斗篷把一切都毁了。不过，我很多家人都不同意我的选择。

original: I know it's what everyone says, "To go to new places and see the world." But it's true in my case... I never bargained on seeing more than I liked.
traduit: 很多人都说“去新的地方见识见识世界”。对于我来说真是这样……我真的见识到了很多。

original: So, why'd you join the Stormcloaks?
traduit: 那你为啥加入风暴斗篷？

original: So what's your story?
traduit: 你有什么经历？

original: My cousin disappeared one night. Some say the Thalmor grabbed him. It wasn't long before I found myself under Ulfric's banner.
traduit: 有天夜里，我表兄失踪了。有人说梭默把他抓走了。没多久我就成了乌弗瑞克的部下。

original: How'd you end up here fighting for Ulfric?
traduit: 你为什么会在这里为乌弗瑞克而战？

original: I don't want some snotty elf telling me what gods I can and can't worship.
traduit: 我不想让臭精灵告诉我该信什么神，不该信什么神。

original: I'm a true Nord. Simple as that.
traduit: 我是真正的诺德人。就这么简单。

original: Leave that dog alone!
traduit: 别碰那条狗！

original: Hey, that's a valuable animal!
traduit: 嘿，那家伙可值钱了！

original: That's it. Don't say I didn't warn you.
traduit: 可别说我没警告过你。

original: That's it. I'm placing you under arrest.
traduit: 没错。我要逮捕你。

original: This is your last warning. Get away from there, or else.
traduit: 最后一次警告。离开那里，否则后果自负。

original: This is your last warning. Get out, or get arrested.
traduit: 这是最后一次警告。滚出去，要么就等着被逮捕吧。

original: You're trespassing here. You'd better clear out.
traduit: 你正在进行侵入行为。最好赶紧离开。

original: You're not supposed to be here...
traduit: 你不应该在这里……

original: Can't a man have a bit of privacy? Get out of here!
traduit: 老爷们就不能有点隐私吗？滚！

original: Can't a woman get a moment to herself? Leave me!
traduit: 女士就不能有点隐私吗？离开！

original: Help! Murder!
traduit: 救命！杀人了！

original: What the...?!
Help, someone!
traduit: 救命，来人啊！

original: Murdered! In cold blood!
traduit: 杀人了！冷血动物！

original: Ysmir's beard!
traduit: 伊斯米尔的胡子！

original: By the gods, no!
traduit: 神啊，不！

original: By the gods, did that really just happen?!
traduit: 神啊，这是真的？！

original: Murder! Murder!
traduit: 杀人了！杀人了！

original: Help! Somebody, help!
traduit: 救命！来人啊，救命！

original: The Stormcloaks pay blood for blood!
traduit: 风暴斗篷以血还血！

original: You dare dishonor the Legion?
traduit: 你竟敢侮辱军团？

original: Fool! The Imperial Legion will have your blood!
traduit: 傻子！帝国军团会消灭你的！

original: Bad idea.
traduit: 这可不是好主意。

original: Help! Someone's being attacked!
traduit: 救命！有人被袭击了！

original: Help! I'm being attacked!
traduit: 救命！有人袭击我！

original: Help me, help me!
traduit: 救命，救命！

original: Last mistake.
traduit: 你最后的错误。

original: Think you can steal from me?
traduit: 你觉得你能偷得了我吗？

original: You little thief!
traduit: 你个小贼！

original: Why you...
traduit: 你怎么……

original: You're not getting anything from me!
traduit: 你别想从我这儿偷走任何东西！

original: Nice try, fat-fingers!
traduit: 想得美，黄油手！

original: You dare try and steal from me?
traduit: 你敢偷我东西？

original: Get back, thief!
traduit: 回来，小偷！

original: Filthy pickpocket!
traduit: 臭扒包的！

original: Pickpocket! We've got a pickpocket!
traduit: 扒手！有扒手！

original: You little wretch, I saw that!
traduit: 小坏蛋，我看见了！

original: Hey! Hands off!
traduit: 嘿！管好手！

original: Hey, that isn't yours!
traduit: 嘿，那不是你的！

original: I saw you steal that!
traduit: 我看见你偷东西了！

original: Why you little filcher...
traduit: 你这个小偷……

original: Get your thieving hands off that!
traduit: 把你偷东西的手管好！

original: You won't get away with that!
traduit: 你拿不走那个的！

original: You can't take that!
traduit: 你不能拿走！

original: Put that down, you mangy cat!
traduit: 放下，你个脏猫！

original: By Ysmir, a thief!
traduit: 伊斯米尔在上，有小偷！

original: You thieving little elf!
traduit: 你这个小偷精灵！

original: You dirty, filching lizard!
traduit: 你这个肮脏的蜥蜴！

original: What are you doing, s'wit?
traduit: 你在干什么，斯'威特？

original: Yamarz has fallen. It is now up to you to return the giant's hammer to Atub.
traduit: 亚马兹已死。由你把巨人之锤交给阿图布。

original: The tribe may yet survive, but only if you are willing to do what is right.
traduit: 部落能否延续，都取决于你的抉择了。

original: Yamarz has revealed himself as a coward and a schemer, and has earned the fate of all who follow that path.
traduit: 亚马兹暴露了自己的懦弱与奸诈，命中注定就是这种下场。

original: Take the giant's hammer to Atub, and tell her what has happened here.
traduit: 带着巨人之锤回去找阿图布，告诉她这里的事。

original: Excellent work. You have a true fighting spirit. Did that better than I could have.
traduit: 干得漂亮。你拥有真正的战斗精神。比我做得还要好。

original: Of course, I can't let you leave here alive. Wouldn't want anyone finding out.
traduit: 不过，我不能让你活着离开。我可不想被人发现。

original: Okay, I'll do it.
traduit: 好吧，我会的。

original: Good. I'll be waiting right here.
traduit: 好。我就在这儿等着。

original: Just stay out of my way.
traduit: 别挡着我的路。

original: No, you're supposed to do it.
traduit: 不，应该你去做。

original: Fine, then wait here. This should only take a second.
traduit: 好吧，在这儿等着。应该花不了多久。

original: I'm tired, I haven't slept well in weeks.
traduit: 我很累，已经好几周没睡好觉了。

original: You kill the giant, bring me the hammer. We go back to Largashbur, I tell everyone I did it.
traduit: 你去杀巨人，再把锤子交给我。我们一起回拉加施布尔，我告诉所有人说是我干的。

original: You keep your mouth shut, and I pay you. Handsomely.
traduit: 只要你肯保密，我会给你一大笔报酬。

original: All right, I'll go kill this giant.
traduit: 好啊，那我去杀巨人。

original: Unless, of course, you'd like to make some extra gold.
traduit: 当然，当然。谁不想多赚点呢。

original: I've decided to turn myself in.
traduit: 我决定自首。

original: We haven't forgotten your crimes, outlander.
traduit: 我没还没忘记你的罪行，外来者。

original: Submit and pay bloodprice, criminal.
traduit: 投降或是交付血价，罪犯。

original: Stop, outlander! You must pay bloodprice for your crimes.
traduit: 停下，外来人！你必须为罪行付出血价。

original: By the Code of Malacath, you must pay bloodprice for your crimes. Which will it be, blood or gold?
traduit: 根据玛拉凯斯法典，你必须为你的罪行付出血价。是用血还是金币？自己选吧。

original: Your crimes offend the Code of Malacath and we demand payment. Choose. Gold or blood.
traduit: 你的罪行违背了玛拉凯斯法典，我们要求赔偿。金币或鲜血都可。

original: There are no jails in an Orc Stronghold, criminal. You must pay in gold or blood.
traduit: 兽人要塞没有监狱，罪犯。你必须用金币或鲜血来偿还。

original: Over my dead body.
traduit: 除非是我死。

original: Today is a good day to die.
traduit: 今天是战死的好日子。

original: Fight well, and I'll make sure your corpse is not dishonored.
traduit: 好好一战吧，我会保证你的尸体不被玷污。

original: I'll pay. Don't worry.  (<CrimeGold> gold)
traduit: 我会付钱的。别着急。（<CrimeGold>金币）

original: Huh. Okay. We'll test your mettle another day.
traduit: 嗯。好吧。那我们改天再领教你的勇气。

original: Typical outlander weakling. But your gold will strengthen our clan.
traduit: 典型的外来弱者行为。但你的金币对我们氏族有用处。

original: Then your poverty is my reward. Kill or be killed!
traduit: 你的贫穷就是我的回应。是杀人还是被杀！

original: I don't have the gold right now. (<CrimeGold> gold)
traduit: 我现在没那么多钱。（<CrimeGold>金币）

original: Stop, outlander. You must pay for your crimes in blood or gold.
traduit: 停下，外来者。你必须用血或金钱来为你的罪行付出代价。

original: You've broken the Code of Malacath. Your choice - pay with your blood or your gold.
traduit: 你破坏了玛拉凯斯法典。是用血还是金币来还，自己选吧。

original: Azura is watching over you. She has seen this before it ever happened.
traduit: 阿祖拉正在注视着你。她已经预知了此事。

original: All will happen as it has been foretold.
traduit: 一切都将如预言所说进行。

original: The Twilight has foreseen all of this. Everything will be revealed in time.
traduit: 暮光已经预知了一切。所有事情都会被及时地揭露。

original: I told you what you wanted to know. What else could you want?
traduit: 我已经把你想知道的都说了。你还想要什么？

original: I can send you into Azura's Star as soon as you're ready.
traduit: 等你准备好，我就送你去阿祖拉之星。

original: Azura's Star! I knew the Lady of Twilight had sent you for a reason.
traduit: 阿祖拉之星！我就知道暮光女士派你去自有道理。

original: Hand it over to me. I will ask Azura to restore the Star to its original purity.
traduit: 把它交给我吧。我会请阿祖拉恢复它纯洁的本貌。

original: Are you ready for me to show Azura her Star and receive her wisdom?
traduit: 准备好让我向阿祖拉展示此星，并接受她的智慧了吗？

original: Our order will not forget your deeds.
traduit: 我们教团不会忘记你的贡献。

original: You have done the world a great service.
traduit: 你为世界做出了巨大的贡献。

original: Now what's going on?!
traduit: 这是怎么回事？！

original: Psijics? Here now? What in Talos' name...
traduit: 赛伊克？在这里？塔洛斯啊……

original: I knew you could do it!
traduit: 我就知道你能行！

original: We must hurry if we're going to defeat Ancano.
traduit: 想要打败安卡诺就得快点。

original: Gods, you'd better have something good up your sleeve. I've got nothing left.
traduit: 神啊，你最好有好办法。我已经一无所有了。

original: We never should have brought that thing here...
traduit: 我们就不该把那东西带回来……

original: I'll be amazed if any of us survive this.
traduit: 我们能活下来就怪了。

original: If only we'd stayed out of Saarthal.
traduit: 要是我们没去萨瑟尔就好了。

original: I can't believe any of this is happening!
traduit: 真不敢相信发生了这一切！

original: J'zargo is going to stay right here until this is all over.
traduit: 杰'扎格会一直待在这里，直到一切都结束。

original: If only Savos were alive to see this...
traduit: 要是萨沃斯还活着就好了。

original: To Oblivion with the rest of them - save yourself!
traduit: 都下湮灭去吧，保护好你自己！

original: Why doesn't someone do something?
traduit: 为什么就没人做些什么？

original: I'm not ready to die. I'm just not...
traduit: 我还不想死。我还没……

original: So much energy... So much power. Never in my life have I seen something like this...
traduit: 这么多的能量……这么多力量。这辈子都没见过啊。

original: We've got to find a way to put a stop to this.
traduit: 我们得想办法阻止这一切。

original: I hope whatever you're going to do will work.
traduit: 希望你做的一切能够奏效。

original: You'll defeat Ancano, won't you?
traduit: 你会打败安卡诺的，对吗？

original: What are we going to do? How do we save the College?
traduit: 我们该怎么办？我们该怎么拯救学院？

original: I hope you know what you're doing.
traduit: 希望你知道自己在做什么。

original: I can't lose all my research. There has to be a way to save the College.
traduit: 我不想失去我所有的研究。一定有办法可以拯救学院。

original: You really think the Staff of Magnus is the key?
traduit: 你真的认为玛格努斯之杖会是关键吗？

original: How long can we keep this up?
traduit: 我们还能撑多久？

original: J'zargo knows that you will save the College. You must.
traduit: 杰'扎格知道你会拯救学院。你一定会的。

original: J'zargo is sure this is the end. And this was supposed to be a safe place...
traduit: 杰'扎格确信一切都结束了。这里应该是个安全地方。

original: If we can't stop this, what happens to the rest of Skyrim?
traduit: 如果我们不能阻止这一切，那天际的其他地方会怎么样？

original: I've never seen anything like this, in all my years.
traduit: 我这么多年都没有见过这种事。

original: Can you imagine the kind of power behind this?
traduit: 你能想象这后面的力量吗？

original: We never should have pulled that thing out of Saarthal.
traduit: 我们就不该把那东西带出萨瑟尔。

original: Do you think Ancano knew all along what the Eye was capable of?
traduit: 你说，安卡诺一直都知道那个眼睛的能力吗？

original: This is going to be terrible for business...
traduit: 这对生意来说可是很不好啊……

original: You're still alive!
traduit: 你还活着！

original: Get to the College, before it's too late!
traduit: 快回学院，不然就晚了！

original: What are you doing here? You need to get that Staff, or else we don't stand a chance!
traduit: 你在这里干什么？你得赶紧拿回法杖，否则就没机会了！

original: By the gods... what was that?
traduit: 神啊……那是什么？

original: We need to find out what Ancano's up to.
traduit: 我们得弄清楚安卡诺在干什么。

original: I don't know what he's doing, but he won't get away with it.
traduit: 我不知道他在干什么，但他逃不掉的。

original: I trust that you'll inform me as soon as the Staff is recovered.
traduit: 找到法杖后通知我。

original: I hope Mirabelle is helpful in locating the Staff.
traduit: 希望米拉贝勒能帮你找到法杖。

original: So you're off to find some staff now? I don't see the point of that.
traduit: 你现在是要去找什么法杖吗？我不明白那有什么意义。

original: J'zargo has heard of the Staff of Magnus. Once you are done with it, perhaps you will allow J'zargo to... Borrow it?
traduit: 杰'扎格听说过玛格努斯之杖。等你用完了，也许你会允许杰'扎格……借用一下？

original: Have you managed to track down the Synod, or the Staff of Magnus?
traduit: 你能找到希诺或是玛格努斯之杖了吗？

original: Please, tell me you've found the crystal. I've no wish to die in this place.
traduit: 拜托，一定要找到水晶。我不想死在这里。

original: Unless you can find that crystal, there's no point in wasting more time with talk.
traduit: 除非你能找到水晶，否则没有必要浪费时间聊天。

original: It's very important you do this correctly.
traduit: 做好这件事很重要。

original: You got what you came for, didn't you? Go then, back to your college.
traduit: 你不是已经得到想要的了吗？走吧，回你的学院去。

original: I hope you have good news for Mirabelle.
traduit: 希望你有好消息带给米拉贝勒。

original: Please, make sure Winterhold is safe!
traduit: 请确保冬堡的安全！

original: Well? Is everything out there all right?
traduit: 嗯？外面一切还好吗？

original: Find Savos, and get him back here if you can!
traduit: 去找萨沃斯，尽可能把他带回来！

original: What's happening? What did you people do?
traduit: 发生什么了？你们在干什么？

original: You brought this on us! You!
traduit: 是你把这东西带给我们的！是你！

original: Please, whatever you did, just make it stop!
traduit: 拜托了，不管你做了什么，让它停下来吧！

original: What's going on out there? What happened?
traduit: 怎么回事？发生什么了？

original: Did you make something bad happen?
traduit: 是你把事情搞砸的？

original: I'm not seeing things again, am I?
traduit: 我不会又看不见东西了吧？

original: Whatever it is you're up to at the College, you need to fix this at once!
traduit: 不管你在学院做了什么，都必须马上解决！

original: What have we gotten ourselves into now?
traduit: 我们又惹上什么麻烦了？

original: Well, this certainly won't help our image.
traduit: 这对我们的风评没什么好处。

original: This is not J'zargo's fault!
traduit: 这不是杰'扎格的错！

original: By Azura, what's happening?
traduit: 阿祖拉在上，发生什么了？

original: Shor's blood, what have they done?
traduit: 舒尔的血啊，他们做了什么？

original: What's going on?!
traduit: 到底怎么了？

original: This can't be happening!
traduit: 不应该是这样的！

original: The Arch-Mage is dead! Dead!
traduit: 大法师死了！死了！

original: Protect yourself! We're under some kind of attack!
traduit: 保护好自己！我们遭到攻击了！

original: We've got to stay focused.
traduit: 我们必须集中精力。

original: We never should have brought that thing here!
traduit: 我们就不该把那东西带出来！

original: I hope this isn't something I did.
traduit: 希望这一切不是因为我。

original: If this is somehow your fault...
traduit: 如果这是你的错……

original: Welcome to the Midden.
traduit: 欢迎来到秽道。

original: Is it true? One of the Psijics was here in the College?
traduit: 是真的吗？有个赛伊克来过学院？

original: No one's heard from the Psijic Order in so many years. Hard to believe one would just suddenly show up here.
traduit: 这么多年都没听说过赛伊克教团的消息了。真难相信有一位突然出现在这里。

original: J'zargo regrets that there was no chance to speak with the Psijic Monk.
traduit: 杰'扎格很遗憾没有和那个赛伊克僧侣交谈一下。

original: You must excuse me. I shouldn't be here.
traduit: 请原谅，我不应该在这里了。

original: It is good to meet you in person.
traduit: 很高兴见到你。

original: How could you just leave me here?
traduit: 你怎么能把我丢在这里？

original: Well, everything worked out nicely, didn't it?
traduit: 一切都很顺利吧？

original: I've got to get out of here.
traduit: 我得离开这儿。

original: Why did I ever come here?
traduit: 我为什么要到这里来？

original: Please! Help me!
traduit: 拜托！帮帮我！

original: Don't leave me here!
traduit: 别把我丢下！

original: Urag can be very helpful. Just don't antagonize him.
traduit: 乌拉格很乐于助人。只是不要激怒他。

original: Well, you're certainly making a name for yourself.
traduit: 嗯，你确实为自己打出名声了。

original: I understand you're the one that found this... Orb in Saarthal.
traduit: 我知道你在萨瑟尔发现了这个……球体。

original: You have what you came for. Now leave.
traduit: 你已经拿到想要的东西了。现在赶紧离开。

original: Take your books and go, before I change my mind.
traduit: 在我改主意之前，赶紧拿书走人。

original: Do we have a deal?
traduit: 成交吗？

original: This thing from Saarthal. What does it do? J'zargo cannot say.
traduit: 来自萨瑟尔的东西。它是干什么用的？杰'扎格也不知道。

original: I hear you found some... thing in Saarthal. You think it could help make me a powerful mage?
traduit: 我听说你在萨瑟尔找到了一些……东西。你觉得那能帮助我成为强大的法师吗？

original: We shouldn't have been disturbing Saarthal, no matter what you found down there.
traduit: 不管你在下面发现了什么，咱们都不应该打扰萨瑟尔。

original: At least something good came out of that trip to Saarthal. I didn't find anything but dust.
traduit: 那次萨瑟尔之行总算找到点好东西。我在那儿除了灰尘什么都没找到。

original: What should I do if there's no class?
traduit: 如果没有课程我该怎么办？

original: Well, perhaps it's time for some independent study.
traduit: 嗯，也许是时候独立学习了。

original: Check with Urag gro-Shub in the Arcanaeum. See if he's aware of any references to this... thing that you and Tolfdir found.
traduit: 去秘藏馆找乌拉格·格洛-舒布查阅一下。看看他是否知道这次你和托夫迪尔发现的东西。

original: I'd like to know as much as we can about it.
traduit: 我想尽可能多了解一下。

original: I need to get into the Pelagius Wing.
traduit: 我要进入佩拉吉奥斯侧厅。

original: Absolutely not. That wing has been sealed for hundreds of years, and for good reason. They say the ghost of Pelagius the Mad still haunts it.
traduit: 绝对不行。那个侧厅被锁闭了几百年了，而且不为无因。据说“疯子”佩拉吉奥斯的鬼魂还在里面游荡。

original: Ghost or not, there are reminders of his dark rule that are best left buried away.
traduit: 不管鬼魂真假，他黑暗统治的回忆最好被埋葬起来。

original: Not on your life. It's dangerous in there, and Falk doesn't even like me and Erdi going in every year to clean out the spiders.
traduit: 绝对不行。那里很危险，佛可甚至不想让我和厄尔迪每年进去清理蜘蛛。

original: Oh, I'd get in trouble for that. It's not allowed. Besides, it's scary in there!
traduit: 哦，我会惹上麻烦的。这是不允许的。而且，里面很吓人！

original: What's wrong with you?
traduit: 你怎么了？

original: You! You'll help me! You help people, right? That's what you do?
traduit: 你！你会帮我的！你很乐于助人对吧？你一向这样的！

original: You have done admirably, little one.
traduit: 做得好，小家伙。

original: You have helped rid the Orcs of Yamarz in a way that avoids the destruction of their tribe.
traduit: 你帮助兽人们摆脱了亚马兹，使部落免于毁灭。

original: They will become stronger for it. And you... You have proven your strength.
traduit: 他们会因此变得更加强大……而你已经证明了自己的力量。

original: You have earned my favor for now, mortal, and so I give you a little gift. Use it well.
traduit: 你赢得了我的青睐，凡人。送你一份小礼物。好好使用吧。

original: You, place that hammer on the shrine. You're the only one who's proven worthy in all of this...
traduit: 喂，把锤子放在祭坛上。你是唯一证明了自己价值的人……

original: You'll have to prove yourselves, but I'm willing to give you a chance. Gularzob's in charge now. Let's hope he's a better chief.
traduit: 你们必须证明自己，不过，我愿意给你们一个机会。古拉佐伯从现在起领导你们，希望他是个好酋长。

original: So he has been punished? And what of us? What fate shall we suffer?
traduit: 所以他被制裁了？那我们呢？我们的命运如何？

original: Yamarz was a coward and a weakling. His deceitful ways have cost you all greatly.
traduit: 亚马兹是个弱小的懦夫。他的卑劣行径让你们损失惨重。

original: He fought bravely, but the giant overwhelmed him.
traduit: 虽然不是巨人的对手，但他仍旧选择勇敢地战斗。

original: Ah, that is good to hear, then.
traduit: 啊，那太好了。

original: He asked me to kill the giant, then attacked me.
traduit: 他先是让我去杀巨人，紧跟着又要杀我。

original: What? Why would he do such a thing?
traduit: 什么？他怎么会怎样？

original: I have returned with Shagrol's Hammer.
traduit: 我拿回沙葛洛之锤了。

original: But... What of Yamarz?
traduit: 不过……亚马兹呢？

original: I see. He did not survive. He... He died well?
traduit: 我明白了。他没活下来。他……死的光荣吗？

original: Has the time come? Will I now serve the Night Mother?
traduit: 时机到了吗？我现在能为夜母效劳了吗？

original: DB04AstridPlayerProceeResponse1
traduit: DB04AstridPlayerProceeResponse1

original: Of course, Astrid. What is it?
traduit: 当然，阿斯垂德。什么事？

original: No. No! Listen, I don't know what's going on here, but you take your orders from me. Are we clear on that?
traduit: 不。不！听着，我不知道发生了什么。但你得听我的命令。懂吗？

original: The Night Mother may have spoken to you, but I am still the leader of this Family. I will not have my authority so easily dismissed.
traduit: 也许夜母真的和你说话了，但我还是这个家的领袖。我不允许我的权威这么轻易被推翻。

original: I... I need time to think about all this. Go see Nazir - do some work for him. I'll find you when I'm ready to discuss the matter further.
traduit: 我……需要时间好好想想。去找纳兹尔，帮他做几个活儿。等我准备好进一步讨论这件事的时候，我会找你的。

original: So I should go to Volunruud? I should talk to this man?
traduit: 那我该去沃伦鲁德和那个人谈谈吗？

original: Volunruud? Well, that is interesting. I know this place...
traduit: 沃伦鲁德？有趣。我知道那地方……

original: He's in some place called Volunruud.
traduit: 他在一个叫沃伦鲁德的地方。

original: Amaund Motierre? I have no idea who that is.
traduit: 阿蒙德·莫提雷？没听说过。

original: But Volunruud... that I have heard of. And I know where it is.
traduit: 但是我听说过沃伦鲁德。我也知道位置。

original: I must speak to someone named Amaund Motierre, in Volunruud.
traduit: 我必须去沃伦鲁德见一个叫阿蒙德·莫提雷的人。

original: By Sithis.
traduit: 西帝斯在上。

original: And... what did she say?
traduit: 那……她和你说什么了？

original: Yes.
traduit: 没错。

original: So Cicero wasn't talking to anyone else. Just... the Night Mother's body?
traduit: 所以，西塞罗没有跟任何人说话。只是……对着夜母的尸体自言自语？

original: And the Night Mother, who, according to everything we know, will only speak to the person chosen as Listener... just spoke. Right now...
traduit: 据我们所知，夜母只会和聆听者交谈……然后，她刚刚说话了……

original: ...to you?
traduit: ……跟你？

original: It's true. The Night Mother spoke to me. She said I was "the one."
traduit: 这是真的。夜母和我说话了。她说我就是“那个人”。

original: AstridConfrontListenerResponse1
traduit: AstridConfrontListenerResponse1

original: Then what in Sithis' name is going on? Cicero spoke to the Night Mother, but she spoke to you? Is this just more of the fool's rambling?
traduit: 到底是怎么回事？西塞罗在和夜母交谈，然后夜母和你说话了？是那个笨蛋在胡言乱语吗？

original: Yes, I'm fine.
traduit: 嗯，我没事。

original: It's true, it's true! The Night Mother has spoken! The silence has been broken! The Listener has been chosen!
traduit: 是真的，是真的！夜母说话了！沉寂被打破了！聆听者已经诞生了！

original: What? The Listener? What are you going on about? What is this lunacy?
traduit: 什么？聆听者？你在说什么？这是怎么一回事？

original: I spoke only to the Night Mother! I spoke to the Night Mother, but she didn't speak to me. Oh no. She spoke only to him! To the Listener!
traduit: 我只是在和夜母说话！我和夜母说话，但她不和我说话。哦，不对。她和他说话了！聆听者！

original: I spoke only to the Night Mother! I spoke to the Night Mother, but she didn't speak to me. Oh no. She spoke only to her! To the Listener!
traduit: 我只是在和夜母说话！我和夜母说话，但她不和我说话。哦，不对。她和她说话了！聆听者！

original: Are you all right? I heard the commotion. Who was Cicero talking to? Where's the accomplice? Reveal yourself, traitor!
traduit: 你怎么样？我听到了骚动。西塞罗在和谁说话？共犯是谁？自己站出来，叛徒！

original: By Sithis, this ends now! Back away, fool! Whatever you've been planning is over!
traduit: 西帝斯在上，一切都结束了！站下来，小丑！不管你在谋划什么，都结束了！

original: No! Someone help me! Please!
traduit: 不！来人救我！救命！

original: I've heard you dabble in necromancy.
traduit: 我听说你对死灵法术有所涉猎。

original: I beg your pardon?
traduit: 你说什么？

original: Why are these mages in Fellglow Keep?
traduit: 那些法师去光落堡垒做什么？

original: Let's just call it a "difference of opinion" with the College.
traduit: 就当是和学院“意见相左”吧。

original: They were interested in research that goes outside the bounds of what the College allows, so they were... persuaded to leave.
traduit: 他们对学院允许范围之外的研究很感兴趣，所以就……离开了。

original: Who is this Orthorn?
traduit: 奥拓恩是谁？

original: He was an Apprentice here at the College. Not very skilled, but got involved with a group of mages who took a liking to him.
traduit: 以前是学院的学徒。技术还不怎么样，不过一群法师中意他，他就跟着混到一起了。

original: When they left, he took off after them. Stole supplies and books from the College, I suppose as a way to ingratiate himself.
traduit: 他们离开的时候，他就跟着走了。还从学院偷了东西和书。估计也是图个爽快。

original: You don't have anything that can help?
traduit: 你就帮不上什么忙吗？

original: I said not anymore. Orthorn stole a number of books when he ran off to Fellglow Keep to join those Summoners. Some kind of peace offering.
traduit: 我已经说了没法帮了。奥拓恩偷了很多书当见面礼，跑去光落堡垒加入那些召唤者了。

original: I think one of those volumes may have had some relevant information. If you want them, you'll have to talk to Orthorn.
traduit: 我想其中有一卷可能会有相关信息。如果需要的话，你就得去找奥拓恩。

original: I need to learn about something we found in Saarthal.
traduit: 我需要知道些关于我们在萨瑟尔发现之物的信息。

original: I know what you want. Word travels fast around here. Discovered some big mystery, huh?
traduit: 我知道你想要什么。这里消息传得很快。发现大秘密了哈？

original: Well you don't even need to ask. No, I don't have anything for you. Not anymore, anyway.
traduit: 你根本无需来问。没有，我这里没有东西可以给你。反正现在没有。

original: The last of the hunters is dead.
traduit: 最后一个猎人已经死了。

original: Thank you for your help. I will make my home here, away from anyone I might hurt.
traduit: 谢谢你的帮助。我会在这里安家，远离人群，免得伤害他们。

original: I cannot defy Hircine. You have to die.
traduit: 我不能冒犯海尔辛。你必须死。

original: I will spare your life.
traduit: 我饶你一命。

original: Thank the gods. Now let's deal with these other hunters. We hunt together!
traduit: 谢天谢地。现在对付其他猎人。一起狩猎吧！

original: I've been told to kill you.
traduit: 他们让我杀了你。

original: And I would deserve it, wouldn't I?
traduit: 我是罪有应得，对吗？

original: I can't stop you if that's what you want to do. Hircine is too powerful.
traduit: 你想这么做，我也阻止不了。海尔辛太强大了。

original: But if you spare me, I can be a powerful ally to you. And I would promise to never return to civilized life.
traduit: 但如果你放了我，我可以成为你强大的帮手。我发誓不会再返回文明社会了。

original: I know now that I can't live among people.
traduit: 我现在终于知道，我不能与其他人一起生活。

original: I hear you attacked a little girl.
traduit: 我听说你袭击了一个小女孩。

original: A little girl is dead because of me.
traduit: 一个小女孩因我而死。

original: Believe me, it wasn't anything I ever intended to do. I just... lost control.
traduit: 相信我，我没想那样做。我只是……失控了。

original: I tried to tell them, but none of them believe me.
traduit: 我想辩解，但他们不相信。

original: It's all on account of this blasted ring.
traduit: 都是这该死的戒指。

original: Why are you imprisoned here?
traduit: 你为什么被关在这儿？

original: Some kind of choir. With chanting.
traduit: 是什么唱诗班演唱吗？

original: Screaming?
traduit: 是尖叫吗？

original: Um... the lute? No, drums!
traduit: 呃……鲁特琴？不不，是鼓！

original: Silence, my brother.
traduit: 是沉寂，我的兄弟。

original: What is the music of life?
traduit: 人生的音乐是什么？

original: Oh ho. The whimpering Nord, eh? Yes, yes, I can see how you'd come to that conclusion. Interesting choice.
traduit: 哦，杀了那个呜咽的诺德人啊？嗯，嗯，我明白你是怎么得出这个结论的。有趣的选择。

original: Ah, the feisty goodwife. Quite the mouth on her. Someone must have wanted her dead... right?
traduit: 啊，好胜的太太。她太大嘴巴了。一定有人要她命……对吧？

original: The conniving Khajiit. Cat like that was sure to have enemies. It's no wonder you chose him.
traduit: 放纵的卡吉特。像那种猫肯定会四处树敌的。难怪你会选他。

original: The blubbering barbarian and the tenacious mother. Must have been one of them, right?
traduit: 哭哭啼啼的蛮汉子和坚强的母亲。肯定是其中之一，对吧？

original: The timid warrior and the sly Khajiit. Must have been one or the other, right?
traduit: 胆小的战士和狡猾的卡吉特。肯定是其中一个，对吧？

original: Hmm. The fearless wife and mother, and the underhanded Khajiit. Had to be one of them, right? Interesting choice.
traduit: 嗯。无畏的妻子母亲，还有卑鄙的卡吉特。肯定是其中一个，对吧？

original: Well, well. Aren't we the overachiever. Three possibilities, three victims. Must have been one of them, right? So why take chances...
traduit: 很好，很好。超额完成。三个可能，三名死者。反正就是其中之一，对吧？干什么要做选择呢……

original: Remember, the Sanctuary is in the southern Pine Forest. Just beneath the road, and away from prying eyes.
traduit: 记住，圣所在南部松林。就在大路下面，远离人们视线的地方。

original: Ah, at last! I hope you found the place all right.
traduit: 啊，终于来了！希望你喜欢这儿。

original: You. You must take the Lexicon. Free me of my burden.
traduit: 你。你必须把这个方典拿走。把我从负担里解救下来。

original: I'm here to deliver a message.
traduit: 我来送个消息。

original: Reeaaaallllyyyy?
Ooh, ooh, what kind of message? A song? A summons? Wait, I know! A death threat written on the back of an Argonian concubine! Those are my favorite.
traduit: 哦哦，什么消息啊？歌曲？召唤？等等，我知道了！写在阿尔贡情妇后背上的死亡威胁！我最喜欢这些了。

original: Well? Spit it out, mortal. I haven't got an eternity!
traduit: 嗯？说出来吧，凡人。真当我时间无限多嘛！

original: Actually... I do. Little joke.
traduit: 实际上……我有得是时间。开个小玩笑。

original: But seriously. What's the message?
traduit: 说正事。有什么消息？

original: Hafrumph! Well then, if you're going to be like that... Perhaps it's best I take my leave. A good day to you sir. I said good day!
traduit: 哎哎！好吧，如果你那样的话……也许我该走了。祝你过得好，先生。我说祝你过得好！

original: Yes, yes, as you've said, countless times before...
traduit: 对，对，你都说过无数次了……

original: You are the best Septim that's ever ruled. Well, except for that Martin fellow, but he turned into a dragon god, and that's hardly sporting...
traduit: 你是最好的塞普汀皇帝。好吧，除了马丁那家伙，不过他变成龙神了，和他比就太不公平了……

original: You are far too hard on yourself, my dear, sweet, homicidally insane Pelagius. What would the people do without you? Dance? Sing? Smile? Grow old?
traduit: 你对自己太苛刻了，亲爱的小疯子佩拉吉奥斯。如果你不在了，人们会怎样？跳舞？欢歌？微笑？还是变老？

original: So many undesirables to contend with. Naysayers. Buffoons. Detractors. Why, my headsman hasn't slept in three days!
traduit: 还有很多讨厌鬼要对付。唱反调的、耍宝的、造谣的。哎，我的刽子手都三天没睡觉了！

original: Oh, I couldn't. Goes right through me. Besides, I have so many things to do...
traduit: 啊，不用了。那只会从我身上漏下去。而且，我还有很多事要做……

original: More tea, Pelly my dear?
traduit: 再来点茶吗，佩莉亲？

original: How rude! Can't be bothered to host an old friend for a decade or two.
traduit: 真粗鲁！连招待老朋友一二十年都不愿意。

original: I have a saying - I'm not going to feel what you have to like. Or something like that.
traduit: 我得说，我不会有你喜欢的那种感觉，或者类似的东西。

original: Is it just me or is it getting saner and saner these days?
traduit: 是我出幻觉了还是世界变得更理智了？

original: Pelagius stopped by and mentioned he hated you. Or I mentioned he hated you and he agreed.
traduit: 佩拉吉奥斯来做客，说他恨你。或者我提到他恨你，然后他同意了。

original: I hope you're having a good time. Actually, I hope I'm having a good time. I could care less about you.
traduit: 希望你玩得开心。实际上是我希望自己玩得开心。我才不在乎你呢。

original: I see you've been minding your own business. So how is the mind business?
traduit: 我看你一直在忙自己的事。那思想的事怎么样了？

original: Do you mind? I'm busy doing the fishstick. It's a very delicate state of mind!
traduit: 别烦我行不行？我在忙着做鱼棒，需要非常微妙的心态！

original: Please, take pity on an old madman!
traduit: 可怜可怜老疯子吧！

original: Who among you can help me?
traduit: 谁能帮帮我？

original: Wait, hear my plea! My master, he is lost between worlds and I cannot bring him back!
traduit: 等等，听听我的恳求吧！我的主人，他迷失在世界之间，我没法带他回来！

original: Why does everyone ignore me? Why do you turn your heads? Why will no one help me?
traduit: 为什么都无视我？你们为什么扭过头去？为什么没人愿意帮我？

original: The flame of my master burns low. Without him, we are all lost and forever gray... Please, help us!
traduit: 我主人的火焰燃烧越来越弱。没有他，我们都会迷失方向，陷入灰暗……请帮帮我们！

original: Falk asked me to check it out.
traduit: 佛可让我去看看。

original: I'll make an exception for you, but do not bring anything out when you leave. Too many dark deeds transpired in those halls...
traduit: 我可以为你破例一次，但你走的时候别带任何东西出来。那个大厅里发生了太多黑暗的事……

original: Falk, you know I'll be careful.
traduit: 佛可，你知道我会小心的。

original: Well... I suppose in that case, it's okay to let you in. But only briefly. Be careful, and come right back!
traduit: 好吧……我想让你进去也没什么。不过小心点，快去快回！

original: If you really want to... Just be careful of the ghost! He snuck up on me once and scared me sick. It took a week for me to feel better...
traduit: 如果你真的想去……小心鬼魂！有一次他偷偷接近我，把我吓坏了。缓了一个星期才感觉好些……

original: Who is your master?
traduit: 你主人是谁？

original: He is a great man, but one rarely praised! He rules twin empires that span the length and breadth of our minds! All know him, but few can name him!
traduit: 他是个伟大的人，但很少被称颂！他统治着跨越我们思想长度和宽度的双生帝国！他无人不知，却很少有人能说出他的名字！

original: But... he has forbidden me from saying his name. He says it distracts him, and woe to those who draw his ire.
traduit: 但……他禁止我说出他的名字。他说这会分散他的注意力，那些惹恼他的人会很麻烦的。

original: But you will know him when you see him. He's the one who made me like this!
traduit: 不过你见到他的时候就会知道了。就是他让我变成这个样子的！

original: How can I find your master?
traduit: 我怎么才能找到你主人？

original: Last I saw him, he was visiting a friend in the Blue Palace. But no one as mundane as the Jarl. No, no... such people are below him.
traduit: 我上次见他在蓝宫会友。但不是领主那种身份平凡的人。不，不……没人地位在他之上。

original: No, he went into the forbidden wing of the palace, to speak with an old friend. Said it had been ages since they had last had tea.
traduit: 他去了宫中被封闭的侧厅，他说要找一位老朋友，他们很久没一起喝茶了。

original: Oh and you'll need the hip bone... it's very important. No entering Pelagius' Wing without that.
traduit: 哦，你还需要这块髋骨……这很重要。没有它就进不了佩拉吉奥斯的侧厅。

original: My master has abandoned me! Abandoned his people. And nothing I say can change his mind.
traduit: 我主人抛弃了我！抛弃了他的民众。我没法说服他回心转意。

original: Now he refuses to even see me. He says I interrupt his vacation! It's been so many years... Won't you please help?
traduit: 他现在甚至拒绝见我。说我打断了他的假期！已经好多年了……能请你帮帮忙吗？

original: Without his guidance, our homeland is falling apart. North wages war against south! The holy flame flickers and dies! We need his return.
traduit: 没了他的领导，我们的家园正在分崩离析。南北之间爆发混战！神圣的火焰闪烁欲熄！我们需要他回去。

original: Oh, but... I'm sure he'll repay you when he comes to his senses! His favor is a powerful, powerful thing. And so very worth any... inconveniences.
traduit: 哦，但是……我相信他恢复理智之后会酬谢你的！他的眷顾很强大，很强大。所以很值得……耽搁一点时间。

original: Why do you need him back?
traduit: 你为什么要他回去？

original: Here are the books that went missing.
traduit: 这是丢失的书。

original: Well, well. And you seem to be in one piece!
traduit: 嗯，很好。看来安然无恙吗！

original: Thank you. I'll look these over, and inform Mirabelle if I find anything relevant.
traduit: 谢谢了。我会仔细查看的，如果有任何相关信息，我会通知米拉贝勒的。

original: "Night of Tears", eh? I remember this one. Well, isn't that interesting.
traduit: “泪之夜”，嗯？我记得这个。嗯，很有趣么。

original: Did you read it yourself? If I recall it correctly, that has some interesting implications. You should mention that to Tolfdir.
traduit: 你有读过吗？如果我没记错的话，这里面有些有趣的暗示。你应该去告诉托夫迪尔。

original: And... here. I suppose you've earned these.
traduit: 还有……给你。这是你应得的。

original: You needed to know more?
traduit: 你想知道更多吗？

original: You again? We have nothing else to discuss. Now move.
traduit: 又是你？我们没什么好说的了。躲开吧。

original: Why are you following me? I told you, I don't know anything else!
traduit: 你为什么要跟踪我？我说了，我什么都不知道！

original: Look, I've told you everything. Now leave me alone!
traduit: 听着，我把所有都告诉你了。现在别来烦我了！

original: Our business has concluded and you're standing in my way.
traduit: 我们的交易已经结束了，现在你妨碍到我了。

original: Ah, I see you have the wine. Hand it over and we'll talk.
traduit: 啊，我看到你把酒带来了。给我吧，然后再谈。

original: No Firebrand Wine yet? How disappointing.
traduit: 没拿到火牌葡萄酒吗？真令人失望。

original: Hmmm, you again. What is it this time?
traduit: 嗯，又是你。这次又有什么事？

original: Aringoth was a fool to think he could get away with this.
traduit: 阿林格斯真傻，居然以为能侥幸逃脱。

original: No time for idle chatter. Mercer is awaiting your presence.
traduit: 没时间闲聊了。墨瑟正等着你呢。

original: Is there anything we can do?
traduit: 我们能做些什么？

original: Mercer thinks he knows a way to identify this new thorn in our side. He wants to meet with you right away.
traduit: 墨瑟觉得自己能找出我们新麻烦的源头。他要马上见你。

original: And if I were you I'd hurry. I've never seen him this angry before.
traduit: 如果我是你，我会抓紧时间。我从没见过他这么气愤。

original: I warned you not to cross Maven. If I hadn't stepped in and paid amends, you'd be... well, I think you know.
traduit: 我警告过你不要惹恼玛雯。要不是我出面赔偿，你早就……哎，你应该明白。

original: At least Sabjorn has found himself in Whiterun's prison. How unfortunate for him.
traduit: 但至少撒布乔恩已经发现自己身在白漫城大牢里了。真惨啊。

original: Word on the street is that poor Sabjorn has found himself in Whiterun's prison. How unfortunate for him.
traduit: 有消息说可怜的撒布乔恩被关进了白漫城大牢。真不幸啊。

original: What are you gawking at? Can't you see I have problems here?
traduit: 你看什么看？没看见我现在有麻烦吗？

original: Maven said you're expecting me.
traduit: 玛雯说你在等我。

original: I'm going to keep this short 'cause we've got a lot to do.
traduit: 那我长话短说，我们还有很多事要做。

original: Honningbrew's owner, Sabjorn, is about to hold a tasting for Whiterun's Captain of the Guard and we're going to poison the mead.
traduit: 蜜之酿的老板撒布乔恩正准备为白漫城的卫兵队长举办一次品酒会，而我们则要往蜜酒里下毒。

original: How about we skip the conversation?
traduit: 我们跳过寒暄阶段如何？

original: You're a firebrand, aren't you?
traduit: 说话很有煽动力吗？

original: It's about time Brynjolf sent me someone with business sense. I was beginning to think he was running some sort of beggar's guild over there.
traduit: 布林乔夫也是该派个有商业头脑的人过来了。我还以为他那边在经营什么乞丐公会呢。

original: Brynjolf said you wanted to see me.
traduit: 布林乔夫说你想见我。

original: So you're the one that burned down Goldenglow Estate.
traduit: 就是你烧了金色光辉庄园啊。

original: Do you have any idea what that little stunt you pulled is going to cost me?
traduit: 你知不知道为了你的小花招，我要付出多大的代价？

original: I'm amazed you even bothered to show your face here.
traduit: 居然有脸来这里也是挺新鲜的。

original: So, you're the one. Hmm. You don't look so impressive.
traduit: 所以就是你啊。嗯，看起来也不怎么样嘛。

original: You're a madman.
traduit: 你是疯子。

original: Jolly good guess!
traduit: 有意思的猜测！

original: But only half right. I'm a mad god. The Mad God, actually. It's a family title. Gets passed down from me to myself every few thousand years.
traduit: 但只对了一半。我是疯神。疯神，其实是一个家族的头衔。每隔几千年我就会把它传给我自己。

original: Now you. You can call me Ann Marie.
traduit: 你现在可以叫我，安·玛丽。

original: But only if you're partial to being flayed alive and having an angry immortal skip rope with your entrails.
traduit: 前提是你喜欢被活活剥皮，然后让愤怒的不朽者拿你的肠子当跳绳。

original: If not... Then call me Sheogorath, Daedric Prince of Madness. Charmed.
traduit: 如果不喜欢……那还是叫我谢尔格拉，迷人的迪德拉疯狂君王。

original: All I know is that your people need you to return.
traduit: 我只知道你的民众需要你回去。

original: Yaaawwwwnn....
traduit: 哈啊啊啊呜呜呜呜。

original: Oh, pardon me. Were you saying something? I do apologize, it's just that I find myself suddenly and irrevocably...
traduit: 哦，对不起。你说什么？抱歉，只是突然不由自主感到……

original: Bored!
traduit: 无聊！

original: I mean, really. Here you stand, before Sheogorath himself, Daedric Prince of Madness, and all you deem fit to do is... deliver a message? How sad.
traduit: 我是说，真的。你站在迪德拉疯狂君王谢尔格拉面前，却只是想……传个口信儿？悲哀啊。

original: I'm afraid I don't know, sir.
traduit: 我恐怕不知道，先生。

original: Wrong!
traduit: 错了！

original: Actually, you do. Sort of.
traduit: 其实你知道的，应该知道的。

original: I am a part of you, little mortal. I am a shadow in your subconscious, a blemish on your fragile little psyche. You know me. You just don't know it.
traduit: 我就是你的一部分，小凡人。我就是你潜意识里的阴影，是你脆弱心灵的污点。你知道我，但没感觉到。

original: Sheogorath, Daedric Prince of Madness. At your service.
traduit: 谢尔格拉，疯狂的迪德拉君王。乐意为你效劳。

original: So does that mean you'll leave? Or not?
traduit: 那你走还是不走？

original: Now that's the real question, isn't it? Because honestly, how much time off could a demented Daedra really need?
traduit: 这才是问题所在，是吧？说实话啊，一个疯狂的迪德拉究竟要休息多久才行？

original: So here's what I'm going to do. I'm going to leave. That's right. I'm done. Holiday... complete. Time to return to the hum drum day-to-day.
traduit: 好了我该走了。没错。我完事了。假期……结束了。是时候回到枯燥乏味的日常里去了。

original: On one condition.
traduit: 有个条件。

original: You have to find the way out first. Good luck with that.
traduit: 你得先找到出路。祝你好运哦。
