original: I think I made a mistake coming here...
traduit: 我觉得来这里是个错误……

original: Oh, no no no! No mistake at all. What you made was a choice. Granted, not a very wise choice, but these things happen. Ah, the folly of youth...
traduit: 哦，不不不！完全没错儿。你只是做了一个选择，虽然不太明智，但事情已经发生了。啊，年轻人的愚蠢……

original: You know, you remind me of myself at a young age. All I cared about was riding narwhales and sleeping in honeycombs and drinking babies' tears...
traduit: 你让我想起了年轻的自己，只关心骑独角鲸、在蜂巢里睡觉、喝婴儿的眼泪……

original: Word of advice if you ride a Narwhale. Mind the pointy end.
traduit: 给你个骑独角鲸的忠告。别骑尖的那一头。

original: Ah, but there I go, waxing poetic about my misspent youth. Now where were we? Ah yes. You're the mortal messenger. An I am...?
traduit: 啊，我又来了，讴歌我虚度的青春。我们说到哪儿了？哦对，你是那个凡人信使。我是……？

original: Honestly. Have you any idea?
traduit: 说实话，你知道吗？

original: So you need me to bring him back?
traduit: 所以你想让我把他带回来？

original: Yes, but don't try to use force! He's far too mighty. He'd crush you like a clay doll, or drop you from the sky, or simply eat your brain right up!
traduit: 对，但千万别动武！他太强了。他会像捏泥娃娃一样把你捏碎，或者把你扔上天再掉下来，再不然就是干脆吃掉你的脑子！

original: Oh, but he probably won't do those things to you. Probably. Just remind him to come home, and... there'll be no fighting or unpleasantness. Probably.
traduit: 哦，不过他可能不会对你那么做。可能吧。提醒他该回家了，然后……千万别动武，也不要闹不愉快。可能吧。

original: He's just a little confused at the moment, is all. Knowing my master, he may very well reward you for bringing him to his senses!
traduit: 他现在只是有点糊涂而已。我了解主人，如果帮他恢复理智，他会重赏你的！

original: Yes, yes, go. Leave me to my ceaseless responsibilities and burdens...
traduit: 是，是，走了。继续承担无休止的责任和负担咯……

original: How can I get to your master?
traduit: 我怎么找到你的主人？

original: He stays in the Pelagius Wing of the Blue Palace. The doors are locked, and only Falk Firebeard can grant entry.
traduit: 他在蓝宫的佩拉吉奥斯侧厅。门被锁上了，只有“火胡”佛可才能进去。

original: But I hear the maids, Una and Erdi, know how to enter it for cleaning. Surely they can help for such an important matter?
traduit: 不过我听说乌娜和厄尔迪两个女仆会进去打扫。这么重要的事情，他们应该会帮忙的吧？

original: Why don't you leave your master?
traduit: 你为什么不离开主人？

original: Oh, you just don't understand. Without him, I am not free! Without him, I am doomed! All of his empire shall fall into chaos...
traduit: 哦，你不懂。没了他，我就没有自由！没了他，我就完了！他的帝国也会陷入一片混乱……

original: I was asked to retrieve you from your vacation.
traduit: 我是受人委托，来接你结束度假的。

original: Were you now?
traduit: 是吗？

original: By whom?
traduit: 谁啊？

original: Wait! Don't tell me! I want to guess!
traduit: 等等！别告诉我！我要猜！

original: Was it Molag? No, no... Little Tim, the toymaker's son? The ghost of King Lysandus? Or was it... Yes! Stanley, that talking grapefruit from Passwall.
traduit: 莫拉格？不，不对……玩具匠的儿子，小提米？莱桑杜斯王的鬼魂？还是……对了！斯坦利，翻墙镇那个会说话的柚子。

original: Wrong on all accounts, aren't I?
traduit: 我全猜错了？

original: Ha! No matter! Honestly, I don't want to know. Why ruin the surprise?
traduit: 哈！没关系！老实说我不知道。干什么破坏惊喜呢？

original: But more to the point. Do you - tiny, puny, expendable little mortal - actually think you can convince me to leave?
traduit: 更重要的是。你这个小小的、微不足道的、可有可无的凡人。真以为能劝我离开吗？

original: Because that's... crazy. You do realize who you're dealing with here?
traduit: 真是……疯了。你知道自己在和谁打交道吗？

original: Okay, what's the catch?
traduit: 好吧，你想怎么样？

original: Ha! I do love it when the mortals know they're being manipulated. Makes things infinitely more interesting.
traduit: 哈！我就喜欢凡人得知自己被人操纵时候的感觉。让事情变得再有意思点吧。

original: Simple.
traduit: 简单。

original: Is it?
traduit: 是吗？

original: It's too bad they executed Roggvir before we got here.
traduit: 真可惜，他们在我们来之前处决了罗吉维尔。

original: They say Helgen got hit by a dragon. One of those horrors comes here, we'll be ready.
traduit: 他们说海尔根被龙给袭击了。一旦真有恐怖的事发生，我们会做好准备的。

original: Brigands I can handle, but this talk of dragons? World's gone mad, I say.
traduit: 强盗我还能应付，但你说龙族？那世界真是疯了。

original: The Greybeards have summoned the Dragonborn to High Hrothgar. Such a thing has not happened for... hundreds of years.
traduit: 灰胡子召唤龙裔去霍斯加修道院了。这样的事……有几百年没发生过了。

original: There was a fight down in the Ratway, but reports are... sketchy. Some say it was Thalmor Agents, others say Thieves Guild. Some say it was both.
traduit: 鼠道里发生了一场打斗，但是报道很……粗略。有人说是梭默特使，有人说是盗贼公会。还有人说是这两家打起来了。

original: Word is Elenwen's furious. Big party at the Thalmor Embassy, and one of the guests went someplace they shouldn't. Caused quite a commotion.
traduit: 听说爱琳温相当生气。她在梭默大使馆举办了一场盛大宴会，结果有位客人去了不该去的地方。骚动不小啊。

original: Have you heard? There's been another dragon attack. Kynesgrove, this time.
traduit: 你听说了吗？又有巨龙袭击事件了。这次是在凯娜之林。

original: What could it mean? The return of the Dragonborn? And who among us could possibly hold that honor? And such power?
traduit: 这到底意味着什么？龙裔归来了？我们里谁能有这样的荣耀？还有力量？

original: By the gods, it's true, isn't it? A dragon has attacked Whiterun. How could mere men bring down such a beast?
traduit: 神啊，是真的？龙袭击了白漫城。人类怎么能打倒这样的巨兽？

original: By Ysmir, you did it. You killed a dragon.
traduit: 伊斯米尔在上，你成功了。你杀了一头龙。

original: There's been talk amongst the guards. That you are... Dragonborn. But such a thing... Surely that's not possible...
traduit: 卫兵们有传言。说你是……龙裔。但这……怎么可能嘛……

original: The guards in Dragonsreach say you've aided the Jarl. On behalf of Whiterun, I thank you.
traduit: 龙临宫的卫兵说你曾经帮助过领主。我替白漫谢谢你。

original: I've seen you helping the Jarl. If only all visitors to Whiterun were as noble.
traduit: 我看到你帮助了领主。要是所有来白漫城的人都这么高尚就好了。

original: It was you convinced the Jarl to trap that dragon in the keep. And by Ysmir, it actually worked.
traduit: 你说服领主把龙困在城堡里了。伊斯米尔啊，居然成功了。

original: There's a dragon. Here. In Dragonsreach. And I thought it was just a name.
traduit: 有只龙。就在龙临宫里。我还以为这就是个名字呢。

original: We had that beast contained. And you released it! Why? Why would you do such a thing?
traduit: 我们抓了那畜生，你却放了它！为什么？你干嘛这么做？

original: Is it true what they say? There was a dragon held captive in Whiterun, and you... you released it? By the gods, man, why?
traduit: 他们说的是真的？白漫城囚禁了一头龙，然后你……你又把它放了？天啊，为什么？

original: Is it true what they say? There was a dragon held captive in Whiterun, and you... you released it? By the gods, woman, why?
traduit: 他们说的是真的？白漫城囚禁了一头龙，然后你……你又把它放了？天啊，为什么？

original: The Greybeards have arranged a truce between the Stormcloaks and Imperials. How long can such a thing last?
traduit: 灰胡子已经让帝国和风暴斗篷达成停战协议了。但这又能持续多久？

original: The Greybeards have called a peace council, at High Hrothgar. And can you believe it - both Ulfric Stormcloak and General Tullius have agreed to go.
traduit: 灰胡子在霍斯加修道院召开和平会议了。你相信吗，乌弗瑞克·风暴斗篷和图留斯将军都同意参加了。

original: Word is spreading like magefire! The great evil has been vanquished! You have truly saved us all!
traduit: 消息像法师火焰一样炸开了！强大的恶魔被征服了！你真的救了我们所有人！

original: All hail the Dragonborn!
traduit: 向龙裔致敬！

original: In the ancient tongue, you are Dovahkiin - Dragonborn!
traduit: 古语里，你就是都瓦克因——龙裔！

original: You! You're the one who wiped out the Dark Brotherhood! All the guards are talking about it... You're a hero to us all!
traduit: 你！是你消灭了黑暗兄弟会！所有卫兵都在谈论这件事……你是我们所有人的英雄啊！

original: You hear the news? The Emperor has been murdered! Right here, in Skyrim. By the gods, if the Dark Brotherhood can do that, nobody's safe...
traduit: 你听说了吗？皇帝被刺杀了！就在天际。神啊，如果黑暗兄弟会能做到这点，那还有谁是安全的……

original: By the gods. The Emperor's been murdered. On his own ship... moored in the inlet. It was... the Dark Brotherhood. There was nothing we could do...
traduit: 神啊。皇帝被刺杀了。就在自己停在港口的船里……黑暗兄弟会。我们什么都做不了……

original: That old woman who runs the orphanage has been murdered. Say, didn't I see you coming out of there...?
traduit: 管理孤儿院的老太太被杀了。诶，我是不是看见你从那里出来？

original: Been a murder, over in Riften. Some old lady who runs an orphanage. Those poor children must be heartbroken.
traduit: 有个开孤儿院的老太太被杀了，就在裂谷城。那些可怜的孩子一定很伤心吧。

original: Hey! You're the one who killed Alain Dufont, up in Raldbthar. Oh yeah, word about that got around. Man was a piece of bandit trash, is what I hear.
traduit: 嘿！是你在拉德巴塔尔杀了阿兰·杜峰特吧。啊对，这消息已经传遍了。我听说他是个强盗人渣。

original: The Emperor's cousin, killed. Right here in Solitude. I feel nothing but shame...
traduit: 皇帝的表妹被杀了。就在独孤城。我感到很羞愧……

original: The cousin of the Emperor was murdered! In Solitude, at her own damn wedding. Not a chance we would have let that happen here.
traduit: 皇帝的表妹被杀了！就在独孤城里，还是她自己的婚礼上。我们绝不会让这种事发生在这里。

original: You didn't hear this from me, but we've uncovered a plot to kill the Emperor! It gets better. The ringleader? One of the Emperor's own elite guard...
traduit: 别说是我说的，但我们发现了一个刺杀皇帝的阴谋！还有更劲爆的。知道主谋吗？是皇帝自己的精英护卫之一……

original: There was some ruckus over by that weird black door. You weren't involved in that craziness, were you?
traduit: 那扇奇怪的黑门旁边有骚动。你没卷进那件疯狂的事里吧？

original: Been lots of people coming and going through that creepy black door. And noises...  I'd say it sounds like construction, but that's crazy. Right?
traduit: 有好些人从那扇奇怪的黑门那里进进出出。还有声音……听起来像是有建筑。但这听着太疯狂了对吧？

original: There are some that say the Dark Brotherhood is back, and stronger than ever. That they've made Dawnstar their home. Tell me - am I wrong?
traduit: 有人说黑暗兄弟会回来了，而且比以前更强了。还在晨星安了家。快告诉我，是我错了吧？

original: The guards have been saying things about you... That you're the one that... Well... They say the Dark Brotherhood... Well. Never mind. Sir.
traduit: 卫兵们都在说你的事……说你是……呃……黑暗兄弟会的成员……好吧。没什么事。先生。

original: The guards have been saying things about you... That you're the one that... Well... They say the Dark Brotherhood... Well. Never mind. Ma'am.
traduit: 卫兵们都在说你的事……说你是……呃……黑暗兄弟会的成员……好吧。没什么事。女士。

original: Wait, I know you. You went into the Emperor's Tower, just before... before his decoy was murdered...
traduit: 等等，我认识你。你进了皇帝塔，就在……就在他的替身被杀前……

original: We just received word that somebody tried to kill the Emperor! Turned out to just be his double, but can you imagine if he had succeeded?
traduit: 我们刚收到消息说有人杀皇帝！结果死的是他的替身，但你能想象他成功了会怎么样吗？

original: They're saying the Dark Brotherhood has been destroyed. Wiped off the face off Tamriel. But that's not entirely true... is it?
traduit: 他们说黑暗兄弟会被摧毁了。从泰姆瑞尔除名了。但这可说不准……对吧？

original: You're the one all the guards are talking about. You went into that Sanctuary... wiped out the Dark Brotherhood! Friend, I owe you a drink.
traduit: 所有卫兵都在谈论你啊。你杀进圣所……消灭了黑暗兄弟会！朋友，我欠你一杯酒。

original: The city's changed, friend. The Thieves Guild is on the rise... and they've got a firm foothold here in Whiterun.
traduit: 这个城市变了，朋友。盗贼公会正在崛起……他们在白漫城站稳脚了。

original: Maybe you haven't heard, but the Thieves Guild is back. Windhelm is their city now, if you catch my meaning...
traduit: 也许你没听说，但盗贼公会又回来了。风舵城现在成了他们的天下，你明白我说的是啥……

original: Markarth's a different place, now. Do business here, and you do business with the Thieves Guild.
traduit: 马卡斯现在不一样了。在这里做生意就是和盗贼公会做生意。

original: A change has swept into Solitude, like a breeze off the ocean - the Thieves Guild has come...
traduit: 一场变化席卷了独孤城，就像微风吹拂大海一样，盗贼公会来了……

original: Ain't no doubt about it. The Thieves Guild is back, and they've got Riften in their grip.
traduit: 毫无疑问。盗贼公会回来了，他们已经控制了裂谷城。

original: Welcome to Riften, home of the Thieves Guild. Or so they'd have you believe. It's all lies. They're just thugs... vermin, creeping around the Ratway.
traduit: 欢迎来到裂谷城，盗贼公会之家。别信那套。这些都是谎言。他们不过是群恶棍……是在鼠道里爬行的害虫而已。

original: The say the College has been snooping around Saarthal. Mages in a burial crypt. No good can come of that...
traduit: 听说学院在萨瑟尔附近探查。法师跑进墓穴去。没什么好结果……

original: Some are saying the Psijic Monks have been seen in Skyrim. They're an ancient order. I had 'em figured for dead.
traduit: 有人说赛伊克僧侣在天际现身了。他们可是很古老的教团了。我还以为他们已经死绝了呢。

original: You hear the news? Those damn mages blew up Winterhold! Guess it was just a matter of time...
traduit: 你听说了吗？那群该死的法师炸了冬堡！我以前就觉得这是个时间问题……

original: Word is the College of Mages is back to normal. If there's such a thing for that lot.
traduit: 听说法师学院恢复正常了。如果他们真有正常可言的话。

original: Your name's been cleared... by Thonar Silver-Blood. Consider yourself lucky.
traduit: 你能洗脱罪名……全仗着托纳尔·银血。认便宜去吧。

original: So Madanach was behind those murders. Gods help us.
traduit: 所以迈德纳奇是那些谋杀的幕后黑手啊。老天保佑。

original: By Shor, is that... is that Azura's Star? How did you come to possess such a rare treasure?
traduit: 舒尔在上，那是……阿祖拉之星？你是怎么得到这种宝贝的？

original: Who did you have to kill to get that blade?
traduit: 你杀了谁才拿到那把刀的？

original: That is one... big hammer.
traduit: 好个……大锤子。

original: That mace... get it away from me. Get it away...
traduit: 那个钉锤……离我远点。把它拿开……

original: Your shield... Dwarf-make, is it not? But yet it seems so much... more.
traduit: 你那盾牌是……矮人造的？但是好像……不太一样啊。

original: That hammer... Why that's Aegisbane, heirloom of Clan Shatter-Shield! Last I heard, it was stolen by a couple of swindlers. Alain and... Muiri. Yeah.
traduit: 那把锤子……不是神盾之祸么。碎盾氏族的传家宝！我记得它被俩骗子偷走了。一个叫阿兰……还有一个暮蕊。没错。

original: What a foul and unnatural weapon you wield. Never have I seen its like.
traduit: 你的武器真是又肮脏又不自然。我还没见过这样的。

original: Ugh. Your breath is foul. What've you been eating?
traduit: 啊。你嘴怎么这么臭。吃什么了？

original: As if Skyrim didn't have enough outsiders. Now we've got mercenaries from Hammerfell struttin' about...
traduit: 好像天际的外来户还不够多似的。现在还有从落锤来的雇佣兵在四处乱晃……

original: From what I hear, you're the one gave the Thalmor a black eye. Sure know how to pick your enemies, don't you?
traduit: 我听说，你把梭默揍得鼻青脸肿的。你可真会挑对头啊？

original: You've come to Dawnstar at a strange time, friend. Seems everyone in the town is having nightmares...
traduit: 你来晨星不是时候啊，朋友。现在镇上所有人好像都在做噩梦……

original: The damned nightmares have finally stopped. Don't suppose you'd know anything about that?
traduit: 该死的噩梦终于停止了。你知道这事儿吗？

original: You've been seen in the company of the Companions. That's an honorable path you're on, friend.
traduit: 有人看见你加入战友团了。你走的可是很光荣的道路，朋友。

original: I know of your deeds, and am honored to address a member of the Companions.
traduit: 我听说过你的事迹，能够跟战友交谈我感觉很荣幸。

original: Uch. Been tending your hounds? You smell like wet dog.
traduit: 啊。出去遛狗了？怎么闻着像个落水狗一样。

original: Heard about what you did. Killing those foul witches. Well done, Companion.
traduit: 听说你把那些邪恶的女巫杀了。干得好啊，战友。

original: Kodlak killed, Jorrvaskr attacked. How could this happen, within the walls of Whiterun?
traduit: 克拉科被杀了，月瓦斯卡被袭击。怎么会在白漫城发生这种事？

original: I heard about the attack on Jorrvaskr, and the killing of your honored leader. You have my sympathies, Companion.
traduit: 我听说月瓦斯卡被袭击了，你们敬爱的领袖也牺牲了。为你感到惋惜，战友。

original: Kodlak White-Mane has been laid to rest, I know. May his soul live forever in the halls of Sovngarde.
traduit: 听说“白鬃”克拉科已经安葬了。愿他的灵魂在松加德的殿堂中永生。

original: You... you're the Harbinger. Of the Companions. It is my honor to stand before you.
traduit: 你……你是战友团的，先驱。能站在您面前我很是荣幸。

original: I hear the East Empire Company has reopened, thanks in no small part to you. Well done. All of Skyrim benefits from their trade.
traduit: 我听说东帝国公司要重新开张了。据说你功劳不小。干得好。天际所有人都能从他们的贸易中受益。

original: You did this city a great service by catching that killer. Well done.
traduit: 你抓住了凶手，帮了城市的大忙了。干得好。

original: Good thing you did for Nurelion, retrieving that phial for him before he died. Man was obsessed.
traduit: 你帮努瑞莱昂干了件好事，在他死前帮他找回了那个小药瓶。他痴迷那玩意很久了。

original: By Ysmir, you've helped save the Gildergreen. Words can't express what that means to this city.
traduit: 伊斯米尔在上，你拯救了镀绿树。这对这座城市的意义无法形容。

original: That sapling you recovered means the Gildergreen will live again. Your deed honors the people of Whiterun.
traduit: 你找回那棵树苗意味着镀绿树又复活了。你为白漫人帮了大忙了。

original: You've actually done it. You've found the Sybil of Dibella. You have done Markarth a tremendous service.
traduit: 你真的办到了。找回迪贝拉的女预言家。帮马卡斯大忙了。

original: You... you were talking to that murderous savage. And then he escaped. What are you hiding?
traduit: 你……你怎么跟那个凶残的野蛮人说话。然后他还逃走了。你在隐瞒什么？

original: First Torygg and now Elisif. Damn those Stormcloaks. Let's hope that Erikur fares better than they did.
traduit: 先是托依格，又是艾利西弗。该死的风暴斗篷。希望艾瑞库尔表现比他们好吧。

original: Filthy she-hound Elisif got what she deserved. Let her serve as "High Queen" of Oblivion, for all I care.
traduit: 艾利西弗那个臭母狗遭报应了。让她滚去湮灭做她的“至高女王”吧。

original: Solitude wouldn't be the same without the Fire Festival. City owes you a debt of gratitude.
traduit: 要是没有了火烧节，独孤城都会不一样。全城都欠你一个人情啊。

original: It's no secret the Aretino boy is doing some ritual, trying to call the Dark Brotherhood. But who's going to stop him? Me? I'll have no part of that.
traduit: 大家都知道艾瑞提诺那小子在搞什么仪式想召唤黑暗兄弟会。但谁又能制止他呢？我？我可不想掺和。

original: Whoa, whoa, whoa! Watch the magic!
traduit: 喔，喔，喔！小心点那个魔法！

original: Go cast your fancy magic someplace else.
traduit: 到别处显摆你那神奇的魔法吧。

original: Guard might get nervous, a man approaches with his weapon drawn...
traduit: 当有人拿着武器靠近，卫兵可是会紧张的……

original: Guard might get nervous, a woman approaches with her weapon drawn...
traduit: 当有人拿着武器靠近，卫兵可是会紧张的……

original: Sheathe those claws, Khajiit...
traduit: 把你爪子套上，卡吉特……

original: You come up to me, fists raised? You looking for a beating?
traduit: 你举着拳头奔我来？欠揍吗？

original: Releasing a captured dragon. I don't think I'll ever understand that one...
traduit: 放掉一头抓来的龙。我是永远理解不了这句话…………

original: Whatever you need, Dragonborn. Just say the word.
traduit: 龙裔，无论你需要什么。尽管开口。

original: Yes, Dovahkiin? How can I help you?
traduit: 嗯，都瓦克因？有什么需要吗？

original: You have vanquished a great evil from Skyrim. You have saved this land... and our very souls.
traduit: 你击败了天际的大恶魔。拯救了这片土地……还有我们的灵魂。

original: No matter what else happens, the guards will always be grateful for everything you've done.
traduit: 不管发生什么，卫兵们都会对你所做的一切心怀感激的。

original: Looks like it's really happening. A peace council, attended by both Ulfric and Tullius, up on High Hrothgar. Maybe there's hope for Skyrim yet.
traduit: 看起来是来真的了。乌弗瑞克和图留斯要在霍斯加修道院举行和平会议。也许天际还有希望。

original: This truce with the Stormcloaks won't last a fortnight. Bloody savages will kill us while we sleep.
traduit: 和风暴斗篷的休战不会超过两周。那群该死的蛮子肯定会趁我们睡觉的时候来偷袭。

original: A truce? With the Imperials? They'll murder us all, first chance they get.
traduit: 休战？和帝国人？他们一逮着机会机会杀我们。

original: I caught a glimpse of that captured dragon. It's.. beautiful. In its own way.
traduit: 我瞥见了那头被捕的龙。真是……美丽啊。就它自己的方式来说。

original: Trapping a dragon in Dragonsreach. Damn clever idea you had, I have to admit.
traduit: 在龙临宫抓头龙。我得说，你这主意真他妈聪明。

original: You have the Jarl's confidence, friend. And so you have mine.
traduit: 你得到领主的信任了，朋友。还有我的。

original: You couldn't possibly be the Dragonborn of legend. Could you?
traduit: 你不可能是传说中的龙裔。对吧？

original: If we killed a dragon once, we can do it again. With your help, of course.
traduit: 如果我们杀过龙，那就能再杀一次。当然，是要有你的帮助。

original: If those Whiterun guards can take down a dragon, so can we.
traduit: 如果那些白漫卫兵能干掉一头龙，那我们也成。

original: Got to thinking, maybe I'm the Dragonborn, and I just don't know it yet.
traduit: 我在想，也许我是龙裔。只是我还不知道。

original: For a dragon to attack Kynesgrove... Why? Why there? Is no place safe?
traduit: 一头龙攻击了凯娜之林……为什么？为什么会是那儿？难道就没有安全的地方了吗？

original: If I'd been on guard at the Thalmor Embassy, wouldn't nobody be disturbing that party...
traduit: 如果当时在梭默大使馆站岗的是我，那就不会有人大闹宴会了……

original: Thalmor in the Ratway? What's next, Spriggans in the Bee and Barb?
traduit: 梭默在鼠道里？接下来是哪儿，蜂与钩吗？

original: I have to wonder... what does the Dragonborn do once he's summoned by the Greybeards? Can the Thu'um be taught, like any skill?
traduit: 我想知道……龙裔被灰胡子召唤后会做什么？吐'目也能像其他技能一样传授吗？

original: You know, I could have gone into that Sanctuary. Killed all those Dark Brotherhood types. But I was... sick that day.
traduit: 你知道吗，我本可以去圣所的。杀光所有黑暗兄弟会。但……那天我生病了。

original: Helgen... destroyed by a dragon. Hard to believe, isn't it?
traduit: 海尔根……被龙给摧毁了。很难相信吧？

original: I know who you are, assassin. I guess the rumors about your kind's "extinction" have been... exaggerated.
traduit: 我知道你是谁，刺客。我猜你们那伙儿“灭绝”的谣言是……被夸大了。

original: So the Emperor had a decoy. Poor bastard got murdered, too. But then, I guess that was his job...
traduit: 所以皇帝还备了一个替身。可怜的家伙也被谋杀了。但我想……那就是他的工作吧……

original: Now, I know who you are. And... and I know your business... Just, please... These are good folk we got here. Mostly...
traduit: 我知道你是谁。还有……我知道你的买卖……只是，拜托……我们这里都是好人。大多数都是的……

original: It ain't true what they say about you and... and the Dark Brotherhood? Is it?
traduit: 他们说你在和……黑暗兄弟会一起？真的？

original: There are stories about you, and dark tidings in Dawnstar...
traduit: 有关于你的传言了，说晨星有黑暗的消息……

original: Seems the Emperor's coming to Skyrim... and one of his own protectors was going to have him assassinated. Can't trust anyone these days.
traduit: 看来皇帝要来天际了……他的一个护卫还要暗杀他。这年头没有可信的人了。

original: I heard you were at the wedding of the Emperor's cousin. In Solitude? Gods, that must have been horrible...
traduit: 我听说你参加皇帝表妹的婚礼了。是在独孤吗？神啊，那一定很可怕……

original: Look, that Vici woman had a bodyguard. I know it's terrible she got murdered at her own wedding, but the city guard is hardly to blame...
traduit: 维齐家那个女人还有个保镖。我知道她在自己婚礼上被刺杀是很糟糕，但也不能怪城里的卫兵……

original: You ask me, those brats in the orphanage are better off, now that old Grelod is dead.
traduit: 要我说，现在老桂罗死了，孤儿院的孩子们也就好过了。

original: The Emperor's cousin Vittoria Vici is getting married soon. The reception will be public - anyone in Solitude can attend.
traduit: 皇帝的表妹维托利亚·维齐要结婚了。婚宴是公开的，谁都可以去参加。

original: The Emperor of Skyrim. Dead. These are dark times, my friend. Dark times, indeed...
traduit: 天际的皇帝。死了。这是个黑暗的时代，朋友。太黑暗了……

original: We may guard Whiterun, but the Thieves Guild guards us. If you know what I mean.
traduit: 我们护着白漫城，但盗贼公会护着我们。你懂的。

original: Shirking the law in Windhelm ain't what it used to be. Not with the Thieves Guild running things...
traduit: 在风舵城想逃避法律已经不像从前那样了。自从盗贼公会开始掌控一切以后……

original: Break the law here in Markarth, and maybe we can work something out. Courtesy of the Thieves Guild.
traduit: 在马卡斯城犯法，也许我们能拿出点办法。多亏了盗贼公会啊。

original: You know, the law here in Solitude can be a bit... "flexible." So long as you've got the gold. That's the way the Thieves Guild likes it.
traduit: 你知道，这里的法律可能会有点……“灵活”。只要你有金币就行。盗贼公会喜欢这样。

original: Seeing as how Riften is home to the Thieves Guild, maybe we can work something out if you have trouble with the law. For the right price.
traduit: 既然裂谷城是盗贼公会的总部，那只要是法律上的问题，我们都能解决。只要价钱合适。

original: The Thieves Guild used to run this city. Now they're nothing but braggarts and bullies, rotting to death down in their Ratway...
traduit: 这个城市以前被盗贼公会掌控。可现在他们就是群自卖自夸的刁棍，在他们那个鼠道里腐烂到死……

original: What business do College mages have in a place like Saarthal, anyway? It's a place for Nord dead... not your weird experiments.
traduit: 学院的法师到萨瑟尔这种地方搞什么名堂？这是埋葬诺德死者的地方……不是用来搞你们那些奇怪实验的。

original: One of the guards said he saw a mage appear out of thin air. Claimed it was one of those Psijic Monks. Man's been hitting the skooma, I say.
traduit: 有个卫兵跟我说他看见有个法师突然出现。说那是赛伊克僧侣。要我说，那家伙是斯库玛嗑多了。

original: Imagine, blowing up an entire town. Damn College... Winterhold will never be the same.
traduit: 想象一下，把整个城镇都炸了。该死的学院……把冬堡搞得面目全非的。

original: You're that Mage from the College. Right? Hear things have finally calmed down over there.
traduit: 你是学院的法师吧？听说那边终于安定下来了。

original: You put those Forsworn down. Good job.
traduit: 你干掉了那群弃誓者啊。干得好。

original: Gods damn those Forsworn. So many dead...
traduit: 该死的弃誓者。杀了多少人……

original: You see those warriors from Hammerfell? They've got curved swords. Curved. Swords.
traduit: 你看见那些落锤来的战士了吗？他们的剑是弯的。剑，是弯的。

original: Wonder what it's like for those Thalmor, now that they've been taken down a notch...
traduit: 这回那些梭默被狠狠地挫了锐气，真想知道他们是什么表情。

original: The people here are still plagued with nightmares. It's... unnatural.
traduit: 这里的人还在被噩梦困扰。这……不正常。

original: No more nightmares. Thank the gods for that.
traduit: 噩梦不见了。谢天谢地。

original: Now I remember - you're that new member of the Companions. So you, what - fetch the mead?
traduit: 我想起来了，你是战友团的新成员啊。你平时是在伺候蜜酒吗？

original: Honored Companion. How can I assist you?
traduit: 尊敬的战友。我能为您做些什么吗？

original: Is that... fur? Coming out of your ears?
traduit: 那是……毛吗？从你耳朵里冒出来的？

original: I'm telling you, I heard it. Howling. Those werewolf tales are true.
traduit: 我跟你说，我真听见了。嚎叫。狼人的传说是真的。

original: I find your wolfish grin... unsettling.
traduit: 你笑起来跟个狼似的……吓人。

original: With respect, Companion, I'd ask that you and your friends muzzle that dog of yours. The howling coming from Jorrvaskr has gotten out of hand.
traduit: 没别的意思，战友。我是想请你和你的朋友们给自己家狗带上嚼子。月瓦斯卡的咆哮声太失控了。

original: If it isn't the slayer of the Glenmoril Witches. How can I assist you, Companion?
traduit: 这不是格伦摩利女巫的屠杀者吗。有什么需要吗，战友？

original: Who would dare attack the leader of the Companions? In his own hall? There'll be blood for this, I know it.
traduit: 是谁敢袭击战友团的领袖？还是在他自己的大厅里？我知道，他们肯定吃不了兜着走。

original: Kodlak White-Mane is in a better place now. For is there any place better than Sovngarde?
traduit: “白鬃”克拉科找到好地方了。还有比松加德更好的归宿吗？

original: Thanks again for helping reopen the East Empire Company. Gonna have them import me some of that aged Breton cheese.
traduit: 再次感谢你帮忙让东帝国公司重新开张了。得让他们帮我进些老布莱顿奶酪。

original: I was this close to catching that killer. I swear it.
traduit: 我就差一点就能抓住凶手了。我发誓。

original: With Nurelion gone, I suppose Quintus has taken over business in the White Phial.
traduit: 努瑞莱昂死了，现在应该是奎因图斯接管白瓶了吧。

original: The Gildergreen blooms again. All thanks to you.
traduit: 镀绿树重新绽放了。多亏了你啊。

original: The Gildergreen will bloom again. All thanks to you.
traduit: 镀绿树将会重新绽放。这都要感谢你啊。

original: Thanks for clearing out that vampire nest. You saved Morthal.
traduit: 谢谢你清理了那个吸血鬼巢穴。你救了莫萨尔。

original: Wonder what kinds of things they've got the Dibella doing, over in the temple. Mostly praying, I reckon...
traduit: 不知道她们在迪贝拉神殿里做什么。大概是在祈祷吧……

original: I know you had some part in Sinding's escape. Don't deny it...
traduit: 我知道你参与了辛丁越狱的事。别否认了……

original: We'll protect Erikur as best we're able, but I fear the throne of Solitude is cursed.
traduit: 我们会尽全力保护艾瑞库尔，但恐怕独孤王位是被诅咒了。

original: It is whispered that one of the Daedric Princes himself is behind the murder of Elisif. It would seem even the nobility of Oblivion favors our cause.
traduit: 据说某个迪德拉君王是杀害艾利西弗的幕后黑手。看来湮灭的至高存在也要支持我们的事业啊。

original: Watch the skies, traveler.
traduit: 小心天上，旅行者。

original: Stay out of trouble, Argonian.
traduit: 别惹麻烦，阿尔贡。

original: What is it, Argonian?
traduit: 怎么了，阿尔贡？

original: Stay out of trouble, lizard.
traduit: 别惹麻烦，蜥蜴。

original: Staying out of trouble, kinsman?
traduit: 可要离麻烦远点啊，老乡。

original: How can I help a brother Nord?
traduit: 我的诺德兄弟有什么需要帮忙吗？

original: Stay out of trouble, Nord.
traduit: 别惹麻烦，诺德人。

original: Don't cross me, Elf.
traduit: 别惹我，精灵。

original: Stay out of trouble, Elf.
traduit: 别惹麻烦，精灵。

original: What is it, Elf?
traduit: 有事吗，精灵？

original: Stay out of trouble, Khajiit.
traduit: 别惹麻烦，卡吉特。

original: What is it, Khajiit?
traduit: 怎么了，卡吉特？

original: What do you want... cat?
traduit: 想干嘛……小猫？

original: Stay out of trouble, Redguard.
traduit: 别惹麻烦，红卫人。

original: What is it, Redguard?
traduit: 怎么了，红卫人？

original: Stay out of trouble, Imperial.
traduit: 别惹麻烦，帝国人。

original: What is it, Imperial?
traduit: 怎么了，帝国人？

original: Stay out of trouble, Orc.
traduit: 别惹麻烦，兽人。

original: What is it, Orc?
traduit: 怎么了，兽人？

original: Hail, Companion.
traduit: 向战友致敬。

original: You're that one from the College. Heard about you.
traduit: 你是学院的人吧。听说过你。

original: So you can cast a few spells. Am I supposed to be impressed?
traduit: 这么说你会摆弄些法术咯？我应该感到惊讶吗？

original: Try to hide it all you want. I know you're in the Thieves Guild... and so do the other guards.
traduit: 你想怎么隐瞒随便。但我知道你是盗贼公会的……别的卫兵也一样。

original: Psst. Hey, I know who you are. Hail Sithis.
traduit: 嘘。我知道你是谁。西帝斯万岁。

original: Ugh. That armor stinks of death. You been grave robbing?
traduit: 啊。那身盔甲散着死亡的气息。你去盗墓了？

original: Ah, now that's a fine shield. And not mere Dwarven... is it?
traduit: 啊，这盾牌真不错。而且不单单是矮人做的……对吧？

original: What manner of staff is that? Such a horror...
traduit: 那是什么法杖？太恐怖了……

original: You wield... Azura's Star? How... how can such a thing be possible?
traduit: 你拿着……阿祖拉之星？这……这怎么可能？

original: Ah, Aegisbane. Sigil of Clan Shatter-Shield. But didn't that get stolen awhile back? Hmph. Must be rememberin' wrong.
traduit: 啊，神盾之祸。碎盾家族的传家宝。但那不是被偷了吗？嗯。一定是我记错了。

original: Fine armor you've got there. Dwarven make, am I right?
traduit: 你这盔甲不错啊。矮人造的吧？

original: Ebony armor. By Ysmir, 'tis a wondrous sight.
traduit: 黑檀盔甲。伊斯米尔啊，太好看了。

original: Is your armor made of... dragon bones? By the gods, what I wouldn't do for a set of that.
traduit: 你这盔甲是……龙骨的？天啊，我要是有这么一身让我做什么都行。

original: Is your armor made of... dragon scales? By the gods, what I wouldn't do for a set of that.
traduit: 你这盔甲是……龙鳞的？天啊，我要是有这么一身让我做什么都行。

original: Some advice, friend. That armor won't offer much protection in a real fight.
traduit: 给你个建议，朋友。那盔甲在真正的战斗里可挡不住什么。

original: You come talking to me wearing Imperial armor? You got stew for brains?
traduit: 你穿着帝国的盔甲来和我聊天？你脑子进水了？

original: That's some fine Imperial armor you've got there.
traduit: 你身上的帝国甲不错啊。

original: Judging by your armor, I'd say you're an Imperial scout. If so, well met.
traduit: 按你的盔甲看，你应该是帝国的侦察兵吧。如果是那就太好了。

original: For your sake, I hope your took that armor from a dead Imperial scout...
traduit: 我希望你是从死了的帝国侦察兵那扒下来的盔甲……

original: You wear the armor of a mercenary. Now that's the life.
traduit: 你穿着佣兵的护甲。这就是生活啊。

original: That's good armor you've got there, friend. Iron, solid and true.
traduit: 你盔甲不错，朋友。铁的就是坚固又实在。

original: Hmph. You wear that armor well. Iron may be simple, but it'll stop enough to keep you in the fight.
traduit: 嗯。你的护甲不错。铁可能很简单，但它足以帮你挡很多伤害了。

original: Fancy the leather armor, huh? Something to be said for going light.
traduit: 喜欢穿皮制盔甲？为了活动更灵便吗？

original: That armor... it's like nothing I've ever seen. Like forged midnight...
traduit: 我还从没见过……那样的盔甲。简直就像把暗夜锻造起来了。

original: Orcish armor, hmm? Had me a set of that once. Ugly and strong, like those that forged it.
traduit: 兽人护甲啊？我以前也有一套。虽然丑但是够坚固。和锻造他们的兽人一样。

original: That armor... Are you one of the Emperor's protectors? Can't say I envy you that job.
traduit: 那身盔甲……你是皇帝的护卫？我可不羡慕你的差事。

original: That armor... Are you one of the Emperor's protectors? Not very good at your job, are you?
traduit: 那身盔甲……你是皇帝的护卫？差事不好当吧？

original: That's fine scale armor you've got on there. Shiny.
traduit: 你这身鳞甲真好。亮闪闪。

original: Aye, now that's some fine armor. Good old-fashioned steel.
traduit: 啊，这盔甲不错。传统的钢甲就是好。

original: Ah, steel plate. Now that's a solid choice of armor.
traduit: 啊，钢板甲。很可靠的护甲。

original: What do you aim to do with that hammer, friend? Knock down a house?
traduit: 你打算用那把锤子干什么，朋友？拆房子吗？

original: No.. get that accursed mace away from me...
traduit: 不……快把那该死的钉锤拿开……

original: You wear the armor of the bear, my friend. A fine choice.
traduit: 你穿上了熊的护甲，朋友。很好的选择。

original: You dare strut around here, wearing that filthy Stormcloak hide?
traduit: 你还敢穿着风暴斗篷的烂衣服搁这儿趾高气昂？

original: That Stormcloak armor's getting on my nerves...
traduit: 那件风暴斗篷护甲看得我心烦……

original: You wear that Stormcloak armor well, friend.
traduit: 你这身风暴斗篷甲很好，朋友。

original: You wear the armor of a brigand. Best not cause any trouble on my watch.
traduit: 你怎么穿着强盗的盔甲。在我眼皮底下最好别惹麻烦。

original: I know Thieves Guild armor when I see it. You're not fooling anyone.
traduit: 我一眼就认出来是盗贼公会的护甲了。你骗不了谁。

original: You wear the garb of a true Nord. I salute you.
traduit: 你穿着真正的诺德人装束。向你致敬。

original: Pigsticker like that's not going to get you far. Best visit the blacksmith.
traduit: 你身上的破烂用不了多久的。去铁匠铺看看吧。

original: That iron sword's pretty undependable. You should try steel.
traduit: 那把铁剑不太靠谱。你应该换把钢的。

original: Iron sword, huh? What are you killing, butterflies?
traduit: 铁剑？你想拿来杀什么？蝴蝶吗？

original: Aye, now that there's a beautiful sword. Like a sliver of midnight.
traduit: 嘿，真是把漂亮的剑。就像是午夜的利刃。

original: Why the Elven blade, hmm? Nord steel not good enough for you?
traduit: 为什么用精灵武器，嗯？诺德的钢配不上你吗？

original: Favor a steel sword, do ya? Good choice for slashing or stabbing.
traduit: 喜欢钢剑是吧？是砍是刺都是好选择。

original: I've a lot of respect for the Restoration School. Skyrim could use more healers.
traduit: 我很尊重恢复系学派。天际需要更多的医师。

original: Lightly armored means light on your feet. Smart.
traduit: 轻甲意味着腿脚灵便。聪明人。

original: Hey, you mix potions, right? Can you brew me an ale?
traduit: 嘿，你是药剂师吧？能帮我冲杯麦芽酒吗？

original: Hands to yourself, sneak thief.
traduit: 管好自己的手，小贼。

original: I find your hand in my pocket, I'm going to cut it off.
traduit: 如果发现你把手伸进我口袋里，我就剁了它。

original: I know your kind, always sneaking about.
traduit: 我知道你们这种人，总是偷偷摸摸的。

original: Go fiddling with any locks around here, we're going to have a real problem.
traduit: 你要是敢乱动这里的锁，那咱们就有麻烦事了。

original: Fancy yourself an alchemist, hmm? Never could get the hang of that.
traduit: 你是个炼金术士吗，嗯？我自己从来弄不懂那东西。

original: You're the one casts those illusions. Impressive.
traduit: 你会使幻术吗。挺厉害啊。

original: Don't think you can barter with me like I'm one of those damned shopkeepers.
traduit: 别以为我是那些该死的店主可以讨价还价。

original: Best offense is a good defense, am I right?
traduit: 最好的进攻就是防守，是吧？

original: Don't suppose you'd enchant my sword? Dull old blade can barely cut butter.
traduit: 你不会打算给我的剑附魔吧？这破刀片子连黄油都切不动。

original: Heard about you and your honeyed words...
traduit: 听说过你的那张小甜嘴儿。

original: Hail, summoner. Conjure me up a warm bed, would you?
traduit: 你好啊，召唤师。能帮我变张温暖的床吗？

original: Destruction magic's fine, just don't go burning down any buildings.
traduit: 要玩毁灭魔法没事儿，但别把房子点了。

original: Takes a fair bit of strength to carry a greatsword like that. But can you use it?
traduit: 拿这么把大剑可得费点力气。你用得动？

original: Keep your arrows in their quiver, archer.
traduit: 把你的箭收在箭袋里，弓箭手。

original: Favor the bow, eh? I'm a sword man, myself.
traduit: 喜欢用弓？我是使剑的。

original: The gods gave you two hands, and you use them both for your weapon. I can respect that.
traduit: 神给了你两只手，你都用来拿武器了。佩服。

original: You're like me, eh? Don't fancy those clunky two-handed weapons.
traduit: 你跟我一样啊？不喜欢那些笨重的双手武器。

original: No lollygaggin'.
traduit: 没工夫闲扯。

original: I heard the Gourmet is hiding out somewhere in Skyrim. You know, fella who wrote that cookbook.
traduit: 我听说“美食家”就藏在天际的某个地方。就是那个写食谱的人。

original: We got a nickname for anyone who trifles with us guards here in Windhelm - "Suicide."
traduit: 我们给那些敢在风舵城招惹我们卫兵的家伙取了个外号叫“找死的”。

original: I fear the night. Because the werewolves and vampires don't.
traduit: 我很害怕晚上。因为狼人和吸血鬼喜欢。

original: Bit late to be wandering around, isn't it?
traduit: 现在到处闲逛有些晚了吧？

original: Only burglars and vampires creep around after dark. So which are you?
traduit: 只有小偷和吸血鬼才会在天黑以后出来。你是哪种？

original: You hear that? I swear, there's something out there. In the dark.
traduit: 你听到了吗？我发誓，外面一定有什么东西。就藏在黑暗里。

original: Let me guess - someone stole your sweetroll...
traduit: 让我猜猜，有人偷了你的甜卷吧。

original: Could sure use a warm bed right about now...
traduit: 真想要张温暖的床啊……

original: I'd be a lot warmer and a lot happier with a bellyful of mead...
traduit: 喝点蜜酒真是暖和又快乐啊……

original: Just a few more hours and I can crawl under some furs...
traduit: 再过几个小时，我就能钻到毛毯下面睡大觉了……

original: Disrespect the law, and you disrespect me.
traduit: 蔑视法律就是蔑视我。

original: Thinking of settling in? There's a house for sale - Breezehome. You should talk to the steward up in the keep if you're interested.
traduit: 想在这里住下？刚好有栋房子要卖，叫微风阁。有兴趣的话，到城堡里找总管谈谈。

original: You're that one lives in Breezehome, right? Fine place. Almost bought it myself.
traduit: 你就是住在微风阁的那个吧？是个好地方。我差点就买下来了。

original: Hjerim is a fine house, and it's up for sale. You should talk to the steward in the keep if you're interested.
traduit: 霜斋是个好宅子。现在要对外出售了。有兴趣的话可以去城堡找总管谈谈。

original: Don't think you'll get special treatment just because you have a house in the city...
traduit: 别以为你在城里有房就有特殊待遇了……

original: My heart goes out to Clan Shatter-Shield. Kin murdered, family warhammer stolen... There's no fairness in all that.
traduit: 真同情碎盾氏族，亲人被杀，祖传的战锤被偷……这不公平。

original: Proudspire Manor, now there's a fine home. Up for sale, too. If you're interested, talk to the steward, in the keep.
traduit: 豪塔别墅是个好房子。现在正在出售。有兴趣的话就去找总管谈谈吧，就在城堡里。

original: You own Proudspire Manor, hmm? Beautiful house. At least from the outside.
traduit: 豪塔别墅归你了？挺漂亮的房子。至少从外面看不错。

original: If you're looking to settle in Riften, there's a house for sale - Honeyside. See the steward in the keep if you want it.
traduit: 如果你想在裂谷城定居。正好有栋房子在出售，甜蜜湾。想要的话就去城堡找总管吧。

original: Smart thing you did, buying Honeyside. Nice place, and why pay for an inn?
traduit: 买下甜蜜湾真是个明智之举。干嘛要花钱住旅店呢？

original: Ah, Vlindrel Hall's a fine home, if you can afford it. The steward in the keep can tell you more.
traduit: 啊，要是你买得起的话，林德尔会堂是个不错的房子。城堡里的总管会和你详细介绍的。

original: So you bought Vlindrel Hall, eh? Wish I could afford a house that nice.
traduit: 所以你把林德尔会堂买下来了？真希望我也能买得起这么好的房子。

original: They say Ulfric Stormcloak murdered the High King... with his voice! Shouted him apart!
traduit: 他们说乌弗瑞克谋杀了至高王……用吼声！把他喊得震碎了！

original: What is it? Dragons?
traduit: 怎么了？有龙吗？

original: My cousin's out fighting dragons, and what do I get? Guard duty.
traduit: 我表哥出去和龙战斗了，我呢？就是巡逻。

original: Gotta keep my eyes open. Damned dragons could swoop down at any time.
traduit: 我得睁大眼睛。该死的龙族随时都可能来袭击。

original: I used to be an adventurer like you. Then I took an arrow in the knee...
traduit: 我以前和你一样也是冒险家。直到我的膝盖中了一箭……

original: Everything all right?
traduit: 一切都好吧？

original: Trouble?
traduit: 有麻烦？

original: Staying safe, I hope?
traduit: 但愿一切都好吧？

original: I mostly deal with petty thievery and drunken brawls. Been too long since we've had a good bandit raid.
traduit: 我总是在处理小偷小摸和酒后斗殴。已经很久没遇到一次像样的强盗袭击了。

original: The Imperials think we need their laws. Pfft.
traduit: 帝国人觉得我们需要他们的法律。啊我呸。

original: The Imperials think us all lawless beasts. I'm proof of their ignorance.
traduit: 帝国人觉得我们是无法无天的野兽。我会证明他们有多无知。

original: 'Tis a wicked axe you wield there, friend. That blade looks sharp enough to cut through a god.
traduit: 你挥舞的那把战斧够邪恶的啊，朋友，看起来连神都能切开似的。

original: You're the one saved the Fire Festival. I remember.
traduit: 是你挽救了火烧节。我还记得你。

original: What do you need, bard?
traduit: 有什么需要吗，吟游诗人？

original: WhiterunInnkeeperRumorsBranchTopic
traduit: WhiterunInnkeeperRumorsBranchTopic

original: The Companions? In Jorrvaskr? They're recruiting new members, from what I hear.
traduit: 战友团？月瓦斯卡？我听说他们在招新人。

original: Give me the latest gossip.
traduit: 跟我说说最近的小道消息。

original: Yes, and here's what was in the safe.
traduit: 没错，然后这是保险柜里的东西。

original: At least you remembered one of the things I asked. Let me see that.
traduit: 至少你还记得我让你做的事。让我看看。

original: Sorry. Here's what was in the safe.
traduit: 抱歉。这是保险柜里的东西。

original: Let me take a look at what you found.
traduit: 我来看看你发现了什么。

original: Why did this make you attack the girl?
traduit: 你为什么袭击那个女孩？

original: I had just come into Falkreath. They needed some help working the mill, and I thought that would be something safe. Something I could do.
traduit: 我刚刚来佛克瑞斯。他们想雇人在磨坊工作。我觉得应该很安全，而且力所能及。

original: When I saw the little girl, I was just... I could feel it coming on. I could taste the... I needed to hunt.
traduit: 直到我看到那个小女孩，我只是……感觉到了。我能够尝到……渴望狩猎的滋味。

original: But this pitiful, limited body wasn't meant for hunting. Slow. No claws. Weak, mashing teeth for chewing cud.
traduit: 但这个可怜而有限的肉体没法用来打猎。速度迟钝，没有爪子。而且只有一口能用咀嚼的磨牙。

original: I held in my rage as long as I could. But it boiled inside of me.
traduit: 我已经在尽全力抑制体内的躁动。但它还是在不断沸腾。

original: She looked so fragile. Helpless prey. And then...
traduit: 她看上去那么脆弱。像个无助的猎物。然后……

original: I... I feel terrible about what happened. About what I did. It would probably be best for everyone if I just went away.
traduit: 我……我为所做的一切感到懊悔。我还是应该远离大家。

original: I'll take the ring to Hircine.
traduit: 我会把戒指还给海尔辛的。

original: Oh my. You would do this for me? Here, take it. I don't want anything to do with this wretched thing anymore.
traduit: 哦。你愿意帮我？来，拿着吧。我不想再和这见鬼的东西扯上关系了。

original: Seek out the beast. He wanders these woods. Bring him down and... well, the Lord of the Hunt should smile on you.
traduit: 去寻找那头野兽。它就在树林里游荡。猎杀它……就能取悦狩猎之王。

original: I wish you luck, but should leave here while I still have my skin.
traduit: 祝你好运，但我还得趁自己的皮还在，赶紧离开。

original: Should our paths cross again, I will remember your kindness. Farewell.
traduit: 如果再次相遇，我会记得你的好处。告辞。

original: What kind of transformations?
traduit: 什么样的变化？

original: I don't suppose there's a point in keeping the secret if I'm going to die in here anyway.
traduit: 反正我会死在这儿了，保守秘密也没什么意义。

original: I'm sure you've heard of men who shift to beasts under the influence of the moons.
traduit: 你肯定听过，人类在月亮的影响下变成猛兽的传闻。

original: I am one of them. A werewolf. It's my secret, and my shame.
traduit: 我就是其中之一。我是狼人。这既是秘密，也是耻辱。

original: That's why I wanted the ring... it was said to give men like me control.
traduit: 所以我才想要这个戒指……据说它能让人掌握变身的主动权。

original: Now I may look like a man, but I still feel the animal inside of me, as strong as ever.
traduit: 现在我看似一个人类，但我能感受到内在的野兽如以前一样强壮。

original: What ring?
traduit: 什么戒指？

original: This is the Ring of Hircine. I was told it could let me control my transformations.
traduit: 海尔辛的戒指。我听说，只要得到它，我就能控制变身能力。

original: Perhaps it used to. But I'll never know. Hircine didn't care for my taking it, and threw a curse on it.
traduit: 或许它过去有那种奇效。可惜我永远没法验证了。海尔辛不愿让我拿走，甚至还施加了诅咒。

original: I put it on... and the changes just came to me. I could never guess when. It would be at the worst times.
traduit: 戴上了它之后……就会突然变化。我永远想不到变化什么时候会发生。但总是在最糟糕的时刻。

original: Like... with the little girl.
traduit: 就像……和那个小女孩在一起时。

original: Who did this?
traduit: 谁干的？

original: Sinding. Came through as a laborer. Seemed like a decent man.
traduit: 辛丁。来这里做工。看上去很正派的一个人。

original: He's stewing in the pit while we figure out what to do with him, if you've got the stomach to look at him.
traduit: 他被关在牢坑里，等待处置。如果不怕反胃，可以去看看。

original: What could drive a man to do something like this?
traduit: 一个人怎能作出这种事？

original: How did she die?
traduit: 她是怎么死的？

original: She was... he ripped her apart. Like a sabre cat tears a deer. We barely found enough of her to bury.
traduit: 她被……撕成了碎片。就像剑齿虎把麋鹿扯开那样。我们甚至没法找全她的尸体安葬。

original: Who died?
traduit: 谁死了？

original: Our daughter. Our little girl. She hadn't seen her tenth winter.
traduit: 我们的女儿。我们的小女儿。她还没有度过十岁的冬天。

original: You take care of yourself, now. And if you ever find yourself in New Sheoth, do look me up. We can share a strawberry torte. Ta ta!
traduit: 照顾好自己吧。要是哪天你到了新谢尔斯，一定来找我，我们可以一起吃草莓蛋糕。拜拜！

original: And as for you, my little mortal minion... Feel free to keep the Wabbajack. As a symbol of my... Oh, just take the damn thing.
traduit: 至于你，凡人小奴才……你留着瓦巴杰克吧。作为我的……哦，赶紧拿走那破玩意儿。

original: Yes, yes, that's quite enough celebration. Let's send you ahead, shall we?
traduit: 没错没错，庆祝够了吧。我们先把你送走成吗？

original: Master! You've taken me back! Does this mean we're going home? Oh, happy times! I can't wait to...
traduit: 主人！你把我带回来了！是不是要回家了？哦，太好了！我快等不及了……

original: Luggage! Now where did I leave my luggage?
traduit: 行李！我把行李放哪儿了？

original: Let's make sure I'm not forgetting anything. Clothes? Check. Beard? Check! Luggage?
traduit: 确认一下有没有忘东西。衣服？带了。胡子？带了！行李？

original: Well, I suppose it's back to the Shivering Isles. The trouble Haskill can get into while I'm gone simply boggles the mind...
traduit: 好吧，我想也是该回战栗群岛了。我不在的时候，哈斯基尔肯定遇上好多麻烦……

original: Pelagius Septim the Third, once the Mad Emperor of Tamriel, now so boringly sane. I always knew he had it in him!
traduit: 佩拉吉奥斯三世，曾经的泰姆瑞尔疯子皇帝，现在又理智得令人讨厌。我就知道他有潜力！

original: Care to take a look around? This is not, I dare say, the Solitude botanical gardens. Have you any idea where you are? Where you truly are?
traduit: 想四处看看吗？我敢说这可不是独孤城的植物园。知道自己在哪儿吗？到底在哪儿啊？

original: Welcome to the deceptively verdant mind of the Emperor Pelagius III. That's right! You're in the head of a dead, homicidally insane monarch.
traduit: 欢迎来到皇帝佩拉吉奥斯三世这颗稚嫩的心灵。没错！你在一个死了的，疯子皇帝的脑子里。

original: Now, I know what you're thinking. Can I still rely on my swords and spells and sneaking and all that nonsense? Sure, sure. Or... you could use...
traduit: 我知道你在想什么。我还能依靠剑和魔法还有那些小花招吗？当然，当然。或者……你还可以用……

original: The Wabbajack! Huh? Huh? Didn't see that coming, did you?
traduit: 瓦巴杰克！嗯？嗯？没料到吧？是不是？

original: Ever think of moving to Morrowind?
traduit: 有考虑搬到晨风去吗？

original: Not a day goes by that I don't think about returning to the ancestral home of my people.
traduit: 我没有一天不想回祖先的家乡。

original: Still, even with the rough treatment we've had at the hands of Ulfric and his lot, I've got ties here.
traduit: 尽管我们受到乌弗瑞克和他支持者的粗暴对待，但我在这里还是打下些关系了。

original: It's probably more trouble to pack up and leave than it is to stay. Besides, Ambarys can't run the cornerclub on his own.
traduit: 收拾东西走人可能比留下更麻烦。再说，安巴利一个人也照看不了街角吧。

original: What's the Gray Quarter?
traduit: 灰民区是什么？

original: Windhelm is divided into four quarters. The Gray Quarter is the one that's home to all the city's Dark Elves.
traduit: 风舵城有四个部分，灰民区是城里所有暗精灵的家园。

original: If it looks to you like an impoverished slum, that's because it is. Ulfric prefers that we live in squalor.
traduit: 如果你觉得像个贫民窟，那也是事实。乌弗瑞克更倾向让我们住在这种腌臜地方。

original: He has nothing but disdain for anyone who isn't a Nord. He tolerates us, but that's the extent of his hospitality.
traduit: 除了诺德人他谁也看不起。他容忍我们，但他的热情也只限于此了。

original: I don't appreciate loiterers, if that's what you're here to do.
traduit: 我不喜欢没事闲逛的人，你是吗？

original: I hope you have coin to spend, and you're not just here to gawk at my goods.
traduit: 希望你有钱付账，不是只看不买。

original: Have a look around. I buy and sell just about anything.
traduit: 瞧一瞧看一看吧。我这里什么东西都能买卖。

original: I'm always happy to see a customer, but I won't deal in stolen goods. That's trouble I don't need.
traduit: 很高兴有顾客上门，但先说好我倒卖赃物。我可不想惹麻烦。

original: Make yourself at home, please. Let me know if I can be of any assistance.
traduit: 请不要拘束。有什么需要尽管开口。

original: Fresh fruit and vegetables for sale!
traduit: 新鲜的水果蔬菜嘞！

original: Fruits and vegetables, all ripe and ready for your table!
traduit: 熟透的水果蔬菜，买回去尝尝啊！

original: Take home Windhelm's finest and freshest produce today!
traduit: 风舵城最好最新鲜的产品，快来买吧！

original: Assorted fruits and vegetables, all delicious and affordable!
traduit: 蔬菜水果，好吃不贵！

original: Come and browse my fine selection! Everything's fresh and delicious!
traduit: 瞧一瞧，看一看了！又新鲜又好吃！

original: I've a little of everything for sale, come and see for yourself!
traduit: 一应俱全，来看看吧！

original: Cookware, knives and other goods for the home, all at reasonable prices!
traduit: 厨具、刀具、家居用品，价格公道！

original: Assorted wares and tools you just can't live without! Come and see for yourself!
traduit: 生活日用，百货俱全！看一看咯！

original: Buying and selling a wide range of assorted goods! The best selection in Windhelm!
traduit: 公买公卖，应有尽有！风舵城不二之选！

original: Go back to Morrowind, Dark Elf maggots! You're not welcome here!
traduit: 回晨风去吧，暗精灵蛆！这里不欢迎你！

original: Get out of our city, gray-skins! This is Nord land!
traduit: 滚出我们的城市，灰皮东西！这是诺德的地盘！

original: We don't want your kind here, dark elves!
traduit: 我们不会欢迎你们的，暗精灵！

original: This place reeks of gray-skin filth!
traduit: 这地方到处都是灰皮杂碎！

original: You like living in this filthy slum, dark elves? Maybe you should go back to Morrowind, where you belong!
traduit: 暗精灵，你喜欢这么肮脏的贫民窟？你们就该滚回晨风去！

original: Spare a coin for a poor old woman?
traduit: 能给我这可怜的老女人一枚金币吗？

original: A few septims for my supper is all I ask.
traduit: 只求几个塞普汀买顿晚饭。

original: I ask only for a little charity.
traduit: 请施舍一点吧。

original: Will you spare a few coins to help someone who's got nothing?
traduit: 能给一无所有的人几枚硬币吗？

original: I ain't askin' for much, just a few septims.
traduit: 我要的不多，几枚塞普汀就好。

original: The Divines smile on those who show mercy an' charity.
traduit: 圣灵保佑善心人。

original: A few septims ain't nothing. You can spare that, can't you?
traduit: 几个塞普汀算不了什么。您漏漏指缝就有了对吧？

original: Hear my prayer, son of Akatosh, and grant peace to these departed souls.
traduit: 阿卡托什之子啊，请聆听我的祈祷，让死去的灵魂获得安息。

original: Lord of Seasons, I pray to you now that you might watch over the dead with mercy and kindness.
traduit: 四季之主，我向您祈祷，愿您的怜悯和仁慈保佑这些死者。

original: Mighty Arkay, God of Mortals, hear now the prayers of your humble servant. Bless these departed souls and welcome them into the realms beyond.
traduit: 伟大的凡人之神阿尔凯啊，请聆听您卑微的仆从祈祷。请祝福这些逝去的灵魂，让他们进入彼方的位面。

original: Mighty Arkay, I pray that you will shepherd these souls as they pass into the realm of death.
traduit: 伟大的阿尔凯，我向您祈祷，请引导这些灵魂进入死者的国度。

original: Feast your eyes on my strange and wondrous collection of curiosities.
traduit: 请尽情欣赏我收集的奇珍异宝吧。

original: For a few septims, I'll give you a brief tour that includes some of my most unusual items.
traduit: 只需几个塞普汀，我会带你做个简单参观，这里面可有不少我收集的珍品。

original: The objects you see here might look mundane at first glance, but I assure you, behind each is an unusual tale.
traduit: 你在这里看到的东西乍一看可能平平无奇，但我保证，它们背后都有不寻常的故事。

original: Why help the dark elves?
traduit: 你为什么要帮助暗精灵？

original: Help the Dark Elves? Oh, you must have heard me talking to Malthyr.
traduit: 帮助暗精灵？哦，你一定是听见了我和马提尔聊天了吧。

original: The Dark Elves live in a run-down slum called the Gray Quarter. Ulfric's content to keep it that way.
traduit: 暗精灵现在住在灰民区的贫民窟里，乌弗瑞克乐得保持这种状态。

original: I guess they think I can open Ulfric's eyes to their plight, and get him to lift a finger on their behalf.
traduit: 我猜他们是觉得我能让乌弗瑞克看清他们的困境，让他帮帮忙。

original: I'm trying, but Ulfric is set in his ways. For him, there's two kinds of people in this world -- Nords, and the folk beneath them.
traduit: 我正在努力，但乌弗瑞克固执己见。对他来说，世上只有两种人，诺德人，还有诺德之下的民族。

original: That dark elf called you a war hero.
traduit: 那个暗精灵称你为战争英雄。

original: I killed a lot of High Elves in the Great War, and I didn't die. I guess that makes me a war hero.
traduit: 我在浩大战争里杀了不少高精灵，而且还没死。可能这就成了战争英雄吧。

original: The "Great War"... there was nothing great about it. Thousands died on both sides, and where did it get us?
traduit: 浩大战争……有什么伟大浩大可言。双方死伤成千上万，结果又如何？

original: Did we really save the Empire? Or did we just plant the seeds for Ulfric's uprising, and another war?
traduit: 我们真的拯救了帝国？还是说，我们只是为乌弗瑞克起义，乃至更多战争埋下了种子？

original: You one of those "Skyrim for the Nords" types?
traduit: 你也是那种觉得“天际属于诺德”的人吗？

original: I think I'll make my own way from here.
traduit: 我想我们还是各走各的吧。

original: If I make it back to Solitude, I'll put in a good word for you with General Tullius.
traduit: 如果我回了独孤城，我会替你向图留斯将军说好话的。

original: The Legion could sure use someone like you. Good luck.
traduit: 军团需要你这样的人。保重。

original: I think all folk should be welcome here.
traduit: 我认为这里应该欢迎所有人。

original: And you're right, at least as far as I'm concerned.
traduit: 你说得对，至少我是这么认为的。

original: Don't let Ulfric or some of these other short-sighted Nords bother you. Most of us are happy to welcome newcomers.
traduit: 别让乌弗瑞克和其他鼠目寸光的诺德人打扰到你。我们大多数人都是欢迎新人的。

original: Yes. Outsiders like me have no place here.
traduit: 没错。我这样的外人根本没有立足之地。

original: That's just what Ulfric wants you to think.
traduit: 乌弗瑞克就是想让你们这么觉得。

original: If that's what you really believe, then you're a fool. Never had much patience for fools, myself.
traduit: 如果你真这么觉得，那你就是个傻子。我对傻子可没什么耐心。

original: No. Skyrim's big enough for everyone.
traduit: 不，天际足够大，能够包容所有人。

original: Good. Too many Nords in this town have been listening to Ulfric's narrow-minded words.
traduit: 很好。城里听信乌弗瑞克狭隘理论的诺德人太多了。

original: He's tough, loyal to his men and a good leader, but if you're not a Nord, Ulfric will never trust you.
traduit: 他确实坚韧强大，对部下也很忠诚，是个好领袖，但如果你不是诺德人，那乌弗瑞克不会信任你。

original: Yes. Anyone who's not a Nord is a trespasser.
traduit: 没错。任何非诺德人都是入侵者。

original: Is that so? You ought to join the Stormcloaks, if you haven't already.
traduit: 这样啊？如果你还没加入风暴斗篷的话，那你真该去入伙。

original: Seems to me they're a bunch of narrow-minded bigots, just like you.
traduit: 在我看来，他们和你一样都是心胸狭隘的偏执狂。

original: Meantime, you best steer clear of me.
traduit: 另外，你最好离我远点。

original: I'm sorry to be such a bother. We'll talk another time.
traduit: 很抱歉给你添麻烦了。那我们改天再谈。

original: I'll take it.
traduit: 我要了。

original: Do you have any bedlam jobs?
traduit: 你这里有骚乱工作吗？

original: Sometimes we like to remind a city that we mean business, so we hit it hard. Just steal whatever we can until we've made an impression.
traduit: 有时候我们需要提醒城市里的人，我们不开玩笑，所以就要狠狠地打击。能偷多少就偷多少，直到我们给他们留下印象。

original: Simple right? Almost. The catch is it doesn't count if anyone sees you take it. The message needs to be clear; we work in the shadows.
traduit: 很简单吧？问题是如果有人看见你在拿，就不作数了。信号必须明确：我们在阴影中工作。

original: Steal from anywhere in the hold, and you even get to keep everythin' you stole. So, you in?
traduit: 在领内任何地方去偷，甚至可以保留你偷来的东西。所以，要加入吗？

original: Tell me about the bedlam jobs.
traduit: 跟我说说骚乱工作。

original: I always have bedlam jobs. Just remember to hit them fast and don't let them see you. Feel like going for it?
traduit: 我这里有的是骚乱工作。记住要快速打击，别被发现。想试试吗？

original: Of course. Don't forget to keep out of sight, it doesn't count if they catch you red-handed. You ready?
traduit: 当然。别忘了躲开别人的视线，如果他们当场把你抓了，那就不算了。准备好了吗？

original: Taking an easy job, eh? Well, go and do some damage. Just stick to the shadows and keep out of sight. Want to go for it?
traduit: 来份轻松的差事哈？好吧，去搞搞破坏吧。躲在暗处，别让人看见。想试试吗？

original: (Invisible Continue)(Forced Good bye) Time Limit to Attack
traduit: (Invisible Continue)(Forced Good bye) Time Limit to Attack

original: Join the forces mustering outside of [CAPITAL]. (Infos conditioned on Capital location go here)
traduit: Join the forces mustering outside of [CAPITAL]. (Infos conditioned on Capital location go here)

original: (Invisible Continue) Difficulty based on Attack Delta
traduit: (Invisible Continue) Difficulty based on Attack Delta

original: We are ready to mount our final attack.
traduit: 我们已经做好了总攻的准备。

original: Halt, outlander!
traduit: 站住，外来者！

original: Surrender or die, outlander!
traduit: 投降还是去死，选吧外来者！

original: Clanfolk, stop the outlander!
traduit: 族人们，阻止外来者！

original: Hold, there!
traduit: 喂，停下！

original: Lay down your weapons!
traduit: 放下武器！

original: That'll teach you to break the law on my watch.
traduit: 给你个教训，别在我眼皮底下犯法。

original: I thought it was finally going to be a quiet day.
traduit: 我还以为今天会很安静呢。

original: You really thought you could get away with it?
traduit: 你真以为能逃脱惩罚吗？

original: Don't get any bright ideas.
traduit: 别动什么歪脑筋。

original: Stop, in the name of the Jarl!
traduit: 以领主的名义，停下！

original: Come quietly or taste the Jarl's justice!
traduit: 老实点，否则就尝尝领主的审判！

original: By order of the Jarl, I command you to halt!
traduit: 以领主名义，我命令你停下！

original: Sheathe your weapons and come quietly!
traduit: 收起武器，老实点！

original: You sent me a message about Wolf Skull Cave?
traduit: 你给我发了关于狼头骨洞穴的消息？

original: Yes, old friend, I'm afraid it's not good news.
traduit: 没错，老朋友。恐怕不是什么好消息。

original: When you broke up the binding Potema escaped. We've encountered some of her minions.
traduit: 当你解开束缚的时候，波特玛逃走了。我们碰到了她的手下。

original: Styrr says she's still in spirit form or we'd all be dead already.
traduit: 斯提尔说她尚在精魂状态，否则我们早死光了。

original: You've already done us a service in stopping the binding, but I need you to go talk to him, to see if Styrr can tell us what to do next.
traduit: 你已经帮我们解除了束缚，但我还是需要你去找斯提尔谈谈，看他说下一步该怎么做。

original: Very well. Empty the vessels into the sconce near the throne, then sit in the throne.
traduit: 非常好。把容器倒到靠近宝座的器皿里，然后坐在宝座上。

original: When you have done so, I will unbind Hevnoraak. He will awaken in a weakened state, but the lich is still to be reckoned with. Be ready.
traduit: 当你做完之后，我会解放赫诺拉克。他会从虚弱的状态中醒来，但巫妖的力量不可忽视。要做好准备。

original: This seems dangerous.
traduit: 这听起来很危险啊。

original: More dangerous than you know. Left alone, however, he will awaken when he has grown too powerful to be stopped. This is the only way to be sure.
traduit: 比你想象的还危险。不管怎样，等他变得强大到没法阻止的时候，他就会醒来。这是唯一能够确定有效的办法。

original: What am I going to do with these?
traduit: 我要拿这些做什么？

original: In life, Hevnoraak drained his own blood from his body. His goal was to transfer his power back into himself after death, becoming a powerful lich.
traduit: 赫诺拉克在生前吸干了自己的血液。他的目标是在死后把力量转回自己身上，成为一个强大的巫妖。

original: The vessels contain that very blood. Empty them and you remove any chance he has of regaining his former powers.
traduit: 容器里就是这些血液，把它们倒掉他就失去了恢复往日力量的机会。

original: What was I doing again?
traduit: 我应该干什么来着？

original: Find the three vessels within Valthume, then return to me. With these we can defeat him.
traduit: 找到瓦尔图梅里的三个容器，然后回来找我。有了这些，我们就能打败他。

original: I was happy to help.
traduit: 我很乐意帮忙。

original: Even though the Phial was damaged, I still think your efforts deserve reward.
traduit: 尽管白瓶已经坏了，但我仍然觉得你的努力应该得到奖励。

original: Now, if you'll pardon me, I'm going to tend to Nurelion. I can make his final days a bit less painful.
traduit: 现在恕我失陪了。我得去照顾努瑞莱昂。我得让他最后的日子不那么痛苦。

original: I have the materials you requested.
traduit: 我拿到了你需要的材料。

original: Thank the gods. I'll get to work on the Phial straight away.
traduit: 感谢诸神。我这就去修复白瓶。

original: I've brought the Phial, but it's damaged.
traduit: 我把白瓶带回来了，但是它已经坏掉了。

original: This... it matches every description of the Phial that I've found in lore. But if it can't hold liquid, there's no way of knowing.
traduit: 它……和传说中白瓶的样子完全吻合。但如果不能盛放药液，也就没法验证了。

original: How did you manage to damage it, then? This is what I get for not retrieving it myself.
traduit: 你是怎么把它弄坏的？这就是我没亲自去找的后果。

original: What were you arguing about?
traduit: 你们在争论什么？

original: What are you arguing about?
traduit: 你们在争论什么？

original: You acted as a broker for its new owner.
traduit: 你替它的新主人当过中间人。

original: Maybe I did, maybe I didn't. I can't be expected to remember every deal I handle.
traduit: 或许我做过，或许我没做过。我不可能记住处理过的每笔交易。

original: You can drop the act now... Gajul-Lei.
traduit: 你现在别装了……加茹尔-雷。

original: Oh, wait... did you say Goldenglow Estate? My apologies.
traduit: 哦，等等……你说的是金色光辉庄园？抱歉。

original: I'm sorry to say I know very little about that... bee farm, was it?
traduit: 我确实知道的不多。那是个……养蜂场？

original: So, what do we have here? Hmm. Let me guess.
traduit: 什么风把你吹来了？嗯，让我猜猜。

original: By your scent, I'd say you were from the Guild. But that can't be true, because I told Mercer I wouldn't deal with them anymore.
traduit: 你身上带着公会的气味。但不可能，我跟墨瑟说过不会再和他们打交道了。

original: East Empire Company? Who are they?
traduit: 东帝国公司？他们是什么人？

original: A mercantile group that has established ports all over Tamriel. They pretty much dominate the whole shipping industry.
traduit: 一个在泰姆瑞尔建立了诸多港口的商业集团。他们几乎控制了整个航运业。

original: The Emperor himself supposedly backs them, which means they have fairly unlimited resources... so don't get their feathers in a ruffle.
traduit: 据说皇帝本人在支持他们，也就是说他们拥有无限的资源……所以别惹到他们。

original: If I get information from Gulum-Ei, what then?
traduit: 我从古鲁姆-埃那拿到情报后该做什么？

original: Just head right back to the Guild and get the information to Mercer. Nothing else is more important.
traduit: 直接回公会把消息告诉墨瑟。没什么比这更重要。

original: If you discover Gulum-Ei's holding out on us and has more loot stashed away than he claims, we'd find that information quite valuable as well.
traduit: 如果你发现古鲁姆-埃有什么瞒着我们，或是藏了比他报告过来还要多的赃物，也是很有价值的。

original: You think Gulum-Ei will give me trouble?
traduit: 你觉得古鲁姆-埃会找我麻烦？

original: There are thieves and then there is Gulum-Ei. No honor, no code at all. He'd shake your hand and stab you in the back at the same time.
traduit: 即使在盗贼这行里，古鲁姆-埃也很特别。没有荣誉和准则可言。他会在和你握手的时候在背后给你一刀。

original: The cut he's supposed to provide the Guild has dwindled as of late. He says pickings in the warehouse are slim, but I'm certain he's lying.
traduit: 他最近给公会的份子钱减少了。他说是因为仓库里缺货，但我肯定他是在撒谎。

original: Keep your eyes on him, he's quite crafty.
traduit: 盯紧他，他狡猾得很。

original: How is Gulum-Ei an asset to the Guild?
traduit: 古鲁姆-埃是如何成为公会的人的？

original: Gulum-Ei works in the East Empire Company Warehouse. He helps maintain all of the shipments of goods that goes in and out of Solitude.
traduit: 古鲁姆-埃在东帝国公司仓库工作。他负责帮忙维护所有进出独孤城的货物。

original: That means he has the pick of the litter from some of the finest goods to grace Skyrim's shores.
traduit: 这就意味着他可以从好的商品中挑出最好的。

original: He isn't exactly in the Guild, but he pays us a cut of all the stuff he lifts from the warehouse.
traduit: 他不完全算是公会的成员，但他从仓库提货时，会给我们分润一点。

original: If he's betrayed us, I'll kill him.
traduit: 如果他出卖了我们，我就宰了他。

original: No, no. Mercer wants him alive, for now.
traduit: 不，不。墨瑟想让他活着，至少现在要活着。

original: Stubborn or not, he's the only contact we've got at the East Empire Company.
traduit: 不管他顽固与否。他都是我们在东帝国公司的唯一线人。

original: Just keep on his tail and he's bound to step into something he can't scrape off his boot.
traduit: 只要跟紧他，早晚能抓住他的小尾巴。

original: Think he'll give me trouble?
traduit: 你觉得他会给我找麻烦？

original: Trouble? He's one of the most stubborn lizards I've ever met! You have your work cut out for you.
traduit: 麻烦？他是我见过最顽固的蜥蜴！好好对付他吧。

original: I can't believe Gulum-Ei's mixed up in all this; that Argonian couldn't find his tail with both hands.
traduit: 真不敢信古鲁姆-埃居然跟这事有牵连，那个阿尔贡俩手都找不到自己的尾巴。

original: Don't get me wrong, he could scam a beggar out of his last septim... but he's no mastermind.
traduit: 别误会，他能骗走乞丐的最后一个塞普汀。但他不是主谋。

original: I was told you wanted to see me right away.
traduit: 听说你急着见我。

original: I've consulted my contacts regarding the information you recovered from Goldenglow Estate, but no one can identify that symbol.
traduit: 我跟线人咨询了你从金色光辉庄园找到的信息，但没人认出那个符号。

original: Come on inside. Sigrid will get you something to eat and you can tell us what happened.
traduit: 进屋吧。西格利会给你们弄点吃的。然后再说发生了什么吧。

original: Okay, okay. Come inside, then. Sigrid will get you something to eat and you can tell me all about it.
traduit: 好了，好了。进屋吧。西格利会给你们弄点吃的。咱们坐下再聊吧。

original: He's a friend. Saved my life in fact. Come on, I'll explain everything, but we need to go inside.
traduit: 他是我的朋友。还救了我一命。来吧，我会解释清楚的，不过我们得进去说。

original: She's a friend. Saved my life in fact. Come on, I'll explain everything, but we need to go inside.
traduit: 她是我的朋友。还救了我一命。来吧，我会解释清楚的，不过我们得进去说。

original: What's going on? And who's this?
traduit: 出什么事了？还有，这位是？

original: Shh.. Uncle, please. Keep your voice down. I'm fine. But we should go inside to talk.
traduit: 嘘……叔叔，小声点。我很好。不过我们得进去谈。

original: Are you in some kind of trouble?
traduit: 你碰上麻烦了？

original: Shor's bones, what happened to you, boy?
traduit: 舒尔的骨头啊，小子你是怎么了？

original: Hadvar, thank Talos! Your friend told me about Helgen...
traduit: 哈达瓦，感谢塔洛斯！你朋友告诉我海尔根被……

original: Hadvar? What are you doing here? Are you on leave from...
traduit: 哈达瓦？你怎么在这？你是回来休假么……

original: Uncle Alvor! Hello!
traduit: 阿尔沃叔叔！你好！

original: It's nice to be back in a friendly spot, huh?
traduit: 回到亲切的地方感觉真好，是吧？

original: Listen, I'm going to lay up here for a while. You can make your own way to Solitude from here.
traduit: 听着，我得在这休息一会儿。你可以从这自己去独孤城。

original: I'd recommend heading to Whiterun, just down the road from here. From there you can take a carriage to Solitude.
traduit: 我建议你沿着这条路到白漫城去。从那里可以坐马车到独孤城。

original: I hope I'll see you in Solitude. Good luck.
traduit: 希望咱们在独孤城还能再见面。祝你好运。

original: Come on. I'll feel better once we're under cover in Riverwood.
traduit: 走吧。等进了河木镇我才能感觉好点。

original: I hope that dragon isn't still flying around here somewhere.
traduit: 但愿那头龙不会往这边飞。

original: I still almost can't believe it... a real, live dragon...
traduit: 我还是没法相信……一头活生生的龙……

original: Yeah? What is it?
traduit: 啊？什么？

original: Did you really see a dragon?
traduit: 你真的看到了龙吗？

original: Make yourself at home.
traduit: 在家里请随意些。

original: Take what you need, my friend. Within reason, of course.
traduit: 随意取用吧，朋友。当然要在合理范围里。

original: Namira grind your bones for my bread!
traduit: 娜米拉会磨碎你的骨头做成我的面包！

original: I will drink your blood and feast on your flesh!
traduit: 我要喝你的血，吃你的肉！

original: I will feast on you!
traduit: 我要吃了你！

original: Glory to Namira!
traduit: 荣耀归于娜米拉！

original: Glory to the repulsive!
traduit: 荣耀归于可憎者！

original: Not here. We will meet at Reachcliff Cave.
traduit: 不在这儿。在延崖洞穴见面。

original: Bring Verulus here. The Lady of Decay will do the rest.
traduit: 把维鲁鲁斯带来。剩下的就交给腐烂女士了。

original: Go ahead. Eat.
traduit: 来。吃吧。

original: Soon, Namira's blessing will be yours.
traduit: 很快，娜米拉就会眷顾你的。

original: We will sate the hunger together.
traduit: 我们会一起饱餐。

original: Don't fear the unknown, the hidden, the wretched.
traduit: 不要害怕未知、隐秘和不幸的事。

original: I'd like to know more about Azura.
traduit: 我想进一步了解阿祖拉。

original: She is the Goddess of Dawn and Dusk. Azura sees into the Twilight of the future, and guides her followers through it.
traduit: 她是黎明与黄昏的女神。阿祖拉能看到未来的暮光，并引导追随者穿越它。

original: You're my... friend....
traduit: 你是我……朋友……

original: Priest of Arkay. I'm your friend.
traduit: 阿尔凯祭司，我是你的朋友。

original: Who... who are you? What's going on?
traduit: 你……是谁？这是干什么呢？

original: Why did she kill him?
traduit: 她为什么要杀他？

original: Greed? Jealousy? Spite? Who can say what drove her to such an iniquitous act.
traduit: 贪欲？嫉妒？怨恨？谁知道她为什么做出这种邪恶行径。

original: One thing's certain. I intend to find out before she draws her last breath.
traduit: 有一件事是肯定的。我会在她死前弄清楚。

original: And Gallus?
traduit: 加卢斯呢？

original: The last thing I saw was Karliah dumping his body into a opening atop the ruins; an unceremonious end for a remarkable man.
traduit: 我最后看到的一幕，就是卡莱亚把他的尸体扔进遗迹顶部的一个洞里，一代英杰竟是如此下场。

original: To this day I've regretted allowing her to escape, even if it meant I had died trying. I owed Gallus that much.
traduit: 时至今日，我都在后悔放跑了她，哪怕我在追逐的时候死掉也在所不惜。我欠加卢斯太多了。

original: So Karliah took on both of you alone?
traduit: 所以是卡莱亚一个人对付你们俩？

original: Karliah was a master marksman and her greatest weapon was the element of surprise. I was lucky... she missed my heart by mere inches.
traduit: 卡莱亚是个箭术高手，最擅长出其不意。我很幸运……她的箭离我的心脏只有几寸。

original: I staggered away from the ruins and my vision began to blur. It's then that I realized the bitch had poisoned her arrows.
traduit: 我摇摇晃晃地离开遗迹，视线就开始模糊了。那时候我才意识到那婊子在箭上下毒了。

original: How did Gallus die?
traduit: 加卢斯是怎么死的？

original: Twenty-five years ago I was standing outside these very same ruins. Gallus told me to meet here but he wouldn't say why.
traduit: 二十五年前，我也站在这个遗迹前。加卢斯约我在此见面，但不肯说原因。

original: When I arrived, Gallus stepped from the shadows. Before he uttered a sound an arrow pierced his throat.
traduit: 我到达的时候，加卢斯从阴影里走出来，还没等他开口，就被一箭穿喉了。

original: Before I could even draw my blade, her second arrow found its mark in my chest.
traduit: 我还没来得及拔出武器，第二支箭就射中了我的胸膛。

original: So, they had a relationship.
traduit: 这么说，他们以前是情侣啊。

original: If you want to call it that, yes. Me? I think she was softening him for the kill.
traduit: 如果你想这么说也没错。至于我？我觉得她是想让他放松警惕再杀了他。

original: Gallus would call her his "little nightingale." He was absolutely smitten by her.
traduit: 加卢斯会叫她“小夜莺”。他是完全被迷住了。

original: Tell me about Karliah.
traduit: 和我说说卡莱亚。

original: She was a stubborn Dunmer... always had to do everything her way.
traduit: 她是个固执的丹莫……总是按自己的方式做事。

original: But she was also the best... bringing in more coin a month than some thieves heist in a year.
traduit: 但她也最出色……有时候她一个月偷的钱比别的贼一年还多。

original: Gallus trusted her too much and let her get too close.
traduit: 加卢斯过于信任她了，让她靠的太近了。

original: Just make certain you keep your eyes open. Karliah is as sharp as a blade.
traduit: 一定要睁大眼睛。卡莱亚锋利得就像一把剑。

original: The last thing I need is you blundering into a trap and warning her that we're here.
traduit: 我可不希望你贸然踩到陷阱然后提醒她我们来了。

original: You want me to lead?
traduit: 你想让我走前面？

original: I'm sorry, I was under the impression I was in charge.
traduit: 啊呀不好意思，我觉得应该是我说了算吧。

original: You're leading and I'm following. Does that seem clear to you?
traduit: 你打头，我跟着。明白？

original: You saw her?
traduit: 你看见她了？

original: No, I found her horse. Don't worry, I've taken care of it... she won't be using it to escape.
traduit: 不，我找到了她的马。别担心，我已经把她马杀了。她不会骑着逃跑了。

original: Let's get moving, I want to catch her inside while she's distracted. Take the lead.
traduit: 我们走吧，我想趁她分心的时候把她抓住。带路吧。

original: Good, you're finally here.
traduit: 很好。你总算来了。

original: I've scouted the ruins and I'm certain Karliah is still inside.
traduit: 我已经搜查过遗迹了，我确定卡莱亚还在里面。

original: What'd you pick up there? Oh, I wish I saw that first. You're so lucky!
traduit: 你拿到什么了？哦，我还以为我是第一个看到的呢。你可真走运！

original: Hey, someone had to take it, right?
traduit: 嘿，总得有人拿，对吧？

original: Lucky for you that was just sitting there for the taking.
traduit: 算你走运，它就像在那儿等你拿一样。

original: Oh, wow! That was just sitting there? I wish I found it first.
traduit: 哦，喔！就是在那里？我还以为能先找到它呢。

original: Hope nobody misses that...
traduit: 希望没人会错过……

original: You just find that lying around? Must be your lucky day.
traduit: 你随便找找就找到了吗？今天你可真走运啊。

original: That was just lying around? Good find.
traduit: 就是随便放在那里的？找的漂亮。

original: Hush, child. Don't pester your cousin.
traduit: 嘘，孩子。别打扰你哥。

original: Hadvar, did you really see a dragon? What did it look like? Did it have big teeth?
traduit: 哈达瓦，你真的看见龙了吗？它长什么样？牙很大嘛？

original: Of course! Any friend of Hadvar's is a friend of mine. I'm glad to help however I can.
traduit: 当然！哈达瓦的朋友就是我的朋友。我很乐意尽力帮助你。

original: Not much more to tell. This dragon flew over and just wrecked the whole place. Mass confusion.
traduit: 没什么好说的了。这头龙飞过来大闹一番，把整个海尔根都毁了。

original: I don't know if anyone else got out alive. I doubt I'd have made it out myself if not for my friend here.
traduit: 我不知道还有没有人活下来。要不是因为我朋友，我也可能丧命了。

original: I need to get back to Solitude and let them know what's happened.
traduit: 我得回独孤城向他们报告情况。

original: I thought you could help us out. Food, supplies, a place to stay.
traduit: 我想你能帮我们。准备些吃的、补给还有住的地方。

original: Mara's mercy! A dragon... in Helgen? Why, it could be here at any moment!
traduit: 玛拉啊！有龙……在海尔根？怎么会这样？它随时可能会来！

original: Husband. Let him tell his story.
traduit: 老公。让他讲吧。

original: When your friend told me, I didn't believe it at first either.
traduit: 当你朋友告诉我时。我一开始也不信。

original: A dragon? That's... ridiculous. You aren't drunk, are you boy?
traduit: 龙？太……荒唐了。小子你没喝多吧？

original: I don't know where to start. You know I was assigned to General Tullius's guard.
traduit: 我不知道从何说起。你知道，我被派去充当图留斯将军的护卫。

original: We were stopped in Helgen when we were attacked... by a dragon.
traduit: 我们停留在海尔根时被袭击了……被一头龙。

original: Now, then, boy. Helgen was destroyed? How did you get away?
traduit: 那，然后呢，小子。海尔根被毁了？你怎么跑出来的？

original: Now, then, boy. What's the big mystery? What are you doing here, looking like you lost an argument with a cave bear?
traduit: 那，然后呢，小子。那个大秘密是什么？你来这做什么？你看上去就像刚在洞里和熊干了一架。

original: Sigrid! We have company!
traduit: 西格利！家里来客人了！

original: Hadvar! We've been so worried about you! Come, you two must be hungry. Sit down and I'll get you something to eat.
traduit: 哈达瓦！我们一直很担心你！来，你们一定饿坏了。快坐下。我给你们弄点吃的。

original: Hrrrmm.
traduit: 呃嗯嗯。

original: Don't care.
traduit: 我不在乎。

original: Come again?
traduit: 再说一遍？

original: I am prepared to deal with your insolence...
traduit: 我准备好教训教训你的傲慢了……

original: I'm not going to apologize.
traduit: 我不会道歉的。

original: Fine. Then it will be an honor to kill you for your offenses against my kin.
traduit: 很好。那我很荣幸因为你冒犯我的家族而杀你。

original: I'm not apologizing. And I'm not afraid of you.
traduit: 我不会道歉。我也不怕你。

original: If you value your well being, you will offer an apology...
traduit: 如果你重视自己的性命，就该道歉才是……

original: You should be.
traduit: 你归我了。

original: You may care nothing of honor, but I do. I'm not leaving without an apology.
traduit: 你也许不在乎荣誉，但我在乎。不道歉我是不会走的。

original: You sure you want it to come to this?
traduit: 你确定要闹到这个地步吗？

original: In your death may you find the honor you lacked in life.
traduit: 愿你死后能找到你生前缺少的荣誉。

original: What? You stupid or something?
traduit: 什么？你是傻瓜还是什么？

original: Say you're sorry. Say it now.
traduit: 说对不起。现在就说。

original: That's it!
traduit: 就是这样！

original: You're making a fatal mistake. Apologize, and you may yet live...
traduit: 你犯了一个致命的错误。快道歉，也许还能留你一命……

original: I will not tolerate this offense against my kin.
traduit: 我不会容忍对我族人的冒犯。

original: Are you mad? Apologize, or I will gut you like a horker.
traduit: 你疯了吗？道歉，否则剁碎了你。

original: Then you are fool, and will die for it.
traduit: 那你就是个蠢到死的傻子。

original: Honor may mean nothing to you, but it means much to me. Your apology, or your life.
traduit: 荣誉对你来说也许不算什么，但对我来说很重要。要么道歉要么纳命。

original: Only your death or an apology will restore my family's honor. Last chance.
traduit: 只有你的死亡或道歉才能恢复我家族的荣誉。最后给你一次机会。

original: Then I guess we're done talking.
traduit: 那就谈到此为止了。

original: Perhaps I haven't made myself clear. Your best and least painful course of action is to apologize and promise to leave my family in peace.
traduit: 也许是我没说清。你最好且最不受痛苦的做法就是道歉，然后保证不再伤害我的家人。

original: No? You sure? 'Cause we're reaching the point of no return here...
traduit: 不道歉？你确定？那我们就没有回头路了……

original: Annnddd... Point of no return reached.
traduit: 那么……就没有可挽回的余地了。

original: I trust this is the last I'll hear of your violent outbursts.
traduit: 相信这是最后一次听到你的暴力行径。

original: Stay away from my family if you value your life.
traduit: 想活命就离我家人远点。

original: Good. But know that further dishonor to my family will mean your death.
traduit: 好。但你要知道，对我家族的进一步侮辱就意味着你的死亡。

original: You stay away from my family. Or you die. Be smart. Stay away.
traduit: 要么离我家人远点，要么就死。放聪明点。走吧。

original: This had better be the last I hear of you disrespecting my family.
traduit: 这最好是最后一次我听到你对我家族不敬。

original: Mark these words carefully, fetcher. Stay away from my family, or I will paint the ground with your blood.
traduit: 好好记着，费彻。离我家人远点，否则我让你血流遍地。

original: Any further dishonor done to my kin, and I'll put you in the ground.
traduit: 如果你再对我的家人做任何不光彩的事，我就把你活埋了。

original: That wasn't so hard, now was it.
traduit: 也没那么难，是吧。

original: You assaulted one of my family members. I've come to accept your apology.
traduit: 你袭击了我的家人。我是来要求你赔礼道歉的。

original: You! Fetcher! I should kill you for assaulting my family. But I will accept your apology...
traduit: 你！这个费彻！我本该杀了你，你袭击了我的家人。但我可以接受你的道歉……

original: You know who I am? You attacked one of my clan. I've come to accept your apology... or your death.
traduit: 你知道我是谁么？你袭击了我的族人。我是来接受你的道歉……或你的死亡的。

original: You! You hurt my family. I don't like when my family gets hurt. Say you're sorry. Or say goodbye.
traduit: 你！你伤害了我的家人。我不希望他们受到伤害。要么道歉，要么去死。

original: You attacked one of my family. What do you have to say for yourself?
traduit: 你袭击了我的家人。还有什么想说的吗？

original: You can't attack my family and get away with it, fetcher! I will have an apology, or your head on a spike. Choose.
traduit: 你袭击了我的家人，还想逍遥法外，费彻！我要你道歉，否则就把你的脑袋挂在矛上，选吧。

original: Dishonorable dog. You attacked one of my kin. So now you're going to apologize... or I'm going to lop off your head.
traduit: 癞皮狗。你攻击了我的亲戚。所以要么道歉……要么我砍下你的脑袋。

original: Here's the situation. You attacked my family. So now you're going to apologize.. or I'm going to kill you. I hope we understand each other...
traduit: 情况就在这儿摆着。你袭击了我的家人。所以赶紧道歉……不然我就杀了你。希望咱们能互相体谅……

original: I'm sorry to hear that.
traduit: 我对此深表遗憾。

original: As am I.
traduit: 我也是。

original: You acted very nobly in helping my master realize his life's work. Thank you for that.
traduit: 你帮我师父实现了他毕生的愿望，你的行为十分高尚。谢谢你。

original: As for myself, I've always been content to simply be an alchemist.
traduit: 至于我，我一直满足于做一名炼金术士。

original: I fear keeping the Phial would just remind me of Nurelion's obsession, and how it consumed him.
traduit: 我担心留着白瓶会让我想起努瑞莱昂的痴迷，还有他是怎么被这瓶子吞噬。

original: Here, keep it. You are as much a part of its legend now as Curalmil was. I hope it brings you the happiness that my master desired.
traduit: 给，拿着吧。你现在和库拉米尔一样是传说的一部分了。我希望它能给你带来我师父想要的那种幸福。

original: What happened to Nurelion?
traduit: 努瑞莱昂怎么了？

original: He is gone.
traduit: 他去了。

original: But thanks to you, he died knowing his life's work was not in vain.
traduit: 但多亏了你，他死之前看到了自己毕生的努力没有白费。

original: Marvelous.
traduit: 神乎其神。

original: It doesn't matter. Look, it's refilling with your tonic as we speak.
traduit: 没关系的。看呐，咱们说话的工夫，您的药液就补充上了。

original: What? How?
traduit: 什么？怎么会？

original: Master, look. It's the Phial.
traduit: 师父，您看。这是白瓶。

original: You want a real fight, eh?
traduit: 你想实实在在打一架吗？

original: Don't let him get away with this!
traduit: 别让他得逞！

original: Don't let her get away with this!
traduit: 别让她得逞！

original: Get her!
traduit: 拿下她！

original: Come on, he's not so tough.
traduit: 快啊，他没那么强。

original: Come on, she's not so tough.
traduit: 快啊，她没那么强。

original: Twelve septims on the big one!
traduit: 12塞普汀赌大的那个！

original: Fight! Fight!
traduit: 打啊！打啊！

original: Drive that snowback to the ground. Come on!
traduit: 把那混蛋按在地上。快啊！

original: You just going to stand there and take it? Fight back.
traduit: 你打算就这么站着挨揍吗？打回去啊。

original: Who taught you to fight? Keep those hands up!
traduit: 是谁教你这么打的？把手架起来！

original: I'm not paying you a bribe.
traduit: 我是不会贿赂你的。

original: Is that so? Well then, I'll have to charge you with disturbing the Jarl's peace.
traduit: 是吗？那我就得控告你扰乱领主的安宁了。

original: Fine. Take it. (Pay 50 gold)
traduit: 好吧。拿着。（支付50金币）

original: See, that wasn't so difficult, was it.
traduit: 看看。这不是很难吧。

original: You have.... But I don't care.
traduit: 是清楚了……但我不在乎。

original: No? Do you care about rotting away for a month in a cell?
traduit: 不在意？那你在意到牢房里蹲上一个月吗？

original: Ah, but nobody wants that, right? Painful for you, annoying for me. So, you pay my fine... and you walk away.
traduit: 啊，但没人想这样，对吧？对你是痛苦，对我是麻烦。所以，付罚款吧……然后就可以走了。

original: I'm sorry.
traduit: 我很抱歉。

original: See that it doesn't happen again.
traduit: 注意别再发生这种事了。

original: You shouldn't leave weapons laying around. Someone could get hurt. And if I see you do it again, that someone will be you.
traduit: 你不该拿着武器到处乱晃。有人可能会受伤。下次再让我看见，那受伤的就是你。

original: Have I made myself clear?
traduit: 我讲得够清楚了吗？

original: So you're the Augur of Dunlain?
traduit: 所以你就是占卜师杜兰？

original: I am that which you have been seeking.
traduit: 我就是你一直在寻找的人。

original: Your efforts are in vain. It has already begun.
traduit: 你的努力毫无意义。一切已经开始了。

original: But those who have sent you have not told you what they seek. What you seek.
traduit: 但差你过来的人，没有告诉你他们所寻求的是何物，以及你寻求的是何物。

original: Have you ever heard of the Augur of Dunlain?
traduit: 你有没有听说过占卜师杜兰？

original: The Augur? Really? Well, it's certainly not my place to say anything about it.
traduit: 那个占卜师？你认真的？哎，这事儿我真不方便多嘴。

original: I think you'd better go see Mirabelle Ervine.
traduit: 我觉得你最好还是去找米拉贝勒·厄文。

original: What? The Augur? Oh no, I'm quite sure that's... He's nothing I'm involved in. No, no.
traduit: 什么？占卜师？哦不，我很确定……他和我没什么关系。没有，没有。

original: Mirabelle Ervine... Or Tolfdir. They're qualified to discuss him. Not me, definitely not.
traduit: 米拉贝勒·厄文……或是托夫迪尔。他们有资格讨论。但我不会，绝对不会。

original: It's not enough that you've stolen the spotlight with this Eye thing, now you're looking for the Augur?
traduit: 你靠那个“眼睛”抢了这么多关注度还不够，现在又要去找占卜师？

original: I'm not sure what you're playing at, but you'd do well to remember your place around here.
traduit: 我不知道你想玩什么，但你最好认清自己在这里的位置。

original: The Augur? Tragic story, really. At least, the way I heard it. But that was a long time ago.
traduit: 占卜师？那可是个悲剧，真的。至少我是这么听说的。但那已经是很久前的事了。

original: It was some experiment gone horribly wrong. Ghastly results, I was told. And his ghost still roams the halls, they say.
traduit: 听说是某个实验出了严重错误。结果很可怕。据说他的鬼魂仍旧在各殿厅里游荡。

original: Of course, on further reflection, that may have simply been an attempt to scare me. Hmm.
traduit: 当然，仔细想想，那可能只是为了吓唬我也说不定。嗯嗯。

original: Perhaps I'll ask Tolfdir what really happened. I understand he was here at the time.
traduit: 也许我该问问托夫迪尔到底发生了什么。那时候他应该在这儿。

original: Oh, no. No, that won't do at all.
traduit: 哦，不不。那个不能谈。

original: Not my problem. Not even a little. Take it to Tolfdir, he's supposed to be looking after you lot.
traduit: 跟我没关系。一点也没有。跟托夫迪尔去说，你们是归他照看的。

original: That's nothing you need to concern yourself with.
traduit: 这不关你的事。

original: The what of what? No. No idea.
traduit: 什么跟什么？不知道，不知道。

original: If it's important, maybe Tolfdir knows. He seems to know a lot.
traduit: 如果很重要的话，托夫迪尔应该知道。他好像知道很多。

original: Huh? That sounds ominous. Are you getting yourself into even more trouble?
traduit: 嗯？听起来很不祥啊。你要给自己惹更多麻烦吗？

original: Did you ask Mirabelle? She runs things around here, after all.
traduit: 你去问过米拉贝勒了吗？毕竟现在这里是她管事。

original: I've never heard of anything like that. Did you ask Tolfdir? He's been here a long time, and seems to know almost everything.
traduit: 我从来没听说过。你问过托夫迪尔没有？他在这里很长时间了，而且好像什么都知道的样子。

original: The what?
traduit: 什么？
