original: You should head on inside. Eydis or Skuli can take care of you.
traduit: 你该进去。爱迪斯和斯库利会招待你的。

original: I work for Eydis. She runs the inn.
traduit: 我替爱迪斯工作。她经营这家旅店。

original: You'll be looking to rent Tiber Septim's room I take it?
traduit: 想要租泰伯·塞普汀的房间吗？

original: Old Hroldan is the stone that the Empire's history is built on.
traduit: 古霍尔丹是帝国历史的基石。

original: Don't underestimate my son, Skuli. He may look young, but he can handle any drunks we get.
traduit: 不要小瞧我儿子斯库利。他是看着年轻，但能对付我们遇到的任何醉鬼。

original: Skuli's father is off fighting for the Empire. I'm sure he's just fine.
traduit: 斯库利的父亲在为帝国而战。我相信他会没事的。

original: Skuli's father is off fighting for the Stormcloaks. I'm sure he's just fine.
traduit: 斯库利的父亲去为风暴斗篷战斗了。我相信他会没事的。

original: Now, take Shagrol's hammer back to Largashbur, and we'll see about whipping the rest of them into shape.
traduit: 现在，把沙葛洛之锤带回拉加施布尔，把剩下的事处理好。

original: Well, the giants took care of him, and you took care of the giants. Two problems solved at once.
traduit: 好了，巨人教训了他，你又教训了巨人。两个问题同时解决了。

original: But, you took care of him and the giants. Two problems solved at once.
traduit: 但你把他和巨人都料理了。两个问题同时解决了。

original: Yamarz was a fool. Always trying to scheme his way out of responsibility.
traduit: 亚马兹就是个笨蛋。总是想要推卸责任。

original: If you bring mead, you're welcome here! Even if you don't, you're still welcome!
traduit: 带了蜜酒，我们欢迎！没带蜜酒，照样欢迎！

original: All this talk of dragons is making people antsy. Nonsense!
traduit: 关于龙族的话题让大家坐立不安。太荒谬了！

original: I visited the meaderies of Riften once, as a lad. Wish I had their skill.
traduit: 我以前去过裂谷城的蜜酒庄。真希望我也有他们那样的技术。

original: Working our mine is dangerous work, but Dravynea keeps it going. Well, Dravynea and the promise of more mead.
traduit: 在我们矿里工作很危险，不过德拉维尼亚保证了这里的运行。哎，好吧，是德拉维尼亚和蜜酒的诱惑。

original: You've got a fine look about you. Come have a visit at the Braidwood Inn. Better than home!
traduit: 你长得不赖啊。来辫枝旅店坐坐吧。比家里还好！

original: Welcome to Kynesgrove. If you want to do business here, you'll have to deal with me.
traduit: 欢迎来到凯娜之林。想做生意可以找我。

original: If it's malachite you're after, you've come to the right place. I'll pay for any you dig up out of Steamscorch Mine.
traduit: 如果你想交易孔雀石，那你来对地方了。你在汽灼矿场挖出来的我都收。

original: Kjeld speaks for Kynesgrove. Anyone who says otherwise is aching for a fight.
traduit: 克耶尔德在凯娜之林说话算数。不这么说的人就是讨打。

original: Roggi and I do the work around here. My wife and brats just sit around on their brains wasting time.
traduit: 我和罗吉在这儿工作。我的老婆孩子只会坐着浪费时间。

original: My wife is a good woman, but every man needs a little variety, you know?
traduit: 我妻子是个好女人，但男人总是需要些新花样不是吗？

original: An outsider? No reason to stop in Kynesgrove. Keep moving.
traduit: 外来人啊？凯娜之林没什么好待的。继续走吧。

original: The mine's always on the verge of collapse. Good thing I'm around to keep it up.
traduit: 这个矿场已经在坍塌的边缘了。还好有我在，还能坚持下去。

original: Morrowind used to be a lovely place, but you couldn't pay me to live there these days.
traduit: 晨风曾经是个好地方，但现在我是不想住那里。

original: Most people in Skyrim don't care for Dunmer. Roggi's the only one around here even half-decent.
traduit: 天际大部分人都不喜欢丹莫。罗吉算是这里唯一过得去的。

original: I should get over to Windhelm more. See how the other Morrowind refugees are getting along.
traduit: 我应该多去风舵城几趟。看看其他晨风难民过得怎么样。

original: Seen the remnants of the grove? That... well, that was me. Me and my sister.
traduit: 看到这片树林残迹了吧？这……好吧，是我做的。我，还有我妹妹。

original: Came here to start a lumber mill. Who knew the Nords cared about a bunch of old trees?
traduit: 跑到这里想开个木材厂。谁知道诺德会在乎一堆老树？

original: But... well, they did. Sacred, they said. So we work the mines until we've worked it off. Fair enough, I guess.
traduit: 但……哎，他们就是在乎。他们说这些树很神圣。所以我们也只能挖矿了，挖到挖空为止。我觉得也算公平。

original: Oh, great, another wanderer. Slumming it on your way to Windhelm?
traduit: 哦，好啊，又来了个流浪者。要去风舵的贫民窟吗？

original: Wouldn't even be here if it weren't for my idiot sister.
traduit: 要不是因为我那白痴姐姐，我才不会来这儿。

original: I can't believe she dragged me all the way to this snowball. I'd rather be broke in Cyrodiil than broke here.
traduit: 真不敢相信她把我拖到这冰天雪地来。我宁可待在希罗帝尔饿死也不会在这里等破产。

original: If these Nords don't let up soon, I might just make a break for it. At least Cyrodiil is warmer than this.
traduit: 如果这些诺德人早点放弃，我也就能早点溜了。好歹希罗帝尔比这里暖和。

original: Did you see my husband already? I'm sorry... he can come off a bit rough at times.
traduit: 你见过我丈夫了？抱歉……他有时会有点粗暴。

original: I hope you'll stay for a bit. We could certainly use the business.
traduit: 希望你能多待会儿。我们可以谈谈生意。

original: This is really quite a nice town when you get down to it. Just look at the view!
traduit: 仔细看的话，你会发现这镇子很不错。看看这风景多好！

original: Got some nice comfy beds at the Braidwood Inn, if you're looking to flop down somewhere.
traduit: 如果想找地方睡觉的话，辫枝旅店有很舒服的床。

original: I've never seen you before. Leave me alone!
traduit: 从前没见过你啊。离我远点！

original: My pa runs this town, and you're going to be in big trouble if you mess with me.
traduit: 我爸管着这个镇子。你要是敢惹我就有大麻烦了。

original: You don't look so tough. I'll bet I could take you.
traduit: 你看起来没那么强。我敢打赌能拿下你。

original: Why are you still here?
traduit: 你怎么还在这儿？

original: Boy, did you miss all the excitement.
traduit: 孩子，你想找点刺激吗。

original: There's too much of an obsession these days with knives and arrows. You can kill someone just as easily with a well-placed spell.
traduit: 现在的人对小刀弓箭太过痴迷了。法术运用得当，杀人也是轻而易举的。

original: You like creepin' around in the shadows? Magic'll work just as good there as anywhere else.
traduit: 你喜欢在阴影里潜行？魔法在那里一样管用。

original: Nobody ever expects a fireball from the darkened corner.
traduit: 没人会料到有火球从黑暗的角落冒出来。

original: Talk to Babette about potions. She's the creepy little girl - can't miss her.
traduit: 想要药水就去找巴贝特吧。就是那个惊悚的小女孩，你认不错的。

original: Yes, yes. I'm your brother and I'm supposed to greet you respectfully. So "hello." There, satisfied?
traduit: 对，对，我是你兄弟，我应该恭恭敬敬地问候你，说“你好”。满意了吗？

original: I believed in Cicero. But he's betrayed us all.
traduit: 我相信西塞罗，可他背叛了我们大家。

original: Don't let my appearance throw you off. I'm older than you. A lot older. Getting bitten by a vampire when you're ten will do that to a girl.
traduit: 不要被我的外表迷惑了。我比你老得多。十岁时被吸血鬼咬过的女孩就是如此了。

original: It's been quite a boon, looking like a child. No one ever suspects a thing.
traduit: 看起来像小孩挺好的。没有人会怀疑到我头上。

original: My targets make the mistake of not perceiving me as a threat. Last mistake they ever make.
traduit: 我的目标们最大的错误就是没把我当做威胁。这也是他们这辈子最后一个错误。

original: I could brew some potions for you. Or train you in Alchemy.
traduit: 我可以帮你炼些药，或者训练你的炼金术。

original: You looking to buy some potions? Or maybe I could help train you to make your own?
traduit: 想买药水吗？还是我训练你自己做？

original: Let me guess - Astrid failed to mention I'm her husband? She has a tendency to do that. Doesn't want the others thinking she plays favorites.
traduit: 我猜猜，阿斯垂德没说我是她丈夫吗？她肯定是不想别人觉得她偏心。

original: What do you want, beef roast?
traduit: 有事么，烤肉？

original: You're part of a family now, hamshank. I trust you... you trust me. Got it?
traduit: 你现在已经是家庭的一员了，小火腿。我信任你……你也得信任我。懂？

original: Don't take offense to the nicknames, morsel. I'm a werewolf. Hard not to think of you as a snack.
traduit: 别介意我给你取的外号，小东西。我是狼人，很难不拿你当零食看。

original: Hello, tidbit.
traduit: 你好，点心。

original: It was a truly terrifying scene. Beautiful, in some respects.
traduit: 这场景真吓人。但某种意义上，很美。

original: Does death not come to us all? Is it not a certainty? I am, therefore, honored to be doom's herald. To play some part in a being's inevitable end.
traduit: 死亡会降临到所有人身上吧？这是必然不是吗？因此，我很荣幸成为厄运的使者。在生命不可避免的终局中扮演一个角色。

original: In the Dark Brotherhood, I found acceptance, love, and my life's true purpose.
traduit: 在黑暗兄弟会，我找到了认同、爱情还有人生的真正目标。

original: Death is but the time to sleep forever, in the Void.
traduit: 死亡不过是在虚空里长眠。

original: Sithis' whisper be upon you, brother.
traduit: 西帝斯的低语眷顾你，兄弟。

original: Sithis' whisper be upon you, sister.
traduit: 西帝斯的低语眷顾你，姐妹。

original: It only hurts when I laugh. He he he. Owww...
traduit: 我笑起来就会疼。呵呵呵。哦……

original: Ah, you're back. It was good to fight alongside you. I'm sure people won't be forgetting that wedding anytime soon, hmm?
traduit: 啊，你回来了。很高兴和你并肩作战。相信人们短时间内不会忘记那场婚礼了吧？

original: Me, I have been part of the Dark Brotherhood from the day I first hatched. I am a Shadowscale, you see. Born under the sign of the Shadow.
traduit: 我从被孵化的第一天就一直是黑暗兄弟会的一员。如你所见，我是个影鳞。诞生于暗影座的标记下。

original: I serve Astrid, and this Sanctuary. Life is simple, and good.
traduit: 我效忠于阿斯垂德和这个圣所。生活简单而美好。

original: The Shadowscales are all but forgotten. An ancient tradition, from another time.
traduit: 影鳞几乎被遗忘了。这是另一个时代的古老传统。

original: Greetings, brother.
traduit: 兄弟你好。

original: Greetings, sister.
traduit: 姐妹你好。

original: Oh, hello hello!
traduit: 哦，你好，你好！

original: You require the services of the Fool of Hearts?
traduit: 需要红桃小丑的帮忙吗？

original: Greetings, Listener!
traduit: 聆听者你好啊！

original: How may I serve the Listener?
traduit: 需要我为聆听者做什么吗？

original: Brother.
traduit: 兄弟。

original: Sister.
traduit: 姐妹。

original: Thank you, hero. Now I may finally rest. Take Hevnoraak's iron mask. It may be of use to you, and serve as some reward for your feat here.
traduit: 谢谢你，英雄。现在我终于可以安息了。拿上赫诺拉克的铁面具吧，也许对你有帮助，这是你在此功绩的奖赏。

original: It is done.
traduit: 结束了。

original: With those three vessels, Hevnoraak can restore himself. Find them before he can.
traduit: 有了这三个容器，赫诺拉克就能恢复正常。在他之前拿到它们。

original: Kill him now, while we still can!
traduit: 趁我们还有机会，快杀了他！

original: Did you find all of the vessels?
traduit: 你找到所有容器了？

original: Do not interrupt the ritual. Go empty the vessels and sit on the throne.
traduit: 不要打断仪式。把容器倒空，坐在宝座上。

original: Hevnoraak is defeated.
traduit: 赫诺拉克被击败了。

original: Who is Hircine?
traduit: 海尔辛是谁？

original: Do you not know the Daedric Lord of the Hunt?
traduit: 你不知道迪德拉的狩猎之王？

original: He revels in the chase, and also gave the "gift" of lycanthropy to mortals.
traduit: 他在狩猎中狂欢，将狼化之力“馈赠”给凡人。

original: A powerful force, not to be crossed. As I learned too late.
traduit: 他力量强大，难以逾越。可惜我知道的太晚了。

original: ... and may we one day rejoin them in eternity.
traduit: ……也愿我们终有一天，能与他们相逢于永恒。

original: May the spirit of Lavinia and all those who have left this world and its suffering know the beloved serenity of Aetherius...
traduit: 愿拉维妮娅的精魂与所有离开尘世者，都能找寻到光界充满爱意的宁静……

original: It is through the ebb and flow of this cosmic tide that we find renewal and, in the end, peace.
traduit: 正是在这宇宙的潮起潮落之中，我们找到了来世与最终的宁静。

original: But he willingly gave up this existence that we might better understand the vagaries of life and death.
traduit: 但他主动舍弃了自己的存在，以便让我们更好的理解生死的变化无常。

original: The god Arkay was once like us, bound to winding mortality.
traduit: 阿尔凯神曾和我们一样，注定要面临死亡。

original: The master vampire Movarth is dead.
traduit: 吸血鬼首领莫瓦斯死了。

original: By the Eight, I didn't think you could do it!
traduit: 八圣灵在上，我就知道你能行！

original: Now maybe we can put all this behind us.
traduit: 现在我们终于可以松口气了。

original: Take this as a token of our gratitude.
traduit: 收下谢礼吧。

original: Damn Forsworn. Only a matter of time before they hit here, too.
traduit: 该死的弃誓者。他们早晚会来袭击这里的。

original: Guess we'll have two more mouths to feed for a while.
traduit: 看来我们得多管俩人的饭了。

original: Don't have much to say unless you're here to mine metal.
traduit: 除非你是来挖矿的，否则没什么好说的。

original: I'm in charge of Left Hand Mine. You cause trouble, you answer to me.
traduit: 左手矿场是我的。如果你惹了麻烦，就得听我的。

original: Left Hand Mine deals with iron, the perfect metal to dig with a war going on.
traduit: 左手矿场出铁，在战争期间，这是最适合开采的金属。

original: Kolskeggr, overrun with Forsworn, what next?
traduit: 科斯凯格被弃誓者占去了，接下来是哪儿呢？

original: Did you hear that? Pavo was driven out of his mine. Almost everyone is dead.
traduit: 你听说了吗？帕沃被赶出自己的矿场了。人也死了七七八八。

original: What if the Forsworn come here? We aren't safe.
traduit: 如果弃誓者来了怎么办？我们这里也不安全。

original: You should speak with my husband. Skaggi runs everything.
traduit: 你应该去找我丈夫。斯卡基负责一切。

original: I'm just here to mine.
traduit: 我只是来挖矿的。

original: Got ore to dig.
traduit: 还有矿石要挖呢。

original: I'm one of miners. Plenty of ore to dig up around here.
traduit: 我是矿工。这附近还有很多矿石要挖。

original: Don't have much to say to you. Got work.
traduit: 我跟你没什么好说的。还得工作呢。

original: It's amazing how much work goes into the little things, isn't it?
traduit: 在这些小事上付出真么多努力也很神奇，对吧？

original: I'm just here to dig. Not much else to talk about.
traduit: 我只是来挖矿的，没什么好说的。

original: Kolskeggr Mine is lost, friend. Forsworn killed everyone.
traduit: 科斯凯格矿场丢了，朋友。所有人都被弃誓者杀了。

original: Don't go to Kolskeggr. It's not safe.
traduit: 别去科斯凯格，不安全。

original: Gat and I are the only survivors.
traduit: 只有我和噶特活下来了。

original: Pavo and I had to fight our way out of Kolskeggr. Forsworn killed everyone else.
traduit: 帕沃和我杀出科斯凯格。弃誓者杀了所有人。

original: Thank Malacath we got out of Kolskeggr alive.
traduit: 感谢玛拉凯斯保佑我们活着逃出了科斯凯格。

original: Don't know what I would have done without Pavo. Man's braver than he admits.
traduit: 真不知道没了帕沃我该怎么办。他比自己承认的还要勇敢。

original: Poor Pavo and Gat. To have lived through a Forsworn attack.
traduit: 帕沃和噶特太可怜了。被弃誓者袭击。

original: Another day, another settlement gets attacked. No place in the Reach is safe from the Forsworn.
traduit: 总有定居点遭到袭击。瑞驰没有远离弃誓者的安全地方了。

original: I'm the hardest worker in Left Hand. Better than any man.
traduit: 我是左手矿场最努力的人。比其他男人都强。

original: Most women would rather die than dig, but I have a daughter to raise.
traduit: 大多数女人死也不愿意挖矿，但我还要养活女儿。

original: My Erith has her father's eyes. She's all I have left of him.
traduit: 艾瑞斯的眼睛随她爸爸。她是他留给我的一切。

original: You don't invite monsters into your home to have supper! I won't have them here, and I'm certainly not smiling for them!
traduit: 你别想邀请怪物来家里吃饭！我不会让他们在这里，也不会对着他们笑！

original: Oh, stop being such a grouch! Not every visitor to the farm wants to burn it down! Maybe they just want to have a nice supper with us, hmm?
traduit: 哦，别那么爱发牢骚！不是每个来农场的人都是来烧房子的！也许他们只是想吃顿晚饭呢？

original: You want me to smile? What's there to smile about? Soldiers and dragons are going to be trampling all over the crops this year. I just know it.
traduit: 你还想让我笑出来吗？有什么好乐的？今年士兵和龙族会毁了庄稼。我就知道这个。

original: Oh, wipe that frown off your face Rogatus. You've been wearing that frown for over 50 years now.
traduit: 哦，别总皱着个眉头了，罗迦图斯。你皱眉都皱了50年了。

original: Oh, what is this? A visitor? To our farm? Oh, do stay for a while, dear.
traduit: 哦，这是什么？有客人了？来到我们农场？哦，亲爱的，再多待一会儿吧。

original: Now, you don't let Rogatus cause you any bother.
traduit: 不要让罗迦图斯打扰到你。

original: My husband just gets cranky when he doesn't get enough sleep.
traduit: 我丈夫睡眠不足的时候就会发脾气。

original: Our son Leontius moved to Old Hroldan nearly 30 years ago. I still miss him.
traduit: 我们的儿子莱昂提尤斯三十年前搬到了古霍尔丹。我还是很想他。

original: I hope my son has found some nice, well-mannered girl to settle down with.
traduit: 我希望我儿子能找个好姑娘安顿下来。

original: Rogatus and I have been married over 50 years. He's always been a bit of a grouch.
traduit: 罗迦图斯和我结婚50多年了。他总是有点爱发牢骚。

original: My boy Leontius lives in Old Hroldan. Damn drunk.
traduit: 我儿子莱昂提尤斯住在古霍尔丹。该死的酒鬼。

original: I've lived through rebellion, Forsworn, undead, witches, wizards, hagravens, and marriage.
traduit: 我经历过叛乱、弃誓者、亡灵、女巫、巫师、鬼婆，还有婚姻。

original: Next thing you know there will be some kind of damn blight and undead will walk the land.
traduit: 接下来你就会看到某种该死的枯萎病，还有亡灵在地上乱跑。

original: You ever have to farm land while there was a battle going on? I have.
traduit: 你在打过仗的地方种过地吗？我种过。

original: Damn soldiers always trample my crops.
traduit: 该死的士兵总是来踩我的庄稼，

original: I'm been farming this bit of land all my life.
traduit: 我这辈子都在这里种地。

original: I am answering your summons.
traduit: 我来回应你的召唤。

original: I am Master Arngeir. I speak for the Greybeards.
traduit: 我是代表灰胡子发言的艾恩盖尔大师。

original: Now tell me, Dragonborn, why have you come here?
traduit: 龙裔，现在告诉我，你为何到此？

original: Shout for us, Dragonborn. Then we may have time for questions.
traduit: 向我们展示龙吼吧，龙裔。然后我们有的是时间提问。

original: I just don't understand what kind of a man does that.
traduit: 我还是不能明白，一个人怎么能做出这种事。

original: All right. Keep up the good work.
traduit: 好吧，再接再厉吧。

original: Yes sir, of course.
traduit: 是的先生，当然。

original: Let's make sure we're just as productive this month as we were last. If Bryling's happy, we're happy.
traduit: 我们得确保这个月的工作效率和上月一样。白灵高兴了，我们才能高兴。

original: Morthal is full of cowards! Let's go kill that monster.
traduit: 莫萨尔全是胆小鬼！我们进去杀那怪物。

original: Cowards! We must kill the vampires. We have to make them pay!
traduit: 胆小鬼！我们必须杀光吸血鬼。让他们付出代价！

original: And it's full of vampires?
traduit: 里面全是吸血鬼吗？

original: Yeah. Kind of scary too.
traduit: 是啊。有些吓人。

original: Um...this place looks dangerous.
traduit: 嗯……这地方看起来很危险。

original: You want to help me kill the vampire?
traduit: 你想帮我去杀吸血鬼？

original: I want vengeance for my wife!
traduit: 我要为我妻子报仇！

original: Vengeance for Laelette!
traduit: 为拉莱特报仇！

original: We're marching on Movarth's Lair whether you come with us or not.
traduit: 不管你跟不跟我们来，我们都要打到莫瓦斯的巢穴去。

original: Destroy him!
traduit: 毁灭他！

original: Let's kill him!
traduit: 我们去杀了他！

original: Kill him!
traduit: 杀了他！

original: Kill the vampire!
traduit: 杀光吸血鬼！

original: Take us!
traduit: 我们走！

original: Yeah!
traduit: 耶！

original: Yes!
traduit: 是！

original: I'm going to Movarth's Lair to kill that monster. Are you with me?
traduit: 我要去莫瓦斯的巢穴杀了那怪物。你跟我来吗？

original: Take us to Movarth's Lair!
traduit: 带我们去莫瓦斯的巢穴！

original: Right. Well, you let me know if you need anything.
traduit: 好。有什么需要就告诉我。

original: Of course not. I never thought otherwise.
traduit: 当然。我从没这么想过。

original: Good, good. It's honest work, son. No shame in that.
traduit: 好，好。这是实在的工作，儿子。这没什么可羞耻的。

original: I'm fine, father. Work is fine.
traduit: 爸，我很好。工作很顺利。

original: How goes it, son?
traduit: 怎么样，儿子？

original: Yes sir.
traduit: 是。

original: Yes, well... That's all we ask of you. Carry on.
traduit: 嗯，好……这是我们对你的唯一要求。继续吧。

original: Teeba-Ei is cold, but Teeba-Ei works hard as always.
traduit: 提巴-埃很冷，但提巴-埃会一直努力工作。

original: Is everything well with you, my scaly friend?
traduit: 一切还好吗，鳞片朋友？

original: Good, good. Keep up the hard work. It'll all pay off.
traduit: 好，好。继续努力工作。一切都会有回报的。

original: Yes sir, fine sir.
traduit: 是的先生，一切都好。

original: Everything well, Jesper?
traduit: 一切正常吗，杰斯帕？

original: I'm answering your summons.
traduit: 我来回应你的召唤。

original: We will see if you truly have the gift.
traduit: 我们会验证你是否真的具有天赋。

original: Show us, Dragonborn. Let us taste of your Voice.
traduit: 向我们展示吧，龙裔。让我们感受一下你的吼声。

original: Oh yes, mistress. You're the "boss." For now.
traduit: 没错，夫人。你才是“老大”。暂时的。

original: Oh yes, mistress. Perfectly! You're the boss.
traduit: 哦，好的，夫人。完美！你才是老大。

original: But make no mistake. I am the leader of this Sanctuary. My word is law. Are we clear on that point?
traduit: 但不要搞错了。我才是这个圣所的领袖，言出法随。懂了吗？

original: Oh, what a kind and wise wizard you are. Sure to earn our Lady's favor.
traduit: 哦您真是个亲切又睿智的巫师啊。肯定能得到我们母亲的青睐。

original: Mister Cicero, I for one am delighted you and the Night Mother have arrived. Your presence here signals a welcome return to tradition.
traduit: 西塞罗先生，很高兴你和夜母的到来。你的到来标志着传统的回归。

original: Oh, be quiet you great lumbering lapdog. The man has had a long journey. You can at least be civil.
traduit: 哦，安静点，大笨狗。他长途跋涉至此。你至少该文明一点。

original: Oh, yes yes yes! Thank you, thank you, thank you!
traduit: 哦，没错，没错，没错！谢谢，谢谢，谢谢！

original: Understood... husband?
traduit: 懂了吗……老公？

original: You and the Night Mother are of course welcome here, Cicero. And you will be afforded the respect deserving of your position as Keeper.
traduit: 这里当然欢迎你和夜母的到来，西塞罗。你也会得到作为守护者应得的尊重。

original: But the Night Mother is mother to all! It is her voice we follow! Her will! Would you dare risk disobedience? And surely... punishment?
traduit: 但夜母是所有人的母亲！我们追随着她的声音！她的意志！谁胆敢不服从？不怕……遭到报应吗？

original: You call me Dragonborn. What does that mean?
traduit: 你叫我龙裔是什么意思？

original: First, let us see if you truly are Dragonborn. Let us taste of your Voice.
traduit: 先让我们看看你是否真是龙裔。让我们感受一下你的吼声。

original: Master Einarth will now teach you "Ro," the second Word in Unrelenting Force.
traduit: 爱纳斯大师现在将教授你冷酷之力的第二个词汇——“洛”。

original: Without training, you have already taken the first steps towards projecting your Voice into a Thu'um, a Shout.
traduit: 不经训练就能跨出第一步，将声音转化为吐'目、龙吼。

original: Now let us see if you are willing and able to learn.
traduit: 现在来看看你有没有学习的能力和意愿。

original: So... a Dragonborn appears, at this moment in the turning of the age.
traduit: 所以……在时代转折的此刻，龙裔出现了。

original: You are now ready for your last trial.
traduit: 你可以接受最后的试炼了。

original: Retrieve the Horn of Jurgen Windcaller, our founder, from his tomb in the ancient fane of Ustengrav.
traduit: 从我们的创始人“唤风者”约根的墓，乌斯滕格拉，取回他的号角。

original: Remain true to the Way of the Voice, and you will return.
traduit: 恪守吼声之道，你就能成功回来。

original: Masters Einarth, Borri, and Wulfgar will each demonstrate a Shout. Make your choice.
traduit: 爱纳斯、博瑞、沃夫加三位大师会各自展示龙吼。自己选择吧。

original: Don't worry, though. You will find all three Words in Ustengrav.
traduit: 别担心。你会在乌斯滕格拉找齐那三个力量之语的。

original: Strike the targets as they appear. Breath and focus.
traduit: 目标出现后进行攻击。调整呼吸，集中精力。

original: Master Borri has agreed to teach you the first Word of a new Shout. Attend to him.
traduit: 博瑞大师会教你新龙吼的第一个词。跟上他。

original: Use both words, if you can.
traduit: 如果能行的话，试着用上两个词。

original: Use both Fus and Ro. Together, they will make the Shout more powerful.
traduit: 同时使用“伏斯”和“洛”，会使龙吼变得更加强力。

original: Well done. Again.
traduit: 做得好。再来一次。

original: You learn quickly. Once more.
traduit: 你学得很快啊。再来。

original: That's it. One more time.
traduit: 就是这样。再来一次。

original: Bex!
traduit: 比克斯！

original: Come, we will do your next test inside the hall.
traduit: 来吧，到大厅去进行下个测试。

original: Try it again. Breath and focus.
traduit: 再试试。调整呼吸、集中精力。

original: Is this your best effort? Again.
traduit: 你就这种程度吗？再来。

original: Come, Dragonborn. Attend to Master Borri.
traduit: 来吧，龙裔。跟上博瑞大师。

original: Stand next to me. Master Borri will open the gate. Use your Whirlwind Sprint to pass through before it closes.
traduit: 站到我边上。博瑞大师会打开大门。利用你的旋风冲刺在门关上前冲过去。

original: Now we will see how quickly you can master a new Shout.
traduit: 我们来看看你掌握新龙吼的速度如何。

original: Now we will see how quickly you can master a new Word.
traduit: 我们来看看你掌握新力量之语的速度如何。

original: We will perform your next trial in the courtyard. Follow Master Borri.
traduit: 下一项试炼在院子里进行。跟上博瑞大师。

original: Impressive. Your Thu'um is precise. You show great promise, Dragonborn.
traduit: 很不错。你的吐'目很精确。大有前途，龙裔。

original: You show promise. Remain focused, and you will fulfill your potential.
traduit: 你很有前途啊。集中精神，就能发挥你的潜力。

original: You have the ability, but you need to learn discpline if you wish to fulfill your potential.
traduit: 你很有能力。但想要充分发挥潜力，还要学会控制。

original: Did you see the fires from Goldenglow Estate? I was afraid the whole place was going to burn to the ground!
traduit: 你看到金色光辉庄园的大火了吗？真害怕整个地方烧成白地！

original: If you're looking to purchase goods, I have none to sell. You should head into Riften instead.
traduit: 如果你想买东西，我这里没有。你应该去裂谷城看看。

original: Pretty quiet out here on the farm. My wife and I kind of like the solitude.
traduit: 农场很安静。我们夫妻喜欢独处。

original: Vulwulf has been quite generous to let me take care of their farm considering I am not part of their family.
traduit: 虽然我不是他们家族的人，但乌尔武夫还是很慷慨地让我打理他们的农场。

original: The Snow-Shod's are very trusting to let me run this place without their supervision.
traduit: 雪蹄家非常信任我，让我可以在不受他们监督的情况下经营这里。

original: I'm glad there are guards outside the farm. I don't think I could defend the place alone.
traduit: 农场外有卫兵实在太好了。我一个人可护不了这个地方。

original: My husband and I were just recently married.
traduit: 我和我丈夫才刚刚结婚。

original: I'm originally from Cyrodiil, but I left there after I had a falling out with my family.
traduit: 我祖籍是希罗帝尔，自从和家里人闹翻了就离开了。

original: This was the first door in Skyrim I knocked upon, and little did I know my future husband would be answering the door.
traduit: 这里是我来天际敲开的第一扇门，我也没想到开门的会是我未来的丈夫。

original: I like the farm life. It's a huge change from living in a city.
traduit: 我喜欢农场的生活。和城市比起来确实大不一样。

original: Addvild's made me a happy woman. I wouldn't want to be with anyone else in the world.
traduit: 阿德维尔德让我非常快乐。我只想与他厮守一生。

original: I try to think of it as coaxing the ore from the rock.
traduit: 我一直试着把挖矿想成和岩石斗智的过程。

original: I keep hearing stories about Morrowind. Sounds like a wretched place.
traduit: 我一直有听说关于晨风的事。那地方听上去很糟糕。

original: I hear there's baked slaughterfish tonight.
traduit: 我听说今晚有烤鱼吃了。

original: Is there something I can help you with?
traduit: 有什么需要帮忙的吗？

original: What's your trouble? Dasturn telling tales again?
traduit: 有麻烦吗？达斯特恩又讲故事了？

original: We keep hearing that the war could come through here. I try not to worry about it.
traduit: 我们不断收到这里可能要爆发战争的消息。我试着尽量不去担心。

original: It's tough to keep track of Hrefna. If her father wasn't such a snowback, he'd be around to help out.
traduit: 想看住荷夫娜太难了。要是她爹不是那样的混蛋，他也该在这儿帮帮忙的。

original: I'm not proud of Hrefna's father. If she knew him, she wouldn't be either.
traduit: 我从不以荷夫娜的父亲为傲。如果她也认识他，那她也不会的。

original: A traveler? I'll be you've seen some sights. We should swap tales sometime.
traduit: 旅行者？你应该见识过一些风景吧。我们可以找时间聊聊。

original: There's a gorgeous tree that grows right up through a cave to the northeast of here.
traduit: 东北方向的山洞里有颗特别漂亮的树。

original: If you're heading to Kynesgrove, stick to the road. Some pretty dangerous caves between here and there.
traduit: 如果你想去凯娜之林，记得走大道。从这儿到那儿的路上有些洞穴很危险。

original: Verner used to love exploring before we got married. Now he's become a bit of a milk drinker. Likes to stay home.
traduit: 我们结婚前维尔纳很喜欢探险。现在怂得就知道窝在家里。

original: If you head straight west from where the White River splits towards Whiterun, you can get a look at the Cradlecrush giants.
traduit: 如果你从白河往白漫去的支流往西走的话，你能在破碎摇篮岩看见巨人。

original: You looking for work? We could use an extra hand in the mine. Just bring me any Corundum you dig up.
traduit: 在找活儿干吗？我们矿里需要帮手。把你挖出来的刚玉拿来给我。

original: Annekke used to help more with the mining, but nowadays she's a bit of a bounder.
traduit: 安尼克以前帮忙挖矿出力挺多的。现在变得有点粗鲁。

original: I do love my wife. Just wish she'd get her head out of the clouds.
traduit: 我很爱我的妻子。只是希望她的想法别太天马行空了。

original: If you want some information about the area, Annekke knows it better than anyone.
traduit: 如果你想了解这片地方的事，安尼克是最熟悉的了。

original: Sometimes I feel like Annekke cares more about finding new rocks than being with me.
traduit: 有时候我觉得安尼克更关心寻找新岩石，而不是和我在一起。

original: Still shaken from all the fighting, my friend. It's been too long since I had to kill someone.
traduit: 还在为战斗而颤抖，朋友。我已经很久没杀过人了。

original: Are you all right, Gat?
traduit: 你还好吧，噶特？

original: Yes it can. I haven't been wrong in 50 years, and I won't be wrong tomorrow.
traduit: 是啊，是啊。我50年来都没预感错过，明天也不会错。

original: Oh, Rogatus! Maybe tomorrow will be pleasant for once, hmm? It can't be terrible every day!
traduit: 哦，罗迦图斯！也许明天会很愉快啊？不可能每天都那么糟的！

original: Look at the sky. Be a terrible day tomorrow. I know it.
traduit: 看看这天儿。明天会很糟。我就知道。

original: How do you think the crops are coming, dear?
traduit: 你觉得庄稼长得怎么样啊，亲爱的？

original: Terrible. Only a matter of time before soldiers come and burn all my hard work into dust!
traduit: 糟透了。士兵们迟早要把我的心血都烧了！

original: No. I have enough trouble without more mouths to feed! They're the Jarl's men, they can eat supper at the keep.
traduit: 不。我的麻烦够多了，喂不了更多人了！他们是领主的人，能在要塞里吃饭的。

original: Maybe we could invite some of those nice guards over. You know, for some supper?
traduit: 也许我们可以请几个卫兵过来。比如吃顿饭？

original: I don't care! Just stay away from the soldiers and keep to your business. It's the only way we'll make it through this.
traduit: 我不管！离士兵远点，管好你自己的事。这是我们挺过去的唯一办法。

original: Sorry, Marise. I just can't sit back and watch them treat us like a resource. This is our home!
traduit: 抱歉，辛达。我不能坐视不管，看着他们把我们当成资源。这是我们的家！

original: All you'll accomplish by threatening them is ending up in the Riften dungeon. You're lucky they didn't take you seriously.
traduit: 你威胁完他们，结果就是把自己弄到裂谷城大牢。你该庆幸他们没拿你当回事。

original: I can't stand them, they represent everything I hate about Skyrim. They're tearing the place apart!
traduit: 我忍不了他们了，我对天际所有的厌恶都在他们身上了。他们把这地方搞得乱七八糟！

original: Dravin! One of the soldiers I spoke to on the way home said you threatened them. What's come over you?
traduit: 德拉文！我回家路上有个士兵说你威胁了他们。你怎么回事？

original: If it puts your mind at ease, I'll take it with me. I'm sorry.
traduit: 如果这能让你放心的话，我就带着吧。抱歉啦。

original: That doesn't matter. All it would take is a stray wolf or a bandit crossing your path... I can't bare to lose you after everything we've done.
traduit: 距离不重要。只要有一只野狼或者应该强盗正好经过你走的路……我们经历了那么多，我不能失去你。

original: Husband, you worry far too much. We are within an hour's walk of Riften.
traduit: 老公，你太操心了。我们这里走到裂谷城还不到一个小时。

original: Synda... you left your dagger behind again yesterday. I told you, the road isn't safe.
traduit: 辛达……你昨天又把匕首落下了。我告诉过你路上不安全。

original: Thanks again for getting my bow back from those thieves. Next time they come knocking I'll be ready.
traduit: 再次感谢你从那些贼手里拿回了我的弓。下次他们再来的时候，我会做好准备的。

original: So, has my bow turned up yet?
traduit: 所以，我的弓有下落了吗？

original: Who in the name of Azura are you?
traduit: 阿祖拉在上，你是谁？

original: You look suspicious. You better not be one of those damn thieves.
traduit: 你看起来很可疑。你最好不是跟那些贼是一伙的。

original: It's not safe around here. There's thieves out there looking to steal everything you own.
traduit: 这里不安全。外面有小偷想要偷走你所有东西。

original: You even think of taking something from my house... and I'll kill you.
traduit: 你要是打算拿我家里的东西……我会杀了你。

original: Now that you've brought Dravin's bow back, he's back to his crabby old self. For better or for worse, I still thank you.
traduit: 现在你把德拉文的弓拿回来了，他又变回那个暴躁的自己了。不管怎样，还是要谢谢你。

original: After we were robbed, Dravin's become more bitter than ever. He hates this place.
traduit: 我们被抢了之后，德拉文变得比以前更凶了。他讨厌这个地方。

original: You'll have to forgive my husband's manners. He's not used to pleasantries.
traduit: 请原谅我丈夫的无礼，他不擅长客套。

original: The war's been hard on the farm and hard on Dravin. We don't know what to expect from one day to the next.
traduit: 战争对农场和德拉文都很残酷。我们不知道新的一天能期待什么。

original: Someday, I hope we can get away from here... perhaps move back to Morrowind. This isn't at all what we expected.
traduit: 我希望，有一天我们能离开这里……也许可以搬回晨风。这里和我们想的完全不一样。

original: I'm afraid we have little to offer you in the way of hospitality.
traduit: 恐怕我们没东西可以热情招待您了。

original: Just be careful, Gralnach. That copse doesn't look safe. If you see any trouble, you run right home.
traduit: 小心点，格拉那驰。那片丛林看起来不安全。如果遇见麻烦直接往家跑。

original: I was hoping to head into Riften for supplies, but I can do that after I'm done with the elms.
traduit: 我本来想去裂谷城拿些补给，但我可以砍完榆树再去。

original: There is a copse of elms to the east. We could really use that wood.
traduit: 东边还有一片榆树林。我们真的很需要那边的木头。

original: Mother, I finished cutting at the northern stand. Where do I move on to now?
traduit: 妈妈，我把北边的高台砍完了。接下来我该去哪儿呢？

original: It's okay, mother. I understand.
traduit: 没事的，妈妈。我明白。

original: I wish you didn't hate him so much... I wish the whole family could be together again.
traduit: 我希望你不要那么恨他……我希望一家人还能团聚。

original: He was a wonderful man, and he loved us very much. I'm sorry I yelled at you.
traduit: 他是个很好的男人，很爱我们。对不起，不该吼你的。

original: That's because there's nothing to tell. He left us to fend for ourselves and that's all you need to know.
traduit: 那是因为没什么好说的。他丢下我们自己照顾自己，你只需要知道这些。

original: I'm sorry mother, now that he's dead, I just want to know everything I can about him.
traduit: 抱歉妈妈，他现在死了，我只是想知道关于他的一切。

original: I'm sorry mother, I just want to know more about him. You never tell me anything!
traduit: 抱歉妈妈，我只是想多了解了解他。你什么都不告诉我！

original: Gralnach! I told you not to go through your father's things!
traduit: 格拉那驰！我说过不要翻你爸的东西！

original: Despite what you discovered it's still comforting to know my husband is at peace.
traduit: 不管你发现了什么，但能知道我丈夫安然无恙还是让人欣慰的。

original: So, any luck finding my louse of a husband?
traduit: 所以，我那个讨厌的丈夫有下落了吗？

original: Hmph. If you see my good-for-nothing husband Leifnarr on your journeys tell him he's no longer welcome here.
traduit: 哼。如果你在旅途中看见了我那个一无是处的丈夫雷夫纳尔，告诉他这里不欢迎他了。

original: Men are utter pigs... they only care about one thing.
traduit: 男人都是猪……他们就关心一件事。

original: You men are utter pigs... you only care about one thing.
traduit: 你们这些男人都是猪……只知道关心一件事。

original: Men are complete pigs, am I right? All they care about is one thing... and you know exactly what I mean.
traduit: 男人都是猪，对吧？他们就知道关心一件事……你明白我的意思。

original: If I ever catch my husband in bed with another woman, he's going to find himself homeless.
traduit: 如果我发现我丈夫和别的女人上了床，他就别打算回家了。

original: Thank you. What's next?
traduit: 谢谢你。接下来干什么？

original: I thought it was this easy for everyone.
traduit: 我以为这是人人都能做到的。

original: No. Indeed not. But beware that your skill does not outstrip your wisdom.
traduit: 不，不。但要记住，不要让你的技巧凌驾于自己的智慧。

original: I'm ready for more training.
traduit: 我准备好接受更多训练了。

original: Your quick mastery of a new Thu'um is... astonishing. I'd heard the stories of the abilities of Dragonborn, but to see it for myself...
traduit: 你对新吐'目的掌握速度实在……惊人。我听说过龙裔能力的传说，但还是刚刚亲眼得见……

original: What is the "Way of the Voice"?
traduit: “吼声之道”是什么？

original: Why are the dragons returning? Does it have something to do with me?
traduit: 龙族为何回归了？和我有关吗？

original: What does it mean to be "Dragonborn"?
traduit: 成为“龙裔”意味着什么？

original: Dragons have the inborn ability to learn and project their Voice. Dragons also are able to absorb the power of their slain brethren.
traduit: 龙族天生就能学习和投射他们的声音。也能吸收被杀同胞的力量。

original: A few mortals are born with similar abilities -- whether a gift or a curse has been a matter of debate down through the centuries.
traduit: 一些凡人天生拥有相同的能力，至于这究竟是赐福还是诅咒，却争论不休。

original: What you have already learned in a few days took even the most gifted of us years to achieve.
traduit: 你几天中就能学到的东西，即使是我们中最具天赋的人，也需要花上几年时间。

original: Some believe that Dragonborn are sent into the world by the gods, at times of great need. We will speak more of that later, when you are ready.
traduit: 有些人相信，龙裔会在最需要的时候被诸神派到世界上来。当你准备好以后，我们可以多谈谈。

original: Tell me about the Greybeards.
traduit: 跟我说说灰胡子。

original: Master Einarth is waiting.
traduit: 爱纳斯大师在等你。

original: You must feel the Word within yourself.
traduit: 你要在内心感受这个词。

original: You learn quickly, as only a Dragonborn can.
traduit: 你学得很快，只有龙裔能做到。

original: Master Borri is waiting.
traduit: 博瑞大师在等你。

original: Stand next to me, and prepare your Whirlwind Sprint. Master Borri will give the signal.
traduit: 站在我边上，准备好你的旋风冲刺。博瑞大师会给出信号。

original: Follow me. Master Borri will test your Whirlwind Sprint.
traduit: 跟我来吧。博瑞大师会测试你的旋风冲刺。

original: We will do your next test in the courtyard. Follow Master Borri.
traduit: 在院子里进行下一项测试。跟上博瑞大师。

original: Master Borri will teach you the first Word of a new Shout. Attend to him.
traduit: 博瑞大师会教你新龙吼的第一个词。去找他吧。

original: Thanks for the help. Not many willing to take on the Forsworn these days.
traduit: 谢谢你的帮助。现在没什么人愿意管弃誓者。

original: Painting won't put food on the table, but our crops will. Be patient Aduri... it will happen someday, I promise.
traduit: 画画不能当饭吃，但庄稼可以。要有耐心，阿都丽……总有一天会实现的，我保证。

original: It's not going to be next year, nor the year after that! You just care about this farm more than you care about me!
traduit: 不是明年，也不是后年！你只关心这个农场，比关心我还多！

original: I'm sorry, Aduri, not this year. Perhaps next year after the harvest, I don't know. There's so much to do.
traduit: 抱歉，阿都丽，今年不行了。也许等明年收获之后吧，我也不确定。还有很多事要做。

original: Have you decided if I can head up to Solitude yet? I hear it's the best place to meet someone who may be willing to teach me to paint.
traduit: 你决定好让我去独孤城了吗？我听说那里是能遇到愿意教我绘画的人的最佳地点。

original: All right, I understand. I'll do it tomorrow, okay? Just get off my back.
traduit: 好吧，我知道了。我明天再做，好吗？别再烦我了。

original: Boring? That food is paying for everything. If we lose even a single crop, we could starve or be forced to beg. I won't have it!
traduit: 无聊？食物就是一切。减产一株作物，都可能让我们挨饿或者乞讨。我可不想！

original: Because it's boring. The fields are going to do fine... you don't have to dote over them so much.
traduit: 因为太无聊了。田地会自己好起来的。你不需要这么溺爱它。

original: Aduri, how come the fields haven't been tilled like I asked?
traduit: 阿都丽，为什么没有按我说的去耕地？

original: I'm still busy, but I can always make time to speak with you.
traduit: 我还是很忙，但总是能抽出时间来和你聊聊。

original: Always a pleasure. What brings you back?
traduit: 见到你总是让人高兴。什么风把你吹来了？

original: Any luck locating those jazbay grapes?
traduit: 找到贾兹贝葡萄了吗？

original: Ah, you're back.
traduit: 啊，你回来了。

original: I hope this is important... I get little sleep as it is.
traduit: 我希望是要紧事……我现在睡得太少了。

original: I'm a bit busy at the moment, what did you want?
traduit: 我现在有点忙，你有什么需要吗？

original: I have a lot to do around the farm, so make it quick please. What is it you wanted?
traduit: 我在农场还有很多要做，所以请快点说。你有事吗？

original: I don't suppose you could come back another time? I'm very busy.
traduit: 我想你能不能下次再来？我太忙了。

original: This place is boring. Nothing but the same thing every day. Sigh.
traduit: 这地方太无聊了。每天都是同样的事。哎。

original: I wish I could head to one of the capital cities... maybe even back to Mournhold. Anywhere but here.
traduit: 我希望我能到首府城市去……或者是回哀伤之城。总之不是待在这里就好。

original: One day I hope to become a painter, but at this rate it looks like it's never going to happen.
traduit: 我希望能成为画家，但照目前的进度，似乎永远不可能实现了。

original: Can you imagine how wonderful it would be to set what you see on a canvas so you'd have that memory forever?
traduit: 你能想得到，用画布把看到的东西变成永恒的记忆是多么美妙吗？

original: My sister keeps telling me that the farm keeps us alive, but I don't really call this living.
traduit: 我姐姐一直跟我说农场能让我们活下去，但我不认为这是生活。

original: I can't let you do this, mother. You have to die now!
traduit: 我不能让你这么做，母亲。你现在去死吧！

original: I'll just prepare the subject now...
traduit: 我现在就准备实验对象……

original: Splendid! Please take a seat on the chair behind me, would you?
traduit: 太好了！请在我后面找个椅子坐下，好吗？

original: I found a willing subject for you. Payment has already been discussed, of course.
traduit: 我给您找来了一位自愿的受试者。当然，报酬也已经谈妥了。

original: Daughter. Who is this you have brought me?
traduit: 女儿。你带来的这是谁？

original: Greetings, mother.
traduit: 你好啊，母亲。

original: This is the last hagraven between us and my mother!
traduit: 这是我们和我母亲之间最后一个乌鸦鬼婆了！

original: Mining out this old rock is a lot quieter, now. Thank the Divines.
traduit: 现在开采这块老石头可安静多了。感谢圣灵。

original: Hard to believe there'd be an old crypt underneath the mine.
traduit: 真不敢相信这矿场下面居然有个古老地穴。

original: We're getting back to work as best we can.
traduit: 我们要尽最大努力复工。

original: It's crazy to still be working here. What if there's more draugr down there?
traduit: 在这里继续干活儿太疯狂了。万一下面还有更多尸鬼呢？

original: This mine will be our grave yet. I just know it.
traduit: 这个矿场就是我们的坟墓。我就知道。

original: Any day now more draugr are going to come out of that crypt.
traduit: 随时都可能有更多尸鬼从地穴里爬出来。

original: We tunneled into an old crypt. We're warning strangers to keep out.
traduit: 我们挖到了一个老地穴。我们正警告陌生人不要靠近。

original: I'm not going into the mine with draugr lurking down there.
traduit: 我可不会跟尸鬼一块挖矿。

original: Guards are useless. They just stand around waiting for a full regiment to come and help.
traduit: 卫兵一点用没有。他们就会在那儿干看着等大部队来帮忙。

original: We're keeping the mine closed until that crypt is clear.
traduit: 我们得关闭矿场，直到地穴被清理。

original: I hear talk about a regiment coming to clear the crypt out. We'll see if that happens.
traduit: 我听说有大部队来清理地穴，拭目以待吧。

original: There's still plenty of ore left in that mine. What a waste.
traduit: 那个矿里还有很多矿石呢。太浪费了。

original: Mine's closed. Move along.
traduit: 矿场关门了。走吧。

original: Yes, ma'am.
traduit: 是，妈妈。

original: You leave him alone. I don't want to hear Skaggi telling me you've been bothering him again!
traduit: 你离他远点。我不想再听到斯卡基抱怨说你又去骚扰他了！

original: But mom, it's so boring with just me and Torom. I was just asking Skaggi some questions.
traduit: 可是妈妈，只有我和托罗姆太无聊了。我只是想问斯卡基几个问题。

original: Skaggi tells me that you were bothering him today. Can't you and Torom just play by yourselves?
traduit: 斯卡基说你今天打扰到他了。你就不能和托罗姆自己玩儿吗？

original: I'm grateful, Skaggi. I'm sorry my daughter gives you so much trouble.
traduit: 我很感激，斯卡基。抱歉我女儿给你添了这么多麻烦了。

original: You work hard, Daighre. Glad you have stayed with us.
traduit: 你工作很努力，戴格利。很高兴你能在我们这儿。

original: So you're the newest member of our dwindling, dysfunctional little Family. I've heard quite a bit about you.
traduit: 这么说，你就是我们这个日益萎缩，职能紊乱的小家庭的新成员了。我对你还有所耳闻呢。

original: Stop. Turn around. And go back the way you came. Astrid is waiting for you. She's down near the entrance. You must have passed right by her.
traduit: 停下。向后转。原路返回。阿斯垂德在等你。在靠近入口那里。你从她那里擦肩而过了吧。

original: Divines sake, Skald. Who do think we're threatening with our old war wounds? We're not soldiers, anymore.
traduit: 圣灵在看着呢，斯卡德。谁会觉得我们在用过去战争的伤痛威胁你？我们已经退役了。

original: We need to talk.
traduit: 我们得谈谈。

original: I know, I know. I'm hurrying.
traduit: 我知道我知道。我正抓紧呢。

original: Yes, I'll be ready in a moment, I just need one more thing...
traduit: 好了，我快弄好了，只需要再……

original: Fine! I'll just... leave the rest of it. Let's go, then, if you're in such a hurry.
traduit: 好了！剩下的就……不要了。要是你很着急，我们现在就走。

original: Come in, come in. Mustn't speak of these things in the Ratway.
traduit: 请进，请进。千万别在鼠道里讲这些。

original: You... Dragonborn? Is it really true?
traduit: 你是……龙裔？这是真的？

original: So Delphine keeps up the fight, after all these years.
traduit: 这么多年过去，戴尔芬还在坚持战斗。

original: I thought she'd have realized it's hopeless by now. I tried to tell her, years ago...
traduit: 我还以为她也意识到没有希望了。很多年前我就告诉过她……

original: Too bad. That's what we're playing, and you're the Elf. Now go hide so I can hunt you!
traduit: 太糟了。我们就是在玩这个啊，你是精灵。快躲起来，我好追杀你！

original: Why do I always have to be the Elf? I don't want to!
traduit: 为什么我总要当精灵？我不想当！

original: We're playing Hunt the Elf. You're the Elf.
traduit: 玩狩猎精灵吧。你当精灵。

original: Good morning, Assur. What do you want to do today?
traduit: 早上好，阿苏尔。今天想干些什么？

original: It's not my place to get involved in their family's business, remember? You're the one that told me to stay out of it.
traduit: 我无权干涉人家的家事啊。是你不让我管的。

original: Are you so sure of that? I think Birna might disagree with you.
traduit: 你肯定？我想比尔娜可能不同意你的观点。

original: As long as he keeps paying, I suppose. He keeps to himself, and isn't hurting anyone.
traduit: 我想只要他继续付钱就行。他独来独往地也不会伤害谁。

original: How long are we going to let Ranmir drink himself into a stupor? When will enough be enough?
traduit: 我们要让兰米尔喝到昏迷不醒多久？什么时候才是个头？

original: I suppose that's a benefit to having so few customers.
traduit: 我想这就是客人少的好处吧。

original: Let's just keep an eye on the supply. It's such a chore to restock.
traduit: 那就盯着点存货吧。上新货真是个苦差事。

original: No. Even Ranmir can only drink so much.
traduit: 没有。就是兰米尔也只能喝那么多。

original: No, without Ranmir around we're running out of stock far less often than we used to.
traduit: 没有，没了兰米尔，我们现在缺货的次数比以前少多了。

original: Are we running low on mead?
traduit: 我们的蜜酒快喝完了吗？

original: But, give me... just a moment... I must gather a few things...
traduit: 但是，给我……一会儿时间……我得收拾些东西……

original: You're talking about the literal end of the world?
traduit: 你说的是字面意思上的“世界末日”？

original: Oh, yes. It's all been foretold. The end has begun. Alduin has returned.
traduit: 对，没错。一切早已被预言。终结已经开始，奥杜因回归了。

original: Only a Dragonborn can stop him. But no Dragonborn has been known for centuries.
traduit: 只有龙裔才能阻止他。可是几百年了龙裔并没有出现。

original: It seems that the gods have grown tired of us. They've left us to our fate, as the plaything of Alduin the World-Eater.
traduit: 看来众神已经厌倦了我们。他们把我们当成了“世界吞噬者”奥杜因的玩物，任由我们的命运遭受摆布。

original: Alduin... The dragon who's raising the others?
traduit: 奥杜因……就是那个在复活其他龙的家伙？

original: Yes. Delphine seemed to think it was important.
traduit: 对。戴尔芬似乎认为这很重要。

original: Important? Far more than even she realizes! If you are Dragonborn, then...
traduit: 重要？比她想的重要的多！你如果真是龙裔，那……

original: What do you mean, "it's hopeless"?
traduit: “没希望”是什么意思？

original: What do you mean, "the end is upon us"?
traduit: “末日临头”是什么意思？

original: The Thalmor have found you. We have to get out of here.
traduit: 梭默已经发现你了。我们得离开这儿。

original: Yes, yes, so you said. But so what? The end is upon us. I may as well die here as anywhere else. I'm tired of running.
traduit: 对，对，你说得对。但那又怎样？我们末日临头了，死在这里还是死在别处于我没什么区别。我已经不想再奔波了。

original: Oh, certainly I hope not! That would be quite unfortunate for my research.
traduit: 哦，我当然不希望！这对我的研究来说太不幸了。

original: I... see. And is this something I'll need to worry about in the future?
traduit: 我……知道了。那这就是我将来要担心的事？

original: No, certainly not. A small experiment may have gone awry, but clearly with no discernable consequences.
traduit: 不，没什么。有个小实验出了些差错，但显然没什么明显的后果。

original: Is there a reason you're asking me?
traduit: 你为什么这么问我？

original: No, I certainly didn't!
traduit: 不，我肯定没听到！

original: I say, you didn't hear any loud noises last night, did you? No, ahh... explosion sounds?
traduit: 我说，你昨晚有没有听到很大的声音？不对，是，啊……爆炸的声音？

original: I see. Well, let me know if things get out of hand.
traduit: 我明白了。好吧，如果事情失控，喊我一声。

original: Are you referring to your other customers? No, everything is quite all right. I expect a bit of animosity now and then.
traduit: 你指的是其他客人吗？没有，一切都好。我想时不时会有点敌意。

original: And there haven't been any... problems?
traduit: 没有任何……问题吗？

original: Oh yes, quite fine. My accommodations here continue to be just what I need.
traduit: 哦，是的，很好。这里的住宿条件很符合我的需要。

original: Is everything well, Nelacar?
traduit: 一切都还好吗，内拉卡？

original: Ha! Drink ain't gonna kill me. Not today, anyway.
traduit: 哈！喝酒害不死我。不管怎么说，今天就是不行。

original: Why? Because I'd rather be here trying to keep my only brother from drinking himself to death.
traduit: 为什么？因为我要阻止我唯一的兄弟喝死在这儿。

original: Why don't you go... sell something.
traduit: 你为什么不能去……卖点东西。

original: Can't. Got at least two rounds to go.
traduit: 不行。还得再喝两轮呢。

original: Please, come home. Just... Just come home.
traduit: 拜托，回家吧。快……回家吧。

original: Oh, I'm sorry. Am I bothering you? Am I making your life more difficult?
traduit: 哦，那可真对不起。是我打扰你了？还是让你的生活更艰难了？

original: If I wanted to get yelled at, I'd be home. Can't you leave me be?
traduit: 如果我想挨骂，我会回家的。你就不能离我远点吗？

original: How much of our money have you spent today, Ranmir? Anything left, or is it all gone?
traduit: 你今天花了我们多少钱，兰米尔？还有剩吗，还是都没了？

original: Well, isn't this a surprise!
traduit: 啊，真是惊喜啊！

original: Well, then he's welcome to eat and drink at home, isn't he?
traduit: 好啊，那就请他在自己家吃喝不就好了？

original: I believe he was suggesting their presence causes him harm.
traduit: 我相信他是在暗示他们的存在会对他造成伤害。

original: What of it? It's our Inn, and they cause him no harm.
traduit: 有什么关系呢？这里是我们的旅店，他们也不会伤害他。

original: I understand Korir's been complaining about our customers again.
traduit: 我听说科利尔又在抱怨我们的顾客了。

original: All right, all right. I'll speak to her.
traduit: 好吧，好吧。我会跟她说的。

original: I'm not "fretting." I don't want Eirid playing those sorts of games!
traduit: 我不是“烦恼”。我是不想让爱瑞德玩这种游戏！

original: It's just children playing, Haran. I wouldn't fret over it.
traduit: 只是孩子们玩闹，哈兰。不用为这事烦恼。

original: I understand Eirid's been playing "Hunt the Elf" again.
traduit: 我知道爱瑞德又在玩狩猎精灵了。

original: That's because you always lose... Elf.
traduit: 那是因为你总是输……精灵。

original: I hate this game.
traduit: 我讨厌这个游戏。

original: I'm gonna find you, Elf!
traduit: 我会抓到你的，精灵！

original: I don't know where she is.
traduit: 我不知道她在哪儿。

original: I'll find that Elf. I always do.
traduit: 我会找到那个精灵。我总是能找到。

original: I know where she is, but I'm not telling you.
traduit: 我知道她在哪儿，但是不会告诉你。

original: Fine, Elf-Lover. I'll find her myself.
traduit: 很好，你个亲精灵的。我会自己找到她的。

original: She's hiding on the east side of town.
traduit: 她躲在镇子东边。

original: All right!
traduit: 好吧！

original: She's hiding at the north end of town.
traduit: 她躲在镇子北边。

original: She's hiding over near the Inn.
traduit: 她就躲在旅馆附近。

original: Eirid and I are playing Hunt the Elf. It's my job to find the Elf, and kill it dead.
traduit: 我和爱瑞德在玩狩猎精灵。我的工作就是找到精灵再杀了它。

original: Have you seen it?
traduit: 你看见它了吗？

original: What now?
traduit: 又怎么了？

original: Now you have my Oghma Infinium. It contains the knowledge of the ages as revealed to Xarses, my loyal servant.
traduit: 现在你拿到了我的无限智典，其中包含了我的忠仆沙克斯的远古知识。

original: For hundreds of years it's been shut away from the world. Septimus was a useful tool for unleashing it.
traduit: 几百年来，它一直与外界隔绝。赛普蒂莫斯这个工具很好地执行了解放它的使命。

original: Now it is in your hands. Let us work wonders together...
traduit: 现在，它落到你的手里。让我们一同创造奇迹……

original: Come, my champion.
traduit: 来吧，我的勇士。

original: What is this... it's... it's just a book?! I can see. The world beyond burns in my mind. It's marvelous....
traduit: 这是什么……就……就是一本书？！我看到了。世界尽头在我脑海里燃烧。太神奇了……

original: Go forth. Do the biddings of Septimus, for he is working my will in your plane.
traduit: 去吧。执行赛普蒂莫斯的命令，帮助他就是在你们的位面执行我的意志。

original: I'll never join you, vile demon!
traduit: 邪魔外道！你休想让我和你同流合污！

original: Be warned. Many have thought as you do. I have broken them all. You shall not evade me forever.
traduit: 注意点，曾有无数人与你抱有同样的妄想，而我将他们尽数击溃。你躲得了一时，躲不了一世。

original: I am your servant, my lord.
traduit: 主啊，我就是你的仆人。

original: Indeed. Speak with me when the box has been opened, and all shall be revealed.
traduit: 很好。等箱子打开的时候再和我交谈吧，一切都会分晓的。

original: Your continuing aid to Septimus renders him increasingly obsolete. He has served me well, but his time is nearing its end.
traduit: 你对赛普蒂莫斯的持续帮助让他越发过时。他帮了我很多忙，不过他时日无多了。

original: Once that infernal lockbox is opened, he will have exhausted his usefulness to me.
traduit: 一旦那个该死的密锁箱被打开，他对我就没用了。

original: When that time comes, you shall take his place as my emissary. What say you?
traduit: 届时，你就代替他成为我之使者，如何？

original: Come closer. Bask in my presence.
traduit: 近前些。沐浴我的存在。

original: This "Ruminations" book is incomprehensible.
traduit: 这本《上古卷轴之思》很晦涩啊。

original: Aye, that's the work of Septimus Signus.
traduit: 对，那是赛普蒂莫斯·希格纳斯的作品。

original: He's the world's master of the nature of Elder Scrolls, but... well.
traduit: 他是研究上古卷轴本质的世界级大师，不过……

original: He's been gone for a long while. Too long.
traduit: 他已经消失太久太久了。

original: Keep an eye out for Imperials. They still hold this entire region. As long as we don't do anything stupid... we should be all right.
traduit: 注意帝国人。他们还控制着这片地区。但只要我们不做傻事……应该就没问题。

original: All right. If I make it back to Windhelm, I'll make sure Ulfric knows how you helped me.
traduit: 好吧。如果我回了风舵城。我会告诉乌弗瑞克你帮了我的。

original: Skyrim needs people like you, if we ever hope to regain our freedom from the damned Empire. Good luck.
traduit: 天际需要你这样的人。我们得摆脱这该死的帝国。

original: I was hoping you'd change your mind. Come on. I'm heading to Riverwood, just up the road. My sister Gerdur will help us out.
traduit: 希望你会改主意。来吧。我要沿着这条路去河木镇，我姐姐歌尔朵会帮咱们的。

original: To reach the heights of the Companions, you must join with us in the shared blood of the wolf.
traduit: 为了达到战友团的顶点，你必须分享我们的狼之血脉。

original: What kind of celebration?
traduit: 什么庆祝？

original: There's a pack of werewolf hunters camped nearby, at Gallows Rock.
traduit: 附近有一伙狼人猎手在绞架岩扎营。

original: The Silver Hand. I think you've met them before.
traduit: 是银手。你以前应该见过。

original: We're going to slaughter them. All of them.
traduit: 我们要杀光他们。

original: Lead on. Skjor's already scouting ahead.
traduit: 来吧。斯科约尔在前面探路了。

original: How could that have happened?
traduit: 怎么会这样？

original: He was one of the strongest we had, but numbers can overwhelm. He should not have come without a Shield-Brother.
traduit: 他是我们中最强的一个，但两拳难敌四手。他不该不带盾牌兄弟就来的。

original: Get out of here. I'm going to make sure we got the last of them, and see if there's any information to be gotten from the bodies.
traduit: 你先走吧。我留下来把他们赶尽杀绝，看看能不能从尸体上得到什么信息。

original: You and I have work to do. The Silver Hand will tremble at our sight.
traduit: 你我还有事要做。让银手在我们面前发抖吧。

original: We do this in secret because Kodlak is too busy trying to throw away this great gift we've been granted.
traduit: 我们之所以秘密行事，是因为克拉科正忙着要放弃我们得到的这份伟大礼物。

original: He thinks we've been cursed. But we've been blessed. How can something that gives this kind of prowess be a curse?
traduit: 他觉得我们被诅咒了。但我们是被祝福了。能被赋予这等威力之物，怎么可能是诅咒？

original: So we take matters into our own hands.
traduit: 所以我们得自己来了。

original: I'm glad you came. It's been a long time since we had a heart like yours among our numbers.
traduit: 很高兴你来了。我们已经很久没有接纳像你这样的人了。

original: That pitiful ceremony behind the hall does not befit warriors like us.
traduit: 大厅后院那个可悲的仪式不适合咱们这样的勇士。

original: You are due more honor than some calls and feasting.
traduit: 比起喊口号，办宴会，你值得获得更多荣耀。

original: That mound you remembered sounds like what we're looking for. East of Kynesgrove, right?
traduit: 你印象里那个土堆听上去像是我们要找的。好像在凯娜之林东面？

original: I don't know exactly. We need to find the ancient burial mound. Let's ask around town.
traduit: 我也记不太清楚。但咱们得找到那座古坟。到镇上问问看吧。

original: So where are we headed?
traduit: 我们去哪呢？

original: Do you know how crazy this sounds?
traduit: 你知道这有多疯狂吗？

original: Ha. A few years ago, I said almost the same thing to a colleague of mine. Well, it turned out he was right and I was wrong.
traduit: 哈。几年前，我也是跟我一个同事这么说。结果证明他是对的，我是错的。

original: You'll be back. If you're really Dragonborn, this is your destiny.
traduit: 你会回来的。你如果真是龙裔，那这就是你的命运。

original: Come on. We've got to get to Kynesgrove.
traduit: 来吧。我们得赶去凯娜之林。

original: We'd better keep moving.
traduit: 我们得快点。

original: What makes you think dragons are coming back to life?
traduit: 你凭什么认为龙族复活了？

original: I know they are. I've visited their ancient burial mounds and found them empty.
traduit: 我当然知道。我去过它们的古代埋葬地，结果发现墓穴空了。

original: And I've figured out where the next one will come back to life.
traduit: 我知道下一个要复活的在哪。

original: We're going to go there, and you're going to kill that dragon. If we succeed, I'll tell you anything you want to know.
traduit: 我们得赶过去，然后杀了那头龙。如果成功了，我自会向你解释一切。

original: So what's the part you're not telling me?
traduit: 你是不是瞒了我什么？

original: Dragons aren't just coming back, they're coming back to life.
traduit: 龙族不是什么回归，它们是正在复活。

original: They weren't gone somewhere for all these years. They were dead, killed off centuries ago by my predecessors.
traduit: 这么多年它们哪儿也没去，因为很久之前就被我的前辈们杀光了。

original: Now something's happening to bring them back to life. And I need you to help me stop it.
traduit: 现在有东西正在让它们起死回生。我需要你帮我一起阻止它。

original: Why are you looking for a Dragonborn?
traduit: 你为何寻找龙裔？

original: How do I know I can trust you?
traduit: 我如何才能相信你？

original: If you don't trust me, you were a fool to walk in here in the first place.
traduit: 你要是不相信我，那你刚才走进来就是犯傻。

original: You'd better start explaining. Fast.
traduit: 你最好给我快点解释清楚。

original: I'll explain what I want when I want, got it? You'd already be dead if I didn't like the look of you when you walked in here.
traduit: 我想解释的时候才会解释，懂吗？要不是看你进来时还算顺眼，你早就死了。

original: But I had to know if the rumors about you were true...
traduit: 而我必须知道那些关于你的传言是真是假……

original: Go on. I'm listening.
traduit: 继续。我听着呢。

original: Like I said in my note, I've heard that you might be Dragonborn.
traduit: 如我留言所说，我已经知道你可能是龙裔了。

original: I'm not your enemy. I already gave you the horn. I'm actually trying to help you. I just need you to hear me out.
traduit: 我不是敌人。号角给你了。我是想帮你。听我把话说完。

original: I'm part of a group that's been looking for you... well, someone like you, for a very long time.
traduit: 我们的组织长时间以来一直在寻找你……好吧，像你一样的人。

original: If you really are Dragonborn, that is. Before I tell you any more, I need to make sure I can trust you.
traduit: 我需要知道你是不是真是龙裔。在我和你说更多之前，我得确认你值得信任。

original: Kynesgrove. There's an ancient dragon burial near there. If we can get there before it happens, maybe we'll learn how to stop it.
traduit: 凯娜之林。那里有座古老的龙冢。我们如果能在事发前到达，或许就能找到制止它的方法。

original: That was well done. Come on. I've been wanting a closer look at one of these buggers.
traduit: 干得好。来吧。我一直想近距离看看这群家伙。

original: Come on. Let's go see if there's a mythical dragon buried up there.
traduit: 走吧。看看传说中的龙是不是真埋在那儿。

original: We need to find the burial mound. Let's ask in the inn.
traduit: 我们得找到那个坟堆。去旅馆问问吧。

original: I... it's true, isn't it? You really are Dragonborn.
traduit: 是……真的？你真的是龙裔。

original: So you were paying attention. I arranged to have Farengar recover the dragonstone for me.
traduit: 你注意到了。是我安排法仁加替我取回龙石的。

original: It's what I do. I make things happen from behind the scenes. After all, here you are.
traduit: 我就是这么做的。在幕后推动这一切，然后你就是这么到这儿来的。

original: I shouldn't let you walk out of here, knowing what you know. But I guess even my paranoia has its limits.
traduit: 你知道得太多了，我本不该让你活着离开。但我想，我的偏执总该有个限度。

original: You know where to find me when you change your mind. Because you will. You have to.
traduit: 回心转意之后，你知道去哪儿找到我。因为你一定会改变主意的，你也必须这样。

original: We remember what most don't - that the Dragonborn is the ultimate dragonslayer.
traduit: 大多数人都忘了，可我们记得——龙裔是终极屠龙者。

original: You're the only one that can kill a dragon permanently by devouring its soul.
traduit: 你是唯一一个能通过吞食巨龙灵魂而永久杀死它们的人。

original: The dragonstone was a map of ancient dragon burial sites. I've looked at which ones are now empty. The pattern is pretty clear.
traduit: 龙石是一幅古代龙冢地图。我已经看过哪里变空了。路径相当清晰。

original: It seems to be spreading from the southeast, down in the Jeralls near Riften. The one at Kynesgrove is next if the pattern holds.
traduit: 似乎是从东南方向开始的。从裂谷城旁边的杰拉尔山脉开始，如果路径保持一致，那接下来应该是凯娜之林附近这座。

original: I didn't go to all this trouble on a whim. I needed to make sure it wasn't a Thalmor trap.
traduit: 我不是心血来潮。而是要确认这一切并非梭默的陷阱。

original: You should know. You got the map for me. The dragonstone you got for Farengar, remember?
traduit: 你应该知道。地图是你给我的，你帮法仁加找回了龙石。不记得了？

original: Slen Tiid Vo!
traduit: 瑟冷 提德 沃！

original: There's no time to waste. Let's go.
traduit: 没时间了。我们走。

original: I just came here for the horn.
traduit: 我只是来拿号角的。

original: You ready to hear me out?
traduit: 你准备好听我说完了吗？

original: You'd better have a good reason for dragging me here.
traduit: 你最好有个好理由把我拉到这里。

original: It was the only way I could make sure it wasn't a Thalmor trap.
traduit: 这是我验证梭默陷阱的唯一办法。

original: What's with all the cloak and dagger?
traduit: 这些斗篷和匕首是怎么回事？

original: You can't be too careful. Thalmor spies are everywhere.
traduit: 你要格外小心。梭默间谍无处不在。

original: You're the one who took the horn?
traduit: 你是拿走号角的人？

original: Surprised? I guess I'm getting pretty good at my harmless innkeeper act.
traduit: 很惊奇？看来我很擅长伪装成无害的旅馆老板了呀。

original: So you're the Dragonborn I've been hearing so much about.
traduit: 所以你就是我听了很多回的那个龙裔。

original: Close the door, then we can talk.
traduit: 关上门我们再聊吧。

original: Not here. Follow me.
traduit: 不是这儿。跟我来。

original: The Greybeards seem to think you're the Dragonborn. I hope they're right.
traduit: 灰胡子好像觉得你是龙裔。但愿他们没走眼。

original: I think it would be better if you waited here.
traduit: 我觉得你还是在这里等比较好。

original: I suppose you're right. I'm not a fighting man.
traduit: 你说得对。我并不擅长战斗。

original: Go, and avenge my Laelette for me.
traduit: 去吧，为我的拉莱特报仇。

original: You're a brave man. Let's go.
traduit: 你够勇。我们走。

original: I have to go into the vampire's lair alone?
traduit: 我得独自深入吸血鬼巢穴？

original: They may be cowards, but I'm not. I'll go with you.
traduit: 他们都是胆小鬼。我和你去。

original: Of course. But why not let him go in first?
traduit: 当然可以。但为什么不让他先呢？

original: Of course. But why not let her go in first?
traduit: 当然可以。但为什么不让她先呢？

original: The rebels have agreed to cease hostilities until we hash out this treaty. Suffice it to say I'm not holding my breath.
traduit: 叛军已经同意在达成条约前停止敌对。但我不会屏息以待。

original: For the moment we have ceased hostilities. We'll see what these Imperials have to say. I doubt we'll come to any lasting agreement.
traduit: 我们目前已经停止敌对。看看帝国会怎么说。我怀疑我们没法达成持久的协议。

original: Things are quiet for the moment. That won't last long. As soon as a new campaign starts, I want you there. Stay close. See me tomorrow.
traduit: 目前一切平静。但这不会持续太久。一旦新战役打响，你就过去吧。保持密切联系。明天来见我。

original: The gods have granted us peace for the moment. But that won't last long. I'm sure trouble will be stirred up soon enough.
traduit: 众神暂时赐予了和平。但这不会持续很久。麻烦很快就会来的。

original: We were victorious!
traduit: 我们赢了！

original: By defeating Ulfric at Whiterun we have solidified the allegiance of the Jarl.
traduit: 在白漫城击败乌弗瑞克巩固了领主对我们的忠诚。

original: Perhaps the Stormcloaks will soon lose heart for this little rebellion of theirs once and for all.
traduit: 或许风暴斗篷很快就会对他们的小小叛乱彻底丧失信心了。

original: We've driven the Imperials out of Whiterun. This is good. Very good. We now control the center. It's a powerful position. One I aim to keep.
traduit: 我们把帝国军赶出了白漫城。很好。非常好。我们现在控制了中心地区。我们必须坚守住这个有力位置。

original: How goes the war?
traduit: 战争怎么样了？

original: What will it cost to change your mind? (Bribe)
traduit: 多少钱才能让你回心转意？（贿赂）

original: I'm not certain how many scholars you're accustomed to dealing with, but I can assure you that personal wealth is our lowest priority.
traduit: 我不知道你和多少学者打过交道，但我可以保证，钱财于我们真的是浮云。

original: Perhaps I could view your work?
traduit: 我能参观一下你的成果吗？

original: Preposterous! That research represents years of personal toil in some of the most dangerous Dwemer ruins in Skyrim!
traduit: 荒谬！这些研究是我在天际多少危险的锻莫遗迹里花费的多年心血！

original: You must be mad to think I'd allow anyone to see it before it's completed.
traduit: 你一定是疯了，才会觉得我会在完成前公之于众。

original: I hear you're the authority on ancient Falmer.
traduit: 我听说你是研究古代伐莫的权威。

original: Then you were well informed. I am at this very moment on the cusp of completing my magnum opus on the subject.
traduit: 消息很灵通。此时此刻，我即将完成我关于这个课题的杰作。

original: I'm calling it "Calcelmo's Guide to the Falmer Tongue." It will revolutionize the way we understand those ancient beings.
traduit: 我会把它命名为“卡塞莫的伐莫语指南”，这将彻底改变我们对那些古人的理解。

original: Can you translate it?
traduit: 你能翻译吗？

original: No. However, I know someone who might.
traduit: 不能，不过我知道有人或许可以。

original: The court wizard of Markarth, Calcelmo, may have the materials you need to get this journal translated.
traduit: 马卡斯的宫廷巫师卡塞莫，他或许有你需要的资料，可以翻译这本日记。

original: A word of warning. Calcelmo is a fierce guardian of his research. Getting the information won't be easy.
traduit: 给你个忠告。卡塞莫对他的研究严防死守。想拿到资料并不容易。

original: Yes, but there's a problem.
traduit: 对，但有个问题。

original: A problem? Let me see it.
traduit: 问题？让我看看。

original: This is just like Gallus. A dear friend, but always too clever for his own good.
traduit: 这才像是加卢斯。这老伙计就是喜欢自作聪明。

original: He's written all of the text in the Falmer language.
traduit: 整本日记都是用伐莫语写的。

original: I've been sent by Karliah.
traduit: 是卡莱亚让我来的。

original: Karliah? Then she's finally found it.
traduit: 卡莱亚？这么说她终于找到了。

original: Do you have Gallus's Journal?
traduit: 你有加卢斯的日记？

original: Shhh. Listen to Enthir... we can't afford to miss a single detail.
traduit: 嘘。仔细听恩希尔的话……我们不能放过任何一个细节。

original: We haven't much time for discussion, but what did you need?
traduit: 我们没多少时间可以讨论了，你到底想干什么？

original: Let's listen to Enthir's translation before we decide what we do.
traduit: 我们先听听恩希尔的翻译再做决定吧。

original: Please, there isn't much time. What is it?
traduit: 拜托，没多少时间了。有事吗？

original: Please, make it brief. We have much to do.
traduit: 请长话短说。我们还有很多事要做。

original: Back, eh? And how was our friend Calcelmo?
traduit: 回来了啊？咱们的朋友卡塞莫怎么样了？

original: Yes, yes. What is it?
traduit: 好，好。怎么了？

original: Can I help you with anything else?
traduit: 还有什么我能帮你的吗？

original: Ah yes, my matchmaker. What is it I can do for you?
traduit: 啊，是我的大媒人啊。需要效劳吗？

original: Look, I'm very busy, so this better be important.
traduit: 听着，我很忙，所以你最好说的是要紧事。

original: I've already provided you with the key to my museum, what else could you possibly want?
traduit: 我已经把博物馆的钥匙给你了，你还有什么需要吗？

original: How interesting. It appears Gallus's history has repeated itself.
traduit: 何等有趣。看来加卢斯的历史又重演了。

original: Karliah has provided me with the means to be rid of you, and this ancient tomb becomes your final resting place.
traduit: 卡莱亚给我提供了除掉你的好办法，这座古坟也就是你安息之地了。

original: But do you know what intrigues me the most? The fact that this was all possible because of you.
traduit: 但你知道是什么最吸引我吗？正因为你，这一切才成为可能。

original: You're a clever girl, Karliah. Buying Goldenglow Estate and funding Honningbrew Meadery was inspired.
traduit: 你是个聪明的女孩，卡莱亚。收购金色光辉庄园，资助蜜之酿酒庄，确实高明。

original: I'm no fool, Mercer. Crossing blades with you would be a death sentence.
traduit: 我可不傻，墨瑟。和你交手是自寻死路。

original: But I can promise the next time we meet, it will be your undoing.
traduit: 但我保证，下次见面的时候，你就完蛋了。

original: Enough of this mindless banter!
traduit: 这种无脑的玩笑已经够了！

original: Did you forget the Oath we took as Nightingales? Did you expect him to simply ignore your methods?
traduit: 你忘了我们成为夜莺时的誓言了吗？你以为他会就这么忽略了你的把戏吗？

original: Gallus had his wealth and he had you. All he had to do was look the other way.
traduit: 加卢斯有钱有你，财色双收。只需睁一只眼闭一只眼就可以了。

original: Not quick enough, otherwise Gallus would still be alive.
traduit: 还不够快，不然加卢斯就不会死了。

original: You always were a quick study.
traduit: 你总是学得很快。

original: "To ensure an enemy's defeat, you must first undermine his allies."
traduit: “为了确保敌人的败亡，必须先击溃他的盟友。”

original: It was the first lesson Gallus taught us.
traduit: 这是加卢斯给咱们上的第一课。

original: Give me a reason to try.
traduit: 那就给我个试试的理由。

original: Do you honestly think your arrow will reach me before my blade finds your heart?
traduit: 你真以为你的箭能在我的剑捅进你的心脏前射中我么？

original: Dragonborn!
traduit: 龙裔！

original: Shor's blood, the Thu'um!
traduit: 舒尔的血啊，是吐'目！

original: Are you Dragonborn?
traduit: 你是龙裔？

original: By the gods, is that the Voice?
traduit: 神啊，那是吼声吗？

original: Wow!
traduit: 喔！

original: That must be the Voice!
traduit: 那一定是吼声！

original: What in Arkay's name was that?
traduit: 阿尔凯在上那是什么？

original: That sound... it's deafening!
traduit: 耳朵……要被震聋了！

original: Could that be... the Voice?
traduit: 那是……吼声吗？

original: Those words have such power!
traduit: 这吼声这么有力！

original: What sort of power was that?
traduit: 这是什么力量？

original: That was amazing!
traduit: 太惊人了！

original: The Voice? Here?
traduit: 是吼声？在这儿？

original: That sound could bring mountains down!
traduit: 这声音快把山吼倒了！

original: You have a mighty voice!
traduit: 你的声音很洪亮啊！

original: That voice is power!
traduit: 这声音真有力！

original: Louder than the roar of the Mane, that is!
traduit: 比鬃鬣的咆哮还要洪亮！

original: S'rendarr's mercy!
traduit: 斯'仁达尔保佑！

original: Are you a Greybeard?
traduit: 你是灰胡子吗？

original: Did anyone else hear that?
traduit: 只有我一个听到了吗？

original: By the gods, my ears...
traduit: 神啊，我的耳朵……

original: That gave me the shivers!
traduit: 太吓人了！

original: Now that's a real man!
traduit: 这才是好汉！

original: Oh gods, my ears!
traduit: 天啊，我的耳朵！

original: Not so loud!
traduit: 不要这么大声！

original: I haven't heard a true shout in generations!
traduit: 真正的龙吼已经失传好几代了！

original: Now that's the true Voice!
traduit: 这才是真正的吼声啊！

original: How did you do that?
traduit: 你是怎么做到的？

original: Damn shame, Roggvir. You were a good man.
traduit: 真可惜，罗吉维尔。你是个好人。

original: That makes Twenty-Three.
traduit: 第二十三个。

original: Talos protect you.
traduit: 塔洛斯保佑你。

original: Roggvir. You damn fool.
traduit: 罗吉维尔。你这个大傻瓜。

original: I'm going to find whoever did this.
traduit: 我一定要找出凶手。

original: Kynareth preserve us.
traduit: 凯娜瑞丝保佑我们。

original: Better this one than me.
traduit: 干的比我好。

original: Agh! Dead body!
traduit: 啊！尸体！

original: Poor bastard's better off.
traduit: 可怜的家伙。

original: What a waste.
traduit: 真可惜。

original: Another corpse for the pile.
traduit: 又有一具尸体了。

original: Such a shame.
traduit: 太可惜了。

original: Damn shame.
traduit: 真可惜。

original: Dead? Oh my goodness!
traduit: 死了？神啊！

original: Shouldn't leave things around to trip over...
traduit: 不应该把东西留在这儿绊人……

original: Oh my word, this is terrible.
traduit: 我的天，太可怕了。

original: Agh! Who did this?
traduit: 啊！谁干的？

original: Another poor soul lost.
traduit: 又一个可怜的灵魂逝去了。

original: Dead? How did this happen?
traduit: 死了？怎么回事？

original: Oh... what happened?
traduit: 哦……发生什么了？

original: Your muscles ripple when you work the forge. It's pleasing.
traduit: 你的肌肉随着锻造一起颤动。赏心悦目啊。

original: Thank you, my chief.
traduit: 谢谢你，酋长。

original: It's simple Orc smithing practice, my chief. Nothing that hasn't been passed down for years.
traduit: 这只是兽人锻造的简单练习，酋长。都是些多年流传下来的。

original: The way you and your mother forge weapons is impressive.
traduit: 你们母子锻造武器的方式相当高明。

original: I am honored.
traduit: 我很荣幸。

original: Malacath is pleased with your strength, Larak.
traduit: 玛拉凯斯很满意你的力量，拉拉克。

original: You are speaking to Larak, chief of Mor Khazgur.
traduit: 我是拉拉克，莫尔·卡兹古尔的酋长。

original: You should see my forge-wife, Shuftharz, if you need weapons or armor.
traduit: 如果需要武器盔甲，可以去找我的锻妻舒夫萨兹。

original: My mother, Sharamph, knows many remedies you may wish to take with you.
traduit: 我母亲沙拉菲知道很多你需要的治疗方法。

original: I'm a strict follower of the old traditions. Honor, strength, deeds.
traduit: 我是个严格遵守古老传统的人。荣誉、力量、行为。

original: My place is chief and my challenge is to lead my people.
traduit: 我是这里的酋长，我的挑战是领导我的族人。

original: I have poisons for your weapons, and cures for your ills.
traduit: 我有可以涂在你武器上的毒药，也有治你病症的药水。

original: Poisons can kill your enemies faster than any blade.
traduit: 毒药可以比任何武器更快地杀死你的敌人。

original: Do not allow Ataxia to fester. A smart warrior keeps a potion to cure diseases at all times.
traduit: 千万别让运动失调症状恶化了。聪明的战士会常备药品来治疗疾病。

original: If you wish to trade, see me during daylight.
traduit: 如果想要交易，白天来找我吧。

original: I am wise woman to this stronghold.
traduit: 我是这座要塞的智妪。

original: Our chief is strong. That is all that matters.
traduit: 我们酋长很强壮。这很重要。

original: You should see my mother, Sharamph, if you need a cure or a poison.
traduit: 如果需要毒药或者药水的话，可以去找我母亲沙拉菲。

original: Shuftharz can forge you some armor, outlander.
traduit: 舒夫萨兹可以帮你锻造盔甲，外来者。

original: Malacath protect you.
traduit: 玛拉凯斯保护你。

original: Larak is strong, but he has much to prove as chief.
traduit: 拉拉克很强壮，但他还需要继续证明自己适合担任酋长。

original: You need some armor, outlander?
traduit: 需要护甲吗，外来者？

original: How about an axe? Malacath smiles on the axe-wielder.
traduit: 要不来把斧子？玛拉凯斯很欣赏使斧子的。

original: We can trade in the morning, outlander.
traduit: 明早再交易吧，外来者。

original: The forge is strong and so is our chief, Larak. I'm content.
traduit: 锻炉和我们的酋长都很坚固。我很满足。

original: My son, Olur, learns the forge well. His work brings me pride.
traduit: 我儿子欧罗很会锻造。他的工作让我感到骄傲。

original: I envy you, outlander. You can choose to leave if you wish.
traduit: 我很羡慕你，外来者。你可以随心所欲地选择离开。

original: Soon, I will be of age. The taste is bitter.
traduit: 很快我就要成年了。这滋味苦涩啊。

original: Perhaps I'll join the Legion one day, as my father had done.
traduit: 或许有一天我要像父亲那样加入军团。

original: I work in the forge and the mines. Mother says it pleases her and our people.
traduit: 我在铁匠铺和矿场里工作。母亲说她和族人都很高兴。

original: Even good hammers warp metal if struck without care.
traduit: 再好的锤子使用不慎也会变形。

original: Mother tells me to shape metal with focus and strength.
traduit: 母亲告诉我要集中精神和力量来锻造金属。

original: Patience, my son. The hunter days not welcome the blood of his prey, he waits for it.
traduit: 耐心点，儿子。猎人的日子不是欢迎猎物的鲜血，而是要等待它的到来。

original: Ah, the air is good today. I welcome the smell of blood from all the kills I will make.
traduit: 啊，今天空气真好。我欢迎所有杀戮带来的血腥味道。

original: Yes, mother. I'm eager to prove my skills today.
traduit: 是，母亲。我今天很想证明证明我的能耐。

original: The air has the smell of beasts. The hunt is good today.
traduit: 空气中有野兽的味道。今天很适合打猎。

original: Serving in the Legion taught me to respect leadership. The stronghold needs Burguk.
traduit: 在军团服役让我学会了尊重领袖。要塞需要博古克。

original: You could challenge Burguk, my brother. Yours is the stronger swordarm.
traduit: 你可以去挑战博古克，兄弟。你的剑比他更强。

original: This metal will serve the forge well, my brother.
traduit: 这种金属可以被锻造得很好，兄弟。

original: It is a fine day to work the mines.
traduit: 今天是个在矿场工作的好天气。

original: Oh, thank you my chief!
traduit: 哦，谢谢你，我的酋长！

original: No, my wife. You have been given other gifts to please your chief than mine work. I will talk to Gharol and all will be well.
traduit: 不会的，老婆。比起矿场的工作，你被赋予了取悦酋长的职责。我会跟加洛尔谈谈，不用担心了。

original: My chief, Gharol threatens to have me work in the mines. You won't allow my pretty hands to dirty, will you?
traduit: 酋长，加洛尔威胁要让我去矿场工作。你不会让我漂亮的手被弄脏吧？

original: No more talk of Shel. As chief, I will do what I please, so point your fiery gaze to our enemies.
traduit: 别再提谢尔了。身为酋长我想怎么做就怎么做，所以把你炽热的目光投向我们的敌人吧。

original: Do they, my chief? Am I now favored enough to replace Shel by your side at the feast? Back your words with action!
traduit: 是吗，我的酋长？那我现在有资格在宴会上代替谢尔待在你身边了吗？用行动来支持你的话吧！

original: I saw you working the forge today, wife. Your muscles have grown strong from the metal shaping!
traduit: 我今天看见你在锻炉干活了，老婆。你的肌肉在金属的塑造下变得很强壮了！

original: He is pleased. Ours is the strongest tribe in all the Reach.
traduit: 他是高兴的。我们是整个瑞驰最强大的部落。

original: Tell me, mother, does Malacath favor our stronghold?
traduit: 母亲，请告诉我，玛拉凯斯会喜欢我们的要塞吗？

original: You speak to Burguk, chief of Dushnikh Yal.
traduit: 我是博古克，杜什尼克·亚尔的酋长。

original: You need steel? Speak to my forge-wife, Gharol.
traduit: 需要武器吗？去找我的锻妻加洛尔。

original: Need a poison for your hunting? My mother, Murbul, knows several.
traduit: 需要打猎用的毒药？我母亲莫布尔知道几种。

original: This stronghold respects strength, and strength alone.
traduit: 这个要塞尊重力量，也只有力量。

original: Orc poisons are to be feared, if you wish to trade.
traduit: 如果想交易的话，兽人的毒药可是很可怕的。

original: I have an old cure for Rockjoint. Common in little Orc children.
traduit: 我这里有关节石化病的老方子。这病在兽人小孩子里很常见。

original: If you wish to trade, wait for the sun to rise.
traduit: 如果想交易的话等白天再说吧。

original: I am Burguk's mother and wise woman to our tribe, outlander.
traduit: 我是博古克的母亲，也是我们部落的智妪，外来者。

original: Malacath rewards the strong and punishes the weak.
traduit: 玛拉凯斯奖强罚弱。

original: Murbul knows many poisons and cures if you need them.
traduit: 莫布尔那儿有很多毒药和治病方子。

original: You should see Gharol if you're looking for a blade or armor.
traduit: 如果需要武器或者盔甲，去找加洛尔吧。

original: I am the hunts-wife of this stronghold.
traduit: 我是这座要塞的猎妻。

original: Burguk is a fine chief. He brings strength and wealth to the stronghold.
traduit: 博古克是个好酋长，给要塞带来了力量和财富。

original: You wish to trade in Orc steel?
traduit: 想买兽人武器吗？

original: Strong gauntlets for strong hands.
traduit: 强壮的手需要结实的护具。

original: Blades to kill your prey and your rivals.
traduit: 用武器去杀死你的猎物和对手吧。

original: We can trade when there's light outside.
traduit: 我们等外面天亮再交易吧。

original: I'm Burguk's forge-wife. I shape all the steel for the stronghold.
traduit: 我是博古克的锻妻，为堡垒打造武器。

original: As forge-wife, I'm also in charge of our mine.
traduit: 身为锻妻，我还负责我们的矿场。

original: I am Burguk's favored wife. He knows my beauty should be praised.
traduit: 我是博古克最宠爱的妻子。他知道我的美貌应该得到赞扬。

original: Arob and Gharol eye me with envy. They don't know how to please their chief.
traduit: 阿罗步和加洛尔总是羡慕地看着我。她们不知道怎么取悦酋长。

original: Umurn and Nagrub will be held up as weak next to the son I will one day bear for my chief.
traduit: 摩恩和纳格鲁在我和酋长未来生下的孩子面前就是弱者。

original: I work the forge, with my mother Gharol. We mine our own ore and shape our own metal.
traduit: 我在锻炉上和我母亲加洛尔一起工作。我们自己开采矿石自己锻造金属。

original: One day I will shape a weapon fit for a chief. Maybe that chief will be me.
traduit: 总有一天我会锻造出一件适合酋长的武器，而那个酋长也许就是我。

original: I help in the mines as well as the forge.
traduit: 我在矿上帮忙，也在铁匠铺打下手。

original: One day, I must fight my brother Nagrub for chiefdom. It will not be easy.
traduit: 总有一天我会和我兄弟纳格鲁争夺酋长位置。不容易啊。

original: I help my mother Arob with the hunt. We bring much meat and skins to the stronghold.
traduit: 我帮我母亲阿罗步打猎。我们给要塞提供了很多肉和毛皮。

original: Brother Umurn is a strong warrior. I look forward to fighting him for chiefdom one day.
traduit: 我兄弟摩恩是个强壮的战士。我期待有一天与他竞争酋长位置。

original: One day, I intend to be chief. I will fight my father and my brother for it, as is tradition.
traduit: 总有一天，我会当上酋长。按照传统，我会先和我父亲和兄弟决斗。

original: I serve my chief and my brothers by working in the mines. It's the only place fit for an aging Orc.
traduit: 我在矿上为我的酋长和兄弟们服务。这是唯一适合老兽人的地方。

original: Sorry, outlander, but this old Orc cannot help you. Burguk is the chief here.
traduit: 抱歉了，外来者，我这个老兽人可帮不上你。博古克才是这里的酋长。

original: I don't know how Ghorbash has so much spirit. He should act his age.
traduit: 真不知道格巴什怎么这么有精神。他的行为应该和年龄符合才对。

original: I used to wander the corners of Skyrim like you. I miss those days.
traduit: 我曾经也像你一样在天际四处闯荡。真怀念那段岁月。

original: We honor the bravest fighters, but I have seen many types of bravery in my travels.
traduit: 我们会向最勇敢的战士致敬，但我在旅途中见识了很多种勇敢。

original: I am an Orc and a warrior, but I have no desire to become chief.
traduit: 我是兽人，也是战士。但我不想当酋长。

original: Well, your bounty is low... All right, get out of my sight. But you're known to me now, scum. Remember that.
traduit: 你的赏金太低……好吧，滚出我的视线。但我现在认识你了，人渣。记着点。

original: You know what? You're not worth the hassle. Go... be some other guard's problem.
traduit: 你知道吗？你不值得这么麻烦。滚吧……剩下就是其他卫兵的事儿了。

original: I'm getting out of here!
traduit: 我得离开这儿！

original: Those fools are actually fighting!
traduit: 那些蠢货真的开打了！

original: Hey! Watch what you're doing.
traduit: 嘿！注意你的所为。

original: My money's on the big one.
traduit: 我赌大的那个。

original: Gods! Another fight.
traduit: 神啊！又打起来了。

original: I'm staying out of this.
traduit: 我不想掺和了。

original: Don't hurt me!
traduit: 别伤害我！

original: Please, someone do something!
traduit: 拜托，来人管管啊！

original: Somebody help!
traduit: 来人帮忙！

original: A fight!
traduit: 打起来了！

original: This should be good.
traduit: 这下好瞧了。

original: Get 'em! Kill 'em!
traduit: 拿下他们！杀了他们！

original: Why are they hurting each other?
traduit: 他们为什么要互相伤害？

original: Hey, no fair! Get her, Stump!
traduit: 嘿，不公平！树桩，去抓她！

original: How about... we play tag! You're it!
traduit: 要不……我们玩捉人游戏吧！抓到你了！

original: Oh yeah, and what would you rather do?
traduit: 哦好吧，那你想做什么？

original: Frodnar... nobody is going to believe that your dog is a... Frostbite Spider. And if they do... they'll kill him. That's not much of a prank.
traduit: 弗洛德纳……没人会觉得你的狗是……霜噬蜘蛛。如果他们真认错了……会杀了它的。这不是什么恶作剧。

original: Sure I am. We get some furs and tree branches, paint them white, and then tie them to Stump. Instant Frostbite Spider!
traduit: 我是认真的。我们找些皮毛和树枝，涂成白色，然后绑在树桩的身上。马上变成霜噬蜘蛛！

original: Wait, so... a costume? You're not serious...
traduit: 等等……伪装？你不是认真的吧……

original: I have the Horn of Jurgen Windcaller.
traduit: 我拿到了“唤风者”约根的号角。

original: Ah! You've retrieved the Horn of Jurgen Windcaller.
traduit: 啊！你找回了“唤风者”约根的号角。

original: Well done. You have now passed all the trials.
traduit: 做得好。你已经通过了全部试炼。

original: Come with me. It is time for us to recognize you formally as Dragonborn.
traduit: 跟我来吧。我们是时候正式承认你是龙裔了。

original: Stand in the center of the room and prepare yourself to taste the Voice of the Greybeards.
traduit: 站在房间中央。准备试试我们灰胡子的吼声吧。

original: Come inside. The other masters will meet us there.
traduit: 进来吧。其他大师在那等着我们。

original: First, Master Wulfgar will teach you the final word of Unrelenting Force. You are ready.
traduit: 首先，沃夫加大师会教你冷酷之力的最后一个词。准备好。

original: But to be outnumbered twenty to one...
traduit: 但人数上却是二十比一……

original: You infiltrated the position, eliminated the target, and made it look like an accident. Impressive. I'd say you earned your bonus on that one!
traduit: 你潜入那里，消灭了目标，还伪装成了一场意外。相当不错。奖赏是你应得的！

original: To kill triplets, secretly, and then have the whole thing blamed on the mother. Remarkable.
traduit: 偷偷杀了三胞胎，然后把一切都栽赃到母亲身上。干得漂亮。

original: It was a suicide mission! Astrid said as much. Yet here you stand, hale and hearty.
traduit: 这可是次自杀式的任务！阿斯垂德也这么说。而你还活蹦乱跳的站在这里。

original: By Sithis, you slew everyone! Well, except for that one you kept alive, to serve as witness. Does your wickedness, or your skill, know no bounds?
traduit: 西帝斯在上，你杀了所有人！除了那个留下了当目击者的。你的邪恶与技巧就没有极限吗？

original: But really. A horker, some twine, three wood elves, and a hatchet? Points for creativity, if nothing else.
traduit: 但说真的。一头海象、几根麻绳，三个木精灵再加一把斧子？别的不说，至少很有创意啊。

original: It's the part with the severed head I find most impressive. My compliments.
traduit: 我觉得砍头那部分很精彩。值得表扬。

original: I'm just trying to imagine you hiding inside the body of a mammoth. Bloody brilliant idea.
traduit: 我只是在想你躲在猛犸身体里的样子。真是好点子。

original: You're referring to that blacksmith contract?
traduit: 你是说铁匠那个契约？

original: You must be talking about the caravan job...
traduit: 你是说商队那个差事吧……

original: Word certainly travels fast, doesn't it?
traduit: 消息传的够快啊。
