original: The temple contract? Well, I certainly won't deny my involvement. He he he he he.
traduit: 那个神殿的契约？我当然是参与了。呵呵呵呵呵。

original: The Redoran contract? Yes, you heard correctly. In and out of Vvardenfell in less than forty eight hours.
traduit: 那个瑞多然的契约？对，你没听错。出入瓦登费尔用了才不到两天。

original: Ah, you must mean my little adventure on the ship...
traduit: 哦，你是说我在船上的小小冒险吧……

original: Oh, you mean in that manor house? During the thunderstorm? Heh. What can I say? It happened, just like you heard.
traduit: 哦，你是说庄园里那档子事？下雷雨那天？哈，我还有啥好说的？和你听说的一样。

original: Astrid, I've been hearing some, er... interesting things, from the others... about what you did when you left the Sanctuary last week...
traduit: 阿斯垂德，我从别人那听说了一些……有意思的事……说你上周离开圣所的所作所为……

original: Tell me, husband. Is it true what I've heard?
traduit: 老公，跟我说说。我听到的是真的吗？

original: So, is it true?
traduit: 这么说，是真的了？

original: I heard about what happened...
traduit: 发生的事我已经听说了……

original: Tell me, brother. Are the stories true?
traduit: 兄弟，跟我说说，那事是真的吗？

original: Tell me, sister. Are the stories true?
traduit: 姐妹，跟我说说，那事是真的吗？

original: Your latest exploit certainly has the Sanctuary talking...
traduit: 你最新的英雄事迹已经在圣所里传遍了……

original: Come now. What everyone else is saying. It can't possibly be true...
traduit: 得了吧。不管大家怎么说。肯定不是真的……

original: Aye, and she's added more traps now as well... A moment of silence for our fallen friend...
traduit: 是啊，现在她又加了一堆陷阱……只能为咱们死去的朋友默哀了……

original: It was a stupid plan, and now Rigel is so mad she won't even let us cut him down from there!
traduit: 那就是个愚蠢的计划，现在利赫尔太疯狂了，连让我们把他摘下来都不行！

original: I tried to tell him that he wouldn't get past the traps, but he wouldn't listen...
traduit: 我试着告诉他，他不可能通过陷阱，但他就是不听……

original: The crucial nature is pure apparent. Mundane sight traded for another sort.
traduit: 关键性的本质是十分浅显可解的。而世俗之见换来了另一种解读视角。

original: How do I join the Imperial Legion?
traduit: 我怎么加入帝国军团？

original: There's no greater honor than to serve. If you're serious about enlisting, speak to Legate Rikke in Castle Dour.
traduit: 没有什么比参军更荣耀的了。如果你真的想入伍，就去阴郁堡找瑞姬副官。

original: Who is Roggvir?
traduit: 罗吉维尔是谁？

original: He's the sorry bastard who's going to be executed.
traduit: 就是那个要被处决的混蛋。

original: A gate guard who let Ulfric Stormcloak escape the city, after he killed the High King.
traduit: 乌弗瑞克杀害至高王之后，帮他逃出城的卫兵。

original: If you've come to Solitude to join the Legion, speak to Rikke. If not, just keep your nose clean while you're here... or you'll end up like Roggvir.
traduit: 如果你来独孤是为了加入军团，去和瑞姬谈谈吧。如果不是，那就别在这里惹事……否则就会像罗吉维尔一样。

original: Angela... Mrs. Morrard... your daughter is dead.
traduit: 安吉灵……莫兰德夫人……您的女儿已经去世了。

original: I told her. I told her the imperial army would kill her. That this was a war of Jarls and Imperial Generals and we had no part in it.
traduit: 我告诉过她。我说帝国军会害了她。这是领主和帝国将军们的战争，我们没必要掺和进去。

original: She just wouldn't hear it.
traduit: 她就是不听。

original: It was brave of you to come to me with this. I can't thank you for it, not for this, but you have done me a service.
traduit: 你很有勇气，愿意把真相告诉我。我不知道该怎么感谢你，但你帮了我一个忙。

original: I have some news about your daughter.
traduit: 我有关于您女儿的消息。

original: You got Aldis to tell you something? I knew you would. What did he say?
traduit: 艾迪斯告诉你了吗？我就知道你能办到。他说什么了？

original: Her daughter was sent to Whiterun, the skirmishes there have been violent. The whiterun legate, he needed to know the Stormcloak positions.
traduit: 她女儿被派到白漫，那里的冲突一直很激烈。白漫地区的副官需要知道风暴斗篷的确切位置。

original: He sent out a party to scout the area. They happened upon a large force... I'm told none of them made it back.
traduit: 他派了一个小队去侦察那个地区。结果他们撞上了一支大部队……我听说他们全军覆没了。

original: Private Morrard... Angela's daughter was in that scouting party. She needs to be told.
traduit: 莫兰德列兵……安吉灵的女儿也参加了那支队伍。应该让她知道情况。

original: Tell me about her daughter. That's an order, Captain.
traduit: 告诉我她女儿的情况。这是命令，队长。

original: Yes, Sir. Although I'm not sure you'll be happy to know.
traduit: 是，长官。虽然我觉得你不会乐意听到。

original: Fine. If that's the way you want it.
traduit: 很好。如果这是你想要的。

original: That's the way it is.
traduit: 就是这么回事。

original: Well, I'm making it "need to know." (Intimidate)
traduit: 我可以把它更正成“必须知道”。（恐吓）

original: If you want to know that bad then fine.
traduit: 如果你很想知道，那好吧。

original: I'm afraid that kind of thing doesn't work on Captains in the Imperial Army.
traduit: 恐怕这法子在帝国军的队长身上行不通。

original: I think Angela needs to know. (Persuade)
traduit: 我想安吉灵应该知道。（说服）

original: I... I've been trying to find the time and place to let her know.
traduit: 我……我一直在找合适的时间和地点去告诉她。

original: I'm sorry, I can't help you.
traduit: 对不起。我帮不了你。

original: Captain, Angela sent me to ask about her daughter.
traduit: 队长，安吉灵让我来问问她女儿的事。

original: Generally posting information is need to know only.
traduit: 通常来说，驻派情报只向必要知情人透露。

original: It's good to see a fresh face. You wouldn't have happen to come from Whiterun would you?
traduit: 很高兴能见到新面孔啊。你不会碰巧从白漫来吧？

original: It's all thanks to a special technique I developed. I call it the "Razor-Winged Butterfly." I'd teach it to you... but then I'd have to kill you.
traduit: 都要归功于我发明的一项特殊技术。我起了个名字叫“刀翼蝴蝶”。回头可以教教你……教完我就得把你弄死。

original: Yeah, well, don't expect many more stories like that in my future. I'm getting old. Being that amazing takes too much damn effort.
traduit: 嗯，别指望我以后有这么多故事了。我老了。想做到那么神奇太费劲了。

original: Hmph. Been awhile since I've actually cleaved someone in two. Forgot how hard it was to get the scimitar back out.
traduit: 嗯。我很久没把人劈成两半了。都快忘了把弯刀拔出来有多难了。

original: Let that be a lesson to you young pups. There is no challenge that magic cannot overcome.
traduit: 给你们这群小崽子上一课吧。没有魔法应付不了的挑战。

original: Bah! A child could have accomplished it. Such is the power of the arcane. If you only knew of the spells I didn't use. He he he he he.
traduit: 呸！小孩子都能做得到。这就是奥术的力量。但如果你只懂那些我没用过的魔法的话。呵呵呵呵呵。

original: What? You think me too old, too feeble? There is more knowledge in me than in two of you pups put together. And knowledge... knowledge is my weapon.
traduit: 什么？你觉得我太老太弱？我的知识，就是你们这种小崽子两个捆在一块都比不上。知识……知识就是我的武器。

original: Once again, you have underestimated me. You see the man, brutish and hulking. But I am wolf as well. Deliberate. Cunning.
traduit: 你还是低估了我。你看到的是粗野又壮硕的人。但我也是狼，会深思熟虑，狡猾无比的狼。

original: Romantic, isn't? Like that time we first met. Remember that? Never seen so much blood. Ah, to be young again...
traduit: 浪漫吗？就像我们的初遇一样。记得吗？从没见过那么多血。哦，梦回年轻啊……

original: When I am become wolf, I am treachery incarnate. And then, then... there is no one who can stand between the hunter and his prey.
traduit: 当我变成狼，我就是背叛的化身。然后，然后……就没人能阻挡猎人狩猎了。

original: When I first received the blessing of the wolf, my creator gave me a valuable piece of advice. "Arnbjorn," he said. "Never lose!" And I never do.
traduit: 当我第一次得到狼之祝福的时候，创造我的人给了我一个宝贵的建议。他说，“艾恩乔恩，永远不要失败！”。而我做到了。

original: He he. Don't forget that I am Shadowscale. I was, quite literally, born to kill.
traduit: 呵呵。别忘了我是影鳞。毫不夸张，我天生就是杀手。

original: It was a simple matter, really, when one has mastered the art of camouflage. Scale becomes stone, becomes shadow. Then... death.
traduit: 掌握了伪装的艺术之后，一切都变得简单了。鳞片变成石头、变成阴影。然后……死亡降临。

original: My greatest challenge was deciding which weapon to use, for I am prone to indecision. Bow, dagger... axe? In the end, I opted for my claws.
traduit: 我遇到的最大挑战就是考虑该使用哪种武器，因为我很容易优柔寡断。弓箭、匕首……斧子？最后我选了自己的爪子。

original: In truth? It was so easy, I feel a bit guilty. Once again, the sweet, innocent child earned more trust than was wise.
traduit: 事实上呢？太容易了，容易得让我觉得有些不好意思。再说一次，天真可爱的小孩比小机灵鬼更容易赢得更多信任。

original: You give me too much credit. For how could I fail? I am, after all, just a little girl. What threat could I possibly pose? He he he he he.
traduit: 你太抬举我了。我怎么会失败呢？毕竟，我就是个小女孩呀。又有什么威胁呢？呵呵呵呵。

original: I am the perfect weapon. My innocent, childish form grants me nearly unrestricted access. Poison or a good bite usually takes care of the rest.
traduit: 我自己就是完美的武器。天真、幼稚的躯体让我不受任何限制的进入任何地方。毒药或者咬一口就能解决剩下的问题。

original: I am but a humble instrument of Sithis. Our Dread Father guides me. Therefore, failure is an impossibility.
traduit: 我不过是西帝斯卑微的工具。我们的恐惧之父指引着我。因此，永不会失败。

original: In the end, I relied on a woman's natural weapons - beauty and seduction. The rest was a formality. Though, a rather wet, messy formality...
traduit: 最后，我依靠的是女人的天然武器——美貌与诱惑。其他都是走过场。不过，是个相当潮湿、凌乱的过场。

original: When one can divine the future, success may not be assured... but it can at least be anticipated. It helps that I've already foretold my own death.
traduit: 即便能够预知未来，但不一定能成功……不过至少可以预知些东西。比如我已经预知了自己的死亡，还算有点用。

original: Come now, dear husband. You above all people should know what I'm capable of.
traduit: 拜托，亲爱的。所有人中你是最知道我能力的。

original: Unscrupulous daring. It's why you fell in love with me, my dear.
traduit: 肆无忌惮的胆量。这就是你我相爱的原因，亲爱的。

original: Sometimes I just need to remind everyone why I'm the one in charge.
traduit: 有时候，我只是需要提醒大家为什么我才是老大。

original: I guess I got tired of handing out contracts to everyone else, while I stayed home playing den mother. It was good to get out, and have some fun.
traduit: 我想我是厌倦了把契约交给别人，然后自己待在家里当训话员。出去走走，找点乐子，感觉不错。

original: I'd be lying if I said I didn't enjoy myself. But more importantly, I made this Sanctuary some much needed gold. In the end, that's all that matters.
traduit: 如果我说玩得不开心，那是撒谎。但最重要的是，我帮圣所赚了些急需的资金。这才是最要紧的。

original: Well, I just did what had to be done. Nothing more. Nothing less. I'm just glad I lived to tell the tale.
traduit: 我只是做了该做的事。仅此而已。我只是很高兴能说着讲述故事。

original: Ah, contracts like that are few and far between, it seems. Makes me long for the old days...
traduit: 啊，这样的契约很少了。真怀念过去的日子……

original: I'm the Jarl's personal blacksmith, but that doesn't mean I can't sell you a few pieces for a fair price.
traduit: 我是领主的私人铁匠，但我也能卖几件给你。

original: The Empire has always been good to the Orcs, but this war of theirs is none of my concern.
traduit: 帝国一直对兽人很好，但他们这场战争与我无关。

original: I served in the Legion with Thongvor Silver-Blood. He's a good man and a tough soldier.
traduit: 我和松瓦·银血一起在军团里服过役。他是个好人，也是个坚强的战士。

original: I learned to forge when I was a pup, then I joined the Legion and mastered it.
traduit: 我从小就学习锻造，在我加入军团之后逐渐精通了。

original: Poor Banning. Twice as much work here in the stables without him.
traduit: 可怜的班宁。没了他，马厩的活儿多了一倍。

original: You need a reliable horse in the Reach. That's what we have.
traduit: 在瑞驰你需要有匹可靠的马。我们这里就有。

original: You treat a horse well, it'll take you to Oblivion and back.
traduit: 只要你对马好，它能驮着你到湮灭跑个来回。

original: Traveling in the Reach is dangerous. You need a good carriage.
traduit: 在瑞驰领旅行很危险。你需要有个好马车。

original: City of Markarth sure is a beauty. No doubt about that.
traduit: 马卡斯城很美丽。这是肯定的。

original: Stormcloaks took Markarth. It is good to see Talos worshipped openly again.
traduit: 风暴斗篷占领了马卡斯。很高兴看到塔洛斯再次被公开崇拜。

original: What can an old skald do for you, huh?
traduit: 老吟唱者有什么能帮你的吗？

original: Songs are just old memories that help the mead go down quicker.
traduit: 歌曲就是帮助蜜酒更快下肚的古老记忆。

original: I've seen every corner of Skyrim, but nothing is as beautiful as the battlefield.
traduit: 我见识过天际的每个角落，但没有什么比战场更加美丽的了。

original: My father Kleppr is the one you want to talk to. I just clean up.
traduit: 你应该在找我爸克莱珀。我只是负责打扫的。

original: My mother and father yell a lot. Always have.
traduit: 我爹妈就爱大喊大叫。总是这样。

original: I work silver, like my father, and his father before him.
traduit: 我是做银器的，和我父亲也是，父亲的父亲也是。

original: My wife Kerah runs our jewelry stall in the market.
traduit: 我老婆克拉在市场经营珠宝摊。

original: My daughter Adara is also my apprentice. She's a quick study.
traduit: 我女儿艾达拉也是我徒弟。她学东西很快的。

original: I prefer working in silver. More skill needed than forging iron or steel.
traduit: 我喜欢做银器。比锻造钢铁更需要技术。

original: Silver-Bloods tax everything now that they run the city.
traduit: 银血家族现在掌管着城市，什么都收税。

original: The finest jewelry in all of Markarth.
traduit: 全马卡斯最好的珠宝。

original: Redguard craftsmanship in every piece.
traduit: 每一件都是红卫工艺。

original: Are you looking for a gift for a friend, perhaps? Or... a lover?
traduit: 在为朋友挑礼物吗？还是……小情人？

original: Perhaps a silver necklace or a silver ring? Easy to wear and soft against the skin.
traduit: 要不要来个银项链或者银戒指？戴起来方便而且不磨皮肤。

original: I have a necklace that would look lovely on you, or on a... special someone.
traduit: 我这里有条项链你戴上会很好看，或者买给……特别的人。

original: My daughter Adara is going to be a fine silversmith when she's older.
traduit: 我女儿艾达拉长大后会成为优秀的银匠。

original: Jewelry for sale. Redguard craftsmanship in every piece.
traduit: 卖珠宝。红卫工艺的珠宝。

original: You there, uh, the finest silver in Markarth is sold right here.
traduit: 喂，马卡斯最好的银器就在这里。

original: Maybe you could buy a gift for a friend? A best friend?
traduit: 想给好朋友买些礼物？

original: I'm going to be a silversmith one day, like my mother and father.
traduit: 总有一天我会成为和我爸妈一样的银匠。

original: Being an apprentice is great. I get to swing a hammer at things.
traduit: 当学徒很棒。我可以拿锤子去敲东西。

original: Mama doesn't like me jumping up and down in the house, but I can't help it. I swear.
traduit: 妈妈不喜欢我在房子里上蹿下跳，但我就是忍不住。真的。

original: Stormcloaks or Imperials. Either way, all they want is everything for free and you to lick their boots.
traduit: 风暴斗篷也好，帝国也罢。不管怎么样，他们想要的都得免费，而你还要舔他们的鞋。

original: Hey you. Yeah, you. Fresh meat for your stomach.
traduit: 嘿。对，就是你。给你的胃准备点鲜肉吧。

original: The bloodiest beef in the Reach.
traduit: 全瑞驰最新鲜的牛肉。

original: You want a cut of venison or mutton? Of course you do.
traduit: 想要块鹿肉还是羊肉？你肯定想要吧。

original: Don't try to haggle with me. Buy or leave.
traduit: 别想讨价还价。要么买要么走开。

original: The secret to chopping meat is never washing your hands.
traduit: 切肉的秘诀就是永远不要洗手。

original: A man like me makes a lot of enemies. People are always trying to cheat me.
traduit: 像我这样的人树敌很多。人们总是想骗我。

original: I paid extra for the biggest room in the Silver-Blood Inn. I need space to stretch these arms.
traduit: 我付了额外的费用租下了银血旅店最大的房间。我需要空间来伸展伸展。

original: I am the Jarl of Markarth, now. The Silver-Blood family is finally where it should have always been.
traduit: 我现在是马卡斯的领主了。银血家族终于回到了它本该在的地方。

original: Igmund was weak. We'll bring the order that the Empire should have.
traduit: 依格蒙德太弱了。我们会带来帝国应该带来的秩序。

original: Let the Forsworn ravage the Reach. Talos favors us. Our victory is assured.
traduit: 让弃誓者蹂躏瑞驰去吧。塔洛斯保佑我们，我们终会胜利的。

original: The Silver-Blood family will be heard.
traduit: 银血家族会声名远扬。

original: Jarl can refuse to see me all he likes. He can't ignore us forever.
traduit: 领主想怎么拒绝接见我都行。但他不可能永远不理我们。

original: Markarth lives because my family makes sure it's fed on gold and silver.
traduit: 马卡斯能够存活的原因就是我的家族确保了它能以真金白银为食。

original: I'm Thongvor's steward now. Every coin in this city is ours.
traduit: 我现在是松瓦的总管了。这个城市每一枚金币都是我们的。

original: We'll be sending generous resources to Ulfric. As much as the Reach can bleed.
traduit: 我们会向乌弗瑞克提供大量资源。瑞驰能出多少就出多少。

original: Taxes. I love taxes.
traduit: 税收。我喜爱税收。

original: Out of my way, kinsman.
traduit: 让开点，老乡。

original: Out of my way, outsider.
traduit: 让开点，外来的。

original: Didn't I speak clear enough? Out of my way.
traduit: 我说的还不够清楚吗？让开。

original: Thongvor's made me his housecarl. Remember, me killing you is legal.
traduit: 松瓦任命我当他的侍卫。记住，我杀你可不犯法。

original: Keeping this place secure is as simple as breaking a few spines.
traduit: 保证这里的安全就像打断几根脊椎一样简单。

original: Used to have run-ins with the guards, now they have run-ins with me.
traduit: 以前我和卫兵有争执，现在他们和我有争执。

original: Outsiders. Pfft.
traduit: 外来人。呸。

original: Blood and silver, friend. Blood and silver.
traduit: 血与银，朋友。血与银。

original: Just turn around and leave the city. That's the smart move.
traduit: 聪明点的，就转身离开这座城市。

original: My family owns this inn, but I've put Kleppr in charge. Right rat for the right job, I say.
traduit: 我的家族拥有这座旅店，但我让克莱珀来打理。要我说，合适的人干合适的活儿。

original: I'm a busy man. Half this city works for my family, and I have to keep them in line.
traduit: 我很忙。半个城的人都在为我的家族工作，我得让他们听话。

original: Thongvor may be the head of the family, but I'm the hands.
traduit: 松瓦也许是一家之主，但掌权的是我。

original: We control every piece of this city. The people should be calling us kings.
traduit: 我们控制着城市的每个区域。人们应该管我们叫国王。

original: If someone joins the Forsworn, we haul him to the mines.
traduit: 如果有人加入弃誓者，我们就把他扔进矿场里去。

original: Every prisoner in the Reach is just another worker for our family.
traduit: 瑞驰的所有犯人都是我们家族的工人。

original: I'm married to Thonar Silver-Blood. Keep that in mind while you're speaking to me.
traduit: 我嫁给了托纳尔·银血。跟我说话的时候记着点。

original: My husband Thonar handles all our family's business. He's an important man.
traduit: 我丈夫托纳尔负责我们家族所有的生意。他可是个大人物。

original: I married Thonar for the money, and I'm not the least bit ashamed to admit it.
traduit: 我嫁给托纳尔就是图他钱，承认这一点没什么可耻的。

original: I'm just a servant. Don't pay me any mind.
traduit: 我就是个仆人。不用费心。

original: Working in the Treasury House isn't so bad. I earn good money.
traduit: 在珍宝屋工作也没那么糟。我挣得不少。

original: Ildene has been working in the Treasury House since before I was born.
traduit: 伊德内在我出生前就在珍宝屋工作了。

original: Sometimes I hear Yngvar singing in his room. He's actually quite good.
traduit: 有时我听到英瓦尔在房间里唱歌。他其实挺厉害的。

original: You just let old nana know if you need anything, all right dear?
traduit: 有什么需要就告诉我这个老妈子，好吗，亲爱的？

original: I've worked in the Treasury House for almost twenty years.
traduit: 我在珍宝屋工作了将近20年了。

original: There isn't an inch of this building that I haven't cleaned up.
traduit: 这栋房子里的每一寸地方我都打扫过了。

original: So the Stormcloaks took the Reach? Maybe Talos really is on their side.
traduit: 这么说风暴斗篷占领了瑞驰？也许塔洛斯真的站在他们那边。

original: Arnleif and Sons Trading Company buys and sells anything you wandering types need.
traduit: 阿雷夫父子贸易商行买卖任何你们这些流浪者需要的东西。

original: No, I'm not Arnleif. Yes, I know it's called Arnleif and Sons.
traduit: 不，我不是阿雷夫。我知道这里叫阿雷夫父子贸易商行。

original: The selection seems small, but we can provide whatever you need. Just ask.
traduit: 可供选择的看似很少，但我们会提供您需要的任何商品。只要问我就行。

original: I love hearing Ogmund sing at the inn. He's a true skald.
traduit: 我喜欢听欧格蒙在旅馆里唱歌。他是个真正的吟唱者。

original: With Lisbet gone, I'll be taking care of you.
traduit: 利斯拜特走了，有什么事找我好。

original: Let me know if there's something you need to buy.
traduit: 如果想买什么，请告诉我。

original: I'm keeping Arnleif and Sons going, as best I can.
traduit: 我会尽我所能把阿雷夫父子贸易商行经营下去的。

original: Never thought I'd be running the store. I'm not used to it.
traduit: 从没想过我会经营这家店。我还不太习惯。

original: Lisbet handles the customers. I just check the shipments.
traduit: 利斯拜特负责接待客户，我只是检查货物的。

original: Feel free to take a look around the store.
traduit: 在店里随便看看。

original: I've been at Arnleif and Sons all my life. It's a good store.
traduit: 我这辈子都在阿雷夫父子，这是家好店。

original: I remember old Arnleif building each shelf in this store himself.
traduit: 我还记得老阿雷夫自己搭建了这个店里的每一个货架。

original: Old Arnleif would be proud of Lisbet. She's kept this place running, thick and thin.
traduit: 老阿雷夫会以利斯拜特为傲的。无论好坏，她都维持着这个地方正常运转。

original: I brought in my cousin Cosnach to help me handle shipments.
traduit: 我让我表弟科斯纳奇来帮忙整理货物。

original: There's no shipments coming in, so I do nothing. Just drink.
traduit: 没有货进，所以没事可做。只能喝酒了。

original: "Check the shipments" Lisbet says. "There are no shipments" I says.
traduit: 利斯拜特说“检查货物”，我说“没货可查”。

original: No breaks for a good worker out here.
traduit: 好工人在这儿得不到休息。

original: This is the Silver-Blood Inn. I'll let you figure out who owns it by yourself.
traduit: 这里是银血旅店，你应该知道这里属于谁。

original: If I can't get you something, I'm sure my wife will bellow at me until I can.
traduit: 要是没招待好你，我老婆会冲我吼的。

original: Things are so much quieter with my darling Frabbi dead.
traduit: 我亲爱的弗拉碧死了，这里变得好安静。

original: Unlike my husband Kleppr, I watch after our guests.
traduit: 我不像我老公克莱珀，我会照顾好客人的。

original: Now you just tell me if you need something.
traduit: 如果需要什么请告诉我。

original: You come right to me if you find an unwashed floor or lumpy bed.
traduit: 如果你发现哪里的地板没擦或者有床不舒服，请直接来找我。

original: I'll bend Kleppr's ear if there's anything wrong with a room you rent.
traduit: 如果你租的房间有问题，我会跟克莱珀说的。

original: Isn't my son Hreinn such a good worker? Not like his father at all....
traduit: 我儿子贺莱尼很会干活儿吧？一点儿不像他爸爸……

original: My worthless husband is gone, so I run the inn now.
traduit: 我那没用的丈夫去世了，所以现在由我经验旅店。

original: I can't believe the mess Kleppr left things in. I have twice the work with him gone.
traduit: 真不敢相信克莱珀把东西搞得这么乱。他这一去，我的工作多了一倍。

original: Don't mind the yelling. My parents are always going at each other.
traduit: 不要介意吵嚷。我爸妈经常吵架。

original: I'm just here to clean up.
traduit: 我只是负责打扫。

original: My father is more generous than he lets on. Gives me plenty of spending money.
traduit: 我父亲比他表现得要慷慨。给了我很多钱。

original: The Hag's Cure is here for all your discreet needs...
traduit: 鬼婆妙方能满足你所有需求……

original: I have potions for disease, love sickness, irritating children...
traduit: 我这里的药能治很多病，相思病，多动症……

original: A little bit of old Reach magic can cure whatever ills you....
traduit: 一点古老的瑞驰魔法可以治愈你的所有疾病……

original: Oh yes... you'll need one of my special brews...
traduit: 哦，是的……你应该需要一些我的特制药……

original: Not scared of an old woman now, are you?
traduit: 你不会怕我这个老太婆吧？

original: I've taken over the Hag's Cure, since Bothela is gone.
traduit: 自从波塞拉走了，我接手了鬼婆妙方。

original: I'm not sure if half these potions work. But they should. I think.
traduit: 我不确定这些药剂里的一半会不会奏效。但我觉得，应该会的。

original: I wish Bothela was still running the store. I'm not ready for this.
traduit: 真希望波塞拉还在经营这家店。我还没有做好准备。

original: I'm Bothela's assistant. She's the one you should talk to if you need an herb or a potion.
traduit: 我是波塞拉的助手。如果你需要草药或者药剂，可以去找她。

original: There's so much to learn about the shop. I'll never get it all straight.
traduit: 关于这家店我还有很多东西要学。我可能永远也搞不清楚。

original: Why can't the men in this city leave me alone?
traduit: 为什么这城里的男人不能躲我远点？

original: Alms. I said "alms" you backbiter. Give a crippled worker a helping hand.
traduit: 施舍。我说了“施舍”，你个背后挨刀的。给我这个残疾工人些帮助。

original: How about a septim? Wait, make that two septims, I feel like living it up.
traduit: 给个塞普汀行吧？等等，给两个。我得好好享受一下。

original: Come on, you outsiders always have plenty of gold on you. Spare a piece!
traduit: 来吧，你们这些外来的身上有的是钱。拿点出来！

original: They don't like us talking to people when we work.
traduit: 他们不喜欢我们工作时和别人说话。

original: Busy with the smelter.
traduit: 正忙着冶炼呢。

original: Got metal to shape.
traduit: 还有的是金属要炼。

original: Just here to drink.
traduit: 我只是来喝酒的。

original: Can't talk. Mulush will beat me if I stop working.
traduit: 不能聊天了。如果穆鲁什看见我不干活儿，会打我的。

original: I spill just a bit of metal, and Mulush takes it out of my hide.
traduit: 我只要撒了一点金属，穆鲁什就会从我这儿抠出来。

original: Can't you see I'm working? Beat it.
traduit: 没看见我在工作吗？走开。

original: Drinks here are watered down, but they're cheap.
traduit: 这里的酒掺了水，但是很便宜。

original: I oversee Markarth Smelter. Worker gets out of line, I get him back in line.
traduit: 我负责监督马卡斯冶炼厂。工人胆敢越界，我就会把他赶回去。

original: These workers. Always complaining. Always excuses.
traduit: 这些工人，就知道抱怨和找借口。

original: If a man has time to complain, he has time to work.
traduit: 一个人要是有时间抱怨，那就有时间工作。

original: Shipment of silver this month is behind. Nepos is to blame, not me.
traduit: 这个月银子的装运延期了。应该怪奈波斯，不怪我。

original: I tell Thonar I can only smelt what Nepos and his miners dig up.
traduit: 我告诉过托纳尔，我只能熔炼奈波斯和他的矿工挖出来的东西。

original: Stormcloaks have taken the Reach, but we'll return. The Empire will bring order.
traduit: 风暴斗篷拿下了瑞驰，但我们会回来的。帝国会带来秩序。

original: What do you want? Haven't you done enough damage to Markarth?
traduit: 你想要什么？你对马卡斯的伤害还不够吗？

original: You speak to Igmund. Son of Hrolfdir. Jarl of Markarth.
traduit: 我就是依格蒙德。霍夫迪尔之子，马卡斯的领主。

original: Treat my people fairly, and I will do the same to you.
traduit: 公平对待我的人民，我也会公平对待你。

original: Forsworn have troubled the Reach for too long. I intend to deal with them.
traduit: 弃誓者困扰瑞驰太久了。我打算对付他们。

original: Markarth is not without its problems, but the Empire is here to maintain order.
traduit: 马卡斯并非没有问题，但帝国会维持秩序的。

original: I can't believe we lost Markarth. Igmund's family has ruled there for generations.
traduit: 真不敢相信我们丢掉了马卡斯。依格蒙德的家族已经统治那里好几代了。

original: I don't think we have anything to discuss, Stormcloak.
traduit: 我觉得我们没什么好谈的，风暴斗篷。

original: I'm Igmund's uncle as well as his steward.
traduit: 我是依格蒙德的叔叔，也是他的总管。

original: I advise Igmund the same way I advised his father. Caution, caution, caution.
traduit: 我给依格蒙德的建议和给他父亲的一样。谨慎、谨慎、再谨慎。

original: The Forsworn know every stone in the Reach. We have to wait them out.
traduit: 弃誓者熟悉瑞驰的地形，我们得等他们出来。

original: Igmund is alive, and I'll keep it that way, Jarl or not.
traduit: 依格蒙德还活着，我不管他还是不是领主，我都会保护他。

original: You lay one finger on Igmund, and I'll end you Stormcloak.
traduit: 你敢碰依格蒙德一根手指，我就结果了你这个风暴斗篷。

original: As his housecarl, Igmund's security is my chief concern.
traduit: 作为侍卫，我最关心的是依格蒙德的安全问题。

original: Igmund's father was killed by Forsworn. I won't rest until they've paid with their blood.
traduit: 依格蒙德的父亲被弃誓者杀了。他们不血债血偿，我决不罢休。

original: Raerek is far too cautious, but I'll agree with him on any measure that keeps this city safe.
traduit: 拉瑞克太过谨慎了，但只要能保证城市的安全，他的意见我都同意。

original: Need a new blade?
traduit: 需要新武器吗？

original: Got an axe here. Good for cleaving up Forsworn.
traduit: 备把斧头吧。对付弃誓者很管用。

original: How about some armor?
traduit: 来些护甲吗？

original: You'll want some thick armor if you're traveling the Reach alone.
traduit: 如果想独自在瑞驰行走，你需要来个厚点的护甲。

original: Don't bother with Tacitus. Useless.
traduit: 别为塔西佗费心。没用的。

original: You'd think an apprentice could forge a few hinges. Not Tacitus.
traduit: 你以为所有学徒都能锻造铰链吗？塔西佗就不行。

original: I run the forge now. Kind of... scary.
traduit: 现在我经营这家铁匠铺了。有点……害怕。

original: Making weapons and armor isn't like making nails at all.
traduit: 锻造武器护甲和打钉子完全不一样。

original: You need a sword? Uh, how about a small sword? Nail-sized?
traduit: 你需要剑吗？呃，小一点的怎么样？钉子那么大的行吗？

original: I'm Ghorza's assistant. I help her with the forge.
traduit: 我是果扎的助手，帮她照看铁匠铺。

original: Ghorza is the one you should ask if you need anything.
traduit: 如果需要什么还是问果扎吧。

original: I'm not very good for anything more than smithing nails right now.
traduit: 我现在除了打钉子啥也不会。

original: One time, I almost cut a finger off sharpening a blade. I hate blood.
traduit: 有次磨刀的时候差点把手指头切下来。我讨厌血。

original: I have things to study, what is it?
traduit: 我还有研究要做呢，有事么？

original: The artifacts I've discovered in Nchuand-Zel will make history one day.
traduit: 我在尼楚安德-泽尔发现的文物总有一天会创造历史。

original: I've only ever lost a few guards to Steam Centurions. Good odds, considering...
traduit: 我只是在蒸汽百夫长那儿损失了几个守卫。还有机会，考虑到……

original: I used to travel so much before all this Forsworn nonsense. Such an inconvenience...
traduit: 弃誓者来前我经常旅行。现在真不方便……

original: Oh, excuse me. With my uncle gone, things are a bit of a mess.
traduit: 哦，抱歉。自从我叔叔去世之后，一切都一团糟。

original: I'm not half the wizard my uncle was, but I still have a few spells worth buying.
traduit: 我现在造诣不及我叔叔的一半，但我还是有些法术值得一买。

original: Did you need something? A staff? Some enchanting materials?
traduit: 需要些什么吗？法杖？还是附魔材料？

original: I'm Calcelmo's nephew. I help him around the laboratory.
traduit: 我是卡塞莫的侄子。我在实验室帮他工作。

original: Don't let my uncle go on about his theories. You'll be here all night.
traduit: 别让我叔叔继续谈他的理论了。否则你这一晚都得待在这儿。

original: I'm afraid to touch half of the things we keep in the tower.
traduit: 我们存在塔里的一半东西，我都不敢碰。

original: I try not to think about how my uncle got all the Dwemer Centurion parts.
traduit: 我尽量不去想我叔叔是怎么集齐锻莫百夫长的全部零件的。

original: Before you say anything, no, I am not from the Reach.
traduit: 在你开口前，先告诉你，不是，我不是瑞驰来的。

original: I have meals to cook for the entire castle and almost no help.
traduit: 我要给整个城堡的人做饭，却没什么人来帮忙。

original: The Jarl gives me two incompetent assistants. Worthless.
traduit: 领主给我的两个助手都不称职。太没用了。

original: I have to work, or Anton will rip my head off.
traduit: 我还得工作。不然安东会拧断我的头。

original: Anton sure looks like he's from the Reach, but don't tell him that.
traduit: 安东看起来像是瑞驰人，但别跟他说这个。

original: Only reason Jarl keeps Anton on is because he cooks up a storm.
traduit: 领主还让安东干下去就是因为他手艺好。

original: Don't mind the dogs, they get anxious when they haven't had dinner.
traduit: 不用管那些狗，它们没吃饭就会那样焦躁。

original: You should talk to Anton if you need anything. He's the master chef.
traduit: 如果有什么需要请找安东，他是这里的主厨。

original: It's been a hard day cleaning. Good, honest work I say.
traduit: 打扫很辛苦。但这是诚实的好工作。

original: Even the dead need company. That's what Arkay provides.
traduit: 即使是死者也需要陪伴。这就是阿尔凯提供的东西。

original: We all come into Arkay's light in the end, but there's no need to rush.
traduit: 我们最终都会归于阿尔凯的光辉，但没有必要急着去。

original: Markarth is a city of wealth, but gold doesn't follow you in death.
traduit: 马卡斯确实是一座财富之城，但钱财外物生不带来，死不带去。

original: Arkay's blessing to you.
traduit: 阿尔凯保佑你。

original: You have the honor of addressing a member of the Thalmor. Bask in it.
traduit: 你正在荣幸地与梭默成员讲话。沐浴这份光荣吧。

original: The Dominion is here, and we're watching you.
traduit: 先祖神洲就在此处，我们正盯着你呢。

original: The Thalmor know how to deal with Talos worshippers.
traduit: 梭默有的是办法对付塔洛斯信徒。

original: If you see any signs of Talos worship, it's your obligation to report them to me.
traduit: 如果看到任何信仰塔洛斯的迹象，你有义务向我报告。

original: The Aldmeri Dominion is the only thing keeping the Empire on its feet.
traduit: 先祖神洲是维持帝国站稳脚跟的唯一支柱。

original: This war is such nonsense. All this fuss over their false human god.
traduit: 这场战争太无聊了。一切都是为了他们虚假的人类神。

original: The Warrens isn't a place for your type. What do you want?
traduit: 窝棚不是你这种人该来的地方。你想干什么？

original: Warrens ain't for you. Trust me.
traduit: 窝棚不适合你。相信我。

original: You don't want to be here. No one wants to.
traduit: 你不会想待在这儿。没人愿意。

original: Don't know anyone here doesn't have Rattles or Ataxia.
traduit: 我不知道这里还谁没得过颤抖症或者运动失调。

original: The Empire didn't think we could take the Reach, but here we are.
traduit: 帝国以为我们拿不下瑞驰，但我们成功了。

original: Let's see those Stormcloaks try to break into this canyon.
traduit: 看看那些风暴斗篷能不能闯进这峡谷。

original: Outsiders aren't trusted in Markarth. Best keep that in mind.
traduit: 外人在马卡斯不受信任。记住这一点。

original: Can't believe I'm posted here. Even the beds are made of stone.
traduit: 真不敢相信我会到这里。连床都是石头做的。

original: You should see that Orc over in Understone Keep, have him forge you some new armor...
traduit: 你应该去看看石下要塞那个兽人，让他给你锻造些新盔甲。

original: By Shor, you're hauling around a lot of junk. Best stop in at the Arnleif and Sons Trading Company, sell it off.
traduit: 舒尔啊，你就拖着这么多垃圾到处跑？最好去趟阿雷夫父子贸易商行，都卖掉吧。

original: Let me guess - you need a drink. It's the Silver-Blood Inn you're looking for.
traduit: 让我猜猜啊，你是想去喝一杯吧。那你是在找银血旅店。

original: Break the law in Markarth, and it's off to Cidhna Mine with you.
traduit: 敢在马卡斯犯法，我就送你去希讷矿场。

original: Caught a case of Rockjoint, once. Bothela at the Hag's Cure fixed me right up.
traduit: 有次得了关节石化病，鬼婆妙方的波塞拉把我治好了。

original: Lots of nasty holes in the Reach, and Blind Cliff Cave is one of them. A filthy Hagraven nest, northeast of here.
traduit: 瑞驰有很多肮脏的洞穴，东北面的盲崖洞穴就是其中之一。里面栖息着肮脏的乌鸦鬼婆。

original: There's an evil to the north, friend, and its name is Ragnvald. A tomb like so many in Skyrim, where the dead have found no peace.
traduit: 北方有个鬼地方，朋友，它的名字叫拉根沃德。和天际好多坟墓永远，里面的死者得不到安息。

original: Travel southeast and you'll find an Orc stronghold, up around the old Dushnikh orichalcum mine.
traduit: 往东南走有个兽人要塞，在老杜什尼克·亚尔矿场附近。

original: Beware the region northeast, across the river. Forsworn have taken refuge in Broken Tower Redoubt and Red Eagle Redoubt.
traduit: 小心河对岸的东北地区。弃誓者在破碎塔楼和红鹰据点汇集。

original: There's a small skeever den just east of the city, at Reachwater Rock.
traduit: 城东边的触水岩有个小耗子洞。

original: The Forsworn have been spotted to the north, near Bruca's Leap Redoubt.
traduit: 弃誓者在北边出没了，在布兰卡之跃据点附近。

original: Need a trained war dog? Fiercest companion money can buy.
traduit: 需要一只训练有素的军犬吗？钱能买到最厉害的伴侣。

original: I'll be handling the horses with Cedran gone. Miss that old man.
traduit: 赛丹走后我照顾这些马。真想那个老家伙啊。

original: A war dog is good company and good protection.
traduit: 军犬是好伙伴，也是好保镖。

original: I like the loyalty of a dog. Not as fickle as a wolf.
traduit: 我喜欢狗的忠诚，讨厌狼的善变。

original: You have to train a good war dog from a pup. Bite your arm clean off otherwise.
traduit: 想要一只优秀的军犬就要从小训练，不然它会把你胳膊咬下来。

original: Ondolemar is the commander of the Thalmor in Markarth.
traduit: 昂多勒马是马卡斯的梭默指挥官。

original: Worship of Talos is strictly forbidden.
traduit: 严禁信仰塔洛斯。

original: What's that supposed to prove? Get back on patrol!
traduit: 那又能证明什么？回去巡逻！

original: But, I've got the key to the Sabre Cage! Look!
traduit: 但是，我拿着剑齿虎笼子的钥匙！你看！

original: Pfft
traduit: 啧。

original: Troll's blood was he a tough one!
traduit: 巨魔的血让他变得强大！

original: Take down that one with your bare hands too?
traduit: 然后你又徒手拿下了那个？

original: Yeah, why?
traduit: 是啊，怎么了？

original: Wasn't our last catch a Cave Bear?
traduit: 上次不是抓过一只洞穴熊吗？

original: Why, you don't think I could do it?
traduit: 怎么，你觉得我做不到？

original: So, you're saying you brought that cat down alone?
traduit: 你是说那猫是你一个人带来的？

original: You are on the right path, and you will prevail.
traduit: 你正走在正确的道路上，你会成功的。

original: You will be called on to take swift action. Rise to the challenge, and discover what you are capable of.
traduit: 你需要迅速采取行动。迎接挑战，发现自己的能力。

original: It is imperative that you return to your College at once.
traduit: 你必须马上返回学院。

original: You have done well thus far, but trying times are ahead.
traduit: 到目前为止，你做得很好，但是困难仍在前方。

original: Maybe he's looking for something to eat?
traduit: 也许他是在找吃的？

original: Maybe she's looking for something to eat?
traduit: 也许她是在找吃的？

original: He might find something good in there. One man's trash is another's treasure.
traduit: 他可能会在里面找到好东西。我之垃圾就是彼之财富。

original: She might find something good in there. One man's trash is another's treasure.
traduit: 她可能会在里面找到好东西。我之垃圾就是彼之财富。

original: The poor dear must truly be hungry to comb through rubbish like that. Hope he finds something edible.
traduit: 这个可怜的宝贝儿一定是饿坏了才把垃圾翻得这么干净。希望他能找到吃的吧。

original: The poor dear must truly be hungry to comb through rubbish like that. Hope she finds something edible.
traduit: 这个可怜的宝贝儿一定是饿坏了才把垃圾翻得这么干净。希望她能找到吃的吧。

original: Sometimes it pays to look in every nook and cranny.
traduit: 有时候不放过每个角落是有好处的。

original: When you're hungry, you'll look anywhere for food. Can't blame him.
traduit: 当你饿了的时候，也会四处找吃的。不要怪他。

original: When you're hungry, you'll look anywhere for food. Can't blame her.
traduit: 当你饿了的时候，也会四处找吃的。不要怪她。

original: Desperate times call for desperate measures. Maybe he found what he was looking for in there.
traduit: 非常时刻非常举措。也许他找到了需要的东西。

original: Desperate times call for desperate measures. Maybe she found what she was looking for in there.
traduit: 非常时刻非常举措。也许她找到了需要的东西。

original: How unfortunate he has to dig through refuse like that. Someone should give him a piece of bread.
traduit: 他还得在那样的垃圾里翻找，太不幸了。应该有人分他一块面包才是。

original: How unfortunate she has to dig through refuse like that. Someone should give her a piece of bread.
traduit: 她还得在那样的垃圾里翻找，太不幸了。应该有人分她一块面包才是。

original: You never know what you'll find laying around in a crate or barrel. People toss the darnedest things in them.
traduit: 你永远不知道会在板条箱或者桶里发现什么。人们总会把东西扔进去。

original: What's he doing poking his nose in there?
traduit: 他在那里闻什么呢？

original: What's she doing poking her nose in there?
traduit: 她在那里闻什么呢？

original: Is he... sifting through trash?
traduit: 他是在……捡垃圾？

original: Is she... sifting through trash?
traduit: 她是在……捡垃圾？

original: What's he rummaging around in there for?
traduit: 他在那儿翻来翻去找什么呢？

original: What's she rummaging around in there for?
traduit: 她在那儿翻来翻去找什么呢？

original: Look at him, rummaging through refuse. Wonder what he's lost... besides his mind.
traduit: 瞧瞧，在垃圾堆翻来翻去的。也不知道他丢什么了……也可能是脑子有病。

original: Look at her, rummaging through refuse. Wonder what she's lost... besides her mind.
traduit: 瞧瞧，在垃圾堆翻来翻去的。也不知道她丢什么了……也可能是脑子有病。

original: Tsk. What a man will do for a few coins...
traduit: 啧。一个人能为几个钱这么拼……

original: Tsk. What a woman will do for a few coins...
traduit: 啧。一个人能为几个钱这么拼……

original: Picking through garbage. Has he no shame?
traduit: 捡垃圾啊。他就不觉得羞耻吗？

original: Picking through garbage. Has she no shame?
traduit: 捡垃圾啊。她就不觉得羞耻吗？

original: What's he digging around in there for?
traduit: 他在那儿翻什么呢？

original: What's she digging around in there for?
traduit: 她在那儿翻什么呢？

original: What's he doing? Looking for rubies in rubbish? Get a job!
traduit: 他在干什么？在垃圾里找红宝石么？赶紧去找份工作！

original: What's she doing? Looking for rubies in rubbish? Get a job!
traduit: 她在干什么？在垃圾里找红宝石么？赶紧去找份工作！

original: What's this? It thinks it can just throw refuse wherever it likes?
traduit: 这是什么？你以为可以随地乱扔垃圾吗？

original: Really, the nerve of some people, leaving their trash wherever they please.
traduit: 真是的，有些人胆儿太大了，随便乱扔垃圾。

original: What kind of filthy barbarian just throws their trash on the ground?
traduit: 什么样的蛮子才会把垃圾扔在地上？

original: Oh, by all means. Just leave your refuse wherever you see fit.
traduit: 哦，不管怎么说。把你的垃圾放在合适的地方。

original: There's a place for trash, and that's not it.
traduit: 垃圾是得找地方扔，但不是这里。

original: In my day, we knew how to dispose of trash properly.
traduit: 在我们那年代，都知道怎么处理垃圾。

original: What's the matter with you? You think you can just go dropping your junk wherever you like?
traduit: 你怎么回事？以为可以随便扔垃圾吗？

original: Look at this one. Spoiled as a child, I'll bet. Allowed to leave trash just lying around...
traduit: 瞧瞧。我敢打赌，你是被宠坏了才会这样把垃圾到处乱扔……

original: I swear, is there no end to these uncouth savages, just throwing their trash wherever they please...
traduit: 这群蛮子真是没完没了，他们真爱把垃圾到处乱扔……

original: Hrmmm. Pick up your trash, fetcher.
traduit: 嗯……把你垃圾捡起来，你这个费彻。

original: And they call me a savage. Least I don't leave my trash lying around...
traduit: 他们是叫我野蛮人。可我至少不会把垃圾扔得到处都是……

original: I never did understand the local custom of simply leaving one's trash wherever is convenient...
traduit: 我一直不了解这里的风俗为什么可以随地乱扔垃圾。

original: Who does that? Who just leaves their garbage lying about?
traduit: 谁干的？把垃圾扔得到处都是？

original: Gah! Quit throwing your garbage everywhere.
traduit: 嘿！别乱扔垃圾。

original: One person's trash is another's treasure. Don't be surprised if you find that gone...
traduit: 你之垃圾我之财富。你要是发现它消失了，请不要惊讶……

original: I do the cookin' and cleanin' round the palace.
traduit: 我负责烹饪并打扫宫殿周围。

original: Don't need to pay me no mind. I'm the least important person in here.
traduit: 不必在意我。我在这里无关紧要。

original: Keepin' the palace clean an' the lords fed ain't easy work, but it's honest work.
traduit: 保持宫殿干净，保证大人们吃好不容易，但这是很实在的工作。

original: Every night, I walk around the Gray Quarter and let them gray-skins know what I think of 'em.
traduit: 每天晚上，我都会去灰民区溜达溜达，让那些灰皮知道知道我对他们的看法。

original: We ought dig a big hole, throw all them dark elves and Argonians in it, and let 'em tear each other to pieces.
traduit: 我们就该挖个大坑把暗精灵和阿尔贡都扔进去，看他们在里面把彼此撕成碎片。

original: Only thing I hate worse than those scale-backs are them filthy gray-skins!
traduit: 这世上只有那群灰皮比鳞片怪更讨厌。

original: The Gray Quarter's a disgrace. Them dark elves live like animals.
traduit: 灰民区就是个耻辱。那群暗精灵活得就像畜生。

original: Can't see why we let them dark elves live inside the walls. We should kick 'em out like we did to the scalebacks.
traduit: 真不明白我们为什么要允许暗精灵住在城里。我们就该把他们像那群长鳞片的一样踢出去。

original: Yes? Make it quick, I'm a busy man.
traduit: 嗯？有事吗，我很忙。

original: Skyrim isn't very friendly for Argonians, so we mostly just keep out of the way.
traduit: 天际对阿尔贡不是很友好，所以我们常常保持距离。

original: Shahvee knows the dock doesn't look nice, but fresh air is good for the gills.
traduit: 沙维知道码头看起来不太好，但新鲜空气对鳃有好处。

original: Good honest work staves off the cold.
traduit: 勤恳工作就不会冷了。

original: I like to bring Grimvar down here sometimes. It reminds him how lucky he is.
traduit: 我有时喜欢把格瑞姆瓦带到这儿来，让他看看自己是有多幸运。

original: I try to keep Grimvar safe, but these are dangerous times.
traduit: 我努力保护格瑞姆瓦的安全，但现在太危险了。

original: When Grimvar asks me why women are being killed around the city. I don't even know what to say to him.
traduit: 格瑞姆瓦问我为什么城里有女人被杀的时候，我都不知道该怎么回答他。

original: Ever tried taking care of children? It can be a nightmare.
traduit: 你有照顾过孩子吗？这就是个噩梦。

original: We can't thank you enough for helping us get this office running.
traduit: 我们非常感激你的帮助。

original: Hey, it's our hero! Seen any more of those pirates around here?
traduit: 嘿，我们的英雄来了！附近还有其他海盗吗？

original: I appreciate everything you've done for us, but I really am quite busy.
traduit: 非常感谢你为我们所做的一切，但我现在真的很忙。

original: To receive the blessing of Talos, you have only to pray at the altar.
traduit: 想要得到塔洛斯的祝福，只需在祭坛前祈祷。

original: Ulfric Stormcloak was a true hero of Skyrim. He stood up to the Thalmor and refused to turn his back on Talos.
traduit: 乌弗瑞克是天际真正的英雄。他起身反抗梭默，拒绝背弃塔洛斯。

original: The Stormcloaks are gone, but Talos will never be forgotten. I don't care what the Thalmor say!
traduit: 风暴斗篷失败了，但塔洛斯永远不会被遗忘。我才不管梭默怎么说！

original: You know about Talos? He founded the Empire!
traduit: 你知道塔洛斯吗？他是帝国的缔造者！

original: We're the only Temple in Skyrim that can openly worship Talos.
traduit: 我们这里是天际唯一公开崇拜塔洛斯的神殿了。

original: Those awful Thalmor can't touch us, thanks to Ulfric.
traduit: 多亏了乌弗瑞克，那些可怕的梭默才碰不到我们。

original: I can't believe the Empire would turn its back on Talos.
traduit: 我真不敢相信，帝国居然背叛了塔洛斯。

original: Spare a coin for a poor old woman, milord?
traduit: 老爷，施舍老太婆一枚硬币吧。

original: Spare a coin for a poor old woman, milady?
traduit: 夫人，施舍老太婆一枚硬币吧。

original: Spare a coin? Talos rewards the generous.
traduit: 能施舍一枚硬币吗？塔洛斯会奖励慷慨的好人。

original: I hope the wind dies down a bit before tonight. Hard when you've got to sleep outside.
traduit: 希望今晚的风能小一点。睡在外面很难受。

original: Nervous being alone at night. Especially these days, with the Butcher prowling the streets.
traduit: 晚上一个人会很紧张。尤其这些天还有屠夫在街上游荡。

original: Looking for shipping? We'll always offer better service than the East Empire Company.
traduit: 找船运货吗？我们比东帝国公司服务好得多。

original: These lazy Argonians better get their tails moving.
traduit: 这些懒惰的阿尔贡最好赶紧动起来。

original: You hear about the Shatter-shield girl? It's a tragedy.
traduit: 听说过那个碎盾家的女孩吗？真是悲剧。

original: Torbjorn wants the shipping operations to bring in cash, and I make it happen.
traduit: 托布乔恩想靠船运赚钱，我会负责的。

original: Come see me in the marketplace tomorrow. You won't find better prices in all of Eastmarch.
traduit: 明天到集市来找我，整个东陲都找不到更好的价格了。

original: I don't haggle. If you want a lower price, look elsewhere.
traduit: 谢绝还价。如果想便宜些，到别处看看吧。

original: I'd travel more, but who wants to deal with all the soldiers these days?
traduit: 我很想多出去旅行，但谁愿意在兵荒马乱的时候乱跑呢？

original: If you're looking to get a drink, Candlehearth Hall's got warm fires and strong ale.
traduit: 如果想喝点什么的话，烛炉堂有温暖的炉火和烈啤酒。

original: Horses. All day long. Do you have any idea how dull horses are?
traduit: 马马马。成天就是马。你知道马有多没劲吗？

original: If the guards would listen to Viola, they'd have caught the Butcher by now.
traduit: 要是卫兵们听维欧拉的话，他们早就抓住屠夫了。

original: I love my husband, but he can be a bit... dull at times.
traduit: 我爱我的丈夫，但他有时候有些……无趣。

original: Ugh. I'll need to bathe thoroughly to get this stench off of me.
traduit: 啊，我得好好洗个澡，把身上的臭味洗掉。

original: Looking for something?
traduit: 在找什么吗？

original: Real Nords like to prove their mettle in the pit.
traduit: 真正的诺德人喜欢在深坑里证明勇气。

original: Just between you and me, I wouldn't mind if the Empire just up and left for good.
traduit: 咱俩私下说，我真不介意帝国就此滚蛋。

original: I'd love get one of those Imperial weasels under my boot...
traduit: 真想再用脚踩死一只帝国黄鼠狼。

original: I've been a bit out of sorts since... since our daughter was taken from us.
traduit: 自从……自从我们的女儿离开我们，我就一直不太舒服。

original: Not really sure what to do with myself anymore. I just miss her so much.
traduit: 我都不知道该怎么办了。我实在太想念她了。

original: I try not to think of her, but sometimes the simplest thing will remind me.
traduit: 我试着不去想她，但有时简单的一件东西就会提醒起我。

original: No mother should have to bury her daughter.
traduit: 没有母亲应该为女儿送葬。

original: This is the Hall of the Dead. Someday you'll end up here.
traduit: 这里是亡者之厅。总有一天你也会来这里的。

original: My job's simple enough. The dead don't really complain much.
traduit: 我的工作很简单。死者不会抱怨。

original: Luckily Windhelm is cold, so the dead don't rot as quickly. Sometimes the burial has to wait for the ground to thaw, though.
traduit: 所幸风舵城很冷，死者不会腐烂很快。不过，有时要等地面解冻才能下葬。

original: Another Dark Elf. Just what Windhelm needs.
traduit: 又一个暗精灵。风舵城很需要你们啊。

original: Maybe you should just move along.
traduit: 你该走了。

original: This here's Candlehearth Hall. Great room's upstairs, an' there's a bed for rent on the ground floor.
traduit: 这里是烛炉堂。大厅在楼上，一楼有床位出租。

original: Got some fresh-baked bread an' good cheese, if you're after a bite to eat.
traduit: 想吃东西的话，这里有新鲜出炉的面包和美味的奶酪。

original: Mind you don't get fresh with Susanna. She plays the flirt, but it's just to get good tips.
traduit: 别对苏珊娜太无礼。她卖弄风情只是为了得点小费。

original: Those Dark Elf refugees will take over the city if we aren't careful.
traduit: 如果我们不小心的话，暗精灵难民就要把这座城占领了。

original: Be on the lookout. The Butcher could be around any corner!
traduit: 保持警惕，屠夫随时可能出没。

original: Captain Lonely-Gale has been avoiding me, I just know it.
traduit: 我知道，孤风船长一直在躲着我。

original: After what happened to those other women, I'm worried about my own safety.
traduit: 那些女人出事后，我很担心自己的安全。

original: Women murdered time and again, and all the guards care about is the war.
traduit: 女人们一次又一次被谋杀，但卫兵们只关心战争。

original: How can Elda hate the dark elves when she knows so little about them?
traduit: 艾尔达对暗精灵又不了解，怎么会这么恨他们呢？

original: You didn't hear it from me, but if you want a real drink, try the Cornerclub in the Gray Quarter.
traduit: 别说是我说的，但如果你真想喝一杯，还是去灰民区的街角吧。

original: Did you know that candle on the mantle hasn't gone out in over a hundred years?
traduit: 知道吗，那火炉上的蜡烛一百多年都没熄灭过。

original: Stand away from me, or I'll crack you like an egg.
traduit: 离我远点，不然就像鸡蛋一样把你敲碎。

original: What are you looking at? Scared of strong women?
traduit: 你看什么呢？害怕强壮的女人吗？

original: You look mighty tasty. Better not stick around for supper.
traduit: 你看上去很可口。最好别留下来等晚饭了。

original: Working in Windhelm is great. I get to see Ulfric up close.
traduit: 在风舵城工作很棒。我能近距离看到乌弗瑞克了。

original: I never expected Ulfric to live up to his legend, but he does.
traduit: 我从没想过乌弗瑞克会延续他的传奇，但他做到了。

original: Ulfric was a true hero of Skyrim. He will be missed.
traduit: 乌弗瑞克是天际真正的英雄。人们会怀念他。

original: I just can't believe that Ulfric is gone. Skyrim will never be free now.
traduit: 我真不敢相信乌弗瑞克就这么走了。天际现在永远没法解放了。

original: I couldn't ask for a better teacher than Oengul.
traduit: 我找不到比欧恩古尔更好的老师了。

original: It's a new day in Windhelm. The Stormcloaks are gone, and so is their prejudice.
traduit: 风舵城新的一天到来了。风暴斗篷消失了，他们的偏见也消失了。

original: I wish the Nords, Argonians and dark elves in Windhelm got along better.
traduit: 我希望诺德人、阿尔贡和暗精灵能更好地相处。

original: We Argonians do the work the Nords don't want to do.
traduit: 我们阿尔贡做得工作都是诺德人不想做的。

original: The water is cold, but it's a lot better than having to work up in the dry air.
traduit: 水很冷，但总比在干燥的空气里工作要好。

original: Shatter-Shield, East Empire Company... we'll work for any ship that pulls in, as long as they can pay.
traduit: 碎盾、东帝国公司……只要付钱，我们都愿意帮忙工作。

original: The Nords don't appreciate us, but so what? I don't appreciate them right back.
traduit: 诺德人看不起我们又如何？我也看不起他们。

original: Look, we don't have much love for your kind down here. Probably best if you just left.
traduit: 听着，我对你们族人没什么好感。你最好还是走开吧。

original: Haven't seen you here before, egg brother. Welcome!
traduit: 我以前没见过你啊，卵生兄弟。欢迎！

original: Haven't seen you here before, egg sister. Welcome!
traduit: 我以前没见过你啊，卵生姐妹。欢迎！

original: The docks can be a dangerous place. Don't expect me to save you if you fall in.
traduit: 码头是个危险的地方。如果你掉下去，别指望我会救你。

original: Huh? What's that now? Leave me alone.
traduit: 嗯？怎么了？别打扰我。

original: Another day, another septim.
traduit: 新的一天，新的塞普汀。

original: The young folks are too happy to break their backs for the Nords. They forget what it was like to swim free.
traduit: 年轻族人开始乐于向诺德人弯腰了，他们忘了畅游水中的感觉了。

original: Do you know my father? He's really important. He even talks to the Jarl sometimes.
traduit: 你认识我父亲吗？他很重要的，有时甚至能和领主说说话。

original: Did you know my father? He was really important. He even talked to the Jarl sometimes.
traduit: 你认识我父亲吗？他很重要的，有时甚至能和领主说说话。

original: All the Argonians at the docks are nice to me. Good thing, too, or father would run them off!
traduit: 码头上的阿尔贡对我都很好。这对他们也是好事，否则我父亲会把他们赶走！

original: They say dragons are coming back. I want to kill one!
traduit: 他们都说龙族回来了。我要去杀一个！

original: I made my fortune as a sea captain, but now I'm retired.
traduit: 我当船长时赚了不少，现在退休了。

original: The townsfolk call me "captain" because I used to be a sailor.
traduit: 因为我以前当过水手，乡亲们都叫我“船长”。

original: I lost my family years ago. Truth is, I don't really know what keeps me going.
traduit: 几年前，我失去了我的家人。说真的，我真不知道自己是怎么坚持下来的。

original: Did Viola send you to bother me?
traduit: 是维欧拉派你来烦我的吗？

original: Serving as Steward to Ulfric Stormcloak was a great honor, but I don't miss his temper.
traduit: 担任乌弗瑞克·风暴斗篷的总管是我的荣幸，但我不怀念他的脾气。

original: I don't care that we lost, I'm just glad the war is over.
traduit: 我不在乎我们输了，我很高兴战争结束了。

original: The Stormcloaks are finding victory across the land.
traduit: 风暴斗篷在这片土地上获得了胜利。

original: I'm not much of a strategist, but Lord Ulfric listens to my counsel all the same.
traduit: 我不是个战略家，但乌弗瑞克大人也会听取我的建议。

original: If you have any news of the western holds, take it to Ulfric immediately.
traduit: 如果你有任何关于西边领地的消息，请马上报告乌弗瑞克。

original: Terrible shame, what happened to those women.
traduit: 那些女人的遭遇实属我们的耻辱。

original: I was one of the best soldiers in the Stormcloak army, until I took a sword through the chest.
traduit: 我曾是风暴斗篷军中数一数二的好兵，直到一把剑刺穿了我的胸膛。

original: I'd be out there fighting the Imperials right now if it wasn't for my war-wound.
traduit: 如果不是我负伤了，现在已经在外面和帝国军作战了。

original: Ever since that Imperial craven ran me through from behind, I've had trouble breathing. Don't have any trouble drinking though.
traduit: 自从那个帝国懦夫从后面把我打倒后，我就变得呼吸困难了。不过喝酒倒是没什么问题。

original: What? Were you hoping to claim this house for yourself? Well, the Aretinos always liked me, so I think I'm family enough to take up here.
traduit: 什么？你想独占这所房子？艾瑞提诺家一直很喜欢我，所以我觉得我是这里的一份子了。

original: The milk drinkers in this town wouldn't last five minutes in a real battle.
traduit: 真要是碰上打仗，城里的这群喝奶娃五分钟也坚持不了。

original: Rumor holds that the Aretino boy brought an assassin here. Sounds like nonsense to me.
traduit: 听说艾瑞提诺家的孩子带了个刺客来这里。听起来像是胡说八道。

original: I once killed six men, single-handed, while rescuing my brothers-in-arms from ambush by an Imperial patrol.
traduit: 我们弟兄遭到帝国巡逻队伏击的时候，我单枪匹马杀过六个，把他们救了出来。

original: I'm not too proud to admit that I need a bit of help from time to time.
traduit: 不得不承认，我时不时需要些接济。

original: Can't say I mind the sight of all the Imperial guards. It's a change for the better.
traduit: 我不介意看到帝国卫兵出现。这是向好处改变的兆头。

original: All my goods are legitimate, which is more than I can say for some.
traduit: 我只能说，我所有的货物都是合法的。

original: I like to share my good fortune with those who deserve it.
traduit: 我喜欢把好运和值得的人一起分享。

original: Trader dropped by recently with some lovely pieces, if you'd like to have a look.
traduit: 最近有货商带了些漂亮衣服，你可以看看。

original: Pardon the mess. We're really trying to do better around here.
traduit: 请不要介意这里脏乱。我们真的在努力保持更好了。

original: "Windhelm's an easy posting!" they said. Guess they didn't count on Ulfric's little uprising.
traduit: 他们说“风舵城是个美差！”看来他们是没料到乌弗瑞克的小起义。

original: Can you believe the company won't even dock ships here anymore?
traduit: 你能信？公司不再把船停靠在这儿了。

original: The conquering hero returns!
traduit: 英雄凯旋！

original: I really can't thank you enough for your help.
traduit: 非常感谢你的帮助。

original: I still can't believe Isabella's gone. She was such a helpful young lass.
traduit: 我还是不敢相信伊莎贝拉去世了。她是个乐于助人的好姑娘。

original: Now more than ever, the world needs tales of heroism.
traduit: 现在，世界比任何时候都需要英雄的故事。

original: I'll find some way to finish my book.
traduit: 我会想办法写完我的书。

original: Know any tales of nobility and courage? I'm keen to record them.
traduit: 你知道有什么关于高尚和勇气的故事吗？我很想把它们都记录下来。

original: Oh splendid, another Nord.
traduit: 哦，好极了。又来了个诺德人。

original: Come slumming to the Gray Quarter, have you?
traduit: 来灰民区体验贫民生活吗？

original: Welcome, brother. Please, enjoy yourself.
traduit: 欢迎你，兄弟。请好好享受。

original: Welcome, sister. Please, enjoy yourself.
traduit: 欢迎你，姐妹。请好好享受。

original: Apparently some Nord women were murdered. Not sure why I should care.
traduit: 有些诺德女人很明显是被谋杀的。不知道我为什么会在乎。

original: At long last, Windhelm is free. No longer must we suffer persecution at the hands of Ulfric Stormcloak.
traduit: 风舵城终于自由了。我们再也不会受乌弗瑞克·风暴斗篷的迫害了。

original: Things have been a lot worse around here since Ulfric took over.
traduit: 自从乌弗瑞克接管这里以后，情况变得更糟了。

original: It's not the cold of Skyrim that gets to me. It's the stink from the people.
traduit: 天际的寒冷并不让我厌恶。真正恶心的是人们的恶臭。

original: When I've made enough money, I'm going to return to Morrowind in high style.
traduit: 等我赚够了钱，我就能体体面面地回晨风了。

original: Both my daughters. Now my wife? How much is one man supposed to take?
traduit: 先是我的两个女儿。现在又是我妻子？一个人还能被夺走什么？

original: Poor Nilsine has been wrecked since her sister was killed.
traduit: 尼尔欣自从她姐妹被杀后就一直很痛苦。

original: Seeing a good tavern brawl might be just the thing to lift my spirits.
traduit: 看场精彩的酒馆斗殴可能让我的精神振奋一下吧。

original: Brond's one of the most savage fighters I've ever seen...
traduit: 布容德是我见过最野蛮的拳击手之一了。

original: What I lack in strength, I make up for with tenacity.
traduit: 我的力量不足，就用坚韧来弥补。

original: You need anything, come see me. I'm as resourceful as I am discreet.
traduit: 有什么需要可以来找我。我可是既谨慎又聪明。

original: I have a lot of respect for Ambarys Rendar, but his views are a little extreme.
traduit: 我很尊重安巴利·仁达尔，但他的观点有点极端。

original: You look like someone who appreciates nice things.
traduit: 你看起来是个会欣赏好东西的人。

original: Oh, pardon me. Was I in your way?
traduit: 哦，抱歉。是我挡路了吗？

original: I hope someday we'll get to know each other better.
traduit: 希望有一天我们能好好互相了解。

original: I see why the Nords like Skyrim. This crisp air is wonderful for the lungs!
traduit: 我算知道为什么诺德人喜欢天际了。这里清新的空气对肺有好处！

original: You seem like such a nice person. I'd love to hear more about you.
traduit: 你看起来是个好人。我想多和你聊聊。

original: Can't believe Ulfric's gone. If not for Hermir, I'd have left the city by now.
traduit: 真不敢相信乌弗瑞克去世了。如果不是为了赫米尔，我早就离开这座城市了。

original: Everyone says Eorlund Gray-Mane is the best smith in Skyrim. I plan to change a few minds about that.
traduit: 人人都说厄伦德·灰鬃是天际最好的铁匠，我会改变他们的想法。

original: Need some metal hammered?
traduit: 需要锤炼金属吗？

original: Hermir's become a decent smith. Like to think I had a hand in that.
traduit: 赫米尔能成为一个不错的铁匠，这事儿跟我分不开。

original: With my swords in their hands, Ulfric's men will send those legion dogs running.
traduit: 有我打的剑在手，风暴斗篷赶走军团狗。

original: I lost my twin sister a while back. Have you ever lost anyone close?
traduit: 不久前我失去了双胞胎姐妹。你有失去过亲近的人吗？

original: My father says we need to just get on with our lives. Like it's that easy.
traduit: 父亲说我们得继续生活下去。说得轻巧。

original: I've been a lot of things in my life. Pit fighter's the one I'm best at.
traduit: 我这辈子经历过很多事。当斗士是我最拿手的。

original: We should get a dragon for the Pit. I'd love to fight one.
traduit: 我们该给深坑里弄条龙来。我很想和他们打一架。

original: I've been fighting in the Pit for years. That should tell you something.
traduit: 我在深坑里战斗了很多年。应该能教你些东西。

original: There's two kinds of Pit fighters -- good ones and dead ones.
traduit: 只有两种深坑斗士——赢了的和死了的。

original: Ulfric once tried to get me to fight for him, but marching bores me.
traduit: 乌弗瑞克曾想让我为他而战，但我觉得参军很无聊。

original: Steel. Barehanded. Armor. Naked. It's all fighting. I can kill you with a weapon or by myself. No difference.
traduit: 手握武器、赤手空拳、穿盔甲、不穿盔甲，都是战斗。我可以用武器或者徒手杀了你。没什么区别。

original: With Ulfric dead and the Stormcloaks gone, who will have the courage to champion the cause of Talos?
traduit: 乌弗瑞克死了，风暴斗篷消失了，还有谁有勇气捍卫塔洛斯的事业？

original: I've spent my life serving Talos. I don't plan to stop now, no matter what the Empire says.
traduit: 我一生都在为塔洛斯服务。我不打算就此停下来，不管帝国说了什么。

original: Talos created the Empire. You'd think they'd show him more respect.
traduit: 塔洛斯缔造了帝国。还以为他们会更尊重他呢。

original: The way I see it, Ulfric's fighting a holy war.
traduit: 在我看来，乌弗瑞克是在进行一场圣战。

original: Someday all of Skyrim will worship Talos openly, as we do here.
traduit: 总有一天，天际所有人都能向我们这里一样公开崇拜塔洛斯。

original: Whatever you've heard I can do is probably true.
traduit: 你听别人说我能做的事，多半都是真的。

original: If Ulfric needs a favor, he has it. Anyone else better pay well for the service.
traduit: 如果乌弗瑞克需要帮忙，我会去的。其他人就得付钱了。

original: I'd explain my research, but you'd just be confused.
traduit: 我很想向你解释我的研究，但会让你感到困惑。

original: Yes, I'm a powerful wizard. No, I won't put on a magic show for you.
traduit: 没错，我是个强大的巫师。不对，我不是，我不会给你表演魔法的。

original: My job? Well, I'm the Watcher of the Wheel! Which is... exactly what it sounds like. I watch the Wheel.
traduit: 我的工作？我就是个看轮子的！就是字面意思。我负责看轮子。

original: Watching the wheel isn't as simple as you might think. Have to inspect all the way around the ice, make sure it's not melting.
traduit: 看守轮子不是那么简单。必须检查周围的冰，确保没有融化。

original: Don't get too many folks up here these days. Sometimes I think they've forgotten about me.
traduit: 最近没有多少家伙来这里，有时我觉得他们已经把我忘了。

original: My time is limited, so speak quickly.
traduit: 我时间有限，有事快说。

original: It'll take time to rebuild, but the Nords are no strangers to hard work.
traduit: 重建需要时间，但诺德人早已习惯了艰苦的工作。

original: The dark elves and Argonians won't soon forget Ulfric's prejudice, but I'm doing what I can to repair that rift.
traduit: 暗精灵和阿尔贡不会很快忘却乌弗瑞克的偏见，但我会试图修复裂缝。

original: Being a Jarl isn't something I ever wanted, but if I can help these people, then I will.
traduit: 成为领主并非我愿，但如果能帮助人们，那我愿意。

original: Got no time for a Nord who thinks he's better than everyone else. Keep walking.
traduit: 我没时间跟一个自以为是的诺德人说话。走开吧。

original: I told you, I've got no patience for fools. Keep walking.
traduit: 我告诉过你，我对傻子没耐心。走开吧。

original: There's no glory in war. It's just something they tell soldiers so they'll risk their lives.
traduit: 战争没有荣耀可言。只是士兵在流血牺牲罢了。

original: They call me a war hero. I'm no hero, I'm just a soldier who didn't want to die.
traduit: 他们都叫我战争英雄。我不是什么英雄，就是个不想死的士兵。

original: If Ulfric had his way, anyone who wasn't a Nord would be shipped right out of Skyrim.
traduit: 如果乌弗瑞克按照他的想法，那所有非诺德人都该被直接送出天际。

original: The sooner this war ends, the sooner we can all get on with our lives.
traduit: 战争越早结束，我们就能越早回归自己的生活。

original: Welcome to the House of Curiosities! I offer a brief tour for a few coins, or you can simply browse at your leisure.
traduit: 欢迎来到珍品屋！花几枚硬币可以听讲解，或者你可以在这里简单浏览一下。

original: If you've got some time, stop by my House of Curiosities. I promise you'll see wonders!
traduit: 如果你有时间，可以来我的珍品屋看看。保证你会看到奇迹的！

original: Welcome, friend, to Calixto's House of Curiosities!
traduit: 欢迎，朋友，欢迎来到卡利斯托的珍品屋！

original: My sister and I once traveled the world to assemble our collection. Such adventures we had!
traduit: 我和我的姐妹曾经环游世界寻找藏品。真是一场难忘的冒险！

original: I don't care much for the war one way or the other.
traduit: 不管怎样，我都不太喜欢这场战争。

original: It bothers me that fewer people come to Windhelm these days.
traduit: 现在来风舵城的人越来越少了，令人困扰啊。

original: Name's Nils. I'm the cook up at Candlehearth Hall.
traduit: 我叫纽斯。是烛炉堂的厨师。

original: Can't just throw the big logs on the fire. Got to have the little bits, too.
traduit: 不能只把大木头扔进火里，也得加点小柴火。

original: When I'm cutting wood, I pretend there's an Imperial soldier's head on the stump.
traduit: 我砍柴的时候，都会假装木桩上有颗帝国士兵的头。

original: Hello, hello, hello. Interested in fighting in the Pit? The rules are strict, but if I don't see it, it didn't happen, know what I mean?
traduit: 喂喂喂。有兴趣参加深坑战斗吗？规矩很严格，但如果我没看到，就当没发生过，懂我的意思么？

original: It's very important to Huki that all the battles are fair. What's more important to me is that my pay is fair.
traduit: 对胡基来说，所有战斗都是公平的，这很重要。对我来说，薪酬公平才是要紧的。

original: Prove your valor in the Pit! If you haven't got any valor, prove your pocketbook!
traduit: 来深坑证明你的勇气吧！如果没有胆量，那就拿出钱袋来！

original: When Ulfric was killed, justice was done. That might sound harsh, but it's how I feel.
traduit: 乌弗瑞克被杀时，正义得到伸张了。这听起来很残酷，可我就是这么想的。

original: I thought the the Gray Quarter would be a haven for my kind. I was wrong.
traduit: 我以为灰民区会是我们族人的天堂，可是我错了。

original: The Gray Quarter's not much to look at now, but it wasn't always so bad.
traduit: 灰民区没什么可看的，但也不总是那么糟糕。

original: The cornerclub's been filling up at night lately. I'll bet Elda up at Candlehearth is jealous.
traduit: 街角吧最近每晚都起满坐满。我敢说烛炉堂的艾尔达肯定很嫉妒。

original: We might be poor, but is it really any better out there?
traduit: 我们也许很穷，但外面就一定更好吗？

original: Not a day passes that I don't wonder if life would be better in Morrowind.
traduit: 我每天都在想，晨风的生活是否会更好。

original: I don't see why we should live as an underclass to the Nords. If anything, they owe us.
traduit: 我不明白我们为什么要比诺德人低一等。如果没有什么理由的话，那就是他们欠我们的。

original: Alchemy is simple. Unless, of course, you are simple. Then I can't help you.
traduit: 炼金术很好入门的。当然，要是你脑子不够使，那我帮不了你。

original: Must you bother me now? I've almost figured out where it is.
traduit: 你现在一定得烦我吗？我差不多已经知道它在哪儿了。

original: My master can be a bit short-tempered, but I've learned so much from him.
traduit: 我师父有时脾气很暴躁，但我从他身上学了很多东西。

original: I'll never have Master Nurelion's skill with potions.
traduit: 我永远达不到努瑞莱昂大师的药剂水平。

original: I have a decent mind for potions, but I've also learned how to craft magical items.
traduit: 我对药剂很在行，但我也学会了如何制作魔法物品。

original: I'm a sailor on the Northwind. We're laying over in Windhelm for awhile.
traduit: 我是北风号的水手。我们现在要在风舵城停留一段时间。

original: It's good to spend some time on solid land.
traduit: 能够花点时间在陆地上呆呆是好事。

original: A life on the river makes for weak legs, so I do a lot of walking when we dock.
traduit: 长年在河上生活会让腿部力量虚弱，所以我们每次靠岸时，我都会走很多路。

original: Captain Kjar expects the best, but he's a fair man. He never fails to reward hard work and loyalty.
traduit: 科亚船长期望很高，但他很公正，总是会奖励勤奋工作和忠实的人。

original: Never much cared for Windhelm. The place is depressing.
traduit: 我从不在意风舵城。这地方令人沮丧。

original: I'm a lot happier out here on the deck than I am wandering around in that ruin of a city.
traduit: 在甲板上可比在这城里的废墟快活得多。

original: I heard those Forsworn out west live in caves. Can't be any worse than trying to live in Windhelm.
traduit: 我听说弃誓者都住在山洞里。但总不会比在风舵城更糟吧。

original: Can't wait until we raise anchor. Anytime the boat's not moving, I start to get impatient.
traduit: 什么时候才能拔锚起航啊。船不动地儿的时候，我都很不耐烦。

original: Sorry, but I'm not looking to hire any more crew right now.
traduit: 抱歉，但我现在不想再招人了。

original: You don't know what freedom really means until you've lived on the river.
traduit: 除非你在河上生活过，否则是不会知道自由的真正含义的。

original: Been on the river since I could walk. Wouldn't trade it for the world.
traduit: 从我学会走路起就一直在河上生活。无论如何我都不会放弃的。

original: While you're on my boat, you follow my rules. First rule is, don't touch anything that doesn't belong to you.
traduit: 你在我船上就得按我的规矩来。首先就是，不要碰任何不属于你的东西。

original: The best way for us to win the Nords' respect is through hard work.
traduit: 赢得诺德人尊重的最好方式，就是努力工作。

original: Too many dark elves in Windhelm complain about the way we're treated. What good does complaining do?
traduit: 在风舵城有太多暗精灵在抱怨我们受到的待遇。抱怨有什么用？

original: I'm proud of my farm. It takes no small effort to grow crops in this part of Skyrim.
traduit: 能够拥有属于自己的农场值得自豪。在天际的这片区域种庄稼需要付出不少努力。

original: I own Hollyfrost Farm outside the city. It's honest work, if a bit dull.
traduit: 我在城外有个冬青霜农场，这是实实在在的工作，但有些无聊。

original: The Cruel-Seas have been sailors for generations. In truth, I regret not following in the footsteps of my ancestors.
traduit: 酷海家世代都是水手。说实话我很后悔没有追寻先人的足迹。

original: If I make enough money from the farm, I'll buy myself a longship to sail the rivers of Skyrim.
traduit: 等我的农场赚够了钱，我就买一艘长船到天际的河流上航行。

original: I understand what potions do, but I don't always understand how they do it.
traduit: 我知道药水的作用，却不知道它们是怎么起作用的。

original: This is Stormcloak territory. If you're one of those craven Imperials, don't expect a warm welcome.
traduit: 这里是风暴斗篷的地盘。如果你是个懦弱的帝国人，别指望在这里受到欢迎。

original: If you're here to join the Stormcloaks, the palace is inside.
traduit: 如果你是想加入风暴斗篷，宫殿就在这里面。

original: Loyal Nords are always welcome here. Anyone else better watch their step.
traduit: 这里永远欢迎忠诚的诺德人。其他人最好小心点。

original: If you're an Imperial spy, better turn around right now.
traduit: 如果你是帝国间谍，趁早掉头离开吧。

original: Stay away from the Aretino Residence. The place is cursed.
traduit: 离艾瑞提诺家宅远点，那地方被诅咒了。

original: You should unload some of that unwanted gear. Head over to Sadri's Used Wares, talk to the Elf.
traduit: 你该把不需要的装备卸一卸。到萨德利旧货店和那个精灵谈谈。

original: If you need an apothecary, the White Phial has respectable stock.
traduit: 如果需要药剂的话，白瓶那里有的是。

original: By the gods, you're diseased. Get yourself to the White Phial and purchase a remedy, before you infect us all.
traduit: 神啊，你生病了。在你感染我们之前赶紧去白瓶抓药吧。

original: The Dunmer get their drinks at the New Gnisis Cornerclub. Why they can't just call it a tavern is beyond me...
traduit: 丹莫都在新格尼西斯街角吧喝酒。真搞不懂他们为嘛不叫酒馆。

original: If it's bed or board you're after, Candlehearth Hall's got both.
traduit: 如果想要床位或者用餐，都可以去烛炉堂。

original: Across the river to the northeast lies Yngol Barrow. Steer clear of that foul place, lest the walking dead claim you as their own.
traduit: 河北岸就是英格尔古坟，远离那晦气地方，免得那些行尸走肉把你同化咯。

original: The Eye of Talos was a fine ship, once. Now it lies wrecked, off an island just north of here.
traduit: 塔洛斯之眼以前是艘好船。现在它失事了，就在北面的岛上。

original: Maybe you've seen masts sticking out of the water to the northeast? That would be the wreck of the Winter War. Fine vessel, back in its day.
traduit: 见过东北方向伸出水面的桅杆吧？那是冬战号残骸。想当初可是个好船。

original: South of here, and west of the road, lies Cronvangr Cave. Stay away from that cursed place, and the vampires that call it home.
traduit: 城南面大路的西侧有个克隆万格洞穴，离那儿远点，那地方被诅咒了，还有吸血鬼在那儿安家。

original: Tell me you've seen them. Those... things. Small and evil, like something out of a nightmare. They come from Stillborn Cave, to the north. I know it.
traduit: 我告诉你我看见过。那些……东西。又小又邪恶，就像噩梦里出来的一样。就在北面的死胎洞穴里。

original: I've no problem with your kind, Orc. But that stronghold you've got in the southeast? Narzulbur? It's an affront to my people.
traduit: 我对你们没意见，兽人。但你知道东南的要塞吗？纳祖伯？那是对我族的侮辱。

original: I've no problem with Orcs. But that stronghold they've got in the southeast? Narzulbur? It's an affront to my people.
traduit: 我对兽人没什么意见。但他们在东南的要塞？纳祖伯？那是对我族的侮辱。

original: You hear the news? There's a dragon roosting up on Mount Anthor, to the northwest.
traduit: 听说了吗？西北的安索尔山上有头龙。

original: I... knew Veren and Thorek. They were my friends.
traduit: 我……认识维仁和图雷克。他们是我朋友。

original: Is this punishment for my past? Is it Mara's will to torment me so?
traduit: 这是玛拉有意惩罚我的过往吗？

original: You must deliver those items to your superior. And I... I must get out of this foul place.
traduit: 你去把这些东西交给你们上级。我……得离开这个肮脏的地方。

original: I don't even know what to think anymore...
traduit: 我都不知道该怎么想了……

original: Are you excited? Oh, you should be. Things are finally looking up!
traduit: 你兴奋吗？哦，你肯定兴奋。事情终于好转了！

original: Doesn't really matter. Thanks, but no.
traduit: 那并不重要。谢谢，但还是不行。

original: I haven't even said what it is.
traduit: 我还没说是什么呢。

original: No, I don't think so. Not today.
traduit: 不，今天可能不行。

original: Malur, I need you to take care of something.
traduit: 马鲁尔，我需要你去处理些事。

original: Well, he's been very busy. Perhaps today he'll have some free time.
traduit: 嗯，他很忙。也许今天他有空闲呢。

original: Again? Are you sure? He still hasn't answered your last several requests.
traduit: 又来？您确定？他还没有回复您前面几次的邀请呢。

original: Why don't you see if Arch-Mage Aren is interested in joining me for a meal?
traduit: 你去看看阿冉大法师有没有兴趣和我吃顿饭吧。

original: Will you be needing anything special today?
traduit: 您今天有什么特别需要吗？

original: Yes, that will be fine. Thank you.
traduit: 行，那就好。谢谢了。

original: I shall inform you the moment something noteworthy happens.
traduit: 有值得注意的事的话，我会通知您。

original: None? Nothing at all? Nothing from the College, even?
traduit: 没有？什么都没有？连学院的消息都没有吗？

original: There is no news, I'm afraid.
traduit: 恐怕没什么新消息。

original: So, what's the latest exciting news about goings-on in Winterhold?
traduit: 有什么关于冬堡的新消息吗？

original: Oh, you prefer to listen, eh? Of course, of course! The Listener listens! A joke! A funny joke! I get it.
traduit: 哦，你更喜欢听，哈？当然，当然！聆听者在聆听！笑话！有趣的笑话！我明白了。

original: Then listen to this - don't kill me. Let poor Cicero live! I attacked the strumpet Astrid, I did! And I'd do it again! Anything for our mother!
traduit: 那就听着吧——别杀我。让可怜的西塞罗活下去！我袭击了那个婊子阿斯垂德，是我干的！我还会这么干！为了我们的母亲我什么都敢做！

original: Return to the pretender, tell her I'm dead! Tell her you strangled me with my own intestines! Ha ha! But lie! Yes, lie! Lie, and let me live!
traduit: 回到那个冒牌货身边，就告诉她，我死了！告诉她你用我的肠子把我活活勒死了！哈哈！不过是撒谎！没错！撒谎！撒谎吧，让我活下去！

original: Traitor? Me? Silly assassin. So confused, so confused... and they say I'm mad!
traduit: 叛徒？我？愚蠢的刺客。不可思议，不可思议……他们居然说我疯了！

original: If I'm a traitor, so are you! Have you not heard the maiden's voice? Are you not the Listener?
traduit: 我要是叛徒，那你也是！你没听见夜母的声音吗？你不是聆听者吗？

original: So walk away! Let poor Cicero live! Tell Astrid you did the job! Stabbed, strangled, drowned poor Cicero! A tiny white lie for a dark assassin!
traduit: 赶紧走开！让可怜的西塞罗活下去！告诉阿斯垂德你完成任务了！用刺、用勒、用水淹，整死可怜的西塞罗！黑暗的刺客和善意的谎言！

original: Time to die, traitor!
traduit: 该上路了，叛徒！

original: Oh, I like that! Very good, very good! Creative!
traduit: 哦豁，我喜欢！非常好，非常好！有创意！

original: But killing me would be a mistake! Oh yes. You would displease our mother, hmm? For she's your mother too, isn't she... Listener?
traduit: 但杀我会是一个错误！哦，没错。你会让我们的母亲不高兴的，对吧？因为她也是你母亲对吧？聆听者？

original: Walk away! Let poor Cicero live! Tell the pretender Astrid you did the job! Stabbed, strangled, drowned poor Cicero! One little itty bitty lie!
traduit: 走吧！让可怜的西塞罗活下去！告诉阿斯垂德那个冒牌货，你完成任务了！用刺、用勒、用水淹，整死可怜的西塞罗！一个小小的谎言！

original: There is only one cure for your madness, Cicero. Me.
traduit: 西塞罗，治好你的疯狂只有一个办法。那就是我！

original: DB07AstridCiceroDeadNoChoice
traduit: DB07AstridCiceroDeadNoChoice

original: Yes, Cicero is dead. (Lie)
traduit: 没错，西塞罗死了。（撒谎）

original: DB07AstridCiceroDeadYesChoice
traduit: DB07AstridCiceroDeadYesChoice

original: Yes, Cicero is dead.
traduit: 是，西塞罗死了。

original: Arnbjorn is safe, and for that you have my thanks. But what of the fool? Is Cicero dead?
traduit: 艾恩乔恩安全回来了。我得谢谢你。那个小丑怎么样？西塞罗死了吗？

original: DB07CiceroConfrontBranchTopic
traduit: DB07CiceroConfrontBranchTopic

original: You caught me! I surrender! Ha ha ha ha.
traduit: 你抓到我了！我投降！哈哈哈哈。

original: Do what you will. Cicero has no fight left. In the end, Sithis will judge us both.
traduit: 随你做什么吧。西塞罗没斗志了。到时候西帝斯会审判咱俩的。

original: What is it doing? Walking around nearly naked...
traduit: 这是干什么？一丝不挂地跑来跑去的……

original: Oh! Look over there!
traduit: 哦！看那边！

original: That's certainly unusual.
traduit: 这可不正常。

original: Some folk - they got no shame.
traduit: 有些人，属实不要脸。

original: Well now! That's a shamefully absurd way to go around in public.
traduit: 哎呀！大庭广众光着跑还要脸不要了。

original: Ummm... they'd lock me up if I went around like that.
traduit: 嗯……如果我那样到处乱跑，肯定会被抓走的。

original: What is that half-naked fetcher trying to prove?
traduit: 那个半裸的费彻想要干什么？

original: What a vulgar display.
traduit: 又粗俗又现眼。

original: That's not something you see every day...
traduit: 这可不是天天能看得到啊……

original: Gracious! This one is certainly unaccustomed to such sights...
traduit: 天哪！在下确定这景象不常见……

original: Well now! Aren't you putting on quite the show?
traduit: 哎呀！你的表演很精彩嘛？

original: Shameful, really. I blame the parents.
traduit: 丢人，太丢人。爹妈没教育好。

original: Oh, dear. Would you look at that? How embarrassing.
traduit: 哦，亲爱的。你看看啊？多尴尬。

original: Look at that fool.
traduit: 看那个傻蛋。

original: Gah! Look over there. I can't believe it.
traduit: 哈！看那边。真不敢相信。

original: It takes a lot of confidence to walk around naked. Trust me on that.
traduit: 光着身子来回跑确实够勇。勇得很。

original: Whoa.
traduit: 呀。

original: Crazy person... Something must be wrong with its head, to strut around like that.
traduit: 疯子……脑子出毛病了，裸奔有什么可神气的。

original: They're half-naked. That ain't right. Somebody's gotta say somethin'...
traduit: 不穿衣服。这不正常。总得有人管管吧……

original: Look! Look!
traduit: 看啊！快看！

original: Somebody get that idiot some armor...
traduit: 快来个人给那个白痴遮上点……

original: A bit much, going around like that...
traduit: 过分了啊，这样走来走去的……

original: Why the impropriety!
traduit: 什么情况！

original: Never see me strutting around like that!
traduit: 从没见过这么无耻还走来走去的！

original: Crazy, naked n'wah...
traduit: 疯了吧，裸体恩'瓦……

original: Whoa... Not even I'm that drunk...
traduit: 哇……就算我喝得再高……

original: Positively vulgar.
traduit: 这么卖力丢人现眼。

original: Somebody get that fool a blanket.
traduit: 谁来给这笨蛋披条毯子。

original: Despite the shame, this one can't help but stare.
traduit: 太羞耻了，但在下还是忍不住多看一眼。

original: By Ysmir's beard! I didn't know it was gonna be a party!
traduit: 伊斯米尔的胡子啊！我不知道这里还有个派对！

original: For shame! You should be locked up for strutting around like that.
traduit: 不害臊！这样大摇大摆就该被关起来。

original: Oh my. Been a lot of years since I've seen something like that...
traduit: 哦，天。多少年没见过这样的景儿了……

original: Got to admire the chops it takes to walk around like that.
traduit: 能这样走来走去，令人佩服。

original: Not my thing, but who am I to judge...
traduit: 不关我的事，我也没啥资格评判了……

original: Wait until the boys hear about this.
traduit: 等孩子们听说了再说吧。

original: Now that's something else, right there!
traduit: 出事了，就在那儿！

original: I've heard you might know what Faleen likes.
traduit: 我听说你可能知道法琳喜欢什么。

original: What? Why, are you... interested?
traduit: 什么？怎么，你……对她感兴趣？

original: You just need to have something to talk about.
traduit: 你只是需要找点话题聊聊。

original: That's the trouble. I know Faleen from the Keep, but I have no idea what sorts of things she likes.
traduit: 那就麻烦了。我只知道法琳在要塞站岗，但我不知道她喜欢什么啊。

original: It's not a simple matter. I could offend her fairly easily by bringing up the wrong subject. I've seen it happen before.
traduit: 这不是个简单的问题。万一说错话招她烦了怎么办。我以前有过这种情况。

original: Looks like there's not much you can do.
traduit: 看来你也无能为力了。

original: I guess not.
traduit: 我觉得也是。

original: I'm not sure. I hope things work out for you.
traduit: 我不确定。希望你一切顺利吧。

original: As do I. It's a puzzling situation.
traduit: 希望吧。这个局面太让人困惑了。

original: Boti said she'd handle Jofthor.
traduit: 伯蒂说她能搞定约夫托尔。

original: She would? If she's willing to deal with him, then everything would be all right.
traduit: 真的吗？如果她愿意，那一切都好办了。

original: I'll... I'll go speak to Fastred. Post-haste!
traduit: 我……我得去找法斯莱德。越快越好！

original: Have you spoken to my parents yet? Please, my love depends on it!
traduit: 你和我父母谈过了吗？拜托了，我的爱情全靠它了！

original: What would inspire them to leave?
traduit: 他们为什么要离开？

original: Bassianus is still so terrified of Jofthor.
traduit: 巴夏努斯还是很怕约夫托尔。

original: If he knew that I'd keep him from hunting the poor boy down, he'd take Fastred to Riften without a second thought.
traduit: 如果那倒霉小子知道我能阻止我丈夫去追他，他会毫不犹豫地把法斯莱德带到裂谷城去。

original: Let him know that I'll watch out for them. I just want my daughter to be happy.
traduit: 告诉他我会替他们看着的。我只希望女儿能开开心心的。

original: I'll see if I can't get some work done inside, where it's warm.
traduit: 我看看能不能再屋里干点活，还是屋里暖和。

original: That's nice, son. Just don't stomp on the crop like last time!
traduit: 很好，儿子。但别像上次一样把庄稼踩坏了。

original: I'm gonna go play soldier with a tree!
traduit: 我要和树玩士兵游戏！

original: It's too cold for my bones, but that never seems to stop you, dear.
traduit: 对我来说还是太冷了，但这好像对你没影响啊，宝贝。

original: Another gorgeous gray day, right dear?
traduit: 又是美丽凉爽的一天，对吧亲爱的？

original: Guess we can't afford to miss that much work, can we? Oh well...
traduit: 看来我们不能放下这么多工作，对吧？好吧……

original: True enough, you cur. Back to work, I suppose...
traduit: 不错，你个混球。还是回去工作吧……

original: Hjorunn, the last time you tried anything, your fist broke on my head!
traduit: 卓恩，上次你动手的时候，拳头是打在我脑袋上！

original: Just as long as you don't breathe on me, Hjorunn. I'll be out for hours.
traduit: 只要你别把气吐在我身上，卓恩。我会出去待几个小时。

original: What did you say? I ought to break off one of those tusks and use it as my drinking horn!
traduit: 你说啥？我就该打折你一颗獠牙然后当我的角杯！

original: Don't make me to defend the honor of my mead! It's been my friend a lot longer than you have!
traduit: 别逼我捍卫我喝蜜酒的荣誉！它做我朋友的时间可比你长多了！

original: I have to work twice as hard because you drink up all our profits.
traduit: 我得加倍努力工作，你把咱们的利润都喝光了。

original: Can you pay attention to work for once, instead of your mug?
traduit: 你能不能把注意力放在工作上，而不是你的酒杯？

original: Kharag, take a break and drink with me! Those trees aren't going anywhere!
traduit: 卡拉戈，歇会儿陪我喝一杯！反正那些树也跑不了！

original: Why so glum, my ugly friend? Did we run out of mead?
traduit: 怎么这么郁闷啊，我的丑哥们儿？我们的蜜酒喝光了吗？

original: It's not hopeless, Esbern. I'm Dragonborn.
traduit: 不是毫无希望，伊思本。我是龙裔。

original: You're right, I forget myself. I've lived without hope for so long...
traduit: 你说得对，我有些忘我了。我活在绝望中太久了……

original: The prophecies are clear. Only the Dragonborn can stop Alduin.
traduit: 预言是明确的。只有龙裔可以阻止奥杜因。

original: What? You're... can it really be true? Dragonborn?
traduit: 你……真的是龙裔？

original: Then... there is hope! The gods have not abandoned us! We must... we must...
traduit: 那就……有希望了！众神没有抛弃我们！我们必须……必须……

original: Tell me about Alduin.
traduit: 和我说说奥杜因。

original: No, never mind.
traduit: 想都不要想。

original: You're trying my patience, lad.
traduit: 你在考验我的耐心，小子。

original: You're trying my patience, lass.
traduit: 你在考验我的耐心，姑娘。

original: Break the law? Are you kidding?
traduit: 违法勾当？你是开玩笑吧？

original: Sorry... I usually have a nose for this kind of thing.
traduit: 抱歉……我通常对这类事嗅觉很灵敏。

original: Never mind then, lad. If you change your mind, come find me.
traduit: 没关系，小子。改主意的时候就来找我。

original: Never mind then, lass. If you change your mind, come find me.
traduit: 没关系，姑娘。改主意的时候就来找我。

original: What do I have to do?
traduit: 我该怎么做？

original: Simple... I'm going to cause a distraction and you're going to steal Madesi's silver ring from a strongbox under his stand.
traduit: 很简单……我去分散大家的注意力，你去玛德希摊位的保险箱里偷出一个银戒指。

original: Once you have it, I want you to place it in Brand-Shei's pocket without him noticing.
traduit: 得手以后，悄悄放到布兰德-谢的口袋里。

original: What do you have in mind?
traduit: 你在想什么？

original: I've got a bit of an errand to perform, but I need an extra pair of hands.
traduit: 我有些事要办，不过需要一个帮手。

original: And in my line of work, extra hands are well-paid.
traduit: 干我这一行，帮手的报酬也不错哦。

original: My wealth is none of your business.
traduit: 我的钱不关你的事。

original: Oh, but that's where you're wrong, lad. Wealth is my business.
traduit: 哦，但这就是你错了的地方，小子。钱就是我的事。

original: Maybe you'd like a taste?
traduit: 也许你想试一试？

original: Oh, but that's where you're wrong, lass. Wealth is my business.
traduit: 哦，但这就是你错了的地方，姑娘。钱就是我的事。

original: How could you possibly know that?
traduit: 你怎么知道？

original: It's all about sizing up your mark, lad.
traduit: 这都是为了评估目标，小子。

original: The way they walk, what they're wearing. It's a dead giveaway.
traduit: 走路方式、穿着打扮。都会暴露出事实。

original: It's all about sizing up your mark, lass.
traduit: 这都是为了评估目标，姑娘。

original: I'm sorry, what?
traduit: 对不起，你说什么？

original: I'm saying you've got the coin but you didn't earn a septim of it honestly. I can tell.
traduit: 我是说，你虽然有钱，但不是靠正当途径赚来的。

original: Your pockets... they're a little low on coin. I can tell.
traduit: 我是说，你的囊中……有些羞涩啊。

original: Glad to see you finally came to to your senses. Ready to make some coin?
traduit: 很高兴见到你终于恢复理智了。准备好赚钱了吗？

original: Never done an honest day's work in your life for all that coin you're carrying, eh lad?
traduit: 你这辈子都没靠正当营生赚过钱吧，小子？

original: Running a little light in the pockets, lad?
traduit: 要给口袋添点光吗，小子？

original: Never done an honest day's work in your life for all that coin you're carrying, eh lass?
traduit: 你这辈子都没靠正当营生赚过钱吧，姑娘？

original: Running a little light in the pockets, lass?
traduit: 要给口袋添点光吗，姑娘？

original: When I'm done here, I'd be more than happy to sell you an elixir.
traduit: 等我搞定之后，我很乐意卖你一剂。

original: Please, please... hold all your questions until after I've finished!
traduit: 请吧，请吧……所有问题都留到我讲完再问！

original: Oh, excuse me, milord. I'll be glad to sell you an elixir after I'm done with these fine people.
traduit: 哦，抱歉，老爷。在我跟大家说完之后，我很乐意卖你一剂药。

original: Oh, excuse me, milady. I'll be glad to sell you an elixir after I'm done with these fine people.
