traduit: 哦，抱歉，夫人。在我跟大家说完之后，我很乐意卖你一剂药。

original: What wasn't I clear about?
traduit: 我说得不够清楚吗？

original: Okay lad, ready to make some coin?
traduit: 好了小子，准备好挣点钱了吗？

original: Okay lass, ready to make some coin?
traduit: 好了姑娘，准备好挣点钱了吗？

original: Changed your mind I hope?
traduit: 希望你是改了主意了？

original: I'm fine, I'm fine. Let's move on.
traduit: 我没事。我没事。我们继续。

original: This place has had you shaking in your armor ever since we arrived.
traduit: 我们一到这地方你就吓得一惊一乍的。

original: Quiet! I think I heard something.
traduit: 安静！我觉得我听见什么了。

original: Can't say that I have.
traduit: 没看到。

original: Find anything worthwhile yet?
traduit: 找到有价值的东西了吗？

original: No way. It was wrong to do those things.
traduit: 没门。那样做是不对的。

original: Arrogant, eh? Play it however you want, but listen up.
traduit: 很傲慢啊？但你想怎么演是就怎么演，但听好。

original: The group I represent has its home in the Ratway beneath Riften... a tavern called the Ragged Flagon.
traduit: 我所代表的组织在裂谷城下的鼠道里安家……那里有家叫漏壶的酒馆。

original: When you come to your senses, find me there and we'll discuss your future.
traduit: 等你恢复理智了，就去找我，我们来聊聊未来。

original: The money's nice, but I don't know...
traduit: 赚钱是好事，但我不知道……

original: Look, I'll make this simple for you.
traduit: 听着，我说得简单点……

original: When you make up your mind, come find me there and we'll talk about your future.
traduit: 等你决定好了就来找我，我们可以谈谈未来。

original: I can handle it.
traduit: 我应付得来。

original: All right, then. Let's put that to the test.
traduit: 好吧。那就来测试一下。

original: Get there in one piece and we'll see if you've really got what it takes.
traduit: 完好地到达那里，让我们看看你是否真的具有我们需要的能力。

original: What's been going on?
traduit: 发生什么事了？

original: Bah. My organization's been having a run of bad luck, but I suppose that's just how it goes.
traduit: 哎。我的组织最近运气不大好，但我想情况就是这样。

original: But never mind that, even though you fouled up the job I still think you've got that spark I'm looking for.
traduit: 不过没关系，就算你把工作搞砸了，我还是觉得你有我想要的那种激情。

original: There's plenty of gold out there for the taking... if you're up to the challenge.
traduit: 有的是钱等你去赚……前提是你愿意接受挑战的话。

original: But never mind that, you did the job and you did it well. Best of all, there's more where that came from... if you think you can handle it.
traduit: 但不用管了，你做的很好。更重要的是，还有很多东西等着你呢……只要你觉得能搞定。

original: Lorkhan's eyes! Look at that big bastard! Keep your head down, let's see what it does.
traduit: 洛克汗之眼啊！看那个大家伙！低下头。我们看看它要干嘛。

original: What should we do?
traduit: 我们要怎么做？

original: Gods above! Look at that!
traduit: 众神在上！看那儿！

original: Kill the damn dragon! Unless you have a better idea?!
traduit: 杀了这个混账龙！不然你有什么好主意？！

original: Stay under cover. This is what we came for. We need to see what happens.
traduit: 待在掩体后面。我们就是为此而来。咱们得看看会发生什么。

original: Steady. Let's see what it does.
traduit: 稳住。看看它要做什么。

original: Come on. We need to find out what's happening up there!
traduit: 来吧。咱们去看看上面发生什么了！

original: You learn a new word like a master... you truly do have the gift.
traduit: 你学习新词就像大师一样啊……真的很有天赋。

original: I'm not playing with you, Kayd! You play mean!
traduit: 我不跟你玩了，凯德！你很坏！

original: Father says I shouldn't play with you anymore.
traduit: 爸爸说我以后不能再和你玩了。

original: Can't catch me!
traduit: 你抓不住我！

original: Aww, I'm hungry! Can we get some food, instead?
traduit: 哇，我饿了！我们能去找点吃的吗？

original: Tag! You're it!
traduit: 嘿！抓住你了！

original: I'm bored! Let's play a game!
traduit: 我好无聊！来玩游戏吧！

original: Pantea, perhaps you should attend to your students, and leave the politics to me.
traduit: 潘提亚，也许你应该去关心一下你的学生们，政治问题交给我吧。

original: That is precisely why we remain neutral. Ours is to tell tales of empires, not to make or break them.
traduit: 这正是我们保持中立的原因。我们的使命是讲述列国的故事，而不是成就或摧毁它们。

original: Aia, please be quiet. Viarmo and I are discussing matters of national politics.
traduit: 艾雅，安静。我和维阿墨是在讨论国家政治问题。

original: Aia, this is a delicate matter. Why don't you review your lessons and be silent for a while.
traduit: 艾雅，这是个微妙的问题。为什么不去复习功课，安静一会儿呢？

original: But I'm sure those Skyrim dogs would stand down if the keepers of the tales showed their patriotism!
traduit: 但我肯定，如果故事的守护者表现出他们的爱国精神，那些天际的狗家伙就会退却！

original: Maybe if we stopped singing about their silly Nord heroes, the rebels would stop making such a fuss!
traduit: 也许如果我们停止歌颂他们愚蠢的诺德英雄，叛军就不会这么大惊小怪了！

original: Lady Ateia, it is the official position of the college to remain neutral in all political affairs. We cannot risk our history by choosing sides.
traduit: 阿提亚夫人，学院的官方立场就是在所有政治事务中保持中立。我们不能拿学院的历史去冒险站队。

original: Now, now, our duty is to record the great tales of history, not to pick sides in them. Best to stay out of the warfare, I feel.
traduit: 不行，不行，我们的职责是记录历史上的伟大故事，而不是选边站。我看还是远离战争吧。

original: Viarmo, the college really must take a stand on the war!
traduit: 维阿墨，学院必须对战争表明立场！

original: Viarmo, don't you think it's time that the Bards College officially declared support for the empire?
traduit: 维阿墨，你不觉得是时候让吟游诗人学院正式宣布支持帝国了吗？

original: You're on! Loser buys the next round!
traduit: 好啊！输的人买下轮酒！

original: In your dreams! If I win, the next round's on you!
traduit: 做梦去吧！如果我赢了，下一轮算你的！

original: Bet I can reach the bottom of this flagon before you!
traduit: 但我打赌能比你先喝到底！

original: Bet I can down this ale faster than you!
traduit: 我肯定比你喝得快！

original: Not if you were the last man in the Empire.
traduit: 除非你是帝国里最后一个男人。

original: Oh, if you insist!
traduit: 哦，如果你非要的话！

original: You can buy me whatever you want!
traduit: 你想给我买什么都行！

original: Aw, that's so sweet of you! Thanks!
traduit: 你真是太贴心了！谢谢！

original: Being friends with the bartender's son has its advantages, huh?
traduit: 和酒保的儿子做朋友也有好处啊？

original: Oh, yes please!
traduit: 哦，可以啊！

original: Can I buy you a drink, darling?
traduit: 我能请你喝一杯吗，亲爱的？

original: So, um, mind if I buy you a drink?
traduit: 所以，呃，介意我请你喝一杯吗？

original: This drink's on me.
traduit: 这杯我请了。

original: Free mead!
traduit: 免费的蜜酒！

original: Hooray!
traduit: 欧耶！

original: You heard the man! Drink and be merry!
traduit: 听到他说的了吧！尽情畅饮吧！

original: Let's hear it for our kind benefactor!
traduit: 让我们为慷慨的人欢呼吧！

original: A round for all of my friends!
traduit: 为我所有的朋友干杯！

original: Another round, on me!
traduit: 再来一轮，算我的！

original: That's it! I'm not retiring, ever! End of discussion!
traduit: 就这样吧！我不退休了！别再讨论了！

original: Well, you see, that's a little complicated, and... you know what? Never mind. Guess I'm not retiring anytime soon.
traduit: 嗯，你看，有些复杂，而且……你知道吗？不用担心，我短期内不会退休了。

original: Oh, brother...
traduit: 哦，哥哥……

original: What about "Auntie Faida" in Dragon Bridge? She runs a bar, and you said she's one of your favorite girls!
traduit: 龙桥的菲达阿姨呢？她也在经营酒馆，你还说她是你最喜欢的姑娘之一！

original: But you always say you want more girls in the bar to begin with!
traduit: 但你总说你想要和更多姑娘在酒馆里开始！

original: Don't be a silly girl! Running a bar's no job for a young lady.
traduit: 别当傻丫头！经营酒馆不是年轻姑娘该干的。

original: Hah! A girl running a bar? Don't be ridiculous, Minette!
traduit: 哈！女孩经营酒馆？别傻了，米内蒂！

original: I could run the Skeever! You even said I'm almost as smart as you!
traduit: 我可以经营恶鼠！你甚至说过我和你一样聪明！

original: Why not let me run the Skeever? I already know lots about it!
traduit: 为什么不让我经营恶鼠？我已经知道很多了！

original: I don't know, father... There's a whole world out there I want to see.
traduit: 我不知道，父亲……我想去外面见见世面。

original: You'd just spend your time here, bossing me around and yelling for more drinks. You're practically retired already...
traduit: 你只会在这里消磨时间，对着我颐指气使，大声喊着拿酒来。你实际上早就退休了……

original: It's been a good week, my boy! Loud customers mean good cheer, and good cheer means a full till!
traduit: 这周过得不错，孩子！顾客吵闹意味着欢呼，欢呼代表着满满的收入！

original: You know, I ought to retire and leave you to run the Skeever, son!
traduit: 你知道，我该退休了，让你来经营恶鼠吧，儿子！

original: Yes, yes, fine. Just hurry! Mustn't keep the customers thirsty!
traduit: 好，好。好。快点吧！不能让客人们渴着！

original: Good idea, sis. Maybe you ought to be in charge!
traduit: 好主意，妹子。也许应该你来负责！

original: Bring the Blackbriar 195 Berry-Blend. It should be at its peak right now, and if it doesn't get served soon, it'll only go bad.
traduit: 拿黑棘195浆果混合。现在应该是最美味的时候，不快点上桌的话，只会变差的。

original: We just got a cask of Old Gold 200 that has a crack in it. Better serve it now before it goes bad.
traduit: 我们刚拿到一桶有裂缝的老黄金200。最好现在就上桌，免得变质了。

original: Fat Toad 190 is always a crowd-pleaser. Father could probably charge extra.
traduit: 胖蛤蟆190总是很受欢迎。父亲可能会额外赚点。

original: Just bring any of them, lad! Can't risk thirsty customers without mead to drink, even for a second!
traduit: 随便带一桶来，小子！不能让口渴的顾客喝不上蜜酒，一秒钟也不行！

original: Any of them! Just hurry up! No time for a debate when customers are thirsty!
traduit: 随便！快点就行！顾客渴着呢，没时间浪费！

original: Yes, father. Which cask should we open?
traduit: 是，父亲。我们该打开哪桶？

original: Bring up some more mead, my boy. This cask's nearly tapped!
traduit: 再拿点蜜酒来，孩子。这桶要见底了！

original: Come, Galmar. We've still much work to do.
traduit: 来吧，加尔玛。我们还有很多工作要做。

original: May the gods preserve us all.
traduit: 也愿神保佑我们所有人。

original: And of course, we couldn't have done it without you.
traduit: 当然，没有你，我们也不可能成功。

original: May the gods preserve you.
traduit: 愿众神保佑你。

original: I'm not afraid of the remnants of the Legion, in time they'll all give up and go home.
traduit: 我不害怕军团的残余，他们迟早都会放弃，然后回家。

original: What I fear, is that the Thalmor will see our victory here and turn greater attention to our shores.
traduit: 我所担心的是，梭默会看到我们的胜利，并将更多的注意力转向我们这里。

original: We must be prepared to face them.
traduit: 我们必须做好面对他们的准备。

original: The Imperials aren't going to leave us alone. They still have camps in the hills.
traduit: 帝国军不会放过我们的。他们在山里还有营地。

original: They'll continue to strike out at us, whenever and wherever they can.
traduit: 他们会随时随地继续攻击。

original: Oh, I know.
traduit: 嗯，我知道。

original: It's a foregone conclusion, you know.
traduit: 你知道，这是意料之中的结局。

original: Thank you, I thought so, too.
traduit: 谢谢你，我也这么认为。

original: Eh, not so bad.
traduit: 嗯，还不错。

original: Nice touch about the High King.
traduit: 很有至高王的感觉。

original: How'd I do?
traduit: 我做的如何？

original: There is much to do, and I need every able bodied man and woman committed to rebuilding Skyrim.
traduit: 还有很多事情要做，我需要每个有能力的人致力于重建天际。

original: A great darkness is growing, and soon we will be called to fight it, on these shores or abroad.
traduit: 巨大的黑暗正在蔓延，我们很快将被召唤去对抗它，无论在本土还是国外。

original: The Aldmeri Dominion may have defeated the Empire, but it has not defeated Skyrim!
traduit: 先祖神洲可能打败了帝国，但它并没有打败天际！

original: Then it is settled. The Jarl will continue to rule Solitude, I will garrison armies here to ward off Imperial attempts to reclaim the city.
traduit: 那就这么定了。领主将继续统治独孤，我将在这里驻军以抵御帝国夺回这座城市的企图。

original: And in due time, the Moot will meet, and settle the claim to High King once and for all.
traduit: 然后再找适当的时机召开领主议会，彻底解决至高王人选问题。

original: I do!
traduit: 我会的。

original: Yes, what about the Lady Elisif?
traduit: 没错，那艾利西弗夫人怎么办呢？

original: Will she put aside her personal hatred for me, and her misplaced love for the Emperor and his coin, so that the suffering of our people will end?
traduit: 她会不会放下对我个人的仇恨，对皇帝和金钱的错爱，让我们人民结束痛苦？

original: Will she acknowledge that it is we Nord's who will determine Skyrim's future?
traduit: 她会不会承认，我们诺德人有权决定天际的未来？

original: Will she swear fealty to me, so all may know that we are at peace, and a new day has dawned?
traduit: 她会不会向我宣誓效忠，好向所有人知道我们已经相安无事，新的一天已经到来？

original: Yes, what about Jarl Erikur?
traduit: 没错，艾瑞库尔领主怎么办呢？

original: Will he cast aside the Imperial coin falling into his coffers?
traduit: 他会不会把落入他囊中的金银抛弃？

original: Will he acknowledge that we Nords deserve to determine our own future?
traduit: 他会不会承认，我们诺德人有权决定天际的未来？

original: Will he swear fealty to me, that all may know we are at peace, and a new day has dawned?
traduit: 他会不会向我宣誓效忠，好向所有人知道我们已经相安无事，新的一天已经到来？

original: And what about Jarl Elisif?
traduit: 那艾利西弗领主怎么办呢？

original: And what about Jarl Erikur?
traduit: 那艾瑞库尔领主怎么办呢？

original: And it is for these reasons that I cannot accept the mantle of "High King."
traduit: 正是因此，我不能就这样接过“至高王”的称号。

original: Not until the Moot declares that title should adorn my shoulders will I accept it.
traduit: 我需要等待领主议会把头衔授予我，我才会接受。

original: Huzzah!
traduit: 万岁！

original: To return to our glory and traditions, to determine our own future!
traduit: 使我们回归荣耀和传统，得以亲手决定我们自己的未来！

original: But more than that, it was you who fought for Skyrim, for our right to fight our own battles...
traduit: 更重要的是，是你们，在为天际而战，在为我们的权利而战……

original: It was you who fought your kin who didn't understand our cause, who weren't willing to pay the price of our freedom.
traduit: 是你们，与那些不了解我们的事业，不愿意为我们的自由付出代价的同族战斗。

original: It was you who fought the Thalmor and their puppets who would have us deny our gods and our heritage.
traduit: 是你们，与那些企图否定我们的神和遗产的梭默和他们的傀儡战斗。

original: It was you who fought a dying Empire who sunk its claws into our land, trying to drag us down with it.
traduit: 是你们，和一个把魔爪伸到我们的土地上，试图把我们拖下水的垂死帝国战斗。

original: But it is all of you who are the true heroes!
traduit: 但你们大家才是真正的英雄！

original: And indeed, there are many that call us heroes.
traduit: 的确，有很多人称我们为英雄。

original: And indeed, there are many that call me hero.
traduit: 的确，有很多人称我为英雄。

original: I am indeed Ulfric Stormcloak, and at my side the man we know as Stormblade, and the world knows as the Dragonborn.
traduit: 我就是乌弗瑞克·风暴斗篷，在我身边的是我们熟知的风暴之刃，也是世人所说的龙裔。

original: I am indeed Ulfric Stormcloak, and at my side the woman we know as Stormblade, and the world knows as the Dragonborn.
traduit: 我就是乌弗瑞克·风暴斗篷，在我身边的是我们熟知的风暴之刃，也是世人所说的龙裔。

original: I am indeed Ulfric Stormcloak...
traduit: 我就是乌弗瑞克·风暴斗篷……

original: And now, I present to you, Ulfric Stormcloak, hero of the people, liberator and High King of Skyrim!
traduit: 现在，有请人民英雄、天际的解放者与至高王，乌弗瑞克·风暴斗篷！

original: Come, at the very least walk out with me.
traduit: 来吧，至少和我一起出去走走。

original: My reasons are my own.
traduit: 我有自己的理由。

original: A man's heart is his own burden to bear, so I will honor your request, though it casts a bit of gloom on an otherwise glorious day.
traduit: 每个人都要承担自己心灵的负担，所以我尊重你的要求。尽管在这么一个灿烂的日子里显得有点阴郁。

original: I'm not sure this was all worth it, after all.
traduit: 我不确定这一切是否值得。

original: There's no shame in such thoughts. A man without doubts is a man without a conscience.
traduit: 有这样的想法并不丢人。没有疑虑的人是没有良心的。

original: But rest assured. We've won Skyrim's right to determine her own future. And for that, every Nord praises us.
traduit: 但放心吧。我们赢得了天际自主决定未来的权利。因此，每个诺德人都会称赞我们。

original: But I will heed your wishes.
traduit: 不过我会听从你的意愿。

original: Many have fought and died. I'm no different than they are.
traduit: 我们那些在战斗中牺牲的人没有不同。

original: On the contrary, you exceed the rest.
traduit: 恰恰相反，你超过了很多人。

original: But, I will honor your request. The gods know of your victories, and they themselves will glory in your deeds.
traduit: 不过，我会尊重你的要求。诸神知道你的胜利，他们也会为你的作为感到光荣。

original: Maybe you should leave me out of your speech.
traduit: 也许你应该把我排除在演讲之外。

original: Oh, why is that?
traduit: 哦，为什么？

original: Of course, my Lord.
traduit: 当然，大人。

original: Very good. Come, the people await us.
traduit: 非常好。来吧，大家都在等我们。

original: Oh, and Legate. It's been an honor to have you at my side. As a token of my appreciation, I want you to keep my sword.
traduit: 啊，副官。有你在我身边，是我的荣幸。为了表达感激之情，希望你收下我的剑。

original: And now, to deliver a speech.
traduit: 现在，我要发表演讲。

original: Stormblade. I want you to have my sword, a token of my appreciation.
traduit: 风暴之刃。希望你能收下我的剑，以示我的感激之情。

original: Now then. The men will expect a speech. Will you stand by my side? I wish to honor you, Dragonborn and the truest of Stormcloaks.
traduit: 现在。将士们期待一场演讲。你能在我身边吗？我希望为你这位龙裔、最忠实的风暴斗篷增添荣耀。

original: The men will expect a speech. Will you stand by my side? I wish to honor you, Dragonborn and the truest of Stormcloaks.
traduit: 将士们期待一场演讲。你能在我身边吗？我希望为你这位龙裔、最忠实的风暴斗篷增添荣耀。

original: Don't you worry about her. I've sent my best men to round her up.
traduit: 不用担心，我已经派得力部下去围捕她了。

original: Don't you worry about him. I've sent my best men to round him up.
traduit: 不用担心，我已经派得力部下去围捕他了。

original: And Elisif?
traduit: 艾利西弗呢？

original: And Erikur?
traduit: 艾瑞库尔呢？

original: I'll go gather the men in the courtyard.
traduit: 我去把人集合到院子里。

original: Well, I suppose some kind of speech is in order.
traduit: 好吧，我想可能得进行演讲了。

original: Good. It's done.
traduit: 好。完事了。

original: Geh, Sahloknir, kaali mir.
traduit: 嘎，撒洛克尼尔，卡利 米尔。

original: Alduin, thuri! Boaan tiid vokriiha suleyksejun kruziik?
traduit: 奥杜因，苏瑞！博安 提德 沃克瑞哈 苏雷克西昂 克鲁兹克？

original: It's mine. Don't touch it.
traduit: 这是我的。别动。

original: Oh. Well, you should probably go get it before someone steals it.
traduit: 哦。好吧，你还是拿上吧，免得被人偷了。

original: Well... you probably should go collect it before someone else does, shouldn't you?
traduit: 嗯……你应该趁别人没拿之前赶紧带走，对吧？

original: Oh... well. Never mind then.
traduit: 哦……好吧。算了。

original: Well what did you go dropping it for? Got my hopes up for nothin'...
traduit: 那你为什么把它扔了？我是没打什么注意……

original: You dropped it by mistake? Well, if I was you, I'd go grab it now before somebody does.
traduit: 你不小心掉的？

original: Aww. I thought you were done with it.
traduit: 啊。我还以为你不要了呢。

original: Well... fine. I wasn't really gonna do anything with it anyway. Hmph.
traduit: 嗯……好吧。反正我拿来也没什么用。

original: Well, you'd better go pick it up then, before someone snatches it.
traduit: 那你最好捡起来，免得被被人抢走了。

original: Consider it yours.
traduit: 归你了。

original: That's great. I owe you one. Thanks!
traduit: 太好了。我欠你个人情。谢了！

original: Oh, well, um... thank you.
traduit: 哦，好吧，嗯……谢谢。

original: Thanks! I'm going to go put it on right now.
traduit: 谢谢！我现在就去把它穿上。

original: Mighty decent of you.
traduit: 你可真是个大好人。

original: My thanks!
traduit: 谢谢！

original: Well great! Let's see anyone try to hurt me now...
traduit: 太好了！现在看谁还能伤得了我……

original: Best luck I've had all day.
traduit: 我今天运气真是太好了。

original: I'm going to go get it right now and wear it. Many thanks!
traduit: 我现在就拿去穿上。多谢了！

original: Beg pardon. You dropped some armor over there. Don't suppose you'd mind if I... took it?
traduit: 请原谅。你在那边扔了几件护甲。我想你不会介意……我拿走吧？

original: Umm... You dropped a piece armor over there. I was kind of hoping that I could, you know, have it?

original: If you're working on any experiments, please clean up after yourself.
traduit: 做完实验请自己清理干净。

original: Just like anywhere else, it's all about who you know. Lucky for you, you know me.
traduit: 无论到什么地方，结识人很重要。很幸运，你认识了我。

original: I hope I can count on you if I ever need a favor.
traduit: 如果我需要帮忙的话，希望你能帮上我。

original: It's a small group of us here at the College. Favors don't go unremembered. Neither do affronts.
traduit: 我们在学院就是个小组。不能忘记别人的帮助，也不能忘记别人的冒犯。

original: The Arch-Mage triumphant! The College... Skyrim... All of Tamriel owes you a great debt!
traduit: 大法师万岁！学院……天际……泰姆瑞尔所有人都欠你一个大人情！

original: I'm quite pleased that we're back to business as usual.
traduit: 很高兴我们又能恢复正常了。

original: Certainly nothing illicit going on here, Arch-Mage. You can be quite sure of that.
traduit: 这里肯定没有什么不正当的事，大法师。你可以相信这一点。

original: Even with the College's laid-back attitude, there are still some things that are off-limits.
traduit: 尽管学院态度悠然，但有些东西还是禁止的。

original: There are some experiments the College frowns on. If they're aware of them, of course.
traduit: 学院对一些实验是不赞成的。当然，前提是他们看得到。

original: If you ever need something, especially something hard to come by, let me know.
traduit: 你如果需要什么东西，还很难找的话，告诉我一声。

original: I've spent a long time building up a list of contacts for goods from all over Tamriel.
traduit: 我花了很长时间建立了一份从泰姆瑞尔各地进货的联络人名单。

original: I am always available should you need me, Arch-Mage.
traduit: 如果你需要我的话，随时待命，大法师。

original: Like it or not, you are a shining example to future generations of College Mages.
traduit: 不管你喜不喜欢，你都会是未来几代学院法师的光辉榜样。

original: After all that it's been through, the College still stands. In no small part thanks to you!
traduit: 经历这么多，学院仍旧屹立不倒。很大程度要感谢你啊！

original: It's always encouraging to see the younger generations embracing education.
traduit: 看到年轻一代能够接受教育总是能鼓舞我。

original: The College will be here for you, no matter what. We always look after our own.
traduit: 不管发生什么，学院都会陪着你。我们会互帮互助的。

original: Education is never appreciated until after the fact. Young people never understand this.
traduit: 教育只有在实践之后才会被重视。年轻人永远不会明白这一点。

original: Have you, by chance, seen my research notes? I seem to have misplaced them.
traduit: 你有看到我的研究笔记吗？我好像放错地方了。

original: Another day, another opportunity to learn!
traduit: 新的一天，新的学习！

original: What you learn here will last you a lifetime. Several, if you're talented.
traduit: 你在这里学到的东西会使你一辈子受益。如果天赋好的话，几辈子。

original: It's no secret that the College's reputation in Skyrim is... tainted.
traduit: 学院在天际名誉受损已经不是什么秘密了。

original: Please don't do anything to anger the locals. They don't need additional reasons to hate us.
traduit: 请不要做出任何激怒当地民众的举动。他们已经够恨我们的了。

original: It is not the place of the College to become involved in local politics.
traduit: 学院不适合参与到当地的政治里。

original: Someday the College may be fully accepted by the Nords. I hope that my work as Arch-Mage may help.
traduit: 总有一天，学院可能会被诺德人完全接受。希望我身为大法师的工作能对此有所帮助。

original: Please don't bother the Arch-Mage unless it's absolutely necessary.
traduit: 除非有绝对必要，否则请不要打扰大法师。

original: If there are any problems, let me know. It's my job to keep things running smoothly.
traduit: 如果有什么麻烦，请告诉我。我的工作就是为了让一切顺利运作。

original: Day-to-day operations are my responsibility, which means if you become a problem, you get sent to me.
traduit: 维护日常运作就是我的职责，也就是说，如果你有什么问题，交给我处理就好。

original: Mine is not a popular position, but someone needs to keep things running smoothly around here.
traduit: 我的职位不太受欢迎，但总得有人维持这里运转顺利。

original: Like it or not, this College is a direct influence on the public's impressions of magic and those that use it.
traduit: 不管你喜欢与否，学院都直接影响着公众对魔法和使用魔法者的印象。

original: It is up to each of us to present ourselves publicly as maturely as possible, and to remain above petty local squabbles.
traduit: 我们每个人都应该尽可能在公众面前表现得成熟，并远离那些微不足道的地方纠纷。

original: I still can't believe it. You, the Arch-Mage? Never would have guessed it.
traduit: 我还是不敢相信。你，当了大法师？我还真没想过。

original: You know, this is one of a very few places where you can receive a real education in the schools of magic.
traduit: 你知道吗，学院可是为数不多能够接受到真正魔法教育的地方。

original: I think my parents reserved a spot for me here at the College on the day I was born.
traduit: 我在想我父母是不是在我出生时就在学院帮我留好位置了。

original: There's a lot of pressure for me to excel in my studies. I hope I can live up to expectations.
traduit: 想要在研究上取得好成绩让我压力很大。希望我不会辜负大家的期望。

original: Thanks to you, the people of Skyrim will continue to have a place to study magic. Even if most of them resent you for it.
traduit: 多亏有你，天际的人才有了学习魔法的地方。虽然他们中大多数人会因此怨恨你。

original: I never would have suspected that the Eye could be so dangerous. Tolfdir is right, isn't he? Magic really can overwhelm you.
traduit: 我从没想过那个眼球会那么危险。托夫迪尔说得对啊。魔法真的可以征服我们。

original: I've certainly learned more here than I ever expected to.
traduit: 我在这里学的东西比想象中要多。

original: I wonder if the College's reptuation will ever recover from our adventures.
traduit: 不知道我们的冒险能不能帮学院恢复声誉。

original: The College is a bit of an oddity in Skyrim. Magic isn't something that's looked upon fondly here.
traduit: 学院在天际确实有点怪。魔法在这里不受欢迎。

original: Nords don't trust magic, or those that use it. Made it difficult for me growing up.
traduit: 诺德人不信任魔法，也不信任用魔法的人。这样很难让我成长。

original: They won't say much, but most people have very strong opinions about the College and those that study here.
traduit: 他们或许不会说太多，但大多数人对学院和学院成员是有很强烈的看法的。

original: Don't expect the local Nords to take kindly to you once they find out you're from the College.
traduit: 别指望当地的诺德人发现你是学院成员后会对你多友好。

original: J'zargo is pleased, and more than a little jealous, to greet the new Arch-Mage.
traduit: 杰'扎格怀着高兴，另外有点嫉妒的心情，欢迎我们的新任大法师。

original: J'zargo had expected to be named Arch-Mage. But there is still time.
traduit: 杰'扎格本以为自己会被任命为大法师。但没关系，来日方长。

original: Are the Arch-Mage's robes as comfortable as J'zargo believes them to be?
traduit: 大法师的长袍穿起来有杰'扎格想象中舒坦吗？

original: Skyrim couldn't be more different from Elsweyr. But magic... Magic's the same no matter where you go.
traduit: 天际和艾斯维尔完全不同。但是魔法……魔法走到哪儿都一样。

original: J'zargo will go wherever he can to learn more. Oblivion itself, if need be.
traduit: 杰'扎格要去任何能去的地方了解更多。如果有需要的话，湮灭也要去。

original: Khajiit are not known as mages, so J'zargo has much to prove.
traduit: 卡吉特不以法师著称，所以杰'扎格还有很多要证明的东西。

original: J'zargo can learn magic from these men and elves, but they cannot learn to be as dashing as he. J'zargo comes out on top.
traduit: 杰'扎格可以向人类和精灵学习魔法，但他们没有他那么有活力，所以杰'扎格会笑到最后。

original: I think we could blow up half of Eastmarch, and people would still come to us for enchantments.
traduit: 就算咱们炸掉半个东陲领，人们还是会来求我们附魔。

original: The local Nords may not like us very much, but they don't seem to mind having access to enchanted weapons and armor.
traduit: 当地的诺德人是不太喜欢我们，但却又不介意用附魔武器和盔甲。

original: Savos doesn't care for politics. He likes to believe the College is removed from the rest of Skyrim.
traduit: 萨沃斯不关心政治。他觉得应该让学院远离天际的其他地区。

original: If he could, Savos would float the the entire College above Skyrim, for all the Nords to see.
traduit: 如果他能行的话，萨沃斯会让整个学院漂浮在天际之上，让所有诺德人都看看。

original: Greetings, Arch-Mage.
traduit: 您好，大法师。

original: May I help you, Arch-Mage?
traduit: 大法师，有什么需要帮助吗？

original: Dying breed, eh? Well what do you call that then!
traduit: 濒危物种？那你管这叫什么？

original: It's time to face the truth, old friend. You, Vex, Mercer... you're all part of a dying breed. Things are changing!
traduit: 是时候面对现实了，老伙计。你，小烦还有墨瑟……你们都是濒危物种了。世道变了！

original: We've all heard that one before, Bryn! Quit kidding yourself.
traduit: 这话我们都听过了，布林！别再逗自己玩了。

original: I'm telling you, this one is different...
traduit: 我跟你说，这次不一样……

original: Give it up, Brynjolf... those days are over.
traduit: 放弃吧，布林乔夫……那日子已经过去了。

original: When you're ready, I'll keep the rest of your gear safe until you get back.
traduit: 你准备好后，我会帮你保管其他装备等你回来。

original: You'll only have what Malborn smuggled in for you, plus whatever you can pick up inside.
traduit: 你只能用马伯恩帮你偷偷带进去的东西了，再说你还可以在里面捡点儿。

original: Not yet.
traduit: 还没有。

original: You need to meet with him and give him whatever you think you can't live without while you're inside the embassy.
traduit: 你得去见他。把你进入大使馆之后的必需品交给他。

original: The Thalmor are paranoid and thorough. You won't get in the front door with anything but the clothes on your back.
traduit: 梭默可是歇斯底里的。除了身上的衣服，你什么也带不进去。

original: Yes, Malborn's all set.
traduit: 对，马伯恩已经准备妥当了。

original: Good. I have your invitation to the party.
traduit: 好。我给你准备了宴会请柬。

original: But the only way you're going to get past the guards is if they really believe you're an invited guest.
traduit: 你能进去的唯一途径，就是让警卫把你当成真正的客人。

original: Which means you need to look the part, and not be armed to the teeth. Here, put this on.
traduit: 所以你得穿得像个人物，可不能全副武装的。来，把这个穿上。

original: Hold on a minute.
traduit: 稍等一下。

original: This is no time for cold feet. I've put everything in your hands here, not least Malborn's life.
traduit: 现在可不能临阵退缩了。我把一切都交给你了，还有马伯恩的性命。

original: Now do whatever it is you need to do, and let's get going before we miss our chance!
traduit: 要做什么就抓点紧，趁我们还没错过机会，赶紧行动吧。

original: I'm ready. Keep the rest of my things safe for me.
traduit: 我准备好了。帮我保管好我的其他东西。

original: Don't worry, it will all be waiting for you when you get back.
traduit: 别担心。等你回来，一切原物奉还。

original: Just make sure you get back out of there alive with the information we need.
traduit: 带着我们需要的情报，活着出来。

original: I'm ready to go.
traduit: 我已经准备好了。

original: You can't go to a party at the Thalmor Embassy dressed like that.
traduit: 你可不能穿成这样参加梭默大使馆的宴会。

original: Have you given Malborn the gear you want to smuggle into the embassy?
traduit: 你把装备交给马伯恩带进去了吗？

original: Hold on, I need to get a few things ready.
traduit: 等等，我还需要准备些东西。

original: I'll give you a few more minutes. I can't wait here all day. It's my neck on the line, remember.
traduit: 我再等你会儿。但你记着我可不能在这儿等一整天，这可是要命的啊。

original: I'm ready. Here's what I'll need.
traduit: 我准备好了。这是我需要的东西。

original: Okay. I'll get this inside the Embassy for you. I've got to go. I'll find you at the party, don't worry.
traduit: 好。我会帮你带进大使馆的。我得赶紧走了。别担心，宴会上见。

original: Your job is to get into the party without being fingered as a spy. I'll take care of the rest.
traduit: 你的任务就是在不暴露的情况下混进宴会。其他的交给我办。

original: Here's the deal. I can smuggle some equipment into the Embassy for you.
traduit: 你听好。我可以帮你把一些装备偷偷带进大使馆。

original: Don't plan on bringing anything else in with you. The Thalmor take security very seriously.
traduit: 但别打算自己带东西进来。梭默高度看重安全问题。

original: Give me what you can't live without, and I'll make sure to get it into the Embassy. The rest is up to you.
traduit: 把你必要的东西交给我，我保证能把它们带进大使馆。但其他的就得靠你自己了。

original: You ready yet? I need to get back before I'm missed. Remember, you won't have anything except what I smuggle in for you.
traduit: 你准备好了？我得在被发现前赶紧回去。记住，除了我给你带进去的，什么都别带。

original: Our mutual friend sent me.
traduit: 我们共同的朋友让我来的。

original: Really? You're who she picked? I hope she knows what she's doing.
traduit: 真的？你就是她说的人？我真希望她知道自己在干些什么。

original: You should just serve your time. Find an ore vein and start digging.
traduit: 你应该开始服刑了。找个矿脉去挖吧。

original: You're not in here for life, like I am.
traduit: 你不会像我待在这里一辈子的。

original: I left behind my daughter Uaile when I was taken.
traduit: 我被带走的时候留下了我女儿乌哀乐。

original: How old is my daughter now, I wonder? In prison, you lose track of time.
traduit: 我都不知道我女儿现在多大了？在监狱里，连时间都会忘记。

original: I'm just another Forsworn sent to rot here in this mine.
traduit: 我只是被扔在这矿里等死的弃誓者罢了。

original: You need to not bother me.
traduit: 你别来烦我。

original: You're talking to a killer, remember that.
traduit: 你是在跟杀手说话，好好记着。

original: You serve your time by digging. So dig.
traduit: 你要靠挖矿来服刑。所以去挖吧。

original: Prison's not so bad. Less complaints when I kill people.
traduit: 监狱也不赖。至少我杀人的时候会少些抱怨。

original: Cidhna Mine's for prisoner scum only. Keep out.
traduit: 希讷矿场里只有罪犯人渣。离开。

original: I'm in charge of the prisoners here.
traduit: 我负责这里的囚犯。

original: No funny business. I'm watching you.
traduit: 没什么有趣的。我会盯着你的。

original: You do something out of line, I'll put you down.
traduit: 如果你敢做出格的事，我就把你扔下去。

original: Don't reach for a shiv around me, or we'll both regret it.
traduit: 别在我身边拿着刀晃悠，否则我们都会后悔的。

original: What do you want? Have digging to do.
traduit: 你想干什么？还得挖矿呢。

original: Other prisoners get suspicious when we talk to each other, so keep it down.
traduit: 我们说话的时候会让其他犯人起疑心的，小点声。

original: Whenever I get out of here, I'm going to go kill a Nord.
traduit: 等我出去，就杀个诺德人。

original: I was sent here because someone said I was a Forsworn.
traduit: 我被关到这里就因为有人说我是弃誓者。

original: I'm innocent. The Nords framed me. I was nowhere near that murder weapon.
traduit: 我是无辜的。诺德人陷害了我。我当时离凶器很远。

original: I wonder how grandma Bothela is doing. She's probably worried sick about me.
traduit: 我想知道波塞拉奶奶怎么样了。她可能很担心我。

original: What do you want, new blood?
traduit: 想干什么，新人？

original: Jarl decided I was too much of a problem. Threw me in here with the Forsworn.
traduit: 领主觉得我太麻烦了。就把我和弃誓者关在一起了。

original: I got locked up one too many times. Now I'm in for life.
traduit: 我被关了太多次。这回是要终身监禁咯。

original: I swear, if I ever get out of here, I'm giving up thieving. Really.
traduit: 我发誓，只要能出去，我再也不偷了。真的。

original: You mess with the Silver-Blood family, you end up here.
traduit: 敢惹银血家族的话，就得到这儿来了。

original: I catch you stealing anything, I'll break your neck.
traduit: 如果我发现你偷东西，脖子都给你拧断了。

original: Now this is real guard duty. Just throw them in the mine and be done with it.
traduit: 这才是卫兵真正的职责，把他们都扔进矿场，万事大吉。

original: Hurry it up. I've got to get back before I'm missed.
traduit: 快点，我得回去了。免得被人发现。

original: Come on. If someone misses me at the party, we're both dead.
traduit: 快点，要是宴会上有人发现我不见了，咱们都得完蛋。

original: I need to lock the door behind you or the patrols might notice something's wrong.
traduit: 我得把你身后的门锁上。不然巡逻的会察觉到不对劲。

original: Your gear is in that chest. I'll lock the door behind you. Don't screw this up.
traduit: 你的装备在那个箱子里。我去锁门。千万别搞砸了。

original: Of course. Let me see if we have another bottle of that.
traduit: 当然。我看看咱们能不能再来一瓶。

original: I'll be waiting by the door for everyone to be distracted.
traduit: 我会在门口等着大家转移注意力。

original: Tss! Get out of here, I saw nothing.
traduit: 嘁！出去吧，我什么都没看见。

original: Perhaps I should ask the Ambassador...
traduit: 或许我得问问大使……

original: Rules, is it, Tsavani? I didn't realize that eating Moon Sugar was permitted.
traduit: 规矩？萨瓦尼？我不知道咱们这儿还允许吃月亮糖哦。

original: A guest? In the kitchens? You know this is against the rules...
traduit: 客人怎么进厨房了？你不知道这不合规矩吗……

original: A guest, feeling ill. Leave the poor wretch be.
traduit: 是客人，感觉不舒服。放过这可怜人吧。

original: Who comes, Malborn? You know I don't like strange smells in my kitchen.
traduit: 马伯恩，谁来了？你知道我不喜欢厨房有生人味儿的。

original: So far so good. Let's hope nobody saw us slip out.
traduit: 目前一切顺利。但愿没人看见咱们溜出去。

original: We need to pass through the kitchen. Your gear is hidden in the larder.
traduit: 我们得穿过厨房。你的装备在储藏室里。

original: Just stay close and let me do any talking, got it? Follow me.
traduit: 跟紧点，说话的事儿交给我，明白？跟我来

original: Tell me about Alduin's Wall.
traduit: 告诉我关于奥杜因之墙的事。

original: Alduin's Wall was created by the ancient Akaviri Dragonguard, the forerunners of the Blades.
traduit: 奥杜因之墙是由刀锋会的前身，阿卡维尔龙卫建造的。

original: One of the lost secrets of the Blades. Where they recorded all they knew of Alduin and his return. Part history, part prophecy.
traduit: 这是刀锋会众多遗失的秘密之一。记录了他们所知的关于奥杜因及其回归的一切。有历史，也有预言。

original: Its location was lost for centuries, but I know where it is: Sky Haven Temple, an ancient Blades sanctuary, hidden within the crags of the Reach.
traduit: 它的位置曾经遗失了几百年。但我知道它在哪，天佑神殿，隐藏在瑞驰峭壁中的一座古代刀锋会圣殿。

original: We must go, quickly now. Take me to Delphine. We have much to discuss.
traduit: 快，我们必须得走了。带我去找戴尔芬。我们还有很多要讨论的。

original: You're talking about... the literal end of the world?
traduit: 你是在说……真的世界末日？

original: Oh, yes! The prophecies make clear the signs that will precede the end times. One by one, I have seen them fulfilled.
traduit: 啊，没错！我看到预言所说的终结之兆一个接一个实现了。

original: I tried to tell them. They wouldn't listen. Fools. It's all come true... all I could do was watch our doom approach...
traduit: 我试着告诫他们。但没人相信。一群笨蛋。全都成真了……我现在只能眼睁睁看着末日逼近我们。

original: Doom? You mean the return of the dragons?
traduit: 末日？你是指龙族归来吗？

original: Dragons, pah. They can be killed. The Blades killed many in their early days as dragon-slayers.
traduit: 龙算什么。它们能被杀死。想当年刀锋会还是屠龙者的时候，杀过不知多少。

original: No, the dragons are merely the final portent of the End of Days.
traduit: 但是，龙族只是世界末日的最后预兆。

original: You're talking about... the end of the world?
traduit: 你在说……世界末日？

original: That's what everyone keeps telling me.
traduit: 每个人都这么说。

original: Then... there is hope after all. For so long, all I could do was watch our doom approach, helplessly.
traduit: 那就……还有希望。这么久以来，我只能眼睁睁看着末日不断逼近，太无助了。

original: It's a possibility we can't ignore.
traduit: 我们不能忽视这种可能。

original: No! You're wrong. You must be wrong. Laelette may have met her fate out in the marsh.
traduit: 不！你错了。你肯定错了。拉莱特也许是在沼泽出的事。

original: I refuse to believe Alva had anything to do with this. There is no way you can prove it to the Jarl.
traduit: 我不相信阿尔瓦与这事有关。你没法向领主证明。

original: The other one? What do you mean?
traduit: 还有一个人？什么意思？

original: I can't tell you. She might hear me. She's so close.
traduit: 我不能告诉你。她离得很近。可能会听到的。

original: If you can find me first, I can tell you.
traduit: 如果你能先找到我，我就告诉你。

original: Make Laelette go away!
traduit: 让拉莱特走开！

original: On threat of what, exactly? This city wouldn't run without me! Now if you'll excuse me, my work awaits.
traduit: 威胁谁呢？这座城市没了我还有法转吗！失陪了，我还有工作要做。

original: Miss Stentor, watch your tongue in the Jarl's court!
traduit: 斯丹特小姐，领主宫廷之上还请慎言！

original: And? I've seen jarls come and go. This one only became Jarl because her husband died. She'll be replaced in a matter of months.
traduit: 然后呢？我见过的领主换了一茬又一茬。她能当领主还不是因为她丈夫死了。她过几个月就会被取代。

original: Very well. But I suspect her grace will not be pleased.
traduit: 很好。但我猜殿下会不高兴的。

original: Yes, and I'm also aware of how necessary my divinations and wards have been in the city's defense. My experiments are all I ask for in return.
traduit: 是的，但我也知道我的占卜和结界对保卫城市有多么重要。我只要求以我的实验作为回报。

original: Miss Stentor, these are quite expensive. I trust you know how limited the hold's funds are at this time?
traduit: 斯丹特小姐，这些太昂贵了。相信你应该知道现在领地的资金有多有限吧？

original: Steward, I will need the following reagents for my studies. Please see to them.
traduit: 总管，我的研究需要以下试剂。请帮忙找一下。

original: "Fair" is a word rarely applied to politics, my grace. I'm afraid you must learn to accept this.
traduit: “公平”这个词很少用于政治，殿下。恐怕您得学会接受这一点。

original: He uses all of Haafingar's resources, and doesn't answer to me in the slightest? This hardly seems fair.
traduit: 他动用了全海芬加领的资源，却对我毫无应答？这似乎不太公平。

original: I'm afraid he can. His authority comes from the emperor. Who you also serve, technically.
traduit: 恐怕他可以。他的权威授自皇帝。严格意义上，您也在效劳。

original: Again? He can't simply cancel an appointment with the Jarl! He serves in my capital city!
traduit: 又来了？他不能就这么草率地取消和领主的会面！他是在我的首府效劳！

original: I'm afraid he's had to reschedule, my grace. By all accounts, waging war takes his every moment.
traduit: 恐怕他得重新安排时间了，殿下。众所周知，战争占据了他的全部时间。

original: Steward, when is my appointment to meet with General Tullius? There are some issues we must speak about.
traduit: 总管，我什么时候能和图留斯将军会面？我们有些问题需要谈谈。

original: That may well be our only answer. I will empower my Steward to seek out capable individuals to secure Haafingar. Thank you, my Thanes.
traduit: 这可能就是我们的唯一答案了。我会授权让总管去寻找有能力的人来保卫海芬加。谢谢武卫们了。

original: Humph. That's only a problem for people who can't afford to hire their own security.
traduit: 哼。只有那些雇不起保卫的人才会遇到这种事。

original: Trouble on the roads and cities means less commerce. Less commerce means less money and more starving people. And that means more crime.
traduit: 道路和城市的麻烦意味着商业活动减少。商业活动减少就会导致财政紧张和人民饥馑。这会导致更多犯罪的发生。

original: My dear Bryling. Barring any... fancy and folly... the good people of Haafingar are surely capable of dealing with the odd highwayman or stray dog.
traduit: 亲爱的白灵啊。头脑里净剩下……幻想和愚蠢……海芬加的良民肯定能够对付那些古怪的强盗和野狗的。

original: The Stormcloaks are far from the only threat to the hold. The roads are beset by bandits and beasts... and now there's even talk of bloody dragons.
traduit: 风暴斗篷不是领地的唯一威胁。道路上强盗野兽环伺。现在还有人谈论到血腥的巨龙。

original: I don't see any reason why we'd need them. As long as those dogs stay outside of our borders, we're fine.
traduit: 我看不出我们有需要他们理由。只要那些狗东西不越过边界，我们就是安全的。

original: The news is the same as it's been for the rest of the war, your grace. Our borders are secure, but at the cost of the guards for our towns and roads.
traduit: 和其他战争的消息一样，殿下。我们的边境很安全，但代价是牺牲了城镇和道路上的守卫力量。

original: Thane Bryling, what do you have to report about the state of Haafingar's defenses?
traduit: 白灵武卫，你对海芬加领的防御状况有什么要报告的吗？

original: That is quite enough. Perhaps I will raise these issues when I have an audience with General Tullius.
traduit: 够了。也许等我和图留斯将军会面的时候可以提出这些问题。

original: The Stormcloaks only rebel because the Empire uses Skyrim as its personal larder. The more they take, the more support the rebels gain!
traduit: 风暴斗篷之所以叛变，就是因为帝国以天际为私财。他们剽掠越多，叛军获得的支持就越多！

original: My lady... Surely you're not that naive. Such foolishness would only leave us defenseless. The rebels would storm the palace in an afternoon.
traduit: 夫人啊……你没这么天真吧。这种愚蠢的行为只能让我们毫无防备。叛军一个下午就能打进宫殿来。

original: Simple. Let the Empire fight its own war, with its own funds, and without hijacking our supplies and soldiers. Let Haafingar rebuild.
traduit: 很简单。让帝国花自己的钱去打自己的仗，不要裹挟我们的物资和士兵。我们去重建海芬加。

original: And what would my impetuous Thane Bryling suggest, instead?
traduit: 那我冲动的白灵武卫有什么建议吗？

original: Listen to you, speaking of sacrifice. You've never gone hungry a day in your life, Erikur!
traduit: 听听你说的话吧，张口闭口的牺牲。你这辈子就没饿过肚子吧，艾瑞库尔！

original: This is an unfortunate but unavoidable ebb in revenue. But as long as we continue to support the Empire, our sacrifices will be well rewarded.
traduit: 此次收入下降虽然不幸但无可避免。不过只要我们继续支持帝国，牺牲总会有回报的。

original: As you know, Solitude's coffers are much depleted by the war efforts. Thane Erikur, you have a strong head for business. What do you suggest?
traduit: 如你所知，独孤城的钱在战争中消耗殆尽了。艾瑞库尔武卫，你很有商业头脑，有什么建议吗？

original: Hmph. Music tames the most savage beasts. Even Nords.
traduit: 哈。音乐能够驯服最凶猛的野兽。即使是诺德人。

original: You'd better hope the war's over by then. The Stormcloaks would eat you alive!
traduit: 你最好祈祷战争在那之前结束。风暴斗篷会把你活吃了的！

original: Lady Ateia has already arranged for me to perform in the court of the Jarl of Falkreath.
traduit: 阿提亚夫人已经安排我去为佛克瑞斯的领主宫廷表演了。

original: What're you going to do after you graduate? I'm thinking of joining the Legion. I hear they're looking for skalds. Just think. Me - a war bard.
traduit: 你毕业后打算做什么？我在考虑加入军团。我听说他们在招募吟唱者。想想吧。我——战争诗人。

original: Try not to play favorites, Lady Ateia. It does a disservice to the whole class.
traduit: 不要厚此薄彼了，阿提亚夫人。这样对全班都没有好处。

original: Of course not! Complacency is the bane of art. They're in good hands with you, Inge.
traduit: 当然不能！自满乃艺术的祸根。因格，他们被你照顾的不错。

original: I'm sorry to break it to you, Giraud, but students are an unfortunate necessity of a college. Do try to persevere.
traduit: 很抱歉告诉你了，吉劳德，但学生是一个学院必需的。一定要坚持下去。

original: Passably. Aia is my star pupil. None of the others can hold a candle to her. Especially not that wretched llldi.
traduit: 马马虎虎吧。艾雅是我的明星学生。其他的都比不上她，尤其是那个倒霉的厄尔迪。

original: Some of them have a long way to go, but they're mostly passable. Don't let them hear I said that, though!
traduit: 其中一些还有很长的路要走，但大部分都过得去。别让他们听到我说的！

original: Bunch of distractions, if you ask me. They just interrupt the rest of my work.
traduit: 要我说，都是些让人分心的玩意儿。他们只会打断我剩下的工作。

original: Yes, headmaster.
traduit: 是，校长。

original: How are your students coming along?
traduit: 你的学生进展如何？

original: Yes, well, see that you keep at it. That is all.
traduit: 好吧，那你一定要坚持下去。就这样吧。

original: I'll be the judge of that. Now, back to your practice.
traduit: 那得由我来判断。现在，回到你的练习上来。

original: Patience, Illdi. We study the heroes of the past so we can have better understanding of the heroes of today... and tomorrow.
traduit: 耐心点，伊尔迪。我们学习过去的英雄是为了更好的理解今天的英雄……还有未来的。

original: I'm sure it will be fine. Just don't be late.
traduit: 我觉得没事。但是不要迟到。

original: Yes, Lady Ateia. My voice is strong as a Dragonborn's!
traduit: 是的，阿提亚夫人。我的声音就像龙裔一样洪亮！

original: Always! Perfection takes dedication, after all!
traduit: 永远！毕竟完美需要奉献！

original: Yes, madam. I know I have a lot to work on.
traduit: 是的，夫人。我知道自己还有很多事要做。

original: I've converted the classic tale of Eyldi the Bear to be performed with drums. I think you'll be impressed!
traduit: 我要把“熊罴”艾尔迪的经典故事改编成用鼓来演奏。你会感到惊奇的！

original: At this point, I hardly see how your advice would improve it. It's flawless.
traduit: 在这点上，我看不出你的建议能对它有什么改善。它很完美。

original: Oh, thank you! I've been working on an original piece. I hope it can stand up to the classics!
traduit: 哦，谢谢你！我一直在创作原创作品。希望它能经得起经典的考验！

original: Yes sir, Professor Gemane! It's a war epic about Hoag Merkiller's last stand!
traduit: 是的，格玛尼教授！这是关于“精灵杀手”霍格最后一战的战争史诗！

original: Must it be written? Poetry is so dull when it isn't set to music.
traduit: 一定要写出来吗？诗歌不经过音乐配合是很乏味的。

original: Why do we always focus on retelling the old stories? There are so many new stories being made, right now...
traduit: 为什么我们总是注重叙述老旧故事？现在有很多新故事可以创作……

original: You there. Have you performed your voice exercises today?
traduit: 喂。你今天练习发音了吗？

original: Your solo performance is about a week away. I expect to hear your early rendition tomorrow, understand?
traduit: 离你的单独表演还有一周。我希望明天看看你的表演效果，明白吗？

original: Pardon me, but I trust you've been working on your poem, on the classical heroes of Skyrim, yes?
traduit: 抱歉，你一直在写关于天际经典英雄的诗歌，对吧？

original: Kynareth has blessed you with tremendous compassion, Silana. You will find a way, I'm sure of it.
traduit: 凯娜瑞丝以莫大的同情祝福你，西拉娜。我相信你会找到办法的。

original: I know, and I appreciate it dearly. But I can't help but feel we could be doing more...
traduit: 我知道，我很感激。但我还是忍不住觉得我们还有更多可以做的事……

original: We took you in, didn't we? We would be glad to extend our welcome to any other who showed your dedication. What more could we do?
traduit: 我们不是收留了你吗？我们很乐意向其他表现出奉献精神的人表示欢迎。我们还有什么可做的吗？

original: Mistress, the people of Solitude are destitute. Many are starving and desperate for work. We need to be more active, to reach out to them.
traduit: 夫人，独孤城的人民很贫穷，许多人为了谋生忍饥挨饿。我们应该更积极地去接触他们。

original: What could be more important than hearing the prayers of the faithful, and answering the questions of the dedicated?
traduit: 有什么比聆听信徒祷告、回答信徒问题还重要的吗？

original: I know you and father Rorlund have many duties to attend to in the temple, but sometimes I feel that there are more important matters to attend to.
traduit: 我知道你和洛伦德神父在神殿里有很多事，但我有时觉得还有更重要的事要办。

original: Certainly, acolyte. What troubles you?
traduit: 当然，助手。有什么困扰吗？

original: Mistress, a word?
traduit: 夫人，能聊聊吗？

original: I see you have meditated on this subject quite thoroughly. I shall not stop you, but please, try to attend to your temple duties as well.
traduit: 看得出你在这个问题上是经过深思熟虑的。我不会阻止你，但也请你尽力履行好你在神殿的职责。

original: I respectfully disagree, sir. Stendarr and Zenithar may demand strength from them, but Mara and Dibella demand compassion from us.
traduit: 恕难苟同，先生。斯丹达尔和泽尼萨尔或许要求他们自强，但玛拉和迪贝拉也教导我们慈悲。

original: Your compassion is admirable, but you see, we cannot help them all. The poor must learn from the examples of the gods and raise themselves up.
traduit: 你的同情心令人钦佩，但你要知道，我们不能帮助他们所有人。穷人必须向众神学习，让自己振作起来。

original: Oh, yes sir. I feel many of Solitude's families are having trouble getting by, and the wealthy do nothing to help them!
traduit: 是的，先生。我觉得独孤城有许多家庭生活艰难，但富人却不愿伸出援手！

original: Silana, you don't seem yourself. Is something the matter?
traduit: 西拉娜，你好像不太对劲啊。出什么事了？

original: Ah, that must be it. So many of the men are serving in battle. I shall pray to Stendarr that they return victorious.
traduit: 啊，一定是因为男人大多都上战场了。我会向斯丹达尔祈祷，愿他们胜利归来。

original: Nonsense, dear. I've had more visitors than ever seeking the wisdom of the hearth goddesses.
traduit: 胡说什么呢，亲爱的。我这边来的人比以前还多，都是来寻求炉灶女神智慧的。

original: I fear attendance is down. There are so few worshippers coming to see us. Could it be that the war has weakened their faith?
traduit: 信徒出勤情况好像不好，来找我们做礼拜的人很少。难道是战争削弱了他们的信仰吗？

original: What troubles you, darling?
traduit: 有什么烦心事吗，亲爱的？

original: A word, my love?
traduit: 能说句话吗，宝贝？

original: Sure, whatever.
traduit: 好吧，随便吧。

original: I'm on my feet all day. Can you please do this one thing for me?
traduit: 我整天都在忙。你能帮我做件事吗？

original: Maybe. I'll see if I feel like it.
traduit: 也许吧。看我心情。

original: Father, could you clean up the house a little while I'm away?
traduit: 父亲，我不在的时候你能把屋子打扫一下吗？

original: I suppose. But Svari, we don't steal. We're better than that. Understand?
traduit: 我同意。但是斯瓦瑞，我们不能偷东西。不能自甘堕落。明白吗？

original: I'll talk with Jala, dear. I'm sure she'll accept a potato as repayment.
traduit: 我去跟加拉谈谈，亲爱的。到时候赔她一颗土豆好了。

original: Just a little one! I was hungry!
traduit: 只是一小个！我饿了！

original: Svari, Jala said you stole an apple from her cart yesterday. Is this true?
traduit: 斯瓦瑞，加拉说你昨天从她车上偷了个苹果。是吗？

original: Humph. Some daughter you are.
traduit: 哼。你可真是个好女儿。

original: I barely make enough for us to eat as it is, father. You can't just drink it all away.
traduit: 我挣的钱只够咱们吃饭，父亲。你不能总是喝酒了。

original: Well, did you bring back any mead?
traduit: 嗯，那你带蜂蜜酒回来了吗？

original: At the market, father.
traduit: 在市场上，父亲。

original: Where've you been all day?
traduit: 你一整天都去哪儿了？

original: We'll make it, Greta. We always have so far...
traduit: 我们会的，格瑞塔。我们一直都有……

original: Maybe we'll have better luck tomorrow.
traduit: 也许我们明天运气会好一些。

original: Eat up, Svari.
traduit: 赶紧吃，斯瓦瑞。

original: Fish? Again?
traduit: 又是鱼啊？

original: Potatoes? Again?
traduit: 又是土豆啊？

original: It's all we've got for today. Don't be greedy.
traduit: 这就是我们今天的饭了。别贪吃。

original: As always, lord, your loyalty is a shining example to us all.
traduit: 一如既往啊，大人，您的忠诚是我们所有人的光辉榜样。

original: Right you are, elf! Or even from the rebels, if they've got enough money to make a competitive offer.
traduit: 你说得对，精灵！如果有足够的钱来开价，卖给叛军也未尝不可。

original: Even a fine weapon is only as good as its wielder, sir. But they should fetch a high price from the Imperial army.
traduit: 即使是好武器，也要看使用者的优劣，阁下。但是它们能从帝国军队那里卖个好价钱。

original: Scary, thinking of those boots with an army of Elven weapons at their command. Let's be thankful they're half a world away, eh?
traduit: 想想穿着那些靴子、拿着这些精灵武器的军队就觉得可怕。谢天谢地，他们在世界的另一端，是吧？

original: Indeed I have, sir. Elven weapons for their armies, sir. Elven material, but poor workmanship, like most of what we get from them.
traduit: 确实，阁下。是精灵军队使用的武器。用的是精灵材质，但做工很差，就像我们从他们那里得到的大多数武器一样。

original: Melaran, you lazy milk drinker, have you finished studying the imports from Black Marsh?
traduit: 梅拉然，你这个懒虫，研究完黑沼泽进口的东西了吗？

original: Of course they do, brother. You keep raising their rent.
traduit: 当然了，哥。你一直在涨他们的房租。

original: I swear, those scheming elves charge us twice what anyone else would pay.
traduit: 我发誓那些狡猾的精灵收我们的钱是别人的两倍。

original: I can commission one from the Radiant Raiment. It won't be cheap, but if you want the best, they're the only choice.
traduit: 我可以去锦衣服饰店给你再买一身。虽然不便宜，但是如果你想要最好的，她们那儿就是唯一的选择了。

original: That clumsy maid at the palace spilled wine on my best suit. Sister, I believe it's time for a replacement.
traduit: 宫里那个笨手笨脚的女仆把酒洒到我最好的衣服上了。妹妹，我看是时候换一件了。

original: Fair or not, they'll pay it, and that's all I need to care about. Bear that in mind, sister.
traduit: 不管公平与否，他们都会付钱，这才是我们需要关心的。好好记住，妹妹。

original: Yes, brother. I'm sure they'll agree it's a fair price to pay in order to avoid interacting with you on a daily basis.
traduit: 是的，哥哥。我相信他们会同意的。为了避免每天和你打交道，这个价格可以接受。

original: I'm afraid "acceptable" just isn't acceptable anymore. I'm sure they can spare a few more coins in monthly rent.
traduit: 恐怕“可接受”已经变得不可接受了。我相信他们每个月还能再多出几个硬币付租子。

original: Profits continue to rise. The warehouse continues to bring in good revenues, and rent on your stores in the Well is acceptable.
traduit: 利润持续上升。仓库还在继续带来不错的收入，你在井边的商店情况也是可接受的。

original: Sister, how is my fortune coming along?
traduit: 妹妹，我的财富运转如何？

original: One more reason to pray for the fighting to end then, my love.
traduit: 又多了一个祈祷战争结束的理由，亲爱的。

original: You're right, of course. But when this war is over, I'll gladly resign and we can stop sneaking around like this.
traduit: 你说的当然没错。但等这场战争结束了，我很乐意辞职，这样我们就可以不必偷偷摸摸的了。

original: I'm serious. If Erikur knew about us, he'd force you to resign from your position. And without you, he'd have the Jarl bent around his little finger.
traduit: 我是认真的。如果艾瑞库尔知道了我们的事，他会强迫你辞职的。没了你，领主就在他手掌心里了。

original: I'm serious. If Erikur knew about us, he'd force you to resign from your position. And without you helping the Jarl, Solitude would be weaker.
traduit: 我是认真的。如果艾瑞库尔知道了我们的事，他会强迫你辞职的。没有你辅佐领主，独孤城会更加脆弱。

original: I know, my lady. I just needed to see you outside of court, away from all of the politics.
traduit: 我知道，亲爱的。我只是想在宫廷外见你，远离所有的政治。

original: Falk, you shouldn't have come. You know what'd happen if people found out about us.
traduit: 佛可，你不该来的。你知道如果别人发现我们的事会怎么样。

original: I told you you wouldn't like the news.
traduit: 我说过你不会喜欢听的。

original: I'm not just talking about my subjects. I'm talking about my people: the proud Nords of Skyrim.
traduit: 我说的不只是我下辖的人民。我说的“我的人民”，是全天际自豪的诺德人。

original: Possession of the holds change on an almost daily basis, but I can report that Haafingar is still secure. Your people are safe.
traduit: 对各领的占有几乎每天都在变化，但我可以说海芬加还是安全的。你的人民也是安全的。

original: I'm well aware that I won't like it. But it's my duty to keep my people safe. Tell me.
traduit: 我很清楚不会喜欢。但我有责任保护我的人民。告诉我吧。

original: You won't like it, my lady.
traduit: 你不会喜欢的，夫人。

original: What news have you heard from the war, Irnskar?
traduit: 你听到什么战争的消息了吗，艾恩斯卡？

original: She does, my lady. But apparently, she hates you just a little less than the others.
traduit: 是的，夫人。但显然，她只是讨厌你比讨厌其他人稍微少一点点。

original: That was suspiciously nice of her. I thought she hated everyone.
traduit: 她真是太好了。我一直以为她讨厌所有人。

original: Madame Endarie insisted. She made it free of charge, in honor of your lenience about last month's rent discrepancies.
traduit: 恩达蕊夫人坚持要免费提供，以此感谢您对上个月租金不符的宽容。

original: Really? How did we afford that? Besides, I like the gown I already have.
traduit: 真的？我们怎么负担得起？另外，我很喜欢现在这身。

original: My lady, I'm pleased to inform you that you have a new gown for court, specially tailored by madame Endarie.
traduit: 夫人，很高兴地告诉您，您有一件新的宫廷礼服，是恩达蕊夫人特制的。

original: Shoo! Go away! You get nothing from me.
traduit: 嘘！走开！你在我这儿什么也得不到。

original: You bother me again, maybe you will not walk away. Understand?
traduit: 你再来烦我，就走不开了。明白吗？

original: Sorry, I have everyone I need at the warehouse. Times are tight.
traduit: 抱歉，我需要的人都在仓库了。时间很紧。

original: Got any work?
traduit: 有工作吗？

original: I ain't begging. I just need a job. Anything.
traduit: 我不是乞丐。我需要的是工作。任何东西都行。

original: Patience, sister. Patience.
traduit: 耐心点，姐妹，耐心。

original: Why should we settle for half a fin when we could just take the whole whale?
traduit: 当我们能捕捞到整条鲸鱼的时候，干嘛还要满足于拿走半条鳍呢？

original: I know of a ship coming in from Hammerfell. Some cargo might get "lost"...
traduit: 我知道有艘船要从落锤来。有些货物可能会“丢失”……

original: My contact, she says Hammerfell steel is much desired by certain parties.
traduit: 我的联络人说落锤钢铁很受某些团体的青睐。

original: Yeah, we'll get the valuables out of there, no problem!
traduit: 是，我们会把贵重物品拿出来的，没问题！

original: Oh, we'll make sure it's emptied out by morning. You can trust us!
traduit: 哦，我们会在早上之前把它清空。放心吧！

original: Big shipment coming in later tonight. I need you three working late.
traduit: 今天晚些时候会有大批货进来。我要你们三个加班。

original: They aren't my "people." I'm with the Empire because they pay me. And that means I'm out here, and you're in there. So shut up, scum!
traduit: 他们不是我的“族人”。我和帝国站在一起是因为他们付钱给我。也就是说，我在外面，你在里面。闭嘴吧，人渣！

original: So it's okay if your people rebel against the Empire, but not mine?
traduit: 所以你们族人可以反抗帝国，我们就不行吗？

original: I said shut up, scum!
traduit: 我说了闭嘴，人渣！

original: I mean, the Redguards fought off the Aldmeri and the Empire, and now Hammerfell is an independent state. That's all we Nords want for Skyrim!
traduit: 我是说，红卫人击退了先祖神洲和帝国，现在落锤独立了。这就是我们诺德人对天际的愿望！

original: Shut up, scum.
traduit: 闭嘴，人渣。

original: Hey, jailor! What I don't understand is why you're siding with the Imperials.
traduit: 嘿，狱卒！我不明白你为什么要和帝国人站在一边。

original: Come now. You'll want to show up in Sovngarde refreshed. You got an eternity of merrimakin' ahead of you.
traduit: 来吧。你最好神清气爽地到松加德报到。你还有很长的路要走呢。

original: Guess the headsman's been busy with all your friends. Ha ha ha ha ha!
traduit: 看来刽子手一直在忙着对付你的朋友。哈哈哈哈哈哈！

original: Yeah, you said that yesterday.
traduit: 是啊，你昨天也是这么说的。

original: Rest up, scum. Probably getting executed tomorrow.
traduit: 休息吧，人渣。你明天可能就要被处决了。

original: Understood, sir.
traduit: 理解了，长官。

original: That is correct. Those orders have been delivered by special courier. I can't trust some of our normal distribution channels.
traduit: 这是正确的。那些命令已经有专人递送。我不能相信一些正常的派送渠道。

original: Sir, these are missing commands for about half of the commanders.
traduit: 长官，半数指挥官的命令不见了。

original: New orders for the soldiers, Legate. Make sure they're distributed as noted.
traduit: 给士兵们新的命令，副官。确保按说明分发下去。

original: Don't you think I know that? But these commands come straight from Cyrodiil.
traduit: 你以为我不知道吗？但这是来自希罗帝尔的命令。

original: We must maintain order and put the rebellious Jarls in their place, before we have a full scale war on our hands.
traduit: 我们必须在陷入全面战争前维持秩序，并把叛乱的领主们摆平。

original: Sir, this is costing lives of both imperial loyalists and Skyrim citizens alike. And it's winning the rebels support where they had none before.
traduit: 总管，这是在牺牲帝国忠诚者和天际公民的生命。还让叛军在以前不支持他们的地方获得了支持。

original: Your concerns are duly noted, Legate, but unfounded. I assure you, this war will be over in another six months.
traduit: 我知道你的担忧，副官，但这毫无根据。我向你保证，这场战争再过六个月就会结束。

original: Sir, we can't just keep trading blows with the rebels like this - it's only strengthening their resolve.
traduit: 长官，我们不能就这样继续打击叛军，这样只会加强他们的决心。

original: In that case, I'm pretty sure it tried to buy me a drink last night.
traduit: 那样的话，我敢肯定它昨晚想请我喝酒。

original: It's the root that looks like an ugly little man.
traduit: 它的根长得像个丑陋的小男人。

original: Which one is that again?
traduit: 是哪个来着？

original: Vivienne, could you check out supplies of mandrake root?
traduit: 薇薇安，你能去查查曼德拉草根茎的供应情况吗？

original: Good. And while you're at it, perhaps you should sew your mouth shut when our fine customers are within earshot, hrm?
traduit: 很好。另外当你这么做的时候，也许你应该在我们的好顾客能听到的时候把嘴闭上，嗯？

original: Oh certainly, dear sister. We couldn't afford to have our customers look like the simple pigs they are, now could we?
traduit: 哦，当然可以，亲爱的姐姐。我们不能让我们的顾客看上去像猪一样，对吗？

original: Sister dear, could you try sewing those sleeves a little tighter? We can't have our customers looking sloppy because of your work.
traduit: 亲爱的妹妹，你能不能把袖子缝紧一点啊？我们不能让客户因为你的活计显得邋遢。

original: You'd make a better Imperial ranger than me. I may have charmed the locals, but my fellow soldiers hated my waggling tongue.
traduit: 你比我更适合当帝国巡逻兵。虽然当地人更喜欢我，但战友们讨厌我油嘴滑舌。

original: Wish I could learn some of that charm. I'm just good with bows, not people.
traduit: 真希望我也能学学你的魅力。我虽然擅长做弓，但是不会和人相处。

original: The same place I learned my charm and quick wits: I used to be an Imperial ranger, my boy!
traduit: 也是我学会自己魅力与机敏的地方，我以前是帝国的巡逻兵，孩子！

original: Fihada, where did you learn how to make bows so well?
traduit: 费哈达，你从哪里学的这么好的做弓技术？

original: Slow's the only way to do it! Work too hard and you'll warp the wood.
traduit: 慢慢来是唯一的办法！操之过急会使木头变形。

original: Slow, but looking good, sir.
traduit: 很慢，但看起来不错，先生。

original: How's it coming there, Jawanan?
traduit: 怎么样了，加瓦南？

original: Give him time. In a couple years, he'll be the age you were when you started!
traduit: 给他时间。再过几年，他就和你刚来的时候一样大了！

original: Right you are! Guess I'll keep training you... for now.
traduit: 你说得对！看来我现在……得继续训练你。

original: Yeah, but can he hammer the anvil for 8 hours straight?
traduit: 是啊，但他能连续锤铁砧八个小时吗？

original: Sure, but I bet he can't hold his mead as well as me!
traduit: 当然，但我打赌他喝蜜酒不如我！

original: Come on, Heimvar. My son could stoke the forge better than you do!
traduit: 快点，黑姆瓦。我儿子给锻炉添柴都比你快。

original: You're making progress, Heimvar. But my boy could still work the bellows better than you do!
traduit: 你有进步了，黑姆瓦。但我儿子吹风箱还是比你好！

original: It's okay, dear. More work than ever down at the blacksmith.
traduit: 没关系，亲爱的。铁匠铺那里的生意比以往任何时候都要多。

original: We'll make it through, dear. We always do.
traduit: 我们会挺过去的，亲爱的。我们总是这样。

original: Who needs customers and their old junk?
traduit: 谁会需要顾客和他们的旧破烂呢？

original: Father oughtta punch them in the mouth! That'd get people in here!
traduit: 父亲把他们打得满地找牙！这样才会有人气！

original: Not that I mind the break, of course. But, still...
traduit: 当然，我不介意休息一下。但是……

original: I suppose in wartime, people aren't looking to part with their old junk...
traduit: 我想战争年代，人们不愿意扔掉旧东西吧……

original: Sure has been quiet around the shop lately.
traduit: 商店最近很安静啊。

original: We hardly ever get new customers anymore.
traduit: 我们都没什么新客户了。

original: I'm sorry...
traduit: 我很抱歉……

original: We barely have enough for ourselves...
traduit: 我们的钱只够自己吃……

original: Here, it's all I can spare...
traduit: 给，我就剩这些了……

original: Alms? Alms for a veteran?
traduit: 能给些施舍吗？帮老兵一把吧？

original: Spare a bite for a poor old veteran?
traduit: 能给可怜的老兵施舍些吗？

original: Please, ma'am, I've got nowhere to go...
traduit: 拜托了，夫人，我无家可归了……

original: I lost my eye defending the Empire... Spare some grub for a veteran?
traduit: 我为了保卫帝国丢了眼睛……给老兵点吃的吧？

original: You look thirsty.
traduit: 你渴了吧。

original: Of course! I would do anything for you, my one and truest friend! What do you need from me?
traduit: 当然！你是我唯一信得过的朋友，我愿意帮你做任何事！你想要我做什么？

original: There's something you could do for me.
traduit: 你能帮我个忙。

original: Ah, the one generous soul amongst a gathering of pinch-pennies and lick-spittles!
traduit: 啊，真是个被吝啬鬼和贪心佬包围的慷慨灵魂！

original: If there's anything I can ever do for you, do not hesitate to call upon me!
traduit: 要是需要帮忙，尽管来找我！

original: Here, I brought you a drink.
traduit: 来，我给你拿了杯酒。

original: Ah, the nectar of the gods! If there's ever anything I can do for you, just name it!
traduit: 啊，玉液琼浆！要是需要帮忙，尽管提！

original: My friend, you are very perceptive! I have a powerful thirst that cannot be slaked!
traduit: 朋友，你好眼力！我确实忍不住要喝一杯了。

original: And none of the waiters will bring me a drink. Elenwen must have told them to cut me off, the frigid bitch.
traduit: 连个给我端酒的侍者都没有。爱琳温这个冷漠的臭婊子肯定嘱咐他们把我晾在这儿了。

original: Afraid I'll cause another scene, I suppose...
traduit: 可能是怕我又酒后闹事儿吧……

original: Indeed. Being a drunken boor is thirsty work. And I can't seem to find my way back to the bar...
traduit: 确实。做个醉鬼乡巴佬是个口渴的活儿。我都找不到回酒馆的路了……

original: She's your daughter. Don't you care?
traduit: 她是你女儿。你不关心吗？

original: I have Alva to take care of now. I don't need Helgi anymore.
traduit: 我现在要照顾阿尔瓦。我不再需要海尔吉了。

original: I saw Helgi's ghost in the ruins of your house.
traduit: 我在你房子的废墟中看到了海尔吉的鬼魂。

original: Really? How nice.
traduit: 真的吗？非常好。

original: She said goodbye to Alva, but not to her own husband?
traduit: 她没向自己丈夫告别，却去找了阿尔瓦？

original: He was cruel to her. He would beat her every night.
traduit: 他对她很残忍。每晚都打她。

original: It's no wonder she fled in the middle of the night.
traduit: 难怪她会半夜里逃走。

original: Thonnir says Alva was the last person to see Laelette... alive.
traduit: 索尼尔说阿尔瓦是最后一个见过拉莱特的人，在她生前的时候……

original: She came by so Alva could kiss her goodbye.
traduit: 她是来和阿尔瓦吻别的。

original: Then she left to join the Stormcloaks.
traduit: 然后她就去加入风暴斗篷了。

original: What about your wife and child?
traduit: 你的妻儿呢？

original: Yeah, that was a shame.
traduit: 是啊，真可惜。

original: But now Alva takes care of me. And I take care of her.
traduit: 但现在我和阿尔瓦彼此相爱，互相照顾。

original: I heard your home burned down.
traduit: 我听说你家被烧毁了。

original: That's true, but I'm in a new house now. A better house.
traduit: 使得，但我现在有新房子了。更好的房子。

original: Let me know if you find out anything about the fire.
traduit: 火灾有什么新发现就来告诉我。

original: Hroggar's fate is in your hands.
traduit: 赫鲁加的命运在你手里了。

original: I hope Alva is not what you think.
traduit: 希望阿尔瓦不是你想的那样。

original: You mentioned Nivenor.
traduit: 你提到了尼维诺尔。

original: Nivenor is my wife. How I was ever able to meet such a gorgeous creature is one of life's mysteries.
traduit: 尼维诺尔是我妻子。我如何才能遇到如此美丽的人，真是人生的谜题。

original: We're... at odds about my charity. She thinks the people in this town have become lazy and expecting a handout.
traduit: 我们……在我的慈善事业上有分歧。她认为这个镇上的人会变得懒惰并期待施舍。

original: I try to include her in my lessons from Maramal over at the Temple of Mara, but she prefers to shop instead. Different strokes, eh?
traduit: 我试着让她和我参加玛拉莫在玛拉神殿的课程，可她更喜欢购物。人各有好对吧？

original: Are you a fisherman?
traduit: 你是渔民吗？

original: Only the best in all of Riften! I own Riften Fishery.
traduit: 全裂谷城最好的！我是裂谷渔场的老板。

original: Started out with a single fishing pole and now I have an entire building and two boats to my name. Not bad for a middle-aged Nord, eh?
traduit: 一开始只有一根钓竿，现在我有了一栋楼和两艘船。对一个中年诺德人来说还不错吧？

original: Too bad I haven't had the same success helping this city shed its poverty. Nivenor thinks I'm wasting my time trying, but I disagree.
traduit: 可惜我没能在帮助城市摆脱贫困方面取得同样的成功。尼维诺尔觉得我这么做是在浪费时间，但我不同意。

original: Glad you're so happy.
traduit: 很高兴你这么开心。

original: Sure am! I thank my lucky stars every time I look to the night sky that Maven took me in and gave me this opportunity.
traduit: 当然！每次仰望夜空，我都要感谢我的幸运星，是玛雯收留了我，给了我这个机会。

original: Okay, look. If I'm caught saying anything bad about the meadery or the family, I'm a dead man.
traduit: 好了，听着。如果我说了任何关于蜜酒庄和家族的坏话被听到，我就死定了。

original: I'm the fourth person to work the tasting counter in the last year. The last three are at the bottom of Lake Honrich.
traduit: 我是去年第四个在品酒台工作的人。前三个都在霍利奇湖底。

original: Just take my advice and just get out of Riften as soon as you can.
traduit: 听我一句劝，赶紧离开裂谷城吧。

original: Here, now tell me the truth. (<BribeCost> gold)
traduit: 来，跟我说实话吧。（<BribeCost>金币）

original: It's going to take a lot more than that.
traduit: 这远远不够。

original: Come on, get the truth off your chest. (Persuade)
traduit: 来吧，把心里话说出来吧。（说服）

original: That is the truth, my friend! Maven is a saint and don't let anyone tell you otherwise.
traduit: 这就是实话，朋友！玛雯是个圣人，不要信任何人告诉你的反对意见。

original: Tell me about Maven Black-Briar.
traduit: 跟我说说玛雯·黑棘。

original: She's an absolute pleasure to work for! In fact, I almost feel guilty accepting pay from her.
traduit: 为她工作真是太好了！事实上，我连接受她的报酬都感觉愧疚。

original: Why, just this last week I was commenting to my fellow meadery workers just how lucky we are to be working for such a charitable family.
traduit: 就在上周，我还跟蜜酒庄的同事们说，我们能为这样一个仁慈的家族工作是多么幸运。

original: There are worse things than being fired.
traduit: 还有比被炒更糟糕的事么。

original: Yeah... fired. Sure. That's what I meant.
traduit: 是……被炒。没错。字面意义的被炒。

original: That sounded rehearsed.
traduit: 听起来像是背词儿。

original: Damn it! Sorry. I'm not very good at this.
traduit: 该死！抱歉，我不太擅长这个。

original: Look, just don't say anything to Maven, will you? I've spent weeks trying to get that right and if she sees how stupid I am, she'll get rid of me.
traduit: 听着，别跟玛雯提，好吗？我花了几个星期才背下来，要是让她觉得我蠢，她会把我开销了的。

original: What makes Black-Briar Mead so special?
traduit: 黑棘蜜酒为什么这么特别？

original: Lady Maven's been developing the secret recipe for Black-Briar Mead over the last several decades.
traduit: 玛雯夫人在过去几十年里一直在研究黑棘蜜酒的秘方。

original: She uses a very secret blend of spices, fresh honey from Goldenglow Estate and specially constructed aging casks to ensure the best flavor.
traduit: 她使用了一种很秘密的香料混合，来自金色光辉庄园的新鲜蜂蜜和特殊构造的陈年木桶，确保酿出最好的味道。

original: Even when you get to the last sip in your flagon, it'll taste just as good as the first!
traduit: 即使你喝到酒壶里的最后一口，它的味道还是和第一口一样好！

original: You're involved with the meadery?
traduit: 你和蜜酒庄有关系？

original: Yes, actually. I'm partnered with Maven Black-Briar. I put up a chunk of the gold she needed to get the place off the ground.
traduit: 没错。我是玛雯·黑棘的合伙人。我给了她一大笔钱，让她把酒庄运转起来。

original: We've been staggeringly successful so far. In fact, I'm almost surprised how quickly she's generated business for us.
traduit: 到目前为止，我们取得了惊人的成功。事实上，她能这么快给我们带来生意，我都有些意外。

original: My name may not be on the label, but some of my blood, sweat and tears are in every drop. Uh, figuratively of course.
traduit: 虽然酒的标签上没有我的名字，但每一滴酒里都流淌着我的血泪汗。啊，只是打个比方了。

original: Are you at odds with them?
traduit: 你和他们有矛盾吗？

original: Don't mistake my political beliefs as a substitute for my family values. They're still my parents, and I love them dearly.
traduit: 不要误以为我的政治信仰会替代我的家庭观念。他们还是我的父母，我非常爱他们。

original: I just think they've let my sister's death skew their outlook on Ulfric and what he really brings to the table with this war.
traduit: 我只是觉得我妹妹的死影响了他们对乌弗瑞克的看法还有他在这场战争中的真正作用。

original: I'm not so certain that Ulfric's intentions are as noble as they think. I think Ulfric cares about Ulfric and the rest is a smokescreen.
traduit: 我不确定乌弗瑞克的意图是否和他们想的那样高尚。我觉得乌弗瑞克只在乎乌弗瑞克，其他都是障眼法。

original: I'd... appreciate if you kept my opinion between us. The last thing I want to do is have my parents "lose" another child.
traduit: 我……希望你能对我的意见保密。我最不想的就是让我父母“失去”他们另一个孩子。

original: Can you tell me about the wedding ring?
traduit: 能跟我说说婚戒的事吗？

original: Every Argonian wedding proposal band is supposed to have three flawless amethysts as part of their design.
traduit: 每个阿尔贡的结婚戒指都要有三颗无瑕的紫水晶作为设计的一部分。

original: Two of the gems, the ones on the outside, represent the couple to be married... one for the husband, one for the wife.
traduit: 其中两颗宝石在外，代表即将结婚的夫妇……一个是丈夫，一个是妻子。

original: The amethyst in the center represents The Hist, the entity that all Argonians consider a sacred part of our lives.
traduit: 中间的紫水晶代表希斯特，所有阿尔贡都认为它是我们生命中神圣的一部分。

original: I... I... I don't know what to say. Such kindness is unheard of in these times.
traduit: 我……我……不知道该说什么好了。这样的善举在当今真是罕见。

original: Here. I want you to accept this as payment for your sacrifice and I... well, we both thank you.
traduit: 给。请接受这些作为你付出的回报，我……我们都很感谢你。

original: I've found those amethysts for you.
traduit: 我帮你找到紫水晶了。

original: I have them right here.
traduit: 我这里就有。

original: Can't help you there.
traduit: 对此我无能为力了。

original: I understand. Hopefully I'll be able to save my meager earnings up to buy them one day.
traduit: 我理解。希望有一天我微薄的收入能够存出买它们的钱。

original: I could find those for you.
traduit: 我可以帮你找到。

original: I was hoping you'd offer. I didn't think it was my place to ask such a favor of you. I thank you.
traduit: 我还以为你需要什么回报。我没想到你会帮我这个忙。感谢你。

original: You mentioned you served special drinks?
traduit: 你说你们这儿有特殊的饮料？

original: Three in fact. They're my own recipe. Brought them over here from my days as a bartender in Gideon.
traduit: 有三种。这是我自己的配方。是我在吉迪昂当酒保的时候带过来的。

original: First is the "Velvet Lechance" which is a mixture of blackberry, honey, spiced wine and a touch of nightshade... perfectly safe, I assure you.
traduit: 第一种是“天鹅绒乐长思”，混合了黑莓、蜂蜜、香料酒和一点夜影花……但绝对安全，我可以保证。

original: Second, we have the "White-Gold Tower" which is heavy cream with a layer of blended mead, lavender and dragon's tongue on top.
traduit: 第二种，“白金塔”，混合蜜酒、薰衣草和龙舌花，再盖上一层重奶油。

original: Last, and only for the bravest of souls, we have the "Cliff Racer" which is Firebrand Wine, Cyrodiilic Brandy, Flin and Sujamma.
traduit: 最后一种，只有最勇敢的灵魂才敢尝试的“峭壁行者”，配料里有火牌葡萄酒、希罗帝尔白兰地、飞令和苏贾玛。

original: I need you to cause a scene. Get everyone's attention for a few minutes.
traduit: 我需要你引起点轰动，吸引大家注意力几分钟。

original: Is that all? My friend, you've come to the right person. You could say that causing a scene is somewhat of a specialty of mine.
traduit: 就这？朋友，你算找对人了。跟你说，惹事儿就是我的专长。

original: Stand back and behold my handiwork.
traduit: 往后站，看我表演了。

original: Actually, there is something you could do for me.
traduit: 你确实可以帮我个忙。

original: Wonderful! I can begin to repay your generosity immediately. Say on, friend.
traduit: 好极了！能立刻报答你的慷慨了。说吧朋友。

original: Thanks. I'll let you know if I need anything.
traduit: 谢谢。如果我需要什么，一定告诉你。

original: Your wish is my command! As long as it doesn't involve much physical activity. I seem to be having trouble staying on my feet at the moment.
traduit: 如你所愿！只要不是什么体力活就行。我现在有点站不起来了。

original: What is this madness? Rexus, help me!
traduit: 这是发什么疯？雷萨斯，救我！

original: Wait! That's not how this is supposed to work!
traduit: 等等！不该是这样的！

original: What are you doing? I thought we were friends!
traduit: 你在干什么？我们不是朋友吗？

original: What do you expect to find? My juggling balls? He he.
traduit: 你在找什么呢？我的杂耍球吗？呵呵。

original: Hey, that's my lint! Ha, Cicero is just joking. You can have it.
traduit: 嘿，那是我的麻布！哈，西塞罗开玩笑呢。拿去吧。

original: If I had anything worth giving, I'd have offered it already.
traduit: 如果我有什么值得拿出手的，我早就给你了。

original: Anything good in there?
traduit: 有什么好东西吗？

original: See if they have any cheese. I'm getting a bit... peckish.
traduit: 看看他们有没有带奶酪。我有点……饿了。

original: You're putting your hand... in my pocket? Have you gone complete cracked?
traduit: 你的手怎么……放我口袋里了？你疯了吗？

original: I've hardly anything worth pickpocketing...
traduit: 我可没什么好偷的东西。

original: This how you get your thrills? Feeling up an old man?
traduit: 你还有这爱好？对老头子干这种事？

original: I haven't been touched like that since I visited a certain brothel in the city of Sentinel...
traduit: 自从我逛完哨卫城的某家妓院之后，就没人这么碰过我了……

original: It would seem you're not the accomplished pickpocket you think you are...
traduit: 看来你的扒包功夫没自己想得那么到家啊……

original: What do you hope to find? Sweets and my dolly? Or maybe some of my spare Nightshade?
traduit: 你想找什么？糖果和娃娃吗？还是多余的夜影花？

original: You're not actually... picking my pocket? Well, you've got guts. I'll give you that.
traduit: 你是不是……在翻我口袋啊？嗯，不得不说，你很勇嘛。

original: It's... it's like watching an artist create a masterpiece.
traduit: 就像……在看艺术家创作杰作一样。

original: And another soul for Sithis.
traduit: 又为西帝斯献上一个灵魂。

original: You are an inspiration. Do you know that?
traduit: 你可真会鼓舞人心啊。你知道吗？

original: Oooh. Time to kill?
traduit: 哦。要杀人吗？

original: Finally!
traduit: 终于！

original: Ooh. That had to hurt.
traduit: 哦。那肯定很疼。

original: What? Why would the stranger attack innocent Cicero?
traduit: 怎么了？为什么陌生人要袭击无辜的西塞罗？

original: Ow! What did I do?
traduit: 噢！我做了什么？

original: What have I done, Listener? Has Cicero offended you?
traduit: 聆听者，我做了什么了？西塞罗冒犯你了吗？

original: By Sithis, you will pay for that!
traduit: 西帝斯在上，你会付出代价的！

original: Why you insolent little bastard...
traduit: 你这个傲慢的小杂种……

original: Is that... the best... you can do...
traduit: 这就是……你的……极限了……

original: Ow... It hurts when I laugh. He he...
traduit: 噢……笑起来有些痛。呵呵……

original: Have you... gone... completely... mad?
traduit: 你……完全……疯了……？

original: This... this is... an outrage...
traduit: 真是……真是……侮辱……

original: It will... take more than that... to stop me...
traduit: 想……阻止我……就……再用点力……

original: Ooh. What a fun trick. Teach me, teach me!
traduit: 哦。有意思的把戏。教教我，教教我！

original: For someone called the "Listener," you do an awful lot of shouting...
traduit: 相比其他“聆听者”，你算是最爱大吼大叫的了……

original: That's my boy.
traduit: 这才是我的好儿子。

original: I hate them.
traduit: 我讨厌他们。

original: Because they don't care about you or I, cub. They think they're better than all of us, and that we can just be thrown away.
traduit: 因为他们根本不在意你我，孩子。他们觉得自己比我们所有人都强，我们都是可以被抛弃的。

original: Why did they do that? Why would they be so evil?
traduit: 他们为什么这么做？他们为什么这么邪恶呢？

original: Eirid's a little girl who doesn't understand that they're responsible for destroying our home.
traduit: 爱瑞德一个小丫头怎么会明白他们毁了咱们的家园。

original: Eirid says the mages at the College are nice people, but you said they're bad.
traduit: 爱瑞德说学院里的法师都是好人，但你说他们是坏人。

original: And it's clear money matters more to Dagur than honor.
traduit: 而且对达古尔来说，金钱显然比荣誉更重要。

original: It's clear that memories are far too short.
traduit: 显然，人们的记忆太过短暂。

original: This is what it's come to. No one seems to care what they've done to our home.
traduit: 这就是现在的情况了。没人在意他们对我们的家乡做了什么。

original: That... wizard is still at the Inn. I can't believe Dagur allows him to stay there.
traduit: 那个……巫师，还在旅店里。真不敢相信达古尔会让他留下。

original: I'm sure you're right.
traduit: 我觉得你是对的。

original: Not like this. Feels colder than usual. Bet it's those damned Mages.
traduit: 不是。感觉比平常更冷。肯定是那些该死的法师。

original: Aren't they all?
traduit: 哪天不是呢？

original: Looks to be another cold day.
traduit: 看来又是寒冷的一天啊。

original: Who is Mirabelle Ervine?
traduit: 米拉贝勒·厄文是谁？

original: She's the Master-Wizard here. Arch-Mage Aren may be in charge, but Mirabelle runs the place.
traduit: 她是这里的巫术大师。大法师阿冉也许是领导人，但米拉贝勒管理这里。

original: You'd do well to remember that.
traduit: 你最好记住这点。

original: Please, enjoy yourself!
traduit: 请吧，好好享受！

original: DB05PlayerWhoIsTargetTopic1
traduit: DB05PlayerWhoIsTargetTopic1

original: Her name is Vittoria Vici. She oversees the East Empire Company's business holdings in Solitude.
traduit: 维托利亚·维齐。她独自监管着东帝国公司的商业资产。

original: The wedding is being held in that city, at the Temple of the Divines. Her death will cause an uproar, which is exactly what we want.
traduit: 婚礼在城里的圣灵神殿举行。她的死会引起轩然大波，而这正是我们想要的。

original: Vici is likely to address her guests frequently, as is the wedding custom. Kill her when she does that, and I promise you a significant bonus.
traduit: 按照婚礼习俗，维齐可能会频繁向客人致意。在那时候杀了她，保证给你一大笔奖赏。

original: Now go. And give my best to the bride.
traduit: 现在去吧。带我向新娘问好。

original: Who's the target?
traduit: 目标是谁？

original: Yes, the blushing bride now serves Sithis in the Void.
traduit: 很好，娇羞的新娘正在虚空中服侍西帝斯了。

original: Yes, the blushing bride now serves Sithis in the Void.
traduit: 很好，娇羞的新娘正在虚空中服侍西帝斯了。

original: DB05AstridBrideDeadResponse1
traduit: DB05AstridBrideDeadResponse1

original: She bled like a stuck pig.
traduit: 她死的就像头捆好的猪一样。

original: Ha ha! The news is everywhere! Vittoria Vici, the Emperor's cousin, butchered at her own wedding! Well done!
traduit: 哈哈！新闻已经传遍了！皇帝的表妹维托利亚·维齐在自己的婚礼上惨遭杀戮！做得好！

original: Let's see his eminence try to ignore this.
traduit: 看看皇帝会不会选择无视。

original: Oh, no need to be shy! My day is your day! Please - eat, drink, make merry! We're all friends here!
traduit: 哦，别害羞嘛！我的好日子就是你的好日子！请吧，尽情吃喝享用！这里的人都是朋友！

original: Ha ha ha ha! Yes, yes indeed! Hail the Imperial Legion! Hail the Stormcloaks! Hail Solitude and the Eight Divines!
traduit: 哈哈哈！没错，没错！帝国军团万岁！风暴斗篷万岁！独孤城与八圣灵万岁！

original: On this glorious day, we honor everyone! Ha ha ha ha!
traduit: 这个光荣的日子值得向所有人致敬！哈哈哈哈！

original: Hail the Imperial Legion!
traduit: 帝国军团万岁！

original: Oh! Well, you tell your Stormcloak friends "hello" right back at them! This is a day of healing! Legion, Stormcloaks - all are welcome here!
traduit: 哦！也和你的风暴斗篷弟兄问声好！今天是个治愈的日子！军团、风暴斗篷，这里欢迎所有人！

original: The Stormcloaks say hello!
traduit: 风暴斗篷向你问好！

original: What an amazing day this has been. I hope you're enjoying the festivities. I'm... I'm just so overwhelmed. Such kindness... for me.
traduit: 真是美好的一天。希望你玩得开心。我……真是太激动了。这么多人……祝福我。

original: Oh, Asgeir! My husband! My dear, sweet husband! Why would someone do this to you? Why? This was supposed to be the happiest day of my life!
traduit: 哦，艾斯盖尔！我的丈夫！我亲爱的丈夫！为什么有人要对你下此毒手？为什么？这本该是我生命中最幸福的一天！

original: Please, enjoy the festivities! This is a day of peace and happiness, when Imperials and Stormcloaks join together, as equals!
traduit: 请尽情享受节日！今天是和平与幸福的日子，帝国人与风暴斗篷都可以加入进来！

original: My wife is dead! Dead!
traduit: 我妻子死了！死了！

original: Now now, fella. Let's not get too close to my new bride, eh?
traduit: 诶诶，伙计。能别离我新娘太近吗？

original: Well aren't you a pretty thing? Should my new bride by worried? He he he he.
traduit: 你很漂亮吗？我的新娘是不是该担心了？呵呵呵。

original: Make sure to get yourself something to drink.
traduit: 记得自己拿些喝的。

original: You hungry? There's plenty of food. Eat up, now.
traduit: 饿了吗？这里食物充足。快去吃吧。

original: What's going on? Why would somebody do that?
traduit: 怎么回事？为什么有人要这么做？

original: This wedding is boring. I wish they had jugglers.
traduit: 这婚礼太无聊了。我希望他们请几个杂耍演员。

original: When my aunt got married, they had a cake that was three feet tall. I got really sick that day.
traduit: 我阿姨结婚的时候，他们定制了一个三尺高的蛋糕。可惜那天我病得很厉害。

original: I heard Vittoria Vici is the Emperor's cousin. I wish he came to the wedding. I never saw a real live Emperor before.
traduit: 听说皇帝是维托利亚·维齐的表兄。真希望他能亲临婚礼，我以前还没见过皇帝呢。

original: By the gods, the blood! The blood!
traduit: 神啊，血！是血！

original: Vittoria did pretty well for herself, marrying that Asgeir. Not a bad looking fellow at all.
traduit: 维托利亚嫁给艾斯盖尔真好。他长得不错。

original: I love weddings, don't you?
traduit: 我喜欢婚礼，你呢？

original: I just can't wait to be a bride someday. Someday...
traduit: 我都等不及当新娘了。总有一天……

original: I didn't do it! You saw! I didn't do it!
traduit: 不是我干的！你看见了！不是我干的！

original: Long as I stay out of the way, the guards don't seem to care about me being here.
traduit: 只要我不碍事，卫兵好像不在乎我在这里。

original: I've eaten more in the last two hours than I have in the last two weeks.
traduit: 我这两小时吃的比这两周吃的都要多。

original: If I'm really lucky, I'll get to kiss the bride for good luck.
traduit: 如果有这个幸运的话，我想亲吻一下新娘求点好运。

original: The Emperor's cousin is dead! This is a disaster!
traduit: 皇帝的表妹死了！真是场灾难！

original: By all the gods, the groom has been killed. At his own wedding! I can only think of my own husband...
traduit: 神啊，新郎被杀了。在他自己的婚礼上！我想起来自己的丈夫……

original: A marriage of both love and political advantage. A rare thing indeed.
traduit: 既有爱情又有政治利益的婚姻实属罕见。

original: Oh, no no no... This is so wrong...
traduit: 哦，不不不……不应该……

original: I'm so glad Vittoria and Asgeir chose a public reception. That way the entire city can share in their holy bond.
traduit: 真高兴维托利亚和艾斯盖尔选择举办一场公开的招待会。整个城市都能见证他们神圣的结合。

original: Oh, did you miss the ceremony? It was rather quick, actually. The couple seemed more concerned with their reception.
traduit: 哦，你错过仪式了吗？其实挺快的。这对新人好像更关心如何招待客人。

original: I just came to sing! This is a horror show!
traduit: 我只是来唱歌的！真是场恐怖的演出！
