original: If you want my opinion, I think they should have paid for an entire quartet. Plenty of bards at the College would have loved the opportunity.
traduit: 要是我说，他们应该直接雇我们搞个四重奏。学院里很多诗人都会喜欢这个机会的。

original: Ahem. Mi mi mi mi. Pardon me. Just, um, warming up. Never know when I may be called upon for a ballad.
traduit: 咳嗯。咪咪咪咪。不好意思。只是，呃，吊嗓子。不知道什么时候会被叫去唱歌。

original: My daughter! Dead! Noooooo!
traduit: 我女儿！死了！不！

original: My nephew, the Emperor. Too busy to attend the wedding of his beloved cousin. We won't stand for this slight, I assure you.
traduit: 我那个外甥皇帝真是个大忙人。连他钟爱的表妹结婚都不来参加。我绝不能容忍这种侮辱。

original: What my daughter sees in that... barbarian, I'll never know.
traduit: 我女儿居然看上了那个……野蛮人。真不明白。

original: The thought of paying a dowry to that, that... Stormcloak turns my stomach.
traduit: 一想到要给那个……风暴斗篷送嫁妆，都觉得反胃。

original: It was the Empire killed her! I know it! They killed her so they can blame it on the Stormcloaks!
traduit: 是帝国干的！我知道！他们杀了她，然后好栽赃给风暴斗篷！

original: My son is dead! At his own wedding! Only those Imperial dogs would have dared do something like this! Damn them all to Oblivion!
traduit: 我儿子死了！在他自己的婚礼上！只有那群帝国狗才能做出这种事！让他们见鬼去吧！

original: I still think my boy should have had a traditional Nord wedding. Outside, in the cool mountain air.
traduit: 我还是觉得我儿子应该在外面山间，享受清凉的空气，举行一次传统的诺德婚礼。

original: They say this marriage is the first step towards peace. Who in Shor's name wants peace? Pfft.
traduit: 他们说这次联姻是迈向和平的第一步。舒尔在上，谁想和谈了？呸。

original: My boy, he always did have an eye for the pretty ones. That Vittoria ain't bad, for an Imperial.
traduit: 我儿子对美女还是很有眼光的。维托利亚作为一个帝国人来说，长得还不错。

original: By Ysmir, this is horrible! I never wanted the girl dead, I swear!
traduit: 伊斯米尔啊，太可怕了！我没想过让这姑娘死啊，我发誓！

original: Vittoria may be pretty, but does she have the right hips for the job? I want grandchildren, and lots of them.
traduit: 维托利亚确实很漂亮，但她屁股适合生孙子吗？我想多要几个。

original: To think, my little boy is married. And to an Imperial. Oh, they grow up so fast.
traduit: 想想吧，我的儿子要和帝国人结婚了。哦，他们这么快就长大了。

original: If my Asgeir is happy, then I'm happy. Really.
traduit: 只要我家艾斯盖尔快乐，我就高兴。真的。

original: I never should have taken this job!
traduit: 我真不该接这份工作！

original: Sorry, no time to talk. I need to keep playing.
traduit: 对不起，没时间聊天。我还得继续表演。

original: Let's see what Esbern has to say.
traduit: 我们听听伊思本怎么说。

original: Amazing, eh? To be standing at the very entrance to Sky Haven Temple itself!
traduit: 站在天佑神殿的入口处很惊艳吧？

original: We must be getting close. We should proceed cautiously.
traduit: 我们一定是快到了。小心一点。

original: Are you sure this is the right way?
traduit: 你确定走对了吗？

original: I've told you where Sky Haven Temple is. I'll trust you to get us there in one piece.
traduit: 天佑神殿的位置已经告诉你了。希望你能把我们安全带到那儿。

original: I must speak to Delphine at once. There's no time to lose.
traduit: 我必须马上跟戴尔芬谈谈。不能浪费时间了。

original: So this is where Delphine has been hiding all these years? Hmm.
traduit: 这么说戴尔芬这么多年就躲在这儿。

original: Are we close? Thalmor spies could be anywhere.
traduit: 我们快到了吗？梭默间谍可是无处不在。

original: I don't like being out in the open like this.
traduit: 我不太喜欢在户外。

original: Did you hear that?
traduit: 你听到什么了吗？

original: Well, I guess that's good enough... let's be off...
traduit: 好吧，我觉得够了……我们……走吧。

original: One moment, I know, time is of the essence, but mustn't leave secrets for the Thalmor... there's one more I must bring...
traduit: 我知道，时间就是金钱，但不能把秘密留给梭默……我得把这个带上……

original: I'll need this... No, no, useless trash... where'd I put my annotated Anuad?
traduit: 我得拿上这个……不对，这个没用了……我把注释版的阿努之歌放哪儿了？

original: Alduin's Wall was where the ancient Blades recorded all they knew of Alduin and his return. Part history, part prophecy.
traduit: 古代的刀锋们在奥杜因之墙上记载了他们所知道关于奥杜因和它的回归的事情。部分是历史，另外是预言。

original: Its location has been lost for centuries, but I've found it again. Not lost, you see, just forgotten.
traduit: 它的位置已经失传了几百年，不过又被我找到了。你看，事物从无凭空消失，唯有遗忘而已。

original: The Blades archives held so many secrets... I was only able to save a few scraps...
traduit: 刀锋会的档案里蕴藏无数秘密……可惜我只留下些皮毛……

original: Sky Haven Temple. An ancient Blades sanctuary, hidden deep in the crags of the Reach. That's where we'll find Alduin's Wall.
traduit: 天佑神殿。一座古代刀锋会圣所，深藏在瑞驰的峭壁中。那就是奥杜因之墙的所在。

original: Alduin's Wall... one of the lost secrets of the Blades. Where they recorded all they knew of Alduin and his return. Part history, part prophecy.
traduit: 奥杜因之墙……刀锋会的遗失之密中的一个。他们在上面记录了他们所知关于奥杜因及其归来的一起。有历史也有预言。

original: Its location has been lost for centuries, but I've found it again.
traduit: 它的位置已经遗失了几百年，但又被我找到了。

original: Not lost, you see, just forgotten. The Blades archives held so many secrets... I was only able to save a few scraps...
traduit: 你看，不是遗失而是遗忘。刀锋会的档案中保藏的众多秘密……我只留住了一些皮毛……

original: Right. Good thing they've already let you into their little cult. Not likely they'd help Esbern or me if we came calling.
traduit: 对。幸好他们把你当做了他们小团体的一员。要是我和伊思本去找他们，他们应该不会帮我们。

original: We'll look around Sky Haven Temple and see what else the old Blades might have left for us. It's a better hideout than I could have hoped for.
traduit: 我们会在天佑神殿四处转转，看看以前的刀锋们有没有给咱们留下些什么。这里是个不错的藏身处。

original: Talos guard you.
traduit: 塔洛斯保佑你。

original: This looks promising. Akaviri stonework, I think. Reminds me a bit of Cloud Ruler Temple.
traduit: 看起来很不错。应该是阿卡维尔的石刻工艺。不禁让我想起凌云者神殿。

original: I think we're getting close. Let's keep moving.
traduit: 我们应该快到了。继续前进吧。

original: Lead on to Sky Haven Temple.
traduit: 去天佑神殿吧。

original: We'll meet up near Karthspire.
traduit: 我们在卡斯尖峰附近会合。

original: Let's get this door open and see what we've got.
traduit: 打开这扇门看看能找到什么。

original: Alduin isn't getting any weaker while we stand around here gawping at the architecture.
traduit: 只是在这儿呆呆地看着建筑可不会让奥杜因变弱。

original: Let's pretend we haven't. What's Alduin's Wall and what does it have to do with stopping the dragons?
traduit: 就算没有吧。奥杜因之墙是什么？它和阻止龙族有什么关系？

original: Either of you?
traduit: 你也没有？

original: You mean... you don't mean to say you haven't heard of Alduin's Wall?
traduit: 你是说……你没听说过奥杜因之墙？

original: Esbern. What are you getting at?
traduit: 伊思本你在说什么？

original: A wise and foresighted policy, in the event.
traduit: 这确实是一项远见卓识的决策。

original: Despite the far-reaching fame of Alduin's Wall at the time - one of the wonders of the ancient world - its location was lost.
traduit: 尽管奥杜因之墙这等奇迹闻名一时，但如今位置却失传了。

original: Shh!
traduit: 嘘！

original: This is where they built Alduin's Wall, to set down in stone all their accumulated dragonlore.
traduit: 他们在这儿建立了奥杜因之墙，将他们积累的所有龙族知识都刻在了石头上。

original: A hedge against the forgetfulness of centuries.
traduit: 当做抵御漫长岁月遗忘的屏障。

original: Do you know what he's talking about?
traduit: 你知道他在说什么吗？

original: You see, right here. Sky Haven Temple, constructed around one of the main Akaviri military camps in the Reach, during their conquest of Skyrim.
traduit: 你们看，就是这里。天佑神殿，在阿卡维尔征服天际期间，兴建在一座主要军营附近。

original: Ah! Here it is. Come, let me show you.
traduit: 啊！在这里。来，你们看。

original: Esbern, what...
traduit: 伊思本，是什么啊……

original: Give me... just a moment...
traduit: 稍等我……一小会儿……

original: This changes everything, of course. There's no time to lose. We must locate...  let me show you. I know I had it here, somewhere...
traduit: 一切都为之一变。我们不能浪费时间了。必须找到……等我给你们看一下。我记得它在这儿啊，哪里去了……

original: Oh yes! Dragonborn! Indeed, yes.
traduit: 哦，没错！龙裔！我知道。

original: Now then. I assume you know about...
traduit: 现在。我想你知道……

original: Yeah, sure.
traduit: 好，没问题。

original: Orgnar, hold down the bar for a minute, will you?
traduit: 奥格那，照看一下柜台，好吗？

original: Well, then. You made it, safe and sound. Good. Come on, I have a place we can talk.
traduit: 嗯。你做到了，安然无恙。很好。来吧，我有个可以畅谈的地方。

original: It's good to see you, too, Esbern. It's been too long, old friend. Too long.
traduit: 我也很高兴见到你，伊思本。老朋友，好久不见。真的太久了。

original: Delphine! I... it's good to see you. It's been... a long time.
traduit: 戴尔芬！见到你……真高兴。真是……好久不见。

original: Isn't it amazing?
traduit: 是不是很惊人？

original: Just think. We're the first to set foot here in thousands of years.
traduit: 想想吧。我们是几千年来第一批踏足这里的人。

original: I can't wait to see what's inside!
traduit: 我太想知道里面有什么了！

original: Patience. Give me a moment and I'll explain everything.
traduit: 耐心点。给我些时间，我会解释清楚。

original: Then we have to stop him.
traduit: 那我们得阻止他。

original: Agreed. He's taken everything the Guild has left, and to go after one of the last greatest heists is just an insult.
traduit: 同意。他拿走了公会剩下的所有东西，企图独自吞下最后的大劫案，简直就是侮辱。

original: I've spoken to Karliah, and made amends for how the Guild's treated her. Now she wishes to speak with both of us.
traduit: 我已经和卡莱亚谈过了，也为公会对她的方式做出补偿。现在她要和咱俩谈谈。

original: Quickly, we have no time to lose.
traduit: 快点，我们没时间了。

original: He wasn't there, but I found these plans.
traduit: 他不在那里，但我找到了这些计划。

original: Shor's beard! He's going after the Eyes of the Falmer? That was Gallus's pet project.
traduit: 舒尔的胡子！他要去找伐莫之眼？那可是加卢斯的得意计划。

original: If he gets his hands on them, you can be certain he'll be gone for good and set up for life.
traduit: 如果他得到了，肯定会永远失踪，享受人生。

original: We've scoured the town and I've spoken to every contact we have left. No sign of Mercer.
traduit: 我们搜遍了整座城市，也和我们所有联络人谈过了。没有发现墨瑟的踪迹。

original: Any luck on your end?
traduit: 你那边有发现吗？

original: What's missing from the vault?
traduit: 金库里少了什么？

original: Better question would be "what did he leave."
traduit: 你最好问“金库里还剩下什么。”

original: Mercer took everything. Even all of our plans are gone.
traduit: 墨瑟把所有东西都拿走了。连我们所有的计划也泡汤了。

original: Stabbed in the back. It's like the Dark Brotherhood all over again.
traduit: 背后捅刀子。简直就像黑暗兄弟会的重演。

original: Can't talk long, got to keep my eyes open for Mercer.
traduit: 不能多聊了。我得注意墨瑟。

original: Hold your thoughts 'til after we untangle this mess.
traduit: 在我们理清这团乱麻之前，最好别胡思乱想了。

original: If I see Frey, I'll pluck his eyes from his skull with my bare hands!
traduit: 要是让我看见弗雷，我就直接把他眼珠子挖出来！

original: Need to stay focused in case Frey comes back, make it fast.
traduit: 集中注意，以防墨瑟回来，动作要快。

original: We can talk after I find out what's going on.
traduit: 等我弄清楚发生了什么再聊吧。

original: I'm relieved Brynjolf has an open mind or that could have gotten bloody.
traduit: 很高兴布林乔夫想法很开放，否则后果不堪设想。

original: The time for talk has passed. We must hurry.
traduit: 聊天到此为止，我们必须快点。

original: Quickly, what is it?
traduit: 快说，怎么了？

original: I can't believe this is happening, lad.
traduit: 真不敢相信会发生这种事，小子。

original: I can't believe this is happening, lass.
traduit: 真不敢相信会发生这种事，姑娘。

original: Just take a step back and let me figure this out. Then we'll talk.
traduit: 你先别打扰我，让我想想办法。然后再说。

original: Can't talk.... I'm outta' here.
traduit: 现在不能交谈……我需要离开这里。

original: This is Mercer Frey's place and he don't like visitors. Now go away.
traduit: 这里是墨瑟·弗雷的地方，他不喜欢外人来访。走开。

original: I dare Mercer to come back here! He sets one foot in the cistern and I'll cut it off!
traduit: 墨瑟敢再回来！哪只脚伸进水池，就砍哪只！

original: Look at that dark elf whore... strutting around like she's innocent. I'll cut her open from gullet to groin!
traduit: 看看那个暗精灵臭婊子……趾高气昂好像多无辜似的。看我把她一刀开个大膛！

original: I never saw this coming, I thought we were just having a run of bad luck.
traduit: 我从没想过会是这样，我以为我们只是不走运而已。

original: So it's true. You've turned traitor. I can't believe it.
traduit: 所以这是真的。你也叛变了。没想到啊。

original: I hope he turns up soon... he needs to answer for his betrayal.
traduit: 真希望他快点出现。他得为背叛付出代价。

original: I won't rest until Mercer's dead. How could he murder Gallus and betray all of us like that?
traduit: 不杀了墨瑟誓不罢休。他怎么能害死加卢斯又背叛我们大家？

original: If you don't have a good reason to be partnered with Karliah, you're dead.
traduit: 和卡莱亚合伙，要是没有充分的理由，你就死定了。

original: How can Karliah remain so calm when Mercer had her on the run for that long? Amazing.
traduit: 卡莱亚被墨瑟撵着跑了这么久，怎么还能那么冷静？真神奇。

original: They say that Karliah murdered Gallus, but I'm not so sure.
traduit: 他们说卡莱亚杀了加卢斯，但我不确定。

original: If I find Mercer first, I'm going to crush his skull with my bare hands!
traduit: 如果我先发现墨瑟，我一定一拳砸烂他的脑袋！

original: They're waiting for you in the cistern. No tricks.
traduit: 他们在蓄水池等你。别耍花招。

original: Punishment's too good for Mercer Frey. The only penalty for his betrayal is death.
traduit: 惩罚对墨瑟·弗雷来说太轻了。他背叛的唯一惩罚就是死。

original: Vex is ready to tear you apart. I hope you have a good excuse for bringing Karliah here.
traduit: 小烦准备把你剁碎了。希望你有带卡莱亚回来的正当理由。

original: There's no doubt Mercer will make for the borders of Skyrim. I hope you find him before he escapes our grasp.
traduit: 墨瑟肯定会逃出天际。希望在他逃走前把他找到。

original: I heard what happened and the Guild owes you thanks for bringing this to light.
traduit: 我听说了事情的经过，公会欠你一份情，感谢你把这些曝光出来。

original: I can't believe he emptied the vault. Right from under our noses.
traduit: 真不敢信他就在我们眼皮底下把金库搬空了。

original: How dare you bring that Dunmer bitch here.
traduit: 你怎么敢把那个丹莫婊子带到这儿来。

original: Vex better leave a piece of Mercer for us. It's payback time.
traduit: 小烦最好把墨瑟留点给我们。现在是让他还债的时候了。

original: What in blazes is going on? Are you working with Karliah?
traduit: 到底怎么回事？你怎么和卡莱亚一伙了？

original: Ah, yes. Of course. No, I don't need anything.
traduit: 哦，是。当然。那我没什么需要了。

original: I'm here to help you with books, Nirya. That's all.
traduit: 我在这儿是帮忙找书，尼尔雅。仅此而已。

original: Did she, perhaps, mention any dangerous research she might be working on? Anything that could get her in trouble?
traduit: 她有没有提过她可能在进行什么危险的研究？或者任何可能给她带来麻烦的事？

original: Nirya...
traduit: 尼尔雅……

original: I was wondering. Has Faralda been in recently? Borrowed any books that you can recall?
traduit: 我是在想，法劳达最近来过吗？有借过什么书吗？

original: Can I help you with anything, Nirya?
traduit: 有什么需要帮忙的吗，尼尔雅？

original: What's that? Oh yes, yes. Thank you, I will.
traduit: 什么？哦，好好。谢谢。

original: Ah. Well, then. Let me know if you need anything.
traduit: 啊。那好吧。如果有什么需要就告诉我。

original: Hmm? Oh, no. No, not really. I... Actually, I've forgotten what I was looking for.
traduit: 嗯？哦，不不。不是。其实我……忘了要找什么了。

original: Are you looking for any specific volumes, Drevis?
traduit: 你在找什么特殊卷宗吗，德莱维斯？

original: Amazed isn't the right word. They might find this... offensive.
traduit: “惊讶”不恰当。他们可能会觉得这是……冒犯。

original: I bet your family would be amazed, right?
traduit: 我打赌你家里人会很惊讶吧？

original: I'm surprised that the College is allowed to excavate here.
traduit: 我很惊讶学院居然会被允许发掘这里。

original: Can you believe we're here? Saarthal, of all places.
traduit: 你敢相信我们会来这儿？尤其是这萨瑟尔。

original: My sweet Leanora, I will never let anything happen to us. I promise.
traduit: 亲爱的利奥娜拉，我不会让咱们出任何事的。我发誓。

original: I've already lost a family, and we're about to start a new one. I don't want that to happen again.
traduit: 我已经失去了一个家，而我们即将组建一个新家。我不希望这事儿再发生了。

original: It brings me joy to hear that, but what possessed you to say that so suddenly?
traduit: 听你这么说我是很高兴了，但突然这是怎么了？

original: My darling, you've made me the happiest woman in all Skyrim.
traduit: 亲爱的，你让我成为了天际最幸福的女人。

original: Just worry about keeping the fields tended and let the Jarl worry about the war.
traduit: 咱们管好田地就行。打仗的事留给领主去操心吧。

original: I suppose so. I just fear they won't make it out here in time.
traduit: 我想也是。就怕他们赶到这儿需要时间。

original: It will have to do. Besides, if it came to blows, I'm sure the Snow-Shod's would come out here and assist us.
traduit: 也只能这样了。再说，真要是打起来，雪蹄家会出来帮咱们的。

original: I'm not so sure the few guards they've assigned to the farm are enough.
traduit: 不知道他们派到农场的那几个卫兵够不够用。

original: Yes, thank you Arch-Mage.
traduit: 是，谢谢您，大法师。

original: Everything's under control, then? Right. Keep up the good work.
traduit: 一切都在掌握中啊？好。再接再厉。

original: There were also two items requiring disciplinary action recently.
traduit: 最近还有两个项目需要受到纪律处分。

original: I'm dealing with a few new research proposals, evaluating the results of three long-term projects, and keeping an eye on our new Apprentices.
traduit: 我正在处理一些新的研究计划，评估三项长期项目的结果，并密切关注我们的新学徒。

original: Is there anything new I should be aware of, Mirabelle?
traduit: 有什么需要我注意的新情况吗，米拉贝勒？

original: Never. The College cannot become mired in local politics. What happens inside these walls is our worry. What happens outside is theirs.
traduit: 永远不会。学院绝不能陷入当地政治纷争的泥沼里。我们只需关心咱们自己的事。外面的一切由他们去。

original: Forgive me, but at what point does it become our concern?
traduit: 请原谅，但我们什么时候才要关心这件事呢？

original: The same thing we've told them before, and the same thing we've told these Stormcloaks. It's not our concern.
traduit: 就和我们之前告诉他们的，还有跟风暴斗篷的答复一样。这些不关咱们的事。

original: Sir, the Imperial Legion has again requested assistance. What shall I tell them?
traduit: 先生，帝国军团又来请求援助了。我该如何答复？

original: Ah, yes. True. Well, thank you.
traduit: 啊，真的很感谢。

original: Your schedule is always clear, Arch-Mage. I see to that.
traduit: 我会保证您的日程安排清楚，大法师。

original: Mirabelle, would you please make sure my schedule is clear for the next few days? I'm working on something important.
traduit: 米拉贝勒，你能帮我空下后面几天的日程吗？我有些要紧事。

original: "Disappointed" is not the word I would choose, Colette. Excuse me.
traduit: 我不太爱用“失望”这个词，柯莱特。打扰了。

original: Oh, my dear Urag. You're trying so hard to help. I do hope you're not disappointed.
traduit: 哦，亲爱的乌拉格。你这么想帮忙啊。我不会让你失望的。

original: So, you don't need anything then.
traduit: 那，就是什么都不需要了。

original: I'm positive whatever I require will be revealed to me on its own, in due time.
traduit: 我确信我所需要的一切会在适当的时侯，自己回应我。

original: Was there something specific you needed?
traduit: 你有什么需要吗？

original: Don't fret, my fanged acquaintance. I shan't trouble you a bit.
traduit: 别烦恼啊，尖牙兄。我不会打扰你的。

original: I... see.
traduit: 我知道了……

original: I only wish to escape the constant glaring of my "colleagues" and discover an opportunity for repose. Your Arcanaeum is so lovely and quiet...
traduit: 我只是想逃避一下“同事们”不断地盯视，找机会休息下。你的秘藏馆很可爱也很安静。

original: Did you need something, Colette?
traduit: 你有什么需要吗，柯莱特？

original: Ah, my dearest Urag! How are you today, my green-skinned friend?
traduit: 啊，亲爱的乌拉格！今天感觉怎么样啊，绿皮老哥？

original: This is why I avoid being social.
traduit: 所以我才会避免社交。

original: Oh! Well... I... I'm sorry. Yes, we have been working on something together.
traduit: 哦！嗯……抱歉。对，我们是在搞某些合作。

original: Calm down! Why are you over-reacting? I was going to ask if the two of you are collaborating on research!
traduit: 冷静点！你怎么这么过激啊？我只是想问问你俩是不是在合作搞研究！

original: What? Why, the audacity! How dare you imply such a thing!
traduit: 什么？怎么，这么无礼！你竟然敢对我含沙射影！

original: You've been spending a fair bit of time with Sergius lately, I see.
traduit: 我听说你最近和瑟吉尔斯待的挺久。

original: Oh, no. Err, wouldn't do to say at all. Not, err, not now. Not at all. I have far too many things to do still.
traduit: 哦，不是。嗯，我不太像说。不是，是现在不能说。抱歉了，我还有很多事要做。

original: Right. And what did you say the point of this little venture was?
traduit: 好吧。你说的那次小冒险意义何在啊？

original: Oh, that. Err, yes. It's... It's quite promising, I believe. Definitely on the right track. Results, err, results should be soon.
traduit: 哦，那个。呃，对。我……相信这个很有前途。我绝对是走对了。结果很快就会出来了。

original: So, Arniel. How's that little project of yours coming along? Any progress worth mentioning?
traduit: 喂，阿内尔。你的小项目进展如何了？有什么值得一提的吗？

original: Ahh, hmm. Yes. I, err, I was unaware that I had forgotten that. I will, err, I mean I'll take care of that as soon as possible.
traduit: 啊，呃。是。我，呃，我不知道是不是忘记了。我会付钱的，嗯，我是说我会尽快付钱的。

original: And that, my nervous little friend, has not happened. Would you care to comment on that, perhaps?
traduit: 然而，我那位紧张的小老弟，还是没付钱啊。也许你对此可以评论评论？

original: Really, Arniel? Because I seem to recall doing just that for you recently, at which point you assured me that you'd cover my expenses.
traduit: 真的吗，阿内尔？因为我记得最近帮你买的时候，你保证会给我付钱的。

original: Yes, err, apologies for the intrusion. I was wondering, err, if you could possibly, ah, procure a few select items for me.
traduit: 是，抱歉打扰你了。我在想，呃，能不能，帮我买几样精选的东西。

original: Err, excuse me Enthir. Might I have a moment?
traduit: 呃，打扰了，恩希尔。能抽点时间吗？

original: Yes, Arch-Mage. Thank you.
traduit: 是，大法师。谢谢您。

original: No, I don't think so. Respond to their request, and we'll leave it at that.
traduit: 不，我觉得不必。对他们做出回应，就到此为止即可。

original: Should we consider investigating the matter?
traduit: 我们是否需要去调查一番？

original: That hasn't changed, has it? Then just tell them again.
traduit: 这一点并没有变，不是吗？那就再告诉他们一遍。

original: That they had arrived, asked for information which was provided to them, and went on their way with no suggestion of further interaction.
traduit: 他们来过，询问了他们需要的信息，就继续赶路了，没有任何进一步交流的意思。

original: What did you tell them last time?
traduit: 你上次是怎么跟他们说的？

original: Arch-Mage, the Synod have contacted us again, asking if we've any word on their researchers. What shall I tell them?
traduit: 大法师，希诺再次联系我们了，问我们有没有关于他们研究人员的消息。我该如何回复？

original: Some fool is opening a museum in Dawnstar. They say he's paying people to collect artifacts from that old Mythic Dawn cult.
traduit: 有个笨蛋在晨星开了家博物馆。都说他要花钱雇人搜集古代神话黎明邪教的文物。

original: I wonder why they only stole Lucan's golden claw. I mean, we have plenty of things in the shop that are worth just as much coin.
traduit: 真不知道他们为什么只偷了卢坎的黄金龙爪。我是说，我们店里其他东西也挺值钱的。

original: Lucan found the claw about a year after he opened the store. He never quite explained where he got it. He's a tricky one.
traduit: 卢坎在这儿开店一年之后发现了这个爪子。从来没和我解释过是从哪里找到的。他挺狡猾的。

original: Those thieves must be mad, hiding out there. Those old crypts are filled with nothing but traps, trolls, and who knows what else!
traduit: 那些小偷一定是疯了才会躲在那里。那些老坟除了陷阱就是巨魔，鬼知道还有什么！

original: Wh- no... I.... Oh, by the Eight, fine. But only to the edge of town!
traduit: 啊……不……我……八圣灵在上，行吧。但只能送到镇子边上！

original: Oh really? Well I think your new helper here needs a guide.
traduit: 哦是吗？我觉得你的新帮手需要个向导。

original: Yes. So now you don't have to go, do you?
traduit: 没错。所以你现在不用走了吧？

original: So this is your plan, Lucan?
traduit: 这就是你的计划，卢坎？

original: Come on, father. There's nothing more to be said here.
traduit: 得了吧，爸。没什么好说的了。

original: Face it, cow! Your stupid son is dead! He died a Stormcloak traitor. And you... you best keep your mouth shut before you suffer the same.
traduit: 面对现实吧，蠢牛！你那笨儿子死了！他作为一个风暴斗篷叛贼死了。而你……最好管住嘴，免得落得和他一样的下场。

original: "Holding him"? Why I've got him in my cellar. He's my prisoner.
traduit: “关他”？我就把他关在地窖里，他可是我的囚犯啊。

original: Do you believe this old hag?
traduit: 你相信这个老鬼婆吗？

original: I will never accept his death! My son still lives. I feel it in my heart. So tell me, Battle-Borns, where is he? Where are you holding my Thorald?
traduit: 我永远不信他死了！我儿子还活着，我心里能感受到。告诉我，战狂，他在哪儿？你把我儿索拉德关到哪里去了？

original: Your son chose his side, and he chose poorly. And now he's gone. Such is the way of war. The sooner you accept his loss, the better.
traduit: 你儿子选错了阵营，现在他死了，这就是战争。还是早点接受现实为好。

original: Nothing? And what of my son? Hmm? What of Thorald? Is he nothing? So don't talk to me about suffering!
traduit: 什么都不懂？那我儿子呢？嗯？索拉德呢？他也什么都不是？别跟我说什么痛苦！

original: Foolish old woman! You know nothing! Nothing of our struggles, our suffering!
traduit: 愚蠢的老女人！你什么都不知道！不懂我们的挣扎，我们的痛苦！

original: Well what are you going to do then, huh? Let's hear it!
traduit: 那你打算怎么办，哈？洗耳恭听呢！

original: We are done talking about this.
traduit: 这件事到此为止了。

original: I helped the young lovers in Ivarstead.
traduit: 我帮助了伊瓦尔镇的年轻情侣。

original: How wonderful. Like the sea, their love roils and swells, but brings life and nourishment to all.
traduit: 太美妙了。他们的爱就像大海一样波涛汹涌，却能给所有人生命力和滋养。

original: It doesn't matter. I'm here. We're together now. And we will be forever.
traduit: 没关系的。我就在这儿。我们现在在一起，永远在一起。

original: I'm so confused. What's happening?
traduit: 我也不明白。发生什么事了？

original: But that battle isn't expected until tomorrow... Ruki, what's going on?
traduit: 可是这场战斗要明天才开始啊……茹姬，这是怎么回事？

original: I had heard that Gjukar's men were wiped out. I came to find you.
traduit: 我听说古卡尔的人被消灭了。我是来找你的。

original: Of course I am. What brings you here?
traduit: 我当然还活着啊。你怎么来了？

original: Fenrig! You're alive!
traduit: 芬利格！你还活着！

original: Is Ulfric's armor done yet?
traduit: 乌弗瑞克的盔甲做好了？

original: Oh, right. That makes sense. Kind of a messy metal, anyway.
traduit: 哦，好吧。说得对。反正就是个乱七八糟的材料。

original: Don't even bother with that one. Leave it to the orcs.
traduit: 这个你就不用操心了。那东西还是留给兽人吧。

original: I think I've got a handle on it, but Orichalcum is confusing.
traduit: 我想是能搞定的，但山铜有些弄不懂。

original: Have you been learning your ores?
traduit: 你有了解过矿石吗？

original: Let me take you to Ruki.
traduit: 我带你去找茹姬。

original: If she's come this far from home, it must be important. Lead on. I just need to report back to camp by sunrise.
traduit: 如果她从家跑这么远过来，肯定是有重要的事。带路吧。我只要在天亮前回营地报到就行了。

original: Why don't you like camping here?
traduit: 你为什么不喜欢在这里扎营？

original: Our fires are visible for miles. We're in a low valley. Sitting ducks.
traduit: 我们这儿的火光几里外都看得见。我们这里地势低，太容易被攻击了。

original: West, in the plains over the mountain.
traduit: 在西边，山那边的平原上。

original: We're expected to fight there tomorrow. Gjukar elected to camp here for the night. I don't like it, though.
traduit: 我们明天要去那里作战。古卡尔选择在这里扎营，但我不喜欢。

original: Your wife is looking for you.
traduit: 你妻子在找你。

original: Ruki? Where is she?
traduit: 茹姬？她在哪儿？

original: Come, help me search for Fenrig.
traduit: 走吧，帮我找到芬利格。

original: The last battle here was hundreds of years ago.
traduit: 这里最后一次打仗已经是几百年前了。

original: Are you a fool? Look at the bodies around you. Even if you're blind, surely you smell the blood.
traduit: 你傻吗？没看到这周围这么多尸体吗。就算是瞎了也能闻到血腥味吧。

original: I'm searching for my Fenrig. He was marching with Gjukar's men, who they say were wiped out here.
traduit: 我在找我的芬利格。他和古卡尔的部队在一起，他们都说古卡尔的军队在这里被消灭了。

original: I've turned over every body, though, and I can't find him.
traduit: 我把所有尸体都找遍了，就是找不到他。

original: Please help me look. He has a bright red beard and hair.
traduit: 拜托请帮我找找。他的胡子和头发又红又亮。

original: Well one of us has to do something!
traduit: 好啊，我们总得有个人做点什么吧！

original: Twilight guide your path.
traduit: 暮光指引你的道路。

original: May Azura's magic protect you.
traduit: 愿阿祖拉的魔法保护你。

original: This has all been foreseen, and we must play our parts.
traduit: 一切早有预言，我们必须各司其职。

original: No, I really don't. It'll be a while before I'm ready for that. I'll be on my way now.
traduit: 不，我真的不知道。我还需要一段时间才能准备好。我先走了。

original: Well, if it works in the one case, why not the other? Don't you want to at least give it a try?
traduit: 好吧，如果这个道理在一种情况下行得通，那另一种怎么就不行呢？难道你就不想试一试吗？

original: I didn't lose a lover, Viola, I lost my wife. It's not the same thing.
traduit: 维欧拉，我失去的不是旧情，是我的妻子。这是两码事。

original: It was an old Nord proverb. It said, the best way to get over the loss of a lover is to find a new one.
traduit: 诺德有句老话。“忘记旧情最好的方式，就是找个新爱”。

original: What did you hear?
traduit: 你听说什么了？

original: Hello, captain! Can you spare a moment? I heard something the other day that I wanted to share with you.
traduit: 你好啊，船长！能抽出点时间吗？前几天我听说了一些事情想和你一起分享。

original: I'm sure the guards have the matter well in hand. Now, if you'll excuse me.
traduit: 我相信卫兵们会妥善处理的。现在，恕我失陪了。

original: You wouldn't think it from the racket that Cornerclub makes.
traduit: 要是你听到过街角吧里传来的吵闹声，就不会这么想了。

original: Viola, dark elves sleep just like the rest of us.
traduit: 维欧拉，暗精灵和咱们一样需要睡觉休息的。

original: Do you think those dark elves had anything to do with the murders? The attacks all happened at night, after all.
traduit: 你说那些暗精灵会和谋杀案有关吗？毕竟，袭击都是发生在晚上。

original: Yes, I think that must be it. My wife hasn't been gone that long, after all. Ask me again on another day.
traduit: 是的，的确如此。我妻子刚离开不久，还是改天再说吧。

original: Oh, I see. Is it still too soon?
traduit: 哦，我明白了。还是太快了吗？

original: I've thought about it, but I'm not sure it's such a good idea.
traduit: 考虑过了，但这恐怕不是个好主意。

original: Have you thought about my invitation?
traduit: 你考虑过我的邀请了吗？

original: And now you've found me. Can I help you?
traduit: 你找到我了。有什么需要帮助的吗？

original: Captain Lonely-Gale! I've been looking for you everywhere!
traduit: 孤风船长！我一直在四处找你！

original: I... well. Perhaps. But still! It's curious.
traduit: 我……好吧。也许是的。但是！还是很奇怪。

original: Don't you think all your tramping around there investigating might have something to do with it?
traduit: 你不觉得和你在那里到处奔走调查有关吗？

original: Did you notice that the snow settles in a different direction near the murder sites?
traduit: 你有注意到谋杀现场附近的雪朝向不同方向了吗？

original: What is it now, Viola?
traduit: 又怎么了，维欧拉？

original: Captain, captain!
traduit: 船长，船长！

original: Oh... yes. Now that you mention it, I think... sorry about that.
traduit: 哦……还真是。既然你提到了，我……对不起了。

original: Did you look behind the forge? I think I saw it there.
traduit: 你到锻炉后面看了吗？我在那儿看到过。

original: Hammers don't have legs.
traduit: 锤子没长腿。

original: I didn't touch it!
traduit: 我没碰过！

original: Blast, girl, I told you to leave my tools alone. You have yours and I have mine.
traduit: 该死，小姑娘，我告诉过你别碰我的工具。你用你的，我用我的。

original: No.
traduit: 没有。

original: Did you use my good hammer?
traduit: 你用过我那把好锤子吗？

original: This is the royal armor, lass. Maybe in a few years.
traduit: 这可是贵族盔甲，姑娘。再过几年吧。

original: I did that engraved piece just last month!
traduit: 我上个月才做过雕刻的！

original: This is more delicate work than you're used to.
traduit: 这活儿比你以前干得要精细得多。

original: Can I help with it? Maybe just the cuirass?
traduit: 我能帮忙吗？也许只是打打胸甲？

original: No, I want to take my time with it.
traduit: 不，我想慢慢来。

original: Come to gawk at the Dark Elf?
traduit: 来傻看暗精灵吗？

original: I mean no offense. I am but a humble farmer. Not a... a great wanderer, like you.
traduit: 我无意冒犯。我不过是个卑微的农民。不是……像你一样伟大的冒险者。

original: Do yourself a favor and don't have children. They're good for nothing at all.
traduit: 为自己着想，别生孩子。一点用处都没有。

original: I got enough troubles, so don't go adding to them.
traduit: 我的麻烦够多了，别再添麻烦了。

original: I spend every day tending the fields, and what do my daughters do? Nothing! Complain and caterwaul! Sleep and eat! Useless!
traduit: 我每天都在忙着种地，我的女儿们在干嘛？什么都没有！抱怨和叫唤！睡和吃！没用的东西！

original: Curse my good-for-nothing daughters! My wife was twice the woman they'll ever grow to be. She gave her life birthing them. What a waste.
traduit: 诅咒我一无是处的女儿们！我妻子比她们长大后更像个女人。她为了生她们俩死了。太浪费了。

original: Did you have any luck talking to my father?
traduit: 你跟我父亲谈过了吗？

original: I hope you can change my father's mind. He can be a little stubborn.
traduit: 我希望你能改变我父亲的想法。他有时候会有点固执。

original: You look like you've seen your share of adventure. I envy you that. In fact, maybe you can help me with something.
traduit: 你看起来像是冒过险的人。真羡慕你。其实，也许你能帮我个忙。

original: My father, Mralki, manages the inn. He used to be a soldier, but he left that life behind.
traduit: 我父亲穆拉基经营这座旅店。他以前是军人，现在已经退役了。

original: If you need a meal or a room, I've got both.
traduit: 如果需要饭或者房间，我这儿都有。

original: I only take real coin here, no handouts and no bartering.
traduit: 我这里只收现钱，概不赊账，也不接受以物换物。

original: That fool son of mine, Erik, wants to be an adventurer. He a good-natured lad, but he's got no idea how dangerous the world really is.
traduit: 我那个傻儿子艾瑞克想当冒险家。他是个好孩子，但不知道这世界多险恶。

original: Some folk here will tell you I'm sheltering my boy too much, but I ask you, isn't it a father's duty to keep his children safe?
traduit: 有些人说我太护着我儿子了，但我问问你，保护孩子的安全不是父亲的责任吗？

original: Name's Ennis. If you've got friends who do business in Whiterun, they might know me.
traduit: 我叫埃尼斯。如果你有朋友在白漫城做生意，他们可能认识我。

original: You talk to Reldith yet? She's like a mother to me.
traduit: 你和雷尔迪斯谈过吗？她就像我母亲一样。

original: You here from the city? I visit Whiterun from time to time, mostly to make deals.
traduit: 你是从城里来的吗？我偶尔会到白漫城去做生意。

original: Reldith is the hardest-working farmer in Rorikstead, but I'm the one with a head for business.
traduit: 雷尔迪斯是洛利克镇最勤劳的农民，但我有经商的头脑。

original: Did you see those guards? Get out of line, and you'll have them to deal with.
traduit: 你看到那些卫兵了吗？要是敢违法，你就得对付他们了。

original: We're honest, hardworking folk here, and we don't suffer beggars or thieves.
traduit: 我们都是诚实勤劳的人，容不下乞丐和盗贼。

original: City folk might look down on us, but what's wrong with farming? Everything we've got, we had to earn with our own sweat.
traduit: 城里人可能瞧不起我们，但务农有什么不好？我们的一切都是靠自己的汗水换来的。

original: You look like the adventurous sort. You should talk to Erik, the innkeeper's son. He could use your help.
traduit: 你看起来像是个爱冒险的人。你该去和旅店老板的儿子艾瑞克谈谈。他需要你的帮助。

original: If you've got some business in Rorikstead, you should start by speaking to Jouane.
traduit: 如果你是来洛利克镇做生意，先去和乔安内谈谈吧。

original: Sorry, I don't mean to be rude but Jouane's the one who deals with people. I'm afraid I lost my charm years ago.
traduit: 抱歉，我不是有意无礼，但现在乔安内才是负责和人打交道的。恐怕我很多年前就没这个魅力咯。

original: No offense intended, but I don't think we have anything to talk about.
traduit: 无意冒犯，但我觉得咱们没什么可谈的。

original: I was a different man, once -- strong, commanding, ah, and young. But the Great War was a long time ago.
traduit: 我以前很不一样的——强壮、威严，啊，还年轻。但浩大战争过去很久咯。

original: If you're thinking of setting up to farm, you picked the right place.
traduit: 如果你想盖个农场，那你选对地方了。

original: Peace and prosperity are all the good folk of Rorikstead want in life.
traduit: 和平和繁荣是洛利克镇的善民们向往的生活。

original: I'm sure it's hard to believe, but I was once a bold adventurer like you, ready to face any danger.
traduit: 我知道很难相信，但我也曾经是个勇敢的冒险家，随时准备面对任何危险。

original: Have you spoken to Erik? His father won't let him go out and seek his fortune in the world. Maybe you can help.
traduit: 你和艾瑞克聊过吗？他父亲不让他出去闯荡。也许你能帮帮忙。

original: Do enjoy your time in Rorikstead. This close to the Reach, well, we are truly blessed to have such fertile ground.
traduit: 好好享受在洛利克镇的时光吧。我们这儿已经离瑞驰很近了，能有这么肥沃的土地真是幸运。

original: You there! Wait a moment.
traduit: 喂！等等。

original: Not sure, let's watch and find out.
traduit: 不确定，我们去看看吧。

original: Is that the murderer?
traduit: 那是凶手吗？

original: Okay, I'll come quietly.
traduit: 好吧，我会老实去的。

original: You're smarter than you look.
traduit: 你比看上去机灵多了。

original: I'd rather die than go to jail.
traduit: 我宁死也不去监狱。

original: Resisting arrest will mean your death.
traduit: 拒捕就意味着死期到了。

original: I'm not answering any questions.
traduit: 我不会回答任何问题的。

original: Is that so? Well, perhaps a night in jail might loosen your tongue. Hmmm?
traduit: 是吗？也许在监狱里住一晚能让你想通点？

original: Alright, you are now under arrest.
traduit: 好吧，你现在被捕了。

original: Doesn't scare me.
traduit: 别想吓到我。

original: I'm not sure what happened.
traduit: 我不知道发生什么了。

original: Hmm... If you happen to recollect anything about the incident, you be sure to report to the captain of the guard.
traduit: 嗯……如果你想起什么线索，一定向卫兵队长报告。

original: Then perhaps you care to explain why you are standing so close a dead body with your weapon drawn?
traduit: 那你能解释解释为什么拿着武器站在一具尸体旁边吗？

original: Hmmm... You can go, but you stay on your best behavior now.
traduit: 嗯……你可以走了，但最好老实一点。

original: Don't know what else to say... I had nothing to do with this.
traduit: 我不知道还能说什么……但我和这事儿一点关系没有。

original: You there. What do you know about this?
traduit: 喂。你知道些什么吗？

original: If anyone saw anything, step forward. Otherwise, step away from the body!
traduit: 如果有人看到了什么，请上前。否则，离尸体远点！

original: Alright now. Everyone back away. Let the law handle this.
traduit: 好了。所有人都退后。我们依法来处理这件事。

original: Looks dead to me.
traduit: 看来是没救了。

original: Is he... dead?
traduit: 他……死了？

original: Is she... dead?
traduit: 她……死了？

original: Oh no... what happened here?
traduit: 哦，不……发生什么了？

original: If anyone falls, it will be you.
traduit: 如果有人会死，那必然是你。

original: Then the die is cast, and once again my blade will taste Nightingale blood!
traduit: 既然如此，我之剑刃将再饮夜莺之血！

original: The difference is I still have honor.
traduit: 区别在于我心中还有荣耀感。

original: It's clear you'll never see the Skeleton Key as I do... as an instrument of limitless wealth.
traduit: 显然你无法像我一样……把万能钥匙作为一种拥有无限财富的工具。

original: Instead you've chosen to fall over your own foolish code.
traduit: 相反，你选择了自己愚蠢的信条。

original: I don't believe you. Nocturnal guides me.
traduit: 我不相信你。诺克图娜尔会指引我。

original: Then it appears the shadows shroud more than your presence... they blind your wisdom as well.
traduit: 看来阴影不止隐藏了你的行踪……更蒙蔽了你的心智。

original: Our actions have always been one in the same; both of us lie, cheat and steal to further our own end.
traduit: 我们的行为别无二致，我们都在为自己的目的而撒谎、欺骗、偷窃。

original: It's not about Nocturnal. This is personal.
traduit: 这是个人的恩怨，与诺克图娜尔无关。

original: Revenge is it? Have you learned nothing from your time with us?
traduit: 报仇来的？你跟我们在一起这么久就没学到些什么吗？

original: When will you open your eyes and realize how little my actions differ from yours?  Both of us lie, cheat and steal to further our own end.
traduit: 什么时候你才能睁开眼睛，看清楚你我只是一丘之貉？我们都在为了自己的目的而撒谎、欺骗、偷窃。

original: Give me the Key, Mercer.
traduit: 墨瑟，把钥匙交给我。

original: What's Karliah been filling your head with? Tales of thieves with honor? Oaths rife with falsehoods and broken promises?
traduit: 卡莱亚给你灌输了什么？盗亦有道？充满谎言和背叛的誓言？

original: Nocturnal doesn't care about you, the Key or anything having to do with the Guild.
traduit: 诺克图娜尔根本不在乎钥匙、公会或是你。

original: TG08BMercerOutroBranchTopic
traduit: TG08BMercerOutroBranchTopic

original: When Brynjolf brought you before me I could feel a sudden shift in the wind.
traduit: 当布林乔夫把你带到我面前的时候，我就感觉到，风向转了。

original: And at that moment, I knew it would end with one of us at the end of a blade.
traduit: 那时我就知道，你我必有一人死于刀下。

original: Why plant the ring on Brand-Shei?
traduit: 为什么要把戒指放到布兰德-谢身上？

original: There's someone that wants to see him put out of business permanently. That's all you need to know.
traduit: 有人想让他永远做不成生意。你知道这些就够了。

original: Now, you tell me when you're ready and we'll get started.
traduit: 现在，等你准备好，我们就开始。

original: I'll be out in the market all day, from eight in the morning until eight in the evening.
traduit: 我每天都会在市场上，早八点到晚八点。

original: Meet me then if you've still got the stomach for it.
traduit: 有想法的话就来找我吧。

original: Force of habit, I guess.
traduit: 我想这就是习惯的力量吧。

original: I see... and this "force of habit," does it also compel you to murder?
traduit: 我知道了……所以这种“习惯的力量”也会迫使你去杀人吗？

original: But don't underestimate the Stormcloaks. Many are Legion veterans. They may be traitors, but they know how to fight.
traduit: 但不要低估风暴斗篷。他们很多都是军团的退伍军人。虽然是叛徒，但他们知道该如何战斗。

original: Let's show these rebels what real soldiers look like.
traduit: 让叛军看看什么才叫真正的士兵。

original: Good. If you need any details on your marks, I'll be here. Now get going.
traduit: 好。如果需要任何关于目标的细节，随时找我。现在去吧。

original: How did you want me to handle it?
traduit: 你想让我怎么处理？

original: Honestly, the debt is secondary here. What's more important is that you get the message across that we aren't to be ignored.
traduit: 老实说，清债是次要的。更重要的是，得让大伙明白，我们不容忽视。

original: A word of warning though... I don't want any of them killed. Bad for business.
traduit: 不过我要警告你一句……我不想他们有人被杀。这对业务不利。

original: There's just one more target before we strike out at the Emperor.
traduit: 在我们刺杀皇帝前，还有一个目标。

original: Have you by chance heard of the "Gourmet"? Read his cookbook? It's become quite a phenomenon.
traduit: 有没有听说过“美食家”？看过他写的食谱吗？那可是风靡一时啊。

original: The Gourmet is scheduled to cook for the Emperor at a special dinner. You'll kill him, steal his Writ of Passage, and assume the roll of master chef.
traduit: 美食家将会为皇帝准备特别的一餐。杀了他，偷走他的通行证，然后冒充主厨。

original: Festus has been spearheading this part of the assassination plan. He's close to uncovering the identity of the Gourmet. You should report to him.
traduit: 菲斯图斯主持这次暗杀计划。他马上就要查出美食家的身份了。你去找他报到吧。

original: Right. So what's my next task?
traduit: 是的。那我下一个任务是什么？

original: Deadbeats? What'd they do?
traduit: 老赖？他们做了什么？

original: They owe our organization some serious coin and they've decided not to pay.
traduit: 他们欠我们组织很多钱，而且决定不还了。

original: I want you to explain to them the error of their ways.
traduit: 我希望你让他们明白自己做错了。

original: Sounds good. Who are they?
traduit: 听起来不错。都是谁？

original: Keerava, Bersi Honey-Hand and Haelga.
traduit: 基拉瓦，“甜手”波西还有哈尔嘉。

original: Do this right, and I can promise you a permanent place in our organization.
traduit: 好好干，我保证你能在组织里拿个铁饭碗。

original: Will I get a cut?
traduit: 我能分一杯羹吗？

original: Of course you'll get a cut. We take care of our own.
traduit: 当然有分红。我们也很照顾自己人。

original: Now if you need any details on your marks, I'll be here. Get going.
traduit: 如果需要任何关于目标的情报，随时找我。现在去吧。

original: You have no business in our stronghold, outlander.
traduit: 你与我们的要塞无关，外来者。

original: Malacath blesses this land for the Orcs. And the Orcs alone.
traduit: 玛拉凯斯为兽人祝福了这片土地。这里只属于兽人。

original: We won't kill you, outlander, but we don't want you here.
traduit: 我们不会杀你的，外来者，但我们不欢迎你在这儿。

original: Most of my kin are in the longhouse. Come back during the day if you wish to trade.
traduit: 我的大多数亲族都在长屋里休息。想要交易的话就等白天再来吧。

original: It's late outlander. Come back in the morning if you need to spend coin.
traduit: 现在太晚了，外来者。想要买东西的话明天请早吧。

original: We only trade during the day, outlander. At night, most rest in the longhouse.
traduit: 我们只在白天贸易，外来者。现在天晚了，大家都回长屋休息了。

original: I'm here to mine, outlander. So unless you want to dig, get out.
traduit: 我在这里是挖矿的，外来者。除非你也许挖，否则就出去。

original: I have metal to dig.
traduit: 我还要继续挖矿呢。

original: Malacath has given me the task to mine. Good ore brings strength to our people.
traduit: 玛拉凯斯将挖矿的任务交给了我。好的矿石能给我们一族带来力量。

original: Every Orc learns the heavy labor of mining. All spend years in the caves.
traduit: 每个兽人都学会了挖掘这项重体力劳动。都要在洞穴里度过几年。

original: The mines are hard, but Malacath rewards those who rise to the challenge.
traduit: 开矿很难，但玛拉凯斯会奖赏那些勇于挑战的人。

original: This is High Hrothgar, our temple, sanctuary, and home. We ask that you respect our solitude while you are here.
traduit: 这里是霍斯加修道院，我们的神殿、圣殿、家园。我们希望你来到这里时能够尊重我们的宁静独处。

original: Your training proceeds well, Dragonborn.
traduit: 你训练得不错，龙裔。

original: What do you need, Dragonborn?
traduit: 龙裔，你需要什么？

original: Do you need something?
traduit: 你需要些什么吗？

original: Eh? Did you say something?
traduit: 啊？你说了什么吗？

original: You'll have to speak up. I'm a little deaf in my right ear.
traduit: 你得大点声，我右耳有些耳背。

original: Drem Yol Lok. Greetings.
traduit: 旦姆 约 洛克。你好。

original: Speak. I will listen.
traduit: 说吧，我听着呢。

original: Dovahkiin.
traduit: 都瓦克因。

original: Ah! You made it! Good to see you, my friend. I'll never forget how you saved my life from those Thalmor maniacs.
traduit: 啊！你做到了！很高兴见到你，朋友。我不会忘记是你把我从那些梭默疯子手里救下来的。

original: So you made it out. Good for you. Don't expect me to thank you. I still remember what you did to me.
traduit: 所以你成功了。这对你有好处。但别指望我感激你。我还记得你对我做过的事。

original: Ah... so tender. Come here, you morsel!
traduit: 啊……好柔软。过来，你这个小东西！

original: Keep an eye out for wolves if you're headed up the path to High Hrothgar.
traduit: 如果你要去霍斯加修道院，千万注意路上的狼群。

original: What is your need, Dragonborn?
traduit: 龙裔，你需要什么？

original: Lead me into battle.
traduit: 带我去战斗。

original: I answer the call of the Dragonborn.
traduit: 我回应龙裔的召唤。

original: I serve the Dragonborn.
traduit: 我为龙裔服务。

original: I'd like to think about it.
traduit: 我得考虑一下。

original: All right, but hurry. Who knows if Azura is watching us?
traduit: 好吧，但请快点。谁知道阿祖拉是不是正在监视咱们？

original: Let's do it.
traduit: 我们开始吧。

original: Give me a minute to examine the Star. I'll see what we'll need to do.
traduit: 稍等一会儿，我要检查一下这颗星。看看需要做些什么。

original: It sounds like Malyn got what was coming to him.
traduit: 听起来马林是咎由自取了。

original: The College would agree with you, but do you have any idea how many innocent lives were cut short, just so Azura could have revenge?
traduit: 学院也是这么说，但你知不知道，因为阿祖拉的复仇，有多少人无辜枉死？

original: We're nothing to the Daedra. Pawns to move around, praise, and punish as they see fit.
traduit: 我们对迪德拉而言不算什么。只是可以随意摆布、夸奖、惩罚的棋子。

original: Stay away! Last time you hurt me.
traduit: 躲开！你刚刚伤害过我。

original: I don't want to fight you again.
traduit: 我不想再和你打架了。

original: Hey! You're the one that hurt me!
traduit: 嘿！上次是你伤了我！

original: You gonna hurt me again?
traduit: 你又要来伤害我了？

original: You! Don't hurt me! Not again!
traduit: 你！别打我！别！

original: I don't want any trouble. Not after what you did to me last time.
traduit: 我不想找麻烦。你刚对我做过那种事。

original: You! Back to inflict more pain on me?
traduit: 你！又来给我带来痛苦了？

original: I hope you're not planning to attack me again...
traduit: 希望你不是打算再袭击我一次……

original: If you provoke me, I will be forced to unsheathe my claws.
traduit: 如果你再激怒我，我会被迫亮出自己的爪子。

original: I don't want to be hurt again!
traduit: 我不想再受伤了！

original: You wouldn't attack an old woman again, would you?
traduit: 你不会想再攻击一个老太太吧？

original: You here to attack me? I'm ready for you this time.
traduit: 你又来攻击我了？这次我可有准备了。

original: You have a lot of nerve coming near me again. I'm still sore from what you did to me.
traduit: 你可真不要脸，还敢靠近我。我还在为你对我的所作所为困扰呢。

original: Please! Don't hurt me again!
traduit: 拜托！别再伤害我了！

original: No! Don't hurt me again!
traduit: 不！别再伤害我了！

original: This one's claws are ready for you should you assault me again.
traduit: 如果你再攻击我，那这爪子就是给你准备的。

original: If you try to hurt me again, I may have to kill you.
traduit: 如果你再攻击我，我可能得杀你了。

original: Attack me again and I'll hunt you down!
traduit: 再攻击我，我就干掉你！

original: Ah! No more! Don't hurt me again.
traduit: 啊！别来了！别再伤害我了。

original: Come back to gloat? I've been beaten by worse than you.
traduit: 回来幸灾乐祸？我被比你更厉害的人打败过呢。

original: Don't come near me! I don't want to get hurt again.
traduit: 别靠近我！我不想再受伤害。

original: Uh, oh. You ain't gonna hurt me again, are ya?
traduit: 哦哦。你不会又想伤害我吧？

original: You're the brute that hurt me before.
traduit: 你是以前伤害过我的那个禽兽。

original: Hey! Don't get mad and hurt me again.
traduit: 嘿！别发疯又伤到我了。

original: Look, I don't want to get in another brawl with you.
traduit: 听着，我不想再和你吵了。

original: You wouldn't attack an old man again, would you?
traduit: 你不会再袭击老人家了吧？

original: I don't go down easy if you raise your hand against me again.
traduit: 如果你再对我动手，我是不会轻易认输的。

original: Well, if it isn't the bully that goes around hurting people.
traduit: 哈，这不是那个四处伤人的恶霸吗？

original: Ah! Are you planning on hurting me again?
traduit: 啊！你打算再伤害我一次？

original: If it's a fight you want, I'm ready this time.
traduit: 如果你想打架，这次我可准备好了。

original: You did it. You killed it. Now cut me down before anything else shows up.
traduit: 你办到了。你杀了它。快在其他东西出现之前把我放了。

original: What? Who are you? Oh, never mind. Cut me down before that thing gets us!
traduit: 什么？你是谁？哦，无所谓。在那东西把我们抓住前放了我！

original: I have the golden claw.
traduit: 我拿到黄金龙爪了。

original: I better get back to cleaning the store. What a mess.
traduit: 我得回去收拾商店了。真是搞得一团糟。

original: Damn thieves. As if things weren't bad enough.
traduit: 该死的小偷。好像事情还不够乱一样。

original: Where are you going? Come back!
traduit: 你要去哪儿？回来！

original: Wait, come back!
traduit: 等等，回来！

original: Noooo!
traduit: 不！

original: Aaaaagh!
traduit: 啊啊啊！

original: Cut me down, or you'll never get the claw!
traduit: 放我下来吧，否则你永远拿不到爪子！

original: Where are you... get me down from this!
traduit: 你在哪儿……快放我下来！

original: Sorry, but I have a treasure to get to...
traduit: 抱歉，但我还有个宝藏要拿……

original: So long "friend." Ha ha ha!
traduit: 再会了，“朋友”。哈哈哈！

original: Good luck. Lucan and I will be waiting for you back in the shop.
traduit: 祝你好运，我和卢坎在店里等你。

original: Yes, we did have a bit of a... break-in. But we still have plenty to sell. Robbers were only after one thing.
traduit: 是的，我们确实被……抢了。但我们还有很多东西可卖，抢匪只是拿走了一件东西。

original: An ornament, solid gold. In the shape of a dragon's claw.
traduit: 一个龙爪形状的纯金装饰品。

original: Did something happen?
traduit: 出什么事了？

original: You mean before he died? We had a break in. Thieves didn't touch anything on the shelves, or any coin, just one thing.
traduit: 你是说他生前那次吗？有贼闯进来，货架和钱都没动，只抢走了一件东西。

original: A solid gold ornament, in the shape of a dragon's claw.
traduit: 一个龙爪形状的纯金装饰品。

original: What were you arguing about with Lucan?
traduit: 你和卢坎在争什么？

original: Show those thieves not to steal from Lucan Valerius!
traduit: 教训那些贼不要再偷卢坎·瓦勒瑞斯的东西！

original: The sooner you find the claw, the sooner our lives can get back to normal.
traduit: 越早找回龙爪，我们的生活就能越早恢复正常。

original: You're back from Bleak Falls. Did you find anything?
traduit: 你从荒瀑古坟回来了啊。找到什么了吗？

original: Don't let my sister do anything foolish.
traduit: 别让我妹妹做傻事。

original: I don't know what you overheard, but the Riverwood Trader is still open. Feel free to shop.
traduit: 我不知道你听到了什么，但河木镇贸易行照常营业。请随意选购。

original: You're not getting that treasure.
traduit: 你拿不到宝藏。

original: I'm too swift for you!
traduit: 我跑得比你快！

original: Lucan over in the Riverwood Trader says thieves broke into his store. Strange, he says they hardly took anything.
traduit: 河木镇贸易行的卢坎说有贼闯店，但是，什么都没拿走。

original: Did you hear? The Riverwood Trader was robbed! Poor Lucan must be torn to pieces over it.
traduit: 听说了吗？河木镇贸易行被抢了！可怜的卢坎一定快气疯了。

original: I heard Lucan yelling the other day about a thief breaking into his store. It wasn't me, honest!
traduit: 那天我听见卢坎大喊有贼。那可不是我，真的！

original: Maybe you could talk some sense into my pig-headed brother.
traduit: 也许你应该劝劝我那个猪头哥哥。

original: Lucan's dead. I guess I'm in charge of the Riverwood Trader now.
traduit: 卢坎死了。我得运营河木镇贸易行了。

original: I guess Lucan will never see the golden claw again now.
traduit: 看来卢坎再也看不到黄金龙爪了。

original: Mara bless you for agreeing to help us.
traduit: 玛拉会因为你帮助我们的善举保佑你的。

original: If you're going after the claw, you'll need to know the way.
traduit: 如果你要去找龙爪，得知道路怎么走。

original: So, you need a guide out of town after all?
traduit: 所以，你还是需要个向导带你出镇子吧？

original: Bleak Falls Barrow is just outside of town. I can show you.
traduit: 荒瀑古坟就在镇子外面。我可以告诉你。

original: You have the claw. Oh, you have to tell Lucan at once. Hurry!
traduit: 你找到龙爪了。哦，快去告诉卢坎。快！

original: Hurry up and tell Lucan you have the claw. He'll be so excited!
traduit: 快点告诉卢坎你拿到龙爪了。他会很高兴的。

original: For the Empire!
traduit: 为了帝国！

original: Time to show what you're really made of.
traduit: 是时候展现你们的实力了。

original: Everybody ready? We charge on my signal.
traduit: 准备好了吗？等我的信号就冲锋。

original: Things look quiet enough here. Come on. There's my uncle.
traduit: 这里很宁静吧。来，这是我叔叔。

original: How did you know I'd be able to defeat Ancano?
traduit: 你怎么知道我能击败安卡诺？

original: A great many things obscured to you are quite clear to us. We have long believed you would prevail.
traduit: 有许多事情，你们不明白，但我们却懂。我们一直相信你会获胜。

original: The Eye has grown unstable. It cannot remain here, or else it may destroy your College and this world.
traduit: 眼已经开始不稳定了。不能留在这里，否则就会摧毁你们学院和整个世界。

original: It must be secured. Ancano's actions prove that the world is not ready for such a thing.
traduit: 必须确保安全。安卡诺的行径足以证明，这个世界还没有做好准备。

original: We shall safeguard it... for now.
traduit: 我们会保管它……目前吧。

original: You now have the opportunity to maintain your College, and carry on with your lives.
traduit: 你们现在有机会重回学院，重新开始生活了。

original: You have our gratitude, Arch-Mage.
traduit: 向您致谢，大法师阁下。

original: We knew you would succeed.
traduit: 我们知道你会成功的。

original: Your victory here justifies our belief in you. You have proven yourself more than worthy to guide the College of Winterhold.
traduit: 你的胜利证明我们的信任是没错的。你已经证明自己能够胜任对冬堡学院的指导。

original: You dare approach me here? Are you mad? You cannot hope to defeat me!
traduit: 你竟敢找上门来？你疯了？凭你休想打败我！

original: The College will not fall!
traduit: 学院不会失败！

original: We will prevail!
traduit: 我们会胜利的！

original: I'll not go down without a fight!
traduit: 我绝不会不战而降！

original: It is time for us to go.
traduit: 我们该走了。

original: I have no quarrel with you.
traduit: 我和你没有过节。

original: I'm afraid you do.
traduit: 恐怕是有的。

original: Get out of my way.
traduit: 躲开。

original: You fool. You don't stand a chance.
traduit: 笨蛋，你没机会了。

original: dunHillgrundsTombSharedAuntQuestion
traduit: dunHillgrundsTombSharedAuntQuestion

original: Sigh... I'm not proud of it. I'm terrified of that place and Aunt Agna knows it.
traduit: 哎……我并不觉得光荣。但我很怕那个地方，阿格娜姑姑也知道这点。

original: My Da locked me in there in a drunken rage when he left us... three days in there eating the offerings left for our dead before Aunt Agna found me.
traduit: 我爸喝醉之后把我锁在里面离开了。在阿格娜姑姑找到我之前，我在里面吃了三天祭品。

original: Agh! It... hurts...
If I can just... stand up...
traduit: 如果我……能站起来……

original: I'll... get you...
traduit: 我……要打倒你……

original: This... isn't over...
traduit: 还……没完……

original: All right... End it...
traduit: 好吧……结束吧……

original: Come on. Finish it!
traduit: 来啊。结束啊！

original: Please... mercy...
traduit: 拜托……饶命……

original: No... not like this...
traduit: 不……别再来了……

original: You really shouldn't be in here, but I guess since it's you...
traduit: 你真不该来这里，不过既然是你……

original: If you were anyone else, I'd make you leave.
traduit: 要是别人，我就轰走了。

original: You're not really supposed to... you know, be here.
traduit: 你不应该……那个，在这里。

original: You know you're not supposed to be in here right now.
traduit: 你知道现在不该在这里。

original: You're not really allowed in here, you know.
traduit: 你是被禁止进来的，知道吗。

original: Help yourself, by all means. Who cares if I starve?
traduit: 请自便吧。谁会在乎我饿不饿？

original: Don't worry about it. Keep it.
traduit: 别担心。拿着吧。

original: I guess you can have that.
traduit: 我想这个是可以给你的。

original: You must really need that.
traduit: 你一定很需要吧。

original: I'll look the other way this time.
traduit: 这次我就当没看见了。

original: I didn't really want that anyway.
traduit: 反正我也不想那样做。

original: I suppose that's yours now.
traduit: 就归你了吧。

original: Oh, what a clever thief you are.
traduit: 哦，你可真是个聪明贼。

original: You could have asked before just taking it.
traduit: 想要就直接说一声嘛。

original: I guess I can look the other way, this time.
traduit: 我看这次就算了。

original: Guess they deserved it...
traduit: 这就是他们自作自受吧……

original: What's done is done.
traduit: 做了就做了吧。

original: Well... that was an unpleasant bit of business.
traduit: 嗯……确实不是件值得高兴的事。

original: I didn't know you were so cold-blooded...
traduit: 我都不知道你这么冷血……

original: Remind me not to make you angry.
traduit: 记得提醒我别惹你生气。

original: I guess you had your reasons.
traduit: 你应该是事出有因吧。

original: None of my business.
traduit: 不关我的事。

original: I don't think there's a need for that!
traduit: 我觉得没必要这么做！

original: Why are you doing that?
traduit: 你为什么这么做？

original: Papa told you to do that, not me! Now leave me alone!
traduit: 爸爸是让你做，不是我！别烦我了！

original: I told you to weed the garden by sunset, and you didn't do it. Now you're in big trouble!
traduit: 我告诉过你太阳下山前把花园的草拔完，你没做到。你现在有大麻烦了！

original: Why? What did I do?
traduit: 为什么？我怎么了？

original: You're going to get it, Sissel!
traduit: 你要倒霉了，希塞尔！

original: That sounds lovely. You're very sweet.
traduit: 听起来很漂亮。你嘴就是甜。

original: Well that's where I want to build. In the fall forest. Give it an easterly view. The sunrise is almost as pretty as you are.
traduit: 我就是想在那儿盖房子。在落叶森林里，把房子弄成东西向。那里的日出和你一样美。

original: I've been there before, but I don't know it well.
traduit: 我以前去过，但不太熟。

original: There's a clear spot just west of Riften. You know the area?
traduit: 裂谷城西面有块空地。你知道那儿吗？

original: Oh? Where?
traduit: 哦？建在哪儿呢？

original: I've been thinking about building that cabin we talked about.
traduit: 我一直在考虑建我们说过的那个小木屋。

original: Perhaps. But not today.
traduit: 或许吧。但不是今天。

original: One of these days he'll have to learn.
traduit: 总有一天他会学会的。

original: I just feel like if I'm not here, then something could go wrong. Nils is a hard worker, but I wouldn't trust him to run things.
traduit: 我只是觉得如果我不在这里，可能会出问题。纽斯工作很努力，但我不放心交给他来管理。

original: Just wondering when you'll be ready to give it up and settle down. Seems like you're always working.
traduit: 只是想知道你什么时候才会放弃，然后安顿下来。看起来你一直在工作。

original: Nearly thirty years, now.
traduit: 差不多三十年了。

original: How long have you run this place, again?
traduit: 你经营这里多久了？

original: Oh! You behave, now!
traduit: 哦！瞧你这德行！

original: Hows about we figure out some way to keep warm tonight?
traduit: 不如我们想想今晚用什么办法保暖吧？

original: I'm sorry. What would you like to talk about?
traduit: 抱歉。那你想聊点什么？

original: Elda, honey, let's not talk about the war. It's in the past.
traduit: 艾尔达甜心，咱们不要谈论战争了。那都是过去的事了。

original: Tell me about the Great War. I hear you were in the battle of...
traduit: 跟我说说浩大战争吧。我听说你参加过……

original: Does Mara require more of me?
traduit: 玛拉还有什么要求吗？

original: I see you are eager to carry the light.
traduit: 我看你很希望照亮别人。

original: As you venture, Mara fills my mind ever more with visions of love in peril.
traduit: 随着你的冒险，玛拉在我的脑海中充满了爱之危机的景象。

original: Embers lie nestled in stone, needing only fuel to bloom to a flame that will warm all around them.
traduit: 依偎在石头旁边的灰烬，只要一点燃料就能重新燃烧，温暖周围的一切。

original: Go to Markarth. There you'll find Calcelmo, wise, acid, and reclusive. Help him to emerge and state his intentions.
traduit: 去马卡斯吧。隐居在那里的卡塞莫聪明而刻薄。帮他说出自己的意图。

original: This is the prayer heard by the goddess and relayed to her servants.
traduit: 这是女神听到并传给追随者的祈祷之声。

original: Out of my sight!
traduit: 一边去！

original: No... I was trying to...
traduit: 不……我是想……

original: What? You've been lollygagging in idle reading?
traduit: 什么？你一直在磨洋工看书吗？

original: Erm... no. Not yet. I'm sorry, I was reading up on the effects of distillation.
traduit: 嗯……不。还没有。抱歉，我在研究蒸馏效果。

original: Don't be so sure. Now, have you finished grinding the dried snowberries?
traduit: 别那么肯定。对了，你磨完雪浆果了吗？

original: I know, master. Don't say such things -- there is always time.
traduit: 我知道，师父。别说这样的话，时间总会有的。

original: I'm sorry to always be so hard on you, boy. I just worry I don't have much time left.
traduit: 很抱歉一直对你这么严苛，孩子。我只是担心自己时日无多了。

original: Yes, master. I'm sorry, I'll get back to those notes straight away.
traduit: 是，师父。不好意思。我马上去整理笔记。

original: You can waste your own time, not mine. An apprentice obeys his master. A good one does, at least.
traduit: 想浪费就浪费自己的时间，别浪费我的。学徒要服从师长。这是起码的好学生标准。

original: Yes, master, I know. I just want to keep up my own projects as well.
traduit: 知道了，师父。我只是想继续自己的项目。

original: When I ask you for something, I expect it to get done.
traduit: 当我要求你某件事的时候，我希望你能够把它完成。

original: Yes, and I'm working on it, but I'm also trying to...
traduit: 是的，我正在努力去办，但我也正在努力……

original: Damn it, child, didn't I tell you to gather my notes on sub-material properties?
traduit: 该死的，孩子，我不是让你去收集我关于次级物质属性的笔记吗？

original: Master, I have a question about infusions of arrowroot.
traduit: 师父，我有个关于竹芋萃取液的问题。

original: Don't waste time apologizing, just find the book!
traduit: 别浪费时间道歉了，快去找书！

original: I... I apologize, master.
traduit: 抱歉……师父。

original: Confound it, boy, I know what I'm doing. It will help me determine the season of his burial, which I can cross-reference.
traduit: 胡说，小子，我知道我在做什么。这能帮我确定他下葬的季节，我可以进行交叉比对。

original: Did they really record the star positions from Curalmil's tomb? There's no way it's that precise.
traduit: 他们真的从库拉米尔的坟墓上记录了星星的位置吗？不可能那么精确吧。

original: Quintus, could you fetch me a copy of The Firmament? I need to compare the old star charts to today's.
traduit: 奎因图斯，帮我拿份《苍穹》的副本好吗？我需要把旧的星象图和今天的比对一下。

original: I'd like a drink.
traduit: 我想喝点什么。

original: Here you go, sir. The finest Colovian brandy.
traduit: 先生，请用。上好的科洛文白兰地。

original: Is there anything else I can get for you?
traduit: 还有什么我能效劳的吗？

original: Here you go, ma'am. The finest Colovian brandy.
traduit: 女士，请用。上好的科洛文白兰地。

original: We seem to have run out of Colovian brandy. I'll check in the wine cellar for more when I get a moment.
traduit: 我们的科洛文白兰地似乎用光了。我抽空去酒窖看看吧。

original: Here you go, sir. Colovian brandy.
traduit: 先生，请用。科洛文白兰地。

original: Here you go, miss. Colovian brandy.
traduit: 女士，请用。科洛文白兰地。

original: I'm sorry, but I think you've had enough for the moment.
traduit: 实在抱歉。我觉得您已经喝得够多了。

original: Oooh, wonderful! I can't wait!
traduit: 哦，太棒了！我快等不及了！

original: Hmph. Most certainly not. But perhaps I can teach you how to put some candles out. We'll start there.
traduit: 嗯。肯定不行。但也许我可以教你怎么熄灭蜡烛。我们从这里开始吧。

original: I understand. I'm sorry. I just get so excited thinking about it. So... can we. Do some fire magic?
traduit: 我明白了。抱歉。我只是一想到就会很兴奋。所以……我们能，来点火焰魔法吗？

original: Shh shh. It's fine, child. It's fine. But we must be cautious, hmm? What we do, the things I teach you. The others wouldn't understand.
traduit: 嘘。没事儿，孩子。没事儿。但我们必须谨慎，对吧？我们做的事，我教你的东西，别人是不会理解的。

original: Oh! I'm... I'm sorry. I didn't mean to upset you.
traduit: 哦！我……抱歉。我不是故意让你难堪的。

original: By the Eight, keep your voice down! Do you want the entire village to learn our secrets?
traduit: 八圣灵啊，小声点！你打算让全村都知道咱们的秘密吗？

original: I was just wondering. The next time we meet, do you think maybe you could teach me some fire magic? Nothing dangerous! Maybe a candle lighting spell?
traduit: 我只是想知道，下次咱们见面的时候，你能不能教我一些火焰魔法？不用危险的！也许就烛光术也行？

original: Jouane?
traduit: 乔安内？

original: TG08BHellos
traduit: TG08BHellos

original: Let's get out of here before we end up like Mercer!
traduit: 趁我们还没变成墨瑟那样赶紧走吧！

original: Aye, there will be blood today. I can promise you that.
traduit: 对，今天必有一场血战。相信我。

original: Crime is one thing, murder is another. Mercer will answer for this.
traduit: 犯罪是犯罪，谋杀是谋杀。墨瑟必须为此负责。

original: I'd just assume die before I'd let Mercer get those gems.
traduit: 我死也不会让墨瑟拿走宝石。

original: Do the Falmer also have no sense of smell? This place reeks!
traduit: 伐莫没有嗅觉吗？这地方也太臭了！

original: The Eyes would go a long way in helping get the Guild back on its feet.
traduit: 伐莫之眼将会帮助公会重整旗鼓。

original: I can't wait to get my hands around that bastard's neck.
traduit: 我等不及要活活掐死那个混蛋了。

original: By Talos, Mercer has a lot to answer for.
traduit: 塔洛斯在上，墨瑟有的是债要还呢。

original: This place is coming down. Let's get out of here!
traduit: 这地方要垮了。我们得离开这儿！

original: With any luck, this will be Mercer's final day alive.
traduit: 不管怎么样，这都是墨瑟在人世的最后一天了。

original: This place, it's like a maze. How did the dwarves find their way around?
traduit: 这地方简直就是个迷宫。矮人们是怎么找到路的？

original: This is just like old times.
traduit: 这里还和以前一样。

original: Keep as quiet as you can. The Falmer may be blind, but they can still hear us.
traduit: 尽量保持安静。伐莫虽然瞎了，但还是能听到我们的。

original: If Mercer leaves here with the Eyes, we'll never see him again.
traduit: 如果墨瑟带着伐莫之眼逃了，那咱们就再也找不到他了。

original: We have to get the Key back.
traduit: 我们得把钥匙拿回来。

original: Mercer's here. I can feel it.
traduit: 墨瑟就在这儿。我能感觉到。

original: Be careful, there's no telling what lurks within these walls.
traduit: 小心，谁也说不准墙里藏着什么。

original: We should tread carefully. I wouldn't be surprised if he's left behind a few surprises for us.
traduit: 我们得小心。就算他给咱们留了些惊喜也没什么好惊讶的。

original: TG08BKarliahIntroBranchTopic
traduit: TG08BKarliahIntroBranchTopic

original: Mercer's been here, I hope we aren't too late.
traduit: 墨瑟来过了，希望咱们没来晚。

original: He can't treat me like that. He needs me.
traduit: 他不能那样对我。他需要我。

original: Rulindil, pah! One day, the shoe will be on the other foot.
traduit: 鲁林迪尔，呸！早晚有你好看。

original: I knew he was telling the truth. I always can tell.
traduit: 他说的是实话。我看得出来。

original: They're scared of the dragons, too, aren't they? Paying too well. They don't know anything.
traduit: 他们也在害怕龙不是吗？但报酬太高了。他们什么都不知道。

original: Etienne must know something related to the dragons... who else might know? Greasy Thom... no, they'd see right through him...
traduit: 艾逖恩肯定知道一些关于龙的情报……还有谁可能知道呢？格雷西·托姆……不，他一眼就能被看穿……

original: That would probably be best.
traduit: 那最好不过了。

original: Now get out!
traduit: 现在出去！

original: No, no. I'll... I'll wait outside.
traduit: 不，不。我……我就在外面等着。

original: You'd like to come downstairs with me, is that it, Gissur?
traduit: 你想和我一起下楼吗，吉苏尔？

original: Shall we loose his bonds and put you in a cell together? You can ask him anything you like, and see how he answers.
traduit: 要不我们把他的铐子打开，再把你们关在一起？这样你就能随心所欲问他问题了，看看他会怎么答复你。

original: Can I... I could help you. He'd talk to me. He trusts me.
traduit: 我……我可以帮你的。他会跟我说话。他信任我。

original: Everyone talks, in the end.
traduit: 到最后，所有人都会说的。

original: Now, I have work to do. Leave me to it, if you ever want to see the rest of your payment.
traduit: 我现在还有工作要处理。如果打算要你剩下的报酬，就不要搅和我了。

original: So he has talked! I knew it!
traduit: 他这么说的？我知道！

original: You'll get the rest of your money when we confirm his story. As agreed.
traduit: 等我们证实了他所说的，就把约定的剩余报酬给你。

original: But no one else has brought you such valuable information, have they?
traduit: 但你也是第一次收到这么有价值的消息啊？

original: Etienne, he's talked, hasn't he? He knows where that old man is you're looking for, he told me himself.
traduit: 艾逖恩已经招了啊！他供出了你们要找的那个老头在哪，是他告诉我的。

original: Do not presume, Gissur. You are most useful, but do not presume. We have other informants who are less... offensive.
traduit: 别太高看自己了，吉苏尔。你确实很得力，但也别太自信了。我们还有其他更……听话的线人。

original: Silence!
traduit: 安静！

original: I have my own expenses you know...
traduit: 你应该清楚，我有我自己的开销。

original: But, I need that money! I earned it.
traduit: 但我需要那笔钱！那是我应得的。

original: Can you tell me more about your missing son?
traduit: 你能跟我说说你失踪的儿子吗？

original: Not here. Let's speak at my home, where we can be alone, unwatched.
traduit: 不能在这儿。去我家谈吧，那里私密，不会被人监视。

original: Thorald's disappearance has been hard on all of us, but Avulstein has taken it badly.
traduit: 索拉德失踪我们都很难过，但阿武斯特恩更难过。

original: He's afraid of being taken as well, so he hasn't left the house. All he talks about is Thorald.
traduit: 他害怕也被带走，所以足不出户。成天都在念叨索拉德。

original: Please, help Avulstein if you can. Something has to be done, or we're all going to lose our minds.
traduit: 拜托了，帮帮阿武斯特恩。必须做点什么，否则我们都要疯了。

original: Can you tell me anything else about what's going on?
traduit: 能告诉我发生什么了吗？

original: How can you be sure your son is alive?
traduit: 你怎么确定你儿子还活着？

original: I just... I just know it. I can feel it in my heart. You have to believe me.
traduit: 我……就是知道。母子连心。你要相信我。

original: Please, visit me at my home. I can tell you the whole story.
traduit: 拜托了，请到我家来。我会告诉你来龙去脉。

original: How do you know they're lying?
traduit: 你怎么知道他们在撒谎？

original: It's not wise to discuss it here. Please, if you truly wish to help, meet me at my home. I'll tell you the whole story.
traduit: 在这里讨论不明智。如果你真想帮忙，请到我家来。我会告诉你来龙去脉。

original: All I can think about is my son, my Thorald... they say that he was killed, but I know better. I know my son is alive!
traduit: 我满脑子都是我儿子，索拉德……他们说他被杀了，但我清楚得很。我知道我儿子还活着！

original: Those Battle-Born... they're in with the Imperials. They know it too, and yet they lie to my very face!
traduit: 那些战狂……都是帝国的人。他们心知肚明，却当面扯谎！

original: You have a job to do.
traduit: 你还有工作要做。

original: You want to get paid? Do what I hired you for.
traduit: 你想得到报酬？那就去干我雇你做的事。

original: Doesn't sound like something I'm interested in.
traduit: 听起来我不太感兴趣。

original: I don't mind hurting someone for money.
traduit: 我不介意为了钱去害人。

original: No funerals, just some pain. If you get caught, it's not my problem.
traduit: 没有葬礼，给点苦头就行。如果你被抓了，那不关我的事。

original: No killing. I'm not hiring the Dark Brotherhood, here. If you get caught, it's not my problem.
traduit: 不要杀人。我没打算雇佣黑暗兄弟会的。如果你被抓了，别把我供出去。

original: Just cause some pain. I don't want a death on my conscience. If you get caught, it's not my problem.
traduit: 给点苦头就好了。我不想良心不安。如果被抓了，别把我供出去。

original: Hurt him. I mean her. Whichever. No killing though. And I ain't paying your fine if you get caught.
traduit: 给他个教训。我是说她。随便啦。尽量别杀人。如果你被抓了，我可不负责往外赎。

original: I hope I can hear the screams. But don't let on it's from me! And I'm not paying your fine if you get caught.
traduit: 真希望能听到那尖叫声。但千万别让别人知道是我指使的！如果你被抓了，我可不负责交罚款。

original: Make it quick, but make it hurt. If you get caught by the guards, I don't know you.
traduit: 做得利索点，但要打痛。如果被卫兵抓了，别说我认识你。

original: Good. No killing, though. Don't get arrested. I won't help you.
traduit: 好。就是别闹出人命。别被抓到。我是不会帮你的。

original: Make it hurt. But not too much. No killing. And don't let the guards catch you.
traduit: 要见点伤。但别太多。不要杀人。也别让卫兵抓住你。

original: It should hurt. A lot. But I'm not paying for murder. Oh, if you're caught, it's not my problem.
traduit: 要让它多受点伤。但我可不会为谋杀买账。被抓了也不关我事。

original: Good. Now remember - pain, and lots of it. But not to the death. If they arrest you, it's not my problem.
traduit: 好。记住。要多给点苦头。但别闹出人命。如果被抓了，不关我事。

original: You wanted to see me about something?
traduit: 你找我有事吗？

original: I heard you attacked someone in town recently.
traduit: 我听说你最近在镇上袭击了一个人。

original: Thought you might be open to doing it again... for a tidy sum.
traduit: 我想你可能会愿意再来一次……收入可观哦。

original: Heard you hit somebody in town not too long ago.
traduit: 听说你不久前在镇上打了人。

original: I'll pay to do the same, to a certain special someone.
traduit: 我会为同样的事付钱，去教训某人。

original: So you like to hurt people, huh? The town is still talking about what you did.
traduit: 所以你很喜欢伤害别人，是吗？镇上的人还在谈论你的所作所为。

original: You know, I'll pay you to attack one of my enemies...
traduit: 听着，我会付钱雇你去攻击我的敌人……

original: Yeah. You beat people up.
traduit: 哈。你刚揍过人吧。

original: Got someone I want you to hurt. Don't worry, I can pay.
traduit: 我想让你去打个人。别担心，我付得起。

original: Uh... yeah. I know you don't mind hurting people. Just look what you did to... well, you know.
traduit: 嗯……没错。我知道你不介意去伤害某人。看看你刚干了是吗……嗯，你懂的。

original: I need someone to do that to someone. I'll even pay.
traduit: 我需要有人去对付别人。我会付钱的。

original: I heard you hurt someone in town not too long ago.
traduit: 我听说你不久前在镇上打过人。

original: I'll pay you to hurt someone else. Okay?
traduit: 我付钱让你去再打一个。怎么样？

original: I heard about what you did. You hurt someone. Bad.
traduit: 我听说过你的事。伤害他人。够坏的。

original: I got someone who deserves a beating, but I need someone else to do it for me. I can pay.
traduit: 我找到了一个活该挨揍的人，需要人手。钱不是事儿。

original: Yeah. Uh, I know you hurt someone in town recently.
traduit: 嗯。啊，我知道你最近在镇上伤过人。

original: I'd like to pay you to hurt somebody else. For me.
traduit: 我愿意付钱让你去打其他人。为了我。

original: Idiot! That wasn't the deal. You were just supposed to teach them a lesson. I am not paying you...
traduit: 白痴！我是怎么说的。只是给他们个教训。我不会付钱给你了。

original: I ended up killing your enemy.
traduit: 我把你的敌人杀了。

original: They're dead? But now everyone will think I did it!
traduit: 死了？但是现在所有人都会以为是我干的！

original: What have you done? You weren't supposed to murder anyone! Gods...
traduit: 你做了什么？你不该杀人的！神啊……

original: Good. Wait. Dead? That's not what I asked for. I... uh... you should leave. I need a drink...
traduit: 好。等等。死了？我可没让你杀人啊。我……嗯……你走吧。我得喝一杯……

original: Dead? No, no, no, no, no! This is terrible. I don't know you. Get away from me!
traduit: 死了？不不不不不不！太可怕了。我不认识你。离我远点！

original: Shor's bones! What did you do that for? I would have hired the Dark Brotherhood if I'd wanted that! Get away from me.
traduit: 舒尔的骨头啊！你为什么这么做？如果我想这么干，我直接雇黑暗兄弟会不就得了！离我远点。

original: Really? What did you go and do that for? You... you need to go away.
traduit: 真的？你为什么这么做？你……你赶紧走开吧。

original: No! Tell me you're joking. Sweet Mara, what have I done? Go away. Just go away.
traduit: 不！你肯定是开玩笑吧。玛拉在上，我干了什么？消失。快消失。

original: Oh gods, what did you do that for? This is horrible. I'm not paying for murder. Get away from me.
traduit: 神啊，你为什么这么做？太可怕了。我不会为谋杀付钱的。离我远点。

original: What have you done? They'll think I did it. Wait, I did do it! I'm not paying you! This is all your fault!
traduit: 你干了什么？他们会怀疑我的。等等，我没干！我不会付钱的！都是你的错！

original: Ha! There's nothing like a few cuts and bruises to drive home a point, huh?
traduit: 哈！没什么比割伤和擦伤更能说明问题了，对吧？

original: I did what you asked.
traduit: 我照办了。

original: Good. Maybe things will be different around here from now on.
traduit: 好。也许打今儿起这里的情况会有变化。

original: Good. Let's hope it's a lesson learned.
traduit: 好。希望能让他们长点记性。

original: You what? Oh. That. Good. I hope there was a lot of blood.
traduit: 什么？哦，那好。希望你放的血够多。

original: It can't be traced back to me, can it? Was there lot's of crying? I hope so.
traduit: 这事儿不会追到我头上吧？哭得厉害吗？但愿如此。

original: Really? I hope it hurt.
traduit: 真的？希望够痛。

original: Hmph. Good. That'll teach 'em.
traduit: 嗯。好。给他们个教训。

original: Really? Good. Was there a lot of screaming? Never mind. I don't want to know.
traduit: 真的？好。尖叫声多不多？算了。我不想知道。

original: Were there tears? I hope everyone can see the bruises.
traduit: 哭了吗？希望每个人都看到伤痕。

original: Good. I hope it hurt a lot, after all the pain I've been put through.
traduit: 好。我经历了那么多痛苦，希望他们也一样感同身受了。

original: Let's see here...
traduit: 来看看……

original: Yeah, got this note.
traduit: 啊对，是这个字条。

original: I have a letter here from Quintus Navale in Windhelm. He said it was urgent.
traduit: 我这里有封信，是风舵城的奎因图斯·那瓦勒发来的。他说有急事。

original: I've got a letter and a lot of gold. Something about it being your inheritance? Oh, and... sorry for your loss.
traduit: 我这里有你一封信和一笔金币。说是你继承的遗产？哦，呃……对你的遭遇深表遗憾。

original: A letter... not sure who from. He wouldn't say. Just that he was a friend of yours.
traduit: 有你一封信……不知道那人是谁。他不愿意说。只说自己是你朋友。

original: I have a letter here for you.
traduit: 我这儿有你一封信。

original: A note from someone named Calcelmo, in Markarth.
traduit: 是马卡斯一个叫卡塞莫的寄来的。

original: It's from... Falk Firebeard at the Blue Palace? You've got friends in high places.
traduit: 是……蓝宫的“火胡”佛可？你居然还有身居高位的朋友呀。

original: Looks like that's it. Got to go.
traduit: 应该就是这样了。我得走了。

original: Do you have anything for me?
traduit: 你有东西给我吗？

original: I've been looking for you. Got something I'm supposed to deliver - your hands only.
traduit: 我一直在找你。有东西要亲手交给你。

original: Nope, sorry. Nothing.
traduit: 不，抱歉了。没什么东西。

original: Then we'd best get started.
traduit: 那我们开始吧。

original: Brynjolf is needed back at the Thieves Guild to keep order while you're away.
traduit: 你不在的时候，布林乔夫要回盗贼公会维持秩序。

original: And I... I can't bear to face Nocturnal after my failure to protect the Key.
traduit: 至于我……在我没保住钥匙之后，我无法厚颜去见诺克图娜尔。

original: I'm afraid you'll have to face the end of your journey alone.
traduit: 恐怕你得独自前往路途的终点了。

original: I take it you never used the Pilgrim's Path.
traduit: 我猜你从未走过“朝圣之路”吧。

original: It wasn't created for the Nightingales. It was created to test those who wished to serve Nocturnal in other ways.
traduit: 因为它并非为了夜莺而建。而是用来试炼那些希望以其他方式服务诺克图娜尔的人。

original: As a consequence, I have no knowledge of what you'll be facing.
traduit: 因此，我也不知道你会面对什么。

original: Sounds like it will be a simple task.
traduit: 这任务听起来不难。

original: I'm afraid it's not that simple.
traduit: 恐怕没那么简单。

original: When the Skeleton Key was stolen from the Twilight Sepulcher, our access to the inner sanctum was removed.
traduit: 万能钥匙被从黄昏坟墓偷走后，我们进入内部密室的通道就被移除了。

original: The only way to bring it back will be through the Pilgrim's Path.
traduit: 归还它的唯一方法就是穿过“朝圣之路”。

original: TG08BKarliahOutroBranchTopic
traduit: TG08BKarliahOutroBranchTopic

original: I can't believe it's over. Twenty-five years in exile and just like that, it's done.
traduit: 真不敢相信一切都结束了。二十五年的流亡生涯就这么结束了。

original: All that remains is to ensure the safe return of the Skeleton Key.
traduit: 剩下的就是将万能钥匙归还回去了。

original: Maybe they're so scared of you they ran away.
traduit: 也许他们太怕你，所以跑了。

original: I don't like it. What are they waiting for?
traduit: 我不喜欢这样。他们在等什么？

original: No, but I know they're out there. No other way they can come. Now shut it or you'll ruin our ambush.
traduit: 没有，但我知道他们在外面。他们没有别的路可走。把嘴闭上，不然你会毁了我们的埋伏。

original: You hear anything?
traduit: 听到什么了吗？

original: Today, they take away your faith. But what of tomorrow? What then? Do the elves take your homes? Your businesses? Your children? Your very lives?
traduit: 今天，他们夺走了您的信仰。但明天呢？将来呢？精灵会夺走你的家人？你的事业？你的孩子？你的生活吗？

original: The very idea is inconceivable to our Elven overlords! Sharing the heavens with us? With man? Ha! They can barely tolerate our presence on earth!
traduit: 这个想法对我们的精灵老爷们来说不可思议！与我们共享天堂？人类？哈！他们几乎不能容忍我们在地上存在！

original: And there it is, friends! The ugly truth! We are the children of man! Talos is the true god of man! Ascended from flesh, to rule the realm of spirit!
traduit: 就是这样，朋友们！这就是令人厌恶的真相！我们是人类的子孙！塔洛斯才是人类的真神！从肉体升华，统治了精魂的领域！

original: Aye, love. Love! Even as man, great Talos cherished us. For he saw in us, in each of us, the future of Skyrim! The future of Tamriel!
traduit: 啊，爱。爱！即使身为人类，伟大的塔洛斯也会珍视我们。因为他在我们身上，在我们每个人身上，看到了天际的未来！泰姆瑞尔的未来！

original: "I breathe now, in royalty, and reshape this land which is mine. I do this for you, Red Legions, for I love you."
traduit: “我现在凭王权而呼吸，重塑这片属于我的土地。我这么做是为了你们，红色军团，因为，我爱你们。”

original: But you were once man! Aye! And as man, you said, "Let me show you the power of Talos Stormcrown, born of the North, where my breath is long winter."
traduit: 但您也曾一度为人！啊！作为人类，您说过，“让我向你等展现诞生于北境，呼吸如漫长严冬的风暴王冠塔洛斯的力量吧。”

original: And deserve our praise you do, for we are one! Ere you ascended and the Eight became Nine, you walked among us, great Talos, not as god, but as man!
traduit: 您值得我们赞美，因为我们同源！伟大的塔洛斯啊，在您升天，将八圣灵变为九圣灵之前，您曾经在我们之间行走，不是以神的身份，而是作为一个人！

original: We are but maggots, writhing in the filth of our own corruption! While you have ascended from the dung of mortality, and now walk among the stars!
traduit: 我们不过是在堕落的污秽中挣扎的蛆虫！而您已经从死亡的粪土中爬起，行走于群星之间！

original: Terrible and powerful Talos! We, your unworthy servants, give praise! For only through your grace and benevolence may we truly reach enlightenment!
traduit: 可怕而强大的塔洛斯！我们，您卑微的仆人，赞美您！因为只有凭借您的恩典和仁慈，我们才能真正达到教化！

original: Talos the mighty! Talos the unerring! Talos the unassailable! To you we give praise!
traduit: 无比强大的塔洛斯！永不错误的塔洛斯！不容置疑的塔洛斯！我们赞美您！

original: Tomorrow. I'll let you know tomorrow.
traduit: 明天。明天我再告诉你。

original: Come on now, we discussed that. I wouldn't be traveling all of Skyrim. It'd just to Whiterun and back, that's it.
traduit: 别这样，我们讨论过了。我不会走遍整个天际，只是到白漫城再回来，就这样。

original: Oh, I don't know. Yes, we'd make more money, but I don't like the idea of you traveling alone out there with the war and talk of dragons.
traduit: 哦，我不知道。没错，我们是能赚更多的钱，但我不喜欢你一个人在战争和巨龙的威胁下旅行。

original: Have you given my idea any more thought? You said you'd let me know yesterday, and that obviously didn't happen.
traduit: 你有没有再考虑一下我的想法？你说昨天就会告诉我的，但你没有。

original: That dark elf wants to go on ahead, let him. Better than us risking our necks.
traduit: 那个暗精灵想去就随他去吧。总比咱们玩儿命强。

original: So we're just supposed to sit here while Arvel runs off with that golden claw?
traduit: 所以我们就坐在这儿眼睁睁看着阿维尔带着黄金龙爪跑掉？

original: No. Not again. Help!
traduit: 不。不要。救命！

original: MS13AlrvelHelp03BranchTopic
traduit: MS13AlrvelHelp03BranchTopic

original: Hold on. You may know something important.
traduit: 等等。你应该知道一些重要的事。

original: I damn well hope so. If it helps you twist them up, I'm glad to help.
traduit: 我太乐意了。要是你能修理他们一顿，我很高兴能帮上忙。

original: They're after some old guy named Esbern. Something to do with dragons, I gathered it from listening to them talk when they thought I was out.
traduit: 他们在找一个叫伊思本的老头。这件事与龙族有关，我是假装出去之后偷听他们说的。

original: I've seen a guy in Riften who they seem to think is him.
traduit: 我曾经在裂谷城见过那个疑似是他们要找的人。

original: Not much to go on -- I don't even know where he lives, or his name. But they seemed pretty excited about it.
traduit: 但我也没什么线索。我连他住在哪、叫什么都不知道。不过他们似乎很兴奋。

original: That's it. Now, let's get out of here.
traduit: 就这样。我们离开这儿吧。

original: You go ahead. I'm not done here.
traduit: 你走吧。我还有事没办完。

original: No problem. Thanks for springing me. I owe you. Look me up in Riften if you make it out.
traduit: 没问题。多谢搭救。我欠你的。以后有机会裂谷城见。

original: I guess you know what you're doing. I've got to find a way out of here.
traduit: 我想你清楚自己在干什么。我得想办法出去。

original: Sounds good, I'll follow you.
traduit: 听起来不错。我跟你走。

original: Whatever you want. But let's go, now.
traduit: 不管你想干什么，我们现在得赶紧走。

original: If you like. But we need to find a way to unlock that trap door.
traduit: 如你所愿。不过我们得先想办法打开这扇暗门。

original: You've been very cooperative. Thanks.
traduit: 合作愉快。

original: Why don't you just kill me already.
traduit: 你为什么不杀我。

original: No time to explain. Let's get out of here. (Free him)
traduit: 没时间解释了。我们得逃出去。（释放他）

original: Yeah, sure, okay.
traduit: 对对，没错。

original: Come on, this way. I've seen the guards use it to get rid of bodies. It must lead somewhere.
traduit: 来，这边走。我见过卫兵从这里运送尸体。它肯定通向某个地方。

original: I'd like to hear it all one more time.
traduit: 我想再听一遍。

original: Fine. Whatever you want. Can't you just kill me and get it over with?
traduit: 好吧。如你所愿。你就不能杀了我了事吗？

original: There's this old man. I've seen him around Riften. I don't know where he lives. I don't know his name.
traduit: 我在裂谷城见过那个老头。我不知道他叫什么，住在哪。

original: Yes, he matches the description of this Esbern guy you're looking for. Maybe it's him. Maybe it isn't.
traduit: 没错，你要找的伊思本和他很符合。但我也不确定是不是他。

original: That's all I know, okay?
traduit: 我就知道这些，成了吗？

original: I'm not here to torture you.
traduit: 我不是来折磨你的。

original: What? Who... what do you want then?
traduit: 什么？你是谁……你想做什么？

original: I need to talk to you.
traduit: 我得跟你谈谈。

original: I told you, I don't know anything else about it.
traduit: 我跟你说了。我真的不知道更多了。

original: You fool, why should I share the treasure with anyone?
traduit: 傻子，我凭什么跟别人分享宝藏？

original: The way out is clear. Good luck.
traduit: 出去的路已经畅通了。祝你好运。

original: Thank you. When I find my daughter, it will be thanks to you.
