original: We are the rightful rulers of Markarth!
traduit: 我们才是马卡斯的合法统治者！

original: Death to the Nords!
traduit: 诺德人去死吧！

original: Glory to the Forsworn!
traduit: 为了弃誓者的荣耀！

original: Makes sense.
traduit: 有道理。

original: Aye, the last thing we want to be doing is crossing our clients.
traduit: 是啊，我们最不想的就是和自己的客户闹僵。

original: What's so important about these clients?
traduit: 这些客户有那么重要？

original: The Guild depends on an arrangement of influential people to keep things running smoothly.
traduit: 公会依靠和一些大人物的协议来维持业务的顺利进行。

original: Hmm? Oh, yes.
traduit: 嗯？哦，对。

original: Since Brynjolf assures me you'll be nothing but a benefit to us, then you're in. Welcome to the Thieves Guild.
traduit: 既然布林乔夫向我保证过你对我们有用，那就入伙吧。欢迎加入盗贼公会。

original: Mercer, aren't you forgetting something?
traduit: 墨瑟，你是不是忘了什么？

original: Goldenglow Estate is critically important to one of our largest clients.
traduit: 金色光辉庄园对我们某位最大客户至关重要。

original: However, the owner has suddenly decided to take matters into his own hands and shut us out. He needs to be taught a lesson.
traduit: 然而那里的老板突然决定单干，把我们拒之门外。得给他个教训。

original: Brynjolf will provide you with the details.
traduit: 布林乔夫会告诉你细节。

original: You claim this recruit possesses an aptitude for our line of work. If so, let him prove it.
traduit: 你说过这个新人有做咱们这行的天赋。如果真是这样，就让他证明一下吧。

original: You claim this recruit possesses an aptitude for our line of work. If so, let her prove it.
traduit: 你说过这个新人有做咱们这行的天赋。如果真是这样，就让她证明一下吧。

original: Wait a moment, you're not talking about Goldenglow, are you? Even our little Vex couldn't get in.
traduit: 等一下，你不会是说金色光辉吧？那里可是连咱们的小烦烦都进不去啊。

original: I think I'll just kill you...
traduit: 我还是杀了你吧……

original: Get it over with, then.
traduit: 那就赶紧动手吧。

original: You're making a mistake!
traduit: 你犯了个大错！

original: Now where's Esbern?
traduit: 伊思本现在何处？

original: Not at all. It's good to be put in your place once in a while.
traduit: 没有。和你比试比试也不错

original: I guess I shouldn't boast so much... it gets expensive!
traduit: 我不该这么吹嘘……代价有点贵！

original: I hope you aren't angry.
traduit: 希望你没生气。

original: You're no liar. Best fight I've had in years. There you are.
traduit: 你没吹牛。这是我这几年打得最痛快的一架。给你。

original: You ever need another blade at your side, just ask. Wouldn't mind seeing how you handle a few trolls.
traduit: 如果你还需要帮手，尽管开口。我倒是很想看看你是怎么对付巨魔的。

original: I think I've earned that 100 gold.
traduit: 我应该赢那100金币了吧。

original: You're a real fighter. I like that.
traduit: 你是个好手。我喜欢。

original: You ever need my steel by your side, you just ask.
traduit: 如果需要帮手，尽管开口。

original: My axe is yours, outlander. Just say the word.
traduit: 我的斧子算你的了，外来者。尽管开口就是。

original: You'll come with me, then?
traduit: 那你愿意和我一起去吗？

original: That you have. Here.
traduit: 你赢了。给。

original: I've earned my coin, I think.
traduit: 应该是我赢了吧。

original: Fair fight. Here you are.
traduit: 公平的一战。钱归你了。

original: You lost. Give me my money.
traduit: 你输了。把钱给我。

original: Fine. The hilt is in a chest inside my house.  Here are the keys. Take that damn thing and go.
traduit: 好吧。刀柄在我家的箱子里。给你钥匙。拿上那鬼东西赶紧走吧。

original: Give me the hilt. Now.
traduit: 现在，把刀柄给我。

original: Yeah. Here.
traduit: 没错。给你。

original: Yeah, yeah. Go on in.
traduit: 是，是。进去吧。

original: You'll let me through now?
traduit: 你现在能让我过去了吗？

original: Here. I hope you choke on it.
traduit: 给你。喝的时候小心呛死。

original: Now give me that skooma.
traduit: 现在把斯库玛给我。

original: You win. On my honor, Carlotta won't have to worry about me ever again.
traduit: 你赢了。我起誓，叫卡萝塔不用再担心了。

original: You leave Carlotta alone, or this gets worse.
traduit: 离卡萝塔远点，否则就得吃点苦头了。

original: I get your point. Tell Iddra I'm sorry for being so stubborn about the coin.
traduit: 我明白你的意思。告诉艾德拉，对钱那么执着是我不对。

original: You ready to listen to reason now?
traduit: 准备好听我解释了吗？

original: You got me, fair and square. Tell Haran I'll pay.
traduit: 你赢了，光明正大。告诉哈兰我会付钱的。

original: You ready to pay up now?
traduit: 准备好付钱了吗？

original: I yield. By the honor of Clan Shatter-Shield, the Argonians will be paid as much as any other worker.
traduit: 我输了。以碎盾氏族的荣誉起誓，阿尔贡会得到和其他工人一样的报酬。

original: You pay those Argonians fairly, or else.
traduit: 你应该给那些阿尔贡应得的报酬，不然要你好看。

original: I was sent by Nepos the Nose. The old man hands out the orders.
traduit: 是大鼻子奈波斯派我来的。那老头下的令。

original: He told me to make sure you didn't get in the way. That's all I know, I swear!
traduit: 他让我教训你不要碍事。我只知道这些，我发誓！

original: Talk, or I send you to the gods.
traduit: 快说，不然送你去和神聊聊。

original: All right. Tell the old man his debts are settled.
traduit: 好吧。告诉那老头我和他两清了。

original: Final warning. Leave Octieve alone.
traduit: 最后的警告。离奥克提夫远点。

original: All right. I'll lay off him. Just leave.
traduit: 好吧。我会让他休息。你走吧。

original: Leave Omluag alone. This is my final warning.
traduit: 离奥穆鲁阿远点。这是我最后的警告。

original: Please, stop! I'll pay! Take it!
traduit: 请住手吧！我付钱！拿去吧！

original: Please, no more. I'll pay, I'll pay. Here!
traduit: 拜托，不要再来了。我付钱，这就付。给你！

original: Here... take your damn coin and get out of here!
traduit: 给……拿上你该死的钱然后出去！

original: Well fought, ya swinging bit of skeever bait.
traduit: 打得好，你打得不错。

original: I don't believe it. I guess you were right!
traduit: 我不相信。但你是对的！

original: Your fists speak louder than your words.
traduit: 你的拳头比言语更有力。

original: You bested me, an Orc chief. Impressive.
traduit: 你比我这个兽人酋长要强。不可思议。

original: It's been so long since I tasted my own blood. Sour.
traduit: 我已经很久没尝过自己的血了。有点酸。

original: Damn addicts always stealing from me.
traduit: 该死的瘾君子总是偷我的东西。

original: Damn it. Why'd you have to walk into Morthal?
traduit: 该死的。你为什么要来莫萨尔？

original: Now that's what I call a punch. You got me.
traduit: 这拳头够劲。我输了。

original: Now that was a punch.
traduit: 这拳头够劲。

original: Wait, I can still fight. No, no I can't.
traduit: 等等，我还能打。哎，是我输了。

original: That wasn't a fair swing.
traduit: 这根本不公平。

original: Damn outsider. Why couldn't you just mind your own business?
traduit: 该死的外来者。就不能不多管闲事吗？

original: Backbiter.
traduit: 搞偷袭。

original: Damn boot-lover.
traduit: 该死的脚法。

original: You throw a mean hook.
traduit: 你的勾拳够劲。

original: What was that? Some kind of foreign move?
traduit: 那是什么？某种外国技法吗？

original: You know how to throw a punch, I'll give you that.
traduit: 不得不承认，你很会打拳。

original: I owe Thorald my life. Helping to save him is the least I can do.
traduit: 我欠索拉德一条命。我得帮他一把。

original: No one should ever be left to the Thalmor.
traduit: 没有人应该被梭默关起来。

original: The Thalmor need to be taught a lesson.
traduit: 得给梭默上一课。

original: I pledged to aid Avulstein and Thorald a long time ago. There's nothing that could keep me from helping them now.
traduit: 很久以前我就发誓要帮阿武斯特恩和索拉德。现在没什么能阻止我帮他们。

original: I must be on my way now.
traduit: 我现在得走了。

original: I owe you my life, friend.
traduit: 我的命交给你了，朋友。

original: Keep going! We need to get farther away from here!
traduit: 继续前进！我们得离这里远点！

original: Let's get out of here, fast as we can!
traduit: 我们快点离开，越快越好！

original: We're getting Thorald back, no matter what.
traduit: 无论如何我们都得把索拉德救出来。

original: Do you have news? Did you find something?
traduit: 有消息了吗？找到什么东西了？

original: Please tell me you have news of my son.
traduit: 请一定告诉我有我儿子的消息。

original: Please, let's speak privately.
traduit: 拜托，我们得私下去谈。

original: Please, anything you can do to help find my Thorald...
traduit: 求你了，无论如何要帮我找到索拉德……

original: If only you could help bring my son back to me.
traduit: 如果你能找到我儿子就好了。

original: Thorald's disappearance has left our family in shambles.
traduit: 索拉德失踪让我们家一片混乱。

original: If I hadn't heard it with my own ears I wouldn't have believed it. How could Astrid have done this to us? Strangely, I feel only pity for her...
traduit: 要不是亲耳听到，我是不会相信的。阿斯垂德怎能这样对我们？奇怪，我只是对她感到同情……

original: Astrid... By the sands, I still can't wrap my head around it...
traduit: 阿斯垂德……以沙漠之名，我还是无法理解……

original: By Sithis, what... what happened?
traduit: 西帝斯在上，发生……什么了？

original: Nazir told me what happened in Solitude. You poor dear. You've been through so much...
traduit: 纳兹尔把独孤城发生的事告诉我了。你真可怜。经历了这么多……

original: Oh, Astrid...
traduit: 哦，阿斯垂德……

original: No... No, this cannot be...
traduit: 不……不，这不可能……

original: Whoa, whoa, whoa. Slow down. It's all right. You've been through a lot. Maybe you should just sit down for a bit...
traduit: 喔，喔，喔。慢一点。没关系。你经历的事情太多了，应该坐下来休息一下……

original: I'm with you, Listener.
traduit: 我会跟着你的，聆听者。

original: Astrid did the right thing, and now it's your turn. End her suffering.
traduit: 阿斯垂德做得对。现在轮到你了，结束她的痛苦吧。

original: By Sithis, help me!
traduit: 西帝斯在上！帮我一把！

original: How do I get to the top of the mountain to see him?
traduit: 我怎么爬到山顶去见他？

original: Only those whose Voice is strong can find the path. Come. We will teach you a Shout to open the way to Paarthurnax.
traduit: 只有吼声强大之人才能开辟道路。来。我们教你一种龙吼，用来打通去见帕图纳克斯的道路。

original: Why haven't I met Paarthurnax yet?
traduit: 为什么我还没看见帕图纳克斯？

original: He lives in seclusion on the very peak of the mountain.
traduit: 他在山顶隐居。

original: He speaks to us only rarely, and never to outsiders. Being allowed to see him is a great privilege.
traduit: 他从不与外人交谈，连我们都很少与他说话。能获准见到他是种莫大的荣幸。

original: I need to speak to Paarthurnax, then.
traduit: 那我得和帕图纳克斯谈谈。

original: You weren't ready. You still aren't ready.
traduit: 你没准备好，你还没准备好。

original: But thanks to the Blades, you now have questions that only Paarthurnax can answer.
traduit: 但是多亏了刀锋会，你现在的问题只有帕图纳克斯能回答了。

original: If the Shout is lost, how can I defeat Alduin?
traduit: 如果那个龙吼失传了，我又该怎么打败奥杜因？

original: Only Paarthurnax, the master of our order, can answer that question, if he so chooses.
traduit: 只有我们教团的宗师，帕图纳克斯能回答这个问题了。前提是他愿意。

original: To get the answers you seek, you must travel to the top of the mountain and speak to our master, Paarthurnax.
traduit: 想得到你想要的答案，就得到山顶去找我们的宗师，帕图纳克斯。

original: Okay, I think this door should lead to the main burial chamber where Vals is holed up. Let's get in there and put and end to this.
traduit: 好了，我想这扇门应该通向瓦尔斯所在的主墓室了。我们进去吧，结束这一切。

original: Sigh... fine, take whatever you want, so long as you help me get rid of Vals.
traduit: 哎……好吧，随你拿吧，只要你能帮我除掉瓦尔斯就行。

original: Hey! Those belong to my family!
traduit: 嘿！那些东西是我家的！

original: Careful, there's a pressure plate around here. I've triggered it before and got pelted with darts.
traduit: 小心点，这附近有个压板，我以前触发过，还被射了几镖。

original: I'm ready. Let's go trap a dragon.
traduit: 我准备好了。让我们捕龙去吧。

original: My men know what to do. Make sure you do your part. I'm putting my city in your hands.
traduit: 我的人已经安排好了。做好你的分内之事。我可是把城市交到你的手里了。

original: Not quite yet.
traduit: 还没呢。

original: Now that it's upon us, I'm rather looking forward to the challenge. I'll be famouser than Olaf One-Eye!
traduit: 现在轮到我们了。我很期待这个挑战。我将比“独眼”奥拉夫更加出名了！

original: Get me out of here!
traduit: 把我带出去！

original: Hey, over here!
traduit: 嘿，在这里！

original: Don't leave me, for Arkay's sake!
traduit: 看在阿尔凯的份上，别丢下我！

original: Help me! Help!
traduit: 救命！救命！

original: Help me out of here!
traduit: 帮我离开这里！

original: Get me down. Get me down!
traduit: 放我下来。放我下来！

original: Ah, kill it. Kill it!
traduit: 啊，杀了它。快杀了它！

original: Get it away from me. Get it away!
traduit: 把它赶走。把它赶走！

original: Don't let it get me. Help!
traduit: 别让它把我吃了。救命！

original: Agh. Agh!
traduit: 啊。啊！

original: Keep it away from me!
traduit: 把它赶走！

original: Is it over?
traduit: 完了吗？

original: Is it dead?
traduit: 它死了？

original: Is it safe now?
traduit: 安全了吗？

original: You'll never get the claw!
traduit: 你永远得不到龙爪！

original: You found it? Ha ha ha. There it is. Strange... it seems smaller than I remember. Funny thing, huh?
traduit: 你找到了啊？哈哈哈。是它没错。怪了……怎么比我印象里要小呢。有意思啊？

original: I'm going to put this back where it belongs. I'll never forget this. You've done a great thing for me and my sister.
traduit: 我要把它放回原处了。我永远不会忘了你为我们兄妹所做的一切。

original: Thanks. I guess this was the least you could do after what happened to Camilla.
traduit: 谢谢。这也是你在凯米拉出事之后应该做的。

original: Thanks. I only wish Camilla was here to see it.
traduit: 谢谢。我只希望凯米拉也能看到。

original: Here, take this. You've done a good thing for the Riverwood Trader.
traduit: 给，收下吧。你帮河木镇贸易行做了件好事。

original: Thanks. I guess this was the least you could do after what happened to Lucan.
traduit: 谢谢。我想这是你在卢坎出事之后应该做的。

original: Thanks. I only wish Lucan was here to see this again.
traduit: 谢谢。我只希望卢坎也能看到。

original: Take this. You've done a good thing for the Riverwood Trader.
traduit: 给，收下吧。你帮河木镇贸易行做了件好事。

original: What else can you tell me about the Gourmet?
traduit: 关于美食家还有什么情报么？

original: Nobody knows his true identity. Well, nobody except Gaius Maro, and you've already taken care of him.
traduit: 无人知道他的真实身份。除了加留斯·马洛之外没人知道，而他已经被你解决了。

original: I do know the Gourmet was classically trained in traditional Breton cuisine in High Rock. So that's where he must have met Anton Virane.
traduit: 我听说美食家在高岩接受过传统的布莱顿烹饪训练。他一定是在那儿认识的安东·维拉尼。

original: In any event, our anonymous chef shares a passion for food with all of Tamriel. And that anonymity will prove the Emperor's undoing.
traduit: 无论如何，我们的匿名大厨点燃了全泰姆瑞尔的烹饪激情。但这种匿名性会害死皇帝。

original: DB08_Festus_GourmetInnBranchTopic
traduit: DB08_Festus_GourmetInnBranchTopic

original: Yes. Gaius Maro, on orders from his father, arranged for the Gourmet to come to Skyrim months ago. To serve as the Emperor's personal chef.
traduit: 没错，加留斯·马洛几个月前奉父命安排美食家来到天际。作为皇帝的御厨。

original: But the Emperor canceled his journey at the last minute. Maro was smart, kept the Gourmet around, in case things changed.
traduit: 但皇帝在出发前突然取消了行程。马洛很聪明，把美食家留了下来，以防情况变化。

original: And so, the Gourmet has remained in seclusion, somewhere in Skyrim... on indefinite hold. Probably feels like a prisoner. But you'll fix that.
traduit: 所以，美食家还隐居在天际某地。像个囚犯一样漫长的等待。但你会帮他解决的。

original: So the Gourmet is in Skyrim?
traduit: 这么说美食家在天际？

original: DB08festus_CookbookBranchTopic
traduit: DB08festus_CookbookBranchTopic

original: "Uncommon Taste." It was published a few years ago, and became a sensation throughout the Empire almost overnight.
traduit: 《奇珍异味》。几年前出版的时候，一夜便轰动了整个帝国。

original: The recipes were hailed as both practical and decadent.
traduit: 被誉为实用而堕落的食谱。

original: I've made a few of the Gourmet's dishes myself, actually. His roast mutton with Redguard berry sauce is to die for.
traduit: 我也照着做了几个菜。他的红卫浆果酱汁配烤羊肉好极了。

original: But his chocolate pate gives me the runs.
traduit: 但巧克力馅饼不太合我口味。

original: Tell me about this cookbook.
traduit: 跟我说说这本食谱。

original: Come now, you've got your orders. What else could you possibly need?
traduit: 来吧，你有命令要执行。你还需要什么？

original: Yes, well. Perhaps the proprietor of this establishment can assist you. Please, you're starting to... frighten me.
traduit: 呃，嗯。也许店老板能帮你。拜托，你有点……吓到我了。

original: Yes, well. Perhaps someone else in the village can assist you? Please, you're starting to... frighten me.
traduit: 呃，嗯。也许村里有人能帮你。拜托，你有点……吓到我了。

original: What? The Emperor? But I...
traduit: 什么？皇帝？但我……

original: Oh. Oh, by the gods, no. No, you can't do this. You can't!
traduit: 哦。哦，神啊，不。不，你不能这么做。你不能！

original: Soon, the Emperor will die. Murdered, by the Gourmet.
traduit: 皇帝很快就要被美食家谋杀了。

original: Gourmet? Why I... Um...
traduit: 美食家？我……呃……

original: Oh dear. You're going to kill me now, aren't you?
traduit: 哦，天啊。你是来杀我的吗？

original: You've served your last meal... Gourmet.
traduit: 你已经完成最后一餐了……美食家。

original: Whatever it is, I'm sure I can't be of help. I'm just here on... holiday.
traduit: 不管怎样，我肯定是帮不上什么忙。我只是在这里……度假。

original: Please, just let me be...
traduit: 请让我静静……

original: How does the Ebonmere affect all of us?
traduit: 黑檀池是怎么影响我们所有人的？

original: The Ebonmere is a conduit through which Nocturnal influences our world. Not through magic or blessings, but purely through luck.
traduit: 黑檀池是诺克图娜尔影响咱们世界的通道。不是依靠魔法或赐福，而是纯粹的运气。

original: Can't you just take the Key?
traduit: 你就不能拿走钥匙吗？

original: Whatever is affecting the Nightingale Sentinels is starting to affect me too.
traduit: 影响夜莺哨卫们的东西也开始影响我了。

original: As I get closer to the Ebonmere I begin to feel myself slipping away.
traduit: 我离黑檀池越近，就越能感觉到自己在消逝。

original: Even right this moment, I feel strange... when I don't think I should be feeling anything at all.
traduit: 即使此时此刻，我也觉得很奇怪……即使我觉得我本不该有任何感觉的时候。

original: So it's done. You've killed the Gourmet.
traduit: 所以你成功地杀掉了美食家。

original: And now Titus Mede II is as good as dead.
traduit: 现在提图斯·迈德二世离死不远了。

original: So what's this dragon's name?
traduit: 所以这头龙叫什么？

original: Ah, indeed. I'm no master of the Voice like these worthy gentlemen, but it is written here in this scroll.
traduit: 啊，确实。我不是那群老先生一样的吼声大师，但龙名就在这卷轴上。

original: Ah, indeed. I'm no master of the Voice, but it is written here in this scroll.
traduit: 啊，确实。我不是吼声大师，但龙名就在卷轴上。

original: Why would he come when called?
traduit: 为什么他会回应召唤而来？

original: He's not compelled to, but dragons are prideful by nature and loath to refuse a challenge.
traduit: 他不是被迫的。但龙族生性高傲，不会拒绝挑战。

original: Your Voice in particular is likely to intrigue this dragon, after your victory over Alduin.
traduit: 在你战胜了奥杜因之后，你的吼声很可能引起他的兴趣。

original: I think it very likely that he will be unable to resist investigating your call.
traduit: 我想他应该会忍不住去调查你的呼唤。

original: How does that help us?
traduit: 这有什么用？

original: Ah, don't you see? The names of dragons are always three Words of Power -- Shouts.
traduit: 啊，你不知道？龙族的名字往往是由三个力量之语组成，也就是龙吼。

original: By calling the dragon with the Voice, he will hear you wherever he might be.
traduit: 通过吼声呼唤，无论他身处何方，都会听到。

original: How can we lure a dragon to Dragonsreach?
traduit: 我们该如何把龙引到龙临宫呢？

original: I anticipated the problem. While you were arranging this meeting, I was busy in the library of Sky Haven Temple.
traduit: 我早料到这个问题了。在你安排会议的时候，我一直在天佑神殿的图书馆里忙活。

original: Do you promise to serve me?
traduit: 你答应效忠于我了？

original: Aam? Serve you? ...no. Ni tiid. If and when you defeat Alduin, I will reconsider.
traduit: 阿姆？效忠你？……不。尼 提德。如果到时候你打败了奥杜因，我会考虑的。

original: Hmm... krosis. There is one... detail about Skuldafn I neglected to mention.
traduit: 嗯……科洛西斯。有一个……关于斯库达芬的细节我还没提。

original: You were telling me where to find Alduin?
traduit: 你是在告诉我哪里可以找到奥杜因？

original: Unslaad krosis. Innumerable pardons. I digress.
traduit: 安斯拉德 科洛西斯。万分抱歉。我跑题了。

original: He has travelled to Sovngarde to regain his strength, devouring the sillesejoor... the souls of the mortal dead. A privilege he jealously guards...
traduit: 他已前往松加德，通过吞食斯乐瑟约尔……凡人死者的灵魂恢复力量。这是他紧紧守护的权能。

original: His door to Sovngarde is at Skuldafn, one of his ancient fanes high in the eastern mountains.
traduit: 他前往松加德的传送门设在斯库达芬。那里是他藏在东部群山高处的古老神殿。

original: Mindoraan, pah ok middovahhe lahvraan til. I surely do not need to warn you that all his remaining strength is marshalled there.
traduit: 米多兰，帕 欧克 米多瓦赫 拉维兰 提尔。我应该不需要再提醒你，他的剩余力量全都汇集到那里了。

original: Zu'u lost ofan hin laan... now that I have answered your question, you will allow me to go free?
traduit: 祖'乌 洛斯特 欧凡 兰……我回答了你的问题，可以放我走了吗？

original: That's right. Where is he hiding?
traduit: 这就对了。他藏在哪里？

original: Rinik vazah. An apt phrase. Alduin bovul. One reason I came to your call was to test your Thu'um for myself.
traduit: 瑞尼克 瓦扎。形容很恰当。奥杜因 伯维尔。我来此的原因之一就是亲自测验你的吐'目。

original: Many of us have begun to question Alduin's lordship, whether his Thu'um was truly the strongest.
traduit: 我们很多都已开始质疑奥杜因的统治地位，怀疑他的吐'目是否还是最强。

original: Among ourselves, of course. Mu ni meyye. None were yet ready to openly defy him.
traduit: 在我们之中他无疑是最强的。姆 尼 米诶耶。还没谁准备公然反对他。

original: How does it feel to be my prisoner?
traduit: 成为我的囚犯感觉如何？

original: Zu'u bonaar. You went to a great deal of trouble to put me in this... humiliating position.
traduit: 祖'乌 伯纳尔。你费尽心机把我置于……屈辱之中。

original: Hind siiv Alduin, hmm? No doubt you want to know where to find Alduin?
traduit: 辛德 斯弗 奥杜因，嗯？你肯定想知道去哪里找到奥杜因吧？

original: Zok frini grind ko grah drun viiki, Dovahkiin.
traduit: 佐克 福瑞尼 格瑞德 寇 格拉 如恩 威科，都瓦克因。

original: Ah. I forget. You do not have the dovah speech.
traduit: 哈。我忘了。你根本听不懂都瓦之语。

original: My... eagerness to meet you in battle was my... undoing, Dovahkiin. I salute your, hmm, low cunning in devising such a grahmindol - strategem.
traduit: 我……渴望在战斗中与你一决胜负……这是我的败因，都瓦克因。我真佩服你，唔，设计了这么一个狡猾的格拉明都……战略。

original: Horvutah med kodaav. Caught like a bear in a trap...
traduit: 霍夫塔 米德 寇达夫。像只熊一样被困在陷阱里……

original: Nid!
traduit: 聂德！

original: I think it's holding!
traduit: 我想它还在！

original: I know I ran ahead with the claw, but I need help!
traduit: 我知道我拿着爪子跑不对，但我需要帮助！

original: Is... is someone coming? Is that you Harknir? Bjorn? Soling?
traduit: 有……有人吗？哈克尼尔，是你吗？比约恩？索琳？

original: We're ready when you are.
traduit: 我们随时等你准备好。

original: You do have a plan for luring a dragon here, yeah?
traduit: 你有办法把龙引到这儿来吧？

original: Go ahead and call this dragon of yours. We're ready.
traduit: 去把龙召来吧，我们准备好了。

original: What are you waiting for? Let's get this over with.
traduit: 还等什么？早点办完吧。

original: Just shut it and keep an eye out for trouble.
traduit: 闭嘴吧，保持警戒别出麻烦。

original: What if Arvel doesn't come back? I want my share from that claw!
traduit: 如果阿维尔不回来怎么办？我想拿到我那份！

original: You'll come to the peace council, then?
traduit: 那你同意参加和平会议了？

original: Yes. Yes, fine, I'll come to this Greybeard council. For all the good it will do.
traduit: 没错。好吧。我会去灰胡子的会议。为了利益嘛。

original: Why won't the Emperor send more reinforcements?
traduit: 皇帝为什么不派更多援军？

original: Most of the Legion is tied down on the border with the Aldmeri Dominion. The Emperor can't afford to risk weakening Cyrodiil's defenses.
traduit: 大部分军团都被拖在与先祖神洲的边界上。皇帝不能冒险削弱希罗帝尔的防御。

original: From the Imperial City, our war here is just a sideshow. An interlude before the main event against the Thalmor resumes.
traduit: 在帝都眼里，我们的战争不过是个插曲。与梭默重开战端前的余兴罢了。

original: I think you know it's not as simple as that.
traduit: 你应该知道事情没那么简单。

original: Fair enough. We're driving the Stormcloaks back well enough at the moment, but we're already overstretched.
traduit: 说得对。我们已经把风暴斗篷赶回去了，但我们也已经不堪重负了。

original: The best time to negotiate is from a position of strength.
traduit: 处于有利地位是谈判的最佳时机。

original: No, you're right. After all this time, Ulfric still holds almost half of Skyrim.
traduit: 你说得对。这段时间，乌弗瑞克还保有一半天际。

original: The war is stalemated. What's the harm in talking to Ulfric?
traduit: 如今战况胶着。和乌弗瑞克谈谈有何不好？

original: Well... we could use some breathing space to regroup. Things haven't been going well for us lately.
traduit: 嗯……我们可以喘口气重新整合一下。我们的近况也不太好。

original: Better to negotiate than lose completely.
traduit: 谈判总比彻底失败来得好。

original: They're convening a peace council at High Hrothgar.
traduit: 他们要在霍斯加修道院召集一场和平议会。

original: Why? There's nothing to discuss as long as that traitor Ulfric is in arms against his rightful Emperor.
traduit: 为什么？只要乌弗瑞克那个叛徒还在拿着武器对抗他的合法皇帝，就没什么好谈的。

original: The Greybeards? What do those old hermits want with me?
traduit: 灰胡子？那群老隐士想要我做什么？

original: Who is your lord?
traduit: 你主人是谁？

original: The Daedric prince of the unknown. Hermaeus Mora. I thought there were no secrets left to know. Until I first spoke to him.
traduit: 迪德拉里的未知君王。赫麦尤斯·莫拉。我以为世上已无秘密可言，直到我与他第一次交谈。

original: He asks a price -- to work his will. A few murders, some dissent spread, a plague or two. For the secrets I can endure.
traduit: 他开出了价码，按他意志行事。谋杀、谣传、瘟疫，为了秘密，这都能忍了。

original: In time, he brought me here. To the box.
traduit: 后来，他指引我到此寻找这个盒子。

original: But he won't reveal how to open it. Maddening.
traduit: 但他不愿透露打开的方法。真是急死个人。

original: You have an Elder Scroll? Here?
traduit: 你有上古卷轴？在这儿？

original: I've seen enough to know their fabric. The warp of air, the weft of time.
traduit: 我对它们的构造了如指掌，空气之经，时间之纬。

original: But no, it is not in my possession.
traduit: 不过，它不在我这儿。

original: (Listen at the door)
traduit: （在门口偷听）

original: I've been waiting for someone more fit to carry out my will.
traduit: 我一直在等更适合的人到来，执行我的意志。

original: The child is spirited, but lacks... agency.
traduit: 那个孩子很活泼，但……难堪大任。

original: You're still stuck.
traduit: 你还是被困住了。

original: By the gods! I know this looks bad. Let me explain...
traduit: 神啊！我知道这看起来很糟糕。让我解释……

original: Then I must do this alone.
traduit: 那我就一个人去。

original: I'll help you.
traduit: 我来帮你。

original: Good. Follow me. We have to fight our way up. I don't think anyone else here is about to have a change of heart.
traduit: 太好了。跟着我。我们得一路打上去。我不觉得这里的其他人会回心转意。

original: How about <Alias=SonsMajorHoldCapital>?
traduit: <Alias=SonsMajorHoldCapital>如何？

original: Hmm. The Rift would help secure our communications with Cyrodiil... and threaten Ulfric's southern flank...
traduit: 嗯。裂痕领有助于保障我们与希罗帝尔之间的通讯，还能威胁到乌弗瑞克的南翼。

original: It's true that Whiterun is dangerously exposed as long as the Stormcloaks hold Markarth...
traduit: 的确，只要风暴斗篷控制了马卡斯城，那白漫就暴露在危险中了。

original: How about Morthal?
traduit: 莫萨尔如何？

original: How about Falkreath?
traduit: 佛克瑞斯怎么样？

original: How about the Dawnstar?
traduit: 晨星如何？

original: How about Winterhold?
traduit: 冬堡如何？

original: You're right. Ulfric isn't in any position to ask for Markarth.
traduit: 你说得对。乌弗瑞克没资格索要马卡斯城。

original: Ulfric holds nothing worth trading Markarth for.
traduit: 乌弗瑞克手里没有值得与马卡斯城交换的东西。

original: Ulfric holds only Windhelm. He's in no position to make demands.
traduit: 乌弗瑞克只占据风舵城。他没提条件的资格。

original: Damn right.
traduit: 说得太对了。

original: Just what I was thinking.
traduit: 和我想的一样。

original: The Empire holds only Solitude. Tullius is in no position to make demands.
traduit: 帝国只掌握独孤城。图留斯没有提要求的资格。

original: I'm listening.
traduit: 我听着呢。

original: Since we're all here at your request, I'd like to hear what you think Markarth is worth.
traduit: 既然我们都是应你之邀而来。我想听听你对马卡斯城价值的看法。

original: This council was your idea, eh? So tell us, what do you think Riften is worth?
traduit: 这次会议是你的主意吧？我们想听听你觉得裂谷城值多少？

original: First, let's be clear. This council wasn't my idea. I think it's a waste of time.
traduit: 先说清楚。这次会议不是我的主意。我认为这是浪费时间。

original: You are a traitor to the Empire, and deserve a traitor's death.
traduit: 你是帝国的叛徒，就该像叛徒一样被处死。

original: You lost the trust of the people of Skyrim, Elisif. You had your chance to make the right choice when the war started.
traduit: 你失去了天际人民的信任，艾利西弗。你本有机会在战争之初作出正确选择的。

original: Wait. General, you don't intend to just hand over Markarth to that... traitor!
traduit: 等等。将军，你不会是想把马卡斯城交给那个……叛徒！

original: What would the Empire want in return?
traduit: 帝国想要什么换呢？

original: Yes, that'd be entirely out of character.
traduit: 没错。这根本不是他的性格。

original: We've taken it before. I'm only asking for what will be ours soon enough anyway.
traduit: 我们以前占领过。我只是想拿回很快就要属于我们的东西。

original: You hope to gain in council what you've been unable to take in battle, is that it?
traduit: 你想在会议上拿到你在战争中拿不走的东西，是吗？

original: I'm sure Jarl Ulfric does not expect something for nothing.
traduit: 我相信乌弗瑞克领主不会想要空手白拿的。

original: Ulfric, you can't seriously expect us to give up Markarth at the negotiating table.
traduit: 乌弗瑞克。你别指望我们在谈判桌上放弃马卡斯。

original: Yes, let's get down to it.
traduit: 嗯，我们开始吧。

original: You know exactly... no. Not this time.
traduit: 你很清楚……不。不是这一次。

original: She's supposed to be on our side?
traduit: 她是站在我们这边的？

original: Ulfric, why so hostile? After all, it's not the Thalmor that's burning your farms and killing your sons.
traduit: 乌弗瑞克，怎么这么有敌意呢？又不是梭默烧毁了你的农场，杀戮了你的子民。

original: But she is to observe, nothing more. We are not negotiating with her, is that clear?
traduit: 但她只能在一旁看着。我们不是和她谈，明白吗？

original: We walk, then.
traduit: 那我们走。

original: No. We'll stay. Out of respect for the Dragonborn and our Greybeard hosts.
traduit: 不。我们会留下。这是出于对龙裔和灰胡子东道的尊重。

original: Sorry, sir. It won't happen again.
traduit: 对不起，长官。不会再发生了。

original: Legate. We represent the Emperor here.
traduit: 副官。我们在这里可是代表皇帝。

original: You're lucky I respect the Greybeards' council, Galmar!
traduit: 你该庆幸我尊重灰胡子主持的会议，加尔玛！

original: Unlike your Imperial friends here.
traduit: 不像你的帝国朋友。

original: Ha! Skyrim will never bow to the Thalmor!
traduit: 哈！天际永远不会向梭默低头！

original: Very well, Ulfric. Enjoy your petty victory.
traduit: 非常好，乌弗瑞克。享受你的小胜利吧。

original: I've only looked through a portion of this section. You, uh, you can look around in the chambers just north of here.
traduit: 我只搜索了一部分。你可以去北部的房间看看。

original: Try and be careful, all right? We don't want to damage anything.
traduit: 小心点好吗？我们不想造成任何破坏。

original: Ah, yes. You. I remember you. You're going to help? That's fine. Just... Just don't make a mess of my work.
traduit: 啊，对。是你啊。我记得你。你要帮忙吗？很好。只是……不要把我的工作搞乱。

original: You must be one of the new apprentices, then? Fine, fine. Just... just don't make a mess of my work, all right?
traduit: 你是新来的学徒吧？很好，很好。只是……别把我的工作搞砸了，好吗？

original: Tolfdir sent me to help you.
traduit: 托夫迪尔让我来帮你。

original: He what?
traduit: 他吗？

original: I'm going up there to stop her. This cycle must end. I don't know what brought you here, but I could use your help, if you're willing.
traduit: 我要上去阻止她。这个循环必须被打破。我不知道你为什么会到这儿，但我需要你的帮助，如果你愿意的话。

original: I called it home, now I know that was a mistake. I am, or was part of a coven serving the Hagravens that live here. So was she.
traduit: 我曾经管这里叫做家，现在我知道这是个错误。我是，或者说曾经是住在这里为乌鸦鬼婆服务的女巫团成员。她也是。

original: You killed that woman.
traduit: 你杀了那个女人。

original: I didn't want to, but she attacked to try and keep me from leaving.
traduit: 我也不想，但她攻击我，还想阻止我离开。

original: I just can't be a part of this place any more! The things we do here - evil, evil things. No more!
traduit: 我不想再成为这地方的一份子了！我们在这里做的事，全是歪门邪道。我受不了了！

original: Finally, reinforcements have arrived.
traduit: 终于有援军到了。

original: I was expecting more though, you'd better be good.
traduit: 但我本来以为会再多一些，你最好够强。

original: Just round up the rest of the magical artifacts so that I can catalog them.
traduit: 把剩余的魔法器物都找出来，我好给它们分类。

original: Hardly worth giving up Markarth for, but not a bad starting point.
traduit: 放弃马卡斯没什么意义，但这个开头不算坏。

original: Not quite worth handing over Riften, but not a bad starting point.
traduit: 虽然没什么和裂谷城价值相当的。但这个开头不算坏。

original: I don't know about you, but I'm going in there.
traduit: 我不知道你怎么想，但我要进去。

original: Not without us, you aren't! I'm sure there's enough for everyone, after all.
traduit: 没有我们你不行！我确信这里面的东西够咱们分的。

original: Come on, Beem-Ja. We're going.
traduit: 来吧，毕姆-加。我们走。

original: What do you expect to find inside?
traduit: 你想在里面找到什么？

original: Gold, silver. Gems, maybe? Only one way to find out!
traduit: 金银珠宝吧？只有一种办法能知道！

original: We should be inside, loading up on treasure. Worry-scales here thinks we should wait, though. Don't get any ideas, either. We were here first.
traduit: 我们应该在里面，装财宝。但是那个多虑的鳞片人觉得我们该再等等。别想了，是我们先来的。

original: I don't care what Beem says. It's high time we get in there and find our fortune.
traduit: 不管毕姆怎么说。是时候进去找找宝藏了。

original: Speak with Miss Salma, if you wish to speak.
traduit: 想聊的话就去找萨尔玛小姐吧。

original: I grow tired of debating this. If Miss Salma insists on this folly, so be it.
traduit: 我已经厌倦争论了。如果萨尔玛小姐执意要做，那就随她去吧。

original: I admit, there is strength in numbers. Perhaps between us...
traduit: 我承认，人多力量大。或许我们……

original: I'd like a waraxe.
traduit: 我想要一把战斧。

original: Now that's a smart weapon. Light, strong, useful. Crack some skulls for me.
traduit: 很灵巧的武器。闪亮、强大、实用。替我敲碎几个头骨。

original: I'd like a greatsword.
traduit: 我想要一把巨剑。

original: Sure you can handle that? Ha! Of course you can.
traduit: 你拿得动？哈！看着没问题。

original: I'd like a battleaxe.
traduit: 我想要一把巨斧。

original: Just like Ysgramor himself.
traduit: 就像伊斯格拉默一样。

original: I'd like a dagger.
traduit: 我想要一柄匕首。

original: Ah, the sneaky type, eh? I think we can fix you right up.
traduit: 哈，喜欢玩儿阴的？我想我们可以很快把你引上正道。

original: I'd like a sword.
traduit: 我想要一把剑。

original: A blade! It will be as sharp as Fralia's tongue!
traduit: 剑锋！和法利亚的舌头一样锋利！

original: I was told you would have a weapon for me.
traduit: 听说你会给我准备武器。

original: Yes, lad, you've been raised into the Companions, I hear.
traduit: 没错，孩子，我听说你已经成为战友团一员了。

original: I can fashion whatever kind of weapon you want. Finest forge in Skyrim, right here before you.
traduit: 我可以制作你想要的任何武器。全天际最好的锻炉就在你的面前。

original: C03SharedInfos
traduit: C03SharedInfos

original: Found you!
traduit: 找到你了！

original: Argh! You found me!
traduit: 啊！被发现了！

original: You got me.
traduit: 你抓到我了。

original: My turn!
traduit: 到我了！

original: He he he.
traduit: 呵呵呵。

original: He'll never find me here.
traduit: 他不会找到咱们的。

original: She'll never find me here.
traduit: 她不会找到咱们的。

original: This is a good hiding spot.
traduit: 这儿是个藏起来的好地方。

original: I found you! Na na na, na na na!
traduit: 我发现你了！呐呐呐，呐呐呐！

original: Found you!
traduit: 找到你了！

original: Better than nothing, I suppose. But Ulfric will need to offer a lot more if he wants me to give up Markarth without a fight.
traduit: 我想总比没有好。但是，如果乌弗瑞克想让我不战而退放弃马卡斯城，他得提供更多条件。

original: Better than nothing, I guess. But Tullius will need to offer a lot more if he wants me to give up Riften without a fight.
traduit: 我想总比没有好。但是，图留斯如果想让我不战而退放弃裂谷城，就得提供更多条件。

original: You're right. <Alias=SonsMajorHoldCapital> is a fair trade for Markarth.
traduit: 你说得对。<Alias=SonsMajorHoldCapital>对马卡斯来说是个公平交易。

original: I'm glad you agree. I was starting to wonder whose side you were on here.
traduit: 很高兴你能同意。我刚才都怀疑你是站在哪边的了。

original: Well. You surprise me. I was expecting you to favor Ulfric. Maybe this council will achieve something after all.
traduit: 好。你令我大吃一惊。我还以为你会支持乌弗瑞克呢。这次会议也许会有所成就。

original: There are advantages to gaining <Alias=SonsMinorHoldCapital>. (Persuade)
traduit: 获得<Alias=SonsMinorHoldCapital>是有好处的。（说服）

original: Not enough to outweigh the loss of Markarth. With the Reach in enemy hands, our whole position in Solitude would be threatened.
traduit: 这可补不上马卡斯的损失。一旦瑞驰落入敌手，我们在独孤城的位置就会受到威胁。

original: You asked my opinion. I gave it to you.
traduit: 你问我的意见。我已经说过了。

original: Fair enough. Although I'm beginning to wonder whose side you're really on. Still...
traduit: 很好。不过我有点怀疑你是站哪边的了。尽管如此……

original: Fair enough. I was hoping you could put aside your loyalties for the greater good, but I see you're firmly in Ulfric's camp. Still...
traduit: 很好。我希望你能顾全大局先把你的忠诚放在一边，但你却坚定的站在乌弗瑞克一方。尽管如此……

original: I did ask. Although I'm beginning to wonder whose side you're really on. Still...
traduit: 我确实问了。不过我开始怀疑你的立场了。尽管如此……

original: Fair enough. I thought you might be able to see past your Imperial loyalties in the interests of peace, but I guess not. Still...
traduit: 很好。我本以为你能暂时放下对帝国的忠诚来维护和平，但我看你做不到。尽管如此……

original: Fair enough. You claim to be neutral, but it seems that you actually favor the Empire. Still...
traduit: 很好。你虽然宣称中立，实际却支持帝国。尽管如此……

original: I've never liked having the rebels right on Solitude's doorstep. Retaking Hjaalmarch would help secure our supply lines...
traduit: 我可不喜欢叛军堵在独孤城门口。夺回希雅陲有助于保护我们的补给线……

original: How about Hjaalmarch?
traduit: 希雅陲如何？

original: Regaining Pale Pass would help our supply situation considerably... and Whiterun is dangerously exposed with the enemy in Falkreath...
traduit: 夺回苍白隘口可以大大改善我们的供应状况……而白漫也会暴露在佛克瑞斯面前。

original: Having another port would ease our supply situation considerably...
traduit: 拥有更多港口可以大大改善补给状况。

original: How about the Pale?
traduit: 苍原如何？

original: Winterhold would allow us to directly threaten the rebel supply lines out of Windhelm...
traduit: 冬堡可以让我们直接在风舵城外威胁叛军的补给线。

original: I expected better from you Dragonborn. I came here in good faith, despite your known Imperial sympathies.
traduit: 我对你期望很高，龙裔。尽管你同情帝国，但我还是诚心诚意而来。

original: You're different from what I expected, Dragonborn. You treat us with respect, despite your known Imperial sympathies.
traduit: 你与我所想的不一样，龙裔。尽管你同情帝国，但也很尊重我们。

original: Think hard about your loyalties, brother. I expected better from you.
traduit: 想想你的忠诚，兄弟。我本来很期待你。

original: I expected better from you Dragonborn. I came here in good faith, and now it seems you help the Empire at every turn.
traduit: 我对你期望很高，龙裔。我诚心诚意而来。但你好像处处帮着帝国。

original: Think hard about your loyalties, sister. I expected better from you.
traduit: 想想你的忠诚，姐妹。我本来很期待你。

original: Well done, brother. If you can hold these Imperials to their promises, we might be able to reach an agreement.
traduit: 干得好，兄弟。你要是能让这些帝国人遵守承诺，那我们也许能达成协议。

original: Well done, sister. If you can hold these Imperials to their promises, we might be able to reach an agreement.
traduit: 干得好，姐妹。你要是能让这些帝国人遵守承诺，那我们也许能达成协议。

original: You've dealt with us fairly so far. You've heard our demand. What say you?
traduit: 迄今为止你对待我们很公道。你已经知道了我们的诉求。你怎么说？

original: What say you, Dragonborn?
traduit: 你怎么说，龙裔？

original: Now that that's settled, may we proceed?
traduit: 既然问题解决了，可以继续了吗？

original: Who would like to open the negotiations?
traduit: 双方可愿意开始谈判？

original: This council is unprecedented. We are gathered here at the Dragonborn's request.
traduit: 这次会议前所未有。我们应龙裔之邀汇聚于此。

original: I ask that you all respect the spirit of High Hrothgar, and do your best to begin the process of achieving a lasting peace in Skyrim.
traduit: 希望你们都尊重霍斯加修道院之精神，并尽你们最大努力保证天际长久和平。

original: Jarl Ulfric.
traduit: 乌弗瑞克领主。

original: General Tullius.
traduit: 图留斯将军。

original: Are we ready to proceed?
traduit: 我们可以开始了吗？

original: But the difficulty remains - how to lure a dragon to Dragonsreach at all?
traduit: 但还有一个难题，如何把巨龙引导龙临宫？

original: Hjaalmarch would allow us to directly threaten the Imperial supply lines out of Solitude...
traduit: 希雅陲可以让我们直接威胁独孤城外的帝国补给线……

original: Blocking Pale Pass would cut one of the main Imperial supply routes... and Whiterun is dangerously exposed with the enemy in Falkreath.
traduit: 封锁苍白隘口将切断帝国的一条主要补给线。而白漫也会直接暴露在佛克瑞斯之下。

original: Blocking Pale Pass would cut one of the main Imperial supply routes... and would leave Whiterun dangerously exposed...
traduit: 封锁苍白隘口将切断帝国的一条主要补给线。并把白漫置于危险之地。

original: Hmm... the Empire is bringing in a lot of supplies through Dawnstar. Taking the Pale would stretch them pretty thin...
traduit: 嗯……帝国正通过晨星城运送大量补给。拿下苍原就能削弱他们。

original: I've never liked having the Imperials right on Windhelm's doorstep. Retaking Winterhold would help secure our supply lines...
traduit: 我很讨厌帝国军队站在风舵城门口，夺回冬堡有助于保障我们的补给……

original: I expected better of you, Dragonborn. You swore an oath to serve the Emperor. Don't forget it.
traduit: 我对你期望很高，龙裔。别忘了你是向皇帝宣誓效忠了的。

original: I don't blame you, Dragonborn. You made the best of a bad situation.
traduit: 我不怪你，龙裔。你在糟糕的状况下做的够好了。

original: You disappoint me, Dragonborn. I accepted your invitation to this council, despite your known association with the rebels.
traduit: 你让我失望了，龙裔。尽管知道你与叛军有联系，但我还是接受了你的邀请赴会。

original: But it seems you have no intention of dealing fairly with me.
traduit: 但看起来你不打算公平对待我。

original: You disappoint me, Dragonborn. I accepted your invitation on trust in your good name. But it seems you intend to favor Ulfric.
traduit: 你让我失望了，龙裔。我信赖你的名声，接受了邀请。但现在看来你是想支持乌弗瑞克。

original: I don't blame you, Dragonborn. You treated us fairly despite your known rebel sympathies.
traduit: 我不责怪你，龙裔。尽管你同情叛军，但你对我们很公平了。

original: But I can see now that this is not a negotiation at all.
traduit: 但我现在明白了，这根本就不是谈判。

original: I can see now that this is not a negotiation at all.
traduit: 我现在明白，这根本不是谈判。

original: If you think this war is nearly won, you're as deluded as your Emperor when he signed away our freedom to the Thalmor.
traduit: 如果你认为这场仗快赢了，那你就和你那个皇帝把我们的自由签送梭默的时候一样愚蠢。

original: You can trample us underfoot but we will rise again!
traduit: 你可以践踏我们，但我们会再度崛起！

original: If you think you can hold Markarth, you're as deluded as your Emperor when he signed away our freedom to the Thalmor.
traduit: 如果你觉得能保住马卡斯，那你就和你那个皇帝把我们的自由签送梭默的时候一样愚蠢。

original: If you think we'll just hand over Riften, you're as deluded as your Emperor when he signed away our freedom to the Thalmor.
traduit: 如果你觉得我们会交出裂谷城，那你就和你那个皇帝把我们的自由签送梭默的时候一样愚蠢。

original: Soon enough I'll have you back under the headsman's axe, and this time there won't be any dragon to save you.
traduit: 很快我就会再送你去找一趟刽子手，这次不会有龙来救你了。

original: As always, the Empire's fine words are worth nothing!
traduit: 帝国的花言巧语一如既往地毫无价值！

original: You heard the man, Ulfric.
traduit: 听到他说的了吧，乌弗瑞克。

original: You heard what she said, Ulfric.
traduit: 听到她说的了吧，乌弗瑞克。

original: You did the best you could, brother. But I've learned the hard way that these Imperials are best dealt with at sword point.
traduit: 你尽力了，兄弟。但我吃过苦头，早就明白了，对付这些帝国人的最佳方式就是用剑指向他们。

original: You did the best you could, Dragonborn. But I've learned the hard way that these Imperials are best dealt with at sword point.
traduit: 你尽力了，龙裔。但我吃过苦头，早就明白了，对付这些帝国人的最佳方式就是用剑指向他们。

original: You did the best you could, sister. But I've learned the hard way that these Imperials are best dealt with at sword point.
traduit: 你尽力了，姐妹。但我吃过苦头，早就明白了，对付这些帝国人的最佳方式就是用剑指向他们。

original: As for you, General Tullius, I see now that Galmar was right. Talking to the Empire is just as useless as ever.
traduit: 至于你，图留斯将军，看来加尔玛说得对。和帝国对话毫无用处。

original: Skyrim will never again bow to your false Empire!
traduit: 天际不会再想你的伪帝国低头了！

original: Let's go, Galmar. I should have listened to you in the first place.
traduit: 走吧，加尔玛。我一开始就该听你的。

original: You always were a fool, Ulfric. You're no better at diplomacy than you are on the battlefield.
traduit: 你一直这么傻，乌弗瑞克。你在外交上和在战场上一样无能。

original: You've been even-handed so far. What do you say to our demand?
traduit: 迄今为止你都很公正。你对我们的要求有何看法？

original: So, Dragonborn. What do you say?
traduit: 所以龙裔你怎么看？

original: Ah. I believe I can be of help here.
traduit: 啊。我相信我能帮上忙。

original: That's what comes of trying to win a war with a bare handful of legions. If the Emperor would just give me the reinforcements I've requested!
traduit: 想靠区区这些军团部队打赢战争就是这种结果。要是皇帝能给我需要的援军就好了！

original: Take your seat and we can begin.
traduit: 请坐，我们可以开始了。

original: We all wait upon you, Dragonborn.
traduit: 我们都在等你，龙裔。

original: Why delay? Please, take your seat so we can begin.
traduit: 在等什么？请坐，要开始会议了。

original: <Alias.Cap=SonsMinorHoldCapital> seems like a fair trade.
traduit: <Alias.Cap=SonsMinorHoldCapital>看起来是个公平的交易。

original: In exchange for Markarth, the source of most of Skyrim's silver? Hardly.
traduit: 用马卡斯这个天际主要银产区交换？很难。

original: Riften seems like a better choice to me. Well-fortified, easily resupplied across Lake Honrich. Plus all the mead we can drink.
traduit: 我觉得裂谷城是个更好的选择。防御优良，还能通过霍利奇湖补给。再加上能喝到不错的蜜酒。

original: In exchange for Markarth, the source of most of Skyrim's silver? Hardly. I might rather consider Whiterun.
traduit: 用马卡斯这个天际主要银产区交换？很难。我宁可考虑白漫。

original: Who's to say what happened at <Alias=SonsTownRaided>?
traduit: 谁知道<Alias=SonsTownRaided>发生了什么？

original: Think carefully where your loyalties lie... brother.
traduit: 想清楚自己是忠于哪方的……兄弟。

original: Think carefully where your loyalties lie... sister.
traduit: 想清楚自己是忠于哪方的……姐妹。

original: I don't know why I expected even-handed treatment from you.
traduit: 我怎么就会期望你能公平呢。

original: You don't really expect compensation every time a farm gets burned in a war that you started, do you Ulfric?
traduit: 你不会指望，在这场你掀起的战争中，每逢农场被毁你都能拿到补偿吧，乌弗瑞克？

original: That's a lie! My legionnaires are disciplined, unlike your...
traduit: 撒谎！我的军团兵纪律严明，可不像你的……

original: You slaughtered them - the women, the children! You butchers!
traduit: 是你们屠杀了他们，那群妇孺！你们这群屠夫！

original: The Empire should compensate you for <Alias=SonsTownRaided>.
traduit: 帝国应该为<Alias=SonsTownRaided>一事补偿你。

original: I think you're on the wrong side in this war, my friend.
traduit: 我觉得你在战争里站错位置了，朋友。

original: I don't know about the end of the world, but this dragon situation has gotten out of hand.
traduit: 我不晓得什么世界末日，但这头龙已经逐渐失控了。

original: If this truce will help the Dragonborn here put an end to that menace, we both gain. Remember that, Ulfric.
traduit: 如果这次休战能帮助龙裔解决威胁，我们都会获益。记住了，乌弗瑞克。

original: That's enough out of you.
traduit: 你说的够多了。

original: If he's right about Alduin... we both have just as much to lose here, Tullius, remember that.
traduit: 如果他对奥杜因的看法是对的……我们都会因此受到巨大打击。图留斯，记住了。

original: Shut up.
traduit: 闭嘴。

original: A very pretty speech, but what does it have to do with...
traduit: 很精彩的演讲，但这跟……

original: Can you not put aside your hatred for even one moment in the face of this mortal danger?
traduit: 面对这场致命的威胁，你们还不能暂时放下仇恨？

original: He grows more powerful with every soldier slain in your pointless war!
traduit: 你们这场毫无意义的战争每阵亡一个士兵，都会让他变得更强！

original: Alduin has returned! The World-Eater! Even now, he devours the souls of your fallen comrades!
traduit: 奥杜因回来了！世界吞噬者！就在现在，他还在吞噬你们牺牲战友的灵魂！

original: Don't you understand the danger? Don't you understand what the return of the dragons means?
traduit: 你们还不明白有多危险吗？你们不清楚龙族回归意味着什么吗？

original: And I advise you both to listen to what he has to say, before you do anything rash.
traduit: 我建议你们双方在鲁莽行事之前，先听听他的话。

original: He is with me.
traduit: 他是跟我一起的。

original: Is he with you, Delphine? If so, I advise you to tell him to watch his tongue.
traduit: 戴尔芬，他是跟你一起的？如果是的话，建议你告诉他说话注意点。

original: Here you sit arguing about... nothing! While the fate of the land hangs in the balance!
traduit: 你们在这里争论……毫无意义！这片大地的命运已经悬于一线了！

original: Stop! Are you so blind to our danger that you can't see past your petty disagreements?
traduit: 停下！你们就这样无视我们的险境，只会顾着自己那点小分歧？

original: You always were a fool, Ulfric. You'll never get a better chance to salvage something from the ruins of your ambition.
traduit: 乌弗瑞克，你一向傻的可以。你再也找不到更好的机会，从你那野心的废墟里挽救些东西了。

original: Markarth is off the table. Your rabble is on the verge of defeat. We have no need of a truce at such a price.
traduit: 马卡斯不在议程之内。你那群乌合之众眼看就要败了。我们没必要花这样的代价休战。

original: We've made you a fair offer. Are you serious about these talks, or are you just here to posture?
traduit: 我们已经给出了公平的报价。你到底有没有诚意啊？

original: Do you hear that, Tullius? The blood of the innocent cries out for weregild.
traduit: 听到了吧，图留斯？无辜者的鲜血在呼唤赔偿。

original: And so the Empire runs roughshod over Skyrim, as usual.
traduit: 所以，帝国一如既往地在天际横行霸道。

original: But I at least will negotiate in good faith.
traduit: 但至少我会真诚地谈判。

original: Ulfric will withdraw his forces from Hjaalmarch, allowing Jarl Idgrod Ravencrone to return to Morthal.
traduit: 乌弗瑞克将从希雅陲撤军，“老乌鸦”艾德格洛德领主返回莫萨尔。

original: Ulfric will withdraw his forces from Falkreath, allowing Jarl Siddgeir to return.
traduit: 乌弗瑞克将从佛克瑞斯撤军，西德盖尔领主将返回。

original: Ulfric will allow Imperial forces into the Pale. Skald the Elder will go into exile, and Brina Merilis will assume the Jarlship.
traduit: 乌弗瑞克允许帝国军进驻苍原。驱逐“老者”斯卡德，布里那·莫里利斯接任领主。

original: Ulfric will allow Imperial troops to enter Winterhold. Korir will replace Kraldar as Jarl.
traduit: 乌弗瑞克允许帝国军进驻冬堡。卡拉达接替科利尔的领主之位。

original: The Empire will allow Ulfric's forces to enter Hjaalmarch. Idgrod Ravencrone will go into exile, with Sorli the Builder replacing her as Jarl.
traduit: 帝国允许乌弗瑞克军进驻希雅陲。驱逐“老乌鸦”艾德格洛德，由“建造者”索莉接任领主。

original: The Empire will allow Ulfric's forces to enter Falkreath. Jarl Siddgeir will step down, and Dengeir of Stuhn will take his place as Jarl.
traduit: 帝国允许乌弗瑞克军进驻佛克瑞斯。西德盖尔领主下台，由斯图恩的丹格尔接任领主。

original: The Empire will withdraw its troops from the Pale, allowing Jarl Skald the Elder to return from exile.
traduit: 帝国将从苍原撤军。“老者”斯卡德领主结束流放回归领地。

original: The Empire will withdraw its troops from Winterhold, allowing Jarl Korir to return from exile.
traduit: 帝国将从冬堡撤军。科利尔领主结束流放回归领地。

original: The Stormcloaks will withdraw from the Reach, allowing Jarl Igmund to return to Markarth.
traduit: 风暴斗篷从瑞驰撤军，依格蒙德领主返回马卡斯。

original: The Stormcloaks will withdraw from the Rift, allowing Imperial troops unhindered access.
traduit: 风暴斗篷从裂痕撤军，允许帝国军无阻进驻。

original: Jarl Laila Law-Giver will step down, and Maven Black-Briar will become the Jarl of Riften.
traduit: “布法者”莱拉领主下台，玛雯·黑棘接任裂谷城领主。

original: The Empire will withdraw its troops from the Reach, allowing Ulfric's forces unhindered access to Markarth.
traduit: 帝国从瑞驰撤军，允许乌弗瑞克军无阻进驻马卡斯。

original: Jarl Igmund will go into exile, with Thongvor Silver-Blood taking his place as Jarl of Markarth.
traduit: 放逐依格蒙德领主，松瓦·银血接任马卡斯领主。

original: The Empire will withdraw its troops from the Rift, allowing the return of Jarl Laila Law-Giver.
traduit: 帝国从裂痕撤军，“布法者”莱拉领主返回裂谷城。

original: Hjaalmarch will be turned over to Ulfric, with Sorli the Builder assuming the Jarlship.
traduit: 希雅陲移交乌弗瑞克，“建造者”索莉担任领主。

original: Falkreath will be turned over to Ulfric, and Dengeir of Stuhn will return as Jarl.
traduit: 佛克瑞斯移交乌弗瑞克，斯图恩的丹格尔复位领主。

original: Imperial forces will withdraw from The Pale, and Jarl Skald the Elder will be allowed to return to Dawnstar.
traduit: 帝国军撤离苍原，“老者”斯卡德领主返回晨星。

original: Imperial troops will withdraw from Winterhold, and Kraldar will return as Jarl.
traduit: 帝国军撤离冬堡，卡拉达返回成为领主。

original: The Stormcloaks will withdraw from Hjaalmarch, and Idgrod Ravencrone will resume the Jarlship.
traduit: 风暴斗篷从希雅陲撤军，“老乌鸦”艾德格洛德复位领主。

original: Falkreath will be returned to Imperial control, under the authority of Jarl Siddgeir.
traduit: 佛克瑞斯归还帝国，由西德盖尔领主治理。

original: The Pale will be turned over to the Empire. Brina Merilis will assume the Jarlship in Dawnstar.
traduit: 苍原归还帝国。由布里那·莫里利斯接任晨星领主。

original: Winterhold will be turned over to the Empire, although the College itself will retain its traditional neutrality.
traduit: 冬堡移交帝国，但学院本身还会保持中立传统。

original: Markarth remains allied to the Empire, under the authority of Jarl Igmund.
traduit: 依格蒙德领主统治马卡斯，继续与帝国结盟。

original: Riften remains allied to the Stormcloak cause, under the authority of Jarl Laila Law-Giver.
traduit: “布法者”莱拉领主统治裂谷城，继续与风暴斗篷结盟。

original: Markarth will be handed over to Ulfric's forces. Jarl Igmund will step down, and Thongvor Silver-Blood will become the Jarl of Markarth.
traduit: 马卡斯交付乌弗瑞克军。依格蒙德领主下台，松瓦·银血接任马卡斯领主。

original: Riften will be handed over to Imperial control. Jarl Laila Law-Giver will step down, and Maven Black-Briar will become the Jarl of Riften.
traduit: 裂谷城交付帝国。“布法者”莱拉领主下台，玛雯·黑棘接任裂谷城领主。

original: These are the terms currently on the table.
traduit: 现在条款如下。

original: I shouldn't agree to terms that so blatantly favor the Empire. I have no choice, though, under the circumstances.
traduit: 我本不该同意如此明显偏向帝国的条款，但我现在别无选择。

original: But once Alduin is defeated - then it will be the Empire's turn. Remember - "Evgir Unslaad."
traduit: 但等到奥杜因被打败，就该轮到帝国了。记住了——“艾弗吉 安斯拉德”。

original: The sons of Skyrim will live up to their agreements. As long as the Imperials hold to theirs.
traduit: 天际之子会履行协议。但愿帝国也会坚守。

original: These terms blatantly favor the rebels. Everyone here knows that.
traduit: 在座都能看出来，这些条款公然支持叛军。

original: But the Empire will accept them, until the dragon menace is dealt with.
traduit: 但帝国会接受，直到龙的威胁解除。

original: The Empire can live with these terms, yes. For a temporary truce, until the dragon menace is dealt with.
traduit: 帝国可以接受这些条款。暂时休战，直至龙的威胁解除。

original: You both agree to this?
traduit: 双方同意否？

original: General Tullius...
traduit: 图留斯将军……

original: Jarl Ulfric...
traduit: 乌弗瑞克领主……

original: I'm willing to let the Dragonborn be the judge of the fairness of my request.
traduit: 我希望由龙裔来判断我的要求是否公正。

original: It seems I have no choice but to let the Dragonborn decide. Although I'm starting to doubt your fairness.
traduit: 看来我别无选择，只有让龙裔决定了。尽管我有点质疑你的公平性。

original: The Empire doesn't need to give up any more territory.
traduit: 帝国无需放弃更多领土。

original: What? And you call yourself a son of Skyrim?
traduit: 什么？你这样还能自称天际的儿子吗？

original: What? And you call yourself a daughter of Skyrim?
traduit: 什么？你这样还能自称天际的女儿吗？

original: Even the Dragonborn betrays Skyrim.
traduit: 连龙裔也背叛天际了。

original: I agree. The Empire should turn over <Alias=ImperialMinorHold2>.
traduit: 我同意。帝国应移交<Alias=ImperialMinorHold2>的归属权。

original: You treat us fairly. Thank you.
traduit: 你公平地对待了我们。谢谢。

original: Spoken like a true son of Skyrim!
traduit: 这才是真正天际之子说的话！

original: Spoken like a true daughter of Skyrim!
traduit: 这才是真正天际之女说的话！

original: What makes you think I'll give that to you, if I wouldn't give you Markarth?
traduit: 如果我不给你马卡斯，你凭什么认为我会给你那个？

original: Where do these demands stop, Ulfric? Do you expect me to surrender all of Skyrim?
traduit: 你的要求难道毫无止境，乌弗瑞克？你希望我把全天际拱手让你吗？

original: Elisif! I said I'd handle it.
traduit: 艾利西弗！我说了，我会处理。

original: Jarl Elisif, I'll handle this.
traduit: 艾利西弗领主，我来处理。

original: General, this is outrageous! You can't be taking this demand seriously! I thought we were here to discuss a truce!
traduit: 将军，这太过分了！你不能答应这种要求！我本以为我们是来商讨休战的！

original: So that's why you're here, Ulfric? You dare to insult the Greybeards by using this council to advance your own position?
traduit: 你就是来干这个的，乌弗瑞克？你竟然敢利用会议提高你自己的地位？你这是侮辱灰胡子！

original: I'm sure you have something in mind.
traduit: 你应该有自己的想法了。

original: If we're not going to get Markarth, we need you to give us something.
traduit: 如果我们得不到马卡斯，你们就得给我们些东西。

original: You know as well as I do that that we can't hand over Riften on these terms.
traduit: 你我都清楚。我们不能就这样交出裂谷城。

original: Don't hand me a mug of sheep's piss and call it mead. These terms are still not acceptable.
traduit: 别塞给我杯羊尿还唬我说是蜜酒，这些条件我接受不了。

original: These terms are not acceptable. You know that.
traduit: 我不能接受这样的条件。你明白。

original: Come on, Tullius. You have to give a little ground here. The dragons are a threat to us both.
traduit: 得了吧，图留斯。你得做点让步。龙族对我们双方都是威胁。

original: We want compensation for the massacre at Barleydark Farm.
traduit: 我们要求对方就麦黑农场的屠杀进行赔偿。

original: We want compensation for the massacre at Riverwood.
traduit: 我们要求对方就河木镇的屠杀进行赔偿。

original: We want compensation for the massacre at Rorikstead.
traduit: 我们要求对方就洛利克镇的屠杀进行赔偿。

original: We want compensation for the massacre at Karthwasten.
traduit: 我们要求对方就卡斯威斯腾的屠杀进行赔偿。

original: We want compensation for the massacre at Old Hroldan.
traduit: 我们要求对方就古霍尔丹的屠杀进行赔偿。

original: We want compensation for the massacre at Kolskeggr Mine.
traduit: 我们要求对方就科斯凯格矿场的屠杀进行赔偿。

original: We want compensation for the massacre at Stonehills.
traduit: 我们要求对方就石山的屠杀进行赔偿。

original: We want compensation for the massacre at Frost River Farm.
traduit: 我们要求对方就霜河农场的屠杀进行赔偿。

original: We want compensation for the massacre at Granite Hill.
traduit: 我们要求对方就花岗岩山丘的屠杀进行赔偿。

original: We want compensation for the massacre at Half-moon Mill.
traduit: 我们要求对方就半月木材厂的屠杀进行赔偿。

original: We want compensation for the massacre at Heljarchen.
traduit: 我们要求对方就赫雅根的屠杀进行赔偿。

original: We want compensation for the massacre at Anga's Mill.
traduit: 我们要求对方就安佳木材厂的屠杀进行赔偿。

original: We want compensation for the massacre at Loreius Farm.
traduit: 我们要求对方就罗瑞尤斯农场的屠杀进行赔偿。

original: We want compensation for the massacre at Whistling Mine.
traduit: 我们要求对方就笛声矿场的屠杀进行赔偿。

original: We want compensation for the massacre at Ivarstead.
traduit: 我们要求对方就伊瓦尔镇的屠杀进行赔偿。

original: We want compensation for the massacre at Shor's Stone.
traduit: 我们要求对方就舒尔之石的屠杀进行赔偿。

original: We want compensation for the massacre at Heartwood Mill.
traduit: 我们要求对方就心木木材厂的屠杀进行赔偿。

original: We want compensation for the massacre at Sarethi Farm.
traduit: 我们要求对方就萨雷锡农场的屠杀进行赔偿。

original: You surrender Hjaalmarch to us, and take Idgrod Ravencrone with you. Sorli the Builder will take over as Jarl of Morthal.
traduit: 把希雅陲交给我们，带走“老乌鸦”艾德格洛德。让“建造者”索莉接任莫萨尔领主。

original: You surrender Falkreath to us. Siddgeir steps down, and Dengeir of Stuhn resumes the Jarlship.
traduit: 把佛克瑞斯交给我们，西德盖尔下台。让斯图恩的丹格尔恢复领主身份。

original: You withdraw from the Pale, and allow Jarl Skald the Elder to return to Dawnstar.
traduit: 你们从苍原撤退，让“老者”斯卡德领主返回晨星。

original: We want Imperial forces to withdraw from Winterhold, and allow Jarl Kraldar to return from exile.
traduit: 我们希望帝国军撤出冬堡，让卡拉达领主结束流亡。

original: Bah! This is a waste of time. I can see that we won't get better terms from this council.
traduit: 呸！浪费时间。我就知道我们不能从会议里得到更好的条件。

original: So be it. The sons of Skyrim at least put the greater good above our own interests.
traduit: 就这样吧。天际之子要把全体的利益置于个人利益之上。

original: Let's play tag.
traduit: 来玩捉鬼游戏吧。

original: Sure. What game do you want to play?
traduit: 好啊。你想玩什么？

original: Really? All right! You pick. Tag or hide-and-seek?
traduit: 真的？好吧！你选吧。是捉鬼还是捉迷藏？

original: Heh, I'm sorry. Of course. It's your most famous recipe, after all.
traduit: 哦，抱歉。当然。毕竟这是您最著名的食谱。

original: All right then, your secret ingredient's been added.
traduit: 好了，您的秘密佐料已经放进去了。

original: And if I may say so... it has been an honor, getting a chance to prepare a meal with, well... the best chef in the entire Empire.
traduit: 我得说……很荣幸能有机会……和帝国最优秀的厨师共事。

original: I'll carry the stew pot, and lead the way up to the dining room. I'm sure the Emperor and his guests are dying to meet you.
traduit: 我来端汤锅吧，请跟我一起来餐厅。皇帝和宾客一定很想见你。

original: Now, now, Gianna. Who's the Gourmet here?
traduit: 喂，喂，吉安娜。现在谁是美食家啊？

original: Excellent. They should be ready for us now.
traduit: 太好了。应该做好了。

original: We're done. Let us serve... the Potage le Magnifique!
traduit: 完成了。来看看……美味浓汤！

original: Oh? What is this, some kind of herb? Are you sure? The Potage tastes perfect as it is. Any other ingredient might...
traduit: 哦？这是什么，药草吗？你确定？这锅汤已经很美味了。任何多余的佐料都可能……

original: There is one final ingredient. Here, add this. (Give jarrin root)
traduit: 最后还有一味配料。来，把这个加进去。（拿出加林根）

original: Of course! I.... I'm sorry. One giant's toe. There.
traduit: 当然！我……很抱歉。巨人脚趾。在这儿。

original: What, um... What next?
traduit: 接……接下来呢？

original: I said a giant's toe! Do not question the Gourmet!
traduit: 我说了，加巨人脚趾！不要质疑“美食家”！

original: My choice, hmm? All right, then - tomatoes. Simple, yet infinitely flavorful. Don't you agree?
traduit: 我的选择吗？好吧，那就，番茄。简单但美味。你觉得呢？

original: Well, I have to say, the stew seems done. Add anything else, and we may dilute the distinct flavors. So... is that it?
traduit: 嗯，我觉得菜已经做好了。如果再加其他东西，可能就会冲淡这股独特的味道。所以……是这样吗？

original: Hmmm... horker. So delicious. I swear, is there a soul alive who doesn't enjoy the taste of...
traduit: 嗯……海象肉。很美味。我发誓世界上还没有谁不喜欢……

original: Sorry, I didn't mean to get carried away. There we go, one cup of diced horker meat.
traduit: 抱歉，我不是故意失神的。好了，一杯海象肉丁。

original: I have to say, the stew seems done. Add anything else, and we may dilute the distinct flavors. So... is that it?
traduit: 我觉得菜已经做好了。如果再加其他东西，可能就会冲淡这股独特的味道。所以……是这样吗？

original: Diced horker meat.
traduit: 海象肉块。

original: A Septim? As in... a gold coin? Really?
traduit: 塞普汀？金币吗？真的？

original: Ah, I see now. That would give the Potage le Magnifique a slightly metallic - but delicious - aftertaste. Simply brilliant.
traduit: 啊，我明白了。这样可以让美味浓汤多一点金属感却又美味的回味。简单又奢华。

original: You must add... a septim.
traduit: 你得再加……一枚塞普汀。

original: Ooookay.... Um.... Let me see. Thistle? Yes, let's try that. Just a sprig or two...
traduit: 好吧……嗯……我看看。蓟花？嗯，试试这个。只需要加一两枝……

original: Really? Oh, I use Nirnroot as a special seasoning all the time as well. What a wonderful idea.
traduit: 真的？哦，我也一直拿它当特殊调味料。好主意。

original: Okay. Now what?
traduit: 好了。现在呢？

original: One nirnroot.
traduit: 一颗奈恩根。

original: A... giant's toe? You're... sure about that?
traduit: 巨……巨人脚趾？你……确定吗？

original: We shall now add... a giant's toe!
traduit: 我们现在应该加……巨人脚趾！

original: My choice, then? Very well. I think we should add some Chaurus eggs. For additional flavor.
traduit: 我来选吗？好吧。我觉得应该加些查鲁斯卵。能添加些风味。

original: Ah, of course. I suspected as much.
traduit: 啊，当然。我也这么想。

original: You must now add a splash of mead.
traduit: 你现在得加些蜜酒。

original: Vampire dust? Seriously?
traduit: 吸血鬼灰烬？你认真的？

original: Hmm... yes. I guess I can see how that would add a more... earthy texture. And, oddly enough, we do have some on hand...
traduit: 嗯……是。我想这会增加更多……朴实的质感。说来也怪，我们手头确实有……

original: All right. What next, then?
traduit: 好吧。接下来呢？

original: The next ingredient is... vampire dust.
traduit: 下种配料是……吸血鬼灰烬。

original: Maybe we should start over, hmm? We want the Gourmet's famous Potage le Magnifique to be perfect, after all.
traduit: 也许我们应该重新开始了？毕竟我们都希望美食家驰名的美味浓汤是完美的。

original: So, what is the first special ingredient?
traduit: 那，第一种配料是什么？

original: Oh, I get it. This is a test, right? You want to see how well I know the Potage le Magnifique.
traduit: 哦，我明白了。这是个测试，对吗？你想看看我有多了解美味浓汤是吧。

original: Well then, I think  a pinch of frost salts should do the trick, right?
traduit: 那，我想来一小撮霜盐就可以了，对吧？

original: Now what?
traduit: 现在呢？

original: Ooohh.... how decadent. I never would have guessed it.
traduit: 哦……真微妙。我永远也猜不到。

original: What next?
traduit: 接下来是什么？

original: A sweetroll.
traduit: 一个甜卷。

original: Carrots? Really? Okay...
traduit: 胡萝卜？真的吗？好吧……

original: Carrots.
traduit: 胡萝卜。

original: Oh! Yes, but of course. Ahem.
traduit: 哦！对，当然了。嗯哼。

original: The Emperor has requested your signature dish - the Potage le Magnifique. I've taken the liberty of getting it started.
traduit: 皇帝点了您的招牌名菜，美味浓汤。我擅自开始制作了。

original: But the cookbook only says so much, and everyone makes the Potage differently. I would be honored if we could make it... the Gourmet's special way.
traduit: 但菜谱上说的就这么多，而且每个人做汤的方法不一样。如果我们能一起制作的话，那我很荣幸见识到……美食家的特别技艺。

original: The base broth is already boiled. We can get started right now. So... which ingredient should I add next?
traduit: 底汤已经煮好了。现在可以开始了。所以……我接下来该加什么配料？

original: Enough! The Gourmet is here to cook, not talk! Let us begin.
traduit: 够了！美食家是来烹饪的！不是来聊天！我们开始吧。

original: Oh. Well, um, actually... you're not. Wearing a chef's hat, I mean. There's one right over there on the shelf. You can't very well cook without it...
traduit: 哦。嗯，呃，其实……你没准备好。我是说，你还没带厨师帽。那边架子上就有一顶。没有它是做不好饭的……

original: Silence! I am ready to prepare the grand feast!
traduit: 安静！我已经准备好开始烹饪了！

original: You... you're an Argonian! Where did you learn to cook like that? Surely not in Black Marsh. Why even the...
traduit: 你……是个阿尔贡！你从哪儿学的这一手好厨艺？肯定不是在黑沼泽吧。为什么连……

original: I... Well, I just can't believe the Gourmet is a Dark Elf. How difficult it must have been for you in Morrowind. The food there is...
traduit: 我……嗯，我只是不敢相信美食家居然是个暗精灵。你在晨风的日子一定不好过吧。那里的食物……

original: I guessed right! I... I always imagined the great Gourmet was a Wood Elf. You see, only someone with a knowledge of woodland herbs could combine...
traduit: 我猜对了！我……一直觉得大美食家是木精灵。你看，只有懂得林地草药知识的人才能把……

original: You're a High Elf! I... I never would have guessed it. So many of your recipes are clearly aimed at the commonfolk. It just seems...
traduit: 你是个高精灵！我……永远猜不到。你那么多食谱都是针对一般种族的。似乎……

original: It's just... Well... you're an Orc! Ha ha ha! If the people of the Empire only knew! I mean, now I understand your need for secrecy. Most would...
traduit: 你……居然……是个兽人！哈哈哈！要是帝国民众知道了的话！我是说，我现在知道你为什么要保密了。大多数人……

original: Well, I just never expected the Gourmet to be a Breton. It almost seems too obvious. Some of the greatest cooks have been Bretons, and...
traduit: 嗯，我只是没想到美食家会是布莱顿人。似乎太明显了。很多大厨都是布莱顿人出身。

original: You're a Nord! I never would have guessed it! But where in the world did you learn to cook like that? Here in Skyrim? Or maybe somewhere less...
traduit: 你是诺德人！我真没想到！但你是从哪里学到的手艺？在天际？还是别的地方……

original: Well, I'm just surprised the Gourmet is a Redguard. I had you pegged for a Wood Elf, honestly. You know, because of your use of...
traduit: 嗯，我只是有点惊讶美食家居然是个红卫人。说实话，我还以为你是木精灵呢。因为你用了……

original: Well, I don't mean to seem disappointed, but... I just never figured the Gourmet was an Imperial. I had dreamed of something more exotic, maybe...
traduit: 哎，我不想显得很失望，但……我只是没想到美食家居然是个帝国人。我还幻想过一些更奇特的种族，也许……

original: The... Gourmet?
traduit: 美……美食家？

original: Oh! Finally! When I heard the Gourmet was being brought in to cook for the Emperor, I could hardly believe it.
traduit: 哦！终于来了！听说那位美食家要来为皇帝烹饪的时候，我简直不敢相信。

original: It's just...
traduit: 实在太……

original: You misunderstand. For I am... the Gourmet!
traduit: 你误会了。我是……美食家！

original: Not another delivery. I told you people, our stocks are fine. Now put whatever you have over there, then get out!
traduit: 不是那个。我告诉过你们了，我们的库存很好。现在把东西放那边然后赶紧出去！

original: We'll begin as soon as you're wearing the hat. Check the shelf over there. Wouldn't want the Emperor mistaking you for someone else, now would we.
traduit: 等你戴上帽子我们就开始。去那边架子上看看。我可不想让皇帝误以为你是什么别的人。

original: Oh, just look at you. Absolutely brilliant. Now... now you're just as I imagined.
traduit: 哦，看看你自己。绝对好看。现在……你和我想象中一模一样了。

original: The Emperor is going to love it. How can he not?
traduit: 皇帝一定会喜欢的。有什么理由不喜欢呢？

original: Keep it together, Gianna. Keep it together...
traduit: 冷静点，吉安娜。冷静点……

original: Maybe when this is all over, you could sign one of your cookbooks for me?
traduit: 等一切结束后，你愿意给我在你的食谱上签个名吗？

original: I'm so nervous.
traduit: 我太紧张了。

original: Just go right into the tower, then straight ahead to the kitchen. Gianna's expecting you.
traduit: 进塔吧，直接去厨房。吉安娜正等着你呢。

original: The Gourmet. This is such an honor.
traduit: 美食家。这是我的荣幸。

original: The misses and I love your strawberry tarts.
traduit: 我和小姐们都很喜欢你的草莓馅饼。

original: Hmmm, the Potage le Magnifique. Smells delicious.
traduit: 嗯，美味浓汤。闻起来很好。

original: Please, carry on.
traduit: 请继续。

original: Move along, citizen.
traduit: 公民，离远点。

original: What's this now?
traduit: 这是什么？

original: ...order of his eminence... ...possessor of these papers... the "Gourmet"...
traduit: ……凭他高贵的命令……此文件持有者……“美食家”……

original: By Azura. The Gourmet!
traduit: 阿祖拉在上。是美食家！

original: I... I'm sorry! Your clothes... of course... I should have realized!
traduit: 很抱歉！你的衣着。……当然……我早该想到的！

original: Please, excuse my ignorance.  Gianna, the castle chef, has been eagerly awaiting your arrival. You should proceed to the kitchens straight away.
traduit: 请原谅我的无知。城堡的厨师吉安娜一直热切地等你到来。你应该马上到厨房去。

original: (Show Maro the Gourmet's Writ of Passage)
traduit: （向马洛出示美食家的通行证）

original: I... I'm sorry! I didn't realize! We... we had no idea who to expect, you understand. You're not dressed as I would have suspected...
traduit: 很抱歉！我没注意到！请你理解，我们……甚至不知道在等谁。你的穿着和我想的不太一样……

original: But please, don't let me keep you. Proceed to the kitchens straight away. Gianna, the castle chef, has been eagerly awaiting your arrival.
traduit: 但是，请不要为我耽搁。马上去厨房吧。城堡的厨师吉安娜一直热切期盼你的到来。

original: Stop right there. The tower is off limits until further notice.
traduit: 立刻停下。在进一步通知下达前，塔楼禁止进入。

original: Gianna will be overjoyed to meet you. She's in the kitchens.
traduit: 吉安娜见到你肯定会很高兴的。她就在厨房等着。

original: It's a rare plant, found only on the island of Stros M'Kai. It can be served like any vegetable - cut up, put in a salad, perhaps boiled in a stew.
traduit: 一种稀罕的植物，只在斯卓·米'凯岛上出产。可以像任何蔬菜一样切碎了拌到菜里，或者煮进汤里。

original: One taste will lead to nearly instant death, so don't even think about it.
traduit: 别想着偷偷尝了，一口就能要了你的命。

original: What else can you tell me about jarrin root?
traduit: 能跟我说说加林根吗？

original: Here, take this - it's called Jarrin Root.
traduit: 来，拿着，这是加林根。

original: All it takes is one taste, and the effects are quite immediate. The Emperor will be serving Sithis before he even knows he's dead.
traduit: 只要尝上一口，立竿见影。在皇帝回过味儿前，他就去见西帝斯了。

original: Once Mede has been killed, escape through the upper door, and across the bridge. I've "arranged" for it to be unguarded once the alarm is sounded.
traduit: 一旦迈德被杀，从上面的门逃出去，穿过桥。我已经“安排”了，即使警报响起也没人看管。

original: Now go, my friend. Go, and fulfill your destiny as Listener.
traduit: 去吧，朋友。完成你作为聆听者的使命。

original: Which poison I should use?
traduit: 我该用什么毒？

original: Hmph. Look at you. So calm. So confident. I do believe you were born for this task. So let's begin.
traduit: 嗯。看看你。如此平静又如此自信。我相信你天生适合这项任务。我们开始吧。

original: Go now to Castle Dour in Solitude. Present the Gourmet's Writ of Passage to the officer in charge, Commander Maro. I'm sure you remember him.
traduit: 现在去独孤城的阴郁堡，把美食家的通行证交给负责的马洛指挥官。相信你还对他有印象。

original: You'll gain unrestricted access to the kitchens, and then the Emperor. You're posing as a chef, so you'll be able to poison his meal rather easily.
traduit: 你可以自由进出厨房，然后觐见皇帝。因为你假扮成了厨师，所以很容易在食物里下毒。

original: Yes. For Sithis... and the Night Mother. You are the Listener after all, hmm? So let's not waste any more time.
traduit: 是。为了西帝斯……还有夜母。你毕竟是聆听者么，所以不要浪费时间了。

original: The Emperor will die! For Sithis and the Night Mother!
traduit: 皇帝死定了！！为了西帝斯，为了夜母！

original: Oh, I have the utmost faith in your success, believe me. So let's begin.
traduit: 我对你充满信心，你一定能马到成功。咱们快点开始吧。

original: I won't disappoint you, Astrid. Or the Dark Brotherhood.
traduit: 阿斯垂德，我不会让你和黑暗兄弟会失望的。

original: Oh yes. And I've decided you will have the honor.
traduit: 哦，没错。而且我决定把这项殊荣让给你。

original: So it's time? We're ready to assassinate the Emperor?
traduit: 是时候了吗？我们要去刺杀皇帝吗？

original: I wish we could offer more help, but our last attack went sour and we're all that is left.
traduit: 我也希望能够提供更多帮助，但上次进攻失败之后，就剩这几个人了。

original: Fine then.  The blood of my family is on your hands as well as Brurid's.
traduit: 很好。你和布瑞德的手上都沾满了我家族的血。

original: Now, back to the matter at hand.
traduit: 现在，回到问题上。

original: I suppose that's the fairest deal we're likely to get.
traduit: 我想这是我们能获得的最公平的交易。

original: Pay no attention to him. A ponderous windbag, like most Imperial generals.
traduit: 别理他。他和大多数帝国将军一样，就是个呆板又饶舌的家伙。

original: I accept your offer. I'd like to join the Stormcloaks.
traduit: 我接受你的提议。我想加入风暴斗篷。

original: Welcome, brother! I'm glad that your eyes have finally been opened to the Empire's true nature.
traduit: 欢迎你，兄弟！真高兴你终于看清了帝国的真面目。

original: Welcome, sister! I'm glad that your eyes have finally been opened to the Empire's true nature.
traduit: 欢迎你，姐妹！真高兴你终于看清了帝国的真面目。

original: You and Tullius are both mistaken. I'm loyal to the Empire.
traduit: 你和图留斯都错了。我忠于帝国。

original: I'm sorry to hear that. I thought your eyes had finally been opened to the Empire's true nature.
traduit: 真不想听到这个消息。我以为你会看清帝国的真面目。

original: The Empire showed its true colors today, eh? Don't worry. I was once loyal to the Empire, too, before my eyes were opened.
traduit: 帝国今天露出真面目了吧？别担心。在我看清一切前，我也曾对它忠心耿耿。

original: Come see me in Windhelm when all this is over, and I'll find a place for you.
traduit: 结束之后来风舵城找我，我会给你找个位置。

original: I think you may have joined up with the wrong side, Dragonborn. You showed yourself a true son of Skyrim here today.
traduit: 我觉得你可能站错了阵营，龙裔。你今天展现了一个真正天际之子的姿态。

original: I think you may have joined up with the wrong side, Dragonborn. You showed yourself a true daughter of Skyrim here today.
traduit: 我觉得你可能站错了阵营，龙裔。你今天展现了一个真正天际之女的姿态。

original: Sorry, sir. I was trying to come to a fair agreement.
traduit: 对不起，长官。我只是想达成一个公平的协定。

original: Fair? This is war, soldier. War's about winning, not being fair to the enemy.
traduit: 公平？士兵，记住这是战争。战争只有胜败，不讲对敌人公平。

original: Shout for Odahviing from the Dragonsreach courtyard. After that, it's up to you.
traduit: 在龙临宫的天井里大喊傲达威英。剩下的就交给你了。

original: Interesting problem. Hmm. Yes. I've been poring over the records here in Sky Haven Temple.
traduit: 好问题。嗯。没错。我一直在研究天佑神殿的记录。

original: I need a way to lure a dragon to Dragonsreach. Any ideas?
traduit: 我需要把龙引到龙临宫。有什么好办法吗？

original: Just say the word, and my men will help you spring this trap.
traduit: 只要你开口。我的人就会帮你开启陷阱。

original: By Talos, that's an excellent question. I hope you haven't forgotten that little detail?
traduit: 塔洛斯在上，好问题。你没忘记这个小细节吧？

original: Yes, I'm ready to do my part.
traduit: 是的，我准备好了。

original: Jarl Vignar, I assume you are familiar with the Dragonborn's plan?
traduit: 维吉纳领主，你应该知道龙裔的计划吧？

original: This is quite an achievement, Dragonborn. And Jarl Ulfric. Markarth is ours!
traduit: 了不起的成就龙裔。乌弗瑞克领主，马卡斯现在归我们了。

original: Giving up Riften is a heavy price to pay for this truce, Dragonborn. I hope it was worth it.
traduit: 放弃裂谷城来达成休战是个沉重的代价，龙裔。我希望这样是值得的。

original: I admit, I really didn't expect these talks to succeed. Getting the Empire to agree to anything at all is quite an achievement.
traduit: 我承认，我确实没想到这次会议成功。让帝国同意任何事情都是了不起的成就。

original: Legate, with me. We have a lot of work to do.
traduit: 副官，跟我走。咱们还有好多工作呢。

original: I'm sorry. Good luck.
traduit: 很抱歉。祝你好运。

original: You are hereby dishonorably dismissed and removed from the rolls of the Imperial Legion.
traduit: 你在此被耻辱地开除了，从帝国军团的名单除名。

original: I thought the Empire needed to be taken down a notch.
traduit: 我觉得帝国需要低调些。

original: You made your decision. Now live with it.
traduit: 你已经做出决定。接受它吧。

original: I did what I thought was right.
traduit: 我觉得我做的没错。

original: I'm sure that will be comforting to your comrades that gave their lives for the territory you just handed to Ulfric.
traduit: 对你那些为了攻下你奉送乌弗瑞克的土地而浴血牺牲的战友来说，这或许是种安慰。

original: You should think harder on your oath to the Emperor next time you're deciding what's right.
traduit: 下次决定何为正确之前，希望你好好想想对皇帝的誓言。

original: Your actions here were a disgrace. You betrayed your oath to the Emperor at every turn.
traduit: 你在这里的行为很可耻。你一直在违背对皇帝立下的誓言。

original: You... you disappointed me. You gave too much away. More than was necessary to secure this truce.
traduit: 你……让我失望了。你出让的太多了。已经超出达成休战的必要限度。

original: You're losing this war, and you know it.
traduit: 你正在输掉战争，你心里很清楚。

original: You'll never defeat the Empire, and you know it. But you're willing to sacrifice thousands for your own selfish ambition.
traduit: 你永远无法打败帝国，你心里很清楚。但你为了你一己的野心牺牲了数以千计的性命。

original: I know you, Ulfric. If I hand over Markarth, you'll be ready with a new demand.
traduit: 我了解你，乌弗瑞克。如果我让出马卡斯，你就会提出新的要求。

original: Now we'll see if there's anything behind your talk of good faith.
traduit: 现在来看看你所谓的善意背后到底是什么。

original: The Dragonborn has spoken, Tullius. Markarth will be ours.
traduit: 龙裔发话了，图留斯。马卡斯将是我们的。

original: Sure, but will I come out of there alive?
traduit: 好吧，但我能活着回来吗？

original: Ha ha. If it was like that she wouldn't be asking for you, she'd be calling on the Dark Brotherhood.
traduit: 哈哈。如果那样她也就不会找你了，直接喊黑暗兄弟会不就得了。

original: It's just business.
traduit: 只是生意往来而已。

original: I thought I did the job like you asked...?
traduit: 我以为我按你说的做了就……？

original: Oh, no. Nothing like that. You're calling on her for business.
traduit: 哦，不。没什么大不了的。她只是要找你聊聊生意。

original: Good, it's about time I met her.
traduit: 好，我是该见见她了。

original: Don't sound so eager, it's not a social visit. It's business.
traduit: 别那么着急，这不是社交往来，是生意。

original: Maven Black-Briar is the influential client?
traduit: 玛雯·黑棘是很有影响力的客户？

original: We had an arrangement with Maven. We kept an eye on Goldenglow Estate to make sure the honey kept flowing.
traduit: 我们和玛雯之间有协议。我们密切关注金色光辉庄园，确保蜂蜜供应源源不断。

original: If the workers had a dispute, we'd rough them up. If competitors tried to buy honey from Aringoth, we'd steal the shipments.
traduit: 如果工人们闹事，我们就用些暴力手段对付他们。假如有竞争对手想从阿林格斯那买蜂蜜，我们就去偷货。

original: In return, Maven allowed us to extort Aringoth and bring in a huge payout.
traduit: 作为回报，玛雯允许我们好好地敲诈阿林格斯。

original: Mercenaries? Not Riften guards?
traduit: 佣兵？不是裂谷城的卫兵？

original: Aye. Aringoth sent the city guard packing and fortified the entire island.
traduit: 对。阿林格斯派出卫兵占领并加固整个岛屿。

original: In fact, Vex barely made it out of there alive. You should talk to her about it before you go.
traduit: 事实上，小烦都差点没活着出来。你去之前应该找她谈谈。

original: Get ready. Trouble ahead.
traduit: 做好准备。有麻烦了。

original: Yuck. Something smells.
traduit: 啧。有什么味道。

original: Trouble is in the air here.
traduit: 有麻烦的气息。

original: I've got a bad feeling about this.
traduit: 我有不祥的预感。

original: I smell blood.
traduit: 我闻到血味儿了。

original: Keep your blade ready.
traduit: 把武器准备好。

original: I don't like where this is going.
traduit: 感觉不太妙啊。

original: I have a feeling there's going to be trouble.
traduit: 我预感有麻烦了。

original: Get ready for a fight.
traduit: 准备战斗。

original: Get a bad feeling.
traduit: 有不好的预感了。

original: Don't like the looks of this.
traduit: 我不喜欢这样子。

original: Something smells foul.
traduit: 有些奇怪的味道。

original: Got a feeling there's trouble ahead.
traduit: 我觉得前面有麻烦了。

original: Smell that? Blood.
traduit: 闻到了吗？是血。

original: I don't think I like where this is going.
traduit: 我可能不太喜欢现在的情况。

original: Don't see that every day.
traduit: 这可不是天天能看到的东西啊。

original: I've seen better. Well, maybe not.
traduit: 我见过更好的。好吧，也许没有。

original: Damn. That's quite a sight.
traduit: 该死的。这也太壮观了。

original: I've never seen anything quite like that.
traduit: 我从没见过这样的东西。

original: What a sight....
traduit: 好壮观啊……

original: Mighty impressive.
traduit: 太震撼了。

original: Wow! That's impressive.
traduit: 喔！太震撼了。

original: By the Hist, what a sight....
traduit: 希斯特啊，太壮观了……

original: That's...that's...wow.
Impressive. Damn impressive.
traduit: 神奇。太他妈神奇了。

original: Look at that. Am I drunk? I must be drunk.
traduit: 看看这个。是我喝多了吗？我肯定是喝多了。

original: Wow. Would you look at that.
traduit: 喔。你看到了吗。

original: By the Twin Moons...
traduit: 双月在上啊……

original: By Ysmir! That's impressive.
traduit: 伊斯米尔啊！这也太厉害了。

original: Gotta admit, that's impressive.
traduit: 不得不承认，太厉害了。

original: By the Nine!
traduit: 九圣灵啊！

original: There's a cave here. Perfect hideout for bandits or worse.
traduit: 这里有个洞穴啊。强盗们的完美藏身处，甚至是更糟糕的东西。

original: Another filthy cave. Always so dark.
traduit: 又一个肮脏的洞穴。总是那么黑暗。

original: Hmm. Caves. Wonder what's below.
traduit: 嗯。山洞。想知道下面有什么。

original: Hey look, a cave. Wonder what's inside?
traduit: 嘿看呐，有个洞穴。里头有什么呢？

original: Look, a cave. An exciting place to venture, if you know what you're doing.
traduit: 看，有个山洞。如果你知道自己在做什么，这就是个不错的冒险地。

original: There's a cave here. Bears if we're lucky. Trolls if we're not.
traduit: 有个洞穴啊。遇上熊就算幸运了，最好别是巨魔。

original: Look at that, a cave. Who knows what could be down there?
traduit: 看那儿，有个洞穴。谁知道这下面有什么呢？

original: Look, a cave. A fine place to find trouble.
traduit: 看，有个洞穴。找麻烦的好地方。

original: A cave. Dark. Dangerous.
traduit: 洞穴。又黑暗，又危险。

original: There's a cave. Tread carefully.
traduit: 有个洞穴。要谨慎点。

original: Hey, there's a cave. Bad place to stumble drunk.
traduit: 嘿，有个洞穴。醉醺醺地绊倒在这里可不妙。

original: There's a cave here. Think we should check it out?
traduit: 这儿有个洞穴。我们要去看看吗？

original: We've found a cave. I don't think there are warm fires and friendly faces inside.
traduit: 发现洞穴了。我可不觉得这里面有温暖的火焰和友善的面孔。

original: There's a cave. Animals or bandits inside, no doubt.
traduit: 有个洞穴。里面肯定有动物或者强盗。

original: A cave. Up for some hunting?
traduit: 有洞穴诶。要去打猎吗？

original: Cave up ahead. Trouble or maybe treasure?
traduit: 洞穴就在前面。里面是有麻烦还是宝藏呢？

original: It's a Nordic ruin. Thousands of years old.
traduit: 是个诺德遗迹。得有几千年了吧。

original: Look. Nordic ruins. I hope there's gold inside.
traduit: 看。诺德遗迹。但愿里面有金子。

original: Nordic ruins. Old. Secretive.
traduit: 诺德遗迹。古老而神秘。

original: Is that one of the old ruins?
traduit: 那是古遗迹中的一个吗？

original: Oh, look. A Nordic ruin.
traduit: 哦，看呐。是个诺德遗迹。

original: Old ruins. Nordic, I think.
traduit: 是个古老遗迹。我猜是诺德的。

original: My word, look at those ruins. Remarkable.
traduit: 我的天，看看这些遗迹。真是非凡。

original: Look at those ruins. How long have they stood here, I wonder?
traduit: 看看这些遗迹。它们在这里站了多久了？

original: Old stonework. Gold, traps, and bones.
traduit: 古老的石艺。金币、陷阱还有枯骨。

original: Nord stonework. Thousands of years old.
traduit: 几千年的诺德石雕啊。

original: Look at those old stones. Ancient Nords sure could build.
traduit: 看看这些古老石头。古诺德人真是擅长建筑。

original: Look at those ruins. Think there's gold inside?
traduit: 看看这些遗迹。里面会有金子吗？

original: The old Nords sure did love their stonework.
traduit: 古诺德人确实很喜欢石雕啊。

original: Look at these stones. The ancestors knew how to build, no doubt.
traduit: 看看这些石头。毫无疑问，古人很懂得建造工艺。

original: Ruins ahead. Means old traps and bonewalkers.
traduit: 前面有遗迹。也就是说有古老的陷阱和骨行者。

original: Look. One of the ancient Nord ruins. Who knows what's down there?
traduit: 看。是个古诺德遗迹。下面有什么呢？

original: The entrance to a dwarven city. All manner of strange traps and machines will be inside.
traduit: 是通往矮人城市的入口。里面有很多奇怪的陷阱和机器。

original: Is this that dwarven city? I hear the treasure from their ruins is worth a fortune.
traduit: 这就是矮人城市吗？我听说遗迹里的宝藏价值连城啊。

original: Dwemer ruins. The people under the mountains. All gone now.
traduit: 锻莫遗迹。群山之下的种族。现在已经消逝了。

original: Look over there. That's a dwarven ruin.
traduit: 看那边。是个矮人遗迹。

original: A dwarven city. A place of mystery and death.
traduit: 矮人城市。充满神秘和死亡的地方。

original: Dwarven metalwork. So much wasted effort.
traduit: 矮人的金属工艺。得浪费多少精力。

original: Oh, look. It's the entrance to a dwarven city. I've heard stories....
traduit: 哦，看。是矮人城市入口。我听说过传闻……

original: I dislike lurking near dwarven cities. It's like their ghosts are watching us.
traduit: 我不喜欢待在矮人城市附近。就好像他们的鬼魂在盯着我们一样。

original: Huh. Dwarven ruins. Strange places.
traduit: 嗯。矮人遗迹。奇怪的地方。

original: A Dwemer city. The lost people. The heretics.
traduit: 锻莫城市。那群失落的人。异教徒。

original: Is that a dwarven city? I've never seen a dwarf, ever. Don't think anyone has.
traduit: 是矮人城市吗？我从来没见过矮人。我想没人见过。

original: Seems like a ruin. Dwarven, I think?
traduit: 看起来是个遗迹。应该是矮人的吧？
