original: By the Mane, look. A dwarven city. Still sitting here after thousands of years.
traduit: 鬃鬣啊，看。是矮人城市。几千年过去了，居然还在这儿。

original: Get nervous around dwarven stonework. Legends say these cities are haunted.
traduit: 在这些矮人遗迹附近会让人紧张。据说这些城市会闹鬼。

original: Old dwarven ruin. Look at that metalwork. Such a waste.
traduit: 古代矮人遗迹。看看这些金属工艺。太浪费了。

original: That's a dwarven city. I hear they built armor that walks like people.
traduit: 有个矮人城市。我听说他们造出来能和人一样走路的盔甲。

original: Yes. He'll do.
traduit: 是啊。

original: We can just sacrifice another disciple. Apprentice Haerlon will be no great waste.
traduit: 我们可以再献祭一个门徒。牺牲掉学徒哈隆也不浪费。

original: We can't take another villager from the surface so soon. I told you to prepare everything properly!
traduit: 我们不能这么频繁地绑架村民。我告诉你要准备万全的！

original: More souls are needed for the Star. The last one died before he could be harvested.
traduit: 那颗星需要更多灵魂。最后一个还没来得及收割就死掉了。

original: You look like you've just seen a ghost. Please tell me you haven't. Cicero said he spoke to the Night Mother... but she spoke to you?
traduit: 你看起来就像刚见了鬼一样。千万别说你真撞见了。西塞罗说他在和夜母说话……但她却跟你说话了？

original: Okay, let's all take a deep breath. Cicero said he spoke to the Night Mother, but she spoke to you? Please tell me this is some kind of sick joke.
traduit: 好，我们都深呼吸一下。西塞罗说自己在和夜母说话，但夜母和你说了话？你最好告诉我这是个变态玩笑。

original: I...  I don't know. It happened so fast.
traduit: 我……我不知道。事情太突然了。

original: We're not done talking. You fell for that hussy Esmerelda, with the dark feathers - didn't you? I won't let her have you!
traduit: 我没还没说完。你不是爱上了那个满身黑毛的贱人艾丝美拉达吗？我不会让她得到你的！

original: Good luck, Nightingale.
traduit: 祝你好运，夜莺。

original: Choose your path and your journey will be complete.
traduit: 选择你的道路完成旅途吧。

original: Tell me about the Agent of Strife.
traduit: 跟我说说冲突特使。

original: This Agent of Strife can send forth a tendril of pure darkness into the heart of another, causing great injury to them.
traduit: 冲突特使可以把纯粹的黑暗送入他人内心，对他们造成巨大伤害。

original: At the same time, this tether will bolster the agent's own life force, making him stronger.
traduit: 同时，这根锁链能增强特使的生命力，让他变得更强。

original: Tell me about the Agent of Subterfuge.
traduit: 跟我说说诡计特使。

original: The Agent of Subterfuge utilizes shadow to cloud the judgement of those around him.
traduit: 诡计特使可以利用阴影蒙蔽周围人的判断力。

original: By weaving the darkness to their will, this agent can manipulate others into fighting for the Nightingale for a limited time.
traduit: 诡计特使可以通过将黑暗编入人的意志，操纵他人为夜莺战斗一段时间。

original: Tell me about the Agent of Stealth.
traduit: 跟我说说隐秘特使。

original: The Agent of Stealth is the master of remaining unseen. They are able to manipulate the darkness and use it to their advantage.
traduit: 隐秘特使是隐身大师。他们能够操纵并利用黑暗。

original: On moonlit nights or in darkened rooms, this agent literally becomes invisible.
traduit: 在月夜或昏暗的房间，隐秘特使几乎可以完全隐身。

original: I return from the war to find my home overrun with bandit filth.
traduit: 我从战场上回来却发现自家被一群垃圾强盗占了。

original: Those bastards.
traduit: 这些杂种。

original: Ayarg garag gar!
traduit: 啊呀咯 嘎啦 嘎！

original: Ha! Surely you're pulling Cicero's leg!
traduit: 哈！你在逗西塞罗吗！

original: Wait... the Listener is serious? Oh.
traduit: 等等……聆听者是认真的？哦。

original: Well of course the Night Mother will speak to you again! She might speak now, or later, or... I don't know! But speak she will!
traduit: 夜母当然会再和你交谈！她可能现在说，或者以后说，或者……我不知道！但总之会说的！

original: The Night Mother is part of you now! You get to hear voices inside your head! The rest of us should be so lucky.
traduit: 夜母如今已经是你的一部分了！你能够在脑海里直接听到她的声音！我们其他人真幸运。

original: Will the Night Mother speak to me again?
traduit: 夜母还会跟我说话吗？

original: Oh... Well... yes. I did. I did indeed. I tried to listen. Tried so hard. But the Night Mother never spoke to poor Cicero.
traduit: 哦……嗯……没错。我想啊。我确实想。我试着去倾听。很努力地去听。但夜母从来没和可怜的西塞罗说过话。

original: The silence became almost... maddening.
traduit: 那沉寂几乎……令人抓狂。

original: Oh, but that was then! This is now! You're the Listener, and the Night Mother chose you for a reason, I'm sure! Cicero will remain the happy Keeper.
traduit: 哦，但是都过去了！现在！你是聆听者，我相信夜母的选择！西塞罗依旧是个快乐的守护者。

original: Cicero, did you want to be the Listener?
traduit: 西塞罗，你想成为聆听者吗？

original: Oh, the Listener, well... listens! The Night Mother speaks to you. Guides you on your path.
traduit: 哦，聆听者嘛，当然是……听了！夜母会与你说话。指引你前行。

original: But when the Night Mother speaks, the Listener must obey. You must! For her word is the will of Sithis. And Sithis is the Dark Brotherhood incarnate.
traduit: 但夜母说的话聆听者必须服从。必须！因为她的话就是西帝斯的意志。西帝斯就是黑暗兄弟会的化身。

original: What exactly does a Listener do?
traduit: 聆听者需要做什么？

original: So Azura isn't giving you more visions?
traduit: 所以阿祖拉没再给你更多启示？

original: No. She said my part was over. That my fate had moved beyond the Twilight, and I was on my own.
traduit: 没有了。她说我的使命结束了。我们命运已经穿越了暮光。现在需要靠我自己了。

original: I will tend Azura's shrine when you do not need me. I still have my duties, but for the first time I feel... alone.
traduit: 你不需要我帮忙的时候，我会继续照看阿祖拉的祭坛。虽然职责还在，但我还是第一次感觉到……孤独。

original: Until next time, guardian.
traduit: 回头见，守护者。

original: It's been an honor, guardian.
traduit: 我很荣幸，守护者。

original: What use would you be?
traduit: 你会些什么？

original: I was a sorceress of no small skill before I came into Azura's faith. Afterwards, her magic sustained me.
traduit: 在我皈依阿祖拉之前，是一个技艺娴熟的术士。后来，她的魔法支撑着我。

original: I could easily provide my spells to your cause. Protect you from harm. Defeat your enemies.
traduit: 我可以轻易地使用魔法。帮你提供保护、击败敌人。

original: Thank you, Aranea.
traduit: 谢谢你，阿兰尼亚。

original: Twilight watch over you, guardian.
traduit: 愿暮光护佑你，守护者。

original: While you were in the Star, Azura gave me a vision. Her last, she said.
traduit: 在你进入星内的时候，阿祖拉最后一次赐予我启示。

original: I have never been without Azura's foresight since escaping Morrowind. I don't know what to do.
traduit: 自从逃离晨风。我一直追随阿祖拉的远见，我不知道该做什么了。

original: If you need me, I'd be honored to accompany you, Guardian of the Star. It would give me a purpose.
traduit: 星之守护者，如果你需要帮助，我很荣幸能作为你的同伴。这样我也有目标了。

original: Leave this shrine, blasphemer, before I kill you for defiling Azura's artifact.
traduit: 亵渎之人，远离祭坛，不然我就以玷污阿祖拉神器之罪将你杀死。

original: She wishes to speak to you herself. Please. Place your hands on the altar, and you will hear her voice.
traduit: 她想亲自和你谈谈。来，把手放在祭坛上，你就能听到她的声音。

original: Azura. Mother of Roses. Goddess of Dusk and Dawn. Your chosen champion has returned your Star to you.
traduit: 阿祖拉，玫瑰之母，晨昏女神。您选中的勇士已经把星辰带回来了。

original: This experiment of yours is over!
traduit: 你的实验结束了！

original: This is my realm. I won't let you take it from me!
traduit: 这是我的领域！我不会让你抢走它！

original: You can't escape your fate, Malyn.
traduit: 马林，你逃不开自己的命运。

original: Ah, my disciples have sent me a fresh soul. Good. I was getting... hungry.
traduit: 啊，我的门徒又给我带了一个新鲜的灵魂。很好。我已经有点……饿了。

original: Wait. There's something different about you.
traduit: 等等。你有些不对劲。

original: I have Alessandra's dagger here.
traduit: 我这里有亚历山德拉的匕首。

original: She finally decided to return it to her father. Bless her heart.
traduit: 她终于决定把它还给她父亲了。祝福她的好意。

original: I will make sure this finds its way to his tomb as soon as possible. Thank you for bringing it, my child.
traduit: 我会尽快把这个送往他的墓里。谢谢你带过来，孩子。

original: But you ended up doing it anyway.
traduit: 但你还是做了。

original: I had to for honor's sake, but I had waited too long. My father died before he could see my training to completion.
traduit: 为了荣誉，不得不如此。但我等太久了。我父亲没能看到我完成训练就去世了。

original: When I finally became a priest, they gave me the new high priest's dagger, but I already owned my father's.
traduit: 当我最终成为一名祭司的时候，他们给了我一把新的高级祭司匕首，但我已经有我父亲的了。

original: So you see, I have to return it. It breaks tradition, and I need to tell him that I finally did what he wanted.
traduit: 所以你看，我得把它还回去。这打破了传统，我得告诉他我终于如他所愿了。

original: What's special about the dagger?
traduit: 这把匕首有什么特别的吗？

original: A Priest of Arkay is entrusted with a ceremonial dagger once they've completed their training.
traduit: 阿尔凯祭司在完成训练之后就会被授予仪式用的匕首。

original: It usually given by the head priest who sanctified the ritual. In my case, the head priest happened to be my father.
traduit: 通常都是由考核仪式的主持祭司授予的。对我而言，主持祭司正好是我父亲。

original: The thing is, I never wanted to follow in his footsteps... I some ways I still don't.
traduit: 问题是，我来没想步他后尘……因为某些原因，我现在仍然不想。

original: The Thalmor never forget.
traduit: 梭默从未忘记。

original: You'll have a traitor's death.
traduit: 叛徒要有叛徒的下场。

original: Why struggle? The Thalmor will only send more like me.
traduit: 为何抵抗？梭默只会派来更多向我一样的刺客。

original: Indeed. That would be best.
traduit: 确实。那最好不过。

original: Malborn has a message for you.
traduit: 马伯恩有消息要给你。

original: Malborn? Ah... very good. I think we understand each other.
traduit: 马伯恩？啊……非常好。咱们彼此理解了。

original: Move on, friend. I have nothing to sell today.
traduit: 离开吧，朋友。我今天没什么可卖的。

original: I was trying to get to Morrowind. The Dunmer don't care much for the Thalmor and I figured I'd be safe there. As safe as anywhere,that is.
traduit: 我打算去晨风。丹莫不太喜欢梭默。所以那里应该比别的地方安全。

original: But there's a Khajiit hanging around the main gate. I didn't like the way he was looking at me.
traduit: 但是门口有个卡吉特在徘徊。我不喜欢他看我的样子。

original: I'm sure he's Thalmor. Just waiting for me to leave so he can follow me and kill me in a lonely place.
traduit: 我敢肯定他是个梭默。只要我一离开，他就可以跟踪我，然后找个僻静地方杀了。

original: Sounds like you're just being paranoid.
traduit: 你听起来有点多心了。

original: No, you can't ever be too paranoid where the Thalmor is concerned. Look what happened to the Blades. The Blades!
traduit: 不，你不能对梭默掉以轻心。想想刀锋会的下场！

original: If the damn Blades are no match for the Thalmor, what chance do I have?
traduit: 如果连刀锋会都对付不了梭默。我又有什么把握？

original: Please, just go check it out. You'll be saving my life.
traduit: 求你了，去看看吧。你得救我一命。

original: Don't worry. I'll take care of this assassin for you.
traduit: 不用担心。我会帮你对付那个刺客。

original: You'd be saving my life. Again. I know I probably seemed ungrateful... I've just been so scared. Expecting a knife at my throat any minute.
traduit: 你又救了我一命。我知道我这样或许有些忘恩负义……但我太害怕了。我总觉得有一把刀子在我喉咙上捅来捅去。

original: Tell me about this Thalmor assassin that's hunting you.
traduit: 跟我说说追杀你的梭默刺客。

original: That's... great news. I'd... I'd better go. Right now. Before they find me again. This is my chance.
traduit: 真是个……好消息。我得……我得在他们找到我前赶紧走。这是个机会。

original: Thank you! Here... I stole a lot from the Thalmor over the years. You may as well have some of it.
traduit: 谢谢你！来……我这些年从梭默那偷了不少东西。你拿走些吧。

original: The Thalmor assassin is dead. It's safe to leave Windhelm.
traduit: 梭默刺客死了。你现在可以安全离开风舵城了。

original: I was trying to get to Morrowind. The Dunmer don't care much for the Thalmor and I figured I'd be safe there. As safe as anywhere, that is.
traduit: 我打算去晨风。丹莫不太喜欢梭默。所以那里应该比别的地方安全。

original: Sorry, I can't help right now.
traduit: 抱歉，我现在帮不了你。

original: Sure, fine. Thanks for nothing. You already got what you needed from me.
traduit: 好吧。不劳你费心了。你已经从我这得到了想要的，我也就没什么用了。

original: You helped me. I'll do what I can to help you.
traduit: 你帮了我。我也得尽力帮你。

original: You will? Really? Well, okay, here's the situation.
traduit: 你真的会帮我？好，情况是这样的。

original: Trying to stay alive. I think time's running out though. I'm pretty sure the Thalmor know where I am.
traduit: 试着活下去罢了。我觉得时日无多了。我敢肯定梭默已经知道了我的下落。

original: Maybe you can help me. You know, by way of making amends for getting me into this mess.
traduit: 你也许能帮我。你得明白，这是弥补把我搞成这幅德行的损失。

original: It's Delphine you should be angry with, not me.
traduit: 要生气也是生戴尔芬的，别冲我来。

original: Don't worry, I'm mad at her, too. And at myself for ever agreeing to get involved in her insane scheme.
traduit: 别着急。我确实生她的气。但也怪我自己，居然会同意参加她那个疯子计划。

original: At least you're still alive. That's something.
traduit: 至少你还活着。这就不错了。

original: I count my blessings every day.
traduit: 我每天都在祈祷。

original: Malborn, it's good to see you.
traduit: 马伯恩，很高兴又见到你。

original: Trying to stay ahead of the Thalmor assassins. I'm not a hero like you. I don't stand a chance.
traduit: 我正忙着躲梭默的刺客呢，我没你那么英雄。这回是没救了。

original: Malborn, what are you doing here?
traduit: 马伯恩，你在这里做什么？

original: Oh, it's you. I didn't expect to see you again.
traduit: 啊，是你啊。没想到还能再见到你。

original: Well, we'd better get back to our rounds.
traduit: 好了，该回营房了。

original: Please, tell me more about yourself. What brings you to this... to Skyrim?
traduit: 请再多说些。你为什么来到……天际？

original: My apologies. We'll have to get better acquainted later. Please, enjoy yourself.
traduit: 容我致歉。我们以后会增进了解的。请尽情享受宴会。

original: Yes, Madame Ambassador.
traduit: 是，大使女士。

original: Of course. I've told you before not to bother me with such trifles.
traduit: 当然。我早说了不要拿这种琐事来烦我。

original: Do I have your permission to uncork the Arenthia red...
traduit: 我可以打开阿兰西亚红酒么？

original: It's just that we've run out of the Alto wine.
traduit: 只是我们的阿尔托酒已经喝完了。

original: What is it, Malborn?
traduit: 马伯恩，怎么了？

original: Madame Ambassador, I'm so sorry to interrupt...
traduit: 大使女士，很抱歉要打断您……

original: You're Elenwen? I've heard so much about you!
traduit: 你就是爱琳温？久仰大名。

original: Have you? All good, I trust. But you have me at a disadvantage. I'm afraid I know nothing about you...
traduit: 是吗？想必都是好话吧。现在倒成我处于下风了，毕竟我还对你一无所知……

original: Quite a party. It's my first time, you know. Where can I get a drink?
traduit: 很好的宴会。我是第一次来，该上哪里找点酒喝？

original: Don't worry, my parties are always well-stocked with the finest food and drink available in this country.
traduit: 别担心，我的宴会上总是备有这个国家最好的美酒佳肴。

original: But first, you were introducing yourself.
traduit: 但你还是得先做个自我介绍。

original: My name is <Alias=Player>. Pleased to meet you.
traduit: 我叫<Alias=Player>。很高兴见到你。

original: Ah yes. I remember your name from the guest list.
traduit: 哦，没错。我在宾客名单中见过你。

original: He looks so... sweet. Go ahead. Have the first bite.
traduit: 他看上去很……甜美。去吧。享用第一口。

original: Dir volaan!
traduit: 迪尔 沃兰！

original: Bolog aaz, mal lir!
traduit: 波洛格 阿兹，玛 利尔！

original: Faaz! Paak! Dinok!
traduit: 法兹！帕克！迪诺克！

original: Kren sosaal!
traduit: 克伦 索萨尔！

original: Qiilaan us dilon!
traduit: 奇兰 阿斯 蒂隆！

original: Sovngarde saraan!
traduit: 松加德 萨兰！

original: Daanik Kendov!
traduit: 达尼克 肯都瓦！

original: Unslaad Krosis!
traduit: 安斯拉德 科洛西斯！

original: Ha ha ha ha ha ha ha ha!
traduit: 哈哈哈哈哈哈！

original: Aav dilon!
traduit: 阿夫 蒂隆！

original: Any tips to get me in there?
traduit: 有什么能让我进去的建议吗？

original: Well, there's an old sewer tunnel that dumps into the lake on the northwest side of the island.
traduit: 嗯，那里有一条老旧的下水道，一直延伸到岛屿西北侧的湖泊里。

original: That's how I slipped in there. Should still be unguarded.
traduit: 我就是这么溜进去的。那里应该还是无人看守的状态。

original: Know anything about Goldenglow Estate?
traduit: 你知道金色光辉庄园的事吗？

original: Watch yourself out there. The mercenaries Aringoth hired are trained killers. Just ask our poor little Vex.
traduit: 小心点。阿林格斯的佣兵都是训练有素的杀手。问问咱们可怜的小小烦就知道了。

original: The honey they collect on that hunk of rock goes into making Black-Briar Mead; just about the best tasting mead in all of Skyrim.
traduit: 他们从那收集的蜂蜜是制作黑棘蜜酒的原料，那可是天际最美味的蜜酒。

original: I wouldn't bother smacking at those hives with a weapon. Set 'em on fire and they'll go up like kindling.
traduit: 我是不会用武器去敲打蜂箱的。把它们点着，就会像火柴一样烧起来。

original: I'd like to know why you're wasting time asking about it when you should already be on your way.
traduit: 你怎么还在这里浪费时间问东问西，还不赶紧上路。

original: The fort is yours.
traduit: 堡垒是你的了。

original: Thank you for your help.  Did you see my family inside?
traduit: 谢谢你的帮助。你在里面看到我的家人了吗？

original: Brurid?
traduit: 布瑞德？

original: He's a rogue mage who defected at the beginning of the war.  I turned him in but apparently he escaped and now this.
traduit: 他是个在战争开始时叛逃的流浪法师。我告发了他，但很显然他逃走了，现在又发生了这事。

original: Stop! That's priceless!
traduit: 停下！那个很值钱！

original: Please, I don't have anything to pay you with! Don't destroy my urn!
traduit: 求你了，我没钱给你！别毁了我的宝贝瓮！

original: If I had it, I'd pay! There's no need to do that!
traduit: 如果我有钱，我会付的！没必要这样！

original: No! You're going to break it!
traduit: 不！别把它弄坏了！

original: I can't pay, I can't!
traduit: 我真没钱，真的！

original: I can't believe you're doing this! Stop!
traduit: 真不敢相信你会这么做！快停下！

original: Ralof! What are you doing here? Ah... I'll be right down.
traduit: 拉罗夫！你怎么在这？啊……我马上过来。

original: Hod! Come here a minute. I need your help with something.
traduit: 胡德！过来一下。我需要你帮点忙。

original: You're right. Follow me.
traduit: 你说得对。跟我来。

original: Is there somewhere we can talk? There's no telling when the news from Helgen will reach the Imperials...
traduit: 我们能找个地方谈谈吗？海尔根的消息随时会传到帝国那边去。

original: Not a comrade yet, but a friend. I owe him my life, in fact.
traduit: 还不是战友，但也是我朋友。实际上他刚救了我一命。

original: Not a comrade yet, but a friend. I owe her my life, in fact.
traduit: 还不是战友，但也是我朋友。实际上她刚救了我一命。

original: And who's this? One of your comrades?
traduit: 这位是？你的战友吗？

original: Gerdur, I'm fine. At least now I am.
traduit: 歌尔朵。我很好。至少现在很好。

original: Gerdur...
traduit: 歌尔朵……

original: Are you hurt? What's happened?
traduit: 你受伤了？发生了什么？

original: Did you hear? The Hall of the Dead is closed. Brother Verulus isn't the most popular man in town right now.
traduit: 你听说了吗？亡者之厅关闭了。维鲁鲁斯修士现在被全城人讨厌了。

original: They say that something happened in the Hall of the Dead. Brother Verulus has the whole place closed.
traduit: 他们说亡者之厅发生了状况。维鲁鲁斯修士把大厅关了。

original: Thanks again for saving my life. I think I'm done with venturing outside of Markarth, though.
traduit: 再次感谢你救我一命。不过我不想再到马卡斯以外的地方冒险了。

original: It's an honor to see you, the keeper of Namira's ring.
traduit: 很荣幸见到你，娜米拉戒指的保管者。

original: Namira watch over you, champion.
traduit: 娜米拉注视着你，勇士。

original: You're one of Namira's faithful now.
traduit: 你现在是娜米拉忠实的信徒了。

original: But is it safe for you to be here? Won't the Imperials be looking for you?
traduit: 不过你来这里安全吗？帝国人不会找上你吧？

original: But is it safe for you to be here? We heard that Ulfric had been captured...
traduit: 不过你来这里安全吗？我们听说乌弗瑞克被抓了……

original: Brother! Mara's mercy, you're safe! Your friend told me about Helgen...
traduit: 兄弟！感谢玛拉保佑，你还活着！你朋友告诉我说海尔根……

original: Brother! Mara's mercy, it's good to see you!
traduit: 兄弟！感谢玛拉保佑，能见到你真是太好了！

original: Perhaps we can come to an arrangement.
traduit: 或许我们能达成个协议。

original: An arrangement? After you've destroyed so much?
traduit: 协议？在你毁了这么多之后？

original: Fine. Leave me the elf. You may go with your books.
traduit: 好吧，把那个精灵留下。然后拿着书走吧。

original: I'm afraid you don't have anything worth trading.
traduit: 恐怕你没有值得交易的东西。

original: Now, you can go back to your College and leave me be, or I can kill you. Your choice.
traduit: 现在，要么你回学院，远离我这儿，要么我就杀了你，自己选吧。

original: May I please have the books?
traduit: 可否将书还给我？

original: Oh, now we're all please and thank you, are we?
traduit: 哦，现在我们都很高兴，还得多谢你了，是吧？

original: I'm afraid we're well beyond pleasantries.
traduit: 恐怕这已经超越玩笑的界限了。

original: I'll allow you the opportunity to turn around, walk out that door, and never come back. I suggest you move quickly.
traduit: 我会让你有机会转身离去，永远别再回来。我建议你快点离开。

original: I'm here for the books from the College.
traduit: 我是过来拿学院的书的。

original: So you're just one of Aren's lackeys? That's disappointing. You show real promise.
traduit: 所以你就是阿冉的狗腿子了？可惜了。你很有前途啊。

original: You come here, kill my assistants, disrupt my work... You've annoyed me, so I don't think I'll be giving you anything.
traduit: 你到这里来，杀了我的助手，搅乱了我的工作……你已经激怒我了，所以我不打算给你任何东西。

original: Names no longer matter. You may refer to me as The Caller.
traduit: 名字不重要了。你可以称我为“召唤者”。

original: Now, do you have a reason for making such a mess?
traduit: 好了，你为什么要来此大搞破坏？

original: So, you're the one who barged into my home and laid waste to my projects.
traduit: 这么说，就是你闯进我家然后破坏了我的计划。

original: How nice to meet you.
traduit: 很高兴见到你。

original: Well? What's it going to be?
traduit: 好了，到底是什么事？

original: Gerdur!
traduit: 歌尔朵！

original: Looks like nobody here knows what's happened yet. Come on. Gerdur's probably working in her lumber mill.
traduit: 看起来这里的人还不知道发生了什么。来吧。歌尔朵可能在木材厂工作呢。

original: Now where are the books?
traduit: 书现在在哪儿？

original: Yes, of course. I said I'd tell you, didn't I?
traduit: 啊，当然。我会告诉你的。

original: The Caller will have them. She was most interested in one of the volumes.
traduit: 召唤者拿走了。她对其中一卷最感兴趣。

original: Although not interested enough to keep me from being locked up.
traduit: 但这兴趣没充足到免除我的关押。

original: The... the books? Oh, I see. I thought perhaps... Well, I thought you'd come for me.
traduit: 书吗？哦，我知道了。我想也许……哎，我还以为你是来找我的。

original: But yes, the books. The Caller will have them. She was most interested in one of the volumes.
traduit: 说回来，那些书。召唤者把它们拿走了。她对其中一卷最感兴趣。

original: I don't want your help.
traduit: 我不用你帮忙。

original: Ah. I see.
traduit: 啊，我知道了。

original: Well, then I'll just stay behind you a little bit, and follow along quietly.
traduit: 好吧，那我就安安静静地跟在你后面好了。

original: Windhelm has been hard on my people. But our fortunes will turn, and we have shelter and food.
traduit: 风舵城对我们一族太苛刻了。但我们会转运的，而且好歹还有住处和食物。

original: I'm saying you were right. The Night Mother was right. The old ways... they guided the Dark Brotherhood for centuries. I was a fool to oppose them.
traduit: 我说，你是对的。夜母是对的。传统的方式……引导了黑暗兄弟会多年。反对这些，我真是一个傻瓜。

original: And to prove my... sincerity, I have prayed for a contract. You lead this Family now. I give you the Blade of Woe, so that you can see it through.
traduit: 为了表示我的……诚意。我祈祷了这个契约。现在就由你来领导这个家。我把痛苦之刃交给你，你明白了吧……

original: You must kill...
traduit: 你必须杀了……

original: Me.
traduit: 我。

original: What are you saying?
traduit: 你说什么？

original: Don't you see? It was me. I set you up, wanted you dead. I betrayed you, the Night Mother... everything I hold dear. And now Maro has betrayed me.
traduit: 你不明白吗？是我，是我出卖了你，想要你死。我背叛了你，背叛了夜母……还有我珍视的一切。现在马洛背叛了我。

original: I just wanted things... to stay the way they were. Before Cicero, before the Night Mother. Before... you. I thought I could save us. I was wrong.
traduit: 我只是想让一切……都保持原来的样子。在西塞罗来之前，夜母来之前。在你来……之前。我以为自己能拯救大家。但我错了。

original: But you're alive! So there's still a chance. A chance to start over, rebuild. That's why I did... this.
traduit: 但你还活着！还有机会。一个重启、重建的机会。所以……我才做了这个。

original: Don't you see? I prayed to the Night Mother! I am the Black Sacrament.
traduit: 没看见吗？我向夜母祈祷了！我就是黑色圣礼的祭品。

original: No! Don't pity me. I deserve whatever fate the Dread Lord has in store. I betrayed you... and now Maro has betrayed me. Fitting...
traduit: 不！不要同情我。接受恐惧之主的命运是我罪有应得。我背叛了你……现在马洛背叛了我。报应不爽……

original: But you're alive! So there's still a chance. A chance to start over, rebuild. That's why I did... this.
traduit: 但你还活着！还有重启、再造的机会。所以我才……做了这个。

original: You will be judged by Sithis in the Void. I pity you.
traduit: 你会在虚空中受到西帝斯的审判。我很同情你。

original: Yes. I set you up. I wanted you dead. I betrayed you, the Night Mother, and everything I hold dear. And now Maro has betrayed me.
traduit: 对。是我陷害你。我想害死你。我背叛了你，背叛了夜母，还有我珍视的一切。现在马洛背叛了我。

original: You... sent me to die? Traitor!
traduit: 你……打算害死我？叛徒！

original: Ssshhh.... Please. There is much... I have to say. And... not much time...
traduit: 嘘……安静。我有很多话……要说。没……时间了……

original: I'm sorry. So very sorry. The Penitus Oculatus... Maro... He said that by giving you to them, he would leave the Dark Brotherhood alone. Forever.
traduit: 对不起。非常对不起。洞察眼……马洛……他说把你交出去，就放过黑暗兄弟会。永远。

original: By Sithis, I was such a fool. All of this... it's all my fault. You are the best of us, and I nearly killed you... as I've killed everyone else...
traduit: 西帝斯在上，我太傻了。这一切……都是我的错。你是我们中最优秀的，可我差点杀了你……我害死了所有人……

original: Astrid...
traduit: 阿斯垂德……

original: Alive.... You're alive... Thank Sithis...
traduit: 活着……你还活着……感谢西帝斯……

original: Kust is responsible for the cemetery here in Falkreath, I take care of the Shrine.
traduit: 卡斯特负责佛克瑞斯的墓地，我照看神殿。

original: The number of graves in this cemetery never decreases.
traduit: 这个墓地的坟墓永远不会减少。

original: War is not new to Falkreath. You have only to stand in our cemetery to see that.
traduit: 战争对佛克瑞斯来说并不陌生。看看这片墓地就知道了。

original: Dengeir deserves more respect than his nephew, Jarl Siddgeir, affords him.
traduit: 丹格尔应该比他那个领主侄子西德盖尔得到更多尊重。

original: Without birth there is no life, without death there is only stasis. Such is the truth of Arkay.
traduit: 没有出生就没有生命，没有死亡就陷入停滞。此乃阿尔凯之真理。

original: Strangers like you bring war. I've seen enough war.
traduit: 你这样的陌生人会带来战争。我已经看够战争了。

original: These graves hold the sons and daughters of Falkreath.
traduit: 这些坟墓里安葬着佛克瑞斯的儿女。

original: Show respect while you're here and you and I will be fine.
traduit: 在这里时请尊重点，我们就相安无事了。

original: You have the look of a killer.
traduit: 你长得像个杀手。

original: Arkay helps us find peace with death.
traduit: 阿尔凯帮助我们平静地面对死亡。

original: Indara and I like to keep to ourselves and run our farm.
traduit: 因达拉和我喜欢过自己的日子，经营自己的农场。

original: Runil has been a true friend to my wife and I in our time of need.
traduit: 鲁尼尔是我们夫妻在需要时伸出援手的真朋友。

original: My wife, Indara, has a gift with animals.  It makes her a better farmer than anyone I've ever seen.
traduit: 我妻子因达拉很有照顾动物的天赋。她是我见过的最好的农民。

original: This war isn't needed. Imperials like my wife can be hard to handle but we Nords could work with them. I should know.
traduit: 这场战争毫无必要。像我妻子这样的帝国人很难对付，但我们诺德人可以和他们合作。我是知道这一点的。

original: I don't know if the war is Arkay's will or man's, but it's none of my doings.
traduit: 我不知道这场战争是阿尔凯的意志还是人类的想法，但我什么都做不了。

original: My husband Mathias and I tend Corpselight Farm.
traduit: 我丈夫马西斯和我一起经营尸光农场。

original: Falkreath is a hard place and tending a farm here is thankless work.
traduit: 佛克瑞斯是个苦地方，在这里照看农场吃力不讨好啊。

original: Mathies is a kind and wise man. The Nords could use more like him. So could the Imperials.
traduit: 马西斯聪明善良。诺德人和帝国人都需要更多他这样的人。

original: How could people see all the graves in Falkreath and still want to make war?
traduit: 人们看过佛克瑞斯的坟墓之后怎么还会想要打仗？

original: Steel's good, but loyalty's better. I'm loyal to Dengeir first and the Empire second.
traduit: 钢铁诚可贵，忠诚价更高。我首先忠于丹格尔，其次才是帝国。

original: Only a hearty soul travels the road these days.
traduit: 如今，只有真心实意的旅者在路上前行了。

original: The war bleeds Skyrim. It bleeds her dry and I think none of us are the better for it.
traduit: 战争让天际流血。她的血被榨干，我们又能获得什么好处。

original: Men and women join the war, they travel far on these roads to spill each other's blood.
traduit: 男男女女加入了战争，他们在这些路上长途跋涉，互相厮杀。

original: Falkreath's warriors always return, one way or another.
traduit: 佛克瑞斯的战士无论生死，总会回来。

original: Someone new, perhaps someone looking for me to mix something up for them?
traduit: 新面孔啊？是想让我替你调配点什么吧？

original: Don't let the shop's name frighten you away. I have plenty of reliable tonics and healing potions to sell.
traduit: 别让商店的名字吓到了，我这里有很多可靠的补品和治疗药剂的。

original: If either these Nords or Imperials had some red in their blood this war would be over.
traduit: 如果这些诺德人和帝国人流的还是人血的话，就该结束这场战争。

original: A hearty welcome to Falkreath!  All of Skyrim's true sons are welcome here!
traduit: 欢迎来到佛克瑞斯！这里欢迎所有真正的天际之子！

original: Stay out of my way, boot.
traduit: 别挡路。

original: I can't believe we let provincials like you wander Skyrim.
traduit: 不敢相信我们会让你这种外地人在天际闲逛。

original: You'll find my brother Solaf and I are the only true Nords in Falkreath.
traduit: 你会发现我和索拉夫哥俩儿是佛克瑞斯唯二真正的诺德人了。

original: Well met. Unlike my brother, I've no dislike of strangers. Met lots of 'em while I was a Stormcloak.
traduit: 你好啊。我不像我兄弟，我不讨厌陌生人。我当风暴斗篷时见过很多这样的人。

original: Can I get you something?
traduit: 需要什么吗？

original: Don't mind Bolund. He's young and gets riled easily.
traduit: 别跟波伦德计较。他年轻气盛，一点就着。

original: What do you need, stranger?
traduit: 需要什么吗，陌生人？

original: Shor's bones! A handsome man in Falkreath.
traduit: 舒尔的骨头！佛克瑞斯难得有个帅哥。

original: You're going to have the men around here wrapped around your finger in no time.
traduit: 你很快就会让这里的男人围着你转了。

original: A strong drink will chase off that chill in the air.
traduit: 一杯烈酒足以驱散空气中的寒意。

original: I've half a mind to ask if you'll take me on one of your adventures, but I can't just leave Valga on her own.
traduit: 我很想加入你的冒险之旅，但我不能丢下瓦尔加一个人。

original: Not much exciting happens around here. You're as like as not to be bored to death if you stay too long.
traduit: 这里太平淡了。如果在这里待久了，会无聊死的。

original: Anything I can get you?
traduit: 有什么需要效劳的吗？

original: Can I get you a drink?
traduit: 要喝点什么吗？

original: Welcome to Dead Man's Drink.
traduit: 欢迎来到亡者之饮。

original: I escaped fighting in Cyrodiil only to have it track me down again in Skyrim.
traduit: 我逃离了希罗帝尔的战争，却又在天际被赶上了。

original: I wouldn't complain if we could string together a few sunny days now and then.
traduit: 如果我们能赶上几个大晴天就好了。

original: Try not to judge Falkreath too harshly, visitor - the war has been hard on us.
traduit: 别对佛克瑞斯太苛刻了，外来者，战争对我们来说太残酷了。

original: I'm sorry, I should really go now.
traduit: 抱歉，我真的得走了。

original: I can't really help you, I'm just Dengeir's maid.
traduit: 我帮不了你什么，我只是丹格尔的女佣。

original: I was Jarl once, but I was encouraged to step down when I took sides with the Stormcloaks. It was an imperial plot, I tell you!
traduit: 我曾经是领主，但因为支持风暴斗篷就被鼓动下台了。我告诉你，这是帝国的阴谋！

original: Be mindful. My maid Tekla has been known to pass information to that pompous nephew of mine, Siddgeir.
traduit: 要注意，我的女佣苔卡拉在给我那个自大狂侄子西德盖尔传信。

original: Enemies and ears. Both are everywhere.
traduit: 敌人和探子。到处都是。

original: If you're sympathetic to the Empire, you'll be wise to put Falkreath far behind you.
traduit: 如果你同情帝国，那你最好离佛克瑞斯远一点。

original: My nephew has always been handed things, even the title of Jarl.
traduit: 我侄子总从别人手里接过东西，甚至包括领主的头衔。

original: Stendarr protect Falkreath until Skyrim's Sons rise.
traduit: 斯丹达尔会保佑佛克瑞斯，直到天际之子崛起。

original: The war has changed Falkreath, even our neighbors can be our enemies.
traduit: 战争改变了佛克瑞斯，连我们的邻居都可能成为敌人。

original: I protect the Jarl, whoever that might be.
traduit: 无论领主是谁，我都会保护他。

original: Falkreath's cemetery reminds of us that war is not new here.
traduit: 佛克瑞斯的墓地提醒着我们，战争在此屡见不鲜。

original: Being Housecarl of Falkreath is an honor.
traduit: 能担任佛克瑞斯的侍卫是种荣誉。

original: Treat the Jarl with respect, and you'll be welcome here.
traduit: 尊重领主，你在这里就会受到欢迎。

original: I'm the Steward here.  I serve under Jarl Siddgeir and Jarl Dengeir before him.
traduit: 我是这里的总管。我为西德盖尔领主和此前的丹格尔领主服务。

original: Siddgeir can sometimes act too quickly but he does listen to Helvard and I.
traduit: 西德盖尔有时行事草率，但他确实听我和黑尔沃德的话。

original: For Falkreath and I this is just one more war in a long line.
traduit: 对佛克瑞斯和我来说，这只是漫长战线上的又一次战争。

original: Yes? What is it that you want?
traduit: 嗯？有什么需要吗？

original: Boland speaks much about the war and the Stormcloaks but he knows who provides.
traduit: 波伦德说了很多关于战争和风暴斗篷的事，但他明白谁说了算。

original: The Stormcloaks want freedom but don't understand its price.
traduit: 风暴斗篷想要自由，却不知道自由的代价。

original: There are opportunities everywhere.  Why don't you go find them.
traduit: 机会到处都是，你为什么不出去找找。

original: No time, I have business to conduct.
traduit: 没时间说话了，我还有事要办。

original: Unless you intend to bury someone, this isn't the place you're looking for, traveler.
traduit: 除非你想来埋人，这里不是你要找的地方，旅人。

original: Falkreath was once full of wanderers and warriors like yourself. Those were better days.
traduit: 佛克瑞斯曾经充满像你一样的漂泊者和战士。那真是个好时候。

original: Skyrim's history of war is well documented here in Falkreath's graveyard.
traduit: 天际的战争历史被很好地记录在佛克瑞斯的墓地。

original: My brother Dengeir can be... difficult. Take his words with a grain of salt.
traduit: 我兄长丹格尔有些……困难。他的话半信半疑就行。

original: Can't believe we let provincials like you wander around Skyrim.
traduit: 真不敢相信我们会让你这样的外地人在天际闲逛。

original: That Valga Vinicia is a gossip and a troublemaker.
traduit: 瓦尔加·维尼西亚是个爱说闲话的捣蛋鬼。

original: In Falkreath if I don't know it, it's not worth knowing.
traduit: 佛克瑞斯如果有什么事是我不知道的，那就是不值得知道的。

original: From maid to Steward, I can hardly believe it. I hope I'm up to the task.
traduit: 从女佣到总管，不敢相信。我希望能够胜任这工作。

original: Be mindful.  My maid Tekla has been known to pass information to Siddgeir.
traduit: 要注意。我女佣苔卡拉在向西德盖尔送情报。

original: Nenya's history of service is impeccable.  She truly is the Steward of Falkreath.
traduit: 南雅的服务一直无可挑剔。她真是佛克瑞斯的好总管。

original: Dengeir was a good Jarl in his day.  Even if his day has passed.
traduit: 丹格尔执政时是个好领主。即使他的时代已经过去了。

original: Stand aside.  I don't need to speak to you.
traduit: 站一边去。我不需要和你说话。

original: Unless you intend to bury someone this isn't the place you're looking for, traveler.
traduit: 除非你想来埋人，这里不是你要找的地方，旅人。

original: I think I'm okay.
traduit: 我还好。

original: Ancano is doing something with that thing... the Eye. We can't stop him!
traduit: 安卡诺正在对……那个眼做什么。我们阻止不了他。

original: I haven't seen Savos since the explosion. He must've been blown clear, and he may be injured.
traduit: 爆炸之后我就没见到萨沃斯。他肯定被炸飞了，有可能受了伤。

original: I need you to find the Arch-Mage, and I need you to do it quickly. Get moving!
traduit: 你去找大法师，要快。快行动起来！

original: Are you all right? Can you walk?
traduit: 你没事吧？能动吗？

original: I need you on your feet. We're in trouble here.
traduit: 快点站起来，我们有麻烦了。

original: Don't go near him!
traduit: 不要靠近他！

original: Ancano! Stop this at once! I command you!
traduit: 安卡诺！马上住手！我命令你！

original: I know where to find the Staff of Magnus.
traduit: 我知道玛格努斯之杖的位置了。

original: Excellent. I'd suggest that we go retrieve it immediately, but right now we have more pressing matters.
traduit: 太好了。我们得马上把它取回来，但现在有更紧急的事。

original: Ancano has somehow locked himself in the hall. He's up to something, and I intend to put a stop to it.
traduit: 安卡诺不知怎么把自己锁在大厅里了。他正在谋划什么，我要阻止他。

original: Help us get through this, will you? We're throwing everything we have at it.
traduit: 来帮我们一把成吗？我们已经尽全力了。

original: Now's not the time. We need to put a stop to whatever it is that's going on.
traduit: 现在不是时候。不管发生什么，我们都必须阻止。

original: What's going on?
traduit: 怎么回事？

original: Ancano. He's in there, doing... something. We don't know what. We're trying to get in now.
traduit: 是安卡诺。他在里面干……一些事情。我们不知道他在干什么，正在想办法进去。

original: I will have his head for this, I assure you.
traduit: 我会杀了他，我保证。

original: Help take this down, will you? We're throwing everything we can at it.
traduit: 来帮忙把门打开成吗？我们现在已经竭尽所能了。

original: I don't care what it is, I want it down now! I want to know what he's doing in there!
traduit: 我不管这是在干嘛，现在赶紧拿下！我要知道他在里面搞什么名堂！

original: Hear me!
traduit: 听我说！

original: I didn't mean to offend.
traduit: 我不是故意冒犯。

original: Were you certain in your purpose, you would have no need to apologize.
traduit: 如果目标明确，就不需道歉。

original: You have much to learn... But you have proven your will is strong and your heart is devoid of pity.
traduit: 你还有很多可学……但你已经证明了自己意志坚定，心无慈悲。

original: So, perhaps you are not entirely useless... We shall soon find out.
traduit: 所以，你也许不算一无是处……很快就能见分晓了。

original: I have slain <Alias=DeadFriend> to gain your favor.
traduit: 我杀<Alias=DeadFriend>是为了博取您的青睐。

original: My favor?
traduit: 我的青睐？

original: My good pleasure is not some trophy for mortal sport!
traduit: 我岂会因凡人的战利感到愉悦！

original: I should slay you for such insolence!
traduit: 如此无礼，真该杀了你！

original: Shhh! Be still. Beware her anger!
traduit: 嘘！肃静。不要触怒她。

original: She is here, among us.
traduit: 她就在我们身边。

original: (Gasps)
traduit: （喘气）

original: Our Lord! She has come!
traduit: 我们的主降临了！

original: I'll do nothing of the sort.
traduit: 我不会那种事的。

original: Then you are weak and inconsequential.
traduit: 那你可真是软弱渺小。

original: That remains to be seen. But if it is so, and if Boethiah appears, then we will welcome you as one of us.
traduit: 我们拭目以待。如果波耶西亚果真降临，我们会接纳你。

original: My heart is full of purpose, and my life is full of deeds.
traduit: 我心存信念，生活充实。

original: If you desire a glimpse of our Dark Mistress, then this is what you must do.
traduit: 如果想一睹我们的黑暗女士，你就必须这么做。

original: First, prove your tongue can wield a lie. Find someone. Gain his trust. Lead him to the shrine above.
traduit: 首先，证明你自己善于说谎。骗取一个人的信任，把他带到上面的祭坛去。

original: Next, instruct your thrall to touch the Pillar of Sacrifice. Its magic will ensnare him, rendering him helpless.
traduit: 然后指示你的奴隶触摸献祭之柱。上面的魔法会诱捕他，使他失去抵抗。

original: Then, girded with certitude, plant the ceremonial blade deeply, so that the waters of his heart wash over you.
traduit: 接着，毫不犹豫地把仪式之刃狠狠插进去，用他的心灵之水洗涤你。

original: If your will is strong enough, it will stir Boethiah in her Dark Mansion, and she will appear before us.
traduit: 如果你的意志足够坚定，波耶西亚就会在她的黑暗之宅中感受到，并降临到我们面前。

original: I'm not afraid of you.
traduit: 我可不怕你。

original: Good. Perhaps I've misjudged.
traduit: 好，看来是我看走眼了。

original: (Invisible Walk Away)
traduit: (Invisible Walk Away)

original: You are nothing.
traduit: 百无一用的东西。

original: Who is Boethiah?
traduit: 波耶西亚是谁？

original: The Lord of Plots, Deceiver of Nations, Devourer of Trinimac. The Queen of Shadows, Goddess of Destruction, He-Who-Destroys and She-Who-Erases...
traduit: 密谋之主，欺诈众国者，崔尼玛克的吞噬者。阴影女王，破坏女神，毁灭之父与抹杀之母……

original: Many are our lord's lofty names, but they befit only us mortals. Intone her mighty names from now until the end of time - it is for naught.
traduit: 我们的主拥有许多高贵的名字，但只适用于凡人。无限吟诵她强大的真名只是徒劳。

original: Names mean nothing to our Lord. She only cares for those who care for themselves, whose hearts are full of purpose, whose lives are full of deeds.
traduit: 名字对我主毫无意义。她只眷顾那些珍惜自我的人，那些心存目标并付诸行动的人。

original: Is this some kind of cult?
traduit: 这是什么教派么？

original: We are forged by Boethiah's example. We carve our will upon the world through our tongues and our blades.
traduit: 我们以波耶西亚为榜样。致力于用自己的言辞和武力将意志铭刻于世。

original: You? You are nothing. An empty vapor, dispersed by the slightest breeze.
traduit: 而你？一无是处。不过是被微风吹散的空洞水汽。

original: Well done. You have proven the strength of your will and your tongue's gift for lies. You have shown ferocity and prowess in combat.
traduit: 干得好。你已经充分证明了自己坚定的意志、高超的谎言，还有凶猛强悍的战法。

original: Now the time has come for a final proving. Are you able to cast aside your honor and strike with the hidden blade?
traduit: 现在，是最后一个考验了。你能否抛下自己的荣誉，暗剑伤人？

original: Ahhhhgh. Wearing flesh is so... distasteful.
traduit: 哈。穿上肉身实在……恶心。

original: You have caught my attention, mortal. That is most unwise.
traduit: 你引起了我的注意，凡人。太不智了。

original: We are Lord Boethiah's faithful. Have you come to test your mettle?
traduit: 我们是波耶西亚大人忠实的信徒。你是来考验勇气的？

original: If you wish to gain Boethiah's attention, you must slay a thrall upon her shrine.
traduit: 如果想引起波耶西亚的注意，就必须去她的祭坛上杀害一个奴隶。

original: A well placed word, or a well placed dagger. Both can achieve equal purposes.
traduit: 恰到好处的话语，或是运用得当的匕首，都能达到目的。

original: Do you wish to test yourself against me?
traduit: 你想挑战我？

original: Though we live in shadow, we carve indelible signs of our passing into the world.
traduit: 我们虽然生活在阴影中，但在世界上留下了不可磨灭的痕迹。

original: It's a deal. You can have Orthorn.
traduit: 交易达成，你带走奥拓恩吧。

original: Fine. Take your books and leave at once.
traduit: 很好。带上你的书然后赶紧离开。

original: If you ever come back, I won't be so gracious.
traduit: 胆敢再回来，休怪我不客气。

original: You wouldn't do that, would you? You wouldn't leave me here with her!
traduit: 你不会这么做的对吧？你不会把我留在这儿的！

original: He gets the books, I get you. It's very simple.
traduit: 他拿到书，我拿到你。就这么简单。

original: She gets the books, I get you. It's very simple.
traduit: 她拿到书，我拿到你。就这么简单。

original: I, uhh... wait, what?
traduit: 我，唔……等等，什么？

original: Sounds like she just likes us to suffer.
traduit: 听上去就像她想让我们吃苦一样。

original: Nocturnal's whim is the greatest mystery to everyone. There have been volumes written on the subject.
traduit: 诺克图娜尔的奇思妙想对每个人来说都是最大的谜题。关于这个问题的著述很多。

original: Does she exact payment when we die? When we suffer does she revel in our misery? No one knows.
traduit: 我们死后她会索取报偿吗？我们受苦时她会感到陶醉吗？没人知道。

original: The return certainly seems worth the risk though.
traduit: 不过，回报还是值得冒险。

original: I have my skill, not powers or magic.
traduit: 我依仗的是自己的技术，不是力量或者魔法。

original: Again, you have to think differently. Haven't you ever noticed how our luck behaves?
traduit: 我再说一遍，你得从不同角度思考问题。你没注意到我们的运气吗？

original: Like a novice picking an impossible lock or a blind man suddenly turning to face you as you reach for his pocket?
traduit: 比如新手遇到了超难搞的锁头，或者掏瞎子包时对方突然转过身来？

original: It's through these subtle means that Nocturnal influences us.
traduit: 诺克图娜尔就是通过这种微妙的手段来影响我们。

original: Sounds like a Guild contract.
traduit: 听起来和公会的契约一样。

original: You're closer to understanding than you realize.
traduit: 你比自己意识到的还要接近理解了。

original: The only difference is she doesn't demand payment in the traditional sense and sometimes the cost can be quite high.
traduit: 唯一的区别就是，她不要求传统意义上的报酬，有时代价非常高昂。

original: Whether you know it or not, Nocturnal dictates how well we perform as rogues.
traduit: 不管你知道与否，诺克图娜尔都决定了我们作为盗贼的表现。

original: I never met a thief that worshipped anything.
traduit: 我从没见过有信仰的小偷。

original: Nocturnal isn't one for worship and reverence. There are no priests and no sermons, no services and no alms.
traduit: 诺克图娜尔不是用来礼敬或崇拜的。没有祭司、没有传教、没有礼拜，也没有施舍。

original: She influences our luck and in return demands payment.
traduit: 她影响我们的运气，反过来要求我们支付报酬。

original: Who is Nocturnal?
traduit: 诺克图娜尔是谁？

original: She's the mistress of night and darkness and the patron of every thief in Tamriel.
traduit: 她是夜晚与黑暗之主，也是全泰姆瑞尔小偷的守护神。

original: Tell me about the Nightingales.
traduit: 跟我讲讲夜莺。

original: Gallus, Mercer Frey and I were once members of what's known as the Nightingale Trinity.
traduit: 加卢斯、墨瑟·弗雷还有我都曾经是夜莺三人组的成员。

original: The Trinity disbanded twenty-five years ago when Mercer Frey betrayed us by slaying Gallus and dumping his body in the ruins of Snow Veil Sanctum.
traduit: 二十五年前，墨瑟·弗雷背叛我们，杀死了加卢斯，并把他的尸体扔在了雪幔圣所遗迹里。三人组就这么散了。

original: You were lovers?
traduit: 你们曾经是恋人？

original: Gallus once said he felt comfortable around me; able to let his guard down. I can't help but think that I'm responsible for what happened to him.
traduit: 加卢斯曾说他和我在一起时感觉很舒服，能够放松警惕。我总觉得他的死是我的错。

original: Tell me about Gallus.
traduit: 跟我说说加卢斯。

original: He was a scholar, a master thief and a natural leader. Everyone respected him and followed him without question.
traduit: 他是个学者，也是个大盗贼，天生的领袖。大家都很敬重他，毫不犹豫地追随他。

original: It was Gallus who inducted me into the Nightingales and honed my skills to a razor sharp point. I owe everything to him.
traduit: 是加卢斯把我介绍进了夜莺，磨砺我的技巧。我的一切都拜他所赐。

original: We were... very close.
traduit: 我们曾经……亲密无间。

original: Might not have a choice next time.
traduit: 下次可能就没得选了。

original: I can promise you if it comes to that, and my back's to the wall, I won't hesitate.
traduit: 我可以向你保证，如果真的到了那一步，我退无可退时，我是不会犹豫的。

original: Why didn't you kill Mercer?
traduit: 你为什么不杀了墨瑟？

original: Mercer lied to the Guild, branded me a murderer and slandered my name across his network of contacts.
traduit: 墨瑟欺骗了公会，给我贴上了杀人犯的标签，还动用关系网对我进行诽谤。

original: For twenty-five years I ran, never sleeping in the same place twice and carefully covering my tracks.
traduit: 我逃了二十五年，不敢在同一个地方睡两次觉，小心翼翼地掩盖自己的踪迹。

original: Mercer doesn't need to die... he needs to feel the cold sting of fate as his life crumbles in front of him and he's hunted by the Guild.
traduit: 墨瑟不用死……他需要感受命运冰冷的刺痛，让他被公会追杀，生命在自己面前崩溃。

original: This seems like a really bad idea to me.
traduit: 我觉得这主意不太妙。

original: Hold on. Not yet.
traduit: 等等。还没好。

original: Hey, when you make up your mind, just let me know. I'll be here.
traduit: 等你决定好告诉我一声。我会在这里等。

original: Yes, I'm sure.
traduit: 没错。我确定。

original: Your funeral. Someone else is gonna have to help you get him back in there again.
traduit: 你这是自找麻烦哦。下次你找别人把他弄回去吧。

original: Open the trap.
traduit: 打开陷阱吧。

original: You sure about that? You want to let that dragon loose after all the trouble to catch him in there?
traduit: 你确定？你费了半天劲把龙抓来又要放走？

original: Hold on. I'm not quite ready.
traduit: 等等。我还没准备好。

original: Kreh zini! The freedom of the sky beckons! Yet I stay here, nau gol, as promised.
traduit: 科瑞 兹尼！天空的自由在召唤！但我会留在这里，纳乌 戈尔，我答应过你。

original: I'm ready. Take me to Skuldafn.
traduit: 我准备好了。带我去斯库达芬。

original: Zok brit uth! I warn you, once you've flown the skies of Keizaal, your envy of the dov will only increase.
traduit: 佐克 布瑞特 乌斯！我警告你哦，一旦你飞上凯扎尔的天空，那你会更嫉妒都瓦的。

original: You didn't escape.
traduit: 你没逃跑。

original: Saraan uth - I await your command, as promised. Are you ready to see the world as only a dovah can?
traduit: 萨兰 乌斯——如承诺所说，我在等待你的命令。准备好用都瓦的视角俯瞰世界了吗？

original: Are you ready to see the world as only a dovah can?
traduit: 准备好用都瓦的视角俯瞰世界了吗？

original: Onikaan koraav gein miraad. It is wise to recognize when you only have one choice.
traduit: 欧尼堪 寇拉夫 盖恩 米拉德。别无选择之时，承认也是智慧。

original: And you can trust me. Zu'u ni tahrodiis. Alduin has proven himself unworthy to rule. I go my own way now.
traduit: 你可以相信我。祖'乌 尼 塔洛迪斯。奥杜因已经证明自己无统治之资。我现在要和他分道扬镳了。

original: Free me, and I will carry you to Skuldafn.
traduit: 放了我，我带你去斯库达芬。

original: Amativ! Mu bo kotin stinselok.
traduit: 阿玛提乌！姆 伯 克汀 斯汀瑟洛克。

original: This is far as I can take you. Krif voth ahkrin. I will look for your return, or Alduin's.
traduit: 我只能送你到这里了。克瑞夫 沃斯 阿克因。我会见证你或奥杜因的归来。

original: Hin laas los dii.
traduit: 亨 拉斯 洛斯 蒂依。

original: Fent ni filok.
traduit: 芬特 尼 菲洛克。

original: Sosaal fah hin vothaarn.
traduit: 索萨尔 法 亨 沃塔恩。

original: Zu'u uth nall thurri dein daar miiraak.
traduit: 祖'乌 乌斯 纳尔 图瑞 戴恩 达尔 米拉克。

original: Alduin mah nol thur.
traduit: 奥杜因 玛 诺尔 苏利。

original: Alduin sizaan midroti.
traduit: 奥杜因 司赞 米多提。

original: Dovahkiin zol mul. Zu'u gahvon miri Alduin.
traduit: 都瓦克因 佐尔 穆尔。祖'乌 嘎翁 米尔 奥杜因。

original: I guess I'll have to trust you.
traduit: 看来我得相信你。

original: You did try to trick me into letting you go.
traduit: 你不会是想骗我放了你吧。

original: Hin aar, orin nu. And yet here I am, still your prisoner.
traduit: 亨 阿尔，奥瑞 努。我还在这儿，依旧是你的囚犯。

original: I'm still wondering if I can trust you.
traduit: 我还在考虑该不该信你。

original: Zu'u ni tahrodiis. It was you that lured me here and took me prisoner... vobalaan grahmindol. I have done nothing to earn your distrust.
traduit: 祖'乌 尼 塔洛迪斯。是你把我引到这儿囚禁起来的……沃巴兰 格拉明都。我没做过什么让你怀疑的事啊。

original: Yes. I'll set you free if you promise to take me to Skuldafn.
traduit: 对，如果你答应带我去斯库达芬，我就放了你。

original: You have reconsidered my offer, hmm? Onikaan kron?
traduit: 你重新考虑我的提议了？欧尼堪 科隆？

original: Do you expect me to take your word for that?
traduit: 你觉得我会信吗？

original: Ahraan. You wound me, Dovahkiin. I may not tell the whole truth, but I am no liar.
traduit: 阿兰。你已经伤到我了，都瓦克因。就算我不全招，也不会撒谎的。

original: Go and see for yourself. Zu'u ni bo nol het. I will be here... unless Alduin returns before you do.
traduit: 你自己去看吧。祖'乌 尼 伯 诺尔 赫特。我会在这儿等着……除非奥杜因先你一步回来。

original: We seem to be at an impasse, then.
traduit: 看来我们陷入僵局了。

original: Indeed. Orin brit ro. I cannot leave here until you defeat Alduin, which you cannot do without my help.
traduit: 没错。奥瑞 布瑞特 若。在你打败奥杜因之前我不能离开，但没我帮忙你也做不到。

original: Tell me what you know, then.
traduit: 跟我说你知道什么。

original: Only this. You have the Thu'um of a dovah, but without the wings of one, you will never set foot in Skuldafn.
traduit: 你拥有都瓦的吐'目，却没有都瓦的翅膀。你永远进不了斯库达芬。仅此而已。

original: Of course... I could fly you there. But not while imprisoned like this.
traduit: 当然……我可以带你飞过去。可这么关着我做不到啊。

original: Not until Alduin is defeated.
traduit: 除非奥杜因被击败。

original: Ah. Well. Hmm... krosis. There is one... detail about Skuldafn I neglected to mention.
traduit: 啊。好吧。嗯……科洛西斯。有一个关于斯库达芬的细节我没提。

original: You have done well, my Champion. You have earned my respect, a feat few manage and live to tell about it.
traduit: 做得好，勇士。你赢得了我的尊重，很少有人能活着讲述这项壮举。

original: Now go. I have strings to pull that require my full attention. You may pursue your own course wherever it leads you.
traduit: 去吧。我还有需要专心处理的事。去追寻自己的道路吧。

original: Remember always this: You need answer to no authority, neither mortal, nor divine... As you will it, so it shall be.
traduit: 记住：无需服从凡人和圣灵的权威……心有所愿，即能实现。

original: You may keep my Ebony Mail, a token of my appreciation to my new champion. Its gifts will resonate with your talents.
traduit: 留下我的黑檀链甲，作为我对新勇士的酬谢。它之效力与你之才能相得益彰。

original: Remember always this: As you will it, so it shall be.
traduit: 记住：心有所愿，即能实现。

original: You have earned the right to call yourself my Champion.
traduit: 你有成为我之勇士的资格。

original: And now you must perform the task for which I created you. You have already proven to possess the needed skills.
traduit: 现在，执行我创造你的任务。你有足够的技能。

original: Go to Solitude. Stalk the Jarl and slay her.
traduit: 到独孤城，追踪并杀掉领主。

original: I have spread rumors of an assassin. It will make your job harder, but will allow me to place blame where I desire it.
traduit: 我已经散布了谋杀谣言。这样工作的难度提高，我可以随心责备你了。

original: You will need stealth and lies to get past her guards. You will assassinate her swiftly and quietly. And if combat finds you, survive the escape.
traduit: 你需要隐秘行动、运用谎言才能骗过她的护卫。迅速低调的暗杀也可，正面一战溜之大吉也可。

original: Succeed, and you may keep your title and my armor, and I shall write your name upon the Tablet of Absolute Blackness.
traduit: 成功了，就能保住头衔和盔甲，我会把你的名字写在“绝暗石板”上。

original: Failure is not an option.
traduit: 只需成功，不许失败。

original: Who is he?
traduit: 他是谁？

original: I am loath to utter his name... one cannot erase a thing if it has a name to be remembered.
traduit: 我不愿提及他的名字……一旦有人记住他的名字，就表示他的存在无法被彻底抹杀。

original: I'll do whatever you ask.
traduit: 你说什么我都答应。

original: I have little need for mindless thralls.
traduit: 我不需要无脑的奴隶。

original: My servants serve their own purposes. But, if their will is insufficient, nor suitably aligned with mine, I simply destroy them.
traduit: 我的仆人各有目标。但是，如果意志不够充分，或者忤逆我愿，我会干脆地摧毁他们。

original: Which brings me to my present concern.
traduit: 我现在就在为此忧心。

original: (Invisible Continue / Walk Away)
traduit: (Invisible Continue / Walk Away)

original: Listen. All of you!
traduit: 所有人！听着。

original: This one's locked. Let's see about that gate.
traduit: 这里上锁了。我们去那边的门看看。

original: Looks like we're the only ones who made it.
traduit: 看来只有我们成功了。

original: That's it! Come on, let's get out of here before the dragon brings the whole tower down on our heads.
traduit: 就这样！快，我们得在那头龙把整个塔推倒前离开。

original: Here we are, found a key. Let's see if it opens that door.
traduit: 找到钥匙了。看看能不能把门打开。

original: Maybe one of these Imperials had the key.
traduit: 也许那些帝国兵手里有钥匙。

original: Damn. No way to open this from our side.
traduit: 该死。我们这边打不开。

original: I'm going to see if I can find some way out of here.
traduit: 我试试能不能从这里逃出去。

original: There you go. You may as well take Gunjar's gear. He won't be needing it any more.
traduit: 这样吧。你把甘佳尔的装备带上。他已经用不上了。

original: We better get moving. Come here. Let me see if I can get those bindings off.
traduit: 我们得走了。这边来。我试试能不能把这些绳索弄开。

original: We'll meet again in Sovngarde, brother.
traduit: 兄弟，我们松加德再会吧。

original: How can you compete with Black-Briar Meadery?
traduit: 你是如何和黑棘蜜酒庄竞争的？

original: Maven Black-Briar's gone out of her way to try and have me shut down, but fortunately I have a good relationship with Whiterun's Jarl.
traduit: 玛雯·黑棘绞尽脑汁想把我打败，但万幸我和白漫领主关系很好。

original: Every year, I sell more Honningbrew and Maven loses customers. Know why? My mead tastes better.
traduit: 我们蜜之酿的销量逐年增长，而玛雯的客户却在流失。知道为什么吗？因为我的蜜酒味道更佳。

original: So get rid of him and he's no longer a threat.
traduit: 所以除掉他，威胁也就消失了。

original: Exactly. With Sabjorn in prison, his meadery will be forced to close.
traduit: 说对了。只要撒布乔恩入狱，他的酒庄自然被迫倒闭。

original: Then I swoop in and take over the place. No more competition.
traduit: 然后我就能趁虚而入接管那里。减少竞争。

original: Sabjorn seems like more than just friendly competition.
traduit: 撒布乔恩似乎不想只是公平竞争。

original: Not a day goes by that I don't regret letting Sabjorn get as far as he did.
traduit: 我无时无刻不在后悔放任了撒布乔恩。

original: In only a few short years, he's taken that bile he calls mead to market and a chunk of my profits with it!
traduit: 短短几年，他就把他那个称之为蜜酒的破胆汁推向市场，并割走了我一大块利润！

original: I can't imagine where he found the gold to take it to market so quickly.
traduit: 我想不出他从哪获取的资金，还这么快把资金运作到市场上。

original: Sorry you're disappointed.
traduit: 对不起让你失望了。

original: This is exactly what I'm talking about.
traduit: 这就是我想说的。

original: Once again Brynjolf sends me someone with no backbone, no determination.
traduit: 布林乔夫又给我派来个没骨气的窝囊废。

original: I'm the best at what I do.
traduit: 我在这行可是首屈一指。

original: Is that confidence I hear... or is it arrogance? Strange how often they're confused.
traduit: 我听到的这是信心……还是狂妄？奇怪的是这二者时常被混淆。

original: You have to understand, it's been a long time since Brynjolf's sent me anyone I can rely on.
traduit: 你要知道，布林乔夫已经很久没派什么靠谱的人来了。

original: A new hand touches the beacon.
traduit: 又有一只手触摸到了信标。

original: You have found my beacon.
traduit: 你已经找到了我的信标。

original: But it is not time for rejoicing. The defiler continues to profane my temple.
traduit: 但还不是高兴的时候。亵渎者还在玷污我的神殿。

original: Return to my figure on Mount Kilkreath, and I shall make you the instrument of my cleansing light.
traduit: 到基尔克瑞斯山找到我的神像，我会让你成为我洁净之光的工具。

original: Do you prefer heedlessness to my luminous glory? Go!
traduit: 你敢对我的辉煌荣耀如此漫不经心？快去！

original: Take my beacon to the mount above Kilkreath.
traduit: 带着我的信标去基尔克瑞斯山。

original: Can you not hear me? Are your ears full of hate?
traduit: 你听不见我说的话吗？难道你耳朵被仇恨堵住了？

original: The defiler waxes!
traduit: 亵渎者正在变强！

original: Go now, with haste. Take my beacon to Mount Kilkreath.
traduit: 现在快走吧。带着我的信标去基尔克瑞斯山。

original: Fool! He is perverting my Light.
traduit: 笨蛋！他在扭曲我的光芒。

original: A Light that could illuminate Skyrim and her people.
traduit: 能够照亮天际与她的人民的光芒。

original: Malkoran has forced the doors shut. But this is my temple, and it responds to my decree.
traduit: 莫克然强行把门堵上。但这是我的神殿，它会回应我的命令。

original: I will send down a ray of light. Guide this light through my temple and its doors will open.
traduit: 我会射出一道光，引导它穿过我的神殿，门就会打开。

original: (Invisible Continue / Invisible Walk Away)
traduit: (Invisible Continue / Invisible Walk Away)

original: Go now, the artifact must be reclaimed and Malkoran destroyed.
traduit: 去吧，神器必须被回收，莫克然也必须被毁灭。

original: Of course you will. I have commanded it!
traduit: 当然要交给你。这是我的命令！

original: It doesn't really sound like I have a choice in the matter.
traduit: 听起来我别无选择。

original: But a single candle can banish the darkness of the entire Void. If not you, then someone else.
traduit: 一道烛光就能驱散整个虚空的黑暗。如果不是你，那还会有别人。

original: My beacon is sure to attract a worthy soul.
traduit: 我的信标一定会吸引有价值的灵魂。

original: But if you are wise, you will heed my bidding.
traduit: 如果你够聪明，就乖乖听我的。

original: The Necromancer Malkoran defiles my shrine with vile corruptions, trapping lost souls left in the wake of this war to do his bidding.
traduit: 死灵法师莫克然用邪恶的堕落行径玷污我的祭坛，诱捕战争中迷失的亡魂充为奴仆。

original: Worse still, he uses the power stored within my own token to fuel his foul deeds.
traduit: 更糟的是，他用我储存在神器中的力量给自己的邪恶行为提供能量。

original: I have brought you here, mortal, to be my champion. You will enter my temple, retrieve my artifact, and destroy the defiler.
traduit: 凡人，我把你带到这里，任命为我的勇士。你需要进入我的神殿，取回神器，并消灭亵渎者。

original: Guide my light through the temple to open the inner sanctum and destroy the defiler.
traduit: 引导我的光穿过神殿，打开内部圣所，将亵渎者彻底消灭。

original: I'll keep the sword. But find someone else to spread your religion.
traduit: 我会保管这把剑。但还是找别人去传播你的教义吧。

original: It matters not. The plant cares nothing for the rays that bring it the warmth of the sun. As you carry Dawnbreaker, so will my light touch the world.
traduit: 这不重要。草木不会关心是哪道光给它带来太阳的温暖。只要你带着破晓者，我的光芒就会照耀这个世界。

original: I'll wield this mighty blade in your name.
traduit: 我会以您的名义挥舞这把宝剑。

original: May the light of certitude guide your efforts.
traduit: 愿肯定之光指引你努力的方向。

original: Malkoran is vanquished. Skyrim's dead shall remain at rest. This is as it should be. This is because of you.
traduit: 莫克然被征服了。天际的死者得到了安息。这一切回归本貌。这是你的功劳。

original: A new day is dawning. And you shall be its herald.
traduit: 新的一天已经开始。而你将是黎明的预兆。

original: Take the mighty Dawnbreaker and with it purge corruption from the dark corners of the world. Wield it in my name, that my influence may grow.
traduit: 带上这把强大的破晓者，用它扫清世界黑暗角落中的腐败堕落。以我的名义挥舞它，而我的影响也将壮大。

original: It is time for my splendor to return to Skyrim.
traduit: 是时候让我之光彩重现天际了。

original: But the token of my truth lies buried in the ruins of my once great temple, now tainted by a profane darkness skittering within.
traduit: 但我真正的象征还被埋在曾经的神殿废墟中，被亵渎的黑暗所玷污。

original: What is it? I said I didn't wish to... be disturbed.
traduit: 怎么回事？我说过我不想被……打扰。

original: Don't worry, I'll stay right with you.
traduit: 别担心，我会陪着你的。

original: I think perhaps it might be best if you lead the way. My eyes aren't what they used to be.
traduit: 我觉得你最好在前面。我的眼睛有点不够用了。

original: This is all very strange. I've never seen anything like this.
traduit: 这一切太古怪。我从没见过这样的事。

original: Invisible Walk Away
traduit: Invisible Walk Away

original: The World-Eater waits within the mist! Bring word to Shor's hall of our hard fate!
traduit: 世界吞噬者正在迷雾中出没！快把我们的险境报告舒尔大厅！

original: Don't worry, I'm here to kill Alduin.
traduit: 别担心，我来此正为杀死奥杜因。

original: Follow me. I'll lead you through this mist.
traduit: 跟我来。我带你穿过迷雾。

original: I'll try to hold to your hopeful purpose. Quickly, before this encompassing fog once more snares me in the World-Eater's net.
traduit: 我不会辜负你给的希望。快走，趁着迷雾没把我卷进世界吞噬者之网里。

original: Yes, it's at the far end of the valley from here.
traduit: 对，在峡谷的尽头。

original: I saw it fair when first I trod this long-sought path. The pain and fear vanished, dreamlike, and a vision beckoned -
traduit: 我首次踏上这追寻已久的道路，目睹了它的美丽。感觉痛苦和恐惧都消失了，就像做梦一样，一个幻象在召唤着——

original: Shor's hall, shimmering across the clouded vale. But quenched was hope by the shrouding mist - my mind is darkened.
traduit: 舒尔大厅，在云烟缭绕的山谷里闪闪发光。但是希望被笼罩的迷雾浇灭了——我的心也随之黯淡。

original: I've lost the way and wander blindly.
traduit: 我迷失了方向，茫然地徘徊。

original: Hurry! Before Alduin your life devours bring word to Shor's hall of our hard fate!
traduit: 快走吧！在奥杜因吞噬你生命之前，把我们的险境带到舒尔大厅！

original: What's this mist?
traduit: 这是什么雾？

original: I do not know - but none have passed through.
traduit: 不知道，但没人能穿过去。

original: Alduin, his hunger insatiable, hunts the lost souls snared within this shadowed valley.
traduit: 奥杜因是饿极了，在这片阴暗的山谷里猎食迷失的灵魂。

original: Can you lead the way to where Shor's hall waits, beckoning us on to welcome long sought?
traduit: 你能带我们去等候已久的舒尔大厅吗？它已经召唤我们多时了。

original: Near Giants' Gap, in the gloom before dawn, we marched, unsuspecting into the Imperials' trap.
traduit: 我们在拂晓时分在巨人峡谷附近行军，毫无防备地中了帝国的圈套。

original: Then we stood and fought, our shield-wall defending until by dawn's light the Legion's ranks wavered.
traduit: 我们起来战斗，盾墙一直坚守到黎明，军团的队列都开始动摇了。

original: But I never knew if nights-end brought victory - a swift-flying arrow to Sovngarde carried me.
traduit: 但我不知道黑夜是否伴随胜利的到来结束了，一只流矢把我带到了松加德。

original: Turn back, traveler! Terror waits within this mist.
traduit: 回去吧，旅人！迷雾中有恐怖等待。

original: Many have braved the shadowed vale but vain is all courage against the peril that guards the way.
traduit: 有许多人勇敢地面对黑暗的山谷，但面对道路上的危险，一切勇气都是徒劳。

original: In life I felled foes unnumbered, fearless in battle; but no blade can defend against the terror of this gloom-stricken valley.
traduit: 我生时杀敌无数，从未怯战，但我知道没有任何利刃能破开这幽谷中的恐怖。

original: When Ulfric Stormcloak, with savage Shout, sent me here, my sole regret was fair Elisif, left forlorn and weeping.
traduit: 当乌弗瑞克·风暴斗篷用凶暴的龙吼把我送来时，我唯一的遗憾就是美丽的艾利西弗。她被遗弃在那儿哭泣。

original: I faced him fearlessly - my fate inescapable, yet my honor is unstained - can Ulfric say the same?
traduit: 我无所畏惧地面对他，虽然难逃厄运，但不损我之荣誉。乌弗瑞克敢这么说吗？

original: When I woke from cold death, my doom was lifted - there was Shor's Hall, my heart's desire.
traduit: 当我从冰冷的死亡中醒来，我解脱了厄运，那里有我心中所向的舒尔大厅。

original: But now I wander, weary and lost. Alduin hunts me as we once hunted our prey - a bitter payment for many bloody deeds.
traduit: 但我现在彷徨、疲惫，迷失了方向。奥杜因在追捕我，就像我们追捕猎物一样……这或许就是血腥行径的惨痛代价吧。

original: The bitter war of the world beyond was all for naught.
traduit: 外面世界的残酷战争都是徒劳的。

original: We are all trapped in Alduin's web - for our allegiance he cares not, but devours us equally - doom unescapable.
traduit: 我们都因自己的忠诚被奥杜因困在网中。他对我们效忠于谁毫不在意，只会无差别地将我们吞噬……我们难逃厄运了。

original: Shor as well - he welcomes all heroes to his kingly hall, if we could but reach it.
traduit: 舒尔也不在意，他会欢迎所有抵达的英雄来到他的王者之殿。

original: Skyrim was betrayed, the blood of her sons spilled in doomed struggle against fate.
traduit: 天际被背叛了，她的孩子在与命运的斗争中流血牺牲。

original: And so in death, too late, I learn the truth - fed by war, so waxed the power of Alduin, World-Eater - wisdom now useless.
traduit: 即使是在死后，太晚了，我现在才了解到了真相……战争滋养了世界吞噬者奥杜因的力量。现在无计可施了。

original: By gods' jest in this grim mist together snared, Stormcloak and Imperial, we wander hopeless, waiting for succor.
traduit: 我们被困在诸神玩笑般的迷雾当中。无论帝国军还是风暴斗篷。我们都在绝望地徘徊，等待救援。

original: Dragonborn, even in death you dog my steps?
traduit: 龙裔，即使死了你也要追着我？

original: How come you here? The king of this realm will cast you out - cursed be your name by all sons of Skyrim, with scorn unceasing.
traduit: 你来此作甚？领域之王会驱逐你，所有天际之子会诅咒你的名字，不断嘲笑你。

original: Do you know the way? I'm weary and lost.
traduit: 你认识路吗？我又累又迷茫。

original: Turn back! Before he finds you!
traduit: 回去吧！别让他找上你！

original: I'll see what I can do.
traduit: 我看看能做些什么。

original: Thank you. I can't stand the thought of being trapped in this village for the rest of my days.
traduit: 谢谢。一想到我余生都要困在这个村子里，我就受不了了。

original: You look like you've seen your share of adventure. I envy you that. In fact, maybe you can help me with something. Will you hear me out?
traduit: 你看起来像是冒过险的人。真羡慕你。其实，也许你能帮我个忙。你愿意听我说说嘛？

original: I want to be an adventurer like you, but my father says I can't.
traduit: 我想成为像你一样的冒险家，但我父亲说我做不到。

original: He says that he needs me to stay here and work the farm, and even if he did let me be an adventurer, we couldn't afford to buy armor.
traduit: 他说需要我留在这儿，在农场干活，就算他想让我当冒险家，我们也买不起盔甲。

original: His name's Mralki, and he's the innkeeper here. I hope you can change his mind.
traduit: 他叫穆拉基，是这里的旅店老板。我希望你能帮我劝劝他。

original: I'll take your challenge, but if I win I get to start a new life as an adventurer, and with no objections from you.
traduit: 我接受挑战，但如果我赢了，我就开始新的冒险生活，而且你不许反对。

original: Strong, yes, but how clever are you? I'll tell you what, if you can open the lock on my chest, you can have everything in it.
traduit: 你是够强壮了，但聪明呢？这样吧，如果你能打开箱子上的锁，就拿走里面的所有东西吧。

original: I'll make the preparations immediately!
traduit: 我马上准备！

original: But... I... very well.
traduit: 但……我……好吧。

original: We can do this one of two ways. You can walk with me up to the keep, or I can drag your lifeless body. Your choice.
traduit: 现在给你两条路。要么，跟我们走回城堡，要么，我把你尸体拖过去。自己选吧。

original: This is insane! I didn't steal anything! I never saw this ring before in my entire life!
traduit: 这不可能！我什么都没偷！我从没见过这个戒指！

original: That's right. It isn't yours. You're under arrest, Brand-Shei.
traduit: 这就对了。这不是你的。你被捕了，布兰德-谢。

original: I'm telling you, I don't... wait, what's this ring? This isn't mine!
traduit: 我告诉你了，我没……等等，这戒指是怎么回事？这不是我的啊！

original: Don't play stupid. I said turn out your pockets... now!
traduit: 别装傻了。我说，现在把你的口袋翻过来！

original: Have what? What in blazes are you talking about?
traduit: 什么东西？你在说什么？

original: All right, Brand-Shei. Turn out your pockets, we know you have it.
traduit: 好了，布兰德-谢，把你的口袋翻出来，我们知道在你这。

original: Wait a second. Looks like there's something in this cage.
traduit: 等下。笼子里好像有东西。

original: Was Jarl Ulfric with you?
traduit: 乌弗瑞克领主和你一起吗？

original: Shor's bones. We were too late. Damn the Empire.
traduit: 舒尔的骨头。我们来晚了，该死的帝国。

original: A storeroom. See if you can find any potions. We'll need them.
traduit: 储藏室。看看能不能找到我们需要的药剂。

original: A storeroom. Grab anything you can, but let's keep moving.
traduit: 储藏室。尽你所能拿点东西，然后赶紧走。

original: That's some good armor you've put together.
traduit: 你做的盔甲很不错。

original: That's a decent weapon you've made there.
traduit: 你做的武器很不错。

original: Shor's hall? What's that?
traduit: 舒尔大厅？那是什么？

original: Don't you know? What drew you here? Surely your dreams showed you the way?
traduit: 你不知道？那是什么吸引你来的？你的梦肯定给你指明了方向吧？

original: The Hall of Valor, where heroes wait to follow Shor to the final battle.
traduit: 勇士大厅，英雄们在那里等待追随舒尔奔赴最后一战。

original: Astrid is dead. It is as it should be. May she find redemption in the Void.
traduit: 阿斯垂德已死。顺理成章。愿她在虚空中获得救赎。

original: But while you live, the Dark Brotherhood lives. We must fulfill our contract. Emperor Titus Mede II must be eliminated.
traduit: 但只要你还活着，黑暗兄弟会就存在。我们必须执行契约。提图斯·迈德二世必须死。

original: Speak with Amaund Motierre at the Bannered Mare in Whiterun. He will know the true Emperor's location.
traduit: 去白漫城的悬旗母马找阿蒙德·莫提雷。他知道真皇帝在哪里。

original: But first, inform Nazir of your plans. For you are the Listener, and must bind this Family together.
traduit: 但首先，和纳兹尔说你的计划。你是聆听者，必须把这个家凝聚起来。

original: Is this your note? What does this mean?
traduit: 这是你的字条吗？什么意思？

original: My note? No, that's yours. Must have fallen out of your pocket.
traduit: 我的？不，是你的。肯定是从你口袋里掉出来的吧。

original: Can you please help me find this Augur? (Persuade)
traduit: 你能帮我找到占卜师吗？（说服）

original: Very well. It's not something often discussed, as it might be... misunderstood by the locals.
traduit: 好吧。这事通常不便多谈，因为可能会被当地人……误解。

original: The Augur is down in the Midden, below the College. I don't recommend going down there unless it's absolutely necessary.
traduit: 占卜师就在学院下面的秽道里。除非万不得已，否则我不建议你去那里。

original: Where is the Midden?
traduit: 秽道在哪儿？

original: Underneath the College. It's not the nicest place, so if you go down there, please do be careful.
traduit: 学院地下。那不是什么善地，如果要去，请务必小心。

original: Shor's favor has found you, Dragonborn. The Hall of Valor, heart's-ease, awaits.
traduit: 舒尔会赞赏你的，龙裔。勇士大厅正在默默等待。

original: By right of plunder. I am a Nightingale of Nocturnal.
traduit: 凭掠夺之权。我是诺克图娜尔的夜莺

original: Do not mistake the night-shrouded thief's stealthily-taken spoils, stolen and unearned, for a warrior's plunder, won in honorable battle.
traduit: 别把夜盗偷来的不劳而获之物和战士在光荣一战中取得的战利混为一谈。

original: Your doom already binds you to your dark mistress, but your errand I will not hinder, if my wrath you can withstand.
traduit: 你的终末注定与黑暗女士交织一起，但只要你能承受我的愤怒，那我不会阻止你的使命。

original: By right of blood. I Listen for the Night Mother.
traduit: 借鲜血之当。我是夜母的聆听者。

original: You trespass here, shadow-walker. Shor does not know you.
traduit: 暗影行者，你擅闯此地。舒尔并不相信你。

original: Perhaps before the end you will earn the right to pass this way.
traduit: 但或许在末日来临前，你能获得通过此路的权利。

original: Welcome I do not offer, but your errand I will not hinder, if my wrath you can withstand.
traduit: 我不欢迎你，只要你能承受我的愤怒，我就不会阻拦你的使命。

original: By right of Cleverness. I am Master of the College of Winterhold.
traduit: 依聪慧之理。我是冬堡学院的大师。

original: Well met, mage of Skyrim.
traduit: 你好，天际的法师。

original: The Nords may have forgotten their forefathers' respect for the Clever Craft, but your comrades throng this hall.
traduit: 诺德人可能已经忘记了他们的祖先对聪慧技艺的尊敬，但你的同志们正在大厅里。

original: Here in Shor's house we honor it still.
traduit: 在舒尔之殿，我们仍旧尊重它。

original: By right of glory. I lead the Companions of Jorrvaskr.
traduit: 以荣耀之名。我是月瓦斯卡战友团的领袖。

original: I welcome the chance to challenge the blade of Ysgramor's heir, honored shield-brother to Kodlak Whitemane, whom I've watched for in vain.
traduit: 很高兴有机会挑战伊斯格拉默之刃的继承者，“白鬃”克拉科光荣的盾牌兄弟，我等他很久了。

original: I welcome the chance to challenge the blade of Ysgramor's heir, honored shield-sister to Kodlak Whitemane, whom I've watched for in vain.
traduit: 很高兴有机会挑战伊斯格拉默之刃的继承者，“白鬃”克拉科光荣的盾牌姐妹，我等他很久了。

original: Can I enter the Hall of Valor?
traduit: 我能进入勇士大厅吗？

original: By the right of birth. I am Dragonborn.
traduit: 以出身之义，我是龙裔。

original: Ah! It's been too long since last I faced a doom-driven hero of the dragon blood.
traduit: 哈！我很久没见过身负龙血的末日英雄了。

original: Still you persist? Very well, you may enter.
traduit: 你还是要坚持吗？好吧，你可以进来了。

original: Your perseverance will only lead you to disappointment.
traduit: 你的坚持只会带来失望。

original: There is no solace in knowing what is to come.
traduit: 知道将要发生的事是得不到任何安慰的。

original: There is no help for you here.
traduit: 这里帮不了你。

original: And what is it I'm seeking?
traduit: 那我是在寻找什么？

original: You seek that which all who wield magic seek. Knowledge.
traduit: 你所追寻的，是所有使用魔法者都在追寻的。知识。

original: You shall find this: Knowledge will corrupt. It will destroy. It will consume.
traduit: 你会发现：知识会腐朽，会摧毁，会消耗。

original: You seek meaning, shelter in Knowledge. You will not find it.
traduit: 你想在知识中寻找意义和庇护。徒劳无果。

original: The Thalmor sought the same thing, and it shall lead to his end as it has so many others.
traduit: 那个梭默也在寻求同样的东西，那只会让他和其他很多人一样迎来灭亡。

original: I was told to find you.
traduit: 有人让我来找你。

original: Indeed. And so you have come looking, though you do not know why.
traduit: 确实。所以你就来找我了。虽然你根本不知道为了什么。

original: Like others before you, you blindly follow a path to your own destruction.
traduit: 像你之前的人一样，你盲目地走上了自我毁灭的道路。

original: The Thalmor came seeking answers as well, unaware they will be his undoing.
traduit: 那个梭默也来寻找答案，殊不知会导致自己的毁灭。

original: Your path now follows his, though you will arrive too late.
traduit: 现在你的道路紧随他后，尽管你来得太晚。

original: Surely you're joking?
traduit: 你在开玩笑？

original: This is the true Emperor, not some half-Septim lookalike. He'll be surrounded by elite bodyguards, I'm sure. You'll have your work cut out for you.
traduit: 这可是真皇帝，不是冒充他的什么半吊子塞普汀了。他肯定会被精英护卫严密保护。你的工作会很困难。

original: Still... everyone assumes the Dark Brotherhood has been completely destroyed. They may be a bit more lax than usual.
traduit: 不过……人人都以为黑暗兄弟会已经玩完了。他们可能会比平时更松懈一点。

original: What kind of security should I expect?
traduit: 那里的安保怎么样？

original: Well, I don't know.
traduit: 嗯，我不知道。

original: It's in the Solitude Inlet - that's the channel just north of the docks.
traduit: 它停泊在独孤城海湾，码头北的海峡那里。

original: I suppose you should go to the docks and... swim?
traduit: 我觉得你到码头之后应该……游泳？

original: This ship, the Katariah. How will I get onboard?
traduit: 我该怎么登上这卡塔瑞亚号？

original: You mean, after all that's transpired, the Dark Brotherhood will still... honor the contract?
traduit: 你是说，即使已经暴露，黑暗兄弟会还愿意继续……执行契约？

original: Why, this is astounding news! Wonderful news!
traduit: 真是令人震惊的好消息！

original: The Emperor is still in Skyrim, but not for long. He's onboard his ship, the Katariah, moored offshore in the Solitude Inlet. But you must hurry!
traduit: 皇帝还在天际，不过不会待太久了。他现在在自己的船，卡塔瑞亚号上。停泊在独孤城的海湾。你必须快点！

original: If you can get onboard that ship. Kill Titus Mede II, as contracted... I will reveal the location of the dead drop that holds your payment.
traduit: 如果你能顺利登船。按照约定杀死提图斯·迈德二世……我会告诉你存放酬金的秘密地点。

original: The Emperor. The real Emperor. Where is he?
traduit: 皇帝，真正的皇帝在哪儿？

original: By the gods. You... you're alive! But I had heard... your Sanctuary...
traduit: 神啊，你还……活着！但我听说……你们的圣所……

original: Please! You mustn't think I had anything to do with that! I wanted the Emperor dead! The true Emperor! I still do! It was Maro! He...
traduit: 拜托！千万别误会我跟那件事有关系！我想要皇帝死！真皇帝！我依旧这么想！是马洛！他……

original: DB11AmaundPlayerResponse4
traduit: DB11AmaundPlayerResponse4

original: Sithis is due a soul. Wouldn't you agree?
traduit: 西帝斯正需要一个灵魂。你不觉得吗？

original: We have unfinished business, Motierre.
traduit: 我们还有未了的事，莫提雷。

original: Well. Perhaps you'll at least consider it, hmm?
traduit: 好。也许你至少会考虑一下，嗯？

original: Now, on to the business at hand...
traduit: 好了，该回到手头的事了……

original: Hmph. Pity. I had hoped to obtain even a modicum of justice.
traduit: 嗯。真遗憾。我还希冀能得到一点公正的待遇。

original: Well, on to the business at hand then, hmm?
traduit: 好吧，那就说正事吧？

original: A Dark Brotherhood assassin doesn't do... "favors."
traduit: 黑暗兄弟会的刺客可不会……“帮忙”。

original: Now, on to the business at hand I suppose, hmm?
traduit: 现在，我们应该谈正事了吧？

original: I'll... consider your request.
traduit: 我会……考虑你的请求。

original: Well? I won't fight you, so we may as well get this over with.
traduit: 怎么了？我不会和你打的，我们还是把这事儿了结了吧。

original: Don't you have all the information you need? Please, the Emperor isn't going to kill himself. Hmph. Now wouldn't that be a blessing...
traduit: 你不是得到需要的消息了吗？来吧，帝王不会自戕。嗯。这不是件好事吗……

original: You will hear me out, then? Good.
traduit: 你愿意听我说完？好。

original: You will kill me, and I have accepted that fate. But regardless of your path through life, I sense in you a certain... ambition.
traduit: 你会杀了我，我也已经认命了。但不管你人生道路如何，我能够感受到你内在的……抱负。

original: So I ask of you a favor. An old man's dying wish. While there are many who would see me dead, there is one who set the machine in motion.
traduit: 所以我想请你帮个忙。算是一个老人的遗愿吧。很多人想要我死，但其中一个迈出了这一步。

original: This person, whomever he or she may be, must be punished for their treachery.
traduit: 不管那人是谁，都得为他们自己的奸诈付出代价。

original: Once you have been rewarded for my assassination, I want you to kill the very person who ordered it. Would you do me this kindness?
traduit: 等你拿到刺杀我的报酬，我要你杀了指使你的人。你能帮我这个忙吗？

original: Tsk. How unfortunate. I had hoped you would honor an old man's dying wish. Well, let's be done with it then.
traduit: 啧啧。真不幸。我还指望你能尊重一个老人的遗愿呢。好吧，那我们就说到此为止吧。

original: I've heard enough. Your life ends now.
traduit: 我听够了。你命到头了。

original: Come now, don't be shy. You haven't come this far just to stand there gawking.
traduit: 来吧，别那么害羞。你大老远跑来不是为了傻站着看看我吧。

original: You and I have a date with destiny, it would seem. But so it is with assassins and emperors, hmm?
traduit: 看来你与我命中注定有此一会了。即使一个刺客和一个皇帝，嗯？

original: Yes, I must die. And you must deliver the blow. It is simply the way it is.
traduit: 是啊，我必须死。而你必须动手。事情就这么简单。

original: But I wonder... would you suffer an old man a few more words before the deed is done?
traduit: 但我希望……你动手之前，能听老人家多说几句？

original: Oh, you can save your sinister bravado. I'll not go to my grave whimpering like an infant.
traduit: 哦吼，你不必如此大逞淫威。我也不会像个娃娃一样哭哭啼啼地去死。

original: I know why you're here. I must die. And you must deliver the blow. It is simply the way it is.
traduit: 我知道你为什么在这里。我必须死，而你必须出手。就这么简单。

original: Your rule is at an end! Sithis commands it!
traduit: 以西帝斯的名义！你的统治结束了！

original: DB11EmperorPlayerResponse13
traduit: DB11EmperorPlayerResponse13

original: I thank you for your courtesy.
traduit: 感谢你如此礼貌。

original: But of course. You and I have a date with destiny. But so it is with assassins and emperors, hmm?
traduit: 当然。你我命中注定有此一会。即使是刺客与皇帝之间，对吧？

original: You were... expecting me?
traduit: 你是在……等我？

original: Identify the buyer and we'll forget what we know. (Persuade)
traduit: 指认买家，我们就权当什么都不知道。（说服）

original: All right. Had I known the deal would bring me this much trouble, I never would have accepted the gold.
traduit: 好吧。要是我知道这笔交易会给我带来这么大麻烦，我是决不会接受这笔钱的。

original: I don't care what you promise. If I tell you the buyer's name and word gets around, it could ruin me!
traduit: 我不管你的承诺如何。要是我告诉你买家的名字和消息，我就毁了！

original: Yes? No? Nothing?
traduit: 是？不是？到底怎么了？

original: Very well, then. If you'll just... get going now...
traduit: 好吧，那，你现在能不能……走开呢……

original: Ha! Well, I certainly do feel that way.
traduit: 哈！我确实这么觉得。

original: Now, if, um... you'll get going?
traduit: 现在，那个，呃……你要走吗？

original: Today is the luckiest day of your life.
traduit: 今天是你一生中最幸运的一天。

original: You assassins and your riddles. It really does get very annoying, you know. Now if you'll excuse me...
traduit: 你们这些杀手太爱打哑谜。确实有点烦人。恕我不奉陪了……

original: Just a favor... for an honorable man.
traduit: 只是为了帮个小忙……为了一个高尚的人。

original: And what might that be?
traduit: 什么事？

original: Actually, Motierre, there is one more thing...
traduit: 其实，莫提雷，还有一件事……

original: Your payment awaits. And don't worry, I'm not stupid enough to betray you.
traduit: 去拿你的报酬吧。别担心，我还没蠢到背叛你。

original: Oh, for the love of Mara, would you please just go?
traduit: 哦，玛拉在上，你能走了吗？

original: DB11AmaundJobDoneTopic
traduit: DB11AmaundJobDoneTopic

original: I know! I know! I received the news not moments ago! Ha ha! This is glorious!
traduit: 我知道！我知道！我刚刚收到了消息！哈哈！何等光荣！

original: My friend, you may not realize it, but you have served the Empire, indeed all of Tamriel, in ways you cannot possibly imagine.
traduit: 朋友，你可能还没意识到，但你为帝国、乃至泰姆瑞尔以你无法想象的方式做出了贡献。

original: Ah, but you care little for politics, am I right? You want money! And money you shall have!
traduit: 啊，但你不太关心政治吧？你只想要钱！那钱就归你了！

original: Your payment waits for you at a dead drop. It is inside an urn, in the very chamber where we first met, in Volunruud.
traduit: 你的钱放在一个瓮里。就在我们第一次见面的沃伦鲁德。

original: Now please, go. Collect your money, and let us never look upon one another again. Our business, thank the gods, is concluded.
traduit: 现在，请吧。去收钱，然后永远别再见面了。诸神在上，咱们的交易，结束了。

original: Titus Mede II lies dead.
traduit: 提图斯·迈德二世死了。

original: Aha! You're back!
traduit: 啊哈！你回来了！

original: I think you're lying to me.
traduit: 我觉得你在骗我。

original: Look, that's all I know. I never promised you I'd have all the answers.
traduit: 听着，我就知道这些。我也没说过我什么都知道吧。

original: Now, since our transaction is done, I'll be on my way.
traduit: 现在，既然你我的交易达成，我就告辞了。

original: That's it? No name or anything?
traduit: 就这些？没有名字什么的吗？

original: In this business we rarely deal in names; our identity comes from how much coin we carry.
traduit: 干这行，我们很少用真名，我们的身份都是来自于我们带了多少钱。

original: Did she say why she was doing this?
traduit: 她有说过为什么这么做吗？

original: Not at all. I tend not to ask too many questions when I'm on the job. I'm sure you understand.
traduit: 没有。我在工作时一般不会问太多。你应该能理解。

original: However, I did notice she was quite angry and it was being directed at Mercer Frey.
traduit: 不过，我注意到她对墨瑟·弗雷很愤怒。

original: What about the information on Goldenglow Estate?
traduit: 有什么关于金色光辉庄园的消息吗？

original: I was approached by a woman who wanted me to act as the broker for something big.
traduit: 有个女人来找我，想要我给一桩大买卖做中间人。

original: She flashed a bag of gold in my face and said all I had to do was pay Aringoth for the estate.
traduit: 她在我面前亮出一袋金子，说我只需要把钱给阿林格斯就行。

original: I brought him the coin and walked away with her copy of the deed.
traduit: 我把钱交给他，然后把她的契约副本拿走了。

original: It is done. Emperor Titus Mede II lies dead, and the Dark Brotherhood yet lives.
traduit: 结束了。皇帝提图斯·迈德二世死了，黑暗兄弟会依旧存在。

original: Into the tunnel. Let's go.
traduit: 进隧道。我们走。

original: I'm ready.
traduit: 我准备好了。

original: Where did this tunnel come from?
traduit: 这隧道是哪儿来的？

original: It's a little gift from the dwarves. Who knew they would end up helping our cause?
traduit: 矮人们留下的小礼物。谁知道最后帮了我们？

original: We have to move. We'll talk more once we see the sky.
traduit: 我们得走了。等我们看到天空再谈吧。

original: I say you've earned an early pardon. Let's go.
traduit: 我说了你迎来提前出狱了。走吧。

original: Through this gate, just beside my quarters, is a tunnel. A tunnel that leads right through the old Dwarven ruins of Markarth, into the city.
traduit: 穿过我住处旁边的那扇门，就是一条隧道。直穿马卡斯的古代矮人废墟，进入城里。

original: Well, what do you say, my brothers?
traduit: 好了，你们怎么看，兄弟们？

original: My brothers, we have been here long enough. It's time to leave Cidhna Mine and continue our fight against the Nords.
traduit: 兄弟们，我们已经在这里待得够久了。是时候离开希讷矿场继续与诺德人作战了。

original: Your time runs short.
traduit: 你的时间不多了。

original: Please, we do not have much time.
traduit: 拜托，我们没有时间了。

original: Get moving.
traduit: 行动起来。

original: I can't believe we're finally getting out.
traduit: 真不敢相信我们终于出来了。

original: No turning back now.
traduit: 现在不能回头了。

original: Get going.
traduit: 出发。

original: Come on, move it. We have Nords to kill.
traduit: 快点，走了。我们要杀诺德人去了。

original: For the Forsworn!
traduit: 为了弃誓者！

original: We cannot fight the foe in this mist!
traduit: 我们没法在迷雾里战斗！

original: Clear Skies - combine our Shouts!
traduit: 一起用澄澈天空！

original: I need your help to defeat Alduin.
traduit: 我需要你的帮助来击败奥杜因。

original: Alduin escaped us long ago. Today we take our well-tempered revenge.
traduit: 奥杜因很久以前从我们手里逃了。现在该轮到我们报仇了。

original: For a hundred lifetimes my heart has burned for revenge on Alduin too long delayed.
traduit: 我长久以来一心想要向奥杜因复仇。

original: It is long since one of the living has entered here. May Shor's favor follow you and your errand.
traduit: 很久没有生者来到此地了。愿舒尔的恩惠伴随你和你的使命。

original: You fought well. I find you worthy.
traduit: 打得好。你很够格。

original: I'll get proof... and <Alias=Steward>'s cooperation.
traduit: 我会拿到证据……<Alias=Steward>会合作的。

original: Good. I can always count on you, can't I?
traduit: 好。我知道你靠得住。

original: I can always count on you, can't I?
traduit: 我就知道你很可靠。

original: This will require stealth and discretion. The Jarl's guards won't take kindly to anyone rummaging through her Steward's private quarters.
traduit: 行动要秘密谨慎。领主的卫兵可不会容忍有人在总管的私人住处乱翻。

original: You'll need to be careful with this one. The Jarl's men won't look kindly on you rummaging through the steward's quarters.
traduit: 小心点。领主的卫兵可不会容忍有人在总管的私人住处乱翻。
