original: Blackmail, eh? Tell me more...
traduit: 敲诈吗？告诉我更多……

original: DBNazirPlayerMoneyComeClean
traduit: DBNazirPlayerMoneyComeClean

original: Ha! I knew it, you rascal! By Sithis, the old man was worth the trouble.
traduit: 哈！我就知道，你个小无赖！那个老东西肯定是值钱的。

original: Gotcha! It was 20,000 gold.
traduit: 铛铛！是20000金币。

original: DBNazirPlayerMoneyStillLie
traduit: DBNazirPlayerMoneyStillLie

original: Pfft. You'd think an emperor would fetch at least twice that. Damn that motherless cheapskate, Motierre.
traduit: 呸。还以为皇帝得至少值这个的两倍呢。莫提雷那个死妈玩意儿抠门鬼。

original: In any event, here's my advice. Go to Riften's Ratway, find Delvin Mallory. I believe Astrid had you visit him once before, no?
traduit: 无论如何，我还是有些建议。去裂谷城的鼠道里找戴尔文·马洛里。我想阿斯垂德之前派你找过他一次吧？

original: Mallory is an expert "obtainer of goods." We can use the money to repair and refit this Sanctuary. Make a true home for us, eh?
traduit: 马洛里是“拿货”的专家，可以用这笔钱来修理装修一下这个圣所。给我们一个真正的家，怎样？

original: Sorry, no joke. 5,000 gold. (Lie)
traduit: 抱歉，没开玩笑。就5000金币。（撒谎）

original: Oh. Is that all? Really?
traduit: 哦，就这些？真的？

original: Come now! You're joking with old Nazir! Surely the Emperor's life was worth more than that.
traduit: 得了吧！你跟老纳兹尔开玩笑呢吧！皇帝的性命肯定值不少钱。

original: 5,000 gold. (Lie)
Ha! Clearly, we should have killed that old bastard years ago!
traduit: 哈！我们几年前就该杀那个老家伙了！

original: 10,000 gold. (Lie)
Ha! Remarkable! Well, the old bastard certainly made it worth your while, didn't he?
traduit: 哈！赚大了！那个老混蛋还挺值钱不是吗？

original: Truly?
traduit: 真的？

original: Could you have brought us more wondrous news? Recent events notwithstanding, this is a happy day for us, my friend.
traduit: 还有别的好消息么？虽然最近发生了一些事，但今天对在咱们来说却是快乐的一天。朋友。

original: Despite your misfortunes, you stayed true to the Dark Brotherhood. You've saved us all, and for this you have my eternal thanks.
traduit: 尽管遭遇了不幸，但你仍然忠于黑暗兄弟会。你救了我们大家，非常感谢。

original: Now, of course I must ask... Killing the Emperor... How much did Motierre pay for such a thing?
traduit: 现在我得问问……杀了皇帝……莫提雷给了多少钱？

original: Titus Mede II is dead... by my hand.
traduit: 提图斯·迈德二世死了……被我亲手杀了。

original: Well? What word of the Emperor?
traduit: 嗯？有皇帝的信儿吗？

original: I'll be fine. I just need a minute to catch my breath. Find Savos...
traduit: 我没事。只是需要喘口气。去找萨沃斯……

original: Excellent. I can move more soldiers through the area now that I know those scouts are dead.
traduit: 很好。既然那些侦察兵死了，我就能派更多士兵穿过这片区域了。

original: Good job! With those Imperial scouts out of the way, I can be more aggressive about where I send our men.
traduit: 干得好！没了那群帝国侦察兵，我就能更大胆地把人派过去了。

original: Good. They'll think twice before crossing us while their command structure is in disarray.
traduit: 很好。当他们指挥结构混乱时，就会在越过我们前三思后行了。

original: I pray Talos overlooks our less than honorable approach. But he knows our purpose is just and true. I'm glad you made it out alive.
traduit: 希望塔洛斯不会在意我们不光彩的做法。但他一定知道我们的目的是正义而真实的。我很高兴你能活着出来。

original: Good work. This was a double victory. We took a garrison away from the Stormcloaks and further proved the hollowness of their cause.
traduit: 干得漂亮。这是双重意义的胜利。我们让风暴斗篷从那里撤军，还证明了他们事业的空虚。

original: Excellent. That's one less settlement in Imperial hands, and one more sign to all that our cause is true.
traduit: 很好。又一个聚落从帝国手里解脱了。我们再次证明了事业的正确性。

original: Good work. I'll send some men with a wagon to collect the prize. We can use the weapons here, and I'll pass on the coin to Solitude.
traduit: 干得漂亮。我会派人赶着马车去收集战利。我们可以用这里的武器，然后把钱运回独孤城。

original: Well done! I'll send men with a wagon to collect our prize. We'll put the weapons to use here, and I'll send the coin back to Windhelm.
traduit: 干得漂亮！我会派人赶着马车去收集战利。我们把武器放在这，然后把钱运回风舵城。

original: Good job. The more citizens that join the fight against the rebels, the sooner they will see the futility of their rebellion.
traduit: 干得好。随着更多公民投入对抗叛军的战斗，叛军就会更快看到自己的反抗是徒劳的。

original: We grow that much stronger with each son and daughter of Skyrim who joins us. Down with the Emperor!
traduit: 每一位天际子女加入我们，都会壮大我们的力量。打倒皇帝！

original: Thanks for taking care of that. I don't think that will be the last we see of that Orc. It's always good to gain allies.
traduit: 谢谢你的帮忙。我不认为这是最后一次见到那个兽人。但获得盟友总是好的。

original: Thanks for dealing with that orc. Something tells me that's not the last time we'll see him. And, something tells me that might not be a bad thing.
traduit: 谢谢你帮忙对付那个兽人了。直觉告诉我，我们以后还会见他。但也许不是坏事。

original: Good job! I knew I gave the mission to the right person.
traduit: 干得好！我就知道我找对人了。

original: Good job! Ulfric was right about you. I'm glad to have you with us!
traduit: 干得好！乌弗瑞克没看错。很高兴你能加入我们。

original: What if I told you about a large shipment of gold and weapons?
traduit: 要是我告诉你一大批金子和武器呢？

original: What kind of agreement did you have in mind?
traduit: 你想达成什么协议？

original: What if I told you about a large shipment of silver and weapons?
traduit: 要是我告诉你一大批银子和武器呢？

original: Perhaps we could come to some kind of agreement?
traduit: 或许我们能达成某种协议？

original: I found some evidence...
traduit: 我找到了些证据……

original: So. You're an Imperial spy... Interesting...
traduit: 所以，你是帝国间谍……有意思……

original: I have no strong love for the Stormcloaks but I can't say I'm all that fond of the Empire, either.
traduit: 我不太喜欢风暴斗篷，但我也不是多喜欢帝国。

original: This war of yours makes it difficult for a resourceful woman to advance her interests.
traduit: 你们的这次战争很难让一个聪明的女人获益。

original: Perhaps we can find a way for both of us to prosper from this unfortunate discovery?
traduit: 或许我们能在这不幸当中找到双赢的办法？

original: You rebels are doing a fine job destroying yourselves. Soldiers running errands?
traduit: 你们这群叛军真是自掘坟墓。居然派士兵去跑腿？

original: So. You're one of Ulfric's spies...
traduit: 这么说。你是乌弗瑞克的间谍了……

original: I can't deny the man is right about a few things...
traduit: 我不否认他在一些事情上的正确性……

original: But I've seen first hand what Ulfric is capable of, given the chance. Suffice it to say, he is no friend to Markarth, and no friend of mine.
traduit: 但我曾有机会亲眼目睹了乌弗瑞克的能耐。我只想说，他不是马卡斯的朋友，也不是我的朋友。

original: My first and only loyalties are to my nephew, and to this city.
traduit: 我唯一效忠的对象就是我的侄子和这座城市。

original: If you believe in Talos, why don't you join our cause?
traduit: 如果你相信塔洛斯，为什么不加入我们的事业？

original: Recognize this? (Show <Alias.PronounObj=Steward> <Alias=Evidence>)
traduit: 认得这个么？（向<Alias.PronounObj=Steward>展示<Alias=Evidence>）

original: Not here. Come with me.
traduit: 别在这儿说。跟我来。

original: Stay close and the guards will leave you alone.
traduit: 跟紧点，卫兵就不会打扰你了。

original: I suppose you're here to extort something from me? Is that it?
traduit: 你是来敲诈我的吧？

original: Well, what is it you want?
traduit: 好啊，你想要什么？

original: One more time, and the World-Eater must face us!
traduit: 再来一次，世界吞噬者要面对我们了！

original: His power crumbles - do not pause for breath!
traduit: 他的力量在崩溃，不要停下！

original: Again, and we break his grim hold over Shor's realm, and redeem it for eternity!
traduit: 再来，让我们打破他对舒尔领域的控制，还松加德以自由！

original: Stand fast! His strength is failing! Once more, and his might will be broken!
traduit: 坚持住！他的力量变弱了！再来一次他就会被击垮！

original: Does his strength have no end? Is our struggle in vain?
traduit: 他的力量难道取之不尽？我们的斗争不就毫无意义吗？

original: Ven Mul Riik!
traduit: 文 穆尔 瑞克！

original: This was a mighty deed! The doom of Alduin encompassed at last, and cleansed is Sovngarde of his evil snare.
traduit: 了不起的伟业！奥杜因末日临头，它在松加德布下的邪恶陷阱也被扫清。

original: They will sing of this battle in Shor's hall forever. But your fate lies elsewhere.
traduit: 他们会在舒尔的大厅永久传唱这场战斗，但你现下不该留在此处。

original: When you have completed your count of days, I may welcome you again, with glad friendship, and bid you join the blessed feasting.
traduit: 等你过完你的一生，我将再次友好地欢迎你，邀请你参加神圣的宴会。

original: When you are ready to rejoin the living, just bid me so, and I will send you back.
traduit: 你准备好返回人间时，告诉我一声。我会把你送回去。

original: The eyes of Shor are upon you this day. Defeat Alduin, and destroy his soul-snare.
traduit: 今日舒尔也在注目于你。看你击败奥杜因，摧毁他的灵魂陷阱。

original: All hail the Dragonborn! Hail him with great praise!
traduit: 向龙裔致敬！尽力为他欢呼吧！

original: All hail the Dragonborn! Hail her with great praise!
traduit: 向龙裔致敬！尽力为她欢呼吧！

original: The endless wait gives way to battle! Alduin's doom, his death or ours!
traduit: 等待无尽岁月终于迎来了这一战！奥杜因的末日到了，我们要与他决一死战！

original: Fen du hin sille ko Sovngarde!
traduit: 芬 都 亨 斯勒 寇 松加德！

original: Zu'u lost daal.
traduit: 祖'乌 洛斯特 达尔！

original: Kel drey ni viik.
traduit: 科尔 德瑞 尼 威科。

original: Di kiirre fen alok.
traduit: 蒂 吉瑞 芬 阿洛克。

original: Daar Lein los dii.
traduit: 达尔 雷恩 洛斯 蒂依。

original: Hin sil fen nahkip bahloki.
traduit: 亨 斯尔 芬 纳吉普 巴洛基。

original: Pahlok joorre! Hin kah fen kos bonaar.
traduit: 帕洛克 约尔瑞！亨 卡 芬 寇斯 伯纳尔。

original: Zu'u Alduin, zok sahrot do naan ko Lein.
traduit: 祖'乌 奥杜因，佐克 撒洛特 都 纳安 寇 雷恩。

original: Nust wo ni qiilaan fen kos duaan.
traduit: 努斯特 沃 尼 奇兰 芬 寇斯 杜安。

original: Dovahkiin, hin kah fen kos bonaar.
traduit: 都瓦克因，亨 卡 芬 寇斯 伯纳尔。

original: Zu'u lost kriaan hi ont, nu hin sille fen nahkip suleyki.
traduit: 祖'乌 洛斯特 柯瑞安 亥 昂特

original: Zu'u ni faas gaaffesejul.
traduit: 祖'乌 尼 法斯 加菲塞尔。

original: Dovahkiin, you should not have come here. Nu hin sil dii.
traduit: 都瓦克因，你不该来此。尼 亨 斯尔 蒂依。

original: I have already defeated your friends once. Beyn. I do not fear them.
traduit: 我曾经击败过你的朋友。彼恩。我可不怕他们。

original: You are persistent, Dovahkiin. Pruzah ol aar. A fine slave you would have made.
traduit: 你很执着，都瓦克因。如扎 欧 阿尔。你将来是个不错的奴隶。

original: My teeth to your neck, Dovahkiin!
traduit: 都瓦克因，看我咬断你的脖颈！

original: Face me, then! Zu'u Alduin!
traduit: 直面我吧！祖'乌 奥杜因！

original: Again, together! Alduin is strong!
traduit: 一起再来一次！奥杜因很强！

original: Again, as one! The World-Eater fears us!
traduit: 再来！世界吞噬者在害怕我们！

original: We can shatter his power if we Shout together!
traduit: 只要齐心协力用龙吼，就能粉碎他的力量！

original: Again!
traduit: 再来！

original: We must clear this confounding mist.
traduit: 我们必须清除这团混杂的迷雾。

original: Alduin will hide in this lightless mist until we Shout together, and shatter his power.
traduit: 奥杜因躲在迷雾里，我们必须一起使用龙吼，把他的力量粉碎。

original: We must Shout together these shadows to dispel.
traduit: 我们必须用龙吼驱散迷雾。

original: We're ready, Dragonborn, our wrath to unleash.
traduit: 龙裔，我们准备好释放愤怒了。

original: Everyone, inside. Now!
traduit: 所有人，进屋。快！

original: By the gods...
traduit: 神啊……

original: Dragon!
traduit: 龙！

original: There's no time. We have to make sure Winterhold is safe.
traduit: 没时间了。我们得确保冬堡的安全。

original: We'll go with you, but when this is all over I want an explanation.
traduit: 我们和你一起去，但一切结束后你要给我个解释。

original: I'll go with you, but when this is all over I want an explanation.
traduit: 我和你一起去，但等一切结束后，我需要一个解释。

original: I'll go with you, but when things are back to normal I want an explanation.
traduit: 我和你一起去，但等一切恢复正常了，我需要一个解释。

original: Something went wrong. Winterhold may be in danger. Can you help?
traduit: 发生事故了。冬堡可能有危险。你能帮下忙吗？

original: It 'may be' in danger? Take a look. I don't think there's much question.
traduit: “可能”有危险？你看看，这还叫有“可能”？

original: Let's get down there. We have to do something.
traduit: 咱们下去吧。得做点什么。

original: That's certainly an understatement. I've never seen anything like this!
traduit: 这说法实在轻描淡写。我从没见过这样的东西！

original: Well, I suppose we can't just stand here. We'd better do something.
traduit: 好吧，咱们不能在这儿傻站着。我们最好做点什么。

original: What's going on? What happened in there?
traduit: 怎么回事？发生什么事了？

original: What does the Guild get if I do that?
traduit: 我这么做公会能得到什么？

original: Since I know losing the farm's payments will harm the Guild, I intend to make a substantial contribution for compensation.
traduit: 因为我知道失去养蜂场的付款会对公会造成损失，所以我打算给一笔可观的补偿。

original: I take care of my friends.
traduit: 我很照顾朋友的。

original: What would convince you that we're on your side?
traduit: 要如何才能让你相信我们是站在你这边的？

original: If you were to bring me the deed to Goldenglow Estate, so I was the full owner, that would be a step in the right direction.
traduit: 如果你能把金色光辉庄园的地契给我，让我成为它的全权所有者，那就行了。

original: You don't believe us?
traduit: 你不相信我们？

original: When you've been doing business like I have for decades, you quickly discover that the only person you can trust is yourself.
traduit: 等你像我一样做了几十年生意后，你就会发现你只能信任你自己。

original: What do you mean "supposed"?
traduit: 你说的“假设”是什么意思？

original: Having Goldenglow kept in line by the Thieves Guild has kept the honey flowing with minimal cost.
traduit: 由盗贼公会负责维持的金色光辉以最小的成本保证了蜂蜜的流通。

original: Now, mysteriously, some sort of anonymous adversary shows up and takes the Estate out of my hands.
traduit: 现在，一个匿名的对手神秘出现，从我手中夺走了这座庄园。

original: Mercer wants me to discover Goldenglow's buyer.
traduit: 墨瑟想让我找出金色光辉庄园的买主。

original: Yes, we spoke at length while you were in Whiterun dealing with our meadery situation.
traduit: 对，当你在白漫处理蜜酒庄的事时我们谈了很久。

original: I hope for all your sakes you find out who's behind this supposed "plot."
traduit: 为了你们大家，希望你们能够找出那个假设的“黑幕”。

original: So how do I get him to talk?
traduit: 那我该如何让他开口？

original: You're going to have to buy him off; it's the only way to get his attention.
traduit: 你得收买他，这是唯一能引起他注意的方法。

original: If that fails, follow him and see what he's up to. If I know Gulum-Ei, he's in way over his head and you'll be able to use it as leverage.
traduit: 如果失败了，就跟踪他，看看他在做什么。如果我了解古鲁姆-埃，他现在有点力不胜任，你可以利用这点作为筹码。

original: Seems all our eggs were in one basket.
traduit: 看来我们所有的鸡蛋都放在一个篮子里了。

original: Look, in case you hadn't noticed, these aren't the glory days of the Guild.
traduit: 听着，你可能没注意到，现在公会不是处在辉煌时期。

original: We've lost more clients in the last decade than I'd care to count, but Maven's stuck with us through throughout the entire ordeal.
traduit: 过去十年里，我们流失的客户数不胜数，但玛雯一直在陪伴我们。

original: I'll be damned if I'm going to lose her to... well, to whatever they are.
traduit: 一旦她输给了……不管是谁，那我都惨了。

original: And Honningbrew?
traduit: 还有蜜之酿？

original: Let's not kid ourselves. Black-Briar Mead is swill. The only thing keeping it successful is Maven.
traduit: 我们就别再自欺欺人了。黑棘蜜酒就是泔水。唯一让它保持成功的，就是玛雯。

original: Word on the street was that Honningbrew tasted better, cost less and Sabjorn didn't shove it down everyone's throat.
traduit: 有传言说，蜜之酿的味道更佳，成本更低，而且撒布乔恩并没有把它强灌进每个人的喉咙。

original: If Sabjorn ever managed to push Maven off her pedestal, we'd all be in trouble.
traduit: 如果撒布乔恩把玛雯从宝座上拉下来，那我们就都有麻烦了。

original: How is all this affecting the Guild?
traduit: 这一切对公会有什么影响？

original: Goldenglow Estate provided a huge payout for us before Aringoth locked us out.
traduit: 在阿林格斯把我们拒之门外前，金色光辉庄园给我们提供了大量资金。

original: Maven looked the other way as long as the honey kept flowing and we kept him in line.
traduit: 只要蜂蜜持续产出，我们又让他懂得守规矩，玛雯就不会管。

original: I found the same marking at Honningbrew Meadery.
traduit: 我在蜜之酿酒庄发现了同样的标记。

original: It would seem our adversary is attempting to take us apart indirectly by angering Maven Black-Briar. Very clever.
traduit: 看来我们的对手正试图激怒玛雯·黑棘，借此离间我们。够聪明。

original: It's really dead, then?
traduit: 这是真死了吗？

original: I never would have believed it, if I hadn't seen it with my own eyes...
traduit: 要不是亲眼所见，我永远也不会相信……

original: It may be dead now, but... where did it come from?
traduit: 它现在是死了，但是……这是从哪里来的？

original: In all my years, I've never seen such a thing...
traduit: 活了这么多年，还没见过……

original: Something's happening...
traduit: 发生什么事了……

original: What manner of magic is this?
traduit: 这是什么魔法？

original: Look out! Don't get too close!
traduit: 小心！别靠的太近！

original: It's like the ancient legends. Dragonborn...
traduit: 就像古代的传说一样。龙裔……

original: It can't be... You... You took its very soul...
traduit: 不可能……你……你居然夺走了它的灵魂……

original: By the gods... I don't even know what to say...
traduit: 神啊……我都不知道该说什么好了……

original: Hey... is someone watching me?
traduit: 嘿……有人在看着我吗？

original: I swear, if I'm being followed...
traduit: 我发誓，肯定有人跟踪我……

original: I swear I feel like I'm being watched.
traduit: 我绝对被人监视了。

original: If this keeps up, I'm headed back to the Winking Skeever.
traduit: 如果再这样下去，我就回眨眼恶鼠去。

original: I don't have time to chase shadows, I've got better things to do.
traduit: 我没时间去追踪影子，我还有要紧事要做。

original: Damn ears... playing tricks on me again. Can't stand this sea air!
traduit: 该死的耳朵……又在糊弄我。真受不了这海上的空气！

original: Following me, huh? You're not very good at this are you?
traduit: 跟踪我？你不太擅长这个吧？

original: You may as well give up, I see you there.
traduit: 你还是放弃吧，我看到你了。

original: You're trailing me? I knew I heard something.
traduit: 你想尾随我？我还不是聋子。

original: Ha! I knew it was you all along.
traduit: 哈！我一开始就知道是你。

original: Is someone following me?
traduit: 有人跟踪我吗？

original: I've never been more sure about anything in my entire life. Someone like Grelod doesn't deserve to live one more day. She's a monster.
traduit: 我从来没这么确信过。桂罗这种人不配多活一天。她就是个怪物。

original: Are you sure about this, boy? Murdering this woman?
traduit: 孩子，你真的这么确定？要杀这个女人？

original: She got sick, last winter, when the snows came. And she just... she never got better. Not all year. One night she fell asleep and...  never woke up.
traduit: 去年冬天开始下雪的时候，她病倒了。只是……没再好起来。还没转过年，有天晚上她就睡着了……再也醒不过来了。

original: So now I'm all alone. And the Jarl said I had to go to Honorhall Orphanage. It's not fair!
traduit: 现在我成了孤儿了。领主说我得去荣耀堂孤儿院。这不公平！

original: Tell me about your mother. What happened?
traduit: 和我说说你母亲吧。发生什么了？

original: Your weird experiments are over, wizard.
traduit: 你的古怪实验到头了，巫师。

original: Your corpse will feed my spiders for weeks. Now die, you fool!
traduit: 你的尸体够喂我的蜘蛛好几周了。现在去死吧，蠢蛋！

original: What? Who are you? How did you get this far?
traduit: 什么？你是谁？你是怎么来到这儿的？

original: Please hurry. To be honest, I'm kind of lonely here. As much as I hated getting sent to Honorhall, I really miss my friends there...
traduit: 请快点。老实说我在这儿有点寂寞。虽然我很讨厌被送到荣耀堂，但我有点想念那里的朋友……

original: You've taken up enough of my time. Now leave.
traduit: 你耽误我太多时间了。现在赶紧出去。

original: Think you can intimidate me? In my own orphanage? Ha! Not bloody likely.
traduit: 你以为能在我的孤儿院里吓到我吗？根本没戏。

original: You assist all you like. And get roasted for your trouble. I'll guard the exit.
traduit: 想做什么就去吧。被烤死是你自己的事。我来守出口。

original: Arcturus took some men deeper in, wanted to be sure. We should maybe... assist them.
traduit: 阿克图鲁斯带人往深处去了，想要确认一下。我们应该……帮他们。

original: Suppose not. But what's taking the others so long? The sooner we get out of here, the better. Smoke's getting bad. This place'll be raging soon.
traduit: 万一没呢。但其他人怎么这么久还没来？越早离开越好。烟越来越浓了。这地方很快就要爆炸了。

original: Dunno. One of these corpses. Does it matter?
traduit: 不知道。这尸体里的一个吧。怎么了？

original: Which one was the rat?
traduit: 哪个是那个告密者？

original: Thank you again for resolving my... problem.
traduit: 再次感谢你解决了我的……麻烦。

original: Ah, hello there, traveler. Come to the Nightgate for food or lodging?
traduit: 啊，你好啊，旅行者。欢迎来到夜扉旅店，请问打尖还是住店？

original: Need a room? Or maybe just some mead?
traduit: 需要房间吗？还是来点蜜酒？

original: Something I can get for ya?
traduit: 我能帮你些什么吗？

original: I can't help you, friend. Talk to Hadring, the Innkeeper.
traduit: 我帮不了你，朋友。去和旅馆老板哈德灵谈谈。

original: I value my privacy. So if you don't mind?
traduit: 我很注重个人隐私。所以能否请你不要打扰我？

original: I really don't mean to be rude, friend, but I'm not feeling particularly sociable...
traduit: 朋友，我确实不想失礼，但我不太喜欢社交……

original: Hadring got himself another customer, eh?
traduit: 哈德灵又有新客人了？

original: The beds and beer are both lousy, you ask me.
traduit: 要我说的话，这里的床位和酒都很糟糕。

original: You did? Really?
traduit: 你成功了？真的？

original: This is the best news I've ever gotten!
traduit: 这是我听过最好的消息！

original: I mean, I knew the Dark Brotherhood was good... just not that good! You killed the old hag before I even asked!
traduit: 我是说，我知道黑暗兄弟会还不错……但是没那么好！你在我开口前就把那个老妖婆宰了！

original: Oh, and please, take this as payment. It's an old family heirloom, supposed to be pretty valuable. It should fetch you a nice price. Thank you again!
traduit: 哦，还有，请收下这个算作报酬。这是一件古老的传家宝，应该很值钱。但愿能卖个好价钱。太谢谢你了！

original: Grelod? As it turns out... I already killed her.
traduit: 桂罗？我已经把她杀了。

original: What do you want? You have no business being in here.
traduit: 你想要干什么？你不该待在这儿。

original: All right. I'll take care of it.
traduit: 好的，我会去处理的。

original: I'll handle it. No need to blow things out of proportion.
traduit: 我会处理的。没必要小题大做。

original: Please, just let me handle it. It's not a problem.
traduit: 拜托，让我来处理就好。这不是问题。

original: Okay, okay. I'll deal with it.
traduit: 好的，好的。我会处理的。

original: Samuel is getting to be a problem. Fancies himself something of a "leader" to the other children. Put an end to the nonsense, or I will.
traduit: 萨穆埃尔越来越麻烦了，真以为自己是那帮孩子的“头儿”了。他再胡说八道，我会让他闭嘴的。

original: Hroar's crying is keeping me up at night. I'll give you one chance to talk the tears out of him, or he's getting the belt.
traduit: 赫洛阿的哭声吵得我睡不了觉。就给你一次机会，想办法把他哄住，再哭我就拿皮带抽他。

original: I can't abide Samuel's constant talk of his parents. "They're coming for me." "This is only temporary." The boy must accept his fate.
traduit: 萨穆埃尔天天念叨他爸妈，真是听够了。“他们来找我了。”“这只是暂时的。”得让这孩子认命。

original: Seven septims are missing from my purse. I know it was Runa. You get those coins back, or by Stendarr, I'll see her rot in the dungeon.
traduit: 我包里少了七个塞普汀。我知道是卢娜拿的。去把钱追回来，不然，我以斯丹达尔的名义起誓，一定让她烂死在牢里。

original: This place is filthy. I've a mind to cancel all town privileges unless those brats start pulling their weight.
traduit: 这地方太脏了。我打算取消所有进城权利，除非这些小鬼开始尽责打扫。

original: The stores are running low. We'll need to water down the milk again. Besides, don't want the little darlings getting fat.
traduit: 存货快不够了。我们得再往牛奶里掺点水。再说，我也不想让小宝贝儿们吃胖了。

original: We haven't had an adoption in months. At this rate, we'll be stuck with these brats forever. We need to get the word out. A sale, if need be.
traduit: 已经好几个月没人来领养了。照这样下去，我们得被这些小鬼赖一辈子。干脆放出话去，整个大甩卖得了。

original: Yes, Grelod?
traduit: 怎么了，桂罗？

original: Constance!
traduit: 康斯坦斯！

original: I am Tsun, shield-thane to Shor.
traduit: 我乃苏恩，舒尔的盾之武卫。

original: The Whalebone Bridge he bade me guard and winnow all those souls whose heroic end sent them here, to Shor's lofty hall
traduit: 他命我守卫鲸骨桥，筛选那些因英勇之终末来到此地的灵魂，前往舒尔的崇高殿堂。

original: where welcome, well-earned, awaits those I judge fit to join that fellowship of honor.
traduit: 那里是我认定适合成为荣耀一员者应得的归宿。

original: Come on! You know you want what's in that chest. Just walk toward it!
traduit: 来吧！你知道你想要箱子里的东西。朝它走！

original: Just walk toward the chest! Gravity will do the rest.
traduit: 朝着箱子走！重力会做完剩下的事。

original: I know you're up there. Go get the treasure. Doesn't it look pretty?
traduit: 我知道你在上面。去拿宝藏吧。很漂亮是吧？

original: Oh, and I wasn't entirely truthful before. This is actually going to hurt a lot. You see, you have to be dead in order for the spell to take hold.
traduit: 哦，我之前也没完全说实话。其实是很疼的了。你得理解，只有你死了，法术才会生效。

original: Ah...Here it is. Now, if you'd be so kind as to stand still this will be much easier for me to do.
traduit: 啊……在这儿。好了，如果你能好心点站着别动，那我就轻松多了。

original: Hhhmmm...maybe I put it over here.
traduit: 嗯嗯……也许是放这儿了。

original: It's got to be somewhere around here! Now where did I put it?
traduit: 肯定就在这附近！我把它放哪儿了？

original: Oh, and don't mind my assistant here. He may have seen better days, but he's still more help to me dead than he was alive.
traduit: 哦，别介意我的助手。也许他活着时候会更好看，但他死了对我的帮助比活着大。

original: Don't worry though. It'll be relatively painless...relatively.
traduit: 不过别担心。相对来说不会很痛苦的……相对来说。

original: Alright, let's see if we have something here to end this as quickly as possible.
traduit: 好了，来看看我们能不能尽快结束这一切。

original: Ooooh...yes...yes. You've fallen for my trap! Greed makes a great lure. Odd you didn't die from the fall though. Most do.
traduit: 哦……对……对。你掉进了我的陷阱里了！贪婪铸就极大的诱惑。你怎么没被摔死呢。少见。

original: You're obviously a thief. I kill thieves. (Intimidate)
traduit: 你明显是个贼。我是专门杀贼的。（恐吓）

original: All right, calm down, no need to for that. I'll let you in right away, just need to get the gate unlocked.
traduit: 好了，冷静点，没必要这样。我马上让你进去，把门打开就行了。

original: I think you'd be a little smarter than that.
traduit: 我觉得你应该更聪明点。

original: Like anyone would even notice, in all this mess.
traduit: 这么乱的地方，没人会注意到的。

original: Don't sound so disappointed. You wouldn't be allowed to take it even if there was.
traduit: 不要说得那么失望。即使有也不会让你拿的。

original: There's no gold, nothing shiny at all.
traduit: 没有金币，没有闪亮亮的东西。

original: I'm not sure what I was expecting, but this isn't it.
traduit: 我不知道我该期待些什么，但肯定不是这个。

original: I just don't know that it's right for us to be in here like this, picking through the ruins .
traduit: 我只是不知道我们这样待在遗迹里搜寻是否合适。

original: You seem uncomfortable being here.
traduit: 你在这里好像不太自在。

original: That doesn't begin to describe it.
traduit: 瘆人可形容不了这里。

original: This is a little creepy.
traduit: 有点瘆人。

original: I think, given the state of Skyrim, some might disagree.
traduit: 我觉得，考虑到天际的现状，有些人可能不同意这种说法。

original: Oh, right. That whole thing with the elves. Well, it all worked out in the end, didn't it?
traduit: 哦，对。是精灵的事。最后一切都解决了不是吗？

original: Not excited, no. Some very bad things happened here.
traduit: 不激动，不激动。这里发生过一些非常糟糕的事情。

original: Are you excited to see what's in there? This is important to you Nords, isn't it?
traduit: 你很激动地想看看里面有什么吧？这对你们诺德人很重要吧？

original: Don't get any ideas. We're here on official business, remember?
traduit: 别瞎想了。我们是来办公的，忘了？

original: I'm betting bodies. Lots and lots of bodies. And maybe some valuables...
traduit: 我敢打赌，会有好多好多尸体。也许还有些宝物……

original: It's thousands of years old. Who knows what we might find?
traduit: 这里有几千年历史了。谁知道会发现什么？

original: What do you think we'll find in there?
traduit: 你觉得咱们能在这儿找到什么？

original: Why in the world would this be sealed off? What is this place?
traduit: 为什么要把这里封起来？这里是什么地方？

original: Well, this is highly unusual. And very interesting.
traduit: 很不寻常，也非常有趣。

original: This is an exciting opportunity for us. To be able to study such an early civilization, and the magics they used...
traduit: 这对我们来说是个很好的机会。能够研究这样一个早期文明，以及他们对魔法的使用……

original: Sacked by the elves in the infamous "Night of Tears," not much is known about what happened to Saarthal.
traduit: 在臭名昭著的“泪之夜”中，萨瑟尔被精灵洗劫一空，关于这一事件我们知之甚少。

original: As some of you may know, Saarthal was one of the earliest Nord settlements in Skyrim. It was also the largest.
traduit: 如大家所知，萨瑟尔是天际最早期的诺德定居地之一。也是其中最大的一个。

original: I found this amulet. It might be important.
traduit: 我找到这个护符。可能很重要。

original: You found what?
traduit: 你找到了什么？

original: Hmm. Well now. Yes, this might actually be something interesting. You'd better show that to Tolfdir right away.
traduit: 嗯。好吧。这个可能有点意思。你最好快点拿去给托夫迪尔看看。

original: Hmm. Well now. This is all very fascinating, but I don't recall asking to you to touch anything in here.
traduit: 嗯。好吧。这些东西确实很迷人，但我好像没允许你碰任何东西吧。

original: I suppose you'd better show that to Tolfdir nonetheless. And please, ask before tampering with anything else.
traduit: 我想你最好还是给托夫迪尔看看吧。在动别的东西之前，请先问一声。

original: Kill her?
traduit: 杀了她？

original: I've thought this through, and it's the only way. She's too far gone, too corrupted by the Hags. At least in death she can be free again.
traduit: 我想过了，这是唯一的方法。她走得太远了，被鬼婆们搞得过于堕落了。至少她死后能重获自由。

original: Enough. Let's go.
traduit: 够了。咱们走吧。

original: What's the plan?
traduit: 计划是什么？

original: I'll present you as the sacrifice. Just play along. While mother begins the ritual, I'll strike. Then, together we can... we can kill her.
traduit: 我会把你当成祭品。只是假装的。当母亲开始仪式的时候，我就会动手。然后我们可以一起……杀了她。

original: All right. Mother is just outside this door. I have a plan.
traduit: 好了。母亲就在门那头。我有个计划。

original: Don't be sorry for me. I just - if I would have known it would come to this. Mother...
traduit: 不必为我难过。只是，如果我早些预料到事情会到这个地步。母亲……

original: About your mother...
traduit: 关于你母亲的事……

original: You've decided to help?
traduit: 你决定帮忙了？

original: Do I make myself clear?
traduit: 我说清楚了吗？

original: Don't know. Creepy fella, black robe. Couldn't see his face. Paid me a pretty sum to get that into your hands, though.
traduit: 不知道。是个诡异的家伙，穿着一身黑袍。脸看不清。不过给了我一大笔钱要我送到你的手里。

original: From who?
traduit: 谁送来的？

original: Well, here we are. We think.
traduit: 好了，我们应该是到了。

original: Their leader is a battle-mage named Haldyn.
traduit: 他们的首领是个叫哈尔丁的战斗法师。

original: Haldyn? I've heard of the man, but never guess he'd join up with some pirates.
traduit: 哈尔丁？我听说过他，没想到他和海盗混到一起了。

original: This could be even more dangerous than I thought. Head to the ships. We'll plan the assault on the way.
traduit: 这可能会比想象的要危险。上船吧。我们路上计划怎么进攻。

original: Finally, someone around here that can get things done.
traduit: 终于有人办到了。

original: Since we're short on soldiers you'll be coming with us, too. No arguments.
traduit: 我们现在兵源不足，你也得跟我们走。没得商量。

original: Anything else you want to say?
traduit: 还有什么要说的吗？

original: Sorry isn't good enough, Orthus. There's a lot of gold at stake here, and sniveling isn't going to get it back.
traduit: 抱歉是不够的，奥苏斯。事关大量资金，你就是哭也拿不回来。

original: Adelaisa, I'm sorry.
traduit: 阿德莱萨，我很抱歉。

original: Who is Haldyn?
traduit: 谁是哈尔丁？

original: Our secret ingredient, if you will.
traduit: 如果你愿意接受这种说法，那就是我们的秘密成员。

original: A battle-mage of fearsome cunning.
traduit: 狡猾可怕的战斗法师。

original: Runs the Blood Horkers, and makes sure the battles end right-side up.
traduit: 掌管血腥海象，并确保战斗能够顺利结束。

original: Lots of gold to be had plundering ships.
traduit: 掠夺船只赚得不少吧。

original: Aye, the war keeps the Empire and the locals too busy to worry about us. Haldyn calls it "our golden age."
traduit: 是啊，战争让帝国和当地人都顾不上我们。哈尔丁管这叫“属于我们的黄金时代”。

original: Oh, we've got other things in mind for our mouths, sweetie.
traduit: 哦，我们的嘴边还得有点其他东西，甜心。

original: Just... leave me alone! I've brought your mead, now drink it and shut your filthy mouths.
traduit: 离……离我远点！我把你要的蜜酒拿来了，赶快喝，闭上你的臭嘴。

original: Come now, dearie, surely we aren't all that bad.
traduit: 得了吧，小宝贝，我们没那么坏。

original: You beasts are the worst.
traduit: 你们这些畜生坏透了。

original: Both of you wait here for a moment.
traduit: 你俩在这儿等一会儿。

original: We're right behind you.
traduit: 我们会紧随你。

original: Lead on, we're ready.
traduit: 带路吧，我们准备好了。

original: We're with you.
traduit: 我们和你在一起。

original: Will do. Don't stray too far away or else we'll come after you.
traduit: 好吧。但别走太远，不然我们会去找你。

original: No problem, but if you get too far away, we're going to catch up.
traduit: 没问题，但如果你走太远，我们会去跟上你的。

original: All right, but don't wander ahead too far or else we'll be forced to come find you.
traduit: 好吧，但不要走太远，不然我们就得去找你了。

original: Here's an order from General Tullius himself.
traduit: 这是图留斯将军亲自下的命令。

original: Well... This seems to be in order. Very well, follow me.
traduit: 嗯……似乎是真的。好吧，跟我来。

original: I need a prisoner released from Northwatch Keep.
traduit: 我需要从北望堡垒释放一个囚犯。

original: The Thalmor? Do you have any idea what you're asking?
traduit: 梭默？你知道自己在问什么吗？

original: I'm sorry, that's just not possible. It would cause far too many problems.
traduit: 很遗憾，行不通。会闹出一堆麻烦。

original: I can only imagine the headaches this is going to cause...
traduit: 我都能想到这能带来多少头疼事……

original: Here, take this. Assuming they even honor it, you should be able to get your prisoner out.
traduit: 拿着。如果他们能尊重这玩意儿，你应该能把你要的犯人带出来。

original: I'm here for Thorald Gray-Mane
traduit: 我是为索拉德·灰鬃而来的。

original: Are you joking?
traduit: 你开玩笑吧？

original: Even if we had a prisoner by that name, the only way he'd be released is by order of the Imperial Legion.
traduit: 就算我们有叫这个的囚犯，也只有帝国军团的命令才能释放他。

original: Now I suggest you turn around and go back the way you came.
traduit: 我建议你掉过头去，哪里来回哪里去的好。

original: Look, I'm getting out of here. Normally, spiders make my skin crawl, but magic spiders? Blech.
traduit: 听着，我要走了。一般的蜘蛛也就是让我起鸡皮疙瘩，但魔法蜘蛛？太恶心了。

original: What was going on with that spider?
traduit: 那只蜘蛛到底怎么了？

original: I don't know, but this place is full of them. Every one I've encountered has been enchanted or the like.
traduit: 我不知道，但这地方到处都是。我遇到的每一个都被施了魔法之类的。

original: Does it matter? You're warm, dry... and still very much alive. That's more than can be said for old Grelod. Hmm?
traduit: 有什么关系？你身上温暖干燥……而且活蹦乱跳。老桂罗可就不一样。嗯？

original: What? Where am I? Who are you?
traduit: 什么？我在哪儿？你又是谁？

original: Sleep well?
traduit: 睡得可香？

original: How long has Yamarz been cursed?
traduit: 亚马兹被诅咒多久了？

original: Almost ever since he became leader of the tribe.
traduit: 几乎是从他成为部落首领就开始了。

original: He killed Shagrol in combat, which none of us thought possible. But the winner is made Chief. That is how it is done.
traduit: 他在战斗中出人意料地杀了沙葛洛。但按照惯例，胜者将成为酋长。

original: Is there a key for this cage?
traduit: 这个笼子有钥匙吗？

original: No, it's the levers in the center there. Just make sure you don't pull the wrong one. Please, hurry. I don't like being in here!
traduit: 没有，拉动中间的拉杆就行。只要不拉错就好。请快点。我不喜欢待在这儿！

original: Why are you in this cage?
traduit: 你为什么被关在笼子里了？

original: They threw me in here until they were ready to use me in one of their experiments.
traduit: 他们把我扔在这里，等着拿我做实验。

original: This wasn't supposed to happen. I thought they wanted my help, not to use me as a test subject!
traduit: 本不该是这样的。我以为他们是需要我的帮助，结果却是想拿我做实验！

original: I'm here to rescue you and recover the books you stole.
traduit: 我是来救你，然后拿回你偷的书。

original: See? I knew Aren wouldn't leave me in here!
traduit: 看到了吧？我就知道阿冉不会把我扔在这里不管的！

original: Hurry and get me out of this cage before they come for me!
traduit: 快，在他们来抓我之前把我放出来！

original: I've located Grimsever.
traduit: 我找到了无情切割者。

original: When you told me of your intent to join the Thieves Guild, I honestly didn't think we'd have much to speak about ever again.
traduit: 当你告诉我你打算加入盗贼公会的时候，我真的觉得咱们没什么可谈的了。

original: Yet here you are with my weapon that you could have easily sold or kept for yourself.
traduit: 但你却拿着本可以轻易卖掉或者自己留着的武器还给我。

original: Forgive me for my hasty opinion of you, I see that I was wrong and that there's much I can learn from you.
traduit: 请原谅我对你草率的看法，是我错了，我可以从你身上学到很多东西。

original: If you'd permit me, I'd be honored to accompany you in your travels for a time.
traduit: 如果你允许的话，我很愿意陪你旅行一段时间。

original: Astonishing. To think you actually were able to reach it and yet return to tell the tale.
traduit: 太惊人了。你居然能到达那里却还活着回来讲这段故事。

original: Rarely in my travels have I encountered those who possess skills equal to your own.
traduit: 在我旅行当中，很少遇到你这样有本事的人。

original: I see I still have much to learn. If you'd permit me, I'd be honored to accompany you in your travels for a time.
traduit: 看来我还有很多东西要学。如果你允许的话，我很愿意陪你旅行一段时间。

original: "Honor" is a coward's tool.
traduit: “荣誉”是懦夫的借口。

original: An astute observation.
traduit: 所见不差。

original: Skyrim is a beautiful and harsh mistress, but her people cling to such a petty notion of honor.
traduit: 天际美丽而严苛，但她的子民却执着于狭隘的荣誉观。

original: My previous champion displeases me.
traduit: 我的前任勇士冒犯了我。

original: It is time he is replaced - in the traditional fashion.
traduit: 是时候用传统的方式把他取代了。

original: Impressive.
traduit: 叹为观止。

original: Well, it was. Sadly, this forge is dying and I've used the last of my fire salts. If I can't feed it soon, it may grow cold.
traduit: 嗯，那是。可惜，这锻炉快要死了，我把最后的火盐用完了。如果不马上喂饱它，它就该冷下来了。

original: You seem quite proud of your work.
traduit: 你似乎对自己的工作很自豪啊。

original: Smithing's been in my blood for generations. I owe my success to my forefathers and their recipe for flame.
traduit: 我们家几代人都是铁匠。我的成功归功于祖先和他们的火焰秘方。

original: The secret is my forge. It consumes fire salts, a strange mineral that burns as hot as Red Mountain lava.
traduit: 秘密就在我的熔炉里。它是烧火盐的，那是种奇怪的矿物，燃烧起来就像红山的熔岩一样热。

original: No, no! This can't be happening!
traduit: 不，不！这不可能！

original: The sealed letter will explain everything that needs to be done. The amulet is quite valuable - you can use it to pay for any and all expenses.
traduit: 这封密信会解释一切。这个护符也很值钱，足够支付全部费用。

original: How did you meet Keerava?
traduit: 你是怎么遇到基拉瓦的？

original: I met her when I wandered into Riften a few years ago. Been smitten with her ever since. In fact, I'm thinking of asking her to marry me.
traduit: 几年前我在裂谷城游荡时遇到了她。从那之后就被她迷住了。实际上，我正在考虑向她求婚。

original: In Black Marsh, tradition dictates we present a potential mate a unique wedding ring to represent our future bond.
traduit: 在黑沼泽，我们的传统是要送给潜在的伴侣一枚独特的婚戒来代表我们未来的关系。

original: I already have the gold band, but all I need are three flawless amethysts to complete the setting.
traduit: 我已经准备好了金戒指，但还需要三枚无瑕的紫水晶才能完成整个镶嵌。

original: I've given away all the missives.
traduit: 所有册子都送出去了。

original: Oh, splendid! Just splendid! Mara smiles upon us this day.
traduit: 哦，好！实在太好了！玛拉今天向我们微笑了。

original: Allow me to give you her gift... a true blessing to aid you in times of need. Despair not, her warmth will protect you always!
traduit: 请允许我把她的赐福……一份真正的祝福送给你，会在你需要的时候帮助你。愿你永不绝望，她的温暖会永远保护你！

original: Just head north - you can't miss it. It's the capital of Whiterun Hold.
traduit: 一路往北，很好找的。那里是白漫领的首府。

original: Jarl Balgruuf still hasn't declared for one side or the other, so at least you won't run into any Imperials along the way.
traduit: 巴尔古夫领主还没宣布支持哪边，所以至少不用担心在路上碰到帝国兵。

original: Cross the river and then head north. You'll see Whiterun on its hill as you pass the falls.
traduit: 过河往北走，经过瀑布之后你就能看见山上的白漫城。

original: We escaped from the Imperials together.
traduit: 我们一起从帝国手中逃出来。

original: You did? We heard that Ulfric was captured...
traduit: 真的？我们听说乌弗瑞克被俘了……

original: ... no, sorry, but in times like these I can't just take the word of a stranger who wanders into town claiming to be my brother's friend.
traduit: ……不行，抱歉了。这种时候我不能相信随便来个陌生人就说是我兄弟的朋友。

original: Of course. Here's a key to the house. Stay as long as you like. If there's anything else you need, just let me know.
traduit: 当然。这是房门的钥匙。你想待多久就待多久。如果还需要什么东西的话，尽管跟我提。

original: But what's this all about? What are you two doing here?
traduit: 但到底是怎么了？你们俩来这干什么？

original: Ralof? How do you know him?
traduit: 拉罗夫？你怎么认识他的？

original: Ralof said you could help me out.
traduit: 拉罗夫说你可以帮我。

original: Here, sister. Blessings of Mara upon you.
traduit: 给你，姐妹。愿玛拉祝福你。

original: Mara only helps those who can afford her tithes. This is nonsense.
traduit: 玛拉只会帮助那些给得起她捐赠的人。真是胡说八道。

original: Oh, how kind! Thank you.
traduit: 哦，多么善良啊！谢谢你。

original: Excellent, I needed some more kindling for my kitchen hearth.
traduit: 太好了。我这就给厨房的壁炉添点柴火。

original: Whatever you're peddling, I'm not buying.
traduit: 不管你在叫卖什么，我是不会买账的。

original: Are you serious? You're as crazy as Maramal.
traduit: 你是认真的？你和玛拉莫一样疯了。

original: Look, the only religion I believe in is the good old septim. Everything else is just a waste.
traduit: 听着，我唯一的信仰就是金闪闪的塞普汀。其他都是扯淡。

original: Ugh. Get this awful paper away from me, by Talos!
traduit: 啊。塔洛斯在上，把这破纸拿开！

original: Oh, a new pamphlet from Dinya? I'll be glad to read it. Thanks.
traduit: 哦，丁雅新写的小册子吗？我很乐意读读。谢谢。

original: Huh? Oh. Sure, whatever. I prefer Dibella's teachings myself.
traduit: 嗯？哦。当然，不过我更喜欢遵从迪贝拉的教导。

original: Thank you. Umm, blessings upon you too.
traduit: 谢谢。嗯，也祝福你。

original: I wouldn't even clean my tail with this trash.
traduit: 拿这垃圾清理我尾巴我都嫌脏。

original: Unless Mara wishes to come down and help me with these urchins, I don't really give a damn about her blessings.
traduit: 除非玛拉愿意亲自下来帮我对付这些小坏蛋，否则就爱祝福谁祝福谁去吧。

original: Thank you. I'll share this with Aerin.
traduit: 谢谢。我会和艾灵一块分享的。

original: Hmmm. Never read anything from the temple before. I suppose there wouldn't be any harm in reading it.
traduit: 嗯。从没读过神殿的东西。读一下也没什么坏处。

original: Here, brother. Blessings of Mara upon you.
traduit: 给你，兄弟。愿玛拉祝福你。

original: What's this nonsense? Bah.
traduit: 这是什么胡说八道？呸。

original: I'll read it. Thank you.
traduit: 我会读的，谢谢。

original: I don't have time for this nonsense.
traduit: 我没时间听你胡扯。

original: Seems like a noble cause, I'll look it over.
traduit: 这是个高尚的事业，我会仔细看看的。

original: If only more people would read this, things might be better in Riften.
traduit: 如果有更多人读读这些，裂谷城的情况可能会更好。

original: I don't understand how paper will help the dregs of this city, but suit yourself.
traduit: 我不明白这张破纸怎么帮助整个城市的渣滓，但随你的便。

original: Do you take me for a fool? Get this drivel away from me!
traduit: 你当我是傻子？躲我远点！

original: Thank you. Blessings of Mara upon you as well.
traduit: 谢谢。也愿玛拉祝福你。

original: Interesting. I'll look it over. Thanks.
traduit: 有意思。我会读一遍的。谢谢。

original: I hold my own beliefs, but thanks anyway.
traduit: 我有自己的信仰，但还是谢谢你了。

original: Mara this and Mara that. Where is she when hundreds of Stormcloaks are dying for no good reason, eh?
traduit: 玛拉这，玛拉那。成百上千的风暴斗篷死得那么不值的时候她在哪儿呢？

original: Not really my usual read, but I'll give it a try.
traduit: 我通常不爱读书，但我会试试的。

original: Mara can't help me. No one can.
traduit: 玛拉帮不了我。没人能帮我。

original: Oh, interesting. I'll read it this evening.
traduit: 哦，有意思。我今晚会读的。

original: I have no desire to seek religion.
traduit: 我对信教没兴趣。

original: I visit the temple sometimes, but perhaps not often enough. Thanks for bringing this to me.
traduit: 我有时会去神殿，但可能不太频繁。谢谢你给我这个。

original: Thank you for the blessing, I'll put this to good use.
traduit: 谢谢你的祝福。我会好好看看的。

original: Oh, well thank you. I'll try and read this if I can.
traduit: 哦，谢谢你。我会试着读一下的。

original: I think I have some more of these padding my mattress.
traduit: 我想我的床垫下面还有些这个东西。

original: I have no time for Marla or Mara or whatever her name is... there's work to be done!
traduit: 我没时间听什么玛尔拉、玛拉，不管她叫什么了……我还要干活儿呢！

original: Had only Mara saved that poor animal...
traduit: 只有玛拉能救那可怜的动物……

original: I'll give it a try, thanks very much.
traduit: 我会试试看的，非常感谢。

original: Where did he acquire the knowledge to use it?
traduit: 他从哪获得这些知识？

original: Ironically, I pointed him in the same direction I pointed you. To Markarth and Calcelmo.
traduit: 讽刺的是，我给他指的方向和指给你的一样。马卡斯的卡塞莫。

original: I'm only hoping whatever means he used to learn the language will still be available to you.
traduit: 我只希望他学习语言的方法对你仍然有用。

original: Why did Gallus scribe his journal in Falmer?
traduit: 为什么加卢斯要用伐莫文写日记？

original: Besides the fact that there are only a handful of people in Tamriel that even recognize the language?
traduit: 大概是因为泰姆瑞尔只有少数人识得这种语言？

original: I'm fairly certain he was planning some sort of a heist that involved a deep understanding of the Falmer language.
traduit: 我很确定他在策划一场劫案，需要深入了解伐莫语。

original: Sadly, we never had the opportunity to speak about the details.
traduit: 很遗憾，我们再没有机会谈论细节。

original: How did you meet him?
traduit: 你是怎么认识他的？

original: Ah yes, quite an amusing anecdote actually. I caught him trying to break into my laboratory.
traduit: 啊对，说来确实有意思。我撞见他正企图闯进我的实验室。

original: I was about to show him the error of his ways when he made a curiously astute comment about my research notes.
traduit: 我正要把他逮住的时候，他对我的研究笔记提出了一个真知灼见。

original: I was astounded and in turn it lead to a conversation. Who'd have imagined it would lead to such a strong friendship?
traduit: 我很震惊，反而和他聊了起来。谁能想到就这么结下了如此深厚的交情呢？

original: He was an academic yet he chose a different path. Why?
traduit: 他既然是个学者，为什么会走上了一条不同的道路？

original: Well, for the thrill of course.
traduit: 当然是为了寻求刺激了。

original: He was quite clear that he felt more in his element climbing through a window rather than hunched over a dusty tome.
traduit: 他很清楚，比起弓着身子读那些满是灰尘的书，他更喜欢翻窗上梁。

original: What can you tell me about Gallus?
traduit: 你对加卢斯有什么了解？

original: He was a dear friend of mine and a surprisingly astute pupil of academia... I was devastated when he was killed.
traduit: 他是我的挚友，也是个聪明绝顶的学者。他被害的时候，我很伤心。

original: I suppose that risk always coexisted with his line of work, I just never thought his luck would run out.
traduit: 我知道他的工作是把脑袋拴在裤腰带上，只不过没料到他也会有气运耗尽的一天。

original: Remember, speak only to Enthir. Trust no one else.
traduit: 记住，只和恩希尔交谈。不要相信其他人。

original: If you have further need of me, you can find me in the College.
traduit: 如果你需要我的帮助，可以到学院找我。

original: Calcelmo is stubborn as a mule. Be careful when you speak to him.
traduit: 卡塞莫是头倔驴。跟他说话的时候要小心。

original: I hope you enjoy touring the museum. Just don't touch anything.
traduit: 希望你能享受博物馆之旅，但请不要碰任何东西。

original: Oh, be certain to purchase my Falmer translation tome when it's completed!
traduit: 哦，书出版以后记得买一本我的伐莫语翻译！

original: Now, stand aside, there's work to be done.
traduit: 现在，站到一旁，还有工作要做。

original: Try not to disturb me in the future, I'm in the midst of groundbreaking research!
traduit: 以后不要再来打扰我，我正在进行突破性研究！

original: Can't you come with me to Winterhold?
traduit: 你不和我一起去冬堡吗？

original: I'm afraid not. There are preparations to make and Gallus's remains to lay to rest.
traduit: 恐怕不行。还有准备工作要做，而且我想把加卢斯的遗体安葬好。

original: I promise to join you there as soon as I can.
traduit: 我保证尽快去和你会合。

original: I'll be right back.
traduit: 我回尽快回来的。

original: I certainly hope so. I don't know how long we can keep this up.
traduit: 希望如此吧。我不知道还能撑多久。

original: At least tell me where you're going, so we can send someone after you if you don't come back.
traduit: 至少告诉我你要去哪里，如果你不回来，我们也好派人去找你。

original: Why me?
traduit: 为什么是我？

original: I've got to stay here, to see if we can get to Ancano and stop this. I need someone I can trust to do it.
traduit: 我得留在这儿，看看能不能阻止安卡诺然后停下这一切。我需要有个信得过的人来办这件事。

original: Besides, you're the one having all of these visions, aren't you?
traduit: 再说，那些幻象都是你看到的，不是吗？

original: Winterhold is safe for now.
traduit: 冬堡暂时安全了。

original: Wish I could say the same for us.
traduit: 真希望我们也能说出同样的话。

original: Tolfdir and I can try and keep this contained. You need to get your hands on the Staff of Magnus. Now.
traduit: 托夫迪尔和我会试着控制局面。你得去拿玛格努斯之杖。现在就去。

original: It's coming loose. I can feel it.
traduit: 已经松了。我能感觉到。

original: Don't stop. Keep cutting.
traduit: 不要停。继续砍。

original: That's it. Keep hacking at it.
traduit: 就是这样。再加把劲。

original: I'll distribute them.
traduit: 我去分发。

original: Oh my, how wonderful! Lady Mara will be so pleased!
traduit: 哦，天呐，太好了！玛拉女神会很高兴的！

original: Here you are. Now make sure you give out every single one, we can't afford to let even one lost soul stray from Her warmth.
traduit: 给你。确保每一份都发出去，我们不能让任何一个迷失的灵魂离开她的温暖。

original: Does the temple need any additional assistance?
traduit: 神殿需要额外的援助吗？

original: Riften is drowning in a sea of sin and wickedness and it's my personal mission to let everyone know that the warmth of Mara can see them through.
traduit: 裂谷城正淹没在罪孽和邪恶的海洋中，而我个人的使命就是让大家知道玛拉的温暖，帮助他们渡过难关。

original: All I need is a messenger to bring Her words to these poor souls by distributing these missives.
traduit: 我需要一个信使把她的话语传递给这些可怜的灵魂。

original: I have deathbell for you.
traduit: 我把丧钟花给你带来了。

original: Good, my experiments are at a critical stage and these are just what I need to finish. Here's some coin for all the trouble.
traduit: 好，我的实验正在关键阶段，我正需要这些来完成呢。这些钱给你，麻烦你了。

original: I have nightshade for you.
traduit: 我把夜影花给你带来了。

original: Perfect. This is just what I needed. Here's some gold for your time.
traduit: 完美。我正需要这个呢。这些钱给你，麻烦了。

original: I have nirnroot for you.
traduit: 我把奈恩根给你带来了。

original: Ah yes, excellent samples. Thank you. This coin should compensate you for all the bother.
traduit: 啊，非常好的样品。谢谢。这些钱应该能补偿你的麻烦。

original: He gave me this keg to deliver.
traduit: 他让我把这桶酒送出去。

original: That fetcher! I gave him the same keg just this morning and told him to store it in the cellars.
traduit: 那个费彻！我今早还给了他一桶，叫他放在地窖里。

original: Oh, he'll rot in prison for this one I promise you. As soon as Maven finds out, it's all over for him.
traduit: 哦，我向你保证他会烂在监狱里的。一旦玛雯知道，他就完了。

original: Here, take this as a bit of a reward for nabbing our little thief.
traduit: 给，这是你抓到小偷的奖励。

original: Did you know Romlyn is skimming from the meadery?
traduit: 你知不知道洛姆林在偷酒庄的东西？

original: Aye, I suspected as much but I've never been able to catch that little sneak with proof.
traduit: 是啊，我也这么怀疑，但我一直没能抓到那个混蛋。

original: Thieves and temples. It just doesn't add up.
traduit: 盗贼和神殿。根本说不通啊。

original: I felt the same way when Gallus first revealed these things to me.
traduit: 加卢斯第一次和我透露时，我也这么觉得。

original: I think given time, you'll understand what I mean.
traduit: 给你一段时间，就能明白我的意思了。

original: Very well, we do it your way for now.
traduit: 很好，就按你说的做吧。

original: I'll make for Riften and scout the situation; see if I can discover what Mercer's up to. When you're ready, meet me at the Ragged Flagon.
traduit: 我先去裂谷城侦察一下情况，看看能不能查出墨瑟在搞什么鬼。等你准备好了，就去漏壶那找我。

original: In the meantime, I wanted you to have this. It belonged to Gallus, but given the circumstances I think he'd approve.
traduit: 还有，我想把这个给你。这是加卢斯的遗物，但此情此景，我想他会同意的。

original: Why does it require that type of protection?
traduit: 为什么需要这样的保护？

original: Everything that represents Nocturnal's influence is contained within the walls of the Sepulcher.
traduit: 一切代表诺克图娜尔影响的东西，都在坟墓的墙壁上。

original: Now it seems Mercer's broken his oath with Nocturnal and defiled the very thing he swore to protect.
traduit: 现在看来，墨瑟违背了他对诺克图娜尔的誓言，玷污了他誓要保护的东西。

original: Gallus's journal mentioned the "Twilight Sepulcher."
traduit: 加卢斯在日记里提到了“黄昏坟墓”。

original: You've come this far, so I see no harm in concealing it any longer.
traduit: 到了这个地步，我看再瞒下去也没用了。

original: The Twilight Sepulcher is the temple to Nocturnal. It's what the Nightingales are sworn to protect with their lives.
traduit: 黄昏坟墓是诺克图娜尔的神殿。是夜莺立誓用生命保护的地方。

original: We must hasten to Riften before Mercer can do any more damage to the Guild.
traduit: 我们必须赶在墨瑟对公会造成更大伤害前赶回裂谷城。

original: I have a delivery from Romlyn.
traduit: 洛姆林让我送些东西来。

original: All right, pipe down. You want the whole blessed place to hear you?
traduit: 好了，小点声。你想让所有人都听见吗？

original: The arrangement called for a trade. I hope you'll find this suitable.
traduit: 这交易讲究一次付清。希望你觉得价钱合适。

original: What kind of delivery?
traduit: 怎么运送？

original: I need someone to take this small keg of Black-Briar Mead to Wilhelm at the Vilemyr Inn in Ivarstead.
traduit: 我需要有人把这一小桶黑棘蜜酒送到伊瓦尔镇的烂醉如泥旅店的威尔海姆那儿。

original: Drop it off and he'll trade you something for the delivery. Keep it as payment for the legwork.
traduit: 把它放在那儿，他会给你些东西。留着做跑腿费吧。

original: Oh, and if you bump into Indaryn from the meadery, keep your mouth shut. He'd rat us out in a second.
traduit: 哦，如果你在蜜酒庄碰见印达林，千万把嘴管好。他会马上出卖咱们的。

original: You're selling cheap mead?
traduit: 你在卖廉价蜜酒？

original: No, no friend. You've got it all wrong. I'm not selling cheap mead. I'm selling good mead for cheap... Black-Briar Mead.
traduit: 不，不，朋友。你错了。我卖的不是廉价蜜酒，是物美价廉的蜜酒……黑棘牌儿的。

original: I sell cases of it for half of what the inns and taverns pay through the Meadery.
traduit: 我成箱成箱地卖，价钱是蜜酒庄卖给酒馆客栈的一半。

original: All I need is someone to deliver it for me. If anyone saw me leave Riften, they'd get suspicious.
traduit: 我只需要有人帮我送出去。如果有人看到我离开裂谷城，会起疑心的。

original: She's made her way east into Morrowind.
traduit: 她向东跑去晨风了。

original: So, the whore thinks the Black-Briar reach ends at the border of Skyrim, eh? She'll soon discover her mistake.
traduit: 那个婊子以为黑棘的手只能伸到天际边境吗？她很快就会发现自己想错了。

original: She's in Ivarstead using the name Lynly.
traduit: 她用“林立”这个假名在伊瓦尔镇躲着。

original: Ivarstead? So close to Riften? She's an even bigger fool than I thought.
traduit: 伊瓦尔镇？离裂谷城这么近？她比我想的还要蠢。

original: I have some information about Svidi.
traduit: 我有关于丝薇蒂的消息了。

original: Good, good. Just point me in the right direction and I'll do the rest.
traduit: 好，好。只要告诉我位置就行。剩下的我来办。

original: You have nothing to fear from me. (Persuade)
traduit: 你不用怕我的。（说服）

original: I'm sorry, I don't know what you're talking about.
traduit: 抱歉，我不知道你在说什么。

original: Your real name is Svidi, isn't it?
traduit: 你的真名是丝薇蒂吧？

original: No, I'm sorry. You must have me mistaken for someone else. I've never even heard that name before.
traduit: 不，抱歉。你一定是把我认错成什么人了。我从没听过这个名字。

original: So you got arrested for his murder?
traduit: 所以你就因为杀他被捕了？

original: Exactly! And now I have to stare at these bars for eight months. Can you believe it?
traduit: 没错！现在我得盯着这些栏杆看八个月。你能相信？

original: I was about to let that wench marry into the richest family in Riften, and this is how she repays me.
traduit: 我正要让那丫头嫁进裂谷城最有钱的人家，她就是这样报答我的。

original: I'd do anything to have that whore's head on a platter. All I need to know is where she is.
traduit: 只要能把那婊子的脑袋放在盘子里，我愿意做任何事。我只需要知道她在哪里。

original: Why are you in jail?
traduit: 你为什么在监狱里？

original: Look, we all have our flaws; mine is that women can't get enough of me.
traduit: 听着，我们都有自己的小毛病，我的毛病就是所有女人都对我爱的不行。

original: So I had this little affair going on while I was betrothed to a beautiful girl named Svidi.
traduit: 我和一个叫丝薇蒂的姑娘订婚时发生过一段小小的婚外情。

original: Well, she finds out and she tells her brother, Wulfur. Then her brother attacks me with a knife... I mean, I had to defend myself!
traduit: 然后她发现了，告诉她哥哥乌尔富尔。她哥就拿刀攻击我……我是，正当防卫！

original: I've killed Nimhe.
traduit: 尼姆赫被我杀了。

original: You have my gratitude. That spider had been interfering with my excavations for months.
traduit: 多谢了。那只蜘蛛干扰我发掘工作几个月了。

original: As promised, here's the key to the Dwemer Museum. Mind the displays. Some of them are quite fragile.
traduit: 这是咱们讲好的，锻莫博物馆钥匙。看展览的时候注意点。有些东西可是很脆弱的。

original: Not interested.
traduit: 没兴趣。

original: Oh, very well. Probably safest that way.
traduit: 哦，很好。可能这样最安全。

original: That spider is as good as dead.
traduit: 那蜘蛛死定了。

original: Enthusiasm. Good. Here's the key to the dig site.
traduit: 很有热情。好。这是挖掘场的钥匙。

original: I'll let you in if you agree to something for me. There's a giant spider in Nchuand-Zel. My workers call her "Nimhe," the poisoned one.
traduit: 如果你同意帮我个忙，我可以让你进去。在尼楚安德-泽尔有只大蜘蛛，我的工人管它叫“毒物尼姆赫”。

original: If you deal with Nimhe, I'll let you into both the excavation site and my Dwemer Museum. What do you say?
traduit: 如果你能对付尼姆赫，我就让你进我的挖掘现场和锻莫博物馆。怎么样？

original: I'd like to see the excavation site.
traduit: 我想看看挖掘现场。

original: Correct. It's a private place where I can catalog my research. Occasionally, the Jarl will come in and have questions, but that's thankfully rare.
traduit: 没错。那是私人地方，我可以用来把我的研究归类。领主偶尔会去问一些问题，但谢天谢地，这种情况不多见。

original: A guard said you own the Dwemer Museum.
traduit: 卫兵说锻莫博物馆是你的。

original: Persistent aren't you? Oh, very well. Who am I to stand in the way of curiosity?
traduit: 这么坚持的吗？哦，很好。我怎么能阻拦好奇心呢？

original: Dwemer Museum?
traduit: 锻莫博物馆？

original: It means "Dwarven Museum." Lost race of people that built the city.
traduit: 也就是“矮人博物馆”，建造这个城市的遗失种族。

original: You want to know more? Ask Calcelmo. He's usually in front of the ruins, just down the tunnel.
traduit: 你想了解更多吗？去问卡塞莫吧。他一般会在遗迹的前面，就在隧道下边。

original: Who's the court wizard?
traduit: 谁是宫廷巫师？

original: Calcelmo. He's the Jarl's magical advisor, but he spends most of his time studying the ruins.
traduit: 卡塞莫。他是领主的魔法顾问，但他大部分时间都在研究遗迹。

original: If you want in, Calcelmo has to give his say-so. He's usually in front of Nchuand-Zel. Just down the tunnel.
traduit: 如果你想进去，必须征得卡塞莫同意。他一般会在尼楚安德-泽尔遗迹前面，就在隧道下边。

original: Why can't I go in?
traduit: 我为什么不能进？

original: Because Calcelmo doesn't want anyone to go in. He runs the museum, he makes the rules.
traduit: 因为卡塞莫不想让任何人进去。博物馆是他的，规矩也得由他定。

original: You have a problem with that? Go talk to him. You'll find him in front of the ruins during the day. Just down the tunnel.
traduit: 你有意见？那就去找他吧。他白天都会在遗迹前。就在隧道下边。

original: Halt. The Dwemer Museum isn't open to anyone without the court wizard's permission.
traduit: 停下。没有宫廷巫师的允许，锻莫博物馆不向任何人开放。

original: Margret!
traduit: 玛格丽特！

original: Guards! Forsworn!
traduit: 卫兵！有弃誓者！

original: Gods, not again....
traduit: 神啊，不要再……

original: Head on in. Keep your nose clean, and you won't have any problems with us.
traduit: 进来吧。只要别惹事，我们也不会找你麻烦。

original: I just need some supplies and a drink.
traduit: 我只是需要些补给和酒水。

original: You're our favorite kind of traveler, then. The market area is just inside in the gate.
traduit: 就喜欢你这样的旅行者。市场就在大门里。

original: Jarl Igmund sits on the Mournful Throne. You can find him in the keep, in the back end of the city inside the mountain.
traduit: 领主依格蒙德高居哀伤宝座。你可以到要塞里见他，就在城市后面的山里。

original: Is there some problem in the city?
traduit: 这城市有什么麻烦吗？

original: See, there you go. Getting involved. Don't ask too many questions in Markarth. Safer for everyone that way.
traduit: 听着，进去吧。不要惹麻烦。在马卡斯别问太多问题。这样对大家都更安全。

original: First time in Markarth, traveler? Take my advice. You see anything, don't get involved. The city guard will take care of it.
traduit: 第一次来马卡斯吗，旅行者？听我一句劝。看见什么都不要插手。城里的卫兵会处理的。

original: I don't want that job.
traduit: 我不想接这份工作。

original: I'll take that job.
traduit: 这工作我接了。

original: It seems that a predator has invaded their home, and someone needs to clear the beast out.
traduit: 似乎有猎食者入侵了他们家，需要有人把那畜生清理出去。

original: A citizen of the Reach has asked for our help.
traduit: 有位瑞驰领的公民向我们求助。

original: A citizen of Haafingar has asked for our help.
traduit: 有位海芬加领的公民向我们求助。

original: A citizen of Hjaalmarch has asked for our help.
traduit: 有位希雅陲领的公民向我们求助。

original: A citizen of Falkreath has asked for our help.
traduit: 有位佛克瑞斯领的公民向我们求助。

original: A citizen of Whiterun has asked for our help.
traduit: 有位白漫领的公民向我们求助。

original: A citizen of the Pale has asked for our help.
traduit: 有位苍原领的公民向我们求助。

original: A citizen of the Rift has asked for our help.
traduit: 有位裂痕领的公民向我们求助。

original: A citizen of Eastmarch has asked for our help.
traduit: 有位东陲领的公民向我们求助。

original: A citizen of Winterhold has asked for our help.
traduit: 有位冬堡领的公民向我们求助。

original: A citizen of Skyrim has asked for our help.
traduit: 有位天际的公民向我们求助。

original: Even after everything I did for you and Faleen?
traduit: 即使我为你和法琳做了这么多？

original: Well, I'm not blind to the fact that you've been instrumental in improving my affairs of the heart.
traduit: 嗯，我也知道你在我的感情问题上出了很大的力。

original: If you wish, you may enter my tower to view the museum section, but I'm afraid the laboratories are still off limits.
traduit: 如果你愿意，你可以进我的塔楼里参观博物馆区域，但恐怕还是不能进入实验室。

original: That's the best I can offer.
traduit: 这是我能提供的最大限度了。

original: I've already provided you a key to the museum. You should consider it an honor. Few are allowed to browse my collection.
traduit: 我已经把博物馆的钥匙给了你。你应该把这视为荣誉。很少有人能参观我的藏品。

original: I'm sorry, but that's as far as my generosity extends.
traduit: 抱歉，我的慷慨也仅限于此了。

original: Even after slaying your troublesome spider?
traduit: 即使我帮你干掉了那只恶心的蜘蛛？

original: He sacked it and used magic to blame Solitude.
traduit: 他将那里洗劫一空，然后用魔法嫁祸独孤城。

original: That sounds good. I'm not sure the court will believe that Olaf had wizard powers but we shall see.
traduit: 听起来不错。虽然不确定宫廷会不会相信奥拉夫拥有什么巫术力量，但可以试试看。

original: You're leaving? Okay, we'll just work on the verse in a bit.
traduit: 你打算离开？好吧，我们先把歌词改一改。

original: Olaf sacked it in dragon form! (Persuade)
traduit: 奥拉夫以巨龙的样子洗劫了它！（说服）

original: Oh that is exciting! I'm sure the court and the Jarl will love it. I'm writing it in now.
traduit: 哦，太刺激了！领主和宫廷成员会喜欢的。我现在就写上。

original: No, that's pushing it too far. Very exciting but highly unlikely, I can't possibly write that in.
traduit: 不，这太过分了。虽然很刺激，但不足信，我不能这么写。

original: It's not the most exciting answer but the most likely. I'll write it in.
traduit: 虽然很平淡，但也是最有可能的答案了。我这就写上。

original: He convinced Solitude to attack Winterhold.
traduit: 他说服了独孤城进攻冬堡。

original: Olaf was Numinex. A dragon in human form! (Persuade)
traduit: 奥拉夫就是怒米奈科斯。一条人形的龙！（说服）

original: I find that highly unlikely... but the court will love it. I'm writing it in.
traduit: 我觉得不大可能……但宫廷会喜欢的。我这就写上。

original: I find that highly unlikely... I think it would be irresponsible to write that in to the verse.
traduit: 我觉得不大可能……这么写是不负责任的。

original: Olaf was Numinex. A dragon in human form!
traduit: 奥拉夫就是怒米奈科斯。一头披着人皮的龙！

original: Hmmm, Olaf did become king and Numinex escaped later. It's entirely possible... and I'm sure the court will like that, I'm writing it in.
traduit: 嗯，奥拉夫确实成了国王，怒米奈科斯后来逃跑了。完全有可能……宫廷会喜欢的，我这就写进去。

original: Olaf made a deal with Numinex.
traduit: 奥拉夫与怒米奈科斯做了交易。

original: I think they like you.
traduit: 我想他们会喜欢你的。

original: Does that mean I'm a Bard now?
traduit: 那我现在是吟游诗人了？

original: Soon, soon. These things must be done properly, you will be inducted as part of the Festival itself.
traduit: 快了，快了。这些事情必须做得更完美，你将成为节日的一部分。

original: I need you to go speak to Jorn. He was preparing the Effigy of King Olaf.
traduit: 你去跟乔恩谈谈。他正在准备奥拉夫王的肖像。

original: Tell him to finish the preparations, the Festival is back on.
traduit: 告诉他赶紧准备好，节日又要开始了。

original: Unbelievable! You have done us a great service here. I can't begin to thank you enough.
traduit: 难以置信！你帮了我们大忙了。我不知道该怎么感谢你才好。

original: Thank you yet again. I will make sure our applicant, who was instrumental in... recovering the poem will be well rewarded.
traduit: 再次感谢您。我保证我们的申请人会因为……取回这首诗歌而得到丰厚的回报。

original: Furthermore, I believe that such a fine poem deserves some payment of Patronage. The college will be moderately rewarded.
traduit: 另外，我觉得这样一首好诗应该得到赞助。学院会得到适当的奖赏。

original: Furthermore, I believe that such a fine poem deserves some payment of Patronage. The college will be generously rewarded.
traduit: 另外，我觉得这样一首好诗应该得到赞助。学院会得到丰厚的奖赏。

original: Furthermore, I believe that such a fine poem deserves some payment of Patronage. The college will be very generously rewarded.
traduit: 另外，我觉得这样一首好诗应该得到赞助。学院会得到十分丰厚的奖赏。

original: You have proven your point, Viarmo.  The festival is truly a celebration of Solitude and a condemnation of false kings.
traduit: 你已经证明了你的观点，维阿墨。这个节日确实是独孤城的庆典和对伪王们的谴责。

original: I thank you and the college thanks you, Jarl.
traduit: 我代表学院向您表示感谢，领主。

original: "So ends the story of Olaf the liar, a thief and a scoundrel we of Solitude commit to the fire."
traduit: “奥拉夫的故事就此告终，欺世盗名的窃国刁棍，我们独孤的子民将他扔到火里焚烧殆尽。”

original: "In Solitude bards train for their service, they also gather each year and burn a King who deserves it."
traduit: “独孤城的吟游诗人训练有素，他们年年聚会，火烧一位罪有应得的王。”

original: "Olaf gave orders, Winterhold disguises. An attack on Solitude total destruction to follow."
traduit: “奥拉夫下达了命令，换上了冬堡的旗号。独孤城的彻底毁灭旋踵而至。”

original: "His men dressed up and then went out to fight, but they reversed Olaf's orders much to Winterhold's sorrow."
traduit: “他的部下整装上阵，却颠倒了奥拉夫的命令，致使冬堡追悔莫及。”

original: "Olaf sent word to Solitude's Jarl, cajoling and mocking and begging for a fight."
traduit: “奥拉夫传信于独孤领主，几近嘲弄哄骗，企图与其一战。”

original: "From Winterhold Olaf had sent every message, upon attack he was nowhere in sight."
traduit: “奥拉夫从冬堡发出消息，但一遇攻击就消失的无影无踪。”

original: "Because Solitude would not soon bend knee, Olaf would hurt them while his status accrued."
traduit: “独孤城不愿迅速屈服，奥拉夫决定在他更上一层的时候施以报复。”

original: "He sacked Winterhold his only true ally, and used magic bold to blame Solitude."
traduit: “他洗劫了自己唯一的盟友冬堡城，并大胆地用魔法嫁祸独孤城。”

original: "He sacked Winterhold in dragon form, and bent their minds to blame Solitude."
traduit: “他以巨龙之姿洗劫冬堡，并嫁祸独孤城。”

original: "No shouting match between dragon and man, no fire or fury did this battle entail."
traduit: “人类与龙族之间并无嫌隙，战火未燃，仇恨未结。”

original: "Olaf captured a fast-sleeping dragon, a mighty feat which the meek would not fail."
traduit: “奥拉夫捕获了一只沉睡的巨龙，乘龙之危的壮举稳胜不败。”

original: "Olaf struck a deal to make himself king, Numinex let go though none tell that tale."
traduit: “奥拉夫为了成为王，与怒米奈科斯达成了协议，巨龙放弃了抵抗，但无人知晓这个故事。”

original: "Olaf was Numinex in human form, on moonless nights he would spread wings and sail."
traduit: “奥拉夫即是怒米奈科斯幻化的人形，在无月之夜，他就会张开双翼翱翔。”

original: Is that it?
traduit: 就这些了吗？

original: It has a few final lines but that's all we needed to add. I need to head to court immediately and present this. You should come.
traduit: 最后还剩几句话，但需要咱们补充的就这些了。我马上就到宫廷把诗呈上去。你应该跟我一起来。

original: That was a close one!
traduit: 好险啊！

original: And they got the orders backwards. Ha ha ha.  Yes, I'm writing that in.  It should be good for a laugh from the court.
traduit: 然后他们把命令弄反了。哈哈哈。好，我这就写上。应该能逗宫廷的人一笑。

original: Olaf ordered disguised troops to attack Solitude?
traduit: 奥拉夫命令一支伪装部队去攻打独孤城？

original: Okay, what's next?
traduit: 好，接下来呢？

original: Ha! All right, I'm writing that in. I'm not sure about the court but I find that much more probable than Olaf capturing a dragon.
traduit: 哈！很好，我这就写。我不太清楚宫廷会怎么看，但我觉得这比奥拉夫捉龙要现实得多。

original: Olaf found him asleep.
traduit: 奥拉夫发现他睡着了。

original: We can do this. What's the first verse?
traduit: 我们可以试试。第一段是什么？

original: Can't we just make up missing parts of the verse?
traduit: 我们就不能把缺了的补上吗？

original: Make it up? That doesn't seem appropriate...
traduit: 补上？似乎不合适吧……

original: I suppose I could copy his style based on what you brought me but I have no idea what happened in between these verses.
traduit: 我应该可以按照你给我的残本，模仿他的风格，但我不知道这些句子之间发生了什么。

original: It means I can't read it to the court. Without the verse I won't be able to convince Elisif of the importance of The Burning of King Olaf Festival.
traduit: 意思就是我没法在宫廷上吟诵。没有这首诗，我就没法说服艾利西弗相信火烧奥拉夫节有多重要。

original: If she isn't convinced of the festival's importance then she won't reverse her decision to stop the effigy burning.
traduit: 如果她不信这个节日很重要的话，就不可能撤销停止焚烧肖像的决定。

original: It means that the Burning of King Olaf, which the Bards College has held for time immemorial, won't be happening.
traduit: 也就意味着，吟游诗人学院自古以来举办的火烧奥拉夫王活动就不能再重现了。

original: I found King Olaf's Verse.
traduit: 我找到了奥拉夫王之诗。

original: I have to admit I didn't think it would actually be there.  Now let's take a look at this...
traduit: 我得承认，我都没想过它真的会在那里。现在来看看吧……

original: Oh. Oh-no. This won't do at all.
traduit: 哦。哦不。这根本行不通。

original: The copy is incomplete, it's aged to the point that parts are unreadable.
traduit: 副本根本不完整，已经老朽到不能识读了。

original: And the parts that are readable... well... bardic verse has come a long way since ancient times.
traduit: 而那些可读的部分……哎……吟游诗歌自古以来发展的足够长远了。

original: Ah wonderful, I knew it would be. This is a significant find.
traduit: 太好了，我就知道是这样。这是个重要的发现。

original: I'll let Viarmo take possession but I will be looking forward to adding this to our library. Good work.
traduit: 我会让维阿墨接手的，但我很期待把它添加到我们的图书馆里。干得漂亮。

original: King Olaf's Verse was right where you said it would be.
traduit: 奥拉夫王之诗就在你说的那里。

original: That's tremendous! I have to admit I didn't fully believe it still existed. Now let's take a look at this...
traduit: 太震撼了！我得承认，当时我也不全信它还存在。现在来看看吧……

original: Oh. Oh-no. This won't do at all. The copy is incomplete, it's aged to the point that parts are unreadable.
traduit: 哦。哦不。这根本行不通。副本根本不完整，已经老朽到不能识读了。

original: I've been to the tomb. I have Olaf's Verse.
traduit: 我去了陵墓并找到了奥拉夫之诗。

original: I knew it was at the Dead Man's Respite.
traduit: 我就知道是在亡者之栖。

original: I've already been to the tomb. I have Olaf's Verse.
traduit: 我已经去过陵墓，我这有奥拉夫之诗。

original: What do you need me to do?
traduit: 你需要我做什么？

original: Elisif has forbidden the Burning of King Olaf, a Festival put on by the Bards College. We need to change her mind.
traduit: 艾利西弗禁止吟游诗人学院举办火烧奥拉夫王的节日。我们得想办法让她回心转意。

original: To convince her I want to read King Olaf's Verse. A part of the Poetic Edda, the living history of Skyrim. Unfortunately the verse was lost long ago.
traduit: 我想给她读《奥拉夫王之诗》来说服她。那是天际最鲜活的历史——《诗歌埃达》的一部分。可惜，那首诗遗失很久了。

original: Why did Elisif forbid the festival?
traduit: 艾利西弗为什么禁止这个节日？

original: As you may be aware Elisif's husband High King Torygg was recently killed.
traduit: 你应该知道，艾利西弗的丈夫，至高王托依格最近被害了。

original: Elisif mourns her husband deeply and she feels that a festival that burns a King in effigy is... distasteful.
traduit: 艾利西弗深深地悼念亡夫，觉得火烧国王肖像的节日……令人反感。

original: I've tried to convince her the festival is many centuries old and celebrates Solitude but I need proof.
traduit: 我试着劝说她这个节日是独孤城延续多年的传统庆典，但我还需要证据。

original: I believe King Olaf's verse will provide that proof.
traduit: 我相信奥拉夫王的诗歌可以证明这一点。

original: I'm looking to apply to the college.
traduit: 我想申请加入学院。

original: Always a pleasure to meet a prospective bard.
traduit: 很高兴能见到一位未来的吟游诗人。

original: You should be aware that many apply but we accept very few people.
traduit: 你应该知道，申请者虽众，但我们录取的很少。

original: When possible, we ask applicants to perform tasks the college needs completed. In this case, I do have a task befitting an aspiring bard...
traduit: 在可能的情况下，我们会要求申请人完成学院下达的任务。现在我确实有一个适合有抱负的吟游诗人去完成的任务……

original: What do you do around here?
traduit: 你在这里是做什么的？

original: It is. We train the bards you hear throughout the land. Viarmo is the head of the college and in charge of admissions.
traduit: 没错。你在各地见过的吟游诗人都是我们这里训练的。维阿墨是学院院长，负责招生工作。

original: So this is the Bards College?
traduit: 这里就是吟游诗人学院？

original: Only in that I'm a graduate. I work at here at the Winking Skeever. I would highly recommend it though. Talk to Viarmo if you're interested.
traduit: 我是毕业生。在眨眼恶鼠工作。如果你感兴趣，我强烈推荐你去找维阿墨谈谈。

original: So you're a member of the Bards College?
traduit: 你是吟游诗人学院成员？

original: Only in that I'm a graduate. I work over at the Winking Skeever. I would highly recommend it though. Talk to Viarmo if you're interested.
traduit: 我是毕业生。在眨眼恶鼠工作。如果你感兴趣，我强烈推荐你去找维阿墨谈谈。

original: I'm a bard, trained at the Bards College in Solitude. Wanderers like you should think about applying.
traduit: 我是在独孤城吟游诗人学院接受的训练。像你这样的漫游者应该去申请试试。

original: I'm a bard, from the Bards College here in Solitude. Wanderers like you should think about applying.
traduit: 我来自独孤城吟游诗人学院的吟游诗人。像你这样的漫游者应该去申请试试。

original: At the Bards College in Solitude. They train bards and skalds like myself.
traduit: 在独孤城的吟游诗人学院。像我这样的吟游诗人都是在那里训练的。

original: If you go there, talk to Viarmo. He's the headmaster.
traduit: 如果想去那里的话，就找维阿墨谈谈吧。他是那里的院长。

original: Where did you learn to play so well?
traduit: 你是从哪儿学到这么好的表演？

original: Karliah, when will you learn you can't get the drop on me?
traduit: 卡莱亚，你何时才能明白自己根本没法制住我？

original: Climb down that ledge and see if you can...
traduit: 从台子上爬下去，看看你能不能……

original: Aye, lass. Nothing's getting by me.
traduit: 好的，姑娘。没人能从我这儿过去。

original: He's here and he hasn't seen us yet. Brynjolf, watch the door.
traduit: 他在这儿，还没有看见我们。布林乔夫，把门守好。

original: The <Alias=Beast> is dead.
traduit: <Alias=Beast>死了。

original: Good work. A simple job, but it keeps the coin rolling in. Here's your share.
traduit: 干得好。工作虽然简单，但是却能让资金滚滚而来。这是你那份儿。

original: I'm sure that the owner of that place is relieved. They certainly came through with the coin.
traduit: 我敢肯定那地方的主人算是松口气了。他们把钱给我了。

original: Well done. Here's your gold.
traduit: 干得好。这是你的金币。

original: How do I fit in?
traduit: 我要怎么混进去？

original: You're going to happen by and lend poor old Sabjorn a helping hand.
traduit: 你只需顺道帮一下可怜的撒布乔恩。

original: He's going to give you the poison to use on the pests, but you're also going to dump it into the brewing vat.
traduit: 他会给你用来对付害虫的毒药，但你也要把它倒进酿酒桶里。

original: Go. Out. Before I change my mind.
traduit: 在我改主意前赶紧出去。

original: I can't help you right now.
traduit: 我现在帮不了你。

original: What? Why? But... you must have said something to Erikur! You lied to him and now here I am! You're a heartless monster!
traduit: 什么？为什么？你……你一定和艾瑞库尔说了什么！是你骗了他，我才被关在这儿！你这个没心肝的禽兽！

original: No... please, you have to help me! You don't understand what they do to people here!
traduit: 不……求你了，请你救救我！你不知道他们会对这里的囚犯干些什么！

original: Come on, you'd better get out of here. (Free her)
traduit: 来吧，你得离开这儿。（释放她）

original: Oh... thank you. I don't understand what's happening. I can't stay here. What will I do now?
traduit: 哦……谢谢你。我不知道发生了什么。我不能待在这儿了。现在该怎么办？

original: What did you tell him? Why did you do this to me?
traduit: 你跟他说了什么？你为什么这么对我？

original: You've got to help me! Please!
traduit: 你得帮帮我！求你了！

original: I don't know where I'll go. Somewhere far away from here.
traduit: 我不知道我该去哪儿，但我必须远离这儿。

original: Maybe this is a way out?
traduit: 这里也许是条出路？

original: Maybe one of the guards had a key?
traduit: 某个卫兵或许会有钥匙？

original: There's got to be some way out of here!
traduit: 一定有办法能出去！

original: You must be new. We don't talk to each other here.
traduit: 你一定是新来的吧。我们彼此不在这儿交谈。

original: You here to see Rulindil, too, eh? None of my business of course.
traduit: 你也是来找鲁林迪尔的？不过也不关我事。

original: Push off, will you?
traduit: 请走开好吗？

original: I'm looking for a Khajiit... might be a Thalmor spy.
traduit: 我在找一个卡吉特……可能是个梭默间谍。

original: Ah. You must mean that one over there. He's not one of us.
traduit: 啊，你说的是那边那个吧。他不是我们的人。

original: Thalmor filth, eh? Giving all Khajiit a bad name.
traduit: 梭默杂碎？真给卡吉特丢脸。

original: I'd rather not take that job.
traduit: 我还是不接这工作了。

original: I'll take care of it.
traduit: 我来搞定。

original: It seems that predators have taken up residence and have been attacking farmers and travelers.
traduit: 似乎是有捕食者在那边筑巢了，而且在攻击农民和路人。

original: Someone's got to head out there and take care of the beasts.
traduit: 总得有人去搞定这些野兽啊。

original: The Jarl of the Reach has asked for our help.
traduit: 瑞驰领主向我们请求帮助。

original: The Jarl of Haafingar has asked for our help.
traduit: 海芬加领主向我们请求帮助。

original: The Jarl of Hjaalmarch has asked for our help.
traduit: 希雅陲领主向我们请求帮助。

original: The Jarl of Falkreath has asked for our help.
traduit: 佛克瑞斯领主向我们请求帮助。

original: The Jarl of Whiterun has asked for our help.
traduit: 白漫领主向我们请求帮助。

original: The Jarl of the Pale has asked for our help.
traduit: 苍原领主向我们请求帮助。

original: The Jarl of the Rift has asked for our help.
traduit: 裂痕领主向我们请求帮助。

original: The Jarl of Eastmarch has asked for our help.
traduit: 东陲领主向我们请求帮助。

original: The Jarl of Winterhold has asked for our help.
traduit: 冬堡领主向我们请求帮助。

original: One of the Jarls has asked for our help.
traduit: 有位领主向我们求助。

original: Must have taken a fortune to get started.
traduit: 一开始肯定投了不少钱吧。

original: Well... yes. I mean, all of the gold didn't come from me. I have a silent partner that helped with the finances.
traduit: 嗯……没错。我是说，并不是全部资金都由我来出。我有个秘密合伙人，帮我解决财务问题。

original: You mentioned someone named Mallus?
traduit: 你提到了莫鲁斯？

original: Mallus is the best deal I've ever made. Lent him a bit of gold some time ago I knew he'd never be able to pay back.
traduit: 莫鲁斯是我做成的最好的一笔交易。我知道他永远也还不起钱。

original: Nothing like free labor to make operating costs cheaper.
traduit: 没有什么比免费劳力更能降低运营成本了。

original: Is something wrong?
traduit: 有什么问题吗？

original: Are you kidding me? Look at this place.
traduit: 你在和我开玩笑？看看这里吧。

original: I'm supposed to be holding a tasting of the new Honningbrew Reserve for the Captain of the Guard.
traduit: 我要为卫兵队长举办一场蜜之酿珍藏酒的品尝会。

original: If he sees the meadery in this state, I'll be ruined.
traduit: 要是他看到酒庄这副德行，我就完了。

original: Why bother poisoning the nest for Sabjorn?
traduit: 为什么要帮撒布乔恩往巢里下毒？

original: Once Sabjorn is out of the way, Maven has plans for this place. One way or another, we don't want the pests coming back.
traduit: 一旦撒布乔恩滚蛋，玛雯就会计划接管这里。不管怎样，我们都不希望害虫卷土重来吧。

original: Consider it just more of the dirty work. I did my part getting them in there, now you need to clear them out.
traduit: 就当是更脏的活吧。我把它们弄进去，现在还得你把它们清出来。

original: Remember to put in a good word with Maven for me.
traduit: 记得帮我向玛雯美言几句。

original: I love it when a plan comes together.
traduit: 我喜欢看着计划慢慢成形。

original: Remember, Sabjorn will be needing a helping hand. Make it look good.
traduit: 记着，撒布乔恩需要帮助。要装的像一点。

original: Good luck. I'll be here if you need me.
traduit: 祝你好运。如果你需要帮助，就来我这儿。

original: Please hurry. The Captain of the Guard isn't patient when it comes to tasting time.
traduit: 请快点。一旦到了品酒时间，卫兵队长就没有耐心了。

original: Now I've got to clean up this mess.
traduit: 我现在得收拾这个烂摊子了。

original: Remember, you don't get paid until they're all dead.
traduit: 记住，得把害虫都杀了才能拿到钱。

original: One more time in case I wasn't clear. You butcher this job and you'll be sorry.
traduit: 再说一遍，以免有没说清的地方。如果敢毁了这份工作，你会后悔的。

original: How do I get to the brewing vats?
traduit: 我怎么去找酿酒桶？

original: Both of the buildings are connected by tunnels made by the pests infesting the meadery.
traduit: 这两栋建筑由害虫形成的隧道连接起来了。

original: There's an entrance to it in the basement storeroom of the warehouse that used to be boarded over.
traduit: 仓库的地下储藏室有个入口，不过被木板围起来了。

original: I've already removed the boards so the meadery would get infested. That's where you should start.
traduit: 我已经把板子拆了，这样酒庄就会被祸害，你从那开始就行了。

original: Why are you doing all this?
traduit: 你为什么要这么做？

original: I made the mistake of borrowing coin from Sabjorn. He's allowing me to pay it back, but he's working my fingers to the bone!
traduit: 我就不该找撒布乔恩借钱。他允许我做工抵债，却把我累得七死八活！

original: He treats me like a slave... I have to do every nasty, dirty job in the meadery.
traduit: 他待我如同奴隶……酒庄所有脏活累活都是我干。

original: I've cleared the beast's lair.
traduit: 我已经清理了野兽的巢穴。

original: Good work. The mindless cretins didn't stand a chance.
traduit: 干得好。那些没脑子的畜生根本没机会。

original: Not bad, not bad. The intensity of the hunt is special, isn't it?
traduit: 不错，不错。狩猎的强度很特别吧？

original: Good to hear. Have your share of the pay.
traduit: 很高兴听到这个消息。这是你那份报酬。

original: You made that from the remains of a dragon? Amazing.
traduit: 你能用龙的残骸来制作？叹为观止啊。

original: You don't see many people crafting with that these days. Impressive.
traduit: 这年头有这手艺的人不多了。了不起。

original: Masterful. That's a work of art, right there.
traduit: 很熟练了。简直就是艺术品。

original: Good job. I can see you know what you're doing.
traduit: 干得好。看得出你知道自己在干什么。

original: Not too shabby. Apprentice level work, but solid. Keep at it.
traduit: 不算太寒酸。算是到了学徒水平了，但够扎实。好好保持。

original: Not bad. Reminds me when I first started smithing.
traduit: 不赖啊。让我想起了我刚学锻造的时候。

original: What? What treachery! Defiler! Debaser and defiler! You have violated the sanctity of the Night Mother's tomb! Explain yourself!
traduit: 什么？这是背叛！是亵渎！是卑劣的亵渎！你居然敢亵渎夜母的圣棺！给我解释！

original: Tell Cicero the time has come. Tell him the words he has been waiting for, all these years: "Darkness rises when silence dies."
traduit: 告诉西塞罗，时间到了。告诉他这些年来他一直等的那句话“沉寂消亡之时，便是黑暗崛起之日”。

original: Poor Cicero has failed you. Poor Cicero is sorry, sweet mother. I've tried, so very hard. But I just can't find the Listener.
traduit: 可怜的西塞罗让您失望了。可怜的西塞罗很抱歉，亲爱的母亲。但我试过了，很努力的试过了。但我就是找不到聆听者。

original: I've returned you home, as promised.
traduit: 我已经按约定送你到家了。

original: I'm ever so grateful. Please, give my regard to the rest of the Companions.
traduit: 感激不尽，请代我向其他战友问好。

original: I'm here to rescue you.
traduit: 我是来救你的。

original: Thank the Divines! Let's move!
traduit: 感谢圣灵！我们快走吧！

original: I rescued <Alias=Victim>.
traduit: 我已经救出<Alias=Victim>了。

original: Unfortunate. Let's be more careful next time.
traduit: 真不幸。下次可得小心点。

original: <Alias=Victim> was killed.
traduit: <Alias=Victim>被杀了。

original: So I hear. You've brought honor to the Companions and yourself.
traduit: 我听说了。你为自己和战友团带来了荣誉。

original: We've received a desperate missive.
traduit: 我们收到了一封绝望的信函。

original: I've taken care of the problem.
traduit: 我已经把问题解决了。

original: And I have already received word that the client is satisfied. You have done well for yourself, and for the Companions.
traduit: 我得到消息说客户很满意。你为自己和战友团做得很好。

original: Another job well done. Your payment is secure, and you have my thanks.
traduit: 又是次出色的工作。你的报酬在这儿，多谢了。

original: I expected no less of you. And once again, you have not disappointed.
traduit: 我一直很看好你。你又一次没让我失望。

original: I'd rather not handle that.
traduit: 我不想去处理。

original: Shame. But, I'm sure one of the whelps around here will take it up.
traduit: 丢人啊。不过我肯定别的崽子会去接手的。

original: I knew you could be counted on. Do what must be done.
traduit: 我就知道你可靠。去做该做的事吧。

original: Excellent. Show them no mercy.
traduit: 很好，别对他们手软。

original: Good. Do not spare them your blade.
traduit: 好。对他们可别吝惜你的剑。

original: What kind of trouble should I expect?
traduit: 什么麻烦呢？

original: Nothing but a bunch of lowly bandits. Cowards, who will take little effort.
traduit: 不过是一群卑鄙的强盗。用不着你费多少力气的懦夫。

original: The restless dead. Not pretty, but if you don't stop them, they'll move on to the locals.
traduit: 不得安宁的死者。不太麻烦，但如果不阻止他们，当地人可能要遭殃。

original: The Falmer. There have been reports that they've been attacking people at night.
traduit: 伐莫。有消息说它们在晚上袭击人了。

original: It's a problem with the Forsworn. Unpredictable, unknowable, and dangerous. Be careful.
traduit: 弃誓者的问题。不可预测、难以理解、十分危险。小心点。

original: It's a clan of giants. The war is driving them out of their lands, and they've started attacking settlements.
traduit: 是个巨人部落。战争把它们赶出了自己的土地，它们就开始攻击定居点了。

original: You'll be clearing a nest of those Hagraven things. I've never faced one myself, but I hear... disturbing things about them.
traduit: 你要清理一窝乌鸦鬼婆。我自己从没见过，但听说……它们很令人不安。

original: Oddly enough, Spriggans. Usually they let alone, but for some reason, this particular grove isn't.
traduit: 挺奇怪的，是木灵。一般情况下它们挺安静的。但不知道为什么这片树林的不是。

original: Bloodsuckers. Vampires. Take every precaution. One bite, and you could end up as one of them.
traduit: 嗜血族。吸血鬼。记得采取一切预防措施。只要被咬上一口，你可能就成了他们一员了。

original: Rogue wizards. I've never trusted magic types. The College is bad enough. Destroy them.
traduit: 流氓巫师。我从来不相信会魔法的人。学院已经够糟糕了。去摧毁他们。

original: There's some trouble in Eastmarch. Farmers getting troubled by some bad types who've built up a stronghold in the area.
