traduit: 东陲领有些麻烦。农民们收到一些恶类的困扰，他们在那里建立了据点。

original: There's some trouble in Falkreath. There's always some sort of trouble down there, but now it's come to a head.
traduit: 佛克瑞斯领有些麻烦。那里倒是总有麻烦，不过这次有点大。

original: There's some trouble in Haafingar. The Legion's too busy with the war, and they're hiring us to take care of their problems.
traduit: 海芬加有麻烦了。军团忙着打仗，所以雇我们来解决他们的问题。

original: We've been hired to deal with some pests in Hjaalmarch. Someone's got them riled up, and you need to put an end to it.
traduit: 希雅陲雇我们去解决害虫。有人惹怒了他们，你去解决了。

original: There's some trouble in The Pale. We need you to go in and clear out an enemy stronghold.
traduit: 苍原领有些麻烦。我们需要派你去清除一个敌人据点。

original: There's always some sort of trouble in The Reach, but a local warlord has raised the stakes. We have to handle the situation.
traduit: 瑞驰总是有麻烦，但当地有个军阀正在加大砝码。我们得去处理一下。

original: The Rift is seeing a lot of trouble from some riff-raff. We need to head in and break them up.
traduit: 裂痕领有群乌合之众在惹事。我们得去把他们清理了。

original: We've got trouble right here in Whiterun Hold. Nothing we can't handle.
traduit: 白漫领有些麻烦。不过没什么是咱们处理不了的。

original: There's trouble up in Winterhold. I'm a little surprised anyone's complaining about it, but money is money.
traduit: 冬堡有麻烦了。我倒是有点惊讶那里还有人来抱怨。不过钱就是钱嘛。

original: I have the pelts you asked for.
traduit: 你要的毛皮我带来了。

original: These look like good quality, too. I know it's not the glamorous, heroic work, but don't be surprised if I ask you to do it again.
traduit: 看起来质量不错。我知道这工作不太华丽，也不太显你勇，但如果我再交给你一次，别太惊讶。

original: We've got some traders coming in, and are short on Cave Bear pelts.
traduit: 有些商人来了，现在洞穴熊皮很短缺。

original: We've got some traders coming in, and are short on Bear pelts.
traduit: 有些商人来了，现在熊皮很短缺。

original: We've got some traders coming in, and are short on Snow Bear pelts.
traduit: 有些商人来了，现在雪熊皮很短缺。

original: We've got some traders coming in, and are short on Sabre Cat pelts.
traduit: 有些商人来了，现在剑齿虎皮很短缺。

original: We've got some traders coming in, and are short on Snow Sabre Cat pelts.
traduit: 有些商人来了，现在雪剑齿虎皮很短缺。

original: We've got some traders coming in, and are short on Ice Wolf pelts.
traduit: 有些商人来了，现在冰狼皮很短缺。

original: We've got some traders coming in, and are short on Wolf pelts.
traduit: 有些商人来了，现在狼皮很短缺。

original: There's no time! You have to get back to the College as fast as you can!
traduit: 没时间了！你得赶紧回到学院去！

original: Mirabelle is dead, and they're losing ground fast. I'd be there now if I hadn't seen... I had one of your 'visions', I think.
traduit: 米拉贝勒死了，阵线快守不住了。要不是我看到了你的那些“幻象”……我恐怕也在那儿了。

original: Go on, get moving! I'll try and clear a path for you.
traduit: 快，快！我会试着给你开路。

original: We'll stay here and see if we can find anything else that could be of use.
traduit: 我们就待在这里，看看有什么发现。

original: Hadvar... get away from there!
traduit: 哈达瓦……远离那儿！

original: Follow me. Let's see where this leads.
traduit: 跟我来。看看这里通向哪儿。

original: Steady, legionnaires! We've been through worse. Just keep your guard up!
traduit: 将士们坚持住！我们经历过比这更糟的情况。保持警惕！

original: Alright, let's move, men! We've got more...
traduit: 好了，走吧伙计们！我们还有更多事……

original: How's it going? You find anything yet?
traduit: 进展如何？找到什么了吗？

original: Keep looking. There's got to be some way to get that gate open.
traduit: 继续找吧。一定有办法打开那扇门。

original: This may sound obvious, but do you see a lever anywhere?
traduit: 虽然听着有点傻，但你看到有杠杆了吗？

original: Auxiliary, do what you do best. See if you can find some way to get that gate open.
traduit: 辅助兵，做你擅长的事。看看能不能打开那扇门。

original: Alright legionnaires! Spread out and see what we've got.
traduit: 军团将士听好！分头行动，看看有什么发现。

original: Alright everyone! Keep your guard up. Let's move out!
traduit: 好了，大家听着！保持警惕。出发！

original: I had Kaie recover all the things the Nords stole from you. You better get ready before we break out into the city.
traduit: 我让凯伊把诺德人从你这里偷走的东西都找回来了。你最好在咱们进城前做好准备。

original: And take this. It's blessed with the old magicks. Something to remember me by.
traduit: 拿上这个。这东西受古老的魔法祝福过。这样你也能记得我。

original: It wasn't easy getting all your things. A few guards had to have their throats slit.
traduit: 把你的东西拿回来真不容易。还不得不割了几个卫兵的喉咙。

original: Good work. Get ready while I have a word with our favorite outsider.
traduit: 干得好。做好准备，我要和我们最亲爱的局外人谈谈。

original: Madanach. I've brought what you asked for.
traduit: 迈德纳奇。你要的东西我带来了。

original: And you... you're coming with me to Dragonsreach. We'll see how quickly your memory clears in the city's prisons.
traduit: 你……现在就跟我去龙临宫。看看你在监狱里记忆会恢复得多快。

original: Now move.
traduit: 赶紧走。

original: I beg you... please. This is not what it seems!
traduit: 求求你……不要。这看起来不是那样的！

original: Silence, idiot! I should have known better... to trust this place after it's been riddled with filth.
traduit: 住口，你这白痴！我早就该知道……不能相信这种肮脏的地方。

original: No, please! I don't understand...
traduit: 不，拜托！我不明白……

original: You assured me this place was clean! I'll see... see to it that you remain in irons for the rest of your days!
traduit: 你向我保证过这里是干净的！看来我要……要让你在监狱里度过余生了！

original: I... I don't know. What's wrong?
traduit: 我……我不知道。怎么了？

original: By the Eight?! What... what's in this?
traduit: 八圣灵在上！这……这是什么？

original: Shor's Bones! What... what's in this?
traduit: 舒尔的骨头！这……这是什么？

original: Help yourself, milord. It's my finest brew yet... I call it Honningbrew Reserve. I think you'll find it quite pleasing to your palate.
traduit: 请随意，大人。这是我这儿最好的酒……我给它起名为“蜜之酿精选”。我觉得应该合您的口味。

original: Well, Sabjorn. Now that you've taken care of your little pest problem, how about I get a taste of some of your mead?
traduit: 好了，撒布乔恩。既然你已经解决了小害虫的问题，那我来尝尝你的蜂蜜酒怎么样？

original: Job's finished.
traduit: 工作完成了。

original: Well it's about time! I had to stall the captain until you were finished.
traduit: 是时候了！直到你完事为止我都得拖住队长。

original: Why are you standing here then?
traduit: 那你怎么还在这里？

original: I've told the captain of the guard we'll have the meadery cleared for the tasting and he could be here any minute.
traduit: 我已经告诉卫兵队长，我们会保证蜜酒庄清洁，并随时准备他到来品酒。

original: I haven't finished the job yet.
traduit: 我还没有完成工作。

original: But you weren't killed... Not even once.
traduit: 但你没被杀啊……一次也没有。

original: Yeah, but Twice-Killed has more of a ring to it!
traduit: 是啊，但“两度死亡”对我很有意义！

original: And you lived?
traduit: 然后你还活了？

original: Yeah, I was lucky though. After Vex tore the guy to pieces, she gave me a potion. If she hadn't of been there...
traduit: 是啊，很幸运。小烦把那家伙撕碎了，给了我一剂药。要不是她在那儿……

original: Anyway, after I got back to the Guild, I decided to start calling myself Twice-Killed.
traduit: 总之，当我回到公会，我就决定自称“两度死亡”了。

original: Twice-Killed?
traduit: “两度死亡”？

original: Got into a scrap a few years ago at the Ragged Flagon. Some idiot who stole himself a guard's sword and kept boasting about it.
traduit: 几年前我在漏壶和人吵过一架。有个傻子偷了卫兵的剑还不停吹牛逼。

original: He's making too much racket and I'm trying to get Vex drunk. So I tell him to keep it down and he just runs me through.
traduit: 他吵得很，我本想把小烦灌醉。所以我叫他小声点，他直接把我捅穿了。

original: So prison is a Guild punishment?
traduit: 所以关监狱是公会的惩罚？

original: Hey, if you're in good with Maven you've pretty much got it made.
traduit: 嘿，如果你和玛雯相处得很好，那你已经差不多要做到了。

original: She's got friends in high places, and I don't just mean in Skyrim.
traduit: 她有很多地位很高的朋友，当然不只是在天际。

original: So getting the guards to throw me in here as a "punishment" was about as easy as falling off a log.
traduit: 所以让卫兵把我扔到这里作为“惩罚”就像从木头上掉下来一样容易。

original: Why are you in prison?
traduit: 你为什么被关起来？

original: Because big, bad Brynjolf doesn't like the way I play thief.
traduit: 因为大混蛋布林乔夫不喜欢我偷东西的方式。

original: Look, he says we needed coin, so I got coin. Who cares if people got hurt? Blood washes off septims.
traduit: 听着，他说我们需要钱，所以我去拿钱。有人受伤又怎样？不就是钱上带血吗。

original: Now I'm sitting in here counting skeever droppings while he's drinking Black-Briar mead with Maven.
traduit: 现在我在这里数着恶鼠粪球，他却和玛雯一起喝着黑棘蜜酒。

original: Don't worry. I'm sure he made it out. It'll take more than a dragon to stop Ulfric Stormcloak.
traduit: 别担心。我敢肯定他成功了。单凭一头龙可拦不住乌弗瑞克·风暴斗篷。

original: I ought to get back to work before I'm missed, but... did anyone else escape? Did Ulfric...
traduit: 我是时候回去工作了，不过……还有其他人逃出来吗？乌弗瑞克……

original: Thanks, sister. I knew we could count on you.
traduit: 谢谢你，姐姐。我就知道你靠得住。

original: I told you my sister would help us out.
traduit: 我告诉过你我姐姐会帮咱们的吧。

original: I hope to see you in Windhelm. Good luck.
traduit: 希望咱们风舵城再会。祝你好运。

original: Do you think that dragon is still flying around here somewhere?
traduit: 你觉得那头龙还会在附近吗？

original: I almost can't believe it... a real, live dragon...
traduit: 我还是有点不太相信……一头活生生的龙……

original: I bet my uncle Ralof is tougher than you are.
traduit: 我打赌我叔叔拉罗夫比你强壮。

original: I'm glad to help any way I can.
traduit: 我很乐意尽力帮忙。

original: Good luck, brother. I'll see you later.
traduit: 保重吧兄弟。一会儿见。

original: Hmph. Help them drink up our mead, you mean.
traduit: 哈。你是要帮他们喝光咱们的蜜酒啊。

original: I'll let them into the house and, you know, show them where everything is...
traduit: 我会让他们进屋。然后告诉他们东西都在哪……

original: Mind your mother, boy!
traduit: 小子，听你妈妈的话！

original: Go and watch the south road. Come find us if you see any Imperial soldiers coming.
traduit: 去南边路上看看。要是看见有帝国兵来了就告诉我们。

original: Any friend of Ralof's is a friend of mine.
traduit: 拉罗夫的朋友就是我朋友。

original: Nonsense. You and your friend are welcome to stay here as long as you need to.
traduit: 可笑。你和你朋友要住多久就住多久。

original: Let me worry about the Imperials.
traduit: 我来搞定帝国人。

original: Good. Maybe we can lay up for a while. I hate to put your family in danger, Gerdur, but...
traduit: 好吧。我们可以休息会儿了。我也不想把你们一家置于危险，歌尔朵，不过……

original: Nobody else has come up the south road today, as far as I know.
traduit: 据我所知今天南边路上没人来过。

original: As strange as it sounds, we'd be dead if not for that dragon. In the confusion, we managed to slip away.
traduit: 听起来很扯，但如果没有那头龙，我们早就完了。我们趁乱溜了。

original: Are we really the first to make it to Riverwood?
traduit: 我们真的是最早到了河木镇的？

original: I can hardly believe it myself, and I was there.
traduit: 我自己都不敢信，我当时在那。

original: You don't mean, a real, live...
traduit: 你不会是说，一头活生生的……

original: But then... out of nowhere... a dragon attacked...
traduit: 不过后来……不知从哪来了头龙……发起了攻击。

original: They wouldn't dare give Ulfric a fair trial. Treason, for fighting for your own people! All of Skyrim would have seen the truth then.
traduit: 他们不敢公正地审判乌弗瑞克。为了自己的人民而战却成了叛徒！所有天际人都会看到真相的。

original: The cowards!
traduit: 懦夫！

original: Where to start? Well, the news you heard about Ulfric was true. The Imperials ambushed us outside Darkwater Crossing.
traduit: 从何说起呢？好吧，你听到的乌弗瑞克的消息是真的。帝国军队在暗水岔口伏击了我们。

original: Like they knew exactly where we'd be. That was... two days ago, now.
traduit: 就像他们知道我们会在哪里一样。那是……距今两天前了吧。

original: We stopped in Helgen this morning, and I thought it was all over. Had us lined up to the headsman's block and ready to start chopping.
traduit: 今早我们在海尔根停下了。我以为万事休矣。他们让我们在断头台前排好准备挨砍。

original: I can't remember when I last slept...
traduit: 我已经不记得上次睡觉是什么时候了……

original: Now, Ralof, what's going on? You two look pretty well done in.
traduit: 拉罗夫，到底怎么了？你们俩怎么看着这么累。

original: Look at you, almost a grown man! Won't be long before you'll be joining the fight yourself.
traduit: 看看你小子，差不多快成年了！要不了多久你就能自己去参战了。

original: Uncle Ralof! Can I see your axe? How many Imperials have you killed? Do you really know Ulfric Stormcloak?
traduit: 拉罗夫舅舅！我能看看你的斧头吗？你杀了多少帝国兵啊？你真的认识乌弗瑞克·风暴斗篷吗？

original: Why strike now?
traduit: 那为何现在要下手？

original: The Goldenglow Estate job has undoubtedly interrupted the supply of honey I need to make my mead.
traduit: 金色光辉庄园的事中断了蜜酒原料的供应。

original: Sabjorn could use this interruption to his advantage and collect a larger share of the market. I can't have that.
traduit: 我不能坐视撒布乔恩利用这次供货中断为自己争取更大的市场份额。

original: Strange. According to history Solitude attacked Winterhold, but Aesgeir seems to be saying Olaf reacted. What do we say happened?
traduit: 奇怪。根据历史记载，是独孤城攻击了冬堡，但这里却说奥拉夫在其中起了作用。到底发生了什么？

original: King Olaf was Olaf One-Eye? He famously captured the dragon Numinex and took him to Dragonsreach. What do we say really happened?
traduit: 奥拉夫王就是“独眼”奥拉夫？他可是捕获了巨龙怒米奈科斯，还把他带到了龙临宫。事情真相到底是什么？

original: "O, Olaf, our subjugator, the one-eyed betrayer;"
traduit: “哦，奥拉夫，我们的征服者、独眼的背叛者；”

original: "death-dealing demon and dragon-killing King."
traduit: “致命的魔头与屠龙王。”

original: "Your legend is lies, lurid and false;"
traduit: “你的传说不过是耸人听闻的谎言；”

original: "your cunning capture of Numinex, a con for the ages."
traduit: “你投机取巧捕获了怒米奈科斯，真真欺世盗名。”

original: "Olaf grabbed power, by promise and threat;"
traduit: “奥拉夫软硬兼施攫取权力；”

original: "From Falkreath to Winterhold, they fell to their knees;"
traduit: “从佛克瑞斯到冬堡，人人匍匐在地；”

original: "But Solitude stood strong, Skyrim's truest protectors."
traduit: “唯有独孤城依旧挺立，我们是天际最忠实的保护者。”

original: "Olaf's vengeance was instant, inspired and wicked."
traduit: “奥拉夫的报复转瞬即至，又邪恶狡诈。”

original: When I heard Cicero screaming, I knew you'd been discovered. I feared the worst. Are you all right?
traduit: 我一听到西塞罗的尖叫，就知道你暴露了。这是我担心的最坏情况。你还好吗？

original: What's your opinion of Markarth?
traduit: 你对马卡斯有什么看法？

original: We'd be better off without the Silver-Bloods. They send their brute, Yngvar, to shake some coins from me every few days.
traduit: 没有银血家的话我们会过得更好。他们每隔几天就派他们那个凶蛮的英瓦尔来找我要钱。

original: And Betrid Silver-Blood is always asking for more potions to fuel Thonar's "ambitions." Gives him a temper fiercer than any bear.
traduit: 而且贝垂德·银血总是想要更多药水来推动托纳尔的“野心”。他的脾气变得比熊还要暴躁。

original: Olda wanted me to steal this <Alias=QuestItem>.
traduit: 奥尔达想让我偷这个<Alias=QuestItem>。

original: Shor's Crown, that woman never gives up. I guess that's why I married her.
traduit: 舒尔的王冠啊，那娘们还没放弃呢。这估计也是我娶她的原因吧。

original: You're a real friend saving this mead from her. Here, let me show you how to block a punch that might be coming from some angry spouse, huh?
traduit: 你可真是个好朋友，把蜜酒从她那儿拿来了。来，我教教你如何阻挡来自愤怒配偶的拳头，怎么样？

original: I have the <Alias=QuestItem>.
traduit: 我拿到<Alias=QuestItem>了。

original: Stendarr's Mercy to you. If my Horgeir doesn't give up the mead this time, I'll hit him over the head with it.
traduit: 斯丹达尔保佑你。如果我家霍格尔这次还戒不了酒，我就用它来打他的头。

original: Here, for your trouble.
traduit: 给，辛苦你了。

original: Tough luck.
traduit: 真不走运啊。

original: It's not luck, it's mead I'm cursing.
traduit: 这不是运气，是该死的蜜酒。

original: I could get your husband's stash for you.
traduit: 我可以把你丈夫的酒给你拿来。

original: If you want to try, but I'll keep my dagger sharpened just in case.
traduit: 如果你想试试，那我得把匕首磨快点以防万一。

original: You can help yourself to any drink you find, but bring me the bottle of Dragon's Breath Mead. It's his favorite, so I know he has one there.
traduit: 里面的酒你随便喝，但请把那瓶龙息蜜酒拿给我。那是他的最爱，他肯定在那儿藏了一瓶。

original: Your husband drinking too much?
traduit: 你丈夫很爱喝酒吗？

original: He promised me, swore on his ancestors, that he'd give up the mead. And what do I find out? He's been stashing drink in a cave nearby.
traduit: 他向我保证过，还对着祖宗发誓，要戒了蜜酒。结果你猜我发现了什么？他一直在附近的山洞里藏酒。

original: He even has some wolves guarding it. I swear, I should just cut out his tongue. That would be the end of it.
traduit: 他甚至喊了一群狼来给他看酒。我真该割了他的舌头，这样他就不能再喝了。

original: Have you met my husband? Well don't bother, he's a drunk.
traduit: 你见过我丈夫吗？算了，他就是个酒鬼。

original: You... you did? He has?
traduit: 你……成功了？他同意了？

original: Oh stranger! You have made Cicero so happy! So jubilant and ecstatic! But more! Even more! My mother thanks you!
traduit: 哦！陌生人！你让西塞罗好开心啊！让人欣喜若狂！但更重要的是！更重要的是！我的母亲会感谢你的！

original: Here, here. For your troubles! Shiny, clinky gold! A few coins for a kind deed! And thank you! Thank you again.
traduit: 给你，给你。你的辛苦费！闪闪发光的金币！好人有好报！谢谢你！再次谢谢你！

original: I talked to Loreius. He's agreed to fix your wagon wheel.
traduit: 我跟罗瑞尤斯说完了。他同意帮你修车轮。

original: Oh. Oh yes! Yes, the kindly stranger can certainly help!
traduit: 哦。哦，没错！好心的陌生人当然能帮上忙！

original: Go to the farm - the Loreius Farm. Just over there, off the road. Talk to Loreius. He has tools! He can help me! But he won't! He refuses!
traduit: 去那边的农场，罗瑞尤斯农场。就在那边，路边上。和罗瑞尤斯说话。他有工具！他可以帮我！但是他不帮！他拒绝我！

original: Convince Loreius to fix my wheel! Do that, and poor Cicero will reward you. With coin! Gleamy, shiny coin!
traduit: 劝罗瑞尤斯来修我的轮子！做得好，可怜的西塞罗会报答你的。用金币！闪闪发光的金币！

original: Is there some way I can help?
traduit: 有什么需要我帮助的吗？

original: Poor Cicero is stuck. Can't you see? I was transporting my dear, sweet mother. Well, not her. Her corpse! She's quite dead.
traduit: 可怜的西塞罗被卡住了。看不出来吗？我在运送我可爱的母亲。好吧，不是她本人。她的尸体！她确实死了。

original: I'm taking mother to a new home. A new crypt. But... aggh! Wagon wheel! Damnedest wagon wheel! It broke! Don't you see?
traduit: 我要带母亲去一个新家。一个新坟墓。但是……啊啊啊！车轮！该死的车轮！坏掉了！你看不见吗？

original: Problem?
traduit: 有问题吗？

original: Ha! Wonderful!
traduit: 哈！好极了！

original: Like I said, the guard is down by the road. You really can't miss him.
traduit: 照我说的做，卫兵就在路边。很容易看到的。

original: You tell him that jester is up to no good, and he'll deal with it. Then come back here, and I'll toss a few coins your way, yeah?
traduit: 告诉他那个小丑在干坏事，他就会处理的。回来之后我会给你些金币当报酬的，好吗？

original: I'll do it. I'll report Cicero to the guard.
traduit: 我会的。我会去向卫兵举报西塞罗。

original: Hmph. Fine. Suit yourself. But you're wrong, anyway. Just look at the fool. I don't know what it is, but he's damn well guilty of something.
traduit: 嗯。好吧。随你便。但不管怎样，你肯定错了。看看那个小丑吧。虽然我说不上来，但他一定在干什么违法勾当。

original: I won't condemn an innocent man.
traduit: 我不会平白说人有罪。

original: Hmm. You have a point. What can I do to help?
traduit: 嗯，你说的有道理。我能帮上什么忙？

original: And just who in Mara's name are you, anyway? Hmm? Come here, telling me my business. And for what? To help a... a... a fool!
traduit: 玛拉在上你到底是谁？嗯？来这儿，跟我说什么？帮助一个……一个小丑！

original: He's a stranger who needs assistance. Please, do the right thing.
traduit: 他是个需要帮助的过路人。拜托了，行行好。

original: So what's the problem? I'm sure he'll pay you...
traduit: 所以有什么问题呢？我保证他会给你钱的……

original: Pay me? You think this is about money?
traduit: 给钱？你以为是钱的问题？

original: Have you seen the man? He's completely out of his head. A jester? Here, in Skyrim? Ain't been a merryman in these parts for a hundred years.
traduit: 没看到那个人吗？完全失智了。小丑？在天际？这里一百年没来过滑稽艺人了。

original: And he's transporting some giant box. Says it's a coffin, and he's going to bury his mother. Mother my eye.
traduit: 看他在运的那个大箱子。说是棺材，要给母亲下葬。信他就见鬼了。

original: He could have anything in there. War contraband. Weapons. Skooma. Ain't no way I'm getting involved in any of that.
traduit: 他可能在里面夹带任何东西。战争违禁品。武器。斯库玛。我可不想扯进这种事里。

original: So why not help him? I'm sure he'll pay you.
traduit: 所以为什么不帮他一把呢？我确信他会付钱的。

original: Well, there is something. There's a guard, patrols the road that crazy jester is on. He passes by pretty often.
traduit: 嗯，对了。有个卫兵在那个疯子小丑所在的路上巡逻。他经常路过这里。

original: You could report the fool. You know, say he's done something against the law. That will at least get rid of him for me. What do you say?
traduit: 去举报这个小丑。就说他作奸犯科了。那样我至少能摆脱他了。你说呢？

original: That Cicero feller?
traduit: 那个叫西塞罗的家伙？

original: Hmph. Tell me something I don't know. Crazy fool's already asked me about five times. Seems he's not satisfied with my answer.
traduit: 嗯。说点新鲜的吧。那疯子小丑已经问了我五次了。看来他对我的回答不满意。

original: Why can't he just leave us alone?
traduit: 他就不能放过我们吗？

original: The, um, little man really needs your help. With his wagon?
traduit: 那，呃，那小子真需要你帮忙。能帮他修修车轮吗？

original: Is something wrong. "Is something wrong?" she asks. Yes, something is bloody well wrong!
traduit: 有什么问题。你还说“有什么问题”。没错，就是他妈的有问题！

original: Or maybe you missed the demented little man in the jester's garb, down by the road? Goes by the name of Cicero?
traduit: 你可能没看到路边那个疯子小丑？那个叫西塞罗的？

original: Crazy fool's asked me to fix his broken wagon wheel five times. He won't take no for an answer. Why can't he just leave us alone?
traduit: 那个疯子小丑叫我修他的坏车轮，五次了。他不接受拒绝。他就不能放过我们吗？

original: Is something wrong. "Is something wrong?" he asks. Yes, something is bloody well wrong!
traduit: 有什么问题。你还说“有什么问题”。没错，就是他妈的有问题！

original: You need something talk to my husband. Vantus Loreius. Or just Loreius, if it's all the same to you.
traduit: 需要什么的话，就去和我丈夫谈谈吧。万图斯·罗瑞尤斯。如果不介意的话，就叫罗瑞尤斯也行。

original: You need something?
traduit: 你需要什么吗？

original: You don't want to go up to that farmhouse, citizen. It's a terrible sight. The farmer and his wife, slaughtered in the night. So many knife wounds...
traduit: 你绝不会想去那个农舍的，公民。那景象太可怕。农夫夫妇在夜里遇害了，浑身都是刀伤。

original: Don't worry, citizen. I'm on top of that little matter we discussed.
traduit: 别担心，公民。我们讨论过的那件小事已经处理好了。

original: I'll soon arrange transportation for our little friend. Don't worry, he'll rot in a cell and pay for what he's done.
traduit: 我马上会给我们的小朋友安排交通工具。别担心，他会烂死在牢房里赎罪的。

original: Oh, for the love of Mara. What now?
traduit: 啊，玛拉之爱在上。又怎么了？

original: You need to report that crazy jester to the guard. He should be patrolling the road.
traduit: 你得向卫兵举报那个疯子小丑。他应该就在这条路上巡逻。

original: I thought we'd talked enough. Unless you've reconsidered my offer? That Cicero needs sortin'...
traduit: 我觉得咱们说的够多了。除非你重新考虑我的提议？西塞罗必须……

original: Well? Is it done? Have you reported the fool to the guard?
traduit: 嗯？完事儿了吗？向卫兵举报那个小丑了吗？

original: Ha! That'll teach the little jester to go bothering the decent, hardworking folk of Skyrim. Fool never should have come here.
traduit: 哈！教训教训那个小丑少来打搅天际正派勤劳的人们才能待的地方。傻子少往这里跑。

original: Little fool's going to experience the hard reality of Skyrim justice, eh?
traduit: 小傻子要体验天际正义法律的残酷现实了，对吧？

original: You can tell Cicero I'll be along presently. I just need to do a couple things here first, and gather my tools.
traduit: 告诉西塞罗我马上就过去。我得先处理手头的事，然后拿上工具。

original: Just need to gather my tools and finish up a couple of things. No worries - I'll see to Cicero, make sure that wagon gets fixed.
traduit: 我得先整理工具，处理一下手头的事情。别担心，我会帮西塞罗把马车修好的。

original: Agh! Bother and befuddle! Stuck here! Stuck! My mother, my poor mother. Unmoving. At rest, but too still!
traduit: 啊！烦死了！困在这里了！困在这里了！母亲啊，可怜的母亲。一动不动。就这么安息着，但也太安静了！

original: The farmer is at his farm! Where else would he be? Loreius is his name. Talk to him. Convince him to help poor Cicero.
traduit: 农夫就在农场里！他还会去哪儿呢？他叫罗瑞尤斯。跟他说说。让他来帮帮可怜的西塞罗。

original: Poor mother... she's been waiting here so long... Stupid farmer and his stupid tools! Why won't he help us?
traduit: 可怜的母亲……她还要在这儿等多久……笨蛋农夫、笨蛋工具！他为什么不帮帮我们？

original: Poor mother... Her new home seems so very far...
traduit: 可怜的母亲……她的新家好像还很遥远……

original: Unfair! Unjust! Cicero has done nothing wrong! Loreius will pay for his treachery! Oh, how he will pay... And you! You were no help! Not at all!
traduit: 不公平！不公平！西塞罗没有做错什么！罗瑞尤斯要为背叛付出代价！哦，他要怎么付呢……还有你！你帮不上忙！一点也帮不上！

original: I will wait for Loreius! Oh yes, mother and I will wait right here, right here until he fixes our wheel.
traduit: 我会等着罗瑞尤斯！对，母亲和我就在这里等他，就在这里，直到他修好我们的轮子。

original: I'm here to pick up Harrald's sword.
traduit: 我来这拿海拉德的剑。

original: Lazy good-for-nothing, isn't he? Sent you down here when I'm a stone's throw from the keep?
traduit: 他可真是又懒又没用，是吧？我这里离城堡就几步道儿，还得派你过来？

original: Here's the sword. Tell Harrald to stop slaying walls and perhaps his blade will stay in better condition!
traduit: 这是他的剑。告诉海拉德别再砍墙了，这样他的剑会更好用！

original: Here's the sword from Balimund.
traduit: 这是从巴利蒙德那取来的剑。

original: Took your sweet time getting it to me.
traduit: 让你费时间了。

original: Here you go, for your trouble.
traduit: 给你，麻烦了。

original: Maybe later.
traduit: 以后再说吧。

original: Hmph. I should have known better than to ask a knave.
traduit: 哼。我真不该问个混混。

original: Thank you. Do hurry please.
traduit: 谢谢。请快点。

original: Only a dagger for the son of the Jarl?
traduit: 领主的儿子就用把匕首？

original: If you must know, I was practicing in the yard when the guard I was sparring with feinted when I specifically told him to duck!
traduit: 如果你非得知道，我当时在院子里练习，我特意嘱咐和我对打的那个卫兵让他闪开，结果他做了假动作。

original: My blade bit right into the stonework next to the keep and needed serious repairs. Thankfully our smith Balimund works wonders.
traduit: 我的剑正好刺中了堡垒旁边的石雕，需要好好修理。谢天谢地，我们的铁匠巴利蒙德创造了奇迹。

original: In fact, if you'd fetch my blade from him I'd be most appreciative.
traduit: 其实，如果你能把我的剑从他那儿拿回来，我会很感激的。

original: Aren't you forgetting something?
traduit: 你没忘了什么东西吧？

original: What? Oh! How could I have possibly forgotten. Your reward, of course... of course.
traduit: 什么？哦！我怎么能忘了呢。当然，你的报酬……当然。

original: Here you are. So sorry about that.
traduit: 给你。真是很抱歉了。

original: I have a purchase agreement for you.
traduit: 我这里有份采购协议给你。

original: Ah, Bolli finally got someone out here. Well it's about time. I've been waiting for weeks.
traduit: 啊，波利终于派人来了。也是时候了。我都等了几个星期了。

original: Well, thank you for bringing it I suppose. Have a good day.
traduit: 嗯，谢谢你把它送来。祝你今天愉快。

original: Certainly.
traduit: 那行。

original: Good. Kleppr will pay you as soon as you arrive with the letter. Here you are.
traduit: 好。等你带着信一到，克莱珀会付钱给你的。拿好。

original: Who buys all your fish?
traduit: 谁买了你所有的鱼？

original: I sell my catch across a good portion of Skyrim... it's worth its weight in gold to me.
traduit: 我在天际出售我的渔获……对我来说，它就像金子一样值钱。

original: The only untapped market left is Markarth. However, I just got word that Kleppr at The Silver Blood Inn might be interested.
traduit: 唯一还没有开发过的市场就是马卡斯了。不过，我刚听说银血旅店的克莱珀可能会有兴趣。

original: If you're headed that way, I would appreciate you delivering a purchase agreement for me. You'd be paid, of course.
traduit: 如果你顺路的话，希望你能帮我送一份购买协议。当然，不会让你白跑的。

original: We don't just take in any milk drinker who stumbles in. Talk to Kodlak if you think you have what it takes to be a Companion.
traduit: 我们不会随便接纳那些不小心闯进来的懦夫。如果你觉得自己有成为战友的能力，就去和克拉科谈谈。

original: Can I join the Companions?
traduit: 我可以加入战友团吗？

original: I don't know if you're capable, and I don't have time to find out. If Kodlak will vouch for you, I might have some work you could do.
traduit: 我不知道你是否有能力，也没工夫测验。如果克拉科愿意为你担保，我可能会给你安排些活计。

original: Kodlak is the one who figures out who can be a Companion. So talk to him. It's out of my hands.
traduit: 克拉科知道谁有资格成为战友。和他聊聊。这不是我能做主的。

original: So you think you have what it takes? Huh. Lucky for you, I'm not the one who makes that decision. Talk to Kodlak.
traduit: 你是觉得自己有能力吗？嗯。你走运了，我不是做主的。和克拉科去说吧。

original: Who knows, maybe he's in a generous mood.
traduit: 谁知道他现在心情好不好呢。

original: Aren't you already running a job for Aela? Come talk to me when you finish that up.
traduit: 你不是已经在替艾拉干活吗？做完再来找我。

original: I've already given you a job, now get to it.
traduit: 我已经给过你工作了，现在就去吧。

original: Aren't you already running a job for Farkas? Come talk to me when you finish that up.
traduit: 你不是已经在替法卡斯干活吗？做完再来找我。

original: Aren't you already running a job for Vilkas? Come talk to me when you finish that up.
traduit: 你不是已经在替威尔卡斯干活吗？做完再来找我。

original: Aren't you already running a job for Skjor? Come talk to me when you finish that up.
traduit: 你不是已经在替斯科约尔干活吗？做完再来找我。

original: But you have indulged my weakness for speech long enough. Krosis. Now I will answer your question.
traduit: 但你已经纵容我之嗜好太久了。科洛西斯。我现在得回答你的问题。

original: How can I learn it, then?
traduit: 我怎么学呢？

original: Drem. All in good time. First, a question for you. Why do you want to learn this Thu'um?
traduit: 旦姆。不要着急。我先问你。你为什么要学那个吐'目？

original: I don't believe in destiny. But I will stop Alduin.
traduit: 我不信命，但我会去阻止奥杜因。

original: And so, perhaps, your destiny will be fulfilled. Who can say?
traduit: 所以，或许，你的命运终会实现。谁知道呢？

original: Dez motmahus. Even to the dov, who ride the currents of Time, destiny is elusive.
traduit: 德兹 莫特马胡斯。即使是驾驭时间之流的都瓦，命运也是难以捉摸的。

original: Alduin believes that he will prevail, with good reason. Rok mul.
traduit: 奥杜因坚信他会胜利，理由很充分。若克 穆尔。

original: And he is no fool. Ni mey, rinik gut nol. Far from it. He began as the wisest and most far-seeing of us all.
traduit: 他并不愚蠢。尼 米埃，日尼克 古特 诺尔。远非如此。他曾经是我们之中最为睿智远见者。

original: What better reason to act than to fulfill my destiny?
traduit: 完成使命还需要什么理由？

original: If you can see your destiny clearly, your sight is clearer than mine.
traduit: 你如果能清晰地洞察自己的命运，那你的视野比我清明得多。

original: Dahmaan - remember, Alduin also follows his destiny, as he sees it.
traduit: 达曼 记住。奥杜因也在追随自己看到的命运。

original: But, I bow before your certainty. In a way I envy you. The curse of much knowledge is often indecision.
traduit: 但是，我被你的坚定折服了。也可以说，我很羡慕你。过多的知识也会导致优柔寡断。

original: The next world will have to take care of itself.
traduit: 来世要由它自己把握。

original: Paaz. A fair answer.
traduit: 帕兹。公允的答案。

original: Ro fus... maybe you only balance the forces that work to quicken the end of this world.
traduit: 洛 伏斯……也许你只是在平衡那些毁灭此世的力量。

original: Even we who ride the currents of Time cannot see past Time's end. Wuldsetiid los tahrodiis.
traduit: 即使我们乘着时间之流，也难以窥见时间的尽头。乌德瑟提德 洛斯 塔洛迪斯。

original: Those who try to hasten the end, may delay it. Those who work to delay the end, may bring it closer.
traduit: 试图加速终结者，也可能拖延它的到来；努力推迟终结者，也可能加速它的临近。

original: I didn't come here to debate philosophy with you.
traduit: 我不是来和你聊哲学的。

original: Hahaha! You have much to learn of the dov, then.
traduit: 哈哈哈！那你还有很多要向都瓦学学。

original: There is nothing else but philosophy to a dovah. It is no accident that we do battle with our Thu'um, our Voices.
traduit: 对都瓦来说除哲学别无他物。我们用吐'目，吼声战斗绝非偶然。

original: There is no distinction between debate and combat to a dragon. Tinvaak los grah. For us it is one and the same.
traduit: 于龙而言，辩难与战斗毫无差别。 提沃克 洛斯 格拉。对我们而言是一样的。

original: I like this world. I don't want it to end.
traduit: 我爱这个世界，不想它走向终结。

original: Pruzah. As good a reason as any. There are many who feel as you do, although not all.
traduit: 如扎。好理由。很多人与你同感，但并不是人人如此。

original: Some would say that all things must end, so that the next can come to pass.
traduit: 有人可能会说，只有一切终结，新世才会到来。

original: Perhaps this world is simply the Egg of the next kalpa? Lein vokiin? Would you stop the next world from being born?
traduit: 或许此世不过是孕育来劫之卵？ 雷恩 沃克因？你要阻止下一个世界的诞生吗？

original: The prophecy says that only the Dragonborn can stop him.
traduit: 预言说只有龙裔才能阻止他。

original: True... But qostiid - prophecy - tells what may be, not what should be.
traduit: 没错……但是科斯提德，预言，只是说可能发生什么，而不是应该发生什么。

original: Qostiid sahlo aak. Just because you can do a thing, does not always mean you should.
traduit: 科斯提德 撒洛 阿克。只是说你能做，而不意味着你该做。

original: Do you have no better reason for acting than destiny? Are you nothing but a plaything of dez... of fate?
traduit: 你就没有比使命更好的理由了吗？你只是德兹……命运的玩物？

original: I need to stop Alduin.
traduit: 我需要阻止奥杜因。

original: Yes. Alduin... zeymah. The elder brother. Gifted, grasping and troublesome as is so often the case with firstborn.
traduit: 是啊。奥杜因…… 泽玛。我的兄长。天赋异禀却也贪得无厌、麻烦不断，这样的长子很常见。

original: But why? Why must you stop Alduin?
traduit: 但到底为什么？你为什么要阻止奥杜因？

original: Nid. If you wish me to answer your question, you must answer mine.
traduit: 聂德。你希望我回答你的问题，就得先回答我的问题。

original: I need to learn the Dragonrend Shout.
traduit: 我需要学习“龙魂撕裂”龙吼。

original: Do you know why I live here, at the peak of the Monahven - what you name Throat of the World?
traduit: 知道我为什么住在莫纳文……你们所说的世界之喉的山顶吗？

original: You have not answered my question. Why do you need to learn this Thu'um?
traduit: 你还没回答我的问题。你为什么要学这个吐'目？

original: Ah. I have expected you. Prodah.
traduit: 啊，我一直在等你。普洛达。

original: You would not come all this way for tinvaak with an old dovah. No. You seek your weapon against Alduin.
traduit: 你不是大老远赶来和我这个老都瓦汀瓦克的。对，你是来寻找对付奥杜因的武器。

original: Can you teach me the Dragonrend Shout?
traduit: 你能教我“龙魂撕裂”龙吼吗？

original: By long tradition, the elder speaks first.
traduit: 根据悠久的传统。应该长者先开口。

original: Aaah... yes! Sossedov los mul. The dragonblood runs strong in you. It is long since I had the pleasure of speech with one of my own kind.
traduit: 啊……没错！索瑟都瓦 洛斯 穆尔。你体内流淌着强大的龙血。我很久没有跟同族交谈过了。

original: Now, show me what you can do. Greet me not as mortal, but as dovah!
traduit: 现在，让我看看你的能耐。不要以凡人的方式问候我，要像个都瓦一样！

original: Now, show me what you can do. Greet me not as elf, but as dovah!
traduit: 现在，让我看看你的能耐。不要以精灵的方式问候我，要像个都瓦一样！

original: Now, show me what you can do. Greet me not as orc, but as dovah!
traduit: 现在，让我看看你的能耐。不要以兽人的方式问候我，要像个都瓦一样！

original: Now, show me what you can do. Greet me not as khajiit, but as dovah!
traduit: 现在，让我看看你的能耐。不要以卡吉特的方式问候我，要像个都瓦一样！

original: Now, show me what you can do. Greet me not as Argonian, but as dovah!
traduit: 现在，让我看看你的能耐。不要以阿尔贡的方式问候我，要像个都瓦一样！

original: Come, Dovahkiin. Nin Yol. Strike me with the fire of your Thu'um.
traduit: 来吧，都瓦克因。尼恩 约。用你的吐'目之火攻击我。

original: Why do you delay? Are you Dovahkiin or not?
traduit: 为什么拖拖拉拉的？你不是都瓦克因吗？

original: Do not be afraid. Faasnu. Let me feel the power of your Thu'um.
traduit: 别害怕。法斯努。让我感受一下你的吐'目之力。

original: Ha ha! Oh, I knew I had a good feeling about you!
traduit: 哈哈！我就知道没看错你！

original: Here, my friend. A few septims, to show my thanks, hmm? And may that twisted little jester rot in a cell for a fortnight!
traduit: 来，朋友。几个塞普汀，算是我的感谢，怎么样？但愿那个扭曲的小丑在牢房里待上十天半个月！

original: I have. Cicero won't be bothering you again.
traduit: 我做完了。西塞罗不会再打扰你了。

original: An assault. On my watch. By the gods, he'll not get away with this.
traduit: 在我眼前搞袭击？诸神在上，他逃不掉。

original: My thanks for bringing this to my attention, citizen. Don't worry, I'll take care of it.
traduit: 感谢你的报告，公民。别担心，我会处理的。

original: He... attacked a traveler! On the road! I saw it! (Persuade)
traduit: 他……在攻击旅行者！就在路上！我看到了！（说服）

original: How dare that little fool! And right under my nose!
traduit: 那个小丑竟敢在我眼皮底下做这种事！

original: He's transporting war contraband! In the coffin! (Persuade)
traduit: 他在运输战争违禁品！就在那具棺材里！（说服）

original: DB01MiscGuardPlayerCiceroFramed1
traduit: DB01MiscGuardPlayerCiceroFramed1

original: Did he now?
traduit: 是吗？

original: Nobody pilfers property on my watch.
traduit: 没人能在我眼皮子底下偷鸡摸狗。

original: He, um... stole something! I saw him! (Persuade)
traduit: 他，呃……偷东西了！我看见了！（说服）

original: What about him?
traduit: 他怎么了？

original: It's that odd jester, Cicero. The one with the wagon...
traduit: 就是那个古怪的小丑，西塞罗。那辆马车的主人……

original: Bah! Stop wasting my time!
traduit: 呸！别浪费我时间！

original: Never mind. I... I was mistaken.
traduit: 没事。我……闹误会了。

original: Would you now?
traduit: 是吗？

original: Well, spit it out. What's the matter?
traduit: 好吧，有话就说吧。到底怎么了？

original: Yes. I'd like to report a crime.
traduit: 对，我是来报案的。

original: Well all right, then.
traduit: 那好吧。

original: No, nothing. I'll just be moving on.
traduit: 不，没事。我只是路过。

original: Sure, my voice could use a rest.
traduit: 可以啊，我正要歇歇嗓子呢。

original: Can I make a request?
traduit: 我能点首歌吗？

original: Sure, what can I do for you?
traduit: 当然，你有什么需要吗？

original: For a generous fellow traveler? But of course. What would you like to hear?
traduit: 为了一个慷慨的旅伴？当然可以。想听些什么？

original: Can I make a request? (25 gold)
traduit: 我能点首歌吗？（25金币）

original: Sorry friend, but it looks like you're a bit light in the purse, and the wayward minstrel can't afford to do free performances.
traduit: 抱歉了，朋友。看起来你钱不大够，而本人作为流浪诗人是不会免费献唱的。

original: Haven't attacked each other yet. Good a sign as any.
traduit: 还没有互相打架。好兆头。

original: How are the new breeds getting along with my dogs?
traduit: 新来的马和我对狗相处怎么样？

original: I'd rather spend the gold on a new litter of pups, but the horses bring in more gold.
traduit: 我宁愿把钱拿去再养一窝新小狗子，马上就能赚更多。

original: Think we should buy more horses next season?
traduit: 我们下个季度要不要多买点马？

original: We're not fighting we're just.... Why don't I get you something to eat? Mama and papa will talk later.
traduit: 我们不是吵架，我们只是……要不要带你去吃点东西？妈妈和爸爸一会儿再谈。

original: Mama, why are you and papa fighting?
traduit: 妈妈，你为什么和爸爸吵架？

original: You want to give up now? Out of fear? Is that what we're teaching our daughter?
traduit: 你想现在放弃吗？害怕了？我们就是这么教女儿的吗？

original: You're closing the stall, and that's final.
traduit: 你得把摊位关了，就这么定了。

original: What am I supposed to do? Never leave the house? You want that, Endon?
traduit: 你要我怎么办？永远不出门吗？你想怎么样，恩东？

original: If you can't pound the dusk out of your iron, it'll break when it's finished. Hit. It. Harder.
traduit: 如果你不能把铁里的杂质敲出来，完工之后就会破裂。重重地，敲它。

original: I'm sorry, Ghorza. I just... flinch, and uh....
traduit: 抱歉，果扎。我只是……有点退缩，而且呃……

original: You strike your metal like a new mother giving her babe a light slap. Hit it harder.
traduit: 你敲金属的时候就像刚当妈的轻轻拍孩子。大着点儿劲。

original: You grew up in a stronghold?
traduit: 你是在要塞长大的吗？

original: That's right. An Orc stronghold. Kept to ourselves. Lived as our ancestors would have wanted.
traduit: 没错。兽人要塞。自治自管。按照我们祖先的意志生活。

original: Wasn't enough for me, though. I left. Didn't want to end up as the third wife of some lowly chieftain.
traduit: 但对我来说不够。所以我离开了。我可不想成为某个二流酋长的第三个老婆。

original: Where'd you learn to smith?
traduit: 你从哪儿学的锻造？

original: Grew up in a stronghold. Every Orc girl tended the forge at some point.
traduit: 我在要塞里长大，每个兽人女孩都会有机会去照看铁匠铺。

original: But a girl has to grow up, and life in the stronghold asked for a lot in return, so I joined the Legion. Mastered my trade there.
traduit: 但女孩儿总会长大，要塞里的生活要求很多回报，所以我加入了军团，在那里掌握了自己的手艺。

original: I was wondering where I could get a drink.
traduit: 我想找地方喝一杯。

original: That's about the only harmless thing you can do in this city. Silver-Blood Inn is the place to go.
traduit: 这大概是你能在这城里做得唯一人畜无害的事了。银血旅馆是个好地方。

original: And once you've had your fill of mead, do us all a favor and go home. Markarth has enough trouble.
traduit: 等你喝完蜜酒，再帮我们个忙，回家去吧。马卡斯的麻烦已经够多了。

original: I'm looking for work, if you have any.
traduit: 我在找工作，你这里有吗？

original: I don't. Go bother Kleppr at the Silver-Blood Inn, he handles the newcomers.
traduit: 没有。去银血旅店找克莱珀吧，他会帮新来的。

original: And by Ysmir, if you find work, just do what you're told. There's enough trouble in Markarth already.
traduit: 还有，伊斯米尔在上，如果你找到了工作，按吩咐办就好。马卡斯的麻烦够多了。

original: I wanted to know more about Markarth.
traduit: 我想知道关于马卡斯的更多事。

original: Then you're talking to the wrong man. You want that elf in the keep. Calcelmo.
traduit: 那你找错人了。去找要塞里的那个精灵吧。他叫卡塞莫。

original: The only thing I'll tell you about Markarth is stay out of our business. We have enough around here without some outsider causing trouble.
traduit: 关于马卡斯，我唯一能告诉你的，就是别多管闲事。我们这里的麻烦更多了，不能再让外人惹麻烦了。

original: Why are you bothering me, kinsman?
traduit: 老乡，你烦我作甚？

original: Why are you bothering me, outsider?
traduit: 外来者，你烦我作甚？

original: What do you mean by "blood and silver"?
traduit: 你说的“血与银”是怎么回事？

original: It's right there in the name of the most powerful family in Markarth. The Silver-Bloods.
traduit: 这就是马卡斯最有权势的家族的名字。银血。

original: They have a whole mine filled with prisoners to dig up silver ore, gets smelted by workers they pay, and they own half the city.
traduit: 他们坐拥整个矿场，里面全是被派去挖银矿的囚犯，再由他们雇工冶炼，而且他们还拥有半个城市。

original: I work for them. The inn is named after them. When the guards make an arrest, they check with them first.
traduit: 我替他们工作。连旅店都是用他们的名字命名的。当卫兵要逮捕谁时，都要先和他们核对。

original: Jarl is who you want to talk to. Always coin to be made killing off some Forsworn in the hills.
traduit: 你该去找领主。去杀山里的弃誓者总能赚到钱。

original: As long as you don't mind going axe-to-axe with a bunch of Daedra-worshipping savages who practice the dark arts.
traduit: 如果你不介意和一群崇拜迪德拉、练习黑魔法的野蛮人大砍大杀的话。

original: You live here in Markarth?
traduit: 你在马卡斯住？

original: No. I live in a nice house in Solitude where the air isn't filled with smoke from the silver smelters and golden-haired girls shine my shield.
traduit: 不。我住在独孤城的一所好房子里，空气里没有冶炼银矿的烟雾，到处都是金发女孩儿。

original: Been here ever since I left the Bards College. Turns out a few muscles earn more gold than a damn lute.
traduit: 我离开吟游诗人学院之后就一直在这里。原来卖弄肌肉比该死的鲁特琴要赚得多。

original: The Silver-Bloods pay me, let me crack a few skulls, and keep the guards off my back. That's all I need.
traduit: 银血家雇了我，让我敲碎几个人的脑袋，还让卫兵不敢管我。这才是我需要的。

original: Are you threatening me?
traduit: 你威胁我？

original: If I was threatening you, believe me, you'd know it.
traduit: 如果我想威胁你，相信我，你会知道的。

original: You outsiders never learn. If the Forsworn don't get you, the guards will throw you in Cidhna Mine to work your fingers off.
traduit: 你们这些外来户总也学不聪明。如果弃誓者没抓到你，卫兵也会把你扔进希讷矿场，让你把手指头都累折了。

original: Think that's water in the river? Blood and silver are what flows through Markarth, friend.
traduit: 你觉得那河里流的是水？那是马卡斯流淌的血与银。

original: More blood is always better.
traduit: 血流得越多越好。

original: Then you've found your home, friend. Blood and silver are what flows through Markarth. Welcome.
traduit: 那你算是找到家了，朋友。马卡斯流的就是血与银。欢迎欢迎。

original: Bloody enough.
traduit: 太血腥了。

original: Then turn around and go back where you came. City doesn't need you, doesn't want you.
traduit: 那就转过身去，从哪儿来回哪儿去吧。这城市不需要你，也不欢迎你。

original: Blood and silver are what flows through Markarth. That's the way it is. That's the way it'll stay.
traduit: 马卡斯流的就是血与银。事实如此。而且会一直这样下去。

original: Excuse me?
traduit: 不好意思？

original: Markarth. Is it bloody enough for you?
traduit: 马卡斯。对你来说够血腥吗？

original: Bloody enough for you, outsider?
traduit: 感觉够血腥了吗，外来者？

original: Why do you think the Battle-Borns are involved?
traduit: 你为什么觉得战狂会参与其中？

original: It's hardly a secret that they have ties to the Empire, and hate anyone who speaks out against it.
traduit: 他们和帝国有联系，这不是什么秘密，他们痛恨任何公开反对帝国的人。

original: Thorald did worse. He took action against the Empire, and the Battle-Borns knew it.
traduit: 索拉德做得比这更狠。他直接采取行动反抗帝国了，战狂也知道。

original: The Battle-Borns. The Emperor's biggest boot-lickers here in Whiterun.
traduit: 战狂，是白漫城里皇帝最大的马屁精。

original: Their connections to the Empire and the Legion are well-known. When Thorald didn't return home, there was no question in my mind.
traduit: 他们和帝国还有军团的联系人所共知。索拉德没回来，我第一反应就是他们干的。

original: They knew Thorald supported the Stormcloaks, knew he was going to aid them in battle. Made sure he didn't come back.
traduit: 他们知道索拉德支持风暴斗篷，知道他去参军了。肯定会把他抓起来。

original: Locked him up someplace to get back at my family. I'm sure of it.
traduit: 把他关在什么地方来报复我们家。我敢肯定。

original: No, I'm not.
traduit: 不，还没有。

original: Time is of the essence here, please hurry back.
traduit: 时间紧迫，请快点回来。

original: What if Mercer's there?
traduit: 墨瑟如果在那怎么办？

original: Then we show them Gallus's journal and hope for the best.
traduit: 那我们就把加卢斯的日记给他们看，希望一切顺利。

original: Remember, we have proof and all he's got is his word.
traduit: 记住，我们手里有证据，他只有一张嘴。

original: Keep your eyes open. I'm not sure what to expect when we enter the cistern.
traduit: 保持警惕。不知道进了蓄水池之后会发生什么。

original: I'm glad you're here. I think some of these people are beginning to suspect who I am.
traduit: 很高兴你来了。我觉得有人已经开始怀疑我的身份了。

original: Are you ready to face the Guild?
traduit: 准备好面对公会了吗？

original: Are you finished your other business and ready to face the Guild?
traduit: 事情都办完了吗，准备好面对公会了？

original: By the Eight! It's gone, everything's gone! Get in here, all of you!
traduit: 八圣灵在上！没了，全没了！大家快过来！

original: I've used my key, but the vault's still locked up tighter than a drum. Now use yours.
traduit: 我用了钥匙，但金库锁得严严实实。现在换你吧。

original: Use your key on the vault, Delvin. We'll open it up and find out the truth.
traduit: 戴尔文，用你的钥匙去把金库打开。我们会弄清真相的。

original: What's she on about?
traduit: 她在说什么？

original: He didn't need to pick the lock.
traduit: 他不需要开锁。

original: That door has the best puzzle locks money can buy. There's no way it can be picked open.
traduit: 那扇门上有市面上最好的锁。不可能撬得开。

original: It says Mercer's been stealing from our vault for years. Gallus was looking into it before he was murdered.
traduit: 上面说，墨瑟多年来一直从咱们的金库里偷东西。加卢斯遇害前就调查过。

original: What's in that book? What did it say?
traduit: 那本书里写了什么？

original: Wait just a blessed moment, Bryn.
traduit: 等一下，布林。

original: It's true, Brynjolf. Every word. Mercer's been stealing from the Guild for years, right under your noses.
traduit: 是真的，布林乔夫。每个字都是。墨瑟这么多年一直在你们眼皮底下偷公会的东西。

original: There's only one way to find out if what the lass says is true. Delvin, I'll need you to open the Vault.
traduit: 只有一个办法知道那姑娘说的是真是假。戴尔文，打开金库。

original: This can't be true. I've known Mercer too long...
traduit: 这不可能。我和墨瑟相识多年……

original: No, it... it can't be.
traduit: 不，这……这不可能。

original: I have Gallus's journal. I think you'll find its contents disturbing.
traduit: 我有加卢斯的日记。你会发现里面的内容令人不安。

original: Now what's this so-called proof you speak of?
traduit: 你所谓的证据是什么？

original: No tricks, Karliah or I'll cut you down where you stand.
traduit: 别想耍花招，卡莱亚，否则我就当场把你砍了。

original: Please, lower your weapons so we can speak. I have proof that you've all been misled!
traduit: 请放下武器，我们得谈谈。我有证据证明你们被骗了！

original: You better have a damn good reason to be here with that murderer.
traduit: 和那个杀人犯站在一起最好有个好理由。

original: How can you be sure Thorald is still alive?
traduit: 你怎么肯定索拉德还活着？

original: He's my son. I just... I feel it in my heart. You'd understand if you had children.
traduit: 他是我儿子。我们……母子连心啊。如果你有孩子你也会明白的。

original: Arch-Mage Aren is dead?
traduit: 阿冉大法师死了？

original: I can hardly believe it.
traduit: 我简直不敢相信。

original: But there's no time. Whatever happened here has affected Winterhold as well. I need you to get out there and make sure everything's all right.
traduit: 但是没时间了。这里发生的一切已经影响冬堡了。你需要去确保城区的安全。

original: I'll do what I can here. Go now, go!
traduit: 我会尽力维持这里。现在就去，快！

original: It's Ancano. He's done something with the Eye!
traduit: 是安卡诺。他对“眼”动了手脚！

original: By the Nine...
traduit: 九圣灵……

original: Is he responsible for this? The Arch-Mage, dead?
traduit: 他是罪魁祸首？大法师是因他而死？

original: There's more. Something's happened to Winterhold. It must be whatever Ancano did. You need to get out there and make sure it's safe.
traduit: 还有。冬堡城区出事了。肯定也是安卡诺干的好事。你得快去确保那里的安全。

original: Quickly now, quickly! I'll find Mirabelle and see if we can't put a stop to this!
traduit: 快，快！我会去找米拉贝勒，看看能不能阻止这一切！

original: Are you all right? What happened in there?
traduit: 你没事吧？里面发生什么了？

original: Delvin, Vex... watch the Flagon. If you see Mercer, come tell me right away.
traduit: 戴尔文，小烦……照看漏壶。一旦发现墨瑟立刻告诉我。

original: Vex! Put it away... right now.
traduit: 小烦！把刀收起来……现在。

original: We can't afford to lose our heads... we need to calm down and focus.
traduit: 我们不能失智……冷静下来，集中精神。

original: That son-of-a-bitch! I'll kill him!
traduit: 那个狗娘养的！我要杀了他！

original: The gold, the jewels... it's all gone.
traduit: 金子、珠宝……全没了。

original: Why do you think Ulfric killed the High King?
traduit: 你觉得乌弗瑞克为什么要杀了至高王？

original: No doubt he thought it was the only way to make his point. And also because he knew he could.
traduit: 毫无疑问，他觉得这是表明自己观点的唯一途径。而且他也知道自己能做到。

original: Whose side are you on?
traduit: 你支持哪边？

original: If it's the war you're referring to, I'm on the side of Whiterun.
traduit: 如果你是指这场战争，那我是站在白漫这边的。

original: No doubt General Tullius and his friends in the Empire will tell you that I owe them my loyalty, and perhaps I do.
traduit: 图留斯将军和他在帝国那侧的朋友们无疑会告诉你，我应该对他们忠诚，也许我确实该如此。

original: Ulfric Stormcloak would say that I owe my allegiance to the Nord people as they fight for Skyrim's independence. Perhaps this is also true.
traduit: 乌弗瑞克·风暴斗篷会说我应该忠于为天际独立而战的诺德人。也许这也没错。

original: The day might come when I am forced to draw my sword for one side or the other.
traduit: 总有一天我会被迫拔剑为其中一方而战。

original: But that day has not come yet.
traduit: 但这一天还未到来。

original: Where are your children?
traduit: 你的孩子们呢？

original: If the gods are merciful, they've found a safe place to hide in the city.
traduit: 若是诸神垂怜，他们应该已经在城里找到了安全的藏身之所。

original: I hope Vignar doesn't find them. He'll ask a king's ransom, I'm sure.
traduit: 希望维吉纳找不到他们。我敢肯定他会索要一大笔赎金的。

original: No doubt you welcomed the Stormcloaks with open arms.
traduit: 你肯定是张开双臂欢迎风暴斗篷了。

original: With open arms, with cheers and song, with joy in my heart and tears in my eyes!
traduit: 张开双臂，欢呼歌唱，心中欢乐，眼含热泪！

original: Praise be to Talos, this is a glorious day for Whiterun and for all Skyrim! Our liberators have come at last!
traduit: 赞美塔洛斯，这是白漫与全天际都为之光荣的一天！我们的解放者终于到来了！

original: Are you glad the Stormcloaks are in charge?
traduit: 你很高兴风暴斗篷来统治吗？

original: I'm sure my brother Vignar is, since they made him Jarl after throwing Balgruuf out.
traduit: 我兄弟维吉纳肯定是，因为他们赶走巴尔古夫之后立他为领主了。

original: Comes the end of the day, Imperials and Stormcloaks ain't much different.
traduit: 说到底，帝国和风暴斗篷没什么不同。

original: Both sides want to tell you how you should live your life. Guess I'd rather hear it from a real Nord than some Emperor down south.
traduit: 双方都想告诉你该如何生活。我宁愿听真正的诺德人来说，也不会听南边皇帝的。

original: Have the Stormcloaks treated you roughly?
traduit: 风暴斗篷对你很粗暴吗？

original: Of course they have! I've made no secret of my loyalty to the Empire. I'm no coward.
traduit: 当然了！我毫不掩饰自己对帝国的忠诚。我可不是懦夫。

original: Twice I've been robbed, and good luck getting any kind of justice from Vignar now that he's the Jarl. He probably told the Stormcloaks to do it.
traduit: 我被抢了两次，现在维吉纳当了首领，也就没处讨公道了。估计也是他指使风暴斗篷来干的。

original: Lately, they've been threatening to send my whole family into exile if we're caught collaborating with the Empire. They think we're spies!
traduit: 最近，他们威胁说如果抓到我们与帝国勾结，就把我全家流放。他们觉得我们是间谍！

original: Needless to say, these rebels and I have no love for each other.
traduit: 也不消说了，反正这些叛军和我互相看不顺眼。

original: Are you pleased to see the Stormcloaks in charge?
traduit: 你很高兴看到风暴斗篷掌权吗？

original: Pleased enough, I suppose. At least they appreciate the ways and traditions of the Nord people.
traduit: 当然很高兴。至少他们欣赏诺德人的生活方式和传统。

original: Can't say I ever much liked the idea of the Empire telling us what to do an' how to do it.
traduit: 我可不喜欢帝国来告诉我们什么该做什么不该做。

original: The College of Winterhold is an amazing sight. I've never set foot on the grounds, but always wanted to.
traduit: 冬堡学院是一道令人惊叹的风景线。我从未来过这片土地但心向往之。

original: The Forsworn haven't been kind to Karthwasten. I've heard rumors that they've attacked this place without mercy.
traduit: 弃誓者对卡斯威斯腾可没客气过，我听说他们袭击过这儿，那叫一个心狠手辣。

original: I grew up in The Pale. This land was my home for most of my life... and for a Dunmer, that's quite a statement, I assure you.
traduit: 我在苍原领长大。这片土地是我大半辈子的家……对于一个丹莫来说，这句话够分量。

original: We should bow our heads in silent reverence for those who are interred in Falkreath's cemetery.
traduit: 我们应该向安葬在佛克瑞斯墓地的人们低头默哀。

original: I've always wanted to make a pilgrimage here to the Temple of Mara. Thank you for bringing me here... you've made me quite happy.
traduit: 我一直很想去玛拉神殿朝圣。谢谢你带我来这里……我很高兴。

original: Watch your step, Markarth has quite a reputation thanks to the Silver-Blood family. I wouldn't advise crossing them.
traduit: 小心点，多亏了银血家族马卡斯算是名声大噪了。我可不建议你轻视他们。

original: What an amazing city. I've actually never managed to visit Whiterun, but I always wanted to.
traduit: 真是个神奇的城市。我还从没来过白漫城，但我一直想来一趟。

original: Windhelm is absolutely freezing. How can these people tolerate it?
traduit: 风舵城真是够冷的。这些人是怎么忍下来的？

original: I was a student at the Bards College for a short time... until my affiliation with Vaermina was discovered. I haven't been back to Solitude since.
traduit: 我曾经在吟游诗人学院上过一阵子学……直到我和瓦尔迷纳的关系被撞破了，我就再没回过独孤城了。

original: I've heard Riften's home to the worst Skyrim has to offer. I hope we don't run into any trouble while we're here.
traduit: 我听说裂谷城是天际最烂的地方。希望别在这里遇到什么麻烦。

original: Her Benevolence has taught me patience and mercy, but these vampires deserve none of it.
traduit: 她的慈惠教导我要耐心和仁慈，但这些吸血鬼不配得到它。

original: A good friend of mine was infected by a vampire long ago. He killed himself rather than change into one of those... things.
traduit: 我的一个好朋友很久以前也被吸血鬼感染了。他宁愿自杀也不愿变成那样的……东西。

original: Vampires are utter abominations. We need to do everything in our power to destroy them.
traduit: 吸血鬼太恶心了。我们要尽自己所能消灭他们。

original: Being a priest of Vaermina put me very close to dark sorcery at its worst.
traduit: 成为瓦尔迷纳的祭司让我接触到了最邪恶的黑暗魔法。

original: Let's try and stay together, the sorcerers in these places tend to... well, harvest bodies for parts.
traduit: 我们尽量待在一起，住在这种地方的术士往往会……嗯，收集尸体部件。

original: I've seen my share of black magic, but that's all in the past now.
traduit: 我也曾经使用过黑魔法，但那都是过去的事了。

original: This place must be cleansed. These draugr were once living beings and they deserve better.
traduit: 这地方必须清理干净。这些尸鬼一度拥有生命，他们应该得到安息。

original: These poor souls... suffering in eternal servitude.
traduit: 可怜的灵魂……居然忍受着永恒的奴役。

original: The thought of the dead rising... makes me sick to my stomach.
traduit: 一想到复活死人……就让我倒胃口。

original: Bandits know nothing of pity or mercy. No need to show them any either.
traduit: 强盗都是不知怜悯之心的。所以也没必要展示给他们看。

original: A group of bandits descended on Dawnstar once... if it wasn't for the guard, who knows what they could have done to the place.
traduit: 有一次一群强盗袭击了晨星……要不是那个卫兵，谁知道那些人会对这地方做什么。

original: Bandits are the worst lot. They'd steal from their own mothers given the chance.
traduit: 强盗都是烂人。只要有机会，连亲妈都能偷。

original: I thought I heard footsteps. Be careful.
traduit: 我好像听到了脚步声。小心。

original: When I was a young acolyte of Vaermina, I paid my dues in a shrine located within the catacombs of a fort in Cyrodiil.
traduit: 当我还是个瓦尔迷纳的年轻侍僧时，我在希罗帝尔一个堡垒的地下墓穴里向神坛进行了起誓。

original: I served as a healer in a fort not unlike this one long ago.
traduit: 很久之前，我在一个堡垒里当治疗师，跟这差不多。

original: I can't imagine what happened to the dwarves. How could a race with the capability to build a place like this simply vanish?
traduit: 我无法想象矮人究竟发生了什么。一个有能力建造这种地方的种族怎么会消失呢？

original: I've never been inside a dwarven ruin. They are simply astounding.
traduit: 我从没进过矮人遗迹。真是令人惊叹。

original: Did you hear that? A metal on stone sound... hmmm, perhaps it was nothing.
traduit: 你有听到吗？是金属撞在石头上的声音……嗯，也许没什么。

original: This place could be massive... very easy to get lost. We have to be careful not to lose our way.
traduit: 这地方可能很大……容易迷路。我们得小心点别走迷糊了。

original: What a marvel of engineering. The ancient Nords were ingenious builders.
traduit: 何等伟大的工程。古诺德人真是能工巧匠。

original: Ugh, this place... horrible.
traduit: 啊，这地方……够可怕。

original: Watch yourself, these Nordic ruins are notorious for their traps.
traduit: 小心点，这些诺德遗迹里的陷阱是出了名的。

original: These ruins are old, maybe a thousand years or more.
traduit: 这些遗迹很古老，得有千年以上了吧。

original: Why anything would chose to reside down here is beyond me.
traduit: 我不明白为什么会有生物选择住在这里。

original: These caves... they harbor ill omens, I can sense it.
traduit: 这些洞穴……我有不祥的预感。

original: Trust in Mara... she'll protect us in this dark place.
traduit: 相信玛拉……她会在这个黑暗的地方保护我们。

original: I don't like the looks of this place... not at all.
traduit: 我不喜欢这种地方……一点也不。

original: I don't know what persuaded you to assist me when we met in Dawnstar, but I'm glad you did.
traduit: 我不知道我们在晨星初遇的时候，你为什么要帮我，但我很高兴你能这么做。

original: I've done a lot of... questionable things in my life. Serving Vaermina was a horrible mistake, and I hope Mara will forgive me one day.
traduit: 我这辈子……做过许多错事。信仰瓦尔迷纳是个可怕的错误，希望玛拉有一天能宽恕我。

original: I was recruited as an acolyte of Vaermina as a young elf. I had no real childhood to speak of... we weren't permitted to socialize.
traduit: 我年轻时就被招纳为瓦尔迷纳的侍僧。没有真正的童年可言……我们不允许与他人交往。

original: I've always felt a great deal of guilt running from Nightcaller Temple and leaving my friends to die. I'll never forgive myself for that.
traduit: 我一直对自己逃离唤夜神殿留下朋友等死的行径非常愧疚。我永远也无法原谅自己。

original: After running from Nightcaller Temple, I wandered Skyrim for years until I was taken in by a priest of Mara who lived in Morthal.
traduit: 从唤夜神殿逃离后，我在天际游荡了几年，直到我被一个住在莫萨尔的玛拉祭司收留了。

original: Finding Mara was the greatest moment of my life. I'll never forget the warmth that spread through my heart when we embraced.
traduit: 找到玛拉是我人生最重要的时刻。我永远不会忘记我投入她怀抱时，内心的温暖。

original: It was a bit difficult to come to the ways of Mara at first, but my fellow priests were kind and quite patient with me.
traduit: 一开始，我也很难适应玛拉的生活方式，但我的祭司同伴们都很友善，对我非常有耐心。

original: I've never admitted this before, but I've killed more than I care to admit. I'll just leave it at that.
traduit: 我以前从没承认过，但我确实杀过人，而且多到我都不愿承认。就讲这些吧。

original: My parents are long dead, but they lived wonderful lives... I have no sad stories to tell about them. Perhaps one day I'll visit their resting place.
traduit: 我父母去世很久了，但他们曾经过得很好……我没有什么关于他们的悲惨故事可讲。也许有一天，我会去给他们上坟。

original: I've been enjoying this journey with you. Not for the wealth we've accumulated, but just being carry Mara's will to every corner of Skyrim.
traduit: 我很享受和你在一起的旅程。不只是为我们积累的财富，而是能把玛拉的意志带到天际的每个角落。

original: It's wonderful to be able to sleep soundly, don't you think?
traduit: 能睡个安稳觉真是太好了，你说呢？

original: The Greybeards are an amazing lot. Imagine, living your entire life without speaking to a friend or a loved one. I couldn't stand it.
traduit: 灰胡子真是群了不起的人。想想看，一辈子不和朋友爱人说话。我是受不了。

original: I've been to Ivarstead a few times, but never climbed High Hrothgar. I wouldn't mind visiting the monastery at the summit.
traduit: 我去过伊瓦尔镇几次，但没爬过霍斯加。我不介意去看看山顶那座修道院。

original: When the weather permitted, Aerin and I would often walk the Rift's forests. The trees here are so beautiful.
traduit: 天气好的时候，我和艾灵常去裂痕领的森林里散步。这里的树真漂亮。

original: Ah, Winterhold. I've always wanted to visit this place. The secrets locked inside must be astounding.
traduit: 啊，冬堡。我总是想来看看。里面的秘密一定很惊人。

original: Incredible... imagine the manpower and ingenuity needed to carve the buildings of Markarth.
traduit: 不可思议……想想雕刻马卡斯的建筑需要多少人力和创造力。

original: Whiterun is a such beautiful city. Have you ever seen the likes of this place?
traduit: 白漫这座城市太美了，你见过能比得上这儿的地方吗？

original: This is the first time I've set foot in Windhelm. What a dreary place.
traduit: 这是我第一次踏足风舵城。真是个沉闷的地方。

original: My mother always loved the sea. When I was young, we'd visit Solitude and watch the ships from the bluff. Ah... better times.
traduit: 我母亲很喜欢大海。我小时候，我们常去独孤城在悬崖上看船。啊……多好的时光啊。

original: It feels good to walk the streets of Riften again.
traduit: 再次走在裂谷城的大街上感觉真好。

original: Vampires... an unclean lot. It will be a pleasure to clear this place.
traduit: 吸血鬼……不洁之物。能够清理这个地方是我的荣幸。

original: Don't let the vampires strike you or else you may get infected with their blood poisoning.
traduit: 不要让吸血鬼攻击到你，否则他们的血液可能会让你感染。

original: Be aware of rune traps on the ground or else this could be a very short expedition.
traduit: 注意地上的符文陷阱，否则这次探险就要瞬间结束了。

original: Kill these casters as fast as you can, otherwise they may summon creatures we don't want to deal with.
traduit: 尽快杀掉这些施法者，别让他们召唤出我们不想对付的东西。

original: Ugh... dark sorcery. Always makes my skin crawl.
traduit: 啊……黑暗巫术。每次都让我起鸡皮疙瘩。

original: If there's one thing I'm certain of, it's that draugr burn like tinder. We could use that to our advantage.
traduit: 如果有一件事我可以确定，那就是尸鬼像火绒一样易燃。我们可以利用这一点。

original: Many have fallen in this crypt. The Draugr show no mercy.
traduit: 许多人在这个墓穴里丧命了。尸鬼是没有仁慈之心的。

original: Ugh, Draugr. They reek of decay.
traduit: 啊，尸鬼。一股腐烂味。

original: When I was a child, my village was burned to the ground by bandits. Do you know I actually saw one laugh as he ran my brother through...
traduit: 当我还是个孩子的时候，我的村子被强盗夷为平地了。你知道吗，我看到一个人，笑着把我弟弟撞穿了。

original: I hope there's more bandits around... their numbers could use a little more thinning.
traduit: 我希望这附近还有更多强盗……他们的数量应该再减少些。

original: These bandits would stab each other in the back if it meant an extra coin in their pockets.
traduit: 这些强盗为了多赚一点钱，甚至可以互相背后捅刀子。

original: Bandits... the worst type of scum.
traduit: 强盗……最糟糕的人渣。

original: Perhaps we can find some treasure if we search the grounds of the fort thoroughly.
traduit: 也许我们可以把整个堡垒彻底搜一遍，也许能找到宝藏。

original: If fought more than my share of bandits in places like this.
traduit: 如果能在这地方再多杀些强盗就好了。

original: Keep your eyes open for ambushes. These forts have too many blind corners.
traduit: 睁大眼睛，小心埋伏。这些堡垒死角太多。

original: These are the most dangerous, but the most profitable types of ruins. The dwarves must have been a prosperous race.
traduit: 这种类型的遗迹是最危险的，也是最有利可图的。矮人肯定是个富有的种族。

original: Watch the walls for the sphere constructs... they can appear in the blink of an eye.
traduit: 注意墙壁里的机械球……它们一眨眼就能出现。

original: The dwarves were masters at subterranean construction... these ruins show  only a fraction of their capabilities.
traduit: 矮人是地下建筑的大师……这些遗迹只是展现了他们能力的一小部分。

original: Mzinchaleft. I swore I'd never return here.
traduit: 姆津查莱夫特。我发过誓再也不来了。

original: I almost died in a ruin just like this.
traduit: 我差点就死在了这样的遗迹里。

original: Danger's about, I can tell. Be cautious.
traduit: 我敢说，有危险了。小心点。

original: Can you just imagine how ancient this place must be? Hundreds of years? Thousands?
traduit: 你能想象这地方有多古老吗？几百年？还是上千年？

original: There could be Draugr about, I can smell the decay in the air.
traduit: 这附近可能有尸鬼，我能闻出空气中腐烂的味道。

original: I've ventured into quite a few Nord ruins in my day.
traduit: 我小时候去过不少诺德遗迹。

original: Killed my first creature in a cave just like this... I'll never forget it.
traduit: 就像这样在洞穴里杀死了我杀过的第一只生物……我永远忘不了。

original: I'm certain we'll find some treasure down here.
traduit: 我确定咱们能在这里发现宝藏。

original: Keep your eyes open, I don't like the looks of this place.
traduit: 小心点，我不喜欢这地方的样子。

original: Exploring these caves feels like coming home. I missed this.
traduit: 探索洞穴就好像回家一样。我很怀念。

original: I've really missed traveling like this. Walking the breadth of Skyrim has always filled my heart with excitement.
traduit: 真是怀念这样的旅行。在天际走一走总是让我兴奋不已。

original: I've never been a sellsword... never traded my skills for pay. I've always adventured on my own terms.
traduit: 我从来没当过佣兵……没试着拿自己的技艺赚钱。只是按照自己的想法去冒险。

original: You should have seen me at the height of my adventuring career... I was fearless and took too many risks. But that's what it was all about.
traduit: 你应该看看我冒险事业的巅峰时期……那时我无所畏惧，冒过无数风险。但也就是这些了。

original: I remember a cutpurse trying to rob me on the road once. When I drew Grimsever, I think the poor man soiled his armor!
traduit: 我记得有一次，路上有个小贼想要抢劫我。当我抽出无情切割者的时候，我想这个倒霉蛋会弄脏自己的盔甲！

original: I've seen enough death to last three lifetimes, yet I never tire of a good fight. What do you make of that?
traduit: 我见过的死亡足够我活三辈子了，但我从不厌倦战斗。你怎么看？

original: When I was young, I'd journey with my father on hunting expeditions into Morrowind. The cliff racers made for excellent sport.
traduit: 小时候，我和父亲去晨风打猎。峭壁行者很擅长移动。

original: I love the cold air... it's exhilarating. Perhaps it's because of my Nord blood, but there's something about it that makes me feel alive.
traduit: 寒冷的空气真好……吹得人神清气爽。也许是因为我的诺德血统吧，但这空气里就是有一种东西，让我感受到自己还活着。

original: My father wanted me to follow in his footsteps as a hunter, but I set my aspirations a bit higher. He never complained... I miss him.
traduit: 我父亲想让我追随他的脚步成为一名猎人，但我想把志向定的高些。他从没有抱怨过什么……我很想念他。

original: My mother was a strong woman... she's the one who instructed me on my swordfighting techniques. Can you imagine?
traduit: 我母亲是个强壮的女人……我的剑术是她教的。你信吗？

original: People say Skyrim is one of the most dangerous places in Tamriel. I think they're wrong... it's magnificent and I'm proud to call it home.
traduit: 人们都说天际是泰姆瑞尔最危险的地方之一。我觉得他们错了……这里很壮丽，我很自豪将这里称之为家乡。

original: As we walk these stone passages, we delve into the very bones of the earth.
traduit: 当我们行走在这些石头通道里，我们就是在挖掘地骨。

original: There is an unnatural chill in the air. Some evil power is at work in this place.
traduit: 空气中有股反常的寒意。这里有邪恶的力量作祟。

original: I do not envy those creatures that make a home in such cold, dark places as this.
traduit: 我可不羡慕那些在这么寒冷黑暗地方安家的生物。

original: Careful. Our footsteps will echo in every chamber and tunnel.
traduit: 小心。我们的脚步声会回荡在每个房间和通道里。

original: By the Nine, I'd pay good money for a pint of ale to warm my bones!
traduit: 九圣灵在上，我得买一大杯麦芽酒暖暖身子！

original: Curse this chill! I should have dressed more warmly.
traduit: 该死的寒意！我该穿暖和点的。

original: If this cold numbs my fingers any worse, I'll scarcely be able to hold a weapon.
traduit: 如果手指再冻僵一点，我就该拿不住武器了。

original: Gods, I'd hate to lose my footing in a place like this. A fall on this stony floor will break bones.
traduit: 神啊，我可不想在这种地方滑一跤。摔在这种石板地上肯定会摔折骨头的。

original: Take extra care you don't hit your head on a low-hanging bit of stone.
traduit: 小心点，脑袋别撞在垂下来的石头上。

original: Mind your step. I think I spied a patch of ice on the floor.
traduit: 脚下留神。我看地上好像有块冰。

original: Don't go stopping for a nap. If you fall asleep in this place, you'll never wake up.
traduit: 不要停下打盹。在这儿睡着了可就醒不过来了。

original: Are you sure you can find your way? It would be easy to get lost in here.
traduit: 你确定能找到路吗？在这里很容易迷路。

original: This cold is unbearable. It's all I can do not to shiver until my teeth rattle.
traduit: 这冷劲儿真让人受不了。我现在也只能忍住不打牙战。

original: Would it be foolish to stop for a while and light a fire? I suppose it would.
traduit: 停下来一会儿生个火是不是很蠢？我想是的。

original: Gods willing, we'll find a chest full of gold in one of these chambers.
traduit: 诸神保佑啊，但愿我们能在某个房间找到装满金币的宝箱。

original: At times like this, I truly appreciate the joys of a warm fire and a stiff drink.
traduit: 这种时候，我真的很羡慕温暖的炉火和烈酒带来的乐趣。

original: There are strange echoes in these caves. Keep you eyes open.
traduit: 这些洞穴里有奇怪的回声。睁大眼睛。

original: If a man can't feel at home in a freezing cave, then he isn't truly a Nord.
traduit: 如果一个人没法在寒冷的洞穴里找到家的感觉，那就不是真正的诺德人。

original: I have to admit, I admire your courage. Most folk in Skyrim wouldn't go near a place like this.
traduit: 我得承认，我很佩服你的勇气。天际中大部分人都不会靠近这种地方。

original: When I was a boy, my friends and I used to play "seek the wumpus" in caves much like this.
traduit: 我小时候经常和朋友们在这种洞穴里玩“寻找狮头象”的游戏。

original: Caves sounded more exciting in the bard's songs.
traduit: 在诗人的歌中，洞穴总是令人兴奋的。

original: It's kind of dark in here.
traduit: 这里有点暗啊。

original: How deep is this cave?
traduit: 这洞到底有多深？

original: It feels like a whole mountain of rock is above  us.
traduit: 感觉有一整座岩山在我们上面。

original: In a mine, the poor man labors to find precious stones that only the rich man can afford.
traduit: 在矿场，穷人们在努力寻找只有富人买得起的宝石。

original: I wonder how many poor souls have lost their lives working these tunnels.
traduit: 我想知道有多少可怜人在这些隧道里失去了生命。

original: These earthen passages do not agree with me. I already miss the wind and sky.
traduit: 这些土道不适合我，我开始想念风和天空了。

original: The fewer of these mines we venture into, the happier I'll be.
traduit: 我们能少去几个矿井就好了。

original: The cloying air in this place is almost unbearable.
traduit: 这地方的空气令人腻味，难以忍受啊。

original: By the gods, let this mine be small so we can be done with it quickly.
traduit: 神啊，让这个矿变小一点吧，这样就能快点挖完了。

original: My nose and mouth are so full of dust, I can hardly breath.
traduit: 我的鼻子和嘴里都塞满了灰，快喘不过气了。

original: Wouldn't it be something if we found a vein of gold?
traduit: 如果咱们发现了金矿，那不是很了不起吗？

original: It would be easy for someone -- or something -- to sneak up on us down here.
traduit: 在这里，要是有什么人，或者东西，接近我们很容易。

original: Are you sure you wouldn't rather explore, say, a nice tavern?
traduit: 你确定你不想去逛逛，比如，一家不错的酒馆？

original: Let's try not to make too much noise. I've heard that cave-ins can start that way.
traduit: 我们尽量别制造太多噪音。我听说塌方很可能就是这样开始的。

original: I wonder what they were mining down here.
traduit: 我想知道他们在这里挖什么。

original: Let's hope the miners didn't unearth anything besides precious stones, if you take my meaning.
traduit: 但愿矿工们除了宝石别挖出其他东西，你懂的。

original: Not for all the gold in Skyrim would I spend my life working in these tunnels.
traduit: 即使能赚到全天际所有金币，我也不愿意在矿井里过一辈子。

original: I've heard that miners sometimes die from poisonous gases trapped beneath the ground.
traduit: 我听说矿工有时候是被地下的有毒气体熏死的。

original: I'm already looking forward to getting back above ground.
traduit: 我已经很期待返回地面上了。

original: You know what I miss the most right now? Fresh air.
traduit: 你知道我现在最想念什么吗？新鲜的空气。

original: It takes uncommon strength to work the mines in Skyrim. The earth here is cold and hard, like the heart of a Nord.
traduit: 在天际挖矿需要非凡的力量。这里的土地又冷又硬，就像诺德人的心。

original: There's an old maid's tale that says our ancestors dug these mines with their bare hands.
traduit: 有个古老传说说我们的祖先是徒手挖矿的。

original: I've half a mind to grab a pickaxe and start digging. Never know what you might find.
traduit: 我真想拿把鹤嘴锄开挖了。你永远不知道自己能发现什么。

original: It seems warmer down here than it was outside.
traduit: 这里似乎比外面暖和啊。

original: Hard to believe people actually have to work in places like this.
traduit: 很难相信人们真的要在这种地方工作。

original: Wonder what they mine from these walls.
traduit: 不知道他们在这些墙上挖到什么。

original: I'll take a sword or mace over a pick axe any day.
traduit: 总有一天我要用剑或者钉锤代替鹤嘴锄。

original: Do you think we'll find gold nuggets in here?
traduit: 你决定我们能在这里找到金子吗？

original: It is strange to think that these chambers were once home to the ancient Nords.
traduit: 奇怪的是，这些房间曾经是古诺德人的家。

original: I feel the eyes of angry spirits upon us. We are not welcome here.
traduit: 我能感受到愤怒的精魂们投来的目光。我们好像不太受欢迎啊。

original: Few would dare to trespass in these ruins. What you lack in wisdom, you make up for in courage.
traduit: 很少有人敢闯进这些遗迹。你的勇气能补上智慧不够的问题了。

original: Do not ask me to take treasures from this place. I will not risk the anger of the dead.
traduit: 别让我从这里拿走财宝。我可不想惹死人生气。

original: They say ruins like these are filled with treasure. Of course, they're filled with traps, too.
traduit: 他们说这些遗迹盛满了宝藏。当然，陷阱也多得很。

original: I could have sworn I heard something right behind us.
traduit: 我发誓刚才听到后面有动静了。

original: I'll bet some of these artifacts would fetch a good price. I hope they're not cursed.
traduit: 我敢赌这里有些宝贝能买个好价钱。但愿它们没被下什么诅咒。

original: I wonder what the ancient Nords did in these ruins. Unspeakable sacrifices, maybe?
traduit: 我想知道古诺德人在这些遗迹里做些什么。也许是什么莫名其妙的祭祀？

original: If these ruins frighten you, take comfort in the knowledge that I am here.
traduit: 如果这些遗迹让你害怕，没关系，我就在这里陪着你。

original: Do try not to set off any traps, will you?
traduit: 尽量别触发什么陷阱，好吗？

original: I suppose you intend to carry off every item of value in these ruins.
traduit: 你是想把遗迹里所有值钱东西都拿走吧。

original: These ruins might be interesting if I wasn't already an expert on Nordic history.
traduit: 如果我不是个诺德历史专家，这些遗迹可能看着更有趣。

original: Remember to check behind you every once in a while. Who knows what might try to sneak up on us.
traduit: 记得隔阵子就看看身后。谁知道会不会有什么东西偷偷接近我们。

original: Keep your eyes open for traps. Old ruins like this are usually filled with them.
traduit: 睁大眼睛，小心陷阱。这种古遗迹里大多都有。

original: The ancient Nords were a savage people, but they built some remarkable crypts and temples.
traduit: 古诺德人是很野蛮，但他们建造的坟墓和神殿很不凡。

original: There's a lot of history in a place like that. I'll bet these walls could tell some amazing stories.
traduit: 这些地方都有很多历史。我打赌这些墙壁会讲述很多精彩的故事。

original: Look at this craftsmanship! These old halls fill some folk with dread, but as a Nord, they fill me with pride.
traduit: 看看这工艺！这些古老的大厅让人感到恐惧，但身为诺德人，它们让我感到骄傲。

original: We're bound to find some gold in these ruins, but out of respect, let's leave a few coins for the dead.
traduit: 我们肯定能在这些遗迹里找到金币，但出于尊重，还是要给逝者留几个钱。

original: It's strange to think that some of my own ancestors might be buried in here.
traduit: 一想到我有些祖先可能就埋在这里，就会感觉很奇怪。

original: Plunder these ruins at your peril, friend. The spirits of the dead won't look kindly upon it.
traduit: 朋友，去抢掠这些遗迹吧。死者的灵魂是不会在意的。

original: Never knew a place could be so ancient. I bet it's over a thousand years old.
traduit: 没想到会有这么古老的地方。我打赌这里有上千年历史了。

original: Wonder if any of my ancestors ever walked these halls?
traduit: 不知道我的祖先中是否有人走过这些大厅呢？

original: Everything in here seems to be about death. Burial urns, crypts, funeral shrouds. It's a bit depressing.
traduit: 这里的一切似乎都与死亡有关。骨灰瓮、墓穴、葬礼裹尸布。令人有点沮丧感啊。

original: I wonder what the ancient nords used this place for?
traduit: 我想知道古诺德人用这地方做什么？

original: The Dwemer who built this place were sometimes called Dwarves, but history records that they were no shorter than humans.
traduit: 建造这地方的锻莫有时候也被叫做矮人，但历史记载他们并不比人类矮。

original: There are scholars in Cyrodiil who have dedicated their lives to solving the mystery of the Dwemers' disappearance.
traduit: 希罗帝尔有些学者毕生都致力于解开锻莫失踪之谜。

original: It is remarkable that so many of these ancient Dwemer creations still function.
traduit: 值得注意的是，还有许多古老的锻莫造物还在运作。

original: There are those who believe that the entire Dwemer race will one day return just as suddenly as it vanished.
traduit: 有些人相信，整个锻莫族总有一天会像他们突然消失一样突然回归。

original: What good is a sword or an axe against an enemy made of brass and steel?
traduit: 刀剑斧头对铜头铁脑的敌人有什么用？

original: It's unnatural, building all these machines. If you ask me, the Dwemer got what they deserved.
traduit: 建造这些机械就是忤逆自然。要我说，锻莫是罪有应得。

original: I don't like fighting these Dwemer creations. Where's the fun in killing something that doesn't even bleed?
traduit: 我不想和这些锻莫造物作对。杀死一个连血都不会流的东西有什么意思？

original: Watch out for the hot steam vents down here. They'll burn you worse than fire.
traduit: 小心下面的热蒸汽通风口。它们燎起人来比火还厉害。

original: Had they placed their faith in magic instead of machinery, the Dwemer might still be around.
traduit: 如果他们相信魔法而不是机械，锻莫也许还能存在。

original: A living Dwemer was once discovered in Morrowind. Can you imagine it, being the last surviving member of your race?
traduit: 晨风曾经发现过一个活着的锻莫。你能想象吗，全族最后的幸存者？

original: I should bring some of these Dwemer artifacts to the Arcane University in Cyrodiil for study.
traduit: 我应该带些锻莫文物回希罗帝尔的奥法大学去研究。

original: I wonder what keeps these machines working so long after their masters disappeared.
traduit: 我想知道是什么让这些机械在主人消失这么久之后还能工作。

original: The Dwemer created so many wondrous machines, and yet nobody ever followed in their footsteps. Why is that, I wonder?
traduit: 锻莫创造了这么多奇妙的机械。可为什么没人追随他们脚步？

original: Among other things, the Dwemer were expert trap-makers. Watch the floor for tripwires and false plates.
traduit: 还有啊，锻莫是陷阱行家。小心地板上的绊网和压板。

original: I've half a mind to dismantle one of these Dwemer machines. I'd like to see how it works.
traduit: 我还真想拆台锻莫机械看看里面是咋运作的。

original: I suppose the warmth in this place comes from all the hot steam vents.
traduit: 我想这地方这么暖和是因为这些蒸汽通风口吧。

original: Scholars say the Dwemer were an advanced culture. Ha! The Nords outlasted their entire race. So much for being advanced.
traduit: 学者们说锻莫是一种先进的文化。哈！诺德人比他们整个种族都长。那岂不是高他们一等。

original: I wonder why the Dwemer came to Skyrim. Why did they build this place? I suppose we'll never know.
traduit: 我想知道为什么锻莫会到天际来。他们为什么要建造这种地方？咱们是永远得不到答案了。

original: Do these steel walls and strange Dwemer devices make you uneasy? Perhaps it's just me.
traduit: 这些钢铁墙壁和奇怪的锻莫装置会让你不安吗？也许只是我的问题。

original: I've heard that you can sell Dwemer artifacts on the black market down in Cyrodiil. They fetch a handsome price, too.
traduit: 我听说你可以在希罗帝尔的黑市上卖锻莫文物。它们也能卖个好价钱。

original: This place is amazing! It's hard to believe that mortal hands built them.
traduit: 这地方太棒了！很难相信是出于凡人之手。

original: What do you think these devices were for?
traduit: 你觉得这些装置是干什么用的？

original: The stories don't say why the dwarves disappeared. I wonder if their machines turned on them.
traduit: 传说里没说锻莫为什么消失。我想知道他们的机械是否也会让他们感到兴奋。

original: It's amazing this place is so well preserved. There isn't even a hint of rust.
traduit: 这地方能保存这么好，真是太神奇了。连点锈都没生。

original: So many shadowy corners to strike from! I could learn to like this place.
traduit: 有那么多阴暗的角落可以攻击！我可以学着喜欢这地方。

original: Silence will serve us well in this place. Let us take our foes by surprise.
traduit: 在这地方保持安静对咱有好处。可以出其不意袭击敌人。

original: Be wary for traps. If you spy one, try to get an enemy to trigger it.
traduit: 小心陷阱。如果发现了，试着让敌人去触发它。

original: I can see the battle-lust in your eyes. Doom will surely come to any who cross your path.
traduit: 我能从你眼中看到战斗的欲望。任何与你相遇的人，必遭厄运。

original: If it wasn't for all the dangers in here, this place could almost be cozy.
traduit: 如果不是这地方危险太多，还挺舒适的。

original: When I was a child, I dreamed about having a fort like this all to myself.
traduit: 当我还是个孩子，我就梦想拥有一个这样的城堡。

original: I wonder if we'll come across some bandits who've just finished roasting a rabbit on a spit. Maybe they'll have a keg of ale, too.
traduit: 我想知道我们能不能碰上一群强盗刚刚在烤架上烤完兔子，还备好了一桶麦芽酒。

original: If my ma could see me now, she'd scold me good. She'd tell me I should know better than to go poking around in abandoned forts.
traduit: 如果我妈看到我现在的样子，她会骂我的。她会告诉我，不要在这种废弃堡垒里四处乱晃。

original: This smell of dank earth and worm-eaten wood is going to make me lose my last meal.
traduit: 潮湿的泥土和虫蛀的木头味恶心得我隔夜饭都快出来了。

original: How pathetic, being forced to eke out a miserable existence in a place like this.
traduit: 真可怜，被迫在这种地方过这样的悲惨生活。

original: Just look at this place. Is this what passes for a fort in Skyrim?
traduit: 看看这地方。这就是天际的堡垒吗？

original: The sooner we can get out of this filth-pit, the better.
traduit: 我们赶紧离开这个肮脏的地方才好。

original: These timber supports are rotted through. It's a wonder this place is still standing.
traduit: 这些木架子都烂掉了。这地方还能存在真是个奇迹。

original: Check every crate, chest and barrel you see. Who knows, maybe a few of them have something valuable inside.
traduit: 每个板条箱、宝箱和桶都看看。谁知道会不会找到几个值钱东西呢。

original: Did you bring a torch? These old forts can get pretty dark inside.
traduit: 你带火把了吗？这些老堡垒里很黑啊。

original: There are forts like this all over Skyrim. The Imperials abandoned most of them a long time ago.
traduit: 天际里到处都是这样的堡垒。帝国很久以前就把它们中的大部分抛弃了。

original: Just look at this place. I've seen better workmanship from Nord children only ten winters old.
traduit: 看看这地方。我在十岁的诺德孩子那儿看到过手艺更好的。

original: So this is what passes for Imperial craftsmanship. Try not to sneeze, or you might bring the whole fort down.
traduit: 这就是所谓的帝国工艺了。尽量别打喷嚏，不然整个堡垒都震垮了。

original: What is that stench? Rotting wood, perhaps? That can't be good.
traduit: 这是什么味道？是烂木头？那可不太妙。

original: You'd have to be pretty desperate to want to make a home in this dank hole.
traduit: 想在这么潮湿的洞里安家，你得多绝望才行啊。

original: The Jarls never want to pay to keep the forts. They just keep slipping further into ruin.
traduit: 领主们从来不想着花钱维修一下这些工事，就看着这些东西慢慢变成废墟。

original: I wonder what great battles were fought here?
traduit: 我想知道这里发生过什么大战？

original: Do you think Tiber Septim ever fought here?
traduit: 你觉得泰伯·塞普汀会不会在这里打过仗？

original: I can see why they built the fort here. A small force could control most of the nearby land.
traduit: 我知道他们为什么把堡垒建在这里了。一支小部队就能控制住附近大部分地区。

original: Outlaws and brigands are the lowest of the low. They prey on their own countrymen for profit.
traduit: 亡命徒和强盗都是群贱种。为了牟利不惜掠夺同胞。

original: I hope that when I die, I don't end up as a shambling corpse.
traduit: 我希望我死得时候，可别变成个一瘸一拐的尸体。

original: The Forsworn are as wild as wolves. Practice those old magics, so some folk say.
traduit: 弃誓者野得跟狼似的。有人说，他们在练习那些古老魔法。

original: Wizards. Why is it always wizards.
traduit: 巫师。为什么总有巫师。

original: It isn't just your blood that a vampire wants, it's your mortal soul.
traduit: 吸血鬼不止想喝你的血，还有你的凡人灵魂。

original: Fighting draugr is as much about controlling your fear as anything else.
traduit: 对抗尸鬼其实就是在克服恐惧。

original: Most bandits are cowards. These seem to be braver than most.
traduit: 大多数强盗都是懦夫。这些似乎还算勇敢。

original: These wizards are mad beyond reason. They understand only violence.
traduit: 这些巫师疯得不可理喻。只懂暴力的家伙。

original: There is no greater madness than those who seek to become vampires. That's a dark bargain if there ever was one.
traduit: 没有比那些想变成吸血鬼的人更疯狂的了。如果真有的话，那可真是黑暗的交易。

original: You can easily break a blade on the metal skin of a Dwemer construct.
traduit: 这些锻莫建筑物的金属表皮想崩断你的剑可是很容易的。

original: I hate bandits and thieves. Men like these raid our town every year.
traduit: 我讨厌强盗和小偷。像这样的人每年都会袭击我们的镇子。

original: The Forsworn are strange men. They fight to reclaim Markarth, but they live like savages.
traduit: 弃誓者都是群怪人。他们为了夺回马卡斯而战，却活得像野蛮人一样。

original: I don't like wizards and their spells. Give me an axe any day.
traduit: 我不喜欢巫师和他们的法术。随便给我把斧头就行。

original: These walking devices are strange yet amazing. What magic powers them?
traduit: 这些行走的装置很怪异，也很神奇。它们是靠什么魔力啊？

original: I'd rather fight bandits than draugr. At least bandits know when to stay dead.
traduit: 我宁愿和强盗战斗也不想和尸鬼打架。至少强盗知道什么时候自己会死。

original: Taken alone, the draugr aren't so fearsome. They're far more deadly in greater numbers.
traduit: 单独行动的尸鬼没什么大不了。数量越多才越致命。

original: These Forsworn are just savages. They live in caves and ruins when civilized folk build towns and cities.
traduit: 这些弃誓者都是群蛮子。当文明人开始建造城镇的时候，他们还在住山洞和遗迹。

original: You can't argue with these mages. They'll attack you on sight.
traduit: 别想着和这些法师争论什么。他们看见你就会打过来。

original: It probably took some Dwemer craftsman a year to build one of those things.
traduit: 锻莫工匠想造这样的东西得花上一整年吧。

original: There may be no enemy more foul than a walking corpse.
traduit: 没什么比行尸走肉更可怕的敌人了。

original: I thought about becoming a bandit. I decided I preferred clean clothes and fresh mead.
traduit: 我也想过当强盗。但我更喜欢干净的衣服和新鲜的蜜酒。

original: These ruins and their mechanical inhabitants are all that remain of the Dwemer.
traduit: 这些遗迹和里面的机械住民就是锻莫仅存的痕迹了。

original: It's said that the Forsworn make dark pacts with the Hagravens, and that is why they can use magic.
traduit: 据说弃誓者和乌鸦鬼婆订立了黑暗契约，所以他们才能使用魔法。
