original: There is no adversary more deadly than a vampire. They are as cruel as they are cunning.
traduit: 没有比吸血鬼更致命的敌人了。又残忍又狡猾。

original: Bandits are desperate men. They have nothing to lose, and they fight like it.
traduit: 强盗都是群走投无路的。光脚不怕穿鞋的啊。

original: What some call devotion to the dark arts, I call foolishness.
traduit: 有些人把对黑魔法的研究叫忠诚，我看就是傻。

original: These Forsworn don't even have the decency to dress right.
traduit: 弃誓者连身得体的衣服都没有。

original: Draugr are slow and clumsy. Hardly a challenge for a man like me.
traduit: 尸鬼动作缓慢还笨拙。对我这种人来说不算什么。

original: I would find the Dwemers' mechanical guardians fascinating if they didn't try to kill everything on sight.
traduit: 我觉得锻莫的机械守卫很迷人，如果它们不想着杀死看到的一切的话。

original: Don't get too far ahead.
traduit: 别走得太远了。

original: We will be back. This is not over.
traduit: 我们会回来的。这事儿没完。

original: I don't care what you're doing, after what happened you're lucky I don't toss you in jail. Now get lost.
traduit: 不管你们要干什么，没把你们扔进监狱算你们走运。赶快离去。

original: We're causing no trouble. All we ask is to look for her.
traduit: 我们不是来找麻烦的。只是要找到她。

original: Look, you've already been told you're not allowed here. Turn around and go back the way you came.
traduit: 听着，已经告诉过你们了，你们不能进去。转过身，哪来的回哪去吧。

original: Karliah was behind Goldenglow and Honningbrew.
traduit: 卡莱亚是金色光辉庄园和蜜之酿的幕后主使。

original: Trying to make Mercer look bad in front of Maven, eh? Clever lass.
traduit: 想让墨瑟在玛雯跟前出丑？聪明的姑娘。

original: Was there anything else?
traduit: 还有别的事吗？

original: Gallus, Karliah and Mercer were Nightingales.
traduit: 加卢斯、卡莱亚还有墨瑟曾经是夜莺。

original: What? Nightingales? But, I always assumed they were just a tale... a way to keep the young footpads in line.
traduit: 什么？夜莺？但是，我以为那只是个传说……为了让年轻的小贼们守规矩。

original: Was there anything else she told you?
traduit: 她还和你说了什么？

original: Mercer killed Gallus, not Karliah.
traduit: 是墨瑟杀了加卢斯，卡莱亚不是凶手。

original: Aye. I feared that was the case. From that last entry in Gallus's diary, it looks like he was getting close to exposing Mercer to the Guild.
traduit: 嗯。我担心情况正是如此。从加卢斯日记的最后一篇来看，他似乎快要把墨瑟的事报告给公会了。

original: Look, before I have you help track Mercer down I need to know what you learned from Karliah. I mean everything.
traduit: 听着，在我让你帮我找到墨瑟前，我得知道你从卡莱亚那里知道了什么。我是说，知道的一切。

original: Plans for what?
traduit: 什么计划？

original: Before Mercer took over, Gallus started collecting every bit of material he could on locations the Guild could heist.
traduit: 在墨瑟接手前，加卢斯就开始在公会可以洗劫的地方收集了他能收集到的所有材料。

original: Museums, keeps, estates... you name it. By the time Mercer took over the Guild we must have had a few dozen.
traduit: 博物馆、要塞、庄园……应有尽有。墨瑟接管公会的时候，我们肯定还剩几十个。

original: How could he have opened the vault door alone?
traduit: 他如何能一个人打开金库大门？

original: I don't have a clue. That door is impenetrable.
traduit: 不知道。那扇门坚固无比。

original: Without two keys, it's impossible to open. I have a key, Delvin has a key, and Mercer has a key. That's it. There are no other copies.
traduit: 没有两把钥匙一起根本打不开。我、戴尔文、墨瑟都有钥匙。除此之外，没有其他备份了。

original: That's it? After all the trust I've given you?
traduit: 就这些？亏我给了你那么多信任？

original: As a Nightingale, I took an oath and was sworn to secrecy.
traduit: 作为夜莺，我发誓要保守秘密。

original: Be patient and your time will come.
traduit: 耐心点，会有机会解释的。

original: How could Mercer have gotten into the Vault?
traduit: 墨瑟是怎么进到金库的？

original: All I can tell you for now is that he's abused his authority as a Nightingale.
traduit: 我现在只能告诉你，他滥用了作为夜莺的职权。

original: So you are alive. I was starting to wonder.
traduit: 你还活着。我都有点惊讶了。

original: Look for a way out! We are not going to burn to death in our own damned Sanctuary!
traduit: 快找出路！我们不能在自己的圣所被烧死！

original: Come on! We've got to find a way out of here!
traduit: 来吧！我们得想办法离开这里！

original: Never said that. Just that we don't get many of you wanting to join, that's all.
traduit: 不是这么说。只是你们中大多数都不想进来而已。

original: You won't take me because I'm an Argonian?
traduit: 你不带上我，就因为我是个阿尔贡？

original: Here's a key to the house. Stay as long as you like. If there's anything else you need, just let me know.
traduit: 这是房子的钥匙。想待多久就待多久。如果有什么需要，随时跟我说。

original: If you really are Ralof's friend, I'll be glad to help you. But you didn't answer my question - how do you know him?
traduit: 如果你真是拉罗夫的朋友，我当然愿意帮你。但你还没回答我，你们是怎么认识的？

original: My sister Gerdur runs the mill in Riverwood, just up the road. I'm sure she'd help you out.
traduit: 我姐姐歌尔朵在河木镇经营木材厂。她会帮你的。

original: It's probably best if we split up. Good luck. I wouldn't have made it without your help today.
traduit: 我们最好还是分开走。祝你好运。如果没有你的帮助，我可能逃不出来。

original: You know, you should go to Windhelm and join the fight to free Skyrim. You've seen the true face of the Empire here today.
traduit: 你应该去风舵城加入解放天际的战斗。你今天已经看到帝国的真实嘴脸了。

original: If anyone will know what the coming of the dragon means, it's Ulfric.
traduit: 如果说谁会知道巨龙从何而来，那一定是乌弗瑞克。

original: Changed your mind? You ready to pledge your blood and honor for Skyrim's freedom?
traduit: 改主意了？准备好为天际的自由奉献鲜血与荣耀了吗？

original: Speaking of which...
traduit: 说到这个……

original: Of course... your pay. Haha! You're smart as a whip, lad.
traduit: 当然……你的报酬。哈哈！很聪明嘛，小子。

original: Keep doing right by us and there's plenty more where that came from.
traduit: 只要继续跟我们好好干，钱肯定是更多的。

original: Of course... your pay. Haha! You're smart as a whip, lass.
traduit: 当然……你的报酬。哈哈！很聪明嘛，姑娘。

original: What does Maven want from me?
traduit: 玛雯想从我这得到什么？

original: That's between you and Maven and I prefer to keep it that way.
traduit: 那是你和玛雯之间的事，我是敬而远之的。

original: Just keep your ears open and your mouth shut and you'll do fine.
traduit: 记住了多听少说，你就没事儿。

original: Don't worry about it. Maven's business dealings usually involve quite a bit of gold for her people.
traduit: 别担心。和玛雯的业务往来一般都能让你赚不少。

original: Forget it. I'll just open it myself.
traduit: 算了吧。还是我自己打开。

original: No! I'm not about to let you ruin everything I've worked so hard for!
traduit: 不！我绝不会让你毁了我努力奋斗得来的一切！

original: Then I'll take it off your corpse!
traduit: 那我就从你尸体上把它取下来！

original: Give it your best shot!
traduit: 有本事就来吧！

original: New owner? What are you talking about?
traduit: 新主人？你在说什么？

original: I've already said too much.
traduit: 我已经说得够多了。

original: I gave you what you came here for, now go. Leave me in peace.
traduit: 你来这里要的东西我已经给你了，走吧。别打扰我。

original: So, how dangerous is it to cross her?
traduit: 那越过她有多危险？

original: Let me put it to you this way.
traduit: 我这么跟你说吧。

original: Nothing happens in Riften without Maven's consent. One word from her and you could spend the rest of the fourth era in prison.
traduit: 玛雯不点头，在裂谷城寸步难行。只消一句话，你就得在监狱里度过第四纪元剩下的日子了。

original: Hey, I'm not done talking to you yet. Come back here!
traduit: 喂，我还没和你说完呢。回来！

original: Without them at our backs, we'd be in serious trouble.
traduit: 如果没有他们做后盾，我们的麻烦就大了。

original: What should I do about Aringoth?
traduit: 我该怎么处置阿林格斯？

original: Maven prefers that Aringoth remains alive, but if he tries to stop you from getting the job done, kill him.
traduit: 玛雯更希望阿林格斯活着。但如果他试图阻拦，就做掉他。

original: The Guild has a lot riding on this. Don't make me look foolish by mucking it up.
traduit: 公会对这事抱有很大期望。别搞砸了，到时候连我都会像个傻子。

original: Why are the Alik'r after you?
traduit: 阿里克'尔为什么追杀你？

original: I don't know for sure. I spoke out against the Aldmeri Dominion publicly; I suspect that's why these men were hired to hunt me down.
traduit: 我不确定。可能是我公开反对先祖神洲，所以这些人就被雇来追捕我了。

original: Why haven't you gone to the guards for help?
traduit: 你为什么不找卫兵求助？

original: You think I'd be in hiding if this was something I trusted town guards to handle?
traduit: 如果这件事能交给卫兵，我还用躲起来吗？

original: These men are ruthless. Cunning, deceitful... they'll pay off whoever they can. I can't trust anyone here in Whiterun.
traduit: 那些人都是冷血动物。狡诈、虚伪……他们会给任何付钱给他们的人效劳。我不相信白漫城的任何人。

original: Guards and Jarls can be bought. And the Alik'r are close; I'm running out of time, so I'm choosing to trust you.
traduit: 卫兵和领主也可以被收买。再说阿里克'尔逼近，我快没有时间了，所以我选择相信你。

original: Have you heard of Avanchnzel?
traduit: 你听说过阿旺晨泽尔吗？

original: Yes, Yes. It is an ancient and ruined city. Built by the Dwemer. The dwarf folk. It is nearby, but I'd stay clear. People say it is quite dangerous.
traduit: 知道。是座古老破败的城市遗迹。锻莫建造的。也就是矮人。就在附近，但我会离那儿远点。都说那里很危险。

original: The way out is right there! Run, damn it!
traduit: 出去的路在那儿！跑啊，该死的！

original: I did not come all the way here just to walk out empty-handed.
traduit: 我大老远到这里不能空手而归。

original: I can't hold these things! We need to leave!
traduit: 我拿不住这些东西了！我们得走！

original: I have the Lexicon! Where's the podium?
traduit: 我拿到方典了！基座呢？

original: Aaaaaaaaaaa....
traduit: 啊啊啊啊啊啊……

original: Something doesn't feel right.
traduit: 有点不对劲。

original: We're almost there. I can hear the Lexicon. Come on. Quickly!
traduit: 我们差不多到了。我能听到方典的呼唤了。来吧，赶快！

original: Ours. Soon the Lexicon's knowledge will be ours.
traduit: 是归我们。方典的知识很快就要归我们所有了。

original: Once we have the Lexicon, we'll need to take it to its podium. I know what to do from there. Soon the Lexicon's knowledge will be mine.
traduit: 等我们拿到方典，我们就得把它放到基座上。我知道接下来该怎么做。方典里的知识很快就归我了。

original: So we grab it and we get out, right?
traduit: 那我们拿了就走，对吧？

original: We are close now. Can you hear the Lexicon calling out?
traduit: 我们快到了。能听到方典的呼唤吗？

original: Calm yourself, Breya. We are closing in on the Lexicon. I can feel it calling. We'll continue without Drennen.
traduit: 冷静点，布莱亚。我们就快找到方典了。我能够感受到它在召唤我。没了德恩南，咱们也得继续。

original: My pay will be nothing if we die in here!
traduit: 如果我们死在这里，我什么都拿不到了！

original: Let the field mouse run. Your pay will be double.
traduit: 让那田鼠跑吧。你的报酬就能翻倍了。

original: Drennen!
traduit: 德恩南！

original: You sure that's power we're meant to have?
traduit: 你确定这是咱们能拥有的力量吗？

original: I assure you, it is. The knowledge contained in the Lexicon created everything you see around you.
traduit: 我向你保证，肯定的。方典中包含的知识创造了你周围的这一切。

original: The Lexicon had better be worth all this trouble.
traduit: 那个方典最好值得你费这么大力气。

original: Great.
traduit: 非常好。

original: You said they were sleeping. I said they were waiting. It seems a few of them were "waiting" for someone to try and take the Lexicon.
traduit: 你说他们在睡觉，我看他们是在等咱们。他们中某些可能正“等”着有人尝试拿走方典。

original: I thought you said these things were "sleeping"?
traduit: 你不是说这些东西在“睡觉”吗？

original: So we're not turning back, you fool.
traduit: 所以我们不能回头，傻瓜。

original: So?
traduit: 所以呢？

original: Drennen, you do understand that the Lexicon at the bottom of this place holds the accumulated memories of centuries of Dwemer.
traduit: 德恩南，你应该知道这地方底下保存的方典存着锻莫几个世纪积累的记忆吧。

original: Maybe we should turn back. I don't want to sleep here.
traduit: 也许我们应该回去。我可不想睡在这里。

original: It is large, indeed. I did not anticipate Avanchnzel's size or the time needed to uncover the entrance.
traduit: 确实够大。我没想到阿旺晨泽尔的体积这么大，打开入口需要这么长时间。

original: This place is huge.
traduit: 这地方真大。

original: And yet none of us can pick a damned lock.
traduit: 但我们没人撬得开那把该死的锁。

original: We are thieves, you fool. We're stealing the cube.
traduit: 我们就是贼，傻瓜。我们来就是要偷方典的。

original: I told you we should have hired a thief.
traduit: 我就说我们应该雇个盗贼。

original: Why are all these metal... things... ignoring us?
traduit: 为什么这些金属……家伙……会无视我们？

original: Anavchnzel is waiting.
traduit: 阿旺晨泽尔正等着你呢。

original: Indeed. Avanchnzel is as much a library as it is a city. Built to hold the vast memories of the Dwemer.
traduit: 确实。阿旺晨泽尔既是城市，也是图书馆。用来储存锻莫的庞大记忆。

original: This place is unbelievable.
traduit: 这地方太不可思议了。

original: Enough. Their services will be more than adequate. Let us continue.
traduit: 足够了。有他们帮忙绰绰有余。我们继续前进吧。

original: If you two cannot handle this, we can find others to hire.
traduit: 如果你们俩处理不了，我们可以再雇别人。

original: It's a simple job, Drennen. We get in, we steal the Lexicon, we leave. Don't get jumpy.
traduit: 这工作很简单，德恩南。我们进去，偷走方典，然后离开。不要紧张兮兮的。

original: I don't like this place. It feels like we're being... watched.
traduit: 我不喜欢这地方。感觉好像我们被什么……盯着。

original: I don't pay much attention to current events.
traduit: 我不太关心时事。

original: Oh, right, they said you were captured crossing the border.
traduit: 啊对，他们说你在越境时被捕了。

original: Still, I'm surprised you haven't heard of Ulfric. He's our leader - the leader of the Stormcloaks.
traduit: 不过我还是很惊讶你居然没听说过乌弗瑞克。他是我们风暴斗篷的领袖。

original: Oh, right. Ulfric Stormcloak...
traduit: 哦对，乌弗瑞克·风暴斗篷……

original: Right. The leader of our fight against the Empire. I forget that most people don't know what he looks like, except for those Imperial wanted posters.
traduit: 没错。他是我们反抗帝国的领袖。我忘记了，大部分人不知道他的相貌，除非看过帝国通缉令。

original: Why were you being executed?
traduit: 你们为什么要被处决？

original: Seriously, you don't know? That was Ulfric Stormcloak himself.
traduit: 你真不知道？那可是乌弗瑞克·风暴斗篷本人。

original: Was that dragon on your side?
traduit: 那头龙和你们是一伙儿的吗？

original: What? Oh, hardly! I don't think even Ulfric could pull a dragon out of his pocket.
traduit: 什么？啊，不是！我觉得即使是乌弗瑞克也没法从他口袋里掏出只龙来。

original: Lucky for us it attacked when it did, eh? I wasn't looking forward to getting a shave from the Imperial headsman.
traduit: 不过所幸它来袭击了。我可不想让帝国的刽子手给我刮两下。

original: Maybe you'll see one yourself soon. Helgen isn't that far from here.
traduit: 说不定你很快就能亲眼看到了。海尔根离这可不远。

original: Don't even say such things! I hope that dragon stays away from Riverwood. We don't need that kind of trouble.
traduit: 别这么说！这龙离这越远越好。我们可不想惹这种麻烦。

original: Much bigger than that. As big as the inn.
traduit: 比那要大得多。和那个旅店差不多大。

original: Well I'll be! That'd be a sight to see.
traduit: 喔！那一定很值得一看。

original: Not that I actually want to see one, understand. I hope that dragon stays far away from here.
traduit: 啊，我不是真的想看。我也想那龙离这远点。

original: I really don't want to talk about it.
traduit: 我真的不想谈这个。

original: Sure, sure. It's just, you know, not every day I meet someone who's laid eyes on a dragon.
traduit: 当然当然。只是你得知道，龙这东西可不是天天能见到的。

original: So you saw a dragon, did you? Tell me, what was it like? As big as a house?
traduit: 这么说你见过龙了？跟我说说，长什么样？跟房子一样大吗？

original: What do you think about the war?
traduit: 你对这场战争怎么看？

original: The Empire may have been good for Skyrim once upon a time, but those days are long past.
traduit: 加入帝国对天际很好，但那时代早就过去了。

original: Banning the worship of Talos was the last straw. Thalmor everywhere, dragging people off for honoring our own gods!
traduit: 禁止塔洛斯信仰是压垮骆驼的最后稻草。现在到处都是梭默，四处抓捕坚持信仰的人。

original: I'm glad Ralof is helping drive them out of here. If I was a bit younger, I might have joined the fight myself.
traduit: 我很高兴拉罗夫能参加驱逐他们的战斗。如果我再年轻点，我也会亲自参战的。

original: I've got enough to worry about, taking care of my family. I don't concern myself with such matters.
traduit: 我单是操心家人就够忙了。这些事与我无关了。

original: I've killed Haldyn.
traduit: 我杀了哈尔丁。

original: Impressive work. We started the attack once you made the fog scamper away like that.
traduit: 干得漂亮。你把雾驱散之后我们就开始进攻了。

original: Hope you didn't catch any of the fire.
traduit: 希望你没什么事。

original: We can head back whenever you're set. There's celebrating to be done!
traduit: 你准备好我们就回去。要准备庆祝了！

original: Have we reached Japhet's Folly?
traduit: 我们已经到了贾菲特之愚？

original: Hard to say. The weather's taken a bit of a turn, here.
traduit: 难说。天气有变。

original: Haldyn's been known to obscure his hideaways with magic.
traduit: 哈尔丁会用魔法隐蔽自己的据点。

original: If we take care of him, the way should be clear to properly assault the island.
traduit: 如果我们搞定他，就能顺利进攻这座岛了。

original: This must be him, then.
traduit: 就是他吧。

original: This must be her, then.
traduit: 就是她吧。

original: I've got a top man on the job right now. He should be returning any moment.
traduit: 我现在有个顶尖的好手在办这件事。他应该很快就回来了。

original: I've got a sharp woman on the job right now. She should be returning any moment.
traduit: 我现在有个顶尖的好手在办这件事。她应该很快就回来了。

original: Name is Stig Salt-Plank, one of the captains of the Blood Horkers.
traduit: “咸木板”斯蒂，血腥海象的船长之一。

original: Why is the worship of Talos banned?
traduit: 塔洛斯信仰为什么被禁止了？

original: I guess that wasn't such a big deal elsewhere in the Empire, but here it's caused a lot of resentment. Native son and all that.
traduit: 我想这在帝国的其他地方算不上什么大事。不过却在这里引发很多不满。尤其是本地人。

original: Even I'll admit it hasn't been the Empire's finest hour. But it wasn't like the Emperor had any choice, did he?
traduit: 我承认这对帝国来说很不光彩。但皇帝也别无选择，不是吗？

original: If he hadn't signed the peace treaty with the Thalmor, they would have destroyed the Empire - then where would Skyrim be?
traduit: 如果他没和梭默签订和平条约，那梭默就会摧毁帝国。到时候，天际又该何去何从呢？

original: That's the part that Ulfric's supporters always conveniently forget about. Unless the Empire stands together, the Thalmor will destroy us all.
traduit: 乌弗瑞克的支持者很容易忘了这一点。帝国如果不能团结一致，早晚要被梭默一网打尽。

original: It's from that treaty that ended the Great War, remember, when the Emperor was forced by the Thalmor to outlaw Talos worship.
traduit: 正是这个条约结束了浩大战争，记得吗？当时皇帝在梭默的被迫下宣布了塔洛斯信仰非法化。

original: We didn't pay much attention to it when I was a boy - everyone still had their little shrine to Talos.
traduit: 我小时候也没谁在意，当时每个人都有祭拜塔洛斯的小神龛。

original: But then Ulfric and his "Sons of Skyrim" started agitating about it, and sure enough the Emperor had to crack down.
traduit: 可是后来乌弗瑞克和他的那群“天际之子”开始闹起来了，皇帝不得不镇压他们。

original: Dragging people off in the middle of the night... one of the main causes of this war, if you ask me.
traduit: 在半夜把人拖走……在我看来这就是战争的主因。

original: Why are the Thalmor allowed to arrest people for worshipping Talos?
traduit: 为什么梭默能被允许逮捕塔洛斯信徒？

original: Oh, right, you were caught trying to cross the border into Skyrim, weren't you?
traduit: 哦对，你在企图越境的时候被抓了？

original: You're not kidding. Ulfric's the leader of the Stormcloaks - you know, the traitors trying to break Skyrim away from the Empire.
traduit: 你怕不是在开玩笑。乌弗瑞克是风暴斗篷的首领。你肯定知道，这是群想把天际从帝国分裂出去的叛党。

original: He's a traitor of some kind?
traduit: 他是什么叛徒么？

original: Right, the leader of the Stormcloaks.
traduit: 没错，风暴斗篷的领袖。

original: They claim to be fighting for Skyrim's freedom, but the war is really all about Ulfric wanting to be High King of Skyrim.
traduit: 他们声称为天际的自由而战，实际上是乌弗瑞克想当天际至高王。

original: Who were those other prisoners?
traduit: 其他囚犯都是什么人？

original: You didn't know? That was Ulfric Stormcloak and his top lieutenants.
traduit: 你不知道？那是乌弗瑞克·风暴斗篷和他的将佐们。

original: I thought dragons were all dead long ago.
traduit: 我以为龙族早就消亡了。

original: So did I! If the damn Stormcloaks somehow found one, or woke it up... the war might be about to take an ugly turn.
traduit: 我也是！如果那群混蛋风暴斗篷找到或者唤醒了一个……那战况就不妙了。

original: Hard to believe it was just a coincidence, that the first dragon anyone's seen for centuries attacks just as Ulfric was about to be executed.
traduit: 很难相信这是巧合。几百年来人们第一次看到的龙，就是在乌弗瑞克要被处死时现身袭击。

original: People are rightly stirred up about the damn Thalmor being allowed to roam around arresting people, just for worshipping Talos.
traduit: 人们对梭默能够四处抓捕塔洛斯信徒感到愤怒。

original: But was it worth tearing Skyrim apart, and maybe destroying the Empire? No, Ulfric will have a lot to answer for in the end.
traduit: 但因为这就把天际搞得四分五裂，甚至为此毁了整个帝国？乌弗瑞克最后要为很多事负责。

original: Nords have always supported the Empire, and the Empire has always been good for Skyrim.
traduit: 诺德人一直支持着帝国，而帝国也没亏待了天际。

original: I just hope the war doesn't come to Riverwood. There's enough trouble in the world without those Stormcloaks stirring up more.
traduit: 我只希望战火不要烧到河木镇来。就算没这群风暴斗篷瞎搅和，世界也已经够乱了。

original: The Companions have been asked for assistance, and we shall answer. Particularly when the pay is as good as this.
traduit: 战友团已经收到求助请求，而且会答应的。尤其报酬还这么高。

original: Get moving. I shudder to think what might happen if you're too late.
traduit: 行动起来。一想到去晚了发生的事我就不寒而栗。

original: A citizen of the Reach has been kidnapped.
traduit: 瑞驰领的一位公民被绑架了。

original: A citizen of Haafingar has been kidnapped.
traduit: 海芬加领的一位公民被绑架了。

original: A citizen of Hjaalmarch has been kidnapped.
traduit: 希雅陲领的一位公民被绑架了。

original: A citizen of Falkreath has been kidnapped.
traduit: 佛克瑞斯领的一位公民被绑架了。

original: A citizen of Whiterun has been kidnapped.
traduit: 白漫领的一位公民被绑架了。

original: A citizen of the Pale has been kidnapped.
traduit: 苍原领的一位公民被绑架了。

original: A citizen of the Rift has been kidnapped.
traduit: 裂痕领的一位公民被绑架了。

original: A citizen of Eastmarch has been kidnapped.
traduit: 东陲领的一位公民被绑架了。

original: A citizen of Winterhold has been kidnapped.
traduit: 冬堡领的一位公民被绑架了。

original: A citizen of Skyrim has been kidnapped.
traduit: 有天际公民被绑架了。

original: See if you can find some, and I'll try to find some more interesting work by the time you get back.
traduit: 看看你能不能找些来，回来的时候我会试着帮你找些更有趣的工作的。

original: I'm going to rest up here a while before heading to Windhelm. Be careful.
traduit: 我得先休息一阵再去风舵城。你自己多小心。

original: We'd better keep moving. I don't want to run into any Imperials who know what happened at Helgen.
traduit: 我们最好继续走。以免碰上任何得到海尔根消息的帝国人。

original: Good luck. Come to Windhelm and talk to Ulfric. You won't regret it.
traduit: 祝你好运。去风舵城找乌弗瑞克谈谈。你绝对不会后悔的。

original: Be careful on the way to Solitude. Damn Stormcloaks could be anywhere.
traduit: 去独孤城的路上一定当心。该死的风暴斗篷无处不在。

original: We'd better keep moving. I feel like that dragon might be up there watching us right now.
traduit: 我们最好继续走。我总觉得那头龙在盯着我们。

original: Good luck. If you get a chance, look me up in Solitude.
traduit: 祝你好运。有机会独孤城见。

original: I think you and I have some things to talk about.
traduit: 我觉得咱们可以谈谈。

original: You've proven your strength, warrior. Let's avoid any more bloodshed.
traduit: 你已经证明了你的力量，勇士。我们不需要更多的流血。

original: Alik'r, hold!
traduit: 阿里克'尔，停下！

original: I'm ready. Let's go get them.
traduit: 我准备好了。去找他们吧。

original: That's what I like to hear.
traduit: 我就想听你这么说。

original: Hold on. I need a minute.
traduit: 等等。我还需要点时间。

original: Even the Imperials might eventually decide to patrol their perimeter. Get yourself ready!
traduit: 等帝国军也决定巡逻防线的时候就完了。快点准备好！

original: Get the crown. We will keep an eye out for more of those dustmen.
traduit: 找到王冠。我们得更加留意这些清道夫。

original: That crown should be around here somewhere. Just keep an eye out for the bonewalkers...
traduit: 王冠应该就在附近。留意一下这些骨行者……

original: The Imperials are here in force. Stick together.
traduit: 帝国军已经到了。跟紧点。

original: What's the Legion doing here? Damn Imperial spies... Well, should be fun for us, at least. They don't seem to know we're here yet.
traduit: 军团在这里做什么？该死的帝国间谍……好吧，至少能找点乐子。他们还不知道我们来了。

original: Ready to spill some Imperial blood for Skyrim?
traduit: 准备好为天际献上帝国人的血了吗？

original: You ready?
traduit: 准备好了吗？

original: I've found the final resting place of the Jagged Crown. Can you believe it? Well, I'm almost certain.
traduit: 我找到了锯齿王冠的下落了。你信吗？我可是很肯定。

original: We're headed to Korvanjund. But, if old King Borgas is indeed buried there, we're bound to run into trouble of some kind.
traduit: 我们要去科万琼德。但是如果先王博加斯真的葬在那里，我们一定会碰上麻烦的。

original: Your fellow Stormcloaks are already assembling outside the tomb. I'll meet you there as soon as I'm finished up here.
traduit: 你的风暴斗篷战友已经在墓外集结了。我办完这里的事情就去找你们。

original: But do not make the mistake of underestimating the Legion. Plenty of them are Nords same as us.
traduit: 但不要低估了军团。他们中很多也是诺德人。

original: Follow me. Quickly and quietly now. I want their guts on the ground before they even know we're here.
traduit: 跟我来。要又快又静。得让他们发现我们前就趴下。

original: Oooh... So silent. So menacing. A true assassin of the old way. Cicero likes you. Oh yes, Cicero likes you, indeed.
traduit: 哦……如此沉默，又如此具有威慑。老牌刺客。西塞罗喜欢你哦。没错，西塞罗可喜欢你了。

original: Do you mistrust poor Cicero? I am, as you say, just an innocent jester. A fool! Oh, but my work is not foolish, no. For I am our mother's Keeper.
traduit: 你不信任可怜的西塞罗吗？你说得对，我就是个无辜的小丑。一个傻瓜！哦，但我的工作可不蠢。我可是母亲的守护者。

original: Keep your distance, jester, and we'll get along just fine.
traduit: 保持距离，小丑，我们会彼此相安无事的。

original: So polite! So nice! Cicero likes you. The Night Mother is sure to like you too. Oh, we're going to be fast friends. Fast friends.
traduit: 真有礼貌！太好了！西塞罗喜欢你。夜母肯定也喜欢你。我们很快会成为好朋友的。很快的，朋友。

original: It's good to meet you too, Cicero.
traduit: 我也很高兴见到你，西塞罗。

original: He said I attacked someone! On the road! But it never happened. Never. Sweet mother and I were just waiting. My knife was sheathed!
traduit: 他说我袭击了某人！在路上！但这是没有的事。从来没有。亲爱的母亲和我只是在等待。我的刀已经插好了。

original: But I...
traduit: 但我……

original: He said I was transporting weapons! For the war! In mother's coffin! He made me... open it! Indignity! Sacrilege!
traduit: 他说我在偷运武器！是战争贩子！在母亲的棺材里！他让我……打开它！这是侮辱！是亵渎！

original: He said I stole something! Me! Poor Cicero. A common thief. The very thought is insulting. One might even say... maddening.
traduit: 他说我偷东西了！我！可怜的西塞罗。是一个普通的小贼。这想法本身就是侮辱。有人甚至会说……令人抓狂。

original: I am! I am! But not just my mother. Our mother, hmm? The Night Mother! Oh yes!
traduit: 我是！我是！但不只是我的母亲，是我们的母亲。嗯？夜母！没错！

original: And you helped me! You helped poor Cicero! You talked to Loreius, got him to fix my wheel!
traduit: 你还帮了我！你帮助了可怜的西塞罗！你跟罗瑞尤斯谈过了，让他帮忙修轮子！

original: Oh, you may have pleased me, but you have surely pleased the Night Mother. And our mother, she will never forget.
traduit: 哦，你让我很高兴，肯定也让夜母很高兴。我们的母亲不会忘记的。

original: You're the man with the wagon! Transporting his mother...
traduit: 你是那个驾着马车的！要送母亲……

original: But you disappeared! You were there... then you weren't! Did you mean to help poor Cicero or not? I'm left to wonder...
traduit: 但你消失了！你在那里的……然后走了！你到底想不想保住可怜的西塞罗？我很想知道……

original: Ah, it doesn't matter. What's done is done, right? Cicero is here! As is the Night Mother! Joy of joys!
traduit: 哦，不过没关系。过去的就过去吧？西塞罗现在到了！夜母也到了！好高兴好高兴！

original: Oh, but you didn't help poor Cicero! You helped that stupid farmer! Stupid Loreius! Oh, the guard said cruel things about us. Untrue things...
traduit: 但你没帮可怜的西塞罗！你帮了那个笨蛋种地的！那个傻子罗瑞尤斯！卫兵污蔑我们。都是假的……

original: Wait, oh wait. I know you! Yes, yes. From the road! Cicero never forgets a face.
traduit: 哦，等一下。我认识你！对，对。在路上！西塞罗忘不了那张脸。

original: Another member of the Family! Hello, hello. So very good to meet you.
traduit: 又一个家庭成员！你好，你好。很高兴见到你。

original: No time to talk now, my friend. No time. Out mistress needs tending. Keeping.
traduit: 现在没时间说话，朋友。没时间。我们的主母需要被照顾。守护。

original: Why talk? Cicero has nothing to say to you. Call it a matter of... trust.
traduit: 为什么要说话？西塞罗没什么好跟你说的。就当成是……信任吧。

original: Oh, I do wish we could get to know each other better. But not now! I must tend to mother. See her settled.
traduit: 哦。我真希望我们更加深入了解彼此。但现在不行！我得照顾母亲。帮她安居。

original: Keep talking, little man, and we'll see who gets "punished."
traduit: 继续说啊，小子，看看谁会被“惩罚”。

original: There's a horse waiting at the stables. I'll make sure you're safe. (Lie)
traduit: 马厩那儿有匹马。我会保证你的安全。（撒谎）

original: After all this, I have to pick up and leave again?
traduit: 经历了这一切，我又得收拾东西走人？

original: If you really think this is the only way, I trust you. Let's not waste any time.
traduit: 如果你真觉得这是唯一出路，我相信你。不要浪费时间了。

original: They've found a way in. We need to get you out of here. (Lie)
traduit: 他们找到了进来的办法。我得带你离开这里。（撒谎）

original: But where will I go? I can't keep running forever!
traduit: 但我又能去哪儿？我不能一直逃下去！

original: Oh, come now. You didn't really expect to manipulate people forever, did you? Your luck had to run out sometime.
traduit: 哦，得了吧。你不会真想永远操纵别人吧？运气总有花光的一天。

original: What is this?
traduit: 这是怎么回事？

original: We meet at last, my dear lady.
traduit: 我们终于见面了，亲爱的女士。

original: It seems like I shouldn't be here.
traduit: 看来我不该来这儿。

original: No, don't go!
traduit: 不，留步！

original: No, don't go! You may not be one of our tribe, but you are an Orc nonetheless!
traduit: 不，请留步！你虽然不是我们部落的一员，但仍然是个兽人！

original: Our Chief, Yamarz, was once a strong and proud warrior. Now he is stricken, cursed.
traduit: 我们的酋长亚马兹，曾经是个强壮骄傲的战士。但他现在遭受打击，中了诅咒。

original: He is weak, and so our tribe is weak. The giants sense this, and intrude on our territory. Now they assault our very home.
traduit: 他变弱了，部落也就变弱了。巨人们有所察觉，并入侵我们的领地。现在他们就在攻击我们的家园。

original: Yamarz refuses help, but I sense that you may be just what we need.
traduit: 亚马兹拒绝求援，但我觉得你正是我们要找的人。

original: Please, our tribe suffers and we need help.
traduit: 拜托了，我们的部落正在受苦，需要帮助。

original: How am I supposed to get rid of them?
traduit: 我要怎么除掉他们？

original: They're mercenaries, only in it for the money. They're led by a man named Kematu. Get rid of him, and the rest will scatter.
traduit: 他们是雇佣兵，眼里只有钱。领头的人叫凯马图。除掉他，其他人也就作鸟兽散了。

original: I don't dare show my face, lest they recognize me, so you'll have to find out where they are.
traduit: 我不敢露面，怕被他们认出来，所以你得找出他们的所在。

original: We did well today, Shield-Brother.
traduit: 我们今天干得很好，盾牌兄弟。

original: We did well today, Shield-Sister.
traduit: 我们今天干得很好，盾牌姐妹。

original: Aela's laid claim to your services, and I've learned the hard way not to upset her. Best you stick to her for now.
traduit: 艾拉要求你去帮她，我学聪明了，不要惹她。你现在最好去找她。

original: Aela said you were hers, and I wasn't supposed to interfere. She scares me.
traduit: 艾拉说你现在归她，我不该干涉。她让我感到害怕。

original: And there is more work to be done, but I fear that Kodlak's gotten wind of our recent efforts. He's asked to see you.
traduit: 还有很多工作，但恐怕咱们最近的努力被克拉科知道了。他要见你。

original: My advice? Always be honest with the old man, but don't tell him anything he doesn't need to know.
traduit: 要我说？对老爷子永远要诚实，但有的事犯不着告诉他。

original: We've killed your beast spirit.
traduit: 我们已经杀死了你的野兽精魂。

original: And so slain the beast inside of me.
traduit: 如此一来，我体内的野兽就被杀死了。

original: I thank you for this gift. The other Harbingers remain trapped by Hircine, though.
traduit: 感谢你给我的礼物。然而，其他的先驱还被海尔辛困着。

original: Perhaps from Sovngarde, the heroes of old can join me in their rescue. The Harrowing of the Hunting Grounds. It would be a battle of such triumph.
traduit: 也许松加德的古老英雄可以加入我的营救行动。对猎场的痛击将是一场胜利之战。

original: And perhaps some day, you'll join us in that battle. But for today, return to Jorrvaskr. Triumph in your victory.
traduit: 也许有一天，你也会加入我们的战斗。但今天，还是回月瓦斯卡吧，为你的胜利欢呼。

original: And lead the Companions to further glory.
traduit: 要继续领导战友团走向荣光。

original: Kodlak, is that you?
traduit: 克拉科，是你吗？

original: Of course. My fellow Harbingers and I have been warming ourselves here. Trying to evade Hircine.
traduit: 没错。我和其他先驱在这里取暖。试图躲避海尔辛。

original: I return them with honor. (Give fragments)
traduit: 我怀着荣耀将它们归还。（交出碎片）

original: Don't get too flowery on me, lad.
traduit: 别整的太花哨了，小子。

original: Don't get too flowery on me, lass.
traduit: 别整的太花哨了，姑娘。

original: Do you have the fragments of Wuuthrad, still?
traduit: 你还有巫斯拉德的碎片吗？

original: I'll need to prepare them for mounting again.
traduit: 我得准备好让它们再度归一。

original: How do we get inside?
traduit: 我们怎么进去？

original: Return Wuuthrad to Ysgramor. It should open the way.
traduit: 将巫斯拉德还给伊斯格拉默。应该就能打开道路。

original: For the fallen...
traduit: 为此人的陨落……

original: We grieve.
traduit: 我们哀伤。

original: Before the ancient flame...
traduit: 在远古的火焰之前……

original: The others have probably prepared Kodlak's funeral by now.
traduit: 其他人现在应该准备好克拉科的葬礼了。

original: Come up to the Skyforge to pay your respects.
traduit: 到天空锻炉行礼吧。

original: Was anyone else hurt?
traduit: 还有别人受伤吗？

original: No, but they made off with all our fragments of Wuuthrad.
traduit: 没了，但他们把咱们所有的巫斯拉德碎片都抢走了。

original: But you and I are going to reclaim them.
traduit: 你和我一起去夺回来。

original: We will bring the battle to their chief camp. There will be none left living to tell their stories. Only songs of Jorrvaskr will be sung.
traduit: 我们要到他们的大本营去。让他们的故事就此断绝。月瓦斯卡的赞歌会被永久传唱。

original: We will avenge Kodlak. And they will know terror before the end.
traduit: 我们要为克拉科报仇。让他们体会死前的恐怖。

original: The Silver Hand. They finally found enough courage to attack Jorrvaskr.
traduit: 是银手。他们终于有胆子来进攻月瓦斯卡了。

original: We fought them off, but...
traduit: 我们击退了他们，但是……

original: The old man... Kodlak... he's dead.
traduit: 老爷子……克拉科……死了。

original: One of the fiercest battles I've ever seen.
traduit: 这是我见过的最激烈的战斗之一了。

original: I was doing Kodlak's bidding.
traduit: 我是去办克拉科交代的事情了。

original: I hope it was important, because it means you weren't here to defend him.
traduit: 希望是要紧到让你没能来保护他的事。

original: I don't wish to remove this blessing.
traduit: 我不想消除这个祝福。

original: This is not about your desires, lad.
traduit: 这与你的意愿无关，小子。

original: This is not about your desires, lass.
traduit: 这与你的意愿无关，姑娘。

original: It shall be done.
traduit: 交给我吧。

original: Good. Now move quickly. And don't leave any of them alive.
traduit: 好。现在快去吧。别留活口。

original: Am I to do this alone?
traduit: 我一个人去吗？

original: You shall have no Shield-Brother this time. But the spirit of Ysgramor goes with you, to restore the honor of his legacy.
traduit: 这次没有盾牌兄弟了。但是伊斯格拉默的精神与你同在，恢复他遗产的荣耀吧。

original: Is there a way to cure yourself?
traduit: 有办法治愈你自己吗？

original: That's what I've spent my twilight years trying to find out.
traduit: 这是我晚年以来一直想弄清楚的。

original: And now I've found the answer. The witches' magic ensnared us, and only their magic can release us.
traduit: 现在我找到答案了。女巫们的魔法困住了我们，只有用她们的魔法来解救。

original: They won't give it willingly, but we can extract their foul powers by force.
traduit: 她们自然不会心甘情愿，但我们可以用武力榨取她们的邪恶力量。

original: I want you to seek them out. Go to their coven in  the wilderness. Strike them down as a true warrior of the wild.
traduit: 我希望你去把她们找出来。去她们在野外的集会地。像一名战士一样击败她们。

original: And bring me their heads. The seat of their abilities. From there, we may begin to undo centuries of impurity.
traduit: 把她们的头带回来给我。那是她们的能力所在。这样我们就能消除这几个世纪以来的不洁了。

original: The disease, you see, affects not just our bodies. It seeps into the spirit.
traduit: 你看，这种疾病不止是影响了我们的身体，还渗透进我们的精魂当中。

original: Upon death, werewolves are claimed by Hircine for his Hunting Grounds.
traduit: 狼人死后，会被海尔辛带进自己的猎场位面。

original: For some, this is a paradise. They want nothing more than to chase prey with their master for eternity.
traduit: 对一些人来说，那里就是乐园。他们只知道与主人一起永远地追逐猎物。

original: And that is their choice. But I am still a true Nord. And I wish for Sovngarde as my spirit home.
traduit: 这是他们的选择。但我仍然是一个真正的诺德人。我希望魂归松加德。

original: You were telling me about the witches.
traduit: 你在和我说女巫的事情。

original: Ah yes, their trickery.
traduit: 啊对，她们的诡计。

original: The witches should be hunted down for their trickery.
traduit: 这些女巫应该为自己的诡计被猎杀。

original: We'll get to that.
traduit: 我们会的。

original: It's not so simple as just killing them, though.
traduit: 但这不是杀死她们那么简单。

original: But aren't you more powerful now?
traduit: 但你现在不也更加强大了吗？

original: The witches didn't lie, of course. But it's more than our bodies.
traduit: 当然，女巫们没有撒谎。不过起变化的远不止身体。

original: And they became werewolves?
traduit: 他们变成了狼人？

original: They did not believe the change would be permanent. The witches offered payment, like anyone else.
traduit: 他们知道变化无法永久维持。而毫不意外地，那些女巫们也为此要求代价。

original: But we had been deceived.
traduit: 但我们被骗了。

original: So what is the truth, then?
traduit: 那么真相是什么？

original: The Companions are nearly five thousand years old. This matter of beastblood has only troubled us for a few hundred.
traduit: 战友团有近五千年的历史了。但野兽血脉困扰我们也只是这几百年的事。

original: One of my predecessors was a good, but short-sighted man. He made a bargain with the witches of Glenmoril Coven.
traduit: 我的一位前任是个好人，但目光短浅。他和格伦摩利女巫团做了个交易。

original: If the Companions would hunt in the name of their lord, Hircine, we would be granted great power.
traduit: 如果战友团以她们的主人海尔辛之名狩猎，就能被赋予强大的力量。

original: Vilkas said it was a curse laid upon the ancient Companions.
traduit: 威尔卡斯说这是自古代起施加在战友团身上的诅咒。

original: The boy has a nugget of truth, but the reality is more complicated than that.
traduit: 那孩子说的有些道理，但真相远比此要复杂。

original: It always is.
traduit: 事情总是这样。

original: Skjor said it was a blessing from Hircine.
traduit: 斯科约尔说这是海尔辛的赐福。

original: Aye, that sounds like him.
traduit: 啊，听起来像他会说的话。

original: As in all matters of faith, though, the reality is more complicated than one believer would tell you.
traduit: 然而，就像所有关于信仰的事一样，事实总会比信徒告诉你的要复杂许多。

original: You said you had a task for me?
traduit: 你有任务要给我？

original: Have you heard the story of how we came to be werewolves?
traduit: 你有听说过我们变成狼人的故事吗？

original: In any case, I have a task for you.
traduit: 无论怎样，我有个任务交给你。

original: Mind you, it's no business of mine what each Companion does in the name of honor.
traduit: 随你，每个战友以名誉的名义做了什么与我无关。

original: But this sneaking around. It doesn't befit warriors of your standing. Aela knows better, and so should you.
traduit: 但这样并不光彩。不适合你这样身份的勇士。艾拉更清楚，你也应该明白。

original: They should be back shortly. You're welcome to wait here if you like.
traduit: 他们很快就会回来。如果你愿意，也欢迎在这里等。

original: This temple is dedicated to Mara, and the light of love she shines on us all.
traduit: 这座神殿是献给玛拉的，她的爱之光芒照耀着我们。

original: I'm only a humble acolyte, though. If you wish to avail yourself of Mara's blessing, you should speak with Dinya Balu or Maramal.
traduit: 不过，我只是个卑微的侍僧。如果你希望得到玛拉的祝福，可以去找丁雅·巴鲁或者玛拉莫。

original: Get yourself kitted out with what you need. Welcome to the fight, brother!
traduit: 把你需要的东西准备好。欢迎加入战斗，兄弟！

original: Get to Windhelm with the crown as quick as you can. Tell Ulfric he owes me a drink.
traduit: 尽快把王冠带到风舵城去。告诉乌弗瑞克，他欠我一顿酒。

original: It's the rebels! Defend the entrance!
traduit: 是叛军！守住入口！

original: Stormcloaks!
traduit: 风暴斗篷！

original: Yes. An axe. How long have you been in Skyrim. Give the man my axe.
traduit: 没错。斧子。你在天际多久了？把我的斧头交给他。

original: If he keeps it, I will bide my time. If he returns it to you, it means war.
traduit: 如果他收下，我会等待时机。如果他退还给你，就意味着战争。

original: Men who understand each other often have no need for words.
traduit: 互相理解的男人往往不需要言语。

original: There are but a few simple truths behind one warrior giving another his axe.
traduit: 当一个战士将自己的斧头交给另一个战士时，道理最简单不过了。

original: Balgruuf will know my meaning.
traduit: 巴尔古夫会明白我的意思。

original: Hrongar will know my meaning.
traduit: 霍隆格纳会了解我的意思。

original: Keep your wits about you. The Jarl of Whiterun is known for his temper.
traduit: 保持头脑清醒。白漫领主脾气坏得很。

original: What happened to capturing Mercer alive?
traduit: 活捉墨瑟的时候发生了什么？

original: From the moment you were struck with my poisoned arrow at Snow Veil Sanctum, my path changed its course.
traduit: 从你在雪幔圣所被我的毒箭射中的那一刻起，我的道路就改变了。

original: Perhaps I couldn't bring Mercer back alive, but together, we were able to clear my name and to put Gallus's memory to rest.
traduit: 也许我没法活捉墨瑟，但我们可以合作，洗清我的罪名，也让加卢斯安息。

original: I'd always intended Mercer's fate to ultimately be decided by the Guild, and it seems they've spoken.
traduit: 我一直想让公会对墨瑟的命运做最终决断，现在看来他们已经决定了。

original: I suggest you talk to Karliah first. She has some news that'll turn your stomach.
traduit: 我建议你先和卡莱亚谈谈。她有些消息可能会让你反胃。

original: Time's wasting and Mercer's still out there. Let's get this show on the road.
traduit: 别再浪费时间了，墨瑟还在逍遥法外。我们快开始吧。

original: This is enough to make your head spin, eh?
traduit: 这足以让你头晕目眩了吧？

original: I think we should trust the lass and take the deal.
traduit: 我觉得咱们应该相信那姑娘，接受协议。

original: I'm just as puzzled as you, lad.
traduit: 我和你一样困惑，小子。

original: I'm just as puzzled as you, lass.
traduit: 我和你一样困惑，姑娘。

original: I think we can trust Karliah. Let's see what she's on about.
traduit: 我觉得卡莱亚可以信任。看看她要说什么吧。

original: I have some preparations of my own to make. I'll meet you at the stone.
traduit: 我也有些准备工作要做。咱们在立石会合。

original: Not now, lad. Karliah said it was important.
traduit: 现在不行，小子。卡莱亚说这事很重要。

original: Not now, lass. Karliah said it was important.
traduit: 现在不行，姑娘。卡莱亚说这事很重要。

original: We'll speak when the Oath is complete.
traduit: 等立誓之后我们再谈。

original: You appear ready for the Oath.
traduit: 看来你已经准备好宣誓了。

original: You appear hesitant to don your Nightingale Armor. What's troubling you?
traduit: 你似乎还在犹豫要不要穿夜莺甲。有什么问题吗？

original: It's just ahead. Please, keep following.
traduit: 就在前面了。请跟上。

original: I'm preparing to leave for the standing stone. What is it?
traduit: 我正准备去立石。有事吗？

original: I promise you, all your questions will be answered. You just have to trust me.
traduit: 我向你保证，所有问题都会有答案。只要你相信我。

original: Just outside of Riften, beyond the Southeast Gate is a small path cut up the mountainside.
traduit: 在裂谷城外，东南门后面有一条沿山坡斜插的小路。

original: At the end of that path is a clearing and an old standing stone. I'd ask you both meet me there.
traduit: 小路尽头有一块空地和一块古老的立石。你们俩去那里和我会合吧。

original: Then it's all true... everything I heard in the stories. The Nightingales, their allegiance to Nocturnal and the Twilight Sepulcher.
traduit: 那这一切都是真的……传说里的一切。忠于诺克图娜尔和黄昏坟墓的夜莺。

original: We have to be very careful, Brynjolf. Mercer is a Nightingale, an Agent of Nocturnal.
traduit: 我们得慎之又慎，布林乔夫。墨瑟是夜莺，是诺克图娜尔的特使。

original: Aye, lass... and I've come to a decision.
traduit: 好，姑娘……我已经做出决定了。

original: Mercer Frey tried to kill both of you, he betrayed the Guild, murdered Gallus and made us question our future. He needs to die.
traduit: 墨瑟·弗雷企图谋害你俩，背叛公会，杀害加卢斯，让我们对未来充满迷茫。他必须死。

original: Brynjolf, the time has come to decide Mercer's fate. Until a new Guild Master is chosen, the decision falls to you.
traduit: 布林乔夫，决定墨瑟命运的时刻到了。在新的公会大师被选出前，由你来做决定吧。

original: Stay your hand, warrior!
traduit: 不要动，勇士！

original: It's no secret why you're here and you have proven your skill in combat. Let us talk a moment, and no one else needs to die.
traduit: 你来这里已经不是什么秘密了，你在战斗中也证明了自己的实力。我们来谈一谈，不要再有无谓的伤亡了。

original: I think we can all profit from the situation in which we find ourselves.
traduit: 我觉得咱们可以各退一步。

original: My men will not attack you, if you will lower your weapons.
traduit: 如果你放下武器，我的人是不会攻击你的。

original: She won't be harmed?
traduit: 她不会受到伤害吗？

original: Not on the way back. Once she gets there, it's not up to me to decide what's done with her.
traduit: 在回去的路上是不会的。但等她到了那里，就不是由我来决定了。

original: And as for you, I owe you a portion of the reward, don't I?
traduit: 至于你，我还欠你一份报酬，对吧？

original: Well, here you go. Spend it wisely, and if I may... Don't allow yourself to be fooled by a pretty face. You're better than that.
traduit: 好了，给你。好好用吧，如果可以的话……不要被漂亮脸蛋儿给迷惑了。你不是那种人。

original: Now, we'll take our friend here back to Hammerfell, where she will pay the price for her treason.
traduit: 现在，得带着这位朋友回落锤了，在那里她要为叛国罪付出代价。

original: I... I will. Thank you...
traduit: 我……我会的。谢谢你……

original: Erandur, she has a point. You keep telling us no harm will follow these dreams, but they must be an omen.
traduit: 依兰杜尔，她说的也有道理。你一直说我们不会被梦伤害，但那肯定是什么预兆。

original: It's the same dream over and over again. You think that's normal? It's evil I tell you!
traduit: 同一个梦一遍遍重复。你觉得这正常？我告诉你，这是邪祟！

original: Irgnir, get a hold of yourself. They're just dreams. Please tell her, Erandur.
traduit: 伊格涅尔，自制一点。依兰杜尔，快告诉她这就是梦罢了。

original: It's a curse! It has to be! I've got to get out of this town.
traduit: 这是诅咒！一定是的！我得离开这个镇子。

original: I don't know how you made it this far, but you'll go no farther.
traduit: 我不知道你是怎么走这么远的，但你不用再走了。

original: Listen, lad. There's one last piece of business we need to settle before we go after Mercer... the leadership of the Guild.
traduit: 听着，小子。在我们对付墨瑟前还有最后一件事要解决……关于公会的领导权。

original: Listen, lass. There's one last piece of business we need to settle before we go after Mercer... the leadership of the Guild.
traduit: 听着，姑娘。在我们对付墨瑟前还有最后一件事要解决……关于公会的领导权。

original: I have two others that wish to transact the Oath; to serve you both in life and in death.
traduit: 我和另外二人希望宣读誓言，此生来世都为您效忠。

original: Lady Nocturnal, we accept your terms. We dedicate ourselves to you as both your avengers and your sentinels.
traduit: 诺克图娜尔夫人，我们接受您的条件。我们以复仇者与哨卫的身份向您效忠。

original: We will honor our agreement in this life and the next until your conditions have been met.
traduit: 我们今生来世都会遵守约定，直到满足您的条件。

original: My Lady, I've come before you to throw myself upon your mercy and to accept responsibility for my failure.
traduit: 夫人，我来此恳求您的宽恕，并为我的失败承担责任。

original: I call upon you Lady Nocturnal, Queen of Murk and Empress of Shadow... hear my voice!
traduit: 我召唤您，诺克图娜尔夫人，黑暗与阴影的女皇……请聆听我的呼唤！

original: Religion and thieves make odd bedfellows.
traduit: 宗教和盗贼真是怪异的组合。

original: This isn't about religion or destiny. This is nothing more than a business transaction between yourself and Nocturnal.
traduit: 这与宗教或命运无关。不过是你和诺克图娜尔之间的交易。

original: Consider this an extremely risky job but with a massive potential for profit, and you'll do fine.
traduit: 这是一项危险却暴利的工作，你会做得很好。

original: Am I to become a Nightingale?
traduit: 我会成为夜莺吗？

original: It's my hope that you will, yes.
traduit: 我希望你会，没错。

original: This is Nightingale Hall. You're the first of the uninitiated to set foot inside in over a century.
traduit: 这里就是夜莺大厅了。你们是这一百年来首次踏足这里的外人。

original: This isn't about religion, Brynjolf... it's business.
traduit: 这与宗教无关，布林乔夫……这是生意。

original: I'm trying to understand why I'm here, lass. I'm no priest, and I'm certainly not religious. Why pick me?
traduit: 我在试图理解自己为何身处此地，姑娘。我不是祭司，也不信教。为什么选择我？

original: What's wrong, Brynjolf? I can almost hear your brow furrowing.
traduit: 怎么了，布林乔夫？我都快听到你拧眉毛的声音了。

original: The assumption that the Nightingales were just a myth was seeded within the Guild on purpose.
traduit: 把夜莺当做传说的谣言是故意在公会里传播的。

original: It helped avert attention from our true nature.
traduit: 这样有助于转移人们对我们本质的关注。

original: So, this is Nightingale Hall. I heard about this place when I joined the Guild, but I never believed it existed.
traduit: 原来，这里就是夜莺大厅啊。我加入公会时就听说过这地方，但从来不相信它真的存在。

original: What's the significance of this place?
traduit: 这地方有什么意义吗？

original: This is the headquarters of the Nightingales, cut into the mountainside by the first of our kind.
traduit: 这里是夜莺的总部，由我们的先辈在山腰处开辟出来。

original: We've come to seek the edge we need to defeat Mercer Frey.
traduit: 来看看这里能不能找到打败墨瑟·弗雷的致胜法宝吧。

original: What kind of an edge?
traduit: 什么样的致胜法宝？

original: If you'll follow me, I'll try to explain on the way.
traduit: 跟我来吧，路上会跟你解释的。

original: I'm glad you're here.
traduit: 很高兴你来了。

original: Here's the Jagged Crown. I believe you owe Galmar a drink?
traduit: 这是锯齿王冠。这次你可欠加尔玛一顿酒了。

original: Damn him - the old bear was right! Did you run into any trouble?
traduit: 那个该死的老熊说对了！有遇到什么麻烦吗？

original: Just try it. Maybe a little time inside Cidhna Mine will get rid of all that fat on you.
traduit: 有种就试试。也许在希讷矿场待一阵子你身上的肥膘也就没了。

original: You little twig. I'll snap you in two!
traduit: 你个瘦麻杆。看我把你撕碎了！

original: I said give me some meat. I'm hungry, and the Divines know you don't need more food in that huge gut of yours.
traduit: 我说给我点肉。我饿了，圣灵们知道你的大肚子里用不了这么多吃的。

original: What did you say to me, Reachman?
traduit: 你跟我说什么呢，瑞驰人？

original: Alms. Give me some meat, you fat Nord!
traduit: 施舍。给点肉，你个肥诺德佬！

original: Hogni Red-Arm, more like Hogni Fat-Arm.
traduit: “红臂”霍尼，是“肥臂”霍尼吧。

original: How dare you. No one turns down cut meat from Hogni Red-Arm!
traduit: 你扯淡。没有人能拒绝“红臂”霍尼的肉！

original: Picking on me again, you backbiting Nord? Tired of those prissy nobles turning down your rotten slabs of venison?
traduit: 你个背后挑刺儿的诺德人又来欺负我？你是厌倦了那些挑剔的老爷们拒绝吃你那腐烂的鹿肉了吗？

original: Look at you, begging on the streets. Learn a trade.
traduit: 看看你，成天在街上乞讨。学门手艺吧。

original: Let's not talk about this over dinner.
traduit: 吃饭的时候不提这些了。

original: The stones aren't what bother me, love. The Forsworn are tearing the Reach apart.
traduit: 困扰我的不是石头，亲爱的。弃誓者正在瑞驰肆虐。

original: The city hasn't changed that much, dear. Same old dwarven stones gathering the same old moss.
traduit: 城市没变啊，亲爱的。一样的矮人老石头聚集着一样的老苔藓。

original: Markarth has changed, but the inn is as lively as ever.
traduit: 马卡斯变了，但旅馆还是一样热闹。

original: Maybe. Let me think about it.
traduit: 也许吧。让我想想。

original: Maybe we could spend a little bit more and buy some meat, Endon.
traduit: 也许我们可以多花点前买点肉，恩东。

original: Stew again, papa? I want steak.
traduit: 又炖啊，爸爸？我想吃牛排。

original: Something simple, a stew perhaps.
traduit: 来点简单的，炖菜怎么样。

original: What should we have tonight?
traduit: 我们今晚吃什么？

original: Yes, I know. As does Astrid. You have done well, and have earned both your reward, and a bonus, as I may have mentioned.
traduit: 是，我知道了。阿斯垂德也知道了。你做的很好，我说过，既能拿报酬，还有额外奖励。

original: But you should know that we have a more pressing matter to deal with.
traduit: 但你要知道，我们还有更紧急的事情要处理。

original: It's... Cicero. There's been an incident. You should proceed into the Sanctuary. I'll let Astrid explain.
traduit: 是……西塞罗。出了点意外。你进圣所去吧。还是让阿斯垂德来解释吧。

original: Gaius Maro is dead.
traduit: 加留斯·马洛死了。

original: Yes, I know. As does Astrid. And you've earned your payment, though the bonus is forfeit, as I'm sure you're aware.
traduit: 是，我知道了。阿斯垂德也知道了。你的报酬按数发放。但是没有奖励了，我想你也明白。

original: Ah, at last. I've been anxiously awaiting your return.
traduit: 啊，你终于回来了。我可是等急了。

original: Why are you here? Killing Gaius Maro is but the first step of your contract - you must also plant the incriminating letter on his body...
traduit: 你怎么还在这儿？你契约的第一步就是杀死加留斯·马洛，把栽赃信放在他尸体上。

original: Head for the Great Hall, quickly! Don't stop for anything!
traduit: 快去大厅！不要停下来！

original: Be on your guard. I've no idea what to expect inside the College.
traduit: 保持警惕。我也不知道在学院里会发生什么。

original: If it can help us get inside the College, and reach Ancano, we'll have to hope that there's a way to stop all this.
traduit: 如果它能帮咱们进入学院，找到安卡诺，那我们就只能寄希望有办法阻止这一切。

original: You're the one with the staff, my boy.
traduit: 你才是掌握法杖的人啊，孩子。

original: You're the one with the staff, my dear.
traduit: 你才是掌握法杖的人啊，孩子。

original: Come then. See what I can do now.
traduit: 来吧。看看我现在的能耐。

original: The power to unmake the world at my fingertips, and you think you can do anything about it?
traduit: 我弹指之间就能毁灭世界，你还能做些什么？

original: You think I don't know what you're up to? You think I can't destroy you?
traduit: 你以为我不知道你想干什么吗？你以为我毁不了你不成？

original: You've come for me, have you?
traduit: 你是来找我的？

original: I know what you mean about these old ruins.
traduit: 我想知道你对这些古老遗迹的看法。

original: You, too, huh? I'd much rather a straight up fight than creeping around a place like this.
traduit: 你也一样吗？我宁愿直来直去地打一架也不愿意溜进这种地方。

original: But never mind all that. We're the Emperor's soldiers. We'll do our duty no matter what stands in our way, right?
traduit: 但管不了了。我们是皇帝的士兵。不管有什么阻碍，都得尽职尽责，不是吗？

original: These old ruins... They don't want us here, the ancient ones. Better left alone.
traduit: 这些旧废墟……古人不希望我们踏足这里搅扰他们。

original: Good to see you, my friend! I knew you'd make a proper Legionnaire.
traduit: 见到你真好，朋友！我就知道你会成为一名合格的军团兵。

original: I'm glad you'll be with me in there. I don't like the looks of this place... and I'm not talking about the Stormcloaks.
traduit: 很高兴你能陪我进去。我不太喜欢这地方的样子……倒不是害怕风暴斗篷。

original: I remember you... You were with us at Helgen... I heard you came around and picked the right side. Welcome to the Legion!
traduit: 我记得你……你当时在海尔根……听说你选择了正确的一方，欢迎加入军团！

original: I'm glad you're with us. I don't like the looks of this place... and I'm not talking about the Stormcloaks.
traduit: 很高兴你能和我们一起。我不太喜欢这地方的样子……倒不是害怕风暴斗篷。

original: No politics, Thongvor. I told you before.
traduit: 别聊政治，松瓦。我以前就跟你说过。

original: Sometimes I miss the Legion, back when the Empire stood up for Skyrim.
traduit: 有时我会想念军团，想念帝国还在为天际挺身而出的时候。

original: Your family's success burdens you, does it?
traduit: 你家族的成功成了你的负担了，是吧？

original: I grow tired of counting coin all day. Put steel in my hand, not gold.
traduit: 我对整天数钱感到烦了。我手里拿的应该是钢铁，不是黄金。

original: Hello, my friend. Come to visit the forge?
traduit: 你好啊，哥们。来参观铁匠铺吗？

original: Flattery doesn't suit you, Thongvor.
traduit: 拍马屁不适合你，松瓦。

original: I was about to say how impressed I was that you always managed to put it back together.
traduit: 我刚想说我对你总能把它重新组装起来感到惊奇。

original: Well, if you had learned to swing it correctly. A sword is an extension of the arm, not a meat cleaver.
traduit: 嗯，如果你学会了如何挥舞它。剑就变成了手臂的延伸，而不是切肉刀。

original: Remember that old rusty sword I had? Damn thing must have had over a hundred chips in it.
traduit: 还记得我那把生锈的老剑吗？那该死的东西里头肯定已经碎成一百片儿了。

original: It's fine. Much better than the rickety tools I had in the Legion.
traduit: 很好。比我在军团里用的那些破烂工具好多了。

original: How's the forge today?
traduit: 铁匠铺今天怎么样？

original: There's no going back?
traduit: 没法后悔吗？

original: Once the Oath has been struck, the terms are binding.
traduit: 一旦誓约生效，条款就具有约束力了。

original: Knowing this, are you ready to undergo the ceremony?
traduit: 知道这些后，准备好接受仪式了吗？

original: And in return?
traduit: 回报呢？

original: In return, you'll be required to defend the Twilight Sepulcher and everything within when the need arises.
traduit: 作为报偿，你会被要求在需要的时候保卫黄昏坟墓和里面的一切。

original: More importantly, upon your death, your spirit will be bound to the Twilight Sepulcher as one of its guardians.
traduit: 更重要的是，死后，你的灵魂将作为守护者与黄昏坟墓相连。

original: I'm not sure I understand the terms.
traduit: 我还不太明白这些条款。

original: By transacting the Oath with Nocturnal, you're entering into a business deal.
traduit: 通过向诺克图娜尔宣誓，你就达成了一项交易。

original: You'll be provided all of the power and knowledge befitting a Nightingale.
traduit: 你将拥有身为夜莺的一切力量和知识。

original: You're free to use those powers as you see fit to further your own goals or the goals of the Thieves Guild.
traduit: 你可以自由使用你认为适合的能力来更好地对付自己或盗贼公会的目标。

original: Yes, I'm ready.
traduit: 是，我准备好了。

original: Good. After I open the gate, please stand on the western circle.
traduit: 好，我开门后请站在西面的环里。

original: Yes?
traduit: 嗯？

original: What about you? Are you ready to transact the Oath with Nocturnal?
traduit: 你呢？你准备好和诺克图娜尔交换誓言了吗？

original: Aye, there's always a catch. But at this point, I suppose there isn't much to lose.
traduit: 啊，总是会有些代价的。不过到现在，我也没什么可失去的了。

original: If it means the end of Mercer Frey, you can count me in.
traduit: 如果这样就意味着墨瑟·弗雷末日降临，算我一个吧。

original: The terms are quite simple, Brynjolf. Nocturnal will allow you to become a Nightingale and use your abilities for whatever you wish.
traduit: 条件很简单，布林乔夫。诺克图娜尔允许你成为夜莺，用你的能力做自己想做的事。

original: And in return, both in life and in death, you must serve as a guardian of the Twilight Sepulcher.
traduit: 作为回报，无论是生是死，都必须作为黄昏坟墓的守护者。

original: You must be the new unblooded. Welcome to the fight, brother.
traduit: 你一定是新来的吧。欢迎加入战斗，兄弟。

original: You must be the new unblooded. Welcome to the fight, sister.
traduit: 你一定是新来的吧。欢迎加入战斗，姐妹。

original: At least we got the damn crown. I hope it was worth it.
traduit: 至少我们拿到了这破王冠。希望这是值得的。

original: I wish Galmar would hurry it up. We shouldn't be here.
traduit: 但愿加尔玛能快点。我们不该在这里。

original: I don't know what we're doing here. Ulfric must have his reasons.
traduit: 我不知道我们在这里干什么。但乌弗瑞克肯定自有道理。

original: I keep thinking I see something moving in the shadows...
traduit: 我一直觉得自己看到阴影里有东西在动……

original: I hope we don't run into anything worse than Imperials in here.
traduit: 希望不会碰到比帝国兵还糟的东西。

original: Keep a sharp eye out.
traduit: 保持警惕。

original: Don't interfere with Imperial Legion business. Now move along, unless you want three inches of steel in your gut.
traduit: 不要干涉帝国军团的事务。再向前走就不客气了。

original: You must be the new recruit. Welcome to the Legion.
traduit: 你是新兵吧。欢迎加入军团。

original: I wish the Legate would let us clear out of here. Place gives me the creeps.
traduit: 但愿副官会让我们离开这儿。这地方太瘆人了。

original: I don't know what we're doing here, but orders are orders.
traduit: 我不知道我们在做什么，但命令就是命令。

original: I hope we don't run into anything worse than Stormcloaks in here.
traduit: 希望不会遇到比风暴斗篷还糟糕的东西。

original: It's the waiting that gets me.
traduit: 等待真是难受。

original: I don't like the look of this place.
traduit: 我不太喜欢这地方的样子。

original: Nobody allowed in. Ulfric Stormcloak's orders. Consider yourself warned.
traduit: 奉乌弗瑞克·风暴斗篷之命，任何人不得入内。这是警告。

original: But never mind all that. We've got a job to do, and nothing's going to stand in our way.
traduit: 但先别管这些了。我们还有任务，没什么能阻挡我们。

original: You, too, huh? I'd take a straight fight with the whole Legion over creeping around a place like this.
traduit: 你也一样吗？我宁愿去跟整个军团打一架，也不想在这种地方鬼鬼祟祟地。

original: These old ruins... My father always told me to stay away from them. Good advice, I'd say.
traduit: 这些古老遗迹……我爸总说叫我离这种地方远点。不得不说，这是个好建议。

original: Ha, I knew you'd join up! Great news. We'll take back Skyrim together, eh?
traduit: 哈，我就知道你会加入我们！好消息啊。我们一起来夺回天际吧？

original: I remember you... you were with us at Helgen. I heard you joined us. Welcome to the Stormcloaks!
traduit: 我记得你……你和我们一起被抓到海尔根了。我听说你加入我们了。欢迎加入风暴斗篷！

original: Ooh... This place really chills the blood, eh?
traduit: 哦……这地方真瘆人，是吧？

original: Just keep at it, or Mulush will beat you.
traduit: 坚持吧，不然穆鲁什该打你了。

original: Divines, I'm tired. This is too much work.
traduit: 圣灵啊，我太累了。这工作量也太大了。

original: I know what I'm doing. Stop telling me.
traduit: 我知道自己在干嘛。不用告诉我。

original: Careful of the molten metal. That gets on you, kiss your fingers goodbye.
traduit: 熔炼金属的时候小心点。要是沾上了，就和手指吻别吧。

original: Yes, Mulush.
traduit: 是，穆鲁什。

original: If I see you sneaking off with even one speck of silver, I'll break your leg and throw you into the river.
traduit: 如果我看到你们带银子出去，哪怕是点银子渣儿，我都把你的腿打断再扔到河里去。

original: I don't want any of you thieving workers even thinking about stealing any silver.
traduit: 你们这群偷东西的工人可别想着去偷银。

original: No Mulush. I'll work harder.
traduit: 不，穆鲁什。我会努力工作的。

original: I could smelt metal in half the time as you weak-willed pink-skins. Do I have to do everything?
traduit: 我熔炼金属只需要你们这些意志薄弱的小粉皮人的一半。什么都得我来弄吗？

original: Are you complaining? Work. If you have strength to whine, you have strength to smelt.
traduit: 你在抱怨吗？去干活儿。有劲儿抱怨就有劲儿干。

original: Mulush, we need a break. The heat from the smelter is too much.
traduit: 穆鲁什，我们需要休息。冶炼厂的温度实在太高了。

original: Did you just talk back to me? I'm not paid to listen. I'm paid to keep you working. Now work.
traduit: 你跟我顶嘴呢？我不是被雇来听抱怨的。我拿钱就是让你继续工作。赶紧干活。

original: I'm being as careful as I can.
traduit: 我已经够小心了。

original: Careful. You spill one drop of silver, I'm taking it out of your hide.
traduit: 小心着。敢漏出一滴银子，我就从你身上掏回来。

original: Cedran said he'd... what am I paying you for? Next time, you bring the shipment in yourself.
traduit: 赛丹说他……那我雇你是干什么的？下次你自己把货运来。

original: Only a few things came today. Cedran said he'd drop it off later.
traduit: 今天只有几件东西。赛丹说过会送来。

original: Where are my goods? Did the shipment come in?
traduit: 我的货在哪里？货还没到吗？

original: Lazy oaf.
traduit: 懒鬼。

original: There are no goods to bring to the store. That's what I'm saying.
traduit: 没有货能运到商店来。这就是我要说的。

original: What do I pay you for, to stand around all day? You're supposed to be bringing goods to the store.
traduit: 我付你工钱是干嘛的，雇你整天站着吗？你应该去运货。

original: No shipments have come in.
traduit: 还是没有货来。

original: What sort of arrangement? I need to know the terms.
traduit: 什么协议？我需要知道细节。

original: Okay, lass. We've got these getups on... now what?
traduit: 好吧，姑娘。我们穿上这些装束了……现在呢？

original: Beyond this gate is the first step in becoming a Nightingale.
traduit: 越过这扇门，就是成为夜莺的第一步。

original: Dear brother, I need you to steal into that chamber, and eavesdrop on their meeting.
traduit: 亲爱的兄弟，我需要你偷偷溜进房间，偷听他们的会面。

original: It'll be no use clinging to the shadows. They'll see you for sure. No, you need a hiding place. Somewhere they'd never think to look.
traduit: 隐藏在阴影里没用。他们一定会看到你。所以你需要一个藏身之处。一个他们从没想过要查看的地方。

original: Like inside the Night Mother's coffin.
traduit: 比如，夜母的棺材里。

original: Dear sister, I need you to steal into that chamber, and eavesdrop on their meeting.
traduit: 亲爱的姐妹，我需要你偷偷溜进房间，偷听他们的会面。

original: I made a mistake. I want to be a Stormcloak. The crown belongs to you.
traduit: 我做了错误的决定。现在我想加入风暴斗篷。王冠属于你了。

original: You're not short of guts, are you? What's your game?
traduit: 你很勇敢啊？你在玩什么把戏？

original: Why would Tullius waste resources getting the crown only to give it to me? Poisoned perhaps? No. He's not that cunning.
traduit: 图留斯干什么费这么大力气抢完王冠又送给我？想下毒吗？不对。他没那么狡猾。

original: Alright. I believe you. You aren't the first to turn away from the Empire in disgust.
traduit: 好吧。我信你。你不是第一个讨厌地离开帝国的。

original: But remember - you're one of us now, forever. Whatever Imperial loyalties you may have had... that's all in the past, forgotten.
traduit: 但记住，你从今往后都是是我们的一员。不管你对帝国多忠诚，那都是过去的事，忘了吧。

original: Now, to prove yourself to me, I have a task for you. Take my axe, and deliver it to the Jarl of Whiterun.
traduit: 现在，为了证明自己，我有个任务交给你办。把我的斧头交给白漫领主。

original: The Imperials wouldn't have just let you walk away. Remember that.
traduit: 记住，帝国军是不会这么放过你的。

original: I have the Jagged Crown.
traduit: 我有锯齿王冠。

original: So you as good as admit you're working for the Imperials. Yet you walk in here, and ask to join me. What are you playing at?
traduit: 那你算是承认自己为帝国人工作了。现在却又来要求加入我。你在耍什么把戏？

original: I just want to join the Legion. Consider the crown a gift.
traduit: 我只是想加入军团。王冠算是见面礼。

original: Well... you did show remarkable initiative. And you didn't have to bring the crown to me...
traduit: 嗯……你确实够主动。不然你也不会把王冠带给我……

original: But let me warn you - joining the Legion is for life. Any previous loyalties... I trust we understand each other.
traduit: 但我要警告你，加入军团是一辈子的事儿。以前效忠的都不作数了……我觉得咱们能彼此理解。

original: You can prove your new allegiance to me, by delivering an important message to the Jarl of Whiterun.
traduit: 你要向我证明自己的忠诚。去给白漫领主传递一个重要信息。

original: You'd do well to get out of here before I change my mind and have you locked in irons...
traduit: 在我改变主意把你锁起来前，最好赶紧离开……

original: I brought you the crown from Korvanjund.
traduit: 我从科万琼德把王冠给你带来了。

original: You... what? How could you possibly...
traduit: 你……什么？怎么可能……

original: Oh, so you're trying to play both sides, is that it? What do you really want?
traduit: 哦，你是想耍两面派不成？你到底想要什么？

original: I'd like to join the Imperial Legion.
traduit: 我想加入帝国军团。

original: You... you were at Helgen. One of the prisoners. What makes you think I'm interested in someone like you for the Legion?
traduit: 你……你是在海尔根的囚犯。你凭什么觉得我会对你这种人加入军团感兴趣？

original: I'm here to join your fight against the Empire.
traduit: 我来加入你们对抗帝国。

original: Are you now? You were at Helgen, one of the prisoners. Although no one seems to know how you got mixed up in that affair.
traduit: 你吗？我记得你当时也是海尔根的囚犯吧。不过好像没人知道你为什么被抓。

original: Normally, I would have welcomed someone like you -- resourceful, clearly no friend of the Empire.
traduit: 我通常都会欢迎你这样聪明能干、反对帝国的人。

original: But I've had some disturbing reports of you... seen talking to General Tullius in Castle Dour, for example.
traduit: 但我也听说了一些令人不安的情报……比如你在阴郁堡与图留斯将军的对话。

original: So what do you have to say for yourself? How can I be sure you're not an Imperial spy?
traduit: 有什么要说的吗？我如何鉴别你是不是帝国奸细？

original: You misunderstand. It's just... I feel for him, is all. To carry a weight like that. It's got to take its toll. That happened to me, I'd be a wreck.
traduit: 你误会了。我只是……很同情他，仅此而已。背负这么多，人是会伤的。要换我，早就垮了。

original: I'm going to pretend I didn't hear that. Commander Maro is the best the Penitus Oculatus has ever produced. You should be half the man he is.
traduit: 我可不愿意听这话。马洛指挥官是洞察眼建立以来最优秀的。你还不如他一半爷们儿。

original: I suppose. But what about the old man? Son killed, family name ruined... and he acts as if nothing even happened. Think he's even fit for duty?
traduit: 我知道。但那老头怎么办？儿子被杀了，家族声誉也毁了……他居然像个没事人似的。你觉得他能好好尽职吗？

original: You worry too much. The Emperor's never been safer. You think assassination attempts are planned overnight? We discovered the plot. End of threat.
traduit: 你多虑了。皇帝从没有过现在这么安全的时候。你觉得暗杀计划是一夜就能想好的吗？我们已经发现了阴谋，终结了威胁。

original: Lazy and useless, the lot of them. They can't even keep the Stormcloaks in line. No way I trust them with the Emperor's life.
traduit: 这群人又懒又没用。连风暴斗篷都制不住。我怎么放心把陛下的身家性命交给他们。

original: I'm all for diplomacy, but the sooner the Emperor deals with this civil war mess, the sooner we can get back to Cyrodiil.
traduit: 我赞成外交，但皇帝越快处理好内战问题，我们就能越早回到希罗帝尔。

original: This city is crawling with Imperial Legion, and you know what? I'm still nervous.
traduit: 你知道吗，这座城里到处都是帝国军团的人。我还是很紧张。

original: All these damn Stormcloaks. They're making me nervous. Never in a million years did I imagine they'd gain control of Solitude.
traduit: 这些该死的风暴斗篷。他们让我很紧张。我从没想过他们能够控制独孤城。

original: We have, of course, severed all ties with the mage in question, but the Jarl isn't appeased.
traduit: 当然，我们已经切断了与法师的所有联系，但领主还没消气。

original: So, the mage needs to be "taken care of," if you understand me.
traduit: 所以，法师需要被“照顾”，明白吧。

original: He's been complaining of a member of the College running amok in his hold.
traduit: 他一直在抱怨有个学院成员在自己的领地上乱跑。

original: She's been complaining of a member of the College running amok in her hold.
traduit: 她一直在抱怨有个学院成员在自己的领地上乱跑。

original: Is there anything I should be aware of?
traduit: 有什么需要我注意的事吗？

original: I'm afraid so. There's a problem with one of the Jarls here in Skyrim.
traduit: 恐怕是的。天际有位领主有点麻烦。

original: It's been dealt with.
traduit: 已经解决了。

original: Well, that's good to know. I suggest you tell your people at the College to keep a tighter leash on their mages.
traduit: 好，这是好消息。我建议你告诉你们学院的人，要对自己的法师严加管教。

original: I'm here on behalf of the College.
traduit: 我是代表学院来的。

original: Ah, so they've finally sent someone to deal with that lunatic.
traduit: 哦，这么说他们终于派人来对付那个疯子了。

original: Well, is it taken care of?
traduit: 好了，处理了吗？

original: So the Key unlocks any door?
traduit: 那这把钥匙能打开任何门？

original: Well, yes. But the Key isn't only restricted to physical barriers.
traduit: 嗯，没错。但并不仅限于物理意义上的障碍。

original: All of us possess untapped abilities; the potential to wield great power, securely sealed within our minds.
traduit: 我们都有未开发出来的潜力，拥有强大的潜能，只不过被牢牢封存在脑海里。

original: Once you realize the Key can access these traits, the potential becomes limitless.
traduit: 一旦你意识到钥匙激发这些特质，潜力也就变得无限。

original: He's done more?
traduit: 他还犯了别的罪？

original: Mercer was able to unlock the Guild's vault without two keys because of what he stole from the Twilight Sepulcher... the Skeleton Key.
traduit: 正因为墨瑟从黄昏坟墓偷来的东西，他才能不用两把钥匙就打开公会金库……万能钥匙。

original: By doing this, he's compromised our ties to Nocturnal and in essence, caused our luck to run dry.
traduit: 这样一来，我们与诺克图娜尔的联系就被破坏了，运气也逐渐枯竭。

original: Now that you've transacted the Oath, it's time to reveal the final piece of the puzzle to you; Mercer's true crime.
traduit: 现在你宣誓完毕，也是时候向你解释谜题的最后一部分了，墨瑟的真正罪行。

original: Maybe there's something on the claw itself that could help us.
traduit: 也许爪子上的东西能帮我们。

original: Looks like the door will open if we turn these rings the right way.
traduit: 如果我们把这些环转到正确位置，门就会打开。

original: Uh oh! Look out!
traduit: 哦哦！当心！

original: Careful! I wouldn't do that again unless you know for sure it's going to open.
traduit: 小心！我不会再试了，除非你确定它能被打开。

original: Hmm... what is that? Some kind of stone claw? I wonder what it's used for.
traduit: 嗯？那是什么？某种石头龙爪吗？不知道有什么用啊。

original: See what you can figure out auxillary, I'm going to check out these carvings over here. Let me know if you find something.
traduit: 辅助兵，看看你能想到什么。我去看看雕刻，有发现立刻报告。

original: Even if these carvings tell us where the crown is, I'm sure we're going to have to find a way through this door.
traduit: 就算这些雕刻能告诉我们王冠的下落，我们也得想办法穿过这扇门。

original: Looks like we weren't the first ones here, either.
traduit: 看来我们不是第一批到达的。

original: One thing at a time soldier. Focus on our primary mission. We're searching for the crown.
traduit: 士兵，一时只做一件事。专注我们的首要任务，找到王冠。

original: Too bad we can't read these carvings.  Who knows what secrets we'd uncover?
traduit: 可惜我们看不懂这些雕刻。不然兴许能发现些秘密？

original: Oh... I've heard of this. These walls are supposed to show the history of the ancients who built this place.
traduit: 哦……我听说过。这些墙上展示的是建造此地的古人们的历史。

original: And this must be the Hall of Stories.
traduit: 这里一定就是故事大厅了。

original: Did you need anything else?
traduit: 还需要些别的吗？

original: No, I think I have enough here to get started.
traduit: 不，我想我已经攒够材料开干了。

original: Here, let me give you this. It's the least I can do for all your trouble.
traduit: 给，请收下这个。对于你的麻烦我只能做这些了。

original: I have a chunk of gold ore for you.
traduit: 我有你要的金矿石。

original: Perfect. Melting this down will give me plenty of gold for those necklaces I started.
traduit: 完美。把它熔了我就有足够的金子开始做项链了。

original: I have a mammoth tusk for you.
traduit: 我有你要的猛犸牙。

original: The ivory from this tusk will be perfect for the inlay on my amulets.
traduit: 象牙很适合镶嵌在我做的护符上。

original: I have your flawless sapphires.
traduit: 我有你要的蓝宝石。

original: Good, these will make wonderful settings for my rings.
traduit: 好，这会成为我戒指上的绝佳装饰。

original: Madesi was actually my original Saxhleel name. Unlike others, I decided to embrace tradition and keep it that way.
traduit: 玛德希是我最初的萨克希尔名。不像其他人，我决定拥抱传统并保持下去。

original: Saxhleel?
traduit: 萨克希尔？

original: Forgive me. It's a term I haven't used in some time. While most in Tamriel call my kind Argonian, we prefer the term Saxhleel.
traduit: 请原谅我。我有阵子没用过这个词了。虽然泰姆瑞尔的大多数人都管我们一族叫阿尔贡，但我们更喜欢自称“萨克希尔”。

original: Forgive me. It's a term I haven't used in some time. While most in Tamriel would call us Argonian, we prefer the term Saxhleel.
traduit: 请原谅我。我有阵子没用过这个词了。虽然泰姆瑞尔的大多数人都管咱们叫阿尔贡，但我们更喜欢自称“萨克希尔”。

original: I'm seeking a small list of items to complete my next creation: two flawless sapphires, a mammoth tusk and a chunk of gold ore.
traduit: 为了完成我下一个作品，我正在寻找几样小东西：两颗无瑕蓝宝石、一根猛犸牙和一块金矿石。

original: Thank you, marsh-friend.
traduit: 谢谢了，沼泽朋友。

original: Thank you, land-strider.
traduit: 谢谢了，陆上行者。

original: Do you make your own jewelry?
traduit: 这些首饰都是你自己做的？

original: I do. Sadly, I'm one of the few traditional Saxhleel Jewelers that remains in Tamriel; it's becoming a lost art.
traduit: 是的。遗憾的是，我已经是泰姆瑞尔为数不多的传统萨克希尔珠宝匠人了，这门艺术快要失传了。

original: Only trouble is gathering materials has become hazardous. The roads to the mines and to the other cities are thick with bandits... and worse.
traduit: 唯一的麻烦就是收集材料越来越危险了。通往矿山和其他城市的路上挤满了强盗……甚至更糟。

original: Would you be interested in gathering some materials for me? I'd certainly be happy to compensate you.
traduit: 你有兴趣帮我收集些材料吗？当然，我很乐意为此补偿你。

original: I've brought the ore sample from Filnjar.
traduit: 我从菲林亚那带来了矿石样本。

original: Thank you. I'll be sure to get Elgrim to examine this as soon as his... busy schedule allows.
traduit: 谢谢你！我会让艾尔格瑞姆检查的，只要他……繁忙的日程允许的话。

original: Here, I had him make you a few things for all that travel.
traduit: 给，我让他给你做了些旅行必需品。

original: What's so special about this ore?
traduit: 这矿石有什么特别的吗？

original: Redbelly is supposed to be nothing but an iron mine. Been working it for years.
traduit: 红腹矿场只是个铁矿，我已经挖了很多年了。

original: Then right before the spiders had moved in, we found that chunk of ore. Never seen anything like it.
traduit: 就在蜘蛛搬进去之前，我们发现了那块矿石，从来没见过这样的东西。

original: I want to know what I'm dealing with before I start tearing it out of the ground.
traduit: 在我把它挖出来之前，我想知道我在面对什么东西。

original: I'm here for Elgrim's ore sample.
traduit: 我来拿艾尔格瑞姆的矿石样本。

original: It's about time; I sent them a letter weeks ago. That Elgrim... he'd forget his own pants if his wife didn't help him dress.
traduit: 是时候来了。我几周前就给他们寄了信。艾尔格瑞姆……如果他老婆不帮他穿衣服，他连裤子都能忘了。

original: Here you go. Tell Hafjorg that she can chip off whatever she thinks is a fair trade for their time.
traduit: 给你。告诉哈弗约格，只要她觉得合适，随她怎么切。

original: The job pays well, so I hope I can make arrangements soon. We could really use the gold.
traduit: 这工作能赚不少，所以我希望能尽快安排。我们真的很需要钱。

original: I could get it for you.
traduit: 我可以帮你拿。

original: You would? Oh, that would be wonderful.
traduit: 你吗？哦，那太好了。

original: Speak to Filnjar in Shor's Stone. He's got some sort of ore sample he wants us to identify and was willing to pay us well for it.
traduit: 和舒尔之石的菲林亚谈谈。他那有种矿石样本想让我们鉴定，他愿意为此付高价。

original: Are you jealous of her?
traduit: 你嫉妒她吗？

original: Oh! No, I didn't mean it that way. Elgrim can barely put his on his own shoes let alone have the energy to pursue a young girl.
traduit: 哦！不，我不只是那个意思。艾尔格瑞姆连自己的鞋子都提不上，更别说有精力去追年轻姑娘了。

original: He's been gushing about how talented Ingun is at alchemy. He'd never say it to her face; that's not his way.
traduit: 他一直滔滔不绝说因甘在炼金术方面很有天赋。但他永远不会当着她面说，这就是他的做法。

original: I just think Elgrim's taken it upon himself to mentor the young thing so he focuses a lot of attention on her.
traduit: 我只是觉得艾尔格瑞姆承担了指导这孩子的责任，所以把很多注意力都放在了她身上而已。

original: Are you an alchemist as well?
traduit: 你也是炼金术士吗？

original: I know how to mix a few basic potions, but I'm nowhere near as skilled as a master alchemist.
traduit: 我懂得混合一些基本药剂的方法，但远没有炼金大师那样熟练。

original: I've picked up a few tricks by reading the tomes scattered all over the shop, but I don't have the knack to pull half of the formulas off.
traduit: 我在阅读店里散落的各种书的时候学到了一些诀窍，但还没有学到其中一半。

original: Does it bother you living underground?
traduit: 住在地下很困扰吗？

original: When Elgrim said we were setting up shop down here, I told him he would catch his death.
traduit: 艾尔格瑞姆说要在这里开店的时候，我说他会死的。

original: The dirt, the moisture... it's disgusting. Who wants to spend their life living like a skeever?
traduit: 泥土、湿气……挺恶心的。谁愿意一辈子过得像个恶鼠呢？

original: But that old bellyacher just fed me some nonsense about light ruining his mixtures and being close to the water... agh.
traduit: 但那老家伙跟我说了一堆废话，什么光线会破坏他的合剂，离水近什么的……哎。

original: You've got your hands full, eh?
traduit: 你忙得不可开交吗？

original: I swear, if I wasn't around, Elgrim would forget to eat his meals. How we make any coin at all is beyond me.
traduit: 我发誓，如果我不在了，艾尔格瑞姆连吃饭都能忘了。我们挣钱全指着我。

original: In fact, I need to arrange for someone to pick up an ore sample for me in Shor's Stone... goodness knows Elgrim won't lift a finger to do it.
traduit: 其实，我需要找人帮忙到舒尔之石取下矿石样本……神是知道艾尔格瑞姆不会动根手指的。

original: How did you capture Ulfric?
traduit: 你是怎么擒获乌弗瑞克的？

original: I was assigned to Ulfric's guard. We were on our way to Darkwater Crossing, in the south of Eastmarch.
traduit: 我被派去充任乌弗瑞克的护卫。结果我们在向暗水岔口进发的路上遭到了伏击，就在东陲领的南部。

original: The Imperials were waiting for us. As pretty an ambush as I ever saw. We were outnumbered five to one, at least.
traduit: 帝国军埋伏在那。确实是一场漂亮的伏击战，我们要与五倍于自己的敌人作战。

original: Ulfric ordered us to stop fighting. Didn't want us all to die for nothing, I guess.
traduit: 乌弗瑞克命令我们停止战斗。我猜他是不想我们都白白送死。

original: I thought they were taking us south to Cyrodiil. Parade us in front of the Emperor. But then we stopped in Helgen, and you know the rest.
traduit: 我以为他们会把我们南送希罗帝尔交到皇帝面前。结果却在海尔根停下了，后头的事你都知道了。

original: How did you end up as Imperial prisoners?
traduit: 你是怎么沦为帝国的犯人的？

original: A masterstroke by General Tullius! He's only been in charge here for a few months, but he's turned things around for the Empire.
traduit: 这是图留斯将军的妙计！他只来了几个月就为帝国扭转了局面。

original: We've been trying to catch Ulfric since the war started, but he always seemed to slip through our fingers... like he knew we were coming.
traduit: 从战争开始，我们就想捉住乌弗瑞克，但他总能从我们的指缝间溜走……就像知道我们要来似的。

original: This time, the General turned the tables on him. Ulfric rode right into our ambush with only a few bodyguards.
traduit: 这次，将军转变了战局。乌弗瑞克只带了几个贴身侍卫就闯进了我们的伏击圈。

original: He surrendered pretty meekly, too. So much for his death-or-glory reputation.
traduit: 他很配合地投降了，他那非死即荣的名声也到头了。

original: I thought we were taking Ulfric back to Cyrodiil, but I guess the General changed his mind. You know the rest.
traduit: 我原以为会押着乌弗瑞克回希罗帝尔，但我猜将军改主意了。后头的事你都知道了。

original: Who are the Stormcloaks?
traduit: 风暴斗篷是什么人？

original: Surely even down in Cyrodiil people have heard news of the war in Skyrim?
traduit: 即便你人在希罗帝尔，也应该听到天际战争的消息了吧？

original: The Nords are tired of spending our blood fighting the Empire's wars, and paying for the Empire's decadence with our taxes.
traduit: 我们诺德人厌倦了为帝国的战争流血，也不会再用自己的税收为帝国的堕落买单了。

original: Ulfric is our rightful High King. He's leading the fight to drive the Empire out of Skyrim, once and for all.
traduit: 乌弗瑞克是我们合法的至高王。他正在领导一场将帝国永远逐出天际的战斗。

original: You haven't heard of the civil war in Skyrim? I guess down in Cyrodiil people have other things to worry about.
traduit: 你没听说过天际的内战？我猜希罗帝尔的人们在关心别的事吧。

original: It's pretty simple. Ulfric founded the Stormcloaks years ago, as a sort of private army to advance his ambitions.
traduit: 很简单，乌弗瑞克在几年前组建了风暴斗篷作为他的私人军队以推动他个人的野心。

original: He's always used the ban on the worship of Talos to stir people up against the Empire.
traduit: 他老是利用塔洛斯信仰禁令来煽动人民起来反对帝国。

original: He never succeeded in getting much support, so a few months ago he murdered the High King! That got the Empire's attention.
traduit: 他没能获得多少支持，所以几个月前他谋杀了至高王！这引起了帝国的注意。

original: That looks like the way out! I knew we'd make it!
traduit: 好像是出口！我就知道我们能逃出来！

original: Whew. That was close.
traduit: 喔，好险好险。

original: Sneaking is overrated, eh?
traduit: 潜行没多难吧？

original: Almost there.
traduit: 差不多了。

original: I'd rather not tangle with her right now. Let's try to sneak by. Just take it nice and slow, and watch where you step.
traduit: 我现在可不想吵着她，我们偷偷溜过去。慢点，注意脚下。

original: Hold up. There's a bear just ahead. See her?
traduit: 慢着。前面有头熊，看到了吗？

original: We'd better push on. The rest of them will have to find another way out.
traduit: 我们最好继续前进。其他人会找别的路的。

original: No going back that way, now.
traduit: 现在回不去了。

original: Good dog.
traduit: 好狗狗。

original: Stupid dog.
traduit: 蠢狗。

original: Let's see where this goes.
traduit: 看看这通向哪儿。

original: That thing was a dragon. No doubt. Just like the children's stories and the legends. The harbingers of the End Times.
traduit: 那是头货真价实的龙。就和童话还有传说里说的一样，末日的预兆。

original: No, not that it's any of your business.
traduit: 不，这不关你的事。

original: Oh, got a bit of an interest in your boss do you?
traduit: 哦，你对你老板有点兴趣了，是吗？

original: Leigelf is a good man, and I'm not running out on him now.
traduit: 雷盖尔夫是个好人，我现在不会抛弃他的。

original: You should quit working in the Eastern Mine. Leigelf's no good to work for.
traduit: 你应该停下在东边矿场的工作。给雷盖尔夫干活儿可不好。

original: That's why I come here to talk to you. You're all heart.
traduit: 这就是为什么我来这儿跟你说了。你可真有心了。

original: You're just getting older.
traduit: 只是你变老了。

original: Tough day at the mines. I swear the ore is getting harder to dig.
traduit: 这些天在矿场太艰苦了。我敢说矿石是越来越难挖了。

original: Aye, to your husband. Divines bless his memory.
traduit: 是啊，敬你丈夫一杯。愿圣灵保佑他的记忆。

original: Those were the days. I'd never seen my husband fight so bravely before.
traduit: 真怀念那段日子。我从没见过我丈夫会那么勇敢地战斗。

original: You mean Hildolf the Skull-Splitter? Remember when we rounded up the townspeople and dragged him out of that cave?
traduit: 你是说“劈颅者”希尔多夫？还记得咱们镇上的人围捕他然后把他从洞里拖出来吗？

original: Now, who was it that kidnapped the Jarl's son 20 years ago?
traduit: 二十年前是谁绑架了领主的儿子？

original: Animals in the Pale don't need a reason to attack Dawnstar. It's just their nature.
traduit: 苍原领的动物想要攻击晨星不需要理由。这是他们的天性。

original: Never did find out why they came sprawling into town like that.
traduit: 我一直不知道它们为什么会那样乱窜到镇子上。

original: How could I forget? That old alpha male almost took off my leg.
traduit: 怎么会忘呢？那老家伙差点把我腿咬断了。

original: Thoring, do you remember the time when that wolf pack come clamoring into town?
traduit: 梭灵，你还记得那群狼闯进镇上的事吗？

original: Oh, dearie, it was so long ago. But I do remember the celebration we had afterwards. Mead never tasted so good.
traduit: 哦，亲爱的，那是很久以前的事了。但我还记得我们后来的庆祝。蜜酒从没有那么好喝过。

original: Who were you fighting against?
traduit: 你的对手是谁？

original: Why, I once fought alongside your father when we were both younger. Saved him from getting his fool head sliced off.
traduit: 我们年轻的时候，我曾经和你的父亲并肩作战。还救了他一命，免得他的脑袋被砍掉。

original: Did you ever have to fight off bandits, Frida? Like in your stories?
traduit: 你曾经击退过强盗吗，福瑞达？就像你的那些故事里那样？

original: Dawnstar has always held its own against the bandits and wild animals of the Pale.
traduit: 晨星一直在对抗苍原领的强盗和野兽。

original: I was a beauty in my day, dearie. Don't act so surprised.
traduit: 我年轻时候可漂亮了，亲爱的。别那么惊讶。

original: Frida, you aren't saying....
traduit: 福瑞达，你不是在说……

original: Oh, he was young, and handsome. I had half a mind to go after him, myself, before I met my husband.
traduit: 哦，他当时又年轻又英俊。在遇到我丈夫之前，我还想追他呢。

original: I can't imagine Skald ever being young.
traduit: 我可想象不来斯卡德年轻的样子。

original: Did I ever tell you about the day when Skald the Elder was Skald the Younger?
traduit: 我有没有告诉过你老斯卡德还是小斯卡德时候的事？

original: Legate.
traduit: 副官。

original: It's always good to see someone I can count on.
traduit: 见到可靠的人真好。

original: The general expects so much with so little.
traduit: 将军的期望太高了。

original: The sooner we end this rebellion, the sooner I'll be able to sleep at night.
traduit: 结束这次叛乱，我晚上才能早早入睡。

original: Ulfric... what have you done my old friend?
traduit: 乌弗瑞克……老伙计，你都干了些什么？

original: Stormcloaks... even the name of their rebellion stinks of Ulfric's vanity. He wants to be king. That's all this is about. One man's ambition.
traduit: 风暴斗篷……连他们叛乱的名字都散发着乌弗瑞克的虚荣心。他想当至高王。这就是叛乱的全部。为了个人的野心。

original: I don't fight for the glory of the Empire, nor do I glory in the death of my kinsmen. I fight to bring peace and order to my homeland.
traduit: 我既不为帝国的荣誉而战，也不因族人的死感到光荣。我只想为家乡的和平与秩序而战。
