original: Damnit! Why can't Ulfric see he's tearing Skyrim to pieces?
traduit: 该死的！乌弗瑞克为什么不看看他在把天际撕成碎片？

original: Sometimes I wonder if the gods have abandoned us... as we have abandoned them.
traduit: 有时候我在想，众神或许抛弃了我们，就像我们抛弃他们那样……

original: What I do, I do for Skyrim and her people.
traduit: 我所做的一切都是为了天际和她的人民。

original: When we destroy the rebellion, perhaps the Thalmor will call off their damned inquisitions. It's just making things worse.
traduit: 等我们消灭了叛乱，梭默也许就会取消该死的宗教审判。这只会让事情变得更糟。

original: Sometimes I miss being out there in the middle of the action.
traduit: 有时候我很怀念那种被人包围的感觉。

original: Unblooded.
traduit: 新人。

original: Ice-Veins.
traduit: 冰之血脉。

original: Stormblade.
traduit: 风暴之刃。

original: Always good to see someone I can trust.
traduit: 见到可信任的人真好。

original: Sometimes I wonder if Ulfric understands what I'm dealing with out here.
traduit: 有时候我也怀疑乌弗瑞克是否理解我在外面的处境。

original: That godless Emperor can shove his damn treaty into the steaming nether-reaches of my you-know-where.
traduit: 让那个不信神的皇帝把那份倒霉条约拿去见鬼吧。

original: My hatred for the Empire is exceeded only by my hatred for their witch-elf puppet-masters.
traduit: 我恨帝国，更恨它背后那些玩傀儡的老巫精灵。

original: What will Skyrim have become if her children submitted to tyranny?
traduit: 如果天际的孩子们屈服于暴政，那她会变成什么样子？

original: The Empire would have us become their slaves as they have become slaves to the Thalmor. I will not live as a slave, nor will I die as one.
traduit: 帝国想要我们变成他们的奴隶，一如他们变成了梭默的奴隶。我无论生死，都绝不会像奴隶一样。

original: The Empire is weak. That is why we fight them. Skyrim must be ruled by the strong.
traduit: 帝国很弱，所以我们要反抗他们。天际必须交由强者统治。

original: Some say Ulfric desires to be king and nothing more... have they not seen that his anger floats on a sea of tears?
traduit: 有些人说乌弗瑞克只是想当至高王……难道他们就没看到他早已泪成汪洋、空余愤怒了吗？

original: Countless dead haunt countless sleepless nights... when Skyrim becomes whole again, perhaps so will I.
traduit: 无数亡者萦绕着无数不眠之夜……等天际重归统一，我或许也能去安息了。

original: When we've reclaimed our homeland from the Imperials, we'll take the fight to the Thalmor. They are the true enemy. Make no mistake.
traduit: 当我们从帝国手中夺回家园，就去和梭默战斗。他们无疑才是真正的敌人。

original: If there was someone else Ulfric could trust with all this planning nonsense, I'd be out there breaking heads with the rest of you.
traduit: 如果乌弗瑞克会信任别人在这儿胡出主意，那我肯定就会跟你们出去一起打仗了。

original: Skyrim is the birth place of the Empire. We won't let a bunch of thugs rob her of her lineage.
traduit: 天际是帝国的诞生地。我们不会让暴徒夺走她的地位。

original: General Tullius expects much of me, and thus I expect much of my men.
traduit: 图留斯将军对我期望很高，所以我对部下期望也很高。

original: In these grave times each Legionnaire must be his better self at all times and under all conditions.
traduit: 在这种严峻的时刻，每个军人都必须随时随地保持最佳状态。

original: The Empire is man's last bastion. If Ulfric wasn't blinded by lust for power, he'd see we are on the same side.
traduit: 帝国是人类最后的堡垒。如果乌弗瑞克没被权力蒙蔽双眼，他就会发现我们是一条战线上的。

original: Were the Stormcloaks to prevail in dismantling Imperial rule in Skyrim, who would be her protector? No. We will crush this rebellion. We must do.
traduit: 倘若风暴斗篷在天际战胜帝国的统治，那谁又能继续守护天际呢？不行。我们必须粉碎这次叛乱。

original: Ulfric would expunge from Skyrim citizens whose only crime was to be born of a non-Nordic woman. That is unacceptable to free men everywhere.
traduit: 乌弗瑞克会清除天际中的很多人，他们唯一的罪行就是自己不是诺德人。这是任何自由人都不能接受的。

original: Every Legionnaire's secret weapon lies in this: knowledge of himself. And like any blade, he must be forged between the hammer and the anvil.
traduit: 军团成员的秘密武器就是：了解自己。如同用锤与砧锻造武器一样磨练自己。

original: On the coldest of nights, in the steam rising from my breath, I see the many faces of the dead.
traduit: 在寒夜中我呵出的水雾里，我看到了很多逝去的面容。

original: We stand out here in the cold, as brothers, warmed by the knowledge that we fight for the rights of every free citizen of the Empire.
traduit: 我们如兄弟般坚守在寒冬中，只要我们为帝国每个自由公民的权利而战，就会感到温暖。

original: Stormblade!
traduit: 风暴之刃！

original: Look deeply into the faces of the warriors around you. These are the true sons and daughters of Skyrim. See her strength and nobility in their eyes.
traduit: 仔细看看周围战士们的脸庞，他们都是真正的天际儿女。眼中闪烁着力量与高尚的光。

original: The Empire would have us become slaves to the Thalmor. We are not slaves. We are men. Free men who will slay anyone who begs to differ.
traduit: 帝国想让我们变成梭默的奴隶。我们不是奴隶，我们是人类，是会杀死敌人的自由人类。

original: It was anger that brought each of us here, but it is love that keeps us fighting.
traduit: 愤怒将我们聚集，而爱会让我们坚持。

original: The measure of a man is taken at the moment of his death. And know this for truth, the ghosts of many heroes walk among us.
traduit: 一个人的价值要在死亡的那一刻才能被衡量。记住，无数英魂与我们同在。

original: One lives for the things he is willing to die for.
traduit: 人活着，都有愿意为之付出生命的东西。

original: My hatred for the Empire is bested only by love for my countrymen.
traduit: 我心中只有对同胞的爱能够胜过对帝国的恨。

original: The Emperor would turn Skyrim into a puppet of the Dominion. I for one would not care to dance for the amusement of those foul elves.
traduit: 皇帝想把天际变成先祖神洲的傀儡。我绝不会去谄媚那些混蛋精灵。

original: That we have forgotten them, this I fear the gods will remember.
traduit: 诸神恐怕会记恨我们把他们遗忘。

original: Before we wage war upon our foes, we must wage a war against our lesser selves. Cleave to your higher voice and with it shatter your foes.
traduit: 在与敌人战斗前，要先战胜怯懦的自我。放声怒吼吧，让敌人为之震颤。

original: I'll fight the entire Legion myself if they dare show their faces here.
traduit: 如果他们敢在这里露面。我就亲自和整个军团作战。

original: Legion soldiers gleam like fresh-fallen snow and clank like a kitchen. They head this way, we'll know it.
traduit: 军团兵像落雪一样在远处烁光，吵闹的像厨房开伙一样。我们会听到他们正在奔这里而来。

original: I long to be out there, with my brothers, waging war against the Empire.
traduit: 我渴望去和兄弟们并肩对抗帝国。

original: Keep an eye out for Stormcloak spies.
traduit: 注意风暴斗篷的奸细。

original: Been so long since I killed a Stormcloak, my sword arm's getting flabby.
traduit: 我很久没杀过风暴斗篷了。连握剑的胳膊都松垮了。

original: Stay alert. Never know when those Stormcloak dogs might charge.
traduit: 保持警惕。不知道风暴斗篷那群狗什么时候会冲过来。

original: The Elder Council...
traduit: 元老院……

original: Oh, now that explains quite a bit. Motierre, you naughty, naughty boy. Hiring the Dark Brotherhood to help you rise beyond your station. Delicious.
traduit: 哦，这样就清楚了。莫提雷这个淘气的孩子，想要雇佣黑暗兄弟会来帮助自己提高地位。好想法。

original: Was Mallory willing to buy the amulet?
traduit: 马洛里愿意收购护符吗？

original: Yes, and specially made for members of the Elder Council.
traduit: 没错，而且是专门为元老院成员预备的。

original: Good, you're back. Well, what did Mallory have to say? Is the amulet authentic?
traduit: 好，你回来了。马洛里怎么说？这个护符靠谱么？

original: Buy it? This? An Elder Council amulet?
traduit: 买下？这个？元老院护符？

original: Oh yes. Oh yes, indeed.
traduit: 哦，没错没错。确实。

original: Wait just one moment...
traduit: 等下……

original: Here. It's a letter of credit. Usable, by Astrid only, for any service or item I can provide. As per our standard arrangement.
traduit: 来，这是信用凭证。只有阿斯垂德能用，可以从我这儿换取物品或服务。按照我们协议的标准来。

original: You bring that back to your lovely mistress. With my regards.
traduit: 把这个给你那可爱的女主人吧。顺便帮我问好。

original: Will you buy it?
traduit: 你愿意买下吗？

original: Let's see...
traduit: 看一下……

original: Where oh where did you get this? Don't answer - I don't want to know.
traduit: 你从哪儿弄来的？别回答，我不想知道。

original: This is an amulet of the Emperor's Elder Council. Specially crafted for each member. Worth a small fortune. Ain't somethin' you'd give up lightly.
traduit: 这是皇帝的元老院成员们佩戴的特制护符。值不少钱。不是轻易能拿出手的。

original: Look, it ain't my business ta tell the Dark Brotherhood its business, but if you killed a member of the Elder Council, you'd better belie-
traduit: 听着，告诉黑暗兄弟会我可不想沾包，要是你杀了元老院成员，最好别……

original: What can you tell me about this? (Give Delvin the amulet)
traduit: 关于这个你能告诉我什么？（把护符交给戴尔文）

original: Oh. Oh I see.
traduit: 哦，我明白。

original: Well, you're makin' friends all over, ain't ya?
traduit: 看来你的交际很广啊？

original: So, uh... how is Astrid doing' these days? Tell her to stop by some time. We can have a drink. Catch up.
traduit: 所以，呃……阿斯垂德最近如何？告诉她可以抽空来一趟。我们可以一起喝一杯。

original: Ah, but business! Of course. What kind of business?
traduit: 哦，还是先说业务吧！当然可以。什么业务？

original: Actually, I'm here on Dark Brotherhood business.
traduit: 其实，我是为黑暗兄弟会跑业务来的。

original: Well now, how is Astrid doin' these days, uh? Tell her to stop by some time. We can have a drink. Catch up.
traduit: 说吧，阿斯垂德最近如何？告诉她可以抽空来一趟。我们可以一起喝一杯。

original: Ah, but we can discuss that later, yeah? What does the Brotherhood need?
traduit: 哦，还是先说业务，对吧？黑暗兄弟会想要些什么？

original: The Dark Brotherhood requires your services.
traduit: 黑暗兄弟会需要你的帮助。

original: Somethin' ya need? Anything for the guild.
traduit: 你需要些什么？为公会什么都行。

original: Ah, now you must be lost. Best ya scurry off while you're able. The Ratway, well, it has a habit of swallowin' up the uninvited.
traduit: 啊，你一定是迷路了。最好还是趁早离开吧。鼠道，嗯，有个习惯，就是把不请自来的人吞下去。

original: Poor Cicero. Dear Cicero. Such a humble servant. But he will never hear my voice. For he is not the Listener.
traduit: 可怜的西塞罗。亲爱的西塞罗。真是个谦卑的好仆人。但他永远听不到我的声音。因为他不是聆听者。

original: Oh, Rexus is no mere servant. He has been with the Motierre family since I was a child. I trust the man with my life.
traduit: 哦，雷萨斯不只是个仆从。我还是个孩子时他就在莫提雷家了。他值得我托付性命。

original: You can trust your servant to keep this secret?
traduit: 你相信你的仆从会保守秘密吗？

original: I have vowed to serve Amaund Motierre until my dying breath. Best remember that.
traduit: 我发誓要效忠于阿蒙德·莫提雷，直到最后一刻。记住了。

original: Here.
traduit: 给。

original: How do I open the door?
traduit: 我怎么把门打开？

original: The whole of Whiterun is ripe with paranoia and tensions. The Jarl's court is right to fear the power I hold behind this door.
traduit: 整个白漫城充满了偏执和紧张。也难怪领主宫廷畏惧我隐藏在门后的力量。

original: The Jarl trusts few, and they will be his undoing. The dark child knows of what I speak.
traduit: 领主信任之人少之又少，但就是他们会把他置于死地。那个阴暗的孩子明白我说的是什么。

original: Let him guide your path.
traduit: 让他给你引路。

original: I was expecting someone... taller.
traduit: 我还以为是什么……高人。

original: Good. The whole point of being in hiding is to appear to be someone you're not.
traduit: 很好。藏起来就是为了让自己看上去和原先不一样。

original: Sorry, I'm supposed to be meeting someone here.
traduit: 对不起，我在这等人。

original: I hope you're just playing dumb. I'm the one who left the note in Ustengrav.
traduit: 真希望你只是在装傻。是我在乌斯滕格拉留的字条。

original: I know many things. I have studied things beyond the reach of most humans, traveled the Oblivion planes, seen things one should not see.
traduit: 我是懂得不少。我研究过大多数人没接触过的东西，也曾在湮灭位面旅行，见过很多不该见的东西。

original: I have met Daedra and Dwemer and everything in between and I know enough to see a vampire where others would see a man.
traduit: 我甚至在其中见过迪德拉和锻莫，而别人看着像人的，我却能认出是吸血鬼。

original: I've heard you're an expert in vampirism.
traduit: 我听说你是研究吸血鬼的专家。

original: Not many come to see me. What do you want?
traduit: 很少有人来拜访我。你有何贵干？

original: Ah the bard-to-be. Did Viarmo send you?
traduit: 啊，是准吟游诗人啊。维阿墨派你来的？

original: So I'm a bard?
traduit: 所以我现在是吟游诗人了？

original: Yes. Congratulations, you are now a full-fledged member of the Bards College.
traduit: 没错。恭喜，你现在是吟游诗人学院的正式成员了。

original: Due to your adventurous nature several of the college professors have some things they wish you to do.
traduit: 鉴于你的冒险精神，有些学院教授希望你帮些忙。

original: What's more, Elisif has declared the Burning of King Olaf should become a weekly event.
traduit: 更重要的是，艾利西弗宣布火烧奥拉夫应该成为每周都举办的活动。

original: And finally, there's the matter of the Patronage that Elisif wanted me to give you.
traduit: 最后，艾利西弗希望我转交你这些赏赐。

original: You'll be all right on your own? Then I'll see you back at the College.
traduit: 你一个人没事吧？那我们学院见吧。

original: Really? J'zargo was having such fun. Ah, well. Back to the College then.
traduit: 真的？杰'扎格玩得很开心。啊，好吧。那我就回学院了。

original: I understand. We must all follow our own paths. If you wish to find me again, I'll be in Nightcaller Temple.
traduit: 我知道了。我们都有各自的路要走。如果你还想找我，就还来唤夜神殿吧。

original: Such a shame. I thought we were getting along so well. I'll head back to Riften if you should have second thoughts.
traduit: 可惜了。我还以为咱们处得不错呢。如果还想找我，就来裂谷城吧。

original: Farewell, then. If you need my services again, just come and look for me in the usual place.
traduit: 那就再见吧。如果你还想叫我服务，到老地方来找我吧。

original: So you think you can make it on your own, then? We'll just see about that.
traduit: 你觉得自己能行吗？那就走着瞧吧。

original: If that's what you want. Watch your back out there, and if you need me again, you know where I'll be.
traduit: 我尊重你的想法。但要小心点，如果还需要我帮忙，你知道我在哪儿。

original: It is a lonely thing, facing all the dangers of Skyrim by yourself. Come and find me if you decide that you miss my companionship.
traduit: 独自面对天际的一切危险是很孤独的。如果想找个伴，还来找我。

original: You're letting me go? What's wrong, is my skill with a blade making you look bad? Hah! I'm kidding, friend. Until we meet again!
traduit: 你要让我走？怎么，我的剑术让你难堪了？哈哈！我开玩笑的，朋友。下次见！

original: Well, it's been fun. I guess I'll head back to Rorikstead.
traduit: 嗯，这次很有趣。那我就回洛利克镇好了。

original: It's time for you to go back home, dog.
traduit: 狗，你该回家了。

original: I'll head back home if you need me.
traduit: 如果你需要我，我就在家里。

original: Then back home is where you'll find me.
traduit: 那我就回家里等你了。

original: I'll be heading home, then, if you need me.
traduit: 我会回家里等着，等你随时需要。

original: You need my strength again, I'll be home.
traduit: 只要你还需要要的力量，我会回来的。

original: I don't think Camilla will be spending any more time with Sven.
traduit: 我看凯米拉不会再和斯万在一起了。

original: I appreciate your help. Please, take this. Some gold I've saved up from working at the mill.
traduit: 感谢你的帮助。拿着吧。这是我在木材厂工作攒的钱。

original: I don't think Camilla will be spending any more time with Faendal.
traduit: 我想凯米拉不会再和法恩达尔来往了。

original: Now that's what I like to hear. Good work. I think you deserve some gold from my tips at the inn.
traduit: 这才是我想听的。干得好。我觉得你应该从我的小费里拿点钱。

original: Sven wanted to trick you into believing this letter was from Faendal.
traduit: 斯万想要骗你相信这封信是法恩达尔写的。

original: What are you talking about? What's in the letter?
traduit: 你说什么？信里写的什么？

original: Oh my. He... he wanted me to think Faendal wrote this?
traduit: 哦天。他……他想让我以为这是法恩达尔写的？

original: Thank you for telling me the truth. Could you talk to Faendal, as well?  I'm sure he'll want to thank you for standing up for him.
traduit: 谢谢你告诉我真相。你能跟法恩达尔谈谈吗？相信他也会感谢你为他挺身而出的。

original: I have a letter from Faendal. (Lie)
traduit: 我有一封来自法恩达尔的信。（撒谎）

original: From Faendal? That's strange. He's never written to me before.
traduit: 法恩达尔？奇怪了。他以前没给我写过信。

original: What, what is this? Is this what he really thinks about me?
traduit: 什么，这是什么？他就是这么看我的？

original: Well, you can tell that... that long-eared ass not to come around the store anymore. He's not welcome.
traduit: 嗯，跟那个……那个长耳朵混蛋说，以后别再来店里了。不欢迎他。

original: Sven wanted me to deliver this letter to Camilla, saying it was from you.
traduit: 斯万让我把这封信交给凯米拉，然后说是你写的。

original: What is that blowhard up to now?
traduit: 那个吹牛大王又在干什么？

original: So, he thinks he can turn Camilla against me? Two can play at this.
traduit: 他觉得能让我和凯米拉反目成仇吗？谁不会这手啊。

original: Here. Give this letter to Camilla and tell her it's from Sven. Let's see what she thinks of him after reading that.
traduit: 给，把这封信给凯米拉，就说是斯万写的。看看她看完有什么想法。

original: Yes. Two people spending time together never blossoms into courtship.
traduit: 没错。耗费时间也不可能擦出爱情的火花。

original: Is that sarcasm? I've heard better wisecracks from Orgnar.
traduit: 这是讽刺吗？我听奥格那说过比这更好的俏皮话。

original: Still, you have a point. Camilla letting Faendal visit her isn't a good thing for me.
traduit: 不过，你说的有道理。让法恩达尔多看凯米拉对我不是好事。

original: Here, let me give you a particularly venomous letter. Say it's from Faendal. That should get Camilla to stop inviting the elf over.
traduit: 给，我给你一封特别恶毒的信，就说是法恩达尔写的。这样凯米拉就不会再邀请那个精灵了。

original: He sounds persistent. Why not do something about it?
traduit: 他听起来挺坚持的。为什么不做点什么呢？

original: You and Faendal both like the same girl?
traduit: 你和法恩达尔都喜欢那个姑娘？

original: Camilla Valerius knows I'm the best man in Riverwood. That elf is kidding himself if he thinks she would choose him over me.
traduit: 凯米拉·瓦勒瑞斯知道我是河木镇最好的男人。如果那个精灵觉得她会选他不是我，那就是自欺欺人了。

original: I've seen him sneaking over to the Riverwood Trader to speak with her when I'm not around. He's wasting his time.
traduit: 我见过他趁我不在偷偷溜进河木镇贸易行跟她聊天。这是浪费时间。

original: You may be right. Camilla may see Faendal as little more than a friend, but why take chances?
traduit: 你可能是对的。凯米拉把法恩达尔看的比朋友亲密点，不能冒这个险。

original: Here. Give Camilla this letter. It's full of venomous nonsense. Tell her it's from Faendal.
traduit: 拿着。把这封信交给凯米拉。里面全是恶毒的胡说八道。告诉她是法恩达尔寄来的。

original: Faendal wanted me to deliver this letter to Camilla, and say it was from you.
traduit: 法恩达尔想要我把这封信送给凯米拉，然后说是你写的。

original: What is this? The elf playing at treachery? Shocking.
traduit: 这是什么？那个精灵在玩背叛游戏吗？令人震惊。

original: As if I would write this dribble. How about we play a bit of turnabout with Faendal?
traduit: 好像我会写这种玩意儿似的。不如我们跟法恩达尔玩个反转吧？

original: Here. I had to use simple words, but this letter should convince Camilla it's from him.
traduit: 拿着。我用了些简单的话，但应该能让凯米拉相信是他写的。

original: Faendal asked me to give you this letter, and say it was from Sven.
traduit: 法恩达尔让我把这封信交给你，然后说是斯万写的。

original: He what? What are you talking about?
traduit: 他怎么？你在说什么？

original: Why that jealous idiot. Thought he could just manipulate me into never seeing Sven again?
traduit: 这个嫉妒的白痴。他以为能操纵我不再去见斯万吗？

original: Thank you for telling me the truth. You should speak to Sven. I'm sure he'll want to thank you, too, for defending his name.
traduit: 谢谢你告诉我真相。你应该和斯万谈谈。相信他也会感谢你为他辩护的。

original: I have a letter for you, from Sven. (Lie)
traduit: 我有一封信给你，是斯万写的。（撒谎）

original: Another poem, I'll bet. He does know how to make a girl blush.
traduit: 又是诗歌吧。他太懂怎么让女孩子害羞了。

original: What's this? If that oaf thinks all I'm going to do is stay in that filthy house of his and clean, I'll....
traduit: 这是什么？如果那笨蛋认为我应该待在他那肮脏的房子里天天打扫，我就……

original: You can tell Sven that he already has a mother. I'm not speaking to him anymore.
traduit: 告诉斯万，他有妈。我不会再和他说话了。

original: Could you... could you give her this letter, and say it's from Sven? I think I've matched that Nord's lack of cleverness perfectly.
traduit: 你能……你能把这封信给她吗，就说是斯万送去的？我已经尽量用诺德那不太聪明的口吻来写了。

original: You're right. When have words ever inspired feelings of love?
traduit: 你说得对。花言巧语岂能激发爱意？

original: I don't need your jokes right now, but maybe you have a point. Maybe Camilla needs some help seeing Sven for what he is.
traduit: 我现在不想听你讲笑话，但你说的有道理。也许凯米拉需要些帮助来看清斯万的真面目。

original: You "hope"? You don't sound very sure...
traduit: 你说“但愿”？你听起来不太确定啊……

original: I've been thinking... maybe Camilla needs a little help seeing Sven for what he is.
traduit: 我一直在想……也许凯米拉需要点帮助才能看清斯万的真面目。

original: What's your problem with Sven?
traduit: 你和斯万有什么矛盾？

original: He's a bard, so he says. Occasionally he finds time to do his job here at the mill.
traduit: 他自称是个吟游诗人，偶尔会抽时间在木材厂干活。

original: Thinks his ballads and sonnets are going to convince Camilla Valerius to marry him. As if she would say "yes."
traduit: 自以为几句民谣、几行情诗就能说服凯米拉·瓦勒瑞斯嫁给他。就跟她已经答应了似的。

original: An intelligent, beautiful woman like her wouldn't fall for that nonsense... I hope.
traduit: 像她这样聪明漂亮的女人是不会上当的……但愿吧。

original: Damn right!
traduit: 说得好！

original: But Housecarl... how can we fight a dragon?
traduit: 不过，侍卫……我们怎么和龙战斗？

original: But we are honorbound to fight it, even if we fail. This dragon is threatening our homes... our families.
traduit: 即使我们会失败，也注定要和它战斗。这条龙在威胁我们家园……还有我们的家人。

original: Now what do you say? Shall we go kill us a dragon?
traduit: 好，现在你们怎么说？要不要和我去杀了这头龙？

original: That's a fair question. None of us have ever seen a dragon before, or expected to face one in battle.
traduit: 问得好。我们谁也没见过龙，也没想过会在战斗中碰上一头。

original: I don't much care where it came from or who sent it. What I do know is that it's made the mistake of attacking Whiterun!
traduit: 我不管它从哪来，被谁派来。我只知道进攻白漫是它最大的错误！

original: You heard right! I said a dragon!
traduit: 你们没听错！我说的就是龙！

original: A dragon is attacking the Western Watchtower.
traduit: 有一头龙在攻击西部哨塔。

original: Here's the situation.
traduit: 情况是这样。

original: They say Falion of Morthal has studied vampires, draugr and all matter of undead.
traduit: 他们说莫萨尔的法利昂研究过吸血鬼、尸鬼还有所有亡灵生物。

original: How do I get a black soul gem?
traduit: 我怎么搞到黑色灵魂石？

original: They are rare things, I have one I picked up during my research of the Oblivion realms but it is a precious item.
traduit: 这东西很稀有，我在研究湮灭领域的时候得到过一个，但它太珍贵了。

original: How can you be so sure I'm a vampire?
traduit: 你怎么确定我是吸血鬼？

original: I met several of your kind during my studies of life-extending magics. I even  considered becoming a vampire myself.
traduit: 我在研究延续寿命的魔法时见过几个像你这样的。我甚至还想过成为吸血鬼。

original: In the end, vampirism would endanger my ward Agni which would defeat the intended purpose.
traduit: 但最后，这样可能会危害到我要保护的阿格尼，这就违背我的初衷了。

original: I'm looking for a cure.
traduit: 我在寻找治愈的方法。

original: It requires a filled black soul gem. You will need to kill someone.
traduit: 得有充满的黑色灵魂石。但这需要你去杀个人。

original: When you have a gem and have filled it return to me and I will perform the ritual. I will bring life to your dead body, vampire.
traduit: 等你找到灵魂石灌满之后交给我，我会为你举行仪式。就能让你死体转生，吸血鬼。

original: You've been suspended from the College for what you did. You'd better talk to Tolfdir if you want to get it sorted out.
traduit: 你因为你的所作所为被学院停学了。如果想解决问题，最好和托夫迪尔谈谈。

original: I'm sorry, but you've been suspended from the College. I can't be seen talking to you right now.
traduit: 抱歉，你已经被学院勒令停学了。我现在不想被别人看到和你说话。

original: The Jarl has been appeased.
traduit: 领主已经被安抚了。

original: Very good. I hope this will allow us to maintain our reputation.
traduit: 很好。希望咱们的声誉不会受损。

original: How much are we talking about?
traduit: 价码多少？

original: I would hate to see our reputation further tarnished.
traduit: 我不愿意看到咱们的名誉进一步受损。

original: I want to purchase your black soul gem. (<BribeCost> gold)
traduit: 我选买你的黑色灵魂石。（<BribeCost>金币）

original: I would not sell it to just anyone but I'll make an exception for you. The cost to replace the gem is quite high.
traduit: 我本来不打算随便出手，但可以为你破例一次。转换这种灵魂石的成本可是相当高。

original: I believe this gem is worth more than you are at the moment.
traduit: 这块灵魂石可比你值钱多了。

original: Ah, you mentioned something that would convince us the festival should take place but I didn't expect King Olaf's lost verse. Please proceed.
traduit: 啊，你提过有东西可以说服我们相信节日有必要继续举办，但没想到居然是遗失的奥拉夫王诗句。请继续吧。

original: I am, Jarl. I wish to present King Olaf's verse from the Poetic Edda. Recovered this very day from the Bards Tomb.
traduit: 是的，领主。我想介绍一下选自《诗歌埃达》的奥拉夫王之诗。这是刚刚从吟游诗人坟墓中发掘到的。

original: Ah, Viarmo.  I assume you are here to petition for the reinstatement of the Burning of King Olaf Festival.
traduit: 啊，维阿墨。你是来请求恢复火烧奥拉夫王节的吧。

original: Take that crown back to Solitude, soldier.
traduit: 士兵，把王冠带回独孤城吧。

original: Get the crown already. We don't need to hang around here any longer than necessary.
traduit: 快把王冠拿上。我们不能在这里待太久了。

original: The crown should be around here somewhere. Spread out, and keep your eyes open.
traduit: 王冠一定就在附近。散开好好找。

original: It's the Legion!
traduit: 是军团！

original: Imperials! Kill them!
traduit: 是帝国兵！杀了他们！

original: The Legion is here! Defend the entrance!
traduit: 军团来了！守住入口！

original: We have it on good authority that Ulfric has raised enough men to attack the city of Whiterun. The Jarl, however, refuses the Legion's support.
traduit: 我们有可靠的证据表明，乌弗瑞克已经集结了足够的兵力进攻白漫城。然而领主回绝了军团的支援。

original: This missive should convince him. Be aware soldier, these documents contain sensitive intelligence for the Jarl's eyes only.
traduit: 这封信应该能说服他。士兵，听好，这里有些敏感情报只能交给领主看。

original: Now let's keep moving.
traduit: 继续走吧。

original: We had the advantage of surprise this time, but don't expect it to last. Let's move out.
traduit: 这次我们占了出其不意的优势，但别指望能一直保持。我们走。

original: Well done. They never knew what hit them.
traduit: 干得好。他们连自己怎么死的都不知道了。

original: We're not kicking you out, just keep the sermons at the temple and let us all sin in peace.
traduit: 我们不是要赶你走，只是布道还是在神殿里吧，我们就在这里安静地犯下罪孽好了。

original: Very well, Talen. I'll remove myself from this den of iniquity.
traduit: 很好，塔伦。我会离开这罪恶的巢穴。

original: Enough, Maramal. We've all heard of the dragons and their return. There's no need to use them as an excuse to harass our customers.
traduit: 够了，玛拉莫。我们都听说龙族回归了。没必要拿它做骚扰我们客人的借口。

original: Keerava, certainly we can come to some sort of an understanding. These people must be made aware of the chaos they've sown.
traduit: 基拉瓦，我们当然可以达成某些共识。人们必须意识到自己造成的混乱。

original: Put down your flagons filled with your vile liquids and embrace the teachings of the handmaiden of Kyne.
traduit: 放下你们那装满污秽液体的酒壶接受凯娜侍女的教诲吧。

original: No, no... Maramal... we talked about this. Talen...
traduit: 不，不……玛拉莫……我们已经说过了。塔伦……

original: This is one of the signs. The signs that Lady Mara is displeased with your constant inebriation.
traduit: 这是征兆之一。玛拉女神对你们纵情酗酒感到不满。

original: People of Riften, heed my words. The return of the dragons is not mere coincidence.
traduit: 裂谷城的民众，听我一言。龙族的回归并非巧合。

original: It's the escaped prisoners!
traduit: 是那些逃犯！

original: Get this gate open.
traduit: 把门打开。

original: It's the Imperials! Take cover!
traduit: 是帝国人！隐蔽！

original: Here are the notes you wanted.
traduit: 这是你要的笔记。

original: Good, good. She didn't see you take them?
traduit: 好，好。她没看见你拿走吧？

original: Al right, this should be enough to figure out what she's up to. Then I can make sure it doesn't work.
traduit: 好，这样就能弄清她在干什么了。我绝不能让她成功。

original: Good work. Here, take this, and keep quiet.
traduit: 干得好。给你，拿着这个，别声张。

original: Nirya wanted me to steal your notes.
traduit: 尼尔雅想让我偷你的笔记。

original: She what?
traduit: 什么？

original: Oh, I should've known she'd try it again!
traduit: 哦，我就知道她会再干！

original: Thanks for warning me. I'll see to it this is taken care of.
traduit: 谢谢你提醒。我会处理好的。

original: I'm still waiting for those notes, if you can get them.
traduit: 我还在等那些笔记，但愿你能拿到。

original: I'll throw some money at you. Good enough?
traduit: 我会给你一些钱。足够了吧？

original: Just get the notes and bring them to me. If you can't do it, I'll find some other way to manage it.
traduit: 只要把笔记拿来给我就行了。如果你办不到，我再找别的办法。

original: Isn't that stealing?
traduit: 这不是偷窃吗？

original: Yes, yes it is.
traduit: 是，没错。

original: You have a problem with that?
traduit: 你有意见吗？

original: Look, either you get the notes or I'll figure out another way to do it. Just come find me if you can get your hands on them.
traduit: 听着，要么去拿笔记，要么我再想辙。如果找到了，拿来给我。

original: You look like you could use some help.
traduit: 你看起来需要帮助。

original: Well, I suppose I could use a hand with something, yes.
traduit: 我想我确实需要你帮个忙。

original: Faralda's working on something, and I want to know what it is.
traduit: 我想知道法劳达正在研究什么。

original: I want her notes. You think you could get them for me, without her knowing?
traduit: 我想要她的笔记。你能在她不知情的情况下给我拿到吗？

original: I'd rather scout ahead.
traduit: 我先去侦查一下。

original: Good enough. We'll meet up near the watchtower. Don't take any chances until we get there.
traduit: 很好。我们在哨塔附近会合。我们到达前不要犯险。

original: I'll come along with you.
traduit: 我和你一起去。

original: Jarl Balgruuf is waiting.
traduit: 巴尔古夫领主在等着呢。

original: You're the one that got out of Helgen, aren't you? I could use anyone who's tangled with a dragon before.
traduit: 你从海尔根逃出来了对吧？我需要任何和龙打过交道的人。

original: Where do you think you'll be the most help - scouting ahead or supporting the rest of my men?
traduit: 你觉得你能帮上什么忙？是先行去侦察一下，还是支援我的人？

original: Well? You going to scout ahead or travel with me?
traduit: 好吗？你想去侦察还是跟我一起走？

original: J'zargo understands. You hesitate because you know J'zargo will be better than you. Very well.
traduit: 杰'扎格很理解。你犹豫是因为你知道杰'扎格比你强。很好。

original: Maybe later. I'm sort of busy now.
traduit: 也许过几天吧。我现在有点忙。

original: J'zargo continues to struggle with wards. You have time to practice?
traduit: 杰'扎格想要练习一下结界术。你有时间吗？

original: Not at all. It means I'm not being hounded about my progress at the College.
traduit: 也不算糟。这也意味着我在学院的进程不会被纠缠。

original: Ah, that's too bad.
traduit: 啊，那太糟了。

original: No, not really. Couriers don't seem to like delivering letters here.
traduit: 不，没有。信差好像不太喜欢往这里送信。

original: Have you heard from your family recently?
traduit: 最近有收到家里的消息吗？

original: Oh. Well, that's... awkward. Sorry to have brought it up.
traduit: 哦。嗯，那是挺……尴尬的。抱歉了。

original: My family didn't really approve of me coming here at all.
traduit: 我家里根本不赞成我来这里。

original: Really? That must be so nice. I came all the way to Skyrim just to get away from my family's expectations.
traduit: 真的？那也挺好。我来天际就是为了摆脱家人的期望。

original: No, and I'm not expecting any.
traduit: 没有，我也不抱希望了。

original: Still no word from your family?
traduit: 还是没有你家人的消息吗？

original: I could help you get the claw back.
traduit: 我可以帮你拿回龙爪。

original: You could? I've got some coin coming in from my last shipment. It's yours if you bring my claw back.
traduit: 你会帮我们？我上一批货赚了点钱。如果你帮我把龙爪拿回来，就归你了。

original: If you're going after those thieves, you should head to Bleak Falls Barrow, northeast of town.
traduit: 如果你要去抓那些小偷，就去镇子东北的荒瀑古坟吧。

original: You could? I've got some coin coming in from my last shipment. It's yours if you bring my claw back.
traduit: 你会帮我？我上一批货赚了点钱。如果你帮我把龙爪拿回来，就归你了。

original: Oh really? Well, I'm not going to hold my breath.
traduit: 哦，真的吗？好，我不会屏息以待的。

original: The thieves are up in Bleak Falls Barrow, northeast of town. I'd take you there, but with Lucan gone, I'm busy with the store.
traduit: 贼跑到镇子东北的荒瀑古坟了。我本想帮你指个路，但卢坎去世了，我得忙着照看店里。

original: Wait, you mean this golden claw?
traduit: 等等，你是说这个黄金龙爪？

original: So, I'm no longer a vampire?
traduit: 所以我不是吸血鬼了？

original: You are human again. Like the rest of us.
traduit: 你又变成人了。和我们一样。

original: The ritual is complete.
traduit: 仪式完成。

original: I call forth that power! Accept the soul that we offer!
traduit: 我召唤那种力量！请接受我们供奉的灵魂！

original: As in death there is new life, in Oblivion there is a beginning for that which has ended.
traduit: 正如死亡中孕育新生，湮灭亦可在终结中蕴藏开始。

original: I call upon Oblivion realms. The home of those who are not our ancestors. Answer my plea!
traduit: 我呼唤湮灭位面。非我等祖先之物居住的家园。回应我等请求！

original: Stand in the center of the circle.
traduit: 站在圆圈的中心。

original: Good, you're here.
traduit: 好，你来了。

original: I have a filled black soul gem.
traduit: 我这里有装满的黑色灵魂石。

original: Very well. Meet me at the summoning circle in the marsh at dawn. We shall banish the creature you have become.
traduit: 非常好。黎明时分到沼泽的召唤圈找我。我们将驱散你现在的状态。

original: Which is utterly useless at the moment. You need to fill it with a soul.
traduit: 现在没用。你得往里面装一个灵魂。

original: I have a black soul gem.
traduit: 我有黑色灵魂石。

original: I killed the dragon. I think I deserve a reward.
traduit: 我杀了龙，所以我该拿到报酬了。

original: There's no question about that. It was a mighty deed. You've earned a place of honor among the heroes of Whiterun.
traduit: 没问题。实在了不起。你如今在白漫的英雄中有一席之地了。

original: But there must be more to it than that. Did something... strange... happen when the dragon died?
traduit: 但肯定不止这些。龙死的时候……发生了……什么怪事吗？

original: Turns out I may be something called "Dragonborn."
traduit: 或许我是某种叫做“龙裔”的东西。

original: Dragonborn? What do you know about the Dragonborn?
traduit: 龙裔？你对“龙裔”了解多少？

original: The watchtower was destroyed, but we killed the dragon.
traduit: 哨塔被毁了，不过我们杀了那个龙。

original: I knew I could count on Irileth. But there must be more to it than that.
traduit: 我就知道伊瑞莱斯靠得住。但是肯定还有别的事。

original: You've done a great service for me and my city, Dragonborn.
traduit: 龙裔，你为我和我的城市做了很大贡献。

original: So what happened at the watchtower? Was the dragon there?
traduit: 哨塔那发生了什么？有龙在那？

original: Help Irileth kill this dragon before it can attack Whiterun. There's no time to lose.
traduit: 帮伊瑞莱斯去杀了这头龙，别让它攻击白漫城。不能浪费时间了。

original: There's no time to stand on ceremony, my friend. I need your help again.
traduit: 没时间客套了，朋友。我需要你再帮我一次。

original: I want you to go with Irileth and help her fight this dragon.
traduit: 我需要你和伊瑞莱斯一起去对付这头龙。

original: You survived Helgen, so you have more experience with dragons than anyone else here.
traduit: 你从海尔根生还出来，在和龙打交道上比在场的所有人都有经验。

original: If you really are Dragonborn, then Skyrim needs you. Go to High Hrothgar and talk to the Greybeards.
traduit: 你如果真是龙裔，那天际肯定需要你。去霍斯加修道院找灰胡子们谈谈吧。

original: What are your orders?
traduit: 你有何吩咐？

original: We'd better go make sure that bastard is really dead. Collect us a trophy or something to bring back to Ulfric.
traduit: 我们最好看看这混蛋是不是真死了。捡点战利品给乌弗瑞克带回去。

original: Scatter and get behind cover! We need to hurt it, somehow! If you've got a bow or spells, now would be a good time to use them!
traduit: 散开，寻找掩体！我们得想办法弄伤他！用弓或者咒语攻击它！

original: That was the hairiest fight I've ever been in, and I've been in more than a few.
traduit: 这是我经历过最激烈的战斗，我参加过好几次这样的战斗了。

original: I don't know about this Dragonborn business, but I'm sure glad you're with us.
traduit: 我不知道龙裔的事，但我很高兴你和我们一起战斗。

original: You better get back to Whiterun right away. Jarl Balgruuf will want to know what happened here.
traduit: 你最好马上回白漫城。巴尔古夫领主肯定想知道这里的情况。

original: I'm taking command here for the moment. You head back to Whiterun and let the Jarl know what happened.
traduit: 这里暂时由我指挥。你回白漫城向领主报告情况吧。

original: Be careful. We need to find out what happened here.
traduit: 小心点。我们得弄清楚这里发生什么了。

original: The dragon is dead.
traduit: 那头龙已经死了。

original: That may be true, but I ordered Irileth to bring back proof. You'd best report back to her at once.
traduit: 那可能是真的，但是我已经命令伊瑞莱斯把证据带回来。你最好立刻去向她汇报。

original: I'm proud to be your battle-brother, Dragonborn. Whiterun doesn't need to fear with you on our side.
traduit: 我很自豪能和你成为战友，龙裔。有你在我们这边，白漫就不需要怕了。

original: You sure took care of that dragon. Dragonborn or not, that's good enough for me.
traduit: 你确实干掉了那头龙。不管你是不是龙裔，我觉得都足够优秀了。

original: I can't believe we actually killed a dragon!
traduit: 真不敢相信我们居然杀了一头龙！

original: Dragonborn... it's an honor.
traduit: 龙裔……真光荣啊。

original: You saved Whiterun today. We won't forget.
traduit: 你今天救了白漫。我们不会忘记的。

original: Is it really dead?
traduit: 它真死了？

original: Come on, I want a better look at that thing.
traduit: 来吧，我想好好看看这东西。

original: We taught that dragon not to mess with Whiterun, didn't we?
traduit: 我们教训了那头龙别惹白漫不是吗？

original: I'm glad you're on our side.
traduit: 很高兴你站在我们这边。

original: Get under cover! The dragon - it's still around somewhere!
traduit: 快躲起来！那头龙还在附近！

original: I'm glad you're coming with us. They say Talos favors you.
traduit: 很高兴你和我们一起来了。他们都说塔洛斯眷顾着你。

original: That dragon should've stuck with killing Imperials. Now he's going to learn how real Nords fight.
traduit: 那头龙杀惯了帝国人。现在他得领教领教真正的诺德人是怎么战斗的。

original: My cousin's stationed out at the watchtower. I hope he's all right.
traduit: 我表弟驻扎在哨塔那边。希望他没事。

original: I doubt any of us are coming back from this mission.
traduit: 真不知道我们能不能从这次任务活着回来。

original: With Irileth, you either come back covered with glory or not at all.
traduit: 跟着伊瑞莱斯，不是满载荣誉就是一事无成。

original: You really think we can kill a dragon?
traduit: 你真认为我们杀的了龙么？

original: I'm looking forward to testing myself against this dragon.
traduit: 我有点期待挑战这头龙了。

original: I hear you faced a dragon at Helgen and lived to tell about it. That ain't nothing.
traduit: 我听说你在海尔根遇上过龙还活下来了是吗？

original: We'd better keep moving. Who knows what that dragon is doing.
traduit: 我们最好快点。谁知道这头龙要做什么。

original: I hope the tower holds out until we get there.
traduit: 希望哨塔那边坚持到咱们到达。

original: Shor's bones, did it kill them all...?
traduit: 舒尔的骨头啊，他们全被杀了……？

original: We'd better find out what's happened.
traduit: 我们得弄清发生了什么。

original: Good luck. I hope you get there in time.
traduit: 保重。希望你能及时赶到。

original: Hold on. I want to hear what Irileth's saying.
traduit: 等等。我想听听伊瑞莱斯说什么。

original: You've found the vessels. I worried that I had sent you to your death.
traduit: 你找到容器了。我还担心会把你害死呢。

original: Then I will help you. What must be done?
traduit: 那我来帮你。该怎么做？

original: You would do this? Three vessels in the tomb below hold the power to vanquish Hevnoraak. Before anything else, we need those.
traduit: 你愿意来帮我？坟墓里有三个容器，装着克制赫诺拉克的力量。首要就是找到它们。

original: Bring them to me - but be careful, mortal. They are guarded by Hevnoraak's minions. They will stop at nothing to see their master return.
traduit: 把它们带来给我，但要小心，凡人。它们由赫诺拉克的随从护卫着。他们会不惜一切让他们的主人回归。

original: There must be a way to stop this.
traduit: 一定有办法阻止这一切。

original: I have been holding him here. While he regains strength, however, I am fading.
traduit: 我一直把他关在这里。当他的力量开始恢复时，我却在逐渐衰弱。

original: By now I can barely contain his power, much less defeat him if he awakens. But with the help of a living champion I may be able to succeed.
traduit: 现在我几乎无法控制他的力量，更不用说在他苏醒之后击败他了。但如果有活着的勇士帮助，我可能会成功。

original: What evil do you mean?
traduit: 你说的是什么邪恶？

original: We stand at the tomb of Hevnoraak, who has been dead for many generations. I fear, however, that his return may be at hand.
traduit: 我们现在站在赫诺拉克的墓前，他已经死了很久了。不过，恐怕他马上就要归来了。

original: Leave, stranger. Evil stirs in this place. I fear for the security of the very land if it should break free.
traduit: 离开吧，陌生人。邪恶在此滋生。我担心这片土地的安全被它冲破。

original: If you see Karliah, don't hesitate. Kill her.
traduit: 如果看到卡莱亚，别犹豫。杀了她。

original: That's enough of this unnecessary chatting, we need to keep going.
traduit: 没必要的闲聊到此为止吧，我们得继续走了。

original: Let's get going. I want her head on my mantle.
traduit: 走吧，我要把她的脑袋放在披风上。

original: Have your weapon at the ready. I'm certain Karliah knows we're here.
traduit: 准备好武器。我敢肯定，卡莱亚知道我们在这。

original: Keep your eyes open and your mouth shut.
traduit: 睁大眼，闭紧嘴。

original: When you're ready, meet me at Snow Veil Sanctum.
traduit: 等你准备好，到雪幔圣所找我。

original: Some days I marvel that you haven't managed to blow yourself up.
traduit: 有时候我很惊讶你没能把自己炸飞。

original: What? Err, nothing!
traduit: 什么？哦，没有！

original: What are you up to, Gane? Hmm?
traduit: 甘，你在干什么呢？嗯？

original: Well, then. Fine. Have a nice day.
traduit: 嗯，好吧好吧。祝你愉快。

original: I'm busy right now, Colette.
traduit: 我现在很忙，柯莱特。

original: Why should I want anything? Why can't I simply be sociable with my colleagues?
traduit: 我为什么一定是要干什么？我就不能简单地和同事交流一下吗？

original: Ugh. What do you want?
traduit: 啊。你想干什么吗？

original: How are you, Drevis?
traduit: 你好么，德莱维斯？

original: Well then "observe" from a greater distance. You're making people uncomfortable.
traduit: 那就从更远的距离“观察”吧。不要让别人感到不适。

original: My dear, I am merely observing the proceedings.
traduit: 亲爱的，我只是在观察实验过程而已。

original: I've had yet another complaint. Please stop barging in on experiments in progress.
traduit: 我又接到新投诉了。请不要干涉正在进行的实验。

original: Ah, err, yes. Sorry.
traduit: 啊，呃，好吧。对不起。

original: Don't even talk to me, Gane.
traduit: 别跟我说话，甘。

original: Hello, Nirya.
traduit: 你好，尼尔雅。

original: Well, err, yes. Sorry to have troubled you.
traduit: 好吧，呃，也对。抱歉打扰你了。

original: Why, because I'm a Dunmer? We didn't all grow up in dwarven ruins, you know.
traduit: 为啥，就因为我是丹莫？我们又不是在矮人遗迹里长大的。

original: Yes, I just thought perhaps you'd have, err, come across something like this before.
traduit: 是，我只是在想也许你以前，呃，遇到过类似的。

original: If this is another dwarven trinket, I keep telling you I'm not familiar with them.
traduit: 如果又是什么矮人饰品的话就算了，我早就说过我不熟悉。

original: Do you think you might, err, have a moment to look at something for me?
traduit: 你能不能，呃，抽空帮我看样东西？

original: Perhaps, but it just means more work for me.
traduit: 也许吧，但是对我来说就意味着加班加点了。

original: At least it's more money for the College.
traduit: 至少能给学院创收了。

original: As always. The Nords don't ever stop wanting things enchanted.
traduit: 一如既往。诺德人总是想要附魔的东西。

original: Keeping busy, Sergius?
traduit: 最近很忙吧，瑟吉尔斯？

original: Good. Don't fail me.
traduit: 好。别让我失望。

original: One last thing, Irileth. This isn't a death or glory mission. I need to know what we're dealing with.
traduit: 还有，伊瑞莱斯。这不是什么赴死或者光荣的任务。我想知道咱们要去处理什么。

original: I've already ordered my men to muster near the main gate.
traduit: 我已经命令我的人到大门口集合了。

original: Irileth, you'd better gather some guardsmen and get down there.
traduit: 伊瑞莱斯，你最好召集些卫兵一起去。

original: Good work, son. We'll take it from here. Head down to the barracks for some food and rest. You've earned it.
traduit: 做得好，小子。我们就此接手了。回营房吃点东西休息休息。这是你应得的。

original: No, my lord. It was just circling overhead when I left. I never ran so fast in my life... I thought it would come after me for sure.
traduit: 不，大人。我离开时它就在我头顶盘旋。我这辈子从没跑得这么快……我以为它肯定会追我。

original: Everyone else, with me.
traduit: 其他人，跟我来。

original: You two, stay and guard the entrance. We don't want any Stormcloak reinforcements taking us by surprise.
traduit: 你们两个，留下了守住门口。我们可不能被赶过来的风暴斗篷给突袭了。

original: Vilkas said you can still be cured.
traduit: 威尔卡斯说你还是能被治愈的。

original: Did he now? I can only hope.
traduit: 是吗？我也希望如此。

original: You still have the witches' heads? Excellent. Throw one of them into the fire. It will release their magic, for me at least.
traduit: 你还留着女巫的头吗？太好了。扔一个进火里。至少对我而言，这样就能解除她们的魔咒了。

original: Don't worry, I'll treat those shipments as if I owned them myself.
traduit: 别担心，我会把这些货当成自己的一样。

original: Shor's Beard! You're right! I'll do it... provided you supervise the shipments personally.
traduit: 舒尔的胡子！你说得对！我来办……你保证能亲自监督装运就好。

original: Exactly. What better way to help the cause than to put weapons into the hands of young Nord warriors dying for their homeland?
traduit: 没错。还有什么比把武器交给保家卫国的年轻诺德人手上更好的办法呢？

original: So I pay for the weapon shipments and you oversee their distribution to the Stormcloaks?
traduit: 所以，我付钱来运输武器，而你负责监督武器分发给风暴斗篷？

original: I'm telling you, Vulwulf, it's the investment you've been waiting for.
traduit: 我跟你说，乌尔武夫，这是你一直在等待的投资。

original: If you want to go out to Whiterun and burn that meadery down, go right ahead.
traduit: 如果你想去烧白漫的酒庄就去吧。

original: And when the guard traces it back here, and Maven is implicated, I'll be sure to tell her it was your idea.
traduit: 等卫兵追踪到这儿，发现玛雯有嫌疑的时候，我一定告诉她这是你的主意。

original: Come on, think about it. She'd reward us!
traduit: 得了吧，想想看。她会赏我们的！

original: If you think I'd would make a move like that without asking Maven, you're out of your mind. Doing that would be a fatal mistake.
traduit: 如果你觉得我会不向玛雯请示就这么干，那你就是疯了。这可是要命的错误。

original: The rest of you lot are with me.
traduit: 其余人跟我走。

original: So, what do you think of my plan. You in or out?
traduit: 你觉得我的计划怎么样。到底要不要来？

original: Gretta, Engar, stay and guard the entrance. We don't want any Imperial reinforcements taking us by surprise.
traduit: 格雷塔、恩加尔，守住入口。我们可不能毫无防备地被帝国援军偷袭了。

original: It's only because I've had an excellent teacher.
traduit: 那是因为我有一个好老师。

original: Aerin, you never cease to amaze me. You always see the good in everything.
traduit: 艾灵，你总是能给我惊喜。你经常能看到事物好的方面。

original: I think some of them do, Lady Mjoll. They're just too frightened to step up and do something about it like you are.
traduit: 我想会有的，穆月尔女士。他们只是太害怕了，不敢像你一样站出来做点什么。

original: Sometimes I'm not certain that the people of Riften want to be helped.
traduit: 有时候我不确定裂谷城的人是不是想要得到帮助。

original: I... I'm sorry Haelga, I can't. Not yet.
traduit: 我……抱歉，哈尔嘉，我不能。还不是时候。

original: That old place? I could care less about it. Its you I want, Bolli.
traduit: 那个破地方？我一点也不在乎。我要的是你，波利。

original: I told you, I can't just pick up and leave. I have my wife, my business... not to mention you have the Bunkhouse.
traduit: 我跟你说过，我不能一走了之。我有妻子，有生意……更别说你还有工棚。

original: When are you going to take me away from here Bolli?
traduit: 你什么时候带我离开这里，波利？

original: Is it really me, or is it your wife? You need to make a choice Bolli. The honey or her.
traduit: 真是因为我，还是因为你老婆？波利，你得做选择，是要甜心还是要她。

original: Haelga! That's just it. I can't keep up with you. Your Dibellan techniques... they're exhausting.
traduit: 哈尔嘉！就是因为这个。我跟不上你了。你的迪贝拉技术太……我快累坏了。

original: Oh, Bolli you silly man. You weren't saying that when you were licking that honey off my...
traduit: 哦，波利你这个蠢男人。你舔我那儿的蜜的时候可没这么说……

original: Haelga, we need to stop seeing each other.
traduit: 哈尔嘉，我们不能再见面了。

original: It's not about the coin, it's about honoring your legacy by picking up arms and keeping this land free.
traduit: 这跟钱没关系，是尊重你的传统遗产，拿起武器，解放这片土地。

original: The sooner you remember that, the better.
traduit: 你应该早点记住这一点。

original: I'll pay you back, if it means that much.
traduit: 如果这真那么重要，那我会还你的。

original: The only reason you have the gold for your "business" is because I gave it to you.
traduit: 你的“生意”能有钱的唯一原因就是我给了你。

original: I'm sorry you disapprove, father. But I've made up my mind. I'm not a warrior, I'm a businessman.
traduit: 你不同意我很抱歉，父亲。但我有自己的想法。我不是战士，是商人。

original: We take our leave.
traduit: 我们向您告别。

original: And for ourselves...
traduit: 为我们自己……

original: We shout.
traduit: 我们怒号。

original: The Imperials were there ahead of us.
traduit: 帝国军赶在我们前面了。

original: Damn it. What were they doing there? Imperial spies are everywhere. Never forget that...  I trust you gave them a thrashing? Now then...
traduit: 该死的。他们在那里做什么？帝国间谍真是无处不在。千万别忘了……你肯定揍了他们一顿吧？现在……

original: The blood of our fallen heroes will make Skyrim free, never doubt it. Also, never doubt me or Galmar. Now then...
traduit: 毋庸置疑的是，我们牺牲英雄的血会让天际重获自由。还有，不要质疑我和加尔玛。现在……

original: That's the spirit. I'll get all the details from Galmar when he gets back. Now then...
traduit: 很有精神。加尔玛回来我再听细节吧。现在……

original: Didn't you hear the thundering sound as you returned to Whiterun?
traduit: 你回白漫城的时候没听到轰鸣吗？

original: That was the voice of the Greybeards, summoning you to High Hrothgar!
traduit: 那是灰胡子的吼声，召唤你去霍斯加修道院！

original: This hasn't happened in ... centuries, at least. Not since Tiber Septim himself was summoned when he was still Talos of Atmora!
traduit: 得有几百年……没发生过了。上次召唤是泰伯·塞普汀还叫做阿特莫拉的塔洛斯的时候。

original: What do these Greybeards want with me?
traduit: 灰胡子找我做什么？

original: The Dragonborn is said to be uniquely gifted in the Voice - the ability to focus your vital essence into a Thu'um, or Shout.
traduit: 传说龙裔在吼声方面天赋异禀，能够将你的本质存在汇聚到吐'目，也叫龙吼中去。

original: The Greybeards are masters of the Way of the Voice. If you really are Dragonborn, they can teach you how to use your gift.
traduit: 灰胡子是吼声之道的大师。如果你真是龙裔，他们会教你如何使用自己的天赋。

original: The Greybeards?
traduit: 灰胡子？

original: Masters of the Way of the Voice. They live in seclusion high on the slopes of the Throat of the World.
traduit: 吼声之道的大师。他们隐居在世界之喉的高坡上。

original: That's just what the men called me.
traduit: 他们是这么叫我的。

original: Not just the men. The Greybeards seem to think the same thing.
traduit: 不只是他们。看来灰胡子也是这么看。

original: When the dragon died, I absorbed some kind of power from it.
traduit: 那头龙死的时候，我从它身上汲取了某种能量。

original: So it's true. The Greybeards really were summoning you.
traduit: 那就对了。灰胡子真的在召唤你。

original: The Greybeards...
traduit: 灰胡子……

original: You heard the summons. What else could it mean?
traduit: 你听到了召唤。这又意味着什么？

original: We were just talking about you. My brother needs a word with you.
traduit: 我们正谈到你。我哥有话对你说。

original: Let's go. We need to get to the Western Watchtower before it's too late.
traduit: 走吧，我们得尽快赶到西部哨塔。

original: I'll see you at the watchtower as soon as the rest of the men have gathered.
traduit: 等人手集合完毕，我会去哨塔等你。

original: Follow me. We're assembling near the main gate.
traduit: 跟我来。我们去大门集合。

original: Talos save us! It's a dragon!
traduit: 塔洛斯救救我们！是龙！

original: But remember, you're still oathbound to our cause. Skyrim still waits to be free.
traduit: 但记住，你曾经向我们的事业立誓。天际还等着我们去解放。

original: Krif krin. Pruzah!
traduit: 克瑞夫 克因。如扎！

original: Thurri du hin sille ko Sovngarde!
traduit: 图瑞 都 辛 西尔 寇 松加德！

original: Brit grah. I had forgotten what fine sport you mortals can provide!
traduit: 布瑞特 格拉哈。我都忘了你们凡人可以提供多有趣的消遣了！

original: You are brave. Balaan hokoron. Your defeat brings me honor.
traduit: 你很勇敢。巴兰 霍克荣。你之失败即我之荣耀。

original: Zok morokei! More souls to feed my master's hunger.
traduit: 佐克 摩洛克伊！我主需要更多灵魂来填饱肚子。

original: Dovahkiin! No!!
traduit: 都瓦克因！不！

original: I can't believe it! You're... Dragonborn...
traduit: 难以置信！你……你是龙裔……

original: There's no refusing a summons from the Greybeards. If you really are Dragonborn, they can teach you how to use your power.
traduit: 没人能拒绝灰胡子的召唤。如果你真是龙裔，他们会教你使用自己的力量。

original: We weep.
traduit: 我们哭泣。

original: At this loss...
traduit: 为如此损失……

original: I'm watching you, Maven Black-Briar. One day, you'll slip up and your Imperial friends won't be there to catch your fall.
traduit: 我会盯着你的，玛雯·黑棘。总有一天，你会摔得很惨，你的帝国朋友也不会接住你。

original: My dear, you have no idea who you're trifling with. Now I suggest you turn around and rattle someone else's cage before you get hurt.
traduit: 亲爱的，你根本不知道你在愚弄谁。我现在建议你，在受伤之前转身走开，惹别人去吧。

original: You're a cold, unfeeling bitch.
traduit: 你可真是个冷酷无情的臭婊子。

original: You may have everyone else impressed around here, but you don't impress me. You couldn't touch me if you wanted to.
traduit: 你可能让这里每个人都对你刮目相看，但我没有。你想碰我都碰不到。

original: Maven. How's the criminal underworld treating you this fine day?
traduit: 玛雯。今天是个好日子啊，黑社会们有对你怎么样吗？

original: Interesting. Keep your ears open for me and tell me if you hear anything more. I'll make it worth your while.
traduit: 有意思。继续帮我听着点，如果有什么消息就告诉我。我不会亏了你的。

original: I heard a traveler say that Helgen was destroyed by one of those creatures. Didn't leave a soul alive they said.
traduit: 我听一个旅行者说海尔根被其中一头毁灭了。没有一个活口。

original: You watch the market, you hear the rumors around Riften. What have you heard about these dragons?
traduit: 你天天盯着市场，应该听过不少裂谷城里的传言。又听说过关于龙的吗？

original: Relax, Marise... I have no quarrel with you. I just wish to speak a moment.
traduit: 放松点，马利瑟……我没打算和你吵。我只是想说几句话。

original: Oh! Miss Maven. What can I do for you?
traduit: 哦，玛雯小姐。我能为您做些什么？

original: Well, if the shoe fits...
traduit: 嘛，有则改之，无则加勉呗……

original: You know very well what I'm talking about. You're saying that I only married Bolli for his gold and that I don't really love him.
traduit: 你很清楚我说的是什么。你说我嫁给波利就是为了钱，不是真心爱他。

original: What rumors?
traduit: 什么谣言？

original: Hey. What's the matter with you? You have no right to spread rumors around town about me.
traduit: 嘿。你怎么回事？你有什么权利在镇上散播关于我的谣言。

original: In a manner of speaking.
traduit: 不好说不好说。

original: May I ask what all the honey's for? I mean, you used to buy almost a jar a week. Are you cooking or something?
traduit: 我能问问这些蜂蜜是做什么用的吗？我是说，你以前差不多一周就买一罐。用来做饭吗？

original: I thought it was strange that Aringoth stopped coming into town. I suppose he's having some difficulties out there.
traduit: 我觉得很奇怪，阿林格斯不进城了。他在外面时遇到麻烦了吧。

original: I'm afraid it's going to be a while before I can get any more Goldenglow Honey.
traduit: 恐怕得过一段时间才能拿到更多金色光辉蜂蜜了。

original: Well, whatever you're doing, keep doing it and you'll have me as a customer for life.
traduit: 好吧，不管你是怎么做到的，继续加油吧，我会当你一辈子客人的。

original: Can't tell you. It's a bit of a trade secret I picked up when I was living in High Rock.
traduit: 不能告诉你。这是我在高岩学到的商业秘密。

original: Thanks for that bushel of apples, Marise. They're wonderful. How did you keep them so fresh?
traduit: 谢谢你的苹果，马利瑟。很好吃。你是怎么保鲜的？

original: Um... okay. Well, the boots aren't here yet. Hopefully on the next Khajiit caravan.
traduit: 嗯……好吧。靴子还没到。希望下一个卡吉特商队能送到。

original: Always be prepared. You never know if you might get a split in one, or lose one, then where would you be? No sir, that's not happening to me.
traduit: 总是得做好准备啊。你永远不知道其中一只会不会开裂或者丢了，那该怎么办？不行，先生，我不能让这种情况发生。

original: What's with all the boots and shoes you keep buying? You must have bought twenty pairs in the last two years.
traduit: 你怎么买了那么多靴子鞋子？过去两年你买了得有二十双了。

original: Brand-Shei... have you managed to find those boots for me?
traduit: 布兰德-谢……你帮我找到那双靴子了吗？

original: Good. Maybe that will teach them to leave honest citizens alone.
traduit: 好。也许这能让他们离好公民们远点。

original: It's true. Wasn't much of a thief though. Made enough noise to wake the Red Mountain.
traduit: 是真的。不过也不是什么好手。吵得红山都快爆了。

original: Is it true you chased a thief from your home? I overheard Aerin mentioning it.
traduit: 你真在家里抓了个小偷吗？我听艾灵提起来过。

original: Well met, Brand-Shei. I've come by to browse your wares today.
traduit: 你好啊，布兰德-谢。我今天来看看你的商品。

original: Perhaps they moved on to greener pastures. Whatever the reason, lets be glad they're scarce.
traduit: 也许他们搬去了更青翠的牧场。不管怎样，他们不来就该庆幸了。

original: No. I'm surprised actually. I thought they had a stranglehold on the city, but in the last few years, it hasn't been that bad.
traduit: 没有。挺惊讶的。我以为他们控制了整个城市，但最近几年情况也没那么糟。

original: They haven't been by the Bunkhouse, but I'm certain they will. How about you?
traduit: 他们没来工棚，但我肯定他们会来的。你那儿呢？

original: Has the Thieves Guild visited you yet, Haelga?
traduit: 盗贼公会有找上你吗，哈尔嘉？

original: Chin up, Brand-Shei. Lady Mara will provide us strength and guidance through these difficult times.
traduit: 振作点，布兰德-谢。玛拉女神会为我们提供力量和指引，帮我们渡过难关。

original: There's the stories about Helgen, bandits, skirmishes between the Stormcloaks and the Imperials... it almost seems endless.
traduit: 是海尔根的事，还有强盗、帝国和风暴斗篷之间的小冲突……无穷无尽。

original: That's a shame. What's causing them all the trouble?
traduit: 真可惜。他们怎么会遇到这么多麻烦？

original: Dinya, about that incense you requested? Its not arriving anytime soon. The Khajiit caravans are having tough times getting through.
traduit: 丁雅，有个关于你熏香的事。短时期到不了了。卡吉特商队现在行进很艰难。

original: I'd still keep an eye on my purse if I was you.
traduit: 如果我是你，我还是得盯紧自己的包。

original: If that's true, then we have much more to fear than the Thieves Guild.
traduit: 如果是真的，那我们要害怕的就不只是盗贼公会了。

original: You've heard too? They say the town was completely destroyed by a dragon.
traduit: 你也听说了？他们说镇子被一头龙完全摧毁了。

original: So while I was in Ivarstead, I heard news that something terrible happened at Helgen.
traduit: 当我在伊瓦尔镇的时候，听说海尔根发生了可怕的事。

original: Thanks, Grelka!
traduit: 谢谢，格瑞卡！

original: Right. You were at Dragonsreach when I gave it to him.
traduit: 对。当我把它给法仁加的时候，你就在龙临宫。

original: How do you know where the dragon will come back?
traduit: 你是怎么知道下次龙会从哪来？

original: So why are they hunting you?
traduit: 那他们为什么追捕你？

original: When I was young, our leaders became obsessed with the Thalmor threat.
traduit: 我年轻时，我们的领袖开始注意到梭默的威胁。

original: They believed that if and when we found a Dragonborn, we would need to protect her against the Thalmor.
traduit: 他们相信如果我们能够找到一位龙裔，就必须保护她不受梭默的伤害。

original: They believed that if and when we found a Dragonborn, we would need to protect him against the Thalmor.
traduit: 他们相信如果我们能够找到一位龙裔，就必须保护他不受梭默的伤害。

original: We hurt them in the past, and they have long memories.
traduit: 我们过去伤过他们，而他们显然记性不错。

original: Who are the Thalmor?
traduit: 梭默是什么人？

original: Hmm. There's no simple answer to that. You want the long version or the short version?
traduit: 嗯。一句两句说不清。你想听个详细版本还是简略版本？

original: Hey, I told you not to ask any questions. Now, here. For your trouble.
traduit: 嘿，我告诉过你什么也别问。给。麻烦你了。

original: Yes. The man came by at noon just like you said. I gave him the package and he gave me this pouch for you.
traduit: 是的。照你说的，那个人中午来过。我把包裹给了他，他给了我这个袋子。

original: The package was heavy... I needed his help getting it on his horse. What was inside?
traduit: 包裹很重……我们俩人才能弄上马背。里面装的什么？

original: Did you do everything I said, Shadr?
traduit: 你照我说的做了吗，沙德？

original: Whatever you say.
traduit: 随你怎么说。

original: I'm watching you, Grelka. One slip up and I report you to the guards. You got that?
traduit: 我会盯着你，格瑞卡。一出问题，我就会向卫兵告发你。明白了？

original: I don't know what he's talking about. He must be seeing things.
traduit: 我不知道他在说什么。他肯定看错了。

original: Aerin tells me you might be dealing arms to the Thieves Guild. Is this true?
traduit: 艾灵跟我说你可能在卖武器给盗贼公会，是真的吗？

original: I'll contact my man tonight and let you know what he says.
traduit: 我今晚就去联系，回头给你信儿。

original: I don't care what it costs. I need four longbows and four score of arrows. Just make it happen.
traduit: 我不在乎钱。我需要四把长弓、四十支箭。你去办吧。

original: I don't usually deal in weapons, but I know someone who can get them for me. You mind paying a little extra to get them fast?
traduit: 我一般不卖武器，但我认识人能给我搞到。你介意多花点钱快点搞到手吗？

original: Grelka, how fast can you get your hands on some longbows?
traduit: 格瑞卡，你多久才能弄到些长弓？

original: All right, all right. Just bring it to me tomorrow and I'll fix it for you.
traduit: 好吧，好吧。明天带来给我就行，我给你修好。

original: Why should I pay for a repair on something I just bought?
traduit: 我刚买的东西为什么要付修理费？

original: Fine. It'll be five septims to repair it.
traduit: 好吧，给五个塞普汀我就能修好。

original: Grelka, I wanted to talk about that suit of leather armor you sold me. The fasteners are already coming loose.
traduit: 格瑞卡，我想跟你说说你卖我那套皮质护甲。紧固件已经松了。

original: Oh, well... I suppose that's a noble cause. I'll settle this bill at the end of the day. Thank you.
traduit: 哦，好吧……我想这也是个好想法。今天结束的时候我会来结账。谢谢。

original: I believe she's trying to look as ravishing as possible for you, milord.
traduit: 我相信她是想让您看起来更迷人些，老爷。

original: Right. Happy trails.
traduit: 好。旅途愉快。

original: Orgnar. I'm travelling. You've got the inn 'til I get back.
traduit: 奥格那。我要去旅行了。我回来前就由你打理旅馆了。

original: So what's your plan? How do I infiltrate the Thalmor Embassy?
traduit: 你的计划是什么？我怎么才能进入梭默大使馆？

original: The Thalmor ambassador, Elenwen, regularly throws parties where the rich and connected cozy up to the Thalmor.
traduit: 梭默大使爱琳温经常会请一些豪富和关系户参加宴会。

original: I can get you into one of those parties. Once you're inside the Embassy, you get away and find Elenwen's secret files.
traduit: 我会让你去参加宴会。一旦你混进大使馆，就离开宴会并寻找爱琳温的机密文件。

original: I have a contact inside the Embassy. He's not up for this kind of high-risk mission, but he can help you.
traduit: 我在大使馆有个线人。虽然他不会冒险，但可以协助你。

original: His name's Malborn. Wood elf, plenty of reason to hate the Thalmor. You can trust him.
traduit: 他叫马伯恩。是个木精灵，有充足的理由恨梭默。你可以信任他。

original: I'll get word for him to meet you in Solitude, at the Winking Skeever -- you know it?
traduit: 我会传话给他。你们俩可以在独孤城的眨眼恶鼠碰头。你认识吗？

original: While you're doing that, I'll work on getting you an invitation to Elenwen's little party.
traduit: 你去碰头的时候，我会给你弄一张爱琳温宴会的请柬。

original: Meet me at the Solitude stables after you've arranged things with Malborn. Any questions?
traduit: 等你跟马伯恩把事安排好以后，到独孤城外的马厩找我。没问题吧？

original: Good to see you.
traduit: 很高兴见到你。

original: What? Something you're still confused about?
traduit: 怎么了？你还在困惑些什么？

original: Not here. Downstairs.
traduit: 不在这。去楼下说。

original: So, we need to find out what the Thalmor know about the dragons. Any ideas?
traduit: 所以，我们需要知道梭默对龙的情报。有什么好主意吗？

original: If we could get into the Thalmor Embassy... it's the center of their operations in Skyrim...
traduit: 如果我们能混进梭默大使馆……那里可是他们在天际运作的中心。

original: Problem is, that place is locked up tighter than a miser's purse. They could teach me a few things about paranoia...
traduit: 问题是，那里锁得比守财奴的钱包还紧。他们可是比我还偏激……

original: Well, well. You've slain my followers. I should destroy you for your impudence!
traduit: 很好，很好。你杀了我的追随者。真该毁了你这厚颜无耻之人。

original: On the other hand, you've weeded out the weak from among those who would deign worship me.
traduit: 话说回来。你把这群弱者从我的信徒中剔除出去。

original: You could be the one I seek... if your will is strong, lure a thrall to my shrine. Convince him to embrace the Pillar of Sacrifice. Then slay him.
traduit: 你就是我在找的那个人……如果你意志坚定，引诱一个奴隶到我的祭坛上，说服他触摸献祭之柱。然后杀了他。

original: Do this, and I shall favor you.
traduit: 如此，我会眷顾于你。

original: Well, he's quite obviously mad. Whether or not that makes him dangerous is another question entirely.
traduit: 嗯，他显然是疯了。而这是否会让他变得危险，是另一回事。

original: Do I trust him? Not in the slightest.
traduit: 我信任他吗？一点也不。

original: Is Cicero dangerous?
traduit: 西塞罗很危险？

original: I abide only those whose will is aligned to my own. Those who oppose my desires perish in the most dreadful of ways.
traduit: 我只会与意志和我一致者同在。那些忤逆我愿者死相凄惨。

original: I have a purpose for which you might prove useful. But first I must test the deftness of your guile, and the strength of your purpose.
traduit: 我有一个目标，或许你能帮上忙。但我必须先测试一下你的狡诈和决心。

original: Make a thrall. Lure him to my shrine. Prove your will is stronger. Convince him to embrace the Pillar of Sacrifice, and then slay him without mercy.
traduit: 找一个奴隶，把他引到我的祭坛来。说服他拥抱献祭之柱，然后无情地杀了他，这样，就证明你意志坚强。

original: Do this and I shall remember you and bestow an important task upon you. Do this not, and I shall forget you, and your soul will waste in obscurity.
traduit: 照做，我就会记住你，并把一项重要任务交给你。做不到，我会忘记你，你的灵魂会默默无闻地消散。

original: Finally. Now get lost.
traduit: 总算给了。现在躲开吧。

original: Oh, thank you! Divines bless your kind heart.
traduit: 哦，谢谢！愿圣灵保佑你那颗仁慈的心。

original: I'm a mage, not a pawnbroker, you know.
traduit: 别忘了我是个法师，不是当铺老板。

original: If it will help you, then certainly.
traduit: 如果对你有帮助，那当然可以。

original: J'zargo only has so much room to carry things.
traduit: 杰'扎格只有这么大地方放东西啦。

original: No problem, I can carry a good bit of gear.
traduit: 没问题，我还能带很多。

original: Running out of room, eh? I'll be glad to help.
traduit: 没地方放了？我来帮忙吧。

original: Do I get to keep it? Just kidding.
traduit: 我能留着吗？开个玩笑。

original: I am an apprentice wizard, not a pack mule! Oh very well, but make it quick.
traduit: 我是个学徒巫师，不是骡子！好吧，赶紧的吧。

original: Sure, feel free to hand me all the gold you want.
traduit: 当然，你能给我多少钱都行。

original: Sure, what have you got?
traduit: 可以啊，你想让我拿什么？

original: No problem! How can I help?
traduit: 没问题！我能帮什么忙吗？

original: What do you want me to carry?
traduit: 你想让我拿什么呢？

original: I'll shoulder some of your burden.
traduit: 我可以帮你分担些。

original: Need me to carry something?
traduit: 需要我帮你拿东西吗？

original: Fine. Let's trade, then.
traduit: 好啊，那就交换吧。

original: And that's where I come in?
traduit: 这就是我的工作？

original: Yes. According to Giraud, our histories keeper, the portion of the Edda dealing with King Olaf might still exist in Dead Man's Respite.
traduit: 没错。根据我们的历史守护者吉劳德的说法，和奥拉夫王有关的那部分《埃达》很可能还存在亡者之栖。

original: I need you to retrieve the poem.
traduit: 我需要你把诗取回来。

original: Yes. According to Giraud, our histories keeper, the portion of the Edda dealing with King Olaf might still exist in the Dead Man's Respite.
traduit: 没错。根据我们的历史守护者吉劳德的说法，和奥拉夫王有关的那部分《埃达》很可能还存在亡者之栖。

original: Make sure that he is.
traduit: 确保他在。

original: Make sure that she is.
traduit: 确保她在。

original: You idiot. Do you even know who I am? The most recognized scholar on the Dwemer in all of Tamriel, and you people keep bothering me!
traduit: 你个白痴，你知道我谁吗？全泰姆瑞尔最著名的锻莫学者，你们这些人就知道打扰我！

original: I... I'm sorry I... I got too excited. I'm in the middle of some very... stressful work, and I shouldn't have yelled. How can I help you?
traduit: 哦……抱歉……我太兴奋了。我正在忙一些……压力很大的工作，我不该这么大吼大叫的。有什么需要帮忙的吗？

original: I was looking for you, actually.
traduit: 其实我是来找你的。

original: I told you I'm not hiring any more guards. Why do you people always bother me when I'm trying to finish my research?
traduit: 我告诉过你们了，我不招护卫了。怎么总在我研究的时候来打扰我？

original: Are you a wizard? I wanted to buy some spells.
traduit: 你是巫师？我想买些咒语。

original: Magic. That's what they always want. Never history. Never the secrets of the lost races. No, just little spells and enchantments.
traduit: 又是魔法。他们总想要这些。不关注历史。不关注失落种族的奥秘。就知道法术和魔法。

original: Excavation site?
traduit: 挖掘现场？

original: Nchuand-Zel? The ruins underneath Markarth? The wealth of artifacts that I've based two human lifetimes of research on?
traduit: 尼楚安德-泽尔？马卡斯城下的遗迹？我耗费人类两辈子时间研究的大量文物的价值？

original: What are you doing here? The excavation site is closed. I don't need any more workers or guards.
traduit: 你在这儿做什么？挖掘现场已经关闭了。我不需要工人和护卫了。

original: Ulfric saved Markarth? How?
traduit: 乌弗瑞克拯救了马卡斯？怎么做到的？

original: He used the Thu'um. Shouted those Forsworn from the walls. Then he led a band of Nord warriors in to take the city.
traduit: 他用了吐'目。朝城墙上的那些弃誓者咆哮。然后带领一群诺德战士占领了城市。

original: Just like Talos himself at the Battle of Old Hroldan, reclaiming the Reach from those heathen natives.
traduit: 就像塔洛斯本人在古霍尔丹战役里那样，从野蛮的原住民手里夺回了瑞驰。

original: What's this about elves?
traduit: 精灵是怎么回事？

original: They started the Great War. Nearly destroyed the Imperial City. Then the Emperor took the coward's way out and surrendered.
traduit: 他们发动了浩大战争。几乎摧毁了帝都。然后皇帝以懦弱的方式出来投了降。

original: Now the Elves dictate everything we do, and they don't want us acknowledging a "mere human" like Talos as the god he is.
traduit: 现在，精灵支配着我们的一切，他们不希望我们承认塔洛斯这样的“区区人类”会成神。

original: Your kind started the Great War. Nearly destroyed the Imperial City. Then the Emperor took the coward's way out and surrendered.
traduit: 你的族人发动了浩大战争。几乎摧毁了帝都。然后皇帝以懦弱的方式出来投了降。

original: Now you people dictate everything we do. Don't want us acknowledging a "mere human" like Talos as the god he is.
traduit: 现在，你们这群人支配着我们的一切，不希望我们承认塔洛斯这样的“区区人类”会成神。

original: Why should the Jarl listen to you?
traduit: 领主为什么会听你的？

original: We own Cidhna Mine. Best prison in Skyrim, and source of half the wealth in this city.
traduit: 我们拥有希讷矿场。天际最好的监狱，也是这座城市半数财富的来源。

original: We keep the Reach safe. We flood Markarth with wealth, but does the Jarl listen to us when we want a say? No.
traduit: 我们保证着瑞驰的安全。给马卡斯注入了大量财富。等我们想表达意见的时候，领主会不听么？不可能。

original: He's busy forgetting that Ulfric Stormcloak saved this city from the Forsworn. Ulfric's a hero, not a damn criminal.
traduit: 他正忙着忘记乌弗瑞克·风暴斗篷从弃誓者手里拯救了这座城市。乌弗瑞克是英雄，不是罪犯。

original: He founded the Empire, and now they've turned their back on him. To appease the Elves. Elves! Do the Elves rule Skyrim, or do the Nords?
traduit: 他建立了帝国，现在他们又背弃了他。就为了安抚精灵。精灵！到底是精灵统治天际，还是诺德人统治天际？

original: He founded the Empire, and now they've turned their back on him. To appease your kind, Elf. Do your people rule Skyrim, or do the Nords?
traduit: 他建立了帝国，现在他们又背弃了他。就为了安抚你们这群。精灵！到底是精灵统治天际，还是诺德人统治天际？

original: You said something about Talos.
traduit: 你谈到了塔洛斯。

original: That's a true Nord hero. A legend. So great that the Divines themselves lifted his soul into the heavens and made him a god.
traduit: 他才是真正的诺德英雄。一个传奇。他伟大如斯，以至于圣灵们亲自将他的灵魂接引到天堂，升为神灵。

original: There's a war on and you don't know what I'm talking about? The Empire is destroying everything Skyrim stands for.
traduit: 战争正在进行，你不知道我在说什么？帝国正在摧毁天际所代表的一切。

original: Jarl Igmund can refuse to see me all he wants. The Silver-Blood family will be heard.
traduit: 依格蒙德领主可以拒绝见我。但银血家族的意见必然会被听到。

original: I'm no friend of the Imperials.
traduit: 我不是帝国人的朋友。

original: Finally, someone with decent sense. The Empire is destroying everything Skyrim stands for. Honor. Pride. Mighty Talos.
traduit: 终于找到个有良心的了。帝国正在摧毁天际所代表的一切。荣誉、骄傲、强大的塔洛斯。

original: Jarl Igmund can't ignore us for much longer. Not if the Silver-Blood family has a say.
traduit: 依格蒙德领主不能再忽视我们多久了。只要银血家族发话，他们就得听着。

original: You can tell Jarl Igmund that the Silver-Blood family won't tolerate his cowardice for much longer.
traduit: 你可以告诉依格蒙德领主，银血家族不会再容忍他的懦弱了。

original: I support the Empire. What of it?
traduit: 我支持帝国。怎样？

original: What of it, he says. Your Empire is destroying everything Skyrim stands for. Honor. Pride. Mighty Talos.
traduit: 你还说什么怎样。你的帝国正在摧毁天际所代表的一切。荣誉、骄傲、强大的塔洛斯。

original: What of it, she says. Your Empire is destroying everything Skyrim stands for. Honor. Pride. Mighty Talos.
traduit: 你还说什么怎样。你的帝国正在摧毁天际所代表的一切。荣誉、骄傲、强大的塔洛斯。

original: You there. You another Imperial puppet? Answer me.
traduit: 喂。你是帝国的傀儡吗？回答我。

original: I'll come back later, then.
traduit: 那我以后再来。

original: Arkay keep you and protect you.
traduit: 阿尔凯保佑你。

original: Is that so? You should be. Though a heart without fear is something I can use... Perhaps you are the one I seek.
traduit: 是吗？你在惧怕。心无畏惧者虽然有用……但你也许就是我要找的人。

original: We shall soon find out.
traduit: 很快就有分晓了。

original: I am called Boethiah. Many names have mortals given me. But I am not interested in names. I am interested only in deeds.
traduit: 我被叫做波耶西亚。凡人给了我许多名字。但我对那些不感兴趣，我只中意于行动。

original: A god? Assuredly not! When was the last time you saw evidence of Aedra in the world?
traduit: 神？肯定不是！你最后一次看到伊德拉的迹象是什么时候？

original: No, we Daedra are far more powerful than any god. And among my brethren, I am the most feared.
traduit: 我们迪德拉比任何神都要强大。在我的兄弟中，属我最为可怕。

original: Are you some kind of god?
traduit: 你是某种神吗？

original: Tell me, why have you slain this one, who trusted you, here upon my shrine?
traduit: 告诉我，你为何在我的祭坛杀死这个信任你的人？

original: Tell me, why have you slain those who profess to follow in my ways?
traduit: 告诉我，为什么要杀害这些自称追随我道之人？

original: You were weak. Now you are dead. What signs have you left of your passing for us to remember you by?
traduit: 你很弱。所以你死了。你可曾留下能让我们记住你的痕迹？

original: A god? Assuredly not! Gods are weak and ineffectual. When was the last time you heard or saw evidence of the Aedra in the world?
traduit: 神？肯定不是！众神软弱无能。你最后一次见闻到伊德拉的迹象是什么时候？

original: Indeed. But I abide only those whose will is aligned to my own. Those who oppose my desires perish in the most dreadful of ways.
traduit: 没错。但我只会和意志与我意志者同在。忤逆我愿者死相凄惨。

original: I don't like being ignored. (Intimidate)
traduit: 我不喜欢被无视。（恐吓）

original: Then my answer is the Hall of the Dead is closed. By order of the Jarl. Understand?
traduit: 那我的答案是，亡者之厅已经关闭了。这是领主的命令。懂吗？

original: Would some coin help? (<BribeCost> gold)
traduit: 你或许需要些钱（<BribeCost>金币）

original: Well, the Priesthood of Arkay always accepts generous donations.
traduit: 好吧，阿尔凯的祭司团乐于接受慷慨的捐赠。

original: That's not going to work.
traduit: 行不通。

original: We've discovered that some of the dead have been... eaten. Flesh has been chewed off, bones were snapped to get at the marrow inside.
traduit: 我们发现有死者的尸体被……吃了。肉被咬过，骨头被敲碎，里面的骨髓也被吸食了。

original: We haven't caught anyone or anything yet. It's like it knows when I'm there.
traduit: 我们没有发现任何线索。它好像知道我何时会去那里。

original: If you can get to the bottom of this, the Priesthood of Arkay will reward you. Take my key, and be careful.
traduit: 如果你能弄清这件事，阿尔凯祭司团会酬谢你的。拿着我的钥匙，小心点。

original: I could help if you tell me. (Persuade)
traduit: 告诉我的话，我也许能帮你。（说服）

original: All right. I was going to suggest the Jarl hire someone to sort this mess out, anyway.
traduit: 好吧。我本来打算让领主雇人来收拾这烂摊子的。

original: Who's Arkay?
traduit: 阿尔凯是谁？

original: Arkay. One of the Eight Divines. God of the Cycle of Birth and Death.
traduit: 阿尔凯。八圣灵之一。生与死轮回之神。

original: It is his shrine people pray to when they visit the Hall. That his divinity will watch over their ancestors on the way to the next life.
traduit: 这是他的神祠，人们可以在拜访大厅时祈祷。他的神性将在他们的祖先进入来世的路上守护他们。

original: What's the Hall of the Dead?
traduit: 亡者之厅是什么？

original: New to Skyrim? I was confused at first, too. The Nords call their mausoleums the Hall of the Dead.
traduit: 刚来天际吗？一开始我也很困惑。诺德人把他们的陵墓称为亡者之厅。

original: It's where people in the city are buried. Fathers. Forefathers. Mothers. Foremothers.
traduit: 城里人们都葬在这里。父亲、祖父。母亲、祖母。

original: That's enough, Thongvor. We're done.
traduit: 够了，松瓦。我们没什么好谈的了。

original: I don't have time right now.
traduit: 我现在没时间。

original: I'll make sure he gets it.
traduit: 我保证送到。

original: Thank you. He can be a bit difficult, but I'm sure he'll appreciate your help.
traduit: 谢谢。他是有些难相处，但他会感激你的帮助的。

original: What do you know about the Forsworn?
traduit: 你对弃誓者了解多少？

original: Only that they break an old woman's heart. So many friends, so many kin, all lost trying to rebuild a past that was over long ago.
traduit: 只知道他们伤了一个老太太的心。那么多朋友、那么多亲人，都在想要重建很久以前就结束的过去时死去了。

original: I don't have time. Sorry.
traduit: 我没时间。抱歉。

original: I'll bring one if I find it.
traduit: 如果我找到了，会带给你的。

original: What's wrong with your apprentice?
traduit: 你的徒弟怎么了？

original: Tacitus? Boy's an Imperial. I keep showing him how to treat the iron, but he never gets it.
traduit: 塔西佗？这孩子是个帝国人。我一直在教他怎么处理钢铁，但他不上道。

original: In the Legion, the Imperial smiths used to read books when they couldn't set their hammers straight. Wisdom of the old, I guess.
traduit: 在军团里，如果帝国人铁匠没法把铁锤摆正的时候就会去看书。我猜这是老辈人的智慧吧。

original: If you find a book called "The Last Scabbard of Akrash," could you bring it to me? Tacitus sure isn't learning by example.
traduit: 如果你能找到一本叫《阿卡拉什的最后剑鞘》的书，能带给我吗？塔西佗肯定是不愿意自己学了。

original: Here's the book you wanted.
traduit: 这是你要的书。

original: Books. Don't know why the Imperials like these so much. This should help the boy, though, Malacath willing.
traduit: 书。不知道帝国人为什么很喜欢这些。应该能帮助那孩子吧，玛拉凯斯在上。

original: Here, let me show you how an Orc learns to smith.
traduit: 来，让我教教你兽人是怎么学会锻造的。

original: I served in the Legion. Perhaps I'll show you some of their technique one of these days.
traduit: 我曾经在军团服过役。也许哪天我会让你看看他们的技巧。

original: I won't be married to some weak-willed Orc chieften. I'd sooner join the Legion.
traduit: 我可不想嫁给一个意志薄弱的兽人酋长。我宁可去加入军团。

original: You'll come of age soon. Time to be married to another chief.
traduit: 你很快就要成年了。是时候嫁给其他酋长了。

original: Imagine the heads of your enemies as you forge. Let your hatred work the steel.
traduit: 锻造的时候想想你敌人的脸。让你的仇恨锻造钢铁。

original: Sorry, mother. I'll focus on my work.
traduit: 抱歉，母亲。我会专注工作的。

original: Save your anger for the forge. The steel cannot hear your whining.
traduit: 把你的怒气投入锻炉吧。钢铁听不到你的抱怨。

original: The metal has been stubborn today. It refuses to bend.
traduit: 今天的金属很顽强。它不想被弯曲。

original: No, mother. It's no wonder our enemies fear the sight of an Orc warrior.
traduit: 没有，母亲。也难怪我们的敌人惧怕见到兽人战士。

original: Ah, is there any weapon finer than an Orc blade?
traduit: 还有比兽人剑器更好的武器吗？

original: On second thought, maybe I'll pass...
traduit: 仔细一琢磨，我还是不去了……

original: I'm in.
traduit: 算我一个。

original: Do you have any burglary jobs?
traduit: 你这里有盗窃工作吗？

original: Pretty simple. Break into a house, grab a specific item and get out before they realize what's going on.
traduit: 很简单，闯进屋里，拿走一件特定的物品，然后在他们反应过来之前离开。

original: The catch is you can't kill anyone who lives there or you forfeit the payment.
traduit: 关键是你不能杀死住户，否则就拿不到报酬。

original: You ready for some good old-fashioned burglary?
traduit: 准备好来一次老派的入室行窃了吗？

original: Tell me about the burglary jobs.
traduit: 跟我说说盗窃的事。

original: We're looking to recover an heirloom for a client. They claim ownership of it, and as long as they're paying we don't really care. You in?
traduit: 我们想替一个客户寻回传家宝。他们宣称东西是自己的，只要他们肯付钱我们就不在乎。想加入吗？

original: We've been trying to get this item for a while, but no one with the skills has come along to claim it. Can I count on you to get it?
traduit: 我们盯上这东西很久了，但是没有一个有技术的人来认领。打算帮我拿回来吗？

original: Have a house with a good bit of valuables inside, but one particular item's caught my eye. You up for it?
traduit: 有间房子里贵重品很多，但是有一件引起了我的注意。准备好了吗？

original: Got a tip on a desirable item at this location. We want you to break in there and bring it to us. What do you think?
traduit: 这是一件心仪物品的线索。我们想让你闯进去给带出来。你觉得如何？

original: Good, got a buyer in a rush for this item. If you hurry we can turn it around and make a quick profit. Can you get it?
traduit: 很好，有个买家急需这件东西。如果你快点，我们就能扭转局面，很快就能赚一笔。你愿意接手吗？

original: Sure, sure. We're always looking to get our hands on items from all over Skyrim. How about this one?
traduit: 当然，当然。我们总希望偷遍全天际。这个如何？

original: As long as you can keep things quiet and don't get yourself killed in the process, this place has exactly what we're looking for. You in?
traduit: 只要你秘密行事，保住小命，这地方就有我们要找的东西。要加入吗？

original: We've actually stolen this item before and somehow it ended up back in some other mark's house. Guess it's time to reclaim it, eh?
traduit: 我们以前也偷过这东西，但不知道后来怎么又回到了另一个目标的家里。是时候收回来了，对吧？

original: I don't have to take this from the likes of you.
traduit: 我没必要听你这种人的。

original: I cleared the mine of draugr.
traduit: 我把矿场里的尸鬼消灭了。

original: You did? We were waiting for the Jarl to send an entire regiment to clear that mine.
traduit: 真的？我们还在等领主派大队人马来摆平矿场呢。

original: Now we can get back to work. Thank you.
traduit: 我们可以回去工作了。谢谢你！

original: The mine isn't safe? Why?
traduit: 矿场不安全？为什么？

original: We tunneled into an old Nordic crypt. The whole place is crawling with draugr.
traduit: 我们挖隧道挖到了一个古老的诺德地穴。到处都是尸鬼。

original: We're not mining up any ore with those undead around, so I wouldn't go down there if I were you.
traduit: 我们不能在亡灵附近开挖矿石，如果我是你，就不会去那里了。

original: Whoa, there. I don't know where you're going, but stay out of that mine. It isn't safe.
traduit: 喂，那边的。我不知道你要去哪儿，但离那个矿场远点。这里不安全。

original: Do you have any shill jobs?
traduit: 你这里有设饵工作吗？

original: When a client needs us to eliminate another, we don't operate like the Dark Brotherhood. We find alternate means to get them out of the way.
traduit: 当客户希望我们消灭其他人时，我们可不会像黑暗兄弟会那样行事。我们会找别的办法把他们赶走。

original: We send you to plant some phony evidence in the mark's house, and then tip off the town guard... the rest takes care of itself.
traduit: 我们会派你去目标的家里栽赃一些假证据，然后通知卫兵……剩下的就顺理成章了。

original: Sound like you can handle it?
traduit: 听上去怎么样？

original: Tell me about the shill jobs.
traduit: 跟我说说设饵工作。

original: Someone wants to see this mark suffer. They're paying a good bit of coin to have us plant the evidence in their house. You in?
traduit: 有人想让目标受点罪。他们付了一大笔钱让我们把证据栽赃到目标家里。你加入吗？

original: This one should be easy. Get in, plant the goods and get out. Quiet and neat. Sound like your kind of job?
traduit: 这个应该很容易。进去，把东西放好，然后出来。安静整洁。你应该能办到吧？

original: The mark must have ticked-off our client badly. He's impatient and keeps asking if the job's done. Can you get him off my back?
traduit: 这个目标肯定让我们客户发火了。他很不耐烦，不停问我们工作是否完成。你能让他别再烦我了吗？

original: Got a good one here. Personal score to settle between myself and this mark. You up for it?
traduit: 这里有个不错的。我和这个目标有点个人恩怨。愿意做吗？

original: Brynjolf finally got some dirt on the mark and the evidence to back it up. Think you can give him a hand?
traduit: 布林乔夫终于找到了目标的把柄和证据了。去帮他一把？

original: This one angered someone pretty high up in the keep. Can I count on you to get this done for me?
traduit: 这件事激怒了城堡里的上层人物了。希望你帮我做了成吗？

original: Got another personal score to settle and I'd consider it a favor if you'd take the job. Think you can help me out?
traduit: 我有个个人恩怨要解决，如果你接了，算我欠你的。帮个忙怎样？

original: Sure, sure. Got one that should be pretty easy, as long as you keep your weapon sheathed. Can you handle it?
traduit: 当然当然。这里有个简单的，只要把武器藏好就行。能应付的来吗？

original: Yeah. Someone ticked off Maven and she wants to teach them a lesson... our way. You in?
traduit: 嗯。有人辱骂玛雯，她想用我们的方式……给他们个教训。要加入吗？

original: Fine, but don't say I didn't warn you.
traduit: 好吧，但别说我没提醒你。

original: There's a war on. We need every scrap of ore we can get, so we're going to keep digging. Understand?
traduit: 这是一场战争。我们要找到每一块矿石，所以要继续挖，明白了么？

original: I don't think it's safe mining a cave on top of that crypt.
traduit: 我觉得在地穴上面挖洞不安全。

original: Don't be such a coward. We haven't seen any draugr since the mine was cleared. Be grateful.
traduit: 别那么胆小。自打矿场被清理干净，我们就再也没见过尸鬼了。好好庆幸吧。

original: Those draugr are going to be back. I can feel it.
traduit: 那些尸鬼会回来的。我能感觉到。

original: That's comforting. Glad they're keeping watch instead of getting rid of the draugr.
traduit: 那可真令人欣慰。真高兴他们能够在这里看守而不是去清理那些尸鬼。

original: The guards say no draugr have come out of the mine.
traduit: 卫兵说没有尸鬼从矿场里出来。

original: "We're safe" he says. You'll eat those words when a draugr is tearing into your face.
traduit: 他还说“我们安全”。等尸鬼把你的脸咬碎了，看你还说得出来么。

original: They haven't moved out of the caves. I think we're safe.
traduit: 他们还没有出那个地穴。我们应该还安全。

original: Those draugr are going to come up and kill us all.
traduit: 那些尸鬼要上来把我们都杀了。

original: Steel your nerves. The draugr are gone. Focus on your mining.
traduit: 你神经过敏了。没有尸鬼了。好好挖吧。

original: I feel like any moment, a draugr is going to come and chop my head off.
traduit: 我感觉随时会有尸鬼来劈我脑袋。

original: How can you say that? This mine was filled with draugr not too long ago.
traduit: 你还说得出？这个矿场前不久还遍地是尸鬼呢。

original: Feels good to be mining again.
traduit: 能再次挖矿的感觉真好。

original: Never mind, maybe later.
traduit: 算了吧，以后再说。

original: Do you have any numbers jobs?
traduit: 你这里有改账工作吗？

original: Most of the establishments in Skyrim keep their transactions recorded within business ledgers.
traduit: 天际的大多数机构会将交易记录记在业务账簿上。

original: Your job would be to change the numbers in those books so the shortfalls from our other jobs look legit.
traduit: 你的工作就是改变账簿上的数字，这样我们其他工作上的亏空就合理了。

original: Feel like doing a bit of writin'?
traduit: 想要去写点东西吗？

original: Tell me about the numbers jobs.
traduit: 跟我说说改账的工作。

original: This business is a regular target for the Guild. They keep pretty shoddy records, so the job should be a cinch. You in?
traduit: 这次任务是公会的固定目标。他们的记录很差劲，所以办起来很容易。要加入吗？

original: We want to waylay a shipment on the way from this business without them even noticin' anything went missin'. Want the job?
traduit: 我们想在运输途中截留一批货，而他们却不会发现丢了什么。想接下吗？

original: Yeah, sure. Got a business on tap that could use a little number rearrangin'. What do you say?
traduit: 嗯，当然有。我这里有笔生意，需要重新整理一下账目。你觉得呢？

original: Okay, got just the one for you. Ledger's just beggin' to be changed and the Guild could use the coin. How about it?
