original: Ignore me all you want, you still aren't getting in.
traduit: 不管你怎么无视我，你还是不能进。

original: Does this finally mean peace?
traduit: 这意味着最终和平吗？

original: The fiercest of the remaining rebels will continue to harass us, but by in large, the people here desire peace.
traduit: 最凶猛的叛军残党会继续袭击我们。但总体来讲，这里的人民渴望和平。

original: What I'm not so sure about is the peace we've made with the Thalmor. But we'll keep that between the two of us, alright?
traduit: 我不太确定我们会和梭默一直保持和平。但这事儿不传六耳，好吗？

original: Now that Ulfric is dead, will there be peace?
traduit: 现在乌弗瑞克死了，和平就会到来了？

original: There are those who still call themselves Stormcloaks, who continue to fight us, and bring misery to the people... but they are few in number.
traduit: 有些人仍自称风暴斗篷，还会与我们继续作战，给人民带去苦难……但数量很少了。

original: The ordinary citizen will be happy to get back to life as normal, to have their families return home.
traduit: 一般公民是很高兴家人们返回故乡，回归正常生活的。

original: And they should enjoy it while they can... I suspect all of Tamriel will again be called to arms in the not too distant future.
traduit: 他们应该趁现在好好享受。我怀疑不久的将来全泰姆瑞尔人还会被征召入伍。

original: There will be peace for a time, during which we must rebuild Skyrim into the land it once was. Strong. Self-reliant. The center of mankind.
traduit: 和平会持续一段时间。这段时间里我们必须把天际重建成曾经那个强大、自力更生的人类中心。

original: Because getting rid of the Empire was only half the problem.
traduit: 因为摆脱帝国只是解决了一半问题。

original: Soon, the elves will again seek to rule the world. We must ready ourselves to fight them.
traduit: 精灵们很快会再次寻求统治世界。我们必须做好与他们作战的准备。

original: For it will be Skyrim that shall lead Tamriel in those dark days, when the fate of the world is finally determined.
traduit: 因为当世界的命运被最终决定，只有天际才能带领全泰姆瑞尔度过黑暗的年代。

original: Now that we've defeated the Imperials, will there be peace?
traduit: 既然我们已经打败了帝国，这里会和平吗？

original: Peace? When has any Nord ever known peace? Skyrim breeds warriors. It's who we are, it's in our blood.
traduit: 和平？诺德人何时知道和平？天际孕育的都是战士。这才是我们的本性，我们的血脉。

original: And that's as it should be. In the darkest days ahead, it'll be us Nords who lead the fight against the elves.
traduit: 这是应该的。在未来的最黑暗时代，我们诺德人会领导与精灵的战斗。

original: It's only a matter of time before their pointy ears start itching to rule the world again.
traduit: 那群尖耳朵再次渴望统治世界只是时间问题。

original: It'll be Skyrim that leads the charge. Mark my words. And that time around, mankind will either succeed once and for all or die trying.
traduit: 天际应该带头冲锋。记住，到那时，人类要么一战成功，要么就是一败涂地。

original: What's next for you?
traduit: 你接下来有什么打算？

original: No, I suspect Skyrim to be my home for many years.
traduit: 不，看来接下来很长时间天际都是我的家了。

original: Can't say I'll ever get used to the damn cold, or understand these Nords... but, I've come to respect them.
traduit: 我不敢说已经适应了这倒霉的寒冷，或者理解了诺德人……但是，我开始尊重他们了。

original: The harshness of Skyrim has a way of carving a man down to his true self.
traduit: 天际的严酷让人看清真实的自我。

original: Will you return to Cyrodiil now?
traduit: 你现在要回希罗帝尔了？

original: The General's put me in charge of assisting the new governments.
traduit: 将军让我负责协助新的各领地政府。

original: I may understand things here in Skyrim better than the General, but I'm a soldier at heart, not a politician. But I'll do my best.
traduit: 我可能比将军更加了解天际，可我心里永远是个兵，不是政治家。不过我会勉力去做。

original: This is the land of my birth, the land that shaped me. I'm proud to have any part in making it strong again.
traduit: 这是生我养我的土地。我很自豪能让它重新强大起来。

original: What's next for the accomplished Legate Rikke?
traduit: 我们多才多艺的瑞姬副官接下来有什么打算？

original: No, not yet. We'll wait for the Moot to name me High King. It'll be better for all that way.
traduit: 不，还没有。我们得等领主议会的任命。那样会更好。

original: But, that doesn't mean I won't start acting like it. There's much to do. The new Jarls need help building armies, and enforcing their right to rule.
traduit: 但这不代表我会等着开会无所事事。事情很多，得帮助新的领主们建立军队，确保他们实行统治。

original: The Empire may try to reclaim Skyrim, and I need everyone ready for that. Though the biggest threat, of course, is the elves.
traduit: 帝国可能会试图夺回天际，我需要大家都做好准备。但是，精灵肯定是最大的威胁。

original: So, do I call you High King now?
traduit: 那我现在该称你为至高王了？

original: Heh. Ulfric's put me in charge of keeping an eye on the new Jarls. You know, make sure they're generally following orders.
traduit: 哈。乌弗瑞克让我负责监视新任的领主们。你知道，得让他们基本上服从命令才行。

original: Can't say I'm looking forward to that. But, I'll also be training men and women for their new armies.
traduit: 虽然不是很期待。但我会帮他们的新军队训练士兵。

original: The Empire might send over a few Legionnaires to make sure we're serious, and of course, we'll be taking the fight to the elves soon enough.
traduit: 帝国可能会派一些军队来试探我们，另外，我们肯定很快会和精灵开战。

original: We'll need trained, disciplined and creative warriors ready for all that.
traduit: 我们需要一批训练有素、纪律严明、富有创造力的战士为这一切做好准备。

original: What's next for the mighty Galmar Stone-Fist?
traduit: 我们强大的加尔玛·石拳接下来有什么打算？

original: Is there anything further I can do...?
traduit: 还有什么我能做的吗？

original: Ulfric is dead and his army destroyed. There's not much more I could ask of you. The gods, however, I suspect, may have plans for you elsewhere.
traduit: 乌弗瑞克死了，他的军队也被摧毁了。我没什么可要求你的了。但我怀疑诸神对你另有安排。

original: That said, Stormcloak true believers are still operating out of hidden military camps in the hills. If you encounter any on you travels, kill them.
traduit: 而且，风暴斗篷的死忠仍然在山里的隐蔽军营里活动。如果在路上遇到，杀。

original: With luck, they'll soon lose heart and return to their homes and families. If not, we'll be forced to put them all to the sword.
traduit: 所幸他们很快就会失去信心，回家团聚。否则，我们就不得不把他们赶尽杀绝。

original: Is there anything further I can do for the Legion?
traduit: 我还能为军团做些什么？

original: The Legion's work is far from finished, but you are free to roam. I suspect you'll be of greater good to Skyrim out there, in the world.
traduit: 军团的工作远未结束。但你可以自由行动了。我觉得你能对世界和天际产生更大好处。

original: If while you're out there, you stumble into any Stormcloak military camps, I expect you to destroy them. I've reports they are hiding in the hills.
traduit: 如果在外面碰到任何风暴斗篷军营，希望你能去摧毁它们。我听说他们还躲在山里。

original: True sons and daughters of Skyrim reign in every city, we've crippled the Imperial Legion, and cut off its head by killing General Tullius himself.
traduit: 每座城市都已经被真正的天际儿女掌控，我们摧毁了帝国军团。还杀死了图留斯将军，破坏了他们的指挥头脑。

original: What more could I ask of you? No, you're free to roam. I suspect the gods have needs for you elsewhere.
traduit: 我还能要求你做什么呢？你现在可以自由行动了。我猜诸神还需要你去别的地方。

original: That said, some of the Legion's staunchest men have organized themselves, and are operating out of hidden military camps in the wilderness.
traduit: 另外，军团的一些死忠已经组织起来，退守在荒野的隐蔽军营里开展活动了。

original: If you come across any Imperials in your travels, I expect you'll know what to do.
traduit: 如果在路上遇到帝国兵，我想你知道该怎么做。

original: Is there anything further I can do for the cause?
traduit: 我还能为这个事业做些什么？

original: No. I trust you'll do more good out there in the world, wherever you damn well please to go. You're a true son of Skyrim. You'll know what to do.
traduit: 不。我相信不管你去哪，总会为世界做更多好事的。你是真正的天际之子。你知道该怎么做。

original: To begin with, killing any Legionnaire you find out in the wilderness. I've reports they've hidden military camps out there.
traduit: 首先，在野外发现任何军团成员，都要杀死。我听说他们还有隐藏的军营。

original: No. I trust you'll do more good out there in the world, wherever you damn well please to go. You're a true daughter of Skyrim and'll know what to do.
traduit: 不。我相信不管你去哪，总会为世界做更多好事的。你是真正的天际之女。你知道该怎么做。

original: To begin with, killing any Legionnaire you find out in the wilderness. I've reports they've hidden military camps out there out there.
traduit: 首先，在野外发现任何军团成员，都要杀死。我听说他们还有隐藏的军营。

original: I'm ready. I made my peace with the gods long ago.
traduit: 我准备好了。诸神很久前就让我平静了。

original: What are you waiting for? Do it!
traduit: 还在等什么？动手啊！

original: With me, you kill Skyrim's last hope. Mark my words. You'll all be serving elven masters soon. And know then, that I would have stopped them.
traduit: 杀了我，你就扼杀了天际最后的希望。记住我的话。你们很快就要替精灵主子服务了。而我原本要阻止他们。

original: By the gods, stop toying with me and do it!
traduit: 众神在上，别再耍我了，动手吧！

original: Oh my. That...
traduit: 哦天。那是……

original: You... you go first.
traduit: 你……你先去。

original: What've you been staring at your feet this whole time? You see that big city up ahead of you? Markarth?
traduit: 你就一直盯着脚下看吗？看到前面的大城市了？马卡斯？

original: Head over there, unless you feel like helping my wife pick crops. And then 50 years later you'll wake up and still be here.
traduit: 去那边吧。除非你想帮我老婆收庄稼。50年后醒来时还在这里。

original: Have you lived here long?
traduit: 你在这里住很久了吗？

original: What kind of question is that? Look at me! Is this a young man's face?
traduit: 这算什么问题？看看我！这是年轻人的脸吗？

original: I've been here 50 years, and nothing is going to move me off my land.
traduit: 我在这里50年了，没什么能让我离开我的土地。

original: As part of your initiation, Master Einarth will allow you to tap into his understanding of "Ro."
traduit: 作为入门的一部分。爱纳斯大师会与你分享他对“洛”的见解。

original: Well, that is how the rest of us learn Shouts. As Dragonborn, you can absorb a slain dragon's life force and knowledge directly.
traduit: 啊，这是我们学习龙吼的方法。作为龙裔，你可以直接吸收被你杀死的龙的生命力量和知识。

original: But learning a Word of Power is only the first step... you must unlock its meaning through constant practice in order to use it in a Shout.
traduit: 但学习力量之语只是第一步……你必须不断练习以解开它的意义，才能在龙吼中使用它。

original: All Shouts are made up of three Words of Power. As you master each Word, your Shout will become progressively stronger.
traduit: 所有龙吼都由三个力量之语组成。每当你掌握一个新词，你的龙吼也会变得更强一些。

original: Ro means "Balance" in the dragon tongue. Combine it with Fus - "Force" - to focus your Thu'um more sharply.
traduit: “洛”在龙语中意味着“平衡”。把它和“伏斯”，也就是“力量”结合起来，可以让你的吐'目更加尖锐。

original: What's all this about the Forsworn?
traduit: 这些弃誓者是怎么回事？

original: Seems Kolskeggr Mine got hit by Forsworn. Those madmen get more bold every season.
traduit: 看来科斯凯格矿场被弃誓者袭击了。那些疯子的胆子越来越大了。

original: Pavo and Gat are the only survivors. I'll be sending word to the Jarl about this, but I don't know when help will come.
traduit: 只有帕沃和噶特活着跑出来了。我要把事情报告领主，但不知道什么时候才会有援助。

original: Was. Forsworn came in the night. Killed everyone. Gat and I are the only ones who escaped.
traduit: 对。弃誓者夜里袭击。杀了所有人。只有我和噶特俩人逃出来了。

original: Hopefully Skaggi will send word to the Jarl and something will be done.
traduit: 希望斯卡基能给领主捎个信，然后就有办法了。

original: You're from Kolskeggr Mine?
traduit: 你来自科斯凯格矿场？

original: Do you own this mine?
traduit: 这矿是你的？

original: That I do. If you want to grab a pickaxe and dig up some iron, feel free. I'll pay for anything you bring me.
traduit: 没错。如果你想找把鹤嘴锄挖点铁，请便。挖出来的东西我都会收的。

original: Skaggi is in charge, not me.
traduit: 斯卡基是老大，我不是。

original: Is this your mine?
traduit: 这是你的矿场吗？

original: That it is. Good to be home. Let me know if you dig up any ore. We'll pay a fair wage.
traduit: 是的。能回家真好。如果你挖到矿石就告诉我，我会付合适的价钱给你的。

original: Let's just hope that doesn't happen.
traduit: 但愿不会发生吧。

original: Do you think the Forsworn will come here? I mean, if they attacked Kolskeggr....
traduit: 你觉得弃誓者会到这里来吗？我是说，如果他们袭击了科斯凯格……

original: Those Forsworn were fierce fighters. Fiercer than I could have imagined.
traduit: 那些弃誓者真是凶猛。比我想象中还要厉害。

original: Thank the Divines we survived that.
traduit: 感谢圣灵，我们活下来了。

original: Well I'm glad you were there. I don't know how I would have gotten past the Forsworn without you.
traduit: 很高兴你能在场。真不知道没有你我怎么闯过那些弃誓者。

original: What does she do with the memories?
traduit: 她会拿这些记忆干什么？

original: Who can say? Perhaps she collects them for display like works of art in a nonsensical art gallery.
traduit: 谁知道呢？或许只是为了陈列而已，就像在荒谬的画廊中陈列艺术品一样。

original: Whatever the case may be, her intentions are far from benevolent.
traduit: 但不管怎样，她绝对不怀好意。

original: Absolutely not! I protest... uh, that is, yes, of course. I still don't understand what just... oh never mind.
traduit: 绝不是！我抗议……啊，对，没错。我还不明白怎么了……啊，没关系。

original: That is absolutely untrue! Uh, that is, yes, of course. What... I don't understand why everyone... never mind.
traduit: 这不是真的！哎，算了。我不明白……为什么每个人……算了。

original: I protest! This is an insult to the dignity of my person! This time I'm completely innocent!
traduit: 我抗议！我的人格尊严受到了侮辱！这一次我真是无辜的！

original: This is preposterous. Disrespect... insulting! I am tired of being hounded from all sides!
traduit: 荒谬至极。这是不敬……不对，是羞辱！我受够这种全方位骚扰了！

original: Madame Ambassador, you know that I would never have behaved... that is to say... well I swear I'm innocent this time!
traduit: 大使女士，你知道我不会这么做……我是说……我发誓这次是清白的！

original: I don't understand... did you say Ulfric Stormcloak? Fine fellow, although a bit too fond of... I mean, no, of course, I condemn him in the most...
traduit: 我不明白……你说乌弗瑞克·风暴斗篷？他是个好汉子，就是有点太喜欢……啊，我是说，我当然谴责他……

original: Hmm? Did you say snakes? Where? I hate them, always slithering they way they do... what? Are they on me?
traduit: 嗯？你说蛇？在哪？我讨厌他们滑来滑去的……什么？我身上有吗？

original: What? Of course I know who you are... I didn't mean to suggest, that is, I don't remember even saying that...
traduit: 什么？我当然知道你是谁……我没有什么意见，我都不记得我说过什么了……

original: What? I didn't... hmm? No, listen, you must have misunderstood... I don't mean to say I wouldn't be interested... what I mean is...
traduit: 什么？我没有……啊？不不，听着，你一定是误会了……我不是说没兴趣……我是说……

original: What? I didn't... hmm? No, listen, you must have misunderstood... I would never openly insult your... that is to say...
traduit: 什么？我没有……啊？不不，听着，你一定是误会了……我不会公开侮辱你的……也就是说……

original: Tell your men to stand down. I don't need any help dealing with this kind of fool. He isn't worth the trouble.
traduit: 让你的人闪开。对付这种蠢蛋用不上别人插手。他也配让人兴师动众？

original: I apologize for the disruption to such a festive occasion.
traduit: 我很抱歉破坏了这个喜庆的场合。

original: Dear me. All this trouble over me? I think I was confused. There's no harm in him. Please, let him go.
traduit: 天啊。怎么这么多麻烦事儿？我有点糊涂了。他应该没恶意。求你让他走吧。

original: Oh... I'm afraid I may have overreacted. Please, I've already forgotten whatever it was he said to me.
traduit: 哦……我可能反应过激了。我都忘了他跟我说了什么了。

original: I'm sure he's learned his lesson. Let's try to enjoy ourselves.
traduit: 我看他也吸取教训了。还是享受宴会吧。

original: I'm sorry, Ambassador. I didn't mean to cause such a commotion. There's no need to have him thrown out on my account.
traduit: 抱歉了大使。我没想引起这么大骚动。没必要为我把他轰出去了。

original: Oh, Ambassador Elenwen, that won't be necessary. It is just Razelan, after all.
traduit: 哦，爱琳温大使，没必要这样。毕竟他是拉泽兰啊。

original: I'm sure he'll behave himself for the rest of the evening, won't you dear?
traduit: 我相信他在剩下的时间里会好好表现的，对吧大使？

original: Well, now. There's no need to ruin the party on my account. I don't think he'll be bothering me again.
traduit: 好了。没必要为我扫了大家的兴致。我看他也不会再打扰我了。

original: Forgive me, Ambassador. I allowed this... fool to provoke me. The fault is mine. There is no need for further disruption on my account.
traduit: 原谅我，大使。我居然被这个……蠢货激怒了。是我不好，没必要坏了大家兴致。

original: Remove him. He's disturbing the other guests.
traduit: 把他轰出去。他打扰其他客人了。

original: Razelan. And you promised to behave yourself this time.
traduit: 拉泽兰。你答应过我这次会规矩点。

original: Razelan. What is it this time?
traduit: 拉泽兰。这次怎么说？

original: You take it back then? You retract your statement? Well?
traduit: 你想收回？你想收回你说的话？啊？

original: Begone, serpent! Begone from this house and trouble it no more!
traduit: 走开，有蛇！从房子里滚出去，不要烦我！

original: Beware of the serpent in your midst! Beware, oh people of Skyrim!
traduit: 天际的人啊，你们要小心，有蛇在你们中间！

original: There's no excuse for your behavior!
traduit: 你的行为简直不可原谅！

original: You behave like you're carousing in a house of ill repute, not the residence of the Thalmor Ambassador!
traduit: 这里是梭默大使馆！不是你寻欢作乐的妓院！

original: I know you're drunk as usual, but that's no excuse for insulting our hostess.
traduit: 我知道你是又喝醉了。但这不是你侮辱主家的理由。

original: I don't think anyone deserves that kind of abuse! I've known plenty of elves who were perfectly decent people.
traduit: 我觉得没人该承受这种辱骂！我认识很多正派的精灵。

original: The head office will hear of this, Razelan! You're a disgrace to the East Empire Company, and to the Empire itself!
traduit: 拉泽兰，总部会知道的！你就是东帝国公司和帝国的耻辱！

original: You're a disgrace to the Empire. To think that you're actually the representative of the East Empire Company.
traduit: 你真是帝国的耻辱。你怎么就当了东帝国公司的代表了呢。

original: When people talk about the decadent, tottering Empire, it's people like you they have in mind!
traduit: 当人们说起颓废衰落的帝国，想到的就是你这种人！

original: Your insults and provocations have gone far enough!
traduit: 你的挑衅和侮辱还不够吗！

original: I'd kill you where you stand if I wasn't bound by my oath as an officer of the Aldmeri Dominion.
traduit: 要不是遵守作为先祖神洲官员的誓言，我早就杀了你了。

original: No harm is meant to you, happy fool.
traduit: 这对你没害处，傻瓜。

original: Right here! I see it in your face! The snakes writhe behind your eyes! Get away, get away from me!
traduit: 在那！我在你脸上看到了！那群蛇就在你眼睛里！走开！离我远点！

original: It's all for a good cause, old chap.
traduit: 老伙计，一切都有正当理由。

original: Ulfric Stormcloak? The rightful High King? That's bordering on treason, man! Stand up. Stand up, I say!
traduit: 乌弗瑞克·风暴斗篷？合法的至高王？简直是叛徒言论！你给我站起来！

original: What...! Do you know who I am? I should have you taken up and flogged!
traduit: 什么……！你知道我是谁吗？真该把你拎起来抽一顿！

original: Hey, Razelan, remember when you told me I'd never amount to anything?
traduit: 嘿，拉泽兰，记得你说过我会一事无成吗？

original: Well, I don't think you should stay things like that about the Ambassador!
traduit: 喂，你怎么能这样评价大使！

original: Just play along.
traduit: 继续装吧。

original: How dare you! You disgusting pig!
traduit: 你怎敢！你这瘟猪！

original: You've got a lot of nerve, suggesting something like that, to me of all people! If this was Riften, I'd have you thrown in the dungeon!
traduit: 好大胆子，竟敢这样跟我说话！这要是在裂谷城，我早把你扔监狱了！

original: How dare you speak of the Thalmor in such a disgusting manner!
traduit: 你怎敢如此恶心地妄议梭默！

original: Say no more. I was wondering what you were doing here... I'm glad to play my part.
traduit: 不用多说了。我刚才还在想你来这儿干什么呢……瞧我的吧。

original: I trust you don't presume on our friendship? I am a Jarl, after all. I wouldn't want to appear foolish in front of these people.
traduit: 你别是在利用咱们的友谊吧？好歹我也是个领主，我可不想在这些人面前显得太蠢。

original: Nothing would please me more. I'll keep their eyes away while you do what you came here for.
traduit: 乐意之至。你去做吧，我来吸引注意。

original: Hmm. I don't want to get involved in anything beneath my dignity as Jarl.
traduit: 嗯。我不想做有损我领主尊严的事。

original: Oh... perhaps not, then. I don't think the Jarl of Solitude should be participating in a childish prank.
traduit: 哦……恐怕不行。独孤城领主不应该参与幼稚的恶作剧。

original: I don't know... I don't want to do anything that might offend Elenwen. There is a lot of money at stake, after all.
traduit: 我不知道……我不想冒犯爱琳温。这事关很多钱啊。

original: I don't even want to know, do I? But for you... all right. I'll do it.
traduit: 我根本不想知道。不过为了你……好吧。我去做。

original: This is very irregular. I trust that whatever you're doing doesn't compromise my position in any way?
traduit: 这太不合规矩了。你要做的事应该不会影响到我的地位吧？

original: That's it? Sure. Shouldn't be too hard. I usually end up making a fool out of myself without even trying.
traduit: 就这？好吧。应该不难。我连什么都不做都能出丑的。

original: If the parties bore you, why attend them?
traduit: 既然你讨厌宴会，为什么还要来呢？

original: The East Empire Company has interests all across Tamriel, inside and outside the Empire's borders. We try not to get involved in politics.
traduit: 东帝国公司的利益遍布泰姆瑞尔，涵盖帝国境内境外。所以我们尽力不卷入政治问题。

original: However, as the head of the company it's my job to make sure we maintain good relationships with prospective partners and investors.
traduit: 但是，作为公司的负责人，我需要确保和潜在伙伴和投资人的良好关系。

original: I need your help with something.
traduit: 我有事需要你帮忙。

original: Well... let's hear it.
traduit: 好啊……说来听听。

original: My ears are always open to a friend's request.
traduit: 我向来会听取朋友的请求。

original: Say on, friend. What do you need?
traduit: 说吧朋友。你需要什么？

original: I'm always glad to help a friend if I can. What do you need?
traduit: 我很乐意帮助朋友，你想干什么？

original: Oh? Something interesting, I hope?
traduit: 哦？是有趣的事吗？

original: Do you want to help me with something?
traduit: 你能帮我个忙吗？

original: Of course! I mean... assuming you don't want me to kill someone for you. I might have to draw the line there.
traduit: 当然！但是……你可别让我帮你杀人。这是我的底线。

original: What is it, my friend?
traduit: 怎么了，朋友？

original: What brings you to this party?
traduit: 你怎么到这个宴会来了？

original: You must be new around here. Bad manners to ask such a direct question, at one of Elenwen's little soirees.
traduit: 你是新来的吧。在爱琳温的宴会上这么直接地提问可不礼貌。

original: But I have nothing to hide. I'm in from the south, on business.
traduit: 不过也没什么可瞒的。我从南方过来公干。

original: And if you want to do business in Tamriel these days, well, you'd better get used to cozying up to the Thalmor. Like it or not.
traduit: 如果你想在泰姆瑞尔做生意。不管喜欢与否，你都得习惯去讨好梭默。

original: What does a fellow need to do to get a drink around here?
traduit: 怎么才能拿到杯酒呢？

original: Ah, I see. Very well, my friend. I'll do it.
traduit: 啊，我知道了。好吧，朋友。让我来。

original: Oh... all right. If it's so important to you, I suppose I can help.
traduit: 哦……好吧。如果这对你很重要。我乐意帮忙。

original: Very well. I suppose there's nothing wrong with a bit of harmless fun.
traduit: 很好。来点无伤大雅的玩笑有什么不好。

original: Don't worry. I'll play my part.
traduit: 别担心。看我演就是。

original: I find these parties such a dreadful bore.
traduit: 我觉得这种宴会实在是太无聊了。

original: One thing everyone can agree on. This war is bad for business.
traduit: 有件事是公认的。这场战争对商业很不利。

original: Ah, pardon me, friend. I didn't see you standing there.
traduit: 哦，对不起，朋友。我没看到你站在那。

original: Allow me to introduce myself: Razelan. Imports and exports, by trade. Observer of human nature, by avocation.
traduit: 请允许我自我介绍，我叫拉泽兰。主业是进出口贸易，副业是观察人性。

original: I've decided to help you end the nightmares.
traduit: 我决定帮你解决噩梦。

original: Mara be praised!
traduit: 感谢玛拉！

original: Sorry, I can't.
traduit: 对不起。我帮不了你。

original: I understand. If you should change your mind, I'll be here.
traduit: 我能理解。但如果你想通了，可以回来找我。

original: Then leave. This isn't your problem.
traduit: 那就离开吧。这不是你的问题。

original: Turn my back on these people when their lives could be at stake? I should say not.
traduit: 在这些人危在旦夕的时候放弃他们？我不能这么做。

original: Those dreams are not just visions, they're a footprint left by the Daedric Lord Vaermina as she drains these people of their memories!
traduit: 那些梦不只是幻象那么简单，是迪德拉君主瓦尔迷纳在吸干这些人记忆的时候留下的痕迹！

original: Don't be ridiculous. Dreams are harmless.
traduit: 别扯了。做梦有什么危害。

original: In any other circumstance, I'd agree with you. However, these aren't normal dreams.
traduit: 在其他时候，我都会同意你的说法。但是，这些可不是普通的梦。

original: The Daedric Lord Vaermina's voracious hunger for memories is responsible for these visions.
traduit: 迪德拉君主瓦尔迷纳对记忆的渴求造就了这些幻象。

original: The nightmares are an echo of her presence as she feeds.
traduit: 噩梦只是她进食时发出的回声。

original: Can't you do it for me?
traduit: 你不能帮我吗？

original: No. No I can't.
traduit: 不，不能。

original: I have enough to keep me busy. View it as a chance to hone your craft.
traduit: 我已经够忙了。就把它作为练手艺的机会吧。

original: Thanks for nothing.
traduit: 那不劳费心了。

original: My pleasure.
traduit: 不客气。

original: I need something enchanted.
traduit: 我想给东西附魔。

original: I'm sure you can figure it out on your own. If you can't, perhaps Urag has a book you can read.
traduit: 我相信你自己能搞定。如果搞不定，可以去乌拉格那里查书。

original: Well, there's an Imbuer here in the Great Hall.
traduit: 大厅里就有附魔装置。

original: Well, there's an Imbuer in the Great Hall.
traduit: 大厅里就有附魔装置。

original: No offense, of course.
traduit: 当然，无意冒犯。

original: New here too, eh? It's good to see another Nord. I feared I'd be the only one.
traduit: 你也是新来的？很高兴又见到诺德面孔了。我还怕就我一个诺德人呢。

original: Almost doesn't feel like Skyrim, being so far away from the rest of the world here.
traduit: 这里的感觉就像不在天际，远离尘世。

original: New here too, eh? I'd hoped I wouldn't be the only Nord, but I should've known better.
traduit: 你也是新来的吧？真希望我不是唯一的诺德人，但我很清楚。

original: Dangerous research must be a problem here.
traduit: 危险的研究在这儿肯定算个麻烦吧。

original: Not often, no.
traduit: 倒也不常见。

original: Some risks must be taken, to be sure. I am simply trying to avoid untimely deaths.
traduit: 当然，有些风险是必须冒的。我只是不想有人白白送命。

original: We also must make an effort to avoid worsening what Skyrim thinks of us.
traduit: 而且我们也必须避免让天际对我们的看法继续恶化。

original: No, sir.
traduit: 还没呢，阁下。

original: "Sir"? How quaint.
traduit: “阁下”？听着怪怪的。

original: No, we haven't.
traduit: 不，还没有呢。

original: Then allow me to introduce myself.
traduit: 那请允许我自我介绍一下。

original: I am Savos Aren, Arch-Mage of the College of Winterhold.
traduit: 我叫萨沃斯·阿冉，是冬堡学院的大法师。

original: I am quite content to see nearly any aspect of magic explored and investigated here.
traduit: 在这里，绝大多数魔法学问都可以钻研。我还挺满意的。

original: But I do not and will not approve of any research or experiments that cause purposeful harm to your fellow members of the College.
traduit: 但我也不会因此允许任何伤害到其他学院成员的研究或实验。

original: Are we clear?
traduit: 明白吗？

original: You are relatively new here, are you not? I have noticed you, but we have not spoken.
traduit: 你是新来的吧？我有注意到你，不过咱们还没聊过吧。

original: You are new here, are you not? We have not spoken.
traduit: 你是新来的吧？咱们还没聊过吧。

original: Still eager to please. This is good. Skjor may be right about you.
traduit: 仍然渴望取悦啊。很好。斯科约尔对你的看法可能没错。

original: He has something special planned for you. Better talk to him.
traduit: 他为你做了特别安排。最好去和他谈谈吧。

original: Yes. I have something a little different planned this time.
traduit: 对，我这次的计划有些不同。

original: But it's not for everyone to hear. Meet me in the Underforge tonight.
traduit: 不能搞得人尽皆知。今晚在地下锻炉见。

original: We will speak more.
traduit: 我们到时候再深谈。

original: Yes, I have something special for you.
traduit: 对，我有些特别的东西要给你。

original: Skjor was looking for you before. Talk to him before doing anything else.
traduit: 斯科约尔之前一直在找你。在干别的之前先和他聊聊。

original: Sorry, Miss Temba.
traduit: 抱歉，谭巴小姐。

original: Sigh. Everyone isn't as short as you are... what good are these boards to someone of the proper height!?
traduit: 哎。不是每个人都和你一样矮啊……这些木板于身高正常的人有什么用？

original: I'm so sorry Miss Temba. Perhaps if you would have been more specific...
traduit: 很抱歉，谭巴小姐。如果你能说得再具体些……

original: Gwilin! I told you to cut those boards at twice arm length! My arm's length. Not yours.
traduit: 格维林！我告诉过你要把木板切成两个胳膊长！我说的是我的胳膊，不是你的。

original: When I want your opinion, I'll ask for it. Otherwise, mind your business.
traduit: 等我需要你的意见时，我会问的。否则别多管。

original: I hardly think the bears are clever enough to hold a grudge against you, Miss Temba.
traduit: 我不觉得熊会聪明到对你怀恨在心，谭巴小姐。

original: Another batch of logs completely ruined. I swear, these bears have it out for me.
traduit: 又一批木料被毁了。我发誓，这些熊就是和我过不去。

original: "Our" business?
traduit: “咱们的”业务？

original: As I remember things, it was you that showed up at my doorstep looking for a job and a place to live. Try and remember that.
traduit: 我要没记错的话，是你跑来我家找工作和住处的吧。试着记住这点。

original: Look, I'm merely suggesting a few things that could expand our business.
traduit: 听着，我只是想提些可以扩大咱们业务的建议。

original: I'm becoming sick to death of your ideas. Not one of them has paid off since you moved in.
traduit: 我很讨厌你的想法。自从你搬进来，就没一个成功过。

original: If you have a moment, I've come up with a few ideas I wanted to share.
traduit: 有时间么，我有个想法和你交流交流。

original: That's none of your business and I appreciate if you wouldn't mention it again.
traduit: 这不关你的事，希望你别再提了。

original: Come on, everyone in town knows that you spend more time with Fastred than fishing in the river.
traduit: 得了吧，镇上谁不知道你和法斯莱德在一起的时间比在河边钓鱼的时间还多。

original: Blood from a stone, Klimmek. I've been out there every morning. They just aren't biting.
traduit: 不要石头里榨血啊，科林麦。我每天早上都去，它们就是不咬钩。

original: We're behind again. I need you to catch another two bushels by week's end if I'm to make another delivery.
traduit: 我们的产量又下来了。如果我再去送货的话，你得在周末前再抓两斗鱼回来。

original: I know your sights are set beyond this town, but for now, while you're under our roof, I need you to pitch in a little more.
traduit: 我知道你志不在此，但现在，既然你还住在咱们家，你就得多投入些。

original: I help, I do the chores. What else would you have me do?
traduit: 我帮了，我把家务做了。你还想让我做什么？

original: I need you to pitch in a little more around here, dear.
traduit: 亲爱的，我得让你多帮帮忙。

original: And if she decides to leave Ivarstead, what then? No, no... I can't bear the thought.
traduit: 那如果她决定离开伊瓦尔镇呢？不，不行……我不能忍受这种想法。

original: You're hardly throwing her to the wolves. She just wants to see the world... just like I did when I was her age.
traduit: 你没把她扔进狼群。她只是想去见见世面……就像我在她这个年纪一样。

original: She's our only child, Boti. Am I to throw her to the wolves?
traduit: 她是我们唯一的孩子，伯蒂。难道让我把她扔进狼群里吗？

original: You have to let Fastred follow her heart. You can't tell her what to do.
traduit: 你得让法斯莱德自己做决定。你不能一直告诉她该怎么做。

original: I know what you said, but I only wanted to speak to him for a moment.
traduit: 我知道你说过，但我只是想和他说几句话。

original: Wilhelm said he saw you speaking to one of the pilgrims on the 7,000 Steps. I told you that I didn't want you to go up there.
traduit: 威尔海姆说他看见你在7000级阶梯上和朝圣者说话。我告诉过你我不想让你上去。

original: Fastred, I wanted to talk with you.
traduit: 法斯莱德，我得和你谈谈。

original: There's much more to worry about in life then a bit of a temper, my friend.
traduit: 朋友，生活里除了脾气之外还有很多要操心的事。

original: Perhaps, but abuse is abuse. I don't think I could stand it.
traduit: 也许吧，但虐待就是虐待。我可忍不了。

original: If you'll pardon the expression, she's far more bark than bite.
traduit: 说句不好听的，她只是爱叫唤，不会咬人。

original: I heard Temba yelling at you yesterday. Why do you let her treat you like that?
traduit: 我昨天听见谭巴在吼你。你就这么由着她？

original: You're sweet. I'm just not ready for that sort of thing right now. I'm sorry.
traduit: 你真好。但我现在还没准备好应付那种事。抱歉了。

original: Perhaps when you're finished here this evening, we could...
traduit: 也许今晚你结束工作之后，我们可以……

original: Thank you Klimmek. That's too kind.
traduit: 谢谢你，科林麦。真是太好了。

original: I thought you played wonderfully last night.
traduit: 我觉得你昨晚弹得很好。

original: I know, but I don't want to let them down. I guess I better start thinking about it soon.
traduit: 我知道，但我不想让他们失望。我看我还是早点开始考虑考虑吧。

original: Take your time then. It isn't as though the Greybeards are going to complain.
traduit: 那就慢慢来吧。那些灰胡子也不一定会抱怨。

original: I wish I didn't have to. It's quite a difficult climb.
traduit: 我希望不用去。爬上去太费劲了。

original: You heading up to High Hrothgar soon, Klimmek?
traduit: 你要去霍斯加修道院了吗，科林麦？

original: Perhaps one day, but not today.
traduit: 也许会有一天吧，但不是现在。

original: Klimmek is doing just fine. You should follow your heart.
traduit: 科林麦做得很好。你应该遵从自己的心意。

original: No. I'll tell you, Wilhelm, if I could sweep her away from here tomorrow I'd do it, but Klimmek still has so much to learn.
traduit: 没有。我跟你说，威尔海姆，如果我明天能把她赶走我一定赶，但科林麦还有的要学。

original: Have you spoken to Fastred yet?
traduit: 你跟法斯莱德谈过了吗？

original: See that you don't. I promised to keep you safe and I'm not going to break my word.
traduit: 千万别去了。我说过要保护你的安全，我不会食言的。

original: I'm sorry. I was curious... I didn't believe the stories. I won't go over there ever again.
traduit: 抱歉。我就是好奇……我不相信那些故事。我不会再去了。

original: That thing's evil, Lynly! I told you to keep away from there!
traduit: 那东西很邪性，林立！我告诉过你离那儿远点！

original: I think I saw it again. That... ghost. It was over by the barrows.
traduit: 我好些又看到了。那个……鬼。就在古坟旁边。

original: All right, Wilhlem. I suppose it's the least I can do for you.
traduit: 好吧，威尔海姆。我想我至少能为你做这个。

original: I think you play beautifully. It would be a shame if you stopped.
traduit: 我觉得你弹得很好。如果不弹的话，就太可惜了。

original: What's the point? I'm not very good, and it's only for the same few people every night.
traduit: 有什么意义呢？我弹得不太好，而且每晚都是同样的几个人。

original: I think you should continue with your performances.
traduit: 我觉得你应该继续表演。

original: Anything you can tell me about High Hrothgar?
traduit: 你能和我说说霍斯加修道院吗？

original: The Greybeards are a solitary lot. I don't think they've ever ventured outside their monastery.
traduit: 灰胡子们很孤僻。他们可能从来没出过修道院。

original: We get the occasional pilgrim passing through here on their way to the summit, but almost all of them have returned disappointed.
traduit: 偶尔会有朝圣者在登顶的时候路过，但几乎所有人都失望而归了。

original: I've been to the monastery many times, but I've never even laid eyes on one of the Greybeards. Not that I'd care to.
traduit: 我去过修道院很多次，但从没见到过灰胡子。我倒也是不想见。

original: Being masters of the Thu'um, they could kill you by uttering a single word.
traduit: 身为吐'目的宗师，他们杀你只需要一句话。

original: Well, not that they would. They seem peaceful, but I wouldn't want to provoke them.
traduit: 当然他们也不会这么干了，他们看起来很和平，但我不想激怒他们。

original: Klimmek brings food supplies up to them once every few weeks when the weather permits it.
traduit: 只要天气允许，科林麦会每隔几周给他们送一次食物。

original: Other than that, they seem like a quiet lot. Don't really know too much about them.
traduit: 除此之外，他们看起来很安静。不大了解。

original: It's frightening living below their monastery.
traduit: 住在修道院底下很可怕。

original: Sometimes I swear I can hear strange noises rolling down from up there. It sounds like thunder, but there's never any rain.
traduit: 有时候我肯定是听到了奇怪的声音从上面滚下来。听起来像是打雷，可又不下雨。

original: What do you make of that?
traduit: 你觉得呢？

original: The Greybeards stay away from me, and I stay away from them. Suits me just fine.
traduit: 灰胡子离我很远，我也会离他们远点。这样就好。

original: Always thought it was odd that there's a layer of thick clouds covering the peak of the mountain above the monastery.
traduit: 修道院上面还有一层被厚厚的云覆盖的山顶，很奇怪。

original: Not sure what's up there, but I bet the Greybeards know.
traduit: 不管上面有什么，我觉得灰胡子肯定知道。

original: They call the path to the monastery the 7,000 Steps. Can you imagine?
traduit: 他们说通往修道院的台阶有7000级。你能想象到吗？

original: I'm not certain if I could even make it to the top without collapsing from exhaustion.
traduit: 我不确定自己爬上去之后会不会累晕掉。

original: The Greybeards are a strange bunch.
traduit: 灰胡子是群怪人。

original: I heard they live their entire life without uttering a single word; can you even imagine?
traduit: 我听说他们一辈子都不能说话，真的假的？

original: I've always fancied a journey up the 7,000 Steps to the monastery.
traduit: 我一直幻想着能爬一次7000阶梯到修道院去。

original: Anything to break the boredom of living in this town. I envy you.
traduit: 只要能打破这个镇子的无聊就行。我真羡慕你。

original: Welcome to the Bards College. I am the headmaster here. How may I help you?
traduit: 欢迎来到吟游诗人学院。我是这里的校长。有什么事吗？

original: I have faith that you'll return with King Olaf's Verse.
traduit: 我相信你会带着奥拉夫王之诗回来的。

original: Ah, you have returned. How goes the task I gave you?
traduit: 啊，你回来了。我交待的任务怎么样了？

original: I still don't know if rewriting the verse is going to work.
traduit: 我还是不确定这首诗是不是能奏效。

original: I do hope the court likes the verse. I think we've done an excellent job of recreating it.
traduit: 真希望宫廷的人能喜欢这首诗。我觉得咱们修复的不错。

original: We should have the festival soon.
traduit: 我们应该很快就能过节了。

original: Good to meet a prospective Bard.
traduit: 很高兴能见到未来的吟游诗人。

original: Get the coat. Then we'll talk.
traduit: 去拿外套。然后再说。

original: Nice to meet the person who went to King Olaf's Tomb.
traduit: 很高兴见到去过奥拉夫王陵墓的人。

original: That sounds acceptable.
traduit: 听起来还行。

original: Then I think we're done talking.
traduit: 那就说定了。

original: You don't own the horse you already sold to Letrush?
traduit: 你卖给莱特鲁什的马不是你自己的？

original: That is correct. You see, Frost belongs to the Black-Briar estate. Technically everything in the estate is owned by my mother, Maven.
traduit: 没错。寒霜属于黑棘庄园。严格来说，庄园的一切都归我母亲玛雯所有。

original: My plan was to take the horse from our lodge and deliver it to Letrush at the stables. Obviously, that didn't exactly work out as I'd planned...
traduit: 我的计划是把马从我们的旅屋牵出来，在马厩交给莱特鲁什。但很明显，计划赶不上变化。

original: Still, I don't want to cross Letrush. Tell you what. Steal the horse and deliver it, and you can have the second half of the payment.
traduit: 但我还是不想违了和莱特鲁什的约定。这样吧。你把马偷来送过去，钱分你一半。

original: I was sent by Louis Letrush.
traduit: 我是路易士·莱特鲁什派来的。

original: Ah, and let me guess. He wants his horse. Well, that's going to be a bit of a problem. You see, I don't really outright "own" Frost...
traduit: 啊，我来猜猜。他是想要回马吧。这有点麻烦。那个，寒霜并不是归我完全“所有”……

original: Why is Sibbi in jail?
traduit: 西比为什么进监狱了？

original: No idea, but whatever he did it must have angered Maven. No guard would lock up a Black-Briar without the old lady's permission.
traduit: 不知道，但不管他做了什么，肯定是激怒了玛雯。没有那老太太的允许，卫兵可不敢把黑棘家的人关起来。

original: Silence, prisoner!
traduit: 安静点，囚犯！

original: Gaaaaah!!!
traduit: 嘎啊！！！

original: What else do you want from me? I've already told you everything. Listen, if you let me go I can take you to Riften, show you where-
traduit: 你还想从我这儿知道什么？我都告诉你了。你听着，只要放我走，我可以带你去裂谷城，给你带路去……

original: That will be all for now. I must say I continue to be disappointed in your lack of cooperation. I hope next time you will do better.
traduit: 就到这儿吧。我得说一句，我对你不合作的态度感到失望。希望下次你能配合点。

original: Like I said, I don't know! I've seen him down in the Ratway. Maybe he lives down there, but I don't know for sure.
traduit: 我已经说了，我不知道！我只是在鼠道见过他。他住不住那儿我真不清楚。

original: And where can we find this nameless old man?
traduit: 我们到哪儿去找这个无名老人呢？

original: You know the rules. Just answer the questions.
traduit: 你应该知道规矩。回答问题就行。

original: Ahhhh!
traduit: 啊！

original: I don't know his name. Like I've told already a hundred-
traduit: 要我说多少次，我不知道他叫什么。

original: And his name is...?
traduit: 那他叫……？

original: There's an old man. He lives in Riften.
traduit: 有个老头，住在裂谷城。

original: He could be this Esbern you're looking for, but I don't know. He's old and seemed kind of crazy. That's all I know.
traduit: 他可能是你们要找的伊思本，但我不确定。他很老，看上去有点疯疯癫癫的。我就知道这么多。

original: No, wait! I was just... catching my breath... why wouldn't I tell you again? I don't even know anything...
traduit: 不，等下！我只是……有点喘不过气……我不是说了很多次吗？我真的不知道更多了……

original: If you persist in this stubbornness I'll have...
traduit: 既然你嘴这么硬，那我只好……

original: Start at the beginning, as usual.
traduit: 和往常一样，从头开始吧。

original: Noooooo!!!
You know the rules.
traduit: 你知道规矩的。

original: No... for pity's sake... I've already told you everything...
traduit: 不要……可怜可怜我吧……我全说了啊……

original: Let's begin again.
traduit: 我们重新开始吧。

original: Silence. You know the rules. Do not speak unless spoken to. Master Rulindil will ask the questions.
traduit: 安静。你知道规矩。没人问你话就闭上嘴。听鲁林迪尔大师吩咐。

original: Stop. Please. I don't know anything else. Don't you think I'd have told you already?
traduit: 停下。求你了。我要是知道别的，我会瞒着你们吗？

original: I promise. Just a joke I want to play on someone. (Persuade)
traduit: 我保证。我就是想跟别人开个玩笑（说服）

original: Hmm. Very well. I'm putting my reputation on the line for you.
traduit: 嗯。很好。我就冒着丢人现眼的风险信你一次。

original: This is neither the time nor place for such things. I'm surprised you would ask it of me.
traduit: 真是不分时间场合，你居然还会问我这种问题。

original: Don't presume upon our friendship. My first loyalty is to the Thalmor, as you well know.
traduit: 别利用你我的友谊。你要知道我对梭默忠心耿耿。

original: Yes, that's probably for the best. I really shouldn't risk getting on Elenwen's bad side.
traduit: 那再好不过了。我可不想惹出爱琳温恐怖的一面。

original: Yes, this probably isn't really the place for your little jokes.
traduit: 就是。这里哪是你开玩笑的场合。

original: Thank you. I knew you'd understand.
traduit: 感谢理解。

original: I'll try to forget you ever asked.
traduit: 我会试着忘了你的请求。

original: There are those in the Empire who would wish to evade their obligations to help root out the Talos heresy.
traduit: 帝国里的某些人企图逃避协助铲除塔洛斯异端的义务。

original: Fortunately, those most opposed to the Emperor's wise policy have now branded themselves traitors as well as heretics.
traduit: 所幸，那些激烈反对皇帝英明政策的人们，已经给自己打上了叛徒和异教徒的标签。

original: I am here to remind the ruling classes of Skyrim that their loyalty to the Emperor requires cooperation with the Thalmor.
traduit: 我来此是为提醒天际的统治者们，既然忠于皇帝就要和梭默合作。

original: You have asked for my help. I am providing it.
traduit: 你不是需要我帮忙吗。我正在做呢。

original: The degeneracy of the Empire is on display here in this room.
traduit: 帝国的腐朽堕落在此展露无遗。

original: It's only a matter of time before your whole rotten Empire collapses of its own decay. No offense.
traduit: 无意冒犯，但你们那个腐朽的帝国迟早要瓦解。

original: None of these people cares a whit about the religious aspects of this war. Another sign of the degeneracy of your Empire.
traduit: 云集在此的人们对这场战争的宗教性毫不在意。这就是你们帝国堕落的又一标志。

original: At least Ulfric's men are willing to fight for their principles, barbaric as they may be.
traduit: 乌弗瑞克他们好歹愿意为了自己的信念而战。只是有些野蛮。

original: It's a necessary part of my job to mix with the upper classes of Skyrim, such as they are.
traduit: 跟天际的上层人士打交道也是我的职责之一。虽说他们也就那样。

original: To maintain relationships.
traduit: 来巩固关系。

original: By the way, I don't know who you are, but unless you want me to blow your cover, I'd advise that you avoid me for the rest of the party.
traduit: 还有，我不认识你是谁。除非你想被揭穿，否则别在宴会期间打扰我。

original: I'm doing as you asked. Not for nothing, I hope?
traduit: 我在照你说的做。希望不是无缘无故吧？

original: I don't recall seeing you at one of these before. And I know everyone who's anyone in Skyrim.
traduit: 我不记得在这种场合见过你。我认识天际所有算得上人物的人。

original: That's General Tullius himself. He can't stand Elenwen, but she insists that he attend these parties. Just to piss him off, no doubt.
traduit: 那就是图留斯将军了。他受不了爱琳温，但爱琳温却坚持要他参加这些宴会。肯定只是为了惹他生气。

original: See that disgusting drunk over there? A high-ranking official in the East Empire Company, believe it or not.
traduit: 看见那边那个恶心的酒鬼吗？就他还是东帝国公司的高官呢，信不信由你。

original: But... I rather thought that if I were to help, I might... Well, I might be allowed to return to the College.
traduit: 但……我想如果能帮上忙，我可能会……好吧，也许我该回学院了。

original: Are you quite sure? I don't want to get in the way, but...
traduit: 你确定吗？我不会妨碍你的，但……

original: I thought you wanted to get out of there.
traduit: 我以为你想离开那里。

original: Well yes, I did. And thank you so much for helping me.
traduit: 啊，是的，我会的。非常感谢你救了我。

original: I'm not sure where else I'd go.
traduit: 我不知道还能去哪儿。

original: All right, you're safe now.
traduit: 好了，你安全了。

original: Wait, what?
traduit: 等等，什么？

original: I thought I was going to help you!
traduit: 我觉得我能帮上你！

original: We need to go upstairs, that's where she is! That's where the books are!
traduit: 我们得上楼去，她就在那儿！书就在那里放着！

original: No, no! This is the wrong way!
traduit: 不，不！别走错了！

original: Can you make me Blood-Kin?
traduit: 你能让我成为血亲吗？

original: Trust like that is not freely given.
traduit: 这样的信任不是随便能给予的。

original: Gladly. By the Code of Malacath, I name you Blood-Brother to the Orcs.
traduit: 乐意之至。根据玛拉凯斯法典，我将你称为兽人的血亲兄弟。

original: Gladly. By the Code of Malacath, I name you Blood-Sister to the Orcs.
traduit: 乐意之至。根据玛拉凯斯法典，我将你称为兽人的血亲姐妹。

original: Are all the Orc strongholds guarded?
traduit: 兽人的要塞都有守卫吗？

original: The most well known stronghold is Dushnikh Yal. Here, I'll mark it down for you.
traduit: 最著名的就是杜什尼克·亚尔了。来，我给你标在地图上。

original: Where can I find an Orc stronghold?
traduit: 我到哪里能找到兽人要塞？

original: The strongholds keep to themselves. Skyrim hasn't always been kind to the Orcs.
traduit: 这些要塞保持自治自理。天际并不总是善待兽人。

original: For an outsider like you to be accepted, an Orc would have to make you Blood-Kin, and send word to the chiefs.
traduit: 像你这样的外族人想要被接纳，就得有兽人将你视为血亲，然后再给酋长们捎个话。

original: Hjalti? Who are you talking about?
traduit: 亚尔提？你在说谁啊？

original: You promised me, Hjalti. You promised that when we sacked Hroldan, you would make me your sworn brother.
traduit: 你答应过我的，亚尔提。你不是说等咱们打下霍尔丹之后，咱们俩拜把子么。

original: And I've waited. Even after the enemies' arrows dug into my chest and their hammers crushed my bones. I've waited.
traduit: 所以我一直等着。即使敌人的箭射进了我的胸膛，锤子击碎了我的骨头。我还是一直在等着。

original: Give me your sword, Hjalti. That we may become brothers as you promised.
traduit: 把你的剑给我吧，亚尔提。我们可以像你说的那样成为兄弟。

original: As I was saying... You'll need to kill the Gourmet, of course. But what's more, you'll need to get his Writ of Passage, so you can take his place.
traduit: 像我刚才说的……你需要去杀了美食家。但更重要的是，你得拿到他的通行证，这样你才能取代他。

original: Oh, and if you can, hide his body. The longer it takes for anyone else to determine his real identity, the better.
traduit: 哦，要是可以的话，把他的尸体藏起来。他的身份越晚被确认越好。

original: Now off with you!
traduit: 现在就去吧！

original: Hmph. I was wrong about you. I see that now. Maybe we all were.
traduit: 嗯。我看错你了。我现在明白了。也许我们都看错了。

original: Here's your payment. And... a little something else, as well. From me. Consider it my way of apologizing. For being so damned curmudgeonly!
traduit: 这是你的报酬。还有……一点额外的东西。算是我的道歉吧。为我这该死的坏脾气！

original: It's called the Nightweaver's Band. I wore this for years. I want you to have it now. It'll give your magic and sneakiness some much needed "oomph."
traduit: 这东西叫“织夜者指环”，我戴了很多年了。现在就给你吧。它会给你的魔法和潜行能力带来一些急需的“魅力”。

original: Now, you'd better get a move on and see Astrid. It's time! Time for the final stage of this grand and glorious operation.
traduit: 现在，最好赶快去找阿斯垂德。是时候进行这宏伟荣光的行动的最后阶段了。

original: Oh, I'm waiting with bated breath...
traduit: 哦，我屏息以待……

original: Oh course, Festus. Please continue.
traduit: 哦，没问题，菲斯图斯。请继续。

original: I believe so. Therefore, you are to obtain that information from Virane - who the Gourmet really is, and where he can be found.
traduit: 我相信如此。因此，你得从维拉尼那里获取到这些情报，美食家的真正身份还有下落。

original: Oh, and when you're done with Virane, kill him.
traduit: 等和维拉尼谈完以后，就杀了他。

original: Loose ends and all that.
traduit: 琐事需要做干净。

original: Next, you'll have to... Are you still paying attention?
traduit: 接下来，你必须……你在认真听吗？

original: And this Anton Virane knows the Gourmet's true identity?
traduit: 这个安东·维拉尼知道“美食家”的真实身份？

original: You know, maybe I was wrong about you after all. Anyone who's smart enough to shut up and listen can't be all bad.
traduit: 也许我真的看错你了。任何聪明到能闭嘴倾听的人都不会是坏人。

original: In my, um, investigations, I came upon this. It's a copy of the Gourmet's cookbook. Ah, but not just any copy. It's signed you see!
traduit: 我在调查的时候发现了这个。美食家著作，而且不是复制品，上面有签名。你看！

original: Seems to be a message from the Gourmet to one Anton Virane. I've tracked Virane to the keep in Markarth. It would seem he's the cook.
traduit: 看来像是一段美食家发给安东·维拉尼的消息。我已经跟踪维拉尼到了马卡斯城。他很可能就是那名厨师。

original: Ah, indeed I do! Indeed I do!
traduit: 啊，我当然知道！我当然知道！

original: Do you have any idea how I might find out?
traduit: 你知道我该怎么去找吗？

original: DB08FestusIdentityTopic1
traduit: DB08FestusIdentityTopic1

original: Don't be so petulant!
traduit: 别这么气盛！

original: So you don't even know who the Gourmet is? Wonderful.
traduit: 你连谁是美食家都不知道？好极了。

original: Quite so.
traduit: 正是。

original: But first you'll need to learn who he is. Assuming, of course, that the Gourmet actually is a "he." Could be a woman for all we know.
traduit: 但首先你得知道他是谁。当然，前提是美食家真的“他”。是个女的也说不定。

original: That I need to kill him and take on his identity?
traduit: 这么说我得杀了他，然后盗用他的身份？

original: There you are. Took your sweet time dealing with Cicero, hmph? Now let's get down to business. Astrid told you about the Gourmet, I hope?
traduit: 你回来了。处理西塞罗的事很麻烦吧？我们谈正事吧。阿斯垂德和你说过美食家的事了吧？

original: I need you to take a case of mead to the Frozen Hearth in Winterhold. The delivery fee is yours to keep.
traduit: 我要你送一箱蜜酒去冬堡的冻炉旅店。运费归你了。

original: Another case of mead needs to find its way to the Bannered Mare in Whiterun. The delivery fee is yours to keep.
traduit: 另一单蜜酒要送到白漫城的悬旗母马。运费归你。

original: Candlehearth Hall is running low on our famous mead. Can you drop off this case? The gold is yours, as always.
traduit: 我们驰名商标的蜜酒在烛炉堂快要卖完了。能把这箱送去吗？老规矩，钱还归你。

original: I have a case of Frost River Mead for you.
traduit: 我有一箱霜河蜜酒要给你。

original: Ah, good. I've been waiting on that.
traduit: 哦，太好了。我等很久了。

original: Here's the gold for it. Thanks.
traduit: 给你报酬。谢谢了。

original: I can certainly help.
traduit: 我可以帮忙。

original: That'd be great. There's a case of our soon-to-be famous mead that needs to get to Winterhold. Get it there, and you can keep the delivery fee.
traduit: 太好了。我们即将出名的蜜酒有个单子要送到冬堡去。送到那里，运费就是你的了。

original: How's the meadery working out?
traduit: 蜜酒庄的运营如何？

original: It's tough, with just the two of us.
traduit: 就我们两个人很不容易。

original: There's hardly ever time to make the occasional delivery to the taverns of Skyrim.
traduit: 我们都没时间到天际各地送货。

original: We could use a pair of hands and a strong back. There'd be a little coin in it for you.
traduit: 我们需要帮手。当然也会给些小钱当报酬。

original: Indeed I do.
traduit: 确实需要。

original: Need me to deliver any more mead?
traduit: 需要我再帮忙送些蜜酒吗？

original: I've brought the fragment.
traduit: 我把碎片带来了。

original: I'll speak with Aela about how you handled yourself. Come back later.
traduit: 回去之后，我会跟艾拉谈谈你的表现。

original: I'll speak with Farkas about how you handled yourself. Come back later.
traduit: 回去之后，我会跟法卡斯谈谈你的表现。

original: The Festival is back on.
traduit: 节日要回来了。

original: Great. Looks like you'll be one of us soon.  We'll gather outside the College for the Burning of King Olaf.
traduit: 太好了。看来你很快就要加入我们了。咱们在学院外面会合，准备火烧奥拉夫王。

original: I'll tell everyone we're ready but we'll start the festival at dusk.
traduit: 我会告诉大家咱们准备好了，节日在黄昏时分举行。

original: Come talk to me after dark, we'll get the festival started when you do.
traduit: 天黑之后再来找我，到时候我们就可以庆祝节日了。

original: Best batch of Spiced Wine I ever had.
traduit: 这是我喝过最好的一批香料酒。

original: I thought the festival wasn't happening this year.
traduit: 我还以为今年不会过这个节了呢。

original: Thanks for convincing Elisif to put this on again.
traduit: 谢谢你说服了艾利西弗重新举办这个节日。

original: Come on! Light the fire!
traduit: 来吧！点火啊！

original: Jorn is the best of the bunch, you should hear him sing.
traduit: 乔恩是这群人里最好的，你应该听听他的歌。

original: I heard you're the reason we get to have this.  Thank you.
traduit: 我听说你你让我们重新过节的。谢谢。

original: I believe Sanguine would be pleased with this festival.
traduit: 我相信桑吉恩会为这个节日感到高兴。

original: I like the pretty lights.
traduit: 我喜欢漂亮的灯火。

original: Burn the king!
traduit: 烧了那个国王！

original: You've done well by restoring our Festival.
traduit: 你恢复了我们的节日，干得好。

original: Thank you so much. The festival has really increased my sales.
traduit: 非常感谢。这个节日让我销售额涨了不少。

original: There's the man himself!
traduit: 是他本人！

original: There's the woman herself!
traduit: 是她本人！

original: Burn the King!
traduit: 烧了那个国王！

original: Congratulations on getting the festival restored.
traduit: 恭喜你恢复了这个节日。

original: Get your festival meat pie. Specially made.
traduit: 领取你的节日肉馅饼。这是特制的。

original: Try our meats made here at the Festival. They're the best.
traduit: 尝尝我们为节日准备的肉。这是最好的。

original: So nice to get this break from my cleaning duties.
traduit: 能从打扫的工作中解脱出来真是太好了。

original: You might as well have some sweets. I made them for the festival after all.
traduit: 你不妨试试糖果。毕竟这是我为节日特制的。

original: I wish you luck in finding the verse.
traduit: 祝你顺利找回诗歌。

original: We should really get to court.
traduit: 我们该去宫廷了。

original: We should present the verse soon.
traduit: 我们应该马上把诗呈上去。

original: Don't forget to speak to Jorn when you're ready for the festival.
traduit: 你准备节日事宜的时候别忘了去找乔恩谈谈。

original: Be careful, you might find more than just King Olaf's Verse in Dead Man's Respite.
traduit: 小心点，亡者之栖里可不止有奥拉夫王的诗歌。

original: Good luck. You're on your own now.
traduit: 祝你好运。你只能靠自己了。

original: He's got to be here somewhere.
traduit: 他一定在这的某个地方。

original: Silence, traitor! Move. Slowly.
traduit: 闭嘴，叛徒！慢慢走。

original: Never mind, I'm dead already-
traduit: 无所谓，我横竖都是死人了……

original: Surrender immediately or you both die.
traduit: 马上投降，否则立刻击杀你们。

original: Listen up, spy! You're trapped in here, and we have your accomplice.
traduit: 听好了，你个间谍！你已经被困在这儿了，我们知道你有同谋。

original: So... we're done?
traduit: 那……我们说完了？

original: No. Oh, please no...
traduit: 不。哦，不要……

original: I'm afraid not. Loose ends, and all that.
traduit: 恐怕没有。琐事，需要做干净。

original: Okay. All right. Wonderful. You're welcome! I'll just be on my way, then...
traduit: 哦，好吧。太好了。不客气！那我走了……

original: Of course, Anton. Thank you. (Lie)
traduit: 当然，安东。谢谢你。（撒谎）

original: The Dark Brotherhood?
traduit: 黑暗兄弟会？

original: Now... now wait a minute. Let's not get hasty. I mean, surely my friend wouldn't want me to endanger my own life. Right?
traduit: 等……等一下。没必要这么着急。那个，我的朋友肯定不想我拿自己的生命冒险，对吧？

original: Look, his name is Balagog gro-Nolob. He's an Orc! The Gourmet's an Orc! He's staying at the Nightgate Inn. That's all I know!
traduit: 那个，他叫巴拉果戈·格洛-诺洛波。是个兽人！美食家是个兽人！住在夜扉旅店。我就知道这么多！

original: Now... now you'll let me go. Right?
traduit: 现在……你能放我走了。对吧？

original: For the Dark Brotherhood, that can be easily arranged. (Intimidate)
traduit: 对于黑暗兄弟会来说，那再容易不过了。（恐吓）

original: The... the Gourmet?
traduit: 美……食家？

original: Never! I don't know what led you here, but nothing will betray my trust. I'll take the secret of the Gourmet's identity to my grave.
traduit: 不！我不知道你为什么来这里，但我不能背叛别人对我的信任。我死也不会告诉你美食家的身份。

original: The Gourmet. Who is he? Where is he?
traduit: 美食家是谁？他在哪儿？

original: Ah yes, High Rock. Home of exquisite Breton cuisine...
traduit: 哎，对。高岩。精致布莱顿美食的家乡。

original: I know who you are, Anton. And where you're from.
traduit: 安东，我知道你是谁，也知道你来自哪里。

original: Yes, yes, for the hundredth time, I am a Breton. I was born in High Rock. And then I came here. I am not a Reachman!
traduit: 对，对，我说了多少次了，我是布莱顿人。出生在高岩。然后才来的这里。不是瑞驰人！

original: Please. Please just let me be...
traduit: 求你。求你让我……

original: Mara have mercy that gave me a fright.
traduit: 玛拉在上，真是吓我一跳。

original: Do you think the ghost is one of... Tiber Septim's dead men?
traduit: 你觉不觉得这鬼魂是……泰伯·塞普汀死去的一个部下？

original: All of a sudden, the ghost disappeared. What happened to it?
traduit: 鬼魂怎么突然消失了。怎么回事？

original: Do you think that ghost is coming back? It seems to have vanished.
traduit: 那个鬼魂还会回来吗？它似乎消失了。

original: I was just getting used to that ghost being here, and poof, now he's gone.
traduit: 我刚习惯了那个鬼魂在这儿，他就突然不见了。

original: Hjalti? Is that you? I've been waiting.
traduit: 亚尔提？是你吗？我一直在等你。

original: I've been waiting for you. Hjalti.
traduit: 我一直在等你。亚尔提。

original: I fought by your side. To take back the Reach from the savages.
traduit: 我和你并肩作战。从蛮子手里夺回了瑞驰。

original: Do you remember me now, Hjalti?
traduit: 你还记得我吗，亚尔提？

original: I have Hjalti's sword.
traduit: 我拿到了亚尔提的剑。

original: It's been an honor to serve you, brother.
traduit: 为你效劳是我的荣幸，兄弟。

original: Remembers our lessons from the sword masters of Alcaire? Let me show you a few things you may have forgotten before we leave Hroldan.
traduit: 还记得咱们在阿尔凯瑞的剑术大师那儿学的东西吗？在我们离开霍尔丹之前，我给你看看你可能忘记的东西吧。

original: The ghost is looking for his sword.
traduit: 那个鬼魂在找他的剑。

original: A sword? I remember a legend that Tiber Septim had attacked one of the enemy camps before he came to Old Hroldan. It could be there.
traduit: 剑？我记得有个传说，说泰伯·塞普汀在抵达古霍尔丹前曾经攻打过敌人的一个营地，它可能在那儿。

original: I'll mark it down on your map.
traduit: 我在你地图上标出来。

original: The ghost mentioned a "Hjalti."
traduit: 那个鬼魂提到了“亚尔提”。

original: Hjalti? I've never heard of anyone named Hjalti. Tiber Septim had many names. Maybe that's one of them?
traduit: 亚尔提？我从没听说过叫亚尔提的人。泰伯·塞普汀有很多名字。也许是其中一个？

original: I heard screaming.
traduit: 我听到了尖叫声。

original: There's a... ghost. Just wandering around my inn like it owned the place.
traduit: 有……有鬼。在我的旅店里转来转去，就跟是这里的主人一样。

original: Yes. I've heard stories that Old Hroldan was haunted, but no ones seen a ghost here since the Great War.
traduit: 没错。我听说过古霍尔丹闹鬼的故事，但自从浩大战争以来就没人见过。

original: He's from the battle, I just know it. He's one of Tiber Septim's soldiers... back from the dead.
traduit: 他应该是来自战场的，我知道。他是泰伯·塞普汀的士兵……死而复生了。

original: You said you saw a ghost?
traduit: 你说你见鬼了？

original: (screams)
traduit: （尖叫）

original: Look. I gave you a contract, and you completed it. Barely. Now let's go back to you being insufferable, and me being... me.
traduit: 那个。我把契约给了你，而你勉勉强强完成了。你实在令人难以忍受，而我……还是我。

original: You would expect any less from the Listener?
traduit: 你对聆听者不抱期待吗？

original: All I've ever wanted to do is serve this Sanctuary.
traduit: 我一直以来只为这个圣所服务。

original: So I gathered. It seems a certain Orc has disappeared. Which means you not only killed the Gourmet, but disposed of the body as well.
traduit: 根据我得到的消息。有个兽人好像失踪了。也就是说你不仅杀了美食家，还把尸体处理好了。

original: You've got the Writ of Passage too, I see. Splendid, splendid...
traduit: 我看你还拿到了通行证。甚好，甚好。

original: Ah, and word has come in from Markarth that the keep's cook has met an untimely demise.
traduit: 啊，还有来自马卡斯的消息，城堡里的厨师不幸离世。

original: You performed your duties to the letter.
traduit: 你完全履行了职责。

original: Dead.
traduit: 死了。

original: Right, which we had already established. And you managed to hide the body as well? Good.
traduit: 嗯，我们已经确认了。你还把尸体藏起来了吧？干得好。

original: You've got the Writ of Passage too, I see. So there's that. And Anton Virane has suffered an untimely fate, as well. Good.
traduit: 我看你还拿到了通行证。安东·维拉尼也惨遭不幸。好。

original: Well, looks like you completed the contract as directed. Finally. A little sloppy, but, well... done is done.
traduit: 好吧，看来你按要求完成了契约。就是有点草率，不过……过去的就过去吧。

original: Here's your gold, with a little extra for hiding the body. Now go see Astrid. The final stage of the contract has come. The Emperor must fall.
traduit: 这是你的金子，藏好尸体还有额外报酬。现在去找阿斯垂德吧。契约已经到了最后一步。皇帝必死无疑。

original: Good. And his Writ of Passage?
traduit: 好。他的通行证呢？

original: Oh wait, let me guess - you don't have them.
traduit: 哦，等等，让我猜猜，你没拿到吧。

original: Fool! Amateur! Without those papers you'll never be able to present yourself as the Gourmet! Off with you! Back to the body to retrieve them!
traduit: 笨蛋！外行！没有那些文件你怎么把自己伪装成美食家！赶紧去尸体上拿回来！

original: Good, good. And you've got the Writ of Passage too, I see, so that's done.
traduit: 好，好。我看见你拿到通行证了。那就算办成了。

original: But why? Why, pray tell, have I received word that Anton Virane is still walking around Markarth, hale and healthy as the day he was born?
traduit: 但是为什么？请问我为什么得到消息说安东·维拉尼还在马卡斯活蹦乱跳，就和他刚出生时一样健康？

original: Back to Markarth with you! Virane must be silenced! He's a potential witness, you witless dagger jabber!
traduit: 回马卡斯！维拉尼必须闭嘴！他是潜在的目击证人，你个呆子！

original: Good, good. And you've got the Writ of Passage, too, I see. So there's that.
traduit: 很好。我看你拿到通行证了。那事情就算办成了。

original: I've also received word from Markarth. It would seem Anton Virane has suffered an untimely fate, as well. Good.
traduit: 我也收到马卡斯传来的消息，看来安东·维拉尼也身遭不测了。很好。

original: But unfortunately, that inn is abuzz with the news of somebody killing one of their guests! What, hiding the body was too much for you to handle?
traduit: 但不幸的是，旅馆里正充斥着客人被杀的消息！怎么，把尸体藏起来有这么难吗？

original: Bah! Useless. Here's your gold. Now go see Astrid. The time to move against the Emperor has finally come. Sithis help us all.
traduit: 呸！真没用。这是你的金币。现在去找阿斯垂德。对抗皇帝的时刻到来了。西帝斯庇佑我们所有人。

original: Remember, the Markarth Keep. That's where you'll find Anton Virane. Probably cooking up all of the Gourmet's recipes, passing them off as his own.
traduit: 记住，在马卡斯要塞。去那里找安东·维拉尼。他可能正在照着美食家的食谱做菜，然后冒充成自己的成果。

original: All you've got to do is find and kill one lousy chef. The clock is ticking...
traduit: 你要做的就是找到并杀掉一个差劲的厨师。时间不等人哦……

original: So, the prodigal murderer returns. And the Gourmet?
traduit: 啊，浪荡刺客回来了。美食家怎么样了？

original: Ah, you're back. Ready to try again, are we? Let's start from the top. You were sent to kill the Gourmet. And he is...
traduit: 啊，回来了。准备好再试一次了吗？我们从头开始吧。你是被派去杀美食家的。他是……

original: On second thought, I'll walk.
traduit: 想了想，我还是走着走吧。

original: Don't blame me if your feet get sore.
traduit: 脚酸了别赖我啊。

original: Then stop wastin' my time.
traduit: 那就别来浪费我的时间。

original: Off with ya then. I've got work to do.
traduit: 那就去吧。我还有工作。

original: Didn't think you had the coin for it anyway.
traduit: 我还以为你是没钱买呢。

original: Then off with ya. I've got better things to do.
traduit: 那你就请吧。我还有更重要的事要做。

original: Should have known you'd be a cheap one.
traduit: 早就该知道你是个抠门的。

original: Then what are you wasting my time for?
traduit: 所以干嘛浪费我的时间？

original: Walkin' never hurt nobody. If you change your mind, I'll be here.
traduit: 走路不会伤害任何人，但如果改主意了，随时回来找我。

original: Oh. Was it something I said? I can't afford to lower the price, but come back if you change your mind.
traduit: 哦。是因为我说了什么吗？我不能降价了，但如果你改主意了，请随时回来。

original: Here's my offer... (<Global=Horsecost> gold)
traduit: 这是我的报价……（<Global=Horsecost>金币）

original: You've got a deal. It's the one with the saddle.
traduit: 成交。带马鞍的那个归你了。

original: Then come back when you've got that much.
traduit: 等你有更多钱再来吧。

original: That'll do. She's all saddled up for you.
traduit: 成交了。她已经准备好归你了。

original: When you get it, she's yours.
traduit: 等你凑够钱，她就是你的了。

original: Sounds fair. She's yours. Like I said, she's all saddled.
traduit: 听起来不错。她归你了。就像我说的，她很能负重的。

original: When you got that much, we'll talk.
traduit: 等你有那么多钱的时候再谈吧。

original: Fair enough. You can have her. She's the one with the saddle.
traduit: 够公平。你可以拥有她了。那个有马鞍的就是。

original: Didn't think you had the coin.
traduit: 我看你没那么多钱。

original: That's your best offer? I suppose so. She's the one with the saddle.
traduit: 这是你最好的报价吗？我看还行。有马鞍那个归你了。

original: If you had it, you'd be riding and we wouldn't be talking.
traduit: 如果你有那么多，马就归你，咱们也没那么多话了。

original: That much? I mean, of course. If that's all you've got.
traduit: 这么多？我是说，没问题。如果你有这么多的话。

original: I'd sell her for that, but you ain't got it.
traduit: 我愿意把她卖这个价，可惜你没有那么多。

original: Sold. She's all yours. She's already saddled up.
traduit: 成交。她的一切都归你了。她已经准备好了。

original: That would work, except you ain't got.
traduit: 价格还行，就是你没那么多啊。

original: Wish everyone haggled like you. She's all yours.
traduit: 希望每个人都能像你一样出价。她归你了。

original: Too bad you don't have that much. Guess you'll have to walk.
traduit: 可惜你没那么多钱。您还是腿儿着走吧。

original: Good enough for me. It's the one with the saddle.
traduit: 对我来说足够了。有马鞍的那个就是。

original: That would be a fair price. When you've got it, come see me.
traduit: 价格合理。等你凑够了再来吧。

original: Wow! Didn't think I could get that for her. I mean, sure!
traduit: 我！没想到我还能把她卖到这个价。我是说，没问题！

original: Looks like you're a little short on coin though. Sorry.
traduit: 不过看起来你好像有点钱紧啊。抱歉了。

original: Can I buy a horse?
traduit: 我能买匹马吗？

original: Suppose so. Got one all saddled if you've got the coin.
traduit: 可以啊。只要有钱，马就归你了。

original: Not today. Sold my last one. Pretty sure I sold it to you.
traduit: 今天不行了。我最后一匹已经卖出去了。而且还是卖给你。

original: Yeah, I got one for sale.
traduit: 可以，我这里有一匹可以买。

original: You could if I had one. Sold my last available horse to someone that looked an awful lot like you.
traduit: 如果我还有的话，倒是能买。但最后一匹我卖给了一个跟你长得特别像的人。

original: Got one all saddled and ready to go. What are you willing to pay?
traduit: 马鞍备好了，随时准备出发。你愿意出多少钱？

original: If I had one. Sold my last one to you a bit ago.
traduit: 如果我还有的话。最后一匹卖给你了。

original: Reckon you can. How much you willing to pay?
traduit: 当然可以。你出多少钱？

original: Nope. Sold my last one to some stranger.
traduit: 不行。最后一个卖给个不认识的了。

original: It's for sale, if you've got the coin.
traduit: 只要你有钱的话。当然没问题。

original: Not right now. You bought my last one.
traduit: 现在不行。最后一个已经被你买走了。

original: That one with the saddle? How much are you offering?
traduit: 那个配了马鞍的？你愿意出多少？

original: Can't help you. They're all spoken for.
traduit: 帮不了你了。它们都有买主了。

original: Don't mind if you do. What's your price?
traduit: 当然可以。你出多少？

original: If I had one you could. They're all spoken for.
traduit: 如果有的话当然卖你。但它们都有买主了。

original: I've got one all saddled up for you! What do you figure she's worth?
traduit: 我已经帮你准备好了！你觉得她值多少钱？

original: Wish I did, but some outlander bought my last one.
traduit: 我也想，但上一匹被个外地人买走了。

original: That's what I'm here for. What are you offering?
traduit: 这就是我为什么在这儿啊。你能出多少？

original: Don't have any that are for sale right now.
traduit: 现在没有可以出售的。

original: Yes! Yes, you can. She's all saddled up and everything.
traduit: 可以！当然可以。她已经准备好了一切。

original: Not today. You should have come by earlier. Wait, didn't I sell me last one to you?
traduit: 现在不行。你该早点来的。等等，我上一匹不是卖给你了吗？

original: I have your frost salts.
traduit: 我拿到你要的霜盐了。

original: Well, well, you actually did what you said you were going to do. I'm impressed.
traduit: 好吧，好吧，你真的说到做到了。令人印象深刻。

original: Here, let me teach you a thing or two about Alteration magic. It's the least I can do.
traduit: 来，我教你一两手变化系魔法。这也是我应该做的。

original: It's not any of your bother, so I don't see what you're apologizing for.
traduit: 本来也不关你的事，不必道歉。

original: I could find those frost salts for you.
traduit: 我可以给你找霜盐。

original: If you want to go to the trouble, feel free. I suppose I could offer you a bit of free Alteration training when you get back.
traduit: 如果你想自找麻烦，那就请便吧。你回来的时候我可以免费给你进行些变化系魔法的训练。

original: What do you do in Kynesgrove?
traduit: 你在凯娜之林做什么？

original: Nosy one, huh? I was a mage back in Morrowind. I lend my talents to the mines here, helping them keep the tunnels safe.
traduit: 很爱问闲事吗？我在晨风的时候也是个法师。我把自己的能力用在这里的矿场上，帮他们维持矿道的安全。

original: By Azura, it gets hot in there. I use Frost Salts for a potion to keep the heat bearable, but I'm out.
traduit: 阿祖拉在上，那里面太热了。我要用霜盐来制作药水缓解高温，但我现在没有了。

original: Yes. I'm sure he's doing well there.
traduit: 是的。我相信他在那儿干的很好。

original: Last time you said he was fighting for the Empire.
traduit: 上次你还说他是为帝国而战的。

original: He's off fighting the war, dear. For the Stormcloaks.
traduit: 他去打仗了，孩子。为了风暴斗篷。

original: Mama, where did papa go?
traduit: 妈妈，爸爸去哪儿了？

original: I did. Those mead stains are always tricky.
traduit: 洗了。那些蜜酒酒渍很难洗。

original: Did you clean the linens, yet?
traduit: 床单洗干净了吗？

original: I'd like to collect my earnings.
traduit: 我想要我的报酬。

original: Here's your pay. It's never enough for what we do, but war gives us warriors its own kind of benefits, doesn't it?
traduit: 这是你的报酬。这点钱不足以酬劳我们的付出，但战争总得给我们的战士创造些好处，不是吗？

original: Are you sure? It's rightfully yours, but this money could go to getting better weapons and armor, and making repairs to the settlements we control.
traduit: 你确定吗？这确实是你赢得的。但这笔前可以买更好的武器盔甲，修缮我们控制的聚落。

original: I saw guards dragging bodies over here. Might be a way out.
traduit: 我看到过卫兵从这把尸体拖走。或许是条出路。

original: We've got to get out of here.
traduit: 我们得离开这儿。

original: You saved my life. I won't forget it. Look me up if you're ever in Riften.
traduit: 你救了我。我不会忘了的。有机会可以来裂谷城找我。

original: You didn't have to help me, so... thanks.
traduit: 你本没必要救我的，真的……太感谢了。

original: Now the Thalmor will be hunting me for the rest of my life. I hope it was worth it.
traduit: 现在我下半辈子都得被梭默追杀了。希望我做得值。

original: I should have known this would end badly. I can't believe I let Delphine talk me into this.
traduit: 我早该知道结局不好。真不敢相信我居然被戴尔芬给说服了。

original: Let's get out of here, for pity's sake!
traduit: 发发慈悲赶紧离开这里吧！

original: Trust me, we have nothing to say to one another.
traduit: 我觉得我们之间没什么好说的。

original: Use your Unrelenting Force shout to strike the targets as they appear.
traduit: 当目标出现后，用冷酷之力去攻击他。

original: Please, sir, leave me alone!
traduit: 求您了，先生，放过我吧！

original: Don't you dare walk away from me, you slut! Do you know who I am?
traduit: 贱人，你敢无视我！你知道我是谁吗？

original: No, I'm sorry, but I can't go anywhere with you. I won't. Please, I must get back to my duties.
traduit: 不，对不起，我不能跟您去。求你了，我得回去工作。

original: Oh, I don't think so. I think I understand perfectly. Don't worry, my dear, I will make any necessary excuses to your employer.
traduit: 啊，我不这么想。我能理解。亲爱的别担心。我会向你雇主解释的。

original: Oh, don't worry. I'll let you make it up to me. Now, where can we go for a little privacy, hmm?
traduit: 哦，别担心。你有机会补偿我。咱们去找点私密空间吧？

original: What? I'm sorry, sir, but you must have misunderstood. I'm not permitted to leave the party.
traduit: 什么？对不起先生。您一定误会了。我不能擅自离开宴会。

original: I'm sorry, sir. I didn't mean to give you the wrong impression earlier. I meant no disrespect.
traduit: 对不起，先生。我不是有意的。我没有不敬的意思。

original: Hello, my dear. I got your message. Where shall we go?
traduit: 你好啊，亲爱的。我受到你的消息了。咱们去哪儿啊？

original: So. You think you can toy with me, is that it? No, my dear. I have my heart set on you, and I always get what I want.
traduit: 你觉得你能耍笑我，是吗？不，小宝贝儿。我是一心要你的，而且我总能把想要的东西拿到手。

original: Yes. She said she can sneak you up to her quarters right now.
traduit: 没错。她说她可以带你偷偷去她住处。

original: Haha. I knew it! No woman yet born has been able to resist my charms for long. Thank you, my friend. I owe you one.
traduit: 哈哈。我就知道！没有女人可以一直抵抗我的魅力。多谢了朋友。我欠你个人情。

original: Not yet. These things can't be rushed.
traduit: 还没有。这种事儿不能急。

original: Ha. Don't toy with me. I may just have to seize my opportunity with both hands, ha ha ha. But we'll play it your way for now.
traduit: 哈。别耍我。我得抓住机会啊，哈哈哈。但现在还是按你的方法来吧。

original: Don't worry. She's all yours.
traduit: 别担心。她肯定是你的。

original: Ha. We'll see. I do have my eye on her, but she seemed a bit cold when I spoke to her earlier. Maybe just playing hard to get, eh?
traduit: 哈。咱们看着吧。我确实注意到她了，不过刚才跟她搭讪的时候，她有点冷淡。也许是个欲迎还拒的把戏，对吧？

original: Maybe I can talk to her for you. See if she's interested.
traduit: 也许我能帮你跟她谈谈。看看她有没有兴趣。

original: Really? Yes, maybe that would be just the thing. She seemed to be playing hard to get when I spoke to her earlier.
traduit: 真的？嗯，那应该合适。我刚才跟她搭讪，她似乎装作一副难以接近的样子。

original: Go on. See what she says. Now you've gone and gotten my hopes up again.
traduit: 去吧。看看她说什么。你赶快去，我的希望又点燃了。

original: I saw you eyeing that serving girl.
traduit: 我看你一直盯着那个女侍者看。

original: Mmm, yes... Brelas, is that the one? I hope you're not thinking of cutting me out, are you? Haha.
traduit: 呃，是……那个叫布莱拉丝的吧？你不是来抢我目标的吧？哈哈哈。

original: I'm warning you, when I get my heart set on something I'm not easily put off.
traduit: 我警告你，我要是打定主意要什么，就不会轻易放弃。

original: You must be new to Skyrim, or you'd already know who I am. I have a stake in most anything of importance in Solitude.
traduit: 你刚来天际吧，不然怎么会不知道我。独孤城的重要事务都与我有关。

original: I feel that it's time to put aside the grievances of the past, and let peace and prosperity flourish between the Empire and the Aldmeri Dominion.
traduit: 我想现在应该放下过去的恩怨，让帝国和先祖神洲共迎和平繁荣了。

original: I try to do my little part. Besides, just between you and me, it's making me pots of money, hahaha.
traduit: 我尽力做好分内的小事。另外，悄悄告诉你，我可是从中赚了不少钱呢，哈哈哈。

original: Have you talked to Brelas yet? I'm not a patient man, you know.
traduit: 你跟布莱拉丝谈过了吗？我可没什么耐心。

original: Did you see that serving girl? I hear elf women are insatiable...
traduit: 你看见那个女侍者了吗？我听说精灵女性可是很饥渴的……

original: For the man who knows how to make money, war can be a most profitable venture.
traduit: 对于有商业头脑的人而言，战争就是最赚钱的买卖了。

original: The Great War is long past. It's time the Empire and the Aldmeri Dominion put aside their differences. Prosperity is good for everyone.
traduit: 浩大战争早过去了。帝国和先祖神洲是时候放下分歧了。繁荣发展对每个人都有好处的。

original: Elenwen always throws quite a party. I never miss one if I can help it.
traduit: 爱琳温举办宴会很有一套。只要能来我绝不错过。

original: Oh... not at the moment. Maybe later. Don't go far.
traduit: 哦……目前没有，晚点可能有，别走太远。

original: Um, thank you. Sir. Was there anything else I can do for you?
traduit: 嗯。谢谢您，先生。您还有别的吩咐吗？

original: No, no, that's not what I'm interested in right now.
traduit: 不必，不必。我现在对那些没兴趣。

original: I just wanted to get a better look at you. I like what I see, my dear.
traduit: 我只想好好看看你。我喜欢看你这个小宝贝。

original: And believe me, I don't say that to everyone. I'm very discriminating when it comes to the female form.
traduit: 实话跟你说，我可不是见谁都这么夸。我挑女人的眼光可是很高的。

original: Uh, Brelas, sir. Did you need a drink? Something to eat?
traduit: 呃，我叫布莱拉丝，先生。您想喝点什么吗？还是吃点什么？

original: You there! Serving girl! What's your name, dear?
traduit: 你在那啊！小女仆！宝贝儿，你叫什么名字啊？

original: There's a likely-looking filly. Even if she is an elf.
traduit: 真是个相貌喜人的小姑娘。虽然是个精灵。

original: That fellow over there asked me to talk to you...
traduit: 那边那个人要我跟你聊聊……

original: Ugh. Erikur, right? He was talking to me earlier. I could tell what he was after.
traduit: 啊，是艾瑞库尔吧？他刚才跟我谈过。我知道他想干嘛。

original: I hate working these parties. Some of the guests are nice, but there's always a few like Erikur.
traduit: 我讨厌在宴会上工作。虽然很多客人都很好，但总会有几个像艾瑞库尔这样的。

original: Please tell him to leave me alone. Politely. I'm sure you'll have better luck getting through to him than I would.
traduit: 请礼貌点转告他离我远点。我觉得你说会比我好些。

original: I hope you're enjoying yourself, sir.
traduit: 希望您玩得愉快，先生。

original: I hope you're enjoying yourself, ma'am.
traduit: 希望您玩得愉快，女士。

original: I trust that this is just the begining of a long and mutually beneficial relationship.
traduit: 我想这是长久互利关系的开端。

original: I'm so glad you could attend today.
traduit: 很高兴您今天能来。

original: I hope you're enjoying yourself.
traduit: 请享受宴会。

original: Please, help yourself to more wine.
traduit: 请尽兴品酒。

original: The hospitality of the Thalmor Embassy is at your service.
traduit: 梭默大使馆热情为您服务。

original: Well, I'm glad that little unpleasantness is over.
traduit: 很好。小不愉快总算过去了。

original: Sir, you must tell her! You don't know what they'll do to me! Please!
traduit: 先生，请您为我作证！您不知道他们会对我做什么！求您了！

original: Mistress Elenwen, it's not true! I did nothing!
traduit: 爱琳温夫人，这不是真的！我什么都没做！

original: Well. Whatever the truth of it, I'm sure a few words with Master Rulindil will have a salutary effect. Take her downstairs.
traduit: 也罢，不管真相如何，相信跟鲁林迪尔大师谈上几句，定能让她受益匪浅。带她下去。

original: Is that so, Erikur? And you with such delicate sensibilities. It must have been most upsetting.
traduit: 当真吗，艾瑞库尔？你如此敏感细腻，想来一定是深受打击了。

original: I demand that you have this wench removed from my presence at once!
traduit: 我命令你立刻把这个贱人从我眼前撵走！

original: Elenwen! This servant girl has been throwing herself at me in a most disgusting manner.
traduit: 爱琳温！这个女仆一直在向我投怀送抱。太恶心了！

original: Now you're going to be sorry you crossed me.
traduit: 你很快就会后悔跟我作对的。

original: Any suggestions as to how I find them?
traduit: 有什么办法能找到他们吗？

original: I heard one of them was just arrested trying to sneak into the city. If he's locked up in the jail, perhaps you can get it out of him.
traduit: 我听说他们中的一个刚刚因为企图偷入城镇被捕了。如果他还被关在监狱里，也许你能从他嘴里套出来。

original: Please, I know I'm asking you to do something difficult, maybe even dangerous. I just don't know who else I can trust.
traduit: 拜托，我知道是在为难你，甚至很危险。我只是不知道该相信谁。

original: You've seen them? Then waste no time, head there at once!
traduit: 你见过他们了？那就别浪费时间了，赶紧去！

original: The longer they're around, the more danger I'm in! Please, kill Kematu and end this nightmare for me!
traduit: 他们在我身边待得越久，我就越危险！求求你了，杀了凯马图，结束我的噩梦！

original: I've run across these Alik'r before. I know where they're hiding.
traduit: 我之前见过这些阿里克'尔。我知道他们藏在哪里。

original: If you're getting involved in this, that'd be where you start looking.
traduit: 你要是想掺和这事儿，就得从那儿开始查起。

original: Why is this suddenly so important, anyway?
traduit: 为什么这事突然变得这么重要了？

original: Last I heard he intended to pass through Eastmarch on his way here.
traduit: 我上次听说他打算从东陲那边过来。

original: Last I'd heard, he was crossing the border from Morrowind into The Rift.
traduit: 我上次听说他打算从晨风穿越边境到裂痕。

original: Where's the courier?
traduit: 信使呢？

original: I don't know. Are you not listening at all?
traduit: 不知道。你没听么？

original: It was a simple task, so I didn't keep close tabs on it like I do with the dangerous stuff.
traduit: 这是个简单的任务，所以我没像处理危险品那样密切关注。

original: What is it Arniel wanted you to get?
traduit: 阿内尔想要你拿什么？

original: I don't know. He never told me.
traduit: 不知道。他没告诉我。

original: He made most of the arrangements himself, he just needed it transported from Morrowind. That's what I agreed to help with.
traduit: 东西是他自己联系的，只是想要找人从晨风运过来。我也只承应了这件事。

original: If I'd known it was so important to him, I'd have charged him more.
traduit: 如果我知道这对他这么重要，我就该多收点钱。

original: Didn't you tell Enthir this was valuable?
traduit: 你没告诉恩希尔这东西很贵重吗？

original: Have you lost your mind?
traduit: 你疯了吧？

original: Think, please, just for a moment, about what he would do if he knew its true value.
traduit: 拜托你动动脑子，想想看，要是他知道那东西的真正价值，他会怎么做？

original: Do you really believe he would honor our agreement, or go running off to the highest bidder?
traduit: 你觉得他会遵守协议，还是跑去找出价最高的人？

original: Please, you must set this right. I'm begging you.
traduit: 拜托，请一定确保它无事。求你了。

original: What is this thing that's so important?
traduit: 到底是什么东西这么重要？

original: It... It's very valuable. Critical to my work, and one-of-a-kind. That's all I care to say for now.
traduit: 它……非常珍贵。对我的工作至关重要，而且独一无二。我只能这么说了。

original: It can't be lost. It just can't! It's irreplaceable, do you understand?
traduit: 不能丢失。绝不能！不可替代啊，明白吗？

original: Without it, I cannot finish my work. All these years, so much time, so much energy...
traduit: 没了它，我就无法完成研究。这么多年，多少时间，多少精力……

original: You must find it! It cannot end this way! Not after I've worked so hard!
traduit: 你一定要找到！不能就这么结束！不能让我的努力付之东流！

original: The courier never arrived with it.
traduit: 信使一直没送来。

original: He has some simple-minded courier delivering it?
traduit: 他是找了个傻子来送吗？

original: It left Morrowind, but never arrived here.
traduit: 货离开晨风了，但没送到。

original: No, no no no. This can't be happening.
traduit: 不，不不不。不可能。

original: Enthir really doesn't have whatever it is you asked him for.
traduit: 恩希尔真没你要的东西。

original: I... I don't understand. Where is it?
traduit: 我……不明白。它在哪儿？

original: You're not listening to me. I don't have it.
traduit: 你没听我说吗，我没拿到那东西。

original: I set up the whole deal. A courier was supposed to be bringing it from Morrowind. He never arrived.
traduit: 整笔交易都是我在张罗，本该有个信使从晨风把东西送过来，可他一直没到。

original: Okay? The deal was already done, the thing just never showed up. I can't help that!
traduit: 明白了？交易已经达成了，但东西一直没到。我有什么办法！

original: I'm not running any more errands for you.
traduit: 我不会再帮你跑腿了。

original: Did I ask you to? Did you hear me say that?
traduit: 我让你去了吗？你没听到我说的吗？

original: What sort of "payment" do you expect this time?
traduit: 这次你又希望，怎么“付款”？

original: Nothing, nothing at all! Arniel already overpaid for... whatever it is.
traduit: 不要！我什么都不要！阿内尔已经付得够多了，就为了那……谁知道是个啥玩意儿。

original: You're holding out on Arniel again.
traduit: 你又在阻挠阿内尔了。

original: Oh, by the Divines, you too?
traduit: 哦，圣灵啊，怎么你也这么说？

original: I've already told him. I don't have it!
traduit: 我已经告诉过他，我没有！

original: What do you want me to say to Enthir?
traduit: 你想让我和恩希尔说什么？

original: I don't know, I don't know!
traduit: 我不知道，不知道！

original: I've already agreed to pay him quite handsomely for the... well, the item in question.
traduit: 我已经同意给他一大笔钱了……结果东西就出问题了。

original: Just... Do whatever it takes to get him to stop lording this over me.
traduit: 只是……不管怎样不要让他再阻挠我了。

original: Have you unraveled the mystery of the dwarves yet?
traduit: 你解开矮人的谜团了吗？

original: No, and at this rate, I never shall!
traduit: 不，照这速度，永远不会了！

original: Enthir is once again holding out on me. He refuses to deliver yet another item absolutely essential to my work!
traduit: 恩希尔又在瞒着我。他又一次拒送一件对我研究至关重要的东西！

original: I am close, so close! You must force him to see reason!
traduit: 明明快了，明明快了！你得赶紧让他明白这个道理！

original: Teach me your spell, and I'll see what I can do.
traduit: 把法术教给我吧，看看我能做些什么。

original: Wonderful, just wonderful! I knew I could count on you!
traduit: 好，太好了！我就知道你靠得住！

original: Now this spell is not for defending yourself, but it's just right for heating the Convector. At least three seconds' burn is necessary.
traduit: 这个法术虽然不能用来自卫，但用来加热环流器刚刚好。记得至少要加热三秒钟。

original: Just place the soul gem inside, and heat the Convector. At least three seconds. You'll almost certainly need to find multiple Convectors.
traduit: 只需要把灵魂石放进去，加热环流器至少三秒。你多半得找好几台环流器才行。

original: I suspect it may be due to the nature of the soul gem versus the crystals this was intended for. Destroys the equipment in the process.
traduit: 我推测这可能是因为灵魂石的特性，与装置原本适配的晶体不同，所以会破坏装置。

original: But, ahh... It's effective. Three times, and the crystal should be ready for the next step. Isn't this exciting?
traduit: 但是，啊……肯定有效。三次，加热三次水晶就可以进入下一步了。很兴奋吧？

original: What's in this for me?
traduit: 这对我有什么好处？

original: Well, I... Don't you see?
traduit: 啊，你……你不明白吗？

original: Unlocking this mystery... The story alone is worth more riches than you can even imagine.
traduit: 解开谜题……解开这个故事本身的价值就超乎你的想象。

original: And perhaps... well, I don't wish to speculate, but... What if we could contact the dwarves? What if they're still out there? Imagine!
traduit: 也许……哎，我也不想瞎猜，但……如果我们能联系上矮人呢？如果他们还在某个地方活着呢？想想吧！

original: Well, yes. The designs for my Convector were based on real dwarven machines, so there may still be some in existence.
traduit: 嗯，是的。我的环流器设计是基于真正的矮人仪器，所以应该还有残存的。

original: I'd go looking myself, but uhh... Yes, there are calculations to double- and triple-check. Many calculations.
traduit: 我想亲自去找找看，但……计算是需要反复检查的。计算量太大了。

original: Perhaps you could seek out these Convectors in Skyrim ruins? I can even teach you the spell to heat them.
traduit: 你也许能帮忙在天际的遗迹里找找环流器？我可以教你加热它们的法术。

original: It's very particular, and very important.
traduit: 这非常特别，也十分重要。

original: Can you build another?
traduit: 你能再造一台吗？

original: Hmm? No, no. No! I'm too close now. Can't take the time.
traduit: 嗯？不，不，不！就差这最后一步了，耽误不起。
