traduit: 我现在在这里学习魔法。这对我很重要。

original: I've just been asked enough questions. I'm here to learn, not to explain myself over and over.
traduit: 我只是被问过太多次了。我是来此学习，不是一遍遍解释自己。

original: Forgive me, I didn't mean to assume.
traduit: 抱歉，我不是故意的。

original: The research I've done seems to indicate that Skorm Snow-Strider left part of his journal here after laying siege.
traduit: 从我搜集到的资料来看，“雪步”斯科姆围攻此地后，将一部分日记留在了这里。

original: I believe it should indicate how to enter the blocked off sections of the stronghold.
traduit: 日记里面应该有进入要塞封闭区域的方法。

original: I should warn you, Forelhost is quite haunted, but I'm sure you can handle it. Return to me here once you've obtained the staff.
traduit: 我得提醒你，这里闹鬼闹得厉害，不过我相信你能应付得来。拿到面具，就回来找我。

original: Me? No, I'm too important to the war effort to risk life and limb in there... Besides, that's what I'm paying you for.
traduit: 我？不行，我对战争来说太重要了，不能进去玩命……再说，我雇你就是为了这个。

original: It seems that after the strength of the Cult was broken in the Dragon War a last contingent came here to create a stronghold and regroup.
traduit: 应该是巨龙战争中拜龙教的势力被摧毁后，最后的分支来到这里建立了据点并重新集结。

original: King Harald's forces crushed stragglers here the during the First Era and it has been haunted ever since, but the specifics of the siege are unclear.
traduit: 哈拉尔德王的军队第一纪元时在此镇压了那些残余势力，从那时起这里就一直闹鬼，但围攻的具体情况不得而知。

original: Tell me about Forelhost.
traduit: 跟我说说皮纸主人。

original: They were among the first men to arrive from Atmora and they worshipped certain animals as avatars of the Gods; Dragons being foremost.
traduit: 他们是最先从阿特莫拉来到这里的人之一，把某些动物当做神的化身来崇拜，其中以龙最为重要。

original: And for their bloody sacrifices, the Dragons gifted their priests with terrible power.
traduit: 为了享受他们献上的血腥祭品，龙族赋予了他们的祭司可怕的力量。

original: But their cruelty was too great for men to bear, and they rose up in what would be called the Dragon War and the Cult swept from the land.
traduit: 但他们太过暴虐，以致人类不堪忍受、奋起反抗，这就是后世所谓的“巨龙战争”，拜龙教也就此被逐出这片土地。

original: What can you tell me of the Dragon Cult?
traduit: 你能告诉我些关于拜龙教的事么？

original: Oh... well... of course they'd disavow all knowledge... spies are everywhere.
traduit: 哦……嗯……他们肯定得装成一无所知啊……奸细无处不在么。

original: That's better. Now we can talk.
traduit: 这样好多了。我们可以谈谈了。

original: Stop it! This is a one-on-one duel!
traduit: 停下！这是一对一决斗！

original: I thought you were a wizard. Hit me with a spell!
traduit: 你是巫师吧。那就用法术来打我啊！

original: You're cheating!
traduit: 你作弊！

original: It's no fun unless you fight me with magic.
traduit: 除非你要用魔法对抗我，否则一点乐子也没。

original: This is a magic duel. Ma-gic. You know, with spells.
traduit: 这是魔法决斗。魔——法。你应该明白的，要用法术。

original: WIChangeLocation03Hit
traduit: WIChangeLocation03Hit

original: It's your funeral.
traduit: 你自找的。

original: The gods will be the judge of that.
traduit: 诸神会做出评判。

original: Sorry. You'll have to find some other way to stroke your ego.
traduit: 抱歉。你得找点其他方法满足自己的虚荣心了。

original: I won't take no for answer!
traduit: 我不接受拒绝！

original: You call yourself a wizard? I challenge you to a duel!
traduit: 你敢自称是巫师？我要向你挑战！

original: Ha ha ha ha ha ha ha ha ha!
traduit: 哈哈哈哈哈哈哈！

original: But now he's dead... and I have a new loincloth.
traduit: 但现在他死了……我又多了条新腰布。

original: I am not adorable, it was not funny, and he wasn't a merchant. He was a Khajiit monk, a master of the Whispering Fang style.
traduit: 我不可爱，也不可笑，他也不是什么商人。他是个卡吉特僧侣，飒牙流的高手。

original: Oh, a big doggy chasing a little kitty! How adorable!
traduit: 哦，大狗狗追小猫咪！多可爱呀！

original: And what of your latest, Arnbjorn. Something about a Khajiit? Merchant was it?
traduit: 你最近怎么样，艾恩乔恩？卡吉特的事怎么样了？这回又是商人？

original: Tried a new spell. Little something I've been working on in my spare time. Came "this" close to turning that priest inside out. Damned messy.
traduit: 我试验了一个新咒语。业余时间做的小玩意儿。差点把那个祭司掀了个底朝天。混乱得一塌糊涂。

original: Ah, the young and stupid. Always mocking the experienced and brilliant. My contract went very well, I'll have you know.
traduit: 啊，蠢小子。总是嘲笑阅历丰富、才华横溢的人可不好。告诉你吧，契约进展顺利。

original: Oh, yes, please, old man. Regale us with your tales of wizardry...
traduit: 哦，来吧，老头儿。跟我们讲讲你的巫术小故事吧。

original: What about you, Festus? How did that last contract turn out?
traduit: 你怎么样，菲斯图斯？上一份契约如何？

original: Oh Babette, but you are so wicked.
traduit: 哦，巴贝特，你可是太坏了。

original: Oh ya, very good. Very good. My it is dark down here. Oh, but you are so beautiful. Such a lovely smile. Your teeth... your teeth! No! Aggghh!!
traduit: 哦，可以。很好，很好。我的天，那边太黑了。哦，但你却这么漂亮。多么可爱的微笑。你的牙也……你的牙！不！啊啊啊啊！

original: Oh yes, please, kind sir. My mama and papa left me all alone, and I'm so very hungry. I know a shortcut to the candy shop. Through this alley.
traduit: 哦，谢谢，好心的先生。我爸爸妈妈把我一个人扔下了。我饿极了。我认识去糖果店的路。穿过这个巷子就是了。

original: Okay, okay. Wait. Here we go. "Ooh, you are such a pretty little girl. Would the sweetie like a sweetie? Oh yes, how about some chocolate?"
traduit: 好吧，好吧。稍等。我们开始。“哦，你可真是个漂亮的小姑娘。宝贝儿想要小点心吗？哦，对，来点巧克力怎么样？”

original: Ha ha ha ha! Again! Again! Do the part where he tries to buy you some candy.
traduit: 哈哈哈！再来！再来一次！就是他要给你买糖那段。

original: Hmph.
traduit: 哼。

original: I'll give you a week before you end up dead in a ditch.
traduit: 在你死在沟里之前，我会给你一周时间。

original: You certainly have a strange energy about you. I look forward to following your progress.
traduit: 你身上确实有种奇怪的能量。我期待你的进步。

original: You just trust in Astrid, follow her orders, and you'll do fine here.
traduit: 只要相信阿斯垂德，服从她的命令，你会在这里干得很好。

original: You're going to love it here. We have a lot of fun, and we look out for each other. Just like any family.
traduit: 你会喜欢这里的。我们在这里很开心，就像家庭一样互相扶持。

original: I will kill anyone who stands in my way. Anyone.
traduit: 我会杀了任何挡我去路的人。任何。

original: It's nice to meet you, Babette.
traduit: 很高兴见到你，巴贝特。

original: The Dark Brotherhood will return to greatness. With my help.
traduit: 黑暗兄弟会会在我的帮助下重获伟大。

original: It's nice to meet you, Veezara.
traduit: 维萨拉，很高兴见到你。

original: I am an assassin without equal. I belong here.
traduit: 我是个无可匹敌的刺客。我天生属于这儿。

original: It's nice to meet you, Gabriella.
traduit: 很高兴见到你，加布里艾拉。

original: You know nothing about me, or my abilities.
traduit: 你对我和我的能力一无所知。

original: It's nice to meet you, Arnbjorn.
traduit: 很高兴见到你，艾恩乔恩。

original: Fine. I'm not here to make friends, old man.
traduit: 很好。我也不是来交朋友的，老头儿。

original: It's nice to meet you, Festus.
traduit: 很高兴见到你，菲斯图斯。

original: Yes, yes, you're the new Family member. Let's make this easy - consider me the cranky old uncle nobody talks to. You go your way, I'll go mine.
traduit: 是，是，你是家里的新成员。直接点说吧，你就把我当成没人理的暴脾气老大爷吧。你走你的路，我走我的路。

original: There you are! Astrid's told me all about you. Heard she pulled the ole' "Choose your victim" gag with you. Ah, I love that one...
traduit: 你来了！阿斯垂德和我说过你的事。听说她和你开了个“选择受害者”的玩笑啊。我喜欢这个……

original: Well, well. It's raw meat. Oh, my beautiful wife has told me all about you.
traduit: 嗯，很好。是块生肉。我的漂亮老婆和我提起过你。

original: New brother. May I offer my most sincere welcome to our Family.
traduit: 新来的兄弟。请允许我向你表示最诚挚的欢迎。

original: New sister. May I offer my most sincere welcome to our Family.
traduit: 新来的姐妹。请允许我向你表示最诚挚的欢迎。

original: Welcome, my brother. Welcome to our Sanctuary. You have made the right choice, joining us, I assure you.
traduit: 欢迎，兄弟。欢迎来到我们的圣所。我向你保证，你选择加入我们是正确的决定。

original: Welcome, my sister. Welcome to our Sanctuary. You have made the right choice, joining us, I assure you.
traduit: 欢迎，姐妹。欢迎来到我们的圣所。我向你保证，你选择加入我们是正确的决定。

original: What's so important about me being Dragonborn?
traduit: 我是龙裔很重要吗？

original: Haven't you been paying attention to anything I've said? Only you can finally defeat Alduin and avert the end of the world!
traduit: 你没听我说的话吗？只有你可以最终击败奥杜因，避免世界的终结！

original: If we can just find out what this Dragonrend Shout is, you may have a chance.
traduit: 如果我们找到龙魂撕裂龙吼的方法，你就有机会了。

original: Or not. There's no guarantee with prophecy. Merely hope.
traduit: 当然也可能没有。预言是没保证的。只是希望而已。

original: If we can just find out what Shout the ancient Nords used, you may have a chance.
traduit: 如果我们找到了古诺德人使用的龙吼，你就有机会了。

original: It's the prophecy, don't you see? Only a Dragonborn can stop Alduin and avert the end of the world!
traduit: 你没看到这预言吗？只有龙裔能够阻止奥杜因，避免世界被终结。

original: But... I don't yet know how you can stop him. The prophecy doesn't say. But Alduin's Wall does. I hope.
traduit: 但……我还不知道你如何才能阻止他。预言里没提到。我希望奥杜因之墙有线索。

original: Not yet, not yet. When we get to Riverwood... with Delphine... I'll tell you both then, when I've collected my thoughts.
traduit: 不到时候，不到时候。等我们到了河木镇……跟戴尔芬会合……我会告诉你们俩。先让我整理一下思路。

original: I never expected... well, suddenly here you are and now I'm too muddled to explain myself.
traduit: 我真是万万没想到……你就这么出现了，搞得我有些语无伦次了。

original: I still need some time to get used to the idea that there might be hope for us after all.
traduit: 我还需要些时间来接受我们还有希望这个念头。

original: Why are the Thalmor so interested in finding you?
traduit: 为什么梭默这么想找到你？

original: Well. They've been hunting down Blades since the Great War, on general principle.
traduit: 哎。他们自浩大战争开始就一直在追捕刀锋会成员。

original: But if you mean me, now, in particular... maybe they've started to get an inkling of what the return of the dragons means.
traduit: 但如果你是指现在……或许是他们已经对龙族回归的意义有些了解了。

original: I don't suppose they want the world to end any more than we do. Or at least, they'd prefer to end it on their terms.
traduit: 我认为他们跟我们一样，也不会希望世界终结，退一步说，就算要终结，方式也得他们挑。

original: Who are you? How do you know Delphine?
traduit: 你是谁？你怎么认识戴尔芬的？

original: Hasn't she told you? We were both Blades, back when that still meant something.
traduit: 她没告诉你？我们过去都是刀锋会成员，那时候这身份还是有些分量的。

original: Now we're just fellow fugitives from the Thalmor. I didn't know she was still alive, but I'm not surprised. She was a survivor.
traduit: 现在我们只是逃避梭默追捕的亡命人。我不知道她还活着，但她能幸存下来也很正常。

original: I found Esbern.
traduit: 我找到伊思本了。

original: So what are you doing here? Lorkhan's eyes, you can't let the Thalmor get to him first! Get back to Riften!
traduit: 那你在这里干嘛？洛克汗的眼啊，不能让梭默接近他！快回裂谷城！

original: I found Esbern. He's hiding out somewhere in the Ratway.
traduit: 我找到了伊思本。他躲在鼠道里。

original: Did you tell him you were Dragonborn? I didn't think so.
traduit: 我看你没告诉他你是龙裔吧？

original: Lorkhan's eyes, do I have to do everything myself? Get back to Riften before the Thalmor find him!
traduit: 洛克汗的眼啊，所有事难不成都得要我去办吗？在梭默找到他前快回裂谷城。

original: I found Esbern, but he won't talk to me.
traduit: 我找到伊思本了，但他不理我。

original: He's on his way.
traduit: 他在路上了。

original: Mara's mercy, then he's safe! Come on, we have a lot to discuss.
traduit: 玛拉保佑，那他安全了！来，我们还有很多事要讨论。

original: He's here in Riverwood. Right outside.
traduit: 他来河木镇了。就在外面。

original: What? You left him on his own? With the Thalmor after him? Go make sure he's safe and bring him here!
traduit: 什么？你把他一个人扔下了？梭默在抓他啊。确保他的安全，把他带回来！

original: Really? He's safe? Where is he?
traduit: 真的？他安全了吗？他在哪里？

original: Is there some kind of trouble in Morthal?
traduit: 莫萨尔有什么麻烦吗？

original: That which is unknown can create unease, even fear. It is to be expected.
traduit: 未知的东西会造成不安乃至恐惧。这是情理之中。

original: Some fear our new resident wizard. As they grow to know him, they will accept him.
traduit: 有人害怕我们的新常驻巫师。等他们逐渐了解他，他们就会接受的。

original: Time will prove me right.
traduit: 时间会证明我是对的。

original: You! Please, help me!
traduit: 你！求你帮我！

original: Hurry, cut me down!
traduit: 快点，放我下来！

original: I want to get to my son. He's all I have left.
traduit: 我要去找我女儿。她是我唯一的亲人了。

original: What are you doing there?
traduit: 你在那儿干嘛？

original: Please, cut me down!
traduit: 拜托，放我下来！

original: Yes sir. Sorry, sir.
traduit: 是的，先生。抱歉。

original: Well? Get out of here and mind your rounds.
traduit: 啊？现在赶紧出去巡逻。

original: Emissary Elenwen was asking for you inside. (Persuade)
traduit: 爱琳温特使让你进去。（说服）

original: Why didn't you say so? Take over my post. Make sure nobody enters the Solar.
traduit: 怎么不早说？过来替岗。别让人进日光房。

original: The Emissary? What's this about?
traduit: 特使？怎么了？

original: Wait... who are you? Intruder!
traduit: 等等……你是谁？有入侵者！

original: I have the coat
traduit: 我拿到外套了。

original: We would but there's a big wedding taking place at Castle Dour. We'll have to wait until after the wedding.
traduit: 虽然可以，但阴郁堡那边有场盛大婚礼。我们得等婚礼结束再说。

original: Come back in a few nights when the wedding reception is over and we'll start the ceremony when you do.
traduit: 先过几晚，等婚礼结束再说吧，到时候我们再开始庆祝。

original: Let's do the fire festival tonight.
traduit: 我们今晚举行火烧节吧。

original: All right. That should do it. I think I'm ready to try the College again. Thanks!
traduit: 好吧。这样就可以了。我准备好再去学院一趟了。谢谢！

original: Come on. I don't want to hit you until you have your ward ready.
traduit: 来吧。你不准备好结界我是不会攻击的。

original: I think I see what I was doing wrong...
traduit: 我想知道我哪里出错了……

original: Great! Now I'm going to cast some spells at you. Keep your ward up so I can study it.
traduit: 太棒了！我现在要对你施法了。把结界保持好，我就能研究了。

original: Get your ward ready.
traduit: 准备好你的结界。

original: Sure, I can teach you.
traduit: 当然，我可以教你。

original: Really? Great! Okay. So, first, you raise your ward and I'll throw a little spell at it. That way I can see the "right" way to do things.
traduit: 真的吗？太好了！好。所以，你先施放结界，然后我来发射些法术。这样我就能看到怎么才算是“正确”的了。

original: Oh. All right... I guess I'll just keep practicing on my own. Sorry to bother you.
traduit: 哦。好吧……我还是自己继续练习吧。很抱歉打扰你了。

original: I've finally found you! I want to join the College of Winterhold. But I need help with my wards. Can you teach me?
traduit: 终于找到你了！我想加入冬堡学院。但我需要练习结界术。你能教教我吗？

original: Thank you. Here, let an old alchemist pass on some of her secrets to you.
traduit: 谢谢。来，让我这个老炼金术士教你一些秘诀吧。

original: I have your ring.
traduit: 我拿到你的戒指了。

original: Thank you. It's a collection of regrets that I try not to forget. Here, I promised you this.
traduit: 谢谢。这是我努力不让自己遗忘的遗憾。给，这是我答应你的报酬。

original: I have your journal.
traduit: 我拿到你的日记了。

original: Look at it. That's real Nord craftsmanship, that is! Let me show you an old trick I learned as a scout. Makes it harder for the enemy to notice you.
traduit: 看看。这可是真正的诺德工艺，没错了！让我给你展示一些我当侦察兵的老把戏吧。能让敌人更难注意到你。

original: I found your helmet.
traduit: 我找到你的头盔了。

original: My clan's shield. So Lenne really did stumble into that cave and was eaten by monsters.
traduit: 我家族的盾牌。所以伦内真的是跌跌撞撞闯进山洞被怪物吃了。

original: In honor of his memory, let me show you a few shield techniques. And tell me if you're leaving town. Be good to travel again.
traduit: 为了纪念他，我给你展示些防御技巧吧。如果你要离开镇子，可以告诉我一声。我很乐意再次出去旅行。

original: I found your shield.
traduit: 我找到你的盾牌了。

original: Look at that edge. Still sharp.
traduit: 看看这剑锋。锋利如故啊。

original: I'll present this to the Jarl later. As for you, let me show you some smithing techniques.
traduit: 我晚点会把这个交给领主的。还有，我来给你展示些锻造技术。

original: I found Queen Freydis's sword.
traduit: 我找到了芙瑞迪丝女王的剑。

original: Why am I not surprised?
traduit: 为什么我一点都不惊讶呢？

original: I can't do that right now.
traduit: 我现在做不了。

original: So many things lost....
traduit: 失去的东西太多了……

original: Well, I never claimed otherwise.
traduit: 是啊，我也没说不是。

original: That's a terrible story.
traduit: 真是个糟糕的故事。

original: Pfft. Ungrateful milk drinker.
traduit: 呸，忘恩负义的懦夫。

original: Watch your words next time.
traduit: 下次说话注意点。

original: Well, aren't you sweet? I'd be happy to give you some alchemy training in exchange for the ring, if you bring it to me.
traduit: 啊，你很贴心啊？如果你能把戒指找来给我，我很乐意给你做些炼金术训练做交换。

original: I could find that ring for you.
traduit: 我可以帮你把戒指找来。

original: Blessing of Arkay to you for your help.
traduit: 阿尔凯祝福你，感谢你的帮助。

original: I'll do it.
traduit: 交给我。

original: Oh, you could? I sure would love to have it again. Could show you some of my old scouting tricks.
traduit: 哦，你会去吗？我真的很想找回它。我可以教你一些以前的侦察技巧。

original: What if I could find that helmet for you?
traduit: 如果我帮你找回头盔呢？

original: According to my grandfather at least. He swore that version of the legend was true, even found the cave old Lenne stumbled into.
traduit: 至少我祖父是这么认为的。他发誓说那个传说是真的，甚至还发现了老伦内偶然走进的山洞。

original: Hey, if you find it, I could show you some of the clan's favorite fighting moves. They're all shield techniques.
traduit: 嘿，如果你找到了，我可以给你展示展示我们氏族最喜欢的战斗动作，都是很好的格挡技术。

original: Your ancestral shield is lost in a cave?
traduit: 你祖先的盾牌丢在山洞里了？

original: Jarl wants it to look like an ancient blade. High Queen Freydis ruled over Windhelm in the Second Era, and her sword was legendary.
traduit: 领主希望它能看起来像一把古代的剑。第二纪元时，至高女王芙瑞迪丝统治着风舵城，她的剑十分传奇。

original: Getting the real sword would be even better than making a copy, but no one wants to risk getting it from its resting place.
traduit: 参考真的那把，我可以仿制得更好些，但没人愿意冒险把它拿回来。

original: If you find that sword, traveler, I'd be grateful.
traduit: 旅行者，如果你找到了那把剑。我会很感激你的。

original: What's special about this sword?
traduit: 这把剑有什么特别之处吗？

original: My husband. We used to go out in the wilds and collect ingredients together. He used to call me his "pretty Juniper."
traduit: 因为我丈夫。我们曾经一起去野外收集食材，他管我叫“美丽的刺柏”。

original: It's quite romantic, if you're an alchemist. Frost took the old fool a few seasons back, while he was looking for the Ring of Pure Mixtures.
traduit: 如果你是炼金术士，就知道这有多浪漫了。几年前严寒把那个老傻瓜带走了，当时他正在寻找提纯戒指。

original: I found the ring's resting place after he died, but I'm far too old to go exploring some cave, now.
traduit: 他死后我找到了戒指的下落，但我年纪大了，不能再去洞穴探险了。

original: How'd you pick up the herb trade?
traduit: 你是怎么开始草药生意的？

original: I am. I came into Arkay's light after the Great War. So many died by my hands, my magics.
traduit: 没错。我是在浩大战争之后接触到阿尔凯的。死在我手上，我的魔法之下的人太多了。

original: I'm fortunate that Kust and the people of Falkreath have come to accept me as one of their own.
traduit: 我很幸运，得到了卡斯特还有佛克瑞斯人民的接纳。

original: Could you do an old elf a favor? I misplaced my journal in a cave I was exploring. I'll pay for its return.
traduit: 你能帮老精灵一个忙吗？我把日记丢在了一个山洞里。如果你能找回来，我会付钱的。

original: You're a priest of Arkay?
traduit: 你是阿尔凯的祭司吗？

original: I was the finest scout in the Legion, once. Tracked down all the places in the wilds that were causing people trouble.
traduit: 我曾经是军团最好的侦察兵。在荒野中能找到一切会给军队带来麻烦的地方。

original: Lost my helmet in one of the old caves. My pretty, pretty helmet. Life just got worse after that. Kept losing things. So many things....
traduit: 我的头盔丢在了一个古老的洞穴里。我那顶超级漂亮的头盔啊。自那之后，生活就变糟了。开始丢东西。很多东西……

original: What's your story, old man?
traduit: 讲讲你的故事吧，老人家。

original: Yes. I've wandered a bit, but I always come back to Kynesgrove. My clan was one of the first to settle here.
traduit: 是，我偶尔会出去逛逛，但总会回到凯娜之林。我的氏族是最早在这里定居的。

original: Legend says that my forefather Lenne discovered the mines after he stumbled into a dark cave to relieve himself. Too much mead.
traduit: 传说我的祖先伦内喝多了蜜酒，到一个黑暗的洞穴里方便时发现了这些矿。

original: Of course, there's another story of Lenne losing the family shield in a different cave, so it depends on who you believe.
traduit: 当然，还有另外的故事说伦内在另外的洞穴里丢掉了家传盾牌，看你喜欢信哪个了。

original: Are you from Kynesgrove?
traduit: 你从凯娜之林来？

original: Of course I am. What do I look like, a tavern wench?
traduit: 当然了。不然你以为我是什么，酒馆女仆吗？

original: Ah, don't let my words cut you too deep. I've just been working the forge too hard. Trying to set this sword right.
traduit: 啊，别在意我的话。我在锻炉上工作太辛苦了。我正试着复原一把剑。

original: You're the castle blacksmith?
traduit: 你是城堡的铁匠？

original: That's a load off my mind. Here's your pay.
traduit: 我心里轻松多了。这是你的报酬。

original: You remind me of myself a few years ago. Let me show you a little bit about wearing light armor. It's helped me out whenever I was scouting.
traduit: 你让我想起了几年前的自己。让我给你展示一下如何穿戴轻甲吧。我以前侦察的时候就会这样。

original: Now I've got the itch to travel again. If you're leaving town, I wouldn't mind coming with for a while.
traduit: 现在我又有些渴望旅行了。如果你想离开这里，我不介意和你一起去一段时间。

original: Good. I'll have a sack of coin waiting for you when you get back.
traduit: 好。等你回来时，我给你准备一袋金币。

original: This brings back memories. Come back when you're done and maybe I'll be up to showing you a few tricks.
traduit: 这真是勾起我的回忆了。等你办完再来，也许我能为你展示一些技巧。

original: I may have accidentally let a prisoner escape. The leader of one of those bandit groups.
traduit: 我可能不小心放走了一个囚犯。是个强盗集团的头子。

original: I told everyone he died during questioning, and I need you to track him down and make sure he doesn't show up to disprove that.
traduit: 我跟其他人说他在审讯时死了，我需要你找到他确保他再也不能出来反驳这点。

original: What's this problem you have?
traduit: 你有什么麻烦？

original: That's right. Used to explore all over. I'm the one who originally found the mine Darkwater Crossing was built around.
traduit: 没错。我曾经四处探险。是我最先发现了暗水岔口附近有矿。

original: I was actually scouting a bit the other day, old times sake. Spied a brigand heading back to his camp.
traduit: 我前几天还出去侦察了呢，老毛病了。我看到有个强盗正在往营地走。

original: Up for a little hunting? My husband is being a sad stick, so I can't go myself.
traduit: 想来次小小狩猎吗？我丈夫总是有些顽固，不让我一个人去。

original: You were an adventurer?
traduit: 你是冒险家？

original: You wouldn't be a sellsword, would you? I have a little problem you could solve.
traduit: 你不会是佣兵吧？我有个小问题让你解决。

original: Fine, then.
traduit: 那算了。

original: Thank you for asking.
traduit: 承你问我了。

original: You're weak. (Intimidate)
traduit: 你很弱。（恐吓）

original: I am not weak. Very well, outlander, I will go with you whenever you are ready.
traduit: 我并不弱。很好，外来者，只要你准备好，我就和你一起去。

original: You dare challenge a child of Malacath?
traduit: 你竟敢挑战玛拉凯斯之子？

original: You're weak. (Brawl)
traduit: 你很弱。（打架）。

original: What if I pay off your dowry? (<BribeCost> gold)
traduit: 如果我付清你的嫁妆呢？（<BribeCost>金币）

original: That is a fine idea. The stronghold would need the gold when I left to marry, anyway. I am ready when you are.
traduit: 好主意。无论如何，当我离开去结婚的时候，要塞需要钱。等你准备好，我就准备好了。

original: No. That won't be enough.
traduit: 不。这还不够。

original: Enough of this! Fight me!
traduit: 够了！来和我一战啊！

original: So, you reveal yourself!
traduit: 你暴露了！

original: Now you die!
traduit: 现在去死吧！

original: Ha, found you!
traduit: 哈，找到你了！

original: Oh come now, resorting to petty tricks are we?
traduit: 哦，得了吧，咱们不要耍小把戏了？

original: A bold but foolish move.
traduit: 这既大胆又愚蠢。

original: Coward.
traduit: 胆小鬼。

original: You cannot escape!
traduit: 你逃不掉的！

original: You can't hide forever!
traduit: 你不能一直藏下去！

original: You can't get away from me!
traduit: 你逃不掉的！

original: They picked on the wrong old man.
traduit: 他们把我当成普通老人了。

original: Haven't fought like that in years.
traduit: 我已经好多年没这样战斗过了。

original: Waste of time.
traduit: 浪费时间。

original: Didn't even work up a sweat.
traduit: 连点汗都没出。

original: Pathetic.
traduit: 差劲。

original: That's what happens when you cross the Guild.
traduit: 这就是惹怒公会的下场。

original: I think they got the message.
traduit: 他们应该是明白了。

original: Damn, just as I was getting warmed up.
traduit: 该死，才刚刚把身热好。

original: I hardly felt a thing.
traduit: 我还没感觉到什么呢。

original: And that's why I'm the best.
traduit: 所以我才是最棒的。

original: The afterlife will bring you darkness.
traduit: 来世将带给你黑暗。

original: Bless you, Lady of Shadows... I live another day.
traduit: 感谢阴影女神……我又多活了一天。

original: I send you to your rest.
traduit: 我送你安息。

original: You were no match for a Nightingale.
traduit: 你不是夜莺的对手。

original: Shadows consume you.
traduit: 暗影将你吞噬。

original: That wasn't a fight, it was an execution.
traduit: 这不是战斗，是处决。

original: So ends the lesson.
traduit: 就教训到这里吧。

original: That was hardly worth my time.
traduit: 简直浪费我的时间。

original: How disappointing.
traduit: 太失望了。

original: Hmph. Hardly a challenge.
traduit: 哼。毫无挑战性。

original: That'll teach you to cross me.
traduit: 这就是惹到我的下场。

original: Guess it was nothing after all.
traduit: 应该没有什么。

original: I must've been hearing things.
traduit: 我一定是听到了什么。

original: You've got moments to live.
traduit: 你本有机会活下去的。

original: I'm endin' you right now!
traduit: 我现在要杀了你！

original: Sure, pick on the old guy!
traduit: 好啊，欺负老人家嘛！

original: Come on, I won't bite.
traduit: 来吧，我是不会咬人的。

original: Let's get this party started.
traduit: 开始狂欢吧。

original: Been itching for a fight.
traduit: 我真想打一场。

original: I promise a swift but painful end!
traduit: 我保证结局会很痛苦的！

original: No mercy for the weak!
traduit: 弱者无需怜悯！

original: I'll give no quarter!
traduit: 绝不宽恕！

original: So, it's to the pain then!
traduit: 这就是痛苦！

original: Ah good, I could use some practice!
traduit: 啊很好，正要练习呢！

original: I'll tear you apart!
traduit: 我要把你撕碎！

original: The burden of death approaches!
traduit: 死亡的重担即将到来！

original: Come, taste darkness's embrace!
traduit: 来吧，回归黑暗的拥抱！

original: Your life is forfeit!
traduit: 你的生命已被收取！

original: I bring death from the shadows!
traduit: 我从阴影带来死亡！

original: By Nocturnal's grace, I will defeat you!
traduit: 诺克图娜尔在上，我将击溃你！

original: I'll bury my blade in your heart!
traduit: 我要把剑插进你的心脏！

original: Your death will be my triumph!
traduit: 你的死亡就是我的胜利！

original: You're not a threat... merely an annoyance.
traduit: 你算不上什么威胁……充其量是个麻烦。

original: You've just written your own epitaph.
traduit: 你刚刚书写了自己的碑文。

original: Your blood will adorn my blade!
traduit: 你的鲜血将点缀我的武器！

original: This shouldn't take long.
traduit: 不会很久的。

original: So, it begins.
traduit: 来吧。

original: Where'd you come from?
traduit: 你从哪儿冒出来的？

original: Talos smite you!
traduit: 塔洛斯毁灭你！

original: Sovngarde awaits!
traduit: 松加德在等待！

original: This should be fun!
traduit: 会很有意思的！

original: For the Emperor!
traduit: 为了皇帝！

original: Die villain!
traduit: 死吧混蛋！

original: Time to fight!
traduit: 是时候战斗了！

original: Finally! Let's end this.
traduit: 终于！结束这一切吧。

original: Your feeble attempt to hide is insulting!
traduit: 你躲躲藏藏的企图是在侮辱我！

original: Enough games, let's end this!
traduit: 玩够了就结束吧！

original: Come coward, now we fight!
traduit: 来啊胆小鬼，来战斗啊！

original: Hm? Something's near...
traduit: 嗯？附近有东西……

original: Wait, I hear something...
traduit: 等待，我听到声音了……

original: I heard something.
traduit: 有什么东西。

original: I'll find you... it's only a matter of time.
traduit: 我会找到你的……这只是时间问题。

original: Coward. Come out and fight me!
traduit: 胆小鬼。出来一战！

original: I'm going to find you...
traduit: 我会找到你的……

original: There's no need to hide. I won't hurt you.
traduit: 没必要藏着了。我不会伤害你的。

original: Come out and face me, you coward!
traduit: 出来面对我，你这个懦夫！

original: I can smell your fear.
traduit: 我能闻出你的恐惧。

original: I can hear your heart beating.
traduit: 我听得到你的心跳。

original: Hiding? The shadows are my domain!
traduit: 藏起来了？阴影可是我的领域！

original: Hiding only prolongs the inevitable.
traduit: 躲得了一时躲不了一世。

original: I know you're here. Show yourself.
traduit: 我知道你在这里。现身吧。

original: Noooo....
Shadows take me...
traduit: 我随阴影而去……

original: Aghh..
I'm not done yet...
traduit: 我还没输呢……

original: Gods... the pain...
traduit: 神啊……好疼……

original: You'll... pay for this...
traduit: 你要……付出代价……

original: Enough of this!
traduit: 够了！

original: Damn it, no more!
traduit: 该死，不要了！

original: No mercy!
traduit: 不可饶恕！

original: Bring it on!
traduit: 来啊！

original: Gettin' to old for this.
traduit: 老不中用了。

original: I'll cut your throat!
traduit: 我要割开你的喉咙！

original: Your end is near!
traduit: 你死期到了！

original: You mean nothing!
traduit: 你算什么东西！

original: Your life is mine!
traduit: 你的命归我了！

original: You're making this too easy!
traduit: 你太弱了！

original: Your fate is sealed!
traduit: 你的命运早已注定！

original: Nocturnal, guide my hand!
traduit: 诺克图娜尔啊，指引我的手！

original: Dodge this!
traduit: 闪开！

original: Darkness consume you!
traduit: 黑暗将会消磨你！

original: Is that all you've got?
traduit: 你就这点本事吗？

original: You fight like a child!
traduit: 你打架就像个孩子！

original: Ha! You're pathetic!
traduit: 哈！真可悲！

original: Come on, put up a fight!
traduit: 来啊，打一架啊！

original: Give up?
traduit: 放弃了？

original: Nyargh!
traduit: 呐啊！

original: Grrarrgh!
traduit: 嘎啊啊！

original: Die, insect!
traduit: 去死吧，虫豸！

original: I will end you!
traduit: 我会杀了你！

original: You're... dead!
traduit: 你死……定了！

original: Fall, damn you!
traduit: 去死吧，混账！

original: Agggh!
traduit: 啊！

original: I... Willl... kill you!
traduit: 我……要……杀了你！

original: Ha ha ha ha ha!
traduit: 哈哈哈哈哈！

original: Die dog!
traduit: 死吧，狗！

original: Hahaha!
traduit: 哈哈哈！

original: Take that!
traduit: 接招吧！

original: They'll understand. Trust me. (Persuade)
traduit: 他们会理解的。相信我。（说服）

original: You're right. Malacath teaches us to meet our fate. Perhaps this is mine.
traduit: 你说得对。玛拉凯斯教会我们直面命运。也许这就是我的命。

original: What do you know about my people, outlander?
traduit: 你对我的族人有多了解，外来者？

original: You want to leave the stronghold?
traduit: 你想要离开要塞吗？

original: Yes, but I must stay here and wait for the day when I'll be married and sent to another stronghold.
traduit: 是的，但我必须待在这里，等待结婚并前往另一个要塞的那一天。

original: It is our way, and I am proud to follow my people's traditions, but I can't help but feel chained.
traduit: 这就是我们的习俗，我很自豪能够遵循我们族人的传统，但我还是感受到了束缚感。

original: I couldn't. It would shame my chief and my mother and foremothers.
traduit: 不能。那会让我的酋长、母亲和女性先人蒙羞。

original: Why don't you come with me?
traduit: 你为什么不和我一起走呢？

original: You don't know who you'll marry?
traduit: 你不知道要嫁给谁吗？

original: No. A chief's daughter marries who her chief wishes. It ensures the stronghold receives a fair trade in goods for my absence.
traduit: 不知道。酋长的女儿会遵循酋长的意愿出嫁。这样我离开的时候要塞就能得到公平的货物交易。

original: I used to look forward to the day when I was of age, to see new places and people, but now it feels like a cage.
traduit: 当我长大后，我曾期待有一天能看到新的地方和新的人，但现在仿佛置身牢笼。

original: What do you do for the stronghold?
traduit: 你为要塞做什么？

original: I am Larak's daughter. Soon, I'll be of age and will be sent to marry an Orc chief in some distant stronghold.
traduit: 我是拉拉克的女儿。很快，我就会成年了，会被派去某个遥远的要塞嫁给一位兽人酋长。

original: Until then, I train. My new home will need strength, and my new sisters must know I am not weak when I arrive.
traduit: 在那之前，我需要训练。我的新家需要力量，在我到那里的时候，我的新姐妹必须知道我并不虚弱。

original: Fine. Forget I asked.
traduit: 很好。就当我没问。

original: Too frightened to leave home? (Intimidate)
traduit: 害怕离开家吗？（恐吓）

original: I'm not a coward, outlander. You want me to prove it? Fine. My axe is yours. To the most dangerous corners of Skyrim and back.
traduit: 我不是懦夫，外来者。想要我证明？很好。我的斧头就是你的了。到天际最危险的角落然后再回来。

original: Too frightened to leave home? (Brawl)
traduit: 害怕离开家吗？（打架）

original: Some coin, to soothe your guilt? (<BribeCost> gold)
traduit: 也许来点金币能打消你的罪恶感？（<BribeCost>金币）

original: Well, for that much, I don't think Malacath would turn his scowl on me. All right, outlander. My axe is yours.
traduit: 既然如此，我觉得玛拉凯斯不会对我怒目相向了。好吧，外来者，我的斧头就是你的了。

original: My honor isn't so cheap, outlander.
traduit: 我的荣耀可不便宜，外来者。

original: You just told me you missed adventure. (Persuade)
traduit: 你才跟我说自己错过了冒险的。（说服）

original: You're right. Look at me, talking in circles like some old wise woman. Very well, outlander. You have my axe when you need it.
traduit: 你说得对。看看我，就跟智妪一样说话兜圈子了。很好，外来者。需要的时候，我的斧子就是你的了。

original: Yes, but I am honor-bound to stay here.
traduit: 没错，但我有义务留在这儿。

original: You miss traveling?
traduit: 你很怀念旅行吗？

original: I do. There is a freedom the roads give you that the stronghold does not.
traduit: 没错。冒险带来的自由是要塞给予不了的。

original: But I have a place here, and I wouldn't want to dishonor my clan by leaving again like some young pup.
traduit: 但我在这里有一席之地，不想像个小狗崽子一样再次离开了，这会让我的氏族蒙羞。

original: I couldn't. It would dishonor the place the chief has made for me.
traduit: 不能。这会让酋长为我安排的位置蒙羞。

original: Why don't you travel with me?
traduit: 你为什么不跟我一起旅行呢？

original: You served in the Legion?
traduit: 你在军团服过役？

original: I did. I was known as Ghorbash gro-Dushnikh in those days, in honor of my homeland.
traduit: 是的。那段日子，我被叫做“格巴什·格洛-杜什尼克”，以此来纪念我的家乡。

original: Many Orcs leave the stronghold to join the Legion. They welcome our skill in battle and smithing, and we welcome a chance to see the world.
traduit: 许多兽人离开要塞加入军团。他们欢迎我们的战斗技巧和锻造技术，而我们也喜欢有机会见见世面。

original: Me? I'm Burguk's brother. I came back after serving many years in the Legion.
traduit: 我？我是博古克的兄弟。我在军团服役很多年之后回来了。

original: By then, Burguk had already become chief, and he welcomed me home as family, not a rival as is tradition.
traduit: 那时候，博古克已经当上酋长了，他欢迎我回家，把我当成家人，而不是传统中的对手。

original: You're going to be my Shield-Brother?
traduit: 你要来当我的盾牌兄弟？

original: So I'm told. Try and keep up.
traduit: 如我所说。试着别落下。

original: You're going to be my Shield-Sister?
traduit: 你要来当我的盾牌姐妹？

original: So I'm told. Let's see if you impress.
traduit: 如我所说。看看你能否打动我。

original: Aela will be your Shield-Sibling on this venture, whelp.
traduit: 在这次冒险中，艾拉会担任你的盾牌姐妹，小崽子。

original: Farkas will be your Shield-Sibling on this venture, whelp.
traduit: 在这次冒险中，法卡斯会担任你的盾牌兄弟，小崽子。

original: Last week a scholar came to us. He said he knew where we could find another fragment of Wuuthrad.
traduit: 上周有位学者找到我们。他说他知道在哪儿能找到巫斯拉德的另一块碎片。

original: He seemed a fool to me, but if he's right, the honor of the Companions demands that we seek it out.
traduit: 在我看来他就是个傻子，但如果他说的属实，那为了战友团的荣誉，我们就得把它找回来。

original: I did. Your time, it seems, has come.
traduit: 确实。看来，你的好时候到了。

original: Yes, and we have something special for you this time.
traduit: 没错。这次我们给你准备了些特别的东西。

original: What does he want?
traduit: 他想干什么？

original: Don't know. He just said he needed to talk to you before you do anything else.
traduit: 不知道。他只是说要在你做别的事前先和你谈谈。

original: I don't like making him angry, but there is some work for you if you want it.
traduit: 我可不想惹他生气，如果你愿意，也有一些工作可做。

original: He didn't say, but you'd better move fast.
traduit: 他没说，但你最好快点。

original: There's probably something I could find for you to do, but best to check with him.
traduit: 也许我能帮你找点事，但最好还是先跟他聊聊吧。

original: I don't know, but he sounded impatient.
traduit: 不知道，他口气很不耐烦。

original: It's got to be the Imperials! Find them!
traduit: 一定是帝国军队！把他们找出来！

original: Look out! Draugr!
traduit: 小心！是尸鬼！

original: It must be the Stormcloaks! Find them!
traduit: 肯定是风暴斗篷！找出他们！

original: Just what I was afraid of!
traduit: 我就担心这个！

original: Damn dustmen!
traduit: 该死的清道夫

original: Why don't you stay dead?
traduit: 你们怎么不继续装死呢？

original: My pa always warned me about these things!
traduit: 我爸总是警告我这些东西！

original: Damn dustmen! Why don't you stay dead?
traduit: 该死的清道夫！怎么不继续装死啊？

original: I'm not ready to pay the fine.
traduit: 我还没准备好交罚金。

original: Not ready? Well, my arrogant little sibling, until you pay the fine the Dark Brotherhood holds nothing for you. No contracts. No rewards. No respect.
traduit: 没准备好？好吧，傲慢的小兄弟。除非你交罚款，不然黑暗兄弟会什么都给不了你，没有契约，没有报酬，也没有尊重。

original: I understand, Listener. And I hope you understand that until the fine is paid, I must insist you refrain from all Dark Brotherhood business.
traduit: 我理解，聆听者。但我希望你明白，在缴纳罚款前，我必须要求你不参与黑暗兄弟会的任何事务。

original: I don't have that much gold.
traduit: 我没那么多钱。

original: Then I suggest you "collect" it. Until you pay the fine, you are effectively cut off from all Dark Brotherhood duties and contracts.
traduit: 那我建议你去“收集”些。在付清罚款前，你不能担任黑暗兄弟会的一切职责和契约。

original: Here's the 500 gold.
traduit: 这是500金币。

original: Good. I'll spread the word that you've made reparations. Now let's forget the past and get back to business...
traduit: 好。我会告诉大家你已经做出了赔偿。现在，我们就忘记过去，回到正事上吧。

original: Excellent. Now we can get back to business. I think it's best we just forget this ever happened and move on, hmm?
traduit: 太好了。现在可以继续谈正事了。忘记一切向前看，对吧？

original: Here's the 300 gold.
traduit: 这是300金币。

original: DBNazirEvictionBranchTopic
traduit: DBNazirEvictionBranchTopic

original: You disrespected the Brotherhood. And it'll cost you. You want back into the Family, you pay the price. 500 gold, and all is forgiven.
traduit: 你不尊重兄弟会。要为此付出代价。想回家来的话，就交罚款吧。500金币，就原谅你了。

original: You may be Listener, and head of the Sanctuary, but your recent behavior sets a bad example. I must insist you pay a fine of 300 gold.
traduit: 你或许是聆听者，也是圣所的领导者，但你最近算是做了坏榜样了。我必须让你交300金币的罚款。

original: If the Tenets were still in place, you would be required to defeat the Wrath of Sithis. Now you just need to pay a fine to Nazir. Ah, the Old Ways...
traduit: 要是我们还在执行“信条”的话，你就得去打败西帝斯的怒火了。现在你只需要给纳兹尔上交罚款就行了。哎，传统方法……

original: When you disrespect your Family, you disrespect yourself. Don't you care for anything at all? Prove that you do - speak with Nazir, make reparations.
traduit: 不尊重家庭，就是不尊重自己。你对此无所谓吗？证明你还是在乎的，去和纳兹尔谈谈，把罚款交了。

original: Bah. If it were up to me, we'd cut off your hands and never let you back in this Sanctuary. But no. All you have to do is pay Nazir a fine. Pathetic.
traduit: 呸。要是我做主的话，就把你手剁下来让你再也回不了圣所。但我做不了主。你只需要找纳兹尔缴纳罚款就行了。真可悲。

original: Ah, don't worry, we all like to break the rules sometimes. Just see Nazir and pay the fine. Seems I do that at least once a month...
traduit: 啊，别担心，我们偶尔也会违反规则。去找纳兹尔吧，把罚款交了。似乎我每个月少说都要交一次。

original: There are so few rules here. All we ask is that you don't disrespect your Family. But for some reason, you have. Best talk to Nazir and pay the fine.
traduit: 这里没什么规则可言。我们只是要求你尊重你的家人。但出于某种原因，你没做到。最好去找纳兹尔谈谈，交笔罚款吧。

original: Idiot. I may not have a lot of rules, but that doesn't give you free reign to do as you please. You want to resume your duties? Go talk to Nazir.
traduit: 白痴。我可能没那么多条条框框，但不是让你想干什么就干什么。想继续履职？去找纳兹尔。

original: Oh, but Cicero can't talk to you. You've been naughty, naughty. I think you need to clear this whole mess up with Nazir.
traduit: 哦，但是西塞罗不能跟你说话。你太淘气了，真淘气。我觉得你得去和纳兹尔掰扯清楚。

original: Looks like Cicero's not the only only one to go a little crazy from time to time. Eh, Listener? You should talk to Nazir, work this whole mess out.
traduit: 看来西塞罗不是唯一一个时不时发疯的人呀。是吧，聆听者？你应该去找纳兹尔谈谈，把事情解决了。

original: With all due respect, Listener, you broke what few rules we seem to have. Nazir insists you talk to him and work this issue out.
traduit: 恕我直言，聆听者，你破坏了我们为数不多的规矩。纳兹尔坚持让你和他谈谈，把问题解决了。

original: I do apologize, Listener, but Nazir made it clear the initiates are not to speak with you until you first deal with him, and atone for your actions.
traduit: 很抱歉，聆听者。但纳兹尔说得很清楚，除非你和他把事情解决了，为你的行为赎罪，否则兄弟们是不能和你说话的。

original: You are invisible!
traduit: 你隐身了！

original: Really? I dunno... I don't feel invisible.
traduit: 真的吗？我……我没觉得别人看不见呀。

original: Boo! Ahahahaha!
traduit: 嘣！啊哈哈哈哈哈哈！

original: Oooooh... weeeeoooooo....
That's right. Who's invisible? Me!
traduit: 是真的。是谁隐身啦？就是我！

original: Surprise! Ahaha!
traduit: 惊喜！啊哈哈！

original: Hey... So are you ever going to make me invisible or what?
traduit: 嘿……你到底要不要让我隐身？

original: Come on. Hurry it up already. The waiting is killing me.
traduit: 来吧。快点吧。我等得不耐烦了。

original: I can't wait to be invisible.
traduit: 我已经等不及要隐身了。

original: Okay, but I'll need a few moments to cast the spell on you.
traduit: 好吧，但我需要一点时间对你施法。

original: All right! I knew you'd do it. This is going to be so fun. You can't even imagine!
traduit: 好！我就知道你办得到。肯定很有意思。你根本无法想象！

original: Of course you're not invisible. Go bother someone else.
traduit: 当然不是真隐身了。去烦别人。

original: You're dumb.
traduit: 你个笨蛋。

original: Trust me. You're invisible.
traduit: 是真的。你已经隐身啦。

original: Okay, great!
traduit: 哦，太好了！

original: Now I'm finally going to have some fun around here.
traduit: 我现在终于可以在这里找点乐子了。

original: Bye!
traduit: 再见！

original: Trust me. You're invisible. (Lie)
traduit: 相信我。你已经隐身啦。（撒谎）

original: Sure, kid. Poof! You're invisible.
traduit: 当然了，孩子。噗！你已经隐身啦。

original: Really? I mean... I still feel like I'm here.
traduit: 真的吗？我是说……我怎么还觉得自己在这里。

original: I'm afraid I can't do that.
traduit: 恐怕我做不到。

original: Awww. And here I thought you could do it...
traduit: 嗷。我还以为你可以呢……

original: Well, I'll just have to think of something else then. Bye.
traduit: 好吧，那我就想想别的办法吧。再见。

original: Ooh, you're a wizard! I mean, you cast that spell just now, yeah? I was hoping you could make me invisible or something. Can you? Make me invisible?
traduit: 哦，你是巫师！我是说，你刚用了个法术吗？我希望你能让我隐个身什么的。你做得到吗？能让我隐身吗？

original: Bunch of foreign troublemakers. Wandering around, getting into mischief, scaring the citizens.
traduit: 一群异邦来的麻烦制造者。四处游荡捣乱，恐吓公民。

original: They've been told to stay out of the city, but keep trying to get back in.
traduit: 已经告诉过他们不许进城，但他们还是试图返回。

original: I have the statue.
traduit: 我拿到雕像了。

original: Give it to me quickly, before they see us together. You've riled up the priestesses, and the guards don't take kindly to that.
traduit: 快给我，别让他们看到咱们在一起。你激怒了祭司，卫兵们可不喜欢这一套。

original: Here's your share. Nicely done.
traduit: 这是你那份。干得好。

original: I saw Helgi's Ghost.
traduit: 我看到了海尔吉的鬼魂。

original: The poor child is probably beggin' for us to string up her murderin' father.
traduit: 可怜的孩子大概是想求我们把她那杀人放火的父亲吊死吧。

original: Best tell the Jarl.
traduit: 最好告诉领主。

original: The spirit world is strong in this place.
traduit: 这里的精魂世界很强大。

original: Look to the graveyard. That is where you'll find her.
traduit: 去墓地看看吧。你可能在那里找到她。

original: Helgi's ghost asked me to find her.
traduit: 海尔吉的鬼魂让我去找她。

original: You saw her ghost?
traduit: 你看见她的鬼魂了？

original: I'm glad it was you and not me.
traduit: 很高兴是你不是我。

original: She's buried outside of town. That's where I'd look.
traduit: 她就被埋在城外。去那里找找吧。

original: Ah, yes, I can imagine you'd want to settle that score. Last I heard he was at the Solitude Docks, conducting the Emperor's departure.
traduit: 啊，对了。我就知道你想报复。我最后一次收到的消息说，他在独孤城码头，负责皇帝离开时的指挥工作。

original: Commander Maro. Where is he?
traduit: 马洛指挥官。他在哪？

original: You mean... there's still a chance? But how? Our plan has gone to ruin, everyone is dead, the Family...
traduit: 你是说……还有机会？但能怎么办？我们的计划泡汤了，所有人都死了，整个家都……

original: The contract is still on. The true Emperor must be assassinated.
traduit: 契约还在继续。必须杀了真皇帝。

original: You found it? I've been looking for that blade for months. You took on all those bandits yourself?
traduit: 你找到了？我找这把剑好几个月了。你一个人对付了那么多强盗？

original: Thank you. Here, my father had a favorite sword and shield technique. Let me teach it to you, in honor of his memory.
traduit: 谢谢。来，这是我父亲最喜欢的剑盾技巧。为了纪念他，我来教教你。

original: I have your sword.
traduit: 我找到你的剑了。

original: Bless you, friend. You have renewed my hope.
traduit: 祝福你，朋友。你让我重新燃起了希望。

original: Before I came into Zenithar's calling, I confess I was a thief. But I learned a few things in my time that might help you survive. Let me show you.
traduit: 在我接受泽尼萨尔的感召之前，我曾经是个小偷。但我那阵子学的东西也许能保你一命。我来给你展示一下。

original: I have your amulet.
traduit: 我拿到了你的护符了。

original: If I cared for your opinion on our affairs, I'd ask. Now, if you'll excuse me.
traduit: 如果我在意你对我们关系的看法，我会问的。现在，不好意思了。

original: Nivenor! How can you say that? He gives you everything you ask for.
traduit: 尼维诺尔！你怎么能这么说？你要什么他就会给你什么啊。

original: How do you think? He's a pig. All I am to him is a warm body to lay with.
traduit: 你觉得呢？他就是头猪。对他来说，我就是一具躺在旁边的热乎尸体。

original: So how are things with you and Bolli?
traduit: 你和波利怎么样了？

original: No, no... please, I'm just tired is all. Thank you.
traduit: 不用，不用……没事，我只是有点累了。谢谢你。

original: Look, if you're in some sort of trouble, I could talk to Haelga.
traduit: 听着，你要是有什么麻烦，我会去和哈尔嘉谈谈的。

original: Don't worry about it, Svana. It's my problem... no need for you to get involved.
traduit: 别担心，斯瓦纳。这是我的问题……你没必要掺和进来。

original: Wujeeta, you're worrying me. You look so... well, so sad.
traduit: 巫杰塔，你让我很担心。你看着很……嗯，很伤心。

original: If there was any justice in the world, I'd just get this over with and die peacefully.
traduit: 如果这个世界还有正义可言，我宁愿就此了结，平静地死去。

original: It's an evil substance. Whoever's selling it to you should be brought to justice.
traduit: 这是很邪恶的东西。卖给你的人就该被抓起来。

original: I can't, Valindor. It won't let me go. It's taking over my life.
traduit: 不行啊，瓦林多。它不让我走，它已经占据了我的生活。

original: Wujeeta, you really need to stop using that skooma. It's very bad for your health and I wouldn't want to see anything happen to you.
traduit: 巫杰塔，你真的不能在用斯库玛了。这对你的健康很不好，我不想看你出什么事。

original: Not to worry, dear Svana. I promise you I can handle it, but your concern is quite flattering.
traduit: 别担心，亲爱的斯瓦纳。我保证，我能搞定的，但你的关心让我感到受宠若惊。

original: Relaxing? They must be working you to the bone! You should rest before you do yourself in.
traduit: 轻松？他们一定快把你累死了！你应该在感到累之前休息一下。

original: Oh, it's not so terrible. I actually find the work quite relaxing.
traduit: 哦，没那么糟糕。事实上我觉得这样工作很轻松。

original: How do you do it, Valindor? How do you work at Black-Briar Meadery and the Fishery without getting exhausted?
traduit: 你是怎么做到的，瓦林多？你是怎么在黑棘蜜酒庄和渔场同时工作还不觉得累的？

original: Sorry, Tythis. I'll get it to you somehow.
traduit: 抱歉，泰迪斯。我会想办法还你的。

original: If you'd stop wasting your coin on that skooma, you'd have enough gold to live on.
traduit: 如果你不再把钱浪费在斯库玛上，你早就有钱活着了。

original: Just give me a few more days and I promise I'll come up with it.
traduit: 再给我几天时间，我保证会还的。

original: Niluva, you promised me you'd pay me back yesterday. So what's the story?
traduit: 尼路瓦，你昨天答应过我会还钱的。那今天有什么新故事？

original: I'll make sure it's sent right away.
traduit: 我保证马上就寄出去。

original: I'll draft a letter to Rythe. If you could have it sent to Cheydinhal for me, that would make up for your blunder.
traduit: 我要给瑞特写封信，你帮我送到夏丁赫尔吧。这就算你弥补错误了。

original: I'm sure my mother can compensate you for it.
traduit: 我母亲一定会补偿你的。

original: Ingun, you clumsy fool! You've tainted our entire supply of Painted Troll Fat. You have no idea how hard that was to get.
traduit: 因甘，你个笨手笨脚的傻瓜！咱们所有的画中巨魔脂肪都被你污染了。你知不知道这东西有多难弄到。

original: Very well, I'll keep practicing them.
traduit: 好吧，我会继续练习的。

original: Ingun! If you want to remain in my shop as an apprentice I expect you to act like one. No exceptions!
traduit: 因甘！想要留在我店里当学徒，希望你表现得像个学徒。没有例外！

original: This is an utter waste of time.
traduit: 这完全是浪费时间啊。

original: Until you can do those formulas with your eyes shut, you'll never be ready to master the more difficult ones.
traduit: 除非你能闭着眼用好这些配方，否则你就没做好准备掌握更难的。

original: I don't understand, Elgrim. The formulas you're giving me are for novices but I've advanced well passed that point.
traduit: 我不明白，艾尔格瑞姆。你给我的配方是给新手用的，但我已经进步很多了。

original: And a hefty cut for yourself too I'm sure. Just see to it the items are secured and the rest disposed of properly this time.
traduit: 我肯定你也能分一大块。这次要确保物品安全，其他的也要妥善处理。

original: The coin isn't just for the men, there's a lot of people that need to be compensated in order to make this happen.
traduit: 钱不只是给这些人的，为了实现这个目标，得补偿很多人。

original: For what it's costing me, I should be handed the merchandise on a silver platter.
traduit: 不管花了多少，我的商品应该被放在银盘上。

original: My agents are telling me that we've appropriated the caravan from Hammerfell... with minimal losses.
traduit: 我的探子告诉我，我们已经从落锤征用了车队……以最小的损失。

original: Anything you can do to keep his filthy hands off of me would be a welcome change.
traduit: 只要你能让他的脏手别碰我，就是个好改变了。

original: I'll talk to him, but he's stubborn. He's like his mother; he sees what he wants and he won't quit until he has it.
traduit: 我会跟他谈谈，但他很顽固。就像他妈一样，知道自己想要什么，不得到手就不罢休。

original: It's Hemming. He's making advances and I can't bear the man's presence. Is there anything you can do?
traduit: 是海姆英。他在向我求爱，我受不了那个人的存在了。你能做点什么吗？

original: Well that depends on what the favor is, now doesn't it.
traduit: 那要看你需要什么了。

original: Maul, can I ask a personal favor of you?
traduit: 摩尔，能帮个忙吗？

original: Just stay away from me and maybe I won't weave a spell to shrink something that matters to you.
traduit: 离我远点，不然我就要施法缩小你在乎的那话儿了。

original: You listen to me. I'd be careful wagging that pretty little tongue at me like that otherwise I may just have it cut off.
traduit: 你必须听我的。我会很小心地用你那可爱的小舌头，而不是割了去。

original: I find the concept of sleeping with you not only repulsive, but morally unsettling. Does that answer your question?
traduit: 我觉得跟你上床不仅恶心，而且让人良心不安。这算是回答了你的问题吗？

original: So, have you thought about what I said?
traduit: 你有考虑过我说的吗？

original: Let's just say my mother knows which pockets to line and keep it at that.
traduit: 这么说吧，我母亲知道该挂上哪几只口袋然后保持下去。

original: It's surprising the Council is allowing a Nord rule Riften under the Imperial flag. That can't be their first choice.
traduit: 令人惊讶的是，元老院居然会允许一个诺德人在帝国的旗帜下统治裂谷城。这肯定不是他们的首选。

original: Yes, she's been grooming herself for this for quite a long time.
traduit: 是啊，她已经为这个准备很长时间了。

original: Your mother seems to have taken to her seat quite well.
traduit: 你母亲似乎很好地坐在了位子上。

original: I'll let him know.
traduit: 我会告诉他的。

original: Next time you speak to him, tell him to clean up his own messes. I'm not about to jeopardize this position for a bunch of low-life thugs.
traduit: 下次你跟他说话的时候，让他自己收拾烂摊子。我可不想因为一群低贱的混混搞丢了自己的位子。

original: I've spoken to Brynjolf and he assures me it'll be taken care of.
traduit: 我跟布林乔夫谈过了，他说保证处理好。

original: Any word about our little problem in the Ratway?
traduit: 鼠道那边有关于咱们的小问题的消息了吗？

original: I'm almost certain he'll reach the Imperial City tomorrow, so we should have an answer by the end of the week.
traduit: 我保证他会在明天抵达帝都，所以咱们周末就能得到答复了。

original: Good. If I need to light a few fires in order to get what we need to defend this place from the Stormcloaks, so be it.
traduit: 好。如果需要点几把火来为我们取得对抗风暴斗篷所需的东西，那就去吧。

original: Yes, and I sent it with our fastest courier and under the cover of night, exactly as you specified.
traduit: 是，我照你说的，派最快的信差连夜寄出去了。

original: Hemming, have you dispatched that letter I gave you yesterday?
traduit: 海姆英，我昨天给你的信寄出去了吗？

original: No, mother. The execution will proceed as planned.
traduit: 不，母亲。行刑会按计划执行的。

original: Are you going soft on me, Hemming? Perhaps I made the wrong choice installing you as steward.
traduit: 你觉得我会心软吗，海姆英？也许我选你当总管是个错误。

original: But, mother... this is quite a sizable contribution and the crime doesn't befit such a harsh punishment.
traduit: 但是，母亲……这是笔可观的保释金，而且这种罪，不适合如此严厉的刑罚。

original: The execution will proceed as planned.
traduit: 按期行刑。

original: There's still the matter of the prisoner to discuss. Now, his family is willing to contribute handsomely if we release him.
traduit: 犯人的事还得商量一下。如果我放了他，他的家人会愿意慷慨解囊的。

original: Yes, milady. Sorry, milday. They will be completed.
traduit: 是，夫人。抱歉夫人。会完成的。

original: Excuses are not acceptable in my court. When I ask for something I expect results, and I expect them immediately.
traduit: 在我的宫廷上不接受借口。我提出要求时，期待的是结果，而且是立竿见影的结果。

original: I'm sorry, milady. The components for those elixirs are quite volatile and in some cases, very dangerous to handle. I must take care.
traduit: 抱歉，夫人。这些灵药的成分非常易挥发，在某种情况下，处理起来非常危险。我必须小心。

original: Why are the potions I requested not completed?
traduit: 为什么我要求的药剂还没有完成？

original: You sent me a letter, didn't you? Thanking me for killing your rival?
traduit: 你给我寄信了？感谢我杀了你的对头？

original: You wanted to thank me for killing <Alias=Victim>?
traduit: 你想感谢我杀了<Alias=Victim>？

original: What if I don't want to be a werewolf?
traduit: 如果我不想变成狼人呢？

original: That is your choice. We will not force you. But to join the Circle, your blood must be as ours.
traduit: 选择权在你。我们不会强迫你。但是想加入圆环，你必须与我们拥有一样的血。

original: Meet us here when you're ready.
traduit: 准备好了就来这儿找我们。

original: No. Now shove off.
traduit: 不行。躲开点。

original: Snilf, it's me. I don't have a roof over my head either, remember?
traduit: 斯尼尔福，是我。我也没地方住，你忘了？

original: Oh if only I could provide more than this coin. I hope it'll do.
traduit: 哦，如果我能提供比这枚金币更好的东西就好了。希望能够你用。

original: Again? Buy some food this time will you?
traduit: 又来？你这次能买点吃的吗？

original: Yes, I hope this helps.
traduit: 好吧，希望能帮上你。

original: Another uncounted causality of this war. Here you are, you poor man.
traduit: 这场战争另一个不可估量的因果啊。给你吧，可怜人。

original: Certainly, my good man. Here.
traduit: 当然，朋友。给你。

original: You're disgusting, stay away from me.
traduit: 你真恶心，离我远点。

original: If I had even a pot to piss in, I'd gladly share. Sorry.
traduit: 如果我还有的话，那我乐意分享。抱歉了。

original: Yes, I hope this helps you.
traduit: 好，希望这个能帮上你。

original: Absolutely. Here you are. Be well.
traduit: 当然了。给你。保重。

original: Ugh, you smell horrible. Get yourself cleaned up.
traduit: 啊，你闻着太臭了。把自己弄干净。

original: Very well, here.
traduit: 当然可以，给。

original: Oh you poor thing, you must be starving. Come to the temple later and let us feed you.
traduit: 哦可怜人，你一定饿坏了。待会儿到神殿来，我们会让你吃饱的。

original: Snilf, I told you begging isn't the answer. I expect to see you at the temple later.
traduit: 斯尼尔福，我告诉过你乞讨不是办法。希望你稍后来神殿吧。

original: Sorry, no time. I'm late.
traduit: 抱歉，没时间了。我迟到了。

original: If you want to awaken from your next slumber, I suggest you leave me be.
traduit: 如果你能从睡梦里醒来，建议你离我远点。

original: What? No. Get away from me.
traduit: 什么？不行。离我远点。

original: I suppose. Just get something to eat and stay away from the Bee and Barb for a change.
traduit: 可以。去吃点东西吧，离蜂与钩远点，换换口味吧。

original: Very well, please use it for food.
traduit: 可以，拿取买吃的。

original: Never. Now move aside.
traduit: 别想。躲一边去。

original: Spare a coin?
traduit: 能给个金币吗？

original: If you could spare a septim, I'd be grateful.
traduit: 如果你能给个塞普汀，我会很感激的。

original: Help out an old man here with some coin, would you?
traduit: 帮老头一把吧，好吗？

original: Hey, can I get a gold or two?
traduit: 嘿，能给我一两个金币吗？

original: I could sure use some coin.
traduit: 我应该是需要点钱。

original: Edda, you know well I barely have any coin to call my own. I'm sorry.
traduit: 艾达，你也知道我自己也没钱。抱歉了。

original: You must be starving. Here, spend it well.
traduit: 你一定饿坏了吧。给，拿去花吧。

original: All right, all right. Here.
traduit: 好吧，好吧，给。

original: Yes, of course. This war is causing your woes, it's hardly your fault.
traduit: 是啊，当然。战争造成了你的痛苦，这不是你的错。

original: Certainly, good lady. Here.
traduit: 当然，女士。给你。

original: Are you joking? Go earn a living and stop loafing!
traduit: 你在开玩笑？去找点活儿干，别再游手好闲了！

original: I would if I could, but I can barely make ends meet.
traduit: 如果我有，肯定会给你的，但我自己也入不敷出了。

original: Here, this should help.
traduit: 给，你应该用得上。

original: Of course, here. Be well.
traduit: 当然，给你。保重吧。

original: Maybe you should look for work instead of begging for coin.
traduit: 也许你应该去工作而不是要饭。

original: Oh you poor thing! Come by the temple and my husband and I will keep you fed.
traduit: 啊，可怜的人！请到神殿去吧，我和我丈夫会让你吃饱的。

original: Edda, Edda. There's no need for this. Just come by the temple and we'll care for you.
traduit: 艾达，艾达。没必要。来神殿一趟吧，我们会照顾你的。

original: Sorry, all out of coin.
traduit: 抱歉，我也没钱了。

original: I've told you before, and I'll tell you again. Leave me alone.
traduit: 我跟你说过，我现在再说一遍。别打扰我。

original: Ugh, you reek. Get out of my way.
traduit: 啊，臭东西。滚开。

original: Here you go, dear.
traduit: 给你吧，亲爱的。

original: Oh, very well. Just try and clean yourself up.
traduit: 哦，很好。只是你得想办法洗洗干净。

original: Get away from me, you filthy woman.
traduit: 离我远点，你这脏女人。

original: Please milady, can you spare a gold coin for an old woman?
traduit: 拜托了，夫人，能分我这个老女人一枚金币吗？

original: Please my lord, can you spare a gold coin for an old woman?
traduit: 拜托了，大人，能分我这个老女人一枚金币吗？

original: Please help me, I'm starving.
traduit: 请帮帮我，我快饿坏了。

original: Please, I don't have anything to eat.
traduit: 拜托了，我没有什么可吃了。

original: Can you spare any coin?
traduit: 能给点钱吗？

original: Spare a septim?
traduit: 给个塞普汀吧？

original: Gladly. He won't bother you anymore, I promise.
traduit: 乐意效劳，我保证他不会再打扰你了。

original: There's a new guard nosing around the meadery. Can you do something about it?
traduit: 有个新来的卫兵在蜜酒庄附近打探消息。你能做点什么吧？

original: Sure, Ton. You know I'm good for it.
traduit: 当然，托尼。你知道我很擅长。

original: I need you to do me a favor, Dirge.
traduit: 我需要你帮个忙，挽歌。

original: That's all they are... rumors. So quit worrying.
traduit: 这些都是……谣言。所以别再操心了。

original: Look, I need to know. What's going on between you and Brynjolf?
traduit: 听着，我需要知道，你和布林乔夫之间怎么了？

original: How dare you! After all we've been through together? How can you do this to me!
traduit: 你怎么回事！我们都经历这么多了？你怎么能这么对我！

original: I can take care of myself.
traduit: 我能照顾好自己。

original: Come on, Ton. Marry me. Let me take care of you.
traduit: 得了吧，托尼。嫁给我吧，我会照顾你的。

original: I don't want to settle. I like things the way they are.
traduit: 我不想定居。我还是喜欢现在的样子。

original: Why can't you just settle down and run the Flagon with me?
traduit: 你为什么不能安定下来和我一起经营漏壶呢？

original: Vekel, you have no shame. I'll get you the rest like I said. I want that hammer.
traduit: 威克尔，别不害臊了。我会按约定把剩下的给你。我要那把锤子。

original: Yeah, funny thing about that. The price was a hundred higher than I expected.
traduit: 是啊，有意思的是，价格比我预料的高了一百金币。

original: You did? Thanks. I get you the rest of your coin by tomorrow.
traduit: 真的？谢谢。我明天把剩下的钱给你。

original: Good news. I found that dwarven hammer you were looking for.
traduit: 有好消息。我找到了你要的矮人锤。

original: I'll pass it along.
traduit: 我会传达的。

original: You know what I mean. Tell your boss that rough is rough, but when someone pulls a dagger fun time is over.
traduit: 你明白我的意思。跟你的老板说，粗暴就粗暴，但有人掏刀子，就没有乐子可言了。

original: They aren't my boys. Do I look like the leadin' type?
traduit: 他们不是我的孩子。我看起来像个主导者吗？

original: You need to tell your boys to place nice, Delvin. Almost threw two of them into the well last night.
traduit: 你得告诉你的小子们老实点，戴尔文。昨晚差点把两个扔进井里。

original: Well if it turns up, I'll be willing to buy.
traduit: 如果能找到，我愿意买。

original: Maybe. That stuff's gettin' tough to bring across the border with all the Argonian patrols.
traduit: 也许吧。阿尔贡巡逻队太多了，要把东西带过边境越来越难了。

original: Well, if some Moon Sugar should fall into your lap...
traduit: 好吧，如果有月亮糖的话……

original: Puttin' together another shipment from Morrowind, Vekel. Lookin' for anythin' special?
traduit: 又有一批货从晨风运来了，威克尔。在找什么特别的东西吗？

original: Am I responsible if the vintage was off on that case? Sorry, you know the rules Vekel. No refunds.
traduit: 这酒年份到了也得我负责吗？抱歉了，威克尔，你知道规矩。不退款。

original: Sure, it tastes great. Only one problem. You said it can make the darkness as clear as day when you drink it. Guess what? It doesn't.
traduit: 是啊，味道好极了。就一个问题。你说喝了它看黑暗像白天一样清晰。你猜怎么着？没这回事。

original: What do you mean? That wine tastes finer than anythin' Surilie Brothers ever made.
traduit: 你什么意思？这酒比苏瑞利兄弟出的任何一款都香醇啊。

original: All right, Delvin. What gives with that case of Shadowbanish you sold me?
traduit: 好吧，戴尔文。你卖给我的那箱驱影酒有什么用？

original: She's in the Bannered Mare. She knows you're out here.
traduit: 她就在悬旗母马。不知道你就在外面。

original: We cannot go after her, not without drawing attention.
traduit: 我们不能去找她，容易打草惊蛇。

original: You must bring her to us.
traduit: 你得带她来见我们。

original: Lead her to the Whiterun stables, outside of the city. We will wait for you there.
traduit: 把她带到白漫城外的马厩去。我们在那儿等你。

original: What do I get for telling you?
traduit: 告诉你有什么好处？

original: Money, if that is what you wish.
traduit: 钱，如果你想要的话。

original: Now tell me where she is!
traduit: 现在告诉我她在哪儿！

original: I've seen the woman you're looking for.
traduit: 我见过你要找的女人了。

original: You have? Where? Tell me now!
traduit: 真的？在哪儿？快告诉我！

original: Why are you after Saadia?
traduit: 你为什么要找萨蒂亚？

original: She sold the city out to the Aldmeri Dominion. Were it not for her betrayal, Taneth could have held its ground in the war.
traduit: 她把城市出卖给了先祖神洲。要不是她叛变，塔尼斯在战争中也许就能守住了。

original: The other noble houses discovered her betrayal and she fled. They want her brought back alive.
traduit: 其他贵族家族发现了她的背叛，所以她就逃了。他们希望抓活的。

original: The resistance against the Dominion is alive and well in Hammerfell, and they want justice.
traduit: 在落锤，反抗先祖神洲的势力仍然强大，他们希望伸张正义。

original: Amazing... you can see how the Akaviri craftsmen were beginning to embrace the more flowing Nordic style...
traduit: 很神奇……能看得出阿卡维尔工匠已经开始吸收更为平滑的诺德风格了……

original: We're here for Alduin's Wall, right, Esbern?
traduit: 伊思本，我们是来找奥杜因之墙的吧？

original: Yes, of course. We'll have more time to look around later, I suppose. Let's see what's up ahead.
traduit: 啊，对，没错。我想以后有的是时间四处逛逛，还是看看前面有什么吧。

original: Fascinating! Original Akaviri bas-reliefs... almost entirely intact!
traduit: 何等迷人！原生的阿卡维尔浮雕……保存的相当完好！

original: The Companions are werewolves?
traduit: 战友团都是狼人？

original: Not everyone, but all the Circle are. It's a secret to everybody.
traduit: 不全是，但全体圆环成员都是。这是个秘密。

original: Not all of us, just the members of the Circle. We shouldn't be talking about this anyway.
traduit: 不全是，只有圆环的成员。反正我们也不谈起。

original: Who are the Silver Hand?
traduit: 银手是什么人？

original: Bad people who don't like werewolves.
traduit: 不喜欢狼人的坏家伙。

original: So they don't like us either.
traduit: 所以他们也不喜欢我们。

original: A group of werewolf hunters who have gotten wise to our little secret.
traduit: 一群知道了我们小秘密的狼人猎手。

original: They've made it their mission to hunt us down, but we are hunters ourselves.
traduit: 他们把追捕我们作为目标，但我们才是真猎人。

original: Why did Skjor call this my Trial?
traduit: 斯科约尔为什么说这是我的“试炼”？

original: I watch you to make sure you are honorable.
traduit: 我会观察你，以确保你确实心怀荣耀。

original: If you are honorable and strong, then I can call you brother.
traduit: 如果你高尚且强壮，那我会称你为兄弟。

original: If you are honorable and strong, then I can call you sister.
traduit: 如果你高尚且强壮，那我会称你为姐妹。

original: I would hope that's obvious.
traduit: 我希望能够轻易见证这一切。

original: Do well here, and you'll be a full member of the Companions.
traduit: 好好干，你就能正式成为战友团的一员了。

original: Fail, and it won't matter anyway.
traduit: 如果失败了，也没关系。

original: What is Wuuthrad?
traduit: 巫斯拉德是什么？

original: Ysgramor was the hero who started the Companions. Wuuthrad was his weapon.
traduit: 伊斯格拉默是创建了战友团的英雄，而巫斯拉德就是他的武器。

original: He came from the ancient homeland and killed all the elves.
traduit: 他自古老的故土而来，杀了所有精灵。

original: But not all of them, because some of them are still here.
traduit: 但也不是全杀光了，因为还有些残存在这里。

original: It was the blade hefted by Ysgramor when he returned to drive the elves out of the old Skyrim.
traduit: 那是伊斯格拉默将精灵赶出古天际时挥舞的武器。

original: Without that axe, this whole land would be overrun still.
traduit: 没有了那把斧子，这片土地就会再度受到蹂躏。

original: Wuuthrad is a relic of Ysgramor. Through that weapon, we trace our line straight to the first harbinger of makind in this land.
traduit: 巫斯拉德是伊斯格拉默的遗物。我们藉由那件武器，追寻着这片土地上的首位先驱。

original: What fragments we have are displayed in honor, but we always seek more.
traduit: 我们持有的所有碎片都被展示出来以示敬意，但我们还在设法找回更多碎片。

original: He'll answer any questions you have.
traduit: 他会回答你所有问题。

original: Try not to disappoint. Or to get him killed.
traduit: 尽量别让他失望，也别害死他。

original: She'll answer any questions you have.
traduit: 她会回答你所有问题。

original: Try not to disappoint. Or to get her killed.
traduit: 尽量别让她失望，也别害死她。

original: We've been awaiting your return.
traduit: 我们一直在等你回来。

original: Leave this place... Leave this place...
traduit: 离开这个地方……离开这个地方……

original: That door up ahead... looks perfect for hiding an ambush. Be ready.
traduit: 前面那扇门……看起来很适合埋伏。做好准备。

original: Why is your cemetery so large?
traduit: 你们这里的墓地怎么这么大？

original: Many battles have been fought here over the centuries. Graves were dug and monuments built, and the town grew around these.
traduit: 千百年来这里发生过很多战争。人们挖了坟，立了碑，城镇就在这里兴起了。

original: In time, Falkreath came to be known as the heroes' graveyard. Many noble Jarls and renowned warriors asked to be buried here.
traduit: 随着时间推移，佛克瑞斯也因为英雄的坟墓而闻名。很多贵族领主和著名的战士都要求埋葬在此。

original: Falkreath's reputation has faded somewhat, but the graves remain, reminding us of the one inevitable truth of life.
traduit: 佛克瑞斯的名声已经有些褪色了，但这些坟墓仍在，提醒我们生命中一个不可避免的真理。

original: How long have you been a Steward?
traduit: 你当总管多久了？

original: It was Dengeir who made me a steward, long ago when he was young.
traduit: 是丹格尔任命我的，很久以前的事了，那时候他还年轻。

original: When Dengeir's health began to fail, young Sidgeir was appointed Jarl in his stead. It was simpler just to keep me as steward.
traduit: 随着丹格尔身体状况恶化，年轻的西德盖尔被任命为领主。让我继续当总管更简单了。

original: Sidgeir has no interest in running his hold, and so leaves such matters to me. As for my part, I do my best to see that folk are treated fairly.
traduit: 西德盖尔不想治理他的领地，所以事情都交给我了。就我而言，我会尽我所能确保人们得到公平的对待。

original: Does your inexperience make your job difficult?
traduit: 你是否因缺乏经验而困扰？

original: Difficult? I am a Jarl. I eat the most succulent meat, drink the finest ale and hunt with the best hounds in the hold.
traduit: 困扰？我是领主啊。我吃着最鲜美的肉，喝着最上等的酒，带着领地里最好的猎犬打猎。

original: Meanwhile, my very capable steward sees to the needs of the smallfolk and ensures that my hold runs smoothly.
traduit: 同时，我那个非常能干的总管负责照顾小民的需要，保证我的领地运行平稳。

original: Being a Jarl could hardly be simpler. You should try it sometime.
traduit: 当领主再简单不过了。你要是能有机会也可以试试。

original: We're on the right track. She's been through here as well.
traduit: 我们的方向没错，她也来过这里。

original: Karliah always was a nimble minx... slipping passed these draugr must be child's play for her.
traduit: 卡莱亚一直是个敏捷的小娘们……绕过这些尸鬼对她来说小菜一碟。

original: Bone chimes... clever. Rigged to wake the draugr I'd bet. Don't blunder into any of them.
traduit: 骨编钟……聪明。我敢打赌，这东西能把尸鬼吵醒。不要贸然闯进他们中间。

original: There's two more of them ahead.
traduit: 前面还有两个。

original: Pull the chain over there, and watch out for the spikes. Looks like Karliah reset all of the traps.
traduit: 把锁链拉起来，小心尖刺。看来卡莱亚重新布置了所有陷阱。

original: The stench in here... this place smells of death. Be on your guard.
traduit: 一股恶臭……这地方充斥着死亡的气息。保持警惕。

original: Karliah's been through here. What does she expect to find?
traduit: 卡莱亚来过这里。她到底想找什么？

original: How did you become a Jarl while so young?
traduit: 你怎么这么年轻就当上领主的？

original: My uncle Dengeir was Jarl until a short time ago. His old age and failing health caught up with him, and he stepped down.
traduit: 我叔叔丹格尔前不久还是领主。但他年纪大了，身体不好，所以辞职了。

original: He now serves us honorably as Thane, and to the great benefit of the hold, I now serve as Jarl.
traduit: 他现在光荣地担任武卫为我们服务。而对我们领地大有好处的是，我成了领主。

original: And, once more, I prove Commander Maro the fool. I told him you can't stop the Dark Brotherhood. Never could.
traduit: 我再次证明了马洛指挥官是个傻瓜。我告诉过他，他阻止不了黑暗兄弟会。永远不能。

original: Yes sir.
traduit: 是，长官。

original: The honor has been mine. You should be proud of what we've accomplished here. The Dark Brotherhood is no more. And the Emperor, finally, is safe.
traduit: 这也是我的荣幸。你该为我们在这里取得的成就感到骄傲。黑暗兄弟会不复存在，皇帝安全返回。

original: Oh... I see. Well then, let me be just say that it's been an honor serving under you Commander Maro.
traduit: 哦……我知道了。我只说吧，在您手下服役是我的荣幸，马洛指挥官。

original: Hmph. Now there's an excellent question. An excellent question, indeed. Truth is, as soon as the Emperor sets sail,  I'm resigning my position.
traduit: 嗯。这是个好问题。好问题啊。其实，等陛下启航之后，我就会辞职了。

original: Very good. And you'll be returning to... Well, if you don't mind me asking, where exactly will you be going now, sir?
traduit: 很好。你就能回……那个，您要是不介意我问的话，您现在要去哪儿呢，长官？

original: It'll be shuttered by the end of the month.
traduit: 这个月底就要关了。

original: And the outpost at Dragon Bridge?
traduit: 龙桥的哨站呢？

original: The library is just through here. We're getting close now.
traduit: 图书馆就在这儿。我们已经快到了。

original: The undercroft is ahead... ugh, Necromancers. Be careful.
traduit: 下面是个地下墓穴……呃，死灵法师。小心点。

original: Yes, you certainly do.
traduit: 对，你当然拿到了。

original: You'll be going back to the College, then? I, uhh... I think perhaps I'll wait a bit before venturing there myself.
traduit: 你要回学院了吗？我，呃……我在回去之前，先等一等。

original: Let this whole thing blow over, you know. Give certain parties a chance to forget what I may have done.
traduit: 这件事就这么过去吧。让其他人先淡忘我的所作所为。

original: Still, you've gotten me out of that cage, and I won't forget it. Thank you again, and good luck to you.
traduit: 但你把我从笼子里救了出来，我是不会忘记的。再次感谢你，祝你好运。

original: I've got what I came for.
traduit: 我得到了我想要的。

original: Have the books, do you? I mean, I'm very glad. That's wonderful.
traduit: 你拿到了书对吧？我是说，我很高兴。这是好事。

original: You could, you know, let me out of this cage now.
traduit: 你应该可以，那个，放我出去。

original: How long have you been here?
traduit: 你在这里多久了？

original: First it was 6 months, then a year, then 2 years. Now I'm in for life.
traduit: 开始是六个月，后来是一年，两年。现在要终身监禁了。

original: What are you in for?
traduit: 你是怎么进来的？

original: The first time? Thieving. The second time? Thieving. The third time? Thieving. It kind of keeps going like that.
traduit: 第一次？偷东西。第二次？偷东西。第三次？还是偷东西。一直这样。

original: Long enough.
traduit: 够长了。

original: Don't want to talk about it.
traduit: 我不想谈这个。

original: A couple of years? I wasn't a Forsworn when I came, but I joined up when I got in. Easier that way.
traduit: 有几年了？我来的时候还不是弃誓者，但进来以后我就入伙了。这样过得更容易些。

original: Guards say I murdered someone. I was just sleeping off some mead in my aunt's house, but that didn't stop them from arresting me.
traduit: 卫兵说我杀人了。我只是在姨妈家喝了蜜酒睡觉，但他们还是把我抓了。

original: I don't even know who they said I killed.
traduit: 我都不知道他们说我杀了谁。

original: Guards brought me in about 12 years ago. Was running a good group of bandits up until then.
traduit: 卫兵十二年前押我来的。在那之前我手底下还有一帮强盗。

original: But these Forsworn. They're nothing like the men I cobbled together. They're real killers.
traduit: 但这些弃誓者和我东拼西凑的烂货完全不一样。他们是真正的杀手。

original: Year seven, I think? Surprised I haven't cut my own throat out by now, but something keeps me going.
traduit: 七年了吧？奇怪的是我还没自行割喉了断，还有东西在支持我活下去。

original: Murder. Banditry. Assault. Theft. And lollygagging.
traduit: 杀人、抢劫、袭击、偷窃。还有虚度光阴。

original: I'm a Forsworn. One of our raids went bad, and I got captured.
traduit: 我是个弃誓者。有次我们的突袭失败，我就被抓了。

original: Would've been fine dying for the Reach with my kinsmen, but the Silver-Bloods want their ore mined, so they threw me in here.
traduit: 我本可以和我的族人一起为瑞驰而死，但银血家想要开采矿石，所以把我扔到这里来。

original: Valmir, you rat. You're not a soldier at all! Must be one of the Thalmor!
traduit: 瓦尔米尔，你这鼠辈。你根本不是军人！肯定是梭默！

original: Oh! Um, he he... Hold on... I... I can explain...
traduit: 哦！嗯，他他，等等……我……我可以解释……

original: Wait... who in blazes is this?
traduit: 等等……这到底是谁啊？

original: Hmm....
Why don't you go in there and get it?
traduit: 为什么你不进去拿呢？

original: Wait, it's haunted? I don't like ghosts... let me think about this for a minute...
traduit: 等等，那里闹鬼？我不喜欢鬼魂……让我想想……

original: My men? What did you do? You'll die for this.
traduit: 我的人？你做了什么？你要付出代价。

original: We're close now. I can see the camp.
traduit: 我们已经接近了。我能看到营地了。

original: It's just across the bridge and up that hill.
traduit: 过了桥，再到那座山就是了。

original: I'll make it worth your while. (Bribe)
traduit: 我不会让你吃亏的。（贿赂）

original: I can't believe it! How did ya' talk her into this?
traduit: 简直不敢相信！你是怎么说服她的？

original: Never mind, I don't care. I'm just glad I don't gotta' work for Maven anymore.
traduit: 没关系，我不在乎。总算不用为玛雯工作了。

original: Here, ya' did me a favor, I guess I owe you one.
traduit: 你帮了我一个忙，我欠你的情。

original: Here, it's your debt with Maven. You're free.
traduit: 这是你打给玛雯的欠条。你自由了。

original: You ain't got enough coin to make my problems go away unless ya' can talk Maven Black-Briar into letting me outta' my debt.
traduit: 你没有足够的钱来帮我解决问题，除非你能说服玛雯·黑棘豁免我的债务。

original: You try and set one foot in this yard, and I'll cut it off.
traduit: 胆敢踏入院子一步，我就剁了你的脚。

original: I need to get inside Mercer's house.
traduit: 我需要进到墨瑟的家里。

original: Of mine? What is it?
traduit: 我吗？什么东西？

original: I have something of yours.
traduit: 我有些你的东西。

original: No visitors. No way. Now piss off, before ya' make me mad.
traduit: 这里禁止入内。没有商量。现在赶紧滚，别把我惹毛了。

original: So, buy him off?
traduit: 那就，收买他？

original: Sure, but he'll ask for a whole lot. I mean, you are asking him to betray Mercer Frey.
traduit: 当然可以，但他会索要很多。我是说，你是在让他背叛墨瑟·弗雷。

original: Your best bet would be to erase his debt with Maven Black-Briar. If you talk to her, she might be able to give you the details.
traduit: 最好的办法就是消除他和玛雯·黑棘之间的债务。如果你和她谈谈，或许能知道更多细节。

original: Of course, you could just run him through and take what you need off of his corpse... I could care less.
traduit: 当然，你也可以直接干掉他，然后从尸体上取走你需要的东西……我不太在乎。

original: I want to get on his good side.
traduit: 我还是想让他走正道。

original: Vald? Good side? I think you have the wrong person.
traduit: 沃德？正道？你可能找错人了。

original: The only thing Vald understands is gold. A man after my own heart.
traduit: 沃德只认钱。和我差不多。

original: Brynjolf said you have info on Vald.
traduit: 布林乔夫说你有沃德的情报。

original: That pig? Oh, I have info on him. More than you care to know.
traduit: 那头猪？我有情报。比你想要的还多。

original: You mentioned a watchdog?
traduit: 你刚才提到了个看门狗？

original: That'd be Vald. A real piece of work, that one.
traduit: 应该是沃德。那家伙很厉害。

original: Mercer's holding something over his head, keeping him loyal.
traduit: 墨瑟拿住了他什么把柄，让他死心塌地的。

original: Talk to Vex. She used to know him very well... if you catch my meaning.
traduit: 和小烦聊聊。她以前和沃德很熟……懂我意思吧。

original: I don't suppose the ramp is easy to access.
traduit: 我想那个坡道不容易上去。

original: No. It's some sort of crazy contraption Mercer commissioned for quick escapes.
traduit: 不。那是墨瑟为了快速逃跑设计的疯狂装置。

original: I'd wager a well-placed shot at the ramp's mechanism would lower it in a hurry.
traduit: 我敢打赌，只要瞄准坡道的机械装置射击，就会唰的一下降下来。

original: What's the best way to get into Riftweald Manor?
traduit: 进入裂野庄园的最佳方案是什么？

original: Good question. I've only set foot inside a few times myself and that was in Mercer's company.
traduit: 好问题。我也只进过几次，而且还是在墨瑟的陪同下。

original: If you can get past his trained watchdog, I think your best bet might be the ramp to the second floor balcony in his backyard.
traduit: 如果你能通过他那只训练有素的看门狗，我想最好的办法就是从他家后院通往二楼露台的坡道进去。

original: Because war is good for business, of course.
traduit: 因为仗一打起来，生意才好做，这还用说吗。

original: And what makes you think that?
traduit: 你怎么会这么想呢？

original: The war? That is not a reason to leave, it is a reason to stay.
traduit: 战争？那可是留下而不是离开的理由。

original: That may be, but what of the war? That is not so easy to escape from.
traduit: 也许吧，但战争呢？这可不是说躲就能躲的。

original: I admit, the dragons are a concern, but we can avoid them if we do not stay in one place for too long.
traduit: 我承认，龙确实是个麻烦，但只要咱们别在一个地方待太久，就能避开它们。

original: Between the war and the return of the dragons, I wonder if we should not leave Skyrim and ply our trade elsewhere.
traduit: 现在又是打仗又是龙灾，我在想，要不要离开天际去其他地方做生意。

original: Hm. I had not thought of it that way.
traduit: 嗯。这我倒是没想到。

original: Hah, you have the foresight of a Khajiit in a sandstorm. If we offer a discount to both sides, the winners will persecute us for helping the losers.
traduit: 哈，你的眼光就像在沙尘暴中的卡吉特。如果我们给两方都打折的话，到时赢家会因为我们帮助过输家而迫害我们。

original: Both. One or the other is bound to win the war eventually. Why not curry favor now, so that the victor will look upon us kindly?
traduit: 两方都给。毕竟这场战争终究会有一方取得胜利，那为什么不趁现在拍拍马屁？这样胜利者也会因为我们帮助过他们而善待我们了。

original: The soldiers? From which side, the Stormcloaks, or the Imperials?
traduit: 士兵？哪边的，风暴斗篷还是帝国？

original: I wonder if we should offer discounts to the soldiers.
traduit: 我在想我们是否应该给士兵打折。

original: And we will lose customers. Let us hope that if there are dragons, there are only a few and they are not too foul-tempered.
traduit: 然后我们也会失去顾客。还是期待龙没有那么多，而且它们脾气也不太坏吧。

original: I feel pity for these Nords. When the dragons attack cities and towns, they will lose everything.
traduit: 这些诺德人真可怜。巨龙如果攻击城镇，他们就啥都没了。

original: We are fortunate. We travel lightly, and can escape at a moment's notice. We have no home that a dragon can burn to the ground.
traduit: 咱们已经够走运了。只要一直轻装旅行，就可以随时躲开它们。毕竟咱们可没有房子等着龙来烧。

original: S'rendarr be merciful! What ill fortune that this should happen now, while we are trying to make a living.
traduit: 请斯'仁达尔怜悯我们！努力谋生的时候发生这种事可太倒霉了。

original: I wish I could say that I did not, but in every part of Skyrim, there is talk of dragon sightings. It is no coincidence.
traduit: 我倒是想说不信，不过天际各地都有目击传闻。这不可能是巧合。

original: Do you believe all this talk of dragons? Can the ancient ones truly have returned?
traduit: 那些关于龙的传闻可靠么？那些远古生物真的回来了？

original: As the saying goes, you do not need to be faster than the dragon; you need only be faster than your friends.
traduit: 老话说：不用跑赢巨龙，只需跑赢弟兄。

original: I suppose if we do, we will find out just how fast each of us can run.
traduit: 真要是遇上了，就能知道咱们都能跑得多快了。

original: Moons protect us! I hope we do not encounter one of them on the road.
traduit: 双月会庇护我们！但愿路上不会撞上一头。

original: All this talk of dragons returning to the world makes me more than a little nervous.
traduit: 他们总说龙族回归了，我有点紧张。

original: That is true. Perhaps I should be more grateful for this opportunity. Not many Khajiit can say that they have visited Skyrim.
traduit: 确实，也许我该更加感谢你给了我这次机会。毕竟也没有多少卡吉特敢说他们去过天际。

original: In truth, I do not. I have always dreamed of seeing new lands, and it does not hurt that we are making a good profit.
traduit: 老实说，没有。我们现在也赚到不少钱了，这有啥不好的，而且我一直是梦想着能去看看新的大地。

original: Do you ever find that you regret making this journey?
traduit: 这一路下来你有没有后悔过？

original: Yes, I know just what you mean. My toes are numb from the cold more often than not.
traduit: 嗯，我懂。我的脚趾也三天两头冻得发麻。

original: We have been in this land for so long, I have forgotten what it feels like to walk on warm sand.
traduit: 我们在这片土地上待得太久了，我都快忘记走在温暖沙地上是什么感觉了。

original: Hah! I wish that I had your optimism.
traduit: 哈！真希望我能和你一样乐观。

original: It is a pity, but it cannot be helped. Perhaps if we continue to show that we can be trusted, they will open their cities to our caravans.
traduit: 是很遗憾，但也没办法。或许，如果我们能继续展现信任感，他们就会允许车队进城了。

original: Not only that, but these Nords have no love for us. They look upon us and see only thieves and smugglers.
traduit: 再说，这些诺德人根本不喜欢我们。在他们眼里，我们就只是盗贼和走私者。

original: I feel the same. I do not think Khajiit were made for the cold.
traduit: 同感，卡吉特可不是为了这片寒冷而生的。

original: It has been a profitable journey, and yet I long for the warm sands of Elsweyr more and more each day.
traduit: 这一路下来确实赚了不少，但我却对艾斯维尔的温暖沙地的怀念却与日俱增。

original: Put the thought out of your mind, and do not speak of it again.
traduit: 赶快把这个念头忘了，以后别再提了。

original: Yes, of course you are right. Still, I would give much for even a few grains of moonsugar.
traduit: 嗯，你说得对。不过，哪怕是几粒月亮糖也好，我愿意出高价的。

original: Control yourself! Do not frighten away our customers with your fits.
traduit: 克制点！别发作起来吓跑了咱们的顾客。

original: My ears hear the truth in your words, and yet my body shakes with the need.
traduit: 我的耳朵还能分辨你说得在理，但我的身体却在因为缺乏月亮糖而颤抖。

original: You know that our supply is limited. It could be a season or more before we get a new shipment from the south.
traduit: 咱们的补给有限。可能要等上一季或者更久才能从南方拿到新货。

original: My bones ache for the moonsugar. It has been too long since I tasted it.
traduit: 我的身体渴望得到月亮糖，我已经太久没吃过了。

original: If the river is not frozen to ice, perhaps.
traduit: 但愿河还没有结冰。

original: The road takes us past many cold rivers. We can fill our skins there.
traduit: 沿着这条路下去能路过很多冰冷的河流，到时我们可以灌点儿水。

original: Soon it will be time to replenish our supply of water.
traduit: 得尽快补充些水了。

original: I welcome you, friend. How may I serve you?
traduit: 欢迎你，朋友。我有什么能为你效劳的？

original: So many refuse to talk to us. They call us thieves and smugglers. I am glad to see that you are not such a one.
traduit: 很多人不肯和我们交流，管我们叫盗贼、走私者。我很高兴你不是那样的人。

original: Welcome. If I cannot serve you, I am sure that one of my other traders can do so.
traduit: 欢迎。如果我无法为你效劳，那我这里其他的商人也能为你提供服务的。

original: I have traveled far across Tamriel to serve you.
traduit: 我从泰姆瑞尔的另一边远道而来，只为你效劳。

original: Perhaps you have encountered Ma'dran or Akhari? Both are sworn to me, and both have worthy goods to offer.
traduit: 也许你遇过玛'德兰或阿卡利？他们两都效忠于我，而且都能提供有价值的商品。

original: The road makes this one weary.
traduit: 在下都走得有些累了。

original: The wind blows bitter cold in this place.
traduit: 这地方寒风凛冽。

original: The longer we travel the roads of Skyrim, the more empty this land seems.
traduit: 我们在天际的道路上走得越久，就越发觉得这片土地空旷。

original: The warm sand of Elsweyr is far away from here.
traduit: 艾斯维尔的温暖沙地离这里很远。

original: The roads of Skyrim lead to many dangers.
traduit: 天际的道路通向许多危险之地。

original: We are creatures of the desert. The north wind chills us to the bones.
traduit: 我们可是沙漠生物，这北风对我们来说冷入骨了。

original: There is much beauty in this place.
traduit: 这地方有很多美丽的东西。

original: How high the mountains of Skyrim rise!
traduit: 天际的山可真高啊！

original: A peaceful greeting to you.
traduit: 你好呀，挺宁静的一天不是？

original: It is a strange sight, the white flakes that sometimes fall from the sky.
traduit: 真是个奇怪的景象，不时会有白色的小碎片从天而降。

original: The air is so clear in Skyrim, one can see forever.
traduit: 天际的天气真晴朗，百看不厌呀。

original: A welcome to you, fellow traveler.
traduit: 欢迎你，同行者。

original: Khajiit welcomes you, and also your coin.
traduit: 卡吉特欢迎你，也欢迎你的硬币。

original: Do you seek to make a purchase?
traduit: 有什么想买的么？

original: Khajiit has wares, if you have coin.
traduit: 只要你有硬币，卡吉特就有货。

original: Fortune smiles upon this meeting.
traduit: 好运将伴随这次相遇。

original: Welcome to you.
traduit: 欢迎你。

original: Warm sands, friend. How may this one serve you?
traduit: 温暖沙地，朋友。在下有什么能为你效劳的？

original: Please, come and browse our goods.
traduit: 请过来看看我们的商品。

original: May your bed be warm and your food sweet.
traduit: 愿你的床铺暖和、食物香甜。

original: You honor Khajiit with your presence.
traduit: 你的光临让卡吉特荣幸之至。

original: Many fine things are here for you, friend.
traduit: 朋友，这里有很多好东西适合你。

original: Come and see what is for sale, traveler.
traduit: 过来看看有什么东西在卖不，旅者。

original: May the sun warm your path, friend.
traduit: 愿太阳温暖你的路途，朋友。

original: Speak to one of the others if you wish to buy something.
traduit: 如果你想买点什么东西就和其他人谈谈吧。
