original: This Khajiit guards the others.
traduit: 本卡吉特保护着其他人。

original: Bring your coins, but do not bring trouble.
traduit: 带你的硬币来，但别带着麻烦来。

original: Khajiit is always watching for thieves and pickpockets.
traduit: 卡吉特总是提防着盗贼和扒手。

original: Khajiit is ready for any troublemakers.
traduit: 卡吉特已经准备好对付任何闹事者了。

original: If you have come to see our wares, speak to the others.
traduit: 如果你是来看我们货物的话，就去和其他人聊吧。

original: Welcome to Khajiit's humble camp.
traduit: 欢迎来到卡吉特的简陋营地。

original: Khajiit is just a guard, and has no wares to sell.
traduit: 卡吉特只是个护卫，没有货物可卖。

original: Blessings of the moons upon you, traveler.
traduit: 双月的祝福将伴随你，旅者。

original: Some come to buy, but others come to steal. Khajiit shows no mercy to thieves.
traduit: 有来买的，也有来偷的。但卡吉特对盗贼可不会留情。

original: Khajiit are not welcome in the cities, so we make our camps outside the walls.
traduit: 卡吉特在城里是不受欢迎的，所以我们在城墙外扎营。

original: There is no trust for Khajiit in this place.
traduit: 这地方对卡吉特没有信任。

original: You'd prefer your son to grow bitter and resent you? (Persuade)
traduit: 你希望你儿子怨恨你吗？（说服）

original: I... I cannot deny the truth of what you say. Erik is all the family that I have left, but it's wrong to hold him back as I have.
traduit: 我……我明白，你说得对。艾瑞克是我唯一的亲人，但我不该这样阻止他。

original: Go and tell Erik that I've changed my mind. I'll see about borrowing some money in Whiterun for his armor.
traduit: 去告诉艾瑞克，我改主意了。我会想办法筹点钱在白漫城给他买盔甲的。

original: Perhaps you should let a father decide what is best for his own son.
traduit: 或许，父亲有权决定什么才是对儿子最好的。

original: Find the money, or you'll have me to deal with. (Intimidate)
traduit: 去找钱，否则我就来对付你。（恐吓）

original: Ah, I see. I've just remembered that I saved a few septims in case of an emergency. This is starting to feel like one.
traduit: 啊，我知道了。我刚想起来我存了些塞普汀以防万一。看起来该派上用场了。

original: Tell Erik that I've changed my mind, and we'll visit Whiterun soon to fit him for armor. And please don't hurt me!
traduit: 跟艾瑞克说我改主意了吧，我们马上去白漫城买盔甲。请不要伤害我！

original: Go ahead, hit me as often as you want. It's not going to change anything, other than to make me and the town guard angry.
traduit: 来啊，想怎么打就怎么打吧。不会改变什么，只会让我和镇上的卫兵很生气。

original: Here, use this to buy some armor. (<bribecost> gold)
traduit: 给，用这些钱去买盔甲吧。（<BribeCost>金币）

original: You would give your own coin to help my son? I'm moved by your compassion.
traduit: 你愿意用自己的钱来帮我儿子？我被你的同情心打动了。

original: Your kind deed will not go unrewarded, my friend. Tell Erik I've changed my mind, and we'll visit Whiterun soon to fit him for armor.
traduit: 你的善举会有回报的，朋友。告诉艾瑞克我改主意了，我们马上去白漫城买盔甲。

original: I appreciate the gesture, but I'd rather not be in debt to a stranger.
traduit: 谢谢你的好意，但我不想欠陌生人的人情。

original: You should let your son choose the life he wants.
traduit: 你应该让你儿子过自己想要的生活。

original: But the world is a dangerous place. Erik has no idea what he's getting himself into.
traduit: 但外面太危险，艾瑞克完全不知道自己要面对什么。

original: What's more, he's got no armor. I'll have to save up the money for it.
traduit: 而且，他也没有护甲。我得为此攒钱。

original: My son? Erik? What about him? Did something happen? Is he alright?
traduit: 我儿子？艾瑞克？他怎么了？发生什么事了？他还好吗？

original: I'd like to talk to you about your son.
traduit: 我想和你谈谈你儿子的事。

original: Mirabelle will be waiting for you.
traduit: 米拉贝勒在等你。

original: Well, boy, you're one of us now. I trust you won't disappoint.
traduit: 好了，孩子，你现在是我们的一员了。相信你不会让我失望。

original: Well, girl, you're one of us now. I trust you won't disappoint.
traduit: 好了，孩子，你现在是我们的一员了。相信你不会让我失望。

original: It shall be so.
traduit: 理当如此。

original: Let it beat with ours, that the mountains may echo and our enemies may tremble at the call.
traduit: 让它随着我们的呼喝而跳动，让我们的声音在群山回荡，喝破敌人的肝胆。

original: His heart beats with fury and courage that have united the Companions since the days of the distant green summers.
traduit: 他的心伴随着愤怒与勇气而跳动，这是自遥远的绿夏时代便将战友团凝聚在一起的东西。

original: Her heart beats with fury and courage that have united the Companions since the days of the distant green summers.
traduit: 她的心伴随着愤怒与勇气而跳动，这是自遥远的绿夏时代便将战友团凝聚在一起的东西。

original: Then the judgment of this Circle is complete.
traduit: 如此，圆环的裁决结束。

original: I would lead the song of triumph as our mead hall reveled in his stories.
traduit: 当我们的蜜酒大厅沉浸在他的事迹中，我愿举杯欢唱凯歌。

original: I would lead the song of triumph as our mead hall reveled in her stories.
traduit: 当我们的蜜酒大厅沉浸在她的事迹中，我愿举杯欢唱凯歌。

original: And would you raise a mug in his name?
traduit: 你愿意为他的名字而举杯吗？

original: And would you raise a mug in her name?
traduit: 你愿意为她的名字而举杯吗？

original: It stands ready to meet the blood of his foes.
traduit: 我的剑随时准备迎接他敌人的鲜血。

original: It stands ready to meet the blood of her foes.
traduit: 我的剑随时准备迎接她敌人的鲜血。

original: And would you raise your sword in his honor?
traduit: 你愿意为他的荣耀而拔剑吗？

original: And would you raise your sword in her honor?
traduit: 你愿意为她的荣耀而拔剑吗？

original: I would stand at his back, that the world might never overtake us.
traduit: 我会站在他的身后，整个世界都无法击倒我们。

original: I would stand at her back, that the world might never overtake us.
traduit: 我会站在她的身后，整个世界都无法击倒我们。

original: Would you raise your shield in his defense?
traduit: 你愿意为他的安危而举盾吗？

original: Would you raise your shield in her defense?
traduit: 你愿意为她的安危而举盾吗？

original: I stand witness to the courage of the soul before us.
traduit: 我来证明站在我等面前的灵魂的勇气。

original: Who will speak for him?
traduit: 谁愿意为他发言？

original: Who will speak for her?
traduit: 谁愿意为她发言？

original: This man has endured, has challenged, and has shown his valor.
traduit: 这个人历经忍耐与挑战，展现了自己的勇气。

original: This woman has endured, has challenged, and has shown her valor.
traduit: 这个人历经忍耐与挑战，展现了自己的勇气。

original: Brothers and sisters of the Circle, today we welcome a new soul into our mortal fold.
traduit: 圆环的兄弟姐妹，在今天，我们欢迎一个新的灵魂加入我们。

original: I've been hunting and fishing in these parts for years.
traduit: 我在这一带打猎捕鱼已经很多年了。

original: It's not like my poaching is hurting anyone. The Jarl can hardly eat every deer now can he?
traduit: 我打猎没有妨碍到任何人。领主也不能把所有鹿都吃光吧？

original: There's enough for all of us if you aren't greedy.
traduit: 只要不贪心，人人都能吃饱。

original: I never loved you, anyway.
traduit: 反正我也没爱过你。

original: Get out of my sight!
traduit: 滚出我的视线！

original: Get out of here. Get out of here and never come back!
traduit: 从这里滚出去。滚出去，再也别回来了！

original: What did you say? Get out of my sight!
traduit: 你说什么？滚出我的视线！

original: You're a monster. Leave and never come back!
traduit: 你真是个怪物。滚开就别再来了！

original: What'd you say to me? Get out! I never want to see you again.
traduit: 你跟我说什么？滚！我不想再见到你。

original: You come all this way just to hurt me a second time? Get out of my sight!
traduit: 你跑回来就是想再伤害我一次？滚出我的视线！

original: Leave. Now!
traduit: 滚。马上滚！

original: It was a mistake. Can we start over?
traduit: 是我的错。我们能重新开始吗？

original: All right, just because it's you, we'll try again.
traduit: 好吧，也就是你。我们再试一次。

original: I'll give you another chance, but watch yourself.
traduit: 我会再给你一次机会，但你注意点。

original: You want to try again? Fine, but I'll be watching you carefully.
traduit: 你想再试一次？好吧，但我会好好盯着你的。

original: Try again? You and me? Fine, but I've got my eyes on you.
traduit: 再试一次？咱俩？好吧，但我会盯着你的。

original: You're testing my patience, but very well. I'll give you another chance.
traduit: 你在测试我的耐心，但好吧，我再给你一次机会。

original: All right, we'll start again, but watch yourself.
traduit: 好吧，我们重新开始，但你注意点。

original: I can't believe you're speaking to me, after what you've done. You broke my heart.
traduit: 真不敢相信，你在做了那些事之后还敢来和我说话。你把我心伤透了。

original: We have nothing to talk about. I can't believe what you did to me.
traduit: 我们没什么好说的了。真不敢相信你会这样对我。

original: Your words are cheap. Why should I speak to you after what you've done?
traduit: 你的承诺真廉价。你都做出这种事了还来找我说话？

original: And why should I speak with you? You broke my heart.
traduit: 我为什么要搭理你？你把我心都伤了。

original: You. You should just go. I don't have enough ale to stomach talking to you.
traduit: 你。你该走了。我没那么多麦芽酒和你一起喝着聊了。

original: Look at you. Come crawling back, after everything you've done to me?
traduit: 看看你。对我做了那么多事，还敢爬过来？

original: What do you want? There's no words left to say to each other.
traduit: 你想干什么？我们之间没话说了。

original: Precious release...
traduit: 可贵的解脱……

original: Father...
traduit: 父亲……

original: Ahhhhhhhh!
traduit: 啊啊啊啊！

original: Yeeeaaahhh!
traduit: 呀啊啊啊啊啊！

original: I... am... eternal...
traduit: 我……获得了……永生……

original: Back... to... the Void...
traduit: 回归……虚空……

original: I return to you, Father.
traduit: 我将回归于您的怀抱，恐惧之父……

original: Ahhhhh.....
Hhhhuuuuuhhh....
traduit: 呼唔……

original: Aiiiieee!
traduit: 啊呀！

original: Coming... Mother...
traduit: 母亲……我来了……

original: Well done...
traduit: 干得好……

original: Uhh.. thank you...
traduit: 啊……谢谢你……

original: But... we had a deal...
traduit: 但……我们说好的……

original: You can't kill what's already dead, mortal.
traduit: 你杀不死已经死去的东西，凡人。

original: Ha ha! I've suffered worse!
traduit: 哈哈哈！这两下不算什么！

original: There is no pain in the Void!
traduit: 虚空中没有痛苦！

original: You would shut out the darkness?
traduit: 你打算拒绝黑暗？

original: You wish to kill me? Someone has already had that honor.
traduit: 想杀我？已经好久没人有这个胆量了。

original: Ooof!
traduit: 哦！

original: Come on! Do it again! Ha ha ha ha ha!
traduit: 来啊！再来啊！哈哈哈哈哈！

original: I'm bleeding! Ha ha ha ha ha!
traduit: 我流血了！哈哈哈哈哈！

original: Ow! Cheap shot!
traduit: 哦！恶意的中伤！

original: Is that the best the Listener can do?
traduit: 聆听者就这点能耐吗？

original: By Sithis, I'll see you dead!
traduit: 西帝斯在上，你死定了！

original: You won't get that lucky again!
traduit: 你不会再那么走运了！

original: You are not welcome here!
traduit: 这里不欢迎你！

original: Unworthy!
traduit: 太弱了！

original: Fall before the will of Sithis!
traduit: 倒在西帝斯的意志之下吧！

original: You dare invade this Sanctuary?
traduit: 你胆敢入侵圣所？

original: Heyargh!
traduit: 喝呀哈！

original: Grrr!
traduit: 叽啊！

original: The Dread Lord awaits!
traduit: 恐惧之主正在等你！

original: I... am Lucien Lachance.
traduit: 我……是卢西恩·拉肯斯。

original: Another soul for you, Father!
traduit: 父亲啊，再向你献上一个灵魂！

original: I weep for you, mortal.
traduit: 我会为你哭泣，凡人。

original: Another thrall for the Void!
traduit: 虚空中又多了一个奴隶！

original: Raaarr!
traduit: 呀啊啊！

original: Grrrarrggh!
traduit: 嘎啊啊啊！

original: Huuragh!
traduit: 呼啊！

original: Ha ha ha ha!
traduit: 哈哈哈哈！

original: For the Night Mother!
traduit: 为了夜母！

original: Who's the fool now?
traduit: 现在谁才是小丑？

original: Stab you, stab you, stab you!
traduit: 插死你，插死你，插死你！

original: Raarrgh!
traduit: 呀啊啊！

original: Grraaagghh!
traduit: 嘎啊啊啊！

original: Eyyaargh!
traduit: 咦呀啊！

original: Pathetic!
traduit: 可悲！

original: Raaarrgh!
traduit: 呀啊啊！

original: Grragh!
traduit: 嘎啊啊！

original: Arugh!
traduit: 啊哈！

original: You dare invade my home?
traduit: 胆敢入侵我家？

original: You might just make it. But for now, you're still a whelp to us, new blood. So you do what we tell you.
traduit: 你或许够格了。但现在，你还只是我们中的小崽子，新人。所以你得按我们说的做。

original: Here's my sword. Go take it up to Eorlund to have it sharpened. And be careful, it's probably worth more than you are.
traduit: 这是我的剑。拿去让厄伦德磨一磨。小心点，它可能比你值钱。

original: Alduin's wings, they did darken the sky. His roar fury's fire, and his scales sharpened scythes.
traduit: 奥杜因，黑翼蔽日遮天，咆哮愤怒之炎，龙鳞锋锐如镰。

original: Men ran and they cowered, and they fought and they died. They burned and they bled as they issued their cries.
traduit: 人们奔逃、祷告；战斗、死去；在悲声中燃烧、流血。

original: We need saviors to free us from Alduin's rage. Heroes on the field of this new war to wage.
traduit: 我们渴求救星，解救万民于奥杜因之怒，英雄们为此踏上征途。

original: And if Alduin wins, man is gone from this world. Lost in the shadow of the black wings unfurled.
traduit: 奥杜因如果得胜，人类将从世上消失，迷失在黑翼的阴影当中。

original: But then came the Tongues on that terrible day. Steadfast as winter, they entered the fray.
traduit: 但在那绝望的时刻，发声者们来临，他们如冬日般坚毅，加入了战斗。

original: And all heard the music of Alduin's doom. The sweet song of Skyrim, sky-shattering Thu'um.
traduit: 所有人都听到了宣告奥杜因末日的音乐。那震天动地的吐'目是天际的欢歌。

original: And so the Tongues freed us from Alduin's rage. Gave the gift of the Voice, ushered in a new Age.
traduit: 发声者让我们摆脱了奥杜因的愤怒。把吼声的天赋作为新时代的献礼。

original: If Alduin is eternal, then eternity's done. For his story is over and the dragons are... gone.
traduit: 奥杜因的永恒传说终结了。龙族就此……消失。

original: Our hero, our hero, claims a warrior's heart.
traduit: 我们的英雄，身怀战士心胸。

original: I tell you, I tell you, the Dragonborn comes.
traduit: 我会告诉你，龙裔必将归来。

original: With a Voice wielding power of the ancient Nord art.
traduit: 那吼声的运用，是古诺德的技艺。

original: Believe, believe, the Dragonborn comes.
traduit: 请相信，请相信，龙裔必将归来。

original: It's an end to the evil, of all Skyrim's foes.
traduit: 这是天际邪恶敌人，害怕的末日。

original: Beware, beware, the Dragonborn comes.
traduit: 看着吧，看着吧，龙裔必将归来。

original: For the darkness has passed, and the legend yet grows.
traduit: 往日黑暗已逝，如今传奇开始。

original: You'll know, You'll know the Dragonborn's come.
traduit: 等着吧，等着吧，龙裔必将归来。

original: We drink to our youth, and to days come and gone. For the age of oppression is now nearly done.
traduit: 为青春干杯，也为来去的年岁。因为压迫的年代，已临近终结。

original: We drink to our youth, to days come and gone. For the age of aggression is just about done.
traduit: 为青春干杯，也为来去的年岁。因为好战的年代，已接近终结。

original: We'll drive out the Empire from this land that we own. With our blood and our steel we will take back our home.
traduit: 我们将驱离帝国势力——从我们世代的土地。凭着热血和刀剑，我们将夺回家园。

original: We'll drive out the Stormcloaks and restore what we own. With our blood and our steel we'll take back our home.
traduit: 我们将驱离风暴斗篷，恢复往日荣光。凭着热血和刀剑，我们将夺回家园。

original: All hail to Ulfric! You are the High King! In your great honor we drink and we sing.
traduit: 乌弗瑞克万岁！您才是至高王！在您的无上荣耀下我们豪饮高歌。

original: Down with Ulfric the killer of kings. On the day of your death we'll drink and we'll sing.
traduit: 打倒乌弗瑞克！这弑君的凶徒！在你的审判到来时我们豪饮高歌。

original: We're the children of Skyrim, and we fight all our lives. And when Sovngarde beckons, every one of us dies!
traduit: 我们是天际之子，毕生奋战不止。待松加德传召之时，无不从容赴死！

original: But this land is ours and we'll see it wiped clean. Of the scourge that has sullied our hopes and our dreams.
traduit: 但这是我们的土地，我们愿它干净。玷污希望与梦想的灾难，终会扫清。

original: There once was a hero named Ragnar the Red, who came riding to Whiterun from ole Rorikstead!
traduit: 曾有位好汉叫“红发拉格纳”，从洛利克古镇一路策马奔向白漫！

original: And the braggart did swagger and brandish his blade, as he told of bold battles and gold he had made!
traduit: 吹牛大王挥舞大剑神气无比，还夸耀他往日的战斗和财富！

original: But then he went quiet, did Ragnar the Red, when he met the shieldmaiden Matilda who said...
traduit: 但当红发拉格纳碰上持盾少女玛蒂尔达，他却住口不再喧哗，且听她如何责骂……

original: "Oh, you talk and you lie and you drink all our mead! Now I think it's high time that you lie down and bleed!"
traduit: “噢，你空口胡编、你坑蒙拐骗，你喝干了咱全部的蜜酒还要不要脸！我看现在正好，叫你趴倒流血一片！”

original: And so then came the clashing and slashing of steel, as the brave lass Matilda charged in full of zeal!
traduit: 当无畏少女玛蒂尔达义愤填膺、冲锋前行，随即传来打斗砍劈、金铁交鸣！

original: And the braggart named Ragnar was boastful no moooooree... when his ugly red head rolled around on the floor!
traduit: 名唤拉格纳的吹牛大王再不能吹牛打屁～～毕竟他那丑陋的红脑袋已经滚落在地！

original: Dragonborn, Dragonborn, by his honor is sworn, To keep evil forever at bay!
traduit: 龙裔，龙裔，以荣耀起誓，永远驱逐邪恶！

original: And the fiercest foes rout when they hear triumph's shout, Dragonborn, for your blessing we pray!
traduit: 当听闻其凯旋的怒号，最残暴的敌人也将望风而逃，我们都为龙裔的赐福祷告！

original: Hearken now, sons of snow, to an age, long ago, and the tale, boldly told, of the one!
traduit: 冰之后代啊，聆听这诉说龙裔的古老传说！

original: Who was kin to both wyrm, and the races of man, with a power to rival the sun!
traduit: 他是龙与人族的后裔，力量足以与日争辉！

original: And the Voice, he did wield, on that glorious field, when great Tamriel shuddered with war!
traduit: 他高声咆哮于荣耀的旷野时，偌大泰姆瑞尔也为此战震颤！

original: Mighty Thu’um, like a blade, cut through enemies all, as the Dragonborn issued his roar!
traduit: 龙裔的咆哮，是强大如刀剑的吐'目，能够瞬间横扫一切敌人！

original: And the Scrolls have foretold, of black wings in the cold, that when brothers wage war come unfurled!
traduit: 而卷轴已然预言，当兄弟兵戎相见之时，寒天之上出现黑翼！

original: Alduin, Bane of Kings, ancient shadow unbound, with a hunger to swallow the world!
traduit: 奥杜因，诸王之灾祸，未缚的先古阴影，带着吞噬世界的欲望降临！

original: But a day, shall arise, when the dark dragon's lies, will be silenced forever and then!
traduit: 但终有一日，黑暗之龙将会倒下，永久沉默下去！

original: Fair Skyrim will be free from foul Alduin's maw, Dragonborn be the savior of men!
traduit: 龙裔是人类的救世主，他会将美丽的天际从奥杜因口中解放！

original: Dovahkiin, Dovahkiin, naal ok zin los vahriin, wah dein vokul mahfaeraak ahst vaal!
traduit: Dovahkiin, Dovahkiin, naal ok zin los vahriin, wah dein vokul mahfaeraak ahst vaal!

original: Ahrk fin norok paal graan fod nust hon zindro zaan, Dovahkiin, fah hin kogaan mu draal!
traduit: Ahrk fin norok paal graan fod nust hon zindro zaan, Dovahkiin, fah hin kogaan mu draal!

original: Huzrah nu, kul do od, wah aan bok lingrah vod, Aahrk fin tey, boziik fun, do fin gein!
traduit: Huzrah nu, kul do od, wah aan bok lingrah vod, Aahrk fin tey, boziik fun, do fin gein!

original: Wo lost fron wah ney dov, ahrk fin reyliik do jul, voth aan suleyk wah ronit faal krein!
traduit: Wo lost fron wah ney dov, ahrk fin reyliik do jul, voth aan suleyk wah ronit faal krein!

original: Ahrk fin zul, rok drey kod, nau tol morokei frod, rul lot Taazokaan motaad voth kein!
traduit: Ahrk fin zul, rok drey kod, nau tol morokei frod, rul lot Taazokaan motaad voth kein!

original: Sahrot Thu'um, med aan tuz, vey zeim hokoron pah, ol fin Dovahkiin komeyt ok rein!
traduit: Sahrot Thu'um, med aan tuz, vey zeim hokoron pah, ol fin Dovahkiin komeyt ok rein!

original: Ahrk fin Kel lost prodah, do ved viing ko fin krah, tol fod zeymah win kein meyz fundein!
traduit: Ahrk fin Kel lost prodah, do ved viing ko fin krah, tol fod zeymah win kein meyz fundein!

original: Alduin, feyn do jun, kruziik vokun staadnau, voth aan bahlok wah diivon fin lein!
traduit: Alduin, feyn do jun, kruziik vokun staadnau, voth aan bahlok wah diivon fin lein!

original: Nuz aan sul, fent alok, fod fin vul dovah nok, fen kos nahlot mahfaeraak ahrk ruz!
traduit: Nuz aan sul, fent alok, fod fin vul dovah nok, fen kos nahlot mahfaeraak ahrk ruz!

original: Paaz Keizaal fen kos stin nol bein Alduin jot, Dovahkiin kos fin saviik do muz!
traduit: Paaz Keizaal fen kos stin nol bein Alduin jot, Dovahkiin kos fin saviik do muz!

original: I do. Now and forever.
traduit: 我愿意，从现在直到永远。

original: Do you agree to be bound together, in love, now and forever?
traduit: 你们愿意永远相爱吗？

original: May they journey forth together in this life and the next, in prosperity and poverty, and in joy and hardship.
traduit: 愿他们今生彼世长相厮守，无论富贵还是贫穷，无论欢乐还是艰辛。

original: We gather here today, under Mara's loving gaze, to bear witness to the union of two souls in eternal companionship.
traduit: 我们今天齐聚一堂，在玛拉的深情注视下，见证两个灵魂永远相伴的结合。

original: It is from her love of us that we first learned to love one another. It is from this love that we learn that a life lived alone is no life at all.
traduit: 正因为她对我们的爱，我们第一次学会了如何爱护彼此。也正是因为这种爱，我们了解到，孤独的生活并不完整。

original: It was Mara that first gave birth to all of creation and pledged to watch over us as her children.
traduit: 玛拉最初创育万物，并发誓像守护自己的孩子一样守护我们。

original: Looking for work? I need someone to deliver a message to Sibbi Black-Briar.
traduit: 在找工作？我需要找人给西比·黑棘捎个信。

original: I'm still looking for someone to deliver my message to Sibbi Black-Briar...
traduit: 我还在找人给西比·黑棘送信……

original: Actually, Letrush wants me to steal the horse...
traduit: 其实，莱特鲁什想要我偷马……

original: Really? Now that is interesting...
traduit: 真的？有意思……

original: Then you should know that Louis and I have a certain... history.
traduit: 那你应该知道路易士和我有点……过节。

original: Tell you what. Go along with his plans for now. I'll keep an eye on you both and, when the time is right, I'll settle accounts with Louis.
traduit: 这样吧。现在按他计划行事。我会盯着你们，等时机到了，我会跟路易士算账的。

original: Why don't you go tell Sibbi yourself?
traduit: 你为什么不自己和西比说？

original: I'm not exactly... comfortable around guards or jails. Definitely not when associates of mine have been locked up. No, I'll meet you outside of town.
traduit: 我对……监狱和卫兵感到不适。我的合伙人被关着。算了，我还是在城外等你。

original: It's settled then. Brief as life can be in Skyrim, at least we'll have each other.
traduit: 那就决定了。在天际，虽然人生短暂，但好在我们可以相伴。

original: Yes. Yes I am.
traduit: 是的，我确定。

original: Together.
traduit: 在一起。

original: I will. Together, then.
traduit: 我会的。在一起。

original: And mine is yours.
traduit: 那我的也会与你同在。

original: I do. My hand is yours.
traduit: 我愿意。我的手永远和你在一起。

original: As short as life can be in this land, we will have each other.
traduit: 虽然这片土地上的生命都很短暂，但我们可以相伴。

original: Together until the end, then.
traduit: 在一起，直到最后。

original: Well, look at us, getting married. Life in Skyrim ain't all bad, huh?
traduit: 好啊，那咱们就结婚吧。天际的生活也不全是那么糟糕，是吧？

original: I'm game.
traduit: 我乐意。

original: Good. The two of us then. All of Skyrim should get ready to stand aside.
traduit: 很好。那我们就在一起吧。全天际的人都会注视我们的。

original: I'd be more than interested.
traduit: 我很有兴趣。

original: Then it's settled. You and me.
traduit: 那就决定了，就你和我。

original: I won't lie. I am.
traduit: 我也不会撒谎。我愿意。

original: Well, yes. Why wouldn't I be? Are you... interested in me?
traduit: 嗯，是的。为什么不呢？那你……也对我有兴趣？

original: I am. I'd be glad to stand by your side until the Divines take us, if you'll have me.
traduit: 是的。如果你愿意，我很乐意与你相伴直至圣灵带走彼此。

original: You're strong. Clever. I'd be proud to face the challenges of life with you, if you feel the same way.
traduit: 你强壮，聪明。如果你也这么想，那我很自豪能够和你一起面对人生的挑战。

original: You have a kind heart. I'd be honored to walk by your side until the trees themselves fade away, if you would have me.
traduit: 你很善良。如果你愿意，我很乐意与你陪你直到希斯特全都凋零。

original: I'd be a fool to turn down a chance of marrying you. I'm game if you're game!
traduit: 如果我拒绝和你结婚的机会，那我就真是傻瓜了。如果你乐意，我就乐意！

original: You are pleasant company, more than pleasant. And what about you? Would you... be interested in a life together?
traduit: 有你相伴很愉快，而且不只是快乐那么简单。那你呢？你有兴趣……和我一起生活吗？

original: I might. Why don't you remind me?
traduit: 可能吧。你要不给我提个醒？

original: Typically, love in Skyrim is as earnest as the people who live here. Life is hard, and short, so there is little room for long courtship.
traduit: 通常情况下，天际的爱情就像生活在这里的人一样真诚。人生苦短，所以长期恋爱的空间很小。

original: A person who is looking for a spouse simply wears an Amulet of Mara about the neck, showing they are available.
traduit: 寻找配偶的人只需要在脖子上戴一条玛拉护符就行了，这表明了他们正在求偶。

original: When another person shows interest, and the two agree to be together, one of them comes to the Temple and we arrange a ceremony.
traduit: 当另一个人表现出意愿，并且两人同意在一起时，其中一个到神殿来，我们就会安排婚礼仪式。

original: No, not really.
traduit: 不，完全不了解。

original: I could have a wedding at the temple?
traduit: 我可以在神殿里举行婚礼吗？

original: Yes. If you were ready, of course. Are you familiar with how marriage works in Skyrim?
traduit: 是啊，准备好了的话当然没问题。你对天际的婚姻习俗了解吗？

original: I wanted to know more about the Temple of Mara.
traduit: 我想进一步了解玛拉神殿。

original: Wonderful. Where to begin?
traduit: 太好了。从哪里开始说呢？

original: Mara is the Goddess of Love. The temple spreads her gifts by tending to the sick, the poor, and the lost.
traduit: 玛拉是爱之女神。神殿会通过周济病患、穷人和迷途者来传播她的恩赐。

original: We also perform wedding ceremonies for all the loving couples in Skyrim.
traduit: 我们还为全天际相爱的情侣举办婚礼。

original: Oh. I'm sorry I said anything, then.
traduit: 哦，很抱歉我说了那些话。

original: No, I'm not.
traduit: 不，还没有。

original: I'm sorry. I'm not interested.
traduit: 我很抱歉，但我不感兴趣。

original: If that is your wish.
traduit: 如你所愿吧。

original: I don't. Sorry.
traduit: 不行。对不起了。

original: Very well. I am poorer for it.
traduit: 很好。我算是变得更可怜了。

original: I'm not interested. Sorry.
traduit: 我不感兴趣。对不起了。

original: What are you, some kind of tease? Stendarr's Mercy....
traduit: 那你刚才是在开玩笑吗？斯丹达尔在上……

original: I don't think I'm game.
traduit: 我觉得我可能不乐意。

original: Waste of time, then.
traduit: 那就是在浪费时间了。

original: No. Sorry.
traduit: 不，抱歉。

original: I'm not.
traduit: 我不愿意。

original: You're looking to cure yourself?
traduit: 你想治愈自己吗？

original: Yes, but it's no easy matter.
traduit: 没错，但并不容易。

original: But you don't need to share the worries of an old warrior. This day is to rejoice in your bravery!
traduit: 不过你不必替我这个老战士担心。今天就是要为你的勇敢欢呼的好日子！

original: What about you?
traduit: 你呢？

original: Well, I grow old. My mind turns towards the horizon. To Sovngarde.
traduit: 嗯，我年事已高。想法开始望向远方，松加德。

original: I worry that Shor won't call an animal to glory as he would a true Nord warrior.
traduit: 我担心舒尔不会像对待真正的诺德战士那样让野兽也获得荣耀。

original: Living as beasts draws our souls closer to the Daedric Lord Hircine.
traduit: 如野兽般生活让我们的灵魂更加靠近迪德拉君主海尔辛。

original: Some may prefer an eternity in his Hunting Grounds, but I crave the fellowship of Sovngarde.
traduit: 有些人可能更喜欢在他的猎场获得永生，但我渴望获得松加德的友谊。

original: I'd better go see what Arngeir knows about this Shout.
traduit: 我最好去问问艾恩盖尔对这个龙吼的知道些什么。

original: Don't worry. I'm not afraid of my own power.
traduit: 别担心。我可没害怕自己的力量。

original: Good. The Greybeards can teach you a lot, but don't let them turn you away from your destiny.
traduit: 很好。灰胡子可以教会你很多东西，但不要被他们带离了自己的命运。

original: You're Dragonborn, and you're the only one who can stop Alduin. Don't forget it.
traduit: 你是龙裔，是唯一能阻止奥杜因的人。不要忘记这点。

original: The Greybeards may have a point. Power is dangerous.
traduit: 灰胡子或许说的有理。力量是危险的。

original: Only if you don't know how to use it. All the great heroes have had to learn to use their power.
traduit: 只有当你不懂得如何运用的时候才是。每位伟大的英雄都必须学会运用自己的力量。

original: Those that shrank from their destiny... well, you've never heard of them, have you?
traduit: 那些企图逃避命运的人……都泯然众人了，不是吗？

original: And there are the villains - those that misused their power. There's always a choice, and there's always a risk.
traduit: 当然，也有人滥用力量成了恶人。有选择就意味着有风险。

original: But if you live in fear of what might go wrong, you'll end up doing nothing. Like the Greybeards up on their mountain.
traduit: 但如果你只是生活在对潜在错误的恐惧中，终将一事无成。就像山里的那群灰胡子一样。

original: What do you have against the Greybeards?
traduit: 你对灰胡子有什么不满？

original: I'm right with you.
traduit: 我就在你身旁。

original: J'zargo is ready for more adventure.
traduit: 杰'扎格准备好迎接更多冒险啦。

original: Of course. Let's go.
traduit: 当然。我们走。

original: Certainly, I'm ready.
traduit: 好啊，我准备好了。

original: I'm ready. Let's go.
traduit: 准备好了。我们走。

original: Good. We should keep moving.
traduit: 好，我们继续前进吧。

original: Good. I'm ready for anything.
traduit: 好。我已经做好准备了。

original: Try not to walk into any spike-filled pits or filthy skeever dens.
traduit: 别掉在钉子坑或者恶鼠窝里啊。

original: Onward to our next adventure!
traduit: 前往我们下一场冒险吧！

original: I am the shadow at your back.
traduit: 我就是你身后的影子。

original: Good! Let's go find something to fight.
traduit: 好啊！找什么东西打一架吧！

original: I will walk alongside you.
traduit: 我会与你并肩同行。

original: Khajiit walks in your footsteps.
traduit: 卡吉特会跟着你的脚步。

original: To the next fight.
traduit: 前往下次战斗吧。

original: I'll stay here. You try not to get into too much trouble.
traduit: 我会在这里等。你也别惹上太多麻烦啊。

original: As you wish. Just don't forget about me.
traduit: 如你所愿。只是别把我落下了。

original: Here? Right here? Very well, J'zargo shall wait.
traduit: 这里？就这里？很好，杰'扎格在这里等着。

original: Certainly. Be careful.
traduit: 当然可以。小心点。

original: All right. Don't take too long.
traduit: 好吧。但别耽误太久。

original: All right. Don't be long.
traduit: 好啊。别让我等太久。

original: You sure? All right. I'll keep guard here.
traduit: 你确定？好吧。那我在这里等着。

original: Don't make me wait too long. I get bored very easily.
traduit: 别让我等太久。不然很容易无聊。

original: Patience isn't exactly my strong suit, but alright.
traduit: 耐心可不是我的强项，不过好吧。

original: Very well. Just be careful!
traduit: 好吧。那你要小心！

original: I'll wait here. Just don't start any trouble without me.
traduit: 我会在这里等着。只是我不在你别惹上什么麻烦。

original: You go on ahead.
traduit: 你先走。

original: Head on, then. I'll keep an eye out.
traduit: 那就走吧。我会留意的。

original: I'll keep watch from here.
traduit: 我会在这里盯着的。

original: You sure? Fine. I'll stand watch.
traduit: 你确定？好吧。我会保持警戒的。

original: Yes... yes, that's an excellent idea. Who knows what other lost treasures we might discover?
traduit: 没错……没错，好主意。万一能发现些遗失的宝藏呢？

original: Well, I'm going to look around some more. See what the old Blades left for us.
traduit: 好吧，我再四处看看。找找老刀锋们留给咱们些什么。

original: I know the prophecy by heart. Once all Blades knew it.
traduit: 那个预言我背得滚瓜烂熟。刀锋的基本功么。

original: Here are the Akaviri - the Blades - you see their distinctive longswords.
traduit: 这些是阿卡维尔的刀锋们，你看他们独特的长剑。

original: Now they kneel, their ancient mission fulfilled, as the Last Dragonborn contends with Alduin at the end of time.
traduit: 他们现在臣服了，他们的古老使命已经达成。最后的龙裔会在时间终焉与奥杜因抗衡。

original: We'd best be careful in here.
traduit: 在这里最好小心点。

original: It's starting to look like Esbern was right.
traduit: 看来伊思本说的没错。

original: I'd like to know more about Winterhold's history.
traduit: 我想多了解了解冬堡的历史。

original: I'm afraid the Winterhold you see before you is somewhat... underwhelming.
traduit: 恐怕你眼前的冬堡显得有些……平庸。

original: I can assure you, though, that it was quite something in its prime. An early capital of Skyrim, you know.
traduit: 不过我可以跟你保证，鼎盛时期的它确实了不得。甚至是天际早期的首都。

original: Sadly, the Oblivion Crisis took its toll on Winterhold, in more ways than one. Then, the Great Collapse swallowed most of our beloved city.
traduit: 遗憾的是，湮灭危机对冬堡造成了多方面的影响。然后，大坍陷吞噬了我们心爱的城市的大部分地区。

original: What's there to tell? It's mostly gone now, thanks to those damned mages in the College.
traduit: 有什么好说的？现在差不多都没了，得好好谢谢学院里那些该死的法师。

original: Someday there'll be proof they caused the Great Collapse. Most of a city just dropping off into the sea... That doesn't just happen.
traduit: 总有一天会有证据证明就是他们造成了大坍陷。城市大部分都沉入海里……事情肯定不简单。

original: I'm afraid there's not much to be said. Winterhold is hardly what it used to be.
traduit: 恐怕没什么好说的了。冬堡比过去差太多了。

original: You can talk to Birna if you need to buy anything. She doesn't have much, but could certainly use the coin. And then there's our little inn.
traduit: 如果想买东西，可以去找比尔娜。她东西不多，但肯定有能用的。然后就是我们的小旅店了。

original: Most of the business we get is from folks here to visit the College, though even that's dried up some.
traduit: 我们大部分生意都来自参观学院的人，尽管这种生意现在也少了些。

original: What can you tell me about Winterhold?
traduit: 你能跟我说说冬堡吗？

original: Tell me more about this artifact.
traduit: 跟我说说这件神器。

original: Mortals call it Dawnbreaker, for it was forged in a holy light that breaks upon my foes, burning away corruption and false life.
traduit: 凡人称之为“破晓者”，因为它在神圣之光中锻造，可以击碎我的敌人，烧毁腐败虚假的生命。

original: You will enter my shrine, destroy Malkoran, and retrieve this mighty blade.
traduit: 你需要进到我的神殿里，消灭莫克然，把这把宝剑带出来。

original: I found this statue in a Forsworn camp.
traduit: 我在一个弃誓者营地发现这个雕像。

original: Ah, there it is! This little gold delight is going to keep us afloat for a while. Thank you. Here's something for your hard work.
traduit: 啊，它在那儿啊！这个小小的金色喜悦能让我们再维持一段时间。谢谢！这是对你辛勤工作的奖励。

original: This store has seen better days, hasn't it?
traduit: 这家店以前很风光吗？

original: Oh, by the Divines is it that obvious? I swear, if my Gunnar was alive to see me now.
traduit: 哦，圣灵啊，这不是很明显吗？我发誓如果我家甘那还在的话，绝不会是这样。

original: This store would finally be on its feet if I hadn't lost my last shipment to Forsworn attacks. A specially-made Dibella statuette.
traduit: 要不是因为我最后一批货被弃誓者袭击了，这家店本可以站稳脚跟的。那是个特制的迪贝拉小雕像。

original: You aren't for hire, are you? A sellsword? I'll pay you if you can recover that statuette from the Forsworn.
traduit: 你不是想找工作吗？你是佣兵吧？如果你能从弃誓者手里把雕像拿回来，我就付钱给你。

original: Why do you need guards?
traduit: 你为什么需要护卫？

original: To protect my research, for one. There are more cutthroat scholars out there who would steal my findings if they got the chance.
traduit: 首先是为了保护我的研究。只要逮着机会，有的是残忍的学者想要偷走我的研究成果。

original: And the excavations into Nchuand-Zel are dangerous. Dwemer machines and traps still function even after thousands of years.
traduit: 而且尼楚安德-泽尔的挖掘工作很危险。锻莫机械和陷阱即使在几千年后还在运转。

original: I have a delivery from Kerah.
traduit: 克拉让我送些东西给你。

original: Oh, that's right. I keep forgetting to pick that up. Poor Kerah, such a patient woman.
traduit: 哦，对。我总是忘记收。可怜的克拉，真是有耐心。

original: Now, you're supposed to get something for your trouble, aren't you? How about some gold? People seem to like that, I notice.
traduit: 现在，你是不是该为麻烦这一趟得到点什么了？来点金币怎么样？我发现人们似乎都很喜欢。

original: I had some questions about this city.
traduit: 我对这个城市有些疑问。

original: Do I look like a guide? Only thing I do is sell meat. Now, are you going to buy or not?
traduit: 我看着像导游吗？我唯一的工作就是卖肉。行了，你到底买不买？

original: This city looks so ancient. Have you been here long?
traduit: 这座城市看着很古老。你在这里很久了吗？

original: My family came here centuries ago. We've made a good living smithing the silver that flows through the city.
traduit: 我家在这里几百年了。我们靠铸造银器过上了好日子。

original: But you probably wanted to know about the fancy carvings and stonework, didn't you? Travelers always do.
traduit: 但你是对那些奇特的雕刻和石雕感兴趣吧？旅行者都这样。

original: Here, I have a delivery I need to make to Calcelmo. Why don't you take it to him? He knows the history of Markarth better than anyone.
traduit: 嘿，我有份东西需要送给卡塞莫。要不你给他拿去？他比任何人都了解马卡斯的历史。

original: May I see the staff?
traduit: 我能看看这个法杖吧？

original: In fact. Keep it. I must have used up the magic in the staff or something. It's just a dumb stick of wood now.
traduit: 其实，我一定是把法杖里的魔法都用光了。它现在就是根破木棍。

original: See, my grandfather was a wizard. My father wouldn't talk about him much. But I found some of his things in the attic. Including this staff.
traduit: 我祖父是个巫师。我爸不怎么谈论他。但我在阁楼上找到了他的一些东西。包括这个法杖。

original: After that I thought I was turning into a wizard too, because dead things near me would come to life again for while.
traduit: 在那之后，我还以为自己也变成了巫师，因为我能让身边死去的东西复活一段时间。

original: I even went to the College of Winterhold. But they just laughed at me. The magic is in the staff, not in me they said.
traduit: 我甚至去过冬堡学院。但他们只是嘲笑我，说魔力是法杖的，不是我的。

original: That's quite a staff you have there.
traduit: 你的法杖不错啊。

original: I used to think so, too.
traduit: 我以前也这么觉得。

original: Yes. It's painfully obvious you don't know what you're doing.
traduit: 是啊。很显然你不知道自己在干什么。

original: You don't have to tell me that.
traduit: 你没必要告诉我的。

original: What exactly are you trying to do?
traduit: 你到底想做什么？

original: Oh... hello there. Didn't notice you come up. I was focusing my magicka.
traduit: 哦……你好。没注意到你。我正在专注于我的魔力。

original: Or at least, I thought I was. I don't really know what I'm doing.
traduit: 至少我是这么认为的。我真的不知道自己该怎么做了。

original: Rise up and live again!
traduit: 起来啊，活过来啊！

original: I grant you a new life!
traduit: 我赐予你新的生命！

original: Come on, get up!
traduit: 来吧，起来吧！

original: This should work. I've done it before.
traduit: 应该能成功啊。我之前试过的。

original: Gah! This staff is useless... I'm useless. The whole world is useless!
traduit: 啊！这法杖没有用……我也没有用。全世界都没用！

original: This looks like the way.
traduit: 看起来这边能走。

original: Velehk Sain, I banish you to Oblivion!
traduit: 维勒克·赛因，我把你逐回湮灭！

original: Clever try, scab, but it won't be that easy!
traduit: 聪明的尝试，小坏蛋，但没那么容易！

original: Vehlek Sain, I release you.
traduit: 维勒克·赛因，我释放你。

original: There's a smart lad. Take the map. The loot's hidden there. It'll show itself when you get near.
traduit: 聪明的小子。拿上地图吧。战利品就藏在那儿。只要一走近就能发现。

original: There's a smart lass. Check the map. The loot's hidden there. It'll show itself when you get near.
traduit: 聪明的小姑娘。拿上地图吧。战利品就藏在那儿。只要一走近就能发现。

original: How could I even release you?
traduit: 我该怎么放你？

original: Names have power, lad. You should know by now. Just say "Velehk Sain, I release you.", and "Poof!", I'm on my way.
traduit: 名字是蕴含能量的，小伙子。你应该知道了。只要说一声“维勒克·赛因，我释放你。”，然后噗的一声，我就走了。

original: Names have power, lass. You should know by now. Just say "Velehk Sain, I release you.", and "Poof!", I'm on my way.
traduit: 名字是蕴含能量的，小姑娘。你应该知道了。只要说一声“维勒克·赛因，我释放你。”，然后噗的一声，我就走了。

original: What wealth is this?
traduit: 什么财富？

original: Years back, I had to ferret away some booty nearby. We'd sunk an Imperial Galleon off the coast. Good plunder, but we needed to travel light.
traduit: 很多年前，我在这附近找了些战利品。我们在海岸击沉了一艘帝国帆船。虽然都是不错的宝贝，但我们得轻装上路。

original: We stashed what we couldn't carry, and I hid it with a trick I know. I can point you in the right direction, and we'll each go our separate ways.
traduit: 我们把带不走的东西用我的小技巧都藏了起来。我可以给你指路，然后咱们各奔东西。

original: Those kids are dead anyway. Killing me won't bring them back. I, on the other hand, have done quite a bit with my time on Mundus.
traduit: 反正那些小娃娃也都死了。杀我也不会让他们复活。而且，我在梦达思度过了很长时间。

original: Release me, and I'll share a bit of my wealth with you.
traduit: 释放我，我可以把我的财富分一点给你。

original: Not a chance.
traduit: 想都别想。

original: Have it your own way, meat.
traduit: 那就是你自找的，肉块。

original: You're going back where you belong, dremora.
traduit: 回你该回的地方去吧，魔人。

original: Where I belong is back aboard my ship, on the Abecean.
traduit: 我应该回到我在阿贝希恩海的船上了。

original: You've no hope of defeating me, pup. Don't bother. Why not broker a bargain, instead?
traduit: 你赢不了我的，小东西。不用麻烦了。为什么不来场交易呢？

original: We're beneath Winterhold College. The Midden.
traduit: 我们在冬堡学院下面的秽道。

original: Ah, I was beginning to think the day would never come. So you broke the binding spell, did you? Matters little.
traduit: 啊，我还以为这一天永远不会到来呢。所以是你解除了封印魔法？无所谓。

original: Their souls are trapped in Oblivion all the same, and here I stay.
traduit: 他们的灵魂仍旧困在湮灭，而我还在这里。

original: Where did you come from?
traduit: 你是从哪儿来的？

original: Where am I? You! Out with it, then.
traduit: 我这是在哪里？你！快说。

original: Ah, here's the blushing bride now. Let's begin the ceremony.
traduit: 啊，娇羞的新娘到了。那我们开始仪式吧。

original: Ah, here's the proud groom now. Let's begin the ceremony.
traduit: 啊，害羞的新郎到了。那我们开始仪式吧。

original: Stop the wedding! I can't go through with this.
traduit: 停下婚礼吧！我做不到。

original: You're just going to walk away from your betrothal? Get out of the temple.
traduit: 你就这么放弃你的婚约？滚出神殿。

original: I do. Now and forever.
traduit: 我愿意，从现在直到永远。

original: Under the authority of Mara, the Divine of Love, I declare this couple to be wed.
traduit: 在爱之圣灵玛拉之权威下，我宣布这对夫妇喜结连理。

original: I present the two of you with these matching rings, blessed by Mara's divine grace. May they protect each of you in your new life together.
traduit: 这对婚戒送给你们，上面接受了玛拉神圣恩典的祝福。愿它们在你们的新生活里保佑你们。

original: I made a mistake. I want to go ahead with the ceremony.
traduit: 是我的错。我想继续举行婚礼。

original: "Forgiveness is the heart of Mara's blessings." Very well. We shall re-arrange your wedding.
traduit: “宽恕正是玛拉慈爱之心”。好吧，我们重新给你安排婚礼。

original: Tomorrow. Same time as before.
traduit: 明天。同一时间。

original: Well I think your betrothed might feel otherwise. The two of you will need to work this out before the temple will marry you.
traduit: 我想你的婚约者可不这么想。你俩得先把事情解决了，神殿才能为你们举办婚礼。

original: It's our wedding day. I feel like all of Skyrim is focused on just the two of us.
traduit: 今天是我们大喜的日子。我感觉全天际都在围绕着我们。

original: This is a fine wedding. And to think, it's for us.
traduit: 真是一个不错的婚礼。而且还是为我们准备的。

original: This ceremony is so different from an Orc marriage. Less blood.
traduit: 这婚礼和兽人的真不大一样。没有血。

original: I never would have dreamed I would be getting married in the Temple of Mara.
traduit: 我做梦也没想到我会在玛拉的神殿举行婚礼。

original: Weddings always make me cry. What am I supposed to do now that I'm the one getting married?
traduit: 婚礼总会让我哭泣。现在是我要结婚，那我该怎么办？

original: It's a simple ceremony, but it'll do. You're here. That's enough.
traduit: 仪式很简约，但也不错。有你在就足矣。

original: Who would have thought I would be getting married?
traduit: 谁能想到我居然能结婚？

original: How could you? Just go.
traduit: 你怎么能这样？躲开。

original: I don't want to see you ever again.
traduit: 我不想再见到你。

original: Get away from me. Liar!
traduit: 离我远点。骗子！

original: You should leave. Now.
traduit: 你赶快躲远点。

original: Get out. Leave me alone!
traduit: 滚。别理我！

original: You're abandoning me? Me? I never want to see you ever again.
traduit: 你要拒绝我？我？我不想再看到你了。

original: Get out of my sight.
traduit: 滚出我的视线。

original: Get out.
traduit: 滚。

original: Congratulations on your wedding. I'm so happy for both of you.
traduit: 恭贺新婚了。真为你们感到高兴。

original: Just leave.
traduit: 离开吧。

original: And so ends the Dark Brotherhood, once and for all. About bloody time.
traduit: 黑暗兄弟会终结了，永远完蛋了。血腥的时代过去了。

original: Anyway, I can smell the smoke. They've already set the place alight.
traduit: 不过，我能闻到烟味了。他们应该已经点着了。

original: If they were easy to kill, don't you think we would have done it years ago? If our men aren't out in a few minutes, they're dead, trust me.
traduit: 如果他们这么容易被杀，难道咱们不会早动手吗？如果我们的人几分钟内不出来，他们就是死了，相信我。

original: What's the bloody hold up in there? How long can it take to run through a few scraggly assassins?
traduit: 里面到底怎么了？干掉几个杂牌刺客要这么久？

original: This had better be worth all the trouble.
traduit: 这些麻烦最好是值得的。

original: Few outsiders earn the right to enter our strongholds. Speak with more respect, or we might forget your gifts.
traduit: 很少有外人有资格进入我们的要塞。说话放尊重点，否则我们可能会忘掉你拿来的礼物。

original: Feel free to trade with our smiths for Orc weapons and armor. Train with my warriors, or purchase poisons from the wise woman.
traduit: 你可以和我们的铁匠交易些兽人武器盔甲，也可以和我的战士们一起训练，或者到智妪那里买毒药。

original: I'm honored.
traduit: 我很荣幸。

original: Welcome to our stronghold, Blood-Kin.
traduit: 欢迎来到我们的要塞，血亲。

original: I don't believe it. You found the Forgemaster's Fingers. You've impressed me, outlander. No one else has returned from this task before.
traduit: 真不敢相信。你找到了锻炉大师的手指。不错么，外地人。以前没人能完成这项任务返回。

original: By the Code of Malacath, I name you Blood-Kin to the Orcs. Let it be known among the strongholds that you are family, now.
traduit: 根据玛拉凯斯法典，我将你视为兽人的血亲。各要塞会知道咱们是一家人了。

original: What are you doing here, outlander? We don't deal with your kind.
traduit: 外来者，你在这里做什么？我们不会和你们打交道的。

original: This is our stronghold. Leave.
traduit: 这是我们的要塞。离开。

original: Outsiders. Nothing but trouble.
traduit: 外来者。除了麻烦什么都不是。

original: Malacath blesses us with this land. It's not for your kind.
traduit: 玛拉凯斯为我们祝福了这片土地。与你们这些人无关。

original: This stronghold is for the Orcs. Leave. Now.
traduit: 这是兽人的要塞。离开。立刻。

original: We don't know you, and we don't want you here.
traduit: 我们不认识你，也不欢迎你。

original: Leave, outlander.
traduit: 离开，外来者。

original: You've no right to be here. This place is for Orcs. And Orcs alone.
traduit: 你无权进入这里。这是兽人的领地。只属于兽人。

original: Outlanders should learn to not wander where they don't belong.
traduit: 外来者应该学会不去不属于自己的地方。

original: Why do we need to be cautious?
traduit: 我们为什么要谨慎？

original: The original Companions. Their finest warriors rest with Ysgramor. You'll have to prove yourselves to them.
traduit: 最初的战友团。他们最优秀的战士正与伊斯格拉默一起安眠。你得向他们证明自己。

original: It's not that you're intruding. I'd wager they've actually expected us.
traduit: 并不是说你会打扰到他们。我敢打赌他们早就预料到我们的到来。

original: They just want to be sure that you're worthy. Be ready for an honorable battle.
traduit: 他们只是想确认你的价值。为光荣的一战做好准备吧。

original: Who will start?
traduit: 谁来开始？

original: Well I'll be damned. We heard you were dead. Motierre's in the back room, if you've got business.
traduit: 吓我一跳。我们听说你死了。如果你有事的话，莫提雷就在里屋。

original: Please, make haste. The Emperor's ship won't stayed moored forever. We won't get a chance like this again.
traduit: 请快点。皇帝的船不会一直停在那。我们不会再有这样的机会。

original: I'll admit, I'm having trouble coming to terms with all of this. I'll just follow Nazir's lead.
traduit: 我承认，我很难接受这一切。我会跟着纳兹尔走的。

original: Babette, my girl - pack your things. We're moving.
traduit: 巴贝特，小姑娘，收拾自己的东西。我们走。

original: Hmph. All right, then. Go. Go, my Listener. Find out what that slimy bastard Motierre has to say, then send the Emperor to Sithis.
traduit: 嗯，好吧。走，走吧，聆听者。问问那个混蛋莫提雷还有什么好说的，然后把皇帝送到西帝斯那去。

original: Ah, but when you're done, there's no use returning here, is there? I was thinking... the Dawnstar Sanctuary. We could make a proper home there.
traduit: 啊，但等你完事之后，就没必要再回来了对吧？我在想……晨星圣所。我们可以在那里建个像样的家。

original: Listen, when you're finished with this Emperor business, meet Babette and me there. I'll find some way to move the Night Mother. Don't worry. Now go!
traduit: 听着，等处理完皇帝的事，就去找我和巴贝特吧。我会想办法把夜母搬走的。别担心。现在去吧！

original: And come back with a barrel full of gold, hmm?
traduit: 然后带一大桶金币回来啊。

original: Our Family lives on, Nazir. You have to trust me.
traduit: 纳兹尔，我们的家庭还在。你必须相信我。

original: Amaund Motierre? But that would mean...
traduit: 阿蒙德·莫提雷？这么说……

original: I must speak with Amaund Motierre once more.
traduit: 我必须再和阿蒙德·莫提雷谈谈。

original: What? Well - what did she say?
traduit: 什么？她，是怎么说的？

original: Not exactly. The Night Mother has spoken to me again.
traduit: 不全是。夜母又对我说话了。

original: By Sithis, what a mess. I guess this is the end.
traduit: 西帝斯在上，真是一团糟。我看一切都结束了。

original: You just worry about fulfilling the contract. I'll take care of things on this end.
traduit: 你只需要考虑契约的事就行了。我来处理这边的事。

original: Derkeethus, from Darkwater Crossing.
traduit: 暗水岔口的德吉图斯。

original: Should have known better than to swim all the way to the falls.
traduit: 早知道就不该游到瀑布来。

original: Please, get me out of here!
traduit: 拜托了，请救我出去！

original: Laelette! She's dead!
traduit: 拉莱特！她死了！

original: Ysmir's beard! She's...she's a vampire!
traduit: 伊斯米尔的胡子啊！她……她是吸血鬼！

original: Die rebel!
traduit: 死吧，叛军！

original: Send Ulfric my regards!
traduit: 带我向乌弗瑞克问好！

original: You call yourself a warrior?
traduit: 你管自己叫战士？

original: For the glory of the Empire!
traduit: 为了帝国的荣耀！

original: A pox on the Empire!
traduit: 遭瘟的帝国！

original: I'll water the ground with your blood.
traduit: 我要让你血洒大地。

original: For the sons of Skyrim!
traduit: 为了天际之子！

original: We're almost through!
traduit: 我们快赢了！

original: They're at the gate!
traduit: 他们在大门那！

original: We're through! Keep at them!
traduit: 我们闯过去了！缠住他们！

original: They're in! Don't let them gain further ground!
traduit: 他们在那儿！拦住他们！

original: Keep it together! There's not many of us left!
traduit: 坚持住！我们的人不多了！

original: This is hopeless! Retreat!
traduit: 没希望了！撤！

original: Yeaaaah! Come on, we can take them!
traduit: 呀啊啊！来啊，我们能打败他们！

original: Here they come!
traduit: 他们来了！

original: That's it! We're pushing them back!
traduit: 就是这样！我们把他们逼退了！

original: Fall back, fall back! Regroup and fall back!
traduit: 撤退，撤退！重新整合然后撤退！

original: We've got them pinned in! It's only a matter of time now. Keep fighting!
traduit: 我们把他们牵制住了！现在就是时间问题。继续战斗！

original: This is it! Hold at all costs! Don't give them any more ground!
traduit: 就这样！不惜一切代价！不要让他们再进一步！

original: Someone take out that mage!
traduit: 找人去把那个法师干掉！

original: Someone put an arrow in that damn wizard!
traduit: 找人把那个混蛋巫师射死！

original: Take out their archers!
traduit: 干掉他们的弓箭手！

original: Archers!
traduit: 弓箭手！

original: Over by that bridge!
traduit: 穿过桥去！

original: Along the fence, do you see them?
traduit: 沿着围栏走，看得见吗？

original: They got archers over there by the fence!
traduit: 围栏那边有弓箭手！

original: Wizard! Hiding over there by that fence!
traduit: 有巫师躲在围墙那边！

original: They're over there, next to that house!
traduit: 他们在那栋房子那边！

original: By that rock over there. See 'em?
traduit: 在石头旁边，看见了吗？

original: They're hiding over by those stables!
traduit: 他们躲在马厩！

original: Up in that tower! Quick!
traduit: 冲上塔去！快！

original: Archer in that tower!
traduit: 塔里有弓箭手！

original: Mage up there! In the tower!
traduit: 塔里有法师！

original: Over by the tree!
traduit: 在树那边！

original: They're up on that wall.
traduit: 他们在墙上。

original: They got archers up along the wall!
traduit: 墙上有弓箭手！

original: Look! Up on the wall. A wizard!
traduit: 看！墙上有巫师！

original: Look sharp. There they are. In the window!
traduit: 小心。他们在窗户那儿！

original: Archers. Behind those windows!
traduit: 窗户后面有弓箭手！

original: They've got a mage hiding in that window up there!
traduit: 窗户后头有法师！

original: Alva is a vampire!
traduit: 阿尔瓦是吸血鬼！

original: So you were right. Go tell the Jarl. Hurry!
traduit: 所以你是对的。赶快告诉领主！

original: Now, I am afraid I must leave you. We will continue to watch over you, and guide you as best we can.
traduit: 现在，恐怕我得离开你了。我们会继续观察你，尽我们所能指引你。

original: It is within you to succeed. Never forget that.
traduit: 不要忘记，功成于心。

original: What happens now?
traduit: 现在呢？

original: Where can I find this Augur?
traduit: 我到哪儿才能找到占卜师？

original: I... I am unsure. He is somewhere within the College. Surely one of your colleagues must know his location.
traduit: 我……我也不确定。他应该在学院的某个地方。你的同事们肯定知道他的位置。

original: I am sorry I cannot provide you with further help, but this conversation requires a great deal of effort on my part.
traduit: 很抱歉我无法再为你提供更多帮助，单是这场对话就已经让我耗尽心力了。

original: Who is the Augur of Dunlain?
traduit: 占卜师杜兰是谁？

original: He was once a student here at the College. Now he is... something different.
traduit: 他曾经是这所学院的学生。但现在……是很不一样的东西了。

original: Why should I trust you or your Order?
traduit: 我为什么要相信你和你的教团？

original: I presume you refer to Ancano's distaste for the Psijic Order?
traduit: 我猜你指的是安卡诺对赛伊克教团的厌恶吧？

original: The Thalmor see our Order as a threat because we have power, and we will not allow them to control us.
traduit: 我们既有力量，又不容梭默操弄。因此他们把我们视为威胁。

original: I assure you that we mean you no harm.
traduit: 我向你保证，我们无意伤害你。

original: I fear I have already overstepped the bounds of my Order, but I will offer this: seek out the Augur of Dunlain here in your College.
traduit: 恐怕我已经超越了本教团的界限，但我建议你在学院里寻找占卜师杜兰。

original: His perception may be more coherent than ours.
traduit: 他的看法也许会比我们更清楚。

original: I'll help, but I don't know what to do.
traduit: 我会帮忙的，但我不知道该怎么做。

original: Unfortunately, the future is as obscured to us as it is to you. The overwhelming power of the Eye makes it difficult for us to see.
traduit: 很不幸，未来对于你我来说都是模糊不清的。“眼”的强大力量使我们很难洞悉。

original: What do you expect from me, then?
traduit: 那你想从我这里得到什么？

original: We believe the your efforts should be directed towards dealing with the aftermath, but we cannot predict what that will be.
traduit: 我们认为，你们应当全力善后，但具体情况我们也无法预知。

original: So what exactly is the problem?
traduit: 那问题到底是什么？

original: As you may have learned, this object... The Eye... is immensely powerful.
traduit: 你可能已经知道，这个物体……那个眼睛……十分强大。

original: This world is not ready for it. If it remains here, it will be misused.
traduit: 这个世界还没准备好。如果它留在这里，就会被滥用。

original: Indeed, many in the Order believe it has already... Rather, something will happen soon, something that cannot be avoided.
traduit: 事实上，教团的很多成员认为它已经……反正事情很快就会发生了，不可避免的事情。

original: You must understand, the Psijic Order does not typically... intervene directly in events.
traduit: 你必须理解，赛伊克教团通常不会……直接干预事件。

original: My presence here will be seen as an affront to some within the Order, and as soon as we have finished, I will be leaving your College.
traduit: 我此行在某些教团同修看来几乎就是冒犯，等我们说完，我就会离开你们学院。

original: I'm all too aware that my arrival has aroused suspicion, especially in Ancano, your Thalmor associate.
traduit: 我很清楚我的到来会引起人们的怀疑，尤其是你的梭默同事安卡诺。

original: Nevertheless, my Order will not act directly. You must take it upon yourself to do so.
traduit: 然而，本教团不会直接发挥作用。你必须自己承担其责任。

original: What does this have to do with me?
traduit: 这和我有什么关系？

original: You set this chain of events in motion at Saarthal.
traduit: 因为你在萨瑟尔的行为开启了这一连串事件。

original: If this is dangerous, then why don't you do something about it?
traduit: 如果很危险，你何不做些什么？

original: I've given us a chance to speak privately, but I'm afraid I can't do this for long. We must be brief.
traduit: 我只是制造一个可以单独交谈的机会，但恐怕我坚持不了太久，所以一切从简吧。

original: The situation here at your College is of dire importance, and attempts to contact you as we have previously have failed.
traduit: 贵学院的情况非常重要，我们曾试图联系你们，但都失败了。

original: I believe it is due to the very source of our concern. This object... The Eye of Magnus as your people have taken to calling it.
traduit: 我认为这正是我们关切的根源所在。这个物体……你们称之为玛格努斯之眼。

original: The energy coming from it has prevented us from reaching you with the visions you have already seen.
traduit: 它散发出来的能量，干扰了我们，我们没法像之前那样，用幻象联系你了。

original: The longer it remains here, the more dangerous the situation becomes. And so I have come here personally to tell you it must be dealt with.
traduit: 它在此停留时间越长，情况就会越危险。所以我亲自到此告诉你解决此事的必要性。

original: I merely wish to talk to you.
traduit: 我只是想和你谈谈。

original: Please do not be alarmed. I mean you no harm.
traduit: 请不必惊慌。我无意伤害你。

original: Aren't you just an advisor here?
traduit: 你不就是个顾问么？

original: Technically, that is true. But I still report to the Aldmeri Dominion, and I cannot ignore this situation.
traduit: 严格来说，没错。但我还是需要向先祖神洲进行汇报，我不能忽视这一情况。

original: Don't worry, you can return to your petty squabbles and meaningless 'research' as soon as this matter is resolved.
traduit: 别担心，等问题解决，你就可以回归你那琐碎的争吵和无意义的“研究”中了。

original: Why are you so concerned about this?
traduit: 你为什么关心这个？

original: I'll be the one asking the questions.
traduit: 我就是提问题的人。

original: All you need to know is that the Psijic Order is a rogue organization, believing themselves to be above the law.
traduit: 你只需知道，赛伊克教团就是个流氓组织，以为可以凌驾法律。

original: They have clashed with the Aldmeri Dominion before, and I have no intention of allowing that to happen here.
traduit: 他们曾经和先祖神洲发生过冲突，我不打算让此事在此重演。

original: Paarthurnax is dead.
traduit: 帕图纳克斯死了。

original: This is how you repay our trust? Paarthurnax's trust?
traduit: 这就是你回馈我们还有帕图纳克斯信任的方式？

original: His noble spirit... the wisdom of ages... his deep understanding of our existence... all gone, and for what?
traduit: 他高尚的精神……经年积累的智慧……对我们存在的深刻理解……全都没了，这是为了什么？

original: A mindless vendetta urged on you by a cabal of Akaviri barbarians!
traduit: 这是那群阿卡维尔野蛮人阴谋集团给你安排的盲目复仇！

original: Begone, before even my philosophy is tested beyond the breaking point. We are men of peace, and you are not.
traduit: 走吧，在我的哲学思想被考验到极限之前。我们爱好和平，但你不是。

original: My oath binds me, Dragonborn. Until Paarthurnax is dead, you aren't welcome here.
traduit: 我的誓言束缚着我，龙裔。在帕图纳克斯死前，你不会受到欢迎。

original: Do the right thing. Paarthurnax deserves to die.
traduit: 做该做的事吧。帕图纳克斯必须死。

original: We have nothing to talk about until Paarthurnax is dead.
traduit: 在帕图纳克斯死前我们无话可谈。

original: You shouldn't be here, unless you've decided to bring Paarthurnax to justice.
traduit: 除非你决定把帕图纳克斯公正裁决掉，就不该在这儿待着。

original: What further business do you have with us?
traduit: 你跟我们还有什么可谈的？

original: You have made your choice, Dragonborn. You are not welcome here.
traduit: 你已经作出了抉择，龙裔。这里不欢迎你。

original: Speak, and then begone.
traduit: 说完就赶紧走。

original: Don't worry, I'm not going to kill Paarthurnax.
traduit: 别担心。我不会杀了帕图纳克斯的。

original: Kynareth has placed the Voice of wisdom within you, Dragonborn. All you need do is learn to listen to it, and your path will be clear.
traduit: 凯娜瑞丝已经在你心中放入了智慧的吼声，龙裔。你现在需要学会倾听，才能道路通明。

original: I haven't decided what to do yet.
traduit: 我还没决定好。

original: You're learning, Dragonborn. Doing nothing can be the wisest choice, although strangely often the most difficult.
traduit: 你学到了，龙裔。什么都不做可能是最明智的选择，尽管也可能是最难的抉择。

original: I trust that you will make the right choice, in the end. Listen to the Voice that Kynareth has placed within you, and your path will be clear.
traduit: 我相信你最终会做出正确的抉择。聆听凯娜瑞丝放在你心中的吼声，你的道路会变得清晰。

original: He still needs to pay for his crimes.
traduit: 他还是需要为罪行付出代价。

original: The same could be said for any of us, could it not? Are you so guiltless as to stand in judgment upon Paarthurnax?
traduit: 这句话也适用于我们每个人，不是吗？难道你就是一身清白可以去审判帕图纳克斯？

original: Listen to your inner Voice before acting. Do not allow the Blades to bully you into doing something you will later regret.
traduit: 在行动前倾听自己内心的吼声。不要被刀锋威胁，做出追悔莫及的事。

original: After all, repentance is something you deny to Paarthurnax by meting out your so-called justice.
traduit: 毕竟，你在伸张你所谓正义的同时，也否决了帕图纳克斯的悔过。

original: I need the Elder Scroll the ancients used. Do you know where to find it?
traduit: 我需要古人用过的上古卷轴。你知道哪里能找到吗？

original: We have never concerned ourselves with the Scrolls. The gods themselves would rightly fear to tamper with such things.
traduit: 我们从未关注过上古卷轴。连诸神也会害怕用这些东西去干涉。

original: As for where to find it... such blasphemies have always been the stock in trade of the mages of Winterhold.
traduit: 至于去哪里找……这些渎神之事向来是冬堡法师们的老本行。

original: They may be able to tell you something about the Elder Scroll you seek.
traduit: 他们也许能告诉你如何寻找上古卷轴。

original: No, but he told me how to find out.
traduit: 没有，但是他告诉我怎么去找。

original: So be it. If he believes it is necessary for you to learn this... we will bow to his wisdom.
traduit: 那就这样吧。既然他认为你有学习的必要……那我们会服从他的智慧。

original: I talked to Paarthurnax.
traduit: 我和帕图纳克斯谈过了。

original: So... you spoke to Paarthurnax. The dragonblood burns bright within you.
traduit: 所以……你和帕图纳克斯谈过了。龙血在你体内熊熊燃烧。

original: Did he tell you what you wanted to know? Did he teach you the Dragonrend Shout?
traduit: 你得到你想要的了吗？他教会你龙魂撕裂了？

original: Is it true what they said? Was he Alduin's ally?
traduit: 他们说的是真的？他是奥杜因的盟友？

original: The Blades want me to kill Paarthurnax.
traduit: 刀锋会想要我杀了帕图纳克斯。

original: Now you see why I've warned you against them! Bloodthirsty barbarians!
traduit: 现在你该知道我为什么警告你要防着他们了吧！这帮嗜血的野蛮人！

original: The Blades said that Paarthurnax used to be Alduin's ally.
traduit: 刀锋会说帕图纳克斯曾经是奥杜因的盟友。

original: Speak, if you have aught to say worth the listening.
traduit: 说吧，如果有什么值得一听的，就说出来吧。

original: By the gods... you! But it can't be. You're dead. You... Yeaaaahhhh!
traduit: 诸神在上……是你！这不可能。你已经死了。你……呀啊啊啊啊！

original: You know, I like it here. We should have moved to Dawnstar ages ago.
traduit: 我挺喜欢这里的。咱们早就该搬到晨星来了。

original: Is there anything more revolting than spiders? Too many legs...
traduit: 还有什么比蜘蛛恶心的东西吗？一堆腿……

original: What? How did you get this far?
traduit: 什么？你是怎么到这儿的？

original: What? No! Get back in your cage!
traduit: 什么？不！回你的笼子去！

original: Give me just a moment, and I'll have this open.
traduit: 稍等一下，我把这个打开。

original: I know! I know! Just shut up and let me look, okay?
traduit: 我知道！我知道！把嘴闭上让我好好找，行吗？

original: You'd better find that chest that fell off the boat or Gulum-Ei will have your hide!
traduit: 你最好把从船上掉下来的那个箱子找到，不然古鲁姆-埃会扒了你的皮！

original: Petra? She's already dead.
traduit: 佩特拉？她已经死了。

original: What? That flower-chewer's died? Then let me out. My tower!
traduit: 什么？那个疯子死了？那放我出去。这是我的塔！

original: Press only middle button! Clever trick, yes? Nobody ever thinks of the middle.
traduit: 只要按中间的按钮！这花招很聪明吧？没人会想到就是中间的。

original: Yes, kind morsel. Let us go up, and mind Melka on the way.
traduit: 好，善良的食物。我们上去吧，路上记得注意梅尔卡。

original: Live in my tower, roost in my home. Mix pretty poisons and collect shiny eyeballs, yes.
traduit: 住在我自己的塔楼里，在自己家里休息。混合漂亮的毒药，收集亮晶晶的眼珠，就这样。

original: You... must not see many Orcs around here.
traduit: 你……在这里看不到太多兽人吧。

original: Why would I release you?
traduit: 我为什么要放你？

original: Because you are such a very nice Orc?
traduit: 因为你是个很好的兽人啊？

original: What? I'm no Breton.
traduit: 啥？我不是布莱顿人。

original: Oh. Yes. You all look the same.
traduit: 哦。是吗。你们看起来都一个样。

original: Hey, I'm not a Breton!
traduit: 喂。我可不是布莱顿人！

original: What do I get if I free you?
traduit: 放了你我能得到什么？

original: Ah, I have a pretty staff. Help me find Petra, wring her neck, pluck her eyes. Take my prize staff, I just want my tower back!
traduit: 啊，我有一根漂亮的法杖。帮我找到佩特拉，扭断她的脖子，抠出她的眼睛。拿走我奖励你的法杖，我只想夺回我的塔楼！

original: Because, because you are such a nice Breton, yes!
traduit: 因为，因为你是个善良的布莱顿人，没错！

original: Petra! Evil Petra put me here, stole my tower. Hate her, chew her bones! Let me out, kind, kind meat.
traduit: 佩特拉！邪恶的佩特拉把我关在这里，偷走了我的塔。恨死她了，咬碎她的骨头！放我出去吧，善良的小肉块。

original: We go up, yes? Always up.
traduit: 我们要上去对吧？总是这样。

original: Such a kind nibble you are.
traduit: 你可真是个好人。

original: You, meat! Come, come.
traduit: 你，那块肉！过来，过来。

original: Don't leave poor Melka to die.
traduit: 别丢下可怜的梅尔卡等死。

original: Petra! Petra! Curse her eyes!
traduit: 佩特拉！佩特拉！诅咒她的眼睛！

original: Do you like my pretty tower?
traduit: 你喜欢我漂亮的塔吗？

original: What, seriously? Come on, I thought that was funny!
traduit: 干嘛这么认真？来吧，我觉得挺有意思的！

original: Oh my... that's the worst one yet. How about we stop talking and keep our eyes open like Gulum-Ei said?
traduit: 哦……这个太烂了。别聊了，听古鲁姆-埃的话好好放哨吧？

original: He didn't want to hit the bar like the rest! Ha ha ha!
traduit: 因为他不想像其他人一样去泡吧！哈哈哈哈！

original: Locked. Damn! One of the hags nearby will have the key. You'll have to take it from here. I'll keep watch here - unless you can pick the lock.
traduit: 锁上了。该死！有个鬼婆拿着钥匙。接下来交给你了。我在这里放哨，等你来开锁。

original: Hagraven up ahead. Pull the lever when you're ready and we'll take her.
traduit: 乌鸦鬼婆在前面。准备好了就拉操纵杆，然后就干掉她。

original: He's a half-decent farmer. Ask him to teach you to farm!
traduit: 他种地还算过得去。让他教你怎么种地吧！

original: But mama...
traduit: 可是，妈妈……

original: I don't want to hear another word about what you're learning from the elf! It's high time you learned to be a Nord, too!
traduit: 我不想再听你从那个精灵那学了什么了！你也该学着怎么做诺德人了！

original: And Meieran thinks that we should go there.
traduit: 梅兰觉得我们应该去那里。

original: I think I like the lake here just a little more.
traduit: 我想还是这里的湖更好看。

original: To see the fires!
traduit: 去看看火啊！

original: I've been in Skyrim my whole life. Why would I want to leave?
traduit: 我一生都待在天际，为什么要离开？

original: Do you ever want to go to Morrowind, Sondas?
traduit: 你想去晨风吗，松达斯？

original: I'll have to take your word on that one, my dear.
traduit: 我只能相信你的话了，宝贝。

original: That it was black and gross and nobody wanted to live there anymore.
traduit: 那里又黑又恶心，没人愿意再住在那里了。

original: Oh? What about it?
traduit: 哦？听说过什么呢？

original: Sondas, I've heard about Morrowind.
traduit: 松达斯，我听说过晨风。

original: Thanks! I'm out!
traduit: 谢谢！我出来了！

original: Be careful... we're certain to find more of the awakened within.
traduit: 小心……我们肯定会发现更多醒过来的人。

original: It's just up here.
traduit: 就在这上面。

original: I've spent the last few decades living in regret and seeking redemption from Mara. And by Her Benevolence, I will right my wrongs.
traduit: 过去几十年，我一直活在悔恨中，寻求玛拉的救赎。凭她的善心，我将纠正我的过失。

original: I knew it! You're a liar!
traduit: 我就知道！你这个骗子！

original: And what would you have me say? Sorry for following the misguided teachings of a mad Divine? Sorry for stealing memories from children?
traduit: 你还想让我怎么说？对不起，我不该听从疯狂神灵的邪说？对不起，我不该偷走了孩子们的记忆？

original: Do you realize when the orcs attacked, I was only concerned with myself? I fled... and left my brothers and sisters behind to die.
traduit: 你知道么，兽人进攻时，我只关心自己。我逃了……留下兄弟姐妹等死。

original: You should have told me the truth.
traduit: 你应该告诉我真相。

original: Yes, you're right. I should have, but I didn't know what to say.
traduit: 没错，你说得对。我是该告诉你的。但我不知如何开口。

original: When the orcs raided the temple, I fled. I left my brothers and sisters behind to die.
traduit: 兽人袭击神殿的时候，我逃走了，把兄弟姐妹们留下等死。

original: Behold the Skull of Corruption, the source of Dawnstar's woes.
traduit: 看吧，堕落头骨，晨星灾难之源。

original: We must reach the inner sanctum and destroy it. Come, there's no time to lose.
traduit: 我们必须到达内部密室并摧毁它。

original: Now I can show you the source of the nightmares. Over here.
traduit: 现在我可以告诉你噩梦的来源了。在这里。

original: I'll send word to the strongholds to let you in as one of our own.
traduit: 我会传话给各要塞把你当成自己人的。

original: Give him a chance to speak. He's trying to help us.
traduit: 给他个说话的机会。他只是想帮我们。

original: It's out of my hands.
traduit: 这就不是我能管的了。

original: Then go back to your boss and tell him what I've already told him so many times, I lose count.
traduit: 那就回去找你老板，告诉他，我说过很多次了，数都数不清。

original: His request is denied... I'm not paying him any more gold. This madness has to end.
traduit: 我不会同意他的要求。我不会再给他钱了。这种疯狂必须结束。

original: I think you know what it is.
traduit: 我想你知道那是什么。

original: You're gouging me for what little coin I make and you can't even protect yourselves? Ridiculous!
traduit: 你为了挣我这点钱而敲诈我，却连自己都保护不了？可笑！

original: Then you'll pay in more than just coin. (Brawl)
traduit: 那你要付出的可不仅仅是钱了。（打架）

original: Ha! We'll see about that!
traduit: 哈！那就试试看吧！

original: Are you ready to pay Brynjolf what you owe?
traduit: 准备好还清欠布林乔夫的钱了吗？

original: No, and I never will. Now get out of my inn!
traduit: 不，永远不会。滚出我的旅馆！

original: I have a delivery from Bothela.
traduit: 波塞拉让我送来些东西。

original: Oh... yes... um... thank you. Here you go. Some gold for your assistance and your, discretion.
traduit: 哦……对……呃……谢谢。给。给你些金币，算是感谢你的协助和……谨慎。

original: Pity.
traduit: 可惜。

original: The "Hag's Cure." That's a unique name.
traduit: “鬼婆妙方”，很独特的名字。

original: Comes with living to a ripe old age, people start thinking there's something magical about you. Then, the insults.
traduit: 随着年龄增长，人们会开始觉得你拥有一些神奇的东西。然后就是，侮辱。

original: Still, a little knowledge of plants and potions can get you by. Not that anyone likes to admit buying things from you.
traduit: 尽管如此，有些关于植物和药剂的小知识还是能帮你度过难关。没人愿意承认从你这里买过东西。

original: See? I even have a little potion for the Steward. Mind handing it over to him? Just say it should solve that problem he has.
traduit: 知道吗？我甚至给总管配了些小药水。介意帮我交给他吗？就说这能解决他的麻烦。

original: We will now see how you learn a completely new Shout.
traduit: 我们来学一种全新的龙吼。

original: I see that you have already begun to learn the Whirlwind Sprint Shout.
traduit: 我看你已经掌握了旋风冲刺龙吼了。

original: Master Borri will teach you "Wuld," which means "Whirlwind."
traduit: 博瑞大师现在要教给你的“勿”是“旋风”的意思。

original: Master Borri will teach you "Nah" - "Fury" - the second word of Whirlwind Sprint.
traduit: 博瑞大师现在要教给你的“纳”是“愤怒”的意思，是旋风冲刺的第二个词。

original: Master Borri will teach you "Kest" - "Tempest"- the third word of Whirlwind Sprint.
traduit: 博瑞大师现在要教给你的“凯斯”是“疾风”的意思，是旋风冲刺的第三个词。

original: Master Wulfgar will now gift you with his knowledge of "Dah."
traduit: 沃夫加大师会与你分享“达”的知识。

original: With all three words together, this Shout is much more powerful. Use it wisely.
traduit: 三个词叠加使用，这个龙吼就会更加强大。要明智地使用。

original: You are ready to learn the final word of Unrelenting Force, "Dah," which means "Push."
traduit: 你已经准备好学习冷酷之力的最后一个词“达”，意思是“推动”。

original: You worry too much, brother. Victory will be ours.
traduit: 你想得太多了，兄弟。我们会赢的。

original: The battle below goes ill. If Alduin does not rise to our challenge, I fear all may be lost.
traduit: 山下战事不利。如果奥杜因不理会我等的挑战，那就全完了。

original: What else is there?
traduit: 是啊，没了。

original: Have you no thought beyond the blooding of your blade?
traduit: 除了杀敌放血你就没点别的想法吗？

original: Hakon! A glorious day, is it not!
traduit: 哈肯！多荣耀的一天啊！

original: This library used to be filled with arcane volumes. Now look at it; almost everything's been burned.
traduit: 这个图书馆堆满了奥术典籍。找找看吧，不过大部分都被烧毁了。

original: I hope the tome we need is still intact.
traduit: 但愿我们要找的书还完好无损。

original: Daar sul thur se Alduin vokrii. Today Alduin's lordship will be restored.
traduit: 达尔 苏 苏尔 瑟 奥杜因 沃克瑞。奥杜因的统治即将重现。

original: But I honor your courage. Krif voth ahkrin. Die now, in vain.
traduit: 但我敬重你的勇气。克瑞夫 沃斯 阿克因。现在，徒然受死吧。

original: You're probably right.
traduit: 你说得也对。

original: I wouldn't worry about that. He's a good elf. I trust him.
traduit: 不用担心。他是个不错的精灵。我相信他。

original: I'm just worried about what he's teaching her.
traduit: 我担心他会教她些什么。

original: She hardly mentions anything else.
traduit: 她就没提过别的事情。

original: Sondas, does Hrefna ever mention Meieran to you?
traduit: 松达斯，荷夫娜跟你说过梅兰吗？

original: Well, I'll try to be a good influence, then.
traduit: 嗯，我会尽量给她正面影响的。

original: Well, I know she thinks the world of you.
traduit: 嗯，我知道她很喜欢你。

original: Oh, it's no trouble. She's a smart little girl. Might talk your ear off, but she's fun.
traduit: 哦，没事儿。她是个聪明的小姑娘。虽然很唠叨，但是挺有趣的。

original: Thanks for looking after Hrefna.
traduit: 谢谢你照顾荷夫娜了。

original: You should. I miss you.
traduit: 当然。我很想念你。

original: I guess I should join you more often.
traduit: 我想我该多陪陪你的。

original: Not when there's so much to see!
traduit: 没那么多可看的东西！

original: Ever think about spending more time around town?
traduit: 想不想花时间到镇上转转？

original: No need to get snippy.
traduit: 没必要这么傲慢。

original: So you can be helpful sometimes.
traduit: 你有时候还是能帮上忙的嘛。

original: It's at the south end near that loose rockpile.
traduit: 在南边那堆松动的石头那儿。

original: Sweetheart, did you move my pickaxe?
traduit: 亲爱的，你动过我的鹤嘴锄吗？

original: I still do. I just like to have food waiting for me when I come home.
traduit: 我还是喜欢的。只是我希望回家的时候能有做好的食物在等我。

original: You used to love finding new places.
traduit: 你以前很喜欢探索新地方的。

original: And I found a new deposit of amber. Would have been nice to have some help pulling it out.
traduit: 而我发现了新的琥珀矿床，如果有人帮我来挖就好了。

original: Verner, you should have come out with me yesterday. I found the most amazing tree growing right out of a cave.
traduit: 维尔纳，你昨天真该跟我一起出去。我在山洞里发现了一颗特别神奇的树。

original: Come to gawk at the monster?
traduit: 来观赏怪物？

original: I have your silver mold.
traduit: 我找回你的铸银模具了。

original: You've more than proven that the Thieves Guild is back on its feet in our city and earned every bit of your reward.
traduit: 你已经证明盗贼公会在我们的城市里站稳了脚跟，而且赢得了奖励。

original: Tell Delvin that he can count on me to provide the influence around here with the right people when he needs it.
traduit: 告诉戴尔文，我会帮他在他需要的时候安排合适的人来影响这里。

original: If you're ever looking to sell any illegally obtained merchandise, I'd also provide my services as a fence. It's the least I can do.
traduit: 如果你需要销赃的话，我也可以提供服务充当中间人。我会尽我所能。

original: No time to lose then.
traduit: 那就别浪费时间了。

original: Yes, indeed. The only thing I can tell you is that the mold was taken to the bandit's hideout... a small cottage called Pinewatch.
traduit: 对，没错。我唯一能告诉你的是模具被带到了强盗的据点……叫松木监视哨。

original: I'm not sure how many men they have inside, but I trust that won't be an issue for you. Good luck.
traduit: 我不知道里面有多少人，但我相信对你来说不是问题。祝你好运。

original: Send a thief to steal back what was stolen.
traduit: 派个贼去把东西偷回来。

original: Look, this mold is irreplaceable. I'll pay you well for its return and I can also prove to be quite a valuable ally to the Thieves Guild.
traduit: 这个模具不可替代。我会付给你很多钱，而且我也可以作为你们盗贼公会很有价值的盟友。

original: Why do you need the Guild's help for that?
traduit: 你为什么要找公会帮忙？

original: Look, I talked to the Jarl, the Steward, the Housecarl... everyone. They all told me their resources were spread too thin right now.
traduit: 听着，我找过领主、总管、侍卫……每个人都找过了。他们告诉我，他们的资源太过分散了。

original: Word on the street says that the Thieves Guild is coming back into its own in Markarth so I figured...
traduit: 有消息说盗贼公会即将回归马卡斯，所以我想……

original: Just start from the beginning.
traduit: 从头说说吧。

original: Several months ago I ordered a special silver mold from some artisans in Valenwood by way of a Khajiit Caravan.
traduit: 几个月前，我通过卡吉特商队从威伦森林的工匠那里订购了一个特殊的铸银模具。

original: Well, it never arrived. Later I found out that it was robbed by a group of bandits led by someone named Rigel Strong-Arm.
traduit: 嗯，到现在也没有送到。后来我发现一伙强盗把它劫走了，领头的叫“壮臂”利赫尔。

original: Delvin Mallory sent me.
traduit: 戴尔文·马洛里派我来的。

original: Oh thank goodness! I wasn't sure where else to turn...
traduit: 哦，谢天谢地！我都不知该向哪里求助了……

original: Remember now? (<BribeCost> gold)
traduit: 现在想起来了？（<BribeCost>金币）

original: Well, can't say exactly where the mold is, but something does spring to mind.
traduit: 虽然不确定模具的具体位置，但我想起来了些什么。

original: It seems there's this strange button on the wall opposite the fireplace in my house. Always wondered what it was for.
traduit: 我家的壁炉对面的墙上有个奇怪的按钮。我一直想知道那是干什么用的。

original: Think I'm going to head out now. Take a long vacation from woodcutting, you know? Good luck.
traduit: 我想我该走了。休个长假，不再干伐木这行了。祝你好运。

original: Come on, what are trying to do? Insult me?
traduit: 得了吧，你想干什么？侮辱我吗？

original: I see. I must have the wrong place.
traduit: 我知道了。看来我找错地方了。

original: No harm done. Tell this Endon fellow I hope he finds what he's looking for.
traduit: 平安无事。告诉恩东，希望他能找回他想要的东西。

original: Tell me where it is, or else.
traduit: 告诉我在哪儿，否则……

original: So that's how it's going to be, huh? Fine. Take your best shot!
traduit: 这就是你想要的结果？很好，有能耐就来吧！

original: I never said it was a silver mold.
traduit: 我可没说什么铸银模具。

original: Well uh, Endon is a silversmith in Markarth, so I just assumed...
traduit: 呃，啊，恩东是马卡斯的银匠嘛，我就以为……

original: I'm looking for Endon's mold.
traduit: 我在找恩东的模具。

original: I thought I was clear when I said I didn't know.
traduit: 我说得很清楚了我不知道。

original: Let's try again. Where is the silver mold?
traduit: 咱们再来一次。铸银模具在哪？

original: Endon's mold? I'm afraid you have the wrong place, my friend. You'll find no silversmiths here.
traduit: 恩东的模具？恐怕你找错地方了，朋友。这里没有银匠。

original: I assure you, I have nothing of value. I'm nothing but a poor woodcutter just trying to make ends meet.
traduit: 我可以向你保证，我没有什么值钱的东西。我只是个勉强度日的可怜樵夫。

original: It would be an honor.
traduit: 这是我的荣幸。

original: On your way, then.
traduit: 那就去吧。

original: Who are you? Where are you from?
traduit: 你是谁？从哪儿来？

original: You don't remember me, Hjalti? Two campaigns we served together. You saved my life time and time again.
traduit: 你不记得我了吗，亚尔提？我们并肩作战了两场大战。你救了我一次又一次，

original: An old sword? That's a fool's errand.
traduit: 一把古剑吗？估计是找不着了。

original: I cannot go into battle without a sword, Hjalti.
traduit: 我不能不带着剑上战场，亚尔提。

original: I'll find your sword.
traduit: 我会找到你的剑。

original: I long to taste battle again.
traduit: 我渴望再次体验战斗的滋味。

original: Then you leave me no choice!
traduit: 那你让我别无选择！

original: Enough of your lies!
traduit: 别再说谎了！

original: I can't allow you to destroy the Skull, Priest of Mara.
traduit: 我绝不能让你毁了头骨，玛拉祭司。

original: No. I... I was scared. I wasn't ready to sleep.
traduit: 不。我……我是很害怕。我没做好入睡的准备。

original: You're a traitor. You left us to die and then ran before the Miasma took you.
traduit: 叛徒。你丢下我们等死，然后在吸入毒气前自己逃跑。

original: I no longer use that name. I'm Erandur, Priest of Mara.
traduit: 我不再用那个名字了。我是玛拉祭司，依兰杜尔。

original: No thanks to you, Casimir.
traduit: 可不是你的功劳，凯西米尔。

original: Veren... Thorek... you're alive!
traduit: 维仁……图雷克……你们还活着！

original: It's time. The Skull must be destroyed.
traduit: 是时候了。必须摧毁头骨。

original: If you'll stand back, I'll perform the ritual granted to me by Lady Mara.
traduit: 请退后。我要执行玛拉女士授予我的仪式。

original: Maybe they were right. Don't destroy the staff.
traduit: 也许他们是对的。不要破坏这个法杖。

original: No! You mustn't listen to them. They speak only lies and deception.
traduit: 不！别听他们的。他们只是在骗人。

original: Had we aided them in releasing the Skull, they would use it to wreak havoc across Skyrim. They... they had to die.
traduit: 如果我们助他们释放头骨，他们会在天际大肆破坏。他们……他们必须死。

original: They were trying to kill us.
traduit: 他们想杀了我们。

original: And had they succeeded, Dawnstar's fate would be sealed. You have a unique way of looking at things, my friend.
traduit: 如果他们成功了，晨星也就在劫难逃了。你看待事物的方式很独特，朋友。

original: We had no choice.
traduit: 我们别无选择。

original: Yes. You're right. If they needed to die so that Dawnstar could live, then it was worth the price.
traduit: 没错，你说得对。为了晨星的存续，他们必须死。这个代价是值得的。

original: To feed my power when I come for you in Sovngarde!
traduit: 在松加德等着成为我的能量吧！

original: Nivahriin joorre! What have you done? What twisted Words have you created?! Tahrodiis Paarthurnax! My teeth to his neck!
traduit: 尼瓦瑞因 约尔瑞！你们做了什么？你们创造了何等扭曲的词语？塔洛迪斯 帕图纳克斯！我要咬穿他的脖子！

original: What does a housecarl do?
traduit: 侍卫的职责是什么？

original: As my Thane, I'm sworn to your service. I'll guard you, and all you own, with my life.
traduit: 您是我的武卫，我宣誓向您效忠。我会用我的生命保护您和您的一切。

original: The others do not speak. Their Voices are too powerful for you to withstand.
traduit: 其他人不说话，因为他们的吼声太强，你经受不住。

original: dunYngvildWizardAttack
traduit: dunYngvildWizardAttack

original: What? An intruder? Attack, my lovelies!
traduit: 什么？入侵者？进攻吧，我的小可爱们！

original: Ah, another plaything for my collection.
traduit: 啊，又一个值得我收藏的玩物。

original: What's happening? No! Leave me alone!
traduit: 发生什么了？不！别丢下我！

original: dunYngvildWizardNormaltoCombat
traduit: dunYngvildWizardNormaltoCombat

original: Lure it into the trap! I'm counting on you!
traduit: 把它引到陷阱来！全靠你了！

original: Do whatever you're going to do before it kills us all!
traduit: 趁它还没把咱们都杀了，快动手！

original: My men are ready. Now it's up to you.
traduit: 我的人都准备好了。就看你的了。

original: Come, my men stand ready on the great porch.
traduit: 来吧，我的人都在大门廊等着呢。

original: Let's do this. Summon this dragon of yours.
traduit: 开始吧。把龙召唤来。

original: Get it into the trap before it kills us all!
traduit: 趁它没把咱们都杀了，快把它引进陷阱！

original: This was your crazy idea, huh?
traduit: 这就是你疯狂的主意吧？

original: You better know what you're doing.
traduit: 你最好知道自己在干嘛。

original: I don't know how you talked the Jarl into this.
traduit: 真不知道你是怎么说服领主的。

original: This is getting ridiculous. If we can't get this open soon, the boss will have our heads.
traduit: 太扯了。如果我们不尽快把门打开，老大会宰了我们。

original: Take cover!
traduit: 隐蔽！

original: Get back! Get back! We need to trap it, not kill it!
traduit: 回来！回来！我们要抓它，不是杀了它！

original: Fine. I'll set you free if you promise to take me to Skuldafn.
traduit: 好。如果你答应带我去斯库达芬，我就放了你。

original: I've planted the contraband on the Dainty Sload.
traduit: 我把违禁品放在优雅斯洛德号上了。

original: Yes, I know. In fact, by now, Captain Volf should be on his way to the prisons.
traduit: 是，我知道。其实现在，沃夫船长已经在去监狱的路上了。

original: Our contract is complete. Here's a token of my gratitude for your efforts.
traduit: 我们的契约完成。这是我一点心意，感谢你的努力。

original: Oh, convey my compliments to Delvin for me. Tell him I'll be happy to reopen whatever doors he needs in Solitude.
traduit: 哦，替我向戴尔文问好。告诉他我很乐意为他重新打开独孤城的门。

original: Captain Volf is ashore right now and I want the authorities waiting for him when he gets back.
traduit: 沃夫船长现在在岸上，我要让执法的等他回去。

original: Now get going... I don't want to see your face until the job's done.
traduit: 现在就去……在任务完成前，我不想见你。

original: What sort of contraband?
traduit: 什么违禁品？

original: You'll need to get your hands on some Balmora Blue from Sabine Nyette down by the docks. She's the first mate on another ship, the Red Wave.
traduit: 你得从码头的撒比尼·尼耶蒂那弄些巴尔莫拉蓝调。她是赤红波浪号的大副。

original: Once you get your hands on it, I want you to plant it in Captain Volf's footlocker. I'll take care of the rest.
traduit: 拿到之后，把它放在沃夫船长的箱子里。剩下的就交给我。

original: I assume this is where I enter the picture.
traduit: 我想这就是我的切入点了。

original: I need you to help me show him the error of his ways by sneaking on board the Sload and planting some contraband.
traduit: 我需要你给他一个教训，让他明白自己犯了什么错误。偷偷溜进斯洛德号，把违禁品放进去。

original: Nothing raises my ire more than having an agreement broken. It's bad for business and it wastes time.
traduit: 没有什么比协议被撕毁更让我气愤的。这对生意很不利，而且浪费时间。

original: Captain Volf of the Dainty Sload has decided to test my patience on this matter by neglecting to honor a trade agreement we had established.
traduit: 优雅斯洛德号的沃夫船长打算考验我在这上面的耐心，无视了我们达成的贸易协议。

original: Let's just get to work.
traduit: 我们开始工作吧。

original: That's more like it.
traduit: 这才像样。

original: That's why he sent me.
traduit: 所以他让我来了。

original: Hmph. That remains to be seen.
traduit: 嗯。这还有待观察。

original: Delvin Mallory said you have work for me.
traduit: 戴尔文·马洛里说你有工作给我。

original: It's about time you got here.
traduit: 你也该来了。

original: I'm not accustomed to dealing with people who are unreliable. That's why I asked Delvin to send me his best.
traduit: 我不习惯和不可靠的人打交道。所以我让戴尔文把他那最好的人派来。

original: Everything's been done. Arn should be safe.
traduit: 一切搞定。阿恩安全了。

original: Arn? Never heard of him.
traduit: 阿恩？从没听说过。

original: I guess that means you're finished. Here's your payment.
traduit: 我猜这证明你完成了工作。这是你的报酬。

original: Tell Delvin that he has my support and all the weight it carries in Whiterun from now on. I think he'll be quite pleased.
traduit: 告诉戴尔文，从现在起我会全力支持他和他在白漫城的影响。我猜他会很高兴的。

original: Any information on the prison registry?
traduit: 监狱的登记有什么情报吗？

original: It's a well-known fact that the steward keeps all of the records on Whiterun's prisoners in a large book.
traduit: 众所周知，总管把全白漫囚犯的记录都写在一本大册子里。

original: My sources tell me you can find that book in a study in his quarters.
traduit: 我的线人告诉我，册子就放在他住处的书房里。

original: Change Arn's entry in the book to anything you want and they'll be forced to let him go after he serves a few weeks.
traduit: 把阿恩的记录改成任何东西都行，他们关他几周就得放他。

original: Where's the letter being kept?
traduit: 这封信放在哪儿？

original: I have eyes within Dragonsreach. They tell me that all correspondence from other holds are sent to the Jarl's private chambers.
traduit: 我在龙临宫里安插了眼线。他们告诉我，其他领地的信件都会送到领主的私人房间里。

original: Sounds easy.
traduit: 听起来很容易。

original: If it was easy, I would have hired a local thug instead of a professional.
traduit: 如果容易的话，我就直接雇个混混了，谁还会找你们这群专业的。

original: You see both of these items are kept inside Dragonsreach, and they don't allow visitors inside the Jarl's or the Steward's chambers.
traduit: 你要知道，这两件东西都在龙临宫里，他们不允许访客进入领主或者管家的房间。

original: One more thing. If you get caught, I can't afford to be connected to you. Remember that before you do anything stupid.
