original: Brynjolf said I should speak to you.
traduit: 布林乔夫说我该和你谈谈。

original: Before we begin, I want to make two things perfectly clear.
traduit: 在我们开始前，我要明确两件事。

original: One, I'm the best infiltrator this rathole of a Guild's got, so if you think you're here to replace me, you're dead wrong.
traduit: 第一，我是公会里最好的潜行者，如果你觉得自己能取代我，那就大错特错了。

original: And two, you follow my lead and do exactly as I say... no questions, no excuses.
traduit: 第二，听我指挥，按我说的做……没有疑问，没有借口。

original: Oh, master. It's your time to do with as you please, but what about those who depend on you so much?
traduit: 哦，主人。您可以随心所欲使用时间，但依靠您的人该怎么办啊？

original: Tendrils of thought may wind their way through this realm, but those tendrils bind our reality together.
traduit: 思想的卷须会穿过这个位面，但这些卷须会将我们的现实绑在一起。

original: A method to your madness and your madness is the method and the melody...
traduit: 方法就是您的疯狂，您的方法与旋律就是疯狂。

original: I found the bone! I've brought it to you but still I am refused...
traduit: 我找到了那块骨头！我把它给您带来了，但我却被拒绝了……

original: Can you train me in Alchemy?
traduit: 你能教我炼金术吗？

original: No, no. Mostly, I'm just a simple herbalist. Lami over in Morthal should be able to help you.
traduit: 不，不。我只是个普通的草药师。莫萨尔的拉米应该能帮你。

original: No, no. I'm just a simple herbalist. You'll want to see Arcadia, over in Whiterun.
traduit: 不，不。我只是个普通的草药师。白漫城的阿尔凯迪雅应该能帮你。

original: Nasty bit of business, Roggvir's execution.
traduit: 罗吉维尔被处决那事，看着太糟心了。

original: Perhaps, but necessary. As you know my cousin, Fura, died out there fighting for us. She wouldn't have had to, if it weren't for Roggvir.
traduit: 也许吧，但该办还得办。你要知道，我的表妹芙拉为了我们战死了。要不是罗吉维尔，她也就不会死。

original: Perhaps, but necessary. My cousin, Fura, is somewhere out there in Skyrim right now, fighting Ulfric Stormcloak and his damned insurrectionists.
traduit: 也许吧，但该办还得办。我的表妹，芙拉，现在就在天际的某个地方与乌弗瑞克·风暴斗篷还有他该死的叛乱分子战斗着。

original: She wouldn't have to be there at all, if it weren't for Roggvir.
traduit: 如果不是因为罗吉维尔，她根本不需要去。

original: How goes the training?
traduit: 训练进行得如何？

original: Their aim could be steadier, but they're battle ready.
traduit: 他们可以瞄得再稳定些，但已经做好战斗准备了。

original: How long have you tended the Hall of the Dead?
traduit: 你看管亡者之厅多久了？

original: All my life. I practically grew up in the Hall. My father and mother were the priest and priestess of Arkay before me, you see.
traduit: 一辈子了。我几乎就是在这个大厅里长大的。我父母就是我前任的阿尔凯祭司。

original: I believe I was put here to protect this place from the darkness that pervades Solitude.
traduit: 我相信，我被关在这里就是为了保护这地方免受弥漫在独孤城的黑暗所袭扰。

original: Elisif seems to rely on you a great deal.
traduit: 艾利西弗似乎很依仗你。

original: She still mourns greatly for her husband, High King Torygg. So she leaves many of the courtly details to me.
traduit: 她还在为她的丈夫，至高王托依格哀悼。所以很多宫廷细务都交给我了。

original: You were the one who executed that man...
traduit: 是你处决了那个人……

original: Aye. I'm the headsman here in Solitude. It's my job.
traduit: 没错。我是独孤城的刽子手。这就是我的工作。

original: You play well.
traduit: 你演奏得很好。

original: Thank you. I'm still at the beginning of my lessons but Inge... Dean Six Fingers... says I'm quite good with the flute.
traduit: 谢谢你！我才刚刚开始我的课程，但“六指”因格院长……她说我很会吹奏笛子。

original: Thank you. I'm still at the beginning of my lessons. Dean Six Fingers used to say I was quite good with the flute.
traduit: 谢谢你！我才刚刚开始我的课程，但“六指”因格院长以前常说我很会吹奏笛子。

original: You seem proud to be a bard.
traduit: 你似乎很以身为吟游诗人为豪啊。

original: And why wouldn't I be? We sing tales of kings, queens and their politics, 'tis true. But do you know who really makes history?
traduit: 为什么不呢？我们歌唱国王女王，还有他们的政治故事，这些都是真的。但你知道是谁真正创造了历史吗？

original: The person who writes it.
traduit: 是书写它的人。

original: But you're talking right now.
traduit: 但你现在不是说话了吗。

original: I shouldn't be. Mama says if I do, people are going to ask about uncle Roggvir.
traduit: 我不应该说的。妈妈说如果我说话，人们就会问起罗吉维尔舅舅。

original: Maybe if I don't talk, they won't either.
traduit: 也许如果不说，他们也会问的。

original: I shouldn't be. Everyone wants to ask me about mama and uncle Roggvir.
traduit: 我不应该说的。每个人都想问我妈妈和罗吉维尔舅舅的事。

original: Were you really in the army?
traduit: 你真的参过军吗？

original: What? You see a man fallen on hard times, and you think he's been like that forever?
traduit: 什么？你看到有人处在困境，他就是从始至终一直这样吗？

original: I was there. I fought in the Great War. I was on the field at Anvil. And when I was struck down, they left me.
traduit: 我参加过浩大战争。就在安维尔的战场上。当我倒下时，他们把我丢下了。

original: You understand? They left me for dead. I didn't leave them.
traduit: 你明白吗？是他们丢下我等死。不是我离开了他们。

original: You're a long way from home, then.
traduit: 那你离家乡很远了啊。

original: Aye, but I'll be here in Solitude for longer still. Fihada's skill as a fletcher drew me to this place. I wanted to learn.
traduit: 是啊，但我还要在独孤城多待些日子。费哈达的造箭技巧吸引我来此。我很想学习。

original: And there is still much of Skyrim I wish to see. I hear there is a city, Wind-Helm, that is nearly white with... What do you call it? Ah yes! Snow.
traduit: 而且我还希望再多见识一下天际。我听说有个叫风舵的城市，那里几乎被东西盖成白色的了……你们管它叫什么来着？哦对！雪。

original: And far to the west lies a ruin. Volskygge. Inside, there is said to be a wall, black as night. And it speaks! In the ancient Dragon tongue!
traduit: 西边远处有一座废墟，叫沃尔斯盖吉。据说里面有一堵墙，漆黑如夜，而且还会说话！用古老的龙语！

original: There are wonders in this place I never dreamed imaginable.
traduit: 这地方有我做梦也想不到的奇迹。

original: So what's your job here, Melaran?
traduit: 梅拉然，你在这的工作是什么？

original: I make sure Erikur keeps breathing.
traduit: 确保艾瑞库尔还能喘气儿。

original: I provide my wisdom and insight to the court.
traduit: 我为宫廷提供自己的智慧和洞察力。

original: It does indeed. You know, I hear you had something to do with Sybille Stentor's demise...
traduit: 确实。我听说你和希比利·斯丹特的死有关……

original: That must have been a hard bit of business. I hear Stentor had been alive for a long, long time.
traduit: 那一定是笔不小的生意吧。我听说斯丹特已经活了很久很久了。

original: A place in court seems to suit you.
traduit: 宫廷这个位置似乎很适合你。

original: So Erikur is your brother?
traduit: 所以艾瑞库尔是你兄弟？

original: Yes. My older brother and the person you probably want to be speaking to right now.
traduit: 是。你或许以为我哥哥现在是独孤城的话事人了。

original: But really, since Torygg's death, Falk Firebeard wields the true power of the Jarl's court. My brother is nothing more than a pompous little fop.
traduit: 但事实上，自从托依格死后，“火胡”佛可就掌握了领主宫廷的实权。我哥哥不过是个爱炫耀的小花花公子罢了。

original: Yes. My older brother. He was a bit of a fop, really.
traduit: 没错。我哥哥。他确实有点花花公子派头。

original: And truth be told, since Torygg's death, he had no real power in court. But still... He didn't deserve to die.
traduit: 说实话，自从托依格死后，他在宫廷里就没什么实权。但……他不该死。

original: So Erikur was your brother?
traduit: 所以艾瑞库尔是你兄弟？

original: What's your place in the court?
traduit: 你在宫廷里是做什么的？

original: I'm a Thane. In the future, you may want to gain that information before talking with someone. Risk of looking like an idiot, and all that.
traduit: 我是武卫。以后跟人说话前，你最好先把对方的身份搞搞清楚，免得看起来像个傻子。

original: Yes. I think your brother was a traitor.
traduit: 没错。我觉得你兄弟是个叛徒。

original: Then you didn't know Roggvir, and you have no idea what it means to be a Nord of Skyrim!
traduit: 那你就是不了解罗吉维尔，你不知道身为天际的诺德人意味着什么！

original: He did the honorable thing, even when he knew it would cost him everything.
traduit: 他做的事很光荣，即使他知道这会让他付出一切。

original: My brother was the best man in Solitude.
traduit: 我的兄弟是独孤城最好的男人。

original: You were at the execution, right?
traduit: 你也在处刑现场吧？

original: I showed up to watch, yeah.
traduit: 我是去看了。

original: I don't know if they were right to execute him for what he did, but I'll tell you something...
traduit: 我不知道他们因为他的所作所为就处死他是否正确，但我告诉你……

original: It couldn't have happened to a nicer guy.
traduit: 这种事可不会发生在好人身上。

original: Fruit, fresh off the boat! The freshest in Skyrim!
traduit: 水果，刚卸下船的水果！全天际最新鲜的嘞！

original: Get your fresh fruit and produce here!
traduit: 想要新鲜蔬果来这边了！

original: Apples, tomatoes, leeks and cabbages! Fresh and ripe!
traduit: 苹果、番茄、韭葱、卷心菜！新鲜保熟！

original: Fresh fish! Fresh fish!
traduit: 鲜鱼！卖鲜鱼！

original: Fresh Fish! Straight from the Fjords!
traduit: 新鲜的鱼！刚从海里打上来的！

original: The finest fish, here! Caught daily!
traduit: 这儿有新鲜的鱼！每天供应！

original: Spiced Wine to warm the blood!
traduit: 来瓶香料酒暖暖身子了！

original: Keep the cold at bay with our spiced wine!
traduit: 喝我们的香料酒抗冻保暖！

original: Spiced wine, the taste of home and hearth!
traduit: 香料酒，让你尝到家和炉边的味道！

original: Come on, now! I want those arrows dead center! The lives of your fellow soldiers are counting on it.
traduit: 来吧，快！给我往靶心上射！你们战友的性命全靠它了。

original: Concentrate. The battlefield is full of distractions. Ignore them! Focus on your targets.
traduit: 集中精神。战场上有很多让人分心的东西。别管它们！专注目标。

original: Some day soon, you will all see battle. And what you do here, today, may well save your lives!
traduit: 再过不久，你们都得上战场。你们今天在这里所做的一切，也许就能救你一命！

original: You won't get anything out of me, you filthy sons o' horkers.
traduit: 你休想从我这儿得到任何东西，你们这群婊子养的烂货。

original: I stand with the Stormcloaks. You Imperial dogs will never break my will. Never!
traduit: 我就是支持风暴斗篷。你们这些帝国狗别想摧毁我的意志。永远别想！

original: I've got weapons for givin', and armor for gettin'!
traduit: 我这里有武器和护甲可以卖给你！

original: Arms and armor! Forged by a master craftsman!
traduit: 武器防具！大师打造！

original: A coin or two for a veteran? It's not much to ask...
traduit: 给老兵一两个硬币吧？这要求不算过分……

original: You know you can afford a septim or two.
traduit: 你能拿出一两个塞普汀的。

original: Let us walk in the steps of the Divines.
traduit: 愿我们追随圣灵的脚步。

original: Remind us of our place, when we forget.
traduit: 当我们忘记自己的位置时，一定要提醒我们。

original: May knowledge of your Divinity carry us through our daily trials.
traduit: 愿您神性的认知带领我们走过日常的试炼。

original: Did you see a hound on the road? A fine, strong creature that's been wandering near town.
traduit: 你在路上看到一只猎犬吗？一个善良强壮的家伙，它时常在镇子附近游荡。

original: Sounds like she has it in for you.
traduit: 听起来她和你过不去啊。

original: I guess that's as good a reason as any.
traduit: 我觉得这是个好理由。

original: I thought so.
traduit: 我也这么想。

original: You kept a skeever as a pet?
traduit: 你养了只恶鼠当宠物？

original: They were smaller back then.
traduit: 那时候它们还要小一点。

original: Do you make anything here that will kill dragons?
traduit: 你这有能屠龙的东西吗？

original: Ha! I like you.
traduit: 哈！我喜欢你这样的。

original: No man is a match for a dragon.
traduit: 没人能够与龙匹敌。

original: Buying one of our blades wouldn't hurt your chances, though.
traduit: 不过买我们的武器不会影响你的机会。

original: I didn't make that much noise.
traduit: 我没有弄出那么大噪音。

original: Please. You're in the presence of a born huntsman. I can hear the sweat sliding down your forehead.
traduit: 拜托。你面前可是个天生的猎人。我能听到汗水从你额头上流下来。

original: How long have you been the court wizard?
traduit: 你当宫廷巫师多久了？

original: I was a member of the court during the reign of Torygg's father. It was Torygg who appointed me to the position.
traduit: 托依格的父亲在位时我就是宫廷的一员。是托依格任命我担任了这个职务。

original: Are you the High Queen of Skyrim?
traduit: 你是天际的至高女王吗？

original: No. Although it's true my husband Torygg was the High King and I am his widow, I am in no position to claim such a title.
traduit: 不。虽然我丈夫托依格确实是至高王，而我则是他的遗孀，但我没有资格宣称这个头衔。

original: Ulfric Stormcloak is victorious, and the Jarls have fallen in line.
traduit: 乌弗瑞克·风暴斗篷取得了胜利，领主们已经倒向他的一边。

original: It seems I will never take my rightful place as High Queen.
traduit: 看来我永远无法获得至高女王应有的地位了。

original: So, do you still claim to be the High Queen of Skyrim?
traduit: 那么你还会宣称自己是天际的至高女王吗？

original: Not yet, no. Although it is true my husband Torygg was the High King, and I am his widow... now is not the time to lay claim to such a title.
traduit: 还不是呢。虽然我丈夫托依格确实是至高王，而我是他的遗孀……但现在还不是宣称自己拥有这一头衔的时候。

original: This land is riven by war, and her people suffer for it. The Stormcloaks are a blight on Skyrim, and like any blight... must be purged.
traduit: 这片土地被战争撕裂，人民为此受苦。风暴斗篷就是天际的枯萎病，就该像其他病症一样……必须被清除。

original: Only then will I take my rightful place as High Queen.
traduit: 只有到那时，我才能获得作为至高女王应有的地位。

original: Don't you have trouble getting ripe goods here?
traduit: 在这里买到成熟的货物不会有困难吗？

original: I have my ways, but it's not easy these days.
traduit: 我有自己的办法，但这段时间确实不容易。

original: The Blackblood Marauders have been plundering ships off the coast. A lot of people been hurt by their foolishness.
traduit: 黑血掠夺者一直在沿海抢掠船只。很多人被他们的愚蠢伤害到了。

original: It's been easier lately.
traduit: 最近好多了。

original: The Blackblood Marauders haven't been seen since the Icerunner attack, so my shipments have been more regular.
traduit: 自从冰驰者号被袭击之后，就没人见过黑血掠夺者了，所以我的货运还比较正常。

original: How are your sales?
traduit: 你的销量怎么样？

original: They're... adequate. Honestly, I rely on the business brought in by the Burning of King Olaf, and that's not likely to happen this year.
traduit: 已经……足够了。老实说，我很依赖火烧奥拉夫节带来的生意，但今年不太可能举办了。

original: Oh, very brisk. When the snow sets in, even the hardiest Nord needs some spiced wine to warm the blood.
traduit: 哦，非常好。下雪时，即使是最顽强的诺德人，也需要来点香料酒暖和暖和。

original: Has the war affected your college much?
traduit: 战争对你们学院影响大么？

original: Not much. But as a bard, I find the whole affair depressing.
traduit: 不太大。但身为吟游诗人，我觉得这件事令人很沮丧。

original: There are no heroes in this war. No winners to be had and no real conclusion.
traduit: 这场战争没有英雄，没有赢家，也没有真正的定论。

original: There are no heroes in this war. Even with Ulfric here in Solitude, there are no winners to be had. No real conclusion.
traduit: 这场战争没有英雄。即使乌弗瑞克占领了独孤城，也没有赢家可言，没有真正的定论。

original: Where do you catch the fish?
traduit: 你从哪里打渔？

original: Down at the docks. There are a few good spots, if you can avoid the East Empire Company workers and those Red Wave thugs.
traduit: 码头那边。如果能避开东帝国公司的工人和赤红波浪的暴徒，那里有几个好地方。

original: Why is this place called the Winking Skeever?
traduit: 这里为什么叫眨眼恶鼠？

original: Well, as it turns out, I had a pet skeever when I was a boy and he used to wink.
traduit: 我小时候养过一只宠物恶鼠，他经常眨眼睛。

original: Do you get a lot of business like that?
traduit: 你们经常有这样的生意吗？

original: I suppose I would, but you're the only one who gets that greeting.
traduit: 确实有，但你是唯一一个听到这样问候的。

original: It's never been an issue. People say you helped with the problems at Wolfskull Cave.
traduit: 这从来不是问题。人们说你解决了狼头骨洞穴的问题。

original: I applaud anyone who assists the court.
traduit: 我为帮助宫廷的人喝彩。

original: Oh, we do all right. Rumor is, you had a hand in the Blackblood Marauders' demise...
traduit: 哦，我们做得很好。有传言说，你和黑血掠夺者的灭亡有关……

original: I'm impressed.
traduit: 真不错。

original: Radiant Raiment has the finest attire in all of Skyrim. That is how we...
traduit: 锦衣服饰店有天际最好的服装。这就是我们为何……

original: Wait. You're that new bard, the one who saved the Festival. Aren't you?
traduit: 哦等等。你是那个新晋的吟游诗人吧，拯救了那个节日，对吧？

original: That was a good bit of work.
traduit: 干得漂亮。

original: Radiant Raiment has the finest attire in all of Skyrim. That is how we get business.
traduit: 锦衣服饰店有天际最好的服装。这就是我们拿到生意的办法。

original: What's wrong with my outfit?
traduit: 我的着装有什么不妥吗？

original: Nothing at all. It's very... nice. If you want something with a little more style, however, you should see what we have available.
traduit: 并没有。已经很……好了。不过，如果你想要更独具风格，应该看看我们的货品。

original: Nothing at all. It's very... nice. If you want something with a little more style, however, you should come by our shop. Radiant Raiment.
traduit: 并没有。已经很……好了。不过你如果想要更独具风格，可以到我们的锦衣服饰店看看。

original: We could fix you right up.
traduit: 我们马上能帮你整理好。

original: I do. So few people possess the taste and sophistication of a proper wardrobe these days.
traduit: 确实。如今很少有人能具有合适的着装品味和礼仪。

original: Be sure and investigate Radiant Raiment's fine selection of clothing. We have many items you'll fancy, I'm sure.
traduit: 一定要来看看我们锦衣服饰店精挑细选的衣服。你一定会喜欢我们的商品。

original: So you like my outfit?
traduit: 你喜欢我的着装吗？

original: You're pretty dedicated to the Empire, then?
traduit: 你对帝国很忠诚吗？

original: Ah... To be honest, no. But High King Torygg supported them, and now her lady Elisif has thrown in with them.
traduit: 啊……说实话，没有。但至高王托依格支持他们，现在他的夫人艾利西弗也加入了他们。

original: You could say I'm a King's man at heart. Hmph. I guess that's "Jarl's man" now.
traduit: 你可以这么说，我实际上是至高王的子民。嗯，我猜现在应该说是“领主的子民”了。

original: My loyalty lies with Solitude. So where Jarl Elisif leads, I follow.
traduit: 我忠于独孤，所以艾利西弗领主说去哪儿，我就会跟到哪儿。

original: Who is Beirand?
traduit: 贝尔兰德是谁？

original: Beirand's my husband. He works the forge up at Castle Dour. I barely see him nowadays, what with him filling orders for the army.
traduit: 贝尔兰德是我丈夫。他在阴郁堡的铁匠铺工作。他现在忙着完成军队的订单，所以我也很少见他。

original: My husband. He was the blacksmith up at Castle Dour.
traduit: 我的丈夫。他以前是阴郁堡的铁匠。

original: Who was Beirand?
traduit: 贝尔兰德是谁？

original: The Bards College? What's that?
traduit: 吟游诗人学院是什么？

original: It's a school that teaches music, poetry, that sort of thing. Most bards in Skyrim have been to the college at some point.
traduit: 教授音乐和诗歌的学校。天际大多数吟游诗人都曾经去学院进修过。

original: If you're thinking of applying, talk to Viarmo in Solitude.
traduit: 如果你想申请入学，去独孤城和维阿墨谈谈吧。

original: A skald? Is that some kind of bard?
traduit: 吟唱者？是某种吟游诗人吗？

original: That's about the truth of it. Write tales about the sights I've seen. The battles I've fought.
traduit: 没错。写下我曾经看过的风景，经历的战斗。

original: Earned quite a name for myself when I was younger. The Bards College still teaches some of my work to their students.
traduit: 我年轻时就已经扬名立万了。吟游诗人学院至今还在拿我的作品教授学生。

original: It is done. The defiler is defeated. Take Dawnbreaker from its pedestal.
traduit: 事已了结。亵渎者已死。将破晓者从基座上取下来。

original: ...retire some day... get myself an island...
traduit: ……等哪天退休了……我就给自己找个岛……

original: ...never enough gold... just need one good haul...
traduit: ……钱不够……还得干一票……

original: ...might pay off my bounty this time... walk into the city a free man...
traduit: ……也许这次就能帮我付清赏金……光明正大进城了……

original: ..told him to just hand over the gold, but did he listen? Oh, no... they always have to fight back...
traduit: ……告诉他了把钱交出来，但他听了吗？不不……他们总是想反抗……

original: ...I'll never do another span in that stinking jail... rather die than give myself up...
traduit: ……我再也不要回那该死的监狱了……死也不回去……

original: ...he he he... two threes? What was he thinking? Fool never saw me pull that ace out of my boot...
traduit: ……呵呵呵……一个一个的？都在想什么？傻子根本看不见我从靴子里把刀掏出来……

original: ...need me some skooma... the imported stuff... just one last time...
traduit: ……得找点斯库玛……进口的好东西……就再来一次……

original: ...gonna start keepin' a knife in my boot... tired of gettin' disarmed...
traduit: ……得在靴子里藏把刀了……被卸了家伙真麻烦……

original: ...should have known she was lying... said she'd wait for me... but they never wait...
traduit: ……我早该知道她在撒谎……她说她会等我……但从来没等过……

original: ...lyin' little harlot... that brat ain't mine... could be anyone's... won't get one rusty septim from me...
traduit: ……骗人的臭婊子……那小子根本不是我的种……别想再从我这儿得到一分钱……

original: ..."go to the college" da said... "use your smarts" he said... like I'm supposed to figure out which college he meant...
traduit: ……我爹还说什么“去学院吧”……“用用脑子”……说得好像我能弄清楚他说的是什么学院似的……

original: ...hmph, wizards... Now that's power... Bet they got that "secret" magic... can turn wood to gold... yeah... Wish I could turn wood to gold...
traduit: ……哼，巫师……那些力量……他们肯定有“秘密”的魔法……可以点石成金……啊……我也想要啊……

original: ...mead, mead, mead... ...kill 'em to get some beer every now and then? ...stupid bees and their stupid honey...
traduit: ……蜜酒，蜜酒，蜜酒……时不时地杀它们就是为了喝点酒？……愚蠢的蜜蜂和蜂蜜啊……

original: ...picking pockets, now that's the real art... ...no rough stuff, just take it and go... ...hmph, don't sound like much fun, though...
traduit: ……扒窃才是真正的手艺……不粗不鲁，只把东西带走……嗯，听着没什么意思，不过……

original: ...once was a woman, as fair as an evenin', of springtime in old Stros M'Kai...
traduit: ……曾经有个姑娘，美得就像斯卓·米'凯的春夜……

original: ...with three beers down, the Orc did frown, and bid the Elf goodbye... ...for none could know, 'twas not for show, and someone had to die...
traduit: ……三杯酒下肚，兽人皱起眉头，向精灵告别……没人知道，这不是作秀，有人就要死了……

original: ...kill him, he talks to me like that again... ...get him while he's sleeping... ...or poison his meat... ...see how he likes that...
traduit: ……真该杀了他，他又这样跟我说话……趁他睡着做了他……要不然就在肉里下毒……看看他有多喜欢……

original: We meet again, mortal!
traduit: 我们又见面了，凡人！

original: Time to end your foolish charade!
traduit: 是时候解除你愚蠢的伪装了！

original: Gone. The living are right to fear the dead.
traduit: 离开了。生者都会惧怕亡灵。

original: There is no more life here.
traduit: 这里已经没有生灵了。

original: You dare hide from me?
traduit: 你敢躲着我？

original: I still sense your presence, living fool...
traduit: 我还能感觉到你的存在，愚蠢的生者……

original: Such an abrupt end to our game.
traduit: 游戏突然就结束了。

original: Finality.
traduit: 结束了。

original: DCETAlertToNormal
traduit: DCETAlertToNormal

original: Nothing... Nothing...
traduit: 没东西……没东西……

original: The glimmer of life is gone...
traduit: 生命的微光已经消逝……

original: Mortal fool! No one hides from the dead!
traduit: 愚蠢的凡人！没人能躲过死亡！

original: Death comes for you now!
traduit: 死亡正在逼近！

original: Lookee here. Looks like we got ourselves a hero.
traduit: 看看。我们终于盼来英雄了。

original: You picked a bad time to get lost, friend.
traduit: 你迷路得可真不是时候，朋友。

original: Now ain't this a surprise.
traduit: 很惊喜吧。

original: Who dares disturb my rest?
traduit: 谁敢打扰我的休息？

original: All the living shall fear the dead!
traduit: 所有生者都要畏惧亡灵！

original: I sense a presence...
traduit: 我感觉到有什么存在……

original: Hmm? Does someone live among the dead?
traduit: 嗯？有生者混进了亡灵之中？

original: Noo...
I will return...
traduit: 我会回来的……

original: Aggghh...
Uggh...
Unnff...
Ha! You can never truly stop me!
traduit: 哈！你永远阻止不了我！

original: Ugh! Only a fool tries to kill the dead!
traduit: 啊！只有傻子才会妄图杀死亡灵！

original: Agh! Pathetic mortal!
traduit: 啊！可悲的凡人！

original: Never!
traduit: 绝不！

original: Waaagh!
traduit: 哇啊！

original: Naggh!
traduit: 呐啊！

original: Ohh... but I will have your blood...
traduit: 哦……但我想要你的血……

original: My thirst will be sated...
traduit: 我的饥渴即将得到满足……

original: Oh, I can smell your blood...
traduit: 哦，我可以闻到你的血味儿……

original: You'll be so much easier to rob when you're dead...
traduit: 等你死了再抢就更容易了……

original: Tell you what. You start running so I can stab you in the back.
traduit: 告诉你。你就跑吧，我好从后面给你一刀。

original: Can't wait to count out your coin...
traduit: 等不及要数你的金币了……

original: You cannot even conceive of the power I wield...
traduit: 我的力量你无法想象……

original: Fire, frost, or lightning - you will suffer at my hands!
traduit: 火霜雷电，你就等着受苦吧！

original: Don't you see? I am master of the arcane!
traduit: 看见了吧？我就是奥法大师！

original: Come. Come and face the Forsworn...
traduit: 来啊。来直面弃誓者吧……

original: First you... then all of the Reach!
traduit: 先拿你开刀……接着就是整个瑞驰！

original: The Forsworn will reclaim what is rightfully ours!
traduit: 弃誓者将夺回属于自己的一切！

original: Soon you will know the cold of death...
traduit: 你很快就能知道死亡的寒冷了……

original: The endless sleep comes for us all...
traduit: 我们所有人都能迎来无尽的睡眠……

original: Eternal slumber awaits...
traduit: 永恒的沉睡正在等待……

original: Foolish human. Your time is at its end!
traduit: 愚蠢的人类。你的末日到了！

original: Time for you humans to learn your place!
traduit: 是时候让你们人类认清自己的位置了！

original: Soon, all Nords will be thralls to the Thalmor!
traduit: 再过不久，所有诺德人都会变成梭默的奴隶！

original: Nord beast! Both your life and lands are now forfeit!
traduit: 诺德野兽！你的生命和土地都会被没收！

original: Behold, the future. Behold, the Thalmor!
traduit: 看呐，未来。看呐，梭默！

original: Ha ha ha ha ha! You wish to defeat me? Impossible.
traduit: 哈哈哈哈哈！你想打败我？不可能的。

original: Don't you see? Elven supremacy is the only truth!
traduit: 你还不懂吗？精灵至高无上才是唯一真理！

original: Death is the only way out of your misery!
traduit: 死亡是你摆脱痛苦的唯一选择！

original: You are but a dog, and I am your master!
traduit: 你就是一条狗，我就是你的主人！

original: This little adventure of yours has cost me a number of test subjects. I need more, and you'll do nicely.
traduit: 你的小小冒险让我损失了许多实验对象。我还需要更多，而你就挺不错。

original: But why?
traduit: 但为什么？

original: I'm just doing what I'm told.
traduit: 我只是按要求行事。

original: Gods, it's cold. They'd better find something good in there to make this worthwhile.
traduit: 神啊，太冷了。他们最好能找到些好东西，不然就太不值了。

original: As long as the College keeps paying, I'll keep digging.
traduit: 只要学院继续付钱，我就继续挖。

original: For thousand-year old ruins, they're not much to look at.
traduit: 这些好几千年的废墟有什么好看的。

original: Can't imagine what the College expects to find in here.
traduit: 真不敢想象学院会在这里发现什么。

original: I've never seen anything like this in Nordic ruins before. Why, just look at all these coffins!
traduit: 我从来没在诺德遗迹里见过这样的东西。哎呀，看看这些棺材！

original: This bears closer inspection. I'd like to stay a while and examine this.
traduit: 还是需要更仔细的观察。我想多待一会儿，好好研究一下。

original: You, however, should press on. See if you can find whatever this vision of yours mentioned. But if it is truly dangerous, be careful.
traduit: 你就继续前进吧。看看能不能找到你看到的幻象提到的东西。但如果真的有危险，一定要小心。

original: Go on ahead. I'll be sure and catch up with you before long.
traduit: 去吧。我会很快赶上你的。

original: I thought it high time I caught up with you.
traduit: 我想是时候追上你了。

original: Hold on, my boy. Hold on!
traduit: 等一下，孩子。等一下！

original: Hold on, my dear. Hold on!
traduit: 等一下，孩子。等一下！

original: What about just going in through the brewery?
traduit: 能否直接进入酿酒房？

original: Sabjorn keeps that locked up tight. If you can get through that way, go right ahead.
traduit: 撒布乔恩把那里锁得很紧。如果你能进得去，就试试吧。

original: The same symbol from Goldenglow was involved.
traduit: 在金色光辉有同样的符号。

original: Then this is beyond coincidence. First Aringoth and now Sabjorn.
traduit: 那就不是巧合了，先是阿林格斯，现在是撒布乔恩。

original: Someone's trying to take us down by driving a wedge between Maven and the Guild.
traduit: 有人想离间玛雯和公会，借此扳倒我们。

original: Farewell, Sabjorn.
traduit: 再见了，撒布乔恩。

original: I said move!
traduit: 我说了，走！

original: Look, I assure you, this is all just a huge misunderstanding!
traduit: 听着，我保证，这是个天大的误会！

original: It will be my pleasure.
traduit: 这是我的荣幸。

original: You... you're in charge here until I can sort this all out.
traduit: 你……在我解决这一切前，就是这里的负责人了。

original: Oh come now, this is mead... not some wine to be sipped and savored.
traduit: 哦得了吧，这是蜜酒，又不是什么需要小口抿着喝的葡萄酒。

original: Sorry, sounds dangerous.
traduit: 抱歉，听起来太危险了。

original: Let me give you a word of advice.
traduit: 给你一句忠告。

original: Think about your choices carefully from now on. You'll go much farther in Riften with me on your side.
traduit: 现在开始要仔细考虑自己的选择。在裂谷城里支持我，才能让你走得更远。

original: Sure, I'll do it.
traduit: 好，我去办。

original: Excellent. Here, this is the key to the warehouse.
traduit: 太好了。给，这是仓库的钥匙。

original: See if you can drop in on this dealer of poison and convince him to close down his operation permanently.
traduit: 看看你能否顺便说服那个毒贩子关闭他的厂子。

original: Good. Here, take the key to the warehouse.
traduit: 好，给，拿着仓库的钥匙。

original: Pay dear old Sarthis a visit and tell him Maven sends her regards, would you?
traduit: 去跟亲爱的老萨迪斯说玛雯向他问好，好吗？

original: I've discovered a skooma dealer in Riften.
traduit: 我在裂谷城里发现了斯库玛毒贩。

original: Yes, I'm afraid we're aware of Sarthis's presence in the warehouse.
traduit: 是，我们已经注意到萨迪斯正藏在仓库里。

original: Unfortunately, we're certain he has informants within the city guard. Every time we've made a move to arrest him, he's escaped.
traduit: 可惜，我们确信他在卫兵内部有线人。每次我们要逮捕他时，他都逃之夭夭了。

original: However, if you'd take care of this discreetly, you might be able to surprise him without warning.
traduit: 不过，你要是能悄悄地动手，说不定能杀他个措手不及。

original: Ah yes, Sarthis... a thorn in my side for the last few years.
traduit: 啊对，萨迪斯……这几年一直是我的眼中钉。

original: I've tried repeatedly to eradicate that meddler, but he has ears within the city guard. Gives us the slip every time we raid the warehouse.
traduit: 我曾经好几次试着除掉那个捣乱鬼，但他在卫兵里有眼线。每次我们搜查仓库，他都能溜之大吉。

original: However, if you'd wish to eliminate that burden for me... well, let's just say it would go a long way with earning my favor.
traduit: 不过，如果你想帮我除掉这个负担……这么说吧，对赢得我的好感很有帮助。

original: Who has a key to the warehouse?
traduit: 仓库钥匙在谁那儿？

original: I overheard Bolli say that only the Jarl carries the key to the warehouse.
traduit: 我无意中听波利说过只有领主才有仓库钥匙。

original: When I meet Sarthis there, he's usually waiting for me outside with his bodyguard.
traduit: 我在那里找萨迪斯时，他一般都是带着保镖在外面等我。

original: If it wasn't for skooma, I'd already be on my way out of this horrible city.
traduit: 如果不是因为斯库玛，我已经在离开这可怕城市的路上了。

original: All my gold... completely gone. Now I have to start over. I'll never use skooma again!
traduit: 我所有的钱……全都没了。现在我要重新开始。我再也不会吃斯库玛了！

original: Although I suppose a little mead now and then would be harmless...
traduit: 不过我想偶尔喝点蜜酒总没害处吧……

original: Okay, okay, I'll tell you.
traduit: 好，好，我告诉你。

original: I get my skooma from Sarthis Idren. He has some sort of a setup over at the Riften Warehouse.
traduit: 我是从萨迪斯·伊德仁那里拿到的。他盘踞在裂谷城仓库里。

original: You can't get inside though. They've kept that place locked up tight since the war began.
traduit: 但你进不去，战争一开始他们就把那地方锁起来了。

original: Okay, never mind.
traduit: 好吧，没关系。

original: And who says I won't? (Intimidate)
traduit: 那谁说他们会我就不会呢？（恐吓）

original: You can't threaten me any worse than they have!
traduit: 你也没法比他们更能威胁我了！

original: Here, does this help? (<BribeCost> gold)
traduit: 这些可还有用？（<BribeCost>金币）

original: It's got nothing to do with the coin... this is my life we're talking about.
traduit: 这和钱没有关系……这可是我的命啊。

original: I think you owe me one. (Persuade)
traduit: 你还欠我个人情吧。（说服）

original: It's not worth dying over.
traduit: 但也不值得我去死。

original: Where do you get your skooma?
traduit: 你从哪儿买的斯库玛？

original: Look, I don't think I should say. I mean, they could kill me!
traduit: 听着，我觉得我不该说。我是说，他们会杀了我！

original: Perhaps some other time.
traduit: 那下次吧。

original: I can't say I'm happy with your decision. If you change your mind, let me know.
traduit: 我对你的决定并不满意。想好了再告诉我。

original: I'm very disappointed. I'd advise you to rethink that decision soon.
traduit: 我很失望。建议你重新考虑。

original: I'll make sure it's done.
traduit: 保证完成任务。

original: Good. Report back to me when your task is complete.
traduit: 好，任务完成之后向我汇报。

original: Good. Make sure not one of them escapes alive.
traduit: 好，一个活口也别留。

original: I've discovered the source of the skooma.
traduit: 我找到斯库玛的源头了。

original: Then there's no time to lose. It won't take long for Sarthis's associates to learn of his death.
traduit: 那就别浪费时间了。萨迪斯的同伙很快就会知道他的死讯。

original: The source of the poison must be destroyed once and for all, otherwise another dealer will simply take his place.
traduit: 毒品的源头必须消灭，否则另外的毒贩很快就会取而代之。

original: Do this task for me and you'll be well on your way to a title in Riften.
traduit: 为我完成这个任务，你就能在裂谷城获得一个头衔。

original: Then I want you to head out there immediately and eliminate all of them.
traduit: 那我要你立刻去把他们都消灭掉。

original: I can't afford to have another Sarthis blunder into Riften because they think we're too lazy to disrupt their pitiful operation.
traduit: 我不能让因为他们觉得我们懒得破坏他们的行动，再放另一个萨迪斯进入裂谷城。

original: They're at Cragslane Cavern.
traduit: 他们在崖道洞窟。

original: Sarthis Idren has been taken care of.
traduit: 萨迪斯·伊德仁被收拾了。

original: It's nice to receive good news for a change. Did you recover anything else from the warehouse worth mentioning?
traduit: 收到这个消息真是太好了。你在仓库还找到什么有价值的东西吗？

original: Results speak volumes over words and you've just proved it.
traduit: 你已经证明了，结果重于言语。

original: Did you happen to discover where the fetcher was getting his skooma from?
traduit: 有没有发现那个费彻是从哪儿搞到的斯库玛？

original: Tell me your side of the story about Sibbi.
traduit: 跟我说说你对西比的看法。

original: Sibbi and I were to be married. We were supposed to be happy together forever.
traduit: 我和西比就快结婚了。我们应该永远幸福地在一起。

original: Then I found that wretched poetry from Svana. When I confronted Sibbi about it, he threatened to kill me.
traduit: 然后我发现了斯瓦纳的那首烂诗。当我和西比对质的时候，他威胁要杀了我。

original: I was scared so I told my brother Wulfur. He went to talk to Sibbi for me and... and... Sibbi killed him. My brother wasn't even armed!
traduit: 我很害怕，就告诉了我兄弟乌尔富尔。他去帮我跟西比谈谈，然后……然后……西比杀了他。我哥甚至没拿武器！

original: When I heard what Sibbi did, I fled. Now you've found me, and you're going to tell him where I am.
traduit: 当我一听西比的所作所为，就逃走了。现在你找到了我，要向他报告我的所在。

original: I should say so. I'd be careful in the future before you confront someone without all of the facts!
traduit: 我也是。以后在你不知道具体情况就和别人对质前我会小心的！

original: How did you figure all this out?
traduit: 你怎么知道这些的？

original: You should know. You got the map for me from Bleak Falls Barrow.
traduit: 你应该记得。你从荒瀑古坟替我拿到了地图。

original: Why did you take the horn from Ustengrav?
traduit: 你为什么要从乌斯滕格拉拿走号角？

original: I knew the Greybeards would send you there if they thought you were Dragonborn. They're nothing if not predictable.
traduit: 我知道如果灰胡子认为你是龙裔，他们就会派你去的。他们没那么高深莫测。

original: When you showed up here, I knew you were the one the Greybeards sent, and not some Thalmor plant.
traduit: 你一来这儿，我就知道你是灰胡子派来的，不是梭默间谍。

original: What are you going to do with this place?
traduit: 你打算怎么处理这里？

original: Start changing it over to the Black-Briar Meadery West as soon as possible. That was Maven's part of the deal.
traduit: 尽快把它改成黑棘蜜酒庄西部分号。这也是和玛雯交易的一部分。

original: She's put me in charge of keeping the mead flowing, so that's exactly what I'm going to do.
traduit: 她让我负责保持蜜酒流通，所以我必须这么做。

original: If you're in the area and you ever need anything fenced, you just let me know.
traduit: 如果你在附近，有任何需要销赃的东西，尽管来找我。

original: Please, lead on.
traduit: 请带路吧。

original: This man is going to take you to Markarth. Are you ready?
traduit: 这个人会带你去马卡斯城。准备好了吗？

original: This woman is going to take you to Markarth. Are you ready?
traduit: 这个人会带你去马卡斯城。准备好了吗？

original: It's our honor to have you there.
traduit: 养育你是我们的荣幸。

original: I'm to go to the temple in Markarth. I... I'll have to leave you and mother.
traduit: 我得去马卡斯的神殿了。我……我要离开你和妈妈了。

original: My little girl. Always strong. Do you know where you have to go?
traduit: 宝贝闺女。总是这么坚强。你知道要去哪里吗？

original: Of course not. My spirit remains strong.
traduit: 当然没有。我很坚强的。

original: Fjotra, dear. Did they hurt you?
traduit: 弗洛特拉，宝贝。他们伤到你了吗？

original: Father!
traduit: 父亲！

original: We'll save her together.
traduit: 我们一起去救她。

original: Thank you, friend.
traduit: 谢谢你，朋友。

original: It's dangerous out there. You should stay.
traduit: 外面太危险。你还是在这里等着吧。

original: You're... probably right. Just hurry, please. Who knows what those things are doing to her.
traduit: 你……你说得对。请快点。谁知道那些混账要对她干什么。

original: I have a question about the statue.
traduit: 我想问问雕像的事。

original: What is there to know? It's in the temple, you bring it out. You bring it to me, I pay you. Now get moving.
traduit: 有什么好说的？就在神殿里，拿出来给我。我付钱给你。赶紧行动吧。

original: Fine. Let's get this over with.
traduit: 很好。赶紧了结这件事吧。

original: Here we go.
traduit: 赶快开始吧。

original: One moment.
traduit: 等一下。

original: We're here to arrange a temporary truce to allow the Dragonborn here to deal with the dragons. Nothing more.
traduit: 我们来这里只是为了让龙裔有条件对付龙族而暂时休战。仅此而已。

original: Enough posturing, Tullius. If you came to talk, let's get on with it.
traduit: 姿态挺高啊，图留斯。你如果要谈，那就赶快吧。

original: We have no need to negotiate when the rebels are so clearly losing the war.
traduit: 在叛军明显要输掉战争的当下我们没必要谈判。

original: I have no authority to negotiate a permanent settlement, unless Ulfric is ready to sue for peace and turn himself over to Imperial justice.
traduit: 我无权商讨永久和解协定。除非乌弗瑞克准备求和然后把自己交给帝国审判。

original: I just want to make clear that the only reason I agreed to attend this council was to deal with the dragon menace.
traduit: 我只想说清楚，我同意参加会议的唯一原因就是对付龙的威胁。

original: Damn right we do.
traduit: 我们当然知道。

original: Don't play dumb, Tullius!
traduit: 别装傻了图留斯！

original: Tell him, Ulfric.
traduit: 告诉他，乌弗瑞克。

original: Very well. You may enter.
traduit: 很好，你们进去吧。

original: The matter at hand is urgent. Alduin must be stopped. You wouldn't have called this council if you didn't agree.
traduit: 手头的事最要紧。我们必须阻止奥杜因。如果你不同意，也就不会召集会议了。

original: We know a great deal about the situation and the threat that Alduin poses to us all. You need us here if you want this council to succeed.
traduit: 我们非常了解局势和奥杜因对全体的威胁。如果你想促成会议，就需要我们在这里。

original: Delphine, we're not here to rehearse old grudges.
traduit: 戴尔芬，我们不是来算旧账的。

original: She did what had to be done. It was long overdue. My only regret is that I wasn't able to kill him myself.
traduit: 她做了该做的事。他早该遭报应了。唯一的遗憾就是我没亲手宰了他。

original: He did what had to be done. It was long overdue. My only regret is that I wasn't able to kill him myself.
traduit: 他做了该做的事。他早该遭报应了。唯一的遗憾就是我没亲手宰了他。

original: For now. The Blades' memory is long, as you know.
traduit: 现在你该知道了，刀锋会的记性很好。

original: If it were up to you, the Dragonborn would sit dreaming on this mountain doing nothing!
traduit: 如果要你来决定，那龙裔就得待在这山上做白日梦，什么都不干！

original: I know what path you set her on. And now Paarthurnax's wisdom is lost to us, just when we need it most.
traduit: 我知道你想把她引向哪条路。现在我们需要帕图纳克斯的智慧，却失去了。

original: I know what path you set him on. And now Paarthurnax's wisdom is lost to us, just when we need it most.
traduit: 我知道你想把他引向哪条路。现在我们需要帕图纳克斯的智慧，却失去了。

original: We know what path you've set her on. But she has made a different choice. Paarthurnax is still safe from your malice.
traduit: 我知道你想把她引向哪条路。但她做出了不同的选择。帕图纳克斯仍然不会受你的恶意攻击。

original: We know what path you've set him on. But he has made a different choice. Paarthurnax is still safe from your malice.
traduit: 我知道你想把他引向哪条路。但他做出了不同的选择。帕图纳克斯仍然不会受你的恶意攻击。

original: Were you? The hubris of the Blades truly knows no bounds.
traduit: 是吗？刀锋会的傲慢真是毫无止境。

original: We have as much right to be at this council as all of you. More, actually, since we were the ones that put the Dragonborn on this path.
traduit: 我们与其他人一样有权参会。事实上，我们更有资格。因为是我们带领龙裔走上了这条路。

original: You were not invited here. You are not welcome here.
traduit: 没人邀请你们。这里不欢迎你们。

original: So. Arngeir, is it? You know why we're here. Are you going to let us in or not?
traduit: 所以，你就是艾恩盖尔？你应该明白我们来此的原因。到底能不能放我们进去？

original: The Order shall rise.
traduit: 教团将会崛起。

original: Yeah, fie!
traduit: 啊嘿！

original: Fie!
traduit: 咄！

original: Grant us this power so that in your name we may vanquish our enemies.
traduit: 请赐予我们力量，我们将以您之名击败敌人。

original: Fie. We beseech you. Darken this gem so that we may use its power to restore The Order of the Black Worm.
traduit: 咄。我们恳求您。让这颗宝石转为黑暗，我们要以它的力量复兴黑蠕虫教团。

original: You can't just leave me here!
traduit: 你不能把我丢在这里！

original: There are advantages to gaining <Alias=ImperialMinorHoldCapital>. (Persuade)
traduit: 拿到<Alias=ImperialMinorHoldCapital>有很多好处。（说服）

original: Not enough to outweigh the loss of Riften. The whole south of Eastmarch would be open to Imperial attack.
traduit: 但不足以弥补失去裂谷的损失。东陲的整个南部都会暴露在帝国的攻击下。

original: You're right. <Alias=ImperialMajorHoldCapital> is a fair trade for Riften.
traduit: 你说得对。<Alias=ImperialMajorHoldCapital>交换裂谷城很公平。

original: Well. Good! You favor the Empire less than I feared. Maybe we will be able to come to some agreement here after all.
traduit: 嗯。很好！你没我想的那么喜欢帝国。也许我们能够在这达成协议。

original: <Alias=ImperialMinorHoldCapital> seems like a fair trade.
traduit: <Alias=ImperialMinorHoldCapital>似乎是个公平交易。

original: In exchange for Riften, the jewel of Skyrim? Hardly.
traduit: 用来换裂谷城这颗天际明珠？很难。

original: Whiterun seems like a better choice to me. From there we can threaten to undermine the whole Imperial position.
traduit: 我觉得白漫不错。我们能从那威胁整个帝国军。

original: In exchange for Riften, the jewel of Skyrim? Hardly. How about the Reach? Gaining control of the silver mines would be invaluable.
traduit: 用来换裂谷城这颗天际明珠？很难。瑞驰如何？获得银矿的控制权很重要。

original: How about <Alias=ImperialMajorHold>?
traduit: <Alias=ImperialMajorHold>如何？

original: It has its advantages. I've never liked having the Empire perched on my doorstep. And Riften would be easy to hold...
traduit: 它有优点。我不喜欢帝国军队在我门口晃悠。而且裂谷城很容易防守……

original: Yes. With Markarth in our hands, we'll be able to raid the Imperial supply lines out of Solitude...
traduit: 嗯没错。我们如果有了马卡斯，就能突袭帝国独孤城的补给线。

original: How about Dawnstar?
traduit: 晨星如何？

original: You're right. Tullius isn't in any position to ask for Riften.
traduit: 你说得对。图留斯没资格索要裂谷城。

original: The Empire holds nothing worth trading Riften for.
traduit: 帝国没有值得拿来交换裂谷的东西。

original: Enough, Galmar.
traduit: 加尔玛，够了。

original: Galmar. We will do whatever I decide is in the best interests of Skyrim. Are we clear?
traduit: 加尔玛，只要我认为这个决定符合天际的利益，我们就要去做。明白了吗？

original: Vignar. We will do whatever I decide is in the best interests of Skyrim. Are we clear?
traduit: 维吉纳，只要我认为这个决定符合天际的利益，我们就要去做。明白了吗？

original: Besides, Jarl Laila will never agree to...
traduit: 而且，莱拉领主不会同意……

original: We want control of Markarth. That's our price for agreeing to a truce.
traduit: 我们想要马卡斯的控制权。这是我们同意休战的条件。

original: You should be glad enough of a chance to lick your wounds at this point in the war.
traduit: 战争进行到这个时刻，你该高兴能有机会舔舔自己的伤口。

original: We consider even sitting down to talk with these rebels more than generous.
traduit: 我们甚至觉得，能坐下来和叛军谈就够慷慨了。

original: It will be fine.
traduit: 会没事的。

original: But regrets are pointless. Here we are.
traduit: 但事已至此。后悔没有意义。

original: Take your seat at the council table and let us see what wisdom we can find among these warriors of Skyrim.
traduit: 在会议桌前就座吧。看看我们能从天际的战士们身上找到什么智慧。

original: This was the only way to get <Alias.Shortname=Jarl>'s help.
traduit: 这是获得<Alias.Shortname=Jarl>帮助的唯一方法。

original: Yes, yes. Which is why I allowed this... violation of all our traditions.
traduit: 没错，没错。所以我才会允许这个……违背我们所有传统的举动。

original: Don't worry. I'll get them to agree to peace.
traduit: 别担心。我会让他们同意和平的。

original: Peace? I doubt it. They may put their weapons down for a moment, but only to gather strength for the next bloodletting.
traduit: 和平？我表示怀疑。他们可能会暂时放下武器，但那只是为下一次流血积蓄力量。

original: They are not yet tired of war. Far from it. Do you know the ancient Nord word for war? "Season unending"... so it has proved.
traduit: 他们对战争乐此不疲。远没疲倦。你知道古诺德人如何形容战争吗？“无休之季”……事实证明所言非虚。

original: I should not have agreed to host this council. The Greybeards have no business involving ourselves in such matters.
traduit: 我真不该同意主持这次会议。灰胡子不该卷入这种事。

original: I told you they'd come.
traduit: 我告诉过你他们会来的。

original: So, you've done it. The men of violence are gathered here, in these halls whose very stones are dedicated to peace.
traduit: 嗯，你做到了。一群暴力分子汇聚在这个致力于和平的石头大殿了。

original: Don't fall behind!
traduit: 别落下！

original: They're all dead.
traduit: 都死了。

original: Then we've no time to lose. Follow me!
traduit: 那我们不能浪费时间了。跟我来！

original: No, not yet.
traduit: 不，还没有。

original: Well, hurry up.
traduit: 好吧，那就快点。

original: Have you killed them all yet?
traduit: 你把它们都杀了？

original: Riften is off the table. The Empire barely has a toehold left in Skyrim. We don't need to pay such a high price for this truce.
traduit: 裂谷城不在讨论范围内。帝国在天际几乎已无立足之地。我们犯不着为休战付出这么高昂的代价。

original: We've made you a fair offer. If you're really serious about this truce, you need to reconsider.
traduit: 我们已经给出了公平的报价。如果你真想谈，就重新考虑吧。

original: You heard the man, Tullius.
traduit: 听到他怎么说了吗，图留斯。

original: You heard what she said, Tullius.
traduit: 听到她怎么说了吗，图留斯。

original: Aye! We haven't forgotten Markarth, Tullius!
traduit: 啊！我们从未忘记过马卡斯，图留斯！

original: But I accepted the Dragonborn's invitation to this council, and I at least will negotiate in good faith.
traduit: 但我接受龙裔的邀请来此赴会。我至少会真诚地进行谈判。

original: First, let me be clear. The sons of Skyrim know from bitter experience that talking to the Empire is a waste of time, or worse.
traduit: 先说清楚。惨痛的经历已经教会天际之子，与帝国对话就是在浪费时间，甚至更糟。

original: Imperial promises are simply a way to lull you while they prepare a dagger for your back.
traduit: 帝国的承诺只是骗人的把戏，与此同时他们会准备从后面给你一刀。

original: Jarl Ulfric, what would you want in return?
traduit: 乌弗瑞克领主，你想要什么？

original: You haven't been able to take it back yet. Why should we give it up now?
traduit: 你还没能把它拿回去。那我们为什么要现在放弃？

original: Come on, Tullius, you can't seriously expect us to just hand over Riften at the negotiating table.
traduit: 得了吧，图留斯，你不会真指望我们在谈判桌上把裂谷城交给你吧。

original: Ulfric, you can't be taking this demand seriously? We can hold Riften against anything the Empire can throw at it.
traduit: 乌弗瑞克，你不会是认真对待这种要求吧？我们可以在帝国的进攻下守住裂谷城的。

original: Of course not! What will you offer for Riften, Tullius? Some empty promises? Maybe some more Imperial bluster?
traduit: 当然不！图留斯，你打算拿什么来换裂谷城？空洞的承诺？还是再加点帝国的唬人话？

original: I'm sure General Tullius does not expect something for nothing.
traduit: 我相信图留斯将军不会空手白拿的。

original: That's quite an opening demand, Tullius.
traduit: 这要求够露骨的，图留斯。

original: Elisif, are you really going to be a party to this foolishness?
traduit: 艾利西弗，你真要掺和这种蠢事？

original: Do you really think Ulfric will just turn Riften over because some Imperial general barked an order?
traduit: 你真以为乌弗瑞克会因为帝国将军的命令就交出裂谷城？

original: Riften must be returned to Imperial control. That's our price for agreeing to a truce.
traduit: 裂谷城必须回到帝国的控制下。这是我们同意休战的条件。

original: Our terms are simple.
traduit: 我们的条件很简单。

original: And now we come to the end of our play. The grand finale.
traduit: 看来我们的表演要结束了。大结局来了。

original: If it's any comfort, I do feel slightly bad about Veezara. Stupid lizard got in my way! But please tell me that hulking sheepdog has bled to death.
traduit: 如果说有什么话能让你舒服点的话，我确实对不起维萨拉。那个笨蜥蜴挡了我的路！但一定告诉我那个巨型牧羊犬已经失血过多而死了。

original: Cicero admits, he thought the Listener would be dead by now. Heh. Maybe we could just forget all this? Hmm? Let bygones be bygones? What do you say?
traduit: 西塞罗承认，他以为聆听者已经死了呢。哈。也许我们应该忘了这一切？嗯？过去的就让它过去吧？你说呢？

original: Brrr! Chilly! You'll enjoy this. Not an original part of the Sanctuary, per se. Let's call it a "forced addition." Forced by what? Oh, come and see!
traduit: 噗呜！好冷啊！你会喜欢的。不过这里不是圣所原先的区域。就叫“强制附加”吧。强制加什么？哦，过来看看呀！

original: All right, so Cicero attacked that harlot, Astrid! But what's a fool to do, when his mother is slandered and mocked? Surely the Listener understands!
traduit: 没错，是西塞罗袭击了那个婊子，阿斯垂德！但是当母亲面临诽谤和嘲笑的时候，一个小丑还能干些什么呢？聆听者会理解的！

original: You're... still alive. Cicero respects the Listener's abilities, of course, but could you at least slow down a bit? I'm not what I used to be. Heh.
traduit: 你……还活着。西塞罗当然尊重聆听者的能力，但是你能不能稍微放慢点节奏？我已经不如当年了。哎。

original: Ouch! Pointy pointy! My home is well defended. I always have been a stickler for details. Get it? "Stick-ler." Ha ha ha ha ha ha ha! Oh, I slay me!
traduit: 诶呦！尖尖的刺刺！我家的防御很好哦。我一直都很注意细节的。明白吗？“注意细节的人”哈哈哈哈哈哈哈哈！哦，真受不了我自己！

original: Oh, but this isn't at all what Mother would want. You kill the Keeper or I kill the Listener? Now that's madness.
traduit: 哦，但这不是母亲想要的结果。你来杀守护者，或者我杀掉聆听者？太疯狂了。

original: Listener! Is that you? Oh, I knew you'd come. Send the best to defeat the best. Astrid knew her stupid wolf couldn't slay sly Cicero.
traduit: 聆听者！是你吗？哦，我就知道你会来。兵对兵，将对将。阿斯垂德知道她那头蠢狼对付不了狡猾的西塞罗。

original: Damn that Loreius. Oh, how he will pay for this treachery...
traduit: 该死的罗瑞尤斯。哦，他一定会为背叛付出代价的……

original: You look like a crazy man to me. And what's in that coffin, hmm? Maybe some time in a cell will help loosen that lying tongue.
traduit: 我看你就是个疯子。棺材里装的什么？看来不蹲几天大狱你是不开口啊。

original: Wh... What? A crime? Me? Preposterous! Poor Cicero is just standing here! Cicero loves order. Oh yes! He would never disrespect the law!
traduit: 什……什么？犯罪？我？太荒谬了！可怜的西塞罗只是站在这里而已！西塞罗热爱秩序。哦，没错！他绝不会蔑视法律！

original: You there! Fool! Hold fast. You've been accused of a crime against the laws of this land. What say you in your defense?
traduit: 喂！小丑！站住。你被指控违反本地法律。还有何话说？

original: Oh thank you, kind stranger. Thank you for helping Cicero and his poor, stranded mother.
traduit: 哦，谢谢你，好心的陌生人。感谢你帮助西塞罗还有他可怜两难的母亲。

original: He he. That'll teach the little loony.
traduit: 嘿嘿。这会给那个小疯子一个教训。

original: A jester. In these parts. Man must be completely off his tree.
traduit: 小丑，在这里。他一定是疯了。

original: Move along, now.
traduit: 快点走。

original: Everyone, fall back! Run for it!
traduit: 所有人，退后！快离开！

original: What the...?
traduit: 什么……？

original: Another trap, most likely. Things are dangerous... three of the guards died when the lower hall flooded with steam last week.
traduit: 很可能是另一个陷阱。这里的东西很危险……上周下层的大厅被蒸汽淹没时，就死了三个卫兵。

original: What do you think this is?
traduit: 你觉得这是什么？

original: ...As you say, sir.
traduit: ……遵命，先生。

original: Sir, are you serious?
traduit: 先生，你是认真的吗？

original: You heard me, captain- our work must not be disturbed.
traduit: 听着队长，我们的工作不能被打扰。

original: Kill any intruders on sight. Call for backup if you need it. But let no one through.
traduit: 任何视线内的入侵者格杀勿论。如果需要，就立刻呼叫支援。但不能放任何人通过。

original: Well, at least this post is safe enough. Come on, let's get back to work.
traduit: 好吧，但至少在这儿站岗够安全。走吧，回去工作。

original: Better them than us. We lost three good men to the traps up there, and for what- just to see another damn spider clanking around?
traduit: 他们比咱们强。咱们在上面的陷阱里折了三个好伙计，结果就是为了看另一只该死的蜘蛛四处游荡？

original: Yeah. Calcelmo called in his entire expedition team- said he needed every man he could get to protect his research.
traduit: 是。卡塞莫召集了他整个探险队，说是需要每个人都来保护他的研究。

original: What a waste! There must be a dozen men up there!
traduit: 真浪费！现在上面肯定有一打人！

original: All right men, spread out and search the tower. No telling who- or what- we're dealing with here.
traduit: 好了，伙计们，分头搜索塔楼内部。现在还不清楚我们在对付什么东西。

original: I... oh, all right. If there is a thief, he won't leave this tower alive. But shouldn't we inform Master Calcelmo?
traduit: 我……哦，好吧。如果真的有贼，那他活着走不出这座塔。但我们不用通知卡塞莫大师吗？

original: Hmm. These doors seem to be the only thing left between me and the treasure.
traduit: 嗯。这些门应该就是我和宝藏的唯一屏障了。

original: Is there someway to open them?
traduit: 有办法打开它们吗？

original: There'd better be. I didn't come all this way to leave empty handed.
traduit: 最好有。我大老远跑来不能空手而归。

original: There must be a way to activate these doors deeper in the ruins. Here, take this key. It should open the doors on either side of this chamber.
traduit: 一定有办法激活遗迹深处的这些门。给，拿着这把钥匙。应该能打开墓室两侧的门。

original: At last, the treasure is mine! All mine!
traduit: 终于，宝藏是我的了！全是我的！

original: Fine. I'll come quietly.
traduit: 好吧。我不会反抗的。

original: You'll never see the sun again, you hear me? No one escapes Cidhna Mine.
traduit: 你再也见不到太阳了，听到了？没人能逃离希讷矿场。

original: No one.
traduit: 没人。

original: You're not taking me alive!
traduit: 你休想活捉我！

original: You'll never leave Markarth!
traduit: 你别想离开马卡斯了！

original: You killed Eltrys!
traduit: 你杀了艾翠斯！

original: We warned you, but you just had to go and cause trouble.
traduit: 我们警告过你，但你偏偏要惹是生非。

original: Now we have to pin all these recent murders on you. Silence witnesses. Work. Work. Work.
traduit: 现在我们得把最近的谋杀案都安到你头上了。别想着能公之于众了，滚去挖矿吧，挖啊挖。

original: He's proud of his service, Skald. The Legion taught us loyalty. And we're loyal to Dawnstar.
traduit: 他为自己曾经的效忠感到骄傲，斯卡德。军团教会了我们忠诚。我们对晨星很忠诚。

original: Your man Horik is wearing his old Legion armor. What should I make of that?
traduit: 你的部下霍理克现在还穿着他帝国军团的老盔甲。我该怎么理解呢？

original: This is quite an achievement, Dragonborn. And General Tullius. Riften is ours!
traduit: 了不起的成就，龙裔。图留斯将军，裂谷城是我们的了！

original: Giving up Markarth is a heavy price for this truce, Dragonborn. I hope it was worth it.
traduit: 放弃马卡斯换取休战是沉重的代价，龙裔。我希望这是值得的。

original: I admit, I really didn't expect you'd be able to arrange a truce. Getting Ulfric to agree to anything at all is quite an achievement.
traduit: 我承认，真没想到你能促成休战。让乌弗瑞克点头同意任何事都是了不起的成就。

original: Come on Galmar. We have a lot of work to do.
traduit: 走吧，加尔玛。我们还有很多工作。

original: Well that's an excellent question. You haven't overlooked that little detail, have you?
traduit: 好问题。你没忘记这个小细节吧？

original: Jarl Baalgruf, I assume you are familiar with the Dragonborn's plan?
traduit: 巴尔古夫领主，你应该知道龙裔的计划吧？

original: Don't listen to him. Ulfric's been telling lies about himself for so long, he's actually starting to believe them.
traduit: 别听他的。乌弗瑞克撒谎习惯了，自己都跟着信了。

original: For what it's worth, I'm sorry to see you go. You fought well for us.
traduit: 不管怎样。我很遗憾你要走了。你为我们奋战的很好。

original: I'm willing to let the Dragonborn decide the fairness of my request.
traduit: 我想让龙裔判断我的请求是否公平。

original: I guess I have no choice but to let the Dragonborn decide. Although I'm starting to doubt your fairness.
traduit: 我看我别无选择，只能让龙裔来决定了。虽然我有点开始怀疑你的公平性了。

original: Why would I give you that, if I wouldn't give you Riften?
traduit: 如果我不给你裂谷城，你凭什么认为我会给你那个？

original: What next, Tullius? Shall I just hand over all of Skyrim?
traduit: 接下来呢，图留斯？我该把全天际都交给你们？

original: We want Hjaalmarch back, and Idgrod Ravencrone restored as Jarl.
traduit: 我们想要回希雅陲，让“老乌鸦”艾德格洛德复位领主。

original: You withdraw from Falkreath, and allow Siddgeir to resume his rightful place as Jarl.
traduit: 你们从佛克瑞斯撤军，让西德盖尔恢复合法的领主身份。

original: We want the Pale returned to Imperial control. The traitor Skald the Elder will be replaced with a more loyal candidate.
traduit: 我们要让苍原重回帝国控制。叛徒老斯卡德要被更忠诚的候选人取代。

original: We want Kraldar removed as Jarl of Winterhold, and an Imperial candidate put in his place.
traduit: 我们要让卡拉达交出冬堡领主位置，由帝国的候选人接替。

original: Never mind. I can see that these are the best terms we'll get from this council.
traduit: 没关系。我知道这是咱们能从会议上获得的最好条件。

original: So be it. The Empire at least puts the greater good above our own interests.
traduit: 就这样吧。帝国的利益高于我们的个人利益。

original: Shor's bones, where will these demands end?
traduit: 舒尔的骨头，要求起来没完没了了？

original: Damn Imperial arrogance!
traduit: 帝国人真是狂的没边！

original: You see what talking to them gets us?
traduit: 看到和他们谈的后果了吧？

original: Out with it, then.
traduit: 那就说吧。

original: If we're not going to get Riften, we need you to give us something.
traduit: 如果我们拿不到裂谷城，你得给我们点东西。

original: You know as well as I do that that we can't hand over Markarth on these terms.
traduit: 你我都清楚，我们不可能在这种条件下交出马卡斯。

original: You know I can't agree to these terms. The Emperor would repudiate this treaty and I would be recalled.
traduit: 你知道我不能同意这种条件。到时候皇帝会拒绝承认协定然后把我召回。

original: Don't hand me a mug of sheep's piss and call it Colovian brandy. These terms are still not acceptable.
traduit: 别塞给我杯羊尿还唬我说是科洛文白兰地。我不能接受这些条件。

original: Come on, Ulfric. You have to give a little ground here. The dragons are a threat to us both.
traduit: 得了吧，乌弗瑞克。你得做点让步。龙族对你我都是威胁。

original: Come see me in Solitude when this is all done. The Emperor can always use another good soldier.
traduit: 一切结束之后，来独孤城找我吧，皇帝一直在寻求优秀的士兵。

original: I accept your offer. I'd like to join the Imperial Legion.
traduit: 我接受你的提议。我会去加入帝国军团。

original: Excellent! You aren't the first to have a change of heart, after seeing what Ulfric's reckless pride is doing to Skyrim.
traduit: 太好了！在看清乌弗瑞克的鲁莽骄傲对天际的损害后，你不是第一个改变想法的。

original: You and Ulfric are both mistaken. I fight for Skyrim's freedom.
traduit: 你和乌弗瑞克都错了。我是为天际的自由而战。

original: I'm sorry to hear that. I thought you'd finally seen through Ulfric's lies.
traduit: 很遗憾听到这个。我以为你终于识破乌弗瑞克的谎言了。

original: Ulfric showed his true colors today, eh? Don't worry. You aren't the first to be taken in by his self-serving lies.
traduit: 乌弗瑞克今天露出真面目了吧？别担心。你不是第一个被他自私谎言欺骗的人。

original: I think you may have joined the wrong side. You showed yourself to be a true friend to the Empire today.
traduit: 我觉得你可能站错阵营了。今天你证明了你是帝国真正的朋友。

original: You've disgraced yourself and our cause. You are no longer fit to be known as a son of Skyrim.
traduit: 你玷污了自己，也玷污了我们的事业。你不再适合做天际之子了。

original: You've disgraced yourself and our cause. You are no longer fit to be known as a daughter of Skyrim.
traduit: 你玷污了自己，也玷污了我们的事业。你不再适合做天际之女了。

original: I'm sorry. I was trying to reach a fair agreement.
traduit: 我很抱歉，我只是想达成公平的协定。

original: Very honorable, I'm sure, but you should not put your own honor above the freedom of Skyrim.
traduit: 这确实很光荣。但你不该为了自己的荣誉而践踏天际的自由。

original: I thought you needed to be taken down a notch.
traduit: 我以为你需要低调些。

original: I'm sure that will be a great comfort to the families of your comrades who died to free the land you just gave back to the Empire.
traduit: 我相信这对于为了解放刚刚被你归还给帝国土地，壮烈牺牲的战友遗孤来说，是个巨大的安慰。

original: You should think harder on your commitment to Skyrim's freedom next time you're deciding what's right.
traduit: 在做决定的时候，应该认真考虑对天际自由的承诺。

original: Your actions here were a disgrace. You betrayed Skyrim at every turn.
traduit: 你在这里的行为太可耻了。你的每一轮决定都在背叛天际。

original: Come see me in Windhelm when this is all done. There's always work for those willing to fight for Skyrim.
traduit: 等一切结束再来找我。对于那些愿意为天际而战者来说，总有工作要做。

original: Ulfric doesn't need to give up any more territory.
traduit: 乌弗瑞克无需放弃更多领土。

original: What? Have you forgotten your oath to the Emperor?
traduit: 什么？你把对皇帝的誓言忘了？

original: As I expected, you favor your friends.
traduit: 如我所料，你更倾向自己的友方。

original: I agree. Ulfric should turn over <Alias=SonsMinorHold2>.
traduit: 我同意。乌弗瑞克应该交出<Alias=SonsMinorHold2>。

original: I'm impressed at your even-handed treatment. Thank you.
traduit: 你公正的态度令人叹服。谢谢。

original: Who's to say what happened at <Alias=ImperialTownRaided>?
traduit: 谁又知道<Alias=ImperialTownRaided>发生了什么？

original: I expected better from you.
traduit: 我对你期望本来很高。

original: I should have known better than to expect you to give us a fair hearing.
traduit: 我早该知道你不会公正地倾听。

original: Ulfric should compensate you for <Alias=ImperialTownRaided>.
traduit: 乌弗瑞克应该为<Alias=ImperialTownRaided>付出补偿。

original: Well said! You may be fighting on the wrong side in this war.
traduit: 说得好！在战争中你可能站错队了。

original: This is our homeland, Tullius. All the blood spilled in this war is on your head.
traduit: 这是我们的家园，图留斯。这场战争流的所有血都该算在你头上。

original: Damned Imperial lies! My men would never stoop to such methods, even in retaliation for your butchery at...
traduit: 该死的帝国谎言！我的部下绝不会作出这种无耻的行径，哪怕是为了报复你在……

original: You slaughtered the very people you claim to be fighting for! True sons of Skyrim would never do such things.
traduit: 你屠杀的正是你信誓旦旦要为之战斗的人！真正的天际之子绝不会这样做。

original: If you think that winning a few battles means you're winning the war, you're even worse at strategy than diplomacy.
traduit: 如果你觉得应几场战斗就意味着战争胜利了，那你的战略可比外交能力还糟糕。

original: You're losing this war and you know it.
traduit: 你会输掉这场战争，你懂的。

original: I know how this works, Tullius. I've learned the value of Imperial promises the hard way. Never again.
traduit: 我知道该做什么，图留斯。我吃了不少才明白帝国的承诺毫无价值。我不会再上当了。

original: We get Riften back. Now we'll see if there's anything behind your fine words.
traduit: 我们拿回裂谷城了。现在看看你的花言巧语是不是真话。

original: You may think this war is nearly won. You're wrong. I've been fighting you with a mere handful of troops.
traduit: 你可能认为你快赢了。但你想错了。我只用区区几支部队就打败了你。

original: Once the Emperor is convinced of the need, then you will see the full strength of the Imperial Legion.
traduit: 只要皇帝认为有必要，你会见识到帝国军团的全部力量。

original: If you think you can hold Riften, you're as deluded as you've always been.
traduit: 你以为你能保得住裂谷城，那就大错特错了。

original: You're here to blacken the Empire's name, and I won't be party to it.
traduit: 你来这里羞辱帝国之名，但我不会参与。

original: I know you, Ulfric. You have no intention of coming to terms.
traduit: 我了解你，乌弗瑞克。你根本没想和我们达成协议。

original: Aedra, what a day!
traduit: 伊德拉啊，今天是怎么了！

original: I'll deal with my uncle. Just... go! Scour this place from top to bottom!
traduit: 我来应付我叔叔。赶快……去！把这个地方仔细搜一遍！

original: Yes, I'm positive I heard something.
traduit: 对，我肯定是听到了什么东西。

original: 'Accidents' like this don't just happen! Someone is trying to sabotage my uncle's research!
traduit: 这样的“事故”怎么会随便发生！有人想破坏我叔叔的研究！

original: You're coming with me. Now. (Intimidate)
traduit: 你现在跟我走。（恐吓）

original: I think you need to calm down before I summon the guards.
traduit: 我觉得你应该在我喊卫兵过来前冷静下来。

original: I'm willing to pay. (<BribeCost> gold)
traduit: 我会付钱的。（<BribeCost>金币）

original: That's no small amount of coin, friend.
traduit: 这可不是笔小数目啊。朋友。

original: I suppose I can come with you for a short venture. Lead on.
traduit: 我想跟你一起短暂冒险。带路吧。

original: I'm just not up for it, sorry. I'd rather stay here, have a glass of wine, and perform my rites to Arkay in peace.
traduit: 我暂时没这打算，抱歉。我更喜欢待在这儿，喝杯酒，平静地为阿尔凯举行仪式。

original: There would be treasure to share... (Persuade)
traduit: 找到的财宝咱俩分……（说服）

original: Treasure, you say?
traduit: 你说财宝？

original: I suppose the Jarl won't mind if I'm gone for a little while. Lead on.
traduit: 啊，我想领主不介意我离开一段时间。带路吧。

original: You know, in the Priesthood of Arkay, we have a joke about an empty pocket being better than a full grave.
traduit: 你知道，阿尔凯祭司团里有个笑话，“空落落口袋好过满当当棺材”。

original: I have need of a priest in my travels.
traduit: 我旅行需要一位祭司帮忙。

original: You are looking for Arkay's protection while you delve some dank tomb, I take it?
traduit: 我猜你是想在挖坟的时候有阿尔凯祭司保护吧？

original: My duties keep me busy in Markarth. I don't know if I can help you.
traduit: 我在马卡斯的工作很忙。我不确定能不能帮你。

original: Just tell me who needs to die.
traduit: 告诉我要谁死。

original: Who is it?
traduit: 是谁？

original: You've done it. The shrine is ours again.
traduit: 你成功了。我们夺回祭坛了。

original: Now we need to prepare a grand feast to welcome you to Namira's coven.
traduit: 现在我们要准备一场盛大宴会欢迎你加入娜米拉集会。

original: You will have the honor of bringing a fresh kill for the main course. And I know the perfect person.
traduit: 你将有幸为主菜带来新鲜的食材。我知道有个完美人选。

original: You seem very sure of yourself.
traduit: 你看上去很有信心啊。

original: There is much for J'zargo to be sure of.
traduit: 杰'扎格还确定很多事。

original: There is skill in magic, there is charm, and there is a strong will. J'zargo will be successful, of this there is no doubt.
traduit: 魔法的技巧、个人的魅力、坚强的意志。杰'扎格毫无疑问会成功的。

original: Not everything is a competition, you know.
traduit: 要知道，不是事事都需竞争。

original: Oh, but you are wrong.
traduit: 不，你错了。

original: The only reason you could disagree is because you are losing so badly you cannot see it.
traduit: 你不同意的唯一原因就是因为你会输的很惨，所以不愿直视。

original: That's far beyond my level of skill.
traduit: 这远远超出了我的能力范围。

original: Is it? This is disappointing.
traduit: 是吗？好失望。

original: J'zargo hoped there might be one who could keep pace with his accomplishments.
traduit: 杰'扎格还希望有人能和他齐头并进呢。

original: Not yet, but I will.
traduit: 还没有，但总会有这么一天。

original: Ah, this is good. But J'zargo will know them first.
traduit: 啊，很好。但杰'扎格会抢先掌握它们的。

original: It is good to finally be around mages who may be able to keep up with J'zargo.
traduit: 能找到跟得上杰'扎格的法师们是一件好事。

original: Yes, I have.
traduit: 没错。

original: You... you have? Already?
traduit: 你……你会？真的吗？

original: Well, J'zargo is surprised. And pleased! There is real competition here. This is good.
traduit: 嗯，杰'扎格很惊讶，也很高兴！这里有真正的竞争了。太好了。

original: You are new, yes?
traduit: 你是新来的吧？

original: Have you mastered the Expert level destruction spells yet?
traduit: 你掌握了专家级的毁灭系法术了吗？

original: Why did Falion leave the College?
traduit: 法利昂为什么离开学院？

original: He didn't like the Arch-Mage. Hated dealing with him, hated having to answer to him.
traduit: 他不喜欢大法师。讨厌和他打交道，也讨厌事事向他汇报。

original: Falion said he hated what this place was becoming. So he just left. Aren found a note on his desk, and that was it.
traduit: 阿冉在他桌上发现张纸条，法利昂说他讨厌这里变成这样。就这些。

original: I understand he settled down in Hjaalmarch, and his presence there caused something of a problem.
traduit: 我听说他在希雅陲定居了，他在那儿出现还引起了一些问题。

original: Are there many Conjurers outside the College?
traduit: 学院以外的召唤师很多吗？

original: Not within society, no. Many who practice within the school of Conjuration do so on their own, secretly.
traduit: 社会上不常见。许多研究召唤学派的人，都是私下进行的。

original: Falion is the only one I know who is public about what he does. He was once my teacher here, but left the College years ago.
traduit: 法利昂是我所知唯一公开行动的人。他曾经是我在这里的老师，但几年前离开了学院。

original: Does the Arch-Mage often ask for advice?
traduit: 大法师经常征询意见吗？

original: Perhaps not as often as he should. In time, I believe he will be more trusting.
traduit: 或许没有那么频繁。但随着时间推移，我相信他会更信任我的。

original: I'd like to know more about the Thalmor.
traduit: 我想更多了解梭默。

original: Now that stability has been established between the Dominion and the Empire, we seek only to help Skyrim.
traduit: 现在先祖神洲和帝国已经建立稳定外交关系，我们只是寻求机会援助天际。

original: To guide its people through this time of transition, to help lead them to a better future.
traduit: 以指引其人民度过这一过渡时期，走向更美好的未来。

original: What is it you do here?
traduit: 你在这里做什么？

original: I am an advisor to the Arch-Mage. The Thalmor wish to promote relations with your College.
traduit: 我是大法师的顾问。梭默希望促进与你们学院之间的关系。

original: I am at the Arch-Mage's disposal if he requires advice.
traduit: 如果大法师垂询建议，我随时恭候。

original: Another new Apprentice, I see.
traduit: 又来了个新学徒，我知道了。

original: Are you of the sort that believe you're here to change the world? Or are you only in it for yourself?
traduit: 你是那种自以为能改变世界的人？还是纯粹为了你自己？

original: I assure you that I shall be watching you -- all of you -- very closely.
traduit: 我保证，我会密切注视你们每一个人。

original: (yawn) I'm so tired...
traduit: （哈欠）我好累……

original: Let me speak to our guest.
traduit: 让我和客人谈谈。

original: Don't be shy. You should be the one to carve.
traduit: 别害羞。由你来下刀吧。

original: This is your initiation into the coven. Go ahead. Have the first bite.
traduit: 这是你加入集会的仪式。去吧。尝第一口。

original: Don't worry, Arkay's protection is absolute.
traduit: 别担心。阿尔凯的庇护绝对可靠。

original: I need to get back to Markarth. Here, take this. It's the least I can do for saving my life.
traduit: 我得回马卡斯了。来，拿着这个。这是谢你救命最起码的谢意。

original: You were this close to being food.
traduit: 你差点变成食物了。

original: Sweet Breath of Arkay, were these the cannibals that were plaguing the Hall of the Dead?
traduit: 阿尔凯的甜蜜之息啊，就是这些食人族在扰乱亡者之厅？

original: It doesn't matter. You're safe.
traduit: 没事儿了。你安全了。

original: Thank you. I don't know what's going on, but I think I owe you my life.
traduit: 多谢。我不知道发生了什么，但我觉得欠你一条命。

original: What... what happened?
traduit: 发生……什么了？

original: The Dawnstar Sanctuary? That where you lot are holing up in now? Hmm... Tell you what. It'll cost you - a lot - but I can help you out.
traduit: 晨星圣所？你们现在躲到那去了？嗯……跟你说，这得花很多钱，但我可以帮你。

original: What exactly are we talking about here?
traduit: 我们来详细谈谈吧？

original: Can you repair and refit the Dawnstar Sanctuary?
traduit: 你能修缮晨星圣所吗？

original: Tell me what you need, and I'll get my people get on it.
traduit: 告诉我你的需要，我会找人去办。

original: I need some things for the Sanctuary.
traduit: 我要给圣所买点东西。

original: Of course you do.
traduit: 当然可以。

original: All right. What's your fancy?
traduit: 好吧。想要些什么？

original: I'm afraid that's it, my friend. I've done all I can. I hope the place is at least livable now. Good luck with, your, um... murders.
traduit: 恐怕只能这样了，朋友。我已经尽力了。我希望这地方现在至少适合居住了。祝你在……谋杀时好运。

original: Would it kill you to let a man go about his business in peace? Really, the nerve...
traduit: 让别人安静做事你能死吗？神经病……

original: Look, I'm busy. Please go bother somebody else.
traduit: 那个，我很忙。请打扰别人去吧。

original: Did you want something? I'm quite busy.
traduit: 你需要什么吗？我实在很忙。

original: I'm dying for a rest. I swear, I could lie down right now, and just sleep forever.
traduit: 我真想休息一下。我发誓，如果现在可以躺下，我能永远睡下去。

original: So you're the... the assassin? I need you to kill the Visiting Noble at Dragonsreach, in Whiterun. Here's the gold. I... I hope it's enough.
traduit: 所以你就是那个……刺客？我要你杀死白漫城龙临宫里来访的贵族。钱在这儿。希望……足够。

original: So you're the one from the... Dark Brotherhood? I need you to kill the Big Laborer at Katla's Farm. Here's the gold for the kill. Make it painful.
traduit: 你就是黑暗兄弟会……的人？我要你杀死凯特拉农场那个高大的劳工。这是刺杀的报酬。让他死得痛苦。

original: You must be the... assassin. I need you to kill the Itinerant Lumberjack, in Morthal, at the logging camp. Here, this is all the gold I have.
traduit: 你一定是……刺客。我要你杀了莫萨尔伐木营地那个巡逻的伐木工。给，这是我身上所有的钱。

original: You're the assassin, right? Look, there's this Reckless Mage in the Frozen Hearth Inn, in Winterhold. I want him dead. This gold should cover it.
traduit: 你就是那个刺客吧？听着，冬堡冻炉旅店里有个鲁莽的法师。我要他死。这些金子应该够了。

original: You're the one? From the... the Dark Brotherhood? The man I need killed is a Seasoned Hunter. He's just outside Falkreath. Here's the gold...
traduit: 你就是那个从……黑暗兄弟会来的人？我要杀一个老练的猎人。他就在佛克瑞斯城外。这是报酬……

original: You're here! I was wondering if that Black Sacrament even worked. I need you to kill a woman, a Poor Fishwife, on the Riften Docks. Here's the gold.
traduit: 你来了！我还在想黑色圣礼到底管不管用呢。我要你杀一个女人，一个贫穷的渔妇，她在裂谷城码头。钱给你。

original: Dark Brotherhood? You look the type. Listen, there's this Grim Shieldmaiden walking the streets of Markarth. Kill her. Now take this gold, and go.
traduit: 黑暗兄弟会？你看起来像。听着，马卡斯街上有个冷酷的盾女。杀了她。现在拿上钱赶紧走。

original: Are you the assassin? From the...? Well, there's this Traveling Dignitary, in Solitude. I need her... you know. This gold will cover it, right?
traduit: 你是那个刺客？从……？哦，有个旅行的显贵独自一人在外。我要她……你懂的。这些金子足够了吧？

original: I'm glad you're here. I need you to kill a Coldhearted Gravedigger, tends to work in the Hall of the Dead in Windhelm. This is all the gold I have.
traduit: 你能来太好了。我要你杀一个冷血的挖墓人，在风舵城的亡者之厅工作。这是我所有的钱。

original: Good, you're here. Look, in Ivarstead, there's this Beautiful Barbarian. I need her dead. Don't ask why. Just do it. This gold should cover it.
traduit: 好，你来了。伊瓦尔镇有个美丽的野蛮人。我要她死，别问为什么。去做就行了。这些金子应该足够了。

original: If anybody asks, this meeting never took place.
traduit: 如果有人问起，就说这次会面根本没发生过。

original: I don't know you.
traduit: 我不认识你。

original: You must speak with the Farmhand at Chillfurrow farm.
traduit: 去和寒犁农场的工人谈谈。

original: CompanionsHit
traduit: CompanionsHit

original: Uf!
traduit: 唔！

original: Yergh!
traduit: 耶呀！

original: Egh!
traduit: 呃！

original: You fight well, brother.
traduit: 打得好，兄弟。

original: You fight well, sister.
traduit: 打得好，姐妹。

original: I'd give a week's pay to see the look on Ulfric's face again, when he had to swallow the terms of the truce.
traduit: 我愿意拿出一周的薪俸再看一遍乌弗瑞克不情不愿地接受停战协议时的表情。

original: I hope this truce gives you what you need. It won't last.
traduit: 希望这次停战能满足你的需要。但不会持续太久。

original: As soon as I get back to Whiterun, I'll get my men ready.
traduit: 我会尽快回白漫城安排好我的人马。

original: When I return to Whiterun, I'll get my men ready to help trap this dragon.
traduit: 等我一回白漫城，就安排部下准备帮助捕龙。

original: The look on Tullius's face while the Greybeard read the terms was worth the trip.
traduit: 看到图留斯听灰胡子宣读条款时的表情真是不虚此行。

original: I don't much like this truce. Feels like a betrayal to me.
traduit: 我不太喜欢这次休战。感觉像是遭到了背叛。

original: We're counting on you to make this all worthwhile.
traduit: 希望你能让一切都值得。

original: I sacrificed a lot here today for this plan of yours.
traduit: 为了你的计划，我今天牺牲了很多。

original: That could have gone worse. Now it's up to you to deliver.
traduit: 本来可能会更糟。现在看你的了。

original: You'd better be able to deliver, Dragonborn. I sacrificed a lot here today.
traduit: 你最好能成功，龙裔。我今天牺牲太多了。

original: Is everyone here? Let's get this started.
traduit: 都到了？那开始吧。

original: Don't worry, I'll come to this peace council of yours.
traduit: 别担心。我是来参加你们的和平会议的。

original: I never thought I'd ever willingly stand in the same room with Tullius again. At least not without a weapon in my hand.
traduit: 从没想过我会愿意再和图留斯站在同一间屋子里。至少不能是不带武器的情况下。

original: It's good to be back in High Hrothgar after all these years.
traduit: 多年之后能回霍斯加修道院感觉真好。

original: I'd just as soon get this over with.
traduit: 我希望能快点完事。

original: I'll come to your council. But I doubt any good will come of it.
traduit: 我会去参加会议。但我怀疑这样做有什么好处。

original: When has any good ever come from talking to the Empire?
traduit: 哪次和帝国谈会有好处？

original: I don't know how you convinced Ulfric to talk to the Empire. Worse than a waste of time if you ask me.
traduit: 真不知道你怎么说服的乌弗瑞克去和帝国谈。要我说，这比浪费时间还糟糕。

original: I'm glad I finally got a chance to see this place.
traduit: 我很高兴终于有机会来看看这里。

original: Talking peace with Ulfric? You must be an optimist.
traduit: 和乌弗瑞克谈和平？你可真是个乐天派。

original: You've done well, to even get the two of them in the same room.
traduit: 能让他们俩共处一室，你已经做的很好了。

original: If you can arrange an end to the fighting, Dragonsreach is at your disposal.
traduit: 如果你能促成休战，那龙临宫随时听你差遣。

original: We should get started. Alduin is only getting stronger.
traduit: 我们得快开始了。奥杜因只会越变越强。

original: We must make them see their danger, Dragonborn.
traduit: 龙裔，我们必须让他们认识到危险。

original: We must succeed here today.
traduit: 我们今天必须成功。

original: And so we meet again. But this time I know who and what you really are.
traduit: 我们又见面了，这次我知道你真实身份了。

original: I'll give you credit for boldness. But associating yourself with the Blades is a choice you will come to regret.
traduit: 我必须称赞你的勇气。和刀锋会扯上关系会让你后悔的。

original: I'm here to ensure that General Tullius does not exceed his authority.
traduit: 我来此是为保证图留斯将军不会越权行事。

original: You gave Ulfric more than he deserved. This will certainly prolong the war.
traduit: 你给乌弗瑞克的太多了。这会延长战争的时间。

original: These terms are satisfactory to my government. The truce is unlikely to last long in any case.
traduit: 这些条款让本政府很满意。无论怎样，休战不会持续太久。

original: I'm here because it's required of me. But there's nothing to be gained by talking to that murderer.
traduit: 我应要求来此。但和那个谋杀犯谈没什么好处。

original: I understand this council was your idea, Dragonborn. I'm afraid I don't hold out much hope for success.
traduit: 我知道这次会议是你的主意，龙裔。但恐怕成功希望不大。

original: I don't know why you gave Ulfric so much. That murderer will never rule Skyrim.
traduit: 我不知道你为什么给乌弗瑞克那么多。这个谋杀犯不可能统治天际。

original: I'm glad you were able to negotiate a truce, but I don't trust Ulfric. He'll break his word as soon as it suits him.
traduit: 很高兴你能协商停战，但我不信任乌弗瑞克。只要对他有利，他就会食言。

original: We should get started.
traduit: 我们该开始了。

original: We have nothing to say to each other. Paarthurnax's murder is beyond my powers of forgiveness.
traduit: 我们没什么好谈的。帕图纳克斯之死超过了我的宽恕极限。

original: Yes. But understand - during the days of Alduin's rule, all dragons were his allies. There was nothing else they could be.
traduit: 没错。但是要知道，在奥杜因统治时期，所有龙族都是他的盟友。他们也别无选择。

original: If not for Paarthurnax, Alduin could not have been overthrown. It was he that first taught men to use the Thu'um.
traduit: 要没有帕图纳克斯，奥杜因就不会被推翻。是他率先教会了人类使用吐'目。

original: Yes, let's get this over with.
traduit: 好吧，快点开始吧。

original: Are you done? Did you just come here to make speeches? Or can we get down to business?
traduit: 说完了？你是来演讲的还是来谈正事的？

original: I consider even talking to the Empire a generous gesture.
traduit: 我甚至觉得和帝国坐下来谈就是慷慨之举了。

original: I knew he wouldn't be able to resist.
traduit: 我就知道他会这样。

original: We have no interest in negotiating with the Empire. It's only a matter of time before they are driven out of Skyrim.
traduit: 我们没兴趣和帝国谈判。把他们赶出天际只是时间问题。

original: There's nothing else to talk about, unless the Empire is finally ready to renounce its unjust claim to rule over the free people of Skyrim.
traduit: 和他们没什么好谈的，除非帝国准备放弃对天际的自由人民的不公统治。

original: The only reason I agreed to attend this council was to deal with the dragon menace.
traduit: 我同意参会的唯一原因就是对付龙的威胁。

original: Here we go.
traduit: 要开始了。

original: I have something to say first.
traduit: 话说在前头。

original: Master Arngeir, are you going to just let him continue to...
traduit: 艾恩盖尔大师，你是打算让他继续下去吗……

original: How does a maid become a Steward?
traduit: 女佣是怎么当上总管的？

original: Comes down to trust, I expect. After Dengeir gave up his seat to his nephew, he didn't trust anyone.
traduit: 我想这是信任问题吧。丹格尔把位子让给侄子以后就不再信任任何人了。

original: Everywhere he looks, he sees assassins, spies an' plots against him. I'm the only one he confides in.
traduit: 他随时随地都能看到刺客、奸细、阴谋。我成了他唯一可以倾诉的对象。

original: So, when he was made Jarl again, he didn't wait a moment to name me his Steward. He said I was the only choice.
traduit: 所以当他再次当上领主的时候，毫不犹豫地任命我当总管了。他说我是唯一的人选。

original: You sound nervous about being the new Steward.
traduit: 听起来你对当新总管很紧张啊。

original: I should think so! I'm well used to taking care of a house and the folk living in it.
traduit: 没错！我习惯了照顾一所房子和住在里面的人。

original: Taking care of the entire hold is another matter entirely. It would be a big enough job without the war on and the dragons about.
traduit: 但照顾好一个领地就是另一回事了。就算没有战争和龙族那工作量也够大了。

original: I just hope I can do right by the good folk who are looking to us to see to their needs.
traduit: 我只是希望我能善待那些需要我们满足他们的好人。

original: You said you were the Jarl once?
traduit: 你说你曾经是领主？

original: Aye, not so long ago. Some'll tell you I stepped down on account of my old age.
traduit: 嗯，不久之前。有人会跟你说，我是因为年纪大了才辞职的。

original: Truth is, I found out about all the Imperial spies crawling around Falkreath. A few well-placed bribes, and they bought themselves some friends.
traduit: 事实上，我发现了在佛克瑞斯周围活动的所有帝国奸细。只消几笔贿赂，他们就给自己买到了几个朋友。

original: Suddenly the nobles are calling for a new Jarl, and all the while their pockets are jingling with the sound of Imperial septims.
traduit: 突然之间，贵族们就开始呼吁换个新领主，他们所有人的口袋里都能听到塞普汀叮当作响。

original: They named me Thane, and they got my nephew Siddgeir in my place. A real friend to Cyrodiil, that one.
traduit: 他们给我一个武卫头衔，还让我侄子西德盖尔取代了我。那小子真是希罗帝尔的好朋友啊。

original: How are you a better Jarl than Siddgeir?
traduit: 你如何做个比西德盖尔好的领主呢？

original: For one thing, I won't empty Falkreath's coffers to buy myself fine clothes an' expensive mead.
traduit: 首先，我不会掏空佛克瑞斯的钱库给自己买漂亮衣服和昂贵的蜜酒。

original: For another, I won't get mixed up with criminals and other sorts who take advantage of the honest folk for profit.
traduit: 另外，我不会和罪犯以及其他利用善民牟利的人混在一起。

original: I might be old, but I haven't forgotten that a Jarl's first duty is to look after his people.
traduit: 我可能老了，但我没有忘记一个领主的首要职责就是照顾他的人民。

original: Why did you side with the Stormcloaks?
traduit: 你为什么支持风暴斗篷？

original: You think some Emperor sitting on a gilded throne in Cyrodiil is going to know what's best for Skyrim?
traduit: 你觉得某个坐在希罗帝尔镀金宝座上的皇帝会知道什么对天际是最好的吗？

original: The Imperial City's so far from here, it might as well be on one of the moons. And yet the Empire thinks it can tell us what to do an' how to live.
traduit: 帝都离这里太远了，和在月亮上没差。然而帝国却认为他们能够告诉我们该怎么做，该怎么生活。

original: I'm no man's fool. I know Ulfric Stormcloak's selfish and power-hungry, but he's the devil I know. Does that put it plain enough for you?
traduit: 我不是傻瓜。我知道乌弗瑞克·风暴斗篷自私且渴望权力，但至少这混球是自家人。这么说够清楚了吗？

original: You're a Stormcloak?
traduit: 你是风暴斗篷吗？

original: I was once, but not any more. I was wounded in a skirmish up near Windhelm. This was years ago, mind you.
traduit: 曾经是，现在不是了。我在风舵附近的战斗中负伤了。注意，这是几年前的事了。

original: Now, maybe I don't pick up a blade in Ulfric's name no more, but I still hold with his ideals. Skyrim is Nord land, and we ought to rule it.
traduit: 现在，也许我不再以乌弗瑞克的名义拿起武器，但我仍然坚持他的理想。天际是诺德人的，我们应该来统治它。

original: We don't need no help from the Empire on that count.
traduit: 我们不需要帝国的帮助。

original: You mentioned a brother? Who is he?
traduit: 你提到个兄弟？他是谁？

original: His name's Bolund. He's the one who works the lumber mill down by the river.
traduit: 他叫波伦德。在河边的木材厂工作。

original: If you meet him, don't expect much in the way o' conversation. He ain't one for talking, especially with folk he don't know.
traduit: 如果你见到他，不要对聊天抱什么希望。他三棍子打不出个屁，尤其是和陌生人的时候。

original: Sounds like loyalty is important to you.
traduit: 听起来你很看重忠诚啊。

original: I was Dengier's personal guard for years. I risked my hide more than once to protect him.
traduit: 我给丹格尔当过多年的侍卫。不止一次冒着风险保护了他。

original: Why would I do that? For money? Because I swore an oath? No, it was because he was a good man and a true friend.
traduit: 为什么我要这么做？为了钱吗？还是因为我发过誓？不，只是因为他是个好人，是真正的朋友。

original: A true Nord places loyalty and honor above all else.
traduit: 真正的诺德人会把忠诚和荣誉置于一切之上。

original: There aren't many Redguards in Skyrim. What brought you here?
traduit: 天际的红卫人不算多。什么风把你吹来了？

original: Well, my family back in Hammerfell didn't approve of my interest in lethal poisons and death in general. So I left, and wandered north.
traduit: 嗯，我在落锤的家人不赞成我研究致命毒药和死亡的兴趣。所以我离开了，向北流浪。

original: When I found this town, with its huge cemetery, I felt right at home. I opened the shop and I've never looked back. This is where I belong.
traduit: 当我找到这个小镇和这片巨大的墓地时，我就感觉像是到家了一样。我开了这家店，而且没有后悔过。这才是我的归宿。

original: Why name your store Grave Concoctions?
traduit: 为什么把店名叫做“坟墓调和物”？

original: I know it's a bit strange. Not exactly a name to bring comfort to the sick and ailing who come to buy a poultice or salve.
traduit: 我知道这听着有些怪。这个名字不太适合给那些买药的人带来安慰。

original: But what you must understand about Falkreath is that our town is defined, for better or wrose, by the large and ancient cemetery here.
traduit: 但关于佛克瑞斯，你必须明白，我们这个小镇无论好坏，都是由这里这座古老而巨大的墓地定义的。

original: That's why the inn is called Dead Man's Drink, the farm is called Corpselight Farm, and so on. I suppose it's sort of a running joke.
traduit: 这就是为什么酒馆叫做“亡者之饮”，农场叫“尸光农场”等等等等。我想这算是个流传很广的玩笑吧。

original: Yes, I put out the fire.
traduit: 是，我把火扑灭的。

original: That was good work. Deeja's in the hold of the ship. Go down two levels.
traduit: 干得不错。蒂亚在船舱里。往下走两层就到了。

original: You're the one who put out the fire in the Lighthouse, right?
traduit: 灯塔上的火是你熄灭的吧？

original: For once you'll actually pay for your crimes.
traduit: 这次你会为罪行付出代价。

original: Once again, the Empire takes the blame for the crimes of others.
