traduit: 帝国又一次替别人的罪行承担了责任。

original: To Oblivion with your loot! This ends now!
traduit: 带着你的战利品下湮灭去吧！结束了！

original: You don't have what it takes to kill me.
traduit: 你没本事杀我。

original: And now it's your turn.
traduit: 现在该你了。

original: That's a lot of work for such a little thing...
traduit: 就为了这么个小玩意儿费了我这么大劲……

original: Your mockery will be the end of you. And on that day, another servant will feast on your entrails and discover a ring clenched in her teeth.
traduit: 嘲笑最后只会毁了你。到时候，另一个仆人会吃掉你的内脏，然后发现嘴里有枚戒指。

original: Be grateful for what time I give you until then.
traduit: 珍惜我给你的时间吧。

original: Thank you, my Lady.
traduit: 多谢夫人。

original: Wallow in your wretchedness, my newest champion.
traduit: 沉浸在自己的不幸中吧，我的新勇士。

original: Mortal. I am Namira, the Lady of Decay. Your consumption of the blood and bile of Arkay's own is pleasing to me.
traduit: 凡人。我乃娜米拉，腐烂女士。你饮用了阿尔凯祭司的血与胆汁，我很欣慰。

original: I give you my ring. Wear it, and when you feast on the flesh of the dead, I will grant you my power.
traduit: 我将我的戒指给你。戴上它，当你享用死者的血肉时，我会赐予你力量。

original: Listen, when you're ready to do something useful, find me outside Haemar's Shame, in Falkreath.
traduit: 听着，等你准备好干点有用的事了，就去佛克瑞斯领的海玛之羞找我。

original: I cannot stay. Not here, not in Whiterun. It likely won't be safe for Avulstein, either.
traduit: 我不能在这里或者白漫城待着了。对阿武斯特恩也不安全。

original: Our best hope now is to fall in with the ranks of the Stormcloaks.
traduit: 我们现在最大的希望就是去加入风暴斗篷的队伍。

original: But would you do me a favor? Tell my mother to suffer the winter's cold wind, for it bears aloft next summer's seeds. She'll know what it means.
traduit: 但你能帮我个忙吗？告诉我母亲，“要忍耐冬日的寒风，只因它承载着来夏的种子”。她会明白这是什么意思的。

original: I thank you again, friend. You've given me my life back.
traduit: 再次感谢，朋友。你让我重获新生了。

original: I don't dare return to Whiterun. But my mother... She'll need some consolation.
traduit: 我不敢回白漫城了。但我母亲……应该安慰她一下。

original: Tell her... tell her to suffer the winter's cold wind, for it bears aloft next summer's seeds. She'll understand.
traduit: 告诉她……“要忍耐冬日的寒风，只因它承载着来夏的种子”。她会明白这是什么意思的。

original: Though shall mourn my brother, I thank you, friend. You've given me my life back.
traduit: 尽管我要哀悼我的兄弟，但我还是要谢谢你，朋友。你让我重获新生了。

original: I told him to wait in Whiterun.
traduit: 我告诉他在白漫等着。

original: A wise decision, but I fear he may not be safe there anymore.
traduit: 明智的觉得，但我担心他在那里可能不安全了。

original: They'll go looking for me, and Whiterun will be the first place they search.
traduit: 他们会去找我，而白漫就是他们第一个要搜查的地方。

original: So he might still be in there?
traduit: 所以他可能还在那儿？

original: I don't dare go back in now. I'll just have to hope that in the confusion he can slip out.
traduit: 我现在不敢回去。只希望他能在混乱中脱身。

original: He came in with me, but I'm not sure what happened to him.
traduit: 他和我一起来的，但我不确定他怎么样了。

original: Avulstein... you stupid boy...
traduit: 阿武斯特恩……你个傻小子……

original: What is my freedom worth, if the price is my brother's life?
traduit: 我的自由有什么价值，值我兄弟一条命？

original: He... didn't make it.
traduit: 他……没活下来。

original: Your family was concerned for you.
traduit: 你家人很担心你。

original: Of course. I should've known. Avulstein was behind this, wasn't he?
traduit: 当然。我知道。是阿武斯特恩出的主意，对吧？

original: Of course. I should've known. This was all Avulstein's idea, wasn't it? Where is he?
traduit: 当然。我知道。是阿武斯特恩出的主意，对吧？他在哪儿？

original: I'll see you at Northwatch Keep, friend.
traduit: 我们北望堡垒见，朋友。

original: Please, get word to my mother.
traduit: 拜托，给我母亲捎句话。

original: Let's go, let's go!
traduit: 我们走，我们走！

original: Tell me about this incense.
traduit: 跟我说说这个熏香。

original: Yes, the incense. Fetch for me a deathbell flower, one silver ingot, a flawless ruby, and some vampire dust. Then I will show you how.
traduit: 对，熏香。给我带一朵丧钟花、一块银锭、一颗无瑕红宝石，再加上吸血鬼灰烬。之后我来告诉你怎么做。

original: Ah, a wanderer, yes? No? Pilgrim, perhaps? Have you come to commune with Peryite, Taskmaster and blighted Lord?
traduit: 啊，旅行者吗？不是？那你是来朝圣的？是来和工头、枯萎之主魄伊特交流的吗？

original: May I commune with Peryite?
traduit: 我能和魄伊特交谈吗？

original: Not everyone has the stomach required to entreat my Lord. But Kesh likes you, friend. There is a way Peryite may speak to us who will take Him in.
traduit: 不是每个人都有向我主恳求的勇气。但凯石喜欢你，朋友。有个办法能让魄伊特跟我们这些愿意接受他的人说话。

original: If you wish to commune with Him, we'll need the incense.
traduit: 想要和他交流，就需要熏香。

original: Ah, no. Don't think you've got the stuff. Come back when you've seen a bit more in life, perhaps.
traduit: 啊，不，我不觉得你有那本事。或许，你应该等经历更丰富了再来。

original: Tell me about Peryite.
traduit: 跟我说说魄伊特。

original: He is the pus in the wound. Oh, proper ones curl their noses, but it's pus that drinks foul humors and restores the blood.
traduit: 他就是伤口上的脓液。哦，正常人自然对此嗤之以鼻。但恰恰是它能够吸收腐烂体液，再造新鲜血液。

original: I worship Peryite, yes, because sometimes the world can only be cleansed by disease.
traduit: 对，我信仰魄伊特。因为世界有时只能通过疾病来净化。

original: My guards told me. Poor Margret. And witnesses report that the attacker was shouting some nonsense about being a Forsworn.
traduit: 我的卫兵已经报告过了。可怜的玛格丽特。目击者说袭击者在大喊什么“弃誓者”之类的废话。

original: I want to make things clear. Markarth has its troubles, but there are no Forsworn in this city.
traduit: 事情得说清楚。马卡斯自有麻烦在此，但城里绝没有弃誓者。

original: They're only a threat in the hills and along the roads, where they live. Everywhere else, we are in control.
traduit: 他们确实在他们生活的山区和大路沿线构成了威胁。但在其他地方，我们才是掌控者。

original: It's unfortunate that we live in such violent times, but there you have it.
traduit: 不幸的是，我们生活在这样一个暴力遍布的时代，但事实就是如此。

original: Now I've been told that the attacker claimed to be a Forsworn. It's nonsense. More likely he was just sick in the head.
traduit: 有人跟我说，袭击者自称是弃誓者。纯属无稽之谈。大概率只是他头脑不清醒。

original: So don't concern yourself with it. Markarth is safe. You have my word.
traduit: 所以不要太在意了。马卡斯很安全。我可以向你保证。

original: It's quite the tale.
traduit: 这可费了一番周折了。

original: I undertstand. Now, let me take a good look at this. Over here, please.
traduit: 我理解。现在先让我好好看看这个。请在这儿稍等。

original: This should help translate Gallus's Journal.
traduit: 这应该能帮咱们翻译出加卢斯的日记。

original: I suppose it would be inappropriate of me to ask how you obtained this, so I simply won't.
traduit: 询问获得的方式好像不太合适。所以我也不问了。

original: A rubbing, eh? Odd. I expected notes.
traduit: 是拓片？奇怪，我还以为是笔记呢。

original: Another soul for the master!
traduit: 师傅又有灵魂了！

original: Hmm? What is it?
traduit: 嗯？怎么回事？

original: If I am to die today, so be it. But you'll not soon forget the Dark Brotherhood.
traduit: 如果我今天会死，那就死吧。但你不会这么快忘掉黑暗兄弟会的。

original: Go, boys! Attack!
traduit: 去吧，孩子们！杀！

original: I bring news of Thorald.
traduit: 我带来了索拉德的消息。

original: Hmm. Yes, it is quite sad. A young boy, Aventus Aretino, lost his mother recently, and was sent to an orphanage.
traduit: 嗯。对，太悲哀了。有个叫阿文图斯·艾瑞提诺的小男孩刚刚失去母亲，就被送去孤儿院了。

original: But he has returned home, and people have heard strange chanting. They say it's the Black Sacrament, the ritual to contact the Dark Brotherhood.
traduit: 但他回家了，人们还听到了奇怪的吟唱。他们说那是黑色圣礼，是用来联络黑暗兄弟会的仪式。

original: Why a little boy would want to contact a group of murderers is beyond me, but he is inviting evil into this city.
traduit: 真不明白一个小男孩为什么要联系一群杀人犯，但他肯定是要把邪恶引进这座城来。

original: Did I hear you say something about a cursed child?
traduit: 我听说有个孩子被诅咒了？

original: All right. I won't deny it, child. What you heard is true. But Aventus Aretino walks a dark path. His actions can lead only to ruin.
traduit: 好吧。孩子，我不否认。你听到的是真的。但阿文图斯·艾瑞提诺走上了一条黑暗的道路。他的行为只会招致毁灭。

original: Ha! Then I'm right. I knew it. He's trying to have somebody killed!
traduit: 哈！那我说对了。我就知道。他想杀人！

original: Oh, Grimvar... always with the nonsense. No, no, of course not. Those are just tales...
traduit: 哦，格瑞姆瓦……总是喜欢说些怪话。不，不，当然不是。那些都是传言……

original: Then it's true, what everyone is saying? That Aventus Aretino is doing the Black Sacrament? Trying to summon the Dark Brotherhood?
traduit: 那大家说的都是真的了？阿文图斯·艾瑞提诺在搞黑色圣礼？他想召唤黑暗兄弟会？

original: No, child! Wait! That boy, that house - they're cursed.
traduit: 不，孩子！那个男孩，那个房子，都被诅咒了。

original: Fine. Then I'll invite him out to play. He lives right there. I'm going to knock on his door...
traduit: 太好了。那我去邀他出来玩。他就住在那里，我去敲门……

original: They don't have to be perfect. Just send them over when they're ready.
traduit: 它们不需要多完美。等准备好就送来。

original: I can only hammer so fast, Gerdur.
traduit: 我只能这么快了，歌尔朵。

original: Are those parts ready yet?
traduit: 那些零件准备好了吗？

original: Now. Enough. We will speak no more of this. I am the only friend you need.
traduit: 现在。够了。不要再谈这件事了。你唯一需要的朋友就是我。

original: Who are you talking about?
traduit: 你在说谁？

original: Faralda. Don't act like she didn't say anything. I know her, I know what she's been up to.
traduit: 法劳达。别装作她什么都没说。我了解她，知道她在做什么。

original: It's lies. All of it. I don't care what she told you, it's all lies.
traduit: 那是谎言。全部都是。不管她跟你说了什么，都是谎言。

original: Is there any advice you can give about Destruction spells?
traduit: 有什么关于毁灭系法术的建议吗？

original: Certainly. Destruction spells come in different forms, each useful for various purposes.
traduit: 当然有。毁灭法术形式不一，用途也有差别。

original: Concentration spells can be cast immediately, though they're weaker. Good for a tight spot, and less costly if you miss.
traduit: 集束型法术释放速度快，但威力较弱。适合用于你错失更好时机的紧张关头。

original: You'll also need to decide whether to devote yourself to a single type of spell.
traduit: 你还需要决定是否专注于一类法术。

original: Focusing solely on flame spells will make them more powerful, but you may find yourself at a disadvantage against foes immune to fire.
traduit: 专注于火焰法术自然能使它们更加强大，可一旦遇到免疫火焰的敌人，你就处于劣势了。

original: Which are the best Illusion spells?
traduit: 最好的幻术是什么？

original: Oh my, that's quite a difficult question.
traduit: 哦，天啊，这问题可不好回答。

original: Never underestimate the ability to influence others. Whether they're friends or foes, they're almost all susceptible to Illusion spells.
traduit: 永远不要低估影响他人的能力。无论是敌是友，都很容易受幻术系法术的影响。

original: They can turn the tide of a battle in a moment's notice.
traduit: 可以瞬间扭转战局。

original: There are also spells that help in avoiding conflict altogether. Invisibility is tricky to master, but exceptionally useful.
traduit: 也有一些法术可以帮你规避正面冲突。隐身术虽然难以掌握，但非常有用。

original: I... No, I can't see you. Not at all.
traduit: 我……不，我看不到你。完全看不到。

original: But you can hear me, obviously. Something still isn't quite right. At least I'm making progress.
traduit: 但很明显你能听见我说话。还有地方不太对。不过至少我在进步了。

original: Of course I can.
traduit: 我当然能看到。

original: Confound it all. I was quite sure I was invisible, or at least transparent.
traduit: 全乱了。我肯定是隐形了啊，至少应该是透明的才对。

original: You... You can see me?
traduit: 你……你能看见我？

original: And finally, there's Colette. She may be... difficult to get along with, she's very knowledgeable when it comes to Restoration magic.
traduit: 还有柯莱特。她可能……很难相处，但对恢复系魔法很在行。

original: If you can find him and focus his attention, there's a great deal Drevis can teach you about Illusion magic.
traduit: 德莱维斯可以教你很多幻术系的知识，前提是你能找到他然后引起他的注意。

original: Don't let Tolfdir fool you; he's the pre-eminent scholar on Alteration. One of the best in Tamriel, and always willing to pass on his knowledge.
traduit: 别被小瞧托夫迪尔，他是变化系的杰出学者。也算是泰姆瑞尔这方面最好的之一了，而且总是愿意传授自己的知识。

original: Phinis is one of the best Conjurers in all of Skyrim, and can help with spells from that school.
traduit: 菲尼斯是天际最优秀的召唤师之一，可以教你召唤系法术。

original: Faralda can teach Destruction spells, and offers training in that school.
traduit: 法劳达可以教授毁灭系魔法，而且在学院提供训练课程。

original: Where can I learn new spells?
traduit: 我在哪儿能学新法术？

original: Well, that depends on what you're looking for.
traduit: 哦，那得看你想学什么了。

original: Why do Nords have a problem with the College?
traduit: 诺德人为什么对学院有意见？

original: Well, look at the evidence. Nords generally don't trust magic, so it's not off to a good start.
traduit: 哎，看看吧。诺德人一般都不相信魔法，所以开端就不太好。

original: Throw in the Oblivion Crisis, which was caused by magic-users, and the troubles now with the Aldmeri Dominion, who are elves and magic users.
traduit: 而湮灭危机又是使用魔法的人引起的，再加上现在和先祖神洲的争端，谁叫他们又是精灵又是使魔法的呢。

original: And finally take the fact that the College is the only thing left standing after most of Winterhold was destroyed. It's all fairly damning.
traduit: 最关键的是，在冬堡城大部分被摧毁的时候，只有学院幸存下来。这一切促成了现在的厌恶。

original: Is it difficult being so far away from the rest of your family?
traduit: 离开家人这么远很困难吧？

original: Not at all. I consider it a blessing.
traduit: 还好吧。我觉得这是好事。

original: My family was convinced coming here was a death sentence, or worse. It took years of insisting that this is what I'm meant to do.
traduit: 我家里人觉得来这儿和判了死刑差不多，甚至更糟。我坚持了很多年，才得到了想要的。

original: Why aren't there many Nords at the College?
traduit: 学院里有很多诺德人吗？

original: Magic is shunned by most. If it can't be swung over your head and used to crack skulls, most Nords want nothing to do with it.
traduit: 他们大多都很避讳魔法。如果不能用来敲碎头骨，那大多数诺德人是不屑一顾的。

original: Magic is seen as something for elves, and weaker races.
traduit: 魔法被看做是精灵和弱小种族才会用的东西。

original: I didn't think you'd get pinched.
traduit: 我没想到你会被抓。

original: Can't say I'm surprised with the way things have been going around here.
traduit: 对这里发生的一切我也没感到惊讶。

original: And here you go... your payment, just as I promised.
traduit: 来给你……说好的报酬。

original: The way things have been going around here, it's a relief that our plan went off without a hitch.
traduit: 从这里发生的事情来看，我们的计划进行的很顺利，真是令人欣慰。

original: Why side with the Empire?
traduit: 为什么要站在帝国一边？

original: Mutual advantage! Any fool can see that.
traduit: 优势互补！傻子都能看出来。

original: For centuries, we have benefited from the Empire's protection, and prosperous trade with the south.
traduit: 千百年来，我们一直受益于帝国的保护，以及和南方的繁荣贸易。

original: In exchange, the people of Cyrodiil sleep peacefully, knowing their northern border is guarded by the fiercest warriors in all Tamriel.
traduit: 作为交换，希罗帝尔的人们可以安心入眠，因为他们知道北部的边界正被泰姆瑞尔最凶悍的战士保卫着。

original: What school of magic are you studying?
traduit: 你在研究什么魔法学派？

original: Is it difficult being away from your family?
traduit: 离开家人会觉得很艰难吗？

original: Mages in Cyrodiil are all about politics. The Synod and the College of Whispers are too busy guarding secrets to bother to teach.
traduit: 希罗帝尔的法师醉心政治。希诺和低语学院都在忙于遮掩秘密，根本无心教学。

original: Skyrim was not J'zargo's first choice, but Winterhold is removed from politics, dedicated to study. This is the place for J'zargo to become great.
traduit: 天际不是杰'扎格的首选，但冬堡学院远离政治，致力研究。这才是能让杰'扎格变强的地方。

original: Why did you become a student at the College?
traduit: 你为什么来学院就读？

original: So far, if only because no one is telling me how great I ought to be.
traduit: 目前为止还行吧，因为没人会催着我变得多好多好。

original: I just want to learn, I don't want to think about what's expected of me.
traduit: 我只是想要学习，不想整日应对别人的期望。

original: Do you like it here at the College?
traduit: 你喜欢学院吗？

original: How do you know so much about mead?
traduit: 你怎么这么懂蜜酒的？

original: A lifetime of study, you might say. The best comes from Riften, but I haven't been there in years.
traduit: 你可以当是一辈子的研究吧。最好的蜜酒是裂谷城产的，但我很多年没去过了。

original: Ever tried making your own? It's... not easy. Trust me.
traduit: 你有试过自己做吗？不过……不容易。相信我。

original: Are things not going well for you?
traduit: 你的情况不太好吗？

original: We got the mill up and running before we found out that the big stand of trees on the hill was sacred.
traduit: 在我们发现山上那些树是神树前，我们就把木材厂修好了。

original: Now we can't cut them, and can't afford to buy another mill somewhere else.
traduit: 现在不能砍树，又没钱在别的地方再盖木材厂。

original: So we scrounge whatever we can from around the tundra.
traduit: 所以我们只能在冻土带附近搜刮搜刮。

original: What can you tell me about Kynesgrove?
traduit: 你能跟我说说凯娜之林吗？

original: A bunch of lazy rabble trying to make a living. Can't get better workers in because everyone's afraid of the tomb up above the mine.
traduit: 一群想要谋生的懒虫。不过也找不到更好的工人了，大家都害怕矿场上面的坟冢。

original: Dead dragons... it hasn't moved since Ysgramor and it's not going to start now. Superstitious milk drinkers.
traduit: 里面埋着死龙……不过自打伊斯格拉默开始就没动过，现在也不会。一群迷信的懦夫。

original: So it seems the milk drinkers were right. That dragon was nearly the death of us.
traduit: 看来那些懦夫是对的。那头龙差点害死我们。

original: All we can do now is rebuild.
traduit: 我们现在能做的也只有重建了。

original: What can you tell me about Darkwater Crossing?
traduit: 你能和我说说暗水岔口吗？

original: Not much to it, really. We fish, and keep to ourselves. Try to keep from upsetting the Empire or the Stormcloaks, and so far the war's left us alone.
traduit: 没什么可说的。我们在这里打渔谋生，不和外人来往。也尽量不惹上帝国或是风暴斗篷，到现在我们还没被战争波及到。

original: Those falls... dangerous place. Derkeethus thought he could find some good fish in the pools.
traduit: 那些瀑布……很危险。德吉图斯说能在那边的池塘找到好鱼。

original: Haven't heard from him in a long while.
traduit: 但好久没听到他的消息了。

original: Has the war affected you?
traduit: 战争对你们有影响吗？

original: I'm lucky enough that none of my friends have been killed. Of course we have soldiers coming through all the time.
traduit: 我还算比较走运，没有朋友死于战争。当然，我们这里经常有士兵路过。

original: That's better. Now scurry off, my little guttersnipes.
traduit: 这就好。快走吧，我的小流浪儿们。

original: Yes, Grelod.
traduit: 是，桂罗。

original: Those who shirk their duties will get an extra beating. Do I make myself clear?
traduit: 胆敢逃避责任的会额外挨打。我讲清楚了吗？

original: We love you, Grelod. Thank you for your kindness.
traduit: 我们爱您，桂罗。谢谢您的善意。

original: Now, what do you all say?
traduit: 现在，你们该说什么？

original: That, my darlings, is why you're here. Why you will always be here, until the day you come of age and get thrown into that wide, horrible world.
traduit: 亲爱的孩子们，这就是你们来这里的原因。你们会一直待在这里，直到成年的那一天，被扔进那个广阔、可怕的世界。

original: And one more thing! I will hear no more talk of adoptions! None of you riff-raff is getting adopted. Ever! Nobody needs you, nobody wants you.
traduit: 还有一件事！别再和我说什么领养了！你们这些渣滓都不可能被收养！没人需要你们，也没人会想领你们。

original: Aventus Aretino. He was sent to live here after his mother died. He escaped. And...
traduit: 阿文图斯·艾瑞提诺。他母亲死了以后被送到这里。他逃走了。而且……

original: Before he left, he said he was going to do the Black Sacrament. You know, to call the Dark Brotherhood. So they'd come and kill old Grelod!
traduit: 他离开前，说他会执行黑色圣礼。就是召唤黑暗兄弟会。所以他们会来杀掉老桂罗！

original: Word out on the street is that he went home to Windhelm, and people have heard strange chanting coming from his house. He's really doing it!
traduit: 街上有消息说，他回到了风舵城的家里，人们听到他家里传出奇怪的诵经声。他真的在做了！

original: Who is Aventus?
traduit: 阿文图斯是谁？

original: Word out on the street is that he went home to Windhelm, and people have heard strange chanting coming from his house. Looks like he really did it!
traduit: 街上有消息说，他回到了风舵城的家里，人们听到他家里传出奇怪的诵经声。他真的做到了！

original: A little boy who lived here. Aventus Aretino. He was nice, but really quiet, and sad, because his mother just died.
traduit: 一个住在这里的小男孩。阿文图斯·艾瑞提诺。他人很好，但太安静了，而且很伤心，因为他母亲刚去世。

original: He ran away. Back home to Windhelm. Samuel told me he's trying to get some murderer people to come here and kill Grelod. I really hope he does.
traduit: 他逃走了。回了风舵城的家里。萨穆埃尔告诉我他正在试着找杀手来杀桂罗。我真希望他能成功。

original: He ran away. Back home to Windhelm. Samuel told me he was trying to get some murderer people to come here and kill Grelod. Did he really do it?
traduit: 他逃走了。回了风舵城的家里。萨穆埃尔告诉我他正在试着找杀手来杀桂罗。他真的成功了吗？

original: Oh, Aventus Aretino. He was sent here when his mother died, but he ran away.
traduit: 哦，阿文图斯·艾瑞提诺。他母亲死了以后被送到这里，但他逃走了。

original: I heard he went back to his house in Windhelm, and is trying to get the Dark Brotherhood to come and murder Grelod. That would be so wonderful.
traduit: 我听说他回了他在风舵城的家，想让黑暗兄弟会来杀桂罗。那可太好了。

original: I heard he went back to his house in Windhelm, to try and get the Dark Brotherhood to come and murder Grelod. And... he actually pulled it off!
traduit: 我听说他回了他在风舵城的家，想让黑暗兄弟会来杀桂罗。而且……他真的成功了！

original: Aventus Aretino? He only lived here for awhile. I think his mother got sick and died or something. Anyway, he's gone now. He ran away.
traduit: 阿文图斯·艾瑞提诺？他只在这里住过一阵。他妈妈好像是病死了。不管怎么样，他已经离开了。逃跑了。

original: But Samuel told me he's back home in Windhelm, and is doing some kind of dark ritual. He's trying to summon some killers to come get old Grelod.
traduit: 萨穆埃尔告诉我他回了在风舵城的家，正在举行什么黑暗仪式。他想叫杀手来杀掉老桂罗。

original: But Samuel told me he's back home in Windhelm, and did some kind of dark ritual. He summoned killers to murder old Grelod. He's saved us all.
traduit: 萨穆埃尔告诉我他回了在风舵城的家，正在举行什么黑暗仪式。他让杀手来杀掉老桂罗。他救了我们大家。

original: I'll be at the market come morning. You better be there too.
traduit: 明早我要去市场，你最好也来。

original: I'm ready when you are. Just give the word.
traduit: 我随时等你准备好。说一声就行。

original: That amount should allow me to readily acquire a drink.
traduit: 这个量够我喝一杯了。

original: You should try that bit on the barkeep. Maybe get yourself a free drink.
traduit: 你应该取找老板试试，看看能不能拿杯免费的。

original: It was quite a trip. Where are we?
traduit: 相当不错的旅行。我们这是在哪儿？

original: I thought you might not remember your first trip here. You had a big night. I think you've definitely earned the staff.
traduit: 我以为你不记得第一次来这里的事了。你那晚玩儿的很爽。我觉得你有资格拿到法杖。

original: Tell me more about your people.
traduit: 跟我说说你的族人吧。

original: We have lived in Skyrim since before the Nords came. Our way is simple, all work to make the tribe strong.
traduit: 我们在诺德人到来前就住在天际了。我们的生活方式很简单，一切为了壮大部落。

original: Only the bravest are allowed to lead, and to marry. A great chief is able to attract many wives and raise bold children.
traduit: 只有最勇敢的人才被允许领导大家并享有婚配。强大的酋长能吸引很多妻子，养育勇敢的孩子。

original: Wise women like myself are mothers of chieftains. We guide the tribe and advice our kin on what is most pleasing to Malacath.
traduit: 像我这样的智妪都是酋长的母亲。我们指导部落，教导族人怎样博取玛拉凯斯欢心。

original: Your weapons and armor are impressive.
traduit: 你的武器和护甲真是不错。

original: It is said that an Orc first learns to wield a hammer in her mother's womb.
traduit: 俗话都说兽人打娘胎里就学会抡大锤了。

original: By tradition, a mother always teaches her children how to smith. If a chief has a second wife, she is called the "Forge-wife" in honor of this.
traduit: 按照传统，母亲都会教导孩子们如何锻造。如果酋长娶了第二位妻子，她就会被称为“锻妻”来纪念这一习俗。

original: How do the Orcs govern themselves?
traduit: 兽人是怎么管理自己的？

original: The Code of Malacath. It is both tradition and law in the strongholds. Break the code, and you must pay Blood Price.
traduit: 《玛拉凯斯法典》，这是要塞的传统和律法。打破法典，就要支付“血价”。

original: The code is not written anywhere. It is known and carried on by the Orcs, and all who live in the strongholds follow it.
traduit: 法典不是写在纸上的东西。每个兽人都知道并传承着它，所有住在要塞里的人都要遵守它。

original: For an outlander, following it is simple. Do not steal or attack anyone in the stronghold, or be ready to pay in gold or blood.
traduit: 对于外来者，条文其实很简单。不要偷盗，不要攻击要塞里的人，否则就准备好金子或者鲜血来偿还。

original: Who is Malacath?
traduit: 玛拉凯斯是谁？

original: He is our creator and master. The Daedric Lord of the Sworn Oath and the Bloody Curse.
traduit: 他是我们的创造者和主。背弃誓言与血腥诅咒的迪德拉君王。

original: Malacath teaches us to honor all words with action. To demand blood from your enemies and strength from your allies.
traduit: 玛拉凯斯教导我们用行动来荣耀一切言语。向敌人索取鲜血，向盟友索取力量。

original: He watches over all Orcs as his children. A truth those who leave the stronghold are quick to forget.
traduit: 他把所有兽人视为孩子。离开要塞的人很容易忘记这个真理。

original: Thank you! Thank you! I'll never speak of this to anyone, I promise!
traduit: 谢谢！谢谢！我不会跟任何人说这件事的，我保证！

original: (Cut the captive's bonds)
traduit: （割断俘虏的绳索）

original: Well it's about damn time. Capturing a woman from her home, keeping her bound like an animal. Ridiculous...
traduit: 真是太糟糕了。把一个女人从家里抓走，像个动物一样绑起来。可笑……

original: Ah, you see? That wasn't so hard, now was it? Let's the two of us just forget we ever met, hmm?
traduit: 啊，你看。没那么难吧？我们两个就权当没见过面吧。怎么样？

original: Please! Release me! Cut my bonds!
traduit: 求你了！放了我吧！给我松绑！

original: You cut these bindings this minute! You hear me? You cut these bindings right now!
traduit: 马上把绳子解开！听见了吗？现在就把绳子解开！

original: Come now, my friend. Haven't we played this game long enough? Untie me, and we can all go our separate ways.
traduit: 行了，朋友。游戏还没玩儿够吗？给我松绑，然后各走各路吧。

original: Thank Shor I have a lot of years before I have to worry about that!
traduit: 多谢舒尔，我还得些年才会担心这个呢！

original: She'll make a fine wife someday.
traduit: 她会成为一个好妻子的。

original: Aye. She's helping me in the house, and even helps her father at the forge.
traduit: 嗯。她帮我做家务，甚至还在铁匠铺帮她父亲。

original: It seems like Dorthe grows a head taller every season.
traduit: 朵西看着每季都要长高一头啊。

original: So that's a no I take it?
traduit: 这么说你是拒绝了？

original: Drunk again, Embry? Don't let Alvor hear you talking to me that way. He'll stick your head in his forge.
traduit: 安伯瑞你又喝醉了？别让阿尔沃听见你和我说这话。他会把你脑袋塞进他锻炉里的。

original: Care to have a drink with me, sweet Sigrid?
traduit: 愿意跟我喝一杯吗，亲爱的西格利？

original: Woman, you'll be the death of me yet. Fine, take your time. I'll just die of thirst in the heat of this forge.
traduit: 女人，你快把我害死了。好吧，慢慢来，把我渴死在锻炉边上得了。

original: Don't you sweet talk me, Alvor. Not after last night. I'll bring you water when I'm done with my other chores.
traduit: 别用甜言蜜语哄我，阿尔沃。昨晚以后就不行了。等我干完其他杂物再给你拿水。

original: Sigrid! Love of my life! When you get a spare moment, I could use some water.
traduit: 西格利！我一生的挚爱！有空的话给我端杯水吧。

original: I've been looking for you.
traduit: 我找你很久了。

original: Very well. What does Azura need?
traduit: 很好。阿祖拉需要什么？

original: You must go to a fortress, endangered by water, yet untouched by it.
traduit: 你必须前往一座被水所围，但尚未完全沉没的堡垒。

original: Inside, you will find an elven mage who can turn the brightest star as black as night.
traduit: 里面有个精灵法师能够将明亮的星辰变成如夜般漆黑。

original: It is cryptic, I know, but Azura's signs are never wrong. I believe the fortress may refer to Winterhold. Ask if they know this elven enchanter.
traduit: 我知道这很含糊。但阿祖拉的指示从不会错。我觉得这个堡垒说的是冬堡。去问问那里的人认不认识这个精灵附魔师。

original: "Seen my coming"? What do you mean?
traduit: “看到我的到来”？什么意思？

original: Azura has given me the gift of foresight. I had a vision of you walking up the steps to this altar long before you were born.
traduit: 阿祖拉赋予我预见的天赋。早在你出生前，我就看到了你走上祭坛的启示。

original: You have been chosen to be her champion. I know it is unexpected, but do not worry. It will all unfold as she has predicted.
traduit: 你被选为了她的勇士。我知道这很意外，但不要担心，一切都会如她预言所说的进行。

original: Calcelmo's orders- no one gets through to the tower. Kill any intruders on sight. Call for backup if you need to.
traduit: 卡塞莫的命令，任何人不能进入塔楼。杀死任何视线内的入侵者。如果需要，立刻呼叫救援。

original: Ha ha ha ha ha ha ha!
traduit: 哈哈哈哈哈哈哈！

original: But the staff is broken.
traduit: 但是法杖坏了。

original: Details, details. The Sanguine Rose breaks all the time and is fixed with but a thought.
traduit: 小意思，小意思。血腥玫瑰总是会坏，修它也就是个念头的事儿。

original: In fact, here it is now. Think of it - a never-ending stream of minions. And all of the prestige of being Sanguine's chosen.
traduit: 事实上，它就在这儿。想想吧，一群不知疲惫的仆从。还有被桑吉恩选中的荣誉。

original: I am Sanguine, Daedric Prince of Debauchery!
traduit: 桑吉恩，放荡的迪德拉君王！

original: I know, I know, how could I lie to you? Well, how could I trust you until we've shared a few drinks?
traduit: 我知道，我知道。不喝几杯咱们是无法信任彼此的。

original: But it wasn't long before I realized you'd make a more interesting bearer of my not-quite-holy staff than this waste of flesh.
traduit: 但没过多久，我就意识到，比起白白放浪形骸，你更适合成为我那根不怎么神圣的法杖的有趣传人。

original: I'll go back to the Orphanage in a while. I'll give them time to, you know... clean up the mess.
traduit: 我一会儿就回孤儿院去。总得给他们些时间……收拾残局。

original: Someone lied. Someone told the guard poor Cicero did something he did not. We were detained, delayed! The Night Mother kept from her new home!
traduit: 有人撒谎了。有人向卫兵污蔑了可怜的西塞罗。我们就被耽搁了，被耽搁了！夜母离她的新家又远了！

original: But you wouldn't know anything about that, would you? Hmmm? No. No... Of course not. Because then Cicero would get angry, and that would be... ugly.
traduit: 但你一无所知对吧？不。不……当然不。因为西塞罗会生气的，那样很……丑陋。

original: Now Loreius. Loreius has learned the meaning of ugly.
traduit: 现在罗瑞尤斯。罗瑞尤斯知道丑字怎么写了。

original: I lost Madesi's ring.
traduit: 我把玛德希的戒指搞丢了。

original: Lost it? Well, at least you showed signs of initiative by telling me.
traduit: 搞丢了？好吧，至少你主动告诉我了。

original: I guess I shouldn't be surprised with the way things are going around here.
traduit: 我想我也不该对这里的事感到惊讶。

original: Yamarz has demanded we stay inside the walls. We cannot leave.
traduit: 亚马兹命令我们待在围墙内。我们不能离开。

original: I must petition Malacath for relief. This curse must be lifted.
traduit: 我必须向玛拉凯斯恳求救赎。这个诅咒必须被解除。

original: But I cannot travel to Malacath's shrine. The ritual must be done here, and I do not have the materials I need.
traduit: 但我没法去玛拉凯斯的祭坛。仪式必须在这里进行，可是我缺乏仪式需要的素材。

original: I beg of you, can you bring me Troll Fat and a Daedra Heart? I have no wish to depend on a stranger, but I have no choice.
traduit: 算我求你，给我带点巨魔脂肪，还要一颗迪德拉之心，可以吗？我也不想依赖陌生人，但我别无选择。

original: Beware! The World-Eater waits within the mist!
traduit: 小心！世界吞噬者在迷雾中等待！

original: There is no escape. Courage is useless.
traduit: 逃不掉了。勇气也是无用的。

original: None may pass this perilous bridge 'til I judge them worthy by the warrior's test.
traduit: 在通过我的勇士考验判断价值前，无人可以通过这座危险的桥。

original: Living or dead, by decree of Shor, none may pass this perilous bridge 'til I judge them worthy by the warrior's test.
traduit: 按舒尔敕令，无论生者亡灵，在通过我的勇士考验判断价值前，无人可以通过这座危险的桥。

original: What brings you, wayfarer grim, to wander here, in Sovngarde, souls-end, Shor's gift to honored dead?
traduit: 冷酷的旅者，你因何来到这灵魂之终点，舒尔赐予荣耀死者之地——松加德？

original: Find... Paratus... in Oculory...
traduit: 去找……帕拉图斯……在汇光之睛……

original: [coughing]
traduit: （咳嗽声）

original: Crystal....  gone...
traduit: 水晶……不见了……

original: We have to find another way out of here before the place fills with water!
traduit: 我们得在这里被水淹没之前找到出路！

original: No luck there, lass. Something must have fallen on the other side of the door because it isn't moving!
traduit: 运气不佳，姑娘。有什么东西掉在门的另一边，把门堵死了！

original: Damn! This place is coming down! Quick, get the Skeleton Key and the Eye and lets get out of here!
traduit: 该死！这地方快塌了！快，把万能钥匙和伐莫之眼拿到手，我们得离开这里！

original: I have all the things needed to repair it.
traduit: 我找到了修理它所需的东西。

original: Oh, the Hagraven feather and so on. You can throw all those out.  You see...
traduit: 啊，乌鸦鬼婆羽毛什么的。你可以都扔了……

original: I'd like to know more about the College's history.
traduit: 我想进一步了解学院历史。

original: I've seen documents dating back to the late Second Era. Beyond that, it's hard to say.
traduit: 我阅读过的文件最早可以追溯到第二纪元晚期。在此之前就难说了。

original: Events in the last several hundred years resulted in a significant loss of our history, I'm afraid.
traduit: 过去几百年的事恐怕导致了我们自己历史的重大损失。

original: The Great Collapse, as it has come to be known.
traduit: 众所周知的“大坍陷”。

original: An unfortunate natural disaster that ravaged the area. The College fared far better than the city of Winterhold, but it was not left untouched.
traduit: 这场不幸的自然灾害席卷了这个地区。学院的情况比冬堡城区要好些，但也没有幸免。

original: What happened in the last few hundred years?
traduit: 过去几百年发生什么了？

original: No one is sure of the cause. Some believed the eruption of Red Mountain had far-reaching consequences that were only felt years later.
traduit: 原因无人知晓。有些人觉得是因为红山爆发产生的深远影响，只不过几年之后才显现出来。

original: I know there are some who have blamed the College, said that we were responsible. I assure you this is not the case.
traduit: 我知道有些人指责学院，觉得我们应该为此负责。但我保证这绝非真相。

original: What caused the Great Collapse?
traduit: 大坍陷的起因是什么？

original: Take this with our gratitude.
traduit: 请收下我们的谢礼。

original: Do you work for the meadery?
traduit: 你在蜜酒庄工作？

original: Sure. How do you think I get my hands on the good stuff and offer it so cheap? You think old Maven is just giving it away to anyone?
traduit: 没错。不然你以为我是怎么弄到这么好还这么便宜的东西的？你觉得老玛雯会轻易把它给别人吗？

original: Good thing she makes so much money. Makes it easier for merchandise like this to fall through the cracks.
traduit: 幸好她买卖大赚得多。这样一来这样的商品就更容易漏网了。

original: No thanks.
traduit: 不了，谢谢。

original: Suit yourself. If you change your mind, I'll be around.
traduit: 随你便，如果你想好了，我就在你身边。

original: Sure, I'll take one. (Pay 10 gold)
traduit: 行啊，来一瓶。（支付10金币）

original: Here you go. Oh, and keep it quiet. This stuff isn't exactly easy to get a hold of at these prices, if you catch my drift.
traduit: 给你。对，别声张。你得明白，在这种价格下弄到这些东西可不容易。

original: What are you selling?
traduit: 你卖什么？

original: Sorry, fresh out. Maybe next time.
traduit: 抱歉了，刚卖完。下次吧。

original: Are you selling any more Black-Briar Mead?
traduit: 你还有黑棘蜜酒卖吗？

original: Absolutely. Did you still want to buy one?
traduit: 当然有。你还想要？

original: Nothing but the best. Black-Briar Mead... fresh from the vat.
traduit: 最上好的，黑棘蜜酒……刚从桶里打上来的。

original: Best of all, you don't have to pay the ridiculous prices Maven charges. So what do you say to that?
traduit: 而且你不用支付玛雯定下的高价。你看怎么样？

original: Tell me about your parents.
traduit: 跟我说说你的父母。

original: My father was a Stormcloak soldier in his younger days. Now he just walks the streets spewing his hatred and propaganda.
traduit: 我父亲年轻的时候是个风暴斗篷士兵。现在他只会在大街上散布他的仇恨和口号。

original: My mother is the Priestess of Talos. She tends to the shrine and teaches his ways. I'm just not so sure she's delivering the right message.
traduit: 我母亲是塔洛斯祭司。她经常去祭坛，传播他的教义。我只是不确定她传达的信息是否正确。

original: May I ask why you're in mourning?
traduit: 我能问问你在为谁服丧吗？

original: It was my sister, Lilija. She served as a Battle Maiden with the Stormcloaks.
traduit: 是我妹妹，莉莉雅。她曾经是风暴斗篷的战地护士。

original: We recently heard she'd been killed... I... I find it difficult to talk about. Perhaps you'd be better off speaking to my parents about it.
traduit: 我们最近听说她战死了……我……我觉得这件事不好说。或许你最好去和我父母谈这件事。

original: Anyway, I'm glad my work at the Black-Briar Meadery keeps me busy. Helps me keep my mind off of things.
traduit: 不管怎样，我很高兴黑棘蜜酒庄让我保持忙碌的状态，不去想这些事。

original: What happened to your daughter?
traduit: 你女儿怎么了？

original: Lilija joined the Stormcloaks many years ago, when the first of the skirmishes broke out across Skyrim. I was so proud of her.
traduit: 莉莉雅许多年前就加入了风暴斗篷，当时天际才刚刚爆发小规模冲突。我为她感到骄傲。

original: She served as a Battle Maiden, using her healing arts to help those that fell on the battlefield. Never even lifted a blade in her life.
traduit: 她作为战地护士用自己的治疗技能帮助那些在战场上倒下的人们。她这辈子连刀都没拿过。

original: It didn't matter. The Imperial soldiers cut her down... killed her like a dog and left her body to rot in the mud.
traduit: 但这并不重要。帝国兵把她砍倒，像杀一条狗一样把她杀死了，让她的尸体倒在烂泥中腐烂。

original: And that's why I won't rest easy until every single Imperial soldier joins her, and Ulfric sits upon the throne of Skyrim.
traduit: 这就是我为什么不会轻易安歇，我要等到所有帝国兵都下去陪她，等到乌弗瑞克登上天际的宝座。

original: I trained our daughter Lilija as a healer... to one day tend the Shrine of Talos and replace me as a Priestess of Talos.
traduit: 我训练我们的女儿莉莉雅成为治疗师……希望她能去照看塔洛斯祭坛，取代我成为塔洛斯祭司。

original: When the fighting began over the White-Gold Concordat, she ran off to join the Stormcloaks. She had her father's fire, how could I say no?
traduit: 当白金协定签订，战斗开始后，她跑去加入了风暴斗篷。她和她父亲一样热血，我怎么能拒绝呢？

original: She died out there, only having tended to the wounded soldiers for a few months. We never even found her body... the Empire burned all the dead.
traduit: 她只照顾了伤员几个月就死了。我们甚至都没找到她的尸体……帝国把所有死者都烧了。

original: Why all the hatred for the Empire?
traduit: 为什么这么恨帝国？

original: They mean to take our history and crush it all in the name of some damn treaty.
traduit: 他们想以某个该死的条约的名义夺走并摧毁我们的历史。

original: The soil beneath our feet is steeped in the blood of our ancestors. We've fought for this land and... died for it.
traduit: 我们脚下的土地，浸透了我们祖先的鲜血。我们为这片土地而战……为它而死。

original: I lost my own daughter to the Imperial dogs, and by Talos I'll not lose anyone else!
traduit: 我的女儿被帝国狗害死了，我再也不想失去任何人了！

original: Talos is part of our culture. He's part of our heritage and our tradition. He's Skyrim personified.
traduit: 塔洛斯是我们文化的一部分。他是我们的遗产和传统。他是天际的化身。

original: To suddenly have all that wrenched away is like losing someone you hold dearly in your heart.
traduit: 突然就失去这一切，就像失去了一个深爱着你的人。

original: The Empire already took my daughter from us, but by Talos they will not take our homeland!
traduit: 帝国已经夺走了我的女儿，但塔洛斯在上，他们夺不走我们的家园！

original: What's the word around town?
traduit: 这城里有什么传言吗？

original: Riften's biggest exports used to be fishing and honey, until the Black-Briar family moved in. Now the meadery is the biggest game in town.
traduit: 在黑棘家族搬进来之前，裂谷城最大的出口商品是鱼和蜂蜜。现在蜜酒庄成了镇上最大的生意。

original: The Thieves Guild has been pushing hard to regain a foothold in this city. Rumor has it they're falling apart from the inside.
traduit: 盗贼公会一直在努力争取重新在城里立足。有传言说他们正在分崩离析。

original: The city guard has been tearing Riften apart looking for the source of our skooma problem. I'd hate to be in their shoes if they get discovered.
traduit: 城市卫兵为了找到斯库玛问题的源头都快把裂谷城折腾碎了。如果他们被发现了，我可不想变成他们那样。

original: Sibbi Black-Briar is furious that his ex-lover tried to murder him. He's leaving no stone unturned searching for her.
traduit: 西比·黑棘对他前任情人试图谋杀他的事很愤怒，正在千方百计寻找她。

original: Mjoll the Lioness used to adventure across Skyrim before she settled down in Riften. I hear it all ended when she lost her enchanted blade.
traduit: “雌狮”穆月尔定居裂谷城之前曾经在天际冒险，我听说她是因为弄丢了附魔剑才结束了冒险。

original: Crime is at an all-time high in this city thanks to the Thieves Guild. Don't we have enough problems with the war going on?
traduit: 多亏了盗贼公会，这座城市的犯罪率达到了历史最高水平。战争还在继续，我们的麻烦还不够多么？

original: If Maven Black-Briar keeps raising prices on mead, I'll have to resort to watering it down just to make ends meet.
traduit: 如果玛雯·黑棘继续抬高蜜酒价格的话，我就不得不在里面掺水了。

original: If it's true that the dragons have returned, what will it mean for all of us? Is this how it all ends?
traduit: 如果巨龙真的回来了，那对大家来说意味着什么？一切都要完了吗？

original: Shop at Belethor's for the best prices and selection. He pays me to say that.
traduit: 在贝莱托尔店里有最好的价格和选择。他花钱雇我这么宣传。

original: Hm hmm.
traduit: 嗯嗯。

original: Best if... you didn't mention to anyone that you saw me here.
traduit: 最好……别跟任何人谈起你在这里见过我。

original: I've said too much already.
traduit: 我已经说得够多了。

original: Remember - don't trust the Imperials. No matter what honeyed lies they tell you.
traduit: 记住，不要相信帝国人。不管他们对你说了什么花言巧语。

original: Live long. Fight well.
traduit: 活得长，打得好。

original: You take care of yourself, now.
traduit: 你现在得照顾好自己。

original: If you need any jewelry, just let me know.
traduit: 如果需要珠宝，请告诉我。

original: If you need a drink, just holler.
traduit: 如果想喝一杯，喊一声就行。

original: Yeah, take care.
traduit: 嗯，保重。

original: Come back anytime if you need a remedy.
traduit: 如果需要治疗，随时来找我。

original: Do forget to see me at my shop sometime - Arcadia's Cauldron.
traduit: 别忘了有时间来我的阿尔凯迪雅之釜看看。

original: Stay out of trouble.
traduit: 不要惹麻烦。

original: Keep your nose clean.
traduit: 别卷入是非。

original: Need anything else, just let me know.
traduit: 需要什么尽管说。

original: I think I've got some mugs need scrubbin'.
traduit: 我得去刷杯子了。

original: Goodbye, dear.
traduit: 再见，亲爱的。

original: Is it cold in here? I should put more wood on the fire...
traduit: 这里冷吗？我该去添点柴火了。

original: Now please, no more questions.
traduit: 现在请不要再问了。

original: If there's nothing else, I have work to do...
traduit: 如果没别的事，我就去工作了……

original: You should buy some produce from Carlotta's stall. Most of it comes from my farm.
traduit: 你应该去卡萝塔的摊位上买些土产。大部分都是我农场里进的货。

original: You should stop by my farm if you get a chance. See what life's really about.
traduit: 如果有机会，来我农场看看。就知道生活究竟是什么了。

original: It's the leaving that's hardest, I know.
traduit: 我知道，离别是最痛苦的。

original: Some parting advice - women love sonnets.
traduit: 临别赠言，女人们都喜欢诗歌。

original: Yeah, take care of yourself.
traduit: 是啊，自己保重。

original: Do come back.
traduit: 一定再来啊。

original: Remember, I'll give you the best deals, or die trying.
traduit: 记住，我是死也要给你最划算的交易。

original: Next time, come see my at my shop. I've got some things you'll just love.
traduit: 下次，来我店里看看。我有些你可能会喜欢的东西。

original: Good doin' business with ya.
traduit: 和你做生意很愉快。

original: We'll have to have a pint together sometime, you and me.
traduit: 我们得找个时间单独喝两杯。

original: Remember, I've got the freshest meat in all of Whiterun.
traduit: 记住，我这里有全白漫最新鲜的肉。

original: Right. Till next time.
traduit: 好吧。下次见。

original: Thank you very much for your business.
traduit: 非常感谢你的惠顾。

original: I was done talkin' anyway.
traduit: 反正我也不想聊了。

original: You go on your way now, boy.
traduit: 你自己走自己的路吧，孩子。

original: You go on your way now, girl.
traduit: 你自己走自己的路吧，姑娘。

original: Farewell, my lady.
traduit: 再见，女士。

original: Farewell, sir.
traduit: 再见，先生。

original: You watch yourself out there.
traduit: 在外面要小心啊。

original: Keep your eyes open for those Stormcloak dogs, yeah?
traduit: 小心那些风暴斗篷狗，知道吗？

original: Do be careful, child. Skyrim is not as safe as it used to be.
traduit: 孩子，一定保重。天际不像以前那么安全了。

original: By the way, you might want to stop in at Warmaiden's. These days, folk need all the protection they can get.
traduit: 对了，你应该去战争少女看看。现如今，人们都得尽可能多点保护措施。

original: Long live the Empire.
traduit: 帝国万岁。

original: The Stormcloaks are living on borrowed time, believe me.
traduit: 相信我，风暴斗篷时日无多了。

original: May your sword be sharp, and your tongue sharper.
traduit: 愿你刀剑锋利，口舌更甚。

original: Keep a song in your heart, and a blade in your boot.
traduit: 心中要有歌，靴里要有刀。

original: It's back to work, then.
traduit: 那就回去工作了。

original: I'll see you.
traduit: 我会看着你。

original: Yes, yes. Goodbye.
traduit: 是，是。再见。

original: May all your possible futures be bright.
traduit: 愿你未来充满光明。

original: Remember, fresh fruit and vegetables every day. Mostly.
traduit: 记住，每天都有新鲜的水果蔬菜哦。大概吧。

original: Thanks for the business.
traduit: 谢谢惠顾。

original: I've really got to be going.
traduit: 我真得走了。

original: I think I hear my daughter calling...
traduit: 我好像听到我女儿喊我……

original: Goodbye, ma'am.
traduit: 再见，女士。

original: Goodbye, sir.
traduit: 再见，先生。

original: May Talos guide you. Always.
traduit: 愿塔洛斯永远指引你。

original: Stay vigilant! Our enemies are legion!
traduit: 保持警惕！我们的敌人很多！

original: Goodbye. And if you happen to see Mikael, tell him I was asking about him...
traduit: 再见。如果碰见米凯尔，告诉他我在问他的事……

original: Back to my book...
traduit: 得回去看书了……

original: Damn it, I lost my page...
traduit: 该死，书看到哪页了……

original: The blessing of Arkay be upon you.
traduit: 愿阿尔凯保佑你。

original: Walk always in the light, in these days of darkness.
traduit: 在黑暗的日子里也要行走在光明之中。

original: Sure. Whatever.
traduit: 好吧。就这样。

original: Bye, now.
traduit: 再见了。

original: Don't let the door slam into your backside on the way out.
traduit: 出门的时候小心门磕着后背。

original: Now if ya don't mind, my house could do with a bit of dusting.
traduit: 我该去打扫屋子了，失陪。

original: Grace of Kynareth be with you.
traduit: 愿凯娜瑞丝的恩赐与你同在。

original: Travel great Skyrim, and Kynareth travels with you.
traduit: 畅游辽阔的天际吧，凯娜瑞丝与你同行。

original: You need to be careful in this city. Never know who you can trust, these days.
traduit: 在城市里得小心点。这年头你永远不知道能相信谁。

original: Right, I really am busy. So...
traduit: 好吧，我确实很忙。所以……

original: If there's nothing else, I really do have important matters tend to.
traduit: 如果没别的事了，我还有更重要的事务要处理。

original: If you run into my husband Nazeem, remind him that he's not married to himself.
traduit: 如果你碰到我丈夫纳奇姆，提醒他，他不是自己娶了自己。

original: You know, if you've got the aptitude, you should join the Mages College in Winterhold...
traduit: 如果你有这方面的天赋，应该去加入冬堡的法师学院……

original: Remember, your mind is the best weapon you have.
traduit: 记住，你的头脑是你最好的武器。

original: Don't forget to check inside the shop if you need anything.
traduit: 如果需要什么，别忘了去店里看看。

original: Enjoy your visit to Dragonsreach.
traduit: 享受龙临宫。

original: If there's any more I can help you with, just let me know.
traduit: 如果我能帮上什么忙，请尽管告诉我。

original: Next time, deal with Avenicci.
traduit: 下次有事，去找阿文尼奇。

original: Now if you don't mind, I've got a city to keep.
traduit: 恕失陪，有一座城市等我守护。

original: Maybe we'll meet in the field. Just pray we're on the same side.
traduit: 也许我们会在战场相遇。祈祷你我会是同一阵营。

original: If you run into any Stormcloaks, kill a dozen for me.
traduit: 如果碰到风暴斗篷，帮我杀几个。

original: I've got my eyes on you.
traduit: 我盯着你呢。

original: Mind yourself in front of the Jarl, or we'll have serious problems.
traduit: 在领主御前注意点，不然咱们就有问题要解决了。

original: Ride strong.
traduit: 骑乘愉快。

original: You always keep us in mind when you need a fresh horse, yeah?
traduit: 需要新马的时候总能想起我们，是吧？

original: Uh huh.
traduit: 嗯嗯。

original: Back to work, I guess. There's never a shortage of dung to shovel around here.
traduit: 该回去工作了。这里从来都不缺粪要铲。

original: Good. Chat time's over.
traduit: 好。聊天时间结束了。

original: Yeah, whatever.
traduit: 是，无所谓。

original: Please, leave me to recover my... mental energies.
traduit: 请让我回去找我的……精神能量。

original: No one has said anything about you.
traduit: 没人提过你。

original: Oh she will, mark my words. And don't you let her.
traduit: 记住我说的，她肯定会的。别让她得逞。

original: No? Well, then she hasn't gotten to you yet. But she will. And you don't you believe a word of it.
traduit: 没有吗？那是她还没找上你。但她一定会的，一个字都不要信。

original: Well met, hunter.
traduit: 你好啊，猎人。

original: What can you tell me about the Sleeping Tree?
traduit: 能跟我说说沉睡之树吗？

original: How the tree came to grow there is a bit of a mystery...
traduit: 那棵树是怎么在那里生长的有点神秘。

original: Some say that when Vvardenfell erupted, a piece was blown to the middle of Skyrim and from the crater grew the tree.
traduit: 有人说，是瓦登费尔的火山爆发时，一块碎片被吹到了天际中央地带，然后那棵树就在坑里长起来了。

original: I've also heard that it was a spore that fell from an island floating in the sky, but that just sounds like nonsense.
traduit: 我还听说那是从一个浮空岛上掉下来的孢子，但听起来像是胡说八道。

original: All I know is that the sap makes you feel as healthy as a cave troll, but slow as a drunk horker. And that and it fetches good coin.
traduit: 我只是知道这种汁液能让你感觉自己像洞里的巨魔一样强壮，但又像喝多了的海象一样迟钝。这样能赚好多钱。

original: So you're in charge of Anga's Mill?
traduit: 所以你在管理安佳木材厂？

original: That I am. My father left it to me after he died in that Great War against the Elves.
traduit: 是。我父亲在那场对抗精灵的浩大战争里去世，这里也就留给我了。

original: I don't care what's going on in the world. Rebellion. Dragons awakening. The mill is enough trouble for me to worry about.
traduit: 我不在乎外界发生了什么。什么叛乱、龙族觉醒。这个厂子就够我操心的了。

original: I'm looking for a job.
traduit: 我在找工作。

original: If you've got an axe, you can always make gold chopping wood. Just bring me everything you cut.
traduit: 如果你有斧头，就去劈木柴换钱吧。劈好的木柴都可以拿来给我。

original: The giant in <Alias=GiantCamp> is dead.
traduit: <Alias=GiantCamp>的巨人死了。

original: You've shown those monsters that they will no longer be tolerated in the Pale. Good work.
traduit: 你已经向那些怪物证明了苍原领不再容忍他们了。干得好。

original: Here, a reward from your Jarl.
traduit: 来，这是本领主给你的奖赏。

original: You don't have time? Fine.
traduit: 你没时间？很好。

original: I'm counting on you.
traduit: 全指望你了。

original: Giants are a common problem in the Pale. The Empire always demanded I leave them be, but the Empire isn't here now.
traduit: 巨人在苍原是个常见麻烦了。帝国一直要求我远离他们，但现在帝国管不着这里了。

original: Go and slay one of the beasts. It should let them know that Dawnstar is not to be trifled with.
traduit: 去杀一头畜生吧。让他们知道晨星不容忽视。

original: It was supposed to be an honor, but very well.
traduit: 这本就是一种荣誉，但没关系。

original: If you don't mind digging, I own the Quicksilver Mine. It's a better life than working in that damned Iron-Breaker Mine with all those milk drinkers.
traduit: 如果你不介意挖矿的话，可以来我的水银矿场。这样的生活总比和那些蠢蛋去碎铁者矿场工作要好。

original: Who runs Dawnstar?
traduit: 谁在管理晨星？

original: That would be Skald the Elder. He's been running Dawnstar ever since he was a boy, and he never lost that brat's attitude.
traduit: 那就是老斯卡德了。他还是个小子的时候就开始治理晨星了，他从来没改过他那个小屁孩脾气。

original: Turned on the Empire first chance he got. Now we're all part of this rebellion.
traduit: 他一有机会就开始攻击帝国。现在我们都是叛军的一员了。

original: Brina Merilis came in with the whole damn Legion and deposed Skald. Couldn't have happened to a better man.
traduit: 布里那·莫里利斯带了好大一帮帝国军推翻了斯卡德。也是他活该。

original: Where'd you learn to play?
traduit: 你在哪儿学的演奏？

original: My mother taught me. She was a Bard, from the college in Solitude.
traduit: 我妈妈教给我的。她是个来自独孤城学院的吟游诗人。

original: I hear they accept most people who apply, if you're ever interested.
traduit: 我听说他们会接受大部分申请的，你如果感兴趣可以去看看。

original: I was looking for a drink. Or some work.
traduit: 我在找喝酒的地方。有工作也行。

original: Drowning your troubles in mead? A lot of folks are doing that these days. You'll want the Windpeak Inn.
traduit: 想把烦恼扔进蜜酒里？现在很多人都这样。那你可以去风岳旅店。

original: As for work, you could try to catch Skald in a good mood, but your best bet would be working in the mines. They're on opposite ends of town.
traduit: 至于工作，你可以在斯卡德心情好的时候找他，但最好还是到矿场吧。就在镇子的两头儿。

original: Did I see you arguing with someone?
traduit: 我看到你在和人争吵？

original: Skald supports Ulfric's rebellion, and he doesn't like having a couple of old Legionnaires living in his town.
traduit: 斯卡德支持乌弗瑞克的叛乱，他不喜欢军团老兵住在他的镇上。

original: He's a fool. A dragon has attacked Helgen. Dawnstar needs the Empire now more than ever.
traduit: 他就是个笨蛋。龙袭击了海尔根。晨星比任何时候都需要帝国。

original: Who's in charge around here?
traduit: 这里谁负责？

original: That would be Jarl Skald the Elder. He's over in the White Hall, probably talking about Ulfric like he's the second coming of Talos.
traduit: 那就是老斯卡德了。他可能正在白色会堂谈论乌弗瑞克吧，整得他跟塔洛斯二次下凡一样。

original: Jarl Brina Merilis is in charge, thanks to the Empire. Best hide any Talos amulets you have.
traduit: 多亏了帝国，现在是布里那·莫里利斯领主统治了。最好把你身上的塔洛斯护符藏起来。

original: What do you do in Dawnstar?
traduit: 你在晨星做什么？

original: I own Iron-Breaker Mine. We make twice as much coin as those horkers over in Quicksilver Mine, and don't let anyone tell you otherwise.
traduit: 我拥有碎铁者矿场。我们这里赚的钱是水银矿场那群笨海象的两倍，别被别人迷惑了。

original: I pay a good wage for any iron ore you dig up, if you're looking for work.
traduit: 如果你想找工作的话，你挖出的铁矿石我都会给你一大笔钱。

original: So you're the one who's been down there killing all my wolves. You're gonna die for that!
traduit: 所以是你在下面杀了我所有的狼。你去死吧！

original: Give em the dogs, boys!
traduit: 小子们，放狗！

original: Get him! Rip his throat out!
traduit: 上！扯断他的喉咙！

original: Sounds like easy money to me. You're on.
traduit: 听起来很容易赚到钱啊。来吧。

original: I'll do you ten gold at three to one on the white one.
traduit: 我赌十枚金币，三比一赔率，赌那个白的。

original: That all happened in the First Era, so the well should be clear of poison by now. It says the key to the well is likely somewhere in the crypt.
traduit: 那些事发生在第一纪元，所以现在井里应该没有毒了。上面说井的钥匙可能在地穴的某个地方。

original: So the Dragon Cult poisoned their own well, which explains the ghosts. However, Skorm thought the well was the key to entering the inner areas.
traduit: 所以是拜龙教自己在井里下毒，这就能解释那些鬼魂了。然而，斯科姆认为井是通往内部区域的关键。

original: Let's see... found the Dragon Cult... laid siege... people already dead... poisoned themselves... blah, blah, blah...  ah! Here it is!
traduit: 来看看……找到了拜龙教……进行包围……人都死了……都是服毒自杀……巴拉巴拉巴拉……啊！在这儿！

original: If it will help the cause...
traduit: 如果这对大业有帮助的话……

original: You there! You look like a sympathetic soldier. I require your assistance!
traduit: 嘿！你看上去像个有同情心的士兵。我需要你的帮助！

original: What mission?
traduit: 什么任务？

original: The General has sent me to obtain a powerful weapon for the war effort.
traduit: 将军派我来寻找一件威力强大的武器，以支援眼下的战事。

original: This was the last great bastion of the Dragon Cult, and their leader's mask was reported to be quite powerful.
traduit: 这里是拜龙教的最后一处巨型堡垒，他们的领袖佩戴的面具据说非常强大。

original: Excellent work!
traduit: 干得好！

original: You have to keep your ward up, or else this won't work. I don't want to hurt you.
traduit: 你得持续保持结界的施放，否则是没用的。我可不想伤到你。

original: Hold still...
traduit: 保持住……

original: Now, cast the ward spell, and keep it up.
traduit: 现在，施放结界法术，保持住。

original: Intruder! Help!
traduit: 有入侵者！请求支援！

original: Help! In here!
traduit: 来人！在这儿！

original: Backup! I need some help in here!
traduit: 支援！我这里需要帮助！

original: Over here! Hurry!
traduit: 在这里！快！

original: I have Azura's Star.
traduit: 我有阿祖拉之星。

original: Stendarr's Mercy. You found it. Azura's Star.
traduit: 斯丹达尔的仁慈啊。你找到了。阿祖拉之星。

original: Maybe this is my chance to make things right. I can finish Malyn's work, the way we had meant to before his madness.
traduit: 也许这是我补过的机会。我可以按马林发疯前的计划，继续完成他的研究。

original: It would mean cutting the Star off from Azura. Only black souls would be able to enter it once we finished.
traduit: 这意味着需要切断阿祖拉和这颗星之间的联系。一旦完工，就只有黑色灵魂才能进入了。

original: Are you ready to give me the Star?
traduit: 准备好把星交给我了吗？

original: Here. Take it.
traduit: 来，拿着。

original: I will commune with Azura.
traduit: 我会和阿祖拉交流。

original: I think I found the mage from your vision.
traduit: 我觉得我找到你预兆中的那位法师了。

original: Good. All will be revealed in time. Keep playing your part, and Azura will reward you.
traduit: 好。一切都会被适时地揭晓。继续扮演好自己的角色吧，阿祖拉会奖赏你的。

original: How does Azura's Star work?
traduit: 阿祖拉之星是怎么运作的？

original: I mentioned how the Star is a soul gem, only it never gets depleted? There's another rule the artifact follows.
traduit: 我刚刚说了吧？那颗星是永不枯竭的灵魂石。它还遵循着另一条规则。

original: You can only store white souls in the Star, belonging to the lesser creatures. Azura's magic won't allow black souls to enter it.
traduit: 那颗星只能存储低等生物的白色灵魂。阿祖拉的魔法隔绝了黑色灵魂进入其中。

original: As a mortal, Malyn's soul was black, so part of his work was breaking past Azura's rules. He was close before... well, I already told you.
traduit: 马林身为凡人，灵魂是黑色的。所以他以前的一部分工作就是要打破阿祖拉的规则。他已经很接近目的了……但是，后面的事你也知道了。

original: How did the daedra drive Malyn insane?
traduit: 迪德拉是如何逼疯马林的？

original: Azura is no ordinary Daedra. She commands an entire realm inside of Oblivion. The more Malyn worked on the Star, the more she was able to damn him.
traduit: 阿祖拉不是寻常迪德拉。她掌控着一整个湮灭位面。马林对那颗星研究越多，所受到的诅咒也就越多。

original: It started slowly at first. Malyn would see things that weren't there. Then he would yell at students over words they hadn't said.
traduit: 开始还是很缓慢的。马林开始出现幻视，接着，他就因为幻听而呵斥学生。

original: Then one day I walked in and Malyn had... killed a student, and in a horrific moment of inspiration, he started using her soul for his work.
traduit: 有一天我走进去发现……马林杀了一个学生，然后突发奇想，用她的灵魂进行研究。

original: I'm looking for an elven mage who studies stars.
traduit: 我在找研究星辰的法师。

original: Who sent you? Was it the College? The Jarl? We agreed there would be no more questions.
traduit: 谁派你来的？学院？领主？我们不是说好相安无事吗。

original: What is it? What happened?
traduit: 那是什么？发生了什么事？

original: There was an... unfortunate incident a few years ago. An elven mage named Nelacar was exiled from the College over it.
traduit: 那是……几年前的悲剧。一个叫内拉卡的精灵法师因此被逐出学院。

original: He's still in town, getting by plying spells to the people inside the Frozen Hearth. Disgraceful.
traduit: 他现在还住在镇子上，在冻炉旅店研究魔法。真可耻。

original: Officially, nothing.
traduit: 正式来说，没什么事。

original: Well, it's a... minor stain on the College's reputation. One of many, unfortunately.
traduit: 啊……那是学院名誉的小污点。不幸的是这种小污点太多了。

original: It was a few years ago. A few of the mages got overconfident and were exiled. They had no talent, anyway.
traduit: 几年前的事了。几个法师过于自信以致被流放。反正他们没有天赋。

original: I hear one of them, Nelacar, still hangs around the Frozen Hearth. Guess he has no where else to go, poor thing.
traduit: 我听说其中一个叫内拉卡的还在冻炉旅店徘徊。看来他是没地方可去了，可怜。

original: There was some bother about a group of mages being exiled. I can't remember what the details were.
traduit: 有一群法师被开除了，细节挺麻烦的，我没记住。

original: I think one of them came back. Nelacar. Stays at the Frozen Hearth, but I don't know why. He's not welcome in the College.
traduit: 我记得其中一个叫内拉卡的回来了。就住在冻炉旅店，但不知道为什么，学院不欢迎他。

original: You shouldn't ask me. There's an Altmer named Nelacar in the Frozen Hearth. He's the one to talk to.
traduit: 你不该问我。冻炉旅店有个叫内拉卡的傲特莫。你应该是在找他。

original: Oh, no, I'm not falling for that one again. Next thing I know, I'm getting yelled at for saying something inappropriate.
traduit: 哦，不，我不会再上当了。我知道自己接下来会怎么样，说一些不合时宜的话然后被骂。

original: If you're so curious, talk to Nelacar, in the Frozen Hearth. He can tell you the whole sad story.
traduit: 如果你这么好奇，就去冻炉旅店找内拉卡吧。他会告诉你悲剧的始末。

original: "Dimwits"? What happened?
traduit: “笨蛋”？发生了什么事？

original: The kind of things that even the College won't tolerate. Things that can get a wizard exiled for life.
traduit: 连学院都不能容忍的事，足够把一个巫师永久开除。

original: There's an Altmer who's staying at the Frozen Hearth. Nelacar. You should speak with him, if you're so curious.
traduit: 有个傲特莫还住在冻炉旅店。叫内拉卡。你要是这么好奇，就去和他谈谈。

original: What kind of things?
traduit: 什么事？

original: Is there an elven mage here that studies stars?
traduit: 这里有研究星辰的精灵法师吗？

original: The mages are up in the College. You can ask them, if they'll let you in.
traduit: 法师都在学院里，如果能进去的话，你可以问他们。

original: Then again, Nelacar might know. He's an old-timer from the College, but he has a room here.
traduit: 话说回来，内拉卡可能知道。他是学院的老资格了，不过他在这里住。

original: Did you say an "elf" and "stars"? I hope you don't know what you're asking.
traduit: 你说“精灵”和“星辰”？希望你不知道自己在问什么。

original: "An elf that studies stars"? Where did you hear about that?
traduit: “研究星辰的精灵”？你从哪听来的？

original: Studies stars you say? Why, there hasn't been a mage doing anything related to stars since.... Oh....
traduit: 你说研究星辰？为什么这么问，自打……那件事以后，就没有法师研究过星辰的相关……哦……

original: Why specifically stars? Wait, you aren't referring to... No, there's no way you would know about that.
traduit: 为什么说星星？等等，你不会是说……不，你不可能知道。

original: I know plenty of spells that produce light, but stars? Hmm. There was that problem a few years ago, but that couldn't be related.
traduit: 发光的咒语我倒是知道不少，但你说星辰？嗯，几年前有过这种问题，但与此无关。

original: Stars? You wouldn't be referring to that incident a few years ago? I still say that exile was far too harsh.
traduit: 星星？你不会是说前几年的事吧？我还是觉得开除太残酷了。

original: Why would anyone bother to study stars? Well, unless you're talking about that artifact that got all those... dimwits thrown out.
traduit: 问什么会有人花时间去研究星星？除非你说的是因为那件神器被开除的……笨蛋们。

original: Studies stars? I remember the last time the word "stars" was flown through the Hall of the Elements. Bad things had happened.
traduit: 研究星辰？上次“星”这个词儿飞过元素大厅的时候，可是发生了些不好的事。

original: I'm not anyone's champion. Find someone else.
traduit: 我不会给任何人当勇士的。找别人吧。

original: There is no one else, but very well. I cannot force you to accept your destiny.
traduit: 并无其他人选，不过很好。我不能强迫你接受自己的命运。

original: I suggest we meet there in a few hours, and see what awaits us inside. That's all for now, thank you.
traduit: 我们过会儿在那儿集合吧，看看里面有什么在等待着我们。就这样，谢谢。

original: The College has undertaken a fascinating excavation in the ruins of Saarthal nearby. It's an excellent learning opportunity.
traduit: 学院在附近的萨瑟尔遗迹进行了一次非常令人着迷的挖掘。这是一场很好的学习机会。

original: I think perhaps we're ready to begin exploring some of the various applications of magic throughout history.
traduit: 看来我们已经做好准备开始探索历史上魔法的各种运用了。

original: Well, I think this is an excellent start. I'd like you all to continue practicing with wards, please.
traduit: 这开始很不错。希望你们都继续一起练习结界术。

original: Then let's get to it.
traduit: 那我们出发吧。

original: I've been pouring over the plans you brought us, and I'm convinced the Eyes of the Falmer are in the dwarven ruins at Irkngthand.
traduit: 我一直在看你带回来的计划书，伐莫之眼应该就在矮人遗迹厄金坦德里。

original: Karliah and I will meet you there. Prepare yourself, lad. This will be a fight to remember!
traduit: 我和卡莱亚去那里等你。自己做好准备吧，小子。这将是难忘的一战！

original: Karliah and I will meet you there. Prepare yourself, lass. This will be a fight to remember!
traduit: 我和卡莱亚去那里等你。自己做好准备吧，姑娘。这将是难忘的一战！

original: I accept.
traduit: 我同意了。

original: Then it's decided. When this entire sorry affair is over, we'll handle the details.
traduit: 那就这么决定了。等这个糟心事结束后，我们再谈细节吧。

original: Until then, we have quite the task ahead.
traduit: 在那之前，任务艰巨啊。

original: Then it's decided. When this is all over and Delvin's contacts assure me that we've regained our footing in Skyrim, we'll handle the details.
traduit: 那就这么决定了。等一切结束，戴尔文的联络人们向我保证咱们在全天际重新站稳脚跟，我们再谈细节吧。

original: No, it's not right.
traduit: 不，这样不对。

original: Look. Everyone in the Guild admires what you've done. Maybe they won't come out and simply tell you, but I promise you it's true.
traduit: 听着。公会所有人都很欣赏你所做的一切。也许他们不会直截了当跟你说，但我保证这是真的。

original: And now they know Mercer never genuinely cared about the Guild. He lacked the loyalty you obviously possess.
traduit: 现在他们知道了墨瑟从未真正关心过公会。他缺乏你这样明显的忠诚。

original: I can't think of anyone better.
traduit: 我想不出更好的人选了。

original: It's about time you asked.
traduit: 你早就该问了。

original: Ha! Spoken like the leader of the Thieves Guild.
traduit: 哈！口气就像盗贼公会头子一样。

original: Just don't lose yourself in the role. We have a bit of an errand to run before your coronation.
traduit: 只是别在角色里出不来了。在你接任前还有事要办呢。

original: I don't know what to say.
traduit: 我不知道该说什么。

original: Well, we have a bit of an errand to run before your coronation, so don't get sentimental on me now.
traduit: 好吧，在你接任前咱们还有些事要办，所以现在先别对着我多愁善感了。

original: Me? What about you?
traduit: 我？那你呢？

original: I've been at this game a long time, my friend. A long time. I've stolen trinkets from nobles and framed priests for murder.
traduit: 我干这行很久了，朋友。很长时间。我偷过贵族的饰品还诬陷过祭司谋杀。

original: I'm good at what I do, maybe even one of the best. But it's all I know.
traduit: 我很擅长这行的工作，也许还是最好的那种。但这是我的极限了。

original: I've never been one to lead. Never desired it, never cared for it. Don't want it.
traduit: 我从没当过领袖。也从没这样想过，从来没有。一点也不想干。

original: Why tell this to me?
traduit: 为什么告诉我这些？

original: Karliah and I had a long discussion before you arrived here.
traduit: 在你来之前，卡莱亚和我聊了很久。

original: Thanks to your efforts, the Guild's been restored to it's full strength and you've exposed the traitor in our midst.
traduit: 多亏了你的努力，公会已经恢复了它全部的力量，你也揭出了我们中的叛徒。

original: As a result, we both feel that you'd make an excellent replacement for Mercer as leader of the Thieves Guild.
traduit: 因此，我们都觉得你适合取代墨瑟成为盗贼公会的领袖。

original: Thanks to your efforts, Mercer's treachery has been exposed. After we deal with him, all that remains is restoring the Guild to its full strength.
traduit: 多亏你的努力，墨瑟的阴谋得以揭穿。等把他做掉以后，剩下的就是恢复公会的全部力量了。

original: As a result, we both feel that you have the potential of replacing Mercer as leader of the Thieves Guild.
traduit: 因此，我们都觉得你有潜力取代墨瑟成为盗贼公会的领袖。

original: The Star is being used to sustain Malyn's soul. I can't fix it while that fragment of him is inside.
traduit: 马林正在用这颗星维持灵魂。只要里面还有他的残留，我就无法修复。

original: Just give me a moment.
traduit: 给我一点时间。

original: These fissures and cracks aren't encouraging. Malyn obviously was growing more desparate once he left the College.
traduit: 看看这残破的样子。马林离开学院之后一定变得更绝望了。

original: Is Dawnstar prepared for dragon attacks?
traduit: 晨星是否准备好应对龙袭了？

original: No. We're completely exposed. Bows and arrows are in short supply. Every building is made of thatch and wood.
traduit: 不。我们完全暴露了。弓弩箭矢都供应不足。这里的建筑都是茅草和木头搭建的。

original: I've given standing orders to the guards to prepare water bucket runs to the harbor in case of a fire, but that's all we can do.
traduit: 我已经命令卫兵在通往港口的地方准备好水桶以防止发生火灾，但我们只能做这么多了。

original: How's the war going?
traduit: 战争怎么样了？

original: The Empire has stretched itself too far. This rebellion in Skyrim is one problem, but solving it won't fix everything.
traduit: 帝国已经拉的太长了。天际的叛乱确实是个问题，但解决它不代表解决所有问题。

original: But that's the kind of talk an old warhorse shouldn't be making. Don't worry. I have my problems with the Empire, but I'm still a soldier first.
traduit: 但这不是个老兵该说的。别担心。我即使对帝国有些不满，但还是个军人。

original: We'll keep peace and order in Dawnstar.
traduit: 我们会维持晨星的和平与秩序。

original: Do you work here all day?
traduit: 你整天都在这里工作吗？

original: Yes. Ever since mother died a few winters ago. I play songs and help with the drinks when I have the time.
traduit: 是的。自从我母亲几年前的冬天去世后。有空的时候我会唱曲或者帮忙倒酒。

original: The only reason dragons are attacking is because Talos is angry with us for turning our backs on him.
traduit: 龙族袭击的唯一原因就是因为塔洛斯对我们的背弃感到愤怒。

original: As soon as we drive the Empire out of Skyrim, the dragons will vanish. Mark my words.
traduit: 一旦我们把帝国赶出天际，龙就会消失。记住我说的话。

original: How is Dawnstar faring in the war?
traduit: 晨星在战争中表现如何？

original: The Stormcloaks are destined to win this fight. Talos is with us, and when you fight under a Divine's blessing, victory is assured.
traduit: 风暴斗篷注定会赢得这场战争。塔洛斯与我们同在，当你在圣灵的护佑下战斗，胜利就是必然的。

original: Dawnstar has a history of being the site of battles that have crippled the fate of the Empire. I hope this remains true.
traduit: 晨星曾是削弱帝国国运的战场。我希望它依然如此。

original: Are you the court wizard?
traduit: 你是宫廷巫师吗？

original: If you could call it that. The Jarl can make all the demands in the world, I'm not setting one foot on the battlefield.
traduit: 这么说也没错。但就算领主可以提出世界上所有的要求，我也不会踏足战场的。

original: I fought in the Great War. I cut enough young lives short, I'm not going to do it again.
traduit: 我参加过浩大战争。我夺去了很多年轻人的生命，我不会再这么做了。

original: The Empire created the Forsworn? How?
traduit: 帝国创造了弃誓者？怎么回事？

original: Through neglect. During the Great War, they let the unwashed natives retake the Reach and declare their own sovereignty.
traduit: 因为忽视。浩大战争期间，他们让这些未开化的土著重新夺回了瑞驰并宣布主权。

original: The Stormcloaks were forced to retake the Reach on our own, but that taste of independence emboldened them. And the Forsworn were born.
traduit: 风暴斗篷不得不靠我们自己的力量重新夺回瑞驰，但那种独特的独立滋味让他们更加大胆了。弃誓者就这么诞生了。

original: In the end, we took back Markarth, but those damn Forsworn still stalk the hills and roads, looking for revenge.
traduit: 最后，我们夺回了马卡斯，但那些该死的弃誓者还在山野徘徊，伺机复仇。

original: Is Markarth prepared to deal with dragons?
traduit: 马卡斯做好对付龙的准备了么？

original: The stone structure the Dwarves have left makes us invincible. Let the dragons singe a few carpets. They'll never topple Markarth.
traduit: 矮人留下的石头建筑让我们战无不胜。那些龙烧几块地皮无所谓。他们永远也推翻不了马卡斯。

original: What's your position on the war?
traduit: 你对这场战争怎么看？

original: The Imperials were weak. They created this Forsworn problem, but now that we're in charge we'll solve it.
traduit: 帝国人很弱。他们制造了弃誓者问题，但现在我们说了算，我们会解决的。

original: Once the war is over, I'll petition Ulfric to send the militia and we'll cleanse the Reach of this menace.
traduit: 一旦战争结束，我会请乌弗瑞克派义勇军来，我们会为瑞驰清除这个威胁。

original: Then the Forsworn will be where they belong. In the mines, bringing us wealth.
traduit: 那些弃誓者会回到他们该去的地方。到矿场里给我们提供财富。

original: Instruction? Where do I sign up?
traduit: 教导？我在哪儿报名？

original: Well, you are lovely to look at, and there's so many things I could teach you, but I'm afraid the Temple isn't taking in new students.
traduit: 嗯，你长得是挺可爱的，我也可以教你很多东西，但恐怕神殿不再收新学生了。

original: Who is Dibella? This is her temple?
traduit: 迪贝拉是谁？这里是她的神殿吗？

original: A heathen. Lovely. Oh, don't put on that angry look. I'm just teasing you.
traduit: 真是可爱的异教徒。哦，别生气。我逗你玩呢。

original: Dibella is the Divine of Beauty. She is a patron deity to artists and bards and those who seek life's simple pleasures.
traduit: 迪贝拉是美之圣灵。她是艺术家、诗人和那些寻求生活中简单快乐者的守护神。

original: The temple offers her blessings to pilgrims and instruction in enjoying all life has to offer.
traduit: 神殿会为朝拜者提供她的祝福，并教导他们如何享受生活。

original: Dragons have returned to Skyrim.
traduit: 龙族回归天际了。

original: Yes, I know. We have some advantages if they come here. The city is built into the mountainside, so it's hard to reach into even from the skies.
traduit: 是，我知道。如果他们来这里，我们还是有些优势的。这座城市建在山腰上，即使从天上飞来也很难抵达。

original: And everything is made of stone. Even the beds. We'll have no trouble from dragon's fire here.
traduit: 一切都是石头做的。连床都是。龙炎不会带来多大麻烦的。

original: The Empire lost the Reach before? How?
traduit: 帝国曾经丢掉了瑞驰？怎么回事？

original: When the Aldmeri Dominion invaded the Imperial City, the Legion all but turned a blind eye to the other provinces.
traduit: 当先祖神洲入侵帝都时，军团几乎无暇顾及其他省份。

original: Many of the disgruntled natives of the Reach used the opportunity to depose the Empire, and founded what they called an independent kingdom.
traduit: 许多不满的原住民就趁机推翻了帝国，建立了他们所谓的独立王国。

original: It was little more than a chaotic uprising, but the Reach was removed from Imperial authority for two years before we reclaimed it.
traduit: 那只不过是一场混乱的起义，但在我们收复之前，瑞驰从帝国手中被分离了两年。

original: But the leaders of the uprising refused our offers of peace. They fled into the hills and became the Forsworn.
traduit: 但起义的领导人们拒绝了我们的和平提议，逃到了山里，成了弃誓者。

original: Why did you arrest the Nord militia?
traduit: 你为什么要逮捕诺德民兵？

original: The White-Gold Concordat. Our treaty with the Elves after the Great War forbids free worship of Talos.
traduit: 因为白金协定。我们在浩大战争之后与精灵签订了条约禁止自由信仰塔洛斯。

original: But that's what we promised Ulfric and his men. It seems foolish looking back, but at the time we were hoping the Elves wouldn't find out.
traduit: 但我们答应过乌弗瑞克和他的部下。回头想想似乎有些愚蠢，但当时我们希望精灵不会发现。

original: So when they did find out, it was either we arrest Ulfric and the militia, or enter into yet another war with the Aldmeri Dominion.
traduit: 所以，当他们发现的时候，我们要么逮捕乌弗瑞克和民兵，要么和先祖神洲再打一仗。

original: The choice was clear. And now, Ulfric threatens the thinly veiled peace we sacrificed so much for.
traduit: 选择不言而喻。现在，乌弗瑞克威胁到了我们为之牺牲甚多的和平。

original: Has the war been hard on Markarth?
traduit: 战争会对马卡斯不利吗？

original: It all started here. This rebellion. When the Empire lost the Reach during the Great War, we became desperate.
traduit: 一切都从这里开始。这场叛乱。当帝国在浩大战争中丢掉瑞驰之后，我们变得绝望。

original: We promised a group of Nord militia free worship in exchange for their help retaking the Hold. Then the Elves found out about it.
traduit: 我们答应让一群诺德民兵以自由信仰为条件将瑞驰领夺回来。后来精灵发现了这件事。

original: We were forced to arrest all of them. Ulfric Stormcloak, their leader, used the whole thing as proof that the Empire had abandoned Skyrim.
traduit: 我们被迫将他们全部逮捕。他们的首领乌弗瑞克·风暴斗篷借此证明了帝国已经放弃了天际。

original: The rebels called it "The Markarth Incident." It was the founding day for the Stormcloaks, and where this war really started.
traduit: 叛军把这叫做“马卡斯事件”。那天就是风暴斗篷成立的日子，也是这场战争真正爆发的日子。

original: Dare I ask where all this meat comes from?
traduit: 我能问问这些肉是从哪儿来的吗？

original: Ah, now that is a good question. Where does Hogni get the finest, freshest meat from all over the Reach?
traduit: 哦，好问题。霍尼从哪儿买到了全瑞驰最好最新鲜的肉？

original: The answer is simple. Orcs. There is a stronghold nearby whose hunters can butcher a deer in seconds.
traduit: 答案很简单。兽人。附近有个要塞，那里的猎人几秒钟内就能杀死一头鹿。

original: Now having an Orc for a wife would be something, yes. Strong and bulky. Too bad they don't let people go beyond the walls.
traduit: 娶个兽人当老婆也不错。又强大又健壮。可惜他们不让她们走出要塞高墙。

original: Let me show you where they are. Maybe they welcome you. Maybe they put an arrow in your face. Who knows?
traduit: 我来告诉你他们的位置吧。也许他们会欢迎你，或是朝你脸上射一箭。谁知道呢？

original: You're researching the Dwemer?
traduit: 你在研究锻莫吗？

original: Yes. Their history and culture is all around us in Markarth. A race of stonecutters, artisans, and engineers.
traduit: 没错。他们的历史和文化在马卡斯随处可见。一个盛产石匠、工匠和工程师的种族。

original: They invented machines and built elaborate underground cities where they researched powers to rival the gods themselves.
traduit: 他们发明机械，建造精密的地下城市，在那里研究与神灵抗衡的力量。

original: And then, at a time we are still not sure when, they disappeared. The whole people, all at once. Leaving behind only their works.
traduit: 然后，在我们仍不能确定的某个时间，他们都消失了。所有人，同时消失了。只留下了他们的作品。

original: I would think a man of your military training would be able to do with less but so be it.
traduit: 我本以为受过你训练的人可以用更少的钱，但还是算了吧。

original: We can't afford to lose any men if we wish to keep Falkreath protected.
traduit: 如果想要保卫佛克瑞斯的话，就不能失去任何人了。

original: Sir, I will shape them up but with the war on it is unwise to reduce their wages any further.
traduit: 阁下，我会让他们振作起来的，但随着战争的进行，再克扣他们的薪资是不明智的。

original: Helvard! The guards are looking sloppy today. I want you to reduce their wages for the month.
traduit: 黑尔沃德！卫兵们今天看起来很邋遢。我命令你扣他们这个月的饷。

original: Very well, but when their emissary arrives I want words with him.
traduit: 很好，但等他们的使者来了我要和他谈谈。

original: They are only a little late, Jarl. The trade routes are affected by the war, we should give them another day.
traduit: 他们只是到的完了些，领主。战争影响到贸易路线了，我们再宽限他们几天吧。

original: Why have taxes not come in from Granite Hill, Nenya? We should send some guards down there.
traduit: 为什么花岗岩山丘没有税收上来，南雅？我们该派点卫兵过去。

original: Mmmm, careful with that, Nenya, our merchants could be selling weapons to an invading force.
traduit: 嗯，小心点吧，南雅，我们的商人可能在向敌对势力出售武器。

original: The trade routes are affected as well. Procuring supplies is a guessing game. Weapons sell well though.
traduit: 贸易路线也受到影响了。采购物资就像猜谜游戏一样。不过武器卖得很好。

original: Preparing the defenses is almost impossible lately, every time we get a new war report our needs change.
traduit: 最近想要准备防御很困难，每次收到新的战争报告，我们的需求都会改变。

original: Few want to be reminded of mortality in a time of war, Kust.
traduit: 战争年代，很少有人能直面生死无常啊，卡斯特。

original: The graveyard has been lonely. Few pay homage to the dead.
traduit: 墓地很空荡。很少有人来祭奠死者。

original: It is a hard time for all of us. I hope that you too can find some sanctuary here, Mathies.
traduit: 这对我们来说都是一段艰难的日子。希望你也能找到自己的避风港，马西斯。

original: The temple is the one place my wife finds peace these days, Runil.
traduit: 鲁尼尔，我老婆最近几天只有在神殿里才会感觉安宁些。

original: Thank you, Runil. Your support means much to us.
traduit: 谢谢你，鲁尼尔。你的支持对我们意义重大。

original: Ah, Indara. Arkay's blessing upon you and your husband. Spend as much time here as you need.
traduit: 啊，因达拉。阿尔凯保佑你们夫妻。想在这里待多久都随意。

original: Falkreath is our home, a place where we have good jobs under a good Jarl. Until the war comes to us we stay put.
traduit: 佛克瑞斯是我们的家，我们在这里有好领主，好工作。直到战争来临前，我们都会在这里。

original: Falkreath is where people go to die. We could be fighting, taking back Nord land!
traduit: 佛克瑞斯是人们死后的归宿。我们可以战斗，夺回诺德的土地！

original: Another day in this graveyard.
traduit: 又在这墓地里转了一天。

original: Falkreath is a fine place to be, Bolund.
traduit: 佛克瑞斯是个好地方啊，波伦德。

original: Thank you sir.
traduit: 谢谢你，先生。

original: Don't let my brother get to you, Tekla. You're doing a fine job around here.
traduit: 别让我兄长影响到你了，苔卡拉。你在这里干的很好。

original: Tekla. The Hall is filthy. See to your cleaning.
traduit: 苔卡拉。大厅太脏了。打扫打扫。

original: Hmmf. Maybe you're the one talking to him then...
traduit: 嗯。那也许你就是那个跟他说话的人……

original: We've been over this, Den. Tekla does not share your secrets with Siddgeir.
traduit: 我们已经说过了，老丹。苔卡拉不会把你的秘密告诉西德盖尔的。

original: Do you think Tekla has been talking to Siddgeir again?
traduit: 你觉不觉得苔卡拉又和西德盖尔联络了？

original: That's kind of you, Lod.
traduit: 谢谢你，罗德。

original: You know how farming is here, long days and little to show for it.
traduit: 你也知道这里的农业怎么样，忙活时间很长，但没什么收获。

original: Mathies. I wanted to say I'm sorry about what happened to your girl.
traduit: 马西斯。我为你女儿的遭遇感到遗憾。

original: How's the Corpselight treating you Mathies?
traduit: 马西斯，尸光农场怎么样了？

original: Yes, yes I do.
traduit: 没错，我有。

original: Do you ever get tired of the long days on the farm, Mathias?
traduit: 马西斯，你有厌倦农场的漫长白天吗？

original: Do you ever get tired of long nights at the mill, Zaria?
traduit: 萨莉亚，你有没有厌倦在木材厂的漫漫长夜？

original: Sure it is, Lod. Sure it is.
traduit: 当然了，罗德。就是这样。

original: The Gentle Repose is barren, it was barren the day my father claimed the land and it's barren now.
traduit: 温柔休眠很无聊，我父亲那阵子就很无聊，现在也很无聊。

original: Hey, Lod, how is the worst farmer in the hold doing?
traduit: 嘿，罗德，领内最差的农民怎么样了？

original: Bolund, you're going to die of thirst if you keep calling me that.
traduit: 波伦德，你再这么叫我就渴死你。

original: Hey gossip, bring me a drink.
traduit: 嘿，包打听，再给我来一杯。

original: The way this war is going there might not be anyone left to drink soon.
traduit: 照这场战争的发展趋势，很快也就没人能喝了。

original: The way this war is going you'll soon have plenty of veterans like me to buy drinks.
traduit: 照这场战争的发展趋势，很快就会有很多我这样的老兵来你这儿买酒喝了。

original: Keep them coming and keep them strong, Valga.
traduit: 让他们来，让他们强，瓦尔加。

original: At some point we should hire Tekla on here. If she could just spend less time serving Dengeir...
traduit: 我们应该雇苔卡拉来。这样她就能少花些时间服侍丹格尔了……

original: I wish I could afford to pay you both, Narri.  I really do.
traduit: 我也希望能付得起你俩的薪水，纳里。我是说真的。

original: Alright, but if you ever want to leave that old curmudgeon I've got plenty for you to do at Gentle Repose.
traduit: 好吧，但如果你想离开那个老吝啬鬼，我有很多事让你去“温柔休眠”做。

original: Ah Tekla, you're a pretty little mouse.
traduit: 啊苔卡拉，你可真是个可爱的小老鼠。

original: Leave me alone, Lod.
traduit: 离我远点，罗德。

original: I don't know about you, tekla, but all my prayers are silent and who I pray to is still my own to decide.
traduit: 我不知你怎么想，苔卡拉，但我所有的祈祷都是默念的，我向谁祈祷仍然由我自己做主。

original: But what about the banning of Talos worship? Isn't that worth fighting about?
traduit: 但塔洛斯信仰禁令呢？难道不值得争吗？

original: I think the war is just an excuse. If it does end there will be a new reason and a new place.
traduit: 我觉得战争只是个借口。如果真的结束了，那也会有新的理由和新的场所。

original: Narri, do you think the war will ever end?
traduit: 纳里，你觉得战争会结束吗？

original: Hmmm, well don't take what you don't have to.
traduit: 嗯，也别太上心了。

original: As he should I suppose.
traduit: 一如既往吧。

original: Tekla! It's good to see you, girl. How's Dengeir treating you?
traduit: 苔卡拉！很高兴见到你啊，姑娘。丹格尔对你怎么样？

original: We had this same argument every week, even when you were Jarl.
traduit: 我们周周都有同样的争吵，你当领主的时候也一样。

original: The impertinence! You never would have talked to me like that when I was Jarl.
traduit: 忒没礼貌！我以前当领主的时候，你也这么跟我说话吗。

original: The mead is same as it ever was and the meat is fresh, maybe your sense of taste has "gone off."
traduit: 蜜酒和以前一样，肉也是新鲜的，也许是你的味觉失灵了。

original: Narri! This mead tastes like water and the meat has gone off.
traduit: 纳里！这蜜酒喝着跟水似的，肉也臭了。

original: And now winter is coming.
traduit: 现在冬天来了。

original: I suppose so. Seems like it was just turning summer yesterday.
traduit: 我想也是。好像昨天刚到夏天似的。

original: The fields will need cutting soon.
traduit: 很快又该收割田地了。

original: Men aren't good or bad. They're just men.
traduit: 人没有好坏之分。只是人而已。

original: There are a lot of good men buried here, Kust.
traduit: 这里安葬着很多好人啊，卡斯特。

original: Most of my friends are buried here.
traduit: 我大多数朋友都葬在这里了。

original: You visit us often, Thadgeir.
traduit: 你总是来我们这儿啊，塔盖尔。

original: Please place your hands on the altar. Azura wishes to speak with you.
traduit: 请把手放在祭坛上。阿祖拉想和你谈谈。

original: I guess you get used to it.
traduit: 我想你会习惯的。

original: There he goes. Looks like he's gone for good this time.
traduit: 他在那。看来这次走远了。

original: Wait!
traduit: 等等！

original: Draugr creeping down the mountain to climb through my window at night, that kind of thing. I admit, I still don't much like the look of it.
traduit: 尸鬼半夜爬下山想爬进我家窗户，那东西确实不讨喜。

original: Looks like he's gone for good this time. But I don't think we should stick around to see if he comes back.
traduit: 看来他走远了。但咱们不能待在这等他回来。

original: Thank you, good patrons of the Bannered Mare! Thank you!
traduit: 谢谢，悬旗母马的好客人们！谢谢！

original: Nnnnooowwwwwww....
traduit: 哦~

original: One more song, what say you? Yeah? All right, then!
traduit: 你说再来一首？是吗？好吧！

original: Thank you, thank you. No, please, hold your applause.
traduit: 谢谢，谢谢。不，拜托，别拍巴掌了。

original: We don't just let people rot in cells until they've served their time. Here, you fight.
traduit: 我们不会让犯人在伏法前烂在牢房里。在这里，你得战斗。

original: If you win, you go free.
traduit: 赢了，也就自由了。

original: If you lose, well, you'll know the freedom of Sovngarde if you're lucky.
traduit: 如果你输了，那你也可能幸运地感受到松加德的自由。

original: Well aren't you in luck. He's the next piece of gutter scum on the docket. Between you and me, I hope you cleave his arrogant head open.
traduit: 你真幸运。他是下一个要被起诉的人渣。私底下跟你说，我真希望你把他傲慢的脑袋敲开。

original: I want to fight Alain Dufont.
traduit: 我想和阿兰·杜峰特决斗。

original: All right. Head to the pit when you think you're ready.
traduit: 很好。准备好就去坑里吧。

original: What is this, you think you're clever?
traduit: 怎么，你觉得你很聪明？

original: If you want to fight your way out of here, you have to do it in the Pit.
traduit: 如果你想从这里打出去，就去深坑竞技场吧。

original: Gotta give the crowd a show.
traduit: 去给观众表演一场。

original: Luckily there's no shortage of Pit bait around here. Now get in there and earn your freedom.
traduit: 还好这里不缺坑饵。想要自由就自己去争吧。

original: All right, meat, it's time for you to earn your freedom.
traduit: 好了，肉块。你该重获自由了。

original: We're going to make them pay.
traduit: 我们要让他们付出代价。

original: Those bastards will regret raising their weapons against Jorrvaskr.
traduit: 那些混蛋会后悔与月瓦斯卡动手的。

original: Let's get back to Jorrvaskr. We'll want to pay our respects to Kodlak's spirit.
traduit: 回月瓦斯卡吧，我们得向克拉科的精魂致敬。

original: By Ysmir, it's true. A jester - funny suit and all. Just north, by the Loreius Farm. Fool had a coffin in a cart, with a broken wheel.
traduit: 伊斯米尔在上，是真的。有个穿着滑稽衣服的小丑在北边，罗瑞尤斯的农场旁边。那傻瓜装棺材的马车轮子坏了。

original: Thought did cross my mind, yeah. War brewing, talk of a riot in Helgen, and now jesters? Skyrim's gone mad, girl. You need to be careful out there.
traduit: 我确实想过。战争一触即发，海尔根又传来被毁的传言，现在还有个小丑？天际疯了，姑娘。你在外面得小心点。

original: You sound like my ma. Figured I was lying dead in a field somewhere, is that it?
traduit: 你说话怎么像我妈似的。老是以为我死在哪儿了？

original: Well, sounds like you've had quite the journey, Uthgerd. But you were gone longer than usual. I got to thinking maybe you weren't coming back...
traduit: 哎，听起来你是经历了很多，乌斯盖德。但你这次离开的时间比平时长。我还以为你回不来了……
