original: I owe you a debt, and I aim to repay it. We'll see each other again someday. For now, goodbye, and thanks.
traduit: 我欠你一份情，我会报答你的。希望还能再见面。现在，告辞了，谢谢你。

original: He won't bother you again.
traduit: 他不会再打扰你了。

original: How did... no, forget it. I don't care to know. I'm free of the little man, and that's what matters.
traduit: 你是怎么……不，算了吧。我不想知道。我摆脱了那小男人，这才是重点。

original: I haven't dealt with him yet.
traduit: 我还没和他说呢。

original: I didn't expect to see you again. What became of my doting husband?
traduit: 没想到还能见到你。我那个溺爱我过头的丈夫怎么样了？

original: Oh, it's you. I didn't think you could handle this on your own. Did you get rid of Christer?
traduit: 哦，是你啊。我以为你一个人处理不了呢。克利斯特走了吗？

original: You monster!  I'll kill you for this!
traduit: 你这个怪物！我要杀了你！

original: I had to kill her. She attacked me.
traduit: 我不得不杀了她。她袭击了我。

original: What?  My Fjola would never...
traduit: 什么？我的弗约拉才不会……

original: I found this ring, but no sign of her.
traduit: 我找到了这枚戒指，但没发现她的踪迹。

original: Her marriage band? Then there's hope - she was here!
traduit: 她的婚戒？那就有希望了，她来过这里！

original: I have to move on if I want to find her. Please, take the coin I promised. Blessings of Stendarr on you!
traduit: 如果我想找到她，就得向前看。请收下我承诺的报酬。愿斯丹达尔祝福你！

original: I'll try getting him to leave.
traduit: 我会想办法让他离开的。

original: Take my wedding band. Stuhn only knows why I've kept it this long. He'll recognize it. Tell him whatever you think will convince him to leave.
traduit: 拿着我的婚戒吧。只有斯图恩知道我为什么要留这么久。他会认出来的。随便你怎么说服他离开。

original: The ring itself is worth a few bits. Keep it as thanks for cutting off the last vestige of an unwanted fate.
traduit: 这枚戒指本身不值几个钱。收下吧，算是斩断不想要的命运的最后一丝痕迹。

original: What am I supposed to tell Christer?
traduit: 我该如何和克利斯特说？

original: I don't know. I never expected the old bag to follow me so far. Just get rid of him.
traduit: 我不知道。我从没想过那个老家伙会追着我走这么远。把他赶走吧。

original: But don't kill him. I don't hate the man. I just want him to go back to his farm and forget about me.
traduit: 但别杀他。我不恨他。我只是想让他回到农场，然后忘了我。

original: This is pointless. I should just kill you and be done with it.
traduit: 毫无意义。我应该就此杀了你了结这一切。

original: Better men have tried. Let's finish this.
traduit: 更强的男人早就试过了。那就来吧。

original: You think so? Let's see who the real woman is here.
traduit: 你这么想吗？那就看看咱们谁才是真正的女人吧。

original: There's no way you'll come peacefully?
traduit: 你就不能心平气和的回去吗？

original: None. Not back to him.
traduit: 不行。我不会回到他身边了。

original: That's quite a story.
traduit: 很好的故事。

original: And it won't end here. I'd die before I went back.
traduit: 但这不是结束。我死也不愿意回去。

original: Didn't take much to prove myself and knock them into shape. Now every free blade from here to Windhelm wants to sign on for a piece.
traduit: 没花多少工夫就证明了自己，然后把他们带得井井有条。现在从这里到风舵城，有的是自由剑客想来入伙。

original: Wait. You know him?
traduit: 等等。你认识他？

original: The fool's my husband. I'm Fjola - or I was, once. Don't you see?
traduit: 那个傻瓜是我丈夫。我就是弗约拉，或者说曾经是。明白了吗？

original: I left that old scab. Came home to Skyrim, and found this rabble of bandits.
traduit: 我留下了那个老傻瓜。从家里走到天际，找到了这伙强盗。

original: Her husband sent me. Where is she?
traduit: 她丈夫派我来的。她在哪儿？

original: Christer?  He's here?
traduit: 克利斯特？他在这儿？

original: Stand aside, woman. I'm here for Fjola!
traduit: 站一边去，女人。我是来找弗约拉的！

original: Fjola?  How do you know that name?
traduit: 弗约拉？你怎么知道那个名字的？

original: All right, snowback. Who are you, and what are you doing in my tower?
traduit: 好了。你是谁，在我的塔楼里干什么？

original: She's dead, but I found this.
traduit: 她死了，但我找到这个。

original: That... I gave it to her on our wedding day. Help me, Divines... it's true isn't it?
traduit: 这……这是我们结婚那天我送给她的。圣灵啊，帮帮我……这是真的吗？

original: I'm sorry. Keep the ring. I cannot bear the weight of them in my heart, and I must make the journey alone now. Thank you for... thank you.
traduit: 抱歉。戒指请你收下吧。我承受不了它们在我心中的重量，现在我必须一个人走了。谢谢……谢谢你。

original: Until you can find out whether Fjola is here there's nothing I care to to discuss.
traduit: 先帮我弄清楚弗约拉在不在这里，别的我都没心思聊。

original: What news? Why isn't Fjola with you?
traduit: 有消息吗？为什么弗约拉没跟你一起？

original: One of the guards dropped this key while I hid. I wager it will come in handy for you. Please hurry!
traduit: 我藏起来的时候，有个守卫掉了这把钥匙。我猜你早晚用得上。请快点！

original: Very well. I'll look for her.
traduit: 好吧。我去找她。

original: Thank you! I don't have much, but I can give you some coin for the trouble.
traduit: 谢谢你！我的钱是不多了，但我还是能给你一些报酬的。

original: You're sure she's being held here?
traduit: 你确定她被关在这里？

original: Honestly? I have no idea. But I've looked all over and the kidnappings here started around when she disappeared. So I have to hope...
traduit: 说实在的？我也不知道。但我到处都找遍了，绑架案就是在她失踪前后发生的。所以我也只能寄希望于此了……

original: I managed to sneak past the guards and get this far, but... I don't think I can go on. I'm no warrior! Please, can you look for her?
traduit: 我设法溜过守卫走到这里，但是……我可能撑不下去了。我不是战士！你能帮我找找她吗？

original: I heard a rumor that these bandits were ransoming captives, so I thought she may be here.
traduit: 我听说这里有群强盗绑架勒索，所以我觉得她可能在这儿。

original: Fjola, my wife, left the farm on errands and never came back. It's been months, and I've been searching for her since.
traduit: 我老婆弗约拉前阵子离开农场办事，就再也没回来。已经好几个月了，我一直在找她。

original: Calm down. Just tell me what happened.
traduit: 冷静点。跟我说发生什么了。

original: I'm sorry, I'm just... you're right. Let me explain.
traduit: 对不起，我只是……你说得对。容我解释一下。

original: It's my wife, Fjola!  I think she's being held in this tower.
traduit: 是我妻子，弗约拉！她应该是被关在这个塔楼里了。

original: Stendarr's mercy - you aren't one of them. Please, you've got to help me!
traduit: 斯丹达尔垂慈，你不是他们一伙的。拜托，请一定帮帮我！

original: Is there any way to cleanse the Star?
traduit: 有办法净化吗？

original: Greetings, mortal. You have followed my guidance through the veils of Twilight and rescued my Star from Malyn Varen.
traduit: 你好啊，凡人。你追随我的指引，穿过暮光的薄纱，从马林·瓦伦手中取回了我之星辰。

original: But his soul still resides within, protected by his enchantments. Until he is purged, my artifact is useless to you.
traduit: 但他的灵魂还盘踞其中，被他的魔法保护着。在他被净化前，我的神器对你毫无用处。

original: Now, take a deep breath.
traduit: 现在，深呼吸。

original: First, I'll need to grab hold of your soul.
traduit: 首先，我需要抓住你的灵魂。

original: I'm ready to enter the Star.
traduit: 我准备好进入星辰内部了。

original: Okay. Stand very still. This might sting.
traduit: 好。站好了。可能会有些痛。

original: What do I do once I'm inside?
traduit: 我进去之后要做什么？

original: Malyn's soul should be in the Star. Theoretically, purging him will be just like killing a ghost anywhere else.
traduit: 马林的灵魂应该还在这颗星的内部。理论上，净化他和在外界杀死鬼魂没区别。

original: I'll have a magical tether to your soul while you're inside. Once you're done, it'll be as simple as pulling you back into your body.
traduit: 你进去的时候我会用魔法拴住你的灵魂。一旦你成功，我就能很轻易把你拉回肉体里。

original: What's to keep me from ending up like Malyn?
traduit: 为什么我没变的像马林那样？

original: Malyn's soul is beyond hope because his body is dead. But I'll be keeping you just slightly alive on this end.
traduit: 马林的灵魂已经因为肉体死去没救了。但我会在这边维持你勉强存活直到结束。

original: But be careful. If you die inside the Star, your soul will be disrupted. There's nothing anyone can do for you if that happens.
traduit: 但还是要小心。如果你死在星的内部，灵魂就会被破坏。那样的话谁也救不了你。

original: You want to send my soul inside, don't you?
traduit: 你想把我的灵魂送进去？

original: A special type of soul trap. Placing you inside the Star without fully killing you. Once Malyn has been dealt with, I'll bring you back.
traduit: 一种特殊的摄魂陷阱。在不完全杀死你的前提下，把你送进阿祖拉之星内部。一旦解决了马林，我就把你带回来。

original: I don't like where this is going.
traduit: 感觉不太妙啊。

original: I could soul trap you. Place you inside the Star. Then bring you back once Malyn has been dealt with.
traduit: 我会对你释放摄魂陷阱。把你放在阿祖拉之星内部。等解决了马林再带你回来。

original: I understand if you need some time to prepare. Let me know when you're ready.
traduit: 你需要时间准备的话，我能理解。准备好了告诉我就行。

original: So we need to deal with Malyn somehow.
traduit: 那我们得解决马林才行。

original: Precisely. But it's not as simple as enchanting Malyn away. He's put up barriers. Souls are only allowed in, not out.
traduit: 一语中的。但不是用魔法赶走马林那么简单。他设置了屏障，内部的灵魂只能进不能出。

original: If we were to... somehow... send a soul inside the Star. One that was ready to overpower Malyn from the inside....
traduit: 如果我们……想办法……把灵魂送到阿祖拉之星里面，从内部制服马林……

original: He did it. He actually managed to trap his own soul inside the Star, but it's falling apart. It needs more and more souls to sustain itself.
traduit: 他真做到了，成功把自己当灵魂困在了阿祖拉之星里。不过星已经要崩溃了，需要更多灵魂来维持。

original: Won't that kill him?
traduit: 那样不会杀死他吗？

original: He's already dead. Worse, the enchantment keeping him intact requires black souls. I don't know how many people he must have killed.
traduit: 他已经死了。更恶劣的是，维持他自身完整的附魔需要黑色灵魂。真不知道他杀了多少人。

original: If we don't do something, the enchantment will eventually fade, and the Star will slip back into Oblivion. Azura will have the last laugh.
traduit: 如果我们无所作为，等附魔消失，星辰回归湮灭。阿祖拉就成了最大赢家。

original: Somewhat, yes. At first it seemed a distant thing, heard only in the idle speech of guards and traders.
traduit: 某种程度上是的。起初事不关己，只是在卫兵和商人的闲谈里有个耳闻。

original: When the wounded soldiers began to return from battle, I did what I could to help them.
traduit: 当受伤的士兵开始从战场上回来，我会尽我所能帮他们。

original: As more of the sick and injured came to the temple, my work as a healer became more important than my duties as a priestess.
traduit: 随着越来越多的伤病号来到神殿，我身为治疗师的工作也变得比当祭司更重要了。

original: I wish only an end to the fighting, so that I can tend to the temple once more.
traduit: 我只希望战争能够结束，这样我就能回归神殿职责了。

original: Has the Stormcloak uprising affected your duties?
traduit: 风暴斗篷起义影响到你的职责了吗？

original: Indeed. The temple here in the city is my charge.
traduit: 没错。我负责城里的神殿。

original: The goddess's divine blessings have no doubt helped make Whiterun a thriving and prosperous city.
traduit: 毫无疑问，正是有女神的神圣祝福，白漫才能成为一个繁荣昌盛的城市。

original: After all, it is she who brings rain to our crops and fair weather on the harvest days.
traduit: 毕竟是她在播种时带来雨水，在收获时带来晴日。

original: You're a priestess of Kynareth?
traduit: 你是凯娜瑞丝祭司吗？

original: Aren't you worried you'll be arrested?
traduit: 你不担心被捕吗？

original: Let them come! I have no fear, for Talos is my ally and I am his prophet. His word is upon my lips, his voice in my throat.
traduit: 让他们放马过来！我不怕，塔洛斯就是我的盟友，我是他的先知。他之言语寄于我之唇舌，他之声音蕴于我之咽喉。

original: Why was Talos worship outlawed?
traduit: 塔洛斯信仰为什么非法？

original: Because the so-called Emperor is a coward! That's right, I said coward!
traduit: 因为所谓的皇帝就是个懦夫！没错，我说他就是懦夫！

original: Oh yes! He agreed to banish the worship of Talos at the tip of an Aldmeri sword. They called it the "White-Gold Concordat."
traduit: 哦没错！他同意了在先祖神洲的剑尖下废除了塔洛斯崇拜。他们管这个叫“白金协定”。

original: Well, I call it blasphemy! A true son of the Empire would never have turned his back on our greatest hero, not at any price.
traduit: 哼，我看这就是亵渎！真正的帝国之子绝不会背叛我们最伟大的英雄，无论付出什么代价都不会！

original: Well, let me tell you something, friend. Cyrodiil is a long way from here, and in Skyrim, we will never forsake mighty Talos!
traduit: 朋友，我跟你说。希罗帝尔离这儿远着呢，我们永远不会抛弃强大的塔洛斯！

original: What can you tell me about Talos?
traduit: 你能跟我说说塔洛斯吗？

original: Hello, my friend! If you seek knowledge about mighty Talos, you have most certainly come to the right person.
traduit: 你好啊，我的朋友！如果你想了解强大的塔洛斯，那你算是找对人了。

original: In mortal life, Talos was a Nord possessed of unmatched tactical skill, limitless wisdom and the power to see into men's hearts.
traduit: 在凡人时期，塔洛斯是一个拥有无比战争才能、无限智慧和洞察人心力量的诺德人。

original: Talos mastered the power of the Voice, and with it he united the lands of men into a great Empire.
traduit: 塔洛斯掌握着吼声的力量，用它把人类的领土整合成了一个伟大的帝国。

original: In southern lands, he was known by the name Tiber Septim. Here in Skyrim, we honor him by his proper Nord name.
traduit: 在南方，他被称为泰伯·塞普汀。在天际，我们会用他的真名来纪念他。

original: So great was his reign in life, when he ascended to the heavens he was made lord of the Divines.
traduit: 当他荣升天堂的时候，由于他生前伟大的统治，他成为了众圣灵之主。

original: If you want to know more, I'm sure you can find any number of tomes on the subject.
traduit: 如果你想知道更多，相关的典籍那是多得是啊。

original: What are the duties of a court wizard?
traduit: 宫廷巫师的职责是什么？

original: I'll put it simply, so you'll understand. I advise the Jarl in matters of magic.
traduit: 我简单点说，省得你听不明白。我在魔法方面为领主提供建议。

original: If the hold is faced with any threats or mysteries of a magical nature, I am called upon to explain things and suggest a course of action.
traduit: 如果领地面临任何魔法性质的威胁或神秘事件，我会应要求做出解释并提供行动方案。

original: Hopefully that answer will satisfy you. Good day.
traduit: 希望这个答案能让你满意。日安。

original: Do you owe allegiance to the Imperials?
traduit: 你们效忠于帝国吗？

original: If I said that was a tedious question, would you be smart enough to know what I meant? Probably not.
traduit: 如果我说这个问题很无聊，你会聪明地直接领会我的意思吗？可能是不会。

original: As long as I'm left alone to pursue my research, I don't care who gives the orders.
traduit: 只要能让我一个人安安静静做研究，谁来下命令无所谓。

original: Now, I'm a busy man and your pointless questions are boring me terribly. Good day.
traduit: 我是个大忙人，你那些毫无意义的问题把我烦透了。日安吧。

original: Have you encountered any dragons?
traduit: 你有遇到过龙吗？

original: Sadly, no. My work affords me few opportunities for such an adventure.
traduit: 很遗憾，没有。我的工作很少能提供冒险的机会。

original: Perhaps some hero will bring one to Dragonsreach, like old Olaf One-Eye once did.
traduit: 也许会有英雄带一头到龙临宫来，就像古时候的“独眼”奥拉夫一样。

original: What a fascinating conversation that would be!
traduit: 那到时候可真就有得聊了！

original: What threats does the jarl face?
traduit: 领主面临什么威胁？

original: Take your pick. Dragons, Stormcloak assassins, ambitious and unscrupulous nobles... Sometimes I think his own children want him dead.
traduit: 那可多了。龙族、风暴斗篷刺客、野心勃勃的无耻贵族……有时候我觉得他自己的孩子都想要他死。

original: And those are just the physical threats. Assaults on his sanity are another matter entirely.
traduit: 这些还只是人身安全上的威胁，更不用说那些精神上的折磨了。

original: Every day, he deals with obsequious functionaries and incompetent bureaucrats. Sadly, I'm not allowed to eliminate them.
traduit: 每天他都要应付谄媚的职员和无能的官僚。可惜，我无权除掉这些人。

original: Well, not yet, anyway.
traduit: 好吧，至少现在做不到。

original: What does a Housecarl do?
traduit: 侍卫是做什么的？

original: I am charged with protecting the Jarl from any and all threats.
traduit: 我负责保护领主不受任何威胁。

original: Powerful men have many enemies. More so, in times of strife. So you can imagine the dangers.
traduit: 当权者总会有很多敌人。冲突时期更甚。所以其中危险可想而知。

original: Oh yes, there have been attempts on the Jarl's life. More than one would-be assassin has met his end at the tip of my blade.
traduit: 没错，总有人企图谋害领主。好几个不自量力的刺客，都死在了我的剑下。

original: How did a dark elf come to be Housecarl?
traduit: 一个暗精灵是怎么成为侍卫的？

original: Balgruuf and I share a battle bond. We met as youths, and forged our friendship in the fires of war.
traduit: 我和巴尔古夫是战友。年轻时候就认识了，在战火中结下了友谊。

original: When he became Jarl, I insisted on serving as his protector. He had no cause to argue.
traduit: 当他当了领主，我坚持要保护他。他也没理由拒绝。

original: Gods, you are curious. Almost... dangerously so.
traduit: 神啊，你的好奇心太强了，几乎到了……危险的程度。

original: Why is the keep called Dragonsreach?
traduit: 龙临宫的名字从何而来？

original: That is an old tale, but well known to those of us who serve in the keep.
traduit: 这是个古老的故事了，但我们这些在城堡里服侍的人都知道。

original: Long ago, there lived a mighty hero of the Nords. Olaf One-Eye. Olaf did battle with a fearsome dragon named Numinex.
traduit: 很久以前，诺德有个大英雄叫“独眼”奥拉夫。奥拉夫与一头名为怒米奈科斯的可怕巨龙打过一仗。

original: The struggle between Olaf and the dragon culminated in a mighty duel atop Mount Anthor, with Olaf the victor.
traduit: 奥拉夫与巨龙在安索尔山山巅爆发了一场激烈大战，奥拉夫赢了。

original: Olaf returned in triumph to Whiterun. By his decree, the city's keep was rebuilt as a prison for Numinex.
traduit: 后来他凯旋而归。按照他的命令，城里的这个城堡被重建成了关押怒米奈科斯的监狱。

original: And so, from that time until this, our great keep has been called "Dragonsreach."
traduit: 所以自那之后这里就叫做“龙临宫”了。

original: What's the city's history?
traduit: 能跟我介绍一下城市的历史吗？

original: Ah, splendid! Our fine city has a proud history, and I'm happy to share what I know.
traduit: 啊，太好了！我们这座美丽的城市有着自豪的历史，我很乐意分享我所知道的。

original: The history of Whiterun begins with Jorrvaskr, the hall of the Companions. For a long time, it was the only building on the mountain.
traduit: 白漫城的历史起源自战友团的大厅，月瓦斯卡。很长一段时间，它都是山上唯一的建筑。

original: As time passed, a thriving community sprang up around Jorrvaskr, as was common with mead halls.
traduit: 随着时间推移，就像很多蜜酒大厅那样，月瓦斯卡周围兴起了一个繁荣的社群。

original: Today, Whiterun is the jewel of Skyrim. I can say without boast that is the greatest city in all the holds.
traduit: 如今，白漫城就是天际的明珠。我可以毫不自夸地讲，这是所有领地里最伟大的城市。

original: How can you protect Whiterun from the dragons?
traduit: 你要如何从龙族手中保护白漫？

original: With good planning and constant vigilance.
traduit: 紧密筹划，保持警惕。

original: Even now, my court wizard, Farengar, continues his research into ways we might drive back these terrors.
traduit: 就连现在，我的宫廷巫师法仁加还在研究击退这些恐怖生物的办法。

original: We must also have ample reserves of water to combat the fires that will surely spread after an attack.
traduit: 我们必须储备足够的水来扑灭龙袭后蔓延的大火。

original: But our greatest weapon? Courage. For if we cannot kill the beast, we must at least have the tenacity to drive it back.
traduit: 但我们最大的武器是什么？勇气。就算我们不能杀死这些畜生，至少也有毅力把它赶出去。

original: Until brave heroes step forward to destroy these monsters, that is the best we can do.
traduit: 直到有勇敢的英雄们站出来消灭这些怪物，我们能做的也就这些了。

original: We must have ample reserves of water to combat the fires that will surely spread after an attack.
traduit: 我们必须储备足够的水来扑灭龙袭后蔓延的大火。

original: What will it take to end the war?
traduit: 如何才能结束战争？

original: Ulfric Stormcloak's head on a pike.
traduit: 直到把乌弗瑞克的脑袋插在长矛上。

original: Do you think Ulfric really cares about Skyrim's independence, or the welfare or its people? I promise you, he doesn't.
traduit: 你真以为乌弗瑞克在乎天际的独立或者人民的福祉？我可以保证，不可能。

original: He's nothing more than a barbarian renegade, whose lust for power has cost the lives of countless innocents.
traduit: 他不过就是个野蛮的叛徒，他的权力欲害死了无数无辜的人。

original: Tell me about the city's districts.
traduit: 跟我说说这个城市的区域划分吧。

original: Well, there are three of them. Arranged in three tiers, as you may have noticed.
traduit: 嗯，你也应该注意到了，这里有三个区。城被分成了三层。

original: The Plains District is so named because it's the closest of the three to the plains that surround the city. The inn and marketplace are found there.
traduit: 平原区得名于离城外平原最近。旅店集市都集中在那边。

original: Most of the city's residents live in the Wind District, which is the middle of the three.
traduit: 城里大部分居民都住在中间的风区。

original: Dragonsreach occupies the highest, which we call the Cloud District. From here, the Jarl can see all that goes on within his city.
traduit: 龙临宫占据了最高位，我们称这里为云顶区。从这里，领主可以俯瞰到他城中发生的一切。

original: I have a letter from your father.
traduit: 我有一封你父亲的信。

original: I guess some things never change. Thanks for bringing this to me. Here, for your trouble.
traduit: 我想有些事永远不会改变。谢谢你带过来给我。给你，麻烦了。

original: I don't have time.
traduit: 我没时间。

original: Typical. Well don't mind me, then.
traduit: 好吧。那不用管我了。

original: Hand me the letter. I'll take it to him.
traduit: 把信给我吧。我去给他送去。

original: Good. You make sure the lug tips you when he gets it.
traduit: 好。送到之后别忘了找那笨蛋要点钱。

original: You said your son is in Old Hroldan?
traduit: 你说你儿子在古霍尔丹？

original: That's right. Old inn to the south. The oaf doesn't even bother to visit these days. What am I supposed to do if the dragons burn down the farm?
traduit: 对。南边那个老旅店。这白痴现在连回来看看都懒得来了。如果龙把农场烧了，我该怎么办？

original: You're a traveler, right? I have this letter for him. Let him know how much of a failure he is.
traduit: 你是旅行者吧？我有封信给他。让他知道自己多失败。

original: They'll be gone as soon as they've found whoever they're looking for. And we'll have all the more coin.
traduit: 他们只要一找到人就会走。咱们还能拿更多的钱。

original: Keep it to yourself. They're not paying us to talk.
traduit: 管好你自己。他们付钱不是让咱们闲聊的。

original: I'm not sure I like these Alik'r warriors hiding out here. They seem like trouble.
traduit: 我不太喜欢这些阿里克'尔战士躲在这里。他们可能会是麻烦。

original: You want to be shipped off to Honorhall Orphanage?
traduit: 你想被送到荣耀堂孤儿院吗？

original: He has a terrible disease. It's very contagious.
traduit: 他得了很可怕的病。会传染的。

original: I'm his bodyguard. Mess with him, you mess with me.
traduit: 我是他的保镖，惹他就是惹我。

original: Okay, okay! I'll leave him alone! I was just kidding around. Besides, if he'd only kiss me, I wouldn't have to beat him up all the time...
traduit: 好吧，好吧！我离他远点就是了。我只是想跟他开个玩笑。而且如果他只要亲我一下，我也就不用一直揍他了……

original: Let's test that out some time.
traduit: 有时间咱们试试。

original: Aren't they slow? I can get in and out before you have one swing.
traduit: 那东西不迟钝吗？我可以在你挥动前连插带拔一气呵成。

original: Yes, you're very fond of saying that. You know I like hammers and axes.
traduit: 对，你很喜欢这么说。你知道我喜欢锤子和斧头。

original: What kind of weapon do you prefer? I like the smaller, quicker blades.
traduit: 你更喜欢哪种武器？我喜欢小一点，快一点的刀剑。

original: Young warriors are smart to listen to older ones. They've lived.
traduit: 聪明的年轻战士会遵从老战士的话。因为他们活下来了。

original: They're lording it over us all the time, though.
traduit: 但他们一直对我们趾高气昂的。

original: I don't think that's how the Circle works.
traduit: 我不认为圆环是这样运作的。

original: One day when you and I are on the Circle, we can change how things are run around here.
traduit: 等到你和我都进入圆环以后，咱们可以改变这里的一切。

original: If Eorlund made it, it's more likely you're gripping it wrong. Find me tomorrow and we can go over it.
traduit: 如果是厄伦德打的，那可能是你抓错方向了。明天找我再聊吧。

original: Can't you just tell me if the grip is bad?
traduit: 你就不能直接告诉我把手到底坏没坏吗？

original: I'm a warrior, not a blacksmith.
traduit: 我是战士，不是铁匠。

original: I've got a bad grip on my shield, could you take a look at it?
traduit: 我的盾牌把手不太好，你能帮我看看吗？

original: We all have different means to glory, Stonearm. Well done.
traduit: 我们有各自获得荣耀的方式，石臂。干得不错。

original: I'm telling you, it works. Let them ring their own ears on my shield, then scoop them up off the ground.
traduit: 我跟你说，很有效的。拿盾牌把他们震得耳朵嗡嗡响，然后在摔到地上。

original: I'm imagining you just standing your ground and letting them tire themselves out.
traduit: 我能想象你只是原地不动就让他们累得筋疲力尽了。

original: Just those same ruffians I was bringing in for the Shatter-Shields.
traduit: 还是同一帮混混，我帮碎盾收拾了。

original: So much wasted breath in that crew.
traduit: 跟那些人就不该废话。

original: Heard you had a bit of trouble near Solitude last week.
traduit: 听说你上次在独孤城附近遇到麻烦了。

original: They should be so lucky.
traduit: 但愿他们走运。

original: By you?
traduit: 被你杀了？

original: That they might get themselves killed.
traduit: 他们可能会因此丧命。

original: What then?
traduit: 那怎样？

original: Some of them might try. But that's not what I'm worried about.
traduit: 有人可能会尝试，但我不担心这个。

original: Worried one of them is going to take your place?
traduit: 担心他们有人会取代你吗？

original: All these younglings scampering around.
traduit: 最近这群小家伙太爱到处乱跑了。

original: You know the old man doesn't like it.
traduit: 你知道那老爷子不喜欢。

original: Let's just not be too obvious.
traduit: 还是别太张扬了。

original: There's nothing wrong with what we're doing.
traduit: 我们又没做错什么。

original: I've been thinking we need to be more... discreet.
traduit: 我一直在想，我们需要更加……谨慎。

original: Are you prepared for tonight's hunt?
traduit: 准备好今晚的狩猎了吗？

original: Of course not. My mistake.
traduit: 当然没有。算我说错了。

original: I've never held a knitting needle.
traduit: 我从来没拿过编织针。

original: It will feel that way for a while. But eventually you'll get used to it, and then you'll get faster with it.
traduit: 这种感觉会持续一段时间。但你总会习惯的，然后就能用得更快了。

original: After that, the shortsword will feel like a knitting needle when you pick it up again.
traduit: 在那之后，等你再次拿起这把短剑的时候，就会感觉轻如织针了。

original: It just feels so slow.
traduit: 感觉还是太慢了。

original: Exactly. When you have a big heavy weight swinging around your upper body, your lower body has to compensate or you'll fall right over.
traduit: 说得对。当你的上半身有很大的重量在摆动时，你的下半身必须跟着协力，否则很容易摔倒。

original: I guess that comes down to footwork, then.
traduit: 那看起来要在步法上下工夫了。

original: If you keep it in close, you'll have more control, but it can be harder to balance a strike.
traduit: 如果你握得比较近，那掌控就会更好，但攻击很难强力。

original: Should I be holding the blade further away than I would a smaller one?
traduit: 我握剑的时候应该远一点好还是近一点好？

original: Well you can either get better with a bow or try to learn from me.
traduit: 那你可以试着学学弓箭，或者跟我学也行。

original: It's just... I think our fighting styles are similar.
traduit: 只是……我觉得我们的战斗风格很像。

original: Because you wanted to learn the longer blades. Aela's never used anything bigger than a dagger.
traduit: 因为你想学长兵器。但艾拉就没用过比匕首更大的东西。

original: Why can't I train with Aela?
traduit: 为什么我不能和艾拉一起训练？

original: I guide the Companions. The Circle advises me. But we are all free warriors. Only our honor binds us together.
traduit: 我指引战友团，而圆环给我建议。但我们都是自由自在的战士。唯有荣誉把我们团结在了一起。

original: But aren't the Circle in charge? And don't you lead them?
traduit: 但不是圆环说了算吗？不是你在领导他们吗？

original: This isn't the military, son. There are no ranks.
traduit: 这里不是军队，孩子。没有位阶之分。

original: I just want to make sure I'm moving up.
traduit: 我只是想确保能够晋升。

original: Don't worry about such things. Just focus on your own honor. Bring glory to the Companions, and that glory will return upon you.
traduit: 不要为这些事烦恼。只需关注自己的荣誉。把荣耀带给战友团的同时，也是把荣耀带给你自己。

original: Do you think I could be a member of the Circle? Some day? If I work hard?
traduit: 如果我工作努力，你觉得我有一天能成为圆环一员吗？

original: Skjor has been a warrior for a long time. You would be wise to listen to him.
traduit: 斯科约尔是个老战士了。听他的没错。

original: Any warrior that gets to be old is either fearsome or a coward. I'll let you find out which Skjor is.
traduit: 任何老战士不是可怕就是懦弱。你会发现斯科约尔是哪类的。

original: Well why do I have to listen to Skjor, then?
traduit: 那我为什么要听斯科约尔的？

original: No one is in charge here. Each Shield-Brother is his own man, each Shield-Sister her own woman.
traduit: 这里没有人是管事人。每个盾牌兄弟都是自己的主人，盾牌姐妹亦如是。

original: Forgive me. You're just the one in charge, and it's what I'm used to.
traduit: 抱歉，你只是管事人，我习惯了。

original: My title is Harbinger, child. I am no man's master.
traduit: 我的头衔是先驱，孩子，我不是任何人的主人。

original: Master, I...
traduit: 主人，我……

original: Don't worry about me.
traduit: 别担心我了。

original: But even the bravest of men consider their actions. I want you to survive long enough to take the mantle.
traduit: 但即使是最勇敢的人也需要考虑自己的行为。我希望你活得够久，能够继承我的位置。

original: Thank you, Harbinger.
traduit: 谢谢你，先驱。

original: You're a strong warrior, Skjor. Your heart is fiery and that serves you well in battle.
traduit: 斯科约尔，你是个强大的战士。你的心很炽热，这在战斗中十分有效。

original: It's not confusing... just frustrating.
traduit: 不是糊涂……是沮丧。

original: I don't mean to confuse you.
traduit: 我不想把你们弄糊涂。

original: You speak in riddles sometimes.
traduit: 你有时说话就像猜谜语。

original: Come on now, boy, you know what I meant...
traduit: 别这样，孩子，你知道我说的是什么意思……

original: Well which is it? Look farther or closer?
traduit: 那到底是怎么样？是看远处还看近处？

original: If you want to lead this pack when I'm gone, you have to see farther. Look closer.
traduit: 如果你想在我走后领导这群人，那就要高瞻远瞩。还要细致入微。

original: To me as well. I think we don't see the same tradition at play here.
traduit: 对我来说也一样。但我觉得咱们说的不是一种传统。

original: Tradition is very important to me, son.
traduit: 传统对我来说十分重要，孩子。

original: Brave hearts beat lesser ones. That's the decider.
traduit: 勇敢的心会击溃脆弱的心，这才是关键所在。

original: Big swords should always beat little swords.
traduit: 大武器总是能击溃小武器。

original: When I was young, I favored huge swords, much like you. Hard to lift these days, but I still enjoy the heft of a good hammer.
traduit: 年轻的时候，喜欢大剑，和你一样。年纪大了举不动了，不过锤子的重量我还是喜欢的。

original: What weapon do you like, Harbinger?
traduit: 你喜欢什么武器啊，先驱？

original: Just have them focus on the calm in the battle. Control the rage, don't let it control you.
traduit: 要让他们在战斗中保持冷静。学会控制愤怒，不要反被愤怒控制。

original: I remember when you were the same way. The more they train, the more they'll cool down.
traduit: 我记得你也有这种时候。他们训练的越多，就会变得越冷静。

original: Some are too happy to fight. Blood runs hot.
traduit: 有些人太热衷战斗了。有些热血过头了。

original: How are the young ones coming along?
traduit: 最近的年轻人怎么样？

original: What glorious prey. Come back alive, and with stories to tell!
traduit: 真是增光添彩的猎物。要好好活着带故事回来啊。

original: Skjor's heard rumors of a bear the size of a mammoth in Hammerfell. We're going to seek it out.
traduit: 斯科约尔听说落锤有一头猛犸那么大的熊。我们想去找找看。

original: How goes the hunt?
traduit: 最近狩猎如何？

original: That's why it's best to not mistake foolhardiness for bravery.
traduit: 这就是为什么最好不要把鲁莽看做勇敢的原因。

original: I'm sorry. I didn't mean to snap. Just... these hunters. We're all on edge.
traduit: 抱歉，我不是故意发脾气的。只是……那些猎人。搞得我们很紧张。

original: You forget yourself, young one.
traduit: 你太忘我了，年轻人。

original: Where I go is my business. If you have a concern about my honor, bring it before the Circle.
traduit: 我要去哪儿是我的事。如果你担心我的名誉，可以在圆环里提出来。

original: I worry that you've been spending too many nights out.
traduit: 我担心你在外过夜的时间过多了。

original: Some of them, anyway.
traduit: 只是一部分吧。

original: Fighting people is different. Smarter.
traduit: 与人战斗可不一样。人更聪明。

original: I've been hunting on my own for years.
traduit: 我已经独自打猎好多年了。

original: Relax, new blood.
traduit: 放松点，新人。

original: But before I fought, I had to train.
traduit: 在我能去战斗前，也是经过训练的。

original: Easy for you to say. You get to fight.
traduit: 你说得倒轻巧。反正你能去打。

original: No fighting just yet. Not till Skjor says so. We train now.
traduit: 暂时没架可打。除非斯科约尔发话。我们现在还是得训练。

original: Enough with the training. I want to go fight something.
traduit: 训练到此为止之吧。我想去打些什么。

original: You'll do all right some day. Today you need to keep training, though.
traduit: 总有一天你会变强的。但现在你还是需要训练。

original: Well, when you put it that way...
traduit: 好吧，既然你这么说……

original: All I need is one to cut you in half.
traduit: 我只需要一个就能把你砍成两半了。

original: But ten little cuts...
traduit: 但十个小伤口也能……

original: Tiny blades don't hurt enough. A sword needs weight.
traduit: 小刀片伤人不重。剑就是得有点分量才好。

original: You might do well to learn a smaller weapon. Vary your style a bit.
traduit: 你最好学着用用小号的武器。改改你的战斗风格。

original: And they always come to regret it.
traduit: 但它们总是会后悔。

original: But whales eat razorfish.
traduit: 但鲸鱼会吃了剃刀鱼的。

original: It's called a shortsword, oaf. It's quicker. Sharper. Like a razorfish against a whale.
traduit: 那叫短剑，傻蛋。这东西又灵便又锋利。就像剃刀鱼斗巨鲸一样。

original: You only use the little swords.
traduit: 你只是用这么把小剑。

original: It's not exactly forbidden, but even so... it's not true. So that's that.
traduit: 也不是不行，但是即便如此……也不是真的。就是这么回事儿。

original: Is it not allowed?
traduit: 难道还不许了？

original: And if you want to keep having ears, you'll pretend you didn't.
traduit: 如果你你还想留着耳朵，那就最好假装没听过。

original: I've heard some rumors... about you and Skjor.
traduit: 我听到些谣言……关于你和斯科约尔。

original: Well, no. I'm just saying there's more to defense than muscle.
traduit: 嗯，没错。我只是想说，除了肌肉，还有别的防御手段。

original: But strength doesn't hurt.
traduit: 但强壮总不是坏事。

original: You have to remember, it's not about strength. It's about leverage.
traduit: 记住，这和力量无关。要靠杠杆作用。

original: How do you manage to hold your ground like that?
traduit: 你是怎么做到站的这么稳的？

original: Good. We'll take a short break, then move on to wide-area destruction spells.
traduit: 好。我们暂时休息一下，然后继续使用大范围毁灭魔法。

original: And begin.
traduit: 开始吧。

original: I will find you, Fjola!
traduit: 我找到你的，弗约拉！

original: Please, stranger! I need your help!
traduit: 拜托，陌生人！我需要你的帮助！

original: You - over here, quick. Before any of them show up!
traduit: 你，快过来。在他们出来之前！

original: Runil was one of the Thalmor during the war...
traduit: 鲁尼尔在战争期间曾是梭默的一员……

original: I knew he was troubled, but one of the Thalmor? I wish I could say I did not believe it. Thank you for telling me.
traduit: 我知道他很苦恼，但说他是梭默？我希望我能说我不相信。谢谢你告诉我。

original: I knew he was troubled but one of the Thalmor? I wish I could say I did not believe it. Thank you for telling me.
traduit: 我知道他很苦恼，但说他是梭默？我希望我能说我不相信。谢谢你告诉我。

original: Your secret is safe with me.
traduit: 我会帮你保守秘密的。

original: Thank you. May Arkay bless you. I won't forget this.
traduit: 谢谢。愿阿尔凯保佑你。我不会忘记的。

original: And you're afraid your friends will find out?
traduit: 你怕你的朋友们发现吗？

original: I dream about those days still. Except I'm not me. I can see myself there and I try to stop what I know is going to happen but...
traduit: 我仍旧会梦见那些岁月。除了我不是我自己。我能看到自己在那里，我试图阻止将要发生的事，但是……

original: Many of the Empire's troops were Nords at that point. Some of them could even have been from around here.
traduit: 当时帝国军有很多诺德人。甚至有些可能就是来自这附近。

original: The Thalmor?
traduit: 梭默？

original: They are the governing council of the Aldmeri Dominion. They lead us to attack the Empire and forced the Empire to agree to stop worshiping Talos.
traduit: 他们是先祖神洲的管理委员会。他们带领我们进攻帝国，并迫使帝国同意停止塔洛斯崇拜。

original: It was during the war with the Empire that I was at the height of my power. As a Thalmor battlemage I laid waste the enemy.
traduit: 正是在与帝国战争期间，我的力量达到了顶峰。身为梭默的战斗法师，我摧毁了不少敌人。

original: Men, women, children, no one was spared my wrath. I destroyed whole villages.
traduit: 男女老少，无人能在我的怒火下幸免于难。我摧毁过不少村庄。

original: Although I have not practiced in a long time I was once a wizard. Even when I was young my magic was undeniably powerful.
traduit: 虽然我很长时间没有练习了，但我曾经是个巫师。想当年年轻的时候，我的魔法那是不可否认的强大。

original: It was that power that brought me to the attention of the Thalmor. In the Summerset Isles it is a great honor to be chosen to serve the Thalmor.
traduit: 正是这种力量让我引起了梭默的注意。在夏暮岛，被选去为梭默效劳是莫大的荣幸。

original: Some of your friends feel you're troubled.
traduit: 你的朋友觉得你有麻烦。

original: Burying the past is much harder than burying remains. I'm... I'm afraid of what you will think of me if I tell you about the things I've done.
traduit: 埋葬过去比埋葬遗骸要难得多。我……我害怕如果告诉你我做过的事，你会怎样看我。

original: Lod has a book he stole from a grave.
traduit: 罗德有本从墓地偷来的书。

original: I knew something was up. I'll make sure he doesn't disrespect this place anymore. Honesty is a rare thing to find these days. Thank you.
traduit: 我就知道出事了。我会保证他不会继续不尊重这个地方。现如今诚实是很难能可贵的。谢谢你！

original: Sure, I'll take the book.
traduit: 好，我想要这本书。

original: Great.  Here you go. Come back later and I'll have other things.
traduit: 太好了。给你。待会儿再来，我要吃点别的东西。

original: A book?
traduit: 书？

original: Yeah, if your interested then I'll give you the book for free. If you like it you can come back later and I'll have other stuff.
traduit: 没错，要是感兴趣，这本就免费给你了。合心意的话，可以之后再来，还会有其他好货。

original: I mean, it don't cost me anything to let you have one and the dead won't notice their stuff missing. heh.
traduit: 我的意思是，给你也不会花我一分钱，而且死者也不会注意到他们的东西不见了。哈。

original: What sort of items?
traduit: 什么东西？

original: First off, let's keep this between us. I picked these up from the graves in town so don't go blabbing about it to Kust.
traduit: 首先，这件事就你知我知。这些是我从镇上的公墓捡回来的，所以别告诉卡斯特。

original: You have to understand, Gentle Repose is a fallow festering place I should have left a long time ago. This is one of the few ways I make any money.
traduit: 你要明白，我早该远离温柔休眠了。这是我为数不多的赚钱方式之一。

original: Right now I've got a book that I think you might like.
traduit: 我这里有一本你可能会喜欢的书。

original: Hey friend, you wouldn't happen to be looking for unusual items would you?
traduit: 嘿，朋友，你不会碰巧在找不寻常的东西吧？

original: I dislike the daedra looking into my future.
traduit: 我不喜欢迪德拉观看我的未来。

original: Oblivion has been watching you since the day you were conceived, mortal. Do not think that your life has been served by your will alone.
traduit: 湮灭自你出生起就一直在观察你，凡人。别以为你生命只为自己的意志服务。

original: Go now. I have seen the threads of your fate in the Twilight, and you still have much to accomplish.
traduit: 走吧。我在暮光中看到你命运之线，你还有很多事情要做。

original: Thank you, Lady Azura.
traduit: 谢谢你，阿祖拉女士。

original: Farewell, mortal. Know that Azura will be guarding over the threads of your fate in the Twilight.
traduit: 再会了，凡人。记住，阿祖拉会在暮色中守护你的命运之线。

original: My Star has been restored and Malyn's soul has been consigned to Oblivion. You have done well, mortal.
traduit: 我之星恢复原状，马林的灵魂也被送进湮灭。做得好，凡人。

original: As was destined, you are free to use my Star as you see fit.
traduit: 注定，你可以随意使用我之星辰。

original: Malyn wanted to alter the Star. He was dying. Disease. He thought he could store his own soul inside. Become immortal.
traduit: 马林想要改造阿祖拉之星。他当时疾病缠身，大限不远，以为可以通过把灵魂藏在里面达成不朽。

original: It drove him mad. Students started dying. Eventually, the College exiled him. He took a few loyal disciples to Ilinalta's Deep and vanished.
traduit: 这个想法最终使他疯狂，开始杀害学徒。最后，学院将他开除。他就带着几个忠心的门人跑到伊琳娜塔深渊隐居去了。

original: Look, I don't care who asked you to find the Star, but don't take it back to Azura. The Daedra are evil. They're the reason Malyn went insane.
traduit: 听着，不管谁让你去寻找那颗星，但千万别把它还给阿祖拉。迪德拉是邪恶的，马林就是被他们搞疯的。

original: And who are you to challenge me? I have conquered mortality itself. I've spat in the eyes of the Daedric Lords.
traduit: 你凭什么挑战我？我克服了死亡。还羞辱了迪德拉君王。

original: This is my realm now. I've sacrificed too much to let you take it from me!
traduit: 现在这是我的地盘。我牺牲了如此之多，岂能让你夺走！

original: Eventually, the Star will fade back into my realm in Oblivion, but I doubt you have the hundred or so years it would take to wait.
traduit: 这颗星最后会消失，返回我的湮灭领域。但我不觉得你能等上一百年。

original: No, only one option remains. I will send you inside the Star. You will banish Malyn's soul there.
traduit: 所以，只有一个选择。我会把你送进星内，把马林的灵魂放逐。

original: Tell me when you are ready, mortal.
traduit: 准备好了就告诉我，凡人。

original: What do we do with it now?
traduit: 我们现在该怎么办？

original: Now? You could use it for what we meant it for. Using black souls for enchanting.
traduit: 现在？你可以随意使用它了。用黑色灵魂进行附魔。

original: The Black Star will never decay, but it can no longer hold the white souls of lesser creatures.
traduit: 黑星不会破碎，但不能再容纳低级生物的灵魂了。

original: You keep it. I'd sooner finally put this chapter of my life behind me. Congratulations. You've changed the fate of a Daedric artifact and lived.
traduit: 拿着它吧。我希望把这段过往抛诸脑后。恭喜你。你改变了一件迪德拉神器的命运，并成功活了下来。

original: If it's fixed, then it's mine.
traduit: 既然修好了，那就归我了。

original: Go ahead. Take it. I'd sooner finally put this chapter of my life behind me.
traduit: 拿去吧。我倒希望就此把这段过往彻底抛诸脑后。

original: Congratulations. You've altered the fate of a Daedric artifact and lived.
traduit: 恭喜你。你改变了一件迪德拉神器的命运，并成功活了下来。

original: Easy there. The numbness will pass. Just don't strain yourself.
traduit: 放松点。麻木感会消失的。别绷太紧就行。

original: We've done it. The Star has been cut off from Azura, and Malyn's soul finally has some measure of peace, even if it is in non-existence.
traduit: 我们成功了。这颗星和阿祖拉的联系被切断了。虽然马林的灵魂消散了，但也算是让他安息了。

original: Have faith, mortal. I will be watching over you.
traduit: 拿出信心，凡人。我会一直守护你。

original: Are you ready to enter the Star and purge the soul of Malyn Varen?
traduit: 准备好进入星内净化马林·瓦伦的灵魂了吗？

original: Then why don't you remove it? Aren't you a daedra?
traduit: 那你为什么去净化它？你不是迪德拉吗？

original: Only if I can help it.
traduit: 只要还能喝得下。

original: But damn if I ain't almost sober.
traduit: 但我能清醒才怪呢。

original: Hey. In the Bannered Mare, there's this bottle of Argonian Ale. The good stuff. Get it for me. They won't even know it's gone. Come on...
traduit: 嘿。悬旗母马有瓶阿尔贡麦芽酒。好东西。帮我拿过来。他们甚至发现不了它不见了。拜托了……

original: Are you always drunk?
traduit: 你总是醉醺醺的吗？

original: Well that all depends on you, now. Doesn't it?
traduit: 那就得靠你了。不是吗？

original: Not anymore. Thanks to you. Friend.
traduit: 不了。多亏你了。朋友。

original: Still thirsty?
traduit: 还渴吗？

original: What can I expect in return for my help?
traduit: 我出手能得到什么？

original: My family is everything to me.  Clear the fort and on top of the posted reward you can have whatever items you'd like.
traduit: 我的家就是我的一切。清理堡垒，东西随你挑。

original: Do you have a plan?
traduit: 你有什么计划吗？

original: The front gate is locked so you'll need to use the mine entrance behind us.  Open the front gate and we'll try and give you some support.
traduit: 前门是锁着的，你可以从我们后面的矿井入口进去。打开前门，我们会试着支援你的。

original: Sounds like more then just "bad blood."
traduit: 听起来不像是“不和”那么简单。

original: You ask a lot of questions for a mercenary.  Just get in there and open the gate, we'll try and provide help once that's done.
traduit: 作为一个佣兵你的问题有点多了。进去把门打开，我们会尽力提供帮助的。

original: I suspect Brurid planned this, there's been bad blood between us since the king's death.
traduit: 我怀疑是布瑞德策划的，自从至高王死后我们之间就一直不和。

original: But to invade my home, kidnap my family...
traduit: 但侵入我家绑架我的家人……

original: I'm the best.
traduit: 我是这儿最棒的。

original: Good, the place is crawling with bandits.  We lost some good men trying to take it earlier.
traduit: 好，这里到处都是强盗。早些时候我们已经折了好几个好兄弟了。

original: Are you here to help?
traduit: 你是来帮忙的吗？

original: I will take back my family's castle.
traduit: 我要夺回我家族的城堡。

original: Agreed, we can't afford to try again.
traduit: 同意，我们不能再试了。

original: Help will arrive soon.
traduit: 救援马上就到。

original: Here, take it.
traduit: 给，拿着吧。

original: Let me see that journal...
traduit: 让我看看那本日记……

original: Now we can rest in peace once again. Come Fjori, my love...
traduit: 现在我们可以再次安息了。来吧，佛乔里，亲爱的……

original: Thank you for releasing us from her spell.
traduit: 谢谢你为我们解除了她的法术。

original: You will not stop me from killing those who wage this pointless war!
traduit: 你阻止不了我，我要杀光那些发动这场毫无意义战争的人！

original: I could not raise him, but I will raise an army to avenge his defilement!
traduit: 我不能复活他，那我就复活一支军队为他的死报仇吧！

original: I shall have vengeance for the death of my husband. Rise!
traduit: 我要为我死去的丈夫报仇。醒来吧！

original: Rise from your graves to defeat this worm!
traduit: 从你们的坟墓里醒来吧，打倒这只虫子！

original: I'm going to eat well tonight, my darling!
traduit: 亲爱的，今晚我要好好吃一顿！

original: No! You can't be here! You're all dead! I already killed you over and over!
traduit: 不！你不可能在这儿！你已经死了！我已经杀了你一遍又一遍了！

original: Ah. Ha ha! Come here, come here come here come here!
traduit: 啊。哈哈！过来，过来，过来！

original: Yes, yes. Closer. I won't bite. Promise.
traduit: 对，对。再近点。我不会伤害你的。我保证。

original: Come over here. Please pretty please?
traduit: 过来吧。求你了行吗？

original: I have a present for you. A nice, shiny present.
traduit: 我有个礼物送给你。一个闪亮的好礼物。

original: A little closer.
traduit: 再近些。

original: Ah... so tender. Come here, you juicy morsel!
traduit: 啊……真是温柔。快来，你这个多汁的小东西！

original: Go away. Go away. Go away!
traduit: 走开。走开。走开！

original: It's hopeless. He told me. He's right, you know.
traduit: 没有希望了。他这么告诉我的。他说得对。

original: Their fires lit up the night. All across Lake Rumare, like stars come to earth. It was beautiful, really.
traduit: 他们的火把照亮了夜空。穿过卢玛瑞湖，就像群星降临大地。真的很美。

original: They were golden, even when they were dead. But their blood was red. I knew it would be.
traduit: 他们是金色的，即使他们已经死了。但他们的血是红的。我就知道会这样。

original: You don't think there's any hope, do you? I don't. He's right.
traduit: 你觉得没有希望了是吗？我是这么觉得。他说得对。

original: He explained it all to me. Before, when I still understood. I don't remember, but I still know.
traduit: 他向我解释了一切。在以前，我还不能理解的时候。我不记得了，但我还是知道。

original: He'll tell you. Just ask. You don't even need to ask. He'll tell you anyway.
traduit: 他会告诉你的。只需问就行了。你甚至不需要问。反正他都会告诉你的。

original: I finally understand what it all means. What it was all for. The killing. And the dying.
traduit: 我最终明白了一切的意义。这一切都是为了什么。杀戮。还有死亡。

original: I had a medal. It had someone's face on it. I threw it away, after. It didn't help.
traduit: 我有一枚奖章。上面还有某个人的脸。我把它丢掉了。一点用都没有。

original: Are you going to tell me, or am I going to have to beat it out of you?
traduit: 你是直接说，还是我打到你说？

original: There's no need for that. Not like he's a friend of mine or anything. Just calm down.
traduit: 没必要。他又不是我朋友。冷静点。

original: You've got a lot of nerve. But not a lot of common sense.
traduit: 你虽然勇敢，但是也缺乏常识。

original: Are you going to tell me, or am I going to have to beat it out of you? (Brawl)
traduit: 你是直接说，还是我打到你说？（打架）

original: Easy there. I don't want that kind of trouble. Guy ain't worth it.
traduit: 放松点。我不想惹麻烦。这么做不值。

original: I can break some of your bones if that's what it's going to take...
traduit: 要是有必要，我可以打断你几根骨头。

original: Yeah. That's what it's going to take.
traduit: 哈。那再好不过了。

original: I can break some of your bones if that's what it's going to take... (Brawl)
traduit: 要是有必要，我可以打断你几根骨头。（打架）

original: Maybe this will help your memory. (<BribeCost> gold)
traduit: 这或许能帮你想起来。（<BribeCost>金币）

original: Well... when you put it that way, I think I do know the old guy you're talking about.
traduit: 嗯……这么说的话。我确实认识那个老头。

original: Big talk for someone with a light purse.
traduit: 这么点钱还敢吹大话。

original: You know what? I think I do know the guy you're talking about.
traduit: 你知道吗？我确实认识你说的那个人。

original: Maybe it would. If you had it.
traduit: 也许会吧。

original: I need to talk to him. I'm a friend. His life's in danger. (Persuade)
traduit: 我得跟他谈谈。我是他朋友，现在他有生命危险。（说服）

original: Maybe I'm just getting soft in my old age, but I actually believe you.
traduit: 也许是我人老了心也软了吧，我信你了。

original: That's a touching story. Now get outta my face.
traduit: 真感人哦。快滚。

original: A friend, huh? Well... then it's probably okay if I tell you.
traduit: 朋友？嗯……那告诉你无妨。

original: I guess you don't hear too well. I never heard of this "friend" of yours.
traduit: 我看你是没听清。我从没听说过你这么个“朋友”。

original: I won't be able to do that right now.
traduit: 我现在做不了。

original: It will be an honor.
traduit: 这是我的荣幸。

original: The honor will be mine.
traduit: 也会是我的荣幸。

original: Good. Honor to you.
traduit: 好。给你这份荣耀。

original: I cleared out the vampires from <Alias=Dungeon>.
traduit: 我清除了<Alias=Dungeon>的吸血鬼。

original: Filthy creatures, aren't they? Living in the darkness, like they do. So uncivilized.
traduit: 他们都是些肮脏的生物，是吧？一直以来，都生活在黑暗中。野蛮。

original: I prefer finery. Like this. Here, for your trouble. And I suppose I should show you a little about Illusion magic for free, shouldn't I?
traduit: 我比较喜欢像这样漂亮的东西。给你吧，作为你的酬劳。另外，免费给你演示一下幻术系法术，怎么样？

original: I give, and I give.
traduit: 我已经给过你了啊。

original: I don't expect you to be capable of even that.
traduit: 我也不指望你真能办到。

original: What's your problem?
traduit: 你怎么了？

original: Nothing. I'm busy, and I don't like being bothered unless I'm expecting something from you.
traduit: 没事。我很忙，而且不喜欢被打扰，除非我有事找你。

original: Oh, don't give me that look. Fine. I supposed I can find some menial task to set your mind on. Hmm....
traduit: 哦，别用那种眼神看着我。好吧。我是有些小事可以让你做。嗯……

original: We have something of a vampire problem. Bodies have been found with blood drained. I know of a den nearby you can wipe out as a precaution.
traduit: 我们碰上些关于吸血鬼的麻烦。尸体被发现的时候被抽干了血。我知道附近有个小藏身处，你可以把那清除干净。

original: If I needed something from you, you would know it.
traduit: 如果我需要你的帮助，会告诉你的。

original: I don't have time for that now.
traduit: 我现在没时间。

original: I have the Helm of Winterhold.
traduit: 我拿到冬堡之盔了。

original: Can you believe that this hold used to contend for the throne of the High King? Now perhaps others will listen.
traduit: 你能相信，这个领曾经是至高王宝座的有力竞争者吗？也许现在会有人愿意听我们说话了。

original: Here, your reward as promised. You have Winterhold's thanks.
traduit: 给，这是我承诺的奖励。冬堡很感谢你。

original: Then I have no work for you.
traduit: 那就没工作给你了。

original: I'll recover the helm.
traduit: 我去把头盔找回来。

original: Good. I'll have a sum of gold waiting for your return.
traduit: 好。我备好金币等你回来。

original: Winterhold has lost much of its history, and with that much of its power. I aim to change that.
traduit: 冬堡城已经失去了太多历史，也失去了很多权力。我打算改变这一点。

original: I've heard rumors of the resting place of the Helm of Winterhold, the very same helm that Jarl Hanse wore in the First Era.
traduit: 我得知了冬堡之盔的下落，那是第一纪元的汉斯领主所戴的头盔。

original: Hanse was in line to be High King of Skyrim, you know. Having that might get the ear of the other Holds and give me some authority.
traduit: 你也知道，汉斯曾经有资格成为天际至高王。如果别的领地听说，应该能给我带来一点威信。

original: No, no, no. I've got more blood than you know!
traduit: 不，不，不。我的血比你想得还要多！

original: Give me just one... little... bite!
traduit: 就让我咬……一小口！

original: Ah, yes. No fat on this one!
traduit: 啊，对。这个不胖！

original: Don't run. Stay for dinner!
traduit: 别跑啊。留下来吃饭吧！

original: I've been waiting for you, my sweet one.
traduit: 我一直在等你，甜心。

original: Come closer!
traduit: 再靠近些！

original: Oh yes. You're a fine fat one, aren't you!
traduit: 哦对。你是个漂亮的小胖子，是吧！

original: Your old crew member has been taken care of.
traduit: 你的老船员已经被照顾好了。

original: Fine work. Here's your pay. Don't spend it all on mead.
traduit: 干得好。这是你的报酬。别都拿去喝酒了。

original: That's the spirit.
traduit: 这就对了。

original: You're the ship captain?
traduit: 你是船长？

original: The North Wind is my mistress, and I'm her master. I don't tolerate any disloyalty.
traduit: 北风号就是我的情人，我是她的主人。我不容许任何不忠。

original: You looking for work? Got a sailor who thought running a gang of thieves would be more money than hauling my cargo.
traduit: 你在找工作吗？有个水手觉得经营一伙盗贼比在我这儿搬货更赚。

original: You make an example of that gang, I'll give you a year's worth of pay.
traduit: 你要是给那伙人立个榜样，我付你一年的酬劳。

original: I have the Fine-Cut Void Salts.
traduit: 我拿到精制虚无盐了。

original: That's the first bit of good news I've had since I set sail a year ago.
traduit: 这是我出航一年来收到的第一个好消息。

original: Here's your cut.
traduit: 这是你的那份。

original: Don't bother asking. I'm not interested.
traduit: 不打扰了。我不感兴趣。

original: Your choice, friend.
traduit: 随你吧，朋友。

original: What happened to the salts?
traduit: 那些盐怎么了？

original: Sailors are what happened to them. They got drunk and ended up losing the merchandise in some cave.
traduit: 还不是水手们惹的事。他们喝大了，结果把货丢在某个山洞里了。

original: If you're not afraid of little exploring, I'll pay good gold to get those salts.
traduit: 如果你不怕来次小冒险的话，我愿意出高价买回这些盐。

original: By inheritance, as my men are fond of saying. Can't blame them, my mother ran the Sea Squall as strictly as she ran the house.
traduit: 和我手下总说的一样，是继承来的。这也不怪他们，我母亲在海飑号时就像在家里一样严格。

original: I've been trying to find new areas of business, trying to win the sailors' respect, but I keep having problems.
traduit: 我一直在开拓新业务，希望赢得水手们的尊重，但总是遇到问题。

original: Take the last trade we did. Some Fine-Cut Void Salts from the College of Winterhold. Plenty of coin if you know who to sell it to.
traduit: 就拿上次的生意说吧。冬堡学院的精制虚无盐。如果你知道卖给谁的话，就知道钱肯定少不了了。

original: Any plans to renovate the Gray Quarter?
traduit: 有要翻修灰民区的计划吗？

original: I've taken the first steps toward doing so already.
traduit: 我已经为此迈出了第一步。

original: I met with several of the Dark Elves to discuss improvements in the Gray Quarter, but we have no real plans as of yet.
traduit: 我和几个暗精灵讨论过灰民区的改进问题，只是尚无计划出台。

original: First we'll need to refill our coffers and stockpile stone and wood. The war took a heavy toll on Windhelm's resources.
traduit: 首先，我们得填充我们的金库和储蓄的石材木料。战争让风舵城的资源损失惨重。

original: But I swore an oath to our Dunmer friends that, for as long as I sit on the throne of Windhelm, their needs will not be ignored.
traduit: 但我向我们的丹莫朋友发过誓，只要我还在风舵城的王座上，就不会忽视他们的需求。

original: Will you let the Argonians into the city?
traduit: 你会让阿尔贡们进城吗？

original: I'd like to, but it's not as simple as that.
traduit: 我也想，但事情没那么简单。

original: Most of the folk in the city believe as Ulfric did, that outsiders should not be trusted.
traduit: 城里大多数人都和乌弗瑞克一样认为外人不可信任。

original: Until those people learn to accept the Argonians, they must remain outside, for their own safety.
traduit: 在那些人学会接受阿尔贡以前，为了自身安全，他们必须待在外面。

original: Old habits don't die easily, and we Nords can be as stubborn as stone.
traduit: 旧习不会轻易消失，而我们诺德人就像石头一样顽固。

original: How are you settling into your new role?
traduit: 你对新角色适应如何？

original: Every day is a struggle, but a Nord doesn't back down from a fight when the cause is honorable.
traduit: 每天都是一场斗争，但诺德人不会在光荣的战斗中退缩。

original: I just wish things were simpler. In my days as a soldier, I knew who the enemy was, and how to defeat him.
traduit: 我只是希望事情能简单些。我当兵的时候，我知道敌人是谁，怎么打败他们。

original: Unfortunately, a sword can't repair damaged buildings, feed hungry people or undo years of prejudice.
traduit: 不幸的是，舞刀弄剑修不好建筑，养不活饥民，也消除不了积年的偏见。

original: You must be devastated by Ulfric Stormcloak's death.
traduit: 你一定是为乌弗瑞克·风暴斗篷的死而悲痛。

original: I don't care what the Imperials say -- when Ulfric Stormcloak died, one of Skyrim's greatest heroes was lost.
traduit: 我不管帝国怎么说，乌弗瑞克死的时候，天际最伟大的一位英雄就消失了。

original: Now at last, the Thalmor will get their way. The worship of Talos will finally be stamped out. Or so they think.
traduit: 现在，梭默总算要得逞了。塔洛斯信仰要被消灭了。至少他们是这么想的。

original: Those true sons and daughters of Skyrim will never cease to worship mighty Talos. If we cannot do so in our temples, we will do so in our hearts.
traduit: 那些真正的天际儿女是永远不会放弃对伟大塔洛斯的信仰的。如果我们不能在神殿礼敬，我们也会在心里去做。

original: Oblivion take the Thalmor! I'll never give up Talos, not even if it means my life. Let them come and make me a martyr!
traduit: 让湮灭带走梭默！我永远不会放弃塔洛斯，即使这意味着牺牲我的生命，有本事就让他们把我变成殉道者吧！

original: Do you miss Ulfric Stormcloak?
traduit: 你怀念乌弗瑞克·风暴斗篷吗？

original: Aye, that I do. I ain't sayin' he was perfect, but he knew what it meant to be a Nord.
traduit: 哎，没错。我不会说他完美无缺，但他知道身为诺德人意味着什么。

original: The Empire's always taken us for granted. Nords died by the thousands in the Great War, and what did the Empire do?
traduit: 帝国一直对我们想当然。诺德人在浩大战争牺牲成千上万，他们又做了什么？

original: They outlawed the worship of Talos, Skyrim's most beloved son. There's thanks for you.
traduit: 禁止了塔洛斯信仰，他可是最受敬爱的天际之子。这就是他们的谢意。

original: I guess what I'm sayin' is, Ulfric stood up for us, an' for all Skyrim. So who's goin' to stand up for us now?
traduit: 我想说的是，乌弗瑞克为我们天际所有人挺身而出，那现在又有谁来为我们仗义执言呢？

original: Will you stay in Windhelm now that Ulfric's gone?
traduit: 乌弗瑞克不在了，你还会留在风舵城吗？

original: I almost didn't. I wasn't sure I could stomach having some Imperial tell me how to live my life.
traduit: 不太想了。我不确定自己能否忍受由帝国人指示我该如何生活。

original: I was ready to pack my things when Hermir came to me. She wanted to make sure I'd finish teaching her the smithing trade.
traduit: 我正在准备收拾东西，赫米尔来找我。她想让我教完她锻造手艺。

original: That girl's determination won me over. I suppose it didn't hurt that she said she only wanted to learn from the best smith in Skyrim.
traduit: 那个姑娘的决心征服了我。她说只想向天际最好的铁匠学习，我觉得这并不坏。

original: I couldn't let her run off to that pretender Eorlund Gray-Mane, could I?
traduit: 我总不能让她去找那个冒名顶替的厄伦德·灰鬃吧？

original: Has the change to Imperial rule disrupted business?
traduit: 改为帝国统治之后，生意有影响吗？

original: In some ways, yes, but there is often opportunity in chaos.
traduit: 某些方面，没错，但混乱中往往也有机会。

original: When a new government takes charge, records can be lost, taxes can be forgotten and laws aren't always enforced.
traduit: 新的政府掌权时，记录可能会遗失，税收可能被忘记，法律也不一定能执行。

original: The new guards are often too busy learning their responsibilities to notice a few smuggled goods or minor robberies.
traduit: 新的卫兵总是忙于学习他们的新职责，而没有注意到一些走私和小劫案。

original: Not that I'd ever get involved in any of those kinds of things, of course.
traduit: 当然，并不是说我永远不会卷进这些事。

original: Have things changed much with the Empire in charge?
traduit: 帝国掌权之后情况变化很大吗？

original: Well, not yet. The Empire hasn't been in charge for that long, and real change takes time.
traduit: 哦，还没有。帝国统治的时间并不长，真正的改变是需要时间的。

original: Still, having a just and honorable man like Brunwulf in charge can only be an improvement.
traduit: 不过，有个像布伦武夫这样公正可敬的人统治，是一种进步。

original: Unlike Ulfric, Brunwulf has shown a great willingness to work with the other races and make us feel more at home here.
traduit: 不像乌弗瑞克，布伦武夫表现出了和其他种族合作的极大意愿，让我们在这里感觉更自在。

original: For the first time in a long while, I truly believe that there are brighter days ahead.
traduit: 这么久了，我第一次真正相信，未来会有更光明的日子。

original: Are you glad to see Ulfric Stormcloak gone?
traduit: 乌弗瑞克·风暴斗篷的死让你感到高兴吗？

original: You have no idea.
traduit: 你不懂。

original: Did you know it was his decree that forbade the Argonians from living inside the city walls?
traduit: 你不知道他的法令禁止阿尔贡住进城内？

original: I hope in his next life, he's reborn as an Argonian forced to live in a slum because of some bigoted Nord dictator.
traduit: 我希望他下辈子投胎当个阿尔贡，然后因为某个顽固的诺德统治者被迫住在贫民窟。

original: I'm joking, of course, but I'm a lot happier seeing the Empire running things in Windhelm.
traduit: 当然，我是在开玩笑，但我更高兴看到帝国在风舵城管事了。

original: Is life better under Imperial rule?
traduit: 帝国统治下生活更好吗？

original: Yes, markedly so. Ulfric and his Stormcloaks made no secret of their disdain for the Dark Elves.
traduit: 嗯，很明显。乌弗瑞克和他的风暴斗篷们毫不掩饰对暗精灵的蔑视。

original: In fact, they didn't seem to care much for anyone who wasn't a Nord.
traduit: 事实上，他们对诺德以外的民族都不太关心。

original: The folk of the Empire have always had a more cosmopolitan view of the world, so I'm glad to see them in charge.
traduit: 帝国人对世界的看法比较国际化，所以我很高兴看到他们掌权。

original: Fools! You will not hold me here any longer, Valdar!
traduit: 蠢货！你再也不能把我关在这里了，沃达尔！

original: I spit on you, dead sister.
traduit: 看我啐死你，该死的姐妹。

original: Petra, you traitorous grouse! Die!
traduit: 佩特拉，你个该死的叛徒！死吧！

original: Ah, my parlor. No finer place to boil eyes, no...
traduit: 哦，我的客厅。没有比这更好煮眼珠的地方了，没有……

original: I seek entrance to the Hall of Valor.
traduit: 我在寻找前往勇士大厅的入口。

original: No shade are you, as usually here passes, but living, you dare the land of the dead.
traduit: 只有幽影方可通过此地，你这生者竟有胆量踏足死者之地。

original: By what right do you request entry?
traduit: 你是以什么名义要求通过？

original: I pursue Alduin, the World-Eater.
traduit: 我在追赶世界吞噬者奥杜因。

original: A fateful errand.  No few have chafed to face the Worm since first he set his soul-snare here at Sovngarde's threshold.
traduit: 命中注定的使命。自从他第一次把灵魂陷阱设在松加德门外，不少人想要干掉这大虫子。

original: But Shor restrained our wrathful onslaught - perhaps, deep-counselled, your doom he foresaw.
traduit: 但舒尔克制了我们的暴怒进攻……也许，他早已预见了你的到来。

original: From Adrianne?
traduit: 阿德里安？

original: Ah, this must be that weapon for the Jarl. Poor girl, so eager to prove herself. I'll present it to Balgruuf when his mood is... agreeable.
traduit: 啊，这一定是献给领主的武器。可怜的姑娘，太想证明自己了。等巴尔古夫领主的情绪……愉快的时候，我再给他吧。

original: Thank you. Please, take these few coins, for services rendered.
traduit: 谢谢。请收下这点钱吧，算是报酬了。

original: I have a sword for you, from your daughter.
traduit: 你女儿让我把这剑给你。

original: Do you work the forge all day?
traduit: 你整天都在铁匠铺工作吗？

original: Aye, that I do. I've got to, if I hope to be as good as Eorlund Gray-Mane some day. In fact, I just finished my best piece of work.
traduit: 是，没错。如果我希望有一天能如厄伦德·灰鬃一般出色的话，我就必须如此。事实上，我刚刚完成了我最好的作品。

original: It's a sword. I made it for the Jarl, Balgruuf the Greater. It's a surprise, and I don't even know if he'll accept it. But...
traduit: 是一把剑。我为领主，“伟岸者”巴尔古夫打造的。这是个惊喜，所以我不知道他会不会接受。但是……

original: Listen, could you take the sword to my father, Proventus Avenicci? He's the Jarl's steward. He'll know the right time to present it to him.
traduit: 那个，你能帮我把这把剑带给我父亲普罗万图斯·阿文尼奇吗？他是领主的总管。他会挑合适的时候献给他的。

original: Damn it.
traduit: 该死。

original: You'll have to do better than that.
traduit: 你就这么点本事吗。

original: Not bad... but it won't save you.
traduit: 不赖啊……但救不了你。

original: I'm too old for this.
traduit: 我这把年纪折腾不起了。

original: Damn you.
traduit: 该死。

original: I could use some help over here!
traduit: 我这需要援助！

original: Oho, so that's where you went.
traduit: 哦哦，你去那了。

original: Here we go again.
traduit: 我们又来了。

original: You should have run away.
traduit: 你就该跑的。

original: Well, good. They're gone.
traduit: 嗯，好吧。他们走了。

original: I think they're gone.
traduit: 我想他们离开了。

original: I don't see 'em any more.
traduit: 我可不想再见他们了。

original: Stay alert. They may not have gone far.
traduit: 保持警惕。他们可能没走远。

original: Hmm. Gone. I don't like it.
traduit: 嗯。走了。我不喜欢这样。

original: Anyone see anything?
traduit: 有人看到什么吗？

original: I'm afraid I've lost them.
traduit: 我可能我跟丢他们了。

original: Must still be here, somewhere...
traduit: 肯定还在这里……藏在某个地方。

original: Don't let your guard down.
traduit: 不要放松警惕。

original: You think running will save you?
traduit: 你觉得跑就能活命吗？

original: I've waited an eternity for this day.
traduit: 我正等着这天呢。

original: My debt is repaid at last.
traduit: 我的债终于还清了。

original: I vowed to have your head.
traduit: 我非砍了你的头不可。

original: I can always use the practice.
traduit: 我可以拿这练练手。

original: That's how it's done.
traduit: 事情就这样。

original: I was just getting warmed up.
traduit: 我才刚刚热身。

original: Another one for the Blades.
traduit: 另一个交给刀锋会。

original: That's the end of that, hmm?
traduit: 这就完事儿了，啊？

original: That seems to be all of them.
traduit: 这应该是他们全部人了。

original: A shame it had to come to that.
traduit: 事情发展到这步实在遗憾。

original: Seems I still remember my old training.
traduit: 看来我还记得以前的训练。

original: I'm getting too old for this.
traduit: 老了，不适合干这个了。

original: Must be my mind playing tricks on me.
traduit: 一定是我脑子出问题了。

original: Hmm, nothing there after all.
traduit: 嗯，那里什么都没有。

original: Nothing there. Strange.
traduit: 什么都没有。奇怪了。

original: I must be getting jumpy.
traduit: 一定是我太紧张了。

original: Hmm. I was sure I heard something.
traduit: 嗯。我一定是听到了什么。

original: Hold on, what was that?
traduit: 等等，那是什么？

original: I'm going to check that out.
traduit: 我得去看看。

original: Running won't save you.
traduit: 逃跑救不了你的命。

original: Got to be here somewhere...
traduit: 肯定藏在这附近……

original: You should run while you have the chance.
traduit: 你就该抓住机会赶紧跑的。

original: Maybe they're gone?
traduit: 他们大概是走了？

original: Better make sure.
traduit: 最好还是确认一下。

original: I'm sure I heard something...
traduit: 我肯定听见了什么……

original: Nothing yet.
traduit: 什么都没有。

original: Could have been my imagination, I suppose...
traduit: 我看是我产生幻觉了……

original: Hmm. I don't see anything.
traduit: 嗯。我什么都没看见。

original: That's strange...
traduit: 奇怪了……

original: Is the College dangerous?
traduit: 学院很危险？

original: Goodness, no!
traduit: 神啊，没有！

original: They're simply scholars, they mean no one harm. I've had... several conversations with Arch-Mage Aren over the years.
traduit: 他们只不过是一群学者，不想伤害任何人。我……过去几年里和大法师阿冉交谈过几次。

original: He's perfectly polite, if a bit guarded.
traduit: 他很有礼节，只是有些戒心。

original: The Great Collapse? What's that?
traduit: 大坍陷？那是什么？

original: Just about eighty years ago, there was a terrible disaster. The cliffs overlooking the Sea of Ghosts collapsed, taking most of Winterhold with them.
traduit: 大概八十年前，发生了一场可怕的灾难。俯瞰幽灵海的悬崖坍塌了，冬堡城的大部分城区也随之消失了。

original: In the middle of it all, the College was practically untouched. Many of the survivors were suspicious.
traduit: 经历了这一切，学院却几乎没受到影响。很多幸存者都对此表示怀疑。

original: Some believed the mages were behind the whole thing, and others felt they could have at least prevented it.
traduit: 有些人认为是法师们在背后操纵，而有些人则觉得他们至少可以阻止这一切发生。

original: Arch-Mage Aren assures me that his people had nothing to do with it, and I believe him. But Winterhold never recovered.
traduit: 大法师阿冉向我保证，他们与这件事无关，我相信他。但冬堡再也没恢复起来。

original: How did the Oblivion Crisis impact Winterhold?
traduit: 湮灭危机对冬堡造成什么影响了？

original: You may have noticed the College, just to the north there. Very prestigious place. Mages from all over Tamriel traveled here to seek knowledge.
traduit: 你应该注意到学院了吧，就在北面。是个很有名的地方，泰姆瑞尔各地的法师都会来这里寻求知识。

original: After the Oblivion Crisis was over, many felt that magic users were to blame. Elves, to be specific. It created a great deal of tension.
traduit: 自从湮灭危机结束，很多人都觉得魔法使用者是罪魁祸首。具体来说，就是精灵。这造成了很大的紧张感。

original: A good many dark elves were driven from the city, and people became... uncomfortable with the presence of the College.
traduit: 许多暗精灵被赶出了城市，人们变得……对学院的存在感到不安。

original: True, but I'm not going to be the one to try to oppose her...
traduit: 是啊，但我不想和她作对……

original: Yeah, but raising Draugr to take on both the Imperials and the Stormcloaks? That's just crazy.
traduit: 是啊，但复活尸鬼去对抗帝国军和风暴斗篷？简直疯了。

original: I think it's sweet Lu'ah is so worked up over her dead soldier...
traduit: 卢'阿对她的亡灵士兵可真是太好了……

original: I'm on it, lass.
traduit: 我来了，姑娘。

original: Wait a moment... what's that?
traduit: 等等……那是什么？

original: Aye, lass... and we'll be ready for him.
traduit: 没错，姑娘……咱们会做好准备的。

original: He's toying with us. He wants us to follow.
traduit: 他在戏耍我们。他要引咱们过去。

original: Damn it! There's no way through.
traduit: 该死！没有过去的路。

original: It's Mercer! Look... down there!
traduit: 是墨瑟！看……在那里！

original: I can hear water rushing through these pipes. We must be beneath a lake.
traduit: 我能够听到水流过管道的声音。咱们一定是在湖底。

original: Then this is it. We do this for Gallus and for the Guild.
traduit: 就是这样。我们这是为了加卢斯和公会。

original: He's close. I'm certain of it. We must prepare ourselves.
traduit: 咱们离他很近了。我敢肯定。做好准备。

original: Falmer patrol up ahead. I don't think they know we're here.
traduit: 伐莫在前面巡逻。他们应该没发现咱们。

original: Aye. Whatever you want to do, we're with you.
traduit: 嗯。不管你想怎么办，我们都支持你。

original: There's a mass of the Falmer in this chamber. We can sneak through or take them down... I don't care. As long as we get to Mercer.
traduit: 这个房间里有大量伐莫。我们可以偷偷溜过去或者直接干掉他们……我不在乎。只要能够找到墨瑟就行。

original: Even the Falmer don't deserve the pain these implements must have inflicted. The dwarves were a cruel race.
traduit: 即便是伐莫也不该承受这些工具的折磨。矮人实在是个残忍的种族。

original: This must be their hive. We'll have to keep silent if we want to avoid drawing their attention.
traduit: 这里一定是他们的巢穴。不想引起注意的话，就保持沉默。

original: The stench... this place reeks of Falmer.
traduit: 恶臭……这地方到处都是伐莫的气息。

original: This is where we saw Mercer. We must be getting close.
traduit: 刚才墨瑟就在这个位置。我们一定是快到了。

original: We can take the beast on or sneak around. It's your call, lad. We're right behind you.
traduit: 我们可以选择对付这些野兽，也可以偷偷绕过去。你选择吧，小子。我们支持你。

original: We can take the beast on or sneak around. It's your call, lass. We're right behind you.
traduit: 我们可以选择对付这些野兽，也可以偷偷绕过去。你选择吧，姑娘。我们支持你。

original: It's a Dwarven Centurion. Very tough and very deadly.
traduit: 是矮人百夫长。坚不可摧且极度致命。

original: Shor's Bones! Look at that monstrosity.
traduit: 舒尔的骨头！快看那怪物。

original: I'll bet my last septim that there's a mechanism around here somewhere.
traduit: 我打赌这附近肯定有机械装置。

original: Mercer must have triggered these pistons. We're going to have to search for a way to open them.
traduit: 肯定是墨瑟触发了这些东西。我们得想办法打开它们。

original: The only reason to do that would be to block pursuit. It must be Mercer.
traduit: 唯一的原因就是为了阻止追捕。肯定是墨瑟干的。

original: We'll have to find another way around.
traduit: 我们得另寻出路了。

original: So this is what we heard. The entire tower collapsed.
traduit: 和我们听到的一样。整座塔楼都塌了。

original: Looks like we can take the low road or the high road across this chamber. Your choice.
traduit: 看来穿过这里可以走上下两条路。你选吧。

original: Can't say that I have. Imagine the riches hidden within these walls.
traduit: 没见过。想象一下这些墙后面藏着多少财富。

original: Look at the size of this place. Have you ever seen anything like it in your life, lass?
traduit: 看看这地方有多大。姑娘，你这辈子见过这样的东西吗？

original: Those bandits back there...
traduit: 那些强盗……

original: Brynjolf and I found them like that. Mercer's doing.
traduit: 布林乔夫和我发现他们时就已经这样了。墨瑟干的。

original: We have to catch up to him before it's too late.
traduit: 我们得尽快抓住他。

original: The museum is opening, Madena.
traduit: 博物馆就要开放了，玛迪娜。

original: It's the past! Dead oaths on dead lips. Let it stay there.
traduit: 都过去了！死人的誓言就留在过去吧。

original: Why should I hide from it? This is my family's legacy!
traduit: 我为什么要逃避？这是我家族的遗产！

original: Your ancestors wouldn't want this, Silus!
traduit: 你的祖先不会希望你这样的，希鲁斯！

original: I'll make sure the Emperor himself hears of all you've accomplished. You've made Skyrim a better place.
traduit: 我会向皇帝陛下转达你的成就。你的作为让天际变得更加美好。

original: By all I hold holy... Can it be true? Have you actually done it?
traduit: 天啊……是真的？你真的成功了？

original: This is a great day, my friend. You have struck a blow against darkness that will not soon be forgotten! Here, as promised - a most generous reward!
traduit: 朋友，这是伟大的一天。你对黑暗的打击不会被很快忘记！来，这是我答应你的，丰厚报酬！

original: We have a chance to destroy the Dark Brotherhood, forever. It's all up to you.
traduit: 我们有机会一举摧毁黑暗兄弟会。一切看你了。

original: The leader of the Dark Brotherhood? You mean Astrid? Dead? And this is no jest?
traduit: 黑暗兄弟会的首领？你是说阿斯垂德？不开玩笑？

original: Ha! This is a stroke of good fortune. Long have I watched the Dark Brotherhood's movements... waiting for the time to strike. That time is now!
traduit: 哈！真是幸运。我一直在观察黑暗兄弟会的动向……伺机出击。现在时候到了！

original: My agents have recently acquired the passphrase to their Sanctuary. It is, "Silence, my brother." Every assassin in that hole must be put down!
traduit: 我的密探们最近拿到了他们圣所的密语。“是沉寂，我的兄弟。”必须把那洞里的刺客全部干掉！

original: You, my friend. You've slain their leader. This honor should be yours. Do this, and you will be rewarded most handsomely!
traduit: 朋友。你杀了他们的首领。这个荣誉应该属于你。做完之后，奖赏丰厚！

original: A guard sent me. I killed the leader of the Dark Brotherhood.
traduit: 卫兵派我来的。我杀了黑暗兄弟会的首领。

original: You did what?
traduit: 你做了什么？

original: By the gods, you're serious. You'd better report this to Commander Maro right away. He's at the Penitus Oculatus outpost, up in Dragon Bridge.
traduit: 天啊，你是认真的。你最好赶快向马洛指挥官报告。他就在龙桥镇的洞察眼哨站。

original: I killed the leader of the Dark Brotherhood.
traduit: 我杀了黑暗兄弟会的首领。

original: Ah, splendid, splendid. It's for a special brew I'm working on. A love elixir like none other. Maybe I'll test it on Farengar first...
traduit: 啊，太好了，太好了。这正是我现在需要的原料。无与伦比的爱之灵药。也许我应该先在法仁加身上试试。

original: Oh, but I suppose you expect some compensation. Um... here, these potions should suffice.
traduit: 哦，但我想你是在等报酬吧。嗯……给你，这些药水应该足够了。

original: I have some Frost Salts for you, from Farengar.
traduit: 法仁加让我给你带些霜盐来。

original: Ah, splendid, splendid. It's for a special brew I'm working on. A love elixir like none other.
traduit: 啊，太好了，太好了。这正是我现在需要的原料。无与伦比的爱之灵药。

original: I have a Frost Salts for you, from Farengar.
traduit: 法仁加让我给你带一份霜盐来。

original: Are you the only wizard in Whiterun?
traduit: 你是白漫城唯一的巫师吗？

original: I believe I am, yes. Technically speaking, of course. The city is also home to a priest, priestess, an alchemist, and I'm sure others who practice.
traduit: 严格来说，应该是的。但城里还有两位祭司和一个炼金术士，而且肯定还有其他同行吧。

original: Ah, that reminds me. Speaking of alchemists, I have some frost salts for Arcadia. She asked me to obtain them for one of her potions.
traduit: 啊，这倒是提醒我了。说起炼金术士，我给阿尔凯迪雅准备了霜盐。她想用来做药水用。

original: Would you be so kind as to deliver the frost salts for me? I'm sure Arcadia will provide some form of recompense...
traduit: 你能帮我把霜盐送过去吗？我想阿尔凯迪雅肯定会想办法答谢你的……

original: Are you the only wizard in Whiterun?
traduit: 你是白漫城唯一的巫师吗？

original: What did you lose?
traduit: 你丢了什么？

original: My Amulet of Arkay. It's the source of my divine powers and also a sacred badge of office.
traduit: 我的阿尔凯护符。这既是我神圣力量的源泉，也是神圣的职业勋章。

original: I misplaced it in the catacombs. I'd look for it, but I've been hearing noises down there. I fear the dead have become... restless.
traduit: 我把它丢在地下墓穴里了。我本想找找，但我听到下面有响动。恐怕死者已经变得……焦躁不安了。

original: Without that amulet, I'm powerless to confront them. Would you be willing to search for it?
traduit: 没有那个护符，我无力对抗他们。你愿意帮我找找吗？

original: The bandit leader at <Alias=BountyLocation> is dead. I'm here for the bounty.
traduit: <Alias=BountyLocation>的强盗头目死了。我是来领赏的。

original: I'm looking for work. Got any leads?
traduit: 我在找工作。有什么活儿吗？

original: The Jarl has put out a bounty on some bandits. Here, take a look at this decree for details.
traduit: 领主悬赏缉拿几个强盗。给，这份悬赏令有详情。

original: It's the Key, Brynjolf. In his hands, there's no telling what he's capable of.
traduit: 是钥匙，布林乔夫。钥匙在他手里，谁也说不准他会做出什么事来。

original: Mercer was able to knock this thing down? Gods...
traduit: 墨瑟能把这东西弄塌了？神啊……

original: Look old woman. If your boy wants to learn how to fight, we'll teach him. Now off with you.
traduit: 听着，老女人。如果你儿子想学怎么打架，我们会教训他的。走开吧。

original: If he does, tell him how bad the food is. And how dangerous it is.
traduit: 如果他要去，请告诉他吃的多不好，还有多危险。

original: Not this again.
traduit: 请别问了。

original: Has my son Sven asked to join the war?
traduit: 我儿子斯万有说要去参战吗？

original: You're always thirsty. Just like you're always drunk. Now let me get back to my rounds.
traduit: 你没有不渴的时候。就像你一直醉咕隆咚一样。我还得继续巡逻了。

original: But I'm thirsty now.
traduit: 但我现在渴了。

original: Not now. If I don't pull night duty, I'll drink a round with you at the Sleeping Giant.
traduit: 现在不行。如果我不上夜班，再和你到沉睡巨人喝一杯吧。

original: My favorite drinking buddy! Let's get some mead.
traduit: 我最好的酒友啊！一起去喝点蜜酒吧。

original: Dragons, now, is it? Please, mother. If you keep on like this everyone in town will think you're crazy.
traduit: 这回又变成龙了吗？拜托，妈。如果继续这样，镇上的人会以为你疯了的。

original: It was as big as the mountain, and black as night. It flew right over the barrow.
traduit: 它像山一样大，像夜一样黑。正好从古坟那儿飞过去了。

original: What? What is it now, mother?
traduit: 什么？又怎么了，妈？

original: A dragon! I saw a dragon!
traduit: 龙！我看见龙了！

original: The prey is strong. Stronger than the hunters.
traduit: 猎物很强壮。比猎人还要强壮。

original: But more will come. Bring him down, for the glories of Lord Hircine.
traduit: 但还会有更多人赶过来。为了海尔辛大人的荣耀，一定要杀了他。

original: What happened here?
traduit: 发生什么了？

original: Has the Bloodmoon called you, fellow Hunter?
traduit: 血月召唤了你吗？猎人朋友？

original: Can it be? You've brought me my amulet? Oh, thank Arkay. And thank you. Oh, dear friend, please, take this gold for your troubles.
traduit: 怎么会？你已经拿到了我的护身符？哦，感谢阿尔凯。也感谢你。哦，亲爱的朋友，请收下这些金币做谢礼吧。

original: No. I will have no peace until these hunters are dead.
traduit: 不。这些猎人不死，我就不得安生。

original: For Kodlak!
traduit: 为了克拉科！

original: Greetings, Shield-Brother.
traduit: 你好，盾牌兄弟。

original: Greetings, Shield-Sister.
traduit: 你好，盾牌姐妹。

original: Is this the tomb?
traduit: 这就是那座墓吗？

original: This is the resting place of Ysgramor. And his most trusted generals. You should be cautious.
traduit: 这里是伊斯格拉默的安息之所。里面还有他最信任的将军们。你要小心点。

original: What did you need help with?
traduit: 你需要什么帮助？

original: J'zargo has seen that Tolfdir likes you.
traduit: 杰'扎格觉得托夫迪尔很中意你。

original: You must be very skilled with magic, yes?
traduit: 你一定很会用魔法吧？

original: J'zargo is working hard, but cannot do it alone. Can you help with this?
traduit: 杰'扎格正在努力研究，但没办法独立完成。你能帮我一下吗？

original: J'zargo is eager to hear how the scrolls are working.
traduit: 杰'扎格想知道那些卷轴是怎么运作的。

original: It is difficult to admit, but J'zargo could still use some help.
traduit: 虽然难以启齿，但杰'扎格还是需要帮助。

original: Can you... can you possibly help J'zargo?
traduit: 你能……你能帮帮杰'扎格吗？

original: Don't worry, Hewnon will let you pass.
traduit: 别担心，海农会放你过去的。

original: We won't give you any more trouble.
traduit: 我们不会再给你找麻烦了。

original: Sorry to have bothered you. I'll just be out of your way now.
traduit: 抱歉，打扰你了。我不会挡你的路了。

original: What are you lookin' at?
traduit: 你看什么呢？

original: Ignoring me, huh? Suit yourself. Get 'em Hewnon!
traduit: 无视我？随你的便。弄死他们，海农！

original: How about I kill you instead?
traduit: 不如我杀了你？

original: Suit yourself. Get 'em Hewnon!
traduit: 随你便。弄死他们，海农！

original: How much to let me pass?
traduit: 多少钱才能让我过去？

original: You aren't going to pass. You're going to give me everything you have. Whether you leave here in one piece is up to you.
traduit: 你过不去。把所有东西都给我。你能否安然无恙离开取决于你自己。

original: I've killed dozens like you. (Persuade)
traduit: 你这样的我也杀过一打了。（说服）

original: No need to get hasty. I... I was just testing you. You can go on ahead.
traduit: 没必要着急。我……我只是在测试你。你可以往前走了。

original: Let 'em go, Hewnon. All clear.
traduit: 让他过去吧，海农。没事了。

original: I doubt that very much.
traduit: 我对此深表怀疑。

original: I'm just looking for the Ragged Flagon.
traduit: 我在找漏壶

original: Brynjolf's been sending idiots like you down here for years looking for their hideout.
traduit: 布林乔夫长年派你这种白痴来这里找他们的老窝。

original: Funny thing is his stupid Thieves Guild never counted on me and my partner blocking the way.
traduit: 有意思的他们这群蠢逼从没想到我们哥俩会在这里挡道。

original: Now, empty your pockets or I'll pick the gold off your corpse.
traduit: 现在，要么自己掏钱，要么我从你尸体上掏钱。

original: Hey, you. Stop right there!
traduit: 嘿，你。停下！

original: Empty your pockets or end up as skeever food.
traduit: 掏空你的钱包，要么就去喂恶鼠吧。

original: I'm going to check the entrance to the Ratway. Be right back.
traduit: 我去检查一下鼠道的入口。马上就回来。

original: Okay, okay.
traduit: 好，好。

original: You worry about bashing people's heads in, I'll worry about the Guild. Okay?
traduit: 你负责敲碎人的脑袋，我去负责对付公会。成吗？

original: This far? We're livin' in a sewer. You said we'd have a house as big as the Black-Briars' by now.
traduit: 远吗？我们住在下水道里。你说过我们现在会有一所像黑棘家一样大的房子。

original: Why are you always acting like such a big baby? I've gotten us this far.
traduit: 你怎么总像个巨婴似的？我已经带着咱俩走了这么远了。

original: I dunno, Drahff. They'd skin us alive if they knew we were doin' this.
traduit: 我不知道，德拉夫。如果他们知道我们这么做，他们会活扒了我们的皮。

original: Let's finish this.
traduit: 赶紧了结吧。

original: What the... we've been betrayed! Look out!
traduit: 什么……有叛徒了！小心！

original: There he is! Get him!
traduit: 他在那儿！抓住他！

original: Treachery! Attack!
traduit: 有叛徒！攻击！

original: Exactly what kind of help do you need?
traduit: 你到底需要什么帮助？

original: J'zargo has worked hard on learning new spells, trying new things. This will make J'zargo stand out as a mage.
traduit: 杰'扎格正在努力学习新法术，尝试新事物。这样总有一天杰'扎格会成为杰出的法师。

original: But J'zargo works so hard, there is no time to test these new spells. If you help with the testing, this will make learning easier.
traduit: 但杰'扎格工作太忙了，没时间去测试这些新法术。如果你能帮忙做下测试，那研究会更容易。

original: J'zargo will give you scrolls, you will use them and report the results. This is a good plan, no?
traduit: 杰'扎格会给你一些卷轴，使用之后告诉我效果如何。这计划不错吧？

original: You tell J'zargo when you are ready.
traduit: 准备好了告诉杰'扎格就行。

original: Then we will immediately send out a legion to scour the cave and secure the town. Haafingar's people will always be safe under my rule.
traduit: 我们会马上派一个军团去搜查洞穴，保护镇子。在我的统治之下，海芬加的人民会永享安宁。

original: Your eminence, my scrying has suggested nothing in the area. Dragon Bridge is under imperial control. This is likely superstitious nonsense.
traduit: 领主阁下，我的占卜并未显示该地区存在异常。龙桥正处在帝国的控制之下。这很可能是迷信之谈。

original: I swear to you, unnatural magics are coming from that cave! There are strange noises and lights! We need someone to investigate!
traduit: 我发誓，那个洞里散发着异常的魔法！有奇怪的声音和光！我们得有人去查看！

original: All right, I'll help you. Give me the scrolls.
traduit: 好吧，我来帮你。把卷轴给我吧。

original: Ha! You can't resist, can you?
traduit: 哈！你忍不住了吧？

original: Let's see... this one, I think. J'zargo has designed it to be an excellent flame cloak, with a twist.
traduit: 看一看……对就这个。杰'扎格把它设计成了很好的火焰斗篷，稍稍加了点改动。

original: It is especially potent against the undead, and should burn them to a crisp in no time.
traduit: 对亡灵效果极佳，能把它们轻易烧成脆脆饼。

original: J'zargo gives you plenty of these scrolls, so you try them and return when you can say whether they work.
traduit: 杰'扎格会给你好几份卷轴，所以你可以多尝试几次，看看有没有效果。

original: Why aren't you like them?
traduit: 你为什么没像他们一样？

original: My spirit didn't manifest itself in the Sepulcher immediately, so fortunately I wasn't present when the Ebonmere was sealed.
traduit: 我的精魂并未立刻在坟墓中显现，所以黑檀池被封印的时候，我侥幸逃过一劫。

original: However, ever since that day, I've felt my power waning... slowly draining away.
traduit: 然而，自那之后，我就感受到力量在变弱……慢慢流逝。

original: What's wrong with the other Nightingale Sentinels?
traduit: 其他夜莺哨卫出了什么事？

original: With the Ebonmere closed, and their sudden severance from the realm of Evergloam, I fear they've undergone a drastic change.
traduit: 黑檀池关闭的时候，他们突然与永暮位面分离，估计造成了巨大的变化。

original: They're shadows of their former selves. They no longer remember their true purpose or their original identities.
traduit: 他们只是过去形态的影子。不再记得自己的真正目的和最初的身份。

original: Then I'll have to proceed alone.
traduit: 那我只能孤军奋战了。

original: I'm afraid so. I'm weakening, and I can feel myself slipping away. The years without restoration of my power have taken their toll.
traduit: 恐怕如此。我越发衰弱了，能够感觉到自己渐渐消逝。多年来我的力量始终得不到补充。

original: Whatever damage has been caused can only be corrected by following the Pilgrim's Path to the Ebonmere and replacing the Key.
traduit: 所以无论造成了什么损害，现在都只能通过朝圣之路前往黑檀池并归还钥匙来纠正这一切了。

original: How can a spirit die?
traduit: 精魂怎能死亡？

original: The Sepulcher isn't merely a temple or a vault to house the Key. Within these walls is the Ebonmere... a conduit to Nocturnal's realm of Evergloam.
traduit: 黄昏坟墓不止是单纯的神殿或者存放钥匙的墓穴。墙内便是黑檀池……那是前往诺克图娜尔的位面——永暮的通道。

original: When Mercer stole the Key, that conduit closed, severely limiting our ties to her.
traduit: 当墨瑟将钥匙偷走，通道关闭了，大大限制了我们与她的联系。

original: Then take the Key and right all the wrongs.
traduit: 那就归还钥匙，纠正一切错误。

original: Nothing would bring me more pride than to return the Key, but I'm afraid it's impossible.
traduit: 没有什么比归还钥匙更能让我自豪了，但恐怕现在不可能了。

original: From the moment I arrived here, I've felt myself... well... dying.
traduit: 自我来到这里那一刻起，我就感觉到自己正在……呃……死亡。

original: Wait a moment... You're Gallus!
traduit: 等等……你是加卢斯！

original: I haven't heard that name in a long time.
traduit: 我很久没听见这个名字了。

original: How do you know of me?
traduit: 你是怎么知道我的？

original: How are you to blame?
traduit: 怎么会是你的责任？

original: I was blinded. Blinded by dark treachery masquerading as friendship.
traduit: 我被蒙蔽了，被伪装成友谊的背叛所蒙蔽。

original: Perhaps if I had been more vigilant, then Mercer Frey wouldn't have lured me to my fate and stolen the Skeleton Key.
traduit: 如果我能再警惕些，墨瑟·弗雷就不会害死我然后偷走万能钥匙了。
