original: The last? What happened to the rest?
traduit: 最后一个？其他人怎么了？

original: We were betrayed by one of our own kind. In fact, I'm to blame for what's happened here.
traduit: 我们被同伴背叛了。事实上，这一切都是我的错。

original: I'd ask the same question of you.
traduit: 我也想问你同样的问题。

original: The last of the Nightingale Sentinels, I'm afraid. I've defended the Sepulcher alone for what seems like an eternity.
traduit: 最后的夜莺哨卫，大概吧。我一直都在守护黄昏坟墓。

original: I don't recognize you, but I sense that you're one of us. Who are you?
traduit: 我不认识你，但能感觉到你是我们的一员。你是谁？

original: You'll serve me soon enough.
traduit: 你很快就会为我效劳了。

original: I have much to thank you for, little one. When you die I will raise you and you can take your place by my side.
traduit: 我得好好感谢你啊，小家伙。你死后我会复活你，把你留在我的身边。

original: You've arrived at last. The hero who prevented me from being bound returns to my fold.
traduit: 你终于来了。阻止我被束缚的英雄回归了我的怀抱。

original: You've arrived at last. The heroine who prevented me from being bound returns to my fold.
traduit: 你终于来了。阻止我被束缚的英雄回归了我的怀抱。

original: So with the Ebonmere closed, our luck's run dry.
traduit: 黑檀池一关，我们的运气就没了。

original: Precisely. There are a few who still call Nocturnal "Lady Luck" and for good reason.
traduit: 所言不虚。有人坚称诺克图娜尔为“幸运女神”不为无因。

original: How's that changing the way things are?
traduit: 这是怎么改变一切的呢？

original: Think about the Guild... about the state it was in when you began. Think about all the little things you might have heard.
traduit: 想想公会吧……你刚开始的时候是什么状态。回忆你可能听过的一切细节。

original: A pick breaking when it shouldn't have, the clouds in the nighttime sky clearing at the wrong moment...
traduit: 撬锁器无端折断，夜空中的云朵恰好消散……

original: Our access to those bits of luck are what separates us from common bandits.
traduit: 我们获得的这些运气才是我们与普通强盗的区别所在。

original: Luck is meaningless. What we do involves skill.
traduit: 运气毫无意义。咱们靠的是技术。

original: Yes, absolutely. Your skill is your own... don't let anyone ever tell you otherwise.
traduit: 没错。你的技术是你自己的……这没毛病。

original: But Nocturnal, she influences our luck; nearly imperceptible assistance we get when we ply our trade.
traduit: 但诺克图娜尔，她影响着我们的运气；当我们入行的时候，就得到了无法察觉到的帮助。

original: I did this to honor the Guild.
traduit: 我是为了公会的荣耀。

original: You've done the Guild a great deed. And although they may not show it, I'm certain they appreciate your sacrifices.
traduit: 你为公会贡献甚大。虽然他们可能没表现出来，但我可以肯定，他们很感激你的牺牲付出。

original: I did this to get rich.
traduit: 我是为了发财。

original: Were I able to provide it, I'd shower you in wealth for what you've done.
traduit: 我要是能的话，会为你的作为赠予一大笔财富。

original: That burned paper is all that remains of the fabled Mysterium Xarxes. The blasphemous book written by Mehrunes Dagon himself.
traduit: 那张被烧过的纸，就是传说中的沙克斯秘典的残本。由梅鲁涅斯·大衮亲自撰写的渎神之书。

original: It's said that Mankar Camoran used the book to open a portal to a Paradise where all his followers would live forever.
traduit: 据说曼卡·卡莫然用这本书打开了前往“乐园”的大门，他的追随者将在其中得到永生。

original: The tapestries hung here and outside were found in hideouts where members of the Mythic Dawn would meet and plot.
traduit: 屋子内外的挂毯是在神话黎明成员聚集、密谋的隐秘据点中发现的。

original: The cult's greatest accomplishment was the assassination of the Septim Dynasty and the opening of the Oblivion Gates.
traduit: 这个邪教的最大成就就是刺杀了塞普汀皇帝，并打开了湮灭之门。

original: The Commentaries on the Mysterium Xarxes were written by the Mythic Dawn cult leader, Mankar Camoran.
traduit: 《沙克斯秘典注解》是神话黎明教主，曼卡·卡莫然所写。

original: He promised a paradise awaited his followers when they died, that they would be reborn by Mehrunes Dagon's side.
traduit: 他向追随者许诺，死后会进入乐园，他们会在梅鲁涅斯·大衮身边获得重生。

original: Those robes were worn during the Mythic Dawn's secret meetings, where they plotted to bring the Daedra Mehrunes Dagon into Tamriel.
traduit: 这些长袍是神话黎明秘密集会中的穿着，他们在那里密谋将迪德拉君王梅鲁涅斯·大衮引到泰姆瑞尔。

original: Each bolt of yarn used to make the robe was colored with a dye made from sacrificial blood.
traduit: 制成长袍所用的每一根线，都是用祭祀时的血染红的。

original: Feel free to look around. Come talk to me when you're ready to discuss that job I mentioned.
traduit: 随便看看。等你准备好谈工作时再来找我。

original: Hold, comrades - let us counsel take before battle is blindly joined.
traduit: 听着，伙伴们，我们要商量一下，不能盲目参战。

original: At long last! Alduin's doom is now ours to seal - just speak the word and with high hearts we'll hasten forth to smite the worm wherever he lurks.
traduit: 这一刻终于来临了！我们会终结奥杜因。无论他藏身何处，只需一句话，我们就会怀着高昂的斗志发起冲锋，将它消灭。

original: Speak with the Nervous Patron at Candlehearth Hall, in Windhelm. Accept his gold, then kill the target. So begins a contract, bound in blood.
traduit: 到风舵城烛炉堂和紧张的委托人谈谈。接受他的金币，杀死目标。开始一份以血缔结的契约。

original: Speak with the Wary Outlaw at the Bee and Barb, in Riften. Accept his gold, and then eliminate the target. So begins a contract, bound in blood.
traduit: 到裂谷城蜂与钩与警惕的歹徒谈谈。接受他的金币，杀死目标。开始一份以血缔结的契约。

original: Speak with the Corrupt Agent at the Penitus Oculatus Outpost, in Dragon Bridge. Accept his gold, then kill the target. Hail Sithis!
traduit: 到龙桥镇洞察眼哨站和堕落的密探谈谈。接受他的金币，杀死目标。开始一份以血缔结的契约。

original: Speak with the Scheming Servant at the Keep in Markarth. Accept his gold, then eliminate the target. So begins a contract, bound in blood.
traduit: 到马卡斯城要塞和密谋的仆人谈谈。接受他的金币，杀死目标。开始一份以血缔结的契约。

original: Speak with the Desperate Gambler at the Barracks, in Windhelm. Accept his gold, then eliminate the target. So begins a contract, bound in blood.
traduit: 到风舵城营房和绝望的赌徒谈谈。接受他的金币，杀死目标。开始一份以血缔结的契约。

original: Speak with the Blasphemous Priest at the Temple of Kynareth, in Whiterun. Accept his gold, then kill the target. Hail Sithis!
traduit: 到白漫城凯娜瑞丝神殿和渎神的祭司谈谈。接受他的金币，杀死目标。西帝斯万岁！

original: Speak with the Dishonored Skald at the Bards College, in Solitude. Accept his gold, then eliminate the target. So begins a contract, bound in blood.
traduit: 到独孤城的吟游诗人学院和蒙羞的吟唱者谈谈。接受他的金币，杀死目标。开始一份以血缔结的契约。

original: Speak with the Indolent Farmer at the Vilemyr Inn, in Ivarstead. Accept his gold, then kill the target. So begins a contract, bound in blood.
traduit: 到伊瓦尔镇烂醉如泥旅店和懒惰的农民谈谈。接受他的金币，杀死目标。开始一份以血缔结的契约。

original: Speak with the Griefstricken Chef, at the Windpeak Inn, here in Dawnstar. Accept his gold, then eliminate the target. Hail the Listener! Hail Sithis!
traduit: 到晨星的风岳旅店和悲伤的厨师谈谈。接受他的金币，杀死目标。聆听者万岁！西帝斯万岁！

original: Speak with the Unemployed Laborer at the Frostfruit Inn, in Rorikstead. Accept his gold, then kill the target. So begins a contract, bound in blood.
traduit: 到洛利克镇霜果旅店和失业的劳工谈谈。接受他的金币，杀死目标。开始一份以血缔结的契约。

original: Yet another child has prayed to their mother.
traduit: 又有一个孩子向母亲发出了祈祷。

original: But our work is just beginning. Approach me, Listener, and hear my words.
traduit: 但我们的工作才刚刚开始。靠近我，倾听我的旨意。

original: A courier gave me this pamphlet...
traduit: 一个信使给了我这本册子……

original: And here you are. I hope you've found the museum to your liking.
traduit: 所以你就来了。希望你对这个博物馆感到满意。

original: Finally, all the pieces of Mehrunes' Razor are in my hands. It's time I let you in on something.
traduit: 梅鲁涅斯剃刀的所有碎片总算都在我手里了。是时候告诉你一件事了。

original: There's a fourth piece. That scabbard in the display case. Built to house the Razor. And there's more.
traduit: 还有第四块碎片，就是陈列柜里的那个鞘，是用来装剃刀的。另外。

original: I know how to put all the pieces together. We just need to take them to Dagon's shrine and contact the Lord of Change directly.
traduit: 我知道如何把所有碎片整合起来。只需要带着它们到大衮的祭坛，直接联系变革之主。

original: We just need the shards of the blade and the hilt, now.
traduit: 我们现在只需要刀刃和刀柄了。

original: We just need the pommel and the shards of the blade, now.
traduit: 我们现在就需要刀柄宝石和刀刃了。

original: We just need the hilt and the pommel, now.
traduit: 我们现在就需要刀柄还有上面的宝石了。

original: There's only the shards of the blade left to collect. Exciting, isn't it?
traduit: 只剩下刀刃碎片了。很兴奋吧？

original: There's only the pommel left to collect. Exciting, isn't it?
traduit: 只剩下柄上宝石了。很兴奋吧？

original: There's only the hilt left to collect. Exciting, isn't it?
traduit: 只剩下刀柄了。很兴奋吧？

original: The hilt of Mehrunes' Razor, as promised.
traduit: 梅鲁涅斯剃刀的刀柄，给钱吧。

original: Did you try the grip? Isn't it eerie how it seems to mold itself into your hand?
traduit: 你有试过握它吗？它会自己适应手的形状，很诡异吧？

original: Here's your gold.
traduit: 这是你的报酬。

original: Here's the pommel stone of Mehrunes' Razor.
traduit: 这是梅鲁涅斯剃刀的柄上宝石。

original: Our master craftsman are nothing compared to the perfection of the Daedra. Look at how it shines.
traduit: 与迪德拉的完美造物相比，我们的那些工艺大师简直不值一哂。看看它光灿灿的样子。

original: Here's your gold, as promised.
traduit: 这是说好的报酬。

original: I have the blade shards of Mehrunes' Razor.
traduit: 我找到了梅鲁涅斯剃刀的刀刃碎片。

original: Look at them. The legendary sharpness of a deadric weapon. Marvelous.
traduit: 看看吧。迪德拉武器是何等锋利。太不可思议了。

original: And here's your payment for the shards.
traduit: 这是你找回碎片的报酬。

original: I'm looking for pieces of Mehrunes' Razor.
traduit: 我在找梅鲁涅斯剃刀的碎片。

original: Don't know what you're talking about, stranger.
traduit: 陌生人，我不懂你在说什么。

original: You want me to get those fragments?
traduit: 你想让我找回碎片？

original: At least two of the owners, Ghunzul and Drascua, are dangerous marauders. And the third owner, Jorgen, I only know he lives in Morthal.
traduit: 至少有两个持有者是危险的掠夺者，一个叫古祖尔，一个叫德拉斯库拉。至于第三个，乔根，我只知道他住在莫萨尔。

original: Here are my notes about them. I'll gladly pay you for getting the pieces any way you can. No questions asked.
traduit: 这是我关于他们的记录。不管你用什么手段，只要找回碎片我就付你一大笔钱。其他的不要问。

original: Let's talk about this job you want done.
traduit: 说说吧，你想让我干什么。

original: A little history, first. After the Oblivion Crisis, a number of groups cropped up dedicated to wiping out the remnants of the Mythic Dawn.
traduit: 先讲点历史。在湮灭危机之后，一些团体突然出现，致力于消灭神话黎明的残党。

original: One of these groups found Mehrunes' Razor, the artifact of Dagon. They split it into three fragments and pledged to keep them apart forever.
traduit: 其中一组人发现了大衮的神器——梅鲁涅斯剃刀。他们将剃刀分成三份，并且发誓将碎片永远分开。

original: That was almost 150 years ago, and the pieces are still being kept by the descendants of that group. And they're right here, in Skyrim.
traduit: 那是大概150年前的事了，这些碎片还被他们的后人保管着。他们恰好都在天际。

original: The beginning of what?
traduit: 什么的开始？

original: Why, perhaps the greatest crime spree Skyrim's ever known.
traduit: 这可能是天际有史以来最大的犯罪狂欢。

original: There are pockets brimming with coin and coffers overflowing with riches ripe for the picking.
traduit: 有些人口袋里塞满金币，有些保险箱满载财富，等待着被采摘收割。

original: We may be Nightingales, but in our hearts we're still thieves and we're damn good at what we do.
traduit: 我们虽然是夜莺，但内心深处还是盗贼，而且还是很在行的盗贼。

original: And you?
traduit: 那你呢？

original: The Guild has welcomed me back with open arms. I feel like a void in my life has finally been filled.
traduit: 公会张开双臂欢迎我的回归。我生命中的空虚终于得以填补。

original: I only hope that this isn't an ending to things, but actually the beginning.
traduit: 我只希望这不是结束，而是开始。

original: So what now?
traduit: 现在怎么办？

original: Now, your life as a Nightingale begins. Should the need arise, you'll be summoned to the Sepulcher in order to defend it.
traduit: 现在，你作为夜莺的生活就要开始了。如果有必要，你会被召唤到坟墓来捍卫它。

original: Why can't I be all three?
traduit: 为什么我不能兼具三者呢？

original: This is Nocturnal's way of maintaining balance.
traduit: 这是诺克图娜尔维系平衡的方法。

original: If you ever feel the need to change your abilities, you can return to the Sepulcher and step onto a different circle.
traduit: 如果你觉得需要改变能力，可以回坟墓再进不同的圈子里。

original: Be warned that once you've chosen, you can't reselect for at least a day.
traduit: 请注意，一旦做出选择，一天内是无法再选的。

original: What's this about becoming an Agent of Nocturnal?
traduit: 成为诺克图娜尔的特使意味着什么？

original: The circles at the base of the Ebonmere imbue you with powers befitting a Nightingale Agent.
traduit: 黑檀池底部的圆环会赋予你一个作为夜莺特使应有的能力。

original: The crescent moon represents the Agent of Shadow, the half moon for the Agent of Subterfuge and the full moon for the Agent of Strife.
traduit: 新月代表阴影特使，半月代表诡计特使，满月代表冲突特使。

original: Pleased? She sounded indifferent.
traduit: 满意？她听上去很冷漠。

original: I wouldn't take that to heart. It's her way.
traduit: 我就不会放在心上。她一向如此。

original: Think of her as a scolding mother continually pushing you harder to be successful; outwardly sounding angry but silently content.
traduit: 把她想成一个不停训斥你、督促你努力取得成功的母亲吧，表面上看起来很生气，但内心却很满足。

original: I assure you, had she been displeased with you, we wouldn't be having this conversation.
traduit: 我可以保证，如果她对你不满，那就不会有这次对话了。

original: Hello, Karliah.
traduit: 你好，卡莱亚。

original: I'm glad you were able to bring the Key back safely.
traduit: 很高兴你能把钥匙安全带回来。

original: Nocturnal seemed quite pleased with your efforts.
traduit: 诺克图娜尔似乎对你的努力很是满意。

original: Yeah. I'm glad we can finally stand down- getting tired of looking over my shoulder all the time.
traduit: 嗯。终于出来了，我都厌倦了一直处处提防了。

original: Well, it's all over now. Lieutenant said you could see the smoke from Whiterun.
traduit: 好了，现在都结束了。尉官说从这里能看见白漫的烟。

original: I think we'll all feel better once we're back out to sea. Won't be long now.
traduit: 我想到了海上会感觉好点。不会太久了。

original: Dragons, murder, rebellion... and we sail right into the middle of it with the Emperor on board.
traduit: 龙族、谋杀、叛乱……皇帝还在船上，不能把他卷进来。

original: Gods, I'll be glad to see the last of Skyrim.
traduit: 神啊，终于要离开天际了。

original: Arniel, stay on your guard. We can't let harm come to these people.
traduit: 阿内尔，保持警惕。我们不能让这里的人受到伤害。

original: Please remain calm!
traduit: 请保持冷静！

original: Everyone please, stand back!
traduit: 请大家退后！

original: Is he dead?
traduit: 他死了？

original: What's happened? He's not...
traduit: 发生什么了？他不是……

original: You'd better get out of that Stormcloak gear. Today's not the day to go around dressed like a rebel.
traduit: 你最好把风暴斗篷的装备脱下来。今天可不适合穿得像个叛军。

original: So what is this Mythic Dawn cult?
traduit: 那神话黎明邪教是什么？

original: They were worshippers of Mehrunes Dagon, the Daedric Lord of Destruction and Change.
traduit: 他们是毁灭与变革的迪德拉君王——梅鲁涅斯·大衮的信徒。

original: The Mythic Dawn killed Uriel Septim VII and his heirs, triggering the events that lead to the Oblivion Crisis, when the Daedra invaded Tamriel.
traduit: 神话黎明刺杀了尤瑞尔·塞普汀七世及其继承人们，引发了迪德拉入侵泰姆瑞尔的湮灭危机。

original: All that remains of the infamous cult, I've gathered in my museum.
traduit: 这个臭名昭著的邪教的遗物，都被我收藏到博物馆了。

original: I am pleased, mortal. I will give you my Razor. Use it to wreak havoc on Tamriel.
traduit: 我很高兴，凡人。我把剃刀赠予你。用它在泰姆瑞尔肆意破坏吧。

original: He helped me find the pieces. He deserves to live.
traduit: 他帮我找到了碎片，应该活下去。

original: Only Dagon can declare if a pawn is worth keeping. I. Have. Spoken.
traduit: 只有大衮才能决定卒子是否值得保留。我，已经，发话了。

original: It will be done, Lord Dagon.
traduit: 遵命，大衮大人。

original: Kill him. Take your rightful place as my champion, or I will crush you.
traduit: 杀了他。尽你的本分，成为我的勇士，否则我就碾碎你。

original: You. Mortal. You are worthy of speaking to. You have claimed the pieces of my Razor. It has been an amusing game to witness.
traduit: 你。凡人。你有资格与我交谈。你拿到了我之剃刀的全部碎片。真是一场有趣的游戏。

original: But Dagon does not declare a winner while there is a pawn on the board. Kill Silus. He and his family have served their purpose.
traduit: 但大衮不会在棋盘上还有卒子的时候宣布胜者。杀了希鲁斯。他们一家已经完成了使命。

original: I planned to kill Alain myself, you know. Nilsine, too. But lost my nerve. I even brewed a special poison, Lotus Extract. Maybe you could use it?
traduit: 我本来打算亲手杀了阿兰，还有尼尔欣。但没那个胆子。我还酿造了一种特殊的毒药，叫莲花精华。也许你用得到？

original: Just coat your weapon with it. Then... you get the idea.
traduit: 涂在武器上就行。然后……你懂的。

original: I will use the Razor as I see fit, Dagon.
traduit: 这把剃刀我想怎么用就怎么用，大衮。

original: Spare me your pitiful pride. You are but a tool of my ambitions, mortal. Never forget that.
traduit: 收收你那可怜的自尊吧。凡人，永远别忘了。你不过是我野心的工具。

original: Place your hands on my altar one last time, and you will witness the power of Mehrunes Dagon for yourself.
traduit: 把你的手最后一次放在我的祭坛上，亲眼见证梅鲁涅斯·大衮的伟力吧。

original: Thank you, Lord Dagon.
traduit: 多谢大衮大人。

original: You have been a worthy tool. Fill the world with destruction in my name.
traduit: 你是个不错的工具。以我之名义，让世间充满毁灭吧。

original: Your guy's hiding out in the Ratway Warrens and paying us good coin for nobody to know about it. Well, until now that is.
traduit: 你要找的人躲在鼠道窝棚里，付给我们一大笔钱要我们保密。好吧，是到目前为止。

original: Tell you what. Go ahead and deal with your business for now. When you're done, find me and we'll deal with mine.
traduit: 跟你说。去处理你自己的事吧。等你办完之后来找我，我们来谈谈咱们的问题。

original: Let me find him first. Dragons are bad for business. (Persuade)
traduit: 让我先找到他再说。龙对生意很不利。（说服）

original: Aye, you've got a point there.
traduit: 对，你说的有道理。

original: Passing on a golden opportunity is worse.
traduit: 错过黄金机会是会更糟糕。

original: Dammit...
traduit: 该死……

original: I think this might be the end...
traduit: 我猜可能结束了……

original: Our ancient debt for Alduin's reprieve is now repaid - the long night is ended!
traduit: 奥杜因今天偿还了我们的老账——长夜结束了！

original: I'll look for you, friend, when at last you return to Shor's hall. The honor will be ours when you rejoin the ranks of Sovngarde.
traduit: 希望你能重返舒尔大厅，朋友。你的加入松加德的行列会是我们的荣幸。

original: Even here, where heroes throng, few can match this mighty deed. What glory! The gods themselves must envy us this well-earned honor!
traduit: 即使是在这英雄云集的地方，也很少有人能造此伟业。何等荣耀！诸神一定会羡慕我们应得的光荣！

original: Everyone on me. Let's show these Imperial milk drinkers what true Nords look like!
traduit: 所有人跟我来。让这些帝国懦夫见识一下真正的诺德人！

original: Rrrrraaaaaarrrrr!!!!!
traduit: 呀啊啊啊啊啊！！！！！

original: Everyone on me. Let's show these Imperials what we're made of!
traduit: 所有人跟我来。让帝国兵见识我们的厉害！

original: Ready now! Everyone, with me! For the Empire! For the Legion!
traduit: 准备好！所有人跟上我！为了帝国！为了军团！

original: Rrrrrraaaaaaaaaaaaahhhhhhh!!!!
traduit: 呀啊啊啊啊啊！

original: All right men. On me! For the Emperor! For his Legionnaires!
traduit: 好了，将士们跟我来！为了皇帝！为了军团！

original: Ready now! Everyone, with me! For the sons and daughters of Skyrim!
traduit: 所有人，准备好！跟我来！为了天际的儿女们！

original: Rrrrrraaaaaaaaggggghhhhhhh!!!!!!
traduit: 呀啊啊啊啊啊啊！！！！！

original: Whiterun's walls are tall, but they are old and crumbling, like the Empire whose Legion lines them.
traduit: 白漫的城墙虽高，但和军团一样，早就腐朽残破了。

original: The approach to Riften is guarded by watchtowers. They will be full of archers. Move fast, and stay low.
traduit: 前往裂谷城的路上有瞭望塔。肯定布满弓箭手。放低身形快速通过。

original: The only way into Windhelm is across this bridge. Keep moving, stay close, and we'll be through their gates in no time.
traduit: 想攻进风舵城必须通过这座桥。继续走，跟紧他们，我们很快就能攻进大门。

original: We now fight our way to Castle Dour to cut the head off the legion itself!
traduit: 我们现在就要杀进阴郁堡，除掉军团的首脑！

original: And in that moment, the gods will look down and see Skyrim as she was meant to be. Full of Nords who are mighty, powerful, and free!
traduit: 到那时，众神会看到天际曾经的样子。到处都是强大、有力、自由的诺德人！

original: The walls of Markarth may be high, but their age will have created weakness or secret entrances. Find them!
traduit: 马卡斯的城墙很高，但年代太久了，一定会有弱点或者秘密入口。找出来！

original: Our objective is the drawbridge. If we can find a way to drop it, the city will be ours!
traduit: 我们的目标是吊桥。只要想办法把它弄下来，城市就是我们的了！

original: The faster we take them out, the faster we can claim this city as ours!
traduit: 我们越快干掉他们，就能越快攻下城市！

original: Beyond that are two exterior gates. Find a way to open them and we can take this city!
traduit: 外部还有两扇大门。想办法打开，就能占领城市！

original: All that remains then is the exterior gate. Find a way through to open it and the city will be ours!
traduit: 现在只剩下外门了。想办法打开，就能占领城市！

original: They've barricades to block us, but we'll tear through them and the Imperials behind them!
traduit: 他们设了路障来阻挡我们，但我们会突破它们还有躲在后面的帝国兵！

original: They've barricades to block us, but we'll tear through them and the rebels behind them!
traduit: 他们设了路障来阻挡我们，但我们会突破它们和躲在后面的叛军！

original: They'll have set barricades to slow us down.
traduit: 他们会设置路障拖住我们。

original: Destroy them quickly, and take out the archers in the towers along the way.
traduit: 迅速破坏它们，干掉路旁塔上的弓箭手。

original: They'll have barricades set, destroy them quickly. Keep pressing forward.
traduit: 尽快摧毁他们设置的路障。勇往直前。

original: This is it men!
traduit: 伙计们听好了！

original: This is it men! It's time to make this city ours!
traduit: 伙计们听好了！是时候夺取这座城市了！

original: Well, I'd better get back to work. You two make yourselves at home.
traduit: 好了，我得回去工作了。你们自便吧。

original: Well, I'd better get some sleep. Don't mind me, though. You two make yourselves at home.
traduit: 好了，我得睡会儿了。不用管我，你们自便就行。

original: Are you the only one that works at the Bunkhouse?
traduit: 工棚里就你一个人吗？

original: Of course not. You expect me to take care of it by myself?
traduit: 当然不是。你觉得我能一个人料理开吗？

original: My niece Svana helps me with the chores. She'd be more help if she kept her head out of the clouds.
traduit: 我的侄女斯瓦纳帮我打扫这里。如果她不那么想入非非，可能会帮上更多忙。

original: She's been with me ever since her parents were killed by bandits and she was dropped in my lap.
traduit: 自从她父母被强盗杀了以后，她就一直和我在一起。

original: This heap of matchsticks is what everyone calls Haelga's Bunkhouse. Can you stay here? No.
traduit: 这个破火柴棚子就是大家说的“哈尔嘉的工棚”。你能待在这儿吗？不行。

original: The Bunkhouse is for the working man, not some sort of a luxury inn for tourists.
traduit: 工棚是给工人们住的，不是游客们下榻的豪华旅馆。

original: Can you tell me about Mara's beliefs?
traduit: 你能跟我讲讲玛拉的信仰吗？

original: Mara's domain encompasses the emotions we strive the most to embrace; love, compassion and understanding.
traduit: 玛拉的领域包括了我们最努力想要拥抱的情感：爱、同情还有理解。

original: It's difficult to appreciate her gifts in these dark times, but you should consider her light a beacon in the storm.
traduit: 在这个黑暗的时期，很难欣赏她的恩赐，但你可以把她看做暴风雨中的灯塔。

original: I have a price on my head in Riften.
traduit: 在裂谷城我的脑袋很值钱。

original: And you think that I care? Interesting.
traduit: 你觉得我会在意吗？有意思。

original: I don't believe in getting my hands dirty. You have people that handle those sort of things... use them.
traduit: 我不喜欢弄脏自己的手。你有专人处理这类事情的话……找他们吧。

original: How did you become allied with the Thieves Guild?
traduit: 你是怎么和盗贼公会结盟的？

original: The Black-Briar family has always been allied with the Guild. Our connections with the Empire and within Skyrim make for a perfect fit.
traduit: 黑棘家族一直与公会联合。我们在帝国和天际的关系网对他们十分重要。

original: I dare say the Guild owes its survival as much to my family as it does to its own people.
traduit: 我敢说，在公会的存续方面，我们的贡献与公会成员的功劳同等重要。

original: Your name carries weight in Riften.
traduit: 你的名字在裂谷城很有分量。

original: Of course. Nothing gets done without my approval in this city. I have the Jarl's ear, and the guards in my pocket.
traduit: 当然。在这座城市里，没我的许可，什么事都不能做。领主对我言听计从，卫兵们也在我掌控之中。

original: Anyone makes trouble for me and I pay a visit to the Thieves Guild. Make me angry and I contact the Dark Brotherhood.
traduit: 谁敢找我的麻烦，我就会去找盗贼公会。敢惹怒我，我就会联系黑暗兄弟会。

original: You'd do well to remember that the next time you make such a stupid observation.
traduit: 下次你做出这么愚蠢的评论前，最好想起这一点。

original: Maybe you should speak to the authorities.
traduit: 也许你应该去和官面上谈谈。

original: Authorities? Have you been listening to what I said? They're all dirty. Every one of them.
traduit: 官面上？你有在听我讲话吗？他们都是脏的。每一个都是。

original: The only way to get things done in this city is to keep your head down and pay off the right people.
traduit: 在这座城里，想要办成事，唯一的办法就是低调行事，把钱付给对口的人。

original: What's wrong with Riften?
traduit: 裂谷城怎么了？

original: The question is, what isn't wrong with Riften.
traduit: 问题应该是，裂谷城还有哪儿不怎么了。

original: This city is corrupt. Rotten to the core. No one cares about anything except themselves and how much coin they can make off the misery of others.
traduit: 这座城市腐败了。烂透了。除了每个人自己和他们能从别人的痛苦里榨出多少钱外，没人会关心任何事。

original: Gods.... You two head inside and get some rest. I'll send word to the Jarl.
traduit: 神啊……你俩快进去休息吧。我会给领主送信的。

original: Troll's blood, what happened to you Pavo?
traduit: 巨魔的血啊，帕沃，你怎么了？

original: The Forsworn have taken Kolskeggr Mine. We're the only ones left.
traduit: 弃誓者占领了科斯凯格矿场。只有我们活下来了。

original: Rip the eyes from her head!
traduit: 把她的眼睛从头上扯下来！

original: Rip the eyes from his head!
traduit: 把他的眼睛从头上扯下来！

original: Don't applaud yourself too soon, worm!
traduit: 不要高兴的太早，蛆虫！

original: You've come far, mortal, but can you stand against my inner council?  Let's see!
traduit: 你已经走了很远了，凡人，但你觉得能抗击我的内部议会？来看看吧！

original: Now, might I offer some advice? You should go to Riften and find Delvin Mallory. I believe Astrid had you visit him once before?
traduit: 现在，我能提点建议吗？你应该去裂谷城找戴尔文·马洛里。我记得阿斯垂德让你找过他一次？

original: Mallory is an expert "obtainer of goods." We can use the money to repair and refit this Sanctuary. Make a true home for us, hmm?
traduit: 马洛里可是“货物获取”专家。我们可以用这笔钱重新修缮装饰这个圣所。做成我们真正的家，怎样？

original: You do that, and I'll see what I can do about recruiting some new additions to our Family...
traduit: 你来负责这个，我去看看能不能招些新成员加入咱们的家庭来……

original: You're a little light on coin there, my friend. No gold, no refit.
traduit: 你钱不够啊，朋友。没有金币，无法改装。

original: Nothing. Never mind.
traduit: 没什么。不用在意。

original: Heh. Chamber fit for a king and all that, right? No problem. Give ya a big bed, decorate the room real nice, maybe even throw in a few extra baubles.
traduit: 哈，适合王者居住的房间对吧？没问题。给你办一张大床，把房间点缀的漂漂亮亮，再放上些额外的小玩意儿。

original: Master bedroom. (3,000 gold)
traduit: 主卧室。（3000金币）

original: Yeah, we can do that. I'm thinking a sewer grate on the outskirts of Dawnstar. Leads to a tunnel, then inside. You'll be in or out, quick as a coney.
traduit: 没错，是该建一个。我看就在晨星郊外建个下水道格栅。打通一条隧道到圣所去。进进出出快如兔子。

original: Secret entrance. (5,000 gold)
traduit: 秘密入口。（5000金币）

original: Oh ho. Now that's the Dark Brotherhood I know and love. This for business or pleasure? Ah, what's it matter, right? I'll see that it gets done.
traduit: 哦吼。这才是我了解并喜爱的黑暗兄弟会。这是为了生意还是玩乐？没什么关系，对吧？我会办妥的。

original: Torture chamber. (5,000 gold)
traduit: 刑讯室。（5000金币）

original: That'll come in handy, yeah? An alchemy station, maybe a little garden with some choice plants. All right, consider it done.
traduit: 迟早要派上用场的吗？一个炼金工作台，再加上个种植精选植物的小花园。好吧，这就搞定。

original: Poisoner's nook. (5,000 gold)
traduit: 毒药师工作角。（5000金币）

original: DBSancMalloryRefitChoice1
traduit: DBSancMalloryRefitChoice1

original: Banners, huh? Trying to pretty up the place? All right, you got it.
traduit: 旗帜吗？想把里面装点漂亮点？好吧，没问题。

original: New banners. (1,000 gold)
traduit: 新旗帜。（1000金币）

original: Welcome, Dragonborn! Our door has stood empty since Alduin first set his soul-snare here.
traduit: 欢迎，龙裔！自从奥杜因设下灵魂陷阱以来，就无人登门了。

original: The three await your word to loose their fury upon the perilous foe.
traduit: 那三个人正等着你发话去向强敌发泄怒火呢。

original: Do not fail Kodlak. He's earned his place here, and does not deserve to fall prey to Alduin's insatiable hunger.
traduit: 不要辜负了克拉科。他为自己赢得了一席之地，不该成为奥杜因贪婪的牺牲品。

original: My disciples still follow the difficult path - the Way of the Voice is neither wide, nor easy.
traduit: 吼声之道狭窄且艰难，但我的门徒还在继续追随着。

original: But if you stray from wisdom then to Sovngarde you will not return.
traduit: 但如果你偏离了智慧，就再也不能返回松加德。

original: You freed Svaknir, a fool of a poet, but an honest enemy who has earned my respect.
traduit: 你释放了斯瓦科尼尔吧，那诗人虽然愚蠢，但也是值得我尊敬的敌人。

original: Sadly, he's now lost in the soul-snaring mist - defeat Alduin, and his doom avert - I hope to greet him in this Hall as a friend.
traduit: 可惜他现在迷失在灵魂陷阱的迷雾中，打败奥杜因，扭转他的厄运，我希望在这个大厅里用朋友的身份欢迎他。

original: Fate drives you, but you follow your own path. Choose wisely, lest you wander into evil.
traduit: 命运驱使着你，但你要坚持自己的道路。明智地抉择，不要堕入邪恶。

original: Far you've travelled, your trials long, to taste of Sovngarde's sweet delights.
traduit: 只有长途跋涉，历经磨难，才能品尝到松加德的甜美之乐。

original: Seek ye food or song unending? Fighting, drinking, fellowship and boasting? Find welcome here, and warm your soul.
traduit: 寻找无尽的美食或欢歌？战斗、美酒、朋友、炫耀？那这里肯定能温暖你的灵魂。

original: Hail, Dragonborn. That honor is also mine - to our shared birthright you'll bring new glory!
traduit: 龙裔万岁！这份荣耀同样属于我们——为了我们与生俱来的权利，你将为我们带来新的荣耀！

original: Dragonborn! Have you come to cleanse Sovngarde at long last of Alduin's foul mist?
traduit: 龙裔！你是来净化松加德的奥杜因迷雾的？

original: Why does Shor forbid us to face Alduin? I fear no worm, World-Eater though he be.
traduit: 舒尔为何禁止我们去迎战奥杜因？管他是不是世界吞噬者，我才不怕那条虫子。

original: I long to fight that foul worm, but by Shor's command we curb our wrath.
traduit: 我渴望和那条脏蛆战斗，但舒尔命令我们抑制愤怒。

original: No gloom can hold my heart for long in Shor's bless'd hall, where no shadows lie.
traduit: 舒尔的祝福之堂中没有阴霾，让人感觉心情畅快。

original: A cup, Dragonborn, to death and glory!
traduit: 来干杯吧，龙裔，为了死与荣耀！

original: Take your ease, let troubles fade.
traduit: 放轻松，让烦恼消失吧。

original: By Shor's command we curb our wrath, so we feast and sing, til the final doom.
traduit: 谨遵舒尔之命，我们遏制忿怒，宴饮高歌，直至终劫。

original: Shor's power protects this hall; but beyond is fear, brought by Alduin.
traduit: 舒尔之力保护着大厅，但大厅以外是奥杜因播撒的恐怖。

original: Shor's high seat stands empty; his mien is too bright for mortal eyes.
traduit: 舒尔的圣座看似空空如也，只因他的风采对凡人来说太过闪耀。

original: I hear your heart beat like the Harbingers of old. Your glories in Skyrim are seen and honored.
traduit: 我听到你的心脏如古老的先驱们一样跳动。你在天际的荣誉将被目睹并尊重。

original: In life we were enemies, but eternity's too long to hold a grudge - my heart's now free of such old hatreds.
traduit: 我们生时为敌，但来世漫长，仇恨已不足道，我的心已经释怀旧恨了。

original: Hero of the Nords I name you, Dragonborn, let none deny it.
traduit: 我愿称你为诺德的英雄，龙裔。这是无人可以否认的。

original: The mist is gone! A glorious day!
traduit: 迷雾消散了！光荣的一天！

original: The World-Eater is dead! The way is now clear!
traduit: 世界吞噬者死了！前路通畅了！

original: You saved us all. We will sing of you forever.
traduit: 你救了所有人。我们会永远歌颂你。

original: Delphine needs your help to stop the dragons. (Persuade)
traduit: 戴尔芬需要你帮忙阻止龙族。（说服）

original: You'd better come in and tell me how you found me and what you want.
traduit: 你最好进来跟我说说，你是怎么找到我的，想要做什么。

original: Delphine? How do you ... ? This is just a trick to get me to open the door, eh? I told you to go away!
traduit: 戴尔芬？你怎么会……？是要骗我开门吧？走开！

original: I have a message from General Tullius.
traduit: 我有来自图留斯将军的消息。

original: Oh, yes? I wonder what that old busybody wants now.
traduit: 哦？我不知道那个多管闲事的老家伙想干嘛。

original: Whatever it is, it will have to wait until after I've finished dealing with this dragon situation.
traduit: 但不管是什么事，都得等我处理完龙的问题再说。

original: And I'm sure he told you it was urgent. Well, he's not the only Jarl in Skyrim with problems to deal with.
traduit: 他肯定告诉你事情紧急，但天际不是就他一个领主有问题要处理。

original: I have a message from Ulfric Stormcloak.
traduit: 我有来自乌弗瑞克·风暴斗篷的消息。

original: Hey, haven't I seen you around the Flagon? I never expected to see another Guild brother down here.
traduit: 嘿，我在漏壶见过你！没想到会见到公会的弟兄。

original: They grabbed me in the Ratway. The nerve of these bastards... they need to be taught a lesson.
traduit: 他们在鼠道把我抓了。这群混蛋有胆量……得教训教训他们。

original: They grabbed me in Riften. They seem to think I know something. They just kept asking me the same damn questions.
traduit: 他们在裂谷城抓了我。他们好像觉得我知道些什么，一直在问我同样的倒霉问题。

original: A hard truth, that is. Let's drink to the fallen ones.
traduit: 事实很残酷，来，敬倒下的人。

original: War may be good for business, but it's hard on families.
traduit: 战争对生意有利，确是家庭的悲哀啊。

original: Ay, we can get that for ya. We just finished the timber for those catapults.
traduit: 嗯，我们帮你拿。我们刚刚进了一批能做投石车的木材。

original: I got a new order in for shields. I'm gonna need some hardwood planks. None of that soft pine this time.
traduit: 我接到一份新的盾牌订单。需要些硬木板。以前那种软松木不行了。

original: I'm just sayin' you should pick one to settle down with.
traduit: 我只是说你应该选一个安顿下来。

original: It's bad enough my brother is harping on me to pick one. Don't you start too.
traduit: 我哥哥一直唠叨要我选一个已经够烦了。你别也开始啊。

original: You need to choose between those two boys. It ain't fair to Sven or Faendal to keep tuggin' on their heart strings like that.
traduit: 你得在那俩小伙子中间选一个。这对斯万和法恩达尔都不公平。

original: Gimme a mug of ale.
traduit: 给我一杯麦芽酒。

original: A pint of your finest mead.
traduit: 来瓶最好的蜜酒。

original: Some wine, please?
traduit: 拿点葡萄酒来行吗？

original: I'll have some mead.
traduit: 来些蜜酒。

original: Pour me an ale.
traduit: 倒杯麦芽酒。

original: Oh, Sven. You do know how to turn a girl's head.
traduit: 哦，斯万。你太会吸引女生了。

original: With you as my muse, how could I not?
traduit: 有你做我的视线里，我怎么可能弹错？

original: You play so well.
traduit: 你弹得真好。

original: Just stay away from her, or...or else.
traduit: 离她远点就行，否则……否则。

original: Ah, Camilla. Fair as the morning sun. But I ask you, how could she prefer your brooding to my romantic tunes?
traduit: 啊，凯米拉。像朝阳一样美丽。但我问你，她怎么会喜欢你这样的闷葫芦而不是我的浪漫情调？

original: Stay away from Camilla.
traduit: 离凯米拉远点。

original: Would you two shut up before Brurid hears you messing around.
traduit: 你俩能不能闭嘴，别让布瑞德听见。

original: Funny coming from a woman who's breath smells like she just kissed a draugr.
traduit: 一个女的口气闻起来像是刚亲过尸鬼一样，有意思。

original: And it shows, I've seen horkers with smaller guts.
traduit: 这就说明，我见过胆子更小的海象。

original: It's been forever since I've eaten so well.
traduit: 我已经很久没吃得这么好了。

original: Fine. Let me see if I can cut you down.
traduit: 好吧，我看看能不能把你放下来。

original: Sweet breath of Arkay, thank you.
traduit: 阿尔凯的甜蜜气息，谢谢你。

original: Hand over the claw first!
traduit: 先把龙爪交出来！

original: Does it look like I can move? You have to cut me down, first.
traduit: 我现在看起来能动吗？先把我放下来。

original: Where's the golden claw?
traduit: 黄金龙爪在哪儿？

original: Yes, the claw. I know how it works. The claw, the markings, the door in the Hall of Stories. I know how they all fit together!
traduit: 对，龙爪。我知道该怎么用。龙爪、标记还有故事大厅的门。我知道该怎么组合在一起。

original: Help me down, and I'll show you. You won't believe the power the Nords have hidden there.
traduit: 放我下来，我教给你。你都不会相信诺德人藏在那里的力量。

original: Like I said, I'm glad to help in any way I can.
traduit: 我说了。我很乐意尽我所能帮忙。

original: But I need your help. We need your help.
traduit: 但我需要你帮助。我们都需要你的帮助。

original: Your mother Gharol wants you to have this sword.
traduit: 你母亲加洛尔希望你拿着这把剑。

original: So that's it, then. "Don't come back."
traduit: 就是这样啊。“不要回来”。

original: Thank you. Here. You honored my mother's task and should be rewarded.
traduit: 谢谢你！给。你尊重了我母亲的职责，应该得到报酬。

original: Now, I need to be alone.
traduit: 现在，我想一个人静静。

original: Do you trade your weapons with any of the cities?
traduit: 你们和其他城市交易武器吗？

original: Occasionally. But an Orc blade is a very personal thing. Anger, regret, pride. All these things are put into our steel.
traduit: 偶尔吧。但兽人的武器是很私人的物品。愤怒、懊悔、骄傲。这一切都被融入了我们的武器当中。

original: When my daughter Lash chose to leave the stronghold, I forged a sword to channel all my shame and grief.
traduit: 当我女儿拉什选择离开要塞的时候，我锻造了一把剑来引导我所有的耻辱和悲伤。

original: Honor me with a task, outlander. Bring the sword to my daughter, if you see her. It'll be all she needs to know.
traduit: 帮我个忙吧，外来者。如果你见到我女儿，把这把剑给她。这里有她要知道的一切。

original: Everyone, please. I'm doing what I can to end these nightmares.
traduit: 大家请安心。我一定会尽全力结束这些噩梦。

original: In the meantime all I ask is you remain strong and put your trust in Lady Mara.
traduit: 与此同时，希望大家能够坚强，相信玛拉女士。

original: Listen to your friend, Fruki. They are just dreams, my dear. I assure you that it is quite normal.
traduit: 听你朋友的话，弗如吉。只是梦而已，亲爱的。我向你保证，这很正常。

original: The shrine of Namira is beyond that door. Get ready.
traduit: 娜米拉的祭坛就在门后。做好准备。

original: The shrine of Namira is further inside. Keep going.
traduit: 娜米拉的祭坛就在更深处。继续。

original: Draugr are below. Foul tasting.
traduit: 尸鬼就在下面。尝起来很恶心。

original: A lot of our kind block out the memory of their first meal. The shame is too much. But you don't need to hide anymore.
traduit: 我们很多人都会尘封自己初次品尝的事。感觉很羞耻。但你不需再隐藏了。

original: Namira, the Lady of Decay, accepts you for what you are. She has a place for us, where we can sate our appetites without judgment.
traduit: 腐烂女士娜米拉接受了你的本来面目。她给我们留了个地方。我们能在那里满足自己的欲望而不受批判。

original: To Oblivion with you then!
traduit: 下湮灭去吧！

original: A priest, filled with the taste of an easy life. Brother Verulus, from Markarth.
traduit: 一个生活安逸的祭司。马卡斯城的维鲁鲁斯修士。

original: Give him this gold. Tell him you need Arkay's help exploring an old cavern for treasure.
traduit: 把钱给他。跟他说，你在一个古老地穴寻宝，需要阿尔凯的帮助。

original: And when he stands in Namira's presence, she will take care of the rest.
traduit: 当他出现在娜米拉面前，娜米拉会处理剩下的事。

original: I'm not a cannibal. What are you trying to do to me?
traduit: 我不是食人族。你想对我做什么？

original: It's all right. I will not shun you for what you are. Stay. I will tell you everything you have forgotten.
traduit: 没关系。不管你是谁。我不会躲着你的。我会让你想起忘记的一切。

original: We're not done here.
traduit: 我们还没说完呢。

original: "Long live the Emperor! Long live the Empire!"
traduit: “皇帝万岁！帝国万岁！”

original: Welcome to the Imperial Legion, soldier.
traduit: 欢迎加入帝国军团，士兵。

original: Just remember, we take care of our own. Once you're in the Legion, you're in it for life.
traduit: 记住，我们要自己照顾自己。一日为兵，终生为兵。

original: Speak to Beirand, he's normally out by the forge. He'll get you outfitted.
traduit: 跟贝尔兰德说说，他一般都在铁匠铺外面。他会给你全套装备。

original: Now, if I'm not mistaken. Legate Rikke has a special assignment for you.
traduit: 如果我没记错的话，瑞姬有特殊任务给你。

original: "May those above judge me, and those below take me, if I fail in my duty."
traduit: “如果我不履行职责。愿上下周遭之人惩罚我”

original: "Long live the Emperor! Long live the Empire!"
traduit: “皇帝万岁！帝国万岁！”

original: "...and unwavering obedience to the officers of his great Empire."
traduit: “……并毫不动摇地服从他伟大帝国的军官们”

original: "May those above judge me, and those below take me, if I fail in my duty."
traduit: “如果我不履行职责。愿上下周遭之人惩罚我”

original: "Upon my honor I do swear undying loyalty to the Emperor..."
traduit: “我以我的名誉起誓，我将永远效忠于皇帝……”

original: "...and unwavering obedience to the officers of his great Empire."
traduit: “……并毫不动摇地服从他伟大帝国的军官们”

original: Is the gas dangerous?
traduit: 这气体危险吗？

original: Sadly, yes. The longer an individual is exposed to the Miasma, the more the mind can become damaged.
traduit: 很遗憾，危险。在毒气中暴露的时间越长，他的思维就容易受损。

original: Those who've been under the effect of it for extended periods of time have been known to lose their minds entirely.
traduit: 那些长时间受其影响的人会完全失去理智。

original: In some cases, a few never awoke at all.
traduit: 某些情况下，一些人根本不会醒来。

original: What does the Miasma do?
traduit: 毒气有什么用？

original: The Miasma was created by the priests of Vaermina for their rituals. It's a gas that places the affected in a deep sleep.
traduit: 毒气是瓦尔迷纳祭司为他们的仪式创造的。能够让吸入者进入深度睡眠。

original: Because the rituals would last for months or even years, the Miasma was designed to slow down the aging process.
traduit: 因为这些仪式会持续几个月甚至数年，毒气还能延缓衰老。

original: Why is it dangerous if they're asleep?
traduit: 他们睡着了有什么危险？

original: I'm concerned that when this place is unsealed, the Miasma will dissipate and they'll awaken; both orcs and priests alike.
traduit: 我担心，一旦这里开启，毒气消散，祭司和兽人都会醒来。

original: What do you mean, "return"? You've been there?
traduit: 你说的“回”是什么意思？你以前去过那里？

original: I've already said too much. If anyone overhears what we're saying, it could start a panic.
traduit: 我说得太多了。如果有人听到，会引起恐慌的。

original: I would simply ask that you trust me and help me end Dawnstar's nightmares.
traduit: 只求你相信我，帮我结束晨星的噩梦。

original: "All hail the Stormcloaks, the true sons and daughters of Skyrim!"
traduit: “向真正的天际儿女，风暴斗篷致敬！”

original: Now you're one of us.
traduit: 现在你是我们的一员了。

original: Which means you get to tag along on a little trip with me.
traduit: 也就是说你得跟我来一趟小小旅行了。

original: Oh, and here. You're a Stormcloak now, you ought to look the part.
traduit: 哦，对。你现在是风暴斗篷了，也得穿得像个风暴斗篷样子。

original: "As Talos is my witness, may this oath bind me to death and beyond..."
traduit: “塔洛斯为我见证，我将誓死遵守诺言，永不背誓……”

original: "...even to my lord as to my fellow brothers and sisters in arms."
traduit: “……待战友同袍如对待主君。”

original: "...Jarl of Windhelm and true High King of Skyrim."
traduit: “……风舵城的领主与天际真正的至高王。”

original: "As Talos is my witness, may this oath bind me to death and beyond..."
traduit: “塔洛斯为我见证，我将誓死遵守诺言，永不背誓……”

original: "I do swear my blood and honor to the service of Ulfric Stormcloak..."
traduit: “我以我的鲜血与荣誉起誓，效忠于乌弗瑞克·风暴斗篷……”

original: "...Jarl of Windhelm and true High King of Skyrim."
traduit: “……风舵城的领主与天际真正的至高王。”

original: You will do my bidding.
traduit: 你必须服从我。

original: You dare bring me here? You must be punished.
traduit: 你敢把我带到这里？你必须受到惩罚。

original: What else is there to be learned about Conjuration magic?
traduit: 关于召唤系魔法还有什么可学的？

original: How quickly you've advanced. Most impressive.
traduit: 你进步之快，令人惊叹啊。

original: There are spells yet to be learned, powerful spells that can more closely and more permanently bind creatures to your will.
traduit: 还有些魔法有待学习，这些强大的法术可以更紧密、永久地将召唤物与你的意志捆绑在一起。

original: But there are risks. There are always risks. You must summon and command an unbound Dremora.
traduit: 但也存在风险。不过风险无处不在。你必须召唤并命令一个不受束缚的魔人。

original: Helgen? Has something happened...?
traduit: 海尔根？发生什么事了……？

original: Don't worry about me. I know how to lay low.
traduit: 不用担心我。我知道低调点。

original: I'm glad to assist you in any way I can.
traduit: 我很高兴能尽力帮你。

original: That's right! Don't worry, Uncle Ralof, I won't let those soldiers sneak up on you.
traduit: 没错！拉罗夫舅舅，别担心。我不会让那些士兵偷着接近你的。

original: Aw, mama, I want to stay and talk with Uncle Ralof!
traduit: 啊，妈妈，我想和拉罗夫舅舅聊天！

original: Hush, Frodnar. This is no time for your games.
traduit: 嘘，弗洛德纳。现在不是你玩闹的时间。

original: Hod. Just come here.
traduit: 胡德。过来一下。

original: What is it, woman? Sven drunk on the job again?
traduit: 怎么了，老婆？斯万上班又喝醉了？

original: Have anything to trade?
traduit: 有什么要交易的吗？

original: I'll take that dog off your hands. (<global=animalgold> gold)
traduit: 我想把你手里的狗买走。（<global=animalgold>金币）

original: Good. Here you are. He'll follow you to Oblivion and back, if it comes to that.
traduit: 好。归你了。如果有需要，他能跟你去湮灭溜达一圈再回来。

original: Sorry. You already have an animal with you.
traduit: 抱歉，你已经带着动物了。

original: War dogs cost gold, friend. Come back when you have some.
traduit: 买战犬是需要钱的，朋友。等你有钱了再回来吧。

original: Why do you fear Hevnoraak?
traduit: 你为什么惧怕赫诺拉克？

original: He had a way of enthralling people and built up a loyal army of followers. Good men fell under his spell and were forever twisted. Made... evil.
traduit: 他有一种吸引他人的办法，并且建立了一支忠诚的追随者军队。善良的人会被他的法术迷惑，然后永远扭曲，变得……邪恶。

original: After that, fear was enough to keep them in line. He could torture and humiliate them and they would not rebel. Even in death, they serve him still.
traduit: 在那之后，小施恐惧就能让他们乖乖听话。即使折磨他们、羞辱他们，他们也不会反抗。就算死后，他们也会继续效忠于他。

original: Why are you here?
traduit: 你为什么在这里？

original: Hevnoraak planned his resurrection obsessively before dying. My duty in life and in death is to make sure he stays in this tomb for eternity.
traduit: 赫诺拉克死前就执迷于策划自己的复活。我无论生前死后，职责就是确保他永远待在这个坟墓里。

original: Now, clear your mind and breathe deeply. Good concentration is very important for spellcasting.
traduit: 现在，理清你的思绪，深呼吸。良好的专注力对施法是很重要的。

original: Wow! Then I could dive into a river and swim so far away that Britte and father could never find me.
traduit: 喔！然后我就可以跳进河里游到很远的地方，布里特和爸爸就再也找不到我了。

original: Oh, it's much better than that. I will teach you how to breathe underwater, with no need to turn into one of those ugly creatures.
traduit: 哈，比那好多了。我会教你如何既能在水下呼吸，又不需要变成那些丑八怪。

original: Oh! Are you going to teach me how to turn into a mud crab?
traduit: 哦！你要教我怎么变成泥沼蟹吗？

original: Today I'll teach you a useful spell that might just save your life. If you should ever fall into a river, you'll be very glad you learned it.
traduit: 今天我要教你一个很有用的法术，也许能救你一命。如果有天你掉河里了，你会很高兴学过这个的。

original: There's times I think you're the coldest man in Skyrim. This is your own flesh and blood you're talking about.
traduit: 有时候我真觉得你是天际最冷酷的人。你说的可是自己的亲骨肉啊。

original: They've grown, all right - lazier and more stupid.
traduit: 她们确实成长了，更懒了也更蠢了。

original: Your daughters are growing up fast, Lemkil. Seems like only yesterday they were newborn babes.
traduit: 你女儿们成长的很快，莱姆吉尔。仿佛昨天她们还是婴儿似的。

original: Hah! And what would a witless oaf like you know about raising children?
traduit: 哈！像你这样的傻瓜怎么知道怎么养孩子？

original: You keep on like you are, you'll end up with two daughters who hate you.
traduit: 你再这样下去，你只能得到两个对你怀有恨意的女儿。

original: You're right, it's none of your business. How about you keep your nose out of it?
traduit: 你说得对，这不关你事。别管闲事好不好？

original: I'm not saying it's my business, but I have to ask. Why are you so cruel to your little girls?
traduit: 虽然这不关我事，但我不得不问。你为什么对你女儿这么残忍？

original: When you're rich, you can waste as much money as you like on far-fetched business ideas. In the meantime, there's a farm to run.
traduit: 等你有钱了，再在不切实际的商业设想上浪费吧。在此之前，你还要经营农场呢。

original: Hey, people have paid money for stranger things. Take our cow dung - we sell that by the wagon load.
traduit: 嘿，有的是人买过更奇怪的东西。把咱们的牛粪拿去，能论车卖。

original: Hah! Who in their right mind would pay for dirt? You'd get laughed out of Whiterun for even trying it.
traduit: 哈！会有脑子正常的人买垃圾吗？你哪怕试试都会被白漫的人嘲笑的。

original: Maybe we should start selling the soil along with the dung. We could make a tidy profit.
traduit: 也许我们应该把土和粪肥一起卖了。可以赚一笔可观的利润。

original: The way our crops have been growing, Rorikstead must have the richest soil in the hold.
traduit: 按咱们的庄稼长势来看，洛利克镇的土地一定是领内最肥沃的。

original: It's too fine a day to dwell on such things. Let's get back to work and forget about wars and orphans for awhile.
traduit: 今天天气不错，不该细想这些。我们回去工作吧，暂时忘了战争和孤儿的事。

original: I was lucky. If you hadn't rescued me, I'd probably be a thief, a mercenary or something even worse.
traduit: 我很幸运。如果不是你救了我，我可能会当小偷，佣兵或者更糟的东西。

original: Lives lost, crops burned, land ruined... there's no greater sin than war. And yet, you were an orphan, and you've made something of your life.
traduit: 生命沦丧，庄稼焚烧，土地被毁……没有什么比战争更罪恶了。你曾经也是孤儿，但你的人生却有所成就。

original: I'll tell you who I don't envy - those poor children who lost their parents in this war.
traduit: 我告诉你我不羡慕谁，那些在这场战争中失去父母的可怜孩子们。

original: Another fine day at work in the fields. I don't envy those city folk who miss out on the joys of working the land.
traduit: 又是个在田里干活的好天气。我一点也不羡慕那些错过种地乐趣的城里人。

original: I'm old enough to decide how to live my life, and I'd be honored to wear your armor, if you'd just let me. I'm strong enough to handle it.
traduit: 我已经长大了，该决定自己的生活了。如果你愿意的话，我很荣幸能穿上你的盔甲。我有足够的力量来处理它。

original: I've told you a hundred times, I lock that chest for a reason. I don't want you getting a head full of ideas about adventure and glory.
traduit: 我告诉过你一百遍了，我锁那个箱子是有原因的。我不希望你满脑子都是关于冒险和荣耀的想法。

original: I just wanted to try on your old armor, from back when you were a soldier. I thought I might be old enough to wear it.
traduit: 我只是想试试你以前当兵时穿的盔甲。我想我已经长得足够大了，可以穿了。

original: I heard you sneaking around downstairs last night. Were you trying to break into my chest again, son? I've told you to leave it alone.
traduit: 我昨晚听见你在地下室鬼鬼祟祟的。你又想撬开我的箱子吗，儿子？我告诉过你不要碰。

original: Yes, that's your mother's side of the family talking. Just stay on for one more season, that's all I ask.
traduit: 是啊，但这也是你母亲的想法。就再多待一阵子，我只有这点要求了。

original: But I don't want to be safe! I'm not afraid of the dangers out there. The only thing I'm afraid of is wasting my life on this farm.
traduit: 但我不想要安全！我也不害怕外面的危险。我唯一害怕的就是在这个农场浪费生命。

original: I know where this is going, son. As I've said many a time. the world is a dangerous place. You're much safer here at the farm, with me.
traduit: 我知道你是什么意思，儿子。我已经说过很多次了。世界很危险，你和我待在农场会更安全。

original: Father, how old were you when you left home?
traduit: 父亲，你是多大离开家的？

original: You're a liar! I won't listen to you. Leave me alone!
traduit: 你个骗子！我不听你说了。躲开！

original: You smell like a pig's pen, too. What a stink! Have you been rolling in the dirt all day?
traduit: 你闻着也像猪圈一样，真臭！你一整天都在地上打滚吗？

original: I am not! You're lying!
traduit: 我才不是！你撒谎！

original: Look at you! You're as filthy as a pig in a pen!
traduit: 看看你！就像猪圈里的猪一样脏！

original: It pleases me to know that I can still be of use even in the twilight of my life.
traduit: 我很高兴知道自己在老了之后还能派上用场。

original: Well done! I don't know where I'd be without you, my old friend.
traduit: 干得好！不知道没了你我会怎么样，老朋友。

original: The last wheat shipment fetched a fine price at market.
traduit: 上批小麦在市场卖了好价钱。

original: Maybe you're right. Even so, I can't help wondering if some other force it at work here.
traduit: 也许你说得对。即便如此，我还是忍不住想，是不是有其他力量在起作用。

original: Luck? I think it has more to do with the hard work and good soil.
traduit: 走运吗？我认为是和辛勤劳作还有好土地更有关系。

original: Looks like we're in for quite a harvest. We've had better luck with our planting than any village in the hold.
traduit: 看来我们要大丰收了。咱们的庄稼很走运地比领地里其他村子都要好。

original: Nothing refreshes the soul like an honest day's labor in good, tilled earth.
traduit: 没有什么比在耕耘过的土地上辛勤劳动更能使人振奋的了。

original: Looks like it's going to be a bountiful harvest once again. The gods continue to smile upon us.
traduit: 看来又要大丰收了。众神还在对我们微笑。

original: It's remarkable that our farms are so prosperous given the harsh winters of late.
traduit: 考虑到近来的严冬，我们的农场能如此繁荣真是不可思议。

original: We've gotten a letter about someone needing some muscle over in the Reach.
traduit: 我们收到一封信，说瑞驰领有人需要人手。

original: We've gotten a letter about someone needing some muscle up in Haafingar.
traduit: 我们收到一封信，说海芬加领有人需要人手。

original: We've gotten a letter about someone needing some muscle up in Hjaalmarch.
traduit: 我们收到一封信，说希雅陲领有人需要人手。

original: We've gotten a letter about someone needing some muscle down in Falkreath.
traduit: 我们收到一封信，说佛克瑞斯领有人需要人手。

original: We've gotten a letter about someone needing some muscle right here in Whiterun Hold.
traduit: 我们收到一封信，说白漫领有人需要人手。

original: We've gotten a letter about someone needing some muscle out in the Pale.
traduit: 我们收到一封信，说苍原领有人需要人手。

original: We've gotten a letter about someone needing some muscle over in the Rift.
traduit: 我们收到一封信，说裂痕领有人需要人手。

original: We've gotten a letter about someone needing some muscle over in Eastmarch.
traduit: 我们收到一封信，说东陲领有人需要人手。

original: We've gotten a letter about someone needing some muscle all the way in Winterhold.
traduit: 我们收到一封信，说冬堡领有人需要人手。

original: I can handle that.
traduit: 我来摆平。

original: Try not to get carried away.
traduit: 要保持理智啊。

original: Go. Bring honor to yourself, and the Companions.
traduit: 去吧。给自己和战友团带来荣誉。

original: Get to it, then.
traduit: 那就去吧。

original: Were they successful?
traduit: 他们成功了吗？

original: No. Knowing they could never defeat the orcs, the priests of Vaermina released what they call "The Miasma," putting everyone to sleep.
traduit: 不。因为明白没法打败兽人，瓦尔迷纳的祭司们释放了所谓的“毒气”，让所有人进入了梦乡。

original: Before we enter, I must warn you about the dangers that could be lurking within.
traduit: 进去前，我得提醒你潜在的危险。

original: Years ago, this temple was raided by an orc war party seeking revenge... they were being plagued by nightmares just like the people of Dawnstar.
traduit: 多年前，这个神殿被一支寻仇的兽人武装袭击……他们也是像晨星人一样被噩梦困扰。

original: That's a fine potion you've put together.
traduit: 你配制的药水不错啊。

original: You've brewed a truly vile poison there. I pity the beast that tastes that.
traduit: 你配制的毒药可够危险的。我都开始同情尝到这味道的野兽了。

original: You've produced a rarefied solution there, an infusion of pure essences. Artfully done.
traduit: 很纯净的药剂精华。完成得太巧妙了。

original: An excellent elixir. Your technique shows a command of the alchemical art.
traduit: 优秀的灵药。显然你已经掌握炼金术了。

original: That's a good concoction. But keep trying new things. Alchemy rewards inquisitive minds.
traduit: 混合得不错。但还是要不断尝试新事物。炼金术会奖励好奇的头脑的。

original: An "interesting" mixture... Keep experimenting. You'll improve with practice.
traduit: “有趣”的混合……继续试验吧。练习让人进步。

original: It's intriguing the way certain materials are more or less receptive to the force of lightning, is it not?
traduit: 有些材料或多或少能承载些闪电之力，很有趣吧？

original: It's wise to carry a few summoning enchantments around.
traduit: 随身带几件召唤附魔物品准没错。

original: Ah, fire. A capricious element. Often deadly, but always exciting.
traduit: 啊，火焰。反复无常的元素。往往致命却总是令人兴奋。

original: Now that's how it's done! I doubt anyone in Skyrim could have weaved a better enchantment.
traduit: 居然完成了！我看天际没人能创造比这更好的附魔了。

original: Well done. Not many enchanters could pull that off.
traduit: 干得好。现在没多少附魔师有这手能耐了。

original: That's a decent enchantment. But keep studying, you've only scratched the surface.
traduit: 很不错的附魔。但还得继续学习，现在你只是掌握了些皮毛而已。

original: Watching you reminds me of my first days as an enchanter.
traduit: 看到你就想起我刚成为附魔师时候的样子。

original: The meal is on Namira's table. Go ahead. Carve.
traduit: 食材已经放在娜米拉的桌子上了。去吧，下刀吧。

original: Come with me. Our feast is about to begin.
traduit: 跟我来。盛宴就要开始了。

original: I need to lay down. I'll just be a minute....
traduit: 我要躺下。我要休息一会儿……

original: Why don't you lay down and rest, while we get the meal ready?
traduit: 何不先躺下休息一下，等我们去准备饭菜？

original: I've been invited to dinner.... I'm so hungry....
traduit: 我受邀来用餐……我很饿……

original: Yes. I'm your friend, and I've invited you to dinner.
traduit: 对。我是你的朋友，来邀你共进晚餐。

original: Never mind, then.
traduit: 没关系。

original: Arkay watch over you.
traduit: 阿尔凯注视着你。

original: I said let's go. Now.
traduit: 我说走。现在。

original: He... He gave me something just a little while ago.
traduit: 他……刚才交给我一样东西。

original: He told me it was from Labyrinthian, and that I would know what to do with it when the time came.
traduit: 他告诉我，这东西来自迷城，到时候我会知道该如何处理。

original: I think... I think he meant this for you, then. I'm not sure why, but there was something very personal about it for him.
traduit: 我想……我想他是想要说给你听。我不知道为什么，但这应该是他很私密的事。

original: Also, I think you should take this amulet. It belonged to Savos, but I think would do you the most good now.
traduit: 还有，我觉得你应该收下这个护符。萨沃斯的遗物，我觉得现在对你更有用处。

original: Take it, and get out of here. Bring back that staff before Ancano brings the whole College down around us.
traduit: 拿着吧，离开这里。在安卡诺把整个学院炸上天之前把东西拿回来。

original: I don't understand. What coincidence?
traduit: 我不明白你的意思。什么巧合？

original: Savos. Before... before he died.
traduit: 是萨沃斯。在……他离世前。

original: You really think the Staff will help?
traduit: 你真觉得法杖有用吗？

original: You were told to find it, weren't you?
traduit: 有人让你去找它不是吗？

original: If the stories about the staff are true, if it really can absorb a tremendous amount of power, maybe we can break through Ancano's magic.
traduit: 如果法杖的故事属实，它真的能吸收巨大的能量，也许我们就能够突破安卡诺的魔法。

original: What in the name of Sithis...
traduit: 西帝斯在上这是……

original: Cicero! It's good to see you again, old friend.
traduit: 西塞罗！很高兴又见到你，老朋友。

original: Listener!
traduit: 聆听者！

original: Home again, home again! I'll return to the Night Mother straightaway!
traduit: 回家咯，回家咯！我要回到夜母身边去！

original: You're dismissed. Return home.
traduit: 你先解散。回家吧。

original: Oh, of course. Mother needs me, after all.
traduit: 哦，当然。夜母还需要我呢。

original: You're dismissed. Stay in the Sanctuary.
traduit: 先解散。回圣所吧。

original: I will return to the Dawnstar Sanctuary immediately, Listener.
traduit: 我马上就返回晨星圣所，聆听者。

original: Yes, Listener. I'll be here if you need me.
traduit: 是，聆听者。你需要我的时候我就在那儿。

original: Yes, Listener. I'll return to the Dawnstar Sanctuary without delay.
traduit: 是，聆听者。我会立刻返回晨星圣所。

original: Of course. But if you need me, just give the order.
traduit: 好的。需要我的时候，只管吩咐。

original: Yes, Listener! I will remain in this very spot until you tell me otherwise. Spiders could eat my face off and faithful Cicero would not move an inch!
traduit: 好的，聆听者！我会一直待在这里，直到你另作指示。就算蜘蛛把我脸啃掉，忠诚的西塞罗也会寸步不离！

original: Wait here.
traduit: 在这儿等着。

original: Yes, Listener. I won't move unless you give the word.
traduit: 好的，聆听者！你不说动我就不动。

original: I'll remain in this location until ordered otherwise.
traduit: 除非另外下令，不然我就在这儿了。

original: Oh yes, Cicero and the Listener! On the hunt!
traduit: 哦好，西塞罗和聆听者！开始狩猎了！

original: I command you to accompany me.
traduit: 我要你和我一起走。

original: Off we go.
traduit: 我们走吧。

original: Oh, but the Listener jests with poor Cicero. You already have company. You don't need my help at all.
traduit: 哦，聆听者是在耍笑可怜的西塞罗吧。你已经有同伴了。根本不需要我的帮助。

original: I am honored to be chosen.
traduit: 被选中真荣幸。

original: Lead on, Listener.
traduit: 走吧，聆听者。

original: But you already have a traveling companion. I fear I would just get in the way.
traduit: 但你已经有旅伴了。我会碍事的。

original: I am yours, Listener.
traduit: 我跟你走，聆听者。

original: Yes, Listener.
traduit: 好的，聆听者。

original: Oh, well... You seem to already have assistance. Surely you mean to remain inconspicuous...
traduit: 哦……你好像已经有帮手了。你肯定希望保持低调的……

original: As for myself, you've proven your mastery twice over. Thuri, Dovahkiin. I gladly acknowledge the power of your Thu'um.
traduit: 至于我，你已经两次证明了自己的力量。图瑞，都瓦克因。我很高兴承认您的吐'目之力。

original: And so Alduin's lordship passes to you. Thuri, Dovahkiin. I gladly submit to your mastery of the Thu'um.
traduit: 因此奥杜因的主人身份移交于你。图瑞，都瓦克因。我很高兴承认您的吐'目之力。

original: Zu'u Odahviing. Call me when you have need, and I will come if I can.
traduit: 祖'乌 傲达威英。在你需要的时候召唤我，我会为你而来。

original: The world is a better place without Alduin.
traduit: 没了奥杜因，世界更美好。

original: Perhaps. At least it will continue to exist. Grik los lein.
traduit: 或许吧。至少世界会继续存在。格瑞克 洛斯 雷恩。

original: And, as you told me once, the next world will have to take care of itself. Ful nii los. Even I cannot see past Time's ending.
traduit: 而且，就如你告诉我的，彼世自有彼世福。富尔 尼依 洛斯。就连我也无法看穿时间的终结。

original: I am glad you believe that. At least it will continue to exist. Grik los lein.
traduit: 很高兴你会相信这一点。至少世界会存续下去。格瑞克 洛斯 雷恩。

original: Even I cannot see past Time's ending to what comes next. Niid koraav zeim dinoksetiid. We must do the best we can with this world.
traduit: 就连我也无法看穿时间的终结。尼依德 寇拉夫 泽姆 迪诺克瑟提德。我们必须尽力在这个世界上做得最好。

original: But I forget myself. Krosis. So los mid fahdon. Melancholy is an easy trap for a dovah to fall into.
traduit: 但我有些忘我了。科洛西斯。索 洛斯 米德 法顿。都瓦很容易掉入哀伤的陷阱。

original: You have won a mighty victory. Sahrot krongrah - one that will echo through all the ages of this world for those who have eyes to see.
traduit: 你赢得了一场大胜。撒洛特 克隆格拉——会被此世所有明眼人永久传唱下去。

original: Savor your triumph, Dovahkiin. This is not the last of what you will write upon the currents of Time.
traduit: 尽情享受你的胜利吧，都瓦克因。这不会是你在时间之流中写下的终章。

original: Perhaps now you have some insight into the forces that shape the vennesetiid... the currents of Time.
traduit: 也许你现在对塑造温聂瑟提德……时间之流的力量有些理解了。

original: Perhaps you begin to see the world as a dovah.
traduit: 也许你开始以一个都瓦的眼光审视世界了。

original: I was just fulfilling my destiny as Dragonborn.
traduit: 我只是在履行我作为龙裔的使命。

original: You once told me you did not believe in destiny.
traduit: 你曾说过自己不信命运。

original: Indeed, you saw more clearly than I - certainly more clearly than Alduin. Rok funta koraav.
traduit: 的确，你现在比我，还有奥杜因看得都清楚。若克 芬塔 寇拉夫。

original: I told you I'd stop him, and I did.
traduit: 我告诉过你我会阻止他，我成功了。

original: And so you fulfilled your destiny, which you once said you did not believe in.
traduit: 所以你还是完成了自己的使命，当初你告诉我自己不信命。

original: But I cannot celebrate his fall. Zu'u tiiraaz ahst ok mah. He was my brother once. This world will never be the same.
traduit: 但我不能庆祝他的陨落。祖'乌 提拉兹 阿斯特 欧克 玛。他曾是我的兄弟。世界也在不断变化啊。

original: Alduin brought this on himself.
traduit: 奥杜因这是自找的。

original: Indeed.  Alduin wahlaan daanii.
traduit: 确实。奥杜因 瓦兰 丹尼。

original: His doom was written when he claimed for himself the lordship that properly belongs to Bormahu - our father Akatosh.
traduit: 当他僭越称治，剽窃伯马胡——我等之父阿卡托什之权的时候，他就注定在劫难逃了。

original: It was necessary.
traduit: 我别无选择。

original: You did what was necessary. Alduin had flown far from the path of right action in his pahlok - the arrogance of his power.
traduit: 你做了你应做的。奥杜因因为对自身力量的帕洛克……傲慢，已经偏离了正确行动的道路。

original: I have no regrets. Alduin had to be destroyed.
traduit: 我不后悔。因为奥杜因必须被毁灭。

original: Of course. Alduin wahlaan daanii. I would not have helped you if I thought otherwise.
traduit: 当然。奥杜因 瓦兰 丹尼。如果我不这么想，也就不会帮你了。

original: You don't sound very happy about it.
traduit: 你听着不太高兴。

original: Happy? No, I am not happy. Zeymahi lost ont du'ul Bormahu. Alduin was once the crown of our father Akatosh's creation.
traduit: 高兴？我当然不高兴。泽玛亥 洛斯特 昂特 都'乌尔 伯马胡。奥杜因曾经冠绝我父阿卡托什的造物。

original: So, it is done. Alduin dilon. The Eldest is no more, he who came before all others, and has always been.
traduit: 所以，结束了。奥杜因 蒂隆。前无来者、亘古存在的长子已经不存在了。

original: I was actually looking to buy something.
traduit: 其实我是来买东西的。

original: Didn't you just see that woman getting attacked in front of us? We're closed.
traduit: 你没看见那女人在我们面前被袭击了吗？今天打烊了。

original: Who was he? Who are the Forsworn?
traduit: 他是谁？弃誓者是什么人？

original: Think he worked down at the smelter. Lot of the laborers there are sympathetic to the Forsworn.
traduit: 应该是冶炼厂的工人。那里有很多劳工都很同情弃誓者。

original: They promise people they'll kill off all the Nords that rule over the Reach. Nothing but murderers and saboteurs.
traduit: 他们宣称要杀光统治瑞驰的全部诺德人。一群杀人犯和破坏狂罢了。

original: Did you see that madman? A Forsworn agent. Here in the city.
traduit: 你看见那个疯子了吗？弃誓者的奸细啊。就在这个城里。

original: I'm sorry. I don't think I can bare to sell anything right now.
traduit: 抱歉。我现在什么生意也不想做了。

original: Did you know her? Who was she?
traduit: 你认识她吗？她是谁？

original: She's a traveler, from the Imperial City. Came by every day looking for jewelry for her relatives back home.
traduit: 是个从帝都来的旅行者。每天都来给她老家的亲戚选购珠宝。

original: Why would anyone want to kill her? It doesn't make any sense.
traduit: 为什么会有人想杀她？没意义的啊。

original: No. She's such a nice woman. Comes by every day looking for jewelry for her family in Cyrodiil. Is it because she's a noble?
traduit: 不。她是个好人。每天都来为希罗帝尔的家人挑选珠宝。难道因为她是贵族？

original: Do you know why he was after her?
traduit: 你知道她为什么被盯上吗？

original: Margret. He... he killed her. Right in front of me.
traduit: 玛格丽特……被他杀了。就在我的面前。

original: He... he tried to kill Margret. Right in front of me.
traduit: 他……他打算在我面前，杀了玛格丽特。

original: None of my business, anyway.
traduit: 无所谓，不关我的事。

original: That's right. It isn't.
traduit: 这就对了。与你无关。

original: That man shouted something about the "Forsworn."
traduit: 那个人大喊着什么“弃誓者”。

original: I said move along. The Forsworn are just a bunch of madmen. We have everything under control. Stay out of it.
traduit: 我说走开。弃誓者就是一群疯子而已。一切尽在我们掌控。不要插手了。

original: We'll handle things from here. Move along.
traduit: 我们来处理这件事。走开吧。

original: The Forsworn. Here inside the city.
traduit: 弃誓者。就在城里。

original: He was after Margret. Why?
traduit: 他盯上了玛格丽特。为什么？

original: Damn. Another body to get rid of.
traduit: 该死。又有尸体要处理了。

original: Betrid. No! We had a deal you Forsworn bastards!
traduit: 贝垂德。不！你们这群混蛋弃誓者！

original: Why? We had a deal Madanach. A deal!
traduit: 为什么？我们说好了的，迈德纳奇。说好了的！

original: Traitors. Traitors all of you!
traduit: 叛徒。全是叛徒！

original: Biding his time until what? Until another person is lying dead in the streets? Don't be naive.
traduit: 他在等什么？直到再有人横死街头？不要太天真了。

original: Please. Those savages are no match for us. The Jarl is just biding his time.
traduit: 拜托，那些蛮子不是咱们的对手。领主只是在等待时机。

original: The Jarl is refusing to dispatch men to the front lines. Do you think it's because of the Forsworn threat?
traduit: 领主拒绝派人到前线去。你觉得会不会是因为弃誓者？

original: You're being paranoid. We're in control of Markarth. Not the Forsworn.
traduit: 你偏执了。马卡斯现在在我们手里。不是弃誓者。

original: Yeah, but she was a Nord. And a noble. Perfect Forsworn target.
traduit: 是啊。但她是诺德人。而且是贵族。弃誓者的好靶子啊。

original: I think it was Margret. Poor woman, she was just visiting the city from Cyrodiil.
traduit: 应该是玛格丽特。可怜的女人，她才刚从希罗帝尔来这里。

original: Someone was attacked in the market. Do you know who it was?
traduit: 有人在市场被袭击了。你知道是谁吗？

original: Now you're being ridiculous. This is our city. Not theirs.
traduit: 你太搞笑了。这是我们的城。不是他们的。

original: This was their city once. They won't stop until we're all dead.
traduit: 这里曾经是他们的城市。我们不死他们是不会罢休的。

original: The Jarl has things under control. Don't you worry.
traduit: 一切都在领主掌控之中。不用担心。

original: A Forsworn agent. Running loose in the city. The Jarl is going to hear about this.
traduit: 弃誓者奸细。居然在城里乱晃。我得报告给领主知道。

original: dunMiddenShared
traduit: dunMiddenShared

original: I'd like to rent a room. (<Global=RoomCost> gold)
traduit: 我想租间房。（<Global=RoomCost>金币）

original: Are you joking? You just rented a room from me.
traduit: 你在开玩笑？你不是刚从我这里租了个房间吗。

original: Have a good rest. It's the big room with the double bed.
traduit: 好好休息。那是个有双人床的大房间。

original: I'll rent Tiber Septim's room. (<Global=RoomCost> gold)
traduit: 我把泰伯·塞普汀的房间租了。（<Global=RoomCost>金币）

original: Sure thing. It's yours for a day.
traduit: 行啊。今天归你了。

original: What does this look like, the Temple of Mara? No gold, no bed.
traduit: 我这里难道是玛拉神殿吗？没有钱，就没有床。

original: I'd like to rent a room.  (<Global=RoomCost> gold)
traduit: 我想租个房间。（<Global=RoomCost>金币）

original: Sorry, love, but I'm not a charity.
traduit: 抱歉，亲爱的，但我不是慈善家。

original: Oh, very well. But my energies are low. I warn you - I won't be able to see much. Give me... five gold, and I'll do what I can.
traduit: 哦，很好。但我的能量状态太低了。我跟你说，这样是看不清楚的。给我……五枚金币，我会尽力而为的。

original: I want you to read my fortune.
traduit: 我想请你看看我的未来。

original: No... no, that is all. Now... now please. I find myself very weary all of sudden.
traduit: 不……不，就这些了。现在……请吧。我突然觉得很累。

original: Is there anything else?
traduit: 还有什么吗？

original: There's a cave. No, not a cave. A... home? A place you feel secure. You will find safety there... sanctuary. I see snow, lit by the star of dawn.
traduit: 有一个山洞。不，不是山洞。是一个……家？一个让你感到安全的地方。你会在那里找到安全的……圣所。我看见了被黎明之星照亮的白雪。

original: And you are not alone. There are others. A child of night... a stalker of the sands? Oh, but before you are family, there will be blood. Such blood.
traduit: 你并不孤单。还有别的人在你身旁。一个黑夜之子……一个沙漠行者？哦，但在你们成为家人前，会有鲜血相伴。大量的鲜血。

original: Wait! There's something else... A potential for adventure, and wealth. It is a ruin, ripe for the plunder. Deepwood Redoubt. Far to the northwest...
traduit: 等等！还有别的东西……潜藏着冒险和财富。是座遗迹，时机已经成熟。深木据点。在遥远的西北方向……

original: Through there is... Hag's End. The last resting place of an assassin of old. A Dark Brother, who bequeaths his ancient earthly possessions... to you.
traduit: 穿过那里就是……鬼婆之终。古代刺客最后的安息之所。那位黑暗兄弟把他古老的尘世财产……留给了你。

original: What do you see?
traduit: 你看到了什么？

original: Your destiny is dark. Oh yes, so dark. But much of it has been fulfilled. You have found sanctuary, and the comforting words of a mother's love.
traduit: 你的命运一片黑暗。哦没错，太黑暗了。但大部分目标已经实现。你找到了圣所，找到了母爱的慰藉。

original: And you have companionship. A child of night, and a stalker of the sands. Together, you are a family.
traduit: 你还有同伴。一个黑夜之子，还有个沙漠行者。你们现在是一家人了。

original: It is the last resting place of an assassin of old. A Dark Brother, who bequeaths his ancient earthly possessions... to you.
traduit: 那是古代刺客最后的安息之所。那位黑暗兄弟把他古老的尘世财产……留给了你。

original: WhiterunOlavaReadingTopic1
traduit: WhiterunOlavaReadingTopic1

original: Hmph. Yes. Yes, I surely can. It's not something I do lightly, mind you, and it's not as specific as you might want. But yes. I will do this for you.
traduit: 嗯。对，对。我当然能。但提醒一下，这不是轻易能做到的事，也没你想象的那么具体明确。但确实没错。我能帮你。

original: Please, relax. Free your mind. Yes, that's it...
traduit: 请放松。放空精神。没错，就是这样……

original: I was told you could see my future.
traduit: 我听说你能看到我的未来。

original: Token, you say? Let me see.
traduit: 你说标记？让我看看。

original: Oh, goodness me. You're a friend of Gabriella's, then. Well, I guess we both know why you're here.
traduit: 哦，天啊。你是加布里艾拉的朋友啊。你来这儿的原因咱们心知肚明。

original: I have this token for you.
traduit: 我有个标记要给你。

original: Why, this is utterly unique.
traduit: 这也太特殊了。

original: I'm not the only one seeing this, am I?
traduit: 我不是唯一看到这个的人吧？

original: Not much further. Come, little thing. Serve me in death.
traduit: 不远了。来吧，小东西。以亡灵之姿侍奉我吧。

original: I took care of that group of Silver Hand.
traduit: 我把那群银手处理了。

original: Excellent. Looks like you've really driven them into hiding. Keep this up. We'll wipe them out, yet.
traduit: 太好了。看来你真的逼得他们躲起来了。继续保持。我们会消灭他们的。

original: I've got the plans.
traduit: 我拿到计划了。

original: Perfect. Hopefully this will let us know more about their movement. I think we've got them on the run!
traduit: 完美。希望能更了解他们行动。咱们会把他们赶跑的！

original: I took care of the problem in <Alias=BruteTown>.
traduit: 我把<Alias=BruteTown>的问题解决了。

original: Kind of fun to push people around sometimes, isn't it. Good work, brother.
traduit: 有时候打人也挺好玩吧。干得好，兄弟。

original: Kind of fun to push people around sometimes, isn't it. Good work, sister.
traduit: 有时候打人也挺好玩吧。干得好，姐妹。

original: You seem to have a knack for this kind of thing. I'll make sure people in charge know.
traduit: 你似乎对这种事很有一套啊。我会让负责人知道的。

original: I figured you had it in you. Nicely done.
traduit: 我就知道你有这本事。完成得不错。

original: I'm cutting your pay for this job.
traduit: 我扣你钱了。

original: Be more careful next time. This isn't a game.
traduit: 下次小心点。这可不是玩闹。

original: <Alias=Brute> was killed.
traduit: <Alias=Brute>被杀了。

original: Shor's bones, boy. What did I tell you?
traduit: 舒尔的骨头啊，小伙子。我是怎么给你说的？

original: Shor's bones, girl. What did I tell you?
traduit: 舒尔的骨头啊，小姑娘。我是怎么给你说的？

original: I don't know what the fight is about, and that's not our business anyway.
traduit: 我不知道他们在吵什么，反正也不关我们的事。

original: I just need you to go out there, look tough, and scare this milk drinker into submission.
traduit: 只是要你过去，样子摆的凶点，把这个软蛋吓服了就行。

original: No more than that. I don't want to hear about a killing, understand?
traduit: 仅此而已。我可不想听到有人被杀，明白吗？

original: What's the next target?
traduit: 下一个目标是什么？

original: The Silver Hand has been scouring the world for more pieces of Wuuthrad.
traduit: 银手一直在满世界找巫斯拉德的碎片。

original: What's our first target?
traduit: 我们第一个目标是什么？

original: If you can sneak into their camp and steal his plans, we'll have the advantage.
traduit: 如果你能溜进他们的营地偷取他的计划，那我们就能占据上风。

original: If you can sneak into their camp and steal her plans, we'll have the advantage.
traduit: 如果你能溜进他们的营地偷取她的计划，那我们就能占据上风。

original: I've caught wind that one of the brighter Silver Hand has been sniffing around the Reach.
traduit: 我听说有个银手的干部正在瑞驰领巡查。

original: I've caught wind that one of the brighter Silver Hand has been sniffing around Haafingar.
traduit: 我听说有个银手的干部正在海芬加领巡查。

original: I've caught wind that one of the brighter Silver Hand has been sniffing around Hjaalmarch.
traduit: 我听说有个银手的干部正在希雅陲领巡查。

original: I've caught wind that one of the brighter Silver Hand has been sniffing around Falkreath.
traduit: 我听说有个银手的干部正在佛克瑞斯领巡查。

original: I've caught wind that one of the brighter Silver Hand has been sniffing around Whiterun.
traduit: 我听说有个银手的干部正在白漫领巡查。

original: I've caught wind that one of the brighter Silver Hand has been sniffing around the Pale.
traduit: 我听说有个银手的干部正在苍原领巡查。

original: I've caught wind that one of the brighter Silver Hand has been sniffing around the Rift.
traduit: 我听说有个银手的干部正在裂痕领巡查。

original: I've caught wind that one of the brighter Silver Hand has been sniffing around Eastmarch.
traduit: 我听说有个银手的干部正在东陲领巡查。

original: I've caught wind that one of the brighter Silver Hand has been sniffing around Winterhold.
traduit: 我听说有个银手的干部正在冬堡领巡查。

original: Run fast, my friend.
traduit: 朋友，尽快行动。

original: A group of them has holed up in the Reach.
traduit: 他们有一伙正躲在瑞驰领。

original: A group of them has holed up in Haafingar.
traduit: 他们有一伙正躲在海芬加领。

original: A group of them has holed up in Hjaalmarch.
traduit: 他们有一伙正躲在希雅陲领。

original: A group of them has holed up in Falkreath.
traduit: 他们有一伙正躲在佛克瑞斯领。

original: A group of them has holed up in Whiterun.
traduit: 他们有一伙正躲在白漫领。

original: A group of them has holed up in the Pale.
traduit: 他们有一伙正躲在苍原领。

original: A group of them has holed up in the Rift.
traduit: 他们有一伙正躲在裂痕领。

original: A group of them has holed up in Eastmarch.
traduit: 他们有一伙正躲在东陲领。

original: A group of them has holed up in Winterhold.
traduit: 他们有一伙正躲在冬堡领。

original: I've been hearing rumors of Silver Hand activity.
traduit: 我一直在收集关于银手的传言。

original: Please get me home!
traduit: 请送我回家！

original: Are you here to save me?
traduit: 你是来救我的吗？

original: Just remember I'm here if you rethink your decision.
traduit: 等你考虑好了，我还在这儿等你。

original: Wolf Queen. Hear our call and awaken. We summon Potema!
traduit: 狼后。聆听我们的召唤，醒来吧。我们召唤您，波特玛！

original: Long have you slept the dreamless sleep of death, Potema. No longer. Hear us Wolf Queen! We Summon You!
traduit: 您沉睡无梦的死亡之梦久矣，波特玛。请觉醒。聆听我们的召唤，狼后！我们召唤您！

original: We summon Potema!
traduit: 我们召唤您，波特玛！

original: As our voices summon you the blood of the innocent binds you Wolf Queen!
traduit: 当我们的声音召唤你的时候，我们也以无辜者的鲜血束缚您，狼后！

original: Summoned with words. Bound by blood.
traduit: 以言灵召唤。以鲜血束缚。

original: Yes! Yes! Return me to this realm!
traduit: 对！对！把我带回这个位面！

original: What! What are you doing?! You fools! You cannot bind me to your wills!
traduit: 什么！你们在干什么？！蠢货！你休想让我屈服于你们的意志！

original: You ants don't have the power to bind me!
traduit: 你们这群蝼蚁岂能束缚我！

original: Something is wrong. There is an intruder.
traduit: 不对劲。有入侵者。

original: I shall not be bound.
traduit: 我是不会被束缚的。

original: What did you do in Wolfskull cave?!
traduit: 你在狼头骨洞穴做了什么？！

original: I'm Sybille Stentor, court mage of Solitude, and according to my scrying you've managed to unleash Potema herself!
traduit: 希比利·斯丹特，独孤城宫廷法师，根据我的占卜，你释放了波特玛！

original: I stopped some Necromancers from summoning Potema.
traduit: 我阻止了一群死灵法师召唤波特玛。

original: You weren't nearly as successful as you think, fool. According to my scrying the Wolf Queen has returned.
traduit: 没你想的那么成功，傻瓜。按我的占卜，狼后已经回来了。

original: I'm here to speak to Falk.
traduit: 我来找佛可。

original: Listen you impudent cur. According to my scrying something happened at Wolfskull Cave that returned Potema to this world.
traduit: 听着，你个无耻杂种，我的占卜显示狼头骨洞穴发生了什么事情，把波特玛放回这个世界了。

original: Panic we can handle, Balgruuf. It's the dragons I'm not so sure about.
traduit: 我们能应对恐慌，巴尔古夫。我不觉得那真是龙族。

original: By Ysmir, this is just what we need. There'll be panic in the streets if this proves true.
traduit: 伊斯米尔在上，这正是我们需要的。如果是真的，那街上就会一片恐慌。

original: I've dispatched a rider to Helgen. We'll know soon enough.
traduit: 我已经派飞骑去探海尔根了。很快就能知道消息。

original: And you're sure?
traduit: 你确定？

original: We will find her eventually.
traduit: 我们会找到她的。

original: She cannot hide from us forever.
traduit: 她不可能永远躲着我们。

original: If you locate her, find us in Rorikstead.
traduit: 如果你找到她，去洛利克镇找我们。

original: Quickly, come with me.
traduit: 快，跟我来。

original: Find me the moment the Alik'r are taken care of.
traduit: 等搞定了阿里克'尔再来找我。

original: So, what's this special request?
traduit: 那特殊任务是什么？

original: Got word from Torsten Cruel-Sea in Windhelm that a rival Guild is tryin' to get itself started.
traduit: 我们从风舵城的托斯滕·酷海那里收到风儿了，一个敌对公会正试图开始活动。

original: Not only that but they're givin' us thieves a bad name by murderin' their marks.
traduit: 不仅如此，他们还谋杀了自己的目标，给咱们盗贼业抹了黑。

original: Get over there and see what you can do.
traduit: 去看看能做些什么。

original: We actually got a request from one of the most powerful families in Whiterun, the Battle-Born's.
traduit: 我们受到了白漫城最有权势的一个家族的请求，是战狂家。

original: Make your way up there and look for Olfrid. He says he's got a matter that requires a delicate touch, and I suggested you for the job.
traduit: 去找奥弗瑞德吧。他说有件事需要小心处理，我就推荐你了。

original: Don't make me the fool and let me down, all right?
traduit: 别让我看上去很傻，也别让我失望，好吗？

original: I want you to head out to Markarth and speak to Endon. He's a silversmith... has some kind of a shop there.
traduit: 我需要你去马卡斯和恩东谈谈。他是个银匠……在那儿开了家店。

original: His father was a good friend of the Guild back in the day, and we could really use his family's influence back on our side.
traduit: 他父亲以前是公会的好朋友，我们可以利用他们家的影响力。

original: I need you to make your way to Solitude and talk to Erikur. He's lookin' to run some kind of a shill job.
traduit: 我需要你去独孤城和艾瑞库尔谈谈。他在找人做一次设饵工作。

original: Now, he's not exactly goin' to welcome you with open arms, but keep your cool. Do this job right and we've just made an important friend out there.
traduit: 他不会张开双臂欢迎你，但保持冷静。做好这件事，咱们就交到一个重要的伙伴。

original: Have something special for me, Delvin?
traduit: 有什么特别任务给我吗，戴尔文？

original: Well, I never thought I'd see the Guild this way ever again. The place is growin' into what it used to be when Gallus was runnin' the show.
traduit: 我从没想过公会还能是这个样子。这地方渐渐变回加卢斯掌舵的样子了。

original: Contacts are springin' up all over and I've got young footpads beatin' down the door to join up.
traduit: 到处都是想要加入的人，很多年轻人希望入伙。

original: I got one last special request of you. Finish this one and all of Skyrim's ours for the takin'.
traduit: 我还有最后一个特别任务。完成这个，全天际就是咱们的了。

original: I don't know what your made of, but I've never seen anyone tackle this many jobs without endin' up dead or in jail.
traduit: 我不知道你有什么本事，但我还没见过谁干了这么多活儿还没死或者蹲号子。

original: We've got half of Skyrim back under our wing and the coin's startin' to flow.
traduit: 我们已经打下了天际的半壁江山，资金开始流动了。

original: Now, if you're ready, I got another special job for you.
traduit: 现在，如果你准备好了，我这里有另一项特殊任务给你。

original: I've got another special request and they specifically asked for you.
traduit: 我这里有新的特殊任务，而且他们点名要你出马。

original: Your makin' a name for yourself, that's for sure. But more important, you're makin' a name for the Guild. Keep it up.
traduit: 你已经开始扬名立万了，毋庸置疑。但更重要的是，你为公会打出名声了。好好坚持。

original: Well, it appears your actions are startin' to make waves out there. People are talkin' about the Guild again.
traduit: 嗯，你的行动在外面掀起波澜了。人们开始重新谈论公会了。

original: In fact, I just got a special job request in. I haven't gotten anythin' like it in years.
traduit: 其实，我刚收到一份特殊工作的请求。我都好几年没接到过这种东西了。

original: The Guild's at full strength and we have you to thank for it. We've had our share of dark times, and now they seem like a distant memory.
traduit: 公会现在羽翼丰满，都要感谢你。我们经历过黑暗的时光，但现在似乎成了遥远的记忆。

original: I'm goin' to tell you'll somethin' you'll never hear me say again, and if you tell anyone I told you, I'll deny it.
traduit: 我要告诉你一些我不会再重复的话。要是你传出去说是我说的，我就会否认。

original: When you walk through the Guild, don't be ashamed to hold your head high 'cause you're the best damn thief in the place.
traduit: 当你行走在公会里，要昂首挺胸。因为你是这里最棒的小偷。

original: Success means that the Guild is gettin' stronger. We've picked up another merchant and a new recruit.
traduit: 成功意味着公会变得更加强大。我们又招来了一个商人还有一个新人。

original: Bein' a thief is like a second skin for you, ain't it? Never seen anythin' like it.
traduit: 小偷这行对你来说简直就是量身打造，对吧？真稀奇啊。

original: If you don't watch out, you might even earn Vex's respect. Now that'd be something, eh?
traduit: 你要是不注意，甚至要赢得小烦的尊重了。这可是很了不起的。

original: We're still growin' by leaps and bounds thanks to you. Another merchant's just moved into the space outside the Flagon.
traduit: 多亏了你，我们还在飞速发展。新的商人刚刚搬到漏壶外面。

original: You're a natural. Never seen anythin' like it.
traduit: 你真是天生的贼。从没见过这样的事。

original: We've got a long way to go, but don't let that bother you... it's a lot farther than we've been in years.
traduit: 我们还有很长的路要走，但不要因此感到困扰……咱们已经比以前走过的路远多了。

original: I think you'll find that the Guild is beginnin' to grow. We've had a merchant move into the space right outside the Flagon.
traduit: 我想你会发现公会开始了成长，有个商人搬到了漏壶外面。

original: It's nice to shake the cobwebs off and get things rollin' again. Keep this up and I can see a bounty headed our way.
traduit: 甩掉蜘蛛网，让一切重新开始，感觉真好。再这样下去，我都觉得有赏金要来了。

original: I've finished that special Markarth job.
traduit: 我完成了马卡斯的特殊任务。

original: I hear Endon's quite pleased to have his merchandise back.
traduit: 我听说恩东很高兴货找回来了。

original: He's a powerful ally in Markarth. Should help the Guild regain a foothold in the west.
traduit: 他会成为在马卡斯城的强大盟友。应该能帮公会在西边重新立足。

original: I've finished that special Windhelm job.
traduit: 我完成了风舵城的特殊任务。

original: Torsten was gratified the death of his daughter was avenged and the heirloom was returned.
traduit: 托斯滕很高兴女儿大仇得报，传家宝也回来了。

original: At this very moment, he's layin' the groundwork for the Guild to reestablish itself in Windhelm.
traduit: 此时此刻，他正在帮公会在风舵城的重建做准备。

original: Burnin' that banner was a nice touch, too. Should send a clear message to the Summerset Shadows that we're a force to be reckoned with.
traduit: 烧毁旗帜干得不错。这应该能向夏暮暗影发出明确的信号，我们是股不容忽视的力量。

original: I wished you could have sent more of a message to those Summerset Shadows upstarts, but hopefully they'll stay out of our business.
traduit: 真希望你能给那些夏暮暗影的暴发户释放点信号，但愿他们别再来插手咱们的事了。

original: I've finished that special Solitude job.
traduit: 我完成了独孤城的特殊任务。

original: Erikur assures me that Captain Volf will spend pretty much the rest of his life clapped in irons.
traduit: 艾瑞库尔保证，沃夫船长的下半辈子得在监狱里过了。

original: Best of all, he's also pledged to open doors for us in Solitude and to get things rollin' again.
traduit: 最重要的是，他承诺为我们打开独孤城的大门，让一切重新开始。

original: I've finished that special Whiterun job.
traduit: 我完成了白漫城的特殊任务。

original: Olfrid sent ahead his compliments. Looks like his friend Arn is soon to be released thanks to his brand new identity.
traduit: 奥弗瑞德转达了他的问候。看起来因为新的身份，他的朋友阿恩马上就要被放了。

original: More importanly, he's pledged the full support of the Battle-Born clan to the Thieves Guild.
traduit: 更重要的是，他承诺战狂氏族会全力支持盗贼公会。

original: Need a ride?
