traduit: 要雇车吗？

original: I can take you to any of the hold capitals.
traduit: 我可以带你去任意的领地首府。

original: My carriage is the safest way to travel.
traduit: 我的马车就是最安全的旅行方式。

original: DB02Captive3Intimidate
traduit: DB02Captive3Intimidate

original: Fool! Don't you get it? I live in the shadow of death every day. A knife in every doorway, a nocked arrow on every rooftop!
traduit: 傻子！你还不明白？我每天都活在死亡的阴影中。每个门口都插着刀，屋顶上全是箭！

original: If one of my enemies wouldn't pay to have me killed, I'd take it as a personal insult.
traduit: 要是我的对头不愿意花钱杀我，我还会觉得羞耻呢。

original: Answer me, or I'll paint this room with your blood! (Intimidate)
traduit: 回答我，不然就用你的血去刷墙！（恐吓）

original: DB02Captive2Intimidate
traduit: DB02Captive2Intimidate

original: I'm kneeling here with my hands bound and a sack over my head, and you have the gall to ask me that?
traduit: 我被绑着双手套着麻袋，跪在这里，你还敢这样问我？

original: What do you think, genius?
traduit: 你觉得呢，小天才？

original: One last time: Would. Someone. Pay. To. Have. You. Killed? (Intimidate)
traduit: 我最后说一次：有人、出钱、要、杀你吗？（恐吓）

original: DB02Captive1Intimidate
traduit: DB02Captive1Intimidate

original: Please! I don't know! I mean, I'm a soldier. I've killed people. When I was ordered to. Maybe there were some times... some times I got carried away?
traduit: 求你了！我真不知道！我是说，我是个士兵。有人下令我当然要杀人。也许有时候……有时候我太忘乎所以了？

original: But war is war. Right? Nobody could blame me for that. Could they?
traduit: 但战争就是战争。对吧？没人能指责我。对吧？

original: Answer me, or die! (Intimidate)
traduit: 回答我，不然就去死！（恐吓）

original: DB02Captive3Persuade
traduit: DB02Captive3Persuade

original: He he he he he he he. The real question is, "Would someone pay to have me killed... again."
traduit: 呵呵呵呵呵呵。但真正的问题是“会有人再次花钱杀我吗。”

original: A day goes by without someone trying to gut me in the street, I get disappointed.
traduit: 在街上一天没人想杀我，我都会很失望啊。

original: Come on, you can tell me. We're all friends here. (Persuade)
traduit: 来吧，你可以告诉我。咱们是朋友。（说服）

original: DB02Captive2Persuade
traduit: DB02Captive2Persuade

original: I'm a woman living in Skyrim with six children and no husband. I don't have the time or patience to be "nice."
traduit: 我就住在天际，六个孩子的妈，没有丈夫。我可没时间对你“好好”说话。

original: Do some people look down on me? Have I made some enemies? You're damn right.
traduit: 有人看不惯我？我有没有对头？你他妈说对了。

original: It's all right. Just tell me what I need to know. (Persuade)
traduit: 没关系。只需要告诉我我想知道的。（说服）

original: DB02Captive1Persuade
traduit: DB02Captive1Persuade

original: Okay, well... I guess it's possible. I've been selling my sword arm for years now. Killed a lot of people. Could be someone wanted revenge.
traduit: 好吧，嗯……我想是有可能的。我当雇佣兵很多年了。杀了不少人。可能有人想要报仇。

original: But... But you're not going to kill me. Right?
traduit: 但……但你不会杀我的。对吧？

original: Shhh... Don't be afraid. You can tell me. (Persuade)
traduit: 嘘……别害怕。你可以告诉我。（说服）

original: I'll need to lock up the store. Thank you so much for agreeing to help us.
traduit: 我得打烊了。非常感谢你同意帮我们。

original: I should lock up the store now. Thank you again.
traduit: 我得打烊了。再次感谢。

original: Mara, I forgot how late it was. We'll need to lock up the shop.
traduit: 玛拉啊，我都忘了这么晚了。我得打烊了。

original: Mara, I forgot how late it was. Need to lock up the shop.
traduit: 玛拉啊，我都忘了这么晚了。我得打烊了。

original: Many used to come to these caves. The forgotten. The wretched.
traduit: 很多被遗忘者和可怜人曾聚集在这些洞穴里。

original: I've found the Crown of Barenziah.
traduit: 我找到了巴兰兹亚王冠。

original: I knew you had it in you. After all, finding the Stones was no easy feat.
traduit: 我就知道你有这个本事。毕竟，找齐这些宝石可不容易。

original: Well, I'm not one to welch on a deal, so here's your reward. I hope you put it to good use. I know I have.
traduit: 我可不会在交易上敷衍了事，这是你的报酬。好好利用吧。

original: Does the crown still exist?
traduit: 王冠还在吗？

original: I have it on good authority that the crown is within Tolvald's Cave; dropped by a Dunmer caravan leaving Morrowind long ago.
traduit: 据可靠消息，王冠藏在托沃德洞穴里，从很久以前离开晨风的丹莫马车上掉下来的。

original: If you can bring it back, we could restore the paragon... and reap its benefits.
traduit: 如果能够带回来，我们就能修复那件典藏品……还能从中获益。

original: Now is it worth something?
traduit: 现在它值多少？

original: When I told you the set had to be complete, I left out a small detail... I honestly didn't think you'd ever get this far.
traduit: 我告诉你必须完整一套的时候，我漏掉了一个小细节……真没想到你能走到这一步。

original: If the stones were remounted on the crown, it would be of great benefit to the Thieves Guild.
traduit: 如果这些宝石被重新安置在王冠上，将会对公会大有裨益。

original: I've found all of the Stones of Barenziah.
traduit: 我找齐巴兰兹亚宝石了。

original: I've found all the Stones of Barenziah.
traduit: 我找齐了所有巴兰兹亚宝石。

original: Unbelievable! You must be the first person to set eyes on all twenty-four of them in... well, the last two eras.
traduit: 难以置信！你一定是第一个集齐二十四块的……呃，过去两个纪元内。

original: You sure you won't buy it?
traduit: 你确定不买吗？

original: Look, I only buy things I can turn around quickly for a profit. And no one wants those stones unless they have the whole set.
traduit: 听着，我只会买那些能够快速周转变现的东西。没人想要单独收这些石头，除非是一整套。

original: Tell you what, if you find the rest of them, talk to me again. Otherwise, keep it and maybe it'll bring you luck.
traduit: 这样吧，如果你能找到剩下的宝石再来找我吧。否则就自己留着，也许能给你带来好运呢。

original: How many of these are there?
traduit: 这东西有多少个？

original: I think there were twenty-four in all. Most people keep them as a curiosity.
traduit: 一共二十四个。大多数人拿着它们只是出于好奇。

original: Some of the Guild members have tried to locate them over the years, but they haven't been successful... well, until now.
traduit: 多年来很多公会成员一直试图找齐它们，但都失败了……嗯，直到目前。

original: Is it worth anything?
traduit: 值钱吗？

original: Not like that it isn't.
traduit: 不是钱的问题。

original: The stone was pried off of Barenziah's ceremonial crown by a thief in order to cover his tracks.
traduit: 为了掩盖踪迹，有个小偷从巴兰兹亚的仪式王冠上把宝石撬了下来。

original: Is this unusual gem worth anything?
traduit: 这块不寻常的宝石值钱么？

original: Been a while since I've seen one of those. What you've got there is a Stone of Barenziah.
traduit: 很久没见过这种东西了。你手上的是巴兰兹亚宝石。

original: In case Falk doesn't make it clear - Solitude owes you a debt of gratitude.
traduit: 佛可也许没说清楚，但独孤城欠你一份情。

original: I hope Falk made it clear that Solitude owes you a debt of gratitude.
traduit: 希望佛可有告诉你独孤城欠你一份情。

original: I have Potema's remains.
traduit: 我拿到了波特玛的遗骸。

original: Excellent! These things do have a way of working out when people take action. I'll sanctify the remains.
traduit: 太好了！只要付诸行动，总会有办法解决的。我来净化她的遗骸。

original: Take this payment - the Jarl would thank you but she very much wants to keep Potema's return quiet.
traduit: 收下这笔报酬吧，领主很感谢你，但她不想让人知道波特玛回来过的事。

original: Make no mistake we consider you a protector of Solitude.
traduit: 别误会，我们都把你看成是独孤城的守护者。

original: Falk sent me to talk to you about Potema.
traduit: 佛可派我来和你谈谈波特玛的事。

original: Ah Potema. Former queen of Solitude and one of the most dangerous necromancers in recorded history.
traduit: 啊，波特玛。独孤城前太后，史上最危险的死灵法师之一。

original: She was responsible for the Empire's near collapse almost five hundred years ago. I believe I have a book about her...
traduit: 大概在500年前，她害得帝国险些分崩离析。我还有本关于她的书……

original: As to Potema herself, find what's left of her body, likely a skeleton. Remove it from the Catacombs and bring it back to be sanctified by Arkay.
traduit: 至于波特玛本人，找到她的残骸，也可能是骷髅。把它从墓穴拿出来，让阿尔凯把它净化。

original: I can do that.
traduit: 我可以去办。

original: Good. Being at the summoning created a connection to Potema, you are the one to do this.
traduit: 好。在召唤的时候，你和波特玛建立了联系，这件事非你莫属。

original: I can provide you with some help with her minions.
traduit: 我可以帮你对付她的手下。

original: And now that Potema has returned?
traduit: 现在波特玛回归了？

original: Summoned in spirit form is not raised from the dead. She'll need help before she can return to the living.
traduit: 精魂形态的召唤不能让人起死回生。她需要帮助才能复活。

original: For the moment, the Wolf Queen has retreated to a place filled with dead eager to serve her. She has gone to her old Catacombs.
traduit: 眼下，狼后已经撤退到自己的地下陵墓，那里满是渴望为她效劳的亡灵。

original: A few days ago, one of her servants busted through a wall into the Temple of Divines. We'll need you to go into the Catacombs themselves.
traduit: 几天前，她的一个仆人撞破了圣灵神殿的墙。我们需要你亲自到墓穴去。

original: I'll talk to Styrr. We'll figure something out.
traduit: 我去找斯提尔谈谈。我们会想出办法的。

original: I wish you well friend. Be careful.
traduit: 朋友，祝你好运。但是要小心。

original: You've returned. Good. What did you find at Wolfskull Cave?
traduit: 你回来了。太好了。狼头骨洞穴有什么发现？

original: Pruzah wundunne wah Wuth Gein. I wish the old one luck in his... quest.
traduit: 如扎 温登聂 瓦 乌斯 盖恩。希望那个老家伙能达成他的……追求吧。

original: But I doubt many will wish to exchange Alduin's lordship for the tyranny of Paarthurnax's "Way of the Voice".
traduit: 但我怀疑有多少同类愿意用奥杜因的统治换来帕图纳克斯“吼声之道”的暴政。

original: If Alduin himself could not stand against your Thu'um, I feel no shame in my own defeat.
traduit: 如果奥杜因都无法对抗你的吐'目，我也就不对自己的失败感到羞耻了。

original: Goraan! I feel younger than I have in many an age.
traduit: 果兰！感觉自己年轻多了！

original: Many of the dovahhe are now scattered across Keizaal. Without Alduin's lordship, they may yet bow to the vahzen... rightness of my Thu'um.
traduit: 还有很多都瓦分散在凯扎尔各处。失去了奥杜因的统治，他们或许会服从于我吐'目的瓦扎恩……正确性。

original: But willing or no, they will hear it! Fare thee well, Dovahkiin!
traduit: 但无论愿意与否，他们都会听到的！保重，都瓦克因！

original: Alduin mahlaan
traduit: 奥杜因 马兰

original: Mu los vomir
traduit: 姆 洛斯 沃米尔。

original: Thu'umii los nahlot
traduit: 图'姆米 洛斯 纳洛特。

original: Dovahkiin los ok dovahkriid
traduit: 都瓦克因 洛斯 欧克 都瓦克瑞德。

original: Sahrot thur qahnaraan
traduit: 撒洛特 图 恰纳兰。

original: I'll put it plainly. You can claim your sword, or you can keep your wife. If you set foot outside the gate, I won't be here when you return.
traduit: 我直说吧。要么去拿你的剑，要么要你的老婆孩子。如果你敢出城门，你回来就见不到我了。

original: I just need to hire one, maybe two good men. You won't starve.
traduit: 我只需要雇一两个好手就行。你不会挨饿的。

original: So you're willing to starve your wife and daughter to reclaim some rusty old sword?
traduit: 所以你宁愿让自己的妻女挨饿就为了拿回一把生锈的破剑？

original: It took me weeks to find that thieves' den. I can't stop now, and I can't get the sword on my own.
traduit: 我花了好几周才找到那个贼窝。我现在不能收手，我也不是自己去拿。

original: I know your family's honor is important to you, but we can't afford it!
traduit: 我知道你们家族的荣誉对你来说很重要，但我们负担不起！

original: Wait... I....
traduit: 等等……我……

original: Saffir!
traduit: 萨菲尔！

original: I want to stop at Karthwasten. (<Global=CarriageCost> gold)
traduit: 我想去卡斯威斯腾。（<Global=CarriageCost>金币）

original: Dawnstar. (<Global=CarriageCostSmall> gold)
traduit: 晨星。（<Global=CarriageCostSmall>金币）

original: Morthal. (<Global=CarriageCostSmall> gold)
traduit: 莫萨尔。（<Global=CarriageCostSmall>金币）

original: Winterhold. (<Global=CarriageCostSmall> gold)
traduit: 冬堡。（<Global=CarriageCostSmall>金币）

original: Falkreath. (<Global=CarriageCostSmall> gold)
traduit: 佛克瑞斯。（<Global=CarriageCostSmall>金币）

original: I want to stop at Kynesgrove. (<Global=CarriageCost> gold)
traduit: 我想去凯娜之林。（<Global=CarriageCost>金币）

original: I want to stop at Shor's Stone. (<Global=CarriageCost> gold)
traduit: 我想去舒尔之石。（<Global=CarriageCost>金币）

original: I want to stop at Darkwater Crossing. (<Global=CarriageCost> gold)
traduit: 我想去暗水岔口。（<Global=CarriageCost>金币）

original: I want to stop at Ivarstead. (<Global=CarriageCost> gold)
traduit: 我想去伊瓦尔镇。（<Global=CarriageCost>金币）

original: I want to stop at Riverwood. (<Global=CarriageCost> gold)
traduit: 我想去河木镇。（<Global=CarriageCost>金币）

original: I want to stop at Stonehills. (<Global=CarriageCost> gold)
traduit: 我想去石山。（<Global=CarriageCost>金币）

original: I want to stop at Old Hroldan. (<Global=CarriageCost> gold)
traduit: 我想去古霍尔丹（<Global=CarriageCost>金币）

original: Just pay me when the job's done.
traduit: 活儿干完再给钱就行。

original: My only demand is that these vermin are permanently eliminated before my reputation is completely destroyed.
traduit: 我唯一的要求就是在我的名声被彻底毁灭之前把那些害虫完全消灭。

original: You'd better, or I yell "skeever." (Intimidate)
traduit: 你最好快点，要不我就要喊“恶鼠”了。（恐吓）

original: Okay, okay. No need to make rash decisions.
traduit: 好吧，好吧。没必要冲动。

original: Here's half. You get the rest when the job's done.
traduit: 这是一半。任务完成以后，再给你另一半。

original: Yell all you want. It's not going to change my mind.
traduit: 随你喊。我是不会改主意的。

original: I might be able to help.
traduit: 我也许能帮上忙。

original: Oh really? And I don't suppose you'd just do it out of the kindness of your heart, would you?
traduit: 真的？我猜你不会是出于好心吧？

original: I hope you're not expecting to get paid until the job's done.
traduit: 我希望你别指望在工作完成前就拿到钱。

original: That's the only way I operate. (Persuade)
traduit: 这是我行事的原则。（说服）

original: Oh, very well. Here's half. You get the rest when the job's done.
traduit: 哦，好吧。先给你一半。剩下的等工作完成再给你。

original: Well that's not how I operate, so forget it.
traduit: 但这不是我的方式。别想了。

original: You've got a deal.
traduit: 一言为定。

original: Don't come back until every one of those things are dead.
traduit: 在那些东西死掉之前别回来。

original: How do I "permanently" clear the vermin?
traduit: 如何才能“永久”清除害虫？

original: I bought some poison. I was going to have my lazy, good-for-nothing assistant Mallus handle it, but he seems to have vanished.
traduit: 我买了一些毒药。我本想让我那懒惰没用的助手莫鲁斯来办，但他好像消失了。

original: If you plant this in the vermin's nest, it should stop them from ever coming back.
traduit: 把这个放到害虫的巢穴里，应该就能阻止它们卷土重来。

original: My apologies, Lady Maven.
traduit: 抱歉，玛雯夫人。

original: The only reason we're having this conversation is due to Brynjolf's assurance you won't botch another assignment.
traduit: 我们之所以谈这个，是因为布林乔夫保证你不会再搞砸了。

original: He claims you possess some sort of uncanny aptitude for your line of work. Quite frankly I find that hard to believe.
traduit: 他说你在业务上有某种不可思议的天赋。老实说，我不信。

original: Head to the Bannered Mare in Whiterun and look for Mallus Maccius. He'll fill you in on all the details.
traduit: 去白漫城的悬旗母马找莫鲁斯·马修斯。他会跟你交待细节。

original: You won't have that problem with me.
traduit: 你不用担心。

original: I hope not. This is an important job.
traduit: 但愿如此。这是份很重要的工作。

original: I have a competitor called Honningbrew Meadery that I want to put out of business.
traduit: 我有个竞争对手，蜜之酿酒庄。我想让它关门大吉。

original: I also want to know how they managed to get the place up and running so quickly.
traduit: 我还想知道他们如何这么快建立并运营起来的。

original: You have no faith in the Guild?
traduit: 你不信任公会吗？

original: Faith? I don't have faith in anyone.
traduit: 信任？我从不信任任何人。

original: All I care about is cause and effect. Did the job get done and was it done correctly. There's no gray area.
traduit: 我只关心前因后果。工作完成与否？事情办得好坏？没有灰色地带可言。

original: You seem to know an awful lot about this place.
traduit: 你似乎很了解这里。

original: I suppose there's no point in concealing the truth any longer.
traduit: 我想也没必要再隐瞒真相了。

original: My knowledge of this temple comes from personal experience. I was a priest of Vaermina.
traduit: 我对这所神殿的了解都来自亲身经历。我曾经是瓦尔迷纳祭司。

original: Let's just hope they got it right this time.
traduit: 希望他们这次做对了。

original: It was my idea to replace one of the key elements with our focusing crystal. Months of enchantments went into it.
traduit: 我的设想是用聚焦水晶来代替其中一个核心元件。我们花了好几个月进行附魔。

original: This machinery, all of it, was designed to collect starlight, and then... I'm not sure. Split it, somehow?
traduit: 这个机器，就是用来收集星光的，然后……我就不太确定了。把它，分裂开？

original: From all our research, it seems they were intent on discerning the nature of the divine.
traduit: 从我们的研究来看，他们似乎一心要辨别神明的本质。

original: I was the one who thought of using this... this Oculory. I don't know what the dwarves called it. Something unpronounceable, I'm sure.
traduit: 是我想到利用这个……汇光之睛。我不知道矮人是怎么称呼它的。反正也念不出来。

original: No matter what Gavros said, this was my idea first. The Council is going to know that when I get back.
traduit: 不管加弗罗斯怎么说，这都是我首倡的。等我返回议会他们会知道的。

original: I found your crystal.
traduit: 我找到了你的水晶。

original: Ha! So you did.
traduit: 哈！你做到了。

original: I was almost beginning to think Gavros had gone and gotten himself killed just to spite me.
traduit: 我都快要以为加弗罗斯是为了报复我才去送死的。

original: Well, with the Falmer skulking around I can't very well do this on my own. I guess you'll have to come with me.
traduit: 哎，伐莫在周围鬼鬼祟祟地，我一个人根本搞不定。我想你得和我一起去。

original: I'll explain on the way.
traduit: 路上我再给你解释。

original: I'm with the College of Winterhold.
traduit: 我是冬堡学院来的。

original: You are, are you?
traduit: 是吗，是吗？

original: Savos wouldn't even grant us an audience when we came to you, but now you come here expecting something from me?
traduit: 我们找上你们的时候，萨沃斯连个面都不露，现在你却来找我问东问西？

original: I don't much like this, I'll tell you. But you've saved my skin, so maybe I can overlook the past for now.
traduit: 实话跟你说，这让我很不爽。但你救了我，也许我可以暂且不计前嫌。

original: Come on, I'll explain on the way.
traduit: 来吧，我路上给你解释。

original: I happen to have found a focusing Crystal. Is this what you were looking for?
traduit: 我碰巧找到一个聚焦水晶。这是你要找的东西吗？

original: You found... how in the world...
traduit: 你找到了……到底是怎么……

original: That's it. That's it! I don't know who you are, but you may have just saved this little project...
traduit: 是这个，就是这个！我不知道你是谁，但你可能拯救了这个小项目……

original: In fact, who are you, anyway?
traduit: 说回来，你到底是谁？

original: I don't know what sort of help you expect from me, but if you can actually find the crystal I'd certainly be grateful.
traduit: 我不知道你想从我这里得到什么帮助，但如果你真能找回水晶，我会很感激的。

original: If I find this crystal you're looking for. Will you help me?
traduit: 如果我拿到你想要的水晶，你会帮我吗？

original: What's the crystal for?
traduit: 水晶是做什么用的？

original: It was a brilliant idea, really. Mostly mine, though Gavros took the credit.
traduit: 原本是个绝妙的设想，真的。基本上都是我想出来的，可功劳全被加弗罗斯抢了。

original: Secret, though. Official Synod business. Can't talk about it.
traduit: 不过，这是秘密。希诺官方事务，恕不外传。

original: Get out of my face!
traduit: 从我面前消失！

original: <Global=WE17GoldAmount> gold? You can have it, if you can take it from me.
traduit: <Global=WE17GoldAmount>金币？能从我这里拿走就归你了。

original: If you insist. Come on boys. This'll be fun.
traduit: 如果你坚持的话。弟兄们，来吧。有乐子了。

original: I'm afraid I don't have any gold to spare.
traduit: 我恐怕没多余的钱了。

original: Fine. If you can't pay with coin, you'll pay with your life!
traduit: 好吧。拿不出钱那就偿命吧。

original: Here, take it. (Pay <Global=WE17GoldAmount> gold)
traduit: 给，拿去吧。（支付<Global=WE17GoldAmount>金币）

original: The, um, Emperor thanks you... Now shove off!
traduit: 嗯，皇帝会感谢你的……离开吧！

original: Er, rather, have a nice day, citizen.
traduit: 呃，不如说，祝你愉快，公民。

original: You there! Ah... citizen. This area is off limits.
traduit: 喂！啊……公民。这片区域禁止进出。

original: You are interfering in Imperial business. Yeah, so you'll have to pay us a fine... of say, 100 gold. Pay up, citizen.
traduit: 你在干涉帝国公务。嗯，所以你得缴纳罚款……大概，100金币。付钱吧，公民。

original: Grant me the power to break through this barrier and to send the Skull to the depths of Oblivion!
traduit: 请赐予我突破屏障的力量，把头骨送至湮灭深渊！

original: The Skull hungers. It yearns for memories and leaves nightmares in its wake.
traduit: 头骨正在渴求记忆，醒来之时徒留噩梦。

original: I call upon you, Lady Mara!
traduit: 我召唤您，玛拉女士！

original: We can discuss it later. We need to proceed.
traduit: 我们以后再说吧。现在需要继续前进。

original: Indeed. My reverence for Vaermina's machinations should not take precedence over our mission. My apologies.
traduit: 确实。我对瓦尔迷纳阴谋的敬畏不该阻碍任务。抱歉。

original: The inner sanctum lies ahead. We must reach the Skull and put an end to Dawnstar's troubles. Lead on, my friend.
traduit: 密室就在前面。我们必须摧毁头骨，终结晨星的麻烦。走吧，朋友。

original: Here? Now?
traduit: 在这里吗？现在？

original: Dawnstar's fate rests in that tiny bottle. The longer we wait, the more damage Vaermina could be doing to those poor people.
traduit: 晨星的命运就在那小瓶子里了。等得越久，瓦尔迷纳对那些可怜人的伤害就越大。

original: I understand your hesitation, but I promise you that it works.
traduit: 我理解你的顾虑，但我保证有效。

original: I found the Torpor.
traduit: 我找到眠药了。

original: I'm relieved you discovered a bottle intact; this place looks as though it was ransacked by the orcs.
traduit: 能找到完好无损的一瓶太好了。这里好像被兽人彻底洗劫过。

original: So... I've taken us this far, but you need to guide us the rest of the way. Drink.
traduit: 所以……我已经带了这么久的路了，剩下的路还需要你来指引。喝吧。

original: How will I know what it looks like?
traduit: 我怎么知道它长什么样？

original: It should be in a small bottle, very similar to a potion.
traduit: 装在一个小瓶子里，和药水瓶很像。

original: I'll begin searching up here.
traduit: 我从这里开始找。

original: Now that they've been dealt with, we need to find the Torpor.
traduit: 既然解决了他们，我们还是得找那个眠药。

original: What am I looking for?
traduit: 我要找什么？

original: We're looking for a book of alchemical recipes called "The Dreamstride."
traduit: 我们在找一本叫《梦中漫步》的炼金配方。

original: The tome bears the likeness of Vaermina on the cover. It should be here somewhere.
traduit: 那本书封面有瓦尔迷纳的画像。应该就在这里某处放着。

original: Barring any more interruptions, perhaps we can locate the information I need.
traduit: 只要没有其他干扰，我们应该能找到需要的信息。

original: Don't wait around for me. I bet I'll beat you to Korvanjund even though you start first.
traduit: 不要在这儿等我。就算你先走肯定也是我先到。

original: We're not leaving until we get what we came for.
traduit: 不拿到想要的东西我们是不会走的。

original: No. And I'm not sure I'm better off for it now neither.
traduit: 不。我不确定现在要不要去找它。

original: Hail, Galmar.
traduit: 干得好，加尔玛。

original: Hail, Ilfhild.
traduit: 干得好，伊尔弗雷德。

original: Cold as the inside of an ice wraith. That and some Imperials are camped out around the entrance, staying nice and warm around their fires.
traduit: 冷得像冰怒灵一样。还有帝国兵在入口处守着，围着火取暖呢。

original: Imperials? Well, if they're keeping themselves comfortable, let's slip in and send them to their graves that way.
traduit: 帝国兵？好吧，要是他们想一直舒服下去，咱们就溜过去送他们走吧。

original: What's the situation?
traduit: 什么情况？

original: Well, that's something at least.
traduit: 好吧，好歹有点东西。

original: Stormcloaks were already camped out around the entrance when we got here. They don't know we're here yet, though.
traduit: 我们来的时候已经有风暴斗篷守在门口了。不过他们还不知道我们来了。

original: I feel sick.
traduit: 我觉得很恶心。

original: There, there. It will pass. Going too long without a proper meal can make the stomach weak.
traduit: 放松，放松。一切都会过去的。长时间不用正餐会让胃口变弱的。

original: Feel free to stay and mingle with your new coven, if you have the strength.
traduit: 如果还有力气的话，可以留下和集会同伴交流交流。

original: Thank you, Eola. For everything.
traduit: 爱欧拉，感谢你做的一切。

original: It's an honor, champion. Feel free to stay and mingle with your new coven.
traduit: 这是我的荣幸，勇士。你可以留下和集会成员交流。

original: Enough talk. Let's go kill some Imperials.
traduit: 说的够多了。去杀几个帝国兵吧。

original: We had the advantage of surprise this time, but things won't be so easy from here on out.
traduit: 我们占了出其不意的优势，但现在开始没那么容易了。

original: That's the way I like it. Short and bloody. They never knew what hit them.
traduit: 我就喜欢这种简洁血腥的方式，让他们死都不知道怎么死的。

original: I knew when you walked into the Hall of the Dead that you were special.
traduit: 当你踏入亡者之厅的那一刻，我就知道你与众不同。

original: And here you are. Champion of Namira. Keeper of her ring. You're everything I hoped you would be.
traduit: 所以你就在这里了。娜米拉的勇士。戒指的保管者。你与我的期望一模一样。

original: Praise to Namira!
traduit: 赞美娜米拉！

original: The feast has begun!
traduit: 宴会开始了！

original: I can smell the blood. Good and sour.
traduit: 我闻到了血的气味。酸甜美味。

original: Is dinner ready?
traduit: 饭做好了吗？

original: I love this part of the meal.
traduit: 我很喜欢这道菜。

original: Namira grants us victory.
traduit: 娜米拉指引胜利。

original: Do you know the way out of here?
traduit: 你知道怎么出去吗？

original: Yes, yes. We should proceed cautiously.
traduit: 知道。小心点就行。

original: "End of Days"? I don't think things are quite that bad.
traduit: “末日”？我可没觉得会那么糟。

original: We'll stick around here for a while and see if we can find anything else useful.
traduit: 我们在这里待一段时间，看看有没有其他有用的东西。

original: The crown must be around here somewhere. Spread out, and keep your eyes open.
traduit: 王冠肯定在附近。散开好好找找。

original: Too bad we can't read these carvings. Who knows what secrets we'd uncover?
traduit: 可惜我们看不懂这些雕刻。不然说不定能从里面发现些什么？

original: Oh... I've heard of this. They say these walls show the history of the ancients who built this place.
traduit: 哦……我听说过这个。他们说这些墙是记录建造这里的古人们的历史。

original: Let's hope that's the last of them. Come on, let's see what's down this way.
traduit: 希望这是最后一个了。来，看看这边有什么。

original: Steady now! They may be uglier than Imperials but they'll go down just the same.
traduit: 稳住了！他们可能比帝国兵长得丑，但还是能打倒的。

original: That's done it! Alright, boys, let's get moving. We've got more...
traduit: 成功了！好了，小子们，该走了。我们还有更多……

original: How's it going, Unblooded? You find anything yet?
traduit: 怎么样了，新人？找到什么了？

original: Keep looking, Unblooded. There's got to be some way to get that thing open.
traduit: 继续找找吧，新人。肯定有办法打开那东西。

original: You see a lever anywhere?
traduit: 附近有拉杆吗？

original: Unblooded, do what you do best. See if you can find some way to get that gate open.
traduit: 新人，做你擅长的吧。看看你能否打开那扇门。

original: Come on, boys. Let's spread out and see what we've got.
traduit: 来吧，小子们。分头看看能找到什么。

original: Alright everyone! Keep your guard up. No telling what we'll find down here.
traduit: 好了，大家！保持警惕。不知道我们在下面会找到什么。

original: Is there anything on the claw that might show how to open this door?
traduit: 爪子上有说怎么开门吗？

original: I wouldn't do that again unless you know for sure it's going to open.
traduit: 我不会再这么做了，除非你能确定打开它。

original: Hmm... that looks like some kind of claw from a statue. I wonder what it's used for.
traduit: 嗯……看起来像是某种爪子雕刻啊。不知道是干什么的。

original: See what you can figure out, Unblooded. I'm going to check out these carvings over here. Let me know if you find something.
traduit: 看看你能想到什么，新人。我要去看看雕刻。有发现及时报告。

original: Even if one of these pictures tells us where the Crown is, I'm betting we're going to have to find a way through that door.
traduit: 就算这些图里能告诉我们王冠在哪儿，我看咱们也得想法子穿过那道门。

original: Hmm, looks like this is as far as the Imperials got.
traduit: 嗯，看来帝国军就走到这里了。

original: One thing at a time. We're here for the Crown. Any of these carvings show a crown?
traduit: 一时只做一件事。我们是奔着王冠来的，这雕刻上有王冠吗？

original: Ah! The Hall of Stories... we must be getting close now.
traduit: 啊！是故事大厅……我们一定快到了。

original: Draugr. Ain't you ever seen one before?
traduit: 尸鬼啊。你以前没见过？

original: Steady. A few dusty bonewalkers aren't going to stop us anymore than the Imperials could.
traduit: 稳住，几个落灰的骨头架子可不能像帝国兵那样阻止我们。

original: Careful, boys. There's bound to be more up ahead.
traduit: 小心点，伙计们。前面肯定会更多。

original: No, but I know they're out there. No other way they can come. Now shut up or you'll blow our ambush.
traduit: 没有，但我知道他们就在外面。他们没有别的路可走。现在快闭嘴，不然会毁了我们埋伏。

original: You there, Unblooded, see if you can find another way through. We'll charge in to help as soon as we hear fighting.
traduit: 新人，你去看看能不能找到别的路。一听到战斗，我们就冲过去帮忙。

original: Not so sure? Oh, then perhaps we should take a moment to look around a little, eh?
traduit: 不太能确定？那我们就花时间四处看看，好吗？

original: You sure about that? Then please, be my guest and go strolling on in there. We'll stay here and watch your back...
traduit: 你确定吗？那好，你进去走走吧。我们会在这儿保护你。

original: But there isn't any other way through.
traduit: 但也没别的路了。

original: Pick a man and put him down. We attack on my signal.
traduit: 挑一个人干掉。等我的信号就攻击。

original: Sold. Here you go. (Gain <Global=WIAddItem07PayB> gold)
traduit: 成交。给你吧。（获得<Global=WIAddItem07PayB>金币）

original: I'm glad we could come to an agreement.
traduit: 很高兴能够达成交易。

original: Not good enough. I'll hold onto this. You'll need to find another one.
traduit: 不够。我会保留的。你另找人买吧。

original: Oh... well... I can see you have no appreciation for scholarship.
traduit: 哦……嗯……看来你对学术并不感兴趣。

original: Not good enough. I'll shake the extra coin out of you if I must. (Intimidate)
traduit: 不够。如果有必要，我会把你多出的钱抖出来。（恐吓）

original: Hold on, there. I suppose, in the uh, interest of research... I can spare a few more coins. Double and a half its value. That's all I can muster.
traduit: 等等。我想，出于研究需要……我可以再多给你些。就按市价的二点五倍。我只有这么多了。

original: Ha! I'll see to it the Jarl hears of your abuse of a court scholar. Shame on you.
traduit: 哈！我会让领主知道你虐待宫廷学者的事。你可真丢人。

original: I think you can do better than that. (Persuade)
traduit: 我觉得你能出个更好的价钱。（说服）

original: Well... I suppose important research is worth every coin. All right. You have yourself a deal. How's double and a half its value in trade?
traduit: 嗯……为了重要的研究还是值得的。好吧。就这么定了。再给你按市价加五成怎么样？

original: With this the world could have a better understanding of the Dwemer!
traduit: 有了这个，世界就能更好地了解锻莫！

original: Come now, where's your sense of propriety? Extorting an old man like this.
traduit: 得了吧，你还有点分寸没有？就这么敲诈老年人吗。

original: Sounds fair. Here you go. (Gain <Global=WIAddItem07PayA> gold)
traduit: 听起来够公道。给你了。（获得<Global=WIAddItem07PayA>金币）

original: Wonderful. You've just made an important contribution to the advancement of a Dwemer scholarship.
traduit: 太棒了。你刚刚为锻莫学术的发展做出了重要贡献。

original: Sure. Take a look.
traduit: 好吧。来看看。

original: Excellent. Very good. This is exactly what I need to complete a series of studies I'm doing on Dwemer craftsmanship and magical resonance.
traduit: 好。很好。这正是我完成系列研究所需要的。我正在研究锻莫工艺和魔法共振。

original: I simply must have this! I'll pay you double what it's worth.
traduit: 我一定要买下！我会付你双倍。

original: Actually, I'm not sure I have it anymore.
traduit: 事实上，我还不确定它放在哪里了。

original: Oh... what a terrible shame. Well, if you think you know where you left it and can retrieve it, I'll be here.
traduit: 哦……那太遗憾了。如果你想起来把它放在哪里而且能找回来，我就在这里等着。

original: I'm here about the <Alias=Item>.
traduit: 我是来卖<Alias=Item>的。

original: You are? Very good.... may I see it?
traduit: 是吗？太好了……我能看看吗？

original: There have been murders in Windhelm?
traduit: 风舵城出了谋杀案？

original: None of that matters to me. Until someone takes a Dunmer, I let Windhelm deal with its own problems.
traduit: 对我来说不重要。除非有丹莫遇害了，我觉得还是让风舵自己处理问题。

original: I've got what I came for, I better get back to Dragon Bridge.
traduit: 我已经得到想要的答复了，我得赶回龙桥去了。

original: Did you find anything at Wolfskull Cave?
traduit: 你在狼头骨洞穴找到什么了吗？

original: How are the dark elves treated in Windhelm?
traduit: 风舵城的暗精灵受到怎样的对待了？

original: Well you see where we have to live. This forgotten alley. All the filth from the upper quarters flows downhill, like they say.
traduit: 看看我们住在什么地方。被遗忘的小巷，就像他们说的，所有上层的污物都会流向这里。

original: Good luck getting one of the guards to help with anything.
traduit: 也不能指望卫兵们帮上什么忙。

original: I tried to get Ulfric to even come down here to see the squalor, but the High Lord of His Mightiness couldn't find the time.
traduit: 我甚至想让乌弗瑞克来亲自看看这肮脏的地方，但这位尊贵的大人可能没时间。

original: Why are there so many dark elves here?
traduit: 这里为什么会有这么多暗精灵？

original: Where else would we be?
traduit: 那我们还能去哪儿？

original: When the Red Mountain burned, you could scarcely breathe in Morrowind. So we came west.
traduit: 红山爆发的时候，晨风几乎没法呼吸。所以我们向西走了。

original: Windhelm is the first city on that road, and here we are.
traduit: 风舵是这条路上的第一座城市，我们就在这里了。

original: If we had known the Nords would be so unwelcoming, we may have kept walking.
traduit: 如果我们早点知道诺德人这么不好客，我们可能还会继续走下去。

original: Are the people of Windhelm devout?
traduit: 风舵城的人很虔诚吗？

original: Like anyone, a crisis will push them towards devotion. I've been seeing a lot of the Shatter-Shields, since they lost their daughter.
traduit: 危机总会把人民推向虔诚，任何人都是如此。自称碎盾家失去女儿后，我就经常看到他们。

original: Hillevi Cruel-Sea comes in a lot, but I haven't seen her husband here in years.
traduit: 希勒维·酷海倒是经常来，但我很多年没看见过她丈夫了。

original: Ulfric prays for strength. I speak to Captain Lonely-Gale, but he doesn't spend much time here. Too busy.
traduit: 乌弗瑞克会为力量而祈祷。我和孤风船长谈过，但他不常来这里。可能太忙了。

original: What does Talos have to do with the war?
traduit: 塔洛斯和这场战争有什么关系？

original: The Empire's elven puppetmasters never cared much for the idea of a human becoming a divine. So the worship of Talos is outlawed.
traduit: 操纵帝国傀儡的精灵们从来不相信人族能变成神的说法。所以塔洛斯信仰是非法的。

original: Skyrim doesn't take kindly to being told what to do. And to try and forget Talos, well... they may as well ordered us all to cut off our ears.
traduit: 天际不喜欢别人耳提面命该如何做。想要我们忘掉塔洛斯，哼……和命令我们割掉耳朵有什么区别。

original: Tell me about Talos.
traduit: 跟我说说塔洛斯吧。

original: Talos, who in life was known as Tiber Septim, united Tamriel and founded the Empire.
traduit: 塔洛斯生前被叫做“泰伯·塞普汀”，他统一了泰姆瑞尔并建立了帝国。

original: He was rewarded for his deeds by being joined with the Divines in eternal glory. The only mortal to do so.
traduit: 他因为其行受到奖赏，在永恒的荣耀中加入圣灵的行列。这是唯一达成如此成就的凡人。

original: We worship him that we might follow in his path. We can't literally join him in the heavens, but we may do our best to know them here on Nirn.
traduit: 我们崇拜他，希望追随他的道路。我们无法在天堂加入他，但我们可以在奈恩尽力去了解他们。

original: What's there to do in the city?
traduit: 城里有什么可做的吗？

original: If you're looking to pass the time, you can give Calixto a few septims and gawk at whater oddity he's come across lately.
traduit: 如果想打发时间，可以给卡利斯托几个塞普汀，看看他最近搜集了什么怪东西。

original: If you're need of goods, there's a market. If it's a soft bed and a hot meal you're after, there's Candlehearth Hall.
traduit: 想要买些东西，可以去市场看看。如果想要张柔软的床或是热腾腾的饭菜，那就去烛炉堂吧。

original: Who are the prominent citizens in Windhelm?
traduit: 风舵城有什么杰出的公民吗？

original: There's an author named Adonato staying at the inn. He's published a few works of historical fiction.
traduit: 有个叫阿多纳托的作家住在旅馆里。他出版过好几本历史小说。

original: The clans Shatter-Shield and Cruel-Sea see most of the gold that passes through the city.
traduit: 碎盾氏族和酷海氏族掌握着大部分流过城市的黄金。

original: And obviously you have Ulfric, the Jarl and future High King.
traduit: 当然，你肯定知道乌弗瑞克，我们的领主和未来的至高王。

original: Oh, and that busybody Viola Giordano. She's got her nose in everyone's business, which I guess is one way of being prominent.
traduit: 还有那个爱管闲事的维欧拉·乔尔丹诺。她对每个人的事都很关心，我想这应该是她彰显自己的一种方式吧。

original: Folk are talking about murders.
traduit: 人们都在谈论谋杀案啊。

original: Terrible shame, that. Seems we have a killer on the loose here in Windhelm.
traduit: 确实很丢脸。风舵城可能有个可怕的杀手在逃。

original: He's claimed three victims that I know of, though maybe there's more that haven't been found yet.
traduit: 据我所知，他已经杀了三个人了，不过也许还有更多没被发现的。

original: All lovely young ladies, too. Let's hope the guards find that demon soon, and introduce him to the headsman's axe.
traduit: 都是些年轻可爱的姑娘。希望卫兵们赶紧找到那个恶魔，然后押到刽子手那儿正法。

original: What kind of captain are you?
traduit: 你是什么船长？

original: Well, nothing. At least not any more. Folk just call me that because of what I used to do.
traduit: 嗯，不是什么船长。至少现在不是了。大伙儿这么叫我是因为我以前的工作。

original: I was a sailor for many a year. I made my coin as a trader and in time, I bought my own ship.
traduit: 我当过很多年的水手。我做商人赚了钱，后来自己买了船。

original: When I retired here in Windhelm, most folk already knew me as Captain Lonely-Gale, and the name just stuck.
traduit: 我退休回到风舵城，大家就叫我“孤风船长”，这个名字就这么传开了。

original: Watch that tongue, Rendar, or your whole lot could be down with the Argonians hauling ballast by tomorrow.
traduit: 注意自己的话，仁达尔，否则你明天就得被阿尔贡拖着重物扔水里了。

original: Typical Nord. Beard for brains.
traduit: 典型的诺德人。一脑袋胡子。

original: My men have their orders. But it's a big city, and there's a war on. Plus these murders.
traduit: 我的人会听命令的。但这城市太大，而且又在打仗。再加上这些谋杀案。

original: A few dark elves getting shoved around doesn't really amount to much.
traduit: 几个暗精灵被推来推去没什么大不了的。

original: If the guards in the Gray Quarter weren't a bunch of n'wahs, I wouldn't be here talking to you.
traduit: 要不是灰民区的卫兵不是一群恩'瓦，我也不会在这儿跟你说了。

original: If anything actually happens, call a guard.
traduit: 如果真的发生了什么，就喊卫兵。

original: I have the items you requested.
traduit: 你要的东西我带来了。

original: Ah, have you? Let Kesh have them.
traduit: 啊，是吗？给凯石吧。

original: That should do. Now - Inhale deeply.
traduit: 好了，现在，深呼吸。

original: Yes, yes. This will create a fine fume.
traduit: 很好，很好。能产生一股不错的烟气。

original: Remind me again about the attack on the fort...
traduit: 再跟我说说进攻要塞的事……

original: That fort is as good as ours.
traduit: 要塞是我们的了。

original: Tell me about the attack on the fort.
traduit: 跟我说说攻打要塞的事。

original: What? Get over with the rest of the men at Korvanjund.
traduit: 怎么了？去科万琼德和其他人会合吧。

original: Korvanjund. Remember?
traduit: 科万琼德。忘了？

original: Good work! Lucky we had you with us today.
traduit: 干得好！有你在真是太幸运了。

original: That crown must be here somewhere. Keep looking.
traduit: 王冠一定就在附近。继续找。

original: My pa always warned me not to mess with places like this.
traduit: 我爸总警告我不要到这种地方乱来。

original: Careful. No telling what will happen the next time you mess with that door.
traduit: 小心。下次弄坏那扇门不知道会发生什么。

original: Maybe that claw has a clue on it? You know, how to turn the rings so the door will open.
traduit: 也许爪子上有线索？你也知道，得把那些环转到正确位置门才会开。

original: Keep a sharp eye out. There's no telling what we might run into in here.
traduit: 保持警戒。谁知道会在这里遇到什么。

original: All for an old crown, huh?
traduit: 就为了一顶老王冠，哈？

original: The Imperials will be sorry they got in our way.
traduit: 帝国兵会后悔挡了我们的路。

original: So far, so good.
traduit: 目前还好。

original: Ulfric Stormcloak is counting on us to bring him back that crown, and that's exactly what we're going to do.
traduit: 乌弗瑞克·风暴斗篷正等着我们把王冠带回去，这才是我们现在要做的。

original: Keep your wits about you and watch your shield brother's back.
traduit: 保持清醒，帮你的盾牌兄弟注意四周。

original: I know some of you are ex-legion and may know men on the other side. But remember this. They are the enemy now and they will not hesitate to kill you.
traduit: 我知道你们有些人是从军团退役的，可能认识对面的人。但记住了，他们现在是敌人，会毫不犹豫杀了你。

original: Their spies must've found out we know about the Crown, and they don't want us to have it. But they won't stand in our way.
traduit: 他们的间谍肯定是发现了我们知道王冠下落的事。他们不想我们得到王冠，可是拦不住我们。

original: Listen up. Those Imperials aren't here by coincidence.
traduit: 听好，这些帝国兵来这里不是巧合。

original: General Tullius is counting on us to bring back the Jagged Crown, and that's exactly what we're going to do.
traduit: 图留斯将军正等着我们把锯齿王冠拿回去，这才是我们要做的。

original: I realize some of you may know men on the other side. But remember this. They are the enemy now and will not hesitate to end your lives either.
traduit: 我知道你们可能认识对面的人。但记住，他们现在是敌人，会毫不犹豫地杀死你们。

original: Ulfric the Pretender wants that crown, but we're not going to let him have it.
traduit: 逆贼乌弗瑞克想要那顶王冠，但我们不能让他得逞。

original: Listen up, legionnaires. Those Stormcloaks are here for the same reason we are.
traduit: 士兵们，听好。这些风暴斗篷和咱们想一块儿去了。

original: No... No! You must be the one who took my skooma!
traduit: 不……不！你肯定是来偷我斯库玛的！

original: No! There's got to be more Skooma... Shut up! Shut up!  Don't lie to me J'zhar! You hid it! You always try to steal it from me!
traduit: 不！肯定还有更多斯库玛……闭嘴！闭嘴！别骗我了杰'扎尔！你把它藏起来了！你总是想从我这儿把东西偷走！

original: Where is it? I know you were trying to keep it for yourself J'zhar... You always try to keep it for yourself!
traduit: 在哪里？我知道你把它留给自己了，杰'扎尔……你总是想自己留着它！

original: Kynareth save us, here he comes again...
traduit: 凯娜瑞丝救救我们，他又回来了……

original: I don't know!
traduit: 我不知道！

original: Guardsman! What happened here? Where's this dragon? Quickly now!
traduit: 卫兵！这发生什么了？龙哪去了？快说！

original: No! Get back! It's still here somewhere! Hroki and Tor just got grabbed when they tried to make a run for it!
traduit: 不！快回来！它还在附近！洛基和托尔在逃跑时被它抓走了！

original: I envy you the chance to see this dragon up close!
traduit: 我真羡慕你能这么近距离看这头龙！

original: This is all just too much, too fast. Go get some work from Nazir. I need time to... to think...
traduit: 事情太多，也太突然了。去帮纳兹尔干几单活。我需要时间……想想……

original: Maybe, but they wouldn't taste as good as a loaf of fresh-baked pumpernickel.
traduit: 也许吧，但味道肯定不如新出炉的面包好。

original: Exactly. Road patrols were cut in half because the Jarl needed soldiers. Now the bandits are bolder than ever.
traduit: 完全正确。因为领主需要士兵，所以道路上的巡逻队被削减了一半。现在强盗们比以前胆子大多了。

original: They've been raiding the farms for food, and supplies are scarcer than ever. Maybe I should sell swords and armor, instead.
traduit: 他们一直在掠夺农场，所以供给比以往都要少。也许我该改卖武器盔甲了。

original: Let me guess, they're saying it's because of this trouble with the Stormcloaks?
traduit: 让我猜猜，是不是说因为风暴斗篷的麻烦？

original: I had to. The farmers are charging me double for the produce I sell.
traduit: 没办法。给我供货的农民收了双倍的价。

original: Did you raise your prices, Carlotta?
traduit: 你是涨价了吗，卡萝塔？

original: You're right. I'll have to remember that the next time I get a shipment in.
traduit: 你说得对。下次收货的时候我一定得记着点。

original: I'm sure you could charge double for those and still sell them all within a week.
traduit: 你肯定能在一周内卖出去。而且价格得翻一番。

original: Aren't they? I always set some aside for myself when the traders bring them up from the south.
traduit: 是吧？每次商人从南边运过来的时候，我总会自己留一些。

original: Those green apples you sold me the other day were delicious.
traduit: 你那天卖我的青苹果很好吃。

original: The gods smile on them who show charity. Best you remember that.
traduit: 诸神会对仁慈的人微笑。最好记住这点。

original: Make it quick, then. I don't want your stink driving my customers away.
traduit: 那就快点看。我不想让你的臭味赶走了我其他客人。

original: That's right, mock the town beggar like everyone else. But I've got a right to browse, don't I? I ain't hurtin' anyone.
traduit: 这就对了，像其他人一样嘲笑镇上的乞丐。但我还是有看看的权利的吧？我又没妨害到谁。

original: How goes the begging today, Brenuin?
traduit: 今天讨到钱了吗，布瑞纽恩？

original: Best you forget whatever you think you saw, elf. Such idle talk can prove hazardous to one's health.
traduit: 最好把你看到的都忘了，精灵。传闲话有害身体健康。

original: Would your good friend be named Jon, by any chance? I've spied the two of you talking quite intimately.
traduit: 你朋友是叫乔恩吗？我看见你俩在亲密交谈来着。

original: Glad to see you're making new friends. I know Jon's death was hard on you.
traduit: 很高兴看到你交了新朋友。我知道乔恩的死让你很难过。

original: Got any sausages? I'm cooking a special breakfast for a friend, and they're his favorite.
traduit: 有香肠吗？我想给朋友做顿特别的早餐。他喜欢吃这个。

original: Ah, Olfina. How may I help you?
traduit: 啊，奥菲娜。有什么需要效劳吗？

original: Make it quick, and there might be a bowl of hot stew in it for you.
traduit: 请快点，说不定还能分你一碗炖肉呢。

original: Certainly. I'll be sure to bring some back for you the next time I go hunting.
traduit: 当然。下次打猎的时候我会带些给你。

original: I've got a recipe for venison stew that I want to try out. Will you have venison anytime soon?
traduit: 我找到一份炖鹿肉的食谱想要试试。你最近会去猎鹿吗？

original: By Ysmir, I will. Gods know it's been too long since I tasted real meat.
traduit: 伊斯米尔在上，我会的。天知道我多久没吃到真正的肉了。

original: If they do, promise you'll actually purchase something for once.
traduit: 如果他们给了，向他们保证真的买一次东西吧。

original: Just browsin' today. If the gods be kind, someone will take mercy on me and spare a few septims.
traduit: 今天就看看。如果诸神慈悲的话，或许会有人发善心给我几个塞普汀。

original: Here's what they owed us.
traduit: 这是他们欠咱的。

original: I suppose it's not a total loss then.
traduit: 看来也不算毫无收获。

original: Let me give you a piece of advice. If you want to make some serious coin in this business you need to listen to rules.
traduit: 给你个建议，想要在这行里赚大钱，就得守规矩。

original: Now, on to other things.
traduit: 现在，说说别的事吧。

original: Yeah, it's all here.
traduit: 没错，都在这。

original: Well done. And it would seem I owe you something in return.
traduit: 干得好。看来我得给你点东西做奖励。

original: Here you go, I think you'll find these quite useful.
traduit: 给你，你会发现这些东西很有用的。

original: Are you daft? I told you not kill any of them. How much clearer do you need me to be?
traduit: 你蠢吗？我告诉过你别杀人，还要我说得多清楚？

original: How about the gold? Did you remember to bring it or is that too difficult an instruction as well.
traduit: 钱呢？带来了吗？还是说太难了。

original: So, job's done and you even brought the gold. Best of all you did it clean. I like that.
traduit: 任务完成，钱也带来了。最棒的是，做得干干净净。我很喜欢。

original: Dumping bodies and keeping the guards quiet can be expensive.
traduit: 抛尸和买通卫兵的代价太大了。

original: I don't suppose you're going to buy something this time?
traduit: 你这次也不会买东西吧？

original: Malyn's enchantments are broken. Hold on. I'm going to pull your soul out of there. Brace yourself.
traduit: 马林的附魔已经被破坏。等一下，我要把你的灵魂取出来了。振作点。

original: The Star is free to purify itself. Don't worry, mortal. I will return you before you are cleansed.
traduit: 星辰可以自我净化了。别担心，凡人。我会在你被一并净化前送你出去。

original: I've helped your people as you asked.
traduit: 我按你的要求帮助了你的民众。

original: Then by my right as Jarl, I name you Thane of Eastmarch. Congratulations.
traduit: 那么我以领主之名，任命你为东陲武卫。恭喜。

original: I grant you a personal Housecarl to watch over your home and this weapon from my armory to serve as your badge of office.
traduit: 我会授予你一名私人侍卫照看你家，并从我的军械库中取出这把武器作为你的贵族身份象征。

original: I'll also notify my guards of your new title.
traduit: 我也会通知卫兵们你获得了新的头衔。

original: My Jarl, is there anything else you need?
traduit: 领主大人，还有什么需要吗？

original: I'd like to offer you a place in my court, as a Thane. It's mainly an honorary title, but there are a few perks.
traduit: 我想让你在我的宫廷中担任武卫。这其实就是个荣誉头衔，但也有些额外好处。

original: Now, by law and tradition, I can only grant the title to one who is known throughout Eastmarch, and who owns property in Windhelm.
traduit: 但是，根据法律与传统，我只能将爵位授予在东陲领广为人知，并在风舵城拥有房产的人。

original: If you do good works for the people and purchase a home from my steward, I'll name you my Thane.
traduit: 如果你能为人民做些好事，并从我的总管那里买一所房子，那我就任命你为我的武卫。

original: Then by my right as Jarl, I name you Thane of Whiterun. Congratulations.
traduit: 那么我以领主之名，任命你为白漫武卫。恭喜。

original: Then by my right as Jarl, I name you Thane of Haafingar. Congratulations.
traduit: 那么我以领主之名，任命你为海芬加武卫。恭喜。

original: Oh, forgive me, Thane. I didn't realize it was you.
traduit: 哦，原谅我，武卫大人。我不知道是您。

original: We'll look the other way this time, but even the Jarl's influence has its limits. Be more careful.
traduit: 这次我们会睁一只眼闭一只眼了，但即使是领主的影响力也有极限。请小心。

original: Wait... I know you.
traduit: 等等……我认识你。

original: In the name of the Jarl, I'm ordering you to stand fast!
traduit: 以领主的名义，我命令你站在原地！

original: Since you put it that way, I think we can overlook your crime for now.
traduit: 既然你这么说，我觉得可以忽略你的罪行了。

original: All right, all right. Just keep your voice down and don't let me catch you again.
traduit: 好吧，好吧。小声点，别让我再抓到你了。

original: Everything here appears to be in order. You can move along now.
traduit: 这里的一切好像都挺有序的。你现在可以走了。

original: I can make all your problems with the guards go away. But it'll cost you. What do you say?
traduit: 我可以解决你和卫兵之间的问题。但你得付出点代价。你说呢？

original: I'm the Jarl's Thane. I demand you let me go at once.
traduit: 我是领主的武卫。我命令你立刻放我走。

original: No one in the Jarl's court is above the charge of conspiring against the city. You're coming with us.
traduit: 在领主的宫廷没人能逃脱阴谋反抗城市的指控。你跟我们走。

original: The Jarl has appointed me to be your housecarl. It's an honor to serve you.
traduit: 领主任命我为您的侍卫。为您服务是我的荣幸。

original: Long life to you, Thane.
traduit: 愿您长寿，武卫大人。

original: I am your sword and your shield.
traduit: 我就是您的剑和盾。

original: Honor to you, my Thane.
traduit: 荣幸之至，武卫阁下。

original: What do you need, my Thane?
traduit: 有什么事吗，武卫阁下？

original: Honored to see you again, my Thane.
traduit: 很荣幸再次见到您，武卫大人。

original: There is room in my court for a new Thane. It's an honorary title, mainly, but there are a few perks someone like you could make use of.
traduit: 我的宫廷里还有地方容纳新的武卫。这就是个荣誉头衔，但你也可以持有一些特权。

original: However, I could only grant the title to someone who is known throughout my Hold, and who owns at least one piece of property in my city.
traduit: 然而，我只能把头衔授予给我领地内有名望，且在城里有一块土地的人。

original: You help my people and purchase a house from my steward, and I'll make you my Thane.
traduit: 你需要去帮助我的人民，然后再从我的总管处买一所房子，我就可以封你做我的武卫了。

original: However, I could only grant the title to someone who is known throughout my Hold.
traduit: 然而，我只能把头衔授予给我领地内有名望的人。

original: You help my people, and I'll make you my Thane.
traduit: 你去帮助我的人民，我就封你做我的武卫。

original: Then by my right as Jarl, I name you Thane of the Reach. Congratulations.
traduit: 那么我以领主之名，任命你为瑞驰武卫。恭喜。

original: Hmph. When most would speak, you listen. You think. You understand that the only thing that matters is you following my orders. To kill.
traduit: 嗯。当大多数人说话的时候，你选择了倾听。还有思考。你知道唯一重要的是，你要服从我的命令。去杀人。

original: You told me to kill, and I killed.
traduit: 你让我杀人，我就杀了。

original: Indeed. For you, my friend, seem to understand what's truly important. When I give an order to spill blood, you follow it. No questions. No remorse.
traduit: 没错。朋友，你似乎明白了什么才是最重要的。我下令杀人，你就得照做。不提问题，没有后悔。

original: So who was it? Who had the contract?
traduit: 那到底是谁？谁才是契约目标？

original: Oh. No, no, no. Don't you understand? Guilt, innocence, right, wrong.... Irrelevant. What matters is I ordered you to kill someone, and you obeyed.
traduit: 哦。不不不。你还没明白吗？有罪无罪，是对是错……都不重要。重要的是我命令你去杀人，你遵从了。

original: That's what I thought.
traduit: 我也是这么想。

original: Never you mind, then. I'll find a more charitable soul.
traduit: 那就不劳你费心了。我会找个更仁慈的人。

original: So you can spend it on drinks at the Bannered Mare? If it's food you need, ask for that instead.
traduit: 这样你就能去悬旗母马喝酒了？如果需要食物，那就去要。

original: Spare a coin for a fellow Nord who's down on his luck?
traduit: 能给落魄的诺德兄弟来个金币吗？

original: I've recovered all of Arondil's Journals.
traduit: 我集齐了阿荣迪尔的日记。

original: Good. I was hoping you hadn't forgotten about it.
traduit: 好。我正希望你没忘了呢。

original: As promised, here's your payment for bringing them to me. Got it as part of a fair trade from my client.
traduit: 我答应过你，这是你把它们带来的报酬。是我客户交易的一部分。

original: How can you be certain the journals exist?
traduit: 你怎么确定日记真的存在？

original: Recently, a woman was found... naked and shivering along the road to Dawnstar.
traduit: 最近，有个女人……光着身子瑟瑟发抖地走在通向晨星的路上。

original: The only information the guard could get from her were tales of strange experiments and Arondil scribbling in his journals.
traduit: 卫兵从她那里得到的唯一信息就是奇怪的实验故事和阿荣迪尔在日记上的涂鸦。

original: Do you know anything about Arondil?
traduit: 关于阿荣迪尔你知道些什么？

original: Only rumors. He used to have a home in Dawnstar until they burned it down.
traduit: 只有些谣言。以前他在晨星城安家，后来被烧了。

original: The people say he was doing unspeakable experiments on reanimation... rituals only a necromancer would perform.
traduit: 人们说他在做无法形容的复活实验……只有死灵法师才会进行那些仪式。

original: After he made for Yngvild, he was never heard from again.
traduit: 在他前往鹰维尔德之后，就再没有消息了。

original: I think you're in luck.
traduit: 我觉得你挺走运。

original: I can't believe it. You have them already?
traduit: 不敢相信。你已经拿到了？

original: Here, take this. This should cover your end of the work nicely.
traduit: 给，拿着吧。应该够支付你完成的工作了。

original: It's a good start, but you need all four of the volumes or the set isn't complete.
traduit: 这是个好的开始，但你得凑齐四卷才行。否则不完整啊。

original: Why don't you head back out to Yngvild and find the rest?
traduit: 要不你再回鹰维尔德找找剩下的？

original: I'm not into books.
traduit: 我对书没兴趣。

original: Yeah, but you're into gold. Let me know if you change your mind. I'm not going anywhere.
traduit: 是啊，但你对钱肯定有兴趣。如果改主意了，就告诉我一声。反正我哪儿也不去。

original: I'll get them for you.
traduit: 我去给你拿。

original: Then we have a deal.
traduit: 那就这么定了。

original: In his later years, Andoril moved into some ice caves known as Yngvild. He prefered the solitude in which to perform his, um... experiments.
traduit: 阿荣迪尔晚年搬进了有个叫鹰维尔德的冰洞。他喜欢独来独往完成他的……实验。

original: What kind of books are they?
traduit: 什么类型的书？

original: I'm told they're the ravings of a madman... a wizard named Arondil and his peculiar cravings.
traduit: 我听说是些疯子的胡言乱语……一个叫阿荣迪尔的巫师和他奇怪的欲望。

original: It's said to be spread across four volumes and very hard to come by. My client is offering quite a reward for them, which I'd split with you.
traduit: 据说这本书有四卷，很难找到。我的客户下了一笔可观的赏金，我愿意和你平分。

original: Anything you need done around here?
traduit: 有什么需要帮忙的吗？

original: Now that you mention it, there is.
traduit: 既然你提起来，确实有。

original: I have a buyer with, shall we say, a very odd taste in literature looking for some particular books.
traduit: 我有个买家，怎么说呢，他对文学品位很奇怪，想要找一些特别的书。

original: Yes, and just like weeds, they're nothin' but trouble.
traduit: 是啊，就跟野草一样，除了麻烦没别的。

original: Those little girls of yours are growing like weeds, Lemkil.
traduit: 你的小女儿们长得就像野草一样快啊，莱姆吉尔。

original: True enough, but there's nothing wrong with a little adventure now and then. Not much excitement in working the soil every day.
traduit: 这倒是真的，但偶尔来点小冒险也没什么不对。每天种地没什么乐趣。

original: Ah, there's nothing like fresh air and honest labor to bolster the spirit.
traduit: 啊，没有什么比新鲜的空气和诚实的劳动更能振奋精神了。

original: So far, things are going well. Let's just hope the weather holds.
traduit: 目前为止一切都好。只希望好天气能继续保持下去。

original: Are you making good progress with the planting?
traduit: 你们的种植进展顺利吗？

original: I'm trying something new, offering discounts for bulk purchases. So far, that seems to be working.
traduit: 我在尝试一些新方法，大量购买的给打折。目前看，效果不错。

original: I hear your crops sold well at the market. Well done, Ennis.
traduit: 我听说你的庄稼在市场上卖得不错。干得好，埃尼斯。

original: We don't need your charity, Breton. If my girls deserve something nice, it'll be their father who buys it.
traduit: 我们不需要你的施舍，布莱顿人。如果我女儿配得上这些好东西，那也应该是她们的父亲来买。

original: Good day, Lemkil. I saw some nice dresses for your little girls while I was in Whiterun. I'd be happy to purchase them, if you like.
traduit: 你好啊，莱姆吉尔。我在白漫城看到有些很适合你家女儿们的漂亮裙子。如果你喜欢，我很乐意买下。

original: Thanks for the offer, Jouane, but I'm saving up for a new sword.
traduit: 谢谢你，乔安内，但我想攒钱买把剑。

original: Anything I can pick up for you on my next trip into the city, Erik?
traduit: 下次进城有什么需要我帮你带的吗，艾瑞克？

original: How thoughtful! I'll come take a look after supper.
traduit: 你太体贴了！我晚饭后去看看。

original: I picked up a set of fine silver brushes in the city, Reldith. I thought you might be interested.
traduit: 我在城里买了套银刷子，雷尔迪斯。我想你可能会感兴趣。

original: Glad to hear all my hard work has paid off. Maybe we'll fetch a better price for our crops next time we're in the city.
traduit: 很高兴听到我所有的努力得到了回报。也许我们下次进城能把庄稼卖个好价钱。

original: The last time I was in Whiterun, the tradesmen were talking about you. It seems your reputation as a businessman is growing.
traduit: 上次我去白漫城的时候，商人们都在谈论你。看来你当商人的名声越来越好了。

original: I hereby grant you permission to purchase property in my city. Talk to my steward if you're interested.
traduit: 我在此允许你在我的城市中购置房产。如果你有兴趣，可以去找我的总管谈谈。

original: And take this. A gift from the Jarl's personal stores.
traduit: 收下这个吧。来自领主私人库藏的礼物。

original: Don't worry about me. I'll do it.
traduit: 别为我担心。我去办。

original: Divines watch over you.
traduit: 愿圣灵护佑你。

original: I've brought you <Alias=QuestItem>.
traduit: 我把<Alias=QuestItem>给你带来了。

original: You've honored my father's memory in more ways than I have words to say.
traduit: 我无法用言语表达你对我父亲的敬意了。

original: Do you have any more work for me?
traduit: 您还有其他工作要我做吗？

original: I do. A personal matter. My father died trying to negotiate with the Forsworn, back when that was possible.
traduit: 确实有。是私事。我父亲在尝试和弃誓者谈判的时候被杀害了，那阵还是有可能谈判的。

original: They took his shield to those Hagraven beasts they consort with. I need you to bring it home where it belongs.
traduit: 他们把我父亲的盾牌带到乌鸦鬼婆那里去了。我要你把它夺回来，物归原主。

original: I warn you, it's dangerous work. No man of mine has ever faced a Hagraven and lived. I'll understand if you decline.
traduit: 我得警告你，这是个危险的工作。我手下没人能面对乌鸦鬼婆然后幸存回来。如果你想拒绝，我也能理解。

original: Is there anything else you need, my Jarl?
traduit: 还有什么需要吗，领主大人？

original: Then by my right as Jarl, I name you Thane of Winterhold.
traduit: 那么我现在以领主之名，任命你为冬堡武卫。

original: I grant you this weapon from the armory to serve as your badge of office.
traduit: 我将我军械库中的这把武器作为你的勋章。

original: I'll also notify the guards of your new title. Wouldn't want them to think you're part of the common rabble, now.
traduit: 我也会告知卫兵你获得了新的头衔。我可不想让他们拿你当成平民百姓。

original: Anything else you need, my Jarl?
traduit: 您还需要什么吗，领主大人？

original: Why is this buried so far within Saarthal?
traduit: 为什么这东西会埋在萨瑟尔如此深的地方？

original: I never imagined we'd find something like this.
traduit: 我从没想过会找到这样的东西。

original: Well now... would you look at that.
traduit: 哎呀……你看看那个。

original: Please. Not now. You'll know when I'm ready to discuss the issue.
traduit: 行了，现在别提了。等我准备好讨论这个问题的时候会告诉你的。

original: Have you seen Astrid? She needs to speak with you. It seemed urgent. Come talk to me afterward.
traduit: 你去见阿斯垂德了吗？她要找你谈谈。好像很急的样子。和她谈完再来找我吧。

original: On this day... I go to Sovngarde.
traduit: 今天……我要去松加德了。

original: Such is our way! Such is the ancient custom of Skyrim, and all Nords!
traduit: 这就是我们的方式！这就是天际、这就是所有诺德人的古老传统！

original: There was no murder! Ulfric challenged Torygg. He beat the High King in fair combat.
traduit: 这根本不是谋杀！乌弗瑞克挑战了托依格。在决斗中打败了至高王。

original: By opening that gate for Ulfric you betrayed the people of Solitude.
traduit: 在你为乌弗瑞克打开大门之时，你背叛了独孤城的人民。

original: Roggvir. You helped Ulfric Stormcloak escape this city after he murdered High King Torygg.
traduit: 罗吉维尔。乌弗瑞克·风暴斗篷谋杀至高王托依格后，你帮助他逃离了城市。

original: Let me know if there's anything else you need.
traduit: 如果还需要什么尽管说。

original: I'll show you to your room. Right this way.
traduit: 我会带你去房间。这边走。

original: Ah! I've heard of this Shouting, but never seen it. Fascinating...
traduit: 哦！我听说过这种龙吼，但是还没亲眼见证过。太神奇了……

original: I've read the dragon language, but to hear it spoken is most interesting.
traduit: 我读过龙语，但还是听人吼出来更有趣。

original: This skill should prove very useful, Dragonborn. Fighting fire with fire, as the saying goes.
traduit: 龙裔，这个技能肯定很实用，俗话说，以毒攻毒。

original: The dragons will surely fear your Voice.
traduit: 龙族肯定会惧怕你的吼声。

original: Ah... the power of the dragon is yours! There can be no doubt that you are the Dragonborn of prophecy.
traduit: 啊……你拥有龙之力量！你就是预言中的龙裔。

original: Alduin cannot ignore this for long.
traduit: 奥杜因不会一直坐视不管的。

original: We've got to bring it down!
traduit: 我们得把它弄下来！

original: Don't let it get too close!
traduit: 别让它靠太近了！

original: We've got to ground that bastard!
traduit: 我们得让这混蛋落到地上来！

original: Come on! This is our best chance!
traduit: 上吧！好机会！

original: Attack while it's landed!
traduit: 等它着陆就攻击！

original: Now it's my turn, you son of a bitch.
traduit: 现在该我了，你个狗娘养的。

original: For the Blades!
traduit: 为了刀锋会！

original: Come on. What are you waiting for?
traduit: 上啊。还在等什么？

original: Lorkhan's eyes, you're an ugly one, aren't you?
traduit: 洛克汗的眼睛啊，你长得真够丑的。

original: Remember Cloud Ruler Temple!
traduit: 铭记凌云者神殿！

original: Did you think the Blades had been destroyed?
traduit: 你以为刀锋会完蛋了不成？

original: Now it's your turn, Thalmor bitch.
traduit: 现在轮到你了，梭默贱人。

original: The Blades will never be defeated, Thalmor dog.
traduit: 梭默狗，刀锋会是永远不败的。

original: I could use a hand here.
traduit: 我需要援手。

original: I'm not afraid of you.
traduit: 我可不怕你。

original: I wasn't looking for trouble.
traduit: 我可不是自找麻烦。

original: I gave up this kind of thing a long time ago.
traduit: 这种事我很久前就不做了。

original: You can still run. It's not too late.
traduit: 你现在要跑还不晚。

original: You've brought this on yourself.
traduit: 这是你自找的了。

original: Thalmor dog! Death is too good for you.
traduit: 梭默狗！死就算便宜你了。

original: You'll die knowing it was the Blades that sent you to Oblivion.
traduit: 你马上就得死了。记住，是刀锋会送你去的湮灭。

original: You're starting to make me angry.
traduit: 你惹恼我了。

original: I'm in a bit of trouble here.
traduit: 我遇到些麻烦了。

original: I need some help with this one!
traduit: 我需要帮助！

original: You should not have meddled in the Thalmor's affairs.
traduit: 你不该干涉梭默事务！

original: The Thalmor's memory is long.
traduit: 梭默记性可不差。

original: Esbern cannot elude us, fool.
traduit: 伊思本躲不过我们的，笨蛋。

original: I shall sing of thee in Sovngarde!
traduit: 我会在松加德纵情歌唱！

original: Feel the bite of my axe!
traduit: 尝尝我的斧头！

original: It is glorious to battle once again in Tamriel!
traduit: 重新站在泰姆瑞尔上战斗十分光荣！

original: Feel the thunder of my voice!
traduit: 感受我雷鸣般的怒吼吧！

original: You will die for the glory of the Dragonborn!
traduit: 你会为龙裔的荣耀而死！

original: You are not worthy of Sovngarde!
traduit: 你不配去松加德！

original: For the Dragonborn!
traduit: 为了龙裔！

original: For Sovngarde!
traduit: 为了松加德！

original: My sword will taste of your blood!
traduit: 我的剑正渴着呢！

original: I'd rather not do that.
traduit: 我还是不去了。

original: This work isn't for everyone. Maybe you're more cut out for those snowberries up in Winterhold.
traduit: 这工作不是谁都能来。也许你更适合去冬堡捡雪浆果。

original: This isn't an order of cowards. I'll find someone more agreeable, I'm sure.
traduit: 看来这命令不适合你这软蛋。我会去找个更招人喜欢的来办。

original: Fine, I'll get someone else to take care of it.
traduit: 好吧，我找别人来处理。

original: Of course you will.
traduit: 就知道你会。

original: Is it true that the Companions are werewolves?
traduit: 战友团真的是狼人吗？

original: I see you've been allowed to know some secrets before your appointed time. No matter. Yes, it's true.
traduit: 看来你已经在时机到来前知道了些秘密了。没关系，这是真的。

original: Not every Companion, though. Only members of the Circle all share the blood of the beast.
traduit: 不过不是每个战友团。只有圆环成员才有野兽之血。

original: Some take to it more than others.
traduit: 有些人会比较喜欢这样。

original: Shor's bones... how did they find this place?
traduit: 舒尔的骨头……他们是怎么找到这个地方的？

original: Be careful around the burial stones. I don't want to haul you back to Jorrvaskr on my back.
traduit: 在这些墓石周围要小心点。我可不想把你背着回月瓦斯卡。

original: Looks like someone's been digging here. And recently.
traduit: 看来有人在这里发掘过，而且时间很近。

original: Tread lightly.
traduit: 走路轻一点。

original: You've already turned down a job that I had for you.
traduit: 你已经拒绝了我给你的工作。

original: Work needs doing, and if you're not up to it, maybe you're not cut out to be a Companion.
traduit: 工作是需要完成的，如果你觉得自己不能胜任，那你也许就不适合当战友。

original: Be cautious. Beasts are not nearly as predictable as men. Give the thing a quick death.
traduit: 小心点。野兽可不像人那样容易预判。让它死得痛快点。

original: Good. I knew that we could count on you. It's simply a beast, but be cautious. The beasts of Skyrim are made of sterner stuff than most.
traduit: 好。我就知道能指望你。虽然只是头野兽，但也要小心。天际的野兽可比其他地方的要强得多。

original: I knew we could count on you. Get it taken care of right away. Nobody wants an animal left roaming around in their place.
traduit: 我就知道我们能指望你。尽快把它料理了。没人希望有动物在自己的地盘上游荡。

original: You're not afraid, are you? Of animals? Come back when you find your spine.
traduit: 你不会是害怕了吧？怕动物？等你有点骨气的时候再回来。

original: Unfortunate, but someone else will take care of it.
traduit: 真不幸，但会有人去处理的。

original: I see. Well, should you change your mind, the contract will be available for a while.
traduit: 我知道了。嗯，这个契约应该还可以保存一段时间，改主意了随时来。

original: All right, so here you are. Looks like the others are eager to meet you.
traduit: 好了，到了。看来其他人也很想见见你。

original: Come to me or Aela if you're looking for work.
traduit: 如果想找活儿干，可以来找我和艾拉。

original: Once you've made a bit of a name for yourself, Skjor and Vilkas might have things for you to do.
traduit: 等你有点名气之后，斯科约尔和威尔卡斯可能就会给你工作了。

original: Good luck. Welcome to the Companions.
traduit: 祝你好运。欢迎加入战友团。

original: The quarters are up here. Just pick a bed and fall in it when you're tired.
traduit: 住处就在那儿。累了的时候就找张床睡吧。

original: Tilma will keep the place clean. She always has.
traduit: 提尔玛会负责打扫。她一直在这儿。

original: Nice to have a new face around. It gets boring here sometimes.
traduit: 很高兴有新面孔出现。这里有时会很无聊。

original: I hope we keep you. This can be a rough life.
traduit: 希望我们能留下你。这里的生活有可能很艰难。

original: Skjor and Aela like to tease me, but they are good people.
traduit: 斯科约尔和艾拉喜欢取笑我，但他们人很好。

original: They challenge us to be our best.
traduit: 他们要求我们做到最好。

original: New blood? Oh, I remember you. Come on, follow me.
traduit: 新人啊？啊，我记得你。来吧，跟我来。

original: New blood? Oh, hello. I'm Farkas. Come, follow me.
traduit: 新人啊？啊，你好。我是法卡斯。来吧，跟我来。

original: Of course we did, icebrain.
traduit: 当然了，呆瓜。

original: Show this new blood where the rest of the whelps sleep.
traduit: 带着新人去看看崽子们睡觉的地方。

original: Did you call me?
traduit: 你叫我？

original: Farkas!
traduit: 法卡斯！

original: Here, let's have Farkas show you where you'll be resting your head.
traduit: 来，让法卡斯带你去住处看看。

original: I would kill him before he drew his sword.
traduit: 我会在他拔出剑之前就宰了他。

original: Woah, ease up there. We're rough, but there's no need to kill a Shield-Brother over a dispute.
traduit: 喔喔，放轻松。我们都是大老粗，但没必要为了争执就杀了盾牌兄弟。

original: I like your fire, though. You'll make a fierce Companion. Let us hunt together sometime.
traduit: 不过我喜欢你的热情。你会成为很厉害的战友。有时间可以一起去打猎。

original: I don't care for boasting.
traduit: 我对自吹自擂没兴趣。

original: Ah, a man of action.
traduit: 哈，行动派。

original: Ah, a woman who lets her actions speak for her. I knew there was something I liked about you.
traduit: 啊，用行动说话的女人。我就知道你身上有我喜欢的东西。

original: There you are. I had wondered where you got to.
traduit: 你来了。我还在想你去哪儿了。

original: Do you think you could handle Vilkas in a real fight?
traduit: 你觉得能在真正的战斗中击败威尔卡斯吗？

original: Don't let Vilkas catch you saying that.
traduit: 可别让威尔卡斯听见。

original: Ah, yes. I heard you gave him quite a thrashing.
traduit: 啊，对了。我听说你把他狠狠地揍了一顿。

original: You know this one? I saw him training in the yard with Vilkas.
traduit: 你认识这家伙吗？我看到他在院子里和威尔卡斯对练来着。

original: You know this one? I saw her training in the yard with Vilkas.
traduit: 你认识这家伙吗？我看到她在院子里和威尔卡斯对练来着。

original: I told you, this is the whelp that Vilkas mentioned.
traduit: 我告诉过你了，这就是威尔卡斯提到的那个崽子。

original: I have your shield.
traduit: 我把你的盾牌带来了。

original: Ah, good. I've been waiting for this. Good to see you made it up here.
traduit: 啊，很好。我一直等着呢。多谢你把它拿来了。

original: Ah, good. I've been waiting for this. Wait... I remember you. So the old man thinks you've got some heart, I guess.
traduit: 啊，很好。我一直等着呢。等等……我认得你。看来那老头儿觉得你有点胆量啊。

original: Ah, good. I've been waiting for this. Are you new here?
traduit: 啊，很好。我一直等着呢。你是新来的？

original: I'm happy to lend a hand.
traduit: 我很乐意帮忙。

original: That's a good man.
traduit: 你真是个好人。

original: Well done.
traduit: 很好。

original: Didn't you just tell me not to be a servant?
traduit: 你不是才跟我说别当奴才吗？

original: This isn't a command. Just decency. Help out an old blacksmith. I've got to get back to my work.
traduit: 这不是命令。只是礼貌的请求。帮助我这个老铁匠。我得回去工作了。

original: I'll need to be going.
traduit: 我得走了。

original: I have a favor to ask.
traduit: 我想请你帮个忙。

original: Someone has to be in charge, though.
traduit: 但总得有人管事吧。

original: Well, I'm not sure how they've managed it, but they have. No leaders since Ysgramor.
traduit: 嗯，我也不知道他们是怎么做到的，但他们确实做到了。自从伊斯格拉默以后，就没有领袖了。

original: Kodlak is the Harbinger, and he's a sort of advisor for the whole group, but every man is his own. Every woman, her own.
traduit: 克拉科是先驱，作为整个团队的顾问，但这里无论男女，都是独立自主的。

original: I'm just doing what I'm asked.
traduit: 我只是按要求行事。

original: That attitude would get you far, if you were some stuffy merchant or a Jarl's footstool.
traduit: 如果你是个古板的商人，或者领主的马凳儿，这种态度会让你走得更远。

original: Around here, you'll want to learn to live your own life. Remember, nobody rules anybody in the Companions.
traduit: 在这里，你需要学会过自己的生活。记住，战友团中没人统治其他人。

original: Not actually a Companion myself, but none of them know how to work a forge properly, and I'm honored to serve them.
traduit: 并不是，但他们中没人会使用锻炉，所以我很荣幸替他们效劳。

original: My name is Eorlund Gray-Mane. I work the Skyforge. Best steel in all of Skyrim. All of Tamriel.
traduit: 我叫厄伦德·灰鬃。在天空锻炉工作。我这里出产全天际，全泰姆瑞尔最好的钢铁。

original: Does Vilkas always send newcomers on errands?
traduit: 威尔卡斯总是打发新人跑腿吗？

original: Oh, don't worry too much about it. They were all whelps once. They just might not like to talk about it.
traduit: 哦，别太在意。谁以前还不是个小崽子呢。他们只是不太愿意谈起来而已。

original: And don't always just do what you're told. Nobody rules anybody in the Companions.
traduit: 也不要总是按吩咐去做。战友团里没人统治其他人。

original: Vilkas sent me with his sword.
traduit: 威尔卡斯让我来送他的剑。

original: I'm guessing you're the newcomer then?
traduit: 我猜你是新来的吧？

original: How was that?
traduit: 怎么样？

original: Not bad. Next time won't be so easy.
traduit: 还不坏。下次不会这么容易了。

original: Now that's impressive. You're mightier than you look.
traduit: 挺不错。你比看上去强大得多。

original: What do you think this is? We don't do battle with magic around here, new blood. Now come at me.
traduit: 你在想什么？我们这里不斗法，新人。现在跟上来。

original: Come on now, fight your own battles.
traduit: 来吧，随便招呼。

original: So you're supposed to train me?
traduit: 你是想训练我？

original: Not here. Out in the yard. Come on.
traduit: 不是在这儿。到院子里。来吧。

original: The old man said to have a look at you, so let's do this.
traduit: 老爷子让我试试你，咱们就来吧。

original: Just have a few swings at me so I can see your form. Don't worry, I can take it.
traduit: 给我几下子，让我看看你的斤两。别担心，我受得住。

original: I have much to learn.
traduit: 我还有很多东西要学。

original: That's the spirit. Vilkas, here, will get started on that.
traduit: 很有精神。这是威尔卡斯，他会接手的。

original: You dare question my skill?
traduit: 你竟敢质疑我的本事？

original: Calm down there, whelp. Don't feel like you need to show off for our sake.
traduit: 冷静点，小崽子。用不着在我们面前逞能。

original: Vilkas, here, will be the one testing your mettle.
traduit: 这位是威尔卡斯，他会考验你的胆识。

original: I can handle myself.
traduit: 我能独当一面。

original: That may be so. This is Vilkas. He will test your arm.
traduit: 也许吧。这位是威尔卡斯，他会考验你的胆识。

original: Oh you're back. Do you still think you could stand as a Companion?
traduit: 哦，你回来啦。你觉得你能成为一名战友吗？

original: Of course. How are you in a battle, boy?
traduit: 那是自然。你身手怎么样，小子？

original: Of course. How are you in a battle, girl?
traduit: 那是自然。你身手怎么样，姑娘？

original: And their arm.
traduit: 还有他们的身手。

original: Sometimes the famous come to us. Sometimes men and women come to us to seek their fame. It makes no difference.
traduit: 有时来者已经名声显赫，有时来者来此寻求名声。并无分别。

original: What matters is their heart.
traduit: 重要的是他们的心。

original: Apologies. But perhaps this isn't the time. I've never even heard of this outsider.
traduit: 抱歉。但是这次应该不行。我从没听说过这个外来者。

original: I am nobody's master, Vilkas. And last I checked, we had some empty beds in Jorrvaskr for those with a fire burning in their hearts.
traduit: 我不是任何人的师父，威尔卡斯。上次我查看时，月瓦斯卡有些空床可以留给那些热血新人。

original: Master, you're not truly considering accepting him?
traduit: 师父，你不会真的考虑接纳他吧？

original: Master, you're not truly considering accepting her?
traduit: 师父，你不会真的考虑接纳她吧？

original: I would like to join the Companions.
traduit: 我想加入战友团。

original: Would you now? Here, let me have a look at you.
traduit: 你吗？来，让我看看你。

original: Hm. Yes, perhaps. A certain strength of spirit.
traduit: 嗯。对，也许可以。你身上有股强大的精神。

original: Leave that to me.
traduit: 交给我吧。

original: You have my brother and I, obviously. But I don't know if the rest will go along quite so easily.
traduit: 你确实说服了我们哥俩儿。但我不知道剩下的人能否这么顺利。

original: We all do. It is our burden to bear. But we can overcome.
traduit: 我们都能听到。这是我们需要忍受的重负，但我们可以克服。

original: But I still hear the call of the blood.
traduit: 但我还是能听到血脉的召唤。

original: Spread out and look for survivors. We need to know what we're dealing with.
traduit: 分散寻找幸存者。我们得搞清楚要面对什么。

original: No signs of any dragon right now, but it sure looks like he's been here.
traduit: 没有龙的迹象，不过肯定来过。

original: But the old tales tell of the Dragonborn who could kill dragons and steal their power. You must be one!
traduit: 但古老传说里龙裔能够杀死龙族并窃取他们的力量。你一定是的！

original: There weren't any dragons then, idiot. They're just coming back now for the first time in... forever.
traduit: 那时候又没有龙，白痴。他们这么长时间第一次回来啊。

original: I never heard of Tiber Septim killing any dragons.
traduit: 我从没听说泰伯·塞普汀杀过龙啊。

original: That's right! My grandfather used to tell stories about the Dragonborn.
traduit: 没错！我爷爷过去常和我讲龙裔的故事。

original: Dragonborn? What are you talking about?
traduit: 龙裔？你在说什么？

original: What's happening?!
traduit: 怎么回事？！

original: Everybody get back!
traduit: 所有人后退！

original: Look at that!
traduit: 看那儿！

original: I thought we were all dead for sure!
traduit: 我还以为我们全完了！

original: We killed it! I can't believe it!
traduit: 我们真的杀了它！不敢相信啊！

original: Damned good shooting, boys!
traduit: 好箭法，小子们！

original: Let's make sure that overgrown lizard is really dead.
traduit: 我们去看看这个大蜥蜴是不是真死了。

original: Do not be afraid. Your Shout will not harm us.
traduit: 不要怕。你的龙吼伤不到我们。

original: Shout at us, and let us taste of your Voice.
traduit: 对我们用龙吼吧，让我们试试你的吼声。

original: Strike us with the power of your Voice.
traduit: 用你的吼声之力攻击我们。

original: We'll meet back up at the Sanctuary! I'll be fine. Go!
traduit: 我们圣所再见！我没事的。走吧！

original: Astrid ordered me to keep an eye on you. Figured you could use a hand when the chaos erupted.
traduit: 阿斯垂德命令我看着点你。我觉得骚乱爆发的时候你得有个帮手。

original: I'll try and hold them off as best I can. You get back to the Sanctuary!
traduit: 我会尽力拖住他们。你回圣所去！

original: Veezara?
traduit: 维萨拉？

original: I guess we should have expected this response, hmm?
traduit: 我想咱们早该料到这种反应？

original: I thank you all again for making this the best wedding a woman could ask for.
traduit: 再次感谢你们的光临，让一个女人拥有了最棒的婚礼。

original: You have all helped make this a truly extraordinary wedding. All of my dreams have come true. So thank you. Thank you all.
traduit: 你们的到来让这场婚礼变得非同寻常。我的所有梦想都得以实现。谢谢你们，谢谢你们所有人。

original: May you all be as happy in your lives as I know I will be in mine. Thank you again for everything.
traduit: 愿你们能在自己的生活中找到属于自己的快乐。再次感谢你们的光临。

original: Today, the problems of Skyrim are not my problems. Nor are they yours. Today we are joined in peace and happiness. So please, enjoy yourselves.
traduit: 今天，天际的矛盾不属于你我。今天，我们在和平与幸福中结合。所以请尽情享受吧。

original: These days, it seems there is dread everywhere, whether it be war or dragon. But I beg you - here, today, put such fears aside. Enjoy yourselves!
traduit: 最近，似乎各地都因战争与龙陷入恐惧。但我恳请你们，在这里，将恐惧抛诸脑后。好好享受！

original: In this courtyard, there are no Stormcloaks. There are no Imperials. There are only people, come to celebrate a union of two souls. So make merry!
traduit: 这个庭院中，没有风暴斗篷，没有帝国，只有来庆祝两个灵魂彼此结合的宾朋。所以请尽兴享受！

original: I just wanted to take this time to thank you all for being here. To thank you for sharing this wonderfully happy day with myself, and my new husband.
traduit: 我谨借此机会感谢大家的光临。感谢你们来此与我们夫妻共享这美好的一天。

original: Are you all enjoying yourselves? Please, eat, drink, and make merry on this most happy of days.
traduit: 你们玩得开心吗？请在这最幸福的日子尽情吃喝玩乐吧。

original: My husband Aesgir and I thank you for coming to our reception. We thank you for sharing the love we have for each other.
traduit: 我和我丈夫艾斯盖尔欢迎你们的到来。感谢你们来此分享我俩对彼此的爱。

original: Honored guests.
traduit: 尊敬的来宾。

original: Good people of Solitude.
traduit: 独孤城的朋友们。

original: Good friends and neighbors.
traduit: 好朋友、好邻居们。

original: I really appreciate what you've done for me. I'll never forget it.
traduit: 我真的很感谢你为我做的一切。我不会忘记的。

original: Anything you can find would be of great help. Good luck.
traduit: 你找到的任何东西都会有很大帮助。祝你好运。

original: Keep your eyes to the road.
traduit: 眼睛注视前路。

original: Thanks again for the ice wraith teeth.
traduit: 再次感谢你送来的冰怒灵之牙。

original: Be careful looking for those teeth... those little bastards are dangerous.
traduit: 找那些牙齿的时候要小心……那些小混蛋很危险。

original: Keep your belly full and your shoulders strong.
traduit: 填饱肚子，强壮肩膀。

original: Come back when you're ready to spend more gold... goodness knows I could use it.
traduit: 当你准备好花更多钱的时候再回来吧……神是知道我需要钱的。

original: Safe travels, landstrider.
traduit: 旅途安全，旅行者。

original: Good journey, marsh-friend.
traduit: 愿旅途愉快，沼泽之友。

original: Return anytime. You're quite welcome here.
traduit: 随时回来看看。我十分欢迎。

original: Remember, nothing but genuine fire salts will do... the forge knows the difference.
traduit: 记住，只有真正的火盐才会起作用……锻炉是能察觉区别的。

original: If you need any more smithing work, come see me again.
traduit: 如果你还需要锻造更多东西，再回来找我吧。

original: Thanks for your business.
traduit: 谢谢惠顾。

original: It was nice to meet you.
traduit: 很高兴见到你。

original: Be careful out there... Riften can be dangerous.
traduit: 在外面要小心……裂谷城很危险。

original: Door's over there. Why don't you use it?
traduit: 门就在那儿。你为什么不用呢？

original: Come back and see us again.
traduit: 下次再来看我们吧。

original: Just get out of here.
traduit: 快点走。

original: If you'll excuse me, I have other things to attend to.
traduit: 失陪了，我还有其他事要做。

original: Imperial bastard.
traduit: 帝国混蛋。

original: Farewell, kinsman.
traduit: 再见了，族人。

original: Support Ulfric or die trying. There's nothing in between.
traduit: 支持乌弗瑞克或者死。没有余地。

original: Talos preserve you.
traduit: 塔洛斯保佑你。

original: It's been good talking to you.
traduit: 很高兴和你聊天。

original: Good, now maybe I can get back to work.
traduit: 很好，我现在可以回去工作了。

original: Well, that was important.
traduit: 嗯，真是够重要的。

original: Come back and see us again!
traduit: 再来的时候，来看看我们吧！

original: Travel safe.
traduit: 一路平安。

original: Remember to give at the temple.
traduit: 记得到神殿去捐钱。

original: When I find that bitch, I'm going to wring her little neck.
traduit: 等我找到那个婊子，我要拧断她的小脖子。

original: Visit me anytime. I'm not going anywhere soon.
traduit: 随时来找我，我哪里都不去。

original: I believe we're done.
traduit: 我想咱们说完了。

original: Out of my way.
traduit: 别挡路。

original: Don't forget to check your supply chest from time to time.
traduit: 别忘了经常检查一下你的储物箱。

original: My experiments can't be completed until you've brought me those ingredients. Do hurry.
traduit: 你不把原料带来我就没法做完实验。请快点。

original: Now was it two parts giant lichen or three? Hm...
traduit: 巨型青苔是分成两部分还是三部分？嗯……

original: You'd do well to remember who's really in charge around here.
traduit: 你最好记住谁才真是这里说了算的。

original: You'd do well to remember who's in charge around here.
traduit: 你最好记住谁是这里说了算的。

original: May you return to Her Benevolence in safety.
traduit: 愿你平安回归她的慈悲。

original: You represent Mara now. Set an example for all.
traduit: 你现在代表玛拉了。请为所有人树立榜样。

original: Good journey, my child!
traduit: 旅途愉快，孩子！

original: I don't know why I bother.
traduit: 真不知道我干嘛要费这个口舌。

original: Try and get those marks without violence please. I don't want to be responsible for their deaths... or yours.
traduit: 拿取标记的时候请尽量不要使用暴力，我不想为他们的死负责……或者为你的死负责。

original: Sure, leave. Not like you care anyway.
traduit: 好吧，离开了。反正你也不在乎。

original: Remain vigilant and don't trust anyone.
traduit: 保持警惕，不要相信任何人。

original: You've been kind, I thank you.
traduit: 你真好，谢谢。

original: Any healing potion will do. Please hurry.
traduit: 任何治疗药水都行。请快点。

original: What am I going to do?
traduit: 我该怎么办？

original: A Dreth never forgets a friend.
traduit: 德莱瑟不会忘记朋友。

original: Remember, keep this to yourself.
traduit: 记住，只你自己知道就行。

original: Please, come back and speak to me anytime.
traduit: 请随时回来找我聊聊。

original: Be cautious, the pilgrimage to the Shrine is not an easy one.
traduit: 小心点，祭坛的朝圣之旅并非易事。

original: I'd ask you maintain civility while you're here.
traduit: 希望你在这里的时候能保持礼貌。

original: Good journey to you.
traduit: 旅途愉快。

original: You're welcome in Riften as long as you continue to obey our laws.
traduit: 只要你继续遵守我们的法律，随时欢迎你来裂谷城。

original: I'm keeping my eye on you.
traduit: 我会盯着你的。

original: I have to remember... ward first, then summon.
traduit: 我得记住……先设结界，再召唤。

original: Okay, now where did I put those spiders?
traduit: 好吧，我把蜘蛛放哪儿了？

original: I see I still have much to learn. Lead on.
traduit: 看来我还有很多东西要学。继续吧。

original: Please be careful, I don't wish to be the reason for your death.
traduit: 请小心，我不想害死你。

original: Just stay away from me and I'll forget we had this discussion.
traduit: 请离我远点，我会忘记我们的讨论的。

original: Watch yourself around here, it isn't safe.
traduit: 小心点，这里不安全。

original: Yes, yes... goodbye.
traduit: 是，是……再见吧。

original: You didn't need to leave so soon.
traduit: 没必要走这么快。

original: Give Vex a kiss for me.
traduit: 替我亲一下小烦吧。

original: Be careful, the road to Shor's Stone could be dangerous.
traduit: 小心，到舒尔之石的路上可能很危险。

original: Don't forget us if you need supplies for your journey.
traduit: 如果旅途需要补给，别忘了我们。

original: Hurry up with it, we've got a merchant in the pit to take care of after we carve this thing up.
traduit: 快点，我们得赶紧把这东西切完，还有个商人在坑里等着我们呢。

original: Gotta have a sharp axe to cut through all that fat...
traduit: 得有把锋利的斧子才能砍开这些肥肉……

original: Let's move out.
traduit: 我们过去吧。

original: We're so dead...
traduit: 我们死定了……

original: We're with you!
traduit: 我们同在！

original: No, Housecarl!
traduit: 不，侍卫！

original: Now we're in for it.
traduit: 我们陷进来了。

original: A dragon?
traduit: 龙？

original: What brings you here?
traduit: 你来干什么？

original: Over the years I've heard things. Powerful magics lost to the ages, incredible spells that only the most skilled mages can master.
traduit: 这些年来，我听说，一些强大魔法遗失于各代，只有最娴熟的法师才能掌握。

original: This is the only thing I've ever found. I think it's better off in your hands.
traduit: 这是我唯一能找到的东西。我觉得还是你来保管比较好。

original: What else is there to be learned about Destruction magic?
traduit: 还有什么毁灭系魔法可学吗？

original: I daresay you've learned all I can teach you.
traduit: 我敢说能教给你的，你都学会了。

original: But... That doesn't mean there isn't more out there.
traduit: 但……这并不意味着没有更多可学了。

original: No! Noooooooo!
traduit: 不！不——

original: The bride has been murdered! Somebody help!
traduit: 新娘被杀了！来人啊！

original: What treachery?
traduit: 这是什么背叛？

original: Aaaaiiiiieeee!
traduit: 啊呃呃呃！

original: Vittoria! No!
traduit: 维托利亚！不！

original: La la la, la la la, la la la, la la la la. La la la, la la la la la laaaaaahhhh...
traduit: 啦啦啦啦啦，啦啦啦，啦啦啦，啦啦啦啦。啦啦啦，啦啦啦啦啦 啦………

original: La la la, do do do do do, dum de dum dum...
traduit: 啦啦啦。嘟嘟嘟嘟嘟，咚得咚咚……
