original: Dum, di di dum, dum di dum, dum di di di di dum da da dum.
traduit: 咚，滴滴咚，咚滴咚，咚滴滴滴滴咚哒哒咚。

original: Ba ba ba, bum ba, ba ba ba, bum ba, ba da da da, dum da da...
traduit: 叭叭叭，咚叭，叭叭叭，咚叭，叭哒哒哒，咚哒哒……

original: I would be fine if they didn't.  Have you seen their eyes? They don't have any! Gross.
traduit: 如果不来还好。你没看见他们的眼睛么？没有眼睛！太恶心了。

original: I hope one comes running up here so I can stab it right in the face.
traduit: 我希望有一只能跑过来，这样我就能一刀捅它脸上。

original: Yeah! It'll teach them to steal from us! One of them took my good helmet.
traduit: 是啊！这会让他们学会怎么偷我们的东西！其中一个拿走了我最好的头盔。

original: The boss is going to cut those creepy cave people to pieces!
traduit: 老大会把那些恶心的穴居人撕成碎片！

original: Something to report?
traduit: 有什么要报告的吗？

original: The General and I have our disagreements, but he's the best hope for both the Empire and Skyrim.
traduit: 将军与我有分歧，但他是帝国和天际的最大希望。

original: Many of my countrymen joined the rebels. They can't see the big picture. Skyrim needs the Empire as much as it needs us.
traduit: 我的许多同胞加入了叛军。他们不懂大局。天际需要帝国，帝国也需要天际。

original: Make it quick. I get enough delays from politicians.
traduit: 有话快说吧。政客已经耽误我们太多时间了。

original: I trust this is something important?
traduit: 有什么重要的事吧？

original: There isn't someone less busy who can help you?
traduit: 难道不能找个不忙的人帮你吗？

original: It's good we hold the Reach. Were the rebels to gain control, the silver mines would give them coin to hire more thugs and expand their violence.
traduit: 控制瑞驰领很好。一旦叛军取得这里的控制权，银矿就会使他们有更多资金雇佣暴徒，进而扩大他们的暴行。

original: It was important we reclaimed the Reach. Letting Ulfric control the flow of silver was a mistake. One I'm glad we've finally corrected.
traduit: 重夺瑞驰领很重要。就不该让乌弗瑞克控制银矿。很高兴能够纠正这一点。

original: We need to stem the flow of silver to the rebellion. Until we retake the Reach, the Stormcloaks will plunder it's mines to fund further violence.
traduit: 我们得阻止银矿流入叛军。在我们重新夺回瑞驰领之前，风暴斗篷会掠夺矿脉，以此为扩大暴行提供更多资金。

original: Hjaalmarch is an important buffer zone between the rebel forces and the capital. Ulfric will try to break through at some point.
traduit: 希雅陲是叛军和首府之间的重要缓冲地带。乌弗瑞克会找机会突破的。

original: Reclaiming Hjaalmarch lets me worry less about the rear guard, and push more men to the front. It was a mistake to let Ulfric control it for so long.
traduit: 收复希雅陲使我不再担心后方，把更多人送往前线。让乌弗瑞克控制这里这么久是个错误。

original: I'm losing my patience with this damn war. We must take Hjaalmarch back! The Stormcloaks will be beating upon the doors of the capital soon.
traduit: 我对这该死的战争失去耐心了。我们必须夺回希雅陲！风暴斗篷很快就会敲响首府的城门。

original: Ulfric will want to take Whiterun from us. But we will hold fast. We can't give the rebellion free reign through the center of Skyrim.
traduit: 乌弗瑞克想从我们手里夺走白漫。但我们会紧紧守住。不能让叛军随意占领天际的中心。

original: I can't believe we lost Whiterun. The rebels have a great advantage in controlling the center now. We must take it back!
traduit: 真不敢相信我们失去了白漫。现在叛军控制了中部地区，获得了很大优势。我们必须把它夺回来。

original: By holding onto Falkreath, we control access to the Reach, Whiterun, and the Rift. Ulfric will try for it soon. We'll be there to stop him.
traduit: 控制了佛克瑞斯，我们就控制了去往白漫领和裂痕领的通道。乌弗瑞克很快就会试着夺走它。我们得阻止他。

original: By taking back Falkreath, we control access to the Reach, Whiterun, and the Rift. We should never have given it up.
traduit: 夺回佛克瑞斯，我们就控制了去往白漫领和裂痕领的通道。我们就不该放弃它。

original: I fear losing Falkreath may give too much advantage to Ulfric. The rebels now control access to the Reach, Whiterun, and the Rift. I want it back.
traduit: 我担心失去佛克瑞斯会给乌弗瑞克带来太多好处。叛军现在控制了通往白漫领和裂痕领的通道。我想把它夺回来。

original: Taking the Pale gives us another port in Dawnstar, and puts us within striking distance of Windhelm. That should make Ulfric a bit more cautious, eh?
traduit: 占领苍原领使我们获得了在晨星城的新港口，还缩短了到风舵城的距离。这会让乌弗瑞克更谨慎的，对吧？

original: Controlling the Pale gives Ulfric a port town and takes the pressure off of Windhelm. But it's only a matter of time before it's back in our hands.
traduit: 控制苍原领给乌弗瑞克增加了一个港口城镇，减轻了风舵城的压力。但我们重新夺回来只是时间问题。

original: Now that we have Winterhold, I can garrison some troops there until I'm ready to march on Windhelm.
traduit: 现在我们有了冬堡，可以在那里驻扎一些部队直到我准备向风舵城进军。

original: There's not much up there, but if we can regain Winterhold, our proximity to Windhelm should keep Ulfric wary and wasting troops garrisoned at home.
traduit: 尽管那里东西不多，但如果我们能夺回冬堡，就能拉近到风舵城的距离，乌弗瑞克会保持警惕并浪费更多部队驻扎在自己家里。

original: I almost can't believe it's over. The rebellion is squashed, Windhelm is free. I must admit, Ulfric put up a stronger fight than I was expecting.
traduit: 真不敢相信一切都结束了。叛乱被镇压，风舵城被解放。我必须承认，乌弗瑞克的反抗比我想的要激烈得多。

original: We will oust Ulfric from Windhelm soon enough. And when we do, I'll have his head on a plate.
traduit: 我们很快就能把乌弗瑞克赶出风舵城。到时候我会把他的脑袋切下来放到盘子里。

original: Taking control of the Rift was a great victory. Ulfric must be rather nervous with us so close to his door step.
traduit: 控制裂痕领是个伟大的胜利。我们离乌弗瑞克如此之近，他肯定很紧张。

original: We need the Rift. We need to regain control of it before we can march on Windhelm without worry about our rear guard.
traduit: 我们需要裂痕领。我们得先夺回它的控制权再向风舵城进军，这样就不用担心我们的后防了。

original: I almost can't believe it. The Empire has been defeated. The world bears witness to the power and righteousness of the sons and daughters of Skyrim.
traduit: 简直不敢相信帝国被打败了。全世界都见证了天际儿女的力量与正义。

original: Soon enough we will march on Solitude. And on that day the heroes of Sovngarde will march with us, and the Empire will fall to its knees in fear.
traduit: 很快我们就会向独孤城进军了。等到那时，松加德的英雄们会与我们同在，帝国将会在恐惧中跪倒在地。

original: Now that the Empire has been driven from the Reach we can put a stop to the raping of her silver mines. That silver belongs in Skyrim.
traduit: 现在帝国已经被赶出瑞驰领了。这些银属于天际母亲，我们阻止了她的银矿被掠夺。

original: The Empire's ravenous hunger for Skyrim's silver makes them fierce. But rest assured, we'll win the Reach and wrest it from their greedy paws.
traduit: 帝国对天际的银子垂涎三尺，企图用它增强实力。但安心，我们一定会从他们贪婪的爪子中把瑞驰领夺回来。

original: Tullius must be getting nervous. Taking Hjaalmarch we're practically in his backyard now. As soon as we're able, we'll march on Solitude.
traduit: 图留斯现在一定很紧张。占领希雅陲的我们就站在他后院里。只要有机会我们就能向独孤城进军了。

original: We should take Hjaalmarch. It'll be an important pressure point on the Imperials. We'd be within spitting distance of the capital.
traduit: 我们应该拿下希雅陲。这将会给帝国很大压力。我们离首府也就更近一步了。

original: The Imperials have really dug into Whiterun. We'll wrest it from them soon enough. We must. Its central position is key.
traduit: 帝国军已经深入到白漫了。我们很快就会从他们那夺回来。我们也必须夺回来。白漫的中心位置至关重要。

original: I'm proud we liberated Falkreath from the Empire. In many ways it's the heart and soul of Skyrim. Not to mention its rather strategic position.
traduit: 很自豪我们能从帝国那里解放佛克瑞斯。从很多方面来看，它都是天际的心脏和灵魂。更不用说战略地位的重要性了。

original: The Empire thinks it holds Falkreath from us. But the souls of Skyrim's bravest are buried there and will fill our hearts and strengthen our blades.
traduit: 帝国以为自己控制着佛克瑞斯。但天际勇士们的灵魂就安葬在那里，它们会充实我们的内心，锐化我们的剑刃。

original: Tullius has camps in the Pale, entertaining thoughts of battle. The Empire still underestimates the force of our cause. It will be their undoing.
traduit: 图留斯在苍原领扎营了。但帝国还在低估我们的力量，这会导致他们的毁灭。

original: I'm glad we've finally restored the Pale. It was extremely foolish giving the Empire control of another port.
traduit: 很高兴终于光复苍原领了。让帝国控制更多港口是很蠢的。

original: I can't believe we let them take the Pale. Losing the port of Dawnstar is lessened only by the threat of Imperial forces being so close to Windhelm.
traduit: 真不敢相信我们让他们拿走了苍原领。失去晨星城的港口让帝国军离风舵城更近了。

original: I'm not sure why Tullius is wasting his time trying to take Winterhold from us. But if he wants to throw his men away, I'll gladly accept that gift.
traduit: 我不知道图留斯为什么要浪费时间去抢冬堡。如果他想抛下他的部下，那我很乐意收下这份礼。

original: I'm glad we've taken back Winterhold. While the Imperials were up there, important resources were tied up stiffening our northern border.
traduit: 很高兴我们能夺回冬堡。帝国军驻扎在那儿的时候，我们重要的资源被用去强化北部边防了。

original: I don't like Imperial troops holed up in Winterhold... such a close march to Windhelm. So I'm sending a campaign up there to take it back.
traduit: 我不喜欢帝国军躲在冬堡……里风舵城太近了。所以要把它夺回来。

original: Damn Tullius. He's pocketed men in the Rift. It's dangerous having Imperials skulking about on the southern border of Eastmarch.
traduit: 该死的图留斯。他把人派到裂痕领了。让帝国军在东陲南部边境鬼鬼祟祟是很危险的。

original: I'm glad we liberated the Rift. It was dangerous having Imperials skulking about on the southern border of Eastmarch.
traduit: 很高兴能解放裂痕领。让帝国军在东陲南部边境鬼鬼祟祟可是很危险的。

original: Losing the Rift gives Tullius easy access to the south of Eastmarch. Talos preserve us. We must take it back!
traduit: 失去了裂痕领让图留斯能轻易进入东陲南部。塔洛斯保佑。我们必须夺回来！

original: I'm promoting you to Quaestor.
traduit: 我要提拔你为财务官。

original: Take this blade, a symbol of your new station and responsibility. I'll keep an eye on your progress. The Empire rewards excellence, and so do I.
traduit: 拿上这把武器，这是你新地位和新责任的象征。我会密切关注你的发展。帝国和我都不吝奖励出色的人。

original: Battles are won by trained and disciplined men. Wars are won by talented and exceptional individuals.
traduit: 战斗的胜利要靠训练有素、军纪严明的士兵。但战争的胜利要靠富有才华的杰出人士。

original: I'm raising you to Praefect. Take this blade, as a gift and symbol of your new rank. You've earned it.
traduit: 我提拔你作为监察官。拿上这把武器吧，这是你新职位的象征，你应得的。

original: You've come a long way. I don't think we could do without you. I'm hereby raising you to Tribune. Congratulations.
traduit: 你历经努力到达这里。我们不能没有你了。我在此提拔你为保民官。恭喜。

original: Here, take this gift as a sign of the Empire's appreciation, and my own.
traduit: 来，收下这份礼物吧，帝国和我个人都很感激你。

original: I have come to rely heavily upon you. It is only fitting that you join the upper echelon. I am hereby elevating you to the rank of Legate.
traduit: 我已经十分倚重你了。你如今当之无愧可入职上层。我在此提拔你为副官。

original: On behalf of the Empire, and myself, please accept this gift along with your new rank.
traduit: 我谨代表帝国和我个人，请接受这份礼物还有你的新军衔。

original: Congratulations.
traduit: 恭喜。

original: However, I'm disappointed to hear that you fled from the field of battle. We do not reward cowardice in the Legion. I expect better of you.
traduit: 但是，听说你从战场上逃跑了。我很失望。军团不会奖励懦夫。我对你期望很高。

original: We'll call you Ice-Veins now, for the thick blood of our land has seeped into your heart.
traduit: 现在我们称你为“冰之血脉”，我们土地的浓浓血液已经融入你的心脏了。

original: Here, take this. It's an Imperial officer's sword. A fitting weapon to use against our enemy.
traduit: 拿着这个。这是一把帝国官员的剑。用来对付敌人很合适。

original: Some brothers have taken to calling you Bone-Breaker, evidence of your ferocity and determination. A fitting name. So we shall all call you thus.
traduit: 有些兄弟已经把你称为“碎骨者”，这证明了你的凶猛和决心。恰如其分。所以我们都这样称呼你。

original: The war demands so much from us, and we give all we have to it and to the people... but I've kept a little something to offer you in appreciation.
traduit: 战争对我们要求很高，我们为人民付出了一切……但我还是留了点东西给你。

original: Please take this on behalf of all the brothers and sisters.
traduit: 请代表全体兄弟姐妹收下这个。

original: And I need capable and loyal warriors close at hand. So I'd like to offer you a home in Windhelm. Speak with my steward who'll make the arrangements.
traduit: 我身边需要你这样忠诚干练的战士。所以我打算让你住在风舵城。跟我的总管谈谈，他会给你安排的。

original: Multitudes of our enemies are buried in an avalanche of pain and retribution delivered by your hands. I shall call you Snow-Hammer now.
traduit: 我们的无数敌人被你亲手埋在雪崩般的痛苦和惩罚中。我现在该叫你雪锤了。

original: You show great passion for battle, and compassion for those we fight for. You are becoming indispensable to our cause.
traduit: 你对战斗有极大热情，且对我们为之战斗的人表示同情。你对我们的事业来说是不可或缺的。

original: We do what we do out of love for our brothers and sisters. Here, take this as a token of such love reciprocated.
traduit: 我们的所作所为都是出于对我们兄弟姐妹的爱。来，把这个作为爱的象征吧。

original: You've become a true hero of Skyrim. I number you among my kin. You shall now be known as Stormblade.
traduit: 你已经成为了天际真正的英雄。我把你看作亲人一样。现在你该被称为“风暴之刃”。

original: The love of the land and her people flows from your heart, even as death to her enemies flows from your hands.
traduit: 你的心中充满了对这片土地和人民的爱，为此你用自己的双手消灭了她的敌人。

original: On behalf of the sons and daughters of Skyrim, on behalf of all that is righteous and true, take this token of our appreciation for your service.
traduit: 我代表天际的儿女们，代表一切正义和真实，向你所做的贡献表示感谢。

original: But I'm disappointed to hear you ran away from the battle. The gods do not reward cowardice. Nor do I. I expect better from you.
traduit: 听说你从战场上跑了，我很失望。神灵不会奖励懦夫。我也不欣赏。希望你能做到更好。

original: We found this in the Jarl's treasury after we captured the city. I thought you should be the one to have it.
traduit: 占领城市之后我们在领主的宝库找到了这个，我觉得该由你拿着。

original: We found this in the Jarl's treasury after we captured the capital. I thought you should be the one to have it.
traduit: 占领首府之后我们在领主的宝库找到了这个，我觉得该由你拿着。

original: Found this among the dead. Something tells me I should give it to you.
traduit: 在死人身上找到这个。我感觉还是应该由你拿着。

original: Here. I want you to have this. Don't ask. Just take it.
traduit: 来。我想把这个给你。别推辞。拿着吧。

original: I've come to rely on you. There's something I want you to have. It was my father's. It would be my honor if you carried it.
traduit: 我开始倚重你了。给你这个。是我父亲的物品。如果你愿意拿着，那将是我的荣幸。

original: Just how long did you expect me to keep those people distracted? I had to let the whole plan fall through.
traduit: 你要我吸引那些人注意多久？我只能让整个计划落空了。

original: Well, at least you didn't do anything stupid. Next time, when you're given a job, don't wander off or take your sweet time.
traduit: 不过至少你没做什么蠢事。下次记得，得到一份差事的时候，不要闲逛或者发呆。

original: I guess I shouldn't be surprised. Nothing around here has been going well lately.
traduit: 我想我也没感到惊讶。最近是诸事不顺啊。

original: Are you daft? This isn't the Dark Brotherhood! We don't go around murdering anyone, ever. It just isn't how things are done.
traduit: 你傻吗？这不是黑暗兄弟会的勾当！我们不会到处杀人，永远不会。我们不是这样办事的。

original: I guess I expected too much from you.
traduit: 我可能对你的期望太高了。

original: Looks like I chose the right person for the job.
traduit: 看来我选对人了。

original: Now look what you've gotten yourself into. No worries. Just sit tight. I'll find the release.
traduit: 看看你惹上什么麻烦了。别担心。老实待着。我很快就会找到开关的。

original: She's dead! On my watch! This won't stand!
traduit: 她死了！在我的注视下！这不能忍！

original: I'm just here to provide protection for his eminence's cousin. Please, enjoy yourself.
traduit: 我只是来保护皇帝的表妹。请自便。

original: Having a good time?
traduit: 玩得开心吗？

original: Oh my, yes. I absolutely love weddings. I haven't found my special someone yet, but there's still hope. Vittoria is, well, getting up in years...
traduit: 哦，是的。我非常喜欢婚礼。我还没遇到自己的命中注定，但还是有希望的。维托利亚已经找到了，哎，我年纪也越来越大了……

original: Am I! Free food and wine, and nobody trying to throw me in the dungeon. I wish they did weddings here every day.
traduit: 当然！吃的喝的随便拿，还没有人会把我扔进地牢。真希望他们每天都在这里办婚礼。

original: Not really. It's just a bunch of elders standing around, looking important. I wish something exciting would happen.
traduit: 不太开心。一群大人站在那里，煞有介事的。我希望能发生些更刺激的事。

original: Oh. Why... why certainly. I keep telling myself I'm not losing a son, I'm gaining an Imperial. Daughter. An Imperial daughter...
traduit: 哦。当……当然了。我一直告诉自己，我不是失去了儿子，而是多了个帝国的，女儿。一个帝国人女儿……

original: No, I'm not having a good time. My boy just married a gods-forsaken Imperial. Skyrim is full of eager Nord women, and he beds down with the enemy.
traduit: 不。我一点也不开心。我儿子刚刚娶了一个抛弃了神明的帝国人。天际有的是诺德好姑娘，他却想和敌人同床共枕。

original: The best. Vittoria's a good woman. Any man should be so lucky. I know my father's not happy about me marrying an Imperial, but that's his problem.
traduit: 很不错。维托利亚是个好女人。娶到她是种幸运。我知道父亲不愿意我娶一个帝国人，但那是他的毛病。

original: Congratulations. Quite the day, hmm?
traduit: 恭喜恭喜。今天很不错吧？

original: I most certainly am not. I've just lost my daughter to a Nord beast, and my nephew Titus is too busy playing Emperor to even show up.
traduit: 我肯定没有。我女儿被一只诺德野兽夺走了，而我外甥提图斯忙着当皇帝，连面都没时间露。

original: I am, thank you. I do so enjoy singing at weddings. It's just one of the many duties we at the Bards College are called upon to perform.
traduit: 是的，谢谢。我很喜欢在婚礼上歌唱。这只是我们吟游诗人学院的众多职责之一。

original: So far. I just hope things remain calm. Wine gets drunk, tempers flare. This may be a joyous celebration, but it's shadowed by a lot of animosity.
traduit: 到目前还行吧。我只希望事情能平静。酒喝多了，脾气就大。这场庆典虽然欢乐，但却被很多敌意笼罩了。

original: Oh, yes. Presiding over the union of two lovers is one of my greatest responsibilities. It helps that Asgeir and Vittoria truly care for each other.
traduit: 哦，是的。能主持两个彼此相爱者的结合是我最大的职责之一。艾斯盖尔和维托利亚彼此相爱，这很好。

original: I always leave room for the main course, Eola.
traduit: 我总会给主菜留肚子的，爱欧拉。

original: Not too full on bread and wine, I hope?
traduit: 没被面包和酒撑坏吧？

original: Thank you, Lisbet. It's been such a joy to dine with you all these years.
traduit: 多谢夸奖，利斯拜特。这些年和你一起用餐很开心。

original: This is lovely, as always, Eola.
traduit: 爱欧拉，这里的宴会一如既往美味。

original: I never miss a good meal.
traduit: 我从不错过任何美食。

original: Thank you for coming to dinner, Hogni.
traduit: 欢迎来享用晚餐，霍尼。

original: I always preferred the liver myself. My brother had such a juicy liver.
traduit: 我爱吃肝。我哥的肝就不错。

original: The toes are my favorite part. I hope I get to take a few home with me.
traduit: 我最喜欢吃脚趾。希望能打包带回去些。

original: Either way, I came back with meat for the table.
traduit: 不管怎样，我都带着肉回去了。

original: That must have been quite a surprise.
traduit: 你一定很惊讶吧。

original: My friend Marex. We were hunting, and I thought he was an elk.
traduit: 那就是我朋友玛莱克斯。我们打猎的时候，我把他当成了麋鹿。

original: Of course they don't count!
traduit: 狗当然不算！

original: Do dogs count?
traduit: 吃狗算吗？

original: When was your first meal, Banning?
traduit: 班宁，你第一顿饭是什么时候？

original: I'm just glad we had this, now. I was almost getting ready to eat my servant and blame it on the Forsworn.
traduit: 很高兴我们现在又聚在一起了。我差点就准备吃掉我的仆人然后栽赃给弃誓者了。

original: Eola is a fine host. She really keeps the faithful together.
traduit: 爱欧拉主持得不错。她把信徒们团结了起来。

original: It's so good to have everyone around the table again.
traduit: 大家又能聚在一起真好。

original: You were at Namira's feast, weren't you?
traduit: 你参加了娜米拉的盛宴，是不是？

original: Shh. You mustn't speak about such things away from the shrine. Only you and your dinner guests can know.
traduit: 嘘。不要再远离祭坛的地方谈这些事。只有你和晚宴客人才知道。

original: Better if we don't talk about that. As far as anyone's concerned, we all had dinner at a nice inn along the road, and nothing strange happened.
traduit: 我们还是不要谈。对其他人来说，我们只是在路边一家不错的小酒馆吃了顿饭，什么奇怪的事也没有。

original: Don't go talking about that. Only the dinner guests can know.
traduit: 别再提这件事了。只有晚宴客人才能知道。

original: Wait. I know you.
traduit: 等等，我认识你。

original: Ah, yes. The courier. I guess you know my secret ingredient for that spiced beef, now.
traduit: 啊，没错。你帮忙送过东西。现在知道香料牛肉的秘密食材了吧。

original: You buy a war dog from me? There's a reason why my hounds are so eager to bite into people.
traduit: 你从我这儿买过战犬吧？我的猎犬这么爱咬人是有原因的。

original: That's right. You're the sellsword. Thank you again. It's so nice to have help with my husband gone. Shame what happened to him.
traduit: 没错。你是那个佣兵吧。感谢你。我丈夫死了，有人帮忙真好。他的事真遗憾。

original: One of my customers? Did you know I inherited the store from my late husband? Shame what happened to him. He had such good taste.
traduit: 来过我的店？你知道我是怎么从亡夫那里继承的店吗？他的遭遇很遗憾，但尝起来很美味。

original: "The bloodiest beef in the Reach!" Ha ha ha.
traduit: “瑞驰领最新鲜的牛肉！”哈哈哈。

original: Praise to you, champion!
traduit: 赞美你，勇士！

original: Ah, the new disciple. I hear you have quite the appetite.
traduit: 啊，新人。我听说你胃口不错。

original: It's an honor, Keeper of the Ring.
traduit: 见到你是我的荣幸。戒指的守护者。

original: You've brought us quite the meal.
traduit: 你给我们带来了丰盛的一餐。

original: You were given Namira's ring? A great honor.
traduit: 娜米拉把戒指给了你？何等荣耀。

original: I remember my first feast. I envy you.
traduit: 我还记得我第一餐时的事。真羡慕你。

original: I'm so glad Eola invited you to dinner.
traduit: 爱欧拉把你邀来真好。

original: Namira spoke to you? I knew this feast was going to be something.
traduit: 娜米拉跟你交谈了？我就知道这次盛宴会很精彩。

original: Now this is going to be a good feast.
traduit: 这将是一场盛宴。

original: You there. Are you here to kill me? Slay the mighty Logrolf while he sits tied and helpless?
traduit: 喂。你是过来杀我的？在强大的罗格洛夫被捆缚起来的时候杀了他吗？

original: I was actually just about to head on inside. Be good to have someone watch my back.
traduit: 我正准备进去。如果有人帮忙那就更好了。

original: Follow me, and keep your eyes open. Daedra are powerful creatures and tricksters. Never know what you'll find.
traduit: 跟我来，保持警惕。迪德拉是强大的生物和骗子。你永远不知道会发现什么。

original: No, I haven't.
traduit: 不，我没见过。

original: Seems no one in this city has.
traduit: 看起来全城人都不知道。

original: Excuse me, but do you know anything about this house? Seen anyone enter or leave?
traduit: 打扰一下，你了解这栋房子吗？有没有看见谁进出？

original: It's abandoned and it's always been abandoned.
traduit: 它被遗弃了，一直以来都是这样。

original: I can't afford that right now.
traduit: 我现在买不起。

original: On second thought, maybe I'll wait a bit longer to decide.
traduit: 想了想，我还是过段时间再做决定吧。

original: On second thought, perhaps I'll wait a bit longer to decide.
traduit: 想了想，我还是过会儿再做决定吧。

original: I would like to purchase a house in the city. (<Global=HPWindhelm> gold)
traduit: 我想在城里买套房。（<Global=HPWindhelm>金币）

original: There is an empty home in the city, but there was some... unpleasantness recently. I'm afraid it's not available just yet.
traduit: 城里有套空房，就是最近闹了些……不愉快。恐怕现在还没打理好。

original: I'd like to purchase a house in the city. (<Global=HPMarkarth> gold)
traduit: 我想在城里买房。（<Global=HPMarkarth>金币）

original: I'd like to purchase a house in the city. (<Global=HPRiften> gold)
traduit: 我想在城里买套房。（<Global=HPRiften>金币）

original: I'd like to purchase a house in the city. (<Global=HPWhiterun> gold)
traduit: 我想在城里买套房。（<Global=HPWhiterun>金币）

original: I'll buy everything you've dug up.
traduit: 你挖出来的我都要了。

original: I have ore to sell.
traduit: 我有矿石要出售。

original: I have corundum ore to sell.
traduit: 我有刚玉矿石要出售。

original: I have ebony ore to sell.
traduit: 我有黑檀矿石要出售。

original: I have gold ore to sell.
traduit: 我有金矿石要出售。

original: I have iron ore to sell.
traduit: 我有铁矿石要出售。

original: I have malachite ore to sell.
traduit: 我有孔雀石矿石要出售。

original: I have moonstone ore to sell.
traduit: 我有月石矿石要出售。

original: I have orichalcum ore to sell.
traduit: 我有山铜矿石要出售。

original: I have quicksilver ore to sell.
traduit: 我有水银矿石要出售。

original: I have silver ore to sell.
traduit: 我有银矿石要出售。

original: Mining is hard work, but we pay a fair price for any ore you dig up.
traduit: 采矿是个辛苦活，但你挖出的所有矿石我们都会给公道价的。

original: Are you looking to work? The mines are nearby. You bring me ore, I'll give you coin.
traduit: 在找工作吗？矿场就在附近。你给我矿石，我给你金币。

original: I have wheat to sell.
traduit: 我有小麦要出售。

original: We could always use help picking crops if you need a few extra coins.
traduit: 如果你想赚些外快，我们可以雇你帮忙收庄稼。

original: Well. You must have all those annoying gods on your side to have made it this far, whoever you are. Even I have to admit, that's pretty impressive.
traduit: 好吧。不管你是谁，能走到这一步肯定有一群烦人的神明大人保佑吧。连我都得承认，真是太厉害了。

original: You had your chance to talk!
traduit: 给你个说话的机会！

original: What is this? Have I been poisoned?
traduit: 这是什么？我中毒了？

original: In a sense, but no more poisoned than a fool after too much wine.
traduit: 算是吧，不过不会比喝酒喝高了的笨蛋中毒深。

original: I have watched you for some time, you know. The decisions you've made intrigue me, and I wonder if you are the proper agent for a task of mine.
traduit: 我观察你有一段时间了。你所做的决定引起了我的兴趣，我想知道你是否适合执行我的任务。

original: Breathe deep, mortal. I would have you hear me well, so let these vapors fill your lungs.
traduit: 深呼吸，凡人。希望你能真切地聆听到我的声音，让这些水汽充满你的肺。

original: You're going to make me a werewolf?
traduit: 你要把我变成狼人？

original: Oh, no. Only the Circle have the beastblood. Prove your honor to be a Companion.
traduit: 哦，不是。只有圆环才拥有野兽之血。此行是为了证明你的荣誉，成为真正的战友。

original: "Eyes on the prey, not the horizon."
traduit: “眼睛盯紧猎物，不要好高骛远。”

original: No, only members of the Circle get this blessing. Right now we're just seeing if you're worth keeping around.
traduit: 不，只有圆环成员才能获得祝福。我们现在只是想看你是否有留下的价值。

original: What was that?
traduit: 那是什么？

original: It's a blessing given to some of us. We can be like wild beasts. Fearsome.
traduit: 这是赐予我们的祝福。我们可以如野兽一般令人畏惧。

original: Come on now, you're a sharp one. You must have heard of werewolves before.
traduit: 别这样，你挺机灵的啊。以前肯定听说过狼人吧。

original: It's a blessing given to the most honored of the Companions.
traduit: 这是给最荣耀的战友团成员的祝福。

original: I'm... I'm sorry you had to see that.
traduit: 我……很抱歉让你看到了。

original: I hope I didn't scare you.
traduit: 希望没有吓到你。

original: The answer ain't gonna be any different the next time. Arrogant elven bastard.
traduit: 下次的答案也一样。你们这群自大的混蛋精灵。

original: Your lack of cooperation has been noted. We'll be back if we require further information. You won't get a second chance.
traduit: 我们已经知道了你的不合作态度。需要更多消息的时候，我们会再来。你不会再有机会了。

original: You'd better clear out before someone gets hurt.
traduit: 你最好在我们伤到你前出来。

original: No. Not yet.
traduit: 不。不行。

original: You're in the wrong place to be asking those kind of questions, pal.
traduit: 伙计，你问错人了。

original: Where is he? The one who was asking about the fugitive hiding in the Ratway?
traduit: 刚才有人问逃犯下落？他在哪里？

original: Let's go
traduit: 我们走。

original: Fine, but I've locked the door so don't think you're getting in there without me.
traduit: 好吧，但我把门锁上了，别以为没我你也能进去。

original: No offense, I mean I'm sure you aren't into any of that kind of stuff.
traduit: 无意冒犯，我是说我很确定你不喜欢那些东西。

original: My aunt went in after him, but she hasn't come out yet and I'm afraid to go in by myself.
traduit: 我姑姑跟在他后面进去了，但还没有出来，我又不敢一个人进去。

original: My aunt went in after him, but she hasn't come out yet and I don't think I can take him by myself.
traduit: 我姑姑跟在他后面进去了，但还没有出来，我想我一个人可能搞不定他。

original: Who's in the tomb?
traduit: 谁在坟墓里？

original: Vals Veran. My family has never really seen eye to eye with him and he has finally gone off the deep end.
traduit: 瓦尔斯·威冉。我的家族和他一直不对付，他终于还是失控了。

original: He's gone in to defile our family tomb by using our ancestors for his filthy dark elf necromancy.
traduit: 他要用他那肮脏的暗精灵死灵法术来利用我们的祖先亵渎我家族的坟墓。

original: Can you help me? He's in the tomb doing Gods know what with my dead relatives.
traduit: 你能帮帮我吗？他在坟墓里对我死去的亲人做着神才知道的事。

original: I'd like to purchase a house in the city. (<Global=HPSolitude> gold)
traduit: 我想在城里买房。（<Global=HPSolitude>金币）

original: It will keep it's hands to itself, yes?
traduit: 把手放老实点，好吗？

original: Umm... are you in trouble? Is that why you're hiding like that?
traduit: 嗯……你遇到麻烦了吗？所以才要躲起来？

original: I hope you're not planning on picking my pocket.
traduit: 希望你不是打算扒我的口袋。

original: What? Why are you skulking about like that?
traduit: 怎么了？为什么这么鬼鬼祟祟的？

original: Look at you, up to no good.
traduit: 看看你，准是没安好心。

original: You remind me of the Shadowscales, from the old histories.
traduit: 你让我想起了古时候的影鳞。

original: Are you playing hide and seek?
traduit: 你在玩捉迷藏吗？

original: I trust you aren't considering any... thievery.
traduit: 相信你不是在琢磨着怎么……偷窃吧。

original: You're not a thief trying to rob me, right?
traduit: 你不会是想要抢劫我，对吧？

original: You trying to hide? 'Cause I can see you plain as day.
traduit: 你想藏起来？可我能清楚的看到你。

original: You're a bad sneak. You're not creeping up on anybody like that.
traduit: 你潜行的手段真差劲。这样接近不了任何人。

original: You, my friend, need practice...
traduit: 朋友，再多练练吧……

original: Are you a member of the College, or did you just steal those robes from a real wizard?
traduit: 你是学院成员吗？还是从真正的巫师那儿偷了件袍子？

original: You must be one of those wizards. From the College in Winterhold.
traduit: 你肯定是来自冬堡学院的巫师之一吧。

original: Wow! Look at that robe. Are you a wizard?
traduit: 喔！看看这袍子。你是巫师吗？

original: Those are College of Winterhold robes, aren't they?
traduit: 那是冬堡学院的袍子吧？

original: Fancy robes. You a wizard or somethin'?
traduit: 华丽的长袍。你是巫师还是什么？

original: I like your robes. Are you a sorcerer? From the College?
traduit: 我喜欢你的长袍。你是术士吗？从学院来的？

original: dunRannveigQSTLOSTTOCOMBAT
traduit: dunRannveigQSTLOSTTOCOMBAT

original: dunRannveigQSTBLEEDOUT
traduit: dunRannveigQSTBLEEDOUT

original: dunRannveigQSTSHARED01
traduit: dunRannveigQSTSHARED01

original: I'm sorry! This isn't what I want!
traduit: 抱歉！这不是我想要的！

original: I don't want to do this!
traduit: 我不想这么做！

original: I don't have any choice! I'm sorry!
traduit: 我没有选择！抱歉！

original: Is someone there? Stay back! I don't want to attack you.
traduit: 有人吗？停下！我不想伤害你。

original: Stay away!
traduit: 躲远点！

original: Stay back or I'll be forced to attack you!
traduit: 躲远点，不然我就会被迫伤害你！

original: No matter. Another one will be along any time now.
traduit: 没关系。下一个随时都会来。

original: Well...that's disappointing. This one didn't survive the fall either.
traduit: 哎……令人失望。这个也没能活下来。

original: I'll meet you at Karthspire.
traduit: 我们卡斯尖峰见。

original: Very good. I'll trust you to get there in one piece. Don't be long.
traduit: 很好。我相信你能平安到达。别耽搁太久。

original: Your call. Might be safer to travel separately - attract less attention that way.
traduit: 随你决定。分开走可能安全些，可以尽量避免注意。

original: Don't worry, I'll get Esbern there in one piece. We'll wait for you near Karthspire. Good luck.
traduit: 别担心，我会把伊思本完好无损地送到那里。卡斯尖峰附近会合。保重。

original: How do we find the entrance to Sky Haven Temple?
traduit: 我们怎么才能找到天佑神殿入口？

original: The Akaviri blood seal can only be opened with the right kind of blood. Your blood, Dragonborn.
traduit: 阿卡维尔的血封印只能用对应的血才能打开。龙裔，要用你的血。

original: We should be careful. There's no telling what traps and wards the ancient Blades may have set.
traduit: 我们要小心。没人知道古代刀锋在里面设置了什么陷阱和守卫。

original: The entrance must be past the Forsworn camp. Look for a canyon or cave entrance into the Karthspire.
traduit: 要到达入口必须穿过弃誓者营地。找个峡谷或者洞穴进入卡斯尖峰。

original: Ah, yes. The entrance seems to be near what's now known as the Karthspire. We'll have to see what we find when we arrive.
traduit: 啊，对。入口似乎在卡斯尖峰附近。看看我们到了之后能找到什么。

original: How do we get to Sky Haven Temple?
traduit: 我们怎么去天佑神殿？

original: I met your brother.
traduit: 我见过你兄弟。

original: Maul? Yeah. That jerk works for Maven Black-Briar now. Left me down here watching this garbage heap.
traduit: 摩尔？啊。那个混蛋现在替玛雯·黑棘办事了。把我留在这里看垃圾。

original: I guess he's better at all that talking stuff anyway. I'd just mess everything up.
traduit: 我猜是因为他更擅长交谈，而我只擅长破坏一切吧。

original: Forget I mentioned it.
traduit: 就当我没说吧。

original: Already did.
traduit: 我已经忘了。

original: I think it's hilarious. You got a problem? (Intimidate)
traduit: 我觉得很好笑。有问题？（恐吓）

original: No, no. Sorry if I sounded so mean there. My brother always said I have a big mouth.
traduit: 没有，没有。抱歉，我刚才太刻薄了。我兄弟总是说我多嘴。

original: Here, have one on me.
traduit: 给，这个算我的。

original: Yeah, my problem is I'm too tired to punch your face in.
traduit: 是啊，我的问题就是我累了，没力气揍你的脸。

original: No way. That name would scare anyone. (Persuade)
traduit: 不可能。这名字吓不住人。（说服）

original: Oh yeah? I think so too. You're pretty smart.
traduit: 哦，是吗？我也这么认为。你很聪明。

original: Hey, here. Have one on the house.
traduit: 嘿，给你。这个算我账上。

original: Good. Now shut up and get out of my face.
traduit: 好。现在闭嘴，赶紧从我面前消失。

original: Why do they call you Dirge?
traduit: 他们为什么叫你“挽歌”？

original: They call me Dirge, 'cause I'm the last thing you hear before they put you in the ground.
traduit: 他们叫我挽歌，因为我是他们把你送入土之前听到的最后一句话。

original: Why? You think it's funny or something?
traduit: 怎么？你觉得好笑吗？

original: What, you still think it's funny?
traduit: 怎么，你还是觉得很好笑？

original: About your name...
traduit: 关于你的名字……

original: I already told you. They call me Dirge, 'cause I'm the last thing you hear before they put you in the ground.
traduit: 我已经告诉过你了。他们叫我挽歌，因为我是他们把你送入土之前听到的最后一句话。

original: Remind me, why do they call you Dirge?
traduit: 再跟我说说，他们为什么叫你“挽歌”？

original: Any news involving the Dark Brotherhood?
traduit: 有关于黑暗兄弟会的消息吗？

original: The only thing I heard is a rumor that a boy named Aventus Aretino, in Windhelm, has been attempting to contact the Dark Brotherhood.
traduit: 我听说过一个传言，有个住在风舵城叫阿文图斯·艾瑞提诺的小孩儿，一直在试图联系黑暗兄弟会。

original: He used to live here in Riften at the Orphanage on the other side of town but I think he ran away. Can't say I blame him.
traduit: 他以前在裂谷城另一头的孤儿院住过，估计是逃走了。这也不能怪他。

original: Old Nord sacrifice place. Be careful around here. Let's look for a way to open the bars.
traduit: 古诺德的献祭之地。在这里小心点。看看有没有打开闸门的办法。

original: Ah, the ceremonial juncture. The old Nords used to do sacrifices here. Look around for a way to open those bars.
traduit: 啊，仪式地点。古诺德人用来献祭的地方。看看有没有打开闸门的办法。

original: It comforts me to know that, Bolgeir.
traduit: 能知道这点让我很欣慰，波盖尔。

original: No disrespect toward the general, but sometimes I wonder if he's got your best interests at heart.
traduit: 我无意冒犯将军，但有时我还是怀疑他是否真心为您着想。

original: In any case he won't be turnin' me into no Imperial soldier. I know my place, and it's at your side.
traduit: 无论如何，他都别想把我变成帝国士兵。我明白我的值守就是在您身边。

original: I'm aware of that, Bolgeir, and I appreciate your dedication.
traduit: 我明白，波盖尔。我很欣赏你的奉献精神。

original: However, if we lose the war, the guardsmen of Solitude will make little difference in the end.
traduit: 无论如何，如果我们输了这场战争，独孤城卫兵多寡也无济于事。

original: Told you that, did he?
traduit: 他告诉你的吗？

original: I'm sworn to protect you, my Jarl, but I'm the last line of defense.
traduit: 我发誓要保护你，领主大人，但我只是最后的防线。

original: The first line is the walls around this city and the men who patrol them.
traduit: 第一道防线是围绕这座城的城墙和墙上的巡逻卫兵。

original: Men who, I might add, we're precious short on.
traduit: 我必须得补充一句，我们现在急缺这样的人。

original: Yes, I know. The general acted with my blessing.
traduit: 我知道。将军的行动得到了我的同意。

original: It is vital that we bring Ulfric to justice, but that cannot happen until his army of Stormcloaks is defeated utterly.
traduit: 我们必须把乌弗瑞克绳之以法，但在他的风暴斗篷军备彻底击败前，是不可能的。

original: We lost another five guardsmen, my Jarl.
traduit: 我们又折损了五名卫兵，领主大人。

original: If General Tullius continues to conscript our men and send them off to battle, we'll have none left to protect the city.
traduit: 如果图留斯将军继续征召我们的人去打仗，我们就没人能保卫城市了。

original: Oh, very well. I can see there's no changing your stubborn Nord minds.
traduit: 哦，很好。看来是改变不了你顽固的诺德想法了。

original: But when this war is won, I will have my parade!
traduit: 但等战争结束，我一定要举行自己的阅兵！

original: I must protest, my Jarl.
traduit: 我必须抗议，领主大人。

original: A parade would make you an easy target for a Stormcloak assassin. You're safer here in the palace.
traduit: 阅兵会使您轻易成为风暴斗篷刺客的目标。您待在宫殿中会更安全。

original: What a... fine idea, my Jarl. However, I would suggest we wait until the war has ended.
traduit: 真是个……好主意，领主大人。然而我还是建议咱们等到战争结束。

original: After all, the General needs his soldiers out in the field, fighting battles against the Stormcloaks.
traduit: 毕竟，将军需要将士们在战场上和风暴斗篷作战。

original: Steward, I have an idea that might help to bolster the morale of our people in this difficult time.
traduit: 总管，我有个办法也许能在这个困难时期鼓舞士气。

original: I think we shall have a grand parade, and let General Tullius march his troops from the Blue Palace to Castle Dour in all their finery.
traduit: 我想我们应该举行一次盛大的阅兵，让图留斯将军把军队盛装打扮起来从蓝宫行军到阴郁堡。

original: I will make the arrangements, my Jarl.
traduit: 我会安排的，领主大人。

original: There's no need for an apology, and you're right about the war.
traduit: 没必要道歉，你关于战争的看法是正确的。

original: Perhaps this is a matter best discussed with with the general in person.
traduit: 也许我最好亲自和将军讨论这个问题。

original: My apologies, Jarl Elisif. I was thinking only of the importance of the war effort.
traduit: 抱歉，艾利西弗领主。我想的只是战争的重要性。

original: General Tullius does not run this city, Thane Erikur. Or have you forgotten your oaths of fealty?
traduit: 图留斯将军无权管理这座城市，艾瑞库尔武卫。还是说你忘了你的效忠誓言了？

original: General Tullius will never allow that. He's ordered all surplus food to be given over for the war effort.
traduit: 图留斯将军是不会允许的。他已经下令把所有剩余的食物都用于战争了。

original: A wise course of action, my Jarl. However, we have little food or water to spare.
traduit: 明智之举，领主。然而我们几乎没有富裕的食物和水了。

original: Steward Falk, I have a task for you.
traduit: 佛可总管，我有个任务交给你。

original: I want to begin stockpiling food and water in the event we come under siege, and I would like you to oversee this work personally.
traduit: 我打算储存食物和水，以防被围困，希望你能亲自监督这项工作。

original: Stop it, both of you. You're acting like children.
traduit: 你俩都停吧。像个小孩子似的。

original: I should very much like to see you try it, my dear steward.
traduit: 我很想看你尝尝它，亲爱的总管。

original: Hold your tongue, Wizard, or you're likely to lose it.
traduit: 管好你的舌头吧，巫师。否则你就该失去它了。

original: Oh, I'm sorry, did I imply that you'd be meeting for purposes other than court business? You must forgive me.
traduit: 哦，不好意思，我是不是在暗示你们的会面不是为了宫廷事务啦？请一定要原谅我哦。

original: Oh, well done. Very subtle.
traduit: 哦，很好。非常妙。

original: Is it that time again already?
traduit: 又到这时候了吗？

original: Very well, let's meet this evening and make the arrangements.
traduit: 很好，我们今晚见面做安排吧。

original: It's nearly time to collect taxes on your properties here in the city, Bryling.
traduit: 是时候对你在城里的财产征税了，白灵。

original: We'll need to visit each home for an assessment.
traduit: 我们要去每家做评估。

original: Have faith, Bryling. When this war is over and Ulfric is dead, you'll see that you were jumping at shadows, and nothing more.
traduit: 要有信心，白灵。等战争结束，乌弗瑞克死掉，你就会发现你只是在阴影中跳来跳去，仅此而已。

original: Yes, of course, but Ulfric's message is a powerful one. More of our people flock to his cause every day.
traduit: 是的，当然。但乌弗瑞克的宣言很有力。我们每天都有更多的民众支持他的事业。

original: We don't have the luxury of hanging back to see who wins before choosing our friends, Bryling. You know this.
traduit: 我们没时间在选择盟友前观望胜败，白灵，你应该明白。

original: And besides, no Nord with a shred of honor would consider it. We're no cowards.
traduit: 再说，每个拥有一丝荣誉感的诺德人都不会考虑这些。我们可不是懦夫。

original: You know that I support the Empire, as we all do. However, I fear General Tullius is underestimating the Stormcloaks.
traduit: 你应该知道我们大家都支持着帝国。但我担心图留斯将军低估了风暴斗篷。

original: Too often the general has lost good soldiers because he did not take Ulfric and his men seriously.
traduit: 将军频频失去优秀的士兵，就是因为他没有正视乌弗瑞克和他的士兵。

original: If this continues, and the worst comes to pass, Solitude will pay the price. The Empire is headquartered here, after all.
traduit: 如果这种情况再持续下去，一旦最坏情况发生，独孤城可能会付出代价。毕竟帝国的总部就设置在这里。

original: Speak your mind, Bryling. You're among friends here.
traduit: 说出你的想法吧，白灵。在这里都是你的朋友。

original: There's something that's been troubling me, Falk. I am hesitant to share it, but I feel that I must.
traduit: 佛可，有件事一直困扰着我。我不太愿意说，但觉得还是必须说出来。

original: The Jarl would be wise to remember that it is her thanes - and my profits - that are paying for this war.
traduit: 领主最好记得，是她的武卫们还有我的利益在为这场战争买单。

original: We know full well about your investment in shipping ventures, Erikur.
traduit: 我们很了解你在船运上的投资，艾瑞库尔。

original: I've also heard troubling rumors about dealings between you and the crew of that pirate ship, the Red Wave.
traduit: 我还听说你和赤红波浪号那艘海盗船船员之间交易的不安谣言。

original: Thankfully, Jarl Elisif cares far less about your lost profits than she does about winning the war!
traduit: 所幸艾利西弗领主并不在乎你损失的利润。她更在乎战争的胜败！

original: Then let's increase the taxes on the farms and merchants. We can't afford to lose the loyalty of the ship captains.
traduit: 那我们还是增加农场和商人的税收吧。我们不能失去船长们的忠诚。

original: General Tullius needs more money for the war effort. We need the funds to arm and provision more troops.
traduit: 图留斯将军需要更多资金投入战争。我们需要更多资金来武装更多士兵。

original: I've heard the Empire plans to levy a tax on our trading ships. Falk, you've got to do something about this.
traduit: 我听说帝国计划对我们的商船征税。佛可，你得做些什么。

original: If you really are Dragonborn, like out of the old tales, you ought to be able to Shout. Can you? Have you tried?
traduit: 如果你真是传说中的龙裔，你应该会龙吼的。你有试过吗？

original: Go ahead... try to Shout.
traduit: 来……试试龙吼。

original: Have you tried to Shout?
traduit: 你没试过龙吼吗？

original: They say the Dragonborn can Shout without any training. Like Talos himself...
traduit: 传闻龙裔不需要任何训练就能使用龙吼。就像塔洛斯那样……

original: Here's a dead dragon, and that's something I definitely understand. Now we know we can kill them.
traduit: 我只知道，这是头死龙，我们现在有能力杀它们。

original: That was Shouting, what you just did! Must be. You really are Dragonborn, then...
traduit: 那是龙吼，你刚才干了什么！也许……你真是龙裔啊……

original: But I don't need some mythical Dragonborn. Someone who can put down a dragon is more than enough for me.
traduit: 我不需要什么神话里的龙裔。对我来说，能放倒一头龙的人就足够了。

original: Hmph. Some of you would be better off keeping quiet than flapping your gums on matters you don't know anything about.
traduit: 嘁。你们最好安静点，不要在自己不清楚的事上胡言乱语。

original: Come on, Irileth, tell us, do you believe in this Dragonborn business?
traduit: 来吧，伊瑞莱斯，你来说说，你相信龙裔的事情吗？

original: What do you say, Irileth? You're being awfully quiet.
traduit: 伊瑞莱斯，你怎么看？你怎么这么安静？

original: Those born with the Dragon Blood in 'em. Like old Tiber Septim himself.
traduit: 那些生而具有龙血的人。就像古代的泰伯·塞普汀一样。

original: Thash grape!
traduit: 辣似葡萄！

original: You know, you're a fun person to drink with. I know this great little place where the wine flows like water. We should head there.
traduit: 知道吗，和你喝酒很有趣。我知道有个很棒的小地方，那里酒如泉涌。我们应该去那儿接着喝。

original: Hey, you don't look so good...
traduit: 嘿，你看上去不妙啊……

original: One more. No Problemsh.
traduit: 再来。没问迪。

original: Wow. You've really done it. The staff is yours.
traduit: 喔。你很能喝啊。法杖归你了。

original: I'm done now.
traduit: 我喝完了。

original: Awww, well, maybe next time.
traduit: 哦哦，好，那下次再喝。

original: A second drink. Easy enough.
traduit: 第二杯。小意思。

original: So says you. I think I've hit my limit on these things. Tell you what, one more and you win the contest.
traduit: 说得好。我看我快喝不下了。这样吧，再来一杯你就赢了。

original: And how about you?
traduit: 你怎么样？

original: And another one for me.
traduit: 再给我来一杯。

original: This was a bad idea.
traduit: 这不是什么好主意。

original: Here we go.
traduit: 我们走。

original: One down, my friend. One down.
traduit: 一口闷，朋友。一口闷。

original: Your turn!
traduit: 到你了！

original: I'll start round one. Down the hatch!
traduit: 我先开始。干杯！

original: I don't really feel like drinking...
traduit: 我真不想喝酒……

original: Well come back when you do, my friend. Come back when you do.
traduit: 等你想喝了再来，朋友。想喝随时来。

original: A drinking contest? You don't stand a chance!
traduit: 比酒量？你赢不了我！

original: Ha! We'll see about that. This is a special brew, very strong stuff. Let's get started.
traduit: 哈！我们走着瞧吧。这可是特制的烈酒。我们开始吧。

original: You look like someone who can hold their liquor. How about a friendly contest to win a staff?
traduit: 你看起来酒量不小啊。来场赌法杖的友谊比赛怎么样？

original: I'm guessing you also don't remember coming in here and blathering incoherently about marriage or a goat.
traduit: 我看你是不记得来这里口齿不清地谈论什么婚姻和山羊了。

original: Which means you don't remember losing your temper and throwing trash all over the temple.
traduit: 也就不记得你在这儿耍脾气，把东西扔得到处都是。

original: I'll return my ancestors to Sovngarde, and you with them!
traduit: 我会把我的祖先们送回松加德，你就和他们一起去吧！

original: Sovngarde is a myth, you s'wit! And now you can join your ancestors in service to me!
traduit: 松加德就是个神话，你个斯'威特！现在你可以和你的祖先一起为我服务了！

original: The dead should be made to serve the living, not the other way around!
traduit: 应该让死人服侍活人，而不是反过来！

original: Vals Veran will die for what he's done.
traduit: 瓦尔斯·威冉会为他的所作所为付出代价。

original: That dark elf is about to be a dead elf.
traduit: 那个暗精灵要变成死精灵了。

original: It doesn't bother you that we're killing your ancestors?
traduit: 我们杀了你的祖先，你不觉得困扰吗？

original: We're not killing them, they were already dead. We're helping them back to Sovngarde.
traduit: 我们不是杀他们，他们早就已经死了。我们是要帮他们回到松加德。

original: You found it! The passage goes through the sarcophagus... I don't like this... but we'd better keep going.
traduit: 你找到了！这条通道居然穿过棺材……我不喜欢……但我们必须前进。

original: This looks like the area Agna told me about. She said that the bear would show the way...
traduit: 这跟阿格娜告诉我的地方很像。她说熊会为我们指引道路……

original: Agna once told me there is a secret room deeper in where they buried disgraced members of the family. Maybe that will get us into the main chamber...
traduit: 阿格娜告诉过我，在更深的地方有个秘密房间，那里埋葬了名誉扫地的家族成员们。也许那里能让我们进入主墓室……

original: He's barred the door. Gods only know how he's... defiling the bodies of my ancestors in there!
traduit: 他把门锁上了。众神肯定知道……他在玷污我祖先的尸体！

original: No! Aunt Agna! Talos, why didn't I go in with her?
traduit: 不！阿格娜姑姑！塔洛斯啊，我为什么不跟她一起进来？

original: You're all heart, Vivienne.
traduit: 你可真有心了，薇薇安。

original: You should tell her that her uncle is scum that betrayed his High King. Best she know now, Addvar.
traduit: 你应该告诉她，她舅舅是个背叛了至高王的人渣。最好现在就让她知道，艾达瓦。

original: Svari, you need to go home. Go home and stay there until your mother comes.
traduit: 斯瓦瑞，你得回家了。待在家里，等你妈妈回去。

original: Of course! You don't remember getting here.
traduit: 当然！你不记得来过这里了。

original: Where am I?
traduit: 我这是在哪儿？

original: They can't hurt uncle Roggvir. Tell them he didn't do it.
traduit: 他们不能伤害罗吉维尔舅舅。快告诉他们不是他干的。

original: A traitor right up to the end.
traduit: 彻头彻尾的叛徒。

original: I've been waiting for Roggvir's execution. Talk to me later.
traduit: 我一直在等着罗吉维尔被处死。待会儿再说。

original: Very well, Roggvir. Bow your head.
traduit: 很好，罗吉维尔。把头低下。

original: Sorry. I don't know anything.
traduit: 抱歉。我什么都不知道。

original: Thank you for your time.
traduit: 感谢你抽出时间。

original: I don't need your help.
traduit: 我用不着你帮。

original: Guard. Prepare the prisoner.
traduit: 卫兵。带犯人。

original: Oooh... pretty colors.
traduit: 哦……颜色挺漂亮。

original: What a display of color!
traduit: 多么鲜艳的色彩！

original: Oh, such colors!
traduit: 哦，这颜色好看！

original: Is that magic? Careful, please...
traduit: 那是魔法吗？请小心些……

original: Oh, look at the colors!
traduit: 哦，看这颜色！

original: Wow! Look at all the colors!
traduit: 喔！看看这些颜色！

original: Colorful...
traduit: 五彩缤纷……

original: Brilliant!
traduit: 太美了！

original: Keep that magic away from me.
traduit: 把魔法拿远点。

original: Well hey, that's not something you see every day.
traduit: 嘿，这可不是天天能见到的。

original: Thank you for your help with Vals. Please, take this and leave me to see to Aunt Agna and my other family members.
traduit: 谢谢你帮我解决了瓦尔斯。请收下这个，我要留下来照看阿格娜姑姑和其他家族成员。

original: What? Who is this, Brother? Another of the smooth skins looking for food? But this one wasn't trapped with us...
traduit: 什么？这是谁，兄弟？又有滑皮的来找吃的？但在下这里没有啊……

original: I don't need a guide.
traduit: 我不用向导。

original: Oh, really? You're just like my brother. Fine, but if you change your mind, I'll be right here.
traduit: 哦，真的？你跟我哥哥一个样。好吧，但如果你改主意了，我还在这里等你。

original: Lead on then.
traduit: 请带路吧。

original: I'll meet you outside!
traduit: 我在外面等你！

original: I know. I just don't want you to leave; you're the only good thing that's happened to this city in a long time.
traduit: 我知道。我只是不想你离开，长久以来，你是这座城市唯一的好人了。

original: They represent the reason I'm here. I can't just ignore them, Aerin.
traduit: 他们就是我在这里的原因。我不能无视，艾灵。

original: Be careful, Mjoll. The Thieves Guild has Maven Black-Briar at her back.
traduit: 小心点，穆月尔。盗贼公会身后有玛雯·黑棘撑腰。

original: One snap of her fingers, and you could end up in Riften Jail... or worse.
traduit: 她打个响指，你可能就会被关进裂谷城监狱了……甚至更糟。

original: I had another run-in with the Thieves Guild.
traduit: 我又和盗贼公会起冲突了。

original: Brynjolf said you had something for me?
traduit: 布林乔夫说你有东西要给我？

original: Yes, and I'm more than happy to give it to you.
traduit: 对，我很乐意把它交给你。

original: I mean look at this place. I've never seen so much wealth down here. You've made us all rich.
traduit: 我是说，看看这里吧。我从没见过这么多财富。你让我们腰包都鼓起来了。

original: Here you go... should fit you like a glove... boss.
traduit: 给……应该很适合你……老大。

original: So that's it? There's nothing else to it?
traduit: 就这了？没别的吗？

original: Well, that's it. Sorry if it isn't the ceremony you were hoping for, but we're not exactly known for throwing our coin around.
traduit: 嗯，就这。如果这不是你想要的仪式，我也只能说声抱歉了。但我们可不是乱扔钱的人。

original: After we're done here, head over to Tonilia and she'll set you up with your Guild Master Armor.
traduit: 这里完事以后，就去找托尼利亚，她给你准备了公会大师护甲。

original: Oh, and one last thing. Here, I want you to take this. It's sort of a tradition around here.
traduit: 哦，最后一件事。给你，拿着这个。这是这里的传统。

original: This is Helgen. I used to be sweet on a girl from here. Wonder if Vilod is still making that mead with juniper berries mixed in.
traduit: 这里就是海尔根。我曾经爱上过这里的一个姑娘。也不知道维罗德是不是还在拿刺柏浆果酿蜜酒。

original: I've heard Jaree-Ra is hanging around the Wells District, looking for new blood to hire.
traduit: 我听说加雷-拉正在井泉区四处乱晃，好像是在招新人。

original: Umm... Actually, I was hoping to get the ring back.
traduit: 嗯……我其实想把戒指拿回。

original: What? You want it for that hussy Esmerelda, with the dark feathers - don't you? I won't let her have you!
traduit: 什么？你想把它送给那个长着黑毛的贱人艾丝美拉达吗？我不会让她得到你的！

original: Darling! I've been waiting for you to return, to consummate our love!
traduit: 亲爱的！我一直等你回来，让我们的爱最终圆满！

original: Haven't you talked to Astrid? She's by the pool, greeting the Night Mother and her little jester. She has a contract for you. Come see me afterward.
traduit: 你没跟阿斯垂德谈过吗？她在池边向夜母和小丑问好。她有个契约交给你。之后再来找我吧。

original: There's no way out. There's no way out....
traduit: 出不去了。出不去了……

original: Out the way we came. Hurry!
traduit: 从我们来的路出去。快！

original: We're getting out of here. Now.
traduit: 我们得离开这儿。快。

original: See if you can get the door open.
traduit: 看看你能不能把门打开。

original: Something's going on here.
traduit: 这里发生过什么。

original: Eyes open.
traduit: 保持警惕。

original: Why should I help you?
traduit: 我为什么要帮你？

original: We left to help with the war and these filth bags swooped in and seized the place.  My family is in there.
traduit: 我们离开去参战，那群肮脏的家伙突然闯进来占了这里。我的家人还在里面。

original: Don't come too close with that.
traduit: 别靠太近了。

original: Get away from me!
traduit: 离我远点！

original: That spell looks dangerous... keep your distance.
traduit: 那法术看着很危险……离我远点。

original: That spell looks dangerous...
traduit: 那法术看起来很危险……

original: Please! Keep that magic away from me.
traduit: 拜托！把那魔法离我远点。

original: You really should be more careful with the spells you cast.
traduit: 你真该小心你用的那个法术。

original: You should be more careful with your spell casting.
traduit: 你用法术的时候小心点。

original: You keep your distance with that magic
traduit: 和魔法应该保持点距离。

original: Dear, that spell is making me nervous.
traduit: 亲爱的，那个法术搞得我很紧张。

original: Hurt anyone with that spell and you'll be sorry.
traduit: 用这个法术伤害任何人，你会后悔的。

original: Uuh. Would you mind dousing that magic?
traduit: 唔。你介意把魔法收起来吗？

original: It's wearing a dangerous spell...
traduit: 讨厌的危险法术……

original: That spell looks like it'll hurt.
traduit: 那个法术打人会很痛吧。

original: That looks dangerous...
traduit: 看起来很危险……

original: Please stay away while you got that spell on you.
traduit: 你捏着魔法的时候请离我远点。

original: Keep your distance.
traduit: 保持距离。

original: Walking around like that is why magic gets a bad name. Shame on you.
traduit: 就是因为像这样走来走去，魔法才会声名狼藉。你可真丢人。

original: This one thinks you should be more careful with your spells.
traduit: 在下觉得你应该小心对待你的法术。

original: You're asking for trouble walking around with dangerous magic like that.
traduit: 你带着这么危险的魔法到处晃悠就是在自找麻烦。

original: Do be careful with that spell, will you?
traduit: 千万小心那个法术，好吗？

original: You better be careful with that magic, if you know what's good for you.
traduit: 使用魔法最好小心点，要知道什么对你有好处。

original: I trust you know what you're doing with that spell?
traduit: 我想你明白自己该用那个法术做什么吧？

original: That man said something about the "Forsworn."
traduit: 那个人说到了“弃誓者”。

original: I've heard of them. Something about the men who live in the hills and attack caravans.
traduit: 我听说过。那些躲在山里袭击商队的人。

original: I'm sorry. I don't know anymore. I'm just visiting here from Cyrodiil.
traduit: 抱歉。我知道的也不多。我刚刚从希罗帝尔旅行到这里。

original: Do you know why he was after you?
traduit: 你知道他为什么盯上你吗？

original: No. I don't have any idea. I was just shopping for a pendant for my sister back in the Imperial City.
traduit: 不，我也不知道。我只是来给我在帝都的妹妹选个项链。

original: By the gods, that man nearly killed me. You saved my life.
traduit: 神啊，那个人差点杀了我。你救了我的命。

original: Thank you. Here, I was going to bring this to my sister, but I think you should have it.
traduit: 谢谢。给，我本想把它带给我的妹妹，我觉得应该送给你。

original: Thank you again. I can't believe I was this close to being killed.
traduit: 再次感谢。真不敢相信我差点就被杀了。

original: Everyone stay back. The Markarth city guard have this all under control. There are no Forsworn here.
traduit: 所有人都退后。这里都在马卡斯卫兵的掌控下。这里没有什么弃誓者。

original: By the Divines, the Forsworn are here in the city!
traduit: 圣灵啊，弃誓者居然在城里！

original: Oh, this pendant would look lovely on my sister.
traduit: 哦，这个项链戴在我妹妹身上肯定很漂亮。

original: I'd appreciate if you don't bother my wife, Tova. She's still in mourning.
traduit: 希望你不要打扰我妻子托娃。她还在服丧。

original: I...I'm fading away!
traduit: 我……我在消失！

original: Now what am I supposed to do? I can't be seen in public like this. If I can even be seen at all...
traduit: 现在我该怎么办？大家都看不到我。如果我被看到……

original: You turned me invisible!
traduit: 你把我隐形了！

original: Not bad. Now turn me back.
traduit: 不坏啊。现在让我变回去。

original: I'm...I'm invisible!
traduit: 我……我隐身了！

original: What did ya do that for?
traduit: 你为什么这么干？

original: Bah! Save your magic. A warrior should face her foe, not hide from him.
traduit: 呸！收起你的魔法。战士就该直面敌人，而不是逃避。

original: Ooohh... The things I could do now...
traduit: 哦……我现在能做好些事……

original: Hey! Where did I go?
traduit: 嘿！我怎么了？

original: Magic! I'm not sure I approve.
traduit: 魔法！我可拿不准。

original: You're a tricky one. Now fix it.
traduit: 你个狡猾的东西。赶紧给我复原。

original: Hey! I can't see myself! What did you do to me?
traduit: 嘿！我看不见自己了！你干了什么？

original: Wizard tricks! An Orc faces the enemy. He doesn't hide from him.
traduit: 巫师的鬼把戏！兽人会直面敌人，而不是躲开。

original: Stop that! How can I do my job if I'm invisible?
traduit: 停下！如果我隐身了还怎么工作？

original: Clever. To think, now I could... Well, never mind.
traduit: 聪明。想了想，我现在可以……哎，算了。

original: Ahhh... no one will know I'm here now.
traduit: 啊……没人会知道我在这里。

original: What did you do to me? What am I made of? Air? Shadow? Oh, this is not good...
traduit: 你对我做了什么？我怎么了？空气？影子？哦，这可不妙啊……

original: What the...I'm invisible!
traduit: 怎么……我怎么隐身了！

original: Goodness!
traduit: 神呐！

original: What did you do! I'm...I'm see through! This better not be permanent. You can't just go around making women invisible like this!
traduit: 你做了什么！我……怎么透明了！最好不是永久的。你不能就这样到处让女人隐形！

original: Oh! I didn't expect that!
traduit: 哦！我可不想这样！

original: What have you done to me?
traduit: 你对我做了什么？

original: Hey! Where did I go? I can't see myself!
traduit: 嘿！我怎么不见了？我看不见自己了！

original: Hey! This could be handy!
traduit: 嘿！这挺方便啊！

original: Ah! I am now like the Shadowscales of old.
traduit: 啊！我现在就像以前的影鳞。

original: Hmm. I could be a great hunter like this.
traduit: 嗯。我这样就能成为伟大的猎人了。

original: Wow! I'm see through!
traduit: 喔！我透明了！

original: Hey! What did you do to me? My body is gone!
traduit: 嘿！你对我做了什么？我的身体不见了！

original: What? Do I have mead on my chin?
traduit: 怎么？我的下巴上有酒吗？

original: My thanks. I feel... better.
traduit: 谢谢。我感觉……好多了。

original: I suppose you think you're better than me because you can do that?
traduit: 我猜你觉得比我强就是因为你能做到这个？

original: I hope you're not expecting a thank you.
traduit: 希望你不是在等我说谢谢。

original: A healing spell? Was that really necessary?
traduit: 治疗法术？有必要吗？

original: Huh. I feel better now.
traduit: 嗯。我现在感觉好多了。

original: My old bones don't hurt so much now.
traduit: 我这把老骨头不那么疼了。

original: Healing magic? An Orc lets her wounds heal naturally...
traduit: 治疗魔法？兽人会等伤口自然愈合……

original: Huh? What...oh! That felt nice.
traduit: 嗯？什……哦！感觉不错啊。

original: What...hey! That felt good.
traduit: 什么……嘿！感觉很好啊。

original: No need to do that now.
traduit: 现在没必要。

original: Suddenly I feel much better.
traduit: 我突然感觉好多了。

original: You heal away my scars and there's gonna be a problem...
traduit: 你治好了我的伤，现在有个问题……

original: That put a spring in my step.
traduit: 走起来又带劲了。

original: Hey! You trying to pull a fast one on me?
traduit: 嘿！你是想耍我吗？

original: Save it for the battlefield.
traduit: 留到战场上再说吧。

original: I wasn't hurt, but that did make me feel better.
traduit: 我没受伤，但确实感觉好多了。

original: A healing spell? Are you a priest?
traduit: 治疗法术？你是祭司吗？

original: Don't go casting spells on a woman without asking her permission.
traduit: 未经允许不要擅自对女性施法。

original: Hmm. Feel a bit better now. Thanks.
traduit: 嗯。感觉好点了。谢谢。

original: Was that some sort of... healing spell?
traduit: 这是不是……治疗法术啊？

original: Thanks! Not sure it was necessary, though.
traduit: 谢谢！但我不确定是不是有必要。

original: Healing spells always leave me light-headed...
traduit: 治疗法术总是晃得我头晕。

original: Ah! What did you do? Stop that!
traduit: 啊！你在干什么？停下！

original: Mmm. That felt nice.
traduit: 嗯。感觉不错。

original: Ah! That felt refreshing.
traduit: 啊！感觉神清气爽。

original: Wow! What was that? Do it again!
traduit: 喔！那是什么？再来一次！

original: Hey! My hangover is gone!
traduit: 嘿！我的宿醉消失了！

original: Ah! I feel like I just woke from a nap.
traduit: 啊！感觉好像刚睡了个午觉。

original: Hey! What the... keep your damn magic to yourself.
traduit: 嘿！怎么回事……把你那该死的魔法收起来。

original: What the... Don't do that!
traduit: 怎么……别这么做！

original: Keep your damn spells to yourself.
traduit: 收起你那该死的法术。

original: That was pathetic. It didn't even do anything.
traduit: 真可悲。一点儿不起效。

original: Ah! Damn wizard. Keep your spells off of me.
traduit: 啊！该死的巫师。把你的法术拿远点。

original: Stop that! Keep your spells to yourself.
traduit: 停下！收好你的法术。

original: Don't try to magic me, you damn wizard.
traduit: 别想对我施法，你这该死的巫师。

original: Hey! What are you trying to pull?
traduit: 嘿！你在耍什么把戏？

original: Huh? Don't do that!
traduit: 啊？别这样！

original: Don't know what that was, but don't try it again.
traduit: 我不知道那是什么，但别再搞了。

original: Hey! Stop that.
traduit: 嘿！停下。

original: Magic is for the weak. Pick up some steel if you want to fight me.
traduit: 魔法是给弱者准备的。想打赢我就拔出武器吧。

original: Wizards. There oughta be a law against them.
traduit: 巫师。就该被明令禁止才对。

original: Whoa, whoa, whoa? What did you do?
traduit: 喔喔喔。你做了什么？

original: Ah! Keep your spells away from me.
traduit: 啊！把你的魔法拿远点。

original: Ah! Don't do that.
traduit: 啊！别这样。

original: Ah! I'm just an old woman. Don't hurt me.
traduit: 啊！我就是个老女人。别伤害我。

original: You stop that! I will not be violated by some... half-Septim magician!
traduit: 停下！我可不会被你这种……半吊子法师伤到！

original: Oh! What did you just do?
traduit: 哦！你刚刚干了什么？

original: Hey! I didn't ask you to magic me.
traduit: 嘿！我可没让你给我施法。

original: Hey! Don't do that.
traduit: 嘿！别这样。

original: Ah! Picking on an old man? What did I ever do to you?
traduit: 啊！欺负老头子？我没招过你吧？

original: Oh! I don't feel any different. What did you do?
traduit: 哦！我没觉得有什么不一样啊。你干了什么？

original: Stop it! I don't like magic.
traduit: 停下！我不喜欢魔法。

original: Wow! That was fun. Do it again!
traduit: 喔！有意思。再来一次！

original: Ah Please! Don't hurt me!
traduit: 哦拜托！别伤害我！

original: You there! That was uninvited. No more.
traduit: 喂！我没让你这么做。别再干了。

original: What was that? Don't do it again.
traduit: 那是什么？别再这么干了。

original: Huh... what was that? What'd you do?
traduit: 嗯……那是什么？你做了什么？

original: I did not ask for that! No more magic.
traduit: 我不想要这些！别再用魔法了。

original: Hey, Longhammer, set us up with a round of... what in Oblivion happened in here?
traduit: 嘿，长柄锤，可是让我们……这里发生了什么？

original: Come on... there! I got it, let's go!
traduit: 来吧……在那儿！我成功了，我们走！

original: Shut up or they'll kill us, you idiot! Once they're gone I'll pick the lock...
traduit: 闭嘴，不然他们会杀了我们的，你个白痴！他们一走我就开锁……

original: Take the money, just let us go...
traduit: 把钱拿走，放我们走吧……

original: No! You'll never take me alive!
traduit: 不！你休想活捉我！

original: Excellent. I think you'll be glad that you made this decision.
traduit: 太好了。我保证你这个决定不亏。

original: If you change your mind, you know where to find me.
traduit: 如果你改主意了，你知道去哪儿找我。

original: Thank you. I'll be sure to put it to good use.
traduit: 谢谢。我会妥善利用的。

original: Let's see what you can do with this. (<Global=InvestAmount> gold)
traduit: 那就看看你能拿这些干什么吧。（<Global=InvestAmount>金币）

original: You have my thanks, friend.
traduit: 谢谢你，朋友。

original: Ah, the sound of clinking coins. Even better, the sound of clinking coins in my hand!
traduit: 啊，金币叮当作响。而且还是我手中的金币叮当作响！

original: I'll call upon my suppliers this very evening and arrange to double my orders.
traduit: 今晚我会去找供应商，告诉他们订单加倍。

original: I'll start planning how best to spend this. You have my thanks!
traduit: 我要开始规划规划这笔钱了。谢谢你！

original: You'll look back on this as one of your best decisions, I swear it.
traduit: 我发誓，这是你做过最好的决定。

original: If you want to make the most of your investment, you'll come here to sell your goods.
traduit: 如果你想最大限度利用你的投资，只管来这里买卖。

original: Thank you so much! With this coin, I'll be able to double my stock.
traduit: 非常感谢！有了这些钱，我的存货就能扩一倍了。

original: Ah, look at the pretty, shiny coins. Now, how best to spend them?
traduit: 啊，看这些闪亮的金币。怎么才能利用起来呢？

original: If you have spare weapons and armor to sell, bring them here.
traduit: 如果你有多余的武器盔甲，都可以拿来。

original: More coin means more supplies, and that means more useful balms, potions and remedies for everyone.
traduit: 钱越多货源越多，大家都能有药膏药水和救命的办法了。

original: I'll work hard to justify your faith in me.
traduit: 我会努力工作回馈你的信任。

original: A wise choice, my friend. After all, what would a common adventurer know about the complexities of finance?
traduit: 明智的选择，朋友。毕竟，普通的冒险家是不会了解金融的复杂性的。

original: Wise is the one who spends a few coins now to make a fortune later.
traduit: 最明智的就属投小钱赚大钱的人了。

original: Thank you. When I have the time, I'll try to think of how best to use this.
traduit: 谢谢。等我有时间了，就琢磨琢磨怎么利用它。

original: May prosperity bless us both!
traduit: 愿咱俩生意红火！

original: On second thought, perhaps I'll invest another time.
traduit: 想了想，还是下次吧。

original: I'd like to make an investment in your business.
traduit: 我想投资你的生意。

original: Oh? Well, I won't turn down your money.
traduit: 哦？好吧，我是不会拒绝注资的。

original: By helping me, you're helping the good folk of Whiterun. How could I say no to that?
traduit: 帮助我，就是帮助白漫城的好人们。我怎么能拒绝呢？

original: I'll take your money, but I make no promises of a large return on your investment. These are troubled times, after all.
traduit: 你的钱我可以收，但我不能保证投资就能有高收益。毕竟，现在世道太乱。

original: Splendid! With the extra coin, I'll be able to purchase twice the volume in supplies that I normally do.
traduit: 太好了！有了这些钱，我就能进比平时多一倍的货了。

original: I've been looking to expand the business, and your investment will certainly help with that. I accept!
traduit: 我一直想扩展业务，你的投资很及时。我接受了！

original: Such an investment will mean that I can take better care of my family, as well as my customers.
traduit: 有这样的投资我就能更好地照顾家里和顾客了。

original: An investment, is it? Alright, I'm sure I can put the extra money to good use.
traduit: 投资？好吧，我肯定会把好钢用在刀刃上。

original: Splendid! I've been looking for a new investor. Now it seems my search is over.
traduit: 太好了！我一直在找新的投资人。看来现在不用找了。

original: Come to see the hag with an offering of coin, then? So be it. I accept your investment.
traduit: 拿着钱来找鬼婆？行啊。我接受你的投资。

original: Of course you want to invest in my business. I'm the finest blacksmith in all Skyrim.
traduit: 你想投资是理所当然的。我可是全天际最优秀的铁匠。

original: How kind. At my age, I've certainly learned how to spend wisely.
traduit: 太好了。到我这年纪，当然知道该怎么花钱。

original: You want to give me money? Just like that? Fine, but I intend to earn that investment. I don't need handouts.
traduit: 你想给我资金？就像这样？好吧，但我不会白要。我不接受施舍。

original: Ah yes, good idea. Best to let a professional businessman handle that money for you.
traduit: 哦，好主意。最好有专业商人帮你处理这笔钱。

original: You make an interesting offer. Very well, I'm sure that I can put the extra coin to good use.
traduit: 你的出价不错。好，我会妥善运用的。

original: An investment? Very well, I don't see why not.
traduit: 投资？太好了，没什么不行的。

original: I hear you've been busy of late.
traduit: 我听说你最近很忙啊。

original: What is this about?
traduit: 在干什么呢？

original: Listen, as far as I'm concerned you've already earned your pardon.
traduit: 听着，据我看你应该已经被赦免了。

original: But until we get that confirmed by General Tullius, just stay clear of other Imperial soldiers and avoid any complications, all right?
traduit: 但在我们得到图留斯将军最终确认前，还是离其他帝国士兵远点以免麻烦，好吗？

original: See that ruin up there? Bleak Falls Barrow. When I was a boy, that place always used to give me nightmares.
traduit: 看到那边的废墟了吗？荒瀑古坟。我小时候，那地方总是吓得我做噩梦。

original: I'm glad you decided to come with me. We're almost to Riverwood.
traduit: 我很高兴你会跟我一起走。我们就要到河木镇了。

original: You sure you won't change your mind? Riverwood isn't far. I'm sure my uncle will be glad to help you out.
traduit: 你不改主意了吧？河木镇不算远。我叔叔肯定会乐意帮你的。

original: Remember, this isn't Stormcloak territory. If we're ahead of the news from Helgen we should be fine as long as we don't do anything stupid.
traduit: 记住，这里不是风暴斗篷的地盘，如果现在帝国方没有收到海尔根的消息，只要我们不犯傻，应该不会有事的。

original: If we run into any Imperials, just let me do the talking, all right?
traduit: 如果咱们碰上了帝国的人，由我负责交谈。好吗？

original: See that ruin up there? Bleak Falls Barrow. I never understood how my sister could stand living in the shadow of that place.
traduit: 看见那边的遗迹了吗？荒瀑古坟。我一直不明白我姐姐是怎么受得了住在那玩意儿脚下的。

original: You sure you won't change your mind? Riverwood isn't far. I'm sure my sister will be glad to help you out.
traduit: 你确定你不改主意了？河木镇离这不远了。我确定我姐会乐意帮你的。

original: I'm a proud supporter of Ulfric Stormcloak. What of it?
traduit: 我是骄傲的乌弗瑞克·风暴斗篷支持者。有什么问题？

original: Is that right? Here's how the Legion deals with rebel scum like you.
traduit: 是吗？那就见识见识军团是怎么对付你这样的叛乱者的。

original: I'm loyal to the Empire and don't care who knows it.
traduit: 我忠于帝国，不在乎谁知道。

original: You don't seem to realize there's a war on. What you are is a damn Imperial spy!
traduit: 你好像没意识到现在正在打仗。该死的帝国奸细！

original: Sorry, I didn't mean anything by it.
traduit: 抱歉，我不是故意的。

original: Well. I'll let it slide this time. But you'd be smart to take that off. Someone might get the wrong idea.
traduit: 好吧。这次我就不计较了。但你最好还是脱下来。免得有人误会。

original: Hmm. I still don't like it, but I guess I'll overlook it. This time.
traduit: 嗯。我还是不喜欢，但我就无视吧。下不为例。

original: What do you think you're doing, walking around dressed like a damn Stormcloak traitor?
traduit: 你以为你在干什么，穿得像个该死的风暴斗篷叛党？

original: You've got a lot of nerve, walking around here dressed like an Imperial Legionnaire.
traduit: 你胆子可真够大，穿得像个帝国军团兵一样在这里晃来晃去。

original: Do you have anything for sale?
traduit: 有什么要卖的吗？

original: We are on the hunt.
traduit: 我们在打猎。

original: Meat from fresh kills.
traduit: 新杀好的鲜肉。

original: Got a witchhunter in town, from the Priesthood of Stendarr. Keeps asking questions about that old abandoned house.
traduit: 镇上有个猎巫人，是个斯丹达尔的祭司。一直在询问那栋废弃房屋的事。

original: A witchhunter from the Priesthood of Stendarr is in town. He's asking a lot of questions about that old abandoned house.
traduit: 有个斯丹达尔祭司团的猎巫人来到镇上。一直在问那所老废弃屋子的事。

original: A mace? This is hardly a fitting prize.
traduit: 钉锤？这东西不划算啊。

original: Know your place, mortal. Or Molag Bal may just send another champion to claim his mace from your broken corpse.
traduit: 认清自己的位置，凡人。不然，莫拉格·巴尔不介意派另一个勇士从你的残尸上拿回钉锤。

original: Now, I have a soul in Oblivion to claim. Take care of the house while I'm gone. Ha ha ha!
traduit: 现在，湮灭里还有个灵魂等着我去收取。我不在的时候照看一下房子。哈哈哈！

original: Thank you, Lord Molag Bal.
traduit: 谢谢您，莫拉格·巴尔大人。

original: Now, I have a soul in Oblivion that needs claiming. Take care of the house while I'm gone. Ha ha ha!
traduit: 现在，湮灭里还有个灵魂等着我去收取。我不在的时候照看一下房子。哈哈哈！

original: The Mace of Molag Bal! I give you its true power, mortal.
traduit: 莫拉格·巴尔的钉锤！我授予你它真正的力量，凡人。

original: When your enemies lie broken and bloody before you, know that I will be watching.
traduit: 记住，当敌人血肉模糊地倒在你脚下，我始终注视这一切。

original: Rescue? No one knew where I was, when I was taken. Who sent you?
traduit: 救我？没人知道我被带到了哪里。谁派你来的？

original: A mace. It's rusted.
traduit: 一个生锈的钉锤。

original: Rusted. Dry. There was a time when this mace dripped with the blood of the feeble and the worthless.
traduit: 生锈了，干涸了。曾几何时，这把钉锤沾满了弱者和废物的鲜血。

original: But a Daedric Lord has his enemies, and my rival Boethiah had her priest desecrate it. Left it here to decay. Until you came.
traduit: 但迪德拉君王也有自己的敌人，我的对头波耶西亚让她的祭司亵渎了它，把它放在这里腐烂。直到你来。

original: Yes. Your reward is waiting for you, mortal. Further down.
traduit: 没错。你的奖赏正在等着，凡人。再往深处走。

original: It's an altar.
traduit: 是个祭坛。

original: Yes. It's an altar. Men would come and sacrifice the wretched in my name. The weak would be punished by the strong.
traduit: 没错。这是个祭坛。人们以我的名义来牺牲那些倒霉蛋。弱者就该受到强者的惩罚。

original: But a Daedric Lord has his enemies, and my rival Boethiah had her priest desecrate the altar. Until you came.
traduit: 但迪德拉君王也有自己的敌人，我的对头波耶西亚派祭司亵渎了这个祭坛。直到你来。

original: Fool! Did you think Molag Bal, the Lord of Domination, would so easily reward you?
traduit: 蠢货！你以为统治之主莫拉格·巴尔会这么轻易地奖赏你？

original: What do you see from that little cage? Speak.
traduit: 你从笼子里看到了什么？说。

original: Esbern, look out!
traduit: 伊思本，小心！

original: Yes, yes! I think we must be close to the entrance.
traduit: 没错！我们一定接近入口了。

original: Looks safe now. Let's move.
traduit: 看起来是安全了。继续走吧。

original: I would suggest staying on the plates with the Dragonborn symbol.
traduit: 我建议待在有龙裔符号的板子上。

original: There should be a way to turn this off.
traduit: 一定有办法关掉。

original: We'll cross once it's safe.
traduit: 等安全了就过去。

original: Hmm, Esbern's right. Look like pressure plates.
traduit: 嗯，伊思本说得对。看起来像是压板。

original: We should be careful here. See these symbols on the floor?
traduit: 小心这里。看到地上的符号了吗？

original: Why are you stopping?
traduit: 怎么停下了？

original: Wait.
traduit: 等等。

original: Whatever you did, it worked. Let's see what else those old Blades left in our way.
traduit: 不管你做了什么，但起作用了。来看看那些古代刀锋们在前面还留了什么？

original: Given that Sky Haven Temple was sealed against the return of the Dragonborn, I would try turning all the pillars to that symbol.
traduit: 考虑天佑神殿是封印起来以备龙族回归的，我建议把所有柱子都调成那个符号。

original: Yes, that's it. The symbol on the pillar on the left.
traduit: 对，就是它。左边柱子上的符号。

original: Yes, that's it. The symbol on the middle pillar.
traduit: 对，就是它。中间柱子上的符号。

original: Yes, that's it. The symbol on the pillar on the right.
traduit: 对，就是它。右边柱子上的符号。

original: And of course the symbol for "Dragonborn." That's the one that appears to have a sort of arrow shape pointing downward at the bottom.
traduit: 当然还有“龙裔”。底部有个箭头朝下指的那个。

original: Let's see... you have the symbol for "King"... and "Warrior"...
traduit: 来看看……有“王”……还有“战士”……

original: Yes. These are Akaviri symbols.
traduit: 没错，这是阿卡维尔符号。

original: These pillars must have something to do with it.
traduit: 这些柱子应该和它有关。

original: We've got to get this bridge down.
traduit: 我们得把桥降下来。

original: Yes. Definitely early Akaviri stonework here.
traduit: 没错，肯定是早期的阿卡维尔石刻工艺。

original: This looks promising.
traduit: 看起来真不错。

original: If you find that ring, bring it here.
traduit: 如果找到了戒指，请把它带回来。

original: That journal means a lot to me, if you find it.
traduit: 那本日记对我很重要，请务必找到。

original: I do miss that helmet....
traduit: 我真的很想念那个头盔……

original: Hopefully, that story about Lenne's Shield is true.
traduit: 希望伦内之盾的故事是真的。

original: Don't forget. You find Queen Freydis's Sword, I'll reward you.
traduit: 别忘了，如果找到芙瑞迪丝女王的剑，我会给你报酬的。

original: If you find that sword, please bring it to me.
traduit: 如果你找到那把剑，请把它带回来。

original: Come back as soon as you have the helm.
traduit: 拿到头盔就赶紧回来。

original: Retrieve that shield at all costs.
traduit: 不惜一切代价也要把盾牌取回来。

original: Execute every last bandit. Spare no one.
traduit: 每个强盗都要杀死。别留活口。

original: Good luck with the giant. Don't get stepped on.
traduit: 祝你面对巨人时走点运。别被一脚踩扁了。

original: I want no mercy for those Forsworn. Understand?
traduit: 我绝不会宽恕那些弃誓者。明白吗？

original: Vampires are clever hunters. More clever than you, definitely.
traduit: 吸血鬼都是些聪明的猎手。肯定比你聪明。

original: Remember. I need that bandit dead. Not alive.
traduit: 记住。那个强盗我只要死的不要活的。

original: Bandits are cowards. Don't strain yourself chasing them all down.
traduit: 强盗都是懦夫。不需把他们挨个都追上。

original: Sneak that ring back to Viola before we both get caught.
traduit: 趁我们都被抓之前赶紧把戒指还给维欧拉。

original: Have you taken care of that... little problem?
traduit: 你把那个……小麻烦处理好了？

original: Don't let Viola catch you in her house.
traduit: 别让维欧拉在她家里把你逮到了。

original: You don't look so good. Are you feeling all right?
traduit: 你气色不太好啊。不舒服吗？

original: You should probably be in bed. You're looking a bit under the weather.
traduit: 你应该躺在床上休息。你看起来不太舒服。

original: How do you feel? I think you might be sick.
traduit: 你感觉怎么样？我瞧你像是病了。

original: You look sick. I hope it's not contagious.
traduit: 你看起来是病了。但愿不会传染。

original: Are you feeling all right, dear? You look a little ill.
traduit: 你没事儿吧，亲爱的？你看起来气色不好啊。

original: Don't take this the wrong way, but you look a little sickly.
traduit: 别误会我的意思，但你看起来有点病。

original: You're looking a little rough around the edges. You feeling all right?
traduit: 你看起来不大正常。感觉还好吗？

original: You look a bit peaked. You sure you shouldn't be home, in bed?
traduit: 你看起来有点憔悴。确定不需要在家休息休息吗？

original: You look worse than I feel.
traduit: 你脸色瞧着比我还糟。

original: Are you feeling sick?
traduit: 你不舒服吗？

original: You look awful. Better not get me sick.
traduit: 你脸色糟透了。最好别给我传上。

original: You all right? You look like you might be sick.
traduit: 你还好么？你看起来像是生病了。

original: No offense, but you're not looking so good. Are you feeling ill?
traduit: 无意冒犯，但你看起来不大好。不舒服吗？

original: That someone would attack Jorrvaskr... it's unthinkable.
traduit: 有人进攻月瓦斯卡……真不可想象。

original: Look at that.
traduit: 看那儿。

original: All right, you want to go?
traduit: 好吧，你想去吗？

original: Watch it, there, brother.
traduit: 小心点，兄弟。

original: Watch it, there, sister.
traduit: 小心点，姐妹。

original: Do not worry, my friend. All is well.
traduit: 别担心，朋友。一切都好。

original: So, the same then.
traduit: 这么说，一如既往啊。

original: The visions continue to hold me in balance, Gorm.
traduit: 幻象让我继续保持平衡，葛姆。

original: How are you feeling, Jarl Idgrod?
traduit: 你感觉怎么样，艾德格洛德领主？

original: Yes, okay. Well thank you.
traduit: 是，好的。谢谢您。

original: No, Gorm. I am simply telling you what I see.
traduit: 不，葛姆。我只是在告诉你我所看到的。

original: No, no. I'm fine. Is there something you need?
traduit: 不，不。我很好。您有什么需要吗？

original: You are troubled, Gorm.
traduit: 你有麻烦了，葛姆。

original: All things are possible, my child. But I believe it is within you to succeed.
traduit: 一切皆有可能，孩子。但我相信你能成功。

original: Have you... Do you see that future? Will I be a good leader?
traduit: 那您……看到未来了么？我是个好领导吗？

original: That is what the Divines have planned for you, yes.
traduit: 这是圣灵们为你计划的，没错。

original: I will be Jarl someday, mother?
traduit: 总有一天我会成为领主吗，母亲？

original: No, no. Just watch over him.
traduit: 不，没有。照看好他就行。

original: What sort of harm? Have you had a vision?
traduit: 什么伤害？您有看到幻象吗？

original: Good. He must be kept safe from harm.
traduit: 好。必须保护他不受伤害。

original: You are looking after your brother, yes?
traduit: 你在照顾你弟弟吗？

original: Don't believe everything you hear, child.
traduit: 不要相信你听到的一切，孩子。

original: Okay.
traduit: 好吧。

original: It's not true, I assure you.
traduit: 这不是真的，我保证。

original: I don't know. Someone in town said it.
traduit: 我不知道。是镇上的人。

original: What? Where did you hear such a thing?
traduit: 什么？你从哪儿听来的？

original: Is it true that you kill deer and eat their hearts?
traduit: 你真的有杀鹿然后吃它们的心吗？

original: Why, good evening Jonna!
traduit: 晚上好啊，乔娜！

original: I don't like being told what to do.
traduit: 我不喜欢别人告诉我怎么做。

original: No? Then how do you like the idea of having your legs broken?
traduit: 不喜欢？那你觉得摔断你的腿怎么样？

original: Mind your manners in this hall, friend.
traduit: 在大厅里注意礼貌，朋友。

original: Why would I disrespect her?
traduit: 为什么我会不尊重她？

original: It's no secret that Jarl Idgrod is... different. It's also no secret that there are rumors about her and her visions.
traduit: 艾德格洛德领主有些……与众不同。关于她和她看到的幻象的谣言也算不得什么秘密了。

original: I won't repeat them, and I won't allow them to be spread under this roof.
traduit: 我不会再重复，也不会让它们在这个屋檐下散播。

original: Now, you go about your business.
traduit: 现在，做你自己的事吧。

original: We certainly do.
traduit: 那是自然。

original: Then by all means, go about your business.
traduit: 那就好，忙你自己的事吧。

original: You will not disrespect Jarl Idgrod while in this Hall. Do we have an understanding?
traduit: 在这个大厅里不准你不尊重艾德格洛德领主，我们达成共识了吗？

original: So then what do you do?
traduit: 所以你怎么做？

original: I keep to myself. I offer spells and scrolls to those who need them, and wisdom in Conjuration magic for those who wish to learn.
traduit: 我独来独往。提供法术和卷轴给那些需要的人，并为那些希望学习魔法的人提供智慧。

original: Beyond that I seek only to be left alone to pursue my research.
traduit: 除此之外，我只想一个人待着继续自己的研究。

original: Why would anyone accuse you of that?
traduit: 为什么会有人这样指责你？

original: The people of Morthal would much rather weave their own horrid tales about my life than simply ask me for the truth.
traduit: 莫萨尔的人们宁愿编织关于我生活的可怕故事，也不愿意简简单单来问我真相。

original: If they choose to fear me in their ignorance, that is their choice. But it will not change what is true.
traduit: 如果他们选择因无知而畏惧我，那就随他们去吧。但这改变不了事实。

original: If you stand before me to accuse me of sacrificing children, or eating the hearts of the dead, you may save your breath.
traduit: 如果你是想站在我面前指责我献祭小孩儿，或者吃死人心的话，那就省省吧。

original: I have done no such thing, nor do I intend to. I simply wish to live my life in peace.
traduit: 我没做过，也不打算做。我只想平静地生活。

original: I understand you have visions.
traduit: 我知道你能看到幻象。

original: The Divines reveal things to me at times, yes. I do not hide this.
traduit: 圣灵有时会向我透露些事情没错。我不打算隐瞒。

original: It is a gift. Anyone who believes otherwise does not and cannot understand it.
traduit: 这是一份祝福。任何不相信的人都不会，也无法理解它。

original: I'm not getting involved.
traduit: 我不会管的。

original: I'll see that your letter reaches Aldis.
traduit: 我会把你的信交给艾迪斯。

original: Thank you. Please, do not open it. It is... private.
traduit: 谢谢。请不要打开。这很……私密。

original: Remember, this is where they recorded all they knew of Alduin and his return.
traduit: 记住，他们在这上面记载着他们关于奥杜因及其回归的所有知识。

original: Yeah... sure. You, too, Delphine. You be safe.
traduit: 嗯……好吧。你也一样，戴尔芬。你也要注意安全。

original: Take care of yourself, Orgnar. Goodbye.
traduit: 你自己多保重，奥格那。再见了。

original: Well, now. That's something to think about.
traduit: 这样啊，那可得琢磨琢磨了。

original: Orgnar, this is it. The inn is yours. I'm probably never coming back here.
traduit: 奥格那，就这样了。旅馆归你了。我以后可能不回来了。

original: Where can we find Alduin's Wall?
traduit: 我们在哪能找到奥杜因之墙？

original: This is what I've been trying to explain. It's in Sky Haven Temple, an ancient Blades sanctuary, hidden deep in the crags of the Reach.
traduit: 这就是我试着解释给你们的。在天佑神殿，那是一座古老的刀锋会圣殿，深藏在瑞驰的峭壁当中。

original: That's where we'll find Alduin's Wall.
traduit: 在那里能找到奥杜因之墙。

original: So you think Alduin's Wall will tell us how to defeat Alduin?
traduit: 所以你觉得奥杜因之墙能够告诉我们如何击败奥杜因？

original: Yes, exactly. Well, I think so. It's certainly our best hope. The ancient Blades remembered much Akaviri dragonlore that has now been forgotten.
traduit: 没错。我想应该是。这是我们最大的希望了。古代的刀锋会记载着很多现在失传的阿卡维尔龙族知识。

original: We'll meet you there. Be careful. That part of the Reach is rough country these days.
traduit: 我们在那里会合。小心点。瑞驰的那部分地区现在不太平静。

original: What's the best way to get there?
traduit: 怎么走最好？

original: From Riverwood? The road south through Falkreath is the most direct route.
traduit: 从河木镇出发？从南边穿过佛克瑞斯最直接。

original: Or you could catch the carriage from Whiterun to Markarth and then approach from the west.
traduit: 或者你可以从白漫城坐马车到马卡斯城，然后在从西向东走。

original: Either way, the Reach is wild country these days. The Forsworn are everywhere. Best be careful.
traduit: 不管怎么说，瑞驰现在是片野蛮之地，遍地都是弃誓者。最好还是小心点。

original: Let's travel there together. Are you ready to go?
traduit: 我们一起走吧。你准备好了吗？

original: Always. Let's go see if we can find this Sky Haven Temple.
traduit: 一直准备着呢。看看我们能不能找到天佑神殿。

original: Sky Haven Temple it is, then. I knew you'd have something for us, Esbern.
traduit: 那目标就是天佑神殿了。我就知道你能帮上忙，伊思本。

original: Well, yes, but... there's no guarantee, of course.
traduit: 嗯，没错，不过……也是没什么保证。

original: So you think that Alduin's Wall will tell us how to defeat Alduin?
traduit: 你觉得奥杜因之墙能告诉咱们怎么打败奥杜因？

original: Hmm? Oh, yes. Presumably something rather specific to dragons, or even Alduin himself.
traduit: 嗯？啊，当然。应该是专门对付龙的，甚至就是针对奥杜因的。

original: You mean they used a Shout to defeat Alduin? You're sure?
traduit: 你是说他们用一种龙吼击败了奥杜因？你确定？

original: How does 50 gold sound? (Persuade)
traduit: 50金币怎么样？（说服）

original: Eh, fine. I can tell you aren't worth the trouble. Just get out of here before I change my mind.
traduit: 呃，好吧。我觉得你不值得我费那么大劲。在我改主意之前赶快离开。

original: How does a knife in the gut sound? It's 200 gold or your life.
traduit: 那我把刀捅进你肚子里怎么样？要么200金币，要么拿命抵。

original: How about you let me through and I don't kill you? (Intimidate)
traduit: 不如你让我过去，然后我不杀你？（恐吓）

original: You know, now that I think of it, that sounds fair. Just shove off before the others notice.
traduit: 好吧，现在我想了想，很公平。在别人注意到之前赶紧走吧。

original: Ha! Tough talk for someone who's about to have their guts spilled.
traduit: 哈！内脏都快被扯出来的人还敢嘴硬。
