original: Well then, what are you waiting for? Get in there and earn your pay.
traduit: 好吧，那你还等什么？进去赚钱吧。

original: Why aren't you going in there?
traduit: 你为什么不进去？

original: I've found the journal of Skorm Snow-Strider.
traduit: 我找到了“雪步”斯科姆的日记。

original: And what? You couldn't read it yourself? Fine, give it here a moment.
traduit: 然后呢？你不会自己读么？好吧，给我吧。

original: What are you waiting for? Get in there and find that mask.
traduit: 你还在等什么？快进去找面具。

original: Any progress on finding the mask?
traduit: 找面具有进展了？

original: Don't bother me if you haven't found anything about the mask.
traduit: 如果没找到面具的线索，就别来烦我。

original: Do you worry about raising a family in these dangerous times?
traduit: 这种危险时刻，你担心自己的家庭吗？

original: Of course. Every night I pray that we don't get a visit from a dragon, or that two armies don't show up to fight over the bridge.
traduit: 当然。我每晚都要祈祷别有龙找上门来，或者别有两支军队在桥上打仗。

original: You ask if I'm worried? I'm terrified, if you want to truth of it. But I have to stay strong for my wife and children.
traduit: 你问我是否担心？说实话，我确实害怕。为了老婆孩子，我必须坚强。

original: You mentioned mean folk passing through town?
traduit: 你提到有人经过镇上？

original: Both the Imperials and Stormcloaks have sent riders this way, scouting the bridge and the lands nearby.
traduit: 帝国军和风暴斗篷都派骑兵来这里侦察过桥和周边的土地。

original: They stayed at the inn, but didn't pay. They said soldiers don't need to pay because they're risking their lives to protect us.
traduit: 他们赖在旅店还不给钱。说是当兵的正在冒着生命危险保护我们，所以不需要付钱。

original: And that's not all. They took a heap of our lumber, and one tried to have his way with my daughter. They think they can do whatever they want.
traduit: 这还不算。他们拿走了我们一堆木材，还有一个想把我女儿抢走。他们太为所欲为了。

original: Did you say you came here from Markarth?
traduit: 你说你是从马卡斯城来的？

original: I grew up an orphan on the streets of Markarth. I'd have died there, too, but for the kindness of an old warrior named Logrolf the Bent.
traduit: 我是在马卡斯街头长大的孤儿。要不是有个叫“驼背”罗格洛夫的老战士心善，我可能会在那里直到死去。

original: Logrolf rescued me and gave me enough money to get out of the city. I followed the Karth river north, and came here.
traduit: 罗格洛夫救了我，给我足够的钱让我离开那座城市。我沿着卡斯河向北，来到了这里。

original: When I met Michel, I knew this was where I belonged. I suppose that's it, really.
traduit: 当我遇到米切尔时，我知道这里就是我的归宿了。我真的就是这么想的。

original: How old is that stone bridge near the town?
traduit: 镇子边上那个石桥有多少年了？

original: Hard to say. It's ancient, that much we know for sure. It was here long before the town itself.
traduit: 很难说了。可以肯定的是这东西很古老了。早在这镇子出现前就在这里了。

original: I just hope the bridge survives the war. It's the only place you can cross the Karth river for a long way in either direction.
traduit: 我只是希望这座桥能在战争中幸存下来。这是唯一一个可以不绕路跨过卡斯河的地方。

original: Could be if one side wants to keep the other from coming across, they might try to knock it down.
traduit: 如果一方想阻拦另一方过来，他们可能会试图把它拆毁。

original: Sounds like you're having some trouble with your wife.
traduit: 听起来你们夫妻有些矛盾。

original: Her name's Olda. If you've met her, then you probably already know what I'm talking about.
traduit: 她叫奥尔达。如果你见过她，就知道我在说什么了。

original: I swear that woman is the most spiteful shrew in all Skyrim. I think there's a chunk of ice where her heart ought to be.
traduit: 我发誓那娘们儿是天际最恶毒的泼妇。她的心脏都是冰做的。

original: What brings a Breton to Skyrim?
traduit: 一个布莱顿人到天际做什么？

original: Isn't it obvious? Why, the wonderful weather and hospitable people, of course!
traduit: 这不是显而易见吗？当然是因为宜人的气候和好客的民众了！

original: Not to mention my great fondness for dragons and petty political power struggles.
traduit: 更别提我还多热爱龙族和琐碎的政治权力斗争了。

original: Ah, but without a doubt, the most compelling feature of this frozen wasteland is the volley of inane questions leveled at me on a regular basis.
traduit: 啊，但毫无疑问，这片冰冻荒原上最吸引我的就是经常有人向我提出一连串愚蠢的问题。

original: How's business?
traduit: 生意如何？

original: Interesting, to say the least. What with all that's been going on.
traduit: 至少可以说有点意思吧。尤其是发生了这么多事。

original: On the one hand, supplies are harder to come by, since fewer traders are traveling the roads these days.
traduit: 一方面，由于现在走大路的商人越来越少，供应越发难得。

original: But on the other, the scarcity of supplies has led to some, well, "elevated" prices.
traduit: 但另一方面就是，供应短缺引发了价格的“上涨”。

original: All that matters is that I have what you need. And it's worth every septim.
traduit: 重要的是我有你需要的东西，而且绝对一分钱一分货。

original: Who's in charge of Whiterun?
traduit: 谁统治白漫城？

original: That'll be the Jarl, Balgruuf the Greater. He's an honorable enough man. Never done wrong by me or my kin.
traduit: 领主“伟岸者”巴尔古夫。他是个可敬的人，始终为我和亲人们着想。

original: Things are tough for him now, I'd wager. What with the fighting, and the dragons. But Balgruuf's a tough old Nord. He can handle it.
traduit: 我敢打赌，他现在日子不好过。战乱还有巨龙。但巴尔古夫是个坚强的老诺德人。他能应付得过来。

original: Hrongar became the Jarl when his brother Balgruuf, who had the job before him, was murdered.
traduit: 自从他哥哥巴尔古夫被杀了以后，霍隆格纳就接任领主了。

original: Balgruuf was an even-tempered man, but his brother's a hot-blooded war-monger who wants to settle everything with a blade.
traduit: 巴尔古夫性情平和，但他弟弟是个热血的战争贩子，想用武力解决一切。

original: If you've got some business with Hrongar, mind you stay on his good side. The palace dungeon's filled with folk who roused his temper.
traduit: 如果你想和霍隆格纳打交道，注意要投其所好。宫殿的地牢里全是惹怒他的人。

original: Vignar the Revered is the Jarl in Whiterun. I guess he was a great hero once, because the Companions all call him "Vignar the Revered."
traduit: “耆宿”维吉纳是白漫城领主。他以前应该也是个大英雄吧，战友团都叫他“耆宿维吉纳”。

original: Is Vignar too old to be Jarl? It's a fair question. If he's grown infirm and is losing his wits, where does that leave the people of Whiterun?
traduit: 但维吉纳当领主是不是太老了些？这是个好问题啊。如果他变得虚弱或者失智，那白漫的人民该怎么办？

original: You ever think of returning to Cyrodiil?
traduit: 你想过回希罗帝尔吗？

original: Why, because I'm a proud citizen of the Empire? Because the Stormcloaks only want Nords in Skyrim?
traduit: 为什么，就因为我是自豪的帝国公民？因为风暴斗篷只想让诺德人占有天际？

original: The Stormcloaks can rot in Oblivion for all I care. I've lived in this city for twenty years. Twenty!
traduit: 风暴斗篷尽管在湮灭里腐烂吧。我已经在这城里住了二十年。二十年！

original: Who should I talk to for work?
traduit: 我可以找谁领工作？

original: Try Hulda, the innkeeper at the Bannered Mare. It's just up the road, near the market.
traduit: 去找悬旗母马的老板胡尔达试试吧，那家店就在这条路上的市场附近。

original: You should check in at Dragonsreach, too. There's so much going on these days, the Jarl or his Steward might have need of help.
traduit: 你也可以去拜访一下龙临宫。这几天发生了很多事，领主和总管可能会需要帮助。

original: Try Olfina, the new innkeeper at the Bannered Mare. It's just up the road, near the market.
traduit: 去找悬旗母马的新老板奥菲娜试试吧，那家店就在这条路上的市场附近。

original: Who's the best blacksmith in Skyrim?
traduit: 谁是天际最好的铁匠？

original: I can tell you're new around here, askin' a question like that.
traduit: 一问这种问题就知道你是初来乍到。

original: My husband Eorlund tends the Skyforge up at Jorrvaskr, the Companions mead hall. There's no finer smith in the nine holds.
traduit: 我丈夫厄伦德在战友团蜜酒大厅月瓦斯卡旁边的天空锻炉。九大领地里没有比他更好的铁匠了。

original: You should ask him about his work. It's the only subject that'll get him talking.
traduit: 你应该找他聊聊他的工作。这是唯一能让他开口的话题。

original: Well, that and maybe those stuck-up, dung-sniffing Battle-Borns.
traduit: 嗯，还有那些自命不凡的臭战狂。

original: Curse you for bringing up that bitter memory.
traduit: 你真该死，让我想起那段痛苦的回忆。

original: Not long ago it was my husband Eorlund. There was no finer smith in the nine holds.
traduit: 不久之前还是我丈夫厄伦德。九大领地就没有比他更好的铁匠。

original: Now he's dead and gone and the Skyforge of Jorrvaskr lies cold.
traduit: 现在他死了，月瓦斯卡的天空锻炉也冷了。

original: You get a lot of attention from men?
traduit: 有很多男人关注你吗？

original: You've got no idea. Half the men in Whiterun have proposed to me. Some were even single.
traduit: 你不知道。白漫城有一半男的跟我求过婚。有些人到现在还单着。

original: They'll never understand. No amount of flowers or honeyed words are going to change my mind.
traduit: 他们永远不会明白。再多的鲜花和甜言蜜语也改不了我的心。

original: Right now, all that matters is my daughter Mila. No man's going to get between me and my little girl.
traduit: 现在，我最重要的就是女儿米拉。没人能阻隔在我们母女之间。

original: Now it is your turn.
traduit: 现在该你了。

original: Master Borri.
traduit: 博瑞大师。

original: Master Wulfgar will demonstrate Whirlwind Sprint. Then it will be your turn.
traduit: 沃夫加大师会展示旋风冲刺。然后就该轮到你了。

original: You must hear the Word within yourself before you can project it into a Thu'um.
traduit: 你必须在内心中听到这个词，再将它投射成一个吐'目。

original: Nah...
Kest...
traduit: 凯斯……

original: Tell me about the Black-Briar family.
traduit: 跟我说说黑棘家族。

original: Maven Black-Briar is the owner of the largest and most profitable business in all Skyrim, the Black-Briar Meadery.
traduit: 玛雯·黑棘是全天际最大、最赚钱的生意——黑棘蜜酒庄的老板。

original: We're pleased to have her in Riften. She brings stability, opportunities for employment and strategic value to our city.
traduit: 我们很高兴她能来到裂谷城。她为我们的城市带来了稳定、就业和战略价值。

original: Maven Black-Briar, the matriarch of the family, represents everything that's wrong with this city.
traduit: 玛雯·黑棘是这个家族的族长，代表了这个城市的所有错误。

original: She's bribed countless officials, has friends back in the Imperial City and freely associates with the Thieves Guild.
traduit: 她贿赂官员无数，在帝都也有朋友，还和盗贼公会随意往来。

original: I've tried everything I can to protect Riften's citizens from her family, but to no avail.
traduit: 我已经尽我所能保护裂谷城的公民不受她一家的伤害，但无济于事。

original: The Black-Briars have been instrumental in keeping Riften on the map.
traduit: 黑棘为裂谷存留于地图发挥了重要作用。

original: Before the meadery was opened almost fifty years ago, this town was nothing... a simple waypoint for those journeying on to Morrowind.
traduit: 在蜜酒庄开办的大概五十年前，这个小镇什么都不是……只是通往晨风的一个路标。

original: Now, thanks to my mother's generosity, this city is making its mark.
traduit: 现在，多亏我母亲的慷慨，这座城市开始崭露头角了。

original: Tell me about your family.
traduit: 跟我说说你的家族。

original: When speaking of the Black-Briars, only one thought should spring to mind. We are not to be trifled with.
traduit: 说到黑棘家族，我心里只有一个念头。我们不容愚弄。

original: Help us, you end up rich. Cross us and you'll end up a memory. Is that enough information for you?
traduit: 帮助我们，盆满钵满。背叛我们，变成回忆。这些信息对你来说还够吗？

original: Hmph. My family. All that wealth and they squander it on foolish ventures and political schemes.
traduit: 哎。我的家族。他们把所有财富都浪费在愚蠢的冒险和政治计划上。

original: I was meant for so much more than all of this... I wish to pledge my life and ply my talents in darker circles.
traduit: 我的人生意义远不止于此……我希望把生命和才能投入更黑暗的圈子里。

original: If only my mother would let me, I would make her proud.
traduit: 只要我母亲允许，我会让她感到骄傲。

original: What are the rumors of corruption you mentioned?
traduit: 你所提到的腐败谣言是什么？

original: There are those that believe the Jarl does nothing for this city... that it's corrupt and run by the Black-Briar family.
traduit: 有人认为领主对城市毫无贡献……城市已经腐败了，被黑棘家族掌控了。

original: I can assure you that this is entirely false. We are fully in control of everything.
traduit: 我可以向你保证，这是完全的错误。一切都在我们的掌控中。

original: Why would you want to leave Skyrim?
traduit: 你为什么要离开天际？

original: Are you serious? The war is tearing the land apart, the dragons have returned seeking who knows what... Skyrim is going nowhere fast.
traduit: 你是认真的？战争正在撕裂这片土地，龙族也回来了，谁知道他们在找什么……天际已经快完了。

original: If I were you, I'd pack up and get out of here before you end up in one of those burial cairns.
traduit: 如果我是你，我就收拾东西离开，免得被砸死在石头底下。

original: You treat all your customers like this?
traduit: 你对所有顾客都这态度吗？

original: Look, I've moved all over Skyrim selling these bits of junk and I'm barely scraping by.
traduit: 听着，我跑遍天际卖这些垃圾，只能勉强度日。

original: I'm not out to win friends and I could care less if you're happy about your purchase or not. I just need the coin.
traduit: 我不是来交朋友，也不在乎你是否对购物感到愉快。我只需要钱。

original: The sooner I get out of Skyrim the better.
traduit: 我要尽快离开天际才行。

original: By the Eight... you actually got your hands on it! This alone is worth more than some thieves earn in a lifetime.
traduit: 八圣灵啊……你真拿到手了！就这一件就比其他贼一辈子赚的还多了。

original: I managed to recover an Eye of the Falmer.
traduit: 我设法拿到了一颗伐莫之眼。

original: Must have come from Mercer's place. He'd admired the Gray Fox for some time. Sure, I'll buy it from you... here you are.
traduit: 肯定是从墨瑟家拿的吧。他崇拜灰狐有些日子了。当然，我买了……给你钱。

original: Found this bust of the Gray Fox. Worth anything?
traduit: 我找到这个灰狐半身像。值钱吗？

original: It's worth quite a bit actually. Quite a catch! Here you go, this should make you smile.
traduit: 确实值些钱。拿的好！钱给你，应该能够你乐的了。

original: Can I sell this Dwarven Puzzle Box to you?
traduit: 你愿意收这个矮人魔方吗？

original: What a delightful find! This should cover it.
traduit: 真是令人欣喜的发现！这些应该足够了。

original: Would this ship model be worth anything?
traduit: 这个船模值钱吗？

original: This should compensate you for your find.
traduit: 这个应该够支付你的发现了。

original: I found this map at the EETC. Interested?
traduit: 我在东帝国公司找到这张地图。有兴趣吗？

original: I can't do this. We shouldn't be here. I'm sorry.
traduit: 我做不到。我们不该来这里。抱歉。

original: A few hours sleep and we should be ready to continue through.
traduit: 睡几个小时，我们就可以继续前进了。

original: Best get rid of the ones we see. Just in case.
traduit: 最好干掉那些看到我们的。以防万一。

original: If you wish to talk, I'll be here for a bit.
traduit: 如果你想谈谈的话，我可以在这儿待一会儿。

original: Proceed down the hall to the gate when you're ready.
traduit: 准备好了就从大厅往大门那里走吧。

original: This way, please.
traduit: 请走这边。

original: Please hurry, we need to catch Mercer before he leaves Skyrim.
traduit: 请快点，我们得赶在墨瑟离开天际前抓住他。

original: Until next we meet, lad.
traduit: 下次见面再聊吧，小子。

original: Until next we meet, lass.
traduit: 下次见面再聊吧，姑娘。

original: Revenge? How interesting...
traduit: 复仇？何其有趣……

original: Very well, the conditions are acceptable. You may proceed.
traduit: 好，条件可以接受。你们继续吧。

original: My appetite for Mercer's demise exceeds my craving for wealth, Your Grace.
traduit: 我对墨瑟之死的渴望已经胜过了对财富的渴求，殿下。

original: Very well. I name your initiates Nightingale and I restore your status to the same, Karliah.
traduit: 很好。我给予你的新加入者夜莺之身份，并恢复你地位，卡莱亚。

original: And in the future, I'd suggest you refrain from disappointing me again.
traduit: 希望以后你别再让我失望了。

original: You surprise me, Karliah. This offer is definitely weighted in my favor.
traduit: 你真让我吃惊，卡莱亚。这个提议确实对我有利。

original: You're already mine, Karliah. Your terms were struck long ago. What could you possibly offer me now?
traduit: 你早已是我的了，卡莱亚。契约的条件早已注定。你现在还能给我什么？

original: Ah, Karliah. I was wondering when I'd hear from you again. Lose something did we?
traduit: 啊，卡莱亚。我还在想你什么时候会再次联络我。我们是不是丢了什么东西啊？

original: Before we depart, Brynjolf has some business to discuss. I suggest you listen to him.
traduit: 在咱们离开前，布林乔夫有话要说。我建议你先听听他的话。

original: If the Key isn't returned to its lock in the Twilight Sepulcher, things will never be the same for the Guild.
traduit: 如果钥匙不重新插回黄昏坟墓的锁眼上，公会将永无复兴之日。

original: As time passed, our luck would diminish to the point of non-existence. And whether you know it or not, our uncanny luck defines our trade.
traduit: 随着时间流逝，我们的运气会衰减到分毫不剩。不管你知不知道，不可思议的运气就是决定了咱们这个职业。

original: First time I ever set out to return something...
traduit: 这还是我第一次去还东西……

original: Very true. In our line of work, it's quite rare we set out to return a stolen item to its rightful owner.
traduit: 可太对了。在咱们这行，很少把偷来的东西物归原主。

original: You have returned with the gauntlets! Enter. Speak to our chief right away.
traduit: 你把护腕带回来了！请进吧。赶紧和我们酋长谈谈。

original: Return with the gauntlets, or not at all.
traduit: 要么带着护腕回来，要么就别再来了。

original: You cannot take this away from me!
traduit: 你休想从我这里夺走！

original: No! The Eye is mine!
traduit: 不！玛格努斯之眼是我的！

original: No! You will not deny me this!
traduit: 不！你没法打败我！

original: Erik the Slayer, huh? Sounds fearsome.
traduit: “嗜杀者”艾瑞克哈？听着挺吓人。

original: Father says I should pick a name that describes what I really am,  but nobody's going to hire Erik Greenthumb or Erik Hoe-pusher.
traduit: 父亲说我应该取个符合真实身份的绰号，但不会有人愿意雇“菜鸟”艾瑞克或者“挥锄人”艾瑞克。

original: No, I need a name that will put some fear in the hearts of my enemies. When I have some enemies, that is.
traduit: 所以我需要个能让敌人感到害怕的绰号。当我有敌人的时候。

original: On second thought, let's talk about this another time.
traduit: 想了想，还是回头再说吧。

original: Another time, or not at all. It's really none of your business, after all.
traduit: 下次再说，最好是再也别说。毕竟这真和你没关系。

original: How old are your horses?
traduit: 你的马多大了？

original: None of 'em's older than nine, and the youngest is six.
traduit: 都不超过九岁口，最小的才六岁。

original: Now, the horse I got for sale is seven years old, but in fine health. She's got a lot of spirit, that one.
traduit: 我现在要卖的那匹已经七岁了，不过身体不错、就是那个很有精神的。

original: We've taken to calling her Queen Alfsigr, or just Allie for short. I expect you can name her anything you like once she's yours.
traduit: 我们都叫她爱丽芙斯格尔女王，或者简单点叫爱丽。只要你买下她，想起什么名字随你意。

original: Your days of exploiting your son are over.
traduit: 你利用你儿子的日子结束了。

original: Exploiting? What's that supposed to mean? Erik works the farm because he's a good lad!
traduit: 利用？什么意思？艾瑞克在农场干活是因为他是个好孩子！

original: I'm not forcing him to stay here. I know that he wants a life of adventure, but I've told him before that I can't afford to buy him armor.
traduit: 我从没强迫他留在这里。我知道他想去冒险，但我之前告诉过他我买不起盔甲。

original: Tell me about Riften.
traduit: 跟我说说裂谷城吧。

original: You can get a room at the Bee and Barb, but mind your coin purse -- it's no secret the Thieves' Guild makes its home here.
traduit: 你可以去蜂与钩租间房，但一定要小心自己的钱包。盗贼公会在这里安家已经算不得秘密了。

original: Oh, and if you meet Maven Black-Briar, stay on her good side. This is her city, and nobody else's.
traduit: 哦，如果你见到玛雯·黑棘，要按她说的办。这里是她的城市，不归别人管。

original: What do you know about Solitude?
traduit: 你对独孤城了解多少？

original: Solitude's been the capital of Skyrim as long as I can remember. Most of the High Kings of Skyrim were Jarls of Solitude first.
traduit: 从我记事起，独孤城就是天际的首都了。天际大多数至高王起初都是独孤领主。

original: Ah, let's see, what else... The Bards College is here, and the main office of the East Empire Company.
traduit: 啊，让我想想还有什么……吟游诗人学院在这儿，东帝国公司总部也在这儿。

original: If you need it, you can get a room for a fair price at the Winking Skeever, just inside the main gate.
traduit: 如果有需要的话，可以去眨眼恶鼠租间房，价格还挺公道的，就在进正门不远。

original: What can you tell me about Windhelm?
traduit: 你能跟我说说风舵城吗？

original: It's an old city, I can tell you that. The Palace of the Kings is ancient.
traduit: 跟你说，这是座古城了。众王之殿年头不短了。

original: It's not the friendliest place for outsiders. The Dark Elves were all forced to live in a slum called the Gray Quarter.
traduit: 这里对外来者不太友好。暗精灵都被迫住在一个叫“灰民区”的贫民窟里。

original: The Argonians can't even live inside the walls. They're all stuck out on the docks.
traduit: 阿尔贡更惨，连城都进不去。都住在码头。

original: Still, Candlehearth Hall's got decent food and cheap bunks. You could do worse.
traduit: 不过，烛炉堂吃的住的都不错。也没那么糟。

original: What do you know about Whiterun?
traduit: 你对白漫城了解多少？

original: Well, I know the Companions make their home here. Their mead hall, Jorrvaskr, is the oldest building in the city.
traduit: 战友团在这里安家。他们的蜜酒大厅“月瓦斯卡”是这城里最古老的建筑了。

original: Oh, and there's a nasty feud between two families called the Gray-Manes and Battle-Borns. You'll want to be careful there.
traduit: 对了，两个家族有世仇，一个灰鬃，一个战狂。你要小心。

original: The rest you can find out by asking the townsfolk. I'd start with the barkeep at the Bannered Mare, or the castle steward.
traduit: 其他的你可以问问住在城里的人。是我的话就去悬旗母马酒馆或者找城堡的管家。

original: I don't care about the ring! Tell me what else I said! (Intimidate)
traduit: 我不在乎什么戒指！告诉我我还说了什么！（恐吓）

original: All right, all right. You're mean when you're sober.
traduit: 好吧，好吧。你清醒的时候怎么这么刻薄。

original: You said you the ceremony was going to be in Morvunskar. You said your friend Sam was going to be your best man.
traduit: 你说过，要在莫万斯卡举行婚礼。你说你朋友山姆会做你的伴郎。

original: You think you can bully me. I grew up with five brothers. Go... get...my...ring.
traduit: 你以为能欺负我不成。我和五个兄弟一起长大。去，把我，戒指，拿回来。

original: I just need to get to the wedding. Please. (Persuade)
traduit: 我得赶紧参加婚礼。求你了。（说服）

original: You must have had a wild night if you can't remember that.
traduit: 如果你记不起来，那你那晚肯定玩得很疯啊。

original: But I suppose everyone gets the jitters before their wedding. And I did say you could take a bit of time paying me back.
traduit: 但估计每个人在婚礼前都会紧张。所以我说过，允许你过段时间再还钱。

original: You said the ceremony was going to be at Morvunskar. Don't forget you still owe me!
traduit: 你说要在莫万斯卡举办婚礼。别忘了你还欠我的哦！

original: I'm sure your bride-to-be will tell you when you where the ceremony will be.
traduit: 我觉得你的婚约者会告诉你婚礼的地点。

original: If she still wants to marry you when you tell her you can't afford the ring.
traduit: 前提是你告诉她买不起戒指之后，她还愿意嫁给你。

original: Seriously, let me pay you for the ring. (2000 gold)
traduit: 戒指的钱我出了。（2000金币）

original: Decided to go through with it then? I knew you couldn't have forgotten about your fiance. You spoke of her so glowingly.
traduit: 决定付钱了？我就知道你不会忘记你的未婚妻。你每次提到她都会眉开眼笑。

original: I don't know much about Morvunskar but it sounded like a lovely place for the ceremony. Congratulations.
traduit: 我对莫万斯卡不太熟，但听起来是个举行婚礼的好地方。祝贺你。

original: I think I would prefer my ring back. I put a lot of time into making it and you just gave is away as a joke.
traduit: 我还是把戒指拿回来为好。我花了这么长时间制作，而你却因为一个玩笑把它拿走了。

original: Tell me everything and you won't end up like your goat. (Intimidate)
traduit: 把一切都告诉我，否则你就和你的山羊一样了。（恐吓）

original: Okay, okay. Most of what you said didn't make sense but you left a note. The only bit that I could read said "after repaying Ysolda in Whiterun."
traduit: 好吧，好吧。你说的大部分都狗屁不通，但留了张字条，我就看懂一句“把钱还给白漫城的伊索尔达之后”。

original: That's all I know.
traduit: 我就知道这些。

original: Do what you have to do, I'm not giving up on Gleda.
traduit: 该干什么干什么。我不会放弃格丽达的。

original: Help me retrace my steps and I'll pay you for the goat. (1000 gold)
traduit: 帮我找出我的行程，我会赔你的山羊。（1000金币）

original: Fine, but I'll still be missing my Gleda. Doubt I'll ever have a prize winning goat again.
traduit: 好吧。但我还是很想念格丽达。恐怕我再也养不出这么好的山羊了。

original: Most of what you said was gibberish but you left a note. The only bit I could read was "after repaying Ysolda in Whiterun."
traduit: 你说的大部分话都狗屁不通，不过留了一张字条。我只看懂了“把钱还给白漫城的伊索尔达之后”。

original: There's not enough money in the world to replace Gleda.
traduit: 钱取代不了格丽达。

original: Now, what did I say about that staff?
traduit: 我是怎么说那法杖来着？

original: You said a whole lot of nonsense about selling Gleda to hire a priestess for some big event.
traduit: 你说了一堆胡话，要卖掉格丽达，为了什么大事去贿赂一个女祭司。

original: There was a bit of talk about some staff you had in safe keeping. Never said where, but you sure didn't have it with you!
traduit: 我们还聊起了你的法杖。没说在哪儿，但肯定没在你身上！

original: I need to find Sam and the staff, in order to get Gleda back. (Persuade)
traduit: 为了找回格丽达，我需要找到山姆和法杖。（说服）

original: I suppose that makes sense. You didn't mention a Sam and nothing you said about the staff made sense.
traduit: 有道理。你没提到山姆，关于法杖也是一堆胡言乱语。

original: You left a note but it was mostly gibberish, the only bit I could make out was "after repaying Ysolda in Whiterun."
traduit: 你留了张字条，不过太潦草了，我只看懂一句“把钱还给白漫城的伊索尔达之后”。

original: You didn't seem to need either to sell Gleda to the Giant in the first place. I think you'll figure it out.
traduit: 看来你一开始就不需要把格丽达卖给巨人。我想你会明白过来的。

original: Tell me how I got here and I'll pay for the damages. (<BribeCost> gold)
traduit: 告诉我，我是怎么来的，我会赔偿损失。（<BribeCost>金币）

original: Well, we can always use contributions.
traduit: 好吧，我们时常接受捐赠。

original: You were ranting when you got here  but most of it was slurred. You did say something about Rorikstead . Maybe you should take a look there.
traduit: 你刚来的时候大喊大叫，模糊不清。不过你说了洛利克镇。也许你该去那里看看。

original: Oh you must be nobility of some sort. Running around partying and paying others to clean it up.
traduit: 哦，你一定很有钱吧。到处开宴会，还花钱请别人打扫。

original: I don't think so. Clean up your own mess.
traduit: 我可不这么想。自己收拾好。

original: I'm sorry, I don't even remember how I got here. (Persuade)
traduit: 抱歉，我都不记得自己怎么来的了。（说服）

original: Well, you were deep in your cups when you got here.
traduit: 好吧，你来的时候喝得酩酊大醉。

original: You were ranting but most of it was slurred. You said something about Rorikstead.
traduit: 一直大喊大叫，还听不清说的是什么。不过你倒是提到了洛利克镇。

original: Oh, I'd love to help you figure it out, but I'm so busy cleaning up the mess you made of our temple...
traduit: 我也很想帮你搞清楚，但我正忙着收拾被你搞的一团糟的神殿……

original: Now if you were to help tidy up and perhaps apologize afterwards... I might be able to help you.
traduit: 现在，如果你帮我收拾一下，然后道个歉……我也许会帮你。

original: You're going to assault Northwatch Keep?
traduit: 你要攻击北望堡垒？

original: I'll do anything if it means saving my brother. You'll join us, won't you?
traduit: 只要能救我兄弟，我什么都愿意干。你会跟我们一起对吧？

original: Thorald can't be left to those... monsters.
traduit: 不能把索拉德留给那些……怪物。

original: Lingrah krosis saraan Strundu'ul, voth nid balaan klov praan nau.
traduit: 灵嘎 科洛西斯 撒然 斯特朗都'乌尔，沃斯 聂德 巴兰 克罗夫 普兰 恼。

original: Stand between us, and prepare yourself. Few can withstand the unbridled Voice of the Greybeards. But you are ready.
traduit: 站在我们中间，做好准备。很少有人能抵挡灰胡子全力的吼声。但你应该可以。

original: You have completed your training, Dragonborn. We would Speak to you.
traduit: 龙裔，你完成了你的训练。我们要与你“谈谈”。

original: Dah...
Meyz nu Ysmir, Dovahsebrom. Dahmaan daar rok.
traduit: 梅兹 努 伊斯米尔，都瓦瑟布罗姆。达曼 达尔 若克。

original: Naal Thu'umu, mu ofan nii nu, Dovahkiin, naal suleyk do Kaan, naal suleyk do Shor, ahrk naal suleyk do Atmorasewuth.
traduit: 纳尔 吐'目乌，姆 欧法 尼依 努，都瓦克因，纳尔 苏勒耶 都 凯恩，纳尔 苏勒耶 都 舒尔，阿克 纳尔 苏勒耶 都 阿特莫拉瑟乌斯。

original: Let me know. We shouldn't stay here all day. My men want their mead.
traduit: 准备好就告诉我。我们不能成天待在这里。我的部下正期待庆功酒呢。

original: Are you ready to go?
traduit: 准备好出发了吗？

original: Do I have to beat it out of you? (Brawl)
traduit: 非要我逼你说出来吗？（打架）

original: So, what's the word around the Guild?
traduit: 公会有什么消息吗？

original: I haven't seen so much celebrating in years. Mercer's dead, we have a new Guild Master and things are finally looking up.
traduit: 我有好些年没见过这么多庆祝了。墨瑟死了，我们有了新的公会大师，事情总算见好了。

original: Business is booming, coin is flowing and everyone seems content as things keep going our way.
traduit: 生意兴隆，财源滚滚，每个人都对事情的发展很满意。

original: A new chapter in the Thieves Guild is being written this day and we all owe it to you. Many thanks.
traduit: 盗贼公会的新篇章现在正在被书写，我们都该感谢你。多谢了。

original: I only hope we can restore the Guild to its former glory after all the damage that's been done.
traduit: 我只希望在经历这么多伤害之后，我们能让公会重现往日的荣光。

original: So, word has it you and Brynjolf know where Mercer's hiding. Good.
traduit: 听说你和布林乔夫找到墨瑟藏在哪儿了。很好。

original: Make sure you make him pay for what he did to Gallus... heck, for what he did to all of us.
traduit: 一定要让他为他对加卢斯做的事付出代价……该死的，是为他对我们的一切所作所为。

original: We're all behind you, friend. Do your best.
traduit: 我们都支持你，朋友。尽力去做吧。

original: The word is that Mercer Frey is a dead man. The Guild wants his blood.
traduit: 都说墨瑟·弗雷现在死定了。公会的人都想要些他的血呢。

original: I can't say I blame them. Murder is not our way. Gallus was before my time, but I still can't believe it.
traduit: 这也不怪他们。虽说咱们不靠杀人解决问题。我来的时候加卢斯已经死了，但我还是无法相信。

original: You need to teach him a lesson... show him the penalty for betrayal around here.
traduit: 你得去给他个教训……让他见识一下背叛的下场。

original: Look, I like you, so I'll tell it to you straight. Brynjolf and the rest are in the Guild, and they're ready to cut you down.
traduit: 听着，我很中意你，所以我就直说了。布林乔夫和其他人都在公会里，他们准备好要做了你了。

original: I know you have a damn good reason for siding with Karliah, so I hope you can give it to them.
traduit: 我知道你有充分的理由支持卡莱亚，所以希望你能告诉他们。

original: Everyone's been worried since you and Mercer haven't shown up in a while. Brynjolf even went out to find you.
traduit: 你和墨瑟有段时间没回来了，大家都很担心。布林乔夫还出去找过你。

original: Delvin and Vex have been running things for now.
traduit: 现在是戴尔文和小烦在操持着。

original: I hope this all gets straightened out soon or I'm headed on the first caravan out of Riften.
traduit: 我希望这一切能尽快解决，否则我就直接搭车离开裂谷城了。

original: Glad to hear Gulum-Ei got what he deserved. That lizard owes me big for a bad shipment of Shadowbanish Wine he tried to pass off on me.
traduit: 很高兴听到古鲁姆-埃遭报应了。那只蜥蜴欠我一大笔钱，他卖给我的驱影酒根本不好卖。

original: Mercer's been storming around waiting for you to come back. I think he's finally figured out who's been messing with the Guild.
traduit: 墨瑟一直等你回来。我猜他是知道是谁在招惹公会了。

original: Never seen the guy so angry. Better help him out any way you can.
traduit: 从没见过他这么生气。你最好尽力帮他办好。

original: Maven was down here right before you got back and she was all smiles. Haven't seen her like that in a long time.
traduit: 玛雯在你回来前来过，她笑得很开心。很久没见她那样了。

original: Whatever you did at Honningbrew, you're now on her good side. Best of all, if she's happy, Mercer's happy.
traduit: 不管你在蜜之酿干了什么，她现在对你很满意。关键是，只要她开心，墨瑟也会开心。

original: Keep it up and you'll go places.
traduit: 坚持下去，你会成功的。

original: Well, you did something Vex couldn't do at Goldenglow, so you're looking pretty damn good.
traduit: 嗯，你在金色光辉做到了小烦没做到的事，你看起来还不赖。

original: Word is that you found something while you were out there though... something that could be a problem for the Guild.
traduit: 有消息说你在外面发现了一些东西……这对公会来说可能是个问题。

original: Just watch your back and do what Mercer says... he'll sort it out.
traduit: 小心点，照墨瑟说的办……他会解决的。

original: I don't know about the others, but I sure am glad to see a fresh face down here.
traduit: 我不知道其他人怎么想，但我很高兴能在这里看到新面孔。

original: The Flagon used to be packed every night with the boys from the Guild but now look at it.
traduit: 以前漏壶每晚都挤满公会里的小伙子，但看看现在。

original: Last few years have been pretty bad. I've almost closed this place up.
traduit: 过去几年很糟糕，我差点把这里关了。

original: Can you share anything about the Thieves Guild?
traduit: 你能跟我分享些关于盗贼公会的事吗？

original: I don't know you so we've got nothing to talk about. How about you finish the job Brynjolf gave you, then we can talk.
traduit: 我不认识你，所以没什么可说的。不如你把布林乔夫交代的差事办完再聊吧。

original: Sure. How about you mind your own business about it, and I won't have to get Dirge to toss you into the cistern?
traduit: 行啊。你管好自己的事怎么样，这样我就不用喊挽歌把你扔进水槽里了。

original: You're not from Riften?
traduit: 你不是裂谷城的人吗？

original: I've been adventuring across Tamriel since I was a fresh-faced young woman barely able to swing a blade.
traduit: 从我还是个连刀都不会挥的小姑娘开始，我就在泰姆瑞尔四处冒险了。

original: My travels have taken me from High Rock to Valenwood, Elsweyr to Morrowind and all points in between.
traduit: 我的足迹从高岩到威伦森林，从艾斯维尔到晨风，还有其间所有地方。

original: Why is your shop down here in the canal?
traduit: 你为什么把店开在运河旁边？

original: The moisture in the air is better for the ingredients. It isn't every day that you get your hands on fresh nirnroot or painted troll fat.
traduit: 水气足一点对原料有好处。不是每天都能弄到新鲜的奈恩根或者刚刮下来的画中巨魔脂肪。

original: It also makes it easier to gather water when the canal is right out the front door.
traduit: 运河在正门外面，取水就方便多了。

original: Besides, I also prefer the quiet. I didn't open this business for browsing. Come in, buy what you need and get out.
traduit: 此外，我更喜欢安静。我开店不是为了搞展览。进来，买了想要的，然后就出去。

original: How did you come to be known as Horse-Crusher?
traduit: 你为什么被称为“碾马者”？

original: Been stuck with the name for years.
traduit: 我用这名字好多年了。

original: I've been ridin' horses since I was a lad... nothin' I liked more. But as I got bigger, so did my mounts.
traduit: 我从小就开始骑马……非常喜欢。但随着我长大，坐骑也得变大。

original: Then one day, I was drunker than I've ever been and mounted a poor colt. Broke his back in two. Haven't ridden since.
traduit: 然后有一天，我喝多了骑上了一匹可怜的小马。把它的背脊摔成两半了。自那以后我就不骑马了。

original: I imagine current events are keeping you busy.
traduit: 时事如此让你很忙吧。

original: People say I'm making gold off of other people's misery, but what else would I do? Smithing is all I know.
traduit: 人们说我是在从别人的痛苦中赚钱，但我还能做什么？我只会打铁。

original: Next time one of my shields deflects a killing blow, they'll change their tune.
traduit: 下次等我的盾牌帮他们挡住致命一击的时候，他们就不会这么说了。

original: I'll donate some other time.
traduit: 我改天再捐吧。

original: As you wish. Whatever you can afford will certainly be put to good use.
traduit: 如你所愿。无论你捐多少，我们都会善用的。

original: I'd like to donate. (5 gold)
traduit: 我想捐些款。（5金币）

original: Thank you! I can promise you that this will be put to good use.
traduit: 谢谢！我保证这些钱会得到善用的。

original: Do you accept charity?
traduit: 你们接受捐赠吗？

original: Of course! I'd be more than happy to add a donation to our charity box.
traduit: 当然！我很乐意给我们的捐款箱里再添一笔。

original: Right now, the best you could provide is coin. We need all the help we can get.
traduit: 现在，你能提供的最好东西就是金币了。我们需要能得到的所有帮助。

original: You sound quite charitable.
traduit: 你听起来很仁慈啊。

original: Yes, I suppose someone has to be around here. Have you seen the condition of this sorry excuse for a city?
traduit: 是的，我想这附近总会有人需要帮助。你看见这座可怜城市的状况了吗？

original: Beggars roam the streets, crime runs rampant and the threat of war is driving away business.
traduit: 乞丐游荡，犯罪猖獗，战争威胁，这一切让商业望而却步。

original: The paltry amount of coin that I place in the charity box at the temple is the least I can do to help.
traduit: 我往神殿的慈善箱里放的那点钱是我能帮上的最起码的一点忙了。

original: Lady Maven could buy or sell anyone in Skyrim. I wouldn't be surprised if she's the one pulling the strings around this city.
traduit: 玛雯女士可以买通或者出卖天际的任何人。如果她是这座城市的幕后操纵者，我一点也不惊讶。

original: She's always welcome in Mistveil Keep and between you and me, I'm pretty sure she even has some pretty influential friends within the Empire.
traduit: 她在雾隐堡垒很受欢迎，我跟你说，我确信她在帝国内部有一些很有权势的朋友。

original: I'd also warn you not to cross her. She employs quite a few... troubleshooters  to take care of messy problems.
traduit: 我得警告你，别去惹她。她雇了不少……解决麻烦的。

original: You run the Black-Briar Meadery?
traduit: 你是黑棘蜜酒庄的经营者？

original: Maven Black-Briar wants me to keep the mead flowing and that's what I aim to do despite all these lazy good-for-nothings that work for us.
traduit: 玛雯·黑棘要我保持蜜酒持续出产，这就是我的目标。尽管是这群懒鬼在替我们工作。

original: Ever since I took over as the foreman the production of our mead has never been more profitable.
traduit: 自从我担任工头后，我们的蜜酒从没这么有利可图过。

original: And if the meadery is profitable, I get rich. Get the picture?
traduit: 只要蜜酒庄有钱赚，我也跟着发财。明白了？

original: He's the protector of Man, the Dragon of the North, the patron of all Nords.
traduit: 他是人类的守护者、北方巨龙、全诺德人的守护神。

original: And despite the Imperials and their treaty, he will always be one of the Nine Divines.
traduit: 尽管帝国人和他们的条约否认这点，但他永远是九圣灵之一。

original: A devout Nord would rather fall in battle and have his blood spill upon the earth than allow the Empire to strike his name from the divinity.
traduit: 一个虔诚的诺德人宁可战死沙场，抛头洒血，也不愿帝国把他的名号从神谱中抹去。

original: Not well I'm afraid. That Brynjolf... he keeps draining the people's pockets with his ridiculous miracle cures.
traduit: 恐怕不太行。布林乔夫……他不断用他那个荒谬的神药榨取人们的钱包。

original: A few months ago it was troll fat salve and now he's got something new.
traduit: 几个月前是巨魔脂肪药膏，现在又换新的了。

original: Not that there's anything that can be done about it. He's in good with the Thieves Guild.
traduit: 我们也做不了什么。他和盗贼公会关系不错。

original: I take it you protect the Jarl?
traduit: 你是在保护领主吧？

original: Indeed. There have been multiple attempts on the Jarl's life. We're not certain if it's the Dark Brotherhood or simply Imperial sympathizers.
traduit: 没错。有很多人想刺杀领主。我们也不确定是黑暗兄弟会还是单纯的帝国支持者。

original: We've also had run-ins with spies attempting to probe our security for weaknesses. I work with the city guard to make certain they fail.
traduit: 我们还遇到过试图探查安全漏洞的奸细。我和城市卫兵一起把他们破获了。

original: At the end of the day, I'm the last line of defense for the Jarl. I will not allow her to fall.
traduit: 说到底，我是领主的最后防线。我不会让她受到伤害的。

original: As long as she continues to keep me at her side, she can count on my blade to protect her.
traduit: 只要她继续把我留在身边，我的剑就会一直保护她。

original: To be honest, I doubt someone would be stupid enough to make an attempt on Maven... sorry, Jarl Maven's life.
traduit: 老实说，我怀疑会不会真有人尝试对玛雯……抱歉，领主玛雯不利。

original: But just in case, I'll be ready for them.
traduit: 但以防万一，我会准备好的。

original: What is the White-Gold Concordat?
traduit: 白金协定是什么？

original: Surely you're aware of the Great War between the Imperials and the Elves who called themselves the Aldmeri Dominion?
traduit: 你肯定知道帝国和自称先祖神洲的精灵间爆发的浩大战争吧？

original: When the smoke cleared, the White-Gold Concordat was signed... it was supposedly a treaty aimed at establishing peace within the Empire.
traduit: 硝烟散去，《白金协定》就签署了……被认定为旨在建立帝国内部和平的条约。

original: One of the terms of the treaty was the outlawing of worship to Talos.
traduit: 条款之一就是取缔塔洛斯崇拜。

original: To the Stormcloaks, this was viewed as the moment when the Empire became unworthy of the allegiance of any true Nord.
traduit: 对于风暴斗篷来说，这是帝国不再值得任何一个真正诺德人忠诚的一刻。

original: What of Ulfric himself?
traduit: 乌弗瑞克自己呢？

original: With the Stormcloaks at his back, Ulfric's poised to rid Skyrim of the Empire's forces and invalidate our involvement with the White-Gold Concordat.
traduit: 在风暴斗篷的支持下，乌弗瑞克准备除掉天际的帝国军队并取消我们和白金协定的关系。

original: Between you and I, I think his motivations are a bit more self-serving. He uses this holy war as leverage in order to pursue the throne.
traduit: 但只你知我知，我觉得他的动机更自私点。他是要利用这场圣战做追求王位的筹码。

original: If he were to be crowned High King, I'm not so certain it would be the golden age his followers expect.
traduit: 如果他真被加冕为至高王，我不确定真的就是他的追随者们期望的黄金时代。

original: Many have died taking up arms for this cause. I fear that the land will be stained with blood for years to come.
traduit: 许多人为此牺牲，拿起武器。我担心这片土地在未来的岁月被鲜血污染。

original: What's your stance on the war?
traduit: 你对这场战争怎么看？

original: While I feel Ulfric's cause is just, my concern is for the people of The Rift.
traduit: 虽然我觉得乌弗瑞克的事业是正确的，但我关心的是裂痕领的人民。

original: How can they continue to lead their already meager lives with dark clouds looming overhead?
traduit: 在乌云密布之下，他们还能继续过自己贫瘠的生活吗？

original: My heart goes out to them. If only our coffers were deeper, I could protect them as they were my own family.
traduit: 我很同情他们，如果我们的金库再大一点，我就能像保护自己家人一样保护他们了。

original: You seem to be well acquainted with wealth.
traduit: 你似乎很了解财富啊。

original: Wealth is my business. Help me out and I can add to yours. Would you like a taste?
traduit: 财富就是我的业务。你帮我，我就能帮你。想试试吗？

original: Maybe I should visit that farm in Morrowind.
traduit: 也许我应该拜访一下晨风的农场。

original: How could you possibly know about...
traduit: 你怎么会知道……

original: Please. My family means too much to me. Don't hurt them.
traduit: 拜托，我的家人对我很重要。不要伤害他们。

original: Don't say I didn't warn you. (Brawl)
traduit: 别说我没警告过你。（打架）

original: Come on, give it your best shot!
traduit: 来啊，有什么本事都使出来吧！

original: I think you need to shut your mouth. (Brawl)
traduit: 我觉得你该闭嘴了。（打架）

original: I'm going to make you sorry for this!
traduit: 我会让你后悔的！

original: I can't thank you enough for what you did.
traduit: 感谢你所做的一切。

original: The East Empire Company is in your debt.
traduit: 东帝国公司欠你一份情。

original: Glad Orthus was able to find someone competent to help out.
traduit: 奥苏斯能找到能干的人帮忙真是太好了。

original: You handled yourself pretty well back at Japhet's Folly. We'll remember that.
traduit: 你在贾菲特之愚表现得很好。我们会记住的。

original: Do you like it out here, away from everything?
traduit: 你喜欢这里远离一切的生活吗？

original: Other people just make things complex. Out here, Hern and I can get everything we need from the occasional traveler.
traduit: 其他人喜欢把事情复杂化。在这里，我和赫恩能从偶尔路过的旅行者那里得到需要的一切。

original: What locations does this mill supply?
traduit: 这家木材厂向哪里供货？

original: We supply Falkreath to the south. Until recently we supplied Helgen.
traduit: 我们向南边的佛克瑞斯供货。最近还为海尔根供应。

original: Falkreath trades with the surrounding holds and without our wood they would have trouble keeping their prices low.
traduit: 佛克瑞斯和周围的领地做生意，如果没有我们的木材，他们很难保持低价的。

original: Do you get many guests?
traduit: 你这里客人多吗？

original: We have guests as often as we can but there aren't a lot of travellers these days. The war keeps people off the roads.
traduit: 我们尽可能多接待客人，但现在没有那么多旅客。战争使人们都远离大路了。

original: Hey! It's the bard-to-be.
traduit: 嘿！是那个准吟游诗人。

original: We will see about this...
traduit: 我们还是走着看吧……

original: I'm sorry, were you about to say something?
traduit: 不好意思，你想说什么吗？

original: Ayleid, Dwemer, Daedric... Not even Falmer. None of them are a match. Quite curious indeed.
traduit: 亚历德、锻莫、迪德拉……甚至伐莫。都不能匹配。确实很神奇。

original: Surely there's more you can tell me.
traduit: 你肯定能告诉我更多。

original: There is indeed much that we know that you do not. That does not mean that you are ready to understand it.
traduit: 我们确实知道很多你不知道的事。但这不意味着你准备好去接受它了。

original: Do not let your easy mastery of the Voice tempt you into the arrogance of power that has been the downfall of many Dragonborn before you.
traduit: 不要自恃能够轻松掌握龙吼就目中无人，在你之前有不少龙裔因此堕落。

original: Thank you, Master. I will continue my training.
traduit: 大师，谢谢你。我会继续训练的。

original: Good. Then you will be ready for whatever lies ahead.
traduit: 很好。然后你就能为未来的一切做好准备了。

original: I will try to follow the Way of the Voice.
traduit: 我会试着遵循吼声之道的。

original: That is commendable. But remember, the Dragon Blood is itself a gift of Akatosh. Do not try to deny that gift.
traduit: 值得称赞。但你要记住，龙血本就是阿卡托什的赐福，不要试着否定它。

original: Your destiny requires you to use your Voice - why else would Akatosh have bestowed this power upon you?
traduit: 你命中注定要使用你的吼声，不然阿卡托什为何要把力量赐予你？

original: If you remember to use your Voice in service to the purpose of Akatosh, you will remain true to the Way.
traduit: 只要你能铭记用自己的吼声服务于阿卡托什的目标，那你就能走上正途。

original: But I don't follow your philosophy. Why help me learn the Voice?
traduit: 但我并不遵循你的学说。那你们为什么帮助我学习吼声？

original: The Dragonborn is an exception to all the rules - the Dragon Blood itself is a gift of the gods.
traduit: 龙裔是可以论外的，龙血本身就是众神的馈赠。

original: If we accept one gift, how can we deny the other? As Dragonborn, you have received the ability to Shout directly from Akatosh.
traduit: 我们不能因为接受一份礼物就拒绝其他礼物吧？作为龙裔，你直接从阿卡托什那里获取了龙吼的能力。

original: We therefore seek to guide you on the proper use of your gift, which transcends the restrictions which bind other mortals.
traduit: 所以我们争取引导你正确使用你的天赋，这种天赋能超越束缚在其他凡人身上的限制。

original: Who was Jurgen Windcaller?
traduit: “唤风者”约根是谁？

original: He was a great war leader of the ancient Nords, a master of the Voice, or Tongue.
traduit: 他是古诺德的伟大战争领袖，吼声大师，发声者。

original: After the disaster at Red Mountain, where the Nord army was annihilated, he spent many years pondering the meaning of that terrible defeat.
traduit: 在诺德军队在红山被击溃后，他花费数年来思考那场可怕失败的意义所在。

original: He finally came to realize that the gods had punished the Nords for their arrogant and blasphemous misuse of the Voice.
traduit: 最后他意识到，诸神因为诺德人傲慢而亵渎地滥用吼声而降下了惩罚。

original: He was the first to understand that the Voice should be used solely for the glory and worship of the gods, not the glory of men.
traduit: 他首先领悟出，吼声只能用于礼敬和荣耀神明，而不应该用于荣耀人类。

original: Jurgen Windcaller's mastery of the Voice eventually overcame all opposition, and the Way of the Voice was born.
traduit: “唤风者”约根对吼声的精通最终压制了所有反对者，并创立了吼声之道。

original: What did you actually say?
traduit: 你们到底说了什么？

original: Ah. I sometimes forget you are not versed in the dragon tongue as we are. This is a rough translation:
traduit: 啊，我偶尔会忘了你不像我们那样精通龙语。我简单翻译一下：

original: "Long has the Stormcrown languished, with no worthy brow to sit upon."
traduit: “风暴王冠凋谢已久，无人有资格佩戴。”

original: "By our breath we bestow it now to you in the name of Kyne, in the name of Shor, and in the name of Atmora of Old."
traduit: “我们现在以凯娜、舒尔以及古老阿特莫拉之名，将它赐予你。”

original: "You are Ysmir now, the Dragon of the North, hearken to it."
traduit: “你如今即是伊斯米尔，北方巨龙，倾听吧。”

original: What was that ceremony all about? Were you Shouting at me?
traduit: 那个仪式是怎么回事？你在对我使用龙吼？

original: We spoke the traditional words of greeting to a Dragonborn who has accepted our guidance.
traduit: 我们在向接受了指引的龙裔致以传统的问候之语。

original: The same words were used to greet the young Talos, when he came to High Hrothgar, before he became the Emperor Tiber Septim.
traduit: 年轻的塔洛斯在成为皇帝泰伯·塞普汀之前，来到霍斯加修道院的时候，也被致以同样的问候。

original: Goodbye, my love.
traduit: 再见，亲爱的。

original: Bye, love.
traduit: 再见，亲爱的。

original: Conquer your enemies, my love.
traduit: 去征服你的敌人吧，亲爱的。

original: I'll be here if you need me, love.
traduit: 需要我的时候，我都在这儿，亲爱的。

original: You're going? I'll miss you, dear.
traduit: 要走吗？我会想你的，亲爱的。

original: Leaving? Take the world by storm, dearest.
traduit: 要走吗？为整个世界带来风暴吧，挚爱。

original: I'll be here, my dear.
traduit: 我就在这儿，亲爱的。

original: Who runs the show at Honningbrew Meadery?
traduit: 蜜之酿酒庄老板是谁？

original: Some layabout named Sabjorn.
traduit: 一个叫撒布乔恩的懒汉。

original: Been a thorn in my side for the last few years now.
traduit: 这几年一直是我的眼中钉。

original: You might want to rethink that. You're missing out on some wonderful opportunities, working in that bar.
traduit: 你可以重新考虑一下的。在酒馆工作什么时候能出头。

original: I'm not interested, Jaree. It doesn't matter how many times you ask.
traduit: 我没兴趣，加雷。问多少次也没用。

original: Degaine the beggar got himself kicked out the Temple of Dibella. Caused quite the ruckus.
traduit: 乞丐德加因被赶出了迪贝拉神殿。引起的骚动可不小啊。

original: Skjor was looking for you, earlier.
traduit: 刚才斯科约尔要找你。

original: I'm looking for the Staff of Magnus.
traduit: 我在找玛格努斯之杖。

original: Are you?
traduit: 是吗？

original: Well. I'm afraid I can't help you with that. I need the crystal to do anything useful, and I don't have it.
traduit: 嗯。恐怕我帮不了你。任何事都离不开水晶，但我手里没有。

original: *Sigh*... and that's the last one. All right, enough of this.
traduit: （叹息）……这是最后一个。好了，够了。

original: C'mon, let's get something to eat.
traduit: 走吧，我们去吃点东西。

original: Would you mind cooking something for me?
traduit: 你能帮我煮点东西吃吗？

original: Here, this is fresh. I'll have another meal ready tomorrow.
traduit: 给，刚做好的。明天我再准备点别的。

original: Here. Wouldn't want you going into a fight on an empty stomach. I'll have another meal ready tomorrow.
traduit: 给。可不能让你空着肚子去作战。明天我再准备点新的。

original: A warrior marches on the gut. Here. This should give you strength. I'll cook another tomorrow.
traduit: 战士就是凭着胃口前进的。给。能够带给你力量。明天我再做新的。

original: Here. This is from a recipe my people have passed on to me. I can cook another tomorrow.
traduit: 给。这是我族人传给我的秘方。我明天再做新的。

original: Here you are. I added a little mead into the recipe. I think it tastes better. Let me know what you think tomorrow, I'll make another one.
traduit: 给你。我在食谱的基础上加了一丁点蜜酒。我感觉味道更好了。明天说说感受，到时候我再做新的。

original: I should be asking you the same question, but all right. I'll cook. Here, try this, and don't you dare ask for another one before tomorrow.
traduit: 我本来也想问你同样的问题呢，但好吧。我来做。来尝尝这个，明天之前就别再喊饿了。

original: I can. Here. This is fresh. I'll have another one made tomorrow.
traduit: 可以啊。刚做好的。明天我再做新的。

original: I have the Elder Scroll.
traduit: 我拿到上古卷轴了。

original: You have it. The Kel - the Elder Scroll. Tiid kreh... qalos. Time shudders at its touch.
traduit: 你找到了。科尔……上古卷轴。提德 科瑞……洽洛斯。时间在它的触摸下颤抖。

original: There is no question. You are doom-driven. Kogaan Akatosh. The very bones of the earth are at your disposal.
traduit: 毫无疑问。你果然受末日驱策而来。寇甘 阿卡托什。地骨由你处置。

original: Go then. Fulfill your destiny. Take the Scroll to the Time-Wound.
traduit: 去吧。回应你的命运。到时之痕使用卷轴吧。

original: Do not delay. Alduin will be coming. He cannot miss the signs.
traduit: 不要犹豫。奥杜因要来了。他不会错过机会的。

original: Do not delay. Alduin must feel the tremors in Time by the Scroll's presence here. He will know what it means.
traduit: 不要犹豫。奥杜因肯定感受到了上古卷轴在此引发的时间震颤。他知道意味着什么。

original: Use Dragonrend! It is the only chance to defeat him!
traduit: 快用龙魂撕裂！这是打败他的唯一机会！

original: He is too strong on the wing! Bring him to gol with Dragonrend!
traduit: 他的翅膀过于强大！用龙魂撕裂把他带到戈尔上！

original: Use Dragonrend, Dovahkiin!
traduit: 都瓦克因，快用龙魂撕裂！

original: Dovahkiin, vosaraan! Use Dragonrend before Alduin consumes you!
traduit: 都瓦克因，沃萨兰！再不用龙魂撕裂奥杜因就要把你吞了！

original: Now, Dovahkiin! Now he is vulnerable!
traduit: 就是现在，都瓦克因！他现在很脆弱！

original: This is your chance, Dovahkiin! Strike with all your force!
traduit: 好机会，都瓦克因！全力进攻！

original: Hurt him while he is grounded!
traduit: 在他被禁锢的时候攻击他！

original: Ruth wah nivahriin joor!
traduit: 鲁斯 瓦 尼瓦瑞因 约尔！

original: Aav uv dir. Join me or perish with your mortal friends.
traduit: 阿瓦 乌维 迪尔。臣服我，或者跟你的凡人朋友一起灭亡。

original: Kynesgrove is this way. We can travel together or split up and meet there, your choice.
traduit: 凯娜之林走这边。我们可以一起去，也可以到那碰头。你自己选吧。

original: That's better. Let's get on the road to Kynesgrove.
traduit: 好多了。我们上路去凯娜之林。

original: I think you're looking for this.
traduit: 我想你是在找这个。

original: When he shows up here and vouches for you, then I'll see what I can do for you.
traduit: 先等他来给你做做保证。我再看看能帮你些什么。

original: Closest town from here is Riverwood. My uncle's the blacksmith there. I'm sure he'd help you out.
traduit: 离这儿最近的是河木镇。我叔叔是那里的铁匠。他肯定会帮你的。

original: Listen, you should go to Solitude and join up with the Imperial Legion. We could really use someone like you.
traduit: 听着，你应该到独孤城加入帝国军团。我们真的很需要你这样的人。

original: And if the rebels have themselves a dragon, General Tullius is the only one who can stop them.
traduit: 如果叛军有一头龙，那图留斯将军就是唯一能阻止他们的人。

original: Place the crystal in the central apparatus, and we can start the process for focusing it.
traduit: 把水晶放到中央的装置里，我们就可以开始聚焦了。

original: Took an incredible amount of work to get it running again. Now I'm hoping it'll all be worth it.
traduit: 让它重新运转花了大工夫。希望一切都值得。

original: Here it is. Magnificent, isn't it?
traduit: 看看。很宏伟吧？

original: No one seems to know. Perhaps the return of the Dwemer. Perhaps the end of the world.
traduit: 没人知道。也许是锻莫的回归。也许是世界末日。

original: Waiting for what?
traduit: 等什么呢？

original: I'll be glad to help you. There are many ways to improve your home, provided you have the coin.
traduit: 乐意帮助。有很多方案可以改善你的住宅，只要你有钱的话。

original: And of course, don't forget to consult your Home Decorating Guide for descriptions of the decorations you can buy.
traduit: 当然，请不要忘记浏览家装指南，了解您能买到的装饰。

original: Now, what would you like to purchase?
traduit: 好了，你想买些什么？

original: You've already purchased every available improvement. I'm afraid I have nothing else to offer you.
traduit: 你已经购买过所有可改进的项目了。恐怕我没什么可提供给你的了。

original: Splendid! There's a house available right now.
traduit: 太好了！现在刚好有一套。

original: The house I mentioned earlier is still available, if you want to buy it.
traduit: 如果你想买的话，我前面提的那栋房子还在出售。

original: I'd like to purchase a house in the city. (10,000 gold)
traduit: 我想在城里买套房。（10000金币）

original: Wonderful! Here is the key to your new home.
traduit: 太好了！这是您新家的钥匙。

original: Very well, just let me know when you're ready to purchase the house.
traduit: 很好，你准备买的时候请通知我。

original: Very well, just let me know when you have the necessary funds.
traduit: 好吧，你有足够的资金之后，请告诉我。

original: Is there anything else you'd like to purchase?
traduit: 还想买别的东西吗？

original: As you wish. Speak to me again if you decide to purchase some decorations for your home.
traduit: 如你所愿。如果还想装修的话，请随时来告诉我。

original: Never mind, I don't want to purchase decorations right now.
traduit: 算了，我现在不想装修。

original: I'm sorry, but you don't seem to have enough gold to pay for that.
traduit: 抱歉，你现在的钱好像不大够。

original: Kitchen furnishings. (<Global=HDWhiterunKitchen> gold)
traduit: 厨房家具。（<Global=HDWhiterunKitchen>金币）

original: Living room furnishings. (<Global=HDWhiterunLiving> gold)
traduit: 客厅家具。（<Global=HDWhiterunLiving>金币）

original: Dining room decorations. (<Global=HDWhiterunDining> gold)
traduit: 餐厅装饰。（<Global=HDWhiterunDining>金币）

original: Loft decorations (<Global=HDWhiterunLoft> gold)
traduit: 阁楼装饰。（<Global=HDWhiterunLoft>金币）

original: Never mind, I don't want to purchase decorations right now.
traduit: 算了，我现在不想装修。

original: We're at war, old fool, or have you forgotten?
traduit: 我们在打仗，老傻子，你忘了不成？

original: Whiterun is the crown jewel of Skyrim, and you would leave us defenseless?
traduit: 白漫城可是天际的皇冠宝石，你想让我们毫无防备？

original: As you command, my lord. But, the issue could be solved another way.
traduit: 遵命，大人。但是这个问题还有另外的解决办法。

original: If we spend less on new arms and armor for the guards, for example...
traduit: 比如，我们在为卫兵购置新武器装备上少一些支出……

original: Raise the taxes, then! Put anyone that refuses to pay in the stocks and make an example of them.
traduit: 那就增税吧！任何拒绝纳税的都抄没充公，杀一儆百。

original: My lord Jarl, if we do not take steps soon, our coffers will be empty.
traduit: 领主大人，如果我们不尽快采取行动，我们的金库就要空了。

original: Lead us to your Sybil.
traduit: 请告知我们您的预言家现在何方。

original: Dibella, guide us.
traduit: 迪贝拉，请指引我们。

original: Come on. Hurry. We might be too late.
traduit: 快来。我们可能来晚了。

original: Wait. Something's wrong.
traduit: 等等。有问题。

original: No, you don't want to go up there! A dragon... it's attacking!
traduit: 不，别上去！有龙……它在攻击！

original: I'm not going out there. Not with that dragon on the loose.
traduit: 那头龙还在我是不会出去的。

original: I wouldn't go out there for all the money in the world.
traduit: 就算给我再多钱，我也不出去。

original: Do you think it's gone yet?
traduit: 它走了吗？

original: Don't you know there's a dragon attacking?
traduit: 你不知道龙在攻击吗？

original: We've got to find someplace to hide!
traduit: 我们得找地方躲起来！

original: Lexicon? Burden? What are you talking about?
traduit: 方典？负担？你在说什么？

original: The memories. I cannot stand them. You must take them away, return them to Avanchnzel.
traduit: 那些记忆。我受不了了。你必须把它们带走，还给阿旺晨泽尔。

original: You must take the Lexicon from me. Please... take it now.
traduit: 你必须把方典拿走。拜托了……快拿走吧。

original: I don't talk to people who drink that Black Briar drench.
traduit: 我不和喝黑棘水儿的人说话。

original: Ha! Too true, my friend. Too true...
traduit: 哈！太对了，朋友。太真实了……

original: The meads won't argue your ear off about which one should go first!
traduit: 蜜酒可不会为谁先走在你耳边叨叨！

original: Why's that?
traduit: 为啥？

original: I'd rather have two bottles of mead then two wenches, friend.
traduit: 我宁愿多要两瓶蜜酒也不想要俩丫头，朋友。

original: Drink Honningbrew Mead with a wench on each arm? Ha ha!
traduit: 和姑娘拿蜜之酿蜜酒喝交杯酒？哈哈！

original: Ah, is there any way you'd rather spend the day than drinking Honningbrew Mead?
traduit: 你有什么比喝蜜酒更好度过一天的办法吗？

original: This good deed should not go unrewarded. Here, take this!
traduit: 这好事不能没回报。来，拿着这个！

original: Why only have one bottle when you can have two?
traduit: 你明明可以喝两瓶，为什么只喝一瓶呢？

original: Ysmir's beard! You're one after my own heart. I would love another bottle.
traduit: 伊斯米尔的胡子哟！你太中我的意了。我是想再来一瓶。

original: Black Briar Mead? What are you trying to do? Poison me?
traduit: 黑棘蜜酒？你想干什么？毒死我吗？

original: Perhaps you'd like to share this Black Briar Mead with me instead?
traduit: 也许你愿意和我喝这瓶黑棘蜜酒？

original: Black Briar? How dare you shove that swill in my face. I'd rather drink mammoth drool!
traduit: 黑棘？你怎么敢把这垃圾推到我面前。我宁愿去喝猛犸的口水！

original: Cheers, my friend! May your adventures find you fame and fortune!
traduit: 干杯，朋友！愿你的冒险让你名利双收！

original: I would love to share a drink with you, friend!
traduit: 我很乐意和你喝一杯，朋友！

original: Ha, nothing like fine spirits to help raise your... well, your spirits!
traduit: 哈，没什么比好酒更能帮你提振你的……嗯，精神了！

original: But enough talk. Come! Won't you share a drink with me and my companions?
traduit: 但说得够多了。来！跟我们哥几个喝一杯吧？

original: Its sweetness is like a fair maiden's kiss on a starry night. And it's got enough kick to put a frost troll on his hind quarters! Ha!
traduit: 它的甜蜜就像美少女在繁星闪烁的夜晚下献给你的吻。喝了它你能有力气把霜巨魔踢个大筋斗！哈！

original: Honningbrew Mead?
traduit: 蜜之酿蜜酒？

original: You've never had a taste of sweet Honningbrew? Why, it's only the finest mead outside of Sovngarde!
traduit: 你没喝过甘甜的蜜之酿吗？这可是松加德以外最好的蜜酒啊！

original: Ah, but you look tired. Come, share a bottle of Honningbrew Mead with me!
traduit: 啊，但你看起来很累啊。来吧，和我们分享一瓶蜜之酿蜜酒！

original: Hail, friend! It's good to see another merry soul enjoying this fine day.
traduit: 嘿，朋友！很高兴看见另一个快乐的灵魂享受这美好的一天。

original: Elisif loved the outfit. She'll be placing an order soon.
traduit: 艾利西弗很喜欢这套衣服，很快就会下订单。

original: That's wonderful. You've done us a great service. As promised the outfit is yours and here's something for your trouble.
traduit: 太好了。你帮了我们大忙了。如我所承诺，这套衣服归你了，算是给你的补偿。

original: If you are here to purchase, I have many spells available. Do come in.
traduit: 如果你是来买东西的，我这里法术不少。请进吧。

original: Welcome. There are many things here that cannot be found elsewhere.
traduit: 欢迎光临。这里的稀奇货别处可不常见。

original: Good to have a customer! You need food or drink, you say the word.
traduit: 有客人光临真好啊！需要吃的喝的尽管开口。

original: Always good to see folk come back for more. You need a drink, you just let me know.
traduit: 有老客来了。想喝点什么尽管说。

original: It's down the stairs, dear. Just come right in.
traduit: 在楼下，亲爱的。快进来吧。

original: Oh, do come in! I hope I have what you need.
traduit: 哦，请进！希望有你需要的东西。

original: The Mortar and Pestle makes potions, if you can't tell from the name. Just step up to the counter.
traduit: 钵与杵专做药剂，如果你说不出名字，可以来柜台。

original: I'm kind of busy, but if you need any potions or ingredients, let me know.
traduit: 我有点忙，但如果你需要什么药剂或者原料，就告诉我一声。

original: I'll be over here if you need any potions or ingredients.
traduit: 如果需要什么药剂或者素材，我就在这儿。

original: Hello there, can I pour you a Black-Briar Mead?
traduit: 你好啊，需要来杯黑棘蜜酒吗？

original: Ah good, back for some more Black-Briar mead, eh?
traduit: 啊太好了，是回来品尝黑棘蜜酒的吗？

original: Welcome to the Pawned Prawn. Come on in, take a look around.
traduit: 欢迎来到典当小虾。请进，随便看看。

original: Welcome back to the Prawn. Let me know if you need anything.
traduit: 欢迎回到典当小虾。有什么需要尽管说。

original: Let me know if you see anything you like.
traduit: 如果看上了什么，都可以告诉我。

original: Take a good look around. I'm sure you'll find what you're looking for. If not, let me know, I might have it stored away.
traduit: 好好看看周围。肯定有你想要找的东西。如果没有，请告诉我，也许是我收到什么地方去了。

original: Got something for just about everybody in here. Give a holler if you have any questions.
traduit: 这里所有人都能找到合用的东西。如果有什么问题，请跟我说一声。

original: It was made by Radiant Raiment.
traduit: 这是锦衣服饰店出品的。

original: Oh really? Well you can tell them that I will be putting in a request for a few dresses quite soon.
traduit: 哦，是吗？你可以告诉她们，我很快就会去订购几身。

original: Do you like my outfit?
traduit: 你喜欢我这套衣服吗？

original: It's quite fetching actually. The craftsmanship is excellent.
traduit: 确实很吸引人。工艺非常好。

original: Sorry, I'm afraid you'll make me look silly.
traduit: 对不起，我怕你会让我看上去很蠢。

original: Look silly! As if you could look any sillier than you do now.
traduit: 看上去蠢！好像你还能比现在更傻似的。

original: Sounds easy enough. I'll do it.
traduit: 听起来很容易。我来办吧。

original: Good. Here's the outfit. Try to get Elisif's opinion on it and if she likes it mention it's from Radiant Raiment.
traduit: 好。这是套装。去问问艾利西弗的意见。如果她喜欢的话，就说这是锦衣服饰店出品的。

original: So what should I wear to the Blue Palace?
traduit: 那我该穿成什么样去蓝宫呢？

original: You're really going to the Blue Palace? That presents an opportunity.
traduit: 你真的要去蓝宫？这倒是个机会。

original: If you were willing to wear one of Radiant Raiment's outfits and speak to the Jarl I would not only pay you but let you keep the outfit.
traduit: 如果你愿意穿一身锦衣服饰店的衣服和领主谈谈，我不仅可以付你些钱，还可以让你留下那身衣服。

original: You don't need my fruit, I've heard when you sing people throw tomatoes at you anyway.
traduit: 你不需要我的水果，我听说你唱歌时人们会朝你扔番茄。

original: How about I trade you a song for some fruit?
traduit: 不如我用一首歌换些水果吧？

original: Perhaps if I were a little more blessed I could afford to give away my fruit. As is you'll have to pay, Rorlund.
traduit: 或许如果我受到的祝福再多一点，我就能捐出自己的水果了。你还是得付钱，洛伦德。

original: Perhaps you could spare a tomato for a priest of the Divines?
traduit: 或许你能分给圣灵祭司一个番茄？

original: My mother always used to say that too.
traduit: 我妈以前也经常这么说。

original: Fine, Ataf. You should eat some more tomatoes, though.
traduit: 好的，阿塔夫。不过你应该多吃些番茄。

original: Um, excuse me. Could I buy two leeks.
traduit: 嗯，不好意思。我能买两棵韭葱吗？

original: Generally, if you want rumors, you should talk to Corpulus. That said... I did see a visitor pass through on his way to the Blue Palace.
traduit: 一般来说，要想听传言，可以去找科普卢斯。说回来……我看见一个访客在去蓝宫的路上经过过。

original: Does being a bard pay well?
traduit: 吟游诗人报酬高吗？

original: Oh, no. But being surrounded by good music, good drink and good friends is all I've ever asked for.
traduit: 哦，没有。但被美妙的音乐、美酒和好朋友包围，就是我的唯一要求。

original: You and everyone else. Word is it may not happen this year though.
traduit: 所有人都可以。但有消息说今年可能办不了。

original: I think I may wait until the Burning of King Olaf to have and Spiced Wine.
traduit: 我想我可以等到火烧奥拉夫的时候再喝些香料酒。

original: It is a shame though.
traduit: 确实遗憾。

original: It's too bad the Burning of King Olaf was called off this year. I think some of the younger bards would really have gotten a kick out of it.
traduit: 今年取消火烧奥拉夫王的活动真是遗憾。那些年轻诗人会在其中找到乐趣的。

original: I think our flutist here has gotten better since the Burning of King Olaf.
traduit: 我觉得咱们的笛子手在火烧奥拉夫举办之后进步很大。

original: Well, you can understand Elisif not wanting it.
traduit: 你可以理解艾利西弗是不想的。

original: I'm so glad we got to have it. I thought for sure Elisif would never consent.
traduit: 我很高兴能够举办它。我以为艾利西弗肯定不会同意。

original: Absolutely not. I prefer to be near enough to come visit but free to come and go as I please.
traduit: 绝没有。我更喜欢离得近一些，但能够随意出入。

original: Do you miss your days training at the College?
traduit: 你想念在学院训练的日子吗？

original: Not in our nature.
traduit: 这不是我们的天性。

original: You Bards don't cut each other any slack do you?
traduit: 你们吟游诗人从不放过彼此，对吧？

original: Speaking of harsh.
traduit: 说得严厉些。

original: He's okay. A little breathy and a little harsh on the notes.
traduit: 他还行。喘气有些不匀，音符有些刺耳。

original: She's okay. A little breathy and a little harsh on the notes.
traduit: 她还行。喘气有些不匀，音符有些刺耳。

original: I could listen to him play all day.
traduit: 我可以听他演奏一整天。

original: I could listen to her play all day.
traduit: 我可以听她演奏一整天。

original: It's those damned Blackblood Marauders. They're scaring off shipping.
traduit: 都是那些该死的黑血掠夺者。把航船都吓跑了。

original: One apple. Since the Blackbloods were dispatched I've had good luck getting shipments.
traduit: 来个苹果吧。自从黑血掠夺者解散之后，拿货顺利多了。

original: Your fruit are looking a little less ripe today.
traduit: 你今天的水果看着不熟啊。

original: Your selection looks very delicious. I'll take an apple.
traduit: 你们的蔬果看起来很好吃。我要来个苹果。

original: Positions.
traduit: 就位。

original: Lock the city gate.
traduit: 锁上城门。

original: Do you have a hard time getting supplies way out here?
traduit: 把补给弄到这里困难吗？

original: No, no. Well, sometimes, but that's not the problem.
traduit: 不不。好吧，有时会，但这不是问题。

original: I just often don't have much to do, so I tend to... I try things out. They don't usually work, but I try.
traduit: 我只是经常会无所事事，所以我倾向于……尝试各种事物。通常不起作用，但我会试试。

original: Next thing I know, I've used up most of my stock.
traduit: 接着我发现，我的存货都用完了。

original: What's with the Orc?
traduit: 那个兽人怎么了？

original: Lurbuk?
traduit: 卢布克？

original: Fancies himself a bard. He pays, so I let him stay.
traduit: 自称是个吟游诗人。他付了钱，我就让他留下了。

original: If I had any customers, I'd be worried about him annoying them. But, well... Look around.
traduit: 如果我有顾客的话，我还会担心他惹到别人。但是，嗯……看看周围就知道了。

original: Is business in Morthal slow?
traduit: 莫萨尔生意不好？

original: Slow? No. It just ain't there at all.
traduit: 不好？不。是压根不存在。

original: Few enough reasons to pass through Morthal before the war started.
traduit: 在战争开始前，就很少有人需要途经莫萨尔。

original: Now... Well, let's just say the front door doesn't get much use.
traduit: 现在……这么说吧，前门就没什么用。

original: What can you tell me about the area?
traduit: 你能跟我说说这里的情况吗？

original: The marsh is treacherous. You would do well to not wander at night.
traduit: 这里的沼泽很危险。最好不要夜里去瞎逛。

original: Why set up shop in Morthal?
traduit: 为什么在莫萨尔开店？

original: As anyone will tell you, Morthal can be a dangerous place.
traduit: 所有人都会告诉你，莫萨尔是个危险的地方。

original: My... talents... are useful here. I help maintain order, even if it goes unnoticed.
traduit: 我的……才能……在这里有用处。我会帮忙维持秩序，即使不为人知。

original: I've got the Amulet
traduit: 我拿到护身符了。

original: Thanks so much. I'll return to temple. Here's something for your time and effort.
traduit: 非常感谢。我要回神殿去了。这些算是酬劳。

original: I'll do what I can.
traduit: 我会尽我所能。

original: Why did you... nevermind, it's a sign. I'll return to temple. Here's something for your help.
traduit: 你怎么会……没关系，这是个兆头。我要回神殿去了。谢谢你的帮助。

original: Actually I've got it here.
traduit: 其实我已经拿到了。

original: She wants you to return to Temple.
traduit: 她想让你回神殿去。

original: Well. I wish it were that simple.
traduit: 我希望事情能那么简单。

original: Maybe it is. Look, I want to go back but I won't feel right in there without a tie to Talos.
traduit: 也许也是。听着，我想回去，但失去了和塔洛斯的联系，让我在那里感觉不太好。

original: My brother Roggvir wore a symbol of Talos. He kept it hidden on his person. If I had that...
traduit: 我兄弟罗吉维尔一直带着塔洛斯的护符。他把它藏在身上。如果有那个的话……

original: I can't go near his body. Would you get it back for me?
traduit: 我不能靠近他的尸体。你能帮我拿回来吗？

original: Hi. Svari asked me to talk to you.
traduit: 你好。斯瓦瑞让我来和你谈谈。

original: She did, did she? She's going to get a sit down later.
traduit: 是吗？她一会儿得挨罚了。

original: You may just have to give her time.
traduit: 也许你要给她些时间。

original: Yeah, that's what papa says too.
traduit: 嗯，爸爸也这么说。

original: Maybe I could convince her.
traduit: 也许我能说服她。

original: You would do that? That's great. You should go do it right now.
traduit: 你会吗？太好了。你现在就去吧。

original: I'm sorry about your uncle.
traduit: 你舅舅的事我也很难过。

original: Thanks. Papa talks about it some. Mum doesn't say much since Uncle Roggvir died. She doesn't even go to Temple anymore.
traduit: 谢谢。爸爸谈过几次。罗吉维尔舅舅死后，妈妈不怎么说话。她都不去神殿了。

original: I wish she would. At least that way she'd have people to talk to.
traduit: 我希望她回去。至少这样她能跟人说说话。

original: You don't put up with a man like that. He puts up with you.
traduit: 你不需容忍这样的人。他得容忍你。

original: I once saw Fihada put an arrow in between the eyes of a Blackblood Marauder at five hundred paces.
traduit: 我曾经看见费哈达在五百步外射穿了一个黑血掠夺者的眼睛。

original: How do you put up with that fop Fihada?
traduit: 你是怎么能忍受费哈达这个花花公子的？

original: I've tasted your food, Odar. It's better than most songs I've heard.
traduit: 我尝过你的食物，奥达。比我听过的大多数歌曲都好。

original: Sometimes I like to think my cooking is like playing the flute or singing a song.
traduit: 有时我会把做饭想象成在吹笛子或者唱歌。

original: I don't think that was a compliment.
traduit: 我不觉得这是赞美。

original: You like everyone Jorn. You'll make a good court bard some day.
traduit: 你喜欢每个人，乔恩。你将来会成为优秀的宫廷诗人的。

original: I like you Una. You've got presence.
traduit: 我喜欢你，乌娜。你的气质太好了。

original: Most of those don't happen very often.
traduit: 这些情况大多数不会经常发生。

original: I'm pleased when the palace is clean, I'm pleased when the beds are made on time, I'm pleased when I Erdi isn't around.
traduit: 我很高兴宫殿保持干净，我很高兴床铺能按时铺好，我很享受厄尔迪不在的时候。

original: Your a hard woman to please Una.
traduit: 乌娜，你真是很难取悦的女人。

original: I keep coming out here thinking I'll see what others see in this... frivolity.
traduit: 我一直在想，我能看到别人看不到的……轻浮。

original: I've heard stanger things, are eaten over at the Temple of the Divines.
traduit: 我听说过有更奇怪的东西在圣灵神殿被吃掉。

original: Vegetables are the food of the Divines.
traduit: 蔬菜可是圣灵的食物。

original: There's nothing quite like a good vegetable.
traduit: 没什么能够比得上好蔬菜。

original: You never can tell.
traduit: 这谁说得准。

original: The guy in from Dragon Bridge? He didn't seem the type.
traduit: 龙桥来的那个人？他看上去不像那种人啊。

original: I'll need a whole crate of fruit. That Varnius Junius went through quite a few of our supplies.
traduit: 我需要一整箱水果。瓦纽斯·尤尼斯吃掉了我们很多存货。

original: That's generous, Jala, but I am happy to pay my way.
traduit: 你太大方了，加拉。但我还是乐意自己付钱的。

original: Free of charge for you.
traduit: 免费给你。

original: Hello, Silana. Would you like an apple?
traduit: 你好啊，西拉娜。需要苹果吗？

original: Still can't wake him up? Perhaps you're barking up the wrong tree?
traduit: 还没叫醒他？也许你搞错了？

original: You seem to be having a small problem... or perhaps it's a big problem? Maybe if you shrunk the whole thing down a little first?
traduit: 你好像碰上了小麻烦……或者也可能是大麻烦？也许你该先把它缩小点？

original: Hmm... Your creature doesn't appear to be fairing any better than before. Methinks your aim is off.
traduit: 嗯……你的创造物没比刚才的好多少啊。我觉得你没有瞄准。

original: How long have you been a stablemaster?
traduit: 你经营马厩多久了？

original: Been about eight years now. I used to be a mercenary, but one trip to Ravenscar Hollow cured me of that.
traduit: 八年了。我曾经是个雇佣兵，但自从去过一回鸦痕山谷之后我就改行了。

original: There's hagravens in that cave with talons like daggers. They'll open your bowels quick as a wink if you let 'em get close.
traduit: 那个山洞里的乌鸦鬼婆爪子像匕首一样锋利。如果你让它们近身，很快就会被开肠破肚。

original: Creature like that'll make a man think long and hard about what he wants out of life.
traduit: 那样的生物会让一个男人仔细思考他想从生活中得到什么。

original: Aren't you worried about the dragons?
traduit: 你不担心龙吗？

original: My pa used to say there ain't no use worryin' about the things you can't change.
traduit: 我爸常说，改变不了的事儿担心也没用。

original: If it's my fate to be ended by a dragon, so be it. Meantime, I'll live my life the way I want to.
traduit: 如果我注定被龙杀死，那就这样吧。在此之前，我要过自己想要的生活。

original: I don't know what it's doing up there, but I'm not waiting around to find out!
traduit: 我不知道它在上面做什么，我也不想知道！

original: Where's this dragon?
traduit: 这条龙去哪了？

original: It flew over the town and landed on the old dragon burial mound.
traduit: 它从镇子飞过，落在那边的老龙冢了。

original: A dragon is attacking Kynesgrove?
traduit: 龙在攻击凯娜之林？

original: Well, I don't know. Not yet... it flew over the town and landed on the old dragon mound!
traduit: 我不知道。啊不对……它飞过镇子，落在那边的老龙冢了。

original: Back in 42 I was stationed in Hammerfell, on leave in Sentinel, trying to track down some refugee relatives who had fled persecution in Alinor.
traduit: 那是4E42年的事了，我驻扎在落锤。在哨卫城休假时，我想去寻找一些逃出艾琳诺的难民同族。

original: Suddenly an explosion of magic in the refugee quarter. Thalmor mages were attacking the Altmer dissidents who were resisting with magic of their own.
traduit: 突然，难民区发生了魔法爆炸。梭默法师用魔法攻击那些傲特莫异见者，那些人随后也用魔法还击。

original: I ran to the scene with other Legionaries who where stationed there, but the entire quarter was a smoking ruin by the time we arrived.
traduit: 我和驻扎在那里的其他军团兵跑到了现场，但整个难民区已经是一片冒烟的废墟了。

original: Everyone was dead. Wholesale slaughter. The Dominion, not content with killing dissidents at home, came to Hammerfell to finish the job.
traduit: 所有人都死了。大规模屠杀。先祖神洲，并不只是满足于在国内杀死持有不同政见者，还来到落锤执行这项任务。

original: We're supposedly at peace now. But I put in to be stationed here to keep an eye on the Thalmor. I've a feeling they're behind this unrest in Skyrim.
traduit: 我们现在是处于和平状态。但我派兵驻守这里监视梭默。我感觉他们就是天际动乱的幕后黑手。

original: What happened during the Night of Green Fire?
traduit: “绿火之夜”发生了什么？

original: Go on...
traduit: 继续……

original: Ulfric and his thugs are stirring up trouble for their own agenda. The Empire is the only thing keeping the Dominion from walking all over Skyrim.
traduit: 乌弗瑞克和他的手下为了自己的目的而制造麻烦。只有帝国能阻止先祖神洲在天际横行。

original: It matters little if some of the people here are ignorant to that truth. They are still citizens of the Empire. It's our solemn duty to protect them.
traduit: 即使有些人不明白这个事实，也无妨。他们仍旧是帝国公民，保护他们是我们的神圣职责。

original: Not everyone seems to want us here.
traduit: 但不是每个人都希望我们在这儿。

original: That's all I wanted to know.
traduit: 我就想知道这些。

original: For the glory of the Empire.
traduit: 为了帝国的荣耀。

original: You mentioned something back there...
traduit: 你刚才提到了……

original: The life of a soldier is full of hardship. That's nothing.
traduit: 军旅生涯就是充满艰辛，这没什么。

original: But they send the Legion to places that've gotten too bad to be settled without violence. What's hard is seeing good people warped by evil.
traduit: 但他们把军团派到那些糟糕到只能用暴力才能解决的地方。真是不忍看到好人被邪恶扭曲。

original: And I've seen the face of evil. It was in the air above Sentinel on the Night of Green Fire.
traduit: 我曾经目睹过邪恶的面貌。就在绿火之夜时哨卫城的上空。

original: Sounds like you've seen you far share of hardship.
traduit: 听起来你经历过很多困难啊。

original: Please continue...
traduit: 请继续……

original: Home? Home to me is a hot cup of ale at the end of the day and five minutes without someone needing something from me...
traduit: 家？家对我来说就是一天结束时的热麦芽酒和五分钟的清闲时光……

original: Cyrodiil is a beautiful place, full of diverse peoples and histories. But so too, Hammerfell and Skyrim, and every other place I've been.
traduit: 希罗帝尔是个美丽的地方，历史丰富，各族往来。但落锤、天际还有其他我到过的地方也是如此。

original: Don't get me wrong, every country has its dark corners. But that's why we're here. To bring order and civilization, and to protect the people.
traduit: 别误会我的意思，每个国家都有黑暗的角落。但这也是我们在这里的原因。我们要建立秩序与文明，并保护人民。

original: You're from Cyrodiil? What's it like back home?
traduit: 你从希罗帝尔来？你家什么样啊？

original: Why did you join the Legion?
traduit: 你为什么加入军团？

original: My parents were traveling merchants eventually settling in Cyrodiil. I must have inherited their wanderlust...
traduit: 我的父母是旅行商人，最后定居在希罗帝尔。我肯定是继承了他们的旅行癖……

original: I joined the Legion to see the world. I know, that's one of those things people say, but it's completely true in my case.
traduit: 我加入军团就是为了见识世界。我知道，人们经常会这么说，但对我来说就是这样。

original: Wasn't long before I saw more of the world than I bargained for.
traduit: 没过多久，我就发现这个世界远超出我的想象。

original: Do you do any work for the ships?
traduit: 你在船上工作吗？

original: Aye. I've worked on a few moorings here and there for it. Most of the ship captains are superstitious about who works on their vessels, though.
traduit: 是。我在几个停泊处工作过。不过大多数船长对船上工作的人很迷信。

original: And Dawnstar is known for its bad luck. We're the last port of call before Windhelm, and the ore we trade makes rich targets for pirates.
traduit: 晨星以厄运著称。我们是通往风舵城之前最后一个港口，我们交易的矿石对海盗来说可是笔大财。

original: Not much. I came here a few years ago from Hammerfell when I married.
traduit: 不太多。几年前我结婚的时候从落锤搬来的。

original: The land is beautiful, but I can't stand this cold. I don't know how Rustleif manages it.
traduit: 这地方很美，但我受不了冷。我不知道鲁斯特雷夫是怎么做到的。

original: What can you tell me about Dawnstar?
traduit: 关于晨星城你能告诉我些什么？

original: Have you been in Dawnstar long?
traduit: 你在晨星很久了吗？

original: Pfft. I'm the oldest woman in Dawnstar. Was here when the Skald the Elder was Skald the Younger.
traduit: 哈。我是晨星岁数最大的女人了。老斯卡德还是小斯卡德的时候我就在这儿了。

original: He's a fool, if you haven't met him already. Thinks Ulfric Stormcloak is invincible and spits dragon fire.
traduit: 你如果还没见过他，那我告诉你，他就是个傻子。他以为乌弗瑞克·风暴斗篷是无敌的，还会喷龙炎呢。

original: The people here look to Brina Merilis when they need things settled. Real firebrand going up. Wasn't surprised when she joined the Legion.
traduit: 这里的人需要解决问题的时候都会去求助布里那·莫里利斯。真正的火炬正在成长。难怪她加入过军团。

original: Seems Brina Merilis and the Legion came and now she's Jarl. That's a relief. I don't like the fighting, but Brina is the woman for the job.
traduit: 看来布里那·莫里利斯和军团到来了，现在她是领主。这是一种解脱。我不喜欢争吵，但布里那就是这个职位的最合适人选。

original: Who's in charge of Dawnstar?
traduit: 晨星城由谁统治？

original: Tiber Septim's room?
traduit: 泰伯·塞普汀的房间？

original: That's right. In the Second Era, Tiber Septim himself led the army that conquered Old Hroldan from the barbarians of the Reach.
traduit: 没错。第二纪元时，泰伯·塞普汀亲率军队从瑞驰蛮子手里征服了古霍尔丹。

original: Septim would later found the Empire that united Tamriel, but his first known battle and victory was right here.
traduit: 后来塞普汀建立了统一泰姆瑞尔的帝国，但他的第一次战役和胜利就发生在这里。

original: And this inn has the very bed the great general slept in on his first night as Old Hroldan's liberator. As good as it was hundreds of years ago.
traduit: 这个旅店的床就是那位伟大将军成为古霍尔丹解放者的第一晚睡过的。保存的和几百年前一样好。

original: How long have you been in Windhelm?
traduit: 你在风舵城多久了？

original: Just got here from the Summerset Isles. Lots of opportunity in Skyrim.
traduit: 我刚从夏暮岛过来。天际有很多机会。

original: Must be tough to grow anything out here.
traduit: 在这里种庄稼很辛苦吧。

original: There's an old saying that only a Nord can work the soil in Skyrim. I don't think anyone else would have the patience for it.
traduit: 有句老话，只有诺德人能在天际工作。我觉得没人有这耐心。

original: It takes half a day just to dig a planting row in the cold, stony earth here. But what else can we do, eat rocks and ice?
traduit: 光是在这冰冷多石的土地上挖一排土就需要半天工夫。但我们能怎么办，吃石头吃冰块吗？

original: Wherever I can find them. If you're the type who worries over where something came from, you may want to move on.
traduit: 从能找到的地方来。如果你是担心货物来源的人，那就换别家看看吧。

original: How long have you lived in Windhelm?
traduit: 你在风舵城住了多久了？

original: I came here as a hatchling. The only thing colder than Skyrim is the Nords themselves, but we stick together.
traduit: 我来的时候还是个刚出壳的小崽。唯一比天际还冷的就是诺德人自己，但我们很团结。

original: Why are all the dock workers Argonians?
traduit: 为什么码头上所有工人都是阿尔贡？

original: We work where we can get work. The Nords don't like unloading their ships, so we do it instead.
traduit: 我们在有活儿干的地方工作。诺德人不喜欢卸货，所以我们来干。

original: Sometimes cargo goes missing.
traduit: 有时货物就不见了。

original: Do you like being a blacksmith?
traduit: 你喜欢当铁匠吗？

original: Smithing isn't the most exciting thing for me, but we all have to lend a hand as best we can.
traduit: 对于我来说，锻造不是最让人兴奋的事，但我们都在努力。

original: If a Stormcloak uses one of my swords to strike down an Imperial soldier, then I've done my part to free our land.
traduit: 如果一个风暴斗篷拿我的剑杀死帝国士兵，那我就完成了我的使命，帮助我们解放自己的土地。

original: Sounds like you really admire Ulfric.
traduit: 听起来你真的很仰慕乌弗瑞克。

original: Every Nord should admire Ulfric. He fights for all of us.
traduit: 每个诺德人都该敬佩乌弗瑞克。他为我们所有人而战。

original: In fact, he's the reason I chose to learn the smithing trade. I want to make weapons and armor for the great Stormcloak army.
traduit: 事实上，他也是我选择入行做铁匠的原因。我想为伟大的风暴斗篷军队制造武器和盔甲。

original: What will you do now that Nurelion is gone?
traduit: 努瑞莱昂死后你要怎么办？

original: I'll carry on his tradition as best I can. I could spend a lifetime just going over his notes.
traduit: 我会尽我所能继承他的传统。我可能要花一辈子时间看他的笔记。

original: Do you think the White Phial exists?
traduit: 你认为白瓶真的存在？

original: It doesn't matter what I believe. Nurelion does, and it might be the only thing keeping him alive right now.
traduit: 我相信什么不重要。关键是努瑞莱昂，这可能是现在唯一能让他活下去的东西了。

original: Why do you work for Nurelion?
traduit: 你为什么为努瑞莱昂工作？

original: Are you kidding? I came all the way from Cyrodiil just to work with him.
traduit: 你在开玩笑吧？我大老远从希罗帝尔赶来，就是为了和他一起工作。

original: He's... he's not the best teacher. But just watching him, I've learned so much.
traduit: 他……他不算是最好的老师。但只是看着他，我就学到了很多。

original: What kind of magic do you study?
traduit: 你学的是哪种魔法？

original: Whatever I don't already know.
traduit: 我自己都不知道了。

original: Power is the crux of this world. There's always more of it to be had, if you look in the right places.
traduit: 力量是这个世界的关键。如果你找对地方，你就能拥有更多东西。

original: Does Ulfric have much need for magic?
traduit: 乌弗瑞克很需要魔法吗？

original: No, but then I don't have much need for Ulfric.
traduit: 不，但我也不怎么需要乌弗瑞克。

original: We both leave well enough alone.
traduit: 我们现在这样也挺好。

original: Grew up here. Colder as Atmora, but that just grows the beards thicker!
traduit: 我在这里长大。虽说跟阿特莫拉一样冷，但只是让人的胡子长得更厚罢了。

original: Lot of history in these walls. We're trying to make some more. It's a lucky time to be alive.
traduit: 这些墙充满历史。我们会创造更多历史。活着真是幸运。

original: What do you do for the Jarl?
traduit: 你在为领主做些什么？

original: For Ulfric? Oh, nothing official. Known him for years.
traduit: 乌弗瑞克吗？哦，没什么。我和他相识多年了。

original: He seems to value my thoughts, and I'm grateful for that.
traduit: 他似乎很重视我的想法，对此我很感激。

original: I don't really have a mind for war, and I think he likes having an untrained opinion from time to time.
traduit: 我对战争没什么看法，而且我觉得他是喜欢偶尔听听未经雕琢的意见。

original: You know what I mean. Forges have personalities, right?
traduit: 你懂我的意思。锻造时很个性的，对吧？

original: If that makes any sense.
traduit: 如果这说得通的话。

original: How's your steel?
traduit: 你的钢锻造得怎么样？

original: Every bit as sharp as what you'll find in Whiterun.
traduit: 和你在白漫城看到的一样锋利。

original: I respect Eorlund, but he has the good fortune to work the Skyforge. Something about the fires... their steel just holds tighter.
traduit: 我很尊敬厄伦德，但他幸运在于能在天空锻炉工作。因为那些火……他们的钢更加密实。

original: Does the war mean good business for you?
traduit: 战争让你生意很好吗？

original: I don't see these troubles as business. This is a labor of honor.
traduit: 我不觉得这些麻烦算是生意。这是光荣的劳动。

original: To bring Ulfric his rightful glory, I would hammer a thousand shields.
traduit: 为了给乌弗瑞克带来他应得的荣耀，我愿再捶打一千面盾牌。

original: Shor's bones, I might just have to!
traduit: 舒尔的骨头，我必须这么做！

original: I got the fragment.
traduit: 我拿到碎片了。

original: Another piece of glory. Good work, Shield-Brother.
traduit: 又一份荣耀。干得好，盾牌兄弟。

original: Another piece of glory. Good work, Shield-Sister.
traduit: 又一份荣耀。干得好，盾牌姐妹。

original: Get it back, for the honor of us all.
traduit: 为了我们的荣耀，把它拿回来。

original: One group has hidden out in the Reach.
traduit: 有一伙躲在瑞驰领。

original: One group has hidden out in Haafingar.
traduit: 有一伙躲在海芬加领。

original: One group has hidden out in Hjaalmarch.
traduit: 有一伙躲在希雅陲领。

original: One group has hidden out in Falkreath.
traduit: 有一伙躲在佛克瑞斯领。

original: One group has hidden out in Whiterun.
traduit: 有一伙躲在白漫领。

original: One group has hidden out in the Pale.
traduit: 有一伙躲在苍原领。

original: One group has hidden out in the Rift.
traduit: 有一伙躲在裂痕领。

original: One group has hidden out in Eastmarch.
traduit: 有一伙躲在东陲领。

original: One group has hidden out in Winterhold.
traduit: 有一伙躲在冬堡领。

original: Why is this called Candlehearth Hall?
