traduit: 这里为什么叫烛炉堂？

original: Did you see that candle above the fire upstairs?
traduit: 看到楼上壁炉里的蜡烛吗？

original: It was lit one hundred and sixty-three years ago, back when this building was the home of a grand warrior named Vundheim.
traduit: 它是一百六十三年前点亮的，当时这座建筑是位伟大战士的住宅，他叫冯德海姆。

original: When word came that he'd fallen, his son Deroct lit the candle in his honor. Nobody knows why it still burns.
traduit: 当他去世的消息传来，他儿子德洛特为他点燃了蜡烛。没人知道为什么它还在燃烧。

original: I have Alva's journal.
traduit: 我这有阿尔瓦的日记。

original: So it's true. That traitorous bitch! Morthal owes you a debt.
traduit: 所以这是真的。那个叛徒婊子！莫萨尔欠你个人情。

original: Here. You were promised a reward for solving the crime, but I need one more favor from you.
traduit: 给。你破案之后应该得到奖赏。但我需要你再帮我一个忙。

original: Morthal is still in danger. The journal mentions Movarth, a master vampire I thought was destroyed a century ago.
traduit: 莫萨尔还很危险。日记里提到了吸血鬼首领莫瓦斯，我以为他一个世纪以前就被消灭了呢。

original: I'll gather together some able-bodied warriors to clean out Movarth's lair. They'll be waiting outside for you to lead them.
traduit: 我会去召集一些精壮的战士去清理莫瓦斯的巢穴。他们会在外面等你，就由你来带领他们。

original: By Ysgramor's axe! It's true. Morthal owes you a debt.
traduit: 伊斯格拉默的斧子！这是真的。莫萨尔欠你个人情。

original: Here is your reward for solving the murder, but I have another request.
traduit: 这是你破案应得的奖赏，但我还想请你帮个忙。

original: Unfortunately Morthal is still in danger. The journal mentions Movarth, a powerful master vampire that I had assumed was destroyed.
traduit: 莫萨尔如今很不幸地还处在危险之中。日记里提到了一个强大的吸血鬼首领，莫瓦斯，我还以为他早就被消灭了呢。

original: Uh... I haven't found anything yet.
traduit: 呃……我还没发现什么。

original: You're from Hammerfell?
traduit: 你是从落锤来的吗？

original: That's right. Home of the Redguards. The land of sand and seas.
traduit: 没错。红卫人的家园。沙漠与海洋的大地。

original: I hope one day I'll convince Rustleif to take us back there. Until then, I'm content running the forge together here in Dawnstar.
traduit: 我希望有一天能说服鲁斯特雷夫回去。在那之前，我只能在晨星和他一起经营铁匠铺了。

original: Come back if you need steel.
traduit: 需要武器就回来找我。

original: We forge every day if you need anything.
traduit: 如果你需要什么，我们随时都能打。

original: Let me know if you come down with the Rattles.
traduit: 如果你得了颤抖症，记得来告诉一声。

original: Back to another fine day in Dawnstar.
traduit: 找个好日子再回晨星吧。

original: Stay out of trouble, now.
traduit: 现在别惹麻烦。

original: Don't bother me again unless it's important.
traduit: 如果不是重要的事就别再烦我了。

original: Sahloknir! Ziil gro dovah ulse!
traduit: 撒洛克尼尔！兹尔 格洛 都瓦 乌瑟！

original: Kitchen furnishings. (<Global=HDRiftenKitchen> gold)
traduit: 厨房家具。（<Global=HDRiftenKitchen>金币）

original: You do not even know our tongue, do you? Such arrogance, to dare take for yourself the name of Dovah.
traduit: 你甚至连我等的语言都不通晓吧？如此傲慢，居然还敢自号都瓦。

original: Ful, losei Dovahkiin? Zu'u koraav nid nol dov do hi.
traduit: 富尔，洛瑟 都瓦克因？祖'乌 克拉乌 聂德 诺尔 都瓦 都 亥。

original: Sahloknir, krii daar joorre.
traduit: 撒洛克尼尔，科瑞 达尔 约尔瑞。

original: Come on, now.
traduit: 快点，来吧。

original: Come at me. You couldn't hurt me if you wanted to.
traduit: 上前来。你不能单靠想象就伤到我。

original: Don't just stand there.
traduit: 别傻站着。

original: How's the newcomer look?
traduit: 这个新人怎么样？

original: He might just make it.
traduit: 他可能会成功。

original: She might just make it.
traduit: 她可能会成功。

original: Looks slow to me.
traduit: 我觉得有些慢了。

original: I could take him.
traduit: 我可以拿下他。

original: I could take her.
traduit: 我可以拿下她。

original: Not bad.
traduit: 还不坏。

original: Thank you, Legate. In the future, I'll let you know when your opinion is needed.
traduit: 谢谢你，副官。以后需要意见时我会告诉你的。

original: You don't think this is a war already? Sir, I...
traduit: 你不觉得这已经是场战争了吗？长官，我……

original: Nurelion only gave me five septims.
traduit: 努瑞莱昂只给了我五塞普汀。

original: Oh, I'm sorry about that.
traduit: 哦，我很抱歉。

original: Here, you should have this.
traduit: 给，你应得的。

original: I want to thank you for your help. I know my master can be a bit short at times.
traduit: 感谢你的帮助。我知道我师父有时候有点抠门。

original: Yes, sir!
traduit: 是，长官！

original: Should I say anything to him?
traduit: 我该和他说点什么吗？

original: An axe?
traduit: 斧子？

original: Get those documents to Whiterun.
traduit: 把那些文件送到白漫城。

original: To Whiterun with you.
traduit: 记得是去白漫啊。

original: You have your orders, soldier.
traduit: 按命令行事吧，士兵。

original: I thought I gave you something to do?
traduit: 我不是有事交给你做吗？

original: Don't keep waiting, soldier.
traduit: 不要再等了，士兵。

original: Good luck with that Icewraith.
traduit: 祝你和冰怒灵好运。

original: I can take a hint, lad. You want to make some coin, come find me.
traduit: 我懂你的意思，小子。想赚钱了就来找我。

original: I can take a hint, lass. You want to make some coin, come find me.
traduit: 我懂你的意思，姑娘。想赚钱了就来找我。

original: Why are you looking for this person?
traduit: 你们为什么找这个人？

original: It's none of your concern. All you need to know is that we're paying for information.
traduit: 与你无关。记得我们会花钱买消息就行。

original: If that doesn't interest you, feel free to walk away.
traduit: 如果你不感兴趣，请自便。

original: We'll stay here. Get back to the College and let them know what's going on.
traduit: 我们会留在这儿。回学院去吧，告诉他们这里的事。

original: That looks like it's the last of them.
traduit: 看来是最后一批了。

original: Do we have to? They'd never lift a finger to help us.
traduit: 我们一定要去吗？他们从来不帮咱们忙的。

original: Come on, Arniel. Let's go.
traduit: 来吧，阿内尔。我们走。

original: Get moving, now. I'll be fine.
traduit: 现在行动起来。我没事的。

original: I don't see the Arch-Mage. He must've been blown clear. I need you to find him immediately, all right? Make sure he's safe.
traduit: 我没看到大法师。他肯定是被炸飞了。马上找到他好吗？确保他的安全。

original: I have no idea what happened. Ancano did it, I think.
traduit: 我不知道发生了什么。应该是安卡诺干的。

original: Come on, get up... I need you on your feet.
traduit: 来吧，起来……我需要你站起来。

original: I don't have the gold for that.
traduit: 我没有那么多钱。

original: Then I'm afraid your suspension will stand for now. I'm sorry, but that's the way it has to be.
traduit: 那恐怕你得暂时停学了。很抱歉，但这是必须的。

original: Here's the gold you wanted.
traduit: 钱给你。

original: Yes. I hope this will be enough to maintain order.
traduit: 好。希望这些钱足够维持秩序了。

original: Once again, your suspension is lifted. Please try and control yourself.
traduit: 你的停学处分再次解除了。请尽量克制点。

original: Very good. I'll see that this is put towards getting things back to normal.
traduit: 很好。我会用这笔钱去让一切恢复正常。

original: Consider the suspension lifted.
traduit: 停学处分可以取消了。

original: Oh, excellent. I'll see that it gets where it needs to go.
traduit: 哦，太好了。我这就把钱送到需要的地方。

original: And I'll make sure the suspension is lifted. I'm glad we were able to clear this matter up, and I do hope we don't need to have this talk again.
traduit: 我会确保停学处分取消的。很高兴这件事捋清楚了，希望不会再讨论这个问题了。

original: You don't seem to have the gold on you. Perhaps there's a misunderstanding?
traduit: 你身上没钱吧。是不是有什么误会？

original: I'd like to clear up the matter of my suspension.
traduit: 我想弄清被停学的事。

original: Then, as I've said, 1000 gold will be required to set things right.
traduit: 嗯，如我所说，需要1000金币来解决问题。

original: I made it rather clear that a donation of 500 gold will clear it up rather neatly.
traduit: 我说得很清楚了，交500金币就能把事处理干净。

original: As I've said, a donation of 250 should help take care of that.
traduit: 我说了，250金币应该就能解决问题。

original: It's most unfortunate that we need to have this discussion once again.
traduit: 很遗憾我们又要讨论这个问题了。

original: These matters are becoming more difficult to deal with. I'm going to need 1000 gold from you in order to make reparations.
traduit: 这些事越来越难处理了。你得付1000金币进行补偿。

original: I also hope that this is the last time we'll need to discuss this.
traduit: 我也希望这是咱们最后一次谈论这个问题。

original: Another incident? I must say, I'm disappointed.
traduit: 又出事了？我真得说，很失望。

original: I thought I made it clear that this sort of behavior is totally unacceptable.
traduit: 我已经说得很清楚，这种行为完全不可接受。

original: It cannot become widely known that these sorts of things happen here. Work will need to be done to keep this quiet.
traduit: 发生了这类事情不能被闹得众人皆知。我们需要做些工作来保密。

original: I think a donation of 500 gold on your part is necessary in order to put this behind us.
traduit: 我觉得你有必要捐500金币来消除这件事。

original: Ah, yes. There was an incident, wasn't there?
traduit: 哦，对。出事了吧？

original: Well, as this is the first time this has happened, I'll make it very clear that the College does not condone that sort of behavior.
traduit: 好吧。由于你也是第一次出这种事情，我得明确表态，学院不能容忍这种行为。

original: As an act of good faith on your part, I'd advise that you consider donating an amount of gold to the College.
traduit: 为了表示你的善意，我建议你向学院捐赠一笔钱。

original: Strictly to cover damages, you understand. I believe 250 gold should be sufficient.
traduit: 你得严格地赔偿损失。我觉得250金币足够了。

original: Get out of my face.
traduit: 从我面前消失。

original: Watch out some gray-skin doesn't pick your pocket.
traduit: 小心那些灰皮偷走你的口袋。

original: Talos protect you, friend.
traduit: 塔洛斯保护你，朋友。

original: Farewell, then.
traduit: 再会吧。

original: I enjoyed our talk.
traduit: 我很享受咱们的谈话。

original: Until our next meeting, honored friend.
traduit: 期待下次见面，尊敬的朋友。

original: May Talos shield you from all harm.
traduit: 愿塔洛斯保佑你免受伤害。

original: May Talos bless your days.
traduit: 愿塔洛斯祝福你。

original: Blessings of Arkay be upon you.
traduit: 愿阿尔凯保佑你。

original: Too few remember to honor the god of the dead. Do not be one of those.
traduit: 大多数人不会记得尊敬死者之神。不要成为他们中的一员啊。

original: The Divines smile on a charitable soul.
traduit: 圣灵会对仁慈的灵魂微笑。

original: Don't forget them who's less fortunate than yourself.
traduit: 不要忘记那些没你幸运的人。

original: Thank you for your custom.
traduit: 感谢惠顾。

original: I'll see you again soon, I hope.
traduit: 希望快点再见。

original: Enjoy your stay, and don't break nothin'!
traduit: 祝你在这儿玩得愉快，不要破坏任何东西！

original: Mind you don't put out that candle on the hearth upstairs!
traduit: 别把楼上壁炉里的蜡烛弄灭了！

original: Be careful! That murderer could be anywhere, and anyone.
traduit: 小心点！那个谋杀犯可能是出现在任何地方的任何人。

original: The streets are safer now, thanks to you.
traduit: 多亏了你，街道安全多了。

original: See you around, handsome.
traduit: 回头见，帅哥。

original: See you around, my beauty.
traduit: 回头见，美女。

original: A word of advice -- don't buy discounted armor.
traduit: 给你个建议，别买打折的盔甲。

original: If you've need of weapons or armor, come back and see Oengul.
traduit: 如果你需要武器或者盔甲，去找欧恩古尔吧。

original: May the earth beneath your feet be always soft.
traduit: 愿你脚下的土地永远柔软。

original: I hope we will speak again soon, marsh-friend.
traduit: 希望我们能很快再见，沼泽朋友。

original: Trust me, marsh-friend, you do not want to live in this city.
traduit: 相信我，沼泽朋友，你不会想住在这城里的。

original: I would not complain if you returned with some Skooma.
traduit: 如果你带些斯库玛过来，我是不会抱怨的。

original: Fair winds and calm seas. That's an old sailor's parting.
traduit: 愿风平浪静。这是一个老水手告别的方式。

original: It was a pleasure to talk to someone so interesting.
traduit: 和有趣的人交谈是种享受。

original: Travel safely. It's dangerous out there.
traduit: 旅行平安。现在外面很危险。

original: If you'll excuse me, I must return to my duties.
traduit: 恕我失陪了，我得回去工作了。

original: Do come again!
traduit: 欢迎再来！

original: May you lose yourself in the pages of a good book!
traduit: 愿你沉浸在一本好书里！

original: As you travel Skyrim, make sure you stop and take in the view from time to time!
traduit: 当你在天际旅行时，一定时不时停下来看看风景！

original: If you need another drink, I'll be right here.
traduit: 如果还想来一杯，我就在这儿。

original: Have a seat, there should be plenty of space.
traduit: 请坐，空间足富裕。

original: Please forgive my mood. I'm still coming to terms with my daughter's death.
traduit: 请原谅我的心情。我还在试着接受我女儿的死讯。

original: Please forgive my mood. I'm still coming to terms with the death of my wife and daughters...
traduit: 请原谅我的心情。我还在试着接受我妻子和女儿的死讯……

original: Don't take anything for granted in life. Nothing lasts forever.
traduit: 别把生活的什么事都看成理所当然。没有什么是永不变的。

original: Be sure to stop by Sadri's Used Wares in the Gray Quarter.
traduit: 一定去灰民区的萨德利旧货店看看。

original: Take care, friend.
traduit: 保重，朋友。

original: Sometimes the difference between life an' death is a swift steed.
traduit: 有时生死就是因为一匹快马。

original: Sorry about the smell. It's a stable, after all.
traduit: 很抱歉这里味道不好。毕竟是个马厩么。

original: Whether it's armor you need or a new blade, come see me.
traduit: 不管是想要新盔甲还是新刀剑，都可以来找我。

original: If you meet anyone in your travels who needs good steel, send them my way.
traduit: 如果旅途中碰到需要好钢铁的人，让他们来找我吧。

original: Strength and steel are well and good, but magic is the true power in this world.
traduit: 力量和钢铁虽好，但魔法才是这世界上真正的力量。

original: A strong sword-arm wins battle, but a keen mind wins wars.
traduit: 强壮的武器可以赢得战斗，但敏锐的头脑能赢得战争。

original: Safe journeys, sword-brother.
traduit: 旅途安全，朋友。

original: A most pleasant chat. Until the next!
traduit: 又是一次愉快的交谈。下次再见了！

original: I bid you safe travels.
traduit: 祝你一路平安。

original: Be seeing you.
traduit: 再会。

original: Alright, then.
traduit: 好吧。

original: If you're not doing something you enjoy, then you're wasting your life.
traduit: 如果你不是在做自己喜欢的事，那就是在浪费生命。

original: I hope to see you again soon.
traduit: 希望很快再见。

original: If you have need of tonics or potions, come see me at my shop.
traduit: 如果需要补品或者药水，欢迎光顾我的店。

original: Battle reveals who a man really is. Remember that.
traduit: 战斗能看出一个人的本质。记住这点。

original: Keep on your guard. This city can be a little rough for those such us.
traduit: 保持警惕吧。这座城市对我们这种人来说有些艰难。

original: It was a pleasure.
traduit: 这是我的荣幸。

original: I should have been an adventurer like you, instead of a farmer.
traduit: 我应该做一个像你一样的冒险家，而不是一个农民。

original: Never trade a sword for a hoe, my friend.
traduit: 永远不要拿剑换锄头，朋友。

original: Right. See you around.
traduit: 好吧。再会。

original: Aye, 'til next time.
traduit: 嘿，下次见了。

original: The last one was warm up.
traduit: 上次只是为了暖身。

original: Sure, Sorex. Just like you did the last one.
traduit: 当然，索莱克斯。就像上次一样。

original: Actually just a bottle for me today. I'm thinking of giving it to Vivienne.
traduit: 其实我只想自己买一瓶。我想送给薇薇安。

original: Spiced Wine for the Winking Skeever?
traduit: 给眨眼恶鼠进些香料酒吗？

original: Well, keep at it. The fish have to get to know you before they're willing to bite.
traduit: 好吧，坚持下去。在鱼儿上钩前，它们必须先了解你。

original: Naw, mostly just froze.
traduit: 呐，大多数都冻住了。

original: Brave man, with the Blackbloods out there. Did you catch anything?
traduit: 真是勇敢，外面还有黑血掠夺者呢。你抓到了吗？

original: I went out ice fishing a few days ago.
traduit: 我前几天去冰上钓鱼了。

original: Vittoria is practically glowing.
traduit: 维托利亚简直就像在发光。

original: It should be quite the affair. Nice to have something happy in the midst of the war.
traduit: 就该这样。战争时期能有开心的事真好。

original: Not too bad. A few of the guests from the upcoming wedding have placed orders.
traduit: 不太坏。有些打算举办婚礼的客户已经下了订单。

original: They seem to when you're around Silana.
traduit: 就像在西拉娜身边时一样。

original: Are your sales going well?
traduit: 销售还顺利吗？

original: I hope the Divines have been keeping you well.
traduit: 希望圣灵们有看顾你。

original: Do you know I look forward to Burning of King Olaf each year just because of the fire?
traduit: 你知道我每年都盼着火烧奥拉夫就是因为那场火吗？

original: A bit of warming wine, Illdi. You know you can't resist.
traduit: 来点温热的酒吧，伊尔迪。你知道你抗拒不了。

original: Not fair. You're well aware I can't seem to get warm here.
traduit: 不公平。你知道我在这里暖和不了。

original: Plenty of ways to worship the Divines as you know.
traduit: 如你所知，拜神的方式有很多。

original: Of course. And I'm sure it's mostly for ceremonial purposes.
traduit: 当然可以。相信这是为了举行仪式。

original: Ah a few bottles of Spiced Wine should hit the spot.
traduit: 啊，再来几瓶香料酒就好了。

original: Viarmo is trying to get Elisif to allow the Burning of King Olaf. I don't want to look like I don't know how to drink in front of the other bards.
traduit: 维阿墨想让艾利西弗同意举办火烧奥拉夫。我可不想让别的吟游诗人知道我不会喝酒。

original: No thank you. I'm still feeling sick from the festival.
traduit: 不用了，谢谢。我现在还觉得过节时候喝得难受呢。

original: I haven't known you to drink before, Ataf.
traduit: 我以前还不知道你会喝酒啊，阿塔夫。

original: A bottle of spiced wine for ya, Ataf?
traduit: 给你来瓶香料酒，阿塔夫？

original: I'll take a bottle of spiced wine.
traduit: 我要一瓶香料酒。

original: Alchemy laboratory. (<Global=HDRiftenAlchemy> gold)
traduit: 炼金实验室。（<Global=HDRiftenAlchemy>金币）

original: I was told someone at the College might be able to help me.
traduit: 我听说学院里有人可以帮我。

original: It's true, the scrolls are a subject of interest to us, and work has been done to learn of them. But outsiders are not allowed within the College.
traduit: 确实，这些卷轴是我们感兴趣的研究项目之一，我们致力于研究它们。但外人不能随意进入学院。

original: I need to locate an Elder Scroll.
traduit: 我需要找到上古卷轴。

original: A lofty goal, to be sure. And what brings your search to our doorstep?
traduit: 崇高的目标。那你为何会来此寻找？

original: Oh, well, it's just... I never imagined the Gourmet was a Khajiit. You know, because of all the fur, and the potential for getting hair in the...
traduit: 哦，好吧，我只是……没想过美食家是卡吉特。你知道，因为全身都是毛么，毛发可能会……

original: You just keep quiet and stay where you are. Soon as my relief arrives, we'll all take a nice little trip.
traduit: 保持安静，在原地等待。等我的替班来了，咱们可以有段愉快的小旅行。

original: Soft. Just like all outlanders.
traduit: 软蛋，跟所有外来户一样。

original: Pfft. Snowback.
traduit: 呸。软骨头。

original: Pit bait.
traduit: 怂货。

original: This will be good training. Let's go!
traduit: 这可是很好的训练。来吧！

original: You're short on coin.
traduit: 你可没那么多钱。

original: That's the spirit! Let's go.
traduit: 很有精神！来吧。

original: Hey, I may have had a few, but I can still count. You don't have a hundred septims on you.
traduit: 虽然我喝了点，但还能数清数。你身上可没一百塞普汀。

original: Just fists. No weapons, no magic... no crying. Let's go!
traduit: 只用拳头。没有武器，没有魔法……输了别哭。来吧！

original: Why don't you come back when you actually have a hundred gold?
traduit: 为什么不等你凑够一百金币时候再说呢？

original: All right. Fists only. And none of that magic stuff, either. Let's go!
traduit: 好吧。只能用拳头。别用什么花里胡哨的魔法。来吧！

original: I said a hundred gold! Damn broke elves and damn broke elf-lovers.
traduit: 我说的是一百金币！精灵和精灵支持者都是他妈的穷逼吗？

original: Just your own two hands. Weapons and magic are out. Now let's see what you got!
traduit: 只需用拳头。武器魔法免谈。现在来看看你有什么能耐！

original: How about a test? Your muscle against mine. The victor gains 100 gold coins from the loser.
traduit: 来个测试怎么样？咱俩来次肉搏。赢的人拿走100金币。

original: Any work to be done in the stronghold?
traduit: 在要塞里有什么工作吗？

original: I'm drunk, and it's been a while since I had a good fight.
traduit: 我刚喝完，有段时间没好好打一架了。

original: A hundred septims says I can take ya, bare-handed.
traduit: 一百塞普汀，赌我能赤手空拳干掉你。

original: You say something about a bet?
traduit: 你说要打赌？

original: And why not? I could beat anyone in this city, bare-handed.
traduit: 为什么不呢？我能赤手空拳打败这城里的所有人。

original: A hundred gold says I knock your hide to the ground.
traduit: 一百金币，赌我能把你打趴下。

original: You think you can take me on?
traduit: 你觉得能打败我？

original: Don't like it? Too bad. This is our city. Ours!
traduit: 不喜欢？那太糟了。这是我们的城市。我们的！

original: Don't think I can take you? One hundred septims says I can punch you back where you came from.
traduit: 你觉得我打不赢你？一百塞普汀，看我把你打出去。

original: I don't like your attitude.
traduit: 我不喜欢你的态度。

original: Really? You convinced that lute player to stop chasing me?
traduit: 真的？你说服那个弹琴的不再追我了？

original: I'd thank the gods, but I'll settle for thanking you. Here's some coin for your help.
traduit: 真是得感谢诸神，但也要感谢你。这是给你的报酬。

original: <Alias.ShortName=Target> won't be bothering you anymore.
traduit: <Alias.ShortName=Target>不会再困扰你了。

original: You talked Torbjorn down? I'm impressed.
traduit: 你说服了托布乔恩？太厉害了。

original: Here, I was saving this for a rainy day. Maybe now I can afford a few more for my people. Take it.
traduit: 给，我一直留着这个以备不时之需。也许现在我可以给我的族人多买一些了。收下吧。

original: <Alias.ShortName=Target> will be paying you all more.
traduit: <Alias.ShortName=Target>会付给你们更多工钱的。

original: I don't believe it. Someone sticking up for us. Here. It's a week's wages for me, but you've earned every coin.
traduit: 我不相信。居然有人会维护我们。给，这是我一周的工资，但每一分都是你应得的。

original: I convinced <Alias.ShortName=Target> to ease up a bit.
traduit: <Alias.ShortName=Target>答应我会温和一点。

original: You've done a fine thing for me. You know, I used to be quite a warrior in my day. Let me show you a thing or two.
traduit: 你为我做了件好事。你知道吗，我以前是个很厉害的战士呢。我来教你两手。

original: Irnskar's agreed to forgive your debt.
traduit: 艾恩斯卡同意免除你的债务了。

original: It'll be good to not have to hear him whining about his debts.
traduit: 不用再听他抱怨自己的债务真好。

original: Roggi pawned a few of his things back when he still had things to pawn. Take them.
traduit: 罗吉当掉了一些他当时还能当的东西。你拿上吧。

original: Roggi won't be complaining anymore.
traduit: 罗吉不会再抱怨了。

original: Thank you. He's not a bad man, just bad with his coins and his drink. My husband Dagur could tell you stories, there.
traduit: 谢谢你。他不是个坏人，只是没钱还贪杯。我丈夫达古尔可以跟你说说那些故事。

original: I have a couple of Ranmir's things that he traded to us back when he was still paying regularly. I say you've earned them.
traduit: 我这里有几件兰米尔的东西，是他还能定期付款时卖给我们的。我想这是你应得的。

original: Ranmir's agreed to pay his debts.
traduit: 兰米尔同意还他欠的钱。

original: Wasn't your business, anyway.
traduit: 反正也不关你的事。

original: Already have.
traduit: 好吧。

original: Idiot.
traduit: 白痴。

original: It's better that way.
traduit: 这样也好。

original: Whoa. Hey there. I didn't mean to make you upset. On my honor, Carlotta won't have to worry about me again.
traduit: 哇。那个。我不是故意惹你的。我以自己的名誉起誓，卡萝塔不用再担心了。

original: Leave her alone, or else. (Intimidate)
traduit: 离她远点，否则的话……（恐吓）

original: Leave her alone, or else. (Brawl)
traduit: 离她远点，否则的话……（打架）

original: Easy. Maybe I was being too harsh on them. By the honor of Clan Shatter-Shield, they will be paid fairly. You have my word.
traduit: 这简单。也许是我对他们太苛刻了。以我碎盾氏族的荣誉起誓，他们会得到公道的报酬。我向你保证。

original: Pay them, or things will get ugly. (Intimidate)
traduit: 给他们钱，否则事情可就不好看了。（恐吓）

original: Pay them, or things will get ugly. (Brawl)
traduit: 给他们钱，否则事情可就不好看了。（打架）

original: Wait. You win. I'll ease off on the beatings, just leave me alone.
traduit: 等等。你赢了。我不会再打他了，你离我远点就行。

original: Then we do this the hard way. (Intimidate)
traduit: 那我们只能来硬的了。（恐吓）

original: Think you can mess with an Orc of the Reach? Let's go.
traduit: 你觉得你能比得过瑞驰的兽人吗？那就来吧。

original: Then we do this the hard way. (Brawl)
traduit: 那我们只能来硬的了。（打架）

original: All right, all right. Have it your way. Tell Octieve to forget about the debt.
traduit: 好吧，好吧。按你说的办。告诉奥克提夫把债忘了吧。

original: Lay off the old man. Now. (Intimidate)
traduit: 别再碰那个老人了。明白吗。（恐吓）

original: Lay off the old man. Now. (Brawl)
traduit: 别再碰那个老人了。明白吗。（打架）

original: What? No. All right. I won't worry about the coin anymore, just stop giving me that look.
traduit: 什么？不了。好吧。我不会再担心那些钱了，别用那种眼神看我。

original: Do I need to beat some sense into you? (Intimidate)
traduit: 需要我教训你一下吗？（恐吓）

original: Do I need to beat some sense into you? (Brawl)
traduit: 需要我教训你一下吗？（打架）

original: Calm down there, friend. I'll pay! Tell Haran that she'll have her gold.
traduit: 冷静点，朋友。我会付钱的！告诉哈兰钱会给她的。

original: Do it, or things get ugly. (Intimidate)
traduit: 照我说的做，不然事情可就不好看了。（恐吓）

original: Do it, or things get ugly. (Brawl)
traduit: 照我说的做，不然事情可就不好看了。（打架）

original: Maybe we can come to an understanding. (<BribeCost> gold)
traduit: 也许我们能达成共识。（<BribeCost>金币）

original: Bribing me? Well, a bard does need to eat. On my ancestor's honor, I won't trouble sweet Carlotta again.
traduit: 想要贿赂我？好吧，诗人也是要吃饭的。我以祖先的名义起誓，我不会再去打扰可爱的卡萝塔了。

original: Paying the wages yourself? Well, I won't say no to gold. By my family's honor, this money will go to the Argonian workers.
traduit: 你自己来付工钱？我是不会拒绝金币的。以我家族的名誉起誓，我会把这笔钱交给阿尔贡工人的。

original: What if I invest in their future? (<BribeCost> gold)
traduit: 那如果我投资他们的未来呢？（<BribeCost>金币）

original: What future?
traduit: 什么未来？

original: I guess I can spare him a few beatings. Deal.
traduit: 那我可以少打他几下。成交。

original: The only thing I understand is you bothering you.
traduit: 我唯一能理解的就是你在打扰我。

original: Works for me. Tell Octieve the debt's settled.
traduit: 我看行。告诉奥克提夫，债两清了。

original: What if I pay it? (<BribeCost> gold)
traduit: 如果我来付钱呢？（<BribeCost>金币）

original: Don't think so.
traduit: 我看不行。

original: A true Nord would settle it himself, but at least this way Iddra gets her coin. Thank you. Tell her I'll be fine.
traduit: 真正的诺德会自己解决问题，但至少这样艾德拉能拿到自己的钱。谢谢！告诉她我会没事的。

original: This isn't about me paying Iddra back, this is about me being able to pay her back with my own coin.
traduit: 这不是我要付给艾德拉的钱，我会用我自己的钱还给她。

original: I won't say no to that.
traduit: 我是不会拒绝的。

original: I'm not about to take on debts from some milk drinker I don't know.
traduit: 我可不想向一个我不认识的软蛋借钱。

original: I want to talk to you about <Alias.ShortName=QuestGiver>.
traduit: 我想和你谈谈<Alias.ShortName=QuestGiver>。

original: Anything for my favorite lass.
traduit: 为我最爱的姑娘怎么都行。

original: You need to leave <Alias=QuestGiver> alone.
traduit: 你得离<Alias=QuestGiver>远点。

original: Oh? Were you after her yourself? I won't stand in your way, my friend. You have my word.
traduit: 哦？你是在追她吗？我不会妨碍你的，朋友。我保证。

original: Carlotta put you up to this, didn't she? I'm sorry, but that fiery widow is mine. She just doesn't know it yet.
traduit: 卡萝塔让你来的，对吧？抱歉，但那个暴躁寡妇已经归我了。她只是还不知道而已。

original: Well, my friend, if you think those boots needs more coin, I'll make it happen. But I'm doing this for you, not them.
traduit: 好吧，朋友，如果你觉得那些奴才需要更多钱，我可以给他们。但这是因为你，而不是他们。

original: You need to pay the Argonians a fair wage.
traduit: 你应该给那些阿尔贡应得的报酬。

original: Those boots aren't worth the septims I do pay them. I'm not giving them coin I could give to good, Nord workers.
traduit: 那些奴才不值得我付那么多塞普汀给他们。我不会把应该付给优秀诺德工人的钱给他们。

original: What? Are you telling me how to treat my workers? Do you have any idea how much metal the Silver-Blood family wants us to smelt?
traduit: 什么？你在教我做事？你知不知道银血家族想让我们炼多少金属？

original: I want you to leave Omluag alone.
traduit: 我希望你离奥穆鲁阿远点。

original: Debts are debts. Either he pays them, or his kind do.
traduit: 欠债还钱天经地义。要么他自己还，要么他亲戚还。

original: I'd like you to forgive Octieve's debts.
traduit: 我希望你能免去奥克提夫的债务。

original: I guess if you're telling me to stop worrying about it, maybe I should just let it go. Thank you, friend.
traduit: 如果你让我别再担心，那我是该放下了。谢谢你了，朋友。

original: Iddra wants you to forget about all that coin you owe.
traduit: 艾德拉希望你忘掉自己欠的钱。

original: What do you think I am, a beggar? My family has always paid back every single coin we owed, going back to Tiber Septim's time.
traduit: 你以为我是什么人，乞丐吗？自从泰伯·塞普汀时代起，我的家族就从来不会欠一分钱。

original: Who are you to say what I should do? I'll pay her back when I'm ready.
traduit: 你谁啊？凭什么对我指手画脚？我一有钱就会还她的。

original: You need to pay Haran back for all your drinks.
traduit: 你得把欠哈兰的酒钱还清了。

original: I'm sure. I'm sure.
traduit: 是啊。是啊。

original: I can take care of myself. A Whiterun woman learns how to handle a few idiot men early in life.
traduit: 我会照顾好自己的。白漫的女人从小就得学着对付痴汉了。

original: We will make do somehow. We always have.
traduit: 我们会想办法应付的。我们总是能想到。

original: Sorries don't help anyone.
traduit: 表达遗憾可帮不了任何人。

original: He'll be fine, I just hate worrying about his worrying.
traduit: 他会没事的。我只是不想每天为他的担心而担心。

original: I'm sure we'll get our gold at some point. Not like he has anywhere to go.
traduit: 我们总会拿到钱的。反正他也没别的地方可去。

original: What if I talk to <Alias.ShortName=Target>?
traduit: 要是我去和<Alias.ShortName=Target>谈谈呢？

original: He's a stubborn oaf. I don't know what good it'll do.
traduit: 他就是个顽固的笨蛋。我不知道会不会有用。

original: If you want to try, go right ahead. I don't think anything will get through that thick skull of his, though.
traduit: 如果你想试试那就去吧。不过，我觉得他那个笨脑壳是怎么也穿不透了。

original: You can try, but we've gotten nowhere talking to him ourselves.
traduit: 你可以去试试，但我们跟他谈都没什么办法。

original: You're going to try to talk sense into that Orc? I'll believe it when I see it.
traduit: 你想去和那个兽人谈？我可不信他会听你的。

original: If you could convince him that I don't care about his tab, it'd certainly make me feel better.
traduit: 如果你能让他相信我不在乎他的账单，我心里也会好受些。

original: Go right ahead. He just might be sober enough to listen to you.
traduit: 那就去吧。他要是没喝醉也许会听你的。

original: Someone giving you trouble?
traduit: 有人找你麻烦吗？

original: That bard Mikael is begging for a dagger up against his throat, the way he goes on about me.
traduit: 那个诗人米凯尔真是找死，看看他对我的态度。

original: I've heard him boasting at the Bannered Mare, saying he'll "conquer me as a true Nord conquers any harsh beast." Hmph.
traduit: 我听他在悬旗母马吹牛，说他会“征服我，就像真正的诺德人征服任何凶猛的野兽一样。”呸。

original: Torbjorn Shatter-Shield. I wish someone would beat the coin out of his fat fists. He clings to every Septim.
traduit: 托布乔恩·碎盾。我真希望有人从他的胖拳头里把金币抠出来。他把每个塞普汀都拴在身上。

original: He says an Argonian's labor is only worth a tenth of a "proper Nord worker." My people are not slaves!
traduit: 他说，每个阿尔贡工人只值一个“正常诺德工人”的十分之一。我们又不是奴隶！

original: He's a damn tyrant. Always being goaded on by the Silver-Bloods to get more work out of us.
traduit: 他就是个该死的暴君。银血家总是让他逼我们干更多活。

original: They pay us next to nothing. We get beaten if we make a mistake, and where are our kind Nord rulers? What are they doing? Typical.
traduit: 他们几乎不给我们钱。如果我们犯了错，还要被打，我们善良亲切的诺德统治者在哪儿？他们在干什么？不用想都知道。

original: You've having trouble with Mulush?
traduit: 你对穆鲁什有意见？

original: Too many drinking games, too many bets, and I'm too old to ever raise the coin on my own.
traduit: 我划拳赌博次数太多了，而且这么大岁数，也没法自己筹钱。

original: You're in debt to Irnskar?
traduit: 你欠艾恩斯卡钱？

original: He's been in Kynesgrove forever. Great storyteller. Keeps everyone's spirits up.
traduit: 他一直待在凯娜之林。不错的说书人。每个人都能振作起来。

original: Owes me a lot of coin for drinks. I keep telling him not to worry about it, but he's got the stubborn Nord blood.
traduit: 他欠了我一大笔酒钱。我一直告诉他别在意，但他这个诺德人太顽固了。

original: Damn fool doesn't have the coin to pay me back, so he just beats himself up over it, and then he gets thirsty, and it cycles all over again.
traduit: 这傻蛋没钱还我，就打自己一顿，然后口渴了又来，就这样循环往复了。

original: Who's Roggi?
traduit: 罗吉是谁？

original: He owes this tavern enough coin to burn it down, build it back up, then burn it down again just for laughs.
traduit: 他欠这家酒馆的钱，足够把这里烧了再盖，盖了再烧玩几次的了。

original: He's had some troubles in his life, but I can't have him drinking here without at least paying back some of the coin he owes.
traduit: 他生活上有些不如意，但我不能让他再这么喝下去了，至少也要把欠的钱还上。

original: What's wrong with Ranmir?
traduit: 兰米尔怎么了？

original: Ah, a test subject! Go, my pets! Attack!
traduit: 啊，实验目标！去吧，宝贝们！攻击！

original: Good. I'll see if I can get some copies made for the men. Here, something for your trouble. The Legion thanks you.
traduit: 好。我去看看能不能复制几份发给他们。给，给你些酬劳。军团非常感谢你。

original: I found that book you wanted.
traduit: 我找到你要的书了。

original: It's amazing how much you can learn from a book.
traduit: 你能从书本里学的东西多到惊人。

original: Here. Let me show you some of the things the temple healers taught me about potions.
traduit: 来。给你看看神殿治疗师教我的药剂知识。

original: Don't know what the Redguards see in books, but this will make my Seren happy.
traduit: 不知道这书里记载了红卫人的什么，但我家赛仁会很高兴的。

original: Thank you. Let me show you some tricks around the forge.
traduit: 谢谢。我给你露几手锻造技巧吧。

original: Now that's what I like to see. Someone who gets things done.
traduit: 这才是我想看到的。能把事情办好的人。

original: Here. A little something for you.
traduit: 来。给你点小礼物。

original: Here's your Black-Briar Mead.
traduit: 这是你要的黑棘蜜酒。

original: Thank you. This should turn that old cat's gaze. Maybe I'll be able to become a caravaneer myself, one day.
traduit: 谢谢。这样应该能引起那只老猫的注意了。也许有一天，我也能成为一名商队主。

original: As promised, let me show you a thing or two about bargaining. Don't want some shifty merchant giving you a raw trade.
traduit: 按原先说好的，我来给你展示一两个讨价还价小技巧。我可不想让你被奸商坑了。

original: Here's your mammoth tusk.
traduit: 这是你要的猛犸牙。

original: I hope Arkay grants my wife some comfort. Thank you. Here. I always pay my debts.
traduit: 希望阿尔凯能带给我妻子一些慰藉。谢谢你。来，我这人是有债必偿的。

original: Here's an amulet of Arkay.
traduit: 这是阿尔凯护符。

original: My loss, right?
traduit: 这算是我的损失吗？

original: I don't have time for that.
traduit: 我没时间管这个。

original: Then I don't have time for you.
traduit: 那恕不奉陪了。

original: I'll do my best.
traduit: 我会努力的。

original: I suppose it is.
traduit: 我想也是。

original: Be glad you're not training under me with that mouth of yours.
traduit: 庆幸的是你这张破嘴不在我手底下训练。

original: I don't have time for book-hunting.
traduit: 我没时间去找书本。

original: Good on you.
traduit: 谢谢你。

original: If I see it, I'll bring it to you.
traduit: 如果看到的话，我会带给你的。

original: You better. I hate people who waste my time.
traduit: 你很不错。我很讨厌浪费我时间的人。

original: I'll bring it to you.
traduit: 我去给你拿来。

original: You'd do that? If you find one, I could teach you a thing or two about trading. Help you get a fair bargain in the future.
traduit: 你会帮我？如果你能找到一份，我可以教你几招贸易技巧。帮你以后讨个更公道的价钱。

original: Maybe I can help you.
traduit: 也许我可以帮你。

original: Really? I'd be happy to show you a bit about herbs if you find the book.
traduit: 真的？如果你找到的话，我很乐意给你介绍介绍草药知识。

original: If I find a copy, I'll bring it to you.
traduit: 如果我有找到副本，可以带一份给你。

original: If I find one, I'll bring it to you.
traduit: 如果找到，我可以带一个给你。

original: My wife Seren and I run it together. She still smiths even though we found out she is with child.
traduit: 我妻子赛仁和我一起。即使她怀孕了，还是坚持在锻造。

original: Our son or daughter isn't going to get much Redguard culture here in Skyrim. I know my wife worries how she will pass along her traditions.
traduit: 我们的儿女在天际得不到太多红卫文化熏陶。我知道我妻子担心她的传统能否被继承。

original: Hey, if you find a book called "Night Falls on Sentinel," could you bring it to me? It's a story from my wife's people. Be good to have.
traduit: 嘿，你能不能找到一本叫《夜幕降临哨卫城》的书？那是来自我妻子她们民族的故事。希望里面有点好东西。

original: You in charge of this forge?
traduit: 你负责这个铁匠铺吗？

original: Work? I demand tribute before you can be considered for any real tasks.
traduit: 工作？想让我安排差事也得先拿点孝敬才好啊。

original: How about drink? None of that local piss. Real Black-Briar Mead, fresh from Riften.
traduit: 酒怎么样？不要当地的马尿。要刚从裂谷城运来货真价实的黑棘蜜酒。

original: You're the Jarl? I'm looking for work.
traduit: 您是领主吗？我在找工作。

original: Before my ma and da passed, I told them that one day, I'd become the best trader in Skyrim.
traduit: 在我父母去世前，我就告诉他们总有一天我会成为天际最棒的商人。

original: I met one of the caravan leaders, Ma'dran. He said he'd help get me started if I could bring him a mammoth's tusk. Easier said than done.
traduit: 我遇到了一个商队首领，叫玛'德兰。他说如果我能给他一根猛犸牙，他就会帮我起步。说起来容易做起来难啊。

original: You're looking to become a merchant?
traduit: 你想成为商人？

original: I picked up the trade when I was a girl. One of the temple healers staying here on a pilgrimage showed me the basics.
traduit: 从还是个小女孩开始就在干这行了。一个来朝圣的神殿治疗师教给我一些基础知识。

original: She had a book with her, "Song of the Alchemists," that I used to read over and over. I miss having a copy.
traduit: 她随身带着一本叫《炼金术士之歌》的书，我曾经读过好多遍。真怀念有份副本的日子。

original: How long have you studied alchemy?
traduit: 你学习炼金术多久了？

original: That I am. Train the recruits. Turn boys into men. That sort of thing.
traduit: 没错。负责训练新兵。让小孩变成爷们。就是这类事。

original: Thinking of asking the General for some training books. Give the soldiers something to do while they're on rest. Something besides drinking.
traduit: 我得向将军要些训练书籍。让这些士兵在休息时除了喝酒还能做些事。

original: Ever seen a book called "The Mirror"? We used to hand it out to boys looking to learn basic shield work.
traduit: 有见过一本叫《镜》的书吗？我们曾经把它分发给想学习基本盾牌技能的小伙子们。

original: Are you with the Legion?
traduit: 你是军团的吗？

original: Our little girl died recently. I've been shouldering my days with strong mead, but nothing gives my Tova peace.
traduit: 我们的小女儿最近去世了。我每天都借酒浇愁，但没有什么东西能为我家托娃带去安慰。

original: I've been looking for an Amulet of Arkay to remind my wife that our child is with the gods now, but I can't find one.
traduit: 我一直想找一件阿尔凯护符来提醒我妻子，我们的孩子已经与众神同在了，但我还没找到。

original: Your wife is in mourning?
traduit: 你妻子在服丧？

original: Tell me now or I'll kill you where you stand!
traduit: 现在告诉我，否则就杀了你！

original: No, please! There's no need for that! I'll tell you everything.
traduit: 不，不要！没必要这样！我会把一切都告诉你。

original: It's Karliah... her name is Karliah.
traduit: 是卡莱亚……她叫卡莱亚。

original: He's going to owe us for this betrayal.
traduit: 他会因这次背叛欠我们的。

original: Aye, he does indeed... and with his fingers in the East Empire Company's pie, we'll make good use of that debt.
traduit: 哎，是这样没错……他染指了东帝国公司的生意，我们会好好利用这笔账。

original: If I'm not being clear enough, that means we don't want him killed.
traduit: 如果我说得还不够清楚，意思就是，我们不希望他死。

original: For now, just keep on his tail and he's bound to step into something he can't scrape off his boot.
traduit: 现在，只要跟着他，早晚能抓住他的小尾巴。

original: I don't need to prove anything to you. I'm done here.
traduit: 我不需要和你证明什么。告辞。

original: I know that mound - high on the hill east of Kynesgrove.
traduit: 我知道那个冢，就在凯娜之林东边的山上。

original: Why didn't you say so earlier? At least now we don't have to waste time searching the area.
traduit: 你怎么不早说？好在我们不用浪费时间搜索这里了。

original: We should get moving. There's no time to waste.
traduit: 我们走。没时间了。

original: Hold on. I'm not ready to go yet.
traduit: 等等。我还没准备好。

original: I can't wait around for you to make up your mind. I'll meet you at Kynesgrove. Don't waste time getting there.
traduit: 没时间等你想事情了。我们凯娜之林见。路上别浪费时间。

original: Let's go kill a dragon.
traduit: 我们去屠龙吧。

original: I need to get into my traveling gear. Give me a minute and I'll be ready.
traduit: 我需要穿上旅行装备。稍等片刻我就准备好了。

original: Good. Good. Now we won't have to spend time searching for it.
traduit: 好。好。我们现在不用花时间找了。

original: The Greybeards are right. I am Dragonborn.
traduit: 灰胡子说得对。我是龙裔。

original: I hope so. But you'll forgive me if I don't assume that something's true just because the Greybeards say so.
traduit: 我也希望如此。但请原谅，我不能因为灰胡子说什么就跟着附和。

original: I just handed you the Horn of Jurgen Windcaller. Does that make me Dragonborn, too?
traduit: 我刚刚把“唤风者”约根的号角交给你了。难不成我现在也算龙裔了？

original: Take that thing down!
traduit: 把它弄下来！

original: I am Sahloknir! Hear my Voice and despair!
traduit: 我乃撒洛克尼尔！聆听我之吼声，感受绝望！

original: It's to be a real fight, then. Good!
traduit: 一场真正的战斗。好极了！

original: My lord Alduin requires your death. I am glad to oblige him.
traduit: 我主奥杜因要尔等死亡。我乐意为其效劳。

original: I see that mortals have become arrogant while I slept.
traduit: 凡人在我沉睡期间竟变得如此傲慢。

original: My Voice has been silent for too long!
traduit: 我之吼声沉寂已久！

original: Hiding will not save you!
traduit: 东躲西闪也难救你性命！

original: Dohaviin, your Voice is no match for mine!
traduit: 都瓦克因，你之吼声远不及我！

original: Your Voice is strong... for a mortal.
traduit: 以凡人而言，你的吼声还算有力。

original: Come and face me, then!
traduit: 来直面我！

original: I do not fear you, Dovahkiin!
traduit: 都瓦克因，我可不会怕你！

original: Go. Tell your commanders you have won. I, my family, and my men will be gone before they arrive.
traduit: 去吧。告诉你的指挥官，你们赢了。我，还有我的家人、部下会在他们到达前离开这儿。

original: There is no point in further talk. Go now!
traduit: 没必要再谈下去了。赶快出发吧！

original: We surrender. The capital is yours. If you pledge no harm will come of my people, I turn over the seat of power to you.
traduit: 我们投降。首府是你们的了。只要保证不再祸害我的民众，宝座可以交给你们。

original: It's over. No more violence.
traduit: 结束了。别再抵抗了。

original: Sir...
traduit: 阁下……

original: Enough! Stop!
traduit: 够了！停！

original: Cease fighting. It's over.
traduit: 停止战斗。结束了。

original: Well, let me know if you ever want to practice.
traduit: 好吧，如果你想练习就告诉我。

original: You chose the wrong girl to mess with.
traduit: 你惹错人了。

original: Nice shot! Right on target.
traduit: 射得好！命中目标了。

original: Now hit it again.
traduit: 现在再来一次。

original: Let me know if you want to practice some more. Next time we'll make it a little more challenging.
traduit: 如果你还想练习，就告诉我。下次可以加强些挑战性。

original: You need to stay inside the boundaries.
traduit: 你得站在界限内。

original: Only use the practice arrows.
traduit: 只能用练习箭哦。

original: Stay within the boundaries and only use the practice arrows.
traduit: 站在界限之内，使用练习箭。

original: Shoot the right target.
traduit: 射击右侧目标。

original: Shoot the left target.
traduit: 射击左侧目标。

original: Shoot the middle target.
traduit: 射击中间目标。

original: Two Imperial drunks who thought they were above the law.
traduit: 两个自以为能凌驾在法律上的帝国酒鬼。

original: Don't be like them. Don't feel sorry for me.
traduit: 不要像他们一样。别为我感到难过。

original: Nice job hitting those targets.
traduit: 目标完成得不错。

original: Excellent. Follow me to the targets and we'll begin.
traduit: 太好了。跟我去靶子那儿，我们可以开始了。

original: One, two, three...
traduit: 一，二，三……

original: Time's up! Better luck next time.
traduit: 时间到！祝你下次好运。

original: Here, take these. Looks like you're running low.
traduit: 来，拿着吧。看你的像是快用光了。

original: Listen to me and you might learn something.
traduit: 好好听我说，也许你能学点东西。

original: Let's see if I can teach you a few things about using a bow.
traduit: 看看我能不能教你些用弓的技巧。

original: Remember, composure and speed. You don't need to see your arrow hit before moving onto your next target. Trust your shot is true.
traduit: 记住，冷静加速度。在你转向下一个目标之前，不要去看箭有没有射中。要相信自己的箭术。

original: Take care, stranger. Be careful out there.
traduit: 保重吧，陌生人。在外面要小心。

original: Shoot the far target.
traduit: 射击远处目标。

original: It was nice to spend time with someone who enjoys archery as much as I do.
traduit: 能和一样喜欢射箭的人在一起真是太好了。

original: Lost, stranger?
traduit: 迷路了吗，陌生人？

original: Looking to practice, stranger?
traduit: 是想练习吗，陌生人？

original: Try and hit the middle target.
traduit: 试着射射中间的目标。

original: Ready to practice some more?
traduit: 准备好继续练习了吗？

original: Let me know if you want to try again.
traduit: 如果还想再试试就告诉我。

original: Try and hit the left target.
traduit: 试着射射左面的目标。

original: Try and hit the right target.
traduit: 试着射射右面的目标。

original: Great job hitting those targets. You definitely surprised me with your speed and composure.
traduit: 能射完所有的靶子。你的速度和沉着让我感到震惊。

original: It's not often I get visitors out here. You lost, stranger?
traduit: 这里很少有客人。你是迷路了吗，陌生人？

original: Try and hit the far target.
traduit: 试着射射远处的目标。

original: You're a mercenary?
traduit: 你是佣兵？

original: I am an artisan, painting in strokes of blood red upon the canvas of life. But yes, I will take coin to fight at your side.
traduit: 我是艺术家，专门在生命的画布上用血作画。但是，我愿意收钱和你并肩作战。

original: After all, where is the value in creating art if there is nobody left alive to see it?
traduit: 毕竟，没活人见证的话，创造艺术又有什么价值可言？

original: Why'd the Companions reject you?
traduit: 战友团为什么拒绝你？

original: It wasn't my fault! I told them over and over that it was an accident!
traduit: 那不是我的错！我一直在跟他们解释那是个意外！

original: They wanted me to prove my worth, so they threw me up against a young whelp of a lad, hardly old enough to grow his first chin-hairs.
traduit: 他们想让我证明自己的价值，就把个下巴没毛的小子扔给我。

original: I guess they thought a woman wasn't strong enough to hurt him. I didn't mean for him to die! Why would I want that? I just... lost control.
traduit: 我猜他们是觉得女人不够强也伤不到他。我也没想让他死！再说也没理由啊？我只是……没控制好。

original: Sounds like you've got a grudge.
traduit: 听起来你心里有怨气啊。

original: You been talking to those Companions?
traduit: 你已经和战友团谈过了？

original: "Too hot-headed," they cried. Weak, pathetic cowards, the lot of them!
traduit: 他们说我“太急躁了”。都是些软弱可怜的懦夫！

original: You must really love to fight.
traduit: 你很喜欢战斗吧。

original: The heat of battle is the fire that forges the strongest blades. It's an old Nord proverb.
traduit: 诺德古话讲，战斗的激情是锻造最坚固刀剑的烈火。

original: That, and a true Nord never misses a chance to test her worth.
traduit: 所以啊，一个真正的诺德人是绝不会错过考验自己价值的机会的。

original: What do you know of the Khajiit?
traduit: 你对卡吉特了解多少？

original: About the same as everyone else. They're the cat-folk of Elsweyr. Great warriors, good traders.
traduit: 和其他人差不多。他们是来自艾斯维尔的猫族。是伟大的战士和优秀的商人。

original: Way I hear it, Elsweyr ain't nothing like Skyrim. It's got tropical forests and dusty badlands. It sounds awful!
traduit: 据我所知，艾斯维尔和天际迥乎不同。那里有热带森林和尘土飞扬的荒漠。听起来很糟糕。

original: You mentioned trading caravans?
traduit: 你提到了商队？

original: Yeah, these Khajiit make a living traveling the roads and selling their wares.
traduit: 是，那些卡吉特靠沿途贩运货物为生。

original: It's got to be tough. Skyrim's a hard enough land when you've got a roof over your head.
traduit: 肯定很艰难。就算对拥有栖身之所的人来说，天际都是片相当严酷的土地。

original: Worst thing is, nobody wants them in the cities. Nobody trusts them.
traduit: 最糟糕的是，没人想让他们进城，也没人信任他们。

original: What can you tell me about Whiterun?
traduit: 你能跟我说说白漫城吗？

original: Hmph. Plenty.
traduit: 嗯，那可有的说了。

original: I'd say we're prosperous enough. Most folk don't go hungry, if they're willing to work hard.
traduit: 我们这里已经足够繁荣了。只要愿意努力工作，大多数人都不会挨饿。

original: The city's ruled by the Jarl up in Dragonsreach. That's the fortress, there, up on the tall hill.
traduit: 领主在龙临宫里统治这座城市。那儿，就是远处高山上的堡垒。

original: But you're probably more interested in Jorrvaskr, mead hall of the Companions. Their deeds of war and valor are... legendary.
traduit: 但你可能会对月瓦斯卡更感兴趣，那里是战友团的蜜酒大厅。他们的战争和英勇事迹……非常传奇。

original: Arise! Arise and defend us!
traduit: 起来吧！起来保护我们！

original: Porch. (<Global=HDRiftenPorch> gold)
traduit: 走廊。（<Global=HDRiftenPorch>金币）

original: (sigh)
traduit: （叹气）

original: No. Not really.
traduit: 不。算不上有。

original: This isn't over. I catch you sending one letter to General Tullius, I'll have you both executed.
traduit: 这不算完。一旦我抓住你给图留斯将军送信，我就处决了你俩。

original: You mentioned the Great War.
traduit: 你提到了浩大战争。

original: About 30 years ago, the Aldmeri Dominion invaded the Empire. It was a surprise attack, caught everyone off guard.
traduit: 大概30年前，先祖神洲入侵了帝国。那次突然袭击让大家措手不及。

original: They ended up sacking the Imperial City. I was there, blasting apart young Elven men and women with Fireballs and Lightning Bolts.
traduit: 他们最终洗劫了帝都。我当时在场，用火球和闪电箭把那些年轻的精灵男女炸开。

original: By Akatosh, all the blood. The smell of flesh burned and pulled apart by magic. I never want to do that to another soul ever again.
traduit: 阿卡托什在上，遍地是血。血肉的味道被魔法烧焦和撕裂。我再也不想对别人做这种事了。

original: You cannot prevail against me. I will outlast you... mortal!
traduit: 你们赢不了我。笑到最后的必将是我……凡人！

original: I knew it... Mercer sent you to kill me! Guards, there's an intruder!
traduit: 我知道……墨瑟派你来杀我！卫兵，有入侵者！

original: In honor of your service in battle, I am hereby granting you permission to purchase property in Whiterun. Talk to my steward if you're interested.
traduit: 为了表彰你在战斗中的贡献。我在此授予你在白漫城购置房产的权利。有兴趣的话可以去找我的总管。

original: In honor of your service in battle, I am hereby granting you permission to purchase property in Markarth. Talk to my steward if you're interested.
traduit: 为了表彰你在战斗中的贡献。我在此授予你在马卡斯城购置房产的权利。有兴趣的话可以去找我的总管。

original: In honor of your service in battle, I am hereby granting you permission to purchase property in Riften. Talk to my steward if you're interested.
traduit: 为了表彰你在战斗中的贡献。我在此授予你在裂谷城购置房产的权利。有兴趣的话可以去找我的总管。

original: In honor of your service in battle, I am hereby granting you permission to purchase property in Windhelm. Talk to my steward if you're interested.
traduit: 为了表彰你在战斗中的贡献。我在此授予你在风舵城购置房产的权利。有兴趣的话可以去找我的总管。

original: Just... leave here! Leave us alone!
traduit: 快……离开这里！离我们远点！

original: Begone from here! Get out of this orphanage! Help!Somebody help me!
traduit: 从这儿离开！离开这个孤儿院！救命！谁来救救我！

original: Oh, thank Arkay. Please, take this gold for your troubles.
traduit: 哦，感谢阿尔凯。请收下这些钱，麻烦你了。

original: I found your amulet.
traduit: 我找到你的护身符了。

original: Well, would you look at that! Argonian Ale! My thanks, friend. Here, take this here healing potion. I, er, "found" it in the temple.
traduit: 哇，看看这个！阿尔贡麦芽酒！谢谢你朋友。拿着这个治疗药水吧。我在神殿里，呃，“发现”的。

original: Here's that special ale you wanted.
traduit: 这是你要的麦芽酒。

original: A bit of jewelry for your journey home?
traduit: 回去时候带点首饰吗？

original: The dragon at <Alias=BountyLocation> is dead. I'm here for the bounty.
traduit: <Alias=BountyLocation>的龙已经死了。我是来领赏的。

original: The Jarl has put out a bounty on the dragon that's been terrorizing the countryside. Here, take a look at this decree for details.
traduit: 领主在悬赏一直祸害乡里的巨龙。给，悬赏令上有详情。

original: The Battle-Borns?
traduit: 战狂是怎么回事？

original: Don't even get me started on that lot.
traduit: 别跟我提那些东西。

original: They put on airs like they're somethin' special. Sure, they've got money, but they ain't got a shred of honor between 'em.
traduit: 他们到处摆架子，好像自己很特别似的。当然，他们是有钱，但没有一点荣誉可言。

original: Gray-Mane. Now that's a name fills you with pride. We've got roots in Whiterun. We've got history.
traduit: 灰鬃才是值得你骄傲的名字。我们在白漫城树大根深，有悠久的历史。

original: Where's Jorrvaskr?
traduit: 月瓦斯卡在哪？

original: Head up the steps from the market an' look to your right. Can't miss it.
traduit: 从市场往台阶上面走，向右看去就是了。不会走错的。

original: Do you trust them?
traduit: 你信任他们吗？

original: Matter of fact, I do. They've been fair enough with me, far as I can tell.
traduit: 当然了。据我所知他们对我已经很公道了。

original: And a Nord knows a liar when she sees one.
traduit: 而且诺德人一眼就能认出骗子。

original: Reputation, mostly. A lot of Khajiit turn to smuggling and thievery to get by.
traduit: 主要还是名声不好。有很多卡吉特靠走私和盗窃为生。

original: A few bad apples spoil the bunch. You know how it is.
traduit: 一粒老鼠屎搅了一锅汤。你应该明白这个道理。

original: Thanks for sticking around and keeping me company.
traduit: 谢谢你一直陪着我。

original: It was nice to finally meet someone out here who doesn't want to rob you or take off your head.
traduit: 很高兴终于能在这里碰上一个既不想抢你也不想砍你脑袋的人。

original: I know it isn't much, but here, take this bow. It was given to me by my family. It's special to me, but brings back too many painful memories.
traduit: 我知道这不值钱，但拿着这把弓吧。这是我家人给我的。对我来说很特别，却也带来了太多痛苦的回忆。

original: Looks like you're no longer needed. Time to die.
traduit: 看起来我不再需要你了。去死吧。

original: Maybe I can teach you thing or two about using a bow.
traduit: 也许我可以教你一两招弓箭。

original: It was my pleasure. It's not often I get visitors out here. Let alone friendly ones.
traduit: 这是我的荣幸。我这里很少有客人来。更不用说是友人了。

original: Thanks for helping me out.
traduit: 谢谢你帮我。

original: I think I've taught you everything I know. You might even be as good as me now.
traduit: 我已经把我知道的都教给你了。你现在可能和我一样厉害了。

original: Kind of scary if I think about it.
traduit: 想想都挺吓人的呢。

original: I'm ready for some more practice.
traduit: 我准备好再练习练习了。

original: Great shot. Now hit the target to the right.
traduit: 射的不错。现在射右面的目标。

original: I want to try again.
traduit: 我想再试一次。

original: You did it! All three targets in eight seconds. Nice job.
traduit: 你成功了！八秒中搞定三个目标。干得漂亮。

original: I'll count to three and then say "go." You have eight seconds to hit each of the three targets. Draw string and get ready.
traduit: 我数到三，就说“开始”。八秒内射中三个靶子。拉好弦，做好准备。

original: When I tell you to, try and hit each of the three closest targets in eight seconds.
traduit: 当我喊开始之后，试着在八秒内射击最近的三个靶子。

original: If you can learn to keep your composure and trust that each shot is true, then you should be able to quickly handle multiple targets.
traduit: 如果你能保持冷静，相信每一箭都能射中，那么你就能快速解决多个目标。

original: So whenever we came across more than one deer in a single location, it was imperative we kill as many as we could.
traduit: 所以每当我们在一个地方遇到不止一头鹿的时候，都必须尽可能地多猎杀几头。

original: At the time, it was difficult to keep food on the table, let alone have enough left over to sell at the market.
traduit: 那时候，连自家餐桌上都没什么食物，更别提到市场上出售剩余的了。

original: My older brother took me out hunting a lot when I was little.
traduit: 小时候我哥常带我出去打猎。

original: Now hit the target to the left.
traduit: 现在射击左面的目标。

original: It's easy - stay inside the boundaries and only use the practice arrows.
traduit: 很简单，站在界限内，只用练习箭射击。

original: What are the rules again?
traduit: 规则是什么来着？

original: I need some practice arrows.
traduit: 我需要些练习箭。

original: OK, let's see what you can do.
traduit: 好了，来看看你做的怎么样。

original: Remember to stay within the boundaries and only use the practice arrows. I have some if you don't have any.
traduit: 记住，要待在界限内，只能使用练习箭。如果你没有的话，就来找我要。

original: Aim for the middle target.
traduit: 瞄准中间的目标。

original: If you can remain calm, even in the midst of chaos, your arrow will most likely find its target.
traduit: 如果你能够保持冷静，那么即使在混乱中，你的箭依旧能找到它的目标。

original: She always said composure was the key to a successful archer.
traduit: 她总是说，沉着冷静是成为神射手的关键。

original: My father was rarely home, so it was my mother who actually taught me how to use a bow.
traduit: 我父亲很少在家，实际上一直是我母亲教我怎么用弓的。

original: I was just curious.
traduit: 我只是好奇。

original: Well aren't you a strange one.
traduit: 你可真奇怪。

original: You're right. I was probably mistaken.
traduit: 你说得对。我可能搞错了。

original: Of course you were. Now stop wasting my time.
traduit: 当然。别再浪费我的时间了。

original: It's true. He told me.
traduit: 是真的。他告诉我的。

original: Please, stop wasting my time. You're embarrassing yourself.
traduit: 拜托，别浪费我时间了。你这样太尴尬了。

original: What do you think of him?
traduit: 你觉得他怎么样？

original: Think of him? He's an odd little man. Always poking around the ruins and wasting time in his museum.
traduit: 他？他就是个古怪的小男人。总是在遗迹里乱翻，然后宅在博物馆里。

original: Seems friendly enough. Obviously intelligent. Why do you ask?
traduit: 看上去挺友善的。当然，也很聪明。你问这个干什么？

original: He has feelings for you.
traduit: 他对你有感觉。

original: What? You're out of your mind. That old coot's more interested in dead dwarves than anybody around here.
traduit: 啥？你疯了吧。比起和我们这些活人打交道，那老家伙更喜欢研究死了的矮人。

original: Don't talk such rot.
traduit: 别说这种废话了。

original: I want to talk to you about Calcelmo.
traduit: 我想跟你聊聊卡塞莫。

original: Calcelmo? What about him?
traduit: 卡塞莫？他的什么？

original: You're probably overthinking this.
traduit: 你可能是想多了。

original: That may be the case.
traduit: 但这可能就是事实。

original: But she is as volatile as a sabre cat. One wrong word, and I've seen her turn on a man so quickly...
traduit: 她就像个剑齿虎一样反复无常。只要说错一句就完了，我见过她对男人变脸有多快……

original: You sound a little confused.
traduit: 你听起来有点困惑。

original: I don't want to choose! They're both so amazing.
traduit: 我不想选择！他们都很好。

original: Are you prepared, then, to help bring the light across this land?
traduit: 那你准备好把光明带到这片土地上了吗？

original: Is it still possible to aid the temple?
traduit: 神殿还需要什么帮助吗？

original: Always, child. Mara's mercy is ever-flowing.
traduit: 一如既往，孩子。玛拉的仁慈永不停息。

original: I don't think I can help you.
traduit: 我可能帮不了你。

original: Do not forsake your heart, child, for it may one day come to surprise you.
traduit: 别放弃你的善心，孩子，总有一天它会让你惊喜的。

original: Mara will always accept into her arms should you seek return to her fold.
traduit: 如果你想回归玛拉的怀抱，她会永远乐意接纳你的。

original: Have it your way. I'll take the job, but don't expect a miracle.
traduit: 随你便吧，单子我接了，但别指望有奇迹。

original: Ha! I'd sooner bend my knee to Ulfric Stormcloak.
traduit: 哈！那我直接去跪乌弗瑞克·风暴斗篷不就完了？

original: Besides, Gray-Mane would never make steel for the Legion.
traduit: 再说，灰鬃也绝不会为军团打造武器。

original: I just can't fill an order that size on my own.
traduit: 这么大的订单我一个人可做不过来。

original: Why don't you swallow that stubborn pride of yours and ask Eorlund Gray-Mane for help?
traduit: 你为什么不放下固执的自尊去请厄伦德·灰鬃帮忙呢？

original: We'll pay whatever it takes. But we must have more swords for the Imperial soldiers.
traduit: 多少钱我们都会给。我们必须为帝国士兵准备更多的剑。

original: What's dangerous about daedra?
traduit: 迪德拉有什么危险？

original: They are profane creatures with no hope of redemption. They lure innocents to their deaths and corrupt the souls of all they touch.
traduit: 他们是不可救药的异教怪物。他们会引诱无辜的人送死、腐化他们接触过的灵魂。

original: And their heretical artifacts grant powers to mortals that wreak havoc across Tamriel. They must be destroyed or guarded to prevent temptation.
traduit: 他们的异端神器会给予凡人力量，对泰姆瑞尔造成严重破坏。必须把它们摧毁或者监管起来，防止凡人被诱惑。

original: Who's Stendarr?
traduit: 斯丹达尔是谁？

original: He is the God of Mercy. The patron of order and justice for all of Tamriel.
traduit: 他是仁慈之神。泰姆瑞尔秩序与正义的守护神。

original: We bring his compassion where none can be found, by cleansing all those who would offend his children.
traduit: 我们把他的仁慈带到人迹罕至的地方，净化那些冒犯他子民之物。

original: You're bloated with disease. The Vigilant of Stendarr can help you, as long as you promise to never assist the Daedra.
traduit: 你因疾病而浮肿了。斯丹达尔警戒者可以帮你治疗，但你要保证不再帮助迪德拉。

original: I am Keeper of the Vigil here in Skyrim. We bring Stendarr's Mercy to the innocent and His Justice to the Daedra.
traduit: 我是天际的斯丹达尔警戒者。我们会把斯丹达尔的仁慈带给无辜者，把他的正义审判施与迪德拉。

original: You speak to a Vigilant of Stendarr. Cavort with any Daedra, and we will hunt you down.
traduit: 我是斯丹达尔的警戒者。只要敢与迪德拉勾结，我们都会抓到你。

original: Wherever the Daedra hide, the Vigil of Stendarr will cast them into the light.
traduit: 无论迪德拉藏在何处，斯丹达尔警戒者之光会让他们无处遁形。

original: Stendarr's Mercy be upon you, for the Vigil has none to spare.
traduit: 斯丹达尔的仁慈会保佑你，但警戒者没那么多富裕的怜悯。

original: Walk always in the light, or we will drag you to it.
traduit: 永远行于光明，不然就由我们把你拉回正道。

original: The suffering the Daedra cause will not go unpunished.
traduit: 造就苦难的迪德拉一定会受到惩罚。

original: The Mercy of Stendarr does not extend to Daedra worshippers.
traduit: 斯丹达尔的仁慈不会保佑迪德拉信徒。

original: You're a Vigilant of Stendarr?
traduit: 你是斯丹达尔的警戒者？

original: Yes. Our order was founded after the Oblivion Crisis. We dedicate our lives to facing the threat of Daedra wherever they appear.
traduit: 没错。我们的教团是在湮灭危机之后建立的。无论迪德拉出现在何处，我们都会全力以赴。

original: Stendarr be with you.
traduit: 斯丹达尔与你同在。

original: The Vigil will be watching you.
traduit: 警戒者会盯着你的。

original: None escape the Vigil. All come into the light.
traduit: 没人能躲避警戒者。所有人都应该活在光明中。

original: Please cure me.
traduit: 请治疗我。

original: Stendarr's Light purify you of your ills.
traduit: 斯丹达尔之光已经净化了你的疾病。

original: Fine. Take all the artifacts I have.
traduit: 好吧。把我的神器都拿走吧。

original: Wise decision. The vaults in the Hall of the Vigilant will guard this against future temptation.
traduit: 明智的决定。我们会把东西带到警戒者之厅的保管库封存起来，以免日后再有人受到诱惑。

original: You hunt daedra?
traduit: 你们在狩猎迪德拉？

original: And any other abominations that prey on mortals. Vampires. Werewolves. Witches.
traduit: 还有其他掠夺人类的可憎之物。吸血鬼、狼人、女巫。

original: But the Daedra are the worst. Their callous disregard for our lives is abhorrent in the eyes of the God of Mercy.
traduit: 但迪德拉是最糟糕的。他们对我们生命的漠视，在仁慈之神看来也是可恶的。

original: Thank you for your role in all of this.
traduit: 谢谢你所做的一切。

original: It'd be my honor should you decide to make Whiterun your home. Speak with Proventus. He'll make the necessary arrangements.
traduit: 如果你决定要在白漫城安家，那将是我的荣幸。和普罗万图斯谈谈。他会做必要的安排。

original: For Whiterun! For the Empire!
traduit: 为了白漫！为了帝国！

original: Carry on men, my gratitude and blessings go with you!
traduit: 继续加油吧，伙计们，接受我的感激与祝福！

original: Lest our honor be lessened should we allow these bloodthirsty beasts to prowl our lands!
traduit: 如果坐视这群嗜血的野兽游荡在我们的土地上，我们会因此蒙羞！

original: Ha! The most important question of all, that one.
traduit: 哈！这才是最重要的问题对吧。

original: You'll want the Bannered Mare. See old Hulda, she'll keep you swimmin' in mead.
traduit: 去悬旗母马吧。找老胡尔达，她会让你在蜜酒的海洋里荡漾的。

original: But mind he bard, Mikael. Poncy little milk drinker, that one.
traduit: 但是要注意那个吟游诗人，米凯尔。那家伙是个小懦夫。

original: Where can I get a drink?
traduit: 我到哪里找酒喝？

original: You'll want the Bannered Mare. See Olfina, she'll keep you swimmin' in mead.
traduit: 去悬旗母马吧。找奥菲娜，她会让你在蜜酒的海洋里荡漾的。

original: Ain't sure if they're takin' on new members, but you should talk to the Companions. They're over in their hall, Jorrvaskr.
traduit: 你应该去找战友团谈谈，但我不确定他们是否在招新人。他们就在月瓦斯卡大厅。

original: If by "work" you mean "testing your steel in bloody battle."
traduit: 如果你说的“工作”是指“在血腥的战斗中检验武器”的话。

original: Any place I can find work?
traduit: 我到哪儿能找些工作？

original: Aye, that I do. Have all my life. We Battle-Borns have been here since the beginning. Along with the Gray-Manes.
traduit: 是啊，我一辈子都住在这儿。我们战狂从一开始就和灰鬃一样在这里了。

original: Our families been close as kin for generations.
traduit: 我们两家世代交好。

original: But Ulfric Stormcloak's uprising has divided us. Now seems we can scarce look at each other without comin' to blows. Petty and foolish, that.
traduit: 但乌弗瑞克·风暴斗篷的起义把我们搞得分裂了。到现在，我们只要对视一眼都能打起来。真是小气而愚蠢。

original: They're sayin' dragons have returned to Skyrim. Now that there, that's a real problem.
traduit: 现在有传言说龙族回归天际了。这才是真正的问题。

original: You live here?
traduit: 你住在这里吗？

original: A pity. And words I hear too often.
traduit: 遗憾啊。这话我听的太多了。

original: But there's no shame in it. One of them dragons comes callin' in Whiterun, the place'll go up like tinder.
traduit: 但这并不可耻。如果有龙向白漫袭来，这地方就会像易燃物一样炸开。

original: Just passing through.
traduit: 只是路过。

original: Ha! By Shor, this city could use more like you.
traduit: 哈！舒尔在上，这城市需要更多像你这样的人。

original: Best head up to Dragonsreach, then, and see the Jarl. He's lord of Whiterun, and can set you on the path.
traduit: 你最好到龙临宫去见领主。他是白漫城的主人，会适当安排你的。

original: I'm here to help, in any way I can.
traduit: 我是来尽我所能提供帮助的。

original: Ah, so it's gold you're after, then?
traduit: 啊，这么说你是来淘金的？

original: You need only ask about. Plenty o' folk in Whiterun with too much fat and gold to be bothered doing anything for themselves.
traduit: 四处问问就行。白漫城不缺那种脑满肠肥还什么事都不愿意自己干的有钱人。

original: I seek my fortune.
traduit: 我来寻找财富。

original: Well met, kinsman. What brings you to Whiterun?
traduit: 你好啊，老乡。什么风把你吹到白漫城来了？

original: Well met, traveler. What brings you to Whiterun?
traduit: 你好啊，旅行者。什么风把你吹到白漫城来了？

original: And so, we must each one of us, continue to fight this insurrection, lest our fallen brothers have died for naught!
traduit: 所以，我们大家必须继续与叛乱作斗争，不要让倒下的弟兄们白白牺牲！

original: ...You! Why?
traduit: ……你！为什么？

original: But Ulfric will not stop here. No, he will continue to strike out against any true Nord who remains faithful to the Empire.
traduit: 但乌弗瑞克不会就此止步。他会继续打击忠于帝国的诺德人。

original: He will continue to sow discord and chaos wherever he can.
traduit: 他会利用一切可能去制造纷争与混乱。

original: The citizens of Whiterun are forever in your debt!
traduit: 白漫的公民永远铭记你们的贡献！

original: In defeating these Stormcloak traitors, you have proven the hollowness of their cause and the fullness of your hearts.
traduit: 在击败风暴斗篷叛徒时，你们证明了他们的事业是虚假的，而你们的心灵是充实的。

original: They already sing of your valor and skill! The halls of Sovngarde are no doubt ringing with your praises!
traduit: 他们在歌颂你的英勇与技巧，称赞声响彻松加德的大厅！

original: Revel in your victory here today, even as the gods revel in your honor!
traduit: 尽情享受今天的胜利吧，众神为你们的荣耀欢呼！

original: Everyone, on me! The Jarl wishes to speak!
traduit: 所有人注意！领主有话要说！

original: You don't look like a guard.
traduit: 你看起来不像警卫。

original: We're not. The Silver-Bloods pay our wage. Every man here is a trained mercenary.
traduit: 确实不是。银血家付钱给我们。这里人人都是训练有素的雇佣兵。

original: Keep out? Why?
traduit: 躲开？为什么？

original: This is a jail, owned by the Silver-Blood family. We use the prisoners to mine for ore.
traduit: 这里是银血家族的监狱。我们利用囚犯开采矿石。

original: It's the most secure prison in Skyrim. Throw scum in, close the gates. No one gets out.
traduit: 这里是天际最安全的监狱。只要把那些人渣扔进来，把门一关。没人能出来。

original: So unless you're here to dig, you don't belong here.
traduit: 所以除非你是来挖矿的，就跟这儿没关系。

original: Now, you. Get down there.
traduit: 喂，你。下去。

original: All right. Open her up.
traduit: 好了。把门打开。

original: I'm sorry. I'm a little deaf in this ear.
traduit: 抱歉。我耳朵有些聋啊。

original: Don't get smart with me. I'm in charge. You keep it up, I'll have your toes cut off.
traduit: 别耍小聪明。我管着这里。再装，我就把你脚指头剁了。

original: Got it, ma'am.
traduit: 明白了，女士。

original: When do I get out?
traduit: 我什么时候能出去？

original: You won't. The Jarl has ordered a life sentence for you. Get comfortable in the dark, 'cause you'll never see the sun again.
traduit: 你出不去了。领主给你判了无期徒刑。好好适应黑暗吧，你再也看不见太阳了。

original: You'll pay off your debt to the Reach. Just work and you'll earn your freedom.
traduit: 你先要还清欠瑞驰的债务。好好工作，你会获得自由的。

original: All right, prisoner. Eyes front. You're in Cidhna Mine, now. And we expect you to earn your keep.
traduit: 好了，囚犯。看着前面。你现在在希讷矿场了。你好好工作吧。

original: There's no resting your hide in a cell in this prison. Here, you work. You'll mine ore until you start throwing up silver bars.
traduit: 在这个监狱里，你无处藏身。只能好好工作。开采矿石直到挖出银条来。

original: You got it?
traduit: 明白了？

original: I said get down there. Now.
traduit: 我教你下去。快点。

original: Maybe you're right. I guess I just didn't want anyone to think I couldn't handle one Nord lass.
traduit: 也许你说得对。我看我也只是因为不想让别人觉得我应付不了一个诺德姑娘。

original: On my honor, I won't bother Carlotta ever again.
traduit: 以我的名誉起誓，我不会再打扰卡萝塔了。

original: She's not yours. Stop this nonsense. (Persuade)
traduit: 她不是你的。别说这种胡话了。（说服）

original: What did you just say? All I heard was the sound of jealousy.
traduit: 你刚才说什么？怎么醋味这么大呢。

original: Bold words, but true. Fine, you win. I'll pay the Argonians more coin.
traduit: 豪言壮语，但此言不虚啊。好，算你赢了。我会给阿尔贡更多钱的。

original: They'll work harder if you pay them more. (Persuade)
traduit: 如果你多付些钱，他们会更努力工作的。（说服）

original: They don't work now. Why should I waste more money?
traduit: 他们现在不工作，我为什么要浪费更多的钱？

original: All right, all right. You sound like a damn Legion officer, but I get it. I'll give him a break. This better not hurt our quota.
traduit: 好吧，好吧。你说话像个军团军官似的，但我懂。我会饶他的。但最好不要影响到我们的业绩。

original: You're working him to death. Lay off. (Persuade)
traduit: 你快把他累死了。停下吧。（说服）

original: I'm in charge of the smelter. Not you. So why don't you lay off?
traduit: 负责这家冶炼厂的是我不是你。你怎么不停下？

original: Fine. You sound like a priest of Mara, but I get your point. Tell him to forget about the gold.
traduit: 好吧。你说话像个玛拉祭司似的，但我明白你的意思。告诉他把账忘了吧。

original: He's an old man. Let it go. (Persuade)
traduit: 他就是个老头子。放过他吧。（说服）

original: A debt. Is a debt.
traduit: 欠债还钱。天经地义。

original: I guess you're right. A Nord shouldn't be so proud to turn down a kind soul's generosity. Tell Iddra I'll be fine.
traduit: 说得对。诺德人不该傲慢地拒绝善良灵魂的慷慨。告诉艾德拉我没事了。

original: Stop being stubborn. Let it go. (Persuade)
traduit: 别太固执了。忘了吧。（说服）

original: No. I have my pride.
traduit: 不。我有自己的骄傲。

original: You're right. What would my forefathers think if they knew I wasn't paying my debts? Tell Haran I'll bring her the gold I owe.
traduit: 你说得对。要是我祖宗知道我欠钱不还，他们该怎么想？告诉哈兰我会把欠她的钱还上的。

original: You owe her gold. Pay it. (Persuade)
traduit: 你欠她的。还是付钱吧。（说服）

original: And I told you I'd pay it when I'm good and ready.
traduit: 我告诉过你，等有钱了我会还清的。

original: How am I doing?
traduit: 我做的怎么样？

original: (Crying)
traduit: （哭泣）

original: We're quartered in the Hall of the Vigilant. Keeper Carcette heads Skyrim's branch of our order there, providing healing and justice as needed.
traduit: 我们就住在警戒者之厅。守护者凯西提领导我们在天际的分部，会在需要的时候提供治疗与正义。

original: To the block, prisoner. Nice and easy.
traduit: 上断头台来吧，囚犯。放松点。

original: Next, the Nord in the rags!
traduit: 下一个，那个穿得破烂的诺德人！

original: Next, the lizard!
traduit: 下一个，那个蜥蜴！

original: Next, the Breton!
traduit: 下一个，那个布莱顿人！

original: Next, the dark elf!
traduit: 下一个，那个暗精灵！

original: Next, the high elf!
traduit: 下一个，那个高精灵！

original: Next, the renegade from Cyrodiil!
traduit: 下一个，那个希罗帝尔的叛徒！

original: Next, the cat!
traduit: 下一个，那只猫！

original: Next, the Orc!
traduit: 下一个，那个兽人！

original: Next, the Redguard!
traduit: 下一个，那个红卫人！

original: Next, the wood elf!
traduit: 下一个，那个木精灵！

original: As we commend your souls to Aetherius, blessings of the Eight Divines upon you, for you are the salt and earth of Nirn, our beloved....
traduit: 当我们祈祷你们的灵魂升入光界之时，八圣灵的祝福会降临你的身上，你们是奈恩的盐与土，我们挚爱的……

original: It's nothing. Carry on.
traduit: 没什么。继续吧。

original: Ulfric Stormcloak. Some here in Helgen call you a hero. But a hero doesn't use a power like the Voice to murder his king and usurp his throne.
traduit: 乌弗瑞克·风暴斗篷。海尔根里有些人把你叫做英雄。但英雄可不会用吼声的力量去谋杀国王、篡夺王位。

original: Forget the list. He goes to the block.
traduit: 别管名单了。一并处置了。

original: Forget the list. She goes to the block.
traduit: 别管名单了。一并处置了。

original: Follow the Captain, prisoner.
traduit: 跟上队长吧，囚犯。

original: Captain. What should we do? He's not on the list.
traduit: 队长。我们该怎么办？他不在名单上。

original: Captain. What should we do? She's not on the list.
traduit: 队长。我们该怎么办？她不在名单上。

original: To blazes with Nocturnal. I'm here for the Eyes.
traduit: 去他的诺克图娜尔。我是来拿伐莫之眼的。

original: Wait a moment... do I detect a hint of genuine avarice from this noble thief?
traduit: 稍等……我能从这个高贵的贼身上看出一丝真正的贪婪？

original: Perhaps Karliah and Brynjolf misjudged you and your true nature is no different than my own.
traduit: 或许卡莱亚和布林乔夫看错你了，你和我是一丘之貉啊。

original: He's no longer abusing the power of the Eye. I would've expected all this to stop.
traduit: 他不能在滥用眼的力量了。真希望这一切就此结束。

original: And yet...
traduit: 可是……

original: You've done it! You've beaten him!
traduit: 你成功了！你打败他了！

original: I have a delivery from Hillevi.
traduit: 希勒维有东西要给你。

original: Ah yes, the extract, good. Poisonous, of course, but it has its uses.
traduit: 哦对，那瓶精华，很好。虽然有毒，但也有它的用处。

original: I suppose you want something for your trouble? Here.
traduit: 我猜你是想要些酬劳吧？给。

original: Do you grow all your own crops?
traduit: 你自己种庄稼吗？

original: Everything you see is grown at my family's own Hollyfrost Farm. Fresh and filling.
traduit: 你看到的所有东西都是我家冬青霜农场出产的。新鲜充足。

original: I also do a little herb growing. The court wizard, Wuunferth, pays us to plant a little Nightshade. Who knows what he uses it for?
traduit: 我也会种些药草。宫廷巫师巫恩菲斯付钱让我们种些夜影花。谁知道他是拿来干什么用的？

original: Hey, could you deliver this bottle of Nightshade Extract to Wuunferth?
traduit: 嘿，你能把这瓶夜影花精华送到巫恩菲斯那儿去吗？

original: But we haven't taken a side because it's not our fight.
traduit: 但我们没有站队，这就不是和我们有关的战争。

original: Maybe we'll pay you a visit tonight, little spy. We got ways of finding out what you really are.
traduit: 也许我们今晚可以去找你，小间谍。我们有的是办法查出你的真实身份。

original: Imperial spies? You can't be serious!
traduit: 帝国间谍？你不是认真的吧！

original: Hey, maybe the reason these gray-skins don't help in the war is because they're Imperial spies!
traduit: 嘿，也许这些灰皮是帝国间谍，所以才拒绝支持战争！

original: You come here where you're not wanted, you eat our food, you pollute our city with your stink and you refuse to help the Stormcloaks.
traduit: 你们来到根本不需要你们的地方，吃着我们的饭，用你们的臭味污染我们的城市，还拒绝帮助风暴斗篷。

original: You are worthy. The knowledge is yours.
traduit: 你值得拥有这份知识。

original: The Augur was a brilliant mage. Truly inspired. Mastered spells others could barely comprehend.
traduit: 占卜师是个聪明的法师。能力卓越。掌握了别人几乎无法理解的法术。

original: He was especially gifted when it came to Restoration. He's... Well, he's very particular about who shares the knowledge.
traduit: 他在恢复系方面很有天赋。他……哎，他对与谁分享知识方面很挑剔。

original: So you'll need his approval first. Go on, go talk to him. I'm sure he's been paying attention, and will be expecting you.
traduit: 所以你需要先得到他的批准。去吧，跟他谈谈。我相信他一直在注意，正等着你呢。

original: I thought you were the authority on this subject.
traduit: 我以为你是这方面的权威。

original: Oh, goodness no. There are those far more skilled than I.
traduit: 哦，不。有人比我更加娴熟。

original: What does the Augur have to do with this?
traduit: 占卜师和这事有什么关系？

original: Oh, didn't you know?
traduit: 哦，你不知道吗？

original: It looks like you're ready to speak with the Augur.
traduit: 看来你已经准备好和占卜师谈谈了。

original: What else is there to be learned about Restoration Magic?
traduit: 关于恢复系魔法还有什么可学的？

original: Look at you. Such a devoted student of Restoration.
traduit: 瞧瞧。你对于恢复学派何等虔诚。

original: It's comforting to see that not everyone has dismissed it as entirely as most members of the College. Truly comforting.
traduit: 不是每个人都像学院里大多数人那样完全否定它，这足够令人感到欣慰了。

original: Which is why I brought the Elder Scroll.
traduit: 所以我带来了上古卷轴。

original: You are banished! Alduin, we shout you out from all our endings unto the last!
traduit: 你被放逐了！奥杜因，我等之龙吼会将你放至末日来临之时！

original: Begone, World-Eater! By words with older bones than your own we break your perch on this age and send you out!
traduit: 离去吧，世界吞噬者！借比你更久远的上古骸骨之语，我们将你从这个时代彻底驱逐！

original: Faal Kel...?! Nikriinne...
traduit: 法尔 科尔……？尼克瑞聂……

original: Meyye! Tahrodiis aanne! Him hinde pah liiv! Zu'u hin daan!
traduit: 米诶耶！塔洛迪斯 安聂！西姆 亨德 帕 立夫！祖'乌 亨 丹！

original: You are banished!
traduit: 你，被放逐了！

original: No, damn you!
traduit: 不！该死！

original: You feel fear for the first time, worm. I see it in your eyes.
traduit: 终于害怕了吧，你这虫子。我从你眼睛里看出来了。

original: If I die today, it will not be in terror.
traduit: 死有何惧。

original: Gormlaith! We're running out of time! The battle...
traduit: 葛姆拉丝！我们没时间了！战斗……

original: DCETNoticeCorpse
traduit: DCETNoticeCorpse

original: We've got a murderer on the loose...
traduit: 有个在逃的杀人犯……

original: What...? Whoever did this, you're dead. You hear me? Dead!
traduit: 什么……？不管是谁，你都死定了。你听到了吗？你死定了！

original: Kill one of us, and three more will take their place. The Forsworn are unstoppable.
traduit: 杀了一个，就会有三个接替他。弃誓者是不可阻挡的。

original: Your body lies dead, but your soul has joined our ranks...
traduit: 你的肉体已经死了，但你的灵魂会加入我们……

original: Freshly killed. Whoever did this is still close... and will suffer for their insolence.
traduit: 刚刚死的。不管是谁干的肯定就在这附近……而且要为他们的傲慢付出代价。

original: Damn. We've got trouble.
traduit: 该死的。我们惹上麻烦了。

original: Sovngarde take your soul. I'll avenge your body.
traduit: 松加德会带走你的灵魂。我会为你的尸体报仇。

original: Well now, this is unexpected...
traduit: 哎呀，这可真是没想到……

original: I'll claw the eyes out of whoever did this!
traduit: 我要把凶手的眼睛挖出来！

original: Dead! Someone's going to pay for this.
traduit: 死了！得让那人付出代价。

original: Hsss! Dead. Who did this?
traduit: 嘶！死了。谁干的？

original: Damn it, this will not stand!
traduit: 该死，这不可能！

original: What...? No... No, this can't be happening...
traduit: 什么……？不……不，这不可能……

original: A...a body! How absolutely terrible.
traduit: 尸……尸体！太可怕了。

original: Murdered? By Azura, who would do such a thing?
traduit: 杀人了？阿祖拉在上，是谁干的？

original: What? Someone will suffer for this injustice.
traduit: 什么？那人必须为这种不义之举付出代价。

original: I'm going to find whoever did this, and when I do...
traduit: 我一定要找到凶手，等我找到了……

original: By Ysmir! There's a killer about.
traduit: 伊斯米尔啊！附近有杀手。

original: Hmph. Looks like we got a cutthroat skulkin' around...
traduit: 嗯。看起来我们附近有个鬼鬼祟祟的杀手……

original: Ain't nothing pretty about a corpse. No matter how fresh.
traduit: 尸体再怎么新鲜也没什么好看的。

original: You should be more careful about the women you spend time with in port. Come back later and it will be ready.
traduit: 你在港口找女人的时候应该更小心点。过会儿再来，就好。

original: Can you make some new poultices for my...you know?
traduit: 你得做些新的药膏给我……你懂吧？

original: Back so soon Xander?
traduit: 这么快就回来了，赞德尔？

original: I doubt it can be repaired. You'll have to buy a new one.
traduit: 我不知道还能不能修好。你得买个新的。

original: My tunic is fading. Too much sun and salt spray.
traduit: 我的外衣褪色了。晒得太厉害了，还都是盐沫子。

original: If you give me a list, I'll have them delivered to the dock by tomorrow morning.
traduit: 给我清单，码头早上我送到码头。

original: I need some things for the ship.
traduit: 我需要给船准备些东西。

original: Man gives bards a bad name.
traduit: 这家伙败坏了吟游诗人的名声。

original: We Nords have a long history as warrior poets. I am proud to count myself among them.
traduit: 我们诺德人有很悠久的战士诗人历史。我很自豪能成为其中一员。

original: But Mikael... He sings only for gold and the affections of wenches. He dishonors our traditions.
traduit: 但米凯尔……他只是为了钱和姑娘的芳心而歌唱。玷污了我们的传统。

original: You don't like Mikael?
traduit: 你不喜欢米凯尔？

original: Dovahkiin, you call yourself? Arrogant mortal.
traduit: 你敢自称都瓦克因？傲慢的凡人。

original: Bahloki nahkip sillesejoor.
traduit: 巴洛基 纳吉普 斯乐瑟约尔。

original: I will feast on your soul in Sovngarde!
traduit: 我会在松加德饱餐你的灵魂！

original: You are no match for me, joor!
traduit: 约尔，你岂是我的对手！

original: Paarthurnax is weak. I am strong.
traduit: 帕图纳克斯很弱。但我却很强大。

original: My time has come again.
traduit: 我的时代再度来临了。

original: Maar saraan ko Sovngarde.
traduit: 马尔 萨兰 寇 松加德。

original: You are no match for me, Dovahkiin.
traduit: 都瓦克因，你不是我的敌手。

original: I have feasted on many greater than you.
traduit: 我曾吞噬过不少比你还强的人。

original: You will pay for your defiance!
traduit: 为你的反抗付出代价！

original: Looked like those Nords were giving you trouble.
traduit: 看起来这些诺德人一直在找你麻烦。

original: Nothing new there. Most of the Nords living in Windhelm don't care much for us, but Rolff is the worst by far.
traduit: 不算新鲜事了。住在风舵城的大多数诺德人都不怎么关心我们，但罗尔夫最恶劣的一个。

original: He likes to get drunk and walk around the Gray Quarter yelling insults at us in the small hours of the morning. A real charmer, that one.
traduit: 他喜欢喝得酩酊大醉然后在灰民区瞎溜达，在半夜凌晨对着我们大吼大叫，这人真有意思。

original: Not a chance. Not for this. You're going to the Cidhna Mine for the rest of your days.
traduit: 没戏。不是钱的事儿。你这辈子就待在希讷矿场吧。

original: Well... maybe just this once. But there's still a price on your head. Better make yourself scarce, or we'll have to do this little dance again.
traduit: 嗯……那下不为例。但还是有人要悬赏你的脑袋。你最好走远点，不然我们又要来一遍了。

original: You really think the dark elves are Imperial spies?
traduit: 你真觉得暗精灵是帝国间谍吗？

original: Wouldn't surprise me. They've done nothing to help in the fight for Skyrim's freedom.
traduit: 没什么不可能。他们没给天际的自由做出过任何贡献。

original: Those Thalmor are elves, too. I bet they're working together.
traduit: 那些梭默也是精灵。我打赌他们是一伙的。

original: Maybe I should round up some men and take us a few prisoners to interrogate.
traduit: 也许我该找几个人把他们抓起来审审。

original: Why do you hate the dark elves?
traduit: 你为什么恨暗精灵？

original: They're parasites. They're living in our city, under our protection, but what do they do for us? Nothing!
traduit: 他们都是寄生虫。他们住在我们的城市里，受我们的保护，但为我们做了什么？什么都没有！

original: I know the High King invited them here, but he didn't ask me or anyone else first. Maybe he should have.
traduit: 我知道是至高王邀请他们来这里的，但他没有事先征询我还有其他人的意见。他应该先问问我们。

original: Are you treated as badly as the dark elves?
traduit: 你也和暗精灵遭遇一样糟吗？

original: It was difficult at first. The Nords of this city are, at best, suspicious of outsiders.
traduit: 一开始很困难。城里的诺德人不过是对外人保持怀疑而已。

original: But in time, I made the right friends and proved myself useful enough that they don't give me trouble anymore.
traduit: 但随着时间推移，我也交了很多朋友，证明了自己的价值，他们就不再给我找麻烦了。

original: The dark elves are too proud and naive to understand the way things truly are, and so they continue to dwell in that slum.
traduit: 暗精灵自视太高，也太天真，无法理解人情世故，所以就只能继续住在那边的贫民窟了。

original: You live in the Gray Quarter?
traduit: 你住在灰民区？

original: I'm a Dark Elf and I live in Windhelm, so yes, I live in the Gray Quarter.
traduit: 我一个住在风舵城的暗精灵，当然住在灰民区。

original: You must be new around here, or you'd know they don't let my kind live anywhere outside that slum.
traduit: 你一定是新来的，不然你就会知道，我们一族除了贫民窟外哪里也不能住。

original: You there. If you're here to trade, step up to the counter.
traduit: 嘿。如果你是来交易的，请到柜台这儿来。

original: It's just the market rabble. We should get back to work.
traduit: 只是市场闹事罢了。我们该继续工作了。

original: Did you hear all that noise outside?
traduit: 你听到外面的吵闹了吗？

original: Yes, let's keep going.
traduit: 好，我们继续走吧。

original: I want to get out here.
traduit: 我想离开。

original: Excuse me.
traduit: 抱歉了。

original: I'm sorry about your family.
traduit: 我为你家人的事感到遗憾。

original: Let's see about that. Time to die!
traduit: 那就看看。受死吧！

original: Sorry, a girl can't be too careful out here.
traduit: 抱歉，姑娘家独自在外越小心越好。

original: Like I said, name's Angi and I've been living out here for a couple of years now.
traduit: 我刚说了，我叫安吉，我在这里一个人住有些年了。

original: Calm down. I'm not going to hurt you.
traduit: 冷静点。我不会伤害你的。

original: Name's Angi and if you try anything stupid I won't hesitate to put in arrow in your head.
traduit: 我叫安吉，如果你敢做什么傻事我会毫不犹豫把你一箭爆头的。

original: I'm ready for some practice.
traduit: 我准备好练习了。

original: I moved here from Helgen after my family was killed.
traduit: 我家人被杀以后，我就从海尔根搬到这里了。

original: At the time I couldn't stand to be around anyone. They all felt sorry for me and I didn't want them to. It was my problem, not theirs.
traduit: 那时候我受不了和人们住在一起，他们都对我报以同情，但我不打算让他们同情我。那是我的问题，和他们无关。

original: Why live out here all by yourself?
traduit: 为什么一个人住在这里啊？

original: I could also do some good for a change. Sure, I'd go with you.
traduit: 我也可以帮上忙。好吧，我和你一起去。

original: I am sorry.
traduit: 我很抱歉。

original: Keep Mother's staff. Think of it as payment. I want to leave everything from this cursed place behind. Goodbye. And thank you.
traduit: 拿着我母亲的法杖吧。就当是报酬吧。我想离开这个被诅咒的地方。再见。还有，谢谢你。

original: You could come with me.
traduit: 你可以跟我一起走。

original: I suppose it would be better than sitting around thinking about all this.
traduit: 总比在这里坐着强。

original: I'm not picking sides.
traduit: 我不会选边站的。

original: Sooner or later, we all have to choose a side.
traduit: 或早或晚，我们都得做出选择。

original: Gray-Mane or Battle-Born?
traduit: 灰鬃还是战狂？

original: I don't know what you're asking.
traduit: 我不知道你在问什么。

original: New in town, huh? Whiterun's got two clans, both old and both respected.
traduit: 新来此地的吧？白漫城有两个同样古老而受人尊敬的家族。

original: Difference is, the Gray-Manes turned their backs on the Empire and we Battle-Borns stayed loyal.
traduit: 不同的是，灰鬃背弃了帝国而我们战狂依然忠诚。

original: So I'll ask again, Gray-Mane or Battle-Born?
traduit: 所以我再问一遍，灰鬃还是战狂？

original: Battle-Born.
traduit: 战狂。

original: Then I say well met, friend. I could tell you were a sharp one the moment I laid eyes on you.
traduit: 那请容我问好，朋友。我一眼就看出你是个精明人。

original: Gray-Mane.
traduit: 灰鬃。

original: Then you're either a Stormcloak sympathizer or a fool. Either way, you're no friend of mine.
traduit: 那你要么是风暴斗篷的支持者，要么是个傻子。不管怎样，你都不是我的朋友。

original: Got stones in your ears? I asked what side you're on, Gray-Mane or Battle-Born!
traduit: 耳朵里塞石头了？我是问你站在哪一边，灰鬃还是战狂！
