original: There's a whole college up in Solitude where they teach the arts. Song. Lute-playing. Poetry.
traduit: 独孤城有所教授此类艺术的学院。歌曲、鲁特琴、诗歌。

original: I studied there myself. Had to leave over a misunderstanding with a headmistress. Well, more a misunderstanding with her husband.
traduit: 我也在那里学习过。不过因为和一位女院长发生了些误会，不得不离开了。哎，更准确说是和她丈夫有误会。

original: Let's just say Hircine would be jealous.
traduit: 或许海尔辛也会嫉妒。

original: Probably better than you.
traduit: 可能比你还好。

original: No, not really.
traduit: 不，不太会。

original: That I am. You know how to use one?
traduit: 没错。你知道怎么用吗？

original: Are you any good with your bow?
traduit: 你很会用弓箭吗？

original: I set up those targets a long time ago. I shoot at them from time to time. Don't want to get rusty with my bow.
traduit: 我很久前就在这儿安了这些靶子。时不时地射几箭。不能让弓生锈啊。

original: What are those targets for?
traduit: 这些靶子是怎么回事？

original: Karliah's close, I'm certain of it. Now let's get moving.
traduit: 卡莱亚就在附近了，我可以确定。现在我们前进吧。

original: Fortunately, these doors have a weakness if you know how to exploit it. Quite simple, really.
traduit: 幸运的是，这些门有个弱点，如果你懂得如何利用。就很简单了，真的。

original: Without the matching claw, they're normally impossible to open. And since I'm certain Karliah already did away with it, we're on our own.
traduit: 没有对应的龙爪就打不开。而且我敢肯定卡莱亚已经把它毁了，我们只能靠自己了。

original: Ah, it's one of the infamous Nordic puzzle doors. How quaint.
traduit: 啊，臭名昭著的诺德谜语门。真有趣。

original: Quite simple really, I don't know what the fuss is about these locks. All it takes is a bit of know-how and a lot of skill.
traduit: 真的很简单，我不知道这些锁有什么好大惊小怪的。只是需要一点窍门和大量经验。

original: That should do it. After you.
traduit: 这样就行了。你先进吧。

original: This one doesn't look too difficult.
traduit: 但这个看起来不难。

original: They say that these ancient Nordic burial mounds are sometimes impenetrable.
traduit: 别人都说这些古诺德的陵墓有时候根本进不去。

original: Hey, ugly!
traduit: 嘿，丑八怪！

original: Hey, slug-breath!
traduit: 嘿，鼻涕虫！

original: Hey, skeever butt!
traduit: 嘿，耗子屁股！

original: Hey, cheese brain!
traduit: 嘿，奶酪脑！

original: Hey, melon nose!
traduit: 嘿，大鼻头！

original: Hey, troll bait!
traduit: 嘿，活肉饵！

original: DB02AstridWalkAwayTopic
traduit: DB02AstridWalkAwayTopic

original: I'll cut right to it. You murdered the old woman in the orphanage. You owe the Dark Brotherhood a kill. I've come to collect.
traduit: 我直接切入正题吧。你杀了孤儿院的老太太。欠黑暗兄弟会一条命。我就是来收账的。

original: One of these poor sods has a contract out on their life. Which one is it? Any idea? Make your choice. Make your kill. And you get to walk away.
traduit: 这些倒霉蛋里有一个被定下了契约。哪一个？怎么想？你选吧。把人杀了，你就能走了。

original: Too rich for my blood.
traduit: 我付不起啊。

original: Suit yourself, but you better decide what you want to do about this arrest. No one walks away for free.
traduit: 随你便，但你最好想想怎么处理这次逮捕。没人能不花钱就走人。

original: Yes, clear my bounty. (<Global=GuildCost> gold)
traduit: 好吧，我付清罚金。（<Global=GuildCost>金币）

original: Done. Now move along, before you get me in trouble.
traduit: 完事儿了。走吧，别在我这儿惹麻烦。

original: Falkreath seems quiet.
traduit: 佛克瑞斯似乎很宁静。

original: Only inside the gates. Much of Falkreath hold is wilderness and there's plenty of trouble to be had.
traduit: 仅限大门以内吧。佛克瑞斯领大部分都是荒野，麻烦多着呢。

original: Grant me access or you'll regret it. (Intimidate)
traduit: 让我进去，否则你会后悔的。（恐吓）

original: Do you realize that at a snap of my fingers I can bring the entire Markarth city guard to my defense?
traduit: 你知不知道，我打个响指，全马卡斯城的卫兵都会过来保护我？

original: You best rethink this course of action or you may find yourself on the executioner's block.
traduit: 你最好谨言慎行，否则会被送上断头台。

original: But I'm a great admirer of your work. (Persuade)
traduit: 但我非常钦佩你的研究啊。（说服）

original: What kind of a mentor would I be if I denied a potential student a glimpse at his master's ingenuity!
traduit: 如果不能让潜在的学生看到老师的聪明才智，那我还算什么导师！

original: Here, this key will provide access to my museum. Feel free to browse for as long as you wish.
traduit: 给，这是我博物馆的钥匙。想看多久就看多久。

original: However, I must insist that my laboratory remains strictly off limits.
traduit: 不过，我必须继续保持实验室严格封闭。

original: While I appreciate the sentiment, I still have to decline.
traduit: 虽然我很欣赏你这种感情，但还是恕我拒绝。

original: Being an admirer, I'm sure you can appreciate the need to keep my research a secret.
traduit: 作为我的仰慕者，相信你能够理解我的研究保密的必要性。

original: I'd give you a bow, but it looks like you've already taken it from the rack.
traduit: 我本想给你张弓的，但看来你已经从架子上把它拿下来了。

original: dunArcherQST_NoticeTargetsTopic03a
traduit: dunArcherQST_NoticeTargetsTopic03a

original: If you need a bow, there's one on the rack to the left of the door.
traduit: 如果你需要弓，门左边的架子上有一张。

original: Already did. Part of the reason I'm living out here now. Thanks for offering though.
traduit: 已经处理完了。这也是我现在住在这里的原因之一。谢谢你的好意。

original: Want me to take care of them?
traduit: 用我去料理他们吗？

original: Who killed your family?
traduit: 谁杀了你的家人？

original: Sounds like a waste of time.
traduit: 听上去是浪费时间。

original: Well nobody asked you. If you think you're better than we are, go talk to Kodlak Whitemane.
traduit: 没人求你。如果你觉得自己比我们强，就去找“白鬃”克拉科。

original: See what a warrior of true mettle is like.
traduit: 看看真正有勇气的战士是什么样子。

original: Who are the Companions?
traduit: 战友团是什么人？

original: I tried my best.
traduit: 我已经尽力了。

original: Ha. Another milk drinker crying about his effort.
traduit: 哈。又一个懦夫在为自己那点儿努力哭哭啼啼。

original: Glory only awaits those who triumph.
traduit: 荣耀只会等待胜者。

original: And as Companions, our glory must always be hard-fought.
traduit: 作为战友团，我们的荣耀永远是来自艰苦奋斗。

original: You didn't look like you needed help.
traduit: 你看起来不像需要帮助的样子。

original: Certainly not. But a true warrior would have relished the opportunity to take on a giant.
traduit: 确实不需要。但一个真正的战士会珍惜与巨人一战的机会。

original: That's why I'm here with my Shield-Brothers.
traduit: 所以我才和我的盾牌兄弟到这儿来。

original: Can I join you?
traduit: 我能加入吗？

original: Not for me to say. You'll have to talk to Kodlak Whitemane up in Jorrvaskr.
traduit: 我说了不算。你得去月瓦斯卡找“白鬃”克拉科。

original: The old man's got a good sense for people. He can look in your eyes and tell your worth.
traduit: 老爷子看人很准。他可以透过你的眼睛，看清你的价值。

original: If you go to him, good luck.
traduit: 如果去找他，那就祝你好运吧。

original: What is a Shield-Brother?
traduit: 盾牌兄弟是什么？

original: What is a Shield-Sister?
traduit: 盾牌姐妹是什么？

original: You handle yourself well. You could make for a decent Shield-Brother.
traduit: 你干得不错。是个做盾牌兄弟的料。

original: You handle yourself well. You could make for a decent Shield-Sister.
traduit: 你干得不错。是个做盾牌姐妹的料。

original: Well, that's taken care of. No thanks to you.
traduit: 嗯，事情解决了。没得谢你了。

original: Damn it, not now!
traduit: 该死，现在不行！

original: Who in Dagon's name are you? Speak, or I'll cut you down where you stand.
traduit: 大衮在上你是谁？快说，不然砍死你。

original: Who knows. The cat was crazy. She was a fool to trust him.
traduit: 谁知道呢。那猫疯了。她可真傻，居然相信他。

original: But.. stealing the boss's sword? Did he have a death wish?
traduit: 但……偷老大的剑？他这不是找死吗？

original: Ra'jirr was always dragging her into things.
traduit: 拉'吉尔总是把她拖下水。

original: But... Eisa? She's smarter than that.
traduit: 但是……埃莎？她不会那么笨啊。

original: When I tell you to, try and hit all four targets in ten seconds.
traduit: 听我喊开始，试试十秒内射中四个目标。

original: Just remember everything I've taught you and you should be able to complete it.
traduit: 但只要记住我教给你的一切，就该能完成。

original: It may take you a couple of tries, but that's what practice is all about.
traduit: 可能需要尝试几次，但这就是全部的训练了。

original: I'm warning you now, this challenge will be quite difficult.
traduit: 我提醒你啊，这个挑战很有难度。

original: We've talked about composure, speed, and precision.
traduit: 我们已经谈到了冷静、速度还有精度。

original: Now it's time to use all three at once.
traduit: 现在是时候同时使用这三项了。

original: You did it! All four targets in ten seconds. Nice job.
traduit: 成功了！十秒内搞定了四个目标。干得不赖。

original: I'll count to three and then say "go." You have ten seconds to hit each of the four targets. Draw string and get ready.
traduit: 我数到三，然后说开始。你有十秒钟时间来射中四个目标。拉好弓弦，做好准备。

original: OK, your turn. Try and hit that target way in the back, far behind the other three. Remember to take your time and make your shot count.
traduit: 好了，轮到你了。试着射后面那个比其他三个更远的靶子。记着要慢慢来，要让射击真的奏效。

original: If you find yourself in such a situation, then you need to make your shot count.
traduit: 如果你发现自己处于这种情况，那就需要让你的射击发挥最大作用。

original: Don't rush your shot. Crouch down, get comfortable, and take aim.
traduit: 不要急着射击。蹲下，调整个舒服姿势，好好瞄准。

original: However, with such a long shot, it's more than likely that's the only shot you'll be able to take before your prey runs off.
traduit: 然而，这么远距离的射击，很可能是你在猎物逃掉前的唯一一击。

original: Often times you won't be able to get as close to your prey as you'd like and you'll have to settle with a long shot.
traduit: 通常情况，你没法顺利接近你的猎物，所以必须进行长距离射击。

original: We've talked about speed and composure. Now we'll go over precision.
traduit: 我们已经聊过了速度和沉着的问题。现在说说精度。

original: Thanks, Aia. That means a lot.
traduit: 谢了，艾雅。这话对我很重要。

original: Glad to hear it, Aia.
traduit: 很高兴听你这么说，艾雅。

original: None of what he collected tasted as good as your Spiced Wine, Evette.
traduit: 他收集的不如你的香料酒好，爱芙缇。

original: I'm still finding your Spiced Wine to be the best drink I've ever tasted.
traduit: 我还是觉得你的香料酒是我喝过最好的。

original: Rum from Hammerfell, mulled wine from Daggerfall and the like.
traduit: 落锤的朗姆酒，匕落的热红酒之类的。

original: You know, my father collected exotic alcohols.
traduit: 我父亲喜欢收藏外国酒。

original: I seem to have more chores for the Winking Skeever each day. I still have a delivery to do too.
traduit: 我似乎每天在眨眼恶鼠都有更多的杂务要做。我还得去送货呢。

original: A little late in the day for your rounds Sorex.
traduit: 你出来逛有些晚啊，索莱克斯。

original: Thank you, Addvar, I am picky about what I eat these days.
traduit: 谢谢了，艾达瓦。我这几天吃东西很挑剔。

original: I've been pushing the Salmon but I'll tell you the Slaughterfish is a bit better today.
traduit: 我一直在推销鲑鱼，但我告诉你，今天的食人鱼会好一点。

original: Fresh fish sounds like just the thing today, Addvar.
traduit: 看来今天的菜是鲜鱼了，艾达瓦。

original: I appreciate the thought though.
traduit: 不过我很欣赏他的想法。

original: I don't think he would have wanted your absolution, Rorlund. He worshiped Talos.
traduit: 我不认为他会想要你的赦免，洛伦德。他信仰着塔洛斯。

original: I wish we could have absolved your brother-in-law of his sins before his execution.
traduit: 我本希望你舅子被行刑前能被赦免。

original: As long as they're playing instruments they're passable. You don't want to hear them sing.
traduit: 如果是演奏乐器，那他们还说得过去。你不会想听他们一展歌喉的。

original: Speaking of sounding good, I've heard a couple of your classmates on the street recently.
traduit: 说到听起来不错，我最近在街上听到过你的几个同学在表演。

original: Salmon sounds good today.
traduit: 今天的鲑鱼听起来好像不错。

original: A war veteran should be respected.
traduit: 老兵应该得到应有的尊重。

original: A sale's a sale but I have to know... why are you buying something for Noster?
traduit: 虽然只是买卖，但我还是想知道……你为什么会给诺斯特买东西？

original: I am buying a fish for Noster. He likes fish.
traduit: 我是来给诺斯特买鱼。他喜欢吃。

original: Okay. Well. That's all I've got.
traduit: 好吧。我这里也只有这些了。

original: I do not like fish.
traduit: 我不喜欢吃鱼。

original: Jawanan, I don't see you here often.
traduit: 加瓦南，我不常在这里见到你啊。

original: Greta is taking it hardest. She won't go to the Temple of Divines anymore.
traduit: 格瑞塔才是最难过的。她都不再去神殿了。

original: I'm sorry about Roggvir. It's a shame, I liked him.
traduit: 罗吉维尔的事很遗憾。真可惜，我挺喜欢他的。

original: Stand back. Interrupting an execution is a serious crime.
traduit: 退后。打断行刑是大罪。

original: Cut em down!
traduit: 杀了他！

original: Booooo.
traduit: 吁。

original: He doesn't deserve to speak!
traduit: 他不配说话！

original: Liar!
traduit: 骗子！

original: Traitor!
traduit: 叛徒！

original: I have a delivery from <Alias=QuestGiver>.
traduit: <Alias=QuestGiver>有东西给你。

original: Oh right, the rum. Thank you. I developed a taste for it after a fair weather trip to Hammerfell.
traduit: 哦对，朗姆酒。谢谢。自从在落锤旅行过之后，我就喜欢上这东西了。

original: Yeah, thanks.
traduit: 啊，谢谢。

original: I can deliver that for you.
traduit: 我可以帮你送货。

original: Save me a lot of trouble. Here. Take it to the Blue Palace.
traduit: 省我大麻烦了。给。把它送到蓝宫。

original: Who's in charge of Solitude?
traduit: 谁统治独孤城？

original: Jarl Elisif the Fair. Poor woman. Losing her husband and king like that. It was a dark day for us all.
traduit: 艾利西弗领主。可怜的女人。就这样失去了她的丈夫和王。对我们所有人来说，那都是黑暗的一天。

original: Damn, that reminds me, I have a delivery to make to her steward, Falk Firebeard. He ordered a special bottle of Stros M'Kai Rum.
traduit: 该死，这倒是提醒我了，我要给她总管“火胡”佛可送点东西。他点了一瓶特制的斯卓·米'凯朗姆酒。

original: We all get used, dear. It's living with it that makes you a woman.
traduit: 我们都习惯了，孩子。忍受它，才能成长为女人。

original: I was such a fool. How could I let him use me like that?
traduit: 我真是个傻瓜。怎么会让他这样利用我？

original: Stop moping about, girl. Tears won't change what you've done.
traduit: 别闷闷不乐了，姑娘。泪水改变不了一切。

original: Real men prove their love. Words are as empty as the air they run through.
traduit: 真正的男人会证明自己的爱。说话还不就像空气一样空洞。

original: He said he loved me....
traduit: 他说过他爱我……

original: You should be more careful with the men you pick, dear.
traduit: 你挑男人的时候要小心点，亲爱的。

original: Up the stairs! Quickly!
traduit: 快上楼！

original: Move! Up the tower!
traduit: 快走！往塔上走！

original: Come on! Before the dragon brings down the whole tower!
traduit: 快走！在龙把整个塔毁了前离开这！

original: What are you waiting for? Up the stairs! Now!
traduit: 你在等什么！快上楼！

original: We need to move. Now!
traduit: 我们现在得走了！

original: Hey, kinsman. Get up! Come on, the gods won't give us another chance!
traduit: 嘿，老乡。快起来！神可不会给我们第二次机会！

original: Hey, dark elf. Get up! Come on, the gods won't give us another chance!
traduit: 嘿，暗精灵。快起来！神可不会给我们第二次机会！

original: Hey, Breton. Get up! Come on, the gods won't give us another chance!
traduit: 嘿，布莱顿人。快起来！神可不会给我们第二次机会！

original: Hey, Khajiit. Get up! Come on, the gods won't give us another chance!
traduit: 嘿，卡吉特。快起来！神可不会给我们第二次机会！

original: Hey, Argonian. Get up! Come on, the gods won't give us another chance!
traduit: 嘿，阿尔贡。快起来！神可不会给我们第二次机会！

original: Hey, high elf. Get up! Come on, the gods won't give us another chance!
traduit: 嘿，高精灵。快起来！神可不会给我们第二次机会！

original: Hey, wood elf. Get up! Come on, the gods won't give us another chance!
traduit: 嘿，木精灵。快起来！神可不会给我们第二次机会！

original: Hey, Redguard. Get up! Come on, the gods won't give us another chance!
traduit: 嘿，红卫人。快起来！神可不会给我们第二次机会！

original: Hey, Orc. Get up! Come on, the gods won't give us another chance!
traduit: 嘿，兽人。快起来！神可不会给我们第二次机会！

original: Hey, you. Get up! Come on, the gods won't give us another chance!
traduit: 嘿。快起来！神可不会给我们第二次机会！

original: Now you're sounding as crazy as the cat. Be going on about the Pale Lady next.
traduit: 你现在说得跟那只猫一样疯狂。跳过苍白夫人的话题吧。

original: I've got a bad feeling about this... something's just felt wrong down there lately. Eerie.
traduit: 我有一种不祥的预感……那里最近有些不对劲。很怪异。

original: Yeah, he's after Ra'jirr- never seen him so angry.
traduit: 是啊，他去追拉'吉尔了，从没见过他这么生气。

original: The boss went down there? Today?
traduit: 老大去下面了？今天？

original: There she is!
traduit: 她在那儿！

original: What? There's a whole shift down there!
traduit: 什么？下面有一整个班呢！

original: Kyr's orders. Nobody goes in or out until he gets back. Or the boss will skin you soon as he's done with Ra'jirr.
traduit: 凯尔有令。在他回来之前，不许任何人进出。否则等老大解决完拉'吉尔非扒了你的皮。

original: Has the store made any money?
traduit: 商店赚到钱了吗？

original: We have a cozy little profit. Here. This is your share, love.
traduit: 有些利润。给，这份是你的，亲爱的。

original: We've made a bit of gold. Here, love, this is your share.
traduit: 我们赚了点钱。给，亲爱的，这份是你的。

original: Fortune smiles on us. Here's your share, love.
traduit: 还算走运。这份是你的，亲爱的。

original: The gold is flowing nicely. Here's your half of the profits, my dear.
traduit: 资金流动还不错。这是你那半利润，亲爱的。

original: You want your share, don't you? Here you are, love.
traduit: 你想分点是吧？给你了，亲爱的。

original: Of course it has. Would you expect any less of me? Here, this is your half, my love.
traduit: 当然有。你对我的期望这么低吗？给，这是你那半，亲爱的。

original: It has. Here, this is your half, love.
traduit: 有的。给，这是你那半，亲爱的。

original: You should probably just take this directly to Faleen. Wouldn't want the old icebrain stumbling over the words.
traduit: 你最好直接把这个交给法琳。我可不想让那个老榆木疙瘩说错话。

original: You should probably just let Faleen read it herself. Don't want you stumbling over the words and ruining my flow.
traduit: 你还是让法琳自己看吧。别回头结结巴巴浪费了我的好诗。

original: As for what she might like...
traduit: 那她可能喜欢什么……

original: I didn't tell you this. Faleen likes to act tough, but she really has a soft spot for, of all things, poetry.
traduit: 别说是我说的。法琳表现得很强硬，但偏偏对诗歌情有独钟。

original: You know, I took some classes at the Bards College as a youth. Poems come in handy when wooing.
traduit: 我年轻的时候在吟游诗人学院上过课。诗歌在求爱时是很有用的。

original: There's a poem I once used on an older lady of Rorikstead. I can change it to be about Faleen, if you've got some gold.
traduit: 我有首诗以前是写给洛利克镇一个老太太的。如果你肯付钱，我可以改成写给法琳的。

original: It's not for me. It's for Calcelmo.
traduit: 不为我，是替卡塞莫。

original: Calcelmo? Is he interested in Faleen? That sly old codger. I should have guessed.
traduit: 卡塞莫？他对法琳有意思？那个狡猾的怪老头儿。我早该猜到的。

original: Good for him. For the both of them.
traduit: 对他来说不错。他们俩合适。

original: Between you and me, she could use a bit of warmth.
traduit: 你知我知，她需要一点温暖。

original: I'd rather not say.
traduit: 我宁可不说。

original: Ah, a secret admirer, eh? Don't worry, I won't tell a soul.
traduit: 啊，神秘的仰慕者，是吗？别担心，我不会告诉任何人的。

original: He must be here somewhere...
traduit: 他一定在什么地方……

original: I don't see any bodies here.
traduit: 我没看到任何尸体。

original: I don't have time for your foolishness. Either help me or be gone.
traduit: 我没时间听你犯傻。要么帮我，要么就走开。

original: I used Dragonrend on Alduin, but he escaped.
traduit: 我对奥杜因使用了龙魂撕裂，不过他逃跑了。

original: Esbern should be able to help. He's spent his whole life poring over every old book he could find about dragons and that prophecy.
traduit: 伊思本应该能帮上忙。他毕生都在研读他找到的所有关于龙族还有那个预言的书籍。

original: He's been digging around the records the Blades left here, too. But we can talk about that later.
traduit: 他在查找刀锋会遗留的记录。不过咱们过会儿再说这个。

original: I have good news.
traduit: 我有好消息。

original: Did you find the Elder Scroll? What happened when you took it back to the Throat of the World?
traduit: 你找到上古卷轴了？你把它带到世界之喉的时候发生什么了？

original: I defeated Alduin.
traduit: 我击败了奥杜因。

original: What's happened? Did you find a way to learn the Dragonrend Shout?
traduit: 发生了什么？你学会龙魂撕裂了？

original: As I've said, I made some progress using the essence of dragon scales. But they're just not quite potent enough.
traduit: 我说了，我利用龙鳞的精华获得了一些进展，但还不够强大。

original: My knowledge of Skyrim's history is far from complete, but I did some research and discovered two things.
traduit: 我对天际历史的了解远远不够，但我做了些研究发现了两件事。

original: First, there are ancient references to dragon "heartscales". What little I could learn suggests they may be what I need.
traduit: 首先，古代有关于龙的“心鳞”的记载。我之所学表明它们可能正是我所需要的。

original: Second, there are stories of a dagger called Kahvozein's Fang, said to be sharp enough to carve individual scales off a dragon.
traduit: 其次，有一种叫做卡沃奇恩之牙的匕首，据说锋利到能够将龙鳞切下。

original: First you'll need to retrieve the dagger, then use it to carve a few scales off a dragon. Presumably a deceased one.
traduit: 你先去把匕首取回，然后用它在龙身上片下几块鳞来。最好得是死了的。

original: I need you to collect some dragon scales. And not just any dragon scales.
traduit: 我需要你收集一些龙鳞。而且还不是一般的龙鳞。

original: I need dragon scales. And not just any dragon scales.
traduit: 我需要些龙鳞，而且还不是一般的龙鳞。

original: Is there anything more I can learn about Alteration magic?
traduit: 关于变化系魔法还有什么可学的吗？

original: At this very moment? No. However...
traduit: 现在吗？没有了。不过……

original: Well, I've been working on something. An improvement on the Ebonyflesh spell.
traduit: 嗯，我一直在研究些东西。对黑檀躯法术进行改进。

original: I've made progress, but then hit a snag. I think perhaps you could help.
traduit: 我已经取得了一些进展，但遇到了些障碍，也许你能帮上忙。

original: You are not worthy!
traduit: 你不配！

original: What kind of a test is this?
traduit: 什么测试？

original: Knowledge is power. Knowing spells can be powerful, but applying that knowledge is key.
traduit: 知识就是力量。懂得法术可以变得强大，但如何运用这些知识才是关键。

original: You will be called upon to rely solely on your Restoration spells.
traduit: 你只能依靠自己的恢复魔法。

original: I'm ready for your test.
traduit: 我准备好参加你的测试了。

original: Step into the light, and your test begins.
traduit: 走到光亮处，测试可以开始了。

original: You will rely on your skill as a mage. Not on your belongings, not on your scrolls and potions. Only what lies within.
traduit: 你将依靠自己作为法师的技能。而非诸如卷轴药剂等外物。只能求诸于内。

original: Survive, and you are worthy. This is the test put before you. Will you accept?
traduit: 生存下来，你就具有价值。这就是摆在你面前的考验。你能接受吗？

original: I'm ready for anything.
traduit: 我准备好了。

original: Arrogance will serve you poorly. Your worth must be determined before knowledge can be bestowed upon you.
traduit: 傲慢对你没有任何好处。在你获得知识前，必须先确定你的价值。

original: And so you shall be tested.
traduit: 所以你需要接受考验。

original: Prepared for what?
traduit: 准备什么？

original: Colette has already told you. You must be tested before knowledge can be imparted to you.
traduit: 柯莱特已经告诉过你。传授知识前，必须经过测试。

original: Once again you have come seeking something.
traduit: 你又来寻找什么了。

original: The circumstances differ. This time I have what you seek.
traduit: 这次情况不一样。我有你想要的东西。

original: The trial awaits. Are you now prepared?
traduit: 试炼正在等待。准备好了吗？

original: We'll come back for you as soon as we've reached our goal. You have my word.
traduit: 等我们到了目的地就回来找你。我保证。

original: No, no. You just stay here and rest.
traduit: 不，不。你就在这儿休息吧。

original: You want to stay here, fine. But the rest of us aren't giving up now.
traduit: 你想留在这里也行。但其他人还没放弃呢。

original: I don't care... We're going all the way in. I want to know what Shalidor hid in here.
traduit: 我不在乎……一路走下去吧。我想看看沙利多在这里藏了什么。

original: Don't just stand there! Kill that thing!
traduit: 别在那傻站着！快去杀了那东西！

original: Guards, get the townspeople to safety!
traduit: 卫兵，掩护镇民到安全地带！

original: Someone get the battlemages out here. Now!
traduit: 来人把战斗法师带到这来。现在就去！

original: Sentries! What do you see?
traduit: 哨兵！你看到了什么？

original: What in Oblivion is that?
traduit: 那到底是什么玩意儿？

original: I need to talk to you about Helgen.
traduit: 我想和你谈谈海尔根的事。

original: Well done. You sought me out, on your own initiative. You've done Whiterun a service, and I won't forget it.
traduit: 做得好。你能主动请见。我不会忘记你帮了白漫。

original: So. You were at Helgen? You saw this dragon with your own eyes?
traduit: 所以，你当时在海尔根？亲眼看见了那头龙？

original: What's this about Riverwood being in danger?
traduit: 河木镇有什么危险？

original: Well. I trust you have something vitally important to tell me. Important enough to interrupt me in the middle of council?
traduit: 好吧。我相信你有足够重要的事，重要到要打断我的会议。

original: Can you sing "Ragnar the Red"?
traduit: 你会唱“红发”拉格纳吗？

original: Ahhh, a fine but bloody tale. I can do that one.
traduit: 啊哈，精彩而血腥的故事。我当然会唱。

original: Do you know "The Age of Oppression"?
traduit: 你会唱“压迫年代”吗？

original: You must be a Stormcloak through and through to request that one.
traduit: 你肯定是个坚定的风暴斗篷才会点这首歌。

original: Only true Imperials request that one.
traduit: 只有真正的帝国子民才会点这首歌。

original: Do you know "The Age of Aggression"?
traduit: 你会唱“好战年代”吗？

original: Forgive me, my lord. It was foolish of me to make such a suggestion.
traduit: 原谅我，大人。我真不该提出这么愚蠢的建议。

original: Chops and steaks fit for a Jarl! Come and see my selection of finest-quality meats!
traduit: 配得上领主享用的排骨和肉排！来看看我精心挑选的肉吧！

original: Tired of bread and stew? Had enough of fish and fowl? Treat yourself and your kin to a choice cut of steak or a tender rack of ribs!
traduit: 吃腻了面包和炖菜？吃够了鱼肉鸡肉？买块上好的肉排犒劳犒劳一家人吧！

original: Ripe fruit and fresh vegetables for sale!
traduit: 成熟新鲜的水果蔬菜！

original: Take pity, sir, and spare me a few septims.
traduit: 可怜可怜我吧，先生，给我几块塞普汀吧。

original: Take pity, lady, and spare me a few septims.
traduit: 可怜可怜我吧，女士，给我几块塞普汀吧。

original: Spare a coin for a poor old beggar?
traduit: 能给可怜的老乞丐一枚金币吗？

original: If you have need of hunting supplies then you've come to the right place.
traduit: 如果你需要狩猎用品，那你来对地方了。

original: We sell bows, arrows and ale. A unique combination, to be sure.
traduit: 我们这里有弓箭和麦芽酒。这确实是个独特的组合。

original: I'll be happy to assist you if you'd like to purchase something.
traduit: 如果想买东西，我很乐意效劳。

original: I can tell you're no stranger to the wilds. I'm sure we can meet your hunting needs.
traduit: 看来您也是个野外常客。相信我们这里能满足您的狩猎需求。

original: We've got arms and armor of all kinds.
traduit: 我们这儿有各式各样的武器和护甲。

original: You look like someone who knows how to wield a weapon. Well, you've come to the right place.
traduit: 你看起来像个会使武器的。嗯，来对地方了。

original: If it's armor you need, we've got all kinds, both light and heavy.
traduit: 如果想买护甲，我们这里样式齐全，轻重都有。

original: Everything you see here was made with skill and care by my wife Adrianne.
traduit: 你现在看到的一切都是我老婆阿德里安精心打造的。

original: Please, do look around. I'm sure I have something you'll want.
traduit: 请一定四处看看。肯定有你想要的东西。

original: I can tell you're a discriminating customer. Perhaps you're a wealthy one, too, hm?
traduit: 看得出你是个有眼光的顾客。也许你还很有钱，是吧？

original: Everything's for sale, my friend! You need visit no other shops today!
traduit: 什么都有卖，朋友！你今天不需要去别的商店了！

original: I assure you, I'm prepared to make any deal.
traduit: 我可以跟你保证，我这里什么交易都做。

original: You'll find tonics, salves, poultices and potions on my shelves. Browse to your heart's content.
traduit: 我的货架上有补品、药水、药膏。随意看看。

original: I offer remedies for ailments both common and rare. Do let me know if I can be of service.
traduit: 我这里常见病罕见病药方都有。如果需要帮忙尽管提。

original: If there's anything I can help you with, you have but to ask.
traduit: 如果需要帮忙尽管开口问。

original: I sell cures for all ills, and I'll be happy to serve you.
traduit: 我这里治什么病的药都有，乐意为你效劳。

original: Walk in Gaius Maro's shadow, and deliver to him the judgment of Sithis.
traduit: 行走于加留斯·马洛的影子里，将他交给西帝斯审判。

original: Gaius Maro will die! Hail Sithis!
traduit: 加留斯·马洛死定了！西帝斯万岁！

original: He is set to leave the Penitus Oculatus outpost at Dragon Bridge, and inspect the security of each city in Skyrim.
traduit: 他会离开位于龙桥镇的洞察眼哨站，并检查天际各城的安全。

original: Go there now. Observe Gaius Maro's departure, and follow him. Waylay him in one of the cities, and send his soul to Sithis.
traduit: 去吧。目送加留斯·马洛离开，跟着他，在城里埋伏，把他的灵魂送到西帝斯那里。

original: Once he's dead, plant the incriminating letter on his body, and let fate take care of the rest.
traduit: 等他死了，就把栽赃信件放在他身上，接下来就静候命运的安排吧。

original: Oh, and one final thing...
traduit: 哦，还有一件事……

original: Killing Commander Maro would do no good. Someone would merely replace him. No, we need him to remain in charge. But... distracted. Weakened.
traduit: 杀死马洛指挥官毫无益处。总有人能取代他。所以我们需要让他继续负责。但是……要让他心烦意乱，不堪一击。

original: Implicate and kill his son Gaius, and the commander will be grief-stricken and humiliated, his family name ruined. The security plan will then fail.
traduit: 揭发并杀死他儿子加留斯，可以让指挥官伤心欲绝、颜面尽失，家族名誉扫地。他的安保计划也就失败了。

original: Best yet, the Emperor will be lulled into a false sense of security, thinking an assassination plot had already been discovered and foiled.
traduit: 最好让皇帝陷入一种虚假的安全感中，误以为暗杀阴谋已经被挫败。

original: What will killing Gaius Maro accomplish?
traduit: 杀死加留斯·马洛有什么影响？

original: Aye, I'll hate it, but I'll do it if I have to.
traduit: 是。虽然我讨厌这么做，但如果非做不可，我会下手。

original: You're not going to kill her, are you?
traduit: 你不会杀她吧？

original: It's up to her, isn't it?
traduit: 这不是取决于她自己吗？

original: If that must be, then it will. And why should I be any different? How many the lives already lost. What's one more?
traduit: 如果非要如此，那就这样吧。我又有何特殊？已经失去了那么多生命，再多我一个又怎样？

original: Rikke, leave. They'll kill you.
traduit: 瑞姬，离开这。他们会杀了你的。

original: You're a cold hearted bastard, aren't you?
traduit: 你可真是个冷血混蛋啊。

original: Just kill her and get it over with.
traduit: 干脆点杀了她，了结这事儿吧。

original: I fear that will be the way of it.
traduit: 恐怕这就是解决办法了。

original: A true Nord never fears death. It's the how and why of it that one needs consider.
traduit: 真正的诺德人从不畏惧死亡。但我们要考虑如何死、为何死。

original: We'll kill you if we must.
traduit: 如果有必要，我们会杀你。

original: Always was a stubborn woman. She's not going to stand down.
traduit: 她一直是个固执的女人。她不会放弃的。

original: War always comes down to this, doesn't it? A single truth-laden moment.
traduit: 战争总要面临这个，不是吗？一个真实而残酷的时刻。

original: Dragonborn... Perhaps this is the fate of Skyrim after all. To be destroyed from the inside.
traduit: 龙裔……或许这是天际的命运。从内部被摧毁。

original: You've left me no choice...
traduit: 但你让我别无选择……

original: Talos preserve us.
traduit: 愿塔洛斯保佑我们。

original: Rikke. You don't have to do this.
traduit: 瑞姬。你没必要这样。

original: That's not the Skyrim I want to live in.
traduit: 这不是我想生活的天际。

original: Damnit woman, stand aside.
traduit: 该死的女人，站到一边。

original: This is what you wanted? Shield brothers and sisters killing each other?
traduit: 这就是你想要的？盾牌兄弟互相残杀？

original: Families torn apart?
traduit: 妻离子散？

original: This is the Skyrim you want?!
traduit: 这就是你想要的天际？

original: You're also free to die for it.
traduit: 你也可以自由地为它而死。

original: I'm also free to stay and fight for what I believe in.
traduit: 那我也可以自由地留下来，为我的信仰而战。

original: Rikke. Go.
traduit: 瑞姬。你走吧。

original: You're free to leave.
traduit: 你可以自由离开。

original: He has given up. But I have not.
traduit: 他虽然放弃了，但是我没有。

original: Stand aside woman. We've come for the General.
traduit: 走开！你这个女人。我们是来找将军的！

original: You're a damn fool.
traduit: 你可真是个大傻子。

original: The Empire is weak, obsolete. Look at how far we've come and with so little.
traduit: 帝国已经脆弱而过时了。看看我们，才用了这些人就取得如此成就。

original: When we're done rooting out Imperial influence here at home, then we will take our war to the Aldmeri Dominion.
traduit: 等我们铲除了家乡的帝国势力，就去找先祖神洲开战。

original: You were there with us. You saw it. The day the Empire signed that damn treaty was the day the Empire died.
traduit: 你当时和我们在一起。你也看到了。帝国在签订那个该死的条约的时候已经灭亡了。

original: You're wrong. Ulfric. We need the Empire. Without it Skyrim will assuredly fall to the Dominion.
traduit: 你错了，乌弗瑞克。我们需要帝国，没有它，天际会落到先祖神洲手里！

original: Stop what? Taking Skyrim back from those who'd leave her to rot?
traduit: 停下什么？从那些腐化天际的人手里把她夺回来？

original: Ulfric. Stop.
traduit: 乌弗瑞克，停下！

original: Already done.
traduit: 已经好了。

original: Are we ready?
traduit: 我们开始？

original: I think my voice is ready. I hope we've done this well.
traduit: 我觉得我的声音准备好了。希望咱们表现得够出色。

original: I'd understand better if less mystery was involved.
traduit: 如果少点神秘感，我就能理解了。

original: As a Nightingale, I've been sworn to secrecy regarding the Sepulcher.
traduit: 身为夜莺，黄昏坟墓的事必须保密。

original: I know the Guild doesn't do much to foster faith, but I'm going to have to ask that you continue to trust me.
traduit: 我知道公会在信仰培养方面做得不足，但我还是希望你能继续相信我。

original: It's alright Karliah. You don't have to say a word.
traduit: 没关系，卡莱亚。你什么都不用说。

original: I'm sorry Enthir, I can't say. All that matters is we deliver your translation to the Guild immediately.
traduit: 抱歉，恩希尔，我不能说。现在最要紧的是马上把你的翻译交给公会。

original: Farewell, Enthir... words can't express...
traduit: 再会吧，恩希尔……我也不知道该说些什么好……

original: I'm not familiar with the Twilight Sepulcher. What is it? What's Mercer Frey done?
traduit: 我不太了解黄昏坟墓。那是什么？墨瑟·弗雷干了什么？

original: Shadows preserve us. So it's true...
traduit: 阴影保佑。是真的……

original: The last few pages seem to describe "the failure of the Nightingales" although it doesn't go into great detail.
traduit: 最后几页似乎是在讲“夜莺的失败”，不过语焉不详。

original: Gallus also repeatedly mentions his strong belief that Mercer desecrated something known as the Twilight Sepulcher.
traduit: 加卢斯还反复提及自己坚信墨瑟亵渎了一个叫“黄昏坟墓”的地方。

original: Hmm. Yes, here it is.
traduit: 嗯。有了，在这儿。

original: Anything else, Enthir? Anything about... the Nightingales?
traduit: 恩希尔，还有别的吗？有没有关于……夜莺？

original: Yes. Gallus seems certain that Mercer had been removing funds from the Guild's treasury without anyone's knowledge.
traduit: 是。加卢斯好像很确定墨瑟在不引起任何人注意的情况下，从公会的金库里转移资金。

original: Does the journal say where this wealth came from?
traduit: 但日记没有说这些钱是哪来的？

original: It appears that Gallus had suspicions about Mercer Frey's allegiance to the Guild for months.
traduit: 看来加卢斯怀疑墨瑟·弗雷对公会的忠诚有几个月时间了。

original: Gallus had begun to uncover what he calls an "...unduly lavish lifestyle replete with spending vast amounts of gold on personal pleasures."
traduit: 加卢斯开始发现他所谓的“……过度奢侈的生活方式，在个人享乐上花费不菲。”

original: Hmm. This is intriguing, but highly disturbing.
traduit: 嗯。有意思，但也极度令人不安。

original: Do you know anything about the attack?
traduit: 你知道袭击的事吗？

original: No. I was just getting some fresh air. Had one too many pints of mead at the Silver-Blood Inn.
traduit: 不。我刚才在银血旅店蜜酒喝多了，打算出来吹吹风。

original: Where's the Shrine of Talos?
traduit: 塔洛斯祭坛在哪？

original: Huh. Not sure. I don't worship Talos, myself.
traduit: 嗯。不确定。我不信仰塔洛斯。

original: I think I heard someone mention it was underneath the Temple of Dibella, in the big crag in the center of the city.
traduit: 我听说它在迪贝拉神殿的下面，就在城中心的巨石上。

original: I must have missed it. Sorry.
traduit: 肯定是我没看到。抱歉了。

original: You don't have to say sorry to me. I just hope the Eight bring us more peace in the future.
traduit: 不用客气。我只是希望八圣灵能为未来带去更多和平。

original: Sure, I understand. It's not easy to go from being executed by the Legion one day to joining up the next.
traduit: 没问题，我能理解。刚要被军团处决就要加入军团确实不容易接受。

original: But I think you'll see that the Legion is Skyrim's only hope for real peace right now. I know you'll make the right choice in the end.
traduit: 但我想你会看到的，军团是如今天际实现真正和平的唯一希望。你最后一定能作出正确的选择。

original: You make a good case. Maybe I will join up.
traduit: 你说得对。我会加入的。

original: I hope so. The Legion is Skyrim's only hope right now. Come on, we'd better get moving.
traduit: 希望如此吧。军团是目前天际唯一的希望。来，我们得走了。

original: You really think I should join the Imperial Legion?
traduit: 你真觉得我该加入帝国军团吗？

original: Of course! I know, today wasn't the best introduction to the Legion, but I hope you'll give us another chance.
traduit: 当然！我知道，今天军团给你留下的印象不太好，但希望你能给军团一个机会。

original: The Legion could really use someone like you, especially now.
traduit: 军团现在真的很需要你这样的人。

original: General Tullius has his headquarters in Castle Dour, in the city of Solitude, northwest of here.
traduit: 图留斯将军的指挥部设在西北方的独孤城阴郁堡。

original: You'll want to talk to Legate Rikke. She deals with the new recruits.
traduit: 你可以和瑞姬副官谈谈。她负责和新兵打交道。

original: I'll be sure to put in a good word for you if I get back to Solitude first.
traduit: 如果我先回独孤城的话，我一定给你说点好话。

original: How do I join the Imperial Legion?
traduit: 我怎么加入帝国军团？

original: Did the Imperials try to arrest you?
traduit: 帝国人想抓你吗？

original: Oh yes, many times. But mighty Talos was my keeper, my shield against the heresy of the south!
traduit: 哦没错，很多次了。但强大的塔洛斯就是我的守护者，是我对抗南方异端邪说的护盾！

original: If not for Talos, and a few modest bribes paid to the right jailors, why, I would not be standing before you today, resplendent in my faith!
traduit: 如果不是因为塔洛斯，还有向狱卒行贿，我今天就不会站在你的面前。都是因我的信仰光彩夺目啊！

original: I'll come back later.
traduit: 我一会儿再来

original: Stand aside, or else. (Intimidate)
traduit: 一边待着去，否则的话。（恐吓）

original: Or else what? You think you can stand against the entire Whiterun city guard? The gate's closed.
traduit: 否则什么？你觉得能对抗全白漫城的卫兵吗？城门已经关闭了。

original: Will this change your mind? (<bribecost> gold)
traduit: 这样能改改你的主意吗？（<BribeCost>金币）

original: Welcome to Whiterun, friend. Go right on in.
traduit: 欢迎来到白漫城，朋友。请进吧。

original: I have news from Helgen about the dragon attack. (Persuade)
traduit: 我有关于海尔根遭到龙袭的消息。（说服）

original: Fine, but we'll be keeping an eye on you.
traduit: 好吧，但我们会盯着你的。

original: Riverwood calls for the Jarl's aid.
traduit: 河木镇请求领主的援助。

original: Riverwood's in danger, too? You'd better go on in. You'll find the Jarl in Dragonsreach, at the top of the hill.
traduit: 河木镇也有危险了？快进去吧。到山顶的龙临宫见领主。

original: The Jarl will definitely want to talk to you. You'll find him in Dragonsreach, at the top of the hill.
traduit: 领主肯定想和你谈谈。到山顶的龙临宫去见他吧。

original: Halt! City's closed with the dragons about. Official business only.
traduit: 停下！龙族在附近出没，城市已经关闭了。非公莫入。

original: Oh, of course you want me to leave. Just waiting for me to turn my back. So you can have all the glory for yourself!
traduit: 哦，你当然想让我走了。等我一转身，你就可以独享荣耀了。

original: Sulla, let's just get out of here. Hasn't there been enough death?
traduit: 苏拉，我们还是走吧。死的还不够多吗？

original: No! Blackreach was to be my discovery!
traduit: 不！黑境是我发现的！

original: Sulla look, the passage is open, wait... there's someone down there!
traduit: 苏拉，你看，通道打开了，等等……下面有人！

original: Ha! I thought as much.
traduit: 哈！如我所料。

original: No, I'm a Redguard. My family hails from the Imperial Province. Ah, but I left home when I was just a lad. Been wandering ever since.
traduit: 对，我是红卫人。我家是在帝国省。啊，但我很小时后就离开家了。从那以后我一直在流浪。

original: You're not from Skyrim, are you?
traduit: 你不是天际人吧？

original: No, I'm not. Looks like we've got something in common, then.
traduit: 对，我不是。看来我们有共同点了。

original: Hmph. No, friend, that I'm not. But I get along with your kind well enough.
traduit: 嗯。没错，朋友，我不是。但我和你们诺德人相处得不错。

original: Ha! And neither are you, eh? Good to see another Redguard. I like to think we bring a little heat to this frozen wasteland.
traduit: 哈！你也是一样，嗯？很高兴能见到其他红卫人。我觉得我们能给这片冰冷的荒原带来一点热量吧。

original: Enough... enough...
traduit: 够了……够了……

original: I'll gladly kill him.
traduit: 我很乐意杀了他。

original: Dragonborn. Here, use my sword to do it. This moment will be immortalized in song. Make it a good kill.
traduit: 来吧，龙裔。用我的剑。让这一刻在诗歌中永垂不朽。杀的漂亮点。

original: Here, use my sword to do it. I made sure to sharpen it for the occasion.
traduit: 来，用我的剑吧。我为了这一刻把它磨得很锋利了。

original: That honor belongs to you.
traduit: 那这份荣誉归你了。

original: As you wish. This moment, we three, will be immortalized in song.
traduit: 如你所愿。此时此刻，我们三个，都会在诗歌中永垂不朽。

original: Fine by me.
traduit: 无所谓。

original: I won't give him the satisfaction.
traduit: 我不会让他死得这么满意的。

original: I've had my fair share of killing today.
traduit: 我今天杀人已经够多了。

original: Well, I'm not quite done myself.
traduit: 嗯，我还没准备好。

original: Well, Dragonborn. What do you say? Do you want the honor?
traduit: 好了，龙裔。你怎么看？你想拥有这份荣耀吗？

original: Song or not, I just want it done.
traduit: 不管什么诗歌不诗歌。我只想早点完事。

original: Good point.
traduit: 好主意。

original: By the gods! If it's a good ending to some damn story you're after - perhaps the Dragonborn should be the one to do it.
traduit: 神啊！如果你想找个好结局，应该让龙裔去完成这件事。

original: Come, Galmar. Where's your sense of the dramatic moment?
traduit: 加尔玛，你对这个激动人心的时刻作何感想？

original: Just kill him and let's be done with it already.
traduit: 杀了他，就结束了。

original: That Empire is dead. And so are you.
traduit: 那个帝国已经不存在了。你也一样！

original: The Empire I remember never surrendered.
traduit: 我记忆中的那个帝国不会屈膝投降。

original: And if I surrender?
traduit: 如果我投降呢？

original: It makes us right.
traduit: 这么说你还是承认了。

original: You just said it yourself.
traduit: 你刚才已经自己说了。

original: Perhaps you're right. But then what does that make you?
traduit: 也许你说得对。那你们又是什么人？

original: Maybe not, but you certainly aren't the good guys.
traduit: 或许吧，但也不会是什么好人。

original: We aren't the bad guys you know.
traduit: 我们并不是你想象中的坏人。

original: Heh.
traduit: 哈。

original: It's a little more than a rebellion, don't you think?
traduit: 这可不仅是一次叛乱，你觉得呢？

original: The Thalmor. They stirred up trouble here. Forced us to divert needed resources and throw away good soldiers quelling this rebellion.
traduit: 梭默，他们激起这里的麻烦，迫使我们投入资源和优秀的士兵来镇压这场叛乱。

original: What who wanted?
traduit: 谁？

original: You realize this is exactly what they wanted.
traduit: 你知道，这正是他们想要的。

original: This is it for you. Any last words before I send you to Oblivion?
traduit: 这就是你的结局了，在我送你下湮灭之前，还有什么想说的？

original: I'm not doing anything yet.
traduit: 我什么都没做。

original: Is there something else?
traduit: 还有别的事吗？

original: There's something you could do for me. For all of us here.
traduit: 有件事你可以帮我，帮我们这里所有人。

original: The Jarl needs to know if there's a dragon on the loose. Riverwood is defenseless...
traduit: 领主需要知道有一头龙在外肆虐。河木镇缺乏防御手段……

original: We need to get word to Jarl Balgruuf in Whiterun to send whatever soldiers he can. If you'll do that for me, I'll be in your debt.
traduit: 我们得给白漫城的巴尔古夫领主捎个信，请他尽可能派些兵过来。如果你能帮我，那我就欠你个人情了。

original: That dragon flew off this way. You must have seen it.
traduit: 那头龙朝着这个方向飞走了，你一定见过它。

original: You're right, I saw it. Didn't want to believe my own eyes, is all.
traduit: 你说得对，我看到了。真不敢相信自己的眼睛。

original: It was a dragon. Hadvar will tell you the same thing.
traduit: 那是一头龙。哈达瓦会告诉你同样的事。

original: A dragon... here in Skyrim. What's this world coming to? First the war, now dragons... trouble loves company, they say...
traduit: 龙……在天际。世界怎么了？先是打仗，现在有龙……难怪俗话说祸不单行啊……

original: Suit yourself. I hate to turn away any friend of Hadvar, but in times like these... you understand if I can't just take your word for it.
traduit: 随便你吧。我虽然不想扔下哈达瓦的朋友不管……但现在这种时候，我得想办法相信你才行啊。

original: A dragon attacked Helgen and destroyed it. Hadvar and I escaped together.
traduit: 一头龙袭击并摧毁了海尔根。哈达瓦和我一起逃了出来。

original: What? A dragon? In Helgen?
traduit: 什么？龙？在海尔根？

original: That explains what I saw earlier... flying down the valley from the south... I was hoping I was wrong about what I thought it was...
traduit: 这就解释了我之前看到的……有东西从南边飞下山谷了……我还以为是我的错觉……

original: Are you ready to spring the trap on the dragon?
traduit: 你准备好设置陷阱抓那头龙了吗？

original: As I promised, my men stand ready. The great chains are oiled. We wait on your word.
traduit: 我保证过，我的部下随时待命。大锁链也已经润滑过了。就等你的命令了。

original: We'll be ready, don't worry. You do have a plan for actually luring a dragon into this trap, don't you?
traduit: 别担心，我们会准备好。你真有办法把龙引到陷阱来吗？

original: My men will be ready when you are, Dragonborn. You have a truce to arrange first, eh?
traduit: 我的人随时待命，龙裔。你得先去安排休战协议吧？

original: It's the only way to find Alduin before it's too late.
traduit: 这是及时找到奥杜因的唯一方法。

original: Then... Whiterun will stand with you, Dragonborn. We will take the risk, and gain the glory, whether it be in victory or defeat!
traduit: 那么……白漫会与你同在，龙裔。无论成败，我们都会用迎接风险，换回荣耀！

original: So what's the plan, then? How do you intend to lure a dragon into the trap?
traduit: 所以你的计划呢？你打算怎么把龙引到陷阱来？

original: Leave that to me. I'll talk to Arngeir about hosting a peace council.
traduit: 这个交给我。我会请艾恩盖尔主持一次和平会议。

original: Aye, Dragonborn. Maybe you can stop the dragons - and this war into the bargain.
traduit: 啊，龙裔。也许你能够阻止龙族，促成停战谈判。

original: I want to help you, Dragonborn. And I will. But I need your help first.
traduit: 我很想帮你，龙裔。但我也需要你的帮助。

original: I need your help.
traduit: 我需要你的帮助。

original: Now, what's this nonsense about trapping a dragon in my palace?
traduit: 你刚才说要在我宫殿里抓龙是怎么回事？

original: Maybe so, but I plan to go down fighting. What about you?
traduit: 也许吧，但是我打算斗争到底。你呢？

original: Spoken like a true Nord. I'll stand beside you, Dragonborn.
traduit: 像个真诺德人说的话。我支持你，龙裔。

original: No Nord could have said it better! I'll stand beside you, Dragonborn.
traduit: 连诺德人都不一定说的这么好。我支持你，龙裔。

original: I'm Dragonborn. It's my destiny to stop him.
traduit: 我是龙裔。阻止他是我的使命。

original: I don't know about such things, but I heard the Greybeards summon you. That's good enough for me.
traduit: 我不太了解这些，但我听到了灰胡子对你的召唤。这就足够了。

original: It's only hopeless if we give up.
traduit: 如果我们放弃就真没希望了。

original: I didn't say anything about giving up.
traduit: 我没说过要放弃。

original: The threat is worse than you know. Alduin has returned.
traduit: 这次威胁远比你想的更糟。奥杜因已经回来了。

original: Alduin? The World-Eater himself? But... how can we fight him? Doesn't his return mean it's the end times?
traduit: 奥杜因？世界吞噬者本尊？但……我们怎么打败他？他回来不就意味着末日降临了吗？

original: How can we fight Alduin? Doesn't his return mean it's the end times?
traduit: 我们怎么打败奥杜因？他回来不就意味着末日降临了吗？

original: I have important documents for you, sir.
traduit: 我有重要文件给阁下。

original: Is that so? Lost your uniform along the way did you, soldier?
traduit: 是吗？士兵，你在路上把制服弄丢了？

original: Is that so? I don't recognize you. Why aren't you wearing your Stormcloak colors?
traduit: 是吗？我不认识你。为什么不穿风暴斗篷的衣服？

original: All right. Let's take a look...
traduit: 好吧。我看看。

original: Ah, good. Looks like the reinforcements for the fort are on the way. And we have some information about enemy troop movements as well. Excellent.
traduit: 哦，很好。看来支援要塞的部队已经在路上了。还有一些关于敌军动向的情报。太好了。

original: It's not easy running messages, what with Imperials scouts crawling all over the place. Well done.
traduit: 送信可不是容易事。现在到处都是帝国侦察兵。做得好。

original: Why don't you grab yourself a drink at the Windpeak before heading back?
traduit: 回去前到风岳旅店喝一杯吧。

original: Thank you, soldier. Let's take a look at these reports...
traduit: 谢谢你，士兵。我来看看这些报告……

original: I'm waiting on word about reinforcements for the fort... Good, they're on the way. And we have some information on enemy troop movements. Excellent.
traduit: 我一直在等要塞援军的消息……很好，他们在路上了。还有关于敌军动向的情报。太好了。

original: Stormcloak scouts are making it difficult to move around. It's good you made it here in one piece.
traduit: 现在外面这么多风暴斗篷的侦察兵，行动不容易。你能毫发无损地把信送来真是太好了。

original: Why don't you have yourself a drink at the Moorside before you head back?
traduit: 回去前在坞边旅店喝一杯吧。

original: How do I get in?
traduit: 我怎么进去？

original: Two things I have for you. Two shapes. One edged, one round.
traduit: 我给你两样东西。一个方的一个圆的。

original: The round one, for tuning. Dwemer music is soft and subtle, and needed to open their cleverest gates.
traduit: 圆的用来调试。锻莫的音乐柔和微妙，可以打开他们最巧妙的大门。

original: The edged lexicon, for inscribing. To us, a hunk of metal. To the Dwemer, a full library of knowings. But... empty.
traduit: 方典用来刻录。于我们而言，这就是块废铁。对锻莫来说，这不亚于一座知识宝库。不过……是空的。

original: Find Mzark and its sky-dome. The machinations there will read the Scroll and lay the lore upon the cube.
traduit: 找到姆扎克和里面的天穹顶。那里的机关可以读出卷轴内容，并把里面的知识刻录在方典上。

original: Trust Septimus. He knows you can know.
traduit: 相信赛普蒂莫斯。他知道你知道。

original: Now you just stay here, with all your friends, and I'm going to go get my shovel.
traduit: 你就和你的朋友们在这儿待着吧，我去拿铲子了。

original: Let me just take this coin purse off your hands for you. And those nice boots you've got there.
traduit: 就让我把你的钱包拿走吧。还有你那双漂亮的靴子。

original: Well, seems like you have a bit of gold left in your pockets, don't you, my friend?  Mmm, yes...
traduit: 哎呀，看起来你口袋还剩了点金币啊，朋友？嗯，对……

original: DialogueCarriageSystemIdle
traduit: DialogueCarriageSystemIdle

original: Come on now, old girl.
traduit: 来吧，老宝贝儿。

original: Gee up, there!
traduit: 驾驾！

original: Never been to Whiterun before? The Jarl's palace is something to see. Dragonsreach they call it. Big old dragon skull hanging on the wall.
traduit: 没去过白漫城吗？领主的宫殿很值得一看的。都管它叫龙临宫。墙上挂着个龙头骨。

original: First time to Solitude? Beautiful old city. Capital of Skyrim, but I'm sure you already knew that.
traduit: 头一回去独孤城？很漂亮的古城。天际之都，你应该也知道的。

original: Ever been to Markarth? Some say it was built by the dwarves. I don't believe a word of it though.
traduit: 没去过马卡斯？有人说是矮人建的。但我一个字儿都不信。

original: If you've never been to Riften, be sure to visit the Black-Briar meadery. A few mugs of that and you'll forget all about the long trip.
traduit: 如果你没去过裂谷城，一定得去黑棘酒庄看看。喝上几杯，能甩掉一切长途跋涉的辛苦。

original: Ever been to Windhelm? Oldest city in Skyrim, by some accounts. They say the big old palace there was built by Ysgramor himself.
traduit: 去过风舵城吗？天际最古老的城市。据说那座宫殿是伊斯格拉默亲自建造的。

original: Solitude's famous for it's Bards College. Worth a visit if you've never been. Some of them can sing just as pretty as a lark.
traduit: 独孤城一向以吟游诗人学院闻名。没去过的话，值得一看。他们唱歌像云雀一样好听。

original: Solitude's a big port town, you know? Full of sailors and their tales of far away lands. Most of 'em's foreigners and liars, of course.
traduit: 你知道吗？独孤城是个大港。到处都是水手分享他们遥远故乡的故事。当然了。大多数人都是外邦人和骗子。

original: You'll want to watch out for the Forsworn if you do any travelling around the Reach. Bloodthirsty bastards, them.
traduit: 如果想在瑞驰旅行，一定要小心弃誓者。一群嗜血的混蛋。

original: If you don't mind a piece of advice, I'd stay out of trouble in Markarth. They'll toss you in the Cidhna Mine, and you'll never get out.
traduit: 别怪我多嘴，建议还是别在马卡斯惹麻烦。要是被扔进希讷矿场，就一辈子出不来了。

original: When I'm in Whiterun, I always visit the Gildergreen. Never hurts to pay your respects to Lady Kynareth, particularly in my line of work.
traduit: 我在白漫城的时候，经常会去参观镀绿树。向凯娜瑞丝女神致敬是好事，尤其是干我这行。

original: You'll want to watch yourself in Riften. A lot of ways to get yourself in trouble in that town.
traduit: 你应该亲眼去看看裂谷城。在那里想惹麻烦太方便了。

original: I might have to stop and get myself a pint of Black-Briar mead while I'm in Riften. Almost worth the trip all by itself.
traduit: 到了裂谷停下来喝杯黑棘蜜酒，就算不虚此行了。

original: You might run into some of them lizard-folk in Riften. Quite a few of them work the docks there, not sure why. Like swimming in the lake, maybe.
traduit: 在裂谷城你可能会碰上蜥蜴人。都在码头工作，不知道为啥。也许是喜欢离湖近？

original: Windhelm's a bit cold for my tastes. And I ain't talking about the weather. You're not from Windhelm, are you?
traduit: 风舵在我看来有点冷。我说的不是天气。你应该不是风舵人吧？

original: You'll find Windhelm's full of dark elves. The kind from Morrowind, you know. Not that I have anything against them, long as they keep to themselves.
traduit: 你会发现风舵城到处都是暗精灵。就是晨风那种。我不是反对他们，只是他们自己玩就好。

original: You ever met one of them cats? - kah-jeet, I think they call themselves. I hear there's whole countries full of them down south.
traduit: 你见过那些猫人吗？卡———杰特，好像他们是这么称呼自己的。听说南方很多国家都能见到。

original: Gee up, there.
traduit: 驾，驾。

original: Steady, old girl.
traduit: 稳住了，老宝贝儿。

original: Sun feels good, hmm?
traduit: 阳光很好吧？

original: It's almost getting downright hot out now.
traduit: 现在天气也变热了。

original: Couldn't ask for better weather.
traduit: 天气真不错。

original: Nice weather for a ride. Hope it lasts.
traduit: 天气真好。希望能持续一阵子。

original: This'll clear up soon, I'm sure of it.
traduit: 我看天快晴了。

original: Why is it always raining?
traduit: 为什么总是在下雨？

original: This rain will stop eventually. Always does.
traduit: 这雨总会停的。一直这样。

original: Hope you're not getting too wet back there.
traduit: 你在后面别淋得太湿了。

original: Better bundle up. This may keep up for a while.
traduit: 穿暖和点吧。可能得冷一阵子了。

original: A little snow never stopped me, don't worry.
traduit: 这点小雪算不得什么。别担心。

original: I bet you'll be glad to get to Whiterun and get out of this weather.
traduit: 我打赌你会很高兴去白漫的，能避开这种鬼天气。

original: You picked quite a day for a trip to Solitude.
traduit: 今天去独孤城是个好日子。

original: You picked quite a day for a trip to Markarth.
traduit: 今天去马卡斯是个好日子。

original: I swear it rains like this every time I go to Riften.
traduit: 每次去裂谷城都是下这样的雨。

original: Better get used to it. Snows most all the time in Windhelm.
traduit: 你最好习惯一下。风舵城经常下雪。

original: If you were getting them from my farm, they'd be twice as fresh.
traduit: 如果你从我的农场买，肯定会更新鲜。

original: I get them fresh from the farms daily, Nazeem.
traduit: 我每天都从农场上新的，纳奇姆。

original: These fruits and vegetables are disappointing, Carlotta.
traduit: 这些蔬菜水果真是令人失望啊，卡萝塔。

original: And Nilsine Shatter-Shield? Why must she die?
traduit: 尼尔欣·碎盾呢？她为什么必须死？

original: Don't you see? I was like a daughter to Tova. A sister to Nilsine and Friga. But the family refuses to believe my innocence. No matter what I say.
traduit: 你不明白吗？我就像托娃的女儿一样，和尼尔欣、弗丽嘉情同姐妹。但是不管我怎么解释，他们一家都不肯相信我是无辜的。

original: Couldn't they understand that I was used? That I was grieving for Friga, too? No... they treated me like garbage, threw me away.
traduit: 他们就不明白我被利用了吗？没看到我也为弗丽嘉的死伤心吗？没有……他们就像扔垃圾一样把我丢在一边。

original: With Nilsine dead, maybe then Tova will realize what she's lost, hmm? Maybe then she'll see that I was just as much a daughter as the others.
traduit: 或许尼尔欣的死会让托娃意识到她到底失去了什么，嗯？到那时她可能就会明白我和她其他女儿一样了。

original: And if not, may she drown in her own tears.
traduit: 如果没意识到，那就祝愿她被自己的泪水淹死吧。

original: Karliah helped me.
traduit: 卡莱亚帮了我。

original: Karliah... she's still alive?
traduit: 卡莱亚……她还活着？

original: I feared she'd befallen the same fate, ending up a victim of Mercer's betrayal.
traduit: 我担心她也遭受厄运，成为墨瑟背叛的受害者。

original: Here are the texts you requested.
traduit: 这是你要的文本。

original: Yes, very good.
traduit: 好，非常好。

original: Here, then, is the first of the Illusion spells you sought.
traduit: 来，这是你要找的第一个幻术魔法。

original: Here's your heartscale.
traduit: 这是你要的心鳞。

original: Wonderful, just wonderful!
traduit: 太好了，好极了！

original: And it's just as I suspected. The energies need to be channeled back through the nexus a second and third time...
traduit: 和我怀疑的一样，能量需要第二次、第三次通过连接点被引导回来……

original: And that's it. I certainly think you deserve the first copy of the tome. Use it well!
traduit: 就是这样。我觉得你应该第一个拿到这本书。好好使用吧！

original: How do I collect these dragon scales for you?
traduit: 我该怎么帮你收集这些龙鳞？

original: Not just any dragon scales. Heartscales. Very special.
traduit: 不是随便的什么龙鳞。是心鳞。非常特别。

original: You'll need Kahvozein's Fang, of course.
traduit: 当然，你首先需要卡沃奇恩之牙。

original: Then, if you should happen upon the corpse of a dragon, you should be able to use it to slice off a heartscale or two.
traduit: 然后，如果你碰巧看见一具龙尸，可以切几片心鳞下来。

original: Even just one should be enough for me to complete my research.
traduit: 有一个就足够完成我的研究了。

original: Is there anything else you can tell me about the dagger?
traduit: 关于匕首还有什么需要告诉我的吗？

original: Not much, I'm afraid. It was named Kahvozein's Fang after the dragon worshipped by this particular sect of the cult.
traduit: 恐怕不多了。不过卡沃奇恩之牙这个名字，来自拜龙教某分支供奉的巨龙。

original: They were said to be quite fond of ritual sacrifices. So fond, in fact, that the high priest spent a great deal of time sharpening the dagger.
traduit: 据说他们非常喜欢祭祀仪式。正因如此，他们的大祭司花了很长时间来打磨这把匕首。

original: That way it was always ready for the next inevitable victim.
traduit: 这样才能随时准备好迎接下一个注定的受害者。

original: Perhaps not the brightest spot in Skyrim's history, eh?
traduit: 这一幕在天际历史上也算不得多光彩吧？

original: I was just asking. I didn't really want to be involved.
traduit: 我只是问问。没想参与进来。

original: Ah, well now you can help me directly! Far more useful, I think.
traduit: 啊，你现在可以直接帮我了！我觉得更有用。

original: Please do let me know if you change your mind.
traduit: 如果你改变主意的话，务必告诉我一声。

original: I'll return shortly with the dragon scales.
traduit: 我会尽快把龙鳞带回来。

original: That would be wonderful.
traduit: 那太好了。

original: I'll be sure and have everything ready. This is exciting, isn't it?
traduit: 我会把一切准备好。很令人兴奋吧？

original: Uhhh.
traduit: 呃。

original: CommandedHello
traduit: CommandedHello

original: Release...me.
traduit: 放……开我。

original: Until then, I've no ale for you.
traduit: 在那之前，没酒给你。

original: I'll find some coin for you. I always do.
traduit: 我会找到钱给你的。哪次不是。

original: You've had more than enough. Besides, you still haven't paid for the last one.
traduit: 你喝得太多了。再说，你上次的酒钱还没付呢。

original: I need some more ale, Orgnar.
traduit: 再来点麦芽酒，奥格那。

original: You come do an honest day's work at my mill, and I'll pay you an honest day's wages. Then we'll drink.
traduit: 你到我厂里老老实实干一天活，我就老实付你一天工钱。然后我们再喝。

original: It's only right seein' as your the important lumber man.
traduit: 你可是个伐木挣钱的，这不是应该的吗。

original: You'll be wantin' me to pay for them?
traduit: 你想让我付钱？

original: How's about a drink, Hod.
traduit: 喝一杯怎么样，胡德。

original: I'll talk to Alvor about getting us a new one.
traduit: 我会跟阿尔沃定台新的。

original: Gettin' dull. We'll need a new one soon.
traduit: 变钝了。我们很快就该换新的了。

original: And the blade?
traduit: 刀刃怎么样？

original: Ay, it can. Wouldn't want them any bigger though.
traduit: 啊，没问题。但再大点可能不行了。

original: Can the sawmill handle those logs? They look a might big.
traduit: 木材厂能处理这些木头吗？看起来可能会很大。

original: Just never you mind about that.
traduit: 你别管。

original: And speaking of spoiling Dorthe, who made her a new doll last week?
traduit: 说到溺爱朵西，上周谁给她做的新娃娃啊？

original: Ay, it is.  I suppose it won't hurt the girl to eat it this once.
traduit: 啊，是。我想这姑娘吃一次也没事儿。

original: She needs to learn to eat what I serve her. I swear, you spoil that child rotten. Besides, it's one of your favorites.
traduit: 我给她做什么她就得吃什么。我觉得你把孩子宠坏了。而且，这也是你最喜欢的菜。

original: Dorthe won't eat that. Are you trying to starve the child?
traduit: 朵西不吃那个。你打算饿死孩子吗？

original: I've got some fresh cabbage. I'm thinking of making some apple cabbage stew.
traduit: 我这儿有些新鲜的卷心菜。我打算做些苹果炖卷心菜。

original: In you go.
traduit: 走吧你。

original: This isn't over, Jorleif!
traduit: 这事儿没完，乔雷福！

original: I'm sorry, sir. But you'll have to come with me.
traduit: 我很抱歉，先生。但您得跟我走了。

original: Yes, sir!
traduit: 是，长官！

original: Get him out of my sight.
traduit: 把他带走。

original: Make your excuses from the Bloodworks, wizard.
traduit: 巫师，到血厂再去找借口吧。

original: Has the whole city lost their brains?
traduit: 整座城市的人都疯了吗？

original: I've been scrying and auguring to find the murderer myself.
traduit: 我一直在占卜，希望能找到凶手。

original: You're under the arrest, for the Murder of Susanna of Candlehearth Hall. And Friga Shatter-Shield. And all the rest.
traduit: 你被捕了，罪名是谋杀烛炉堂苏珊娜、弗丽嘉·碎盾。还有其他女性。

original: We're wise to your scheming, you coward.
traduit: 我们知道你的诡计了，你这个懦夫。

original: You. You're coming with me.
traduit: 你，跟我来。

original: We're finally going to arrest the Butcher.
traduit: 我们终于要逮住“屠夫”了。

original: Housecarl! No!
traduit: 侍卫！不！

original: The Jarl's down!
traduit: 领主倒了！

original: Why are we doing this again?
traduit: 我们为什么还要再来一次？

original: Dragonborn, do whatever you're going to do!
traduit: 龙裔，想做什么就去做！

original: We may not be trying to kill him, but he sure seems to be trying to kill us!
traduit: 我们也许不想杀他，但他肯定是要杀我们！

original: Damn dragon!
traduit: 该死的龙！

original: Dovahkiin! Here I am!
traduit: 都瓦克因！我来也！

original: Faaz! Nah!
traduit: 法兹！纳！

original: So this is how you defeated Alduin. Ruth... zu'u ni Alduin.
traduit: 你就是这么打败奥杜因的。 鲁斯……祖'乌 尼 奥杜因。

original: Your Thu'um is no match for mine.
traduit: 你的吐'目远不及我。

original: Do not try to hide from me.
traduit: 你躲不掉。

original: Nivahriin joorre!
traduit: 尼瓦瑞因 约尔瑞！

original: My Thu'um is strong!
traduit: 我的吐'目很强大！

original: Ni faas, Dovahkiin!
traduit: 尼 法斯，都瓦克因！

original: I will conquer where Alduin failed.
traduit: 我要征服奥杜因失败之处。

original: I claim the glory of your defeat, Dovahkiin!
traduit: 我会以击败你为荣，都瓦克因！

original: Your Thu'um is strong, Dovahkiin. But not strong enough!
traduit: 你的吐'目很强，都瓦克因。但还远远不够！

original: Thu'um wah Thu'um!
traduit: 吐'目 瓦 吐'目！

original: Hold your fire until he's close!
traduit: 等他接近再开火！

original: Steady now!
traduit: 稳住！

original: We need to bring it down!
traduit: 我们得把它弄下来！

original: Keep under cover until it's down!
traduit: 在它下来前注意隐蔽！

original: We've almost got it!
traduit: 我们快成功了！

original: You heard right. It's the only way to stop the dragons.
traduit: 你没听错。这是阻止龙族的唯一方法。

original: Now - hear his name. Odahviing. Taste it on the wind. Od-ah-viing. Know it in your su'um. Od-ah-viing!
traduit: 现在，听好他的名字。傲达威英。在风中品尝吧。傲-达-威英。把它记在你的苏'目里。傲-达-威英！

original: He is not compelled to come, but the dov are prideful by nature. Few could resist such a challenge. Especially from you, Dovahkiin.
traduit: 他并非被迫前来。但都瓦生性高傲。很少能拒绝挑战。尤其是来自你的挑战，都瓦克因。

original: But Odahviing, he is... headstrong? Boziik. Rash. Even among the dov, he was known for this.
traduit: 但傲达威英很……任性？波兹克。鲁莽。即使在都瓦中也很有名。

original: He will not resist the challenge of your Voice, Dovahkiin. He will come.
traduit: 他不会拒绝你吼声的挑战，都瓦克因。他会来的。

original: So we know his name. How does that help me get him to Dragonsreach?
traduit: 我们知道了他的名字。这对我引他到龙临宫有什么帮助？

original: Ah, I forget how little you know of the dov. Our names are always made up of three Rotmulaag - Words of Power.
traduit: 哦，我都忘了你对都瓦了解不多。我们的名字总是由三个罗姆拉格……力量之语组成的。

original: You see - Paar-thur-nax - a Thu'um - a Shout, yes?
traduit: 你看，帕-图-纳克斯，这是个吐'目，龙吼吧？

original: Odahviing will come to your challenge. Boziik. Krilot. He will not be able to resist your call, from the Hill of the Dovah itself... he will come.
traduit: 傲达威英会接受你的挑战。波兹克。科瑞洛特。他不会拒绝来自你在都瓦山丘的召唤……他会来的。

original: Hmm, yes. I have been pondering on exactly that question. Lingrah morah.
traduit: 嗯，没错。我一直在认真思考那个问题。灵拉 摩拉。

original: I have tasted the voices of Alduin's allies on the wind. Pogaan nahlaas, vokrii wah jun.
traduit: 我从风中感受到了奥杜因盟友的吼声。迫甘 纳拉斯，沃克瑞 瓦 琼。

original: There is one who I remember well. Odahviing. He is the one to tell us where Alduin has gone.
traduit: 有一个我印象很深，傲达威英。他能告诉我们奥杜因的去向。

original: I don't know yet. But I know some people who can probably help.
traduit: 我还不知道。不过我知道几个人或许能帮上忙。

original: Oh... well, I'll leave that to you. I trust you know your business.
traduit: 哦……好吧。那就交给你了。我相信你很熟悉自己的工作。

original: Probably for the best. It will give me time to see if that old trap still works - and break the news to the men.
traduit: 那最好了。这样我就有时间去看看那个老陷阱还能不能用，在把消息告诉部下。

original: You know who I am, fool. So why you askin'?
traduit: 你不是知道我是谁了吗，傻瓜。你怎么又问了？

original: Tell me about yourself.
traduit: 跟我说说你自己吧。

original: You blind, boy? I'm a blacksmith. Any half-wit could see that.
traduit: 你瞎吗，小子？我是个铁匠。傻子都能看出来。

original: You blind, girl? I'm a blacksmith. Any half-wit could see that.
traduit: 你瞎吗，姑娘？我是个铁匠。傻子都能看出来。

original: Good. Then there isn't much more to say.
traduit: 好。那就没什么好说的了。

original: Here's your armor, just make sure you put it to good use.
traduit: 这是你的护甲，好好利用吧。

original: Is there anything you don't charge for?
traduit: 有什么是不收费的吗？

original: Sure, how about I get Dirge to knock you over your head and dump you into the cistern?
traduit: 有啊，要不让挽歌揍你一顿，再丢进水池？

original: Look, I've been in this business a long time and I've seen all types. You can play it tough, you can play it smart... whatever.
traduit: 听着，我做这行很久了，见的人多了。强硬也好，聪明也罢……都不算什么。

original: At the end of the day you'll find all we care about down here is how much gold you can make us.
traduit: 到最后，你会发现，在这里我们只关心你能给我们赚多少金币。

original: I'm the fence down here. You come by anything you don't exactly own and I'll pay you some coin for it. Minus a little slice for the Guild, of course.
traduit: 我是这里的销赃人。如果你拿到了任何不属于你的东西，我都可以收购。当然，要分润一些给公会。

original: I can also provide a few supplies useful to our trade now and again, for a small fee.
traduit: 我还会时不时提供一些对生意有用的物品，但需要一点费用。

original: Brynjolf sent me.
traduit: 布林乔夫派我来的。

original: So, you're the new recruit, eh?
traduit: 你就是那个新人吧？

original: Well, looks like you and I are going to have to get very well acquainted.
traduit: 看来你我得好好熟悉一下了。

original: Does the Guild provide other services?
traduit: 公会还提供其他服务吗？

original: Well, you could always speak to Delvin or Vex if you're looking for extra work.
traduit: 如果想找额外工作，可以去找戴尔文或小烦。

original: Or if you're looking for training, we've got plenty of it down here. Delvin, Vex, Niruin and Vipir can give you a leg up on that.
traduit: 我们这里训练服务也很多。戴尔文、小烦、尼鲁因和维皮尔都能帮你。

original: If you're lookin' to get some coin for the fruits of your labor, you should talk to Tonilia. She sounds tough, but she'll cut you a fair deal.
traduit: 如果想把劳动成果变现，就去找托尼利亚吧。她说话很强硬，但保证公道实惠。

original: I also suggest you spend some time in the trainin' room. Just talk to Vipir. He'll show you around.
traduit: 建议你去训练室多转转。跟维皮尔谈谈，他会带你去看看的。

original: If you're ever in need of some quick coin for items you find on the job, Tonilia is the best fence around.
traduit: 如果你需要快速变现，你会发现托尼利亚是最好的销赃人。

original: And besides myself, Delvin, Niruin and Vipir can help you with any sort of training you might need to sharpen your skills.
traduit: 除我之外，戴尔文，尼鲁因和维皮尔也可以训练你的技能。

original: I'll point you to the first and last person you're ever going to need to talk to. Tonilia. She's the Guild's fence.
traduit: 你最应该去找托尼利亚聊聊，她是咱们公会的销赃人。

original: Treat her right and she'll make you rich. Try and rip her off and you'll have the whole Guild to answer to.
traduit: 对她好点，她会帮你发财的。胆敢偷她的东西，你就得对整个公会负责了。

original: If talking your way out of trouble isn't enough, you could always pick up some training from Delvin, Vex or Vipir.
traduit: 如果感觉技术不好的话，可以去找戴尔文、小烦或维皮尔接受训练。

original: Also, I recommend hitting the training room if you need lockpick practice. Helped me out of a jam more than once.
traduit: 此外，如果需要开锁练习，建议你去训练室。那里帮我突破困境已经不是一次两次了。

original: Hey, what the...?
traduit: 嘿，怎么……？

original: Gods, what a mess.
traduit: 神啊，真是一团糟。

original: Do you know what I did with it?
traduit: 你知道我做了什么吗？

original: You went right out to give it to your fiancee! Don't you even remember where you left her?
traduit: 你把它给了你的未婚妻！你连把她留在哪里都不记得了吗？

original: And after you told me that sweet story of how you met in Witchmist Grove! I can see why she left you.
traduit: 你明明跟我说过你们在女巫迷雾树林相遇的甜蜜故事！我算是明白她为什么离开你了。

original: You went right out to give it to your fiancee! Don't you even remember where you left him?
traduit: 你把它直接给了你的未婚夫！你都不记得把他留在哪儿了吗？

original: And after you told me that sweet story of how you met in Witchmist Grove! I can see why he left you.
traduit: 你明明跟我说过你们在女巫迷雾树林相遇的甜蜜故事！我算是明白他为什么离开你了。

original: It's all right, Irileth. I want to hear what he has to say.
traduit: 伊瑞莱斯，无妨。我想听听他要说什么。

original: It's all right, Irileth. I want to hear what she has to say.
traduit: 伊瑞莱斯，无妨。我想听听她要说什么。

original: I'm starting to think...
traduit: 我在想……

original: I was told to give the message directly to the Jarl.
traduit: 有人叫我把消息直接告诉领主。

original: Whatever you have to say to the Jarl, you can say to me.
traduit: 不管你要和领主说什么，跟我说就行了。

original: A dragon has destroyed Helgen.
traduit: 一头龙摧毁了海尔根。

original: You know about Helgen? The Jarl will want to speak to you personally. Approach.
traduit: 你有海尔根的情报？领主应该会亲自跟你谈。过来吧。

original: <Alias=RiverwoodFriend> sent me. Riverwood is in danger.
traduit: <Alias=RiverwoodFriend>让我来这。河木镇现在有危险。

original: As housecarl, my job is to deal with all dangers that threaten the Jarl or his people. So you have my attention. Now, explain yourself.
traduit: 身为侍卫，我的工作就是处理所有威胁领主和领民的危险。所以我得盯紧你。现在，请解释清楚。

original: I have news from Helgen. About the dragon attack.
traduit: 我有关于海尔根遭到龙袭的消息。

original: Well, that explains why the guards let you in. Come on then, the Jarl will want to speak to you personally.
traduit: 好吧，我知道卫兵为什么把你放进来了。来吧，领主会亲自跟你谈的。

original: I need to speak to the Jarl...
traduit: 我想和领主谈谈……

original: What's the meaning of this interruption? Jarl Balgruuf is not receiving visitors.
traduit: 因何打断会议？巴尔古夫领主现在不会客。

original: I just...
traduit: 我只是……

original: Who's this, then?
traduit: 这是谁？

original: My lord. Please. You have to listen.
traduit: 求你了，大人。您得再听听别人的意见。

original: I only counsel caution. We cannot afford to act rashly in times like these.
traduit: 我只是建议您多加小心。这种时候我们不宜轻举妄动。

original: If the news from Helgen is true... well, there's no telling what it means.
traduit: 如果海尔根的消息是真的……没人知道这意味着什么。

original: My lord. Please. This is no time for rash action. I just think we need more information before we act.
traduit: 大人。现在不宜鲁莽行事。我是说咱们必须在行动前掌握更多情报。

original: What would you have me do, then? Nothing?
traduit: 那你要我怎么办？就这么干等着？

original: Who's Elisif?
traduit: 艾利西弗是谁？

original: Ah, I forget you're new to Skyrim. Jarl Elisif, I should say, although only because she was married to Jarl Torryg when he was murdered.
traduit: 啊，我忘了你是刚来天际了。我应该称艾利西弗领主才对。虽然她是在她丈夫，托依格领主被杀后才接任的。

original: Ulfric murdered Torygg, you know. Walked right into his palace in Solitude and killed him. Shouted him to death, if you believe the stories.
traduit: 乌弗瑞克谋杀了托依格。独自走进宫殿然后杀了他。还有谣传说托依格是被吼杀的。

original: That's what started this whole war. The Empire couldn't ignore that. Once the jarls start killing each other, we're back to the bad old days.
traduit: 这就是战争的起因。帝国不能无视这一点。一旦领主们开始自相残杀，我们就回到了过去糟糕的年代了。

original: You support the Empire, then?
traduit: 这么说你是支持帝国了？

original: Of course. Skyrim has always been part of the Empire.
traduit: 当然了。天际一直是帝国的一部分。

original: That doesn't mean I support everything the Empire's been doing lately, but Nords have never been fair-weather friends.
traduit: 这不是说我对帝国最近的所作所为全都支持。不过诺德人从来不做墙头草。

original: Which side in the war does he favor?
traduit: 他在战争里支持哪边？

original: I don't think he likes either Ulfric or Elisif much. Who can blame him?
traduit: 我想他应该对乌弗瑞克和艾利西弗都不喜欢。但谁又能责怪他呢？

original: But I've no doubt he'll prove loyal to the Empire in the end. He's no traitor.
traduit: 但我相信他最后一定会选择忠于帝国。他不是叛徒。

original: What can you tell me about the Jarl?
traduit: 你能跟我说说领主吗？

original: Jarl Balgruuf? He rules Whiterun Hold. A good man, perhaps a bit over-cautious, but these are dangerous times.
traduit: 巴尔古夫领主吗？他统治着白漫领。他是个好人，就是有些太过谨慎了。但现在是危机时期，谨慎些也没错。

original: So far he's managed to stay out of the war. I'm afraid it can't last, though.
traduit: 到目前他都在避免卷入战争。但我看坚持不了多久。

original: You'll see! It was a dragon! It'll kill us all and then you'll believe me!
traduit: 你会看见的！那就是龙！会杀了我们所有人，到时候你就信了！

original: Don't worry. I'll return the Key.
traduit: 别担心。我会把钥匙还回去的。

original: Take this with you. I'm not certain if it will help within the walls of the Sepulcher, but I certainly don't need it as much as you.
traduit: 把这个带上吧。我不确定在坟墓里用不用得上，但你现在比我更需要这个。

original: I've had this bow almost my entire life, and it's never let me down. I hope it brings you the same luck.
traduit: 我这辈子都带着这把弓，它从没让我失望。希望它也能为你带来同样的好运。

original: I don't have any of my old armor.
traduit: 我没带旧的护甲。

original: Tough luck for you then. Come back when you have at least one of the pieces.
traduit: 那你真不走运啊。至少拿着其中一件再回来。

original: Actually, let me chose something else.
traduit: 想了想，还是选别的吧。

original: I'll trade in my boots.
traduit: 我想把靴子换了。

original: I'll trade in my gloves.
traduit: 我想把手套换了。

original: I'll trade in my cuirass.
traduit: 我想把护甲换了。

original: Are you sure? Once I exchange it for you, I'm not taking it back... unless you want to sell it at a discount of course.
traduit: 你确定？一旦交换，概不退回……当然，除非你想折价出手。

original: Make up your mind already.
traduit: 你已经做好决定了吗。

original: Okay, there you go.
traduit: 好，来吧。

original: I'll trade in my hood.
traduit: 我想把兜帽换了。

original: Anything different about it?
traduit: 有什么不同吗？

original: Of course... otherwise it wouldn't be much of a reward, now would it?
traduit: 当然……否则就不是什么奖励了，不是吗？

original: Your new piece will enhance your skill beyond that of the original. Trust me.
traduit: 你护甲的新部件将比原先的更有效地提高技能。相信我。

original: Well, looks like you're fitting in well down here.
traduit: 嗯，看起来你挺适应这里的嘛。

original: I'm supposed to allow you to trade in one of your pieces of Guild armor, so what will it be?
traduit: 你可以来交换一件公会护甲，想换哪一件？

original: Is the war really over?
traduit: 战争真的结束不了吗？

original: I wish I could say that it was, but it's not that simple.
traduit: 我也希望能说快结束了，但事情不那么简单。

original: Many Stormcloaks will fight until they die, because they still believe they're fighting for Skyrim's freedom.
traduit: 许多风暴斗篷会一直斗争到死，因为他们仍然相信自己在为天际的自由而战。

original: But without Ulfric, the movement will wither and die. It's only a matter of time.
traduit: 但没有了乌弗瑞克，这场运动枯萎消亡只是时间问题了。

original: Why did Brunwulf choose you to be Steward?
traduit: 为什么布伦武夫选你作为总管？

original: Well, a few reasons come to mind.
traduit: 我想有几个原因。

original: In my days as a riverboat captain, I was known to run a tight ship.
traduit: 我以前在内河当船长时，大家都知道我管理很严格。

original: That, and I made my fortune by knowing when to spend my septims, and when not to. I can't stand waste.
traduit: 其次，我知道塞普汀什么时候该花，什么时候不该花。我是受不了铺张浪费的。

original: Tell me about the city's history.
traduit: 给我说说这座城市的历史吧。

original: Windhelm is one of the oldest human cities in all of Tamriel. In fact, it was the capital of the First Empire, which was founded by Ysgramor
traduit: 风舵城是泰姆瑞尔最古老的人类城市之一，也是伊斯格拉默建立的第一帝国的首都。

original: The Palace of the Kings in which you now stand is one of the last buildings that remain from that era.
traduit: 你现在所在的众王之殿就是那个纪元遗留下的一座建筑。

original: Long ago, the Empire used the city to garrison troops who guarded the passes to Morrowind.
traduit: 很久之前，帝国在此驻扎军队，守卫着通往晨风的关隘。

original: And now, thanks to you, the city is back under the Empire's banner.
traduit: 而现在，多亏了你，这座城市又重归帝国旗下了。

original: Go on in.
traduit: 进去吧。

original: Oh, you again.
traduit: 哦，又是你。

original: Don't cause any trouble in the city.
traduit: 别再城里惹麻烦。

original: You're clear to enter.
traduit: 你可以进去了。

original: The Legion's always looking for strong, capable warriors. If you think you've got what it takes, our headquarters is in Solitude.
traduit: 军团一直在寻找强壮得力的战士。如果你觉得你能胜任，就到我们独孤城的总部去吧。

original: Speak with Legate Rikke. She will determine if you are Legion material.
traduit: 找瑞姬副官谈谈。她会判断你是否适合加入军团。

original: If you are, then you make your way to Windhelm and talk to the man himself. If you're not, well friend, you'd best walk away before this gets ugly.
traduit: 如果你是，那就去风舵城找他本人谈谈。如果不是，朋友，你最好赶紧走开，否则我就不客气了。

original: If you are, then you talk to the man himself. If you're not, well friend, you'd best walk away before this gets ugly.
traduit: 如果你是，那就去找他本人谈谈。如果不是，朋友，你最好赶紧走开，否则我就不客气了。

original: Tell me about your group.
traduit: 跟我说说你们。

original: Not sure I understand the question. The Legion's always been in Skyrim.
traduit: 我不太明白你的问题。军团一直在天际。

original: We have garrisons throughout all the provinces of the Empire. Our mission is to serve the Emperor, uphold the law, and protect the citizenry.
traduit: 我们在帝国的各省都有驻军。我们的使命就是效忠皇帝、维护法律、保护公民。

original: Skyrim's days are darkening, and the Legion will soon be called into service like never before. But we stand ready, as always, to meet that call.
traduit: 天际的形势越发黯淡，军团将会被前所未有的迅速召集。我们一如既往做好了迎接征召的准备。

original: What's the Imperial Legion doing in Skyrim?
traduit: 帝国军团在天际做什么？

original: At first they called us that to belittle our cause. But we gladly accept being named for Ulfric Stormcloak, the only true High King of Skyrim.
traduit: 首先，他们这样叫我们是为了贬低我们的事业。但我们很乐意接受以天际唯一的真正至高王乌弗瑞克·风暴斗篷之名来命名自己。

original: We are the true sons and daughters of Skyrim, and Ulfric... he's the truest of us all.
traduit: 我们都是天际真正的儿女，而乌弗瑞克……他是我们中最纯正的。

original: We fight to make our land great once more, to raise up strong, noble thanes, and lay low false Jarls and the cowards who hide behind them.
traduit: 我们为了复兴自己的土地而战，要拥立强大、高贵的武卫们，打倒虚伪的领主和躲在他们背后的懦夫。

original: The sound of our fury is a storm about to break on the heads of our enemies. Our friendship, a cloak of true brotherhood for all who would wear it.
traduit: 我们的狂怒之音就是冲溃敌人头脑的风暴。我们的友谊是友人身上真情实意的斗篷。

original: Why are you called Stormcloaks?
traduit: 你们为什么叫做风暴斗篷？

original: How do you feel about this war?
traduit: 你如何看待这场战争？

original: You mean Ulfric's so-called "Stormcloak rebellion"?
traduit: 你是说乌弗瑞克所谓的“风暴斗篷叛乱”？

original: The Nord kings - oh, excuse me, "Jarls" - they can't seem to control their own people. So the Legion has stepped in to keep order.
traduit: 诺德的国王们，哦，抱歉，“领主”，他们似乎无法控制自己的人民。所以军团要介入进来维持秩序。

original: Sadly, the Empire's stretched a little thin these days, and we've gotten very few reinforcements. So we've been forced to recruit locally.
traduit: 遗憾的是，最近帝国人手有些不足，增援部队也很少。所以我们得在当地招募新兵。

original: But rest assured, citizen. We'll put an end to this uprising... and things will get back to normal soon enough.
traduit: 但请放心，公民。我们会平定这场叛乱……一切很快就会恢复正常的。

original: Skyrim is the birthplace of humanity. The birthplace of honor. And those snowbacked Imperials renounced both when they laid down before the Thalmor.
traduit: 天际是人类与荣誉的发源地。但那些软骨头的帝国人跪伏在梭默脚下的时候放弃了这两个东西。

original: Worse still, to pay for the privilege to keep his throne, the Emperor sells Skyrim and our very gods - Talos, no less! - to the damn elves.
traduit: 更糟糕的是，皇帝为了保住皇位，把天际和我们的神灵塔洛斯卖给了该死的精灵！

original: And what did Torygg do? He and the Jarls that supported him? They took the Emperor's gold. Sold out their people for a slave master's "peace treaty."
traduit: 而托依格做了什么？支持他的领主做了什么？他们接受了皇帝的金子。把人民出卖给了一个奴隶主的“和平条约”。

original: Ulfric did right killing him. Soon we'll rid Skyrim of elves, their bloody Justiciars, and the Jarls in their pockets. The whole damn lot of them.
traduit: 乌弗瑞克杀他杀得好。很快我们就要除掉天际的精灵、他们那群嗜血的审判者，还有支持他们的领主。除掉他们所有人。

original: And we'll cleave through the Legion to get to them.
traduit: 我们要撕裂军团的阵线抓到他们。

original: How do I join?
traduit: 我怎么加入？

original: Think you've got the mettle, eh?
traduit: 有勇气是吧？

original: Honestly, the Legion can use all the able bodies it can muster. We have our hands full. A dead king, a rebellion, and now dragons? Skyrim's a mess.
traduit: 老实说，军团现在需要能干的人。我们忙得不可开交了。国王被杀，叛乱爆发，现在还有龙？天际真是一团糟了。

original: If you're serious, make your way to Solitude. Our headquarters is Castle Dour. You find General Tulius there, commanding our forces in Skyrim.
traduit: 如果你是认真的，就到独孤城去吧。我们的总部在阴郁堡。你在那里能见到总揽天际军事的图留斯将军。

original: But talk to Legate Rikke. She handles the local recruiting.
traduit: 但先去找瑞姬副官谈谈。她负责招募新兵的工作。

original: How does one join the Imperial Legion?
traduit: 如何加入帝国军团？

original: If you're serious, you're in the right place. Our headquarters is Castle Dour. Here you'll find General Tullius, commanding our forces in Skyrim.
traduit: 如果你是认真的，那你来对地方了。我们的总部在阴郁堡。你在那里能见到总揽天际军事的图留斯将军。

original: Ulfric's not running a social club. You don't join anything. Either you're a true son of Skyrim, or you're not.
traduit: 乌弗瑞克可不是开社交俱乐部的。除非你是真正的天际之子，否则就没法加入。

original: How does one join the Stormcloaks?
traduit: 怎么加入风暴斗篷？

original: Ulfric's not running a social club. You don't join anything. Either you're a true daughter of Skyrim, or you're not.
traduit: 乌弗瑞克可不是开社交俱乐部的。除非你是真正的天际之女，否则就没法加入。

original: I'm not sure. Tell me about him.
traduit: 我不太确定。跟我说说他吧。

original: Well, as I said, Arkay is the god of life and death. You'll find his temples and Halls of the Dead all across Tamriel.
traduit: 嗯，我说过，阿尔凯是生死之神。你会发现他的神殿和亡者之厅遍布泰姆瑞尔。

original: Priests of Arkay such as myself perform rites for the dead and sometimes console the bereaved.
traduit: 像我这样的阿尔凯祭司会为死者举行仪式，有时也会去安慰逝者家属。

original: We also keep a constant vigil against those who practice the vile arts of necromancy.
traduit: 我们也会时刻警惕那些使用死灵邪术的人。

original: I asked the question because I was hoping you might be able to help me recover something I've lost.
traduit: 回答这些是希望你能帮我找回我失去的东西。

original: So be it. I'm sure Arkay will find it in his heart to forgive you... eventually.
traduit: 那就这样吧。阿尔凯会发自内心的原谅你的。

original: You're on your own, priest.
traduit: 自求多福吧，祭司。

original: I'll just wait here and make sure nothing foul escapes the catacombs.
traduit: 我就在这里等着，确保没有什么肮脏的东西从地下墓穴跑出来。

original: I'll find your amulet.
traduit: 我去找你的护身符。

original: I'll talk to this girl.
traduit: 我去和那女孩谈谈。

original: Oh, good. She'll listen to you, I just know it.
traduit: 哦，太好了。我知道她会听你的。

original: Grow a backbone, kid.
traduit: 拿出点骨气来，孩子。

original: Oh, okay. I didn't think you'd help me. Nobody ever does.
traduit: 哦，好。我没想过你会帮我。从来没人帮我。

original: Did you need anything else?
traduit: 还需要些别的吗？

original: Hand the key over. Now. (Intimidate)
traduit: 把钥匙交出来。赶紧的。（恐吓）

original: All right. I don't want any trouble. It's yours.
traduit: 好吧。我不想惹麻烦。给你了。

original: Are you serious? I hear more threatening words from my wife.
traduit: 你认真的？我妻子吓唬人比你强多了。

original: Are you serious? I say more threatening words to my husband.
traduit: 你认真的？我丈夫吓唬人比你强多了。

original: Maybe I could rent the room? (<BribeCost> gold)
traduit: 也许我可以租下这间房？（<BribeCost>金币）

original: Well, I guess Margret isn't around to complain. It's yours.
traduit: 好吧，玛格丽特也没机会抱怨了。归你了。

original: Sorry. Margret might be dead, but the room's rented.
traduit: 抱歉。玛格丽特是死了，但房已租出不能更换。

original: I won't tell anyone. Promise. (Persuade)
traduit: 我不会告诉别人的。我保证。（说服）

original: Well, you seem like the honest sort. Here you are.
traduit: 好吧，你看着还算老实。给你吧。

original: Right. You adventuring types would never go into a room just to steal everything.
traduit: 得了吧。你们这种爱冒险的进了房间没个不偷东西的。

original: Do you have the key to Margret's room?
traduit: 你有玛格丽特房间的钥匙吗？

original: Of course. But I can't just hand that over. Privacy, after all.
traduit: 当然了。但我不能就这么交出来。毕竟涉及她的隐私。

original: Did a woman named Margret stay here?
traduit: 有个叫玛格丽特的女人住这吗？

original: Ah, yes. Rented the nicest room we had for a whole month.
traduit: 啊，没错。把我们最好的房间租下了一个月。

original: I think she's sitting by the fire. Poor girl.
traduit: 她应该正在火炉边坐着呢。可怜的女孩。

original: Does a woman named Margret stay here?
traduit: 有个叫玛格丽特的女人住在这吗？

original: Best we all forget about her. Bad luck to talk about the dead in Markarth.
traduit: 我们最好还是忘了她吧。在马卡斯谈论死者不吉利。

original: Oh yeah. Pretty little thing. Been sitting by the fire all day.
traduit: 哦，没错。挺漂亮的姑娘。在火炉边坐一整天了。

original: Oh yeah. Pretty little thing. Had a room here I think. Ask the innkeeper.
traduit: 哦对。挺漂亮的小姑娘。她好像租了一间房。去问问老板吧。

original: Aye. She's by the fire.
traduit: 对。她就在火炉那边。

original: I remember her. Her stance. The way she walked. A trained warrior, no doubt.
traduit: 我记得她。她行动坐卧的方式，一看就是个训练有素的战士。

original: She had a room here. Might talk to the innkeeper about it.
traduit: 她在这里租了间房。你应该去找老板谈谈。

original: I have some questions about Margret.
traduit: 我有些关于玛格丽特的问题。

original: Who? You mean that woman who was attacked in the market?
traduit: 谁？你是说在市场被袭击的那个女的？
