original: If we can't get back into the mine, our town is sunk.
traduit: 如果我们回不了矿井，那我们的镇子就完了。

original: One day we were cracking rocks in the deepest parts of the mine and the next day they were all over the place.
traduit: 有一天，我们在矿井的最深处凿石头，第二天它们就到处都是。

original: I'd give my eye teeth if it meant getting those damn spiders out of the mine!
traduit: 如果能把那些该死的蜘蛛从矿里弄出去，我会不惜一切代价！

original: Finally, we can reopen the mine and put Shor's Stone back on the map!
traduit: 我们终于可以开矿，然后振兴舒尔之石了！

original: Here, please accept this gift as a token of our gratitude.
traduit: 给，请接收这份谢礼，以示我们的感激。

original: I've cleared the mine of spiders.
traduit: 我已经清除了矿场的蜘蛛。

original: Gone? Every one of them? Why, that's incredible.
traduit: 没了？每一个？为什么，不敢相信。

original: Get back!
traduit: 回来！

original: Go! We'll follow when we can!
traduit: 走吧！一会儿我们会跟上的！

original: What's wrong with the mine?
traduit: 矿场怎么了？

original: It's full of spiders, that's what's wrong with it! Almost killed Grogmar and me when they showed up.
traduit: 里面全是蜘蛛，这就是问题！它们出现的时候差点杀了我和戈洛格玛。

original: I'm worried that they'll come out of the mine looking for food soon... then we're in even bigger trouble.
traduit: 我担心它们很快就会从矿场出来觅食……那我们的麻烦就更大了。

original: Entrance hall. (<Global=HDMarkarthHall> gold)
traduit: 门厅。（<Global=HDMarkarthHall>金币）

original: Enchanting laboratory. (<Global=HDMarkarthEnchanting> gold)
traduit: 附魔实验室。 （<Global=HDMarkarthEnchanting>金币）

original: Living room furnishings. (<Global=HDMarkarthLiving> gold)
traduit: 客厅家具 （<Global=HDMarkarthLiving>金币）

original: Bedroom furnishings. (<Global=HDMarkarthBedroom> gold)
traduit: 卧室家具。（<Global=HDMarkarthBedroom>金币）

original: Tell me about the mine.
traduit: 跟我说说这个矿场吧。

original: Redbelly Mine gets its name from the red mist filling the place.
traduit: 红腹矿场得名于弥漫在里面的红雾。

original: You get used to it after a while... kind of smells like the hot springs out in the tundra.
traduit: 过一段时间就会习惯……闻起来像是冻土带上的温泉。

original: No idea what's causing it though.
traduit: 但不知道是怎么来的。

original: Mining iron takes a lot of strength and special reinforced tools.
traduit: 开采铁矿需要很多坚硬且特殊的强化工具。

original: I must have broken five or six pickaxes in the last few months alone.
traduit: 过去才几个月，我就弄坏了五六把鹤嘴锄。

original: But now that I've got Rocksplinter here, I can cut through stone like a hot knife through butter.
traduit: 但现在有了碎岩者，我可以像热刀切黄油一样敲碎石头了。

original: I might be a woman, but I can crack rock with the best of them.
traduit: 虽然我是个女人，但我也能和他们一样挖掘岩石。

original: Be careful in there, you can take a nasty spill.
traduit: 在里面要小心，可能会摔得很惨。

original: Damn place is filled with this reddish mist. Can't see more than ten feet in front of your face.
traduit: 这该死的地方到处都是红色的雾。你的能见范围过不去十尺。

original: But when you can sniff out a vein of iron like me, it isn't too much trouble.
traduit: 但等你像我一样能嗅出铁矿的味道时，也不算太麻烦。

original: I don't want to be responsible for sending you to your death. Be careful in the mine.
traduit: 我不想把你送到矿里送死。在矿场里要小心。

original: Don't kid yourself... stone runs in our blood.
traduit: 不要欺骗自己……石头流淌在我们的血里。

original: May the road favor the foolish...
traduit: 希望傻人有傻福啊……

original: Darkwater Crossing is a difficult journey. Mind yourself.
traduit: 到暗水岔口很不好走。照顾好自己。

original: Keep yourself safe, traveler.
traduit: 注意安全，旅行者。

original: Fortune to you and your children.
traduit: 祝你和你的孩子好运。

original: I think her mother, Tova, has the key.
traduit: 我觉得她母亲托娃应该有钥匙。

original: Her mother would have had the key, but she... that family is cursed, I tell you.
traduit: 她母亲应该有钥匙，但是她……我跟你说啊，那家人被诅咒了。

original: I have Kodlak's fragment.
traduit: 我拿到了克拉科的那块碎片。

original: Thank you. Your Shield-Siblings have withdrawn to the Underforge. I think they're waiting for you.
traduit: 谢了。你的盾牌兄弟们已经退到地下锻炉。我想他们正在等你。

original: I guess I'll have to.
traduit: 我看还是我来吧。

original: I appreciate it.
traduit: 谢谢。

original: It would be my pleasure.
traduit: 这是我的荣幸。

original: Thank you. I'll be here.
traduit: 谢谢。我就在这里等着。

original: You're back.
traduit: 你回来了。

original: This isn't a good time.
traduit: 现在不合适。

original: The old man had one wish before he died. And he didn't get it. It's as simple as that.
traduit: 老爷子临死前就这么个愿望。但他没实现。就这么简单。

original: That's fine for you. But he wanted to be clean.
traduit: 对你来说是不错。但他就是想净化掉。

original: He wanted to meet Ysgramor and know the glories of Sovngarde. But all that was taken from him.
traduit: 他想去见伊斯格拉默，去感受松加德的辉煌。但这一切都被夺走了。

original: No, Farkas, he didn't. And that's not what this is about.
traduit: 对，法卡斯，他不在乎。而且也不是这个问题。

original: We should be honoring Kodlak, no matter our own thoughts on the blood.
traduit: 无论我们对自己的血是什么看法，我们都该尊重克拉科。

original: Kodlak used to speak of a way to cleanse his soul, even in death.
traduit: 克拉科曾经说过一种净化灵魂的方法，死后也可以使用。

original: You know the legends of the Tomb of Ysgramor.
traduit: 你们知道伊斯格拉默之墓的传说吧。

original: Is that? Did you repair the blade?
traduit: 什么？你把武器修好了？

original: Being moon-born is not so much of a curse as you might think, Vilkas.
traduit: 成为月裔并不像你想象的那样是什么诅咒。威尔卡斯。

original: And you avenged him.
traduit: 你也替他报仇了。

original: You're right. It's what he wanted, and he deserved to have it.
traduit: 你说得对。那是他的愿望，也是他应得的。

original: There the souls of the Harbingers will heed the call of northern steel.
traduit: 先驱们的灵魂在那里聆听北方钢铁的召唤。

original: We can't even enter the tomb without Wuuthrad, and it's in pieces, like it has been for a thousand years.
traduit: 没有巫斯拉德我们根本进不去，而且那东西已经碎了一千年了。

original: Kodlak did not care for vengeance.
traduit: 克拉科并不在乎复仇。

original: And dragons were just stories. And the elves once ruled Skyrim.
traduit: 龙族曾经只是传说，而精灵也曾统治天际。

original: Just because something is, doesn't mean it must be.
traduit: 不能因为某事如此，便认为理应如此。

original: The blade is a weapon. A tool. Tools are meant to be broken. And repaired.
traduit: 这东西不过是个武器。一个工具。工具就是会被破坏的，修好就是了。

original: This is the first time I've had all the pieces, thanks to our Shield-Brother here.
traduit: 这是我第一次拿到全部碎片，多亏了咱们这位盾牌兄弟。

original: This is the first time I've had all the pieces, thanks to our Shield-Sister here.
traduit: 这是我第一次拿到全部碎片，多亏了咱们这位盾牌姐妹。

original: "The flames of a hero can reforge the shattered."
traduit: “英雄之火可以重塑碎片”

original: The flames of Kodlak shall fuel the rebirth of Wuuthrad. And now it will take you to meet him once more.
traduit: 克拉科的火焰为巫斯拉德的重生提供了燃料。现在是时候去和他再见一面了。

original: The rest of you, prepare to journey to the Tomb of Ysgramor. For Kodlak.
traduit: 其余人，做好准备，前往伊斯格拉默之墓。为了克拉科。

original: As the one who bore the fragments, I think you should be the one to carry Wuuthrad into battle.
traduit: 作为拿回碎片的人。我觉得应该由你带着巫斯拉德回归战场。

original: I can't go any further, Shield-Brother.
traduit: 我不能再往前走了，盾牌兄弟。

original: I can't go any further, Shield-Sister.
traduit: 我不能再往前走了，盾牌姐妹。

original: Ever since Dustman's Cairn, the big crawly ones have been too much for me.
traduit: 自从进入过清洁者石冢之后，我就受不了那些大虫子。

original: Everyone has his weakness, and this one is mine.
traduit: 每个人都有自己的弱点，我就是害怕这个。

original: I'm not proud, but I will stay back with Vilkas. Give my regards to Ysgramor.
traduit: 我并不觉得自豪，但我会留下来陪威尔卡斯。代我向伊斯格拉默问好。

original: Did I hear right? Did he say you were to lead the Companions?
traduit: 我没听错吧？他说让你领导战友团？

original: I'm just surprised. But your strength and honor are apparent to all.
traduit: 我只是感到惊讶。但你的力量与荣耀是有目共睹的。

original: You've earned the right. Your strength and honor are apparent to all.
traduit: 你有此权利。你的力量与荣耀是有目共睹的。

original: And it's my honor to be first to address you as Harbinger.
traduit: 我很荣幸成为你上任先驱后第一个与你交谈的人。

original: Let's go tell the others.
traduit: 我们去告诉其他人吧。

original: Extraordinary. I see it now.
traduit: 太好了。我懂了。

original: The sealing structure interlocks in the tiniest fractals.
traduit: 密闭结构以微小的碎形连接。

original: Dwemer blood can loose the hooks, but none alive remain to bear it.
traduit: 锻莫之血可以使挂钩解锁，但他们没有活体存在了。

original: A panoply of their brethren could gather to form a facsimile. A trick. Something they didn't anticipate, no, not even them.
traduit: 但他们同胞的血液可以汇聚成复制品。这个诡计他们肯定想不到。

original: The blood of Altmer, Bosmer, Dunmer, Falmer, and Orsimer. The elves still living provide the key.
traduit: 傲特莫、波斯莫、丹莫、伐莫、奥辛莫之血。活着的精灵们提供了解封的钥匙。

original: Bear you hence this extractor. It will drink the fresh blood of elves. Come when its set is complete.
traduit: 带上这个萃取器，它会汲取精灵之血。等收集齐全之后再回来。

original: I've inscribed the lexicon.
traduit: 我刻好方典了。

original: Give it, quickly.
traduit: 快给我。

original: What do I do with this cube?
traduit: 我该怎么处理这个方典？

original: To glimpse the world inside an Elder Scroll can damage the eyes. Or the mind, as it has to Septimus.
traduit: 窥视上古卷轴中的世界会伤害双眼，或者像赛普蒂莫斯一样被伤到神志。

original: The Dwemer found a loophole, as they always do. To focus the knowledge away and inside without harm.
traduit: 锻莫如往常一样找到了漏洞。将知识集中其中却不会造成伤害。

original: Place the lexicon into their contraption and focus the knowings into it. When it brims with glow, bring it back and Septimus can read once more.
traduit: 把方典放到他们的装置里，把知识刻录在里面。当它闪烁光芒的时候，就拿回来。赛普蒂莫斯就能再读一遍了。

original: What do I do with this sphere?
traduit: 我怎么处理这个球体？

original: The deepest doors of Dwemer listen for singing. It plays the attitude of notes proper for opening. Can you not hear it? Too low for hearings?
traduit: 锻莫最深邃的门可以聆听歌唱。它能够正确的地演奏音符。你没听见吗？难道声音太小了？

original: You see this masterwork of the Dwemer. Deep inside their greatest knowings.
traduit: 看看这个锻莫杰作。他们伟大知识中的深藏之物。

original: Septimus is clever among men, but he is but an idiot child compared to the dullest of the Dwemer.
traduit: 赛普蒂莫斯是人类里最聪明的。但即使与最迟钝的锻莫比，他也蠢得像个孩子。

original: Lucky then they left behind their own way of reading the Elder Scrolls.
traduit: 所幸他们留下了自己阅读上古卷轴的方法。

original: In the depths of Blackreach one yet lies.
traduit: 在黑境深处还有一处。

original: Have you heard of Blackreach? "Cast upon where Dwemer cities slept, the yearning spire hidden learnings kept."
traduit: 你听说过黑境吗？“锻莫城市沉睡之处，渴慕的尖塔保存着隐秘的知识”。

original: Don't make me hurt you. Just tell me where it is.
traduit: 别逼我伤了你。告诉我在哪就行。

original: Oh, a brutish one. Septimus has no fear of you. But as one block raises another, perhaps ourselves could help us each.
traduit: 哦，野蛮人。赛普蒂莫斯不怕你。但是，当一块砖托起另一块时，我们可以互相帮助。

original: Can you help me get the Elder Scroll or not?
traduit: 你到底能不能帮我找到上古卷轴？

original: One block lifts the other. Septimus will give what you want, but you must bring him something in return.
traduit: 一块砖可以托起另一块。赛普蒂莫斯会给你想要的。但你得有点回报。

original: Would this loosen your tongue? (<bribecost> gold)
traduit: 这些够让你松口了吗？（<bribeCost>金币）

original: Ah, I think that'll do just the trick.
traduit: 啊，我想这样就行了。

original: You'll need a little more coin than what you're floatin' around with.
traduit: 你给的还差点儿意思。

original: Gauldur!
traduit: 高尔多！

original: Bormah!
traduit: 伯马胡！

original: Then he left for Blackreach I suppose.
traduit: 他后来去了黑境。

original: One day he simply ran out to me in the field, excited that he'd made some sort of a breakthrough and he was going to head out on another trip.
traduit: 有一天，他跑到田里找我，看着很兴奋，因为他取得了某种突破，要开始另一次旅行。

original: He never returned. From the journal you discovered, I'm sure you know the rest.
traduit: 他再也没有回来。从你发现的日记里，我相信你肯定知道了剩下的事。

original: How did he end up in Skyrim?
traduit: 他是怎么来天际的？

original: Well, after I fled Morrowind during the eruption, I made my way here... my family had purchased this farm and its all we had left.
traduit: 哎，我在红山爆发的时候逃离了晨风，来到了这里……我们家买下了这个农场，这里是我们所剩的一切。

original: Years later, Sinderion simply showed up at our doorstep asking to stay for a while... said he was going to do field research.
traduit: 几年后，辛德莱昂突然来到我们家门口，要待一阵……他说要去做实地调查。

original: He stayed with us for decades... became an uncle of sorts to Aduri.
traduit: 他和我们生活了几十年……就像阿都丽的叔叔一样。

original: How did you and Sinderion meet?
traduit: 你和辛德莱昂是怎么相遇的？

original: When I was very young, I was sent to Skingrad in Cyrodiil to study with him.
traduit: 当我很小的时候，我被送到希罗帝尔的斯金格勒和他一起学习。

original: He was a strange Altmer... paid more attention to his research than his own well-being. He lived in the basement of an inn for goodness sakes!
traduit: 他是个很怪的傲特莫……他更关注研究而不是自己过得怎么样。他甚至就住在一家旅店的地下室里。

original: Did Sinderion teach you how to grow nirnroot?
traduit: 是辛德莱昂教会你怎么种奈恩根的？

original: Yes. He was an absolute genius when it came to the nirnroot.
traduit: 没错。要说到奈恩根，他是绝对的天才。

original: Sinderion made it his life's work, developing all sorts of interesting concoctions.
traduit: 辛德莱昂把它作为毕生的事业，开发了很多有趣的合剂。

original: I used to be. There isn't much time for that in my life anymore I'm afraid.
traduit: 曾经是。恐怕我已经没什么时间去从事这个行业了。

original: I actually owned a shop in Vivec City long ago, but I had to leave all that behind when the Red Mountain erupted.
traduit: 其实很久以前我在维威克城开过一家店，但红山爆发时，不得不都抛在身后了。

original: Perhaps someday I'll reopen a shop here in Skyrim.
traduit: 也许我会在天际重新开一家店。

original: One day, these beautiful plants will make us famous and we can finally move off of this farm... thanks to Sinderion.
traduit: 总有一天，这些美丽的植物能帮我们扬名，我们终于可以离开这个农场了……要谢谢辛德莱昂啊。

original: They're beautiful. I can see why he wanted to find them.
traduit: 真漂亮。我知道他为什么想找到它们了。

original: Remember Uncle Sinderion? These are the plants he was searching for... the Crimson Nirnroot.
traduit: 记得辛德莱昂叔叔吗？这些是他一直在追寻的植物……深红奈恩根。

original: Where did all these pretty red plants come from?
traduit: 这些漂亮的红色植物是从哪儿来的？

original: You've done alchemy a great service by helping to complete Sinderion's work.
traduit: 你为辛德莱昂的炼金研究帮了大忙。

original: I'd like to give you this tome...it's one of Sinderion's greatest works. I believe you've more than earned it.
traduit: 我想把这个给你……辛德莱昂最伟大的作品之一。这是你应得的。

original: I've brought this Crimson Nirnroot for you.
traduit: 我给你带来这个深红奈恩根。

original: You've gathered quite a few of them I see.
traduit: 看来你收集了不少了。

original: I'll search through Sinderion's notes and find some more information about the Crimson Nirnroot and its properties.
traduit: 我会研究辛德莱昂的笔记，找到更多关于深红奈恩根的信息。

original: I found it in Blackreach.
traduit: 我在黑境找到了这个。

original: Blackreach... why does that sound so familiar?
traduit: 黑境……怎么听着这么耳熟？

original: Of course! It's where my mentor, Sinderion said he was going to do his field research.
traduit: 对了！我导师辛德莱昂说过要去那里搞野外考察。

original: It's been... years I think, but perhaps you could still find him.
traduit: 已经……有很多年了，但也许你能找到他。

original: Are you familiar with this Crimson Nirnroot?
traduit: 你熟悉这种深红奈恩根吗？

original: Crimson Nirnroot? I'd heard such a strain existed, but never imagined I'd see any in my lifetime.
traduit: 深红奈恩根？我听说过，但从没想过能亲眼见到。

original: Where did you find this?
traduit: 你从哪儿找到的？

original: I've found Sinderion's remains.
traduit: 我找到了辛德莱昂的遗体。

original: I knew this day would eventually come.
traduit: 我就知道这一天总会来的。

original: At least poor Sinderion died doing what he loved, his field research. I told the old fool he should take it easy, but he was too stubborn.
traduit: 至少辛德莱昂至死都在从事自己喜欢的野外考察。我告诉过那个老糊涂慢一点，可他固执了。

original: Perhaps someday I'll continue where he left off, it's the least I can do considering how much he did for me.
traduit: 他对我的付出我无以为报，也许有一天我会继承他的事业，至少我能做这些。

original: Well, your secret is safe with me.
traduit: 嗯，我会替你保密的。

original: I should hope so. The Dark Brotherhood is also known to place contracts on those who associate with the Morang Tong as well.
traduit: 希望如此。黑暗兄弟会也会给那些与莫拉格堂有关系的人下契约。

original: So, unless you wish a visit from one of their own, I'd suggest you follow your own advice and keep your mouth shut.
traduit: 所以，除非你想让他们亲自来拜访你，我建议你还是照你自己说的，管好嘴。

original: Perhaps you should have joined the Dark Brotherhood.
traduit: 你也许可以加入黑暗兄弟会。

original: If the Dark Brotherhood discovered I had been a Morang Tong, they would come after me with a vengeance.
traduit: 如果黑暗兄弟会发现我是莫拉格堂的人，他们会报复我的。

original: Better to stay out of sight and ply my trade with the Thieves Guild than risk a contract on my head.
traduit: 与其冒着被人下契约的风险，还不如躲起来和盗贼公会打交道。

original: Why didn't you stay with the Tong?
traduit: 你为何没留在那？

original: I didn't have a choice. When the Red Mountain erupted in Morrowind, the Tong fled... spread to the nine winds.
traduit: 我没得选。晨风的红山爆发时，本堂四散奔逃。

original: We made a pact that one day, we might reunite... but I believe that day is long in coming.
traduit: 我们相约总有一天可以重聚，但我觉得那一天还远远未到。

original: Was it anything like the Dark Brotherhood?
traduit: 它与黑暗兄弟会有些像？

original: No. In fact, the Tong were quite the bitter rivals with the Dark Brotherhood.
traduit: 不，事实上，本堂是黑暗兄弟会的死对头。

original: Where they operate within the shadows, we operated on the side of justice.
traduit: 他们行于阴影，而我们执行正义。

original: Who are the Morang Tong?
traduit: 莫拉格堂是什么人？

original: We were an assassins guild that was sanctioned by the Empire to provide public as well as private executions.
traduit: 我们是帝国批准的刺客公会，可以公开或私下执行死刑。

original: We did this in the name of Mephala, whom I used to quite fervently worship.
traduit: 我们以梅法拉的名义行事，我曾经十分崇拜她。

original: So, where do you hail from?
traduit: 那你是哪来的？

original: Morrowind of course. Any Dunmer worth their weight in ash would tell you the same.
traduit: 自然是晨风了。任何一个尊重灰地的丹莫都会这么说。

original: I used to be a member of the Morang Tong.
traduit: 我曾经是莫拉格堂的一员。

original: That was big of you to accept.
traduit: 你能接受可太好了。

original: Something told me I wouldn't regret it. I had heard the Guild was back on its feet again and most of Skyrim under its belt.
traduit: 直觉告诉我，我不会后悔。我听说公会又重新站稳脚跟了，天际已经大部分置于其下了。

original: I'll tell you, I wouldn't want to cross blades with Vex again, but I certainly wouldn't mind a bit of a scuffle...
traduit: 我跟你说，我再也不想跟小烦拼刀子了，当然发生点别的战斗还是可以的……

original: A stalemate?
traduit: 陷入僵局了？

original: After a few minutes, she looked me dead in the eye and asked me if I wanted to join the Guild. Just like that, no apologies.
traduit: 几分钟后，她看着我的眼睛问我要不要加入公会。就这样，连句道歉都没说。

original: Is that when she asked you to join?
traduit: 所以她邀请你来入伙？

original: Actually, that's when she politely asked me to hand over my coin purse. Can you imagine?
traduit: 事实上，她当时很礼貌地让我把钱掏出来。你能想得到？

original: We scuffled for a while, broke each other's weapons, and finally fell to the ground exhausted.
traduit: 我们打斗了一会儿，把彼此的武器都打坏了，最后精疲力尽地倒在地上。

original: She needed help with some wolves?
traduit: 她需要帮手？

original: Well, there were eight of them and she'd already killed three by the time I joined the fight.
traduit: 嗯，它们一共八只，我加入战斗的时候她已经杀了仨了。

original: Together, we made short work of them and the last one limped away licking its wounds.
traduit: 我们很快干掉了它们，最后一只舔着伤口一瘸一拐地跑了。

original: So how did someone like you join the Guild?
traduit: 你这样的人是怎么加入公会的？

original: It's kind of an amusing tale.
traduit: 那可是个有趣的故事了。

original: I was making my way down the road from Ivarstead towards Riften, and I saw Vex fighting off a couple of wolves.
traduit: 我正从伊瓦尔镇往裂谷城走，看见小烦在和几头狼搏斗。

original: I'll keep an eye out for anything.
traduit: 我会帮你留意的。

original: I appreciate that.
traduit: 非常感激。

original: Ah! Here it is.
traduit: 啊！在这里。

original: So who gave you the name?
traduit: 你的名字是谁取的？

original: Actually, the fisherman who found me, the man I call my father gave it to me.
traduit: 就是那个发现我的渔夫，那个被我称为“父亲”的人。

original: Thought it was fitting I suppose. I never changed it, because it never felt right to do so.
traduit: 我觉得挺合适的。我从没想过改名，因为感觉那样做不好。

original: Maybe you aren't meant to know.
traduit: 也许你本就不必知道。

original: Perhaps. They could be nonsense... inane scribbles done by someone in idle boredom.
traduit: 也许吧。可能就是些无稽之谈……某人在无聊时瞎画的。

original: But if not... if they actually mean something, they might tell me where I'm from... what ship was I on. Everything.
traduit: 但如果不是的话……如果真的有什么含义，也许我就只能知道我的身世……知道我在哪艘船上。知道一切。

original: Do you know what they mean?
traduit: 你知道那是什么意思吗？

original: No one does. I've even taken the damn thing to the College of Winterhold.
traduit: 没人知道。我甚至还带着它去了趟冬堡学院。

original: I must have spent every last coin I've made with the Guild trying to find out what it means.
traduit: 我把我在公会赚到的所有钱都花在了这上面，想要弄清楚含义。

original: How did you get your unusual name?
traduit: 你这名字是怎么来的？

original: My father told me he found me as a young boy in the wreckage of a ship that sank off of the coast near Solitude.
traduit: 我父亲告诉我，我小时候是他从一艘船的残骸里找到的，那艘船在独孤城附近的海岸沉没了。

original: All he found in my pocket was a tiny smooth stone inscribed with some sort of strange runes.
traduit: 他在我口袋里找到一块光滑的小石头，上面刻着某种奇怪的符文。

original: And Garthek?
traduit: 加塞克呢？

original: I left his head on a pike at the wreckage of the caravan.
traduit: 我把他脑袋挂在车队残骸的尖刺上了。

original: Never knew what became of the rest of the clan that survived. I suppose they moved on just like I did.
traduit: 不知道其他活下来的弟兄怎么样了。我想他们也应该和我一样离开了。

original: You'd never had to do that before?
traduit: 你以前没这么干过？

original: No, we usually let them go. I refused to do it, and Garthek ordered the clan to kill me as well.
traduit: 没干过。我们通常会放过他们。我拒绝了，加塞克命令团伙宰了我。

original: Luckily, I had made some friends with the clan who immediately sided with me.
traduit: 所幸我在那里交了几个朋友，他们站在了我这边。

original: We tore each other to pieces. After it was over, those of us that remained simply went our separate ways.
traduit: 我们把那一边的撕成了碎片。一切结束后，我们这些幸存的也就分道扬镳了。

original: What changed?
traduit: 怎么就变了呢？

original: We raided a caravan one spring... I think it was a few wagons with some farmers moving to a new village.
traduit: 有年春天，我们突袭了一支车队……估计都是些想搬到新村镇的农民。

original: They didn't put up much of a fight. All that was left were the women and the children.
traduit: 他们没怎么反抗。就剩下些女人和小孩子。

original: Then the leader of our clan... Garthek... he ordered us to kill the rest.
traduit: 然后我们团队的首领……加塞克……他下令让我们去杀了所有人。

original: But not for you?
traduit: 你不是？

original: Don't get me wrong. The first few years with that clan were some of the best years of my life.
traduit: 别误会。和那伙人在一起的头几年是我这辈子最好的日子。

original: All the food I could eat, all the wine I could drink and all the women I could bed.
traduit: 吃得好喝得好，还能跟好多女的滚床单。

original: So you were part of a bandit clan?
traduit: 所以说你曾经加入过强盗团伙？

original: I joined up with them maybe ten years ago.
traduit: 大概是十年前吧。

original: Small clan... maybe twenty men. We'd raid villages, rob caravans... but it was always about the killing for them.
traduit: 一个小团伙……二十人左右。我们袭击村庄，劫掠商队……但对他们来说，一切都是为了杀戮。

original: Why did you join the Guild and not the Brotherhood?
traduit: 那你为什么加入公会而不是黑暗兄弟会？

original: I don't know. I think I realized that out in the world, my skills would bring me more wealth as a thief rather than an assassin.
traduit: 不知道。可能是我意识到我的技术当盗贼赚的比刺客多。

original: Killing someone in a jail is much easier than what the Dark Brotherhood deals with. I guess I wanted to play it safe.
traduit: 在监狱杀人比黑暗兄弟会的工作要容易的多。我想还是小心点好。

original: I already knew Delvin, I asked if I could join up, and that was that.
traduit: 我当时早就认识戴尔文了，问他能不能加入，就这样。

original: I think I see what you're getting at.
traduit: 我想我明白你的意思了。

original: The last jailbreak I attempted failed. I was imprisoned in High Rock for three years before they let me go.
traduit: 我上次越狱失败，在高岩的监狱被关了快三年才放出来。

original: After that I promised myself I'd never do it again.
traduit: 那以后，我就发誓不再干了。

original: Why did you stop doing it?
traduit: 你为什么不干了？

original: Well, as a jailbreaker, you work alone. No Guild to back you up.
traduit: 作为越狱者，只能单干。没有公会的支持。

original: I'd do jobs for the Thieves Guild and the Dark Brotherhood, but if things didn't go as planned, I was on my own.
traduit: 我替盗贼公会和黑暗兄弟会工作，但如果事情不顺利，就只能靠自己了。

original: Jailbreaking? What's that?
traduit: 越狱？那是什么？

original: It's where a client pays you to get arrested, and you get thrown into a prison for the express purpose of breaking out.
traduit: 客户付钱，让你被捕，然后为了越狱而关进监狱。

original: Usually it's to free someone the client cares about... and sometimes to... well, to kill someone on their behalf.
traduit: 通常是为了释放客户关心的人……也有时是为了杀人。

original: Either way, the trick was in the escape, and that's where my strengths came in handy.
traduit: 不管怎样，诀窍就在逃跑上，这就是我天赋的用武之地。

original: With skills like yours? Why not?
traduit: 你这么好的技术怎么不用呢？

original: I didn't mean to imply I was earning an honest living either.
traduit: 我也不是说我在老老实实谋生。

original: With my lock picking aptitude, I was a natural at jailbreaking... made a great deal of gold doing it too.
traduit: 我有开锁的天赋，擅长越狱……用这种方法也赚了不少钱。

original: How did you become so good at picking locks?
traduit: 你是怎么这么擅长开锁的？

original: Pull up a chair, my friend... this is quite a tale.
traduit: 拉把椅子过来吧，朋友……这是个好故事。

original: When I started out in this business, I wasn't really interested in the Guild or being a thief.
traduit: 我最开始做这行的时候，我对加入公会或者当小偷没什么兴趣。

original: You still never told me your real name.
traduit: 你还是没告诉我你名字啊。

original: Maybe one day, just not today.
traduit: 也许某一天会告诉你吧，但不是今天。

original: How did you escape?
traduit: 你是怎么逃出来的？

original: Over time, I managed to gain their confidence. Then one night I grabbed a knife, waited until they fell asleep and cut their throats.
traduit: 过了些日子，我设法获取了他们的信任。有天晚上，我抓起一把刀子，趁他们睡觉就割了他们的喉咙。

original: I never returned to that pig farm you know. There's nothing for me there.
traduit: 我没再回那个养猪场，你应该明白，我在那里的一切都没了。

original: So that's my sad story. What do you think?
traduit: 这就是我悲伤的故事了。你怎么看啊？

original: You don't have to continue.
traduit: 你别再说了。

original: It's fine... I had to tell someone I suppose.
traduit: 没事……跟人说说也好。

original: Carrying around a weight like that... it hurts after a while. Cuts you inside like a dagger to the heart.
traduit: 背负这么沉重的东西……时间久了会很疼的。就像一把匕首插进了心里。

original: Sounds horrible.
traduit: 听起来很恐怖。

original: Oh, wait... it gets much better.
traduit: 哦，这……还算是好的呢。

original: How about the fact that our farm was attacked by bandits, and that they killed my entire family who didn't even brandish a weapon against them.
traduit: 假如我说我们的农场遭到了强盗洗劫呢，他们把我全家都杀了，我们甚至连抵抗都没有。

original: Here's the best part. They took me as a prize, and violated me for a fortnight. Tossed me from bandit to bandit like... like...
traduit: 最精彩的来了。他们把我当成了战利品，侵犯了我两个星期。一个接一个地……就像……就像……

original: Something had to make you this angry.
traduit: 一定有什么事让你如此生气。

original: Look, you want to know about me? All right, I'll tell you.
traduit: 你真想知道我的事？好吧，我来告诉你。

original: I'll tell you about the time I was a young girl, barely out of her teens... living on a pig farm in the middle of nowhere.
traduit: 我还是个小女孩的时候，刚刚十几岁时……住在一个偏僻的养猪场。

original: Didn't have a coin to spend between our entire family. Ate the same slop we fed our livestock.
traduit: 我们全家穷得叮当响。吃的就是喂猪的泔水。

original: So, will you tell me your real name?
traduit: 你能告诉我你的真名吗？

original: Look, I don't really know you. I don't even really know anyone here.
traduit: 听着，我不了解你。我不了解这里的所有人。

original: Why do you care anyway? It's not like we're family. This is a business.
traduit: 你为什么要关心这个？我们又不是一家子。这是生意。

original: That must have been difficult.
traduit: 那一定很艰难吧。

original: I ended up in Skyrim thanks to a contact I'd made when I was with the Crescents... good old Delvin.
traduit: 我最后还是选择来了天际，也得感谢我在银色新月时和老戴尔文搭上了线。

original: He introduced me to Gallus, and that was it. I've been here ever since.
traduit: 他把我介绍给了加卢斯，就这样。自那以后我就在这里了。

original: And you know what? Despite what I left behind, I don't regret it one bit.
traduit: 你知道吗？尽管我离开了，但并不后悔。

original: How did you end up in Skyrim?
traduit: 你是怎么来天际的？

original: Well, after a while my father caught on to what I was doing. He confronted me one night and gave me a choice.
traduit: 过了些日子，我父亲好像发现了我在干什么。有天晚上他与我对质，让我做个选择。

original: Either leave Valenwood, or he'd have me thrown into jail. Gave me a day to say my goodbyes to everyone.
traduit: 要么离开威伦森林，要么他把我送进监狱。他给了我一天时间和大家告别。

original: Like being a thief.
traduit: 比如做贼。

original: I hooked up with a guild in Valenwood... I think they called themselves the Silver Crescents. Spent quite a few years doing jobs for them.
traduit: 我和威伦森林的一个公会搞在一起了……他们自称叫银色新月。我替他们工作了好几年。

original: Made a lot of coin, but I didn't care. I didn't really need it... I was running with them because it fit, made me feel alive.
traduit: 赚了不少钱，但是我不在乎。我其实不需要……带着它们奔走只是因为很合适，能够感觉到自己还活着。

original: Why would you leave all that behind?
traduit: 那你为什么要放弃这一切呢？

original: Because it was dull. Every day was the same boring routine; working at the winery, social visits with friends, parties with no one I cared about.
traduit: 因为无聊啊。每天都是枯燥的重复，酒厂劳作，与朋友社交，和不感兴趣的人聚会。

original: I just wanted a little excitement. Something dangerous.
traduit: 我想找些刺激。试试危险的东西。

original: How did you end up at the Guild?
traduit: 你是怎么加入公会的？

original: I used to live in Valenwood working at my father's winery... we made the finest wine to ever cross your lips I promise you.
traduit: 我以前住在威伦森林，在我父亲的酒厂里工作……我保证，我们酿的酒绝对是你能尝到最好的。

original: We were doing well, plenty of coin, a huge mansion and I was even betrothed to a lovely young woman.
traduit: 我们过得不错，钱多房大，还和一个可爱的年轻姑娘订了婚。

original: Why were they laughing?
traduit: 他们乐什么？

original: Well, I had forgotten we had our horses tied up just outside of Windhelm... Vex rode hers back and arrived hours before I did.
traduit: 哎，我忘了自己把马拴在风舵城外面了……小烦自己骑马回来了，比我早到了几小时。

original: So, that's how I earned the name. Now keep it to yourself.
traduit: 所以我才有了这么个外号。别外传啊。

original: That's an incredible distance to run.
traduit: 这距离可不短啊。

original: Vex was waiting for me at the Flagon when I came in... drenched in sweat. Everyone just took a look at me and laughed.
traduit: 我进来的时候，小烦已经在漏壶那儿等我了。我浑身上下都是汗。大家一看就乐了。

original: Did either of you get caught?
traduit: 你们有谁被抓了吗？

original: Are you kidding me? Vex lost them in seconds... once she steps into the shadows, she vanishes.
traduit: 你逗我呢？小烦几秒钟就把他们都甩开了……她一走进阴影就消失了。

original: Me? I ran... and I ran... straight through the gates of Windhelm and all the way back to Riften.
traduit: 至于我？我就跑啊……跑……直接穿过风舵城门，一路跑回了裂谷城。

original: Sounds normal to me.
traduit: 听起来很正常啊。

original: Well it was, up until the point where we set foot outside. The house was surrounded by town guard... the client had ratted us out.
traduit: 是，直到我们走出去那一刻。整座房子都被卫兵给包围了。客户把我们给卖了。

original: Vex just tells me to run, so I did. Half of them went after me, the other half went after her.
traduit: 小烦让我快跑，我就跑了。一半人在追我，另一半在追她。

original: So how did you earn your name?
traduit: 你的名字是怎么来的？

original: It was on a job a few years back... it was supposed to be a simple burglary on a house in Windhelm.
traduit: 源自几年前一桩工作……本来只是去风舵城简单地搞个入室行窃。

original: I was working with Vex and we got inside with no trouble. We found the loot, and made our way out.
traduit: 我和小烦搭伙，没遇上什么麻烦就进去了。然后找到赃物就出去了。

original: If you want to get paid, keep your weapon sheathed.
traduit: 想要钱就把你的武器收好。

original: No one dies. Remember that. We're not assassins.
traduit: 不能有人死。记住。我们不是刺客。

original: If you get arrested, it's on your head.
traduit: 如果被捕，自己负责。

original: Keep to the shadows and you'll do fine.
traduit: 行于阴影，保你没事。

original: I don't want a trail of dead bodies leading here. Keep it clean.
traduit: 我可不想把血迹引到这里。做得干净些。

original: Get the job done and get back alive. That's all there is to it.
traduit: 完成任务，活着回来。就这些。

original: Don't give up now... there's plenty of loot out there just ripe for the taking.
traduit: 现在不要放弃……还有大量的战利品等你去拿呢。

original: Hey, I still have plenty of work to do here.
traduit: 嘿，我这儿还有好些活儿呢。

original: Walking away without taking a job is like passing a bloated coinpurse on a table.
traduit: 不接工作就走，就和把一袋子钱扔桌子上不管一样。

original: You think you're finished? I've got plenty more where that came from.
traduit: 你觉得这就完事了？我这里还有很多呢。

original: Come on, take another job so we can both make some money.
traduit: 来吧，再来拿份工作，这样咱们都能赚钱。

original: These jobs aren't going to finish themselves you know.
traduit: 你得明白工作可不会自动完成。

original: Hey, where do you think you're going? We have work to do.
traduit: 嘿，你打算去哪儿？我们还有活儿要干呢。

original: Don't muck this up.
traduit: 别把事情搞砸了。

original: Don't forget your represntin' the Guild. Don't do anythin' stupid.
traduit: 不要忘了你是在代表公会。别干傻事。

original: Make us proud.
traduit: 让我们也跟着骄傲骄傲。

original: Be careful out there... wouldn't want to lose such a promisin' cutpurse now, would we.
traduit: 在外小心……我们可不想现在就失去一个有前途的盗贼，明白吗。

original: Use your skills, not your blade and you'll do fine.
traduit: 善用技术，别总想着动手，你能办到。

original: No killin' or no pay. Remember that.
traduit: 杀人就赚不着钱。记好了。

original: Remember, keep it clean. We don't want blood on our hands.
traduit: 记住，保持整洁。我们可不想沾一手血。

original: Can I give you a little tip? Take every job you can get or else you'll end up a beggar.
traduit: 给你个小建议？把握每份能拿到的工作，否则早晚变成乞丐。

original: Hey, this guild needs the coin... walkin' away without takin' work is not going to make you popular around here.
traduit: 嘿，公会现在需要钱……不接活儿就走人，你会变得不受欢迎的。

original: There's plenty more work for the likes of you.
traduit: 还有很多可以给你的工作。

original: What's the matter, afraid of getting your hands dirty?
traduit: 怎么了？怕把手弄脏了？

original: Where you off to? There's work to be done.
traduit: 你要去哪儿？还有工作呢。

original: Only way this guilds going to continue to grow is by takin' extra work.
traduit: 想让公会继续发展的唯一办法就是做额外工作。

original: Find me if you're ever lookin' for some extra coin.
traduit: 想要赚些外快就来找我吧。

original: Finally. Now I can get back to work.
traduit: 总算结束了。我要回去工作了。

original: Don't hurry back, I won't be waiting.
traduit: 别急着回来，我不会等的。

original: Good luck on your next job.
traduit: 祝你下份工作好运。

original: Off for some wine, eh? Drink one for me.
traduit: 要喝点酒？给我来一杯。

original: Keep to the shadows.
traduit: 行于阴影。

original: Always a pleasure...
traduit: 这是我的荣幸……

original: Go and pick some fights.
traduit: 去找点事做吧。

original: Some other time, perhaps.
traduit: 下回再聊吧。

original: I'm sure we'll speak again.
traduit: 咱们肯定有机会再聊的。

original: I hope we bump into each other again.
traduit: 希望下次再会。

original: Maybe I'll see you around the Guild.
traduit: 咱们公会再见。

original: If you ever need more practice with the bow, just grab me.
traduit: 如果需要练箭就来找我。

original: Come find me if you need more marksman training.
traduit: 需要弓箭练习可以来找我。

original: Need any more pickpocket training, you just let me know.
traduit: 需要扒窃训练可以找我。

original: Come back and see me if you ever need pickpocket training.
traduit: 需要扒窃训练可以回来找我。

original: A word of advice. Don't disappoint me.
traduit: 给你个建议。别让我失望。

original: I'm watching you.
traduit: 我看着你呢。

original: Yeah... Let's wait a little longer. Then...
traduit: 是啊……我们再等一会儿吧。然后……

original: Something's wrong... Boss' been down there too long.
traduit: 不对劲……老大在下面时间太长了。

original: I'm a Blade, now. I can hardly believe it.
traduit: 我现在是刀锋了。简直不敢相信。

original: By my honor, I pledge to rid Tamriel of dragons.
traduit: 我以我的荣誉起誓，为泰姆瑞尔铲除龙族。

original: Dragonborn. What do you need?
traduit: 龙裔。您有事吗？

original: Tell me about Kyne.
traduit: 跟我说说凯娜。

original: Those sycophants in the Temple would call her Kynareth. Just a pale shadow of the truth, like all the Temple Divines.
traduit: 神殿里那些马屁精管她叫凯娜瑞丝。那东西和所有神殿里的圣灵一样，只是真实下的苍白阴影。

original: Kyne! Blessed Warrior-Wife. Shor's widow, sacred to any true Nord hunter. She's the mother of men and beasts, and her veil is the storm.
traduit: 凯娜！受祝福的战妻。舒尔的遗孀，对于所有真正的诺德猎人来说都是神圣无比的。她是人类与野兽的母亲，风暴即是她的面纱。

original: Killing him was a bit... impulsive.
traduit: 杀他是有点……冲动了。

original: A true professional would have kept his cool and dealt with it a different way, but I'll let it go.
traduit: 一个真正的专业人士会保持冷静，用不同的方式来处理问题。但这次就算了。

original: Actually, I admire how you handled the situation.
traduit: 事实上，我很欣赏你处理这件事的方式。

original: You kept your cool and you didn't kill him. That's the mark of a professional thief.
traduit: 你很冷静，没有动手杀他。这是职业盗贼的素养。

original: So the guard at the North Gate was your man?
traduit: 所以北门的卫兵是你安排的？

original: Aye, that he was. And you sniffed him out because he broke one of the cardinal rules of our business... he got greedy.
traduit: 对，没错。而你察觉到了，因为他犯了我们工作中的一项大忌……贪婪。

original: He was told to run the scam on merchants, but he smelled the gold on you and his judgment went out the window.
traduit: 我告诉他要勒索行商，但从你身上嗅到金币味道之后，他的判断力就被抛诸脑后了。

original: Look how you sniffed out my little scheme at the North Gate. You knew it was a shakedown and you called him on it. That's what I'm talking about.
traduit: 你在北门发现了我的小阴谋。察觉了勒索，还揭露了出来。我说的就是这个。

original: The gate's unlocked. You can head inside when you're ready.
traduit: 大门打开了。准备好就可以进了。

original: Forget it. I'll come back.
traduit: 算了吧。我会回来的。

original: Don't want in, huh? Fine. Have a good walk to the next city.
traduit: 不想进去？好吧。一路好走，去下个城市吧。

original: This is obviously a shakedown. (Persuade)
traduit: 这明显是敲诈啊。（说服）

original: All right, keep your voice down... you want everyone to hear you? I'll let you in, just let me unlock the gate.
traduit: 好了，小点声……你想让所有人都听到吗？我会放你进去的，等我把门打开。

original: Call it what you want. You don't pay, then you're not getting in.
traduit: 随你怎么说。不付钱你就别进去了。

original: This is obviously a shakedown, but I'll pay. (<BribeCost> gold)
traduit: 虽然显然是敲诈，但我会付钱的。（<BribeCost>金币）

original: It's been a pleasure doing business with you. Let me open the gate and you can head into the city.
traduit: 和你做生意很愉快啊。等我开完门你就能进城了。

original: Nope. Not even close.
traduit: 不行，差得远呢。

original: What's the tax for?
traduit: 这是什么税？

original: For the privilege of entering the city. What does it matter?
traduit: 为了买进入城市的权利。怎么了？

original: Hold there.
traduit: 停下。

original: Before I let you into Riften, you need to pay the visitor's tax.
traduit: 想进裂谷城，你得先交访客税。

original: Have you decided to pay the visitor's tax?
traduit: 决定要交访客税了吗？

original: Welcome to Riften.
traduit: 欢迎来到裂谷城。

original: You want in, you need to cooperate.
traduit: 想要进，就配合点。

original: Well? In you go.
traduit: 嗯？进去吧。

original: I'm going in this way. Stand aside! (Intimidate)
traduit: 我就要进去。躲开点！（恐吓）

original: How about you let me in anyway? (25 Gold)
traduit: 你还是让我进去吧？（25金币）

original: Could you make an exception in my case? (Persuade)
traduit: 你能为我破一次例吗？（说服）

original: Why? What's going on?
traduit: 为什么？这是怎么了？

original: Hold and stand down.
traduit: 站住，退下。

original: If you want to get into Riften, use the North Gate. This one's closed.
traduit: 如果你想进裂谷城，从北门走。这里封闭了。

original: My orders are to tell the riff-raff to use the North Gate, that's it.
traduit: 我接到的命令就是让你们这群人渣走北门，就这样。

original: No. You can use the North Gate, or you can head to the next city.
traduit: 不行。要么走北门，要么去下个城市吧。

original: Keep it. Not worth going to prison over.
traduit: 得了吧。没必要进监狱。

original: That's a quick way to the executioner's block.
traduit: 这是通往刽子手的捷径。

original: That's the North Gate in case you forget.
traduit: 别忘了走北门。

original: That's far enough.
traduit: 这点不够。

original: If you want to enter Riften, use the North Gate. Otherwise, we have nothing to talk about.
traduit: 如果想进裂谷城，从北门走吧。否则我们没什么好谈的。

original: There's nothing else to discuss. Use the North Gate if you want to enter Riften.
traduit: 没什么好说的了，想进裂谷城就从北门走。

original: You can use the North Gate to enter the city, or you can hit the road. Your choice.
traduit: 要么从北门进城，要么就走。自己选。

original: It's a long way to the next city if you change your mind.
traduit: 如果你不打算进城了，到下个城市还有好长一段路。

original: Um, I don't know, why?
traduit: 呃，我不知道，为啥？

original: Three guards run into a bar, but the fourth one just ducks. Why?
traduit: 三个卫兵冲进了酒馆，但第四个躲过去了。为什么？

original: Fine, go ahead.
traduit: 好啊，来吧。

original: Okay, got another one for you.
traduit: 好吧，再给你讲一个。

original: I'm sorry lass, I... I can't...
traduit: 抱歉，姑娘，我……我不能……

original: Fight it, Brynjolf... he's taken control of you!
traduit: 战斗吧，布林乔夫……他把你控制住了！

original: Damn you, Mercer!
traduit: 墨瑟你这混蛋！

original: What's... what's happening... I can't stop myself.
traduit: 发……发生什么了……我控制不了自己。

original: Come, we must get to the Skull and destroy it.
traduit: 来吧，我们必须找到并破坏头骨。

original: Let's continue, we still have much to do.
traduit: 继续吧，还有很多事要做。

original: The Torpor should be in a tall bottle with dark liquid. If you find it, bring it to me.
traduit: 眠药是装在瓶子里的深色液体。找到就带给我。

original: The laboratory adjoins the library. I'm hoping we'll find a sample of the Torpor left undamaged.
traduit: 实验室和图书馆毗邻。但愿能找到完好无损的眠药样本。

original: If you'll check the shelves around the balcony, I'll check around the lower level.
traduit: 你去看看露台周围的架子，我在楼下看看。

original: This way... the library isn't far.
traduit: 这边走……图书馆就在前面。

original: We mustn't tarry... the Skull needs to be destroyed as soon as possible.
traduit: 我们不能等了……必须尽快摧毁头骨。

original: Once we get inside, all will become clear.
traduit: 等我们进去，一切都会清楚的。

original: I promise to answer all of your questions. Follow me.
traduit: 我保证会回答你的所有问题。跟我来。

original: This way, my daughter.
traduit: 这边走，孩子。

original: This way, my son.
traduit: 这边走，孩子。

original: If you change your mind, I'll be here.
traduit: 如果你想通了，就来这里找我。

original: Take your time. I understand your hesitation.
traduit: 没关系。你的犹豫可以理解。

original: What's wrong with the College?
traduit: 学院怎么了？

original: Look around you. Winterhold is in this state because of those damned mages.
traduit: 看看你四周吧。都是因为那些该死的法师，冬堡才会变成这样。

original: They sit up there in their tower, doing gods-know-what, and who watches over them?
traduit: 他们高坐在塔楼里，做的事只有天知道，还有谁能看得住他们？

original: The guards don't even dare go up there unless they've no choice.
traduit: 除非别无选择了，卫兵都是不敢上去的。

original: I do, and if you count yourself among their numbers then you've blood on your hands as well.
traduit: 我知道，如果你也算他们的一员，那你的双手也沾满了鲜血。

original: There's nothing left of Winterhold. Nothing!
traduit: 冬堡什么都没有了。都没有了！

original: Everyone knows it's the College's fault that the sea swallowed our city. Still they deny it, but we all know the truth.
traduit: 每个人都知道是学院的错才让大海吞噬了我们的城市。他们还在否认，但我们都知道真相。

original: You have a problem with the College?
traduit: 你对学院有意见吗？

original: It does. The College has caused enough problems; don't need you or anyone else adding to them.
traduit: 有。学院造成的问题已经够多了，不需要你或其他人在加入他们了。

original: If you're not here for the College, then you've little other reason to be in Winterhold at all.
traduit: 如果你不是来加入学院，那在冬堡也就没什么理由了。

original: Stay clear of that College, if you know what's good for you.
traduit: 想对自己好点，就远离那所学院。

original: Nothing but foul deeds behind those walls.
traduit: 那墙后面只有肮脏的勾当。

original: I'm here for the College.
traduit: 我是为学院而来的。

original: Should've known.
traduit: 我早就该知道。

original: Not that it matters anymore. No one bothers coming to Winterhold for any other reason.
traduit: 这已经不重要了。没人会为其他原因来冬堡了。

original: What's your business here in Winterhold?
traduit: 你来冬堡干什么？

original: Enchanting laboratory. (<Global=HDWindhelmEnchanting> gold)
traduit: 附魔实验室。（<Global=HDWindhelmEnchanting>金币）

original: Alchemy laboratory. (<Global=HDWindhelmAlchemy> gold)
traduit: 炼金实验室。（<Global=HDWindhelmAlchemy>金币）

original: Living room. (<Global=HDWindhelmLiving> gold)
traduit: 客厅。（<Global=HDWindhelmLiving>金币）

original: Kitchen furnishings. (<Global=HDWindhelmKitchen> gold)
traduit: 厨房家具。（<Global=HDWindhelmKitchen>金币）

original: It is? Well that's different.
traduit: 是吗？有些不一样啊。

original: He's in the inn. Look around. I'm sure you'll find him.
traduit: 他在旅馆里。四处看看，你就能找到了。

original: He was here, but he left. If you leave now, you can probably catch him.
traduit: 他来过这里，不过走了。如果你现在出发，也许能追上他。

original: Or, you can just wait here. He'll be back soon enough.
traduit: 或者你可以在这里等。他很快就会回来。

original: I tend to keep my patrons' privacy.
traduit: 我倾向于保护顾客的隐私。

original: Very good... Let's see what you have here.
traduit: 很好……看看你拿到什么了。

original: Interesting... They know more of our plans than I expected...
traduit: 有意思……他们对我们计划的掌握程度比我想的要多。

original: It would seem Fort Dunstad is in need of reinforcements... We'll make sure they won't be getting those...
traduit: 看来丹斯塔德堡需要增援……我们要确保他们拿不到这些……

original: One moment while I "correct" some of these documents... That should do it.
traduit: 等我“更正”一些文件内容……就行了。

original: Make sure those forged documents get to the Stormcloak commander in Dawnstar. It'll throw him off our trail, allowing us to maneuver more freely.
traduit: 确保这些伪造的文件送到晨星的风暴斗篷指挥官那里。这样他就会放松对我们的跟踪，这样就能更自由地行动了。

original: Good work! Let's see what you got.
traduit: 干得好！看看你拿到什么了。

original: Hmm... They know more of our plans than I thought... Not good...
traduit: 嗯……他们对咱们计划的掌握程度比我想的要多啊……不好办……

original: Oh, what's this? Fort Snowhawk is in need of reinforcements... We'll make sure they won't be getting those...
traduit: 哦，这是？雪鹰堡需要增援……我们得保证他们拿不到这些……

original: Give me a moment while I make a few, um, "corrections" to these reports... There we go.
traduit: 给我点时间，我要“更正”一下报告内容……好了。

original: Make sure those forged documents get to the Legate in Morthal. They should give them the wrong idea... and us the advantage.
traduit: 确保那些伪造文件送到莫萨尔副官那儿。他们应该会作出错误判断……这样我们就占据优势了。

original: His life is in danger. (Persuade)
traduit: 他有生命危险。（说服）

original: Yeah, sure it is. You don't fool me.
traduit: 是是是。你骗不了我。

original: The dragon of <Alias=DragonLair> is dead.
traduit: <Alias=DragonLair>的龙已经死了。

original: It's good to see the Blades fighting alongside the Dragonborn once again. To think we're treading in the footsteps of thousands of years past.
traduit: 很高兴能看到刀锋会再度与龙裔并肩作战。想想吧，我们正在踏上几千年前的足迹。

original: While you're out hunting, keep a sharp eye open for any dragon scales and bones you might find. I'd be interested in looking at them.
traduit: 当你外出狩猎时，留意看看可以发现的龙鳞和龙骨。我很有兴趣。

original: Good. The dragon's soul should be making you stronger. Come back another time, and we'll track down another one for you.
traduit: 好。龙魂可以让你变得更强大。下次再来，我们还能给你再找一头。

original: We're with you, Dragonborn.
traduit: 我们会跟随你，龙裔。

original: I'm not ready yet.
traduit: 我还没准备好。

original: Let me know when you are, then.
traduit: 到时候告诉我一声就行。

original: Tell them to meet me there.
traduit: 告诉他们到那儿找我会合。

original: Good luck, Dragonborn.
traduit: 祝你好运，龙裔。

original: Find any dragons to hunt?
traduit: 哪里发现可以猎杀的龙了吗？

original: I have. One of the old Akaviri records names a dragon living nearby. Shall we send the Blades to help you?
traduit: 找到了。一份古代阿卡维尔的记录里提到了生活在附近的一头龙。要不要派刀锋协助你？

original: Delphine mentioned you're studying dragon lairs.
traduit: 戴尔芬说你在研究龙巢。

original: I am. The Blades of the 2nd Era hunted down many dragons in their day, and they have records of where the beasts lived.
traduit: 没错。第二纪元的刀锋会在那个时代猎杀了很多龙，还保留了这些巨兽生活地点的记录。

original: Only you can truly defeat these monsters, Dragonborn, but you do not have to do so alone. The Blades can help you.
traduit: 只有你才能真正击败这些怪物，龙裔，但你不必孤军奋战。刀锋会可以帮你。

original: Just ask whenever you're ready to take on a dragon. We will send the Blades to help you fulfill your destiny.
traduit: 只要你说准备好讨伐巨龙。刀锋会就会派人帮你完成使命。

original: It's quiet for now, Dragonborn. Perhaps later we'll find where one of those serpents is hiding.
traduit: 现在很安静，龙裔。也许过一阵子就能再找到一头龙的藏身之处了。

original: Find any dragons to hunt?
traduit: 哪里发现可以猎杀的龙了吗？

original: You there. The Dragonborn wishes to give you the chance to join the lost guardians of Tamriel. The dragon slayers. The Blades.
traduit: 龙裔希望给你机会加入泰姆瑞尔失落的守护组织、龙族的屠杀者。刀锋会。

original: Do you wish to become a Blade?
traduit: 你希望成为刀锋吗？

original: Are you willing to trade away all claims and titles of your former life? To live here and devote yourself to protecting Tamriel from danger?
traduit: 你愿意放弃先前的所有权利和头衔，住在这里，保护泰姆瑞尔免于危难吗？

original: Then by my right as acting grandmaster, I name you a Blade, with all the privileges, rights, and burdens that brings. Godspeed.
traduit: 那么我以代理大宗师的名义，同意你成为刀锋，授予你相应的权利与义务。愿神灵保佑你。

original: I do.
traduit: 我愿意。

original: What we do here today, we do for our country! For all the true Nords of Skyrim!
traduit: 我们今天在这里所做的一切，都是为了我们的国家！为了天际所有真正的诺德人！

original: But make no mistake. What we do here today, we do for Skyrim and her people.
traduit: 但别搞错了。我们今天在此所做的一切，都是为了天际和她的人民。

original: By cutting out the disease of this rebellion, we will make this country whole again!
traduit: 只有根除这场叛乱。我们才能让这个国家重归完整！

original: Fear neither pain, nor darkness. For Sovngarde awaits those who die with weapons in their hands, and courage in their hearts.
traduit: 不要畏惧痛苦，不要畏惧黑暗。松加德正在等候那些手握武器，心怀勇气的人们。

original: But they are no match for Legionnaires. You are the best and the brightest warriors in Tamriel. Professional soldiers, fearless and devastating.
traduit: 但他们不是军团的对手。你们是泰姆瑞尔最优秀、最聪明的士兵，是无畏且强悍的职业军人。

original: The Emperor will be paying close attention to what happens here today. Men who distinguish themselves will be well rewarded.
traduit: 皇帝会密切关注今天的战事。表现突出者，奖赏丰厚。

original: And we have come this far because our cause is true. Because we fight as one. And because our hearts are bursting with anger!
traduit: 我们之所以能走到这一步，是因为我们的事业是正确的。因为我们齐心协力。因为我们的心充满了愤怒！

original: That message is this.
traduit: 这就是信息。

original: Any king who denies the Emperor will wake one morning to face the Legion staring down his gates.
traduit: 任何胆敢拒绝皇帝统治的国王都会在某天早上醒来时面对军团的围攻。

original: And on that day, we will confiscate his city, and restore the rule of law to his lands.
traduit: 那时候，我们会没收他的城市，重建他土地的法治。

original: The gods are watching. The spirits of our ancestors are stirring. And men under suns yet to dawn will be transformed by what we do here today.
traduit: 诸神在看着。我们祖先的灵魂也因之激动不已。而还未迎来曙光的人们将因我们此时此刻之所为而改变。

original: Because this is the end for them, the Stormcloaks will fight like cornered rats. They will be fierce and crafty.
traduit: 正因今天是他们的末日，风暴斗篷会像走投无路的老鼠一样战斗，会变得凶狠而狡猾。

original: But no! We are farmers! We are craftsmen! We are sons and daughters of shopkeepers, maid servants and soldiers!
traduit: 但是错了！我们是农民！我们是工匠！我们是店老板、仆从、士兵的儿女！

original: We are the sons and daughters of Skyrim!
traduit: 我们是天际的儿女！

original: This is the day we send a message to Ulfric Stormcloak and the rebel Jarls who support him.
traduit: 今天是我们向乌弗瑞克·风暴斗篷还有支持他的叛乱领主们传达信号的一天。

original: On this day, our enemy will know the fullness of our determination, the true depth of our anger, and the exalted righteousness of our cause.
traduit: 今天，敌人会领教我们决心有多坚定、我们的愤怒有多猛烈、我们的事业有多么崇高正义。

original: Ulfric thinks he can hide behind the walls of his castle. But we will fight our way in and drag him out through the rubble to face justice.
traduit: 乌弗瑞克觉得他能躲在城堡的墙后，但我们会不惜一切把他从瓦砾堆里拖出来接受审判。

original: They say that our cause is false and that we are nothing more than thieves, thugs and murderers!
traduit: 他们说我们的事业是错误的，我们只不过是小偷、暴徒、杀人犯！

original: This is an important day for the Empire and for the Legion. And for all of Skyrim.
traduit: 今天，对于帝国、对军团，对天际都是重要的一天。

original: We come to this moment carried by the sacrifices and courage of our fellows. Those who have fallen. And those still bearing the shields to our right.
traduit: 我们之所以走到这一步，是那些已经倒下的、还有依然守护在彼此身边的同胞们用牺牲和勇气换来的。

original: All right. It's time to deliver the final blow to the Stormcloak rebellion.
traduit: 好了。是时候给风暴斗篷叛乱最后一击了。

original: You have all fought bravely, and sacrificed much to bring us to this point.
traduit: 你们都很勇敢，我们牺牲了很多人才走到这一步。

original: Uuuuhhhnnnn... aaarrrghhh....
traduit: 唔呃呃呃呃……啊啊啊啊……

original: Ooohhhh, ahhhrrrghhhh... uuuuggghhh.
traduit: 哦，啊……唔呃，

original: Uhhh... (coughing, wheezing) ... ahhhh...
Uuuuhhhnnnn... it hurts...
traduit: 唔嗯……太疼了……

original: Aaaahhhhhrrrr.... the pain, somebody, stop... the pain...
traduit: 啊啊啊啊……疼啊，有人能，帮忙……止疼……

original: (coughing fit) Uuughhnnn...
traduit: （咳嗽发作）唔嗯……

original: Speak with Galmar. He'll size you up and see where we can best use your talents.
traduit: 去和加尔玛谈谈。他会对你作出评价。看看在哪里最能发挥你的才能。

original: If you know any true sons and daughters of Skyrim, tell them to head to Windhelm. Ulfric Stormcloak wants to see them.
traduit: 如果你知道哪里有真正的天际儿女，告诉他们去风舵城。乌弗瑞克·风暴斗篷想见见他们。

original: You need to go inside, little cub.
traduit: 你得进去了，小家伙。

original: Who are they, daddy? Where are they going?
traduit: 爸爸，他们是谁？他们要去哪儿？

original: Here's a dragon scale and a bone.
traduit: 这是一份龙鳞和龙骨。

original: Have you ever heard of the expression, "the scale of the Argonian that bit you?"
traduit: 你听说过那句话吗？“阿尔贡鳞片会咬人”。

original: No, I guess not. Well, the principle applies here. It's a potion, made from those dragon parts. Give it a try.
traduit: 好吧，你好像没听过。嗯，但这原理同样适用。这药水是用龙族的身体部分制成的。试试看吧。

original: What? Your heroic tale of locking yourself in the Ratway for years isn't enough?
traduit: 什么？你把自己锁在鼠道这么多年的光荣事迹还不够吗？

original: Come now. You did more than just survive all those years. Your evasion of the Thalmor would be useful for future Blades to study.
traduit: 别这样。你做的可不仅仅是活了这么多年。你躲避梭默的方法对未来的刀锋会很有帮助。

original: "I survived"?
traduit: “我还活着”？

original: I've been chronicling the recent history of the Blades. What would you like your entry to say?
traduit: 我一直在记录刀锋会最近的历史。你有啥想说的吗？

original: There's a difference?
traduit: 有区别吗？

original: Now, now my dear. I'm talking about academia, not politics.
traduit: 好了，亲爱的。我说的是学术界，与政治无关。

original: Esbern, if the Empire could even acknowledge the Blades existence, we'd all have reason to celebrate.
traduit: 伊思本，如果帝国还承认刀锋会的存在，我们就该烧高香了。

original: I've been writing some notes about all the Akaviri designs we've discovered. If only the Imperial Library could see my research.
traduit: 我一直在写关于我们发现的阿卡维尔设计的笔记。如果帝国图书馆能收录我的研究就好了。

original: You're right. Sorry to bring it up.
traduit: 你说得对。我不该提这事的。

original: The other Blades? No. Best not to think what the Thalmor do to their victims, my dear.
traduit: 其他的刀锋？不。最好不要去想梭默任何对待落到他们手里的受害者，亲爱的。

original: Do you ever think about them, Esbern? The others?
traduit: 你想到过他们吗，伊思本？其他人？

original: Well, I'm "not a scholar" of architecture. And that's that.
traduit: 好吧，那我不是建筑学方面的“学者”。这总行了吧。

original: Nonsense. Is a child who learns to read "not a scholar" of literature? Is a smith's apprentice "not a scholar" of blacksmithing?
traduit: 无稽之谈。一个学会阅读的孩子难道不是文学“学者”？铁匠的学徒就不是锻造“学者”？

original: I'm not a scholar, Esbern. How many times do I have to tell you?
traduit: 我不是学者，伊思本。我得和你说几次？

original: The architecture of this temple is marvelous. Have you ever seen stonework like this, Delphine?
traduit: 这座神殿的建筑真是不可思议。你见过这样的石雕吗，戴尔芬？

original: I need that dragon slaying blessing.
traduit: 我需要那个屠龙祝福。

original: "May the scales of the dragonkind splinter at the touch of your arrows and crack under the weight of your sword."
traduit: “愿你的箭矢和利刃破碎巨龙之鳞。”

original: That's all there is to it, Dragonborn. Good luck.
traduit: 就这样，龙裔。祝你好运。

original: Any advice for fighting dragons?
traduit: 有什么对付龙的建议吗？

original: You're in luck. There is a blessing the Blades used on the eve of battle. It's supposed to prepare the mind for slaying dragons.
traduit: 你走运了。刀锋会在战斗之前都会用一种祝福。是用来在屠龙前做好心理准备用的。

original: I doubt the blessing's effects last for very long, so ask whenever you're heading out, and I'll perform the proper rites.
traduit: 我也不知道祝福的效果能持续多久，所以需要的时候就问问我，我会为你举行合适的仪式。

original: Giving away your spiced wine, eh?
traduit: 要把香料酒白送人吗？

original: Just one bottle per customer. Except for the man who saved the festival. Here's a couple bottles for you.
traduit: 每位顾客限一瓶。除了那位拯救了节日的人。这几瓶是给你的。

original: Did you say free meat pies?
traduit: 你说有免费的肉馅饼？

original: I said "a free meat pie". As in one. Here's yours.
traduit: 我说的是“一个免费的肉馅饼”。就一个。这是你的。

original: Candy! Get your King Olaf's Festival candy!
traduit: 糖果！来领取你的奥拉夫国王节日糖果！

original: Tasty, sugary treats!
traduit: 甜点，美味的甜点！

original: Spiced Wine here. First cup is paid for by the college.
traduit: 香料酒。第一杯学院付账。

original: Get some Spiced Wine. A Festival Favorite.
traduit: 买些香料酒吧。节日最佳选择。

original: Meat Pies. Try one for free, come back for more. Get your meat pies.
traduit: 肉馅饼。免费试吃，吃一个想两个。来领肉馅饼了。

original: Can't have a meal without meat. Come and get some here.
traduit: 没有肉怎么下饭。来买点吧。

original: I've collected some of the Edda for you.
traduit: 我帮你找到一些《埃达》片段。

original: Wonderful. Soon we'll have the latest section of the Edda complete. Keep up the good work.
traduit: 太好了。我们很快就能完成《埃达》的最新部分了。再接再厉啊。

original: That's it! You've collected every last verse. I can't thank you enough. This deserves a special bonus.
traduit: 就是这样！你把诗句都集齐了。我真不知道该怎么感谢你。值得特别奖励啊。

original: Do you have a verse for the Poetic Edda?
traduit: 你这里有《诗歌埃达》的诗句吗？

original: I do. I've been working on mine for a while now.
traduit: 有。我已经写了一段时间了。

original: I suppose Giraud sent you for it? I was still trying to get the wording right but here it is.
traduit: 是吉劳德派你来的吧？我还在斟酌措辞，但给你吧。

original: Here you are. Always good to see a fellow bard. Tell Giraud I said hello.
traduit: 给你。能够见到诗人同行是好事。代我向吉劳德问好。

original: This is part of me. Guard it with your life.
traduit: 这是我的那部分。要好好守护它啊。

original: I've got it right here. Just don't read it, it's not very good.
traduit: 我的就在这儿。先别读，还没写得很好。

original: Come back to me if you change your mind.
traduit: 如果你改变主意，就再来找我。

original: Wonderful. Just speak to various bards outside of the college, get there parts of the Poetic Edda and return them here to me.
traduit: 太好了。和学院外的吟游诗人谈谈，找到《诗歌埃达》的片段，然后拿来给我。

original: Is the Edda complete now that you have King Olaf's Verse?
traduit: 现在你有了奥拉夫之诗，那《埃达》完成了？

original: The Poetic Edda is never truly complete. As a living history of Skyrim we Bards continually add parts to it.
traduit: 《诗歌埃达》永远不会真正完成。作为天际活的历史，我们吟游诗人会不断添加内容。

original: In fact, If you collected parts of the Edda from any Bard you encountered in your travels I would be willing to pay you for them.
traduit: 其实，如果你能在旅途中找其他吟游诗人收集《埃达》的片段，我愿意付钱给你。

original: Come in and shut the door.
traduit: 进来，把门关上。

original: Welcome to Bits and Pieces. I'm sure you'll find what you need here.
traduit: 欢迎来到零珠碎玉。这里会有你想要的。

original: Your path has brought you to the finest fletcher in all the land.
traduit: 你现在所在的地方，可是这片大地上最好的箭矢店。

original: Feel free to look around. We have a fine selection of herbs here at Angela's Aromatics.
traduit: 请随意看看。安吉灵的芳香有各种精选香草。

original: Welcome to the Winking Skeever. Take a load off and enjoy the atmosphere.
traduit: 欢迎来到眨眼恶鼠。放松一下，享受这里的氛围吧。

original: You see, all you need is a bit of spirit and any song can be made into a classic.
traduit: 明白了吧，你们所需要的只是一点精神，任何歌曲都能成为经典。

original: That's all for today. You're dismissed.
traduit: 今天就到这里。下课吧。

original: This time let's try "The Age of Aggression". I will demonstrate for the class.
traduit: 这次我们来看看“好战年代”。我来为同学们示范一下。

original: This time let's try "The Age of Oppression". I will demonstrate for the class.
traduit: 这次我们来看看“压迫年代”。我来为同学们示范一下。

original: Very good, Aia. Class, observe her finger movements. Let's try a few more pieces.
traduit: 很好，艾雅。同学们，观察她的手指动作。我们再来几段。

original: Yes, Dean Inge.
traduit: 是，因格院长。

original: Now, you try it Aia
traduit: 现在艾雅来试试。

original: Let's try a lute piece. Follow along...
traduit: 来试试演奏一段鲁特琴。跟上了……

original: Even while making parts up.
traduit: 即使是在编造部分的时候。

original: Read carefully. You will see there are ways to stay true to the essence, Illdi.
traduit: 仔细阅读。你会发现很多方法可以保存本质，伊尔迪。

original: Can we really just make things up? It doesn't seem right.
traduit: 我们真的能编造故事吗？这似乎不妥。

original: Seems like most of these are nine parts fiction.
traduit: 看起来大部分都是虚构的。

original: A good story is nine parts truth and one part fiction.
traduit: 好的故事，九分真实，一分虚构。

original: Yes, Dean. Thank you.
traduit: 是，院长。谢谢你。

original: Your performance has been excellent lately Aia. You still need training but one day you will make an adequate singer.
traduit: 艾雅，你最近的表现很好。你还需要继续训练，但终有一天你会成为一名合格的歌手。

original: Have it your way, then.
traduit: 那就随你便吧。

original: Aia. You're so mean. I don't think he means anything by it.
traduit: 艾雅。别太吝啬了。我不觉得他有什么意思。

original: You should tell him to mind his own business.
traduit: 你应该告诉他管好自己。

original: Ataf keeps making eyes at me.
traduit: 阿塔夫一直在对我暗送秋波。

original: I think someone has a crush on Illdi.
traduit: 我觉得有人是爱上伊尔迪了吧。

original: I think Illdi's better than Dean Pantea actually knows. She just gets intimidated when she's in class and can't sing.
traduit: 我觉得伊尔迪比潘提亚院长所知道的还要好。她只是在课堂上有些害怕，所以唱不出来。

original: I still don't have my Gleda back.
traduit: 我的格丽达还没回来。

original: Don't come back until you have the ring.
traduit: 没拿到戒指就别回来。

original: The temple is still not clean. Get to it.
traduit: 神殿还没整理干净。赶快收拾。

original: You can't have the ring back! You made a commitment!
traduit: 你还没把戒指拿回来！你明明答应过！

original: Once you leave the party you can't just come back.
traduit: 一旦你离开派对，就再也回不来了。

original: Lets see how tough you are without Sam keeping an eye on you.
traduit: 看看没了山姆的注视，你能有多坚强。

original: No Sam, no protection. Time to die.
traduit: 没了山姆，没了保护。死期就到了。

original: Clavicus sent you didn't he?
traduit: 是卡拉威库斯派你来的？

original: You can't have the Axe! It's all I have left now!
traduit: 你不能拿走斧头！我现在只剩这个了！

original: We should go get the axe.
traduit: 我们得拿到斧头。

original: Let's get the axe and be done with this.
traduit: 拿走斧头，赶紧解决。

original: Now that guy was nuts.
traduit: 那家伙疯了。

original: Don't bother, Clavicus won't talk to me.
traduit: 免了，卡拉威库斯不会跟我说话的。

original: Wait a second, there's another option here.
traduit: 稍等。还有别的选择。

original: I have a feeling I'm not going to like what happens when we get back to Clavicus.
traduit: 我有一种感觉，当我们回去找卡拉威库斯的时候，会有不好的事发生。

original: All this just to kill me Clavicus?
traduit: 卡拉威库斯，你就这么想杀我？

original: You're worth putting in the extra effort for, pooch.
traduit: 你这人确实值得费点工夫，笨狗。

original: I remember that axe.
traduit: 我记得那把斧子。

original: And I was so close to being rid of you.
traduit: 我差点就摆脱你了。

original: So what's the story behind the Rueful Axe.
traduit: 所以，悔恨之斧有什么故事？

original: One of Clavicus's little jests. A wizard named Sebastian Lort had a daughter who worshiped Hircine.
traduit: 卡拉威库斯的小玩笑之一。有个叫赛巴斯蒂安·洛特的巫师，他女儿崇拜海尔辛。

original: When the daughter became a werewolf it drove Sebastian over the edge. He couldn't stand to see his little girl take on such a bestial form.
traduit: 当他女儿变成狼人的时候，赛巴斯蒂安快崩溃了。他不忍心看女儿变成野兽。

original: The wizard wished for the ability to end his daughter's curse.
traduit: 巫师希望得到解除自己女儿诅咒的能力。

original: Clavicus gave him an axe.
traduit: 卡拉威库斯就给了他一把斧头。

original: I think I want to keep the axe.
traduit: 我想我还是留着斧头吧。

original: The axe isn't the only item dear old Clavicus has.
traduit: 亲爱的老卡拉威库斯不止这一件东西。

original: Give him the Rueful Axe and once we're reunited the Masque of Clavicus Vile will be yours.
traduit: 把悔恨之斧还给他，我们团聚之后，卡拉威库斯·维尔的面具就归你了。

original: Look along the east coast. The boat will be there.
traduit: 沿着东海岸走。船就在那里。

original: It would be best if we spoke little until you've completed your task.
traduit: 在你完成任务之前，咱们还是少说话。

original: No! I'm losing the binding.
traduit: 不！我失去绑定了。

original: Stop the intruder!
traduit: 阻止入侵者！

original: Come back to me if you find anything.
traduit: 有什么发现及时回来找我。

original: You're interrupting the performance.
traduit: 你在打断演出。

original: Please don't leave. You must help me.
traduit: 请不要离开。你一定得帮我。

original: I'll meet you outside of town.
traduit: 我到城外和你碰头。

original: Hey, don't you want to make this exchange?
traduit: 嘿，你不打算交换了吗？

original: Do you worship Talos?
traduit: 你信仰塔洛斯吗？

original: No but my husband Torygg would want a proper burial and this is the way Nords are buried in Skyrim.
traduit: 不，但我的丈夫托依格想要一个正式的天际诺德人拥有的葬礼。

original: I'm sorry, I can't right now.
traduit: 对不起，我现在办不到。

original: That's all right. Return to me if you change your mind though.
traduit: 没关系。如果改主意了可以来找我。

original: I would be honored to help.
traduit: 我很荣幸能够帮上忙。

original: Thank you. It would mean a lot to me.
traduit: 谢谢。这对我来说意义重大。

original: What can I do for you, Jarl?
traduit: 有什么可以帮上忙的吗，领主？

original: Falk told me what you did for us at Wolfskull cave. He says you're someone we can trust.
traduit: 佛可告诉我，你在狼头骨洞穴为我们做了很多。他说你值得信赖。

original: As you may know Talos worship is outlawed in the Empire.
traduit: 你可能知道，在帝国信仰塔洛斯是非法的。

original: When we buried my husband I made offerings to all the gods... except Talos.
traduit: 当我们安葬我丈夫时，我向诸神献祭……唯独缺了塔洛斯。

original: I would like you to take an item of his, a warhorn handed down from his father, and place it at a Shrine of Talos.
traduit: 我想让你拿一件他的东西，这是他父亲传下来的战争号角，把它放在塔洛斯的祭坛里。

original: Yes, when we buried my husband I wasn't able to make an offering to Talos.
traduit: 是的，我们安葬我丈夫时我没能向塔洛斯献祭。

original: I was hoping you would to take something of his, a warhorn handed down from his father, and place it at a Shrine of Talos.
traduit: 我希望你拿着他父亲传给他的战争号角，放到塔洛斯的祭坛里。

original: You mentioned a personal task earlier.
traduit: 你之前提过有件私事。

original: I've placed the horn at the shrine.
traduit: 我把号角放在祭坛上了。

original: Falk said I could count on you.
traduit: 佛可说可以指望你。

original: You have more than earned the right to purchase property and take the next step to becoming a Thane.
traduit: 你为自己赢得了购买房产的权利，再进一步还能成为武卫。

original: Speak to Falk when you have the funds. And thank you.
traduit: 等你凑足钱就去找佛可吧。谢谢你。

original: There's something... personal... I was hoping you would do for me.
traduit: 有些……私事……我想请你帮帮忙。

original: We need coin, Ranmir, and you're not bringing home any.
traduit: 我们需要钱，兰米尔，你从没赚过钱。

original: And you'd have me do what, join the College and prance about casting spells all day?
traduit: 你想让我怎么做？加入学院，然后成天欢天喜地地念咒语吗？

original: I have responsibilities to attend to. We'll continue this discussion some other time.
traduit: 我有责任去处理。我们改天再继续讨论吧。

original: That's all I ask. With your help, we have a chance to make a better life for ourselves here. For that, I thank you.
traduit: 这是我唯一的请求。有了你的帮助，我们就有机会在这里为自己创造更好的生活了。为此我深表感谢。

original: You've seen how we live -- cramped alleys, run-down buildings, few guard patrols. Even the name "Gray Quarter" is an insult.
traduit: 你也看到了我们生活的环境了——狭窄的陋巷、破败的建筑、很少有卫兵巡逻保护。就连“灰民区”这个名字都是在羞辱我们。

original: You're a war hero, Brunwulf. Ulfric will listen to you.
traduit: 布伦武夫，您是位战争英雄。乌弗瑞克会听你的。

original: Have you located any Words of Power?
traduit: 你找到新的力量之语了吗？

original: We have felt the whisper of a Word. Give me your map, and I will show you where its echo can be found.
traduit: 我们感受到了一段力量之语。把你的地图给我，我来告诉你上哪里去找。

original: I'd like to learn more about the Voice.
traduit: 我想了解更多吼声。

original: You have learned so much already, Dragonborn. Growing your gift too quickly would be dangerous.
traduit: 你已经学了很多了，龙裔。依靠天赋过快成长是祸非福。

original: But there are many Words of Power in Skyrim, carved in the Dragon tongue. Even from here, we can feel the Thu'um resonate from them.
traduit: 但在天际有很多用龙语雕刻的“力量之语”。即使在这里，我们也能从这些碑刻上感受吐'目的共鸣。

original: Finding these lost Words would be a sufficient test, to temper your abilities with experience. Ask when you are ready to search.
traduit: 寻找这些遗失的词语会是一种充分锻炼你能力和经验的试炼。等你准备好探索的时候，再来问我。

original: There is only silence right now. Perhaps later we will hear one of the lost Words.
traduit: 现在一片寂静。也许过一阵子我们就能听到其中一个失落的力量之语了。

original: Have you located any Words of Power?
traduit: 你找到新的力量之语了吗？

original: I'll speak to Ulfric soon, but I make no promises that I can change his mind.
traduit: 我会尽快和乌弗瑞克谈谈，但我没法保证让他回心转意。

original: It's not that simple. Ulfric wants a Skyrim for the Nords. He doesn't trust what he calls outsiders.
traduit: 事情没那么简单。乌弗瑞克想要一个诺德人的天际，他不相信他口中的外来者。

original: General Tullius, over here!
traduit: 图留斯将军，这边！

original: Rare trinkets and the finest oddities from Morrowind!
traduit: 来自晨风的稀有饰品和上好珍宝！

original: Gems, potions, exotic ingredients... I have them all!
traduit: 宝石、药水、奇特材料……应有尽有！

original: The fairest prices and the highest quality in Skyrim!
traduit: 全天际最公道的价格和最硬的质量！

original: Beautiful baubles and gleaming gemstones over here!
traduit: 漂亮的小饰品和闪闪的宝石！

original: Jewelry with legendary Argonian craftsmanship!
traduit: 传奇的阿尔贡工艺珠宝！

original: Buying and selling fine jewelry here!
traduit: 要买好珠宝来这里了！

original: Fresh meats and produce! Get them before they're gone!
traduit: 新鲜的肉和农产！手慢买不到哦！

original: All meats guaranteed clean and free from Rockjoint!
traduit: 干净卫生的好肉，绝对没有关节石化病！

original: Vegetables as crisp as a winter's morning!
traduit: 冬天早晨一样脆的蔬菜！

original: Looking to stay alive? Why take a chance?
traduit: 想要活命？干嘛不来看看？

original: Buy some armor and live to tell about it!
traduit: 买点护甲，然后活着告诉别人！

original: Protect yourself right... buy armor from Grelka.
traduit: 保护好你自己……那就买些格瑞卡的护甲。

original: Inkpot. Stone. Bucket. Book. Knife.
traduit: 墨水瓶。石头。桶。书。小刀。

original: Ha ha ha ha! No! Never find me!
traduit: 哈哈哈哈！绝对找不到我！

original: Bucket. Knife. Book. Inkpot. Stone. No, no, no.
traduit: 桶。小刀。书。墨水瓶。石头。不，不，不。

original: Knife. Yes. Book. Yes. Bucket. Yes. Inkpot? No.
traduit: 小刀。在。书。在。桶。在。墨水瓶？不见了。

original: Genuine Falmerblood Elixir for sale! Live for thousands of years... see into other people's thoughts!
traduit: 货真价实的伐莫血灵药！喝了以后长生不老……窥视别人真实想法！

original: Learn a library's worth of knowledge in moments or grow back that missing limb with my genuine Falmerblood Elixir!
traduit: 一瞬间学到成堆知识，断手断脚喝了就长！

original: Don't miss out... purchase a bottle of my genuine Falmerblood Elixir! Only 20 septims each!
traduit: 走过路过别错过……买一瓶伐莫血灵药吧！一瓶才卖二十塞普汀！

original: Make love like a sabercat or crush your enemies to dust like a giant! Only a mere 20 gold coins and all this could be yours!
traduit: 做爱持久直逼剑齿虎，摧枯拉朽赛过巨人！只要二十金币，一切都属于你了！

original: Why are you still here? You're supposed to be at Korvanjund, proving Galmar right, or proving him wrong.
traduit: 怎么还在这儿？去科万琼德，见证加尔玛说的是对是错。

original: I believe the Legate gave you an order. Why are you standing around here flapping your jaw? Move out!
traduit: 副官应该给你下令了。为什么还在这里废话？快去！

original: You were right about this place. And about Mauhulakh.
traduit: 你对这地方和莫胡拉克的看法是对的。

original: This was worth coming back for.
traduit: 回来是值得的。

original: Urog is a good learner. I'm glad I have the chance to teach her. Makes me not miss the woods as much.
traduit: 沃格很好学。我很高兴有机会教她。这样我就不会那么怀念森林了。

original: Urog and I still hunt a lot, so it's not like I'm cooped up in the longhouse.
traduit: 我和沃格常去打猎，所以我不会被关在长屋里。

original: By all I hold sacred... that's a Shout! Like the Graybeards on their mountain!
traduit: 我的天啊……是龙吼！就像山上的灰胡子一样！

original: By the gods! What manner of power is that?
traduit: 神啊！这是什么力量？

original: The Thu'um! He summons the Thu'um!
traduit: 是吐'目！他召唤了吐'目！

original: The Thu'um! She summons the Thu'um!
traduit: 是吐'目！她召唤了吐'目！

original: It is the power of old! The Voice of the Dragonborn!
traduit: 那是古老的力量！龙裔的吼声！

original: Try not to?
traduit: 尽量别被抓好么？

original: But I do realize it's sometimes not that easy. You may want to make a statement, or a contract may require a public killing.
traduit: 但我也知道，有时候确实不容易跑掉，或者契约有公开杀人的需求。

original: Murder is, obviously, a very serious crime, and a very high bounty will be put on your head in the hold where the act was committed.
traduit: 很明显，谋杀是重罪，你会因此在案发领地挂一份高额赏金。

original: You can run, obviously, but you'll still have a price on your head. If a guard attacks, you can attempt to yield by sheathing your weapon.
traduit: 你当然可以选择逃跑，但还会被悬赏。如果有卫兵要攻击你，你可以试着把武器收起来表示投降。

original: If the guard accepts, you can serve your time in a cell, or pay your bounty. We've all gone through it. We do what we must to survive.
traduit: 如果卫兵接受了，那你就得在牢房里服刑，或者支付赏金。我们都经历过。为了生存，在所难免么。

original: But, there is another option. Some members of the Thieves Guild in Riften can get their bounties... erased. For a price. Something to think about.
traduit: 但是，还有另一个选择。裂谷城盗贼公会的某些成员可以把悬赏……抹去。花些钱就行。还是值得考虑考虑的。

original: What if I get caught killing someone?
traduit: 如果我杀了人被抓了怎么办？

original: You're with the College?
traduit: 你是学院的人？

original: No. Gods no, not for years.
traduit: 不是。当然不是，早几年前就不是了。

original: I left Winterhold for some time, and returned to stay here at the inn.
traduit: 我离开过冬堡一段时间，回来就住进旅店了。

original: I still have research that keeps me busy, and being here in Winterhold ensures I have access to former colleagues.
traduit: 我还有些研究要忙，来冬堡能让我接触到以前的同事。

original: Why would you live here at the inn?
traduit: 你为什么住在旅店里？

original: Talos watch over you.
traduit: 塔洛斯注视着你。

original: Keep your brother, and he'll keep you.
traduit: 保护兄弟，兄弟也会保护你。

original: As you were.
traduit: 随意吧。

original: Go on, get out of here.
traduit: 走吧，离开这儿。

original: Dismissed.
traduit: 解散。

original: You're dismissed.
traduit: 解散吧。

original: I've defeated the guardian spirits.
traduit: 我已经打败了全部的守护灵。

original: You do Kyne proud. Only one challenge remains. Go and defeat the troll champion.
traduit: 凯娜为你骄傲。现在就剩下一个挑战了。去打败巨魔勇士。

original: Then you finally know what it means to be a true hunter, in the Nord way.
traduit: 然后你就能体会到，诺德传统的真正猎人意味着什么。

original: For this you have earned the Blessing of Kyne, and can count me as a friend.
traduit: 由此，你获得了凯娜的祝福，也可以把我当作你的朋友。

original: I've defeated the guardian troll.
traduit: 我击败了巨魔守护者。

original: I've defeated the guardians.
traduit: 我打败了守护灵。

original: Maybe you're not so soft, after all. Now you're ready for a real challenge.
traduit: 看来你没有那么软弱啊。现在应该准备迎接真正的挑战了。

original: I'll anoint you with the symbol of the Bear, the Sabrecat and the Mammoth. Tread carefully, these are mighty beasts.
traduit: 我会给你涂上熊、剑齿虎和猛犸的象征。小心点，这都是很强大的野兽。

original: The guardian spirits of Bear, Mammoth and Sabre Cat await you. Return when they are defeated.
traduit: 熊、猛犸和剑齿虎的守护灵在等待你。等打败它们再回来。

original: What should I do now?
traduit: 我现在该做什么？

original: Kyne's guardian troll awaits you. Complete this trial and you'll have proven yourself a true hunter.
traduit: 凯娜的巨魔守护灵正在等你。完成试炼，就能证明自己是个真正的猎人。

original: Yol.
traduit: 约。

original: In your tongue, the Word simply means "Fire." It is change given form. Power at its most primal.
traduit: 在你们的语言里，就是“火”的意思。一种变换无常的形态。最本源的力量。

original: That is the true meaning of "Yol." Suleyk. Power. You have it, as do all dov. But power is inert without action and choice.
traduit: 这就是“约”的真正含义。苏勒耶。力量。你和都瓦都拥有。但如果没有行动和选择，力量就是惰性的。

original: Think of this as the fire builds in your su'um, in your breath. Su'um ahrk morah. What will you burn? What will you spare?
traduit: 把这个想象成你苏'目，吐息中的火焰吧。苏'目 哈克 摩拉。你想烧毁什么？又想宽恕什么？

original: Feim.
traduit: 费姆。

original: "Fade" in your tongue. Mortals have greater affinity for this Word than the dov. Everything mortal fades away in time, but the spirit remains.
traduit: 在你们的语言里就是“凋零”。凡人比都瓦更加亲和这个词。一切凡人都会随时间而消逝，但精神却可以永存。

original: Ponder the meaning of spirit. Unslaad zii. Where mortal flesh may wither and die, the spirit endures.
traduit: 思考精神的含义吧。安斯拉德 兹。凡人肉体终会枯萎消亡，但精神却可永存。

original: That is "Feim." Let that meaning fill you. Su'um ahrk morah. You will find that your spirit will give you more strength.
traduit: 这就是“费姆”。将它的含义灌注全身。苏'目 哈克 摩拉。你会发现精神能带给你更多力量。

original: Fus.
traduit: 伏斯。

original: It is called "Force" in your tongue. But as you push the world, so does the world push back.
traduit: 在你们的语言里就是“力量”的意思。但当你推动世界，世界也会反推向你。

original: Think of the way force may be applied effortlessly. Imagine but a whisper pushing aside all in its path.
traduit: 想象一下轻松用力的方式。只不过是一声低语，把阻挡的一切推开。

original: That is "Fus." Let its meaning fill you. Su'um ahrk morah. You will push the world harder than it pushes back.
traduit: 这就是“伏斯”。让它的含义灌注全身。苏'目 哈克 摩拉。你所作用之力将超过反推之力。

original: I wish to meditate on a Word of Power.
traduit: 我想冥想一种力量之语。

original: Which calls to you, Dovahkiin? Fus, Feim, or Yol?
traduit: 是什么在呼唤你呢，都瓦克因？伏斯，费姆，还是约？

original: You're the Master of the Greybeards. Do others come here to train?
traduit: 既然你是灰胡子的老师。那其他人会到这里来修炼吗？

original: I have taught the Way of the Voice for centuries and the Thu'um since long before that.
traduit: 我从很早就开始教导吼声之道和吐'目了，很多个世纪了。

original: But no, Dovahkiin. Others do not come here to train anymore. Saraan. You are the first in over a hundred years.
traduit: 但是，没有，都瓦克因。其他人不会来这里训练。萨兰。你是这一百年来的第一个。

original: I meditate on the Rotmulaag - the Words of Power. I counsel in their use. It is enough for me.
traduit: 我在冥想罗姆拉格——力量之语。我会指导如何使用。这就足够了。

original: I've found the ice wraith teeth.
traduit: 我找到了冰怒灵的牙。

original: Any idea where I can find some ice wraiths?
traduit: 你知道哪里有冰怒灵吗？

original: Well, I'd be careful if I were you. I hear the Nords hunt them for some kind of initiation rite and not all of them end up victorious.
traduit: 哎，如果我是你，我会小心点的。我听说诺德人会为了某种成年礼猎杀它们，但不是人人都能活下来。

original: The last traveler that traded me some said he found them at a place called Ancient's Ascent.
traduit: 上一次和我交易的旅行者说是在远古坡道找到的。

original: Careful though, rumor has it a dragon makes its home there.
traduit: 但是要小心，据说有龙在那里安家了。

original: Perfect, just perfect! These should help keep my stock fresh for quite a while.
traduit: 太好了，太好了！这些应该就能让我的货物保持新鲜了。

original: And, as promised, here's my trade. Hope you like it.
traduit: 还有，这是说好的报酬。希望你喜欢。

original: Would these do?
traduit: 这些够用吗？

original: Not really interested.
traduit: 真的没兴趣。

original: Oh! Well if you change your mind, come back and see me.
traduit: 哦！如果你改主意了，就回来找我吧。

original: Okay, I'll find some.
traduit: 好吧，我去找。

original: Thanks, I was actually worried I'd run out.
traduit: 谢谢，我还担心会用完了呢。

original: How do you keep this food so fresh?
traduit: 你是怎么让食物这么新鲜的？

original: I picked up a trick from a butcher in Elinhir, a small town over the border in Hammerfell.
traduit: 落锤边境上有个叫艾琳赫尔的小镇，我从那儿的屠夫手里学了这招。

original: He showed me a way to grind up ice wraith teeth and use it as a preservative. Keeps everything cold and fresh, but only for a limited time.
traduit: 他教给我一种磨碎冰怒灵牙齿的方法。拿它做防腐剂能够在一段时间内保持食物凉爽新鲜。

original: I'm always looking to replenish my supply, so if you ever come across five of them, I'd be more than happy to take them off your hands.
traduit: 我一直在寻找补给，所以如果你能拿到五个的话，我很乐意从你手里收购。

original: I found a book that might help your search.
traduit: 我找到了一本书，可能对你的搜寻有帮助。

original: Yes... yes. This is it! I don't know how you found this stranger, but you've obviously succeeded where I had failed.
traduit: 对……对。就是它！我不知道你是怎么找到这个的，但你显然是在我失败的地方成功了。

original: Please, let me offer you this key. It unlocks my strongbox under my stand in the marketplace. Help yourself to anything inside.
traduit: 请收下这把钥匙。它能打开我在市场摊位的保险柜。里面的东西请随便取用。

original: I think this book may answer your questions.
traduit: 我觉得这本书能回答你的问题。

original: Why were you searching in Skyrim?
traduit: 你为什么要在天际找？

original: I learned that a matron who had served for House Telvanni had escaped Morrowind during the Accession War.
traduit: 我得知有个曾在泰瓦尼家族服侍过的女佣在“进驻战争”期间逃离了晨风。

original: Records showed her buying passage aboard a sailing vessel named "The Pride of Tel Vos," but that's where the trail ran cold.
traduit: 有记录显示，她买了一艘名叫“泰尔·沃斯荣耀号”的船，但线索就这么断了。

original: I spent years looking for what became of the ship, but I ended up empty-handed.
traduit: 我花了好几年寻找这艘船的下落，但却空手而归。

original: I'll keep an eye open.
traduit: 我会留意的。

original: Do you have any clues about your past?
traduit: 你对自己的过去有什么线索吗？

original: Just one. I know when I was found by my Argonian father, I was wrapped in a blanket bearing the symbol of House Telvanni.
traduit: 只有一条。我知道我被我阿尔贡族父亲发现时，身上裹着的毯子上有泰瓦尼家族的标志。

original: It was one of the great houses in Morrowind long ago. Whether that means I was one of them or not, I'm uncertain.
traduit: 那是晨风一个很古老的大家族。但是否意味着我是其中一员，我也不确定。

original: If you come across anything in your travels that might provide me with the answers I'm looking for, I'd be grateful.
traduit: 如果你在旅途中遇到什么东西，能给我提供想要的答案，我会非常感激的。

original: By the gods! It... it can't be!
traduit: 神啊！这……不可能！

original: I'll be glad when this beast is gone from here. Do whatever it is you need to do with it, Dragonborn.
traduit: 这头野兽还是赶紧离开得好。龙裔，做你想做的事吧。

original: Farengar, very bad idea. Even for you.
traduit: 法仁加，这对你来说也是个馊主意。

original: Farengar! Enough, fool!
traduit: 法仁加！够了，笨蛋！

original: Joor mey! What are you doing back there?
traduit: 约尔 梅！你在后面做什么？

original: Surely you wouldn't miss a few scales... or a small amount of blood...
traduit: 你不会介意少几片鳞……或者几滴血吧……

original: I assure you, you will not even notice me. Most of them are hardly painful at all to a large dragon such as yourself.
traduit: 我向你保证，你不会感觉到我在干什么。对于你这样的巨龙，我的操作大部分一点都不疼。

original: I would be most appreciative if you would permit me to perform some, ah, tests on you. Purely in the interests of the advancement of knowledge.
traduit: 如果你能允许我在你身上做些测试，那真是不胜感激。这纯粹是为了促进知识发展。

original: Incredible! Uh... sir, you have no idea how long I have waited for such an opportunity!
traduit: 不可思议！啊……先生，你不知道我等这个机会多久了！

original: Begone, mage. Do not test my promise to the Dovahkiin.
traduit: 走开，法师。不要考验我对都瓦克因的承诺。

original: You're either the bravest person I've ever met, or the biggest fool.
traduit: 你是我见过最勇敢的人，要么就是最蠢的傻子。

original: Faas nu, zini dein ruthi ahst vaal.
traduit: 法斯 努，兹尼 戴恩 如斯 阿斯特 瓦尔。

original: By all the gods...
traduit: 众神在上……

original: May Kynareth guard you while you pass through her realm!
traduit: 愿凯娜瑞丝在你经过她的领域时保佑你！

original: Carry on, soldier. This is all part of the Dragonborn's plan.
traduit: 继续吧，士兵。这是龙裔计划的一部分。
