original: I admit, I doubted you, but no more. You've made a dragon submit to your will. A feat to rival the legendary Olaf One-Eye! What glory!
traduit: 我承认，我怀疑过你能否成功，但以后不会了。你让巨龙臣服于自己的意志。这份荣耀直追当年传奇的“独眼”奥拉夫！

original: This is a local favorite and one of the first songs I ever learned. Ragnar the Red.
traduit: 这是当地人的最爱，也是我学到的第一首歌。“红发”拉格纳。

original: This one's a favorite of mine. A legend we all know and love...
traduit: 这是我个人最喜欢的一首。一个喜闻乐见的传说……

original: This is an ode to Skyrim's truest sons and daughters... the Stormcloaks.
traduit: 这首歌献给真正的天际儿女……风暴斗篷。

original: This is an ode to Skyrim's staunch protectors... the Imperials.
traduit: 这首歌献给天际坚定的保护者……帝国军团。

original: This next song goes out to the Dragonborn. The savior of Skyrim.
traduit: 下一首歌要献给天际的救世主，龙裔。

original: Just checking on our take. How are we doing?
traduit: 只是想看看咱们的收入。最近如何？

original: It's as if the merchandise and coin are simply falling from the sky.
traduit: 货和钱就像从天上掉下来一样。

original: Vex and Delvin are having to turn clients away at this point, it's almost impossible to keep up.
traduit: 小烦和戴尔文现在都得拒绝一些客户了，简直供不应求。

original: Don't forget to check your tribute chest once in a while. As Guild Master you're getting a significant cut of the spoils.
traduit: 别忘了偶尔检查一下你的分红箱。身为公会大师收到的红利还是很可观的。

original: How's the Guild doing?
traduit: 公会进展怎样？

original: Take a good look around you! Have you ever see the Guild in such a prosperous state?
traduit: 好好看看周围吧！有见过公会如此盛况吗？

original: With Mercer Frey gone and our influence present in all of Skyrim's cities, the Guild's accumulating wealth faster than we can spend it.
traduit: 墨瑟·弗雷死了，我们在天际各城都有影响力，公会积累财富的速度比咱们花钱的速度快得多。

original: I couldn't be more proud to be a part of the Thieves Guild, or its new Guild Master.
traduit: 无论是成为盗贼公会的一员，还是为了新任公会大师，都很令我自豪。

original: With Mercer Frey gone and our influence spreading across Skyrim, the Guild's earned a new level of respect it hasn't seen in decades.
traduit: 墨瑟·弗雷死了，我们在天际影响也扩大了，公会赢得了几十年来未有过的尊重。

original: About the secrecy of the Nightingales...
traduit: 关于夜莺的秘密……

original: I think by now, most within the Guild are well aware of what transpired between Mercer Frey and ourselves.
traduit: 我想公会里大多数人都知道我们和墨瑟·弗雷之间发生了什么。

original: The notion that the Nightingales are a fictive group has long since passed.
traduit: 夜莺是虚构团体的观念早已成为过去。

original: If you wish to wear your Nightingale Armor within the Guild, I'm certain that no one would give it a second thought.
traduit: 就算你想在公会里穿上夜莺的护甲，也不会有人在意的。

original: How have things been now that Mercer's gone?
traduit: 墨瑟死了以后情况如何？

original: I'm feeling a sense of inner peace... something I haven't felt in a very long time.
traduit: 我感到内心很平静……我已经很久没有过这种感觉了。

original: Instead of being clouded with thoughts of revenge and retribution, I feel only serenity and fulfillment.
traduit: 我没有被复仇和报应的想法笼罩，只是感到平静和满足。

original: Of course, I've been also dabbling in my old pastimes as well. Take a look around, and feel free to share the fruits of my labor.
traduit: 当然，我也在尝试以前的消遣方式。看看周围，你可以随意分享我的劳动成果。

original: It was good speaking with you again.
traduit: 很高兴再次和你聊天。

original: May the shadows guide your journey.
traduit: 愿阴影指引你的旅途。

original: Eyes open and walk with the shadows.
traduit: 保持警惕，行于阴影。

original: Now go and make us some coin, lad!
traduit: 现在去再多赚点钱吧，小子！

original: Now go and make us some coin, lass!
traduit: 现在去再多赚点钱吧，姑娘！

original: Done? Let's get moving.
traduit: 完事了？我们走吧。

original: Done, then? This way!
traduit: 完事了？这边走！

original: Get ready to open the trap!
traduit: 准备打开陷阱！

original: If you were dead, I could keep the horse... (Intimidate)
traduit: 如果你死了，我就能留着这匹马了……（恐吓）

original: Now wait a minute... No need to do anything drastic. Look, Keep the horse, all right? Then we all walk away happy...
traduit: 等等……别做过激行为。听着，把马自己留着吧，好吗？然后我们各自开心地离开……

original: Well ain't that the truth of it. All right, then. Let's see what you've got!
traduit: 这也是事实。好啊。看看你有什么能耐！

original: If you were dead I could keep the horse.
traduit: 如果你死了，我就能留住这匹马。

original: I'm going to Maven unless I leave here with Frost. (Persuade)
traduit: 除非我带着寒霜离开，不然我就去找玛雯好了。（说服）

original: You're playing a dangerous game, my friend.
traduit: 你在玩火，朋友。

original: Fine, you win. Take the horse and leave.
traduit: 好吧，你赢了。带着马走吧。

original: And telling her what? That you stole her horse? I don't think so.
traduit: 告诉她什么？说你偷了她的马？我觉得你不会。

original: You know, I bet Maven would pay me even more for this info... (Persuade)
traduit: 你知道吗，我敢打赌玛雯会为这个情报付我更多钱……（说服）

original: Sure - take advantage of the guy in jail. Okay, fine. I can make the deal sweeter.
traduit: 当然，利用监狱里的人。好，很好。我可以让买卖更划算一点。

original: I obviously don't have anything here, but... there's a hidden stash in the Lodge. And I did manage to hold on to the key...
traduit: 我这儿是什么都没有了，但是……旅屋里有个藏匿处。而我恰好留了把钥匙……

original: Take it.
traduit: 拿去。

original: Nice try, but my mother's already got me in jail. Maybe you should try that one on Letrush.
traduit: 想得倒美，我妈已经把我关在监狱里了。也许你应该去敲诈莱特鲁什。

original: You mentioned something about Whiterun before?
traduit: 你之前有提到过白漫吗？

original: My daughter, Fura, was assigned to Whiterun after she joined the Imperial Army.  I was hoping you might have met her.
traduit: 我女儿芙拉，在加入帝国军之后被分配到白漫了。我还以为你见过她呢。

original: I haven't heard from her lately. I've tried talking to Captain Aldis but he hasn't been any help.
traduit: 我最近没有收到过她的消息。我有试着和艾迪斯队长谈过，但他拒绝帮忙。

original: Actually, yes.
traduit: 确实，没错。

original: Wonderful. I hadn't really hoped to run in to someone who had been there.
traduit: 太好了。我没指望真能碰到去过那里的人。

original: You're a traveller, correct? Have you been to Whiterun?
traduit: 你是旅行者吗？有没有去过白漫？

original: I'm sorry, I've never met her before.
traduit: 对不起，我以前没见过她。

original: Ah, well I guess it was unlikely. I'm sorry to waste your time.
traduit: 啊，我也想是不太可能。很抱歉浪费你的时间了。

original: I haven't met her, but I could try to get more information.
traduit: 我没见过她，但我可以试着找找消息。

original: Oh that's very sweet of you. Anything you can find out from Captain Aldis would be welcome news.
traduit: 你真是太好了。无论你从艾迪斯队长那里拿到什么消息都好。

original: No, sorry. I haven't been to Whiterun before.
traduit: 不，抱歉。我以前没去过白漫。

original: Ah well, it was a long shot.
traduit: 哦好吧，真是音信渺茫啊。

original: Have it your way. Let's get that crown men!
traduit: 按你的方式去做吧。我们去拿王冠！

original: Alright, get the crown off that draugr!
traduit: 好了，王冠从尸鬼那拿下来了！

original: If you don't mind king, we'll just be taking that crown of yours and be on our way.
traduit: 王啊，请恕罪，我们就把王冠取走了。

original: By the nine!
traduit: 九圣灵在上！

original: Ralof... get away from there, fool!
traduit: 拉罗夫……快闪开，呆瓜！

original: Hey, I found a crown over here on this corpse. Is this the one we're looking for?
traduit: 嘿，我在这尸体上找到一个王冠。这是我们要找的吗？

original: Well, King... If you don't mind, we'll just take that crown of yours and be on our way.
traduit: 嗯，王啊……请恕罪，我们要把王冠拿走了。

original: Tell me about Markarth.
traduit: 跟我说说马卡斯。

original: Markarth is... different from the rest of Skyrim, there's no doubt about that.
traduit: 马卡斯……和天际其他地方确实不一样。

original: The Reach has been part of Skyrim for a thousand years, but the Reachmen still haven't accepted it.
traduit: 瑞驰这上千年都是天际的一部分，但瑞驰人不接受。

original: It was only 20 years back that the Reachmen rebelled. Even took control of Markarth itself for a time.
traduit: 20年前，瑞驰人造反了。甚至还一度控制了马卡斯。

original: They were crushed, of course, but the survivors - the Forsworn - still lurk in the wilds and make the Reach dangerous for honest folk.
traduit: 当然，他们已经被击溃了，但幸存者——现在叫弃誓者了，仍然潜伏在荒野里，瑞驰现在对好人来说太危险了。

original: Die, you dog!
traduit: 死吧，狗东西！

original: Death to the beastblood!
traduit: 该死的畜生！

original: I'll rip you apart, Companion!
traduit: 我要把你撕成碎片，战友！

original: Ysgramor would be ashamed of you!
traduit: 伊斯格拉默以你为耻！

original: I can smell your shame!
traduit: 我能感受到你的羞愧！

original: Which one is that?
traduit: 那边那个是谁？

original: We knew you'd be coming here.
traduit: 我们就知道你会来。

original: Well, look what we have here.
traduit: 哈，看看这是什么。

original: It's time to die, dog.
traduit: 是时候去死了，狗东西。

original: Your mistake, Companion.
traduit: 战友，你失误了。

original: It doesn't matter. She wears that armor, she dies.
traduit: 无所谓，只要她穿着那个盔甲就死定了。

original: It doesn't matter. He wears that armor, he dies.
traduit: 无所谓，只要他穿着那个盔甲就死定了。

original: Killing you will make for an excellent story.
traduit: 把你杀了肯定能成就一段精彩的故事。

original: None of you will be alive to tell it.
traduit: 你们没人能活着去讲了。

original: You're going to regret this.
traduit: 你们会后悔的。

original: I don't know the Firebolt spell.
traduit: 我不会火矢术咒语。

original: I don't know the spell for summoning a Flame Atronach.
traduit: 我不会召唤火焰侍灵的咒语。

original: I don't know the Magelight spell.
traduit: 我不会魔光术的咒语。

original: I don't know the Fear spell.
traduit: 我不会恐惧术的咒语。

original: I don't know the Heal Other spell.
traduit: 我不会治愈他人咒语。

original: No? Well, if you think you're capable of it, then I'd be happy to provide it to you for a mere 30 gold.
traduit: 不会么？好吧，如果你觉得能学会，那我可以提供给你，只需30金币。

original: Or you can try your luck with one of the court wizards around Skyrim. They also sell spells.
traduit: 或者你可以去天际的宫廷巫师们那里碰碰运气。他们也会贩卖魔法。

original: Here you are. Now I'm anxious to see you cast it.
traduit: 给你。现在我想看看你如何使用。

original: It's this place. It feels like home. It's just nice to finally have something going right in my life.
traduit: 因为这里有家的感觉了。我的生活终于迎来转机了。

original: So I'm finally seeing you with a smile on your face.
traduit: 我终于看到你的笑容了。

original: Let's just hope it stays this way for a long time.
traduit: 希望这样的好情况多持续一段日子。

original: Couldn't be busier.
traduit: 忙的不行。

original: Better than ever. With the Guild back on its feet, there's more coin to throw around. How about you?
traduit: 比以往都要好。公会恢复了，大家愿意花更多钱。你那呢？

original: How's the training going?
traduit: 训练进行的如何？

original: Never. This is the best the Guild's done since I've been a part of it.
traduit: 从没有。这是我加入公会以来最好的时候。

original: Take a look around. Have you ever laid eyes on such wealth?
traduit: 看看周围。你见过如此巨富吗？

original: I agree. It'll be nice to get back the respect we lost in the last few years.
traduit: 说得对。能够重拾过去的尊严是好事。

original: At this rate, the Guild won't be such a laughingstock anymore.
traduit: 这样下去，公会就能摆脱笑柄地位了。

original: Yeah, it's really something else, isn't it?
traduit: 嗯，确实如此。

original: You know, things are really starting to move around here. I mean, look at the place. I've never seen so much merchandise.
traduit: 你知道吗，这里情况开始好转了。我是说，看看吧，我从没见过这么多商品。

original: Yes, your head hurts and you don't remember where you are.
traduit: 对，你头肯定疼，而且还不记得自己在哪儿。

original: Unh, my head.
traduit: 啊，我的头。

original: I see. So you don't remember fondling the statuary, then?
traduit: 我明白了。这么说你不记得自己摸过雕像了？

original: Blasphemer?
traduit: 亵渎者？

original: So do you remember anything I said when I got here?
traduit: 你还记得我来时说了什么吗？

original: You watch yourself on that island. Those mercenaries don't take prisoners.
traduit: 去岛上要小心。那些佣兵可不留活口。

original: There! Now attack it!
traduit: 好！现在攻击它！

original: Keep it busy. I'll try to drain some of its power!
traduit: 拖住它。我来试着吸取些能量。

original: Nothing seems to work!
traduit: 好像不起作用！

original: We were supposed to be learning about something?
traduit: 我们应该先了解些什么？

original: Yes, well. After the unfortunate incident that occurred, I think it's best if we just move on.
traduit: 嗯。在那次不幸事件之后，我觉得还是应该忘掉并继续。

original: Gaaaah!
traduit: 呃啊啊！

original: Aaaaah!
traduit: 啊啊啊！

original: I'm ready to return to Tamriel.
traduit: 我准备好回泰姆瑞尔了。

original: Return now to Nirn, with this rich boon from Shor, my lord: a Shout to bring a hero from Sovngarde in your hour of need.
traduit: 带着我主舒尔的厚赐回归奈恩吧，这个龙吼可以在你需要时从松加德召唤一位英雄。

original: Tarry not too long - the land of the dead is not meant for mortals to linger.
traduit: 不要耽搁太久了，死者之土并不适合凡人逗留。

original: If it is our lot to end, we'll live in song if not in soul.
traduit: 如果这是我们的结局，我们即使不以灵魂之姿长存，也会永远被诗歌传唱。

original: At Sovngarde's gates I'll meet my fate with mirthful heart, and know I fell in noblest cause.
traduit: 我会怀着愉快的心情在松加德的门前迎接命运，因为我是殒于高洁的事业。

original: Now ends this tale, my eternity be damned!
traduit: 现在该结束这个故事了，让我的永恒见鬼去吧！

original: Through fire and time, the terror has lived. No more, I say! I've set my heart on terrible deeds, death's grim art.
traduit: 跨越战火与时间，恐怖依然存在。我只能说，不会再如此了！我一心扑在危险的事业上，死亡不过是冷酷的艺术。

original: To battle, my friends! The fields will echo with the clamor of war, our wills undaunted.
traduit: 战斗吧，朋友们！我们不屈的战争咆哮会充斥战场。

original: We must drive away his mist, Shouting together, and then unsheathe our blades in desperate battle with our black-winged foe.
traduit: 我们必须驱散他的迷雾，一起用龙吼吧，然后拔剑，与我们的黑翼宿敌决一死战。

original: Felldir speaks wisdom - the World-Eater, coward, fears you, Dragonborn.
traduit: 费迪尔说得对。世界吞噬者就是个懦夫，他在惧怕你，龙裔。

original: But with four Voices joined, our valor combined, we can blast the mist and bring him to battle.
traduit: 但有了我们四个人的吼声，在加上勇气，我们一定能破开迷雾，让他不得不战。

original: Alduin's mist is more than a snare - its shadowy gloom is his shield and cloak.
traduit: 奥杜因的迷雾不仅是陷阱，这也是他的盾与斗篷。

original: By Shor's command we sheathed our blades and ventured not the vale's dark mist.
traduit: 舒尔命令我们收起刀剑，不要管外面山谷的黑雾。

original: But three await your word to loose their fury upon the perilous foe.
traduit: 但他们三个在等你发话，向强敌倾泻怒火。

original: Gormlaith the fearless, glad-hearted in battle; Hakon the valiant, heavy-handed warrior; Felldir the Old, far-seeing and grim.
traduit: 勇敢的葛姆拉丝，热衷战斗；英勇的哈肯，作战凌厉；年长的费迪尔，深思远虑。

original: Daal...Vus!
traduit: 达尔……威斯！

original: Nahl...
traduit: 纳尔……

original: The mist is gone, my mind is clear.
traduit: 迷雾散了，我的精神也清醒了。

original: For Skyrim! For Shor! For Sovngarde's freedom!
traduit: 为了天际！为了舒尔！为了松加德的自由！

original: Down with you, damned worm!
traduit: 看我打倒你，臭虫子！

original: I'll fight and die, if such fate is mine.
traduit: 如果这是命中注定，我愿英勇战死。

original: Better to die with blade in hand than feed his hunger, hopeless in the mist.
traduit: 宁握利刃战死，不做迷雾食粮。

original: No higher fate than fall in battle at Sovngarde's gates, a glorious end!
traduit: 没有比战死在松加德之门前更崇高的命运，更光荣的结局了！

original: Before I fall, you'll feel the bite of my sharp blade, as Shor's my witness.
traduit: 在我倒下前，舒尔会见证我用利刃伤到你。

original: Zu'u unslaad! Zu'u nis oblaan!
traduit: 祖'乌 安斯拉德！祖'乌 尼斯 欧伯兰！

original: I may fall to your malice, but your fate is already written.
traduit: 我可能会中你的圈套，但你在劫难逃。

original: You may strike me down, but your doom is near.
traduit: 你或许能打倒我，但你的末日也到了。

original: You cannot defeat us! The Dragonborn still stands!
traduit: 你打不败我们！龙裔还在坚持！

original: Your doom has come, damned worm!
traduit: 你末日到了，该死的虫子！

original: Stand fast! The fell worm's death is ours at last, the light returns!
traduit: 顶住！那只虫子会死在我们手里，光明要重现了！

original: Nowhere to hide! Hunter becomes our prey!
traduit: 你无处藏身了！猎人要变成我们的猎物了！

original: Use Dragonrend, to drag him down!
traduit: 用龙魂撕裂把他拖下来！

original: Die, World-Eater, in despair and fear!
traduit: 在绝望与恐惧中消亡吧，世界吞噬者！

original: Today you die, your doom has come.
traduit: 你今天必死无疑。

original: Use Dragonrend, brothers! Bring him to swords-reach!
traduit: 兄弟们，用龙魂撕裂！把他拖下来砍！

original: I've waited long for such a worthy opponent.
traduit: 我等这样的好对手很久了。

original: The joy of battle burns in your heart!
traduit: 战斗的喜悦在心中燃烧！

original: The path is closed, till your courage is tested.
traduit: 只有通过有勇气考验，道路才会开启。

original: Shor's Hall awaits, if worthy you prove.
traduit: 只要通过证明，舒尔大厅会向你敞开。

original: Prove worthy by warrior's test, and cross the bridge to the blessed hall.
traduit: 通过战士的试炼来证明价值吧，然后你就能过桥前往圣堂了。

original: Honest pay for honest work.
traduit: 有付出就会有回报。

original: I have nirnroot to sell.
traduit: 我有奈恩根要出售。

original: I have cabbage to sell.
traduit: 我有卷心菜要出售。

original: I have gourds to sell.
traduit: 我有葫芦要出售。

original: I have leeks to sell.
traduit: 我有韭葱要出售。

original: I have potatoes to sell.
traduit: 我有土豆要出售。

original: Ease your heart, our honor is unstained - it's by Shor's command we curb our onslaught.
traduit: 放心吧，我们的荣誉清白，是舒尔命令我们不要进攻。

original: It is by Shor's command that we curb our wrath - so let's feast and sing 'til our fate calls us.
traduit: 舒尔命令我们压制愤怒，所以，让我们尽情吃喝欢唱，直到命运召唤我们。

original: Let us not spurn our lord's bounty - this hall is his gift, for glory well-earned.
traduit: 不要轻视我等之主的恩赐，这个大厅是他的礼物，是光荣者应得的。

original: I long to fight that foul worm.
traduit: 我渴望与那头臭虫战斗。

original: Shall Alduin remain so long unchallenged?
traduit: 怎么还没人去挑战奥杜因？

original: Hear that? Stormcloaks. Maybe we can reason with them.
traduit: 听见了吗？是风暴斗篷。我们或许能和他们讲讲道理。

original: Just give me a minute... I'm out of breath...
traduit: 让我歇会儿……我快喘不上气了……

original: We need to get moving! That dragon is tearing up the whole keep!
traduit: 我们必须走！那头龙就要把整个堡垒撕碎了！

original: Not many wood elves would choose to come alone to Skyrim.
traduit: 木精灵很少选择独自来天际。

original: What're you doing here, Redguard? You a sellsword? A sailor from Stros M'kai?
traduit: 红卫人，你来这做什么？你是佣兵？还是斯卓·米'凯岛的水手？

original: You from one of the strongholds, Orc? How did you end up here?
traduit: 兽人，你是来自某个要塞吗？你怎么到这来了？

original: You're a long way from the Imperial City. What're you doing in Skyrim?
traduit: 你从帝都跑的够远的。你来天际做什么？

original: You're not with the Thalmor Embassy, are you high elf? No, that can't be right....
traduit: 你不是梭默大使馆的高精灵吗？不对，这不可能……

original: Another refugee? Gods really have abandoned your people, dark elf.
traduit: 又是个难民？诸神真的抛弃了你们啊，暗精灵。

original: You from Daggerfall, Breton? Fleeing from some court intrigue?
traduit: 布莱顿人，你从匕落来的？逃离宫廷纷争吗？

original: You with one of the trade caravans, Khajiit? Your kind always seems to find trouble.
traduit: 卡吉特，你是某个商队的成员？你们这群人好像总是在找麻烦。

original: Are you a relative of one of the Riften dock workers, Argonian?
traduit: 阿尔贡，你是裂谷城码头工人的亲戚吗？

original: You picked a bad time to come home to Skyrim, kinsman.
traduit: 老乡，你回天际没挑个好时候啊。

original: With mead and fellowship let's mend our wounds.
traduit: 蜜酒和友谊会抚慰创伤。

original: Shor's favor found me today. Let's lift a mug of mead together, our wounds to salve and weariness cure.
traduit: 舒尔今天眷顾我。一起喝杯蜜酒吧，美酒能抚慰伤口，治愈疲惫。

original: By a bold stroke, you bested me, friend.
traduit: 你这一击打得漂亮，朋友。

original: Well fought, friend. Your fury is unmatched.
traduit: 打得好，朋友。你的愤怒无人可及。

original: Aye. Let us forget our sorrow in the fury of battle.
traduit: 嘿。让我们在激烈的战斗中忘却悲伤吧。

original: Meat and mead must ever make way for the clash of steel - the song of battle.
traduit: 好酒好肉永远要给钢铁碰撞的战斗之歌让路。

original: Hail, comrade! Shall we by clash of steel ease the gloom of the encompassing mist?
traduit: 来啊，伙伴！要不要痛快一战驱散迷雾带来的忧郁？

original: My blade is restless, unblooded too long.
traduit: 我的利刃在躁动，它可是好久没饮血了。

original: Listen well, friend, and lighten your mood while words I'll spin of warriors bold, whose deeds of valor brought undying fame.
traduit: 好好听听吧，朋友，我会讲述英勇战士们成就不朽之名的故事，听完之后你会心情舒畅的。

original: I crave a tale of tall ships and fearless heroes, for heart's ease.
traduit: 我想听有无畏的英雄和大船航海的故事，听了心情会很好。

original: A cup I'll gladly raise in company with you. None have yet bested me in boasting or drinking.
traduit: 很乐意与你共饮一杯。还没人能在吹牛和饮酒上赢过我。

original: Come, let us share a cup of mead, and trade tales of our time on Mundus, reliving the glory of our remembered deeds.
traduit: 来吧，一起喝杯蜜酒，分享我们在梦达思的故事，重温记忆中的荣耀功绩。

original: I ran out of scrolls.
traduit: 我没有卷轴了。

original: You what? How could you run out? J'zargo gave you more than enough. Bah, just forget J'zargo ever asked for your help.
traduit: 什么？怎么弄丢的？我给你够多了。算了，就当杰'扎格没找你帮过忙。

original: I'm afraid she's right. I'm deeply sorry that this has to come between us.
traduit: 我想她说得对。我很抱歉这件事会影响咱们的关系。

original: But just as Paarthurnax's later deeds do not expiate his crimes, your deeds do not allow us to ignore our duty.
traduit: 但正如帕图纳克斯后来的行为不足以弥补他的罪行，你的功劳也不能让我们忽视自己的职责。

original: I hope you will return to us soon with the news that justice has finally been done.
traduit: 希望你能尽快回来，告诉我们正义得到了伸张。

original: With both Alduin and Paarthurnax dead, a dark chapter in history will finally be closed.
traduit: 伴随着奥杜因与帕图纳克斯的死，历史的黑暗篇章将最终结束。

original: There's still the matter of Paarthurnax. I'm not ungrateful for what you've done. Esbern speaks for both of us.
traduit: 还有帕图纳克斯的问题。我不是不感激你所做的一切。但伊思本说得对。

original: But our oath as Blades binds us. Paarthurnax must die. There's no excuse now that Alduin is dead.
traduit: 我们作为刀锋会一员的誓言束缚着我们。帕图纳克斯必须死。既然奥杜因已经死了，就没有借口了。

original: Thank you. Thank you, Dragonborn. You've done a great service for us all.
traduit: 谢谢你，谢谢你，龙裔。你为大家作出了巨大的贡献。

original: I knew you could do it... I believed in you, and yet... I still didn't think I'd live to see this day.
traduit: 我就知道你能行的……我相信你，可是，真没想到我能活着看到这一天。

original: You've done it... just as the prophecy said...
traduit: 你做到了……正如预言所说……

original: Yes. I used Alduin's portal to travel to Sovngarde. He's dead.
traduit: 对。我用奥杜因的传送门去了松加德。他死了。

original: Gods above... that's better news than I had hoped!
traduit: 众神在上……这个消息比我想的还好！

original: When you walked into my inn that day, I never imagined where it would all lead... dragons out of legend... Sovngarde...
traduit: 那天你走进我的旅馆时，我从没想过会发生什么……传说中的龙……松加德……

original: We are all in your debt, Dragonborn.
traduit: 我们都欠你的情，龙裔。

original: Since you're still alive, I assume you have good news to report?
traduit: 既然你还活着，应该是有好消息吧？

original: We heard the news from Whiterun - that you left the city on the back of a dragon!
traduit: 我们从白漫城得到消息，说你骑着巨龙飞走了！

original: That's a little... showy, even for you.
traduit: 即使是你，也有点……太招眼了。

original: Please... Delphine has been very worried about you.
traduit: 请吧……戴尔芬很担心你。

original: Perhaps, perhaps not. Dragons are not like normal mortal creatures, and Alduin is unique even among dragonkind.
traduit: 或许死了，或许没有。奥杜因不是寻常凡类生物，即使在龙族中，他也是独一无二的。

original: He may be permitted to return at the end of time to fulfill his destiny as the World-Eater.
traduit: 他也许会被允许在世界末日来临时回来完成世界吞噬者的使命。

original: But that is for the gods to decide. You have done your part.
traduit: 但那是诸神决定的事，你已经尽了你自己的本分。

original: Is Alduin really dead? I didn't absorb his soul when he died.
traduit: 奥杜因真死了？他死的时候我并没有吸收他的灵魂。

original: You've shown yourself mighty, both in Voice and deed. In order to defeat Alduin, you've gained mastery of dreadful weapons.
traduit: 你在吼声与行动上都展现了自己的强力。为了打败奥杜因，你掌握了可怕的武器。

original: Now it is up to you to decide what to do with your power and skill.
traduit: 现在该由你自己决定该如何使用你的力量与技能了。

original: Will you be a hero whose name is remembered in song throughout the ages?
traduit: 你会成为千古传诵的英雄？

original: Or will your name be a curse to future generations?
traduit: 遗臭万年的恶人？

original: Or will you merely fade from history, unremembered?
traduit: 或者淡出历史，被世人遗忘？

original: Let the Way of the Voice be your guide, and the path of wisdom will be clear to you. Breath and focus, Dragonborn. Your future lies before you.
traduit: 让吼声之道指引你吧，智慧之路已经清晰。调整呼吸，集中精神。龙裔。你的未来就在前方。

original: I hope so. But I don't know if Alduin can ever be completely destroyed.
traduit: 我也希望如此。只是我不知道奥杜因是否能被完全毁灭。

original: As dead as I can make him.
traduit: 我已经尽量让他死的不能再死了。

original: Then it is done at last. Perhaps it was all worth it, in the end.
traduit: 终于成功了。这一切到最后也许都是值得的。

original: Yes. I went to Sovngarde and killed Alduin there.
traduit: 对，我去了松加德，然后在那杀了奥杜因。

original: At last. It is over. Perhaps it was all worth it, in the end.
traduit: 终于。结束了。这一切到最后也许都值得了。

original: Yes, I found Alduin's portal to Sovngarde.
traduit: 对，我找到了奥杜因去松加德的传送门。

original: Does this mean... is it done? Is Alduin truly defeated?
traduit: 也就是说……结束了？奥杜因真的被击败了？

original: I can see it in your eyes - you've seen the land of the gods and returned.
traduit: 从你的眼神中能看得出，你已经见识过神域并回来了。

original: I'm with the Guild. Is this enough to clear my bounty? (<Global=GuildCost> gold)
traduit: 我是公会的。你看这些够还清我的罚金吗？（<Global=GuildCost>金币）

original: I don't care who you're with. After what you did, you're lucky I'm not cutting you down where you stand!
traduit: 谁管你哪条道上的。你做的那些事，我没一刀把你砍翻了算你走运！

original: You just going to stand there, gawking? Go away. You're starting to... frighten me.
traduit: 你干什么一直站在那儿？走开。你有点……吓到我了。

original: What kind of cruel, horrible person are you? My sister was murdered. Do you have any idea what that's like? What I'm going through?
traduit: 你怎么能这么残忍？我姐妹是被谋杀的。你知道那是什么感觉吗？你明白我经历了什么吗？

original: Do you hear that? It's the sound of your sister, screaming in the Void...
traduit: 听到了吗？你姐妹在虚空中的尖叫……

original: Muiri? I can't believe my family trusted that backstabbing little strumpet. You tell her she's dead to us. You hear me? Dead!
traduit: 暮蕊？我真不敢相信我们一家会信任那个小婊子。你就告诉她，我们一家权当她死了。听到吗？死了！

original: Muiri sent me. She is quite unhappy...
traduit: 暮蕊派我来的。她很不高兴……

original: What? Did... you need something?
traduit: 嗯？你……有什么需要吗？

original: I have nothing to say to you. Just... leave me alone.
traduit: 我跟你没什么好说的。别……来打扰我。

original: There you go!
traduit: 就这样！

original: Pretty good arm you have there.
traduit: 你身手不错。

original: Anyone else feel like running?
traduit: 还有人打算跑吗？

original: No, I'm not a rebel. You can't do this!
traduit: 不，我不是叛军。你们不能这么做！

original: Ralof of Riverwood.
traduit: 河木镇的拉罗夫。

original: Face your death with some courage, thief.
traduit: 勇敢面对死亡吧，小贼。

original: My ancestors are smiling at me, Imperials. Can you say the same?
traduit: 我的祖先在冲我微笑。帝国人，你也有祖宗吗？

original: Come on, I haven't got all morning.
traduit: 得了吧，我可没空等你。

original: For the love of Talos, shut up and let's get this over with.
traduit: 塔洛斯在上，快闭嘴动手吧。

original: Wait. You there. Step forward.
traduit: 等等，你，向前一步。

original: Empire loves their damn lists.
traduit: 帝国就是喜欢列他妈的名单。

original: Step towards the block when we call your name. One at a time.
traduit: 凡是被叫到名字的，挨个去断头台那边站好。

original: By Ysmir! Nothing kills it!
traduit: 伊斯米尔啊！没有东西能杀它！

original: What in the Eight Divines is this thing?
traduit: 八圣灵在上，这是什么东西？

original: Keep your eyes on it!
traduit: 盯紧它！

original: It's still coming!
traduit: 它又来了！

original: Die! For the love of the gods, die!
traduit: 死吧！众神在上！死吧！

original: Use everything we have!
traduit: 使出全部本事！

original: Fall, damn you, fall!
traduit: 死吧，该死的，死吧！

original: What does it take to kill this monster?
traduit: 怎么才能杀了这个怪物？

original: It won't die, it just keeps coming!
traduit: 它死不了啊，它又来了！

original: How does it move so damn fast?
traduit: 它怎么飞的这么快！

original: Move! Move!
traduit: 走！快走！

original: How in Oblivion do we kill this thing?
traduit: 我们怎么杀的了这东西？

original: Looks like the way out's up ahead. Come on.
traduit: 看起来出路就在前面。快走。

original: We better keep going.
traduit: 我们得继续走。

original: This way, come on!
traduit: 这边走，快！

original: Stormcloaks! Get them!
traduit: 风暴斗篷！抓住他们！

original: The prisoners are escaping!
traduit: 囚犯们跑了！

original: You won't leave Helgen alive!
traduit: 你活着走不出海尔根！

original: Stormcloaks! Filthy traitors!
traduit: 风暴斗篷！你们这群肮脏的叛徒！

original: Don't let those Stormcloaks get away!
traduit: 别让那些风暴斗篷跑了！

original: If you want to die, so be it.
traduit: 你要是这么想去死，就赶紧死吧。

original: You won't take us alive!
traduit: 你活捉不了我们！

original: Freedom or Sovngarde!
traduit: 要么自由，要么去松加德！

original: For Ulfric and Skyrim!
traduit: 为了乌弗瑞克和天际！

original: Death to the Empire!
traduit: 打倒帝国！

original: Imperial dogs!
traduit: 帝国狗！

original: So that's why you were in the cart. Thieving.
traduit: 所以你才被抓上车！你这个贼。

original: It's the End Times! The End Times have come!
traduit: 末日到了！末日到了！

original: By the gods, a dragon! How?
traduit: 神啊，是龙！为什么？

original: A dragon? It's a dragon! Gods help us!
traduit: 是龙？是龙！神啊，救救我们！

original: Divines help us!
traduit: 圣灵保佑我们！

original: In here!
traduit: 这里！

original: This way! Come on!
traduit: 这边走！来吧！

original: I just need to gather some more potions.
traduit: 我需要再找些药剂。

original: Grab everything important and let's move! Dragon's burning everything to the ground!
traduit: 带上所有重要的东西，走！龙把地上全烧遍了！

original: These Imperials have potions in here. We're going to need them.
traduit: 这些帝国兵身上有药。我们用得上。

original: What are you doing? We need to get out of Helgen. Now!
traduit: 你在干嘛？我们现在必须离开海尔根！

original: Just give the General some time!
traduit: 给将军点时间！

original: I'm not waiting to be killed by a dragon! We need to fall back!
traduit: 我可不想被龙杀了！我们得撤退！

original: Orders are to wait until General Tullius arrives.
traduit: 命令是等着图留斯将军到达。

original: Just give me a minute. Let me think.
traduit: 给我点时间想想。

original: Where in Oblivion are we supposed to go? Where's the way out?
traduit: 我们该去哪里？出路在哪？

original: Look at him, General Tullius the Military Governor.
traduit: 看看他吧，军事统帅图留斯将军。

original: I found more of Shalidor's work.
traduit: 我找到沙利多的其他手迹了。

original: I'll start translating it. Shouldn't take me more than a day or two.
traduit: 我要开始着手翻译了。应该花不了一两天。

original: I've heard whispers of more of his work having turned up. If you can track it down, it may prove useful to all of us.
traduit: 我听说有他的其他手迹出现了。如果能找到的话，可能对大家都有用。

original: Are there any special books you're looking for?
traduit: 你在找什么特别的书吗？

original: As a matter of fact, there are. Have you ever heard of Shalidor?
traduit: 事实上，确实有。你可曾听说过沙利多？

original: Immensely powerful mage, back in the First Era. Had an understanding of magic few have ever matched.
traduit: 第一纪元时非常强大的法师。他对魔法的理解无人能及。

original: He holed himself up in Labyrinthian, and devoted all of his time to research and study. Wrote more than you would imagine possible.
traduit: 他把自己关在迷城，花费毕生精力进行研究。他写的东西数量极大，远超你的想象。

original: Since then, his writings have been scattered all over Skyrim, but are little use to anyone who can't translate them. I'm one of the few who can.
traduit: 自那之后，他的手迹散布在天际各地，但对于那些不会翻译的人来说，毫无用处。而我就是少数能翻译的人。

original: I'm always trying to find more of Shalidor's writings.
traduit: 我一直在寻找沙利多的其他手迹。

original: I'll meet you at Dustman's Cairn.
traduit: 我会在清洁者石冢和你会合。

original: Don't delay, Shield-Brother.
traduit: 不要拖延，盾牌兄弟。

original: Don't delay, Shield-Sister.
traduit: 不要拖延，盾牌姐妹。

original: I don't need some mutt following me around.
traduit: 我可不想让狗跟着我。

original: Come on. You can follow me if you want.
traduit: 来吧，如果想来可以跟着我。

original: What's wrong, boy? Do you want to come with me?
traduit: 怎么了，小子？想和我一起走吗？

original: Clean up that murderer's mess. (<Global=HDWindhelmKiller> gold)
traduit: 清理凶犯的烂摊子。（<Global=HDWindhelmKiller>金币）

original: General Tullius, sir! The headsman is waiting!
traduit: 图留斯将军！刽子手正等着呢！

original: And it looks like the Thalmor are with him. Damn elves. I bet they had something to do with this.
traduit: 看起来梭默和他在一起。该死的精灵。我敢打赌他们跟这事有关。

original: No, this can't be happening. This isn't happening.
traduit: 不，这不可能。这不可能。

original: By the way, if you're looking for something to do...
traduit: 对了，如果你想找点事做……

original: By your orders, Captain.
traduit: 遵命，队长。

original: I'm sorry. We'll make sure your remains are returned to Black Marsh.
traduit: 我很抱歉。我们保证把你的遗体送回黑沼泽。

original: I'm sorry. We'll make sure your remains are returned to High Rock.
traduit: 我很抱歉。我们保证把你的遗体送回高岩。

original: I'm sorry. We'll make sure your remains are returned to Morrowind.
traduit: 我很抱歉。我们保证把你的遗体送回晨风。

original: I'm sorry. We'll make sure your remains are returned to the Summerset Isle.
traduit: 我很抱歉。我们保证把你的遗体送回夏暮岛。

original: I'm sorry. We'll make sure your remains are returned to Cyrodiil.
traduit: 我很抱歉。我们保证把你的遗体送回希罗帝尔。

original: I'm sorry. We'll make sure your remains are returned to Elsweyr.
traduit: 我很抱歉。我们保证把你的遗体送回艾斯维尔。

original: I'm sorry. We'll make sure your remains are returned to Orsinium.
traduit: 我很抱歉。我们保证把你的遗体送回奥辛纽姆。

original: I'm sorry. We'll make sure your remains are returned to Hammerfell.
traduit: 我很抱歉。我们保证把你的遗体送回落锤。

original: I'm sorry. We'll make sure your remains are returned to Valenwood.
traduit: 我很抱歉。我们保证把你的遗体送回威伦森林。

original: I'm sorry. At least you'll die here, in your homeland.
traduit: 我很抱歉。但至少你能死在家乡了。

original: You're not going to kill me!
traduit: 你不能杀我！

original: Get these prisoners out of the carts. Move it!
traduit: 把囚犯押下车。快！

original: Grab Gunjar's gear. No shame in borrowing a friend's axe.
traduit: 拿着甘佳尔的装备吧。借用朋友的斧头并不可耻。

original: Gunjar isn't coming back from the dead. Take his armor and anything else on him.
traduit: 甘佳尔不能死而复生。把他的护甲武器都带上吧。

original: That armor on Gunjar isn't doing him any good. Go ahead. Take it.
traduit: 甘佳尔不再需要这件护甲了。去吧，带上它。

original: You better get some gear.
traduit: 你最好拿些装备。

original: See if one of these chests has some armor for you.
traduit: 看看箱子里有没有合适你的盔甲。

original: Got to be a sword or two in one of these chests. Look around.
traduit: 这些箱子里应该有一两把剑。四处找找看。

original: This way. Come on!
traduit: 这边走。跟上！

original: There's a way out through here!
traduit: 这边有出口！

original: We have to keep moving.
traduit: 我们得继续走。

original: I don't have the gold.
traduit: 我没有钱。

original: Then you are worth more to me dead!
traduit: 那你死了对我更有价值！

original: I will make sure this gets back to the Jarl. Minus my cut, of course. Consider your name cleared, for now.
traduit: 我会确保把钱交给领主。当然是去掉我那份了。现在把你的罪名洗清吧。

original: Pay <Global=WEBountyCollectorCrimeGold> gold.
traduit: 支付<Global=WEBountyCollectorCrimeGold>金币。

original: You have quite the bounty on your head in Winterhold. You pay me, and I see that your name is cleared.
traduit: 你在冬堡一带被人悬赏了不少钱啊。快给我钱，我可以让你的身份变清白。

original: You have quite the bounty on your head in Whiterun. You pay me, and I see that your name is cleared.
traduit: 你在白漫一带被人悬赏了不少钱啊。快给我钱，我可以让你的身份变清白。

original: You have quite the bounty on your head in The Rift. You pay me, and I see that your name is cleared.
traduit: 你在裂痕一带被人悬赏了不少钱啊。快给我钱，我可以让你的身份变清白。

original: You have quite the bounty on your head in The Reach. You pay me, and I see that your name is cleared.
traduit: 你在瑞驰一带被人悬赏了不少钱啊。快给我钱，我可以让你的身份变清白。

original: You have quite the bounty on your head in The Pale. You pay me, and I see that your name is cleared.
traduit: 你在苍原一带被人悬赏了不少钱啊。快给我钱，我可以让你的身份变清白。

original: You have quite the bounty on your head in Hjaalmarch. You pay me, and I see that your name is cleared.
traduit: 你在希雅陲一带被人悬赏了不少钱啊。快给我钱，我可以让你的身份变清白。

original: You have quite the bounty on your head in Haafingar. You pay me, and I see that your name is cleared.
traduit: 你在海芬加一带被人悬赏了不少钱啊。快给我钱，我可以让你的身份变清白。

original: You have quite the bounty on your head in Falkreath. You pay me, and I see that your name is cleared.
traduit: 你在佛克瑞斯一带被人悬赏了不少钱啊。快给我钱，我可以让你的身份变清白。

original: You have quite the bounty on your head in Eastmarch. You pay me, and I see that your name is cleared.
traduit: 你在东陲一带被人悬赏了不少钱啊。快给我钱，我可以让你的身份变清白。

original: Stop right there.
traduit: 站住。

original: I have no more business with you.
traduit: 咱俩两清了。

original: People think they can run away from their crimes, but I will always catch up with them and make them pay.
traduit: 人们总觉得他们可以逃脱自己的罪行，但我总会抓住他们，让他们付出代价。

original: It's very unfortunate that you've been suspended.
traduit: 很不幸你被停学了。

original: dunBloatedMansGrottoQST_NormalToAlert
traduit: dunBloatedMansGrottoQST_NormalToAlert

original: I'll stay here and wait for General Tullius. Good luck you two.
traduit: 我要在这等图留斯将军。祝你们俩好运。

original: Give the staff to me before someone gets hurt. (Persuade)
traduit: 把法杖给我吧，免得有人受伤。（说服）

original: Hand over the staff, or else. (Intimidate)
traduit: 把法杖交出来，否则的话。（恐吓）

original: Seems like coin would be worth more to you.  (<BribeCost> gold)
traduit: 看来金币对你会更有价值啊。（<BribeCost>金币）

original: I'm not paying anything.
traduit: 我不会付钱的。

original: We may be rough, but we don't tolerate thieving around here. If that's your game, go join the lowlives in Riften.
traduit: 我们可能是粗人，但我们不会容忍在这里偷东西。如果你喜欢这行，还是去裂谷城加入那群下等人吧。

original: Take your coin. (<CrimeGold> gold)
traduit: 钱给你。（<CrimeGold>金币）

original: Be careful around here. You don't want to anger the wrong person.
traduit: 在这里小心点。别惹到不该惹的人。

original: I'm sorry. (<CrimeGold> gold)
traduit: 我很抱歉。（<CrimeGold>金币）

original: Hold your head up. I'm sure it won't happen again.
traduit: 抬起头吧。我敢肯定这种事不会发生了。

original: Now that's just sad. Come back when you actually have something to show for your thieving.
traduit: 那太可悲了。等你有的时候再回来吧。

original: I can't afford to pay.
traduit: 我没那么多钱。

original: I think you've been taking things that don't belong to you. Pay your debts, and we'll forget this happened.
traduit: 我觉得你一直在拿不属于你的东西。把账还清，就当无事发生。

original: Oh, well, the Listener is the only person the Night Mother speaks to. It is the highest honor attainable by a member of the Dark Brotherhood.
traduit: 好吧，夜母只会与聆听者交谈。这是黑暗兄弟会成员的最高荣誉。

original: Of course our Lady is dead, so she doesn't talk with words, since her lips are... rotted. But inside the Listener's head. I hear it's... intimate.
traduit: 当然，我们的夫人已经死了，所以不会说话，因为她的嘴唇已经……烂了。声音会直接在聆听者的脑海里回响。真是……太亲密了。

original: Ah, but there has not been a Listener in years and years. Our Lady has not chosen Cicero, and certainly not Astrid. Or... anyone. But some day...
traduit: 但聆听者已经很多年都没有出现了。我们的夫人没有选择西塞罗，也没选中阿斯垂德。或是……别的人。但总有一天……

original: The Listener? What's a Listener?
traduit: 聆听者？聆听者是什么？

original: Ha! Why you are, silly! You are the Listener! You are the Listener! Such a kidder...
traduit: 哈！你这笨蛋！你就是聆听者啊！你就是聆听者！你准是在开玩笑……

original: You must realize what a great honor this is. For the Night Mother to have chosen you... I am just in awe. You have Cicero's utmost confidence!
traduit: 你一定知道这是多大的荣誉啊。夜母选择了你……我真的很敬畏。西塞罗绝对相信你！

original: He did indeed.
traduit: 他确实说了。

original: Does this upset you?
traduit: 这让你心烦吗？

original: Hmm. The gate below still looks closed.
traduit: 嗯。下面的大门好像还是紧闭着。

original: I've seen a puzzle like this before... there's got to be another lever to pull, but you'd better hurry. A septim says this mechanism's on a timer.
traduit: 我以前见过这样的谜题……应该还要去拉下另一个操作杆，不过动作要快点。有个塞普汀说这个机关是有计时装置的。

original: Get the damn Key and let's get out of here before we end up like Mercer!
traduit: 快把钥匙拿过来，在我们和墨瑟一个下场前赶紧离开这里！

original: You can't kill what you can't see!
traduit: 你杀不了看不到的东西！

original: I've mastered the shadows... and now your life is mine!
traduit: 我已经掌握了阴影……你的命归我了！

original: Come, "Nightingale!" Find me if you can!
traduit: 来啊，“夜莺”！有本事就找到我啊！

original: Karliah's taught you nothing! Your lessons begin anew!
traduit: 卡莱亚没交给你什么东西！你的课程要重新开始了！

original: I should've finished you when I had the chance!
traduit: 早就该找机会杀了你！

original: Karliah, I'll deal with you after I rid myself of your irksome companions. In the meantime, perhaps you and Brynjolf should get better acquainted.
traduit: 卡莱亚，等我解决掉你那些烦人的同伴再对付你。现在，也许你可以和布林乔夫好好切磋一下。

original: You cannot escape me!
traduit: 你逃不掉的！

original: Hiding will not save you now.
traduit: 逃避救不了你。

original: There could be no other end.
traduit: 你只有死路一条。

original: No match at all.
traduit: 根本不堪一击。

original: You meet your end, mortal.
traduit: 你的终局到来了，凡人。

original: Another who seeks death.
traduit: 又一个找死的。

original: Quiet again.
traduit: 又安静了。

original: Nothing after all.
traduit: 没有东西。

original: No one escapes!
traduit: 一个也别想逃！

original: There you are, weakling!
traduit: 你在这儿啊，胆小鬼！

original: I smell weakness...
traduit: 我闻到了弱者的气息……

original: A challenger is near...
traduit: 附近有挑战者……

original: Now you suffer!
traduit: 等着受苦吧！

original: You return, foolish mortal?
traduit: 你回来了啊，愚蠢的凡人？

original: Are you prepared for your death?
traduit: 准备好迎接死亡了吗？

original: You are weak, mortal.
traduit: 你太弱了，凡人。

original: I honor my lord by destroying you!
traduit: 为了我主的荣耀，我要摧毁你！

original: I will feast on your heart.
traduit: 我要好好享用你的心脏。

original: No... not by a mortal...
traduit: 我……不可能被凡人……

original: It cannot... end like this...
traduit: 不可能……这么结束……

original: Oblivion take you!
traduit: 到湮灭报到去吧！

original: Fall before me!
traduit: 在我面前陨落吧！

original: You will bleed!
traduit: 你会血流如注！

original: Grrragh!
traduit: 嘎啊！

original: The warehouse is off-limits. I suggest you head back the way you came.
traduit: 仓库禁止进入。建议你从哪里来还是回哪去吧。

original: There's nothing for you in the warehouse, so why don't you take a walk?
traduit: 仓库里没你的事，不如出去走走？

original: The warehouse is for East Empire Company workers only. Entering without permission is a crime.
traduit: 仓库仅供东帝国公司员工使用。未经允许进入是犯罪行为。

original: What kind of problems is the East Empire Company having?
traduit: 东帝国公司出了什么问题？

original: This is the East Empire Company's central warehouse. All of their shipments go through here.
traduit: 这是东帝国公司的主要仓库。他们所有的货都要经过这里。

original: Unfortunately, thanks to some problems they've been having, it hasn't seen much use lately.
traduit: 不幸的是，他们最近遇到了些问题，所以没有怎么启用。

original: Either way, it's off limits to you.
traduit: 不管怎样，你不能进去。

original: And now that they've solved their little pirate problem, they're busier than ever.
traduit: 现在他们已经解决了海盗的小麻烦，比以前繁忙得多。

original: How should I know? I don't work for them.
traduit: 我怎么知道？我又不替他们工作。

original: If you want to help, I suppose you could head to Windhelm and talk to Orthus Endario. He's in charge over there.
traduit: 如果你想帮忙，建议你可以去风舵城找奥苏斯·恩达里奥谈谈。他是那边的负责人。

original: I want to be better hidden in the shadows.
traduit: 我想更好地隐藏在阴影当中。

original: I want to deal more damage in battle.
traduit: 我想在战斗中造成更多伤害。

original: I want to strengthen my magical skills.
traduit: 我想增强我的魔法技能。

original: I want to be tougher in battle.
traduit: 我想在战斗中变得更坚强。

original: I want to resist the forces of magic.
traduit: 我想更好地抵抗魔法。

original: I'd like it to have the power of healing.
traduit: 我希望它能有治愈的能力。

original: All that effort, and you just kill her. You've ruined everything.
traduit: 付出了多少努力，你却把她杀了。都是让你给搞砸了。

original: Well, well. Looks like one of the Dark Brotherhood rats escaped its burning nest. I can fix that.
traduit: 嗯，好。看来有一只黑暗兄弟会的老鼠逃出了燃烧的巢穴。我能搞定。

original: To arms, brothers! It's the assassin!
traduit: 弟兄们拿起武器！是刺客！

original: The Dark Brotherhood is dead... and so are you!
traduit: 黑暗兄弟会已经完了……还有你！

original: You want the Emperor? You'll have to get through us!
traduit: 想去找皇帝？先过我们这关！

original: You'll never reach the Emperor! Not while I'm standing!
traduit: 有我在这儿你休想找到皇帝！

original: It all ends here, assassin!
traduit: 到此为止了，刺客！

original: You'll never leave this ship alive, cutthroat!
traduit: 刺客，你休想活着离开这艘船！

original: Shor, Mara, Dibella, Kynareth, Akatosh. Divines, please help me.
traduit: 舒尔，玛拉，迪贝拉，凯娜瑞丝，阿卡托什。神啊，救救我吧。

original: We're all brothers and sisters in binds now, thief.
traduit: 我们现在是难兄难弟了，小贼。

original: You there. You and me - we shouldn't be here. It's these Stormcloaks the Empire wants.
traduit: 那边的。你和我不该在这里，帝国要抓的是这群风暴斗篷。

original: Damn you Stormcloaks. Skyrim was fine until you came along. Empire was nice and lazy.
traduit: 该死的风暴斗篷。你们出现前天际一切都好。天高皇帝远。

original: If they hadn't been looking for you, I could've stolen that horse and be halfway to Hammerfell.
traduit: 要不是他们想抓捕你们。我早就偷了那匹马到落锤去了。

original: You were trying to cross the border, right? Walked right into that Imperial ambush, same as us, and that thief over there.
traduit: 你是想越境吧？结果和我们还有那边那个小贼一样，直接走进了帝国的伏击圈。

original: Farewell, Nightingale. See to it the Key stays this time, won't you?
traduit: 再会了，夜莺。这次一定要把钥匙保管好，可以吗？

original: You started this war, plunged Skyrim into chaos, and now the Empire is going to put you down, and restore the peace.
traduit: 你发动了这场战争，使天际大乱。现在帝国要剿灭你们，恢复和平。

original: (muffled grunts)
traduit: （低沉的咕哝声）

original: This is notorious bandit hideout. But it's also the shortest way to Kynesgrove, so... we may have to kill a few bandits.
traduit: 这是个臭名昭著的强盗窝。不过从这里去凯娜之林最近，所以……我们可能还得杀几个强盗。

original: We'll cross to the White River and follow it to Windhelm. Then we can swing south to Kynesgrove.
traduit: 我们要过白河，再沿河走到风舵城。然后再往南走就到了凯娜之林了。

original: There's an inn at Kynesgrove - the Braidwood. I hear they serve a nice dark ale. Nothing on the Sleeping Giant, of course.
traduit: 在凯娜之林有家辫枝旅店，听说那里的黑麦芽酒不错。当然啦，比不上我们沉睡巨人。

original: This is Kynesgrove. Not much to look at. The innkeeper ought to be able to tell us if there's any dragon mound nearby.
traduit: 这儿就是凯娜之林了。没什么好看的。旅馆老板应该能告诉咱们附近有没有龙冢。

original: This is Kynesgrove. Not much to look at. Let's see if we can find that dragon mound.
traduit: 这儿就是凯娜之林了。没什么好看的。找找有没有龙冢吧。

original: No need to bother with giants right now. Just keep your distance.
traduit: 没必要担心巨人。保持距离就行了。

original: I'm glad you were willing to trust me. I know it probably wasn't the best way to introduce myself. But old habits... you know.
traduit: 很高兴你愿意信任我。我知道这样做自我介绍很不好。但你知道……积习难改啊。

original: Not too much farther now. Kynesgrove is just down the road to the southeast of here.
traduit: 应该不远了。凯娜之林就在这条路东南方向。

original: I hope you're Dragonborn, I really do. But we'll find out soon enough.
traduit: 我真希望你是龙裔。我们很快就有机会证明了。

original: We may both end up dead, but at least it gets me out of Riverwood. I don't really think I'm cut out for the quiet life.
traduit: 也许我们活不下来。但至少它让我有机会离开河木镇。我真的不适合平静的生活。

original: I doubt the Thalmor are aware of you yet. So we should be safe from them, at least.
traduit: 我怀疑梭默可能，没意识到你的存在。所以咱们至少不用担心被他们伤害了。

original: Remember, we're not looking for trouble. We need to get to Kynesgrove as fast as we can.
traduit: 记住，不要去自寻麻烦。我们得尽快赶到凯娜之林。

original: Keep a sharp lookout. We can't afford any delays.
traduit: 时刻警惕。我们禁不起任何耽搁。

original: Better to stick together. I don't want you to get yourself killed before we even get there.
traduit: 最好走的近一点。我可不希望你在到达前就被杀哦。

original: Run, you idiot!
traduit: 快跑，你这白痴！

original: Thought I told you to run for it! Go!
traduit: 我不是叫你赶紧跑吗！快走！

original: Soldiers, townspeople, and dregs into the keep!
traduit: 士兵、镇民，还有那群混蛋，都快点进堡垒里去！

original: Everyone to the keep!
traduit: 所有人都进堡垒！

original: To the keep! Move!
traduit: 快去堡垒！动起来！

original: What? Do you want to be that thing's next meal? Into the keep, already!
traduit: 你想当它下顿饭吗？快进堡垒里去！

original: I don't know. It's like a ward, but who's casting it? Ancano? How?
traduit: 我不知道。像是个结界，但是谁做的？安卡诺吗？怎么做到的？

original: Hyah!
traduit: 嘿呀！

original: Know that Gormlaith sent you down to death!
traduit: 记住了，杀你的人是葛姆拉丝！

original: You will die in terror, knowing your final fate...
traduit: 你会在恐惧中死去，接受你的命运吧……

original: But first... dir ko maar.
traduit: 但首先……迪尔 寇 马尔。

original: Sorry, I can't spare any gold.
traduit: 抱歉，我也没有富裕的钱了。

original: Thank you, traveler. Be safe and don't forget to keep an eye on the sky.
traduit: 谢谢你，旅行者。注意安全。别忘了时不时看看天上。

original: Here you go. (Give 5 gold)
traduit: 给你吧。（送出5金币）

original: You're too kind. Thank you. Be careful and stay safe.
traduit: 你人真是太好了。谢谢。一定要注意安全啊。

original: There are dragons about, traveler. Be warned.
traduit: 到处都是巨龙，旅行者。要小心啊。

original: It happened so fast. One minute the dragon was there, the next it was gone. Everything was destroyed.
traduit: 事情发生得太快了。前一分钟龙来了，下一分钟就不见了。一切都被毁坏了。

original: We lost everything.
traduit: 我们什么都没了。

original: Can you tell me more about the Augur of Dunlain?
traduit: 你能再多和我说说占卜师杜兰吗？

original: Well, I suppose he wouldn't mind...
traduit: 好吧，我想他应该不介意……

original: It was all before my time, you understand. I've heard the stories, the same as anyone else.
traduit: 那都是我出生之前的事了，我也是和其他人一样听来的故事。

original: He was a brilliant student, an accomplished wizard. Delved into magic in a way none had seen before.
traduit: 他是个很聪明的学生，也是个成就不错的巫师。他以一种前所未有的方式钻研魔法。

original: But, I think, he became too focused on just how much power he could acquire. That's what led to the accident.
traduit: 不过，我觉得他可能过于关注自己能获得多少力量了。这也是事故的原因。

original: Do you remember what I first told you, about how not being able to control magic could destroy you?
traduit: 还记得我第一次教你的东西吗，失控的魔法会毁了你？

original: I didn't simply mean it could kill you. The Augur's accident is another very real type of a life destroyed.
traduit: 我没简单说成那会杀了你。因为占卜师事故就是另一种被摧毁的活生生的例证。

original: Well, it's been described as an accident. I can't imagine it was intentional.
traduit: 哎，据说是个事故，但我总觉得有蹊跷。

original: Something must've gone wrong, and he ended up in the state he's in now, fused to the energies that flow through the College.
traduit: 一定是出了什么问题，才让他变成了现在的模样，和整个学院的能量融为一体了。

original: I've never felt it appropriate to ask him about it, about how that must feel. Or, I suppose, if he can feel at all.
traduit: 我从来没想过要去问他那是什么感觉。或者可以说，我不觉得他还能感觉到什么。

original: Let's see here....
traduit: 看看这……

original: Come on, soldier. Keep moving!
traduit: 士兵，快点。继续前进！

original: All right, get that armor on and give that axe a few swings.
traduit: 好了，穿上盔甲然后挥挥斧头。

original: Grab anything useful and let's go.
traduit: 拿上有用的东西然后快走。

original: It's locked. See if you can get it open with some picks. We might need that gold once we get out.
traduit: 锁上了。看看能不能用东西撬开。我们出去后可能用得上那些金币。

original: Sure, take all my things. Please.
traduit: 没问题，我的东西随便取用。请吧。

original: You better get that armor on. Give that sword a few swings, too.
traduit: 你最好穿上盔甲，再挥挥手里的剑。

original: What did the Psijic want?
traduit: 赛伊克想要什么？

original: Beyond asking for you, he never said. Very strange indeed.
traduit: 除了说要找你之外，什么都没说。奇也怪哉。

original: I'm... I'm not sure what happened.
traduit: 我……不确定发生了什么。

original: A monk from the Psijic Order, here, after all these years, and then he just leaves.
traduit: 这么多年之后，又一个赛伊克僧侣来了这里，然后离开了。

original: I hope we didn't offend him somehow.
traduit: 希望我们没有冒犯到他。

original: You sent for me?
traduit: 你叫我？

original: You've been a worthy patron. Shall I join you once more, free of charge?
traduit: 你是个值得尊敬的雇主。我能再和你一道吗，免费的？

original: I could really use some more experience in the field. I'd be happy to join you again, and it won't cost a thing.
traduit: 我真的需要更多这方面的经验。我很高兴能再次与你同行，而且不收钱。

original: Back for more? Since we had so much fun the last time, I'll join you free of charge.
traduit: 又回来了？既然咱们上次玩得开心，这次就免费陪你了。

original: If you still need my blade, I'll join you. I want to make sure you get your money's worth.
traduit: 如果你还需要我的剑，我会跟你走。我得确保你花钱花得值。

original: Since you paid my fee recently, I suppose it's only fair that I join you once more.
traduit: 既然你最近付过钱给我了，那我应该在跟你走一趟才算公平。

original: I'm bored. What do you say we go smash a few heads in? This one's on me.
traduit: 我很无聊啊。咱们再去砸几个脑袋怎么样？这次我请客。

original: Very well, let's go. (0 gold)
traduit: 好啊，那咱们走。（0金币）

original: Once more into danger!
traduit: 又要冒险了！

original: I'm ready to go!
traduit: 我准备好出发了！

original: My blade is yours once more.
traduit: 我的剑会再次属于你。

original: Good, I can use the exercise. Haha!
traduit: 好，就当是练习了。哈哈！

original: Alright, then. Let's go.
traduit: 那好，出发吧。

original: Or if you're feeling lucky, you can take this bow. Might take her by surprise.
traduit: 如果你想碰碰运气，就拿着这把弓。兴许会吓她一跳。

original: I've tempered the Hide Helmet.
traduit: 我已经强化了皮制头盔。

original: You have talent. Keep working at your craft, and you'll be a fine smith one day.
traduit: 你天赋不错。继续努力吧，总有一天你会成为好铁匠的。

original: Why don't you keep that dagger and helmet? Maybe you'll remember me when you're making Skyforge Steel, huh?
traduit: 何不把匕首和头盔都留下？也许等你能锻造天空锻炉钢的时候会想起我？

original: Here's a Hide Helmet.
traduit: 皮制头盔做好了。

original: I should hire you to be my assistant at this rate.
traduit: 照这样下去，我真该雇你当我助手了。

original: Let's improve the fit. Take this leather to the workbench over there.
traduit: 提高一下合身度吧。把那个头盔放到旁边的制作台上。

original: Here's that Leather you wanted.
traduit: 这是你要的皮革。

original: Ah, good. A lot of weapons and armor need leather for straps, fittings, that kind of thing.
traduit: 哦，很好。很多武器和盔甲都需要皮革带子、配件之类的。

original: Let's see if you can make a hide helmet. Here's the rest of what you need.
traduit: 看看你能不能做个皮制头盔。这是你需要的其他材料。

original: I've sharpened the Iron Dagger.
traduit: 我把匕首磨好了。

original: This looks good. You put time into your blades, they'll serve you well when you need them.
traduit: 看起来不错。只要肯在刀刃上花时间，它们会在需要时帮到你的。

original: You want to keep helping? How about you make some armor? Let's start by tanning some leather on the rack.
traduit: 想继续帮忙吗？做些盔甲怎么样？先到架子上硝些皮革来。

original: Here's an Iron Dagger.
traduit: 铁制匕首打好了。

original: Not bad, but it's a little dull. How about you sharpen it up? Just need a bit of metal and the grindstone over there.
traduit: 还不赖，就是有点钝了。把它磨尖点儿如何？只需要一些金属和旁边那块磨刀石。

original: Need any help around the forge?
traduit: 铁匠铺需要帮忙吗？

original: Yes, actually. How about you smith me an iron dagger? Here's everything you need to make one. Go ahead.
traduit: 需要啊。帮我锻把铁匕首怎么样？这是做一把匕首需要的所有材料。去干吧。

original: Can I use the alchemy lab?
traduit: 我可以用炼金台吗？

original: Long as you clean up. You know how to use it right? Mix a couple of ingredients together, see what happens.
traduit: 用完清理干净就行。你知道该怎么用吧？把原料混合起来，看看效果。

original: A little Wheat and Blisterwort makes a healing potion, if you didn't know.
traduit: 如果你不知道该混合什么，那就试试用小麦和气泡草做瓶治疗药水吧。

original: We have plenty of ingredients for sale, too.
traduit: 我们这里也有很多材料可以卖给你。

original: How do you enchant weapons and armor?
traduit: 你是怎么给武器盔甲附魔的？

original: Ah, a student of the craft. You'll need to start by learning an enchantment.
traduit: 啊，附魔学徒啊。你需要从学习一种附魔效果开始。

original: Take an enchanted weapon or piece of armor, then use the Arcane Enchanter to learn its secrets. The item is destroyed in the process, so be wary.
traduit: 拿一件附魔武器或护甲来，然后用奥术附魔台来学习它的奥秘。但要注意，这个过程会毁掉附魔品。

original: Once you know an enchantment, you'll need a filled soul gem, and something to enchant. You'll use the Arcane Enchanter for that, too.
traduit: 等你知道了附魔效果，就需要一颗充满灵魂的宝石和用来附魔的物品。这些操作也是在奥术附魔台上进行。

original: Of course, I have everything you need for sale, if you have the coin.
traduit: 当然了，你要的东西我这儿都有，有钱就好商量。

original: I think we're done here.
traduit: 我们没什么关系了吧。

original: Listen, I don't want any trouble. (Persuade)
traduit: 听着，我不想惹麻烦。（说服）

original: Who said anything about trouble? Now get out of my face.
traduit: 谁要有麻烦了？现在从我眼前消失。

original: Gods, you're boring!
traduit: 神啊，你可真无聊！

original: Back off. Now. (Intimidate)
traduit: 现在滚远点。（恐吓）

original: What's a milk drinker like you doing out here? Go home to your mother.
traduit: 你这么个软蛋在这里干什么呢？滚回家找你妈去吧。

original: Get out of my face.
traduit: 从我眼前消失。

original: You shouldn't talk to me like that.
traduit: 你不该这么和我讲话。

original: Why? What are you gonna do, cry?
traduit: 怎么？你想怎么样，哭一包吗？

original: Can you play "The Dragonborn Comes"?
traduit: 你能演奏“龙裔归来”吗？

original: Just make sure to take care of whatever's going on there. It's my name on the line.
traduit: 只要确保处理好那里的一切就行了。这也关乎我的名声。

original: Whatever you're getting paid, I'll double it. (<BribeCost> gold)
traduit: 不管你接了多少钱，我付双倍。（<BribeCost>金币）

original: You want to pay me to do my job? Fine. I'll mark the location on your map.
traduit: 你想付钱然后还替我干活儿？好吧。我在你地图上标出来。

original: Tell me where you're going before someone gets hurt. (Intimidate)
traduit: 最好在有人受伤前告诉我你的目的地。（恐吓）

original: All right, all right! No need to get violent. We're on the same side.
traduit: 好吧，好吧！没必要动粗么。我们是一边的。

original: I'll mark it on your map. This one's on you.
traduit: 我给你标在地图上。这活儿归你了。

original: Someone's going to get hurt, all right.
traduit: 有人会受伤是吧，好啊。

original: I could save you a lot of trouble... (Persuade)
traduit: 我可以帮你省去很多麻烦的……（说服）

original: If you really want to do my job for me... Here, I'll mark the location on your map.
traduit: 如果你真想干我这份活儿……好吧，我给你在地图上标出来。

original: No, I think I've got this one. Thanks, though.
traduit: 不了，我自己去解决。谢谢了。

original: Where are you headed?
traduit: 你要去哪里啊？

original: I probably shouldn't tell everyone who asks. This is important business, you know.
traduit: 也许我没必要回答所有人。你得理解，这是很要紧的事。

original: There's been word of some trouble nearby. I'm on my way to investigate.
traduit: 有消息说附近有些麻烦。我正要去探个究竟。

original: Now I have some time to kill...
traduit: 所以，恕我失陪了……

original: Greetings, brother. You look weary. I have something to help you relax, if you're interested.
traduit: 你好啊，兄弟。你看起来乏透了。我这里有东西可以帮你放松放松，有兴趣吗？

original: Greetings, sister. You look weary. I have something to help you relax, if you're interested.
traduit: 你好啊，姐妹。你看起来乏透了。我这里有东西可以帮你放松放松，有兴趣吗？

original: Nice doing business with you, friend.
traduit: 很高兴和你做生意，朋友。

original: This one has something sweet for the fellow traveler, if it entices.
traduit: 如果你愿意的话，这东西会给你的旅伴带来些甜头的。

original: Important deliveries to make! No time for chatting!
traduit: 有要紧东西要送！没时间说话了！

original: Instead of projecting the sky, we project all of Tamriel, and then harness the latent energies to overlay the positions of...
traduit: 我们不是投影天空，而是整个泰姆瑞尔，然后利用潜在的能量，覆盖并定位出……

original: Have you ever seen the Orrery in the Imperial City? It was the inspiration for this idea.
traduit: 你见过帝都的星象仪吗？那就是这个想法的灵感来源了。

original: This projection should be lit up like the night sky...
traduit: 这投影本该像夜空般明亮才对……

original: I have nothing to say to you. Now move along, or I'll order my guards to attack.
traduit: 我跟你没什么好说的。快退下，否则我就让我的护卫动手了。

original: Keep away. If I am harmed, people will come looking.
traduit: 退下。要是我被伤到了，人们都会跑来护卫的。

original: What's the paint on the cow for, again?
traduit: 再跟我说一遍牛身上的图画是干什么的？

original: And the paint on the cow?
traduit: 那牛身上的图画是怎么回事？

original: Thanks. You take care of yourself, now.
traduit: 谢谢。你也得照顾好自己。

original: The cow, of course. Others do it differently, but I've found that an annual offering usually keeps the giants away from our livestock.
traduit: 当然是奶牛了。其他人可能做法不同，但我发现每年献上祭品就能让巨人们在一般情况下远离我们的家畜。

original: Some think it's superstition, but I believe it works. I've yet to have a giant kill any of my livestock.
traduit: 有些人觉得这是迷信，但我觉得是有效的。我还没见过巨人来杀我的家畜呢。

original: What are you offering to the giants?
traduit: 你给巨人带的是什么？

original: I have everything under control. Thanks for offering.
traduit: 一切还在我能力范围内。谢谢你的好意了。

original: Need any help?
traduit: 需要帮忙吗？

original: I'm headed to the inn.
traduit: 我要去找家旅店了。

original: It's tradition. We mark the animal as a way to let the giants know we're giving it to them willingly. Sort of a peace offering.
traduit: 这是传统。我们在动物身上涂画记号，让巨人知道我们是自愿将它献给他们的。算是一种表达和平的礼物。

original: My wife's going to kill me when I tell her we'll need to bring another cow.
traduit: 如果我告诉我妻子我们还得重新养头牛，她会杀了我的。

original: Either way this ends up, I'm headed to the inn.
traduit: 不管怎样，我都得去旅馆歇歇了。

original: I'm on my way to a giant camp and I can't guarantee those beasts won't think you're part of the offering.
traduit: 我要去巨人营地，我可不保证那些野兽会不会把你当成祭品的一部分。

original: Keep your distance and you shouldn't have anything to worry about.
traduit: 保持距离，就没什么可担心的。

original: I'd stay away if I were you.
traduit: 如果我是你，我就会躲远点。

original: No. I was too afraid to look. I don't know what we're going to do now. We have nothing left.
traduit: 没有。我害怕得不敢看。我不知道现在该怎么办。我们一无所有了。

original: Did you see where the dragon went?
traduit: 你看到龙去哪了吗？

original: Then you've seen them, too. We lost our home, our livestock... We barely have enough gold to get by.
traduit: 这么说你也见过它们了。我们失去了家园，牲畜……剩下的钱只够勉强维生了。

original: I know. I was at Helgen.
traduit: 我知道，我当时就在海尔根。

original: It's true about the dragons returning. Saw it with my own eyes.
traduit: 龙族回来的传言是真的。我亲眼所见。

original: Thank you for the gold, traveler.
traduit: 谢谢你的资助，旅行者。

original: That's okay. We'll find a way to get by. Safe travels.
traduit: 没关系的。我们会想办法的。路上要小心啊。

original: Understandable. Be on your way.
traduit: 理解理解。请吧。

original: Thanks for wasting my time.
traduit: 多谢你浪费我时间了啊。

original: That's right.
traduit: 这就对了。

original: Sorry, I'll be leaving now.
traduit: 抱歉，我这就走。

original: Does it involve sneaking and stabbing? Ooh, please say yes!
traduit: 包括偷偷摸摸和捅刀子吗？哦，一定要有啊！

original: Just name it.
traduit: 吩咐吧。

original: Of course, Listener. What is it?
traduit: 当然，聆听者。什么事？

original: This way!
traduit: 这边走！

original: Funny, when I was a boy, Imperial walls and towers used to make me feel so safe.
traduit: 有意思，我小时候感觉帝国的城墙和塔楼特别让人心安。

original: Rorikstead. I'm... I'm from Rorikstead.
traduit: 洛利克镇。我……我来自洛利克镇。

original: A Nord's last thoughts should be of home.
traduit: 一个诺德人的遗愿，应该是落叶归根。

original: Why do you care?
traduit: 你问这干什么？

original: Hey, what village are you from horse thief?
traduit: 嘿，偷马贼，你从哪来啊？

original: Give them their last rites.
traduit: 给他们做最后的仪式吧。

original: Yes, General Tullius.
traduit: 遵命，图留斯将军。

original: Ditched it for this. Easier to sneak past the enemy.
traduit: 为了骗过敌人我把它扔了。

original: I suppose it would be. Good thinking.
traduit: 我想也是。好主意。

original: I'll say what I like to him.
traduit: 我想跟他说什么就说什么。

original: Of course. That's your choice. I just wanted to let you know.
traduit: 当然。这是你的权力。我只是想提醒你一下。

original: Thanks for the warning.
traduit: 多谢提醒。

original: You're welcome.
traduit: 客气了。

original: No, no. Well, I don't think so.
traduit: 不，不。嗯，没什么问题。

original: What does it matter what I say to him?
traduit: 我跟他说又有什么关系？

original: Between the two of us, there are rumors about him. That this "advisor" position he has is a sham, an excuse.
traduit: 咱们私底下说，关于他的谣言很多。他这个“顾问”职位就是个借口。

original: That what he's really doing is spying for the Thalmor, trying to feed them information. Whether it's true, I can't say.
traduit: 他实际上是梭默的间谍，为他们提供情报。至于是否是真，我也说不准。

original: But it never hurts to be a little suspicious, does it?
traduit: 但怀疑一下总没坏处，对吧？

original: Why would Ancano be looking for me?
traduit: 为什么安卡诺要找我？

original: I'm not sure. Just... Well, mind what you tell him, all right?
traduit: 我也不知道。只是……和他说话的时候要注意点，好吗？

original: There you are. I've been trying to find you.
traduit: 你在这儿啊。我一直在找你。

original: I just wanted to let you know that Ancano's been asking about you. I think he's looking for you.
traduit: 我只是来告诉你，安卡诺一直在问你的事。我想他应该是在找你。

original: Has everyone here forgotten their training? Kill that thing!
traduit: 都忘了怎么训练的了不成？杀了那东西！

original: Damn you mages! Aren't you good for anything?
traduit: 你们这群该死的法师！你们还能干好什么？

original: I want every arrow in the sky!
traduit: 弓箭手给我向天上瞄准了！

original: Lead with those arrows, dammit!
traduit: 该死的，给我中啊！

original: Up through the tower, let's go!
traduit: 从塔顶冲过去，我们走！

original: Jarl Ulfric! What is that thing? Could the legends be true?
traduit: 乌弗瑞克领主！那是什么东西？传说成真了？

original: What do you know about Ancano?
traduit: 你对安卡诺有什么了解？

original: Don't trust that one. He's up to something.
traduit: 别信他。他肯定在谋划什么。

original: Most here are up to something, of course, but in his case, it's not good.
traduit: 当然，这里大部分人都有自己的规划，不过就他而言，恐怕不是什么好事。

original: I haven't figured it out yet, but I will.
traduit: 我想不出是什么，但我会想通的。

original: He is rather handsome though, isn't he?
traduit: 不过他倒是挺帅的，不是吗？

original: He's asked far, far too many questions about my research.
traduit: 他问了太多关于我研究的问题了。

original: I think the Thalmor are trying to steal my work!
traduit: 我觉得梭默是想盗我的成果！

original: I haven't told him anything, of course. What I'm doing is far too important. Can't breathe a word of it.
traduit: 当然，我什么都没告诉他。我做的事太重要了。一个字也不能透。

original: I know I don't like the way he looks at me.
traduit: 我不喜欢他看我的眼神。

original: I can't tell if he expects me to blow myself up, or to try and murder him. But he clearly doesn't trust any of us.
traduit: 我不知道他是想让我炸死自己，还是炸死他。但显然他不信任我们。

original: I know he's from the Thalmor, and that he claims to be here simply as an advisor.
traduit: 我听说他来自梭默，还只是来当顾问。

original: I also know that no one really believes that. I've been trying to avoid him, honestly.
traduit: 我也知道没人信。说实话，我一直都在躲着他。

original: There's a rumor that you're spying for the Thalmor.
traduit: 有传言说你在替梭默当间谍。

original: Preposterous, and just the sort of thing I would expect from mages who have nothing better to do with their time.
traduit: 荒谬，这些无所事事的法师只会干这种事。

original: I have made it quite clear that my only role here is as an advisor to the Arch-Mage.
traduit: 我已经说得很清楚了，我在这里的唯一职责就是担任大法师的顾问。

original: I would suggest that you not further spread this rumor.
traduit: 劝你莫再散布谣言。

original: Thank you for your help. You may go now.
traduit: 多谢你的帮助。你可以走了。

original: Why does this matter to you?
traduit: 这对你很重要吗？

original: Something was discovered in Saarthal that was significant enough that Tolfdir sent a new member of the College, alone, to deliver word.
traduit: 在萨瑟尔发现了一些十分重要的东西，以至于托夫迪尔派来一个新学徒来传话。

original: That sounds precisely like the sort of thing that should matter to everyone. Especially me.
traduit: 听起来是应该人人关心的事情，尤其是我。

original: How do you know anything about this?
traduit: 你是怎么知道的？

original: It is my job to know these things.
traduit: 了解这些正是我的工作。

original: My role as advisor to the Arch-Mage is aided by knowing everything that transpires here.
traduit: 我作为大法师的顾问，正需要通过了解这里发生的一切来履行职责。

original: Yes, we did. I just informed the Arch-Mage.
traduit: 没错。我刚刚通知了大法师。

original: I am well aware. Tolfdir is still in Saarthal, is he? I shall be expecting a full report from him when he returns.
traduit: 我很清楚。托夫迪尔还在萨瑟尔是吧？我期待他回来时给我一份详细的报告。

original: Maybe...
traduit: 也许吧……

original: I know full well that you have. Please do not insult my intelligence.
traduit: 我很清楚你们的行动。请勿侮辱我的智商。

original: Tolfdir is still there now, is he? I shall expect a full report when he returns.
traduit: 托夫迪尔还在那儿吧？我期待他回来的时候拿出一份详细的报告。

original: You there. I have questions for you.
traduit: 喂。我有事问你。

original: You were in Saarthal, yes? It has come to my attention that something was found there.
traduit: 你们去了萨瑟尔对吧？我注意到那里发现了一些东西。

original: Let's cut you loose.
traduit: 我给你松绑吧。

original: Come on, you need your hands free.
traduit: 过来，你得把双手解开。

original: Those binds aren't going to cut themselves.
traduit: 这绳子可不会自己解开。

original: Hooray for the Arch-Mage!
traduit: 为大法师欢呼吧！

original: Glory to the Arch-Mage!
traduit: 大法师万岁！

original: Well done, well done indeed!
traduit: 干得好，干得好啊！

original: Congratulations!
traduit: 恭喜！

original: Long live the Arch-Mage!
traduit: 大法师万岁！

original: Members of the College -- your new Arch-Mage!
traduit: 学院的成员们——欢迎你们的新任大法师！

original: You've done it! The College is safe again, thanks to your work.
traduit: 你成功了！多亏了你啊，学院现在安全了。

original: I knew you had it in you. I daresay the Psijics are right. There's no one more deserving to be Arch-Mage, in my opinion.
traduit: 我知道你有这个能力。我看赛伊克说得对。没人比你更有资格担任大法师了。

original: Here, consider these yours. And the Arch-Mage's quarters as well. I shall be here for advice, should you need me.
traduit: 来，给你这个。还有大法师的住处。如果你需要的话，我会为你提供意见。

original: And speak to Eorlund if you want a better weapon than... whatever that is.
traduit: 如果你想要更好的武器，就去找厄伦德吧……他那儿什么都有。

original: At Helgen, they said you shouted the King to death?
traduit: 我在海尔根听到，他们说你把至高王吼杀了？

original: Not entirely true, though not entirely false either.
traduit: 不全对但也不全错。

original: Any Nord can learn the Way of the Voice by studying with the Greybeards, given enough ambition and dedication.
traduit: 只要有足够的抱负和奉献精神，任何诺德人都可以向灰胡子学习吼声之道。

original: My shouting Torygg to the ground proved he had neither.
traduit: 我用龙吼击败了托依格，证明他两者皆无。

original: However, it was my sword piercing his heart that killed him.
traduit: 但是，他是死于被剑刺穿了心脏。

original: I'm out of missives, but I need some more.
traduit: 我已经派完册子了，但我还想再要些。

original: Certainly! Glad to see you have the task well at hand.
traduit: 当然！很高兴看到你把手上的任务完成得这么好。

original: Move!
traduit: 动起来！

original: What are you waiting for? Go!
traduit: 你等什么呢？快走！

original: They're hurt, but they'll live.
traduit: 他们受伤了，但死不了。

original: We'll have to carry this one on our backs....
traduit: 我们得背他走……

original: Another second out there with the dragon, and they'd both be dead....
traduit: 再跟那龙待一秒，他们都得死……

original: You Imperial bastards!
traduit: 你们这群帝国杂种！

original: Death to the Stormcloaks!
traduit: 杀了这群风暴斗篷！

original: Justice!
traduit: 正义！

original: This was all I could find.
traduit: 我就找到这些。

original: I see. It probably doesn't even matter now, what with the mess that's been made in here.
traduit: 我知道了。现在可能已经不重要了。这里被弄得一团糟。

original: I'll add this to the rest of the items. I don't think there's anything further I need from you.
traduit: 我会把这个加到剩下的物品里。我想应该不需要你再做什么了。

original: You're in luck. I happen to already have the mold.
traduit: 你走运了。我刚好拿到了模具。

original: Oh, Beem-Ja. I never meant for this. What have I done?
traduit: 哦，毕姆-加。我不是故意的。我都干了什么？

original: Beem-Ja!
traduit: 毕姆-加！

original: What are you doing? Get off the road!
traduit: 干什么呢？让开！

original: Get off the road, boy!
traduit: 孩子，别在路上站着！

original: Haming, get over here!
traduit: 哈明快过来！

original: Just walk towards me, come on!
traduit: 往我这边走，快！

original: Don't look up. Just focus on me. You can do it!
traduit: 别左顾右看。盯着我，你能做到！

original: Legends don't burn down villages.
traduit: 区区传说可不能把村庄夷为平地。

original: By bringing down my other Hunters, you turned the chase inside out.
traduit: 你打倒了我其他的猎人，将一场围捕彻底扭转。

original: And they were no base prey.
traduit: 他们并不是低劣的猎物。

original: You continue to amuse and impress. Go forth, with my blessing.
traduit: 你可以继续取悦我。去吧，带上我的祝福。

original: I failed to bring down Sinding.
traduit: 我没能打倒辛丁。

original: Not a failure, my servant.
traduit: 这不算失败，仆人。

original: I defy you and your vile tasks.
traduit: 我鄙视你和你的卑劣任务。

original: So you may think.
traduit: 随你怎么想。

original: Well met again, Hunter.
traduit: 又见面了，猎人。

original: Come on, this way!
traduit: 快，这边走！

original: Through here. Let's go!
traduit: 穿过这，我们走！

original: I can cut you loose inside. Come on!
traduit: 我会给你松绑的。快走！

original: You! Come on, into the keep!
traduit: 你！快过来，进堡垒里去！

original: Fine. I hope that dragon takes you all to Sovngarde.
traduit: 好吧。但愿这龙把你们全都送到松加德。

original: We're escaping, Hadvar. You're not stopping us this time.
traduit: 哈达瓦，我们要逃了。这次你阻止不了我们。

original: Ralof! You damned traitor. Out of my way!
traduit: 拉罗夫！你个叛徒。别挡路！

original: You never mentioned that lunatic living in the tunnels.
traduit: 你从没提起隧道里住着个疯子。

original: I thought it would be better to leave some of the details out of our previous discussion. Didn't want to risk you walking away from the job.
traduit: 我觉得先前讨论的一些细节还是不要再提了。我是不想你撂挑子。

original: Besides, you've done Maven a favor getting rid of him and saved me from wasting coin hiring someone else to do it later.
traduit: 再说，你把他除掉也算是帮了玛雯一个大忙，也省得我花钱去雇其他人。

original: You're not sweet-talking your way out of this. Not after what you did. You're headed to Cidhna Mine, and that's that.
traduit: 别想靠花言巧语脱身。你做了那些事，现在要去希讷矿场了。就这样。

original: All right, but you just watch yourself. Next time, I might not be so lenient.
traduit: 好吧，但注意点。下次可不会这么仁慈了。

original: Don't bother with that. Lost the key ages ago. Poor fellow screamed for weeks.
traduit: 别管那个了。钥匙早就丢了。那个倒霉蛋在里头嚎了几个星期。

original: See if you can get it open with some picks. We'll need everything we can get.
traduit: 看看能不能把它撬开。我们得尽量获取一切能拿到的东西。

original: With me, prisoner. Let's go!
traduit: 囚犯，跟我走。快！

original: Mage, eh? Well, to each his own. It's not for me to judge.
traduit: 法师？好吧，人各有志，我不多评价了。

original: Thief, eh? It's never too late to take charge of your own fate, you know.
traduit: 盗贼？要知道浪子回头金不换啊。

original: Warrior, good! Those stars will guide you to honor and glory.
traduit: 战士？好！那些星星会引导你走向荣耀与辉煌。

original: Go ahead, see for yourself.
traduit: 去吧，自己看看。

original: These are the Guardian Stones, three of the thirteen ancient standing stones that dot Skyrim's landscape.
traduit: 这是守护之石。天际一共有十三块这样的立石分布在各处。

original: Warrior, good! I knew you shouldn't have been on that cart the minute I laid eyes on you.
traduit: 战士？好！我一见你就知道你不该被抓上马车的。

original: Hey now, don't take all the good stuff!
traduit: 嘿，别把好东西都拿走了！

original: Oh, Beem...
traduit: 哦，毕姆……

original: Father never trusted Beem. I always thought he was just being overprotective.
traduit: 父亲一直不信任毕姆。我总觉得他是保护欲过剩。

original: Beem! What are you doing? Stop it!
traduit: 毕姆！你在干什么？快停下！

original: No Thanks
traduit: 不用了。

original: Each has their own way.
traduit: 那就随便吧。

original: This doesn't seem legal.
traduit: 这好像不合法吧。

original: Ah, a snitch, eh? Can't have you running to any guards now, can I?
traduit: 啊，想告密？现在不能让你去找卫兵了，对吧？

original: Just give me what you have and we both walk away from this. (Intimidate)
traduit: 把你的东西给我，咱们各走各路。（恐吓）

original: No need to get so... hostile. Just take it. Sounds like you need it more than I do.
traduit: 没必要……剑拔弩张的。给你。看起来你比我需要。

original: Yeah... That's not going to happen.
traduit: 是啊……那是不可能的。

original: The finest skooma, the sweetest moon sugar. At a fair price, of course.
traduit: 上好的斯库玛，最甜的月亮糖。价格公道。

original: It's in the clouds!
traduit: 它在云里！

original: As fearless in death as he was in life.
traduit: 他无论生前还是面对死亡，都是那么勇敢。

original: It has been an honor, Jarl Ulfric!
traduit: 这是我的荣幸，乌弗瑞克领主！

original: Shut up back there!
traduit: 后面的把嘴闭上！

original: Good. Let's get this over with.
traduit: 好。赶紧了结这事吧。

original: Assorted books, scrolls... I'm sure you'll find something useful.
traduit: 书籍、卷轴……相信你能找到有用的。

original: I have a few things laying around that weren't worth adding to the collection. You may look through them.
traduit: 我恰好有些不值当收藏的东西，来看看吧。

original: Please make sure your hands are clean before touching anything, all right?
traduit: 在拿之前手一定要洁净，好吗？

original: Hadvar! Into the keep, soldier, we're leaving!
traduit: 哈达瓦！进堡垒里去，士兵们，我们得走了！

original: We just need to move some of these rocks to clear the way!
traduit: 我们得把石头搬开！

original: With me, up the tower!
traduit: 跟着我，往塔上走！

original: This way, friend! Move!
traduit: 这边走，朋友！快！

original: You know, since Kodlak's funeral the Skyforge feels more... awake.
traduit: 你知道吗，自从克拉科的葬礼之后，天空锻炉感觉更……觉醒了。

original: It's always been said that the souls of the heroes of old are what give Skyforge steel its strength.
traduit: 人们常说，远古英雄的灵魂赋予了天空锻炉钢铁以力量。

original: But I think the forge knows the greatness of Kodlak's soul. I can't really explain, but it feels like it's... young.
traduit: 但我想锻炉应该也知道克拉科灵魂的伟大。我也解释不清，但感觉上它……变得年轻了。

original: I'll wager it could now forge metal the likes of which hasn't been seen since eras long forgotten.
traduit: 我敢打赌，现在它能够锻造出自古以来没有见过的金属。

original: I'm eager to try.
traduit: 我很想试试。

original: That one right there, walking out the door. He was one of them asking about that old man you're looking for.
traduit: 那边要出门的那个。就是他在问你要找的老人在哪。

original: I don't want to help you.
traduit: 我不想帮你。

original: Suit yourself. But those who listen at doors always wonder what is beyond them.
traduit: 随便吧。但在门外偷听的人总是想知道门那边有什么。

original: Eventually your curiosity will drive you back to me.
traduit: 你最后还是会被好奇心带回来。

original: I'm not so easily molded.
traduit: 我可没那么容易被你拿捏。

original: You may think so. But in the end, you mortals will always flit like fire with the winds of your desires and conveniences.
traduit: 你可以这么想。但到最后，你们这些凡人永远会像火一样被自己的欲望之风吹动。

original: And those winds issue from my whispers.
traduit: 这些风都是因我低语而起。

original: Who are you to expect anything?
traduit: 你是哪位？怎么还提上要求了？

original: I forgive your not knowing my name. Few can hear my whispers anymore.
traduit: 我原谅你的无知。毕竟很少有人能听到我的低语。

original: What could the boy not do?
traduit: 有什么是那孩子做不了的？

original: The boy is good at sussing out secrets, but the corruptibility of children is ultimately too limited for my purposes.
traduit: 那个孩子很擅长发掘秘密，但几个小孩儿的堕落对我的目标帮助太小。

original: You, though, I expect will prove far more malleable.
traduit: 但我觉得你可塑性更强。

original: Excellent work, child.
traduit: 干得好，孩子。

original: I can feel their heartbreak swelling in my blade.
traduit: 我能感受到他们心碎的声音在我的刀刃上鼓动。

original: Their tears shine the ebony to a sharpest gleam.
traduit: 他们的泪水让黑檀焕发最耀眼的光芒。

original: Ah, the blood of deceit is a nourishing flow.
traduit: 啊，欺骗之血是何等滋润。

original: At last, my blade is returned to its full glory.
traduit: 我的剑终于恢复了荣耀。

original: Now go forth, child. Continue your tiny subversions against the orders of trust and intimacy.
traduit: 去吧，孩子。继续轻微地颠覆信任与亲密的秩序吧。

original: The blade will feed on the ire of Tamriel. Bathe in your infamy. Feel the weight of their loathing, and my power will course through it once more.
traduit: 那把剑会饱餐泰姆瑞尔的愤怒。沉浸在你自己的恶行中吧。感受他们对你仇恨的重量。我将把我的力量将再次融入其中。

original: Seek out those closest to you. The final pluck of their misguided heartstrings will accompany my blade in the song of your grandeur.
traduit: 寻找你最亲近的人们。他们被欺骗的心弦那最后一声弹拨，会和我的剑一起组成你华丽的乐章。

original: Your world is admirably seeped in lies and inclinations. My blade is a darling leech that feeds on deceptions, and nourishes its master.
traduit: 你的世界流溢着令人赞叹的谎言和欺诈。我的剑能够像水蛭一般以欺骗为食，滋养它的主人。

original: To return to its past glory, it must reacquaint itself with the hatred of this world.
traduit: 想要重现昔日光辉，它就必须重拾这个世界对它的仇恨。

original: To return to its past glory, it must first drink the blood of deceit.
traduit: 想要恢复它往日的光辉，就必须饱饮欺骗之血。

original: In Reachwater Rock, I found a cryptic message that said the tomb here had been sealed, and should be forgotten forever. What is the story of this place?
traduit: 我在触水岩发现了一条神秘的信息，说这里的坟墓被封住了，应该被永远遗忘。这地方有什么故事？

original: In Folgunthur, I found a cryptic message on the body of a powerful Draugr, condemning him for his ancient crimes. What was his story? Why was he entombed with a broken amulet?
traduit: 我在佛古恩瑟一个强大的尸鬼身上发现了一条神秘的信息，谴责他曾经犯下的罪行。他有什么故事？为什么他的护符是破碎的？

original: In Geirmund's Hall, I found a cryptic message on the body of a powerful Draugr, condemning him for his ancient crimes. What was his story? Why was he entombed with a broken amulet?

original: In Saarthal, I found a cryptic message on the body of a powerful Draugr, condemning him for his ancient crimes. What was his story? Why was he entombed with a broken amulet?
traduit: 我在萨瑟尔一个强大的尸鬼身上发现了一条神秘的信息，谴责他曾经犯下的罪行。他有什么故事？为什么他的护符是破碎的？

original: Long ago, the Archmage Gauldur was murdered, and his three sons were hunted down by King Harald's personal battlemage. The entire incident was covered up, their names struck from every record. But the legend survived. Perhaps someone still knows the truth of this ancient tale.
traduit: 多年以前，大法师高尔多被害，他的三个儿子被哈拉尔德王的私人战斗法师追杀。整个事件都被掩盖起来了，他们的名字也被从所有记录中删去了。但这个传说还是流传了下来。也许有人知道这个古老传说的真相。

original: Long ago, the Archmage Gauldur was murdered, and his three sons were hunted down by King Harald's personal battlemage. The mage Daynas Valen spent his life searching for the truth of this tale, and came to Folgunthur with the key needed to unlock its secret.
traduit: 多年以前，大法师高尔多被害，他的三个儿子被哈拉尔德王的私人战斗法师追杀。法师戴纳斯·维兰终其一生都在寻找这个故事的真相，他带着解开秘密的钥匙来到了佛古恩瑟。

original: Long ago, the Archmage Gauldur was murdered by his three sons, who stole his amulet of power and divided it among themselves. The brothers were hunted down in secret and sealed in tombs across Skyrim. To reclaim the amulet, I will need to seek out their final resting places.
traduit: 多年前，大法师高尔多被他的三个儿子谋杀，他们偷走了他的强大护符并一分为三。三兄弟遭到秘密追捕，并被封印在天际的古墓中。为了找回护符，我需要找到他们的安息之地。

original: Long ago, the Archmage Gauldur was murdered by his three sons, who stole his amulet of power and divided it among themselves. I defeated the brothers and reclaimed the fragments of the amulet. Perhaps Gauldur's tomb holds the secret to restoring it to its original form.
traduit: 多年前，大法师高尔多被他的三个儿子谋杀，他们偷走了他的强大护符并一分为三。我击败了他们兄弟三人，夺回了护符碎片。也许高尔多的墓中有让护符复原的秘密。

original: Long ago, the Archmage Gauldur was murdered by his three sons, who stole his amulet of power and divided it among themselves. I collected the fragments of the shattered amulet and brought them to Gauldur's tomb, where the ghosts of the three brothers ambushed me.
traduit: 多年前，大法师高尔多被他的三个儿子谋杀，他们偷走了他的强大护符并一分为三。我收集了护符的残片，把它们带到了高尔多的坟墓，三兄弟的鬼魂在那里伏击了我。

original: Long ago, the Archmage Gauldur was murdered by his three sons, who stole his amulet of power and divided it among themselves. I defeated the undead brothers, located the fragments of the shattered amulet, and forged it anew in Gauldur's tomb.
traduit: 多年前，大法师高尔多被他的三个儿子谋杀，他们偷走了他的强大护符并一分为三。我打败了亡灵三兄弟，收集了护符的残片并在高尔多的墓中将其重铸。

original: Farengar Secret-Fire, Jarl Balgruuf's court wizard, asked me to retrieve a Dragonstone from Bleak Falls Barrow, a stone tablet that he believes contains a map of ancient dragon burial sites. original: Outside Frostmere Crypt, I found a group of bandits attacking one of their own. It seems she was implicated when one of her friends stole a sword from the leader of the gang.
