original: In Frostmere Crypt, the bandit Ra'jirr stole a sword from the gang's leader in order to stop the 'Pale Lady', a mysterious figure haunting his dreams. He fled into the tunnels below the ruin, with the bandit leader in pursuit.
traduit: 在霜池地穴，强盗拉'吉尔从帮派首领那里偷了一把剑来阻止“苍白夫人”，因为这个神秘之物一直困扰他的梦境。他逃入了遗迹下面的地道，强盗首领追了下去。

original: In Frostmere Crypt, the bandit Ra'jirr stole a sword from the gang's leader in order to stop the 'Pale Lady', a mysterious figure haunting his dreams. Ra'jirr ambushed and killed the bandit leader before heading into the underground forest.
traduit: 在霜池地穴，强盗拉'吉尔从帮派首领那里偷了一把剑来阻止“苍白夫人”，因为这个神秘之物一直困扰他的梦境。拉'吉尔在进入地下森林前伏杀了强盗首领。

original: In Frostmere Crypt, the bandit Ra'jirr stole a sword from the gang's leader in order to stop the 'Pale Lady', a mysterious figure haunting his dreams. She appeared and attacked before he could use it to seal her away.
traduit: 在霜池地穴，强盗拉'吉尔从帮派首领那里偷了一把剑来阻止“苍白夫人”，因为这个神秘之物一直困扰他的梦境。苍白夫人出现了，趁拉'吉尔还没来得及封印她就袭杀了他。

original: In Frostmere Crypt, the spectral Pale Lady was released when a group of bandits stole the enchanted sword that sealed her tomb. By returning the sword to her altar, I returned her to her rest.
traduit: 在霜池地穴，因为一群强盗偷走了封印墓地的魔法剑，幽灵般的苍白夫人被释放出来。我把剑送回了祭坛，她安息了。

original: In Frostmere Crypt, the spectral Pale Lady was released when a group of bandits stole the enchanted sword that sealed her tomb. I killed her and claimed the sword as my prize.
traduit: 在霜池地穴，因为一群强盗偷走了封印墓地的魔法剑，幽灵般的苍白夫人被释放出来。我杀了她，把剑拿走作为自己的战利品。

original: Arniel has once again asked me to speak to Enthir, who was supposed to deliver something else relating to Arniel's project.
traduit: 阿内尔再次请我去和恩希尔谈谈。恩希尔好像要为阿内尔的项目提供其他东西。

original: Arniel was convinced that Enthir was refusing to complete the trade the two of them had arranged, but it turns out that this time Enthir never received the item in question. The courier bringing the item never arrived. If I want to help Arniel finish his work, I'll need to find the courier myself.
traduit: 阿内尔坚信恩希尔拒绝完成他们之间的交易安排，但事实证明，恩希尔也没有收到指定的物品。送东西的信使一直没到。如果我想帮阿内尔完成工作，就得自己去找信使了。

original: Arniel was distraught over being unable to finish his project, believing that Enthir was refusing to complete a trade the two of them had agreed upon. Instead, the courier that was supposed to deliver the item never arrived. I've tracked him down (sadly he did not survive) and have the package Arniel wanted. I should make sure it gets to Arniel as soon as possible.
traduit: 阿内尔正在因无法完成项目心烦意乱，他认定恩希尔再次拒绝完成约好的交易。事实是，信使从未到达。我找到了已经遇难的信使，拿到了阿内尔想要的包裹。我得尽快把它送到阿内尔那里。

original: I've helped Arniel with the final piece of his project, by tracking down a missing courier who was supposed to be delivering an item from Morrowind. That item is Keening, a dwarven dagger that Arniel claims is very important. With it, he says he's able to finish his experiment and has asked that I observe what happens.
traduit: 我帮助阿内尔找到了他实验所需的最后一样东西，从失踪的信使处拿回了他从晨风送来的矮人匕首“哀鸣”。阿内尔说，有了它就能完成实验，并邀请我在一旁观察。

original: Arniel's experiment is over, but I'm not entirely sure what has happened. He has vanished, leaving behind the dagger Keening. I may never know whether he succeeded in his work.
traduit: 阿内尔的实验结束了，但我不太确定发生了什么。他消失了，只留下了哀鸣匕首。我可能永远也无法知道他是否已经成功了。

original: Arniel has finally revealed to me that his secret project deals with the disappearance of the dwarves, though he hasn't been clear about how his work relates to it. He's given me a warped soul gem, and asked me to find several Dwarven Convectors in the various ruins around Skyrim. I'm supposed to place the gem inside a convector, and then heat it using a spell Arniel has taught me. When I've done this several times, I should return the gem to Arniel.
traduit: 阿内尔终于向我透露了自己的秘密项目与矮人消失之谜有关，尽管他还不清楚自己的研究是否能够成功。他交给我一块扭曲的灵魂石，并让我在天际四处的矮人遗迹里找寻几个矮人环流器。我需要把灵魂石放进环流器，然后用阿内尔教给我的法术进行加热。等我完成后，再把灵魂石还给阿内尔。

original: I've successfully altered Arniel's warped soul gem, and should return it to him. It is somehow critical to his project regarding the disappearance of the dwarves; perhaps he'll explain exactly what he's up to.
traduit: 我成功改变了阿内尔给我的扭曲灵魂石，现在应该还给他了。这可能对他针对矮人消失的计划至关重要，也许他会向我解释自己的想法。

original: I've once again helped Arniel with his secret, and very vague, project relating to the dwarves. He implied that he's waiting for something else, and then finally maybe I'll see what this is all about.
traduit: 我再次帮阿内尔完成了他那神秘又模糊的矮人研究计划。他好像在等待别的东西，也许到时候我就能知道这一切到底怎么回事了。

traduit: 我已经促成了恩希尔和阿内尔之间的交易，并且拿到了阿内尔感兴趣的东西。这是某种灵魂石，但恩希尔觉得毫无用处。我该把它交给阿内尔。

traduit: 我已进行了宣誓，现在成为了黄昏坟墓的守护者、诺克图娜尔女神的忠实哨卫，夜莺。

original: Karliah has finally revealed the fundamental mission of the Nightingales... the guardianship of the Skeleton Key of Nocturnal. This powerful artifact, normally kept safely within the Twilight Sepulcher, has been stolen by Mercer Frey. As a Nightingale, the duty to recover the Skeleton Key falls squarely upon my shoulders.
traduit: 卡莱亚终于揭示了夜莺的根本使命——守护诺克图娜尔的万能钥匙。这个强大的神器通常被安全地保存于黄昏坟墓里，却被墨瑟·弗雷偷走了。身为夜莺，找回万能钥匙的责任落在了我的肩上。

original: I've passed through Alduin's portal into Sovngarde, the realm of Aetherius where the souls of Nord heroes go to feast and battle until the final reckoning. Alduin has laid some kind of soul-snare across the valley of Sovngarde, a mist where he hides and feeds upon the trapped souls. I reached the Hall of Heroes and met Gormlaith Golden-Hilt, Hakon One-Eye, and Felldir the Old - the three heroes who I saw defeat Alduin in my vision of the past. They have been permitted by Shor, the god of the underworld, to join me in my battle against Alduin.
traduit: 我已经通过奥杜因的传送门进入了松加德。这里是光界的领域，诺德英灵们在那里欢宴战斗直至最终决战到来。奥杜因在松加德的山谷中布下了某种灵魂陷阱，他藏身在迷雾中并以被困的灵魂为食。我在英雄大厅遇到了“金剑柄”葛姆拉丝、“独眼”哈肯、“老者”费迪尔，我曾在幻象中看到这三位英雄击败了奥杜因。他们得到幽域之神舒尔的许可，加入了我对抗奥杜因的战斗。

original: After I defeated Alduin on the top of the Throat of the World, he fled from me. One of his dragon allies may be able to tell me where he's gone. original: After I defeated Alduin on the top of the Throat of the World, he fled from me. One of his dragon allies may be able to tell me where he's gone. With the help of the Jarl of Whiterun, I've trapped the dragon Odahviing in Dragonsreach. Odahviing revealed that Alduin's lair is located in the ancient temple of Skuldafn, which is only accessible by air. Odahviing has offered to take me there, in return for his freedom.
traduit: 我在世界之喉之巅击败了奥杜因。他逃走了。他的龙族盟友也许能告诉我他的去向。在白漫城领主的帮助下，我在龙临宫活捉了巨龙傲达威英。傲达威英透露，奥杜因的巢穴在远古神殿斯库达芬，只能靠飞行到达。傲达威英提出带我过去，以换取自由。

original: I returned to Nazir, but he directed me to speak with Astrid immediately. Perhaps she's made up her mind about me seeing Amaund Motierre in Volundruud.
traduit: 我回到纳兹尔处，但他让我马上和阿斯垂德谈话。也许她决定让我去沃伦鲁德会见阿蒙德·莫提雷了。

original: Astrid has agreed to let me see Amaund Motierre in the dungeon known as Volunruud, as commanded by the Night Mother. I'm to speak with Motierre, and find out what he wants.
traduit: 阿斯垂德已经同意让我遵照夜母的命令到沃伦鲁德去见阿蒙德·莫提雷。我要和莫提雷谈谈，看看他想要什么。

original: Amaund Motierre has commissioned the Dark Brotherhood to kill several people, all of which will lead to the assassination of a primary target - the Emperor of Tamriel himself. I am to report this information back to Astrid.
traduit: 阿蒙德·莫提雷委托黑暗兄弟会去刺杀几个人，而这一切都会指向刺杀行动的主要目标——泰姆瑞尔皇帝。我要把这个消息汇报给阿斯垂德。

original: I've given Astrid the amulet and sealed letter provided to me by Amaund Motierre. I'm to take the amulet to a fence named Delvin Mallory, in the Riften Ratway - to gain any information I can, and sell it if Mallory is willing to buy.
traduit: 我已经把护身符和阿蒙德·莫提雷的密封信交给了阿斯垂德。我要带着护符去找裂谷城鼠道里的销赃人戴尔文·马洛里，搜集能够得到的任何信息，如果马洛里愿意收购的话，我就把它卖掉。

original: Delvin Mallory has informed me that the amulet provided by Amaund Motierre indicates he is a member of the Emperor's Elder Council. Mallory was willing to purchase the amulet in exchange for a letter of credit, which I must now deliver to Astrid.
traduit: 戴尔文·马洛里告诉我，阿蒙德·莫提雷提供的护身符证明他是皇帝的元老成员。马洛里愿意用信用凭证换取护身符，我要把凭证交给阿斯垂德。

original: After meeting with Amaund Motierre, I learned he is a member of the Elder Council, and wants the Dark Brotherhood to kill several people, all of whom lead to a primary target - the Emperor himself.
traduit: 与阿蒙德·莫提雷会面后，我得知了他是元老院的一员，想让黑暗兄弟会杀死几个人，而这一切都是为了引向刺杀的主要目标——皇帝。

original: I've heard rumors there's some kind of problem in the Orc settlement of Largashbur, southwest of Riften.
traduit: 我听说位于裂谷城西南的兽人据点拉加施布尔出了些问题。

original: The orcs of Largashbur are besieged by giants, and have been forbidden to leave their stronghold. Atub, the wise woman of the tribe, has asked me to find her Troll Fat and a Daedra Heart so that she may contact Malacath for guidance.
traduit: 拉加施布尔的兽人们被巨人包围，还被禁止离开要塞。部落的女智者阿图布让我为她找些巨魔脂肪和一颗迪德拉之心，这样她就可以联系玛拉凯斯寻求指引。

original: Malacath has spoken to his followers and expressed disappointment in them. He is angry they allowed his shrine to be desecrated, and has commanded the chieftain of Largashbur, Yamarz, to return to the shrine and reclaim it.
traduit: 玛拉凯斯对追随者们感到失望，也对他们纵容祭坛被亵渎的行为感到愤怒。他命令拉加施布尔的酋长亚马兹去夺回祭坛。

original: Despite being specifically instructed by Malacath to see to it himself, Yamarz wants my help in defeating the giants that have overrun Fallowstone Cave and the shrine of Malacath. He's promised to pay me in exchange for making sure he arrives there safely.
traduit: 尽管玛拉凯斯特别命令要亲自前往，但亚马兹还是希望我能帮他打败那些侵占休石洞穴和玛拉凯斯祭坛的巨人。他答应在安全到达后付我报酬。

original: After Malacath ordered him to retake the shrine in Fallowstone Cave, Yamarz insisted that I escort him there to make sure he arrived safely. Now he has offered to pay me even more in exchange for killing the giant myself, to which I have agreed.
traduit: 玛拉凯斯命令亚马兹夺回休石洞穴的祭坛，但亚马兹坚持要我护送，以确保安全抵达。现在他提出付更高的报酬，由我去杀巨人。我同意了。

original: After escorting Yamarz to Fallowstone Cave and proving myself more worthy, Malacath has commanded me to return to Largashbur and deliver Shagrol's Hammer there.
traduit: 在护送亚马兹抵达休石洞穴并证明自己更有价值后，玛拉凯斯命我带着沙葛洛之锤返回拉加施布尔。

original: The curse placed on the Orcs of Largashbur is lifted. The tribe's leader, Yamarz, was revealed as a shiftless weakling in Malacath's eyes, and I have redeemed his actions by defeating the giant that had taken over the shrine in Fallowstone Cave. Malacath has named Gularzob as the new chief, and has named me his new Champion.
traduit: 拉加施布尔兽人们身上的诅咒被解除了。玛拉凯斯认为部落酋长亚马兹是个无能的弱者，而我击败了侵占休石洞穴祭坛的巨人，弥补了亚马兹的过错。玛拉凯斯任命古拉佐伯为酋长，又任命我为新任勇士。

original: It seems that things are worse than even Delphine thought. Dragons aren't just coming back to life, they're being resurrected by other dragons. original: It seems that things are worse than even Delphine thought. Dragons aren't just coming back to life, they're being resurrected by other dragons. traduit: 情况比戴尔芬预想的还糟糕。龙族是被其他龙复活的。戴尔芬怀疑是梭默带着龙族回来作恶。她会协助我潜入梭默大使馆，查看他们对龙族的了解。我要去独孤城的眨眼恶鼠旅店和她的线人马伯恩碰头。

original: It seems that things are worse than even Delphine thought. Dragons aren't just coming back to life, they're being resurrected by other dragons. Delphine suspects that the Thalmor might be bringing dragons back for some sinister purpose. I met with her contact, Malborn, who is going to smuggle some of my equipment into the Thalmor ambassador's manor. I'm going to infiltrate the manor posing as a guest at the ambassador's party. Once inside, I need to meet up with Malborn and figure out a way to slip away from the party without being caught.
traduit: 情况比戴尔芬预想的还糟糕。龙族是被其他龙复活的。戴尔芬怀疑是梭默带着龙族回来作恶。我和她的线人马伯恩碰过头了。他会帮我把装备偷运进梭默大使馆。我需要扮成宴会宾客潜入大使馆的庄园里。进去后我就得找到马伯恩，想办法在不被发现的情况下溜出宴会。

original: It seems that things are worse than even Delphine thought. Dragons aren't just coming back to life, they're being resurrected by other dragons. I infiltrated the manor posing as a guest at the ambassador's party. Now I need to search the ambassador's office to find out what the Thalmor know about the dragons.
traduit: 情况比戴尔芬预想的还糟糕。龙族是被其他龙复活的。戴尔芬怀疑是梭默带着龙族回来作恶。她的线人马伯恩帮我偷运了一些装备进入大使馆。我也冒充大使宴会的宾客混进了庄园。现在我得搜查大使馆办公室，看看梭默对龙有什么了解。

original: It seems that things are worse than even Delphine thought. Dragons aren't just coming back to life, they're being resurrected by other dragons. Delphine suspects that the Thalmor might be bringing dragons back for some sinister purpose. With the help of her contact, Malborn, I infiltrated the manor posing as a guest at the ambassador's party. I've now learned that the Thalmor are just as in the dark as we are - in fact, they're searching Riften for a Blade named Esbern, who they believe knows what the return of the dragons means.
traduit: 情况比戴尔芬预想的还糟糕。龙族是被其他龙复活的。戴尔芬怀疑是梭默带着龙族回来作恶。在线人马伯恩的协助下，我以宴会宾客的身份混进使馆庄园。我现在查清，梭默跟我们一样蒙在鼓里。事实上他们正在裂谷城搜寻一个叫伊思本的刀锋会成员，他们认为这个人知晓龙族回归的意义。

original: Delphine believes that dragons are coming back to life and that only the Dragonborn can stop them. Near Kynesgrove, we saw a dragon Shouting another one back to life. That dragon is dead, and now it's time for Delphine to give me some answers.
traduit: 戴尔芬相信龙族正在复活，只有龙裔可以阻止它们。我们在凯娜之林附近目睹了一头龙在用龙吼复活同伴。复活的那头已经死了。现在该是戴尔芬向我解释的时候了。

original: Delphine believes that dragons are coming back to life and that only the Dragonborn can stop them. It turns out that she was right. Near Kynesgrove, we saw a dragon Shouting another one back to life. After we killed the dragon and I absorbed its power, Delphine accepted that I was Dragonborn as she had hoped, and revealed that she is one of the last members of the Blades, an organization dedicated to protecting the Dragonborn and stopping the dragons.
traduit: 戴尔芬相信龙族正在复活，只有龙裔可以阻止它们。事实证明她说的没错。在凯娜之林附近，我们目睹了一头龙用龙吼将同伴复活。在我们杀死复活的巨龙之后，我吸收了它的力量，戴尔芬接受了我是龙裔的事实。她说她是刀锋会的最后成员之一，他们曾经致力保护龙裔并阻止龙族。

original: With Esbern's help, I've deciphered Alduin's Wall in Sky Haven Temple. It revealed that Alduin was defeated in ancient times by a Shout of some kind. Maybe the Greybeards can teach me this Shout, or at least tell me how I can learn it.
traduit: 在伊思本的帮助下。我破解了天佑神殿的奥杜因之墙。它表明，奥杜因在古代是被一种龙吼打败的。灰胡子也许能教我，或者告诉我怎么去学。

original: With Esbern's help, I've deciphered Alduin's Wall in Sky Haven Temple. It revealed that Alduin was defeated in ancient times by a Shout of some kind. Arngeir knew the name of the Shout, "Dragonrend", but could not teach it to me. However, he has agreed to show me the way to reach Paarthurnax, the Greybeards' leader, who lives at the top of the Throat of the World. Arngeir says that Paarthurnax is the only one who may know this Dragonrend Shout.
traduit: 在伊思本的帮助下。我破解了天佑神殿的奥杜因之墙。它表明，奥杜因在古代是被一种龙吼打败的。艾恩盖尔知道那龙吼叫做“龙魂撕裂”，却不能教我。但他同意指明去找帕图纳克斯的路。帕图纳克斯是灰胡子们的领袖，住在世界之喉山巅。他可能是唯一知道“龙魂撕裂”的人。

original: With Esbern's help, I've deciphered Alduin's Wall in Sky Haven Temple. It revealed that Alduin was defeated in ancient times by a Shout of some kind. Arngeir sent me to talk to Paarthurnax, who he said was the only one who might know this Dragonrend Shout. It turns out that Paarthurnax is actually a dragon.
traduit: 在伊思本的帮助下。我破解了天佑神殿的奥杜因之墙。它表明，奥杜因在古代是被一种龙吼打败的。艾恩盖尔让我去找帕图纳克斯，说只要他知道“龙魂撕裂”龙吼。结果我发现，帕图纳克斯是一头龙。

original: With Esbern's help, I've deciphered Alduin's Wall in Sky Haven Temple. It revealed that Alduin was defeated in ancient times by a Shout of some kind. Arngeir sent me to talk to Paarthurnax, the Greybeards' leader, who turned out to be a dragon. Paarthurnax didn't know the Dragonrend Shout, but believes that there's a way for me to learn it from the ancient heroes who used it against Alduin.
traduit: 在伊思本的帮助下。我破解了天佑神殿的奥杜因之墙。它表明，奥杜因在古代是被一种龙吼打败的。艾恩盖尔让我去找灰胡子的领袖，帕图纳克斯。我发现他其实是龙。帕图纳克斯也不知道“龙魂撕裂”。但他说我可以从反抗奥杜因的古代英雄们那里学的到。

original: With the Skeleton Key of Nocturnal safely in my possession, I'm bound for the Twilight Sepulcher to return it to its resting place.
traduit: 我要把诺克图娜尔的万能钥匙送回它在黄昏坟墓中的安息之地。

original: Within the Twilight Sepulcher, I happened upon the spirit of Gallus, the Nightingale murdered by Mercer Frey. He warned me that removing the key from its resting place has corrupted the other resident Nightingale Guardian Spirits, distorting their morality and making them incredibly hostile.
traduit: 在黄昏坟墓，我偶然遇到了被墨瑟·弗雷杀害的夜莺加卢斯的精魂。他警示我，把钥匙从安息之处拿走已经腐蚀了其他夜莺哨卫的精魂，扭曲了他们的道德，使得他们变得十分敌对。

original: I've returned the Skeleton Key to its proper resting place within the Twilight Sepulcher and encountered Nocturnal herself. As a reward for my actions, she allowed me to become a true Nightingale Agent and imbued me with the appropriate ability befitting my station.
traduit: 我把万能钥匙放回了它在黄昏坟墓中的位置，并且遇到了诺克图娜尔。作为奖励，她任命我为真正的夜莺特使，并赋予我适合自己职位的合适能力。

original: I'm on my way back to the Ragged Flagon to meet up with Karliah. Using the information obtained from Gallus's journal as proof, I hope to convince Brynjolf of Karliah's innocence and Mercer Frey's betrayal.
traduit: 我在回漏壶的路上碰到了卡莱亚。以加卢斯的日记为证据，希望布林乔夫能够相信卡莱亚是无辜的，而墨瑟·弗雷背叛了他们。

original: Brynjolf has been convinced of Karliah's innocence and Mercer's betrayal after investigating the Guild's treasure vault and finding it empty. Of greater mystery is the fact that the vault can only be opened with two keys and is utterly impervious to lockpicking. How Mercer Frey could have breached it is a mystery to us all.
traduit: 布林乔夫调查了公会的金库，金库已经被搬空了，他相信了卡莱亚是清白的，而墨瑟确实叛变了。更神秘的是，金库只能用两把钥匙同时打开，而且完全不受开锁技术的影响。我们都不知道墨瑟·弗雷是如何破解的。

original: The hunt is on and I'm on my way to Riftweald Manor, Mercer Frey's estate in Riften, to locate a clue as to his current whereabouts.
traduit: 狩猎已经开始，我前往墨瑟·弗雷在裂谷城的庄园——裂野庄园，寻找关于他下落的线索。

original: I've discovered some plans in Riftweald Manor. This must be where Mercer Frey is headed. I should bring these the Brynjolf as soon as possible.
traduit: 我在裂野庄园里发现了一些计划书。这一定是墨瑟·弗雷要去的地方。我应该尽快把这些东西送给布林乔夫。

original: Brynjolf is convinced Mercer Frey intends to perform one final heist before departing Skyrim for good. According to the plans I discovered in Riftweald Manor, he's after the "Eyes of the Falmer," two gems of enormous value. If we have any hopes of intercepting Mercer, we need to proceed to their location immediately.
traduit: 布林乔夫确信墨瑟·弗雷打算在永远离开天际前，进行最后一次抢劫。根据我在裂野庄园发现的计划，他的目标是两颗名为“伐莫之眼”的昂贵宝石。如果我们想截住墨瑟，就得马上前往宝石的所在地。

original: Karliah believes the only proof that could expose Mercer's treachery can be found within the pages of Gallus's journal which she recovered from Snow Veil Sanctum. Unfortunately, the journal is written in some sort of code that needs to be deciphered. Our only hope is Enthir, one of Karliah and Gallus's former acquaintances who is a wizard at the College of Winterhold.
traduit: 卡莱亚认为揭露墨瑟背叛的唯一证据就是她在雪幔圣所找到的加卢斯日记。可惜，日记是用某种需要破译的暗码书写的。我们只能寄希望于卡莱亚和加卢斯以前的熟人，冬堡学院的巫师恩希尔。

original: Enthir has informed me that Gallus's Journal is written in Falmer. He's directed me to seek out Calcelmo, the Court Wizard in Markarth who is the foremost authority on them in hopes of obtaining a translation.
traduit: 恩希尔告诉我，加卢斯的日记用的是伐莫文字。他让我去找这方面的权威人士，马卡斯的宫廷巫师卡塞莫。希望能够得到译文。

original: Calcelmo has proven to be extremely stubborn and refuses to allow me access to his materials regarding the Falmer language. I'm left with little choice other than taking matters into my own hands and stealing his notes.
traduit: 卡塞莫十分顽固，不愿意让我接触他关于伐莫语的材料。我别无选择，只能自己动手偷取他的笔记。

original: Calcelmo's "notes" on the Falmer language are actually derived from a massive stone slab in his tower! It will be impossible to bring this item to Enthir to have him translate Gallus's Journal. I'll have to discover a way to make the information more portable.
traduit: 卡塞莫的“研究笔记”实际上来自他塔楼里的一块巨大石板！我不可能把这东西背回去让恩希尔翻译加卢斯的日记。我得想办法把这些信息带出去。

original: After Enthir successfully translated Gallus's journal, I've discovered that Mercer's  motivations transcended simple greed or murder. As a member of the Nightingales, Mercer was tasked with guarding a place called The Twilight Sepulcher, the Temple of Nocturnal. According to Gallus, he defiled the temple and betrayed the Thieves Guild. Karliah insists we bring this information to Brynjolf immediately.
traduit: 恩希尔成功翻译了加卢斯的日记，我发现墨瑟的动机不仅仅是贪婪或者谋杀。作为夜莺，他的任务是守卫一个叫做“黄昏坟墓”的地方，也是诺克图娜尔的圣殿。根据加卢斯的说法，墨瑟玷污了圣殿，背叛了盗贼公会。卡莱亚坚持要一起立刻把消息带给布林乔夫。

traduit: 无赖的玩笑

original: After the revelations at Honningbrew Meadery and Goldenglow Farm, it's time to put the pieces together and shed some light on the Thieves Guild's anonymous adversary.
traduit: 在蜜之酿酒庄和金色光辉庄园的事件曝光后，是时候拼凑线索碎片，揭开盗贼公会匿名对手的面纱了。

original: Mercer Frey has pointed to Solitude as my next destination. I'm to meet up with an old Argonian contact for the Guild named Gulum-Ei. It's hoped he'll be able to identify the Thieves Guild's anonymous adversary.
traduit: 墨瑟·弗雷说我的下一个目的地是独孤城。我要去见古鲁姆-埃，他是公会的一个老阿尔贡线人。希望他能够找出盗贼公会的匿名对手。

original: As predicted by Mercer Frey, Gulum-Ei proved to be quite stubborn and refused to reveal any useful information. I have no choice but to shadow him during his daily routine and discover if he's up to anything that could be used as influence to make him divulge the truth.
traduit: 正如墨瑟·弗雷所想，古鲁姆-埃十分顽固，拒绝透露任何有用的线索。我别无选择，只能在他日常中跟踪他，看看他是否在做什么可以用来让他吐露真相的事。

original: Thanks to Gulum-Ei's confession, a former member of the Thieves Guild named Karliah has been identified as its anonymous adversary. Worse still, I've discovered that she was the same Dunmer who murdered Gallus, the Guild's previous Guild Master and who's apparently resurfaced after all these years to do the same to Mercer Frey.
traduit: 古鲁姆-埃坦白，盗贼公会的前成员卡莱亚是本组织的匿名对手。更糟的是，我发现她就是杀害前任会长的丹莫，这么多年过去，她再度出现，企图对墨瑟·弗雷下手。

original: I've been sent to speak to Maven Black-Briar, head of the wealthiest most influential family in Riften. According to Brynjolf, she has a job of utmost importance for me and I need to follow her directions to the letter.
traduit: 我奉命去见玛雯·黑棘，她是裂谷城最富有且最有影响力的家族的首领。据布林乔夫说，她有一份对我至关重要的工作，必须严格按她的指示去做。

original: Maven Black-Briar has sent me to Whiterun where I am to meet with someone named Mallus Maccius. Together, our goal is to bring down one of Maven's competitors, Honningbrew Meadery and discover where he obtained the financing to take her on.
traduit: 玛雯·黑棘派我去白漫城见一个叫莫鲁斯·马修斯的人。我们的目标是扳倒玛雯的竞争对手蜜之酿酒庄，并且找到他们的资金来源。

original: I've become a key component in a cunning plan to frame Honningbrew Meadery's owner, Sabjorn, and have him imprisoned. The first part of the scheme is to approach Sabjorn under the guise of assistance with a pest problem he's having thanks to Mallus's tinkering.
traduit: 我已经加入了陷害蜜之酿酒庄老板撒布乔恩并把他关进监狱的狡猾计划。该计划的第一部分是打着帮助莫鲁斯解决害虫问题的幌子，接近撒布乔恩。

original: Sabjorn has provided me with poison I'm to apply to the nests deep within the tunnels under Honningbrew Meadery. As Mallus predicted, I should be able to use the very same poison to taint Sabjorn's mead as well.
traduit: 撒布乔恩把毒药交给我，让我用在蜜之酿酒庄地下隧道深处的巢穴里。如莫鲁斯所料，我也可以把同样的毒药放进撒布乔恩的蜜酒里。

original: The plan worked perfectly and Whiterun's Captain of the Guard was stricken with illness when he drank the poisoned mead. Sabjorn's been carted off to jail and Honningbrew Meadery is now closed.
traduit: 计划十分成功，白漫城的卫兵队长喝下有毒的蜜酒后感到不适。撒布乔恩被送进了监狱，蜜之酿酒庄关门大吉了。

original: Now that Mallus's position as the owner of Honningbrew Meadery has been secured, I need to find any information explaining how Sabjorn was able to fund this costly operation.
traduit: 莫鲁斯作为蜜之酿酒庄老板的地位已经确定了，我需要找到任何可以解释撒布乔恩获取资金来源的线索。

original: The information I obtained from Honningbrew Meadery points to the same anonymous buyer of Goldenglow Estate. If successful, this individual would have completely estranged Maven Black-Briar from the Guild and destroyed it economically. It's becoming painfully obvious that it's time to shed some light on our mysterious adversary before they have a chance to strike again.
traduit: 我从蜜之酿酒庄获得的线索，指向了买下金色光辉庄园的同一个匿名买家。如果计划成功，此人将彻底让玛雯·黑棘与公会分裂，并在经济上摧毁公会。在我们的神秘对手再次发动袭击前，我们需要对他有所了解。

original: Brynjolf is taking me to meet the leader of the organization he represents. He says more work and significantly more coin could be available if I join their ranks.
traduit: 布林乔夫要带我去见组织的首领。他说，如果我加入他们，会有更多的工作和更多的钱。

original: Thanks to Brynjolf's support, I've been welcomed into the Thieves Guild by its Guild Master, Mercer Frey. I'm eager to receive my first task and prove that his recommendation wasn't in vain.
traduit: 多亏布林乔夫的支持，盗贼公会的公会大师墨瑟·弗雷对我表示了欢迎。我希望得到第一个任务，来证明他的引荐没有白费。

original: My first task as a member of the Thieves Guild involves a honey operation located just outside of Riften called Goldenglow Estate. My actions there are in direct response to the owner's sudden silence and lack of cooperation with the Thieves Guild and Maven-Black-Briar, one of the Guild's most important clients.
traduit: 我作为盗贼公会一员的第一个任务，是侵入一个叫金色光辉庄园的养蜂场。此行的目的，是因为那里的主人突然沉默，并且缺乏和盗贼公会以及公会最大的客户之一——玛雯·黑棘的合作做出直接回应。

original: I've completed my task at Goldenglow Estate and discovered the owner's sudden lack of cooperation with the Guild was leveraged by an anonymous buyer of that very same location. Why this buyer purchased Goldenglow and is showing animosity towards the Guild is a mystery for the moment.
traduit: 我完成了在金色光辉庄园的任务，并发现庄园主突然终止与公会的合作是因为被某个匿名买家利用了。至于该买家购买金色光辉，并对公会展露敌意的原因暂时是谜。

original: Mirabelle has told me that members of the Synod recently visited the College, mentioning the Staff of Magnus. They were last known to be heading towards Mzulft; they may know more about where to find the staff.
traduit: 米拉贝勒告诉我，希诺成员近期拜访过学院，并提到过玛格努斯之杖。他们的最后目的地是姆祖伏特，他们可能更清楚到哪里去找法杖。

original: At Mirabelle's suggestion, I entered the ruins of Mzulft searching for the Synod researchers. I found one man who died, and suggested that more people may be inside at something called The Oculory. I should head further into the ruins to see what's going on.
traduit: 在米拉贝勒的建议下，我进入姆祖伏特遗迹，寻找希诺研究人员。我已经发现了一名死了的，我想可能还有更多人在“观测台”。我应该继续往遗迹内部前进，看看发生了什么。

original: At Mirabelle's suggestion, I entered the ruins of Mzulft searching for the Synod researchers. I found Paratus Decimius, who appears to be the only surviving member of the Synod expedition, and who has insisted that a "focusing crystal" is necessary to finish his experiment but was stolen by the Falmer.
traduit: 在米拉贝勒的建议下，我进入姆祖伏特遗迹，寻找希诺研究人员。我找到了希诺探险队的唯一幸存者，帕拉图斯·德西缪斯。他坚持认为必须有“聚焦水晶”才能完成实验，但那东西已经被伐莫偷走了。

original: Exploring Mzulft while looking for information about the Staff of Magnus, I've encountered Paratus Decimius, the sole surviving member of a Synod expedition. I've found the focusing crystal he needs to finish his experiment, and should return it to him.
traduit: 在寻找玛格努斯之杖的下落时，我在姆祖伏特探险中遇到了希诺远征队的唯一幸存者帕拉图斯·德西缪斯。我找到了他完成实验所需的聚焦水晶，现在该还给他了。

original: Paratus Decimius may know the location of the Staff of Magnus, but has asked for my help in completing an experiment in Mzulft. I need to follow him to the top of the ruins.
traduit: 帕拉图斯·德西缪斯应该知道玛格努斯之杖的位置，但他要求我帮忙在姆祖伏特完成一项实验。我要跟着他前往遗迹顶端。

original: Paratus Decimius may know the location of the Staff of Magnus, but has asked for my help in completing an experiment in Mzulft. I need to use magic to attenuate Paratus' focusing crystal, and then manipulate the dwarven machinery to line up the beams of light.
traduit: 帕拉图斯·德西缪斯应该知道玛格努斯之杖的位置，但他要求我帮忙完成在姆祖伏特的实验。我需要用魔法来调整帕拉图斯的聚焦水晶，然后操控矮人的机械来排列光束。

original: Traveling to Mzulft in search of the Synod, I found Paratus Decimius who helped me learn that the Staff of Magnus is located in Labyrinthian. This information needs to get back to Savos Aren at the College immediately.
traduit: 在姆祖伏特寻找希诺的过程中，我找到了帕拉图斯·德西缪斯，他帮我找到了玛格努斯之杖的位置位于迷城。我必须立刻带着消息返回学院汇报给萨沃斯·阿冉。

original: After traveling to Mzulft and learning that the Staff of Magnus is located within Labyrinthian, I returned to the College to give the news to Arch-Mage Aren. Aren, however, is more concerned with the Eye of Magnus at the moment, since Ancano has locked himself in the Hall of the Elements with it. I need to help the Arch-Mage reach him at once.
traduit: 在探索姆祖伏特并得知玛格努斯之杖位于迷城之后，我回到学院把消息报告大法师阿冉。但阿冉现在更关心玛格努斯之眼。安卡诺把自己所在元素大厅。我得帮大法师找到他。

original: After finding the Synod in Mzulft, I learned that the Staff of Magnus can be found in Labyrinthian, and brought this news to the Arch-Mage.
traduit: 我在姆祖伏特找到希诺，得知玛格努斯之杖位于迷城，并把消息告诉了大法师。

original: Ancano has done something to the Eye of Magnus, causing the orb to release incredible amounts of energy, damaging the College and killing the Arch-Mage. The town of Winterhold may be affected as well, and needs to be secured.

original: Ancano interrupted my conversation with Tolfdir to insist that I speak with someone claiming to be from the Psijic Order, who is waiting in the Arch-Mage's quarters in the College.
traduit: 安卡诺打断了我和托夫迪尔的谈话，坚持要我去和一个自称来自赛伊克教团的人对话，他正在大法师的住处等着。

original: I've been led to the Arch-Mage's quarters by Ancano, who was insistent that I speak to someone claiming to be from the Psijic Order. The monk, named Quaranir, has informed me that the "Eye of Magnus" is dangerous and that to learn how to deal with it, I need to speak with The Augur of Dunlain within the College. I should ask my fellow members where to find him.
traduit: 我被安卡诺带到了大法师的住处，并坚持让我和一个自称赛伊克的人谈谈。僧侣夸兰尼尔告诉我，玛格努斯之眼非常危险，为了让学院知道如何对付它，我需要在学院里找到占卜师杜兰谈谈。我应该去问问同事们在哪儿能找到他。

original: I've been led to the Arch-Mage's quarters by Ancano, who was insistent that I speak to someone claiming to be from the Psijic Order. The monk, named Quaranir, has informed me that the "Eye of Magnus" is dangerous and that to learn how to deal with it, I need to speak with The Augur of Dunlain within the College. He can be found in the Midden, beneath the College.
traduit: 我被安卡诺带到了大法师的住处，并坚持让我和一个自称赛伊克的人谈谈。僧侣夸兰尼尔告诉我，玛格努斯之眼非常危险，为了让学院知道如何对付它，我需要在学院里找到占卜师杜兰谈谈。我可以到学院的秽道找到他。

original: After speaking with Quaranir from the Psijic Order and being warned of the danger of keeping the Eye of Magnus at the College, I sought out and talked to the Augur of Dunlain, who lives in the Midden underneath the College. The Augur told me that I'll need to find the Staff of Magnus, and to give that information to my superiors immediately.
traduit: 在和赛伊克教团的夸兰尼尔交谈后，我得知玛格努斯之眼留在学院会有危险。我找到了学院秽道里的占卜师杜兰。占卜师告诉我需要找到玛格努斯之杖，让我去向上级汇报。

original: After speaking privately with a monk from the Psijic Order, I have been warned that the "Eye of Magnus" is potentially dangerous and must be dealt with. After consulting with the Augur of Dunlain beneath the College, I have brought word to the Arch-Mage that the Staff of Magnus needs to be located.
traduit: 赛伊克教团的僧侣警示我玛格努斯之眼有潜在危险，必须处理。在和学院下面的占卜师杜兰商议后，我给大法师带去消息，要去找回玛格努斯之杖。

traduit: 向吉安娜报告

original: Report to Gianna while wearing a chef's hat
traduit: 带上厨师帽向吉安娜报告

original: Make the Potage le Magnifique
traduit: 制作美味浓汤

original: Follow Gianna to the dining room
traduit: 跟随吉安娜前往餐厅

original: Kill the Emperor
traduit: 杀死皇帝

original: Escape the Tower!
traduit: 逃离塔楼！

original: Return to the Sanctuary
traduit: 返回圣所

original: Recipe for Disaster
traduit: 不幸的食谱

original: I must speak with Festus Krex about my next target, the renowned chef known only as the "Gourmet."
traduit: 我要去找菲斯图斯·克莱克斯谈谈下一个目标，著名厨师“美食家”。

original: I have been tasked with killing the Gourmet, but only one person knows the famous chef's true identity and location - a man named Anton Virane. I must get this information from Anton Virane, and then kill him.
traduit: 我接到任务要杀死美食家，但只有安东·维拉尼知道这个著名大厨的真实身份和所在。我必须从安东·维拉尼处得到消息，然后杀了他。

original: I must kill the Gourmet, who is actually an Orc named Balagog gro-Nolob. Once he's dead, I must steal his Writ of Passage. And, if I can manage to hide the body, I'll receive a bonus.
traduit: 我必须杀死美食家，而他的真实身份是个叫巴拉果戈·格洛-诺洛波的兽人。他一死，我就能拿到他的通行证。如果把他的尸体藏起来，我就能拿到奖励。

original: The Gourmet is dead, and I'm now in possession of his Writ of Passage. Soon, I will take his place as chef for the Emperor...
traduit: 美食家死了，通行证落入我的手中。很快，我就会代替他成为皇帝的御厨……

original: Report to Festus Krex
traduit: 向菲斯图斯·克莱克斯报告

original: Question Anton Virane
traduit: 询问安东·维拉尼

original: Kill Anton Virane
traduit: 杀死安东·维拉尼

original: Kill Balagog gro-Nolob
traduit: 杀死巴拉果戈·格洛-诺洛波

original: (Optional) Drag Balagog's body to a hiding place
traduit: （可选）将巴拉果戈的尸体拖至隐秘处

original: Take the Writ of Passage
traduit: 拿取通行证

original: Report back to Festus Krex
traduit: 回去向菲斯图斯·克莱克斯报告

original: The Cure for Madness
traduit: 治愈疯狂

original: Upon my return to the Sanctuary, I was informed by Gabriella that there was some kind of "incident" with Cicero. I need to speak to Astrid to find out what happened.
traduit: 我回到圣所时，加布里艾拉告诉我西塞罗引发了某些“意外”。我得找阿斯垂德谈谈，弄清事态。

original: While I was away, Cicero went berserk and tried to kill Astrid. He fled the Sanctuary, with Arnbjorn in pursuit. I need to locate them both, and then kill Cicero.
traduit: 我在外面时，西塞罗发疯并企图杀死阿斯垂德。他已经逃离圣所，艾恩乔恩追了出去。我得找到他们并杀死西塞罗。

original: After learning that Cicero went berserk and tried to kill Astrid, I was ordered to go to the Dawnstar Sanctuary, find him, and end his life. The matter has now been resolved.
traduit: 在得知西塞罗发疯并试图杀死阿斯垂德后，我奉命到晨星圣所追杀他。现在事情已经解决了。

original: Search Cicero's room
traduit: 搜索西塞罗的房间

original: Read Cicero's diary
traduit: 阅读西塞罗的日记

original: Locate Arnbjorn
traduit: 找到艾恩乔恩

original: Talk to Arnbjorn
traduit: 与艾恩乔恩交谈

original: Enter the Dawnstar Sanctuary
traduit: 进入晨星圣所

original: Kill Cicero
traduit: 杀死西塞罗

original: Kill Cicero, or leave the Sanctuary
traduit: 杀死西塞罗或离开圣所

original: Behold Shadowmere
traduit: 见证微影到来

original: Breaching Security
traduit: 破坏安全

original: Astrid informed me that I should speak to Gabriella about my next contract, which has something to do with the Emperor's security.
traduit: 阿斯垂德让我去找加布里艾拉谈谈下一个契约，与皇帝的安全有关。

original: I must kill Gaius Maro, an agent of the Emperor's security force. Once he's dead, I must plant a letter on his body that will incriminate him in a plot to kill the Emperor. If I wish to earn a bonus, I must not kill him in Dragon Bridge, or on the road, but in one of the cities he visits.
traduit: 我要杀死皇帝安全部队的密探加留斯·马洛。等他死后，在他身上放上一封信以证明他参与了刺杀皇帝的阴谋。如果我想获得额外奖励，就不能在龙桥或路上杀死他，要在城市里动手。

original: I have killed Gaius Maro, and planted the Incriminating Letter on his body. This will surely disrupt the security plan for the Emperor's visit, ruin Commander Maro emotionally, and make the Emperor believe the only plot to kill him has been foiled.
traduit: 我杀了加留斯·马洛，并把栽赃信件放在了他身上。这一定能打乱皇帝出巡的安全计划，击溃指挥官马洛的感情，让皇帝相信唯一能杀死他的阴谋已经被挫败。

original: Speak with Gabriella
traduit: 与加布里艾拉交谈

original: (Optional) Steal Gaius Maro's travel schedule
traduit: （可选）偷取加留斯·马洛的行程表

original: Kill Gaius Maro
traduit: 杀死加留斯·马洛

original: Plant the Incriminating Letter on Gaius Maro's body
traduit: 将诬陷信放在加留斯·马洛的尸体上

original: Report back to Gabriella
traduit: 回去向加布里艾拉报告

original: Bound Until Death
traduit: 至死不渝

original: I must journey to the Temple of the Divines in Solitude, attend the public wedding reception of Vittoria Vici and Asgeir Snow-Shod, and kill the bride. I'll receive a bonus if I kill Vici as she addresses the crowd.
traduit: 我必须独自前往独孤城圣灵神殿出席维托利亚·维齐和艾斯盖尔·雪蹄的婚礼招待宴会，然后杀死新娘。如果我能在维齐向宾客讲话时杀了她，我就能得到一个奖励。

original: I have killed Vittoria Vici, the Emperor's cousin, at her own wedding, and everyone will assume it's related to the ongoing war. The Emperor will now be forced to visit Skyrim to deal with the aftermath, paving the way for his assassination.
traduit: 我在皇帝表妹维托利亚·维齐本人的婚礼上杀了她，所有人都认为这和正在进行的战争有关。皇帝现在将被迫造访天际以处理善后事宜，为暗杀他铺平了道路。

original: Kill Vittoria Vici
traduit: 杀死维托利亚·维齐

original: Whispers in the Dark
traduit: 黑暗中的低语

original: Astrid has heard Cicero speaking with someone, in whispered tones, in the chamber of the Night Mother. She fears they're conspiring against the Sanctuary, and wants me to eavesdrop on the conversation. I'm to sneak into the chamber, and hide in the coffin of the Night Mother.
traduit: 阿斯垂德听到西塞罗在夜母的房间里与某人低声交谈。她担心他们在密谋破坏圣所，所以想要我去偷听他们的谈话。我需要溜进房间，躲在夜母的棺材里。

original: While eavesdropping on Cicero, I heard the voice of the Night Mother, who named me Listener. Astrid seems unsure what to believe, and needs time to process this latest development. In the meantime, I'm to see Nazir for more side contract work.
traduit: 在偷听西塞罗的时候，我听到了夜母的声音，她把我称为聆听者。阿斯垂德似乎不太确定该信什么，需要时间来考虑事情的这一进展。与此同时，我得去找纳兹尔多做些小契约。

original: While eavesdropping on Cicero, I heard the voice of the Night Mother, who named me Listener. Astrid seems unsure what to believe, and it's hard to tell what effect this will ultimately have on the Sanctuary.
traduit: 在偷听西塞罗的时候，我听到了夜母的声音，她把我称为聆听者。阿斯垂德似乎不太确定该不该相信，也很难说这会对圣所产生什么影响。

original: Hide in the Night Mother's coffin
traduit: 躲入夜母的棺材

original: Eavesdrop on Cicero
traduit: 偷听西塞罗的谈话

original: Talk to Cicero
traduit: 与西塞罗交谈

original: Receive a side contract from Nazir
traduit: 从纳兹尔处接取小契约

original: Mourning Never Comes
traduit: 永不哀恸

original: Astrid has given me my first major contract. I am to contact Muiri, the apothecary's assistant in The Hag's Cure, in Markarth. Muiri has apparently performed the Black Sacrament, and is trying to contact the Dark Brotherhood.
traduit: 阿斯垂德交给我第一份重要契约。我要去联络马卡斯城鬼婆妙方的药剂师助理暮蕊。暮蕊显然已经执行过黑色圣礼，并试图联络黑暗兄弟会。

original: Muiri wants me to kill the bandit leader Alain Dufont, who is holed up with his gang of cutthroats in the dwarven ruin of Raldbthar. If Dufont dies, the contract will be completed, but Muiri will pay me some kind of bonus if I also eliminate Nilsine Shatter-Shield, in Windhelm.
traduit: 暮蕊想让我杀死强盗首领阿兰·杜峰特，他和他的手下躲在矮人遗迹拉德巴塔尔。如果杜峰特死掉，契约也就完成了，但如果我愿意去风舵城杀掉尼尔欣·碎盾，暮蕊愿意再付给一些额外奖金。

original: Alain Dufont is dead. I must now return to Markarth, and tell Muiri the deed is complete.
traduit: 阿兰·杜峰特死了，我现在要回马卡斯告诉暮蕊契约完成了。

original: I have spoken to Muiri, and been paid for the assassination of Alain Dufont. I must now report back to Astrid at the Dark Brotherhood Sanctuary.
traduit: 我已经和暮蕊谈过，并得到了刺杀阿兰·杜峰特的报酬。我现在得回黑暗兄弟会圣所向阿斯垂德汇报。

original: After contacting Muiri, the apothecary's assistant at the Hag's Cure in Markarth, I learned that she wished to hire the Dark Brotherhood to kill a slanderous ex-lover. I killed the man, the bandit leader Alain Dufont, and was rewarded for the contract.
traduit: 在与马卡斯的鬼婆妙方药剂师助理暮蕊联系后，我得知她想要雇佣黑暗兄弟会杀死诽谤她的前情人。我杀了那个强盗头子阿兰·杜峰特，并得到了报酬。

original: Talk to Muiri
traduit: 与暮蕊交谈

original: Kill Alain Dufont
traduit: 杀死阿兰·杜峰特

original: (Optional) Kill Nilsine Shatter-Shield
traduit: （可选）杀死尼尔欣·碎盾

original: With Friends Like These...
traduit: 有朋如此……

original: Astrid, of the Dark Brotherhood, informed me that by killing Grelod the Kind, I have robbed her organization of a kill. I have been taken captive and moved to some remote shack. Astrid will only give me the key if I kill someone she has taken captive, to "repay my debt."
traduit: 黑暗兄弟会的阿斯垂德跟我说，我杀死慈祥的桂罗使得她的组织失去了一次杀戮机会。我被俘虏并搬到了一个偏僻的小屋里。只有我杀掉她俘虏的人，“偿还我的债务”。阿斯垂德才会给我钥匙。

original: I have killed one of the captives as Astrid instructed, and must now gain entrance to the Dark Brotherhood Sanctuary, which is located in the southern Pine Forest. Astrid has provided me with the correct passphrase - "Silence, my Brother."
traduit: 我已经按照阿斯垂德的指示杀死了一个俘虏，现在我要进入南部松林里的黑暗兄弟会圣所。阿斯垂德把正确的密语告诉了我——“是沉寂，我的兄弟。”

original: I have killed an innocent person, gained entrance into the Dark Brotherhood Sanctuary, and been officially welcomed into the Dark Brotherhood by Astrid. There's no turning back now.
traduit: 我杀了一个无辜的人，得知了进入黑暗兄弟会圣所的方法，并被阿斯垂德正式邀请进入黑暗兄弟会。现在已经无法回头了。

original: Astrid invited me into the Dark Brotherhood, but I killed her instead. I will now never be able to join the shadowy organization of assassins.
traduit: 阿斯垂德邀请我进入黑暗兄弟会，但我却把她杀了。我再也不能加入这个神秘的刺客组织了。

original: Kill one of the captives
traduit: 杀死其中一个俘虏

original: Enter the Dark Brotherhood Sanctuary
traduit: 进入黑暗兄弟会圣所

original: Innocence Lost
traduit: 纯真已逝

original: I heard a rumor that a boy named Aventus Aretino, in Windhelm, has been attempting to contact the Dark Brotherhood. I should find this boy and speak with him, and find out why he wants to contact a guild of assassins.
traduit: 我听说风舵城有个叫阿文图斯·艾瑞提诺的男孩一直在试图联络黑暗兄弟会。我该找这个男孩谈谈，弄清楚他为什么要联络刺客公会。

original: The mother of Aventus Aretino recently died, and the boy was sent to live at Honorhall Orphanage in Riften. He thinks I'm a Dark Brotherhood assassin, and wants me to kill the Orphanage's sadistic headmistress, Grelod the Kind.
traduit: 阿文图斯·艾瑞提诺的母亲最近去世了，这个孩子被送到了裂谷城的荣耀堂孤儿院。他把我认作黑暗兄弟会的刺客，还想让我杀了孤儿院的虐待狂女院长——慈祥的桂罗。

original: I killed Grelod the Kind, and Aventus Aretino rewarded me with a family heirloom. Now the boy can return to Honorhall Orphanage, and live out his childhood peacefully.
traduit: 我杀死了慈祥的桂罗，阿文图斯·艾瑞提诺给了我一件传家宝作为报酬。现在男孩可以回到荣耀堂孤儿院，平静度过他的童年了。

original: Kill Grelod the Kind
traduit: 杀死慈祥的桂罗

original: Tell Aventus Aretino that Grelod is dead
traduit: 把桂罗的死讯告诉阿文图斯·艾瑞提诺

original: Delayed Burial
traduit: 推迟的葬礼

original: Apparently there's a strange jester near the Loreius Farm, on the road north of Whiterun. It would seem he's transporting a coffin in a cart, but one of the wheels has broken of. It might be worth investigating.
traduit: 白漫城北部的路上，罗瑞尤斯农场附近有个古怪的小丑。他好像在用马车运送棺材。但车轮坏了一个。可能值得调查一下。

original: I met a strange jester named Cicero, who is transporting his mother's coffin. One of the wheels of Cicero's wagon has broken off, and he wants me to ask a farmer named Loreius for help.
traduit: 我遇到了一个叫西塞罗的古怪小丑，他正在运送自己母亲的棺材。西塞罗的马车轮子坏了，想让我向一个叫罗瑞尤斯的农场主求助。

original: I have agreed to help the farmer Loreius get rid of the strange jester named Cicero, who keeps asking for his help. I'm to report Cicero to the nearby guard, and lie about his offense.
traduit: 我答应农场主罗瑞尤斯摆脱那个古怪小丑西塞罗的骚扰。我要向附近的卫兵举报西塞罗，谎称他有犯罪行为。

original: The jester Cicero wants the farmer Loreius to fix his broken wagon wheel, but Loreius just wants Cicero to leave. I can either convince Loreius to fix the wheel, or report Cicero to the nearby guard.
traduit: 小丑西塞罗想让农场主罗瑞尤斯修理他坏掉的车轮，但罗瑞尤斯只想让西塞罗赶紧离开。我可以说服罗瑞尤斯修理车轮，也可以向附近的卫兵举报西塞罗。

original: I have reported Cicero to the guard, and lied about his offense. I must now speak to Loreius, and let him know I have assisted him.
traduit: 我向卫兵谎报西塞罗的罪行。现在要去告诉罗瑞尤斯我已经帮过他了。

original: I have spoken to Loreius, and convinced him to repair Cicero's broken wagon wheel. I need to report back to Cicero, and let him know help is on the way.
traduit: 我已经说服罗瑞尤斯帮西塞罗修理车轮。我得回去找西塞罗，告诉他援助正在赶来。

original: I have resolved the conflict between the jester Cicero and Loreius the farmer.
traduit: 我解决了小丑西塞罗和农夫罗瑞尤斯之间的矛盾。

original: Convince Loreius to fix the wheel
traduit: 说服罗瑞尤斯修好车轮

original: Report Cicero to the guard
traduit: 向卫兵举报西塞罗

original: Convince Loreius OR report Cicero
traduit: 说服罗瑞尤斯或举报西塞罗

original: Talk to Loreius
traduit: 与罗瑞尤斯交谈

original: Rise in the East
traduit: 旭日东升

original: The East Empire Company is being harassed by a group of pirates and would like me to help shut them down. If I do, the Windhelm office can re-open, and there should be some money in it for me.
traduit: 东帝国公司受海盗侵扰，希望我帮着把他们剿灭。如果我照做，那么风舵城的办公室就能重新开张，我也能从中赚一笔。

original: I've helped Orthus Endario to re-open the Windhelm Office of the East Empire Company by eliminating the Blood Horker base at Japhet's Folly.
traduit: 我帮奥苏斯·恩达里奥消灭了贾菲特之愚的据点，东帝国公司的风舵城办公室重新开张了。

original: Steal Suvaris Atheron's logbook
traduit: 偷取苏瓦利斯·奥瑟伦的日志

original: Give the logbook to Orthus
traduit: 把日志交给奥苏斯

original: Talk to Stig Salt-Plank
traduit: 与“咸木板”斯蒂交谈

original: Report back to Orthus
traduit: 向奥苏斯报告

original: Depart for Japhet's Folly
traduit: 前往贾菲特之愚

original: Talk to Adelaisa
traduit: 与阿德莱萨交谈

original: Kill Haldyn
traduit: 杀死哈尔丁

original: Report back to Adelaisa
traduit: 回去向阿德莱萨报告

original: Speak to Adelaisa to return
traduit: 告诉阿德莱萨该回去了

original: Speak to Orthus
traduit: 与奥苏斯交谈

original: Promises to Keep
traduit: 一言九鼎

original: Louis Letrush wants a message taken to Sibbi Black-Briar.
traduit: 路易士·莱特鲁什想给西比·黑棘捎个信。

original: Louis Letrush wants me to ask Sibbi Black-Briar about Frost, a breeding horse Letrush is buying.
traduit: 路易士·莱特鲁什想让我去问西比·黑棘关于寒霜的事。莱特鲁什希望把它买下做种马。

original: Sibbi Black-Briar has asked me to steal Frost and deliver him to Louis Letrush.
traduit: 西比·黑棘要我去偷出寒霜交给路易士·莱特鲁什。

original: I have been rewarded by Louis Letrush for stealing Frost from Black-Briar Lodge.
traduit: 帮路易士·莱特鲁什从黑棘旅屋偷到寒霜之后。我得到了奖励。

original: Listen to Louis Letrush's offer
traduit: 听路易士·莱特鲁什的提议

original: Speak to Sibbi Black-Briar
traduit: 与西比·黑棘交谈

original: (Optional) Steal the Lodge Stash
traduit: （可选）偷盗旅屋保险箱

original: Steal Frost's Lineage Papers
traduit: 偷取寒霜的血统证明

original: Steal Frost
traduit: 偷取寒霜

original: Return to Louis Letrush
traduit: 回去找路易士·莱特鲁什

original: Missing In Action
traduit: 战斗中失踪

original: Fralia Gray-Mane in Whiterun is convinced that her missing son, Thorald, is still alive and being held captive. She's asked me to visit her at her home to speak privately about the matter.
traduit: 白漫城的法利亚·灰鬃确信，她失踪的儿子索拉德还活着，并且被囚禁了起来。她请我到家里私下谈谈这件事。

original: Avulstein Gray-Mane believes his brother Thorald has been taken prisoner, and that the Battle-Borns of Whiterun have proof. I need to find it and bring to Avulstein.
traduit: 阿武斯特恩·灰鬃相信他的兄弟索拉德已经被俘了，而白漫城的战狂有证据。我得找到证据带给阿武斯特恩。

original: After being convinced to help by the Gray-Mane family, I've found evidence that Thorald Gray-Mane is still alive, and is being held in Northwatch Keep. Avulstein will want to see this right away.
traduit: 在被灰鬃家说服之后，我找到了证明索拉德·灰鬃还活着的证据，他被关在了北望堡垒。阿武斯特恩会很想看到的。

original: After being convinced to help, and finding proof that he is still alive, I've offered to try and free Thorald Gray-Mane from Northwatch Keep to prevent bloodshed on either side.
traduit: 在我被说服帮忙，找到索拉德·灰鬃还活着的证据后，我提出试着把他从北望堡垒和平地救出来，避免流血冲突。

original: Now that I have found proof that his brother still lives, Avulstein Gray-Mane insists on assaulting Northwatch Keep to rescue Thorald. I've agreed to meet him outside the Keep to assist in the fight.
traduit: 我现在找到了索拉德·灰鬃还活着的证据，他兄弟阿武斯特恩坚持要进攻北望堡垒救他出来。我同意在堡垒外面与他见面，协助战斗。

original: Thorald Gray-Mane is indeed alive. Now I have to get him away from Northwatch Keep and make sure he stays safe.
traduit: 索拉德·灰鬃确实还活着。现在我得把他从北望堡垒救出来，确保他的安全。

original: Thorald Gray-Mane has been successfully retrieved from Northwatch Keep. Fearing for the safety of his family, he cannot return to Whiterun, and has asked me to deliver a message to his mother: "Suffer the winter's cold wind, for it bears aloft next summer's seeds."
traduit: 索拉德·灰鬃已经被成功从北望堡垒救出来了。由于担心家人的安危，他不能回白漫城，他让我给他母亲捎个口信“要忍耐冬日的寒风，只因它承载着来夏的种子”。

original: Fralia Gray-Mane is grateful that her son Thorald is alive and well.
traduit: 法利亚·灰鬃因为她儿子活得好好的很感谢我。

original: Meet Fralia in her home
traduit: 与法利亚在她家中见面

original: Find evidence of Thorald's fate
traduit: 找到关于索拉德下落的证据

original: Meet Jon Battle-Born at Talos' statue
traduit: 在塔洛斯雕像处与乔恩·战狂见面

original: Deliver proof to Avulstein
traduit: 把证据交给阿武斯特恩

original: Find a way to release Thorald from Thalmor custody
traduit: 想办法在梭默的看守下把索拉德放出来

original: Meet Avulstein at Northwatch Keep
traduit: 在北望堡垒与阿武斯特恩见面

original: Rescue Thorald from Northwatch Keep
traduit: 从北望堡垒救出索拉德

original: Lead Thorald to safety
traduit: 把索拉德带到安全处

original: Speak to Thorald Gray-Mane
traduit: 与索拉德·灰鬃交谈

original: Return to Fralia Gray-Mane
traduit: 回去找法利亚·灰鬃

original: In My Time Of Need
traduit: 患难与共

original: A group of men calling themselves the Alik'r are looking for a Redguard woman in Whiterun.
traduit: 一群自称阿里克'尔的人正在寻找一个住在白漫城的红卫人。

original: The barmaid at the Bannered Mare in Whiterun is apparently a fugitive noble from Hammerfell. She claims that she is on the run from assassins sent by rival houses in her homeland and needs someone to stop them before they find her.
traduit: 白漫城悬旗母马的酒保显然是落锤来的流亡贵族。她声称正在躲避来自她家乡的敌对家族派出的刺客，需要找人在他们把她抓走前阻止他们。

original: The leader of the so-called "assassins" I've been asked to eliminate claims that Saadia betrayed her people to the Dominion and they are here to bring her to justice. I've agreed to lead her into an ambush at the Whiterun stables.
traduit: 所谓“刺客”的首领告诉我萨蒂亚向先祖神洲出卖自己的人民，他们来此是为了将她绳之以法。我同意把她带到白漫马厩的埋伏处。

original: I've helped Saadia escape the clutches of the Alik'r sent after her. With their leader defeated, she believes the rest of them will scatter, affording her some much-needed safety for now.
traduit: 我帮萨蒂亚摆脱了追杀她的阿里克'尔。她相信，首领被杀之后，其余人会散去，她也就获得了急需的安全。

original: After making arrangements with Kematu, I've delivered Saadia to him. He assures me that she will be taken back to Hammerfell alive, though after that her fate is no longer in his hands.
traduit: 与凯马图商量好后，我将萨蒂亚交给了他。他向我保证，会将萨蒂亚活着押解回落锤，但在那之后，她的命运就不掌握在他的手中了。

original: Find the Redguard woman
traduit: 找到那个红卫女人

original: Speak with Saadia
traduit: 与萨蒂亚交谈

original: Inform the Alik'r of Saadia's location
traduit: 把萨蒂亚的位置报告给阿里克'尔

original: Talk to the Alik'r Prisoner
traduit: 与阿里克'尔囚犯交谈

original: Find a way to enter the Alik'r hideout
traduit: 想办法进入阿里克'尔的藏身处

original: Enter the Alik'r hideout
traduit: 进入阿里克'尔藏身处

traduit: 杀死凯马图

original: Kill Kematu or talk to him
traduit: 杀死凯马图或和他谈谈

original: Kill Kematu OR Convince Saadia to meet Kematu
traduit: 杀死凯马图或说服萨蒂亚去见凯马图

original: Return to Saadia
traduit: 回去找萨蒂亚

original: Lead Saadia to the Whiterun Stables
traduit: 把萨蒂亚带到白漫城马厩

original: Glory of the Dead
traduit: 逝者的荣耀

original: I should attend the funeral of Kodak Whitman, the late Harbinger of the Companions.
traduit: 我要去参加战友团上代先驱“白鬃”克拉科的葬礼。

original: Eorlund needs the fragments of Wuuthrad to prepare them for remounting in Jorrvaskr.
traduit: 厄伦德准备在天空锻炉重塑巫斯拉德，因此需要它的碎片。

original: As a member of the Circle, I need to convene in the Underforge to determine the next steps for the Companions following the death of Kodak Whitman.
traduit: 作为圆环的一员，我要到地下锻炉开会以决定“白鬃”克拉科死后圆环的下一步行动。

original: The Companions believe there is a way to cleanse Kodlak's soul of the taint of the beast. We're going to the ancient Tomb of Ysgramor to perform the ceremony.
traduit: 战友团相信有一种办法可以净化克拉科灵魂中的野兽污痕。我们要前往伊斯格拉默之墓举行仪式。

original: I helped grant Kodlak Whitemane the glory of Sovngarde, and took his place as Harbinger of the Companions.
traduit: 我帮助“白鬃”克拉科获得了松加德的荣耀，并且接任他成为战友团的先驱。

original: Attend Kodlak's funeral
traduit: 参加克拉科的葬礼

original: Give the fragments of Wuuthrad to Eorlund
traduit: 将碎片交给厄伦德

original: Retrieve Kodlak's fragment
traduit: 取回克拉科持有的碎片

original: Give the final fragment to Eorlund
traduit: 将最后的碎片交给厄伦德

original: Meet the Circle
traduit: 与圆环集会

original: Go to Ysgramor's Tomb with the Circle
traduit: 与圆环成员前往伊斯格拉默之墓

original: Return Wuuthrad to Ysgramor
traduit: 将巫斯拉德归还给伊斯格拉默

original: Get to the burial chamber
traduit: 前往墓室

original: Speak to Kodlak
traduit: 与克拉科交谈

original: Put witch head into fire
traduit: 将女巫的头放进火里

original: Defeat the wolf spirit
traduit: 击败狼灵

original: Blood's Honor
traduit: 血之荣誉

original: Kodlak Whitemane has caught wind of my secret missions with Aela and has asked to speak with me.
traduit: “白鬃”克拉科听到了我和艾拉秘密行动的风声，要和我谈一谈。

original: As part of his quest to cure his lycanthropy, Kodlak Whitemane has sent me to kill the Glenmoril Witches and bring back their heads.
traduit: 为了治愈自己的化狼症，“白鬃”克拉科派我去杀死格伦摩利女巫，把她们的头带回来。

original: I killed the Glenmoril Witches at the behest of Kodlak Whitemane, but he was killed by the Silver Hand before I could return.
traduit: 我在“白鬃”克拉科的指示下，杀了格伦摩利女巫。但我回来时，他已经被银手杀害了。

original: (Optional) Wipe out the Glenmoril Witches
traduit: （可选）消灭格伦摩利女巫

original: Return to Kodlak
traduit: 回去找克拉科

original: I've been tasked to clear the <Alias=Beast> out of <Alias=BeastVictim>'s home in <Alias=VictimHometown>.
traduit: 我接到任务要将<Alias=Beast>从<Alias=VictimHometown>的<Alias=BeastVictim>家中清除。

original: I've cleared the <Alias=Beast> out of <Alias=BeastVictim>'s home in <Alias=VictimHometown>.
traduit: 我已经将<Alias=Beast>从<Alias=VictimHometown>的<Alias=BeastVictim>家中清除了。

original: Kill the <Alias=Beast>
traduit: 杀死<Alias=Beast>

original: The Blessings of Nature
traduit: 自然的祝福

original: I've agreed to help Danica Pure-Spring repair the Gildergreen, the large tree outside the Temple of Kynareth in Whiterun.
traduit: 我同意帮助“洁春”丹尼卡修复白漫城凯娜瑞丝神殿外的镀绿树。

original: I helped Danica Pure-Spring repair the Gildergreen, a large tree central to the worship of Kynareth in Skyrim.
traduit: 我帮助“洁春”丹尼卡修复了在天际用来崇拜凯娜瑞丝的镀绿树。

original: I brought a sapling to Whiterun that will one day be the new Gildergreen, a tree sacred to the Temple of Kynareth.
traduit: 我为白漫城带回了一棵小树苗，总有一天它会长成新的镀绿树，成为凯娜瑞丝神殿的圣树。

original: Inspect the Temple of Kynareth
traduit: 调查凯娜瑞丝神殿

original: Retrieve Nettlebane
traduit: 取回刺草之祸

original: Bring Nettlebane to Danica
traduit: 将刺草之祸带给丹尼卡

traduit: 取回古光树汁液

original: Follow Maurice
traduit: 跟随毛利斯

traduit: 拿走树苗

original: Return to Danica
traduit: 回去找丹尼卡

traduit: DialogueGenericScene04
